brava-1.title: Brave New Spirits Whisky of Voodoo Coven of the Red Veil 14 Year Old Blended Grain Scotch Whisky
brava-1.bodyHtml:
Brave New Spirits Whisky of Voodoo Coven of the Red Veil is a distinctive 14 Year Old Lowland Blended Grain Scotch Whisky created from mature grain whiskies produced at North British and Cameronbridge distilleries. Released as part of Batch #3 of the Whisky of Voodoo series, this unusual small-batch expression brings together whisky influenced by first-fill St. Emilion Grand Cru wine and Jerez Sherry casks and is bottled at a powerful 58.3% ABV.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast duck, aged Gouda, toasted walnuts, charcuterie, dark chocolate or berry-based desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and fruit-driven with stewed fruit, buttery shortbread and bright orange zest accompanied by herbal freshness, toasted nuts and warming autumn spice.

Nose: Fruit compote and sweet red fruit with orange zest, buttery shortbread and subtle herbal notes.

Palate: Rich red fruit and toasted nuts develop alongside citrus, menthol, basil and warming spice.

Finish: Long and warming with lingering fruit, toasted nuts, herbal freshness and drying spice.

mission-hill-reserve-merlot.title: Mission Hill Family Estate Reserve Merlot 2022
mission-hill-reserve-merlot.bodyHtml:
Mission Hills's 2022 Reserve Merlot was grown in two of our estate vineyards. Osoyoos, the region’s most southern area, is comprised of arid benchlands that benefit from the lake’s effect providing the region with more than 200 frost-free days. This warm climate allows our Bordeaux varietals to completely ripen for full flavour. The Oliver Vineyard estate is a diverse vineyard with more than 60 different individual blocks, affording us an amazing array of premium quality fruit.

On this nose, this wine displays a rich bouquet of wild blackberry and red plum complemented by subtle notes of cedar and mocha. On the palate, this vintage reveals a blend of ripe fruit and earthy undertones, finishing with a smooth, velvety texture.

breezer-tropical-orange-smoothie.title: Breezer Tropical Orange Smoothie 1L
breezer-tropical-orange-smoothie.bodyHtml: Breezer Tropical Orange Smoothie is a premium cooler made with Bacardi rum. It features a dreamy blend of orange and vanilla flavours, creating a taste that is reminiscent of a classic orange creamsicle. This ready-to-drink cocktail is best served well chilled for a refreshing, smooth experience

strongbow-elderflower.title: Giffard Wild Elderflower Liqueur
strongbow-elderflower.bodyHtml:
Giffard Wild Elderflower Liqueur, sold in France as Fleur de Sureau Sauvage, belongs to the Premium range of Giffard, the liqueur house founded in 1885 in Avrillé near Angers in the Loire Valley. It is made from small cream-coloured wild elderflowers that are harvested by hand in spring, dried naturally and then macerated in alcohol in small batches for a rich floral aroma. The liqueur is golden yellow with fine green tints, and it was named Liqueur of the Year 2014 with a Gold Medal at Germany's ISW spirits competition. It is bottled at 20% ABV in a 700ml bottle, and is lactose free, gluten free and vegan.

Tasting Notes: Golden yellow with green tints; exotic and floral, with a fresh touch of acidity.

Nose: Powerful and exotic, with lychee and spice notes of saffron and liquorice.

Palate: Floral with a touch of acidity, mixing rose, hawthorn and fresh and dried flowers.

Serve: Enjoy on the rocks, in cocktails, or topped with sparkling wine.

strongbow-gold.title: Strongbow Gold 4 Tall Cans
strongbow-gold.bodyHtml: Strongbow Gold is a crisp and refreshing cider with a medium gold colour and light carbonation. It features perfumed aromas of ripe golden delicious apples, green apples, white pear, and sweet tree fruits, with hints of apple blossom and citrus. The taste is sweet and refreshing, light-bodied, and crisp with a smooth palate and balanced acidity, offering flavours of ripe yellow apple, green apple candy, and notes of honey and apple sauce, leading to a long, balanced sweet fruit finish .

rev-guarana.title: Rev Vodka & Guarana 473ml
rev-guarana.bodyHtml: Rev Vodka & Guarana is a bold and energizing ready-to-drink cocktail that combines premium vodka with the distinctive kick of guarana, a natural stimulant from the Amazon. This unique beverage delivers a smooth, slightly sweet flavor with herbal undertones and a crisp, invigorating finish. It's designed for those seeking a sophisticated and stimulating alternative to conventional mixed drinks.

grey-goose-vodka-2.title: Grey Goose Altius Vodka
grey-goose-vodka-2.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Altius Vodka is a ultra-premium luxury vodka crafted using French winter wheat sourced from the Picardie region and glacial spring water drawn from the French Alps. Distilled through a specialized process that includes sub-zero crystallization at -24°C, this high-altitude inspired expression achieves remarkable smoothness, extraordinary clarity, and an elevated, crisp mouthfeel.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, beluga caviar, smoked salmon, tuna sashimi, or chilled seafood platter.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear appearance with a smooth, velvety, and exceptionally cold, crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Clean and delicate with subtle floral aromas, light minerality, soft wheat, and a hint of fresh citrus.

Palate : Exceptionally smooth and rounded with delicate notes of sweet grain, soft minerality, and alpine freshness.

Finish : Ultra-clean, long, and silky with a refreshing, crisp finish and no harsh burn.

Serve : Serve neat well-chilled, served over a hand-carved ice sphere, or in an ultra-premium Vodka Martini.

bud-light-apple.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-apple.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

inniskillin-shiraz-cabernet.title: Inniskillin Shiraz Cabernet 750ml
inniskillin-shiraz-cabernet.bodyHtml: White pepper and dark berry fruit are accented by spice, vanilla and floral aromas on the aromatic nose of this red blend. The palate is well structured and balanced displaying spice and berry flavours that lead to a complex and extended finish.

martini-x-dry.title: Martini - Extra Dry Vermouth - 1L
martini-x-dry.bodyHtml: Martini is an icon, and whether you savour it on its own, or utilise within the likes of a Manhattan or Martini, you can’t deny its international appeal. But how does a brand get to enjoy such global appeal? Well lets dive into the minds of the Martini masters, starting in 1863.

martini-x-dry-1.title: Martini X-Dry 500ml
martini-x-dry-1.bodyHtml: Martini Extra Dry Vermouth celebrates refined elegance, embodying the spirit of the Italian aperitivo. First introduced on New Year's Day in 1900, this pale gold vermouth captivates with crisp, citrus-scented notes and a bright, clean finish. Its delicate perfume unfolds with hints of raspberry and lemon distillates, layered over a background of orris and subtle wood, culminating in a well-balanced freshness and a light, dry complexity .

martini-rossi-asti.title: Martini & Rossi Asti 1.5L Magnum
martini-rossi-asti.bodyHtml: This sweet sparkling wine is produced from the aromatic Moscato Bianco grape grown in the unique climate of Asti in the Piedmont region of Italy. Made with quality ingredients, this Moscato wine helps to bring friends and people together with its cool, fresh, sweet taste and pleasant aroma. You can add more sensation to the moment by pairing this Asti spumante sparkling wine bottle with hearty meats, creamy soups and fried potatoes. This bottle of wine is best served alone or in alcohol drinks like a delicious Mimosa.

ciroc-blue-stone-vodka.title: Ciroc Vodka
ciroc-blue-stone-vodka.bodyHtml: Finely crafted spirit made from distilled fine French grapes for ultimate luxury. A subtle nose is followed by a clean smooth mouthfeel delivered from five-time distillation. Delicate nuances of citrus and a hint of sweetness that allows the natural character of the grapes to shine through. An ideal mixer for lemonade.

pabst-blue-ribbon-1.title: Pabst Blue Ribbon 15 Cans
pabst-blue-ribbon-1.bodyHtml: Pabst Blue Ribbon is an American-style premium lager brewed in the finest traditions dating back to 1844. It is crafted with a combination of 2 & 6-row malted barley, select cereal grains, and a blend of hops, resulting in a smooth, full-bodied beer with a noble hop aroma and a clean, crisp finish. This is the original Pabst Blue Ribbon beer, known for its prized flavor without a hint of bitter aftertaste.

martini-bianco.title: Martini Bianco Sweet White Vermouth 1L
martini-bianco.bodyHtml:
Martini Bianco is a classic Italian sweet white vermouth crafted by Martini & Rossi, renowned for its delicate floral character, aromatic complexity and beautifully balanced sweetness. Produced in Piedmont, Italy, this elegant aperitif is made from carefully selected white wines, including Trebbiano, blended with a proprietary selection of aromatic herbs, botanicals and natural flavourings. Its pale straw-gold colour introduces an inviting bouquet of fragrant flowers, soft vanilla, fresh citrus and delicate herbal notes. Smooth and approachable on the palate, Martini Bianco reveals layers of gentle sweetness, vanilla, orchard fruit and subtle spice, complemented by a refreshing botanical bitterness that creates an elegant, harmonious balance. Its light, aromatic character and lingering finish make it a versatile expression of traditional Italian vermouth craftsmanship. Presented in a generous 1L bottle at 15% ABV, Martini Bianco captures the timeless spirit of the Italian aperitivo tradition.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with Mediterranean antipasti, marinated olives, prosciutto, fresh mozzarella, burrata, grilled artichokes and herb-seasoned focaccia. Its delicate sweetness and aromatic herbal character also complement smoked salmon, grilled prawns, mild cheeses, roasted almonds and lightly spiced appetizers.

Tasting Notes: A smooth and aromatic sweet white vermouth offering delicate floral notes, vanilla, fresh citrus, gentle spice and subtle herbal bitterness, with a refreshing and balanced character.

Nose: Fragrant aromas of vanilla, white flowers, fresh herbs and citrus peel, complemented by delicate orchard fruit and subtle spice.

Palate: Smooth, lightly sweet and aromatic, revealing vanilla, pear, melon, citrus and floral botanicals, balanced by gentle herbal bitterness and refreshing acidity.

Finish: Soft, elegant and gently bittersweet, with lingering vanilla, citrus zest and delicate herbal notes.

foothills-gluten-free-vodka.title: Foothills Gluten Free Vodka
foothills-gluten-free-vodka.bodyHtml: Foothills Gluten Free Vodka is one of the rare 10-times distilled vodkas, delivering maximum smoothness and purity. Produced from select Alberta corn, it is both wheat-free and gluten-free, ensuring it is suitable for even the most sensitive consumer. This premium vodka offers a clean, smooth taste with a silky texture and subtle notes of sweetness, making it an ideal base for a wide range of cocktails.

bacardi-gran-reserva-limitada-rum.title: Bacardi Reserva Ocho 8 Year Old Rare Gold Rum
bacardi-gran-reserva-limitada-rum.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Reserva Ocho is an aged gold rum made by Bacardí in Cataño, Puerto Rico, and known within the brand as its Family Reserve. The blend is inspired by a Bacardí family recipe from 1862, and the rum is aged for at least eight years before bottling. Bacardí describes the result as a complex golden rum with a deep, layered and mellow character built on dried fruit, spice and oaky vanilla, with stone-fruit notes emerging from the long ageing. It is labelled Rare Gold Rum, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, and the producer suggests drinking it neat or in a classic Old Fashioned.

Tasting Notes: Dried fruit, spice and oaky vanilla.

Nose: Dried apricot and banana leaf.

Palate: Oak and spice.

Finish: Expansive and well rounded.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or stirred into an Old Fashioned.

aberfeldy-16-year-old.title: Aberfeldy 16 Year Old
aberfeldy-16-year-old.bodyHtml:
Aberfeldy 16 Year Old is a premium and luxuriously rich Highland single malt Scotch whisky that exemplifies the distillery's signature honeyed profile, elevated by an indulgent wood finish. Matured for 16 years in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks, this expression undergoes a crucial finishing period in premium Spanish Oloroso sherry casks. This additional step introduces deep layers of dark fruits, baking spices, and fruitcake complexity to the classic "Golden Dram" foundation of lush heather honey and smooth malt, creating a beautifully rounded and mature sipping experience.

Food Pairing: This richly sherried and honeyed whisky pairs magnificently with slow-roasted pork belly, duck breast with a cherry reduction, or prime rib. It is also an exceptional companion to rich desserts like sticky toffee pudding, dark chocolate truffles, and a mature cheese board featuring aged Gouda or Stilton blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber with copper reflections, exhibiting a medium-to-full body with a soft, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Heather honey, rich stewed dark fruits, raisins, vanilla fudge, cloves, and polished oak.

Palate : Creamy and mouth-coating with flavors of honeyed cereal, sweet citrus, dark chocolate, fruitcake, dried figs, and warm baking spices.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of sherry sweetness, cocoa, gentle spice, and toasted oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of spring water to open up the delicate floral honey and rich sherry fruit layers.

smirnoff-ice-vii-original.title: Smirnoff Ice Vii Original 473ml
smirnoff-ice-vii-original.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Ice VII Original is a sweet, citrus-flavored malt beverage with a crisp taste. This ready-to-drink cooler is a vodka-based cooler full of citrus, lemonade, lime, and grapefruit flavors, designed to be enjoyed chilled straight from the can

smirnoff-ice-light-black-cherry-soda.title: Smirnoff Ice Light Black Cherry & Soda 4 Cans
smirnoff-ice-light-black-cherry-soda.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Ice Light Black Cherry & Soda is a light and refreshing ready-to-drink cooler. It features the perfect blend of juicy fruitiness, allowing you to indulge in the flavours of black cherry, vanilla, and maraschino cherry in a lower-calorie beverage. The palate is delicately balanced with active carbonation and finishes lightly sweet, making it a thirst-quenching choice.

smirnoff-ice-light-white-peach-soda.title: Smirnoff Ice Light White Peach & Soda 4 Cans
smirnoff-ice-light-white-peach-soda.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Ice Light White Peach & Soda is a light and refreshing ready-to-drink cooler. It features the perfect blend of juicy fruitiness, allowing you to indulge in the crisp flavours of ripe peach and nectar in this low-calorie beverage. The palate is delicately balanced with active carbonation and finishes lightly sweet, making it a thirst-quenching choice

smirnoff-ice-light-raspberry-soda.title: Smirnoff Ice Light Raspberry & Soda 4 Cans
smirnoff-ice-light-raspberry-soda.bodyHtml: A lighter version of the original flavoured cocktail from Smirnoff, this light and refreshing, fruity offer is perfectly balanced with notes of raspberry jam. The palate is light and fruity with lively carbonation, providing a delicious tartness and light sweet taste in a refreshing soda cocktail.

kilkenny-draught.title: Kilkenny Draught 4 Tall Cans
kilkenny-draught.bodyHtml: Kilkenny Draught 4 Tall Cans is a classic Irish cream ale celebrated for its rich copper colour, velvety texture, and smooth, balanced flavour. Produced by Guinness under Diageo, this nitrogenated ale delivers the creamy draught experience of a traditional Irish pub. Its distinctive character combines roasted malt, caramel sweetness, subtle coffee notes, and gentle hop bitterness. At 4.3% ABV, Kilkenny offers a medium-bodied drinking experience with a dense, creamy head and a satisfyingly smooth finish.

coole-swan-irish-cream.title: Coole Swan Irish Cream Liqueur
coole-swan-irish-cream.bodyHtml:
Coole Swan Irish Cream Liqueur is a premium Irish cream from an independent, family-run Irish company. It blends fresh Irish dairy cream with single malt Irish whiskey and Belgian white chocolate, and the producer says the recipe was only settled on the 231st attempt and contains no artificial flavourings. The name comes from W.B. Yeats's poem The Wild Swans at Coole, written at Coole Park in County Galway, and the bottle is modelled on a nineteenth-century Irish milk bottle. At 16% ABV it is smooth and medium-bodied, with white chocolate, fresh cream and a soft whiskey note leading to a long, rich finish.

Tasting Notes: Belgian white chocolate, fresh cream and a gentle Irish whiskey character.

Serve: Always chilled: neat, over ice, in coffee or poured over vanilla ice cream.

talisker-port-ruighe.title: Talisker Port Ruighe
talisker-port-ruighe.bodyHtml: Port Ruighe, pronounced Port ree is finished in ruby port casks. Aromas of plum, citrus, seaweed and cranberry lead to flavours of chocolate, vanilla, peat and oak with smoky, briny and medicinal notes. The port finish rounds out the palate and adds layers of sweet, rich berry fruit on the finish. Serve neat or on ice.

lonetree-ginger-apple.title: Lonetree Ginger Apple 6 Cans
lonetree-ginger-apple.bodyHtml: We believe the old ways are still the best. That's why we always use genuine apples to craft our authentic cider selections. Now, we've added a zesty twist of real ginger, for an exotic and lightly spicy cider experience. We know you'll taste the difference. This cider is crafted with locally sourced genuine apples, making it naturally gluten-free.

robert-mondavi-oakville-bdx-red-blend.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Bordeaux Red Blend 2018
robert-mondavi-oakville-bdx-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Firm in structure and rich in texture-a different expression of Oakville. Not produced every vintage, this special wine has deep, blackberry fruit with savoury and white sage flavours balanced by sweet oak spices.
