chapoutier-rasteau-cotes-du-rhone.title: M. Chapoutier Les Gadilles Rasteau 2020
chapoutier-rasteau-cotes-du-rhone.bodyHtml:
M. Chapoutier Les Gadilles Rasteau is a bold and elegant red wine that reflects the depth and character of its Rhône Valley terroir. Made from a blend of Grenache and Syrah, this wine delivers powerful aromas, generous structure, and a refined balance, making it a standout choice for those who appreciate rich and full-bodied reds.

Pairs beautifully with classic French cuisine such as Boeuf Bourguignon, roasted meats, and hearty stews. Its robust character also complements aged cheeses and rustic Mediterranean dishes.

90 Points - James Suckling

Attractive nose of plum, mint and leather. Ripe and fleshy, but also well structured with rather fine tannin that neatly supports the full body. Plenty of spice at the finish. Drink or hold.

chateau-de-courteillac.title: Chateau De Courteillac
chateau-de-courteillac.bodyHtml:
Château De Courteillac is an expressive, fruit-forward, and well-balanced Bordeaux red wine originating from clay and limestone soils on the plateau of the Entre-Deux-Mers region. In the glass, it displays a bright ruby-red color. The bouquet delivers charming aromas of ripe dark plum, black cherry, and red currant, layered with delicate herbal undertones, toasted oak, and subtle spices. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, round, and smooth, offering rich dark berry flavors supported by supple tannins and vibrant natural acidity that leads to a clean, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roast beef, grilled lamb chops, braised pork tenderloin, wood-fired pizza, savory pasta, and medium-aged cheeses.

chateau-le-puy-emilien-2017.title: Chateau Le Puy Emilien 2021 750ml
chateau-le-puy-emilien-2017.bodyHtml:
The fruit of a plot of vines planted with 85% Merlot, 7% cabernet franc, 6% cabernet sauvignon, 1% malbec and 1% carménère,, Emilien is matured in oak barrels and casks for 24 months.

The robe is garnet red, with hints of ruby in the younger wines and a touch of orange in the older vintages, with a diaphanous onion-skin finesse to the oldest bottles. The nose is fruity, with ripe red fruit aromas dominated by blackcurrant and redcurrant, accented with roasted almond notes and occasional hints of mushrooms and undergrowth. The palate is well-rounded, full-bodied and precise, with velvety tannins paving the way for a finish is long and enjoyably complex. A wine of great finesse, with smooth tannins in its youth but also the potential to age and grow for several decades, revealing the full depth and character of this prestigious terroir.

A wine blessed with superb longevity, which will serve as a perfect partner for traditional rustic dishes and delicate, complex cuisine alike. A small miracle of elegance and refinement.

chateau-magnol.title: Chateau Magnol Haut-Medoc 2023
chateau-magnol.bodyHtml:
Chateau Magnol Haut-Médoc 2023 is a refined and structured Bordeaux red blend that serves as the flagship wine and headquarters for the historic Barton & Guestier house. Classified as a Cru Bourgeois Supérieur, this vintage is noted for its "crystalline precision," offering a brilliant ruby colour and an expressive bouquet of blackcurrant, black cherry, and subtle spicy notes. On the palate, it is full-bodied yet harmonious, balancing ripe, silky tannins with a long, savory finish featuring hints of vanilla, liquorice, and toasted oak from its 12-month maturation in French oak barrels. Sourced from a 30-hectare vineyard with sand and gravel soils near Bordeaux, it is certified High Environmental Value (HVE) Level 3, reflecting a commitment to sustainable viticulture.

92 Points - James Suckling

A solid and structured red with medium body and very fine, compact tannins. Succulent and lively with good focus and length.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This estate,'s vineyards at the southern end of the Haut-Médoc region close to the city of Bordeaux, has produced a smooth, ripe wine. The spice and licorice aroma lead to black currant flavors and balanced juicy acidity, with touches of the wood aging coming through at the end. Drink from 2028.

chateau-montelena-cabernet-sauvignon-201.title: Inglenook 1882 Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
chateau-montelena-cabernet-sauvignon-201.bodyHtml:
Inglenook 1882 Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 is a classic, expressive, and historic Napa Valley red wine crafted to honor Gustave Niebaum’s inaugural vintage at Inglenook. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyard blocks—including Chateau, Cohn, and Red Barn—rooted in the deep, gravelly loam soils of the Rutherford Bench, it displays a deep garnet-red hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is inviting and nuanced, revealing aromas of ripe black cherries, macerated plums, and fresh cassis layered over undertones of dark cocoa powder, cedar, sweet pipe tobacco, and subtle baking spices derived from 18 months of aging in French oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied, vibrant, and supple, delivering a solid core of juicy dark fruits framed by refined, fine-grained "Rutherford dust" tannins and balanced natural acidity, concluding in a structured, long, and lightly spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, rosemary venison medallions, and aged white cheddar or gouda cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A solid cabernet with lots of blackberry, chocolate and walnut character. It's full-bodied with plenty of fruit and a flavourful finish. Juicy and intense. Needs time to soften and mellow.

chateau-pesquie-quintessence-rouge-2018.title: Chateau Pesquie Quintessence 2022
chateau-pesquie-quintessence-rouge-2018.bodyHtml:
Quintessence Rouge was first made in 1990 by Paul Chaudière under the urging of his new American importer, Eric Solomon, who loved the character of Syrah he tasted at Château Pesquié. At that time, this region was considered a backwater of the Rhône, only capable of producing cheap, bulk wine. However, largely due to the efforts of Paul and now his sons Alex and Fred, the Ventoux’s reputation has never been greater, and Quintessence remains one of the benchmark wines of the region and still represents a tremendous value. Quintessence is a blend of primarily Syrah with a small proportion of Grenache (~20%) – all from 50+-year-old vines planted at an elevation of 250-350m.

90 Points - James Suckling

A robust, structured and driven red Ventoux expressing notes of currants, black olives, and dried herbs, this is full-bodied with chewy tannins and a fleshy texture. Flavorful finish with a sweet spice and licorice character. Drink or hold.

chateau-pesquie-terrasses-rose-2018.title: Chateau Pesquie Rose 750ml
chateau-pesquie-terrasses-rose-2018.bodyHtml:
Mineral and complex, the Terrasses rosé has a shimmering colour and a bouquet of red berries and citrus fruits on the palate.

WINE TASTING
Color : Very pale rosé, bright and limpid.
Nose : Flavors of small fresh red berries and citrus fruits.
Mouth : The mouth offers a great balance and freshness with aromas of gooseberries, raspberries and citrus, with floral notes.

FOOD & WINE PAIRINGS
"Les Terrasses" rosé is a delightful aperitif. Suited to grilled meats and fishes, raw or grilled vegetables, charcuterie, soft white cheese, asiatic dishes (sweet and sour chicken). Fresh fruit based desserts and sorbet.

90 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
"A crisp, dry, and refreshing Provencal-style rosé with beautiful notes of red berries and citrus. Perfectly balanced and incredibly delicious."


89 Points - Wine Spectator
"Bright and lively with strawberry and peach notes. A clean, well-made rosé that overdelivers for its price point."

chateau-pesquie-terrasses-rouge-2018.title: Chateau Pesquie Ventoux Terrasses 750ml
chateau-pesquie-terrasses-rouge-2018.bodyHtml:
Profoundly anchored in the Ventoux terroir, Grenache and Syrah express themselves here, with brilliance, indulgence and suppleness.

WINE TASTING
Color: deep ruby color.
Nose: intense nose with spicy notes (especially black pepper) and red berries.
Mouth: this very balanced wine offers very round tannins and fresh berries aromas, with some floral and spicy flavors.

FOOD & WINE PAIRINGS
Very easy to match. With simple dishes such as pizzas, kebabs, charcuterie, vegetable pies or salads to more ambitious cuisine like terrines, poultry (guineafowl, turkey...), roasted or grilled meats.

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
"A brilliant, overachieving Rhône blend that punches well above its weight. Offers up a classic, garrigue-laced bouquet of ripe cherries and peppery spices. Medium-bodied, silky, and incredibly delicious."


90 Points - Wine Spectator
"Inviting aromas of raspberry, lavender and thyme. This is fresh and focused, with a silky frame and a finish that echoes the aromatic notes. A terrific value."

chateau-st-jean-cinq-cepages-2016.title: Chateau St. Jean Cinq Cepages 2022
chateau-st-jean-cinq-cepages-2016.bodyHtml:
Château St. Jean Cinq Cépages 2022 is a rich, complex, and full-bodied California red blend crafted from vineyards across Sonoma County. The flagship wine of the estate, its name translates to "five varieties," representing the traditional Bordeaux grapes featured in the blend. On the nose, it offers rich aromas of dark plum, crème de cassis, dried lavender, and dark chocolate, layered with graphite and subtle toasted oak notes. The palate is dense, velvety, and well-structured, featuring powerful black fruit flavors, integrated tannins, and dynamic, long-lasting acidity.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, braised short ribs, or sharp aged cheddar cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

This long-running Bordeaux-style blend is a classic, reserve-style wine that’s dense, layered and polished, but also deep and long. Blended from some of Foley group’s best barrels using grapes from all around Sonoma County. Savory, floral and lavender aromas, with graphite, dark chocolate and creme de cassis flavors that expand on the palate and linger on the finish. 73% cabernet sauvignon, plus merlot, cabernet franc, malbec and petit verdot. Sustainable. Drinkable now, but best from 2029.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of cherry, black plum and bitter cocoa powder flow from the glass on the nose of this blend. The palate is punchy and weighty, with loads of gripping tannin, spice and crushed berry flavors. Best from 2030-2040.

chivas-regal-12-year-old-2.title: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old
chivas-regal-12-year-old-2.bodyHtml:
Chivas Regal 12 Year Old is a classic, world-renowned blended Scotch whisky created by the Chivas Brothers in Aberdeen, Scotland. Crafted from a selection of fine malt and grain whiskies—with Strathisla single malt at its heart—this signature expression is aged for a minimum of 12 years. It delivers a smooth, rich, and accessible Speyside-influenced profile known for its balance of orchard fruits, wild herbs, and sweet honey.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork loin, smoked salmon, creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert, apple pie, and shortbread biscuits.

Tasting Notes : Radiant, warm amber color. Smooth, round, and creamy texture with a light-to-medium body.

Nose : An aromatic infusion of wild herbs, heather, honey, and orchard fruits like ripe apples and peaches.

Palate : Rich and fruity with flavors of sweet honey, poached apples, vanilla, butterscotch, and subtle hazelnut notes.

Finish : Smooth and lingering with gentle notes of oak spice, honey, and subtle maltiness.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed into classic cocktail recipes such as a Highball or Rob Roy.

chivas-regal-18-year-old-1.title: Chivas Regal 18 Year Old Gold Signature
chivas-regal-18-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Chivas is known globally for creating rich and indulgent blends and this is no exception. Multi-layered aromas with hints of dried fruits, buttery toffee and dark chocolate on the nose with a velvety, dark chocolate palate yields to floral notes and a wisp of sweet, mellow smokiness followed by a warm, long finish.

In the early 1800s, the Chivas brothers start storing whisky casks in their grocery store, to eventually blend them and sell them to their clients. After perfecting the art of blending, their Scotches reach international fame at the end of the 19th century. Chivas Regal 18 Year-Old Gold Signature was created in 1997 by Master Blender Colin Scott. It is an elegant and complex blend displaying fragrances of chocolate, butterscotch and dried fruit.

chivas-regal-25-year-old-1.title: Chivas Regal 25 Year Old
chivas-regal-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
At 25 years old, this whisky is a perfect representation of the art of aging. The extended maturation period allows the blend to develop a rich depth and complexity, setting it apart from younger expressions.

Chivas Regal 25 Year Old boasts a luxuriously smooth and rich profile with a harmonious balance of flavours. Notes of dark fruits, honey, creamy chocolate, and subtle spices create an indulgent and satisfying experience for the palate.

As a blended Scotch whisky, Chivas Regal 25 Year Old is a testament to the art and skill of blending. Master blenders carefully select and combine the finest malt and grain whiskies to create a harmonious, perfectly balanced, and sophisticated spirit.

The Chivas Regal 25 Year Old is not as widely available as some of its younger counterparts, making it a sought-after and exclusive addition to any whisky collection. As part of the Chivas Regal line, the 25 Year Old carries the prestige and reputation of a brand with over two centuries of heritage in crafting exceptional Scotch whisky. This rich history adds to the allure and appreciation of this luxurious expression.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements dark chocolate truffles, crème brûlée, fruit tarts, roasted duck, glazed ham, foie gras, and aged cheeses such as Comté, Gruyère, or mature cheddar.

chivas-regal-mizunara.title: Chivas Regal Mizunara
chivas-regal-mizunara.bodyHtml: Inspired by the Japanese discernment and art integrated with the world of whisky, Master Blender Sandy Hyslop travelled to Japan to seek out the best Mizunara oak casks. Following visits to a Japanese cooperage and meeting with the Master Cooper, they together agreed the exact specification of the casks and built a relationship that stands strong today. Chivas Mizunara represents true collaboration between two whisky-loving nations.

chopin-potato-vodka.title: Luksusowa Potato Vodka 1.14L
chopin-potato-vodka.bodyHtml:
Luksusowa Potato Vodka is a classic Polish vodka distilled entirely from potatoes and made since 1928; the name signals the brand's focus on top-quality spirit. Using potatoes rather than grain gives a naturally rich, velvety texture while keeping the profile clean and crisp, so it is smooth enough to sip ice-cold and neutral enough to anchor classic cocktails such as a Martini. Produced by Polmos Zielona Gora in Poland and bottled at 40% ABV in this 1.14L size.

Tasting Notes: Clean and crisp with a subtly creamy, velvety texture.

Serve: Ice-cold and neat, or in a classic Martini.

cinzano-rosso-1.title: Cinzano Vermouth Rosso 1L
cinzano-rosso-1.bodyHtml:
Created in Torino, Cinzano is authentically Italian. Established in 1757, with over 250 years of heritage, Cinzano is about consistent quality that remains constant through time, enduring generations and passing trends.

Over ice with a splash of soda, garnished with an orance slice and olive, or as the perfect incredient for cocktails such as the Americano, thanks to its delicate, yet persistent aftertaste.

90 Points - Ultimate Spirits Challenge
A classic and well-balanced vermouth with nuanced botanicals, gentle bitterness, and subtle sweetness. Perfect for cocktails or sipping neat.
88 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Offers pleasant herbal and citrus notes with a smooth, approachable profile. A versatile and reliable fortified wine.

ciroc-coconut.title: Ciroc Passion Vodka
ciroc-coconut.bodyHtml: Crafted with flavor in mind, CÎROC Passion is distilled from fine French grapes and masterfully infused with an exotic blend inspired by the tropics. Featuring notes of pineapple, mango, citrus, hibiscus, and other natural flavors, it offers a taste experience that's both lusciously unique and elegantly smooth. As a finishing touch, the vodka is encased in a bottle with a distinctive ombre colorway of purple and orange resembling the bright tones of sunset with sleek gold lettering that's sure to stand out on any table.

ciroc-mango.title: Ciroc Passion Vodka
ciroc-mango.bodyHtml: Crafted with flavor in mind, CÎROC Passion is distilled from fine French grapes and masterfully infused with an exotic blend inspired by the tropics. Featuring notes of pineapple, mango, citrus, hibiscus, and other natural flavors, it offers a taste experience that's both lusciously unique and elegantly smooth. As a finishing touch, the vodka is encased in a bottle with a distinctive ombre colorway of purple and orange resembling the bright tones of sunset with sleek gold lettering that's sure to stand out on any table.

ciroc-summer-watermelon.title: Ciroc Summer Watermelon Vodka
ciroc-summer-watermelon.bodyHtml: This fresh and fruity spirit is distilled five times resulting in a cocktail-friendly spirit. Anticipate attractive notes of ripe summer watermelon which lead to a crisp, clean finish. This is perfect over ice with tonic water alongside a fresh fruit salad or create a watermelon martini.

clase-azul-anejo.title: Clase Azul Añejo Tequila
clase-azul-anejo.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Añejo Tequila (also known as “Edición Indígena-Mazahua” or Mazahua Edition due to the bottle design’s tribute to the culture) is an ultra-premium añejo tequila made from 100% Tequilana Weber Blue Agave. Clase Azul Tequila Añejo is proof that the best things in life take time. Its intense amber color and complex, layered aromas are the result of a magnificent 25-month journey in American whiskey casks. Combining art, history, and tequila of the highest quality, this expression truly honors Mexican culture and tradition inside an iconic, handcrafted ceramic decanter.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-braised meats like pork carnitas or birria, mole negro, rich roasted duck, aged cheeses, and indulgent dark chocolate or caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber color with bright copper reflections and a rich, heavy body with a silky, velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Mexican vanilla, cinnamon, clove, toasted oak, hazelnut, dried fruit, and dark chocolate.

Palate : Silky and complex on the palate with rich notes of toasted oak, nutmeg, sweet agave, dark chocolate, caramel, and orange peel.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warming finish featuring lingering notes of sweet toasted oak, dried fruit, vanilla, and gentle baking spices.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip-shaped glass or Tequila Riedel glass to fully appreciate its complex aromas and flavors.

clase-azul-reposado.title: Clase Azul Reposado Tequila
clase-azul-reposado.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila made from 100% Blue Weber Agave, harvested in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Cooked slowly in traditional brick ovens and distilled twice in copper pot stills, it is aged for eight months in American whiskey casks. This aging process imparts a silky texture, rich hazelnut and vanilla flavors, and a smooth profile. Encased in Clase Azul's iconic, hand-painted ceramic decanter featuring cobalt blue feather designs, it stands as an international symbol of luxury and Mexican craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-cooked pork carnitas, grilled ribeye steak, aged cheeses such as Manchego, mole poblano, dark chocolate desserts, or vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Intense amber color with copper highlights and a smooth, rich, medium-to-full body with a silky mouthfeel.

Nose : Agave nectar, vanilla, candied orange peel, toasted oak, hazelnut, and subtle hints of cinnamon.

Palate : Smooth and complex with rich flavors of cooked agave, toasted oak, vanilla, clove, hazelnut, and soft caramel.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant finish with lingering notes of sweet agave, vanilla, toasted wood, and gentle baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip-shaped glass or Tequila Riedel glass to fully appreciate its aromas and flavor profile.

clase-azul-silver.title: Clase Azul Plata Tequila
clase-azul-silver.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Plata Tequila is an ultra-premium unaged tequila crafted from 100% Blue Weber Agave harvested in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. The agave pinas are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours before extraction and fermentation using proprietary yeast. Distilled twice in copper stills, this blanco tequila captures the bright, natural sweetness and pure herbal character of agave, presented in a signature hand-painted ceramic decanter.

Food Pairing: Fresh seafood, ceviche, grilled fish tacos, fresh goat cheese, citrus-based salads, or light appetizers.

Tasting Notes : A vibrant, crystal-clear unaged tequila with a light-to-medium body and a smooth, crisp texture.

Nose : Fresh agave, lemongrass, lime zest, mint, orange blossom, and subtle green apple.

Palate : Naturally sweet with vibrant fresh agave, herbal notes, vanilla, citrus, and delicate white pepper.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering sweet agave, light spice, and a warm, smooth finish.

Serve : Serve neat or on the rocks in a tulip glass or tequila snifter.

clase-azul-ultra-aged-anejo.title: Clase Azul Ultra Extra Añejo Tequila
clase-azul-ultra-aged-anejo.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Ultra is just that - an ultra-premium, extra añejo tequila and our brand’s crown jewel. Ultra is produced in limited quantities and has quickly become a collector and aficionado favorite! Its decanter includes 3 precious metals: pure platinum, sterling silver and 24-carat gold.

Clase Azul Ultra is aged for five years in previously used sherry wood casks from Spain, which gives Clase Azul Ultra its unique, refined character.

COLOR: Dark amber
BODY: Silky, rich and full
AROMA: Wood, fruit, intense sherry notes with hints of caramel and vanilla
TASTE: Smooth, flavorful, elegant with hints of sweet and oak.

clos-dargentine-gran-corte-red-blend-201.title: Clos D'Argentine Red Blend Gran Corte 750ml
clos-dargentine-gran-corte-red-blend-201.bodyHtml: Clos d'Argentine Red Blend Gran Corte 750ml is a high-elevation blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, and Cabernet Franc. It's known for its dark, rich fruit and spice notes. This wine has aromas of blackberries, blackcurrants, and plums, along with bay leaves and sweet spices. It's medium-bodied with sinewy tannins and a tight, tangy finish. The blend is aged in new French oak, adding notes of vanilla, caramel, and cedar.

clos-dargentine-reserva-malbec-2014.title: Clos D'Argentine Winemaker's Selection Reserva Malbec 2014 750ml
clos-dargentine-reserva-malbec-2014.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2014 vintage) "Ripe aromas of blackberry drift towards raisin and animal fur. This is immensely full in body, with ripping tartaric acidity. Flavors of coconut and vanilla are oak based, while blackberry fruit finishes bold, but with a reverb of choppy tartaric acidity. Drink through 2022. Michael Schachner" - Wine Enthusiast

clos-de-loratoire-des-pape-chateauneuf-d.title: Laurence Feraud Chateauneuf du Pape
clos-de-loratoire-des-pape-chateauneuf-d.bodyHtml:
A rich and expressive Southern Rhône red with ripe blackberry, plum and red cherry layered with dried herbs, violet, pepper and savoury spice. Full-bodied yet balanced, the palate combines generous fruit with supple tannins and earthy complexity, leading to a long, warming finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roasted lamb, grilled beef, duck, braised meats, Provençal herbs, mushroom dishes or mature hard cheeses.

cloudy-bay-pinot-noir-2016.title: Cloudy Bay Pinot Noir 2022
cloudy-bay-pinot-noir-2016.bodyHtml:
Open and expressive on the nose, with notes of wild hedgerow fruits, crushed rose petals and sun-warmed red cherry. The palate is finely tuned, with silky tannins and a pure dart of acidity framing and balancing out a core of summer berries, soft spices and a touch of biscuity vanilla. Long on the finish, this wine evokes warm summer evenings, strawberries nestled under shaded leaves and the lingering scent of barbecue smoke.

Versatility is this Pinot Noir’s calling card. It matches with a wide variety of foods, including lighter game meats (duck, rabbit), lamb, roasted vegetables, berries, herbs and almost anything chargrilled.

92 Points - James Suckling

Enticing aromas of plums, orange peel and strawberries with hints of mushrooms that follow through to a medium body with soft, fine tannins and a fresh finish. Tangy and vivid at the end.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Approachable and elegant, with a creamy quality to the seamless mix of maraschino cherry, framboise, lingonberry preserves and Earl Grey. Touches of loamy earth and cedar add an appealingly firming note on the finish. Drink now. 22,000 cases made, 1,500 cases imported.

clynelish-14-year-old-1.title: Clynelish 14 Year Old
clynelish-14-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Clynelish 14 Year Old is the flagship single malt of Clynelish Distillery in Brora, Sutherland, on Scotland's remote north-east coast. Labelled a Coastal Highland whisky, it is closer to an island style than most mainland malts, with a fragrant, waxy character and a long, fresh-fruity finish. This 14-year-old is bottled at 46% ABV and is lighter in weight than many Highland malts, which makes it very drinkable and an excellent aperitif. The distillery's wildcat emblem comes from the Sutherland coat of arms, and Clynelish was originally established in 1819. 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Firm, light-to-medium body with a coastal, maritime character.

Nose: Scented candle wax (more with water), dried flowers by the sea, then brown sugar.

Palate: Creamy mouthfeel, broadly maritime.

Finish: A touch of salt; dryish with an appealing, slightly bitter edge.

Serve: Neat or with a little water in a traditional whisky glass.

codigo-1530-anejo.title: Codigo 1530 Anejo Tequila
codigo-1530-anejo.bodyHtml:
Código 1530 Añejo (Aged 18 Months) is carefully aged for 18 months in the finest French White Oak wine barrels and has been lauded by tequila experts as the finest Añejo tequila available.

There is never a corner cut in Código 1530’s production. The sole purpose is to make the most selective tequila in the world using only perfect inputs and age-old secret family processes. Codigo 1530 uses only fully-matured Blue Weber Agave and Amatitán water from freshwater pools and rainwater, filtered through the volcanic soil of Los Bajos. Codigo 1530's proprietary chopper allows them to extract only the best juice and pulp from the first press of agave to garner the purest flavor.

Código 1530’s tequila offerings have been perfected using time-honored customs without ever veering from the historic traditions of including no added chemicals, flavorings, or sweeteners, to maintain the rich, natural flavor of Los Bajos agave. We use the finest Napa Cabernet French White Oak Barrels in our time-honored family aging process, embracing the clean elegance of wine making to produce a uniquely delicate finish.

AWARDS & ACCOLADES
• 2018 - Double Gold, Stuttgart International Spirits Competition
• 2016 Platinum Best in Class Añejo Tequila, SIP Awards
• Añejo of the Year, NY International Spirits Competition

codigo-1530-reposado.title: Codigo 1530 Reposado Tequila
codigo-1530-reposado.bodyHtml:
Código 1530 Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agave in Amatitán, Jalisco. Aged for six months in uncharred French white oak Cabernet wine barrels sourced from Napa Valley, it strikes an extraordinary balance between rich cooked agave flavors and delicate oak complexity with gentle fruit and vanilla nuances.

Food Pairing: Grilled pork tenderloin, roasted chicken, fish tacos, mole dishes, mild goat cheese, or light fruit desserts.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden straw with a smooth, velvety, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet cooked agave, bright citrus, subtle vanilla, toasted oak, and light red fruit notes.

Palate : Rich cooked agave, gentle oak spice, vanilla, caramel, toasted almonds, and subtle floral hints.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet agave, soft wood spice, and vanilla.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tequila glass, on the rocks, or as a base for an elevated Old Fashioned or Margarita.

codigo-1530-rosa.title: Codigo 1530 Rosa Tequila
codigo-1530-rosa.bodyHtml:
Código 1530 Rosa Tequila is a premium blanco tequila that is rested for 21 days in unsearred French White Oak Cabernet wine barrels from Napa Valley. This brief aging process imparts a natural pale pink hue along with subtle red fruit notes, elevating the pure, crisp profile of fully matured estate-grown Blue Weber agave without overwhelming its essential blanco characteristics.

Food Pairing: Fresh salmon sashimi, grilled shrimp tacos, goat cheese crostini, strawberry salads, or light ceviche.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant pale pink with a light, silky, and refined mouthfeel.

Nose : Subtle floral notes, fresh red berries, light cherry, cooked agave, and bright citrus.

Palate : Soft and balanced with sweet cooked agave, light red wine fruitiness, subtle berry notes, and a hint of white pepper.

Finish : Clean, smooth, and dry with lingering red fruit accents and soft floral sweetness.

Serve : Serve chilled, neat in a tasting glass, on the rocks, or as an elevated base for a Rosé Paloma.

collosorbo-brunello-di-montalcino-2014.title: Collosorbo Brunello di Montalcino 2020
collosorbo-brunello-di-montalcino-2014.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Collosorbo Brunello di Montalcino is an expressive and elegantly structured red that captures the warm, balanced personality of this five-star vintage. Sourced from estate vineyards featuring a rare mix of red clay, galestro, and limestone, this wine is crafted by a dedicated trio of women: owner Giovanna Ciacci and her daughters Laura and Lucia. It offers a ripe and expressive nose of black cherries, baked strawberries, and raspberries, interwoven with delicate floral notes of macerated violets and fresh roses. On the palate, it is full-bodied and supple, showcasing glossy, ripe tannins and a vibrant core of acidity. Aged for three years in Slavonian and French oak barrels, it displays sophisticated tertiary notes of old leather, pepper, and malted chocolate leading to a persistent, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: This robust red pairs beautifully with roasted game meats, grilled ribeye steaks, wild boar ragù, or aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

93 Points - James Suckling

Overt and ripe style to this wine. Fresh roses, black cherries and raspberries, together with macerated violets. The attack is firm yet balanced, with ripe, velvety tannins that turn chalkier in texture on the finish, fresh acidity and medium to full body. Despite the warmth at the end, it’s youthful and good. Best after 2025.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

On the nose, aromas of old leather, pepper, malted chocolate and dried cherries swirl from the glass, while the palate places cherries and blackberries alongside more chocolate, then sprinkles salt and pepper over everything. A squeeze of citrus and a pop of acid light up the finish.

collosorbo-brunello-di-montalcino-riserv.title: Collosorbo Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2019
collosorbo-brunello-di-montalcino-riserv.bodyHtml:
Collosorbo Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2019 is an exceptional and deeply structured Italian red wine produced only in the finest harvest years. Crafted from a meticulous selection of the estate's oldest and best vineyards, it opens with a concentrated and complex bouquet of ripe dark plums, blackberries, warm leather, and subtle hints of dark chocolate and savory tobacco. On the palate, it delivers a powerful, full-bodied experience marked by tightly knit, velvety tannins and a vibrant acidic framework that leads to an incredibly long, expansive finish.

Food Pairing: This robust and structured Riserva pairs beautifully with slow-roasted wild game, prime cuts of grilled red meat, hearty beef stews, or aged Pecorino cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

This opens up with a concentrated nose reminiscent of bark, dark plums and a touch of licorice. The palate is full-bodied and firm, showing plush tannins and an underlying vibrancy that follows through to a tightly wound finish with a hint of dark cherries. From organically grown grapes. Better from 2026.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is sweet, earthy and herbaceous, as aromas of pepper and top soil come first, followed by vanilla and cherries. Oranges join those sweeter notes on the palate, but the overall sensation is earthy, chalky and dense, a feeling which is emphasized by tannins.

colome-estate-malbec-2018.title: Colome Malbec Estate 2022 750ml
colome-estate-malbec-2018.bodyHtml:
Bright and intense in color with beautiful aromas of blackberries, red fruits and exotic floral notes, this wine delivers aromatics that entice the senses. A full lush entry of ripe and rich black fruit surrounds spiced oak notes and hints of pepper. Fresh acidity supports big, bold tannins and wonderful complexity.

91 Points Wine Spectator

The opening notes of toasted herbs and spiced chocolate suggest a rich and dark version, yet the core of this red shows pure raspberry and cherry flavors. A nice layer of minerally freshness underneath drives the finish around precise tannins.

cono-sur-organic-cabernet-sauvignon-carm.title: Cono Sur Organic Red Blend
cono-sur-organic-cabernet-sauvignon-carm.bodyHtml:
The Cono Sur Organic Red Blend is an expressive, juicy, and eco-friendly Chilean red wine, typically crafted from a harmonious blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenere, and Syrah. It features a bright ruby red color and delivers intense aromas of fresh red berries, dark plums, and black cherries, delicately accented by notes of cocoa, black pepper, and subtle sweet spice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-structured, offering smooth, round tannins and a balanced acidity that leads to a fresh, persistent finish.

Food Pairing Pairs beautifully with grilled red meats, barbecued pork ribs, wood-fired mushroom pizza, hearty pasta dishes with rich tomato or meat sauces, and semi-hard cheeses like Gouda or Cheddar.

cono-sur-organic-pinot-noir-1.title: Cono Sur Organic Pinot Noir 750ml
cono-sur-organic-pinot-noir-1.bodyHtml:
88 Points - James Suckling
"A fresh and vibrant organic Pinot Noir with red berry and subtle earthy notes. Light-bodied and easy to drink, offering great value."


87 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"Features straightforward cherry and raspberry flavors. A reliable, food-friendly choice from a trusted organic producer."

cono-sur-pinot-noir-1.title: Cono Sur Bicicleta Reserva Pinot Noir
cono-sur-pinot-noir-1.bodyHtml:
Cono Sur Bicicleta Reserva Pinot Noir displays a bright, lively ruby-red color in the glass. The bouquet opens with vibrant and expressive primary aromas of fresh red cherry, wild raspberry, and juicy plum, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of strawberry jam, delicate sweet spices, and a hint of background smokiness. On the palate, this refreshing New World Pinot Noir showcases a smooth, medium-bodied structure beautifully defined by a fine, zesty line of acidity and polished, delicate tannins. Upfront flavors of crunchy red berries and faint spicy undertones lead into a clean, balanced, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with roasted chicken with wild mushrooms, grilled salmon fillets, duck confit poutine, or light tomato-based pasta dishes.

cono-sur-viognier-1.title: Cono Sur Bicicleta Reserva Viognier
cono-sur-viognier-1.bodyHtml:
Cono Sur Bicicleta Reserva Viognier displays a bright, lively, and intense golden-yellow color in the glass. The highly aromatic nose opens with primary scents of orange blossom, fresh white peach, apricot, and custard apple, beautifully layered with subtle undertones of tropical pineapple and a delicate hint of ginger spice. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied, unoaked white wine is remarkably smooth and concentrated. A vibrant, refreshing core of acidity perfectly balances its lush stone fruit profile, leading into a clean, well-rounded, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with Thai chicken curry, grilled shrimp tacos, pan-seared scallops, creamy pasta dishes, or mildly spiced Asian cuisine.

conundrum-white-2018.title: Conundrum White Blend
conundrum-white-2018.bodyHtml:
Conundrum White Blend pours a vibrant pale straw-gold color in the glass. Created by the legendary Wagner family of Caymus fame, this exotic and highly popular Californian multi-varietal blend delivers an remarkably fragrant bouquet. Layers of ripe apricot, white peach, honeysuckle, and tropical mango mingle with zesty accents of ruby grapefruit, tangerine, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine balances a rich, round, and texturally generous medium-to-full body with a crisp vein of natural acidity. Luscious orchard fruits and a touch of off-dry melon sweetness flow into a beautifully clean, bright, and persistent finish marked by a subtle, refreshing minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spicy Thai coconut curry, grilled chicken with mango salsa, blackened Cajun shrimp, or fresh fish tacos.

convento-san-francisco-2008.title: La Carlina Barolo del Comune di Grinzane Cavour
convento-san-francisco-2008.bodyHtml:
A magnificent and beautifully refined Piedmontese red wine displaying a clear, bright garnet-red color. The expressive, highly aromatic nose opens with a classic bouquet of crunchy sour cherries, wild raspberries, and blood orange peel, masterfully layered with sophisticated notes of dried rose petals, licorice, sweet pipe tobacco, and an underlying earthy, mineral-driven backbone. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it strikes a perfect balance between traditional structural tension and elegant precision, matching its pure core of vibrant red fruit with a crisp, mouth-watering acidity and a framework of tightly woven, finely textured tannins that carry into a long, beautifully harmonious, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with traditional slow-braised beef (Brasato al Barolo), roasted lamb chops, truffle-infused wild mushroom risottos, rich game ragù, and mature, hard artisanal cheeses like Grana Padano.

coors-light-13.title: Coors Light 24 Cans
coors-light-13.bodyHtml: Coors Light 24 Cans is the ultimate choice for those seeking a refreshing, light-tasting lager that delivers a clean, crisp finish every time. Brewed with high-quality barley malt and select hops, this iconic "Silver Bullet" is designed to be served ice-cold. Whether you're heading to a backyard BBQ or relaxing after a long day, this 24-pack ensures you have plenty to share. Each 355 ml can is packed with the legendary Rocky Mountain heritage, offering a light-bodied experience with low bitterness and a smooth, thirst-quenching character.

copa-de-oro-mexican-coffee-liqueur.title: Patron XO Cafe Coffee Liqueur
copa-de-oro-mexican-coffee-liqueur.bodyHtml:
Patrón XO Cafe Coffee Liqueur is a legendary, luxurious blend of ultra-premium Patrón Silver tequila and the natural essence of fine Arabica coffee. Sourced from the Mexican states of Jalisco and Veracruz, this beloved spirit set itself apart from traditional coffee liqueurs by opting for a notably dry profile rather than a cloyingly sweet, syrupy one. The higher proof brings out the bold, roasted flavors of the coffee alongside the earthy, peppery notes of the cooked agave base. Though famously discontinued in 2021 (and occasionally seen in limited re-releases), it remains an iconic benchmark in the coffee liqueur category, prized for its exceptional balance and versatility as both a sipper and a premium cocktail ingredient.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, classic tiramisu, fresh churros with chocolate dipping sauce, premium vanilla bean ice cream, and aged savory cheeses like Manchego.

Tasting Notes : Deep, opaque dark brown in appearance with a smooth, velvety, and medium-bodied mouthfeel that elegantly coats the glass.

Nose : Intense and inviting, leading with bold aromas of freshly roasted espresso beans and dark cocoa, underscored by subtle hints of sweet vanilla and the distinct earthy, herbal scent of roasted agave.

Palate : Bold, rich, and decidedly dry. It delivers a robust wave of fresh espresso, roasted nuts, and dark chocolate, gracefully balanced by the peppery bite and mild agave sweetness of the Patrón Silver base, preventing it from feeling overly confectionery.

Finish : Smooth, clean, and notoriously dry, fading elegantly with lingering notes of dark roasted coffee, subtle vanilla, and the gentle warming heat of premium tequila.

Serve : Serve chilled neat, on the rocks, poured directly over vanilla ice cream, or as the robust foundation for a premium Espresso Martini or Baby Stout cocktail.

copper-moon-malbec-1.title: Copper Moon Malbec
copper-moon-malbec-1.bodyHtml:
A smooth, full-bodied red wine, this selection is uniquely crafted for those seeking a cleaner profile with zero grams of sugar while maintaining its traditional strength. On the nose, it opens with rich aromas of vanilla, dark chocolate, and wild field berries. The palate delivers soft, approachable layers of juicy blackberry, dark plum, and black currant accented by subtle notes of warming spice and light oak. Supported by velvety, fine-grained tannins, it finishes clean, dry, and balanced, proving that zero-sugar alternatives can still offer a robust and satisfying experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steaks, hearty pasta dishes with rich meat sauces, wood-fired pizza, barbecued pork ribs, and sharp, aged cheeses.

copper-moon-pinot-grigio-3.title: Copper Moon Pinot Grigio 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-pinot-grigio-3.bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Pinot Grigio 4L Bag in Box is a crisp, light, and refreshing white wine produced in Canada as an International-Canadian Blend (ICB) by Andrew Peller Limited. Designed for easy everyday enjoyment and convenient large-format sharing, this eco-friendly bag-in-box wine preserves freshness for weeks after opening. In the glass, it presents a pale straw color with bright clarity. The nose opens with inviting aromas of fresh green apple, ripe pear, citrus peel, and white floral notes. On the palate, it is light-bodied and clean, offering subtle orchard fruit flavors balanced by lively acidity and a short, crisp finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light pasta dishes, grilled chicken salads, pan-seared white fish, fresh sushi, goat cheese crostini, and casual summer appetizers.

copper-moon-shiraz-3.title: Copper Moon Shiraz 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-shiraz-3.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: "Probably the best of the Copper Moon varietals although that's not saying a lot. Slightly smoother and with better balance but still too green and herbal, (press wine?) for this palate. The finish is sweet and sour. (Anthony Gismondi and Stuart Tobe)." - 81/100, Gismondi on Wine

cote-des-roses-rose-2020.title: Gerard Bertrand Cote des Roses Chardonnay 2020
cote-des-roses-rose-2020.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Côte des Roses Chardonnay 2020 is an elegant, meticulously crafted white wine from the sun-drenched terroirs of the South of France, beautifully celebrating the Mediterranean Art of Living. Presented in an iconic glass bottle with its base intricately sculpted into the shape of a blooming rose, this exceptional Languedoc Chardonnay reveals a striking yellow hue with bright golden reflections. On the nose, it is highly expressive and fresh, opening with delicate aromas of acacia, white blossoms, ripe stone fruits, and tropical pineapple, layered with nuanced hints of almond, warm butterscotch, and subtle vanilla. The palate is opulently textured, creamy, and generous, flawlessly harmonized by a lively, zesty acidity, crisp green apple, and a distinctively pure, mouth-watering saline and mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with roasted poultry, buttery crab cakes, creamy pasta dishes, grilled sea scallops, or an assortment of rich, soft cheeses.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Delicate aromas of ripe stone fruits and jasmine lead the nose on this wine. Zesty yet creamy, the complex palate offers crisp apple, pineapple, butterscotch, vanilla and oak before a saline finish.

coudoulet-de-beaucastel-cotes-du-rhone-2.title: Chateau de Beaucastel Coudoulet Rouge 2021/2022
coudoulet-de-beaucastel-cotes-du-rhone-2.bodyHtml:
Elegant clear ruby-red color, with purple undertones. Surprisingly fresh for this hot vintage, the nose shows a seductive aromatic bouquet delicately mixing notes of fresh red fruit with aromas of cypress. The freshness continues on the palate with a very nice balance, soft and velvety tannins, beautiful fruity aromas and roundness. Ample and suave, the finish offers a very nice length supported by a hint of salinity.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of 30% Mourvèdre, 30% Syrah, 30% Grenache and 10% Cinsault, the 2022 Cotes du Rhone Coudoulet de Beaucastel exhales a delicate, perfumed bouquet of black cherries, spices, violets and spring flowers. It’s medium to full-bodied, enveloping and layered with a juicy core of fruit, a tense mid-palate and a fresh, ethereal finish. This is a consistent wine and a solid value.

courvoisier-21-year-old-cognac-1.title: Courvoisier VSOP Cognac 1L
courvoisier-21-year-old-cognac-1.bodyHtml:
Courvoisier VSOP is a classic, deeply refined Cognac that beautifully showcases the delicate balance between floral elegance and rich oak maturation. Expertly blended from a selection of fine eaux-de-vie sourced from the Grande Champagne, Petite Champagne, Fins Bois, and Borderies crus, this Very Superior Old Pale expression is aged in fine French oak barrels for a minimum of four years, with some components aged up to a decade. The result is a highly versatile and harmonious spirit, renowned for its signature notes of ripe stone fruit, fragrant jasmine, and warm toasted almonds.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate, caramelized fruit tarts, roasted nuts, premium charcuterie, and strong cheeses like Roquefort or mature Gouda.

Tasting Notes : Radiant golden-amber in appearance with a smooth, well-rounded, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Elegant and highly aromatic, leading with delicate floral notes of jasmine and rose, followed by sweet peach, toasted almond, and soft vanilla oak.

Palate : Smooth, harmonious, and beautifully balanced. Rich flavors of baked apple, ripe peach, and dried apricot are layered with warm vanilla, toasted oak, and a subtle dusting of cinnamon and baking spice.

Finish : Warm, smooth, and of medium length, leaving an elegant, lingering impression of soft stone fruit, mild oak spice, and toasted nuts.

Serve : Serve neat in a tulip glass or snifter to concentrate its floral aromas, over a single large ice cube, or as a premium base for classic cocktails like the Sidecar or a French 75.

courvoisier-avant-garde-bourbon-cask-cog.title: Courvoisier Avant-Garde Bourbon Cask Edition
courvoisier-avant-garde-bourbon-cask-cog.bodyHtml:
This expression from the House of Courvoisier pushes the boundaries outside the bounds of our home Jarnac, France. Courvoisier bourbon cask is a tribute to craftsmen coming together to create a new and exceptional, yet distinctly smooth while bold, spirt.

TASTING NOTES
A warming expression of vanilla créme and caramel followed by soft smoky leather character leaving an elegant and soft velvety finish.

Color
Amber - Golden

Taste
Soft smoky leather and sweet orange

Aroma
Vanilla, honey and sweet marmelade

courvoisier-lessence.title: Courvoisier L'Essence Cognac
courvoisier-lessence.bodyHtml:
A blend of Grande Champagne and Borderies reserves complemented by cognacs that highlight the House’s distillation and aging process, L’Essence is a treasured jewel of Courvoisier.

L'Essence de Courvoisier is a blend of extremely special and rare cognac reserves which date back to early 1900 and add depth and harmony. These are complemented with cognacs from the later twentieth century, which mark our innovations in distillation and barrel-making techniques.

courvoisier-napolean.title: Courvoisier XO Royal Cognac
courvoisier-napolean.bodyHtml:
Courvoisier XO Royal Cognac is an exceptional and historically inspired expression that pays tribute to the historic cognacs served at the royal courts of Europe in the early 20th century. Master Blender Patrice Pinet meticulously crafted this luxurious spirit by selecting and marrying deeply aged Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie with rare Fins Bois de Jarnac. Matured for up to 30 years in French oak casks, this sophisticated blend results in an extraordinarily rich, full-bodied, and beautifully complex cognac. It delivers profound layers of decadent truffle, roasted hazelnuts, and vibrant floral notes, capturing the ultimate elegance of Maison Courvoisier.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, roasted hazelnuts, duck à l'orange, rich fruit tart, aged cheeses, or a fine cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep, radiant mahogany in appearance with a remarkably rich, velvety, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Opulent and highly aromatic, bursting with elegant summer flowers, decadent truffle, toasted hazelnuts, sweet honey, and warm cinnamon spice.

Palate : Full-bodied and deeply complex, delivering rich layers of caramelized orchard fruits, toasted almonds, sweet honey, and earthy truffle, all perfectly balanced by elegant oak and warm baking spices.

Finish : Exceptionally long, rich, and lingering, leaving a warming impression of cinnamon, toasted oak, and delicate floral honey.

Serve : Serve neat in a tulip-shaped tasting glass or snifter at room temperature to fully appreciate its complex aromatics and deeply aged character.

courvoisier-sherry-cask-finish-1.title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Sherry Oak Cask Finish
courvoisier-sherry-cask-finish-1.bodyHtml:
Smoke and sherry here from Laphroaig! The legendary distillery on the south coast of Islay has gone and released a fab 10 year old single malt Scotch whisky which has been finished in Oloroso sherry casks for over 12 months, and bottled up at 48% ABV. Alongside the familiar, intensely peaty elements of Laphroaig’s classic 10 Year Old expression, you’ll also find helpings of dark chocolate and maple syrup notes in this one’s flavour profile.
Those enjoying the Laphroaig 10 Year Old will first notice the bold, smoky taste, followed by a hint of seaweed and a surprising sweetness. This full-bodied variant is the foundation of all Laphroaig expressions and comes with a long finish.

This whisky was also named 2019 Best Single Malt Scotch 10 Years & Under by Jim Murray's Whisky Bible.

courvoisier-xo.title: Courvoisier XO Cognac
courvoisier-xo.bodyHtml:
Courvoisier XO Cognac is an intensely aromatic and luxurious Extra Old Cognac masterfully crafted from a selection of well-aged eaux-de-vie, primarily sourced from the Grande Champagne, Petite Champagne, and Borderies crus. Matured for decades in handcrafted French oak casks, it delivers a complex and harmonious balance of rich fruit, exotic spices, and elegant floral nuances.

Food Pairing: Crème brûlée, dark chocolate truffles, aged blue cheese, roasted duck breast, or fine cigars.

Tasting Notes : An extraordinarily rich and complex Cognac featuring a deep amber hue with mahogany highlights and a velvety, full-bodied texture.

Nose : A rich bouquet of candied orange, dried fig, creme caramel, crème brûlée, iris flowers, and warming cinnamon.

Palate : Complex and harmonious with notes of rich honey, roasted coffee beans, dark chocolate, ginger, and old oak spice.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warm, and velvety with enduring notes of dried fruit, leather, and oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip glass or snifter.

coyam-organic-red-blend-2018.title: Emiliana Coyam 2022
coyam-organic-red-blend-2018.bodyHtml:
Emiliana Coyam 2022 is a rich, complex, and biodynamically farmed red blend produced by Emiliana Organic Vineyards. Sourced from the renown Los Robles Estate in the Colchagua Valley, the vines grow on granite and clay soils of alluvial origin. The 2022 vintage is a harmonious blend led by Syrah and Carmenère, along with Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Carignan, Garnacha, Tempranillo, and Mourvèdre. Spontaneously fermented with native yeasts and aged in a combination of French oak barrels and concrete foudres, it reveals inviting aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, plum, violet, dried herbs, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, structured, and vibrant, balancing concentrated dark fruit with fine-grained tannins, fresh acidity, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, pork carnitas, wild mushroom ragù, and aged hard cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Lots of graphite and blackberries with dried flowers such as lavender and sage. Aromas follow through to a medium to full body, fine tannins and a fresh and savory finish. Plenty of dark berries and forest floor at the end. 31% syrah, 28% carmenere, 17% cabernet sauvignon, 14% carignan, 6% garnacha and 4% mourvedre.

cragganmore-12-year-old-1.title: Cragganmore 12 Year Old
cragganmore-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Cragganmore 12 Year Old is the core single malt from Cragganmore, a Speyside distillery on the banks of the River Spey, an area known as much for its salmon fishing as for its whisky. Diageo describes it as complex and rich, with layers of flavour and a wisp of smoke on the finish, and the whisky writer Michael Jackson called its nose the most complex of any single malt. It has won gold at the Scotch Whisky Masters (2010 and 2011) and the San Francisco World Spirits Competition. This bottling is 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Floral and herbal on the nose, then malty with sweet wood smoke, finishing long and lightly smoky.

Nose: Sweet floral fragrance, riverside herbs and flowers, honey and vanilla.

Palate: Firm and rounded, light to medium bodied; strong malt with hints of sweet wood smoke and sandalwood.

Finish: Long and malt-driven, with light smoke and some sweetness.

Serve: On the rocks in a tumbler or tulip glass; a splash of water opens it up.

cragganmore-20-year-old.title: Cragganmore 20 Year Old
cragganmore-20-year-old.bodyHtml:
A Cragganmore of this age has never been released from the distillery, making this elusive malt a much-anticipated expression. In addition, sweet and mellow woody notes emerge from patient maturation over 20 years in refill casks.

Cragganmore is a highly respected Speyside malt founded by a giant among distillers, John Smith. The ethereal aromas are among the most complex to be found in any malt, appearing and disappearing mysteriously like the ghostly flight of the Barn Owl as it quarters the wooded Speyside glens at twilight in search of its prey.

Serving Suggestion:
A lively example of Cragganmore at natural strength, with considerable complexity, which benefits from a little water.

cragganmore-distillers-edition-1.title: Cragganmore Distillers Edition
cragganmore-distillers-edition-1.bodyHtml:
Cragganmore Distillers Edition is the double-matured version of the Speyside single malt: after its main maturation the whisky is finished in casks that previously held Port. The finish gives a jammy, rich style, with notes of raspberries in honey, wild berry compote, tobacco and cacao. Each Distillers Edition carries its own distillation and bottling years on the label. This bottling is 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Jammy and rich: honey-coated raspberries, wild berry compote, tobacco and cacao.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

cragganmore-flavour-led.title: Cragganmore 12 Year Old Single Malt Whisky
cragganmore-flavour-led.bodyHtml:
The Speyside representative of the Classic Malts series is rich and spicy, with a very satisfying complexity and well-sherried backbone.

A sherried 12 year old single malt from Diageo's Classic Malts range, this bottling from the Cragganmore distillery represents Speyside and proffers a rich, slightly floral whisky with barley notes.

cragganmore-smoky-12-year-old-58-40-2019.title: Cragganmore 12 Year Old 2006 Smoky Special Releases 2019
cragganmore-smoky-12-year-old-58-40-2019.bodyHtml: The first-ever release of smoky whisky from Cragganmore distillery, this Speyside single malt has been matured in refill American oak casks for 12 years, before being bottled for Diageo's 2019 Special Releases. Aromas of crispy bacon and waxy lemons open on the nose, followed by burning leaves, damp peat, fresh pine, cinnamon bark and buttered malt loaf. The palate offers notes of spiced toffee, sponge cake, soft smoke and moss, developing into spiced chocolate, candied orange, charred leaves and damp oak.

craigellachie-23-year-old-1.title: Craigellachie 23 Year Old
craigellachie-23-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Craigellachie 23 Year Old is a premium single malt Scotch whisky distilled in the Speyside region by the Craigellachie Distillery. Known for its distinctively robust, muscular, and sulfurous spirit character achieved through traditional worm tub condensers, this expression represents one of the oldest standard bottlings in the distillery's core range. Matured for over two decades primarily in refill American oak casks and finished in seasoned oak, it softens the distillery's raw, meaty profile into a layered and sophisticated whisky marked by tropical fruit, beeswax, soft smoke, and rich spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with roast duck breast with an orange glaze, pan-seared pork belly, rich charcuterie with aged hard cheeses like Comté or mature cheddar, and warm tarte tatin with vanilla cream.

Tasting Notes : Polished antique gold with warm amber undertones, featuring a rich, oily, and viscous body that coats the glass.

Nose : Roasted pineapple, beeswax, dried mango, baked apples, honeyed malt, a faint whisper of sulfurous flint, and seasoned oak.

Palate : Full and textural on the tongue, revealing flavors of stewed stone fruits, sweet citrus zest, vanilla bean, cinnamon, toasted nuts, and a subtle savory, earthy minerality.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of dried fruit sweetness, lingering oak spices, beeswax, and a faint wisp of chimney smoke.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip whisky glass, or add a few drops of spring water to unlock deeper tropical fruit and floral aromas.

craigellachie-33-year-old-1.title: Craigellachie 13 Year Old
craigellachie-33-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Craigellachie 13 Year Old is a distinctly robust and unconventional Speyside single malt, often affectionately referred to as the "bad boy of Speyside." Unlike the typically light and floral whiskies of the region, Craigellachie utilizes traditional worm tub condensers and an oil-fired malt roasting process. This old-school production method imparts a heavy, meaty, and slightly sulphury character that is beautifully balanced by sweet notes of toasted marshmallows and baked orchard fruits. Bottled at 46% ABV without chill-filtration or added color, it offers a rich and deeply satisfying drinking experience for those seeking a whisky with real heft and character.

Food Pairing: Grilled pork chops, thick-cut bacon, smoked charcuterie, aged cheddar, or a roasted apple tart.

Tasting Notes : Light golden amber in appearance with a noticeably viscous, heavy, and oily mouthfeel.

Nose : A unique and complex aroma of baked apples, toasted marshmallows, vanilla, and honey, underscored by a signature savory, meaty note and a faint hint of struck match or sulfur.

Palate : Oily, rich, and robust, delivering sweet flavors of roasted pineapple, baked apple, and malted milk, which give way to savory, meaty undertones, cloves, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, warming, and distinctly savory, leaving lingering notes of sweet malt, oak spice, and a very subtle hint of wood smoke and sulfur.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its robust character, or add a few drops of water to soften the meaty notes and elevate the sweet orchard fruits.

cristal-brut.title: Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2015
cristal-brut.bodyHtml:
Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2015 is an exceptionally precise and majestic prestige cuvée crafted by one of the most celebrated Champagne houses. Composed of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay meticulously harvested from 45 historic lieu-dit plots farmed with organic practices, this warm, dry vintage reveals a crystalline purity. The expressive bouquet unfolds with aromas of citrus oil, fresh chalk, white peach, and crushed mint, all underpinned by fine pastry notes and roasted almonds. On the palate, it delivers deep concentration and a chiseled structure, driven by a vibrant beam of salinity and an ultra-fine, persistent mousse that finishes with breathtaking vertical elegance and remarkable tension.

Food Pairing: This extraordinarily refined Champagne couples flawlessly with pan-seared sea scallops, fresh oysters, butter-poached lobster tails, or delicate caviar-topped blinis.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

From vineyards that are run organically, this iconic Champagne's latest iteration is as beautiful as ever. Textured, with a mineral undertow, the wine is just beginning to soften and show a balanced maturity. Drink this great wine now.

97 Points - James Suckling

For the warm and dry vintage this has tremendous freshness and elegance. The complex nose of citrus blossom, mint, lemon and lime zest opens up slowly as this aerates in the glass. The wine’s ample structure is still quite firm, which is a vintage characteristic, the mousse very fine but also very lively for an eight-year-old champagne. Cristal fans will love this as it is, but a year or two more in the bottle will do a lot for the very long mineral finish of this youthful masterpiece. A cuvee of 60% pinot noir and 40% chardonnay, picked from all 45 Cristal vineyard plots. Tasted at the Cristal vertical tasting at the champagne house on July 6th, 2023.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This mouthwatering Champagne has an ethereal quality, with a frame of chiseled acidity and focused precision to the pointillisme-like, vibrant mousse. Yet this shows depth and generous expression, with the finely spun notes of patisserie apple and blackberry fruit opening beautifully on the palate and through the minerally finish, with notes of grated ginger, blood orange granita, salted Marcona almond and anise.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

If the 2014 vintage was especially open and demonstrative, the 2015 Cristal is going to require more patience. Unwinding in the glass with aromas of citrus oil, crisp stone fruits, white flowers, crushed mint and subtle hints of buttery pastry, it's medium to full-bodied, deep and layered, with a deep, concentrated and rather introverted core of fruit framed by chalky extract and animated by a pretty pinpoint mousse. This is a serious, vinous Champagne that has considerable substance to age and may well evolve along the lines of the lovely 1985.

cristal-brut-rose.title: Louis Roederer Cristal Rose 2014
cristal-brut-rose.bodyHtml:
Louis Roederer Cristal Rosé 2014 is a rare and breathtaking masterpiece of sparkling wine artistry, recognized as one of the most prestigious prestige cuvées in the world. Crafted using a unique cold infusion technique where Pinot Noir grapes from Aÿ are macerated before being blended and co-fermented with Chardonnay, this exceptional vintage delivers unmatched precision. It expresses a delicate salmon-pink hue and unleashes a tightly coiled aroma profile featuring wild red berries, sweet cherries, blood orange, and fresh almonds, balanced by wet chalk minerality and subtle floral undercurrents. On the palate, its linear intensity, vibrating vertical energy, and pillow-soft mousse combine for a profound, chiseled finish of incredible length.

Food Pairing: This deeply layered, elegant rosé Champagne pairs sublimely with pan-seared duck breast with cherry reduction, glazed wild salmon, fresh lobster, or premium red tuna sashimi.

98 Points - James Suckling

Extremely subtle and delicate, this has an enveloping nose of tiny red berries and dried flowers. This sparkling rosé masterpiece is just beginning to really open up. Fabulous velvety texture on the mouth-filling palate, the very fine mousse already spot on. Tons of structure behind all this, so this should age really well. From organically grown grapes. Tasted at the Cristal vertical tasting at the champagne house on July 6th, 2023.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Roederer's 2014 Cristal Rosé has turned out beautifully, unwinding in the glass with aromas of sweet cherries, almonds, citrus fruit and red berries mingled with notions of white flowers and wet chalk. Full-bodied, fleshy and enveloping, with a layered core of fruit and a pillowy mousse, it's deep, racy and electric, concluding with a long, mineral finish. Comparatively open out of the gates, it's no slight to the 2014's seriousness to say that it will drink well while its 2013 counterpart sleeps in the cellar. Deriving from just a handful of the over 39 blocks that inform the regular Cristal 2014, I suspect that its origins have even more to do with the extra dimension it possesses above and beyond its white counterpart than the subtle infusion of Pinot Noir phenolics that give it its delicate pink hue.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The epitome of great rosé Champagne, this is beautifully intense. The fruit and balanced mineral edge are united with mature redcurrant flavors in a wine that is perfectly aged. It is an impressive wine that is ready to drink.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This rosé features rich, focused flavors of peach tart, poached apricot and mandarin orange fruit, plus accents of toasted brioche, pastry cream, pickled ginger and pink grapefruit sorbet. Exudes an overall vibrant impression, with a fine interplay of elegance and complexity, showing deft integration of the vivid acidity and the satiny mousse. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

crown-royal-black.title: Crown Royal Black
crown-royal-black.bodyHtml: Crown Royal Black Blended Canadian Whisky is a rich and flavourful blend of Canadian whisky. All the signature smoothness of Crown Royal, matured in charred oak barrels and has a rich texture and bold finish.

crown-royal-french-oak-cask.title: Crown Royal Reserve 12 Year Old
crown-royal-french-oak-cask.bodyHtml:
Discover the journey to success with Crown Royal Reserve 12 Year Old. Meticulously crafted by our master blender, this blend of five exquisite whiskies is aged to perfection, embodying the values of patience, perseverance, and delayed gratification. Be captivated by the alluring notes of orchard fruit, white chocolate, and toasted oak, with a hint of vanilla, creating a delightful complexity for your palate. This hand-selected reserve-grade whiskey is a testament to your commitment and legacy – a creamy, indulgent blend with a smooth, velvety finish. Treat yourself to Crown Royal Reserve 12 Year Old – a truly exceptional and prized whiskey for the discerning Crown Royal enthusiast.

Crown Royal is renowned for its dedication to quality and craftsmanship. Each bottle of Crown Royal Reserve 12 Year Old is a masterpiece, reflecting the brand’s rich heritage and commitment to excellence. The whisky is aged for 12 years, allowing it to develop a depth of flavor that is both complex and refined.

NOSE: Red fruit, orchard fruit, vanilla, light baking spice.
PALATE: Orchard fruit, white chocolate, rye spice, toasted oak.
FINISH: Mild heat, lingering cinnamon spice apple notes.

crown-royal-limited-edition.title: Crown Royal Salted Caramel
crown-royal-limited-edition.bodyHtml: Crown Royal Salted Caramel Flavored Whisky is a limited edition flavor, available only in the winter months to bring a little festive sweetness to your holiday season. A blend of the finest Canadian whiskies, carefully selected by our Master Blenders and infused with the subtly salty-sweet taste of indulgent salted caramels ? imparting lush, creamy notes that perfectly compliment the richness of Crown Royal Whisky

crown-royal-maple.title: Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky 3L
crown-royal-maple.bodyHtml:
Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky is the legendary flagship expression that set the standard for Canadian whisky. Originally crafted in 1939 to celebrate the first grand tour of Canada by King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, it is meticulously blended from over 50 distinct whiskies. Aged to perfection in oak barrels, it delivers a remarkably smooth, approachable, and consistently rich flavor profile that has made it a staple in bars and homes worldwide.

Food Pairing: This versatile whisky pairs beautifully with savory, slightly sweet dishes like smoked pulled pork, BBQ chicken, or maple-glazed salmon. For dessert or cheese boards, serve it alongside aged cheddar or milk chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-gold in appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich and robust with dominant aromas of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, subtle floral notes, and gentle oak.

Palate : Delicately smooth and creamy featuring flavors of cooked fruit, caramel, vanilla, and light toasted oak spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and lingering with gentle warm oak and sweet spice notes.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as the base in classic whisky cocktails.

crown-royal-northern-harvest-rye.title: Crown Royal Northern Harvest Rye
crown-royal-northern-harvest-rye.bodyHtml: Crown Royal Northern Harvest Rye Blended Canadian Whisky combines the distinctive flavour of Canadian rye grain with the unmistakable smoothness of Crown Royal for a truly exceptional Canadian whisky.Crown Royal Northern Harvest Rye is the first Canadian Whisky to earn World Whisky of the Year in Jim Murray?s Annual Whisky Bible 2016.

crown-royal-peach.title: Crown Royal Peach Whisky
crown-royal-peach.bodyHtml: Crown Royal Peach Flavored Whisky is a new Limited Edition from Crown Royal, bringing some juicy sweetness to your summer season. To create this extraordinary blend, Crown Royal whiskies are carefully selected by our master blender and infused with the juicy flavor of fresh Georgia peaches. The result is a vibrantly delicious whisky, bursting with the luscious flavor of peach and the distinctive smoothness of Crown Royal.

crown-royal-salted-caramel.title: Crown Royal Salted Caramel
crown-royal-salted-caramel.bodyHtml: Crown Royal Salted Caramel Flavored Whisky is a limited edition flavor, available only in the winter months to bring a little festive sweetness to your holiday season. A blend of the finest Canadian whiskies, carefully selected by our Master Blenders and infused with the subtly salty-sweet taste of indulgent salted caramels ? imparting lush, creamy notes that perfectly compliment the richness of Crown Royal Whisky

crown-royal-vanilla.title: Crown Royal Vanilla
crown-royal-vanilla.bodyHtml: To create this extraordinary blend, Crown Royal whiskies are carefully selected by our master whisky blenders and combined with the rich flavour of Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla. The result is a uniquely sophisticated whisky, bursting with the bold flavour of vanilla and the distinctive smoothness of Crown Royal.

crown-royal-whisky-10.title: Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky
crown-royal-whisky-10.bodyHtml:
Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky is the legendary flagship expression that set the standard for Canadian whisky. Originally crafted in 1939 to celebrate the first grand tour of Canada by King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, it is meticulously blended from over 50 distinct whiskies. Aged to perfection in oak barrels, it delivers a remarkably smooth, approachable, and consistently rich flavor profile that has made it a staple in bars and homes worldwide.

Food Pairing: This versatile whisky pairs beautifully with savory, slightly sweet dishes like smoked pulled pork, BBQ chicken, or maple-glazed salmon. For dessert or cheese boards, serve it alongside aged cheddar or milk chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-gold in appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich and robust with dominant aromas of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, subtle floral notes, and gentle oak.

Palate : Delicately smooth and creamy featuring flavors of cooked fruit, caramel, vanilla, and light toasted oak spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and lingering with gentle warm oak and sweet spice notes.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as the base in classic whisky cocktails.

crown-royal-whisky-11.title: Crown Royal Canadian Whisky 1.14L
crown-royal-whisky-11.bodyHtml:
Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky is the legendary flagship expression that set the standard for Canadian whisky. Originally crafted in 1939 to celebrate the first grand tour of Canada by King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, it is meticulously blended from over 50 distinct whiskies. Aged to perfection in oak barrels, it delivers a remarkably smooth, approachable, and consistently rich flavor profile that has made it a staple in bars and homes worldwide.

Food Pairing: This versatile whisky pairs beautifully with savory, slightly sweet dishes like smoked pulled pork, BBQ chicken, or maple-glazed salmon. For dessert or cheese boards, serve it alongside aged cheddar or milk chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-gold in appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich and robust with dominant aromas of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, subtle floral notes, and gentle oak.

Palate : Delicately smooth and creamy featuring flavors of cooked fruit, caramel, vanilla, and light toasted oak spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and lingering with gentle warm oak and sweet spice notes.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as the base in classic whisky cocktails.
