crown-royal-xo.title: Crown Royal 18 Year Old Extra Rare
crown-royal-xo.bodyHtml:
Crown Royal 18 Year Old Extra Rare is an ultra-premium, highly sophisticated Canadian whisky that represents the absolute pinnacle of Crown Royal's blending artistry. Matured patiently for nearly two decades at the historic Gimli Distillery on the shores of Lake Winnipeg, Manitoba, this limited-edition masterpiece is a meticulous blend of three of Crown Royal's rarest and most exceptional whiskies. It artfully layers the vibrant, spicy character of premium rye with the soft, velvety smoothness of heavily aged corn spirits, delivering a remarkably refined, complex experience with zero astringency.

Food Pairing: The elegant stone fruit, rich vanilla, and gentle wood spice profile of this ultra-aged Canadian whisky pairs beautifully with savory dishes like roasted duck breast with an apricot glaze, slow-cooked pork belly, or seared scallops. It also serves as a flawless companion to nutty, aged cheeses like Comté or Gruyeré, as well as classic desserts like crème brûlée, apple tarte tatin, or fine dark chocolate.

TASTING NOTES - A medium dark amber hue with deep golden reflections. The texture is remarkably rich, silky, and elegantly mouth-coating with a luxurious, velvety presence.

NOSE - Soft, complex, and uncommonly smooth, opening with rich aromas of sweet caramel, vanilla fudge, and dark toffee, beautifully integrated with ripe stone fruits like peach and apricot, dry oak, and a subtle hint of baking spice.

PALATE - Immensely smooth and well-balanced. Deep layers of smooth honey, creamy vanilla, and dark chocolate effortlessly coat the palate, seamlessly met by light orchard fruits, toasted oak, and a delicate wave of rye spice.

FINISH - Long, clean, and highly elegant. The initial sweet caramel and fruit notes gently recede, leaving a pleasant trail of soft oak warmth, lingering citrus peel, and a comforting touch of black pepper.

SERVE - Best enjoyed strictly neat or with a single large, slow-melting ice cube in a premium rocks glass to fully experience its complex, wood-aged layers without diluting the delicate texture.

crown-royal-xr-blue.title: Crown Royal XO
crown-royal-xr-blue.bodyHtml: Crafted by our Master Blender, Crown Royal XO Blended Canadian Whisky takes the signature blend from 50 of our finest whiskies and then finishes them in cognac casks. The result is an elegantly balanced and extraordinarily complex whisky with a smooth expression.

cruzan-black-cherry-rum-1.title: Cruzan Black Strap Rum
cruzan-black-cherry-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Cruzan Black Strap Rum is a dark rum from the Cruzan Rum Distillery at Estate Diamond on St. Croix in the U.S. Virgin Islands. The distillery makes it by adding black strap molasses, an ingredient known for its robust flavour, to its aged dark rum, and compares the result to the classic navy rums of the Virgin Islands. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it sits in the brand's premium range, and the current label carries the Distiller's Collection and Estate Diamond names. Cruzan presents it as a bartender's rum: rich, dark and aromatic, used as a float on tropical drinks such as the Mai Tai and Piña Colada or as the base of a Jungle Bird, and a good match for lemon, lime, ginger and pineapple.

Tasting Notes: Molasses, licorice and ginger snap.

Nose: Warm molasses and fresh-baked ginger snaps.

Palate: Rich and full-bodied, strong and slightly sweet, with licorice and molasses.

Serve: Floated on a Mai Tai or Piña Colada, or mixed in a Jungle Bird.

cruzan-single-barrel-rum-1.title: Cruzan Single Barrel Aged Caribbean Rum
cruzan-single-barrel-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Cruzan Single Barrel Rum is an exceptional aged Caribbean rum crafted at the historic Cruzan Rum Distillery on the island of St. Croix in the U.S. Virgin Islands. Celebrating generations of island rum-making tradition, this distinguished expression is created from a carefully selected blend of vintage rums initially aged between five and twelve years. The matured rums are then expertly married and returned to a single oak cask for approximately one additional year, allowing their individual characteristics to develop into a beautifully harmonious and complex spirit. Displaying a rich amber colour, Cruzan Single Barrel reveals an inviting bouquet of seasoned oak, golden honey, roasted nuts, dark chocolate and delicate smoke, complemented by fragrant cinnamon and ripe cherry. The palate is smooth, rounded and generously textured, offering layers of warm vanilla, toasted oak, rich coffee, honey and subtle nutty sweetness. Its buttery mouthfeel and refined woody character lead to a lingering, gently warming finish with elegant spice and soft oak. Bottled at 40% ABV, Cruzan Single Barrel Rum is a sophisticated expression of Caribbean rum craftsmanship, offering exceptional depth and balance.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled jerk chicken, barbecue pork ribs, roasted duck, slow-braised beef short ribs and Caribbean-spiced seafood. Its rich oak and honey character also complements smoked Gouda, aged cheddar, roasted pecans, toasted almonds, dark chocolate truffles, caramel desserts and banana bread.

Tasting Notes: A rich, smooth and beautifully balanced aged Caribbean rum displaying seasoned oak, honey, roasted nuts, dark chocolate, coffee, vanilla and gentle warming spice, complemented by a buttery mouthfeel.

Nose: Complex aromas of deep oak, golden honey, delicate smoke, roasted nuts and dark chocolate, accompanied by fragrant cinnamon and subtle cherry.

Palate: Smooth, rounded and medium-to-full-bodied, revealing layers of seasoned wood, roasted coffee, toasted nuts, creamy vanilla and honey, supported by a rich, buttery texture.

Finish: Lingering and gently warming, with refined oak, soft vanilla, toasted nuts and subtle woody spice.

crystal-head-vodka.title: Crystal Head Gold Vodka
crystal-head-vodka.bodyHtml:
Crystal Head Gold Vodka is an ultra-premium, ultra-luxurious vodka crafted in Newfoundland, Canada, by Globefill Inc. (founded by actor Dan Aykroyd and artist John Alexander). Distilled seven times from high-quality Canadian corn and blended with pristine water from St. John's, Newfoundland, this expression is filtered seven times—including three distillations through Herkimer diamonds. Encased in a showstopping, 18-karat gold-metallized version of Crystal Head's signature skull-shaped decanter, it offers an exceptionally clean, smooth, and creamy profile with subtle natural sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters on the half shell, caviar, smoked salmon, sushi, creamy cheeses, and dark chocolate truffles.

Tasting Notes : Crystal-clear and brilliant with a smooth, medium-to-full body and a rich, creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Subtle aromas of sweet corn, soft vanilla, delicate citrus, and a clean, fresh minerality.

Palate : Exceptionally smooth and round with layers of sweet grain, creamy vanilla, soft caramel, and gentle warmth.

Finish : Clean, long, and elegant with lingering hints of sweet corn and soft vanilla.

Serve : Serve ice-cold straight from the freezer, neat in a chilled vodka glass, or over a large ice sphere.

cune-gran-reserva-2013.title: Cune Gran Reserva 2018
cune-gran-reserva-2013.bodyHtml:
Garnet color with reddish notes. In terms of aroma, there is a great balance between the ripe black fruit and the aromas from its time in the barrel, such as vanilla, toffee, tobacco leaves, etc. On the palate it shows a smoothness and gentleness that gives us a length with an aftertaste of balsamic and fruity notes. It is a round wine, with a pleasant tannin that allows us a very versatile pairing due to its balance.

Recommended with all Mediterranean dishes.

Blend: 85% Tempranillo, 10% Graciano, 5% Mazuelo


94 Points - James Suckling

Spices, chocolate, vanilla and lots of vibrant, youthful plums, cherries and berries. A medium-bodied, very approachable Rioja with juicy fruit and fine tannins that make you want to drink a bottle. Such a pleasing, well-made and youthful gran reserva, Drink now or hold.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2018 Cune Gran Reserva was produced with grapes picked between the 8th and 26th of October, quite late into the season, reflecting a cooler year with frost and snow and a mild summer. The vegetative cycle was long, 180 days, and the final blend was 85% Tempranillo, 10% Graciano and 5% Mazuelo or Cariñena, mostly from their 70 hectares in Torremontalbo. The grapes fermented with indigenous yeasts in stainless steel and concrete after a 24-hour cold soak, and the wine matured in French and American oak barrels for 24 months. They bottled the wine with 14% alcohol, a pH of 3.6 and 5.76 grams of acidity. It has spicy notes from the oak, vanilla and coconut, and is aromatic and expressive, clean, with a classic Gran Reserve profile.
90 Points - Wine Spectator
A savory red, leading with smoke and espresso notes before a plushly textured mix of black cherry, Kalamata olive and black tea pushes through. Sinewy tannins firm the fresh, spiced finish. Tempranillo, Graciano and Mazuelo.

cune-reserva.title: Cune Reserva
cune-reserva.bodyHtml:
The grapes for the production of Cune Reserva come from the company’s Caballeros, Santo Tomás and Sarnamoros estates, all located in Rioja Alta in the towns of Rodezno, Villalba and Haro.

Alcoholic fermentation takes place at a controlled temperature in 20,000 kg stainless steel tanks where we alternate different types of remontage (traditional and pump), delestage and pigeage.  After fermentation, the wine undergoes heat maceration and remains in the vat for approximately 18 months. Then, after malolactic fermentation, the wine is aged in French oak barrels (partly new) and American barrels. The process continues for 24 months, during which the wine evolves, adopting the characteristic notes of the two types of wood. Following natural clarification, the second phase of ageing and balancing takes place. The wine remains in the bottle in our cellars for a minimum of 12 months before being released on the market.

cuttings-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: Caymus Special Selection Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 1.5L Magnum
cuttings-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
The Caymus 'Special Selection' Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptional wine made from this storied Napa Valley estate. Following some time to open, this incredible Cabernet begins to yield profound aromatics of black cherry compote, blueberry pie and boysenberry along with creosote, black tar, milk chocolate and licorice all soaring from the glass. The mouthfeel is rich, voluptuous and intense, as this wine offers exceedingly dense, concentrated flavors of black cherry reduction, blueberry pie, raspberry liquor and boysenberry, alongside milk chocolate shavings and tar, all cascading on to the long mouth coating finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Lush and polished, with waves of cassis and blackberry compote pouring through, underscored by chocolate, espresso crema and roasted vanilla bean. Maintains a lush, velvety feel through the lengthy finish, where flashes of sweet tobacco and warm earth peek through. For the power Cabernet crowd. Best from 2024 through 2038.

dusse-vsop.title: D'Usse VSOP Cognac
dusse-vsop.bodyHtml:
D'Ussé VSOP Cognac is a premium French cognac produced at the historic Château de Cognac. Naturally aged for at least four and a half years in oak barrels in the humid cellars of the château, this expression offers a bold, full-bodied, and remarkably smooth profile that balances warm spice with rich fruit notes.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards with cured meats and aged cheeses, braised duck breast, roasted pork tenderloin, dark chocolate truffles, or fruit tarts.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a rich, smooth, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Powerful woody notes layered with warm cinnamon, dried fruit, floral accents, and subtle oak.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of rich honey, roasted almonds, baking spices, dried apricots, and delicate caramel.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant with lingering notes of sweet dried fruit, subtle pepper, and toasted oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip or glass snifter, on the rocks, or as a sophisticated base in classic cocktails such as a Sidecar or Sazerac.

dusse-xo.title: D'Usse XO Cognac
dusse-xo.bodyHtml: D'ussé XO Cognac is a blend of Cognacs with 10 to 30 years in oak. Deep copper in colour, and showing a complex nose of dried apricot, butterscotch and orange zest. Flavours of blackberry, dark chocolate, toasted nut, apricot and honey are woven on a smooth and full-bodied palate. Earthy notes emerge on a lengthy finish.

dailuaine-34-year-old.title: Douglas Laing & Co. Old Particular Midnight Series Dailuaine 2009 12 Year Old Sherry Butt Finish 57.3% ABV
dailuaine-34-year-old.bodyHtml:
Douglas Laing Old Particular Midnight Series Dailuaine 2009 12 Year Old #DL15400 was distilled in 2009 and independently bottled by Douglas Laing as part of its Old Particular Midnight Series. Finished in a Sherry butt, it offers a rich, full-bodied profile of dark berries, dried fruit, chocolate and warming spices, complemented by the distillery's distinctive malty character. Bottled at 57.3% ABV without chill filtration or added colouring, this single-cask release is limited to just 270 bottles.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, sticky toffee pudding, roasted pecans, aged Gouda, spiced fruitcake or slow-roasted beef.

Tasting Notes: Rich dark fruits, Sherry sweetness, warming spices, chocolate and malty depth, balanced by delicate oak and vanilla.

Nose: Blackberries, ripe plums, tobacco, freshly baked cake and aromatic baking spices.

Palate: Full-bodied and expressive, with raisins, currants, ginger, sweet barley, mocha, vanilla cream and dark berry compote.

Finish: Long and warming, with lingering dried fruits, chocolate, oak spice and gentle malt sweetness.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its concentrated aromas. Add a few drops of water if desired.

dallas-dhu-1969-50-year-old-private-coll.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Dallas Dhu 1969 50 Year Old 43.1% ABV
dallas-dhu-1969-50-year-old-private-coll.bodyHtml:
Laid down in a Refill Sherry hogshead cask no. 1656 on the 10th June 1969, our Private Collection 1969 from Dallas Dhu Distillery 1969 is a fitting tribute to a site with a colourful history that finally closed its doors in 1983. Elegantly sweet aromas of candied ginger and treacle toffee complement the lingering finish of roasted coffee beans.

New to the Private Collection range, this Dallas Dhu is an absolute rarity. Distilled in 1969 in this discreet Speyside distillery, closed since 1983, this single malt is bottled to its natural degree, from a unique sherry hogshead refill cask. The rich and fruity profile of the distillate is accompanied by the notes brought by its long maturation: prunes, black spices, blond tobacco, rancio. This range brings together a collection of single malts exceptional for their age and quality. Made from unique barrels and shaped by time, they honor distilleries, whether famous, discreet or silent. Private Collection captures the very essence of Gordon & MacPhail: sublimating whisky.

Intense, sherry. Plums, ginger, black spices, blond tobacco, nuts.

dalwhinnie-15-year-old-1.title: Dalwhinnie 15 Year Old
dalwhinnie-15-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Dalwhinnie 15 Year Old is a highly celebrated, remarkably gentle Highland single malt Scotch whisky that serves as a classic representation of its region. Produced at one of the highest and coldest operational distilleries in Scotland, the extreme alpine conditions dynamically slow down the maturation process, yielding a spirit of exceptional purity and elegance. The whisky is distilled in traditional copper pot stills and matured for fifteen years in hand-selected American oak ex-bourbon casks. This patient aging process creates an incredibly clean, crisp, and smooth flavor profile, beautifully marrying soft heather honey sweetness and delicate orchard fruits with a faint, wispy hint of Highland peat smoke.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with smoked salmon blinis, fresh fruit tarts, mild goat cheese, or a slice of classic honey cake.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, straw-gold color with a light to medium-bodied, remarkably smooth, and clean mouthfeel.

NOSE - Aromatic and sweet with prominent notes of fresh heather honey, crisp green apples, and ripe pears, balanced by soft vanilla, citrus peel, and a very subtle touch of wood smoke.

PALATE - Exceptionally gentle and sweet on the tongue, delivering flavors of creamy vanilla fudge, golden syrup, and poached fruits, followed by light malted barley and a delicate, warming touch of nutmeg and cinnamon.

FINISH - Long, clean, and surprisingly crisp, leaving a lingering warmth of sweet malt, soft oak spices, and a brief whisper of dry peat.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat or with a few drops of pure, cool spring water in a Glencairn glass to allow the delicate honeyed floral notes to fully breathe.

dalwhinnie-25-year-old.title: Dalwhinnie 25 Year Old
dalwhinnie-25-year-old.bodyHtml: rom the highest, coldest distillery in Scotland comes a creamy, aromatic, and crisply-focused Dalwhinnie. Drier and less honeyed than you may expect, it drinks very well, both straight and with a little water.

dalwhinnie-30-year-old-51-90-2020-releas.title: Dalwhinnie 30 Year Old 1989 Special Release 2020
dalwhinnie-30-year-old-51-90-2020-releas.bodyHtml:
Dalwhinnie 30 Year Old is part of Diageo's Special Releases 2020, a single-vintage whisky from one of Scotland's highest distilleries in the Highlands. All the casks for this bottling were refill American oak hogsheads filled in 1989, and after three decades the whisky still shows a remarkably bright, lively intensity for its age. It is bottled at natural cask strength of 51.9% ABV, and the label calls it some of the last drops of this elegant 1989 Highland classic. A rare, mature expression of Dalwhinnie's honeyed, heathery house style, in a 750ml bottle presented in its Special Release tube.

Serve: Neat, with a drop of water to open it up.

dalwhinnie-distillers-edition-1.title: Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition
dalwhinnie-distillers-edition-1.bodyHtml:
Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition 2019 is Dalwhinnie distilled in 2004 and double-matured in ex-bodega Oloroso cask wood, adding rich sweetness and spicy complexity to the heathery, honeyed character of the regular release. It is part of the 2019 Distillers Edition range, made in limited quantities worldwide.

Nose: Fresh Oloroso notes over malty, honeyed Dalwhinnie; peaty and still heathery, spicy yet grapey.

Palate: A big, spicy buzz with clear, well-defined malt; a quick burst of sweetness, then rich and grapey.

Finish: Plenty of oak; very dry, with vanilla dominating.

daou-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: DAOU Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
daou-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
DAOU Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a remarkably rich, elegant, and beautifully structured Californian red wine that sets a benchmark for the incredible potential of Paso Robles mountain terroir. It pours a deep, shimmering ruby-purple color in the glass, unfurling a highly aromatic and expressive bouquet of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with complex notes of dried sage, cocoa dust, and toast. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is exceptionally balanced and fruit-forward, delivering lush, concentrated layers of black raspberry, pomegranate, and blueberry crumble. Its fine-grained, sappy tannins provide excellent structural backbone, while a touch of integrated French oak lends luxurious accents of mocha spice and sweet vanilla that carry through to an impeccably polished finish.

Food Pairing: This robust red pairs excellently with a grilled prime ribeye steak, rosemary-braised lamb shanks, wild mushroom risotto, savory wood-fired pepper pizzas, or mature cheeses like sharp aged Cheddar and Gruyère.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Clean lines of cherry, toasted wood, red flower and a pinch of thyme make for a satisfying nose on this widely available bottling. The palate pairs familiar blackberry flavors with mocha spice.

dassai-23-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake.title: Dassai '23' Junmai Daiginjo 300ml
dassai-23-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake.bodyHtml:
To craft the ultimate Junmai-Daiginjo sake, we polished down Yamada-Nishiki rice to 23%. Delivering delicate floral aromas with a palate reminiscent of honey and an elegant lasting finish.

A Gold Medal winner at IWC 2021 this elegant sake is produced using Yamada Nishiki rice milled to 23%. Intense aromatics of melon fruit with fresh cucumber and floral notes. Incredibly balanced with a great depth of flavours, rich and smooth on the palate with a long, dry finish. Serve chilled with raw oysters.

dassai-39-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake.title: Dassai '39' Junmai Daiginjo 300ml
dassai-39-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake.bodyHtml: Made with 100% Yamada-Nishiki rice polished to 39% of the original rice grain. Aromas of fresh pineapple, ripe pear, mango and light notes of anise. Tropical fruit flavours are delicate and soft on the palate, with a clean and dry finish. Enjoy served chilled with grilled seafood and sashimi.

dassai-45-nigori-junmai-daiginjo-sake.title: Dassai '45' Junmai Daiginjo Nigori 300ml
dassai-45-nigori-junmai-daiginjo-sake.bodyHtml: This cloudy sake is light with juicy apple, honey and almond flavours. The palate shows bright and balanced flavours with a slight sweetness. Best served chilled with rich and spicy dishes.

deanston-12-year-old-1.title: Deanston 12 Year Old
deanston-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Deanston 12 Year Old is a beautifully crafted Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky produced at the Deanston Distillery, located on the banks of the River Teith near Doune, Scotland. Matured for 12 years in ex-bourbon oak casks, this expression showcases the distillery's signature combination of natural sweetness, creamy texture and gentle Highland character. Bottled at 46.3% ABV, Deanston 12 Year Old is non-chill filtered and presented without added colouring, preserving its natural character and rich flavour. The whisky opens with inviting aromas of honey, vanilla, malted barley and fresh orchard fruits, complemented by subtle citrus and oak. On the palate, it delivers smooth layers of creamy toffee, sweet malt, vanilla, gentle spice and soft fruit, leading to a satisfying, warming finish with lingering honey and oak.

Food Pairing: Roast chicken, grilled pork, smoked salmon, aged cheddar, baked Brie, roasted almonds, caramel desserts, apple tart, shortbread and milk chocolate.

Tasting Notes: A balanced and naturally sweet Highland single malt featuring honey, creamy vanilla, malted barley, orchard fruits and gentle oak spice.

Nose: Fresh hay, honey, vanilla, creamy toffee, sweet malt and delicate citrus.

Palate: Smooth and creamy, with flavours of honey, vanilla, malted barley, soft fruit, caramel and gentle warming spice.

Finish: Long, clean and gently warming, with lingering honey, sweet oak, malt and a touch of spice.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a whisky tasting glass to appreciate its natural sweetness and complexity. Add a few drops of water to explore additional aromas, or serve over a large ice cube for a refreshing experience.

deanston-18-year-old-1.title: Deanston 18 Year Old
deanston-18-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Deanston 18 Year Old is a Highland single malt from the Deanston distillery near Doune, set in a former cotton mill on the River Teith. The distillery matures its 18 year old fully in American white oak ex-bourbon barrels, producing a classic Deanston profile of sweet barley sugar, vanilla and crisp apple, and describes the style as waxy, aromatic and spiced. Deanston makes its whisky from unpeated, locally sourced Highland barley. This listing is the 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass, adding a drop of water if you like.

deanston-2002-pinot-noir-finish.title: Belle Glos 'Clark & Telephone' Pinot Noir 2023
deanston-2002-pinot-noir-finish.bodyHtml:
Belle Glos 'Clark & Telephone' Pinot Noir 2023 is a bold, opulent, and deeply concentrated California red wine with a dark ruby hue. Crafted by fifth-generation winemaker Joseph Wagner under Copper Cane, it opens with lavish, expressive aromas of ripe blackberry, wild raspberry jam, dark chocolate, and warm gingerbread, accented by cedar box and holiday baking spices. The palate delivers a rich, voluptuous mouthfeel bursting with flavors of crushed ripe cherry, black plum, and sweet cranberry pie. Balanced by a vibrant streak of acidity and layered with fine-grained, velvety tannins, this luxurious wine moves into a long, beautifully structured, and warm finish.

Food Pairing: This rich, bold Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with oven-roasted leg of lamb, grilled ribeye steaks, teriyaki glazed salmon, or rich duck breast.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The dense nose on this wine offers ripe aromas of boysenberry, elderberry, root beer and cola. The palate is quite thick and extremely bold, pairing baked blackberry with coffee cake and cinnamon cookie flavors.

deanston-40-year-old.title: Deanston 40 Year Old
deanston-40-year-old.bodyHtml:
NO FURTHER DISCOUNTS APPLY.

This high end, exclusive, of only 500 bottles, opens with a mouth filling sweetness, followed by heather honey, fruits, vanilla fudge and rich oak, with a lingering fruit finale.

deanston-virgin-oak-1.title: Deanston Virgin Oak
deanston-virgin-oak-1.bodyHtml:
Deanston Virgin Oak is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky from Deanston Distillery at Doune in Perthshire, which operates from a converted cotton mill on the River Teith. It carries no age statement. The spirit is matured first in ex-bourbon casks and then finished in virgin American oak, casks that have never held another wine or spirit, before being bottled at 46.3% ABV without chill filtration or added colour. The new oak adds zest, vanilla and spice to the distillery's honeyed, malty style. The official tasting notes describe lemon zest, barley sugar, apple and nutmeg on the nose, candied fruits, vanilla toffee and heather honey on the palate, and a lightly spiced finish of honeyed malt and sweet oak. This listing is the 750ml bottle.

Nose: Virgin oak, lemon zest, barley sugar, apple and nutmeg.

Palate: Candied fruits, vanilla toffee and heather honey.

Finish: Light spice, honeyed malt and sweet oak.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

decero-cabernet-sauvignon-2017.title: Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
decero-cabernet-sauvignon-2017.bodyHtml:
Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 is an exceptionally elegant, balanced, and precisely structured single-vineyard red wine that beautifully exemplifies the high-altitude terroir of Agrelo in Mendoza, Argentina. Sourced entirely from the sustainably farmed Remolinos Vineyard sitting at 3,500 feet above sea level, the vines are planted on gravel-rich alluvial soils and nurtured by hand. This high altitude ensures warm days and distinctly cool nights, imparting fresh natural acidity and intense aromatic focus. In the glass, it shows a deep ruby color with violet reflections. The highly expressive, classic nose opens with bright aromas of fresh cassis, red cherries, and dark wild berries, masterfully woven with sophisticated undertones of cedar wood, graphite, and subtle spicebox notes reminiscent of traditional Bordeaux style. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, leaning toward refinement and poise rather than overwhelming power. Its core of succulent black and red fruits is supported by supple, beautifully integrated tannins and a vibrant line of acidity, resulting from 14 months of maturation in select French oak barrels. The finish is remarkably persistent, clean, and harmonious, leaving a lingering impression of savory fruit and fine minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled prime ribeye steak, rosemary-crusted roasted rack of lamb, slow-cooked beef stew, and mature hard cheeses like an aged Gouda.

91 Points - James Suckling

A soft and juicy cabernet with currant and raspberry aromas and flavors. Medium body. Easy finish. Delicious. Drink now.

decero-malbec-2017.title: Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Malbec 2019
decero-malbec-2017.bodyHtml:
Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Malbec 2019 is a highly polished, elegant, and aromatically expressive single-vineyard red wine that beautifully showcases the distinctive quality of high-altitude terroir in Mendoza. Sourced entirely from the sustainably farmed Remolinos Vineyard in Alto Agrelo, which sits at an elevation of 3,500 feet, this wine is named after the tiny whirlwinds ("remolinos") that naturally keep the canopy dry and healthy. In the glass, it reveals a deep ruby color with brilliant violet undertones. The nose opens with an intense, lifted bouquet of fresh blackberries, wild blueberries, and dark plum, intricately layered with notes of cacao dust, lemon zest, sweet spices, and the estate's signature violet floral aromas. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, showing excellent fluid coherence and refined tension. Its core of juicy blue and black fruits is seamlessly balanced by a vibrant line of natural acidity and framed by firm, sleek tannins. Aged for 14 months in French oak barrels, it offers a beautifully rich mid-palate and carries into a long, bright finish marked by subtle dark chocolate and hazelnut accents.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled Argentine ribeye steak, rosemary-infused roasted lamb chops, slow-cooked beef stifado, and mature hard cheeses like aged Gouda.

92 Points - James Suckling

Cacao, fresh blackberries and blueberries with hints of violets and lemon zest. This fresh quality to the blue and black-fruit character extends to the palate, showing fluidity, coherence and drinkability. Lovely now, but will hold for a few years, too.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

This Malbec shows plenty of verve, with lively acidity and firm tannins offering structure to the floral, loam-laced core of dark plum and cherry flavors, which meld with concentrated mineral and spice notes midpalate. Ends with notes of dark chocolate. Drink now through 2032.

decoy-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-201.title: Decoy California Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
decoy-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-201.bodyHtml:
Decoy California Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a lush, alluring, and refined red wine crafted under the esteemed Duckhorn Portfolio. This highly approachable expression opens with an inviting bouquet of vibrant red and blue fruits, showcasing aromas of ripe black cherry, blackberry, and plum accented by subtle hints of nutmeg, sweet baking spices, and bittersweet cocoa. On the palate, it delivers a succulent and well-rounded mouthfeel, where layers of dark berry and raspberry fruit are framed by silky, polished tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a long, luxurious finish with nuanced touches of toasted oak.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, wood-fired burgers, roasted lamb chops, or rich pasta dishes with a savory meat ragù.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Dark berry and plum aromas on the nose of this bottling are cut by nutmeg, cola and bittersweet cocoa touches. The palate is quite dry with flavors of dark-chocolate flake and oregano, as dark berry fills in the fruit tones. A very classic California Cab.

decoy-sonoma-county-merlot-2018.title: Decoy California Merlot 2023
decoy-sonoma-county-merlot-2018.bodyHtml: This opulent Merlot offers dramatic aromas of fresh black cherry, ripe boysenberry, and sweet baking spices as well as hints of leather, black olive, and toasty cardamom. On the palate, it strikes a seamless balance between voluptuous fruit, silky tannins, and toasty oak as it flows to a luscious cherry and spice finish.

derange-red-blend-2017.title: Derange Red Blend by The Prisoner 2021 / 2022
derange-red-blend-2017.bodyHtml:
The dark and silky appearance of the 2022 Dérangé Red Blend is inviting, and the nose, featuring bramble fruit, dark cherry, and graham cracker, suggests a rich and nuanced aromatic experience. 

On the palate, the soft, juicy tannins paired with flavors of vanilla, toasty oak, and black sweet fruit paint a picture of complexity and depth. The hints of cassis and plum skin add layers of richness, while the herbal notes of bay leaf and sage provide a refreshing and sophisticated touch. This combination of elements embodies a wine that’s both approachable and intriguing, with a nice balance of fruit and savory elements.

deveron-12-year-old-1.title: The Deveron 12 Year Old
deveron-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
The Deveron 12 Year Old is a single malt Scotch whisky from Macduff distillery, which was built in 1960 by four Scottish entrepreneurs. The brand's stated aim is good-quality single malt for everyday drinking, and every bottle carries an age statement. The distillery explains that it introduced shell-and-tube condensers into what it describes as the first gravity-fed Scotch whisky distillery, a practical approach that cut costs and environmental impact. This expression has spent 12 years in oak, and the producer describes its flavour as moving towards creamy vanilla, rich baked apples and rich fruit, ending in a delicately spicy finish. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle and is meant to be enjoyed neat, over ice or in a long mixed drink.

Tasting Notes: Creamy vanilla, baked apples, rich fruit and gentle spice.

Finish: Delicate and spicy.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in a highball with cloudy lemonade and green apple slices, as the producer suggests.

deveron-18-year-old-1.title: The Deveron 18 Year Old
deveron-18-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
The Deveron 18 Year Old is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky from the Macduff Distillery, bottled at 40% ABV; this listing is the 750ml bottle. It was released as the oldest whisky in The Deveron range, which appeared in 2015 when owner John Dewar & Sons renamed the distillery's single malt from Glen Deveron. The whisky is matured in a combination of Spanish sherry and American ex-bourbon oak casks, mainly hogsheads. Macduff was built in 1960 by four Scottish entrepreneurs, and the brand states that every bottle it releases carries an age statement.

Tasting Notes: A honeyed, sherry-influenced Highland malt.

Nose: Honey, toffee, dried sherried fruits, nuts and a hint of oak.

Palate: Medium-bodied, with honeyed sweetness, vanilla, burnt raisins, ripe plum, toffee and tangy orange.

Finish: Short, with honeyed oak, tangy orange and a drying nuttiness.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

dewars-15-year-old-1.title: Dewar's 15 Year Old The Monarch Double Aged Blended Scotch 1.75L
dewars-15-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Dewar's 15 Year Old Double Aged is a premium blended Scotch whisky created by Master Blender Stephanie Macleod, affectionately known as "The Monarch." It undergoes Dewar's signature "double aging" process, where carefully selected single malt and single grain whiskies—each aged for a minimum of 15 years in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks—are blended together and then returned to oak casks for an additional period of maturation to marry the flavors. This extra resting step results in a remarkably smooth, sweet, and floral whisky with exceptional balance and approachability, presented here in a large 1.75L format.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, mild soft cheeses like Brie, roasted almonds, milk chocolate, or light vanilla-based desserts.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden honey in appearance with a remarkably smooth, mellow, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and floral, leading with rich golden honey, ripe green apple, citrus peel, toffee, and delicate white floral notes.

Palate : Smooth, sweet, and perfectly integrated, featuring flavors of exotic tropical fruits, green apple, vanilla caramel, and honey, balanced by a gentle touch of toasted oak and soft warming spice.

Finish : Medium-length, warm, and exceptionally smooth, leaving a lingering sweetness of floral honey and soft oak.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, on the rocks, or in a classic Highball with premium soda water and a lemon twist.

dewars-18-year-old-1.title: Dewar's 18 Year Old Gift Tin
dewars-18-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Dewar's 18 Year Old is a blended Scotch whisky drawn from some of the oldest casks in the Dewar's reserves. The label explains that it is blended from old and rare Highland, Speyside and Lowland single malts and grain whiskies, each at least 18 years old, with Aberfeldy, Macduff, Royal Brackla, Craigellachie and Aultmore named among the house's malts. After blending, the whiskies are married together in refill casks as part of Dewar's two-stage ageing process, which the producer credits for the harmony of flavour and texture. It shows honey, toffee, dark chocolate and fruit. Dewar's lists a Gold medal at the 2024 International Spirits Challenge and Gold and Double Gold at San Francisco in 2023 and 2022. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, presented here in a gift tin.

Tasting Notes: Honey, toffee, dark chocolate, marzipan and rich fruit.

Nose: Perfumed and floral, with honey and nuts.

Palate: Rich and complex, with toffee, dark chocolate and fruit.

Finish: Lingering and creamy, with full-bodied oak easing into delicate herbal notes.

Serve: Neat, or in a Rob Roy.

dewars-21-year-old-double-double-1.title: Dewar's Double Double 21 Year Old 375ml
dewars-21-year-old-double-double-1.bodyHtml:
Experience the epitome of Scotch whisky craftsmanship with Dewar's Double Double 21 Year Old Blended Scotch Whisky, presented in an accessible 375ml bottle. This meticulously crafted, limited edition blend is the result of a unique four-step maturation process that delivers an unmatched balance of flavours and an unparalleled smoothness.

Aged for a minimum of 21 years, this premium blend features a rich and sophisticated flavour profile. Indulge in sumptuous notes of dark chocolate, ripe stone fruits, and warm spices, enhanced by the subtle sweetness imparted by the sherry cask finish. The Dewar's Double Double 21 Year Old is a true testament to the brand's dedication to innovation and excellence in whisky production.

Whether you're a whisky connoisseur seeking a rare and exceptional addition to your collection or looking for an unforgettable gift, Dewar's Double Double 21 Year Old Blended Scotch Whisky is the perfect choice. Don't miss the opportunity to experience this remarkable, limited edition blend—order yours today!

dewars-25-year-old-1.title: Dewar's 25 Year Old
dewars-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml: Once blended, this elder expression from Dewar’s is decanted into oak casks for further maturation before finishing yet elsewhere. The result of all this to-and-fro? A sophisticated and elegant whisky which truly thrives on the tongue: fresh fundaments of rich apple and apricot are lifted by thick floral notes and honey battles smoke for dominance in a slow, heady finish.

dewars-27-year-old-double-double.title: Dewar's 27 Year Old Double Double 375ml
dewars-27-year-old-double-double.bodyHtml:
Dewar's 27 Year Old Double Double is an ultra-premium blended Scotch whisky crafted by Master Blender Stephanie Macleod, utilizing a unique and meticulous four-stage "Double Double" aging process. First, single malts and single grains are aged separately for at least 27 years. Second, the malts are blended together and rested, while the grains are blended and rested. Third, the malt and grain blends are married together and rested again. Finally, the resulting blend is finished in rare Palo Cortado sherry casks. This labor-intensive method yields an incredibly smooth, complex whisky that beautifully balances Dewar's signature honeyed elegance with the rich, delicately nutty, and subtly spicy influence of the Palo Cortado wood.

Food Pairing: Manchego or aged Comté cheese, roasted duck with a dark fruit glaze, salted caramel desserts, dark chocolate with hazelnuts, or a fine, mild cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep, radiant amber in appearance with an exceptionally silky, luxurious, and viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Intoxicating and highly aromatic, leading with heady floral notes, sweet heather honey, toasted almonds, dried apricot, and a hint of exotic baking spices.

Palate : Sumptuous and refined, delivering rich layers of ripe peaches, caramelized orchard fruits, sweet honey, and toasted walnuts, all elevated by the delicate, nutty, and slightly spicy influence of the Palo Cortado sherry cask.

Finish : Incredibly long, velvety, and complex, leaving a lingering sweetness of dried fruits, warm oak spices, and an elegant floral honey.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter to fully appreciate the complex aromatics and the incredibly silky texture achieved through the four-stage aging process. A single drop of water may be added to unlock further floral notes.

dewars-caribbean-smooth-8-year-old.title: Dewar's 8 Year Old Caribbean Smooth
dewars-caribbean-smooth-8-year-old.bodyHtml: Dewar's Caribbean Smooth is a blend of up to 40 single malts and grain whiskies that have been aged for at least 8 years and then double aged, before being finished in ex Caribbean rum casks for up to six months, creating a Caribbean smooth finish.

dewars-illegal-smooth-8-year-old.title: Dewar's 8 Year Old Ilegal Smooth
dewars-illegal-smooth-8-year-old.bodyHtml:
Dewar’s Ilegal Smooth is a brand new to world product from Dewar’s, bringing together the classic honeyed and fruity house style of the Dewar’s blend and adding this truly unique layer of flavour by finishing the blend in Ilegal Mezcal casks; giving it surprising notes of sliced green pepper and a long wisp of smoke finish.

The result is a slightly quirky, yet supremely smooth taste, unlike anything before. More than just great tasting scotch, Dewar’s Ilegal Smooth brings two cultures together to create something uniquely richer.

dewars-white-label-5.title: Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky
dewars-white-label-5.bodyHtml: Created in 1899, 'White label' is the pillar of the Dewar's portfolio, maintaining its flavour profile throughout the years has ensured its timelessness; pale amber colour with rich honey sweetness, hints of heather and a touch of peat smoke that add to the rounded flavours and smooth satisfying finish.

dewars-white-label-2.title: Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky 1.14L
dewars-white-label-2.bodyHtml: Created in 1899, 'White label' is the pillar of the Dewar's portfolio, maintaining its flavour profile throughout the years has ensured its timelessness; pale amber colour with rich honey sweetness, hints of heather and a touch of peat smoke that add to the rounded flavours and smooth satisfying finish.

dewars-white-label-4.title: Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky 1.75L
dewars-white-label-4.bodyHtml:
Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky 1.75L is one of the world’s most recognizable and highly awarded blended Scotch whiskies, first created in 1899 by Master Blender A.J. Cameron. This classic blend brings together up to 40 of Scotland’s finest single malt and grain whiskies, with Aberfeldy single malt at its sweet, honeyed heart. Dewar’s is renowned for its signature double-aging process, wherein the whiskies are blended together and then returned to oak casks to mature further, ensuring an uncommonly smooth and seamlessly integrated flavor profile.

Food Pairing: Traditional fish and chips, honey-glazed ham, mild cheddar cheeses, or shortbread biscuits.

TASTING NOTES Clear, pale golden amber in appearance with a light, crisp, and exceptionally smooth mouthfeel.

NOSE Clean and invitingly sweet, opening with distinct aromas of heather honey, fresh orchard fruits like green apples and pears, and a subtle undertone of warm unbaked dough.

PALATE Light and well-rounded, delivering dominant flavors of golden honey, sweet malt, and subtle vanilla fudge, beautifully balanced by a touch of fresh citrus and a faint trace of oak wood.

FINISH Short to medium, clean, and refreshing with a gentle, trailing warmth of black pepper and a brief, clean dry note.

SERVE Highly versatile; perfect enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as the quintessential base for a refreshing Scotch Highball mixed with club soda and a lemon twist.

diabolica-red-1.title: Diabolica Red 750ml
diabolica-red-1.bodyHtml: Diabolica Red is described as a devilishly flavorful red wine, offering a full-bodied and smooth experience with a hint of sweetness. It is known for its rich aromas of chocolate, prunes, and sometimes raisins, with a palate featuring dark fruit, chocolate, and red licorice flavors. The finish is often described as lingering and satisfying, with a mix of fruit and spice. Cochrane Liquor Delivery offers a description stating it's bursting with upfront chocolate and prune aromas, medium-bodied, and finishes with a Black Forest cake note. LCBO describes it as a mellow, smooth red with cocoa and raisin aromas, and dried fruit, dark chocolate, and red licorice flavors. hotshotliquor.ca notes a full-bodied, wickedly smooth red blend with dark fruits, oak, and a devilish complexity.

diabolica-reincarnation-1.title: Diabolica Reincarnation Bourbon Oak-Aged Red 2019 750ml
diabolica-reincarnation-1.bodyHtml: Diabolica Reincarnation Bourbon Oak-Aged Red 2019 is a red wine that is aged in bourbon barrels. This unique aging process contributes to the wine's complex flavor profile, offering a blend of rich fruit notes, vanilla, and hints of spice and smoke.

dictador-2-masters-barton-rye-bourbon.title: Dictador 2 Masters Barton Rye Bourbon 1982 36 Year Old Rum
dictador-2-masters-barton-rye-bourbon.bodyHtml:
After 36 years of aging, rum was put for 8 months and 5 days in previously used rye-bourbon casks from the 1792 Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky.

NOSE: dark brown sugar, smoky, dried dark fruits and charred oak.

PALATE: caramel, Christmas spices, brown sugar, figs, dates, and toffee.

FINISH: maple syrup, burnt sugar, tobacco, and oak with a lingering rye spiciness. Remarkably satisfying and unforgettable. ABV: 45.0%

dictador-2-masters-glenfarclas-74.title: Dictador 2 Masters Glenfarclas 1974 45 Year Old Rum
dictador-2-masters-glenfarclas-74.bodyHtml: The Dictador 2 Masters Glenfarclas 1974 2nd is an approximately 45 year old rum from the Destileria Colombiana from Colombia. The rum, which is only available in a number of around 350 bottles, initially matured for 44 years in its home country in a whiskey barrel and was then brought to the Glenfarclas Distillery in Scotland, where it was matured for 14 months in a Glenfarclas sherry. Received the fourth filling barrel. The luxurious old rum is characterized by its smooth and rich character with aromas of gentle sherry paired with notes of orange and chocolate as well as a hint of leather and cigar boxes. The strictly limited rum Dictador 2 Masters Glenfarclas 1974 2nd has an alcohol content of 43.4% vol.

dictador-2-masters-royal-tokaji.title: Dictador 2 Masters Royal Tokaji 1977 42 Year Old Rum
dictador-2-masters-royal-tokaji.bodyHtml:
"In the depths of the 13th century Royal Tokaji wine cellar, our rum has developed a new and extraordinary finish. Its palate is elegant and balanced, smooth and rich, with a good attack and a persistent finish,” commented Hernan Parra, Dictador Master Blender. “The Tokaji Aszú aroma has made a remarkable mark too. Dictador 2 Masters Royal Tokaji is complex and rich, with hints of tropical fruits and a nice honey touch on the nose."

1977 Dictador Rum matured for seven months in the Royal Tokaji 12 year old, 300 litre, Zemplén oak barrel – last wine matured for 2 years in barrels was the 2016 Aszú 6 puttonyos.

dictador-20-year-old.title: Dictador Solera System 20 Year Old Rum
dictador-20-year-old.bodyHtml:
Dictador 20 Years Rum is made from the fermentation of virgin sugar cane honey, distilled partly in copper alembic and partly in steel continuous column, to achieve a medium body rum.

It’s then aged in pre-used oak barrels and finally bottled under the highest quality control to ensure all the secrets are contained in the liquid flavour.

dictador-xo-insolent.title: Dictador Solera System Insolent XO Rum
dictador-xo-insolent.bodyHtml:
Dictador XO Insolent Rum is made from the fermentation of unique virgin sugar cane honey, then distilled in a modern stainless steel alembic. It is then aged in pre-used quality oak barrels from Jerez and Port that now and again reburn to caramelize the interior to achieve sweet flavours coming from the oak.

By carefully hand selecting barrels from each year’s vintage using the highest level of technology and our secret method, our master blender uses all his skills to create the most exquisite blended rum, which is then approved for bottling at the highest standard.

dictador-xo-perpetual.title: Dictador Solera System Perpetual XO Rum
dictador-xo-perpetual.bodyHtml:
Dictador XO Perpetual Rum is made from the fermentation of unique virgin sugar cane honey, distilled in an antique alembic copper still, then aged in the highest quality pre-used oak barrels from ex-bourbon.

Finally, we use our family’s traditional method which our master blender conceives with all his skills and senses. The result is the most exquisite blend using only the finest barrels from each vintage year, approved for bottling under the highest quality control.

dill-pickle-vodka-last-mountain-distille.title: Last Mountain Dill Pickle Vodka
dill-pickle-vodka-last-mountain-distille.bodyHtml:
Last Mountain Dill Pickle Vodka is the original naturally infused dill pickle vodka from Last Mountain Distillery in Lumsden, Saskatchewan, the province's first micro-distillery. The distillery takes its corn-based vodka, made from 100% Saskatchewan grain, and infuses it with fresh cucumber, dill and garlic grown locally in the valley. It is the distillery's most popular product and was built for the Caesar, though it also makes a sharp dirty dill pickle martini. Bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Fresh cucumber, dill and garlic over a clean corn vodka base.

Serve: In a Caesar with Clamato, lime and Worcestershire, garnished with a pickle, or shaken with dry vermouth and pickle juice as a martini.

diplomatico-reserva-exclusiva.title: Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva Rum
diplomatico-reserva-exclusiva.bodyHtml:
Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva Rum is an award-winning, globally celebrated Venezuelan dark sipping rum that stands as a benchmark for rich, sweet, and complex cane spirits. Crafted by Destilerías Unidas S.A. (DUSA) at the foot of the Andes Mountains, this flagship expression is a masterful blend of heavy pot still distillates (80%) and lighter column and batch kettle distillates (20%), utilizing high-quality sugar cane honeys alongside molasses. The rum is aged for up to twelve years in small, hand-selected ex-bourbon and ex-malt whiskey white oak casks. This patient maturation process under tropical conditions creates an exceptionally smooth, decadent, and full-bodied spirit that boasts an exquisite balance of dark caramel, rich baking spices, and dense tropical fruit notes.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with rich dark chocolate fondant, pecan pie, slow-cooked caramelized pork belly, mature blue cheeses, or a fine cigar.

TASTING NOTES - A brilliant, deep amber and orange-tinged copper color with a full, velvety, and luxuriously viscous body that coats the palate.

NOSE - Deeply complex and highly inviting, opening with rich aromas of orange peel, sweet maple syrup, brown sugar, and toffee, followed by warm notes of licorice, vanilla bean, and nutmeg.

PALATE - Luscious, soft, and remarkably smooth on the tongue, delivering dominant flavors of sweet chocolate fudge, rich caramel, and tropical dried fruits, intermingled with hints of oak spice and creamy vanilla.

FINISH - Long, sweet, and exceptionally warming, leaving a highly persistent trail of dark cocoa, charred oak, and a lingering touch of citrus zest.

SERVE - Best enjoyed poured neat at room temperature or with a single large ice cube in a classic rocks or spirits nosing glass, or as the premium foundation for an elegant Rum Old Fashioned.

disaronno.title: Disaronno Originale Amaretto Liqueur 50ml
disaronno.bodyHtml:
Disaronno Originale Amaretto Liqueur is a famous Italian amber-colored almond-flavored liqueur produced in Saronno, Italy. Crafted from a secret formula unchanged since 1525, its distinctive flavor profile is derived from an infusion of apricot kernel oil combined with absolute alcohol, burnt sugar, and the pure essence of seventeen selected herbs and fruits.

Food Pairing: Tiramisu, dark chocolate tarts, biscotti, fruit tarts, vanilla gelato, or almond-based pastries.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper-amber in color with a velvety, rich, and syrupy mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense marzipan, sweet almond, toasted nuts, vanilla, and subtle herbal spices.

Palate : Sweet and smooth with dominant flavors of marzipan, bitter almond, toasted macadamia, sweet vanilla, and caramelized sugar.

Finish : Medium-to-long, sweet, and warming with lingering toasted almond, marzipan, and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, as a digestif, or as the core ingredient in classic cocktails like the Amaretto Sour or Godfather.

disaronno-velvet.title: Disaronno Velvet Cream Liqueur
disaronno-velvet.bodyHtml:
Disaronno Velvet Cream Liqueur combines the distinctive almond-inspired character of Disaronno Originale with a luxuriously smooth, creamy texture. This elegant Italian-branded expression offers delicate floral and fruity nuances alongside chocolate and vanilla flavours. Bottled at 17% ABV, it delivers a rich, silky experience with a gentle warming character and lingering sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pair with classic tiramisu, almond biscotti, vanilla panna cotta, chocolate mousse, amaretti cookies or espresso-flavoured desserts.

Tasting Notes: Silky and indulgent, with almond-inspired flavours, delicate floral and fruity nuances, chocolate and vanilla.

Nose: Sweet almond character with soft floral aromas, vanilla and gentle chocolate notes.

Palate: Smooth, creamy texture with almond, chocolate, vanilla and subtle fruity sweetness.

Finish: Velvety and persistent, with lingering almond sweetness, vanilla and gentle warmth.

dom-perignon-2010.title: Dom Perignon Vintage 2017
dom-perignon-2010.bodyHtml:
Dom Pérignon Vintage 2017 è uno champagne di straordinaria eleganza, complessità e ricchezza strutturale, nato da un'annata sfidante caratterizzata da volumi di produzione estremamente ridotti. Alla vista si presenta di un brillante colore giallo dorato con riflessi verdolini e un perlage finissimo e persistente. Al naso si apre con un bouquet intenso ed avvolgente di petricore, gelsomino fresco, scorza di agrumi candita e albicocca essiccata, impreziosito da note di pan tostato, nocciola tostata, burro e lievi sfumature di cacao. Al palato offre una texture cremosa e voluttuosa, sostenuta da una viva acidità limata e una spiccata mineralità gessosa, sfociando in un finale lungo, teso e piacevolmente persistente.

Food Pairing: Si abbina felicemente con ostriche fresche, caviale, granseola, carne di capriolo, carré d'agnello alle erbe e formaggi a pasta dura stagionati.

98 Points - James Suckling

An edgy Dom Perignon with intense and singular aromas of lemons, toast and botanicals. Medium-bodied with a dense center palate and a vivid and rocking finish. Tight, muscular bubbles frame this nicely. Tense. Developing well in the bottle. 62% chardonnay and 38% pinot noir. 4.5 g/L dosage. Drink now or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Of the two releases—the 2017 and the 2018—the 2017 Dom Pérignon is the deeper and more structurally endowed wine, unfurling from the glass with a complex bouquet of orange peel, dried apricot and burnt buttered toast, mingling with nuances of dried flowers, toasted hazelnut and cacao bean, all strongly singed with the house’s signature smoky reduction. On the palate, it is full-bodied and concentrated, with a rich core of fruit. Its darker, open-knit profile is animated by a pillowy mousse, vibrant acidity and attractively bitter, structuring phenolics that assert themselves on a long, resonant finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A vivid Champagne, offering a finely detailed mousse, with a toasty overtone to the flavors of crushed white raspberry and white cherry fruit, grapefruit pith, toast point and oyster shell, all defined by chiseled, lemony acidity. A fine example from a challenging vintage. Drink now through 2037.

dom-perignon-rose-2006.title: Dom Perignon Rose 2009
dom-perignon-rose-2006.bodyHtml:
Warm, dry and sunny, the summer of 2009 was emblematic of this vintage, where the grapes expressed their full majesty, maturity and richness. It reveals Dom Pérignon Rosé Vintage 2009 exactly as it is, intimate and caressing, a true embodiment of fruit.

The Dom Pérignon gastronomic experience radically explores an entire realm of possibilities while revealing the facets of the wine with its unique character and singular personality. To bring out the aromatic nuances of Dom Pérignon Rose Vintage 2009, the chef Alajmo have created a pairing featuring a spicy tarragon risotto with matcha, served with a yellow tomato sorbet and nigella powder. A combination of tastes that reveal the duality of the vintage wine, highlighting its fresh yet earthly notes.

98 Points - Vinous

The 2009 Dom Pérignon Rosé marks a return to a richer style of Rosé following the more ethereal 2008 Rosé. Sweet red cherry, blood orange, spice and pomegranate all build in a creamy, sensual DP Rosé that hits all the right spots. Over the last few years, Chef de Caves Vincent Chaperon and his team have lowered the still Pinot portion of the Rosé down to about 10% from a high of 28% or so, reached around 2004 and 2005. In 2009, the Rosé gains considerable textural presence from the generosity of the year. It is a superb Champagne. I preferred it to the 2008, which was also part of this tasting.

97 Points - James Suckling

Peaches, fresh crushed strawberries and roses on the nose. Full-bodied and generous. Fine tannins that frame the wine beautifully and set it up for a fresh finish. Some fruit tea and cedar undertones. Enticing finish with hints of bitterness. Savory.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A lovely rosé Champagne that waltzes gracefully across the palate, belying the concentrated range of macerated raspberry and strawberry, candied blood orange peel, toast and saffron notes carried on the elegant, satiny mousse. Long and fresh, with minerally smoke and oyster shell accents on the focused finish. Drink now through 2035.

domaine-de-canton-french-ginger-liqueur.title: Domaine de Canton French Ginger Liqueur
domaine-de-canton-french-ginger-liqueur.bodyHtml: A one of a kind French liqueur crafted in small batches; each taste tested before approval ensuring the highest quality. Infused with Cognac, the combination of ginger, Tahitian vanilla bean and Provencal honey create a rich and delicious flavour profile that is fresh, balanced and a unique addition to cocktails.

domaine-du-vieux-lazaret-chateauneuf-du-.title: Domaine du Vieux Lazaret Chateauneuf-du-Pape Rouge 2019
domaine-du-vieux-lazaret-chateauneuf-du-.bodyHtml:
Domaine du Vieux Lazaret Châteauneuf-du-Pape Rouge 2019 reveals a deep, dark ruby color with crimson flashes. The nose opens beautifully with an incredibly aromatic bouquet of ripe dark cherries, crushed raspberries, and cassis paste layered with nuances of sandalwood, wild thyme, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, this full-bodied Southern Rhône red blend showcases a solid tannin structure balanced by a vibrant streak of natural acidity and excellent mid-palate concentration. Fleshy orchard and berry fruits seamlessly transition into a long, driven finish accented by notes of red licorice, mulling spices, and a touch of earthiness.

Food Pairing: This rich blend pairs excellently with slow-roasted lamb shanks, grilled beef burgers, or a traditional Greek beef stifado.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe, sleek and captivating for its bright and forward display of cassis, cherry paste and boysenberry compote flavors. The finish is lined with red licorice and mulling spice accents, featuring a flash of roasted apple wood. This is for fans of the modern style. Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre, Cinsault, Carignan, Counoise, Terret, Picpoul, Muscardin, Picardan, Bourboulenc, Clairette and Roussanne. Drink now through 2034.

90 Points - James Suckling

A big, dark Chateauneuf with plenty of earthy and smoky character. Solid structure, good depth and lively acidity on the full-bodied palate. Slightly rustic finish. Drink or hold.

dominus-2016.title: Dominus Estate Napa Valley 2021
dominus-2016.bodyHtml:
Dominus Estate Napa Valley 2021 is a profound, world-class, and exceptionally structured red blend crafted by Christian Moueix and winemaker Tod Mostero at the historic Napanook vineyard in Yountville. Aged for 18 months in French oak barrels (40% new), this vintage reflects an extraordinarily concentrated growing season. In the glass, it displays a deep, opaque purple-black color with brilliant clarity. The nose is complex and evolving, revealing high-toned aromas of fresh blackcurrant, blackberry preserves, stewed plum, and violet flowers interwoven with subtle notes of graphite, cedar pencil, crushed rock, tobacco leaf, and sweet spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, taut, and seamlessly balanced, offering intense layers of dark berry fruits and mineral notes framed by exceptionally polished, cashmere-like tannins and vibrant acidity that leads into a long, persistent, and iron-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, venison tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, and aged hard cheeses.

99 Points - James Suckling

The purity of the cabernet fruit is so enticing, with blackcurrant, rose petals, nettles and subtle graphite. Touches of terra cotta and licorice. Full-bodied with super integrated tannins that are wonderfully polished, giving a cashmere texture that is really luxurious to taste at this early stage. It is quenching and so delicious already. 95% cabernet sauvignon and 5% cabernet franc. Needs three to four years to come around but already a joy to taste.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Dominus is a 3,700-case blend of 95% Cabernet Sauvignon and 5% Cabernet Franc, with 40% of the wine matured in new French oak. Black cherries and cassis lead the way, accented by scents of crushed stone and pencil shavings. It's full-bodied, rich and concentrated, dark and intense, with ample tannins, but those tannins are ripe and well-rounded without being overly soft or creamy, gliding easily into a long, mocha-tinged finish. As a whole, the wine exhibits wonderful balance, even if it will benefit from 5 or 10 years in the cellar.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A restrained style, this offers a focused beam of red and black currant fruit lined with warm stone, tobacco and savory accents and allied to a long iron spine. Marries density and freshness through the finish. A wine of precision that feels as if it will expand with time in the cellar. Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2026 through 2042.

dominus-napanook-2016.title: Dominus Napanook 2021
dominus-napanook-2016.bodyHtml:
Deep, sanguine, tobacco, blood orange, nuanced complexity and a long finish. With its own distinct personality, Napanook presents a bold and vibrant character. Its exuberant fruit, smooth structure, and medium bodied texture lend to its immediate appeal.

97 Points - James Suckling

This shows a lot of class, with aromas of blackcurrants, graphite, blueberries, dried flowers, black truffles and a touch of forest floor. The palate is medium- to full-bodied, with seamless tannins that goes on and on. Endless. Blackcurrants, dark mushrooms and violets with hints of fresh rose stems and light herbs. Velvety texture. A blend of 92% cabernet sauvignon, 6% cabernet franc and 2% petit verdot.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Certainly the best Napanook bottling I can recall, the 2021 Napanook is a 3,000-case blend of 92% Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Cabernet Franc and 2% Petit Verdot. Boasting harmonious aromas of raspberries, red and black cherries, cinnamon, clove and dusty earth notes, this full-bodied wine tips the scales at a declared 15% alcohol, yet it shows no detectable heat. It is full-bodied, intense, rich and velvety, with hints of black tea on the long finish. Matured in 20% new French oak, it stands out for its lush mouthfeel and savory complexity.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Bright and fresh, with a streak of tobacco enlivening the core of cherry and red currant preserve flavors. A subtle accent of singed cedar runs along the edges, giving this a reserved feel. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdo

don-david-malbec-1.title: El Esteco Don David Reserve Malbec 2023 750ml
don-david-malbec-1.bodyHtml:
Ruby red, dark and intense with tile edges. Colorful and thick legs indicating very good structure. Spicy where pepper outstands. Smoke, oak and tobacco notes. Persistent aromas. Round and mature tannins. Harmonic. Black berries and chocolate. Elegant and long persistence.

Ideal to serve with dishes prepared with red meats and game cooked in a plow disc, stews and hard cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrants, black beans, dried herbs and cumin on the nose. It’s savory and medium- to full-bodied with well-integrated spice and herb notes to the dark fruit, accompanied by supple tannins. Why wait? Delicious now.

don-julio-1942-anejo.title: Don Julio 1942 Añejo Tequila
don-julio-1942-anejo.bodyHtml:
Don Julio 1942 Anejo Tequila is a premium tequila made from 100% blue agave, aged for an extra smooth taste in oak barrels. Our tequila is characterized by a warm, inviting aroma of sweet cooked agave and dried fruit, with a hint of black pepper and oak. Its flavor is complex and full-bodied, with a roasted agave, oak and cinnamon palate. Rated 94 points by Wine Enthusiast, Don Julio 1942 Anejo Tequila is the perfect choice for those looking for a premium tequila.

Produced in small batches and aged for a minimum of two and a half years, Don Julio 1942 Tequila is handcrafted in tribute to the year that Don Julio Gonzalez began his tequila-making journey.

don-julio-anejo.title: Don Julio Anejo Tequila
don-julio-anejo.bodyHtml:
Don Julio Añejo Tequila is a benchmark luxury spirit that honors the legacy of its pioneering founder, Don Julio González, who revolutionized the tequila industry by choosing quality over production volume. Unlike traditional high-density planting, Don Julio famously spaced his agaves widely apart in the Highlands of Jalisco, allowing each plant to mature fully for seven to ten years before harvest. After distillation in small-batch copper pot stills, this tequila is aged for a minimum of 18 months in hand-selected American white oak ex-bourbon barrels. It stands as a masterclass in balance, seamlessly marrying the bright, citrusy terroir of Highlands agave with the complex, spice-laden character of aged wood.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri, dark chocolate truffles with sea salt, slow-cooked pork carnitas, or aged Manchego cheese.

Tasting Notes : Light amber with bright golden highlights; offers a beautifully smooth, medium-bodied texture that sits elegantly on the palate with a clean, crisp weight.

Nose : Expressive and brilliantly balanced; opens with a striking combination of lime zest, fresh grapefruit, and cooked agave, which quickly gives way to warm layers of wild honey, rich butterscotch, and a light touch of oak wood smoke.

Palate : Complex and beautifully structured on the entry; forward flavors of caramelized agave, honey, and sweet vanilla are closely followed by brighter notes of cooked orchard fruits and a complex mid-palate of white pepper, wild herbs, and ginger.

Finish : Medium to long, clean, and nicely rounded, leaving a trailing warmth of dry oak spices, gentle honey sweetness, and a final, distinct touch of wild pepper.

Serve : Best appreciated neat or over a single large ice cube in a spirits snifter or a Riedel tequila glass to appreciate its clean, fruity, and oak-spiced complexity.

don-julio-blanco.title: Don Julio Blanco Tequila
don-julio-blanco.bodyHtml:
Don Julio Blanco Tequila is a premium, luxury silver tequila that serves as the foundation for all of Don Julio's expressions. Crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in the mineral-rich, red clay soils of the Jalisco Highlands (Los Altos), the agave is slow-roasted in traditional masonry ovens for 72 hours before being double-distilled. Unaged and bottled immediately, it captures the raw, pure essence of the agave plant, delivering a crisp, bright, and citrus-forward profile that helped set the benchmark for the ultra-premium blanco tequila category.

Food Pairing: Fresh fish ceviche, grilled shrimp tacos, guacamole with lime-salted tortilla chips, fresh oysters, and light, zesty citrus salads.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and brilliant in appearance, offering a remarkably crisp, light, and pristine mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright and highly aromatic, leading with crisp, fresh cooked agave, vibrant citrus notes of lemon, lime, and grapefruit, along with subtle floral and sweet herbal undertones.

Palate : Smooth, fresh, and naturally sweet. A clean wave of pure agave and bright citrus zest is beautifully balanced by a gentle, earthy minerality and a touch of light black pepper.

Finish : Crisp, whistle-clean, and refreshing, fading elegantly with lingering notes of grassy agave, bright citrus, and a gentle peppery warmth.

Serve : Serve neat or on the rocks in a traditional copita glass, or use it to elevate classic premium cocktails like a traditional Margarita, a Tommy's Margarita, or a refreshing Paloma.

don-julio-reposado.title: Don Julio Reposado Tequila
don-julio-reposado.bodyHtml:
Don Julio Reposado Tequila is the legendary flagship expression that effectively established the luxury Reposado category worldwide. Created by the visionary Don Julio González in the Highlands of Jalisco, this spirit represents a meticulous approach to aging. While Mexican law requires a Reposado to rest for a minimum of two months, Don Julio ages theirs for a full eight months in hand-selected American white oak ex-bourbon barrels—nearly four times the legal requirement. This extended time in the wood beautifully rounds out the raw, peppery edge of the estate-grown Highlands agave, adding a sophisticated layer of light caramel and spice without over-extracting the wood or masking the plant's natural citrus vibrancy.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken fajitas, Baja-style fish tacos with lime, mild semi-hard cheeses like Monterey Jack, or fresh pineapple carpaccio.

TASTING NOTES Luminous, light straw-gold in appearance with an incredibly smooth, elegant, and medium-bodied texture that glides across the tongue.

NOSE Remarkably inviting and fresh; opens with an aromatic burst of bright lemon zest, lime juice, and sweet cooked agave, smoothly layered with soft vanilla fudge, a hint of white chocolate, and a delicate kiss of dry oak wood.

PALATE Beautifully balanced and clean on the tongue; initial flavors of sweet honeyed agave and ripe orchard fruits are quickly complemented by a creamy wave of vanilla custard and light caramel. The mid-palate introduces a pleasant twist of dried herbs and a soft, warming spice.

FINISH Short to medium, exceptionally clean, and dry, leaving a refreshing trail of sweet citrus oils, soft vanilla cream, and a final, faint touch of white pepper.

SERVE Highly versatile; drinks beautifully neat or on the rocks, and serves as an incomparable, upscale choice for a luxury Paloma or a classic Margarita.

don-julio-reposado-lagavulin-aged.title: Don Julio Reposado Tequila
don-julio-reposado-lagavulin-aged.bodyHtml:

PALATE Beautifully balanced and clean on the tongue; initial flavors of sweet honeyed agave and ripe orchard fruits are quickly complemented by a creamy wave of vanilla custard and light caramel. The mid-palate introduces a pleasant twist of dried herbs and a soft, warming spice.
