don-mateo-mezcal-cupreata-1.title: Don Mateo Cupreata Mezcal
don-mateo-mezcal-cupreata-1.bodyHtml: Don Mateo Cupreata mezcalcomes from Cupreata agave plants approximately 6 to 9 years old. It has organoleptic notes of fruit and a light smoky flavor. Ideal for enjoying neat, in cocktails, or accompanied by the traditional orange slice or some nuts.

don-melchor-gran-reserva-cabernet-sauvig.title: Don Melchor Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
don-melchor-gran-reserva-cabernet-sauvig.bodyHtml:
Don Melchor Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is an iconic, exceptionally structured, and refined Chilean red wine crafted predominantly from old-vine Cabernet Sauvignon grown in the acclaimed Puente Alto vineyard in the Maipo Valley. Displaying a deep garnet core with a purplish rim, it opens with a fragrant, complex bouquet of cassis, dark plum, and wild blackberry, beautifully interwoven with graphite, cedar, graphite earth, mint, and sweet spices. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied, dense, and energetic profile balanced by vibrant acidity and polished, fine-grained tannins, delivering a long and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted leg of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison, and aged hard cheeses.

99 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrants, cassis and graphite on the nose. Pure and fragrant. Full-bodied with superb density and tannins that are so polished. The texture is like touching a silk ball. Its finish is very long and compact with slightly chewy tannins, but it will come together beautifully with time in the bottle. Try after 2028.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Elegant, nuanced and concentrated, with a loamy-clay cast to the fresh thyme and subtle tuberose aromas, which give way to a rich yet balanced core of blackberry and cassis notes lifted by saline-edged acidity. Wonderfully fresh while moving toward the finish, where the flavors come together and linger harmoniously around well-formed tannins. Drink now through 2040.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Puente Alto, located in the highest part of the Maipo Valley, is a renowned appellation for producing some of Chile's finest wines. This elegant Cabernet opens with sweet blackberry aromas and subtle hints of licorice. Sip it slowly allowing its flavorful profile to fully unfold, offering ripe red berries intertwined with delicate oak spices. Energized acidity enhances the wine's structure, carrying through to a finish highlighted by a touch of peppercorn.

dona-paula-estate-malbec-1.title: Dona Paula Estate Malbec
dona-paula-estate-malbec-1.bodyHtml:
Doña Paula Estate Malbec pours an intense violet color in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and fresh, revealing rich aromas of black cherries, blueberries, and wild plums, beautifully layered with purple violets, sweet spices, and distinctive undertones of graphite and mineral flint. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Argentine red displays exceptional freshness and balance, showcasing a robust core of dark berry fruit framed by firm, velvety tannins and bright acidity, driving toward a long, clean, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with grilled sirloin steak topped with chimichurri butter, herb-crusted roasted lamb cutlets, or rich chorizo pasta dishes.

dona-paula-los-cardos-malbec-1.title: Dona Paula Los Cardos Malbec 750ml
dona-paula-los-cardos-malbec-1.bodyHtml:
Intense purplish red color. Sweet, spicy and intense aromas, with notes of red fruits and herbs (such as Herbes de Provence). In the mouth, this wine is soft, velvety, fresh, and well balanced.

On the nose it opens with notes of red berries and plum, intermixed with notes of spice, black pepper, mint and graphite. On the palate, the wine is soft and fresh, full-bodied and very delightful.

donnafugata-tancredi-nero-davola-caberne.title: Chateau Haut-Brion 2016 1.5L Magnum
donnafugata-tancredi-nero-davola-caberne.bodyHtml:
#55 Wine Enthusiast Top 100 Cellar Selections of 2019

Blend: 56% Merlot, 37.5% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6.5% Cabernet Franc


100pts Wine Enthusiast

Immensely tannic, this is a great Haut-Brion, one of the finest for many years. It shows the severe side of this estate, with a dense structure to match the powerful black fruits. Rich with berry flavors and lifted by enough acidity, the wine will age for many years. Drink from 2026.
Cellar Selection


100pts Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2016 Haut-Brion is blended of 56% Merlot, 37.5% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6.5% Cabernet Franc. Medium to deep garnet-purple colored, the nose is at once profound and arresting, offering drop-dead gorgeous Morello cherries, lilacs and red rose scents with a core of Black Forest cake, warm blackcurrants and blueberry preserves plus wafts of sandalwood and underbrush. Medium-bodied, the elegantly crafted palate is completely packed with intense floral, mineral and cassis-laced flavors with a firm frame of very finely pixelated tannins and seamless freshness, finishing very long and achingly stunning.

100pts James Suckling
Stunning black fruit with plenty of forest berries in there, the whole picture cool and very delicate, also on the concentrated and highly structured palate. The tannins are very fine-grained, but decisively austere and, together with the vibrant acidity, they propel the finish out towards infinity and leave a breathtaking final impression. A blend of 56 per cent merlot, 37.5 per cent cabernet sauvignon and 6.5 per cent cabernet franc. Very long aging potential, but you could try it in 2023.

100pts Decanter
This has a little more reticence initially on the nose than La Mission, but after a few minutes the rich texture begins to reveal itself, with charcoal, tobacco, dark plum and damson fruits that are straining at the leash. It has hidden power and subtle oak toasting - this clearly feels no need to shout about its presence, but there will be plenty to discover over time. You can feel those tannins licking around your teeth, building up one layer at a time. A great wine En primeur that has settled into greatness.

98pts Wine Spectator
Large and in charge, this has a prodigious core of steeped plum, black currant and loganberry fruit flavors that show both compote and coulis aspects. While that steeps, this delivers a sturdy frame of roasted mesquite, smoldering tobacco and incense, surrounding a muscular spine of worn cedar and tar. Still rather backward, this will be showing well when most others from the vintage have had their day. Best from 2025 through 2045.

98pts Jeb Dunnuck
As to the reds, the 2016 Haut Brion is a prodigious, legendary wine in the making, although it’s not for those seeking instant gratification. Deeper colored and more concentrated than the La Mission Haut Brion, it reveals a purple/ruby color as well as a sensational bouquet of blackcurrants, cassis, cigar tobacco, cold fireplace, violets, and lead pencil. Deep, masculine, structured, and mineral-laced, it has a stacked mid-palate, full-bodied richness, building tannins, and a firm, blockbuster styled finish that lasts for close to a minute. A wine for the ages, don’t even think about opening bottles for at least 7-8 years. It should keep for half a century. The blend in 2016 is 56% Merlot, 37.5% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 6.5% Cabernet Franc.
Rating: 98+

dos-maderas-5-5-px.title: Dos Maderas 5+5 PX Triple Aged Rum
dos-maderas-5-5-px.bodyHtml:
Dos Maderas 5+5 PX Cask Aged Rum is a fascinating, award-winning expression that showcases an extraordinary "triple-aging" process spanning two completely different continents. Crafted by the historic house of Williams & Humbert, the journey begins in the Caribbean, where fine rums from Barbados and Guyana are column-distilled and matured in American oak barrels for an initial 5 years.

The rum is then shipped to the sun-drenched region of Jerez, Spain, where it undergoes a double-phase finishing process using a traditional Sherry Solera system. It is first aged for 3 years in casks that previously held the distillery's internationally acclaimed "Dos Cortados" 20-Year-Old Palo Cortado Sherry. Finally, it spends an additional 2 years in casks that held "Don Guido" 20-Year-Old Pedro Ximénez (PX) Sherry. This final, heavy PX cask seasoning infuses the rum with an unparalleled, decadent richness, completely blurring the lines between a premium aged spirit and a luxurious dessert wine.

Food Pairing: Rich chocolate fondant, artisanal blue cheese, warm fig tarts, pan-seared duck with a cherry reduction, or a fine premium cigar.

TASTING NOTES Deep, dark mahogany amber with intense ruby highlights; offers a remarkably lush, viscous, and syrupy mouthfeel that entirely coats the tongue.

NOSE Powerfully aromatic and dessert-forward, opening with intense waves of dark molasses, sweet brown sugar, and vanilla fudge, quickly giving way to the heavy sherry influence of juicy raisins, dried figs, dates, and a gentle touch of toasted oak.

PALATE Luxuriously sweet, rich, and deeply complex; initial flavors of dark honey, maple syrup, and toffee are masterfully met by a wave of stewed plums, dark chocolate, and roasted nuts. The Palo Cortado wood breaks through on the mid-palate, adding structural balance with notes of aged leather, tobacco leaf, and a fine hint of spice.

FINISH Exceptionally long, warm, and velvety, leaving a lingering, mouth-coating trail of sweet Pedro Ximénez grapes, dark cocoa, vanilla bean, and a sophisticated, dry wood-smoke finish.

SERVE Best enjoyed strictly neat at room temperature in a snifter or a spirits tulip glass to fully appreciate the complex, slow-unraveling layers of the Solera wood.

doubleday-bourbon-1.title: Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon
doubleday-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon is a landmark Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey widely recognized as the world's first commercially available single barrel bourbon, introduced in 1984 by Master Distiller Elmer T. Lee. Named in honor of Colonel Albert B. Blanton, who spent over five decades managing the historic Buffalo Trace Distillery (formerly the George T. Stagg Distillery), each bottle is drawn from an individual cask aged in the center-cut section of Warehouse H—the only metal-clad warehouse on the distillery grounds, known for rapid temperature fluctuations that accelerate wood interaction. Crafted from Buffalo Trace's high-rye Mashbill #2 and bottled at 93 proof, it delivers a rich, complex, and remarkably balanced profile of sweet vanilla, citrus, caramel, and warm baking spices, housed in its iconic round bottle topped with a collectible cast-metal horse and jockey stopper.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-smoked beef brisket, glazed pork ribs, seared duck breast, aged sharp cheddar or Gouda, dark chocolate pecan tarts, and warm bread pudding with caramel sauce.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber with warm copper-orange highlights, presenting a full, rich body with a velvety, smooth, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Warm vanilla, honey, caramel, dried orange peel, toasted oak, nutmeg, and subtle rye spice.

Palate : Rich and creamy with flavors of burnt sugar, sweet corn, dark toffee, clove, cinnamon, citrus zest, and seasoned charred oak.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warming with lingering notes of sweet vanilla, baking spices, honey, and subtle dry oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or rocks glass, over a single large ice cube, or as the rich centerpiece in classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

dr-l-riesling.title: Dr. Loosen Dr. L Riesling 750ml
dr-l-riesling.bodyHtml: This top-selling Loosen Bros. wine is Ernst Loosen’s “ambassador” for the Mosel region and for the Riesling variety. It embodies the delicate and racy style that is characteristic of Riesling grown in the slate-soil vineyards of the Mosel valley. And, best of all, it delivers this uniquely delicious and invigorating taste at a very affordable price for every day enjoyment. It is a bright, refreshing, fruit-driven wine, with a juicy mid-palate and a crisp, drying finish.

dr-zenzen-vino-noir.title: Dr. Zenzen Noblesse Vino Noire
dr-zenzen-vino-noir.bodyHtml:
Deep ruby-red in colour, opening with bright, inviting aromas of ripe red cherry, wild strawberry, blackberry, and sweet plum, accented by subtle hints of vanilla and soft spice. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied, smooth, and approachable, delivering juicy red and dark berry flavours balanced by gentle sweetness, soft tannins, and clean acidity on a mellow, easy-drinking finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled sausages, roasted chicken, mild barbecue ribs, tomato-based pasta dishes, charcuterie boards, or semi-soft cheeses like Gouda and Edam.

drambuie.title: Drambuie Heather Honey Whisky Liqueur 375ml
drambuie.bodyHtml: This exceptional liqueur has a deep-rooted history and is made from a blend of aged Scotch whisky, spice, herbs and honey. Look for a bright golden colour with flavours of warm malt, tangy lemongrass, heather honey and notes of fresh herbs, spices and warm shortbread on the finish.

drumshanbo-gunpowder-irish-gin-1.title: Drumshanbo Gunpowder Irish Gin
drumshanbo-gunpowder-irish-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Drumshanbo Gunpowder Irish Gin is the flagship gin of The Shed Distillery of PJ Rigney in Drumshanbo, County Leitrim, Ireland. It is slow distilled by hand in what the distillery calls medieval copper pot stills and bottled at 43% ABV; this listing is the 750ml bottle. The recipe joins eight botanicals distilled in the pot still with four that are vapour infused, pairing oriental botanicals with fresh citrus and Chinese gunpowder tea, the slowly dried, rolled green tea that gives the gin its name. The twelve botanicals are meadowsweet, cardamom, juniper, coriander, angelica, orris, caraway, star anise, gunpowder tea, lemon, grapefruit and kaffir lime. The jackalope on the label is the distillery's emblem, a creature its founder says he has glimpsed in the fields around Drumshanbo.

Tasting Notes: Layers of fresh citrus, oriental botanicals and gunpowder tea.

Serve: With premium tonic water and a generous wedge of fresh red grapefruit, or in a cocktail.

drumshanbo-single-pot-irish-whisky.title: Drumshanbo Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
drumshanbo-single-pot-irish-whisky.bodyHtml: Triple Distilled at The Shed Distillery of PJ Rigney, Drumshanbo, Co Leitrim. This single batch whiskey has stayed true to Irish whiskey making traditions. Distilled with Malted Irish Barley, Un-malted Irish Barley & Irish Barra Oats. Un-malted barley imparts a silky mouthfeel when combined with Barra Oats creates an intriguing creaminess & spiciness to the finish that truly sets this Irish whiskey apart. Aged in Sherry Oloroso & Kentucky Bourbon casks. This single Batch ‘Single Pot Still’ Irish Whiskey is exceptionally smooth, creamy, spicy & a true delight for the senses.

duboeuf-beaujolais-1.title: Georges Dubœuf (Duboeuf) Beaujolais 2023 750ml
duboeuf-beaujolais-1.bodyHtml:
This fruit-forward red is sure to please the crowd. Red fruit and spice aromas replay on the juicy, fruit-forward palate. This well-balanced red is crafted in an easy-drinking style, with soft tannins and ripe red berry fruit flavours. It is a perfect patio sipper, date night chaperone or Taco Tuesday accompaniment.

90 Points - James Suckling

A very fruity red that has peach, plum and strawberry aromas. It’s soft and juicy with medium body and a bright finish. Delicious now.

duckhorn-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
duckhorn-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, polished, and beautifully structured red wine that embodies the character and depth of premier Napa Valley grape sources. It opens with captivating aromas of dark red berries, crushed blackberries, cassis, fresh tobacco, and warm cardamom, framed by subtle accents of oak spice and crushed stone. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, fruit-forward core featuring layers of fig jam and boysenberry pie, supported by firm, dusty tannins and a vibrant, well-balanced acidity that leads to a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled tri-tip steak, prime ribeye, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, or aged gouda.

92 Points - James Suckling

Bright and refined with aromas of blackberries, cassis, fresh tobacco, crushed stones and dark chocolate. The palate is full-bodied and polished with fine tannins and vibrant fruit. Defined and balanced with a touch of minerality.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Bright ruby in the glass. Aromatics of ripe fruits and liqueur continue into flavors of fennel, graphite, and spiced cocoa. Polished tannins are well balanced into a lingering finish.

duckhorn-napa-valley-merlot-2017.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Merlot 2022
duckhorn-napa-valley-merlot-2017.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Duckhorn Napa Valley Merlot is a masterful and velvety expression of the varietal from a pioneer of the style. It presents an alluring, deep ruby colour and opens with a complex aromatic profile of black cherry, plum, and huckleberry, seamlessly layered with sophisticated notes of vanilla, clove, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and supple, showcasing a lush core of dark fruit balanced by a bright, refreshing acidity and fine-grained tannins. Aging for 15 months in French oak (roughly 40% new) provides a refined structure and subtle spicy nuances, leading to a long, polished finish with lingering echoes of cocoa, cedar, and savory herbs.

Food Pairing: Perfectly matches with roasted duck breast with a cherry reduction, grilled lamb chops, mushroom risotto, beef tenderloin, or aged cheeses like Gouda and Camembert.

92  Points - James Suckling

A dark-fruited, fleshy red with ripe blackberries, dark chocolate, licorice and hints of wet stones on the nose. Medium-to full-bodied with a lively pace, showing silky tannins and a smooth, lingering finish.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Vibrant and polished, with elegantly complex cherry and red currant flavors that take on hints of toasty spices and tomato leaf as this sails toward refined tannins. Drink now through 2032.

e-j-brandy-vsop.title: St-Remy VSOP French Brandy 1.75L
e-j-brandy-vsop.bodyHtml:
St-Remy V.S.O.P. is a classic French brandy produced using 100% French wine grapes sourced from renowned wine regions across France. Matured in small French oak casks, it exhibits a harmonious, balanced profile with delicate aromas of ripe fruits, oak, and soft vanilla.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, aged cheeses, dark chocolate, fruit tarts, roasted pork, and duck confit.

Tasting Notes : Amber-gold with yellow highlights, offering a smooth, light, and well-rounded mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Ripe red berries, peach, apricot, subtle oak, and light vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of candied fruit, sweet oak, delicate vanilla, and warm spice.

Finish : Smooth, short to medium, with lingering notes of sweet fruit and gentle wood.

Serve : Best served neat in a tulip or glass tumbler at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a versatile base in classic cocktails such as a Brandy Alexander or Sidecar.

eagle-rare-17-year-old-bourbon.title: Craigellachie 17 Year Old
eagle-rare-17-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Craigellachie 17 Year Old is a richly complex and robust Speyside single malt that builds beautifully upon the distillery's famously meaty and distinctive character. Retaining the traditional use of oil-fired malt and old-fashioned worm tub condensers, this expression benefits from an extended 17-year maturation process in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks. The extra time in oak elegantly mellows its signature savory and faintly sulphury edge, elevating notes of exotic roasted pineapple, sweet vanilla, and rich oak spice. Bottled at 46% ABV without chill-filtration or added coloring, it is a heavy, old-school whisky with remarkable depth and character.

Food Pairing: Glazed roast pork, smoked sausages, rich fruitcake, mature cheddar, or roasted root vegetables.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a noticeably thick, waxy, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Complex and expressive, intertwining sweet aromas of baked apple, roasted pineapple, and vanilla with a distinctive savory, meaty undertone and a faint, alluring hint of struck match or sulfur.

Palate : Rich, viscous, and deeply flavorful, opening with sweet notes of tropical fruits, honey, and toasted oats, before evolving into complex layers of clove, licorice, subtle wood smoke, and a savory, meaty backbone.

Finish : Long, warming, and waxy, leaving lingering impressions of sweet oak, dried fruit, and a gentle savory smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to fully appreciate its bold complexity, or add a few drops of water to tame the sulfur notes and enhance the tropical fruitiness.

earthquake-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: Michael David Winery Earthquake Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
earthquake-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
Michael David Winery Earthquake Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a massive, intensely concentrated, and over-the-top California red wine designed to completely saturate the senses. Named to honor the historic 1906 San Francisco earthquake, this bold wine pours a deep ruby-violet color in the glass, unleashing a potent and layered bouquet of raspberry crème brûlée, wild huckleberry, and sweet cherry pie filling, beautifully complexed by hints of cedar box, anise, and vanilla bean. On the palate, it is exceptionally full-bodied, thick, and voluminous, delivering powerful, almost-sweet flavors of blackberry jam, dark blueberries, and a unique undertone reminiscent of warm butter croissants. Backed by a hefty, broad tannin structure and an elevated alcohol warmth, the wine transitions into a trembling, lengthy, and oak-inspired finish laced with lingering notes of savory cocoa, cinnamon spice, and mocha.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with heavily seasoned and rich dishes such as charcoal-grilled ribeye steak, smoked beef brisket, slow-braised short ribs, wild boar burgers with blue cheese, or a rustic venison stew, as well as strong, hard cheeses like aged gouda or clothbound cheddar.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Rich and intense, with aromas of Boysenberry, black licorice, violets, and notes of toasted oak and nutmeg on the nose, the palate is concentrated with brambled Blackberry, Blueberry compote, citrus zest, spearmint cream, and dry silky tannins on the finish. Decant and pair with smoked meats, hearty cheeses.

earthquake-zinfandel-2018.title: Michael David Winery Earthquake Zinfandel 2022
earthquake-zinfandel-2018.bodyHtml:
Michael David Winery Earthquake Zinfandel 2022 is a "burly" and full-bodied red that delivers over-the-top concentration and intensity. It opens with bold aromas of red berry, cranberry tart, and peppery spice, leading to a palate overflowing with Bing cherry, dark chocolate, and molasses flavors. Aged for 18 months in a combination of American (46%), French (14%), and neutral oak (40%), it possesses robust tannins and a fruit-laced finish that lingers long after the glass is empty.

Food Pairing: Ideally suited for rich, savory dishes like American barbecue (ribs and brisket), grilled double pork chops with dark berry relish, hearty lasagna, or bold cheeses such as aged Cheddar and Gorgonzola.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Deep, with aromas of Olallieberry and black currant, notes of vanilla, sarsaparilla, and dried potpourri on the nose, the palate captures baked blackberry pie, cloves, and tobacco layered with candied orange rind and a mouth-watering finish. Decant and pair with grilled double pork chops, mushrooms, dark berry relish.

91 Points - James Suckling

A high-powered wine that takes ripeness to the max, practically glowing with baked blackberries, boysenberries, black pepper and iron on the palate. Elevated alcohol and moderate tannins give an expansive, warm texture.

eau-claire-cherry-gin-1.title: Eau Claire Parlour Cherry Gin
eau-claire-cherry-gin-1.bodyHtml:
This London-dry style gin is infused with sour cherries and over 12 unique botanicals.
The barley-based gin has a hint of natural sweetness, with a tart, pleasant, long silky finish and a unique mouth feel.
Enjoy in a Cherry Gin fizz or aviation!

eau-claire-flourish-gin-1.title: Eau Claire Distillery Flourish Gin
eau-claire-flourish-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Eau Claire Distillery Flourish Gin is a contemporary craft gin produced in small batches by Eau Claire Distillery in Turner Valley, Alberta. Distilled using farm-fresh Alberta grain and pure Rocky Mountain water, this gin is infused with a unique blend of traditional and local botanicals—including juniper, saskatoon berries, rose hips, citrus peel, and mint—delivering a vibrant, floral, and fruit-forward flavor profile with a signature pink hue.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, goat cheese crostini, fresh oysters, summer berry salads, or grilled shrimp skewers.

Tasting Notes : Light pink-hued tint with a smooth, light, and refreshing mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Aromatic floral blossoms, sweet saskatoon berries, fresh rose petal, crisp juniper, and bright citrus zest.

Palate : Soft and fruit-forward with vibrant notes of red berries, gentle piney juniper, subtle mint, and bright grapefruit citrus.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering floral notes and subtle berry sweetness.

Serve : Served over ice with premium tonic water and a garnish of fresh lime or raspberries, or as a base in a French 75 cocktail.

eau-claire-parlour-gin-1.title: Eau Claire Distillery Parlour Gin
eau-claire-parlour-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Eau Claire Distillery Parlour Gin, now labelled Parlour Canadian Dry Gin, is the award-winning gin of Eau Claire Distillery in Turner Valley, Alberta: a London dry style gin with an Alberta spin. It is barley-based and uses 10 botanicals, pairing a juniper-driven dryness with local touches such as rose hips and Albertan Saskatoon berries alongside coriander, lemon, orange and mint. The texture is smooth and harmonious, and the name honours the prohibition-era gin parlours and speakeasies that inspired it. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it suits everything from a martini or Negroni to a simple gin and tonic.

Nose: A floral hint.

Palate: Alberta Saskatoon berries and rose hips, slightly sweet.

Finish: Dry and botanical.

Serve: Neat, in a martini or Negroni, or with tonic.

eau-claire-prickly-pear-equineox.title: Eau Claire Distillery Prickly Pear EquineOx Vodka
eau-claire-prickly-pear-equineox.bodyHtml:
Prickly Pear EquineOx honours the role our horses and oxen play in the annual renewal of the earth, readying our fields for the annual spring planting.

A sweet, barley based alternative to gin or vodka that can be served on ice or enjoy it as a complement to your favourite cocktail. Pair it with longer evenings as you migrate to patio living ? the definition of refreshment.

eau-claire-three-point-vodka-1.title: Eau Claire Distillery Three Point Vodka
eau-claire-three-point-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Eau Claire Distillery Three Point Vodka is an artisanal craft vodka produced by Eau Claire Distillery in Turner Valley, Alberta. Made with locally grown Alberta malting barley and pure Rocky Mountain water, it is distilled in small batches to yield a smooth, clean, and distinctively characterful spirit.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, charcuterie, caviar, or light appetizers.

Tasting Notes : Clear and pristine appearance with a smooth, soft, and buttery mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet aromas with hints of caramel, vanilla, and gentle malted grain.

Palate : Buttery and balanced with light notes of vanilla, caramel, banana, and subtle Alberta barley sweetness.

Finish : Smooth, clean, and moderately lingering with soft warmth and a hint of sweet grain.

Serve : Serve chilled neat, over ice, or as a smooth base in a classic vodka martini or mixed cocktail.

eclipse-trebbiano-dabruzzo-1.title: Eclipse Trebbiano D'Abruzzo 750ml
eclipse-trebbiano-dabruzzo-1.bodyHtml: The "Eclipse Trebbiano d'Abruzzo 750ml" is a dry, white wine from the Abruzzo region of Italy, produced by Cantina Bosco. It's made entirely from the Trebbiano grape variety. The wine has a straw yellow color with light greenish nuances. The aroma is described as intense with floral and fruity notes, while the taste is dry and fresh with a slight bitterness.

edge-cabernet-2017.title: Edge Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
edge-cabernet-2017.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Edge Cabernet Sauvignon was sourced from premium Alexander Valley vineyards, specifically chosen for their high-quality fruit and tannin structure. Ray Signorello and his winemaking team have crafted a rich and luscious age-worthy Cabernet Sauvignon that will drink beautifully for the next 5-8 years.

92 Points - James Suckling

A supple and gentle red wine that soothes the palate with soft tannins and broad, ripe black cherry flavors. Light oak accents. Full-bodied, broad and generous, with chocolate, vanilla and cinnamon notes and a lingering finish.

edinburg-rhubarb-ginger-gin.title: Edinburgh Rhubarb & Ginger Gin
edinburg-rhubarb-ginger-gin.bodyHtml:
Edinburgh Rhubarb & Ginger Gin is a full-strength, flavor-infused Scottish gin crafted by post-infusing the distillery's signature Classic Gin with spring crop rhubarb and warming stem ginger. Evolving from the distillery's popular fruit liqueur, this full-strength expression balances tangy fruit sweetness, gentle ginger spice, and crisp juniper.

Food Pairing: Lemon tarts, rhubarb crumble, ginger cookies, goat cheese crostini, duck breast with fruit reduction, and Thai-inspired seafood dishes.

Tasting Notes : Delicate, pale rose-pink in appearance with a smooth, bright, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright aromas of tangy rhubarb and piney juniper complemented by subtle lemon zest and a lift of warm oriental ginger.

Palate : A harmonious balance of tart, sweet rhubarb and warming ginger spice, supported by crisp juniper, citrus zest, and a touch of lemongrass.

Finish : Smooth, full, and lingering with gentle ginger heat, zesty citrus, and soft pepper-juniper notes.

Serve : Served over ice with premium Mediterranean tonic water or ginger ale, garnished with a lemon wheel or a twist of fresh orange peel.

edinburgh-raspberry-gin-1.title: Edinburgh Gin Raspberry Gin
edinburgh-raspberry-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Edinburgh Raspberry Gin is a vibrant and refreshing fruit gin liqueur crafted by infusing red raspberries and delicate botanicals with classic Edinburgh Gin. Made with natural ingredients and real raspberry juice, it balances sweet berry flavors with a crisp juniper undertone, delivering a bright and authentically fruity spirit profile.

Food Pairing: Vanilla bean ice cream, chocolate torte, lemon tart, fresh fruit pavlova, and mild soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant deep pinkish-red in appearance with a smooth, luscious, and light-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and aromatic, dominated by rich ripe raspberries, sweet berry jam, and a subtle undertone of citrus and piney juniper.

Palate : Sweet and fruit-forward, featuring intense flavors of tart raspberries and red berry syrup balanced by a gentle juniper crispness.

Finish : Clean, sweet, and refreshing, leaving a lingering impression of natural raspberry and subtle botanical spice.

Serve : Serve chilled over ice, topped with Prosecco or champagne for a Royale cocktail, or mixed with premium tonic water or lemonade garnished with fresh raspberries and a mint sprig.

edradour-10-year-old-1.title: Edradour 10 Year Old
edradour-10-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Edradour 10 Year Old is the core single malt of Edradour, one of Scotland's smallest distilleries and one of the last traditional farm distilleries still working. Production methods have changed little in 150 years, and the distillery makes about as much whisky in a year as many distilleries produce in a week, so its output is small and handmade. This version is bottled at 10 years old at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle, a gentler strength than the distillery's 46% unchillfiltered editions. It is a good introduction to the distillery's traditional, small-batch style.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

edradour-ballechin-10-year-old-47.title: Edradour Ballechin 10 Year Old
edradour-ballechin-10-year-old-47.bodyHtml:
Ballechin 10 Year Old is the core expression of the heavily peated single malt made at Edradour Distillery near Pitlochry in Perthshire since 2003. The barley is peated to a level of at least 50ppm, and this bottling is drawn predominantly from ex-bourbon casks with a generous top dressing of ex-Oloroso sherry casks for extra depth and complexity. It is bottled at 46% ABV without chill-filtration and with natural colour, to keep the true cask character. The name comes from Ballechin, a fellow Perthshire farm distillery that closed in 1927, where Alfred Barnard noted a peated whisky during his 1880s tour of the UK's distilleries. Presented in a 700ml bottle with a green tube.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

edradour-ballechin-cuvee-8-year-old-47.title: Edradour Ballechin 8 Year Old 2008 Double Malt Double Cask
edradour-ballechin-cuvee-8-year-old-47.bodyHtml:
Edradour Ballechin 8 Year Old Double Malt - Double Cask is a cuvee of the two whiskies made at Edradour Distillery in Pitlochry: the unpeated Edradour and the peated Ballechin. The label shows one Edradour sherry cask (2008, cask 123) married with three Ballechin bourbon casks (2008, casks 293, 294 and 295), so sherry-cask richness meets peat smoke from bourbon wood. Aged eight years, it is bottled at 46% ABV with natural colour and without chill-filtration. Highland single malt in a 700ml bottle with a black tube.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

edradour-caledonia-12-year-old-46.title: Edradour Caledonia 12 Year Old
edradour-caledonia-12-year-old-46.bodyHtml:
Edradour Caledonia 12 Year Old is a special small-batch release chosen by Scottish songwriter Dougie MacLean and named after his celebrated song "Caledonia", written in 1977 while he was homesick for Scotland. MacLean, who has always lived in Perthshire, says the neat cluster of whitewashed buildings at Edradour near Pitlochry, its traditional equipment and its old methods typify Caledonia. The single malt is fully matured in Oloroso sherry casks and is distilled, matured and bottled at the distillery. Bottled at 46% ABV without chill filtration and with natural colour, it keeps plenty of depth and body; the distillery describes it as an old-fashioned whisky for those who want to taste how whisky used to be made. 700ml, presented in a tube.

Tasting Notes: Sherried dried fruit, honey and gentle spice.

Nose: Sultanas and figs balanced with honey.

Palate: Rich and syrupy, like Christmas cake, with toasted almonds and a hint of orange spice; a little water brings the Oloroso fruit forward.

Finish: Gently warming, spicy and dry.

Serve: Neat or with a few drops of water.

effen-vodka-1.title: Effen Vodka
effen-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
EFFEN Original Vodka is a Dutch wheat vodka made at the family-run Hooghoudt distillery in the north of the Netherlands. It is distilled from 100% wheat grain on a continuous vacuum system, chill-distilled and carbon filtered, then blended with spring water from northern Holland. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is light, crisp and smooth, made for shots and as a clean base for cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Fresh, clean and balanced.

Nose: Fresh and clean.

Palate: Smooth, even and balanced.

Finish: Silky, with minimal alcohol aftertaste.

Serve: Ice-cold as a shot, with soda, or in a Martini or other vodka cocktail.

eh-taylor-18-year-old.title: EH Taylor 18 Year Old Bourbon
eh-taylor-18-year-old.bodyHtml: Known as the founding father of the modern bourbon industry, Colonel Edmund Haynes Taylor, Jr. was committed to making unparalleled bourbon through his steadfast attention to detail and passion for innovation. His constant drive for perfection revolutionized the industry, with many of his techniques still in use today. This unique bourbon combines barrels from three signature mashbills that matured for eighteen years, including two different rye bourbon mashbills and our wheated bourbon mashbill. The marriage of bourbon mashbills gives this magnificent whiskey a nose of vanilla butter cake, a rich palate of caramel and cinnamon, and long finish of toasted oak, cinnamon, and hint of spearmint. A true testament to Taylor?s pursuit of perfection and his dedication to push the boundaries of making whiskey, this bourbon would have made its namesake proud.

eh-taylor-amaranth.title: EH Taylor Amaranth Bourbon
eh-taylor-amaranth.bodyHtml:
LIMIT OF 1 PER CUSTOMER. NO FURTHER DISCOUNTS APPLY.

Fresh spearmint and honey, meet a subtle hint of cherry. Taste coffee and vanilla on the palate with a long finish of oak and honey.

eh-taylor-single-barrel.title: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Select Tennessee Whiskey
eh-taylor-single-barrel.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Select is a Tennessee whiskey from the Jack Daniel Distillery in Lynchburg, Tennessee, established in 1866. Every bottle comes from one individual barrel, chosen for its character from the upper levels of the maturation warehouses, where greater temperature swings drive the whiskey deeper into the toasted oak. Like all Jack Daniel's, the spirit is mellowed through sugar maple charcoal before ageing in American white oak barrels. Bottled at 94 proof (47% ABV) in a 750ml bottle, it offers a more concentrated oak, caramel and spice profile than Old No. 7, lifted by bright fruit and sweet aromatics, and each barrel brings its own variation.

Tasting Notes: Caramel and spice with bright fruit.

Nose: Sweet fruit and vanilla with a touch of spice underneath.

Palate: Spice with warm, rich caramel.

Finish: Medium oak, clove and banana.

Serve: Neat, or in an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

eh-taylor-single-barrel-small-batch.title: E.H. Taylor, Jr. Small Batch Straight Kentucky Bourbon
eh-taylor-single-barrel-small-batch.bodyHtml:
LIMIT OF 1 PER CUSTOMER. NO FURTHER DISCOUNTS APPLY.

Tastes of caramel corn sweetness, mingled with butterscotch and licorice. The aftertaste is a soft mouth-feel that turns into subtle spices of pepper and tobacco.

eh-taylor-straight-rye.title: Elijah Craig Straight Rye Whiskey
eh-taylor-straight-rye.bodyHtml:
Elijah Craig Straight Rye Whiskey is a remarkable Kentucky spirit that honors the legacy of Reverend Elijah Craig, the pioneer widely known as the "Father of Bourbon." Produced by the esteemed Heaven Hill Distillery, this expression utilizes a traditional mashbill featuring a modest 51% rye, supported by a healthy dose of corn and malted barley. This unique grain ratio, combined with careful aging in Level 3 charred oak barrels, creates a beautifully balanced whiskey. It seamlessly harmonizes the fiery, peppery spice of the rye grain with the smooth, sweet, and comforting caramel notes of corn, resulting in a robust yet highly approachable rye whiskey.

Food Pairing: This robust and spicy rye is a fantastic match for savory, slow-cooked meats like smoked beef brisket, pulled pork, or spicy grilled sausages. For a sweeter contrast, serve it alongside classic apple pie, dark chocolate desserts, or a sharp, aged cheddar cheese.

TASTING NOTES - A rich, deep amber liquid with a medium-to-full-bodied texture that coats the glass, showcasing a perfect harmony of sweet barrel notes and sharp rye spice.

NOSE - Engaging aromas of dark chocolate, toasted oak, and baking spices mingle with a distinct undertone of sweet vanilla, dark caramel, and a subtle hint of fresh orchard apples.

Palate - Rich, smooth, and warming. It opens with sweet honey, vanilla cream, and butterscotch, quickly transitioning into a vibrant wave of black pepper, cinnamon, clove, and classic rye baking spices.

FINISH - Crisp, long, and pleasantly warming, leaving a lingering trail of toasted oak, subtle sweetness, and a pleasant, peppery rye prickle.

SERVE - Excellent enjoyed neat or over a single large ice cube, but truly shines as a sturdy, spicy foundation in classic whiskey cocktails like a Manhattan, Boulevardier, or Sazerac.

el-dorado-25-year-old.title: El Dorado 25 Year Old Rum
el-dorado-25-year-old.bodyHtml:
El Dorado 25 Year Old Rum is a pinnacle expression of Demerara rum, showcasing the historic blending traditions of Guyana. Produced by Demerara Distillers Ltd. at the Diamond Distillery, this ultra-premium spirit is crafted from molasses and distilled utilizing their legendary collection of heritage stills, including the Enmore wooden coffey still and the Port Mourant wooden pot still. The rum is then aged for a minimum of 25 years in selected American oak ex-bourbon casks under the tropical climate of Guyana, which dramatically accelerates the interaction between the wood and the spirit. This extensive maturation process yields a remarkably deep, velvety, and luxurious rum that stands as a definitive masterpiece for collectors and connoisseurs worldwide.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with rich dark chocolate fondant, artisanal fruit cakes, premium cigars, pan-seared duck breast with a cherry reduction, or aged blue cheeses.

TASTING NOTES - A deep, dark bronze-amber color with copper highlights, boasting a full-bodied, rich, and intensely velvety texture that completely coats the palate.

NOSE - Deeply aromatic and complex, opening with rich notes of molasses, dark brown sugar, and roasted nuts, beautifully layered with dried fruits, sweet tobacco, raisins, and a prominent touch of old oak wood.

PALATE - Exceptionally smooth and multi-layered on the tongue, delivering dominant flavors of sweet caramel, dark chocolate, and orange peel, seamlessly balanced by baking spices, nutmeg, vanilla, and heavy oak tannins.

FINISH - Remarkably long, warming, and elegant, resolving with a lingering trail of dry wood spices, dark brown sugar sweetness, and a touch of roasted coffee beans.

SERVE - Best enjoyed poured neat at room temperature in a proper spirits nosing glass or balloon snifter to allow the intricate, decades-long barrel character to fully open up.

el-dorado-50-year-old.title: El Dorado 3 Year Old Cask Aged White Rum
el-dorado-50-year-old.bodyHtml:
El Dorado 3 Year Old is a white Demerara rum from Demerara Distillers Limited in Guyana, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750 ml bottle. The rum is laid down in oak barrels for at least three years and then filtered twice through natural charcoal to strip out the colour it took from the wood, leaving a clear spirit that keeps its cask-aged character. El Dorado rums are blends of batches drawn from the distillery's different stills, and the producer presents this expression as a smooth, versatile rum for cocktails, giving a Daiquiri as its signature serve.

Tasting Notes: Balanced yet full flavoured, with citrus, vanilla and coconut.

Nose: Citrus and vanilla, backed by chocolate and raisins.

Palate: Smooth and rounded, with coconut and fruit.

Finish: Dry and rounded.

Serve: In a Daiquiri: the producer's recipe is 50 ml rum, 25 ml lime juice and 10 ml sugar syrup, shaken with ice and strained into a chilled coupe.

el-dorado-gift-pack.title: El Dorado The Collection Rum Gift Pack 12, 15 and 21 Year Old 3 x 375ml
el-dorado-gift-pack.bodyHtml:
El Dorado The Collection is a gift pack of three aged Demerara rums from Demerara Distillers Limited in Guyana, each in a 375ml bottle: El Dorado 12 Year Old, El Dorado 15 Year Old Special Reserve and El Dorado 21 Year Old Special Reserve. Together they show how the house style develops with age, from the smooth, softly sweet 12 year old to the deeper, more complex 15 and the velvety 21 year old with caramel and tropical fruit. Total volume 1.125L, bottled at 40% ABV, presented in a gift box.

Serve: Neat, side by side, from youngest to oldest.

el-dorado-single-still-enmore.title: El Dorado Single Still Enmore 2006 Rum
el-dorado-single-still-enmore.bodyHtml:
The El Dorado Single Still Enmore Rum is produced from the original EHP Wooden Continuous Coffey Still, first constructed at the Enmore Estate in 1880. This still was named after the original owner of the
Enmore Sugar Plantation Edward Henry Porter, and was based on the original design of its inventor, Irishman Aeneas Coffey.

With the closure of the estate in 2000, this still was moved to Diamond Estate. It is the last surviving wooden still operating in the world today. The El Dorado Single Still Enmore Rum was laid down in oak barrels for 12 years.

Tasting Notes

Butterscotch nose blended with roasted coconut and apple. An initial taste of baked peach and coconut with a smoky cedar finish. Excellent mouthfeel.

el-dorado-single-still-port-mourant.title: El Dorado Port Mourant Single Still Rum
el-dorado-single-still-port-mourant.bodyHtml:
The El Dorado Single Still Port Mourant Rum is produced from the Double Wooden Pot Still which is the only one of its kind in use today. Constructed in 1732 on the Port Mourant Estate, this still was later moved to the Uitvlugt Estate and then to Diamond Estate in 2000.

Since then, the Double Wooden Pot Still has been producing small batches of this El Dorado Heritage Rum. This rum was laid down in oak barrels for 12 years.

Tasting Notes

Experience its robust flavours with aromas of sweet baked apples mixed with slight vanilla and cinnamon, flambée banana and coconut with hints of peaty aromas.

el-dorado-single-still-versailles.title: El Dorado Versailles Single Still Rum
el-dorado-single-still-versailles.bodyHtml:
The 18th Century estate at Plantation Versailles, then owned by the French family L’Amirault, was situated on the West Bank of the Demerara River and was famous for its golden rum. Distilled on the Single Wooden Pot Still, the rum is coloured with caramel prior to ageing in oak barrels for 12 years.

This rum celebrates the smooth chocolately palate of a fine aged rum.

Tasting Notes

An initial taste of chocolate with a smooth finish and hints of cigar.

el-jolgorio-a-karwinskii-cenizo.title: El Jolgorio A. Karwinskii Mezcal
el-jolgorio-a-karwinskii-cenizo.bodyHtml: El Jolgorio Cenizo is made with maguey Cenizo (agave Karwinskii) that takes up to 14 years to mature. The first batch of this mezcal was released as a fairly large lot considering how seldom agave Cenizo is used in Oaxacan Mezcal. Master Mezcalero Ignacio Parada is well known for his work with wild agave, and this Cenizo is no exception to his strong record of creating great mezcal. Notes of this mezcal include sweet nectar, chalky minerals, and sea salt. It has a long, extended finish. Newer releases of this mezcal come in a black bottle, and are no longer labelled Cenizo as the CRM told El Jolgorio that in order to certify this mezcal, Cenizo could not be used to name this Karwinskii agave. Despite the local naming, this is now simply called a.Karwinskii.

el-jolgorio-barril-1.title: El Jolgorio Barril Mezcal
el-jolgorio-barril-1.bodyHtml:
El Jolgorio Barril is a mezcal from the El Jolgorio range, supplied by Agave de Cortés of Oaxaca, Mexico, and made entirely from Barril, a member of the Karwinskii family of agaves that grows in hilly country and forms a long, trunk-like stalk. Production is traditional, in La Compañía, Ejutla, Oaxaca, by mezcaleros Gregorio and Gonzalo Hernández: semi-wild agaves harvested at around ten years of age, roasted in an earthen pit, crushed with a mule-drawn tahona, fermented in the open and distilled twice. This bottling is 47% ABV in a 750 ml bottle. The agave is known for giving a mezcal of great complexity that balances sweetness with citrus.

Tasting Notes: Complex, with sweetness balanced by citrus.

Serve: Neat at room temperature, sipped slowly.

el-jolgorio-cuixe.title: El Jolgorio Cuishe Mezcal
el-jolgorio-cuixe.bodyHtml: Traditional pit-roasted, mule-drawn tahona-crushed, open fermented, double-distilled mezcal from 100% wild-harvested Agave Cuixe (Agave karwinskii var.) harvested at 13 years of age, bottled at 47% ABV. Produced in Santiago Matatlan, Oaxaca, by mezcalero Gregorio Martinez Jarquin. The rare, wild agave Cuixe – like its relatives Madrecuie and Barril – grows a single stalk, with leaves spreading at the top. It is difficult to work with and requires extensive experience to achieve and optimal mezcal. The result is a spirit of great intensity.

el-jolgorio-espadin.title: Dixeebe Espadin Mezcal 375ml
el-jolgorio-espadin.bodyHtml:
Dixeebe Espadin is an artisanal mezcal from Oaxaca, Mexico, made by Asis Cortes and his father Valentin Cortes, whose family has distilled mezcal in the Santiago Matatlán area for around 180 years. Before Dixeebe the pair were best known for their work with Mezcal El Jolgorio and Nuestra Soledad; they launched Dixeebe internationally in 2022 as a way of honouring their family traditions. The brand is sold in 375ml bottles, an idea Asis had to make premium mezcal more accessible. This expression is distilled from Espadin agave and bottled at 50% alcohol by volume.

Serve: Neat at room temperature in a small glass, sipped slowly.

el-jolgorio-mexicano-1.title: El Jolgorio Mexicano Mezcal
el-jolgorio-mexicano-1.bodyHtml:
El Jolgorio Mexicano is a mezcal made entirely from semi-wild Agave Mexicano (Agave rhodacantha), bottled at 47% ABV in a 750 ml bottle. It comes from Santiago Matatlán in Oaxaca, where mezcalero Valentín Cortés works with agave harvested at around ten years of age. Production follows the traditional route: the agave is roasted in an earthen pit, crushed under a mule-drawn tahona, fermented in open vats and distilled twice. Mexicano is described as an uncommon variety of A. rhodacantha that prefers moist ground at lower elevations; the plants grow very large, often carry black thorns and hold highly concentrated sugars. Mezcalero and batch details can change from one edition to the next, so check the bottle label for the edition in hand.

Tasting Notes: A very powerful, complex mezcal with a long finish.

Serve: Neat at room temperature, in a copita or small tumbler.

el-jolgorio-pechuga-1.title: El Jolgorio Pechuga Mezcal
el-jolgorio-pechuga-1.bodyHtml:
El Jolgorio Pechuga is a celebration-style mezcal from Oaxaca, bottled at 48% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is distilled in Santiago Matatlán by maestro mezcalero Gregorio Martínez Jarquín from Espadín agave (Agave angustifolia). The agave is cooked in a conical earthen oven, crushed with a horse-drawn stone tahona and left to ferment naturally in open-air wooden vats before distillation in copper pot stills. During the second distillation, pineapple, lime, orange, plantain, apple, pear and a raw turkey breast are added to the still, the traditional pechuga method used in Oaxacan villages for weddings, funerals and Day of the Dead gatherings. El Jolgorio is the mezcal collective of the Cortés family (Casa Cortés).

Tasting Notes: Cooked agave, savoury meatiness and fresh herbs.

Nose: Cooked agave with a subtle savoury, meaty note.

Palate: Savoury and meaty with herbal, thyme-like accents; creamy, intense and lightly astringent.

Serve: Sip neat at room temperature from a copita or small tasting glass.

el-jolgorio-sierrudo.title: El Jolgorio Sierrudo Mezcal
el-jolgorio-sierrudo.bodyHtml: El Jolgorio Sierrudo is made with wild maguey Sierrudo (Agave Americana) by José Cortés in Santiago Matatlan, Oaxaca. As of 2019, Don José Cortés was the oldest living member of the Cortés family and the inspiration for the entire El Jolgorio range. He is mostly retired from making mezcal, but will produce a special batch occasionally. The maguey Sierrudo is seldom used in Mezcal. It’s closely related to maguey Arroqueno, Sierra Negra, and Coyote. This agave is enormous. It generally takes 13-15 years to mature in this region and can grow up to 1,000 pounds in weight. Sierrudo has a high concentration of sugars, meaning a single agave can yield around 20-25 bottles of mezcal. The agaves for the introductory release (ed. 1) were cultivated in a wild environment (i.e. semi-cultivated) in Agua del Guaje, San Pedro Lachigoba, San Carlos Yautepec. The first batch (ed. 1) imported into the US was just 180 bottles.

el-jolgorio-tepeztate.title: El Jolgorio Tobasiche Mezcal
el-jolgorio-tepeztate.bodyHtml:
Tobaziche is a subvarietal of the Agave karwinskii species of agave, which grow wild in certain parts of Oaxaca, representing less than 1% of the agave currently growing in the state.

Unlike most agave, whose leaves (or “pencas”) grow outwards from a central heart or core which remains close to the ground, Agave karwinskii develop as a long vertical stem or trunk, with the sugar concentrated near the top where the pencas remain green and spiky. Agave karwinskii more closely resemble a palm to many observers than what is typically identified as agave. Their height and intimidating spikes have led some indigenous communities to use them as a natural fence.

In addition, the entire trunk is typically fermented and distilled when producing mezcal, resulting in a spirit much higher in vegetal and fibrous aromatic & flavor profiles. There are many subvarietals of Agave karwinskii (Cuishe, Madrecuishe, Barril, Largo); Tobaziche is identified by its slender height, often towering above its sibling subvarietals. Known for stronger sugar concentration than many, it is safe to expect a vegetal herbaceous note paired elegantly against whispers of melon, banana or other tropical fruit.

Tobaziche is a special release from El Jolgorio, thus far only produced by two mezcaleros from the Casa Cortes community. Offered in a distinctive black glass reminiscent of the black clay jugs mezcal was historically stored in, the opaque bottle accentuates the preciousness and singularity of the spirit inside.

el-jolgorio-tobala.title: El Jolgorio Tobasiche Mezcal
el-jolgorio-tobala.bodyHtml:

el-jolgorio-todos-santos-arroqueno-1.title: El Jolgorio Todos Santos Arroqueno Mezcal
el-jolgorio-todos-santos-arroqueno-1.bodyHtml:
El Jolgorio Todos Santos Mezcaleros Arroqueño is a special-edition mezcal released by Casa Cortés in 2020 for Todos Santos, the three-day All Saints celebration of loved ones who have passed. The release paid tribute to the late maestra mezcalera Crispina Hernández Romero, mother of Rolando Cortés. It was distilled in 2015 in Lachigui, Miahuatlán (Oaxaca) by maestro mezcalero "Tío" Pedro Vásquez, the only distiller of El Jolgorio Arroqueño, from Arroqueño agave (Agave americana) in copper stills, then rested in glass for five years before bottling at a traditional 55% ABV. This 750ml bottle is a rare, high-strength single-agave mezcal for collectors and agave enthusiasts.

Serve: Sip neat at room temperature from a copita; a few drops of water open up the high-strength spirit.

el-jolgorio-todos-santos-tobasiche-1.title: El Jolgorio Todos Santos Tobasiche Mezcal
el-jolgorio-todos-santos-tobasiche-1.bodyHtml:
El Jolgorio Todos Santos Mezcaleros Tobasiche is a special edition mezcal from Casa Cortes in Oaxaca, Mexico, bottled at 52% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Released in 2020, it pays tribute to the late Crispina Hernandez Romero, a maestra mezcalera and the mother of Rolando Cortes; the label carries the words 'Un homenaje a Crispina Hernandez Romero'. Todos Santos (All Saints) is the three-day Mexican celebration of friends and loved ones who have died, ending with the Day of the Dead. The mezcal was distilled in copper by maestro mezcalero Pablo Vasquez in Agua del Espino, Ejutla, from Tobasiche, a subvariety of Agave karwinskii that grows on a tall stalk instead of close to the ground. El Jolgorio mezcals are made from wild-harvested agave in Zapotec villages and distilled twice.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in small sips.

el-nido-clio.title: Gil Family Estates Bodegas El Nido Clio 2022 750ml

el-pasador-de-oro.title: El Pasador de Oro XO Rum
el-pasador-de-oro.bodyHtml: The French spirits company Le Bienheureux (The Blessed) blends a selection of fine aged Guatemalan rums, and finishes the spirit in used Cognac barrels. This elegant and aromatic rum pours a deep amber colour, and has aromas and flavours of caramel, burnt sugar, baking spice and citrus. Sip solo, or serve with cr?me brul?e.

el-pasador-de-oro-gran-reserva.title: El Pasador de Oro Gran Reserva Rum
el-pasador-de-oro-gran-reserva.bodyHtml: Guatemala- Distilled from molasses and aged in the tropical Caribbean climate for up to 18 years to extract the optimal amount of oak flavor. El Pasador Gran Reserva is a more powerful and less gentle version of El Pasador de Oro XO. 2020 San Francisco Spirits - Double Gold Winner

el-petit-bonhomme-1.title: Les Vins Bonhomme El Petit Bonhomme Cuvee 2020 750ml
el-petit-bonhomme-1.bodyHtml:
Les Vins Bonhomme El Petit Bonhomme Tinto is a Spanish red wine blend with notes of black fruits, white and black pepper, and gooseberries, with a rich, spicy nose and soft tannins. It's a full-bodied wine that can be paired with grilled meats or sharp cheeses. 

Origin: Jumilla, Murcia, Spain.
Blend: 55% Monastrell, 30% Garnacha, 15% Syrah.
Color: Deep cherry.
Aroma: Rich, spicy nose with notes of plum, dry grass, thyme, and rosemary.
Flavor: Black fruits, white and black pepper, gooseberries.
Texture: Soft tannins.
Body: Intense, balanced, smooth, and persistent.
Alcohol: 14.5%.
Food Pairings: Grilled steak, roast beef, rack of lamb, lamb shank, Osso Bucco, sharp cheddar.
Awards & Scores: 90 points from James Suckling (2021), Silver Medal from Decanter (2020), and 91 points from James Suckling for the 2019 and 2018 vintages.

el-tequileno-gran-reserva-reposado.title: El Tequileno Gran Reserva Reposado Tequila
el-tequileno-gran-reserva-reposado.bodyHtml:
El Tequileño Gran Reserva Reposado Tequila is a premium additive-free Reposado tequila produced at Destiladora del Valle de Tequila (NOM 1108) in Tequila, Jalisco. Crafted using 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agave from the Highlands of Jalisco (Los Altos), it is cooked in autoclaves, fermented in open-air cement tanks with volcanic spring water, and copper pot distilled. Aged for a minimum of 8 months in American oak barrels and expertly blended with a small portion of 18-month aged Añejo, it offers a harmonious profile of rich cooked agave, sweet vanilla, caramel, and gentle oak spice.

Food Pairing: Grilled carne asada, fish or pork carnitas tacos, mole poblano, roasted poultry, or flan.

Tasting Notes : Light golden amber with a smooth, rich, and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Cooked agave, vanilla, caramelized pear, honey, subtle nutmeg, and a touch of oak.

Palate : Creamy and balanced with flavors of sweet cooked agave, light oak, vanilla, macadamia nut, toffee, and subtle white pepper spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and velvety with lingering agave sweetness, gentle drying warmth, and delicate oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Riedel tequila glass or Glencairn, over a large ice cube, or as an elevated base for a Mexican Old Fashioned or Tommy's Margarita.

el-tequileno-platino.title: El Tequileño Platinum Blanco Tequila
el-tequileno-platino.bodyHtml:
El Tequileño Platinum begins with 100% estate grown mature Blue Agave from the Los Altos region of Jalisco. These are combined with the mineral rich water from El Volcan de Tequila and distilled in copper pot stills. El Tequileño Platinum is aged for 14 days in large American oak barrels which gives it a more rounded and balanced complexity of flavors that include cooked agave, light honey and spice.

Enjoy neat, on the rocks or makes a phenomenal Margarita!

Aroma:
Cooked agave, herbal, delicate nuances of anise and black pepper

TASTE:
Slight spiciness, savory with a delicate finish

ENJOY:
Best enjoyed neat or on the rocks. Makes a phenomenal margarita.

el-tequileno-reposado.title: El Tequileno Reposado Tequila
el-tequileno-reposado.bodyHtml:
El Tequileño Reposado Tequila is a highly respected, additive-free spirit crafted using 100% estate-grown blue Weber agave. Distilled in copper pot stills and utilizing mineral-rich volcanic spring water from El Volcán de Tequila, this expression is aged for 3 months in large American oak vats (pipones). This brief contact with wood softens the spirit while beautifully preserving the vibrant, estate-grown agave flavors, making it a highly versatile tequila that excels both as a premium mixer and a neat sipper.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken fajitas, pork carnitas, medium-aged cheeses like Manchego, or al pastor tacos with pineapple.

TASTING NOTES Light straw or pale gold in color, featuring a smooth, clean, and nicely balanced mouthfeel.

NOSE Forward aromas of rich cooked agave, sweet honey, and vanilla, layered with crisp apple, pear, and subtle hints of light oak.

PALATE Balanced and agave-forward with sweet notes of caramel and butterscotch, rounded out by hints of vanilla, green apple, and subtle baking spices like cinnamon.

FINISH Medium-length and dry with a pleasant, warming spice, lingering black pepper, and clean oak undertones.

SERVE Excellent enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as an elevated base for premium Margaritas and Palomas.

el-tequileno-reposado-rare-1.title: El Tequileño Reposado Rare Tequila
el-tequileno-reposado-rare-1.bodyHtml: The world’s first and only Reposado Rare is an exclusive limited release offering that combines only the most coveted 100% Blue Agave from the Highlands of Jalisco with the mineral rich water of El Volcan de Tequila. The extracted mosto is then fermented with our own natural yeast influenced by 150 year old mango trees before distilling in Copper Pot Stills. This exquisite tequila is matured in a slow unique manner by using a large American Oak barrel, called a Pipón with a 25,000 liter capacity, for 6 years.

elements-of-islay-full-proof.title: Laphroaig Elements L2.0
elements-of-islay-full-proof.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Elements L2.0 is an exceptional, highly innovative limited-edition single malt Scotch whisky that marks the second chapter in Laphroaig's experimental Elements series. Crafted at the historic Islay distillery, this non-chill filtered expression pushes the boundaries of traditional production by focusing on a slower, heavily extended fermentation process. The mash was subjected to a continuous 115-hour fermentation—nearly double the distillery's standard timeframe—using a combination of cloudy and clear worts to maximize fruity ester production and structural complexity before double-distillation in copper pot stills. Matured in heavily charred first-fill ex-bourbon barrels and bottled at a robust, unadulterated cask strength of 59.6% ABV, this vibrant pale-gold single malt masterfully integrates Laphroaig's iconic medicinal peat smoke with unexpected waves of bright tropical fruit and deep, malty sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly alongside smoky barbecued pork belly, grilled oysters with garlic herb butter, extra-mature smoked cheddar or Roquefort blue cheese, and artisanal sea-salt dark chocolate.

TASTING NOTES - A brilliant, pale straw-gold appearance displaying a remarkably clean, yet rich and oily texture that coats the palate heavily with slow, defined legs on the glass.

NOSE - High-toned, fresh, and deeply aromatic, opening with prominent notes of green apples, ripe pears, and subtle orange zest, beautifully intertwined with signature Laphroaig coastal brine, medicinal peat smoke, damp sea moss, and a gentle honey sweetness.

PALATE - Bold, full-bodied, and intensely flavor-forward on the arrival; the high proof delivers an immediate tongue-tingling sparkle of white pepper, yielding to a complex mid-palate rich with charred campfire ash, sweet vanilla bean, creamy malted barley, and a bright burst of tropical pineapple and lime juice.

FINISH - Exceptionally long, warm, and drying, leaving a deeply resonant trail of heavy antiseptic peat smoke and salty sea spray perfectly balanced by a lingering, sweet fruity fade and light oak spice.

SERVE - Best enjoyed poured neat at room temperature in a traditional Glencairn glass to experience the uncut power of the fermentation experiment, or slowly opened up with a few drops of pure spring water to temper the cask strength and release hidden floral and citrus oils.

elmer-t-lee-100th-single-barrel.title: Elmer T Lee Single Barrel
elmer-t-lee-100th-single-barrel.bodyHtml: Named after Master Distiller Emeritus Elmer T. Lee, this whiskey is hand selected and bottled to the taste and standards which were set forth by Elmer T. Lee himself. Perfectly balanced and rich, as declared by the man who knew how great bourbon should taste.

elouan-oregon-pinot-noir-2017.title: Resonance Decouverte Vineyard Pinot Noir 2017
elouan-oregon-pinot-noir-2017.bodyHtml:
A nice and brilliant color, with an expressive nose of cherry, blackberries, wild mint, fresh liquorice and noble wood. Vibrant and energetic, the palate reveals a subtle balance and elegant floral notes. The finish is mineral-driven, expressing the complexity of the Jory soil.

Pairs well with lightly seasoned red meats, chicken, turkey, lamb and root vegetables.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Detailed and refined with cherry and pomegranate flavors that are laced with loamy mineral, black tea and dark spices that build tension toward fine-grained tannins. Drink now through 2029.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
The potential is here for the wine to develop further complexity, though currently it's still a bit jangly. Raspberries and blueberries share the flavor podium with peppery herbs and truffley fungus. The earthy, herbal flavors carry well into the finish, and further bottle age may help to soften some rough edges. Drink this wine after 2021.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Résonance purchased this site close to Domaine Drouhin and Domaine Serene in 2014. After clearing the property of blackberry vines, they discovered a natural amphitheater on classic Jory soils (the Résonance vineyard, purchased in 2013, is planted on basalt). Vines were planted in 1996 and more Pinot Noir and Chardonnay have just been planted. Pale to medium ruby, the 2017 Pinot Noir Découverte Vineyard opens with inviting scents of raspberry jam, rhubarb and pomegranate with notes of warm earth and autumn leaves and a floral undercurrent. The palate is light to medium-bodied with youthfully shy fruits (this was bottled three to four months before I tasted it), with a soft frame and very juicy acidity, finishing restrained.

emmolo-merlot-1.title: Emmolo Merlot 2022
emmolo-merlot-1.bodyHtml:
Emmolo Merlot 2022 is a captivating, richly styled Napa Valley red wine crafted by winemaker Jenny Wagner. Defying the softer, traditional expectations of the varietal, this exceptional wine is sourced from vineyards with light, gravelly soils to achieve extended hang time, full ripeness, and maximum concentration. In the glass, it reveals a deep, almost impenetrable dark ruby hue. The highly expressive bouquet opens with inviting aromas of cocktail cherries, ripe blackberries, and sweet plums, elegantly layered with complex notes of newly oiled leather, mocha, and pronounced French oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, opulent, and sumptuously smooth, delivering a luscious core of dark berry compote, cassis, and savory baking spice. This rich, generously fruit-forward profile is perfectly balanced by an underlying fresh earthiness and fine, powdery tannins, culminating in a lush, highly persistent finish laced with toasted oak and vanilla.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with savory mushroom risotto, hearty grilled sausages, roasted pork chops, rich eggplant parmesan, and rustic ratatouille.

empress-1908-gin-1.title: Empress 1908 Indigo Gin
empress-1908-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Empress 1908 Indigo Gin is a visually stunning and contemporary spirit, handcrafted in small batch copper pot stills and famous for its vibrant all-natural indigo hue. Infused with a unique blend of eight botanicals—including juniper, grapefruit peel, coriander, ginger, cinnamon, and a signature blend of black tea—its striking color comes entirely from the butterfly pea blossom. On the nose, it offers a bright, aromatic bouquet of soft citrus and earthy florals. The palate is elegant and crisp, delivering a delicate balance of traditional piney juniper, warm baking spices, and a subtle herbal sweetness. When mixed with tonic or citrus, the gin magically transforms from deep indigo to a soft, beautiful pink, making it as captivating to look at as it is to drink.

Food Pairing: The bright citrus and delicate floral profile of this gin make it a perfect match for light, fresh seafood like a classic shrimp cocktail, crab cakes, or a plate of fresh sushi and sashimi. It also pairs wonderfully with soft, creamy cheeses like brie or goat cheese served alongside fresh berries and artisanal crackers.

english-harbour-5-year-old.title: Antigua Distillery English Harbour 5 Year Old Rum
english-harbour-5-year-old.bodyHtml: English Harbour Five Year Rum has Superior excellence and flavour. Viewed by Rum Connoisseurs in the Caribbean and Worldwide as an impeccably smooth, light bodied Rum. This Rum is aged in oaken casks and is a minimum of five years old. With numerous awards under its belt English Harbour 5yr Rum speaks for itself as it has converted many cognac and scotch drinkers into 5yr Old adorers.

english-harbour-reserve-10-year-old.title: Antigua Distillery English Harbour Reserve 10 Year Old Rum
english-harbour-reserve-10-year-old.bodyHtml: With a perfectly balance blend, English Harbour 10yr Reserve is a deep mahogany rum distilled from molasses Aged 10 years in used whisky and bourbon barrels. First unveiled in 2006, English Harbour 10yr Reserve, instantly began making a name for itself and gave English Harbour 5yr drinkers something to graduate to.

errazuriz-max-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Errazuriz Max Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2016 750ml
errazuriz-max-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Max, named in honor of our founder, Don Maximiano Errázuriz, reflects the in-depth exploration carried out by Viña Errázuriz in the Aconcagua Valley and in other valleys, some of which are the best and most recognized valleys in Chile for producing each of the varieties that are sourced for these wines.
As a result, these wines stand out for their ­nesse, elegance, freshness and delicious acidity, and as a result, it reflects each one of the valleys from where they come from.

espolon-anejo.title: Espolon Anejo Tequila
espolon-anejo.bodyHtml:
This award-winning Anejo is aged in American oak and ex-bourbon barrels for a minimum of 12 months, resulting in complex aromas of roasted agave and wood with hints of dried fruit and butterscotch. The velvety mouthfeel shows subtle notes of caramel, vanilla and dried fruits, with medium to full-bodied palate.

Añejo Old Fashioned:2 oz Espolòn Tequila Añejo 0.5 oz Agave Nectar 1 dash of Angostura Bitters 1 dash of Orange Bitters Build in an old fashioned glass over one large ice cube. Garnish with an orange peel.

espolon-blanco.title: Espolon Blanco Tequila
espolon-blanco.bodyHtml:
Espolòn Blanco Tequila is an award-winning, 100% blue Weber agave tequila handcrafted in the Highlands of Jalisco. Named in honor of the spur of the iconic rooster, a symbol of national pride, this spirit is double-distilled using a combination of traditional pot stills and modern column stills. This precise distillation process yields an exceptionally clean, bright profile that highlights the true essence of Highland agave with a vibrant, spicy punch that makes it a favorite among bartenders worldwide.

Food Pairing: Baja fish tacos, grilled chicken skewers with lime, fresh mango salsa, or spicy jalapeño poppers.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium body and clean texture on the palate.

Nose : Bright agave, sweet lemon zest, tropical fruit, and subtle cracked black pepper.

Palate : Soft and balanced with sweet roasted agave, crisp citrus, white pepper, and a light herbal undertone.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and medium-length with lingering agave sweetness and gentle peppery warmth.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as a base in classic cocktails such as a Paloma or Margarita.

espolon-reposado.title: Espolon Reposado Tequila
espolon-reposado.bodyHtml:
Espolon Reposado Tequila is a 100% blue Weber agave tequila produced at the Destiladora San Nicolas in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted under the vision of Master Distiller Cirilo Oropeza, the agave is cooked in autoclaves, fermented using a proprietary yeast strain, and double distilled in stainless steel pot stills. The spirit is then matured for 3 to 5 months in handcrafted, lightly charred American oak barrels, achieving a balanced profile of rich agave, gentle oak, and warm spice.

Food Pairing: Tacos al pastor, grilled chicken fajitas, ceviche, roasted pork carnitas, enchiladas with mole sauce, and caramel flan.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden amber in color, offering a rich, smooth, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Spicy with a hint of sweet caramel, accompanied by cooked agave, subtle citrus, and light oak notes.

Palate : Bold and round with flavors of sweet agave, tropical fruit, vanilla, toasted oak, and a touch of brown spice.

Finish : Smooth and medium-long, lingering with warm spice, soft oak, and sweet agave notes.

Serve : Best served neat, on the rocks, or as a versatile base in classic cocktails such as a Reposado Paloma, Tequila Sour, or Mexican Mule.

evan-williams-black-label-bourbon-1.title: Evan Williams Black Label Bourbon
evan-williams-black-label-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
Evan Williams Black Label Bourbon is a flagship straight bourbon whiskey produced by Heaven Hill Distillery at the Bernheim Distillery in Louisville, Kentucky. Named in honor of Evan Williams, who opened Kentucky’s first commercial distillery along the banks of the Ohio River in 1783, this classic sour mash bourbon is aged longer than required by law to deliver a rich, approachable profile characterized by traditional notes of vanilla, caramel, and toasted oak.

Food Pairing: Barbecue pulled pork, smoked ribs, grilled steaks, sharp cheddar cheese, pecan pie, or dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Medium amber-gold in color with a smooth, medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Deep vanilla, mint, sweet caramel, and toasted oak.

Palate : Rich and balanced with flavors of oak, brown sugar, caramel, vanilla, and subtle baking spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with lingering spicy oak and sweet vanilla.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as a classic base for cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

evan-williams-vintage-single-barrel.title: Evan Williams Single Barrel Vintage Bourbon
evan-williams-vintage-single-barrel.bodyHtml:
A five-time "Whiskey of the Year" winner, this is Heaven Hill’s most premium and highly decorated Evan Williams bourbon. It is uniquely vintage-dated, meaning each bottle is drawn from a single barrel that was hand-selected by the Master Distillers and marked with the exact year it was put into oak. Bottled at 86.6 proof, it delivers a delicate, nuanced, and exceptionally smooth tasting experience.

NOSE

Fragrant aromas of dark caramel, sweet oak, charred wood, and a touch of dark honey.

PALATE

Lush and pleasantly spicy, featuring prominent notes of oak, honey, baked apple, and sliced orange.

FINISH

Long, graceful, and relaxed with lingering warm spices and wood tannins.

everclear-190-proof-alochol-1.title: Everclear 190 Proof Grain Alcohol 200ml
everclear-190-proof-alochol-1.bodyHtml:
Everclear 190 Proof Grain Alcohol is a world-famous, ultra-high-proof neutral grain spirit produced by the Luxco spirit company. Distilled from 100% selected grains, it is filtered through a meticulous purification process to achieve maximum neutrality, clarity, and potency. Bottled at an unadulterated 95% alcohol by volume (190 proof), Everclear is virtually odorless, colorless, and tasteless beyond its intense, immediate alcoholic burn. Due to its extreme purity and neutral profile, it is rarely consumed straight; instead, it serves as an industry-standard extraction base for homemade liqueurs, bitters, botanical tinctures, fruit infusions, and high-potency party punches.

Food Pairing: Not intended to be paired directly with food due to its high proof; however, fruit infusions or homemade cordials crafted from it pair well with light fruit tarts, citrus sorbets, or spicy cured meats.

TASTING NOTES - Crystal clear and completely water-white, featuring a thin, highly mobile texture in the glass that drops instantly without leaving traditional legs.

NOSE - Extremely pungent and sharp, dominated entirely by an overwhelming vapor of pure, clean grain alcohol with subtle, dry underlying cereal grain graininess.

PALATE - Extremely intense, hot, and instantly drying on the palate, delivering an explosive surge of pure alcoholic heat with minimal underlying flavor other than a faint, neutral grain sweetness.

FINISH - Short, intensely fiery, and deeply warming, leaving a clean, completely neutral, and rapidly drying sensation across the entire mouth and throat.

SERVE - Strictly recommended to be used in tiny quantities as an ingredient base for fruit-infused liqueurs, homemade bitters, or heavily diluted into batch punch bowls; never recommended to be consumed neat or un-diluted.

facundo-eximo.title: Facundo Eximo Rum
facundo-eximo.bodyHtml: A blend of dark rums aged between 10 and 12 years, and the only of the four rums that is blended before aging, with tasting notes of walnuts and vanilla. It is best sipped on the rocks or mixed into an EXIMO Old Fashioned cocktail.

facundo-exquisito.title: Facundo Exquisito Rum
facundo-exquisito.bodyHtml: Exquisito is a blend of seven to 23-year-old rums from the family’s private reserves. Very aromatic and initially sweet, but after a few minutes, the underlying complexity begins to show notes of lavender honey, assam tea, mocha, and fresh tobacco. Incredible sipping experience.

facundo-neo.title: Facundo Neo Silver Rum
facundo-neo.bodyHtml:
FACUNDO NEO is a perfectly balanced blend of medium to heavy bodied rums aged up to 8 years. Once the aging process is complete, the rums are filtered over activated carbon to remove any color, resulting in a sheer blonde hued rum.
FACUNDO NEO is best sipped on the rocks or in a new twist of the classic Negroni cocktail. Sure to be your new go-to white rum, FACUNDO NEO is as easy to sip as it is to mix in elegant and adventurous rum cocktails.

AWARDS
2017 - Gold Medal / Monde Selection
2017 - Gold Medal / Spirits International Prestige Awards
2017 - 91 Points, Highly Recommended / Ultimate Spirits Challenge

facundo-paraiso.title: Facundo Paraiso Rum
facundo-paraiso.bodyHtml: An unparalleled blend of dark rums aged up to 23 years that is smooth and mellow with tasting notes of chocolate, very dark caramel and toasted walnuts. It is best served in a snifter, served neat and sipped slowly.

fandango-mezcal-1.title: Fandango Joven Mezcal
fandango-mezcal-1.bodyHtml: Fandango is a premium mezcal crafted in the state of Oaxaca, Mexico. The objective behind the creation of this spirit was to clearly accentuate the taste and scent of the roasted agave piñas. You will enjoy this Mezcal cold and neat as much as in cocktails. The balance between the rich taste of agave and the smokiness resulting from roasting the fruit will allow you to experience the spirit in one of the most traditional ways like the indigenous people of Oaxaca did when they were taught the distillation process by the Spanish 400 years ago.

faustino-1-gran-reserva-2008.title: Faustino I Gran Reserva 2016
