faustino-1-gran-reserva-2008.bodyHtml:
Faustino I Gran Reserva 2016 displays a deep ruby hue with elegant garnet reflections and a light brick-red rim in the glass. The bouquet is complex, intense, and traditional, unfolding with expressive aromas of ripe plums, black cherries, and sweet spices seamlessly layered with nuances of tobacco leaf, cocoa, and toasted vanilla oak. On the palate, this iconic Rioja blend showcases a medium-to-full body with a remarkably silky entry and a well-defined structure. Polished, supple tannins and a vibrant core of fresh acidity support savory layers of dark fruit and undergrowth maturity, culminating in an incredibly long, persistent, and sophisticated finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye steaks, rosemary-roasted lamb loin, slow-braised beef short ribs, or medium-aged cheeses like Emmental and Gruyère.

93 Points - James Suckling

Savory spices and red berries with iron, white pepper, grilled sesame and citrus. Restrained, pretty complex and traditional, this has medium body, fine tannins and a long, juicy finish. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A harmonious red that leans toward traditional in style without forsaking its concentration or fruit expression. An overtone of tobacco, vanilla and milled white pepper is a fragrant thread winding through ripe and juicy black cherry and plum fruit, framed by refined, supple tannins. Hints of leather, red licorice and wild thyme play on the fresh, focused finish. Tempranillo, Graciano and Mazuelo. Drink now through 2036.

fernet-branca.title: Fernet Branca Liqueur
fernet-branca.bodyHtml: Fernet-Branca is a traditional Italian digestivo made from a secret mix of herbs including myrrh, saffron, chamomile and gentian.

fettercairn-12-year-old-1.title: Fettercairn 12 Year Old
fettercairn-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
After years of maturing in American white oak ex-bourbon barrels, our 12 Year Old is the colour of sunlight and amber honey. Come closer and discover the taste of our signature tropical house style with this welcoming single malt whisky.

COLOUR - sunlight and amber honey.

TASTE - Vanilla and pear, with soft spices.

FINISH - Refreshing nectarine and tropical fruit, with subtle roasted coffee, clove, and ginger. A memorable finish of sultanas and black toffee.

finca-la-sofia-cabernet-sauvignon-1.title: Finca La Sofia Cabernet Sauvignon
finca-la-sofia-cabernet-sauvignon-1.bodyHtml: Finca La Sofia Cabernet Sauvignon is a full-bodied, concentrated and stylish red wine that hails from the Valle de Uco region in Argentina. Produced by the Bodega Familia Zuccardi winery based in Santa Rosa, it exudes aromas of red cherry, cassis, dried herbs, cocoa, and tobacco. Its flavors on the palate are juicy and bold, well-structured with smooth tannins on the finish balancing a long and spicy aftertaste. This vintage was fermented in stainless steel tanks for 15 days and then partially aged in oak barrels for 12 months, adding complexity to the flavor profile and enhancing the structure of this red blend. Finca La Sofia Cabernet Sauvignon is perfect for pairing with grilled meats, cured cheeses, tomato-based stews, and vegetables. It can also be enjoyed on its own or with a nice selection of tapas. This wine is the perfect choice for any occasion, from casual gatherings to a special dinner with friends and family.

finca-la-sofia-malbec-1.title: Finca La Sofia Malbec 2022 750ml
finca-la-sofia-malbec-1.bodyHtml:
Finca La Sofia Malbec is a unique and distinctively flavored wine made from the Malbec grapes grown in the Mendoza region of Argentina. This full-bodied and robust wine is a favorite among wine-lovers for its rich flavor and deep ruby hue. This award-winning wine has been recognized by the Wine Enthusiast and was made from grapes that are grown in the foothills of the Andes Mountains. As part of the process, the grapes are hand-tended to avoid any disease or insects which would affect the grape's flavor. This process allows only the most flavorful and ripe grapes to be used in the creation of this wine. The flavor profile of the Finca La Sofia Malbec is unique and enticing. The aroma is of ripe dark fruits with light spice and earthy undertones. On the palate, the full-bodied flavor of blackberry and ripe red fruits give way to a subtle sweet and spicy finish. Overall, the Finca La Sofia Malbec is a complex and interesting wine to drink. Its deep ruby hue, bold flavor, and unique aroma make it a great choice for those who like their wine full-bodied and flavorful.

92 Points - James Suckling
"A juicy and vibrant Malbec with aromas of fresh plums, violets, and a hint of cocoa. It's medium to full-bodied with supple tannins and a polished, fruit-forward finish. Delicious and approachable."

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This Malbec offers a classic profile of dark berry and black cherry flavors, framed by soft, toasty notes. It's a well-balanced and crowd-pleasing wine that delivers great value."

fireball-cinnamon-whisky-13.title: Fireball Cinnamon Whisky 6 x 50ml
fireball-cinnamon-whisky-13.bodyHtml: The blending of smooth Canadian whisky and intense cinnamon flavour result in a bold shot that is fragrant with pronounced aromas of cinnamon and spice; on the palate the spicy flavours of cinnamon intermingle with caramel notes on a long, hot finish. Serve well chilled. Great on its own, use in cocktails or apple desserts.

fireball-cinnamon-whisky-5.title: Fireball Cinnamon Whisky 1.14L
fireball-cinnamon-whisky-5.bodyHtml: The blending of smooth Canadian whisky and intense cinnamon flavour result in a bold shot that is fragrant with pronounced aromas of cinnamon and spice; on the palate the spicy flavours of cinnamon intermingle with caramel notes on a long, hot finish. Serve well chilled. Great on its own, use in cocktails or apple desserts.

flor-de-cana-25-year-old-tradicion-artes.title: Flor de Caña 25 Year Old Single Estate Rum
flor-de-cana-25-year-old-tradicion-artes.bodyHtml: A warm climate spirit aged beyond 20 years is nothing short of a feat given the setbacks brought on by the climate. Flor de Ca?a?s 25 Year, which was released under the brand?s Centenario collection, is the highest marquee in the portfolio; it?s been aged in white oak bourbon barrels sealed with plantain leaves resulting in a very unique tropical flavor profile. This rum won ?Best Rum of the Year 2017? at the International Rum Congress in Madrid

flor-de-cana-30-year-old-v-generaciones-.title: Flor de Caña V Generaciones 30 Year Old Single Barrel Rum
flor-de-cana-30-year-old-v-generaciones-.bodyHtml: Flor De Cana will celebrate 130 years and five generations’ involvement since its founding back in 1890. To mark the occasion, this 30-year-old single barrel rum distilled back in 1988 is being offered. Sub titled ‘V Generaciones’, it’s the company’s oldest rum to date, matured in a single ex-Bourbon barrel. 411 bottles are on offer world wide, each individually numbered and featuring the signatures of the five family generations behind the company. Replete with a bottle cap crafted from volcanic rock and a replica of the iconic 1902 volcano postal stamp of Nicaragua, the bottles also feature a metallic label and a certificate of authenticity. Just a couple available

flowers-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir-2018.title: Decoy Limited Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2018/2022 750ml
flowers-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir-2018.bodyHtml:
This lush and graceful cool-climate Pinot Noir draws you in with enticing aromas of blackberry, bramble, currant, cedar, and earthy forest floor, as well as oak-inspired hints of baking spices. On the palate, alluring red berry flavors are framed by soft, supple tannins, with bright acidity adding freshness to the long, vibrant finish.
92 Points - James Suckling
A robust, flavorful red that's full of dark cherries and smoky accents on a medium to full body. Broad and generous in mouthfeel, deep in black fruit, cedar and forest floor notes with savory mushroom accents.

fonseca-bin-27-reserve-port.title: Fonseca Bin 27 Reserve Port 750ml + 50ml
fonseca-bin-27-reserve-port.bodyHtml:
TASTING NOTE
Bin 27 shares the heritage and style of the great Fonseca Vintage Ports, as well as much of their depth and character.
However it is bottled when ready to drink and can be served by the glass directly from the bottle. Blended for consistency of character and quintessentially Fonseca in style, this reserve blend provides reliable and affordable value.
Deep youthful ruby colour. Intense rich fruity nose crammed with pure blackberry, cassis, cherry and plum aromas interwoven with notes of spice.
The palate full bodied and round, with a smooth velvety texture balanced by firm mouth filling tannins. The juicy black fruit flavours linger into the rich luscious finish.

PAIRING SUGGESTIONS
The rich black fruit flavours of Bin 27 are a perfect match for chocolate and berry fruit dishes. A chocolate fondant with strawberries makes a deliciously hedonistic combination with Bin 27, the rich creamy chocolate and luscious ripe strawberries blending seductively with the blackcurrant and cherry fruitiness of the wine. Bin 27 is also excellent served after a meal with bitter chocolate with a high cocoa content or a plate of chocolate brownies or truffles. Like all youthful red Ports, Bin 27 is an excellent match for soft ripe cheeses and can be served on its own at the end of the meal or any other relaxed occasion in a generously proportioned wine glass.

fontanabianca-barbaresco-docg-2017.title: Fontanabianca Barbaresco 2017
fontanabianca-barbaresco-docg-2017.bodyHtml:
The 2017 Fontanabianca Barbaresco is a classic and well-balanced expression of Nebbiolo from the Neive subzone. Despite being a warm vintage, this wine maintains a notable freshness and vibrancy. It offers enticing aromas of woodland berries, pressed rose petals, and eucalyptus, layered with hints of star anise, licorice, and baking spices. On the savory and juicy palate, it features a core of red cherry and mature Morello cherry supported by fine-grained, silky tannins. The finish is long and persistent, with a characteristic mineral edge. This wine is approachable in its youth but possesses the structure to age gracefully through 2027.

94 Points - James Suckling

Wild aromas of dried meat and ripe berries with plum and smoke undertones. It’s full-bodied with ripe, chewy tannins and a long, very intense finish. Needs three or four years to soften, but impressive. Better after 2023.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Fontanabianca 2017 Barbaresco delivers terrific results at an approachable price. This production of 25,000 bottles offers a full bouquet of Nebbiolo typicity with the extra heft and exuberance of this warm vintage. The bouquet delivers all the headline aromas you might expect, with wild cherry, dried blueberry, spice, licorice and candied orange peel. You get silky but lasting tannins with polished fruit on the close. This wine gets better with each vintage I taste

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Ripe dark-skinned berry, pressed rose, new leather and eucalyptus aromas form the nose. Chewy and full of flavor, the taut palate shows concentrated black raspberry, mature Morello cherry and baking spice framed in fine-grained tannins. Drink 2021–2027.

fontodi-chianti-classico-docg-2017.title: Fontodi Chianti Classico 2022
fontodi-chianti-classico-docg-2017.bodyHtml:
Fontodi Chianti Classico 2022 is an exceptionally deep, velvety, and organically grown expression of Tuscany's legendary Conca d'Oro (golden shell) amphitheater in Panzano. Due to a dramatic mid-August hailstorm that significantly reduced crop yields, this rare 100% Sangiovese vintage possesses an unexpected, opulent concentration balanced by a lighter wood extraction process. It greets the nose with a dark, expressive bouquet of baked plums, dark cherries, pressed blue flowers, and dusty stone, seamlessly woven with hints of cinnamon, mocha, and new leather. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, dense, and beautifully structured, matching its savory core of blackcurrant and tart red berries with a powerful mineral tension, chewy tannins, and a striking, juicy natural acidity that carries through to a remarkably long, iron-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with a traditional Florentine grilled T-bone steak, wild boar ragù, slow-cooked lamb shanks, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

Tense, firm and juicy with sour cherries, raspberry bush, crushed spices, dried blood orange, cocoa and iron on the nose. The medium- to full-bodied palate is structured and well-framed, with vivid acidity driving the fruit. Long and balanced. From organically grown grapes. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The organic Fontodi 2022 Chianti Classico shows a dark color and a deep, velvety appearance. The bouquet opens to earthy aromas with baked plum, cherry and pressed blue flower. This is quite a rich edition. It's a little different than past releases, but it's also accessible and opulent. This 100% Sangiovese is fermented in steel and ages in both barrique

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Lush and saturated with black cherry, blackberry, violet and mineral flavors. The focused fruit is allied to lively acidity and dense, refined tannins, leaving a sensation of harmony. Terrific length. Drink now through 2033.

fontodi-flaccianello-della-pieve-2017.title: Fontodi Flaccianello della Pieve 2022
fontodi-flaccianello-della-pieve-2017.bodyHtml:
Fontodi Flaccianello della Pieve 2022 is an iconic, commanding, and impeccably structured pure Sangiovese produced by Giovanni Manetti from certified organic estate parcels in the famed Conca d'Oro of Panzano in Chianti. Originating from high-elevation sites characterized by galestro shale, alberese limestone, and pietraforte formations, the 2022 vintage displays an intense, deep ruby core with violet reflections. Fermented with indigenous yeasts and aged for 24 months in French oak barrels (Tronçais and Allier), it offers an expressive bouquet of ripe dark plums, black cherries, and wild blackberries interwoven with dried violets, licorice, pipe tobacco, leather, graphite, and crushed rock minerality. On the palate, it delivers full-bodied concentration paired with remarkable poise, driven by tightly knit, fine-grained architectural tannins and energetic natural acidity that carry its dark fruit core into an expansive, savory, and enduring finish.

Food Pairing: Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roast venison loin, braised wild boar ragù, rosemary-crusted rack of lamb, or mature Pecorino Toscano cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

This rich, fruity wine shows huge complexity. Aromas of plums, black cherries, fresh violets and licorice with touches of leather and graphite. Full-bodied, it displays a well-tamed structure, with firm tannins coated in fruit and chewy acidity that keeps the finish fresh and in balance. From organically grown grapes. Try from 2027.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Another icon from Tuscany is the Fontodi 2022 Flaccianello della Pieve. This organic wine is beautiful, quite bold and thickly extracted. Across the board, these wines from the 2022 vintage made by Fontodi all show high alcohol and a rather robust character, and the same goes for the Flaccianello, whose alcohol content is 15%. This vintage is more accessible overall, with finely tuned tannins. This wine represents a selection of the best estate fruit at various elevations with both alberese limestone soils and galestro shale.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Silky smooth, this red exudes finesse and harmony, along with cherry, blackberry, black currant, violet and toasty oak flavors. It picks up earth and mineral elements as it builds to a long, expansive aftertaste. All the components are in the right place here. Sangiovese. Best from 2027 through 2045.

forty-creek-confederation-oak.title: Forty Creek Confederation Oak Reserve
forty-creek-confederation-oak.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Confederation Oak Reserve is a flagship expression of Canadian whisky craftsmanship, celebrated for its unique finishing process in barrels made from locally sourced, 150-year-old Canadian white oak trees. This extra maturation imparts an exceptionally rich, full-bodied character to the spirit. The nose opens with a dense bouquet of maple, brown sugar, and dark fruits like raisins and figs. On the palate, it delivers a luxurious and creamy texture layered with notes of toasted nuts, buttercream, and warm baking spices, all supported by a deep, resonant oak structure. The finish is long, smooth, and gently warming, leaving behind a trace of peppery spice and sweet praline.

Food Pairing: The deep maple notes and rich, sweet oak of this reserve whisky make it an absolute natural alongside pecan pie, apple crisp, or crème brûlée. For a savory pairing, try it with a glaze over slow-roasted pork belly or alongside a charcuterie board featuring smoked meats and creamy, mature Gouda.

forty-creek-copper-pot.title: Forty Creek Copper Bold
forty-creek-copper-pot.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Copper Bold is the new name for the Ontario distillery's Copper Pot whisky: the same full-bodied, bold Canadian whisky under a new label. It follows Forty Creek's Barrel Select approach of blending separately aged corn, rye and barley whiskies, then goes further with extra oak aging and a higher proof than many Canadian whiskies, at 43% ABV. Deep copper in colour, it balances intense toffee aromas with rye spice. 750ml.

Nose: Bold toffee, nuts and spice.

Palate: Full-bodied, with rich brown spice, dried stone fruit and hints of marmalade.

Finish: A long, slow fade.

Serve: Neat or over ice.

forty-creek-cream.title: Forty Creek Original Whisky Cream Liqueur
forty-creek-cream.bodyHtml: A truly flavourful spirit, Original Cream Liquor is crafted using our award-winning Forty Creek Canadian whisky and fresh dairy cream. Unlike other cream liquors on the market, our Original Cream Liquor focuses on flavours that highlight the quality of our whisky, resulting in a sweet, whisky-forward finish.

forty-creek-double-barrel.title: Forty Creek Double Barrel
forty-creek-double-barrel.bodyHtml: An extra-aged whisky that is a true celebration of the intricate and subtle flavors imparted by barrel aging. The individual rye, barley and corn whiskies are extra-aged in a variety of barrels before being masterfully blended. The resulting liquid then goes through up to 2 years of secondary aging in once-used Bourbon barrels.

forty-creek-nanaimo-bar-cream-1.title: Forty Creek Nanaimo Bar Cream Liqueur
forty-creek-nanaimo-bar-cream-1.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Nanaimo Bar Cream Liqueur pairs Forty Creek's Canadian whisky with fresh dairy cream and the flavours of one of Canada's best-loved desserts. Released in 2020 as part of the Forty Creek cream range, it brings together chocolate, vanilla, coconut and graham cracker in an opaque, milk-chocolate-coloured liqueur. Bottled at 15% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a rich after-dinner sipper and an easy addition to coffee or dessert cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Milk chocolate, buttercream, vanilla custard and coconut.

Nose: Coconut and cocoa with a hint of graham cracker.

Palate: Milk chocolate and buttercream with vanilla custard and coconut.

Finish: Lingering coconut and dairy cream.

Serve: Neat or on the rocks, or stirred into coffee.

forty-creek-resolve.title: Forty Creek Confederation Oak Reserve
forty-creek-resolve.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Confederation Oak Reserve is a flagship expression of Canadian whisky craftsmanship, celebrated for its unique finishing process in barrels made from locally sourced, 150-year-old Canadian white oak trees. This extra maturation imparts an exceptionally rich, full-bodied character to the spirit. The nose opens with a dense bouquet of maple, brown sugar, and dark fruits like raisins and figs. On the palate, it delivers a luxurious and creamy texture layered with notes of toasted nuts, buttercream, and warm baking spices, all supported by a deep, resonant oak structure. The finish is long, smooth, and gently warming, leaving behind a trace of peppery spice and sweet praline.

Food Pairing: The deep maple notes and rich, sweet oak of this reserve whisky make it an absolute natural alongside pecan pie, apple crisp, or crème brûlée. For a savory pairing, try it with a glaze over slow-roasted pork belly or alongside a charcuterie board featuring smoked meats and creamy, mature Gouda.

forty-creek-spike-honey-spiced.title: Forty Creek Honey Spiced Whisky
forty-creek-spike-honey-spiced.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Honey Spiced, originally sold as Forty Creek Spike, is a flavoured Canadian whisky from the Forty Creek distillery in Ontario. It came out of Master Blender Bill Ashburn's work with flavoured whiskies: Forty Creek whisky infused with honey and a selection of spices, landing somewhere between bourbon and rye with a sweet spiciness. Bright deep gold in colour, it shows bold aromas of honey, vanilla, cinnamon, ginger and brown sugar alongside toasty oak, dried fruit and dark chocolate, then a rich, sweet palate with brown spices and hints of butterscotch before a lingering spicy finish. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is designed as a mixer that adds spice to cocktails.

Nose: Honey, vanilla, cinnamon, ginger, brown sugar, toasty oak.

Palate: Rich and sweet, brown spice, butterscotch.

Finish: Lingering spice.

Serve: In cocktails such as a honey spiced lemonade, or over ice.

forty-creek-victory.title: Forty Creek Victory Limited Edition 2019
forty-creek-victory.bodyHtml:
To help commemorate the 205th anniversary of the Engagement at the Forty, we are proud to introduce Forty Creek Victory as our 2019 limited release. An exceptional Canadian Whisky that stacks up against any other whisky from across the globe.

Forty Creek Victory continues our tradition of experimentation in aging with unique types of wood. Our Master Blender has selected only his best Canadian Whisky to further age with the addition of vanilla wood staves. The resulting whisky is then artfully blended, resulting in a product that is signature Forty Creek.

four-roses-small-batch-bourbon-1.title: Booker's Small Batch Bourbon
four-roses-small-batch-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
Booker's Small Batch Bourbon is a premium, barrel-proof Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey produced by James B. Beam Distilling Co. Originally created by 6th-generation Master Distiller Booker Noe as a private gift for friends and family before its public release, this uncut and non-chill filtered bourbon is bottled directly from the center cut of Jim Beam’s rackhouses, offering an intense, robust, and full-bodied profile.

Food Pairing: Smoked beef brisket, prime ribeye, dark chocolate truffles, pecan pie, or strong blue cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber-bronze in appearance with a rich, heavy, and viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Robust and complex with powerful aromas of vanilla, roasted nuts, brown sugar, toasted oak, baking spices, and subtle leather.

Palate : High-proof warmth balanced by intense flavors of sweet caramel, vanilla cream, dark fruits, toasted oak, rye spice, and subtle tobacco.

Finish : Very long, warm, and lingering with notes of dark chocolate, wood spice, charred oak, and caramel.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn or rocks glass, or add a splash of spring water or a large ice cube to open up the aromas and tame the barrel-proof strength.

francis-coppola-diamond-claret-cabernet-.title: Francis Coppola Diamond Collection Claret Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
francis-coppola-diamond-claret-cabernet-.bodyHtml:
Francis Coppola Diamond Collection Claret Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a sophisticated, classic Bordeaux-style red blend that serves as the crown jewel of the Diamond Collection. Wrapped in its signature, elegant gold netting as a nod to historic European traditions, this wine delivers alluring and complex aromatics of ripe blackberries, dark plums, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with notes of toasted oak, sweet vanilla bean, and a hint of clove spice. On the palate, it showcases a luscious, full-bodied structure with velvety, fine-grained tannins and a balanced acidity, yielding rich layers of black cherry, dark chocolate, and black pepper that culminate in a smooth, remarkably long finish.

Food Pairing: Pair this bold, versatile Claret with juicy grilled ribeye steaks, roasted rack of lamb, savory barbecued ribs, or mature hard cheeses like sharp cheddar.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine is vibrant, lively, with aromas of blackberry, Olallieberry, citrus, bittersweet chocolate, toasty vanilla, and florals on the nose. The flavor on the palate are boysenberry, blueberry, Pink grapefruit zest, chicory, espresso, and a velvety dry finish. Decant and Pair with Waygu Beef.

freakshow-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: Michael David Winery Freakshow Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
freakshow-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
Michael David Winery Freakshow Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a bold, muscular, and deeply expressive red wine overflowing with personality and California charm. Affectionately known as the "Strongest Man on Earth," it opens with a dramatic and flamboyant bouquet of black cherry cola, boysenberry, blueberry crumble, and candied spiced pecans. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied selection showcases a rich and robust fruit core packed with flavors of blackberry confiture, fresh cherry pie, and Mission figs. Well-integrated French oak accents of vanilla, brown sugar, and toasted hazelnuts frame its velvety tannins, while warm notes of clove and allspice lead into a smooth, spice-laced, and enduring finish.

Food Pairing: This robust red pairs excellently with a grilled ribeye steak, braised beef cheeks, gourmet bacon cheeseburgers, smoked barbecue brisket, peppered wood-fired pizzas, or sharp aged cheddar cheese.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This brand has become synonymous with richness of style and substance. It is right on brand, with aromas of deep, dark berries, clove, crushed violets, and notes of sweet oak ripple throughout the nose. The flavors are concentrated blackberry, boysenberry, coffee, and cardamom with a dry, juicy finish. Pair with summer grilled fun.

freakshow-chardonnay-2019.title: Michael David Winery Freakshow Chardonnay 2024
freakshow-chardonnay-2019.bodyHtml: Making waves as the most approachable and fun-loving mermaid in the sea, our 2022 Freakshow Chardonnay is crisp and fruit forward, with a playful zest that will tantalize any sailor she comes across. Golden straw in color, her alluring aromas of ripe nectarine, citrus fruit and butterscotch accentuate mouthwatering flavors of cantaloupe, honey and lemon crème pie. With a refreshing and smooth finish, she will leave you no choice but to come back for more.

freakshow-zinfandel-2017.title: Michael David Freakshow Old Vine Zinfandel 2023
freakshow-zinfandel-2017.bodyHtml: This explosive star of the show is a spectacle for the senses! The wild and adventurous human cannonball shows off the fiery side of Lodi Zinfandel, with notes of distinctive bright red fruit, chocolate and butterscotch on the nose. Medium bodied with forward flavors of cherry, cranberry, licorice and fig, the 2021 Old Vine Zin finishes with fruit forward finish and hint of lingering oak.

frescobaldi-castel-giocondo-brunello-di-.title: Frescobaldi CastelGiocondo Brunello di Montalcino 2021
frescobaldi-castel-giocondo-brunello-di-.bodyHtml:
Frescobaldi CastelGiocondo Brunello di Montalcino 2021 is an elegant Tuscan red wine produced from 100% Sangiovese at the historic CastelGiocondo estate in Montalcino. Grown across vineyards with diverse clay, marl, and sandy soils, this distinguished Brunello combines ripe red fruit with floral elegance and savoury complexity. Aromas of black cherry, wild berries, violets, and tobacco lead into a beautifully structured palate with polished tannins and refreshing acidity. Extended oak maturation contributes depth and harmony, while a long, persistent finish highlights the wine's excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Braised short ribs, roasted lamb, wild boar ragù, grilled ribeye steak, porcini mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, aged Pecorino Toscano, and traditional Tuscan dishes.

95 Points - James Suckling

Very attractive aromas of red cherries, mushrooms and flowers follow through to a medium body with firm and integrated tannins and a vivid, subtle, fruity finish. A lovely young Brunello that you can enjoy now or age for many years to come. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Black cherry and black currant flavors are the main themes in this intense red, with iron and wild herbs adding complexity. Balanced and vibrant, with resonant tannins guarding the long aftertaste. This feels more modern in style, with an emphasis on bright fruit. Best from 2030 through 2047.

gabbiano-cavaliere-doro-chianti-classico.title: Castello di Gabbiano Chianti Classico Riserva 2022
gabbiano-cavaliere-doro-chianti-classico.bodyHtml:
The Riserva del castello comes from the best grapes of the estate’s vineyards. This wine respects and cleanly offers the most traditional characteristics of Chianti Classico, refined by a balanced maturation in wood.

A fruity palate, with tobacco and further earthy and spicy notes; balanced firm tannins and fresh acidity. A wine of good nerve and great balance.

gabbiano-cavaliere-doro-chianti-docg.title: Gabbiano Chianti
gabbiano-cavaliere-doro-chianti-docg.bodyHtml:
The Gabbiano Chianti is a vibrant, approachable, and highly traditional Italian red wine that captures the lively, fruit-forward charm of Tuscany. It pours a brilliant ruby-red colour in the glass, lifting with an inviting bouquet of fresh red cherries, wild strawberries, and ripe raspberries, subtly laced with rustic undertones of violet, white pepper, and dried Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine is exceptionally clean and balanced, delivering juicy, upfront flavours of red stone fruits and pomegranate. Driven by a bright, food-friendly acidity and soft, approachable tannins, it transitions smoothly into a dry, refreshing finish that leaves a lingering hint of spice and savory tomato leaf.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic Italian dishes such as wood-fired Margherita pizza, spaghetti bolognese, beef meatballs in marinara sauce, grilled chicken parmigiana, lasagna, and mild cheeses like young Pecorino or Fontina.

gabbiano-cavaliere-doro-pinot-grigio.title: Gabbiano Pinot Grigio
gabbiano-cavaliere-doro-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
The Cavaliere D'Oro Gabbiano Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie is a bright, crisp, and wonderfully vivacious Italian white wine crafted for easy, refreshing enjoyment. Sourced from premium hillside vineyards across northeastern Italy's famed Delle Venezie region, it pours a clear, sunny straw-yellow colour with subtle pale green edges in the glass. The nose lifts with an inviting, fruit-forward bouquet dominated by fresh Bartlett pear, honeydew melon, and white peach, seamlessly layered with delicate citrus blossom nuances. On the palate, this light-bodied wine is intensely clean and vibrant, delivering juicy flavours of zesty green apple, orange peel, and faint lemon pith. Driven by an excellent harmony of refreshing acidity and a fine mineral undercurrent, it transitions into a remarkably crisp, long finish accented by lingering hints of bright citrus and a touch of raw almond.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with light appetizers, fresh garden salads with tangy citrus vinaigrette, pan-seared sea bass, grilled shrimp skewers, sushi, cream-based pasta dishes, or a casual backyard charcuterie board featuring mild cheeses.

gaja-sori-san-lorenzo-2017.title: Gaja Sori San Lorenzo Barberesco 2020/2021
gaja-sori-san-lorenzo-2017.bodyHtml:
Sweet notes on the nose with a beautiful structure of fruit tannins with a lovely, intense color. It is closed initially but when it opens, it has a striking, multifaceted, dense texture. The cask aging also gives the wine a great edge, a little more verve, and tension with notes of salinity, citrus, cassis, currants, mustard, smokiness, and licorice. A deeply complex wine.

Blend:  100% Nebbiolo

2020 Vintage Ratings:

98 Points - James Suckling
The aromas are like a bouquet of pink roses. So perfumed. Citrus. It also has subtle and pure aromas of strawberries, cherries and stone. Full-bodied but agile and floating on the palate with firm and chewy tannins at the end that remain balanced and fresh.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Gaja 2020 Barbaresco Sorì San Lorenzo has bright cherry, currant and underbrush. This wine is very pretty in the mouth, especially if you considered the silky nature of the weightless tannins. The San Lorenzo is fueled by a long finish and does not drop off on the mid-palate. It keeps going strong with red fruits, high notes and balanced acidity. The wood tannins are melted into the wine's fine texture.

2021 Vintage Ratings:

99 Points - James Suckling

A rather exotic and wild Sori San Lorenzo. Even flamboyant. Dried flowers and spices with bark, mushroom and dried dark cherry. Perfumed and primary with earth. Full-bodied and juicy with such fine velvety tannins that are layered and superb. So classic and soft on the palate with great length. Give this four to five years, but a classic in the making.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

An enchanting blend of tea and herbs tangos with grilled cherries and reconstituted currants creates an aromatic profile that's sure to turn heads. The palate is a sublime combination of fresh and preserved red berries, wild herbs, leaves, tar, and crushed stone that all work in unison, ever-evolving with each glance of the glass. Well-structured and firm, a wine of remarkable elegance.

galliano-vanilla.title: Galliano Vanilla Liqueur
galliano-vanilla.bodyHtml:
DELICATE • SMOOTH

The making of Galliano Autentico is a long process, unchanged since the creation of the original Galliano in 1896. Every step of the process reflects Galliano’s dedication to quality and excellence. From a selection of more than 30 herbs and spices such as star anise, juniper, musk yarrow, ginger, lavender and last but not least, the delicate and smooth flavour of vanilla - with a process of seven infusions and six distillations.

ULTIMATE BLEND

The ultimate blend of these distillates and macerates is the sum of all flavours that make Galliano Autentico the unique liqueur that it has been since 1896.

Some consumers however, preferred to have a stronger tone of Vanilla. Therefore, a fragrant vanilla distillate of the highest quality has been added, creating Galliano Vanilla.

gallo-white-zinfandel-3.title: Gallo Family Vineyards White Zinfandel
gallo-white-zinfandel-3.bodyHtml: The Gallo Family Vineyards White Zinfandel is a widely popular, fruit-forward rosé wine from California, known for its light body and approachable, medium-sweet style. It typically features vibrant aromas of strawberry, raspberry, and watermelon, making it a versatile choice for casual dining and warm-weather gatherings.

garrison-brothers-texas-straight-small-b.title: Garrison Brothers Small Batch Bourbon
garrison-brothers-texas-straight-small-b.bodyHtml:
Subtle nose of golden delicious apple-meat and honey. Sweet floral vervena, fresh cut grass, saddle leather, cinnamon and honey. Springtime flavours of honey suckle and orange candy, yellow pound cake, baking spices, lemon gum drops, and sugar cookies. Long and engrossing finish. Complex. Smoky county fair caramel apple sprinkled with walnuts and cinnamon.

96.5 points American Micro Whiskey of The Year

-Jim Murray’s 2017 Whiskey Bible

gato-negro-cabernet-sauvignon-1.title: Gato Negro Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
gato-negro-cabernet-sauvignon-1.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2023 vintage) "This is a light-bodied Cabernet Sauvignon, with mild aromas of white pepper and a simple palate. Flavors of peppercorn and stewed red berries blend with grass and dissolve on a short finish." - Wine Enthusiast

gazela-vinho-verde-1.title: Gazela Vinho Verde 750ml
gazela-vinho-verde-1.bodyHtml:
A cheerful, translucid, lemon-yellow and slightly pétillant white wine, Vinho Verde literally means ‘green wine’ and is named after the northwest Portugese region from which it originates. The ‘green’ in the name refers to the youthful state in which the wines are customarily released and consumed, not the color of the wine.

It is typically a blend of various percentages of Alvarinho, Loureiro, Trajadura, and Pedernã (Arinto). Following initial alcoholic fermentation, a natural, secondary malolactic conversion in cask produces carbon dioxide, giving Vinho Verde its charmingly light sparkle.

gekkeikan-sake-1.title: Gekkeikan Sake 750ml
gekkeikan-sake-1.bodyHtml: Gekkeikan Sake is a popular, herbaceous sake with hints of grapefruit and earthiness. It has a clean, medium finish with good acidity and mineral notes. The sake is versatile and can be enjoyed chilled, at room temperature, or warmed. It's a good pairing with tempura, fish, shellfish, and fresh green vegetable dishes.

gentleman-jack.title: Jack Daniel's Gentleman Jack Tennessee Whiskey
gentleman-jack.bodyHtml:
A premium step up from the classic Old No. 7, Gentleman Jack is the world's only double-mellowed whiskey. It undergoes Jack Daniel's signature Lincoln County Process—filtering through sugar maple charcoal—not once, but twice (both before and after aging in charred oak barrels). Bottled at 80 proof, this extra step strips away any harsh edges, resulting in an exceptionally smooth, soft, and refined Tennessee whiskey that is perfect for neat sipping or elevated cocktails.

 

NOSE

Clean and soft with inviting aromas of caramelized banana, vanilla bean, and light toasted oak.

PALATE

Incredibly smooth and mellow, featuring sweet flavors of vanilla cream, soft caramel, and gentle fruit without any alcohol burn.

FINISH

Short to medium length, finishing clean, crisp, and slightly sweet.

george-t-stagg-58-45.title: George T Stagg  2019 Release
george-t-stagg-58-45.bodyHtml: This extremely hearty whiskey ages in new charred oak barrels for no less than 15 years. Straight out of the barrel, uncut and unfiltered, the taste is powerful, flavorful and intense. Open it up with a few drops of water, sit back and ponder the wonders of the universe.

george-t-stagg-62-45.title: George T Stagg 2018 Release
george-t-stagg-62-45.bodyHtml: This extremely hearty whiskey ages in new charred oak barrels for no less than 15 years. Straight out of the barrel, uncut and unfiltered, the taste is powerful, flavorful and intense. Open it up with a few drops of water, sit back and ponder the wonders of the universe.

george-t-stagg-65-20-2020.title: George T Stagg 2020 Release
george-t-stagg-65-20-2020.bodyHtml: George T. Stagg Bourbon (Fall 2020) is an uncut, unfiltered Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey and is one of the five bottlings in the Buffalo Trace Antique Collection released each fall. For the 2020 release, barrels were filled in spring 2005 and were picked from barrels which matured in Warehouses L, K, and Q. The evaporation for this batch was 59%. Bottled after 15 years and 4 months of aging at 130.4 proof.

giacomo-montresor-amarone-fondatore-2012.title: Montresor Privata Del Fondatore Amarone Della Valpolicella 2012 750ml
giacomo-montresor-amarone-fondatore-2012.bodyHtml:
Tasting notes
A complex nose showing notes of black cherry, plum, violets, coffee and raisins. The palate is smooth and rounded, with a richly-textured mid-palate and a medley of spice, dried fruit characters and supple tannins. The wine remains elegant and nicely balanced, being well-integrated and rich, but with delicate floral notes and a long and complex, dry finish.

gianni-brunelli-brunello-di-montalcino-2.title: Gianni Brunelli Brunello Di Montalcino 2019 750ml
gianni-brunelli-brunello-di-montalcino-2.bodyHtml:
Deep ruby color tending to garnet with floral notes of heather and strawberry tree in the beginning, followed by soft notes of sour cherry and black berries. Concentrated and savory palate, balanced, well structured but fine-grained tannins and good final persistence. 

95 Points by Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2018 Brunello di Montalcino does a great job of capturing the essence and the spirit of Sangiovese, a grape that delivers infinitely nuanced and complex results when in the right hands. This wine reveals wild cherry, blue violet, blood orange, rusty nail and sweet earth. There is a hint of scorched earth or baked clay that underlines the warmest months in this growing cycle. The results are balanced and fresh. I've mentioned alcohol content throughout this report, and although the 14% registered here is still quite high, is it below the average for its peers. This is a job very well done.

gibsons-18-year-old-the-venerable.title: Gibson's Finest Venerable 18 Year Old Canadian Whisky
gibsons-18-year-old-the-venerable.bodyHtml:
Gibson's Finest 'Venerable' 18 Year Old Whisky is an elegantly matured, top-shelf Canadian whisky celebrated for its exceptionally creamy and luxurious profile. Owned by William Grant & Sons and blended from spirits produced at the historic Hiram Walker Distillery in Ontario, this distinguished expression relies on a carefully selected blend of column-distilled corn base whisky and robust rye and malted barley flavoring whiskies. Resting in a variety of oak barrels for nearly two decades, the whisky develops profound layers of rich butterscotch, autumnal baking spices, and a signature velvety mouthfeel, making it a highly acclaimed standout in the premium Canadian whisky category.

Food Pairing: Roast pork loin with cinnamon-spiced apples, baked brie topped with toasted pecans and maple syrup, classic bread pudding, and rich caramel or butterscotch-based desserts.

Tasting Notes : Bright, rich golden-copper in appearance with an oily, luxurious, and highly viscous, creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Exceptionally creamy and inviting, leading with deep aromas of oaky caramel, butterscotch, and sweet vanilla. This is followed by fruity notes of yellow plum and baked pear, along with dusty rye, sweet corn, and a hint of crushed nuts.

Palate : Luxurious and velvety. A rich, sweet wave of butterscotch, maple, and vanilla custard gracefully meets traditional Canadian rye baking spices like nutmeg, cinnamon, and a touch of clove. A distinct, pleasant sweet bread-dough character beautifully balances the warm wood spice.

Finish : Long, warming, and comforting. The sweetness softly fades into lingering notes of baked bread, gentle baking spices, and a beautifully balanced, soft oak tannin.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its full 18-year-old complexity, or gently opened with a single drop of room-temperature water.

gibsons-sterling.title: Gibson's Finest Sterling Canadian Whisky 375ml
gibsons-sterling.bodyHtml:
Gibson's Finest Sterling is a classic Canadian whisky crafted and balanced with mixing and sipping in mind. Produced from a blend of corn, rye, and malted barley whiskies aged in first-fill ex-bourbon barrels, it delivers a rich, creamy texture and a approachable flavor profile featuring sweet orchard fruits, caramel, and soft rye spice.

Food Pairing: Barbecue pulled pork, grilled steak, sharp cheddar, smoked meats, apple pie, and maple-glazed ribs.

Tasting Notes : Pale golden straw in appearance, offering a smooth, creamy, and soft mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet and fruity with notes of caramel, sweet lemon candy, pear, light grapes, and a gentle touch of rye spice.

Palate : Creamy and balanced with flavors of vanilla, sweet caramel, orchard fruits, a hint of walnut, and mild black pepper spice.

Finish : Medium-bodied and clean, ending on soft peppery spice, warm caramel, and lingering citrus zest.

Serve : Served neat, on the rocks, or mixed with ginger ale or cola in classic highball cocktails.

gigglewater-prosecco-doc-1.title: Gigglewater Prosecco
gigglewater-prosecco-doc-1.bodyHtml:
Gigglewater Prosecco is a playful, lively, and highly refreshing Italian sparkling wine. Inspired by the 1920s American slang term for an alcoholic drink, it pours a beautiful light straw yellow and features fine, persistent bubbles. The nose is highly fragrant and expressive, releasing aromas of delicate acacia flowers, crunchy Bartlett pears, ripe apricots, and a bright squeeze of tangerine citrus. On the palate, it is crisp, juicy, and well-balanced, delivering clean flavors of orchard fruits and lemon zest with an elegant, soft mousse and just a touch of honeyed sweetness on the finish.

Food Pairing: This light-hearted and energetic Prosecco is a highly versatile choice for casual dining and entertaining. It is superb served well-chilled as an aperitif, or paired with a fresh watermelon and feta salad, seafood salads, smoked salmon crostini, and light pasta dishes tossed in a cream sauce. It also provides an excellent palate-cleansing contrast to salty appetizers, charcuterie boards, or a selection of soft-ripened cheeses.

gigglewater-rose-sparkling-1.title: Gigglewater Rose Sparkling 750ml
gigglewater-rose-sparkling-1.bodyHtml: Gigglewater Sparkling Rosé is a 750ml bottle of Prosecco-style sparkling wine. It's described as a bright, fresh, and fruity drink with hints of strawberry. It's made in Italy and is known for its light, effervescent body and vibrant pink hue. The wine is also noted for its delicate aromas of cherry blossom, fresh melon, and lemon rind.

gilbey-lemon-gin-collins-1.title: Gilbey's Lemon Gin Collins
gilbey-lemon-gin-collins-1.bodyHtml:
Gilbey's Lemon Gin Collins is a pre-bottled take on the classic Collins, built on Gilbey's Gin and bottled in Canada at 27% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Lemon flavour, sweetening and colouring are added to the gin base, so the bottle delivers the bright, sweet-tart character of a Collins without any measuring or shaking. Lemon leads from the first sniff, with the gin's juniper sitting quietly in the background on the palate. Lower in strength than a standard gin, it is made for easy, casual serving at parties, on the patio or anywhere a quick, refreshing lemon drink is wanted.

Serve: Pour over ice, or top with soda water and a lemon wedge for a longer drink.

gilbey-london-dry-gin-2.title: Tanqueray London Dry Gin 1.75L
gilbey-london-dry-gin-2.bodyHtml:
Tanqueray London Dry Gin is an iconic, double-distilled London dry gin produced by Charles Tanqueray & Co., owned by Diageo. Crafted using a timeless recipe that dates back to the 1830s, it is distilled four times in copper pot stills (including the famous "Old Tom" No. 4 Still) using four core botanicals: piney juniper, coriander seed, angelica root, and sweet liquorice. This balanced, juniper-forward combination delivers a crisp, dry, and classic gin profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon crostini, lemon-herb grilled chicken, goat cheese salad, or cured meats.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear appearance with a light-to-medium, crisp, and clean body on the palate.

Nose : Direct and aromatic with dominant piney juniper, followed by bright citrus zest, herbal coriander, and earthy angelica root.

Palate : Crisp, dry, and balanced with prominent juniper, spicy coriander seeds, subtle citrus peel, and a smooth, bittersweet liquorice undertone.

Finish : Long, dry, and refreshing with lingering notes of piney juniper and warm herbal spice.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled over fresh ice with premium tonic water and a wedge of fresh lime in a classic Gin & Tonic, or as the base of a Dry Martini.

gin-mare-1.title: Gin Mare Mediterranean Gin
gin-mare-1.bodyHtml:
Gin Mare is a Mediterranean gin from Spain, first created in an 18th-century chapel in an old fishing village near Barcelona, where the custom-made still used for the first distillations still stands at the entrance to the distillery. Its four signature botanicals, Arbequina olives, rosemary, basil and thyme, are staples of Mediterranean cooking, and they are joined by orange, lemon, coriander, juniper berries and green cardamom. Each botanical is macerated and distilled separately before blending, and because the acidity of the Arbequina olive changes from year to year, every distillation is slightly different. The result is a savoury, herbal gin, bottled at 42.7% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Savoury and herbaceous, with resinous juniper, thyme and olive.

Nose: Herbaceous, led by resinous juniper and thyme, with olive in the background.

Serve: With premium tonic over plenty of ice, garnished with a sprig of rosemary or a slice of citrus.

giusti-amarone-della-valpolicella-classi.title: Giusti Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2019
giusti-amarone-della-valpolicella-classi.bodyHtml:
Giusti Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2019 is an opulent, powerful, and deeply expressive Venetian red wine crafted by Giusti Wine from historic old vines aged over 70 years in the heart of the Valpolicella Classica zone. Sourced from hillside vineyards rooted in limestone-rich, gravelly soils, the hand-selected clusters of Corvina Veronese, Corvinone, and Rondinella undergo traditional appassimento (drying on bamboo racks for several months to concentrate sugars, polyphenols, and aromatics) before temperature-controlled fermentation and extensive aging in large Slavonian and French oak casks. In the glass, it displays an intensely concentrated, deep ruby core with warm garnet highlights. The bouquet is lavish, perfumed, and layered, revealing concentrated scents of dried black cherries, stewed plums, and dried figs intertwined with nuances of dark chocolate, sweet licorice, cinnamon, warm cardamom, cigar box, and subtle balsamic earth. On the palate, it is full-bodied, expansive, and warmly coating, delivering an unctuous texture of ripe dark fruits framed by supple, velvety tannins, balanced natural acidity, and an enduring, spicy, and warming finish.

Food Pairing: Slow-braised beef short ribs, venison stew with juniper berries, roasted wild boar, osso buco, and mature Parmigiano-Reggiano or aged Gorgonzola cheese.

glen-breton-14-year-old-single-malt.title: Glen Breton Rare 14 Year Old Canadian Single Malt Whisky
glen-breton-14-year-old-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Our 14-Year-Old has suggestions of almond, vanilla and oak, with a hint of lightly baked coconut on the nose. Smooth and malty with just the slightest touch of sweetness and a dash of orange citrus, this is a light and flavourful dram.

Awards

Triple Gold Medal Winner – Micro Liquor Awards

Tasting Notes

Nose - Wild Apple, heather, honey and maple

Taste - Light and smooth with hints of apples, chocolate, vanilla and touch of toasty wood and maple

Finish - Lingering flavour, including nuts, and berries and fruitiness

glen-deveron-16-year-old-1.title: Glen Deveron 16 Year Old Royal Burgh Collection 1L
glen-deveron-16-year-old-1.bodyHtml: Introducing Glen Deveron 16 Year Old Single Malt Whisky, now available in a convenient 1 liter bottle. Crafted with utmost precision and expertise, this exceptional whisky is a true masterpiece. With a rich golden hue and a smooth, velvety texture, Glen Deveron 16 Year Old Single Malt Whisky offers a sensory experience like no other. Each sip reveals a symphony of flavors, including notes of honey, vanilla, and dried fruits, perfectly balanced with a hint of oak.

glen-deveron-20-year-old-1.title: Glen Deveron 20 Year Old Royal Burgh Collection 1L
glen-deveron-20-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Glen Deveron 20 Year Old is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky from the Royal Burgh Collection, presented in a one-litre bottle that was originally released for the travel retail market. Glen Deveron is the name used for the single malts of the Macduff distillery, and the Royal Burgh Collection takes its name from the Royal Burgh of Banff, whose charter is referenced on the label. Matured for at least twenty years and bottled at 40% ABV, it comes in a burgundy gift box.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

glen-deveron-28-year-old-1.title: Glen Deveron 28 Year Old
glen-deveron-28-year-old-1.bodyHtml: A 28 Year old Glen Deveron release, produced at the Macduff Distillery in the Highlands, using some of their rarest whisky stocks. It was bottled from a collection of rare & aged Macduff malts, selected from the Private Reserve of Glen Deveron.

glen-elgin-18-year-old.title: Glen Scotia 18 Year Old
glen-elgin-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Glen Scotia 18 Year Old is a Campbeltown single malt from a distillery whose label carries the date 1832. The whisky spends around 17 years in refill bourbon barrels and refill American oak hogsheads, after which the casks chosen by the Master Blender are vatted together for a twelve-month finish in first-fill Oloroso sherry casks, a nod to Campbeltown's long history with sherry-cask maturation. The distillery describes it as unpeated, floral, aromatic and elegant, with hints of sea spray and spice, and labels it with the style note "Aromatic & Spicy". Bottled without chill filtration at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle and presented in a gift box.

Tasting Notes: Salted caramel, toffee, stone and tropical fruit, gentle spice.

Nose: Crisp saltiness and perfumed floral notes over sweet honey and salted caramel.

Palate: Smooth and rich, with thick sweet toffee, apricot, pineapple and plump sultana, warmed by gentle spice.

Finish: Long and dry, with gentle warming spice.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

glen-grant-12-year-old-1.title: The Glen Grant 12 Year Old
glen-grant-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
The Glen Grant 12 Year Old is a remarkably bright, elegant, and award-winning single malt Scotch whisky that beautifully showcases the classic, fruit-forward style of the Speyside region. Crafted at the historic Rothes distillery under the long-standing guidance of legendary Master Distiller Dennis Malcolm, this expression is distilled using the distillery's famously tall, slender pot stills equipped with unique cooling purifiers. This distinctive design captures only the lightest, most delicate vapors during distillation. Matured for a full dozen years exclusively in high-quality ex-bourbon casks, the resulting spirit balances Speyside's signature orchard fruit character with rich layers of vanilla and oak, offering a highly approachable yet sophisticated dram.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken or pork medallions with an apple glaze, light creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert, smoked salmon crostini, or lemon curd tarts.

Tasting Notes : A bright, polished golden straw color with a light-to-medium body and an exceptionally clean, crisp, and silky texture on the palate.

Nose : Fresh, vibrant, and orchard-forward, opening with distinct aromas of ripe green apples, honeyed pears, and citrus zest, beautifully complemented by notes of vanilla fudge, toasted almonds, and a light herbal undertone.

Palate : Soft and highly balanced on the tongue, delivering dominant flavors of sweet caramel, vanilla cream, and apple pie spice, layered with subtle hints of rich malt, honey, and soft oak tannins.

Finish : Medium in length, clean, and pleasantly dry, resolving smoothly with lingering notes of warm wood spice, soft vanilla, and a trailing hint of citrus fruit.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat or with a tiny splash of pure spring water in a classic Glencairn glass at room temperature, or served over a single large ice cube to enhance its bright fruit notes.

glen-grant-18-year-old-2020-release.title: The Glen Grant 18 Year Old
glen-grant-18-year-old-2020-release.bodyHtml:
The GlenGrant 18 Year Old is an award-winning and exceptionally elegant single malt Scotch whisky, revered for its bright, floral spirit and immense depth. Matured for at least 18 years in the highest quality, handpicked ex-bourbon and sherry oak casks, it pours a radiant golden hue. The nose is complex and inviting, offering a rich bouquet of floral notes, honeysuckle, zesty citrus, sweet vanilla, and toasted oak. On the palate, it delivers a velvety texture with sophisticated and deeply layered flavors of malty caramel, dried raisins, butterscotch, and delicate baking spices. The finish is remarkably long, sweet, and lingering, leaving elegant traces of nuts and soft spice. It is an exceptional sipping whisky that shines neat or with a few drops of water.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted poultry, pan-seared scallops, or lightly smoked salmon. For dessert, it beautifully complements classic crème brûlée, apple tart, vanilla bean cheesecake, or a cheese board featuring soft, creamy cheeses like Brie and Camembert.

glen-scotia-15-year-old-1.title: Glen Scotia 15 Year Old
glen-scotia-15-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
An exceptional single malt whisky intended to deliver a true taste of Campbeltown in its most beautiful simplicity.

Unpeated and matured in first fill bourbon and re-fill American Oak casks, this rich and smooth single malt scotch whisky boasts hints of vanilla oak and spicy aromatic fruits including apricot and orange blossom.

glen-scotia-25-year-old.title: Glen Scotia 25 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
glen-scotia-25-year-old.bodyHtml:
Winner of Best In Show at the prestigious 2021 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, this 25-year-old single malt from Glen Scotia was matured in American oak barrels and married in first-fill bourbon basks before bottling. Aromas of sweet vanilla, salty sea breezes and clove-studded oranges fill the nose, complemented by notes of red apples, tangy orange, caramel, ground ginger and sea salt throughout the palate.

TASTING NOTES

NOSE:Bracing Atlantic breeze gives strong maritime influence.

TASTE:Coastal air, red apple and tangy orange peel with vanilla syrup and caramel sweetness.

FINISH:Long lingering sea salt with a spicy note of ground ginger.

glen-scotia-double-cask.title: Glen Scotia Double Cask
glen-scotia-double-cask.bodyHtml:
Our Double Cask is matured in the finest first fill bourbon barrels before being finished for up to twelve months in Pedro Ximenez sherry casks producing this outstanding single malt whisky that provides the perfect balance of rich spicy fruits, overlaid with the characteristic sea spray and vanilla oak finish for which the house of Glen Scotia is famous.

NOSE
Amber. Very sweet. Initially it is all creme caramel, caramelised fruit sugars, wood sugar, toffee and fudge before some apple and peach come through. In time a charred note of bourbon with a pleasing dusty dryness. Has some power.

PALATE
Sweet start and quite fat and though the alcohol gives a little tongue-tingling buzz the result is a good mid-palate weight. The dry distillery character is there still, but there is now depth to counter. Water slightly dismantles the different elements, but adds some dried mint.

FINISH
Deep and dark.

glen-scotia-victoriana-cask.title: Glen Scotia Victoriana
glen-scotia-victoriana-cask.bodyHtml:
Each cask is chosen for its rare character and exceptional maturity. Finished in deep charred oak, the result is an exceptionally smooth single malt whisky whose aroma and flavour work in harmony. Bottled in the traditional way straight from the cask and without filtration, its subtle wood and vanilla flavour is enhanced by a full bodied spicy fruit aroma and mildly smokey aftertaste.

NOSE

Dark again. An elegant nose with hints of oak driving the bouquet. Interesting creme brulee notes leading to generous caramelised fruits and finally polished oak.

PALATE

Sweet and concentrated start with some jammy blackcurrant fruitiness. A big mid palate. Typical tightening towards the back palate. Becomes more austere with water.

FINISH

Clean and initially sweet.The green bean, with cocoa characteristic.

glenallachie-10-year-old-cask-strength-b.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 2 54.8% ABV
glenallachie-10-year-old-cask-strength-b.bodyHtml:
This bottling has been aged for 10 years in a mixture of casks, which included virgin oak, Oloroso sherry, Pedro Ximénez sherry and first-fill Bourbon.

The result is a well-balanced and sophisticated whisky, serving up flavours of almond, vanilla, liquorice, green apple, honey, malt, toffee, pear, dried fruits, sultanas, butter, dark chocolate, buttered corn, old oak and mango.

The whisky has been bottled at a powerful 54.8% ABV, and without chill filtration or colouration.

An excellent example of the Speyside distillery’s spirit, which illustrates the benefits of multiple cask aging.

glenallachie-10-year-old-cask-strength-b.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 4 56.1% ABV
glenallachie-10-year-old-cask-strength-b.bodyHtml:
Batch 4 of Glenallachie’ss 10 Year Old Cask Strength bottling, which has been an instant hit for newly revived distillery.

A full bodied whisky that clearly has some sherry influence, this dram offers notes of: cinnamon, ginger, plums, prunes, sultanas, dried cranberries, a little earthy vanilla, chilli-chocolate, nutmeg, blackcurrants, treacle, hot malt and old polished oak.

Bottled at 56.1% ABV, and without chill filtration or colouration, this is a thick, flavoursome dram.

glenallachie-10-year-old-port-finish-1.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Port Finish
glenallachie-10-year-old-port-finish-1.bodyHtml: This gorgeous ruby red malt has been matured for over eight years in American Oak Barrels. It was then re-racked into vintage, premium Ruby Port Wood Pipes which developed the flavour depth and complexity, adding vibrant fruit flavours. Regular monitoring ensures we achieve the perfect balance between wood and spirit influence whilst preserving the whisky characteristics. Bottled at 48%, unchilfiltered and natural colour.

glenallachie-10-year-old-sauternes-cask.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 13
glenallachie-10-year-old-sauternes-cask.bodyHtml:
GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 13 is a rich, full-flavored single malt Scotch whisky crafted by Master Distiller Billy Walker at the GlenAllachie Distillery in Speyside. Bottled at natural cask strength, non-chill filtered, and with no added color, this expression delivers a robust, multi-layered profile resulting from a complex maturation process in Spanish Sherry oak, Pedro Ximénez, Oloroso, Virgin Oak, and Rioja casks.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate desserts, sticky toffee pudding, venison stew, blue cheese or sharp aged gouda, and roasted chestnuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany in appearance with a heavy, coating, and full-bodied mouthfeel that brings intense, warming complexity.

Nose : Waves of heather honey, dark chocolate, dried fruit, mocha, cinnamon spice, orange zest, and soft espresso.

Palate : Rich cocoa, treacle, raisins, gingerbread, dark cherries, butterscotch, and sweet oak spices balanced by warm barley malt.

Finish : Long and lingering with notes of dark chocolate, spiced orchard fruit, citrus peel, and seasoned oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

glenallachie-11-year-old-moscatel-wood-f.title: The GlenAllachie 11 Year Old Moscatel Finish
glenallachie-11-year-old-moscatel-wood-f.bodyHtml:
This beautifully bronze gold malt was bottled at 48% and first aged in the finest American Oak Wood Barrels for over nine years before being re-racked into Moscatel Barriques. The second maturation period enriches the flavour, creating a fruitier style of whisky with a very vivid and aromatic nose, typical of the muscat grape.

From Batch 2 of the GlenAllachie Wood Finish Range.

glenallachie-12-year-old-1.title: The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old
glenallachie-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a rich, robust, and masterfully crafted flagship expression that showcases the independent distillery's commitment to bold flavor and exceptional wood management. Reconstructed under the guidance of legendary master blender Billy Walker, this single malt is matured for at least twelve years in a premium combination of Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheons, Oloroso sherry hogsheads, and virgin oak casks. It pours a 100% natural, deep mahogany-bronze hue in the glass, immediately releasing an intense, expressive bouquet of heather honey, dark chocolate, and cinnamon, elegantly layered with complex undertones of sticky raisins, mocha, and candied orange peel. On the palate, the whisky is full-bodied, smooth, and incredibly rich, delivering a luscious wave of sweet honey, dark plums, and marzipan alongside warm notes of grated ginger, espresso bean, and toasted oak spice. Balanced by a refined, satisfying spirit presence, it glides into a long, warming finish that leaves a dry, lingering impression of dark chocolate, sweet baking spices, and caramelized brown sugar.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with rich dishes and artisanal treats, including slow-braised beef short ribs with a dark ale reduction, pan-seared duck breast with cherry sauce, smoked venison, sticky toffee pudding, dark chocolate hazelnut truffles, or mature blue cheeses like Stilton.

glenallachie-12-year-old-bourbon-cask.title: The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old
glenallachie-12-year-old-bourbon-cask.bodyHtml:

glenallachie-12-year-old-chinquapin-virg.title: The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old Chinquapin Virgin
glenallachie-12-year-old-chinquapin-virg.bodyHtml:
This exceptional malt gets its complex, zesty flavours from casks made of Chinquapin Oak (Quercus Muehlenbergii) sourced from the Northern Ozark region in Missouri. Chinquapin is a sub species of Quercus Alba and delivers spicy flavours and aromas. Air dried for almost four years, then toasted to medium level these casks give us the perfect balance of spirit and wood character.

Bottled at 48%, natural colour and non chill filtered.

glenallachie-12-year-old-px-sherry-finis.title: The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old PX Finish
glenallachie-12-year-old-px-sherry-finis.bodyHtml:
This glorious rich mahogany malt has been matured for over ten years in American Oak Wood Barrels. The additional maturation in richly seasoned Pedro Ximenez Puncheons enriches the flavour, creating a sweeter, fruitier whisky. The casks are regularly monitored to ensure the perfect balance between our single malt and this luscious dessert sherry. Natural colour, unchilfiltered and bottled at 48%.

From Batch 1 of the GlenAllachie Wood Finish Range.

glenallachie-12-year-old-spanish-virigin.title: The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old Spanish Virigin Oak
glenallachie-12-year-old-spanish-virigin.bodyHtml:
This rich bronze malt attains its spicy, treacly flavours from hogsheads made of Spanish Oak (Quercus Robur) sourced from Galicia and Asturias regions, more specifically, the Cantabrian Mountains which have a cooler climate and greater humidity. Before being filled, the wood is air-dried for around 18 months, opening up the oak for the GlenAllachie spirit to extract the cask character.

Bottled at 48%, natural colour and non chill filtered.

glenallachie-15-year-old-1.title: The GlenAllachie 15 Year Old
glenallachie-15-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Almost two years after we launched The GlenAllachie core range, we decided to expand it and showcase more of what our whisky has to offer. Our Master Distiller, Billy Walker, worked tirelessly on this new expression since day one, evaluating casks and refining recipes to create something special.

Predominantly matured in sherry casks, the spirit is bursting with sticky raisins, tangy orange, rich spices and dark chocolate truffles. We’re proud to present our flagship expression and the jewel in our crown: the GlenAllachie 15 years old.

The GlenAllachie 15 Year Old is bottled at 46%, non chill filtered and natural colour.

glenallachie-15-year-old-madeira-cask.title: The GlenAllachie 15 Year Old
glenallachie-15-year-old-madeira-cask.bodyHtml:
Almost two years after we launched The GlenAllachie core range, we decided to expand it and showcase more of what our whisky has to offer. Our Master Distiller, Billy Walker, worked tirelessly on this new expression since day one, evaluating casks and refining recipes to create something special.

Predominantly matured in sherry casks, the spirit is bursting with sticky raisins, tangy orange, rich spices and dark chocolate truffles. We’re proud to present our flagship expression and the jewel in our crown: the GlenAllachie 15 years old.

The GlenAllachie 15 Year Old is bottled at 46%, non chill filtered and natural colour.

glenallachie-18-year-old.title: The GlenAllachie 18 Year Old
glenallachie-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
This opulent Scotch whisky was patiently perfected in the finest oak casks for 18 long years. Silently slumbering in our on-site warehouses, the spirit underwent continual monitoring until Billy Walker deemed it had reached its pinnacle.

With enticing aromas of honey and mocha, followed by marzipan and dark cherry tones on the palate, it’s a single malt oozing elegant refinement.

We proudly present The GlenAllachie 18-year-old with integrity; at a high strength of 46%, without added colouring or chill filtration, allowing the unpeated whisky’s true character to reign supreme.

glenallachie-18-year-old-virgin-oak-cask.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 13
glenallachie-18-year-old-virgin-oak-cask.bodyHtml:
GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 13 is a rich, full-flavored single malt Scotch whisky crafted by Master Distiller Billy Walker at the GlenAllachie Distillery in Speyside. Bottled at natural cask strength, non-chill filtered, and with no added color, this expression delivers a robust, multi-layered profile resulting from a complex maturation process in Spanish Sherry oak, Pedro Ximénez, Oloroso, Virgin Oak, and Rioja casks.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate desserts, sticky toffee pudding, venison stew, blue cheese or sharp aged gouda, and roasted chestnuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany in appearance with a heavy, coating, and full-bodied mouthfeel that brings intense, warming complexity.

Nose : Waves of heather honey, dark chocolate, dried fruit, mocha, cinnamon spice, orange zest, and soft espresso.

Palate : Rich cocoa, treacle, raisins, gingerbread, dark cherries, butterscotch, and sweet oak spices balanced by warm barley malt.

Finish : Long and lingering with notes of dark chocolate, spiced orchard fruit, citrus peel, and seasoned oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

glenallachie-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml:

glenallachie-30-year-old-madeira-cask.title: The GlenAllachie 11 Year Old Palo Cortado Sherry Cask Finish
glenallachie-30-year-old-madeira-cask.bodyHtml:
Glenallachie 11 Year Old Palo Cortado Sherry Cask Finish is a single malt Scotch whisky crafted by Master Distiller Billy Walker at the GlenAllachie Distillery in Speyside. Initially matured in premium American oak ex-bourbon barrels, the spirit underwent a secondary maturation for over two years in rare Palo Cortado sherry puncheons sourced from Spain. This unique finishing process imparts a complex balance of rich dried fruits, nutty warmth, and delicate oak spices onto GlenAllachie’s signature honeyed spirit.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast with fig glaze, dark chocolate tarts, aged gouda, charcuterie with prosciutto and dried figs, and toasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany in appearance with a rich, full-bodied mouthfeel that delivers a silky texture and warming depth.

Nose : Heather honey, dark chocolate, dried fruit, cinnamon spice, orange peel, and toasted almonds.

Palate : Rich cocoa, treacle, sultanas, mocha, sweet baking spices, marzipan, and subtle oak tannins.

Finish : Long and warming with lingering notes of dark chocolate, spiced fruit, orange zest, and roasted nuts.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

glenallachie-30-year-old-oloroso-hogshea.title: The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old
glenallachie-30-year-old-oloroso-hogshea.bodyHtml:
The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a rich, robust, and masterfully crafted flagship expression that showcases the independent distillery's commitment to bold flavor and exceptional wood management. Reconstructed under the guidance of legendary master blender Billy Walker, this single malt is matured for at least twelve years in a premium combination of Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheons, Oloroso sherry hogsheads, and virgin oak casks. It pours a 100% natural, deep mahogany-bronze hue in the glass, immediately releasing an intense, expressive bouquet of heather honey, dark chocolate, and cinnamon, elegantly layered with complex undertones of sticky raisins, mocha, and candied orange peel. On the palate, the whisky is full-bodied, smooth, and incredibly rich, delivering a luscious wave of sweet honey, dark plums, and marzipan alongside warm notes of grated ginger, espresso bean, and toasted oak spice. Balanced by a refined, satisfying spirit presence, it glides into a long, warming finish that leaves a dry, lingering impression of dark chocolate, sweet baking spices, and caramelized brown sugar.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with rich dishes and artisanal treats, including slow-braised beef short ribs with a dark ale reduction, pan-seared duck breast with cherry sauce, smoked venison, sticky toffee pudding, dark chocolate hazelnut truffles, or mature blue cheeses like Stilton.

glenallachie-8-year-old-koval-quarter-ca.title: The GlenAllachie 8 Year Old Koval Quarter Cask
glenallachie-8-year-old-koval-quarter-ca.bodyHtml:
Bottled at 48%, This golden malt was first matured in the finest American Barrels with an additional maturation period in Organic Rye Quarter Casks from Chicago’s Koval Distillery. The wood to liquid ratio is greater here, meaning the signature Rye spiciness has a greater impact on the spirit. We closely monitor the process to produce an exciting, sensational result.

From Batch 1 of the GlenAllachie Wood Finish Range.

glencadam-21-year-old-1.title: Glencadam 21 Year Old
glencadam-21-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Multi-award-winning Glencadam Highland Single Scotch Malt Whisky Aged 21 Years is a fine example of centuries of craftsmanship and tradition. “The exceptional” malt with a beautifully lingering, true flavour boasts a lot of richness and malty flavour. Very tasty with a lot going on!

Aromatic and inviting nose, with hints of toffee and salted caramel mixed with baked pineapple and cake spices.  The taste is rich and delicious with layers of heather honey, tangy fruits, golden raisins and cinder toffee followed by toasted brioche and almond hints. The finish is cosy and warming with notes of oat biscuits, acacia honey and orange peels fading into gentle clove spices.

glencadam-reserva-andalucia-oloroso-sher.title: Glencadam Reserva Andalucía Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish
glencadam-reserva-andalucia-oloroso-sher.bodyHtml:
Glencadam Reserva Andalucía Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky crafted at Glencadam Distillery. Carefully selected whisky from sherry butts and bourbon casks is married together before being finished in Oloroso sherry butts sourced from Andalucía, Spain. Bottled at 46% ABV with natural colour and without chill filtration, Reserva Andalucía balances Glencadam's signature fruit-forward character with rich sultana, orchard fruit, creamy toffee and sweet spice from the Oloroso finish. 

Food Pairing: Pair with Manchego cheese, roasted almonds, prosciutto, apple tart, crème brûlée, fruitcake or caramelized desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and smooth with ripe fruit, creamy sweetness and Oloroso sherry character, bringing together sultanas, orchard fruits, vanilla, fudge and gentle sweet spice.

Nose: Ripe soft fruits with soft nougat, oaky vanilla and freshly made fudge.

Palate: Smooth and creamy with sultanas, orchard fruits and toffee apple sweetness.

Finish: Long and silky with honey, muscovado sugar and lingering green tea.

glendalough-13-year-old-mizunara-cask.title: Glendalough 7 Year Old Single Malt Mizunara Finish Irish Whiskey
glendalough-13-year-old-mizunara-cask.bodyHtml: Glendalough's Mizunara 7-year single malt is vivid, but delicate with seamless depth. It is vibrant, fruity, and floral on the nose, enjoying a luxuriously smooth mouthfeel with notes of dark chocolate orange, sandalwood and cinnamon synonymous with Mizunara whiskeys. This unique whiskey benefits from an exceptionally long finish of toasted oak and oriental spices, with the dark chocolate lingering even longer

glendalough-13-year-old-single-malt.title: Glendalough 7 Year Old Single Malt Mizunara Finish Irish Whiskey
