glendalough-7-year-old-american-oak.title: Glendalough 7 Year Old Black Pitts Porter Cask Finish Single Malt Irish Whiskey
glendalough-7-year-old-american-oak.bodyHtml:
Along with whiskey, Ireland is famous across the world for fine stout and porter. We've swapped barrels over the years with our friends in the 5 Lamps Brewery, and found that finishing our whiskey in barrels that had previously held their Black Pitts porter brings our single malt to incredible depths. Made with roasted chocolate barley, it amplifies the malt notes while layering on rich, dark flavours.

Inspired by the 7 hard years that St Kevin spent in the wild and the "city of 7 churches" he came to build at Glendalough. Have a look on the bottle, you?ll see 7 silver crosses. These will lead you to each of the 7 churches, should you ever be stirred into going to Glendalough.

The nose. Sweet with toffee apples, dark chocolate and vanilla ice cream. The taste. Smooth and warm with mandarin orange, cocoa, toffee and cooked fruit, followed by clove and peppery spices. The finish. Long and spicy with toasted oak, treacle and brown-sugared coffee notes.

glendalough-double-barrel.title: Glendalough Double Barrel Irish Whiskey
glendalough-double-barrel.bodyHtml:
Glendalough Double Barrel Irish Whiskey is a highly acclaimed single grain Irish whiskey that undergoes a meticulous two-stage maturation process. It is initially aged in American oak bourbon barrels, which impart deep notes of sweet vanilla and caramel, before being transferred to Spanish oak Oloroso sherry casks for an extended finish. This secondary maturation adds rich layers of dark fruit, nutty complexity, and warming spices, resulting in a remarkably smooth and versatile whiskey that perfectly showcases the innovative spirit of Ireland's first craft distillery.

Food Pairing: The sweet, fruit-forward, and lightly spiced character of this whiskey pairs beautifully with a charcuterie board featuring cured meats, dried fruits, and aged cheeses. It also serves as an excellent companion to roasted pork dishes or rich, dark chocolate desserts.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, radiant golden amber hue. The texture is light, exceptionally smooth, and invitingly approachable on the palate.

NOSE - Rich and sweet, opening with inviting aromas of vanilla, toasted oak, and caramel, which seamlessly blend with dark chocolate, dried figs, and a touch of roasted nuts.

PALATE - Smooth and gently spiced. Flavors of butterscotch, honey, and creamy vanilla are beautifully balanced by notes of dried sherry fruits, dates, brown sugar, and a hint of cracked black pepper.

FINISH - Long, warming, and deeply satisfying. It leaves a lingering trail of sweet sherry, toasted almond, and a touch of ginger spice.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat, poured over a single large block of ice, or used as a flavorful, robust base in classic whiskey cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or an Irish Coffee.

glendalough-pot-still.title: Glendalough Pot Still Irish Oak Finish Irish Whiskey
glendalough-pot-still.bodyHtml:
Finished for up to a year in the rarest of all casks, virgin Irish oak, this is a milestone for Irish whiskey. A single cask, mainstream whiskey that makes available the flavours of Irish oak to everyone.

Each bottle is numbered and traceable to each cask and even to the tree from whence it came.

We sustainably fell 140 year-old trees from the ancient oak forests in the mountains around the distillery. This was the beginning of a year long process that ends with an Irish oak hogshead.

These special casks are filled with the most quintessentially Irish of whiskeys - pot still. The higher levels of toasted oak and vanilla flavours that Irish oak brings to the liquid complement and balance the classic pot still spices.

glendalough-wild-botanical-gin-1.title: Glendalough Wild Botanical Gin
glendalough-wild-botanical-gin-1.bodyHtml:
To make this extraordinary gin, we forage wild plants in the mountains around the distillery. What we pick goes fresh into the still within hours of foraging. 

All the plants are sustainably picked by our full time forager, every day we distil. We take a lot of care that we don't adversely affect the areas we find them in. That means sometimes using scissors rather than picking to make sure roots aren't pulled, or maybe skipping a few before picking the next one, or finding different patches of the same plant, to make sure an area isn't over-foraged.

Our aim is to leave no trace that we were ever there. It's harder work but worth it to keep the mountains beautiful and wild.

Then these wild botanicals are painstakingly slow-distilled to tease out delicate flavours, in very small batches of less than 250 liters. Some go in the pot, and some are hung in a basket to let vapours extract their essential oils. The cut-points are decided batch by batch, by smell and taste (never timed or automated) as if each batch is the first.

This brings the flavour our Wild Gin to a whole other level. The knowledge, experience and man-hours in each bottle are what make this liquid so special.

glendalough-wild-botanical-rose-gin-1.title: Glendalough Wild Rose Irish Gin
glendalough-wild-botanical-rose-gin-1.bodyHtml:
This fresh, rose-petal gin was first made to honour our head distiller's mum, Rose, at his little brother's wedding. Rose had recently passed away, and this was his way to have her there in spirit - literally.

Carefully-tended flowers, from her rose garden are slowly vapor distilled with wild roses and plants from the mountains around the distillery to make this an intensely floral gin.

After distilling, the gin is then further infused with even more roses to deepen the flavours and give it its lovely pink hue.

This is not "just another pink gin", far from it. The depth and complexity really needs to be tasted to be understood. Floral, fragrant and flavourful, it is some of the best, most interesting gin we've made and comes after a lot of experimenting with plants, fruit, spices and flowers.

glendronach-10-year-old-2009-vintage-px-.title: The GlenDronach 2011 10 Year Old PX Cask
glendronach-10-year-old-2009-vintage-px-.bodyHtml:
The exclusive to Canada 2011 vintage GlenDronach 10 Year Old has been matured in Pedro Ximinez sherry casks, bottled at 43% ABV, and as is the case for all The GlenDronach expressions, it is non-chill filtered and naturally coloured, absorbing its rich colour over the 10 years it has spent maturing in the Spanish sherry oak.

A dance of Seville blood orange and cherry, with harvest-ripe barley, roast chestnuts and winter-spiced cocoa. A burst of red berry fruit compote and mandarin orange, lingering current and Morello cherry with barley sugar and traces of ginger.

glendronach-15-year-old-revival-1.title: The GlenDronach 15 Year Old Revival
glendronach-15-year-old-revival-1.bodyHtml:
In flavour, the expression offers sumptuous notes of dark fruits, rich chocolate and manuka honey with an enveloping, memorable finish worthy of this monumental malt’s history. This luxuriously sherried Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky is bottled at 46% ABV and natural in colour.

APPEARANCE

Antique Bronze.

NOSE

An intoxicating burst of maraschino cherry, ripe bramble and dark chocolate mint with hints of orange bitters and walnut liqueur.

PALATE

Honey-glazed apricot and ripe fig with a crescendo of black cherry, angelica and muscovado. Long and enveloping finish with dark manuka honey, herbal bitters and dark chocolate.

glendronach-18-year-old-allardice.title: The GlenDronach 18 Year Old Allardice
glendronach-18-year-old-allardice.bodyHtml: The GlenDronach 18 years old has been named after the renowned founder of the distillery, James Allardice. This exceptional sherried single malt is non chill filtered and of natural colour. Matured in the finest Spanish Oloroso sherry casks and bottled at 46%, this sublime richly sherried malt is truly unforgettable.

glendronach-21-year-old-parliament-2020-.title: The GlenDronach 21 Year Old Parliament
glendronach-21-year-old-parliament-2020-.bodyHtml: Matured in a combination of the finest Oloroso and Pedro Ximenez sherry casks for a minimum of 21 years, the Parliament continues the great GlenDronach tradition of offering fruit-laden intensity in its single malts. This rich expression has been named Parliament after the colony, or parliament, of rooks that have been nesting in the trees that overlook the GlenDronach distillery for almost 200 years.

glendronach-8-year-old-the-hielan.title: The GlenDronach 8 Year Old The Hielan'
glendronach-8-year-old-the-hielan.bodyHtml:
This single malt has been matured and married in a combination of the finest bourbon and sherry casks for at least 8 years. Non-chill filtered, of natural colour and bottled at 46%, The Hielan’ encompasses a unique combination of sweet, buttery aromas with spicy, sherry overtones. The Hielan’ is a tribute to the dialect spoken in the distillery’s surrounding area in the Scottish Highlands.

TASTING NOTES

APPEARANCE
Amber with a burnished copper glow.

NOSE
Rounded waves of orange blossom and a citrus twist flow over buttery, golden sultanas, sundried raisins and ripe yellow plums; all dusted with a touch of vanilla.

PALATE
Crisp, vibrant oak spices warm soaked sultanas, apricot jam and gingerbread; all rounded by delicate hints of butterscotch, cocoa and toasted almonds.

CONCLUSION
Classic sherry overtones with a contrasting crisp dimension demonstrate the complexity of the traditional Highland character.

glendronach-batch-17-1992-cask-5896-26-y.title: The GlenDronach 26 Year Old Cask 5896 Batch 17
glendronach-batch-17-1992-cask-5896-26-y.bodyHtml:
The batch seventeen cask selection truly celebrates The GlenDronach house style; robust, elegant, fruity and full-bodied. Each cask individually explores the sophistication, powerful intricacy and rich layers of Spanish sherry cask maturation found in every GlenDronach expression; from layers of crème brûlée, treacle toffee and over-ripe banana in 1990 to baked blackberry and currants with dark chocolate in 1992, burnt raisin and Oloroso-soaked tobacco leaf in 1995 to toasted pain au raisin and butterscotch simmering beneath the surface in 2007. The distinctive flavour and rich mouthfeel of each cask has developed during the slow maturation process. All fourteen casks are bottled without chill filtration for richness, at high strength and are naturally deep in colour.

1992 CASK 5896

Aged: 26 Years Old

Cask Type: Port Pipe

Appearance: Dark ruby

Nose: Deeply aromatic with cigar box, orange and leather, with slowly emerging layers of dried grass, nutmeg, sandalwood and black cherry.

Palate: Sip baked blackberry and currant with dark chocolate, cherry stone and walnut.

Savour Turkish delight dusted with icing sugar lingering unexpectedly into a nutty nougat and cream ﬁnish.

ABV: 49.3%

glendronach-batch-17-1993-cask-416-25-ye.title: The GlenDronach Batch 17 1993 Cask 416 25 Year Old Oloroso Sherry Butt
glendronach-batch-17-1993-cask-416-25-ye.bodyHtml:
The batch seventeen cask selection truly celebrates The GlenDronach house style; robust, elegant, fruity and full-bodied. Each cask individually explores the sophistication, powerful intricacy and rich layers of Spanish sherry cask maturation found in every GlenDronach expression; from layers of crème brûlée, treacle toffee and over-ripe banana in 1990 to baked blackberry and currants with dark chocolate in 1992, burnt raisin and Oloroso-soaked tobacco leaf in 1995 to toasted pain au raisin and butterscotch simmering beneath the surface in 2007. The distinctive flavour and rich mouthfeel of each cask has developed during the slow maturation process. All fourteen casks are bottled without chill filtration for richness, at high strength and are naturally deep in colour.

1993 CASK 416

Aged: 25 Years Old

Cask Type: Oloroso Sherry Butt

Appearance: Antique bronze with an amber hue.

Nose: Sticky date, burnt-raisin and Oloroso-soaked tobacco leaf give way to Christmas cake and oven-baked treacle pie.

Palate: Sumptuous, mouth-filling taste of baked autumn fruits with plum, apple and blackberry.

Savour the lingering dark fruity taste of blueberry, cherry and treacle.

ABV: 51.2%

glendronach-cask-strength-batch-7.title: The GlenDronach Cask Strength Batch 7
glendronach-cask-strength-batch-7.bodyHtml:
Like all previous Cask Strength batches from The GlenDronach, this expression continues our tradition of marrying the finest Spanish sherry casks from Andalucía; Oloroso and Pedro Ximenez . The Oloroso contributes to the fruity and elegant nature of The GlenDronach, with notes of dark bramble fruits and gentle spices. Pedro Ximenez contributes the robust and full-bodied richness of The GlenDronach, often characterised by notes of dark chocolate and stewed fruits. With each Cask Strength release, our Master Blender selects the ideal marriage of these two casks before bottling without chill filtration, at high strength and naturally deep in colour, as was the custom before the turn of the 20th century. Add a drop or two of water to reveal a cornucopia of flavour – from wild figs and brambles to baked apple and damson plum.

TASTING NOTES

APPEARANCE
Deep bronze

NOSE
Cherry brandy and chocolate with blackberry vines, wild figs and Highland Toffee.

PALATE
Burst of brambles and ripe sultanas give way to Seville orange and roasted chestnut. Finish of baked apple and damson plum linger with chocolate walnut and whipped cream.

glendronach-port-wood.title: The GlenDronach Port Wood
glendronach-port-wood.bodyHtml: The GlenDronach Port Wood is inspired by the historical import of casked port into Scotland during the 19th century. During the 1800s, port was ‘de rigueur’, and many of the finest port pipes would travel from Portugal, down its Douro River, destined for the wine cellars of Scotland’s gentry. Whilst many years have passed, Portugal’s majestic Douro Valley is still renowned for its exceptional port. We have selected some of its finest port pipes to house The GlenDronach for a second maturation period of three years. Our Master Blender has expertly combined the whisky from these port pipes, to create a fruit-filled ten-year-old expression, with layers of ripe berries rolling into its signature long, lingering finish.

glendronach-traditionally-peated.title: The Glendronach Ode to the Embers Sherry & Smoke
glendronach-traditionally-peated.bodyHtml:
The GlenDronach "Ode to the Embers" Sherry & Smoke is a unique single malt Scotch whisky featured as part of The GlenDronach's Master's Anthology collection. Crafted to highlight the rare peated side of the Highland distillery's heritage, it combines lightly peated malted barley with maturation in The GlenDronach's signature Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry casks. This expression delivers a harmonious balance of rich dried fruits, dark chocolate, and warm baking spices infused with a subtle, smoldering ember smoke.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, seared duck breast, dark chocolate fondant, sharp blue cheese, and roasted chestnuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep bronze with a rich, full-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel that seamlessly merges sweet sherry richness with delicate, warming smoke.

Nose : Smoldering heather embers, dark chocolate, dried figs, pipe tobacco, rich treacle, and orange peel.

Palate : Layers of dark berries, espresso, caramelized brown sugar, campfire smoke, sweet oak spices, and rich cocoa.

Finish : Long, warming, and complex with lingering notes of sweet peat smoke, dark fruit, dried orange, and seasoned oak.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

glenfarclas-12-year-old-1.title: Glenfarclas 12 Year Old
glenfarclas-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 12 Year Old is a quintessential Speyside single malt Scotch whisky that beautifully showcases the distillery's signature heavy sherry cask influence. Aged for a full 12 years exclusively in hand-selected Oloroso sherry casks, this classic dram pours a vibrant amber-gold color. The nose is greeted with a rich aroma of fresh honey, mixed spices, and sherried fruit. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied experience with a perfect balance of oak, sweet malt, and delicious hints of dried fruits like raisins and dates, leading into a long, flavorful, and warming finish with a touch of spice.

Food Pairing: This rich, sherried single malt pairs excellently with savory dishes like roasted duck breast, glazed pork belly, or a classic charcuterie board featuring jamón ibérico and walnuts. For a sweet pairing, it beautifully complements a rich fruitcake, dark chocolate ginger biscuits, or sticky toffee pudding.

glenfarclas-15-year-old-1.title: Glenfarclas 15 Year Old
glenfarclas-15-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 15 Year Old is a renowned Speyside single malt Scotch whisky produced by the family-owned Glenfarclas Distillery. Bottled at a higher strength of 46% ABV, it is aged for fifteen years exclusively in 100% Oloroso sherry casks, delivering a rich, complex balance of dark dried fruits, christmas cake spices, and subtle maltiness.

Food Pairing: Roasted venison, dark chocolate desserts, Christmas pudding, aged fruitcake, and sharp aged cheddar or blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance with a full-bodied, rich, and viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Complex and sherry-laden with aromas of dried fruits, raisins, butterscotch, toasted nuts, and sweet malt.

Palate : Full-bodied and balanced with flavors of dark fruitcake, sweet sherry, orange peel, cinnamon, clove spice, and rich oak tannins.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet dried fruit, gentle oak wood, and soft lingering spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to open up the complex sherry fruit and oak spices.

glenfarclas-17-year-old-1.title: Glenfarclas 17 Year Old
glenfarclas-17-year-old-1.bodyHtml: Gold hay hue. The nose is an intricate range of smoke, minerals and sherry. On the palate, there is butterscotch, more sherry and peat. Smoke continues to stay with you long after the final sip. A whisky of complexity and depth, offering a very long finish. Extraordinary.

glenfarclas-21-year-old-1.title: Glenfarclas 17 Year Old
glenfarclas-21-year-old-1.bodyHtml: Gold hay hue. The nose is an intricate range of smoke, minerals and sherry. On the palate, there is butterscotch, more sherry and peat. Smoke continues to stay with you long after the final sip. A whisky of complexity and depth, offering a very long finish. Extraordinary.

glenfarclas-25-year-old-1.title: Glenfarclas 25 Year Old
glenfarclas-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml: From a long-time family-owned distillery, this 25-year-old single malt from Glenfarclas spent its days in 100% Oloroso sherry casks. It’s complex and delicately sherried, a whisky that’s sure not to disappoint. The price for a similar 25-year-old whisky is typically double or triple what this bottle costs making this an extraordinary value.

glenfarclas-30-year-old-1.title: Glenfarclas 30 Year Old
glenfarclas-30-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 30 Year Old is an exceptionally mature single malt Scotch whisky produced at the family-owned Glenfarclas Distillery in the heart of Speyside. Matured in Spanish Oloroso sherry casks, it offers a rich, complex depth with indulgent notes of Christmas fruitcake, dark chocolate, dried fruit, and refined oak.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate desserts, fruitcake, roasted venison, stilton or aged Gouda cheese, and dried figs.

Tasting Notes : Deep gold with copper highlights, featuring a smooth, rich, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Full and complex aromas of dried fruits, dark sherry, malt, polished oak, marzipan, and subtle citrus peel.

Palate : Rich and indulgent with flavors of dark Christmas cake, candied fruit, nuts, marzipan, sherry, cognac-like warmth, and gentle baking spices.

Finish : Exceptionally long, smooth, and exquisite with lingering notes of dark burnt chocolate and soft oak warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip-shaped tasting glass or Glencairn, allowing it time to breathe before sipping.

glenfarclas-40-year-old-1.title: Glenfarclas 40 Year Old
glenfarclas-40-year-old-1.bodyHtml: The Glenfarclas 40 Year Old 5cl miniature is a great way to taste this rare and highly prized single malt Scotch whisky. Aged in ex sherry casks, this Highland whisky has taken on a big influence from the sherry, with strong sherry flavours of sugared fruits and treacle.

glenfarclas-cask-strength-105-proof.title: Glenfarclas 105 Cask Strength
glenfarclas-cask-strength-105-proof.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 105 Cask Strength is a legendary, high-proof single malt Scotch whisky that stands as a definitive expression of the distillery's bold, sherried character. Bottled at its natural cask strength without chill-filtration, this powerhouse dram pours a deep, rich peat-gold. The nose is highly concentrated, offering intense aromas of complex oak, rich fruits, and sweet pears. On the palate, it is exceptionally full-bodied, delivering a velvety blast of sweet malty notes, dark chocolate, raisins, and dried plums, perfectly balanced by a warming, spicy dryness. The finish is remarkably long, smooth, and intensely warming with lingering hints of pepper and rich sherry.

Food Pairing: This robust, high-proof malt requires food that can match its intensity. It pairs spectacularly with rich, fatty meats such as a prime ribeye steak with a pepper crust or roasted venison. It also handles strong cheeses beautifully, particularly an artisanal mature Stilton or a sharp blue cheese. For dessert, it is a perfect match for rich dark chocolate truffles, espresso cake, or Christmas pudding.

glenfiddich-12-year-old-signature-blend.title: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old 1.75L
glenfiddich-12-year-old-signature-blend.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 12 Year Old is the world’s most awarded single malt Scotch whisky and the iconic flagship expression of the Glenfiddich Distillery. Carefully matured in a combination of the finest American oak (ex-bourbon) and European oak (ex-Oloroso sherry) casks for at least 12 years, it is then married in oak marrying tuns for up to nine months. This meticulous process yields an exceptionally smooth, fresh, and beautifully balanced whisky, famous for its signature notes of fresh green pear, subtle oak, and sweet maltiness.

Food Pairing: Soft cheeses like Camembert or Brie, smoked salmon, pork tenderloin with apple glaze, fresh fruit tarts, and shortbread biscuits.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber in appearance with a light, smooth, and easily approachable mouthfeel.

Nose : Distinctively fresh and fruity with a prominent hint of fresh green pear, subtle oak, floral notes, and a touch of sweet malt.

Palate : Smooth and beautifully balanced, featuring characteristic sweet, fruity notes of pear and orchard fruits, turning into subtle butterscotch, cream, malt, and subtle oak spice.

Finish : Long, smooth, and mellow, leaving a sweet and lingering oaky finish.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of water to open up the delicate fruit aromas, or over ice.

glenfiddich-12-year-old-signature-malt-6.title: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old
glenfiddich-12-year-old-signature-malt-6.bodyHtml:

glenfiddich-14-year-old-bourbon-barrel-1.title: Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve
glenfiddich-14-year-old-bourbon-barrel-1.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve is a rich single malt Scotch whisky matured for 14 years in ex-bourbon American oak casks before being finished in deeply charred new American oak barrels from The Kelvin Cooperage in Louisville, Kentucky. This expression seamlessly combines Glenfiddich's classic Speyside orchard fruit character with the bold vanilla, warm oak spice, and sweet caramel notes typically associated with fine Kentucky bourbon.

Food Pairing: Smoked baby back ribs, grilled pork chops with apple glaze, pecan pie, aged cheddar cheese, or bourbon-glazed steak.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber hue with a smooth, velvety, and medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Vibrant aromas of baked apple, ripe pear, sweet vanilla, toasted oak, creamy caramel, and warm baking spices.

Palate : Rich and full-flavored with layers of caramelized apple, sweet vanilla fudge, toasted oak, woody spice, and soft honeyed malt.

Finish : Long, warm, and sweet with lingering notes of crisp oak, sweet vanilla, and subtle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks with a single large ice cube, or with a few drops of water in a Glencairn glass.

glenfiddich-18-year-old-small-batch-1.title: Glenfiddich 18 Year Old Ancient Reserve
glenfiddich-18-year-old-small-batch-1.bodyHtml:
We use fine Spanish Oloroso wood and American oak to mature this rich, intriguingly fruity and robust oak expression, but there are many more reasons why this expression is special.

Every batch is individually numbered and carefully watched over. Each has extraordinary consistency and character from an intense marrying period, and a warming, distinguished finish.

A truly exceptional single malt, the result not just of eighteen years of care and attention, but of whisky-making craft and knowledge passed down through the generations.

glenfiddich-1963-original-1.title: Glenfiddich 1963 Original
glenfiddich-1963-original-1.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 1963 Original is a special-edition Speyside single malt Scotch whisky inspired by Glenfiddich Straight Malt, the distillery's first official single malt bottling, launched in 1963 at a time when malt distilleries made their whisky almost entirely for blending. Malt Master Brian Kinsman recreated that style using the distillery's archives and its collection of historic whisky samples, so this is a tribute to the pioneering bottling rather than whisky distilled in 1963. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The profile is bright and youthful: fruit, flowers and Glenfiddich's signature pear, with soft vanilla oak and a dry finish.

Nose: Fruity and floral with the house hint of pear, light oak and a youthful, biscuity note.

Palate: Gently sweet with lively fruit and soft vanilla oak; a little water brings out delicate spice, citrus and fresh oatcakes.

Finish: Pleasantly dry.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open up the spice and citrus.

glenfiddich-21-year-old-winter-storm.title: Glenfiddich Winter Storm 21 Year Old Icewine Cask Finish Experimental Series 03
glenfiddich-21-year-old-winter-storm.bodyHtml:
For our third experiment, Malt Master Brian Kinsman travelled to Canada to meet a renowned winemaker in Niagara. There he learned how the grapes had to be picked by moonlight at -10?C to produce the intensely sweet Icewine.

Upon his return to the Glenfiddich Distillery Brian started experimenting with several French oak Icewine casks from the Canadian winery, filling them with different Glenfiddich aged malts for up to six months. Only the rarer whiskies, those aged for 21 years, could cope with the extra Icewine intensity.

The taste is a perfect combination of both pioneering liquids, the heightened candied sweets and oakiness of Glenfiddich are complemented by mouth-watering tropical fruit notes and a luscious sweetness from the unique Icewine cask finish.

First released in October 2017, the long-awaited second batch is now available.

glenfiddich-25-year-old-rare-oak.title: Glenfiddich 23 Year Old Grand Cru
glenfiddich-25-year-old-rare-oak.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 23 Year Old Grand Cru is an exclusive single malt Scotch whisky matured for 23 years in American oak and European oak casks before undergoing a finishing period of up to six months in rare French Cuvée oak casks. This secondary maturation imparts an opulent profile of crisp baked pastries, floral fruitiness, and effervescent sweetness that bridges the richness of Speyside malt with the celebratory elegance of French sparkling wine.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh oysters, smoked salmon blinis, caviar, roasted duck breast with spiced cherry reduction, pear and almond tart, and mild artisanal cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden color with brilliant clarity, featuring a velvety, medium-to-full body with a soft and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Freshly baked brioche, sweet apple blossom, candied lemon, ripe pear, vanilla cream, and a touch of white grape sweetness.

Palate : Rich layers of vanilla oak, sweet brioche, poached pear, white peach, sandalwood, and gentle citrus sorbet balanced by delicate baking spice.

Finish : Long, sweet, and crisp with lingering notes of pastry, honeyed apple, and subtle floral oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip-shaped whisky glass, or with a few drops of water to open up the delicate floral aromas and sparkling wine-cask nuances.

glenfiddich-26-year-old-excellence-1.title: Glenfiddich 26 Year Old Excellence
glenfiddich-26-year-old-excellence-1.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 26 Year Old Excellence is a rare, aged Speyside single malt Scotch whisky that spent 26 years maturing in American oak ex-bourbon casks. Glenfiddich created it to honour the unbroken family ownership of the distillery since William Grant founded it in 1887. The long bourbon-cask maturation gives a vibrant yet soft and delicate style, balancing sweetness against dry oak tannin with real depth and complexity. It is bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Soft, delicate and distinctly floral: spring blossom, violets, sweet peas and a light green leafiness.

Palate: Vibrant, balancing dry tannin with soft brown-sugar and vanilla sweetness; deep oak builds with hints of spice and liquorice.

Finish: Deep and complex.

Serve: Neat, allowing time in the glass.

glenfiddich-30-year-old.title: Glenfiddich 23 Year Old Grand Cru
glenfiddich-30-year-old.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 23 Year Old Grand Cru is an exclusive single malt Scotch whisky matured for 23 years in American oak and European oak casks before undergoing a finishing period of up to six months in rare French Cuvée oak casks. This secondary maturation imparts an opulent profile of crisp baked pastries, floral fruitiness, and effervescent sweetness that bridges the richness of Speyside malt with the celebratory elegance of French sparkling wine.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh oysters, smoked salmon blinis, caviar, roasted duck breast with spiced cherry reduction, pear and almond tart, and mild artisanal cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden color with brilliant clarity, featuring a velvety, medium-to-full body with a soft and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Freshly baked brioche, sweet apple blossom, candied lemon, ripe pear, vanilla cream, and a touch of white grape sweetness.

Palate : Rich layers of vanilla oak, sweet brioche, poached pear, white peach, sandalwood, and gentle citrus sorbet balanced by delicate baking spice.

Finish : Long, sweet, and crisp with lingering notes of pastry, honeyed apple, and subtle floral oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip-shaped whisky glass, or with a few drops of water to open up the delicate floral aromas and sparkling wine-cask nuances.

glenfiddich-40-year-old.title: Glenfiddich 23 Year Old Grand Cru
glenfiddich-40-year-old.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 23 Year Old Grand Cru is an exclusive single malt Scotch whisky matured for 23 years in American oak and European oak casks before undergoing a finishing period of up to six months in rare French Cuvée oak casks. This secondary maturation imparts an opulent profile of crisp baked pastries, floral fruitiness, and effervescent sweetness that bridges the richness of Speyside malt with the celebratory elegance of French sparkling wine.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh oysters, smoked salmon blinis, caviar, roasted duck breast with spiced cherry reduction, pear and almond tart, and mild artisanal cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden color with brilliant clarity, featuring a velvety, medium-to-full body with a soft and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Freshly baked brioche, sweet apple blossom, candied lemon, ripe pear, vanilla cream, and a touch of white grape sweetness.

Palate : Rich layers of vanilla oak, sweet brioche, poached pear, white peach, sandalwood, and gentle citrus sorbet balanced by delicate baking spice.

Finish : Long, sweet, and crisp with lingering notes of pastry, honeyed apple, and subtle floral oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip-shaped whisky glass, or with a few drops of water to open up the delicate floral aromas and sparkling wine-cask nuances.

glenfiddich-fire-cane-1.title: Glenfiddich Fire & Cane Experimental Series
glenfiddich-fire-cane-1.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich Fire & Cane is the fourth release in the Speyside distillery's Experimental Series, a single malt Scotch that brings together smoky and sweet. Its roots go back to 2003, when Glenfiddich Malt Master Brian Kinsman first ran peated spirit through the Glenfiddich stills. For Fire & Cane, that peated whisky was married with malts matured side by side in bourbon casks, which carry the distillery's sweet, fruity house style, and the whole vatting was then finished in Latin rum casks for an added layer of caramel and toffee. The result pairs campfire smoke with toffee sweetness. It is a no-age-statement single malt bottled at 43% ABV, offered here in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Gentle peat smoke, toffee and green fruit.

Nose: Soft peat smoke drifting over rich toffee, zesty fresh fruit and spice.

Palate: Campfire peat with oak and toffee, then sharp green fruit, baked apple and gentle smoke.

Finish: Lingering smoke and sweetness.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

glenfiddich-ipa-experiment-1.title: Glenfiddich IPA Experiment
glenfiddich-ipa-experiment-1.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich IPA Experiment was one of the first two releases in Glenfiddich's Experimental Series and is billed as the first single malt finished in casks seasoned with India Pale Ale. Malt Master Brian Kinsman worked with Speyside Craft Brewery, which brewed an IPA specially for the project; the beer rested in Glenfiddich casks for about a month, after which the casks returned to the distillery and were filled with whisky for a three-month finish. Of three brews of different strengths trialled, the team settled on the second. The result is a vibrant, fruity Speyside single malt with a gentle hop edge, bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Fresh green apple, Williams pear and spring blossom, with aromatic hops and fresh herbs.

Palate: Lively citrus zest, then creamy vanilla and a touch of fresh hops.

Finish: Lasting sweetness with an echo of green hops.

Serve: Neat, or over a cube of ice.

glenfiddich-project-xx-1.title: Glenfiddich Project XX
glenfiddich-project-xx-1.bodyHtml:
20 of the whisky industry’s most exceptional minds came together to create this truly unique, pioneering single malt expression.

With its deep golden hue, Project XX embodies the warm, fruity character of a classic Glenfiddich whisky with hints of apple blossom, summer fruits and ripe pear. But its multiple personalities are revealed with hints of sweet candyfloss, cinnamon spice, almonds and rich port tannins with the odd whisper of liquorice. Deep and mellow, the finish is long lasting with a lingering sweet oakiness.

glenglassaugh-octaves-classic-1.title: Glenglassaugh Octaves Classic
glenglassaugh-octaves-classic-1.bodyHtml:
Glenglassaugh Octaves Classic is a rich and complex Highland single malt Scotch whisky produced at the Glenglassaugh Distillery. Crafted from unpeated malt, it is matured in small octave casks—which are approximately one-eighth the size of a standard barrel—allowing for greater wood-to-whisky contact that accelerates maturation and imparts deep oak character, candied fruits, and warm spices.

Food Pairing: Roasted venison, braised pork belly, aged cheddar, pecan pie, or sticky toffee pudding.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber with a full-bodied, smooth, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet honey, candied citrus peel, green apple, toasted oak, vanilla, and dried fruits.

Palate : Rich and fruity with flavors of caramelized orchard fruits, dark honey, toasted almonds, cinnamon, and warm oak spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet malt, oak tannins, and lingering baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of water to reveal deeper fruit notes.

glenglassaugh-octaves-peated-1.title: Glenglassaugh Octaves Peated Batch 2
glenglassaugh-octaves-peated-1.bodyHtml:
Glenglassaugh Octaves Peated Batch 2 is a distinctive Highland single malt Scotch whisky released in 2018. Selected by Master Blender Rachel Barrie, this expression combines peated Glenglassaugh whisky matured in small octave casks reconstructed from bourbon, Port, and Oloroso sherry casks. These approximately 65-litre vessels encourage greater interaction between whisky and oak, developing rich fruit sweetness alongside coastal peat smoke. Bottled at 44% ABV without chill filtration or added colouring, it delivers an intriguing balance of salted caramel, tropical fruit, warming spice, and savoury smoke.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, barbecue pork ribs, grilled lamb, aged cheddar, roasted nuts, dark chocolate, and salted caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes: A balanced combination of coastal peat smoke, tropical fruit, salted caramel, toasted oak, and warming spices.

Nose: Salted caramel shortbread, dark chocolate, mango, burning driftwood, smoked fish, and gentle sea salt.

Palate: Apricot, ginger, mango, yellow plum, smoky bacon, paprika, and maple-smoked oak.

Finish: Long and warming, with roasted nuts, spiced fruit, lingering wood smoke, and salted maple syrup.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature. Add a few drops of water to explore its fruit sweetness and coastal peat character.

glenglassaugh-peated-port-wood-finish-1.title: Glenglassaugh Peated Port Wood Finish
glenglassaugh-peated-port-wood-finish-1.bodyHtml:
Glenglassaugh Peated Port Wood Finish is a distinctive Highland single malt Scotch whisky combining coastal peat smoke with the richness of ruby Port cask maturation. Crafted from peated malted barley and finished in carefully selected Port casks, it reveals layers of juicy red berries, heather honey, dark fruit and warming spice, balanced by sweet smoke and a smooth, complex character.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with smoked duck, barbecue ribs, roasted lamb, dark chocolate, aged cheddar, blue cheese, grilled venison, berry desserts and roasted walnuts.

Tasting Notes: A rich combination of sweet peat smoke, ripe red berries, honey, dark fruit and warming spice, complemented by coastal character and gentle oak tannins.

Nose: Heather honey, fresh red berries and delicate waves of sweet peat smoke.

Palate: Wild berry compote, rich cream, cracked black pepper and sweet campfire smoke, with rounded Port-influenced fruitiness.

Finish: Lingering sweet smoke, dark berries, warming pepper and gentle oak spice.

glenglassaugh-pedro-ximenez-wood-finish-.title: Glenglassaugh Pedro Ximenez Wood Finish
glenglassaugh-pedro-ximenez-wood-finish-.bodyHtml:
Glenglassaugh Pedro Ximenez Wood Finish is a richly textured Coastal Highland single malt Scotch whisky distilled at the historic Glenglassaugh Distillery near Portsoy on the Moray Firth coast in Aberdeenshire, Scotland. Following initial maturation in traditional American oak bourbon casks, the spirit undergoes a secondary finishing period in Pedro Ximénez (PX) sherry butts sourced from Andalusia, Spain. Bottled at 46.0% ABV, non-chill filtered, and at natural colour, this expression marries Glenglassaugh's signature bright, tropical, maritime house character with luscious layers of sun-dried raisins, treacle, dark chocolate, and sweet Mediterranean spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs remarkably well with dark chocolate fondant, sticky toffee pudding, grilled venison loin with blackberry reduction, blue cheeses such as Stilton or Roquefort, spiced fruitcake, or roasted spiced pecans.

Tasting Notes: A decadent, velvety Highland single malt balancing coastal sea-spray freshness with rich, syrupy Pedro Ximénez sherry sweetness, dried figs, and warming baking spices.

Nose: Sumptuous and inviting with aromas of stewed raisins, dark figs, treacle toffee, cacao nibs, and candied orange peel, underpinned by subtle maritime salinity and toasted oak.

Palate: Full-bodied, lush, and mouth-coating on the palate, offering concentrated flavours of Medjool dates, blackberry jam, dark mocha, and honeyed malt, accented by sweet cinnamon, clove, and a gentle coastal mineral note.

Finish: Long, warming, and richly spiced, lingering with sweet sherry-soaked dried fruits, espresso, toasted walnuts, and a whisper of sea salt.

Serve: Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass or tulip tasting snifter to appreciate its full aromatic depth, or with a few drops of spring water to open up its coastal fruit and chocolate nuances.

glenglassaugh-port-wood-finish-1.title: Glenglassaugh Port Wood Finish
glenglassaugh-port-wood-finish-1.bodyHtml:
Glenglassaugh Port Wood Finish is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky released in 2017 as part of the distillery's Wood Finish Series. Initially matured in first-fill American oak casks before receiving a finishing period in Port wine casks, this expression combines Glenglassaugh's coastal character with rich fruit and sweet oak influences. Bottled at 46% ABV without chill filtration or added colouring, it delivers an inviting balance of berries, citrus, toffee, and gentle spice.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate, berry tarts, roasted duck, aged cheddar, caramelized nuts, and dried figs.

Tasting Notes: Fruity and vibrant, combining sweet toffee, fresh berries, citrus zest, herbal oak, and warming spice.

Nose: Brittle toffee, blueberries, garden mint, and gentle allspice.

Palate: Pink grapefruit, blood orange, red berries, caramel, and subtle oak spice.

Finish: Long and crisp, with herbal oak, stewed barley, and lingering citrus.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass or add a few drops of water to explore its fruit and oak character.

glenglassaugh-torfa-peated-1.title: Glenglassaugh Torfa Peated
glenglassaugh-torfa-peated-1.bodyHtml:
Glenglassaugh Torfa is a richly peated Highland single malt Scotch whisky from the Glenglassaugh distillery, launched in 2014 to join Revival and Evolution in the distillery's core range. Its name comes from Old Norse and translates as turf or peat. While most Highland whisky is unpeated, Glenglassaugh produces a small quantity of spirit from barley dried over peat-fired kilns, and Torfa shows that smoky, phenolic side of the distillery. It was matured in ex-bourbon casks and bottled without an age statement at 50% ABV in a 700ml bottle, non-chill filtered and at natural colour.

Nose: Sweet, sooty campfire smoke and sea air with lime zest, apricot jam and soft ripe fruit, warmed by stem ginger and cracked black pepper.

Palate: Sweet coastal peat smoke over candied peel, melon, pineapple and roasted red apple, with oat biscuits, heather honey and cigar-box spice.

Finish: Coastal peat and spiced fruit in an elegant balance.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

glengoyne-12-year-old-2.title: Glengoyne 12 Year Old
glengoyne-12-year-old-2.bodyHtml: The Glengoyne 12-Year-Old is an unpeated Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky, a testament to a production process that prides itself on patience, one of  Scotland’s slowest distillations. Matured for 12 years in hand-selected sherry casks, it has a well-balanced character where fruit and sweetness take center stage without a hint of smoke. At 43% ABV, it is a complex yet approachable dram, certified vegan and sustainably produced.

glengoyne-15-year-old.title: Glengoyne 12 Year Old
glengoyne-15-year-old.bodyHtml: The Glengoyne 12-Year-Old is an unpeated Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky, a testament to a production process that prides itself on patience, one of  Scotland’s slowest distillations. glenkinchie-12-year-old-1.title: Glenkinchie 12 Year Old
glenkinchie-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml: Distilled in Scotland's largest stills this golden dram is fresh with light aromas of orange peel, dried grass, flowers, biscuit and underlying light peat-smoke. Light and elegant with appealing malty sweetness and flavours of oatmeal, cooked fruits and nuts; gentle smokiness melds with sweetness on a lengthy finish.

glenkinchie-distillers-edition-1.title: Glenkinchie 2022 Distillers Edition
glenkinchie-distillers-edition-1.bodyHtml:
Glenkinchie 2022 Distillers Edition is a Lowland single malt Scotch whisky from the distillery known as The Edinburgh Malt, founded in 1837 by farmers George and John Rate some twenty miles from the city. The Distillers Edition series, released annually in limited quantities since 1997, gives each classic malt a second maturation in a cask chosen to suit its character. This edition was first matured in refill American and European oak casks, then finished in re-charred American oak casks seasoned with Amontillado sherry, which adds a nutty, gently dry layer to Glenkinchie's light, grassy style. Bottled at 43% ABV; this listing is the 750ml bottle.

Nose: Crisp and complex, balancing dry wine notes with sweeter, nutty notes of barley and cask wood.

Palate: Lightly oily and malty-sweet, then spicy with raisin and date; creamy and lightly grapey, drying with wood spice.

Finish: Very long, drying and oaky, with a light white-pepper spice.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

glenlivet-12-year-old-double-oak.title: The Glenlivet 12 Year Old 1.75L
glenlivet-12-year-old-double-oak.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 12 Year Old is a classic single malt Scotch whisky crafted at The Glenlivet Distillery in Moray, Scotland. Matured in a combination of traditional oak and American oak casks, it is renowned for its smooth, well-balanced character, featuring distinct notes of summer fruit, floral honey, and subtle vanilla.

Food Pairing: Seared scallops, roasted chicken, mild creamy cheeses like Brie, or lemon tart.

Tasting Notes : Bright, pale gold with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic and delicate with notes of fresh green apple, ripe pineapple, citrus, floral blossoms, and sweet vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of sweet malt, juicy peach, pear, honey, and subtle oak spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and warm with lingering notes of sweet fruit and gentle oak.

Serve : Serve neat, with a splash of cool water, or over a large ice cube.

glenlivet-15-year-old-french-oak-reserve.title: The Glenlivet 15 Year Old French Oak Reserve
glenlivet-15-year-old-french-oak-reserve.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet French Oak Reserve 15 Year Old is a rich, exotic single malt Scotch whisky that showcases the mastery of French oak cask maturation. This expression is uniquely finished in French Limousin oak—the same type of wood often used for aging Cognac—which imparts distinctive flavors of sweet fruits and delicate spice. It is an elegant, well-structured, and creamy whisky that perfectly balances the classic Glenlivet orchard fruit character with deeper, wood-driven complexity.

Food Pairing: This rich and spicy single malt pairs exceptionally well with full-flavored venison dishes or roasted meats. It also beautifully complements strong, mature cheeses such as aged cheddar or rich blue cheese.

Food Pairing: Roasted venison, grilled pork chops, pan-seared duck breast, aged Gruyère cheese, creme brûlée, and apple tart.

Tasting Notes : Deep, warm gold in appearance with a smooth, velvety, and well-rounded texture on the palate.

Nose : Creamy and rich with aromas of buttery fudge, ripe citrus, toasted oak, and a subtle touch of floral sweetness.

Palate : Round and smooth with sweet, fruity flavors of winter spice, cinnamon, cloves, ripe pears, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long and warming with lingering notes of sweet oak and gentle pepper spice.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature, or with a few drops of pure water to open up the spice and oak aromas.

glenlivet-18-year-old-batch-reserve.title: The Glenlivet 18 Year Old Batch Reserve
glenlivet-18-year-old-batch-reserve.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 18 Year Old Batch Reserve is an incredibly elegant and deeply complex Speyside single malt, long considered a gold standard for aged Scotch whisky. Master Distiller Alan Winchester expertly oversees the maturation process, utilizing a carefully calibrated combination of first- and second-fill American oak (ex-bourbon) and European oak (ex-sherry) casks. This specific cask maturation imparts a beautiful harmony between the tropical, vanilla-forward notes of the American oak and the rich, spicy fruitcake characteristics of the European oak. The result is a beautifully balanced, award-winning whisky that delivers a luxurious symphony of ripe orchard fruits, sweet toffee, and delicate winter spice.

Food Pairing: Seared scallops, roasted venison, aged gouda or cheddar, rich fruitcake, and dark chocolate-dipped candied orange peels.

Tasting Notes : Rich old gold with apricot hues in appearance, delivering a remarkably smooth, velvety, and well-rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich and deeply aromatic, featuring elegant notes of sweet toffee, ripe pear, dried apricot, baked apple, and subtle hints of fragrant oak and floral blossom.

Palate : Beautifully balanced and luxurious, bursting with flavors of sweet orange, ripe orchard fruits, rich raisins, and chewy fudge, perfectly complemented by warming winter spices and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, lingering, and elegantly dry, leaving warming notes of sweet citrus, gentle baking spice, and a whisper of raisin.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or with a single drop of water to further unlock its intricate floral and fruity aromatics.

glenlivet-21-year-old-1.title: The Glenlivet 21 Year Old The Sample Room Collection
glenlivet-21-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 21 Year Old 'The Sample Room Collection' is an extraordinarily complex and luxurious single malt Scotch whisky that marks a sophisticated evolution of the distillery’s classic 21-year-old expression. Matured for more than two decades, this precious liquid is finished in a unique combination of three distinct cask types: first-fill Oloroso sherry, fine-grained Tronçais oak Cognac, and vintage Colheita port casks. This intricate triple-cask finish flawlessly elevates The Glenlivet's iconic smooth and fruity house style, weaving in unprecedented layers of deep dark fruits, exotic warming spices, and a refined, velvety richness.

Food Pairing: This deeply layered and opulent single malt pairs beautifully with rich, savory dishes like roasted duck breast with a berry reduction or pan-seared venison. It is also an exquisite companion to premium dark chocolate truffles or a mature cheese board featuring robust blue cheeses like Stilton or Gorgonzola.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber with rich copper highlights and a luxurious, velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic and complex with layers of ripe peaches, caramelized pears, dark plum, grated nutmeg, and rich oak spice.

Palate : Rich and syrupy with flavors of juicy sultanas, chocolate-coated ginger, dried apricot, baked apples, and toasted Troncais oak.

Finish : Long, rich, and warming with lingering notes of sweet spice and dark fruit.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a single drop of water to open up the aromas.

glenlivet-25-year-old.title: The Glenlivet 12 Year Old 1.75L
glenlivet-25-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 12 Year Old is a classic single malt Scotch whisky crafted at The Glenlivet Distillery in Moray, Scotland. Matured in a combination of traditional oak and American oak casks, it is renowned for its smooth, well-balanced character, featuring distinct notes of summer fruit, floral honey, and subtle vanilla.

Food Pairing: Seared scallops, roasted chicken, mild creamy cheeses like Brie, or lemon tart.

Tasting Notes : Bright, pale gold with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic and delicate with notes of fresh green apple, ripe pineapple, citrus, floral blossoms, and sweet vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of sweet malt, juicy peach, pear, honey, and subtle oak spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and warm with lingering notes of sweet fruit and gentle oak.

glenlivet-bridge-of-cally-1.title: The Glenlivet Bridge of Cally
glenlivet-bridge-of-cally-1.bodyHtml: The Glenlivet Bridge of Cally is a limited single cask edition from The Glenlivet distillery in Speyside, one of the distillery's named single cask releases. Drawn from a single cask and bottled at a robust 59.4% ABV, it shows the Speyside single malt at full strength. 750ml. Add a few drops of water to open it up.

glenlivet-captains-reserve-cognac-cask-s.title: The Glenlivet 14 Year Old Cognac Cask Selection
glenlivet-captains-reserve-cognac-cask-s.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 14 Year Old Cognac Cask Selection Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a ground-breaking and highly innovative Speyside single malt that brings a unique twist to a historic distillery's signature style. It is selectively matured in traditional American oak and Sherry casks for fourteen years before being finished for at least six months in high-quality ex-Cognac casks. This specialized finishing process beautifully layers sweet, fruity, and spicy French cognac influences over the classic, smooth, and floral honeyed character of The Glenlivet. The result is a wonderfully rich, inviting, and highly accessible dram that seamlessly bridges the worlds of Scottish distilling and French cognac craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rich chocolate-dipped raisins, warm apple pie, baked brie, caramelized pecan tarts, or slow-cooked duck breast with orange glaze.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance, offering a smooth, velvety, and well-balanced mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet and fruit-forward with aromas of ripe pears, cooked apples, honey, creamy milk chocolate, and subtle sultanas.

Palate : Rich and luscious with flavors of sweet raisins, poached pears, warm cinnamon, honeyed citrus, and gentle oak spice.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warm with lingering notes of sweet spice, dried fruit, and rich oak.

Serve : Best served neat in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of water to release its fruit and spice aromatics, or on the rocks.

glenlivet-caribbean-reserve-1.title: The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve
glenlivet-caribbean-reserve-1.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve is a smooth single malt Scotch whisky produced by The Glenlivet Distillery. A portion of the whisky is finished in casks that previously held Caribbean rum, infusing the distillery's signature fruity Speyside style with tropical sweetness and rich vanilla notes.

Food Pairing: Grilled pork chops with mango salsa, jerk chicken, coconut shrimp, pineapple upside-down cake, and mild creamy cheeses like Brie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber gold in appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and tropical with aromas of ripe banana, sweet pear, red apple, caramel, and subtle brown sugar.

Palate : Smooth and rich, delivering upfront flavors of juicy tropical fruits, sweet red apple, honey, and toasted coconut balanced by soft vanilla.

Finish : Well-balanced and smooth with a lingering tropical fruit sweetness and gentle oak warmth.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed with coconut water or ginger ale in a tropical twist cocktail.

glenlivet-founders-reserve-american-oak-.title: The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve 1.75L
glenlivet-founders-reserve-american-oak-.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve is an exceptionally smooth, bright, and approachable Speyside single malt Scotch whisky created as a tribute to the distillery's pioneering founder, George Smith. To capture the signature fruitiness and elegant character of the original 1824 expression, this non-age-statement malt is distilled in The Glenlivet's classic lantern-shaped copper pot stills. The spirit is then matured in a combination of traditional oak casks alongside a high proportion of first-fill American white oak ex-bourbon barrels. This specialized wood selection infuses the whisky with creamy vanilla sweetness and subtle tropical undertones, making it a highly accessible and delightfully smooth dram for both newcomers and seasoned whisky enthusiasts alike.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light lemon tarts, creamy brie or Camembert cheeses, roasted chicken with herbs, or a traditional vanilla panna cotta.

Tasting Notes : Pale gold in color with a smooth, light, and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Citrus fruit, sweet orange, pear, zesty lime, and a hint of delicate oak.

Palate : Smooth and creamy with flavors of sweet orange, pear, red apple, toffee, and subtle vanilla.

Finish : Long, smooth, and clean with lingering oak warmth and gentle fruit sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, over ice, or with a few drops of water.

glenlivet-nadurra-first-fill-1.title: The Glenlivet Nadurra First Fill
glenlivet-nadurra-first-fill-1.bodyHtml: The Glenlivet Nadurra First Fill Selection belongs to Nadurra, Gaelic for 'natural', The Glenlivet's small-batch range made using traditional techniques. This Speyside single malt is drawn entirely from first-fill American white oak casks, never before used to mature Scotch whisky, which give it a creamy vanilla richness. It is bottled at cask strength, 59.8% ABV, without chill filtration, for a full and textured dram. 750ml. A few drops of water will open it up.

glenlivet-nadurra-oloroso-1.title: The Glenlivet Nadurra Peated Whisky Cask Finish
glenlivet-nadurra-oloroso-1.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet Nàdurra Peated Whisky Cask Finish is a bold Speyside single malt Scotch whisky that brings a smoky twist to Glenlivet's signature fruity character. Initially matured in American oak ex-bourbon barrels before finishing in casks previously used for heavily peated Scotch whisky, this cask-strength expression combines creamy vanilla, orchard fruits, warming spices, and gentle smoke. Bottled without chill filtration, it offers a rich and distinctive interpretation of traditional Speyside whisky.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, grilled pork, aged cheddar, roasted almonds, dark chocolate, and caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes: A rich, creamy single malt combining sweet orchard fruits, vanilla, citrus, and gentle peat smoke.

Nose: Honey, green apple, citrus zest, vanilla cream, and delicate smoke.

Palate: Creamy toffee, caramel, ripe orchard fruits, warm spices, and subtle peaty undertones.

Finish: Long and warming, with lingering oak spice, toffee, and gentle smoky notes.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass or add a few drops of water to soften the cask strength and reveal additional fruit and spice.

glenlivet-nadurra-peated-1.title: The Glenlivet Nàdurra Peated Whisky Cask Finish
glenlivet-nadurra-peated-1.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet Nàdurra Peated Whisky Cask Finish is a cask-strength Speyside single malt from The Glenlivet distillery, bottled here at 61.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Launched in 2015 as the third expression in the Nàdurra range, it was the first of the series with a smoky edge: the whisky is finished in American oak casks that previously held heavily peated Scotch, which lays a gentle, aromatic smoke over the distillery's smooth and fruity house style. The idea looks back to founder George Smith, who dried his malted barley over peat smoke. Like the rest of the range it is bottled in small batches without chill-filtration, and the label of this release carries batch number PW0715. Nàdurra is the Gaelic word for natural.

Tasting Notes: Red apple, citrus zest, vanilla cream and gentle smoke.

Nose: Red apple and citrus zest with aromatic smoke.

Palate: Tangy marmalade and creamy vanilla, with a soft smokiness running through.

Finish: Long and complex, with spice.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up at cask strength.

glenlivet-sherry-butt-cask.title: Signatory Vintage Cask Strength Collection Glenlivet 2006 19 Year Old 1st Fill Oloroso Sherry Butt Cask 901018 58.7% ABV
glenlivet-sherry-butt-cask.bodyHtml:
Signatory Vintage The Glenlivet 2006 is an independently bottled Speyside single malt Scotch whisky showcasing the character of The Glenlivet Distillery through the cask selection of Signatory Vintage. Distilled in 2006 and bottled at an impressive 58.7% ABV, this expression offers a bold, concentrated interpretation of Glenlivet's celebrated single malt spirit. Its high bottling strength makes it particularly appealing to whisky enthusiasts who enjoy exploring mature Scotch whisky at full intensity, with the option of adding a few drops of water to uncover further aromatic complexity. An intriguing addition to any collection of independently bottled Speyside single malts.

Food Pairing: Enjoy alongside mature cheddar, aged Gouda, roasted walnuts, dried apricots, dark chocolate or fruitcake. Rich caramel desserts and orange-infused pastries are also appealing accompaniments.

Tasting Notes: A high-strength Speyside single malt with a concentrated character. The precise balance of fruit, sweetness, spice and oak depends on the specific cask used for this release.

Nose: The exact-release aromatic profile has not been independently verified. Allow the whisky to rest in the glass and explore its aromas neat before adding water.

Palate: Bottled at 58.7% ABV for an intense tasting experience. A small addition of water may reveal further nuances of the individual cask.

Finish: The exact-release finish has not been independently verified and may vary with the maturation cask.

glenlivet-single-cask-davoch-1.title: The Glenlivet 12 Year Old
glenlivet-single-cask-davoch-1.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 12 Year Old is a classic single malt Scotch whisky crafted at The Glenlivet Distillery in Moray, Scotland. Matured in a combination of traditional oak and American oak casks, it is renowned for its smooth, well-balanced character, featuring distinct notes of summer fruit, floral honey, and subtle vanilla.

Food Pairing: Seared scallops, roasted chicken, mild creamy cheeses like Brie, or lemon tart.

Tasting Notes : Bright, pale gold with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic and delicate with notes of fresh green apple, ripe pineapple, citrus, floral blossoms, and sweet vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of sweet malt, juicy peach, pear, honey, and subtle oak spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and warm with lingering notes of sweet fruit and gentle oak.

Serve : Serve neat, with a splash of cool water, or over a large ice cube.

glenlivet-spectra-1.title: Signatory Vintage Cask Strength Collection Glenlivet 2006 19 Year Old 1st Fill Oloroso Sherry Butt Cask 901018 58.7% ABV

glenmorangie-10-year-old-the-original.title: Glenmorangie 'The Original' 12 Year Old
glenmorangie-10-year-old-the-original.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie 'The Original' 12 Year Old is the recently upgraded flagship single malt from the renowned Highland distillery, elegantly replacing its classic 10-year-old predecessor. Distilled in Scotland's tallest copper stills—which ensure only the lightest, purest vapors reach the condenser—this delicate spirit is then aged for a full 12 years in a combination of first- and second-fill American white oak ex-bourbon casks. The additional two years of maturation deepen its signature creamy complexity, resulting in a supremely smooth, approachable, and fruit-forward whisky that perfectly balances vibrant citrus, sweet peach, and rich vanilla.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, seared scallops, soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert, lemon tart, peach cobbler, or vanilla panna cotta.

Tasting Notes : Bright, pale lemon gold in appearance with a soft, creamy, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and highly fragrant, bursting with vibrant aromas of mandarin orange, ripe peach, sweet vanilla bean, and delicate floral notes.

Palate : Creamy and elegant, delivering a luscious wave of rich vanilla, sweet honey, and zesty orange citrus, perfectly intertwined with ripe stone fruit and a gentle whisper of warming baking spice.

Finish : Clean, medium-length, and highly refreshing, leaving a lingering sweetness of peach, orange peel, and soft oak vanilla.

Serve : Serve neat, with a few drops of water to open up the floral aromatics, or poured over ice with premium soda water for a classic Highball.

glenmorangie-10-year-old-the-original-gi.title: Glenmorangie 10 Year Old Original Giraffe Pack
glenmorangie-10-year-old-the-original-gi.bodyHtml:
The original expression of our elegant, floral spirit and the real backbone of the Glenmorangie range. A ten-year-old single malt, Glenmorangie Original is produced by marrying the delicate spirit that emerges from Scotland's tallest stills, with first and second fill American white oak casks.

It is here, maturing for ten long years in a range of ex-bourbon casks such as our famous slow-grown and air-dried 'designer casks' from Missouri, that our raw spirit develops a perfect balance between sweetness and complexity. Resulting in a mature spirit that is soft, mellow and creamy. Perfect for enjoying at any time.

glenmorangie-10-year-old-the-original-gl.title: Glenmorangie The Original 12 Year Old Gift Pack with 2 Glasses
glenmorangie-10-year-old-the-original-gl.bodyHtml:
Gift set includes one 750ml bottle of Glenmorangie and two rocks glasses.

glenmorangie-14-year-old-quinta-ruban-1.title: Glenmorangie The Quinta Ruban 14 Year Old
glenmorangie-14-year-old-quinta-ruban-1.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie 14 Year Old The Quinta Ruban is a bold and velvety single malt Scotch whisky that stands as a testament to the art of wood finishing. The spirit is first aged for 10 years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks to establish a foundation of smooth, creamy vanilla notes. It is then transferred into hand-selected ruby port pipes and casks from the renowned Quinta wine estates of Portugal for a further four years of finishing. This extensive secondary maturation transforms the whisky into a dark, decadent dram with aromas of mandarin orange, dark chocolate, mint, and a touch of nutmeg. On the palate, a thick, voluptuous texture unfolds with flavors of rich walnut, dark chocolate-covered berries, Turkish delight, and sweet wood spice. The finish is long, silky, and deeply satisfying, leaving behind lingering traces of dark chocolate and orange zest.

Food Pairing The dark chocolate and rich fruit notes of this port-finished expression make it an spectacular match for desserts like a flourless chocolate torte, raspberry tart, or dark chocolate mousse. It also pairs wonderfully with savory dishes such as pan-seared venison with a blackberry reduction, roasted lamb chops, or a plate of rich blue cheeses like Stilton or Roquefort.

glenmorangie-15-year-old-cadboll-1.title: Glenmorangie The Lasanta 15 Year Old
glenmorangie-15-year-old-cadboll-1.bodyHtml:
“With its rich spice and luscious sweetness, Glenmorangie Lasanta is a whisky that elicits the radiant wonder of sunset and has been a favourite of Glenmorangie fans for some time. Now aged for 15 years in an enhanced selection of bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks, we’ve introduced even more complex and elegant notes to this whisky, all working together in delicious balance.” - Dr Bill Lumsden

Glenmorangie The Lasanta 15 Year Old is the newly enhanced version of the distillery’s core sherried expression, which was upgraded from a 12-year to a 15-year age statement in 2025. This Highland single malt is first matured for 10 years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before undergoing a five-year finishing period in a combination of Oloroso and Pedro Ximénez sherry casks. The extra three years of maturation compared to the original version provide a more profound depth of flavour and a noticeably richer, more integrated texture.
On the nose, it delivers an inviting and warm bouquet of spiced honey, raisins, and toasted hazelnuts, accented by notes of beeswax and honeycomb. The palate is velvety and full-bodied, showcasing layers of dark chocolate, toffee, and sun-dried sultanas, all balanced by warming baking spices like cinnamon and clove. The finish is long and elegant, leaving a lingering impression of Seville orange marmalade, sweet dates, and a soft, nutty oakiness.

glenmorangie-18-year-old-extremely-rare-.title: Glenmorangie The Infinita 18 Year Old
glenmorangie-18-year-old-extremely-rare-.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie 18 Year Old 'The Infinita' is a prestigious Highland single malt Scotch whisky matured for 15 years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before a portion is transferred to Spanish Oloroso sherry casks for an additional 3 years. Re-imagined under the name 'The Infinita' (formerly known simply as Glenmorangie 18 Year Old Extremely Rare), this expression combines Glenmorangie's signature tall-still delicate citrus floral character with complex layers of dried fruits, warm spice, and nutty sherry richness.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck with orange glaze, pan-seared scallops, dark chocolate tarts, or aged cheeses like Comté or Gouda.

Tasting Notes : Luminous honeyed gold hue with a silky, smooth, and velvety body on the palate.

Nose : Rich dried fruits, ripe figs, caramelized orange peel, sweet jasmine floral aromas, honeycomb, and gentle vanilla oak.

Palate : Vibrant and balanced with layers of sweet dried fruit, candied orange peel, toasted almonds, creamy honey, and soft wood spice.

Finish : Long, delicate, and elegant with persistent sweet floral notes, dried fruit sweetness, and lingering oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

glenmorangie-allta.title: Glenmorangie Allta Private Edition No. 10
glenmorangie-allta.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie Allta is a limited-edition single malt released to mark the 10th anniversary of Glenmorangie’s Private Edition series. The yeasty, biscuit-y nose gives way to an archetypal Glenmorangie palate rich with floral flavours and zesty citrus, augmented by notes of freshly-baked bread, a light menthol freshness and a long, earthy finish.

Allta, which means ‘wild’ in Scots Gaelic, is made using a previously-undiscovered strain of local yeast growing on the barley near the Glenmorangie distillery. This yeast has been used to ferment the barley on which it grew before distillation, lending the spirit not only a distinctive flavour, but an undeniable sense of place.

glenmorangie-la-santa-12-year-old.title: Glenmorangie The Lasanta 12 Year Old
glenmorangie-la-santa-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Rich and full-bodied, our signature expression is first aged in American oak ex-bourbon casks for smoothness. We then finish this single malt whisky in hand-selected Oloroso and Pedro Xim?nez sherry casks.

Sourced from Jerez in Spain, the sherry casks bring rich raisin intensity, toffee and spices to Glenmorangie's renowned smooth style, enjoyed and awarded across the world.

glenmorangie-nectar-dor-1.title: Glenmorangie The Nectar D'Or Sauternes Cask Finish
glenmorangie-nectar-dor-1.bodyHtml: The creation of Nectar d’Or involves a 10-year maturation period in American white-oak casks. From here, the blend is moved over to hand-selected wine barriques from Sauternes for two years of extra-maturation, where it is infused with rich, spicy and pastry-like flavours. As a finishing touch, the whisky is non-chill filtered to develop additional character and mouthfeel.

glenmorangie-signet-1.title: Glenmorangie Signet
glenmorangie-signet-1.bodyHtml:
The Signet is a blend of Glenmorangie’s oldest and rarest whiskies - distilled over thirty years ago and matured in a selection of the world’s finest casks, undoubtedly the richest whisky in the Glenmorangie range. Boasting melting sweetness and explosive spiciness thanks to the use of roasted ‘chocolate’ barley malt and ‘designer’ American white oak casks made especially for Glenmorangie. Crowned Whisky of the Year at the International Whisky Competition, gaining the highest score, 97 points out of a possible 100.

A fusion of unique and rare elements, and clouded in secrecy, Signet is the culmination of a lifetime’s experience. A blend of our oldest whisky and spirit matured in a selection of the world’s finest casks, this undoubtedly is the richest whisky in our range.

Of course, whilst the exact secrets of its production are known only to our whisky creators, we can tell you that Signet’s melting sweetness and explosive spiciness is, at least in part, caused by our unique roasted ‘chocolate’ barley malt and the ‘designer casks’ made bespoke for Glenmorangie from American white oak. Non chill-filtered

glenmorangie-spios.title: Glenmorangie A Tale of Spices
glenmorangie-spios.bodyHtml:
Travelling the world in search of extraordinary casks to bring new flavours to Glenmorangie, Dr Bill has always been drawn to spice markets, with their fragrant aromas and rainbow hues.

Envisioning a whisky infused with such variety, he and Master Blender Gillian Macdonald experimented by finishing bourbon-aged Glenmorangie in four different types of cask for the first time.

Never used before at Glenmorangie, Moroccan red wine casks crafted from French oak give this creation mouth-watering layers of sweet spice. New charred oak casks add another spicy dimension. Shaved, toasted red wine casks offer nuanced, fruity notes. Pedro Ximénez sherry casks bring rich, sweet depths.

From this unusual cask combination comes a uniquely complex Glenmorangie – perfumed, sweet, and spicy. A Tale of Spices brims with sweet spice, floral notes of rose and jasmine are lifted by sugar-coated almonds and a distinct eucalyptus note.

glenmorangie-taster-gift-pack.title: Glenmorangie The Original 12 Year Old Gift Pack with 2 Glasses

Gift set includes one 750ml bottle of Glenmorangie and two rocks glasses.
