glenrothes-12-year-old-1.title: The Glen Grant 12 Year Old
glenrothes-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
The Glen Grant 12 Year Old is a remarkably bright, elegant, and award-winning single malt Scotch whisky that beautifully showcases the classic, fruit-forward style of the Speyside region. Crafted at the historic Rothes distillery under the long-standing guidance of legendary Master Distiller Dennis Malcolm, this expression is distilled using the distillery's famously tall, slender pot stills equipped with unique cooling purifiers. This distinctive design captures only the lightest, most delicate vapors during distillation. Matured for a full dozen years exclusively in high-quality ex-bourbon casks, the resulting spirit balances Speyside's signature orchard fruit character with rich layers of vanilla and oak, offering a highly approachable yet sophisticated dram.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken or pork medallions with an apple glaze, light creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert, smoked salmon crostini, or lemon curd tarts.

Tasting Notes : A bright, polished golden straw color with a light-to-medium body and an exceptionally clean, crisp, and silky texture on the palate.

Nose : Fresh, vibrant, and orchard-forward, opening with distinct aromas of ripe green apples, honeyed pears, and citrus zest, beautifully complemented by notes of vanilla fudge, toasted almonds, and a light herbal undertone.

Palate : Soft and highly balanced on the tongue, delivering dominant flavors of sweet caramel, vanilla cream, and apple pie spice, layered with subtle hints of rich malt, honey, and soft oak tannins.

Finish : Medium in length, clean, and pleasantly dry, resolving smoothly with lingering notes of warm wood spice, soft vanilla, and a trailing hint of citrus fruit.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat or with a tiny splash of pure spring water in a classic Glencairn glass at room temperature, or served over a single large ice cube to enhance its bright fruit notes.

glenrothes-vintage-reserve.title: Signatory Vintage Glenrothes 2014 10 Year Old 100 Proof Edition #20

glenrothes-whisky-makers-cut-1.title: The Glenrothes Whisky Maker's Cut
glenrothes-whisky-makers-cut-1.bodyHtml: Appears pale golden brown with amber glints. Rich aromas of cinnamon, tangerine, and toffee are present. The silky smooth palate imparts flavours of toffee, orange marmalade, cinnamon and nutmeg. Peat and spice notes surface on the lingering finish. Serve on the rocks with smoked duck breast or butterscotch pecan tart.

godiva-white-chocolate-liquor.title: McGuinness Crème de Cacao White Liqueur
godiva-white-chocolate-liquor.bodyHtml:
McGuinness Crème de Cacao White is a clear chocolate liqueur from the McGuinness range of Canadian liqueurs, made in Quebec by Corby Spirit and Wine. Colourless in the glass, it offers sweet cocoa aromas and a thick, sweet chocolate flavour, and it is a staple ingredient in dessert-style cocktails where a dark liqueur would muddy the colour. Bottled at 15% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is the classic choice for a Grasshopper, a Brandy Alexander, a White Chocolate Martini or a Pink Squirrel.

Tasting Notes: Clear and colourless; sweet cocoa aromas; thick, sweet chocolate flavour.

Serve: In dessert cocktails such as a Grasshopper or Brandy Alexander.

golden-pear-hungaria.title: Golden Pear Liqueur Monimpex
golden-pear-hungaria.bodyHtml:
Golden Pear Liqueur is a pear liqueur from Hungary, listed in Alberta under the Monimpex name and supplied by Zwack Unicum. The label carries the Hungaria name and describes the contents as a pear liqueur (poire). It is bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml round flask-style bottle. The liqueur has a sweet pear flavour, delicate aromas and a deep golden colour.

Food Pairing: Pear desserts.

Tasting Notes: Sweet pear with delicate aromas and a deep golden colour.

Serve: Chilled.

goldeneye-pinot-noir-2017.title: Goldeneye Anderson Valley Pinot Noir 2022
goldeneye-pinot-noir-2017.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Goldeneye Anderson Valley Pinot Noir is a gorgeous, beautifully structured red wine that captures the rustic elegance and regional diversity of its ocean-cooled terroir. Combining fruit from warmer estate vineyards with grapes from the cooler deep end of the valley, it bridges dense fruit concentration with refreshing, balanced acidity. The wine opens with a classic bouquet of ripe red cherry, red tea, cinnamon, and a delicate hint of chanterelle mushrooms. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied and silky, delivering concentrated flavours of wild strawberries, blood orange zest, and savory leather supported by subtle oak nuances and light, smooth tannins. Sourced from premium estate sites including Confluence, Gowan Creek, and Split Rail, it undergoes small-lot, open-top fermentation before aging for 16 months in 100% French oak barrels (48% new) to craft an incredibly polished finish.

Food Pairing: Perfectly pairs with roasted duck breast, herb-crusted pork loin, wild mushroom risotto, grilled salmon steaks, roasted turkey club sandwiches, or mild cheeses like Brie and Camembert.

92 Points - James Suckling

A pretty wine with classic flavors and an elegant texture. Aromas of red tea, cherries, black tea and cinnamon lead to a silky palate of red cherries, strawberries and a touch of rhubarb. Light tannins, a full body and subtle oak nuances, even though more than 40% of the French barrels the wine aged in were new.

gooderham-worts.title: Gooderham & Worts Four Grain Canadian Whisky
gooderham-worts.bodyHtml:
Gooderham & Worts Four Grain Canadian Whisky is a blend built on four grains: corn, rye, wheat and barley. Part of the Corby Spirit and Wine portfolio of Canadian whiskies and listed as a product of Ontario, it carries the name of the historic Gooderham & Worts distillery, with 1832 marked on the label. It is bottled at 44.4% ABV in a 750ml bottle and pours a golden amber.

Nose: Honey, toffee, dried flowers and bubble gum.

Palate: Rich and viscous, with sweet floral and stone-fruit flavours.

Finish: Medium in length, with spice.

Serve: Neat, over ice or in classic whisky cocktails.

gooderham-worts-11-souls.title: Gooderham & Worts Eleven Souls
gooderham-worts-11-souls.bodyHtml: William Gooderham and James Worts, brothers in law from Suffolk, England, arrived in Canada in 1832 as part of a large family migration, including 11 children whose parents had passed away during the arduous journey across the sea. . Before all of their success and fame in being the original ?Whisky Barons? of Canada, William Gooderham decided to adopt all 11 orphans and raise them as his own on their arrival to Canada. . This blend of whisky created celebrates that unity by bringing together 11 different casks into one beautiful whisky. It?s an ode to this amazing act of kindness, we hope you enjoy it as much as we do! . Gooderham and Worts 11 Souls. . 11 different bonds of whisky. . Rye, rye malt, barley, barley malt, brasetto rye, corn, wheat. . Pot distilled spirits, column distilled spirits, double column distilled spirits. . 85% of the blend is at least 17 years old, in fact we put in some 22 year. . New oak casks, ex Bourbon casks, Canadian Whisky Casks. . And bottled at 49% abv, the address of Gooderham & Worts Distillery is 49 Wellington, Toronto, Ontario.

gordons-london-dry-gin-2.title: Gordon's London Dry Gin 1.14L
gordons-london-dry-gin-2.bodyHtml:
Gordon's London Dry Gin 1.14L is the classic juniper-led gin behind countless gin and tonics, bottled at 40% ABV. Gordon's was founded in London in 1769 by Alexander Gordon, who set out to make a gin worthy of his family name, and the boar's head on every bottle recalls a Gordon clan legend of saving the King of Scotland from a wild boar. The Gordon's London Dry spirit is grain neutral spirit distilled with juniper berries, coriander seed, angelica root and liquorice, and its distinctive juniper character has come to define the classic gin and tonic. This bottling is produced in Canada, in Ontario. Crisp and dry, it opens with fresh citrus and keeps juniper at its core, making it a dependable choice for the G&T, the martini and other gin classics.

Nose: Fresh, immediate citrus.

Palate: Dry, with citrus and lemon coming through first.

Serve: Over ice with tonic water and a wedge of lime, or stirred into a classic dry martini.

goslings-black-seal-rum-1.title: Goslings Black Seal Rum
goslings-black-seal-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Goslings Black Seal is a dark rum from Bermuda, bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) in a 750ml bottle; the label calls it Bermuda Black Rum. The producer explains that the blend includes distillates from both pot stills and continuous stills, which it credits for the rum's nuanced character. It follows a Gosling family recipe more than 150 years old, is aged in charred American oak casks, has been exported to the United States since 1980 and is now Bermuda's largest export product. It is the rum used in the Dark 'n Stormy, the trademarked Bermudian cocktail made with Goslings Stormy Ginger Beer and a lime garnish. The colour is a dark copper mahogany.

Tasting Notes: Dark copper mahogany; rich and intricate, with sweet spice, stewed fruit and vanilla.

Nose: Fruitcake, herbs and spice, butterscotch, banana and vanilla.

Palate: Rich and well balanced, with thick sweet spices, stewed fruits and vanilla.

Finish: Spicy, crisp and tingling.

Serve: In a Dark 'n Stormy: fill a tall glass with ice, pour in 6 oz ginger beer and float 2 oz Black Seal on top, with a lime wedge.

gran-orendain-anejo.title: Gran Orendain Anejo Tequila
gran-orendain-anejo.bodyHtml:
Gran Orendain Añejo is aged for 20 months in French oak barrels. Smooth on the palate, intense flavor with aromas of cooked agave, caramel, chocolate, vanilla and coffee. In the mouth, similar flavours of agave, chocolate, vanilla, and coffee, with great body and mouthfeel generated through its long aging process. To be enjoyed neat in a snifter or Riedel tequila glass, or on the rocks.

Awards: 2013 Beverage Tasting Institute – Silver Medal; 2015 Spirits Selection by Concours Mondial de Bruxelles – Gold Medal

gran-orendain-blanco.title: Gran Orendain Blanco Tequila
gran-orendain-blanco.bodyHtml:
Triple-distilled, 100% Blue Agave Gran Orendain Blanco is rested in stainless steel before bottling 40% ABV. This tequila truly smells like the rich aroma of baking agaves that you smell when you enter the town of Tequila, Jalisco for the first time – it makes you relive that experience every time you pour yourself a glass! On the palate, smooth and pure agave taste combined with herbs and mint aromas. To be enjoyed neat, on the rocks or in ultra-premium margaritas or other cocktails. A true “old school” tequila that smells and tastes like the best tequilas from 100 years ago.

Awards: 2015 Spirits Selection by Concours Mondial de Bruxelles – Grand Gold Medal

gran-orendain-extra-anejo-3-year.title: Gran Orendain Extra Anejo 3 Year Old Tequila
gran-orendain-extra-anejo-3-year.bodyHtml:
This gorgeous Extra Añejo is aged for 40 months or more in French oak barrels before bottling at 40% ABV. A rich, golden amber color with aromas of honeyed spice cake, toasted meringue, peppers, and dried fruits. On the palate, a silky mouthfeel, dry-yet-fruity at the outset, medium-to-full body, and a long and warming cola, peppery, vanilla toffee, and mineral accented finish. A beautiful sipping anejo excellent on its own or paired with a fine cigar.

Accolades: Total Wines - “Rich and full-bodied with intense cooked agave, wood, and herbal notes. Vanilla notes linger on the long finish.”

gran-orendain-extra-anejo-7-year.title: Gran Orendain Extra Anejo 7 Year Old Tequila
gran-orendain-extra-anejo-7-year.bodyHtml: Our magnum opus is aged in French oak barrels for 84 months or more, bottled at 40% ABV in a French decanter, and placed in a commemorative gift box. Intense flavours and aromas of cooked agave, maple, and vanilla, with wood and herbal nuances, a huge mouthfeel, and a long beautiful finish.

gran-orendain-reposado.title: Gran Orendain Anejo Tequila
gran-orendain-reposado.bodyHtml:
Gran Orendain Añejo is aged for 20 months in French oak barrels. Smooth on the palate, intense flavor with aromas of cooked agave, caramel, chocolate, vanilla and coffee. In the mouth, similar flavours of agave, chocolate, vanilla, and coffee, with great body and mouthfeel generated through its long aging process. To be enjoyed neat in a snifter or Riedel tequila glass, or on the rocks.

Awards: 2013 Beverage Tasting Institute – Silver Medal; 2015 Spirits Selection by Concours Mondial de Bruxelles – Gold Medal

grand-marnier-cuvee-1880.title: Grand Marnier Cuvee du Centenaire
grand-marnier-cuvee-1880.bodyHtml:
Grand Marnier Cuvée du Centenaire is a prestigious French orange liqueur created in 1927 to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the House of Marnier-Lapostolle. Crafted from a blend of fine XO Cognacs—sourced exclusively from the top two crus of Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne—and distilled essence of wild tropical Citrus Bigaradia (bitter orange), this refined expression is aged in French oak casks to achieve remarkable smoothness, depth, and aromatic complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with dark chocolate truffles, flourless chocolate cake, crème brûlée, duck à l'orange, foie gras, and aged blue cheeses such as Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper-amber with warm golden reflections, presenting a rich, full body with a velvety, smooth, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Candied bitter orange peel, gingerbread, macerated dark fruits, toasted oak, and subtle vanilla.

Palate : Rich and harmonious, balancing vibrant bitter orange marmalade with mature XO Cognac notes of honey, caramel, dried figs, baking spices, and gentle oak tannins.

Finish : Long, warm, and refined with lingering notes of zesty citrus peel, sweet spice, and aged Cognac woodiness.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip glass or traditional Cognac snifter as a digestif, or over a single large ice cube.

grand-marnier-louis-alexandre.title: Grand Marnier Cuvée Louis-Alexandre
grand-marnier-louis-alexandre.bodyHtml: A unique blend of refined V.S.O.P. cognac and Liqueur D ’Orange, the cognacs used in this premium Cuvée come from the finest growing areas in the Cognac region. It is a beautiful, complex blend featuring flavours of candied orange and macerated citrus fruit softened by notes of pine and earl grey tea.

grand-marnier-quintessence-1.title: Grand Marnier Quintessence
grand-marnier-quintessence-1.bodyHtml: Grand Marnier Quintessence is a unique liqueur developed in the 19th century by Alexandre Marnier Lapostolle. This luxurious blend of cognac, orange essence, and fine spices is expertly crafted to create a complex, flavorful taste in every sip. Intense and lingering, with notes of citrus and warm spices, the long-lasting finish promises a memorable experience.

grand-mayan-ultra-aged-tequila-1.title: Grand Mayan Reposado Tequila
grand-mayan-ultra-aged-tequila-1.bodyHtml: Grand Mayan's handcrafted Reposado Tequila is produced with the purest, central-highland Blue Agave with the highest standards of production. Aged in American and French oak casks for 6-8 months, Grand Mayan Reposado Tequila is smooth for sipping with notes of oak and chocolate.

grants-family-reserve-2.title: Grant's Triple Wood Blended Scotch Whisky 1.75L
grants-family-reserve-2.bodyHtml:
Grant's Triple Wood is the core blended Scotch whisky from William Grant & Sons, the fifth-generation Scottish family distiller, and is the whisky previously sold as Grant's Family Reserve. Where many whiskies take their flavour from a single type of cask, this blend is matured in three kinds of wood: virgin oak for spicy robustness, American oak for vanilla smoothness and refill bourbon casks for brown-sugar sweetness. The result is a smooth, rich and mellow blend bottled at 40% ABV, offered here in the large 1.75 L format. The producer suggests serving it over ice with a piece of orange peel, or lengthened with cola in a highball glass.

Nose: Complex and clean, with ripe pear and summer fruits.

Palate: Vanilla sweetness balanced by malty and light floral notes.

Finish: Long and sweet with a subtle hint of smoke.

Serve: Over ice with orange peel, or in a highball with cola and an orange wedge.

grants-family-reserve-4.title: Grant's Triple Wood Blended Scotch Whisky
grants-family-reserve-4.bodyHtml:
Grant's Triple Wood is the signature blended Scotch whisky of William Grant & Sons, the fifth-generation Scottish family distiller that fully owns the Grant's brand. Known as Grant's Family Reserve until 2018, the blend was renamed to put the spotlight on its maturation in three different types of wood; the whisky itself stayed the same. Virgin oak casks give spicy robustness, American oak lends a soft vanilla smoothness and refill bourbon casks add brown-sugar sweetness, together creating a smoother, richer and mellower blend. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is an easy all-rounder, equally good neat, over ice or lengthened with a mixer.

Tasting Notes: Clean and fruity, with vanilla sweetness, malt and a light floral lift ahead of a gently smoky close.

Nose: Complex and clean, with ripe pear and summer fruits.

Palate: Vanilla sweetness balanced by malty and light floral notes.

Finish: Long and sweet, with a subtle hint of smoke.

Serve: Pour 50ml over ice in a rocks glass with a twist of orange peel, or top with cola in a highball glass and garnish with an orange wedge.

green-spot-chateau-montelena.title: Green Spot Chateau Montelena Irish Whiskey

grey-goose-cherry-noir.title: Grey Goose Vodka 1.75L
grey-goose-cherry-noir.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Vodka is an ultra-premium, world-renowned spirit crafted in the celebrated Cognac region of France. Created by Maître de Chais (Cellar Master) François Thibault, this expression is distilled using only two high-quality ingredients: single-origin soft winter wheat from the fertile Picardy region and pure spring water naturally filtered through limestone from a dedicated well in Gensac-la-Pallue. Distilled a single time using a continuous column still process to preserve the character of the grain, this vodka bypasses extensive filtration to ensure a naturally rich, soft, and round texture, setting a global standard for high-end luxury vodka.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with fresh oysters on the half shell, caviar with blinis, smoked salmon canapés, creamy goat cheese, or light lemon-herb grilled chicken skewers.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear with brilliant clarity, featuring a plush, smooth, and rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Delicate and floral with subtle notes of sweet winter wheat, citrus zest, and light almond.

Palate : Smooth, soft, and slightly sweet with notes of cracked grain, subtle almond, light cream, and fresh citrus.

Finish : Warm, ultra-clean, and satisfying with a lingering, gentle peppery warmth and soft grain sweetness.

Serve : Serve ice-cold neat from the freezer, on the rocks, or as the refined base in a classic Vodka Martini or Espresso Martini.

grey-goose-lorange.title: Grey Goose L'Orange Vodka
grey-goose-lorange.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose L'Orange is an orange-flavoured vodka from the French house of Grey Goose, made with the natural essence of fresh oranges: more than two pounds of fruit for every litre. Essential oils from the oranges are combined with Grey Goose's soft winter wheat spirit and distilled, giving a bold, zesty citrus character with no added sugar. Cellar Master François Thibault insists on the finest oranges, in the same spirit as the quality bread-making wheat behind Grey Goose vodka. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a natural fit for a Cosmopolitan, an orange vodka soda or a citrus-led martini.

Nose: Fresh and fruity.

Palate: Full and fragrant.

Finish: Refreshing and warm.

Serve: Chilled, with soda and an orange slice, or in a Cosmopolitan.

groth-cabernet-sauvignon-2016.title: Groth Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
groth-cabernet-sauvignon-2016.bodyHtml:
The 2018 Groth Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon is a benchmark wine from a stellar Napa Valley vintage, sourced exclusively from the finest blocks of the Groth family's Oakville Estate. This vintage is characterized by its extraordinary depth and classical structure, offering a complex bouquet of dark currant, black cherry, and espresso, layered with sophisticated notes of graphite, cedar, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, it is full-bodied and powerful, featuring the "iron fist in a velvet glove" texture typical of Oakville benchland fruit. The tannins are dense yet remarkably polished, providing a seamless framework for a long, opulent finish of dark chocolate and savory spice. It is an exceptionally age-worthy wine designed for long-term cellaring.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This has the vivid, driven cassis, boysenberry and blackberry fruit of the vintage, but it's well-harnessed, with streaks of racy anise, alder and sweet bay leaf providing focus and precision. There's a long echo of iron and savory through the finish as the fruit lingers, leaving a mouthwatering feel. Understated in style compared with its colleagues, but no less complex. Best from 2022 through 2038.
94 Points - James Suckling
Aromas of ripe blackberries, blueberries, plums, earth, lavender and bark. It’s medium-to full-bodied with fine-grained tannins and fresh acidity. Balanced and juicy with a caressing texture and a bright core of spiced fruit. Elegant. Drink from 2023.

groth-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon-2016.title: Groth Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
groth-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon-2016.bodyHtml:
The 2018 Groth Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon is a benchmark wine from a stellar Napa Valley vintage, sourced exclusively from the finest blocks of the Groth family's Oakville Estate. This vintage is characterized by its extraordinary depth and classical structure, offering a complex bouquet of dark currant, black cherry, and espresso, layered with sophisticated notes of graphite, cedar, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, it is full-bodied and powerful, featuring the "iron fist in a velvet glove" texture typical of Oakville benchland fruit. The tannins are dense yet remarkably polished, providing a seamless framework for a long, opulent finish of dark chocolate and savory spice. It is an exceptionally age-worthy wine designed for long-term cellaring.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This has the vivid, driven cassis, boysenberry and blackberry fruit of the vintage, but it's well-harnessed, with streaks of racy anise, alder and sweet bay leaf providing focus and precision. There's a long echo of iron and savory through the finish as the fruit lingers, leaving a mouthwatering feel. Understated in style compared with its colleagues, but no less complex. Best from 2022 through 2038.
94 Points - James Suckling
Aromas of ripe blackberries, blueberries, plums, earth, lavender and bark. It’s medium-to full-bodied with fine-grained tannins and fresh acidity. Balanced and juicy with a caressing texture and a bright core of spiced fruit. Elegant. Drink from 2023.

guigal-chateauneuf-du-pape-rouge-2016.title: E. Guigal Chateauneuf-du-Pape 2021
guigal-chateauneuf-du-pape-rouge-2016.bodyHtml:
E. Guigal Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2021 is a wonderfully fresh, elegant, and structurally balanced southern Rhône red wine that beautifully expresses a challenging vintage with classic grace. Displaying a beautiful, deep dark red color in the glass, it opens with an inviting and highly expressive bouquet of ripe dark berries, wild raspberries, plum jam, and fresh licorice, harmoniously interwoven with delicate notes of orange peel, warm spices, and violet flowers. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied wine offers a remarkably velvety, ample, and enveloping texture, showing seamless fluid coherence. Its juicy core of succulent plum and dark stone fruit is supported by fine, sweet tannins and a refreshing line of integrated natural acidity. Traditional vinification combined with three weeks of maceration and two years of aging in large oak foudres yields a smooth, powerful complexity, concluding with a long, elegant, and gently ethereal finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with charcoal-grilled lamb seekh kebabs, rosemary-roasted red meats, classic wild duck, and mature French cheeses like Mimolette.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A polished, modern version, with good richness and depth to the apple and white peach notes, backed by a generous lacquer of oak spice and toast. Salinity and a refreshing blast of acidity maintain tension from start to finish, with lemon and honey elements lingering nicely. Grenache Blanc, Roussanne, Clairette, Bourboulenc, Picpoul and Picardan. Drink now through 2026.

guinness-draught-3.title: Guinness Draught 8 Tall Cans
guinness-draught-3.bodyHtml: Guinness is mahogany brown in color with a creamy white head. Loaded with aromas of coffee, toasted malt and hops, it is full and bold on the palate with a creamy texture and the same rich flavors and a delicate bitterness adds pleasing balance to the finish.

guotai-aged-15-years-guizhou.title: Guotai 15 Year Old Sauce Aroma Baijiu
guotai-aged-15-years-guizhou.bodyHtml:
Guotai 15 Years is a sauce-aroma (jiangxiang) baijiu from Guizhou Guotai Liquor Co., Ltd., made in Maotai Town, Guizhou, the core production area for China's sauce-aroma spirits. The label carries a 15-year statement (Guotai Shiwu Nian) and the Maotai Town origin seal. It comes in a deep blue bottle embossed with gold beast motifs and the Guotai name, presented in a red gift box. Bottled at 53% ABV in a 500ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in small glasses with a meal.

haku-vodka-1.title: Haku Vodka
haku-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Haku Vodka is a Japanese craft vodka from the House of Suntory, distilled from 100% Japanese white rice and bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The name Haku carries two meanings, "white" and "brilliance", a nod to the polished rice it starts from. According to Suntory, the rice is fermented and distilled in Kagoshima, a region long known for rice spirits, and the process is completed in Osaka. Before bottling, the spirit is filtered through bamboo charcoal, a step the producer credits for its soft, rounded and subtly sweet character. The bottle is embossed with a pattern inspired by rice stems moving in the wind, and the label is made from traditional washi paper. Haku was awarded a Gold Medal at the 2024 International Spirits Competition.

Tasting Notes: Soft, rounded and subtly sweet, with the character of the rice at the centre.

Nose: Soft and delicate, with the sweet, floral aroma of rice.

Palate: Rich, building gradually with natural rice sweetness and layered flavour.

Finish: Smooth, with a gentle sweetness that lingers.

Serve: Well chilled on its own, with soda, or in a classic Martini.

hardy-noces-de-perle.title: Hardy Cognac Noces de Perle
hardy-noces-de-perle.bodyHtml:
Containing blends aged thirty, fifty, sixty years and more, the Prestige collection embodies the emotion of times past.

Noces de Perle is a blend of ten different Grande Champagnes with distinct raisin notes followed by dried meadow flowers in the finish. There is gourmet pleasure in the delicately peppery onset and its gentle development with hints of vanilla.

hardy-perfection-lumiere.title: Hardy Cognac Perfection Lumière
hardy-perfection-lumiere.bodyHtml:
When launching the first pitcher Perfection in 1981 with the collaboration of the crystal Daum, Jacques Hardy opens a new era: cognac and its decanter become objects containing very high fashion.

In exceptional complexity, Perfection Lumiere is a wonderful cognac at its peak with notes affirmed chocolate and coffee. The mouth is soft, round, velvety but not heady. Its very powerful aroma is characterized by typical final notes of cigar box and nutmeg.

hardy-privilege-cuvee-benedicte-cognac.title: Hennessy VSOP Privilege Cognac
hardy-privilege-cuvee-benedicte-cognac.bodyHtml:
Hennessy VSOP Cognac is a harmonious and balanced cognac produced by Jas Hennessy & Co. First created in 1817 at the request of the future King George IV of the United Kingdom, it is crafted from a blend of over 60 different eaux-de-vie aged in seasoned French oak casks, resulting in a rich, velvety profile marked by fresh fruit, toasted oak, and delicate spices.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, foie gras, dark chocolate desserts, aged gouda, or rich caramelized pork belly.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber in color with a velvety, rich, and well-rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh fruit, candied orange peel, vanilla, clove, cinnamon, and subtle toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of ripe apricot, dried fruit, vanilla, toasted almonds, and warm winter spices.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant with lingering notes of sweet spice, candied fruit, and subtle oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip glass, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic cocktails like a Sidecar or Sazerac.

havana-club-3-year-old.title: Havana Club Añejo 3 Años Rum
havana-club-3-year-old.bodyHtml:
Havana Club Añejo 3 Años is a light, aged white rum made entirely in Cuba from local sugarcane molasses. Produced by continuous distillation and then aged so that every drop spends at least three years in wood, it marries the fresh, green notes of sugarcane with the fruity side of Caribbean rum. It pours a pale golden straw colour. Havana Club positions it as the essential base for classic Cuban cocktails such as the Mojito and the Daiquiri. Bottled at 37.5% alcohol by volume in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Oak, molasses and sugar cane.

Palate: Sweet, mild and fruity with a light hint of citrus.

Serve: In a Mojito or Daiquiri, or with cola and lime.

havana-club-anejo-reserva.title: Havana Club Añejo 7 Años Rum
havana-club-anejo-reserva.bodyHtml: Havana Club Añejo 7 Años is a legendary Cuban dark rum, widely considered the gold standard for sipping rums and the quintessential expression of the Havana Club range. Created by the late Maestro Ronero Don José Navarro, this rum is crafted through a continuous aging process where a portion of every final blend is returned to the barrel to nurture future generations. It is composed of rums aged for a minimum of seven years in white oak casks, resulting in a rich, mahogany-hued spirit with a complex and silky texture. On the nose, it reveals an intense bouquet of roasted pecans, tobacco, honey, and tropical fruits, while the palate delivers deep notes of cocoa, vanilla, and warm cedar spice. This world-class rum is best enjoyed neat, over ice, or as a sophisticated base for a classic Cuba Libre or an authentic El Presidente.

haymans-london-dry-gin-1.title: Hayman's London Dry Gin
haymans-london-dry-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Our London Dry Gin is crisp, complex and very refreshing.  In fact, it’s a timeless classic.  Try it with tonic and let its flavours unfold.

At Hayman’s, we still make all our gin by hand, using only the finest botanicals and a traditional two-day process.

haymans-old-tom-gin-1.title: Hayman's Old Tom Gin
haymans-old-tom-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Hayman's Old Tom Gin is an Old Tom style gin from Hayman's of London, the English family gin distillers, bottled at 41.4% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Old Tom is the original, rounder style of London gin, and the Haymans make theirs to a family recipe they date back about 160 years. It is distilled from 100% grain spirit in a copper pot still, with the botanicals steeped before distillation and the gin lightly sweetened with sugar; the botanicals named are juniper, coriander, lemon and orange peel, angelica root, cinnamon, cassia bark, orris root, liquorice and nutmeg. The producer calls it juniper forward, rich and characterful, and recommends it for classic cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Juniper forward, rich and characterful, round and smooth.

Serve: Use in classic gin cocktails such as a Tom Collins, with lemon juice, sugar syrup and soda.

hendricks-lunar.title: Hendrick's Lunar Gin
hendricks-lunar.bodyHtml:
Hendrick's Lunar Gin is a delightfully cosmic, limited-edition release from Master Distiller Lesley Gracie’s "Cabinet of Curiosities." Conceived under the celestial light of a moonlit night while tending to her beloved botanicals, this expression offers an alluring combination of gentle warmth and crisp freshness. It layers Hendrick's core foundation of 11 botanicals, rose, and cucumber with a selection of night-blooming floral notes and rich, warming baking spices, resulting in an enchanting gin designed for evening sipping.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with lightly spiced finger foods, honey-glazed pork sliders, duck liver pâté, or a cheese board featuring creamy blue cheese and fresh figs. For a sweet treat, it beautifully complements dark chocolate truffles, spiced ginger biscuits, or an orange zest tart.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear and brilliantly transparent. It has a smooth, rounded, and slightly oily mouthfeel that wraps the palate in a gentle, comforting warmth.

NOSE An intriguing and deep bouquet that opens with dominant notes of warm, peppery spices, sweet wood, and subtle hints of pine needles, wrapped in a delicate layer of night-blooming flowers and soft, candied citrus peel.

PALATE Beautifully balanced and intricate. It reveals a rich wave of warming baking spices—such as black pepper, cardamom, and clove—harmoniously intertwined with sweet orange zest, crisp green cucumber, and a soft, fragrant touch of lavender and rose.

FINISH Long, smooth, and persistent. The initial spice gives way to a clean, cooling close characterized by lingering notes of black pepper, refreshing cucumber, and a subtle floral whisper.

SERVE Superb for sophisticated evening cocktails. Enjoy it in a "Lunar & Tonic" over ice with a classic black pepper and cucumber slice garnish, or stir it with fresh ginger ale and a squeeze of lime for a delightfully warming twist.

hendricks-midsummer-solstice.title: Hendrick's Midsummer Solstice Gin
hendricks-midsummer-solstice.bodyHtml:
Hendrick's Midsummer Solstice Gin is a flirtatious, deeply aromatic limited-edition release from Master Distiller Lesley Gracie’s "Cabinet of Curiosities." Inspired by the intense sensory power of nature during the peak of the summer solstice, this expression pays homage to the original floral focus of Hendrick's. It layers the traditional house foundation of 11 botanicals, crisp cucumber, and Bulgarian rose with a proprietary secret bouquet of bright, sun-ripened summer blooms, resulting in an exceptionally refreshing, bright, and romantic gin.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with summer brunch favorites such as strawberry-topped goat cheese crostini, lemon-herb grilled chicken skewers, smoked salmon, or fresh oysters. It is also an exquisite companion to desserts like raspberry macarons, lemon tarts, or lavender shortbread biscuits.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear and brilliantly transparent. It presents a light, crisp, and remarkably clean mouthfeel that rolls across the palate with refreshing effervescence.

NOSE An enchanting, perfume-like bouquet bursting with ripe dark forest berries, sweet orange blossom, and zesty lemon rinds, seamlessly pinned down by traditional piney juniper and fragrant rose hips.

PALATE Delicate, complex, and highly floral-forward. Soft flavors of elderflower, sweet lavender, and honeysuckle flood the entry, transitioning mid-palate into zesty citrus, candied orange peel, and the refreshing, signature coolness of fresh green cucumber.

FINISH Clean, dry, and exceptionally refreshing. The intense floral sugars fade into a lingering, surprisingly warm finish accented by gentle baking spices, licorice root, and soft pine.

SERVE Superb when mixed into light, casual daytime drinks. Enjoy it as a "Midsummer Solstice & Tonic" by serving it over plenty of ice with a premium Mediterranean tonic water, garnished with a ribbon of cucumber and an orange slice.

hendricks-orbium.title: Hendrick's Orbium Gin
hendricks-orbium.bodyHtml:
Hendrick's Orbium Gin is a brilliantly complex, ultra-premium "Quininated Gin" crafted by Master Distiller Lesley Gracie. Described as what Hendrick's might taste like in a parallel universe, this expression takes the signature house foundation of 11 botanicals, cucumber, and rose, and infuses it with flavors traditionally found in classic gin mixers. By adding extracts of quinine (found in tonic), wormwood (found in vermouth), and the enigmatic Blue Lotus blossom, Orbium delivers a deeply intricate, structurally round, and beautifully bitter flavor profile.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with rich, savory, and briny dishes such as raw oysters, smoked salmon blinis, or caviar. It also contrasts beautifully with rich charcuterie, duck pâté, and sharp, aged cheeses like vintage white cheddar or Manchego.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear and brilliantly transparent. It features a structurally round, velvety, and slightly oily mouthfeel that coats the palate with a unique, sophisticated bitterness.

NOSE An intensely floral and deeply complex bouquet. It opens with the surprising sweetness of blue lotus flower and rose, which quickly gives way to sharp, woody juniper, bright citrus zest, and a distinct, deep herbal undertone of dry wormwood.

PALATE Remarkably deep, complex, and evolving. The entry is unexpectedly sweet and floral, showcasing lotus blossom and citrus. Mid-palate, it transitions into a sharp, woody, and earthy domain where traditional juniper blends seamlessly with the clean, medicinal snap of quinine and a pleasant, herbaceous tea-like dryness.

FINISH Exceptionally long, dry, and clean. The floral sweetness completely fades, leaving behind a lingering, sophisticated bitterness of wormwood, crisp cucumber, and a sharp, refreshing peppery bite.

SERVE Designed to shine in spirit-forward cocktails. It makes an unparalleled, deeply complex Martini when stirred with a twist of lemon, or an elevated Orbium & Soda, where the built-in quinine eliminates the need for sugary tonic water.

hendricks-gin-5.title: Hendrick's Gin 1.75L
hendricks-gin-5.bodyHtml:
Hendrick's Gin is an iconoclastic, ultra-premium Scottish gin renowned for its wonderfully unusual flavor profile. Handcrafted in tiny batches at the Lesley Gracie Lab within the Girvan Distillery, it is uniquely distilled in two distinct types of stills—the Bennet and the Carter-Head. This process creates a divinely smooth gin that is subsequently infused with a signature duet of Bulgarian Rosa Damascena (rose petals) and specially selected crisp cucumbers, delivering a remarkably refreshing, floral, and sophisticated spirit.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with smoked salmon crostini, fresh oysters, classic cucumber finger sandwiches, and light seafood ceviche. It also beautifully complements soft cheeses like goat cheese, fresh brie, or a bright lemon-herb chicken salad.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear and brilliantly transparent. It features a beautifully smooth, light-to-medium-bodied texture that feels remarkably clean, crisp, and refreshing on the palate.

NOSE A wonderfully intense and floral bouquet opening with distinct aromas of fresh juniper, sweet rose petal, crisp cucumber, and a bright zest of citrus oil.

PALATE Excellently balanced and smooth. The palate reveals a complex matrix of green cucumber and earthy juniper, which quickly gives way to delicate layers of floral rose, sweet coriander, and a refreshing burst of orange and lemon peel.

FINISH Clean, dry, and wonderfully refreshing with a lingering, cooling sensation of fresh cucumber and a subtle floral fade.

SERVE The ultimate serve is a classic Hendrick's & Tonic, poured over plenty of ice in a highball or copa glass, and strictly garnished with a fresh wheel of cucumber rather than lime to accentuate its unique infusions.

hennessy-master-blenders-selection.title: Hennessy Masters Blender's Cognac Selection No 3
hennessy-master-blenders-selection.bodyHtml: Master Blender's Selection is a true limited edition that is blended once, and never replicated. Each edition is different from the previous release. This edition is blended from a selection of 20 Cognacs that are a minimum of seven years old. It is fruity, mildly sweet and silky on the palate.

hennessy-paradis.title: Hennessy Paradis Cognac
hennessy-paradis.bodyHtml:
Hennessy Paradis is defined by its graceful character and immediately delights with its rich copper colour. It is a perfectly balanced blend, both voluptuous and round, and combines smoothness and strength with a silky texture. Naturally, it has a flavourful and deep, persistent finish.

Hennessy Paradis was created by Maurice Fillioux in 1979 as a tribute to symphonic music. He compared the blend to ‘a symphonic orchestra’, as “classical music that takes you away and connects with your emotions.” The number of instruments in an orchestra is not necessarily a measure of its success, but rather the purity of sound it creates and the virtuosity of the conductor. The same is true for Hennessy Paradis, a union of exceptional eaux-de-vie selected for their individual qualities to work together to create a harmonious and graceful cognac.

hennessy-paradis-imperial.title: Hennessy Paradis Imperial Cognac
hennessy-paradis-imperial.bodyHtml:
Hennessy Paradis Impérial is a contemporary creation by Yann Fillioux, the 7th generation Master Blender. This rare Cognac is the apogee of Hennessy’s art of selection.

Hennessy Paradis Imperial embodies the pinnacle of the art of selection. From any harvest, the average number of eau-de-vie with the potential to join this blend are a rare few: only 10 out of 10 000. The Master Blender defines the right aging conditions to raise a fine eau-de-vie to its point of elegance, the decisive and fleeting moment when the eau-de-vie reaches its full potential, ready to join the Hennessy Paradis Imperial blend.

hennessy-richard.title: Hennessy XO Cognac
hennessy-richard.bodyHtml:
Hennessy XO Cognac is a world-renowned, ultra-premium cognac originally created in 1870 by Maurice Hennessy for his close circle of friends. It is a masterful, complex blend of over 100 different eaux-de-vie sourced from the finest terroirs of the Cognac region, each meticulously aged in French oak barrels for up to 30 years. This long and patient maturation process gives the cognac its iconic, deep amber color and a legendary, multi-layered profile characterized by intense flavors of candied fruit, wild cocoa, and robust wood spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with rich dark chocolate truffles, slow-cooked duck breast with cherry glaze, dry-aged ribeye steak, or a selection of aged cheeses like Roquefort.

TASTING NOTES - A deep, intense ochre-amber color with a remarkably rich, full-bodied, and velvety smooth mouthfeel.

NOSE - Extremely rich and expressive with dominant notes of candied orange, dried figs, sweet plums, fresh-grated cinnamon, and toasted oak.

PALATE - Robust and deeply complex on the tongue, offering powerful layers of warm chocolate, sweet honey, ground black pepper, leather, and oaky vanilla.

FINISH - Exceptionally long, warm, and elegant with lingering nuances of sweet cinnamon spice, dark cocoa, and refined, smoky wood.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat in a tulip glass, on the rocks, or with a splash of cold spring water to release its deeply nested aromas.

hennessy-vs.title: Hennessy VS Cognac
hennessy-vs.bodyHtml:
Hennessy VS Cognac is a vibrant, iconic French cognac crafted by Jas Hennessy & Co. Assembled from a blend of up to 40 different eaux-de-vie aged for at least two years in French oak casks, it delivers a lively, fruit-forward character balanced by toasted oak and subtle spice.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, braised pork chops, roasted duck, dark chocolate desserts, or rich creamy cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-copper in appearance with a full, round, and smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Toasted oak, fresh citrus, vanilla, subtle floral notes, and hints of brown sugar and almond.

Palate : Vibrant and fruit-driven with notes of fresh apple, ripe grape, warm baking spices, vanilla, and roasted nuts.

Finish : Medium-long, warm, and crisp with lingering notes of wood spice, cinnamon, and subtle fruit.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a foundational spirit for classic cocktails like a Sidecar or Hennessy Ginger.

hennessy-xo.title: Hennessy XO Cognac
hennessy-xo.bodyHtml:
Hennessy XO Cognac is a world-renowned, ultra-premium cognac originally created in 1870 by Maurice Hennessy for his close circle of friends. herradura-anejo.title: Herradura Anejo Tequila
herradura-anejo.bodyHtml: Aged to perfection. Blending modern and traditional distilling techniques, a?ejo was first introduced to the world by Casa Herradura in 1962. Since then Herradura A?ejo has aged in American White Oak barrels for 25 months ? an incredible 13 months beyond industry standards. The result is a remarkably smooth, amber-colored liquid that melts on your tongue leaving notes of cooked agave, toasted oak and dried fruit.

herradura-reposado.title: Herradura Reposado Tequila
herradura-reposado.bodyHtml: The Original Reposado. Tequila Herradura introduced the world to Reposado in 1974 and has been setting the standard ever since. Aged longer than industry standard for 11 months, Reposado has a rich amber color with notes of cooked agave, vanilla and butter. This additional time spent resting in charred American White Oak barrels creates a smooth, sweet finish with a slight taste of spice.

herradura-seleccion-suprema.title: Herradura Seleccion Suprema Extra Anejo Tequila
herradura-seleccion-suprema.bodyHtml:
Herradura Seleccion Suprema Extra Anejo Tequila is an ultra-premium, 100% blue agave tequila produced at the historic Casa Herradura in Amatitán, Jalisco. Crafted using traditional brick ovens, fermented with naturally occurring wild yeasts, and aged for 49 months in heavily charred American white oak barrels, it offers a deeply rich, smooth, and refined experience that rivals the finest aged spirits.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate, aged Gouda, prime ribeye steak, roasted duck, or crème brûlée.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber-mahogany with copper highlights, featuring a full-bodied, velvety, and exceptionally smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich cooked agave, toasted oak, dried fruits, vanilla, cinnamon, and subtle floral undertones.

Palate : Complex and harmonious with notes of sweet agave, caramel, butterscotch, toasted oak, dried fruit, and baking spices.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant with lingering oak, sweet vanilla, and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a snifter or tulip-shaped glass, allowing it to breathe.

herradura-silver.title: Herradura Silver Tequila
herradura-silver.bodyHtml: Herradura Silver owes its distinctly sweet taste of agave and subtle oak notes to resting for an impressive 45 days beyond the industry standard in American White Oak barrels. The prolonged aging process creates a light straw color with a unique, robust aroma of cooked agave, vanilla and wood that leaves your mouth feeling smooth and refreshed.

hey-yall-brewed-black-tea-vodka-1.title: Hey Y'All Brewed Black Tea Vodka
hey-yall-brewed-black-tea-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Hey Y'All Brewed Black Tea Vodka is a black tea flavoured vodka from Quebec, Canada. It is bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Over ice with lemonade, or with soda and a lemon wedge.

hey-yall-original-hard-iced-tea-1.title: Hey Y'All Tailgate Hard Iced Tea 12 Cans
hey-yall-original-hard-iced-tea-1.bodyHtml:
Hey Y’all Tailgate Hard Iced Tea 12 Pack is made for game day and good times. This pack features 12 tallboy cans of lightly sweetened hard iced tea that deliver smooth, refreshing flavor with just the right kick. It’s the perfect balance of classic sweet tea taste and tailgate-ready energy—ideal for parties, parking lot hangs, or a laid-back afternoon.

Crafted with genuine black tea, green tea, and real lemon juice, each sip offers a crisp, satisfying profile with a subtle tropical finish that pairs effortlessly with your favorite tailgate eats. Made with quality natural ingredients and just 80 calories per can, it’s a lighter option that doesn’t compromise on flavor.

Whether you’re firing up the grill or relaxing on the front porch, Hey Y’all Hard Iced Tea is your go-to for easy summer sipping. Stock up while it lasts and get ready to raise a can to the good times.

hibiki-harmony.title: Hibiki Japanese Harmony Whisky
hibiki-harmony.bodyHtml:
Hibiki Japanese Harmony is a meticulous blend of more than ten malt and grain whiskies produced by Suntory, drawing from the Yamazaki, Hakushu, and Chita distilleries. Crafted under the supervision of Master Blender Shingo Torii and Chief Blender Shinji Fukuyo, this expression is matured in five different cask types, including American white oak, Sherry, and Mizunara oak. Presented in a 24-faceted bottle representing the 24 seasons of the traditional Japanese lunar calendar, it yields an exceptionally delicate, subtle, and harmonious profile.

Food Pairing: Sushi, sashimi, grilled yakitori, fresh oysters, dark chocolate, and light citrus desserts.

Tasting Notes : Amber color in appearance with a delicate, smooth, and velvety mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Rose, lychee, a hint of rosemary, mature woodiness, and sandalwood.

Palate : Honey-like sweetness, candied orange peel, and white chocolate.

Finish : Subtle, long finish with a hint of Mizunara oak.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or in a traditional Japanese Highball with premium soda water over clear ice.

high-coast-alv.title: High Coast Cinco Swedish Single Malt Whisky 500ml
high-coast-alv.bodyHtml:
Cinco is Spanish for the number five. For Cinco we have used a number of barrels that previously matured five different styles of sherry. The five varieties are Oloroso, Fino, Pedro Ximénez, Amontillado and Palo Cortado.

The original idea was that these barrels would be used for an Advanced masterclass, but instead we chose to mix some of the barrels together and this became Cinco.

We are fairly certain that no other whisky has been created by combining these five different types of sherry styles.

high-coast-berg.title: High Coast Berg Single Malt Swedish Whisky
high-coast-berg.bodyHtml:
BERG – is a sherry matured whisky which has the same natural colour as the Nordingrå granite which can be seen protruding the dramatic landscape of the High Coast. The casks have previously held the flavoursome Pedro Ximénez sherry.

Origins is a series where we celebrate our heritage. We have embraced our location, history and geography and created four whiskies that reflect these aspects. The Origins quartet is released in selected Systembolaget stores as well as in the ordering range and in selected international markets. Berg was released October 1st 2019.

Berg won two Gold Medals at Stockholm Beer & Whisky Festival 2019 in the categories of Best Swedish Whisky and Best World Wide Whisky.

NOSE - Sultanas, gooseberry, honey, dark chocolate

PALATE - Long and fruity with a spicy aftertaste

FINISH - Rich dates and balanced honeyed sweetness

high-coast-hav.title: High Coast Cinco Swedish Single Malt Whisky 500ml
high-coast-hav.bodyHtml:
Cinco is Spanish for the number five. For Cinco we have used a number of barrels that previously matured five different styles of sherry. The five varieties are Oloroso, Fino, Pedro Ximénez, Amontillado and Palo Cortado.

The original idea was that these barrels would be used for an Advanced masterclass, but instead we chose to mix some of the barrels together and this became Cinco.

We are fairly certain that no other whisky has been created by combining these five different types of sherry styles.

high-coast-timmer.title: High Coast Timmer Single Malt Swedish Whisky
high-coast-timmer.bodyHtml:
Peated single malt whisky matured in first fill Bourbon barrels.

Timmer is our peated whisky, our humble tribute to the men and women who once lived and worked here. Those who risked their lives fighting icy cold waters as they steered the heavy logs downstream and kept warm by burning fires under the pale moon light.

Origins is a series where we celebrate our heritage. We have embraced our location, history and geography and created four whiskies that reflect these aspects. The Origins quartet is released in selected Systembolaget stores as well as in the ordering range and in selected international markets.

Timmer launched May 2nd in local Monopoly stores in Västernorrland as well as nationally available via the order range. Naturally you can order Timmer to your own local Systembolaget store as well as ordering online.

NOSE - Peat, Vanilla

PALATE - Campfire smoke, Rich Vanillia Sweetness

FINISH - Citrus, Ash

high-west-american-prairie-bourbon-1.title: High West Bourbon Whiskey
high-west-american-prairie-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
High West Bourbon Whiskey (formerly known as American Prairie Bourbon) is a meticulously crafted blend of straight bourbon whiskeys from the renowned Utah-based distillery. To create this complex and well-balanced spirit, High West masterfully blends their own house-distilled bourbon with carefully sourced, mature straight bourbons. The result is a highly versatile, high-rye bourbon profile that harmonizes rich caramel and sweet nougat with a vibrant, earthy spice. Dedicated to Western conservation efforts, it is a superb everyday sipping whiskey that also possesses the robust 92-proof structure needed to shine beautifully in classic cocktails.

Food Pairing: Sweet and smoky BBQ pork ribs, roasted root vegetables, sharp aged cheddar or gouda, and classic pecan pie or caramel-heavy desserts.

Tasting Notes : Light amber to rich caramel in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied, and inviting mouthfeel.

Nose : Inviting and sweet, featuring bright aromas of light caramel, sweet vanilla, warm biscuits, and toasted pecans, layered with subtle dark fruit and earthy oak.

Palate : Rich, earthy, and perfectly balanced. A sweet wave of honey, creamy nougat, and sweet corn transitions seamlessly into vibrant notes of cinnamon, mild rye spice, and sweet vanilla bean.

Finish : Long, smooth, and pleasantly sweet, leaving a lingering warmth of caramel apple, vanilla, and gentle baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, over a large ice cube, or use it as a premium, flavorful base for classic whiskey cocktails like an Old Fashioned or a Manhattan.

high-west-campfire.title: High West Campfire Whiskey
high-west-campfire.bodyHtml:
High West Campfire Whiskey is a highly unique and deeply innovative blend that brings together the sweet and spicy profiles of American whiskeys with the smoky allure of Scottish peat. Created by High West Distillery in Utah, this unconventional whiskey masterfully marries mature straight rye whiskey and straight bourbon whiskey with a specially selected peated blended malt Scotch whisky. The result is a beautifully complex, full-bodied "mutant" of a whiskey that perfectly balances sweet honeycomb, zesty rye spice, and the distinct, lingering essence of a fading campfire.

Food Pairing: Smoked beef brisket, grilled steaks, sharp aged cheddar, roasted nuts, and chocolate-heavy desserts like s'mores or dark chocolate truffles.

Tasting Notes : Warm honey-amber in appearance with a smooth, well-rounded, and gently warming mouthfeel.

Nose : Floral, fruity, bright and spicy. It features rich notes of caramel, butterscotch, jasmine, chai tea, sandalwood, leather, and tobacco, all wrapped in the distinct light smoke and smoldering wood of a campfire the morning after.

Palate : Complex and exceptionally balanced. A sweet wave of vanilla, honey, and toffee is complemented by dark fruit notes of blueberries and black cherries. This is quickly followed by chai spices, nutmeg, cinnamon, orange zest, salty caramels, tobacco, and a gentle, integrating peat smoke.

Finish : Long, sweet, spicy, and elegantly smoky, leaving a lingering impression of warm baking spice and soft smoldering embers.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its full complexity, over a large ice cube, or use it to add a rich, smoky twist to classic cocktails like a Manhattan or an Old Fashioned.

high-west-rendevous-rye.title: High West Rendezvous Rye
high-west-rendevous-rye.bodyHtml:
High West Rendezvous Rye is the flagship straight rye whiskey from High West Distillery, located in Park City, Utah. Crafted as a blend of straight rye whiskies featuring both high-rye and low-rye mashbills, it is designed to showcase the classic, bold, and aromatic depth of traditional American rye whiskey. It delivers an intricate, spicy profile driven by rich botanical rye notes, warm baking spices, caramel, and balanced seasoned oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked barbecue ribs, charcuterie boards featuring cured meats and sharp aged cheddar, roasted duck with spiced cherry sauce, and pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Rich amber with golden copper highlights, showing a medium-to-full body with a silky, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Poached pear, bitter orange peel, candied ginger, cinnamon stick, nutmeg, fresh mint, and sweet vanilla oak.

Palate : Caramel, dried apricot, sweet toffee, gingerbread, crushed black pepper, cooling spearmint, and seasoned oak tannins.

Finish : Long, warming, and spiced with lingering cinnamon, dark molasses, dried fruit, and a pleasant herbal rye warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or rocks glass, over a large ice cube, or as the premium foundation for classic whiskey cocktails such as a Manhattan or Sazerac.

high-west-son-of-bourye.title: High West Son of Bourye Whiskey
high-west-son-of-bourye.bodyHtml:
A unique and premium blend of rich bourbon and rye whiskeys, making for a premier sipping whiskey and one of High West’s all-time favorites.

How to Enjoy

Bourye is best enjoyed around a campfire while looking at the Milky Way. Sip straight or with a little water. Not recommended with ice.

The Name

Bourye is a combination of "Bou" for bourbon and "rye" for..well, rye whiskey. Because combining bourbon and rye is a bit unusual, we couldn't help thinking of the jackalope. Honestly, we didn’t think anyone would like the name!

Back Label Story

The jackalope, also called an antelabbit, is an antlered species of
rabbit, a cross between a jack rabbit and an antelope. It is rumored
that pockets of jackalope populations continue to persist in the
American West, its native home. In the old West, when cowboys would
gather by their campfires to sing at night, jackalopes would frequently
be heard singing back, mimicking the voices of the cowboys. When
chased, the jackalope will use its vocal abilities to elude capture.
For instance, when chased by people it will call out phrases such
as, “There he goes, over there,” in order to throw pursuers off its
track. Legend suggests the best way to catch a jackalope is to lure it
with whiskey, as they have a particular fondness for this drink. Once
intoxicated, the animal becomes slower and easier to hunt (believe it
or not, all this mythology is true, we didn’t make any of this up). That’s
why High West created Bourye®, our proprietary blend of mature
Bourbon and Rye, both favorites of real cowboys and sure to attract
even the most finicky of jackalopes.
All whiskeys in this carefully crafted blend are a minimum of 10
years old and sourced from multiple distilleries. See highwest.com
for technical details and sourcing, that’s not a secret. However, the
proportions are! Bourye® is best enjoyed around a campfire while
looking at the Milky Way. Important! Jackalopes will attack if cornered
or provoked. To avoid injury, quickly fall to the ground, remain calm
and still, while humming the Roy Rogers song, “Happy Trails to You”
(we did make this up!).

Label designed by High West Distillery's very own Shelby Caret.

Technical Details

Ratio of component whiskeys: top secret!
Filtration: not chill-filtered, or carbon treated.

TTB Designation

Class & Type: A Blend of Straight Whiskies
Blend: A blend of straight bourbon and rye whiskeys aged a minimum of 10 years

Proof & ABV

ABV: 46%
92 Proof

Age(s), Distilled by & Mashbill(s)

2020 Release:
All sourced from MGP, Lawrenceburg, Indiana:
-Straight Rye Whiskey: 95% rye, 5% barley malt;
-Straight Bourbon Whiskey: 75% corn, 21% rye, 4% barley malt
-Straight Bourbon Whiskey: 60% corn, 36% rye, 4% barley malt

Barrel Type(s)

Whiskeys aged in new, charred white American oak barrels

Sensory Notes

Nose: Brown butter caramel, vanilla cola, grilled pineapple, boysenberry jam, spearmint, sage, violets in wet weather
Taste: Masala chai, cinnamon candies, butterscotch, orange chocolate, gingerbread, walnuts doused in dark caramel
Finish: Creamy toffee, clove, ginger chew spice

Product Reviews & Awards

92 Points/100 - Whisky Advocate 7/2017
96 Points/100 - Wine Enthusiast 5/2017
Best Craft American Whiskey - 2010 American Distilling Institute Craft Whiskey Competition
Best Blended Whiskey- 2010 American Distilling Institute Craft Whiskey Competition
90 Points- Whisky Advocate Magazine
90 Points- American Craft Spirits - americancraftspirits.com

John Hansell, Malt Advocate Magazine - "It's clean, crisp and quite vibrant (especially on the nose). The rye note is evident throughout. It starts out more like a high rye content bourbon, with the molasses, caramel, coconut cream, sweet corn and honey-kissed fruit marrying nicely with the dried spice (vanilla, cinnamon, brisk mint). But then on the latter half of the palate, the rye really kicks in. The whiskey gets bold, the rye becomes intense (almost piercing), with a dried spice finish.

high-west-yippee-ki-yay.title: High West Yippee Ki-Yay
high-west-yippee-ki-yay.bodyHtml:
Cassia bark, red currant jam, black cherry, dried rose petal, rhubarb, star anise, fruit leather, clove, and brown sugar aromas. On the palate, flavors of bright rhubarb, bitter orange peel, smooth vanilla, strawberry reduction, birch, boysenberry, and herbs de Provence. The finish offers notes of candied ginger, clove, and red currants; lively interplay between berry fruit and rye spice.
Yippee Ki-Yay shows best at room temp, neat. With a little time in the glass sitting idle (just a few minutes), the bouquet really opens up to its full potential.
Proof: 92

highland-park-12-year-old.title: Highland Park 12 Year Old 'Viking Honour'
highland-park-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Highland Park 12 Year Old 'Viking Honour' is a benchmark single malt Scotch whisky produced at the Highland Park Distillery in the Orkney Islands. Matured predominantly in sherry-seasoned European and American oak casks, it balances warm heather honey sweetness, rich fruitcake, and gentle oak spice with the distillery's signature subtle, aromatic Orkney peat smoke.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, roasted pork, aged cheddar cheese, dark chocolate, or grilled scallops.

Tasting Notes : Glowing amber gold with a smooth, well-rounded, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Heather honey, rich fruitcake, subtle cocoa, fresh citrus peel, and gentle aromatic peat smoke.

Palate : Sweet honeyed malt, warm dried fruit, orange peel, winter spices, vanilla, and soft heathery smoke.

Finish : Medium-to-long, clean, and gently sweet with lingering notes of wood smoke and subtle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, with a few drops of water to open the aromas, or over a large ice cube.

highland-park-16-year-old-tattoo.title: Highland Park Twisted Tattoo 16 Year Old
highland-park-16-year-old-tattoo.bodyHtml:
We have a tradition of defying convention and that’s how we came to create this distinct and bold single malt whisky and its equally distinct and bold packaging.

The name and design was inspired by the Norse legend of the Midgard serpent, which grew so large it could twist right around the earth to bite its own tail; and we developed the packaging in partnership with Danish tattoo artist, Colin Dale, who uses both ancient and modern tattooing techniques to tell stories on the skin.

Using first-fill Rioja casks in combination with refill casks was a first for Highland Park and the result is a rich and contemporary single malt whisky with very distinctive character. You’ll find generous layers of sweet vanilla, sun-ripened peaches, summer berries and full-bodied red wine, combined on gust of heather-rich peat smoke.

highland-park-18-year-old.title: Highland Park 18 Year Old Viking Pride
highland-park-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Highland Park 18 Year Old 'Viking Pride' is a benchmark Island single malt from Scotland's northernmost distillery in the Orkney Islands. Matured in a high proportion of first-fill European and American oak sherry-seasoned casks, this expression perfectly balances rich, dark sherry fruit and spice with Highland Park's distinct, aromatic Orkney heather peat smoke. Widely decorated and revered globally, it offers a highly harmonious, complex, and full-bodied sipping experience.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate desserts (such as a Black Forest gateau), roasted duck with plum reduction, spiced fruit chutneys with cold meats, smoked salmon, and blue cheeses like Stilton or Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Naturally glowing amber in appearance with a smooth, full, and warming, mouth-coating feel.

Nose : Rich, caramelized sweetness, toffee, and ripe cherries, beautifully supported by dried fruit, dark chocolate, marzipan, and delicate aromatic heather peat smoke.

Palate : Complex and finely balanced, delivering a wave of candied orange zest, dark chocolate, and honeyed fruits alongside cinnamon spice, espresso, and subtle, smoldering heather smoke.

Finish : Long, sweet, and complex, leaving a lingering interplay of gentle peat smoke, winter baking spices, toasted oak, and a slight nuttiness.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its full complexity, or gently opened with a few drops of room-temperature water.

highland-park-21-year-old-1.title: Highland Park 21 Year Old
highland-park-21-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Selecting similar quantities of contrasting cask types – nine first-fill European sherry seasoned oak hogsheads, eight ex-bourbon hogsheads, and nine refill hogsheads – gives the November 2019 Release of Highland Park 21 Year Old single malt whisky an impressively rounded and unique flavour. As the warm spices and rich dried fruit flavours of the European casks mingle with the sweeter, exotic fruit notes from the ex-bourbon hogsheads, the softer influence of the refill casks finishes off the harmony.

Bottled at its marrying strength of 46%, this exceptionally well-balanced whisky delivers notes of freshly-cut pineapple, ripe mango, juicy pears, sun-dried sultanas, dried exotic fruit, spice market aromas and curls of densely aromatic peat smoke.\

highland-park-25-year-old-1.title: Highland Park 25 Year Old
highland-park-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Highland Park 25 Year Old is a highly acclaimed single malt Scotch whisky produced at the historic Highland Park Distillery in Kirkwall, Orkney. Matured for a minimum of 25 years in a high proportion of first-fill European oak sherry-seasoned casks, it is renowned for its harmonious balance of rich dried fruits, dark chocolate, warm oak spice, and signature aromatic heather peat smoke.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate desserts, venison steak, aged Gouda, roasted duck, and sticky toffee pudding.

Tasting Notes : Deep reddish-gold amber in appearance with a rich, complex, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich dried fruits, dark chocolate, sweet heather honey, soft peat smoke, fudge, and warm oak spice.

Palate : Full and complex with flavors of dark fruits, honeyed malt, orange zest, nutmeg, cinnamon, and subtle maritime peat.

Finish : Very long, warm, and lingering with sweet dried fruit, toasted oak, and gentle heather smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of pure water to open up the complex fruit, spice, and smoke layers.

highland-park-30-year-old-1.title: Highland Park 30 Year Old
highland-park-30-year-old-1.bodyHtml: Creating balanced, distinct whiskies takes hard work, skill, dedication, and time: harmonised complexity can’t be rushed. Which is why we matured our robust and oily new make spirit for an extended time in a high proportion of refill casks ​along with first-fill sherry seasoned European ​and American oak casks. The resulting flavour profile is an astonishingly complex harmony. There’s that fudgy sweetness found in the more mature Highland Park expressions, but here it’s paired with layers of aromatic spice and dark chocolate orange and floral peat notes.

highland-park-50-year-old.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Cask Strength Highland Park 20 Year Old 2005 First Fill Sherry Butt Cask #2801 59.7% ABV
highland-park-50-year-old.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Highland Park 2005 Cask #2801 is an exceptional single-cask single malt Scotch whisky distilled at Orkney’s famous Highland Park Distillery and matured by master independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail. Distilled in 2005 and aged for 13 years before being bottled at cask strength from a single refill sherry hogshhead, it showcases Highland Park's signature balance of heather honey, subtle peat smoke, and rich sherry wood spice.

Food Pairing: Smoked venison, dark chocolate-covered ginger, roasted duck breast, aged Gouda, and sticky toffee pudding.

Tasting Notes : Light amber in appearance with a full-bodied, rich, and viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet stewed fruit, festive baking spices, dark honey, orange peel, and gentle aromatic peat smoke.

Palate : Rich and complex with notes of dark chocolate, raisins, ginger spice, toasted almonds, and sweet heather honey underpinned by soft maritime smoke.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of charred oak, sweet sherry dried fruits, and gentle peaty ash.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of water to open up the sherry sweetness and aromatic smoke.

highland-park-cask-strength-1.title: Highland Park Cask Strength Release No. 5
highland-park-cask-strength-1.bodyHtml:
Highland Park Cask Strength Release No.5 is a robust and captivating Orkney single malt Scotch whisky bottled at its natural cask strength without chill filtration or added color. Master Whisky Maker Gordon Motion crafted Release No.5 with a high proportion of European oak sherry-seasoned casks, complemented by American oak sherry-seasoned casks, a small quantity of ex-bourbon casks, and first-fill stalk oak casks. This wood combination delivers an exceptional balance of deep dried fruit complexity, warm baking spices, heather honey, and Highland Park's signature delicate aromatic peat smoke.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with smoked venison, dark chocolate tarts, sticky barbecue ribs, aged Gouda, or blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper and amber with a rich, full-bodied viscosity and a velvety, coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic peat smoke, clove, dried fruit, dark chocolate, toasted oak, and sweet heather honey.

Palate : Rich and complex with notes of sun-dried raisins, warm cinnamon, dark cocoa, toasted oak, and lingering heather peat.

Finish : Long, warm, and satisfying with sweet spices, rich oak, and gentle aromatic peat smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to open up the intense cask-strength aromas and soften the ABV.

highland-park-dark-origins-1.title: Highland Park 18 Year Old Viking Pride
highland-park-dark-origins-1.bodyHtml:
Highland Park 18 Year Old 'Viking Pride' is a benchmark Island single malt from Scotland's northernmost distillery in the Orkney Islands. Matured in a high proportion of first-fill European and American oak sherry-seasoned casks, this expression perfectly balances rich, dark sherry fruit and spice with Highland Park's distinct, aromatic Orkney heather peat smoke. Widely decorated and revered globally, it offers a highly harmonious, complex, and full-bodied sipping experience.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate desserts (such as a Black Forest gateau), roasted duck with plum reduction, spiced fruit chutneys with cold meats, smoked salmon, and blue cheeses like Stilton or Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Naturally glowing amber in appearance with a smooth, full, and warming, mouth-coating feel.

Nose : Rich, caramelized sweetness, toffee, and ripe cherries, beautifully supported by dried fruit, dark chocolate, marzipan, and delicate aromatic heather peat smoke.

Palate : Complex and finely balanced, delivering a wave of candied orange zest, dark chocolate, and honeyed fruits alongside cinnamon spice, espresso, and subtle, smoldering heather smoke.

Finish : Long, sweet, and complex, leaving a lingering interplay of gentle peat smoke, winter baking spices, toasted oak, and a slight nuttiness.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its full complexity, or gently opened with a few drops of room-temperature water.

highland-park-fire-1.title: Highland Park Fire Edition 15 Year Old
highland-park-fire-1.bodyHtml:
This 15 Year Old single malt is encased in a specially-commissioned, crimson glass decanter, as an ode to the battle of fire and ice that signified Ragnarök, the end of the old word and the beginning of the new in Norse mythology.

Entirely matured in refill Port seasoned casks – a first for Highland Park – the result is a vibrant whisky with the natural hue of glowing flames. Damsons, cinnamon, dried fruit and chocolate dance on the tongue, before sizzling to an intense fruity finish.

We’ve been crafting our award-winning whisky at the Highland Park Distillery in Kirkwall, Orkney, since 1798. Age, experience and respect for tradition may define our whisky, but it’s Orkney that sets it apart. Something magic happens here and the result is the wild harmony of flavours found in our whisky.

highland-park-full-volume-1.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Cask Strength Highland Park 20 Year Old 2005 First Fill Sherry Butt Cask #2801 59.7% ABV
highland-park-full-volume-1.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Highland Park 2005 Cask #2801 is an exceptional single-cask single malt Scotch whisky distilled at Orkney’s famous Highland Park Distillery and matured by master independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail. Tasting Notes : Light amber in appearance with a full-bodied, rich, and viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet stewed fruit, festive baking spices, dark honey, orange peel, and gentle aromatic peat smoke.

Palate : Rich and complex with notes of dark chocolate, raisins, ginger spice, toasted almonds, and sweet heather honey underpinned by soft maritime smoke.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of charred oak, sweet sherry dried fruits, and gentle peaty ash.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of water to open up the sherry sweetness and aromatic smoke.

highland-park-ice-1.title: Highland Park Ice Edition 17 Year Old
highland-park-ice-1.bodyHtml: Long winters, summer frosts, and impossibly fast winds. The things that can make Orkney a somewhat challenging place to live make it an exceptional climate for creating and maturing extraordinary whisky. In celebration of this, and as a nod to Niflheim, one of the nine worlds of old Norse mythology and the birthplace of ice, frost and fog, we created Ice Edition 17 Year Old. Matured in ex-bourbon casks, Ice Edition offers aromas of cool, fresh pineapple, and ripe mango sorbet, and is balanced with spicy smoke and ginger root. A special release with an ABV of 53.9%, it was released in spring 2016.

highland-park-soren-26-year-old.title: Highland Park 26 Year Old Søren Solkær 26 Years of Photography
highland-park-soren-26-year-old.bodyHtml:
Søren Solkær’s distinctive work, particularly in portraiture, has earned him a global reputation. In 2016, we commissioned Søren to capture our distillery team at work, to record the whisky-making traditions we have followed for over 220 years, and to reflect the stark beauty of the Orcadian landscape that is our home.

This 26 Year Old single malt is accompanied by a leather-bound book which showcases photographic work from the 26 years of Søren’s career. Featuring 160 pages, it draws on three key themes – men, women and places – and includes an absorbing narrative, hand-written by Søren, describing his journey as a ‘visual storyteller.’

highland-park-the-dark.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Cask Strength Highland Park 20 Year Old 2005 First Fill Sherry Butt Cask #2801 59.7% ABV
