highland-park-valfather-1.title: Highland Park Valfather
highland-park-valfather-1.bodyHtml:
Valfather is the final single malt whisky in a series of three special edition Viking Legend releases, inspired by Odin, the mightiest and most complex of the Norse gods, who’s associated with wisdom, sorcery, poetry, death, wolves and ravens. An intriguingly complex figure, it only follows that this whisky should be just as complex…

Winning Gold in the 2020 World Whisky Awards, Valfather is our most peated whisky to date and matured entirely in our finest refill casks to ensure that all that peat is balanced with subtle layers of flavour and character. You’ll taste sweet apple, fragrant pear, crème brûlée, toasted cedarwood and smoked paprika, hence the term ‘stickysmoke’.

The packaging for the whole series was created by Jim Lyngvild, a Danish designer and artist of international renown, whose great grandfather 36 generations ago was Ragnvald Eysteinsson, the first Earl of the Orkney Islands.

highland-park-valknut-1.title: Highland Park Valknut
highland-park-valknut-1.bodyHtml:
Valknut is the second in our Viking Legend series, celebrating our rich Nordic ancestry here in Orkney. The word translates to ‘knot of those slain in battle’ and the symbol of inter-linked triangles represents the transition from earthly life to heavenly life – ‘heavenly’ being the operative word when it comes to this special release, winning Double Gold in the 2019 San Francisco Spirits Competition.

Created using a higher proportion of our local peated malt and matured in a combination of sherry seasoned European and American oak casks and ex-bourbon casks, Valknut walks a fine line between the aromatic spiciness of cloves and cracked black pepper, and the patisserie sweetness of toasted vanilla and creme brûlée.

The packaging for the whole series was created by Jim Lyngvild, a Danish designer and artist of international renown, whose great grandfather 36 generations ago was Ragnvald Eysteinsson, the first Earl of the Orkney Islands.

highland-park-valkyrie-1.title: Highland Park Valkyrie
highland-park-valkyrie-1.bodyHtml:
Valkyrie celebrates our rich Nordic ancestry here in Orkney, once part of a vast Viking kingdom. According to Norse mythology, Valkyries would descend onto the battlefields to find the best and bravest warriors and give them passage to Valhalla.

Valkyrie is the first in a series of three special Viking Legend releases and was awarded the Chairman’s Trophy in the 2017 Ultimate Spirits Challenge, scoring 99 out of 100. The packaging for the whole series was created by Jim Lyngvild, a Danish designer and artist of international renown, whose great grandfather 36 generations ago was Ragnvald Eysteinsson, the first Earl of the Orkney Islands.

The combination of sherry seasoned European and American oak casks with ex-bourbon casks gives Valkyrie the aroma of crisp green apples in a spice market and an aroma of faraway campfires. We call it ‘Liquorice Lantern Smoke’.

highland-park-vintage-1968.title: Highland Park 1990 Vintage Release
highland-park-vintage-1968.bodyHtml:
This beautifully aged whisky opens with aromas of ripe orchard pears, bittersweet grapefruit, delicate geranium and sweet violet, wrapped in a cloud of delicate peat smoke. Enticing notes of pink grapefruit and sweet mandarin orange follow, elegantly balanced by creamy vanilla, crushed coconut and a suggestion of warm nutmeg. Intensely fruity at the finish, hints of freshly-cut wood and heathery peat smoke linger. 

To create our Vintage Series, Gordon Motion, our Master Whisky Maker, personally selects a small quantity of casks that display outstanding character and flavour. By expertly marrying these casks together, he creates a single vintage release that exemplifies the unique and complex balance of flavours that is Highland Park’s trademark. 

For our Vintage 1990 Release, Gordon tipped 34 ex-bourbon casks, originally laid down in 1990, into first-fill sherry seasoned European and American oak hogsheads and refill hogsheads. After a further period of maturation, allowing the whisky to develop the distinctive colour and character driven by each different cask type, Gordon selected five exceptional casks – three European and one American oak hogshead, and one refill hogshead – marrying them together in August 2023 and allowing the whisky time to harmonise before bottling. 

We’ve been crafting our award-winning whisky at the Highland Park Distillery in Kirkwall, Orkney, since 1798. Age, experience and respect for tradition may define our whisky, but it’s Orkney that sets it apart.

hilbing-malbec-gin-1.title: Trivento Golden Reserve Malbec 2023
hilbing-malbec-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Trivento Golden Reserve Malbec 2023 is a premium, estate-grown Argentinian red wine that presents an intense, deep red color with vibrant violet hues. The aromatic profile is highly expressive, unfolding with sharp layers of fresh red and dark fruits like raspberries, blackberries, and spiced black cherries, woven together with subtle notes of chocolate, lavender, graphite, and toasted hazelnut from careful oak aging. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied experience with a juicy, rounded structure and firm, energetic tannins that lead into a remarkably smooth and lengthy finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri sauce, roasted lamb cutlets, barbecued brisket, empanadas, and strong, hard cheeses like aged Gouda or Manchego.

93 Points - James Suckling

Some fine spices with a touch of cocoa powder to the black cherries and berries. Medium- to full-bodied with plenty of juicy blue fruit and firm, fresh tannins. Solid fruit in the lengthy finish. Really well-balanced. Drink now or hold.

hornitos-anejo.title: Hornitos Anejo Tequila
hornitos-anejo.bodyHtml:
Hornitos Añejo is aged in white oak barrels for at least a year, which gives it a smoother, more complex character and a distinctive amber colour. The oak adds hazelnut, vanilla and dried fruit to the agave-forward profile shared by every tequila in the Hornitos range, the brand Don Francisco launched in 1950 in honour of Mexican Independence Day. Rich tawny brown in the glass and bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Fine agave with herbal and green apple notes.

Palate: Sweet vanilla, hazelnut and dried fruit with a strong agave nectar flavour.

Finish: Deep, rich and complex, drying slightly.

Serve: Neat or over a large ice cube, or in a tequila Old Fashioned.

hornitos-black-barrel-anejo.title: Hornitos Black Barrel Añejo Tequila
hornitos-black-barrel-anejo.bodyHtml:
Hornitos Black Barrel is an añejo tequila bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle; the label reads 'Tequila Añejo' and '100% agave' and states that it is aged 18 months. It starts as an aged añejo, then spends four months in deep-charred oak barrels, which give it a rich, smoky flavour and golden amber colour, followed by two further months in specially toasted barrels for added depth and complexity. It pours dark amber, with aromas of oak, vanilla and pepper and a palate of agave and citrus that leads to a long, warm finish. This listing is the current brown bottle with the gold label.

Tasting Notes: Oak, vanilla and pepper over agave and citrus.

Nose: Oak, vanilla and pepper.

Palate: Agave and citrus.

Finish: Long and warm.

Food Pairing: Tequila-lime chicken.

Serve: Serve neat or over ice with a wedge of lime.

hornitos-plata.title: Hornitos Plata Tequila
hornitos-plata.bodyHtml:
Hornitos Plata is the unaged silver tequila from Hornitos, the brand Don Francisco launched in 1950 in honour of Mexican Independence Day. Made from 100% blue Weber agave grown in Jalisco, it is crafted to put fresh agave flavour first, with bright herbal and citrus notes and a smooth, lively character that suits sipping and mixing alike. Crystal clear with silver hints, it is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Floral, fruity and herbal, with light citrus.

Palate: Agave-forward, with citrus notes.

Finish: Warm and medium-bodied, short but smooth, then dry.

Serve: Neat, over ice with a squeeze of lime, or in a Margarita or Paloma.

hornitos-reposado.title: Hornitos Reposado Tequila
hornitos-reposado.bodyHtml:
REPOSADO TEQUILA
Boldly born in 1950, to celebrate the anniversary of Mexican independence, Hornitos?debuted as a Reposado, one of the first of its kind. We made Reposado decades before it became common practice, and to this day, it remains a symbol of our shot taking spirit.

icebox-black-russian-1.title: Icebox Black Russian 1.14L
icebox-black-russian-1.bodyHtml:
Icebox Black Russian is a bottled Black Russian cocktail from the Icebox range of ready-made cocktails, produced in Quebec, Canada. It comes in a 1.14L bottle at 34.9% ABV, so the classic after-dinner drink is ready to pour without measuring.

Serve: Pour over ice in a rocks glass.

icebox-long-island-iced-tea-1.title: Icebox Long Island Iced Tea
icebox-long-island-iced-tea-1.bodyHtml:
Icebox Long Island Iced Tea is a ready-to-mix version of the classic Long Island Iced Tea, sold in a 750ml bottle at 38% ABV. The cocktail traditionally brings together several white spirits with cola, and Icebox does the measuring for you by combining vodka, triple sec liqueur, rum and gin in a single bottle, as listed on the label. It is not meant to be drunk straight from the bottle: the label instructs to add cola and lime juice. At full spirit strength it gives the same punch as a bar-made Long Island, with none of the work, which makes it a practical choice for parties, patios and cottage weekends.

Serve: Pour over a tall glass of ice, top with cola and add a squeeze of lime.

icebox-long-island-iced-tea-3.title: Icebox Long Island Iced Tea 1.14L
icebox-long-island-iced-tea-3.bodyHtml:

il-palazzone-brunello-di-montalcino-2015.title: San Polino Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2015
il-palazzone-brunello-di-montalcino-2015.bodyHtml:
A fresh and elegant Montalcino red with bright cherry, raspberry, red plum, violet, and subtle earthy spice. Medium-bodied and lively, it combines vibrant acidity with supple tannins, juicy fruit, and a clean savory finish with excellent drinkability.

Food Pairing: Pair with pasta, pizza, grilled poultry, pork, roasted vegetables, salumi, mushroom dishes, or young Tuscan cheeses.

97 Points - James Suckling

The beauty and balance of this Brunello is wonderful, offering blueberry, black-cherry and violet character. It’s full-bodied, yet so layered and refined with and ultra fine palate of silky tannins. A joy to taste...One both to drink and for the cellar.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Made with organically farmed grapes and fermented with wild yeasts, this delicious wine has balsamic aromas of camphor that mingle with new leather, blue flower and spiced plum. Generous and enveloping, the full-bodied palate is full of flavor and already approachable, doling out dried black cherry, blackberry jam and licorice before a baking-spice close. Drink 2022–2028. Kerin O’Keefe

imperial-rioja-gran-reserva-2011.title: CVNE Imperial Gran Reserva Rioja 2019
imperial-rioja-gran-reserva-2011.bodyHtml:
CVNE Imperial Gran Reserva Rioja 2019 is an exceptional Spanish red wine from the prestigious Rioja Alta region, produced by Compañía Vinícola del Norte de España (CVNE). Crafted only in outstanding vintages, this distinguished blend of Tempranillo, Graciano, and Mazuelo undergoes two years of maturation in French and American oak barrels. Rich blackcurrant, ripe plum, tobacco, and dark spice unfold across an elegant palate with polished tannins and remarkable depth. Complex, structured, and beautifully balanced, this Gran Reserva offers classic Rioja character and excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Roast lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, venison, slow-cooked beef, mushroom risotto, aged Manchego, and traditional Spanish dishes.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

Blackberries and violets, with plenty of fruit yet a crunchy restrained profile. The palate is medium- to full-bodied with red and dark fruit throughout, tending toward firm, chalky, imposing tannins of high quality. There is plenty of flavor with a sense of contained richness and withheld expressivity that will reward patience. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

2019 was a warm and classical year of healthy grapes, and the 2019 Imperial Gran Reserva is a powerful version only produced in exceptional years. Produced with a blend of Tempranillo with 10% Graciano and 5% Mazuelo, it fermented in oak vats with their own selected yeasts, and the wine matured for two years in new and used barriques, 80% of them French and the rest American. It has a classical nose, with notes of dry leaves, truffle, cigar ash and dark spices and a touch of iodine and earth. It comes in at 14% alcohol, with a pH of 3.63 and 5.67 grams of acidity. It's harmonious and balanced, with elegant, polished and sleek tannins. 56,000 bottles produced. It was bottled in July 2022.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

An enticing red, with a lovely nose of mountain herbs, graphite, dried violet and sandalwood, aromas that waft through a dark, concentrated range of black currant, black cherry and plum sauce fruit flavors. This is long and vibrant, with fine-grained tannins firming the finish of ripe fruit, spiced orange peel and leather notes. Tempranillo, Graciano and Mazuelo. Drink now through 2039.

inchgower-27-year-old.title: Inchgower 27 Year Old
inchgower-27-year-old.bodyHtml: Burly and brooding on the nose, this whisky finds notes of aggressive earth and bold leather notes, with hints of mushroom and a bit of smoke. Initially the palate follows in suit as expected, earthy and chewy, before finally offering up some relief in the form of hints of orange peel and grapefruit, lavender, and some cocoa powder. It’s surprisingly a bit jumbled, leading to a finish that reprises slightly ashy/smoky grains over the more engaging fruit notes hidden deep within.

inglenook-cabernet-sauvignon-2017.title: Inglenook 1882 Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
inglenook-cabernet-sauvignon-2017.bodyHtml:
Inglenook 1882 Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 is a classic, expressive, and historic Napa Valley red wine crafted to honor Gustave Niebaum’s inaugural vintage at Inglenook. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyard blocks—including Chateau, Cohn, and Red Barn—rooted in the deep, gravelly loam soils of the Rutherford Bench, it displays a deep garnet-red hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is inviting and nuanced, revealing aromas of ripe black cherries, macerated plums, and fresh cassis layered over undertones of dark cocoa powder, cedar, sweet pipe tobacco, and subtle baking spices derived from 18 months of aging in French oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied, vibrant, and supple, delivering a solid core of juicy dark fruits framed by refined, fine-grained "Rutherford dust" tannins and balanced natural acidity, concluding in a structured, long, and lightly spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, rosemary venison medallions, and aged white cheddar or gouda cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A solid cabernet with lots of blackberry, chocolate and walnut character. It's full-bodied with plenty of fruit and a flavourful finish. Juicy and intense. Needs time to soften and mellow.

j-b-rare-2.title: J&B Rare 1.14L
j-b-rare-2.bodyHtml:
J&B Rare is the flagship blended Scotch of Justerini & Brooks, the London wine and spirits merchant founded in 1749 on St James's Street. The blend first appeared as J&B Club and took the Rare name in 1930. It is built from 42 malt and grain whiskies, with Speyside malts at its heart: Knockando, Auchroisk, Strathmill and Glen Spey supply the core malts, and the recipe and the bright yellow label have barely changed since the 1930s. Light, dry and clean in style, with herbaceous and floral notes, it is a versatile whisky for highballs and mixed drinks. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 1.14L bottle. J&B is owned by Diageo.

Serve: Over ice, with soda in a highball, or in a Rob Roy.

j-lohr-hilltop-cabernet-sauvignon-1.title: J. Lohr 'Hilltop' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
j-lohr-hilltop-cabernet-sauvignon-1.bodyHtml:
J. Lohr 'Hilltop' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is an exceptionally polished, expressive, and dark-fruited red wine that beautifully captures the high-elevation terroir of Paso Robles. Sourced primarily from the Shotwell Vineyard in the El Pomar District and the Beck Vineyard in the Creston District, this mountain-influenced Cabernet Sauvignon is enhanced by small percentages of Petit Verdot, Malbec, and Cabernet Franc before aging for 16 months in French oak barrels. In the glass, it displays a dense ruby-purple color with bright clarity. The highly aromatic nose opens with striking scents of ripe black cherries, stewed plums, and blackberry compote, masterfully interwoven with nuanced accents of hazelnut, coffee bean, violet, and warm vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and layered, displaying an engaging fluid coherence where its core of dark currant fruit is effortlessly supported by a lively line of natural acidity and dusty, fine-grained tannins, culminating in a long, elegant finish marked by savory notes of cocoa, marjoram, and a touch of sweet toasted pastry.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rosemary-seasoned grilled ribeye steak, garlic-roasted potatoes with fennel, slow-cooked beef brisket, or mature extra-sharp white cheddar.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Red and purple fruit-syrup aromas meet with pencil shavings, violet, coffee and toasted nut aromas on the nose of this widely available and always reliable Cab. The palate is dry and layered in firm tannins that carry forth flavors of blackberry, oregano, coffee bean and marjoram, sliding into an elegant finish.

j-lohr-riverstone-chardonnay-2017.title: J. Lohr 'Riverstone' Chardonnay 2023
j-lohr-riverstone-chardonnay-2017.bodyHtml:
The 2023 J. Lohr 'Riverstone' Chardonnay is a benchmark cool-climate white that showcases the balance between vibrant acidity and rich texture. Sourced from the windswept Arroyo Seco region, the 2023 vintage is defined by its aromatic complexity and bright fruit energy. It offers an inviting bouquet of ripe pear, apricot, and meyer lemon, interwoven with sophisticated notes of roasted hazelnuts, honey, and crème brûlée. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and creamy, featuring a lush mouthfeel derived from seven to nine months of aging in French, American, and Hungarian oak barrels. A refreshing streak of acidity provides excellent lift, leading to a long finish with a subtle, toasty oak spice.

91 Points - James Suckling

This full-bodied, round and buttery chardonnay has notes of baked apples, toast and brown butter. Ripe, soft and generous. 

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Candied apple and honeysuckle aromas are fresh and clean on the nose of this bottling. The palate is broad with toasted brioche and baked apple flavors that grow a bit more complex by the finish.

j-lohr-seven-oaks-cabernet-sauvignon.title: J. Lohr 'Seven Oaks' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
j-lohr-seven-oaks-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The 2022 J. Lohr 'Seven Oaks' Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic and fruit-forward icon that has defined the Paso Robles style for over thirty vintages. Born from a dry and warm growing season, it presents an exceptionally dark color and a layered bouquet of black cherry, currant, and plum, accented by an authentic barrel-aged bouquet of toasted pastry, hazelnut, and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and smooth, featuring juicy red-fruit flavors supported by velvety, softly textured tannins. Matured for 12 months in 60-gallon American oak barrels (18% new wood), it balances its concentrated ripeness with a long, gratifying finish. It is widely recognized as a "best buy" for its consistency and is ideal for pairing with grilled ribeye steak or hearty pasta dishes.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, hearty beef stews, sausage pasta, and aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

90 Points - James Suckling

Currants, sage, roasted plums and cloves on the nose of this rich and spicy red. It’s full-bodied, plush and toasty, with ripe tannins.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Damp earth aromas lead quickly into sharp yet ripe cherry aromas on the nose of this bottling. Likable flavors of black cherry greet the palate, as wet clay, cocoa, mint and mace flavors add impressive complexity at this price point.

j-wray-white-rum-1.title: J. Wray & Nephew White Overproof Rum
j-wray-white-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Wray & Nephew ltd, established in 1825, has made it's signature overproof rum for over 180 years. With top notes of citrus, pear and pineapple, married with bottom notes of honey and molasses this rum creates an intense, multi-sensorial flavour.

Enjoy in easy mix cocktails like the classic Wray & Ting1 Part Wray & Nephew Overprood Rum5 Parts Ting Grapefruit SodaWedge of LimeBuild Wray & Nephew Overproof Rum with Ting over cubed ice in a highball glass. Garnish with a wedge of lime.

jack-daniels-old-no-7-tennessee-whisky.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey 200ml
jack-daniels-old-no-7-tennessee-whisky.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey is an iconic, smooth American whiskey crafted in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Charcoal mellowed drop-by-drop through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before aging in handcrafted white oak barrels, it offers a distinct balance of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, and smooth caramel character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, pulled pork sandwiches, grilled burgers, smoked brisket, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold in appearance with a light-to-medium-bodied, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, banana, and subtle brown sugar.

Palate : Balanced mix of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, light spice, and rich caramel.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and medium-length with lingering toasted oak, charcoal, and sweet spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed with cola in a highball glass.

jack-daniels-single-barrel.title: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Select Tennessee Whiskey
jack-daniels-single-barrel.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Select is a Tennessee whiskey from the Jack Daniel Distillery in Lynchburg, Tennessee, established in 1866. Every bottle comes from one individual barrel, chosen for its character from the upper levels of the maturation warehouses, where greater temperature swings drive the whiskey deeper into the toasted oak. Like all Jack Daniel's, the spirit is mellowed through sugar maple charcoal before ageing in American white oak barrels. Bottled at 94 proof (47% ABV) in a 750ml bottle, it offers a more concentrated oak, caramel and spice profile than Old No. 7, lifted by bright fruit and sweet aromatics, and each barrel brings its own variation.

Tasting Notes: Caramel and spice with bright fruit.

Nose: Sweet fruit and vanilla with a touch of spice underneath.

Palate: Spice with warm, rich caramel.

Finish: Medium oak, clove and banana.

Serve: Neat, or in an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

jack-daniels-tennessee-apple.title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Apple
jack-daniels-tennessee-apple.bodyHtml: The distinct character of Jack Daniel's charcoal-mellowed Tennessee Whiskey, blended with vibrant natural apple flavour. Experience caramel, toasted oak and spicy notes, coupled with fresh green apple. Enjoy neat over ice, or add crisp apple nuances to your favourite whiskey cocktail.

jack-daniels-tennessee-fire.title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Fire
jack-daniels-tennessee-fire.bodyHtml: The addition of fiery spice to the mellow character of Jack Daniel's creates this unique spirit. Shows bold aromas of cinnamon candy and honey. The palate is sweet and spicy with a warming mouthfeel and flavours of cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla that repeat on a long finish. Serve straight up, over ice, or use in cocktails.

jack-daniels-tennessee-honey.title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Honey
jack-daniels-tennessee-honey.bodyHtml: A blend of Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey and a unique honey liqueur of their own making, for a taste that's one-of-a-kind and unmistakably Jack. With hints of honey and a finish that's naturally smooth, Jack Daniel's Tennessee Honey offers a taste of the unexpected.

jack-daniels-winter-jack.title: Jack Daniel's Winter Jack Tennessee Apple Whiskey Punch
jack-daniels-winter-jack.bodyHtml: A seasonal blend of apple cider liqueur, Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey and holiday spices. Best served warm. Enticing aromas of apple cider, orange peel, cinnamon and Jack Daniel's. Reminiscent flavours of apple pie with a toasted oak and vanilla finish.

jack-daniel-s-single-barrel-2020-special.title: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Special Release Barrel Proof Rye 2020
jack-daniel-s-single-barrel-2020-special.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel’s Single Barrel 2020 Special Release Barrel Proof Rye is a Tennessee Rye that features the distillery’s newest grain bill since Prohibition. Made up of 70% rye, 12% malt and 18% corn, the barrels for it were aged in the highest areas of a barrel house, “resulting in what’s officially described as “a deep copper hue with robust aromas of deep smoke, raisin, rich caramel and toasted fruit; boasting tastes of molasses, sawn oak and bold rye spices with a peppery finish.”

“Our team created this special release to give our friends the chance to taste our rye whiskey at the proof mother nature created,” said Jack Daniel’s newly appointed Master Distiller Chris Fletchert. “This barrel proof offering is as close as you can get to being inside a barrelhouse and sampling for yourself.

“I’m excited to begin my tenure as Master Distiller alongside this special release that celebrates our award-winning rye whiskey, and I look forward to sharing it with the many friends of Jack who are sure to be satisfied.”

jack-daniels-sinatra-select-1.title: Jack Daniel's Sinatra Select Tennessee Whiskey 1L
jack-daniels-sinatra-select-1.bodyHtml:
A premium tribute to Frank Sinatra's enduring loyalty to Jack Daniel's. Bottled at 90 proof and presented in a stunning 1-liter bottle, Sinatra Select is aged in proprietary "Sinatra Barrels." These custom barrels feature deep grooves carved into the staves, exposing the whiskey to extra layers of toasted oak during maturation. The result is an exceptionally dark, rich, and robust Tennessee Whiskey with a bold oak character and a legendary smoothness fitting of Ol' Blue Eyes himself.

 

NOSE

Soft honey, crisp fresh apples, and a bold, inviting aroma of toasted oak.

PALATE

Incredibly rich and velvety, delivering deep flavors of sweet caramel, vanilla bean, dark chocolate, and heavy oak spice.

FINISH

Exceptionally smooth, long, and warm, leaving a signature hint of classic Jack Daniel's smoke.

jack-daniels-single-barrel-barrel-proof-.title: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Select Tennessee Whiskey

jackson-triggs-malbec-1.title: Jackson Triggs Malbec 4L Bag in Box
jackson-triggs-malbec-1.bodyHtml:
Jackson Triggs Malbec in a 4L bag-in-box is a Canadian red wine with notes of berries, plum, and spice. It is a medium-bodied wine with a smooth finish. The wine is also known for its deep color and is a good pairing with steak, roast beef, and sharp cheddar, according to Wine and Beyond. 

86 Points - Wine Align
"A soft, fruit-forward Malbec with plum and berry notes. Consistent and easy-drinking, offering great value in a convenient format."
85 Points - Gismondi on Wine
"An approachable, everyday red with simple dark fruit flavors and a smooth finish. A practical choice for large gatherings."

jacobs-creek-double-barrel-shiraz-1.title: Jacob's Creek Double Barrel Shiraz 750ml
jacobs-creek-double-barrel-shiraz-1.bodyHtml: Jacob's Creek Double Barrel Shiraz is a 750ml bottle of red wine that is known for its unique "double barrel" aging process, which involves finishing the wine in aged Scotch whisky barrels after the initial aging in traditional wine barrels. This process gives the wine a richer, smoother flavor profile with notes of blackberry, plum, and vanilla, along with charry and toasted oak hints.

jacobs-creek-moscato-1.title: Jacob's Creek Moscato
jacobs-creek-moscato-1.bodyHtml:
Jacob's Creek Moscato is a light, delightfully refreshing, and beautifully aromatic sweet white wine produced by one of Australia's most prominent and historically rich estates. Crafted with a focus on youthful, clean fruit expressions, it features a very gentle, playful spritz that enhances its lively nature. In the glass, it displays a beautiful pale straw-yellow hue. The highly inviting bouquet opens with fragrant notes of ripe tropical fruits, juicy white peach, and honeydew melon, elegantly complemented by delicate hints of citrus blossom, fresh ginger, and honeysuckle. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, sweet, and wonderfully balanced, delivering a luscious core of lychee, grapey sweetness, and soft sherbet flavors. A crisp, zesty natural acidity perfectly cuts through the sweetness, preventing it from feeling heavy and ensuring a clean, vibrant, and incredibly refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh fruit platters, light pavlova, moderately spicy Thai noodle dishes, crispy vegetable spring rolls, and mild, creamy blue cheeses.

jameson-black-barrel.title: Jameson Black Barrel Irish Whiskey
jameson-black-barrel.bodyHtml: Charring is an age-old method for invigorating barrels to intensify the taste. Jameson Black Barrel is our tribute to our coopers, who painstakingly give their bourbon barrels an additional charring to reveal their untold richness and complexity. Because every barrel contains secrets; the trick is coaxing them out.

jameson-caskmates-ipa.title: Jameson Caskmates IPA Edition Irish Whiskey
jameson-caskmates-ipa.bodyHtml:
Since we swapped stout beer barrels with our friends at Franciscan Well Brewery in 2013 to create the Jameson Caskmates Stout Edition, we couldn?t wait to try a new beer mate with our casks.

Our whiskey makers down in our Midleton Distillery have stuck their toes in the water (don?t worry that?s just figurative) once again to create Jameson Caskmates IPA Edition - blended Irish whiskey finished in craft Irish Pale Ale-seasoned barrels.

jameson-caskmates-stout.title: Jameson Caskmates Stout Edition Irish Whiskey
jameson-caskmates-stout.bodyHtml: Like all the best conversations, the one between Jameson?s Head of Whiskey Science and the Head Brewer of a local craft beer brewery, started at the bar. A swapping of whiskey and beer barrels soon after, resulted in Jameson Caskmates Stout Edition - triple-distilled, blended Irish Whiskey that has been patiently finished in Irish craft beer-seasoned barrels.

jameson-cold-brew.title: Jameson Cold Brew Irish Whiskey
jameson-cold-brew.bodyHtml:
Jameson Cold Brew is a coffee-flavoured Irish whiskey that brings together triple-distilled Jameson Irish Whiskey and natural cold brew coffee made with Arabica beans from Brazil and Colombia. It is bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The aroma is led by rich coffee bean, backed by the vanilla nuttiness of Jameson; the taste is bold and coffee-driven, followed by a charred wood note from the pot still whiskey, with a full-bodied, smooth and warming feel. It is made to be enjoyed cold rather than as a hot Irish Coffee.

Nose: Intense coffee bean with vanilla and nutty Jameson character.

Palate: Refreshing cold brew coffee, then charred wood from the pot still whiskey; full-bodied and smooth.

Serve: Chilled, over ice, with cola and a twist of orange.

jameson-crested.title: Jameson Irish Whiskey 1.75L
jameson-crested.bodyHtml:
Jameson Irish Whiskey is a globally renowned, exceptionally smooth spirit that embodies the classic taste of Ireland. Produced at the Midleton Distillery in County Cork, it is crafted using a blend of rich pot still and fine grain whiskeys. By triple distilling the spirit and aging it in fine oak casks for a minimum of four years, Jameson achieves its signature, perfectly balanced character that is celebrated for having no harsh edge.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pub classics like fish and chips, savory shepherd's pie, or a rich beef and Guinness stew. It also complements sharp Irish cheddar, smoked salmon, and desserts like bread pudding or dark chocolate squares.

Tasting Notes : Bright light-amber appearance with an exceptionally smooth, light-to-medium-bodied, and clean mouthfeel.

Nose : Light floral fragrance peppered with spicy wood, sweet notes of fresh orchard fruit, cut grass, and a gentle hint of vanilla.

Palate : Perfectly balanced fusion of sweet vanilla, crisp green apple, fresh pear, subtle toasted wood, and a touch of hazelnut.

Finish : Incredibly clean and smooth, leaving behind a brief, pleasant warmth and a lingering, soft note of spice and sweet grain.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, mixed with ginger ale and lime, or as the base in an Irish Coffee.

jaral-de-berrio-mezcal.title: Paquera Barril Mezcal Artesanal
jaral-de-berrio-mezcal.bodyHtml:
Crafted in Ejutla de Crespo, Oaxaca, Mexico, Paquera Barril is an artisanal single-varietal mezcal produced by master mezcalero Francisco Javier Perez Cruz. Made from 100% wild-harvested Barril agave (Agave karwinskii), which takes 12 to 15 years to mature as a tall, tree-like cylindrical plant, this expression showcases the intense minerality and herbal focus characteristic of the Karwinskii family. The wild piñas are slow-roasted in traditional underground conical stone pits fueled by local oak, crushed using a horse-drawn stone tahona wheel, and open-fermented in wooden vats using natural wild airborne yeasts. Double-distilled in traditional copper pot stills, this unaged mezcal offers a bright, highly structured profile defined by crisp green herbs, wet stone minerality, citrus oils, and balanced mesquite smoke.

Food Pairing: Grilled octopus with olive oil, Oaxacan mole verde, roasted pork carnitas, fresh goat cheese crostini, ceviche with lime, or dark chocolate with sea salt.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear in appearance with brilliant clarity, a silky medium body, and crisp, delicate tears.

Nose: Bright, herbal, and mineral-forward, opening with sweet cooked agave, crushed green mint, and damp earth, accompanied by soft wood smoke, lime zest, white pepper, and fresh pine needle accents.

Palate: Vibrant, dry, and complex on the palate, featuring caramelized agave nectar, green melon, and crisp citrus upfront before unfolding into layers of mild mesquite smoke, cracked black pepper, fresh garden herbs, and chalky stone minerality.

Finish: Medium-long, clean, and refreshing with lingering notes of sweet agave, gentle oak smoke, zesty grapefruit pith, and a dry, earthy mineral warmth.

Serve: Enjoy neat at room temperature in a traditional clay copita or Glencairn glass to allow the crisp herbal and mineral nuance of wild Barril agave to fully open.

jeffersons-chefs-collaboration.title: Jefferson's Chef's Collaboration Blended Straight Whiskey
jeffersons-chefs-collaboration.bodyHtml:
This combination of bourbon and rye is a perfect combination of fruit flavors up front and the spice of the rye at the end.

FLAVOR
Fruity, soft and smooth with peaches and buttery oaky notes and a lot of rye in the heart.

FINISH
Spicy and warm mediate finish with Rye being the backbone of it.

NOSE
Cherry and oak aromas and a hint of raw Rye spices in the background.

jeffersons-reserve-ocean-aged-at-sea-bou.title: Jefferson's Ocean Aged At Sea Bourbon
jeffersons-reserve-ocean-aged-at-sea-bou.bodyHtml:
Jefferson's Ocean Aged At Sea Bourbon is a highly unique and innovative straight bourbon whiskey that undergoes a extraordinary maturation process aboard ocean-going ships. After spending its initial years aging on dry land, barrels of this bourbon are loaded into shipping containers and sailed across the globe, crossing the equator multiple times and visiting dozens of ports across five continents. The constant motion of the sea, dramatic temperature fluctuations, and hyper-exposure to salty maritime air accelerate the oak interaction, resulting in a rich, deeply caramelized, and distinctly briny flavor profile unlike any traditional bourbon.

Food Pairing: Sweet and savory BBQ pulled pork, grilled ribeye steak with compound butter, salted caramel desserts, dark chocolate torte, and sharp aged gouda or cheddar.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper and dark amber in appearance with a thick, rich, and remarkably viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich and inviting, opening with prominent aromas of salted caramel, dark vanilla, and toasted oak, followed by dried fruit, brown sugar, and a distinct sea-spray minerality.

Palate : Full-bodied and complex. A bold rush of dark fruit, sweet caramel, and vanilla custard gives way to heavy wood spice, toasted oak, cinnamon, and a signature savory, salted pretzel note.

Finish : Long, warm, and satisfyingly dry, leaving lingering notes of dark chocolate, baking spices, rich oak, and a delicate briny saltiness.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to fully appreciate its dark fruit and subtle maritime salinity, or over a large ice cube to open up the sweet caramel and oak spices.

jeffersons-reserve-pritchard-hill-cabern.title: Jefferson's Reserve Bourbon
jeffersons-reserve-pritchard-hill-cabern.bodyHtml:
Jefferson's Reserve Bourbon is a highly regarded, sophisticated expression that showcases the brand’s mastery of small-batch blending. Originally created by co-founder Trey Zoeller to challenge the prevailing standard of big, high-proof bourbons, this expression is a meticulous marriage of old, mature Kentucky straight bourbons of varying ages. By selecting and blending small batches of fully matured whiskies, the distillery achieves a deeply layered, rich, and robust character while retaining an incredibly smooth and elegant texture. This patient approach results in a big, complex, and highly balanced bourbon that stands as a definitive benchmark for premium small-batch whiskey craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with dry-aged ribeye steaks, smoked gouda or blue cheese, rich dark chocolate caramels, or classic pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper-amber in appearance with a rich, viscous, and elegantly well-rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Complex and inviting, opening with deep aromas of rich vanilla bean, toasted oak, and roasted pecans, beautifully layered with subtle hints of dark fruit, aged leather, and warm baking spices.

Palate : Full-bodied, rich, and sophisticated. A robust wave of sweet honey, dark caramel, and baked apples gives way to deep, earthy notes of sweet tobacco, worn leather, and warm cinnamon spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and deeply satisfying, leaving a lingering, elegant impression of sweet toasted oak, roasted nuts, and soft vanilla.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to fully appreciate its mature complexity, over a single large ice cube, or as a highly elevated base for a premium Old Fashioned.

jeffersons-reserve-small-batch-bourbon.title: Jefferson's Bourbon
jeffersons-reserve-small-batch-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Jefferson's Bourbon (often recognized by its flagship "Very Small Batch" expression) is an expertly crafted blend of straight bourbon whiskeys selected by founder and Master Blender Trey Zoeller. Named in honor of Thomas Jefferson's curiosity and experimental spirit, this bourbon is built on the art of blending. Zoeller sources distinct bourbons of varying ages and mashbills, marrying them in remarkably small batches to achieve a consistent, smooth, and fruit-forward flavor profile. The result is an exceptionally soft, elegant, and highly approachable whiskey that appeals to both bourbon novices and seasoned aficionados alike.

Food Pairing: Maple-glazed pork chops, grilled peaches, soft brie cheese with honey, caramel-drizzled bread pudding, and lightly salted roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden-honey in appearance with a light, remarkably soft, and easy-drinking mouthfeel.

Nose : Gentle and inviting, showcasing sweet vanilla, ripe peaches, bright citrus zest, and soft caramel, underscored by a faint hint of toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and incredibly approachable. A sweet, delicate medley of vanilla, honey, and fresh berry fruits blends beautifully with mild cinnamon, sweet corn, and a touch of peppery oak spice.

Finish : Clean, warm, and of medium length, leaving a soft lingering note of sweet vanilla, citrus, and gentle baking spice without any harsh burn.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, over a large ice cube, or as a highly versatile, smooth foundation for classic whiskey cocktails like a Whiskey Sour or a Kentucky Mule.

jiangsi-yanghe-dream-blue-m3-meng-zhi-la.title: Yanghe Mengzhilan-Dream Blue M6+
jiangsi-yanghe-dream-blue-m3-meng-zhi-la.bodyHtml:
Yanghe Mengzhilan Dream Blue M6+ is a Chinese baijiu from Jiangsu Yanghe Distillery, part of the Yanghe Blue Classic range (梦之蓝 Mengzhilan, "Dream Blue"). It is made from a multi-grain recipe of water, sorghum, rice, glutinous rice, wheat, corn, barley and peas. The M6+ is a premium expression in the Dream Blue line, presented in a deep blue bottle. Bottled at 52% ABV in a 550ml bottle.

Serve: Neat at room temperature in small cups, traditionally alongside a meal.

jiangsi-yanghe-dream-blue-m6-meng-zhi-la.title: Yanghe Mengzhilan-Dream Blue M6 52% ABV
jiangsi-yanghe-dream-blue-m6-meng-zhi-la.bodyHtml:
M6 is produced in the central area of Dream Blue production region. Known as the superstar of its kind, the liquor undergoes a fermentation period as long as 180 days in the century-old liquor pits, and is stored for 15 years in the underground cellar.

The magic of dreams radiates hues of blue—the essence of Mengzhilan is the Chinese dream. Alive and unique, it is the dream of an individual, a nation, a country. It seeks to surpass, lead and improve; it embodies tranquility, tolerance, and gentleness. Mengzhilan is our high-end products and is oriented towards the elite pinnacle of the liquor market. With its classic characteristics, Mengzhilan is our salute to Chinese distilling craftsmanship, culture, and history. Carrying on traditional craftsmanship and distilling techniques from ancient Yanghe, we use base liquor stored for centuries underground as flavoring, strictly controlling every step of the production process. Mengzhilan is strong but not overpowering, gentle but not weak. The taste, bountiful and harmonious, unfolds slowly and ends with a clean finish. The flavor is exquisite and mellow with a long aftertaste. It is truly a masterpiece of Chinese mellow liquor.

jiangsi-yanghe-dream-blue-m9-meng-zhi-la.title: Yanghe Mengzhilan Dream Blue M9 Baijiu 500ml
jiangsi-yanghe-dream-blue-m9-meng-zhi-la.bodyHtml:
M9 is produced in the core area of Dream Blue production region. From production to selection to storage, M9 follows a very strict procedure. About every 50l of quality original baijiu can only produce 50ml M9. Each bottle of M9 is at least 20 years old. The liquor is stored in small pots for 8,000 days in the century-old underground cellar. It features yellowish color, fragrant odor, and a mellow taste.

jim-beam-apple-1.title: Jim Beam Maple 1L
jim-beam-apple-1.bodyHtml:
Jim Beam Maple Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey combines genuine Jim Beam Kentucky Straight Bourbon with natural maple flavour for a rich, sweet and approachable take on the classic Jim Beam profile. Bottled at 35% ABV, it layers the underlying bourbon character with brown maple sweetness, caramel, vanilla and warming spice, creating a smooth flavoured whiskey suited to sipping chilled, over ice or in cocktails. 

Food Pairing: Pair with smoked bacon, barbecue pork, glazed ham, pancakes or waffles, roasted pecans, apple pie or vanilla ice cream.

Tasting Notes: Rich maple sweetness leads into vanilla, caramel and butterscotch, balanced by gentle bourbon character and warming cinnamon and ginger spice.

Nose: Sweet maple and vanilla aromas with caramel, butterscotch and subtle cinnamon.

Palate: Smooth and sweet with maple syrup, caramel, vanilla and butterscotch complemented by gentle bourbon warmth and spice.

Finish: Smooth and warming with lingering maple, butterscotch, cinnamon and a touch of ginger spice.

jim-beam-black-bourbon.title: Jim Beam Black 7 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
jim-beam-black-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Jim Beam Black 7 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon is an extra-aged expression produced by the historic Jim Beam Distillery in Clermont, Kentucky. Reintroduced with a 7-year age statement, this bourbon is crafted using Jim Beam's classic high-corn mashbill and aged in charred new American oak barrels for seven years. The extended aging process enhances the depth of flavor, imparting rich caramel, vanilla, and refined oak notes to the classic Jim Beam character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue brisket, pulled pork, grilled steaks, aged cheddar cheese, pecan pie, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber in color, delivering a rich, smooth, and full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Warm vanilla, sweet caramel, toasted oak, and subtle notes of cinnamon spice and dark fruit.

Palate : Smooth and rich with flavors of brown sugar, butterscotch, toasted oak, vanilla bean, and light baking spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet oak, caramel, and gentle spice.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass, on the rocks, or as a base in classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

jim-beam-devils-cut-1.title: Jim Beam Devil's Cut Bourbon
jim-beam-devils-cut-1.bodyHtml:
A bold and intensely woody Kentucky Straight Bourbon that extracts the rich whiskey trapped deep within the barrel. As bourbon ages, a portion of the liquid is lost to evaporation (the "Angel's Share"), but another portion gets absorbed directly into the charred oak staves. Jim Beam uses a proprietary process to pull this dark, heavily oaked extract—the "Devil's Cut"—back out of the wood. This extract is then blended with extra-aged bourbon and bottled at a robust 90 proof, resulting in a deeply robust, full-bodied spirit.

NOSE

Heavy and complex with deep aromas of charred oak, dark caramel, rich vanilla, and a hint of warm spice.

PALATE

Bold and intensely woody, featuring robust flavors of dark brown sugar, sweet vanilla, and a spicy, oak-driven backbone.

FINISH

Long, warm, and smooth with a lingering, sweet oaky finish.

jim-beam-double-oak.title: Jim Beam White Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon 1.14L
jim-beam-double-oak.bodyHtml:
Jim Beam White Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon is an iconic American whiskey crafted using a time-honored family recipe refined over more than seven generations. Aged for four years in newly charred American white oak barrels, it offers a classic bourbon character marked by smooth, approachable flavors and a balanced, oaky warmth.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with smoky barbecue ribs, grilled burgers, pulled pork, sharp cheddar cheese, pecan pie, or glazed bacon.

Tasting Notes : Bright, rich amber color with a medium body and a smooth, light-to-medium mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet oak, vanilla, spice, and subtle grain notes with light fruit and caramel undertones.

Palate : Smooth and mellow with flavors of oaky vanilla, toasted caramel, sweet corn, and gentle baking spices.

Finish : Clean, warm, and medium-length finish with lingering oak, subtle spice, and sweet corn notes.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as the core base in classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned, Manhattan, or Bourbon & Cola.

jim-beam-masterpiece-bourbon.title: Jim Beam White Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon 1L
jim-beam-masterpiece-bourbon.bodyHtml:

jim-beam-red-stag-cherry-bourbon.title: Jim Beam Black Cherry
jim-beam-red-stag-cherry-bourbon.bodyHtml:
A wildly popular flavored whiskey that masterfully blends the classic, oaky warmth of Kentucky Straight Bourbon with the vibrant, sweet taste of natural black cherry. Recently updated to an approachable 65 proof (32.5% ABV), it delivers a lush and fruity profile that is incredibly easy to drink. It's the perfect entry-level bourbon for those with a sweet tooth and shines beautifully when mixed with cola, ginger ale, or iced tea.

NOSE

Prominent, sweet aromas of dark cherry and berries backed by traditional bourbon vanilla and light oak.

PALATE

Sweet and fruit-forward, featuring luscious black cherry flavors perfectly balanced by soft caramel and warm oak undertones.

FINISH

Smooth, sweet, and lingering with a warm cherry finish.

jim-beam-single-barrel-bourbon.title: Jim Beam Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon
jim-beam-single-barrel-bourbon.bodyHtml:
A premium step up for any Jim Beam fan. Because it is a Single Barrel release, every bottle is completely unique and drawn from a single, hand-selected cask chosen by the Master Distiller for its exceptional flavor. Generally bottled at a robust 108 proof (54% ABV) to preserve its bold, uncut character, this bourbon delivers an intense, rich, and highly complex tasting experience that highlights the very best of what the distillery has to offer.

NOSE

Deep and aromatic with heavy notes of toasted oak, rich vanilla bean, dark caramel, and a hint of sweet tobacco.

PALATE

Bold, rich, and full-bodied. Prominent flavors of dark brown sugar, roasted nuts, baked apple, and heavy baking spices coat the palate.

FINISH

Exceptionally long, warming, and robust with lingering sweet oak and cinnamon spice.

Nose : Sweet oak, vanilla, spice, and subtle grain notes with light fruit and caramel undertones.

john-walker-sons-bicentenary-blend-1.title: John Walker & Sons Bicentenary Blend 28 Year Old
john-walker-sons-bicentenary-blend-1.bodyHtml:
One of a number of 200th Anniversary commemorative bottlings for Johnny Walker. The Bicentenary Blend is an attempt to recreate the profile of Johnnie Walker’s first whisky. The whisky was bottled at 46% from a mariage of components no less than 28 years old. 

It is a celebration of where it all began back in 1820, taking you on a sensorial journey through the fragrant aisles of John Walker’s original grocery store. Rare and exceptional whiskies, including ghost stocks from the long-closed distilleries of Pittyviach, Cambus and Port Ellen, have been explored to craft a whisky that reimagines the exotic flavours of the 1820s. All the whiskies in this limited edition have been aged for at least 28 years.

john-walker-sons-king-george-v-1.title: John Walker & Sons King George V
john-walker-sons-king-george-v-1.bodyHtml:
Rarity reflected in every drop. Johnnie Walker King George V has been created to celebrate the monarch who granted us our first Royal Warrant in 1934. Our makers drew on our archives to hand-select whiskies from distilleries that existed during his reign. This includes some of the rarest in our reserves, including irreplaceable casks from the now-closed Port Ellen distillery. Much like its namesake, it has a great depth of character and elegant reserve.

Nose: Sweet, smoky aromas from Port Ellen greet you. It’s followed by notes of orange, raisins, figs and cinnamon.

Taste: Abundant spice and dried fruits from Speyside and Highland whiskies are perfectly balanced with vanilla. They release layers of sweet fruits, dark chocolate, toffee and roast nuts.

Finish: Port Ellen gives a coastal smokiness that gathers momentum through the long finish.

johnnie-walker-blue-label-3.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
johnnie-walker-blue-label-3.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label is an iconic, ultra-premium blended Scotch whisky crafted by Johnnie Walker. Hand-selected by Master Blender Jim Beveridge from some of the rarest casks across Scotland—including irreplaceable stocks from ghost distilleries—only one in ten thousand casks possesses the quality and character required for this blend. It delivers a rich, velvety balance of sweet honey, dark chocolate, ripe fruits, and a gentle, lingering cloud of soft Islay smoke.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, caviar, seared duck breast, dark chocolate truffles, and aged blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a silky, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Mellow and rounded with aromas of dry smoke, raisins, sweet honey, toasted nuts, and subtle orange peel.

Palate : Complex and velvety, delivering flavors of hazelnut, dark chocolate, sandalwood, honey, Kumquat fruit, and sweet sherry wood spice.

Finish : Rich, long, and warming with lingering notes of gentle peat smoke, dark fruit, dried spice, and pepper.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass accompanied by a glass of ice water on the side to cleanse the palate between sips.

johnnie-walker-blue-label-ghost-rare-por.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Lunar New Year Year of the Goat Edition
johnnie-walker-blue-label-ghost-rare-por.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label Lunar New Year 'Year Of The Goat' Edition is a rare, limited-edition blended Scotch whisky released to celebrate the Lunar New Year. Bottled in a collectible blue porcelain-style decanter featuring custom artwork of the zodiac goat, this expression contains the signature Blue Label blend—crafted from rare, hand-selected malt and grain whiskies sourced from across Scotland, including ghost distilleries.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate desserts, rich fruit cake, smoked duck, roasted venison, or fine cigars.

Tasting Notes : A rich, full-bodied blended Scotch whisky presenting a deep golden-amber appearance with a smooth, velvety, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Mellow and rounded with layers of honeycomb, dried dark fruits, roasted hazelnuts, vanilla custard, orange zest, and a subtle whisper of peat smoke.

Palate : Velvet-smooth and complex, delivering waves of sweet caramel, toffee, sherried figs, dark chocolate, and orchard fruit accompanied by soft baking spices and polished oak.

Finish : Exceptionally long, smooth, and elegant, ending with lingering oak, delicate spice, and a gentle thread of smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a heavy tumbler, accompanied by a glass of ice-cold water on the side to cleanse the palate between sips.

johnnie-walker-blue-label-legendary-eigh.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Legendary Eight
johnnie-walker-blue-label-legendary-eigh.bodyHtml:
A rare jewel crafted from only eight legendary distilleries, all at least 200 years old. Plunge into a rich wave of velvety smooth flavour. Sweet fruit swells before a mellow kiss of citrus recedes to a serenade of warming, gentle smoke.

Johnnie Walker Blue Label Legendary Eight Exclusive Blend is a smooth, mellow Scotch made using some of our rarest whiskies from across the untamed wilds of Scotland, including exceptionally rare whiskies from "ghost" distilleries. Each one is hand-selected from only eight legendary distilleries that existed when John Walker took the first steps on our journey 200 years ago.

The rare whiskies from these distilleries are an inspiration to our whisky makers today. Since John Walker first opened our doors in 1820, we've never stopped in the pursuit of excellence. This passion led to the exceptional quality and depth of flavour that we now find in the remarkable character of every drop of Johnnie Walker whisky. Coat your tongue with sweet toffee and the soft caress of brown sugar and vanilla notes before a wave of fresh orchard fruits is enveloped by a wisp of smoke. This whisky celebrates 200 years of bold and passionate craft, bottled for this moment.

johnnie-walker-blue-label-year-of-the-ox.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Lunar New Year Year of the Goat Edition
johnnie-walker-blue-label-year-of-the-ox.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label Lunar New Year 'Year Of The Goat' Edition is a rare, limited-edition blended Scotch whisky released to celebrate the Lunar New Year. johnnie-walker-blue-label-year-of-the-ra.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Year of the Rat
johnnie-walker-blue-label-year-of-the-ra.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label Year of the Rat celebrates the 2020 Lunar New Year with a limited-edition bottle design by artist Shirley Gong. Her rat captures the entrepreneurship and adaptability of the first sign of the zodiac and heralds the opportunity and good fortune its arrival brings. The whisky is Johnnie Walker Blue Label, a blend of single malt and grain whiskies from the four corners of Scotland, with Caol Ila, Benrinnes, Cardhu, Clynelish and the closed 'ghost' grain distillery Port Dundas among its components. This edition is bottled at 46% ABV in a 750 ml bottle, giving the familiar Blue Label character a little more weight, and it was released in limited numbers for the Year of the Rat.

Nose: Mellow and rounded, with signature dry smoke and raisin sweetness.

Palate: Velvety, with hazelnut, honey, rose petal, sherry and orange, followed by kumquat, aromatic smoke, sandalwood, tobacco and dark chocolate.

Finish: Long and satisfying, with smoke and pepper ending in a touch of spice.

Serve: Neat in a whisky glass, with a sip of iced water beforehand to prime the palate.

johnnie-walker-double-black.title: Johnnie Walker Double Black
johnnie-walker-double-black.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Double Black is a bold, amplified interpretation of the iconic Johnnie Walker Black Label. Crafted by former Master Blender Jim Beveridge, this expression takes the signature balanced profile of Black Label and dials up the intensity by incorporating heavily peated West Coast and Islay single malts, along with whiskies matured in deeply charred oak casks. The result is a robust, full-bodied Blended Scotch Whisky that delivers profound layers of smoldering campfire smoke, rich vanilla, and spiced orchard fruits, offering a more powerful and rugged drinking experience without losing the brand's trademark smoothness.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, BBQ pork ribs, strong blue cheeses like Roquefort, dark chocolate, or roasted salted almonds.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a rich, full-bodied, and slightly syrupy mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense and inviting, leading with sweet campfire smoke, maritime peat, toasted oak, and rich vanilla, underscored by hints of crisp green apple and citrus zest.

Palate : Bold and robust, delivering a powerful wave of peaty smoke, creamy vanilla, and caramelized sugar, beautifully balanced by spiced apples, dried raisins, and a touch of deeply charred wood.

Finish : Long, warming, and distinctly smoky, leaving a lingering finish of smoldering peat, dry oak tannin, and a whisper of sweet fruit.

Serve : Serve neat, over a large ice cube, or with a splash of water to open up the complex smoky aromatics.

johnnie-walker-family-collection-1.title: Johnnie Walker Family Collection 4x200ml
johnnie-walker-family-collection-1.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Family Collection 4x200ml is an exceptional sampler gift set showcasing the remarkable depth, blending mastery, and iconic flavor spectrum of the House of Walker. Perfect for both discerning connoisseurs and those looking to discover premium Scotch, this exclusive taster pack contains four 200ml bottles, each representing a celebrated tier of the portfolio:

  • Johnnie Walker Black Label – The Original Walker Whisky – Aged 12 Years and a rock solid blend.
  • Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve – A multi-layered blend, it offers a smooth balance of sweet fruits and creaminess that evolves into deeper honeyed tones before finishing in lingering waves of wood, fruit, and light, sweet west coast smoke.
  • Johnnie Walker 18 Year Old – A complex, luxurious blend harboring deep layers of flavor that perfectly balance the diverse character of the distilleries from which it came and the wood in which it has rested.
  • Johnnie Walker Blue Label – An exquisite blend made from some of Scotland’s rarest and most exceptional Scotch Whiskies.

Together, they guide you on a comprehensive tasting journey through the finest single malt and grain distillates across Scotland, bound by Johnnie Walker's signature whisper of coastal peat smoke.

Food Pairing: This diverse collection pairs beautifully with a multi-course tasting menu. Enjoy the smoky depth of the Black Label with grilled lamb chops or smoked brisket. Transition to the sweet creaminess of the Gold Label alongside aged Gouda cheese or a fruit tart. Pair the sophisticated 18 Year Old with seared duck breast, and culminate the experience by sipping the rare Blue Label alongside high-quality dark chocolate truffles or a delicate seared ribeye steak.

johnnie-walker-green-label-15-year-old.title: Johnnie Walker Green Label 15 Year Old
johnnie-walker-green-label-15-year-old.bodyHtml: Johnnie Walker Green Label is crafted from a palette of Speyside, Highland, Lowland and Island malts matured for at least 15 years all perfectly balanced to bring together the intense aromas of crisp cut grass, fresh fruit, wood smoke, deep vanilla, and sandalwood.

johnnie-walker-jane-walker-1.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Blended Scotch Whisky 1L
johnnie-walker-jane-walker-1.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label is the flagship luxury blend from John Walker & Sons, crafted from exceptionally rare malt and grain Scotch whiskies selected for their depth, character and smoothness. Johnnie Walker states that only one in 10,000 casks is considered suitable for Blue Label, with the blend incorporating rare stocks, including whisky associated with long-closed “ghost” distilleries. Bottled at 40% ABV, this 1-litre presentation delivers Blue Label’s signature combination of rich fruit, honeyed sweetness, dark chocolate, warming spice and elegant smoke.

Food Pairing: Pair with dark chocolate, smoked salmon, roasted nuts, mature cheeses, grilled seafood, rich chocolate desserts, or delicately smoked meats.

Tasting Notes: Exceptionally smooth and layered, with rich dried and fresh fruit, honeyed sweetness, dark chocolate, warming spice and waves of gentle smoke.

Nose: Mellow smoke with dried fruit, soft spice, honey and subtle oak.

Palate: Velvety and rich, developing layers of honey, dried fruit, dark chocolate, warming spice and gentle smoky character.

Finish: Long, smooth and warming with lingering sweetness, oak, dark chocolate and elegant smoke.

Serve: Best served neat at room temperature with a separate glass of ice-cold water to refresh the palate and reveal the whisky’s depth.

johnnie-walker-platinum-label-18-year-ol.title: Johnnie Walker 18 Year Old
johnnie-walker-platinum-label-18-year-ol.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Aged 18 Years is made using whiskies that have matured for at least 18 years. Carefully chosen for their flavor and quality, these whiskies make for a wonderful combination of both classic and contemporary tastes – blending notes of citrus and fragrant almonds, with warm vanilla and a hint of tropical tangerines. 

NOSE
A wonderfully rich aroma, combining notes of rich, sweet fruit with hints of toffee and caramel.

PALATE
A comforting mix of warming, malty cereal and smooth creamy vanilla, with fragrant notes of almond and tropical tangerine.

FINISH
A lingering finish with hints of dark chocolate, citrus peel and a very light, aromatic smoke.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements roast chicken, duck with fruit glaze, grilled salmon, aged cheeses such as Comté or Gruyère, dark chocolate desserts, and nut-based pastries.

johnnie-walker-xr-21-year-old-1.title: Johnnie Walker XR 21 Year Old
johnnie-walker-xr-21-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
A limited-edition Johnnie Walker Blended Scotch Whisky, it is rumoured to contain some whisky from the once closed but now reopened Brora Distillery! Bottled at 40%.

Created to honour Master Blender Alexander Walker II, this blend is an assured, balanced and elegant, with layers of citrus zest, ripened tropical fruits and hints of tobacco.

jose-cuervo-gold-tequila-3.title: Jose Cuervo Especial Gold Tequila
jose-cuervo-gold-tequila-3.bodyHtml: The #1 tequila brand in the world, Jose Cuervo Especial® Gold is a golden blend of younger tequilas. The light gold spirit has a sweet aroma with pleasant agave notes. Along with its sweet, subtle agave flavor and hints of oak and vanilla, Especial Gold boasts a well-balanced, short, smooth finish. (40% ABV-80 proof) • In history and today, Jose Cuervo Especial is the popular choice for crafting any Margarita: frozen or on the rocks. Jose Cuervo knows how to craft tequila.

jose-cuervo-gold-tequila-5.title: Jose Cuervo Especial Gold Tequila 1.14L
jose-cuervo-gold-tequila-5.bodyHtml:
The #1 tequila brand in the world, Jose Cuervo Especial® Gold is a golden blend of younger tequilas. The light gold spirit has a sweet aroma with pleasant agave notes. Along with its sweet, subtle agave flavor and hints of oak and vanilla, Especial Gold boasts a well-balanced, short, smooth finish. (40% ABV-80 proof) • In history and today, Jose Cuervo Especial is the popular choice for crafting any Margarita: frozen or on the rocks. Jose Cuervo knows how to craft tequila.

(1.14L Bottle)

jose-cuervo-platino.title: Jose Cuervo Reserva de la Familia Platino Tequila
jose-cuervo-platino.bodyHtml: Reserva de la Familia® Platino is specially made using the ‘Esencia de Agave’ process. This unique production method allows the notes of agave to keep their original character, intense aroma and flavor. The bright, clear spirit has a unique sweet and spicy palate with notes of melon, honey and hay. It finishes medium and crisp with notes of chamomile and cinnamon. Enjoy this unique expression on the rocks. (40 ABV-80 proof). The Reserva de la Familia family of products are top award winners.

jose-cuervo-reserva-familia-extra-anejo.title: Jose Cuervo Reserva de la Familia Extra Anejo Tequila
jose-cuervo-reserva-familia-extra-anejo.bodyHtml:
Jose Cuervo Reserva de la Familia Extra Añejo Tequila is a ultra-premium 100% Weber Blue Agave extra añejo tequila crafted as the private family reserve of the Cuervo family. Aged for a minimum of three years in a combination of new American and French oak barrels, with spirits from the family's oldest private cellars blended into the final release, this expression delivers rich complexity, deep wood tones, and exceptional smoothness.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate tarts, braised short ribs, aged Manchego cheese, grilled steak with chimichurri, or rich caramel flan.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber to mahogany hue with copper highlights and a rich, viscous, full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich toasted oak, sweet cooked agave, dark chocolate, dried fruit, cinnamon spice, toasted almonds, and warm vanilla.

Palate : Complex and smooth with dominant notes of charred oak, dark caramel, roasted agave, sweet vanilla, roasted nuts, toasted cocoa, and gentle baking spices.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warm, and elegant with lingering toasted oak, dark chocolate sweetness, and soft agave warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a cognac balloon or Glencairn glass to appreciate its full aromatic profile.

jose-cuervo-silver-tequila-3.title: Jose Cuervo Especial Silver Tequila 1.14L
jose-cuervo-silver-tequila-3.bodyHtml:
Jose Cuervo Especial Silver is the unaged, silver expression of Jose Cuervo's Especial range, offered here in a 1.14L bottle at 40% ABV. Cuervo makes it with blue agave grown on the family estate in Jalisco, Mexico, and double-distils the spirit for a smooth, crisp and clean profile. The aroma is fresh with light agave, the palate stays clean with subtle agave character, and the finish is warm and smooth. Cuervo positions Especial Silver as a mixing tequila first and foremost, and the larger format makes sense for batching margaritas, tequila sunrises or mules for a crowd.

Nose: Fresh and clean, with hints of agave.

Palate: Clean and crisp, with subtle agave notes.

Finish: Warm and smooth.

Serve: In a margarita, frozen margarita or tequila sunrise.

jose-cuervo-silver-tequila-2.title: Jose Cuervo Especial Silver Tequila
jose-cuervo-silver-tequila-2.bodyHtml: Made using blue agave from the family estate in Jalisco, Mexico, Jose Cuervo Especial® Silver is double-distilled for smooth, crisp, clean tequila. Its aroma is fresh and clean with hints of agave. (40% ABV-80 proof) • On the palate, Especial Silver is equally crisp and clean with subtle blue agave notes and a warm and smooth finish. No wonder Especial Silver is one of the fastest growing tequilas in America. Best enjoyed in margaritas, it lives up to its claim as the original party starter. Jose Cuervo is the world’s #1 tequila brand.

jose-cuervo-tradicional-reposado.title: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Reposado Tequila
jose-cuervo-tradicional-reposado.bodyHtml: Artisanal Jose Cuervo Tradicional® Reposado is distilled from select 100% blue agave rested in charred oak and is very “tequilero” in character. It is light straw in color and has an herbaceous essence of agave. Its flavor is of cooked agave and stewed tropical fruits backed by lingering notes of vanilla, clove, cinnamon, and toffee (40% ABV-80 proof). • Family Estate Grown, Small-Batch Tequila. Tradicional celebrates a family tradition started over 200 years ago. The agave is harvested from the family estate, the largest agave holder in all of Mexico.

jose-cuervo-tradicional-silver.title: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Plata Tequila
jose-cuervo-tradicional-silver.bodyHtml: The original tequila created over 200 years ago! Jose Cuervo® Tradicional® Silver is a multiple award winning, 100% blue agave tequila. GOLD MEDAL winner at San Francisco World Spirit Competition 2019. Herbaceous blue agave in aroma with subtle citrus notes. Spice and sweet balance, firmness and fruit overtones within its flavor profile, with a sweet and refreshing finish. When bottled, a special process is used to conserve its flavor and finish at freezing temperatures. By staying true to its methods, it continues to please connoisseurs and new drinkers alike. (40% ABV-80 proof)

joseph-phelps-innisfree-cabernet-sauvign.title: Joseph Phelps Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
joseph-phelps-innisfree-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:
The Cabernet Sauvignon opens with an enticing bouquet of black and red fruits - juicy black cherry intertwined with fresh pomegranate and bright cassis. Notes of cedar spice and toasted coconut add intrigue and sophistication to the aromatic profile. On the palate, layers of raspberry compote anddried wild berries unfold across a full-bodied frame. The wine shows impressive density while maintaining elegance, supported by well-integrated tannins that provide structure without overwhelming. This is a wine of both power and finesse.

94 Points - James Suckling

Bright, lifted, black and red fruits with aromas of dark cherries, damson plums, cedar box and fresh herbs. The full-bodied palate has a supple, rounded mouthfeel and softly integrated tannins. 91% cabernet sauvignon with smatterings of the other main Bordeaux varieties. Lively and approachable yet plush with plenty of years ahead.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Joseph Phelps 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon is dominated by fruit from Yountville and Suscol; only 21% of the blend is from growers, as there's a push toward estate fruit. As always, there's some American oak in the mix, but that proportion is evolving downward. Redcurrants and cherries are joined by gentle dusty earth notes and hints of vanilla and cedar on the nose, while the medium to full-bodied palate is a bit more dusty and drying than the 2021, yet it remains soft and approachable.

joseph-phelps-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvi.title: Joseph Phelps Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
joseph-phelps-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvi.bodyHtml:
