joseph-phelps-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir-20.title: Decoy Limited Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2018/2022 750ml
joseph-phelps-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir-20.bodyHtml:
This lush and graceful cool-climate Pinot Noir draws you in with enticing aromas of blackberry, bramble, currant, cedar, and earthy forest floor, as well as oak-inspired hints of baking spices. On the palate, alluring red berry flavors are framed by soft, supple tannins, with bright acidity adding freshness to the long, vibrant finish.
92 Points - James Suckling
A robust, flavorful red that's full of dark cherries and smoky accents on a medium to full body. Broad and generous in mouthfeel, deep in black fruit, cedar and forest floor notes with savory mushroom accents.

jura-16-year-old-1.title: Jura 16 Year Old
jura-16-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Jura 16 Year Old is a now-discontinued Island single malt from the Isle of Jura distillery, last bottled in 2017 before the 18 Year Old took its place in the range. The whisky spent 14 years in ex-bourbon casks before a further two years of finishing in Amoroso sherry casks, and was bottled at 43% ABV in a 750 ml bottle. The distillery described a full, rich and floral nose of silk and honey with a touch of ginger spice, leading to soft peach, honey, citrus and marzipan on the palate.

Nose: Full and rich; honey and a hint of ginger spice in a floral bouquet.

Palate: Soft peaches and honey with citrus and marzipan.

Serve: Neat, or with a dash of water.

jura-18-year-old-1.title: Jura 18 Year Old
jura-18-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
On Jura, our tiny island community finds time stretched by the changing seasons and tempered by the unique microclimate. Each passing year brings its own riches.

Matured for eighteen long years in American White Oak ex bourbon barrels, this whisky is then beautifully enriched by superior Premier Grand Cru Classé Bordeaux red wine barriques from the South of France. The result is an incredibly rich and fruity whisky, with flavours of cooked raspberries, warm spice, rich caramel and crème anglaise.

kavalan-artist-series-french-wine-cask-s.title: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-artist-series-french-wine-cask-s.bodyHtml:
Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and recharred in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the wood into the whisky overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness.
It has a complex and multi-dimensional background of pepper, spice, dates and other fruits, such as ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of bursting citrus fruits.

Colour
Deep autumn gold

Flavour
A rich fusion of vanilla and caramelized sugars with dark chocolate on top. Ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of citrus fruits burst. Pepper is also present in the background waiting to be noticed.

Palate
The taste ends with clean and complex flavours embodying all that is best in the finest malt whiskies enjoying a long aftertaste.

Tasting
We suggest drinking Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask neat.

kavalan-artist-series-peated-cask-streng.title: Kavalan Solist Peaty Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-artist-series-peated-cask-streng.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Peaty Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky (Exclusively bottled for Sierra Springs Liquor) is a cask-strength single malt produced at the King Car Kavalan Distillery in Yilan County, Taiwan. Matured in a cask previously used to hold peated whisky, this release combines Kavalan’s signature tropical fruit profile with balanced, earthy peat smoke, bottled exclusively for Sierra Springs Liquor at a robust 53.2% ABV.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, smoked barbecue brisket, dark chocolate tarts, braised pork belly, and rich blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a rich, oily, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Earthy peat smoke integrated with sweet honey, ripe mango, tropical fruit, vanilla, and gentle oak spice.

Palate : Complex and intense with initial peat smoke opening up to red apple, coconut, toasted malt, dark cocoa, and warming black pepper.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of smoky embers, sweet tropical fruit, and toasted oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to tame the high proof and release lush fruit and floral aromas.

kavalan-artist-series-puncheon-cask-stre.title: Kavalan Artist Series Paul Chiang Puncheon Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky 1L
kavalan-artist-series-puncheon-cask-stre.bodyHtml:
OCEAN – Puncheon. Single Cask Strength ABV 55.6%

Painting – “Pisilian (Morning Stars over the Coast)”
The indigenous name, Pisilian, refers to a stretch of Taiwan’s eastern coastline, connecting Kavalan’s home in Yilan County with Taitung County where Paul Chiang is based. Kavalan’s story, or dream, starts in the Ocean under a starry sky. From here, moisture rises and eventually condenses above Snow Mountain, creating Kavalan’s legendary water source.

Official Tasting Notes:
Colour: Dark Crimson Waves
Flavour: The delicious aroma of freshly roasted almond biscuits brings out the smoothness of vanilla and sweetness of white peach, with a hint of maple syrup to accentuate the fruity aroma.
Palate: Smooth vanilla and sweet toffee, accentuated with hints of nutty notes, give way to a rich burst of white peach and tropical fruit – a multilayered flavor with an ocean of depth and complexity, and a smooth finish.

kavalan-artist-series-virgin-oak-cask-st.title: Kavalan Solist Virgin Oak 2016 Team Canada R
kavalan-artist-series-virgin-oak-cask-st.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Virgin Oak Team Canada R is an ultra-premium, single-cask-strength single malt whisky produced by King Car Kavalan Distillery in Yilan County, Taiwan. This specific bottling represents an exclusive private single-cask selection curated directly for the Canadian market ("Team Canada"), with the "R" designating the specific barrel allocation in the release. Matured in a new, unaged virgin oak cask under Yilan's intense subtropical climate, the accelerated interaction between wood and spirit develops remarkable depth. It presents a rich, indulgent profile balancing sweet tropical fruits, honey, beeswax, and warm oak spices unique to this cask.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork belly, prime rib steak, dark chocolate tarts, dried fruits, or strong aged cheeses like stilton.

Tasting Notes : Deep black cherry and soft treacle appearance with a rich, full-bodied, and velvety texture on the palate.

Nose : Smoked plum, purple grapes, buttery vanilla, rich beeswax, subtle floral notes, apricot, and honeyed peach.

Palate : Full-bodied and indulgent with subtle oak spice, sweet honey, autumn pear, roasted chestnuts, ripe guava, and warming cinnamon.

Finish : Long, rich, and enduring with lingering notes of ripened tropical fruit, sweet oak spice, and cinnamon warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of pure water to open the complex aromatic fruit and spice layers.

kavalan-concertmaster.title: Kavalan Concertmaster Port Cask Finish Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-concertmaster.bodyHtml:
Using Portuguese ruby Port wine casks as the main flavour, Kavalan Concertmaster single malt whisky is first matured in specially selected American oak casks and then finished in port barriques. The ageing in barriques mellows the flavours and adds indefinable smoothness to the whisky. It is rich bodied with natural sweetness and complexity.

COLOUR - Rich Caramel Ruby

NOSE - Tropical fruitiness with honey, vanilla, coconut and candy floss.

PALATE - Rich bodied with natural sweetness and complexity.

kavalan-concertmaster-sherry-finish.title: Kavalan Concertmaster Sherry Cask Finish Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-concertmaster-sherry-finish.bodyHtml:
The second whisky in the Kavalan Concertmaster series is aged in the distillery's own special reserve of refill casks, then finished in the finest hand-picked Spanish Sherry casks. Wonderfully elegant, soft and fruity with delicate aromas and a complexity of layers, it showcases the art of Kavalan’s blending and the depth of flavours made possible in this unique subtropical climate.

COLOUR - Pale apricot

NOSE - Begins with a soft bouquet of sweet vanilla and toffee accompanied in the background by subtle, silky chocolate and layers of crème brûlée, made satisfyingly complex with rich, ripe dark fruits and walnut and almond nuttiness continuing onto the tongue.

PALATE - Round, thick mouthfeel dominated by a dense burst of this series’ signature taste - seductively luscious tropical fruits - elegantly balanced and lingering long on the finish.

kavalan-distillery-select.title: Kavalan Distillery Select No. 1 Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-distillery-select.bodyHtml:
This elegant, quintessential single malt celebrates the craftsmanship of Kavalan’s master blender released after his hat trick of top prizes: the Icons of Whisky’s 2018 “Distillery of the Year” and its 2017 “World Whisky Brand Ambassador”, as well as the World Whiskies Awards’ 2015 “Distillery Manager and Master Distiller of the Year”. In this unique drop, Master Blender Ian Chang has set out to create the purest and creamiest of whiskies to satisfy both the beginner drinker and the whisky connoisseur.

Featuring Kavalan’s signature fruity sweetness and full body, Distillery Select has been aged in quality casks to lock in rich layers of butterscotch, toffee and vanilla that intensify into a long, encored finish. Versatile and super smooth, enjoyed in cocktails or neat, this single malt is a hugely satisfying experience to savour again and again.

COLOUR - Midnight Amber

NOSE - Delicate and silky. Full with the scent of ripened tropical fruits, fragrant floral notes and warm vanilla.

PALATE - Elegant, perfectly balanced and easy to drink. The rich and complex layers of butterscotch, toffee and vanilla are a further endorsement of our rigorous cask policy.

kavalan-distillery-select-no-2.title: Kavalan Distillery Select No. 1 Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-distillery-select-no-2.bodyHtml:
This elegant, quintessential single malt celebrates the craftsmanship of Kavalan’s master blender released after his hat trick of top prizes: the Icons of Whisky’s 2018 “Distillery of the Year” and its 2017 “World Whisky Brand Ambassador”, as well as the World Whiskies Awards’ 2015 “Distillery Manager and Master Distiller of the Year”. COLOUR - Midnight Amber

NOSE - Delicate and silky. Full with the scent of ripened tropical fruits, fragrant floral notes and warm vanilla.

PALATE - Elegant, perfectly balanced and easy to drink. The rich and complex layers of butterscotch, toffee and vanilla are a further endorsement of our rigorous cask policy.

kavalan-ex-bourbon-oak.title: Kavalan Ex-Bourbon Oak Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-ex-bourbon-oak.bodyHtml:
Kavalan ex-Bourbon Oak dilutes the Solist ex-Bourbon with Kavalan spring water to 46% alcoholic strength. It is incredibly smooth with a soft sweetness, losing the harshness of the alcohol's edge. It has a clean and fresh tropical fruitiness with lingering vanilla, coconut and spices.

COLOUR - Pale Golden

NOSE - Clean with fresh tropical fruitiness and pleasant vanilla, coconut and spices. Imagine being soothed by a comfortable and refreshing sea breeze. This malt can do that for you after a hectic day at the office.

PALATE - Soft, well-balanced natural sweetness, vanilla and oak spices, round and complex with silky smoothness.

kavalan-french-wine-cask.title: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-french-wine-cask.bodyHtml:
Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and recharred in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the wood into the whisky overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness.
It has a complex and multi-dimensional background of pepper, spice, dates and other fruits, such as ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of bursting citrus fruits.

Colour
Deep autumn gold

Flavour
A rich fusion of vanilla and caramelized sugars with dark chocolate on top. Ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of citrus fruits burst. Pepper is also present in the background waiting to be noticed.

Palate
The taste ends with clean and complex flavours embodying all that is best in the finest malt whiskies enjoying a long aftertaste.

Tasting
We suggest drinking Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask neat.

kavalan-king-car-40th-anniversary-1.title: Kavalan King Car 40th Anniversary Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky 1.5L
kavalan-king-car-40th-anniversary-1.bodyHtml:
Kavalan King Car 40th Anniversary is a 1.5-litre single cask single malt bottled to mark forty years of the King Car Group, the parent company of the Kavalan distillery in Yilan County, Taiwan. The whisky was aged in a very rare red wine cask which, in the words of master blender Ian Chang, gives a richly intense whisky with very distinct berry flavours and luxuriant toffee. It is bottled at a cask strength of 56.3% ABV in a heavy 1500 ml glass decanter with a crown-shaped stopper set with Swarovski crystals, and presented in a leather and wooden box together with a whisky glass. A celebratory bottling made to honour the group's four decades of growth.

Nose: Powerful and dense, with dark-skinned Cabernet Sauvignon fruit, strawberry, bilberry, spice and fresh charred oak.

Palate: Thick layers of toffee-rich berry fruit, lifted by pepper, clove and tobacco and tied together by a strong wine character.

Finish: Long and sensuous, with Kavalan's signature fruit and soft spice.

Serve: Neat, from the glass supplied in the box.

kavalan-king-car-conductor.title: Kavalan King Car Conductor Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-king-car-conductor.bodyHtml:
The first expression launched in the name of King Car conglomerate, this single malt's complexity represents the company's diversity and multi-faceted business. Diverse with complex flavours, it has delicate aromas and multiple layers of background fruitiness. Sweet rich vanilla, banana, and coconut with a slight pleasant bitterness balancing the sweetness.

COLOUR - Vivid amber

NOSE - Excellently clean and freshly fruity single malt. A touch of papaya, banana and green apple, just to name a few. Pleasantly floral, delicate and complex with depths and multiple layers of aromas, fragrances and nuances waiting to be discovered by each individual and connoisseur.

PALATE - Sweet and rich with vanilla, banana, and coconut, with a slight pleasant bitterness balancing the sweetness. A mouthfilling dram, more complex and sophisticated than you could ever imagine. A grand masterpiece to represent and bear the name of the Group - King Car.

kavalan-oloroso-sherry-oak.title: Kavalan Peatist Oloroso Sherry Cask Single Cask Strength Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-oloroso-sherry-oak.bodyHtml: Distilled from premium peated malt and matured in the finest Oloroso sherry casks from Spain’s Sherry Triangle, this whisky melds rich dried fruit notes with Kavalan’s signature tropical vibrancy, offering a lightly smoky yet profoundly complex flavour and non-chill filtered to preserve its pure, unrestrained character.

kavalan-podium.title: Kavalan Podium Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-podium.bodyHtml:
Created from hand-selected brand new American oak casks and re-fill casks, this expression is surprisingly delicate and extremely complex. It is a resounding endorsement of our sophisticated wood policy.

COLOUR - Dark Gold with Amber Highlights

NOSE - Clean, subtle and elegant with fragrant and extremely pleasant floral and sweet aromas mixed with vanilla and coconut, which arouses the olfactory senses.

PALATE - Subtropical fruitiness, such as mango and green apple, in a complex background together with hints of honey, cherry, white pepper and grape. The finale is a long and sustainable after-taste encored over and over again. A finish to be experienced with patience. This is a malt that stirs emotions and redefines sensory perception.

PAIRING - Flavourful Taiwanese, Thai and Japanese dishes are ably matched by Kavalan Podium.

kavalan-solist-ex-bourbon-oak.title: Kavalan Ex-Bourbon Oak Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-ex-bourbon-oak.bodyHtml:
Kavalan ex-Bourbon Oak dilutes the Solist ex-Bourbon with Kavalan spring water to 46% alcoholic strength. It is incredibly smooth with a soft sweetness, losing the harshness of the alcohol's edge. It has a clean and fresh tropical fruitiness with lingering vanilla, coconut and spices.

COLOUR - Pale Golden

NOSE - Clean with fresh tropical fruitiness and pleasant vanilla, coconut and spices. Imagine being soothed by a comfortable and refreshing sea breeze. This malt can do that for you after a hectic day at the office.

PALATE - Soft, well-balanced natural sweetness, vanilla and oak spices, round and complex with silky smoothness.

kavalan-solist-oloroso-sherry-oak.title: Kavalan Peatist Oloroso Sherry Cask Single Cask Strength Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-oloroso-sherry-oak.bodyHtml: Distilled from premium peated malt and matured in the finest Oloroso sherry casks from Spain’s Sherry Triangle, this whisky melds rich dried fruit notes with Kavalan’s signature tropical vibrancy, offering a lightly smoky yet profoundly complex flavour and non-chill filtered to preserve its pure, unrestrained character.

kavalan-solist-peated.title: Kavalan Solist Peaty Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-peated.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Peaty Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky (Exclusively bottled for Sierra Springs Liquor) is a cask-strength single malt produced at the King Car Kavalan Distillery in Yilan County, Taiwan. Matured in a cask previously used to hold peated whisky, this release combines Kavalan’s signature tropical fruit profile with balanced, earthy peat smoke, bottled exclusively for Sierra Springs Liquor at a robust 53.2% ABV.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, smoked barbecue brisket, dark chocolate tarts, braised pork belly, and rich blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a rich, oily, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Earthy peat smoke integrated with sweet honey, ripe mango, tropical fruit, vanilla, and gentle oak spice.

Palate : Complex and intense with initial peat smoke opening up to red apple, coconut, toasted malt, dark cocoa, and warming black pepper.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of smoky embers, sweet tropical fruit, and toasted oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to tame the high proof and release lush fruit and floral aromas.

kavalan-solist-peaty-cask.title: Kavalan Solist Peaty Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-peaty-cask.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Peaty Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky (Exclusively bottled for Sierra Springs Liquor) is a cask-strength single malt produced at the King Car Kavalan Distillery in Yilan County, Taiwan. Matured in a cask previously used to hold peated whisky, this release combines Kavalan’s signature tropical fruit profile with balanced, earthy peat smoke, bottled exclusively for Sierra Springs Liquor at a robust 53.2% ABV.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, smoked barbecue brisket, dark chocolate tarts, braised pork belly, and rich blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a rich, oily, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Earthy peat smoke integrated with sweet honey, ripe mango, tropical fruit, vanilla, and gentle oak spice.

Palate : Complex and intense with initial peat smoke opening up to red apple, coconut, toasted malt, dark cocoa, and warming black pepper.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of smoky embers, sweet tropical fruit, and toasted oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to tame the high proof and release lush fruit and floral aromas.

kavalan-solist-port-cask-58-60.title: Kavalan Scotch & Ponder Solist Port Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-port-cask-58-60.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Scotch & Ponder Solist Port Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky is a distinctive single-cask expression from Kavalan Distillery, selected for Scotch & Ponder and bottled at a powerful 54.8% ABV. Matured in a Port cask and presented at cask strength, it showcases the intensity created by Taiwan's subtropical maturation environment, bringing together concentrated dark fruit, rich sweetness, chocolate, warming spice and oak in a full-bodied single malt.

Food Pairing: Pair with roasted duck, grilled beef, glazed pork, mature cheeses, toasted walnuts, dried fruit or rich dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: Rich and concentrated with dark berries, dried fruit and Port-driven sweetness layered with chocolate, nuts, oak and warming spice.

Nose: Intense aromas of ripe berries and dried fruit mingle with caramelized sweetness, dark chocolate, toasted nuts and seasoned oak.

Palate: Full-bodied and powerful with rich dark fruit, chocolate and caramel complemented by warming spice, nuts and structured oak.

Finish: Long, warming and persistent with lingering dark fruit, chocolate, spice and Port-influenced sweetness.

kavalan-solist-vinho-barrique-54-80.title: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky 57.80% ABV
kavalan-solist-vinho-barrique-54-80.bodyHtml:
Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and recharred in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the wood into the whisky overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness.

It has a complex and multi-dimensional background of pepper, spice, dates and other fruits, such as ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of bursting citrus fruits.

COLOUR - Deep Autumn Gold

NOSE - A rich fusion of vanilla and caramelized sugars with dark chocolate on top. Ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate burst of citrus fruits. Pepper is also present in the background waiting to be noticed. This bouquet is simply a sensational feast to your olfactory organ.

PALATE - The taste ends with clean and complex flavours embodying all that is best in the finest malt whiskies and enjoying a long aftertaste.

kavalan-virgin-oak.title: Kavalan Solist Virgin Oak 2016 Team Canada R
kavalan-virgin-oak.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Virgin Oak Team Canada R is an ultra-premium, single-cask-strength single malt whisky produced by King Car Kavalan Distillery in Yilan County, Taiwan. This specific bottling represents an exclusive private single-cask selection curated directly for the Canadian market ("Team Canada"), with the "R" designating the specific barrel allocation in the release. Matured in a new, unaged virgin oak cask under Yilan's intense subtropical climate, the accelerated interaction between wood and spirit develops remarkable depth. It presents a rich, indulgent profile balancing sweet tropical fruits, honey, beeswax, and warm oak spices unique to this cask.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork belly, prime rib steak, dark chocolate tarts, dried fruits, or strong aged cheeses like stilton.

Tasting Notes : Deep black cherry and soft treacle appearance with a rich, full-bodied, and velvety texture on the palate.

Nose : Smoked plum, purple grapes, buttery vanilla, rich beeswax, subtle floral notes, apricot, and honeyed peach.

Palate : Full-bodied and indulgent with subtle oak spice, sweet honey, autumn pear, roasted chestnuts, ripe guava, and warming cinnamon.

Finish : Long, rich, and enduring with lingering notes of ripened tropical fruit, sweet oak spice, and cinnamon warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of pure water to open the complex aromatic fruit and spice layers.

ketel-one-botanical-cucumber-mint.title: Otani Botanical Cucumber Lime Mint
ketel-one-botanical-cucumber-mint.bodyHtml:
Otani Botanical Vodka Cucumber Lime Mint is a flavoured botanical vodka from British Columbia, made at Sheringham Distillery. It is flavoured with cucumber, lime and mint and bottled at a lighter 30% ABV. Presented in a 750ml bottle, it is a made-in-BC option for anyone who prefers a flavoured, lower-strength spirit for long drinks.

Serve: Over ice with soda water and a twist of citrus, or in a light highball.

ketel-one-botanical-grapefruit-rose.title: Ketel One Botanical Grapefruit and Rose
ketel-one-botanical-grapefruit-rose.bodyHtml: Ketel One Botanical Grapefruit & Rose is fit for those who seek zesty mouthwatering grapefruit and the elegance of refined rose petals. Each botanical essence is individually and naturally obtained through innovative extraction methods and distillation processes for the freshest, cleanest, most crisp taste possible.

ketel-one-botanical-peach-orange.title: Ketel One Botanical Peach and Orange Blossom
ketel-one-botanical-peach-orange.bodyHtml: Ketel One Botanical Peach & Orange Blossom appeals to those who enjoy lush, juicy white peaches and bold notes of fragrant orange blossoms. Each botanical essence is individually and naturally obtained through innovative extraction methods and distillation processes for the freshest, cleanest, most crisp taste possible.

ketel-one-citroen-vodka.title: Ketel One Vodka
ketel-one-citroen-vodka.bodyHtml:
Ketel One Vodka is an ultra-premium craft vodka produced by the Nolet family at the Nolet Distillery in Schiedam, the Netherlands. Crafted using 100% European winter wheat, it is distilled in a combination of modern column stills and traditional coal-fired copper pot stills—including the original Distilleerketel #1, from which the brand derives its name. Filtered over loose charcoal and personally tasted for approval by a Nolet family member before bottling, this world-class spirit delivers exceptional clarity, a rich mouthfeel, and a remarkably crisp profile with subtle citrus and herbal accents.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters on the half shell, smoked salmon, caviar, blinis with sour cream, cured meats, or fresh goat cheese.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear appearance with a round, silky, and coating medium-to-full texture on the palate.

Nose : Fresh and crisp aromas of bright citrus zest, faint sweet honey, and subtle cracked black pepper.

Palate : Exceptionally smooth with clean wheat grain sweetness, subtle fennel, gentle citrus, and a silky, refined mouthfeel.

Finish : Long, lively, and crisp with a soft, clean warmth and lingering hints of citrus peel and soft spice.

Serve : Serve ice-cold neat straight from the freezer, over fresh ice with a twist of lemon, or as an elevated base in a classic Vodka Martini or Moscow Mule.

kilbeggan-pot-still.title: Kilbeggan Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
kilbeggan-pot-still.bodyHtml: Exclusively matured in ex-Bourbon barrels, the Kilbeggan Single Pot Still is comprised of unmalted barley, malted barley and 2.5% oats which was double distilled through two copper pot stills at Ireland's oldest licensed distillery. The mash bill was inspired by recipes used at the Kilbeggan Distillery in the late 1800s, when oats would have been grown across the Midlands region in Ireland. Warming flavours of citrus and herbaceous notes followed by a creamy, oily pot still spice.

kilchoman-machir-bay.title: Kilchoman Machir Bay Whisky
kilchoman-machir-bay.bodyHtml:
Named after the most spectacular beach on Islay, Machir Bay is the flagship of the Kilchoman range. Machir Bay is a unique and complex combination of ex-bourbon barrels and oloroso sherry butts. There is a predominantly ex-bourbon influence on this release which is indicated in the cask influence graph on the front of the carton.

“Machir Bay has a beautiful balance of vanilla, smokey butterscotch and rich fruitiness each contributing in complexity and combining to create a truly unique Islay dram” Robin Bignal, Production Manager.

kilchoman-sanaig-1.title: Kilchoman Sanaig
kilchoman-sanaig-1.bodyHtml:
Kilchoman Sanaig is a rich and heavily peated Islay single malt Scotch whisky named after a small rocky inlet near the distillery on the rugged west coast of Islay. Matured in a high proportion of both Oloroso sherry and ex-bourbon casks, it offers a harmonious balance of deep peat smoke, rich dried fruits, and sweet oak complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with dark chocolate, smoked meats, sticky barbecue ribs, blue cheese, or oysters on the half shell.

Tasting Notes : Deep beech color with a medium-to-full body and a rich, oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Soft cooked fruits, dark chocolate, raisins, and red berries followed by warm peat smoke and sweet oak.

Palate : Rich and rounded with layers of dark plum, sweet dried fruit, Demerara sugar, roasted coffee beans, and lingering peat smoke.

Finish : Long and warming with lingering peat smoke, dark chocolate, fruit cake, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to gently unlock deeper fruit and peat aromas.

kilkerran-12-year-old-1.title: Kilkerran 12 Year Old
kilkerran-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Kilkerran 12 Year Old is a highly acclaimed, lightly peated single malt Scotch whisky produced at the historic Mitchell’s Glengyle Distillery in Campbeltown. Reopened in 2004 by the legendary Mitchell family (owners of Springbank), Glengyle revived a historic distillery that had been silent for nearly eighty years, restoring Campbeltown's status as a distinct whisky region. This flagship expression is matured in a careful combination of 70% ex-bourbon casks and 30% ex-sherry casks. It is bottled without chill-filtration or added coloring, offering a wonderfully complex, oily, and authentic Campbeltown profile that beautifully balances coastal brine, sweet malt, and a delicate kiss of peat smoke.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoked duck breast, grilled lamb chops with rosemary, mature pecorino cheese, or rich dark chocolate sea salt caramels.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, pale gold color with a medium-bodied, oily, and wonderfully waxy mouthfeel typical of classic Campbeltown malts.

NOSE - Fragrant and complex, offering aromas of toasted oak, sweet honey, marshmallow, and dried citrus peel, coupled with a gentle, earthy peat smoke and a touch of maritime brine.

PALATE - Robust and incredibly balanced on the tongue, revealing sweet notes of butterscotch, lemon meringue, and vanilla biscuit, layered with black pepper, dry peat, and a light coastal saltiness.

FINISH - Long and clean, ending with a drying, warming mix of ash, oak spice, and lingering sweet brine.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass to experience the coastal and peaty nuances, or with a few drops of water to bring out more vanilla sweetness.

kirk-sweeney-12-year-old-rum-1.title: Kirk & Sweeney 12 Year Old Rum
kirk-sweeney-12-year-old-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Kirk & Sweeney 12 Year Old Rum is a Dominican rum distilled from sugarcane and aged for twelve years in American oak casks. The brand takes its name from the Kirk and Sweeney, a wooden schooner known for running rum from the Caribbean to the American Northeast in the early years of Prohibition, which was seized off the coast of New York with a large cargo of rum aboard. The rum is made in the Dominican Republic and must meet the country's strict rules for Dominican Rum; it is matured in a variety of oak barrels, with the distiller dumping, blending and re-barrelling over the years. The 12 Year Old comes in the brand's round, cork-stoppered bottle with a Coast Guard seizure tag, bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml size.

Serve: Neat or over ice, or in rum cocktails.

kirk-sweeney-18-year-old.title: Kirk and Sweeney 18 Year Old Dominican Rum
kirk-sweeney-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Kirk and Sweeney Gran Reserva Superior Rum is a luxuriously smooth and deeply mature premium Dominican rum crafted to honor the legacy of the infamous Prohibition-era wooden schooner. Adhering to the strict legal standards required to bear the official Dominican Rum designation, the spirit is produced using high-quality, locally harvested sugarcane. This exceptional liquid is composed of a hand-selected blend of rums aged between 5 and 23 years in a variety of seasoned oak barrels, serving as the modern flagship replacement for their former 23-year-old age-statement expression. The extended maturation process imparts an incredibly complex and evolutionary character that beautifully balances deep wood layers with refined tropical sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with glazed barbecued pork ribs, rich dark chocolate espresso tortes, sharp aged gouda cheese, or a warm bread pudding tossed with spiced pecans.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber with mahogany highlights and a full, smooth, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich dried fruits, oak wood, vanilla, brown sugar, and toasted nuts with subtle spices.

Palate : Complex and well-rounded with sweet vanilla, dried plum, dark chocolate, toasted oak, and butterscotch.

Finish : Long, smooth, and elegant with lingering warm oak spice and sweet vanilla.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a snifter glass or over a large ice cube.

kirk-sweeney-23-year-old-rum-1.title: Kirk & Sweeney 23 Year Old Rum
kirk-sweeney-23-year-old-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Kirk & Sweeney 23 Year Old Rum is a long-aged Dominican rum distilled from sugarcane and matured for 23 years in American oak casks. It is made in the Dominican Republic under the country's strict rules for Dominican Rum, with the rums aged in oak and repeatedly dumped, blended and re-barrelled by the distiller over the years. The brand is named after the Kirk and Sweeney, a wooden schooner that ran rum from the Caribbean to the American Northeast in the early years of Prohibition before it was seized off the coast of New York. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat or with a single large ice cube.

knob-creek-bourbon.title: Knob Creek 9 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
knob-creek-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Knob Creek 9 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a highly respected, pre-Prohibition style whiskey that serves as a cornerstone of the Jim Beam Small Batch Collection. Patiently aged for a full nine years in heavily charred new American white oak barrels, this bourbon delivers a robust, full-bodied, and deeply satisfying profile. Bottled at a hearty 100 proof, it perfectly balances the deep, rich flavors of dark oak and aged caramel with the classic sweetness of a traditional Kentucky straight bourbon.

Food Pairing: This bold, higher-proof bourbon pairs magnificently with rich, savory dishes like smoked beef brisket, charred ribeye steak, or sticky BBQ pork ribs. It is also an excellent companion to sharp, aged cheddar cheese, toasted pecans, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : A deep, rich amber-copper hue. The texture is full-bodied, warming, and pleasantly viscous on the palate.

Nose : Robust and inviting. Sweet aromas of toasted nuts, maple sugar, and rich vanilla bean are deeply intertwined with expressive notes of dark, seasoned oak and a hint of leather.

Palate : Big, rich, and naturally sweet. A luscious wave of rich caramel, brown sugar, and dark fruit quickly gives way to a complex, earthy core of heavily toasted oak, baking spices, and a pleasant rye pepperiness.

Finish : Long, rich, and glowing. It leaves a deeply warming trail of sweet vanilla, lingering oak, and a satisfying peppery spice.

Serve : Exceptional neat or poured over a large ice cube to soften the proof and open up the sweet aromatics. Its robust proof and deep flavor also make it the perfect foundation for a classic Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

knob-creek-cask-strength-rye-1.title: Knob Creek Cask Strength Rye
knob-creek-cask-strength-rye-1.bodyHtml:
A limited-edition, powerhouse expression for serious rye whiskey fans. This award-winning release takes Knob Creek's traditional, highly acclaimed straight rye whiskey and bottles it completely uncut and unfiltered at a blistering 119.6 proof (59.8% ABV). The result is an intensely concentrated flavor bomb that masterfully balances a robust, spicy rye kick with the deep, sweet, and heavily oaked undertones that the Knob Creek brand is famous for.

 

NOSE

Bold and intensely aromatic with notes of fresh dill, black pepper, dark caramel, and heavily charred oak.

PALATE

Rich, thick, and mouth-coating. A massive wave of peppery rye spice and cinnamon is perfectly balanced by sweet maple, rich vanilla, and dark fruit.

FINISH

Exceptionally long and chest-warming with a lingering, spicy sweetness and deep toasted wood.

knob-creek-quarter-oak-bourbon.title: Knob Creek Smoked Maple Bourbon
knob-creek-quarter-oak-bourbon.bodyHtml:
A heartfelt tribute to the founder of Knob Creek, Booker Noe, who loved the sweet, smoky flavors of his home-smoked meats and the rich taste of maple syrup. This expression takes Knob Creek's classic Kentucky Straight Bourbon and expertly blends it with natural smoked maple flavors. Bottled at an approachable 90 proof, it offers a beautifully sweet, subtly smoky, and full-bodied sipping experience that tastes like autumn in a glass.

 

NOSE

A robust, sweet aroma of rich maple syrup, toasted nuts, warm vanilla, and a distinct wisp of campfire smoke.

PALATE

Full-bodied and sweet. Prominent flavors of thick maple syrup and smoked hickory are expertly balanced by the underlying bourbon notes of caramel and oak.

FINISH

Smooth, sweet, and lingering with a pleasant, smoky warmth.

knob-creek-single-barrel-bourbon-1.title: Knob Creek x The Whisky Explorer Society Single Barrel No.20517
knob-creek-single-barrel-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
A highly exclusive, private barrel selection bottled specifically for The Whisky Explorer Society. This premium Kentucky Straight Bourbon was laid down in Warehouse J (Floor #5, Rick #17) and aged for a full 9 years. Bottled entirely uncut and unfiltered at a blistering 120 proof (60% ABV), it delivers an incredibly concentrated, robust, and complex flavor profile. This is a rare, one-of-a-kind barrel that showcases the absolute pinnacle of Knob Creek's heavy-oak, sweet-spice character.

 

NOSE

Intense and deeply aromatic with rich caramel, dark brown sugar, roasted peanuts, and heavy toasted oak.

PALATE

Thick, oily, and incredibly full-bodied. Huge waves of toffee, honeycrisp apple, and vanilla bean are layered over heavy barrel char, warm cinnamon, and a hint of dark cherry.

FINISH

Extremely long and chest-warming, leaving a lasting trail of peppery spice, dark caramel, and seasoned leather.

knob-creek-smoked-maple-bourbon-1.title: Knob Creek Smoked Maple Bourbon
knob-creek-smoked-maple-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
A heartfelt tribute to the founder of Knob Creek, Booker Noe, who loved the sweet, smoky flavors of his home-smoked meats and the rich taste of maple syrup. This expression takes Knob Creek's classic Kentucky Straight Bourbon and expertly blends it with natural smoked maple flavors. Bottled at an approachable 90 proof, it offers a beautifully sweet, subtly smoky, and full-bodied sipping experience that tastes like autumn in a glass.

 

NOSE

A robust, sweet aroma of rich maple syrup, toasted nuts, warm vanilla, and a distinct wisp of campfire smoke.

PALATE

Full-bodied and sweet. Prominent flavors of thick maple syrup and smoked hickory are expertly balanced by the underlying bourbon notes of caramel and oak.

FINISH

Smooth, sweet, and lingering with a pleasant, smoky warmth.

koch-el-mezcal-de-oaxaca-arroqueno-1.title: Paquera Arroqueno Artesanal
koch-el-mezcal-de-oaxaca-arroqueno-1.bodyHtml:
Crafted in Ejutla de Crespo, Oaxaca, Mexico, Paquera Arroqueño is an artisanal single-varietal mezcal produced by master mezcalero Francisco Javier Perez Cruz. Made from 100% wild-harvested Arroqueño agave (Agave americana), which takes between 18 to 20 years to mature into massive piñas, this limited-production spirit reflects the patience and heritage of Oaxacan distillation. The mature agaves are slow-roasted in traditional underground conical stone pits fueled by oak wood, crushed using a horse-drawn stone tahona wheel, and open-fermented in wooden vats with natural wild airborne yeasts. Double-distilled in classic copper pot stills, this unaged expression showcases the wild Arroqueño's legendary depth, offering a luxurious profile rich in floral sweetness, melon, herbal tea, and balanced mesquite smoke.

Food Pairing: Slow-cooked Oaxacan mole negro, roasted pork carnitas, grilled lamb chops, aged Manchego cheese, dark chocolate with sea salt, or grilled octopus with paprika.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear in appearance with brilliant clarity, a rich medium-to-full body, and slow-dripping, viscous tears.

Nose: Elegant, floral, and deeply aromatic, opening with sweet cooked agave, crushed fresh mint, and orange blossom, accompanied by soft wood smoke, green apple, wet stone minerality, and light baking spice.

Palate: Velvety, smooth, and multi-layered on the palate, featuring caramelized agave nectar, honeydew melon, and sweet citrus upfront before unfolding into soft mesquite smoke, cracked white pepper, herbal tea, and a subtle clay earthiness.

Finish: Long, warm, and refined with lingering notes of sweet agave, gentle oak smoke, floral nectar, and a crisp, mineral-rich warmth.

Serve: Enjoy neat at room temperature in a traditional clay copita or Glencairn glass to allow the extraordinary aromatic complexity of long-matured wild Arroqueño to fully open.

koch-el-mezcal-de-oaxaca-espadin-3.title: Koch El Mezcal Espadín
koch-el-mezcal-de-oaxaca-espadin-3.bodyHtml:
Koch El Mezcal Espadín is a joven mezcal artesanal from Koch El Mezcal of Oaxaca, made from Espadín agave matured seven to nine years and produced in Santa María Suchixtlán. It is double distilled in copper stills and bottled at 47% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The nose opens with sweet, fireplace-like smoke and ripe fruit, a strong herbal note and a minty lift with violets and pineapple. On the palate, cooked pineapple is joined by coconut, roses and freshly cut herbs, moving to ripe peach, cinnamon and white pepper.

Nose: Sweet smoke, ripe fruit, herbs, menthol, violet and pineapple.

Palate: Cooked pineapple, coconut, roses and fresh herbs, then peach, cinnamon and white pepper.

Finish: A fine note reminiscent of sherry jelly.

Serve: Neat at room temperature, sipped slowly.

kokanee-12.title: Kokanee 24 Cans
kokanee-12.bodyHtml: Kokanee Glacier Lager is a quintessential Western Canadian pale lager, celebrated for its exceptionally crisp and "crystalline" profile that mirrors its mountain heritage. Brewed with a blend of three different varieties of Pacific Northwest hops and mountain-pure water, it offers a light-bodied texture with a clean, refreshing taste and a subtle, grainy sweetness. The 18-can pack is a popular mid-sized format that balances portability with value, making it a reliable choice for camping, fishing, or backyard social gatherings. Each pour delivers a smooth, thirst-quenching experience with a dry finish that has established it as one of the most iconic beers in British Columbia and Alberta.

koval-dry-gin-1.title: Koval Dry Gin
koval-dry-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Koval Dry Gin is a certified organic and kosher dry gin from KOVAL in Chicago, built on the same organic grain base as the distillery's whiskeys and flavoured with juniper, grains of paradise, rose hip, angelica root and coriander. It is bottled at 47% ABV in a 750ml bottle, a little stronger than many gins, and won a Double Gold Medal at the 2015 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, Best in Show at the 2015 Los Angeles International Spirits Competition and Gold at the 2015 SIP Awards. KOVAL was founded in Chicago in 2008 by Dr. Robert Birnecker and Dr. Sonat Birnecker Hart and works grain to bottle, milling, mashing, distilling, ageing and bottling on site. Its name means "smith" or "blacksmith" in several Eastern European languages.

Nose: Wildflowers and juniper.

Palate: Very dry, with spices and herbs over a cereal undertone.

Finish: Dry and long.

Serve: In a Martini, a Negroni or with tonic.

koval-single-barrel-bourbon.title: Koval Single Barrel Bourbon
koval-single-barrel-bourbon.bodyHtml: With a mash bill of 51% corn and 49% millet, KOVAL Bourbon offers a drinking experience that is balanced, approachable, and unparalleled. Tucked away in a charred new American oak barrel to age, millet and corn learn to complement each other, neither taking the lead. Out of the bottle, this duet opens with notes of mango chutney, while the millet renders a soft whisper of vanilla throughout. Then harmonizing, the grains sing with the sweetness of apricot custard. This pair finishes with peppery caramel, a diminuendo into a wisp of clove spiked tobacco lingering on the tongue.

kraken-black-roast-coffee.title: The Kraken Roast Coffee Black Spiced Rum
kraken-black-roast-coffee.bodyHtml: One of the fastest growing rum brands, The Kraken® is the world’s first black spiced rum. The newest addition to the lineup, Black Roast coffee rum shimmers with dark complexity. As the tale goes, a doomed ship carrying coffee beans met the cruel fate of The Kraken one stormy night, creating a mixable 66.6 proof spiced rum infused with natural flavors and coffee bean essence. It is unexpectedly rich, dark, and smooth, and the perfect accompaniment to your favorite coffee cocktails.

kujira-10-year-old.title: Kujira Ryukyu 10 Year Old Single Grain Japanese Whisky
kujira-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Kujira Ryukyu Single Grain Whisky 10 years was distilled from 100% premium Indica rice, and matured in White Oak Virgin casks for more than 10 years. Masahiro Distillery was founded in 1883, its history could trace back to Ryukyu Kingdom era. Masahiro Distillery is known for its production techniques, prominent qualities, and passion for innovation.

Award List
Silver Medal (International Spirit Challenge 2020)

〜Tasting Notes〜
Nose: Rich and sweet butter with caramel, spices from sapwood like bourbon whisky.
Palate: sweet and buttery, like caramel, roasted wood, liquorice. With an extinguish taste of spice such as cloves and cinnamon.
Finish: bitterness with long finish of spices, that brings back the sweetness

kujira-12-year-old.title: Kujira Ryukyu 12 Year Old Japanese Whisky
kujira-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Kujira Ryukyu Single Grain Whisky 12 Year Old is a limited edition of Kujira series. It was distilled from 100% long grain Indica rice and matured in sherry casks for more than 12 years.

〜Tasting Notes〜
Dominant sherry notes with a nice mix of molasses and corn syrup, the natural sweet aroma of this whisky makes it a delightful sip. The strong yet tart fruity taste refers to the very quintessential flavor associated with the extract from balsamic vinegar. Dry palate slightly decorated with a hint of sweetness like rum mousse. A long aftertaste, first bitter, bring out a touch of enduring sweet. Sweet and full of flavor, just like a lovely combination of cognac and rum. The unique sourness doesn’t clash to the finish yet make this just perfect to drink.

kujira-20-year-old-bourbon-cask.title: Kujira Ryukyu 24 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Japanese Whisky
kujira-20-year-old-bourbon-cask.bodyHtml:
This Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is 100% selected rice distilled and matured in first fill bourbon barrels for more than 24 years by Kumesen Shuzo in Okinawa. Okinawa is part of the Ryukyu Islands, which are a chain of subtropical islands located at the southernmost tip of Japan. Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is an utterly unique tropical style Japanese Whisky. Thanks to the island’s warm climate, whisky takes less time to mature and thus has a stronger aroma and a bolder taste.

Kumesen Syuzo has been operational since 1952, and its primary product is Awamori. Back in 1989, though, the distillery started experimenting with whisky making in different oak barrels. In 2018, it introduced its first 20 Year Old Single Grain Whisky aged in bourbon cask also known as Kujira Ryukyu whisky.

This small batch Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is matured in bourbon barrel for more than 24 years which is made entirely of rice provides a wonderful taste profile that has distinguished itself from its malt counterparts and creates a refreshing choice for spirits lovers.

Gold 95pts (International Wine & Spirit Competition 2021)

Nose: herbs, dried plum fruits hint, prune, mint candy
Palate: sweet, chocolate, vanilla, spice, light smoky woodiness
Finish: licorice, Japanese pepper, long finish

kujira-30-year-old.title: Kujira Ryukyu 30 Year Old Japanese Whisky
kujira-30-year-old.bodyHtml:
Distilled with 100% premium Indica rice, Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is aged in selected Sherry, Bourbon and White Oak Virgin casks for more than 30 years in Okinawa, a beautiful southern tropical island of Japan with warm and humid weather all year round.

This unique expression brings full body and smooth experience, with notes of ripe berries which come to the fore while woody tannins that have been ripened for years bring the puckery sourness of Chinese herbs. A hint of nectar and woody character linger long after taste. Decades of maturation gives off deep woody scents of toasted oak barrels, and leaves a pleasantly strong flavour and long-lasting sweetness.

～Tasting Note～
Nose: nectar, caramel, heavy wood smoke of antique furniture
Taste: smooth and supple with complex tones of fruits citrus, caramel pudding, dried persimmons, sugar and rich ripe berries; wood tannins bring the puckery sourness of Chinese herbs
Finish: little nectars dotted among smell of wooden barrels with a long lingering finish of sweetness.

kujira-5-year-old.title: Kujira Ryukyu Whisky 5 Year Old White Oak Virgin Cask
kujira-5-year-old.bodyHtml:
Kujira Ryukyu Single Grain Whisky 5 years was made from 100% premium Indica rice. Matured in 1st filled White Oak casks and seated in subtropical climate at the southern end of Okinawa Japan for more than 5 years. Rich with woody aroma and dark fruity flavor. Body is smooth and mellow and finished with sweet notes.

〜Tasting Notes〜
Nose: Sweet scent of caramel and vanilla, and a bit licorice. Oak barrels bring in woody and spices notes.
Palate: Sweet caramel with a fresh vanilla note. With a hint of tannins from Oak barrels.
Finish: Smooth, mellow and sweet, with woody notes and spices like pepper.

kujira-8-year-old.title: Kujira Ryukyu 8 Year Old Japanese Whisky
kujira-8-year-old.bodyHtml:
Exceptionally malted, fermented, and distilled by craftsman in the distillery, the Ryukyu Whiskey is made from best quality Indica rice and unique Okinawa’s black koji, and then reserved in Spanish Sherry casks and selected American Kentucky bourbon casks for more than 8 years.

Taste Notes
Nose: perfume of oak barrel, vanilla, plum, fresh sweetness
Palate: Sweetness from bourbon and sherry oak cask, dry fruits, comfortable spiciness
Finish: Licorice, perfume, vanilla, spices

kurayoshi-8-year-old.title: Matsui The Kurayoshi 8 Year Old Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
kurayoshi-8-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Kurayoshi 8 Years is a pure malt whisky from Matsui Shuzo, the Tottori Prefecture producer whose Kurayoshi Distillery gives the range its name. Labelled Matsui Pure Malt Whisky, it is made from malt and matured in white oak barrels, carrying an eight-year age statement. Bottled at 43% ABV in a 700ml bottle, it sits in the core Kurayoshi line alongside the 12 and 18 year old expressions. The producer describes a sweet, fruity character reminiscent of dried orange, with vanilla and nuts lifted by a savoury-sweet aroma and a smooth mouthfeel. An approachable, gently sweet Japanese malt that suits neat sipping as well as a highball.

Tasting Notes: Dried orange, vanilla, nuts, smooth and sweet.

Serve: Neat, with a splash of water, or as a highball.

kurayoshi-pure-malt.title: Matsui The Kurayoshi Sherry Cask Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
kurayoshi-pure-malt.bodyHtml:
Matsui The Kurayoshi Pure Malt Japanese Whisky is a smooth and approachable blended malt whisky from Matsui Shuzo in Japan's Tottori Prefecture. Crafted from malt whiskies and matured in white oak casks, this no-age-statement expression offers a harmonious balance of gentle malt sweetness, dried fruits, toasted nuts, and vanilla. Pure water from the Mount Daisen region contributes to its soft, refreshing character, while subtle acidity and delicate oak bitterness provide balance. Bottled at 43% ABV, The Kurayoshi is an inviting introduction to Matsui's distinctive whisky range.

Food Pairing: Grilled salmon, teriyaki chicken, aged Gouda, roasted almonds, dark chocolate, and dried fruit.

Tasting Notes: A balanced blended malt whisky featuring gentle sweetness, dried fruits, toasted nuts, vanilla, and subtle oak.

Nose: Soft malt aromas, raisins, vanilla, toasted nuts, and delicate oak.

Palate: Smooth and rounded, with raisins, nutty sweetness, vanilla, malt, and balanced acidity.

Finish: Gentle and refreshing, with lingering malt sweetness, light oak bitterness, and subtle nuttiness.

Serve: Enjoy neat, over a large ice cube, or as a Japanese-style highball with chilled soda water.

kurayoshi-pure-malt-12-year-old.title: Matsui The Kurayoshi 8 Year Old Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
kurayoshi-pure-malt-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
