kweicho-moutai-chun-astrology-edition.title: Maotai Chun Astrology Edition Baijiu 375ml
kweicho-moutai-chun-astrology-edition.bodyHtml: Moutai Chun products are developed on top of the traditional manufacturing techniques of sauce aromatic baijiu Moutai Chun with a series of complex innovations to reduce sourness and boost flavor. Moutai Chun Astrology Edition features playful astrology concepts and youthful packaging design, every consumer can find the Moutai Chun Astrology Edition of their own.

kweicho-moutai-chun-bai-nian-sheng-shi.title: Maotai Chun Bai Nian Sheng Shi Baijiu
kweicho-moutai-chun-bai-nian-sheng-shi.bodyHtml:
Maotai Chun Bai Nian Sheng Shi Baijiu (茅台醇 百年盛世) is a Chinese spirit from the Maotai Chun range of the Kweichow Moutai Group, produced by the group's Guizhou Moutai Distillery technology development company. The box describes it as a mellow sauce-aroma (jiangxiang) baijiu. Made with traditional methods, it is aromatic and mellow, with earthy aromas, fermented fruit and light minerality, followed by a bold, savoury palate and a lengthy finish. Bottled at 53% ABV in a 500ml bottle and presented in a gold box.

Nose: Earthy, with fermented fruit and light minerality.

Palate: Bold and flavourful, with savoury notes.

Finish: Lengthy.

Serve: Neat in a small baijiu glass, with a meal.

kweichow-moutai-flying-fairy.title: Kweichow Moutai Flying Fairy Baijiu 500ml
kweichow-moutai-flying-fairy.bodyHtml:
Kweichow Moutai Flying Fairy Baijiu is the classic sauce-aroma (jiang xiang) baijiu from Maotai town in China's Guizhou province, a style the Flying Fairy label has carried since the 1950s. It is made from sorghum, wheat and water through a lengthy cycle that takes around five years from start to bottle: the grain is steamed nine times, fermented eight times and distilled seven times, and the resulting spirit rests in cellars for several years before it is blended and packaged. Often called China's national liquor and long associated with state banquets and diplomatic gifts, it is bottled at 53% ABV in a 500ml bottle and is prized both for drinking and for collecting.

Food Pairing: Chinese cuisine, especially spicy stews, as well as Korean grilled meats, sashimi and fried seafood.

Tasting Notes: Soy sauce, flowers, tropical fruit, pear, smoky nuts, plum

Nose: Distinctive savoury sauce aroma with flowers, pear, tropical fruit, smoky nuts and sweet plum.

Palate: Floral and perfumed, with pineapple, guava and a soy-sauce savouriness leading to a smoky middle.

Finish: Long and herbaceous.

Serve: Pour in small measures at room temperature and sip slowly, ideally alongside food.

lostal-cazes-estibals-1.title: Famille J.M Cazes L'ostal Cazes Estibals Minervois 2017 750ml
lostal-cazes-estibals-1.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2021 vintage) "« Bright ruby with purplish tints. Elegant nose offering aromas of red fruit, spices, tobacco and garrigue. Suave and elegant on the palate, with a seductive, unpretentious southern expression. You will be won over by the moderate proportions and accuracy. »" - 90/100, Gilbert & Gaillard

lostal-cazes-rose-1.title: J.M Cazes L'Ostal Rose
lostal-cazes-rose-1.bodyHtml:
J.M Cazes L'Ostal Rosé is a beautifully pale, bright salmon-pink rosé crafted by the legendary Famille J.M. Cazes, the owners of the iconic Château Lynch-Bages in Pauillac. Sourced from the coolest terroirs of the estate in the Languedoc-Roussillon region, this dry wine is made from equal parts Grenache and Syrah. The nose offers an elegant bouquet of wild strawberries, rose petals, and citrus peel, accompanied by tropical white fruits. On the palate, it is remarkably fresh, soft, and light, balancing juicy pomegranate and grapefruit flavors with a crisp acidity and a delicately saline finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light summer salads, steamed mussels, grilled salmon, lemon-basil shrimp, or a simple selection of mild goat cheeses.

la-crema-sonoma-chardonnay-2019.title: La Crema Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2024
la-crema-sonoma-chardonnay-2019.bodyHtml:
La Crema Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2024 is an elegant California white wine showcasing the cool-climate character of Sonoma Coast. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay, this expressive wine offers inviting aromas of Meyer lemon, ripe pear, white flowers, and subtle oak. Flavours of crisp apple, golden peach, and pineapple unfold across a rich, textured palate, complemented by delicate graham cracker and pastry notes. Vibrant acidity balances its generous fruit character, creating a smooth, refreshing wine with a lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Butter-poached lobster, grilled salmon, crab cakes, seared scallops, roasted chicken, creamy seafood pasta, butternut squash risotto, and soft cheeses.

 

89 Points - Wine Spectator

Fresh-cut Fuji apple, pear and lemon sorbet flavors are fresh and lively, with grace notes of cardamom and ginger snap, plus a whiff of toasted, buttery brioche on the finish. Drink now.

la-crema-sonoma-pinot-noir-2017.title: La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2022/2023
la-crema-sonoma-pinot-noir-2017.bodyHtml:
La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir is an elegant, medium-bodied red wine that perfectly captures the cool-climate maritime influence of California's coastal vineyards. The nose is incredibly fragrant, offering inviting aromas of macerated red cherry, red plum, cranberry, and delicate hints of forest floor, mushroom, and cinnamon spice. On the palate, it delivers concentrated layers of ripe raspberry, black cherry, and cocoa, beautifully accented by savory touches of cold black tea and a hint of fresh mint. Supported by vibrant, pithy acidity and fine, plush tannins, this well-structured Pinot Noir offers a smooth, generous mouthfeel that leads into a long, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Enjoy with grilled salmon, roasted duck, veal medallions, roasted pork loin, mushroom risotto, braised lamb, or chicken stuffed with goat cheese.

la-dama-tequila-blanco-1.title: Manuscrito Tequila Blanco - Chapter 1
la-dama-tequila-blanco-1.bodyHtml:
A complex yet perfectly balanced Blanco tequila that is equal parts sweet cooked agave, citrus, and vegetal notes -- reminiscent of the red volcanic soil and terroir of the Los Altos region. A mix of aromas and flavors -- such as wet grass, white pepper, grape, lemon zest, mint and bell pepper -- complement the cooked agave mouthfeel and cool vegetal finish. Made from single estate, 6-8 year, 100% Blue Weber agave and offered at 42.5% alc./vol. to provide a bolder and more complex tasting experience. Hand-crafted by Master Distiller Oscar Vazquez Camarena in Jesus Maria, Mexico, at “El Sabino” Distillery, this Blanco tequila is perfectly oxygenated to provide a smooth and balanced finish.

Tasting Notes: 

Nose:Sweet cooked agave, wet grass, lemon zest, grape, white pepper and floral.

Palate:Cooked agave upfront followed by balanced notes of citrus, vegetal, bell pepper, earthy and white pepper flavors.

Finish:Sweet cooked agave and peppery notes blended with a mix of mineral, floral, mint and citrus flavors.

PRODUCTION NOTES

  • 6–8 years, single estate, mature 100% blue weber agave

  • Cooked 48 hours in a stone brick oven and cooled for another 24+ hours

  • Four-part extraction via roller mill with deep well water

  • Open air, lactic fermentation in 10L stainless steel tanks with native yeast and fibers in fermentation

  • Twice distilled in copper pots and oxygenated for a smooth and balanced finish

  • Derived from just three ingredients: Agave, Water, and Yeast.

la-palazzetta-brunello-di-montalcino-201.title: La Palazzetta Brunello Di Montalcino 2020
la-palazzetta-brunello-di-montalcino-201.bodyHtml:
La Palazzetta Brunello di Montalcino 2020 is an exceptionally pure, organic red wine that captures the warm, generous personality of south-eastern Montalcino. It opens with an inviting bouquet of sweet wild cherries, ripe red plum, and wild strawberries, layered with undertones of Mediterranean dried herbs, licorice root, and a hint of smoky minerality. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, structured, and vibrant, balancing its rich core of red and dark fruit with firm, fine-grained tannins, refreshing acidity, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, Florentine T-bone steak, wild boar ragù, braised game meats, and aged Pecorino cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

Polished and precise wine with bright aromas of licorice root, pure leather, violets and cherry stones. Full-bodied, elegant palate with velvety tannins soaked in fruit and flowers, refreshing acidity and a good, savory aftertaste. Plenty of substance, yet the finish remains supple and juicy. Drinkable now, but best from 2026.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Sweet wild cherries and strawberries headline the nose, while undertones of herbs and earth provide balance. The palate is cohesive, but tangy, as the berries and cherries turn tart and the herbs freshen. On the finish, lots of chilli pepper heat and citrus zest combine with vibrant acid to create a very bright sensation.

la-pinta-pomegranate-tequila-liquor.title: Pama Pomegranate Liqueur
la-pinta-pomegranate-tequila-liquor.bodyHtml:
PAMA Pomegranate Liqueur is the world's first true pomegranate liqueur, crafted in the United States by Heaven Hill Brands (Bardstown, Kentucky). Made with all-natural California pomegranate juice, premium vodka, and a touch of imported tequila to impart subtle warmth and complexity, this vibrant, ruby-red liqueur captures the distinctive sweet-tart essence of fresh pomegranate arils. Bottled at 17.0% ABV (34 Proof), PAMA was specifically developed for modern mixology, adding brilliant jewel-toned colour and crisp, juicy acidity to cocktails without artificial flavours or excessive syrupiness.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with dark chocolate truffles, baked Brie topped with pomegranate seeds and walnuts, roasted duck breast, lamb chops with mint, goat cheese crostini, or vanilla bean panna cotta.

Tasting Notes: A bright, vibrant, and harmoniously sweet-tart fruit liqueur balancing juicy ruby pomegranate arils with crisp natural acidity, subtle citrus zest, and clean spirit warmth.

Nose: Fresh, inviting, and ruby-bright with aromas of freshly crushed pomegranate arils, red currant, cranberry, and subtle blood orange zest.

Palate: Medium-bodied, smooth, and lively on the palate, delivering concentrated tart-sweet pomegranate juice balanced by brisk natural fruit acidity and a clean, subtle hint of vodka and tequila warmth.

Finish: Crisp, refreshing, and moderately dry, fading with lingering pomegranate skin tartness and bright red berry freshness.

Serve: Serve chilled over ice with club soda or tonic water and a lime wedge, topped with dry Champagne or Prosecco for a PAMA Royale, or shaken into classic cocktails such as a Pomegranate Margarita, Cosmopolitan, or Martini.

la-storia-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: La Storia Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
la-storia-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
The La Storia Cabernet Sauvignon is a premium, fruit-forward red wine from the historic Trentadue Winery, a family estate in the Alexander Valley since 1959. This wine is known for its deep red colour and an expressive aromatic profile of blueberries, blackberries, and dark plums. Aging in French oak barrels adds sophisticated layers of cocoa, maple, and toasted vanilla, resulting in a medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel with ripe, velvety tannins. It is a highly consistent wine that frequently earns 90+ point ratings for its approachable yet structured "California sunny" personality.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of black currants, dark cherries and plums with notes of cedar, dried herbs, sweet spices and earth. The full-bodied palate has firmly framed tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a generous, fruit-driven finish with a savory edge. Drink or hold.

la-storia-chardonnay-2018.title: La Storia Chardonnay 2023
la-storia-chardonnay-2018.bodyHtml:
Trentadue La Storia Chardonnay 2023 displays vibrant, tropical fruit aromas featuring notes of green papaya, ripe apples, lemon curd, and white peach accented by toasted oak, vanilla, and light baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a lush, creamy texture with crisp citrus acidity, balanced oak integration, and a long, smooth finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken, seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster, creamy pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and soft-ripened cheeses like Brie.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Chardonnay displays a tropical nose, loaded with aromas of green papaya and lemon curd. The palate feels plush and almost sweet, with flavors of candied ginger, roasted pineapple and a bit of cinnamon that emerges towards the finish.

la-storia-cuvee-32-2018.title: La Storia Cuvee 32 Red Blend 2022
la-storia-cuvee-32-2018.bodyHtml:
The La Storia Cuvée 32 Red Blend 2022 is a bold, expressive, and fruit-forward New World red wine that serves as a highly successful, Italian-inspired "Super Tuscan" expression of its estate vineyards. It pours an attractive dark red colour with a slightly garnet shimmer, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of intense dark cherries, cassis, and raspberry confit, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of plum, blueberry, pomegranate, and mocha. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red blend is remarkably smooth, juicy, and round, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of sarsaparilla, baking spices, and a lush mouthfeel that highlights the exceptional quality of the 2022 vintage. Matured thoughtfully for 17 months in European oak barrels to enhance its structural depth and savory complexity, its structural crunch is sustained by relatively high, food-friendly acidity and soft, well-integrated tannins that carry into a long, fresh finish accented by a lingering touch of cocoa, leather, and black licorice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with casual Italian or hearty Mediterranean fare, including tomato-based pasta dishes with meat ragù, wood-fired mushroom pizzas, grilled pork chops, gourmet beef burgers, slow-cooked lamb shanks, traditional lasagna, and semi-hard or aged cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of ripe raspberry, cinnamon and lemon zest burst from the glass on the nose of this Sangiovese and Merlot dominated blend. The palate brings waves of berry, spice and herb flavors in a richly tannic framework softened by zesty acidity. While delicious now, this will be best from 2028.

90 Points - James Suckling

Red-fruited aromas of dark cherries, raspberry confit and mocha. The palate is medium-bodied with a lush mouthfeel and balanced acidity, giving flavors of sarsaparilla and baking spices. A simple and early-drinking blend of sangiovese, merlot, montepulciano and malbec. Drink now.

la-storia-merlot-2018.title: La Storia Merlot 2021/2022 750ml
la-storia-merlot-2018.bodyHtml: La Storia Merlot is and has been consistently fine example of the ability of this classic Bordeaux variety to make solid, tasty and age worthy wines. The main aromas and flavors are of dark cherry, plums, a bit of black licorice and herbs. The new oak barrels contribute a touch of vanilla, brown sugar, cocoa dust and toast. On the mouth the wine is soft and viscous, balancing the acidity and the tannins well for such a young wine. The finish is long and soft with suggestion of sweetness backed by ripe tannins.

la-storia-zinfandel-2018.title: Trentadue La Storia Zinfandel 2022
la-storia-zinfandel-2018.bodyHtml:
Trentadue La Storia Zinfandel 2022 is a robust and richly layered red wine crafted from estate-grown grapes in Sonoma County's historic Alexander Valley. The 2022 vintage displays dark, concentrated color alongside inviting aromas of ripe blackberry, dark plum, cherry liqueur, and cocoa, accented by nuances of toasted oak, baking spice, and vanilla. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied experience with plush fruit flavors, smooth tannins, and a balanced acidity that provides excellent structure and a warm, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with slow-cooked BBQ pork ribs, grilled ribeye steak, spicy sausages, dark chocolate desserts, or aged cheddar cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Red-fruited aromas of maraschino cherries, Damson plums, Jolly Rancher candy and potpourri. The palate is medium-bodied with fine tannins and balanced acidity, giving sweet notes of raspberry coulis, baking spices an dried herbs. Oddly sweet. Drink now.

la-vielle-ferme-red-1.title: Famille Perrin La Vieille Ferme Rouge
la-vielle-ferme-red-1.bodyHtml:
Famille Perrin La Vieille Ferme Rouge is a charming, approachable, and fruit-forward red wine produced by the renowned Perrin family of Château de Beaucastel. Sourced from limestone and clay soils in the sunny Ventoux region of the Southern Rhône, it displays a bright ruby-garnet color in the glass. The nose delivers inviting aromas of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and red plums, blended with delicate notes of Mediterranean garrigue herbs, soft spice, and a touch of black pepper. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, round, and supple, offering juicy red fruit flavors supported by smooth tannins and balanced acidity that lead into a clean, fresh, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled burgers, roasted chicken, wood-fired pizza, tomato-based pasta dishes, pork chops, charcuterie, and mild cheeses.

la-vielle-ferme-red.title: La Vieille Ferme Rouge 3L Bag in Box
la-vielle-ferme-red.bodyHtml: Pretty purple color with shiny reflections. The nose reveals a seductive bouquet of red fruit and spices. Full of delicacy, the palate is full of freshness and well-balanced, with aromas of cherries and very soft tannins, giving this wine great drinkability.

la-vielle-ferme-rose-1.title: Famille Perrin La Vieille Ferme Rose
la-vielle-ferme-rose-1.bodyHtml:
Famille Perrin La Vieille Ferme Rosé is a vibrant, refreshingly crisp, and fruit-forward rosé produced by the renowned Perrin family, owners of Château de Beaucastel. Crafted using a traditional bleed method (saignée) and direct pressing from limestone and clay-calcareous soils in Southern France, it presents a pale, shimmering salmon-pink hue in the glass. The nose is expressive and charming, featuring delicate notes of wild strawberry, red currant, white peach, and citrus blossom. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, supple, and beautifully balanced, pairing bright acidity with juicy red fruit flavors and a crisp, dry, and mineral-accented finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled shrimp, charcuterie, summer salads, goat cheese, caprese salad, barbecued chicken, and light pasta dishes.

la-vielle-ferme-rose-3.title: La Vieille Ferme Rose 3L Bag in Box
la-vielle-ferme-rose-3.bodyHtml: Elegant translucent pale-peach pink color with shiny reflections. Very fresh and very fruity, the nose is particularly seductive, combining notes of red fruit and juicy summer fruit such as nectarines and peaches. Great vivacity on the palate with beautiful fruity aromas. Well balanced by a slight bitterness on the finish which brings a lot of savoriness.

lagavulin-12-year-old-2016.title: Lagavulin 12 Year Old 57.7%
lagavulin-12-year-old-2016.bodyHtml: This commemorative 200th Anniversary with a 1816-2016 label is a classic, well-structured Lagavulin that smoke heads will love. Wonderfully smoky, oily and bitter-sweet, pure in style and beautifully balanced with an inspiring sophistication and as much at home with food as after-dinner, being lighter in aroma and texture and less drying than recent expressions. Limited quantities exist worldwide.

lagavulin-12-year-old-2017-56-50.title: Lagavulin 12 Year Old 56.5%
lagavulin-12-year-old-2017-56-50.bodyHtml: This commemorative 200th Anniversary with a 1816-2016 label is a classic, well-structured Lagavulin that smoke heads will love. Wonderfully smoky, oily and bitter-sweet, pure in style and beautifully balanced with an inspiring sophistication and as much at home with food as after-dinner, being lighter in aroma and texture and less drying than recent expressions. Limited quantities exist worldwide.

lagavulin-12-year-old-2018-57-80.title: Lagavulin 12 Year Old 57.8
lagavulin-12-year-old-2018-57-80.bodyHtml: A classic expression from historic Lagavulin distillery, this outstanding and inspirational 12 year old is full of energy and packed with distillery character. A particularly intense spread of flavours in this 2018 release.

lagavulin-12-year-old-2019-56-50.title: Lagavulin 12 Year Old 2019 56.50%
lagavulin-12-year-old-2019-56-50.bodyHtml: A classic stripped-down ?acoustic? Lagavulin, pure in style and from spirit specially selected for its high peating levels, this is a Lagavulin purist?s dream; wonderfully simple, and all the better for it.

lagavulin-16-year-old-1.title: Lagavulin 16 Year Old
lagavulin-16-year-old-1.bodyHtml: Considered by many to be the benchmark for Islay malts this classic pours a golden amber colour and wafts from your glass with intense smoky peat and iodine. The palate is full flavour, rich and smooth with peat, figs, dates, and vanilla followed by an enduring smoky and dry finish.

lagavulin-8-year-old-1.title: Lagavulin 8 Year Old
lagavulin-8-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Lagavulin 8 Year Old is an intense, brilliantly lively single malt Scotch whisky crafted at the legendary Lagavulin Distillery on the south coast of Islay. Originally released in 2016 as a limited-edition bottling to commemorate the distillery's 200th anniversary, this expression proved so immensely popular that it was permanently added to their core range. Matured exclusively in refill American oak casks, this 8-year-old malt strips away heavy wood influence to present a bright, fiercely untamed showcase of Lagavulin's classic character. It delivers a magnificent combination of crisp, maritime peat smoke and unexpected sweet, clean citrus brightness, creating a surprisingly punchy and complex dram despite its younger age statement.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with freshly shucked raw oysters, smoked salmon, intensely sharp blue cheeses like Stilton, grilled pork belly, or a sea-salted dark chocolate bar.

Tasting Notes : A pale, bright gold color with a light-to-medium body and a clean, sharp, yet surprisingly smooth and coating texture on the palate.

Nose : High-toned, clean, and smoky, opening with dominant aromas of burning peat, sea spray, and charred wood, beautifully layered with fresh lemon zest, green apple, milk chocolate, and a faint hint of tar.

Palate :Bold and explosive on the tongue, revealing an initial sweetness of honey and orange oil that quickly shifts into powerful layers of hot peat ash, cracked black pepper, brine, and savory wood smoke.

Finish : Long, warming, and remarkably clean, resolving with lingering notes of dry peat smoke, sea salt, clean wood ash, and a touch of sweet malt.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat at room temperature in a classic Glencairn glass to experience its pure, fiery Islay personality, or with a tiny splash of cool water to highlight the underlying fruit and sweetness.

lagavulin-distillers-edition-1.title: Lagavulin Distillers Edition 2020
lagavulin-distillers-edition-1.bodyHtml:
Lagavulin Distillers Edition 2020 belongs to the Islay distillery's Distillers Edition, a double-matured version of Lagavulin released each year in limited quantities. After its first maturation the spirit is given a second period in a different cask type, which brings a raisin-like sweetness to the intense, smoky character of the Islay malt. The Distillers Edition has won Double Gold at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition (2008, 2009 and 2011) and was named Best Islay Single Malt at the World Whiskies Awards in 2007. Bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it balances peat smoke with rich, sweet fruit and a very long finish.

Tasting Notes: Intense peat, vanilla, raisins, roasted malt, salt and coffee.

Nose: Intense peat and vanilla, with raisiny sweetness checking the smoke and crisp, roasty malt.

Palate: Sweet and luscious; clean malt and mouth-filling smoke, a salty tang, coffee, vanilla and a glimmer of fruit.

Finish: Very long, with fruit, peat and lasting oak.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

lagavulin-offerman-edition-guinness-cask.title: Lagavulin 11 Year Old Offerman Edition Guinness Cask Finish
lagavulin-offerman-edition-guinness-cask.bodyHtml:
Lagavulin and celebrity Nick Offerman have partnered to launch Lagavulin Offerman Edition: Guinness Cask Finish, the second limited edition single malt Scotch whisky created collaboratively by Offerman and Lagavulin.

This new Lagavulin Offerman Edition carries an 11 year age statement and has been finished for four months in former Guinness Beer casks from the Open Gate Brewery in Maryland. Bottled at 46% ABV, Lagavulin Offerman Edition: Guinness Cask Finish is described as “a glorious adventure in sweet peat through the combination of the intense peat and charred wood notes of Lagavulin with the roasted coffee, dark chocolate and sweet caramel notes from the Guinness casks.”

laphroaig-10-year-old-1.title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old
laphroaig-10-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig 10 Year Old is the quintessential Islay single malt and the flagship expression of the Laphroaig Distillery. Renowned for its intensely bold, smoky, and medicinal profile, this classic whisky is crafted using malted barley dried over peat fires found only on the island of Islay. Aged for 10 years in American oak ex-bourbon barrels, it masterfully balances its signature heavy peat smoke and salty maritime character with an underlying, subtle vanilla sweetness, making it a beloved staple for peat enthusiasts worldwide.

Food Pairing: Freshly shucked oysters, smoked salmon, strong blue cheeses like Roquefort, dark chocolate, or classic Scottish haggis.

Tasting Notes : Bright, sparkling gold in appearance with a medium-bodied, robust, and slightly oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Intensely pungent and earthy, leading with signature notes of medicinal iodine, seaweed, heavy peat smoke, and tar, followed by a faint whisper of sweet vanilla and honey.

Palate : Bold and uncompromising, delivering a massive hit of peaty campfire smoke, salty sea spray, and black pepper, which gives way to a surprising, gentle sweetness of vanilla and oak char.

Finish : Exceptionally long, drying, and deeply smoky, with lingering notes of tar, iodine, and maritime salt.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to slightly tame the intense smoke and release the hidden fruity and vanilla aromatics.

laphroaig-10-year-old-sherry-oak-finish.title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Sherry Oak Cask Finish
laphroaig-10-year-old-sherry-oak-finish.bodyHtml:
Smoke and sherry here from Laphroaig! The legendary distillery on the south coast of Islay has gone and released a fab 10 year old single malt Scotch whisky which has been finished in Oloroso sherry casks for over 12 months, and bottled up at 48% ABV. Alongside the familiar, intensely peaty elements of Laphroaig’s classic 10 Year Old expression, you’ll also find helpings of dark chocolate and maple syrup notes in this one’s flavour profile.
Those enjoying the Laphroaig 10 Year Old will first notice the bold, smoky taste, followed by a hint of seaweed and a surprising sweetness. This full-bodied variant is the foundation of all Laphroaig expressions and comes with a long finish.

This whisky was also named 2019 Best Single Malt Scotch 10 Years & Under by Jim Murray's Whisky Bible.

laphroaig-25-year-old-2014-45-10.title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old
