laphroaig-30-year-old.title: Laphroaig 30 Year Old 2024 Release
laphroaig-30-year-old.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig 30 Year Old 2024 Release is an exceptional Islay single malt that showcases the remarkable depth and refinement achieved through three decades of maturation. Aged in a combination of American oak barrels and European oak Sherry casks, this distinguished expression balances Laphroaig's signature peat smoke with layers of citrus zest, vanilla custard, rich toffee and delicate herbal spice. Bottled at 45.8% ABV, it offers an elegant, complex character with a lingering smoky finish, marking the inaugural release in Laphroaig's annual 30-year-old collection.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, roasted lamb, aged Manchego, grilled scallops, dark chocolate or salted caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes: Citrus zest, vanilla custard, treacle toffee, delicate herbs, white pepper and smouldering peat smoke.

Nose: Bright orange and lemon peel mingle with creamy vanilla, rich toffee and subtle coastal smoke.

Palate: Elegant and layered, with bergamot, sweet pastries, vanilla cream, fresh thyme and gentle white pepper, balanced by refined oak and soft peat.

Finish: Long and complex, with lingering campfire embers, delicate citrus, warming spice and gentle maritime smoke.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass, allowing several minutes for the aromas to develop. A few drops of water may reveal additional sweetness and soften the oak and smoke.

laphroaig-30-year-old-ian-hunter-story-1.title: Laphroaig 30 Year Old Ian Hunter Story Book 2 48.2%
laphroaig-30-year-old-ian-hunter-story-1.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig 30 Year Old The Ian Hunter Story Book Two is a limited-edition Islay single malt Scotch whisky celebrating the legacy of Ian Hunter, one of the most influential figures in the distillery's history. The second release in this collectible series, titled Building an Icon, honours Hunter's role in shaping Laphroaig's identity and establishing its reputation for distinctive peated whisky. Matured for three decades, this expression combines the distillery's signature maritime smokiness with the elegance and complexity of extended oak maturation.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, grilled lobster, roasted lamb, aged cheddar, dark chocolate, and smoked almonds.

Tasting Notes: Deep golden amber in appearance, with a mature, richly layered character combining soft peat smoke, dried fruit, warming spice, and polished oak.

Nose: Aromatic peat smoke mingles with dried fruit, seasoned oak, vanilla, and gentle maritime notes.

Palate: Rich and rounded, offering layers of sweet oak, dried fruit, warming spices, and distinctive Islay peat smoke.

Finish: Long and warming, with lingering smoke, oak spice, and a gentle sweetness.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a tulip-shaped whisky glass to appreciate its mature aromas and complexity. A few drops of water may be added according to preference.

laphroaig-cairdeas-2020.title: Laphroaig Cairdeas Triple Wood 2019
laphroaig-cairdeas-2020.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Càirdeas Triple Wood 2019 is a limited-edition single malt Scotch whisky crafted specifically for the Friends of Laphroaig community. Distilled on Islay, this expression was bottled at cask strength after undergoing a triple maturation process in ex-bourbon barrels, quarter casks, and European oak Oloroso sherry seasoned casks. It combines Laphroaig’s signature medicinal peat smoke with rich dried fruit, dark chocolate, and spicy oak complexity.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, blue cheeses like Roquefort or Stilton, dark chocolate truffles, grilled oysters, and sticky date pudding.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a rich, oily, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Bold and complex with medicinal peat smoke, iodine, sea salt, dried dates, raisins, toasted nuts, and sweet red fruit from the sherry influence.

Palate : Rich and powerful, delivering layers of sweet caramel, dark berries, and baking spices that quickly give way to heavy peat smoke, charred oak, leather, and dark cocoa.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warm, and lingering with persistent coastal peat, savory oak tannins, dried fruit sweetness, and lingering ash.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to soften the high proof and release the dried fruit and sherry sweetness.

laphroaig-cairdeas-triple-wood.title: Laphroaig Càirdeas 2026 French Oak
laphroaig-cairdeas-triple-wood.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig 'Càirdeas' French Oak 2026 is the 18th annual limited release in the celebrated Friends of Laphroaig series, launched for the Fèis Ìle (Islay Festival) in 2026. Marking a bold first for the distillery, this expression is matured entirely in 100% French oak casks. The European oak imparts structure, tannic grip, and a savory, dark fruit complexity that beautifully balances Laphroaig's signature coastal salinity, medicinal edge, and intense peat smoke, resulting in a rich, distinctly layered Islay malt.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, roasted duck with cherry reduction, strong blue cheeses like Roquefort, dark chocolate truffles, or freshly shucked oysters.

Tasting Notes : Natural mahogany to deep amber in color with a full-bodied, slightly oily, and chewy mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic and smoky, featuring freshly cut wood shavings, earthy peat fires, polished leather, honeydew melon, and sweet stone fruits with a distinct briny sea note.

Palate : Intense and layered with rich campfire smoke, sweet vanilla, black liquorice, brittle dark chocolate, grated star anise, roasted coffee, and a bright fruit lift of tart cherries, plum, and pomegranate.

Finish : Long, savory, and warming with distinct notes of smoked ham, sea salt, and lingering coastal peat smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to experience its full intensity, or add a few drops of water to open up the softer fruit and spice notes. Can also be enjoyed over ice.

laphroaig-lore-1.title: Laphroaig The Cask Lore
laphroaig-lore-1.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig The Cask Lore is a distinguished Islay single malt Scotch whisky crafted at the historic Laphroaig Distillery on the south coast of Islay. Created as a successor to the celebrated Laphroaig Lore, this expression represents a masterclass in cask marriage, combining whiskies matured across a diverse selection of cask styles—including first-fill ex-bourbon barrels, quarter casks, and Oloroso sherry butts—spanning a wide range of maturation ages. Bottled at 48% ABV without chill filtration, it showcases Laphroaig's signature bold medicinal peat smoke and maritime salinity balanced by rich dried fruits, spicy European oak, and creamy vanilla depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh Atlantic oysters, smoked Scottish salmon, grilled langoustines, dark chocolate truffles with sea salt, and pungent blue cheeses such as Roquefort or aged Stilton.

Tasting Notes : Deep burnished gold with warm mahogany highlights, presenting a full, rich body with an oily, velvety, and mouth-coating texture.

Nose : Rich bonfire peat smoke, coastal sea brine, dark dried fruits, bitter dark chocolate, roasted chestnuts, and sweet vanilla.

Palate : Full-bodied and intensely flavorful with notes of medicinal iodine, rich chili spice, sweet sherry-soaked raisins, charred oak, and malted barley.

Finish : Long, warming, and complex with lingering notes of earthy peat embers, sweet dried fruit compote, sea salt, and dry spicy oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or tulip-shaped whisky tasting glass, or add a few drops of pure spring water to unlock deeper sherry fruit and sweet spice layers.

laphroaig-quarter-cask-1.title: Laphroaig Quarter Casks
laphroaig-quarter-cask-1.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Quarter Cask is an iconic Islay single malt Scotch whisky that revives the historic tradition of aging whisky in smaller casks. After an initial maturation in standard ex-bourbon barrels, the spirit is transferred into smaller American oak quarter casks, creating up to 30% greater contact between the wood and the liquid. This accelerated maturation imparts a soft, velvety sweetness that balances Laphroaig's signature powerful peat smoke, medicinal brine, and coastal intensity without chill filtration.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked meats, charred steak, oysters on the half shell, strong blue cheeses such as Roquefort or Stilton, and rich dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Sparkling golden amber with a medium-to-full body and a rich, oily, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Powerful peat smoke, medicinal iodine, sea salt spray, sweet coconut, soft vanilla, and ripe banana.

Palate : Deep, complex, and full-bodied with a surge of peat embers, ash, and brine balanced by sweet vanilla cream, coconut, toffee, and toasted oak spice.

Finish : Very long, dry, and smoky with lingering notes of wood ash, coastal salt, sweet vanilla, and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of pure water to open up the sweet oak and vanilla layers beneath the heavy smoke.

laphroaig-select-1.title: Laphroaig Oak Select
laphroaig-select-1.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Oak Select (formerly known simply as Laphroaig Select) is a beautifully balanced, approachable introduction to the famously bold world of Islay single malt Scotch. It offers a more laid-back expression of the distillery's signature coastal character by marrying whiskies aged across five unique wood types: ex-bourbon casks, quarter casks, Pedro Ximénez sherry hogsheads, Oloroso sherry butts, and new American oak. The result is an inviting nose of classic medicinal peat smoke, lime zest, and sea spray, leading into a smooth palate of soft vanilla sweetness, rich honey, and subtle red fruit notes, all wrapped in a gentle, warm finish of dry ash and spices.

Food Pairing: The delicate balance of sweet oak and maritime peat smoke pairs perfectly with robustly flavored seafood, such as hot-smoked salmon or fresh oysters on the half shell with a squeeze of lemon. It also brilliantly complements rich, savory appetizers like artisanal bacon-wrapped dates or a plate of mature, creamy blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Sparkling gold with layered tones and a lighter, smoother, and slightly less oily mouthfeel compared to the standard 100% ex-bourbon expressions.

Nose : Classic Laphroaig peat smoke and damp earth, noticeably calmer and sweeter, layered with fresh barley, red fruits, vanilla-sugar, and a bright zest of lemon and lime.

Palate : Delicately sweet and easygoing upfront with flavors of honey, soft vanilla, and pastry croissants, quickly giving way to a gentle wave of medicinal peat smoke, sea salt, light dried fruit, and a pinch of black pepper.

Finish : Medium in length, clean and dry with lingering earthy peat smoke, subtle kitchen spices, a touch of almond marzipan, and trailing citrus zest.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat or with a tiny splash of room-temperature water to open up the sweet citrus and fruit notes.

laphroaig-triplewood-1.title: Laphroaig Triple Wood
laphroaig-triplewood-1.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Triple Wood is a softer, richer take on the Islay distillery's classic peated single malt, matured in three types of cask. Spirit of different ages is first aged in American oak ex-bourbon barrels, then blended and moved into small quarter casks, whose extra wood contact adds spice and cedar. Finally it rests in large European oak casks that held Oloroso sherry, gaining sherry sweetness and a full body. The result layers dried fruit, nuts and spice over Laphroaig's signature peat smoke and salt. It is presented at natural colour and bottled at 48% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Sweet raisins and creamy apricots, nuttiness, bonfire ash and earthy peat.

Palate: Creamy vanilla and fruit, with a suggestion of sherry sweetness.

Finish: Mouth-filling and very long, balanced by smooth, sweet caramel.

Serve: Neat, over ice or with a dash of cold water.

le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia-2018.title: Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia 2021 6L Methuselah
le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia-2018.bodyHtml:
Crafted in the famed Bolgheri appellation on the Tuscan coast, Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia is the second wine of the iconic estate Ornellaia. The benchmark 2021 vintage—celebrated for its exceptional balance and richness—is a masterfully composed Bordeaux blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot. It opens with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, cassis, cedar, tobacco leaf, and refined oak spice. The palate is full-bodied, opulent, and impeccably structured, offering silky tannins, bright acidity, and a lingering, luxurious finish.

Food Pairing: Serve at room temperature; pairs exquisitely with Florentine T-bone steak (Bistecca alla Fiorentina), braised venison, roasted lamb chops, rich wild boar ragù, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
This is one of the great vintages for this cuvée and would be a wine for lovers of Bordeaux. The 2021 Le Serre Nuove Dell'Ornellaia sports a saturated red hue and opens to a great layered and harmonious nose, with aromas of kirsch, leather, fresh Mediterranean herbs, and crushed flowers that all resonate together with wonderful purity and depth. It’s open and generous on the palate, with refined, polished tannins, outstanding length, and refreshing acidity that’s seamlessly woven into the wine. Boy, is this hard to resist now and is a truly stunning wine from recently departed winemaker Olga Fusari. Bravo. Stash as much of this as you can away – it’s one for the ages. A great feather in the cap for Axel Heinz as well, it can only increase anticipation of the house’s top label for next year. Bravo tutti.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast
On the nose, hot, meaty, umami aromas hold court, but dark fruit and a sanguine, tangy metallic component prevent those notes of smoke, pepper and tar from becoming overpowering. Undertones of vanilla and chocolate lift the fruit on the palate, but unyielding tannins and energetic acid ensure the spicy earthiness endures.

94 Points - James Suckling
A firm and linear red with currant, berry, chocolate and cedar character. It’s medium- to full-bodied. Fine tannins that run the length of the wine. It’s tight and focused. Energetic and bright. 50% merlot and 28% cabernet sauvignon and the rest split equally between petit verdot and cabernet franc. Better after 2026.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2021 Bolgheri Rosso Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia is a nicely extracted and rich blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. This vintage is very generous, even opulent, with dark fruit that is framed by exotic spice, baking chocolate and softly toasted tones from French oak. The wine ends on a creamy note with vanilla and cinnamon. The oak needs a few more years to integrate.

93 Points - Wine Spectator
A polished red, complex and perfumed, featuring black currant, blackberry, plum, violet and iron aromas and flavors. Builds nicely, showing off its poise and releasing the dense tannins at the end. This should evolve well. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Best from 2025 through 2040. 3,252 cases imported.

ledaig-10-year-old-1.title: Ledaig 10 Year Old
ledaig-10-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Ledaig 10 Year Old is a heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky distilled at the Tobermory Distillery on the Isle of Mull. Bottled at 46.3% ABV, non-chill filtered, and with no added color, this expression delivers a robust, maritime smoke profile balanced by sweet malt, black pepper, and earthy peat character.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, blue cheese, grilled ribeye steak, dark chocolate, and smoked meats.

Tasting Notes : Bright lemon gold appearance with a full-bodied, oily, and coating mouthfeel with prominent warming smoke.

Nose : Sweet peat smoke, medicinal iodine, ocean spray, crisp mint, citrus peel, and cracked black pepper.

Palate : Rich peat smoke, sweet barley, maritime salt, black pepper, clove, and subtle citrus zest.

Finish : Long and warming with lingering campfire smoke, sea salt, dried herbs, and peppered oak.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

legent-bourbon-1.title: Legent Kentucky Straight Bourbon
legent-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
A historic, cross-cultural collaboration that brings together the best of two whiskey worlds. Legent (pronounced "Lee-jent") starts with a historic Kentucky Straight Bourbon recipe from Fred Noe, the legendary Master Distiller at Jim Beam. The bourbon is then partially finished in French oak red wine casks and Spanish sherry casks before being masterfully blended by Shinji Fukuyo, the Chief Blender at Suntory. Bottled at 94 proof, it offers the robust, sweet character of a classic bourbon beautifully elevated by the dark fruit and complex spice of the wine finishes.

NOSE

A complex bouquet of rich caramel, dark cherry, warm oak, and distinct layers of dried fruit and wine tannin.

PALATE

Full-bodied, rich, and layered. Heavy notes of sweet vanilla, brown sugar, and toasted oak are beautifully complemented by tart cherry, raisins, and a touch of baking spice.

FINISH

Long, warm, and lingering with a perfectly balanced blend of classic bourbon sweetness and dry French oak.

licor-44.title: Licor 43 Original
licor-44.bodyHtml: Inspired by a golden elixir produced during Roman times, Licor 43 is made from a secret combination of herbs, fruit and citrus. The result is a delicious golden liquid, with an aromatic bouquet of vanilla, citrus and orange blossoms that instantly transports you to the Mediterranean.

limoncello-luxardo.title: Luxardo Limoncello Lemon Liqueur
limoncello-luxardo.bodyHtml:
Luxardo Limoncello is an Italian lemon liqueur bottled at 27% ABV. Luxardo describes it as a natural, artisanal product still made to the original family recipe first advertised in 1905: alcohol is infused with the peels, pulp and juice of lemons harvested in southern Italy to bring out their aroma and bright citrus taste. The company was established in 1821 by Girolamo Luxardo, remains entirely controlled by the founding family, and is based at Torreglia near Padua in the Veneto. Luxardo lists the liqueur as GMO free, kosher certified and vegan friendly. This listing is the 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Natural lemon aroma with a bright citrus taste.

Serve: Serve chilled and straight up, or over ice with soda or tonic water as an aperitivo.

lindemans-bin-45-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Lindeman's Bin 45 Cabernet Sauvignon
lindemans-bin-45-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Lindeman's Bin 45 Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptionally approachable, full-bodied, and fruit-forward Australian red wine that consistently delivers remarkable value and reliable, everyday-drinking enjoyment. Sourced from the broad, sun-drenched vineyards of the South Eastern Australia wine region, this classic expression showcases a deep ruby red color in the glass. The highly inviting aromatic bouquet opens with robust notes of dark ripe berries, juicy blackcurrant, and fresh dark plum, beautifully interwoven with subtle hints of cool mint, warm vanilla, and a touch of toasted cedar oak. On the palate, the wine is delightfully smooth and well-rounded, offering a generous core of dark fruit flavors that are perfectly supported by soft, velvety tannins. A gentle, balanced acidity carries this highly versatile profile through to a clean, crowd-pleasing finish laced with a whisper of spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic grilled hamburgers, hearty beef stews, slow-roasted leg of lamb, rich tomato-based pasta dishes, and mature cheddar cheese.

lindemans-bin-65-chardonnay-1.title: Lindeman's Bin 65 Chardonnay
lindemans-bin-65-chardonnay-1.bodyHtml:
Lindeman's Bin 65 Chardonnay is a highly approachable, vibrant, and fruit-forward Australian white wine that has enjoyed enormous global popularity since its initial launch in 1985. Sourced from the broad, sun-drenched vineyards of the South Eastern Australia wine region, it perfectly embodies a classic, everyday-drinking style. In the glass, it reveals a bright straw-yellow color with subtle green reflections. The inviting aromatic bouquet opens with fresh, lively notes of ripe peach, tropical fruit salad, and juicy rockmelon, elegantly layered with delicate hints of creamy vanilla and toasted French oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, generous, and straightforward, delivering a soft and creamy core of orchard and citrus fruits. A crisp, well-balanced acidity naturally lifts the wine's buttery characteristics, culminating in a clean, soft, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with creamy pasta dishes, roasted chicken, grilled white fish, vibrant simple salads, and soft, mild white cheeses like brie.

linkwood-37-year-old.title: Signatory Vintage Symington's Choice Linkwood 30 Year Old 1995 Cask 8 50.8% ABV
linkwood-37-year-old.bodyHtml:
Linkwood 30 Year Old 1995 is a single cask Speyside single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Signatory Vintage for its Symington's Choice series. The spirit was filled on 5 June 1995 into a first fill Oloroso sherry hogshead, cask number 8, and bottled on 14 April 2026 after three decades in wood. The cask yielded 341 numbered bottles, offered at a natural 50.8% ABV in 700ml bottles. A long-aged, sherry-matured Linkwood of real rarity, it is one for collectors and lovers of mature Speyside malt.

Serve: Neat, adding a few drops of water to taste.

liquidity-pinot-gris-2019.title: O'Rourke'S Peak Cellars Pinot Gris 2019
liquidity-pinot-gris-2019.bodyHtml:
Fresh and expressive, with pear, green apple, white peach, citrus, and delicate floral notes. The palate is crisp and balanced, offering juicy orchard fruit, refreshing acidity, subtle texture, and a clean, lively finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with seafood, grilled fish, sushi, salads, roast chicken, fresh vegetables, soft cheeses, or lightly spiced Asian dishes.

liquidity-pinot-noir-2018.title: Liquidity Rose
liquidity-pinot-noir-2018.bodyHtml:
Liquidity Rose is a British Columbia rose crafted from Pinot Noir grown specifically for rose production. Whole-cluster pressing and brief skin contact preserve freshness and delicate colour, while the wine delivers bright grapefruit and wild strawberry character with lively acidity and balance.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roasted salmon, watermelon feta salad, spicy sushi, and grilled prawns.

lismore-12-year-old-1.title: Lismore 12 Year Old Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
lismore-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Lismore 12 Year Old is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from the Lismore range of William Lundie & Co., matured for at least 12 years and bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle. It offers a fresh, grassy and herbal nose softened by vanilla, and a palate of burnt sugar and coffee bean that leads into a rich, malty finish.

Nose: Herbaceous and grassy, with vanilla bean underneath.

Palate: Burnt sugar and coffee bean.

Finish: Heavy malt and barley sugar.

Serve: Neat, with a splash of water, or over ice.

lismore-15-year-old-1.title: Lismore 15 Year Old
lismore-15-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Lismore 15 Year Old is a highly accessible and satisfying single malt Scotch whisky from the Speyside region, released by the independent bottling firm William Lundie & Co. (now overseen by J&G Grant). Known in the whisky world as a "mystery malt," the exact distillery of origin remains strictly undisclosed, although it is widely rumored to be sourced from the esteemed Glenfarclas distillery due to the brand's ownership ties. Aged for 15 years in oak casks, this expression delivers a classic, traditional Speyside profile characterized by a delicate balance of sweet orchard fruits, rich honey, and subtle toasted oak. It serves as an excellent, value-driven dram that beautifully captures the elegant and approachable style of the region.

Food Pairing: Roasted salted almonds, aged cheddar or gouda cheese, dried fruit and nut platters, baked apple desserts, or rich fruitcake.

Tasting Notes : Warm golden amber in appearance with a smooth, velvety, and medium-to-full bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Inviting aromas of salty roasted nuts, sweet apricot marmalade, floral honey, and baked cake, accented by subtle hints of toasted oak and vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and well-balanced, presenting a dry-yet-fruity profile with rich flavors of raisin toast, warm brown baking spices, sweet vanilla custard, and a delicate malt backbone.

Finish : Long, elegant, and gently warming, leaving a lingering impression of spicy fruit chutney, sweet floral honey, and mild toasted oak.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or with a splash of room-temperature water to fully open up its sweet fruity and floral aromatics.

lismore-18-year-old-1.title: Lismore 18 Year Old
lismore-18-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Lismore 18 Year Old is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from the Lismore range of William Lundie & Co., a brand the company established in 1974. The distillery that produces the whisky is not disclosed. Matured for at least 18 years, it has the colour of polished oak, and the brand describes it as a properly mouth-filling dram: a sherried nose touched with cinnamon, fruit and toffee leading the palate, and a finish that recalls butterscotch candy. Bottled at 43% ABV; this listing is the 750ml bottle, presented in a tube.

Nose: Floral to start, then dense chocolate and toffee.

Palate: Honey-roasted peanuts, aged oak and chewy caramel.

Finish: A fruity sweetness builds.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

lismore-21-year-old-1.title: Lismore 21 Year Old The Legend
lismore-21-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Lismore 21 Year Old The Legend is the oldest expression in William Lundie & Co.'s Lismore range of Speyside single malt Scotch whisky, presented in a decanter-style bottle. The Lundie family were whisky brokers in Scotland, and the second generation, Alan and Bruce Lundie, created the Lismore brand in 1974 using whiskies from Speyside. The brand describes the 21 year old as a mouth-filling, sherry-led malt with notes of cherry, cinnamon and sugar. It is bottled at 43% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Sherry, cherry, cinnamon and sugar, with a full, mouth-coating texture.

Nose: Chelsea buns, brown sugar and light wafts of peppery oak.

Palate: Custard, cinnamon and sherried fruit, with blood orange and sultanas.

Finish: Vanilla fudge and dried fruit.

Serve: Neat or with a few drops of water.

little-book-iii.title: Little Book Chapter 3 The Road Home
little-book-iii.bodyHtml:
Little Book Chapter 3 "The Road Home" is the 2019 release in the Little Book series created by Freddie Noe, eighth-generation Beam family distiller. It pays tribute to his grandfather Booker Noe, who gave Freddie the childhood nickname "Little Book", by blending four Kentucky straight bourbons from the original small batch collection Booker created: 9 year old Basil Hayden, 9 year old Knob Creek, 11 year old Booker's and 12 year old Baker's. As with every Little Book chapter, the components were blended and bottled at barrel strength, here 61.3% ABV, in a 750ml bottle. The name refers to the road Freddie travels to and from the distillery, the same road Booker drove during his years there.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla, barrel char and dried apricot with lingering oak.

Nose: Caramel, smoky barrel char, sweet baking spices and vanilla.

Palate: Vanilla, char and dried apricot, with oak that lingers.

Finish: Long, warm and sweet, layered with oak.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

little-book-iv.title: Little Book Chapter 4 Lessons Honored
little-book-iv.bodyHtml:
Little Book Chapter 4 "Lessons Honored" is the 2020 release in the Little Book series from Freddie Noe, eighth-generation Beam family distiller, and a tribute to his father, Fred Noe, and the lessons he passed down about whiskey and life. Each component was chosen for a connection to his father: a 4 year old Kentucky straight brown rice bourbon as the base, recalling Freddie's first solo project at the distillery; an 8 year old straight "high rye" rye whiskey, a nod to Booker's Rye; and a 7 year old Kentucky straight bourbon that Fred himself picked from a set of samples. Freddie tested 22 blends before settling on this one, which is bottled at cask strength, 61.4% ABV, in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Brown sugar, charred wood and dried cherry.

Nose: Rickhouse aromas of vanilla, oak and a hint of cereal grain.

Palate: Full-bodied, with brown sugar sweetness followed by charred wood and dried cherries.

Finish: Warm caramel and dry.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

loch-lomond-12-year-old.title: Loch Lomond 12 Year Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
loch-lomond-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Loch Lomond 12 Year Old is a beautifully balanced Highland single malt Scotch whisky, crafted at Loch Lomond Distillery in Scotland. Matured for 12 years in a combination of American oak casks, including bourbon, refill and recharred oak, this expression offers a distinctive combination of orchard fruit, creamy vanilla, gentle sweetness and subtle peat smoke. Bottled at 46% ABV, it delivers a rich yet approachable whisky experience, showcasing the distillery’s versatile distillation style and signature character.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoked salmon, grilled pork, roasted chicken, mature cheddar, smoked Gouda, toasted nuts and dark chocolate. Its fruity sweetness and delicate smokiness complement both savoury dishes and desserts.

Tasting Notes: A balanced Highland single malt featuring ripe orchard fruits, citrus, honeyed sweetness, creamy vanilla, toasted oak and a delicate smoky character.

Nose: Fresh green apple, golden pear, lemon zest, honey and vanilla, accompanied by subtle floral notes and a gentle hint of smoke.

Palate: Smooth and rounded with flavours of orchard fruits, sweet vanilla, caramel, citrus and toasted oak, balanced by soft spice and a light peaty undertone.

Finish: Medium to long, with lingering fruit sweetness, warming oak spice and a delicate touch of smoke.

Serve: Enjoy neat to appreciate its full character, with a few drops of water to open up its fruit and vanilla notes, or over a large ice cube for a refreshing experience.

loch-lomond-18-year-old.title: Loch Lomond 18 Year Old
loch-lomond-18-year-old.bodyHtml: OUR 18 YEAR OLD HAS BEEN MATURING IN THE FINEST OAK BARRELS CHOSEN BY TOMMY WALLACE, OUR MASTER COOPER AT THE TIME. TIME AND NATURE HAS BEEN ALLOWED TO BRING OUT THE SWEETER CHARACTER OF THE WOOD WITH A SUBTLE CHARACTERISTIC HINT OF PEAT AND SMOKE ENSURING A WELL BALANCED FINISH. LOCH LOMOND 18 YEAR OLD IS NON CHILL-FILTERED, TO KEEP THINGS JUST AS NATURE INTENDED.

loch-lomond-original.title: Loch Lomond Original Single Malt Scotch Whisky
loch-lomond-original.bodyHtml: LOCH LOMOND ORIGINAL SINGLE MALT WHISKY IS CAREFULLY MATURED, BEFORE BEING MARRIED IN THE FINEST OAK CASKS FOR THE PERFECT HARMONY OF FLAVOUR AND AROMA. THE RESULT IS AN ELEGANT AND FULL BODIED WHISKY WITH A SMOOTHNESS MAKING THIS EXCEPTIONALLY EASY TO DRINK. A SINGLE MALT SCOTCH WHISKY WITH A DISTINCTIVE BACKGROUND CHARACTER WITH A HINT OF SMOKE AND PEAT.

longmorn-16-year-old-1.title: Longmorn 16 Year Old
longmorn-16-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Longmorn 16 Year Old is a single malt Scotch whisky from Longmorn, a Speyside distillery owned by Chivas Brothers. For most of its history the distillery's output has been prized by blenders, so official single malt bottlings like this one are comparatively rare. This 16 year old is bottled at 48% ABV without chill filtration, which keeps the texture of the spirit intact, and this listing is the 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass, with a few drops of water if preferred.

longmorn-23-year-old.title: Longmorn 23 Year Old 750ml
longmorn-23-year-old.bodyHtml:
Longmorn 23 Year Old is a Speyside single malt from the Longmorn distillery, founded by John Duff in 1894. Unveiled in late 2016 alongside a reworked 16 Year Old, it spent more than two decades in traditional oak casks chosen to suit the soft, creamy and rich character of the Longmorn spirit. It is bottled at 48% ABV without chill-filtration, and the distillery presents it as the fullest expression of its house style, built around ripe orchard fruit and a long, smooth finish.

Tasting Notes: Orchard fruit, fudge, milk chocolate and gentle spice.

Nose: Soft vanilla fudge and creamy caramel with milk chocolate and honey.

Palate: Ripe pears and sweet red apples woven with spiced ginger cake.

Finish: Long and velvety smooth.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

longmorn-distillers-choice.title: Longmorn Distillers Choice
longmorn-distillers-choice.bodyHtml:
Longmorn The Distiller's Choice is a Speyside single malt from the Longmorn distillery, founded in 1894 by John Duff. Introduced in 2016 as the distillery's no-age-statement expression, it is drawn from three cask types: American oak, ex-Oloroso sherry casks and traditional oak casks. The producer describes it as a new take on the classic Longmorn toffee character, with the soft, creamy and rich profile the distillery is known for. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

Tasting Notes: The producer highlights toffee and a soft, creamy, rich texture.

Serve: Neat, over a large ice cube, or in a highball.

longrow-peated-single-malt.title: Longrow Peated Single Malt Scotch Whisky
longrow-peated-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Longrow Peated Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky distilled at the historic Springbank Distillery in Campbeltown, Scotland. First produced in 1973 as an experiment to prove that a heavily peated style could be crafted in Campbeltown, Longrow is double-distilled and dried entirely over peat smoke for 48 hours. This non-chill filtered and naturally colored expression offers a bold, earthy, and maritime peat profile balanced by underlying malt sweetness and creamy fruit notes.

Food Pairing: Smoked oysters, grilled ribeye steak, sharp blue cheese, smoked salmon, dark chocolate desserts, and roasted game.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold in appearance with a rich, oily, and medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Strong peat smoke, maritime sea salt, medicinal notes, damp earth, toasted marshmallow, and subtle citrus peel.

Palate : Rich and complex with dense peat smoke, sweet vanilla, dark fruit, medicinal heather, cracked black pepper, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with persistent peat smoke, drying oak tannins, sea salt, and soft sweet malt.

Serve : Best served neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature, or with a few drops of pure water to unlock the subtle fruit and floral notes hidden beneath the peat.

los-clop-blend-of-terroirs-2014.title: Bodegas De Los Clop Blend Of Terroirs 2015
los-clop-blend-of-terroirs-2014.bodyHtml:
Bodegas De Los Clop Blend Of Terroirs 2015 is a robust and highly expressive Argentine red blend that masterfully showcases the high-altitude terroir of the Uco Valley. Comprising 50% Malbec, 29% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 21% Cabernet Franc, it pours a deep, opaque ruby with striking dark purple hues. The complex, intensely aromatic bouquet offers alluring layers of ripe red berries, black plum, and black pepper, seamlessly interwoven with distinctive nuances of eucalyptus, sweet tobacco, smoke, and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, powerful, and impeccably balanced. A rich, concentrated core of dark fruit is elegantly framed by ripe, sweet tannins and a vibrant natural acidity, culminating in a long, highly satisfying finish with a lingering touch of savory oak spice.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with grilled prime rib, slow-roasted lamb shoulder, hearty beef stews, and mature hard cheeses on a savory charcuterie board.

90 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of iodine and oyster shell with violets and a rich, blue-fruit and dark-berry edge, too. The palate has smooth blueberries and plums. Polished and even. A blend of malbec, cabernet sauvignon and cabernet franc. Drink now.

los-clop-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon-1.title: Los Clop Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
los-clop-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon-1.bodyHtml:
Los Clop Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a full-bodied and expressive Argentinian red wine showcasing a deep red color with vibrant purple hues. On the nose, it delivers complex and inviting aromas of bright bell pepper, ripe cassis, and rich red fruit jam, perfectly interwoven with sweet notes of vanilla, roasted coffee, leather, tobacco, and subtle spices. The palate offers a robust yet approachable structure, highlighting a generous core of dark fruit flavors supported by sweet, round, and seamlessly integrated tannins. The finish is persistent, well-balanced, and highly satisfying, making it an outstanding value from Mendoza.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic grilled ribeye steaks, slow-braised short ribs, hearty beef stews, roasted lamb dishes, or savory pasta with rich meat sauces.

92 Points - James Suckling

This shows the varietal transparency on the nose with ripe, sweet currants, black olives, tobacco and a balsamic undertone that gives it a savory edge. Fluent and almost linear on the flavorful palate with a medium to full body. Tight and nicely chewy on the palate. Drink or hold.

los-clop-reserva-malbec-1.title: Los Clop Reserva Malbec 2023
los-clop-reserva-malbec-1.bodyHtml:
Los Clop Reserva Malbec 2023 is an elegant, full-bodied, and beautifully structured Argentine red wine crafted by Bodega Los Clop in Mendoza's prized Uco Valley. Displaying an intense, deep violet-purple hue, it opens with enticing aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, and fresh plums, seamlessly layered with delicate floral violet notes, sweet spice, vanilla, and subtle toasted oak from barrel aging. On the palate, it delivers a plush, velvety mouthfeel with rich dark fruit flavors, supple tannins, and a refreshing beam of natural acidity that carries into a long, smooth, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised beef short ribs, empanadas, wild mushroom dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

los-clop-reserva-paraje-cabernet-sauvign.title: Bodegas De Los Clop Paraje Altamira Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
los-clop-reserva-paraje-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:
Bodegas De Los Clop Paraje Altamira Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 is a robust, structured, and highly expressive red wine crafted from high-altitude vineyards in the prestigious Paraje Altamira appellation within Mendoza's Uco Valley. Showcasing a deep garnet-red color with vibrant violet reflections, the aromatic bouquet opens with alluring notes of blackcurrant, dark plum, and mint, elegantly layered with nuances of vanilla, cedar wood, and toasty oak. On the palate, it is medium-plus to full-bodied and beautifully zesty, offering a core of succulent dark fruit perfectly framed by firm, fine-grained tannins. A savory touch of leather, roasted coffee beans, and spice adds rich complexity, driving through to a long, persistent, and highly satisfying finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with grilled sirloin steak, slow-roasted pork chops, hearty beef short ribs, savory lamb kebabs, and mature firm cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

Zesty blackcurrants and plums with spicy oak and cedar wood. Succulent, spicy fruit on the palate with very firm yet fine-grained tannin. Long. Drink now or hold.

los-clop-reserve-paraje-malbec-2015.title: Bodegas De Los Clop Paraje Altamira Reserva Malbec 2017
los-clop-reserve-paraje-malbec-2015.bodyHtml:
Bodegas De Los Clop Paraje Altamira Reserva Malbec 2017 is an elegant, highly expressive Argentine red wine crafted from high-altitude vineyards in the prestigious Paraje Altamira appellation of the Uco Valley. It displays a deep purple color with vibrant ruby hues in the glass. The inviting aromatic bouquet offers concentrated notes of plum jam, ripe cassis, and fresh black cherry, gracefully interwoven with sophisticated nuances of clove, sweet vanilla, leather, and dark chocolate derived from careful oak aging. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, impeccably balanced, and well-structured. A rich core of dark fruit is beautifully supported by sweet, rounded tannins and a lively natural acidity, culminating in an elegant, remarkably persistent finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, slow-roasted lamb shoulder, rich beef stews, savory beef empanadas, and mature hard cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Deep nose of blackberries, ground cocoa powder and sweet spices. Spicy palate with round, juicy fruit and fine-grained tannin. Strong, oaky finish. Drink now or hold.

los-danzantes-mezcal-anejo-1.title: Los Danzantes Anejo Mezcal
los-danzantes-mezcal-anejo-1.bodyHtml:
Los Danzantes Añejo is an artisanal mezcal from Destilería Los Danzantes in Oaxaca, bottled at 46% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is made from 100% maguey espadín (Agave angustifolia) grown in the Valley and Sierra Norte regions of Oaxaca, under maestra mezcalera Karina Abad Rojas. The agave is roasted in a conical underground wood-fired oven using white oak, crushed with a horse-drawn stone mill, fermented naturally for six days in 800-litre wooden vats with native yeasts, and distilled twice in a 250-litre copper alembic. The producer states that the añejo then spends 16 months in barrels, 70% American white oak and 30% French oak. The result is a bright amber mezcal that the distillery describes as robust and elegant.

Nose: Light aromas of earth, smoke, ripe fruit and caramel.

Palate: Vanilla, wood and cinnamon.

Finish: Red-wood notes; robust and elegant.

Serve: Neat at room temperature, sipped slowly.

los-danzantes-mezcal-joven.title: Los Danzantes Joven Mezcal
los-danzantes-mezcal-joven.bodyHtml:
This artisanal mezcal is produced with 100% Espadín (Agave angustifolia Haw.), hand-harvested from the Oaxaca Valley plains. It is infused with flavors of the earth, volcanic rock and local woods that awaken our senses and connect heartfelt emotions.

Tastings Notes:

Aroma
Well-balanced aromas of roasted maguey blend with a mix of green herbs and sharp freshness.

Palate
Light, refined flavors marked by hints of sweet citrus at the peak, with strong lingering notes of roasted agave, a persistent citrus flavor and smoky aftertaste.

Silky, balanced flavors that are round and smooth, and spread equally throughout the entire mouth. This mezcal reveals everything and its strong legs and reliable aroma do not disappoint. The initial taste brings on notes of light fresh fruit, with a middle that calls into play concentrated green herbs, and then moves on to the sweet flavor of roasted maguey and a finish reminiscent of smoke and wood, including a strong lingering aftertaste that is generous in the throat and stomach.

los-danzantes-mezcal-reposado.title: Los Danzantes Joven Mezcal
los-danzantes-mezcal-reposado.bodyHtml:
This artisanal mezcal is produced with 100% Espadín (Agave angustifolia Haw.), hand-harvested from the Oaxaca Valley plains. It is infused with flavors of the earth, volcanic rock and local woods that awaken our senses and connect heartfelt emotions.

Tastings Notes:

Aroma
Well-balanced aromas of roasted maguey blend with a mix of green herbs and sharp freshness.

Palate
Light, refined flavors marked by hints of sweet citrus at the peak, with strong lingering notes of roasted agave, a persistent citrus flavor and smoky aftertaste.

Silky, balanced flavors that are round and smooth, and spread equally throughout the entire mouth. This mezcal reveals everything and its strong legs and reliable aroma do not disappoint. The initial taste brings on notes of light fresh fruit, with a middle that calls into play concentrated green herbs, and then moves on to the sweet flavor of roasted maguey and a finish reminiscent of smoke and wood, including a strong lingering aftertaste that is generous in the throat and stomach.

los-danzantes-mezcal-sierra-negra-1.title: Los Danzantes Joven Sierra Negra Mezcal
los-danzantes-mezcal-sierra-negra-1.bodyHtml:
Los Danzantes Joven Sierra Negra is an artisanal mezcal made by Maestra Mezcalera Karina Abad Rojas from the Sierra Negra variety of Agave angustifolia, grown in San Juan Lajarcia, Yautepec, Oaxaca. The agave is roasted in a conical underground wood-fired oven with white oak and mesquite, crushed on a stone mill pulled by the distillery horse, Sansón, and fermented naturally for six days with native yeasts in 800-litre wooden vats. It is then distilled twice in 250-litre copper pot stills and bottled unaged as a joven at 48% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear.

Nose: Fresh herbs such as basil, rosemary and mint.

Palate: Herbal and mineral, with cooked agave and toasted corn, a light touch of smoke and low acidity.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a copita or small tasting glass.

lot-40-cask-strength-3rd-edition.title: Lot No. 40 Cask Strength Third Edition
lot-40-cask-strength-3rd-edition.bodyHtml: As always, Lot 40 is made from 100% rye grain and aged in new oak barrels. This year’s Cask Strength release was initially aged in new American Oak barrels, with 75% of the whisky then being finished in new French Oak barrels to bring added depth and complexity. This imbues the whisky with notes of apple and honey, in addition to the characteristic rye spice and dried fruit notes that Lot 40 is known for.

louis-jadot-pouilly-fuisse-2018.title: Louis Jadot Pouilly-Fuisse 2023
louis-jadot-pouilly-fuisse-2018.bodyHtml:
This wine has aromas of fresh red apples, honey and white flowers with elegant and rich flavors of toasted nuts and citrus. One of the purest expressions of this typical Burgundian grape.

Ideal pairings for this wine include roasted salmon, shellfish or creamy cheeses.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Though supple and full of peach fruit, this also offers apple, lemon, floral and mineral flavors. Lively and leaves a juicy feel on the lingering finish. Enticing and harmonious. Drink now through 2028. 24,000 cases imported.

louis-roederer-brut-premier-1.title: Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2015
louis-roederer-brut-premier-1.bodyHtml:
Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2015 is an exceptionally precise and majestic prestige cuvée crafted by one of the most celebrated Champagne houses. Composed of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay meticulously harvested from 45 historic lieu-dit plots farmed with organic practices, this warm, dry vintage reveals a crystalline purity. The expressive bouquet unfolds with aromas of citrus oil, fresh chalk, white peach, and crushed mint, all underpinned by fine pastry notes and roasted almonds. On the palate, it delivers deep concentration and a chiseled structure, driven by a vibrant beam of salinity and an ultra-fine, persistent mousse that finishes with breathtaking vertical elegance and remarkable tension.

Food Pairing: This extraordinarily refined Champagne couples flawlessly with pan-seared sea scallops, fresh oysters, butter-poached lobster tails, or delicate caviar-topped blinis.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

From vineyards that are run organically, this iconic Champagne's latest iteration is as beautiful as ever. Textured, with a mineral undertow, the wine is just beginning to soften and show a balanced maturity. Drink this great wine now.

97 Points - James Suckling

For the warm and dry vintage this has tremendous freshness and elegance. The complex nose of citrus blossom, mint, lemon and lime zest opens up slowly as this aerates in the glass. The wine’s ample structure is still quite firm, which is a vintage characteristic, the mousse very fine but also very lively for an eight-year-old champagne. Cristal fans will love this as it is, but a year or two more in the bottle will do a lot for the very long mineral finish of this youthful masterpiece. A cuvee of 60% pinot noir and 40% chardonnay, picked from all 45 Cristal vineyard plots. Tasted at the Cristal vertical tasting at the champagne house on July 6th, 2023.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This mouthwatering Champagne has an ethereal quality, with a frame of chiseled acidity and focused precision to the pointillisme-like, vibrant mousse. Yet this shows depth and generous expression, with the finely spun notes of patisserie apple and blackberry fruit opening beautifully on the palate and through the minerally finish, with notes of grated ginger, blood orange granita, salted Marcona almond and anise.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

If the 2014 vintage was especially open and demonstrative, the 2015 Cristal is going to require more patience. Unwinding in the glass with aromas of citrus oil, crisp stone fruits, white flowers, crushed mint and subtle hints of buttery pastry, it's medium to full-bodied, deep and layered, with a deep, concentrated and rather introverted core of fruit framed by chalky extract and animated by a pretty pinpoint mousse. This is a serious, vinous Champagne that has considerable substance to age and may well evolve along the lines of the lovely 1985.

loveblock-pinot-noir-2019.title: Loveblock Pinot Noir 2021
loveblock-pinot-noir-2019.bodyHtml:
This is a delicious Pinot Noir, with fleshy black plum, layers of cherry and sweet berries that play on the palate and dance with hints of violet and savory notes.

Dry tannins and hints of cigar make this a versatile wine to pair with turkey, salmon, lamb and beef.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Presents pretty clove, nutmeg and cardamom details that are a lovely complement to the sleek maraschino cherry, raspberry and cranberry flavors at the core. A touch of malty Assam tea lingers on the finish, adding a firm note. Drink now through 2035.
91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of red cherries, raspberries and dried herbs with stony austerity. The palate is fresh and forward, with red cherry flavors and a medium to full body, finishing with nervy energy.

luce-2017.title: Tenuta Luce Toscana 2017
luce-2017.bodyHtml:
The wine displays an intense, almost impenetrable, ruby red color. On the nose, the wine introduces itself with intense red fruits and subtle hints of incense and spicy notes that bequeath extraordinary complexity. In the mouth, the bouquet’s complexity comes alive through elegant tannins that gift the wine with unique balance and structure.

97 Points - James Suckling
Dark-berry, walnut, cedar and violet aromas with just a hint of chocolate. Full-bodied, layered and rich with ripe tannins and a vivid finish. Shows energy and a velvety texture. Deep and long. Give it two or three years to soften. Try after 2022.

luigi-bosca-la-linda-old-vines-malbec.title: Luigi Bosca La Linda Old Vines Malbec 2024
luigi-bosca-la-linda-old-vines-malbec.bodyHtml:
he Luigi Bosca La Linda Old Vines Malbec 2024 is a bold, expressive, and fruit-forward New World red wine from historic high-altitude vineyards. It pours a brilliant, deep ruby-red with intense violet reflections, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of ripe blackberries, dark plums, and fresh cherries, layered with undertones of purple violets, sweet vanilla, and toasted spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Malbec is remarkably smooth, juicy, and round, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of dark stone fruits and a pleasant smoked aftertaste that balances the naturally vibrant acidity of the 2024 vintage. Crafted from hand-harvested 50-to-60-year-old vines and aged partially in French oak barrels, it features soft, polished tannins that carry into a clean, elegant, and persistent finish accented by a lingering touch of cocoa and savory tobacco.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with casual or premium red meat fare, including prime cuts of grilled flank or ribeye steak, lamb chops with fresh chimichurri, wood-fired mushroom pizzas, gourmet beef burgers, traditional beef empanadas, and a hearty wild mushroom risotto.

luigi-bosca-reserva-malbec.title: Luigi Bosca Malbec 2023
luigi-bosca-reserva-malbec.bodyHtml:
The Luigi Bosca Malbec 2023 is a bold, expressive, and fruit-forward New World red wine that perfectly captures the unique, high-altitude alpine spirit of Mendoza's premium growing regions during an exceptionally balanced vintage. It pours a brilliant, intense deep violet-red colour with intense purple reflections in the glass, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and plums, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of sweet tobacco, white pepper, delicate violets, and a hint of warm vanilla. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Malbec is remarkably smooth, juicy, and round, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of dark stone fruits, chocolate shaving dust, and sweet spices that balance the naturally vibrant, crisp profile of the 2023 vintage. Matured thoughtfully for twelve months in French oak barrels to maintain maximum fruit purity and structural depth, it is driven by a balanced, food-friendly acidity and soft, polished noble tannins that carry into a clean, energetic finish accented by a long, persistent touch of licorice and spice. 
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with casual or premium red meat fare, including prime cuts of grilled beef flank or ribeye steak, wood-fired mushroom pizzas, gourmet beef burgers, slow-roasted lamb chops, traditional beef empanadas, and hard or aged cheeses.

90 Points - James Suckling

Fresh red and black cherries, plums, roasted spices and dried herbs. Fruit-forward and juicy on the palate with firm tannins and a fresh, fruit-expressive finish.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Floral notes with hints of licorice create an attractive bouquet. The palate is fruit forward, showcasing nice acidity and fine tannins. A well-crafted, easygoing Malbec to enjoy with juicy beef empanadas or your favorite casserole.

luksusowa-potato-vodka-1.title: Luksusowa Potato Vodka
luksusowa-potato-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Luksusowa Potato Vodka is a Polish vodka made from potatoes and produced since 1928. Its name translates as luxury or luxurious, a nod to the quality the brand has built its reputation on. Distilled from potatoes rather than grain, it is certified gluten free and non-GMO, and potato gives it a fuller, smoother and almost creamy texture compared with many grain vodkas. The palate brings gentle notes of mashed potato, buttery popcorn and a hint of sour cream. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Palate: Smooth and almost creamy, with mashed potato, buttery popcorn and sour cream.

Serve: Well chilled and neat, or with your favourite mixer.

luzhou-laojiao-bainian.title: Luzhou Laojiao Heigai Ib
luzhou-laojiao-bainian.bodyHtml:
Luzhou Laojiao Heigai, sold internationally as Hey Guys, is a strong-aroma baijiu from Luzhou Laojiao of Luzhou, Sichuan, the house that holds most of the old fermentation pits in the strong-aroma category. It is made by pure-grain solid-state fermentation using the distillery's cellar-mud heritage technique, and a panel of Chinese Academy of Engineering academicians and China Alcoholic Drinks Association experts rated its quality equal to spirit from pits more than 30 years old. The producer describes it as richly aromatic, mellow, smooth and delicately sweet. Presented in a clear bottle with a black cap, it is bottled at 42% ABV in a 500ml size.

Palate: Rich grain aroma; mellow, smooth and delicately sweet.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in small baijiu glasses.

luzhou-laojiao-te-qu-1.title: Luzhou Laojiao Te Qu 60S Ib
luzhou-laojiao-te-qu-1.bodyHtml:
Luzhou Laojiao Tequ 60s Tribute Edition is a strong-aroma baijiu from Luzhou Laojiao of Luzhou, Sichuan, made as a salute to the brand's history. "Tequ" marks the top grade of Daqu baijiu, and this edition recreates the Tequ of the 1950s and 1960s, made in the same old brewing workshop to bring back the flavour of that era. It comes in a blue and white box with a yellow-labelled bottle. Bottled at 52% ABV in a 500ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in small baijiu glasses.

macallan-12-year-old-cny-2021.title: The Macallan 12 Year Old Double Cask CNY Edition 2020 2x750ml
macallan-12-year-old-cny-2021.bodyHtml:
The Macallan Double Cask 12 Years Old forms part of our Double Cask range which marries the classic Macallan style and the unmistakable sweetness of American oak. This is a fully rounded single malt in perfect balance, with flavors of honey, citrus and ginger.

The perfect partnership of Oloroso sherry seasoned American and European oak casks creates the distinctive, warm character of this harmonious single malt. Our skilled whisky making team optimize the right mix of European and American sherry seasoned oak casks to allow the delicate and indulgent flavors of American oak to take centre stage while the more traditional Macallan characteristics of rich fruits, sherry and wood spice provide a reassuringly familiar backdrop.

macieira-royal-spirit.title: Macieira Royal Spirit Brandy
macieira-royal-spirit.bodyHtml: More than 125 years after its launch, Macieira 5 Star remains the trusted and preferred brand of the Portuguese people. Pouring a rich golden brown it greets your nose with delicate complexity. Slightly fruity, the palate is smooth, rich and well structured.

makers-mark-46-bourbon-1.title: Maker's Mark 46 Bourbon
makers-mark-46-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
Maker's Mark 46 Bourbon is a highly acclaimed, deeply flavorful expression from the historic Maker's Mark Distillery in Loretto, Kentucky. Created by Bill Samuels Jr., this innovative expression was the very first release from the distillery's wood-finishing series. The process begins with standard, fully matured Maker's Mark wheated bourbon, which is emptied from its barrels so that ten seared French oak staves can be securely fitted inside. The bourbon is then returned to the modified barrels and aged for several additional months in a limestone cellar. This unique secondary maturation process amplifies the whiskey's natural characteristics, imparting intense wood notes, rich baking spices, and a deeply layered complexity while maintaining the iconic, front-of-the-palate smoothness that defines the brand.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with maple-glazed pork chops, dark chocolate bread pudding, smoked gouda cheese, or slow-cooked barbecue beef ribs.

Tasting Notes : Rich coppered amber in appearance with a full-bodied, smooth, and velvety texture on the palate.

Nose : Sweet toasted oak, rich caramel, vanilla bean, dried dark fruits, and subtle baking spices like nutmeg and cinnamon.

Palate : Complex and well-rounded featuring sweet caramel, creamy vanilla, toasted marshmallow, seared oak, and a warm mid-palate accent of baking spice.

Finish : Smooth, long, and warming with lingering notes of sweet oak, caramel, and persistent baking spice.

Serve : Served neat at room temperature, over a single large ice sphere, or in an elevated Old Fashioned cocktail.

makers-mark-bourbon-4.title: Maker's Mark 46 Bourbon
makers-mark-bourbon-4.bodyHtml:

Palate : Complex and well-rounded featuring sweet caramel, creamy vanilla, toasted marshmallow, seared oak, and a warm mid-palate accent of baking spice.

Finish : Smooth, long, and warming with lingering notes of sweet oak, caramel, and persistent baking spice.

Serve : Served neat at room temperature, over a single large ice sphere, or in an elevated Old Fashioned cocktail.

makers-mark-bourbon-6.title: Maker's Mark Kentucky Straight Bourbon 1.14L
makers-mark-bourbon-6.bodyHtml:
Maker's Mark Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a quintessential American classic, celebrated for its smooth, rich, and approachable character. Setting itself apart from traditional bourbons, Maker's Mark uses soft red winter wheat in its grain bill instead of rye, eliminating any harsh bite. Every single bottle is still hand-dipped in its signature red winter wheat wax at the distillery in Loretto, Kentucky, making it an icon of craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs excellently with rich, savory dishes like slow-cooked barbecue brisket, glazed pork ribs, and sharp cheddar cheese. It is also an exceptional partner for sweet desserts such as pecan pie, bread pudding, or dark chocolate truffles.

Tasting Notes : Rich amber with reddish highlights, offering a soft, smooth, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, and light fruity notes accompanied by subtle hazelnut and soft spice.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of butterscotch, vanilla, sweet wheat, toasted oak, and soft fruit.

Finish : Clean, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of sweet caramel, vanilla, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, on the rocks, or as a base in classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

makers-mark-bourbon-2.title: Maker's Mark Kentucky Straight Bourbon 375ml
makers-mark-bourbon-2.bodyHtml:
Maker's Mark Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a quintessential American classic, celebrated for its smooth, rich, and approachable character. Setting itself apart from traditional bourbons, Maker's Mark uses soft red winter wheat in its grain bill instead of rye, eliminating any harsh bite. Every single bottle is still hand-dipped in its signature red winter wheat wax at the distillery in Loretto, Kentucky, making it an icon of craftsmanship.
