Tasting Notes : Rich amber with reddish highlights, offering a soft, smooth, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, and light fruity notes accompanied by subtle hazelnut and soft spice.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of butterscotch, vanilla, sweet wheat, toasted oak, and soft fruit.

Finish : Clean, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of sweet caramel, vanilla, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, on the rocks, or as a base in classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

malfy-gin-con-arancia-1.title: Malfy Gin Con Arancia
malfy-gin-con-arancia-1.bodyHtml:
Malfy Gin Con Arancia is the blood orange expression of Malfy, the Italian gin brand distilled in Piedmont and bottled at 41% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Its vivid orange-red colour comes naturally from Sicilian blood orange peel, which is combined with other Italian oranges, hand-picked juniper and a selection of botanicals. The result is a bright, citrus-led gin with a juicy orange sweetness, hints of vanilla and tart grapefruit, and a crack of juniper to keep it dry. It works especially well in a long Gin Tonica or spritz-style serve with plenty of fresh fruit.

Tasting Notes: Rich, bittersweet citrus with orange sweetness and a juniper backbone.

Nose: Orange blossom with juniper in the background.

Palate: Juicy blood orange, a touch of vanilla and tart grapefruit, balanced by juniper.

Finish: Long and citrusy.

Serve: Over ice with tonic and a slice of orange.

malfy-gin-originale-1.title: Malfy Gin Originale
malfy-gin-originale-1.bodyHtml:
Malfy Gin Originale is the classic juniper-forward expression of Malfy, the Italian gin brand better known for its Con Limone bottling built around coastal lemons. Originale puts wild Italian juniper at the centre, supported by five further botanicals, for a crisp, dry and clean style. After distillation the gin is brought down to bottling strength with water from the Monviso mountain, drawn at the village of Crissolo in Piedmont. It is bottled at 41% ABV in a 750ml bottle. A versatile everyday gin, it works in a classic gin and tonic with a twist of citrus, in a Negroni or in a dry Martini.

Tasting Notes: Juniper-forward and dry.

Serve: With tonic and a citrus twist, in a Negroni, or in a dry Martini.

malfy-gin-rosa-1.title: Malfy Gin Rosa
malfy-gin-rosa-1.bodyHtml:
Malfy Gin Rosa is a pink grapefruit gin from Malfy, the Italian gin brand inspired by the Amalfi Coast. Its key botanicals are Italian juniper, pink grapefruit peel from Sicily and Italian rhubarb, joined by five further botanicals, which give the spirit its pink hue and bright citrus profile. Sicilian pink grapefruit ripens at lower temperatures, which is why it is prized in the recipe. Bottled at 41% ABV in a 750ml bottle for the Canadian market.

Food Pairing: Goat cheese or smoked salmon.

Nose: Pink grapefruit and juniper.

Palate: Grapefruit and juniper with hints of lemon and white pepper.

Finish: Crisp and refreshing.

Serve: With tonic over ice and a slice of grapefruit, or in a spritz.

malibu-mango-rum-liquor.title: Malibu Mango Rum
malibu-mango-rum-liquor.bodyHtml:
Malibu Mango is a Caribbean rum blended with mango liqueur, part of Malibu's flavoured range. Juicy mango meets creamy coconut for a fresh, sweet and easy-going drink that is made for warm-weather sipping. It is bottled at 21% ABV in a 750ml bottle, a lighter strength that keeps it approachable on its own over ice or as a mixer. Its tropical profile works especially well with soda, lemonade or orange juice, and it is a simple way to add mango to punches and frozen drinks. The white bottle carries Malibu's familiar palm-tree sunset emblem.

Tasting Notes: Ripe mango and creamy coconut.

Serve: Over ice, with soda or lemonade, or in a tropical punch.

mars-shinshu-iwai-traditional-whisky.title: Mars Iwai Tradition Blended Whisky
mars-shinshu-iwai-traditional-whisky.bodyHtml:
Mars Shinshu Iwai Tradition Japanese Whisky is a rich, malt-driven blended whisky crafted at the Mars Shinshu Distillery, located at an elevation of 798 meters in the heart of the Japanese Alps. Matured in a complex array of casks—including ex-bourbon, sherry, and red wine barrels—this expression pays homage to Kiichiro Iwai, a pivotal pioneer in the history of Japanese whisky distillation, delivering a harmoniously balanced profile of ripe dark fruit, warm spice, and a very gentle touch of peat.

Food Pairing: Glazed pork belly, teriyaki salmon, roasted duck, semi-hard cheeses like aged Gouda, or dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : Rich amber in appearance with a smooth, well-rounded, and medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Ripe cherry, honeyed malt, dark toffee, warm baking spices, and a subtle wisp of earthy peat smoke.

Palate : Complex and balanced, featuring flavors of ripe plum, bitter chocolate, sweet caramel, toasted oak, and gentle ginger spice.

Finish : Medium-to-long, warming, and elegantly dry with lingering notes of sweet sherry influence, dark cocoa, and mild oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its complexity, poured over a large ice cube, or mixed into a classic Japanese Highball.

mars-shinshu-iwai-whisky.title: Mars Shinshu Iwai Japanese Whisky
mars-shinshu-iwai-whisky.bodyHtml:
Mars Shinshu Iwai Japanese Whisky is a smooth, approachable blended whisky produced by Hombo Shuzo, the company behind Mars Whisky. Named in honour of Japanese whisky pioneer Kiichiro Iwai, this expression takes inspiration from American whiskey, combining corn and malt whisky matured in ex-bourbon barrels. Its inviting aromas of pear, quince, vanilla, and honey lead into a mellow palate of caramel, orchard fruits, and gentle oak spice. Light yet flavourful, it is equally enjoyable neat, over ice, or in classic whisky cocktails.

Food Pairing: Teriyaki chicken, grilled pork, roasted almonds, aged Gouda, caramel desserts, apple tart, and milk chocolate.

Tasting Notes: A smooth, lightly sweet blended whisky featuring orchard fruits, honey, vanilla, caramel, and delicate oak spice.

Nose: Ripe pear, quince, vanilla, honey, cinnamon, and lightly toasted oak.

Palate: Sweet corn, caramel, red fruits, vanilla, honey, and gentle baking spice, complemented by a soft texture.

Finish: Smooth and mellow, with lingering vanilla, honey, light oak, and subtle spice.

Serve: Enjoy neat, over ice, or in a Japanese highball. Also suitable for an Old Fashioned or Mint Julep.

martell-blue-swift.title: Martell Blue Swift Cognac
martell-blue-swift.bodyHtml:
An audacious combination. Martell Blue Swift is made of cognac VSOP then finished in Bourbon Barrels.

Through Martell’s signature distillation process, the eaux-de-vie absorbs the rich aromatic tones of the bourbon cask. The result is Martell’s hallmark style – delicate notes of candied fruit and plum – complemented by the subtle sweetness of vanilla and toasted oak from the casks. Exceptionally smooth, with a rounded taste and unique character.

The Color: Copper with golden highlights.
The Aroma: Gourmet notes of banana and caramelised pear introduce the subtle sweetness of vanilla, coconut and spices.
The Taste: A sensation of fullness and generosity with notes of ginger and candied fruit, followed by distinctive hints of toasted oak from the Kentucky bourbon casks.

martell-cordon-bleu.title: Martell Cordon Bleu Cognac
martell-cordon-bleu.bodyHtml:
Martell Cordon Bleu Cognac An iconic XO-level French Cognac first created in 1912 by Edouard Martell. Defined by its signature emphasis on eaux-de-vie from the prestigious Borderies cru, it offers exceptional smoothness, aromatic richness, and complex floral and fruit depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with roasted dark meats (such as duck or lamb), rich cheeses (like Comté or Roquefort), dark chocolate desserts, praline, and fruit tarts.

Tasting Notes : Deep, golden copper in color. It offers an exceptionally rounded, smooth, and mellow feel with a luxurious texture.

Nose : Vibrant, rich, and complex, featuring orchard fruit like candied plum and apple, harmonizing with roasted notes of mocha coffee, toasted almonds, and vetiver.

Palate : Mellow, elegant, and well-rounded with flavors of sweet spices, gingerbread, roasted cocoa, candied fruit, and subtle citrus notes.

Finish : Impressively long and complex, characterized by lingering notes of fruit, sweet spices, and toasted wood.

Serve : Best served neat in a tulip or traditional cognac balloon glass at room temperature, or over a single large ice cube.

martini-rossi-prosecco-1.title: Martini & Rossi Prosecco 750ml
martini-rossi-prosecco-1.bodyHtml: Martini & Rossi Prosecco Sparkling Wine is a dry, aromatic Italian sparkling wine made from the Glera grapes that grow in the lush, sun-drenched foothills of the Veneto and Friuli regions of north-eastern Italy. Ripened in this ideal climate, they give this Prosecco wine a stimulating fragrance.

masi-campofiorin-ripasso-1.title: Masi Campofiorin Rosso del Veronese 2023
masi-campofiorin-ripasso-1.bodyHtml:
Masi Campofiorin Rosso del Veronese 2023 is a landmark Italian red wine from the Veneto region, renowned for pioneering the innovative double-fermentation technique (ripassa method). Visually displaying a vibrant, deep ruby-red color, it opens with a fragrant and expressive bouquet of ripe red cherries, dark plums, and blueberries, interwoven with sweet baking spices, vanilla, and subtle cocoa accents. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body characterized by a harmonious balance between rich, concentrated dark fruit flavors, supple tannins, and a refreshing vein of natural acidity, carrying through to a long, velvety, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted meats, grilled ribeye steak, pasta with rich meat ragù, risotto with mushrooms, and aged Italian cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano.

93 Points - James Suckling

A restrained and complex wine with graphite, embers, licorice, red and dark fruit, plums and cherries on the nose. Soft palate with density, a medium body, crisp acidity and ripe tannins. Very silky, juicy and focused with a finish of star anise. Drink or hold.

masi-costasera-amarone-classico-2015.title: Masi Costasera Amarone Classico 2020
masi-costasera-amarone-classico-2015.bodyHtml:
Masi Costasera Amarone Classico 2020 is an iconic, full-bodied Italian red wine displaying a very dark ruby-red color and complex, expressive aromas of baked plums, dark cherry jam, and ripe blueberries, interwoven with elegant notes of dark chocolate, cocoa, coffee, and subtle dried herbs. On the palate, it delivers a rich, velvety texture supported by firm yet polished tannins, balanced vibrant acidity, and a long, warming finish with lingering nuances of sweet baking spices, blood orange, and cocoa.

Food Pairing: Excellent as an after-dinner wine or paired with roasted red meats, braised beef short ribs, game, polenta with sausage, or aged cheeses such as Parmigiano-Reggiano and Gorgonzola.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained and reductive style, showing aromas of bay leaves, red and black cherries and a whiff of flowers. Full-bodied, it has a compact profile on the palate with ripe and velvety tannins, tight-knit acidity and a superprecise finish. A bit technical and young at the moment but very good. It is drinkable now, but wait for more complexity to develop.

91 Points - Wine Advocate

The Masi 2020 Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Costasera (made with 70% Corvina, 25% Rondinella and 5% Molinara) shows dark fruit ripeness with meaty cherry and blackberry. Thanks to the younger vintage, you can appreciate the wine's primary intensity. A potent 15% alcohol content and a full-bodied texture sets this bottle up for a pairing with polenta and sausage. Tart cherry appears as a final send-off.

masi-costasera-amarone-classico-riserva-.title: Masi Costasera Amarone Classico Riserva 2018 / 2019
masi-costasera-amarone-classico-riserva-.bodyHtml:
Proud, majestic, complex and exuberant: this is a special cru version of Masi's gentle giant, Costasera. A benchmark for the Amarone category, which, together with Barolo and Brunello, makes up the aristocracy of the Italian wine world.

Opaque dark red. Intense, super-ripe fruit, cinnamon and vanilla aromas. Warm and satisfying, baked fruit, sweet spices, cooked cherries, cloves, dry and long finish.

Ideal with red meat, game and mature cheeses. Fine after-dinner drink.

 

2018 Vintage Ratings

93 Points - James Suckling

An Amarone that nudges Port, such is the density and liqueur-like notes of cocoa nibs, mocha, root spices and dried cherries. The tannins restrain the flavors into a sense of composure on one hand, while drying out the finish on the other. Very drying. Presumably, this simply needs time, or at least it is best to hope so.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A sleek, well-meshed red, with taut, sculpted tannins and lively orange peel acidity providing fine tension and focus for flavors of macerated raspberry and ripe black currant fruit, plus accents of cured tobacco, cocoa powder, iron and black pepper. Long and plushly textured on the finish. Corvina, Rondinella, Oseleta and Molinara. Drink now through 2038.

2019 Vintage Ratings

94 Points - James Suckling

A complex and deep wine. Highlights of dark chocolate and black pepper over black cherries. Refined and condensed tannins with exuberant, racy acidity and full body. Powerful, this has cellaring potential. Drinkable now but best from 2029.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

In the bottle with the black label, the Masi 2019 Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Riserva Costasera is generous in terms of ripeness, concentration and extract. This blend of 70% Corvina, 15% Rondinella, 10% Oseleta and 5% Molinara shows an inky dark appearance with baked fruit and blackberry preserves. With a 15.5% alcohol content, the wine definitely leaves its mark on all the senses. A hint of mild bitterness comes with the oak tannins.

masi-masianco-pinot-grigio.title: Masi Masianco Pinot Grigio 2024
masi-masianco-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
This offering from Masi celebrates freshness. Ripe, fresh Pinot Grigio brings notes of citrus, apple, and mineral, while semi-dried Verduzzo grapes add depth and acidity to the blend. The palate is dry with harmonious acidity and minerality, perfect for white meats, grilled fish, or as a well-chilled aperitif.

88 Points - James Suckling

An intense white full of spring flower, peach and almond aromas, with zesty acidity, a light body and a savory finish. Drink now.

masi-rosa-dei-masi.title: Masi Rosa dei Masi 2023
masi-rosa-dei-masi.bodyHtml:
A fresh and fruity rosé wine, but complex and elegant at the same time. A new interpretation of the rosé wine category thanks to the use of Masi's speciality Appassimento technique.

This wine is a Supervenetian, and a "brother" to Campofiorin, the famous red wine.

masi-valpolicella-bonacosta.title: Masi Bonacosta Valpolicella
masi-valpolicella-bonacosta.bodyHtml:
Masi Bonacosta Valpolicella is a classic, elegantly crafted, and highly accessible Italian red wine from the renowned Masi Agricola estate. Hailing from the historic heart of the Veneto region, this wine is produced using the traditional Veronese blend of Corvina, Rondinella, and Molinara grapes, sourced exclusively from the prestigious Valpolicella Classico zone. In the glass, it displays a bright ruby red color with subtle violet reflections. The aromatic bouquet is wonderfully fresh and inviting, opening with vibrant notes of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and crushed raspberries, gently layered with delicate hints of vanilla, wild meadow herbs, and a touch of savory spice. On the palate, the wine is light to medium-bodied, remarkably vibrant, and effortlessly balanced, delivering a juicy core of bright red fruit flavors. This refreshing, fruit-forward profile is supported by soft, silky tannins and a lively acidity, culminating in a clean, smooth, and highly versatile finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with classic tomato-based pasta dishes, mildly spiced risottos, savory grilled vegetables, lightly roasted poultry, and a variety of soft, fresh cheeses.

matsui-mizunara-cask.title: The Matsui Mizunara Cask Single Malt Japanese Whisky
matsui-mizunara-cask.bodyHtml:
Katsushika Hokusai’s masterpiece, “Thirty six views of mount Fuji”.
In this classic artwork, the wondrous Mount Fuji is depicted with red-crowned cranes, native to Japan. We believe this iconic image matches the oriental taste of our Mizunara cask whisky. Along with a refreshing after taste, you can enjoy this classic image of Japan on our label.

matsui-peated-single-malt.title: Matsui Peated Japanese Whisky
matsui-peated-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Matsui The Peated Japanese Whisky is a peated single malt from Kurayoshi Distillery in Tottori, Japan, made from carefully selected peated malt and matured in white oak casks. Bottled at 43% ABV, it combines gentle fruit sweetness with fresh malt, toasted oak, vanilla and a pronounced smoky peat character that carries through the finish.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, grilled mackerel, aged cheddar, roast meats, spicy ramen, dark chocolate, or rich dishes with smoky and savoury flavours.

Tasting Notes: Smoky and balanced, with fresh malt and fruit sweetness alongside toasted oak, vanilla, caramel and pronounced peat smoke.

Nose: Fresh malt and gentle peat smoke with vanilla, citrus and subtle floral character.

Palate: Rich and smooth, with sweet malt, toasted oak and vanilla wrapped in smoky, earthy peat.

Finish: Long and smoky, with lingering peat, gentle sweetness, oak and subtle brine.

Serve: Enjoy neat or with a few drops of water to open the smoke, malt and vanilla character.

matsui-sakura-cask.title: The Matsui Sakura Cask Single Malt Japanese Whisky
matsui-sakura-cask.bodyHtml:
Kikukawa Eizan’s “Beauty in the Cherry blossom Garden”.
The artist, Kikukawa Eizan, portrayed Japanese women of strength and grace in his ukiyo-e masterpiece, which we believe was a great fit for the sakura cask which also possesses an underlying strength of flavor and a sweet aroma.

matsui-the-tottori-bourbon-cask.title: The Matsui Sakura Cask Single Malt Japanese Whisky
matsui-the-tottori-bourbon-cask.bodyHtml:
Kikukawa Eizan’s “Beauty in the Cherry blossom Garden”.
The artist, Kikukawa Eizan, portrayed Japanese women of strength and grace in his ukiyo-e masterpiece, which we believe was a great fit for the sakura cask which also possesses an underlying strength of flavor and a sweet aroma.

mauro-molino-barolo-gallinotto-2015.title: Mauro Molino Gallinotto Barolo 2020
mauro-molino-barolo-gallinotto-2015.bodyHtml:
Mauro Molino Gallinotto Barolo 2020 is a highly captivating, elegant, and single-vineyard Italian red wine crafted from Nebbiolo grapes grown in the prestigious Gallinotto vineyard, situated within the Berri MGA (Additional Geographical Definition) in La Morra. This prized south/southwest-facing site features unique calcareous-clayey and marly soils, yielding a classic Barolo of exceptional depth. To develop its layered complexity, the wine undergoes maceration for ten days, followed by 18 months of aging in French oak barrels (60% large casks, 40% used barriques). In the glass, it displays a bright ruby red color and opens with a fascinating, highly expressive bouquet of ripe red berries, wild strawberries, and dark cherries, beautifully complexed by nuances of eucalyptus, fresh mint, rose hips, dried leaves, and subtle licorice. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red is remarkably vibrant and harmonious, showing superb energy and balanced structural weight, backed by polished, fine-grained tannins and a crisp line of mineral acidity that carries into a persistent, savory finish with a refreshing touch of citrus peel.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with slow-braised beef short ribs, herb-roasted rack of lamb, rich porcini mushroom risotto, truffle-infused tagliolini, or mature Piedmontese cheeses.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Barolo Gallinotto is fully loaded with ripe fruit without going too far. There is a core of red fruits framed by pie crust and delicate baking spices. The wine picks up speed in terms of mouthfeel, with energy and intense berry flavors, while maintaining harmony. The tannins are integrated and accessible. The wine is generally balanced from all points of view. It ages in both barrique and larger wood barrels. Production is 8,000 bottles.

92 Points - James Suckling 

Notes of red cherries, dried blood oranges, rose hips and hints of licorice. It is juicier and supple on the palate, with bright red fruit dominating. Medium-bodied with polished tannins and a sleek aftertaste. Shows firmness at the end. It is already attractive, but will be best to drink after three to four years.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

This red falls more into the balsamic camp, offering eucalyptus, juniper, Scotch broom and wild rosemary aromas and flavors. Raspberry and strawberry fruit adds complexity, while this ends with a firm, chalky feel. Best from 2028 through 2042.

mcguinness-creme-de-banane.title: Mcguinness Creme De Banane Liqueur
mcguinness-creme-de-banane.bodyHtml:
McGuinness Crème de Banane is a banana liqueur from McGuinness, the Canadian liqueur range made by Corby Spirit and Wine. Bright yellow, with candied banana aromas and a sweet banana taste, it is a back-bar staple that adds both colour and distinctive flavour to mixed drinks. Bottled at 15% ABV in a 750 ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Candied banana and sweet banana flavour.

Nose: Candied banana.

Palate: Sweet banana.

Serve: In tropical and creamy cocktails.

meiomi-chardonnay-1.title: Meiomi Chardonnay 2023
meiomi-chardonnay-1.bodyHtml:
The Meiomi Chardonnay 2023 is a rich, opulent, and overtly decadent California white wine crafted for those who adore a full-throated, buttery style. It displays a deep golden straw hue in the glass, releasing an intense, sweet-toned bouquet of baked yellow apples, tropical pineapple chunks, and warm lemon curd, deeply layered with notes of melted butterscotch, vanilla bean paste, and toasted praline. The palate is heavy-set, plush, and hyper-creamy, enveloping the mouth in a blanket of honeyed peaches, crème brûlée, and sweet baking spices that reflect the exceptionally sunny, late-harvest conditions of the 2023 vintage. Balanced by just enough soft acidity to keep its unctuous weight in check, it cruises into a long, luxurious, and heavily toasted finish that leaves a persistent trailing note of sweet oak and movie-theatre popcorn butter.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of creamy or savory dishes, including roasted chicken or turkey breast with herb butter, pan-seared sea scallops, poached Atlantic lobster with drawn butter, creamy wild mushroom risottos, crab cakes, fettuccine Alfredo, and soft artisanal cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

meiomi-pinot-noir-1.title: Meiomi Pinot Noir 2022/2023
meiomi-pinot-noir-1.bodyHtml:
Meiomi Pinot Noir 2023 is a deeply concentrated, intensely jammy, and unapologetically bold California red wine that breaks away from traditional delicate profiles in favor of pure, opulent fruit power. It floods the glass with a dark ruby-crimson hue, giving off an expressive and rich bouquet of macerated boysenberries, dark cherry cola, and strawberry jam, heavily layered with fragrant notes of sweet vanilla bean, mocha, and toasted graham cracker. On the palate, it behaves with a velvety, full-bodied weight, coating the mouth with plush, sweet-toned intensities of dark bramble fruits, mocha powder, and a soft, supple texture that defines this intensely warm and ripe 2023 vintage. Devoid of any aggressive tannins and structured with gentle, low acidity, it glides effortlessly into a smooth, decadent finish that leaves a long, lingering signature of brown sugar and sweet oak spice.

Food Pairing: This rich, fruit-forward style pairs excellently with smoky or slightly sweet savory dishes, including slow-cooked barbecued pulled pork sliders, wood-fired Peking duck pizzas, teriyaki-glazed salmon, gourmet lamb burgers with goat cheese, and standard charcuterie boards stacked with mild gouda or cured meats.

metaxa-5-star.title: Metaxa Five Stars Brandy
metaxa-5-star.bodyHtml:
Metaxa 5 Stars is the lighter, fresher member of the Metaxa Stars range, a Greek blend of sweet Muscat wine, fine wine distillates and Mediterranean botanicals. It combines Muscat wines from Samos, which bring mature, deep fruit, with Muscat wines from Lemnos, which add a lighter, airy freshness, and uses wine distillates from the lighter, floral end of the spectrum. The botanicals are macerated in wine alcohol for a year before the blend is married and aged. Luminous amber, bottled at 38% ABV in a 750 ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Smooth, with fresh fruit and floral notes.

Nose: Apricot, orange blossom and rose petals.

Palate: Floral notes, vanilla and white raisins.

Finish: Balanced, with a floral finish.

Serve: On ice, or in a mojito-style highball with lime, mint and soda.

meukow-vsop.title: Meukow VSOP Superior Cognac
meukow-vsop.bodyHtml: The remarkable quality of Meukow VSOP Superior was awarded several times in the most prestigious competitions and tastings around the world. Its incredible roundness is the fruit of the meticulous selection of eaux-de-vie entering in its blend and the minimum ageing requirement which is one year longer than the traditional VSOP. The richness and the delicacy of Meukow VSOP Superior aromas, and the power of its mellow tannins are outstanding.

meukow-xo-extra-old.title: Meukow XO Cognac Gift Set with Rack and Glasses
meukow-xo-extra-old.bodyHtml:
Meukow XO is the fruit of the blend that combines the power of the tannins brought by the long ageing in oak wood barrels and the delicacy of Grande and Petite Champagne eaux-de-vie with the sweetness of Fins and Bons Bois eaux-de-vie.

The glassware is very delicate, not recommended for delivery only local pick-up. Purchase at your risk.

mezcal-union-el-viejo-mezcal.title: Mezcal Unión El Viejo Mezcal
mezcal-union-el-viejo-mezcal.bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes:
Astringent, Dry, Butter, Herbs (mint, pine), Flowery, Sweet, Stone and New Woods.
notas de cata

Smell in the Mouth:
The first drink reveals its 100% artisan process with oak woods and mesquite. After you feel the agave caramelized notes, then flowery herbs tones of Tobalá Agave, which starts to turn off the alcohol power leaving a long back sweet taste of Espadín Agave.

Tasting Summary:
Artisan strong body, buttery, artringent, herbal and a sweet clean smoke.

mi-campo-blanco.title: Mi Campo Blanco Tequila
mi-campo-blanco.bodyHtml:
Our tequila begins as 100% Blue Weber Agave, matured for seven years. We gently squeeze the cooked piñas, illuminating the agave plant’s natural honey characteristic and quelling any trace of bitterness.

Blanco is double distilled, then fermented in open-air tanks, amid fragrant citrus trees, before resting for up to one month in the same French oak barrels used for aging Napa Valley Chardonnay, imparting an incredibly smooth taste.

AROMAS AND FLAVORS
A nose of cooked agave, banana, fresh coconut, almonds, sweet orange and green apple is layered over hints of elegant vanilla. On the palate, orange blossom tea underscores threads of honey and sweet orange, balanced by subtle white pepper notes.

mi-campo-reposado.title: Mi Campo Reposado Tequila
mi-campo-reposado.bodyHtml:
Our tequila begins as 100% Blue Weber Agave, matured for seven years. We gently squeeze the cooked piñas, illuminating the agave plant’s natural honey characteristic and quelling any trace of bitterness.

Reposado is double distilled, then fermented in open-air tanks, amid fragrant citrus trees, resting for three months in the same French oak barrels used for aging Napa Valley Pinot Noir and Cabernet Sauvignon, imparting an incredibly smooth taste.

AROMAS AND FLAVORS
The fragrant nose opens with cooked agave, ripe banana, apple, chocolate and cappuccino, layered over aromas of vanilla, cinnamon, pumpkin and clove. On the palate, honey maple, peaches and cream, white chocolate and a thread of minerality segues to a pepper and toasted oak finish.

mi-terruno-expresion-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Mi Terruno Expresion Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
mi-terruno-expresion-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Mi Terruno Expresión Cabernet Sauvignon is an exquisite red wine from Argentina, known for its deep color and complex flavor profile. The wine offers aromas of dark fruits, such as blackberries and plums, complemented by subtle notes of oak and spices. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied structure with smooth tannins, making it an ideal choice for pairing with grilled meats and hearty dishes.

90 Points - James Suckling

Currants, bark, cedar and roasted bell peppers on the nose of this juicy and creamy red. It’s medium- to full-bodied with medium tannins and toasty undertones. Drink now.

mi-terruno-expresion-malbec-1.title: Mi Terruno Expresion Malbec 2021
mi-terruno-expresion-malbec-1.bodyHtml:
Full ruby red color with violet hues. Black raspberry and violet aromas are perfectly combined with elegant tannins. Very good persistence. Ideal to pair with red meats and hard cheeses. Extremely good example of the emblematic red variety from Argentina.
90 Points - James Suckling
A juicy and soft malbec with aromas of currants, plums, olives and flowers. Supple and medium-bodied, with soft tannins. Drink now.

mi-terruno-mayacaba-malbec-2017.title: Mi Terruno Mayacaba Malbec 2020
mi-terruno-mayacaba-malbec-2017.bodyHtml:
Mi Terruno Mayacaba Malbec opens with aromas of perfectly ripe red fruits. Oak wood are appreciable too; vanilla, smoke, roasted and spicy. The color is a garnet red with bluish reflections. The palate is concentrated, expressive, and appetizing. Silky tannins that give way to a torrent of sensations on the palate, with a long and convincing finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

Cedar, spiced plums, hot chocolate, hazelnuts, coffee cream and baked mulberries on the nose, with some vanilla. Spicy and full-bodied with plush, broad tannins. Firm and compact, too, with a long and deliciously chocolaty finish. Drink or hold.

michelob-ultra-3.title: Michelob Ultra 24 Cans
michelob-ultra-3.bodyHtml:
Michelob Ultra is a light lager produced by Anheuser-Busch, engineered to appeal to active and health-conscious consumers. First introduced in 2002, it features a lower carbohydrate and calorie count than traditional lagers, offering a clean, crisp, and refreshingly light taste with subtle citrus notes and a bright, effervescent carbonation.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken salad, fresh ceviche, light fish tacos, sushi, steamed seafood, and mild goat cheese.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant pale straw yellow in appearance with a thin white head and a light, crisp, and highly carbonated mouthfeel.

Nose : Subtle and clean with gentle notes of sweet malt, light rice, and a faint hint of citrus hops.

Palate : Exceptionally light and refreshing, featuring clean cereal grain, a touch of cracker malt sweetness, and minimal hop bitterness.

Finish : Very short, crisp, and clean with zero lingering aftertaste and a dry, fizzy close.

Serve : Serve ice-cold directly from the bottle or can, or poured into a chilled pilsner glass.

michters-10-year-old-bourbon.title: Michter's US*1 Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon
michters-10-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:
A truly exceptional, highly acclaimed small batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon from the historic Michter's Distillery. Matured to the peak of perfection in fire-charred, new American white oak barrels, it is blended in holding tanks sized to hold no more than 20 full barrels at a time. This meticulous, small-batch process ensures exquisite attention to detail and results in a remarkably consistent, rich, and incredibly smooth flavor profile that punches well above its 91.4 proof.

NOSE

Rich and inviting aromas of sweet caramel, vanilla bean, toasted oak, and a hint of apricot.

PALATE

Smooth, earthy, and perfectly balanced. Deep flavors of sweet corn, rich caramel, peppery spice, and dark stone fruit coat the palate.

FINISH

Long, warming, and elegant with a lasting trail of sweet vanilla and oak.

michters-10-year-old-rye.title: Michter's US*1 Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye
michters-10-year-old-rye.bodyHtml:
A stunning expression of premium Kentucky rye. Michter's US*1 Rye is a Single Barrel release, meaning every bottle is drawn from a solitary, hand-selected cask to ensure peak flavor. The distillery is famous for its low barrel entry proof and heavily toasted/fire-charred barrels, which extract an unbelievable amount of rich flavor from the wood. Bottled at 84.8 proof, it delivers a masterful balance of spicy rye kick, citrus, and deep, sweet butterscotch.

 

NOSE

Bright and fragrant with aromas of cracked black pepper, fresh mint, orange peel, and warm vanilla.

PALATE

Incredibly well-balanced and smooth. A gentle wave of peppery rye spice is beautifully tempered by rich butterscotch, sweet caramel, and toasted oak.

FINISH

Crisp, smooth, and lingering with a pleasant, spicy warmth and sweet citrus.

michters-20-year-old-bourbon.title: Michter's 20 Year Old Bourbon
michters-20-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Michter's 20 Year Kentucky Straight Bourbon is one of the rarest whiskeys in Michter's Limited Production range. The distillery samples its barrels throughout maturation, but watches them especially closely once they pass 17 years – the age it calls the "Fork in the Road" point, when only certain barrels reach an exceptional level of quality. Master Distiller Dan McKee personally chooses those barrels for this very small bottling. Matured in fire-charred new American white oak barrels, it is distilled and bottled in Kentucky and bottled at 57.1% ABV (114.2 proof) in a 750ml bottle. Michter's notes that its age-stated Limited Production whiskeys are often considerably older than the age on the label.

Tasting Notes: Black cherry, rich molasses, honeysuckle, roasted pecans and toasted charred oak.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

michters-25-year-old-bourbon.title: Michter's US*1 Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon
michters-25-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:
A truly exceptional, highly acclaimed small batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon from the historic Michter's Distillery. Matured to the peak of perfection in fire-charred, new American white oak barrels, it is blended in holding tanks sized to hold no more than 20 full barrels at a time. This meticulous, small-batch process ensures exquisite attention to detail and results in a remarkably consistent, rich, and incredibly smooth flavor profile that punches well above its 91.4 proof.

NOSE

Rich and inviting aromas of sweet caramel, vanilla bean, toasted oak, and a hint of apricot.

PALATE

Smooth, earthy, and perfectly balanced. Deep flavors of sweet corn, rich caramel, peppery spice, and dark stone fruit coat the palate.

FINISH

Long, warming, and elegant with a lasting trail of sweet vanilla and oak.

michters-american-whiskey.title: Michter's US*1 Unblended American Whiskey
michters-american-whiskey.bodyHtml:
A highly sought-after, small-batch release that showcases Michter's absolute mastery of maturation. Unlike bourbon, which must be aged in new charred oak, this "Unblended American Whiskey" is aged in whiskey-soaked barrels that previously held bourbon. Bottled at 83.4 proof, this unique aging process yields an incredibly rich, sweet, and smooth spirit that doesn't have the heavy, woody bite of a traditional bourbon, making it one of the most dangerously drinkable whiskeys on the market.

 

NOSE

Sweet and inviting aromas of rich butterscotch, vanilla extract, and ripe orchard fruit.

PALATE

Incredibly soft, creamy, and sweet. Lush flavors of vanilla bean, caramel coated apple, and honeyed dried fruit.

FINISH

Smooth, exceptionally clean, and lingering with sweet notes of butterscotch and gentle vanilla.

michters-barrel-strength-rye-1.title: Michter's Barrel Strength Rye
michters-barrel-strength-rye-1.bodyHtml: "Complex and complete, the sweet and chewy aromas of maple syrup and crème de marrons meet milk chocolate and Andes Mints. On the palate, the intense layered sweetness of vanilla, crème Brulé, pecan pie, butterscotch, and honey is tempered by chili spice and deep earthy notes of leather and tobacco, before toffee and baking spices carry into the long finish." 92 Points, Whisky Advocate 2019.

michters-celebration-sour-mash.title: Michter's Celebration Sour Mash
michters-celebration-sour-mash.bodyHtml:
NO FURTHER DISCOUNTS APPLY.

Michter's Celebration Sour Mash

michters-small-batch-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:

michters-sour-mash-1.title: Michter's US-1 Sour Mash Whiskey
michters-sour-mash-1.bodyHtml:
A fantastic revival of a historic classic! During the 1970s and 80s, Michter's Original Sour Mash was the distillery's single most popular product. It utilizes a highly unique mash bill that doesn't legally qualify as either a rye or a bourbon, but rather sits beautifully right in the middle of the flavor spectrum. Bottled at 86 proof, it offers the sweet, deep caramel and vanilla notes of a great bourbon seamlessly combined with the rich, warming spice of a classic rye.

NOSE

Sweet and complex with prominent aromas of warm cinnamon, honey, toasted nuts, and butterscotch.

PALATE

Incredibly smooth and layered. Sweet flavors of rich butter, brown sugar, and vanilla give way to a beautiful, spicy rye backbone.

FINISH

Clean, smooth, and lingering with sweet honey and gentle baking spices.

michters-straight-rye.title: Michter's US*1 Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye
michters-straight-rye.bodyHtml:
A stunning expression of premium Kentucky rye. Michter's US*1 Rye is a Single Barrel release, meaning every bottle is drawn from a solitary, hand-selected cask to ensure peak flavor.
