michters-toasted-barrel-finish-sour-mash.title: Michter's Toasted Barrel Finish Sour Mash
michters-toasted-barrel-finish-sour-mash.bodyHtml: It is this award winning whiskey that is at the heart of our Toasted Barrel Sour Mash Whiskey. It is made by taking Michter’s US1 Sour Mash Whiskey and then aging it for an additional period of time in a second custom made barrel. This second barrel is assembled from 18-month air-dried wood and then toasted but not charred. Several different levels of toast for the second barrel were evaluated before our production team led by Master Distiller Dan McKee and Master of Maturation Andrea Wilson decided on the one that would best display the elegant nuances of this remarkable whiskey.

midleton-an-dair-blue-bell-irish-whisky.title: Midleton Very Rare Irish Whiskey 2025
midleton-an-dair-blue-bell-irish-whisky.bodyHtml:
Midleton Very Rare Irish Whiskey 2025 is the 42nd release in the prestigious annual vintage series from Midleton Distillery, celebrating the peak of Irish whiskey blending mastery. Master Distiller Kevin O'Gorman selected exceptional single pot still and single grain Irish whiskeys aged between 12 and 33 years in lightly charred ex-bourbon American oak barrels. This expression balances rich orchard fruit notes, delicate floral tones, and warm oak spices, delivering an exceptionally smooth, complex, and memorable tasting experience.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, aged Gouda, dark chocolate truffles, crème brûlée, or glazed pork belly.

Tasting Notes : Luminous honeyed gold hue with a silky, rich, and velvety mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Ripe green apples, sweet pears, vanilla bean, floral blossom, toasted oak, honeyed malt, and gentle nutmeg spice.

Palate : Smooth and complex with layers of orchard fruits, candied orange peel, butterscotch, creamy vanilla, toasted coconut, and warm clove spice.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warm, and elegant with persistent sweet fruitiness, gentle oak tannins, and lingering baking spices.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip glass, or with a few drops of pure water to open up the delicate aromas.

midleton-barry-crocket-legacy-still-pot.title: Midleton Barry Crocket Legacy Pot Still Irish Whiskey
midleton-barry-crocket-legacy-still-pot.bodyHtml: This whiskey represents Barry Crockett's personal selection of fine and elegant whiskeys which have been distilled and laid down over the past 24 years. As the custodian of the legendary Midleton style for over three decades, how fitting is it that the first ongoing bottling of a Single Pot Still whiskey under the Midleton name, pays tribute to the Master Distiller, Barry Crockett. This expression represents Barry's personal selection of old and elegant Pot Still whiskeys, exclusively matured in American bourbon barrels. Bearing the name of the celebrated second generation Midleton Master Distiller, Midleton Barry Crockett Legacy represents a selection of pot still whiskeys which have been matured exclusively in American bourbon barrels with a subtle contribution from a pot still distillate which has been matured in an unseasoned or virgin American barrel.

midleton-very-rare.title: Midleton Very Rare Irish Whiskey 2025
midleton-very-rare.bodyHtml:
Midleton Very Rare Irish Whiskey 2025 is the 42nd release in the prestigious annual vintage series from Midleton Distillery, celebrating the peak of Irish whiskey blending mastery. Master Distiller Kevin O'Gorman selected exceptional single pot still and single grain Irish whiskeys aged between 12 and 33 years in lightly charred ex-bourbon American oak barrels. This expression balances rich orchard fruit notes, delicate floral tones, and warm oak spices, delivering an exceptionally smooth, complex, and memorable tasting experience.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, aged Gouda, dark chocolate truffles, crème brûlée, or glazed pork belly.

Tasting Notes : Luminous honeyed gold hue with a silky, rich, and velvety mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Ripe green apples, sweet pears, vanilla bean, floral blossom, toasted oak, honeyed malt, and gentle nutmeg spice.

Palate : Smooth and complex with layers of orchard fruits, candied orange peel, butterscotch, creamy vanilla, toasted coconut, and warm clove spice.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warm, and elegant with persistent sweet fruitiness, gentle oak tannins, and lingering baking spices.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip glass, or with a few drops of pure water to open up the delicate aromas.

milagro-reposado.title: Milagro Reposado Tequila
milagro-reposado.bodyHtml:
Crafted in Tepatitlán de Morelos, in the high-elevation Los Altos region of Jalisco, Mexico, Milagro Reposado is an estate-grown 100% Blue Weber Agave Tequila founded in 1998 by Pedro Camarena and Danny Schneeweiss. Built on the vision of merging traditional tequila production with modern distilling innovation, the 100% Blue Weber agave (Agave tequilana) is harvested at peak ripeness after maturing for 6 to 8 years in mineral-rich red clay soils. The agave piñas are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens (mampostería) to extract maximum natural sugars, shredded using roller mills, and open-fermented in stainless steel tanks. Uniquely, the wash undergoes a double-distillation process utilizing both a traditional copper pot still to retain rich agave oils and a stainless steel column still to impart crisp, clean purity. The spirit is then rested for 2 to 4 months in American oak bourbon barrels, achieving a harmonious balance between vibrant, sweet cooked agave and subtle, warm oak characteristics.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken fajitas, roasted pork carnitas, fish tacos with chipotle cream, queso fresco, roasted squash, or dark chocolate with sea salt.

Tasting Notes: Bright golden straw in appearance with brilliant clarity, a smooth medium body, and delicate, slow-moving tears.

Nose: Fresh, bright, and inviting, opening with sweet cooked agave, lemon zest, and fresh green herbs, supported by subtle vanilla, toasted oak, light cinnamon, and white pepper.

Palate: Smooth, round, and balanced on the palate, featuring caramelized agave nectar, butterscotch, and citrus peel upfront before unfolding into soft oak spice, cracked white pepper, light caramel, and subtle herbal teas.

Finish: Medium-long, warm, and clean with lingering notes of sweet agave, subtle oak vanilla, zesty lime pith, and a mild peppery lift.

Serve: Enjoy neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or traditional Riedel Tequila glass, on the rocks, or as a rich, versatile base for craft cocktails like a Reposado Paloma, Tequila Old Fashioned, or Spicy Margarita.

milagro-silver.title: Milagro Silver Tequila
milagro-silver.bodyHtml: Made only from blue agave this clear, bright spirit is prized for its crisp fresh aromas and flavours of ripe agave and citrus fruits. Smooth and slightly vegetal on the palate with more agave and citrus notes, a spicy black pepper note provides balance on the lengthy finish.

milagro-single-barrel-reserve-anejo.title: Jose Cuervo Reserva de la Familia Extra Anejo Tequila
milagro-single-barrel-reserve-anejo.bodyHtml:
Jose Cuervo Reserva de la Familia Extra Añejo Tequila is a ultra-premium 100% Weber Blue Agave extra añejo tequila crafted as the private family reserve of the Cuervo family. Aged for a minimum of three years in a combination of new American and French oak barrels, with spirits from the family's oldest private cellars blended into the final release, this expression delivers rich complexity, deep wood tones, and exceptional smoothness.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate tarts, braised short ribs, aged Manchego cheese, grilled steak with chimichurri, or rich caramel flan.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber to mahogany hue with copper highlights and a rich, viscous, full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich toasted oak, sweet cooked agave, dark chocolate, dried fruit, cinnamon spice, toasted almonds, and warm vanilla.

Palate : Complex and smooth with dominant notes of charred oak, dark caramel, roasted agave, sweet vanilla, roasted nuts, toasted cocoa, and gentle baking spices.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warm, and elegant with lingering toasted oak, dark chocolate sweetness, and soft agave warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a cognac balloon or Glencairn glass to appreciate its full aromatic profile.

milagro-single-barrel-reserve-reposado.title: Montagave Single Barrel Canada Edition Reposado Tequila
milagro-single-barrel-reserve-reposado.bodyHtml:
Montagave Reposado Canada Edición is a limited single barrel tequila bottled exclusively for the Canadian market. Made from 100% agave, it is produced at the Cascahuín distillery (NOM 1123) from Lowlands (Los Valles) agave cooked in brick ovens, then rested in French oak before bottling at 90 proof (45% ABV). The result is a refined reposado that balances the agave with soft wood influence. This listing is the 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Smooth caramel, warm spice and a whisper of smoke.

Serve: Neat or with a single large ice cube.

miner-the-oracle-2015.title: Miner The Oracle 2016
miner-the-oracle-2015.bodyHtml:
The Oracle is an exceptionally balanced, full-bodied red blend made from grapes grown in a handful of our best vineyards in Napa Valley. In Greek mythology, the oracle was a source of inspiration and revelation. We hope that you will find the answers to life’s most compelling questions while enjoying The Oracle with friends and family.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Maturing, with sage and sassafras notes permeating the core of steeped plum and loganberry fruit. Mesquite and cedar details check in on the finish for added range. A bit on the chewy side, but shows lots of character. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Best from 2021 through 2028. 1,600 cases made.

90 Points - James Suckling

A very ripe red with dried-berry and raisin character. Full body, round and chewy tannins and a flavorful finish. A little overdone, but still outstanding quality in a typical Napa way.

miro-petite-sirah.title: Miro Dry Creek Valley Petite Sirah 2021
miro-petite-sirah.bodyHtml:
Miro Petite Sirah 2021 is a rich, robust, and deeply concentrated California red wine crafted by acclaimed winemaker Miro Tcholakov. Sourced primarily from mature vines in the prestigious Dry Creek Valley of Sonoma County, this wine showcases the incredible depth and power for which the varietal is known. In the glass, it displays an opaque, inky dark purple hue, opening with intense, high-toned aromas of ripe blueberries, fresh blackberries, and cherry pie, seamlessly interwoven with complex undertones of vanilla, brown sugar, cinnamon, and toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied and beautifully structured, delivering a dense, succulent core of dark bramble fruits and a whisper of black coffee. The naturally bold fruit expression is neatly framed by an energetic acidity and surprisingly soft, velvety tannins, culminating in a long, juicy, and highly satisfying finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with rosemary-infused grilled lamb chops, barbecue beef brisket, hearty wild boar ragù, and sharp, mature cheddar cheeses.

miro-zinfandel.title: Miro Dry Creek Valley Zinfandel 2019
miro-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Miro Dry Creek Valley Zinfandel 2019 is an exceptional, bright, and lively small-production artisanal California red wine masterfully crafted by acclaimed winemaker Miroslav "Miro" Tcholakov. Sourced from the premium Wolcott-Bevill and Göpfrich Vineyards situated on the northeast benchlands of the Dry Creek Valley, the fruit thrives in well-drained, decomposed rock and brick-red Manzanita-type soils. In the glass, it reveals a deep red color, opening with high-toned, concentrated aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blueberry, and fresh plum, layered with a hint of characteristic raisin-esque elements. Aging for 14 months in 25% new European oak barrels integrates complex nuances of vanilla, brown sugar, cinnamon, and a subtle toasty-oaky smokiness. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and beautifully balanced, presenting a succulent core of spiced dark bramble fruits that is seamlessly anchored by very soft, elegant tannins and a refreshing acidity, culminating in a long, remarkably juicy finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steaks, slow-cooked pulled pork, rich barbecued beef brisket, wood-fired meat pizzas, and mature hard cheeses like sharp white cheddar.

mission-hill-compendium-2013.title: Mission Hill Compendium 2013 750ml
mission-hill-compendium-2013.bodyHtml: A COMPENDIUM is a compilation of concise items on a subject, in our case, the combination of soil, climate, clone selection, and hand-harvesting of grape clusters to create this unique wine. The fruit was selected from specifically designated blocks within our vineyard estates in Osoyoos and Oliver, where the porous soil forces the vines to search for nutrients. This struggle results in elegant and luscious fruit. Following fermentation and extended maceration, this wine was aged for eighteen months in French oak barrels.

mission-hill-five-vineyards-pinot-gris.title: Mission Hill Reserve Crafted in BC Pinot Gris
mission-hill-five-vineyards-pinot-gris.bodyHtml:
Fresh and aromatic, with ripe pear, peach, green apple, citrus, and delicate floral notes. The palate is bright and rounded, showing juicy orchard fruit, refreshing acidity, gentle texture, and a clean, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with seafood, grilled fish, roast chicken, fresh salads, sushi, creamy pasta, soft cheeses, or lightly spiced Asian dishes.

mission-hill-quatrain-2013.title: Mission Hill Quatrain 2013 750ml
mission-hill-quatrain-2013.bodyHtml:
Mission Hill Quatrain 2013 is a complex, structured, and bold red blend from Mission Hill Family Estate's flagship Legacy Series, sourced from estate-grown fruit in the Osoyoos and Oliver sub-regions of the southern Okanagan Valley. The warm and extended 2013 harvest allowed each grape variety to achieve optimal ripeness and depth. The nose exhibits focused aromas of dark plum, black currant, and wild blackberry, layered with delicate nuances of star anise, crushed herbs, cedar, and dark chocolate. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-balanced, supported by firm, velvety tannins, a rich fruit core, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, rack of lamb, roasted duck, and sharp aged hard cheeses like cheddar.

mister-sam.title: Mister Sam Tribute Whiskey
mister-sam.bodyHtml: LIMIT OF 1 PER CUSTOMER. NO FURTHER DISCOUNTS APPLY.

mitre-espadin-joven.title: Mitre Espadin Joven Mezcal
mitre-espadin-joven.bodyHtml:
Mitre Joven is a 100% handmade elixir that pays homage to the ancient shaman warriors, precisely embodied in the design of the bottle. Originally from Santiago Matatlán, Oaxaca. Made with double distillation that results in a mezcal that seduces with its flavor, thanks to the Agave Espadín blend.

View: Crystalline and Brilliant.

Nose: Complex aromas that remind us of citrus and herbaceous like the same stalk, with a slight touch of smoke.

Mouth: Soft that confirms aromas and leaves a fresh sensation thanks to its pleasant acidity that remains pleasant and long in the aftertaste. Accompanied by a light and pleasant citric bitterness.

mollydooker-gigglepot-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Mollydooker Gigglepot Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
mollydooker-gigglepot-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Mollydooker Gigglepot Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 is a vibrant and beautifully structured red wine grown in the Rivers Lane vineyard of McLaren Vale. Barrel fermented and matured in 77% American and 23% French oak (50% new and 50% one-year-old), it dazzles with an alluring bouquet of forest fruits, blackcurrant, and subtle hints of freshly roasted coffee. On the palate, it reveals complex, rich layers of ripe blackberry, cigar box, and baking spices, seamless with an underlying chocolate cream richness, supple tannins, and a smooth, joyful finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with Middle Eastern lamb dumplings, braised beef short ribs, grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, and rich aged cheddar cheeses.

montaria-red-1.title: Montaria Red
montaria-red-1.bodyHtml: The Montaria Red is a highly approachable and widely enjoyed red blend from Portugal’s sun-drenched Alentejo region. Crafted by the renowned Luis Duarte Vinhos, this wine is designed to showcase the vibrant, fruit-forward character of traditional Portuguese varieties like Alicante Bouschet, Aragonêz, and Trincadeira. It is celebrated for its smooth, "velvety" texture and an off-dry profile that balances ripe blackberry and red plum notes with a hint of dark chocolate. Fermented in stainless steel to preserve its fresh primary fruit, it offers a clean, easy-drinking experience with soft tannins, making it an excellent "everyday" wine that pairs effortlessly with grilled meats, pasta, or hard cheeses.

montaria-white-1.title: Montaria White
montaria-white-1.bodyHtml:
Montaria White is a refreshing Portuguese white wine produced by Parras Wines in the Alentejo region. Made from traditional Portuguese grape varieties Arinto and Antão Vaz, this vibrant wine offers inviting aromas of apricot, plum, and citrus, complemented by delicate mineral notes. Fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel, it delivers a crisp, fruit-forward palate with balanced acidity and a clean, refreshing finish. An approachable white wine ideal for seafood, light meals, and warm-weather entertaining.

Food Pairing: Grilled white fish, shrimp, steamed mussels, seafood rice, fresh salads, roasted vegetables, goat cheese, and light Mediterranean dishes.

montelobos-mezcal-1.title: Montelobos Espadin Mezcal
montelobos-mezcal-1.bodyHtml:
Montelobos Espadin is an unaged mezcal joven, crafted from meticulously cultivated organic agave Espadin, which is roasted underground and small batch distilled to achieve a perfect balance of sweetness and subtle smoke.

Montelobos Mezcal; Montelobos Mezcal Artesanal; Mezcal; Organic Mezcal; 100% Sustainable Mezcal ; Montelobos Espadin; Montelobos Espadin Mezcal; Montelobos Espadin Mezcal Artesanal;Espadin

montes-folly-2017.title: Montes Folly Syrah 2021
montes-folly-2017.bodyHtml:
Montes Folly Syrah 2021 is a monumental and deeply complex Chilean red wine crafted from low-yielding vines grown on the steepest, highest slopes of the estate’s Finca Apalta vineyard. The 2021 growing season benefited from substantial winter rains that replenished the water tables, followed by a cool ripening period that preserved striking acidity and fresh varietal personality. In the glass, it displays an impressive, deep ruby-violet color with concentrated borders. The nose opens with intense, brooding aromas of ripe blueberry, blackberry, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with notes of dark chocolate, black pepper, nutmeg, candy, and premium leather. As it opens, it reveals refined nuances of tobacco, toast, and vanilla derived from 18 months of aging in French oak barrels. On the palate, this ultra-premium Syrah is robust, exceptionally balanced, and full-bodied, carrying a silky texture and a dense mid-palate structure. Polished, velvety tannins and lively acidity lead into a lengthy, powerful finish marked by hints of licorice, sweet baking spice, and a touch of wild game.

Food Pairing: This highly structured and concentrated Syrah is an absolute match for rich duck breast with a berry reduction, grilled venison, herb-crusted lamb chops, roasted pork tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, or a spicy lamb masala curry.

97 Points - James Suckling

Lots of sweet tobacco, dried meat, graphite and blackberry aromas follow through to a medium to full body, tight center palate and juicy fruit with solid and tight velvety tannins that are very long. Just a touch of wood at the end. Drink or hold. Will age beautifully.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Folly comes from a hillside area of the Apalta property and aged for 18 months in 70% new French oak. The nose features meaty, savory aromas and ripe dark fruits, beautifully framed by high-quality new oak. On the palate, it is voluptuous and powerful, seamlessly leading to a saturated, staining finish with velvety, intense tannins. This wine will benefit from another year or so of cellaring and should delight fans of generous, lavish Syrah well into its second decade.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The bouquet includes black fruit, star anise and cinnamon. Flavors of blackberry and strawberry are released on the smooth palate of this Syrah. After spending a few months in oak barrels, it has a good tannic structure and a supporting acidity. Cardamom and nutmeg spice up the long finish.

montes-purple-angel-1.title: Montes Purple Angel 2021
montes-purple-angel-1.bodyHtml:
Montes Purple Angel Carmenère 2022 is a luxurious and sophisticated premium red wine from Chile's renowned Colchagua Valley, crafted by the prestigious Montes winery. Celebrated as one of Chile's iconic wines, Purple Angel showcases the exceptional depth, elegance, and complexity of Carmenère, complemented by a small proportion of Petit Verdot. The 2022 vintage delivers an intense and beautifully structured expression, featuring rich flavours of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, plums, and blueberries, layered with notes of dark chocolate, sweet tobacco, vanilla, and warm spices. Carefully matured in oak barrels, this full-bodied wine offers velvety tannins, balanced acidity, and remarkable concentration. Its refined character, depth, and lingering finish make it an outstanding choice for collectors, special celebrations, fine dining, and those seeking an exceptional Chilean red wine experience.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, beef tenderloin, venison, slow-cooked beef brisket, roasted duck, mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, aged cheddar, Manchego, and rich Mediterranean-inspired dishes.

 

97 Points - James Suckling

Purple Angel has been very consistent with the opulent style and quality it offers. This seems to be a little spicier and more vibrant than earlier vintages, but it’s still brooding, deep and voluptuous, with a full body and polished tannins that are as smooth as silk. The wine is rich and melted, with masses of fine tannins that deliver a plush, hedonistic finish full of sleek, sweet fruit. Big yet nicely balanced and long. Fruit from Apalta and Marchigue. Drink from 2026.

mortlach-12-year-old-1.title: Mortlach 12 Year Old
mortlach-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Mortlach 12 Year Old is a single malt Scotch whisky produced at the Mortlach Distillery in Dufftown, Speyside. Known as "The Beast of Dufftown" due to its robust character, it is crafted using a complex, precise 2.81 times distillation process and aged for 12 years in a combination of European and American oak casks, including ex-sherry and ex-bourbon barrels. This expression delivers a rich, meaty, and richly sherried profile balancing dried fruit sweetness and deep oak spice.

Food Pairing: Roasted ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, dark chocolate tarts, venison, or aged cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber gold in appearance with a full-bodied, heavy, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich dried fruit, dark caramel, toasted oak, subtle umami and savory notes, and light baking spices.

Palate : Full and muscular with notes of dark berries, sweet malt, toffee, leather, cinnamon, and warm wood spice.

Finish : Long, satisfying, and dry with lingering notes of dark chocolate, oak tannins, and subtle pepper.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to unlock deeper fruit and savory aromas.

mortlach-15-year-old-1.title: Mortlach 15 Year Old Game of Thrones Six Kingdoms
mortlach-15-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
This Mortlach Single Malt Scotch Whisky that has been aged for 15 years, is presented in a metallic gold canister that features an intricate pen and ink drawing of the Three-Eyed Raven as seen throughout the eight seasons of the series. The Six Kingdoms packaging pays homage to the last Greenseer, whose ability to see beyond the constraints of time and unravel the intricate stories that held the tapestry of Westeros together proved to be his ultimate power.

The Mortlach Distillery is built on the site of a historic battle and is the first to legitimately rule over Dufftown’s whisky trade. Influenced by its own collection of historical figures, the Mortlach’s signature method to distil the liquid exactly 2.81 times is a complex process as unique as the Three-Eyed Raven character.

mortlach-16-year-old-1.title: Mortlach 16 Year Old
mortlach-16-year-old-1.bodyHtml: This single malt Scotch Whisky is inspired by the iconic and rewarding first bottling of the 16-year-old released in 1992. It has been matured in only Sherry casks to impart rich, fruity, and fragrant notes atop the beasty complexity synonymous with Mortlach.

mortlach-18-year-old.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseur's Choice Mortlach 2000 23 Year Old
mortlach-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Passion for single malt Scotch whisky has been at the heart of our family business for four generations. This range is an ever-changing collection of unique perspectives on distilleries’ own bottlings, non-chill-filtered single cask and small batch expressions bottled at cask strength — exceptional one-offs.
TASTING NOTES

TOFFEE APPLES and COCOA POWDER give way to LEMON PEEL. Bright VANILLA POD develops alongside CINNAMON SPICE and a faint HERBAL edge. STEWED PLUMS and DARK CHOCOLATE are balanced by soft BLACK PEPPER. ORANGE OIL and BUTTERSCOTCH leads to mature OAK.

mortlach-1961-58-year-old-private-collec.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Mortlach 1961 58 Year Old 44.4% ABV
mortlach-1961-58-year-old-private-collec.bodyHtml:
Featured in the 2019 Summer Collection, our Gordon & MacPhail 1961 from Mortlach Distillery offers an exquisite blend of fresh orange and velvety chocolate aromas with vibrant bursts of candied fruit on the palate, complemented by hints of charred oak and warm roasted chestnuts on the finish.

Product Information

Distilled: Wednesday, 15th March 1961
Bottled: Monday, 18th March 2019
Cask: First fill Sherry hogshead
Outturn: 137 bottles
Colour: Dark Amber

Aroma: Beautiful aromas of fresh orange groves transform into velvety chocolate truffles filled with sherry. Fresh, sweet honeysuckle tones add depth to chocolate orange.

Taste: Dark chocolate with vibrant bursts of orange oil. Candied fruit with gentle oak notes lead to subtle humidor nuances.

Finish: Long and smooth; dark chocolate with orange and dried fruit. Hints of charred oak complement the slight meatiness of the dram, leading into lingering warm roasted chestnuts.

mortlach-20-year-old.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseur's Choice Mortlach 2000 23 Year Old
mortlach-20-year-old.bodyHtml:
Passion for single malt Scotch whisky has been at the heart of our family business for four generations. This range is an ever-changing collection of unique perspectives on distilleries’ own bottlings, non-chill-filtered single cask and small batch expressions bottled at cask strength — exceptional one-offs.
TASTING NOTES

TOFFEE APPLES and COCOA POWDER give way to LEMON PEEL. Bright VANILLA POD develops alongside CINNAMON SPICE and a faint HERBAL edge. STEWED PLUMS and DARK CHOCOLATE are balanced by soft BLACK PEPPER. ORANGE OIL and BUTTERSCOTCH leads to mature OAK.

mortlach-25-year-old.title: Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Mortlach 25 Year Old
mortlach-25-year-old.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Mortlach 25 Year Old is a magnificent and highly sought-after Speyside single malt that beautifully showcases the robust character of the "Beast of Dufftown," elegantly tempered by a quarter-century of maturation. Bottled by the legendary independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail as part of their iconic Distillery Labels series—which utilizes bespoke historical branding paying homage to the unique relationship between the bottler and the distillery—this whisky is matured meticulously in a combination of first-fill and refill sherry casks. It delivers an alchemical balance of Mortlach's notoriously heavy, meaty spirit with lush, decadent layers of dark chocolate, stewed summer fruits, and profound oak spice.

Food Pairing: Thinly sliced roast beef au jus, fig and prosciutto crostini, mature aged Gouda cheese, rich dark chocolate truffles, and traditional fruitcake.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber with burnished copper highlights, offering a rich, mouth-coating, and beautifully viscous feel.

Nose : Opulent and highly aromatic, leading with rich sherry, rum-soaked dried fruits, figs, and fleshy plums. This is supported by warm elements of ginger, cloves, bright orange peel, roasted walnuts, and a distinctive, elegant hint of beeswax polish.

Palate : Complex and robust, perfectly balancing Mortlach's signature savory, meaty character with sweet sherry influence. A lush wave of stewed summer berries, dark chocolate-covered raisins, and sweet dates intertwines with autumnal spices, cinnamon, clove, and subtle zesty orange marmalade.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warming, and fruity, leaving a lasting impression of lingering toasted almonds, dark chocolate, sweet raisins, and a wisp of baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter. Allow it to rest in the glass for 15-20 minutes to fully open its profound sherry maturation and complex aromatics. A single drop of room-temperature water can also be added to slightly reduce the proof and enhance the fruit and waxy notes.

mortlach-26-year-old.title: Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Mortlach 25 Year Old
mortlach-26-year-old.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Mortlach 25 Year Old is a magnificent and highly sought-after Speyside single malt that beautifully showcases the robust character of the "Beast of Dufftown," elegantly tempered by a quarter-century of maturation. Bottled by the legendary independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail as part of their iconic Distillery Labels series—which utilizes bespoke historical branding paying homage to the unique relationship between the bottler and the distillery—this whisky is matured meticulously in a combination of first-fill and refill sherry casks. It delivers an alchemical balance of Mortlach's notoriously heavy, meaty spirit with lush, decadent layers of dark chocolate, stewed summer fruits, and profound oak spice.

Food Pairing: Thinly sliced roast beef au jus, fig and prosciutto crostini, mature aged Gouda cheese, rich dark chocolate truffles, and traditional fruitcake.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber with burnished copper highlights, offering a rich, mouth-coating, and beautifully viscous feel.

Nose : Opulent and highly aromatic, leading with rich sherry, rum-soaked dried fruits, figs, and fleshy plums. This is supported by warm elements of ginger, cloves, bright orange peel, roasted walnuts, and a distinctive, elegant hint of beeswax polish.

Palate : Complex and robust, perfectly balancing Mortlach's signature savory, meaty character with sweet sherry influence. A lush wave of stewed summer berries, dark chocolate-covered raisins, and sweet dates intertwines with autumnal spices, cinnamon, clove, and subtle zesty orange marmalade.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warming, and fruity, leaving a lasting impression of lingering toasted almonds, dark chocolate, sweet raisins, and a wisp of baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter. Allow it to rest in the glass for 15-20 minutes to fully open its profound sherry maturation and complex aromatics. A single drop of room-temperature water can also be added to slightly reduce the proof and enhance the fruit and waxy notes.

mortlach-rare-old.title: Signatory Vintage 35th Anniversary Mortlach 32 Year Old 1991 Cask #4241
mortlach-rare-old.bodyHtml:
Signatory Vintage 35th Anniversary Mortlach 32 Year Old 1991 Cask #4241 is a limited single-cask Speyside single malt Scotch whisky independently bottled by Signatory Vintage in celebration of its 35th Anniversary. Distilled at Mortlach on May 14, 1991, it matured for 32 years in first-fill Oloroso Sherry Butt #4241 before being bottled on October 4, 2023 at a natural cask strength of 54.1% ABV. Only 580 bottles were produced, presenting Mortlach's rich, weighty character alongside concentrated fruit, sherry richness and mature oak.

Food Pairing: Pair with aged cheddar or Comté, roasted walnuts, cured meats, dark chocolate, dried fruits or rich fruitcake.

Tasting Notes: Rich and mature, combining ripe and dried fruits with sweet malt, nuts, aromatic herbs, tobacco and beautifully integrated sherry-seasoned oak.

Nose: Ripe fruit and sultanas mingle with orange blossom, beeswax, walnuts, sweet malt and subtle tobacco.

Palate: Full and expansive, with orange, dark fruit and nutty sherry character layered with malt sweetness, resinous herbs and mature oak.

Finish: Long and complex, with lingering fruit, walnuts, warming spice, herbs and refined oak.

mount-gay-1703.title: Mount Gay 1703 Old Cask Selection Rum
mount-gay-1703.bodyHtml: A new and very exciting addition to the Mount Gay range. 1703 celebrates the foundation of the Barbados-based Mount Gay distillery, and it was created by Allen Smith, the master distiller. It contains rums that have been aged for between 10 and 30 years.

mount-gay-black-barrel-rum-1.title: Mount Gay Black Barrel Double Cask Blend Rum
mount-gay-black-barrel-rum-1.bodyHtml: Mount Gay Black Barrel is a bold and robust expression of the Barbadian rum tradition, meticulously crafted by Master Blender Trudiann Branker. This "Double Cask Blend" is created by marrying high-ester pot still rums with column still rums, all of which are aged for three to seven years in American whiskey casks. The spirit then undergoes a crucial secondary maturation in deeply charred Bourbon oak barrels for an additional six months. This intensive finishing process results in a mahogany-hued rum with an enhanced woody character and a complex spicy profile. On the nose, it offers an alluring bouquet of gingerbread, lychee, and toasted marshmallow, while the palate delivers rich layers of black pepper, dark chocolate, and warm vanilla. With its signature "burnt" oak intensity and smooth, persistent finish, Black Barrel is an exceptional choice for elevating classic cocktails like the Old Fashioned or for sipping neat.

mount-gay-eclipse-amber-rum.title: Mount Gay Eclipse Amber Rum
mount-gay-eclipse-amber-rum.bodyHtml:
Mount Gay Eclipse Amber Rum is the flagship heritage expression from the world's oldest continually operating rum distillery, established in 1703. Distilled in both traditional copper pot and column stills and aged in toasted American oak ex-bourbon casks, it delivers a harmonious, golden profile featuring bright fruitiness and delicate oak notes.

Food Pairing: Jerk chicken, grilled seafood, barbecue pork, tropical fruit desserts, or banana bread.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant golden-amber in appearance with a light-to-medium-bodied, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Distinct floral and fruity notes of ripe banana, sweet apricot, vanilla, and subtle toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of sweet vanilla, caramel, ripe tropical fruit, light oak spice, and subtle smoke.

Finish : Warm, clean, and dry with lingering notes of gentle oak, fruit, and light spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as the base in classic rum cocktails such as a Rum Punch or Dark & Stormy.

mount-gay-xo-rum-1.title: Mount Gay XO Triple Cask Blend
mount-gay-xo-rum-1.bodyHtml: Mount Gay XO is a blend of spirits distilled in both column and pot stills. Maturation is 8 to 15 years in a combination of American whiskey, bourbon and Cognac casks. Look for flavours of caramel, dried fruit, dark chocolate and spice. Silky smooth, with a lengthy finish, this rum is perfect as an after-dinner sipper.

neal-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-2015.title: Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
neal-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-2015.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, beautifully structured, and classic expression of Napa Valley winemaking. Sourced from premier vineyard sites across the region, this vintage offers intense aromas of ripe blackcurrant, dark cherry, cassis, and cocoa, accented by gentle nuances of cedar, sweet oak spice, and subtle violet. On the palate, it delivers a medium- to full-bodied mouthfeel layered with vibrant dark berry fruit, balanced acidity, and supple, velvety tannins that flow seamlessly into a long, polished, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled New York strip steak, herb-crusted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, portobello mushroom burgers, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Soft around the edges and firm in the middle, this red- and black-fruited wine has a creaminess on the palate, delivering a mix of red cherries, blackberries and blueberries wrapped in moderate tannins. Contains small amounts of petit verdot, cabernet franc, malbec and merlot. 

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A polished, fruit-driven style, but with nice focus, as singed alder and savory notes provide a gentle nudge along the edges of the plum and cassis core. Ends with a subtle loam echo on the finish.

newfoundland-screech.title: Famous Newfoundland Screech Rum
newfoundland-screech.bodyHtml:
An award-winning Jamaican rum, steeped in history ? crafted in Newfoundland. Sweet taste of caramelized sugars, ripe fruits, vanilla and oak. A smooth, balanced blend with no sugar added.

Imported from Jamaica for over 200 years, Screech is a true part of Newfoundland culture & tradition.

nikka-coffey-gin-1.title: Nikka Coffey Gin
nikka-coffey-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Nikka Coffey Gin is a distinctive Japanese craft gin produced by Nikka Whisky at its Miyagikyo Distillery. Introduced in 2017, it is crafted using grain spirits distilled through traditional Coffey column stills, creating a remarkably smooth and silky texture. Its complex botanical profile features four Japanese citrus fruits—yuzu, kabosu, amanatsu, and shequasar—alongside juniper, coriander, angelica, apple, and Japanese sansho pepper. Bottled at 47% ABV, this vibrant gin delivers refreshing citrus, delicate sweetness, and a pleasantly peppery finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, sushi, grilled shrimp, sashimi, smoked salmon, citrus-marinated seafood, Japanese tempura, and lightly spiced chicken.

Tasting Notes: Bright and aromatic, combining Japanese citrus, traditional gin botanicals, delicate apple sweetness, and tangy sansho pepper.

Nose: Yuzu, lemon zest, orange peel, fresh juniper, coriander, and subtle floral notes.

Palate: Silky and rounded, with vibrant citrus, sweet apple, earthy juniper, angelica, and gentle botanical spice.

Finish: Long, refreshing, and pleasantly tangy, with lingering citrus zest and distinctive Japanese sansho pepper.

Serve: Enjoy in a Gin & Tonic with premium tonic water and a citrus garnish. Also excellent in a Martini, Gimlet, or Japanese Gin Sonic with soda and tonic.

nikka-coffey-grain.title: Nikka Coffey Grain Japanese Whisky
nikka-coffey-grain.bodyHtml:
Nikka Coffey Grain Japanese Whisky is a distinctive single grain whisky produced by Nikka Whisky at its Miyagikyo Distillery in Japan. Introduced in 2012, this expression is made predominantly from corn and distilled using traditional Coffey column stills, which preserve the grain's natural sweetness and creamy texture. Matured in refill, remade, and re-charred American oak casks, it delivers inviting notes of ripe pear, tropical fruit, vanilla, caramel, and gentle spice. Bottled at 45% ABV, this smooth and approachable whisky offers a unique alternative to traditional Japanese malt whiskies.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate, caramel desserts, vanilla crème brûlée, roasted almonds, banana bread, fruit tarts, and aged Gouda.

Tasting Notes: Smooth, sweet, and fruity, combining tropical fruit, vanilla, caramel, delicate oak, and gentle spice.

Nose: Ripe pear, cherry, blood orange, lemon zest, coconut, and vanilla.

Palate: Creamy and rounded, with ripe banana, caramel, pear, tropical fruit, licorice, and star anise.

Finish: Smooth and mellow, with lingering pear, vanilla, subtle oak, and a pleasantly bittersweet touch.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass, over ice, or in a Japanese Highball. Also works beautifully in an Old Fashioned.

nikka-coffey-malt.title: Nikka Coffey Malt Whisky
nikka-coffey-malt.bodyHtml:
Nikka Coffey Malt Japanese Whisky is a unique Japanese whisky distilled from 100% malted barley in traditional continuous Coffey column stills. Produced by Nikka Whisky, this expression offers a rich, dense texture and a distinctively sweet, warm flavor profile that sets it apart from traditional pot-still single malts.

Food Pairing: Teriyaki-glazed pork, roasted duck breast, aged cheeses, dark chocolate desserts, or fruit tarts.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber in appearance with a rich, dense, and mouth-coating feel.

Nose : Aromatic and lively with notes of butterscotch, vanilla, candied citrus, fresh lemon, pear, and subtle spices.

Palate : Smooth and complex, featuring rich vanilla, citrus peel, cinnamon, clove, honey, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of rich oak, dark chocolate, and mild spices.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tasting glass, on the rocks, or diluted with a splash of water to release complex floral and fruit aromas.

nikka-coffey-series-gift-pack.title: Nikka Coffey Series Gift Pack 4 x 700ml
nikka-coffey-series-gift-pack.bodyHtml: A celebration of the Coffey still from Nikka! This stylish set features four different spirits from the legendary Japanese producer, each one produced using their Coffey still - showing you just how versatile that bit of kit really is!

nikka-coffey-vodka-1.title: Nikka Coffey Vodka
nikka-coffey-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Coffey Vodka is a vodka with flavor and texture. The secret behind this extremely smooth mouthfeel and delicate taste is the quality of Coffey distillates and the preciseness in blending.

Corn and barley are separately distilled into various batches with slight difference in ABV and taste profile. These batches are carefully blended by experts and then refined with white birch charcoal. This vodka with zesty notes, rich sweetness and milky mouthfeel perfectly captures the exquisite fullness brought by the Coffey stills.

nikka-from-the-barrel.title: Nikka From The Barrel Japanese Whisky
nikka-from-the-barrel.bodyHtml:
Nikka From The Barrel is an exceptionally rich and powerful blended whisky from Japan's renowned Nikka Whisky Distilling Company. Created to capture the remarkable depth and intensity experienced by master blenders when tasting whisky directly from the cask, this distinctive expression brings together more than 100 batches of carefully matured malt and grain whiskies, including whiskies associated with Nikka's celebrated Yoichi and Miyagikyo distilleries. Following blending, the whisky is returned to used oak casks for several additional months of maturation, allowing its diverse components to harmonize through a traditional process known as marriage. Bottled at an impressive 51.4% ABV, it delivers extraordinary concentration, richness and complexity. Presented in its iconic square bottle, inspired by the concept of a small block of whisky, Nikka From The Barrel offers an intensely expressive character with layers of ripe fruit, creamy vanilla, toasted oak, caramel and warming spice. A sophisticated and beautifully balanced whisky that showcases Nikka's exceptional blending craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, smoked brisket, barbecue short ribs, roasted duck, teriyaki-glazed pork belly and Japanese yakitori. Its rich oak and spice character also complements wild mushroom dishes, aged cheddar, smoked Gouda, roasted nuts, dark chocolate truffles and caramel-based desserts.

Tasting Notes: A bold, full-bodied blended whisky offering remarkable richness and complexity, with layers of ripe orchard fruit, vanilla, chocolate, toasted oak and warming spice, balanced by a smooth, concentrated texture.

Nose: Rich and complex aromas of toasted oak, creamy vanilla, dark chocolate and fragrant orange peel, accompanied by subtle malt, ripe apricot and delicate floral notes.

Palate: Powerful and beautifully structured, with a thick, rounded mouthfeel revealing caramelized apples, ripe peaches, vanilla, dark chocolate and oak, complemented by black pepper and warming spice.

Finish: Long, warming and complex, with lingering oak, ripe fruit, vanilla and a pleasantly bittersweet woody character.

nikka-miyagikyo-apple-brandy-finish.title: Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt Japanese Whisky
nikka-miyagikyo-apple-brandy-finish.bodyHtml:
Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt Japanese Whisky is an elegant and fruit-forward single malt produced at Nikka's Miyagikyo Distillery in Japan's Miyagi Prefecture. Established in 1969 by Masataka Taketsuru, the distillery is known for its gentle, indirect steam distillation, which produces a refined and delicate spirit. Matured in a selection of oak casks with a notable sherry influence, this no-age-statement whisky offers layers of orchard fruits, floral aromas, vanilla, and gentle spice. Bottled at 45% ABV, Miyagikyo showcases the smooth, balanced character of Japanese single malt whisky.

Food Pairing: Grilled salmon, sushi, roasted almonds, Manchego cheese, dried fruits, and lightly spiced dishes.

Tasting Notes: An elegant Japanese single malt featuring orchard fruits, floral sweetness, delicate malt, gentle spice, and subtle oak.

Nose: Fresh apples, pears, vanilla, floral aromas, malted barley, and hints of exotic fruit.

Palate: Smooth and delicate, with dried fruits, malt sweetness, ginger, cinnamon, chocolate, and gentle oak.

Finish: Long and soft, with lingering orchard fruits, toasted nuts, delicate spice, and subtle oak sweetness.

Serve: Enjoy neat, over a large ice cube, or with a small amount of chilled water to highlight its delicate fruit and floral character.

nikka-miyagikyo-single-malt.title: Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt Japanese Whisky
nikka-miyagikyo-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt Japanese Whisky is an elegant and fruit-forward single malt produced at Nikka's Miyagikyo Distillery in Japan's Miyagi Prefecture. Established in 1969 by Masataka Taketsuru, the distillery is known for its gentle, indirect steam distillation, which produces a refined and delicate spirit. Matured in a selection of oak casks with a notable sherry influence, this no-age-statement whisky offers layers of orchard fruits, floral aromas, vanilla, and gentle spice. Bottled at 45% ABV, Miyagikyo showcases the smooth, balanced character of Japanese single malt whisky.

Food Pairing: Grilled salmon, sushi, roasted almonds, Manchego cheese, dried fruits, and lightly spiced dishes.

Tasting Notes: An elegant Japanese single malt featuring orchard fruits, floral sweetness, delicate malt, gentle spice, and subtle oak.

Nose: Fresh apples, pears, vanilla, floral aromas, malted barley, and hints of exotic fruit.

Palate: Smooth and delicate, with dried fruits, malt sweetness, ginger, cinnamon, chocolate, and gentle oak.

Finish: Long and soft, with lingering orchard fruits, toasted nuts, delicate spice, and subtle oak sweetness.

Serve: Enjoy neat, over a large ice cube, or with a small amount of chilled water to highlight its delicate fruit and floral character.

nikka-super-rare-old.title: The Nikka Nine Decades 90th Anniversary Limited Edition Japanese Whisky
nikka-super-rare-old.bodyHtml:
The Nikka Nine Decades 90th Anniversary Limited Edition is an extraordinary, highly limited blended whisky created to commemorate the 90th anniversary of Nikka Whisky, founded by Masataka Taketsuru in 1934. This masterful blend is a liquid tapestry of the company's history, comprising whiskies distilled across nine consecutive decades—from the 1940s (featuring Yoichi malt distilled in 1945) through the 2020s. The blend seamlessly integrates over 50 batches of whisky from six distilleries, including Yoichi, Miyagikyo, Scottish malt from Ben Nevis, and rare grain whiskies from the closed Nishinomiya, Moji, and Satsuma distilleries, delivering unparalleled depth, history, and complexity.

Food Pairing: Seared Wagyu beef, smoked duck breast, roasted figs, dark chocolate truffles, or mature aged Gouda.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber to dark mahogany in appearance with a rich, viscous, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Intensely complex and nostalgic, featuring layers of antique furniture polish, rich apple pie, raisins, dark chocolate, sweet cinnamon, and a gentle wisp of elegant, old peat smoke.

Palate : Rich, mellow, and deeply layered, showcasing sweet maple syrup, dark roasted coffee, dried figs, roasted nuts, and a harmonious balance of gentle oak spice, dark berry tartness, and subtle earthy peat.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warming, and refined, with lingering notes of dark cocoa, sweet antique oak, and soft, mellow campfire smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter, allowing it ample time to rest and breathe in the glass to fully reveal its complex historical nuances.

nikka-taketsuru-17-year-old.title: Nikka Taketsuru 17 Year Old Japanese Whisky
nikka-taketsuru-17-year-old.bodyHtml:
Nikka Taketsuru 17 Year Old Pure Malt Japanese Whisky is a prestigious and highly acclaimed blended malt whisky crafted by Nikka Whisky in honour of its founder, Masataka Taketsuru, widely regarded as the father of Japanese whisky. Created by carefully marrying mature malt whiskies from Nikka's renowned Yoichi and Miyagikyo distilleries, this exceptional expression combines the distinctive depth and subtle smoky character of Yoichi with the elegant, fruity and refined qualities of Miyagikyo. Every component is matured for a minimum of 17 years, resulting in a beautifully integrated whisky of remarkable complexity and balance. The nose reveals an inviting combination of orchard fruits, honey, vanilla, toasted oak and delicate spice, complemented by gentle smoke and mature malt character. On the palate, rich layers of dried fruit, caramel, citrus and dark chocolate unfold alongside soft oak, subtle nuttiness and refined peat. Its silky texture leads to a long, harmonious finish with lingering sweetness, warming spice and a delicate smoky impression. Bottled at 43% ABV, Nikka Taketsuru 17 Year Old has earned international recognition, including World's Best Blended Malt Whisky at the World Whiskies Awards in 2012, 2014, 2015 and 2018. Discontinued in 2020, this celebrated Japanese whisky remains a highly desirable expression for enthusiasts and collectors.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with Japanese wagyu beef, charcoal-grilled ribeye steak, teriyaki-glazed duck, miso-marinated black cod, roasted pork belly and grilled shiitake mushrooms. Its mature fruit, gentle smoke and oak complexity also complement aged Gouda, Parmigiano Reggiano, toasted nuts and premium dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: An elegant and complex Japanese blended malt whisky offering mature orchard fruits, honey, vanilla, dried fruit, toasted oak, subtle spice and delicate peat smoke, supported by a silky, beautifully balanced texture.

Nose: Expressive aromas of ripe apple, pear, dried apricot, honey, vanilla and toasted oak, accompanied by gentle malt sweetness, warm spice and subtle smoke.

Palate: Smooth, rich and layered, revealing dried fruits, caramel, orange peel, dark chocolate, roasted nuts and refined oak spice, complemented by delicate peat and mature malt character.

Finish: Long, elegant and harmonious, with lingering honeyed sweetness, dark chocolate, soft oak, warming spice and a gentle smoky aftertaste.

nikka-taketsuru-21-year-old.title: Nikka Taketsuru 21 Year Old Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
nikka-taketsuru-21-year-old.bodyHtml:
Nikka Taketsuru 21 Year Old Pure Malt Japanese Whisky is an exceptional aged blended malt whisky produced by Nikka Whisky, combining carefully selected single malts from the Yoichi and Miyagikyo distilleries. Named in honour of Masataka Taketsuru, the founder of Nikka and a pioneer of Japanese whisky, this celebrated expression offers remarkable depth and elegance. Aromas of ripe apricots, delicate florals, and warming spices lead into a complex palate of caramelized apples, peaches, vanilla, and seasoned oak. Aged for at least 21 years, it delivers a refined balance of fruit, spice, and subtle coastal character.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate, fresh figs, cured meats, aged sheep's milk cheese, roasted almonds, dried apricots, and caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes: A complex, mature Japanese blended malt featuring ripe orchard fruits, delicate florals, caramelized sweetness, warming spices, and seasoned oak.

Nose: Lilac, ripe apricots, cloves, leather, delicate oak, and floral notes.

Palate: Ripe peaches, caramelized apples, honeysuckle, black pepper, vanilla, and rich oak spice.

Finish: Long and elegant, with lingering prunes, peaches, vanilla, oak, and subtle coastal notes.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature or over a large ice cube.

nikka-taketsuru-pure-malt.title: Nikka Taketsuru Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
nikka-taketsuru-pure-malt.bodyHtml:
Nikka Taketsuru Pure Malt Japanese Whisky is a highly disciplined, deeply expressive, and award-winning blended malt created as a tribute to Masataka Taketsuru, the legendary father of Japanese whisky and the founder of Nikka. This expression is a masterful exercise in harmony, meticulously blending aged single malts from Nikka's two drastically contrasting northern distilleries: Yoichi on the coast of Hokkaido and Miyagikyo in the misty valleys of Sendai. By marrying the robust, coastal, and heavily peated style of Yoichi with the soft, elegant, fruity, and sherry-cask-influenced profile of Miyagikyo, Nikka's master blenders achieve a balanced spirit that mirrors the silky drinkability of a blended grain whisky while maintaining the intense richness of pure malt.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted pork loin accented by root vegetables, Cantonese dim sum, pan-seared duck breast with an orange glaze, teriyaki salmon, or high-quality dark chocolate bark.

Tasting Notes : Citron gold in appearance, offering a smooth, silky, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Complex and expressive with aromas of citrus, orange peel, juicy pear, sweet vanilla, cereal malt, and a delicate touch of peat smoke.

Palate : Round and delicate with notes of sweet spice, cardamom, candied fruits, honey, yuzu, and gentle toasted oak.

Finish : Smooth, long, and graceful with lingering notes of dark chocolate, gentle peat, sweet citrus, and soft oak spice.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of pure water to unlock the floral and citrus notes, or over a large ice sphere in traditional Japanese style.

nikka-the-nikka-12-year-old.title: Nikka 12 Year Old Japanese Whisky
nikka-the-nikka-12-year-old.bodyHtml: The product of two distilleries, Yoichi and Miyagikyo, The Nikka 12 is a well-balanced blend. There's green apple freshness, rich fruitcake spiciness, butterscotch, and some green-peppercorn punch. Another winner from Nikka!

nikka-yoichi-10-year-old.title: Nikka Yoichi 10 Year Old Japanese Whisky

nikka-yoichi-12-year-old.title: Nikka Yoichi Single Malt Japanese Whisky
nikka-yoichi-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Nikka Yoichi Single Malt Japanese Whisky is the flagship single malt from Nikka's first distillery, built in 1934 by Masataka Taketsuru on the northern island of Hokkaido. Distilled using traditional direct coal-fired pot stills, this whisky is celebrated for its bold, rich, and gently peaty character, which is beautifully balanced by maritime influences from the nearby Ishikari Bay.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, grilled scallops, roasted root vegetables, charcuterie, dark chocolate, or mature aged cheddar.

Tasting Notes: Rich golden amber in appearance with a full-bodied, robust, and slightly oily mouthfeel.

Nose: Gentle peat smoke, fresh maritime sea breeze, candied citrus peel, melon, subtle vanilla, and a touch of roasted nuts.

Palate: Bold and well-rounded, delivering flavors of sweet barley malt, baked apple, gentle coal smoke, subtle sea salt, toasted oak, and a hint of dark chocolate.

Finish: Long, warming, and complex with lingering maritime peat smoke, sweet oak spice, and crisp orchard fruit.

Serve: Serve neat, with a few drops of water to open up the aromas, or over a large ice cube in a rocks glass.

nikka-yoichi-apple-brandy-finish.title: Nikka Yoichi Single Malt Japanese Whisky
nikka-yoichi-apple-brandy-finish.bodyHtml:
Nikka Yoichi Single Malt Japanese Whisky is the flagship single malt from Nikka's first distillery, built in 1934 by Masataka Taketsuru on the northern island of Hokkaido. Finish: Long, warming, and complex with lingering maritime peat smoke, sweet oak spice, and crisp orchard fruit.

nikka-yoichi-single-malt.bodyHtml:
