ninfa-raicilla-maximiliana.title: Ninfa Agave Maximiliana Raicilla
ninfa-raicilla-maximiliana.bodyHtml:
Ninfa Raicilla is made with agave Maximiliana that is cooked for 24-72 hours in an adobe oven with locally sourced oak wood. Once cooked and shredded, the agave are fermented in oak barrels and double-distilled in a copper alembique still.

Ninfa was created by a family whose roots date back to before the Spanish occupation of the Sierra Madre Occidental. The hacienda where this is produced is in the mountains of San Sebastian del Oeste, a 16th century mining village that decided to continue crafting traditional spirits that were inherited from the older generations. Today the family and a team of botanists study and protect the wild agaves and other endangered species that live in the cloud forest, surrounding an important natural preserve, only harvesting mature wild agave and limiting only to a sustainable number of them. The entire harvest of 2017 resulted in a batch of only 2,500 bottles.

nirasaki-blended-japanese-whisky.title: Hibiki Japanese Harmony Whisky
nirasaki-blended-japanese-whisky.bodyHtml:
Hibiki Japanese Harmony is a meticulous blend of more than ten malt and grain whiskies produced by Suntory, drawing from the Yamazaki, Hakushu, and Chita distilleries. Crafted under the supervision of Master Blender Shingo Torii and Chief Blender Shinji Fukuyo, this expression is matured in five different cask types, including American white oak, Sherry, and Mizunara oak. Presented in a 24-faceted bottle representing the 24 seasons of the traditional Japanese lunar calendar, it yields an exceptionally delicate, subtle, and harmonious profile.

Food Pairing: Sushi, sashimi, grilled yakitori, fresh oysters, dark chocolate, and light citrus desserts.

Tasting Notes : Amber color in appearance with a delicate, smooth, and velvety mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Rose, lychee, a hint of rosemary, mature woodiness, and sandalwood.

Palate : Honey-like sweetness, candied orange peel, and white chocolate.

Finish : Subtle, long finish with a hint of Mizunara oak.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or in a traditional Japanese Highball with premium soda water over clear ice.

northern-keep-vodka-1.title: Northern Keep Vodka
northern-keep-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Northern Keep Vodka is made by Alberta Distillers from Canadian rye and sustainably grown winter wheat. At least 30% of the grain is western Canadian winter wheat certified under the Habitat Friendly Ecolabel, sourced from farms that protect nesting waterfowl. The result is a clean, smooth vodka with hints of citrus, light spice and subtle sweetness, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It earned Double Gold at the 2025 SIP Awards and Gold at the 2025 International Spirits Challenge, IWSC and World Vodka Awards.

Tasting Notes: Citrus, light spiciness, subtle sweetness and a smooth finish.

Serve: Chilled, on the rocks, or in a Caesar, martini or vodka soda.

norton-privada-1.title: Norton Privada Family Blend 2024
norton-privada-1.bodyHtml:
Norton Privada Family Blend 2024 is a rich, full-bodied, and deeply complex Argentine red wine crafted from 50 to 90-year-old estate vineyards in Mendoza's premier Luján de Cuyo district. Originally created as an exclusive private cuvée for the Swarovski family, this blend of Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot undergoes aging in French oak barrels. The nose opens with expressive aromas of ripe black plum, blackberry, kirsch, mocha, and toasted cedar. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, harmonious entry with dense layers of dark cocoa, cassis, fine-grained, polished tannins, and a persistent, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with prime grilled ribeye steak, braised ossobuco, roasted lamb shanks, rich mushroom ragù, and aged, hard cheeses.

norton-reserva-malbec.title: Norton Reserva Malbec
norton-reserva-malbec.bodyHtml:
Norton Reserva is a blend of terroirs. It combines carefully selected grapes from two distinct terroirs, Luján de Cuyo and Valle de Uco, to create a balanced experience on the palate and nose.
The diversity of these two terroirs, which differ greatly in altitude and soil, allows us to achieve wines that are both complex and fresh, with appealing aromas and a perfect balance between concentration and body.

oban-14-year-old-1.title: Oban 12 Year Old Heart of the Harbour Special Release 2025
oban-14-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
This 2025 Special Release of Oban is a 12 year old bottled at 54.7% after maturing in ex-Bourbon casks.

The comfort of home draws you back, like a warm welcome after a long journey. Like the highland gull that flies far but always returns. This is the taste of coming home. Maturation in ex-bourbon casks makes for an expression that is deeply warm, sweet and rich in character.

oban-distillers-edition-2020.title: Oban Distillers Edition 2020
oban-distillers-edition-2020.bodyHtml:
Discover a rich and deep expression of a meticulously crafted whisky with Oban Distillers Edition 2020 Bottling Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky. Double-matured in ex-bodega Montilla Fino cask wood for a rich fruitiness and maritime flavors, this 14-year-old whisky boasts a massively complex aroma of salty sea air, orange and hints of smoke.

Distilled in 2006 and bottled in 2020, this full-bodied Scotch is explosive with soft malt and wave after wave of rich fruit carried on a salty tide. The finish features sweetened Jamaican coffee and oak, with an attractive malt-biscuit effect as it dies down. Simply serve in a traditional whisky glass, neat or with a little water. Includes one 86 proof 750 mL bottle of Distillers Edition 2020 Bottling Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

oban-little-bay-1.title: Oban Little Bay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
oban-little-bay-1.bodyHtml:
Oban Little Bay Single Malt Whisky is a distinct Highland single malt Scotch whisky produced at one of Scotland's oldest and smallest distilleries, situated along the rugged western coast. Named after the Gaelic translation of the distillery's seaside home ("An t-Oban" meaning "the little bay"), this expression is crafted from spirit matured in standard refill American oak hogsheads, European oak sherry casks, and refill casks with new ends, which are then married in small, 200-liter rejuvenated American oak quarter casks. This maturation method maximizes contact with the wood, producing a deep, rich profile that harmonizes maritime saltiness with honeyed citrus, dark chocolate, and warming spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked sea salt dark chocolate, pan-seared sea scallops, prosciutto-wrapped melon, roasted duck breast with orange glaze, and creamy blue cheeses such as Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber hue with warm copper reflections, presenting a medium-to-full body with a silky, mouth-coating viscosity.

Nose : Dried apple slices, candied orange peel, heather honey, sea salt brine, vanilla fudge, and subtle toasted oak.

Palate : Chewy and warming with flavors of dark chocolate, spiced plum, candied citrus zest, honeyed malt, cloves, and a distinct wave of coastal sea spray.

Finish : Long, smooth, and gently drying with lingering notes of dark cocoa, maritime saltiness, oak tannin, and soft baking spices.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or tulip-shaped whisky glass, or add a few drops of pure water to open up the sweet citrus and maritime layers.

ogio-pinot-grigio-1.title: Ogio Pinot Grigio
ogio-pinot-grigio-1.bodyHtml:
Ogio Pinot Grigio is a crisp, vibrant, and stylish white wine that beautifully captures the effortless elegance and contemporary flair of modern Italian winemaking. Sourced from premier vineyards across the Northeast, it undergoes temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel to perfectly preserve its fruit purity and refreshing energy. The nose opens with an inviting bouquet of crisp green apple, juicy pear, and sweet white peach, elegantly interwoven with hints of citrus blossoms and wild honey. On the palate, this light-bodied selection is clean, soft, and balanced, layering lively lemon-lime and honeydew melon flavors over a refreshing mineral backbone and a zesty acidity that leads into a bright, mouth-watering finish.

Food Pairing: Exceptionally well-suited for chilled seafood salads with citrus dressing, fresh garden greens, grilled chicken breast, light pasta dishes, or simply enjoyed as a refreshing aperitif.

old-forester-1870.title: Old Forester 1870 Original Batch Bourbon
old-forester-1870.bodyHtml:
Part of the Old Forester Whiskey Row Series, the 1870 Original Batch pays homage to founder George Garvin Brown's original batching process from 1870. To honor the historic technique of blending whiskey from three different warehouses, this bourbon is selected from barrels across three distinct warehouses, each representing a different distillation date and batch. The resulting spirit is bottled at 90 proof to deliver a smooth, soft, and historically inspired flavor profile.

Food Pairing: Grilled pork chops, pecan pie, smoked gouda cheese, glazed ham, and dark chocolate caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber color with a soft, rounded, and smooth texture on the palate.

Nose : Clove, cinnamon stick, and sweet vanilla complemented by citrus fruit, shortbread, and soft oak.

Palate : Sweet caramel, vanilla, and dried fruit flavors balanced by baking spices, subtle clove, and toasted oak.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and medium-long with lingering notes of spice, vanilla, and sweet oak.

Serve : Served neat, over a large ice cube, or with a few drops of limestone water.

old-forester-birthday-bourbon-2020.title: Old Forester Birthday Bourbon 2020
old-forester-birthday-bourbon-2020.bodyHtml:
Old Forester will release the 20th iteration of its limited-edition, vintage-dated Birthday Bourbon on Wednesday, Sept. 2 in celebration of founder George Garvin Brown’s birthday. This year marks the 150th year of the company he began in 1870.

The 2020 Birthday Bourbon will be bottled at 98 proof and is made up of 95 barrels, aged 10 years, and barreled on June 5, 2010. After showing exceptionally unique character during a tasting panel, the 10-year-old barrels were chosen specifically for this year’s Birthday Bourbon. The full allotment of the product represents one day’s production of Old Forester.

AROMA
A nuanced balance of white floral notes, magnolia and citrus, spiced with vanilla, buttery leather and cocoa powder. Countering the spice are sprinkles of brown sugar, white chocolate shavings, caramel drizzle and hints of tropical fruit.

TASTE
Caramel and brittle toffee lead as the tropical character blooms into banana, mango, coconut flakes and macadamia nut.

FINISH
Long and delicately drying with a hint of anise.

old-forester-bourbon-1.title: Old Forester Kentucky Straight Bourbon
old-forester-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
First bottled in 1870 by George Garvin Brown, Old Forester holds the historic distinction of being the first bourbon sold exclusively in sealed glass bottles to guarantee quality and purity. Crafted in Louisville, Kentucky, this iconic flagship 86-proof expression is known for its light-to-medium body, balanced fruitiness, and classic high-rye character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue pulled pork, smoked brisket, grilled burgers, pecan pie, dark chocolate, and sharp cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Rich copper and bright amber in color, offering a light-to-medium body and a smooth, approachable mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright citrus and orchard fruits balanced by vanilla, brown sugar, caramel, toasted oak, and a touch of subtle baking spice.

Palate : Sweet notes of vanilla, brown sugar, and ripe pear paired with rye spice, fresh mint, and toasted oak.

Finish : Crisp and dry with lingering notes of fresh spearmint, clove spice, and subtle charred wood.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as a base in classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

old-forester-whiskey-row-1920.title: Old Forester 1920 Prohibition Style Bourbon
old-forester-whiskey-row-1920.bodyHtml:
A massive fan-favorite and one of the most highly regarded releases in the Old Forester Whiskey Row series! During Prohibition, Old Forester was one of only six distilleries granted a federal permit to continue producing whiskey for "medicinal purposes." Old Forester 1920 is a 115-proof powerhouse crafted to replicate the intensely rich, robust, and heavy-hitting profile of that historic Prohibition-era bourbon. It delivers a thick, dark, and syrupy tasting experience that stands up brilliantly to dilution, making it a dream pour for serious bourbon lovers.

NOSE

Intense and deeply aromatic. Heavy layers of dark chocolate, rich cherry preserve, toasted graham cracker, and seasoned oak.

PALATE

Thick, heavy, and full-bodied. A rush of dark caramel and rich vanilla bean is beautifully balanced by a bold, warming wave of cinnamon and peppery spice.

FINISH

Exceptionally long, warm, and chest-coating, leaving a lasting trail of dark fruit, spiced oak, and sweet tobacco.

old-grand-dad-bourbon.title: Old Grand-Dad Bonded Kentucky Straight Bourbon
old-grand-dad-bourbon.bodyHtml:
An absolute cult favorite among bartenders and whiskey purists. Old Grand-Dad Bonded takes the brand's signature high-rye mash bill and strictly adheres to the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. Distilled in a single season, aged for at least four years, and bottled at a sturdy 100 proof, this expression drastically amplifies the classic flavor profile. The higher proof delivers a massive, robust punch of rich caramel, deep oak, and intense rye spice that punches well above its price point.

NOSE

Robust aromas of deep caramel, dark fruit, heavy cinnamon, and toasted oak.

PALATE

Bold, rich, and mouth-coating. A massive wave of spicy rye and black pepper is beautifully smoothed out by sweet vanilla bean and rich brown sugar.

FINISH

Long, warm, and exceptionally spicy with a satisfying, oaky dryness.

old-overholt-straight-rye-1.title: Old Overholt Kentucky Straight Rye
old-overholt-straight-rye-1.bodyHtml:
A cornerstone of American whiskey history, Old Overholt is one of the country's oldest continually maintained straight rye whiskey brands. Recently upgraded to a 4-year age statement, non-chill filtered, and bottled at a sturdy 86 proof (43% ABV), this classic Kentucky straight rye is better than ever. It offers a gentle, highly approachable rye spice that is expertly balanced by soft fruit and vanilla notes. It is a legendary workhorse whiskey that provides unbeatable value and shines beautifully in a classic Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

 

NOSE

Light spice, black pepper, faint floral fruitiness, and sweet vanilla.

PALATE

Viscous and smooth. Mild peppery rye spice gives way to warm caramel, baked apple, and a touch of toasted oak.

FINISH

Crisp, clean, and lingering with gentle spice and sweet vanilla.

old-pulteney-12-year-old-1.title: Old Pulteney 12 Year Old
old-pulteney-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml: The 12 year old expression from Old Pulteney released in mid-2018 was entirely aged in bourbon casks, resulting in a heavy influence of bourbon sweetness – which helps to balance the characteristic coastal salinity of the whisky. An excellent introduction to Old Pulteney.

old-pulteney-18-year-old-1.title: Old Pulteney 18 Year Old
old-pulteney-18-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Old Pulteney 18 Year Old is an indulgent and deeply warming single malt Scotch whisky that represents the peak of the distillery’s reimagined core range. Matured for 18 years, this exquisite expression is initially aged in second-fill American oak ex-bourbon casks before being finished in first-fill Spanish oak Oloroso sherry butts. This dual maturation introduces a decadent layer of rich chocolate, Christmas cake sweetness, and deep baking spices to Old Pulteney's legendary coastal, sea-salt identity. Bottled at 46% ABV without chill-filtration or added coloring, it beautifully balances mature sherry complexity with a vibrant, refreshing marine character.

Food Pairing: The exquisite sweet-and-saline nature of this 18-year-old malt pairs wonderfully with rich seafood dishes like smoked salmon or pan-seared scallops. It also beautifully complements nutty, aged cheeses such as Manchego and Comté, or sweet desserts like dark chocolate truffles and salted caramel tarts.

TASTING NOTES - A rich, natural copper-amber hue. The texture is noticeably thick, oily, and luxuriously mouth-coating on the palate.

NOSE - Deep and highly aromatic, opening with creamy vanilla and milk chocolate, followed by rich honey, orange marmalade, baked apples, and a distinct thread of coastal sea air.

PALATE - Rich, full, and complex. Decadent notes of dark chocolate, brown sugar, and dense Christmas cake are balanced beautifully by a prickle of black pepper, clove, zesty lemon peel, and a persistent wave of maritime brine.

FINISH - Long, elegant, and warming. The rich chocolate and dried fruit sweetness slowly give way to a lingering finish of dry oak spice, ginger, citrus rind, and a satisfying saline crispness.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn tasting glass to appreciate its full structural complexity, or with just a few drops of pure water to further open up the floral and softer citrus layers.

old-pulteney-25-year-old-1.title: Old Pulteney 25 Year Old
old-pulteney-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Old Pulteney 25 Year Old is an exceptional Highland single malt Scotch whisky matured for a quarter-century in the coastal town of Wick, Scotland. Initially aged in American oak ex-bourbon casks before finishing in Spanish oak Oloroso sherry butts, this refined expression combines tropical fruits, rich dark chocolate, warming spices, and subtle maritime character. Bottled at 46% ABV, it delivers remarkable depth, elegance, and complexity.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate, aged cheddar, roasted almonds, caramel desserts, dried figs, smoked salmon, and rich fruitcake.

Tasting Notes: Rich and complex, featuring tropical fruits, dark chocolate, vanilla, warm spices, and delicate coastal salinity.

Nose: Bright citrus, tropical fruits, mature oak, and subtle vanilla sweetness.

Palate: Dark chocolate, cinnamon, nutmeg, dried fruits, and warming oak spice.

Finish: Long, rich, and gently warming, with lingering spice, mature oak, and a distinctive coastal character.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass, allowing the whisky to rest briefly before tasting. A few drops of water may reveal additional layers of flavour.

old-pulteney-huddart-1.title: Old Pulteney Huddart
old-pulteney-huddart-1.bodyHtml:
Old Pulteney Huddart is a single malt Scotch whisky from Pulteney Distillery in Wick, Caithness, and part of the distillery's Signature Collection. It is named after Huddart Street, where the distillery stands. The spirit is matured first in second-fill American oak ex-bourbon casks for vanilla, soft spice and sweetness, then finished in casks that previously held peated whisky, which adds a mellow, softly smoky layer to Old Pulteney's coastal, briny house style. It is bottled at 46% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Driftwood smoke, honey, warm vanilla, brine.

Nose: Mellow wood smoke and honey, crisp green apple, creamy vanilla and treacle toffee.

Palate: Spice and soft vanilla with gentle smoke, building to coastal brine and salted butterscotch.

Finish: Long and warm.

Serve: Neat or with a drop of water.

old-raj-gin-56.title: Cadenhead's Old Raj Dry Gin
old-raj-gin-56.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead's Old Raj Dry Gin is the 55% ABV version of the saffron-infused gin from Wm Cadenhead, the Campbeltown bottler founded in 1842. The gin is bottled in Campbeltown, Scotland, and saffron is added after distillation. That step brings a gently spicy note and also gives Old Raj the pale yellow colour it is known for. Cadenhead's states that the gin is never chill filtered and has no added colouring. It is sold in a 700ml bottle and sits above the 46% ABV Old Raj in the range, so the two should not be confused. The higher strength makes it a firm base for mixed drinks, and the bottler suggests it for a gin and tonic, a Martini or a Negroni.

Tasting Notes: Gently spicy, with a faint yellow hue from the saffron.

Serve: In a gin and tonic, a Martini or a Negroni.

old-raj-spiced-gin-56.title: Cadenhead's Old Raj Dry Gin
old-raj-spiced-gin-56.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead's Old Raj Dry Gin is the 55% ABV version of the saffron-infused gin from Wm Cadenhead, the Campbeltown bottler founded in 1842. The gin is bottled in Campbeltown, Scotland, and saffron is added after distillation. That step brings a gently spicy note and also gives Old Raj the pale yellow colour it is known for. Cadenhead's states that the gin is never chill filtered and has no added colouring. It is sold in a 700ml bottle and sits above the 46% ABV Old Raj in the range, so the two should not be confused. The higher strength makes it a firm base for mixed drinks, and the bottler suggests it for a gin and tonic, a Martini or a Negroni.

Tasting Notes: Gently spicy, with a faint yellow hue from the saffron.

Serve: In a gin and tonic, a Martini or a Negroni.

old-tub-kentucky-straight-bourbon.title: Old Tub Kentucky Straight Bourbon Bonded
old-tub-kentucky-straight-bourbon.bodyHtml:
A fantastic, unfiltered blast from the past! Before Jim Beam became the world's best-selling bourbon, the Beam family's flagship brand was Old Tub. This modern release pays homage to that historic pre-Prohibition whiskey by adhering strictly to the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. Aged for at least four years and bottled at 100 proof, this expression is uniquely unfiltered, meaning it skips the carbon filtration process to retain a wonderfully rustic, heavy, and full-bodied flavor profile that punches way above its price point.

 

NOSE

Rustic and sweet with heavy aromas of fresh sweet corn, oak sawdust, and rich vanilla.

PALATE

Unfiltered and robust. A warm, mouth-coating wave of deep caramel, cinnamon baking spice, and roasted peanuts.

FINISH

Long, warm, and satisfying with lingering earthy oak and sweet grain.

ole-smoky-apple-pie-moonshine.title: Ole Smoky Apple Pie Moonshine
ole-smoky-apple-pie-moonshine.bodyHtml:
The legendary, quintessential American moonshine that put Ole Smoky on the map! Handcrafted in Gatlinburg, Tennessee, this iconic spirit captures the comforting, nostalgic flavors of a fresh-baked apple pie cooling on a Southern windowsill. Ole Smoky starts with their authentic corn whiskey and infuses it with pure apple juice, ground cinnamon, and a proprietary blend of baking spices, creating a deeply flavorful spirit that revolutionized the modern craft moonshine industry.

Bottled at a highly approachable 40 proof (20% ABV), it drinks exactly like a liquid dessert. The palate is rich with flavors of warm baked apples, buttery pie crust, and a soothing wave of sweet cinnamon and nutmeg. It is phenomenal served warm on a chilly autumn evening, chilled straight from the mason jar, or poured over a bowl of vanilla bean ice cream.

ole-smoky-blackberry-moonshine-1.title: Ole Smoky Blackberry Moonshine
ole-smoky-blackberry-moonshine-1.bodyHtml:
A vibrant, fruit-heavy staple of the Smoky Mountains that perfectly captures the taste of wild summer foraging! Ole Smoky Blackberry Moonshine is a beautiful homage to the Appalachian tradition of mixing fresh-picked berries into jars of white lightning. By infusing their smooth, authentic corn whiskey with the deep, tart flavors of real blackberries, they have created an intensely colorful and incredibly flavorful spirit that balances sweet and sour perfectly.

Bottled at a gentle 40 proof (20% ABV), it delivers a lush, jammy mouthfeel that goes down entirely too easy. The palate bursts with the flavor of ripe, sun-warmed blackberries, followed by a crisp, clean moonshine kick that prevents it from becoming overly syrupy. It makes an incredible base for a Blackberry Bramble, mixes beautifully with lemonade, or shines when simply poured over crushed ice.

ole-smoky-cherries-moonshine-1.title: Ole Smoky Moonshine Cherries
ole-smoky-cherries-moonshine-1.bodyHtml:
The legendary "Appalachian Party Favor" that packs a serious punch! Ole Smoky Moonshine Cherries are not just a flavored spirit; every single mason jar is packed to the brim with real, whole maraschino cherries that have been left to soak in a high-octane bath of 100-proof original moonshine. As the cherries rest, they naturally sweeten the harsh white lightning, while simultaneously absorbing the strong alcohol, resulting in a dangerously delicious boozy treat.

Bottled at a full 100 proof (50% ABV), the liquid itself takes on a bright, syrupy cherry flavor combined with a fiery, white whiskey burn. The real star of the show, however, is eating the cherries themselves. They are the ultimate garnish for a high-end cocktail, a fantastic high-proof shooter alternative, or a guaranteed conversation starter at your next party.

ole-smoky-pickles-moonshine-1.title: Ole Smoky Moonshine Pickles
ole-smoky-pickles-moonshine-1.bodyHtml:
A savory, brine-infused masterpiece that completely flips the script on traditional sweet moonshines! Ole Smoky Pickles is crafted by taking a classic mason jar, packing it full of genuine, crunchy dill pickles, and soaking them in their signature smooth corn whiskey. The result is a wild, savory collision of worlds that has become an absolute cult classic among bartenders and savory cocktail lovers.

Bottled at 40 proof (20% ABV), the liquid itself takes on the tangy, salty, and dill-forward flavors of traditional pickle juice, making it the greatest Bloody Mary base ever invented, or the ultimate ready-made "pickleback" shot. Best of all, once the liquid is gone, you are left with a jar of incredibly potent, alcohol-infused pickles that are guaranteed to liven up any sandwich or charcuterie board!

olmeca-silver.title: Olmeca Silver Tequila
olmeca-silver.bodyHtml:
Olmeca Silver is the clear blanco expression of Olmeca tequila, made with blue agave in the Los Altos highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. It leads with a fresh herbal scent and green pepper, with soft citrus notes coming through at the end, and carries a natural sweetness and freshness that makes it an easy partner for mixers and fruit. The current bottle wears Olmeca's redesigned teal label with the Olmec head emblem on the brand's square, patterned bottle. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a dependable everyday blanco for margaritas, Palomas and chilled shots.

Nose: Fresh herbs and green pepper, with soft citrus at the end.

Serve: In a margarita or Paloma, or as a chilled shot with lime.

orin-swift-abstract-1.title: Orin Swift Cellars Abstract 2022
orin-swift-abstract-1.bodyHtml:
Orin Swift Cellars Abstract 2022 is a bold, opulent, and intentionally hedonistic Californian red wine crafted under the vision of winemaker Dave Phinney. An artful collage of individual lots sourced from premier vineyards across the state, this signature Rhône-style blend is aged for eight months in French oak barrels (31% new). In the glass, it reveals an inky, dark purple core with a vibrant, neon ruby rim. The nose is brooding and aromatically expressive, bursting with scents of ripe black plum, cassis, dark cocoa, and cracked black pepper, beautifully balanced by underlying layers of dried porcini mushrooms, sweet oak, and a musk of forest floor. On the palate, the wine is viscous, full-bodied, and enveloping, sweeping across the mouth with a velvety texture and an engaging fluid coherence. Saturated flavors of blueberry preserves, anise, and balsamic glaze are framed by robust yet polished tannins and an unexpected thread of lively acidity, culminating in a long, warming finish with a distinct savory, umami-laced grip.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-braised lamb shanks, grilled rosemary-garlic ribeye steak, hearty wild boar ragù, and extra-sharp aged gouda cheese.

91 Points - Wine Spectator 

Potent and dense, with brooding flavors of blackberry and cherry accented by bitter chocolate, cracked pepper and savory meat tones as this builds tannins on the finish. Grenache, Syrah and Petit Sirah. Best after 2025.

orin-swift-machete-2018.title: Orin Swift Cellars Machete 2018 750ml
orin-swift-machete-2018.bodyHtml:
A paradox can catch you off guard. A powerful punch and a delicate touch – this Petite Sirah-based blend manages to be both. And the labels? Iconic, but never the same. With fruit sourced from all over the state, Machete is a culmination of bird-dogging some of the best Petite Sirah, Grenache, and Syrah vineyards in California. Double-blind tasted to assure the highest quality fruit, making the cut isn’t easy. Tasting Notes: Pure inky garnet in the glass, the aromatics of plum compote, wild blackberries, crushed gravel, peanut brittle, and Tahitian vanilla emanate. Massive on the entry, the mid-palate is diverse with flavors of dark plums, black pepper, Amarena cherries, slow-roasted Moroccan lamb and a marbled leather texture. Rich, enveloping, and vivacious, the wine finishes with perpetuating energy and length—not to mention the satisfying tannins that rouse a desire for more.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple coloured, the 2018 Proprietary Red Machete needs some swirling to reveal a core of beautiful crushed black plums, boysenberries and black cherry compote plus hints of cracked black pepper, garrigue and camphor. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is laden with muscular, crunchy black fruits and plush tannins, finishing long with lovely freshness.
90 Points - Wine Spectator

Potent and gutsy, with concentrated blackberry, brown baking spices and smoked pepper accents that finish with firm tannins. Petite Sirah, Syrah and Grenache. Drink now.

orin-swift-palermo-cabernet-sauvignon-20.title: Orin Swift Cellars Palermo Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
orin-swift-palermo-cabernet-sauvignon-20.bodyHtml:
Orin Swift Cellars Palermo Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a bold, expressive Napa Valley red wine with an opaque purple-ruby core. It opens with intense aromatics of cassis, dark plum, and blackberry preserves, seamlessly layered with accents of cocoa, toasted oak, sweet vanilla, and crushed graphite. On the palate, it is rich, full-bodied, and velvety, offering concentrated dark fruit flavors framed by fine-grained, structured tannins and a long, seamless finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, venison, and aged hard cheeses like sharp cheddar or Gouda.

orin-swift-papillon-2018.title: Orin Swift Cellars Papillon 2021
orin-swift-papillon-2018.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Papillon fills the glass with an unmistakable dark crimson, a flash of neon purple and a ruby rim. Tears move glacially and the wine opens with aromatics of boysenberry jam, violets, chocolate covered blueberry and hints of Cara Cara rind, graphite and brioche. The entry and mid-palate are bright throughout with considerable weight—tones of cassis, blackberry and baking spices flourish. Enveloping texture, chalky, drying tannins and an enduring finish bows out the wine.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of five Bordeaux varieties, the 2021 Papillon Red Wine is marked by scents of mint, crushed stone, cassis and black cherries. It's full-bodied and expansive, framed by ripe, silky tannins, then finishes long and mouthwatering. With more than 35,000 cases produced and a street price as much as $20 below the suggested retail, it's a wine that should win the Orin Swift brand many fans.

90 Points - James Suckling
Lots of delicious, juicy fruit with spices and berries. Medium to full body, affective, fresh and clean, but a little straightforward.

orin-swift-slander-pinot-noir-2019.title: Orin Swift Cellars Slander Pinot Noir California 2021
orin-swift-slander-pinot-noir-2019.bodyHtml:
Orin Swift Cellars Slander Pinot Noir 2021 is an expressive California red wine crafted by acclaimed winemaker Dave Phinney. Known for its distinctive labels and bold winemaking philosophy, Orin Swift brings a rich, contemporary approach to Pinot Noir, combining ripe California fruit with elegance, complexity and a refined structure.This Pinot Noir offers inviting aromas of ripe cherry, raspberry and dark berries, complemented by notes of vanilla, baking spice and subtle oak. The palate is smooth and layered, with juicy red fruit, gentle tannins and balanced acidity leading to a lingering, polished finish. A sophisticated yet approachable wine, Slander is an excellent choice for special occasions, elegant dinners or enjoying on its own.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, herb-crusted pork tenderloin, grilled salmon, roasted chicken, mushroom risotto, beef tenderloin, truffle pasta and aged Gruyère.

89 Points - Wine Advocate

The 2021 Pinot Noir Slander comes from estate vineyards in Sonoma and Monterey, plus some purchased fruit from Santa Barbara. It spent eight months in 32% new French oak, but it isn't especially oaky on the nose, instead offering up slightly floral notes of rose petals, plus beetroot, cherries and strawberries; it's nicely complex on the nose. On the palate, it's medium to full-bodied, silky in texture but a bit tart, with mocha overtones on the finish.

orphan-barrel-entrapment.title: Orphan Barrel Entrapment 25 Year Old Canadian Whisky
orphan-barrel-entrapment.bodyHtml: A new bottling has now emerged from the depths of Canadian whisky player Crown Royal in the form Orphan Barrel Entrapment. According to those behind it, is a 25 year old whisky distilled and aged at the massive Crown Royal distillery in Gimli, Canada. It represents the eleventh release in this particular Diageo line up, and is the first Canadian whisky to be part of the portfolio.

orphan-barrel-rhetoric-24-year-old.title: Orphan Barrel Rhetoric 24 Year Old
orphan-barrel-rhetoric-24-year-old.bodyHtml:
Orphan Barrel Rhetoric 24 Year Old is a long-aged Kentucky bourbon and the fifth instalment of the Rhetoric series, released as the ninth bottling in the Orphan Barrel range. It was distilled at the Bernheim Distillery in Kentucky from a mash bill of 86% corn, 8% malted barley and 6% rye, and is bottled at 45.4% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Despite its age, it is not dominated by oak.

Tasting Notes: Nutty, rich and toasty with caramel and honey.

Nose: Nutty and oily with pecan pie, walnut, caramel, corn and a hint of rye bread and spice.

Palate: Big and round with toasted oak, honey, caramel and candied nuts, late wood spice and a hint of rye.

Finish: Long, coating and toasty with lingering rye.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

orphan-barrel-rhetoric-25-year-old.title: Orphan Barrel Rhetoric 25 Year Old
orphan-barrel-rhetoric-25-year-old.bodyHtml: “A platform of caramel sweetness comes draped in lovely oak spice with dried flower potpourri-like rose petals and an old-lady’s perfume-along with horehound, cedary oak, and iced tea. The palate veers toward dried fruits-apple rings and dates-with bitter orange peel and a beam of spice that turns peppery on the long finish of tobacco and cedar. The overall impression is lithe, upright, and stately. A mash bill of 86% corn, 8% barley and 6% rye. The nose is smoky and leathery with ripe apples. The palate is filled with smoked vanilla oak, toasted rye and dried fruits. The long, full finish has notes of cherry blossom & bitter chocolate. Sip Neat”-Whisky Advocate 91 points.

osoyoos-larose-le-grand-vin-2016.title: Osoyoos Larose Le Grand Vin 2022
osoyoos-larose-le-grand-vin-2016.bodyHtml:
Osoyoos Larose Le Grand Vin 2022 is an elegant, classically composed Bordeaux-style red blend crafted by Osoyoos Larose Estate Winery (a prominent Canadian estate owned by the Bordelais Groupe Taillan). Sourced entirely from estate vineyards overlooking Osoyoos Lake in the arid, sun-drenched south of the Okanagan Valley, the vines are rooted in deep glaciofluvial sandy loam soils that impart both warmth and structural balance. In the glass, it displays an intense, dark garnet hue with deep ruby glints. The aromatic bouquet is layered and refined, featuring concentrated notes of blackcurrant, dark plum, and violet seamlessly interwoven with graphite, cedar box, and subtle baking spice. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full body characterized by fine-grained, refined tannins, balanced natural acidity, and a core of savory, succulent dark fruit that culminates in a long, lingering, and lightly chewy finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted venison loin, braised beef short ribs, rosemary lamb chops, or aged sharp Canadian cheddar cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A juicy and subtly fruity red with black currant, violet, light spice and some graphite aromas and flavors. It’s medium-bodied with refined tannins and a caressing finish. Lightly chewy. A blend of 74% merlot, 14% cabernet sauvignon, 7% cabernet franc, 4% petit verdot and 1% malbec. Very drinkable now, but even better in a year or two.

ouzo-12.title: Ouzo 12
ouzo-12.bodyHtml:
Ouzo 12 is a traditional Greek anise spirit and, by its makers' account, the world's number one ouzo. Its story begins in 1880 in Constantinople at the Kalogiannis family distillery, where connoisseurs always asked for the ouzo drawn from one particular cask, barrel No. 12, which gave the brand its name. The family moved to Thessaloniki in 1925, and in 1950 the ouzo was bottled for the first time in Piraeus, in the carafe-style bottle that became a classic ouzo shape; the producer says the original recipe has never changed. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it offers the distinct taste of anise with herbal and citrus notes and a touch of sweetness.

Tasting Notes: Anise, with herbs, citrus and a touch of sweetness.

Serve: Chilled, neat or on the rocks.

oxley-gin-1.title: The London No. 1 Original Blue Gin

oyster-bay-chardonnay-1.title: Oyster Bay Chardonnay
oyster-bay-chardonnay-1.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Chardonnay is an exceptionally elegant, refreshing, and fruit-driven cool-climate white wine that beautifully captures the vibrant viticultural style of New Zealand. Sourced from choice vineyard sites in Marlborough and Hawke's Bay, this wine undergoes temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel to preserve its bright fruit purity, while a small portion is barrel-fermented and aged in French oak to add structural complexity and creaminess. In the glass, it displays a brilliant pale straw color with shimmering green highlights. The nose is highly expressive and fragrant, unrolling an aromatic bouquet of ripe white peach, citrus blossoms, and crisp yellow apples, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of toasted brioche and creamy vanilla. On the palate, this medium-bodied white is remarkably balanced, driving a rich core of stone fruit and bright citrus flavors over a soft, texturally pleasing mouthfeel that is kept lively by a crisp line of natural acidity, leading into a clean, smooth, and refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with creamy chicken alfredo, pan-seared sea scallops, garlic-butter basted lobster tail, roasted pork tenderloin, or soft-ripened cheeses like Brie.

oyster-bay-pinot-grigio-1.title: Oyster Bay Pinot Grigio
oyster-bay-pinot-grigio-1.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Pinot Grigio is a vibrant, crisp, and refreshing white wine that brilliantly captures the cool-climate essence of New Zealand. Pouring a pale straw color, it bursts with lively aromas of fresh green apple, ripe pear, and zesty citrus, elegantly layered with subtle floral and delicate herbaceous notes. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, bone-dry, and highly approachable, featuring a mouth-watering acidity and a clean, zesty finish that perfectly balances the generous, fruit-forward flavors.

Food Pairing: Exceptionally versatile, it pairs perfectly with fresh seafood like shrimp or scallops, vibrant garden salads, goat cheese, light pasta dishes, and lightly spiced chicken.

oyster-bay-pinot-noir-1.title: Oyster Bay Pinot Noir
oyster-bay-pinot-noir-1.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Pinot Noir is an elegant, fruit-forward, and beautifully balanced cool-climate red wine that captures the bright, aromatic essence of New Zealand. It displays a clear, vibrant ruby red color in the glass, opening with an inviting, fragrant bouquet of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and sweet plums, subtly complemented by delicate hints of red blossoms and soft, integrated savory spice. On the palate, this wine is light-to-medium-bodied and wonderfully smooth, featuring a soft, velvety texture supported by elegant, fine-grained tannins. Juicy flavors of summer red berries and fresh plums are balanced by a refreshing, crisp acidity, leading into a clean, lingering, and subtly spiced finish.

Food Pairing: The elegant structure, bright acidity, and red fruit profile of this Pinot Noir make it an incredibly versatile food companion. It pairs beautifully with roasted or grilled duck breast with a cherry reduction, herb-crusted rack of lamb, pan-seared salmon, and roasted pork tenderloin. It also serves as an excellent complement to mushroom risotto, earthy beetroot salads, wood-fired thin-crust pizzas, and soft cheeses like Brie, Camembert, or mild goat cheese.

oyster-bay-rose-1.title: Oyster Bay Rose
oyster-bay-rose-1.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Marlborough Rosé is a vibrant and elegantly crafted wine that brilliantly captures the cool-climate freshness of New Zealand. Pouring a luminous pale pink color, it bursts with fragrant, summery aromas of fresh strawberry, ripe red cherry, and delicate melon, beautifully intertwined with subtle floral and citrus nuances. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and refreshingly crisp, offering a mouth-watering acidity, a sleek, polished texture, and a zesty, dry finish that perfectly highlights the vivid red-fruit flavors.

Food Pairing: Exceptionally versatile, it pairs beautifully with grilled shrimp, seared tuna, sun-dried tomato and goat cheese quiche, vibrant summer salads, and lightly spiced chicken skewers.

oyster-bay-sauvignon-blanc-1.title: Oyster Bay Sauvignon Blanc
oyster-bay-sauvignon-blanc-1.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Sauvignon Blanc is a benchmark, highly aromatic, and crisp white wine that captures the vibrant cool-climate essence of New Zealand. In the glass, it displays a pale straw color with green hues, opening with an intense and enticing bouquet of ripe passionfruit, bright citrus, and tropical fruits, underscored by signature notes of fresh lemongrass, green apple, and crushed herbs. On the palate, this wine is light-to-medium-bodied and wonderfully refreshing, bursting with lively flavors of zesty lime, grapefruit, and sweet white peach. Its crisp, mouth-watering acidity delivers a clean, focused palate and a long, zesty, and unmistakably refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: The vibrant acidity and intense tropical fruit profile of this Sauvignon Blanc make it a phenomenal match for fresh seafood and light, herb-driven dishes. It pairs beautifully with freshly shucked oysters, steamed green-lipped mussels, grilled prawns, and pan-seared sea bass. It is also an excellent complement to goat cheese crostini, fresh Greek salads, asparagus risotto, and light poultry dishes like lemon-herb grilled chicken.

pabst-vodka-soda-blue-raspberry-6-cans.title: Pabst Strong Lemonade 12 Cans
pabst-vodka-soda-blue-raspberry-6-cans.bodyHtml: Pabst Strong Lemonade is a bold, high-energy take on a classic summer staple, designed to deliver maximum refreshment with a significant kick. This 12-can pack features a potent blend of premium vodka and natural lemon flavours, offering a non-carbonated profile that is both smooth and intensely zesty. Balancing a sharp, mouth-watering citrus tartness with a balanced sweetness, it provides a clean, "extra strength" drinking experience that avoids the heavier mouthfeel of malt-based alternatives. Engineered for convenience and impact, Pabst Strong Lemonade is a popular choice for outdoor social gatherings, beach days, or anyone seeking a reliable, high-ABV alternative to traditional hard lemonades.

panarea-island-gin.title: Panarea Sunset Gin
panarea-island-gin.bodyHtml: Panarea Sunset Gin is a distilled gin with a fresh, delicate and light taste, suitable for the preparation of long drinks and also great on its own or with a slice of orange or lemon. The raw materials used are first rate: premium botanicals such as coriander and infusions of lemon, orange, juniper, basil, grapefruit and myrtle from Panarea, alcohol and spirits which are carefully processed according to ancient techniques, giving life to a distilled gin rich in tradition. Panarea Sunset Gin is transparent with an intense and spiced aroma, characterised by pleasant citrus notes, and is totally devoid of both allergens and artificial additives. Elegant and versatile, with an alcohol percentage of 44%, Panarea Sunset Gin is perfect as an ingredient for the most classic cocktails, as well as a drink to sip at sunset, looking out on a picturesque Sicilian landscape.

panarea-sunset-gin.title: Panarea Sunset Gin
panarea-sunset-gin.bodyHtml: Panarea Sunset Gin is a distilled gin with a fresh, delicate and light taste, suitable for the preparation of long drinks and also great on its own or with a slice of orange or lemon. The raw materials used are first rate: premium botanicals such as coriander and infusions of lemon, orange, juniper, basil, grapefruit and myrtle from Panarea, alcohol and spirits which are carefully processed according to ancient techniques, giving life to a distilled gin rich in tradition. Panarea Sunset Gin is transparent with an intense and spiced aroma, characterised by pleasant citrus notes, and is totally devoid of both allergens and artificial additives. paolo-scavino-barolo-2015.title: Paolo Scavino Barolo 2020 750ml
paolo-scavino-barolo-2015.bodyHtml:
This Barolo has a special value for our family and represents the history and tradition of blending different cru of Barolo.

Our Barolo comes from the best plots of seven cru. The diversity of soils, exposure and altitude characterizes each of these small but very important terroir. Unifying these diversities, the Barolo offers harmony and complexity with an overall character of the zone.

Separate vinfication. Destemming and light crushing. The maceration and the alcoholic fermentation are in stainless steel with temperature controlled and indigenous yeasts. Malolactic fermentation in oak barrels. The tartaric stabilization occurs naturally during the winter with the low temperatures.

Every plots of the crus is kept separate and aged in neutral French oak barrels for 10 months and further 12 months in large casks. Final blend as a result of a further selection in the cellar of the most performing plots of the vintage. Approximately one year of stainless steel and 10 months of bottle aging before release.

This Barolo comes from the best plots of their seven cru. The diversity of soils, exposure and altitude characterizes each of these small but very important terroir. Unifying these diversities, the Barolo offers harmony and complexity with an overall character of the zone.

pappy-van-winkle-10-year-old-bourbon.title: Old Rip Van Winkle 10 Year Old
pappy-van-winkle-10-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:
TASTING NOTES

A sweet vanilla nose with caramel, pecan and oak wood. Smooth, mellow flavor consisting of robust wheat, cherries and oak. Features a long, smoky wheat finish with hints of fruit, spice and oak tannins.

REVIEWS

"A whiskey connoisseur's bonanza...remarkable find...ranks with the best whiskies."

-Paul Pacult's Spirit Journal

Rich copper color. Aromas of fruity, buttery caramel fudge, roasted pecans, and fine brown spices with a plush, chewy, fruity-yet-dry medium-full body and a long, lingering cherry tobacco, toffee, raisin toast, charcoal, and peppery spice finish. A sensationally flavorful and deep bourbon for sipping or cocktails. RATING: 95 points (Exceptional) -Beverage Testing Institute

pappy-van-winkle-12-year-old-bourbon.title: Van Winkle Special Reserve 12 Year Old Lot B
pappy-van-winkle-12-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:
TASTING NOTES

Highlighted by light aromas of dried mango, cocoa, fruit and spiced peach. Flavors of honey, oak and tobacco dance on the pallet. The finish is balanced and dry, with a lingering tingle.

REVIEWS

Wine Enthusiast rating: 98

"Elegant, stately ... balanced beautifully"

-Paul Pacult's Spirit Journal

pappy-van-winkle-15-year-old-bourbon.title: Pappy Van Winkle Family Reserve 15 Year Old
pappy-van-winkle-15-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:

An elegant and sweet aroma with caramel corn and vanilla. Features big flavor of leather, oak and complex fruitiness. Finishes smooth with notes of spice and oak tannins.

pappy-van-winkle-20-year-old-bourbon.title: Pappy Van Winkle Family Reserve 20 Year Old
pappy-van-winkle-20-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:
TASTING NOTES

Intense and tantalizing. Smooth with a citrus zest note. Some sherry notes, dried fruits and vanilla. The finish is long and elegant.

REVIEWS

Wine Enthusiast rating: 99

-Paul Pacult's Spirit Journal

pappy-van-winkle-23-year-old-bourbon.title: Pappy Van Winkle Family Reserve 23 Year Old
pappy-van-winkle-23-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:
TASTING NOTES

Early aromas of caramel and cream with soft notes of oak, nuts and leather. Features a sweet taste composed of vanilla, maple and honey joined by complimentary flavors of citrus and spice. Has a long lasting oaky finish, along with many of the early flavors.

REVIEWS

Whisky Advocate rating: 95

park-alpine-dry-gin-1.title: Park Distillery Alpine Dry Gin
park-alpine-dry-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Park Distillery Alpine Dry Gin is distilled in Banff National Park, Alberta, with glacier-fed water and Canadian spruce tips foraged by the distillery, in a London dry style. Juniper, coriander and lemon and orange peel join the spruce in the botanical mix. It now comes in a bottle made from 100% recycled glass with a biodegradable cork, and $1 from each bottle of Park gin sold goes to the Nature Conservancy of Canada. Bottled at 45% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Dry, citrusy and crisp, with a finish of Canadian spruce.

Serve: Over ice with tonic, or in classic gin cocktails.

park-barrel-aged-gin-1.title: Peddlers Gin Co. Barrel Aged Gin
park-barrel-aged-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Peddlers Gin Co. Barrel Aged Gin is an artisanal Chinese craft gin rested for three months in French oak barrels that previously held Napa Valley Pinot Noir. Combining traditional gin botanicals with organic flora sourced across China, it harmonizes deep fruit and oak nuances with a signature spicy botanical core.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, smoked duck breast, grilled lamb skewers, dark chocolate tarts, and aged hard cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Warm golden-amber with light pinkish undertones, offering a rich, smooth, and full, almost chewy mouthfeel.

Nose : Soft cinnamon spice, subtle zesty lime, warm vanilla, oak shavings, and sweet Pinot Noir grape nuances.

Palate : Smooth caramel and mellow cherry stone fruit from French oak, complemented by smoked Sichuan pepper and floral pepper flavors.

Finish : Long and drying with a piquant pepperiness, trailing off into notes of angelica, licorice, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Best served on the rocks, topped with premium tonic, or used as a rich, complex substitute for bourbon in a Martinez or Old Fashioned.

park-chili-vodka-1.title: Park Distillery Chili Vodka
park-chili-vodka-1.bodyHtml: Park Distillery Bird's Eye Chili Vodka is a chili-flavoured vodka from Banff, Alberta, made to bring just enough heat and spice to warm the palate. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

park-classic-vodka-1.title: Park Distillery Classic Vodka
park-classic-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Park Distillery Classic Vodka is distilled in Banff National Park with water from Rocky Mountain glaciers and grain from high-altitude family farms in the Alberta foothills: 100% sustainably farmed Alberta triticale. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Crisp, cold nose and a slightly sweet, buttery finish.

Serve: Chilled, or in vodka cocktails.

park-espresso-vodka-1.title: Park Distillery Espresso Vodka
park-espresso-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Park Distillery Espresso Vodka is a coffee-flavoured vodka from Banff, Alberta, inspired by a rich cup of coffee brewed over an early-morning campfire. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: In an espresso martini or over ice.

park-vanilla-vodka-1.title: Park Distillery Vanilla Vodka
park-vanilla-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Park Distillery Vanilla Vodka is made from 100% organic Alberta triticale grain, naturally flavoured with vanilla bean, and distilled with glacier water in Banff National Park. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Over ice or in dessert cocktails.

patron-anejo.title: Patron Anejo Tequila
patron-anejo.bodyHtml:
Patrón Añejo Tequila is an ultra-premium, masterfully crafted spirit renowned for its delicate balance of sweet agave flavor and rich wood complexity. Distilled from 100% highest-quality Weber Blue Agave in the Highlands of Jalisco, it is aged for a minimum of 12 months in a combination of French oak, Hungarian oak, and used American whiskey barrels. This extensive aging process imparts deep, warm oak complexities and a rich golden color, resulting in a remarkably smooth and sophisticated sipping tequila.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with rich savory dishes like grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised lamb shanks, or dark mole chicken. It is also an exquisite companion for desserts, particularly dark chocolate lava cakes, churros with caramel dipping sauce, or a fine cigar.

TASTING NOTES A warm amber-gold color with brilliant clarity. It possesses a smooth, velvety, and full-bodied mouthfeel that elegantly coats the palate.

NOSE A rich and complex bouquet dominated by oak wood, sweet caramel, and dried fruits, underscored by soft vanilla and a gentle hint of roasted agave.

PALATE Luxuriously smooth and well-rounded. Initial flavors of sweet honey, cooked agave, and brown sugar blend seamlessly with deep undertones of toasted oak, vanilla, and a touch of baking spice.

FINISH Long, smooth, and warming with a sophisticated finish that leaves lingering notes of dark caramel, light smoke, and a trace of black pepper.

SERVE Best appreciated when sipped neat or over a single large ice sphere in a snifter or heavy rocks glass. It also makes a magnificent, ultra-premium substitute for whiskey in a classic Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

patron-citronge-lime-liqueur.title: Patron Citronge Orange Liqueur
patron-citronge-lime-liqueur.bodyHtml: PATRÓN CITRÓNGE ORANGE is a premium orange tequila liqueur delicately blended for a delightful and sophisticated taste profile. It is perfectly crafted with the finest Mexican oranges and PATRÓN's iconic 100% Blue Weber agave PATRÓN Tequila to elevate your super premium Margaritas.

patron-citronge-orange-liqueur.title: Patron Citronge Orange Liqueur
patron-citronge-orange-liqueur.bodyHtml: PATRÓN CITRÓNGE ORANGE is a premium orange tequila liqueur delicately blended for a delightful and sophisticated taste profile. It is perfectly crafted with the finest Mexican oranges and PATRÓN's iconic 100% Blue Weber agave PATRÓN Tequila to elevate your super premium Margaritas.

patron-estate-release.title: Patron Estate Release Tequila
patron-estate-release.bodyHtml:
A limited-edition silver tequila crafted exclusively from agave grown on the grounds of Hacienda Patrón. Perfect for sipping, sharing, or mixing.

This limited-edition silver tequila was made from Weber Blue Agave cultivated on the grounds of the Hacienda Patrón distillery in Atotonilco el Alto, Mexico. This special terroir gives the spirit a robust and complex flavor featuring unique herbal and citrus notes.

patron-gran-burdeos.title: Gran Patron Burdeos Anejo Tequila
patron-gran-burdeos.bodyHtml:
A luxury añejo tequila finished in Bordeaux wine barrels.

Gran Patrón Burdeos is crafted in very limited quantities from the finest 100% Weber Blue Agave grown in the Highlands of Jalisco. Twice distilled and aged in used American and new French oak barrels, it is then finished in vintage Bordeaux wine barrels, which impart a dark amber color and a taste that´s velvety smooth with hints of vanilla and raisins.

patron-gran-piedra.title: Gran Patron Piedra Extra Anejo Tequila
patron-gran-piedra.bodyHtml:
Gran Patrón Piedra is an extra añejo tequila from Patrón, named after the Spanish word for stone because it is made exclusively with the traditional tahona process, in which a heavy volcanic stone wheel crushes the cooked agave. Patrón describes it as one of very few tequilas still produced only this way. Made from 100% Weber Blue agave from the Jalisco Highlands, it is aged for four years in a combination of French Limousin oak and new American oak barrels, giving a deep mahogany colour. It is presented in a crystal decanter with a gift box. 40% ABV, 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Earthy and velvety with vanilla, caramel, nutmeg and apple.

Nose: Toasted coconut, sweet potato and dried apple with a hint of toasted French oak.

Palate: Subtly earthy with a velvety texture, vanilla, caramel and nutmeg.

Serve: Neat or on the rocks.

patron-gran-platinum.title: Gran Patron Platinum Tequila
patron-gran-platinum.bodyHtml:
Gran Patron Platinum is presented by Patron as the finest silver tequila it makes. It is produced from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in the Highlands of Jalisco, triple-distilled, and then rested for thirty days in oak tanks, a short rest that adds a subtle creamy oak note while keeping the tequila crystal clear. The producer describes the sweet aroma of lightly cooked agave, notes of citrus, orange and lime with a hint of white pepper, and an elegant, smooth finish. Each bottle is a hand-numbered crystal decanter delivered in a presentation case, which makes it a frequent choice for gifting and celebrations. It is bottled at 40% ABV, and this listing is the 750ml size.

Tasting Notes: Cooked agave, herbal tea, orange rind, ripe pear.

Nose: Sweet, lightly cooked agave.

Palate: Soft oak with citrus notes of orange and lime and a hint of white pepper.

Finish: Elegant and smooth.

Serve: On the rocks, or in a premium cocktail.

patron-gran-smoky.title: Patron Gran Smoky Tequila
patron-gran-smoky.bodyHtml:
A sophisticated silver tequila with a perfectly balanced, very complex smoky flavor.

Gran Patrón Smoky begins with the highest quality Weber Blue Agave. The piñas are roasted with mesquite for about seven days in small underground stone pits at Hacienda Patrón in Jalisco, Mexico. They’re then crushed with a tahona wheel, fermented, and distilled.

patron-guillermo-del-toro-1.title: Patron Guillermo del Toro + Tequila 50ml
patron-guillermo-del-toro-1.bodyHtml:
The pursuit of perfection met its match when film mastermind Guillermo del Toro, a native Jaliscan, came to the Hacienda to bring his artistic approach to Patrón’s process. What came from this partnership was Patrón’s darkest product to date in both age and ideation. The signature bottle holds a perfect extra añejo tequila featuring a blend of aged tequilas averaging 5 years in used oak barrels upside down. The bottle is crowned by a skull resting on top holding an aged deep orange liqueur that perfectly complements the tequila’s symphony of dark flavors. This pairing of products reflects the pairing of film and tequila that came about through Patrón x Guillermo del Toro. 

Patrón x Guillermo del Toro is the culmination of two masters coming together in one masterful spirit. Francisco Alcaraz is the master of Patrón with a history going back over two decades in creating the recipes and processes Patrón still uses today to make the perfect spirit. Francisco distilled the core values of Patrón - Time, Life and Maturity – making Patrón the perfect product for Guillermo del Toro who appreciates the level of work put into the iconic tequila and his own work. Del Toro is a master of film, having created such hits as Pan’s Labyrinth and The Devil’s Backbone in a true distillation of darkness. He writes and produces fantastical works that transport audiences to new worlds through novel sights and sounds that delight and terrify around every turn. 

Guy Davis, a regular collaborator with del Toro on his many visions, began sketching elements of the illustrations for the intricate box in March 2015. Over time and many discussions, the box became an altar to the perfection of Patrón and Guillermo del Toro’s mind. With odes to Mexican culture and heritage through icons representing the tequila making process, the box takes on a life of its own as a drinking ritual. 

The devilish dual-sided bottle deserved signature cocktails that perfectly balanced the two aged spirits. Creating the sinful cocktails came down to Patrón’s own bartenders who took classics and twisted them to incorporate ingredients that perfectly accented the deeper aged flavors of this limited-edition tequila. The cocktails pair neatly with the ritual warranted by Patrón x Guillermo del Toro and allow you to sip darkly into the night.

patron-reposado.title: Patron Reposado Tequila
patron-reposado.bodyHtml:
Patrón Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium, handcrafted tequila that delivers a sophisticated balance of fresh agave flavor and subtle oak complexity. Masterfully distilled from 100% highest-quality Weber Blue Agave in the Highlands of Jalisco, it is aged for a minimum of two months in a combination of fresh and used oak barrels. This careful aging process rounds out the spirit, giving it a beautifully smooth finish and a delicate golden hue that appeals to both silver tequila purists and aged spirit enthusiasts.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled sea bass, garlic butter shrimp, pork carnitas tacos, or grilled chicken breasts marinated in citrus. It also complements slightly spicy dishes, creamy guacamole, or a cheese board featuring medium-aged Gouda and Manchego.

Tasting Notes : Bright, clear with a light amber tint and a smooth, medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh agave, light oak, citrus peel, and gentle honeyed vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of fresh agave, subtle toasted oak, citrus, and light honey.

Finish : Light, clean, and warming with lingering oak spice and agave.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as the base for a premium Paloma or Tommy's Margarita.

Nose : Fresh agave, light oak, citrus peel, and gentle honeyed vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of fresh agave, subtle toasted oak, citrus, and light honey.

Finish : Light, clean, and warming with lingering oak spice and agave.

patron-roca-silver.title: Patron Silver Tequila
patron-roca-silver.bodyHtml:
Patrón Silver Tequila is a smooth, handcrafted ultra-premium blanco tequila produced in small batches at the Hacienda Patrón distillery in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Made from 100% Weber Blue Agave harvested at peak maturity, the agave piñas are slowly baked in traditional brick ovens, crushed using both a volcanic stone tahona wheel and a modern roller mill, fermented, and distilled in small copper pot stills. Bottled immediately without aging, it captures the crisp, pure, and vibrant essence of fresh sweet agave balanced with bright citrus and subtle peppery notes.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh ceviche, grilled shrimp tacos, guacamole with tortilla chips, seared scallops, citrus-marinated chicken, and fresh queso fresco.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and bright with a smooth, light-to-medium body and a clean, crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh cooked agave, sweet citrus zest, green pear, white flowers, and subtle herbal notes.

Palate : Crisp and smooth with flavors of sweet roasted agave, lemon and lime peel, fresh tropical fruit, and a touch of cracked white pepper.

Finish : Clean, light, and warming with lingering notes of sweet agave and gentle black pepper spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tequila tasting glass or flute, chilled on the rocks with a lime wedge, or as the crisp foundation in classic cocktails such as a Margarita or Paloma.

patron-silver-1.title: Patron Silver Tequila 375ml
patron-silver-1.bodyHtml: A handcrafted, small-batch tequila that's made using the finest blue weber agave. Crystal clear with lively aromas of fresh agave and citrus. Smooth and sweet on the palate followed by flavours of citrus, melon and cucumber with light pepper and briny notes on a lengthy finish. Great on its own or use in premium cocktails.

paul-hobbs-cross-barn-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Paul Hobbs Crossbarn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
paul-hobbs-cross-barn-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This wine shows deep ruby in hue with a bouquet of crushed violets, red currant, and black plum. A bounty of concentrated black fruits is featured on the palate, accompanied by dried herbs and cacao. Structured tannins provide this full-bodied wine with a unique depth along with a lively acidity that gives tension to a long, seamless finish.

Pair with grilled skirt steak with shiso chimichurri.

94 Points - James Suckling

A juicy and flavorful red with real Napa character from vineyards in Calistoga and Coombsville. Medium-bodied with juicy fruit and a flavorful finish. Currant and hints of mint. But reserved and focused. Shows tension. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Spectator 

An alluring red, with a menthol note out front, followed by a slow-moving core of boysenberry and blackberry reduction flavors. Shows ample anise and bramble through the grippy, toasty finish, where the menthol note takes an encore. Best from 2025 through 2035.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Blended from Coombsville and Calistoga fruit, Crossbarn's 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley is a terrific bargain, made by Paul Hobbs. It's purple-fruited, with scents of cassis, blackberries and blueberries framed by hints of vanilla and cedar on the nose, while the palate is full-bodied and concentrated, with a long, softy dusty finish. With just 8% new French oak—the bulk of the barrels are second and third use—the quality of the fruit really shines through.
92 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Mouthwatering and flavorful, this satisfying Cabernet Sauvignon greets the palate with flavors of black plum, wet tobacco, and dark hot chocolate. Powdery palate coating tannins enliven a spiced and lengthy, long finish.

paul-hobbs-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvigno.title: Paul Hobbs Crossbarn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
paul-hobbs-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvigno.bodyHtml:
This wine shows deep ruby in hue with a bouquet of crushed violets, red currant, and black plum. A bounty of concentrated black fruits is featured on the palate, accompanied by dried herbs and cacao. Structured tannins provide this full-bodied wine with a unique depth along with a lively acidity that gives tension to a long, seamless finish.

Pair with grilled skirt steak with shiso chimichurri.

94 Points - James Suckling

A juicy and flavorful red with real Napa character from vineyards in Calistoga and Coombsville. Medium-bodied with juicy fruit and a flavorful finish. Currant and hints of mint. But reserved and focused. Shows tension. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Spectator 

An alluring red, with a menthol note out front, followed by a slow-moving core of boysenberry and blackberry reduction flavors. Shows ample anise and bramble through the grippy, toasty finish, where the menthol note takes an encore. Best from 2025 through 2035.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Blended from Coombsville and Calistoga fruit, Crossbarn's 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley is a terrific bargain, made by Paul Hobbs. It's purple-fruited, with scents of cassis, blackberries and blueberries framed by hints of vanilla and cedar on the nose, while the palate is full-bodied and concentrated, with a long, softy dusty finish. With just 8% new French oak—the bulk of the barrels are second and third use—the quality of the fruit really shines through.
92 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Mouthwatering and flavorful, this satisfying Cabernet Sauvignon greets the palate with flavors of black plum, wet tobacco, and dark hot chocolate. Powdery palate coating tannins enliven a spiced and lengthy, long finish.

paul-john-bold.title: Paul John Bold Indian Single Malt
paul-john-bold.bodyHtml:
Bold is a journey that leads you down the unexplored, unchartered terrains of Goa. It offers you a slice of its best-kept secrets, unravelling the mysteries, bit by little bit. This expression of ours invites you to leave the trail, tread the path less taken and plunge headlong into the delicious depths of Goa.

Nose:

After the slightest whiff of smoke, a dizzying array of Manuka honey, prickly spice and bourboneque red liquorice takes over.

Palate:

This melt-in-the-mouth malt has the most profound flavours crashing in like waves. At first, the delivery feels sublimely silky and studded with oak-like honey. And just when you think you've savoured it all, you are surprised by a hefty second wave of spice. This is followed by a cloudy, smoky feel that coats the roof of the mouth and leaves a tidal wave of dry molasses, peaty soot and a degree of copper in its wake.

Finish:

Bold has a light finish with a tinge of copper slowly making its presence known. You can also sense a gorgeous smoked mocha shaped by delicate and intricate spices.

Colour:

Liquid Gold

paul-john-nirvana.title: Paul John Nirvana Indian Single Malt
paul-john-nirvana.bodyHtml:
A captivating expression from the Goan shores of India, the Nirvana arouses the senses with a soft whiff of bourbon, fruitcake and an enticing caramel pudding. The honeycomb sweetness gently touches the palate with a mild salt-tinged barley while the succulent vanilla heralds the honeyed finish of this rich copper whisky, assuring sublime experiences beyond the worldly realm.

Nose:

An attractive honeycombed bourbon with luscious fruitcake, with a light whiff of enticing caramel pudding.

Taste:

A delightful soft honey with a slight salt-edged barley; an excellent mouthfeel with honeycomb sweetness.

Finish:

Immensely long, and richly flavoured with dissolving honey, barley, and succulent vanilla.

Balance:

A joyous barley plays intricately with high quality oak, that offers a dash of true goan pleasure!

Colour:

Deep Copper.

peerless-small-batch-kentucky-straight-r.title: Peerless Small Batch Kentucky Straight Rye
peerless-small-batch-kentucky-straight-r.bodyHtml:
A multi-award-winning rye that put Kentucky Peerless back on the map! Every drop of this Small Batch Rye is crafted using a meticulous sweet mash process and bottled at a robust barrel proof (in this case, 111.6 proof / 55.80% ABV). Because it is strictly non-chill filtered and never watered down, it retains an incredibly thick, viscous mouthfeel. It perfectly balances a robust, peppery rye spice with complex layers of sweet fruit and toasted oak, making it a dream pour for rye enthusiasts.

NOSE

Rich and inviting aromas of sweet roasted nuts, bright citrus zest, and heavy toasted oak.

PALATE

Thick, syrupy, and full-bodied. A bold wave of spicy rye and black pepper is beautifully tempered by sweet caramel, dark chocolate, and candied fruit.

FINISH

Long, warming, and deeply satisfying, leaving a lingering trail of sweet oak and baking spice.

peller-family-cabernet-merlot-2.title: Peller Estates Family Vineyards Cabernet Merlot
peller-family-cabernet-merlot-2.bodyHtml:
Peller Estates Family Vineyards Cabernet Merlot is an approachable and well-balanced red wine crafted for easy, everyday enjoyment, showcasing the classic Niagara style of blending bold structure with smooth fruit. This medium-bodied wine presents a deep ruby colour and an expressive bouquet of ripe black cherries, plums, and blackberries, accented by subtle notes of toasted oak and dried herbs. On the palate, it is supple and refined, featuring soft, velvety tannins and a clean, fruit-driven finish that makes it a versatile choice for casual social gatherings, family dinners, or backyard barbecues. Its reliable and consistent character has established it as a benchmark for high-value Canadian red blends. 

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with casual everyday meals such as grilled steaks, gourmet beef burgers, pepperoni and mushroom pizza, barbecued sausages, meaty lasagna, beef wraps, and aged Canadian cheddar.

penderyn-madeira-finish.title: Penderyn Madeira Finish Single Malt Welsh Whisky
penderyn-madeira-finish.bodyHtml:
This whisky is the original Penderyn ‘house style’, aged in ex-bourbon barrels and finished in ex-Madeira wine casks to bring out its full gold character. It is bottled at 46% abv. A video featuring our designer, Glenn Tutssel, talking about the new bespoke bottle can be seen here.

2020 Spirits Business World Whisky Masters - Gold
2019 Ultimate Spirits Competition - 88/100 - 'Very Good'
2018 Spirits Selection by Concours Mondial – Grand Gold
2018 World Whisky Masters Europe Premium – Gold
2017 World Whisky Masters Europe Premium – Gold

Welsh Gold is extremely rare, pure and precious and was worn by legendary Welsh princes. Our Gold Collection reflects those qualities.

Tasting Notes
Nose: A classic freshness with aromas of cream toffee, rich fruit and raisins.
Palate: Crisp and finely rounded, with the sweetness to balance an appetising dryness.
Finish: Notes of tropical fruit, raisins and vanilla persist.
Balance: Oaky vanilla tones/dry sweetness

penderyn-portwood.title: Penderyn Portwood Welsh Whisky
penderyn-portwood.bodyHtml:
This Portwood-finish whisky is a firm favourite among our customers in France and is a full-bodied whisky. It is bottled at 46% abv.

2020 San Fransisco World Spirits Competition – Gold
2019 Whiskies of the World - Gold (Best in Class)
2019 IWSC Worldwide Whiskies - Gold
2016 World Whisky Masters Europe Premium – Gold

Welsh Gold is extremely rare, pure and precious and was worn by legendary Welsh princes. Our Gold Collection reflects those qualities.

Tasting Notes
Nose: Aromas of rich dried fruits with dark chocolate and cranberries; a hint of toasty oak mingles with a baked nutty dryness
Palate: A creamy richness with some honey and spiced notes emerging
Finish: Smooth with a soft oak and honey sweetness lingering gently on the tongue
Balance: Rich wood/chocolate & dry fruits

penderyn-rhiannon.title: Penderyn Rhiannon Icons of Wales No. 7 Sherrywood Grand Cru Finish Single Malt Welsh Whisky
penderyn-rhiannon.bodyHtml:
We are delighted to announce the 7th in our Icons of Wales Series. ‘Rhiannon’ is a Sherrywood Grand Cru finished whisky at 46% abv. This is a new whisky for Penderyn and we’re very excited about it.

Written in the Welsh language in the 11th century, The Mabinogi are the earliest prose work in the history of Britain. The interrelated tales deal in mythology, history, political themes, romances and magical fantasies. The stories feature strong women characters, and none are stronger than Rhiannon - an enchantress and a horse goddess who could ‘out-run any pursuer even whilst riding slowly’.

2019 - Spirits Business Design & Packaging Awards - Gold

Rhiannon was famed for being intelligent, generous, strong-willed, otherworldly, adept at strategic planning and gifted with both supernatural and physical powers. On her journey Rhiannon uses magic to rid herself of a suitor, is falsely accused of infanticide, and later becomes one of only four survivors of a magical thunderstorm. Rhiannon in Welsh means ‘Great Queen’ or ‘Divine Queen.’ Her parents were the Fairy King and Queen of Gwent (in reality a sizeable Welsh Kingdom of ancient Britain), who educated her to handle sovereignty and governance. Rhiannon also possessed a number of magical birds who could soothe the living into a deep slumber, or wake the dead from eternal sleep.

Rhiannon later became the subject of Stevie Nicks’ song on the eponymous Fleetwood Mac album (1975): ‘She rules her life like a bird in flight…’ More recently Rhiannon has turned up in modern fantasy novels.

Tasting Notes
Nose: Spicy sweetness with the hint of vanilla; oak tannins, red berries, blackcurrants, hazelnuts, pears, sultanas and sweet marzipan
Taste: Smooth velvety sweetness; creamy caramel, figs, red berries, delicate frangipane, chocolate ganache and a touch of coffee
Finish: Sweet and dry with long lingering oak tannins

pendleton-1910-12-year-old.title: Pendleton 1910 12 Year Old Canadian Rye Whisky
pendleton-1910-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Pendleton® 1910 is a rare 100% rye whisky that is aged for a minimum of 12 years in oak barrels before being cut to proof with pristine glacier-fed spring water from Oregon’s highest peak, Mt. Hood. 1910 is named for the inaugural year of the Pendleton Round-Up; a legendary outdoor rodeo that has been held in northeast Oregon for over a century. (40% ABV – 80 proof).

Color: Golden amber
Aroma: Well-rounded and full -bodied aroma. Nutmeg, cloves, and hints of dried pineapple.
Flavor: Muted tropical notes, apples and dried cherries. Nutty toffee undertones.
Finish: A medium dry finish with lingering tart cherry.

pendleton-directors-reserve.title: Pendleton Directors' Reserve 20 Year Old
pendleton-directors-reserve.bodyHtml:
Pendleton® Directors' Reserve is ultra-premium Canadian whisky aged 20 years. Full-bodied finish of spices, pecans & walnuts. Pure, glacier-fed spring water from Oregon’s Mt. Hood allows the unadorned, warm notes of oak, cinnamon, and rye to shine through. Best enjoyed neat. (40% ABV – 80 proof). Pendleton, Oregon is home to one of the most famous and respected rodeos in the world. First held in 1910, the Pendleton Round-Up has taken place in northeast Oregon every September for over 100 years. With a flavor as rich as the tradition that inspired it, this whisky is dedicated to the sport of rodeo and those who celebrate the American West.

Color: Golden amber
Aroma: Toasted coconut, freshly-grated cinnamon, oak, vanilla, and orange zest
Flavor: A full-bodied and satiating finish with a smolder of spices, pecans and walnuts
Finish: A long, mature and smooth finish.

peppoli-chianti-classico-docg.title: Marchesi Antinori Peppoli Chianti Classico 2024
peppoli-chianti-classico-docg.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Peppoli Chianti Classico 2024 is a bright, vibrant, and contemporary expression of classic Tuscan winemaking. Sourced from the historic Pèppoli estate, this Sangiovese-dominant red wine features a lively ruby color and opens with a highly expressive bouquet of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and currants. These fruity layers are beautifully complemented by delicate floral undertones of violets and lavender, alongside light, spicy hints of licorice and blood orange. On the palate, it offers a soft entry with crisp acidity and well-integrated, ripe tannins, culminating in a remarkably fresh, savory, and chalky finish.

Food Pairing: Traditional Tuscan dishes, pasta with meat ragù, wood-fired margherita pizza, grilled poultry, roasted lamb, and aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

91 Points - James Suckling

A spicy wine with aromas of licorice, dried flowers, bright red cherries, violets and blood oranges. Light-bodied, soft and extracted, with crisp acidity and a chalky finish. Drink now.

peter-lehmann-clancys-red-barossa-valley.title: Peter Lehmann Barossa Shiraz
peter-lehmann-clancys-red-barossa-valley.bodyHtml:
Peter Lehmann Barossa Shiraz reflects the rich character associated with South Australia's Barossa, offering ripe plum, blackberry and dark cherry fruit with savoury spice. The generous palate combines concentrated fruit with structured tannins and balanced freshness, delivering a full-flavoured expression with a persistent finish.
