Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled lamb chops, roast beef, barbecue ribs, and aged cheddar.

peter-lehmann-the-barossan-shiraz-1.title: Peter Lehmann 'The Barossan' Shiraz 2024
peter-lehmann-the-barossan-shiraz-1.bodyHtml:
Peter Lehmann 'The Barossan' Shiraz 2024 is a vibrant, full-bodied Australian red wine crafted from select parcels across the Barossa region. It showcases lifted aromas of ripe cherry, plum, and brooding dark fruits, seamlessly integrated with sweet chocolate, mocha undertones, and a touch of peppery oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a rich, generous texture supported by fine, velvety tannins and a soft, supple finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised lamb shanks, BBQ beef ribs, wild mushroom stew, or aged cheddar cheese.

91 Points - James Suckling

A fresh and flavorful shiraz showing a ripe personality with abundant fruit. Aromas of oregano, potpourri, vanilla, chocolate and intense sweet blueberries and dark cherries. Medium- to full-bodied with polished, creamy tannins and a long and round finish. Approachable and attractive now.

petite-petit-petite-sirah-1.title: Michael David Winery Freakshow Petite Petit 2022
petite-petit-petite-sirah-1.bodyHtml:
Michael David Winery Freakshow Petite Petit 2022 is a grandiose, booming, and larger-than-life red wine that perfectly captures the bold, playful spirit of Lodi winemaking. True to its name and its famous circus-elephant label, this is a show-stopping blend of two dark, deeply concentrated grape varieties: Petite Sirah and Petit Verdot. Saturated with an inky, near-opaque purple hue, it opens with powerful aromas of rich plum, boysenberry jam, and black cherry, interwoven with notes of sweet vanilla bean and dried violet petals. On the palate, it delivers a massive, full-bodied experience packed with velvety flavors of blackberry compote, dark cocoa nibs, and warm baking spices. Its thick, opulent texture is firmly held together by strong, structured tannins and a warming core, concluding with a long, satisfying, and deeply robust finish.

Food Pairing: Barbecued beef ribs, flame-grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised venison, hearty meat lasagna, or smoky pulled pork sliders.

91 Points - James Suckling

A show-stopping blend of two dark and tannic grape varieties, this monster of a red wine is potent in flavor and thick in texture. Blackberry, dried-blueberry, cocoa, graphite and cacao-bean flavors are firmly held by strong tannins. Petite sirah and petit verdot. Drink now or hold. Screw cap.

phillips-butter-ripple-schnapps-2.title: Phillips Butter Ripple Schnapps
phillips-butter-ripple-schnapps-2.bodyHtml:
Phillips Butter Ripple Schnapps is a butterscotch-flavoured schnapps liqueur from Phillips, the Minnesota spirits brand founded in 1912. Bottled at 15% ABV, it is a sweet, caramel-flavoured liqueur with aromas of praline and butterscotch and a smooth, creamy palate of nuts and caramel that tastes rich without being too sweet. The brand's liqueurs and schnapps are made for easy mixing, and Butter Ripple is most often used in dessert-style cocktails and shots, sipped over ice or drizzled over a scoop of ice cream. This is the 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Amber in colour, with butterscotch, praline and caramel.

Nose: Praline and butterscotch.

Palate: Smooth and creamy, with nuts, caramel and a full butterscotch flavour.

Serve: Over ice, in dessert cocktails, or poured over ice cream.

pike-creek-21-year-old-oloroso-cask-fini.title: Bowmore 21 Year Old Sherry Oak Cask
pike-creek-21-year-old-oloroso-cask-fini.bodyHtml:
With its meticulous maturation and luscious autumnal hue, this uncommonly captivating 21-year old offers a complex, diverse and rewarding union of flavours.

This confident and eclectic 21-year old offers a remarkable breadth to its character, gathering notes as diverse as tobacco, heather, and beeswax. Its epilogue in first fill Pedro Ximenez Sherry casks is testament to our Master Blender's intuitive genius.

A complex tapestry of tobacco leaves and heather, sweetened by rich toffee treacle and beeswax.

Aged in hand-selected ex-Bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks before being finished in a first fill Pedro Ximenez Sherry cask, gives our 21 Year Old a rich and intriguing persona.

pike-creek-double-barreled-canadian-whis.title: Pike Creek Double Barreled 10 Year Old Rum Barrel Finish Canadian Whisky
pike-creek-double-barreled-canadian-whis.bodyHtml:
Pike Creek is aged in oak casks in a non-climate controlled warehouse, exposing it to Canada's severe temperature swings. This creates an incredibly smooth yet complex whisky, which is then finished in rum barrels to bring out notes of molasses and vanilla.

This whisky yields its best flavor when sipped neat, on the rocks, or with a few drops of water.

pimms-no-1-cup-gin-1.title: Pimm's No. 1 Cup
pimms-no-1-cup-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Pimm's No. 1 Cup is a gin-based liqueur from England, bottled at 25% ABV in a 750 ml bottle. It is made from dry gin, liqueur, fruit juices and spices to a recipe that remains a closely guarded secret, and it traces its origin to the 19th-century London oyster bar owner James Pimm, whose signature appears on the label. The liquid is a deep amber-red, with flavours of orange, warm spice, earthy botanicals and wood and aromas often likened to cucumber, lemon and mint. It is the base of the Pimm's Cup, the long, fruit-filled summer drink that has become a fixture of British garden parties.

Tasting Notes: Orange, warm spice and herbal botanicals with a gentle bitterness.

Nose: Citrus, fragrant herbs and a hint of spice, with cucumber, lemon and mint.

Palate: Fruity sweetness with orange, amber spices, earthy botanicals and a subtle bitterness.

Serve: Serve long over ice with lemonade or ginger ale, fresh mint, cucumber and sliced fruit.

pio-cesare-barbaresco-2016.title: Pio Cesare Barbaresco 2021
pio-cesare-barbaresco-2016.bodyHtml:
Pio Cesare Barbaresco 2021 is an elegant, structured, and beautifully harmonious Italian red wine that perfectly captures the prestige of a classic Piedmontese vintage. Sourced exclusively from the family's prized estate vineyards in Treiso (Cascina Il Bricco and San Stefanetto) and San Rocco Seno d'Elvio, it pours a vibrant garnet-red color in the glass. The nose is exceptionally captivating and complex, unfurling aromas of dark brambleberries, black cherries, and crushed rose petals, elegantly layered with notes of iodine, fresh mint, graphite, and dried orange peel. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied selection delivers a focused core of fresh cherry and redcurrant fruit, accompanied by savory undertones of licorice, sweet pipe tobacco, and woodland spices. Balanced by a bright, racy acidity and firmly woven, linear tannins, it exhibits wonderful tension and a deep mineral drive that carries through to a long, graceful finish.

Food Pairing: This sophisticated Barbaresco pairs magnificently with slow-cooked veal or lamb shanks, duck ragù over fresh pasta, wild mushroom risotto, rich truffle-infused dishes, or aged Alpine cheeses like Castelmagno and Grana Padano.

96 Points - James Suckling

The aromas of iodine and oyster shell really come through together with black cherries and dark brambleberries. Medium body with firm and racy tannins that run the length of the wine. March 2025 release. Drinkable but even better in three or four years. Try after 2028. 

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A bright red color, the 2021 Barbaresco Pio is focused, spicy, and pure on the palate. Coming mostly from Treiso, it offers notes of wild raspberries, clove spice, dried orange peel, and dried earth. Medium-bodied, it exhibits good linear tension and structured tannins, with a deeper structure derived from the Treiso soils, which are more akin to those of Barolo and will require time to soften. Drink 2025-2040.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This first whiff of this wine is like peering into the Grand Canyon's, where layers of red and black berries stretch endlessly, growing deeper with each inhale. Every swirl reveals new depths of sweet tobacco and woodland spices that tease the senses. Pure Nebbiolo power shows its true colors on the palate, where firm tannins and ripe fruit cascade through infinite layers, never hitting bottom. Drink Now - 2040.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Lithe and graceful, this red plays cherry and strawberry fruit and white pepper against balsamic notes of eucalyptus and menthol. Firms up on the finish,where dense tannins leave their grip.

pio-cesare-barolo-2016.title: Pio Cesare Barolo 2021
pio-cesare-barolo-2016.bodyHtml:
Pio Cesare Barolo 2021 is a powerful, deeply complex, and beautifully structured Italian red wine that serves as a magnificent portrait of an exceptional, classic Piedmontese vintage. Since 1881, this historic house has masterfully blended Nebbiolo grapes from family-owned plots across the appellation’s premier communes (including Serralunga d'Alba, La Morra, Grinzane Cavour, Novello, and Monforte d'Alba), producing a textbook Barolo of undeniable distinction. Pours a captivating and deep garnet-ruby color, it opens with a dense, expressive bouquet of fresh raspberries and dried cherries, layered with sophisticated aromas of black truffles, crushed iris, graphite, and a hint of eucalyptus. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied masterpiece delivers a vibrant core of primary red and dark fruits driven by an energetic acidity and clear mineral tension. Firm, chewy, yet finely polished tannins wrap around delicate notes of cedarwood, licorice, and forest floor, carrying the wine through to an incredibly long, expansive, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: This robust and noble red pairs exquisitely with slow-cooked beef osso buco, wild boar ragù over fresh tagliatelle, truffle-infused wild mushroom risotto, roasted rack of lamb, or mature, hard Italian cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano and Castelmagno.

96 Points - James Suckling

This is very powerful and structured, with aromas of black truffles, graphite and hints of dried thyme and cedar. Medium- to full-bodied and chewy yet polished. Hints of terra cotta and dark fruit. The finish goes on and on.
94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Pio Cesare 2021 Barolo draws fruit from various sites, and like the Barbaresco, you get an excellent portrait of the vintage with balanced acidity, firm tannins and bright primary fruit. There is energy and vitality in this pretty Barolo with dried cherry, iris and subtle dustings of iron ore or rust.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

The cherry and raspberry fruit is enhanced by rose and mineral flavors in this red, along with a hint of eucalyptus. Sleek and elegant yet also solidly structured, leaving a dusting of tannins on the finish.

pittyvaich-25-year-old-1.title: Pittyvaich 25 Year Old
pittyvaich-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Pittyvaich 25 Year Old is a rare official single malt from Pittyvaich, the short-lived Speyside distillery that operated only from 1975 to 1993. Released as part of Diageo's 2015 Special Releases, it was distilled in 1989, matured in refill American oak casks and bottled at a natural 49.9% ABV, with 6,000 bottles produced. It is only the second official bottling from the distillery. 750ml.

Nose: Firm, honey-sweet malt and almond oil, turning complex with delicate fruit over vanilla sponge and custard.

Palate: Treacle toffee cut by crisp green apple; sweet with light acidity, then a warm nuttiness, oily and malty.

Finish: Slightly pungent and herbal with a hint of peat, drying to a heather-honey aftertaste.

Serve: Neat, or with a little water.

pittyvaich-28-year-old-2018-release.title: Pittyvaich 28 Year Old 2018 Release
pittyvaich-28-year-old-2018-release.bodyHtml: The third in the Diageo Special Releases 2018 collection, Pittyvaich 28 Year Old Special Releases 2018 is a rarity because the distillery closed its doors in 1993 and not many casks have made it out. So this is quite an exciting one. Aged in American oak hogsheads, this almost three decade matured dram is quite fruity and sweet.

pittyvaich-29-year-old-2019-release.title: Pittyvaich 29 Year Old 2019 Edition
pittyvaich-29-year-old-2019-release.bodyHtml: Part of Diageo’s 2019 Special Releases, this limited edition Speyside single malt was distilled at the ghost distillery of Pittyvaich and matured for 29 years including time spent in Oloroso and Pedro Ximenez sherry-seasoned oak casks before bottling at a natural cask strength of 51.4% abv. Just 4,976 individually numbered bottles have been produced worldwide.

pittyvaich-30-year-old-2020-release.title: Pittyvaich 30 Year Old 2020 Edition
pittyvaich-30-year-old-2020-release.bodyHtml: Pittyvaich is a rarely seen whisky, thanks to the short time it was open. However, owner Diageo has found some more great casks hidden in its warehouses to create this entry for the Diageo Special Releases 2020. Matured solely in first-fill ex-bourbon casks, it showcases the herbal and fruity side of Pittyvaich's spirit, all layered with spice and sweet cream.

planeta-rose-1.title: Planeta Sicilia Rose 2024
planeta-rose-1.bodyHtml:
Planeta Rosé 2024 is an elegant, vibrant, and thoroughly expressive Sicilian rosé that beautifully captures the essence of a Mediterranean summer. Pouring a delicate, pale pearl-pink reminiscent of the inner lining of an oyster shell, this wine opens with a fragrant, high-toned nose of wild Sicilian strawberries, red currants, and wild rose petals, accented by deeper hints of ripe melon and tropical pineapple. On the palate, it is wonderfully supple, refreshing, and light-bodied, balancing its juicy core of crisp red fruit and white peach against a gentle, beautifully integrated vein of natural salinity and crisp acidity. Fermented entirely in stainless steel to retain maximum freshness, it glides effortlessly across the palate into a clean, lifting, and incredibly mouthwatering finish that invites you back for another sip.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with fresh seafood salad, crispy fried calamari, traditional Sicilian street food, raw fish crudo, or as a light summer aperitif.

90 Points - James Suckling

This very pale rosé has aromas of rose water and cherry stones. It’s crisp, fresh and lightly saline with a medium body. Dry. Sustainable. Drink now. Screw cap.

plantation-5-year-old-amber-rum.title: Plantation 5 Year Old Reserve Amber Rum 1.75L
plantation-5-year-old-amber-rum.bodyHtml:
Plantation 5 Year Old Reserve Amber Rum is a Barbados rum from the Plantation range of Cognac Ferrand, presented here in a large 1.75L bottle at 40% ABV. It is distilled in Barbados and spends three to four years in ex-bourbon barrels on the island before being shipped to France, where it ages for a further one to two years in casks that previously held Ferrand Cognac. This double maturation gives a subtle, tropical Barbadian-style rum that works as an aperitif and in classic cocktails such as the Mai Tai.

Serve: On the rocks, or as the base of a Mai Tai or rum punch.

plantation-barbados-vintage.title: Plantation Planteray Barbados 8 Year Old Single Cask Port Cask Finish Very Special Old Rum
plantation-barbados-vintage.bodyHtml:
Plantation Barbados 8 Year Old Port Cask is a single cask rum from the 2023 Single Cask release, distilled from molasses in 2015 in pot and column stills at West Indies Rum Distillery in Barbados. It aged for five years in bourbon casks in the Caribbean and a year in Ferrand casks in France, then spent two more years in a Port cask. No caramel colouring is added. A limited edition bottled at 47.2% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Plum, strawberry, blueberry, ginger, roasted almond and coffee.

Nose: Fruity and spicy, with nuts, plum, strawberry, blueberry and caramel, moving towards vanilla, mint and banana.

Palate: Warm and spicy, with ginger, cinnamon, roasted almonds, coffee, blackberry and coconut oil.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

plantation-isle-of-fiji.title: Planteray Isle of Fiji Rum
plantation-isle-of-fiji.bodyHtml:
From the pristine lagoons to the lush jungles, Plantation Isle of Fiji is an ode to the beauty ofthe Fiji Islands.

This delicious rum is made using traditional techniques and local Fijian sugar cane. First aged in this tropical climate in bourbon casks, the rum is then sailed to the southwest of France for a second maturation in French oak casks.

This double ageing method paired with Fijian know-how creates a rum with warm notes of exotic fruits and raisin.

TASTING NOTES
Color : Gold.

Nose : Intense, it starts on molasses, pear and varnish. It then becomes fruitier and spicier on apple, banana and gooseberry, also nutmeg and vanilla with a hint of smoke.

Palate : Rich and round, it follows the nose with vanilla fudge, honey, ginger and fruity notes of prune and coconut.

Finish : Very long on dried banana, bourbon and allspice.

Empty glass : Molasses, oak and allspice.

plantation-jamaica-vintage.title: Plantation Planteray Single Cask Jamaica 5 Year Old Ferrand Dry Curacao Finish 47% ABV
plantation-jamaica-vintage.bodyHtml:
The rum is made from molasses at the Lluidas Vale Distillery and ferments for 2 to 3 days before being distilled in pot and column stills. It then matures for 5 years in bourbon barrels (200 l) in the country of origin. At MAISON FERRAND, the rum is given a special finish by being aged for 8 months in Ferrand Dry Curaçao barrels. Ferrand Dry Curaçao is a fine orange liqueur made from cognac, brandy and a distillate of Lahara oranges. (automated translation)

Tasting notes:

Color: Amber.
Nose: Dark berries, candied orange peel, orange zest.
Taste: Orange peel, orange marmalade, chocolate.
Finish: Long lasting. (automated translation)

plantation-o-f-t-d.title: Rum Nation Planteray O.F.T.D. Old Fashioned Traditional Dark Overproof Rum 69% ABV
plantation-o-f-t-d.bodyHtml:
Plantation O.F.T.D. Rum is our take on that classic style of overproof rums. And not just ours: to join him on the quest to get the blend and the proof just right, Alexandre Gabriel scoured rum joints around the world to find six grizzled old salts who knew which end of a rum bottle was which.

Together they came up with this blend of Guyana, Jamaica and Barbados rums, bottled at 69 percent alcohol.

O.F.T.D. officially stands for Old Fashioned Traditional Dark but if you ask any of the seven collaborators who were in the room when this blend was born, they?ll tell you it really stands for something else that was exclaimed when the winning rum was tasted?

plantation-original-dark.title: Planteray Artisanal Rum Gift Box 6 x 100ml
plantation-original-dark.bodyHtml:
The Planteray Artisanal Rum gift box, from the house formerly known as Plantation, gathers six 100ml bottles in a cigar-box style case as an introduction to rum styles and origins from Maison Ferrand's range. The set sold under this barcode holds 3 Stars, a white blend of Barbados, Trinidad and Jamaica rums; Original Dark, a rich Barbados-style rum with plum, banana, cinnamon and clove; Grande Réserve, a double-aged Barbados rum with grilled coconut and woody vanilla; Gran Añejo, a fresh, spicy blend from Guatemala and Belize; Xaymaca Special Dry, a 100% pot still Jamaican rum full of classic funk; and the XO 20th Anniversary, an old Barbados rum with chocolate, ripe banana and mango. Average strength 41.03% ABV, 600ml in total.

Serve: Taste side by side, from the 3 Stars to the XO, neat or with a little water.

plantation-white-rum-1.title: Plantation Planteray 3 Stars Artisanal White Rum
plantation-white-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Planteray 3 Stars is a white rum from Planteray Rum, the house formerly known as Plantation, bottled at 41.2% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The name refers to the three Caribbean origins that go into the blend: Barbados, Jamaica and Trinidad. According to the producer, Barbados brings richness and balance, Trinidad adds finesse and Jamaica gives structure. The blend combines aged and unaged rums made with a range of fermentation and distillation techniques, and the bottle is labelled as a product of Barbados. Planteray positions 3 Stars as a cocktail rum, suggesting it for drinks such as the Mojito and the Daiquiri.

Tasting Notes: Light and fresh, with coconut, guava, vanilla, sugar cane honey and soft spice.

Nose: Dried coconut and guava with a little honey and soft spice.

Palate: A spicy entry, then creamy vanilla custard, sugar cane honey and a hint of agave.

Finish: Floral, with zingy spice.

Serve: In a Mojito or Daiquiri, or over ice.

plantation-xamaca-special-dry.title: Planteray Xaymaca Special Dry Rum
plantation-xamaca-special-dry.bodyHtml:
Planteray Xaymaca Special Dry is a 100% pot still Jamaican rum from Planteray, the brand formerly known as Plantation. It is a blend of rums from two Jamaican distilleries, Long Pond and Clarendon, created to revive the traditional pot still style of the 1800s and the island's famous "rum funk". Long Pond's contribution comes from its old John Dore pot still and Clarendon's from a Vendome pot still. Bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it delivers intense notes of black banana and flambéed pineapple, alongside apricot, cashew, ginger and a hint of coconut. Enjoy it neat or in classic rum cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Black banana, flambéed pineapple, apricot, cashew, ginger and a touch of coconut.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or in a Mai Tai, Daiquiri or Mojito.

poggio-san-polo-brunello-di-montalcino-2.title: San Polo Brunello di Montalcino 2018
poggio-san-polo-brunello-di-montalcino-2.bodyHtml:
The 2018 San Polo Brunello di Montalcino is an elegant and nuanced expression of Sangiovese from a vintage defined by its finesse rather than sheer power. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards on the south-eastern slope of Montalcino, this wine offers a sophisticated bouquet of small red berries, violets, and earthy underbrush, with secondary notes of tobacco and vanilla from oak aging. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied with bright acidity and well-integrated, silky tannins that lead to a persistent and savory finish. This vintage is particularly praised for its approachability and classical balance, making it enjoyable in its youth while possessing the structure to age gracefully.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The primarily earthy, sanguine nose gets some pop from the slightly astringent sweetness of plums. That pleasing dynamism continues on the palate, before eventually giving way to a chocolatey, coffee finish. Grippy yet pliant tannins provide structure, while acid brings the heat.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of sour plums, cherry stones, bark and iodine, with some dried herbs. So fresh, tangy and flavorful, with bright berry fruit and savory moss notes. Fine and integrated tannins. Medium body. All about balance. From organically grown grapes.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A certified organic wine, the 2018 Brunello di Montalcino display a savory character that accompanies the wine from start to finish over the palate and then some. There is a core of black fruit, but the real takeaway is that spicy contour of dark chestnut husk, acacia honey, tilled earth and toasted rosemary that fills the balloon of your glass. This Brunello finishes on a tart note and shows tannins that could use a few extra years to soften

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Shows earthy, barnyard aromas that suggest a little reduction, giving way to plum, cherry, rose, juniper, eucalyptus and iron flavors. Reveals burly tannins that define the finish, which is compact and short. Decant now. Best from 2026 through 2046.

poli-grappa-di-sassicaia-1.title: Poli Grappa di Bolgheri Sassicaia
poli-grappa-di-sassicaia-1.bodyHtml:
Poli Grappa di Bolgheri Sassicaia is a prestigious, majestic, and masterfully crafted aged Italian pomace brandy produced by the historic Poli Distillerie in Schiavon, Veneto, in a celebrated collaboration with the legendary Tuscan estate Tenuta San Guido. This exceptional spirit is crafted using the fresh, highly aromatic grape pomace of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc used to create the world-renowned Super Tuscan wine, Sassicaia. Distilled in small batches using traditional, discontinuously operated copper steam pot stills, the distillate is then aged patiently for 4 years in French oak barriques, followed by a finishing period in the very same oak casks previously used to mature the illustrious Sassicaia wine. The result is an imposing, deeply sophisticated grappa of rare elegance that harmoniously bridges Veneto's distillation lineage with Tuscany's ultimate winemaking royalty.

Food Pairing: The deep, woody spice and structural complexity of this ultra-premium grappa make it an unrivaled companion for luxurious after-dinner treats. It pairs phenomenally with artisanal dark chocolate (70% cocoa or higher), espresso-infused tiramisu, black forest cake, and traditional almond-based cantucci or crunchy hazelnut biscotti. For a compelling savory pairing, it beautifully cuts through the richness of a mature cheese board featuring deeply aged Parmigiano-Reggiano, sharp Pecorino Toscano, or an intense, creamy blue cheese like Gorgonzola Dolce alongside toasted walnuts and dark forest honey.

TASTING NOTES - A brilliant, deep golden-amber with warm copper reflections. The texture is intensely full-bodied, unctuous, and remarkably rounded, coating the mouth in a velvety, structured layer of spirit density and fine wine-wood oiliness.

NOSE - Majestic, deeply complex, and heavily aromatic, opening with a rich, warm basket of toasted hazelnuts, roasted peanuts, and dark cocoa powder, beautifully integrated with elegant notes of bourbon vanilla, black liquorice, star anise, and old cedar wood tannins.

PALATE - Bold, dry, and masterfully balanced. A warming, powerful entry dominated by spicy roasted coffee beans, dark dark chocolate, and warm baking spices is seamlessly met mid-palate by a sophisticated, dry wave of French oak wood, sweet tobacco leaf, and an elegant, velvety red-wine cask structure.

FINISH - Exceptionally long, dry, and deeply comforting. The initial deep coffee and hazelnut notes recede slowly and gracefully, leaving an enduring, highly satisfying trail of warm toasted oak, dry spice, a touch of liquorice, and a long, persistent, aristocratic warmth.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat and allowed to breathe at a relaxed room temperature of 18-20°C (64-68°F) in a traditional tulip-shaped grappa glass or a premium spirits snifter, serving as a magnificent meditation distillate on grand occasions.

poli-marconi-46-gin-1.title: Poli Marconi 46 Gin
poli-marconi-46-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Poli Marconi 46 Gin is an exceptionally elegant, aromatic, and deeply botanical Italian craft gin produced by the historic Poli Distillerie in Schiavon, Veneto. Named both after Guglielmo Marconi—the famous Italian physicist who invented the radiotelegraph—and the specific 46% alcohol volume that carries its structure, this premium gin is distilled in small batches using the distillery's custom-designed Crysopea vacuum copper bain-marie still. It features an exquisite selection of local botanicals inspired by the alpine woodland of the Asiago plateau, including juniper berries, Muscat grape pomace, mountain pine, Swiss pine, mint, cardamom, and coriander. The unique addition of distilled Muscat grape must provides an incredibly silky mouthfeel, balancing the bold, resinous pine and alpine freshness with a refined, uniquely Italian touch of fruit elegance.

Food Pairing: The crisp, resinous pine and bright botanical profile of this gin make it a fantastic companion to light, savory appetizers and coastal dishes. It pairs wonderfully with a seafood platter of raw oysters, smoked salmon carpaccio, or sea bass ceviche. It also serves as a flawless match for salty and herbal bar bites, such as green olives, rosemary-infused focaccia, goat cheese crostini, or a classic Italian caprese salad featuring fresh buffalo mozzarella and basil.

TASTING NOTES - Crystal clear with bright, silvery transparency. The texture is medium-bodied, remarkably smooth, and offers a luxurious, velvety, and slightly oily mouthfeel that completely softens the 46% ABV strength.

NOSE - Intense, clean, and highly aromatic, opening with an upfront wave of fresh balsamic notes, resinous mountain pine, and green juniper, beautifully balanced by sweet herbal tea, wild mint, and a delicate fruity touch of fresh white grapes.

PALATE - Harmonious, crisp, and beautifully structured. A soft, welcoming entry of pine needles and herbal mint transitions into deep, elegant layers of spicy cardamom, dry juniper, and coriander, closely rounded by a subtle, velvety sweetness from the grape base.

FINISH - Long, highly refreshing, and cleanly dry. The initial spice and pine intensity slowly recede, leaving a deeply satisfying, lingering trail of cooling mint, clean alpine wood, and a persistent, dry botanical warmth.

SERVE - Outstanding when served over plenty of high-quality ice with a premium tonic water in a large balloon glass, garnished with a fresh slice of lemon or a sprig of mint. Its pristine structure and smooth texture also make it an extraordinary, ultra-premium foundation for a classic dry Martini.

poli-sarpa-1.title: Poli Sarpa di Poli Grappa
poli-sarpa-1.bodyHtml:
Poli Sarpa di Poli Grappa is a historic, robust, and beautifully rustic Italian pomace brandy produced by the iconic Poli Distillerie in Schiavon, Veneto. Introduced in 1989 by Jacopo Poli, "Sarpa" means "grape pomace" in the local Venetian dialect, capturing the true traditional soul of old-school grappa. It is masterfully crafted from a balanced blend of fresh, aromatic pomace from Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot grapes harvested across the rolling hills of the Veneto region. Distilled in small batches using the family's historic, discontinuously operated copper steam pot stills, this clear spirit remains completely unaged to focus entirely on pure varietal expression. It delivers a deeply authentic flavor profile that expertly bridges intense herbaceous structures with a clean, timeless elegance.

Food Pairing: This highly structured, traditional red-grape grappa acts as a brilliant digestif alongside rich, savory Italian dishes and hearty snacks. It pairs exceptionally well with aged cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano, sharp Pecorino, or Asiago Stravecchio. It also matches perfectly with dry cured meats like prosciutto or bresaola, and stands up beautifully next to dark, bittersweet chocolate, espresso-infused biscotti, or traditional fruit-and-nut panettone.

TASTING NOTES - Crystal clear with brilliant, watery-silver transparency. The texture is medium-to-full-bodied, pleasantly robust, and coats the palate with a clean, solid structure and an authentic, rustic warmth.

NOSE - Forward, fresh, and proudly varietal, opening with a rustic bouquet of freshly pressed red grapes, crushed vine leaves, and cut grass, beautifully supported by elegant undertones of red currants, green bell pepper, and a touch of wild geranium flowers.

PALATE - Clean, frank, and beautifully balanced. A dry, powerful entry driven by intense notes of fresh grape must and dark berries is immediately balanced mid-palate by a sophisticated herbaceous grip, subtle notes of black pepper, and a solid, traditional grape-skin oiliness.

FINISH - Long, dry, and highly refreshing. The robust red fruit and green herbaceous notes recede slowly and gracefully, leaving a deeply satisfying trail of dry spice, grape skins, and a comforting, persistent warmth.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat at a cellar temperature of roughly 10-15°C (50-59°F) in a traditional tulip-shaped grappa glass or a small spirits snifter, allowing the liquid to sit and breathe for a moment to fully release its complex red-grape aromatics.

port-askaig-100-proof-57-10.title: Port Askaig 100 Proof Islay Single Malt
port-askaig-100-proof-57-10.bodyHtml:
Port Askaig 100 Proof Islay Single Malt is a robust, cask-strength single malt Scotch whisky created by the independent bottler Elixir Distillers. Named after the historic port village on the east coast of Islay, this expression is bottled at the traditional British 100° proof (57.1% ABV). Sourced from an undisclosed Islay distillery (widely recognized by enthusiasts and industry experts as Caol Ila) and matured primarily in first-fill ex-bourbon casks, it is bottled without chill-filtration or added color, offering a potent balance of maritime peat smoke, crisp fruit, and vibrant minerality.

Food Pairing: Freshly shucked oysters, smoked salmon, charred ribeye steak, grilled calamari in chili oil, or strong goat cheese.

Tasting Notes : Pale gold to light straw in appearance with an oily, full-bodied, and robustly warming mouthfeel.

Nose : Dry and earthy peat smoke, maritime sea breeze, bright lemon and lime citrus, sweet vanilla, and subtle medicinal notes with a hint of toasted almond.

Palate : Intense and warming with layers of sweet barley malt, crisp green apple, zesty citrus peel, cracked black pepper, robust wood smoke, and maritime brine.

Finish : Long, smoky, and warming with lingering campfire ash, salted caramel, sweet vanilla, and a touch of peppery spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of water to temper the high proof and open up the fruity and floral aromas.

prairie-organic-gin-1.title: Prairie Organic Gin
prairie-organic-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Prairie Organic Gin is a farm-crafted organic gin from Prairie Organic Spirits, a Minnesota brand made in the American Midwest. It is an easygoing, approachable gin that layers fresh aromatic herbs with sage, juniper and exotic spices, giving a refreshing taste and a gently balanced, long and delicate finish. Its soft, herbal profile makes it a versatile choice for a simple gin and tonic or classic cocktails. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Fresh herbs, sage and juniper with exotic spice; refreshing, with a long, delicate finish.

Serve: With tonic and a sprig of fresh herbs over ice, or in classic gin cocktails.

proper-no-twelve.title: Proper No. Twelve Irish Whiskey
proper-no-twelve.bodyHtml:
Proper No. Twelve™ Irish Whiskey is a triple-distilled blend of fine grain and single malt that is bourbon-barrel-aged for 4 years. The spirit is unbelievably smooth with notes of vanilla, honey and toasted wood. It is friendly, straightforward and is best enjoyed with ginger ale or on the rocks. (40% ABV – 80 proof) • The whiskey pays tribute to founder, Conor McGregor, and his neighborhood of Crumlin, Dublin 12. It embodies their spirit of brotherhood, loyalty, and hard work.

Color: Clear golden liquid
Aroma: Baked apple with a touch of honey and notes of sweet ripe berries
Flavor: Smooth and approachable with vanilla, honey and toasted wood
Finish: Warming creamy toffee notes

puni-alba.title: Puni Alba Italian Whisky
puni-alba.bodyHtml: ALBA – the Italian word for dawn, as well as the Scottish Gaelic name for Scotland – is matured for three years in the finest Marsala casks from Sicily and finished in handselected casks from the Isle of Islay. This whisky is a harmonious combination of the rich & fruity flavours of Italy and the distinctive smoky character of the Scottish island.

puni-nova.title: Puni Nova Italian Whisky
puni-nova.bodyHtml: This Puni NOVA Italian Single Malt whisky comes from the only whisky distillery in Italy. Since Italy is a grappa-producing country and not a region of Scottish whisky, the Puni distillery has repatriated many tips and traditions from Scotland - as has its traditional copper still. After a long period of experimentation, the first two Puni Single Malts were presented to the public: Nova and Alba. "Alba" not only means "sunrise" in Italian, but also means "Scotland" in Gaelic. The Puni distillery, named after the nearby river, is located in the mountains of South Tyrol. The raw materials that cause whisky, including barley, rye, and wheat, come from local farms. The Nova is distilled with clear spring water from the mountain and is partially aged in old bunkers dating from the Second World War. After a maturity of three years in old American bourbon casks, the whisky matures a few more weeks in old Limousin oak barrels. Thus, Puni Nova has not only the sweet and smoky notes of bourbon, but also the woody notes of European oak. Bottled in bottles created by Italian designer Christian Zanzotti, the two Puni whisky variants have received several awards.

pyrat-xo-reserve.title: Pyrat X.O. Reserve Rum
pyrat-xo-reserve.bodyHtml:
The bottle based on the design of those kept by ship's captains and pirate during the 19th Century. The rums in this blend are aged as much as fifteen years in American oak and French Limousin barrels.

A real connoisseur's rum, with a sublimely orangey, spicy flavour and nuanced finish.

Nose: Very citrussy. So much orange peel. Icing sugar, waves of fruit.

Palate: Sweet, viscous, more orange. Marmalade.

Finish: Molasses, orange peels, marmalade, spice.

Overall: Like an incredible rum old-fashioned.

quails-gate-gewurtztraminer.title: Quails' Gate Gewurztraminer 750ml
quails-gate-gewurtztraminer.bodyHtml: Quails' Gate Gewurztraminer is a 750ml bottle of white wine made from the Gewurztraminer grape variety. It's known for its aromatic characteristics, often featuring notes of lychee, rose petals, and spice, with a slightly off-dry sweetness. The wine is typically light to medium-bodied, making it a versatile pairing with a variety of foods, including Asian cuisine, roasted chicken, and even some less-sweet desserts.

quails-gate-merlot-1.title: Quails Gate Queue 2021 750ml
quails-gate-merlot-1.bodyHtml:
Our Upper Boucherie bench vineyard is a southern exposure site featuring volcanic soils rich in mineral deposits. It is one of the few sites in the Kelowna area that ripens blocks of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Syrah. Queue not only captures the essence of these blocks, but it is also derived from the Latin word cõda which in music, is an arrangement that punctuates the end of a symphony. Queue - the winemaker’s composition.

Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Syrah were hand-picked from the finest parcels on our estate. The grapes were then gently destemmed and transferred to stainless steel tanks for fermentation. Each block was fermented separately and spent between 8-14 days on the skins to develop deep, rich colour. Aged for 18 months in 30% new French oak and 70% neutral French oak before being meticulously blended.

This smooth, rich blend stands up to the most flavourful forces. Our 2021 Queue carries forward an open and expansive bouquet full of blueberry, cocoa and violet.

On the palate, rich waves of black pepper and inescapably supple tannins interlace throughout. The long finish builds gradually with equal measures of strength and elegance.

This bold blend pairs perfectly with flavourful and juicy barbecued meats. Try brisket, spiced European sausages or charred bell peppers topped with blue cheese. Perfect for sharing with friends and family.

quilt-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-201.title: Quilt Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
quilt-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-201.bodyHtml:
Quilt Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a rich, opulent, and deeply concentrated red wine crafted by fifth-generation winemaker Joe Wagner of the famed Wagner family. Inspired by the patchwork of prime vineyards spanning the region, the fruit is meticulously sourced from up to nine distinct, iconic AVAs across the Napa Valley—including Calistoga, Oakville, St. Helena, and Howell Mountain. This blending strategy yields exceptional complexity and structural balance. In the glass, it displays a dark ruby-red color with deep purple edges. The highly expressive nose opens with enticing aromas of cocoa, blackcurrant, dark cherry, and wild blackberries, beautifully supported by hints of warm baking spices, cigar leaf, and toasted oak. On the palate, this full-bodied Cabernet is velvety, luscious, and highly concentrated. It delivers layers of blackberry pie, plum, and espresso, framed by firm yet velvety tannins, and balanced by a bright, vibrant acidity that extends into a long, polished, and sweet-toned finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled ribeye steaks, slow-cooked beef short ribs, roasted rosemary lamb, or rich wild mushroom risotto.

92 Points - James Suckling

Black currants, cedar, licorice, cured meat, spices and crushed stones. The palate is full-bodied with firmly framed tannins, bright acidity and a luscious, polished yet balanced finish. Excellent, showing a sense of class.

quilt-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-res.title: Quilt Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
quilt-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-res.bodyHtml:
Quilt Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a rich, opulent, and deeply concentrated red wine crafted by fifth-generation winemaker Joe Wagner of the famed Wagner family. Inspired by the patchwork of prime vineyards spanning the region, the fruit is meticulously sourced from up to nine distinct, iconic AVAs across the Napa Valley—including Calistoga, Oakville, St. Helena, and Howell Mountain. This blending strategy yields exceptional complexity and structural balance. In the glass, it displays a dark ruby-red color with deep purple edges. The highly expressive nose opens with enticing aromas of cocoa, blackcurrant, dark cherry, and wild blackberries, beautifully supported by hints of warm baking spices, cigar leaf, and toasted oak. On the palate, this full-bodied Cabernet is velvety, luscious, and highly concentrated. It delivers layers of blackberry pie, plum, and espresso, framed by firm yet velvety tannins, and balanced by a bright, vibrant acidity that extends into a long, polished, and sweet-toned finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled ribeye steaks, slow-cooked beef short ribs, roasted rosemary lamb, or rich wild mushroom risotto.

92 Points - James Suckling

Black currants, cedar, licorice, cured meat, spices and crushed stones. The palate is full-bodied with firmly framed tannins, bright acidity and a luscious, polished yet balanced finish. Excellent, showing a sense of class.

rampur-indian-single-malt-1.title: Rampur Asava Indian Single Malt Whisky
rampur-indian-single-malt-1.bodyHtml:
Rampur Asava Indian Single Malt Whisky is a single malt whisky produced at Radico Khaitan's Rampur Distillery situated in the foothills of the Himalayas in Uttar Pradesh, India. Matured initially in American ex-bourbon barrels and finished in casks that previously held Indian Cabernet Sauvignon wine, this non-chill filtered expression harmonizes Rampur's signature tropical fruit and malt character with the subtle tannins and rich fruitiness of Indian red wine.

Food Pairing: Tandoori chicken, grilled lamb chops, spicy Indian curries, roasted duck, aged cheddar, dark chocolate desserts, and dried fruit tarts.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant golden amber with copper hues, featuring a velvety, smooth, and medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Typical tropical fruit aromas of Rampur layered with apricot, blackberry, and plum, followed by a subtle hint of tobacco and warming spices.

Palate : Velvety and balanced with manuka honey sweetness, spicy oak, vanilla, and the structured dryness of Indian red wine.

Finish : Medium-to-long, lingering with warm spice, soft oak, sweet honey, and lingering wine tannins.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature, or with a few drops of pure water to release the layered tropical and red wine aromas.

red-rooster-cabernet-merlot-1.title: Red Rooster Cabernet Merlot 2023
red-rooster-cabernet-merlot-1.bodyHtml:
Red Rooster Cabernet Merlot 2023 is a beautifully balanced, full-bodied, and robust Canadian red wine blend originating from the sun-drenched vineyards of British Columbia's South Okanagan Valley. A classic blend of Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot, it undergoes precise tank fermentation before aging for 12 to 14 months in a combination of stainless steel and oak barrels. It displays a deep, enticing garnet hue in the glass, releasing an aromatic bouquet of ripe blue plum, black currant, and dark cherry seamlessly layered with nuances of tobacco leaf, sweet spice, and smoky oak. On the palate, this extra-dry red offers a smooth yet structured mouthfeel with soft, drying tannins and a concentrated core of juicy black fruits, cocoa powder, and subtle baking spice that lingers elegantly on the finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled steak, roasted lamb shank, hearty beef stews, barbecue ribs, and aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

redbreast-12-year-old.title: Redbreast 12 Year Old Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
redbreast-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Redbreast 12 Year Old Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey is a flagship expression produced at Midleton Distillery in County Cork, Ireland. Crafted from a combination of malted and unmalted barley, it is triple distilled in traditional copper pot stills and aged for at least 12 years in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-Oloroso sherry casks. This process produces a rich, complex, and full-flavored Irish whiskey with notes of dried fruit, toasted wood, and warm pot still spice.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork belly, aged cheddar cheese, dark chocolate tarts, braised lamb chops, and dried fruit platters.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber gold in appearance with a rich, silky, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Complex and aromatic with notes of fruit, toasted wood, sweet cream, and subtle pot still spice.

Palate : Full-flavored and complex with layers of sweet dried fruit, toasted oak, sultanas, spices, and a creamy texture.

Finish : Satisfyingly long, warm, and lingering with notes of spices and sherry sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn or whiskey tumbler glass, or with a splash of spring water.

remy-martin-xo-extra-old-excellence.title: Remy Martin XO Cognac
remy-martin-xo-extra-old-excellence.bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin XO Cognac is an opulent and exceptionally complex Fine Champagne Cognac, blended from up to 400 different eaux-de-vie aged between 10 and 37 years. It showcases the ultimate signature of the house, delivering an incredibly rich, velvet-smooth texture with notes of late summer fruits and warm spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with dark chocolate desserts, aged cheeses like Parmesan or Gouda, or a rich foie gras.

Tasting Notes : Luminous mahogany with fiery amber hues, featuring a velvety, rich, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Extremely complex and floral, opening with aromas of jasmine, candied orange, juicy plum, dried figs, hazelnut, freshly grated cinnamon, and warm brioche.

Palate : Velvety and opulent, delivering abundant layers of ripe passion fruit, dark berries, and candied peel balanced by sweet spices, oak tannins, and honeyed nuts.

Finish : Exceptionally long, smooth, and elegant, leaving a persistent warmth filled with notes of sweet spice, dark chocolate, and toasted oak.

Serve : Serve neat or over a single large ice cube in a tulip glass or classic snifter at room temperature to allow its full aromatic bouquet to bloom.

res-fortes-cote-du-roussilon-rose.title: Res Fortes Rose 2023/2024
res-fortes-cote-du-roussilon-rose.bodyHtml:
The Res Fortes Rosé is an elegant, highly expressive, and beautifully balanced French rosé crafted from old vines by winemaker Moritz Bak in the foothills of the Pyrenees. Produced from whole-bunch pressed grapes to ensure pristine flavor clarity, this premium, dry rosé is often celebrated as a fantastic, character-filled alternative to traditional Provence styles. It pours a clear, pale salmon or coppery-pink hue in the glass, immediately releasing a fresh and vivid bouquet of wild strawberries, white peach, raspberries, and rhubarb, intermingled with delicate notes of white blossom, tangerine rind, and a touch of sea breeze. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, round, and fruit-forward, delivering a juicy and flavorful expression of tart red currants, stone fruits, and pomegranate. Driven by a mouth-watering, crisp mineral acidity, it substantiates a surprising structural depth before subsiding into a clean, remarkably refreshing finish highlighted by lingering citrus zest and a subtle, texturing grip.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of fresh dishes, including goat cheese salad, smoked salmon, oysters, seared scallops, crab legs, grilled pork loin, barbecued chicken, or light summer pasta salads.

2023 Vintage Rating:

90 Points - James Suckling

A fresh and vivid rosé with wild currants, frozen berries and hints of apricot yogurt. It’s medium-bodied with a juicy and flavorful expression on the mid-palate. Fresh acidity brings vitality in the finish. Drink now.

revel-stoke-peanut-butter-whisky-1.title: Revel Stoke Nut Crusher Peanut Butter Whisky
revel-stoke-peanut-butter-whisky-1.bodyHtml:
Revel Stoke Nut Crusher is a peanut butter flavoured Canadian whisky, bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It pairs buttery, nutty peanut butter notes with the mild spice of Canadian whisky, and the brand pitches it with a nod to the classic peanut butter and jelly combination. Light in strength and sweet in style, it is made for easy shots and simple mixed drinks rather than serious sipping.

Tasting Notes: Buttery, nutty peanut butter with mild whisky spice.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, over ice, or with a mixer.

rochfort-coriole-white-port.title: Rochfort Coriole White Port Whisky
rochfort-coriole-white-port.bodyHtml:
The Truth Malters team visited the ROCHFORT Distillery in South Australia in 2019 and after trying many fantastic single malts straight from the cask in the warehouse, this is the one that was chosen to be our official launch of ROCHFORT in Canada and our next bottle in our Chapter Series. To learn more about the history of the cask and process used please read below, these quotes and notes are from the Master Blender himself.

We have hand selected a local South Australian Export Pilsner Malt which produces a rich honey coloured appearance and a highly sweet, yet smooth spirit.

Using traditional methods of production, we pay attention to the temperature of the water whilst “mashing in”. The key is to make sure the grain doesn’t overheat, whilst maintaining the optimal temperature for starch conversion to sugars. We ferment in open top French oak fermenters for a five-day period before distilling through our custom fabricated copper wash still. A run through our custom designed copper spirit still on day seven finalizes refinement of the new make spirit.

Winery Partner

Coriole was founded by Hugh and Molly Lloyd in 1967. In 1969, the first Coriole wine was released and half a century later, the Lloyd family continues to produce wines in McLaren Vale using the same vines.

Barrel Selection - “Coriole White Port Cask”

A remarkable timepiece displaying the history and flavours of maturation over the generations. Over 100 years old and being passed through several families, this fortified cask was taken on by the Lloyd family in 1967 and was nurtured over the remaining decades. One of the most spectacular casks we’ve had the pleasure to work with over the years, its intensity of character and depth are astonishing.

TASTING NOTES:

Color: Dark Mahogany Wood

Nose:
You are immediately greeted with a malty sweetness of vanilla and dark roasted fruits, hints of spices, cinnamon and dark chocolate sprinkled over a floral basket arrangement.

Palate:
A beautiful balanced tingle of sweet and spices on the front palate slowly fading away to a thick butterscotch and cocoa taste. Then you are hit with a perfectly balanced mix of buttery oils and malt biscuits. In the background you can pick out a lot of notes that bounce in and out to add to this complex taste profile such as roasted smoky barley, hazelnut, honey and hints of cigar box and spices but that sweet white port dark taste stays throughout.

Finish:
The way this one coats your complete palate from top to bottom is fantastic. A special Single Malt that is complex and full of flavors to enjoy yet is in no way overwhelming, you would never guess this comes in at 65.1%, as it is just too smooth. You can feel your taste buds bursting with sweetness and spices while the malt biscuit taste leaves you licking your chops for one more sip. This is a great Single Malt Whisky that we are happy to introduce as our Chapter 4, as it states on the bottle, “The TRUTH is… Whisky matured with the history of a century-old cask writes its own chapter.”

rodney-strong-alexander-valley-cabernet-.title: Rodney Strong Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020/2021 750ml
rodney-strong-alexander-valley-cabernet-.bodyHtml:
Aromas of lush, red plum and dark berries with hints of cassis and milk chocolate. Dried fig and chewy tannins give this wine a strong backbone, while 24 months of barrel aging have softened this bold wine

92 Points Wine Enthusiast
Strength comes with finesse in this beautifully molded wine that wraps silky tannins around nicely ripe black cherries, blackberries and mint. The feel is lush yet balanced

rodney-strong-knotty-vines-zinfandel.title: Rodney Strong Old Vines Zinfandel 2019
rodney-strong-knotty-vines-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Rodney Strong Old Vines Zinfandel 2019 is a rich, expressive California wine crafted from low-yielding, historic Sonoma County vines. It opens with captivating aromas of ripe blackberry, dark plum, jammy raspberry, and crushed black pepper, complemented by subtle nuances of warm vanilla, cocoa, and toasted French oak. On the palate, this full-bodied Zinfandel offers a plush, supple texture framed by rounded tannins and vibrant fruit concentration, leading to a long, satisfyingly spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with barbecued baby back ribs, pulled pork sandwiches, grilled chicken pizza, braised short ribs, or aged hard Italian cheeses.

rodney-strong-sonoma-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
rodney-strong-sonoma-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, velvety, and highly approachable Californian red wine that beautifully showcases the diverse, premium terroirs of Sonoma County. Fermented in stainless steel tanks and aged for 16 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels, this vintage delivers an expressive, forward profile. In the glass, it reveals a deep ruby-red color with bright clarity. The highly aromatic nose opens with inviting scents of dark cherry, ripe plum, and baking spices, complexly layered with nuanced undercurrents of black pepper, crushed violets, cassis, and a hint of sweet cocoa. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and wonderfully lush, displaying a seamless fluid coherence where its core of juicy blackberry and dark forest fruits is effortlessly framed by supple, medium tannins and a balanced spine of natural acidity. Lingering spicy oak details and a touch of milk chocolate carry through to a smooth, velvety finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with a wood-fired grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, savory grilled winter vegetables, or aged extra-sharp cheddar cheese.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of spiced plum compote, dark chocolate, mint, and cinnamon drive the nose of this fresh and lively Cabernet. The palate feels nimble, with flavors of cherry gastrique, concentrated raspberry, black pepper, and licorice resonating along the finish.

roku-gin-1.title: Roku Japanese Craft Gin
roku-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Roku Japanese Craft Gin is the first gin released by Suntory, a company that has been distilling gin since 1936; Roku itself was introduced in 2017. Roku means six in Japanese, a reference to the six Japanese botanicals at its heart: sakura flower and sakura leaf for spring, sencha and gyokuro tea for summer, sansho pepper for autumn and yuzu peel for winter. They are combined with eight traditional gin botanicals, among them juniper, orange and lemon peel, coriander and cinnamon. The faceted bottle is embossed with the botanicals, and its label carries the kanji for six. This listing is the 750ml bottle at 43% ABV.

Nose: Cherry blossom and green tea; floral and sweet.

Palate: Layered yet harmonious: a traditional gin base carrying the Japanese botanicals, with yuzu on top and a smooth, silky texture.

Finish: Crisp, with a gentle spice from sansho pepper.

Serve: Over ice with tonic water.

rombauer-carneros-chardonnay-2019.title: Rombauer Chardonnay 2024
rombauer-carneros-chardonnay-2019.bodyHtml:
Rombauer Chardonnay 2024 is a lush, opulent, and iconic California white wine crafted by Rombauer Vineyards. Sourced primarily from sustainably farmed vineyards in the cool, fog-shrouded Carneros region—where marine breezes from San Pablo Bay preserve bright natural acidity—the grapes were gently whole-cluster pressed and fermented in French oak barrels. Following fermentation, the wine underwent full malolactic fermentation and aged for nine months on its lees with regular stirring (bâtonnage) in new and used French oak, imparting its signature creamy texture and decadent barrel spice. In the glass, it displays a luminous pale yellow hue with shimmering green-gold highlights. The aromatic profile opens with expressive notes of ripe yellow peach, melon, and Meyer lemon zest layered with vanilla bean, toasted oak, and subtle baking spice. On the palate, it delivers a rich, full-bodied mouthfeel balanced by crisp citrus acidity, culminating in a long, smooth, and buttery finish.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy fettuccine Alfredo, or mild triple-cream Brie cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Classic in every sense, with freshness and purity underneath the generosity and richness this wine is known for. Cookies, pastry and sweet spices alongside ripe orchard fruit, apples and vanilla. The textural palate shows bright acidity and lovely balance, with saline notes and preserved lemons. Consistent and well-made. Drink or hold.

roscato-rosso.title: Cavit Roscato Rosso Dolce Sweet Red
roscato-rosso.bodyHtml:
Cavit Roscato Rosso Dolce Sweet Red is an incredibly charming, vibrant, and beautifully balanced Italian sweet red wine that stands as a modern benchmark for the accessible, refreshing frizzante style. Crafted by the esteemed Cavit winemaking consortium, this highly popular expression is expertly sourced from select vineyards within Northern Italy's Provincia di Pavia in Lombardy. It combines native northern Italian grape varieties—Croatina, Teroldego, and Lagrein—each vinified with brief skin contact to achieve its brilliant hue, before cold-fermentation is halted to preserve its signature natural sugars and gentle, low-alcohol effervescence. In the glass, it reveals a bright, luminous ruby-red color with lively purple reflections and a delicate, frothy rim. The highly expressive nose opens with intense, inviting scents of muddled blackberries, wild strawberries, and ripe red cherries, layered with subtle undertones of fresh red currants and a light, playful hint of red licorice. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, juicy, and delightfully effervescent, showcasing a seamless, fruit-driven fluid coherence. Its lush core of rich berry sweetness is masterfully counterbalanced by a crisp spine of natural acidity and soft, practically imperceptible tannins that leave the mouth feeling completely clean rather than heavy, concluding with a soft, long, and highly refreshing finish that tapers gracefully.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with spicy Buffalo wings, rich chocolate torte, fresh mixed berry desserts, or mild creamy cheeses like Brie.

rosebank-30-year-old-release-1.title: Rosebank 30 Year Old
rosebank-30-year-old-release-1.bodyHtml:
A 30 year old single malt from the Rosebank Distillery, which was distilled in 1990 (three years before it closed) and matured until 2020. It was aged in 62% refill sherry butts and 38% refill bourbon hogsheads, and has been bottled up at 48.6% ABV. Though the distillery shut its doors many moons ago, Rosebank is being revived, which is incredibly exciting indeed, and bottlings like this only build the excitement!

Only 4,350 bottles are available worldwide, with only 40 coming to Canada.

Tasting Note

Soft and creamy on the nose, with layers of caramel wafer, vanilla and nutmeg. Delicate and crisp on the palate with a wonderful balance of gentle syrup, pear and pleasing oak spice. A lingering finish of candied violets, orange and faint mint. Triple distilled and un-chillfiltered with an ABV of 48.6%

royal-brackla-12-year-old-1.title: Royal Brackla 12 Year Old
royal-brackla-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Royal Brackla 12 Year Old is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky produced at the historic Royal Brackla Distillery near Nairn. Known as "The King's Own Whisky" after receiving the first Royal Warrant granted to a Scotch whisky distillery by King William IV in 1833, the distillery is celebrated for its clean, ester-rich, and floral character achieved through tall stills and slow distillation. Reimagined under the direction of Master Blender Stephanie Macleod, this expression is matured in ex-bourbon American oak casks and finished in first-fill Oloroso sherry casks, creating an opulent profile of ripe fruit, creamy malt, and warm spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with roasted pork loin with apple chutney, seared duck breast, charcuterie boards featuring serrano ham and mature cheddar, spiced fruit tarts, and dark chocolate covered almonds.

Tasting Notes : Warm golden amber with bright polished copper reflections, showcasing a medium body with a rich, silky, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Ripe orchard fruits, baked apples, sultanas, vanilla cream, sweet orange peel, and toasted oak.

Palate : Rich and smooth with flavors of stewed dark plums, honeyed malt, dark cherries, brown sugar, cinnamon, and subtle Oloroso sherry tannins.

Finish : Medium to long, warm and gently spicy with lingering notes of dried fruits, cocoa, and seasoned oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, over a large ice sphere, or with a few drops of water to open the orchard fruit and floral aromas.

royal-brackla-16-year-old-1.title: Royal Brackla 25 Year Old
royal-brackla-16-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Royal Brackla 25 Year Old is the showstopping pinnacle of the distillery’s core range, earning its historical moniker as "The King's Own Whisky" (having been the first Scotch distillery granted a Royal Warrant by King William IV in 1833). Matured for a quarter of a century in first-fill American oak ex-bourbon barrels, this exceptionally refined Highland single malt undergoes a final, luxurious finishing period in Pedro Ximénez (PX) sherry casks. Bottled at a deliberate 46% ABV without chill-filtration or added coloring, it delivers a deeply opulent, velvet-textured dram characterized by profound layers of dark chocolate, rich dried fruits, and sophisticated oak spice.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, sticky toffee pudding, classic tiramisu, roasted nuts, aged gouda, or a premium maduro cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep, natural copper-amber in appearance with a thick, velvety, and endlessly smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Decadent and opulent, bursting with luscious summer fruits layered over spiced raisins, sun-dried figs, melted milk chocolate, freshly ground coffee, and toasted almonds.

Palate : Serene, smooth, and deeply complex. A luxurious foundation of creamy vanilla and honeyed oak from the bourbon barrels is elevated by profound PX sherry notes of sticky toffee, dark chocolate, ripe figs, sultanas, and gentle baking spice.

Finish : Long, warming, and exceptionally elegant, leaving a lasting impression of rich dark chocolate, roasted coffee beans, dark dried fruits, and gentle, lingering wood spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter. Allow it to rest for at least 15-20 minutes in the glass to let its 25 years of maturation and rich sherry-cask finishing fully open up and express their complex aromatics.

royal-canadian-small-batch.title: Crown Royal Canadian Whisky 1.75L
royal-canadian-small-batch.bodyHtml:
Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky is the legendary flagship expression that set the standard for Canadian whisky. Originally crafted in 1939 to celebrate the first grand tour of Canada by King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, it is meticulously blended from over 50 distinct whiskies. Aged to perfection in oak barrels, it delivers a remarkably smooth, approachable, and consistently rich flavor profile that has made it a staple in bars and homes worldwide.

Food Pairing: This versatile whisky pairs beautifully with savory, slightly sweet dishes like smoked pulled pork, BBQ chicken, or maple-glazed salmon. For dessert or cheese boards, serve it alongside aged cheddar or milk chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-gold in appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich and robust with dominant aromas of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, subtle floral notes, and gentle oak.

Palate : Delicately smooth and creamy featuring flavors of cooked fruit, caramel, vanilla, and light toasted oak spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and lingering with gentle warm oak and sweet spice notes.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as the base in classic whisky cocktails.

royal-challenge-whisky.title: Royal Challenge Indian Whisky
royal-challenge-whisky.bodyHtml:
For close to 30 years, Royal Challenge has been one of the largest selling premium whisky brand in India. Apart from the deep and intensely smooth blend of scotch and premium Indian grains in Royal Challenge whisky, American charred oak casks are used for ageing, during which it gains color and flavor from the caramelized sugars in the charred wood and infuses the whiskey with a unique taste.
The brand has recently refreshed its image by contemporizing the Royal Challenge emblem of the Lion and Roundel and embedded the new packaging with markers of aspiration and hence the new Black & Red clutter breaking look is more distinctive, premium, masculine and bold.

royal-reserve-whisky-5.title: Royal Reserve 200ml
royal-reserve-whisky-5.bodyHtml:
Royal Reserve is a classic, value-driven Canadian rye whisky with roots dating back to the cocktail heyday of the 1960s and 70s. Produced by Corby Spirit and Wine at the historic Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, this quintessential mixing whisky is celebrated for its light, smooth, and highly approachable profile. Blended to achieve subtle elegance rather than overpowering heat, it balances sweet grain and toffee notes with a distinctly crisp, brittle Canadian rye character, making it a reliable staple for both casual sipping and traditional highballs.

Food Pairing: Grilled sausages, mild cheddar cheese, roasted salted mixed nuts, classic pub fare, and caramel-heavy desserts like butter tarts or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes: Light golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied, and slightly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose: Gentle and subtly complex, opening with mild aromas of sweet honey, vanilla, and caramel, followed by dusty rye grain, toasted almond, and a faint hint of clove and mild baking spice.

Palate: Smooth, light, and highly approachable. It begins with sweet notes of corn, toffee, and caramelized sugar, which are gracefully balanced by a contrasting, zippy bite of peppery rye spice and a touch of crisp lemon zest.

Finish: Clean, warm, and of medium length, fading gently from zesty rye spice to a lingering, soft vanilla and mild toasted oak sweetness.

Serve: Serve neat or over ice as an easy-drinking sipper, or mix it in classic Canadian whisky highballs like a Rye and Ginger (with ginger ale) or a classic Whisky Sour.

rumchata-limon-liquor.title: RumChata Cream Liqueur
rumchata-limon-liquor.bodyHtml:
RumChata is a cream liqueur inspired by horchata, the cinnamon-scented drink of Spain and Latin America; its label sums it up as "Horchata con Ron". It blends Caribbean rum with real dairy cream and is flavoured with sweet vanilla and warm cinnamon, giving a smooth, creamy sip. The liqueur is made in Wisconsin and bottled at 13.75% ABV in the brand's white 750ml bottle with a gold cap. Its versatility is a big part of its appeal: it can be enjoyed chilled as a shot, poured over ice, stirred into coffee in place of creamer or used in sweet, dessert-style cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Milky white, rich and full.

Nose: Spice, ginger, toast and vanilla.

Palate: Creamy and sweet, with honeycomb and spiced flavours.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, on the rocks, in coffee or in cocktails.

rumchata-peppermint-bark.title: Rumchata Peppermint Bark
rumchata-peppermint-bark.bodyHtml:
RumChata Peppermint Bark Cream Liqueur blends Caribbean rum and real dairy cream with a cool snap of peppermint and rich white and dark chocolate, for a creamy, dessert-like finish. A seasonal favourite, it is bottled at 14% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Over ice, poured over hot chocolate and topped with whipped cream and crushed peppermint, or shaken into a Peppermint Bark Espresso Martini with vanilla vodka and cold brew.

saffron-gin-boudier-1.title: Gabriel Boudier Saffron Gin
saffron-gin-boudier-1.bodyHtml:
Gabriel Boudier Saffron Gin is a distinctive French gin from the family-owned house of Gabriel Boudier in Dijon, Burgundy. The recipe was rediscovered in the Boudier archives and dates back to the era of French and English trading posts in India. Seven botanicals (juniper, coriander, lemon peel, orange peel, angelica, iris and fennel) are distilled together in the family's copper still, and the resulting botanical distillate is blended with an infusion of genuine saffron threads, bringing the total to eight botanicals. Saffron gives the gin its deep coppery-orange colour and a gentle spice that plays against the bitterness of juniper. It is reduced to 40% ABV and bottled in 700ml.

Tasting Notes: Deep coppery orange, smooth and finely spiced.

Nose: Juniper, fennel and citrus.

Palate: Distinctive and smooth, with fine spice and a slightly woody juniper note.

Finish: Very persistent.

Serve: As a Saffron Gin and Tonic over ice, or as a base for gin cocktails.

sandhill-cabernet-merlot-1.title: Sandhill Cabernet Merlot 2022
sandhill-cabernet-merlot-1.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Sandhill Cabernet Merlot is an approachable, smooth, and beautifully balanced Canadian red wine that showcases the distinct fruit-forward profile of the Okanagan Valley. It displays a deep ruby-red hue in the glass, lifting with an expressive bouquet of ripe blackberry, dark plum, and black currant, layered with delicate undertones of sagebrush, dried herbs, tobacco leaf, and subtle cedar. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied blend is fruit-forward and structured, offering juicy flavours of black cherry, dark chocolate, and a hint of warm vanilla. Supported by soft, integrated tannins and a gentle food-friendly acidity, it glides into a clean, smooth finish highlighted by lingering notes of black tea and sweet baking spices.


Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, barbecued burgers, hearty beef stews, tomato-based pasta dishes, and semi-hard cheeses like aged Canadian cheddar or gouda.

sangsters-jamaican-rum-cream.title: Sangster's Jamaica Rum Cream
sangsters-jamaican-rum-cream.bodyHtml:
Sangster’s Jamaica Rum Cream is a cream liqueur from Jamaica, the island that supplies its rum. It blends premium aged Jamaican rum with rich cream and adds a light touch of exotic Jamaican fruits and spices. It is bottled at 15% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Aged Jamaican rum and cream with a hint of tropical fruit and spice.

Serve: Chilled or over ice, or in coffee and dessert drinks.

sassicaia-2017.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Caol Ila 2010 12 Year Old Sassicaia Cask Finish 45% ABV
sassicaia-2017.bodyHtml:
A great 2010 vintage Caol Ila from Gordon & MacPhail’s Connoisseurs Choice range of single malts. This release has been carefully and expertly matured in G&M's own casks with spirit entrusted to them from the Caol Ila distillery. After a years finish in ex-Sassicaia wine casks this lovely dram has lots stewed red berry flavours complimented by demerara sugar and lemon zest notes. A perfect whisky gift to to be savoured and enjoyed.

Official Tasting Notes

Nose: Medjool date aromas with sweet cured meats and pineapple. 

Palate: Stewed red berry flavours complement demerara sugar and lemon zest. 

Finish: A medium-bodied, spicy finish with lingering citrus peel and bonfire embers.

sazerac-18-year-old.title: Sazerac Rye 18 Year Old
sazerac-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Sazerac Rye 18 Year Old is the eldest member of the Buffalo Trace Antique Collection, the annual limited release of five whiskeys from Buffalo Trace Distillery in Kentucky. This Kentucky straight rye whiskey is aged for at least 18 years in new charred American oak and is customarily bottled at 90 proof (45% ABV). The distillery does not publish its mash bill, though the recipe is built from rye, corn and malted barley. A long-aged, hard-to-find rye, presented here in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

sazerac-6-year-old.title: Sazerac Rye Straight Rye Whiskey
sazerac-6-year-old.bodyHtml:
An absolute icon in the whiskey world! Distilled at the legendary Buffalo Trace Distillery, "Baby Saz" is a historic 90-proof Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey that helped define the cocktail culture of New Orleans in the 1800s. Widely believed to be aged around six years, it is crafted from a lower-rye mash bill than many of its competitors, giving it an incredibly sweet, approachable, and fruit-forward profile that finishes with just the right amount of peppery snap. It is the undisputed king of the classic Sazerac cocktail.

 

NOSE

Sweet and inviting with aromas of clove, warm vanilla, anise, and a bright touch of citrus peel.

PALATE

Incredibly smooth and sweet for a rye. Lush flavors of candied spice, ripe dark fruit, and heavy caramel are perfectly balanced by a distinct, peppery rye backbone.

FINISH

Smooth, crisp, and refreshing, leaving a lingering trail of black licorice and sweet vanilla.

scapa-skiren-1.title: Scapa Skiren
scapa-skiren-1.bodyHtml:
Scapa Skiren is a young single malt from the Scapa distillery on Orkney, balancing the tangy coastal character of an island malt with a bright array of fruit. The distillery describes delicate floral aromas with fresh pear, sweet pineapple and a citrus tang, followed by a smooth, sweet palate of ripe honeydew melon, pear and lemon sherbet and a long, refreshing finish. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Pear, pineapple, melon, citrus and a light coastal tang.

Nose: Delicate floral notes with fresh pear, sweet pineapple and a citrus tang.

Palate: Smooth and sweet, with ripe honeydew melon, bursts of pear and lemon sherbet.

Finish: Long, refreshing and gently sweet.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

scapegrace-black-gin-1.title: Scapegrace 'Black' Premium Small Batch Dry Gin
scapegrace-black-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Scapegrace Black is the world's first naturally black, colour-changing gin, from Scapegrace in New Zealand. Its colour comes from botanical extracts of aronia berry, saffron, pineapple and sweet potato, on a wheat-based neutral spirit made with Southern Alps water. Add tonic and it turns from black to a purple-pink. The nose is resinous with juniper and dry earthy notes, the palate full-bodied, floral and naturally chilling, and the finish brings candied sweet potato and pineapple with a velvety mouthfeel. Bottled at 41.6% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Juniper, earthy botanicals, tropical fruit and citrus.

Nose: Resinous with juniper and dry earthy notes, with a slight tropical sweetness at the end.

Palate: Full-bodied florality with a menthol-like crispness, balanced citrus freshness and a hint of spice.

Finish: Candied sweet potato and pineapple; luxurious, velvety and full of natural citrus oils.

Serve: 50ml Scapegrace Black over ice, topped with 150ml premium tonic and garnished with a slice of green apple.

scapegrace-classic-gin-1.title: Scapegrace Premium Small Batch Dry Gin
scapegrace-classic-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Scapegrace Classic is a premium small-batch dry gin from New Zealand, made from a wheat-based neutral spirit and water from the Southern Alps with 12 botanicals in which lemon and, above all, orange peel shine through. Juniper arrives first, followed by floral lavender and orange blossom, earthy cinnamon bark and nutmeg, and a fresh burst of citrus; the finish is warm and surprisingly long, returning to waves of orange and floral notes. It won at the 2019 International SIP Awards. Bottled at 42.2% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Juniper, orange peel, floral notes and warm spice.

Nose: Classic juniper, then lavender and orange blossom, earthy cinnamon bark and nutmeg, and a fresh burst of citrus.

Palate: Vibrant, with juniper, orange peel and deep spice; smooth but crisp.

Finish: Warming and long, with continued juniper and waves of orange and floral notes.

Serve: 50ml Scapegrace Classic over ice, topped with 150ml premium tonic and garnished with a slice of orange.

scapegrace-classic-gin-confession-box-1.title: Scapegrace Premium Small Batch Dry Gin with Confession Box
scapegrace-classic-gin-confession-box-1.bodyHtml:
Scapegrace Premium Small Batch Dry Gin with Confession Box is an exceptional New Zealand craft gin presented in a distinctive gift package that combines sophisticated design with artisanal distilling. Produced by Scapegrace Distilling Co., this premium dry gin is crafted using pure New Zealand water and a carefully balanced selection of 12 traditional botanicals, including juniper, coriander, lemon peel, orange peel, cardamom, nutmeg, cloves, angelica root, orris root, liquorice root, cassia bark and cinnamon. Distilled in small batches, Scapegrace delivers a beautifully refined interpretation of classic dry gin, emphasizing aromatic citrus, crisp juniper and elegant spice. Its striking bottle design draws inspiration from traditional genever bottles, while the Confession Box presentation makes it a memorable gift for gin enthusiasts and collectors. Crystal clear in appearance, this gin offers expressive aromas of fresh orange zest, lemon peel, piney juniper and warming spices, complemented by delicate floral nuances. The palate is exceptionally smooth and vibrant, revealing bright citrus, balanced juniper, gentle coriander and subtle earthy complexity. A long, refreshing finish brings lingering orange peel, floral notes and warming spice. Bottled at 42.2% alcohol by volume, Scapegrace Premium Small Batch Dry Gin combines traditional craftsmanship, contemporary character and distinctive New Zealand provenance in an elegant gift-ready presentation.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with freshly shucked oysters, smoked salmon, grilled prawns, citrus-marinated scallops, seafood ceviche and crispy calamari. Its bright citrus and botanical character also complement herb-roasted chicken, goat cheese crostini, Mediterranean olives, light charcuterie and delicate seafood appetizers.

Tasting Notes: A premium New Zealand dry gin offering vibrant citrus, classic juniper, delicate floral aromas and warm aromatic spices, with a smooth texture and refreshing finish.

Nose: Bright orange peel, fresh lemon zest and piney juniper, followed by subtle orange blossom, cinnamon, nutmeg and delicate herbal notes.

Palate: Smooth, crisp and beautifully balanced, with lively citrus oils, juniper berries, coriander, cardamom and gentle earthy spice.
