Finish: Long, clean and refreshing, with lingering orange zest, warming spice, delicate floral notes and a classic dry juniper character.

scapegrace-gold-gin-1.title: Scapegrace 'Goldi Locks - Gold' Premium Small Batch Dry Gin
scapegrace-gold-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Scapegrace Gold is a juicy navy strength gin from New Zealand, built on a wheat-based neutral spirit and Southern Alps water and bottled at 57% ABV. It layers three citrus notes - orange, lemon and tangerine - over juniper and a full set of spice botanicals, aiming for the perfect friction between complexity and balance. The label notes its IWSC 2018 trophy as best London Dry Gin. Presented here in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Orange blossom, three layers of citrus, juniper and pepper.

Nose: Orange blossom with subtle hints of rose; smooth, sweet and zesty citrus with a light pepper undertone.

Palate: Citrus sweetness, yet still juniper-forward, with a natural hint of pepper.

Finish: Natural warmth brings out the earthy botanicals, with lingering juniper and a dry yet juicy, sweet finish heavy with tangerine.

Serve: As a Gold Gimlet: 50ml Scapegrace Gold, 20ml fresh lime juice and 15ml simple syrup, shaken with ice and garnished with rosemary.

sea-sun-pinot-noir-1.title: Sea Sun Pinot Noir 2022
sea-sun-pinot-noir-1.bodyHtml:
Sea Sun Pinot Noir 2022 is a strikingly soft, lush, and approachable red wine crafted by Charlie Wagner of the renowned Wagner Family of Wines (the creators of Caymus). Sourced from premier ocean-cooled coastal regions across California, it benefits from an extended growing season that develops heightened complexity. It presents a bountiful deep ruby hue and opens with an inviting bouquet of baked cherries, dark plum, and red licorice, layered with warm vanilla, brown sugar, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and fruit-forward, showcasing an intense and creamy texture reminiscent of ripe cherry pie filling. Balanced by a gentle, food-friendly acidity and soft, silky tannins, it trails off into a long, plush finish that evokes the rich taste of milk chocolate and sweet baking spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled salmon, roasted duck, wild mushroom risotto, carnitas tacos, or a charcuterie board featuring mild cheeses like Brie and Camembert.

seventh-heaven-gin.title: Seventh Heaven Pink Grapefruit Ginger and Red Thyme Gin
seventh-heaven-gin.bodyHtml:
Seventh Heaven Pink Grapefruit, Ginger & Red Thyme Gin is a modern craft spirit produced by Domaine Pinnacle / Spirit of York (Norfolk Brands) in Quebec, Canada. Crafted using a neutral grain spirit base distilled from 100% Canadian wheat, this expression infuses classic gin botanicals with a vibrant tri-botanical combination of sun-ripened pink grapefruit, freshly crushed ginger root, and aromatic red thyme. The result is a contemporary, flavor-forward gin that harmonizes bright citrus acidity, warming root spice, and savory Mediterranean herbal notes without sacrificing its underlying juniper spine.

Food Pairing: Grilled salmon with lemon-herbs, Thai green curry, fresh goat cheese crostini, ceviche, and citrus-glazed pork tenderloin.

Tasting Notes: Pale blush pink in appearance with a smooth, crisp, and lively mouthfeel.

Nose: Vibrant and highly aromatic up front, opening with bold pink grapefruit zest and fresh grapefruit juice, followed by a warm, punchy ginger lift and an earthy, savory red thyme undertone, supported by subtle piney juniper.

Palate: Well-balanced and refreshing, delivering a zesty wave of tart pink grapefruit and sweet citrus oils, immediately complemented by a gentle heat from fresh ginger, resinous juniper, and a savory, herbal earthiness from red thyme.

Finish: Medium-long, clean, and invigorating with lingering notes of grapefruit peel, warm ginger spice, and a dry, lingering thyme herbal tail.

Serve: Serve over ice topped with premium Indian tonic water or sparkling water, garnished with a wedge of fresh pink grapefruit and a sprig of fresh thyme, or build into a vibrant Paloma twist, Southside, or Mule.

shafer-one-point-five-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Shafer Hillside Select Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 1.5L Magnum
shafer-one-point-five-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon celebrates hillside vineyards. Rugged, arid vineyard blocks, such as these, with rocky, scant soils create ideal conditions for producing wine of classic richness and elegance. This wine also exhibits the structure and beauty that are the hallmarks of wines born of the winery's location within Napa Valley's Stags Leap District. Aged nearly four years prior to release, this wine offers the pleasures of youthful boldness on release and rich nuance after a decade or more of bottling.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

In the running for the wine of the vintage, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Hillside Select is an incredible success and offers more depth, opulence, and purity than just about every other wine out there. Revealing a dense purple color as well as a killer nose of blueberries, chocolate-covered cherries, scorched earth, tobacco, violets, and exotic spices, it hits the palate with full-bodied richness, a seamless, pure, incredibly layered mouthfeel, building tannins, and a great, great finish. As with most top 2017s, it stays tight and compact on the palate, with notable structure and impressive concentration. It has some up-front appeal given its purity of fruit and balance, yet it's going to take 7-8 years to hit prime time and will be a long-lived bottle of Napa Cabernet. Hats off to Doug Shafer and the team for yet another magical Cabernet Sauvignon!

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Hillside Select displays a deep garnet-purple color, bursting from the glass with scents of blueberry pie, crème de cassis, black cherry compote and chocolate box plus nuances of cedar chest, clove oil, lavender and menthol. The richly fruited, full-bodied palate has a lively skip in its step, featuring gorgeous ripe, velvety tannins and fantastic freshness to support all the spicy black fruit layers, finishing long and perfumed. An absolute triumph!

98 Points - James Suckling

Wild blackberries and brambleberries on the nose with raw cocoa, cloves and crushed gravel. Violets and orange peel, too. It’s medium-bodied with wonderful purity and depth of fruit, interlaced with dark-chocolate flavors. Firm, well-integrated tannins. Complex and refined with fantastic energy. One of the finest Hillside Selects I have had. Better from 2024.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is the 35th vintage of this 100% varietal powerhouse, a deeply concentrated, muscular and intensely flavored wine that offers equal parts grace and age ability. Blue fruit and notes of iron, crushed rock and cocoa powder deliver a seamless palate of opulence, with lasting hints of allspice, black pepper and oak. Best After 2027. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This drips with rich blackberry, boysenberry and raspberry fruit flavors and is liberally laced with licorice root and singed alder notes, delivering a nice tarry tug through the finish as the fruit drips. Shows a twinge of the vintage's rusticity in its tannins, but it's a heck of an effort in this tricky year. Best from 2023

sheep-dog-peanut-butter-whisky.title: Sheep Dog Peanut Butter Whiskey
sheep-dog-peanut-butter-whisky.bodyHtml:
A wildly popular and dangerously delicious treat for anyone with a sweet tooth! Produced by the Sazerac Company, Sheep Dog expertly blends smooth, easy-drinking whiskey with the rich, nostalgic flavors of creamy, roasted peanut butter. Bottled at an approachable 70 proof (35% ABV), it delivers an incredibly thick, velvety, and sweet sipping experience that completely masks any harsh alcohol burn. It is an absolute favorite for chilled party shots, or for pouring over vanilla bean ice cream for a decadent adult dessert.

NOSE

Massive, heavy aromas of freshly roasted peanuts, warm butterscotch, and sweet honey.

PALATE

Thick, creamy, and extremely sweet. Dominant flavors of rich peanut butter and caramel swirl together, entirely taking over the palate.

FINISH

Smooth, syrupy, and lingering, tasting exactly like a liquid peanut butter cup.

shelter-point-cask-strength.title: Shelter Point Cask Strength Single Malt Canadian Whisky
shelter-point-cask-strength.bodyHtml:
Shelter Point Cask Strength Single Malt is the barrel-strength version of the classic single malt from Shelter Point Distillery on the coast of northern Vancouver Island, British Columbia. It is made in small batches from 100% malted BC barley, double distilled in copper wash and spirit pot stills built by Forsyths using water from the distillery's own aquifer, and this expression is bottled straight from the barrel at 58.7% ABV. Natural in colour and non-chill filtered, it matures in a range of selected casks under a strong coastal influence. The distillery describes a balanced mix of fruit, caramel, barley, baking spices and honey with a seaside whiff, hints of wine and smoke, and a sweet, leathery mouthfeel. Sold in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Fruit, caramel, barley, baking spice, honey, sea air, a touch of wine and smoke.

Serve: Neat, then with a little water to open it up.

shelter-point-double-barrel-single-malt-.title: Shelter Point Double Barrel Canadian Single Malt Whisky
shelter-point-double-barrel-single-malt-.bodyHtml:
Shelter Point Double Barrel is a special-edition Canadian single malt from Shelter Point Distillery, the farm distillery on the coast of Vancouver Island between Comox and Campbell River, British Columbia. This 2019 edition was aged for six years in American oak and then finished in a French oak barrel from the nearby Coastal Black Estate Winery. Shelter Point grows much of its own barley and distils it in copper pot stills on the same site. Bottled at 50% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

shelter-point-montfort-single-malt.title: Shelter Point Montfort Canadian Single Malt Whisky
shelter-point-montfort-single-malt.bodyHtml: On the nose Montfort is light, floral and fruity. The palate is full of honey and raisins, with a creamy mouthfeel. The finish is long, enriched with spice, fudge and oak, making Montfort a beautifully rounded premium single grain whisky experience.

shinobu-10-year-old-pure-malt.title: Shinobu 10 Year Old Pure Malt Whisky Mizunara Oak Finish

shinobu-15-year-old-pure-malt.title: Shinobu 15 Year Old Pure Malt Japanese Whisky

shinobu-blended-whisky.title: Shinobu Blended Whisky Mizunara Oak Finish

shinobu-pure-malt.title: Shinobu Pure Malt Mizunara Oak Finish Japanese Whisky

signal-hill-canadian-whisky-1.title: Signal Hill Founders Select Overproof Canadian Whisky

skrewball-peanut-butter-whiskey-1.title: Skrewball Peanut Butter Whiskey
skrewball-peanut-butter-whiskey-1.bodyHtml:
Skrewball Peanut Butter Whiskey is a revolutionary flavored whiskey that pioneered the peanut butter category, crafting a sweet, indulgent, and decadently smooth spirit by combining real roasted peanuts with a base of neutral grains and whiskey. Created by a husband-and-wife duo in San Diego, California, this spirit offers a seamless union of salty, savory, and sweet notes with an approachable finish, making it a favorite for desserts, creative cocktails, and crowd-pleasing shots.

Food Pairing: Vanilla bean ice cream, dark chocolate brownies, crisp bacon slices, pretzel sticks, roasted nuts, or apple pie.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber appearance with a rich, smooth, and velvety texture on the mouthfeel.

Nose : Freshly roasted peanuts, sweet vanilla bean, butterscotch, honey, and warm toasted marshmallows.

Palate : Creamy and rich with bold natural peanut butter flavor, caramel, toasted corn, marshmallow sweetness, and subtle baking spice.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and lingering with notes of roasted nuts, brown sugar, and sweet vanilla without any harsh alcohol burn.

Serve : Serve neat, chilled over ice, as a chilled shot, or mixed into a Peanut Butter Old Fashioned or coffee cocktail.

skyy-vodka-1.title: Skyy Vodka
skyy-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Skyy Vodka is a premium American vodka known for its exceptional smoothness and clarity. Developed in San Francisco, it undergoes a proprietary quadruple-distillation and triple-filtration process using 100% pure American grain and filtered water. This creates a clean, crisp, and incredibly versatile spirit that serves as the perfect canvas for a wide array of cocktails or as a chilled, standalone drink.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked salmon canapés, fresh oysters, caviar, cured meats, and light Mediterranean appetizers like olive tapenade and feta cheese.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear in appearance with a light, silky body and a remarkably clean, neutral profile on the palate.

NOSE Extremely clean and subtle with faint traces of sweet grain and a touch of mineral freshness.

FINISH Short, crisp, and bright with a very smooth, warming touch and absolutely no harsh bite.

SERVE Best served ice-cold straight from the freezer as a shot, on the rocks, or as the crisp foundation of a classic Vodka Martini or Moscow Mule.

sleeman-clear-1.title: Sleeman Clear 2.0 15 Cans
sleeman-clear-1.bodyHtml: Sleeman Clear 2.0 is a light and refreshing lager specifically brewed for those seeking a crisp, low-calorie profile without sacrificing a clean malt flavour. This pale gold beer is triple-filtered to achieve a high level of purity, resulting in an exceptionally smooth texture with a light body and minimal bitterness. As one of Canada’s leading low-carb options, it features a subtle citrus aroma and a thirst-quenching finish that makes it a popular choice for active lifestyles or warm-weather social gatherings. Each 355mL serving contains only 80 calories and 2 grams of carbohydrates, providing a sessionable experience that stays true to the Sleeman family's traditional brewing heritage.

sleeman-original-draught-1.title: Sleeman Original Draught 15 Cans
sleeman-original-draught-1.bodyHtml:
Original Draught combines Sleeman’ s premium brewing heritage with the freshness and sociability of traditional draught beer. This unpasteurized lager goes down well in the company of friends.

With its golden color and concentrated white foam collar, Original Draught is well balanced and easy to drink. In this particular lager you’ ll notice a distinctive floral hop aroma with a refreshing finish.

sljivovica-old-plum-brandy-maraska-zadar.title: Maraska Stara Slivovitz Old Plum Brandy
sljivovica-old-plum-brandy-maraska-zadar.bodyHtml:
Maraska Stara Šljivovica is an old plum brandy (slivovitz) from Maraska of Zadar, Croatia, sold in the house's round, flask-shaped bottle with the Zadar skyline on the label. This fruit brandy is double distilled from ripe plums and bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It shows pronounced plum fruit aromas with a hint of toasted almond, while the palate brings jammy plum flavours that sit well with a dry note of roasted nuts. It is a fruit brandy from Croatia supplied by Maraska Zadar. Well balanced, it can be enjoyed well chilled as an aperitif or after dinner as a digestif.

Nose: Pronounced plum fruit with a hint of toasted almond.

Palate: Jammy plum with a dry note of roasted nuts.

Serve: Well chilled as an aperitif, or after dinner as a digestif.

smirnoff-berry-blast.title: Smirnoff Ice Berry Blast 6 Cans
smirnoff-berry-blast.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Ice Berry Blast is a pre-mixed, flavored malt beverage produced by Smirnoff, combining its signature vodka-inspired flavor base with a sweet, tart blend of blue raspberry, blackberry, and cherry fruit flavors. Known for its distinct electric-blue appearance and crisp, fizzy texture, it offers a sweet, refreshing, and accessible taste profile designed for casual occasions.

Food Pairing: Spicy chicken wings, loaded nachos, fish tacos, barbecue pulled pork, and fresh fruit skewers.

Tasting Notes : Electric vibrant blue in appearance with a light, crisp, and carbonated mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and aromatic, dominated by prominent notes of artificial blue raspberry, ripe blackberry, candied cherry, and citrus zest.

Palate : Sweet, tart, and carbonated, delivering forward flavors of sweet blue raspberry, tangy berry punch, and lemon-lime citrus.

Finish : Quick, crisp, and refreshing, leaving a lingering sweet berry taste with a clean, effervescent bite.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled or poured over ice in a highball glass, optionally garnished with a fresh lime wheel or raspberries.

smirnoff-citrus.title: Smirnoff Berry Blast Vodka
smirnoff-citrus.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Berry Blast vodka is loaded with vibrant cherry, citrus and blue raspberry flavours. The nostalgic flavours combined with Smirnoff vodka are persistent on the palate with a refreshing fruity note. Best served chilled or enjoy over crushed ice in a fresh and fruity cocktail.

smirnoff-infusions-cucumber-lime.title: Smirnoff Lime Vodka
smirnoff-infusions-cucumber-lime.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Lime is a lime flavoured vodka from Smirnoff's Classic Flavours range, made with the brand's triple distilled vodka and infused with natural citrus and lime flavours. Bottled at 35% ABV in a 750 ml bottle, it delivers a fresh, zesty lime taste that is made for simple mixing. Smirnoff positions it as the ideal partner for soda and lime, and it is just as at home in a vodka gimlet, a lime-forward mule with ginger beer, or a quick highball with lemon-lime soda. Serve over plenty of ice with a fresh lime wedge.

Tasting Notes: Fresh lime and citrus.

Serve: With soda and a lime wedge over ice, or with ginger beer.

smirnoff-infusions-strawberry-rose.title: Smirnoff Soda Rose Variety Pack 12 Cans
smirnoff-infusions-strawberry-rose.bodyHtml: This variety pack offers crisp, and fruity zero sugar vodka sodas, elevated by the addition of rosé wine. Flavours include raspberry, strawberry, white peach and pink apple rosé.

smirnoff-peppermint.title: Smirnoff Peach Vodka
smirnoff-peppermint.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Peach is infused with the natural flavor of juicy peaches for a sweet and fruity taste. This spirit has a pleasant sweetness and pairs best with soda water, lemonade, or iced tea. Smirnoff Peach is Kosher Certified and gluten free.

smirnoff-vodka-6.title: Smirnoff Peach Vodka
smirnoff-vodka-6.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Peach is infused with the natural flavor of juicy peaches for a sweet and fruity taste. This spirit has a pleasant sweetness and pairs best with soda water, lemonade, or iced tea. Smirnoff Peach is Kosher Certified and gluten free.

sombra-mezcal-1.title: Sombra Mezcal Artesanal Joven 1L
sombra-mezcal-1.bodyHtml:
Crafted in Santiago Matatlán and San Juan del Río, Oaxaca, Mexico, Sombra Joven is a renowned artisanal mezcal created by Master Sommelier Richard Betts and produced by master mezcalero Crispín Pérez. Built with sustainability and cocktail integrity at its core, Sombra operates an eco-friendly palenque utilizing solar power, certified sustainable wood, and an upcycled agave fiber brick initiative. Made from 100% organically farmed Espadín agave (Agave angustifolia) harvested at 7 to 10 years of age, the mature piñas are slow-roasted in traditional underground conical stone pit ovens fueled by certified wood. Crushed using a stone tahona wheel powered by solar energy, the mash is open-fermented in pine wood tubs with natural airborne yeasts and double-distilled in classic copper pot stills. Bottled at a robust 45% ABV and offered here in a bartender-preferred 1-Liter format, this unaged mezcal delivers a bold, complex profile balancing rich oak smoke, sweet cooked agave, bright citrus, and crisp herbal spice.

Food Pairing: Grilled pork carnitas, spicy chorizo street tacos, fresh ceviche with habanero, mole negro, roasted poblano peppers, or dark chocolate with sea salt.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear in appearance with brilliant clarity, a silky medium-to-full body, and clean, slow-dripping tears.

Nose: Bold, aromatic, and smoky, opening with rich mesquite smoke, sweet roasted agave, and bright lemon peel, accompanied by white pepper, green apple, damp pine needles, and subtle eucalyptus.

Palate: Robust, textural, and spicy on the palate, featuring caramelized agave nectar, lime zest, and green tropical fruit upfront before unfolding into layers of soft oak smoke, cracked black pepper, fresh garden mint, and wet stone minerality.

Finish: Long, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet agave, gentle campfire smoke, zesty citrus pith, and a dry, peppery herbal warmth.

Serve: Enjoy neat at room temperature in a traditional clay copita or Glencairn glass, or use as a bold, muscular foundation for craft cocktails like a Mezcal Last Word, Oaxaca Old Fashioned, or Spicy Mezcal Margarita.

sortilege-maple-syrup-rye-whisky.title: Sortilege Maple Syrup Whisky
sortilege-maple-syrup-rye-whisky.bodyHtml:
Sortilège Maple Syrup Whisky is a distinctive Canadian whisky liqueur that brings together the smooth warmth of aged rye whisky and the rich, authentic sweetness of pure Quebec maple syrup. Crafted according to a traditional Quebec-inspired recipe, this indulgent expression is made with Canadian rye whisky aged for a minimum of three years in white oak barrels before being expertly blended with premium maple syrup. Bottled at 30% ABV, it offers a harmonious balance of whisky character, velvety sweetness and inviting notes of caramel, vanilla and toasted oak. Rich, smooth and unmistakably Canadian, Sortilège is equally delightful enjoyed neat, over ice or as a luxurious addition to coffee and dessert cocktails.

Tasting Notes: A smooth and indulgent whisky liqueur showcasing authentic maple sweetness, mellow Canadian rye whisky and warming notes of caramel, vanilla and oak.

Nose: Inviting aromas of pure maple syrup, golden caramel, creamy vanilla and buttery toffee, complemented by subtle toasted oak and gentle rye spice.

Palate: Rich and velvety, delivering layers of maple syrup, butterscotch, soft vanilla and caramelized sugar, balanced by the mellow warmth of aged Canadian whisky.

Finish: Smooth, sweet and lingering, with persistent maple richness, delicate oak spice and a gentle warming whisky character.

sour-puss-blue-1.title: Sour Puss Blue
sour-puss-blue-1.bodyHtml:
Sour Puss Blue is a bright turquoise sweet and sour liqueur bottled at 15% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is a product of Phillips Products Co. of Minnesota in the United States, and the bilingual label reads Blue/Bleu. The Sour Puss range is described as a blend of secret, exotic natural flavours built around a taste that is sweet and sour at the same time. The blue version is known for its vivid colour and for aromas likened to a blue popsicle, both sweet and tart, with a spicy note of candied cinnamon. It belongs in the liqueur section rather than with coolers, despite the playful name.

Nose: Sweet and tart blue popsicle with candied cinnamon.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, or over ice with lemon-lime soda.

sour-puss-raspberry-3.title: Sour Puss Raspberry 1.14L
sour-puss-raspberry-3.bodyHtml:
Sour Puss Raspberry is a bright, sweet-and-sour raspberry liqueur from the Sour Puss range, made in the United States by Phillips and bottled at 15% ABV. This 1.14L bottle is the large party size, useful for gatherings and for batching mixed drinks. It pours a vivid reddish-pink and balances juicy raspberry sweetness with a sharp sour edge and a slight herbal bitterness, which is why it is a favourite for party shots, sours and fruity highballs.

Tasting Notes: Bright reddish-pink; sweet, sour and slightly bitter raspberry.

Nose: Raspberry with a slight herbal bitterness.

Palate: Sour, sweet and lightly bitter raspberry.

Serve: Well chilled as a shot, topped with lemon-lime soda, or in a sour-style cocktail.

southern-comfort-black.title: Southern Comfort Black Whiskey Liqueur
southern-comfort-black.bodyHtml:
A robust whiskey-forward profile with subtle spice and fruity accents, Southern Comfort Black label takes the original Southern Comfort experience up a notch — for those who like their extra-smooth whiskey extra bold. Try it neat, on the rocks, or in a classic cocktail.

Appearance: Deep amber in colour.

Nose: Spicy and sweet with caramel, hints of cinnamon and vanilla.

Taste: Sweet and mellow. Spice at the forefront with hints of brown sugar, cherry and vanilla.

Finish: Good length with sweet spices, toffee and a hint of smoke.

speyburn-15-year-old.title: Speyburn 15 Year Old
speyburn-15-year-old.bodyHtml:
Speyburn 15 Year Old is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from the Speyburn Distillery at Rothes, Moray. Introduced to the range in the second half of 2017, it spends fifteen years maturing in a combination of American oak and Spanish oak casks, giving a rich and vibrant dram that is amber with gold highlights in the glass. It is bottled at 46% ABV; this listing is the 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Dark chocolate, raisins, orange, toffee and gentle spice.

Nose: Rich dark chocolate with spicy raisins, zesty citrus fruit and vanilla.

Palate: Orange, toffee, vanilla and leather wrapped in gentle spice.

Finish: Long and warming, with sweet, creamy spice.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

speyburn-18-year-old.title: Speyburn 18 Year Old
speyburn-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Speyburn 18 Year Old, Crafted at the Speyburn Distillery tucked away in the secluded glen of Rothes in Speyside, is an elegant, award-winning single malt Scotch whisky. Matured for 18 years in a combination of American oak ex-bourbon and Spanish oak ex-sherry casks, it showcases a harmoniously rich and velvety profile defined by dark chocolate, dried fruit, sweet toffee, and gentle oak spice.

Food Pairing: Venison tenderloin with a blackberry reduction, roasted duck breast, aged Gouda or Cheddar cheese, dark chocolate truffles, and pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper-amber with dark gold highlights. Offers a smooth, viscous, and luxurious mouthfeel with full-bodied richness.

Nose : Rich and inviting with sweet toffee, dark chocolate, and candied almonds blended with orchard fruits like green apples, pears, and subtle tropical fruit.

Palate : Creamy dark chocolate, sweet butterscotch, and candied orange peel paired with golden syrup, raisins, poached pear, cinnamon, and subtle oak spice.

Finish : Long, warming, and elegant, featuring lingering notes of dark cocoa, dried fruit, sweet oak, and a faint touch of delicate wood smoke.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature, or with a few drops of water to open up the complex fruit and oak aromas.

spirytus-rectified-spirit-96-alcohol-1.title: Polmos Spirytus Rektyfikowany Rectified Spirit
spirytus-rectified-spirit-96-alcohol-1.bodyHtml:
Spirytus Rektyfikowany is a Polish rectified spirit from Polmos, bottled at an extreme 96% ABV (192 proof). It is distilled from rye grain grown in north-western Poland and taken through multiple distillations until it is crystal clear and almost neutral in flavour. Spirytus is not intended to be drunk neat: it is used as a base for homemade liqueurs, herbal tinctures and fruit infusions, and in the kitchen to extract flavours for desserts. Always dilute it and handle with care. 750ml bottle.

Serve: Never neat — dilute well or use as the base for homemade liqueurs and infusions.

spottswoode-lyndenhurst-cabernet-sauvign.title: Spottswoode Lyndenhurst Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 750ml
spottswoode-lyndenhurst-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml: Winemaker Notes: A complex and inviting Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon suggesting notes of raw fresh blackberries, crushed graphite, cassis, baking spices, and cocoa powder. Fine tannins provide savory structure, while floral notes of violets and laurel perfume the glass.

spottswoode-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvign.title: Spottswoode Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
spottswoode-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Spottswoode Estate Cabernet Sauvignon is a benchmark Napa Valley Cabernet, offering layered aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, violet, graphite, and cedar. Powerful yet impeccably balanced, it delivers remarkable depth, freshness, and elegance with exceptional aging potential.
 
Food Pairing: Pairs best with dry-aged ribeye, rack of lamb, beef tenderloin, wild mushroom dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

 

99 Points - James Suckling

Pure black currants on the nose with an incredible al dente grape character. It’s almost like grape must. Undertone of ink and violets and sandalwood. Perfumed. Hints of spearmint. Full-bodied, but so well-formed and reserved. A touch of mint on the palate with dark fruits. It is very complete and reminds me of the classy Spottswoode 2001. I keep being impressed with the purity of fruit with the earthy undertones and stones. Savory. A fitting 40th anniversary wine. 90% cabernet sauvignon, 7% cabernet franc, and 3% petit verdot. Best after 2027.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Moving to the Grand Vin, the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon reveals a deep, dense purple color as well as a primordial nose of ripe black fruits, cassis, camphor, scorched earth, violet, and lead pencil aromas and flavors. Reminding me of a young Leoville Las Cases with its closed, dense, structured style, it's concentrated, has a pure, layered, focused style, ripe tannins, and a great finish. It needs 5-7 years of bottle age and will evolve for 30+ years. The blend of the 2021 is 87% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Cabernet Franc, and the rest Petit Verdot.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Slated for a September 2024 release, Spottswoode's 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon comes across as more vibrant, floral and fresh than the 2020. Violet and cassis notes are accented by hints of crushed stone and pencil shavings on the nose. Hugely complex yet harmonious, this medium-bodied effort is firm but silky in feel, with a long, elegant finish. Lovely stuff.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

This offers a gorgeous display of pure, unadulterated mulberry, boysenberry and plum fruit puree flavors that glisten as they move along, throwing off light accents of anise, violet and hibiscus along the way. Inlaid with an underlying fine-grained structure in the form of sleek threads of iron and alder, this shows tensile strength while extending through the long, refined finish.

springbank-15-year-old-1.title: Springbank 15 Year Old
springbank-15-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Springbank 15 Year Old is one of the cornerstones of the Springbank range, a Campbeltown single malt Scotch whisky from Springbank Distillers bottled at 46% ABV in a 750ml bottle. This bottling was matured in a mix of sherry and bourbon casks, and sherry is the leading note, backed by plenty of complexity: salt, smoke and toffee all find their place. Because each batch is drawn from different casks, the character can shift noticeably from one bottling to the next, which is part of the appeal for Springbank followers. It suits an after-dinner dram.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

st-lucia-admiral-rodney-royal-oak.title: St. Lucia Distillers Admiral Rodney 'HMS Royal Oak' Extra Old Rum
st-lucia-admiral-rodney-royal-oak.bodyHtml:
HMS Royal Oak was in the vanguard of ships to engage the French in the famos Battle of the Saints. Captained by Thomas Burnett, the Royal Oak maneuvered skillfully and brought to bear all of her 74 guns on the enemy for the duration of the battle. With 8 men lost and 20 wounded, the Royal Oak played an integral role in the first skirmishes of the battle and encouraged us to create a rum of rarity, intensity, and boldness.

Rum Blend: Admiral Rodney Royal Oak, the original Admiral Rodney blend, contains 7-12 year old Coffey still rum that has been aged exclusively in previously used Bourbon casks and blended to perfection.

Tasting Notes: Bright amber color with a nose of prunes, raisin fruit, toasty oak and tropical spiced. Intense mouth-feel of sweet sultana fruit, tobacco, and chocolate, with vanilla from the oak. Complex finish with sweet fruit, caramel, and spice.

st-remy-vsop.title: St-Remy VSOP French Brandy 1.75L
st-remy-vsop.bodyHtml:
St-Remy V.S.O.P. is a classic French brandy produced using 100% French wine grapes sourced from renowned wine regions across France. Matured in small French oak casks, it exhibits a harmonious, balanced profile with delicate aromas of ripe fruits, oak, and soft vanilla.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, aged cheeses, dark chocolate, fruit tarts, roasted pork, and duck confit.

Tasting Notes : Amber-gold with yellow highlights, offering a smooth, light, and well-rounded mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Ripe red berries, peach, apricot, subtle oak, and light vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of candied fruit, sweet oak, delicate vanilla, and warm spice.

Finish : Smooth, short to medium, with lingering notes of sweet fruit and gentle wood.

Serve : Best served neat in a tulip or glass tumbler at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a versatile base in classic cocktails such as a Brandy Alexander or Sidecar.

kavalan-solist-px-and-moscatel-decanter.bodyHtml:
Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and recharred in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the wood into the whisky overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness.
It has a complex and multi-dimensional background of pepper, spice, dates and other fruits, such as ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of bursting citrus fruits.

Colour
Deep autumn gold

Flavour
A rich fusion of vanilla and caramelized sugars with dark chocolate on top. Ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of citrus fruits burst. Pepper is also present in the background waiting to be noticed.

Palate
The taste ends with clean and complex flavours embodying all that is best in the finest malt whiskies enjoying a long aftertaste.

Tasting
We suggest drinking Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask neat.

bacardi-reserva-ocho-8-year-sherry-cask.title: Bacardi Reserva Ocho 8 Year Old Sherry Cask Finish Rum
bacardi-reserva-ocho-8-year-sherry-cask.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Reserva Ocho Sherry Cask Finish was the first release in Bacardí's limited-edition Cask Finish Series, and its debut edition sold out. It takes Reserva Ocho, the brand's eight-year-old rare gold rum, and finishes it in sherry casks, which bring a fruitier, more aromatic profile to the familiar oak and spice. The label marks it as a limited edition, barrel matured, and it is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, making it a good sipping rum for anyone who enjoys sherry-finished spirits.

Tasting Notes: Oak, citrus peel, maple syrup, baking spice and fennel; medium-bodied and fruity.

Serve: Neat or with a single ice cube.

johnnie-walker-black-label-icon.title: Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old 1.75L
johnnie-walker-black-label-icon.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old is an iconic and highly regarded blended Scotch whisky, crafted using whiskies drawn from the four corners of Scotland. Aged for a minimum of 12 years, this masterful blend combines the lighter, sweeter whiskies of the east with the robust, peaty malts of the west. The result is a deep, complex, and incredibly well-balanced spirit that has set the benchmark for premium blends worldwide.

Food Pairing: The smoky and rich flavor profile of this whisky pairs wonderfully with hearty and savory dishes like slow-cooked BBQ pork, smoked brisket, or a rich charcuterie board. It is also exceptional alongside dark chocolate or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep gold with rich amber highlights in appearance, offering a smooth, medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Bold and aromatic, featuring heavy notes of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, and dark orange peel, beautifully balanced by underlying wood spice and gentle, fragrant peat smoke.

Palate : Complex, smooth, and layered. Rich flavors of sweet vanilla, creamy toffee, and dark fruit give way to warm winter baking spices, toasted oak, and a distinct wave of peat smoke.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth, leaving a lingering impression of soft smoke, sweet malt, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, over ice in a double rocks glass, or mixed with high-quality ginger ale or soda water in a tall highball glass with a fresh orange wedge.

johnnie-walker-red-label-icon.title: Johnnie Walker Red Label 1.75L
johnnie-walker-red-label-icon.bodyHtml:
The Walkers' empire was built upon the Red Label, the best-selling Scottish whisky in the world today. It is appreciated for its pronounced, fruity, spicy and slightly smoky flavours. Perfect to liven up your cocktails, it remains a great choice to begin your exploration of whiskies.

Johnnie Walker Red Label is their Pioneer Blend, the versatile one that has introduced their whisky to the world. Crafted from the four corners of Scotland, it crackles with spice and is bursting with vibrant, smoky flavours, followed by a mellow bed of vanilla, a fresh zestiness and the Johnnie Walker signature of a long, lingering, smoky finish.

alberta-premium-cask-strength-batch-3.title: Alberta Premium Cask Strength 10 Year Old 2025 Release
alberta-premium-cask-strength-batch-3.bodyHtml:
A standout Canadian rye whisky bottled at full strength, this 10-year-old release from Alberta Premium blends decades of refinement with the bold flavor that defines 100 % prairie rye. From the heart of Calgary, it showcases intensity, depth, and character rarely seen in the rye whisky world.

On the nose, warm caramel and vanilla mingle with toasted oak, wild honey, and a swirl of ripe apple and apricot. A subtle undercurrent of rye spice—white pepper and tobacco leaf—sits alongside soft floral whispers of lilac and mint.
The palate opens rich and full, offering butterscotch, dark chocolate, candied apple, and stewed plums, balanced by the unmistakable grain-driven rye heat.
The finish is long and vibrant: lingering waves of cinnamon bark, leather, oak tannin and a bright citrus-peel lift teasing at the edges.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements smoked brisket, grilled steak, maple-glazed pork, pecan pie, dark chocolate desserts, and aged cheeses such as cheddar, Gouda, or blue cheese.

dassai-23-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake-1.title: Dassai '23' Junmai Daiginjo 720ml
dassai-23-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake-1.bodyHtml:
To craft the ultimate Junmai-Daiginjo sake, we polished down Yamada-Nishiki rice to 23%. Delivering delicate floral aromas with a palate reminiscent of honey and an elegant lasting finish.

A Gold Medal winner at IWC 2021 this elegant sake is produced using Yamada Nishiki rice milled to 23%. Intense aromatics of melon fruit with fresh cucumber and floral notes. Incredibly balanced with a great depth of flavours, rich and smooth on the palate with a long, dry finish. Serve chilled with raw oysters.

chateau-de-sancerre.title: Chateau de Sancerre Blanc 2025
chateau-de-sancerre.bodyHtml:
Château de Sancerre Blanc 2025 is an exceptionally vibrant, elegant, and textbook expression of Sauvignon Blanc, crafted at the historic estate overlooking the Loire River. Pouring a beautiful pale straw with brilliant green highlights, it opens with a highly expressive and fresh bouquet of crisp gooseberries, citrus peel, yellow orchard fruit, and white elderflower, underpinned by distinctive smoky and flinty mineral undertones. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, precise, and perfectly balanced, presenting a juicy, layered texture of green apple, grapefruit, and subtle tropical notes. A driving, mouthwatering vein of natural acidity provides remarkable tension and purity, extending through to a long, racy, and bone-dry finish characterized by a clean mineral persistence.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with fresh goat cheeses like Crottin de Chavignol, pan-seared sea scallops, oysters on the half shell, or grilled sea bass with lemon herbs.

carpineto-farnito-cabernet-sauvignon-igt.title: Carpineto Farnito Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
carpineto-farnito-cabernet-sauvignon-igt.bodyHtml:
The name Farnito is derived from a type of oak tree known as Farna found in the vicinity of the vineyards. Carpineto Farnito Cabernet Sauvignon is produced from estate-grown fruit. A full-bodied Super Tuscan, Carpineto Farnito is a rich expression of the Cabernet Sauvignon varietal boasting complex aromas of ripe red cherry with concentrated flavors of spice and licorice. Aged in French and American oak barrels for 12 months, the wine is structured with a vanilla note and big tannins marking the finish.

Food Pairing: Pair this magnificent Cabernet Sauvignon with grilled steak, roasted lamb, hearty game dishes, or aged cheeses.


91 Points - James Suckling

Licorice, bell peppers, dried chilis and plums on the nose, followed by a medium-bodied, lightly chewy palate. Savory and integrated.
91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
The wine has cedar, charred red pepper, and roasted red berries that lift right out of the glass. Overly ripe dark fruit appear on the palate that has some macho tannins that emphasizes blackberry and plum onto the tongue. This wine likes to show a little muscle but the complete experience shows precision and balance.
90 Points - Wine Spectator
Smoky black cherry, black currant and blackberry flavors highlight this vibrant red. Picks up notes of wild herbs, cedar and graphite while winding down on the finish.

cambria-pinot-noir-julias-vineyard.title: Cambria Julia's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021
cambria-pinot-noir-julias-vineyard.bodyHtml:
Cambria Julia's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021 is an exceptionally expressive, elegant, and character-driven cool-climate red wine from the heart of Santa Barbara County. Sourced from its namesake estate vineyard—originally planted in 1972 on the ancient alluvial benchmarks of the Santa Maria Valley—this single-vineyard bottling benefits from a uniquely prolonged growing season shaped by consistent Pacific fog and ocean breezes. The fruit is carefully fermented and aged for several months in French oak barrels (a small portion being new) to beautifully synthesize structural depth with pristine varietal purity. In the glass, it reveals a brilliant, translucent ruby color. The highly aromatic and fragrant nose opens with radiant layers of ripe pomegranate, wild strawberries, and dark maraschino cherries, intricately woven with nuance of lavender, fresh rose petals, toasted sage, and a delicate hint of earthy underbrush. On the palate, this medium-bodied Pinot Noir is remarkably vibrant, sleek, and lively, driving juicy cran-raspberry and dark berry flavors over a framework of supple, fine-grained tannins and a crisp line of natural, refreshing acidity before culminating in a long, beautifully balanced, and subtly spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared duck breast, cedar-plank grilled salmon, rustic wild mushroom risotto, or herb-roasted pork tenderloin.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Tart and fresh aromas of red plum, strawberry and lightly toasted sage and marjoram draw the nose into this zesty, widely available bottling. The palate lands with pleasantly brisk cran-pom-raspberry flavors, as lavender and rose petal qualities add nuance.

kendall-jackson-cabernet-grand-reserve.title: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
kendall-jackson-cabernet-grand-reserve.bodyHtml:
Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon is a quintessential, fruit-forward California wine crafted from a multi-appellation blend of primarily mountain and hillside vineyards in Sonoma and Mendocino counties. On the nose, it reveals an inviting and lush bouquet of black cherry, ripe blackberry, and cassis, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of dried culinary herbs, mocha, and toasted vanilla. The palate is medium-bodied and robust yet exceptionally supple, offering a round mid-palate framed by smooth, seamless tannins. Artisan winemaking techniques, including extended maceration and careful maturation in a mix of French and American oak barrels, impart a balanced structural backbone without overpowering the fruit, culminating in an elegant, velvety finish.

 

Food Pairing: Pairs excellently with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, savory mushroom risotto, hearty lasagna, and aged cheeses like sharp cheddar or Gouda.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This complete and well-balanced wine is a pleasure to drink soon, but will also develop more nuances for a few years. Fresh blackberries and blueberries are accented by light vanilla and cinnamon-scented oak spices on a lightly tannic texture.

robert-mondavi-napa-pinot-noir.title: Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
robert-mondavi-napa-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, beautifully structured, and classic expression of Napa Valley winemaking. Sourced from premier vineyard sites across the region, this vintage offers intense aromas of ripe blackcurrant, dark cherry, cassis, and cocoa, accented by gentle nuances of cedar, sweet oak spice, and subtle violet. On the palate, it delivers a medium- to full-bodied mouthfeel layered with vibrant dark berry fruit, balanced acidity, and supple, velvety tannins that flow seamlessly into a long, polished, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled New York strip steak, herb-crusted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, portobello mushroom burgers, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Soft around the edges and firm in the middle, this red- and black-fruited wine has a creaminess on the palate, delivering a mix of red cherries, blackberries and blueberries wrapped in moderate tannins. Contains small amounts of petit verdot, cabernet franc, malbec and merlot. 

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A polished, fruit-driven style, but with nice focus, as singed alder and savory notes provide a gentle nudge along the edges of the plum and cassis core. Ends with a subtle loam echo on the finish.

argyle-reserve-pinot-noir.title: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Pinot Noir 2021
argyle-reserve-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Pinot Noir 2021 is a bright and approachable regional blend that highlights the vivid fruit character of California’s cool coastal growing regions. Sourced primarily from the benchlands of Monterey, Santa Barbara, and Sonoma counties, the grapes develop small, concentrated clusters due to persistent maritime influences and fog. The winemaking process involves keeping individual vineyard lots separate until the final blend, with the wine aging for 9.5 months in 98% French oak barrels (18% new) to integrate structure and aromatic depth. It delivers a classic aromatic profile of ripe cherry, strawberry, and raspberry intertwined with elegant earthy notes, cola, and mild spice. On the palate, it is supple and well-balanced, offering a smooth texture with hints of vanilla, toasted cedar, and a soft, lingering finish.

bodega-roda-cirsion-2015.title: Bodegas Roda Cirsion 2015 750ml
bodega-roda-cirsion-2015.bodyHtml:
With explosive blackberry, herb and mineral aromas and monstrously dense, ripe, crushed cherry fruit and noble tannins, this is one of the great red wines of the world.

95 Points - Robert Parker
The top of the range is only produced in some vintages, so we are already with the very young 2015 Cirsion—they didn't produce it in 2013 or 2014, so the 2015 is the next vintage after 2012. And starting with the 2012, it seems like the style of Cirsion is going to have a significant percentage of Graciano, at least in the warmer vintages. It is a juicy, layered, hedonistic, spicy and voluptuous modern Rioja from a perfect year for ripeness and with some Mediterranean influence; it might challenge the phenomenal 2005. In this vintage, the blend includes 14% Graciano, which is higher than the 2012, and prior to that, it was only Tempranillo. The selected grapes went through natural fermentation, and they reckon the tannins are ripe enough to only need some eight months in oak, brand new French barrels in this occasion. It's very fruit-driven, heady, ripe, open, aromatic and intoxicating. This is very different from the rest of the wines in the portfolio, a lot more modern, juicy, chewy and, in the last couple of vintages, with the added freshness provided by the Graciano. They think this is a wine that will be long lived in bottle, but most of the bottles are drunk early on, when the profile is exuberant. One day I will have to do a Cirsion vertical... 5,078 bottles produced. It was bottled in January 2017.

lothian-pinot-noir.title: Chateau Vartely Pinot Noir
lothian-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Château Vartely Pinot Noir is an expressive, delicate, and fresh red wine produced from handpicked grapes grown in the central Codru region of Moldova. Fermented in stainless steel tanks under controlled temperatures to preserve primary fruit purity, it shows a luminous light-ruby color in the glass. On the nose, it displays vibrant aromatics of fresh wild raspberries, overripe strawberries, red cherries, and delicate dried herbs. On the palate, it is light- to medium-bodied with juicy fruit flavors, refreshing natural acidity, and fine, silky tannins that lead into a clean, smooth finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with tomato bruschetta, roasted chicken, grilled pork chops, duck breast, wild mushroom ragù, lentil curry, and mild soft cheeses.

copain-tous-ensemble-syrah.title: Errazuriz Aconcagua Costa Syrah 2020 750ml
copain-tous-ensemble-syrah.bodyHtml: The palate is fresh and mineral with delicious notes of red and black fruits such as black currants and blueberries along with a touch of incense and pepper and resulting in a very expressive and complex wine. The very fine tannins lend a rough sensation and plenty of nerve.

altesino-brunello-riserva-docg.title: Altesino Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2017
altesino-brunello-riserva-docg.bodyHtml:
This Brunello Riserva offers a solid, full body and excellent aging potential. Its ample and complex bouquet is reminiscent of violets, wild berries, cedar, leather, tobacco and spices. On the palate, it is austere and seductive with a perfect blend of fruit, acidity and mouth coating tannins. This is the perfect bottle for Brunello lovers.

Pair with steak au poivre, rack of lamb or beef carpaccio.

95 Points - James Suckling
Complex and fragrant nose of neroli, currants, sour cherries, sandalwood, cassis and wild herbs. Roasted walnuts, too. Full-bodied with firm, fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity. Full of energy and power. Try in 2024.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2017 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva (with 13,000 bottles made) shows dark fruit, dried cherry and baked plum. The wine is slightly subdued aromatically speaking compared to the new Brunello annata release, and I chalk that up to the very hot and dry conditions of the relentless 2017 summer. Cinnamon, cumin and crushed clove appear in a second wave and underline this Riserva's more elaborate aging regime. The finish is layered and rich with full-bodied Sangiovese intensity.

93 Points - Wine Spectator
This red starts out round, turning more precise and taut as it builds to the finish. Shows cherry, wild herb, soy and loam flavors that ply the supple texture, before the tannins exert their influence and the finish tightens up (a good sign for the future).

first-drop-mothers-milk.title: First Drop Mother's Milk Shiraz 2022
first-drop-mothers-milk.bodyHtml:
Garnet red with purple hues. A complex nose of dark cherry and blackberry aromas with a hint of forest floor and spice. Vibrant dark cherry and blackberry with a hint of ‘wombat rolled in all spice’ balanced with an even, textural palate with soft, supple tannins.

Pair with rump steak, mushroom sauce, chips and salad.

92 Points - James Suckling

Juicy, spicy and chalky, this shiraz shows notes of currants, baking spices and dried flowers. Medium-bodied with well-integrated tannins. Juicy fruit character on the palate with a seductive, peppery and flavorful finish. Drink now. Screw cap.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers a juicy, exuberant mix of blueberry preserves, fresh black cherry and cherry cola that's smooth and seamless. This complex red seamlessly integrates details of masala chai, bittersweet chocolate, violet, fresh earth, toasted cumin and white pepper on the firming finish.

la-magia-brunello-di-montalcino.title: La Magia Brunello di Montalcino 2020
la-magia-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
The colour is ruby red tending towards garnet, with typical red berry fruit opening out on the nose and in the mouth, mineral overtones, delicate spices, supported by generous acidity, restrained tannin and a long finish.

Direct and engaging is the sensory profile of a solid, centred Brunello. Red plums blend well with nuances of orange juice and pink grapefruit. Slightly opaque the background is reminiscent of black plums, blackberries, incense, wet geraniums, coriander and cumin. Full-bodied, savoury on the palate it shows structure and matter, biting tannins of considerable tension and a really sharp finish that will need time to unwind.

96 Points - James Suckling

Fine-textured, with integrated tannins that frame the wine nicely. It’s medium-bodied with juicy, dark fruit, as well as notes of bark, spice and walnut husk. Flavorful and intense, focused and polished. Drink in two or three years, but already impressive.

lusine-annapolis-pinot-noir.title: L'usine Annapolis Ridge Vineyard Pinot Noir 2019
lusine-annapolis-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
L'usine Annapolis Ridge Vineyard Pinot Noir 2019 is an exceptional, full-bodied red wine crafted by Dave Phinney from a steep, high-elevation site on the extreme Northern Sonoma Coast. Displaying a deep garnet hue, it opens with aromatics of dark cherries, ripe raspberries, wild coastal sagebrush, and sweet baking spices, complemented by nuances of dark cocoa and black tea. On the palate, it reveals a plush texture balanced by vibrant coastal acidity, showcasing layers of concentrated red and dark fruit flavors, supple dust-textured tannins, and an extensive, complex finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with duck breast with cherry reduction, roasted lamb chops, grilled wild salmon, mushroom risotto, pork loin, or aged Gruyère cheese.

port-askaig-12-year-old-autumn-edition.title: Port Askaig 12 Year Old Autumn Edition
port-askaig-12-year-old-autumn-edition.bodyHtml:
Port Askaig 12 Year Old Autumn Edition is a limited Islay single malt from Port Askaig, an independent bottling brand that sources its whisky from Islay distilleries rather than owning one. Bottled in 2020, this seasonal edition was assembled from nine refill American oak hogsheads, five oloroso sherry butts and three solera sherry butts. Port Askaig describes its signature style as a balance of fruit and peat. Aged 12 years, it is non chill-filtered, free of added colouring and bottled at 45.8% ABV in a 700ml bottle, presented in a gift box.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

smokehead-rum-rebel.title: Smokehead Rum Rebel Rum Cask Finish Islay Single Malt
smokehead-rum-rebel.bodyHtml:
Smokehead Rum Rebel is an Islay single malt Scotch whisky from Ian Macleod Distillers, given a rum cask finish and bottled at 46% ABV; this listing is the 700 ml bottle. It belongs to Smokehead's experimental cask series, which sets the brand's heavy Islay peat smoke against other cask types, in this case the sweetness of Caribbean rum casks. The label and presentation tin mark it as a limited edition with a rum cask finish. It is a smoky, tropical whisky showing medicinal peat, sweet caramel, burnt pineapple and caramelised banana, and the brand's own playful note adds citrus, marshmallow and bacon.

Tasting Notes: Medicinal peat smoke, sweet caramel, burnt pineapple, caramelised banana, citrus and tropical fruit.

Serve: Neat, with a splash of water or over ice.

g-m-glentauchers-2006-distillery-label.title: Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Glentauchers 2006 13 Year Old 43% ABV
g-m-glentauchers-2006-distillery-label.bodyHtml:
Bottled under the G&M Distillery Labels range, this 13 year old Glentauchers was matured in Refill American Oak Hogsheads before bottling at 43%.

Nose: Sweet and light fruits; lemon, pineapple and orange. Vanilla pod develops softly and accompanies boiled sweets with a subtle hint of banana.

Taste: Gentle spice with grapefruit and cracked black pepper. Lemon cheesecake comes to the fore alongside subtle white chocolate and soft vanilla.

Finish: A light finish with vanilla and mouth-warming black pepper.

g-m-mortlach-15-year-old-distillery-la.title: Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Mortlach 15 Year Old
g-m-mortlach-15-year-old-distillery-la.bodyHtml: The nose is rich with cereal sweetness and warm barley. Apple blossom rises without effort and notes of malmsey and stewed fruits and Christmas punch emerge with spice and muffin. The palate is quite full and quite sweet. The cereal notes return with a syrupy texture. Shades of sherried sultanas and notes of freshly cut fruit salad, hints of toasty oak with obligatory vanilla spice and peppery warmth. The finish is long with the fruit and spice rising readily from the oak.

whistlepig-piggyback-6-year-old-rye.title: WhistlePig PiggyBack 6 Year Old Rye
whistlepig-piggyback-6-year-old-rye.bodyHtml:
Designed by the legendary late Master Distiller Dave Pickerell specifically for bartenders, PiggyBack is the ultimate cocktail rye! Crafted with a massive 100% rye mash bill and aged for six years, it is intentionally bottled at an exact 96.56 proof (48.28% ABV)—a specific strength chosen because it provides enough robust alcohol content to stand up brilliantly in any cocktail, without overpowering the intricate, spicy flavors of the whiskey itself.

NOSE

Intensely spicy and bright with aromas of fresh black pepper, cinnamon, dark chocolate, and sharp citrus peel.

PALATE

Bold, highly robust, and spice-forward. A massive wave of peppery rye grain and clove is beautifully tempered by rich caramel, toasted oak, and vanilla cream.

FINISH

Long, crisp, and exceptionally spicy, leaving a satisfying dry heat perfect for mixing.

dominuss-estate-redd.title: Dominus Othello 2016
dominuss-estate-redd.bodyHtml: Produced from the historic Napanook vineyard in Yountville, California, Othello is a wine that expresses the singularity of its exceptional terroir and is accessible and enjoyable in its youth. A Bordeaux blend, the wine is forthcoming with lovely aromas of red fruit, round, silky tannins and an abounding brightness.

togouchi-sake-cask-japanese-whiskey.title: Togouchi Sake Cask Finish Blended Japanese Whisky
togouchi-sake-cask-japanese-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Togouchi Sake Cask Finish is a blended Japanese whisky from the Sakurao Distillery in the Hiroshima region of Japan. It blends grain and malt whiskies (15% malt), all distilled in Japan, which are first matured in bourbon casks and then finished for several months in sake casks that come straight from the Sakurao brewery. Togouchi whiskies are distilled near the Seto Inland Sea and their casks rest in the small town of Akiota-Togouchi, at the foot of Mount Osorakan. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle, this edition shows off the link between Japanese whisky and the traditional sake made at the same site.

Serve: Neat, over ice or in a highball.

luc-belaire-bleu.title: Luc Belaire Limited Edition Bleu
luc-belaire-bleu.bodyHtml: Luc Belaire Bleu is a striking, limited-edition French sparkling wine from the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region, famous for its vibrant sapphire blue colour. Inspired by the beautiful blue waters of the French Riviera, this wine is a unique blend of Ugni Blanc and Colombard grapes, offering a balanced profile of fresh berries and tropical fruits. The nose typically reveals a sophisticated bouquet of fresh-cut flowers and citrus, leading to a crisp, clean palate with a subtle, refreshing sweetness. Its stunning bottle and electric hue make it a popular choice for high-end celebrations, creative cocktails, and visually impactful events.

ron-millonario-10-year-old-anniversario.title: Ron Millonario 10 Anniversario Cincuenta
ron-millonario-10-year-old-anniversario.bodyHtml:
Ron Millonario 10 Aniversario Reserva is a Peruvian rum bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle. The blend, created by Fabio Rossi as a homage to the success of Ron Millonario, was designed to be lighter than the sweeter rums in the Millonario range. It comes in a black gift tube marked with the large '10' anniversary emblem.

Serve: Neat or over a large ice cube.

krug-grande-cuvee.title: Krug Grande Cuvee 172eme
krug-grande-cuvee.bodyHtml:
Krug Grande Cuvée 172ème Édition is a non-vintage champagne known for its complexity and elegance. It's a blend of 195 different wines from 12 years, ranging from 2014 to 1998, with 51% Pinot Noir, 38% Chardonnay, and 11% Meunier. This blend gives the champagne a rich, balanced profile with notes of ripe fruit, citrus, and pastry cream, complemented by hints of warm spices and toasted bread. 

This Champagne can be enjoyed as an aperitif with Jabugo ham and mature comté or served to accompany oysters, grilled shrimps, Indian or Moroccan food, as well as desserts such as carrot cake, tarte tatin and cheesecake.

krug-rose.title: Krug Brut Rose 28eme Edition
krug-rose.bodyHtml:
Krug Rosé 28th Edition is a Champagne full of vivacity, amplitude and boldness with a liberated element of the unexpected. The broad palette of elegant notes in this Édition is born from a selection of 32 wines from 6 different years, the youngest from 2016, and the oldest from 2010. 

At first sight, its subtle pale pink color holds a promise of elegance. On the nose, aromas of rose hips, cured ham, mulberries, redcurrant, peony, pepper and pink grapefruit. On the palate, delicate flavors of honey, citrus and dried fruit with a long finish, enhanced by its fine bubbles complete the experience.

Krug Rosé lends itself to pairing ideas outside the box. For example, when it accompanies very good quality anchovies, a magical encounter occurs. The saltiness of the fish sublimes the fruit aromas and silkiness of the Champagne, turning the anchovies into a velvet sensation. Krug Rosé can also be enjoyed with foie gras, lamb, game, white meat, venison or even dishes with spices. Krug Rosé is not recommended for desserts, unless they are not sweet at all. Unexpectedly, it best accompanies very savory dishes.

97 Points - James Suckling

Beautiful peach-pink color with a copper hue and a lot of floral nuances on the nose, offering dried cherries, peach skin and spices. It shows intensity and power, yet with elegance and precision. Full-bodied with a fine texture and phenolic tension. Bright and already delicious with some zesty, dried orange peel character at the end. Drink or hold.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Krug's rosé Champagne was launched in 1983. This latest iteration is as dense, rich and opulent as ever. From its perfumed aroma to its ripe, full and generous red fruits and mature, tangy flavor, the wine is in perfect balance. Drink now.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Offering aromas of peonies, orange peel, cinnamon, dried herbs, rose petals and ripe red berries, the NV Rosé 28ème Edition possesses a medium to full-bodied, rich and concentrated palate with a vinous, creamy core of fruit framed by a vibrant, enrobing mid-palate that leads into a nicely phenolic, long, salty and mineral finish. This rendition—a blend of 58% Pinot Noir, 25% Chardonnay and 17% Pinot Meunier—is one of this house's most powerful and well-executed Champagne rosé ever produced. It comprises 32 wines from vintages spanning 2010 to 2016, with the latter as the base, and red wine sourced from Aÿ.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A majestic rosé Champagne of impeccable balance, with remarkable depth of flavor and focus to its flavors of raspberry puree, kirsch and grilled nuts, plus hints of saffron, blood orange peel and ground coffee. The finely detailed mousse glides across the palate, enmeshed with chiseled acidity. The vibrant frame carries the profile on the long, long finish. Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier. Disgorged winter 2022 to 2023 (Krug ID 123009). Drink now through 2034.

yellow-dog-high-five-hazy-ipa.title: Yellow Dog High Five Hazy Ipa 4 Cans
yellow-dog-high-five-hazy-ipa.bodyHtml: Yellow Dog High Five Hazy Ipa 4 Cans

huruhuru-the-feather-pale-ale.title: Coedo - Yuzu Japanese Pale Ale 333ml
huruhuru-the-feather-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Coedo Yuzu Japanese Pale Ale is a 333ml bottle of Japanese craft beer that is pale golden in color, brewed with rice and infused with the fragrant citrus fruit, yuzu. It has a 5.0% alcohol by volume (ABV) and offers a delicate, citrusy aroma from the yuzu, crisp flavors, and a dry finish. This pale ale is known for its balanced flavor and can be enjoyed for its refreshing, elegant, and Japanese-inspired taste

fernie-brew-what-the-huck-huckleberry.title: Fernie Brew What The Huck Huckleberry 6 Cans
fernie-brew-what-the-huck-huckleberry.bodyHtml: Fernie Brew What The Huck Huckleberry 6 Cans

parallel-49-brewing-pic-a-hop.title: Parallel 49 - Hop Patroll Mixer Pack 8 Cans
parallel-49-brewing-pic-a-hop.bodyHtml:
The Parallel 49 Hop Patroll Mixer Pack is a variety 8-pack featuring four unique, hop-forward craft beers from Parallel 49 Brewing. Each pack typically contains two 473 ml tall cans of each featured style:

  • Shredder (New Zealand Pilsner): A 5.0% ABV pilsner featuring New Zealand hops with notes of citrus, grapefruit, kiwi, and grass.
  • Capt'n Grog (Hazy IPA): A 5.6% ABV juice-forward IPA described by Manitoba Liquor Mart as having a "fluffy mouthfeel" and heavy fruit notes.
  • Sluggo (West Coast IPA): A 6.3% ABV traditional IPA that balances malty flavours with a firm hop bitterness for easy drinking.
  • Haymaker (Cold IPA): A 5.9% ABV crisp IPA brewed with corn as an adjunct to keep malt flavours subtle and emphasize a robust hop profile.

hawk-tail-new-england-pale-ale.title: Hawk Tail New England Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans
hawk-tail-new-england-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Hawk Tail New England Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans

hard-knox-rnr-raspberry-rhubarb.title: Hard Knox Rnr Raspberry Rhubarb 4 Tall Cans
hard-knox-rnr-raspberry-rhubarb.bodyHtml: Hard Knox Rnr Raspberry Rhubarb 4 Tall Cans

krug-collection-1988.title: Krug Brut Collection 1988
krug-collection-1988.bodyHtml:
To the delight of collectors around the world, a very limited number of bottles of Krug Vintage are kept in ideal conditions in the House’s cellars. They are tasted and appraised as they wait to blossom into a second life. Krug Vintage then becomes Krug Collection and reveals a new personality. Krug Collection Champagnes are true examples of time sublimation; maturity exposes hidden facets and depth. New flavours surprise, while old ones have gained structure. Krug Collection is always a wonderful discovery, a deeper story of the Krug Vintage. Krug Collection 1988 is time’s second revelation of Krug 1988.

98 Points - Decanter

When Krug 1988 was first released, a few bottles remained stored in the Krug cellars to see how they aged. The result today is a bouquet of incredible complexity, a veritable spice box full of seductive scents including sandalwood, mocha, and leather as well as a waxy note. Such a beguiling mix of youthful energy with eminent ageworthiness. Readers who can find the 1988 should not hesitate, as it is stellar

krug-rose-magnum.title: Krug Brut Rose 28eme Edition
krug-rose-magnum.bodyHtml:
Krug Rosé 28th Edition is a Champagne full of vivacity, amplitude and boldness with a liberated element of the unexpected. The broad palette of elegant notes in this Édition is born from a selection of 32 wines from 6 different years, the youngest from 2016, and the oldest from 2010. 

At first sight, its subtle pale pink color holds a promise of elegance. On the nose, aromas of rose hips, cured ham, mulberries, redcurrant, peony, pepper and pink grapefruit. On the palate, delicate flavors of honey, citrus and dried fruit with a long finish, enhanced by its fine bubbles complete the experience.

Krug Rosé lends itself to pairing ideas outside the box. For example, when it accompanies very good quality anchovies, a magical encounter occurs. The saltiness of the fish sublimes the fruit aromas and silkiness of the Champagne, turning the anchovies into a velvet sensation. Krug Rosé can also be enjoyed with foie gras, lamb, game, white meat, venison or even dishes with spices. Krug Rosé is not recommended for desserts, unless they are not sweet at all. Unexpectedly, it best accompanies very savory dishes.

97 Points - James Suckling

Beautiful peach-pink color with a copper hue and a lot of floral nuances on the nose, offering dried cherries, peach skin and spices. It shows intensity and power, yet with elegance and precision. Full-bodied with a fine texture and phenolic tension. Bright and already delicious with some zesty, dried orange peel character at the end. Drink or hold.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Krug's rosé Champagne was launched in 1983. This latest iteration is as dense, rich and opulent as ever. From its perfumed aroma to its ripe, full and generous red fruits and mature, tangy flavor, the wine is in perfect balance. Drink now.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Offering aromas of peonies, orange peel, cinnamon, dried herbs, rose petals and ripe red berries, the NV Rosé 28ème Edition possesses a medium to full-bodied, rich and concentrated palate with a vinous, creamy core of fruit framed by a vibrant, enrobing mid-palate that leads into a nicely phenolic, long, salty and mineral finish. This rendition—a blend of 58% Pinot Noir, 25% Chardonnay and 17% Pinot Meunier—is one of this house's most powerful and well-executed Champagne rosé ever produced. It comprises 32 wines from vintages spanning 2010 to 2016, with the latter as the base, and red wine sourced from Aÿ.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A majestic rosé Champagne of impeccable balance, with remarkable depth of flavor and focus to its flavors of raspberry puree, kirsch and grilled nuts, plus hints of saffron, blood orange peel and ground coffee. The finely detailed mousse glides across the palate, enmeshed with chiseled acidity. The vibrant frame carries the profile on the long, long finish. Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier. Disgorged winter 2022 to 2023 (Krug ID 123009). Drink now through 2034.

fernie-brewing-slingshot-session-ipa.title: Fernie Brewing Slingshot Session Ipa 6 Cans

zacapa-edicion-negra.title: Ron Zacapa Centenario Edicion Negra Solera Gran Reserva Rum
zacapa-edicion-negra.bodyHtml: Zacapa Edición Negra is made of a blend of rums between 6 and 24 years old and is inspired by the natural elements of Guatemala including the dark fire of its volcanoes. Edición Negra is aged in select barrels including double charred American oak casks, creating a rich, dark rum with a smoky intensity. Zacapa Edición Negra is best served neat or on the rocks and provides a smoky twist to your dark spirits classic cocktails."

carpano-antica-formula-1.title: Carpano Antica Formula Vermouth 375ml
carpano-antica-formula-1.bodyHtml: Carpano Antica Formula is a legendary Italian vermouth originally created in 1786, widely considered the gold standard of the "Vermouth alla Vaniglia" style. It is celebrated for its deep, complex, and highly aromatic profile, resulting from a meticulous infusion of mountain herbs and botanicals. On the nose, it delivers an intense bouquet of vanilla, dried fruits, and spices like saffron and ginger, accented by orange zest. The palate is rich and velvety, perfectly balancing a delicate sweetness with a pleasant, bitter herbal edge and notes of roasted cocoa and cloves. It is a foundational ingredient for premium cocktails like the Negroni or Manhattan, but it is also traditionally enjoyed neat or on the rocks as an aperitif.

chateau-pavie-2016.title: Chateau La Mondotte 2016
chateau-pavie-2016.bodyHtml:
Château La Mondotte is an iconic Premier Grand Cru Classé Saint-Émilion with intense aromas of blackberry, black cherry, cassis, violet, graphite, licorice, and fine oak spice. Powerful yet remarkably elegant, it delivers velvety tannins, exceptional concentration, mineral freshness, and extraordinary aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle-infused dishes, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté cheese.

 

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Not far off the magical 2015, the 2016 La Mondotte comes from a tiny vineyard of clay and limestone soil located next to Pavie Decesse. A blend of 85% Merlot and 15% Cabernet Franc, this behemoth boasts a deep purple color as well as a brilliant array of crème de cassis, blackcurrants, crushed rocks, and graphite. Full-bodied and beautifully concentrated, with liquid minerality emerging with time in the glass, this legendary Saint-Émilion in the making needs 5-7 years of bottle age and will keep for 3-4 decades.

97 Points - James Suckling

So much black truffle and blueberry on the nose. Decadent and aromatic. Wet soil. Indian ink. Full-bodied, polished and so velvety with fantastic depth of fruit and ripe tannins, yet powerful and fresh. Slightly minerally and salty underneath.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Made by the winemaking team of Canon la Gaffelière, this wine is stylishly elegant, restrained in its structure and tannins. Its intensely juicy character is already attractive, giving the wine almost a refreshing character. This balanced wine will be ready from 2025.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This shows a dark, toasty style at first, with notes of ganache and plum reduction, but it unwinds steadily and slowly, revealing pure cassis, cherry and raspberry fruit flavors gilded liberally with violet and anise accents. The long finish is laced with a superfine chalky minerality that imparts mouthwatering cut even as the fruit gains steam. Best from 2023 through 2038.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 La Mondotte is a blend of 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc this year, picked between 29 September and 15 October and matured in 70% new oak. The alcohol level is around 14.5%. It has a lucid purple hue in the glass. The bouquet is very perfumed, very pure with luscious red cherries, blueberry and a hint of sloes, the new oak discrete and allowing the terroir to shine through perhaps more than the 2015 last year. The palate is silky smooth on the entry, but underneath the bonnet, there is considerable tannic backbone that certainly can be felt more towards the finish that exerts a light grip. In a strange way, it reminds me a little of Château Canon! Give this 4-5 years once in bottle.

duckhorn-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
duckhorn-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a refined and powerful red wine crafted from top-tier estate and independent grower vineyards across the Napa Valley. Blending 93% Cabernet Sauvignon with 6% Merlot, it opens with rich aromas of boysenberry, black currant, and dark cherry, accented by bay leaf, baking spice, and subtle cedar notes. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, well-sculpted texture packed with blueberry, blackberry, and plum flavors supported by fine, firm tannins and a long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, roasted lamb, duck breast, or aged cheddar cheese.

luce-lucente.title: Tenuta Luce Lucente 2016 3L Double Magnum
luce-lucente.bodyHtml:
Tenuta Luce Lucente 2016 is a rich, expressive, and harmonious Super Tuscan red wine produced by the prestigious Tenuta Luce estate in Montalcino. A cuvée crafted primarily from Merlot blended with Sangiovese, it serves as the second wine of the estate, capturing the elegance and character of the property in a more accessible style. In the glass, it exhibits an intense ruby-red color. The nose opens with inviting aromas of juicy Marasca cherry, dark plum, blackcurrant, and violet, interwoven with notes of dark chocolate, star anise, sage, mocha, and Mediterranean brush. On the palate, it is full-bodied, supple, and well-structured, featuring vibrant layers of ripe dark fruit supported by silky, polished tannins and a balanced acidity that extends into a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted red meats, grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, savory pasta ragù, and aged pecorino or Parmigiano-Reggiano cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripeness and intensity here with dark berries, dark chocolate, walnuts and sage on the nose, following through to a full body, round and chewy tannins and a ripe-fruit finish. Better in 2020.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Lucente is a blend of Sangiovese and Merlot and represents the estate's second wine. This is an attractive and accessible mid-weight wine to pair with grilled meats or aged cheese. The primary fruit is bright and vibrant with layers of fresh cherry, plum and blackberry. Those fruit tones are tied together by lighter tones of spice and leather.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This blend of Merlot and Sangiovese opens with aromas of dark-skinned berry, violet, mocha and Mediterranean brush. The savory palate offers juicy Marasca cherry, star anise and a hint of espresso alongside velvety polished tannins.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Light-bodied and elegant yet intense, displaying cherry, black currant, violet, graphite and spice aromas and flavors. Firm and fresh on the long finish. Drink now through 2028.

ornellaia-le-serre-nuove-6l.title: Ornellaia Le Serre Nuove 2018 6L Imperial
ornellaia-le-serre-nuove-6l.bodyHtml:
Characterized by a lively ruby red color, Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia 2018 is a wine of great aromatic complexity, a distinctive feature of this vintage. In the glass, aromas of berries, blackberry, raspberry and red cherry are accompanied by floral hints of wild rose and spicy notes of pink pepper and licorice. On tasting, the wine has a good tannic structure, enveloping and balanced, with a crisp and savory finish.

95 Points - James Suckling

The aromas of currants, tobacco, chocolate and mushrooms are very attractive here. It’s full-bodied with juicy tannins and a flavorful, round-textured finish. Gorgeous wine and very approachable now, but better in 2023.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Bolgheri Rosso Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia is a blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot that is aged in oak for 15 months. The wine shows depth, concentration and generous fruit weight that adds to the intensity and the textural importance of this abundant, full-bodied expression. Late-season rains threw some challenges at the winemakers of Bolgheri, but this open-knit wine has emerged unscathed. This vintage was released in September of last year, but I have also written a review in this report of the younger 2019 vintage (which will be released in September of this year).

90 Points - Wine Spectator
Rich and packed with black cherry, blackberry and plum flavors shaded by wild Mediterranean herbs and baking spices. It's polished, yet dense, the tannins lining the lingering finish like cocoa powder. Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot.

black-tot-rum-50th-anniversary.title: Black Tot 50th Anniversary Rum
black-tot-rum-50th-anniversary.bodyHtml:
Black Tot 50th Anniversary Rum is a limited edition blend created to mark fifty years since Black Tot Day, 31 July 1970, when the Royal Navy issued its last daily rum ration. Only 5,000 bottles were released.
