The blend draws on the four cornerstones of the old Navy recipe: Guyana (61.5%), Barbados (15%), Trinidad (15%) and Jamaica (8%), plus 0.5% original naval rum from the final consignment. It is bottled at 54.5% ABV in a 700ml bottle with no added sugar or flavourings, is not chill-filtered, and was matured in both tropical and continental climates.

Tasting Notes: Toasted cinnamon and nutmeg, caramel-glazed apple tart and citrus, then barbecued pineapple, grapefruit zest, dark chocolate, raisins and Jamaican Blue Mountain coffee, with bitter notes and sweet black liquorice lingering.

Finish: Robust bitter notes with sweet black liquorice.

Serve: Sip neat or with a drop of water.

rum-nation-guadaloupe.title: Rum Nation Venezuela 15 Yo
rum-nation-guadaloupe.bodyHtml:
Rum Nation Small Batch Rare Rums Venezuela 15 Year Old 2010 is a refined Venezuelan rum distilled in 2010 and bottled in 2025. Aged in ex-bourbon casks, it spent 13 years maturing under the tropical sun before resting a further two years in Europe, gaining balance, structure and finesse. Bottled at its natural strength of 54.2% ABV from casks 72 to 74, this small batch of 796 bottles is part of Rum Nation's Small Batch Rare Rums series and comes in a 700ml bottle with a gift tube. The producer presents it as a showcase of tropical ageing: fruity, complex and remarkably smooth for its strength.

Tasting Notes: Tropical fruit, citrus and vanilla with a creamy, bright texture.

Nose: Tropical fruit, candied citrus and warm vanilla.

Palate: Creamy yet bright, with mango compote, toasted banana and a touch of oak.

Finish: Long and elegant.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water if desired.

schrader-mb.title: Schrader Monastery Block To Kalon Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
schrader-mb.bodyHtml:
A brilliant sequel to our inaugural release, the 2018 Schrader MB continues to show the unique qualities of To Kalon Vineyard terroir. Made from grapes grown in close proximity to the Mayacamas Mountains, the wine brims with bold aromas of Bing cherries, briar fruit, and raspberries, complemented by elegant crushed rock minerality. Medium- to full bodied, this wine glides over the palate with fine, grippy tannins and gorgeous bright-yet balanced fruit. The fine tone and vast dimension of the Schrader MB promises tremendous opportunity for further development in the bottle.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Only the second vintage of this new Schrader label, this 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Monastery Block To Kalon Vineyard comes from clone 169 planted on the Monastery Block of the Robert Mondavi section of To Kalon vineyard in Oakville. One hundred percent Cabernet Sauvignon, it is aging in 100% new Darnajou oak barrels. A very deep purple-black colored barrel sample, the 2018 rolls effortlessly from the glass with fragrant Black Forest cake, blueberry pie and warm cassis notes plus touches of dried roses, black tea, pencil lead and underbrush with a waft of baking spices. Medium-bodied, the palate is super elegant and super intense with a firm, grainy texture and bold freshness, finishing long and layered.

98 Points - James Suckling

An expressive and complex cabernet sauvignon with notes of plum, blackberry, toasted oak and earthy undertones. Lots of blue fruit. The palate is full and tannic with firm tannins and a long, powerful finish, showing so much blackcurrant, blue fruit and dark chocolate. Solid. Better after 2024.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Coming from the historic Monastery Block in this Grand Cru vineyard, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon To Kalon Vineyard MB offers a beautifully layered, full-bodied, yet structured profile that's going to benefit from bottle age. Lots of blackcurrants, gravelly earth, dark chocolate, and liquid violet-like nuances give way to a concentrated 2018 with a wonderful mid-palate, building tannins, and a great finish. Do your best to hide bottles for 4-5 years, and this puppy should be long-lived!

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This is laden with vibrant fruit, showing flavors of cassis, kirsch, linzer and açaí berry, while violet, apple wood and melted licorice notes fill in where they can. Shows a brambly hint through the back end, adding good energy to the massively endowed fruit core. The finish echoes and echoes with fruit. Best from 2022 through 2038.

schrader-lpv.title: Schrader Double Diamond Proprietary Red 2021
schrader-lpv.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Schrader Double Diamond Napa Valley Proprietary Red is a wine of remarkable depth and character. Upon the first encounter, it entices with a lavish bouquet of dark fruits, featuring ripe blackberries and plums, intertwined with hints of mocha, cedar, and a touch of vanilla.

With each sip, this wine unveils its opulent and multi-layered palate. Luscious black fruit, including black cherries and currants, takes center stage, harmoniously complemented by notes of dark chocolate, espresso, and a subtle undercurrent of baking spices. Its fine-grained tannins provide structure without overpowering, while the wine's well-balanced acidity imparts vibrancy and liveliness.

The finish is enduring and luxurious, leaving a lasting impression of dark fruit and a lingering note of sweet oak.

94 Points - James Suckling

This Bordeaux-style blend is elegant, approachable and packed with beautiful black fruit. Black cherries, blueberries and hints of mint and bay leaves are wrapped in fine-grained tannins for a sleek texture. 50% cabernet sauvignon, 25% merlot and 25% cabernet franc. it’s a new product from Schrader. Drink or hold.

schrader-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Schrader Double Diamond Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
schrader-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Schrader Double Diamond Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a refined Napa Valley red wine crafted by acclaimed winemaker Thomas Rivers Brown. Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, this expressive wine showcases the depth and elegance of Oakville's celebrated vineyards. Aromas of ripe black cherry, dark plum, violets, and graphite lead into a silky palate of blackberry, cassis, and dark chocolate. Aged in French oak, including 52% new barrels, it combines concentrated fruit with polished tannins, vibrant acidity, and a long, sophisticated finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, venison, wild mushroom risotto, aged cheddar, and truffle dishes.

 

95 Points - James Suckling

A beautiful, luscious, easy-sipping red that goes deep in red and black fruit on a silky texture. Dark plums, black cherries, dark chocolate, cocoa and hints of red flowers, iron and graphite. Soft, resolved tannins and a lingering finish. Drink now or hold.

blue.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
blue.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label is an iconic, ultra-premium blended Scotch whisky crafted by Johnnie Walker. Hand-selected by Master Blender Jim Beveridge from some of the rarest casks across Scotland—including irreplaceable stocks from ghost distilleries—only one in ten thousand casks possesses the quality and character required for this blend. It delivers a rich, velvety balance of sweet honey, dark chocolate, ripe fruits, and a gentle, lingering cloud of soft Islay smoke.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, caviar, seared duck breast, dark chocolate truffles, and aged blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a silky, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Mellow and rounded with aromas of dry smoke, raisins, sweet honey, toasted nuts, and subtle orange peel.

Palate : Complex and velvety, delivering flavors of hazelnut, dark chocolate, sandalwood, honey, Kumquat fruit, and sweet sherry wood spice.

Finish : Rich, long, and warming with lingering notes of gentle peat smoke, dark fruit, dried spice, and pepper.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass accompanied by a glass of ice water on the side to cleanse the palate between sips.

kokanee-5.title: Kokanee 15 Cans
kokanee-5.bodyHtml: Kokanee, the best selling lager in B.C., gains its particular character from the blend of Pacific Northwest hops. The beer has twice won brewing industry awards for its smooth, clean and lightly hopped flavor. It has an alcohol content of 5% abv.

tool-shed-star-cheek-ipa.title: Tool Shed Star Cheek IPA 4 Tall Cans
tool-shed-star-cheek-ipa.bodyHtml: Tool Shed Star Cheek IPA 4 Tall Cans

schrader-old-sparky.title: Schrader Old Sparky Beckstoffer To Kalon Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 1.5L Magnum
schrader-old-sparky.bodyHtml:
The most coveted bottling in our portfolio, Old Sparky To Kalon Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon is blended from a selection of only the best barrels from the vintage. The wine is full-bodied with concentrated black and purple fruit balanced with elegant floral and spice notes, fresh acidity, and firm ripe tannins. A wine that is built to age and recommended to cellar for 15+ years.

100 Points - James Suckling

This elite wine in the Schrader lineup is a selection of the best barrels from three cabernet clones planted in the Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville. Ultra ripe in flavor, creamy in texture, with tannins that are soft at first but firm up on the finish. Generous in chocolate, black cherries, blueberries and those broad, melted tannins. Very full-bodied at 15.5% alcohol, but it has inherent acidity for balance. Tasted from a magnum. Drinkable now, but best from 2030.

98 Points - Robert Parker's The Wine Advocate

A best-barrel selection and blend chosen and made by Thomas Rivers Brown, the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Old Sparky Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard essentially takes the characters of the Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard bottling and ratchets up the intensity. Raspberries, blackberries and black cherries cascade over a base of deep Oakville loam and dried spices. It's full-bodied, rich, concentrated and almost creamy in texture, finishing lush and long. Bottled in magnum.

old-fitzgerald-bourbon-bottled-in-bond.title: Old Grand-Dad 7 Year Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
old-fitzgerald-bourbon-bottled-in-bond.bodyHtml:
Old Grand Dad 7 Year Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon is a highly anticipated, limited annual release that elevates the beloved high-rye Kentucky straight bourbon with a 7-year age statement. Produced by the James B. Beam Distilling Co. and adhering to the strict requirements of the 1897 Bottled-in-Bond Act, this expression takes the brand's signature spicy, nutty character and softens the edges through extended oak maturation, resulting in a more robust, deeply rounded, and complex profile than its standard non-age-stated counterpart.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, pulled pork sandwiches, aged cheddar cheese, pecan pie, or caramel popcorn.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper to dark amber in appearance with a smooth, slightly creamy, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Classic high-rye bourbon aromatics featuring sweet caramel, toasted oak, and vanilla, accented by peanut brittle, citrus peel, saltwater taffy, and a hint of mint.

Palate : Rich and warming, opening with brown sugar and vanilla, followed closely by a robust wave of cinnamon, baking spices, nutty undertones, and a touch of sweet cedar wood and orange zest.

Finish : Long, balanced, and pleasantly warming, leaving lingering notes of baking spice, sweet oak, caramel apple, and a signature rye pepper heat.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate the age and proof, or poured over a large ice cube in a rocks glass.

blood-oath-pact-7.title: Blood Oath Pact No. 7 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
blood-oath-pact-7.bodyHtml:
Blood Oath Pact No. 7 is the 2021 edition of Blood Oath, the limited-release bourbon series from Lux Row Distillers in Bardstown, Kentucky, in which John Rempe blends rare bourbons into a one-time pact. This edition marries three ryed bourbons: an extra-aged 14-year-old, an 8-year-old, and a second 8-year-old finished in Sauternes wine casks from Bordeaux, which adds sweetness and extra spice. The mash bill is corn, rye and barley, and it is bottled as a Kentucky straight bourbon at 49.3% ABV (98.6 proof). Each pact is made once and never repeated.

Tasting Notes: Caramel, oak, honey and stone fruit.

Nose: Caramel and assertive oak with a hint of honey.

Palate: Caramel and oak.

Finish: Apricot, honey and peach.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

mouton-cadet-white-bordeaux.title: Baron Philippe De Rothschild Mouton Cadet White Bordeaux 2021 750ml

stock-extra-dry-white-vermouth.title: Stock Extra Dry White Vermouth 1L
stock-extra-dry-white-vermouth.bodyHtml: Based on a combination of Italian table wine fortified with Italian brandy and more than 50 delicately-infused natural herbs, spices, roots and seeds.Lionello Stock’s original recipe for Stock Vermouth is based on a combination of Italian table wine fortified with Italian brandy and more than 50 delicately-infused natural herbs, spices, roots and seeds. This traditional process is still used to create an incomparable family of world-class vermouths, available as Extra Dry, Rosso or Bianco. Imported Stock Extra Dry Vermouth is naturally crystal-clear and low in sugar. The perfect aperitif or martini mixer: balanced and subtle in taste. Clear water-white; subtle aromas of lemon zest, anise, and dried green herbs; on the palate it is dry and medium bodied with flavours of citrus, eucalyptus, black licorice and white flower.

kwv-roodeberg-red.title: KWV Roodeberg Red 2021 750ml
kwv-roodeberg-red.bodyHtml:
Aromatic layers of plum, cherry and tobacco with undertones of fresh strawberry on the nose.

This famous red blend shows aromatic layers of mixed berries, spicy dried herbs and fruit cake, with undertones of fresh strawberry. The palate is well rounded with nuances of cedary oak and aniseed accompanied by a luscious tannin structure and a lingering finish.

deinhard-green-label.title: Deinhard Green Label Riesling 750ml
deinhard-green-label.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2015 vintage) "Sweet peach gummies, pear, apple butter, in this simple, juicy riesling from the Mosel. Soft, round and short, but pleasant. Not all wine needs be contemplative or involved. This is Mosel Riesling: drink now, chilled well (Treve Ring)." - 86/100, Gismondi on Wine

deinhard-piesport-goldtropfchen.title: Deinhard Piesport Goldtropfchen 750ml
deinhard-piesport-goldtropfchen.bodyHtml: Deinhard Piesport Goldtropfchen 750ml is a Riesling wine from the Mosel region of Germany. It's described as an expressive wine with fruitiness, exhibiting notes of apples, mango, and flint. It's known for its balanced sweetness, fine minerality, crisp acidity, and a long, fruity finish characteristic of the slate terroir. The wine is often described as light, delicate, and off-dry, with aromas of tree fruit, honey, and minerals.

potters-special-old.title: Potter's Special Old
potters-special-old.bodyHtml:
Potter's Special Old Canadian Rye Whisky comes from Highwood Distillers in High River, Alberta, under the Potter's label the brand has carried since 1958. Highwood's whiskies begin with small-batch distillation and are aged in charred oak barrels, with grain selection and blending done to suit each brand. The whisky blogger The Rum Howler named it the best economy Canadian whisky, writing that it drinks like a much older whisky, with none of the harshness of young spirit and a classic, old-time Canadian rye character. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Clean spicy rye, light oak, soft vanilla and a touch of corn.

Palate: Clean, spicy rye carried by light oak, with a soft vanilla note and a light accent of corn.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or with ginger ale or cola.

yellow-tail-merlot.title: Yellow Tail Merlot 750ml
yellow-tail-merlot.bodyHtml:
Style
Soft, velvety, and smooth, [yellow tail] Merlot is an excellent alternative to the heavier and more tannic red varieties.

Aroma
Soft aromas of ripe plums, mulberries, lingering vanilla and the sweet spiciness of Christmas cake.

Flavour
Soft and smooth, with notes of dark plum, mulberries and subtle spice.

Enjoy
With antipasto, good times and great friends.

fontanafredda-barbera-dalba-raimonda.title: Fontanafredda Raimonda Barbera d'Alba
fontanafredda-barbera-dalba-raimonda.bodyHtml:
The colour is deep ruby-red when young, it tends to garnet-red on ageing. It has a rather intense, characteristic nose which is flowery and fruity at the same time, with nice light overtones of wood, spices and vanilla. The flavour is full, persistent, nicely dry and velvety. The wine is already perfect to drink one years after the vintage. Its character and personality will becompleted by a further period of ageing in the bottle.

This is a wine which deserves to be served with main course dishes. Excellent with full-flavour dishes, meats and cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Attractive nose with aromas of dried orange peel, mild spices, ripe cherries and raspberries. Medium-bodied, racy and bright on the palate, with depth and layers to its fruit. Shows good structure, with firm tannins and wet stone mineral complexity at the end. Sustainable. Drink now.
91 Points - Wine Spectator
Succulent and bursting with raspberry and cherry aromas and flavors, this red is spry and vibrant, leaving a mouthwatering impression. The finish echoes ample fruit notes, plus mineral details. Drink now through 2029.

silk-tassel.title: Silk Tassel 1.14L
silk-tassel.bodyHtml:
Silk Tassel Canadian Whisky is a long-standing Canadian whisky brand, presented here in the 1.14L format. Bottled at 40% ABV, it belongs to the Sazerac Company, which bought the brand from Corby Distilleries in 2011 together with its Montréal manufacturing and bottling facility, where a significant share of the brands in that deal are produced. It is a straightforward, everyday Canadian whisky for mixing or for pouring over ice, and the larger bottle suits home bars and gatherings. 1.14L.

Serve: Over ice, or mixed with ginger ale or cola.

broken-ladder-apples-and-hops.title: Broken Ladder Apples And Hops 4 Tall Cans
broken-ladder-apples-and-hops.bodyHtml: Broken Ladder Apples And Hops 4 Tall Cans

j-p-wisers-deluxe.title: J.P. Wiser's Deluxe NHL Edition Canadian Whisky
j-p-wisers-deluxe.bodyHtml:
J.P. Wiser's Deluxe NHL Edition Canadian Whisky is a special NHL-themed presentation of the classic J.P. Wiser's Deluxe, combining Canadian whisky tradition with a celebration of hockey. This smooth, full-flavoured whisky offers a balanced profile of toasted grain, caramel-like sweetness, rich toffee and oak, presented in collectible NHL Edition packaging.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled burgers, barbecue ribs, roast pork, smoked meats, aged cheddar, maple-glazed dishes or dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: Smooth and balanced with toasted grain, rich toffee, gentle sweetness and oak-driven warmth.

Nose: Inviting aromas of caramel, toasted grain, subtle dried fruit and oak.

Palate: Smooth and rounded with rich toffee, caramel sweetness, toasted grain and seasoned oak character.

Finish: Warm, smooth and lingering with gentle sweetness and oak.

yellow-tail-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Yellow Tail Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
yellow-tail-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Style
Cabernet Sauvignon is fragrant and rich, a perfect wine to accompany a hearty meal.

Aroma
A fragrant aroma of red fruits and blackcurrants fills the nose, along with blackberries and sweet mocha.

Flavour
Classic and velvety, with notes of juicy blackcurrants, sweet mocha and spice.

Enjoy
With a Sunday roast, family and friends.

deinhard-riesling-dry.title: Deinhard Riesling Dry 750ml
deinhard-riesling-dry.bodyHtml: Deinhard Green Label Dry Riesling is a dry, crisp white wine from Germany, specifically the Mosel Valley. It's known for its pale straw color and aromas of green apple, lime, and subtle minerals. On the palate, it offers a clean, dry taste with bright acidity, citrus flavors, and a touch of flint. This versatile wine pairs well with light dishes like seafood, salads, and grilled vegetables.

yellow-tail-shiraz.title: Yellow Tail Shiraz
yellow-tail-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Yellow Tail Shiraz is a vibrant, easy-drinking, and immensely popular Australian red wine that focuses entirely on approachable, fruit-forward flavors. It displays a deep purple-crimson color in the glass, releasing an inviting and highly expressive bouquet of ripe dark plum, juicy blackcurrant, and wild blackberry, accented by subtle, classic notes of cracked black pepper and sweet vanilla bean. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied wine is exceptionally smooth and velvety, wrapping soft, round tannins around a generous core of sweet berry preserves and milk chocolate that leads to a clean, crowd-pleasing finish.

Food Pairing: This versatile red pairs excellently with casual everyday meals such as barbecued burgers, grilled sausages, wood-fired pepperoni pizza, beef tacos, or simple charcuterie boards.

russian-prince-vodka-3.title: Russian Prince Vodka 375ml
russian-prince-vodka-3.bodyHtml:
Russian Prince Vodka is a Canadian vodka made in Ontario by Bacardi Canada and bottled at 40% ABV. It is a light-bodied, clear and colourless vodka, triple filtered for purity, clarity and a clean, smooth taste, which makes it an easy all-purpose mixer. The 375ml size is a convenient half bottle.

Serve: Chilled, or with soda, tonic or juice in a highball.

mission-hill-five-pinot-noir.title: Mission Hill Reserve Crafted in BC Pinot Gris
mission-hill-five-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Fresh and aromatic, with ripe pear, peach, green apple, citrus, and delicate floral notes. The palate is bright and rounded, showing juicy orchard fruit, refreshing acidity, gentle texture, and a clean, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with seafood, grilled fish, roast chicken, fresh salads, sushi, creamy pasta, soft cheeses, or lightly spiced Asian dishes.

beach-house-sauvignon-blanc.title: Beach House Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
beach-house-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2022 vintage) "Subtle citrus notes arise from the glass. Mouthwatering acidity adds tension to a racy palate that features grass, ripe peach and lemon zest." - 87/100, Wine Enthusiast

branvin-canadian-sherry.title: Canadian Club Invitation Series 15 Year Old Sherry Cask
branvin-canadian-sherry.bodyHtml: First, in the series, this one-time release whisky has all the hallmark notes of CC Classic 12 YO elevated to 15 years with the secondary aging in Oloroso sherry casks. The results are rich aromas of toffee, spice and subtle sweetness with warm and creamy flavours with mellow wood on the palate. Sip neat or over ice.

beach-house-red.title: Beach House Red 750ml
beach-house-red.bodyHtml: The Beach House Red (750ml) is a medium-bodied red wine with a smooth, velvety texture and a blend of black fruit and spice flavors. It features notes of blackberries, plums, and a touch of black pepper, with hints of vanilla and oak. The taste is described as full-bodied and lush, with dark fruit flavors and a subtle smokiness. It pairs well with barbecue, burgers, and Asian food. The wine is produced by Beach House in South Africa.

copper-moon-merlot.title: Copper Moon Merlot 1.5L Magnum
copper-moon-merlot.bodyHtml: The Copper Moon Merlot 1.5L Magnum is a red wine with a rich, fruit-forward character. It showcases notes of red and dark fruits, with hints of spice and a smooth, velvety texture. It's a medium-bodied wine that is quaffable and fun to enjoy.

farnese-pinot-grigio.title: Fantini Pinot Grigio
farnese-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Straw yellow with golden highlights. Complex, fruit and herbal aromas, with hints of oak, vanilla and nutmeg. Fruity, peach, grapefruit, lemon-lime and mineral favours. Medium body with roundness, a pleasant mouthfeel and good balance. The finish is long, clean and spicy yet delicate.

sassicaia-2018.title: Tenuta San Guido Sassicaia 2020 6L Imperial
sassicaia-2018.bodyHtml:
The 2020 is a beautiful vintage of Sassicaia that presents itself at a young age with a marked acidity and freshness and beautiful complexity both on the nose and in the mouth. It well identifies the style of elegance typical of Sassicaia in which the structure never dominates the elegance and flavor of the wine. The bouquet is especially intriguing with a very lively plummy fruit element that is enhanced by baker's chocolate, pepper spice, iron ore, caramel, and pie crust. The tannins, although noble and silky, require a longer period of maturation in glass compared to other previous years, but already at a young age the wine presents itself with a beautiful freshness and very harmonious.

97 Points - Decanter

Frosts damaged the the earlier-developing Cabernet Franc in late March, leading to reduced production but superb quality fruit. Spring was mild and summer was generally warm, but a rapid acceleration of maturation in late summer forced the team to begin picking in the first week of September to avoid any overripeness. A traditional 85% Cabernet Sauvignon and 15% Cabernet Franc blend, its blackcurranty, dusty, leafy and cedary character is brought into focus by an intense and balsamic palate. It's poised and light on its feet with super-fresh acidity and a fine-grained, almost imperceptible tannic structure. Ripe and tangy raspberry and blueberry fruits linger on the mid-palate, leading to a long, fresh finish with some cream and chocolate notes. This will reward cellaring into the 2050s, yet you'll get plenty of pleasure from it in its youth. 'We advise to keep it at least 10 months in the bottle before opening,' states third-generation Priscilla Incisa della Rocchetta.

97 Points - James Suckling

A very perfumed Sassicaia on the nose with forest floor, citrus and deep dark fruits. Blackcurrants. Cedar and black tea. Some balsamic. Pine needles. Full and very succulent. Really long, structured and complete. Tangy and energetic with a linear line of fresh tannins and acidity. Very Sassicaia throughout. 85% cabernet sauvignon and the rest is cabernet franc. Very attractive now in a youthful and vibrant way, but this will be better in three to four years. Try after 2027.

97 Points - Vinous

The 2020 Sassicaia is a bold, rapturous wine. Dark, fleshy and expansive on the palate, the 2020 offers up scents of blackberry jam, gravel, spice, new leather, licorice and crème de cassis. Potent tannins are nearly buried by the sheer intensity of the fruit. Sassicaia is never a huge wine, the 2020 does seem to have an extra dimension of textural intensity. It's an intensity that is hugely appealing.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Complex aromas and flavors of black currant, blackberry, iron, sweet tobacco and Mediterranean herbs are the hallmarks of this elegant, tensile red, which is already revealing plenty, yet still feels reserved, as though there were many more facets to be discovered. Superb harmony, freshness and a long aftertaste prevail. Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The Tenuta San Guido 2020 Bolgheri Sassicaia speaks to those who seek a more voluptuous, opulent and, ultimately, more accessible wine. This vintage is a precise reflection of Coastal Tuscany, as opposed to a more generic "Tuscan" wine from elsewhere in this large central Italian region. You taste the ripeness and soft fruit weight that comes from a coastal appellation with especially bright luminosity and warm Mediterranean offshore breezes. Sassicaia from the cool vintages is a famously reticent or withholding wine in its earliest years, requiring a long lead time before it eases into an ideal drinking window. That's definitely not the case here. This wine is beautiful and compelling straight out of the gate, showing a lovely mix of dark fruit, oak spice, balanced freshness, textural richness, soft tannins and an expertly contained 14% alcohol content. The wine's immediate character is what distinguishes this vintage, and I wouldn't get too fussed by exaggerated cellar-aging ambitions. The wine awards sheer pleasure in its current form, with dazzling primary fruit and soaring intensity over the near and medium term.

cockburn-late-bottled-vintage.title: Cockburn's Late Bottled Vintage Port 2017 750ml
cockburn-late-bottled-vintage.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "This is a fine perfumed Port, rich and smoothed from wood aging. Dried black fruits and a spicy character give this wine richness while also having a fine structure at the end." - 90/100, Wine Enthusiast

cupcake-red-velvet.title: Cupcake Red Velvet 750ml
cupcake-red-velvet.bodyHtml: Cupcake Vineyards Red Velvet is a rich red wine blend, primarily sourced from California. It's known for its notes of chocolate, blackberry, and red fruit, with a creamy mocha finish. It pairs well with a variety of foods, including steak, cheeseburgers, and even s'mores.

vina-esmeralda.title: Vina Esmeralda 750ml
vina-esmeralda.bodyHtml: Torres Viña Esmeralda 750ml is a light-bodied, aromatic white wine from Catalonia, Spain, crafted from a blend of Muscat and Gewürztraminer grapes. It offers a refreshing, off-dry taste with notes of jasmine, citrus, and ripe peaches. This wine is ideal for pairing with seafood or light salads and is perfect for warm-weather sipping.

korbel-brut.title: Korbel Brut 750ml
korbel-brut.bodyHtml: Korbel Brut is a medium-dry, bottle-fermented California champagne known for its lively, crisp flavor profile. It features a balanced finish and aromas of citrus and cinnamon, with flavors of orange, lime, vanilla, and a hint of strawberry. The wine is made using the traditional méthode champenoise, where the grapes are harvested about two weeks earlier than is typical for still wines, promoting delicate, crisp, bright flavors.

canada-cooler-original-citrus.title: Canada Cooler Original Citrus 2L
canada-cooler-original-citrus.bodyHtml: Canada Cooler Original Citrus is a 2-liter beverage that is made in Canada, specifically in Alberta. It's a fruity, citrus-flavored cooler with a 4% alcohol content and is sold in a plastic container. The beverage is available for purchase at various stores like Howard Johnson Beer Store.

sierra-canabria-crianza.title: El Coto Crianza 2020 750ml
sierra-canabria-crianza.bodyHtml:
El Coto Crianza is exceptionally balanced with layers of fresh raspberry, cherry, spice and toasted oak, building to a silky finish.

Perfectly complements a variety of meats and cheeses, especially jamon.

Professional Ratings

  • 90 Points James Suckling
    Creamy oak spices and chocolate to the elegant berries and plums. Medium-bodied on the palate with a fluid core of red fruit followed by soft tannins and a juicy, medium-length finish with a hint of cream...

hochtaler-dry.title: Hochtaler Dry 4L Bag in Box
hochtaler-dry.bodyHtml: Hochtaler Dry is a Canadian white wine, specifically a dry, medium-bodied style with primary flavors of tropical and citrus fruits like peach, pineapple, and lemon. It is known for its vibrant and aromatic nature, making it a good pairing with fresh seafood, vegetarian dishes, or creamy sauces.

copper-moon-merlot-1.title: Copper Moon 'Moonlight Harvest' Merlot 750ml
copper-moon-merlot-1.bodyHtml: Copper Moon Merlot is a red wine known for its smooth, medium-bodied profile and flavors of black cherry, black currants, and plum. It also features hints of spice and oak on the finish. This wine, made with 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Sauvignon, is a popular choice for its easy-drinking nature and versatility with food.

danzante-prosecco.title: Danzante Prosecco 750ml
danzante-prosecco.bodyHtml: Danzante Prosecco, a 750ml bottle, is an extra-dry sparkling wine from Italy, known for its lively mousse and intensely fruity aroma with notes of apple and pear. It's described as fresh, well-balanced, and aromatic, with a palate that is savory and refreshing. The wine is produced in the Prosecco DOC appellation using grapes from the hills of that region.

walkers-special-old.title: Walker Special Old 1.75L
walkers-special-old.bodyHtml:
Walker's Special Old is a long-established Canadian whisky in the Hiram Walker family, made since the 1850s and labelled as a rye whisky, known for a bold, spicy style that appeals to seasoned whisky drinkers and newcomers alike. This 1.75L bottle is bottled at 40% ABV, a practical size for parties and home bars. Its toasty, spicy character and grain-driven palate make it a versatile, great-value choice for mixed drinks and classic whisky cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Toasty and spicy, with vanilla, caramel and pepper.

Nose: Toast and spice with vanilla, caramel and peppercorn.

Palate: Cereal grains, cinnamon and pepper.

Serve: In cocktails, with ginger ale or cola, or on the rocks.

santa-rita-120-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Santa Rita 120 Reserva Especial Cabernet Sauvignon
santa-rita-120-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Santa Rita 120 Reserva Especial Cabernet Sauvignon is a versatile and accessible Chilean red wine hailing from the Central Valley. On the nose, it delivers ripe aromas of black cherry, plum, and cassis complemented by subtle notes of vanilla, clove, and toasted oak. The palate features a smooth, medium-bodied structure with silky tannins, balanced acidity, and a fruit-forward finish with delicate hints of spice.

Food Pairing: Complements grilled steaks, roasted pork loin, beef empanadas, tomato-based pasta dishes, sausage stews, and medium-aged cheeses like gouda or cheddar.

botter-moscato.title: Bottega 'Petalo' Il Vino dell Amore Moscato Spumante
botter-moscato.bodyHtml:
Bottega 'Petalo' Il Vino dell Amore Moscato Spumante pours a beautiful straw yellow with fine and lasting perlage. The nose is remarkably complex, intense, and delicate, opening with floral notes of rose, wisteria, and wildflowers, alongside fruity aromas of yellow peach, apricot, and citrus. On the palate, this spumante is velvety and pleasantly sweet, maintaining excellent freshness due to a balanced backbone of acidity that perfectly offsets the sugar content, leading into a persistent finish with hints of sage.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with fruit flans, peach shortcake, classic panettone, dry pastries, or alongside aged, artisanal blue cheeses.

woodbridge-white-zinfandel.title: Woodbridge Sauvignon Blanc NV 750ml
woodbridge-white-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Woodbridge Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp, vibrant, and approachable California white wine crafted by Woodbridge by Robert Mondavi in Lodi, California. Sourced from sunny California vineyards—primarily across the Lodi and Central Valley regions—the Sauvignon Blanc grapes are gently pressed and fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to preserve pure varietal freshness. In the glass, it displays a luminous pale straw-yellow hue with subtle green reflections. The aromatic profile opens with expressive notes of lemongrass, starfruit, grapefruit, and white flowers. On the palate, it delivers a light-to-medium body marked by mouthwatering flavors of lime, Meyer lemon, and crisp green apple, balanced by lively acidity and a clean, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, crab cakes, herb-roasted chicken, summer salads with tangy goat cheese, or grilled garlic prawns.

wine-oclock-pinot-grigio.title: Gemma Di Luna Pinot Grigio
wine-oclock-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Gemma di Luna Pinot Grigio is a refreshing Italian white wine crafted from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes grown in northeastern Italy's Delle Venezie DOC region. Presented in the brand's distinctive turquoise bottle, this elegant wine showcases delicate aromas of white peach, crisp apple, and fresh citrus. Its light-bodied palate delivers smooth orchard fruit flavours, subtle strawberry notes, and lively acidity, finishing with a refreshing touch of lime zest. Produced without oak influence, it offers a bright, approachable expression of classic Italian Pinot Grigio.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp, fresh oysters, lemon-herb chicken, Caprese salad, seafood pasta, grilled vegetables, and soft mozzarella.

gato-negro-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Gato Negro Cabernet Sauvignon 1.5L Magnum
gato-negro-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Dark ruby-red in color. Bursting with red fruit aromas such as berries, cassis and cherries melded with hints of sweet vanilla and coconut. A fresh sensation with medium body, smooth tannins and a long, pleasing finish.

highwood-long-island-iced-tea.title: Highwood Long Island Iced Tea Mix 1.14L
highwood-long-island-iced-tea.bodyHtml:
Highwood Long Island Iced Tea Mix is a premixed spirit base from Highwood Distillers in High River, Alberta. Following the traditional 1970s recipe, it combines four Highwood spirits (vodka, gin, rum and triple sec) in one bottle, so only a mixer is needed to finish the drink. The back label sets out the recipe, down to the ounce, for building a Long Island Iced Tea. Bottled at 36% ABV in a 1.14L plastic bottle.

Serve: Over ice, built to the recipe on the back label.

jacobs-creek-chardonnay.title: Jacob's Creek Classic Chardonnay 2023
jacobs-creek-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Jacob's Creek Classic Chardonnay 2023 is a medium-bodied Australian white wine offering ripe melon, juicy peach and refreshing citrus flavours. Subtle toasted oak notes complement its smooth, creamy texture, while lively fruit character brings balance and freshness. Approachable and well-rounded, this Chardonnay delivers an appealing combination of vibrant fruit and gentle oak complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with herb-roasted chicken, grilled white fish, creamy seafood pasta, garlic butter prawns and soft Brie cheese.

gnarly-head-zinfandel.title: Gnarly Head Old Vine Zinfandel 2021/2022 750ml
gnarly-head-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Gnarly Head Zinfandel 750ml is a bold, full-bodied red wine from Lodi, California, with a 14.5% ABV. This fruit-forward Zinfandel delivers flavors of blackberries, plums, and spice, with a smooth finish. Ideal for pairing with barbecue or spicy pasta, it showcases the rich, bold character of old-vine Zinfandel.

Region and Appellation:
Lodi, California, USA

Grape Variety/Varieties:
Zinfandel

Wine Type:
Red Wine

Tasting Notes:
Gnarly Head Zinfandel is bold and juicy, offering intense aromas of blackberries, ripe plums, and spice. The palate is full-bodied, with rich flavors of dark fruit, vanilla, and a hint of pepper. Smooth tannins and a lingering finish make this wine perfect for those who enjoy robust, fruit-forward reds.

Body:
Full-bodied

Sweetness:
Dry

Alcohol Content:
14.5%

Bottle Size:
750ml

Winemaker or Producer Information:
Gnarly Head wines are crafted from old-vine Zinfandel grapes grown in Lodi, California, a region renowned for its rich soils and perfect growing conditions. Known for its bold, fruit-driven wines, Gnarly Head Zinfandel embodies the spirit of California winemaking with its intense flavors and approachable style.

Food Pairings:
Pairs wonderfully with barbecue ribs, grilled sausages, or spicy pasta dishes.

Serving Recommendations:
Serve at 60-65°F (15-18°C). No need to decant, but letting the wine breathe for 15 minutes enhances the aromas.

duckhorn-sauvignon-blanc.title: Duckhorn North Coast Sauvignon Blanc 2024 375ml
duckhorn-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn North Coast Sauvignon Blanc 2024 is a remarkably crisp, elegant, and beautifully structured white wine. From the first swirl, it captivates with expressive aromas of candied pineapple, ripe guava, and sliced honeydew melon, layered with a delicate flourish of key lime blossom and fresh lemon verbena. On the palate, vibrant notes of fresh melon and tree fruit take center stage, harmonizing with bright citrus undertones. The addition of Sémillon to the blend contributes a rich, silky mouthfeel and added depth, while a lively, energetic acidity provides brilliant precision. The wine culminates in a focused, juicy finish marked by a subtle touch of flinty minerality.

Food Pairing: This vibrant white wine pairs exquisitely with fresh seafood dishes, such as grilled sea bass, shrimp scampi, oysters on the half shell, and crab cakes. It is also an excellent complement to herb-roasted chicken, light pasta dishes, green salads with vinaigrette, and fresh goat cheese.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of lemon zest, white peaches, grapefruit, lemongrass and wet stones. The midweight palate shows bright acidity and a smooth, textural mouthfeel, giving freshness and balance to the finish. Drink now. Screw cap.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This classic Sauvy B from an iconic producer continues to be a favorite poolside or anytime in your glass. Crowd pleasing zippy aromatics of citrus segments, lemon grass, papaya, and notes of white flowers on the nose; the flavors tease the palate with lively fruit and texture that says please smile.

mumm-brut.title: G.H. Mumm Cordon Rouge Brut
mumm-brut.bodyHtml:
G.H. Mumm Cordon Rouge Brut is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex Old World champagne that serves as the historic, internationally recognized signature of the house. It pours a brilliant golden yellow colour with jade highlights and an energetic, streaming stream of fine bubbles, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of fresh yellow peaches, crunchy green apples, and zesty citrus fruits, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of rich buttery brioche, wild honey, praline, and warm vanilla bean. On the palate, this medium-bodied sparkling wine is remarkably smooth, crisp, and fresh, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of ripe orchard fruits, fresh grapes, and a lovely structural crunch that highlights the dominance of Pinot Noir. Driven by a finely balanced, food-friendly acidity and a super-sleek texture, its rich tension carries into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by a lingering touch of chalky minerality, caramel, and baked bread.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of fresh or refined culinary choices, including freshly shucked oysters, pan-seared sea scallops, smoked salmon blinis, roasted poultry or turkey breast, creamy wild mushroom risottos, and cured meats or salty appetizers.

91 Points - James Suckling

Quite a complex nose of candied citrus, crisp and dried pear with a touch of bread dough. Then an appealing balance of fruit, fresh acidity and lively mousse on the medium-bodied palate. Long, animating, lemony finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh and balanced Champagne in the aperitif style, with the creamy mousse carrying flavors of ripe yellow apple, toast point and candied lemon peel. A hint of smoky mineral shows on the finish. Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier. Drink now.

35-sherry-okanagan-cellars.title: 35 Sherry Okanagan Cellars 750ml
35-sherry-okanagan-cellars.bodyHtml: Distinctively rich and nutty, this after sherry is perfect for pairing with strong cheeses or as a desert in and of itself.

matua-sauvignon-blanc-marlborough.title: Matua Sauvignon Blanc Marlborough 2022 750ml
matua-sauvignon-blanc-marlborough.bodyHtml:
This classic Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc is deliciously pure, bursting with ripe lemon citrus notes and hints of passion fruit and basil. The palate is fresh and vibrant with concentrated blackcurrant leaf and a touch of classic cut grass and green melon. So refreshing, you'll be left wanting more.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Delivers a fresh, lovely mix of Key lime, mango and Meyer lemon flavors, with a touch of salted ripe melon on a sleek, juicy frame. Shows a hint of lemongrass that lingers.

wolf-blass-red-label-shiraz-cabernet.title: Wolf Blass Red Label Shiraz Cabernet 750ml
wolf-blass-red-label-shiraz-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Wolf Blass Wines, established in 1966, has grown from a humble tin shed to become one of the world’s most successful and awarded wineries. Today, Wolf Blass wines are exported to more than 50 countries and are recognized internationally as icons of modern winemaking. The essence of Wolf Blass wines is exemplified through the passion of its custodians, past and present as they continue to create wines of quality, character and consistency.

88 Points - James Suckling
A reliable and crowd-pleasing Australian blend, offering a classic mix of dark plum from the Shiraz and structure from the Cabernet. Soft tannins and a smooth finish make it a consistent, easy-drinking choice.
87 Points - Wine Companion
This blend delivers straightforward berry flavors and a well-balanced, approachable profile. A dependable and widely enjoyable red that represents solid value.

st-francis-chardonnay.title: St. Francis Chardonnay 2023
st-francis-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
This elegant Chardonnay brings refreshing notes of fresh pear, crisp apple and a hint of butterscotch on the nose. Rich flavors of orange blossom honey, apple galette, roasted pear and white peach emerge on the mid-palate and complement the touch of minerality on the finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This lighter-styled and nimble Chard brings aromas of lemon peel, white flowers and tangerine on the nose, giving way to flavors of pear, river rocks, spice and orange blossom on the palate and finish.

gray-monk-riesling.title: Gray Monk Riesling 750ml
gray-monk-riesling.bodyHtml: Clear and bright with pure fruit aromas of yellow apple, white peach, and sweet citrus. This light-bodied, refreshing white wine is medium-dry with great balancing acidity. Flavours of Meyer lemon, pineapple, and peach excite the palate. Fresh and clean with a citrus medley and green apple flavours lingering on the finish.

jackson-triggs-ps-chardonnay.title: Jackson Triggs Ps Chardonnay 1.5L Magnum
jackson-triggs-ps-chardonnay.bodyHtml: The Jackson-Triggs Proprietor's Selection Chardonnay is described as a fresh and full-flavored wine with notes of apple, pear, and subtle oak. It's available in 750ml, 1.5L, and 4L sizes. This Chardonnay is well-paired with grilled chicken or a sunset, according to Jackson-Triggs.

sterling-napa-merlot.title: Sterling Vineyards Napa Valley Merlot 750ml
sterling-napa-merlot.bodyHtml: It is medium-body and has a bold flavor, with hints of cherry, chocolate, and herbs. Sterling Napa Merlot offers a brilliant ruby-red hue and robust notes of cherries, herbs and dark chocolate. This medium-bodied, Napa Valley-grown wine is perfect for any occasion. Renowned for its precision and complexity, Sterling Napa Merlot provides an unforgettable taste experience.

jackson-triggs-ps-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Jackson Triggs Proprietors Selection Cabernet Sauvignon 1.5L Magnum
jackson-triggs-ps-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Jackson-Triggs Proprietors' Selection Cabernet Sauvignon is an approachable Canadian red wine crafted for everyday enjoyment and effortless entertaining. Presented in a generous 1.5L magnum format, this Cabernet Sauvignon offers a fruit-forward character with dark berry flavours, gentle spice, and a smooth, balanced finish. Its easy-drinking style makes it a versatile choice for casual gatherings, family dinners, and celebrations.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, barbecue ribs, roasted beef, lamb burgers, tomato-based pasta, and aged cheddar.

bottega-prosecco-brut.title: Bottega Gold Prosecco Brut
bottega-prosecco-brut.bodyHtml:
Bottega Gold Prosecco Brut displays a brilliant straw-yellow color with a fine, persistent perlage in the glass. The nose is clean and remarkably expressive, unfolding with elegant aromas of green apple, Williams pear, and citrus fruit, beautifully underpinned by delicate floral notes of acacia, wisteria, and lily of the valley alongside a faint hint of sage. On the palate, this iconic Italian sparkling wine is soft, harmonious, and elegant, showcasing a light body and a vibrant, well-balanced backbone of acidity. Fresh orchard fruit and exotic flavors seamlessly drive into a clean, dry, and thoroughly refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with fresh seafood appetizers, steamed or raw fish dishes, light prosecco risotti, or served as an elegant celebratory aperitif.

e-j-brandy.title: Emperador Light Brandy
e-j-brandy.bodyHtml:
Emperador Light is the lighter-strength expression of Emperador, the best-known brandy brand of the Philippines. The front label describes it as a premium brandy liqueur made from spirits distilled from grapes, blended and bottled by Emperador Distillers, Inc. in Quezon City, and meticulously blended for an extra-smooth character, full body and a distinctive aroma. At 27.5% alcohol by volume it is noticeably gentler than a standard 40% brandy, which is why it is widely poured long with cola, soda or over ice rather than neat. This listing is the 750ml bottle, a product of the Philippines.

Serve: Over ice, or long with cola or soda water.

wine-oclock-malbec.title: Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023
wine-oclock-malbec.bodyHtml:
Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023 is a powerful yet incredibly elegant Argentine red crafted by Dr. Laura Catena, highlighting the genetic diversity and depth of Mendoza's historic, low-yielding vines. Sourced from high-altitude, ungrafted vines (averaging over 50 years old) across premier subregions of the Uco Valley—including La Consulta, Gualtallary, and Paraje Altamira—it pours a deep, luminous purplish-red. The nose is inviting and complex, offering expressive aromas of dark plums, ripe black cherries, and wild berries, thoughtfully accented by notes of cocoa, bark, charcoal, and subtle dried herbs. On the palate, it is precise, linear, and gracefully structured, showcasing a juicy core of crunchy red and blue fruit balanced by velvety, approachable tannins and a vibrant vein of natural acidity. Matured for 12 months in a combination of new and second-use French oak barrels, it delivers a deeply refined and stylish finish laced with savory hints of espresso and bright mineral tension.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with grilled venison, traditional Argentine ribeye steak with chimichurri, roasted lamb shanks, hearty pork roast, or medium-strong cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

This shows plums, bark and charcoal on the nose. The palate is precise, sharp, linear and super elegant, with velvety tannins and crunchy fruit. It’s long, refined and very stylish. Drink now.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Old Vine Malbec combines ungrafted vines from six Uco Valley growers who previously sold grapes for use in bulk wines. It was destemmed and fermented in stainless tank before maturing for 12 months in 35% new barrique. Opening with a pleasant nose of red and blue fruits, anise and dried spices, the palate is plush and straightforward, concluding with a lifted, fragrant finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose reveals enticing aromas of crushed berries leading the way to a juicy palate filled with rich dark fruit flavors and a hint of rosemary. Framed by gripping tannins and vibrant acidity, this full-bodied Malbec features a distinctive chalky texture and a long lasting finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Hints of roasted herbs and loam lead but quickly give way to the core flavors of Santa Rosa plum and cherry, culminating with crunchy acidity, mineral and cocoa powder notes that fill out the structured finish.

ferrari-carano-fume-blanc.title: Ferrari-Carano Fume Blanc 2024
ferrari-carano-fume-blanc.bodyHtml:
The 2024 Fumé Blanc is crisp and full of bright fruit characters. Aromas of guava, apricot, and lychee lead to fresh pineapple, mango, peach, and lemon cream on the palate. This wine is light and refreshing - perfect for spring and summer dining al fresco.

Fumé Blanc pairs well with simple seafood and poultry dishes, and also holds up nicely with veal and pork. This wine has lively flavors that go well with spicy and ethnic cuisines such as Japanese, Vietnamese, Thai, Chinese, Korean, Mexican and Southwestern dishes.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of grapefruit, lemon pith, kaffir limes and flint. The light-bodied palate has notes of melons, apricots, white flowers and papayas. Fresh and vibrant with a generous texture. Delicious.

succo-natura-peach-grappa.title: Bottega Pesca & Grappa Peach Liqueur
succo-natura-peach-grappa.bodyHtml:
Bottega Pesca & Grappa, sold in the Succo Natura range, is a peach liqueur from Bottega, the wine, grappa and liqueur house of the Veneto in north-east Italy. Natural juice from peaches is blended with grappa, alcohol and sugar, and the natural extraction method keeps the fruit character fresh and recognisable. This version is bottled at 16% ABV in a 700 ml bottle. Light and sweet, it suits an aperitivo moment, a dessert course or a simple spritz.

Serve: Well chilled or over ice, or topped up with sparkling wine.

kendall-jackson-vr-merlot.title: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
kendall-jackson-vr-merlot.bodyHtml:
Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon is a quintessential, fruit-forward California wine crafted from a multi-appellation blend of primarily mountain and hillside vineyards in Sonoma and Mendocino counties. On the nose, it reveals an inviting and lush bouquet of black cherry, ripe blackberry, and cassis, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of dried culinary herbs, mocha, and toasted vanilla. The palate is medium-bodied and robust yet exceptionally supple, offering a round mid-palate framed by smooth, seamless tannins. Artisan winemaking techniques, including extended maceration and careful maturation in a mix of French and American oak barrels, impart a balanced structural backbone without overpowering the fruit, culminating in an elegant, velvety finish.

 

Food Pairing: Pairs excellently with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, savory mushroom risotto, hearty lasagna, and aged cheeses like sharp cheddar or Gouda.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This complete and well-balanced wine is a pleasure to drink soon, but will also develop more nuances for a few years. Fresh blackberries and blueberries are accented by light vanilla and cinnamon-scented oak spices on a lightly tannic texture.

blouberg.title: Blouberg 750ml
blouberg.bodyHtml: Blouberg 750ml refers to a South African white wine blend, specifically from the Western Cape region. It's a blend of Sauvignon Blanc, Semillon, and Cape Riesling grapes, resulting in a crisp, refreshing wine with aromas of asparagus, green figs, and lemon. The wine maker suggests pairing it with a variety of foods, including pizza, pasta, seafood, poultry, and cheeses.

jackson-triggs-ps-merlot.title: Jackson Triggs Ps Merlot 1.5L Magnum
jackson-triggs-ps-merlot.bodyHtml: The Jackson Triggs Proprietor's Selection Merlot 1.5L Magnum is a Canadian red wine made from Merlot grapes. Great Estates Niagara describes it as being perfumed with aromas of ripe black cherry and cassis, with subtle notes of vanilla, baking spices, and rich cocoa. It also features silky yet pronounced tannins that meld well with flavors of dried cranberry, wild berries, cocoa, and a lingering vanilla finish.

okanagan-raspberry.title: Daydreamer Cabernet Franc
okanagan-raspberry.bodyHtml:
A fragrant Okanagan Cabernet Franc with ripe red cherry, raspberry and blackberry fruit layered with violet, herbs and subtle spice. The palate is medium-bodied and structured, balancing fresh acidity and fine tannins with a savoury, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled lamb, roast pork, duck, mushroom dishes, herb-roasted chicken, charcuterie, or aged cheeses.

copper-moon-malbec.title: Copper Moon Malbec 1.5L Magnum
copper-moon-malbec.bodyHtml:
A smooth, full-bodied red wine, this selection is uniquely crafted for those seeking a cleaner profile with zero grams of sugar while maintaining its traditional strength. On the nose, it opens with rich aromas of vanilla, dark chocolate, and wild field berries. The palate delivers soft, approachable layers of juicy blackberry, dark plum, and black currant accented by subtle notes of warming spice and light oak. Supported by velvety, fine-grained tannins, it finishes clean, dry, and balanced, proving that zero-sugar alternatives can still offer a robust and satisfying experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steaks, hearty pasta dishes with rich meat sauces, wood-fired pizza, barbecued pork ribs, and sharp, aged cheeses.

sonora-ranch-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Cakebread Dancing Bear Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
sonora-ranch-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Generous aromas of black currant, dried cherry, and raspberry jam flow from the glass, with dark chocolate, coffee, dried rosemary, and fig notes emerging over time. The palate is full-bodied and rich, offering concentrated flavors of ripe cherry and blackberry, along with hints of mocha, leather, baking spices, and rocky minerality. Firm yet opulent tannins drive the wine to a long, powerful finish.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

From the winery's estate vineyard on Howell Mountain, the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Dancing Bear Ranch is a blend of 90% Cabernet Sauvignon, 8% Merlot and 2% Cabernet Franc, all aged 22 months in 59% new French oak. Scents of mocha, tree bark, black cherries, raspberries and cherries mark the nose, while the medium to full-bodied palate is supple, lush and long, with ample concentration and some nicely ripe, softly dusty tannins on the lingering finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripe dark-fruited character with hazelnuts, pine wood, chocolate and ground cloves. Medium- to full-bodied, refined and polished, with dusty tannins and succulent fruit. Long finish.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Loganberry and black currant puree flavors stretch out nicely over this red's sleek iron spine, with hints of tar and apple wood. This is accessible now for its polish and fruit. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Cabernet Franc. Drink now through 2034. 2,600 cases made.

veuve-clicquot-brut.title: Veuve Clicquot Brut 375ml
veuve-clicquot-brut.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label manages to reconcile two opposing factors, strength and silkiness and to hold them in perfect balance with aromatic intensity and a lot of freshness. With golden yellow tiny bubbles, this non-vintage Champagne shows the fruitiness of peach, Mirabelle plum, and pear alongside notes of vanilla and toasted brioche. This consistent power to please makes it ideal as an aperitif, and perfect as the Champagne to enjoy with a meal.

92 Points - James Suckling

This has aromas of grapefruit, citrus peel, quince, toast and almonds. It’s medium-bodied with creamy, fine tannins. Silky texture. Nutty complexity at the end.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Lively, with tangy acidity and a zesty mousse, this aperitif-style Champagne shows notes of mandarin orange, blackberry, toast and a touch of pastry cream. Subtle, smoke-tinged finish. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Drink now.

chateau-ste-michelle-merlot.title: Chateau Ste Michelle Cold Creek Merlot 2018
chateau-ste-michelle-merlot.bodyHtml:
Chateau Ste Michelle Cold Creek Merlot 2018 is a rich and polished Washington Merlot with concentrated notes of blackberry, plum, dark cherry, cocoa, cedar, and subtle spice. Velvety tannins and balanced acidity create a full-bodied palate with exceptional depth and a long elegant finish.

91 Points - James Suckling
90 Points - Wine & Spirits

Food Pairing:
Pairs beautifully with roasted lamb, braised short ribs, filet mignon, mushroom risotto, aged cheddar, grilled sausages, hearty pasta dishes, and rich comfort food favourites.

copper-moon-cabernet-sauvignon-1.title: Copper Moon Cabernet Sauvignon 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-cabernet-sauvignon-1.bodyHtml: Copper Moon Cabernet Sauvignon 4L Bag in Box

zenato-pinot-grigio.title: Zenato Pinot Grigio 2024
zenato-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Lemon-green in color, aromas of Key limes and white peaches complement undertones of green apples and grains of paradise. On the palate, it is smooth and refreshing with a long, pleasant finish.

A great choice for any occasion, but it is ideal with hors d'oeuvres, vegetable soups, fresh garden salads, and grilled sole.

casa-lapostolle-sauvignon-blanc.title: Casa Silva Coleccion Sauvignon Blanc
casa-lapostolle-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Fresh and aromatic, with grapefruit, lime, green apple and tropical fruit complemented by delicate herbal and floral notes. The palate is crisp and lively, showing refreshing acidity, bright citrus character and a clean, fruit-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with ceviche, shellfish, grilled white fish, fresh salads, goat cheese, sushi, or lightly seasoned vegetable dishes.

jackson-triggs-ps-sauvignon-blanc.title: Jackson Triggs Ps Sauvignon Blanc 1.5L Magnum
jackson-triggs-ps-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: The Jackson Triggs Proprietor's Selection Sauvignon Blanc 1.5L Magnum is described as a crisp and refreshing white wine. It features notes of lemon, lime, and tangerine, with a flavor profile that is both citrusy and herbaceous. BSW Liquor says it's is committed to providing the best selection of beer, spirits, and wines at the lowest price. All other descriptions are from Wine-Searcher or bcliquor.

red-tassel-vodka-4.title: Red Tassel Vodka 200ml
red-tassel-vodka-4.bodyHtml:
Red Tassel Vodka is a budget-friendly European-style vodka distilled from grains for a clean and simple profile. Designed for utility and ease of mixing, it offers a straightforward taste with gentle grain notes and a light pepper warmth, making it a functional option for casual gatherings and mixed drinks.

Food Pairing: Salty snacks, pickles, cured meats, fried appetizers, or light pasta salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear and transparent appearance with a light-to-medium, straightforward body.

Nose : Subtle ethanol aroma with faint grain sweetness and light neutral mineral notes.

Palate : Simple and crisp with basic wheat grain sweetness and a light peppery spice.

Finish : Short to medium with a direct, warm pepper finish and slight grain bite.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled or mixed into highball cocktails such as a Vodka Soda or Vodka Cranberry.

two-oceans-cabernet-merlot.title: Two Oceans Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot 1.5L Magnum
two-oceans-cabernet-merlot.bodyHtml:
Two Oceans Cabernet Merlot is an approachable, medium-bodied South African red wine blend celebrated for its easy-drinking style and vibrant fruit profile. Sourced from coastal vineyards influenced by cooling maritime breezes, it showcases luscious aromas of dark plum, ripe red berries, blackcurrant, and subtle hints of oak spice. On the palate, the bold structure of Cabernet Sauvignon blends seamlessly with the velvety softness of Merlot, yielding smooth tannins and a refreshingly balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Perfectly complements grilled beef steak, roast lamb chops, savory sausage stews, tomato-based pasta dishes, and mature hard cheeses like cheddar or gouda.

j-p-wisers-deluxe-1.title: J.P. Wiser's Deluxe 200ml
j-p-wisers-deluxe-1.bodyHtml:
J.P. Wiser's Deluxe is the signature Canadian whisky of the J.P. Wiser's family, here in a compact 200ml bottle. Blended and bottled in Windsor, Ontario, it pours a rich amber and brings together caramel, toffee and vanilla sweetness with toasted grains and seasoned oak for a full, rounded palate. Deluxe earned a Silver Medal at the 2025 World Whiskies Awards. Bottled at 40% ABV, the small format is handy for travel, gifting or trying the whisky neat, over ice or in a highball.

Tasting Notes: Caramel, toffee and vanilla with toasted grains and seasoned oak.

Nose: Dried fruit, caramel and lush spring meadows.

Palate: Oak, toasted grains and rich toffee.

Finish: Full, warm and smooth.

Serve: On the rocks, with soda or ginger ale, or in a Whisky Smash.

penfolds-rawsons-shiraz-cabernet.title: Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet-Shiraz 2023
penfolds-rawsons-shiraz-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet-Shiraz 2023 is an iconic, deeply concentrated, and beautifully structured Australian red wine blend affectionately known as "Baby Grange." It opens with an intricate and shifting bouquet of blackcurrants, dark plums, and Black Forest cake, layered with aromatic nuances of dark chocolate, sweet licorice, star anise, and savory rosemary. On the palate, this wine is full-bodied, dense, and tightly coiled, expertly using the prism of a cooler growing season to maintain freshness and poise. The structural Cabernet Sauvignon lends focused notes of graphite, cassis, and black olive, while the Shiraz grounds the mid-palate with rich plum flavors, warmth, and fleshy fruit. Supported by a frame of fine, powder-gravel tannins and sweet American oak vanillin, it glides into a lingering, muscular, and exceptionally savory finish built for long cellaring.

Food Pairing: The bold structural framework, rich black fruits, and pronounced American oak influence of this classic blend make it a spectacular match for heavy, savory dishes. It pairs magnificently with a grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb crusted with herbs, slow-braised beef short ribs, or osso buco. It also provides a fantastic complement to wild boar ragù, roasted venison, wood-fired peppered pizzas, or a board of intense, full-flavored cheeses like aged sharp Cheddar and Gouda.

96 Points - James Suckling

This wine has been made every vintage since 1960. Refined, generous and polished aromas of blackberries, blackcurrants, cured meat, crushed stones and iodine. The palate is full-bodied with a rounded, textural palate and ultra-refined tannins that lead to a silky, savory, black-fruited finish. 51% cabernet sauvignon and 49% shiraz. Excellent. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Bin 389 Cabernet Shiraz is inky, complete, powerful and structured, with black berries, sweet licorice, star anise and fennel. There are also notes of roasted meat juices and cedar wood. The expression of this wine is very attractive—the prism of the cooler season works well in this wine. The fruit is sourced from McLaren Vale, Padthaway and Barossa Valley, matured for 12 months in American oak hogsheads, 33% new.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Distinctive for its appealing savory thread, with notes of crushed pine needle, forest floor, sage, olive tapenade, rosemary and tobacco leaf that complement the core of spiced plum, dried cherry and blackberry preserves. Offers a firm, muscular structure for an appealing backbone. Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz. Drink now through 2037.

king-estate-pinot-gris.title: King Estate Willamette Valley Pinot Gris 2022 750ml
king-estate-pinot-gris.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2021 vintage) "Vibrant apple and herb aromas lead to bone-dry, medium-bodied flavors with plenty of acidity behind them. There's a whole lot of enjoyment to be had—it's delicious. Sean P. Sullivan" - 90/100, Wine Enthusiast

marques-merlot.title: Markham Merlot 2021
marques-merlot.bodyHtml:
The Estate Vineyards provide the backbone to this vibrant Napa Valley Merlot. Aromas of ripe raspberry and plum jam emerge from the glass, enhanced by caramel notes from oak aging. A bright entry of red fruit flavors balanced by stunning minerality and notes of rich, velvety chocolate-covered cherries. A “Cab-Lovers” Merlot with structure, mid-palate weight, and a long, round finish. .

91 Points - James Suckling

Notes of dark berries, dried cherries, licorice and dark chocolate. Medium- to full-bodied, spiced and dark-fruited with chalky, slightly dry tannins. Succulent finish. A little earthy at the end.

90 Points - Wine Enthusist

A juicy palate of cherries and plums drizzled with chocolate and accents of violet candy and herbs make this an intriguing Merlot. A lightly grippy palate persists with a palate-cleansing finish.

ecco-domani-pinot-grigio.title: Ecco Domani Pinot Grigio 750ml
ecco-domani-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Ecco Domani Pinot Grigio is a dry, acidic Italian white wine known for its vibrant citrus and tropical fruit notes, paired with delicate floral aromas. It's a medium-bodied wine that's crisp and refreshing, with a pale straw color and light green and gold flecks. The wine is made with grapes from the high-altitude region of delle Venezie.

windsor-canadian-rye.title: Windsor Canadian Rye
windsor-canadian-rye.bodyHtml:
Windsor Canadian Rye is a Canadian rye whisky from Alberta, bottled at 40% ABV in a lightweight 750ml PET bottle. An everyday Canadian whisky for mixing and casual sipping.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or with ginger ale or cola.

mark-west-pinot-noir.title: Mark West Pinot Noir 2022 750ml
mark-west-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Mark West Pinot Noir is a 750ml bottle of red wine known for its rich, fruity flavor profile with notes of cherry, strawberry, and plum. It's medium-bodied with soft tannins, making it a versatile wine for pairing with various foods. 

Tasting Notes:
Aromas: Black cherry, strawberry, plum.
Flavors: Red and dark cherry, complemented by notes of toasted oak, brown spice, and nutmeg.
Mouthfeel: Silky, smooth, with a full and plush texture.
Finish: Long and rewarding. 
Other Details:
Alcohol Content: 13.5%.
Closure: Screwcap.
Origin: California.

polar-ice-vodka-3.title: Polar Ice Vodka 375ml
polar-ice-vodka-3.bodyHtml:
Polar Ice Vodka is a Canadian vodka from Ontario, crafted from pure water and grains, quadruple distilled and triple filtered for a clean, smooth taste. Bottled at 40% ABV, this is the 375 ml size in a plastic (PET) flask. A no-fuss vodka for mixing into classics such as a Caesar, Moscow Mule or vodka mojito, or for sipping straight up on the rocks.

Serve: In a Caesar, Moscow Mule or vodka mojito, or chilled over ice.

alize-red.title: Alize Red Passion Liqueur
alize-red.bodyHtml: Imported from France, all Alizé flavours begin with the intriguing and delectable blend of all-natural passion fruit and premium French vodka. Intensely aromatic with notes of cranberry and candied strawberry. On the palate, flavours of orange, cranberry, cherry, and passion fruit followed by a long fruity finish.

the-bend-in-the-river-riesling.title: The Bend In The River Riesling
the-bend-in-the-river-riesling.bodyHtml:
A fresh and approachable German Riesling from Reh-Kendermann Weinkellerei, sourced primarily from Rheinhessen. Pale straw in colour, it offers soft apple and citrus aromas with subtle mineral notes, crisp acidity and a gently refreshing finish. A versatile, easy-drinking style for everyday enjoyment.

Food Pairing: Trout, salmon, shellfish, sushi, mild cheeses, pork and lightly spiced Asian dishes.

wynns-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Wynns Coonawara Estate Black Label Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
wynns-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Wynns Black Label Cabernet is a true icon of Australian wine. First produced in 1954, it has a reputation for ageing gracefully and displaying excellent varietal and regional characteristics. The wine is produced from only the top quality 20 to 25 per cent of Cabernet Sauvignon fruit grown in our terra rossa vineyards.

A wine of style and stature - and a perennial favourite in auction circles - ‘Black Label’ is one of Australia’s most collectable wines and Australia’s benchmark Cabernet Sauvignon. It consistently delivers potential for medium to long-term cellaring.

Our 2019 Cabernet is a perfect amalgam of freshness, balance and power that will certainly reward good cellaring. A seamless line of fruit from our terra rossa vineyards is
supported by a fine tannin framework. Flavours of red cherry and plum are complimented by the secondary notes of walnuts and mixed cooking spice. Very intense yet elegant.

Pairs well with Spicy grilled salmon with Coriander Salsa

93 Points - Gismondi

The Black Label Coonawarra Cab has been a forever classic and a pet project of winemaker Sue Hodder for decades. From the tiny sliver of land that is Coonawarra's red terra rossa (iron oxide clays over limestone), Hodder created this affordable benchmark from 50+ year old organically farmed vines, and in 2019, it was the 64th vintage of the iconic label. The fermentation runs a month in a mix of open and static fermenters before it ages 14 months in French oak (31% new) and a mix of 61/26/13/ hogsheads / barriques / vats. 2019 was a year to remember in Coonawarra, and its ripe cherry, mulberry, blackcurrants, crushed chalk, mint, seawater, and that Coonawarra dried herb styling in the finish tell an amazing story. It will age for decades, but it has the class and balance to be drunk anytime now.

landlust-riesling.title: Landlust Riesling 750ml
landlust-riesling.bodyHtml:
Landlust Riesling is an aromatic, aromatic German white wine with a dry to off-dry style. It showcases notes of honeysuckle, blossom, citrus, and white peach on the nose, while the palate offers Asian pear, red apple, and peach with balancing lemon and lime notes, all framed by a refreshing minerality. The finish is long and harmonious. 

89 Points - James Suckling
A bright and refreshing Riesling with appealing notes of green apple, peach, and citrus. Well-balanced with crisp acidity and a clean, vibrant finish that offers great value.
88 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Presents classic Riesling character with stone fruit flavors and refreshing minerality. An approachable and food-friendly white wine.

mission-hill-five-chardonnay.title: Mission Hill Reserve Chardonnay 2020/2022 750ml
mission-hill-five-chardonnay.bodyHtml: The Mission Hill Reserve Chardonnay 2021 is a dry, medium-bodied white wine with a pale straw yellow color. It features complex aromas of crisp apple, ripe pear, and lemon zest, along with a rich, luxuriant taste with hints of vanilla and toasty oak, according to VINVM. The wine is aged in oak barrels, contributing to its smooth and velvety texture and persistent finish.

conviction-pinot-noir.title: 19 Crimes Pinot Noir
conviction-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
19 Crimes Pinot Noir is an approachable, fruit-forward, and smooth red wine crafted in South Eastern Australia, inspired by the 19 British crimes that transformed convicts into colonists. In the glass, it displays a bright ruby-red color with vibrant aromas of ripe red cherries, raspberries, strawberry jam, and subtle hints of warm baking spice and sweet oak. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and supple, offering a juicy core of dark berry fruit balanced by soft, rounded tannins, mild acidity, and a smooth, slightly sweet finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck, grilled pork chops, roast chicken, mushroom risotto, charcuterie, pizza, and mild cheeses like Brie or Gruyère.

dirty-laundry-cabernet-merlot.title: Dirty Laundry Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
dirty-laundry-cabernet-merlot.bodyHtml:
On the nose, you will find aromas of raspberry, fresh cut grass, tobacco and capsicum with an umami note. In this full bodied wine you will experience a very round mouth-feel and tannin structure with notes of plum and molasses along with hints of cedar and dark chocolate on the finish. This wine will age exceptionally well.

The food pairing possibilities with this beautiful wine are endless. Braised beef short rib pasta, roasted lamb chops, elk tenderloin, or a marinated portobello mushroom cap with grilled asparagus.

masi-modello-merlot.title: Masi Modello Merlot
masi-modello-merlot.bodyHtml:
Masi Modello Merlot is a modern, vibrant, and approachable Italian red wine that elegantly showcases the convivial spirit of the Venetian region. Sourced from the rolling plains of northeastern Italy, it pours a deep ruby red with youthful violet highlights. The nose opens with an expressive, fruit-forward bouquet dominated by ripe Marasca cherries, red plums, wild raspberries, and sweet forest fruits, accompanied by a delicate touch of herbal complexity and sweet spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied yet wonderfully easy-drinking, striking a harmonious balance between its bright, fresh acidity and soft, silky tannins. Ripe berry and dark plum flavors take center stage, leading into a clean, smooth, and pleasantly dry finish.

Food Pairing: This highly versatile, balanced Merlot serves as an exceptional companion for everyday dining. It pairs beautifully with casual antipasti platters, cured meats, and salami, as well as hearty legume or vegetable soups and mushroom risottos. It is also an excellent match for pasta dishes tossed in rich tomato or meat sauces, roasted pork chops, grilled chicken, and fresh or medium-aged cheeses.

hillside-merlot.title: H3 Horse Heaven Hills Merlot 2021 750ml
hillside-merlot.bodyHtml: H3 Merlot is a red wine with a medium body, showcasing flavors of spice, plum, and blackberry. It also features a balance of earthy, cocoa, and ripe black cherry notes, followed by a smooth, velvety finish. This wine is well-suited for pairing with grilled salmon, roasted lamb, wild game, and tomato-based sauces.

jackson-triggs-ps-shiraz-cabernet.title: Jackson Triggs Ps Shiraz Cabernet 750ml
jackson-triggs-ps-shiraz-cabernet.bodyHtml: Jackson Triggs Proprietor's Selection Cabernet/Shiraz is a full-bodied red blend from Canada's Niagara Peninsula. The wine is known for its soft tannins and approachable structure, making it easy to drink and enjoyable on its own or paired with grilled red meats and Italian dishes.

peter-lehmann-shiraz.title: Peter Lehmann 'The Barossan' Shiraz 2024
peter-lehmann-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Peter Lehmann 'The Barossan' Shiraz 2024 is a vibrant, full-bodied Australian red wine crafted from select parcels across the Barossa region. It showcases lifted aromas of ripe cherry, plum, and brooding dark fruits, seamlessly integrated with sweet chocolate, mocha undertones, and a touch of peppery oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a rich, generous texture supported by fine, velvety tannins and a soft, supple finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised lamb shanks, BBQ beef ribs, wild mushroom stew, or aged cheddar cheese.

91 Points - James Suckling

A fresh and flavorful shiraz showing a ripe personality with abundant fruit. Aromas of oregano, potpourri, vanilla, chocolate and intense sweet blueberries and dark cherries. Medium- to full-bodied with polished, creamy tannins and a long and round finish. Approachable and attractive now.

j-lohr-painters-bridge-chardonnay.title: J. Lohr 'Riverstone' Chardonnay 2023
j-lohr-painters-bridge-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The 2023 J. Lohr 'Riverstone' Chardonnay is a benchmark cool-climate white that showcases the balance between vibrant acidity and rich texture. Sourced from the windswept Arroyo Seco region, the 2023 vintage is defined by its aromatic complexity and bright fruit energy. It offers an inviting bouquet of ripe pear, apricot, and meyer lemon, interwoven with sophisticated notes of roasted hazelnuts, honey, and crème brûlée. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and creamy, featuring a lush mouthfeel derived from seven to nine months of aging in French, American, and Hungarian oak barrels. A refreshing streak of acidity provides excellent lift, leading to a long finish with a subtle, toasty oak spice.

91 Points - James Suckling

This full-bodied, round and buttery chardonnay has notes of baked apples, toast and brown butter. Ripe, soft and generous. 

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Candied apple and honeysuckle aromas are fresh and clean on the nose of this bottling. The palate is broad with toasted brioche and baked apple flavors that grow a bit more complex by the finish.

peller-family-merlot-1.title: Peller Merlot 750ml
peller-family-merlot-1.bodyHtml: Peller Family Vineyards Merlot is a medium-bodied red wine with a classic fruit profile, often described as having notes of cherry, plum, and blackberry. It's known for its smooth, approachable style and can be enjoyed on its own or paired with a variety of foods, particularly grilled meats and red sauce dishes.

peller-estates-merlot.title: Peller Family Vineyards Merlot 4L Bag in Box
peller-estates-merlot.bodyHtml:
Peller Family Vineyards Merlot 4L Bag in Box is a smooth, approachable Canadian red wine offering generous fruit flavours in a convenient, large-format package.
