Medium-bodied and easy-drinking, this Merlot showcases ripe cherry, juicy plum, and red berries, complemented by subtle spice and soft tannins. Its balanced character makes it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, family dinners, and everyday enjoyment. The practical 4-litre bag-in-box format provides convenient serving and helps protect the remaining wine from air exposure.

Food Pairing: Grilled burgers, roasted beef, tomato-based pasta, barbecue chicken, mushroom pizza, mild cheeses, and hearty stews.

yalumba-viognier-y-series.title: Yalumba Y Series Viognier 2021 750ml
yalumba-viognier-y-series.bodyHtml:
91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Despite being Yalumba's entry-level Viognier, this is one of its most delicious white offerings. Highly aromatic, it wafts a perfume of honeysuckle, orchard blossom and fuzzy peach skin. The palate is more viscous than the nose implies, but there's enough acidity to keep it fresh. Peach and lemon flavors linger on the finish. Drink with Thai curry or a similarly bold Southeast Asian dish.

sandhill-pinot-grigio.title: Sandhill Pinot Gris
sandhill-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Sandhill Pinot Gris is a quintessential expression of the Okanagan Valley, celebrated for its bright, aromatic complexity and its seamless balance of crisp acidity and lush texture. Sourced from estate vineyards in the South Okanagan, this wine undergoes a meticulous cool fermentation in stainless steel to preserve the natural purity of the fruit and its distinctive mineral backbone. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of ripe pear, golden apple, and honeydew melon, nuanced by delicate floral notes and a hint of ginger spice. The palate is medium-bodied and succulent, featuring a refreshing zest that carries the vibrant orchard fruit flavours through to a clean, persistent finish. As one of the winery’s most beloved offerings, this Pinot Gris exemplifies Sandhill’s commitment to single-vineyard viticulture and its ability to craft sophisticated, food-friendly wines that capture the unique desert terroir of British Columbia.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared sea bass, grilled shrimp skewers, lemon herb roasted chicken, creamy fettuccine Alfredo, rich seafood chowders, and fresh summer salads topped with goat cheese.

ceilis-cream-liquor.title: Ceili's Cream Liquor
ceilis-cream-liquor.bodyHtml:
Ceili's Cream is the traditional cream liqueur from Highwood Distillers of High River, Alberta, and the company's top selling cream for more than 15 years. It blends natural flavours following an age-old recipe to give a smooth, creamy drink. Bottled at 15% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a handy addition to the home bar and a popular gift, especially at Christmas.

Serve: Over ice, or added to a cup of coffee.

montes-twins-malbec-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Montes Alpha Cabernet Sauvignon Colchagua Valley 2023
montes-twins-malbec-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Montes Alpha Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a premium Chilean red wine from the renowned Montes winery in the Colchagua Valley. Celebrated for its commitment to quality and expressive winemaking, Montes produces wines that showcase the richness and character of Chile's exceptional vineyards. This Cabernet Sauvignon combines concentrated dark fruit flavours with elegant structure, delivering a sophisticated yet approachable expression of one of the world's most celebrated red grape varieties. Rich and beautifully balanced, the 2023 vintage offers inviting aromas of blackcurrant, ripe blackberry and dark cherry, complemented by notes of vanilla, cedar, tobacco and warm baking spices. The palate is full-bodied and velvety, with ripe tannins, fresh acidity and a lingering finish accented by subtle oak. Its depth and refined character make it an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining or enjoying alongside a hearty meal.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, barbecue ribs, venison, mushroom risotto, aged cheddar and Manchego cheese.

 

92 Points - James Suckling

Sweet cassis with tomato leaves, quince and a touch of laurel and chocolate. Tight-grained on the palate, with a medium-bodied and nicely chewy texture. Solid finish with generous fruit and tannins. Drink or hold.

tamari-bodega-pinot-grigio.title: Tommasi Le Rosse Pinot Grigio 2024 750ml
tamari-bodega-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
A bright straw yellow with pale green reflections, on the nose it offers notes of ripe fruit (pears and Golden Delicious apples), evolving in the glass with delicate hints of hay and almonds. On the palate it is dry and well-balanced, with a particularly fresh, tangy finish.

Excellent as an aperitif, or with hors d’oeuvres, fish dishes, risottos, white meats and fresh cheeses.

frogs-leap-merlot.title: Frog's Leap Estate Grown Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 / 2021
frogs-leap-merlot.bodyHtml:
A wine with all the hallmarks of the legendary Cabernets of Rutherford: deep, cassis-currant aromas, the classic notes of Rutherford Dust, earthen flavors of cedar and black olive, and a velvety, plush mouthfeel.

2020 Wine Ratings

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of crushed herbs, sliced plums, blackcurrants and violets. Full-bodied with powdery tannins. Bright acidity pairs nicely with the fresh red fruit on the palate. Could use another year to come together.

 

2021 Wine Ratings

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

One of the founding practitioners of organic and dry farming in Napa Valley, Frog's Leap offers a classic approach to Cabernet Sauvignon. Along with flavors of black currant and blackberry, this wine offers lingering spices, lightly tactile tannins and mouthwatering acidity. The wine is both pleasing and perfect for a range of foods from savory mushrooms and risotto, to grass fed beef.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Estate Grown is classically styled stuff, done well and priced realistically. Mixed red and black cherries join subtle shadings of sage and vanilla on the nose, while the medium-bodied palate is streamlined but not overly lean, with gentle padding around the core of acidity that forms the wine's spine. Softly tannic and long on the finish.

91 Points - James Suckling

Well-rounded, fruit-driven and chalky. The nose expresses aromas of blackberries, sweet cherries and earth. It’s medium- to full-bodied with fine tannins. Mellow with a fruity and chewy finish. Try after 2025.

moselland-riesling-hochgewachs-lieblich.title: Moselland Riesling Hochgewachs Lieblich 750ml
moselland-riesling-hochgewachs-lieblich.bodyHtml: Moselland Riesling Hochgewächs Lieblich is a delightful white wine from Germany’s Mosel region. Crafted exclusively from Riesling grapes, it offers a harmonious balance of sweetness and acidity. With notes of stone fruits and a fresh, floral aroma, this wine is perfect for pairing with light dishes or enjoying on its own.

nonino-il-grappa.title: Nonino Il Merlot Grappa
nonino-il-grappa.bodyHtml:
Nonino Il Merlot is a single-varietal grappa from the Monovitigno range of the Nonino family in Friuli, distilled only from fresh Merlot pomace sourced from dedicated growing areas, so each year's output depends on that harvest. The pomace is fermented under vacuum in temperature-controlled stainless steel and distilled straight away in batches, with heads and tails removed, in the copper steam stills Nonino uses for all its grappas. The spirit then rests for six months to a year in stainless steel before bottling at 41% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Clear and bright, it is a soft, rounded grappa with a floral and stone-fruit character.

Tasting Notes: Crystalline, soft and round, with rose petals and cherry stones.

Nose: A fresh bouquet reminiscent of pressed grape must, with rose petal and cherry stone.

Palate: Soft and rounded, carrying the same floral and cherry-stone notes.

Serve: Serve at about 12°C in an open tulip-shaped glass, letting it rest a few minutes before tasting.

sassicaia-2020.title: Tenuta San Guido Sassicaia 2021 1.5L Magnum
sassicaia-2020.bodyHtml:
Sassicaia 2021 is the latest vintage of this iconic Tuscan wine. This vintage is of superior quality, as evidenced by its 100 Parker Points, and is proof that the Marquis Mario Incisa della Rocchetta, inspired by the wines of Bordeaux, was right when he planted Cabernet Sauvignon on his Tuscan estate. 

The Cabernet Sauvignon (85%) and Cabernet Franc (15%) grapes are carefully harvested by hand and vinified individually. Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, followed by maceration for around 20 days. The wine matures for 24 months in French oak barrels, divided between 60 per cent new and 40 per cent second use.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Here it is: A quintessential Sassicaia that represents the excellence of the vintage and also respects the unique taste profile of this distinguished Tuscan blend of Cabernets Sauvignon and Franc. The Tenuta San Guido 2021 Bolgheri Sassicaia offers impeccable balance, excellent freshness and absolutely no signs of over-ripeness. The fruit balance is ideal with a hint of crunch and lasting tension from pulp and skins. The tannins are deftly managed with firm grip and enough velvetiness to add volume and length. There is no greenness on the bouquet that instead offers mulled herbs and spice, with cinnamon and clove, layered delicately between mostly red and some purple berry fruits. Redcurrant, blueberry, sweet pomegranate and Rainier cherry run strong in this vintage. A fragrant hint of heritage rose emerges with time. The oak tones are geared toward gingerbread, hazelnut, cigar, sandalwood and something like a grilled sweet red pepper. To the palate, it offers nice weight with no heavy glycerin, and a rinse of acidity that adds to the wine's natural energy, brightness and viscosity. That marked freshness opens the wine up to long aging potential, but you still need to give it more time in bottle. Drink date: 2028-2060. 

100 Points - Decanter

In 2021, ‘we had a nicely paced harvest... surely a very fortunate vintage for us, for Bolgheri,’ said Priscilla Incisa della Rocchetta at the launch in London of the 2021 vintage of Sassicaia. Welcome rain in mid-August came at just the right time to save the harvest, and production ended up being slightly higher than in 2020. Around eight to 10 separate vinifications were made, fermented in stainless steel with indigenous yeasts and spontaneous malo. The wines were racked to second- and third-use barriques in December 2021, then racked into a mixture of new and used barriques in March 2022. The last step was to make the final blend in stainless tanks, where the wine underwent micro-oxygenation before bottling and further maturation in bottle. Rich dark fruit and herb aromatics are pockmarked by blueberry and petrichor, leading into an intense and vertical palate that's super-fresh with a delightful breezy, saline character. Textured, integrated tannins emphasise the refinement of Sassicaia, showing just a touch of youthful dustiness. Tangy, bright black, blue and red berry fruits overlay underlying hints of dark chocolate and forest undergrowth in a remarkably precise fashion, with pomegranate and a stony minerality surfacing on the mid-palate. 2021 demonstrates lovely sapidity of fruit along with that characteristic freshness and lightness of step, finishing long and poised. Superb. 99-100.

98 Points - James Suckling

Very classy and typical of Sassicaia with currant, tobacco, chocolate, sage and lavender on the nose and palate. Medium- to full-bodied with very integrated and refined tannins that are caressing and pretty with a lovely length and beauty. Such finesse and structure at the same time.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Comforting and luxurious, if restrained at first, on the nose, like hot coffee with a slice of warm berry tart, then suddenly more serious, with aromas of leather-bound books and crisp fall air. The palate is utterly laden with berries but also vibrating with acid, and tannins feel like a silk textile, strong and supple, tightly stitched and flowing through an endless finish.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich yet elegant, laced with black cherry, blackberry, cedar, mineral and oak spice aromas and flavors, this resonant red builds to the long, detailed aftertaste. Shows great balance, with vibrant acidity and refined tannins, yet this will benefit from a few more years of aging.

pisco-aba.title: Pisco ABA 500ml
pisco-aba.bodyHtml:
Pisco ABA is a Chilean pisco, a white spirit distilled from grapes, made in copper pot stills from the fermented juice of Muscat grapes grown in the Chilean Andes. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 500ml bottle, it is a fragrant, delicately flavoured pisco: the Muscat grape shows through as jasmine, tangerine and honey, and the palate is soft and silky with an orange-blossom-honey sweetness, so much so that it can recall a Muscat dessert wine. It is a natural base for a Pisco Sour and also rewards sipping chilled to appreciate its aromatics.

Tasting Notes: Floral and fruity, with jasmine, tangerine and honey.

Nose: Jasmine flowers, tangerine and honey.

Palate: Soft, silky and sweet, with orange blossom honey.

Serve: In a Pisco Sour, or chilled and neat.

stolichnaya.title: Stoli Vodka 375ml
stolichnaya.bodyHtml:
Stoli Premium is the original Stolichnaya premium vodka, an unflavoured vodka produced and bottled in Latvia. It is bottled at 40% ABV, here in a 375ml bottle.

Serve: Ice-cold and neat, or in a martini, Moscow Mule or Caesar.

la-berangeraie-cuvee-juline.title: La Berangeraie Cuvee Juline 750ml
la-berangeraie-cuvee-juline.bodyHtml: La Bérangeraie Cuvée Juline is a red wine from Cahors, Southwest France, primarily made from Malbec and a small amount of Merlot. It's known for its juicy and fruity notes with blackcurrant, fruit pastilles, and a touch of iodine. The wine is best enjoyed between 2 and 6 years, and can be paired with dishes like roast lamb, duck, or grilled meats.

tusker.title: Bib & Tucker Double Char 6 Year Old Bourbon
tusker.bodyHtml:
Bib & Tucker Double Char 6 Year Old Bourbon is a small-batch Tennessee straight bourbon whiskey crafted using an innovative double-barrel maturation process. After aging for six years in new charred American white oak barrels, the bourbon is transferred to a second, heavily charred new oak barrel that has been cold-smoked with sugar maple wood for a minimum of five months. Inspired by turn-of-the-century open-flame cooking, this fire-forged aging method infuses the high-rye bourbon with a distinctive savory white smoke, rich sweet maple, and deep wood complexity.

Food Pairing: Barbecued beef brisket, charred ribeye steak, smoked gouda burgers, dark chocolate brownies, s'mores, and maple pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber to polished copper in appearance, offering a rich, smooth, and velvety texture on the palate.

Nose : A touch of white smoke and toasted oak with immediate notes of dulce de leche, vanilla, campfire smoke, toasted marshmallow, and subtle background hints of cinnamon and clove.

Palate : Sweet vanilla, sugar maple, and toasted sugar surrounded by white smoke, burnt caramel, toasted cinnamon, dark chocolate, and subtle dried fruit.

Finish : Medium to long and smooth, leaving lingering notes of toasted oak, white smoke, vanilla, and gentle baking spices.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature, over a single large ice cube, or with a few drops of water to release the savory smoke aromas.

black-swan-shiraz.title: Berton Metal The Black Shiraz
black-swan-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Deep and intensely coloured, with blackberry and plum aromas layered over toasted vanilla, coffee and spicy oak. The palate is full-bodied and concentrated, showing ripe plum, blueberry and mocha, supported by dense, ripe tannins and a long, structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with slow-cooked beef, rich roasts, barbecue ribs, grilled lamb, hearty stews, or strong aged cheeses.

black-label.title: Vecchia Romagna Etichetta Nera Brandy
black-label.bodyHtml: Vecchia Romagna is an authentic Italian brandy made from the finest Trebbiano grapes. Its smooth, full-bodied flavor is achieved by a 9-year barrel maturation process. This complex flavor profile and aromatic bouquet make it a perfect choice for sipping or adding to cocktails.

smoking-loon-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Smoking Loon Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
smoking-loon-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Smoking Loon Cabernet Sauvignon (750ml) is a California Cabernet Sauvignon, known for its vibrant aromas of blackberry and boysenberry, along with floral notes. It's aged in American and French oak, adding vanilla aromas and contributing to a smooth, silky tannin structure. This medium-bodied wine is approachable, well-balanced, and offers a long, flavorful finish.

lindemans-bin-85-pinot-grigio.title: Lindemans Bin 85 Pinot Grigio 750ml
lindemans-bin-85-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2015 vintage) "Every year I say the same thing about this wine but it is the truth – this is a well-made, fun to drink, grigio for the price. As fresh as it gets, this light, lean, northern Italian style grigio opens with bits of citrus fruit and honey. The attack mirrors the nose with round, citrus, watery, gulpable, grapefruit flavors. Good value in a clean, fresh, white wine for only $11. A super mid-week bargain. (Anthony Gismondi)." - 86/100, Gismondi on Wine

chocalan-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Vina Chocalan 'Vitrum' Blend 2019 750ml
chocalan-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "A blend of varieties planted at the Chocalán property in the coastal Maipo Valley, about 35 kilometers from the Pacific. This is a big red, concentrated in the ripeness of its flavors, the black and candied fruits, and the mouth-filling sensation of voluptuousness. One for lamb, this is 46% cabernet sauvignon, 25% cabernet franc, 13% malbec, 8% syrah, and another 8% carmenere with petit verdot, all from their Chocalán's own vineyards in the Maipo Costa." - 90/100, Patricio Tapia - Descorchados

coopers-creek-pinot-noir.title: Cooper Mountain Pinot Noir 750ml
coopers-creek-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2021 vintage) "Aromas of blackberries and poppies collide with fascinating notes that smell like sugar cookies and gin botanicals. The medium-bodied Pinot Noir offers flavors of earthy oregano, a crisp sea breeze and pie cherries. Sturdy tannins add a bit of chewiness to the wine's texture." - 89/100, Wine Enthusiast

sleeman-original-draught.title: Sleeman Original Draught 15 Cans
sleeman-original-draught.bodyHtml:
Original Draught combines Sleeman’ s premium brewing heritage with the freshness and sociability of traditional draught beer. This unpasteurized lager goes down well in the company of friends.

With its golden color and concentrated white foam collar, Original Draught is well balanced and easy to drink. In this particular lager you’ ll notice a distinctive floral hop aroma with a refreshing finish.

dancing-bull-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Cakebread Dancing Bear Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
dancing-bull-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Generous aromas of black currant, dried cherry, and raspberry jam flow from the glass, with dark chocolate, coffee, dried rosemary, and fig notes emerging over time. The palate is full-bodied and rich, offering concentrated flavors of ripe cherry and blackberry, along with hints of mocha, leather, baking spices, and rocky minerality. Firm yet opulent tannins drive the wine to a long, powerful finish.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

From the winery's estate vineyard on Howell Mountain, the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Dancing Bear Ranch is a blend of 90% Cabernet Sauvignon, 8% Merlot and 2% Cabernet Franc, all aged 22 months in 59% new French oak. Scents of mocha, tree bark, black cherries, raspberries and cherries mark the nose, while the medium to full-bodied palate is supple, lush and long, with ample concentration and some nicely ripe, softly dusty tannins on the lingering finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripe dark-fruited character with hazelnuts, pine wood, chocolate and ground cloves. Medium- to full-bodied, refined and polished, with dusty tannins and succulent fruit. Long finish.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Loganberry and black currant puree flavors stretch out nicely over this red's sleek iron spine, with hints of tar and apple wood. This is accessible now for its polish and fruit. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Cabernet Franc. Drink now through 2034. 2,600 cases made.

villa-teresa-organic-rose-frizzante-1.title: Villa Teresa Organic Rose Frizzante 750ml
villa-teresa-organic-rose-frizzante-1.bodyHtml: Villa Teresa Organic Rose Frizzante is a sparkling rose made from 100% organic Italian grapes. It offers a crisp, fruity taste and an elegant bouquet of rose, peach, and strawberry aromas.

blackwell-shiraz.title: The Black Chook Shiraz 2022 750ml
blackwell-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Bright aromas of red cherry, berries and lifted floral notes with hints of vanilla and mocha. Generously loaded with red fruits, the palate is balanced by fine supple tannins and lingering spice notes. A soft, round Shiraz with great fruit length, generosity and drinkability.

91 Points - James Suckling
A deliciously plush and full-bodied Shiraz from McLaren Vale, bursting with intense aromas of blueberry, blackberry, and dark chocolate. The palate is rich and velvety, showcasing a generous core of ripe fruit that is complemented by subtle notes of mocha and vanilla. The tannins are supple and well-integrated, supporting a long, juicy finish that is both powerful and incredibly smooth.
90 Points - Wine Advocate
This wine exemplifies the modern, fruit-driven style of Australian Shiraz, offering a dense and concentrated palate of black fruits and licorice. It is opulent and forward, with a lush texture and a hint of peppery spice on the finish. Its accessibility and robust flavor profile make it a consistent crowd-pleaser.

cono-sur-organic-chardonnay.title: Cono Sur Organic Chardonnay 750ml
cono-sur-organic-chardonnay.bodyHtml: A ripe and mellow style of Chardonnay; look for aromas of honey, floral notes, yellow pear, spice and yellow melon. The palate is medium-bodied with flavors of honey, pear and melon followed by a clean and fresh finish.

ruffino-il-ducale-rosso-toscana-igt.title: Ruffino Il Ducale
ruffino-il-ducale-rosso-toscana-igt.bodyHtml: Ruffino Il Ducale Rosso is a contemporary "Super Tuscan" blend that bridges the gap between century-old traditions and a modern, fruit-forward style. It offers an intense and complex bouquet of cassis, cherry jam, and plum, accented by spicy notes of vanilla, tobacco, and black pepper. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and well-balanced, featuring round, elegant tannins and a pleasant freshness. The finish is long and satisfying, with refined lingering notes of ripe fruit and subtle spice. It is highly versatile and pairs exceptionally well with tomato-based pasta, herb-roasted chicken, and aged cheeses.

dr-zenzen-elite-pinot-noir.title: Dr. Zenzen 'Elite' Pinot Noir 750ml
dr-zenzen-elite-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: A fruit driven, soft velvety Pinot Noir, with medium body. Aromas reminiscent of black currant and cherry. Wonderful finish.

mer-soleil-chardonnay-silver.title: Mer Soleil Silver Unoaked Chardonnay 2022
mer-soleil-chardonnay-silver.bodyHtml:
On the nose light lemon zest and inviting minerality. The palate is citrus driven, with notes of sweet clementine and mango. With no exposure to oak, Silver awakens the palate with a rousing freshness.

Pair with ceviche, oysters, linguine with clams or roasted lemon chicken.

90 Points - Wilfred Wong

The 2022 Mer Soleil Silver Unoaked Chardonnay is lively and rich on the palate. This wine shines with aromas and flavors of chalky notes, hints of minerality, and alluring Meyer lemons. Pair it with pan-fried, panko-coated sea bass.

coppola-cabernet-ivory-label.title: Francis Coppola Diamond Collection Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
coppola-cabernet-ivory-label.bodyHtml:
Francis Ford Coppola Diamond Collection Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a distinguished and highly approachable red wine meticulously sourced from diverse vineyards across California to ensure complexity and consistency. This vintage opens with an expressive, aromatic nose featuring delightful notes of black cherry, peppercorn, and blackberry, complemented by subtle hints of vanilla, toasted oak, and tobacco. On the palate, it delivers a bold, full-bodied experience with concentrated flavors of plum, boysenberry, and baking spices. The careful integration of fruit and oak, with portions aged in French and American barrels, provides a balanced structure with supple tannins that glide through to a sophisticated, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: This versatile Cabernet pairs exceptionally well with classic grilled steaks, hearty beef stews, slow-roasted lamb, aged cheeses, or rich pasta dishes.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Subtle aromas of dark cherry, orange peel, dried florals, and notes of toasty vanilla saunter across the nose. The flavors on the palate repeat but with supplier flavor and texture along the mouth, finishing with mouth-watering tannins. pair with jerk chicken.

cavaliere-doro-chianti-classico.title: Cavaliere D'Oro Chianti Classico 2019 750ml
cavaliere-doro-chianti-classico.bodyHtml: The Gabbiano Cavaliere d'Oro Chianti Classico 2019 is a medium-bodied red wine with a dry, fruity, and tangy profile. It showcases red cherry, plum, and blackberry flavors, complemented by savory herbs, earth, and spice notes. The wine features lively tannins and refreshing acidity, making it a versatile food wine, especially with red meats.

root-1-the-original-ungrafted-cabernet.title: Unshackled Cabernet Sauvignon by The Prisoner 2023
root-1-the-original-ungrafted-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Unshackled Cabernet Sauvignon by The Prisoner 2023 is a bold, modern, and delightfully unconventional red wine focused on capturing intense fruit vibrancy and immediate accessibility. It displays a deep purple hue in the glass, opening with an aromatic bouquet of dark plum, ripe blackberry, and cassis, seamlessly accented by subtle undertones of black tea, olive, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, delivering rich layers of black stone fruits seamlessly integrated with hints of mocha, dried herbs, and toasted oak shavings. The soft, well-rounded tannins and moderate acidity provide a smooth, approachable texture that coats the mouth completely and drives into a long, satisfyingly plush finish. This expressive blend benefits from grapes sourced across premium vineyards, ensuring a consistently rich flavor profile year after year. The meticulous fermentation process ensures that the wine retains its youthfully expressive and fruit-forward nature without becoming overly aggressive. It represents a highly versatile and reliable crowd-pleaser that delivers a bold, uncompromised California taste experience.

Food Pairing: This bold and smooth Cabernet Sauvignon pairs excellently with charcoal-grilled beef burgers, braised short ribs, gourmet wood-fired meat pizzas, or rich dark chocolate desserts.

wolf-blass-grey-label-shiraz.title: Wolf Blass Grey Label McLaren Vale Shiraz 2018 750ml
wolf-blass-grey-label-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Aromatic blue fruits are complexed with notes of dark chocolate, warm spice and subtle nougat oak

Medium to full bodied, the blue berried fruits are succulent and plush, filling the mouth without being heavy. The tannins are velvety and powdery, framing the palate and providing texture and length.

macmurray-ranch-pinot-noir.title: Long Meadow Ranch Anderson Valley Pinot Noir 750ml
macmurray-ranch-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Long Meadow Ranch's Anderson Valley Pinot Noir is a medium to full-bodied wine with a bright ruby color. It features a powerful nose with notes of red fruit, violet, spices, and wild berries, alongside hints of orange rind and plums. The palate is structured with tannins and tangy acidity, resulting in a long, mouthwatering finish.

phillips-strawberry-schnapps.title: Phillips Peach Schnapps
phillips-strawberry-schnapps.bodyHtml:
Phillips Peach Schnapps is a peach-flavoured schnapps from Phillips, bottled at 15% ABV in a 375 ml bottle. Phillips is a Minnesota spirits and liqueur brand whose history goes back to 1912, and it was a pioneer of the schnapps category: the company introduced its Peppermint Schnapps in 1935 and Root Beer Schnapps in 1984. Peach is one of the core flavours of the Phillips schnapps range and a classic partner for orange juice in a Fuzzy Navel.

Serve: Chilled over ice, or mixed with orange juice for a Fuzzy Navel.

monkey-bay-pinot-grigio.title: Oyster Bay Pinot Grigio
monkey-bay-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Pinot Grigio is a vibrant, crisp, and refreshing white wine that brilliantly captures the cool-climate essence of New Zealand. Pouring a pale straw color, it bursts with lively aromas of fresh green apple, ripe pear, and zesty citrus, elegantly layered with subtle floral and delicate herbaceous notes. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, bone-dry, and highly approachable, featuring a mouth-watering acidity and a clean, zesty finish that perfectly balances the generous, fruit-forward flavors.

Food Pairing: Exceptionally versatile, it pairs perfectly with fresh seafood like shrimp or scallops, vibrant garden salads, goat cheese, light pasta dishes, and lightly spiced chicken.

bitch-grenache.title: Torbreck Les Amis 2017
bitch-grenache.bodyHtml:
A powerful old-vine Grenache with violets, redcurrant, wild raspberry and pomegranate layered with exotic spice, earth and smoky oak. The palate is concentrated and silky, with cleansing acidity, fine tannins and impressive texture carrying the vibrant fruit through a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast lamb, grilled beef, duck, venison, barbecue pork, mushroom dishes, or mature hard cheeses.

 

94 Points - James Suckling

David Slade’s grenache in Greenock delivers smaller berries and bunches. This has been elevaged in French oak barriques for 24 months. Pomegranate and spiced berry-pastry aromas, together with earthy, leathery and spicy character. The cooler vintage has delivered quite complex style. The palate has a very juicy feel with a bolder oak thread and quite a chiseled palate for grenache. Plenty of structure here. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Torbreck's ultrapolished, approachable style is on display here, but those who spurn new oak influence will run a mile. Made with French barrique (50% new), there's so much of it that it's currently blanketing the wine, giving it a coat of sweet vanilla cola. Hiding beneath are lovely, ripe black and blue fruit, flowers and spice. The palate shows more fruit purity, a silky texture and a fine tannin structure. The oak still dominates, though, and a flash of heat from the alcohol is visible, too. Give this another few years in bottle; the cellaring potential is there. Drink 2021–2028.

trapiche-broquel-malbec.title: Trapiche Broquel Malbec 2017/2019 750ml
trapiche-broquel-malbec.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "This malbec from Trapiche comes off 25 year old vineyards between 900-1000m, and aged 1 year in oak. The final blend is a barrel selection. Dark cocoa dusts blackberry, blueberry compote, with sueded tannins and a clipped, pasty finish. One for taking with grilled burgers now. (Treve Ring)." - 87/100, Gismondi on Wine

gallo-pinot-grigio.title: Tollo Pinot Grigio 2024 1L
gallo-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
This refreshing Pinot Grigio offers aromas of pear, green apple, citrus zest, and white flowers. Light-bodied and crisp, the palate reveals bright acidity, clean fruit flavors, and subtle minerality, finishing smooth and refreshing with excellent balance and everyday drinkability throughout.

Food Pairing: Grilled fish, shellfish, fresh salads, vegetable risotto, roasted chicken, light pasta dishes, soft cheeses, and antipasti.

sterling-sauvignon-blanc.title: Sterling Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
sterling-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Sterling Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp and refreshing white wine with a vibrant, aromatic profile. It's known for its citrus and tropical fruit flavors, often including notes of grapefruit, lime, and passion fruit, alongside subtle herbaceous undertones like fresh-cut grass. The wine typically has a light to medium body, balanced acidity, and a clean, zesty finish.

velvet-devil-merlot.title: Charles Smith Wines The Velvet Devil Merlot
velvet-devil-merlot.bodyHtml:
Charles Smith Wines The Velvet Devil Merlot is a smooth, seductive, and immensely appealing red wine created to showcase the sultry, velvety potential of Washington State Merlot. Living up beautifully to its name, it wraps the palate in a rich texture, opening with forward aromas of dark plums, black cherries, and cassis, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of cedar, sweet pipe tobacco, and warm earth. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full-bodied profile bursting with concentrated black fruit and chocolate overtones, all balanced by a fine, polished tannin structure and a surprisingly fresh, focused finish.

Food Pairing:

This lush and supple Merlot pairs effortlessly with classic backyard burgers, grilled flank steak, roasted pork loin, or pasta with a rich meat sauce.

whistler-honey-lager.title: Whistler Bear Paw Honey Lager 6 Cans

ge-organic-red-blend.title: Emiliana Ge Organic Red 2019
ge-organic-red-blend.bodyHtml:
On the nose, this is a very complex wine that shows different nuances that range from black fruits such as plums and blackberries -characteristic of our Syrah from Colchagua- to graphite, cedar, and spices, like clove, and refreshing notes of lavender and rosemary from our Carmenère and Cabernet Sauvignon. It offers a broad entry on the palate, with ripe tannins that make a good balance with its crisp acidity.

97 Points - James Suckling

Finely roasted white sesame, fresh blackberries, currants, red-chili black chocolate and ground pepper on the nose, together with cigar-box and sandalwood notes. This is a very bright and juicy red, showing a complex array of flavors. Elegantly rendered, with layers and finesse. Really silky and long, with a vibrant but refined finish. 54% syrah, 31% carmenere and 15% cabernet sauvignon. From biodynamically grown grapes. Vegan. Drinking well now, but will benefit from aging. Best from 2025.

saint-clair-family-estate-sauv-blanc.title: Saint Clair Family Estate Sauvignon Blanc 2022 750ml

casillero-del-diablo-malbec.title: Casillero del Diablo Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
casillero-del-diablo-malbec.bodyHtml:
Casillero del Diablo Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon is a globally renowned, classic expression of Chilean Cabernet that delivers outstanding value and consistency. It pours a deep, intense ruby red in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and fruit-forward, offering rich aromas of ripe cherries, blackcurrants, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of vanilla, toasted oak, and a hint of dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, smooth, and well-structured. It features a juicy core of dark berry flavors supported by silky, approachable tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a lingering finish accented by gentle spice and toasted coffee bean.

Food Pairing: This highly versatile and food-friendly Cabernet Sauvignon pairs wonderfully with grilled red meats, hearty beef stews, roast lamb, empanadas, heavily spiced dishes, rich pasta with bolognese sauce, and mature cheeses like aged Cheddar or Gruyère.

copper-moon-sauvignon-blanc.title: Copper Moon Sauvignon Blanc 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh, crisp, and easy-drinking Canadian white wine crafted to be light-bodied and accessible. In the glass, it displays a bright pale-yellow hue accompanied by lively, uplifting aromas of lime, pink grapefruit, fresh green apple, and subtle herbal notes. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, vibrant texture with crisp citrus fruit flavors, clean acidity, and a refreshing, dry finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs delightfully with fresh garden salads, goat cheese crostini, grilled chicken breast, pan-seared white fish, oysters, or light pasta dishes.

potters-superior-white.title: Potter's Superior White Rum
potters-superior-white.bodyHtml:
Potter's Superior White Rum is made by Highwood Distillers in High River, Alberta, under the Potter's label the brand has carried since 1958. Highwood's master blender imports Caribbean rum distilled from cane sugar, ages it in oak, then blends and filters it to the profile of each brand; the label calls this one an imported, aged Caribbean island rum. Light-bodied and gently sweet, it is designed as a mixer and a starting point for tropical cocktails. Bottled at 40% ABV in a lightweight 750ml plastic bottle.

Palate: Light-bodied and gently sweet.

Serve: With cola or soda and lime, in a daiquiri or mojito, or in rum punch.

layer-cake-primitivo.title: Layer Cake Primitivo (A.k.a. Zinfandel) 2020 750ml
layer-cake-primitivo.bodyHtml: Huge inky black fruit, spice and white pepper. Layered and rich in the mouth with jammy black cherries, truffles, espresso and a dense, creamy texture.

voga-red-fusion-cab-sauv-zin.title: Voga Red Fusion 750ml
voga-red-fusion-cab-sauv-zin.bodyHtml: Voga Red Fusion is a 65% Zinfandel, 35% Cabernet blend from Puglia, Italy. It's known for its complex flavors, including blackberries, cherries, and plums, with a hint of toasty oak. The wine is described as soft yet balanced, with a long, delicate finish. Voga Red Fusion is part of the VOGA Italia collection and is available in a 750ml bottle.

charles-charles-rose.title: Charles & Charles Rose
charles-charles-rose.bodyHtml:
Charles & Charles Rosé is a vibrant, savory, and beautifully balanced dry rosé born from a collaboration between winemakers Charles Bieler and Charles Smith. Sourced from sustainably farmed, high-elevation vineyards, this Provencal-style New World blush leads with expressive aromatics of bright citrus, wild raspberry, fresh cherry, rose petals, and wild lavender. On the palate, it delivers a generous, multi-layered texture featuring notes of yellow strawberry and apricot, grounded by a distinct stony minerality and a tangy, refreshing finish driven by crisp natural acidity.

Food Pairing:

This versatile dry rosé pairs beautifully with a fresh summer strawberry and goat cheese salad, light shrimp tacos, grilled chicken skewers, or charcuterie.

fernie-brewing-what-the-huck-huckleberry.title: Fernie Brew What The Huck Huckleberry 6 Cans
fernie-brewing-what-the-huck-huckleberry.bodyHtml: Fernie Brew What The Huck Huckleberry 6 Cans

danzante-chianti.title: Danzante Prosecco 750ml
danzante-chianti.bodyHtml: Danzante Prosecco, a 750ml bottle, is an extra-dry sparkling wine from Italy, known for its lively mousse and intensely fruity aroma with notes of apple and pear. It's described as fresh, well-balanced, and aromatic, with a palate that is savory and refreshing. The wine is produced in the Prosecco DOC appellation using grapes from the hills of that region.

arbor-mist-white-pear-pinot-grigio.title: Giusti Longheri Pinot Grigio 2024
arbor-mist-white-pear-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Straw yellow with bright reflections. Intense, fruity with notes of pear and banana. Fresh with good structure, persistently flavoursome on the palate.

Excellent with low-fat starters, soups, risottos made with greens and fish dishes.

johnnie-walker-black-label-4.title: Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old 1.14L
johnnie-walker-black-label-4.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old is an iconic and highly regarded blended Scotch whisky, crafted using whiskies drawn from the four corners of Scotland. Aged for a minimum of 12 years, this masterful blend combines the lighter, sweeter whiskies of the east with the robust, peaty malts of the west. The result is a deep, complex, and incredibly well-balanced spirit that has set the benchmark for premium blends worldwide.

Food Pairing: The smoky and rich flavor profile of this whisky pairs wonderfully with hearty and savory dishes like slow-cooked BBQ pork, smoked brisket, or a rich charcuterie board. It is also exceptional alongside dark chocolate or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep gold with rich amber highlights in appearance, offering a smooth, medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Bold and aromatic, featuring heavy notes of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, and dark orange peel, beautifully balanced by underlying wood spice and gentle, fragrant peat smoke.

Palate : Complex, smooth, and layered. Rich flavors of sweet vanilla, creamy toffee, and dark fruit give way to warm winter baking spices, toasted oak, and a distinct wave of peat smoke.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth, leaving a lingering impression of soft smoke, sweet malt, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, over ice in a double rocks glass, or mixed with high-quality ginger ale or soda water in a tall highball glass with a fresh orange wedge.

oyster-bay-sparkling-cuvee-rose.title: Oyster Bay Sparkling Cuvee Rose
oyster-bay-sparkling-cuvee-rose.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Sparkling Cuvée Rosé is an exceptionally elegant, refreshing, and fruit-forward cool-climate sparkling wine from New Zealand. Made from a carefully calibrated blend of 80% Chardonnay and 20% Pinot Noir, this wine undergoes a natural secondary fermentation using the Charmat method to capture and highlight its pristine varietal intensity. In the glass, it exhibits a beautiful, delicate pale salmon-pink or copper hue with a fine, lively, and persistent mousse. The highly expressive and fragrant nose opens with vibrant aromas of fresh summer strawberries, red cherries, and wild raspberries, beautifully complemented by undertones of citrus blossom, white peach, and subtle sweet spice. On the palate, this light-to-medium-bodied sparkling wine is crisp, balanced, and zesty. A juicy core of concentrated red berry and cranberry flavors is seamlessly balanced by a bright, refreshing line of natural acidity, finishing wonderfully long, clean, and refreshing.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh oysters, smoked salmon bites, light seafood salad, spicy tuna sushi, or elegant holiday hors d'oeuvres.

bortoluzzi-traminer.title: Bortoluzzi Traminer 750ml
bortoluzzi-traminer.bodyHtml: The Bortoluzzi Traminer is described as a fragrant white wine with a straw yellow color, often exhibiting aromas of rose petals, tropical fruits, and spice. It is known for its balanced, elegant, and soft palate with a persistent finish. The wine is typically aged in stainless steel tanks and can be enjoyed with various dishes, including fish, seafood, and spicy cuisines.

cupcake-pinot-grigio.title: Cupcake Pinot Grigio 750ml
cupcake-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Cupcake Vineyards Pinot Grigio is described as a light-bodied, crisp, and refreshing white wine. It typically features aromas of pear, honeysuckle, and lemon zest. The flavor profile includes notes of citrus, green apple, and a mineral-driven finish. It's often paired with seafood, salads, and light appetizers.

agwa-de-bolivia-liqueur.title: Chica Chida Peanut Butter Agave Spirit
agwa-de-bolivia-liqueur.bodyHtml:
Chica Chida Peanut Butter Agave Spirit is an innovative flavoured agave spirit that blends 100% blue Weber agave spirit from Jalisco with natural allergen-free peanut butter flavor and a touch of agave nectar. Created as a smooth, easy-drinking shot, it combines the savory, nut-rich notes of peanut butter with the natural sweetness of agave and subtle earthy citrus undercurrents.

Food Pairing: Chocolate desserts, churros, peanut butter cookies, grilled banana skewers, vanilla ice cream, and salty snacks.

Tasting Notes : Light golden amber in appearance, offering a smooth, creamy, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Roasted peanut butter, sweet agave nectar, light vanilla, and a subtle undertone of warm baking spice.

Palate : Creamy and rich with dominant flavors of roasted peanuts, sweet agave syrup, subtle cocoa, and soft cooked agave.

Finish : Smooth and short-to-medium with lingering peanut butter sweetness and a gentle warm touch.

Serve : Best served well-chilled as a cold shot, over ice, or mixed in dessert-style cocktails and coffee drinks.

anciano-5-year-old.title: Anciano 5 Year Old Reserva 750ml
anciano-5-year-old.bodyHtml: Dark and bold cherry red in colour. Aromas of rich fruit compote combine with hints of cacao, vanilla and sweet spice. Full bodied and packed with ripe berry and cherry flavours. Secondary flavours of balsamic and cinnamon lead to a smooth balanced finish.

benriach-12-year-sherry-wood.title: Benriach 12 Year Old Sherry Wood
benriach-12-year-sherry-wood.bodyHtml: This rich, aromatic Single Malt Scotch Whisky has been created by marrying together whiskies matured in Oloroso and Pedro Ximenez sherry butts sourced from Jerez, Southern Spain.

jose-cuervo-gold-tequila-2.title: Jose Cuervo Especial Gold Tequila 1.75L
jose-cuervo-gold-tequila-2.bodyHtml: The #1 tequila brand in the world, Jose Cuervo Especial® Gold is a golden blend of younger tequilas. The light gold spirit has a sweet aroma with pleasant agave notes. Along with its sweet, subtle agave flavor and hints of oak and vanilla, Especial Gold boasts a well-balanced, short, smooth finish. (40% ABV-80 proof) • In history and today, Jose Cuervo Especial is the popular choice for crafting any Margarita: frozen or on the rocks. Jose Cuervo knows how to craft tequila.

pine-ridge-chenin-blanc-viognier.title: Pine Ridge Chenin Blanc-Viognier 2023
pine-ridge-chenin-blanc-viognier.bodyHtml:
Crisp, bright, and vivacious! The Chenin aromatics bring citrus characters of tangerine, yuzu, pear, orange blossom, and honeydew melon. The Viognier aromatics tend to be a little heavier on stone fruit of peach and mango with hints of honeysuckle. The mouthfeel is clean, crisp with no oak or malolactic fermentation. The slight residual sugar and acid are in balance to add a viscous mouthfeel in the mid-palate with a crisp finish.

This versatile wine pairs well with a number of dishes, from light salads to seafood, and most notably with foods with a hint of spiciness – its subtle sweetness provides balance alongside a touch of heat.

91 Points - James Suckling

Fresh nose with white peaches, sliced apples and white blossoms. Medium-bodied, crunchy and lightly salty on the palate, with juicy acidity coming through. Vibrant in the finish.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers a light-bodied, charming mix of peach, honeysuckle and pear flavors that are crisp and fresh. A touch of lime sherbet lingers on the finish alongside a note of freshly grated ginger. Chenin Blanc and Viognier.

jacobs-creek-shiraz-rose.title: Jacob's Creek Double Barrel Shiraz 750ml
jacobs-creek-shiraz-rose.bodyHtml:
Double barrel is finished in aged whiskey barrels for a richer, deeper, and smoother taste.

The Double Barrel range is crafted from superior quality grapes which are first matured in traditional wine barrels. Then, using our unique Double Barrel technique, they are finished in aged whisk(e)y barrels to build additional layers of complexity.

The intense nose offers cedar, vanilla bean and buttered toast with notes of pecan nut and roast cashew.

An attractive, savory palate of blackberry and ripe plum with integrated charry notes and a lovely soft finish.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Rich, robust, and full-bodied, this Shiraz is characterized by pronounced flavors of dark berries, black plum, and a distinctive smoky, charred oak character imparted by its unique secondary maturation in aged whiskey barrels. The palate is velvety and expansive, carrying the dense fruit and spice notes across a long, warming finish where hints of vanilla and toasted almond linger. This innovative process creates a wine of substantial depth and a modern twist on a classic Australian style.
91 Points - James Suckling
A boldly flavored and generously proportioned Shiraz, featuring deep layers of stewed plum, blackberry compote, and dark chocolate, all beautifully complemented by pronounced notes of vanilla, toasted coconut, and spice from its pioneering whiskey barrel finish. The innovative aging technique adds a remarkable complexity and a uniquely smooth, almost creamy texture that softens the wine's natural robust structure, making it exceptionally approachable despite its intensity.

e-j-brandy-xo.title: Bull XO Brandy Napoleon
e-j-brandy-xo.bodyHtml:
Crafted as a value-driven, classic European-style brandy, Bull XO Brandy Napoleon is an approachable grape spirit designed to deliver traditional French XO characteristics at an accessible price point. Produced from fermented wine grapes, the spirit is distilled in continuous column stills to yield a clean, smooth wine distillate before undergoing aging in French oak casks. Adhering to the "Napoleon" designator tradition, the blend incorporates aged brandies that develop a warm amber color and rounded oak sweetness over time. Bottled in a signature 750ml bottle, Bull XO balances sweet fruit aromatics, light caramel, vanilla, and gentle oak spice, making it a versatile staple for both neat sipping and everyday cocktail mixing.

Food Pairing: Cured meats, milk chocolate, roasted peanuts and cashews, hard cheeses (like Gouda or Cheddar), or sweet fruit pastries.

Tasting Notes: Clear, warm amber in appearance with golden-copper highlights, a light-to-medium body, and fast-moving tears.

Nose: Soft and sweet, opening with notes of caramelized sugar, dried raisins, and vanilla, accompanied by gentle oak wood, dried fruit, and a subtle floral lift.

Palate: Smooth and approachable on the palate, featuring sweet grape nectar, caramel, and butterscotch upfront before opening up to light oak tannins, vanilla bean, and a soft peppery spice.

Finish: Short-to-medium in length, clean and warm with lingering notes of sweet caramel, light wood oak, and gentle spirit warmth.

Serve: Enjoy neat at room temperature in a classic snifter, served over ice, or used as an accessible spirit base in traditional brandy cocktails like a Sidecar, Brandy Alexander, or Brandy & Ginger Ale.

 

THIS PRODUCT IS IN-STORE PICK-UP ONLY, we cannot cover damaged if shipped.

backhouse-pinot-noir.title: Penfolds Bin 23 Pinot Noir 2019 750ml
backhouse-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Bin 23’s name is derived from the place the wine matures, ‘Cellar 23’ at Magill Estate and follows in the footsteps of the success and development of the Penfolds Cellar Reserve Pinot Noir. Bin 23 Pinot Noir is a bold and dynamic inclusion to the Penfolds red wine stable – reflecting an evolving style, regional definition and the complexities of the many and varied pinot noir clones. The relationship between Penfolds and cool-climate regions continues with the multi-regional sourcing of Bin 23 Pinot Noir.

Exotic berried-yoghurt and strawberry-yoghurt cake flavours offer immediate enticement. A roundness and polish is evident, possibly due to time in barrique on lees? Yet there remains a tension, elasticity to contradict and complex! Tasmanian grape sourcing may help to explain this Pinot Noir’s minerality, graphite edge. Ditto the fine acidity, tannins and red fruits. Is the flintiness/wet-stone from the oak and/or fruit? Texturally so silky... a radiant plume conically fanning out ever so softly on the finish.

jackson-triggs-ps-pinot-grigio.title: Jackson Triggs Ps Pinot Grigio 1.5L Magnum
jackson-triggs-ps-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: The Jackson Triggs Proprietor's Selection Pinot Grigio 1.5L Magnum is a crisp, bright, and dry white wine. It offers notes of fresh citrus and green apple, and is well-suited for pairing with seafood or enjoying on a sunny day. The wine is light-bodied and smooth, with a crisp finish. It also has a floral finish, complemented by citrus and peach notes.

arbor-mist-mango-moscato.title: Arbor Mist Mango Strawberry Moscato
arbor-mist-mango-moscato.bodyHtml:
Arbor Mist Mango Strawberry Moscato is a light, refreshingly sweet fruit-infused wine beverage produced in the United States. Combining the smooth, aromatic characteristics of classic Moscato wine with natural juicy mango and ripe strawberry flavors, it presents a pale golden-pink hue in the glass. On the nose, it delivers vibrant, inviting aromas of tropical mango, freshly sliced strawberries, and fragrant peach blossoms. On the palate, it is light-bodied, lively, and effortlessly easy-drinking, offering a pleasant balance of subtle natural sweetness and crisp fruity acidity with a clean, smooth, and fruit-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spicy Asian cuisine, fruit salads, light appetizers, mild cheeses, fish tacos, berry desserts, or enjoyed thoroughly chilled on its own.

evolution-red.title: Sokol Blosser Evolution Big Time Red 2021 750ml
evolution-red.bodyHtml: A juicy, versatile, and exceptionally drinkable blend with notes of cherry, marionberry pie, and red currants.

dreaming-tree-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Dreaming Tree Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
dreaming-tree-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Big and bold, and a great representation of a classic California Cab, this wine is full of character and full of body. Rich flavors of blackberry and plum with a touch of toasty oak, this is a Cabernet you won’t want to keep you to yourself.

A fun start or end to any meal or friendly gathering. Enjoy with grilled flank steak, beef short ribs, or portobella and grilled onion burgers as a vegetarian option.

twisted-tea-hard-iced-tea.title: Twisted Tea Original Hard Iced Tea 6 x 355ml Cans
twisted-tea-hard-iced-tea.bodyHtml:
Twisted Tea Original Hard Iced Tea is a refreshing, smooth and easy-drinking alcoholic iced tea crafted with real brewed tea and natural lemon flavour. Produced by The Twisted Tea Brewing Company, this popular malt-based beverage combines the familiar taste of classic iced tea with a balanced touch of sweetness and a refreshing citrus character. Pouring a clear amber-tea colour, it opens with inviting aromas of freshly brewed black tea, zesty lemon and delicate sweetness. The palate is light, smooth and refreshing, delivering authentic tea flavour, gentle malt character and lively lemon notes without the carbonation of traditional beer or hard seltzer. Its balanced sweetness and clean finish make it an approachable alternative to conventional ready-to-drink alcoholic beverages. At 5% ABV, Twisted Tea Original delivers a refreshing iced tea experience with a subtle alcoholic kick. Conveniently packaged in six 355ml cans, it is a popular choice for backyard barbecues, outdoor gatherings, casual entertaining and relaxed occasions.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled burgers, barbecue chicken, pulled pork sandwiches, crispy chicken wings, fish tacos, grilled shrimp and spicy nachos. Its refreshing lemon and tea character also complements fried chicken, loaded fries, pizza, salty pretzels, grilled vegetables and classic pub appetizers.

Tasting Notes: A smooth, refreshing and non-carbonated hard iced tea featuring real brewed black tea, balanced sweetness, gentle malt character and bright lemon citrus.

Nose: Fresh aromas of brewed black tea, lemon zest and subtle sweetness, with delicate herbal tea nuances.

Palate: Light-bodied and smooth, delivering freshly brewed tea flavours, gentle sweetness and refreshing lemon citrus, balanced by a subtle malt-based alcoholic character.

Finish: Clean, refreshing and lightly sweet, with lingering black tea, soft citrus zest and a pleasantly smooth finish.

dutcher-crossing-reserve-cabernet.title: Dutcher Crossing Proprietor's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
dutcher-crossing-reserve-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Dutcher Crossing Proprietor's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, robust, and beautifully balanced California red wine sourced from premium hillside vineyards in Sonoma County's Dry Creek Valley. Visually displaying a deep ruby-purple core, it opens with expressive aromas of dark blackberry, cassis, and black cherry, elegantly complemented by subtle nuances of cocoa powder, toasted cedar, and dried herbs. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied structure supported by firm, velvety tannins and balanced acidity, carrying rich dark fruit and mocha flavors into a long, polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted lamb chops, hearty game stews, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

mcguinness-peach-schnapps.title: McGuinness Peach Schnapps
mcguinness-peach-schnapps.bodyHtml:
McGuinness Peach Schnapps is a Canadian peach schnapps from the McGuinness range of Corby Spirit and Wine. It aims to capture the taste of fresh market peaches, which are only in season from May to September, so they can be enjoyed all year. The schnapps is clear, with aromas and flavours of ripe peach and a sweet, medium-long finish. Bottled at 15% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a bar staple for fruity cocktails and shooters.

Tasting Notes: Ripe peach, sweet and clear.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, with orange or cranberry juice, or in a Fuzzy Navel or Sex on the Beach.

alamos-seleccion-malbec.title: Alamos Seleccion Malbec
alamos-seleccion-malbec.bodyHtml: A more concentrated and structured expression of the classic label, the Alamos Selección Malbec is crafted from a rigorous selection of high-altitude vineyard lots in the Uco Valley. This wine presents a saturated deep purple color and opens with a complex bouquet of ripe blackberries, black cherries, and sweet spices, layered with elegant floral notes of violets. On the palate, it is full-bodied and remarkably plush, showcasing a dense core of dark fruit supported by firm yet velvety tannins and a vibrant mountain acidity. Extended aging in French oak barrels provides sophisticated nuances of dark chocolate, vanilla, and espresso, leading to a long, persistent finish with a refined mineral tension.

bear-flag-dark-red.title: Pursued By Bear Bear Cub Red 2020 750ml
bear-flag-dark-red.bodyHtml: A youthful, vibrant wine with ripe berry aromas and an appealing hint of vanilla bean. Rich and flavourful on the palate, wild raspberry, black currant, and dark stone fruit mingle with a streak of dark cocoa.

nuance-sauv-blanc-pinot-grigio.title: Savian Pinot Grigio Venezia 1L
nuance-sauv-blanc-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
A magnificent Northern Italian organic white wine displaying a rich, brilliant pale straw yellow color with characteristic shimmering sand-colored hues. Masterfully produced by pioneering third-generation green vignerons from the Savian family in the tenacity-rich calcareous clay soils of Annone Veneto, this sustainably crafted Pinot Grigio opens with an incredibly pure and delicate bouquet of fresh white orchard flowers, crunchy green apples, and ripe Williams pears. The complex, low-sulfite nose is beautifully supported by regional characteristics of wild chamomile, fresh lemon peel, and a distinct, elegant hint of raw almonds. On the palate, it balances a surprisingly fleshy, medium-bodied stone fruit core and a vibrant, linear alpine acidity with a supple, rounded mouthfeel, culminating in a clean, thoroughly refreshing, and harmonious dry finish layered with a pleasant streak of chalky marine minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with fresh seafood risottos, grilled white fish, light summer garden salads, and creamy goat or semi-hard cheeses.

twisted-tea-half-half-hard-iced-tea-2.title: Twisted Tea Half & Half Hard Iced Tea 12 x 355ml Cans
twisted-tea-half-half-hard-iced-tea-2.bodyHtml: Hard Iced Tea with Lemonade Flavor. Perfect for a hot day, whether you're floating down a river, or just wanting a delicious ice cold way to beat the heat. Our Half & Half combines classic flavors of iced tea and lemonade, with a kick

smirnoff-ice-light.title: Smirnoff Ice Light Original 4 Cans
smirnoff-ice-light.bodyHtml: The classic Smirnoff Ice made lighter. Lively, refreshing, and bursting with the zesty flavours of lemon and lime. It's perfectly carbonated and thirst-quenching, with a light, easy-drinking profile and a balanced blend of citrus flavors

the-macallan-1824-amber.title: The Macallan A Night on Earth - The First Light
the-macallan-1824-amber.bodyHtml: A limited edition single malt whisky matured in a harmonious combination of sherry seasoned European and American oak casks, with sparing inclusion of casks that previously held Bourbon. A Night on Earth - The First Light is a radiant tribute to the feeling of joy, renewal and shared beginnings at the very first light of the new year.

fox-run-vineyards-lemberger.title: Kelley Fox Dux Vineyard Chardonnay 2021 750ml
fox-run-vineyards-lemberger.bodyHtml:
Dundee Hills A.V.A. A new bottling in the Kelley Fox lineup, this is from a vineyard planted in the Dundee Hills with cuttings from Cameron’s legendary Abbey Ridge vineyard. After finishing primary fermentation in a stainless tank, the Dux was racked to neutral Burgundy barrels (228L) made from French forests for élevage and malolactic fermentation.

Its appearance is that of pale spun gold with brilliant transparency. Because of both its youth and seriousness, the nose as I type these words is restrained while also delicately perfumed with vanilla, pears and cream, along with a hint of salinity. This character continues in the mouth on a lovely frame and texture, ending with a long finish. I can’t wait to see what this Chardonnay does over time. I would suggest holding this wine for a few years before opening. There’s this alluring golden pear energy that it has.

wine-oclock-moscato.title: Michele Chiarlo Nivole Moscato d'Asti 2025
wine-oclock-moscato.bodyHtml:
Michele Chiarlo Nivole Moscato d'Asti 2025 is a fragrant, vibrant, and delicately sparkling Italian dessert wine crafted from 100% Moscato Bianco grapes grown in the gentle, sun-drenched hills of Piedmont. Brilliant straw yellow with greenish highlights, it displays an enchanting bouquet dominated by floral nuances, fresh white peach, apricot, and subtle notes of sage and orange blossom. On the palate, it is lightly effervescent (frizzante), soft, and beautifully balanced, offering natural grape sweetness offset by lively acidity and a clean, refreshing, fruit-forward finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fruit tarts, fresh berries, Panettone, lemon pound cake, hazelnut desserts, creamy panna cotta, and mild blue or soft-ripened cheeses.

original16-copper-ale.title: Original 16 Copper 15 Cans
original16-copper-ale.bodyHtml: A smooth and refreshing beer brewed with 100% two-row Prairie barley, a blend of roasted black and caramel malts, and five hop varietals

glenfiddich-14-year-rich-oak.title: Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve
glenfiddich-14-year-rich-oak.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve is a rich single malt Scotch whisky matured for 14 years in ex-bourbon American oak casks before being finished in deeply charred new American oak barrels from The Kelvin Cooperage in Louisville, Kentucky. This expression seamlessly combines Glenfiddich's classic Speyside orchard fruit character with the bold vanilla, warm oak spice, and sweet caramel notes typically associated with fine Kentucky bourbon.

Food Pairing: Smoked baby back ribs, grilled pork chops with apple glaze, pecan pie, aged cheddar cheese, or bourbon-glazed steak.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber hue with a smooth, velvety, and medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Vibrant aromas of baked apple, ripe pear, sweet vanilla, toasted oak, creamy caramel, and warm baking spices.

Palate : Rich and full-flavored with layers of caramelized apple, sweet vanilla fudge, toasted oak, woody spice, and soft honeyed malt.

Finish : Long, warm, and sweet with lingering notes of crisp oak, sweet vanilla, and subtle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks with a single large ice cube, or with a few drops of water in a Glencairn glass.

robert-mondavi-ps-crush.title: Vint Crush
robert-mondavi-ps-crush.bodyHtml:
The Robert Mondavi Crush Private Selection comes from cool-climate Central Coast grapes and has been blended primarily from Syrah, Merlot, and Malbec. From steak to turkey to salads, Central Coast Crush pairs well with a wide range of foods throughout the year.

85 Points - CellarTracker

saint-and-sinner-shiraz-cabernet.title: Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet-Shiraz 2023
saint-and-sinner-shiraz-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet-Shiraz 2023 is an iconic, deeply concentrated, and beautifully structured Australian red wine blend affectionately known as "Baby Grange." It opens with an intricate and shifting bouquet of blackcurrants, dark plums, and Black Forest cake, layered with aromatic nuances of dark chocolate, sweet licorice, star anise, and savory rosemary. On the palate, this wine is full-bodied, dense, and tightly coiled, expertly using the prism of a cooler growing season to maintain freshness and poise. The structural Cabernet Sauvignon lends focused notes of graphite, cassis, and black olive, while the Shiraz grounds the mid-palate with rich plum flavors, warmth, and fleshy fruit. Supported by a frame of fine, powder-gravel tannins and sweet American oak vanillin, it glides into a lingering, muscular, and exceptionally savory finish built for long cellaring.

Food Pairing: The bold structural framework, rich black fruits, and pronounced American oak influence of this classic blend make it a spectacular match for heavy, savory dishes. It pairs magnificently with a grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb crusted with herbs, slow-braised beef short ribs, or osso buco. It also provides a fantastic complement to wild boar ragù, roasted venison, wood-fired peppered pizzas, or a board of intense, full-flavored cheeses like aged sharp Cheddar and Gouda.

96 Points - James Suckling

This wine has been made every vintage since 1960. Refined, generous and polished aromas of blackberries, blackcurrants, cured meat, crushed stones and iodine. The palate is full-bodied with a rounded, textural palate and ultra-refined tannins that lead to a silky, savory, black-fruited finish. 51% cabernet sauvignon and 49% shiraz. Excellent. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Bin 389 Cabernet Shiraz is inky, complete, powerful and structured, with black berries, sweet licorice, star anise and fennel. There are also notes of roasted meat juices and cedar wood. The expression of this wine is very attractive—the prism of the cooler season works well in this wine. The fruit is sourced from McLaren Vale, Padthaway and Barossa Valley, matured for 12 months in American oak hogsheads, 33% new.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Distinctive for its appealing savory thread, with notes of crushed pine needle, forest floor, sage, olive tapenade, rosemary and tobacco leaf that complement the core of spiced plum, dried cherry and blackberry preserves. Offers a firm, muscular structure for an appealing backbone. Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz. Drink now through 2037.

van-ruiten-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
van-ruiten-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 pours an opaque, deep purple-ruby color with brilliant violet edges in the glass. Sourced from a diverse palette of eight premium Napa Valley sub-appellations, this expressive Cabernet Sauvignon represents the Wagner family's iconic signature style of opulent fruit density and supple tannic structural power. The highly fragrant bouquet opens with lush aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis paste, and black cherry compote, intricately layered with secondary notes of cocoa powder, espresso bean, warm baking spices, and fine toasted cedarwood. On the palate, the wine delivers a full-bodied, texturally luxurious mouthfeel framed by incredibly soft, fine-grained tannins that eliminate any youthfully bitter edges. A dense mid-palate of concentrated dark orchard fruits and mocha flows seamlessly alongside well-balanced acidity, carrying outstanding weight into a long, satisfyingly plush finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime grilled ribeye steak with rosemary butter, slow-braised beef short ribs, or an artisanal board of aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

carnivor-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Carnivor Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 750ml
carnivor-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: The Carnivor Cabernet Sauvignon is a wine with flavors of blackberry, dark cherry, and cocoa. It is aged in oak barrels, which adds a hint of vanilla and spice to the finish. This wine is full-bodied and well-structured.

ole-smoky-original.title: Ole Smoky Salty Caramel Whiskey
ole-smoky-original.bodyHtml: Might be the best thing to happen to whiskey since, well, whiskey. Savor every sip of this blend of rich, sweet 60 proof whiskey that tastes like liquid caramel with a hint of salt at the end of it. Whiskey never tasted so decadent.

smirnoff-raspberry-1.title: Smirnoff Raspberry Vodka
smirnoff-raspberry-1.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Raspberry is a raspberry flavoured vodka made with Smirnoff's triple distilled vodka. The producer describes it as bringing a tart, fruity raspberry taste to cocktails. It is bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Clear in the glass, it shows aromas of sugared raspberry and raspberry jelly, and is lightly sweet and medium bodied on the palate.

Serve: Mix with lemonade and soda, or with cranberry juice.

yellow-tail-big-bold-red.title: Casella Family Yellow Tail Big Bold Red NV 750ml
yellow-tail-big-bold-red.bodyHtml:
Style
Bursting with ripe dark fruits that inspired the name, this wine will keep the taste buds entertained with every sip.

Aroma
Big and bold with aromas of boisterous red fruits and hints of cherry, dark chocolate and oak.

Flavour
Big and bold, jammed with lush dark fruits, spice and a touch of vanilla.

Enjoy
With a pepper steak and good conversation.

bodacious-shiraz.title: Bodacious Shiraz
bodacious-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Bodacious Shiraz is a smooth, fruit-forward Canadian red wine showcasing the bold character of Shiraz. Rich aromas of ripe raspberry, blackberry and dark cherry mingle with subtle peppery spice. Its velvety texture, juicy dark fruit flavours and soft tannins create an approachable, well-balanced wine with a pleasantly smooth finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled steak, barbecue ribs, roasted lamb, beef burgers, pepperoni pizza, mushroom dishes, tomato-based pasta and aged cheddar cheese.

jacobs-creek-moscato-2.title: Jacob's Creek Moscato 2024 1.5L
jacobs-creek-moscato-2.bodyHtml:
Jacob's Creek Moscato 1.5L Magnum

 82 points Wine Enthusiast

american-barrels-small-batch-bourbon.title: Michter's US*1 Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon
american-barrels-small-batch-bourbon.bodyHtml:
A truly exceptional, highly acclaimed small batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon from the historic Michter's Distillery. Matured to the peak of perfection in fire-charred, new American white oak barrels, it is blended in holding tanks sized to hold no more than 20 full barrels at a time. This meticulous, small-batch process ensures exquisite attention to detail and results in a remarkably consistent, rich, and incredibly smooth flavor profile that punches well above its 91.4 proof.

NOSE

Rich and inviting aromas of sweet caramel, vanilla bean, toasted oak, and a hint of apricot.

PALATE

Smooth, earthy, and perfectly balanced. Deep flavors of sweet corn, rich caramel, peppery spice, and dark stone fruit coat the palate.

FINISH

Long, warming, and elegant with a lasting trail of sweet vanilla and oak.

gerard-bertrand-terroir-languedoc-rouge.title: Gerard Bertrand Chateau l'Hospitalet La Clape Grand Vin Rouge 2022
gerard-bertrand-terroir-languedoc-rouge.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Château l'Hospitalet La Clape Grand Vin Rouge 2022 is an exceptionally elegant, structured, and deeply expressive biodynamic red wine that masterfully captures the unique maritime terroir of the La Clape appellation in Languedoc. Grown on a cliff overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, the vines thrive in a semi-arid climate where limestone cliffs store daytime heat and release it at night, while cooling sea breezes maintain fruit freshness. In the glass, it displays a brilliant, deep ruby hue. The intense, highly complex nose opens with an aromatic array of wild strawberries, muddled black cherries, and cassis, seamlessly layered with fresh sage, wild garrigue herbs, licorice, and sweet hints of barrel-aged vanilla and graphite. On the palate, this full-bodied red is remarkably dense, fleshy, and harmonious. It offers a rich core of dark orchard fruits balanced by fine, silky tannins and an animating, mineral-saline freshness derived from the fossil-rich limestone soils. Aged for 12 to 16 months in traditional French oak barrels, it culminates in a long, focused, and savory finish showing great structural precision.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with a roasted rack of lamb, pan-seared venison, wild mushroom ragù, hearty beef stews, or a selection of mature, artisanal French cheeses.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A seductive white, with juicy peach and apple details joined by hints of candied lemon peel and marzipan. Dense, revealing a robe of well-integrated toasty oak, with warm spice and salted buttercream accents complementing the fruit profile. Long, mouthwatering finish. Solid. Grenache Blanc, Bourboulenc and Vermentino. Drink now through 2028.

capote-velho-white.title: Capote Velho Red 1L
capote-velho-white.bodyHtml:
Capote Velho Red is a highly approachable, soft, and fruit-forward Portuguese red wine crafted to offer exceptional everyday value in a generous 1.0-liter bottle format. Pouring a vibrant ruby-red color with deep garnet highlights in the glass, it reveals an intense and expressive aromatic bouquet filled with ripe blackberries, wild raspberries, and dark cherries, accented by subtle violet florals and delicate earthy undertones. On the palate, this wine is light to medium-bodied, remarkably smooth, and fleshy, delivering a juicy core of fresh red and black fruits. Characterized by a velvety texture, low food-friendly tannins, minimal oak influence, and a balanced acidity, it glides into a clean, smooth finish that makes it an easy-drinking favorite for casual gatherings or as a versatile base for traditional red sangria.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with seasoned pork chops, grilled burgers, traditional meat pies, hearty tomato-based pasta dishes, robust beef stews, and mild, semi-firm cheeses.

apothic-crush.title: Apothic Crush
apothic-crush.bodyHtml:
Apothic Crush is a remarkably luscious, velvety, and fruit-forward red blend designed to offer an indulgent and highly approachable California wine experience. Crafted from a smooth, calculated blend of dark-skinned varieties, this non-vintage selection pours a deep ruby-purple color and opens with a highly expressive, jammy bouquet of dark cherry, ripe blackberry, and red raspberry. The primary fruit aromas are beautifully framed by decadent, oak-derived undercurrents of sweet milk chocolate, mocha, and warm caramel. On the palate, it delivers a medium- to full-bodied framework characterized by supple, ultra-soft tannins and a plush, rounded mouthfeel. Its concentrated core of berry compote and subtle baking spice is carried by a gentle hint of residual sweetness, allowing the rich notes of vanilla and toasted oak to linger gracefully on a clean, silky finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with slow-cooked barbecue pork ribs, wood-fired pepper salami pizza, teriyaki-glazed salmon, sharp aged Gouda cheese, or decadent dark chocolate brownies.

1448-red-blend.title: Jeff Runquist 1448 Proprietary Red Blend 750ml
1448-red-blend.bodyHtml: Jeff Runquist 1448 Red Blend The 1448 Proprietary Red has deep thick color and one would expect form a wine that is predominately Petite Sirah and Petit Verdot. The aromas feature smoky currants and concentrated black fruits. Mocha, caramel, and milk chocolate provide a sweet inviting bouquet. The flavors are big, rich and creamy. Dense ripe black fruits flow across a deeply toasted oak background. The time in small barrels contributes to the rich body and luscious mouth-feel. As with all the Jeff Runquist Wines the tannins are mature and well integrated leading to a smooth lingering finish.

modelo-especial-3.title: Modelo Especial 12 Bottles
modelo-especial-3.bodyHtml:
Modelo Especial is a golden, pilsner-style Mexican lager that was first brewed in 1925 in Tacuba, Mexico City. Crafted as a "model" beer drawing on German brewing traditions, it delivers a rich, full-flavored profile that is balanced by a light hop character and a signature crisp, clean finish.

Food Pairing: Carne asada tacos, citrus-marinated seafood ceviche, Mexican street corn (elote), spicy chicken wings, or fish tacos with lime-cabbage slaw.

Tasting Notes : Golden and well-carbonated in appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied, and highly refreshing mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet orange blossom honey, light toasted malt, and a subtle earthy, herbal quality from the hops.

Palate : Smooth and slightly sweet with notes of gentle honey, toasted barley malt, crisp corn, and a well-balanced, mild hop character without overpowering bitterness.

Finish : Crisp, clean, and refreshing with a quick-drying, faint echo of grain and floral honey.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled straight from the bottle or can, or poured into a pilsner glass, optionally garnished with a fresh lime wedge.

angels-cowboys-rose.title: Angels & Cowboys Rose 2023 / 2024
angels-cowboys-rose.bodyHtml:
Crafted in a style typical of wineries in the Provence region of France, extracting a delicate pink color from Angels & Cowboys' prized Grenache grapes.

Bright, fresh and zesty, with flavors of white peach, nectarine, and fresh raspberry with lingering notes of lavender.

Enjoy well-chilled any time of day - brunch, happy hour or as an aperitif!

2023 Vintage Ratings

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The color of this rosé is pale peach, verging on rose gold. Striking aromas of fresh cherry and limeade dominate the nose. The palate shows varied flavors including watermelon, strawberry and lemon-lime in a lively, acidic framework.

90 Points - James Suckling

Very pale rosé with delicate notes of peaches, apples and strawberries. It’s fresh, creamy and pretty with a medium body.

2024 Vintage Ratings

91 Points - James Suckling

Subtle and refined, with gentle aromas of wild strawberries, peaches, rose petals and citrus peel. The palate is light and fresh, with bright acidity and a soft texture, giving delicate flavors of red berries and grapefruit. Drink now. Screw cap.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This very pale rosé gives aromas of lemon, waxy peach and tart strawberry on the nose, giving way to an acid-forward palate with flavors of nectarine, ginger, white flowers and lemon peel resonating along the finish.

hen-house-sly-white-blend.title: Hen House Sly White Blend 750ml
hen-house-sly-white-blend.bodyHtml: Very aromatic wine with the flavours of apples and pears lingering in the mouth for a very long time making the wine an excellent desert wine that can be enjoyed on its own.

martini-rosso.title: Martini Rosso 500ml
martini-rosso.bodyHtml: Martini Rosso is a sweet red vermouth produced by Martini & Rossi, an Italian company known for its aperitivo drinks. It's a fortified wine, meaning it has been fortified with a distilled spirit, and it's known for its rich, complex flavor profile.
