Martini Rosso is crafted with a blend of carefully selected wines and Italian botanicals, resulting in a distinctive color and taste.

martini-rossi-asti-1.title: Martini & Rossi Asti 375ml
martini-rossi-asti-1.bodyHtml: Martini & Rossi Asti Spumante, in the 375ml half bottle, is a sweet, sparkling wine from the Piedmont region of Italy. It's made from Moscato Bianco grapes, known for their aromatic qualities and unique flavor profile. The fermentation process is stopped early to retain some natural sweetness, resulting in a low-alcohol, fruity, and aromatic sparkling wine.

villa-maria-sparkling-sauvignon-blanc.title: Villa Maria Cellar Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
villa-maria-sparkling-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2022 vintage) "A vibrant and distinctive bouquet, classic with fresh white fleshed fruits, citrus and herbaceous drive. Aromas of peaches and gooseberry, green apple and grapefruits flesh. A layer of wet stone minerality adds depth and complexity. Crisp, dry, fruity, salivating, saline and dry on the palate. Flavours reflect the bouquet with a vibrant, tasty finish. Best drinking from 2022 through 2025." - 92/100, Cameron Douglas MS

farmers-of-wine.title: Tom Gore Vineyards Farmer's Blend
farmers-of-wine.bodyHtml:
Tom Gore Farmer's Blend is a fruit-forward, red wine blend known for its approachable, flavorful profile and great value. It's described as having a deep purple color with aromas of black pepper, spice, blackcurrant, morello cherry, and raspberry. The wine offers a full mouthfeel with round, velvety tannins and hints of spice and pepper, leading to a prolonged, silky finish with dark fruits and black cherry flavors. 

Deep purple with aromas of black pepper and spice, blackcurrant, morello cherry and raspberry. A full mouth feel with round, velvety tannins and hints of spice and pepper. Dark fruits and black cherry with a prolonged silky finish.

bacardi-maestro.title: Bacardi Gold Rum
bacardi-maestro.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Gold is a golden rum crafted by the Maestros de Ron Bacardí, who build its rich flavour and golden colour in toasted oak barrels; its mellow character comes from a blend of charcoals known only to them. The label calls it a superior gold rum, and Bacardi describes a light golden rum with a soft oak flavour, where dry vanilla, ginger root and toasted almond lead to a dry, slightly sweet finish. It is made for zesty, bold mixed drinks, above all the Cuba Libre. This 750ml bottle is bottled at 40% ABV and is a product of Puerto Rico.

Tasting Notes: Soft oak with dry vanilla, ginger root and toasted almond.

Nose: Nuts and butter.

Palate: Rich and toasted.

Finish: Dry and slightly sweet.

Serve: In a Cuba Libre, or with cola and a wedge of lime over ice.

st-francis-sauvignon-blanc.title: St Francis Sauvignon Blanc 2021 750ml
st-francis-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: The St. Francis Sauvignon Blanc 2021 is described as a crisp, refreshing white wine with notes of white peach, lime leaf, and honeydew melon on the aroma, followed by flavors of kiwi and citrus on the palate. It's a lively and balanced wine, ideal for a variety of occasions.

lagavulin-12-year-56-8.title: Lagavulin 8 Year Old 200th Anniversary
lagavulin-12-year-56-8.bodyHtml: Big and smoky on the nose with notes of sweet spice, dried dark fruit, caramel, tar, brine and toasted nut. Palate is rich, sweet and smooth with bold flavours of smoky campfire, cumin, molasses and peat with notes of apple crumble and spice.

screw-it-sauvignon-blanc.title: Duckhorn Vineyards North Coast Sauvignon Blanc 2025
screw-it-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Vineyards North Coast Sauvignon Blanc 2025 is an elegant California white wine from the acclaimed Duckhorn Vineyards, celebrating the winery's 50th anniversary. Crafted from 87% Sauvignon Blanc and 13% Sémillon, this expressive wine combines vibrant tropical fruit with refreshing citrus and a silky texture. Fermented in stainless steel and new French oak, then aged on its lees for five months, it reveals inviting notes of pineapple guava, dragonfruit, lemon meringue, and key lime blossom. Rich yet beautifully balanced, it delivers bright acidity and a lively, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp, seared scallops, fresh oysters, goat cheese, herb-roasted chicken, citrus-marinated fish, asparagus, and light summer salads.

 

91 Points - James Suckling

Bright and fresh, with aromas of lemon zest, grapefruit, white peach and wet stone. The palate is medium-bodied with vibrant acidity and a rounded, textural mouthfeel. Refreshing and well balanced. Drink now. Screw cap.

matua-pinot-gris-gisborne.title: Matua Pinot Gris Gisborne 750ml
matua-pinot-gris-gisborne.bodyHtml:
Critic tasting note (2021 vintage):
"Founded in 1974, Matua has continually surprised and innovated in a country still young on the wine scene. Their 'Matua, Pinot Grigio 2021' stands out as a crisp and refreshing white, yet not without character. From the first pour, the bouquet reveals itself with surprising intensity: vibrant aromas of juicy pear, crisp green apple, and a subtle hint of lemon zest, all highlighted by a delicate, almost saline minerality. On the palate, the attack is lively, marked by well-balanced acidity that brings immediate freshness. Flavors of white-fleshed fruit blossom, supported by light floral notes. However, despite this engaging first impression, the wine also shows its limits: a somewhat timid finish and a complexity that struggles to fully develop over the course of the tasting. Serve at 12°C. Delicious with Thai basil shrimp, teriyaki salmon fillet, pork dumplings, shrimp pad thai, General Tso's chicken, Asian salad, or seared scallop bites."
– 88/100, Bacchus Magazine

tom-gore-chardonnay.title: Tom Gore Chardonnay 2023
tom-gore-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Tom Gore Chardonnay has intense aromas of ripe apple and pear, complemented by notes of brown spice and toasted oak. The wine has ripe fruit flavors with a smooth, creamy texture and a long, full finish.

Pale gold in colour, our Chardonnay features notes of pear, grilled pineapple, brown spice, and caramel with a nice richness in the mouth and a creamy texture and finish.

boschendal-1685-shiraz.title: Boschendal 1685 Shiraz
boschendal-1685-shiraz.bodyHtml: The grapes originated from high-quality vineyard sites around Stellenbosch, Elgin and the Swartland. The palate shows generous, deep black fruit and a riper vintage fruit expression with pepper spice. Richness and juiciness with a round, integrated fruit core and silky ripe tannins.

jaboulet-parallele-45-red.title: Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aine Parallele 45 Rouge
jaboulet-parallele-45-red.bodyHtml:
Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aîné Parallèle 45 Rouge is a historic, vibrant, and highly reliable red wine that serves as a benchmark entry point to the Côtes du Rhône appellation. Named after the 45th parallel north which passes just kilometers from the estate's cellars, this organically and biodynamically farmed cuvée is crafted from a traditional blend of Grenache and Syrah, enhanced by minor components of Carignan and Mourvèdre. In the glass, it presents a deep garnet-red color with bright purple reflections. The nose is highly expressive and fruit-forward, bursting with aromas of ripe wild strawberry, fresh raspberry, and dark cherry seamlessly balanced by complex notes of cracked black pepper, dried lavender, and wild garrigue. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, remarkably approachable, and juicy. It offers a core of succulent red berry fruit supported by fine-grained, supple tannins and a crisp natural acidity, leading into a refreshing, clean, and beautifully balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with cured charcuterie platters, grilled pork sausages, moussaka, classic beef burgers, and savory wood-fired mushroom pizzas.

ruffino-sparkling-rose.title: Ruffino Prosecco Rose
ruffino-sparkling-rose.bodyHtml: Ruffino Prosecco Rosé is an elegant and fragrant sparkling wine that marries the crispness of Prosecco with the delicate charm of Pinot Noir. Produced using the Charmat method at Ruffino's Ca' del Duca and La Duchessa estates in Veneto, it presents an enchanting pale pink hue and fine, persistent bubbles. The bouquet is fresh and fruity, bursting with approachable notes of strawberry, rose petals, and red berries, alongside subtle hints of white peach. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-balanced, offering a lively and juicy finish with a refreshing acidity. It is highly versatile, ideal as an aperitif or paired with light dishes such as grilled fish, roasted chicken, or fresh salads.

fleur-du-cap-pinotage.title: Kanonkop Black Label Pinotage 2021
fleur-du-cap-pinotage.bodyHtml:
Kanonkop Black Label Pinotage 2021 delivers concentrated red and black cherry with vanilla, dark chocolate and sweet spice. Layers of red rose, cured meat and coffee add complexity, while softer tannins from the cool vintage provide balance. The finish is lifted, refined and remarkably persistent.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with aromatic curries, barbecued venison, roast duck, pork belly, or grilled tuna.

lucky-bastard-dill-pickle-vodka.title: Lucky Bastard Dill Pickle Vodka
lucky-bastard-dill-pickle-vodka.bodyHtml:
Lucky Bastard Dill Pickle Vodka is a Saskatchewan favourite from Lucky Bastard Distillers. The distillery's premium vodka is distilled seven times for smoothness, then naturally infused with real dill pickles and brine from Elman's award-winning pickles. It is a two-time People's Choice Award winner at the Rocky Mountain Wine & Spirit Festival and was made with the Caesar in mind. Gluten free and bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: In a Caesar, or chilled and neat for the adventurous.

gauchezco-estate-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Gauchezco Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
gauchezco-estate-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: The Gauchezco Estate Cabernet Sauvignon is a wine characterized by its deep ruby red color, complex aromas of ripe fruits like cherries and plums with hints of cassis, and a long, elegant finish. It is a well-rounded wine, often described as having a persistent, well-rounded character. The wine pairs well with red meats, spicy dishes, and ripe cheeses. The recommended serving temperature is 60°F – 64°F (16°C – 18°C).

goat-locker-pale-session-ale-psa.title: Endeauvour Tumbling Goat Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans
goat-locker-pale-session-ale-psa.bodyHtml: Endeauvour Tumbling Goat Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans

zaccagnini-pinot-grigio.title: Cantina Zaccagnini Tralcetto Pinot Grigio
zaccagnini-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Cantina Zaccagnini Tralcetto Pinot Grigio is a remarkably fresh, crisp, and beautifully balanced Italian white wine, instantly recognizable by the signature piece of grapevine twig (the "tralcetto") hand-tied to the neck of every bottle. Sourced from estate vineyards in the Abruzzo region, this wine captures the vibrant energy of the terroir, fermenting entirely in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to preserve its pure fruit expression. In the glass, it displays a brilliant pale yellow color with subtle greenish hues. The nose is highly expressive and fragrant, opening with inviting aromas of fresh green apples, ripe pears, and citrus zest, beautifully complemented by notes of tropical pineapple, white flowers, and a touch of wild mountain herbs. On the palate, this dry, light-to-medium-bodied Pinot Grigio is incredibly clean and lively, balancing juicy tree fruit flavors with a bright line of acidity and a crisp, saline mineral finish that makes it extremely refreshing.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh grilled white fish, lemon-herb chicken breast, light seafood risottos, steamed mussels, or fresh garden salads dressed in vinaigrette.

folonari-senso.title: Folonari Senso 750ml
folonari-senso.bodyHtml: Folonari Senso is a dry, red wine from the Veronese IGT region in Italy, typically made with Corvina and Merlot grapes. It features cherry and berry flavors, with a rich and spicy finish thanks to the appassimento method, which involves drying some of the grapes. The wine is known for its good value and balanced taste.

montecchiesi-vermentino-chardonnay.title: Tenuta Montecchiesi Vermentino - Chardonnay 2024 750ml
montecchiesi-vermentino-chardonnay.bodyHtml: 60% Vermentino and 40% Chardonnay. Tenuta Montecchiesi Vermentino Chardonnay Toscana IGT is intense straw yellow, with gold highlights. A generous bouquet marries notes of Mediterranean hawthorn blossom and rosemary to crisper impressions of mandarin orange and pencil lead. On the palate, it exhibits stylish grace and superb balance, concluding with a finish marked by ripe fruit and a tangy vein of mineral.

osborne-solaz.title: Osborne Solaz 750ml
osborne-solaz.bodyHtml: Osborne Solaz Tempranillo-Cabernet Sauvignon is a Spanish red wine blend, typically 750ml, crafted from grapes grown in Osborne's Malpica Estate vineyards. It is known for its vibrant, intense cherry color and aromas of red and black fruit, with hints of vanilla and spices. The wine is full-bodied, broad, and well-structured with a good balance between body and acidity. It is often recommended for pairing with red meats, stews, and strong cheeses.

copper-moon-moscato.title: Copper Moon Merlot 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-moscato.bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Merlot 4L Bag in Box is an approachable, smooth, and fruit-forward red wine produced in Canada by Arterra Wines Canada. Conveniently packaged in a 4-liter bag-in-box format, it is designed for easy, everyday enjoyment and stays fresh for weeks after opening. In the glass, it exhibits a bright garnet hue with soft aromas of ripe black cherry, dark plums, and sweet blackcurrant, complemented by subtle hints of spice and gentle oak on the finish. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-rounded, delivering plush dark fruit flavors, supple tannins, and a clean, soft finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled beef burgers, roasted pork chops, pasta with tomato ragù, pizza, BBQ chicken, and mild cheeses.

summer-love-raspberry.title: Summer Dreams Super Chill Pinot Noir 2021
summer-love-raspberry.bodyHtml:
Summer Dreams Super Chill Pinot Noir 2021 is an exceptionally bold, multi-layered, and deeply concentrated California red wine that beautifully exemplifies the intense, vineyard-driven personality of the West Sonoma Coast. Crafted by Jayson Woodbridge, the visionary behind Napa Valley's iconic Hundred Acre winery, this debut-release Pinot Noir is drawn from meticulously selected hillside vineyards ranging between 900 and 1900 feet above sea level, rooted uniquely in fine-grained, well-draining Goldridge sandy loam soils. Comprising an equal blend of Pommard and 777 clones and aged in premium tight-grained French oak barrels from the Vosges Forest, it uncoils with an expressive, highly perfumed bouquet of dark plums, black cherries, and sweet caramel, beautifully layered with undercurrents of bitter chocolate, wild forest flowers, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, remarkably rich, and succulent mouthfeel where a concentrated core of crushed raspberry and dark cherry fruits is balanced effortlessly by an energetic vein of natural acidity and waves of creamy, ultra-fine tannins. Seamlessly structured to carry its generous flavor profile without tasting hot, it glides into a long, ripe, and wonderfully savory finish that combines power and classic coastal tension.

Food Pairing:

Pairs spectacularly with roasted duck breast, grain-fed Chateaubriand steak, grilled wild boar chops, savory eel donburi, or pan-seared venison medallion.

94 Points - James Suckling

A lovely red with plum, cherry and caramel character. Perfumed. Chocolate. Full-bodied and juicy with lots of fruity, creamy tannins. A ripe and savory finish. Solid. From the owner of Napa’s Hundred Acre winery.

poema-cava-brut-rose.title: Poema Cava Brut Rose 750ml
poema-cava-brut-rose.bodyHtml: Poema Cava Brut Rosé is a dry, sparkling rosé wine from Spain. It is known for its lively, bright pink color and refreshing flavors of red berries, citrus, and a hint of floral notes. The wine is well-balanced with a crisp finish, making it a great choice for celebrations or casual sipping.

effen-black-cherry.title: Jim Beam Black Cherry
effen-black-cherry.bodyHtml:
A wildly popular flavored whiskey that masterfully blends the classic, oaky warmth of Kentucky Straight Bourbon with the vibrant, sweet taste of natural black cherry. Recently updated to an approachable 65 proof (32.5% ABV), it delivers a lush and fruity profile that is incredibly easy to drink. It's the perfect entry-level bourbon for those with a sweet tooth and shines beautifully when mixed with cola, ginger ale, or iced tea.

NOSE

Prominent, sweet aromas of dark cherry and berries backed by traditional bourbon vanilla and light oak.

PALATE

Sweet and fruit-forward, featuring luscious black cherry flavors perfectly balanced by soft caramel and warm oak undertones.

FINISH

Smooth, sweet, and lingering with a warm cherry finish.

crystal-head-1.title: Crystal Head Aurora Vodka
crystal-head-1.bodyHtml:
Aurora uses the highest-quality English wheat and pristine water from Newfoundland, Canada to craft an additive-free vodka. The vodka's purity is maintained by way of five distillations and seven filtrations. And as our final distinctive touch, three of these filtrations are passed through layers of Herkimer diamonds.

Crystal Head Aurora was created in celebration of the aurora borealis, the most vivid aerial phenomenon. The bottle, with its delicate and iridescent metallized finish, is our tribute to this natural light display, with its beauty and mysterious visual properties.

A clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose – crisp with delicate floral aromas with a subtle hint of anise. Warm with strong peppercorn notes and a touch of sweetness. Dry, clean and warming sensation on the finish.

moosehead-lager-1.title: Moosehead Canadian Lager 15 Cans
moosehead-lager-1.bodyHtml:
Moosehead Lager is Canada’s iconic, independent lager brewed by Canada's oldest independent brewery, Moosehead Breweries Limited in Saint John, New Brunswick. Brewed using a classic lager recipe with 100% Canadian 2-row malted barley, pure water, and a double-fermentation process, this pale lager delivers a finely balanced balance between sweet maltiness and mild hop bitterness. It is clean, crisp, and refreshing, making it an accessible and timeless Canadian classic.

Food Pairing: Grilled burgers, fish and chips, barbecue chicken, soft pretzels with mustard, and mild cheeses like young cheddar or Colby.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden straw yellow in color with a clear appearance and a light, crisp, and effervescent mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and clean with notes of sweet grain, light corn, subtle malted barley, and a faint touch of grassy floral hops.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with light malt sweetness, soft cereal grains, and a crisp, gentle hop bitterness that cleanses the palate.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing with a crisp, dry finish and slight lingering grain notes.

Serve : Serve well-chilled at 38–42°F (3–5°C) directly from the bottle or poured into a classic pilsner or pint glass.

moosehead-lager-2.title: Moosehead Canadian Lager 15 Cans
moosehead-lager-2.bodyHtml:
Moosehead Lager is Canada’s iconic, independent lager brewed by Canada's oldest independent brewery, Moosehead Breweries Limited in Saint John, New Brunswick. Brewed using a classic lager recipe with 100% Canadian 2-row malted barley, pure water, and a double-fermentation process, this pale lager delivers a finely balanced balance between sweet maltiness and mild hop bitterness. It is clean, crisp, and refreshing, making it an accessible and timeless Canadian classic.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden straw yellow in color with a clear appearance and a light, crisp, and effervescent mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and clean with notes of sweet grain, light corn, subtle malted barley, and a faint touch of grassy floral hops.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with light malt sweetness, soft cereal grains, and a crisp, gentle hop bitterness that cleanses the palate.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing with a crisp, dry finish and slight lingering grain notes.

Serve : Serve well-chilled at 38–42°F (3–5°C) directly from the bottle or poured into a classic pilsner or pint glass.

1000-stories-zinfandel.title: Saldo Zinfandel by The Prisoner 2024
1000-stories-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Saldo Zinfandel by The Prisoner 2024 features intense, ripe dark fruit aromas of blackberry jam, dark plum, and black cherry intertwined with accents of black pepper, black licorice, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied, rich, and velvety texture characterized by concentrated blueberry and cocoa notes, smooth integrated tannins, and a long, warming finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with barbecue ribs, grilled flank steak, peppercorn-crusted pork tenderloin, blue cheese burgers, and aged cheeses like sharp cheddar or Gouda.

bud-light-lime-3.title: Bud Light Lime 12 Bottles
bud-light-lime-3.bodyHtml: Bud Light Lime is a light-bodied lager brewed with real lime peels to deliver a distinctively clean and refreshing citrus taste. It combines the crisp, easy-drinking profile of a light beer with a natural, zesty lime twist. The 12-pack of 341ml glass bottles offers a subtle malt sweetness balanced by a bright, tangy aroma and a fast, snappy finish. It is a popular choice for warm-weather occasions, emphasizing a refreshing and thirst-quenching character.

aberlour-10-year-old.title: Aberlour 12 Year Old Double Cask Matured
aberlour-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Aberlour 12 Year Old Double Cask Matured is a quintessential, deeply satisfying Speyside single malt that perfectly exemplifies the art of dual-wood maturation. Crafted at the picturesque Aberlour Distillery at the confluence of the rivers Lour and Spey, this expression benefits from soft water sourced from the nearby Ben Rinnes mountain. The spirit is aged for a minimum of 12 years in two distinct barrel types: traditional American white oak ex-bourbon barrels and premium European oak Oloroso sherry butts. The component whiskies are then masterfully vatted together, blending the bright, sweet vanilla character of the bourbon oak with the rich, deeply spiced fruit of the sherry wood.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared duck breast with a cherry reduction, warm apple strudel dusted with cinnamon, mature white cheddar, or dark chocolate-covered hazelnuts.

TASTING NOTES Deep amber-gold with reddish reflections, offering a soft, silky, and beautifully approachable medium body.

NOSE Rich, sweet, and classic Speyside; opens with dominant aromas of crisp red apples and ripe autumn fruits, beautifully layered with creamy vanilla caramel, liquid honey, and a delicate hint of festive baking spices.

PALATE Well-rounded and full-flavored without intense bite; an immediate wave of sweet honeycomb and vanilla fudge gives way to deeper, wine-forward notes of sweet plums, raisins, and milk chocolate, all balanced by a fine thread of fresh citrus rind.

FINISH Medium to long, warm, and gently drying, leaving trailing notes of sweet ginger spice, toasted nutmeg, cinnamon, and a final hint of charred oak wood.

SERVE Highly versatile; perfect when enjoyed neat or with a few drops of water in a Glencairn glass to amplify the fruit and sherry layers, or as an upscale base for an elegant Rob Roy.

black-label-1.title: Kanonkop Black Label Pinotage 2021
black-label-1.bodyHtml:
Kanonkop Black Label Pinotage 2021 delivers concentrated red and black cherry with vanilla, dark chocolate and sweet spice. Layers of red rose, cured meat and coffee add complexity, while softer tannins from the cool vintage provide balance. The finish is lifted, refined and remarkably persistent.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with aromatic curries, barbecued venison, roast duck, pork belly, or grilled tuna.

goat-locker-fainting-bock.title: Goat Locker Fainting Bock 4 Tall Cans

whistler-mountain-lager.title: Whistler Forager Gluten Free Lager 6 Cans

jim-beam-rye.title: Jim Beam Rye Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
jim-beam-rye.bodyHtml:
Crafted from a historic pre-Prohibition recipe, Jim Beam Rye is one of the oldest and most trusted names in the rye whiskey category. Bottled at a sturdy 90 proof, it boasts a distinctly bold and spicy flavor profile that stands out beautifully against the sweeter notes of traditional bourbons. This robust character makes it the absolute perfect foundational spirit for classic, whiskey-forward cocktails like the Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

 

NOSE

Bright and spicy with inviting aromas of freshly baked rye bread, black pepper, nutmeg, and a hint of vanilla.

PALATE

Rich and full-bodied, delivering a bold punch of peppery rye spice that is beautifully smoothed out by sweet caramel and warm oak.

FINISH

Long, warming, and pleasantly spicy with lingering notes of cinnamon and pepper.

yellow-tail-bubbles-rose.title: Yellow Tail Bubbles Rose 750ml
yellow-tail-bubbles-rose.bodyHtml:
Yellow Tail Bubbles Rose 750ml

83 points Wine Enthusiast

siempre-tequila-plata.title: Siempre Plata Tequila
siempre-tequila-plata.bodyHtml:
Siempre Plata Tequila is an ultra-premium, additive-free 100% Blue Weber agave blanco tequila crafted using a combination of agave grown in both the Los Altos (Highlands) and Valle (Lowlands) regions of Jalisco. Double-distilled and fermented with wild yeast in open-air fermenters, it delivers a masterfully balanced profile that combines highland floral citrus sweetness with lowland earthy spice.

Food Pairing: Fresh ceviche, grilled shrimp, oysters on the half shell, fish tacos, or citrus-marinated chicken.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and brilliant in appearance with a smooth, bright, and approachable mouthfeel.

Nose : Vibrant cooked agave accompanied by fresh citrus, orange and lime zest, green apple, white pepper, and subtle herbal grass and mint notes.

Palate : Crisp and agave-forward with sweet baked agave, lime oil, black pepper, faint cinnamon, and a light mineral salinity.

Finish : Clean, dry, and refreshing with lingering cracked black pepper, citrus oil, and warm cooked agave.

Serve : Serve neat in a tulip glass, over ice, or as a premium base in classic cocktails like a Margarita or Paloma.

phillips-citricity-grapefruit-zest-ipa.title: Phillips Gorilla Mode Juice Wizard Ipa

jaboulet-biographie-organic-rhone-red.title: Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aine Cotes-du-Rhone Biographie
jaboulet-biographie-organic-rhone-red.bodyHtml:
Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aîné Côtes-du-Rhône Biographie is a fresh, vibrant, and beautifully balanced organic red wine that perfectly captures the lively character of the Southern Rhône Valley. Pouring an inviting deep ruby color with violet glints, it opens with an expressive nose rich in ripe dark forest fruits, crunchy red berries, and wild raspberries, accented by notes of fresh lavender, licorice, and fine black pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and fruit-forward, balancing its succulent core of dark cherries and red currants with fine, approachable tannins and a well-integrated natural acidity. The finish is remarkably clean, supple, and mouth-watering, leaving behind an elegant touch of savory garrigue herbs and crushed stone mineral notes.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with slow-cooked beef stew, grilled pork sausages, roasted duck breast, herb-crusted lamb chops, wood-fired mushroom pizza, and savory charcuterie.

jaboulet-hermitage-la-chapelle-1.title: Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aine Hermitage La Chapelle 2017 1.5L Magnum
jaboulet-hermitage-la-chapelle-1.bodyHtml:
Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aîné Hermitage La Chapelle Rouge 2017 is a monumental and profoundly complex Northern Rhône red wine crafted entirely from 100% old-vine Syrah sourced from legendary plots on Hermitage Hill. In the glass, it exhibits a deeply saturated purple-ruby color. The aromatic profile is incredibly expressive, unfurling layers of pristine dark cherries, wild blackberries, crème de cassis, and black olives blended seamlessly with savory hints of smoked bacon, mocha, licorice, and a distinct graphite and crushed-stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and concentrated, yet retains an almost playful softness due to its intensely slick, integrated, and velvety tannins. Balanced beautifully by a lively, structural acidity, it delivers a powerful yet extraordinarily elegant mouthfeel that evolves gracefully into a spectacular, long, and savory finish showing notes of cracked pepper and subtle dark cocoa.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic roasted rack of lamb, thick-cut grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised venison stew, roasted duck breast, and rich wild mushroom risotto.

98 Points - James Suckling

The icon is in dangerously seductive form. Such pristine dark cherries, blackberries and dark plums, dark chocolate, finely crushed spices and plenty of crushed dark stones on offer. The palate is very intense, very slick and fine tannins deliver an almost playfully soft impression. The oak is super integrated. Like La Maison Bleue, this approachability is an aberration, as it has immense power, concentration and length with such regal and alluring swagger at the finish. But there is so much more to come.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2017 Hermitage La Chapelle comes from the firm's vineyards on the western half of the Hermitage slope, primarily Le Méal, but with substantial contributions from Les Rocoules and Les Bessards. Classic notes of cassis, black olives, mocha and roasted meat are joined by hints of baking spices in a wine that's full-bodied, deep, dense and rich, with a velvety texture and a lingering finish. It's lower in alcohol than the 2018, less voluptuous and maybe just a step behind that monumental wine, but it's still a serious collectible with three decades of evolution ahead of it.

moosehead-pale-ale.title: Moosehead Canadian Lager 24 Cans
moosehead-pale-ale.bodyHtml:
Moosehead Lager is Canada’s iconic, independent lager brewed by Canada's oldest independent brewery, Moosehead Breweries Limited in Saint John, New Brunswick. smirnoff-ice-lime.title: Smirnoff Ice Light Original 4 Cans
smirnoff-ice-lime.bodyHtml: The classic Smirnoff Ice made lighter. Lively, refreshing, and bursting with the zesty flavours of lemon and lime. It's perfectly carbonated and thirst-quenching, with a light, easy-drinking profile and a balanced blend of citrus flavors

smirnoff-ice-grapefruit.title: Smirnoff Ice Vii Original 473ml
smirnoff-ice-grapefruit.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Ice VII Original is a sweet, citrus-flavored malt beverage with a crisp taste. This ready-to-drink cooler is a vodka-based cooler full of citrus, lemonade, lime, and grapefruit flavors, designed to be enjoyed chilled straight from the can

appleton-reserve-rum.title: Appleton Estate 8 Year Old Reserve Rum 1L
appleton-reserve-rum.bodyHtml:
Appleton Estate 8 Year Old Reserve is a Jamaican rum crafted by Master Blender Joy Spence to commemorate the estate's 250th anniversary. A blend of pot still and column still rums, it is aged for a minimum of eight years in the tropical climate of the Appleton Estate in the Nassau Valley, made with Jamaican limestone-filtered water and no added flavours. It pours a brilliant honeyed bronze with a subtle green ring of age and is bottled at 43%. This listing is the 1L bottle. It won Gold at the 2024 San Francisco World Spirits Competition and is Appleton's most versatile expression.

Tasting Notes: Fruit, oak, honey, vanilla and orange peel.

Nose: Spicy fruit and oak, then honey, vanilla, holiday spice and the house orange-peel note.

Finish: Exceptionally smooth, balanced by a hint of molasses and warm oak.

Serve: Sip over ice, or use two parts in a classic Mai Tai.

chateau-souverain-rose.title: Chateau Minuty M Rose 2025
chateau-souverain-rose.bodyHtml:
Château Minuty M Rosé 2025 is a quintessential, bright, and brilliantly fresh Provençal rosé that captures the vibrant spirit of the French Riviera. Crafted by one of the region’s most historic and celebrated Crus Classés estates, this wine displays a remarkably clear, pale pink hue resembling delicate rose petals. The nose opens with an expressive and lively bouquet filled with zesty citrus, wild red berries, white peach, and hints of crisp exotic fruits. On the palate, it strikes a wonderful balance between a luscious, rounded fruit texture and a bracing, mouthwatering acidity, culminating in a clean, persistent, and subtly savory mineral finish that makes it incredibly refreshing.

Food Pairing:

Pair this lively rosé with fresh Caprese or Niçoise salads, grilled shrimp skewers, summer vegetable tapas, pistou soup, or light Mediterranean seafood dishes.

hey-yall-watermelon-hard-iced-tea.title: Hey Y'All Hell Yeah 7% Hard Iced Tea
hey-yall-watermelon-hard-iced-tea.bodyHtml: Hey Y'All Hell Yeah 7% Hard Iced Tea

jacobs-creek-moscato-in-can.title: Jacob's Creek Moscato
jacobs-creek-moscato-in-can.bodyHtml:
Jacob's Creek Moscato is a light, delightfully refreshing, and beautifully aromatic sweet white wine produced by one of Australia's most prominent and historically rich estates. Crafted with a focus on youthful, clean fruit expressions, it features a very gentle, playful spritz that enhances its lively nature. In the glass, it displays a beautiful pale straw-yellow hue. The highly inviting bouquet opens with fragrant notes of ripe tropical fruits, juicy white peach, and honeydew melon, elegantly complemented by delicate hints of citrus blossom, fresh ginger, and honeysuckle. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, sweet, and wonderfully balanced, delivering a luscious core of lychee, grapey sweetness, and soft sherbet flavors. A crisp, zesty natural acidity perfectly cuts through the sweetness, preventing it from feeling heavy and ensuring a clean, vibrant, and incredibly refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh fruit platters, light pavlova, moderately spicy Thai noodle dishes, crispy vegetable spring rolls, and mild, creamy blue cheeses.

broken-ladder-pears-and-peaches-cider.title: Broken Ladder Pears And Peaches Cider 4 Tall Cans
broken-ladder-pears-and-peaches-cider.bodyHtml: Broken Ladder Pears And Peaches Cider 4 Tall Cans

los-clop-malbec.title: Los Clop Reserva Malbec 2023
los-clop-malbec.bodyHtml:
Los Clop Reserva Malbec 2023 is an elegant, full-bodied, and beautifully structured Argentine red wine crafted by Bodega Los Clop in Mendoza's prized Uco Valley. Displaying an intense, deep violet-purple hue, it opens with enticing aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, and fresh plums, seamlessly layered with delicate floral violet notes, sweet spice, vanilla, and subtle toasted oak from barrel aging. On the palate, it delivers a plush, velvety mouthfeel with rich dark fruit flavors, supple tannins, and a refreshing beam of natural acidity that carries into a long, smooth, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised beef short ribs, empanadas, wild mushroom dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

big-house-rose-in-a-can.title: Cottage Springs Punched Up Variety 8 Cans

canmore-brewing-mineside-stout.title: Canmore Brewing Misty Mountain Hops Neip 4 Tall Cans
canmore-brewing-mineside-stout.bodyHtml: Canmore Brewing Misty Mountain Hops Neip 4 Tall Cans

j-p-wisers-triple-barrel-rye.title: J.P. Wiser's Triple Barrel Rye
j-p-wisers-triple-barrel-rye.bodyHtml:
J.P. Wiser's Triple Barrel Rye is a smooth Canadian blended whisky produced by J.P. Wiser's at Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario. It is aged for 10 years using a combination of three cask types—used Canadian whisky barrels, first-fill ex-bourbon casks, and virgin oak barrels—yielding a harmonious balance between sweet corn notes, vibrant rye spice, and rich oak influence.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, pulled pork sandwiches, aged cheddar, dark chocolate, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Deep reddish-amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied, and inviting mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet aromas of toffee, caramel, vanilla, and honeycomb balanced by green apple, ripe orchard fruit, and light rye spice.

Palate : Rich corn sweetness and caramel initial notes opening up to bold rye spice, oak sap, toasted wood, and a touch of maple.

Finish : Warm, crisp, and smooth with lingering notes of baking spice, vanilla, and soft oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as the base for a classic Old Fashioned or Manhattan cocktail.

wallaroo-trail-chardonnay.title: Cairn Trail Chardonnay
wallaroo-trail-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Designed for casual enjoyment, this bright California Chardonnay delivers a wonderfully refreshing profile. Inviting aromas of crisp green apple, juicy pear, and sweet vanilla blossom open into a smooth, medium-bodied palate balanced by clean orchard fruit and a soft, creamy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken with garlic butter, pan-seared pork chops, creamy seafood pasta, or a selection of soft Brie and goat cheeses.

mission-hill-estate-series-pinot-gris.title: Mission Hill Reserve Crafted in BC Pinot Gris
mission-hill-estate-series-pinot-gris.bodyHtml:
Fresh and aromatic, with ripe pear, peach, green apple, citrus, and delicate floral notes. The palate is bright and rounded, showing juicy orchard fruit, refreshing acidity, gentle texture, and a clean, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with seafood, grilled fish, roast chicken, fresh salads, sushi, creamy pasta, soft cheeses, or lightly spiced Asian dishes.

cavaliere-doro-toscana.title: Castello Di Gabbiano Dark Knight Toscana 2021
cavaliere-doro-toscana.bodyHtml:
This bold red wine delivers intense aromas of ripe red berries, sweet spices, coffee, and vanilla. The full-bodied palate is ample and balanced, exhibiting dark plum flavors, mocha notes, and silky tannins. The finish is remarkably smooth, sweet, and spicy.

Food Pairing: Perfectly matches with grilled ribeye steaks, roasted rack of lamb, hearty beef stews, and full-flavoured sharp cheddar cheeses.

jack-daniels-tennessee-rye.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey 1.14L
jack-daniels-tennessee-rye.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey is an iconic, smooth American whiskey crafted in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Charcoal mellowed drop-by-drop through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before aging in handcrafted white oak barrels, it offers a distinct balance of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, and smooth caramel character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, pulled pork sandwiches, grilled burgers, smoked brisket, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold in appearance with a light-to-medium-bodied, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, banana, and subtle brown sugar.

Palate : Balanced mix of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, light spice, and rich caramel.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and medium-length with lingering toasted oak, charcoal, and sweet spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed with cola in a highball glass.

alley-kat-pumpkin-spiced.title: Alley Kat Pumpkin Pie Spiced Ale

tamari-malbec.title: Vasse Felix Tom Cullity Cabernet Sauvignon Malbec
tamari-malbec.bodyHtml:
Refined and deeply expressive, with cassis, blackberry and red fruits layered with violets, savoury herbs, graphite and earthy complexity. The palate combines concentrated fruit with freshness, exceptionally fine tannins and elegant structure, carrying into a persistent, poised finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast lamb, grilled beef, venison, braised short ribs, wild mushrooms, aged cheddar, or herb-crusted meats.

angry-orchard-crisp-apple-cider-1.title: Bumper Crop Crisp Apple Cider 6x355ml Cans
angry-orchard-crisp-apple-cider-1.bodyHtml: Loaded with the flavours of Okanagan apples, Bumper Crop Crisp Apple is sparkling, smooth and refreshing.

los-clop-chardonnay.title: Los Clop Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
los-clop-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Los Clop Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a full-bodied and expressive Argentinian red wine showcasing a deep red color with vibrant purple hues. On the nose, it delivers complex and inviting aromas of bright bell pepper, ripe cassis, and rich red fruit jam, perfectly interwoven with sweet notes of vanilla, roasted coffee, leather, tobacco, and subtle spices. The palate offers a robust yet approachable structure, highlighting a generous core of dark fruit flavors supported by sweet, round, and seamlessly integrated tannins. The finish is persistent, well-balanced, and highly satisfying, making it an outstanding value from Mendoza.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic grilled ribeye steaks, slow-braised short ribs, hearty beef stews, roasted lamb dishes, or savory pasta with rich meat sauces.

92 Points - James Suckling

This shows the varietal transparency on the nose with ripe, sweet currants, black olives, tobacco and a balsamic undertone that gives it a savory edge. Fluent and almost linear on the flavorful palate with a medium to full body. Tight and nicely chewy on the palate. Drink or hold.

19-crimes-the-uprising-red-blend.title: 19 Crimes The Uprising Red NV 750ml
19-crimes-the-uprising-red-blend.bodyHtml: A portion of this wine is aged in rum barrels, as an homage to Australia's Rum Rebellion of 1808. Upfront aromas of fig jam, candied fruit and a hint of spice. The palate is dry, with balanced acidity and supple tannins. Flavours of fig jam and spice, with a brown sugar note on the finish. Serve with steak, ribs or burgers.

flat-roof-manor-opulent-red.title: Nederberg Flat Roof Manor Opulent Red 2017 750ml
flat-roof-manor-opulent-red.bodyHtml: Lively purple-red with a bright pink rim. A combination of raspberry, cotton candy and spices with undertones of a mocha oak finish. Berries and spices with lively tannins, giving the wine a youthfulness; a soft and lingering sweet aftertaste.

andeluna-altitude-malbec.title: Andeluna 1300 Malbec 2023
andeluna-altitude-malbec.bodyHtml:
Andeluna 1300 Malbec 2024 is a rich, vibrant, and expressive Argentinian red wine from the renowned Mendoza wine region. Crafted from Malbec grapes grown in high-altitude vineyards in the Uco Valley, approximately 1,300 metres above sea level, this wine captures the distinctive character of Argentina's mountain terroir. It offers generous dark fruit flavours, delicate floral aromas, and subtle spice notes, complemented by smooth tannins and refreshing acidity. With its approachable structure, balanced complexity, and elegant finish, this Malbec is an excellent choice for everyday enjoyment, dinner gatherings, and special occasions.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled steak, roasted lamb, barbecue ribs, beef burgers, grilled sausages, roasted vegetables, mushroom risotto, hearty pasta dishes, and aged cheeses.

 

91 Points - James Suckling

Plums, chopped herbs and violets on the nose of this youthful red. It’s medium-bodied, bright and crunchy, with stemmy tannins. Vegan. Sustainable. Drink now or in the next few years.
89 Points - Wine Enthusiast 
This wine shows classic Malbec characteristics, with aromas of flowers. Round and soft tannins and moderate freshness frame black fruit flavors. Perfect to enjoy now with your favorite pasta.
88 Points - Wine Spectator
A youthful red, with a floral and thyme edge to the brambly berry center and fresh acidity. Carries the flavors onto the details around fine tannins. Drink now. 15,000 cases made, 3,000 cases imported.

la-crema-shell-ridge-pinot-noir.title: La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2022/2023
la-crema-shell-ridge-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir is an elegant, medium-bodied red wine that perfectly captures the cool-climate maritime influence of California's coastal vineyards. The nose is incredibly fragrant, offering inviting aromas of macerated red cherry, red plum, cranberry, and delicate hints of forest floor, mushroom, and cinnamon spice. On the palate, it delivers concentrated layers of ripe raspberry, black cherry, and cocoa, beautifully accented by savory touches of cold black tea and a hint of fresh mint. Supported by vibrant, pithy acidity and fine, plush tannins, this well-structured Pinot Noir offers a smooth, generous mouthfeel that leads into a long, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Enjoy with grilled salmon, roasted duck, veal medallions, roasted pork loin, mushroom risotto, braised lamb, or chicken stuffed with goat cheese.

ciroc-french-vanilla.title: Ciroc Vodka
ciroc-french-vanilla.bodyHtml: Finely crafted spirit made from distilled fine French grapes for ultimate luxury. A subtle nose is followed by a clean smooth mouthfeel delivered from five-time distillation. Delicate nuances of citrus and a hint of sweetness that allows the natural character of the grapes to shine through. An ideal mixer for lemonade.

trapiche-medalla-malbec.title: Trapiche Medalla Malbec 2019/2021 750ml
trapiche-medalla-malbec.bodyHtml:
Intense purple with violet tones. Concentrated aromas of red berries, plums, cherries and raisins, highlighted by notes of toast, coconut and vanilla from aging in new French oak barrels. In the mouth the wine reveals its best attributes with a sweet entry, soft and intense tannins that give creaminess, volume and meatiness. The flavors of ripe fruit stand perfectly amalgamated with spicy and smoky wood, leaving a pleasant and persistent finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

A very fragrant malbec here with lots of crushed blueberries, stones, blue flowers and wild herbs. Lavender and violets. The medium-bodied palate has lots of juicy red and blue fruits. The tension and the chalky tannins are very noticeable on the palate. Really well-balanced. Fantastic value for the money. Delicious now, but can hold very well for five to six years.

adorada-rose.title: Codigo 1530 Rosa Tequila
adorada-rose.bodyHtml:
Código 1530 Rosa Tequila is a premium blanco tequila that is rested for 21 days in unsearred French White Oak Cabernet wine barrels from Napa Valley. This brief aging process imparts a natural pale pink hue along with subtle red fruit notes, elevating the pure, crisp profile of fully matured estate-grown Blue Weber agave without overwhelming its essential blanco characteristics.

Food Pairing: Fresh salmon sashimi, grilled shrimp tacos, goat cheese crostini, strawberry salads, or light ceviche.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant pale pink with a light, silky, and refined mouthfeel.

Nose : Subtle floral notes, fresh red berries, light cherry, cooked agave, and bright citrus.

Palate : Soft and balanced with sweet cooked agave, light red wine fruitiness, subtle berry notes, and a hint of white pepper.

Finish : Clean, smooth, and dry with lingering red fruit accents and soft floral sweetness.

Serve : Serve chilled, neat in a tasting glass, on the rocks, or as an elevated base for a Rosé Paloma.

aranwa-reserve-chardonnay.title: Aranwa Reserve Chardonnay 2021
aranwa-reserve-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Aranwa Reserve Chardonnay 2021 is a refreshing and elegant white wine that showcases the classic characteristics of the Chardonnay grape. Offering a delightful balance of ripe fruit flavours, refreshing acidity, and a smooth texture, this reserve-style wine provides an enjoyable drinking experience. Its approachable character and versatile food-pairing potential make it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, seafood dinners, celebrations, and everyday enjoyment.

Food Pairing: Grilled salmon, roasted chicken, creamy pasta, shrimp, lobster, seafood risotto, soft cheeses, and roasted vegetables.

three-olives-rose.title: Three Olives Rose Vodka
three-olives-rose.bodyHtml:
Get in touch with your inner fan girl with Three Olives® Rosé, perfect for getting a day party started. Three Olives® Rosé is a 60 proof vodka at only 90 calories per serving. It's a cocktail forward solution to easy recipes, like Rosé Spritz or Frosé. Delicate and pale pink in color, Three Olives® Rosé has a refreshing strawberry and tart cherry aroma, subtle backgrounds of citrus and wildflower, and hints of pomegranate flavors. (30% ABV – 60 proof) - Winner: GOLD MEDAL (94 points), the New York International Spirits Competition 2019

Color: Blush pink
Aroma: A refreshing strawberry and tart cherry with subtle backgrounds of citrus and wildflower.
Flavor: Hints of pomegranate that develops into a blended red fruit and French oak.
Finish: A crisp orchard fruit finish.

meiomi-rose.title: Meiomi Pinot Noir 2022/2023
meiomi-rose.bodyHtml:
Meiomi Pinot Noir 2023 is a deeply concentrated, intensely jammy, and unapologetically bold California red wine that breaks away from traditional delicate profiles in favor of pure, opulent fruit power. It floods the glass with a dark ruby-crimson hue, giving off an expressive and rich bouquet of macerated boysenberries, dark cherry cola, and strawberry jam, heavily layered with fragrant notes of sweet vanilla bean, mocha, and toasted graham cracker. On the palate, it behaves with a velvety, full-bodied weight, coating the mouth with plush, sweet-toned intensities of dark bramble fruits, mocha powder, and a soft, supple texture that defines this intensely warm and ripe 2023 vintage. Devoid of any aggressive tannins and structured with gentle, low acidity, it glides effortlessly into a smooth, decadent finish that leaves a long, lingering signature of brown sugar and sweet oak spice.

Food Pairing: This rich, fruit-forward style pairs excellently with smoky or slightly sweet savory dishes, including slow-cooked barbecued pulled pork sliders, wood-fired Peking duck pizzas, teriyaki-glazed salmon, gourmet lamb burgers with goat cheese, and standard charcuterie boards stacked with mild gouda or cured meats.

wallaroo-trail-chardonnay-1.title: Cairn Trail Chardonnay
wallaroo-trail-chardonnay-1.bodyHtml:
Designed for casual enjoyment, this bright California Chardonnay delivers a wonderfully refreshing profile. Inviting aromas of crisp green apple, juicy pear, and sweet vanilla blossom open into a smooth, medium-bodied palate balanced by clean orchard fruit and a soft, creamy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken with garlic butter, pan-seared pork chops, creamy seafood pasta, or a selection of soft Brie and goat cheeses.

canyon-road-white-zinfandel.title: Canyon Road White Zinfandel 750ml
canyon-road-white-zinfandel.bodyHtml: Canyon Road White Zinfandel 750ml is a light-bodied, semi-sweet wine with a crisp, refreshing finish. It's known for its fruity flavors of strawberry, cherry, and watermelon. It pairs well with cheese, fruit, and desserts.

russell-a-wee-angry-scotch-ale.title: Russell A Wee Angry Scotch Ale

banded-chinook-saison-farmhouse-ale.title: Banded Peak Southern Aspect 4 Tall Cans
banded-chinook-saison-farmhouse-ale.bodyHtml: Throughout the winter, southern aspects on mountainous slopes can present uncertain and variable conditions. It also leads to epic lines on bluebird days for those willing to take the risk. This beer was born out of taking risks and chasing adventure.

crazy-uncle-hard-ginger-ale.title: Crazy Uncle Hard Root Beer 473ml
crazy-uncle-hard-ginger-ale.bodyHtml: A delightful twist on a classic favorite, blending the nostalgic flavors of traditional root beer with a spirited kick. This unique beverage boasts rich, creamy notes of vanilla and sassafras, complemented by a hint of wintergreen and a touch of spice. Smooth, rich flavour of natural sarsaparilla, sweet birch, wintergreen and licorice root with a creamy vanilla finish. Crisp and refreshing without being overly sweet.

parallel-49-pick-a-hop.title: Parallel 49 - Hop Patroll Mixer Pack 8 Cans
parallel-49-pick-a-hop.bodyHtml:
The Parallel 49 Hop Patroll Mixer Pack is a variety 8-pack featuring four unique, hop-forward craft beers from Parallel 49 Brewing. Each pack typically contains two 473 ml tall cans of each featured style:

  • Shredder (New Zealand Pilsner): A 5.0% ABV pilsner featuring New Zealand hops with notes of citrus, grapefruit, kiwi, and grass.
  • Capt'n Grog (Hazy IPA): A 5.6% ABV juice-forward IPA described by Manitoba Liquor Mart as having a "fluffy mouthfeel" and heavy fruit notes.
  • Sluggo (West Coast IPA): A 6.3% ABV traditional IPA that balances malty flavours with a firm hop bitterness for easy drinking.
  • Haymaker (Cold IPA): A 5.9% ABV crisp IPA brewed with corn as an adjunct to keep malt flavours subtle and emphasize a robust hop profile.

deschutes-mirror-pond-pale-ale.title: Deschutes Mirror Pond Pale Ale 6 Cans

guinness-irish-wheat-ale.title: Innis & Gunn Original 6 Bottles
guinness-irish-wheat-ale.bodyHtml: Innis & Gunn The Original is the flagship beer on which the brewery was founded. This Scottish Golden Beer is cask-matured using the best single malt whisky casks, which imparts an incredible smoothness and depth of flavour with hints of vanilla, toffee, and oak. The result is a truly unique, delicious beer brimming with vanilla and toffee, balanced by notes of orange marmalade, citrus, and a very gentle bitterness for a smooth, refreshing finish .

chateau-grand-corbin-manuel.title: Famille de Gaye Chateau Grand Corbin Manuel 2013
chateau-grand-corbin-manuel.bodyHtml:
Famille de Gaye Château Grand Corbin Manuel 2013 is a well-structured and classically styled Right Bank Bordeaux that demonstrates the resilience of Saint-Émilion's terroir. Pouring a deep crimson with evolving garnet tones, this medium-bodied blend of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Cabernet Sauvignon opens with a delicate and savory bouquet of red plums, fresh cherries, and earthy forest floor, subtly accented by hints of tobacco leaf, olive, and espresso bean. On the palate, it is light-textured and linear, balancing its approachable tart red fruit core with fine-grained, well-integrated tannins and an appealing rustic freshness, leading to a dry, spice-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted pork loin, grilled duck breast, braised rabbit, or mild semi-firm French cheeses like Tomme de Savoie.

monopole-rioja.title: Monopole Blanco Seco
monopole-rioja.bodyHtml:
CVNE has been producing Monopole in Haro since the beginning of the 20th century. The name was registered in 1915. This is the white wine with the oldest registered name in Spain. Made from Rioja Alta grapes, it is characterised by its consistent quality and clean and precise aroma. Classic, young Rioja.

Monopole Rioja is a white wine made from Viura grapes harvested from our own vineyards and vineyards owned by our usual Rioja Alta suppliers. The main grape variety is Viura frown on head-trained vines in fresh, clay soils. All work is carried out by hand, including the grape harvest.

On arrival at the winery, the grapes macerated with their skins for 8 hours at a temperature of 10-12ºC.

The grapes then pass by gravity through a small pneumatic press, producing the flower must. We then carry out a static clarification (debourbage) without any mechanical influence. Fermentation is carried out in stainless steel tanks at controlled temperatures to extract and preserve the distinctive, fruity and floral primary aromas of the variety.

town-sq-megawatt-new-england-ipa.title: Town Sq Megawatt New England IPA 4 Tall Cans
town-sq-megawatt-new-england-ipa.bodyHtml: Town Sq Megawatt New England IPA 4 Tall Cans

boschendal-chenin-blanc.title: Boschendal Chenin Blanc
boschendal-chenin-blanc.bodyHtml:
Boschendal Chenin Blanc is an incredibly vibrant, beautifully balanced, and expressive white wine that captures the brilliant purity of South Africa's signature white grape variety. Sourced from exceptional old-vine parcels across the Coastal Region, it undergoes careful vinification with a portion fermented on its solids to enhance its rich, textured profile. In the glass, it reveals a bright pale straw color with youthful greenish highlights. The highly aromatic nose opens with an inviting bouquet of white guava, fresh tropical peach, mango, and crisp green apple, masterfully layered with delicate undertones of lime leaf, orange blossom, wet stone minerality, and a subtle hint of honeyed nuts. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and delightfully crisp, displaying a beautiful fluid coherence where its core of juicy stone fruits is carried by a racy spine of natural acidity. Weekly lees stirring adds a lovely, creamy richness to the mid-palate, seamlessly leading into a long, vibrant finish marked by lingering ripples of toasted almonds and refreshing citrus zest.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-fried halibut filets, garlic-butter shrimp scampi, roasted lemon herb chicken, and creamy, nutty cheeses like mature Gruyère or aged cheddar.

fireball-cinnamon-whisky-4.title: Fireball Cinnamon Whisky Birdie Shot 10 x 50ml
fireball-cinnamon-whisky-4.bodyHtml:
Fireball Cinnamon Whisky Birdie Shot brings the signature heat of Fireball to a fun, golf-themed gift pack containing ten individual 50ml bottles. Made with Canadian whisky and natural cinnamon flavour, this distinctive collection combines bold spice, warming sweetness and smooth whisky character. Perfect for sharing at gatherings, gifting to golf enthusiasts or enjoying as chilled shots.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with barbecue pork ribs, spicy chicken wings, smoked sausages, apple pie, cinnamon doughnuts and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes: Bold cinnamon spice, sweet caramel and warming whisky flavours with a fiery character.

Nose: Intense cinnamon aromas with hints of sweet spice and caramel.

Palate: Sweet cinnamon candy, warming whisky and subtle caramel notes balanced by lively spice.

Finish: Long, warming and fiery, with lingering cinnamon sweetness and a spicy kick.

los-clop-paraje-cabernet-franc.title: Los Clop Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
los-clop-paraje-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml:
Los Clop Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a full-bodied and expressive Argentinian red wine showcasing a deep red color with vibrant purple hues. On the nose, it delivers complex and inviting aromas of bright bell pepper, ripe cassis, and rich red fruit jam, perfectly interwoven with sweet notes of vanilla, roasted coffee, leather, tobacco, and subtle spices. The palate offers a robust yet approachable structure, highlighting a generous core of dark fruit flavors supported by sweet, round, and seamlessly integrated tannins. The finish is persistent, well-balanced, and highly satisfying, making it an outstanding value from Mendoza.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic grilled ribeye steaks, slow-braised short ribs, hearty beef stews, roasted lamb dishes, or savory pasta with rich meat sauces.

92 Points - James Suckling

This shows the varietal transparency on the nose with ripe, sweet currants, black olives, tobacco and a balsamic undertone that gives it a savory edge. Fluent and almost linear on the flavorful palate with a medium to full body. Tight and nicely chewy on the palate. Drink or hold.

tenjaku-blended-japanese-whisky.title: Tenjaku Japanese Whisky
tenjaku-blended-japanese-whisky.bodyHtml:
Tenjaku Japanese Whisky is a blended whisky from Japan, named with the characters for the skylark, the songbird that heralds spring. Rich malt whiskies are balanced with softer grain whisky and natural spring water to give a clear amber, crisp and mellow blend crafted under master blender Kenji Watanabe. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Pear and dried fruit with a light touch of smoke.

Nose: A faint smoky accent with sweet pear and dried fruit.

Palate: A slightly edgy attack that turns rounded and mellow.

Finish: Long and slightly spicy, with a hint of white oak and spreading sweetness.

Serve: On the rocks first, as the producer suggests, or in a highball or with water.

cims-del-montsant.title: Cims Del Montsant 750ml
cims-del-montsant.bodyHtml: Cims del Montsant is a Spanish red wine blend, primarily Grenache and Carignan grapes, known for its fresh, mineral character and balanced palate. It's a supple, easy-to-drink wine often described with notes of cherry, blueberry, and cocoa. The wine is aged for 12 months in large barrels, giving it a good aging potential of at least 8 years.

ale-architect-charleston-spiced-rye-sais.title: Ale Architect Charleston Spiced Rye Saison 4 Tall Cans
ale-architect-charleston-spiced-rye-sais.bodyHtml:
Ale Architect Charleston Spiced Rye Saison 4 Tall Cans is a specialty farmhouse ale brewed by Ale Architect in Edmonton, Alberta. Inspired by the classic Charleston Fizz cocktail, this saison combines the earthy, peppery complexity of a rye base with the bright aromatics of fresh grapefruit zest and French tarragon.

Food Pairing: Goat cheese crostini, roasted poultry, grilled pork chops, fresh herbal salads, and lemon-herb seafood.

Tasting Notes : Hazy golden-straw in appearance with a light-to-medium body and crisp, effervescent carbonation.

Nose : Bright citrus aromatics of grapefruit zest balanced by earthy rye spice and a gentle, herbal anise aroma from French tarragon.

Palate : Complex and refreshing with crisp rye malt pepperiness, tangy grapefruit citrus, tropical yeast esters, and subtle herbal tarragon complexity.

Finish : Dry, clean, and herbal with a lingering peppery spice and citrus zest finish.

Serve : Serve well-chilled in a tulip glass or saison stemware at 45–50°F (7–10°C).

gp-brewing-mercury-strong-lager.title: Gp Brewing Cold One'S Strong 15 Cans

born-col-golden-ale.title: Born Col Autumn Amber 4 Tall Cans
born-col-golden-ale.bodyHtml: An auburn-colored ale with toasted malt-forward characteristics. A subtle caramel flavour defines this well-balanced beer. It is easy drinking but surprisingly complex, with robust amber malts making for a medium-light body .

bodacious-bourbon-barrel-aged-red-blend.title: Bodacious Bourbon Barrel Aged Red Blend 750ml
bodacious-bourbon-barrel-aged-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Aromas of blackberry burst with vibrancy on the palate, enhanced with decadent flavours of mocha and hints of vanilla for a silky, smooth finish.

88 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A smooth and approachable red blend with noticeable vanilla and caramel notes from bourbon barrel aging. Features soft dark fruit flavors and an easy-drinking finish."


87 Points - Tastings.com
"Offers straightforward notes of baked berries and sweet oak spice. A crowd-pleasing, dessert-like wine that appeals to both bourbon and wine drinkers."

lindemans-bin-65-chardonnay.title: Lindeman's Bin 65 Chardonnay
lindemans-bin-65-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Lindeman's Bin 65 Chardonnay is a highly approachable, vibrant, and fruit-forward Australian white wine that has enjoyed enormous global popularity since its initial launch in 1985. Sourced from the broad, sun-drenched vineyards of the South Eastern Australia wine region, it perfectly embodies a classic, everyday-drinking style. In the glass, it reveals a bright straw-yellow color with subtle green reflections. The inviting aromatic bouquet opens with fresh, lively notes of ripe peach, tropical fruit salad, and juicy rockmelon, elegantly layered with delicate hints of creamy vanilla and toasted French oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, generous, and straightforward, delivering a soft and creamy core of orchard and citrus fruits. A crisp, well-balanced acidity naturally lifts the wine's buttery characteristics, culminating in a clean, soft, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with creamy pasta dishes, roasted chicken, grilled white fish, vibrant simple salads, and soft, mild white cheeses like brie.

bodacious-bold-chardonnay.title: Bodacious Bourbon Barrel Aged Red Blend 750ml
bodacious-bold-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Aromas of blackberry burst with vibrancy on the palate, enhanced with decadent flavours of mocha and hints of vanilla for a silky, smooth finish.

88 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A smooth and approachable red blend with noticeable vanilla and caramel notes from bourbon barrel aging. Features soft dark fruit flavors and an easy-drinking finish."


87 Points - Tastings.com
"Offers straightforward notes of baked berries and sweet oak spice. A crowd-pleasing, dessert-like wine that appeals to both bourbon and wine drinkers."

ale-architect-balsam-dark-mild.title: Simple Pleasures Dark English Mild Cls

town-sq-pond-surfer-california-common.title: Town Sq Pond Surfer California Common 4 Tall Cans
town-sq-pond-surfer-california-common.bodyHtml: Town Sq Pond Surfer California Common 4 Tall Cans

saint-clair-family-estate-pinot-noir.title: Saint Clair Family Estate Pinot Noir 2021
saint-clair-family-estate-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Saint Clair Family Estate Pinot Noir 2021 is a vibrant Marlborough red offering dark cherry, blackcurrant, plum, red berries, savoury spice, and subtle oak. The palate is dry and balanced, with fine tannins, medium-plus acidity, juicy fruit, and a lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Roast lamb, duck, pork, venison, grilled beef, mushroom dishes, roasted poultry, charcuterie, and savoury seasonal vegetables.

town-sq-air-tractor-alberta-ale.title: Town Sq Megawatt New England IPA 4 Tall Cans
town-sq-air-tractor-alberta-ale.bodyHtml: Town Sq Megawatt New England IPA 4 Tall Cans

big-rock-variety-pack.title: Big Rock The Rock Box Variety Pack
big-rock-variety-pack.bodyHtml: The Rock Box is the premier signature variety pack from Big Rock Brewery, a pioneer of the Canadian craft beer movement. This pack is designed to offer a "best of" experience, featuring a curated selection of the brewery's award-winning ales and lagers. Known for its versatility, the collection typically highlights Big Rock's commitment to using high-quality, regionally sourced ingredients like Alberta-grown malted barley. Whether in its "Signature" form or limited-edition "Untamed Hop Edition," the pack remains a staple for those seeking a broad range of classic and contemporary beer styles.

barefoot-pinot-grigio-2.title: Barefoot Pinot Grigio
barefoot-pinot-grigio-2.bodyHtml: A light-bodied classic with a crisp, bright finish, Barefoot Pinot Grigio offers all the flavors of tart green apples with fresh, white peaches. Accented with floral blossoms and citrus aromas, our Pinot Grigio pairs perfectly with traditional favorites like poultry, pasta, and pizza.

fontanafredda-solerose.title: Fontanafredda Solerose Langhe Rosato 2018
fontanafredda-solerose.bodyHtml:
As soon as the wine is bottled, its colour is powder pink; with time it can take slightly coppery reflections. The flavours are fruity with notes of raspberry, blueberry and ripe strawberries. In the mouth the wine is fresh, soft and savory.

90 Points - Vinous

tail-spin-gin-sonic.title: Sykkel Rider Gin
tail-spin-gin-sonic.bodyHtml:
Sykkel London Dry Gin is made from extra fine neutral alcohol tri-distilled from cereals. The botanicals, carefully selected for quality and homogeneity, reach the hands of our master distillers who, following the highest standards of quality and food safety IFS FOOD and ISO 14001, are in charge of carrying out the magical process of creating a spirit with character. unique and without comparisson.
Its triple profile, fresh, floral and citrus, is brought to its final volume of 43% thanks to the purest water obtained from Sierra Nevada in beautiful Andalusia and is packaged in exclusive and limited numbered batches of 1400 units.

santa-margherita-still-rose.title: Santa Margherita 'Stilrose' Riviera del Garda Classico Chiaretto 750ml
santa-margherita-still-rose.bodyHtml: Award tasting note: (2017 vintage) "Soft and fresh with lots of elegant red fruit. Very pure expression." - Bronze, International Wine Challenge

jura-18-year.title: Jura 18 Year Old
jura-18-year.bodyHtml:
On Jura, our tiny island community finds time stretched by the changing seasons and tempered by the unique microclimate. Each passing year brings its own riches.

Matured for eighteen long years in American White Oak ex bourbon barrels, this whisky is then beautifully enriched by superior Premier Grand Cru Classé Bordeaux red wine barriques from the South of France. The result is an incredibly rich and fruity whisky, with flavours of cooked raspberries, warm spice, rich caramel and crème anglaise.

the-winemakers-house-cabernet-sauvignon.title: The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
the-winemakers-house-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a luxurious, modern, and brilliantly textured expression that carries the bold and unrestricted winemaking philosophy of this iconic estate into a pure varietal focus. Sourced from premier vineyards across the valley, this vintage exhibits a deep magenta and purple-ruby core. On the nose, it offers an invitingly opulent bouquet of ripe black cherries, crème de cassis, and sweet blackberry pie, seamlessly layered with warm undertones of toasted vanilla bean, cinnamon bark, fresh coffee grounds, and hints of crushed wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is incredibly soft, plush, and full-bodied, delivering an expansive, fruit-forward mid-palate wrapped in supple, velvety tannins. Matured for 15 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels, its powerful dark fruit concentration remains beautifully balanced, showing remarkable structural harmony before concluding with a lengthy, decadent finish accented by a touch of holiday spice and subtle mineral depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with charcoal-grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-infused roasted lamb, or hunks of mature sharp white cheddar cheese.

michelob-ultra-5.title: Michelob Ultra 473ml Can
michelob-ultra-5.bodyHtml:
Michelob Ultra is a light lager produced by Anheuser-Busch, engineered to appeal to active and health-conscious consumers. First introduced in 2002, it features a lower carbohydrate and calorie count than traditional lagers, offering a clean, crisp, and refreshingly light taste with subtle citrus notes and a bright, effervescent carbonation.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken salad, fresh ceviche, light fish tacos, sushi, steamed seafood, and mild goat cheese.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant pale straw yellow in appearance with a thin white head and a light, crisp, and highly carbonated mouthfeel.

Nose : Subtle and clean with gentle notes of sweet malt, light rice, and a faint hint of citrus hops.

Palate : Exceptionally light and refreshing, featuring clean cereal grain, a touch of cracker malt sweetness, and minimal hop bitterness.

Finish : Very short, crisp, and clean with zero lingering aftertaste and a dry, fizzy close.

Serve : Serve ice-cold directly from the bottle or can, or poured into a chilled pilsner glass.

big-rock-pilsner.title: Jasper Crisp Pils 6 Cans
big-rock-pilsner.bodyHtml: A true pilsner-style lager showcasing local malt from the foothills of the Canadian Rockies. It isn't surprising that this beer is approachable, polite and apologetically hoppy. Sorry.

miro-cuvee-sasha.title: Miro Cuvee Sasha
miro-cuvee-sasha.bodyHtml:
Miro Cuvée Sasha is an exceptionally expressive, beautifully balanced Rhône-style red blend masterfully crafted by acclaimed winemaker Miroslav "Miro" Tcholakov. Primarily driven by Grenache blended with Syrah (and occasionally a small touch of Mourvèdre depending on the release), this small-production blend is explicitly designed to capture a style of soft intensity and bright, lively energy. In the glass, it opens with a seductively inviting aromatic bouquet of jammy strawberries, dried red cherries, and sweet plums, elegantly accented by delicate nuances of wild cranberries, dried rose petals, potpourri, and fragrant Herbs de Provence. On the palate, the wine is clean, fresh, and remarkably supple without any structural heaviness, delivering a vibrant core of succulent red berry fruits supported by a beautifully focused acidity and fine, velvety tannins that carry through to a crisp, spice-kissed finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with game birds, gourmet duck sausage, traditional pork pâté, wood-fired mushroom pizzas, lamb sliders, and soft, artisanal cheeses.

export-ale-1.title: Forward Progress Pale Ale 473 Ml Can

budweiser-copper.title: Original 16 Copper 15 Cans
budweiser-copper.bodyHtml: A smooth and refreshing beer brewed with 100% two-row Prairie barley, a blend of roasted black and caramel malts, and five hop varietals

bonterra-organic-rose.title: Bonterra Rose 2024 750ml
bonterra-organic-rose.bodyHtml: The 2021 Bonterra Rose is a dry rosé wine crafted from organically grown Grenache and Syrah grapes from Mendocino County, California. It's known for its light-bodied, fresh, and vibrant profile with citrus aromas and flavors of grapefruit, blood orange, and watermelon, complemented by hints of maraschino cherries, quince paste, and Earl Grey tea. The wine is characterized by a crisp, mouthwatering finish.

ale-architect-akitu-dry-hopped-brut-pale.title: Dusty Trail - Indian Pale Ale 473Ml Cls

laughing-dog-dogs-of-helles-30l-keg.title: Laughing Dog Dogs Of Helles 30L Keg 30L Keg
laughing-dog-dogs-of-helles-30l-keg.bodyHtml: Laughing Dog Dogs Of Helles 30L Keg 30L Keg

stanley-park-variety-pack.title: Stanley Park Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans

sola-sauvignon-blanc.title: Clos du Soleil Washington Series Sauvignon Blanc 2024
sola-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
A bright, energetic Sauvignon Blanc with zesty white grapefruit, gooseberry, crisp green apple and fragrant pear blossom. Fresh acidity drives the palate, while subtle texture from lees ageing adds dimension before a clean, citrus-focused finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with oysters, grilled prawns, fresh salads, goat cheese, roast chicken, sushi, ceviche, or lightly seasoned seafood.

town-sq-gigawatt-neipa.title: Town Sq Gigawatt NEIPA 4 Tall Cans

banded-trail-variety-pack.title: Banded Trail Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans

shannon-ridge-zinfandel.title: Shannon Ridge High Elevation Collection Zinfandel 2021
shannon-ridge-zinfandel.bodyHtml: A bold and expressive red from Lake County’s volcanic soils, the 2021 High Elevation Collection Zinfandel benefits from the intense sunlight and cooling mountain breezes of its high-altitude vineyard sites. This wine displays a deep crimson colour and offers an aromatic profile rich in ripe blackberry, raspberry jam, and dark plum, accented by signature notes of cracked black pepper and dried herbs. On the palate, it is full-bodied and robust yet retains a remarkable brightness due to its mountain acidity. Supple tannins support layers of jammy fruit, toasted oak, and a hint of sweet tobacco, leading to a long, spicy finish that is characteristic of premium California Zinfandel.

bud-light-lemon-tea.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-lemon-tea.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

michel-lynch-bordeaux-blanc.title: Michel Lynch Sauvignon Blanc 2021
michel-lynch-bordeaux-blanc.bodyHtml:
With its pale, brilliant colour and its aromas of citrus, white blossom and pineapple, Michel Lynch Blanc boasts a surprisingly succulent and full-bodied attack on the palate. A structure stemming from the blending of white grapes from the Graves and Entre-Deux-Mers area to the south of Bordeaux, and from low-temperature vinification in oak barrels.

Michel Lynch Blanc should be drunk cool as an aperitif or as the ideal accompaniment to seafood or white meats.

analog-neipa.title: Analog Ready Paler Two 4 Tall Cans
analog-neipa.bodyHtml: Refreshing and approachable, this session IPA is clean and citrusy with a dry finish. Pack with Citra, Mosiac, El Dorado and Simcoe this beer is hop forward without being bitter. Expect citrusy and tropical notes, with a classic West Coast IPA clean finish.

stanley-park-reforest-hazy.title: Stanley Park Reforest Hazy 4 Tall Cans

hob-nob-pinot-noir.title: Hob Nob Wicked Red Blend Limited Edition 2019 750ml

trolley-five-derailed-pale-ale.title: Trolley Five Cloudy Daze Hazy Pale Ale
trolley-five-derailed-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Trolley Five Cloudy Daze Hazy Pale Ale

okanagan-apricot-hibiscus.title: Inniskillin Okanagan Estate Riesling Icewine 375ml
okanagan-apricot-hibiscus.bodyHtml:
Inniskillin Okanagan Estate Riesling Icewine is a rich, luxurious, and vibrant Canadian dessert wine crafted at Inniskillin's estate in the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia. Made from Riesling grapes naturally frozen on the vine, it undergoes gentle pressing at sub-zero temperatures to capture highly concentrated juice. The wine presents intense aromatics of candied lemons, fresh white peaches, green apples, honeysuckle, and tropical papaya. On the palate, it is lusciously sweet and mouth-coating with flavours of mango, apricot, and spiced honey, impeccably balanced by Riesling's signature crisp, electric acidity that ensures a clean and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with blue cheese, lemon tarts, fruit pavlova, peach cobbler, duck liver pâté, spicy Asian cuisine, and apple strudel.

smirnoff-soda-white-peach-rose.title: Smirnoff Soda Rose Variety Pack 12 Cans
smirnoff-soda-white-peach-rose.bodyHtml: This variety pack offers crisp, and fruity zero sugar vodka sodas, elevated by the addition of rosé wine. Flavours include raspberry, strawberry, white peach and pink apple rosé.

marda-casablanca-blonde.title: Marda Loop Casablanca Blonde 4 Tall Cans

marda-jenkins-grapefruit-ale.title: Marda Loop Jenkins Grapefruit Ale 4 Tall Cans
marda-jenkins-grapefruit-ale.bodyHtml: Marda Loop Jenkins Grapefruit Ale 4 Tall Cans

bacardi-limon-lemonade.title: Bacardi Limon Rum
bacardi-limon-lemonade.bodyHtml:
Bacardí Limón is a citrus-flavoured Bacardí rum named after the Spanish word for lemon, although its fresh, zesty flavour actually comes from a blend of three citrus fruits: lemon, lime and grapefruit. The Canadian bottling is produced by Bacardi Bottling Corporation in Florida and bottled at 35% ABV in a 750 ml bottle. Bright, crisp and made for mixing, it is the base of Bacardí's signature Limónade - Bacardí Limón topped with lemonade - and it also suits other simple, fruity long drinks.

Tasting Notes: Fresh lemon, lime and grapefruit.

Serve: With lemonade over ice, as a Bacardí Limónade.

mercury.title: Domaine Faiveley Mercurey Vieilles Vignes 2023
mercury.bodyHtml:
Domaine Faiveley Mercurey Vieilles Vignes 2023 is an elegant, balanced, and fresh red Burgundy crafted by Domaine Faiveley from old vines in the Côte Chalonnaise. Sourced from estate plots with limestone and clay soils, it undergoes traditional fermentation before aging in French oak barrels. In the glass, it displays a vibrant ruby color. The expressive nose offers aromas of fresh red cherry, wild raspberry, and blackcurrant alongside subtle earthy undertones, forest floor, and delicate wood spice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and fruit-forward, featuring crunchy red berry flavors, fine-grained tannins, balanced acidity, and a smooth, clean finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken, duck breast, pork tenderloin, grilled salmon, wild mushroom risotto, and mild cheeses like Brie or Comté.

barefoot-peach-nectarine.title: Barefoot Peach Nectarine 4 Cans
barefoot-peach-nectarine.bodyHtml: Barefoot Peach Nectarine Hard Seltzer is a 4-pack of 250ml cans, offering a refreshing, light, and fruity beverage with a crisp peach and nectarine flavor. It's made with sparkling water and real wine, making it gluten-free, lower in calories and alcohol.
