The seltzer is a great option for those looking for a light and delicious drink, whether for on-the-go enjoyment or entertaining at home.

georgian-bay-smashed-tea.title: Georgian Bay Tequila Smash Mixed 12 Cans
georgian-bay-smashed-tea.bodyHtml: Georgian Bay Tequila Smash Mixed Pack is an assortment of four delicious Tequila Smash flavors: Pineapple, Grapefruit, Prickly Pear, and new Chili Mango. A boldly flavored beverage that's clear, crisp, and refreshing.

town-sq-i-o-nepa.title: Town Sq I/O NEPA 4 Tall Cans

situation-wtf-grapefruit-gose.title: Situation Wtf Grapefruit Gose 4 Tall Cans

picnic-wine-co-rose-lemonade-half-half.title: Cocchi Americano Rosa Aperitivo 750ml
picnic-wine-co-rose-lemonade-half-half.bodyHtml: Cocchi Rosa name reminds us that it’s produced with red wines, from which it derives its colour and wild rose notes. Refined with natural extracts of flowers and spices, in particular gentian, cinchona and citrus as per the Americano Bianco but with the addition of saffron, vanilla and rose petals. Its beautiful red colour is completely natural and derives from the wine.

gavi-di-gavi-docg-bricco-dei-guazzi.title: Gavi Di Gavi Docg Bricco Dei Guazzi 750ml
gavi-di-gavi-docg-bricco-dei-guazzi.bodyHtml: Gavi Di Gavi Docg Bricco Dei Guazzi 750ml

banded-mt-crushmore-ii.title: Banded Mt Crushmore II 4 Tall Cans

annex-your-belgian-things.title: Annex Your Belgian Things 4 Tall Cans

dandy-summertime-and-the-livins-easy.title: Dandy Summertime And The Livin's Easy 4 Tall Cans
dandy-summertime-and-the-livins-easy.bodyHtml: Dandy Summertime And The Livin's Easy 4 Tall Cans

hawk-tail-kveik-lemon.title: Hawk Tail Kveik Lemon 4 Tall Cans

champagne-cartier-diamant-rose.title: Champagne Andreas Bartel Brut Rose
champagne-cartier-diamant-rose.bodyHtml: Delicate, fruity-floral rosé with sweet raspberry and strawberry notes accompanied by light pastry and almond aromas. This champagne offers a seductive balance of fresh acidity and finesse, with a long, smooth finish.

copper-moon-merlot-2.title: Copper Moon Merlot 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-merlot-2.bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Merlot 4L Bag in Box is an approachable, smooth, and fruit-forward red wine produced in Canada by Arterra Wines Canada. Conveniently packaged in a 4-liter bag-in-box format, it is designed for easy, everyday enjoyment and stays fresh for weeks after opening. In the glass, it exhibits a bright garnet hue with soft aromas of ripe black cherry, dark plums, and sweet blackcurrant, complemented by subtle hints of spice and gentle oak on the finish. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-rounded, delivering plush dark fruit flavors, supple tannins, and a clean, soft finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled beef burgers, roasted pork chops, pasta with tomato ragù, pizza, BBQ chicken, and mild cheeses.

phillips-ginger-beer.title: Calgary Beer Craft Lager By Village Cls
phillips-ginger-beer.bodyHtml: Calgary Beer Craft Lager By Village Cls

copper-moon-malbec-2.title: Copper Moon Malbec 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-malbec-2.bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Malbec 4L Bag in Box is an approachable, smooth, and fruit-driven red wine produced in Canada as an International-Canadian Blend (ICB). Presented in a convenient, eco-friendly large-format bag-in-box, it is crafted for everyday enjoyment and easy sharing. In the glass, it exhibits an appealing deep ruby red hue. The nose opens with inviting aromatics of dark red berries, ripe cherry, and black currant blended with sweet hints of vanilla and dark chocolate. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and supple, delivering a rich core of dark fruit, gentle oak undertones, and a soft touch of baking spice on a smooth finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled steaks, barbecued pork ribs, spaghetti Bolognese, pepperoni pizza, and roasted chicken.

phillips-root-beer-schnapps-1.title: Phillips Root Beer Schnapps 375ml
phillips-root-beer-schnapps-1.bodyHtml:
Phillips Root Beer Schnapps is a root beer flavoured schnapps liqueur from Phillips, a brand born in Minnesota in 1912 and known for smooth spirits and easy-mixing liqueurs. Introduced in 1984 and billed as an American original, it captures the taste of a frosty mug of root beer. It became an instant hit on the back of the Phillips Root Beer Barrel, a shot glass of chilled schnapps dropped into a cold mug of beer. The Canadian bottling is labelled naturally flavoured and sits at a gentle 15% ABV, making it an easy choice for shots, floats and casual mixed drinks. This listing is the 375ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Sweet, creamy root beer.

Serve: Well chilled as a shot, dropped into a cold beer as a Root Beer Barrel, or poured over vanilla ice cream.

phillips-peach-schnapps-1.title: Phillips Peach Schnapps
phillips-peach-schnapps-1.bodyHtml:
Phillips Peach Schnapps is a peach-flavoured schnapps from Phillips, bottled at 15% ABV in a 375 ml bottle. Phillips is a Minnesota spirits and liqueur brand whose history goes back to 1912, and it was a pioneer of the schnapps category: the company introduced its Peppermint Schnapps in 1935 and Root Beer Schnapps in 1984. Peach is one of the core flavours of the Phillips schnapps range and a classic partner for orange juice in a Fuzzy Navel.

Serve: Chilled over ice, or mixed with orange juice for a Fuzzy Navel.

james-ready.title: Teeling Small Batch
james-ready.bodyHtml:
Teeling Small Batch is the flagship blended Irish whiskey of the Teeling Whiskey Company, founded in 2012 by Jack and Stephen Teeling and based in the Liberties district of Dublin. Hand-selected grain and malt whiskeys are blended in small batches and then finished in Central American rum casks, which bring extra sweetness and dried-fruit character. It is bottled at 46% ABV without chill filtration, in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Rounded and sweet, with vanilla, dried fruit and spice.

Nose: Floral and herbal aromas with creamy vanilla.

Palate: Raisin and apricot, dried fruit, vanilla and warming spice.

Finish: Gentle oak and spice balancing the sweetness.

Serve: Neat, over ice or in cocktails.

big-surf-honey-brown-lager.title: Wild North - Downtown Honey Brown Lager

oyster-bay-sparkling-cuvee-brut.title: Oyster Bay Sparkling Cuvee Brut
oyster-bay-sparkling-cuvee-brut.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Sparkling Cuvée Brut is an elegant New Zealand sparkling wine offering lime citrus, white peach, pear, and subtle mineral notes. The palate is finely bubbled and refreshing, with crisp acidity, creamy texture, delicate fruit character, and a clean, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Oysters, shellfish, sushi, grilled seafood, fresh salads, roast chicken, light appetizers, goat cheese, and delicate seafood preparations.

big-rock-rhine-stone-cowboy-1.title: Big Rock Rhine Stone Cowboy 6 Cans

mateus-rose-1.title: Mateus Rose 750ml
mateus-rose-1.bodyHtml:
Mateus Rosé, a Portuguese rosé wine, is described as a fresh, seductive, and well-balanced wine with a light pink color and a fruity, slightly fizzy finish. It offers a delicate bouquet with notes of red berries, strawberries, and raspberries. Mateus Rosé is known for its refreshing qualities, making it a versatile choice for various occasions and food pairings. 

85 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A sweet, fizzy, and iconic rosé with simple strawberry and candy notes. Light-bodied and widely popular as a casual, easy-drinking wine."


86 Points - Drinks Business
"Consistently delivers its signature slightly off-dry, fruity profile. A global benchmark for accessible rosé."

royal-reserve-whisky-10.title: Royal Reserve 1.14L
royal-reserve-whisky-10.bodyHtml:
Royal Reserve is a classic, value-driven Canadian rye whisky with roots dating back to the cocktail heyday of the 1960s and 70s. Produced by Corby Spirit and Wine at the historic Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, this quintessential mixing whisky is celebrated for its light, smooth, and highly approachable profile. Blended to achieve subtle elegance rather than overpowering heat, it balances sweet grain and toffee notes with a distinctly crisp, brittle Canadian rye character, making it a reliable staple for both casual sipping and traditional highballs.

Food Pairing: Grilled sausages, mild cheddar cheese, roasted salted mixed nuts, classic pub fare, and caramel-heavy desserts like butter tarts or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Light golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied, and slightly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Gentle and subtly complex, opening with mild aromas of sweet honey, vanilla, and caramel, followed by dusty rye grain, toasted almond, and a faint hint of clove and mild baking spice.

Palate : Smooth, light, and highly approachable. It begins with sweet notes of corn, toffee, and caramelized sugar, which are gracefully balanced by a contrasting, zippy bite of peppery rye spice and a touch of crisp lemon zest.

Finish : Clean, warm, and of medium length, fading gently from zesty rye spice to a lingering, soft vanilla and mild toasted oak sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat or over ice as an easy-drinking sipper, or mix it in classic Canadian whisky highballs like a Rye and Ginger (with ginger ale) or a classic Whisky Sour.

gordons-london-dry-gin-1.title: Gordon's London Dry Gin
gordons-london-dry-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Gordon's London Dry Gin 750ml is the classic juniper-led gin behind countless gin and tonics, bottled at 40% ABV. Gordon's was founded in London in 1769 by Alexander Gordon, who set out to make a gin worthy of his family name, and the boar's head on every bottle recalls a Gordon clan legend of saving the King of Scotland from a wild boar. The Gordon's London Dry spirit is grain neutral spirit distilled with juniper berries, coriander seed, angelica root and liquorice, and its distinctive juniper character has come to define the classic gin and tonic. This bottling is produced in Canada, in Ontario. Crisp and dry, it opens with fresh citrus and keeps juniper at its core, making it a dependable choice for the G&T, the martini and other gin classics.

Nose: Fresh, immediate citrus.

Palate: Dry, with citrus and lemon coming through first.

Serve: Over ice with tonic water and a wedge of lime, or stirred into a classic dry martini.

johnnie-walker-red-label-3.title: Johnnie Walker Red Label
johnnie-walker-red-label-3.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Red Label is a highly vibrant, versatile, and globally renowned blended Scotch whisky that serves as the pioneering flagship expression for the House of Walker. Formulated to be a bold, flavor-forward spirit, it masterfully marries up to 30 different malt and grain whiskies sourced from top distilleries across Scotland's major whisky-producing regions, including the Highlands, Lowlands, Speyside, and Islay. Characterized by its distinctively robust and smoky profile, this expression was intentionally crafted to retain its intense flavor depth even when combined with mixers, making it a foundational staple in bars worldwide.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoky barbecue ribs, grilled chicken wings, spicy Asian dishes, sharp aged cheddar cheese, or roasted salted almonds.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, clear golden amber color with a light-to-medium body and a crisp, energetic mouthfeel on the palate.

NOSE - Fresh, punchy, and highly aromatic, opening with dominant notes of crisp green apple, pear, and citrus zest, beautifully balanced by a distinct undercurrent of aromatic peat smoke and sweet malted barley.

PALATE - Vibrant and full-flavored on the arrival, delivering an initial burst of sweet vanilla cream and fresh orchard fruits that quickly gives way to zesty baking spices, cracked black pepper, and cinnamon, all enveloped in a robust, smoky character.

FINISH - Medium in length, remarkably clean, and satisfyingly smoky, resolving with a persistent trail of earthy peat, warm wood spice, and a faint lingering touch of sweet malt.

SERVE - Highly versatile; best enjoyed as a classic Highball poured over plenty of ice in a tall glass, topped with ginger ale or soda water, and garnished with a fresh wedge of lime or orange.

ruffino-chianti-2.title: Ruffino Chianti
ruffino-chianti-2.bodyHtml:
Ruffino Chianti is a classic, medium-bodied Italian red wine that has been a benchmark expression of Tuscany since 1877. It opens with approachable and expressive aromas of fresh raspberry, plum, and sweet cherry, interwoven with delicate floral notes of violet and rose petal, plus a touch of hazelnut and earthy black pepper spice. On the palate, its bright acidity and soft, integrated tannins frame a juicy core of red fruits, leading into a balanced, smooth, and pleasantly lingering finish that makes it exceptionally food-friendly.

Food Pairing: This bright, versatile red wine pairs perfectly with Margherita pizza, lasagna, ravioli, spaghetti in tomato-based sauces, classic hamburgers, or hard aged cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano.

spumante-bambino-2.title: Spumante Bambino 750ml
spumante-bambino-2.bodyHtml: This vivacious sparkler has been a favourite in Ontario since the early 1980s, gaining fame with its casual, fruity character and a series of zany TV ads. It has aromas and flavours of sweet table grapes and ripe pear, along with light floral and yeasty notes. Serve with fried chicken or a selection of savoury appetizers.

irish-mist-honey-1.title: Irish Mist Honey Liqueur
irish-mist-honey-1.bodyHtml:
Irish Mist Honey Liqueur is an Irish whiskey liqueur from the Irish Mist brand, bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is golden in the glass, with an aroma that mixes floral and herbal notes with the warmth of Irish whiskey. On the palate the herbal character is balanced by sweetness, and it closes smooth with a slight spice. Lighter in strength than a straight whiskey, it suits slow sipping as well as warm drinks and simple mixed serves.

Nose: Floral, herbal and whiskey.

Palate: Herbal, balanced with sweetness.

Finish: Smooth and slightly spicy.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in a hot whiskey or Irish coffee.

jadot-savigny-les-beaune-clos-de-guettes.title: Louis Jadot Savigny-les-Beaune Clos des Guettes Premier Cru 2022
jadot-savigny-les-beaune-clos-de-guettes.bodyHtml:
Nicely balanced between acidity and rich body, Les Guettes has aromas and flavors of apples, white flowers and spices.

It will pair well with white meat, terrines and light cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

Well structured and moderately tannic, this medium-bodied wine has a nice grip on the palate as fine-grained tannins surround tart cherries, raspberries and light oak spices for a vivid, lively expression and the ability to age well. Drink now or hold.

stones-green-ginger-1.title: Stones Green Ginger 750ml
stones-green-ginger-1.bodyHtml: Stone's Original Green Ginger wine is a sweet raisin wine flavoured with pure ground ginger. It has expressive flavours of ginger, finishing sweet and spicy.

gerard-bertrand-chardonnay-laigle-1.title: Gerard Bertrand Domaine de L'Aigle Chardonnay 2023
gerard-bertrand-chardonnay-laigle-1.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Domaine de l'Aigle Chardonnay 2023 is a remarkably sophisticated, biodynamically farmed white wine originating from one of the highest vineyards in the Languedoc, situated up to 500 meters above sea level in the Haute Vallée de l'Aude. This cool-climate, high-altitude terroir produces a Chardonnay with exceptional freshness, often drawing comparisons to fine white Burgundy. In the glass, it reveals a brilliant golden-green hue with delicate silver reflections. The bouquet is highly expressive and generous, unveiling elegant aromas of white peach, quince, and candied lemon, seamlessly interwoven with rich, inviting notes of toasted brioche, fresh butter, and subtle marzipan. On the palate, it is full-bodied, succulent, and beautifully rounded, showcasing concentrated golden fruit flavors perfectly counterbalanced by a racy, crystalline acidity. A distinctive, wet-stone minerality provides brilliant tension, leading into a vivid, precise, and remarkably long finish with a delicate touch of mint.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted poultry, pan-seared trout, rich seafood in creamy sauces, mushroom risotto, or fresh goat cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This substantial, succulent, biodynamic Chardonnay captures Limoux's characteristic freshness. Warm aromas of ripe peach and vanilla baking spice greet you on the nose followed by quince, honeydew melon, wet stone and a dollop of orange marmalade. The palate is fulsome and concentrated with honey-drizzled golden fruit basking in late-August sun.

giraud-chateau-timberlay-1.title: Chateau Timberlay Bordeaux Superieur
giraud-chateau-timberlay-1.bodyHtml: An approachable and refined French red, this Bordeaux Superieur presents a beautiful deep ruby colour. It features an intense and complex nose with aromas of red fruit, candied fruit, vanilla, and spice, alongside light woody notes. On the palate, the wine is round and well-balanced, offering silky tannins and a lingering finish of vanilla and cinnamon.

ruffino-orvieto-classico-1.title: Ruffino Orvieto Classico
ruffino-orvieto-classico-1.bodyHtml: Ruffino Orvieto Classico is a historic and refreshing white wine that pays homage to one of Italy's oldest winemaking traditions. Sourced from the "Classico" zone—the oldest and most prestigious area of the Orvieto appellation—this wine presents a pale straw-yellow colour and a delicate, elegant bouquet of meadow flowers, green apples, and golden pears. On the palate, it is light-to-medium-bodied and remarkably crisp, featuring a clean, dry profile with a subtle mineral undertone and a characteristically pleasant, slightly almond finish. It is a versatile and food-friendly wine, ideal for pairing with light starters, seafood pasta, or herb-roasted poultry.

fronterra-sauvignon-blanc-1.title: Frontera Sauvignon Blanc
fronterra-sauvignon-blanc-1.bodyHtml:
Frontera Sauvignon Blanc is a bright, ultra-crisp, and refreshing Chilean white wine produced by the globally renowned Concha y Toro estate. Sourced from the sun-drenched vineyards of the Central Valley, where cool Pacific breezes help preserve the grapes' natural acidity, this wine is designed for immediate enjoyment and everyday approachability. In the glass, it displays a pale greenish-yellow hue. The lively bouquet opens with vibrant aromas of grapefruit zest, fresh lemon, and green apple, beautifully layered with subtle hints of white peach and delicate wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, zesty, and exceptionally clean, delivering a mouthwatering core of juicy citrus and orchard fruit. A crisp, well-balanced acidity carries this fruit-forward profile through to a refreshing, lightly mineral, and snappy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh shrimp ceviche, light white fish tacos, tangy goat cheese salads, and grilled chicken finished with an herbaceous chimichurri sauce.

schneider-piesporter-michelsberg-1.title: Schneider Piesporter Michelsberg 750ml
schneider-piesporter-michelsberg-1.bodyHtml: Typically, Mosel, light, easy and refreshing, with beautiful fresh fruit aromas. Lovely on it's own, but also marvelous with poultry or sweet and sour dishes.

sartori-marani-bianco-1.title: Sartori di Verona Marani 2021 750ml
sartori-marani-bianco-1.bodyHtml:
Brilliant yellow in color. Notes of rich tropical fruit and honey. Voluptuous on the palate; stone fruits (peaches) and tropical fruits. A persistent mineral finish, reflecting the volcanic soils of the Soave zone.

Intense golden colour, on the nose it unveils fragrances of yellow and exotic fruits with an unmistakable note of honey. On the palate the wine is balanced, elegant and harmonious, in perfect balance with the bouquet.

Food pairings
Cream-sauced first courses like pastas or risotto. Excellent paired with white meats, grilled seafood and medium aged cheese.

the-vibrant-vine-pinot-grigio-1.title: Beringer Main & Vine Pinot Grigio 750ml
the-vibrant-vine-pinot-grigio-1.bodyHtml: Perfect for the hot days and warm nights of summer. Has a refreshing bite of juicy white peach and citrus, finishing with a flinty minerality. Makes for a great pre-dinner sipper or as an accompaniment to fresh salads and grilled chicken.

the-vibrant-vine-phantom-1.title: The Vibrant Vine - Phantom
the-vibrant-vine-phantom-1.bodyHtml: Delicate red berry flavours with sweet fruit and a slight herbaceous note with a feral meatiness from the Syrah make this a very complex red wine that deserves rich yet delicate food to accompany. Think Foie Gras and Quince jam on Brioche or a buttery Rhubarb and Strawberry pie.

andres-golden-cream.title: Andres Golden Cream Apera 750ml
andres-golden-cream.bodyHtml: Light coffee colour; dried prune and fig, smoky, cooked fruit nose; sweet and rich with notes of toasted nuts and fruitcake.

la-scala-spumante.title: La Scala Spumante 750ml
la-scala-spumante.bodyHtml: La Scala Spumante is a light and refreshing Italian sparkling wine, typically described as having aromas of green apple, pear, and citrus, with a crisp acidity and delicate bubbles. It's known for its medium sweetness and fresh, fruity flavors.

mommessin-cotes-du-rhone-red.title: Famille Jm Cazes Cotes Du Rhone Rouge
mommessin-cotes-du-rhone-red.bodyHtml: Famille Jm Cazes Cotes Du Rhone Rouge

pastis-ricard.title: Ricard Pastis
pastis-ricard.bodyHtml: A traditional French liqueur perfect for sitting on a patio and contemplating the day. Served with a few drops of water, the clear amber turns slightly milky, revealing intense anise/licorice and herbal spice. Slightly sweet with a black licorice flavour and a warm, herbal finish.

bolla-valpolicella.title: Bolla Valpolicella Ripasso Classico Superiore
bolla-valpolicella.bodyHtml: After going through the grape marc (solid parts like the skins of the grapes) left over from the region's prestigious appellation, Amarone della Valpolicella, this wine acquires more character than the regular version of Valpolicella, on top of gaining woody notes in this case. A great choice for BBQ fare.

drouhin-beaujolais-villages.title: Joseph Drouhin Beaujolais Villages 2023
drouhin-beaujolais-villages.bodyHtml:
Joseph Drouhin Beaujolais Villages 2023 is a delightfully charming, vibrant, and expressive French red wine that serves as a benchmark for high-quality, approachable Beaujolais. Crafted with Maison Joseph Drouhin's signature emphasis on elegance and biological respect for the soil, this wine is made from hand-harvested Gamay grapes sourced from selected vineyard parcels on granitic soils across the region. In the glass, it presents a brilliant, lovely raspberry color. The nose is both refined and intense, unrolling an aromatic bouquet of wild strawberries, fresh red cherries, and red fruit syrup, beautifully intermingled with delicate floral notes of violet and peony, plus a faint touch of black pepper. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, wonderfully fresh, and exceptionally silky. A lively core of crisp red berry fruits is carried by supple, fine-grained tannins and an agile acidity, maintaining its purity and juicy character all the way through a clean, lingering, and relaxed finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with simply grilled sausages, roasted chicken, herb-stuffed roast pork, eggplant parmigiana, or light charcuterie boards.

90 Points - James Suckling

A playful, fruity and mellow red with aromas of raspberries, cherries and some black pepper. It’s medium-bodied with silky tannins. Juicy and linear with a relaxed, fruity finish. Drink now.

root-1-carmenere.title: Root:1 Reserva Carmenere 2019 750ml
root-1-carmenere.bodyHtml: A bright, balanced, easy-drinking red which avoids the sugary fruit of Californian/Argentine reds and the strident acidity of Italian/Spanish reds. Spiced fruit on the nose, surprisingly savory on the palate - begs for a 2nd glass.

hochtaler.title: Hochtaler White 4L Bag in Box
hochtaler.bodyHtml: Fruity and floral on the nose, with fresh peach and melon aroma. Sweetness is balanced with a tart apple finish. A Canadian Classic!

golden-wedding.title: Golden Wedding Canadian Whisky
golden-wedding.bodyHtml:
Golden Wedding is a classic Canadian whisky with a long history. It began as an American whiskey brand that Schenley's Louis Rosenstiel moved to Canada, where it was distilled at Valleyfield, Quebec, before production moved to the Black Velvet distillery in Lethbridge, Alberta. It has loyal followings in pockets across Canada. Simple but not simplistic, it is hot and peppery with plenty of toffee, burnt caramel and nutty dry grain, while rye brings dusty, earthy and flinty notes alongside cooked fruit and a hint of flowers. It finishes with the typical pithiness of Canadian whisky. Bottled at 40% ABV, 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Toffee, burnt caramel, pepper and dry grain with earthy rye.

Palate: Hot and peppery, with toffee, burnt caramel, nutty grain, earthy rye and cooked fruit.

Finish: Pithy and balanced.

Serve: Mixed with ginger ale, on ice in a tall glass, or straight.

lotengo-malbec.title: Vermouth Leonce Malbec
lotengo-malbec.bodyHtml:
Vermouth Leonce Malbec is an Argentine aromatized wine crafted from Mendoza Malbec, combining rich grape character with botanicals and herbs. This unique expression showcases aromas of red berries, spices, floral notes, and botanicals, with a complex palate featuring balanced sweetness, herbal layers, gentle bitterness, and a smooth lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie, aged cheeses, olives, nuts, tapas, grilled meats, desserts, chocolate, aperitifs, and Mediterranean dishes.

campo-maccione-vermentino-occhio-a-vento.title: Famiglia Zingarelli Rocca Delle Macie Campo Maccione Vermentino
campo-maccione-vermentino-occhio-a-vento.bodyHtml:
Famiglia Zingarelli Rocca delle Macìe Campo Maccione Vermentino is a remarkably fresh, crisp, and expressive Italian white wine that beautifully captures the coastal essence of Tuscany's Mediterranean shoreline. Sourced from the sandy, quartz-rich soils of the estate's dedicated Tenuta Campomaccione property in the sun-drenched Maremma district, it pours a brilliant pale straw-yellow hue with shifting silvery-green reflections. The bouquet is intensely floral and inviting, bursting with clean scents of fragrant acacia blossoms, bright broom flower, and fresh field herbs, beautifully layered with juicy orchard nuances of green apple, sliced pear, and tropical pineapple. On the palate, it is light to medium-bodied, remarkably smooth, and highly energetic, delivering a juicy core of zesty citrus fruit and crisp stone fruit balanced by a snappy, mouthwatering acidity. Vinified entirely in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats to preserve its pristine varietal character and maritime vitality, it concludes with a long, pristine finish marked by a signature saline minerality and a pleasant, classic trace of bitter almond.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with simple grilled seafood, fresh fish carpaccio, roasted Mediterranean vegetables, light summer salads, and artisanal goat cheeses.

nederburg-winemasters-cabernet.title: Nederburg Winemasters Cabernet 750ml
nederburg-winemasters-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Formerly labeled as The Winemaster's Reserve.

Critic tasting note: (2021 vintage) "A lush aroma with cocoa bean, plum confit and blackcurrant. On the palate the wine has quite a subtle density for this price range. Acidity, fruit and tannin are well matched, the structure lends itself to hearty home cooking." - 89/100, Falstaff

bouchard-aine-beaujolais.title: Bouchard Aine & Fils Beaujolais 2023 750ml
bouchard-aine-beaujolais.bodyHtml:
The Bouchard Aine & Fils Beaujolais Villages is a bright cherry red color. Fresh and pleasant aromas of redberries, blueberries, cherry, and strawberry. A very nice and well balanced wine, round, generous, fruity and subtle.

Beaujolais is a pleasant wine to share with friends or family and to be appreciated at any time of the day, with picnics, before meals, or with cold meats and starters. Try also with a chicken livers salad, roast chicken and fresh cheese.

sibling-rivalry-white.title: Sibling Rivalry White 750ml
sibling-rivalry-white.bodyHtml: Sibling Rivalry White by Henry of Pelham is a blend of Riesling, Chardonnay, and Gewürztraminer grapes. It's described as a bright and fresh white wine with flavors of lime citrus and apple, complemented by a hint of lychee. The wine is known for its refreshing and zesty acidity, making it a popular choice for summer.

sibling-rivalry-red.title: Sibling Rivalry Red 750ml
sibling-rivalry-red.bodyHtml: The Sibling Rivalry Red is a wine blend by Henry of Pelham, featuring a combination of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Gamay grapes. It's known for its dark, juicy, and fruity character, with notes of plum, berry, and spice, complemented by soft tannins. The wine is often described as having a rich and flavorful profile with a smooth, well-rounded finish.

entre-lacs-white.title: Entre Lacs White 16L Bag in Box
entre-lacs-white.bodyHtml:
Pale straw in colour with light, fresh aromas of crisp green apple, Meyer lemon, and delicate white grape blossom. The palate is light-bodied, dry, and approachable, offering clean orchard and citrus fruit flavours balanced by soft, refreshing acidity on a smooth, easy-drinking finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled chicken breast, pan-fried white fish, fresh garden salads, light pasta dishes, or mild cheeses.

drouhin-la-foret-pinot-noir-bourgogne.title: Joseph Drouhin Bourgogne Rouge 2022
drouhin-la-foret-pinot-noir-bourgogne.bodyHtml: A wine full of charm: bright ruby colour and a nose rich with aromas of red fruit (raspberry, red currants, wild strawberry). On the palate, the wine is pleasant, fruity and refreshing, with light tannins and great elegance.

faiveley-pinot-noir-bourgogne-paulee.title: Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023
faiveley-pinot-noir-bourgogne-paulee.bodyHtml:
Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023 is a classic, expressive, and finely structured French red wine produced by the prestigious Domaine Faiveley. Displaying a beautiful bright ruby-red color, it opens with pleasant and generous aromas of fresh red cherries, ripe raspberries, and redcurrants, accompanied by subtle nuances of violets, wild herbs, and delicate earthy forest floor notes. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, medium-bodied mouthfeel featuring juicy red fruit flavors, a well-defined line of refreshing acidity, and fine, rounded tannins that lead into a smooth, clean, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken, duck breast, pork tenderloin, seared salmon, wild mushroom risotto, charcuterie, and mild semi-firm cheeses.

bollinger-grande-annee.title: Bollinger La Grande Annee Brut 2015
bollinger-grande-annee.bodyHtml:
Initial scents are full of small stone fruits, with notes of Pomme Gris, plum and Mirabelle plum, layered with a touch of honey. Aromas of blackberry, blackcurrant, cherry, and raspberry follow; a medley of red fruits dances with notes of almond. Exotic touches of mango follow, dissolving into tertiary scents of vanilla and a delicate woody aroma. On the palate the wine is plump, generous and enticing, reminiscent of Mirabelle plum jam. Texture and richness define the tasting experience. The finish blends notes of chocolate and citrus fruits, bringing a touch of acidity, lengthened further by hints of schist. A hugely generous wine!

La Grande Année 2015 is the perfect Champagne to serve with a fine meal, underscoring Bollinger’s reputation as the ultimate food pairing Champagne. The Champagne shines when enjoyed with pan fried foie gras with caramelized apple, magret de canard with raspberry and cranberry sauce, cantal, créme chocolat, raspberry and anise.

96 Points - James Suckling

Enticing, fragrant aromas of toast, lemon zest and an earthy-smoky nuance lead to a palate of subtle Bosc-pear, mango, papaya, even pineapple flavors. Lifted by fresh acidity on the medium-bodied palate, the wine keeps unfolding in toasted walnuts, honey and a dash of bitter marmalade. It’s mouth-filling, alive with acidity and full of finesse.

96 Points - Vinous

Bollinger's 2015 Brut Grand Année is an intriguing wine in that is clearly reflects the decision to pick on the later side in order to avoid vegetal notes derived from the mismatch of alcoholic and phenolic ripeness. "Balance was hard to achieve in 2015," Chef de Cave Denis Bunner notes. "At 10% in sugar, the fruit was simply not ripe. We had to wait to reach the optimal window of ripeness." Bunner also opted to increase the Chardonnay, so the blend is 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay, as opposed to the more typical 70/30 blend, with more Verzenay than Aÿ in the Pinots. Dried citrus peel, sage, menthol, sage, tangerine peel and spice build with some coaxing. Light tropical overtones develop with aeration. There's real density and textural richness here. This will be a fascinating vintage to follow. Stylistically, it is the complete opposite from the much more linear 2014 that precedes it. Dosage is 8 grams per liter. Disgorged: May 2023.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This expressive Champagne features a rich, well-spiced range of flavors chiseled by well-honed, integrated acidity, which lends a racy feel to the ripe black cherry and mulberry fruit and notes of salted almond, pink grapefruit granita, crystallized honey and pickled ginger that ride the raw silk–like mousse. Hints of chalk and spring blossoms play on the clean-cut, lasting finish. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2015 Brut La Grande Année was disgorged last year with eight grams per liter dosage. The wine has turned out beautifully, exhibiting a more muscular, old-school Bollinger profile in contrast to the unusually racy, fine-boned 2014 that preceded it. Wafting from the glass with notes of pear, orange oil and white flowers mingled with notions of mocha, toasted hazelnuts and fino sherry, it's medium to full-bodied, layered and textural, with a dense core of fruit framed by chalky structuring extract, concluding with a long, sapid finish.

anna-de-codorniu.title: Anna De Codorniu Cava 750ml
anna-de-codorniu.bodyHtml:
Anna De Codorníu Brut Cava is an iconic, groundbreaking Spanish sparkling wine renowned for being the very first Cava to introduce Chardonnay into its traditional blend. Pale straw yellow with brilliant greenish reflections, it displays fine, continuous streams of bubbles. The nose opens with delicate citrus, green apple, and tropical aromas like pineapple, accompanied by complex toasted almond and brioche notes from lees aging. On the palate, it is creamy, refreshing, and harmoniously balanced, finishing with crisp, persistent vitality.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with shellfish, fresh sushi, sashimi, tapas, light pasta courses, or savory fish carpaccio.

cedarcreek-cabernet-merlot.title: Cedar Creek Cabernet Merlot 2020
cedarcreek-cabernet-merlot.bodyHtml:
Cedar Creek's two southern Okanagan estate vineyard properties comprise 60 acres at two distinct sites to the north and south of Osoyoos. Haynes Creek, to the south, is a hot and sandy vineyard where in the summer the heat is powerful, and the grapes that are grown there provide a ripe, rich, pure fruit fullness to the blend. But just 10 minutes north, at Desert Ridge, the days are slightly cooler, the soil stonier, and the resulting fruit more structured with earthy, leafy, and herbal characteristics. The two distinct site differences are reconciled in this rich blend.

Perfumed florals and tobacco leaves on the nose follow through to the palate. The dark fruits, cassis and medium tannins make this a nice food wine.

taylor-fladgate-white.title: Taylor Fladgate Fine White Port
taylor-fladgate-white.bodyHtml: Fully matured in oak so it is smooth and ready to drink, Taylor Fladgate's Fine White Port is made exclusively from white grapes. Serve it chilled with toasted almonds or hazelnuts for a creative aperitif.

entre-lacs-red.title: Entre Lacs Red 16L Bag in Box
entre-lacs-red.bodyHtml: The "Entre Lacs Red" in a 16L Bag in Box is a red wine, packaged in a large, convenient container. It has an alcohol content of 11.5% and is priced at $160.00, according to BSW Liquor. More details can be obtained by contacting BSW Liquor at.

os-black-lager.title: Sapporo Black Lager 4 Tall Cans
os-black-lager.bodyHtml: A fusion of Eastern and Western culture is at the heart of the Sapporo brand. Their Black Lager is crafted with expertly roasted malts and has subtle hop bitterness flavours. The body is smooth and crisp with rich coffee and chocolate tones. Wonderful paired with traditional German cuisine such as Schnitzel.

laya.title: Ayala Brut Majeur
laya.bodyHtml:
Ayala Brut Majeur is the signature non-vintage Champagne of the house, crafted from Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier sourced from outstanding Champagne crus. Aged on its lees and finished with a low dosage, it offers vibrant citrus, white flowers, orchard fruit and subtle brioche notes with exceptional freshness, precision and elegance.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, sushi, lobster, grilled seafood, roast chicken, or aged Comte cheese.

rebellion-shiraz.title: Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet-Shiraz 2023
rebellion-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet-Shiraz 2023 is an iconic, deeply concentrated, and beautifully structured Australian red wine blend affectionately known as "Baby Grange." It opens with an intricate and shifting bouquet of blackcurrants, dark plums, and Black Forest cake, layered with aromatic nuances of dark chocolate, sweet licorice, star anise, and savory rosemary. On the palate, this wine is full-bodied, dense, and tightly coiled, expertly using the prism of a cooler growing season to maintain freshness and poise. The structural Cabernet Sauvignon lends focused notes of graphite, cassis, and black olive, while the Shiraz grounds the mid-palate with rich plum flavors, warmth, and fleshy fruit. Supported by a frame of fine, powder-gravel tannins and sweet American oak vanillin, it glides into a lingering, muscular, and exceptionally savory finish built for long cellaring.

Food Pairing: The bold structural framework, rich black fruits, and pronounced American oak influence of this classic blend make it a spectacular match for heavy, savory dishes. It pairs magnificently with a grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb crusted with herbs, slow-braised beef short ribs, or osso buco. It also provides a fantastic complement to wild boar ragù, roasted venison, wood-fired peppered pizzas, or a board of intense, full-flavored cheeses like aged sharp Cheddar and Gouda.

96 Points - James Suckling

This wine has been made every vintage since 1960. Refined, generous and polished aromas of blackberries, blackcurrants, cured meat, crushed stones and iodine. The palate is full-bodied with a rounded, textural palate and ultra-refined tannins that lead to a silky, savory, black-fruited finish. 51% cabernet sauvignon and 49% shiraz. Excellent. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Bin 389 Cabernet Shiraz is inky, complete, powerful and structured, with black berries, sweet licorice, star anise and fennel. There are also notes of roasted meat juices and cedar wood. The expression of this wine is very attractive—the prism of the cooler season works well in this wine. The fruit is sourced from McLaren Vale, Padthaway and Barossa Valley, matured for 12 months in American oak hogsheads, 33% new.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Distinctive for its appealing savory thread, with notes of crushed pine needle, forest floor, sage, olive tapenade, rosemary and tobacco leaf that complement the core of spiced plum, dried cherry and blackberry preserves. Offers a firm, muscular structure for an appealing backbone. Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz. Drink now through 2037.

rosemount-shiraz-cabernet.title: Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet-Shiraz 2023
rosemount-shiraz-cabernet.bodyHtml:

sawmill-creek-dry-white.title: Sawmill Creek Dry White 750ml
sawmill-creek-dry-white.bodyHtml: Sawmill Creek Dry White is a Canadian dry white wine blend known for its light-bodied and crisp character. It features aromas and flavors of lemon, pear, peach, and golden delicious apple. The wine is a blend and is dry, meaning all the natural sugar content has been converted to alcohol during fermentation.

sawmill-creek-dry-red.title: Sawmill Creek Barrel Select Dry Red 16L Bag in Box
sawmill-creek-dry-red.bodyHtml:
Sawmill Creek Barrel Select Dry Red is a Canadian red wine offering an approachable, easy-drinking profile. Made as a red blend, it delivers a straightforward expression suited to casual occasions and everyday meals, with a dry character and accessible style presented under the established Sawmill Creek label.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled burgers, beef pasta, pepperoni pizza, and roasted pork tenderloin.

chateau-ste-michelle-riesling.title: Chateau Ste Michelle Riesling 2022 750ml
chateau-ste-michelle-riesling.bodyHtml:
Our Columbia Valley Riesling is a blend of Riesling from throughout Washington’s Columbia Valley. The wine offers crisp apple and white peach aromas and flavors with subtle mineral notes. This is our go to Riesling that is incredibly refreshing and flavorful and easy to match with a variety of foods.

89 points Wine Spectator

 90 points James Suckling

88 points Decanter

carlo-rossi-fruity-white.title: Carlo Rossi Fruity White 1.5L Magnum
carlo-rossi-fruity-white.bodyHtml: Carlo Rossi Fruity White in a 1.5L Magnum bottle is a white wine known for its sweet and fruity characteristics, often described as having a light-bodied, easy-drinking style. It's a blend of various grape varietals, usually with a focus on fruitiness. The 1.5L Magnum size provides a larger portion, suitable for gatherings or events.

sawmill-creek-sauvignon-blanc.title: Sawmill Creek Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
sawmill-creek-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Sawmill Creek Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp and dry white wine, often described as having bright, citrusy, and herbaceous notes. It's known for its lively acidity and medium body, with flavor profiles often including green apple, grapefruit, and some hints of herbs.

sawmill-creek-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Sawmill Creek Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
sawmill-creek-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Sawmill Creek Cabernet Sauvignon is a full-bodied, dry red wine with flavors of black cherry and a hint of oak. It's a robust wine with a densely structured profile, offering notes of cassis, plum, black cherry, cedar, oak, vanilla, spice, and smoke. This wine pairs well with steaks, barbeque, and full-flavored cheeses.

santa-rita-120-sauvignon-blanc.title: Santa Rita 120 Reserva Especial Sauvignon Blanc
santa-rita-120-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Santa Rita 120 Reserva Especial Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh, crisp, and aromatic Chilean white wine overflowing with expressive notes of citrus, green apple, white peach, and subtle herbaceous undertones. On the palate, it delivers a lively, medium-bodied feel with crisp, mouth-watering acidity, smooth balance, and a clean, lingering fruity finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh seafood, grilled white fish, green salads with goat cheese, ceviche, shellfish, or enjoyed as a refreshing apéritif.

duboeuf-beaujolais-villages.title: Duboeuf Beaujolais Villages 750ml
duboeuf-beaujolais-villages.bodyHtml: Georges Duboeuf Beaujolais-Villages is a light to medium-bodied red wine made from the Gamay grape, a classic Beaujolais style. It's known for its fruity and floral aromas, balanced acidity, and soft tannins, making it a versatile pairing for various dishes.

santa-carolina-reserva-cabernet-sauvigno.title: Santa Carolina 'Carolina' Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
santa-carolina-reserva-cabernet-sauvigno.bodyHtml: Bright violet color, exhibiting aromas of flower hue and red fruits. Grippy tannins, and a long, pleasant finish. Pairs well with Venison stew in red wine sauce, hamburgers with blue cheese, charcoal grilled beef.

peller-estates-dry-red.title: Peller Family Vineyards Dry Red 4L Bag in Box
peller-estates-dry-red.bodyHtml: Dry and medium-bodied, this red wine has flavours of red berry fruit and hints of spice. An excellent wine for everyday enjoyment, special occasions or family gatherings.

ramazzotti-sambuca.title: Ramazzotti Sambuca
ramazzotti-sambuca.bodyHtml: Ramazzotti Sambuca is a household name for many amateur mixologists because it is a liqueur that is easily mixed and often served neat as a shot. Intensely aromatic with classic black liquorice notes; viscous and sweet with anise and herbs dominating. Best enjoyed in coffee or as a cocktail mixed with soda or orange juice.

fetzer-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Mount Veeder Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
fetzer-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Mount Veeder Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a rich, robust, and beautifully structured mountain Cabernet Sauvignon sourced from steep, high-elevation hillside vineyards in the Mount Veeder appellation of Napa Valley. In the glass, it exhibits a deep ruby to dark brick color with a concentrated rim. The nose unfolds with expressive aromas of ripe black plum, blackberry compote, and açaí berries, seamlessly accented by notes of wet sage, bay laurel, anise, mocha, and toasted oak. On the palate, this full-bodied red is dense and layered, offering concentrated dark fruit flavors balanced by lively acidity and a firm, fine-grained tannic backbone that leads to a persistent, savory finish with flashes of dark cocoa and crushed stone.

Food Pairing: Dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison tenderloin, mushroom risotto, and mature sharp cheddar cheese.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This shows off the vintage character nicely, with a burst of friendly, juicy boysenberry, açaí and mulberry compote notes that show flashes of anise, wet sage and bramble. A twinge of tarry grip holds the finish. Best from 2027 through 2038. 13,000 cases made.

marques-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Marques De Casa Concha Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
marques-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Deep red with lush cherry, black currant, and blackberry aromas with a touch of tar and smoke. The texture is smooth—almost silky—and masks the firm tannic structure that lies below and only appears on the lingering finish.

Grilled, roasted, or stewed red meats and game with intense and slightly acidic sauces (tomato or wine) or with herbs such as rosemary, thyme, and bay leaf. Perfect with most cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

A fruity Marques de Casa Concha with a touch of graphite to the ripe dark cherries and dried strawberries. Juicy and savory, with fine-grained tannins and a firm, medium-long finish. From Pirque and Puente Alto. Drink or hold.

santa-carolina-reserve-sauvignon-blanc.title: Santa Carolina Reserve Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
santa-carolina-reserve-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Santa Carolina Reserva Sauvignon Blanc is a wine known for its vibrant, fruity aroma and flavor profile, with notes of citrus, peach, and passion fruit. It's a fresh, crisp wine with a nice balance of acidity and a hint of minerality, making it a versatile choice for various food pairings. The wine is produced in Chile's Leyda Valley, known for its Mediterranean climate and cool breezes, which contribute to the wine's characteristic flavors.

coltiva-lambrusco-di-modena.title: Coltiva Lambrusco Di Modena 750ml
coltiva-lambrusco-di-modena.bodyHtml: Coltiva Lambrusco di Modena is a naturally sparkling Italian red wine known for its lively, fruity flavor and refreshing acidity. It's a blend of different Lambrusco grape varieties from the Modena region, resulting in a ruby red color with a persistent mousse and a bouquet of cherry, raspberry, and blackberry. The palate is smooth and fruity, with a hint of sweetness and delicate bubbles.

bolla-pinot-grigio-del-veneto.title: Bolla Pinot Grigio delle Venezie
bolla-pinot-grigio-del-veneto.bodyHtml: Bolla Pinot Grigio is a strong example of traditional Pinot Grigio from the Veneto region. The wine is extra-dry with a slightly more body than its northern counterparts. Aromas and flavours evoke green apple, melon and lemony citrus. This refreshing white would pair well with linguine and mussels.

boones-tropical.title: Boones Tropical 750ml
boones-tropical.bodyHtml: Boone's Farm Tropical is a 750ml flavored malt beverage that originated as an apple wine product in California. It is known for its fruity, tropical flavors, often described as a mix of pineapple, orange, and citrus. It's a popular choice for casual gatherings and enjoying on a sunny day.

boones-snow-creek.title: Boones Snow Creek 750ml
boones-snow-creek.bodyHtml: Boone's Snow Creek Berry is a 750ml wine-based beverage with a sweet, berry flavor profile. It's described as a blend of rich, juicy berry flavors, offering a balanced mix of sweetness and tartness. The beverage features a deep berry red color with vibrant hues and lush aromas of ripe berries. It is a dessert wine, or a fruit wine, and is part of the Boones Farm line.

boones-sunpeak-peach.title: Boones Sunpeak Peach 750ml
boones-sunpeak-peach.bodyHtml: Boone's Sun Peak Peach is a 750ml bottle of fruit wine with a peach flavor, known for its sweet and fruity taste, and is often described as refreshing and perfect for any occasion. It is a lightly carbonated beverage made with natural fruit juices and a low alcohol content. Shop Suki describes it as "refresh and relax with every sip", suggesting its light and enjoyable character. thegatewayonline.ca describes the taste as "sweet but subtle notes of delectable peach among the sharp notes of carbonation".

cono-sur-chardonnay.title: Cono Sur Chardonnay 750ml
cono-sur-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Cono Sur Chardonnay (750ml) is a Chilean white wine known for its fresh, fruity profile and balanced acidity. Wine and Beyond describes it as having a yellow color with golden hues, refreshing citrus aromas, and fruity notes of white peaches and mineral hints. On the palate, it offers a complex mix of fruity flavors with lovely mineral notes and a well-balanced acidity, making it a young and fresh wine.

kendall-jackson-vr-cabernet.title: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
kendall-jackson-vr-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon is a quintessential, fruit-forward California wine crafted from a multi-appellation blend of primarily mountain and hillside vineyards in Sonoma and Mendocino counties. On the nose, it reveals an inviting and lush bouquet of black cherry, ripe blackberry, and cassis, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of dried culinary herbs, mocha, and toasted vanilla. The palate is medium-bodied and robust yet exceptionally supple, offering a round mid-palate framed by smooth, seamless tannins. Artisan winemaking techniques, including extended maceration and careful maturation in a mix of French and American oak barrels, impart a balanced structural backbone without overpowering the fruit, culminating in an elegant, velvety finish.

 

Food Pairing: Pairs excellently with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, savory mushroom risotto, hearty lasagna, and aged cheeses like sharp cheddar or Gouda.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This complete and well-balanced wine is a pleasure to drink soon, but will also develop more nuances for a few years. Fresh blackberries and blueberries are accented by light vanilla and cinnamon-scented oak spices on a lightly tannic texture.

casa-lapostolle-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Lapostolle Cuvee Alexandre Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
casa-lapostolle-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Lapostolle Cuvée Alexandre Cabernet Sauvignon is a refined and expressive red from the prestigious Apalta Valley, crafted with a French winemaking philosophy and Chilean soul. Born from a vintage that allowed for excellent aromatic precision, it offers an intense bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, fresh cherries, and dark berries, layered with notes of rosemary, sage, and a touch of graphite. On the palate, it is full-bodied and velvety, showcasing a dense core of fruit supported by firm, polished tannins and a vibrant acidity. This estate-grown wine is certified organic and biodynamic, aged for 14 months in French oak to ensure a long, complex, and elegant finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

A fresh nose full of fruit. Dark cherries, fresh blueberries, spices, crushed stones and olives. A touch of graphite, too. Well-structured and vertical on the palate, but there is also fluidity in the center palate filled with fruit. Tight grip of crunchy tannins at the end before a long, fruit-expressive finish. Drink from 2025.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Cuvée Alexandre Cabernet Sauvignon strikes a desirable balance between soft, creamy approachability and a serious expression of its origins. On the nose, red and black fruits blend with fresh rosemary and sage aromas, all framed with judicious new oak. The palate is rich and layered, embracing the lavish house profile while retaining a deftness and purity that carries through to the elegant, refined finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This full-bodied Cabernet has a nose of cranberries, blackberries and herbs. Fruity and fresh, it offers integrated notes of wood spices that enhance dark berry flavors, leading to a lengthy finish.

casa-lapostolle-merlot.title: Lapostolle Grand Selection Merlot
casa-lapostolle-merlot.bodyHtml: Lapostolle Grand Selection Merlot is an approachable and well-structured red wine crafted to highlight the vibrant fruit character of the Rapel Valley. It is designed to be fresh and fruit-forward, featuring a deep ruby colour and an expressive bouquet of ripe raspberries, plums, and black cherries, accented by subtle notes of sweet spices and black pepper. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and remarkably smooth, showcasing velvety tannins and a juicy core of red forest fruits. A light touch of oak adds complexity without overpowering the primary fruit, leading to a clean and persistent finish.

carmen-gran-reserva-merlot.title: Carmen Gran Reserva Merlot
carmen-gran-reserva-merlot.bodyHtml:
Carmen Gran Reserva Merlot pours a deep, concentrated ruby color in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and fruit-forward, opening with inviting aromas of blackcurrant, dark plum, and fresh mulberry, beautifully layered with secondary hints of dark cocoa, roasted coffee beans, and sweet baking spices like cinnamon and clove derived from its careful oak maturation. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Chilean red wine delivers a remarkably rich and fluid entry. Its generous core of ripe black cherries and wild berries is framed by soft, velvety, and tightly woven tannins. A balanced streak of refreshing acidity provides marvelous life and vitality, carrying the dark fruit flavors into a long, supple, and savory finish touched by subtle notes of dried herbs and white pepper.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with pan-fried beef and vegetables, slow-roasted rosemary lamb chops, savory mushroom pasta dishes, or mature, hard artisanal cheeses.

carmen-gran-reserva-sauvignon-blanc.title: Carmen Gran Reserva Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
carmen-gran-reserva-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: The Carmen Gran Reserva Sauvignon Blanc is described as a lively, fruity white wine with an intense bouquet and good structure. It features a balanced acidity, is refreshing on the palate, and has a fresh, elegant aroma with notes of dill and a medium finish of herbs. It is known for its citrus and stone fruit flavors.

farnese-sangiovese.title: Fantini Sangiovese
farnese-sangiovese.bodyHtml: Garnet red with a fruity nose, featuring strawberry, black cherry and hints of oak; quite intense and persistent; medium- bodied, with firm tannins and good balance, immediate appeal.

arbor-mist-strawberry-white-zinfandel.title: Arbor Mist Strawberry White Zinfandel 750ml
arbor-mist-strawberry-white-zinfandel.bodyHtml: What happens when you mix juicy, field ripened strawberry flavor and soft White Zinfandel? A total berry delight! Chill well before serving.

arbor-mist-exotic-fruits.title: Arbor Mist Exotic Fruits 750ml
arbor-mist-exotic-fruits.bodyHtml: A fine wine product with delicious raspberry, lime, and other natural flavors.

arbor-mist-peach-chardonnay.title: Arbor Mist Exotic Fruits 750ml
arbor-mist-peach-chardonnay.bodyHtml: A fine wine product with delicious raspberry, lime, and other natural flavors.

arbor-mist-sangria-zinfandel.title: Arbor Mist Sangria Zinfandel 750ml
arbor-mist-sangria-zinfandel.bodyHtml: Succulent cherries and zesty citrus flavors are blended with a Zinfandel wine to make this Arbor Mist twist on traditional Spanish Sangria. Perfect when chilled.

arbor-mist-tropical-chardonnay.title: Arbor Mist Exotic Fruits 750ml
arbor-mist-tropical-chardonnay.bodyHtml: A fine wine product with delicious raspberry, lime, and other natural flavors.

beringer-fe-chardonnay.title: Beringer Founders' Estate Chardonnay 750ml
beringer-fe-chardonnay.bodyHtml: The Beringer Founders’ Estate Chardonnay is the perfect combination of pear, apple and ripe tropical fruit flavors, with a hint of toasted almond and a classically round mouthfeel. This Chardonnay perfectly complements grilled chicken or fish, or can stand up to rich risotto with its ripe, clean flavors and lingering finish.

arbor-mist-blackberry-merlot.title: Arbor Mist Blackberry Merlot 750ml
arbor-mist-blackberry-merlot.bodyHtml: A delicious blend of full-bodied Merlot and natural Blackberry flavors, two tastes join forces for an unexpected favorite. Tantalizing!

jacobs-creek-merlot.title: Jacob'S Creek Dots Grenache Shiraz 750ml
jacobs-creek-merlot.bodyHtml: Juicy and soft on the palate with lifted fresh raspberry from the Grenache followed by ripe plum that carries the understated creamy taste.

villa-teresa-organic-pinot-grigio.title: Villa Teresa Pinot Grigio Organic 2022 750ml
villa-teresa-organic-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "Ripe cooked pear and apple on the nose, but otherwise clean. The entry is soft and round with a dusting of almonds and spice. A bit old school organic style that lacks lift and energy. Ready to drink. (Anthony Gismondi)." - 84/100, Gismondi on Wine

cabo-wabo-reposado.title: Cabo Wabo Reposado Tequila
cabo-wabo-reposado.bodyHtml:
Originally created by legendary rocker, Sammy Hagar. A golden colour pours into the glass and is instantly filled with a bouquet of bright citrus aromas. Aged from four to six months in American oak barrels, this tequila develops bold flavours of citrus, fresh herbs and refreshing mint with a smooth and lasting peppery finish.

For those who like smoky, meaty cocktails try this in a Repo & Root Beer:2½ oz. Cabo reposado8 oz. root beerBeef jerky stickSweet and smoky BBQ rubIce. Rim a mug with sweet and smoky BBQ rub, fill the mug with ice, and then add tequila and root beer. Use the beef jerky stick to stir and garnish the drink.

jacobs-creek-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Jacob's Creek Heritage St. Hugo Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
jacobs-creek-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
TASTE: Elegant and structural at its core with fine chalky tannins complimented by an even floral fruit spectrum, enhanced with subtle toasted oak.

AROMA: Floral lift, perfumed blueberries and hints of cocoa with overtones of violets and cooling dried herbs

Pairings: Beef, Mushrooms, Crusted Ahi Tuna

94 Points - Cameron Douglas

There’s no mistaking the power and richness, variety and intensity in the bouquet of this wine. Aromas and flavours of blackberry and green olives, sweet cigar tobacco and roasted bell-peppers, dark violet scents and barrel spices of vanilla and clove. A whisper of mint then a dry stone earthy quality adds depth and complexity. Dry on the palate with bold tannis and acid line, contrasting fruit and oak qualities leading to a strong foundation and lengthy finish. An excellent wine ready for drinking on its own from 2025 or decant for service before then and enjoy with food.

rosemount-cabernet-merlot.title: Red Rooster Cabernet Merlot 2023
rosemount-cabernet-merlot.bodyHtml:
Red Rooster Cabernet Merlot 2023 is a beautifully balanced, full-bodied, and robust Canadian red wine blend originating from the sun-drenched vineyards of British Columbia's South Okanagan Valley. A classic blend of Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot, it undergoes precise tank fermentation before aging for 12 to 14 months in a combination of stainless steel and oak barrels. It displays a deep, enticing garnet hue in the glass, releasing an aromatic bouquet of ripe blue plum, black currant, and dark cherry seamlessly layered with nuances of tobacco leaf, sweet spice, and smoky oak. On the palate, this extra-dry red offers a smooth yet structured mouthfeel with soft, drying tannins and a concentrated core of juicy black fruits, cocoa powder, and subtle baking spice that lingers elegantly on the finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled steak, roasted lamb shank, hearty beef stews, barbecue ribs, and aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

wild-vines-raspberry-white-zinfandel.title: Bogle Old Vines Zinfandel
wild-vines-raspberry-white-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Bogle Old Vines Zinfandel pours a deep, intense ruby-purple color in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and fruit-forward, opening with concentrated aromas of summer raspberry, ripe boysenberry, and dark plum. These primary aromas are intricately layered with secondary notes of cracked black pepper, orange pekoe tea, and sweet baking spices like nutmeg and clove derived from 10 months of maturation in American oak. On the palate, this full-bodied red wine delivers a rich, voluptuous mouthfeel. Its bold core of jammy black cherries and wild cranberries is seamlessly balanced by fine, chalky tannins and a lively streak of acidity that keeps the palate energetic, culminating in a long, smooth, and supple finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with smoked beef brisket, slow-cooked pulled pork, spicy pepperoni pizza, or a selection of mature, sharp cheddar cheeses.

santa-rita-reserva-carmenere.title: Santa Rita Pewen de Apalta Carmenere 2022
santa-rita-reserva-carmenere.bodyHtml:
Santa Rita Pewën de Apalta Carménère 2022 is an exceptional, benchmark Chilean red wine produced from historic, dry-farmed vines planted in 1938 on the granite-rich slopes of the Apalta Valley. Crafted under the direction of winemaker Sebastián Labbé, it reveals a dense, purple-carmine hue and an expressive bouquet of ripe blackberries, black cherries, and dark plum, laced with graphite, tobacco leaf, and refined nuances of jalapeño and crushed spice. On the palate, it delivers a concentrated, velvety mouthfeel structured by chiseled, fine-dusted tannins and a vibrant line of natural acidity, culminating in an expansive, lingering finish marked by notes of cocoa, cedar, and mineral complexity.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime hanger steak, roasted venison medallions, braised oxtail stew, and mature hard cheeses like aged Manchego or Comté.

terrunyo-carmenere.title: Terrunyo Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
terrunyo-carmenere.bodyHtml:
A distinguished Cabernet Sauvignon from Concha y Toro's Terrunyo range in Chile's Maipo Valley, showing ripe blackcurrant, blueberry, graphite and chocolate with herbal and spicy nuances. Firm tannins, refreshing acidity and careful oak aging create a structured, concentrated palate with excellent length.

Food Pairing: Grilled steak, roast lamb, braised beef, barbecue ribs, mushroom dishes and aged hard cheeses.

 

94 Points - James Suckling

Dark minerals with tarry and ashy notes to the ripe blackberries and paprika. Juicy and flavorful on the palate with very dusty tannins holding up the fruit. Long, firm and pretty linear. One of the best. Drink or hold.

jackson-triggs-ps-cabernet-merlot.title: Jackson Triggs Ps Cabernet Merlot 750ml
jackson-triggs-ps-cabernet-merlot.bodyHtml: Jackson Triggs Proprietors' Selection Cabernet Merlot is a Canadian red wine blend known for its smooth, fruit-forward profile. It is a blend of Cabernet Franc and Merlot, offering aromas of cherry, blackberry, and raspberry with a hint of pepper spice. The wine is medium-bodied with a gentle tannin structure and a touch of oak, making it versatile for pairing with various dishes like grilled meats, tomato-based pasta, and semi-firm cheeses. It is a popular choice for those looking for an approachable and well-crafted red wine.

langmeil-shiraz.title: Langmeil Valley Floor Shiraz 2023 750ml
langmeil-shiraz.bodyHtml: Langmeil Valley Floor Shiraz is a medium to full-bodied red wine from the Barossa Valley in Australia. It's known for its dark crimson color, rich aromas of blackberry, plum, and spice, and a silky smooth palate with dark fruit, chocolate, and coffee flavors. The wine is characterized by firm tannins and a well-balanced acidity.

masi-modello-bianco.title: Masi Modello Pinot Grigio
masi-modello-bianco.bodyHtml:
Masi Modello Pinot Grigio is a fresh, elegant, and contemporary Italian white wine that beautifully expresses the crisp, cool-climate character of northeastern Italy. In the glass, it displays a bright straw yellow color with pale greenish reflections. The nose is highly aromatic and inviting, opening with a bouquet of white flower blossoms, crisp green apples, ripe Bartlett pears, and vibrant citrus zest. On the palate, this wine is light-to-medium-bodied, clean, and wonderfully refreshing. It strikes a harmonious balance between a soft, smooth texture and a lively, mouth-watering acidity, delivering delicate flavors of orchard fruits and a touch of clean minerality on its dry, crisp finish.

Food Pairing: The refreshing nature and bright acidity of this Pinot Grigio make it an exceptional aperitif and an incredibly versatile food partner. It pairs excellently with light appetizers, fresh summer salads, and classic Italian antipasti like prosciutto with melon. It is also a fantastic match for delicate seafood dishes, including grilled white fish, spaghetti alle vongole (clams), or shrimp cocktail, as well as light poultry dishes and fresh cheeses like mozzarella or goat cheese.

beaulieu-coastal-chardonnay.title: DAOU Chardonnay 2025
beaulieu-coastal-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
DAOU Chardonnay 2025 is an expressive, beautifully balanced, and textural California white wine crafted by brothers Georges and Daniel Daou in the hills of Paso Robles. Sourced from premium vineyard sites across the calcareous clay and limestone terroirs of the Central Coast, the grapes benefit from warm daytime sunshine tempered by coastal breezes and dramatic diurnal shifts. Fermented with careful temperature regulation and aged in French oak to marry richness with precision, it reveals a luminous, pale straw-gold hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is fragrant and layered, unfurling with scents of lemon zest, yellow apple, crisp nectarine, and honeysuckle, complemented by subtle nuances of baking spices, toasted hazelnut, and vanilla cream. On the palate, it delivers a medium-bodied, rounded mouthfeel framed by vibrant natural acidity and tropical hints of melon and ripe orchard fruit, finishing clean, polished, and persistent with delicate touches of toasted oak.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops in lemon-butter sauce, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy mushroom risotto, grilled halibut, or mild artisanal triple-cream cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

Quite subtle and restrained with aromas of lemon, yellow apple, melon, baking spice and nectarine. The palate is medium-bodied with a textural, rounded mouthfeel, bright acidity and a generous finish. Fresh and polished with plenty of flavor and balance. Drink now. Screw cap.

beaulieu-vineyard-coastal-merlot.title: Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
beaulieu-vineyard-coastal-merlot.bodyHtml:
Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is a rich, elegant, and full-bodied red wine from California's renowned Napa Valley. Crafted with carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine showcases the region's exceptional winemaking heritage and Beaulieu Vineyard's commitment to quality. It offers concentrated dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, and subtle oak influences, creating a beautifully balanced and sophisticated drinking experience. With its smooth texture, layered complexity, and lingering finish, this Cabernet Sauvignon is an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining, or enjoying with a hearty meal.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, barbecue, hearty pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses such as cheddar and Gouda.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Focused and brilliant flavors of red and black cherries and black currants drive this sleek and powerful wine, as minty, toasty, and tobacco-like accents stay subtly in the background until the finish. A full body, medium to full tannins and good fruit acidity lend tangy freshness. Best from 2026.

91 Points - James Suckling 

A juicy and delicious wine with a round and polished texture with hints of chocolate and walnuts. Some iron shavings, too. Medium body. Savory at the end. Lovely dark fruit in the finish. Juicy. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a light mesquite edge that mingles with gently mulled plum and blackberry fruit flavors, while lightly singed vanilla and tobacco fill in through the finish. Reveals a solid graphite spine, too. Drink now through 2033. Tasted twice, with consistent notes

casillero-del-diablo-sauvignon-blanc.title: Casillero del Diablo Reserva Sauvignon Blanc
casillero-del-diablo-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Casillero del Diablo Reserva Sauvignon Blanc is a remarkably refreshing and crisp expression of Chile's coastal and cool-climate vineyards. In the glass, it displays a pale, bright yellow color with brilliant greenish hues. The nose is vividly aromatic and fruit-forward, offering an inviting bouquet of lively citrus, lime zest, and pink grapefruit, interlaced with notes of green apple, juicy peach, and a delicate touch of fresh-cut grass and gooseberry. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, clean, and highly energetic. It delivers a bright core of citrus and tropical fruit flavors beautifully balanced by a racy, mouth-watering acidity, leading to a vibrant, zesty finish that leaves the palate revitalized.

Food Pairing: This crisp and highly refreshing white wine pairs perfectly with light seafood dishes such as classic citrus ceviche, grilled sea bass, and fresh oysters. It is also an excellent companion for herb-roasted chicken, fresh green salads with a zesty vinaigrette, vegetable sushi rolls, and soft, tangy cheeses like fresh goat cheese.

beringer-founders-pinot-noir.title: Beringer Founders' Estate Pinot Noir 750ml
beringer-founders-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Beringer Founders’ Estate Pinot Noir is immediately fruit forward with bright flavors of red cherry and currant, beautifully complemented by cedar and cinnamon spice. It is a perfect pairing with grilled salmon, roast turkey, or brie cheese.

86 Points - Wine Enthusiast
A light-bodied, approachable Pinot Noir with soft red berry flavors and a smooth texture. An easy-drinking, crowd-pleasing introduction to the varietal.
85 Points - James Suckling
Offers simple cherry and raspberry notes with minimal tannins. A straightforward, value-driven California Pinot for casual occasions.

jackson-triggs-black-sauvignon-blanc.title: Jackson Triggs Black Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
jackson-triggs-black-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Jackson Triggs Black Cabernet Sauvignon is a full-bodied, fruit-forward red wine with notes of blackcurrant, cherry, and cassis. It is known for its rich, bold aromas and pairs well with rich, rare game meats or braised beef dishes.

boschendal-1685-chardonnay.title: Boschendal 1685 Chardonnay
boschendal-1685-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Chardonnay for this wine was selected from three areas: Stellenbosch, Elgin Valley and Boschendal Farm, from vineyards planted on well-drained soils. This gives complexity and character to the wine and zesty citrus with ripe tropical fruit flavours come through on the palate.

wolf-blass-yellow-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Wolf Blass Yellow Cabernet Sauvignon 1.5L Magnum
wolf-blass-yellow-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: The Wolf Blass Yellow Label Cabernet Sauvignon in a 1.5L magnum is a full-bodied red wine known for its rich, dark fruit flavors and a hint of oak. It's a blend of expertly chosen Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, resulting in a smooth, well-structured wine.

prop-reserve-merlot.title: Peller Estates Proprietor'S Reserve Cabernet Merlot
prop-reserve-merlot.bodyHtml:
A smooth and approachable Canadian red blend, this wine offers ripe dark fruit aromas of blackcurrant and plum with hints of cedar and vanilla. The palate is medium-bodied with soft tannins, balanced acidity, and a warm, rounded finish showing notes of dark cherry and subtle oak spice.


Food Pairing: Grilled beef burgers, roasted lamb, hearty pasta with meat sauce, aged cheddar, and barbecued ribs

rainier.title: Grand Marnier Cuvée Louis-Alexandre
rainier.bodyHtml: A unique blend of refined V.S.O.P. cognac and Liqueur D ’Orange, the cognacs used in this premium Cuvée come from the finest growing areas in the Cognac region. It is a beautiful, complex blend featuring flavours of candied orange and macerated citrus fruit softened by notes of pine and earl grey tea.

sasyr-sangiovese-syrah.title: Sasyr Sangiovese Syrah 750ml
sasyr-sangiovese-syrah.bodyHtml: Sasyr Sangiovese Syrah from Rocca delle Macìe is a blend of Sangiovese and Syrah grapes, offering a full-bodied, complex red wine. It features notes of dark berries, sandalwood, and Spanish cedar, with a polished structure and bright acidity. The wine is described as "Vino Donna" by the winery, highlighting its feminine soul and balance.

bow-valley-lager.title: Bow Valley Lager 15 Cans
bow-valley-lager.bodyHtml:
Bow Valley Lager is a refreshing Canadian pale lager with an easy-drinking character inspired by the Rocky Mountains. Featuring a clean malt profile, subtle toasted grain notes and gentle herbal hop bitterness, this approachable beer delivers a crisp, dry finish. Packaged in fifteen 355ml cans at 5.0% ABV, it is ideal for gatherings.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with grilled burgers, barbecue chicken, pepperoni pizza, crispy fries, nachos and salted pretzels.

Tasting Notes: Light-bodied and refreshing with subtle toasted malt, grain character and restrained herbal hop bitterness.

Nose: Light cereal malt, toasted grain and delicate herbal hop aromas.

Palate: Gentle malt sweetness, cracker notes and lively carbonation with balanced bitterness.

Finish: Crisp, clean and dry with mild lingering hop character.

wolf-blass-red-label-cabernet-merlot.title: Wolf Blass The Classic Red Label Cabernet Sauvignon/Merlot 2021 750ml
wolf-blass-red-label-cabernet-merlot.bodyHtml: Cabernet Sauvignon provides length and a subtle yet persistent structure, while Merlot lends a plush, plummy mid-palate to this classic red blend. A generous wine with bright, dark fruit flavours, a juicy palate and soft, approachable tannins.

wolf-blass-red-chardonnay.title: Wolf Blass Red Label Chardonnay
wolf-blass-red-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Wolf Blass Red Label Chardonnay is a fresh, approachable Australian white wine crafted from Chardonnay grapes sourced across South Eastern Australia. Produced by the renowned Wolf Blass winery, this fruit-forward expression offers inviting aromas of white peach, ripe pear, and delicate citrus, complemented by subtle spicy oak. The palate is soft and rounded, delivering juicy stone fruit flavours with a creamy texture and refreshing balance. Its smooth, lingering finish makes it an excellent everyday Chardonnay, equally suited to casual gatherings and food pairings.

Food Pairing: Herb-roasted chicken, grilled fish, creamy pasta, seared scallops, roasted pork, soft Brie, and vegetable risotto.

jackson-triggs-ps-rose.title: Jackson Triggs Ps Rose 750ml
jackson-triggs-ps-rose.bodyHtml: Jackson-Triggs PS Rosé 750ml is a medium pink rosé wine with aromas and flavors of plum jam, strawberry, and cherry, with a crisp finish. It's known for its easygoing and fruity profile, making it suitable for a variety of occasions. The wine is produced by Jackson-Triggs, a winery known for its award-winning wines. It's a popular Canadian rosé, particularly in the Niagara region of Ontario, and is often described as fresh and refreshing.

highwood-creme-de-cacao-china-white.title: Highwood China White Crème de Cacao
highwood-creme-de-cacao-china-white.bodyHtml:
Highwood China White Crème de Cacao is a clear white chocolate liqueur from Highwood Distillers in High River, Alberta. Made from cacao and vanilla beans, it carries the words 'Liquid Chocolate' on its label and delivers a smooth white chocolate flavour at a gentle 16% ABV. China White has been a standard in the Highwood liqueur range for many years and has been refined over time by the distillery. It is bottled in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Chilled or over ice, or as the chocolate element in creamy cocktails.

sterling-vintners-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Sterling Vintner's Collection Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 / 2022
sterling-vintners-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Sterling Vintner's Collection Cabernet Sauvignon opens with rich aromas of blackberries, with accents of caramel and mocha. The palate is smooth, delivering a balanced expression of plum, blackberry pie, and toffee. Soft, supple, and chocolaty tannins hold the finish, which is long and luxurious.

With its bold flavors and an easy accessibility, this Cabernet Sauvignon pairs well with a variety of foods and occasions, from filet mignon to barbecued ribs.

2021 Vintage Ratings

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is a drink-me-now wine with approachable tannins and a balanced acidity. Find aromas and flavors of roasted coffee, toasted wood, blackberry, black cherry, black currant, black pepper, anise and nutmeg spice.

sterling-vintners-chardonnay.title: Sterling Vintners Chardonnay 2022 750ml
sterling-vintners-chardonnay.bodyHtml: The Sterling Vintners Collection Chardonnay (750ml) is a dry white wine with a balanced profile of orchard and citrus fruits, along with hints of tropical notes and spice. It features a supple mouthfeel and a refreshing finish, making it suitable for various pairings, including shellfish, poultry, and vegetables. The wine is known for its rich and full-bodied nature, with ripe fruit flavors, vanilla oak notes, and a creamy texture.

monasterio-de-las-vinas-gran-reserva.title: Monasterio De Las Vinas Gran Reserva 2018 750ml
monasterio-de-las-vinas-gran-reserva.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "A fragrant, polished red showing complex aromas of nutmeg, cigar box, potpourri and spiced plums. It’s full-bodied, silky and layered, with fine-grained tannins and a spicy and well-balanced finish. Garnacha, tempranillo, cariñena and cabernet sauvignon. Drink or hold." - James Suckling

peller-estates-chardonnay.title: Peller Estates Family Vineyards Pinot Grigio 4L Bag in Box
peller-estates-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Peller Estates Family Vineyards Pinot Grigio 4L Bag in Box is a crisp, refreshing, and light-bodied white wine offering exceptional value and convenience. Pouring a pale straw color, it delivers bright, fruit-forward aromas of crisp green apple, fresh pear, and zesty lemon-lime. On the palate, it is easy-drinking and highly approachable, showcasing a clean, mouth-watering acidity, subtle floral undertones, and a zesty, dry finish that makes it an excellent everyday choice.
