Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with light summer salads, grilled chicken breast, delicate white fish, creamy pasta dishes, soft cheeses, and casual vegetable appetizers.

peller-estates-sauvignon-blanc.title: Peller Family Vineyards Sauvignon Blanc 4L Bag in Box
peller-estates-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: This Sauvignon Blanc is light-bodied and refreshing with flavours of citrus and apple on the palate. Refreshing notes of citrus and white currant linger on the finish.

woodbridge-pinot-grigio.title: Woodbridge Pinot Grigio NV 750ml
woodbridge-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: With aromas of nectarine and fresh peach, our crisp and refreshing Pinot Grigio is a food-friendly wine and a delightful addition to any warm and sunny afternoon. Originating from the northern coast of Italy, Pinot Grigio has long been known for its ability to pair well with seafood and other light dishes. Our Pinot Grigio is a well-rounded wine with a refreshing peach-citrus finish that pairs nicely with oysters, roast chicken or Brie. Serve slightly chilled.

dr-zen-zen-two-colours.title: Dr. Zen Zen Two Colours 750ml
dr-zen-zen-two-colours.bodyHtml: Dr. Zen Zen Two Colours is a fruity, medium-sweet white wine with a floral, aromatic nose due to the muscat grape. It is made in the Rheinhessen region of Germany, from Bacchus grapes, which are a blend of Muller-Thurgau, Riesling, and Sylvaner. The wine is QBA quality and is well-balanced with a juicy, dry finish.

springbank-10-year.title: Springbank 10 Year Old
springbank-10-year.bodyHtml:
Our 10 year old provides the perfect introduction to the Springbank range. Matured in a combination of bourbon and sherry casks, it is complex yet perfectly balanced from the first sip through to the sweet, salty finish.

46% ABV
60% Bourbon, 40% Sherry

fat-bastard-merlot.title: Fat Bastard Merlot 750ml
fat-bastard-merlot.bodyHtml:
FAT bastard Merlot is sourced from select vineyards throughout the Languedoc-Roussillon. The area is known for its stony soil, which naturally limits yields and lends a fresh, fruit-forward character and mature tannins to the final wine.

88 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A plump and juicy Merlot with ripe berry flavors and a soft, round palate. Uncomplicated and crowd-pleasing."


87 Points - James Suckling
"Shows straightforward plum and cherry notes with a smooth finish. A reliable and widely enjoyable wine."

fat-bastard-sauvignon-blanc.title: Fat Bastard Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
fat-bastard-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: FAT bastard Sauvignon Blanc is sourced from Côtes de Gascogne in southwestern France, a zone well suited for growing this varietal. Careful attention in vineyard management and winemaking ensure the fruit-driven aromas and flavors of the final wine.

collazzi-toscana.title: I Collazzi Toscana Rosso 2021
collazzi-toscana.bodyHtml:
The 2021 I Collazzi Toscana Rosso is a monumental and "powerhouse" Super Tuscan, hailing from one of the most successful vintages in recent history for the estate. Produced from 40-year-old vines in a magnificent natural amphitheatre near Florence, this wine offers an intense, deep ruby colour and an expansive bouquet of blackcurrants, ripe blackberries, and marasca cherries, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dark chocolate, balsamic herbs, and spicy sandalwood. On the palate, it is full-bodied and impeccably structured, showcasing a rich, velvety texture supported by firm, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant line of mineral acidity. Matured for 18 months in new and second-passage French oak barrels, it concludes with an exceptionally long, savory finish with lingering hints of black pepper and vanilla.

95 Points - James Suckling

Bright and savory nose of ripe cherries, currants, and hints of black olives, graphite and licorice. Very fine and smooth with good volume and length. Structured and firm, with a medium to full body and lightly chewy tannins. Solid and well made. Cabernet sauvignon, merlot, cabernet franc and petit verdot. Will come together nicely in the next two to three years. Try from 2027.

castarede-armagnac-xo.title: Castarede XO 20 Year Old Armagnac
castarede-armagnac-xo.bodyHtml: Castarede, the oldest non-commissioned house in Gascony, was founded in the distant 19th century. Castarede XO is made from grapes grown in the heart of the Upper Armagnac region. The name XO means at least ten years of aging in a barrel, but the Castarede XO Armagnac is aged for 15-20 years. Delightfully balanced Armagnac, deep and rich, noble, dry and spicy. The aroma shows the tones of ripe plums, chocolate, spices and skin.

oyster-bay-merlot.title: Oyster Bay Merlot
oyster-bay-merlot.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Merlot is an exceptionally smooth, elegant, and fruit-driven cool-climate red wine that beautifully showcases the vibrant viticultural style of Hawke's Bay, New Zealand. Sourced from vineyard sites in the warm, gravelly soils of the Gimblett Gravels and surrounding subregions, this wine undergoes careful temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel before a portion is aged in French oak barrels to impart structural complexity and a subtle touch of spice. In the glass, it displays a bright, deep ruby-red hue with youthful purple reflections along the rim. The nose is highly expressive and fragrant, unrolling a fragrant bouquet of ripe black plums, juicy dark cherries, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of sweet vanilla, dried herbs, and a faint hint of dark chocolate. On the palate, this medium-bodied red is remarkably plush, velvety, and approachable, driving a rich core of succulent dark fruit flavors over a frame of soft, fine-grained tannins and a balanced, refreshing line of natural acidity that leads into a clean, smooth, and fruit-forward finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled lamb chops, pan-seared duck breast, roasted pork tenderloin, wood-fired mushroom pizza, or mild cheeses like Gouda and Brie.

etude-pinot-noir.title: Erath Pinot Noir 2022
etude-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Erath Oregon Pinot Noir expresses the benefits of an extended growing season, offering enchanting aromas of forest berries and lichen. Flavors mature from bright cherry to blackberry compote to savory morel mushroom toast. An Oregon original, this wine achieves excellent balance and complexity while retaining a delicate, fruit-forward profile, the hallmarks of classic, cool-climate Pinot Noir.

89 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Even with 3% Syrah thrown in for good measure, this is one light Pinot Noir that's driven more by its laser-beam acidity than body or tannic structure. Blackberry and lemon aromas are matched by forest- floor notes of pine-needle duff and mushrooms. A tart, not-quite-rip blackberry flavor melds with olive oil and saline notes.

wolftrap-red-boekenhoutskloof.title: The Wolftrap Red
wolftrap-red-boekenhoutskloof.bodyHtml:
The Wolftrap is a tribute to the pioneers who in the early days ventured into the Cape wilderness and erected a wolf trap on Boekenhoutskloof. To date, no wolf either real or mystical, has been seen in the valley. The Wolftrap - a Boekenhoutskloof original.

The Boekenhoutskloof The Wolftrap Red is a South African red wine blend, primarily Syrah, Mourvedre, and Viognier, offering a smooth, easy-drinking experience. It boasts a concentrated red color with purple hues, and a nose that's delightfully fruity, with aromas of black and red berries. On the palate, you can expect flavors like cherries and wild strawberries, with a smooth, fruit-forward finish.

dr-zenzen-late-harvest-red-bottle.title: Dr Zenzen Queen of Grapes Black Riesling
dr-zenzen-late-harvest-red-bottle.bodyHtml:
A distinctive German red with fresh berry fruit, subtle spice and an approachable, smooth character. The palate is fruit-driven and balanced, with gentle acidity, soft tannins and a clean finish that keeps the wine lively.

Food Pairing: Pair with roasted poultry, pork, charcuterie, grilled vegetables, mushroom dishes, mild sausages, or semi-firm cheeses.

painted-turtle-shiraz.title: Torbreck Descendant Shiraz 2019
painted-turtle-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Torbreck Descendant Shiraz 2019 is a rich, highly expressive, and powerful Australian red wine crafted from a single vineyard in the Marananga subregion of the Barossa Valley. Co-fermented with a small percentage of Viognier skins, it opens with seductive aromatics of dark cherries, blueberries, raspberry tart, and wild violets, complemented by nuances of star anise, cracked black pepper, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied, plush, and voluptuous, offering dense dark fruit flavors structured by muscular yet velvety tannins and a persistent, spice-accented finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, venison, and rich game stews.

97 Points - James Suckling

Terrific intensity and depth with blackberry, blueberry, black ink, graphite and umami. Pencil shavings. Full and very fine with depth and richness. Co-fermented with 8% viogner. This is a wine that seduces you with its aromas and complexity. You just want to smell it. Give it three to four years to open. Try after 2025. 

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

2019 followed the warm (but excellent) 2018 in the Barossa, and was marred by low yields and very concentrated fruit. 2020 was another step further down that low-yielding, dry track, completing a trio of concentrated, brooding vintages that are, as the years go by, harder and harder to get ahold of. So, the 2019 Descendant includes Viognier skins in the ferment, usually around 2%, and the fruit is sourced from vines planted from cuttings from the RunRig Vineyard. A baby Runrig, if you will. So, this is silky, slippery, tannic and intense, with layers of vibrant raspberry, jasmine tea, red licorice, jelly snakes and deli meat. As usual for the Torbreck reds, the texture of the wine is velvety, plush, intense and enveloping. This ages very well, we know it does, but if you must drink it early, decant it!

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The mini-me of Torbreck's renowned Runrig, Descendant sees some Viognier skins. It's a perfumed and powerful wine, with aromas of raspberry tart, blueberry preserves, violet, cracked pepper and beetroot and a good lick of chocolaty, toasty oak. The rich yet sculpted palate is gripped by muscular tannins. It'll soften with time and should age quite gracefully, but for now it's still very young. Drink 2024–2035. Christina Pickard

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Fleshy tannins set the stage for rich, dense flavors, but this wine is outstanding for its aromatics as well. Presents palo santo, Asian five-spice, espresso crema, wild blackberry, lapsang souchong black tea and salted toffee, along with a whiff of fresh violet. Gorgeous in its persistence on the long, expressive finish. Shiraz and Viognier. Drink now through 2037.

mirassou-pinot-noir.title: Mirassou Pinot Noir
mirassou-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Pinot Noir can be challengingly difficult to grow, but in the hands of the right winemaker it produces some of the world's most sought-after wines. California Pinot Noir tends to be more fruit-forward than its international counterparts. Mirassou Pinot Noir shows toasty oak, vanilla and plum; perfect for roast chicken.

peller-estates-rose.title: Peller Family Vineyards Rose 4L Bag in Box
peller-estates-rose.bodyHtml: A light-bodied wine with sweet strawberry on the palate and a refreshingly crisp finish.

sacred-hill-pinot-noir.title: Sanford Rita Hills Pinot Noir
sacred-hill-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
A refined California Pinot Noir from Sanford Winery that expresses the cool-climate character of the Sta. Rita Hills AVA with bright red cherry, raspberry and spice aromas. Supple tannins and fresh acidity contribute to a vibrant, elegant palate with length and depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roasted duck breast, grilled salmon with herbs, mushroom risotto, pork tenderloin with sage, or aged Gruyère

blackbox-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Blackbox Cabernet Sauvignon 3L Bag in Box

relax-cool-red.title: Relax Cool Red 750ml
relax-cool-red.bodyHtml:
Relax Cool Red is a 750ml bottle of red wine described as an approachable Beaujolais-type wine with flavors of black cherries and plums, complemented by soft tannins and a touch of sweetness. It's often served chilled, making it a pleasant alternative to traditional red wines. 

87 Points - James Suckling
This light-bodied red is designed for effortless drinking, offering bright and cheerful aromas of red berries, such as strawberry and raspberry, with a subtle floral hint. The palate is soft and slightly off-dry, with a smooth, almost silky texture and very little tannic structure, making it incredibly approachable for a wide range of palates. It finishes clean and refreshing, embodying its name as a truly "cool" and unstuffy red.
86 Points - Wine Enthusiast
True to its name, this wine provides a chilled, easy-drinking experience with straightforward notes of candied red fruits and a touch of sweetness. Its light body and smooth profile make it an ideal choice for casual social gatherings or as a simple, refreshing glass on its own, offering a no-fuss alternative to more structured red wines.

barefoot-chardonnay.title: Barefoot Chardonnay 750ml
barefoot-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Barefoot Chardonnay is a delightful representation of this classic white grape variety. It pours a bright, golden yellow into the glass, exuding an inviting vibrancy. On the nose, it offers a bouquet of tropical fruits such as pineapple and mango, mingling with notes of ripe pear and a hint of citrus zest.

On the palate, this Chardonnay displays a harmonious balance between its creamy texture and lively acidity. Flavors of green apple and juicy peach dance on the tongue, complemented by a touch of vanilla and a subtle buttery richness. The finish is clean and refreshing, leaving a pleasant, lingering impression.

barefoot-merlot.title: Barefoot Merlot 750ml
barefoot-merlot.bodyHtml: A consistently good, award-winning merlot from California. Valued priced and made in a crowd-pleasing style. Ruby red in colour, the nose reveals upfront toast, prune and cassis aromas with notes of spiced chocolate. Dry, light to medium-bodied and rounded, with balanced silky tannins on the long lively berry fruit finish.

brooklyn-lager.title: Olympia 15 Cans
brooklyn-lager.bodyHtml: An American lager with a light, slightly sweeter, more rounded flavour, balanced by a light, refreshing hop aroma and taste

circus-malbec.title: Bodegas Escorihuela Gascon Circus Malbec 750ml
circus-malbec.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2013 vintage) "Savoury, earthy, liquorice, light cherry and chocolate aromas. Light, round, soft, somewhat sweet palate with orange, black cherry, rooty, resin flavours. A touch hollow but otherwise an easy-sipping malbec style. Good value. (Anthony Gismondi and Stuart Tobe)." - 85/100, Gismondi on Wine

flat-roof-manor-pinot-grigio.title: Nederburg Flat Roof Manor Pinot Grigio 2021 750ml
flat-roof-manor-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Pale yellow with a hint of green. Dried peach and apricot as well as a hint of lychee. On the palate the emphasis is on the fruit and what you smell is what you get: peaches, apricots and a bit of lychee.

da-vinci-chianti-docg.title: Piantaferro Chianti DOCG 750ml+
da-vinci-chianti-docg.bodyHtml:
Piantaferro Chianti D.O.C.G. is a distinguished Italian red wine produced by Vinicola Tombacco, crafted exclusively from 100% Sangiovese grapes sourced from the renowned Chianti region in Tuscany.

Tasting Notes
COLOR:
Deep ruby color that develops garnet reflections with age, showcasing a consistent and profound granite profile.

NOSE:
Intriguing scents of red fruits and cherries are complemented by elegant notes of tea and spices, particularly black pepper, resulting in a warm, complex, and sophisticated bouquet.

TASTE:
The wine offers a vibrant introduction with crisp acidity, transitioning into well-structured tannins. It concludes with a pleasant dryness accented by a subtle hint of salinity, leaving a lasting impression and indicating excellent aging potential.
Food Pairing
Piantaferro Chianti pairs excellently with a variety of dishes:

Pasta: Complements pasta with tomato-based sauces, enhancing the rich flavors of the dish. Caná Wine Shop

Pizza: Pairs well with classic pizzas, balancing the acidity of the tomato sauce and the richness of the cheese.

Cured Meats: Ideal alongside salami and other cured meats, offering a harmonious tasting experience. stemwinegroup.com

Burgers: Enhances the flavors of burgers, providing a delightful contrast to the savory components.

quinta-do-infantado-douro.title: Quinta do Vale Meao Meandro Douro
quinta-do-infantado-douro.bodyHtml:
Quinta do Vale Meão Meandro Douro is an elegant Portuguese red wine that showcases the character of the Douro Valley with aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, violets, and subtle spice. Smooth tannins and vibrant acidity support a rich, balanced palate that finishes long and refined.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled lamb, roast beef, game, hearty pasta dishes, and aged cheeses.

copper-moon-chardonnay.title: Copper Moon Moonlight Harvest Chardonnay 750ml
copper-moon-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Moonlight Harvest Chardonnay 750ml is a smooth and approachable Canadian white wine that showcases the rich, fruit-forward character of the Chardonnay grape. Part of the popular Copper Moon wine collection, this refreshing Chardonnay offers a delightful combination of ripe orchard fruits, tropical notes, and subtle citrus flavours. Its balanced acidity, soft texture, and pleasant finish create an enjoyable drinking experience suitable for casual gatherings, dinner parties, and everyday enjoyment. Versatile and easy to pair with food, Copper Moon Moonlight Harvest Chardonnay is an excellent choice for those who appreciate a flavourful and accessible white wine.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken, baked salmon, shrimp pasta, creamy Alfredo dishes, roasted turkey, seafood risotto, mild cheeses, and roasted vegetables.

beringer-founders-pinot-grigio.title: Beringer Main & Vine Pinot Grigio 750ml
beringer-founders-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Perfect for the hot days and warm nights of summer. Has a refreshing bite of juicy white peach and citrus, finishing with a flinty minerality. Makes for a great pre-dinner sipper or as an accompaniment to fresh salads and grilled chicken.

charles-smith-kung-fu-girl-riesling.title: Charles Smith Wines Kung Fu Girl Riesling
charles-smith-kung-fu-girl-riesling.bodyHtml:
Charles Smith Wines Kung Fu Girl Riesling is a vibrant, laser-focused, and exceptionally energetic white wine created with a specific mission to be the ultimate companion for spicy cuisine. Born from an idea the winemaker had while eating Chinese takeout and watching a martial arts film, this pure Riesling beams with an aromatic, high-impact bouquet of white peach, mandarin orange, apricot, and white jasmine flowers. On the palate, it delivers a striking balance of off-dry, juicy stone fruit sweetness and a driving, slate-like minerality, propelled by a roundhouse kick of crisp, mouthwatering acidity that keeps the finish intensely fresh and long.

Food Pairing:

This zippy, high-acid Riesling pairs spectacularly with spicy Thai curries, Sriracha pork tacos, hot ramen bowls, Kung Pao shrimp, or classic Chinese takeout.

mission-hill-reserve-riesling.title: Mission Hill Reserve Chardonnay 2020/2022 750ml
mission-hill-reserve-riesling.bodyHtml: The Mission Hill Reserve Chardonnay 2021 is a dry, medium-bodied white wine with a pale straw yellow color. It features complex aromas of crisp apple, ripe pear, and lemon zest, along with a rich, luxuriant taste with hints of vanilla and toasty oak, according to VINVM. The wine is aged in oak barrels, contributing to its smooth and velvety texture and persistent finish.

beringer-main-vine-merlot.title: Beringer Main & Vine Merlot 750ml
beringer-main-vine-merlot.bodyHtml: Ripe plum and currant flavors are immediately evident in its aromas and flavors. A sweet, toasty note of oak rounds out the blend and gives the wine a nice body and mouth feel. Approachable and delicious from the first sip, this wine is an everyday indulgence.

perrier-jouet-belle-epoque.title: Perrier-Jouet Belle Epoque Brut 2015 / 2016
perrier-jouet-belle-epoque.bodyHtml:
In 2015, an unusually mild, wet winter was followed by a dry, sunny spring. Summer was notable for abundant rainfall in July and August, two months of contrasting temperatures. September brought a return to normal, with favorable climatic conditions for harvest. The grapes were healthy and picked at the point of perfect ripeness. The resulting clear wines were powerful and complex with subtle overtones of fruit.

A pale gold, clear and luminous, like the rising sun. Delicate aromas of fruit – vine peach and poached pear – and linden and hawthorn blossom. Notes of juicy vine peach lend a fine texture, complemented by poached pear and tangy rhubarb. A combination of freshness, balance and tension. A rare and harmonious champagne.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant Champagne, with a satinlike mousse, offering a bright burst of Meyer lemoninfused acidity as a backbone for finely meshed notes of poached apricot and pear, brioche, candied ginger and chopped almond. Pretty and floral on the finish. Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier. Drink now through 2035.

innis-gunn-rum-finish.title: Innis & Gunn Caribbean Rum Cask 6 Bottles
innis-gunn-rum-finish.bodyHtml:
Caribbean Rum Cask (formerly known as Blood Red Sky).

  • Style: A Scottish red beer matured in Caribbean rum casks.

  • ABV (Alcohol By Volume): 6.8%.

  • Tasting Notes: Features aromas and flavors of rich fruit, spiced rum, chocolate, and vanilla, with a warming and mellow finish.

  • Packaging: Typically sold in 330ml bottles. The six-pack you're looking for is a common packaging format for this product

ghost-pines-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Ghost Pines Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
ghost-pines-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Bold and intensely flavored, Ghost Pines Cabernet Sauvignon was crafted with grapes from Sonoma and Napa. The blend of these two regions creates an expansive palate that offers dark fruit flavors, round tannins and an enduring finish. Sweet vanilla nuances and the occasional savory note make this Cabernet a truly unique wine.

ghost-pines-merlot.title: Ghost Pines "Winemaker's Blend" Merlot 2020
ghost-pines-merlot.bodyHtml: A rich and multifaceted California red, the 2020 Ghost Pines Merlot is a masterclass in multi-appellation blending, sourcing premium fruit from both Sonoma and Napa counties. This wine presents an intense dark ruby color and opens with an inviting bouquet of ripe black cherry, plum, and marionberry, complemented by sophisticated notes of mocha, toasted oak, and a touch of savory dried herbs. On the palate, it is full-bodied and supple, offering a velvety mouthfeel with plush tannins and balanced acidity. Layers of dark chocolate and vanilla bean emerge through the mid-palate, leading to a smooth, long-lasting finish that reflects the depth and structure of its high-quality coastal vineyard origins.

captain-morgan-100-proof.title: Captain Morgan Spiced 100 Spiced Rum
captain-morgan-100-proof.bodyHtml: Legend has it, the pirates of old stored their high proof rum in charred oak casks in order to give it a smooth mellow taste. Today this tradition lives on in Captain Morgan Black Cask 100 Proof Spiced Rum, a secret blend of Caribbean rums and select spices which brings out the intensity of rum in all its original full-flavored glory. A firm favourite with The Captain, it's specially crafted to taste great with cola or as a shot.

dogajolo-bianco.title: Carpineto Dogajolo Bianco Toscana IGT 750ml
dogajolo-bianco.bodyHtml:
Straw yellow with green highlights. Pleasantly fruity, elegantly aromatic and harmonious. Medium body with agreeable acidity and a dry, pleasantly velvety, soft finish.

Excellent as an aperitif or with typical Mediterranean cuisine, such as salads, pasta, seafood and white meats. Excellent also with flavorful, spicy Asian foods.

Blend: 40% Chardonnay, 30% Sauvignon Blanc, 30% Grechetto

henkell-rose.title: Henkell Trocken Rose 750ml
henkell-rose.bodyHtml:
Henkell Trocken Rose 750ml is a dry, sparkling rosé wine. It's known for its refreshing and fruity flavors, with notes of red berries, citrus, and a hint of chocolate, according to LCBO. It's described as having a pale pink color and a delicate, effervescent character. Henkell Trocken Rosé is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed as an aperitif or paired with various foods, including seafood, light desserts, or salty snacks, says the LCBO. 

86 Points - James Suckling
A crisp, dry sparkling rosé with lively notes of red berries and a touch of citrus. Fresh and straightforward, it's a versatile apéritif for casual celebrations.
85 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This Prosecco-style rosé offers simple strawberry and cream notes with a clean, refreshing finish. A reliable and widely available sparkling option.

valdivieso-passion-fruit.title: Passoa Passionfruit Liqueur
valdivieso-passion-fruit.bodyHtml: #1 passion fruit liqueur in the world, made with real passion fruit juice from Brazil. Versatile and easy, Passoa mixes with anything in your fridge – from juices to flavored sodas to ginger ale. Or take it to the next level and add a passion fruit twist to your favorite cocktail from sangria to margarita to mojito.

fullers-london-pride.title: Fuller's London Pride 4 Tall Cans
fullers-london-pride.bodyHtml:
London Pride has a smooth, distinctive malty base, with a rich balance of well developed hop flavours from the Target, Challenger & Northdown varieties and our own unique yeast in the brew.
It takes skill, dedication and time to brew an ale this outstanding. It takes the same to become a lion. Play with pride, share with pride
Roar with pride

barefoot-pinot-noir.title: Barefoot Pink Pinot Grigio NV 750ml
barefoot-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Barefoot Pink Pinot Grigio wine has a crisp and fruity style, full of tart apple, peach and raspberry notes. Rising temperatures call for some refreshment and this pink wine is a delicious choice.

bitch-bubbly.title: R Wines Bitch Bubbly Rose 750ml
bitch-bubbly.bodyHtml: A carbonated pink blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this is a sweet, fruity wine that packs more punch than Bracchetto d'Acqui but is otherwise similar. It's very fragrant and loaded with strawberries and raspberries. All sizes are 750ml unless otherwise stated.

piat-dor-merlot.title: Domaine des Masques Emotion Cab/Merlot
piat-dor-merlot.bodyHtml:
Crafted in the high-altitude hillsides of Provence, France, Domaine des Masques 'Émotion' Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot is an extraordinary, cool-climate red blend created under the winemaking guidance of legendary consultant Michel Rolland. Perched on a plateau 500 meters above sea level at the foot of the iconic Montagne Sainte-Victoire near Aix-en-Provence, Domaine des Masques benefits from a rare alpine-influenced terroir in Provence. The steep, limestone-rich soils combined with dramatic diurnal temperature swings allow Bordeaux varietals—Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot—to ripen slowly, retaining bright natural freshness, fine-grained structural tannins, and intense aromatic clarity. Practicing organic farming standards, the estate hand-harvests low-yielding fruit at optimal phenological maturity. Vinified in temperature-controlled concrete vats with gentle extraction, the wine matures in fine French oak barrels, seamlessly marrying Mediterranean warmth and ripe black fruit density with crisp mountain elegance.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, pan-seared duck breast, venison stew, wild mushroom risotto, coq au vin, and hard French cheeses like aged Comté, Cantal, or Saint-Nectaire.

piat-dor-chardonnay.title: DAOU Chardonnay 2025
piat-dor-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
DAOU Chardonnay 2025 is an expressive, beautifully balanced, and textural California white wine crafted by brothers Georges and Daniel Daou in the hills of Paso Robles. Sourced from premium vineyard sites across the calcareous clay and limestone terroirs of the Central Coast, the grapes benefit from warm daytime sunshine tempered by coastal breezes and dramatic diurnal shifts. Fermented with careful temperature regulation and aged in French oak to marry richness with precision, it reveals a luminous, pale straw-gold hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is fragrant and layered, unfurling with scents of lemon zest, yellow apple, crisp nectarine, and honeysuckle, complemented by subtle nuances of baking spices, toasted hazelnut, and vanilla cream. On the palate, it delivers a medium-bodied, rounded mouthfeel framed by vibrant natural acidity and tropical hints of melon and ripe orchard fruit, finishing clean, polished, and persistent with delicate touches of toasted oak.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops in lemon-butter sauce, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy mushroom risotto, grilled halibut, or mild artisanal triple-cream cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

Quite subtle and restrained with aromas of lemon, yellow apple, melon, baking spice and nectarine. The palate is medium-bodied with a textural, rounded mouthfeel, bright acidity and a generous finish. Fresh and polished with plenty of flavor and balance. Drink now. Screw cap.

bear-flag-red.title: Bear Flag Wines Smooth Red Blend 750ml
bear-flag-red.bodyHtml: Bear Flag Red is a 750ml red wine blend, offering a mix of dark fruit flavors like blackberry and blueberry, with hints of oak and spice. It's described as full-bodied, well-structured, and having a smooth finish. Specific varietals or tasting notes may vary depending on the particular Bear Flag Red blend (e.g., Eureka No. 17, Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfandel). +

bear-flag-white.title: Bear Flag Wines Soft White Blend 750ml
bear-flag-white.bodyHtml: Bear Flag Soft White Blend is a wine that's described as light-bodied and subtly sweet, with a mix of flavors including honey, pear, peach, and melon, according to Vivino and Liquor Lodge. The aroma is described as having tropical fruit, citrus, and honey notes, says Natalie MacLean. It's often recommended to serve well-chilled, notes The Beer Guy.

benriach-10-year.title: Benriach The Smoky Ten 10 Year Old
benriach-10-year.bodyHtml: In the early 1970s, Benriach broke convention in Speyside by returning to distilling batches of whisky in the old, 19th century style, using malted barley smoked with Highland peat. This wood rich Highland peat imparts distinctly sweet and smoky notes into Benriach peated whiskies. Benriach The Smoky Ten has been crafted from a combination of unpeated and peated spirit and three cask matured for at least ten years in a combination of bourbon barrels, Jamaican rum casks and toasted virgin oak. The whisky is then expertly married together to create sublimely smooth layers of sunripe fruit, aromatic smoke and toasted oak spice, lingering into the perfectly balanced sweet and smoky finish.

da-vinci-pinot-grigio.title: Gemma Di Luna Pinot Grigio
da-vinci-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Gemma di Luna Pinot Grigio is a refreshing Italian white wine crafted from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes grown in northeastern Italy's Delle Venezie DOC region. Presented in the brand's distinctive turquoise bottle, this elegant wine showcases delicate aromas of white peach, crisp apple, and fresh citrus. Its light-bodied palate delivers smooth orchard fruit flavours, subtle strawberry notes, and lively acidity, finishing with a refreshing touch of lime zest. Produced without oak influence, it offers a bright, approachable expression of classic Italian Pinot Grigio.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp, fresh oysters, lemon-herb chicken, Caprese salad, seafood pasta, grilled vegetables, and soft mozzarella.

graffigna-pinot-grigio.title: Graffigna Centenario Reserve Pinot Grigio 750ml
graffigna-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Graffigna Pinot Grigio is a 750ml bottle of dry, medium-bodied white wine from San Juan, Argentina. It's characterized by a pale straw yellow color with greenish hues. The aroma features citrus notes, floral nuances, and hints of white peach and apricot. The taste profile includes flavors of citrus, mushrooms, and savory elements, with a balanced acidity. The wine is extra dry and soft with a good finish.

graffigna-malbec.title: Graffigna Malbec 2017 750ml
graffigna-malbec.bodyHtml:
Graffigna Malbec is a bold and expressive red wine from the San Juan region of Argentina, renowned for producing rich and flavorful Malbecs. This wine showcases intense aromas of ripe blackberries, plums, and floral notes, complemented by hints of vanilla and spice from oak aging. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-structured, with smooth tannins and a lingering, velvety finish.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Deep purple with violet hues

  • Aroma: Ripe plum, blackberry, violet, and a touch of spice

  • Palate: Juicy dark fruit, soft tannins, subtle oak, and a balanced finish

  • Finish: Long and smooth, with dark fruit and spice lingering

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled meats, hearty stews, pasta with red sauces, or aged cheeses.

Region: San Juan, Argentina
Alcohol Content: ~13.5%
Producer: Graffigna Wines – Established in 1870, one of Argentina’s oldest wineries

smirnoff-classic-caesar.title: Smirnoff Vodka 1.75L
smirnoff-classic-caesar.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff No. 21 Vodka is a classic, globally recognized vodka originally created in 1864. Renowned for its purity and versatility, it undergoes a rigorous triple distillation process and is filtered ten times through seven columns of environmentally sustainable charcoal. This meticulous production method yields a pristine, neutral, and exceptionally smooth spirit that has become a staple for mixologists worldwide.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with caviar, pickled vegetables, cured charcuterie, and light seafood dishes.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear in appearance, delivering a crisp, clean, and light-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and highly neutral with very faint hints of grain sweetness, subtle black pepper, and light minerality.

Palate : Smooth and neutral with a very subtle touch of sweetness, a hint of charcoal, and light peppery spice.

Finish : Short, crisp, and exceptionally clean.

Serve : Best served well-chilled, neat, over ice, or mixed in classic cocktails such as a Moscow Mule, Bloody Mary, or Vodka Soda.

dr-zenzen-noblesse-rose.title: Dr. Zenzen Noblesse Rose 750ml
dr-zenzen-noblesse-rose.bodyHtml: Intensely perfumed with aromas of rose petals, lychee nuts and super-ripe pineapples. This wine is full bodied, rich, lots of different aromas but not heavy. Still you can taste the finesse of the grape variety

big-house-red.title: Big House Red 750ml
big-house-red.bodyHtml: Big House Red is a medium-bodied, dry red wine from California, featuring notes of blackberries, raspberries, and hints of leather and spices. The palate offers flavors of cranberries, roses, and a touch of rhubarb, with a lingering finish of vanilla and dark cherries. It is generally considered a "house red" style, meaning it's a lower-priced, often unnamed, option served in restaurants.

ogio-primativo.title: Ogio Primitivo Puglia IGT 750ml
ogio-primativo.bodyHtml: Ogio Primitivo is a full-bodied red wine from Puglia, Italy, made from the Primitivo grape. It is known for its rich, fruity, and spiced flavors, often featuring notes of blackberries, black cherries, and pepper. The wine is generally dry, with a sugar content of 0-5 g/L.

glen-garioch-12-year.title: The Whisky Agency Glen Garioch 2009 12 Year Old 53.2% ABV
glen-garioch-12-year.bodyHtml:
Glen Garioch 2009 12 Year Old is a Highland single malt distilled at Glen Garioch in 2009 and bottled in 2021 by the independent bottler The Whisky Agency. Drawn from a single ex-bourbon barrel, it was bottled at natural cask strength of 53.2% ABV, with natural colour and without chill filtration, giving an unadulterated look at the distillery's spirit. The label features one of the bottler's illustrated designs, a red stag. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

big-house-octavin-red.title: Big House Octavin Red 3L Bag in Box
big-house-octavin-red.bodyHtml: The Big House Octavin Red is a 3-liter Bag in Box red wine that offers a fruity and spicy experience. It is known for its aromas of blackberries and raspberries, with hints of leather and spices. The palate showcases flavors like cranberries and roses, with a clean and slightly spicy finish. This particular Big House Red is often described as a medium-bodied, dry, and fruity wine with notes of blackberry and cassis. It's not your typical Cabernet, aiming for a unique flavor profile, says Applejack Wine & Spirits. Everything Wine notes that the Big House Red lives up to its old Fruit Bomb moniker.

delirium-nocturnum.title: Delirium Nocturnum 330ml
delirium-nocturnum.bodyHtml: Delirium Nocturnum is a dark, complex Belgian Strong Ale. It boasts a rich, malty base with notes of caramel, chocolate, and dark fruit, along with a hint of spice and mild bitterness. The beer is brewed by Huyghe Brewery in Belgium and comes in a 330ml bottle.

las-mulas-organic-sauvigon-blanc.title: Las Mulas Organic Sauvigon Blanc 750ml
las-mulas-organic-sauvigon-blanc.bodyHtml: Las Mulas Organic Sauvignon Blanc is a white wine from Chile's Central Valley, known for its pale yellow color and aromas of ripe tropical fruits and citrus. It's a silky, crisp wine with a long finish, thanks to its balanced acidity. The "Las Mulas" name pays homage to the mules used in the organic farming process.

las-mulas-organic-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Miguel Torres Las Mulas Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 750ml
las-mulas-organic-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2021 vintage) "If wines could have personalities, this one’s could be characterized as “friendly” and “jovial,” because it is a very easy-drinking Cabernet without all the bells and whistles. Which is good enough for the price. A mix of red berries and cranberries, a little tart, but still rounded with a floral finish. It was made with organically grown grapes. 89 Roger Morris" - 89/100, Wine Review Online

double-decker-red.title: Double Decker Red 750ml
double-decker-red.bodyHtml: The Double Decker Red, a 750ml red wine blend, is characterized by a robust and smooth flavor profile. It is made from Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Sirah, and Barbera grapes, resulting in notes of blackberry, black cherry, and plum. The wine exhibits a smooth, spicy finish and is described as adventurously robust.

1921-anejo.title: 1921 Anejo Tequila
1921-anejo.bodyHtml:
Crafted from 100% Weber Blue Agave harvested in Jalisco. Double-distilled and aged for 12 months in toasted white oak barrels, this expression offers an exceptionally smooth, complex profile that balances sweet agave with rich notes of fruit, honey, and wood.

Food Pairing: Ribeye steak, cochinita pibil, aged Manchego cheese, dark chocolate, and roasted pork.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-yellow hue with copper shades and a smooth, silky medium body.

Nose : Sweet honey, vanilla, fruit, subtle citrus, and roasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and rich with dried fruit, butterscotch, sweet agave, caramel, and gentle wood spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and velvety with a gentle fade of pepper, ginger, and toasted wood.

Serve : Served neat at room temperature in a snifter or cognac glass to fully appreciate its aromas.

cardinal-zinfandel.title: Seghesio Sonoma Zinfandel 2023
cardinal-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Seghesio Sonoma Zinfandel 2023 is a beautifully classic, vibrant, and energetic red wine that serves as a definitive benchmark for high-quality, authentic Sonoma Zinfandel. Sourced from a carefully curated selection of prime, family-farmed vineyards across the region, this cooler-vintage expression captures the true essence of the varietal's lively fruit character. In the glass, it presents a deep crimson-ruby hue with brilliant clarity. The highly inviting nose bursts with an alluring bouquet of ripe red raspberries, dark Santa Rosa plums, and fresh wild blackberries, closely interwoven with delicate nuances of spiced cherry, chocolate malt, lavender, and a grind of warm black pepper. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red delivers immediate pleasure, driving a juicy, succulent core of concentrated wild berry compote, licorice, and savory anise across a smooth, seamless texture. Punctuated by a vitalizing line of fresh natural acidity that keeps the generous alcohol beautifully balanced, it finishes with great precision, leaving a lingering, satisfying trace of silky, supple tannins and sweet baking spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with backyard barbecue pork spare ribs, gourmet grilled cheeseburgers, wood-fired supreme pizza, or a rich gnocchi gorgonzola.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Bright and lively aromas of spiced cherry, chocolate malt, and purple flowers swirl on the nose of this Zin. The palate gives floral freshness with zippy acid and flavors of berry concentrate, plum compote, cinnamon, and lavender lingering through the finale.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Zesty and approachable, with wild berry, licorice and roasted herb flavors that end with perky tannins.

cupcake-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Cupcake Red Velvet 750ml
cupcake-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Cupcake Vineyards Red Velvet is a rich red wine blend, primarily sourced from California. It's known for its notes of chocolate, blackberry, and red fruit, with a creamy mocha finish. It pairs well with a variety of foods, including steak, cheeseburgers, and even s'mores.

hennessy-vs-very-special-black.title: Hennessy VS Cognac 375ml
hennessy-vs-very-special-black.bodyHtml:
Hennessy Very Special (V.S) is one of the most popular cognacs in the world. Matured in new oak barrels, Hennessy V.S is bold and fragrant. Its beguiling character is uniquely Hennessy, a timeless choice with an intensity all its own. Hennessy V.S offers toasted and fruit notes, with a rich, clearly defined palate and a welcoming exuberance.

Hennessy V.S expresses its vibrant and dynamic personality through unique artist partnerships and annual limited editions. Easy to enjoy, it’s a perfect cognac for high-energy occasions and sharing the moment.

The round and robust flavours of Hennessy V.S make it very versatile and ideal for any cocktail possibility, from classic recipes and sophisticated cocktail creations to easy mixed drinks.

ruffino-modus.title: Ruffino Modus Toscana 2021
ruffino-modus.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Ruffino Modus is a rich and contemporary "Super Tuscan" that artfully blends the elegance of Sangiovese with the structure of Cabernet Sauvignon and the plushness of Merlot. This vintage is characterized by its intense, deep ruby red colour and a complex bouquet of mature black cherries, plums, and blackberries, seamlessly integrated with sophisticated notes of cinnamon, cloves, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and opulent, featuring silky, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that maintains balance despite its power. The finish is long and persistent, showcasing refined layers of dark fruit and toasted oak. It is a highly versatile and age-worthy red that pairs excellently with steak, herb-crusted lamb, or aged Pecorino.

93 Points - James Suckling

Deep dark berry aromas with hints of violets, cedar and licorice, following through to a medium- to full-bodied palate with polished, almost silky tannins and layers of delicious fruit. Refined and lingering, with flavors of graphite and black olives. Drink or hold.
90 Points - Wine Spectator
A rich, densely textured red, boasting black currant, black cherry, blackberry, cedar, iron, tobacco and spice aromas and flavors. Starts out supple, gaining traction with dense tannins by the lengthy finish. Sangiovese, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. Drink now through 2033.

ned-pinot-noir.title: Meiomi Pinot Noir 2022/2023
ned-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Meiomi Pinot Noir 2023 is a deeply concentrated, intensely jammy, and unapologetically bold California red wine that breaks away from traditional delicate profiles in favor of pure, opulent fruit power. It floods the glass with a dark ruby-crimson hue, giving off an expressive and rich bouquet of macerated boysenberries, dark cherry cola, and strawberry jam, heavily layered with fragrant notes of sweet vanilla bean, mocha, and toasted graham cracker. On the palate, it behaves with a velvety, full-bodied weight, coating the mouth with plush, sweet-toned intensities of dark bramble fruits, mocha powder, and a soft, supple texture that defines this intensely warm and ripe 2023 vintage. Devoid of any aggressive tannins and structured with gentle, low acidity, it glides effortlessly into a smooth, decadent finish that leaves a long, lingering signature of brown sugar and sweet oak spice.

Food Pairing: This rich, fruit-forward style pairs excellently with smoky or slightly sweet savory dishes, including slow-cooked barbecued pulled pork sliders, wood-fired Peking duck pizzas, teriyaki-glazed salmon, gourmet lamb burgers with goat cheese, and standard charcuterie boards stacked with mild gouda or cured meats.

chandon-blanc-de-noirs.title: Champagne Monmarthe Blanc de Noirs
chandon-blanc-de-noirs.bodyHtml:
This expressive Blanc de Noirs Champagne shows aromas of ripe apple, pear, red berries, toasted brioche, hazelnut, and subtle chalky minerality. Rich yet finely balanced, the palate delivers a creamy mousse, vibrant acidity, and layered complexity, finishing long, structured, and elegantly dry with Pinot-driven intensity.

Food Pairing: Roast chicken, duck breast, charcuterie, grilled scallops, mushroom dishes, aged cheeses, and sushi.

chandon-brut-classic.title: Moet & Chandon Imperial Brut
chandon-brut-classic.bodyHtml:
An elegant golden straw yellow with amber highlights. Its aromas are radiant, revealing bright yellow-fleshed fruits (apple, pear, yellow peach), honey, floral nuances (lime blossom) and elegant blond notes (brioche and fresh nuts). The palate is seductive, richly flavorful and smooth combining generosity and subtlety, fullness and vigor, followed by a delicately fresh crispiness (fruit with seeds), to reveal the magical balance of Champagne.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant version, fine and creamy in texture and backed by lively, orange peel acidity. A streak of smoke-tinged minerality underscores flavors of almond madeleine, poached pear, anise and preserved lemon. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Champagne gets better and better. It has a fine dryness with a crisp apple and citrus character. That goes with the touches of maturity that give the wine fine balance.

90 Points - James Suckling

Nicely complex aromas here, from dried apples, peaches and pears to candied citrus and brioche. It’s fruity, soft and rounded on the palate. Medium-bodied, lightly honeyed and balanced. Blend of pinot noir, pinot meunier and chardonnay.

ravenswood-teldeschi-zinfandel.title: Ravenswood Teldeschi Vineyard Zinfandel 750ml
ravenswood-teldeschi-zinfandel.bodyHtml: Ravenswood Teldeschi Vineyard Zinfandel, a 750ml bottle, is a Zinfandel wine from Sonoma County, California. It is known for its bold and jammy fruit profile, often featuring notes of wild blackberry, black plum, raspberry, and cherry, along with hints of spice, chocolate, and black pepper. The wine is medium to full-bodied, with a silky palate.

beringer-main-vine-moscato.title: Beringer Main & Vine Moscato 750ml
beringer-main-vine-moscato.bodyHtml: Something fruity and satisfying, this one hits all the right notes. Peach-scented, honeysuckle aromas. Fresh, sweet flavors of juicy stone fruit, honeydew melon, Fuji apple and ripe pear. One of our signature wines, this one is an easy-sipping delight.

copper-moon-rose.title: Copper Moon 'Moonlight Harvest' Rose 750ml
copper-moon-rose.bodyHtml: Copper Moon "Moonlight Harvest" Rosé is a light-bodied, off-dry wine with a refreshing profile. It's known for its bright red fruit notes like red berries, watermelon, and cherry, with some tasting notes also mentioning peach and rose petals. It's a popular choice for those who enjoy slightly sweet, easy-drinking wines.

lindemans-bin-90-moscato.title: Lindemans Bin 90 Moscato 750ml
lindemans-bin-90-moscato.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2010 vintage) "This is a frankly sweet, dessert style of still Moscato. It's modest in alcohol, offering up notes of oranges, melons and honey that are reasonably balanced on the finish. The price makes it a bargain." - 85/100, Wine Enthusiast

barefoot-sweet-red.title: Barefoot Red Moscato
barefoot-sweet-red.bodyHtml:
A vibrant, delightfully sweet red wine bursting with juicy flavors of ripe raspberry, fresh cherry, and sweet citrus. It combines a luscious, fruit-forward profile with subtle floral aromas and a soft, smooth finish featuring a touch of lively fizz.

Food Pairing: Pairs with spicy barbecue wings, rich chocolate desserts, fresh fruit tarts, or a variety of mild cheeses and cured meats.

barefoot-sweet-riesling.title: Barefoot Riesling 750ml
barefoot-sweet-riesling.bodyHtml: Barefoot California Riesling is 'Refreshingly Sweet', un-oaked and highly expressive with juicy tree fruit complemented by a rich honey mid-palate, hint of crisp acidity and a bit of vibrancy. Like the other Barefoot varieties, this wine is fruit forward, varietally correct and food friendly.

dreamng-tree-crush.title: Dreaming Tree Crush Red 2021/2022 750ml
dreamng-tree-crush.bodyHtml:
The Dreaming Tree Crush Red Blend is a 750ml red wine made with a blend of California North Coast grapes, including Merlot, Petite Sirah, Zinfandel, and Tannat. It has a full body and a soft, long finish, with flavors of juicy raspberries and jammy dark cherry. The wine is known for its versatility, pairing well with both red meats and vegetarian dishes like stuffed poblano peppers. It's also a favorite for sharing with friends and enjoying with conversations. The Dreaming Tree Crush is a collaboration between musician Dave Matthews and winemaker Sean McKenzie, reflecting their shared passion for creating accessible and quality wines. 

89 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This accessible and fruit-forward red blend presents an inviting nose of ripe blackberries, raspberry jam, and a subtle hint of mocha. On the palate, it is soft and rounded with very approachable tannins and a smooth, supple texture that makes it incredibly easy to drink. The finish is lush and fruit-driven, leaving a pleasant impression of dark cherries and a touch of vanilla, crafted for immediate enjoyment and casual occasions.
88 Points - James Suckling
A crowd-pleasing blend that delivers juicy, forward fruit flavors of plum and black cherry, accented by a light dusting of cocoa. The mouthfeel is plush and velvety, with minimal tannic grip, leading to a straightforward and satisfying finish. It's a consistently reliable and uncomplicated wine that pairs effortlessly with a wide range of foods or stands alone as an easy-going sipper.

h3-merlot.title: H3 Horse Heaven Hills Merlot 2021 750ml
h3-merlot.bodyHtml: H3 Merlot is a red wine with a medium body, showcasing flavors of spice, plum, and blackberry. It also features a balance of earthy, cocoa, and ripe black cherry notes, followed by a smooth, velvety finish. This wine is well-suited for pairing with grilled salmon, roasted lamb, wild game, and tomato-based sauces.

h3-cabernet.title: Treana Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
h3-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Treana Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, expressive, and full-bodied California red wine produced by Hope Family Wines in Paso Robles. Visually displaying a deep dark ruby color, it opens with an inviting and fruit-forward bouquet of cassis, ripe dark plum, and blackberry, seamlessly layered with notes of sweet vanilla, toasted oak, roasted coffee, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a plush, velvety mouthfeel with generous dark fruit flavors framed by rounded tannins and balanced acidity, leading into a smooth, lingering, and decadent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, barbecued pork ribs, braised beef short ribs, venison, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

naked-grape-moscato.title: Naked Grape Merlot 750ml
naked-grape-moscato.bodyHtml:
Naked Grape Merlot is a smooth and approachable red wine, offering rich fruit flavors balanced with soft tannins, making it perfect for casual sipping or pairing with a variety of dishes.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Deep ruby red with a vibrant and inviting appearance.

  • Aromas: Enticing scents of black cherry, plum, and a hint of vanilla from oak aging.

  • Palate: Smooth and velvety, with flavors of ripe red fruit, including blackberry and cherry, complemented by subtle hints of oak and spice. The finish is soft, with a well-rounded mouthfeel.

Wine Profile:

  • Region: California, USA

  • Varietal: Merlot

  • Alcohol: Approx. 13.5%

  • Bottle Size: 750ml

Food Pairing:

Perfect for pairing with grilled meats, pasta dishes with red sauce, roast chicken, and cheeses like cheddar or brie.

Naked Grape Merlot is a versatile and easy-to-enjoy red wine, great for everyday occasions, casual meals, or even a quiet evening of relaxation. Its smooth character makes it a crowd-pleaser at gatherings or dinners.

canadian-club-ginger.title: Canadian Club & Ginger Ale 4 x 355ml
canadian-club-ginger.bodyHtml:
Canadian Club & Ginger Ale is a ready-to-drink highball that pairs Canadian Club whisky with ginger ale, sold here as a four-pack of 355ml cans. Canadian Club and ginger ale both date to around the 1850s, which makes this an old pairing. The pre-mix brings together the smooth, honeyed grain and spice of Canadian Club whisky and the sweet, candied character of ginger ale. In the glass it is golden amber with foamy carbonation, subtle ginger and sweet rye on the nose, and preserved ginger, rye and spice on the palate before a ginger-ale-like finish. Each can is 5% ABV. Canadian Club suggests it with saucy barbecued ribs or spicy curries.

Food Pairing: Saucy barbecued ribs or spicy curries.

Tasting Notes: Golden amber with foamy carbonation, well balanced and sweet.

Nose: Subtle ginger and sweet rye, with grain and spicy wood.

Palate: Preserved ginger with subtle rye and spice.

Finish: Sweet, with a ginger ale character.

Serve: Well chilled, straight from the can or over ice with a lime wedge.

chandon-rose.title: Moet & Chandon Grand Vintage Collection 1999 750ml
chandon-rose.bodyHtml:
Each Grand Vintage is unique, expressing the Moët & Chandon Cellar Master's personal interpretation of the year. In Champagne, 1999 was the culmination of contrasting and often unseasonable weather.

Grand Vintage Collection 1999 is the culmination of a contrasting and unseasonable year with a hot and dry summer. It exalts the depth and character of an almost euphoric harvest, the unforgettable story of a captivating twilight. The 66th vintage in the history of the House.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Moët's style, with its delicious forward fruit, is well evidenced in this 1999 vintage. It is full bodied, with apple and almond flavors, developing a toasty character, but still retaining a ripe, open freshness.

shinas-estate-the-guilty-shiraz.title: Shinas Estate The Guilty Shiraz 2021
shinas-estate-the-guilty-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Shinas Estate The Guilty Shiraz 2021 is a full-bodied, intensely rich red wine originating from the Mildura region in northwest Victoria, Australia. Crafted from low-yielding, premium vineyards with some vines dating back as far as 1898, this wine boasts a deep, inky purple and shiny blackberry red hue. The aromatic bouquet bursts with voluptuous aromas of dark cherry, dense plum, warm vanilla, and a kick of peppery spice. On the palate, it delivers a generous, velvety smooth core of ripe strawberries, dark cherries, and luscious chocolate mocha, beautifully layered with smoky vanilla oak. Juicy, bold tannins and a lively acidity structure the mouthfeel, driving to a powerful, fruit-forward finish that lingers with a welcome reappearance of spice and pepper.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with robust, savory dishes such as grilled ribeye steaks, slow-braised beef short ribs, hearty venison stews, and roasted lamb chops.

okanagan-white-grape.title: Tinhorn Creek Pinot Gris VQA
okanagan-white-grape.bodyHtml:
Tinhorn Creek Pinot Gris VQA is a vibrant, refreshing, and highly approachable white wine from one of British Columbia's most celebrated estates, located in the beautiful Golden Mile Bench of the Okanagan Valley. Crafted with meticulous care and cool-fermented in stainless steel to preserve the grape's pure characteristics, this Canadian wine displays a pale straw-yellow hue in the glass. The inviting aromatic bouquet opens with lively notes of ripe Anjou pear, honeydew melon, and white peach, elegantly layered with subtle hints of Meyer lemon, fresh citrus blossom, and a delicate touch of honey. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, crisp, and beautifully focused, delivering a generous core of fresh orchard and soft tropical fruit. This juicy, fruit-forward profile is perfectly balanced by a bright, mouthwatering acidity and an underlying clean minerality, culminating in a snappy, refreshing, and highly versatile finish that makes it a perfect everyday sipper.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with freshly shucked oysters, lightly grilled halibut, fresh green salads, creamy lemon-herb chicken, and soft cheeses like fresh goat cheese.

gauchezco-estate-malbec.title: Gauchezco Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
gauchezco-estate-malbec.bodyHtml: The Gauchezco Estate Cabernet Sauvignon is a wine characterized by its deep ruby red color, complex aromas of ripe fruits like cherries and plums with hints of cassis, and a long, elegant finish. It is a well-rounded wine, often described as having a persistent, well-rounded character. The wine pairs well with red meats, spicy dishes, and ripe cheeses. The recommended serving temperature is 60°F – 64°F (16°C – 18°C).

maisels-weisse-original.title: Maisel's Weisse Original 6 Bottles
maisels-weisse-original.bodyHtml: Maisel's Weisse Original is a Bavarian-style wheat beer characterized by its fruity and spicy notes. It's brewed with wheat malt and has a cloudy, orange appearance with a creamy white head. The aroma combines dried fruits, banana, and spices like nutmeg and cloves, influenced by the yeast and hops. On the palate, it's sweet and creamy with a slight acidity.

gauchezco-estate-torrentes.title: Gauchezco Estate Torrentes
gauchezco-estate-torrentes.bodyHtml:
Gauchezco Estate Torrontés is a vibrant, aromatic white wine from the high-altitude vineyards of Cafayate in Argentina's Salta Province. Crafted from 100% Torrontés grown approximately 1,700 metres above sea level, this refreshing wine showcases fragrant white flowers, jasmine, peach, and citrus. Fermented at controlled temperatures and matured on fine lees in stainless steel, it develops a smooth texture while retaining lively acidity. Its bright, floral character and clean, persistent finish make it an excellent choice for seafood and aromatic cuisine.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp, fresh seafood, Thai curry, sushi, spicy Asian dishes, ceviche, light salads, goat cheese, and grilled white fish.

frontera-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Frontera Cabernet Sauvignon
frontera-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Frontera Cabernet Sauvignon is a highly approachable, vibrant, and fruit-forward Chilean red wine produced by the globally renowned Concha y Toro estate. Sourced from the sun-drenched, alluvial soils of the Central Valley, this everyday-drinking wine beautifully captures the authentic and friendly character of classic Chilean Cabernet. In the glass, it reveals a bright ruby-red hue. The aromatic bouquet is inviting and generous, opening with appealing notes of ripe black cherries, red plums, and fresh blackberries, elegantly layered with subtle hints of sweet vanilla, dark chocolate, and a touch of mild baking spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, juicy, and exceptionally smooth, delivering a satisfying core of dark fruit flavors that are beautifully balanced by gentle, well-integrated tannins. A lively natural acidity carries this highly versatile profile through to a clean, lingering, and fruit-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic grilled hamburgers, hearty beef stews, flavorful pasta in rich tomato sauces, mildly spiced casseroles, and medium-aged cheeses.

el-dorado-5-year.title: El Dorado 5 Year Old Rum
el-dorado-5-year.bodyHtml:
El Dorado 5 Year Old is a blended Demerara rum from Demerara Distillers in Guyana, presented here in a 750ml bottle. Like the rest of the El Dorado blended range, it is built from batches of rum made on the distillery's different stills and then aged in oak barrels, in this case for at least five years. The producer credits this time in wood with giving the rum real depth and dimension. The producer suggests enjoying it straight or on the rocks, and also uses it as the base of its El Dorado Swizzle with lime, passion fruit and mango. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

Nose: Dried tropical fruit with caramel, butterscotch and molasses.

Palate: A lively, spicy entry opening into fruit, caramel and toasted coconut.

Finish: Fades with a warm, vanilla-tinged glow.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or in a rum swizzle.

revel-stoke-canadian-whisky.title: Revel Stoke Nut Crusher Peanut Butter Whisky
revel-stoke-canadian-whisky.bodyHtml:
Revel Stoke Nut Crusher is a peanut butter flavoured Canadian whisky, bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It pairs buttery, nutty peanut butter notes with the mild spice of Canadian whisky, and the brand pitches it with a nod to the classic peanut butter and jelly combination. Light in strength and sweet in style, it is made for easy shots and simple mixed drinks rather than serious sipping.

Tasting Notes: Buttery, nutty peanut butter with mild whisky spice.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, over ice, or with a mixer.

fontanafredda-gavi-di-gavi-piedmont.title: Fontanafredda Gavi di Gavi 2023
fontanafredda-gavi-di-gavi-piedmont.bodyHtml:
Ample nose, with an intense bouquet featuring floral notes, vanilla, lemon and apples. On the palate, dry, full-bodied, well-balanced and elegant.

90 Points - James Suckling

A clean and fresh white that has notes of chopped apples, almonds and lemon rind. It’s medium-bodied, creamy and balanced.

robert-mondavi-ps-pinot-grigio.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
robert-mondavi-ps-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

original16-canadian-copper-ale.title: Original 16 Copper 15 Cans
original16-canadian-copper-ale.bodyHtml: A smooth and refreshing beer brewed with 100% two-row Prairie barley, a blend of roasted black and caramel malts, and five hop varietals

wolf-blass-gold-label-shiraz.title: Wolf Blass Gold Label Regional Reserve Shiraz 2018 750ml
wolf-blass-gold-label-shiraz.bodyHtml:
An intense and complex mix of blue fruits and dark red plums, with a hint of spice and delicate, well-integrated oak notes.

Blue fruits continue through to a rich, well-balanced palate with a plush mouthfeel, bright fruit flavours, and a long, even finish.

growers-strawberry-rhubarb.title: Growers Strawberry Rhubarb 2L
growers-strawberry-rhubarb.bodyHtml: The "Growers Strawberry Rhubarb" is a fruit beverage that combines the sweet taste of ripe strawberries with the tart flavor of rhubarb, according to Save-On-Foods and Wine and Beyond. It's available in a 2-liter bottle. Saskatoon Co-op Liquor and Manitoba Liquor Mart also offer it as a cider, adding tart notes to the overall taste.

montecchiesi-preziosaterra-sangiovese.title: Montecchiesi Preziosaterra Sangiovese 750ml
montecchiesi-preziosaterra-sangiovese.bodyHtml: Montecchiesi Preziosaterra Sangiovese, a 750ml bottle of Italian red wine, is described as vibrantly fruity with a distinctive Sangiovese character. It features flavors of sour cherries and raspberries, subtly spiced. This wine is made from Sangiovese grapes, known for high acidity and firm tannins, offering a dry, yet flavorful experience with notes of ripe cherries and red berries.

ballard-lane-chardonnay.title: Ballard Lane Pinot Noir 750ml
ballard-lane-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Ballard Lane Pinot Noir is a California red wine known for its fruit-forward character, with notes of red cherries, strawberry shortcake, and baking spice. It typically has a medium-bodied palate with soft tannins and balanced acidity. The wine offers a vibrant, expressive flavor profile with aromas of melon, lemon, and lime.

ballard-lane-pinot-noir.title: Ballard Lane Pinot Noir 750ml
ballard-lane-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Ballard Lane Pinot Noir is a California red wine known for its fruit-forward character, with notes of red cherries, strawberry shortcake, and baking spice. It typically has a medium-bodied palate with soft tannins and balanced acidity. The wine offers a vibrant, expressive flavor profile with aromas of melon, lemon, and lime.

ballard-lane-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Ballard Lane Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
ballard-lane-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Aromas of black cherry, cedar spice, slight toffee and toasted oak. On the plate, it is ripe and succulent with a caramelized sweetness and complemented by the presence of oak. Medium-bodied framed by smooth and chewy tannins. 

Pairs well with a BBQ hamburger with aged cheddar or gouda cheese topped with caramelized onions. Serve with a side of grilled mushrooms or coleslaw.

dab-maibock.title: Dab Maibock 500ml
dab-maibock.bodyHtml:
DAB Maibock 500ml is a traditional German Heller Bock (pale bock) brewed by Dortmunder Actien-Brauerei to celebrate the arrival of spring. Brewed in strict accordance with the German Purity Law of 1516 (Reinheitsgebot), this strong, bottom-fermented lager boasts an elevated alcohol content yet remains incredibly smooth and approachable. It features a rich, robust malt backbone that delivers deep bready and toasty characteristics, beautifully balanced by a crisp, delicate noble hop profile. The result is a bold yet highly refreshing seasonal lager that exemplifies classic Dortmund brewing expertise.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork knuckles (Schweinshaxe), traditional German bratwurst, soft baked pretzels with mustard, hearty meat stews, and rich, semi-hard cheeses like Gouda or Emmentaler.

Tasting Notes : Rich, clear golden-amber in appearance with a persistent frothy white head. It delivers a smooth, medium-bodied, and highly drinkable mouthfeel that effortlessly balances its elevated alcohol content.

Nose : A malt-forward and highly inviting aroma featuring warm sourdough bread dough, sweet grain, and lightly toasted biscuit, followed by a delicate, earthy hop presence.

Palate : Smooth and distinctly malt-driven, leading with rich flavors of sweet bread dough, warm biscuit, and subtle caramel sweetness. A measured, moderate hop bitterness (around 25 IBU) provides excellent structure, accompanied by a very faint, pleasant pear-like fruitiness mid-palate.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and moderately dry, remaining true to its bottom-fermented lager heritage while leaving a balanced, lingering impression of sweet bready malt and mild earthy hops.

Serve : Serve well-chilled (around 45–50°F / 7–10°C) in a traditional glass Pokal, tulip glass, or dimpled beer mug to fully concentrate its bready aromatics.

royal-lochnagar-12-year.title: Royal Lochnagar 12 Year Old
royal-lochnagar-12-year.bodyHtml:
Royal Lochnagar 12 Year Old is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky from the Royal Lochnagar distillery at Crathie, near Ballater in Aberdeenshire, bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle. The distillery was established in 1845 beside the Balmoral estate and took its royal title after a visit from Queen Victoria and Prince Albert; it remains one of the smallest distilleries in Scotland. Its malt was once a key component of the VAT 69 blend, although most of the production is now bottled as single malt. The label describes a sweetly perfumed, subtle and woody Highland malt with a lingering sandalwood finish.

Nose: Soft floral heather and light honey with fresh orchard fruit.

Palate: Sweet cereal, caramel and gentle spice with a faint, warming smokiness.

Finish: Medium and delicately drying, with sweet malt and a hint of wood spice.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

screw-it-merlot.title: Screw It! Shiraz 4L Bag In Box

screw-it-pinot-grigio.title: Screw It! Pinot Grigio 4L Bag in Box
screw-it-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: The Screw It! Pinot Grigio is a 4-liter bag-in-box (BIB) format wine, offering a refreshing and light-bodied white wine experience. It is known for its crisp and dry taste with notes of citrus, apple, and peach. The wine is made from Pinot Grigio grapes and is typically light-bodied, with a refreshing finish. It's a great option for casual gatherings, picnics, or pairing with lighter meals like salads, seafood, or pan-seared dishes.

screw-it-shiraz.title: Screw It! Shiraz 4L Bag In Box

peller-estates-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Peller Family Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 4L Bag in Box
peller-estates-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: The Cabernet Sauvignon is a medium-bodied, juicy, fruit-forward wine with flavours of black cherry and blackberry

gretzky-chardonnay.title: Wayne Gretzky Estates Chardonnay 2021
gretzky-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Wayne Gretzky Estates Chardonnay 2021 pours a clear and bright straw yellow hue in the glass. The highly expressive, fruit-forward bouquet opens with appealing aromas of red apple, ripe Bartlett pear, and fresh pineapple, gracefully layered with delicate nuances of sweet baking spices, custard, and subtly integrated toasty oak. On the palate, this medium-bodied white wine delivers a smooth, slightly rich, and remarkably refreshing mouthfeel. A concentrated core of ripe tree fruits and juicy citrus unfolds across the palate, beautifully balanced by a clean line of crisp natural acidity. Having been barrel fermented and aged sur lie for 12 months in French oak barrels, its well-rounded texture carries persistent notes of orchard fruit, vanilla, and gentle spice into a dry, lingering finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with roasted chicken, herb-stuffed pork roast, smoked salmon risotto, cedar-plank salmon, or a creamy brie cheese served on fresh baguette.

gretzky-merlot.title: Wayne Gretzky Signature Cabernet Merlot
gretzky-merlot.bodyHtml:
Wayne Gretzky Signature Cabernet Merlot is an Ontario red blend combining Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Cabernet Franc. It offers currant, black cherry, dark berries, smoky oak, tobacco, coffee, and sweet spice, with medium-full body, soft tannins, balanced acidity, and a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled beef, rack of lamb, wild game, mushroom stew, sautéed mushrooms, aged cheddar, and dark chocolate.

wee-angus-merlot.title: Wee Angus Merlot
wee-angus-merlot.bodyHtml:
Wee Angus Merlot is a vibrant and juicy expression of Australian Merlot crafted by the Aberdeen Wine Company under their renowned Angus the Bull label. Sourced from premium vineyards across Central Victoria, this wine was explicitly designed to be a supple, fruit-forward companion to red meats. In the glass, it pours a deep crimson color with bright purple hues. The nose is highly inviting, offering lively aromas of ripe black plums, boysenberry, and dark cherries, elegantly layered with subtle hints of fresh mint, toasty oak, and a touch of savory earthiness. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, plush, and generous. It delivers a rich core of dark berry fruit flavors that are beautifully framed by fine, supple tannins and a fresh, balancing acidity, culminating in a smooth, satisfying, and highly approachable finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with gourmet beef burgers, slow-cooked lamb stews, grilled veal chops, robust barbecued meats, and sharp, mature cheddar cheeses.

rodney-strong-sonoma-merlot.title: Rodney Strong Sonoma Merlot 2021
rodney-strong-sonoma-merlot.bodyHtml:
Rodney Strong Sonoma County Merlot is a smooth California red blend led by Merlot. It offers black cherry, boysenberry, cassis, toasted oak, and spice, with a medium-bodied palate, lush tannins, balanced acidity, generous dark fruit, and a lively finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled pork chops, lamb shanks, short rib ragu, roasted beef, burgers, mushrooms, creamy polenta, and aged cheeses.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Drenched in black fruits and dark spices, this velvety, mouthfilling wine wows the palate with rich blackberries, black currants and cedar notes, wrapped in noticeable, shaping tannins. One of the more structured Merlots, it will pair with food by Cabernet standards. Best from 2025.

our-daily-red.title: Our Daily Organic Red Blend 750ml
our-daily-red.bodyHtml: Our Daily Red is a light-bodied, fruit-forward red blend described as having notes of fresh raspberry and juicy cherry, with a hint of violets on the nose. It is made without added sulfites and is described as light, vibrant, and elegant. It's often paired with dishes like ragu alla Bolognese, hearty vegetable stew, or creamy polenta with mushrooms.

19-crimes-shiraz-grenache-mataro.title: 19 Crimes Shiraz Grenache Mataro 2021 750ml
19-crimes-shiraz-grenache-mataro.bodyHtml: The 19 Crimes Red Blend 750ml is a full-bodied Australian red wine known for its bold, juicy flavors and smooth, velvety finish. It's a blend of Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Grenache, offering a rich experience with notes of ripe blackberries, plums, and sweet spices.

lonetree-cranberry-apple.title: Lonetree Cranberry Apple 6 Cans
lonetree-cranberry-apple.bodyHtml: Lonetree Cranberry Apple Cider is a 6-can pack of a crisp, dry cider made with a blend of old-world and fresh table apples, and a 15% addition of real BC cranberries. It's a naturally gluten-free cider, offering a refreshing and natural alternative to beers and coolers. The cider is made by a 100% Canadian-owned company, using traditional methods to ensure a high-quality, authentic cider.

patron-mixed-case.title: Patron Tequila Mixed Case 12 x 750ml
patron-mixed-case.bodyHtml: A Patrón Mixed Case 750ml refers to a selection of Patrón Tequila products, usually containing a variety of expressions like Silver, Reposado, Añejo, and potentially limited edition bottlings, each in a 750ml bottle. These expressions differ in their aging process and flavor profiles, offering a range of tasting experiences.

anna-de-codorniu-rose.title: Anna De Codorniu Rose
anna-de-codorniu-rose.bodyHtml:
Anna De Codorníu Rosé is an elegant, modern sparkling wine that combines a stylish contemporary presentation with centuries of Cava winemaking heritage. Displaying a delicate cherry-pink hue with fine, persistent bubbles, it opens with enticing aromas of fresh red fruits, wild strawberries, cherries, and woodland berries accented by notes of crisp green apple. On the palate, the wine is light, elegant, and harmonious, offering a refreshing balance between vibrant acidity and subtle sweetness that leads to a clean, uplifting finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with tapas, fresh sushi, salmon carpaccio, grilled prawns, light pasta dishes, or berry-based desserts.

black-cellar-malbec-merlot.title: Black Cellar Malbec Merlot 750ml
black-cellar-malbec-merlot.bodyHtml: Black Cellar Malbec Merlot is a Canadian red wine blend known for its smooth, full-flavored profile with aromas and flavors of sweet cherry, blueberry, and spice. The winemaker experimented with 13 different blends to achieve the final, balanced combination.

black-cellar-pinot-grigio-chardonnay.title: Black Cellar Pinot Grigio Chardonnay
black-cellar-pinot-grigio-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Black Cellar Pinot Grigio Chardonnay 750ml is a refreshing and approachable Canadian white wine that combines the crisp, lively character of Pinot Grigio with the smooth, fruit-forward richness of Chardonnay. This delightful blend offers a harmonious balance of fresh orchard fruits, citrus, and subtle tropical flavours, creating a light and enjoyable drinking experience. Its refreshing acidity, soft texture, and clean finish make it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, summer celebrations, and everyday enjoyment. Versatile and easy to pair with food, Black Cellar Pinot Grigio Chardonnay is perfect for those seeking a smooth and refreshing white wine.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken, fresh seafood, shrimp, baked salmon, creamy pasta, roasted vegetables, light salads, sushi, and soft cheeses.

black-cellar-shiraz-cabernet.title: Black Cellar Shiraz Cabernet 750ml
black-cellar-shiraz-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Black Cellar Shiraz Cabernet is a full-bodied red wine with a blend of Shiraz and Cabernet grapes. It's known for its smooth, full-flavored profile with notes of sweet cherry, blueberry, and spice. The wine has a garnet color, a fruit-forward bouquet, and a smooth mouthfeel. It's described as having a finish with plum and cherry, complemented by sweet spice. 

88 Points - James Suckling
"A crowd-pleasing blend with ripe dark fruit and a smooth, soft finish. Reliable and easy to enjoy."
86 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"Features straightforward notes of plum and blackberry. A simple, quaffable red for casual occasions."

black-cellar-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Black Cellar Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
black-cellar-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Black Cellar Cabernet Sauvignon is a dry, medium-bodied red wine with a medium acidity and fruity finish. It features aromas of raspberry and cherry, and flavors of dark cherry, earth, spice, and oak. The wine is known for its medium ruby color.

lephuza-garnacha.title: Lechuza Garnacha 750ml
lephuza-garnacha.bodyHtml: Lechuza Garnacha is a high-toned Garnacha wine, often described as silky and spicy, with a fragrant nose of red fruit liqueur, candied flowers, and white pepper. It offers a smooth, fruit-driven taste with notes of cherry and Chambord, balanced by lively acidity and a gentle, spicy finish. The wine is made from old bush vines of Garnacha, often from high altitude vineyards with poor, granitic sandy soils.

patisserie-blanc.title: Pascal Jolivet Sancerre Blanc 2024
patisserie-blanc.bodyHtml:
