A great example of unique style of the maison. The Sancerre is a perfectly balanced wine, elegant, perfumed, with great depth and flavor definition. A dry, mineral palate is the perfect frame for delicate aromas of white fruit, orchard flowers and a subtle smokiness.

A wine ideal as an aperitif and to accompany oysters, sashimi or white fish.

90 Points - Vinous 

The 2024 growing season presented huge challenges, but this 2024 Sancerre seems to defy them all. It's attractive and tender, with pure fruit and floral flavours. There's a delicious, succulent balance through the mid-palate, giving you something to really embrace. The gently refreshing finish has an assured sense of ease and line.

patisserie-rouge.title: Domaine des Senechaux Chateauneuf du Pape Rouge 2022
patisserie-rouge.bodyHtml:
Domaine des Sénéchaux Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2022 is a rich and elegant French red wine from the prestigious Châteauneuf-du-Pape appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by the historic Domaine des Sénéchaux estate, owned by the Cazes family of Château Lynch-Bages, this wine reflects the region's exceptional terroir, traditional Rhône grape varieties and commitment to quality winemaking. The 2022 vintage showcases expressive aromas of ripe black cherries, raspberries, blackberries and dark plums, complemented by notes of liquorice, black pepper, lavender, sweet spice and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, the wine is generous and beautifully structured, offering concentrated red and dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, balanced freshness and subtle earthy complexity. Its smooth texture and long, savoury finish make it an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining and further cellaring.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, duck confit, venison, beef bourguignon, herb-roasted pork, mushroom risotto, ratatouille, grilled Mediterranean vegetables, aged Comté and Manchego cheese.

 

95 Points - James Suckling

Power, structure and freshness are united in this stunning, modern Chateauneuf-du-Pape that has stacks of Mediterranean herb and raw meat character. Excellent concentration and energy. The elegantly dry finish is very long and precisely contoured. Sustainable. Drink or hold.

bud-shot.title: Bullet Shots - Porn Star
bud-shot.bodyHtml:
Bullet Shots Porn Star is a pre-poured Porn Star shooter from Highwood Distillers of High River, Alberta, sold under the Bullet brand. Each tamper-evident plastic cup holds a pre-measured 28.4 ml (1 fl oz) shot at 16% ABV, so there is nothing to pour or spill. Highwood designed the format so bars do not have to pour hundreds of shots a night, and the cups are just as handy for a party or a home bar. The Bullet range covers around 17 flavours, and Highwood also packs the cups in 106-count cases. This listing is a single cup.

Serve: Chill the cup, peel back the lid and serve straight from the cup.

brewhouse-prime.title: Brewhouse Light 15 Cans
brewhouse-prime.bodyHtml:
Brewhouse Light is brewed from the best of the West's fields so, naturally, Brewhouse Light is the smoothest Light beer choice for Western Canadians. Enjoy one as cold as the Canadian Rockies!

Traditional Western Canadian Light Beer full of fine, smooth flavours of malted barley and a light hop finish.

inception-deep-layered-red.title: Inception Deep Layered Red 750ml
inception-deep-layered-red.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "This sweet red may not have as many layers as Christopher Nolan's film of the same name, but you can expect bold, dark fruit that emerges from a backdrop of smoky oak, kind of like the thunderous horns on Hans Zimmer's dissonant soundtrack. Serve well chilled with a flick, or barbecue. (Geoffrey Moss MW)." - 84/100, Gismondi on Wine

tekena-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Treana Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
tekena-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Treana Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, expressive, and full-bodied California red wine produced by Hope Family Wines in Paso Robles. Visually displaying a deep dark ruby color, it opens with an inviting and fruit-forward bouquet of cassis, ripe dark plum, and blackberry, seamlessly layered with notes of sweet vanilla, toasted oak, roasted coffee, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a plush, velvety mouthfeel with generous dark fruit flavors framed by rounded tannins and balanced acidity, leading into a smooth, lingering, and decadent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, barbecued pork ribs, braised beef short ribs, venison, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

tekena-sauvignon-blanc.title: Matua Hawke's Bay Sauvignon Blanc
tekena-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
The Matua Hawke's Bay Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant, fresh, and aromatic New Zealand white wine that showcases a unique regional twist on the classic varietal. It displays a pale straw color and opens with intense aromas of ripe tropical fruits, stone fruits like white peach and nectarine, complemented by subtle notes of lime leaf and fresh-cut herbs. On the palate, it is crisp and medium-bodied, offering a softer, rounder, and more stone-fruit-driven profile than its Marlborough counterparts, backed by a balanced, refreshing acidity and a clean, juicy finish.

Food Pairing Pairs beautifully with pan-seared white fish, grilled chicken skewers with lemon and herbs, fresh summer salads with goat cheese, shrimp scampi, or lightly spiced Asian noodle dishes.

tekena-vineyard-select-sauvignon-blanc.title: Tokara Estate Reserve Sauvignon Blanc
tekena-vineyard-select-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
A refined Sauvignon Blanc from Tokara’s Reserve Collection, sourced from the estate’s cool Highlands vineyard in Elgin, South Africa. Bright citrus and tropical fruit combine with lemongrass, green herbs and mineral notes, supported by vibrant acidity, subtle lees texture and a lingering saline finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, grilled yellowtail, asparagus with hollandaise, ceviche and goat cheese complement its citrus freshness, herbal character and mineral finish.

mcguigan-black-label-cabernet-merlot.title: Mcguigan Black Label Cabernet Merlot 750ml
mcguigan-black-label-cabernet-merlot.bodyHtml: The Black Label Cabernet Merlot is full of blackcurrant, spiced fruit, mint and bramble with rich layers of cinnamon and vanilla. A generous, mouth-filling wine, with rich spicy fruit and oak characters, soft tannins and a lingering sweet finish. The soft and velvety Merlot combined with the more powerful Cabernet Sauvignon grapes produces a luscious red wine.

mcguigan-black-label-pinot-grigio.title: Mcguigan Black Label Pinot Grigio 2022 750ml
mcguigan-black-label-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: McGuigan Pinot Grigio offers good varietal character with nuts, fresh bread, grapefruit, floral and spice aromas and a balanced dry palate. Relatively low in acidity and light-plus in body, the palate offers flavours of nuts and grapefruit with a pleasing touch of spice on the finish.

arbor-mist-peach-moscato.title: Arbor Mist Exotic Fruits 750ml
arbor-mist-peach-moscato.bodyHtml: A fine wine product with delicious raspberry, lime, and other natural flavors.

jackson-triggs-black-riesling-gew.title: Jackson Triggs Black Riesling Gew 750ml
jackson-triggs-black-riesling-gew.bodyHtml: Jackson Triggs Black Riesling Gew is a white wine blend, known for its vibrant, crisp flavors and floral aromas. It's typically described as having notes of peach, rosewater, and stone fruit, with a balanced acidity and a refreshing finish. The wine features a pale color and a medium finish, with aromas of ginger, apple, honey, and peach.

line-39-sauvignon-blanc.title: Line 39 Sauvignon Blanc
line-39-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Line 39 Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant, refreshing white wine crafted by Line 39 Wines (O'Neill Vintners & Distillers) in California. Clean and fruit-forward, it displays lively aromas of grapefruit, lemon zest, and subtle grassy undertones. On the palate, it delivers bright citrus and subtle tropical fruit flavors supported by crisp, mouthwatering acidity that leads to a clean, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with goat cheese crostini, grilled shrimp, ceviche, fresh green salads, flaky white fish, and light poultry dishes.

apothic-dark.title: Apothic Dark
apothic-dark.bodyHtml:
Apothic Dark is an incredibly bold, rich, and dark-fruited California red blend designed for an intensely smooth and decadent drinking experience. It reveals a highly expressive, jammy bouquet of ripe blackberries, blueberries, and dark plums, seamlessly intertwined with opulent undertones of lightly roasted coffee beans, dark chocolate, and a faint hint of black pepper. On the palate, this medium- to full-bodied red blend exhibits a plush, velvety framework where a concentrated core of berry compote is supported by exceptionally soft, unassertive tannins and balanced by a touch of clean acidity. Refined to deliver a seamless integration of fruit and oak, it leaves a luxurious and smooth impression, concluding with a long, rounded finish highlighted by notes of mocha and toasted vanilla.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with slow-cooked barbecue smoked brisket, sweet-smoky glazed pork ribs, sharp aged cheddar cheese, or rich dark chocolate brownies.

apothic-rose.title: Apothic Crush
apothic-rose.bodyHtml:
Apothic Crush is a remarkably luscious, velvety, and fruit-forward red blend designed to offer an indulgent and highly approachable California wine experience. Crafted from a smooth, calculated blend of dark-skinned varieties, this non-vintage selection pours a deep ruby-purple color and opens with a highly expressive, jammy bouquet of dark cherry, ripe blackberry, and red raspberry. The primary fruit aromas are beautifully framed by decadent, oak-derived undercurrents of sweet milk chocolate, mocha, and warm caramel. On the palate, it delivers a medium- to full-bodied framework characterized by supple, ultra-soft tannins and a plush, rounded mouthfeel. Its concentrated core of berry compote and subtle baking spice is carried by a gentle hint of residual sweetness, allowing the rich notes of vanilla and toasted oak to linger gracefully on a clean, silky finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with slow-cooked barbecue pork ribs, wood-fired pepper salami pizza, teriyaki-glazed salmon, sharp aged Gouda cheese, or decadent dark chocolate brownies.

twisted-shotz-hot-licks.title: Twisted Shotz 'Hot Licks' 4x30ml
twisted-shotz-hot-licks.bodyHtml:
Twisted Shotz Hot Licks is a pre-mixed, double-chambered shot that combines fiery cinnamon whiskey flavored liqueur in one side with smooth, sweet vanilla cream liqueur in the other. When consumed, the two chambers mix in the mouth to create a hot-and-cool flavor profile reminiscent of cinnamon toast and cream.

Food Pairing: Warm churros with chocolate sauce, glazed donuts, spicy chicken wings, jalapeno poppers, and dark chocolate brownies.

Tasting Notes : Split red-amber and opaque white liquid in a dual-chambered cup with a smooth, velvety mouthfeel as both liquids combine.

Nose : Spicy ground cinnamon, candied red hot peppers, sweet vanilla bean, and heavy cream.

Palate : Spicy and sweet, featuring fiery cinnamon spice balanced immediately by smooth, rich vanilla cream and sweet syrup.

Finish : Medium-length, leaving a lingering warmth from the cinnamon spice alongside a coat of sweet vanilla cream.

Serve : Peel back the top foil lid and consume cold directly from the cup as a single shot.

savanna-dry-premium-cider.title: Lonetree Black Currant Apple Dry Cider

1884-estate-grown-sauvignon-blanc.title: Morgenster Estate Sauvignon Blanc
1884-estate-grown-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Morgenster Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh, crisp white wine produced by Morgenster Estate in the coastal ward of Helderberg within Stellenbosch. Grown on maritime-influenced slopes benefiting from cool False Bay ocean breezes, it displays a bright pale straw color. The nose opens with vibrant aromas of passion fruit, green apple, lime zest, lemongrass, and subtle minerality. On the palate, it offers lively acidity, a clean and energetic texture, and refreshing citrus and tropical fruit flavors that lead to a crisp, dry finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, goat cheese salad, grilled sea bass, asparagus risotto, prawns, and light summer pasta dishes.

shocktop-belgian-white.title: Shocktop Belgian White 12 Bottles
shocktop-belgian-white.bodyHtml: Shock Top Belgian White Wheat Beer is a spiced Belgian-style wheat golden ale beer that's the pinnacle of refreshment. This light white beer is brewed with real orange, lemon and lime peels for a smooth, citrusy finish. Shock Top beer contains a 5.2% ABV per serving.

tin-cup.title: Tincup American Whiskey
tin-cup.bodyHtml:
A classic, rugged whiskey built for the outdoors! Inspired by the original miners of the Colorado gold rush who drank their whiskey from tin cups, this expression is a blend of high-rye Indiana bourbon and Colorado single malt whiskey. Cut to proof using pure, crisp Rocky Mountain water and bottled at an approachable 84 proof (42% ABV), it delivers a remarkably smooth, sweet, and perfectly spiced profile that is fantastic around a campfire.

 

NOSE

Bright and sweet with aromas of fresh citrus, black pepper, ginger, and subtle vanilla.

PALATE

Smooth, crisp, and clean. Sweet caramel and honey are balanced beautifully by a sharp, lively punch of peppery rye spice and toasted oak.

FINISH

Clean, refreshing, and lingering with a pleasant cinnamon warmth.

dal-cero-corte-giacobbe-soave-doc.title: Tenuta Corte Giacobbe Soave 2021 750ml
dal-cero-corte-giacobbe-soave-doc.bodyHtml: Bright straw yellow with pale green highlights. The nose is multifaceted with fruity, floral aromas of ripe melon, orange, jasmine, chamomile, rosemary and hay. On the palate, the wine is harmonious with superb persistence and a crisp finish.

montecchiesi-selverello-syrah-doc.title: Tenuta Montecchiesi Selverello Syrah 750ml
montecchiesi-selverello-syrah-doc.bodyHtml: The Tenuta Montecchiesi Selverello Syrah 750ml is a red wine known for its bright ruby red color and intense aromas of fresh fruit with a subtle spicy note typical of the Syrah grape. The palate is described as full and satisfying, with glossy, elegant tannins and a long-lasting finish.

collingwood-canadian-whisky.title: Collingwood Signature Blend Canadian Whisky
collingwood-canadian-whisky.bodyHtml:
Collingwood Signature Blend Canadian Whisky is a smooth and richly textured blended Canadian whisky crafted in Ontario. Its distinctive character combines mellow grain whisky with deeper rye influence, followed by a unique maplewood mellowing process that adds another layer of softness and complexity. Bottled at 40% ABV, it offers an inviting balance of caramel, butterscotch, vanilla, toasted grain, subtle fruit, maple sweetness, and warming spice.

Food Pairing: Maple-glazed pork, roast chicken, grilled sausages, aged cheddar, roasted pecans, apple pie, caramel pudding, and vanilla bread pudding.

Tasting Notes: Smooth and creamy with caramel, butterscotch, vanilla, toasted grain, subtle fruit, maple sweetness, and gentle spice.

Nose: Delicate caramel and butterscotch with floral rose notes, fruit, vanilla, and toasted grain.

Palate: Creamy and lively with caramel, soft grain, subtle marzipan, maple syrup, and gentle warming spice.

Finish: Mellow and smooth with lingering grain, caramel, maple sweetness, and soft spice.

dogliotti-moscato-dasti.title: Michele Chiarlo Nivole Moscato d'Asti 2025
dogliotti-moscato-dasti.bodyHtml:
Michele Chiarlo Nivole Moscato d'Asti 2025 is a fragrant, vibrant, and delicately sparkling Italian dessert wine crafted from 100% Moscato Bianco grapes grown in the gentle, sun-drenched hills of Piedmont. Brilliant straw yellow with greenish highlights, it displays an enchanting bouquet dominated by floral nuances, fresh white peach, apricot, and subtle notes of sage and orange blossom. On the palate, it is lightly effervescent (frizzante), soft, and beautifully balanced, offering natural grape sweetness offset by lively acidity and a clean, refreshing, fruit-forward finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fruit tarts, fresh berries, Panettone, lemon pound cake, hazelnut desserts, creamy panna cotta, and mild blue or soft-ripened cheeses.

knob-creek-rye.title: Knob Creek Kentucky Straight Rye
knob-creek-rye.bodyHtml:
Crafted in the pre-Prohibition style that made the Knob Creek name famous, this award-winning Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey is made with a blend of the finest quality rye grains. Bottled at a sturdy 100 proof, it strikes the perfect balance between the bold, spicy kick of traditional rye and the sweet, heavily oaked vanilla undertones of a classic premium bourbon. It is an incredibly versatile whiskey that elevates any classic cocktail, particularly a Manhattan or an Old Fashioned.

 

NOSE

Inviting aromas of rich rye bread, black pepper, fresh herbs, and a gentle undertone of sweet vanilla and oak.

PALATE

Bold and spicy, featuring a rush of white pepper and rye grain that is beautifully smoothed out by sweet vanilla cream, toasted oak, and a touch of caramel.

FINISH

Warm, long, and satisfying with lingering notes of spice and sweet, toasted wood.

van-ruiten-pinot-noir.title: Tesselaarsdal Pinot Noir 2022 750ml
van-ruiten-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
South African Wine
With an important wine renaissance in full swing, impressive red and white bargains abound in South Africa. The country has a particularly long and rich history with winemaking, especially considering its status as part of the “New World.” In the mid-17th century, the lusciously sweet dessert wines of Constantia were highly prized by the European aristocracy. Since then, the South African wine industry has experienced some setbacks due to the phylloxera infestation of the late 1800s and political difficulties throughout the following century.

Today, however, South Africa is increasingly responsible for high-demand, high-quality wines—a blessing to put the country back on the international wine map. Wine production is mainly situated around Cape Town, where the climate is generally warm to hot. But the Benguela Current from Antarctica provides brisk ocean breezes necessary for steady ripening of grapes. Similarly, cooler, high-elevation vineyard sites throughout South Africa offer similar, favorable growing conditions.

South Africa’s wine zones are divided into region, then smaller districts and finally wards, but the country’s wine styles are differentiated more by grape variety than by region. Pinotage, a cross between Pinot Noir and Cinsault, is the country’s “signature” grape, responsible for red-fruit-driven, spicy, earthy reds. When Pinotage is blended with other red varieties, like Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah or Pinot Noir (all commonly vinified alone as well), it is often labeled as a “Cape Blend.” Chenin Blanc (locally known as “Steen”) dominates white wine production, with Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc following close behind.
Pinot Noir
Thin-skinned, finicky and temperamental, Pinot Noir is also one of the most rewarding grapes to grow and remains a labor of love for some of the greatest vignerons in Burgundy. Fairly adaptable but highly reflective of the environment in which it is grown, Pinot Noir prefers a cool climate and requires low yields to achieve high quality. Outside of France, outstanding examples come from in Oregon, California and throughout specific locations in wine-producing world. Somm Secret—André Tchelistcheff, California’s most influential post-Prohibition winemaker decidedly stayed away from the grape, claiming “God made Cabernet. The Devil made Pinot Noir.”

lamberti-prosecco-doc-extra-dry.title: Corte Bacaro Prosecco Doc Extra Dry 750ml

ravenswood-beseiged.title: Ravenswood Beseiged 750ml
ravenswood-beseiged.bodyHtml: Ravenswood Besieged is a red wine blend from Ravenswood Winery, a popular California wine producer. It's known for its full-bodied, dark fruit-forward flavor profile, often described with notes of blackberry, black cherry, and baking spices. It's a limited release, typically a blend of Old Vine California heritage varietals.

social-lite-cucumber-lemon-mint.title: Social Lite Cucumber Lemon Mint 4 Cans
social-lite-cucumber-lemon-mint.bodyHtml: Refreshingly light and crisp, Social Lite Cucumber Lemon Mint is the perfect ready-to-drink vodka soda crafted for clean, easy sipping. Made with 100% natural ingredients, this fizzy beverage combines cool cucumber, zesty lemon, and a hint of fresh mint, all without sugar or sweeteners. At just 80 calories per can and 4% ABV, it’s ideal for guilt-free enjoyment anytime.

social-lite-ginger-lime.title: Social Lite Ginger Lime 4 Cans
social-lite-ginger-lime.bodyHtml: Social Lite Ginger Lime is a non-alcoholic, sparkling beverage that combines the flavors of ginger and lime. The product is sold in a 4-can pack, with each can containing 355ml of the beverage. It's a popular choice for those who enjoy the taste of ginger and lime without the alcohol.

canadian-club-maple.title: Canadian Club Invitation Series 18 Year Old High Proof
canadian-club-maple.bodyHtml:
A rich, full-bodied Canadian Whisky matured for 18 years in carefully selected oak barrels as part of the Invitation Series. It offers inviting aromas of vanilla, caramel, dried fruits, and toasted oak, leading to a smooth palate of butterscotch, baking spices, dark fruit, toffee, and gentle oak with a long refined finish.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements pecan pie, crème brûlée, roasted pork, smoked brisket, maple-glazed ham, and aged cheeses such as cheddar, Gouda, or Gruyère.

menage-a-trois-midnight.title: Ménage à Trois Midnight Dark Red Blend 750ml
menage-a-trois-midnight.bodyHtml: Ménage à Trois Midnight is a dark, red wine blend with a garnet color and notes of dark fruits, spice, and mocha. It features a rich taste of blackberry and black cherry, along with mocha and exotic spices, and has a smooth, silky finish. This blend includes Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Sirah, and Petit Verdot.

vintage-ink-rebel-red.title: Vintage Ink Wines Rebel Red 750ml
vintage-ink-rebel-red.bodyHtml: A rich full bodied wine that really shows the character of the Okanagan, with flavours of strawberry, vanilla bean, dark chocolate and spice with a long silky finish. Product photos are for display purposes only and may have an out-of-date label, bottle shape or vintage.

case-paolin-cabernet-igt-veneto.title: Case Paolin Cabernet Igt Veneto 750ml
case-paolin-cabernet-igt-veneto.bodyHtml: The Case Paolin Cabernet IGT Veneto 750ml is a red wine from the Veneto region of Italy, produced by the Case Paolin winery. It is a Cabernet Sauvignon grape varietal wine. The wine is aged in oak and concrete vessels before being bottled. Case Paolin describes the production area as the alluvial plains below Montello hill, north of Treviso.

vintage-ink-wild-white.title: Vintage Ink Wild White 750ml
vintage-ink-wild-white.bodyHtml: Vintage Ink Wild White is described as a lively, fruit-forward white wine with floral notes and flavors of orange and citrus. It's known for its smooth, round palate and a refreshing, extended finish. The wine pairs well with light summer foods, such as melon wrapped in prosciutto, gazpacho, tomato and cucumber salad, grilled shrimp, or sushi.

ribstone-creek-lone-bison-ipa.title: Ribstone Creek Lone Bison IPA 6 Cans
ribstone-creek-lone-bison-ipa.bodyHtml: Ribstone Creek Lone Bison IPA is an unfiltered IPA with a 6.5% ABV. It's known for its citrus and pine notes, a pronounced hoppy flavor, and a light hazy orange color.

jack-daniels-master-distiller-2.title: Jack Daniel's Master Distiller Edition #2
jack-daniels-master-distiller-2.bodyHtml: Jack Daniel's Master Distiller Edition #2 is a limited-edition Tennessee whiskey paying tribute to Jess Motlow, the Master Distiller who oversaw the distillery during Prohibition (1911-1941). It is part of a series celebrating all seven Master Distillers in Jack Daniel's history. This bottle is 86 proof and comes in both 750ml and 1L sizes, individually numbered and in a collectible box.

nugan-estate-scruffys-shiraz.title: Nugan Estate Scruffy's Shiraz 750ml
nugan-estate-scruffys-shiraz.bodyHtml: Nugan Estate Scruffy's Shiraz is a red wine with a dense crimson color and youthful garnet hues, offering aromas of blood plum and red berries, intertwined with spice and vanillin notes. The palate is full-flavored with upfront fruit characters of plum and blackberry, complemented by ripe, silky tannins and subtle hints of black pepper and oak. It is a bold wine that pairs well with red meat dishes, especially those with higher alcohol content, according to Bests Wines.

cotton-candy-rose.title: St. Julian Cotton Candy Rosé
cotton-candy-rose.bodyHtml:
St. Julian Cotton Candy Rosé is a charming, delightfully sweet rosé wine produced by St. Julian Winery, Michigan's oldest operating winery. Crafted using a proprietary blend of estate-grown grapes, this playful blush wine captures the nostalgic essence of a classic carnival treat. On the nose, it releases vibrant and inviting aromas of freshly spun sugar, wild strawberries, and ripe raspberries. The palate is light-bodied, smooth, and fruit-forward, balancing its distinct sweetness with a crisp acidity that keeps every sip bright and extraordinarily refreshing.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spicy Thai dishes, salty appetizers, fresh summer berry salads, pepper jack cheese, light pastries, and fruit tarts.

tarima-hill-old-vines.title: Tarima Hill Old Vines Monatrell 2019 750ml
tarima-hill-old-vines.bodyHtml:
92 Points by Wine Spectator

An aromatic underpinning of tarry smoke and medicinal herbs serves as a savoury counterpoint to ripe flavours of creme de cassis, blackberry preserves, licorice and espresso crema in this rich red. A frame of sculpted tannins and a  slightly tangy citrus peel acidity are well-knit to the expressive flavour range, resulting in a powerful, harmonious version. Monastrell. Drink now through 2029.

legacy-canadian-whisky.title: Alberta Premium Batch 10 Legacy Reserve
legacy-canadian-whisky.bodyHtml:
In 2001, we laid down our first batch of liquid. Every year for the next decade, we did the same. Batch 10 Legacy Reserve brings you a blend of liquid from all 10 years, hand selected by our staff to create the best tasting liquid possible from each year’s unique taste profile.

Select whisky from 10 different warehouses from across our 42-acre site, contributing to the breadth of liquids available to blend based on the unique attributes of each warehouse.

New White Oak, Ex-Bourbon and Ex-Canadian Whisky.

COLOUR : Amber
AROMA : Dark chocolate and slightly oaky with fruity notes of dried prunes, warm pear and banana
TASTE : Rich espresso and dark chocolate, balanced with a hint of banana and toffee
FINISH : Smooth and creamy

puech-haut-prestige-rouge.title: Puech-Haut Prestige Rouge 750ml
puech-haut-prestige-rouge.bodyHtml: Puech-Haut Prestige Rouge 750ml is a red wine from Languedoc-Roussillon, France, known for its rich and intense style. It's a blend of Carignan, Grenache, and Syrah grapes, resulting in a wine with notes of blackberry, dried red-cherry flakes, strawberry, and huckleberry. The wine also features a mixture of red and black fruits on the palate, with slightly grippy tannins that add body and concentration.

puech-haut-prestige-blanc.title: Puech-Haut Prestige Blanc 750ml
puech-haut-prestige-blanc.bodyHtml: Puech-Haut Prestige Blanc 750ml is a white wine from Languedoc-Roussillon, France, made from a blend of Roussanne and Marsanne grapes. It's known for its shiny, golden color and a nose that offers rich, complex notes of white fruits. The wine is aged for 8 months in stainless steel tanks on fine lees, with regular stirring in the first months.

bodacious-rose.title: Bodacious Rose 750ml
bodacious-rose.bodyHtml:
This easy-going rose offers lifted strawberry-cherry aromas, plenty of red fruit and citrus flavours and balanced medium sweetness. The luscious, soft character of this wine is a perfect partner for the spicy heat of take-out favourites. Serve well-chilled with spicy barbecued chicken, Thai or Szechuan dishes.

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast
A crisp and refreshing rosé with pleasant notes of strawberry and citrus. Light-bodied and dry, it offers a straightforward, easy-drinking profile perfect for warm-weather sipping and casual occasions.

motts-caesar-extreme.title: Mott's Clamato Caesar Extra Spicy 6 cans

mallee-rock-shiraz-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Chimney Rock Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
mallee-rock-shiraz-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This richly aromatic wine dances with aromas of black currant, cherry, and plums. It is delicately highlighted with notes of caramel, cocoa power and hints of sage and vanilla. Sumptuous and silky. Rich with cherry fruit at the palate entry followed by a sultry, silky mid-palate. The acidity is bright and the finish is long and smooth.

94 Points - James Suckling

So well-balanced, elegant and drinkable. This full-bodied red is moderately tannic, showing deep flavors of raspberries, black cherries, dark chocolate and baking spices. While velvety and approachable, it also delivers great complexity and length. Drink now or hold.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Keenly structured yet polished, with handsome flavors of black cherry and red currant accented by tomato leaf and bittersweet chocolate as this gathers richness toward fine-grained tannins. Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc.

mallee-rock-pinot-grigio.title: Stoneleigh Marlborough Pinot Grigio 2025
mallee-rock-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Stoneleigh Marlborough Pinot Grigio is a lively New Zealand white offering fresh orchard fruit, sweet pear, stone fruit, honey, and subtle spice. The palate is soft yet vibrant, with rich texture, refreshing acidity, ripe fruit character, and a clean finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled salmon, prawn risotto, seafood, goat cheese, prosciutto, crostini, light pasta, and fresh fruit-based desserts.

gauchezco-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Gauchezco Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
gauchezco-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Gauchezco Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon is described as a ruby red wine with dark violet overlays. It has an intense and complex nose with notes of green pepper, black cherry, boysenberry, vanilla, and dark chocolate. The wine is well-balanced and harmonious, with sweet and mature tannins and a long, persistent finish. It is recommended to be served at 60°F–64°F (16°C–18°C).

paula-malbec.title: Dona Paula Seleccion de Bodega Malbec 2020
paula-malbec.bodyHtml:
Deep violet color. Aromas of berries, with graphite, black cherries and spices notes. Great concentration, firm tannins, fresh acidity and long finish.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

I found the 2019 Selección de Bodega Malbec to be superb, showcasing Malbec in their vineyard in Gualtallary at 1,350 meters in altitude. The plots are picked by soil and fermented and matured separately in French oak barrels, 50% of them new, for 20 months. It has 14.5% alcohol, balancing acidity and good freshness, and despite the élevage, the wine is not oaky and shows integrated wood, coming through as serious, elegant, balanced and powerful. It's round and has fine chalky tannins. Best after 2022. Rating;. 93+

bastide-miraflors-vieilles-vignes.title: Domaine Lafage Bastide Miraflors 2023
bastide-miraflors-vieilles-vignes.bodyHtml:
Domaine Lafage Bastide Miraflors 2023 is a rich, expressive, and fruit-forward red wine produced by Jean-Marc and Eliane Lafage in the Roussillon region of Southern France. Sourced from old-vine Grenache and Syrah grown on gravelly and schist soils, it undergoes concrete tank aging for the Grenache and French oak aging for the Syrah. In the glass, it exhibits a deep ruby hue with vibrant aromatics of ripe dark cherries, blackberries, cracked black pepper, dried bay leaves, and wild garrigue herbs. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied, supple, and energetic, balancing lush dark fruit with polished, chalky tannins, bright acidity, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted leg of lamb with herbs, slow-braised beef short ribs, grilled pork chops, barbecued meats, and aged cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

A balanced, focused and flavorful blend of grenache and syrah. On the nose, it presents notes of dark cherries, plums and baking spices, leading to a medium-bodied palate with fine tannins. It’s precise and well-balanced, offering a seductive finish. Drink or hold.

enigma-chardonnay.title: El Enemigo Chardonnay 2023
enigma-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Chardonnay 2024 is a distinctive, mineral-driven Argentine white wine crafted by winemaker Alejandro Vigil and historian Adrianna Catena at Bodega Aleanna. Sourced from high-altitude vineyards at 1,470 meters above sea level in Gualtallary, Tupungato, the grapes grow on deep calcareous and rocky soils that impart intense freshness and tension. Fermented with wild yeasts in 500-liter French oak barrels (35% new) and aged for 9 to 12 months under a biological veil of flor yeast, the wine develops a unique saline complexity inspired by traditional Jura and Sherry methods. In the glass, it displays a luminous pale gold hue. The aromatic bouquet unfolds with expressive notes of fresh pear, pineapple, and lemon zest layered with toasted hazelnut, acacia blossom, and chalky minerality. On the palate, it delivers a dry, medium-to-full body balanced by vibrant natural acidity and a creamy, briny texture that carries into a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Herb-roasted chicken, grilled sea bass, creamy mushroom risotto, seared scallops, or soft triple-cream Brie cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

Youthful and lightly spicy aromas of freshly cut pineapple, chalk, star fruit and touches of kelp and nougat. Deliciously saline and pure on the medium-to full-bodied palate, with a long and lightly unctuous finish. The subtle salinity offers extra layers, length and definition to the wine. Drink from 2027.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Produced from sites in Gualtallary, including Adrianna Vineyard, the 2024 Chardonnay was vinified in 500-liter barrels, a portion of which underwent the biological aging that has become a signature of Alejandro Vigil's winemaking. Crushed stones, dried herbs, green fruits and saline overtones mark the nose, introducing one of the richer, broader palates in the introductory El Enemigo range. The finish recalls the energy of the nose, lingering long with pronounced salinity and herbal overtones.

mad-jack-apple.title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Apple
mad-jack-apple.bodyHtml: The distinct character of Jack Daniel's charcoal-mellowed Tennessee Whiskey, blended with vibrant natural apple flavour. Experience caramel, toasted oak and spicy notes, coupled with fresh green apple. Enjoy neat over ice, or add crisp apple nuances to your favourite whiskey cocktail.

michaels-irish-cream.title: Michael's Irish Cream
michaels-irish-cream.bodyHtml:
Michael's Irish Cream is a rich and indulgent Irish cream liqueur crafted with real dairy cream and Irish whiskey. Smooth and velvety, it offers inviting flavours of milk chocolate, vanilla, caramel and gentle whiskey warmth. Its luscious texture and balanced sweetness make it a delightful after-dinner liqueur with a classic Irish character.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with chocolate brownies, tiramisu, vanilla cheesecake, coffee-flavoured desserts, chocolate truffles, caramel pudding and buttery shortbread cookies.

Tasting Notes: Creamy and sweet with rich chocolate, vanilla, caramel, subtle coffee notes and gentle Irish whiskey warmth.

Nose: Aromas of sweet cream, milk chocolate, vanilla, caramel and delicate toasted nuts.

Palate: Rich and velvety with smooth dairy cream, chocolate, vanilla custard, soft caramel and subtle whiskey character.

Finish: Smooth, sweet and lingering with creamy vanilla, chocolate and gentle warming notes.

mudshake-orange.title: Mudshake Orange Cream 4x270ml Bottles
mudshake-orange.bodyHtml: Indulge in a smooth and creamy delight with Mudshake Orange Cream. This ready-to-drink beverage blends the nostalgic taste of orange creamsicle with rich cream liqueur, delivering a sweet and satisfying experience in every sip. Packaged in a convenient 4-pack of 270ml bottles, it's perfect for casual gatherings, weekend treats, or a refreshing dessert drink. Best served chilled or over ice.

trapiche-malkina-malbec.title: Trapiche Medalla Malbec 2019/2021 750ml
trapiche-malkina-malbec.bodyHtml:
Intense purple with violet tones. Concentrated aromas of red berries, plums, cherries and raisins, highlighted by notes of toast, coconut and vanilla from aging in new French oak barrels. In the mouth the wine reveals its best attributes with a sweet entry, soft and intense tannins that give creaminess, volume and meatiness. The flavors of ripe fruit stand perfectly amalgamated with spicy and smoky wood, leaving a pleasant and persistent finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

A very fragrant malbec here with lots of crushed blueberries, stones, blue flowers and wild herbs. Lavender and violets. The medium-bodied palate has lots of juicy red and blue fruits. The tension and the chalky tannins are very noticeable on the palate. Really well-balanced. Fantastic value for the money. Delicious now, but can hold very well for five to six years.

trapiche-malkina-rose.title: Trapiche Malkina Rose	 750ml
trapiche-malkina-rose.bodyHtml: Trapiche Malkina Rosé is a dry, Argentine rosé wine, often made from a blend of Malbec and Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. It is known for its transparent red color and intense aromas of black fruit and strawberry. The wine is described as having a fruity and balanced palate with a lively, fresh acidity, offering a good reverberation on the finish. Some descriptions also mention a slight hint of vanilla.

trapiche-malkina-pinot-grigio.title: Trapiche Reserve Pinot Grigio 2022/2024 750ml
trapiche-malkina-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Trapiche Reserve Pinot Grigio is a crisp and refreshing white wine made from premium, estate-grown grapes in Argentina, offering a delicate yet vibrant flavor profile. With notes of citrus, green apple, and herbs, this wine pairs well with light and flavorful dishes.

okanagan-extra-white-grape.title: Tinhorn Creek Pinot Gris VQA
okanagan-extra-white-grape.bodyHtml:
Tinhorn Creek Pinot Gris VQA is a vibrant, refreshing, and highly approachable white wine from one of British Columbia's most celebrated estates, located in the beautiful Golden Mile Bench of the Okanagan Valley. Crafted with meticulous care and cool-fermented in stainless steel to preserve the grape's pure characteristics, this Canadian wine displays a pale straw-yellow hue in the glass. The inviting aromatic bouquet opens with lively notes of ripe Anjou pear, honeydew melon, and white peach, elegantly layered with subtle hints of Meyer lemon, fresh citrus blossom, and a delicate touch of honey. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, crisp, and beautifully focused, delivering a generous core of fresh orchard and soft tropical fruit. This juicy, fruit-forward profile is perfectly balanced by a bright, mouthwatering acidity and an underlying clean minerality, culminating in a snappy, refreshing, and highly versatile finish that makes it a perfect everyday sipper.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with freshly shucked oysters, lightly grilled halibut, fresh green salads, creamy lemon-herb chicken, and soft cheeses like fresh goat cheese.

okanagan-extra-strawberry-rhubarb.title: Growers Strawberry Rhubarb 2L
okanagan-extra-strawberry-rhubarb.bodyHtml: The "Growers Strawberry Rhubarb" is a fruit beverage that combines the sweet taste of ripe strawberries with the tart flavor of rhubarb, according to Save-On-Foods and Wine and Beyond. It's available in a 2-liter bottle. Saskatoon Co-op Liquor and Manitoba Liquor Mart also offer it as a cider, adding tart notes to the overall taste.

palm-bay-dragonfruit-watermelon-breeze.title: Palm Bay Dragonfruit Watermelon Breeze 6 Cans
palm-bay-dragonfruit-watermelon-breeze.bodyHtml: Clear, bright pink colour; bursting with aromas of watermelon, dragon fruit and a hint of banana; only slightly sweet on the palate and balanced with fresh flavours of watermelon and dragon fruit.

barefoot-refresh-crisp-red.title: Barefoot Refresh Crisp Red 750ml
barefoot-refresh-crisp-red.bodyHtml: Barefoot Refresh Crisp Red is a refreshing, light-bodied red wine blend known for its fruity flavors and crisp, citrus finish. It's often described as having notes of raspberry, orange, and freshly picked berries. This wine is best enjoyed chilled or over ice.

ruffino-urlo-pinot-grigio.title: Ruffino Lumina Pinot Grigio
ruffino-urlo-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Ruffino Lumina Pinot Grigio is a remarkably crisp, refreshing, and lively white wine from northeastern Italy. It displays a clear, straw-yellow hue with golden highlights. The nose opens with inviting, intense aromas of freshly cut lemon, white peach, green apple, and subtle hints of wildflowers and wild herbs like sage and mint. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, clean, and beautifully balanced, offering vibrant citrus and pear flavors anchored by a delicate, steely mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp skewers, fresh caprese salad, raw oysters, light chicken piccata, or creamy vegetable risotto.

henri-bourgeois-petit-bourgeois.title: Henri Bourgeois Sancerre D'Antan
henri-bourgeois-petit-bourgeois.bodyHtml:
Henri Bourgeois Sancerre D'Antan is a distinctive Sauvignon Blanc aged in oak, offering aromas of ripe citrus, white peach, quince, acacia blossom, toasted hazelnut, vanilla, and flinty minerality. Rich yet beautifully balanced, it reveals creamy texture, vibrant acidity, remarkable complexity, and a long, elegant finish with excellent ageing potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with lobster, roast chicken, creamy seafood dishes, grilled turbot, aged goat cheese, or Comte for an exceptional Sancerre pairing.

underwood-pinot-grigio.title: Underwood Pinot Grigio 750ml
underwood-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Underwood Pinot Gris (750ml) is a bright, refreshing white wine, often described as approachable and fresh, with citrus and green apple notes. It's a popular choice for casual sipping and summer gatherings.

kings-ridge-pinot-noir.title: Kings Ridge Pinot Noir 2021 750ml
kings-ridge-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2022 vintage) "Light and wispy, with rejuvenating acidity, pillow soft tannins and aromas like smoked strawberries and black pepper. Tart cranberry and lemon flavors feel thin in the mouth. Chill and serve at an outdoor concert." - 86/100, Wine Enthusiast

blue-dry-8-1.title: Chateau Margaux 2016 1.5L Magnum
blue-dry-8-1.bodyHtml:
99 Points - James Suckling

It’s very friendly and warm on the nose showing flowers, such as roses, and red fruit. But then on the palate, it lets you know how serious it is. Full-bodied, yet reserved, extremely tight and well-formed with super polished tannins that go on for minutes. A solid and typical Margaux with all the personality and beauty in strength. Try after 2027.

99 Points - Wine Enthusiast

With a rare 94% Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend, this wine is packed both with black-currant flavors and impressive tannins and acidity. It moves Château Margaux into a new dimension with its dense, dry core of tannins that will power the wine into a seriously long-term future. Best after 2025. Cellar Selection

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2016 Château Margaux (blended of 94% Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Cabernet Franc, 2% Merlot and 1% Petit Verdot) sashays out of the glass with glamorous red currants, candied violets, kirsch and crushed blackcurrants scents followed by notions of tilled black soil, forest floor, cast iron pan and cigar box with subtle wafts of lavender and oolong tea. Medium-bodied, mineral laced accents hover over the palate with an ethereal sensation of weightlessness, yet it is super intense with layers of red and black flavors supported by a firm texture of silt-fine tannins, finishing wonderfully fragrant and incredibly long.

98 Points - Decanter

This is a serious Margaux, hugely Cabernet dominant on both nose and palate as you would expect with 94% of the blend. It has an extremely fine, elongated tannic structure, just barely there and so classy, focussing on the gentle elasticity. There are more blue than black fruits here, wonderfully spun out and softened with crushed tobacco. It has the expansive aromatic structure of Margaux, the floral and mineral aspects clear, as is the tension that lifts the palate up and out. It's reminiscent of the 2005, though with less evident tannins. It's not as hefty as the 2010 or as staggering as the 2015, but is still a joyful expression of the estate. 1% Petit Verdot completes the blend.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The grand vin 2016 Château Margaux is a beauty and tastes like the essence of Margaux. Thrilling notes of blueberries, cassis, crushed violets, flowery incense, and spice notes all give way to a full-bodied 2016 that strikes an incredible balance between richness and elegance. A blend of 94% Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Cabernet Franc, 2% Merlot and 1% Petit Verdot brought up in new barrels, it’s more focused and elegant than the 2015, yet I suspect it’s just as concentrated, and readers are going have a blast comparing these two magical vintages over the coming 4-5 decades.
Rating: 97+

97 Points - Wine Spectator
Beautifully rendered, with a lush and seamless flow of cassis, steeped cherry, warmed raspberry and gently mulled blackberry fruit flavors gliding through. Light lilac, savory, mesquite and mineral accents underline the finish, adding additional texture and length. Deep and long, with sublime definition and gorgeous fruit. Best from 2024 through 2040.

vinedos-altamira-valley-malbec.title: Vistaflores Estate Vinedos Altamira Valley Tres Fincas Red Blend 750ml
vinedos-altamira-valley-malbec.bodyHtml: It offers a balanced full-bodied palate of ripe red fruit, toasted wood, and hints of smoky leather. Vinedos Altamira Valley Tres Fincas is a top-tier Chilean red, crafted from three distinct vineyards in the renowned Colchagua Valley. It features a full-bodied palate of ripe red fruit, toasted wood, and smoky leather notes, offering a harmonious blend that reflects the Valley's terroir. With its exceptional balance, this wine is sure to please the most discerning of palates.

vinedos-altamira-valley-tres-fincas.title: Vistaflores Estate Vinedos Altamira Valley Tres Fincas Red Blend 750ml
vinedos-altamira-valley-tres-fincas.bodyHtml: It offers a balanced full-bodied palate of ripe red fruit, toasted wood, and hints of smoky leather. Vinedos Altamira Valley Tres Fincas is a top-tier Chilean red, crafted from three distinct vineyards in the renowned Colchagua Valley. It features a full-bodied palate of ripe red fruit, toasted wood, and smoky leather notes, offering a harmonious blend that reflects the Valley's terroir. With its exceptional balance, this wine is sure to please the most discerning of palates.

relax-pink.title: Relax Pink 750ml
relax-pink.bodyHtml: A fruity Spanish Ros̩ with fresh aromas of strawberries and cherries. It is beautifully balanced with a refreshing crispness and soft, round finish.

dreaming-tree-pinot-noir.title: Dreaming Tree Pinot Noir 750ml
dreaming-tree-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
A collaboration between musician Dave Matthews and winemaker Sean McKenzie, Dreaming Tree Pinot Noir is a smooth and approachable red wine that captures the laid-back spirit of California. This Pinot Noir offers aromas of ripe cherry, wild strawberry, and subtle baking spices, followed by flavors of red berries, soft vanilla, and a hint of oak on the palate. Medium-bodied with silky tannins and a balanced acidity, it’s an easy-drinking wine perfect for everyday enjoyment.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Light ruby red

  • Aroma: Ripe cherry, strawberry, cinnamon, and toasted oak

  • Palate: Soft red fruits, vanilla, spice, and a touch of earthiness

  • Finish: Smooth, clean, and subtly lingering

Food Pairing: Ideal with roasted chicken, grilled salmon, mushroom dishes, or soft cheeses.

Region: California, USA
Alcohol Content: ~13.5%
Producer: Dreaming Tree Wines (Dave Matthews & Sean McKenzie)

gato-negro-9-lives-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Gato Negro Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
gato-negro-9-lives-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2023 vintage) "This is a light-bodied Cabernet Sauvignon, with mild aromas of white pepper and a simple palate. Flavors of peppercorn and stewed red berries blend with grass and dissolve on a short finish." - Wine Enthusiast

wine-oclock-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
wine-oclock-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a highly refined, elegant, and classic expression of Napa Valley. It presents a deep, saturated ruby color and features a vibrant nose of black raspberry, blackcurrant, and dark blackberry preserves, layered with delicate floral notes of violet and lavender. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, its boisterous and bright dark fruit flavors are supported by savory hints of chaparral sagebrush, bay laurel, and subtle cedar. The texture is soft and silky, framed by velvety-rich tannins and crisp acidity that offer a balanced, firm grip leading into a long, sumptuous finish.

Food Pairing: This savory, structured Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, herb-crusted rack of lamb, or rich mushroom ravioli.

93 Points - James Suckling

A very refined and polished red with fine tannins, bright acidity and a tangy undertone. Medium-bodied, juicy and savory. Citrusy. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Earthy, cocoa powder aromatics combine with ripe black fruits on the palate. Lengthy, robust, full bodied and fully flavored, this powerful wine is carried by powdery-fine tannins and a persistent, palate-cleansing acidity.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

There's a caressing feel to the mix of cassis and boysenberry puree flavors that are gilded with a pretty violet note. The long finish has a toasty edge and lingers prettily.

wine-oclock-sauvignon-blanc.title: Duckhorn North Coast Sauvignon Blanc 2024 375ml
wine-oclock-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn North Coast Sauvignon Blanc 2024 is a remarkably crisp, elegant, and beautifully structured white wine. From the first swirl, it captivates with expressive aromas of candied pineapple, ripe guava, and sliced honeydew melon, layered with a delicate flourish of key lime blossom and fresh lemon verbena. On the palate, vibrant notes of fresh melon and tree fruit take center stage, harmonizing with bright citrus undertones. The addition of Sémillon to the blend contributes a rich, silky mouthfeel and added depth, while a lively, energetic acidity provides brilliant precision. The wine culminates in a focused, juicy finish marked by a subtle touch of flinty minerality.

Food Pairing: This vibrant white wine pairs exquisitely with fresh seafood dishes, such as grilled sea bass, shrimp scampi, oysters on the half shell, and crab cakes. It is also an excellent complement to herb-roasted chicken, light pasta dishes, green salads with vinaigrette, and fresh goat cheese.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of lemon zest, white peaches, grapefruit, lemongrass and wet stones. The midweight palate shows bright acidity and a smooth, textural mouthfeel, giving freshness and balance to the finish. Drink now. Screw cap.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This classic Sauvy B from an iconic producer continues to be a favorite poolside or anytime in your glass. Crowd pleasing zippy aromatics of citrus segments, lemon grass, papaya, and notes of white flowers on the nose; the flavors tease the palate with lively fruit and texture that says please smile.

wine-oclock-merlot.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Merlot 2022
wine-oclock-merlot.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Duckhorn Napa Valley Merlot is a masterful and velvety expression of the varietal from a pioneer of the style. It presents an alluring, deep ruby colour and opens with a complex aromatic profile of black cherry, plum, and huckleberry, seamlessly layered with sophisticated notes of vanilla, clove, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and supple, showcasing a lush core of dark fruit balanced by a bright, refreshing acidity and fine-grained tannins. Aging for 15 months in French oak (roughly 40% new) provides a refined structure and subtle spicy nuances, leading to a long, polished finish with lingering echoes of cocoa, cedar, and savory herbs.

Food Pairing: Perfectly matches with roasted duck breast with a cherry reduction, grilled lamb chops, mushroom risotto, beef tenderloin, or aged cheeses like Gouda and Camembert.

92  Points - James Suckling

A dark-fruited, fleshy red with ripe blackberries, dark chocolate, licorice and hints of wet stones on the nose. Medium-to full-bodied with a lively pace, showing silky tannins and a smooth, lingering finish.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Vibrant and polished, with elegantly complex cherry and red currant flavors that take on hints of toasty spices and tomato leaf as this sails toward refined tannins. Drink now through 2032.

columbia-valley-chardonnay.title: Kettle Valley Chardonnay 2025
columbia-valley-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Kettle Valley Chardonnay is a British Columbia white wine produced from Chardonnay grapes. One of the winery's original white wines, it reflects Kettle Valley's focus on flavourful and aromatic whites with a rich mouthfeel, produced from British Columbia fruit at its Naramata winery.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roasted herb chicken, grilled salmon, creamy mushroom pasta, and aged Gruyere.

columbia-valley-merlot.title: L'Ecole No. 41 Merlot 750ml
columbia-valley-merlot.bodyHtml: L'Ecole No. 41 Merlot is a full-bodied, balanced wine with notes of black cherry, plum, and spice. It's known for its complex aromas, rich flavors, and a seamless finish with fine-grained tannins. The wine is often described as having a layered and enticing character, with flavors of dried cherry, blackberry, and baking spice.

kumbaya-red.title: Kumbaya Red 750ml
kumbaya-red.bodyHtml: Kumbaya Red is a 750ml red wine blend from California, often described as having notes of ripe blackberry and red currant with spicy accents. It is considered an easy-to-like, fruity red wine, and it pairs well with beef, lamb, poultry, and deer, according to Strong Water Liquor Warehouse. The wine is noted for its smooth, velvety finish.

kumbaya-white.title: Kumbaya White
kumbaya-white.bodyHtml:
Pale straw in colour with bright, inviting aromas of crisp green apple, ripe pear, white peach, and subtle citrus blossom. The palate is light-bodied, smooth, and easy-drinking, offering juicy orchard and tropical fruit flavours balanced by gentle sweetness and clean, refreshing acidity on a soft, crisp finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast chicken, grilled shrimp skewers, fresh garden salads, mild white fish, creamy pasta dishes, or soft cheeses.

alixir-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
alixir-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a benchmark, expressive California red crafted from estate-owned and grower vineyards across Sonoma County’s sun-drenched Alexander Valley. Vinified in temperature-controlled stainless steel and matured for 24 months exclusively in American oak barrels (roughly 50% new and 50% once-used) sourced from the winery's dedicated Missouri cooperage, it was aged an additional 15 months in bottle prior to release. In the glass, it displays a deep, opaque ruby core with vibrant violet edges. The bouquet reveals intense, inviting aromas of ripe cassis, black cherries, and wild blackberry compote, seamlessly layered over Silver Oak's signature hallmarks of sweet vanilla bean, toasted coconut, dried sage, cedar, and subtle pipe tobacco. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, supple mouthfeel driven by concentrated dark bramble fruit and mocha, framed by fine-grained, velvety tannins and lively natural acidity that lead into an elegant, persistent, and oak-spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, herb-roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild mushroom risotto, and aged sharp white cheddar cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

So full-bodied, ripe and robust, offering spicy, iron-like, black fruit aromas, with generous dark cherries on a firmly tannic palate. Concentrated black plum, graphite, black pepper, coffee bean, pine resin and oak toast flavors on a full body. The tannins are powerful and fine-grained, shaping the texture significantly at this stage. Drinkable now, but best from 2030.

yalumba-christobels-moscato.title: Yalumba Antique Muscat 375ml
yalumba-christobels-moscato.bodyHtml:
Rich and luscious fortified Muscat with intense raisin, fig, caramel and toffee aromas layered with warm spice and nutty complexity. The palate is concentrated and silky, balancing deep sweetness with freshness before a long, warming and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with dark chocolate, sticky date pudding, fruitcake, blue cheese, roasted nuts, caramel desserts, or enjoy after dinner.

radio-boka-tempranillo.title: Radio Boka Tempranillo 3L Bag in Box
radio-boka-tempranillo.bodyHtml: Radio Boka is a ruby red colour with modest aromas of dark cherries, ripe strawberries, plums with hints of sweet spice. The palate is medium-dry, full-bodied with balanced flavours that reflect the nose.

layer-cake-sauvignon-blanc.title: Layer Cake Cabernet Sauvignon 2020/2021 750ml
layer-cake-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
91 Points - James Suckling
"A rich and opulent Cabernet with layers of dark fruit, chocolate, and spice. Full-bodied and velvety with a long, lush finish that truly lives up to its name."

boones-cool-raspberry.title: Boones Cool Raspberry 750ml
boones-cool-raspberry.bodyHtml: Boone's Cool Raspberry is a 750ml bottle of a sweet and fruity wine, typically known for its refreshing and easy-drinking nature. It's popular for its low alcohol content and light body, making it a great choice for those who prefer sweeter wines. The "Cool" in its name likely refers to its chilled serving temperature for optimal enjoyment. Boone's Farm wines are known for their simple, fun, and fruity alternative to traditional wines, often enjoyed at casual gatherings or as a standalone treat.

jinro-chamisul-classic.title: Jinro Chamisul Classic Soju 360ml
jinro-chamisul-classic.bodyHtml: Chamisul Classi is the original traditional soju which is loved since 1924. Chamisul classic Soju's unique quality comes from the bamboo charcoal filter process that ensures purity and clarity. Soju is a white spirit with clean and pure taste, distilled from the best grains.

gauchezco-reserva-malbec.title: Gauchezco Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
gauchezco-reserva-malbec.bodyHtml: Gauchezco Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon is described as a ruby red wine with dark violet overlays. It has an intense and complex nose with notes of green pepper, black cherry, boysenberry, vanilla, and dark chocolate. The wine is well-balanced and harmonious, with sweet and mature tannins and a long, persistent finish. It is recommended to be served at 60°F–64°F (16°C–18°C).

osborne-seven.title: Osborne Seven Cabernet Sauvignon - Tempranillo 750ml
osborne-seven.bodyHtml: Osborne Seven is a Spanish red wine, a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Tempranillo, known for its rich fruit flavors and balanced profile. It typically exhibits aromas of red fruits like cherry and raspberry, with notes of vanilla and chocolate on the finish. The wine is full-bodied with soft tannins and a velvety texture, making it enjoyable for various occasions.

prophecy-pinot-noir.title: Prophecy Pinot Noir 750ml
prophecy-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Prophecy Pinot Noir is a medium-bodied red wine from California known for its balanced, fruity flavors and velvety finish. It offers notes of red cherry, raspberry, and toasted oak, often with hints of spice.

prophecy-sauvignon-blanc.title: Prophecy Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
prophecy-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Prophecy Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant California white wine showcasing refreshing citrus aromas, lively tropical fruit and a beautifully crisp character. Bright notes of grapefruit, lemon and lime mingle with passionfruit, mandarin orange and green apple, complemented by delicate herbal nuances and a subtle touch of white tea. Its fresh acidity and clean, lingering finish make this expressive Sauvignon Blanc an excellent choice for everyday enjoyment.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh oysters, sushi, grilled shrimp, lobster rolls, lemon-herb chicken, goat cheese, seafood salads, lightly seasoned white fish and vegetarian stir-fries.

sortilege-maple-cream.title: Sortilege Maple Cream
sortilege-maple-cream.bodyHtml: Sortilège Maple Cream is a 750ml Canadian whisky liqueur that combines fresh dairy cream, pure Quebec maple syrup, and Canadian whisky. It's known for its smooth, rich, and balanced flavor profile with notes of maple, caramel, and vanilla. The liqueur is popular for sipping on the rocks, adding to coffee, or incorporating into cocktails.

raven-deep-dark-red.title: Raven Deep Dark Red 750ml
raven-deep-dark-red.bodyHtml: Raven Conspiracy Deep Dark Red is a Canadian red blend wine known for its bold, fruit-forward flavors and a smooth, drinkable profile. It features notes of black fruits like cassis, plum, and cherry, along with hints of spice and oak. The wine is often described as having a rich mouthfeel and a dry-ish finish with lingering notes of blackberry, blueberry, and mocha.

granville-english-bay-pale-ale.title: Granville Island English Bay Pale Ale 6 Cans
granville-english-bay-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Granville Island English Bay Pale Ale 6 Cans

midnight-moon-peach.title: Midnight Moon Peach Moonshine
midnight-moon-peach.bodyHtml:
A sweet, fruit-forward celebration of Southern flavor that looks just as incredible as it tastes! Staying true to Junior Johnson’s legendary bootlegging legacy, Piedmont Distillers crafts this expression by taking their ultra-smooth, triple-distilled original corn whiskey and infusing it with real fruit. Instead of relying on artificial syrups or chemical flavorings, every single jar of Midnight Moon Peach actually contains sliced, ripe peaches that soak directly in the moonshine, imparting an incredibly authentic, vibrant color and a deep, natural fruit flavor over time.

Bottled at a highly approachable 70 proof (35% ABV), this moonshine is a massive crowd-pleaser that drinks like a spiked summer dessert. The flavor is bursting with the taste of juicy, sun-ripened peaches, perfectly balanced by the sweet, creamy backbone of the original corn whiskey. It is delicious served chilled straight from the jar, but truly shines when mixed into a pitcher of iced tea or topped with ginger ale for a refreshing porch-sipping cocktail.

midnight-moon-original.title: Midnight Moon Original Moonshine
midnight-moon-original.bodyHtml:
The flagship spirit that helped kickstart the modern craft moonshine revolution! Midnight Moon Original is an authentic, unaged corn whiskey based on the legendary family recipe of Junior Johnson, a famous Prohibition-era bootlegger who used his getaway driving skills to become an early NASCAR superstar. Handcrafted in small batches by Piedmont Distillers, this spirit is made from 100% American corn and undergoes a rigorous triple-distillation process in a copper still to ensure absolute purity and an exceptionally clean profile that leaves the harsh "burn" of traditional white lightning far behind.

Bottled at a smooth 80 proof (40% ABV), Midnight Moon Original is remarkably versatile and easy to drink. It offers a gentle, natural sweetness right out of the jar, with distinct tasting notes of fresh sweet corn, a hint of vanilla, and a surprisingly creamy mouthfeel. It is a fantastic, character-rich substitute for vodka in almost any cocktail, pairs perfectly with simple mixers like lemonade or sweet tea, and is clean enough to be enjoyed neat straight from the iconic mason jar.

inception-white-blend.title: Conundrum White Blend
inception-white-blend.bodyHtml:
Conundrum White Blend pours a vibrant pale straw-gold color in the glass. Created by the legendary Wagner family of Caymus fame, this exotic and highly popular Californian multi-varietal blend delivers an remarkably fragrant bouquet. Layers of ripe apricot, white peach, honeysuckle, and tropical mango mingle with zesty accents of ruby grapefruit, tangerine, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine balances a rich, round, and texturally generous medium-to-full body with a crisp vein of natural acidity. Luscious orchard fruits and a touch of off-dry melon sweetness flow into a beautifully clean, bright, and persistent finish marked by a subtle, refreshing minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spicy Thai coconut curry, grilled chicken with mango salsa, blackened Cajun shrimp, or fresh fish tacos.

young-brute-red-blend.title: Young Brute Red Blend 750ml
young-brute-red-blend.bodyHtml: Young Brute Red Blend is a full-bodied red wine from the Casella family in South Eastern Australia. It's a Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon blend, known for its robust, juicy character and youthful aromas of mint, crush leaves, and ripe dark fruits, according to Dan Murphy's. The blend is typically 80% Shiraz and 20% Cabernet Sauvignon.

le-petit-berticot-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Chateau Smith Haut Lafitte Le Petit Smith Haut Lafitte 2019
le-petit-berticot-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Le Petit Smith Haut Lafitte is the elegant second wine of Château Smith Haut Lafitte, offering expressive aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, black cherry, cedar, graphite, tobacco, violet, and subtle baking spice. Richly textured yet beautifully approachable, it delivers silky tannins, vibrant freshness, refined balance, and a long, polished finish with classic Pessac-Léognan character.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled ribeye, roast lamb, beef Wellington, duck breast, mushroom risotto, aged Comté, braised short ribs, or roasted root vegetables.

 

94  Points - James Suckling

Spices, such as cloves and white pepper, with violets and dark fruit follow through to a full body with firm, chewy tannins and a polished yet intense finish. Open tannins. An ash-like undertone to it.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

As one of the two second wines from this organic estate, Cabernet Sauvignon dominates this wine. It has structured black currant fruits as well as a beautiful pure line of acidity. The structure, while there, is open and integrated, meaning the wine will age well over the medium-term.
93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The more Cabernet Sauvignon-dominated second wine, the 2019 Le Petit Haut Lafitte is dense purple. with a promising bouquet of cassis, cedary spice, tobacco leaf, and background oak. It picks up some classic Graves scorched earth notes as it sits in the glass and is medium to full-bodied, has a concentrated, layered, balanced mouthfeel, and a great finish. A serious, impressive wine, it will benefit from 2-3 years of bottle age and drink brilliantly over the following 10-15. Best After 2024

92 Points - Decanter

Closed up on the opening bars, a little more austere than the 2018 with tight tannins but opens up to show elegance and balance, and the juicy salinity on the finish that has become so characteristic of Smith Haut Lafitte across its range of wines.
91 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe and silky, with alluring warmed cassis and mulled plum flavors and a red licorice accent. The finish, which is carried by lightly singed cedar and grilled savory notes, lets the fruit have the upper hand. Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Drink now.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

More serious than the forward Les Hauts de Smith, the 2019 Le Petit Haut Lafitte contains only 40% Merlot, with the balance Cabernet Sauvignon. Exhibiting aromas of crème de cassis, sweet berries, cocoa nib, pencil shavings and loamy soil, it's medium to full-bodied, lively and concentrated, with a more structured, reserved profile but more incipient complexity too. Best after 2023.

cariboo-blonde.title: Cariboo Blonde 6 Cans
cariboo-blonde.bodyHtml: Cariboo Blonde is an easy-drinking, all-season lager, described as a "white gold" color with a crisp, light malt finish. It's brewed according to purity law standards using natural spring water. This blonde lager is available in both BC and Alberta.

fleur-du-cap-chardonnay.title: Bergkelder Fleur Du Cap Chardonnay 2021 750ml
fleur-du-cap-chardonnay.bodyHtml: The wine has a light straw yellow colour with tints of green and gold. On the nose it shows lovely citrus notes with a touch of tropical fruit aromas and ends with a hint of oak spices. This medium-bodied Chardonnay is highly fruit driven whilst the wood adds to the fullness without dominating it. Beautiful balance between sweetness and acidity is complemented by a lingering aftertaste.

le-tremble-rose.title: Le Tremble Rose 1L
le-tremble-rose.bodyHtml: Le Tremble Rosé is a wine known for its pale pink color, medium intensity, and notes of strawberry, melon, and cream. It is described as dry, with medium-plus acidity and a medium body and intensity. The wine is fruity and can exhibit flavors of strawberry, raspberry, peach, apple, and grapefruit. It's often enjoyed in the backyard, with charcuterie, or as an aperitif.

invivo-sauvignon-blanc-marlborough.title: Invivo Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc
invivo-sauvignon-blanc-marlborough.bodyHtml:
Invivo Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant Marlborough white offering rockmelon, guava, passionfruit, lime, grapefruit, citrus peel, and fresh herbs. The palate is juicy and refreshing, with bright acidity, tropical fruit, lively texture, balanced concentration, and a crisp, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Oysters, prawns, grilled fish, sushi, ceviche, goat cheese, fresh salads, Thai cuisine, and lightly spiced Southeast Asian dishes.

silver-lining-white.title: Silver Lining White 750ml
silver-lining-white.bodyHtml: The "Silver Lining White 750ml" is a Chardonnay wine from California, specifically the Sonoma County region. It is known for its creamy texture and bright acidity, with flavors of golden apple, toasted oak, and hints of banana cream pie. The Belle Côte version, which is part of the Silver Lining line, is described as having lemon drop, pie crust, and toasted meringue notes, according to WineMadeEasy.com.

silver-lining-rose.title: Silver Lining Rose 750ml
silver-lining-rose.bodyHtml: The "Rainstorm Silver Linings Rosé" is a 750ml bottle described as having notes of strawberry, rose petals, and pomegranate seeds, with a crisp and lush flavor profile that is completely dry and refreshing, according to BevMo! and Gopuff. It's classified as a Rosé & Blush wine.

silver-lining-red.title: Silver Lining Red 750ml
silver-lining-red.bodyHtml: The "Silver Lining Red 750ml" is a wine blend from The View Winery, known for its smooth, fruit-forward profile. It's made from Baco Noir, Pinotage, and Merlot, offering a blend of dark cherry, ripe plum, and a hint of spice. The winery describes it as an "easy-drinking crowd pleaser" with a bright and uplifting finish.

screw-it-the-red.title: Screw It! Shiraz 4L Bag In Box

corte-di-giacobbe-pinot-grigio.title: Tenuta Di Corte Giacobbe Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie 750ml
corte-di-giacobbe-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Tenuta di Corte Giacobbe Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie is a crisp, dry white wine with a bright straw yellow color and green hues. It features a refreshing profile with floral and fruit notes of pear syrup and banana. The palate is balanced with a salty-acid balance and a vibrant minerality.

the-glenlivet-founders-reserve.title: The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve 1.14L
the-glenlivet-founders-reserve.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve is an exceptionally smooth, bright, and approachable Speyside single malt Scotch whisky created as a tribute to the distillery's pioneering founder, George Smith. To capture the signature fruitiness and elegant character of the original 1824 expression, this non-age-statement malt is distilled in The Glenlivet's classic lantern-shaped copper pot stills. The spirit is then matured in a combination of traditional oak casks alongside a high proportion of first-fill American white oak ex-bourbon barrels. This specialized wood selection infuses the whisky with creamy vanilla sweetness and subtle tropical undertones, making it a highly accessible and delightfully smooth dram for both newcomers and seasoned whisky enthusiasts alike.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light lemon tarts, creamy brie or Camembert cheeses, roasted chicken with herbs, or a traditional vanilla panna cotta.

Tasting Notes : Pale gold in color with a smooth, light, and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Citrus fruit, sweet orange, pear, zesty lime, and a hint of delicate oak.

Palate : Smooth and creamy with flavors of sweet orange, pear, red apple, toffee, and subtle vanilla.

Finish : Long, smooth, and clean with lingering oak warmth and gentle fruit sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, over ice, or with a few drops of water.

canyon-road-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Canyon Road Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
canyon-road-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Canyon Road Cabernet Sauvignon is a red wine from California, known for its ripe raspberry flavors, smooth finish, and easy-drinking nature. It is a medium-bodied wine with notes of blackberries and cherries, often described as approachable and suitable for casual occasions. The wine's flavors are supported by smooth tannins, and it can pair well with grilled meats, hearty cheeses, and spicy foods.

canyon-road-pinot-grigio.title: Canyon Road Pinot Grigio 750ml
canyon-road-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: The wine showcases a pale, straw-yellow hue, signaling its light and refreshing nature. Aromatic notes of lemon zest, green apple, and pear greet the nose, complemented by a hint of floral undertones that add depth and complexity.

captain-morgan-spiked-root-beer.title: Captain Morgan Original Spiced Rum 1.75L
captain-morgan-spiked-root-beer.bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan Original Spiced Rum is a world-renowned Caribbean classic, celebrated for its warm, approachable, and smooth character. Expertly blended with a secret recipe of mellow Caribbean rums, natural spices, and a hint of vanilla, it is aged in charred white oak barrels to create a perfectly balanced spirit that has become a staple of casual gatherings and vibrant cocktails.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoky barbecue ribs, jerk chicken, pulled pork sliders, or spicy buffalo wings. For dessert, it beautifully complements dark chocolate brownies, pecan pie, or a warm bread pudding.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber appearance with a smooth, light, and easy-drinking body on the palate.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, brown sugar, subtle toasted oak, cinnamon, and gentle baking spices.

Palate : Smooth and sweet featuring dominant vanilla, warm caramel, brown sugar, rich oak, and light spice accents.

Finish : Smooth and medium in length with a clean, warm finish of lingering vanilla and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve mixed with cola over fresh ice with a lime wedge, or as a classic cocktail base.

captain-morgan-spiked-cola.title: Captain Morgan Original Spiced Rum 1.75L
captain-morgan-spiked-cola.bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan Original Spiced Rum is a world-renowned Caribbean classic, celebrated for its warm, approachable, and smooth character. Nose : Sweet vanilla, brown sugar, subtle toasted oak, cinnamon, and gentle baking spices.

Palate : Smooth and sweet featuring dominant vanilla, warm caramel, brown sugar, rich oak, and light spice accents.

Finish : Smooth and medium in length with a clean, warm finish of lingering vanilla and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve mixed with cola over fresh ice with a lime wedge, or as a classic cocktail base.

captain-morgan-spiked-tea.bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan Original Spiced Rum is a world-renowned Caribbean classic, celebrated for its warm, approachable, and smooth character.
