Palate : Smooth and sweet featuring dominant vanilla, warm caramel, brown sugar, rich oak, and light spice accents.

Finish : Smooth and medium in length with a clean, warm finish of lingering vanilla and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve mixed with cola over fresh ice with a lime wedge, or as a classic cocktail base.

yellow-tail-cool-crisp-white.title: Yellow Tail Cool Crisp White 750ml
yellow-tail-cool-crisp-white.bodyHtml: Yellow Tail Cool Crisp White is described as a vibrant and easy-drinking white wine with crisp and zesty flavors of tropical and citrus fruits. It has a fresh, creamy finish and is often paired with light salads, fruit salads, or gelato, according to Manila Wine.

blass-cabernet-sauvignon-by-wolf-blass.title: Wolf Blass Yellow Label Cabernet Sauvignon
blass-cabernet-sauvignon-by-wolf-blass.bodyHtml:
Wolf Blass Yellow Label Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic, approachable, and fruit-driven Australian red wine that consistently delivers excellent value and quality. Pouring a deep crimson with subtle purple hues in the glass, it opens with an inviting and aromatic bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, dark plums, and blackberries, layered with classic varietal notes of subtle mint, cedar, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, showcasing a generous mid-palate filled with rich dark fruit flavors alongside a touch of mocha and vanilla from well-integrated oak aging. Supported by smooth, finely textured tannins and balanced acidity, it culminates in a lingering, satisfyingly smooth finish.

Food Pairing: This highly versatile and food-friendly Cabernet Sauvignon pairs wonderfully with grilled or roasted meats such as steaks, lamb chops, and gourmet beef burgers. It is also a fantastic companion for hearty meat-based pasta dishes, savory stews, and a selection of firm, aged cheeses like sharp Cheddar.

mill-st-vanilla-porter.title: Mill St Vanilla Porter 440ml
mill-st-vanilla-porter.bodyHtml: Mill St Vanilla Porter is a smooth, English-style dark ale, nitrogen-charged for a creamy texture. It's brewed with pure vanilla extract, offering a unique flavor profile. This popular beer, often a winter favorite, is available in a 440ml can, according to Untappd.

catena-malbec-vista-flores.title: Catena Appellation Vista Flores Malbec 2023
catena-malbec-vista-flores.bodyHtml: Catena Appellation Vista Flores Malbec 2023 is a deep and expressive red that showcases the structured, dark-fruited character of the Vista Flores district in the Uco Valley. Sourced from vineyards at 1,100 meters elevation, this vintage is defined by its vibrant energy and tangy freshness. It features an intense bouquet of fresh blackberries, cherries, and lavender, seamlessly layered with nuanced notes of graphite, mocha, and dried herbs. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and juicy, showcasing a silky texture with firm, well-integrated tannins and a crisp acidity that provides exceptional length and focus on the finish.

jaboulet-parallele-45-white.title: Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aine Parallele 45 Blanc
jaboulet-parallele-45-white.bodyHtml:
Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aîné Parallèle 45 Blanc is a fresh, vibrant, and aromatic organic white wine that beautifully captures the essence of the Southern Rhône Valley. Pouring a brilliant pale gold color with soft green highlights, it features a lively bouquet bursting with notes of white peach, crisp pear, lemon citrus, and delicate white flowers, subtly grounded by a gentle touch of stony minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and beautifully balanced, offering an elegant, rounded texture that never feels heavy. A juicy core of stone fruit and citrus oil is uplifted by a crisp, lively acidity, finishing clean and refreshing with a lingering, snappy touch of grapefruit zest and aromatic garden herbs.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared white fish, fresh oysters, grilled scallops, creamy spring vegetable risottos, and a selection of soft goat cheeses.

longhand-pinot-grigio.title: Longshot Pinot Grigio 750ml
longhand-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Carefully selected grapes from premier California vineyards give this popular white wine varietal a crisp, elegant taste. This easy-to-sip wine has its own distinct delicate flavour making it famous for its endless pair-ability. A light Pinot Grigio wine with subtle notes of apple and citrus are complemented with hints of lemon resulting in a soft elegant finish.

longhand-cabernet-merlot.title: Santa Carolina Long Country Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot 1L
longhand-cabernet-merlot.bodyHtml:
A smooth Chilean Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot blend from Santa Carolina's Long Country range. Ripe blackberry and cherry combine with vanilla, cocoa and gentle oak, while soft tannins and balanced acidity create a medium-bodied, approachable red with a satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled meats, beef stew, lamb, sausages, hearty pasta, roasted vegetables and charcuterie.

big-house-zin-in-a-can.title: Big House Zin In A Can 250ml
big-house-zin-in-a-can.bodyHtml:
Big House Cardinal Zin Zinfandel 250ml Can is a fruit-forward California red wine produced by The Wine Group under the Big House Wines label. Presented in a convenient single-serve can, this approachable red offers aromas of smoky plum, black cherry, dried herbs, and gentle oak spice. Its medium-bodied palate combines ripe berry flavours, vanilla, and soft tannins, making it a versatile choice for barbecues, picnics, and casual entertaining. The 250ml format delivers a convenient alternative to a traditional wine bottle.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, grilled burgers, beef skewers, tomato-based pasta, pepperoni pizza, aged cheddar, and roasted vegetables.

Tasting Notes: Fruity and medium-bodied, featuring ripe plum, black cherry, mixed berries, dried herbs, and subtle vanilla.

Nose: Smoky plum, black cherry, sweet dried herbs, and gentle oak spice.

Palate: Ripe berries, dark cherry, plum, vanilla, and soft tannins.

Finish: Smooth and fruity, with lingering berry flavours and subtle spice.

Serve: Serve slightly cool at approximately 14–16°C in a red wine glass or enjoy directly from the can.

big-house-pinot-grigio-in-a-can.title: House Wine Co. Riesling Pinot Grigio
big-house-pinot-grigio-in-a-can.bodyHtml:
House Wine Co. Riesling Pinot Grigio shows floral aromas with mineral undertones and bright lemony citrus character. Dry and medium-bodied, the palate is refreshing and easy drinking, with clean acidity and a lively profile. Its fresh citrus and floral qualities provide a crisp, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled shrimp, fresh seafood salads, butter chicken, or pork ramen.

menage-a-trois-silk.title: Ménage à Trois Silk Soft Red Blend 2021 750ml
menage-a-trois-silk.bodyHtml: Ménage à Trois Silk Soft Red Blend is a smooth and seductive red wine blend. It's characterized by its bright red ruby hue and aromas of dried violets and berries. The wine features flavors of succulent cherry and ripe raspberry, along with hints of rose petals and toasty spice, creating a luxurious and full-bodied experience.

mad-jack-crazy-good-mixer-pack.title: Hey Y'All Hell Yeah! Mixer Pack

batasiolo-piemonte-doc-rosato.title: Beni di Batasiolo Piemonte Rosato 2018 750ml
batasiolo-piemonte-doc-rosato.bodyHtml:
Wine with a delicate pink colour and supple taste on the palate reminiscent of fresh fruit.

A beautifully luminous pale rose hue. Offering notes of sour cherry and strawberry, rose water and hints of wisteria swathed in a generously mineral flavour. Soft, but lively on the palate, fresh syrupy at the same time. A vibrant taste, with perfect nose-palate balance with a long aftertaste modulated by surprising returns of woodland strawberries.

85 Points - Decanter

jaw-drop-orange.title: Jaw Drop Orange 6 Cans
jaw-drop-orange.bodyHtml: Clear, medium orange colour; aromas of citrus and candied oranges; lightly carbonated with balanced flavours of citrus, orange juice and candied orange peel lead to a tangy finish.

jaw-drop-pink.title: Jaw Drop Pink 6 Cans
jaw-drop-pink.bodyHtml: Jaw Drop Tickling Pink is a vibrant and refreshing vodka cocktail that blends the nostalgic taste of front-porch lemonade with tart raspberries and a zingy sour candy twist. Perfect for hot summer days and lively nights, this bold and juicy drink delivers just the right balance of sweetness and tang.

jaw-drop-lemon.title: Lume Pink Lemon Drop
jaw-drop-lemon.bodyHtml:
Lume Pink Lemon Drop is a raspberry-kissed take on the classic lemon drop shot, crafted in Canada by The Fort Distillery as the newest member of the Lume range. It is made with real vodka and real lemon plus natural flavours and colours, giving a raspberry lemonade twist that is ready to pour straight from the bottle. Bottled at 20% ABV in a 750ml glass bottle, it can be served as a chilled shot or poured over ice.

Tasting Notes: Raspberry lemonade, bright and tangy.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, or over ice with fresh raspberries.

twist-of-fate-malbec-merlot.title: Switchback Ridge Peterson Family Vineyard Merlot 2017 750ml
twist-of-fate-malbec-merlot.bodyHtml: Intense aromas of ripe black fruits are complemented by very pretty floral notes. The rich mid-palate is a pleasant flood of texture and flavor with an explosive bright natural acidity. The tannin is quite soft and frames a subtle hint of espresso and toffee in the finish. This Merlot is very Cabernet-like with added fullness in the middle and beautiful balance.

las-nencias-reserve-malbec.title: Trivento Golden Reserve Malbec 2023
las-nencias-reserve-malbec.bodyHtml:
Trivento Golden Reserve Malbec 2023 is a premium, estate-grown Argentinian red wine that presents an intense, deep red color with vibrant violet hues. The aromatic profile is highly expressive, unfolding with sharp layers of fresh red and dark fruits like raspberries, blackberries, and spiced black cherries, woven together with subtle notes of chocolate, lavender, graphite, and toasted hazelnut from careful oak aging. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied experience with a juicy, rounded structure and firm, energetic tannins that lead into a remarkably smooth and lengthy finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri sauce, roasted lamb cutlets, barbecued brisket, empanadas, and strong, hard cheeses like aged Gouda or Manchego.

93 Points - James Suckling

Some fine spices with a touch of cocoa powder to the black cherries and berries. Medium- to full-bodied with plenty of juicy blue fruit and firm, fresh tannins. Solid fruit in the lengthy finish. Really well-balanced. Drink now or hold.

vin-vault-pinot-grigio.title: Vintage Ink Pinot Grigio 750ml
vin-vault-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Crafted using winemaking techniques that defy tradition, being original is what Vintage Ink is all about. It’s in the distinct character and flavours found in their wines. It’s the adventurous people who create them and the stories told through the captivating labels on each wine bottle. It’s the unique people who enjoy Vintage Ink. The ones who challenge conventions and who dare to be different.

apothic-inferno.title: Apothic Inferno
apothic-inferno.bodyHtml:
A bold California red with layers of ripe dark fruit, blackberry, plum, vanilla, and baking spice accented by distinctive whiskey-barrel character. The palate is rich and full-bodied, with smoky oak, warmth, smooth tannins, and a lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with barbecue ribs, grilled steak, smoked brisket, burgers, braised beef, spicy dishes, roasted meats, and aged cheddar.

raven-smooth-bright-white.title: Raven Smooth Bright White 750ml
raven-smooth-bright-white.bodyHtml: Raven Conspiracy Smooth Bright White is a blend of British Columbia grapes, characterized by its smooth, fruity flavors and a slight copper hue. It's a light to medium-bodied wine with notes of peach, melon, and kiwi. The wine is aged in stainless steel to preserve its aromatics, and some skin contact is used to add interesting flavors and textures.

clifford-bay-sauvignon-blanc.title: Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2025
clifford-bay-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc delivering the classic precision and expressive aromatic depth that redefined New Zealand winemaking. Visually gleaming with a pale straw color and faint green reflections, the exceptionally lifted nose bursts with a complex bouquet of ruby grapefruit, zesty Key lime, lemongrass, and fresh passion fruit, grounded by subtle notes of elderflower and crushed stone minerals. On the palate, this medium-bodied white is remarkably sleek, fresh, and focused, driving a succulent core of stone fruit and crunchy citrus flavors across a finely textured mouthfeel. Kept beautifully tense by a vitalizing line of mouthwatering lemon acidity and a delicate, signature salinity, it glides into a highly persistent, crisp finish showing lingering hints of green tea and fresh lime leaf.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with fresh oysters on the half shell, green lip mussels, goat cheese salads, or Thai prawn salad dressed with lemongrass and ginger.

 

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2025 Sauvignon Blanc is fleshy and intense, as is the style of Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc, and there is enough savory extract and shape in the wine to elevate it beyond the norm. Here, we have grass clippings and brine, green olive tapenade, passion fruit and pineapple husk. The acidity is saline, and all elements work together toward a common goal. I recall, in context, this wine looking a little sweeter and fleshier than some of its regional peers, and yet here today in isolation, it looks tight, textural and composed. It's very good indeed. Cloudy Bay is a member of the Appellation Marlborough Wine (AMW). 13% alcohol.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Concentrated and fragrant, with lemongrass, lemon verbena and celery salt notes to complement the pineapple, mango and lemon curd flavors, plus a touch of orange sherbet. Gains momentum on the long, expressive finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Vivid, round and juicy, with lemons, limes, fresh herbs and some mild spices on the nose, following through to a medium body with fresh acidity. Lively and succulent, with a delicious finish packed with limes. Drink now. Screw cap.

mi-terruno-uvas-malbec.title: Mi Terruno Uvas Malbec
mi-terruno-uvas-malbec.bodyHtml:
Vibrant red with violet hues. The aromas are a mic of red fruit and fresh herbs. The palate is well-balanced in the mouth with firm and silky tannins. Pairs well with stews or spicy red meats.

This fruity red has aromas of fresh plums, currants and oranges. It’s medium-bodied, crunchy and straightforward.

mi-terruno-uvas-cabernet.title: Mi Terruno Uvas Cabernet Sauvignon
mi-terruno-uvas-cabernet.bodyHtml:
A great daily drinker from the Maipu region of Mendoza, Argentina!  This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon has a deep claret colour with reddish hues.  The nose is a fine mix of aromatic herbs with pepper and red fruit.  The palate is smooth with thick tannins followed by a long, drawn-out velvety finish.  Enjoy it with seasoned pork or roast lamb with mint sauce.  

This dark-fruited red has aromas of black cherries, mint and cocoa. It’s medium-bodied with grainy tannins. A little rustic.

jack-daniels-master-distiller-3.title: Jack Daniel's Master Distiller Edition #3
jack-daniels-master-distiller-3.bodyHtml: Jack Daniel's Master Distiller Edition #3, a 750ml bottle, is a limited edition release that celebrates the third Master Distiller, Lemuel "Lem" Tolley, who served from 1941 to 1964. This specific release is part of a series honoring all seven Master Distillers in the history of the Jack Daniel Distillery. The whiskey is known for its smooth, aromatic start, soft and harmonious flavor, and medium-long finish with a hint of spice.

edge-fx-vodka.title: Deep Eddy Ruby Red Grapefruit Vodka
edge-fx-vodka.bodyHtml:
Deep Eddy Ruby Red Grapefruit Vodka is made in Austin, Texas by Deep Eddy Distilling Co. It starts with the brand's award-winning Original Vodka, distilled from corn, which is then blended with real ruby red grapefruit juice for a flavour that is both sweet and tart. Bottled at 35% ABV (70 proof) in a 750ml bottle, it is a bright, easy mixer for summer drinks.

Tasting Notes: Sweet and tart ruby red grapefruit.

Serve: With soda and a squeeze of lime, or in a Ruby Paloma with silver tequila, grapefruit and lime juice topped with club soda.

wallaroo-trail-shiraz.title: Barossa Valley Estate Shiraz
wallaroo-trail-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Barossa Valley Estate Shiraz captures the distinctive elegance, finesse, and vibrant fruit flavors of one of Australia's most celebrated wine regions. Grown in ancient red friable clay soils, this contemporary red wine displays striking characteristics of rich dark plum, fresh blackberry, and black pepper, complemented by enticing notes of vanilla and cedar spice. It features a dense fruit core with a soft, velvety texture and smooth tannins derived from careful aging in French oak, making it highly expressive upon release while retaining excellent cellaring potential.

Food Pairing: Perfectly matched with grilled steak, roasted lamb loin, gourmet sausages, charcuterie boards, barbecued meats, or rich peppercorn sauces and aged cheeses.

carnvior-zinfandel.title: Carnvior Zinfandel 750ml
carnvior-zinfandel.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2021 vintage) "Opulent, concentrated blackberry jam, black currant, cardamom, dried florals on the nose. The massive blueberry, boysenberry compote, baked peaches, cinnamon, coats the palate falling into layers of dark chocolate, coffee, vanilla cream with silky tannins and a dry finish. Pair with grilled meats." - 90/100, Wine Enthusiast

fernie-brewing-slow-drift-witbier.title: Fernie Brewing Campout West Coast Pale

line-39-pinot-noir.title: Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023
line-39-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023 is a classic, expressive, and finely structured French red wine produced by the prestigious Domaine Faiveley. Displaying a beautiful bright ruby-red color, it opens with pleasant and generous aromas of fresh red cherries, ripe raspberries, and redcurrants, accompanied by subtle nuances of violets, wild herbs, and delicate earthy forest floor notes. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, medium-bodied mouthfeel featuring juicy red fruit flavors, a well-defined line of refreshing acidity, and fine, rounded tannins that lead into a smooth, clean, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken, duck breast, pork tenderloin, seared salmon, wild mushroom risotto, charcuterie, and mild semi-firm cheeses.

breezer-cherry-lemonade.title: Breezer Tropical Orange Smoothie 1L
breezer-cherry-lemonade.bodyHtml: Breezer Tropical Orange Smoothie is a premium cooler made with Bacardi rum. It features a dreamy blend of orange and vanilla flavours, creating a taste that is reminiscent of a classic orange creamsicle. This ready-to-drink cocktail is best served well chilled for a refreshing, smooth experience

breezer-juicy-mango.title: Breezer Tropical Orange Smoothie 1L
breezer-juicy-mango.bodyHtml: Breezer Tropical Orange Smoothie is a premium cooler made with Bacardi rum. It features a dreamy blend of orange and vanilla flavours, creating a taste that is reminiscent of a classic orange creamsicle. This ready-to-drink cocktail is best served well chilled for a refreshing, smooth experience

kindeli-blanco.title: Kindeli Blanco 750ml
kindeli-blanco.bodyHtml: Kindeli Blanco is a dry, light-bodied white wine blend from New Zealand, often made with a mix of Riesling and Sauvignon Blanc grapes. It's known for its fresh, bright flavors with hints of citrus and green apple, and can be enjoyed well-chilled. The wine is typically produced using organic and biodynamic farming practices, and may involve some skin-contact during the winemaking process.

prophecy-pinot-grigio.title: Prophecy Pinot Grigio 2021
prophecy-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Prophecy Pinot Grigio 2021 is a vibrant, crisp, and beautifully balanced white wine produced from select vineyards across northeastern Italy's Delle Venezie region. In the glass, it displays a pale straw-yellow color with brilliant clarity. The inviting bouquet opens with aromas of fresh citrus zest, green apple, white peach, and subtle floral undertones. On the palate, it is light-to-medium-bodied and refreshingly dry, delivering clean flavors of juicy pear, lemon, and white stone fruit supported by lively natural acidity and a touch of wet-stone minerality on the crisp finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with grilled shrimp, light seafood pasta, caprese salad, prosciutto with melon, fresh goat cheese, and lemon-herb chicken dishes.

barefoot-sangria.title: Barefoot Sangria 750ml
barefoot-sangria.bodyHtml: Barefoot Sangria (750 ml) is a red wine blend ready to drink, offering a classic sangria flavor without the need for extra preparation. It features a blend of zesty citrus fruits like oranges, lemons, limes, and grapefruit, with hints of pineapple. This sangria pairs well with various foods, including pizza, meatballs, and fried calamari, and is best served chilled or over ice.

smirnoff-sourced-cranberry-apple-vodka.title: Smirnoff Green Apple Vodka 375ml
smirnoff-sourced-cranberry-apple-vodka.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Green Apple is a green apple flavoured vodka beverage made with Smirnoff's triple-distilled vodka. This 375 ml flask is bottled at 35% ABV in Quebec, a handy size for mixing a few apple martinis or highballs.

Serve: Shaken with sour mix for a green apple martini, or over ice with soda or ginger ale.

smirnoff-sourced-grapefruit-vodka.title: Smirnoff Berry Blast Vodka
smirnoff-sourced-grapefruit-vodka.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Berry Blast vodka is loaded with vibrant cherry, citrus and blue raspberry flavours. The nostalgic flavours combined with Smirnoff vodka are persistent on the palate with a refreshing fruity note. Best served chilled or enjoy over crushed ice in a fresh and fruity cocktail.

smirnoff-sourced-orange-vodka.title: Smirnoff Orange Vodka
smirnoff-sourced-orange-vodka.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Orange is an orange flavoured vodka from Smirnoff's Classic Flavours range, made with the brand's triple distilled vodka and infused with six varieties of mandarin and navel orange flavours. Bottled at 35% ABV in a 750 ml bottle, it brings a bright, zesty citrus character to any drink. Pair it with cranberry or pineapple juice, top it with soda for a light highball, or use it as the base for an orange-twist Screwdriver or Cosmopolitan. Serve well chilled over ice with an orange slice.

Tasting Notes: Zesty mandarin and navel orange.

Serve: Over ice with soda, cranberry or pineapple juice.

norton-1895-coleccion-malbec.title: Norton 1895 Coleccion Malbec
norton-1895-coleccion-malbec.bodyHtml: The Norton 1895 Colección Malbec is an approachable, fruit-forward red wine created to pay tribute to the founding year of Bodega Norton. Sourced from estate vineyards in the foothills of the Andes, it is designed as an "everyday" wine that captures the fresh spirit of Argentine Malbec. The wine is known for its deep red colour with violet hints and a nose that offers sweet and spicy aromas of black pepper and ripe red fruit. On the palate, it provides smooth, harmonious tannins and flavours of plum and black cherry, making it a versatile pairing for grilled meats, roasted pork, or savory BBQ dishes.

gerard-bertrand-terroir-corbieres.title: Gerard Bertrand An 806 Corbieres
gerard-bertrand-terroir-corbieres.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand An 806 Corbières is a robust and beautifully structured Mediterranean red blend that pays homage to the profound history of the South of France. The name "An 806" marks the first recorded traces of the Peyrepertuse Castle, a majestic Cathar legacy that still overlooks the vineyards today. Masterfully crafted from hand-harvested Grenache, Syrah, and Mourvèdre grown on schist and limestone soils, this wine reveals a deep, intense ruby-red hue in the glass. The bouquet is highly expressive and powerful, offering a rich tapestry of exceptionally ripe black fruits like blackberries, dark cherries, and plums, seamlessly interwoven with savory notes of Mediterranean garrigue herbs, warm mocha, and toasted coffee derived from careful oak maturation. On the palate, it is full-bodied, generous, and perfectly balanced, showcasing a beautiful roundness on the attack and beautifully soft, velvety tannins. It culminates in a deeply flavorful, lingering finish accented by subtle hints of sweet baking spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled red meats, traditional slow-cooked tajines, rich hearty stews, roasted duck, or a selection of mature artisan cheeses.

palm-bay-strawberry-kiwi-iced-tea.title: Palm Bay Strawberry Kiwi Iced Tea 6 Cans
palm-bay-strawberry-kiwi-iced-tea.bodyHtml: Palm Bay Strawberry Kiwi Iced Tea 6 Cans

glengoyne-cask-strength-highland.title: Glengoyne 10 Year Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
glengoyne-cask-strength-highland.bodyHtml: Fresh green apples, toffee and a hint of nuttiness. This is the taste of distilling slower than anyone else in Scotland, of barley we dry by air – never peat – and of hand-selected sherry casks crafted from European and American oak.

naked-grape-sangria.title: Naked Grape Merlot 750ml
naked-grape-sangria.bodyHtml:
Naked Grape Merlot is a smooth and approachable red wine, offering rich fruit flavors balanced with soft tannins, making it perfect for casual sipping or pairing with a variety of dishes.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Deep ruby red with a vibrant and inviting appearance.

  • Aromas: Enticing scents of black cherry, plum, and a hint of vanilla from oak aging.

  • Palate: Smooth and velvety, with flavors of ripe red fruit, including blackberry and cherry, complemented by subtle hints of oak and spice. The finish is soft, with a well-rounded mouthfeel.

Wine Profile:

  • Region: California, USA

  • Varietal: Merlot

  • Alcohol: Approx. 13.5%

  • Bottle Size: 750ml

Food Pairing:

Perfect for pairing with grilled meats, pasta dishes with red sauce, roast chicken, and cheeses like cheddar or brie.

Naked Grape Merlot is a versatile and easy-to-enjoy red wine, great for everyday occasions, casual meals, or even a quiet evening of relaxation. Its smooth character makes it a crowd-pleaser at gatherings or dinners.

terres-de-saint-louis-provence-rose.title: Chateau Mont-Redon Cotes de Provence Saint Max Rose 2025
terres-de-saint-louis-provence-rose.bodyHtml:
A vibrant Provençal rosé crafted by Château Mont-Redon, Saint Max Rosé offers fragrant aromas of wild strawberry, raspberry, watermelon, pink grapefruit, white peach, citrus blossom, and fresh herbs. Crisp and beautifully balanced, it delivers refreshing acidity, delicate minerality, and a clean, elegant finish perfect for warm-weather enjoyment.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled shrimp, Niçoise salad, sushi, roast chicken, fresh goat cheese, Mediterranean seafood, light pasta dishes, or summer vegetables.

red-truck-ale.title: Red Truck West Coast Pale Ale 30L

liberado-verdejo-sauvignon-blanc.title: Unshackled Sauvignon Blanc by The Prisoner 2021 750ml
liberado-verdejo-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Gooseberry, lychee, white flowers on the nose. Crisp acidity, with soft but rich mouthfeel, ripe pineapple, crisp pear, gooseberry finish. Albariño, Malvasia Bianca and Chardonnay blended in.

88 Points - CellarTracker

guinness-hop-house-13.title: Guinness Hop House 13 500ml
guinness-hop-house-13.bodyHtml: Guinness Hop House 13 is a double-hopped lager with a crisp, full-flavored taste and a refreshing, fruity aroma. It's known for its hints of apricot and peach, making it a distinct and flavorful lager. The beer is brewed at the St. James's Gate Brewery in Dublin, using Irish barley and a combination of hops. It's named after a 100-year-old building at St. James's Gate that was used to store hops.

lindemans-bin-45-cabernet.title: Lindeman's Bin 45 Cabernet Sauvignon
lindemans-bin-45-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Lindeman's Bin 45 Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptionally approachable, full-bodied, and fruit-forward Australian red wine that consistently delivers remarkable value and reliable, everyday-drinking enjoyment. Sourced from the broad, sun-drenched vineyards of the South Eastern Australia wine region, this classic expression showcases a deep ruby red color in the glass. The highly inviting aromatic bouquet opens with robust notes of dark ripe berries, juicy blackcurrant, and fresh dark plum, beautifully interwoven with subtle hints of cool mint, warm vanilla, and a touch of toasted cedar oak. On the palate, the wine is delightfully smooth and well-rounded, offering a generous core of dark fruit flavors that are perfectly supported by soft, velvety tannins. A gentle, balanced acidity carries this highly versatile profile through to a clean, crowd-pleasing finish laced with a whisper of spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic grilled hamburgers, hearty beef stews, slow-roasted leg of lamb, rich tomato-based pasta dishes, and mature cheddar cheese.

19-crimes-the-banished.title: 19 Crimes The Banished Dark Red 750ml
19-crimes-the-banished.bodyHtml: Full and round on the palate with a distinct sweetness making the wine rich and mouth coating. The dark chocolate and vanilla aromatics compliment subtle flavours of cloves and cinnamon spice.

gauchezco-oro-malbec.title: Trivento Golden Reserve Malbec 2023
gauchezco-oro-malbec.bodyHtml:
Trivento Golden Reserve Malbec 2023 is a premium, estate-grown Argentinian red wine that presents an intense, deep red color with vibrant violet hues. The aromatic profile is highly expressive, unfolding with sharp layers of fresh red and dark fruits like raspberries, blackberries, and spiced black cherries, woven together with subtle notes of chocolate, lavender, graphite, and toasted hazelnut from careful oak aging. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied experience with a juicy, rounded structure and firm, energetic tannins that lead into a remarkably smooth and lengthy finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri sauce, roasted lamb cutlets, barbecued brisket, empanadas, and strong, hard cheeses like aged Gouda or Manchego.

93 Points - James Suckling

Some fine spices with a touch of cocoa powder to the black cherries and berries. Medium- to full-bodied with plenty of juicy blue fruit and firm, fresh tannins. Solid fruit in the lengthy finish. Really well-balanced. Drink now or hold.

tiki-estate-pinot-gris.title: 50Th Parallel Estate Pinot Gris 750ml
tiki-estate-pinot-gris.bodyHtml: Bright lemon hue. Pure, fruit-forward aromas of pear, apricot, pineapple and chamomile. A bright and juicy palate with flavours of pear and gooseberry.

tiki-estate-pinot-noir.title: Truchard Estate Pinot Noir 2022
tiki-estate-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Truchard Estate Pinot Noir 2022 is an elegant, estate-grown red wine crafted from seven separate clonal selections across select hillside plots in the Los Carneros region. It reveals rich, layered aromas of ripe plum, pie cherries, and rhubarb accented by delicate hints of pomegranate, black tea, and forest earth. The medium-bodied palate delivers a silky, polished texture with concentrated flavors of red currants, cranberry, and sweet vanilla, framed by bright, well-integrated acidity and fine, persistent tannins that carry into a spicy, fruit-forward finish.

Food Pairing:

This versatile Pinot Noir pairs exceptionally well with grilled salmon, roasted duck breast, pork tenderloin with a cherry reduction, turkey, and mushroom risotto.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Flavors of cranberry, pomegranate, dried orange peel and a zestful sprinkle of warming spices bring intrigue, nuance and lift to this refreshing wine. The tannins are fine, but persistent. This wine will work well with food while also being highly drinkable on its own.

91 Points - James Suckling

Dark cherries, red plums, cinnamon and hints of sandalwood on the nose. Medium-bodied with a polished texture and a fruit-forward, spicy aftertaste. Round and textural. Drink now.

sola-syrah.title: Sola Syrah 2015 750ml
sola-syrah.bodyHtml:
Sola Syrah 2015 is a bold, complex red wine that showcases the depth and richness of the Syrah grape. With a perfect balance of fruit and spice, it offers a smooth yet powerful taste experience.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Deep, dark ruby with purple hues, indicating its age and maturity.

  • Aromas: Aromas of blackberry, blueberry, and plum dominate, with subtle notes of black pepper, smoked meat, and a touch of violet.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and rich, the wine delivers concentrated flavors of dark fruit—including black cherry and currants—alongside hints of spices, leather, and a touch of smokiness. Its firm tannins and well-integrated acidity provide structure and a long, lasting finish.

Wine Profile:

  • Region: Likely sourced from a well-known Syrah-producing region, such as California, South Africa, or France (Rhône Valley).

  • Varietal: 100% Syrah

  • Alcohol: Approx. 14%

  • Bottle Size: 750ml

Food Pairing:

This Syrah pairs wonderfully with hearty grilled meats, such as steak or lamb, barbecue, and roasted vegetables. It also complements aged cheeses like cheddar, gouda, or blue cheese.

Sola Syrah 2015 is an excellent choice for wine lovers who appreciate rich, structured reds. It can be enjoyed now or aged further for those who prefer a more developed expression of Syrah.

sola-pinot-noir.title: Cambria Julia's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021
sola-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Cambria Julia's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021 is an exceptionally expressive, elegant, and character-driven cool-climate red wine from the heart of Santa Barbara County. Sourced from its namesake estate vineyard—originally planted in 1972 on the ancient alluvial benchmarks of the Santa Maria Valley—this single-vineyard bottling benefits from a uniquely prolonged growing season shaped by consistent Pacific fog and ocean breezes. The fruit is carefully fermented and aged for several months in French oak barrels (a small portion being new) to beautifully synthesize structural depth with pristine varietal purity. In the glass, it reveals a brilliant, translucent ruby color. The highly aromatic and fragrant nose opens with radiant layers of ripe pomegranate, wild strawberries, and dark maraschino cherries, intricately woven with nuance of lavender, fresh rose petals, toasted sage, and a delicate hint of earthy underbrush. On the palate, this medium-bodied Pinot Noir is remarkably vibrant, sleek, and lively, driving juicy cran-raspberry and dark berry flavors over a framework of supple, fine-grained tannins and a crisp line of natural, refreshing acidity before culminating in a long, beautifully balanced, and subtly spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared duck breast, cedar-plank grilled salmon, rustic wild mushroom risotto, or herb-roasted pork tenderloin.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Tart and fresh aromas of red plum, strawberry and lightly toasted sage and marjoram draw the nose into this zesty, widely available bottling. The palate lands with pleasantly brisk cran-pom-raspberry flavors, as lavender and rose petal qualities add nuance.

sola-chardonnay.title: Mer Soleil Reserve Chardonnay 2023
sola-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Mer Soleil Reserve Chardonnay 2023 is a dramatic, rich, and deeply expressive white wine from the Wagner family (the masterminds behind Caymus). Taking its name from the sea (mer) and sun (soleil), this vintage is shaped by the morning fog and cool ocean breezes of Monterey County. It bursts with a highly fragrant bouquet of Meyer lemon curd, honeysuckle, and lemon blossoms infused with the warmth of sweet vanilla and a subtle hint of crisp sea breeze. On the palate, this barrel-fermented Chardonnay is full-bodied, round, and remarkably lush, showcasing rich layers of ripe peach, tropical pineapple, mango, and lemon meringue pie. Its unctuous, velvety texture is effortlessly balanced by an enlivening coastal acidity, concluding with a clean, satisfying finish defined by notes of toasted almonds, custard, and sweet baking spice.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared Chilean sea bass, butter-poached lobster tails, smoked king crab legs, roasted chicken breast with garlic cream sauce, and creamy fettuccine alfredo.

samuel-wynn-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Wynns Coonawara Estate Black Label Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
samuel-wynn-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Wynns Black Label Cabernet is a true icon of Australian wine. First produced in 1954, it has a reputation for ageing gracefully and displaying excellent varietal and regional characteristics. The wine is produced from only the top quality 20 to 25 per cent of Cabernet Sauvignon fruit grown in our terra rossa vineyards.

A wine of style and stature - and a perennial favourite in auction circles - ‘Black Label’ is one of Australia’s most collectable wines and Australia’s benchmark Cabernet Sauvignon. It consistently delivers potential for medium to long-term cellaring.

Our 2019 Cabernet is a perfect amalgam of freshness, balance and power that will certainly reward good cellaring. A seamless line of fruit from our terra rossa vineyards is
supported by a fine tannin framework. Flavours of red cherry and plum are complimented by the secondary notes of walnuts and mixed cooking spice. Very intense yet elegant.

Pairs well with Spicy grilled salmon with Coriander Salsa

93 Points - Gismondi

The Black Label Coonawarra Cab has been a forever classic and a pet project of winemaker Sue Hodder for decades. From the tiny sliver of land that is Coonawarra's red terra rossa (iron oxide clays over limestone), Hodder created this affordable benchmark from 50+ year old organically farmed vines, and in 2019, it was the 64th vintage of the iconic label. The fermentation runs a month in a mix of open and static fermenters before it ages 14 months in French oak (31% new) and a mix of 61/26/13/ hogsheads / barriques / vats. 2019 was a year to remember in Coonawarra, and its ripe cherry, mulberry, blackcurrants, crushed chalk, mint, seawater, and that Coonawarra dried herb styling in the finish tell an amazing story. It will age for decades, but it has the class and balance to be drunk anytime now.

samuel-wynn-red-blend.title: Samuel Wynn Red Blend 750ml
samuel-wynn-red-blend.bodyHtml: The Samuel Wynn Red Blend is a blend, typically consisting of Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon, and possibly Merlot, resulting in a wine with notes of fruit sweetness, oak spice, and tannins, creating a balanced and flavorful experience.

original16-celebration-mix.title: Original 16 Celebration Mix 12 Cans
original16-celebration-mix.bodyHtml: Variety packs offer beer lovers a low-risk opportunity to try new styles. Catering to various tastes in one pack, Mixers are a top choice for gatherings and parties. Combine that with Original 16’s industry bucking growth trends, and you’ve got a winning mix!

apothic-brew.title: Apothic Red
apothic-brew.bodyHtml:
Apothic Red is a remarkably bold, innovative, and luxuriously smooth California red blend crafted to challenge traditional winemaking rules. Inspired by the "Apotheca," a mysterious 13th-century European cellar where early vintners blended and stored their most coveted creations, this off-dry red opens with an effusive, jammy bouquet of ripe black cherries, blueberries, and grape jam, beautifully layered with indulgent suggestions of rich mocha, sweet licorice, and warm vanilla bean. On the palate, it delivers a medium- to full-bodied experience defined by a lush, velvety mouthfeel and remarkably soft, unassertive tannins. A concentrated core of dark forest fruits, boysenberry, and subtle baking spice is guided by a gentle hint of residual sweetness, concluding with a long, rounded, and decadent finish rich with toasted oak and dark chocolate undertones.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with slow-cooked barbecue pork ribs, pepperoni pizza, sharp aged cheddar, and rich dark chocolate desserts.

wild-rose-anthology-mixer-2018.title: Wild Rose Anthology Mixer - 2018 12 Bottles
wild-rose-anthology-mixer-2018.bodyHtml: The "Wild Rose Anthology Mixer - 2018 12 Bottles" is a sampler pack offering a variety of Wild Rose Brewing Company beers. The pack contains 12 bottles, each 330ml, providing a taste of Wild Rose's diverse range of craft beers. This sampler allows consumers to explore different flavors and styles of Wild Rose's beers, making it a good option for those who enjoy variety.

longshot-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Longshot Cabernet Sauvignon 2021/2022 750ml
longshot-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Longshot Cabernet Sauvignon is a full-bodied, dry red wine from California, known for its bold flavor profile with notes of dark fruit, toasted oak, and dark chocolate. It's an intense yet balanced blend, described as a "delicious" and "bursts with flavors" wine.

longshot-pinot-grigio.title: Longshot Pinot Grigio 750ml
longshot-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Carefully selected grapes from premier California vineyards give this popular white wine varietal a crisp, elegant taste. This easy-to-sip wine has its own distinct delicate flavour making it famous for its endless pair-ability. A light Pinot Grigio wine with subtle notes of apple and citrus are complemented with hints of lemon resulting in a soft elegant finish.

longshot-big-red-blend.title: Longshot The Ultimate Big Red Blend
longshot-big-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Longshot The Ultimate Big Red Blend is a rich, full-bodied, and fruit-forward California red wine. Crafted from a blend of dark red varieties including Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Merlot, Tempranillo, Petit Verdot, and Syrah, it opens with expressive aromas of blackcurrant, dark plum, and juicy cherries layered with nuances of warm vanilla, cocoa, and toasted oak. On the palate, it is smooth, round, and plush, featuring concentrated flavors of ripe dark berries and subtle baking spices backed by soft tannins and a supple, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with barbecued ribs, grilled beef burgers, braised short ribs, roasted pork, and hearty pasta dishes with meat sauces.

town-sq-forged-amber-rye-ale.title: Town Sq Forged Amber Rye Ale 4 Tall Cans
town-sq-forged-amber-rye-ale.bodyHtml: Town Sq Forged Amber Rye Ale 4 Tall Cans

twisted-tea-original-tall-can.title: Twisted Tea Original Tall Can 473ml
twisted-tea-original-tall-can.bodyHtml: Twisted Tea Original is a hard iced tea beverage known for its refreshing, smooth taste and natural lemon flavor. It's made with real brewed tea and has 5% alcohol content. The 473ml tall can provides a convenient serving size, perfect for a refreshing drink.

snake-lake-sidewinder-ipa.title: Snake Lake Sidewinder IPA 6 Cans
snake-lake-sidewinder-ipa.bodyHtml: Snake Lake Sidewinder IPA is a New England-style IPA with a hazy appearance, foamy head, and a blend of hoppy and malty flavors. The beer has a soft, pillowy, and creamy mouthfeel, with ripe, juicy, fruit-forward hops complementing stone-fruit and tropical-fruit esters from the yeast.

strongbow-dry-pear.title: Strongbow Dry Pear 4 Tall Cans
strongbow-dry-pear.bodyHtml:
Cider.

Thirst Quenching Apple Cider for Unbeatable Refreshment

No Artificial Flavours, Sweeteners or Colours

Strongbow Original cider is the nations favourite cider. Its thirst quenching refreshment is characterised by its blend of bittersweet cider apples, grown and pressed in Herefordshire. Strongbow Original cider is sharp and tangy, with a dry finish, delivering the ultimate cut through refreshment. What's even better, it contains no artificial sweeteners, flavours or colours.

It's the blend of the bittersweet cider apples, grown and pressed in Herefordshire, that gives Strongbow Original its unique thirst quenching taste.

We're rolling out Green Grip to remove plastic rings from our cans. Once completed, we'll have removed 500 tonnes of single use plastic each year, equivalent to 94 million plastic bags.

Refreshing the nation since 1960, Strongbow is the number 1 UK cider brand. 1 billion bittersweet apples go into Strongbow cider; all grown, harvested, pressed and canned in and around Herefordshire. That's 25% of all apples grown in the UK!

For more information visit: STRONGBOW.COM

splash-mixed-berry.title: Smirnoff Ice Berry Blast 6 Cans
splash-mixed-berry.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Ice Berry Blast is a pre-mixed, flavored malt beverage produced by Smirnoff, combining its signature vodka-inspired flavor base with a sweet, tart blend of blue raspberry, blackberry, and cherry fruit flavors. Known for its distinct electric-blue appearance and crisp, fizzy texture, it offers a sweet, refreshing, and accessible taste profile designed for casual occasions.

Food Pairing: Spicy chicken wings, loaded nachos, fish tacos, barbecue pulled pork, and fresh fruit skewers.

Tasting Notes : Electric vibrant blue in appearance with a light, crisp, and carbonated mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and aromatic, dominated by prominent notes of artificial blue raspberry, ripe blackberry, candied cherry, and citrus zest.

Palate : Sweet, tart, and carbonated, delivering forward flavors of sweet blue raspberry, tangy berry punch, and lemon-lime citrus.

Finish : Quick, crisp, and refreshing, leaving a lingering sweet berry taste with a clean, effervescent bite.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled or poured over ice in a highball glass, optionally garnished with a fresh lime wheel or raspberries.

rockstar-vodka-silver-ice.title: Rockstar Vodka Fruit Punch 473ml
rockstar-vodka-silver-ice.bodyHtml: A ready-to-drink beverage with the punched-up taste of bold tropical fruits and vodka

brickworks-dry-craft-cider.bodyHtml: Uncommon Cider Dry Craft Cider 4 Tall Cans

andrew-rich-eola-amity-pinot-noir.title: Evesham Wood Eola-Amity Hills Pinot Noir Cuvee 2023
andrew-rich-eola-amity-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: The modest temperatures and even growing season post-flowering seems to have resulted in wines that have knit together quickly and show fantastic poise. This balance is likely to result in wines that drink wonderfully young and will mature gracefully.

black-fly-grapefruit-gin-soda-fizz.title: Black Fly Grapefruit Gin Soda Fizz

smirnoff-caesar.title: Smirnoff Vodka 1.75L
smirnoff-caesar.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff No. 21 Vodka is a classic, globally recognized vodka originally created in 1864. Renowned for its purity and versatility, it undergoes a rigorous triple distillation process and is filtered ten times through seven columns of environmentally sustainable charcoal. This meticulous production method yields a pristine, neutral, and exceptionally smooth spirit that has become a staple for mixologists worldwide.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with caviar, pickled vegetables, cured charcuterie, and light seafood dishes.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear in appearance, delivering a crisp, clean, and light-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and highly neutral with very faint hints of grain sweetness, subtle black pepper, and light minerality.

Palate : Smooth and neutral with a very subtle touch of sweetness, a hint of charcoal, and light peppery spice.

Finish : Short, crisp, and exceptionally clean.

Serve : Best served well-chilled, neat, over ice, or mixed in classic cocktails such as a Moscow Mule, Bloody Mary, or Vodka Soda.

smirnoff-sourced-watermelon-vodka.title: Smirnoff Peach Vodka
smirnoff-sourced-watermelon-vodka.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Peach is infused with the natural flavor of juicy peaches for a sweet and fruity taste. This spirit has a pleasant sweetness and pairs best with soda water, lemonade, or iced tea. Smirnoff Peach is Kosher Certified and gluten free.

prophecy-rose.title: Prophecy Rose
prophecy-rose.bodyHtml:
Prophecy Rosé is a refreshing, dry-style rosé offering delicate aromas of raspberry, strawberry, and white flowers. Bright flavours of ripe red cherry, white peach, and citrus unfold across a softly textured palate, complemented by crisp acidity and a clean, refreshing finish. Light, approachable, and beautifully balanced, this versatile rosé is ideal for warm-weather entertaining, casual gatherings, and pairing with fresh seasonal dishes.

Food Pairing: Grilled salmon, shrimp, fresh seafood, charcuterie, goat cheese, Niçoise salad, roasted chicken, and grilled vegetables.

the-winemakers-house-pinot-grigio.title: The Winemaker's House Pinot Grigio 4L Bag In Box
the-winemakers-house-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: The Winemaker's House Pinot Grigio 4L Bag In Box

the-winemakers-house-merlot.title: Ghost Pines "Winemaker's Blend" Merlot 2020
the-winemakers-house-merlot.bodyHtml: A rich and multifaceted California red, the 2020 Ghost Pines Merlot is a masterclass in multi-appellation blending, sourcing premium fruit from both Sonoma and Napa counties. This wine presents an intense dark ruby color and opens with an inviting bouquet of ripe black cherry, plum, and marionberry, complemented by sophisticated notes of mocha, toasted oak, and a touch of savory dried herbs. On the palate, it is full-bodied and supple, offering a velvety mouthfeel with plush tannins and balanced acidity. Layers of dark chocolate and vanilla bean emerge through the mid-palate, leading to a smooth, long-lasting finish that reflects the depth and structure of its high-quality coastal vineyard origins.

pop-shoppe-black-cherry.title: Pop Shoppe Cream Soda 473ml
pop-shoppe-black-cherry.bodyHtml: Packaged in a retro-style can, this is an adult's version of the classic cream soda. Expect the sweet cream soda flavours of cherry, red berry fruit and vanilla. Smooth and creamy with light carbonation; enjoy well-chilled by the pool and serve with spring rolls or samosas.

ron-barcelo-imperial.title: Ron Barcelo Imperial Rum
ron-barcelo-imperial.bodyHtml:
Ron Barcelo Imperial is a premium aged rum from the Dominican Republic, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is a blend of rums aged for between four and ten years, presented in a squared decanter with a gold crest. Barcelo Imperial won a Gold Medal and the Best in Category title at the 2008 International Cane Spirits Festival.

Serve: Neat, on a large ice cube, or in a rum Old Fashioned.

canadian-club-apple.title: Canadian Club Invitation Series 15 Year Old Sherry Cask
canadian-club-apple.bodyHtml: First, in the series, this one-time release whisky has all the hallmark notes of CC Classic 12 YO elevated to 15 years with the secondary aging in Oloroso sherry casks. The results are rich aromas of toffee, spice and subtle sweetness with warm and creamy flavours with mellow wood on the palate. Sip neat or over ice.

bodega-norton-malbec-doc.title: Norton Barrel Select Malbec
bodega-norton-malbec-doc.bodyHtml: The Norton Barrel Select Malbec is a premium, well-balanced red wine that serves as a bridge between Bodega Norton's entry-level collections and their high-end reserves. Sourced from estate vineyards in the Luján de Cuyo region at altitudes of approximately 3,000 feet, this wine is characterized by its "Barrel Select" process, where 50% of the wine is aged in first and second-use French oak barrels for 12 months. This technique results in a wine that maintains the fresh, vibrant fruit of the Malbec grape while gaining sophisticated layers of toasted oak and spice. It presents a deep red colour with violet hues and a complex nose of ripe black fruits, such as plums and figs, complemented by subtle notes of vanilla and black pepper.

harken-chardonnay.title: Hahn Chardonnay
harken-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
A rich California Chardonnay with lemon, orange peel, pineapple, lychee, pear, vanilla, and creamy toasted oak. Bright acidity balances its smooth, full-bodied texture, while subtle butter and toast notes add depth, finishing clean, rounded, and pleasantly lingering.

Food Pairing: Enjoy with grilled shrimp, roasted chicken, creamy pasta, seafood chowder, baked salmon, crab cakes, soft cheeses, or roasted vegetables.

red-tree-zinfandel.title: Redtree Zinfandel 750ml
red-tree-zinfandel.bodyHtml: Redtree Zinfandel, a 750ml bottle from California, is described as a fruity, jammy wine with flavors of blackberry, cherry, and spices. It also exhibits notes of chocolate, oak, and tobacco, along with a hint of vanilla. The wine is known for its robust, food-friendly nature, especially with beef, lamb, and poultry, according to Wines & More, RI. Some reviewers describe it as slightly vegetal or uneven, with a mix of sweet and green notes, notes Wine-Searcher. It's generally considered a decent, party-friendly wine.

walking-dead-red-blend.title: Walking Dead Red Blend 750ml
walking-dead-red-blend.bodyHtml: The Walking Dead Blood Red Blend 750ml is a robust red wine with an intense, bold flavor profile. It features a blend of grapes like Malbec, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Petit Verdot, resulting in notes of ripe raspberry, cranberry, cherry, and melted milk chocolate. The wine is aged in French and American oak, contributing to its warm vanilla scent and a long-lasting finish.

walking-dead-cabernet.title: The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
walking-dead-cabernet.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a luxurious, modern, and brilliantly textured expression that carries the bold and unrestricted winemaking philosophy of this iconic estate into a pure varietal focus. Sourced from premier vineyards across the valley, this vintage exhibits a deep magenta and purple-ruby core. On the nose, it offers an invitingly opulent bouquet of ripe black cherries, crème de cassis, and sweet blackberry pie, seamlessly layered with warm undertones of toasted vanilla bean, cinnamon bark, fresh coffee grounds, and hints of crushed wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is incredibly soft, plush, and full-bodied, delivering an expansive, fruit-forward mid-palate wrapped in supple, velvety tannins. Matured for 15 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels, its powerful dark fruit concentration remains beautifully balanced, showing remarkable structural harmony before concluding with a lengthy, decadent finish accented by a touch of holiday spice and subtle mineral depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with charcoal-grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-infused roasted lamb, or hunks of mature sharp white cheddar cheese.

half-hitch-papa-bear-prairie-ale.title: Half Hitch Papa Bear Prairie Ale 6 Cans
half-hitch-papa-bear-prairie-ale.bodyHtml: Half Hitch Papa Bear Prairie Ale 6 Cans

tempo-gin-smash.title: Tempo Gin Smash Variety Pack 12 Cans
tempo-gin-smash.bodyHtml: Tempo craft distilled gin is produced by Goodridge & Williams Distilling, in Delta, B.C. This gin smash balances juicy strawberry sweetness with a slight pucker of lemon, allowing the gin's delicate botanical aromatics to shine through. Enjoy this gin smash with a tuna poke bowl or alongside cucumber sandwiches.

jean-marc-lafont-chardonnay-beajolais.title: Jean-Paul Brun Terres Dorees 'Beaujolais Blanc' Classic Chardonnay 2020
jean-marc-lafont-chardonnay-beajolais.bodyHtml:
Jean-Paul Brun Terres Dorees 'Beaujolais Blanc' Classic Chardonnay 2020 is an elegant, mineral-driven expression of Chardonnay grown on the golden, clay-limestone soils of southern Beaujolais. Fermented with indigenous yeasts and aged without oak to preserve its natural purity, it opens with bright, inviting aromas of green apple, white peach, candied citrus, and subtle honeysuckle. On the palate, the wine is beautifully fresh and lightly textured, delivering a vibrant saline minerality and a creamy, lees-led core that echoes with light flint. It offers lovely flow and energy, finishing with a fine, mouthwatering line of acidity that perfectly balances the ripe orchard fruit.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted poultry, grilled shellfish, pan-seared white fish, or mild, creamy goat cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Very attractive aromas of candied citrus and pineapple with a hint of melted butter are married to a creamy and rather generous palate. The lively acidity and fine tannins lift the finish very nicely. Drink now.
tags: Jean-Paul Brun Domaine des Terres Dorées

analog-ready-paler-one.title: Analog Ready Paler One 4 Tall Cans

analog-the-hive-bomber.title: Analog The Hive Bomber 4 Tall Cans
analog-the-hive-bomber.bodyHtml: An easy-drinking American Wheat Ale with piles of character. The Hive Bomber uses exclusively single origin farmed barley for its malt bill coming from local run Albertan barley farms. The honey is locally sourced from a small family apiary just outside of Edmonton. Expect a clean, bright beer with a slight honey character that has a dry finish not expected from a honey beer.

analog-power-up-porter.title: Analog Power Up Porter 4 Tall Cans
analog-power-up-porter.bodyHtml: This porter has a coffee or light chocolate flavour that is enhanced by the light character of imported Madagascar Vanilla. It still has a light body that makes it something you could have a few of in a night.

johnnie-walker-white-walker.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
johnnie-walker-white-walker.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label is an iconic, ultra-premium blended Scotch whisky crafted by Johnnie Walker. Hand-selected by Master Blender Jim Beveridge from some of the rarest casks across Scotland—including irreplaceable stocks from ghost distilleries—only one in ten thousand casks possesses the quality and character required for this blend. It delivers a rich, velvety balance of sweet honey, dark chocolate, ripe fruits, and a gentle, lingering cloud of soft Islay smoke.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, caviar, seared duck breast, dark chocolate truffles, and aged blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a silky, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Mellow and rounded with aromas of dry smoke, raisins, sweet honey, toasted nuts, and subtle orange peel.

Palate : Complex and velvety, delivering flavors of hazelnut, dark chocolate, sandalwood, honey, Kumquat fruit, and sweet sherry wood spice.

Finish : Rich, long, and warming with lingering notes of gentle peat smoke, dark fruit, dried spice, and pepper.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass accompanied by a glass of ice water on the side to cleanse the palate between sips.

os-last-chair-red-lager.title: Os Last Chair Red Lager 6 Bottles

captain-morgan-apple-smash.title: Captain Morgan Apple Smash Rum Shot

ale-architect-django-ginger-szechuan.title: Ale Architect Django Ginger & Szechuan 4 Tall Cans
ale-architect-django-ginger-szechuan.bodyHtml: Ale Architect Django Ginger & Szechuan 4 Tall Cans

iris-malbec.title: Lui Umile Malbec 2022
iris-malbec.bodyHtml:
Lui Úmile Malbec 2022 is a fresh, vibrant, and expressive high-altitude Argentine red crafted by winemaker Mauricio Vegetti. Sourced from choice estate vineyards situated at 1,120 meters above sea level in Vista Flores, within Mendoza's prestigious Uco Valley, the vines thrive in alluvial soils rich in sand and rounded river stones. The nose is incredibly inviting, bursting with bright aromas of fresh red plums, ripe cherries, and raspberries, intricately layered with notes of hibiscus, dark spices, and a quintessential Uco Valley backdrop of desert herbs and wet stones. On the palate, this medium- to full-bodied Malbec showcases a beautifully crunchy fruit character, seamlessly balanced by fine, sturdy tannins and a vivid vein of natural acidity. Maturing 60% of the blend for 10 to 12 months in neutral French oak barrels imparts a sophisticated, silky texture and a touch of vanilla while keeping the focus squarely on its pure, juicy fruit, which carries through to a long, flavorful finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with premium grain-fed ribeye steaks, slow-braised beef short rib tacos, grilled lamb cutlets, or traditional chorizo pasta dishes.

91 Points - James Suckling

Notes of ripe raspberries and cherries with hibiscus, dark spices and wet stones. Medium- to full-bodied with crunchy tannins and vivid acidity. Very attractive fruit character and a flavorful finish. Drink now or hold.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

The nose exhibits aromas of fresh red plums leading the senses to a fruit-driven palate, where a medley of blackberries and ripe cherries is framed by balancing acidity and sturdy tannins. This is a lively Malbec from the Uco Valley, featuring a long finish of desert herbs.

remy-martin-xo-extra-old.title: Remy Martin XO Cognac
remy-martin-xo-extra-old.bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin XO Cognac is an opulent and exceptionally complex Fine Champagne Cognac, blended from up to 400 different eaux-de-vie aged between 10 and 37 years. It showcases the ultimate signature of the house, delivering an incredibly rich, velvet-smooth texture with notes of late summer fruits and warm spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with dark chocolate desserts, aged cheeses like Parmesan or Gouda, or a rich foie gras.

Tasting Notes : Luminous mahogany with fiery amber hues, featuring a velvety, rich, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Extremely complex and floral, opening with aromas of jasmine, candied orange, juicy plum, dried figs, hazelnut, freshly grated cinnamon, and warm brioche.

Palate : Velvety and opulent, delivering abundant layers of ripe passion fruit, dark berries, and candied peel balanced by sweet spices, oak tannins, and honeyed nuts.

Finish : Exceptionally long, smooth, and elegant, leaving a persistent warmth filled with notes of sweet spice, dark chocolate, and toasted oak.

Serve : Serve neat or over a single large ice cube in a tulip glass or classic snifter at room temperature to allow its full aromatic bouquet to bloom.

innis-gunn-tropic-like-its-hop.title: Innis & Gunn Tropic Like It's Hop 500ml

cavaliere-doro-primitivo-puglia.title: Cavaliere D'Oro Primitivo Puglia 750ml
cavaliere-doro-primitivo-puglia.bodyHtml: Cavaliere D'Oro Primitivo Puglia is a full-bodied red wine from Puglia, Italy, known for its rich flavors and velvety texture. It typically exhibits notes of ripe red fruits like cherries and plums, along with cocoa and vanilla, and sometimes hints of licorice or pepper. The wine is characterized by a balanced acidity, medium tannins, and a long, lingering finish.

main-vine-blood-orange-mango-spritzer.title: Dame Beverage Co. Donna Italian Spritz Blood Orange 355ml
main-vine-blood-orange-mango-spritzer.bodyHtml:
Donna Italian Spritz Blood Orange is a ready-to-drink spritz cocktail from Dame Beverage Co., a Canadian maker of cocktails inspired by Italian aperitivo culture. Donna is the company's citrus-forward spritz range, designed as a lighter, brighter take on classic spritz cocktails. This blood orange version is built around the fruit's bittersweet citrus character with lively bubbles, and comes in a 355ml can at 5% alcohol by volume. Made in Ontario, Canada, it is an easy choice for aperitivo hour, the patio or casual entertaining.

Serve: Well chilled, straight from the can or poured over ice with an orange slice.

main-vine-pomegranate-spritzer.title: Main & Vine Pomegranate Spritzer 4 Cans
main-vine-pomegranate-spritzer.bodyHtml: Main & Vine Pomegranate Spritzer is a ready-to-drink wine spritzer that combines wine with natural pomegranate flavors. It's available in 4-can packs and is designed to be a refreshing, slightly sweet, and crisp beverage. The wine spritzer is made with wine and natural fruit flavors, and is gluten-free. It has 95 calories per 250ml can and contains 5.5% alcohol by volume. The taste features fresh pomegranate aromas, along with hints of blackberry, cherry, and herbal notes, according to Yankee Spirits.

red-racer-reign-of-hops.title: Red Racer Reign Of Hops 12 Tall Cans
red-racer-reign-of-hops.bodyHtml: Red Racer Reign Of Hops 12 Tall Cans

dminor-merlot-cabernet.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
dminor-merlot-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a refined and powerful red wine crafted from top-tier estate and independent grower vineyards across the Napa Valley. Blending 93% Cabernet Sauvignon with 6% Merlot, it opens with rich aromas of boysenberry, black currant, and dark cherry, accented by bay leaf, baking spice, and subtle cedar notes. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, well-sculpted texture packed with blueberry, blackberry, and plum flavors supported by fine, firm tannins and a long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, roasted lamb, duck breast, or aged cheddar cheese.

big-rock-lager.title: Big Rock Dark Charge Black Lager

mission-hill-reserve-vidal-icewine.title: Peller Estates Private Reserve Vidal Ice Wine 200ml
mission-hill-reserve-vidal-icewine.bodyHtml:
Bright yellow gold colour with an aromatic bouquet of peach, tropical fruit, melon and honey. A rich, luscious, full-bodied Icewine with wonderful flavours of honey, tropical fruit and candied citrus. Honey, Bartlett pear and caramel notes linger exquisitely on the finish.

92 points Wine Spectator
A lusciously sweet ice wine with concentrated flavors of apricot, peach, and honey. The vibrant acidity balances the richness, giving the wine freshness and structure. The finish is long and silky, with layers of tropical fruit and candied citrus.

93 points James Suckling
An exceptional dessert wine offering intense aromas of ripe mango, pineapple, and caramelized pear. The palate is decadent and silky, with perfectly integrated sweetness and a bright, refreshing lift on the finish. A beautifully crafted ice wine with great depth.

91 points Decanter
A rich and expressive wine featuring notes of orange blossom, baked apple, and honeycomb. Smooth and luscious, it delivers a well-rounded sweetness with a clean, lingering finish that avoids being overly heavy.

paxis-red-blend.title: DFJ Vinhos Paxis 'Bulldog' Vinho Regional Lisboa Tinto 750ml
paxis-red-blend.bodyHtml:
89 Points - James Suckling
"A fruity and vibrant Portuguese red with juicy berry flavors and a soft, easy-drinking texture. Excellent everyday value."
87 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"This robust blend offers dark fruit and a touch of spice. A solid, characterful wine that over-delivers for its price point."

palm-bay-rose-strawberry-cherry-blossom.bodyHtml: Palm Bay Rose Strawberry Cherry Blossom 6 Cans

breezer-day-cucumber-white-tea.title: Breezer Day Cucumber White Tea 6 Cans

spritzd-syrah-rose-wine-spritzer.title: Jackson Triggs Shiraz 4L Bag in Box
spritzd-syrah-rose-wine-spritzer.bodyHtml: Jackson-Triggs Shiraz in a 4L Bag in Box is a popular Canadian red wine known for its rich, fruity flavors and medium-bodied style. It's a Shiraz/Syrah varietal with notes of black pepper, jammy blackberry, and herbal spice. This wine is a good option for those who enjoy a juicy, easy-drinking red with a touch of peppery character.

spritzd-pinot-grigio-wine-spritzer.title: Freixenet Italian Pinot Grigio 750ml
spritzd-pinot-grigio-wine-spritzer.bodyHtml: Stylish bottle, stylish wine. The great Spanish house of Freixenet have extended their winemaking prowess into Italy. Their 150 years of experience are obvious in this elegant white wine made with the finest grapes from the picturesque Garda region in northern Italy.  This fine Pinot Grigio is packed full of fruity and floral flavours. You will also note subtle hints of citrus, making it a well-balanced wine, perfect to drink on its own on a hot summer’s day.  Just as easily, you can pair this with a fresh salad or a platter of seafood.

gordons-gin-tonic.title: Gordon's London Dry Gin
gordons-gin-tonic.bodyHtml:
Gordon's London Dry Gin 750ml is the classic juniper-led gin behind countless gin and tonics, bottled at 40% ABV. Gordon's was founded in London in 1769 by Alexander Gordon, who set out to make a gin worthy of his family name, and the boar's head on every bottle recalls a Gordon clan legend of saving the King of Scotland from a wild boar. The Gordon's London Dry spirit is grain neutral spirit distilled with juniper berries, coriander seed, angelica root and liquorice, and its distinctive juniper character has come to define the classic gin and tonic. This bottling is produced in Canada, in Ontario. Crisp and dry, it opens with fresh citrus and keeps juniper at its core, making it a dependable choice for the G&T, the martini and other gin classics.

Nose: Fresh, immediate citrus.

Palate: Dry, with citrus and lemon coming through first.

Serve: Over ice with tonic water and a wedge of lime, or stirred into a classic dry martini.

gordons-pink-gin-tonic.title: Gordon's Premium Pink Gin
gordons-pink-gin-tonic.bodyHtml:
Gordon's Premium Pink Gin is a fruit-led take on the classic Gordon's gin from Diageo. Launched in 2017 and inspired by a recipe Alexander Gordon used in the 1880s, it starts from the familiar Gordon's base distilled with juniper, coriander seed, angelica root and liquorice, then adds natural flavours of raspberry, strawberry and redcurrant with a touch of sweetness. The result is a soft blush-pink spirit that leads with red berries and keeps a gentle juniper backbone. This Canadian bottling is labelled as a gin-based spirit with natural flavours and is bottled at 37.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Strawberry jam, ripe raspberries and tangy redcurrant over light, piney juniper.

Palate: Smooth and sweet, with fresh strawberry, tart raspberry and a soft juniper warmth.

Serve: Long with tonic or lemonade over ice, garnished with fresh strawberries.

smirnoff-vs-berry-lemon.title: Smirnoff Ice Berry Blast 6 Cans
smirnoff-vs-berry-lemon.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Ice Berry Blast is a pre-mixed, flavored malt beverage produced by Smirnoff, combining its signature vodka-inspired flavor base with a sweet, tart blend of blue raspberry, blackberry, and cherry fruit flavors. Known for its distinct electric-blue appearance and crisp, fizzy texture, it offers a sweet, refreshing, and accessible taste profile designed for casual occasions.

Food Pairing: Spicy chicken wings, loaded nachos, fish tacos, barbecue pulled pork, and fresh fruit skewers.

Tasting Notes : Electric vibrant blue in appearance with a light, crisp, and carbonated mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and aromatic, dominated by prominent notes of artificial blue raspberry, ripe blackberry, candied cherry, and citrus zest.

Palate : Sweet, tart, and carbonated, delivering forward flavors of sweet blue raspberry, tangy berry punch, and lemon-lime citrus.

Finish : Quick, crisp, and refreshing, leaving a lingering sweet berry taste with a clean, effervescent bite.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled or poured over ice in a highball glass, optionally garnished with a fresh lime wheel or raspberries.

menage-a-trois-decadence-cabernet.title: Ménage à Trois Decadence Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 750ml
menage-a-trois-decadence-cabernet.bodyHtml: Menage a Trois Decadence Cabernet Sauvignon arouses your senses with generous berry aromas kissed by bittersweet chocolate. Black cherry, black currant and blackberry flavors mingle with lavish vanilla spice on the palate before culminating in a smooth, lingering finish. This full-bodied Cabernet wine received 93 Points at the American Wine Society Competition in 2020. Pair this extravagant Cabernet Sauvignon red wine with red meats and hard cheeses, such as aged cheddar or gouda. This wine is made using grapes from some of California’s finest wine growing regions: Lodi, Monterey and the North Coast. The wine is infused with French oak, which imparts a lavish mouthfeel and irresistibly sultry hints of vanilla. A touch of Merlot is also added for depth and complexity. This bottled wine has 13.9% alcohol by volume. Menage a Trois offers a robust portfolio of award-winning wines that consistently delight with a high-quality experience.

xoxo-smooth-red.title: XOXO Smooth Red 750ml
xoxo-smooth-red.bodyHtml: XOXO Simply Smooth Red is a blend of grapes, likely with a focus on softer, fruit-forward flavors. It's known for its smooth, rounded mouthfeel and a finish that's typically described as "juicy berry". The wine often features aromas of dark berries, toast, nuts, plum, and chocolate.

copper-moon-smooth-red.title: Copper Moon Smooth Red 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-smooth-red.bodyHtml: Copper Moon Smooth Red 4L Bag in Box

copper-moon-smooth-white.title: Copper Moon Smooth White 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-smooth-white.bodyHtml:
Bright, inviting aromas of crisp green apple, ripe pear, white peach, and delicate citrus blossom greet the nose. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied, smooth, and approachable, offering juicy orchard and tropical fruit flavours balanced by gentle sweetness and clean, refreshing acidity on a soft, easy-drinking finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast chicken, grilled shrimp skewers, garden salads, mild white fish, creamy pasta dishes, or soft cheeses.

granville-island-brewing-english-bay-pal.bodyHtml: Granville Island English Bay Pale Ale 6 Cans

brewsters-blonde.title: Brewsters River City Raspberry 6 Cans
brewsters-blonde.bodyHtml: Our best-selling beer, River City Raspberry, is a fruit beer that builds on our already delicious blonde ale by adding a locally blended 100% natural raspberry purée that lends a subtle sophisticated tang. Incredibly easy-drinking

hey-yall-green-tea.title: Hey Y'All Tailgate Hard Iced Tea 12 Cans
hey-yall-green-tea.bodyHtml:
Hey Y’all Tailgate Hard Iced Tea 12 Pack is made for game day and good times. This pack features 12 tallboy cans of lightly sweetened hard iced tea that deliver smooth, refreshing flavor with just the right kick. It’s the perfect balance of classic sweet tea taste and tailgate-ready energy—ideal for parties, parking lot hangs, or a laid-back afternoon.

Crafted with genuine black tea, green tea, and real lemon juice, each sip offers a crisp, satisfying profile with a subtle tropical finish that pairs effortlessly with your favorite tailgate eats. Made with quality natural ingredients and just 80 calories per can, it’s a lighter option that doesn’t compromise on flavor.

Whether you’re firing up the grill or relaxing on the front porch, Hey Y’all Hard Iced Tea is your go-to for easy summer sipping. Stock up while it lasts and get ready to raise a can to the good times.

queensborough-gin-twst-lime-cucumber-min.title: Queensborough Gin Twst Lime Cucumber Min 473ml

shannon-ridge-petite-sirah-high-level.title: Shannon Ridge Petite Sirah (High Elevation) 750ml
shannon-ridge-petite-sirah-high-level.bodyHtml: The Shannon Ridge Petite Sirah (High Elevation) 750ml is a dark-fruited wine with aromas of blackberry, blueberry, and hints of cranberry. It also features notes of black pepper, cedar, warm spices, and toasty vanilla. The wine is full-bodied with rich and bold tannins, and can be paired with bold dishes like red meats and grilled lamb.

murviedro-coleccion-syrah.title: Bodegas Murviedro Coleccion Syrah 2018
murviedro-coleccion-syrah.bodyHtml:
An exceptional Spanish red wine showing a deep red color with vibrant violet hues. The nose displays intense aromas of fresh blackberries, redcurrants, and red fruits. The dense, oily palate is wonderfully fruity and smooth, culminating in a very long finish.

Food Pairing: Perfectly complements roasted red meats, flame-grilled steak, spicy Mediterranean dishes, rich beef stews, or a variety of artisanal goat cheeses.

coors-slice-orange.title: Coors Seltzer Slushie Flavours Pack 12 Cans

spiked-seltzer-variety.title: Snapple Spiked 7% Variety 12 Cans
spiked-seltzer-variety.bodyHtml: The Snapple Spiked 7% Variety Pack is a bold, nostalgic, and incredibly refreshing collection of hard iced teas designed for patio parties and casual gatherings. This specific package elevates the classic Snapple juice flavor profiles with a premium vodka base, real brewed tea leaves, and a higher-octane 7% alcohol delivery with zero carbonation. The 12-can collection highlights a premium assortment of three crowd-pleasing flavors: Original Tea with a Hint of Lemon, Juicy Strawberry, and Sweet Peach. Each selection pours with natural, colorful tea clarity in the glass, lifting with a vibrant and fruity bouquet of fresh orchard berries, stone fruits, and sweet tea leaves. On the palate, it is smooth, light-to-medium-bodied, and highly approachable, striking a perfect balance where the natural tea tartness cuts right through the juicy fruit sweetness before sliding into a clean, crisp, and remarkably refreshing finish.

black-cellar-chardonnay.title: Black Cellar Pinot Grigio Chardonnay
black-cellar-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Black Cellar Pinot Grigio Chardonnay 750ml is a refreshing and approachable Canadian white wine that combines the crisp, lively character of Pinot Grigio with the smooth, fruit-forward richness of Chardonnay. This delightful blend offers a harmonious balance of fresh orchard fruits, citrus, and subtle tropical flavours, creating a light and enjoyable drinking experience. Its refreshing acidity, soft texture, and clean finish make it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, summer celebrations, and everyday enjoyment. Versatile and easy to pair with food, Black Cellar Pinot Grigio Chardonnay is perfect for those seeking a smooth and refreshing white wine.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken, fresh seafood, shrimp, baked salmon, creamy pasta, roasted vegetables, light salads, sushi, and soft cheeses.

nutrl-4.bodyHtml: A light and refreshing vodka soda. Made with real vodka, seltzer, and real juice for a clean, crisp taste with the fresh flavours of cranberry. No carbs, no sugar, no sweeteners.

alley-kat-fish-bone-nepa.bodyHtml: Alley Kat Fish Bone NEPA 6 Cans is a juicy, hop-forward New England IPA brewed by Alley Kat Brewing Company in Edmonton, Alberta. Named after the brewery's distinctive fish bone logo, this unfiltered, hazy ale combines American and tropical hop varieties to create an expressive, fruit-forward character. Bright tangerine, citrus zest, and tropical fruit flavours are complemented by subtle pine and a smooth, rounded mouthfeel. At 6.1% ABV and 60 IBU, Fish Bone delivers aromatic hop intensity with a refreshing finish and balanced bitterness.
