zaccagnini-tralcetto-montepulciano.title: Cantina Zaccagnini Tralcetto Montepulciano d'Abruzzo
zaccagnini-tralcetto-montepulciano.bodyHtml:
Cantina Zaccagnini Tralcetto Montepulciano d'Abruzzo is a remarkably smooth, fruit-forward, and highly approachable Italian red wine, instantly recognizable by the signature piece of grapevine twig (the "tralcetto") hand-tied to the neck of every bottle. Crafted from 100% Montepulciano grapes harvested in the Abruzzo region, this wine is fermented and aged in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks with a portion undergoing oak maturation to preserve its vibrant fruit character. In the glass, it reveals an intense ruby-red color with purple reflections. The nose is highly expressive and fragrant, opening with inviting aromas of ripe wild blackberries, dark cherries, and fresh plums, beautifully layered with delicate notes of white pepper, sweet spices, and dried herbs. On the palate, this medium-bodied red is incredibly soft and balanced, offering juicy dark fruit flavors framed by smooth, rounded tannins and a fresh, lively acidity that leads to a clean, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with rich bolognese pasta, wood-fired pepperoni pizza, grilled lamb chops, savory beef stews, or a selection of medium-aged cheeses.

odouls-green.title: On the Green Driver Vodka
odouls-green.bodyHtml:
FOR LOCAL PICKUP ONLY!

 

On the Green Vodka is a clean, easy-drinking spirit crafted for versatility and smoothness. Distilled multiple times for purity, it delivers a crisp, neutral profile with subtle hints of grain sweetness and a soft, rounded finish.  

Food Pairing: As a neutral and versatile vodka, it pairs well with light seafood like smoked salmon or oysters, caviar, pickled vegetables, and mild cheeses. It is also excellent served alongside charcuterie or enjoyed in a variety of mixed cocktails.

odouls-amber.title: Lamb's Palm Breeze Amber Rum 1.75L
odouls-amber.bodyHtml: Lamb's Palm Breeze amber rum dates back to 1849 and its hexagonal bottle is said to have been created so it wouldn't roll off a ship's table. It's pale gold with a burnt sugar aroma and vanilla flavour. A Caribbean-style, sugar cane-based rum with island spice and molasses best enjoyed with ice and lime or with ginger beer.

sawmill-creek-white-zinfandel.title: Sawmill Creek Rose 750ml
sawmill-creek-white-zinfandel.bodyHtml: Its easy-drinking nature makes it appealing to sip on any occasion. The pale pink colour leads to lifted aromas of red currant and grapefruit with hints of toast. Juicy yet rather dry, the palate is filled with more flavours of red currant fruit and citrus notes.

sawmill-creek-pinot-grigio.title: Sawmill Creek Pinot Grigio 750ml
sawmill-creek-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Sawmill Creek Pinot Grigio is described as a vibrant and fruity white wine, dry and medium-bodied with flavors of tropical and citrus fruits, along with hints of herbs and florals. It has a pale straw yellow color and aromas of pear, melon, and apple, with light citrus and vanilla notes. The taste is dry, light, and fresh with soft acidity, and finishes with flavors of apple, pear, and lemon. It's a great choice for fresh seafood, vegetarian fare, or creamy sauces.

kavalan-artist-series-paul-chiang.title: Kavalan Artist Series Paul Chiang 4 x 1L

heineken-lager.title: Heineken Lager 6 Bottles
heineken-lager.bodyHtml: Indulge in the refreshing taste of Heineken Lager with this pack of 6 bottles. Perfect for any occasion, each sip delivers a crisp and smooth flavor that will leave you wanting more. Treat yourself to the world-renowned quality and taste of Heineken Lager. Cheers to good times ahead!

canadian-club-whisky-1.title: Canadian Club 1858 Blended Canadian Whisky
canadian-club-whisky-1.bodyHtml:
Canadian Club Whisky is a historic and universally recognized blended Canadian whisky, renowned for its smooth and highly approachable character. Produced at the legendary Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, this flagship expression (often known as 1858) has been a staple in homes and bars since the mid-19th century. Crafted from a careful selection of corn, rye, rye malt, and barley malt, it undergoes aging in white-oak American bourbon barrels, resulting in a crisp, slightly dry, and versatile profile that helped define the Canadian whisky category.

Food Pairing: The peppery rye notes make this a great match for smoked salmon or grilled steak. It also pairs beautifully with maple-glazed pork chops, aged cheddar cheese, or a dessert featuring dark chocolate.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, golden amber spirit that is exceptionally smooth, light, and approachable, offering a balanced interplay between sweet grain and gentle rye spice.

NOSE - Fresh and soft, opening with a mild almond nuttiness and sweet vanilla, followed by an inviting hint of zesty and peppery rye spice.

Palate - Zesty and slightly spicy on the entry with a clear rye character. The mid-palate softens into sweet vanilla, rich oak, caramel, and a pleasant, subtle creaminess.

FINISH - Clean, dry, and relatively short, leaving behind a lingering, gentle warmth with subtle oak tannins and a faint touch of vanilla.

SERVE - Excellent as a versatile mixer. It is perfect for a classic Highball with ginger ale or club soda, a Whisky Sour, a simple Old Fashioned, or simply poured over ice.

smirnoff-vodka-1.title: Smirnoff Peach Vodka
smirnoff-vodka-1.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Peach is infused with the natural flavor of juicy peaches for a sweet and fruity taste. This spirit has a pleasant sweetness and pairs best with soda water, lemonade, or iced tea. Smirnoff Peach is Kosher Certified and gluten free.

baby-duck.title: Andrew Peller Baby Duck Sparkling Wine 750ml
baby-duck.bodyHtml: Baby Duck Sparkling Wine is a unique alcohol made with a special blend of ingredients. It features a smooth, golden flavor and provides a pleasant aroma. As a premium-grade alcohol, Baby Duck delivers a full-bodied taste that will have you coming back for more.

coco-single.title: Lagg Single Malt Corriecravie Edition
coco-single.bodyHtml:
Corriecravie is a hamlet just northwest of the village of Lagg that has its own secrets and stories to tell. This undulating terrain was home to some of the illicit stills that produced the infamous 'Arran water' in the days of early distilling on the island. And just near the village, there is the Torr a' Chaisteil Dun - a fort from the later Iron Age about 2000 years ago, locally known as 'Castle Hill.' With its sweeping views of the southern coastline of the island, Corriecravie is a place of beauty and intrigue that captures the essence of Arran."

"Coming to market shortly after the Kilmory, the Corriecravie Edition offers a unique twist on the Lagg Distillery spirit. After initially being matured in Bourbon barrels, this expression is finished for around six months in Oloroso sherry hogsheads sourced directly from producer Miguel Martin in Jerez.  It is then bottled at 55% Vol, once again without chill filtration and with no added colouring. The result is a whisky that showcases a sweeter smoke and rich fruit notes.

smirnoff-vodka-2.title: Smirnoff Vodka 375ml
smirnoff-vodka-2.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff No. 21 Vodka is a classic, globally recognized vodka originally created in 1864. Renowned for its purity and versatility, it undergoes a rigorous triple distillation process and is filtered ten times through seven columns of environmentally sustainable charcoal. This meticulous production method yields a pristine, neutral, and exceptionally smooth spirit that has become a staple for mixologists worldwide.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with caviar, pickled vegetables, cured charcuterie, and light seafood dishes.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear in appearance, delivering a crisp, clean, and light-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and highly neutral with very faint hints of grain sweetness, subtle black pepper, and light minerality.

Palate : Smooth and neutral with a very subtle touch of sweetness, a hint of charcoal, and light peppery spice.

Finish : Short, crisp, and exceptionally clean.

Serve : Best served well-chilled, neat, over ice, or mixed in classic cocktails such as a Moscow Mule, Bloody Mary, or Vodka Soda.

single-wine-1.title: Garzon Single Vineyard Tannat 750ml
single-wine-1.bodyHtml: Expert tasting note: "The deep, dark ruby-red color is almost opaque. The nose is restrained with delicate hints of juicy raspberry fruit. The palate is lovely & smooth, combining lifted red-fruit notes with licorice-like concentration. Alcohol is balanced & the finish is smooth & concentrated, combining chocolatey smooth tannins with chocolatey flavors & juicy red-fruit. The flavors last well. Should age for 5 years, but is delicious now." - 03/23 DCAMW

seagram-vo-whisky.title: Seagram's VO
seagram-vo-whisky.bodyHtml:
Seagram's V.O. is one of the best-known whiskies from Joseph E. Seagram's former Waterloo Distillery. First released in 1913 to celebrate the marriage of Thomas Seagram, it is a blend of more than 20 whiskies. Family tradition holds that V.O. stands for 'Very Own', a blend created for the Seagram family; others say it means 'Very Old', for the very old Canadian whiskies in the blend. Bottled at 40% ABV, this listing is the 750ml size.

Tasting Notes: Brilliant golden amber, with dried apricot, hazelnut and a touch of vanilla; balanced and smooth, finishing dry with delicate floral notes.

Serve: Over ice, or with ginger ale or soda.

canadian-club-whisky-2.bodyHtml:

beefeater-london-dry-gin.title: Beefeater London Dry Gin
beefeater-london-dry-gin.bodyHtml:
Beefeater London Dry Gin is the classic London dry gin distilled in the heart of London, with roots in the Chelsea distillery founded in 1820 and bought by pharmacist James Burrough in 1863. It is still made to Burrough's original recipe, steeping nine botanicals for 24 hours before distillation. The style is textbook London dry: pine-led juniper and bright citrus, balanced by spice, with a clean, dry finish that makes it a natural choice for a Gin and Tonic, Martini or Negroni. Bottled at 40% ABV. 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Juniper, citrus and orange with a dry finish.

Nose: Pine-forward juniper with spicy and fruity notes and light citrus zest.

Palate: Dry, with bold juniper balanced by strong citrus and orange and hints of violet and coriander.

Finish: Smooth, lingering and dry with citrus.

Serve: In a Gin and Tonic with a lemon wedge, a dry Martini or a Negroni.

bacardi-white-rum-1.title: Bacardi Superior White Rum 375ml
bacardi-white-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Superior White Rum is a classic, light-bodied white rum produced by Bacardi. First created in Santiago de Cuba in 1862 by Don Facundo Bacardí Massó, this smooth spirit is crafted using a proprietary yeast strain, parallel column distillation, and charcoal filtration before aging for one to two years in American white oak barrels to achieve its signature crisp, clean character.

Food Pairing: Fresh ceviche, grilled shrimp tacos, jerk chicken, fish tacos, guacamole, or key lime pie.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and brilliant in appearance with a light, smooth, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh citrus zest, subtle almond, light floral notes, and a hint of sweet vanilla.

Palate : Clean and delicate with subtle flavors of lime, vanilla, sweet almond, green apple, and light coconut.

Finish : Smooth, crisp, and dry with a clean, gentle lingering warmth.

Serve : Serve as the foundational base for classic rum cocktails such as a Mojito, Daiquiri, or Rum & Coke, or chilled over ice.

blue-nun-german-white-wine.title: Blue Nun German White Wine 750ml
blue-nun-german-white-wine.bodyHtml: Blue Nun Authentic White is a German white wine known for its aromatic, fruity, and slightly sweet profile. It's a medium-bodied wine with a mineral taste and refreshing acidity, often described as having notes of apples and other fruits. The wine is semi-sweet and pairs well with light stews, chicken, vegetables, Asian cuisine, and fish dishes.

royal-reserve-whisky.title: Royal Reserve
royal-reserve-whisky.bodyHtml:
Royal Reserve is a classic, value-driven Canadian rye whisky with roots dating back to the cocktail heyday of the 1960s and 70s. Produced by Corby Spirit and Wine at the historic Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, this quintessential mixing whisky is celebrated for its light, smooth, and highly approachable profile. Blended to achieve subtle elegance rather than overpowering heat, it balances sweet grain and toffee notes with a distinctly crisp, brittle Canadian rye character, making it a reliable staple for both casual sipping and traditional highballs.

Food Pairing: Grilled sausages, mild cheddar cheese, roasted salted mixed nuts, classic pub fare, and caramel-heavy desserts like butter tarts or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Light golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied, and slightly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Gentle and subtly complex, opening with mild aromas of sweet honey, vanilla, and caramel, followed by dusty rye grain, toasted almond, and a faint hint of clove and mild baking spice.

Palate : Smooth, light, and highly approachable. It begins with sweet notes of corn, toffee, and caramelized sugar, which are gracefully balanced by a contrasting, zippy bite of peppery rye spice and a touch of crisp lemon zest.

Finish : Clean, warm, and of medium length, fading gently from zesty rye spice to a lingering, soft vanilla and mild toasted oak sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat or over ice as an easy-drinking sipper, or mix it in classic Canadian whisky highballs like a Rye and Ginger (with ginger ale) or a classic Whisky Sour.

folonari-valpolicella.title: Folonari Valpolicella
folonari-valpolicella.bodyHtml:
Folonari Valpolicella is an approachable, vibrant, and traditional Italian red wine that captures the easygoing charm of the Veneto region. Vinified entirely in stainless steel tanks to maintain its fresh, fruit-driven profile, it reveals a fragrant bouquet of crushed red berries, wild strawberries, and fresh cherries, layered with subtle hints of violets and vanilla spice. On the palate, this light-to-medium-bodied selection is smooth and polished, presenting a refreshing acidity and slender texture that accentuates its juicy red fruit core and soft tannins, concluding with a clean finish and a subtle, pleasant touch of green almond bitterness.

Food Pairing: This versatile red pairs effortlessly with traditional pizza, spaghetti bolognese, roasted chicken, grilled salmon, antipasto platters, or a selection of light cheeses.

wisers-de-luxe-whisky.title: J.P. Wiser's Deluxe Canadian Whisky
wisers-de-luxe-whisky.bodyHtml:
J.P. Wiser's Deluxe Canadian Whisky is a rich, exceptionally smooth, and timeless Canadian spirit that stands as one of the country's most cherished everyday classics. Crafted from high-quality grains, traditionally distilled, and patiently aged for a minimum of five years in seasoned oak barrels, it pours a beautiful warm amber-gold colour in the glass. The nose lifts with an inviting, expressive bouquet of rich caramel, warm vanilla, and sweet honey, beautifully complexed by undertones of toasted oak, dried fruits, and a gentle wave of rye baking spice. On the palate, this medium-bodied whisky is remarkably smooth and approachable, delivering a full-flavored experience packed with creamy butterscotch, sweet corn, and toasted wood notes. Balanced by an underlying warmth, it transitions into a clean, smooth, and lengthy finish that leaves lingering hints of clove, black pepper, and toasted vanilla.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with hearty, savory foods such as slow-smoked beef brisket, barbecued pork ribs with sweet glaze, grilled steaks, mature cheeses like aged white cheddar or smoked Gouda, and rich desserts like pecan pie or dark chocolate fudge.

captain-morgan-white-rum-3.title: Captain Morgan White Rum
captain-morgan-white-rum-3.bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan White Rum is a crisp, clean, and refreshing five-times distilled white rum that serves as an effortlessly versatile base for classic cocktails. Made from premium cane molasses, it is distilled in a continuous column still and briefly rested in white oak barrels before being charcoal-filtered to remove all color. This process yields a light-bodied spirit with a gentle sweetness and a smooth, uncomplicated character designed to blend seamlessly with tropical and citrus flavors.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh seafood like grilled shrimp skewers, fish tacos, or lime-infused ceviche. It also complements tropical fruit platters and slightly sweet or coconut-based desserts like coconut flan.

TASTING NOTES

Crystal clear and water-white in appearance, offering a very light, medium-bodied texture that is smooth and uncomplicated on the palate.

NOSE

Subdued and gently sweet with dominant aromas of fresh sugarcane and vanilla, complemented by faint hints of green banana and pear.

FINISH

Short to medium in length, finishing clean, dry, and soft with lingering traces of light molasses sweetness and very mild heat.

SERVE

Primarily designed for mixing; it is best served in classic Caribbean cocktails like a Mojito, Daiquiri, or mixed simply with cola and a squeeze of fresh lime for a perfect Cuba Libre.

alberta-premium-whisky-2.title: Alberta Premium Canadian Rye Whisky
alberta-premium-whisky-2.bodyHtml:
Alberta Premium Canadian Rye Whisky is a legendary staple of Canadian distilling, famous for being one of the few remaining 100% rye grain whiskies on the market. Highly revered by whisky connoisseurs and casual drinkers alike, it offers a distinctively bold, spicy, and robust flavor profile balanced by a subtle undercurrent of sweet vanilla, oak, and toffee. Its sharp, crisp finish makes it exceptionally versatile, performing beautifully neat, on the rocks, or as the spicy backbone of a classic Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

Food Pairing: The aggressive spice and rich oak of this 100% rye slice perfectly through rich, fatty foods. Pair it with slow-smoked BBQ beef brisket, sharp aged cheddar cheese, or a decadent dark chocolate tart to complement its deep, earthy undertones.

alberta-pure-vodka-1.title: Alberta Pure Vodka
alberta-pure-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Alberta Pure Vodka is a Canadian vodka distilled by Alberta Distillers in Calgary, Alberta. Crafted from 100% locally grown Western Canadian prairie grain and blended with pure, glacier-fed Rocky Mountain water, it undergoes a triple distillation and charcoal filtration process to yield a clean, neutral, and exceptionally smooth spirit.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, caviar, pickled herring, oysters on the half shell, charcuterie, and pierogies.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and bright in appearance, featuring a crisp, light, and clean mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and subtle with faint notes of neutral grain and fresh mineral water.

Palate : Smooth and light-bodied with mild grain sweetness, delicate wheat notes, and a clean, neutral character.

Finish : Short, crisp, and refreshing with a soft, clean end.

Serve : Best served well-chilled, neat, over ice, or as a versatile base in cocktails such as a Vodka Soda, Caesar, or Moscow Mule.

wisers-special-blend-whisky.title: J.P. Wiser's Special Blend
wisers-special-blend-whisky.bodyHtml: Wiser's Special Blend Whisky is a Canadian blended whisky known for its smooth, mellow profile and subtle sweetness. It's a golden amber in color and offers a fragrant nose with hints of spice, vanilla, and wood. The palate is smooth and clean with a subtle sweetness, mild oak, and a clean, compact finish. It's best enjoyed neat or in a whisky cocktail.

gilbey-london-dry-gin.title: Gordon's London Dry Gin 375ml
gilbey-london-dry-gin.bodyHtml:
Gordon's London Dry Gin is a classic gin with a heritage dating back to 1769. Its signature recipe combines handpicked wild juniper berries with coriander, angelica and liquorice, which are triple-distilled using the brand's closely guarded process. The result is a crisp, juniper-led London Dry style with herbal and citrus character, well suited to traditional gin cocktails and the classic gin and tonic.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled prawns, smoked salmon, oysters, fried seafood, charcuterie, or light herb-seasoned appetizers.

Tasting Notes: Clear and crisp with a classic London Dry profile. Juniper provides the defining aromatic character, complemented by light herbal nuances and citrus flavours. The palate is smooth and refreshing, developing gentle spice toward the finish.

Nose: Classic juniper aromas with light herbal nuances.

Palate: Smooth and crisp with herbal and citrus flavours.

Finish: Clean with a mildly spicy finish.

Serve: Serve over ice with tonic and a citrus garnish, or use in classic gin cocktails.

ice.title: Icebox Long Island Iced Tea 1.14L
ice.bodyHtml:
Icebox Long Island Iced Tea is a ready-to-mix version of the classic Long Island Iced Tea, sold in a 1.14L bottle at 38% ABV. The cocktail traditionally brings together several white spirits with cola, and Icebox does the measuring for you by combining vodka, triple sec liqueur, rum and gin in a single bottle, as listed on the label. It is not meant to be drunk straight from the bottle: the label instructs to add cola and lime juice. At full spirit strength it gives the same punch as a bar-made Long Island, with none of the work, which makes it a practical choice for parties, patios and cottage weekends.

Serve: Pour over a tall glass of ice, top with cola and add a squeeze of lime.

crown-royal-whisky.title: Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky
crown-royal-whisky.bodyHtml:
Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky is the legendary flagship expression that set the standard for Canadian whisky. Originally crafted in 1939 to celebrate the first grand tour of Canada by King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, it is meticulously blended from over 50 distinct whiskies. Aged to perfection in oak barrels, it delivers a remarkably smooth, approachable, and consistently rich flavor profile that has made it a staple in bars and homes worldwide.

Food Pairing: This versatile whisky pairs beautifully with savory, slightly sweet dishes like smoked pulled pork, BBQ chicken, or maple-glazed salmon. For dessert or cheese boards, serve it alongside aged cheddar or milk chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-gold in appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich and robust with dominant aromas of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, subtle floral notes, and gentle oak.

Palate : Delicately smooth and creamy featuring flavors of cooked fruit, caramel, vanilla, and light toasted oak spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and lingering with gentle warm oak and sweet spice notes.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as the base in classic whisky cocktails.

alberta-pure-vodka-2.title: Alberta Pure Vodka 375ml
alberta-pure-vodka-2.bodyHtml:
Alberta Pure Vodka is a Canadian vodka distilled by Alberta Distillers in Calgary, Alberta. Crafted from 100% locally grown Western Canadian prairie grain and blended with pure, glacier-fed Rocky Mountain water, it undergoes a triple distillation and charcoal filtration process to yield a clean, neutral, and exceptionally smooth spirit.

Nose : Clean and subtle with faint notes of neutral grain and fresh mineral water.

Palate : Smooth and light-bodied with mild grain sweetness, delicate wheat notes, and a clean, neutral character.

Finish : Short, crisp, and refreshing with a soft, clean end.

Serve : Best served well-chilled, neat, over ice, or as a versatile base in cocktails such as a Vodka Soda, Caesar, or Moscow Mule.

ballantines-finest-2.title: Ballantine's Finest Blended Scotch Whisky
ballantines-finest-2.bodyHtml: Ballantine's Finest Blended Malt Scotch Whisky is the oldest recipe created by the Ballantine family, in 1910. It's a brilliant golden color, the nose is fragrant with barley grain and light peat aromas while the palate is soft, round and slightly sweet with dried fruit and grain flavors. Enjoy neat or on the rocks.

royal-reserve-whisky-2.title: Royal Reserve 375ml
royal-reserve-whisky-2.bodyHtml:
Royal Reserve is a classic, value-driven Canadian rye whisky with roots dating back to the cocktail heyday of the 1960s and 70s. Produced by Corby Spirit and Wine at the historic Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, this quintessential mixing whisky is celebrated for its light, smooth, and highly approachable profile. Blended to achieve subtle elegance rather than overpowering heat, it balances sweet grain and toffee notes with a distinctly crisp, brittle Canadian rye character, making it a reliable staple for both casual sipping and traditional highballs.

Food Pairing: Grilled sausages, mild cheddar cheese, roasted salted mixed nuts, classic pub fare, and caramel-heavy desserts like butter tarts or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes: Light golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied, and slightly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose: Gentle and subtly complex, opening with mild aromas of sweet honey, vanilla, and caramel, followed by dusty rye grain, toasted almond, and a faint hint of clove and mild baking spice.

Palate: Smooth, light, and highly approachable. It begins with sweet notes of corn, toffee, and caramelized sugar, which are gracefully balanced by a contrasting, zippy bite of peppery rye spice and a touch of crisp lemon zest.

Finish: Clean, warm, and of medium length, fading gently from zesty rye spice to a lingering, soft vanilla and mild toasted oak sweetness.

Serve: Serve neat or over ice as an easy-drinking sipper, or mix it in classic Canadian whisky highballs like a Rye and Ginger (with ginger ale) or a classic Whisky Sour.

red-tassel-vodka.title: Red Tassel Vodka 375ml
red-tassel-vodka.bodyHtml:
Red Tassel Vodka is a budget-friendly European-style vodka distilled from grains for a clean and simple profile. Designed for utility and ease of mixing, it offers a straightforward taste with gentle grain notes and a light pepper warmth, making it a functional option for casual gatherings and mixed drinks.

Food Pairing: Salty snacks, pickles, cured meats, fried appetizers, or light pasta salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear and transparent appearance with a light-to-medium, straightforward body.

Nose : Subtle ethanol aroma with faint grain sweetness and light neutral mineral notes.

Palate : Simple and crisp with basic wheat grain sweetness and a light peppery spice.

Finish : Short to medium with a direct, warm pepper finish and slight grain bite.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled or mixed into highball cocktails such as a Vodka Soda or Vodka Cranberry.

grand-marnier-cognac-orange-liqueur.title: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge Liqueur
grand-marnier-cognac-orange-liqueur.bodyHtml: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge is a world-renowned French orange liqueur created in 1880 by Louis-Alexandre Marnier Lapostolle. It is a sophisticated blend featuring 51% fine French Cognac and 49% distilled essence of exotic, Caribbean-grown bitter oranges (Citrus bigaradia). Characterized by its bright topaz colour with gold and amber tints, the liqueur offers complex aromas of candied orange zest and vanilla. On the palate, the full-bodied cognac base provides notes of hazelnuts and toffee, balanced by the intensity of bitter orange, leading to a long and harmonious finish. It remains a versatile staple for both neat sipping and as an essential ingredient in classic cocktails like the Sidecar, Margarita, and French 75.

drambuie-scotch-liqueur.title: Drambuie The Isle Of Skye Liqueur
drambuie-scotch-liqueur.bodyHtml: Drambuie whisky liqueur is a blend of aged Scotch whisky, spices, herbs & heather honey. Its origins can be traced to a secret recipe created for Bonnie Prince Charlie by his Royal Apothecary in the 18th Century. The name Drambuie is derived from Scots Gaelic ‘An Dram Buidheach’ and means “The Drink that Satisfies”.

courvoisier-vs-very-special-cognac.title: Courvoisier VS Cognac
courvoisier-vs-very-special-cognac.bodyHtml:
Courvoisier VS Cognac is an iconic Very Special Cognac meticulously crafted from a blend of eaux-de-vie sourced primarily from the Fins Bois and Bons Bois crus of the Cognac region in France. Aged between two to eight years in French oak casks, this vibrant cognac balances youthful fruitiness with delicate floral notes and subtle oak complexity, making it an extraordinarily versatile and approachable spirit.

Food Pairing: Rich duck liver pâté, creamy Brie cheese, dark chocolate truffles, roasted almonds, or fruit-based tarts like tarte Tatin.

Tasting Notes : Luminous golden amber hue with a smooth, light-to-medium body and clean mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh oak, vibrant spring flowers, ripe pear, citrus zest, and subtle hints of crème brûlée.

Palate : Crisp and fruit-forward with flavors of fresh grape, ripe peach, subtle oak spice, vanilla, and gentle floral accents.

Finish : Short-to-medium, fresh, and clean with lingering fruitiness and a delicate touch of wood spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a dynamic cocktail base in classics like a Sidecar or Cognac & Ginger Ale.

lambs-navy-rum.title: Lamb's Navy Dark Rum
lambs-navy-rum.bodyHtml: Alfred Lamb was known for producing the rum of choice for the British Navy. The hexagon shape of the bottle assured his smooth and refined rum wouldn't roll around on ships. Aroma: Natural sweet cane and butter-rum. Taste: Complex blend of sweet island spice and molasses with subtle oak. Finish: Warm and lingering spicy dry finish.

lambs-palm-breeze-rum.title: Lamb's Palm Breeze Amber Rum
lambs-palm-breeze-rum.bodyHtml: Lamb's Palm Breeze amber rum dates back to 1849 and its hexagonal bottle is said to have been created so it wouldn't roll off a ship's table. It's pale gold with a burnt sugar aroma and vanilla flavour. A Caribbean-style, sugar cane-based rum with island spice and molasses best enjoyed with ice and lime or with ginger beer.

captain-morgan-dark-rum-1.title: Captain Morgan Dark Rum
captain-morgan-dark-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan Dark Rum is the Captain's rich, full-bodied dark rum, made with the heritage of Jamaica at its heart. The rum is aged for at least two years in charred oak barrels, which give it its oaky depth, and is then blended to Captain Morgan's own recipe. The Canadian bottling is a blend of Caribbean and Canadian rums, bottled at 40% alcohol by volume in a 750ml bottle. Expect an intensely deep, rich and smooth taste with a smoky cask finish, equally at home neat, on the rocks or in rum punches and classic dark rum cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Intensely deep and rich with a smoky cask finish.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, with ginger ale, or in a Mai Tai.

disaronno-amaretto-liqueur.title: Disaronno Originale Amaretto Liqueur
disaronno-amaretto-liqueur.bodyHtml:
Disaronno Originale Amaretto Liqueur is a famous Italian amber-colored almond-flavored liqueur produced in Saronno, Italy. Crafted from a secret formula unchanged since 1525, its distinctive flavor profile is derived from an infusion of apricot kernel oil combined with absolute alcohol, burnt sugar, and the pure essence of seventeen selected herbs and fruits.

Food Pairing: Tiramisu, dark chocolate tarts, biscotti, fruit tarts, vanilla gelato, or almond-based pastries.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper-amber in color with a velvety, rich, and syrupy mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense marzipan, sweet almond, toasted nuts, vanilla, and subtle herbal spices.

Palate : Sweet and smooth with dominant flavors of marzipan, bitter almond, toasted macadamia, sweet vanilla, and caramelized sugar.

Finish : Medium-to-long, sweet, and warming with lingering toasted almond, marzipan, and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, as a digestif, or as the core ingredient in classic cocktails like the Amaretto Sour or Godfather.

j-b-rare.title: J&B Rare
j-b-rare.bodyHtml:
J&B Rare is the flagship blended Scotch of Justerini & Brooks, the London wine and spirits merchant founded in 1749 on St James's Street. The blend first appeared as J&B Club and took the Rare name in 1930. It is built from 42 malt and grain whiskies, with Speyside malts at its heart: Knockando, Auchroisk, Strathmill and Glen Spey supply the core malts, and the recipe and the bright yellow label have barely changed since the 1930s. Light, dry and clean in style, with herbaceous and floral notes, it is a versatile whisky for highballs and mixed drinks. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. J&B is owned by Diageo.

Serve: Over ice, with soda in a highball, or in a Rob Roy.

sauza-silver-tequila.title: Sauza Silver Tequila
sauza-silver-tequila.bodyHtml:
Sauza Hacienda Silver is the unaged silver tequila from Sauza, the Jalisco tequila house founded in 1873, made to bring agave flavour to margaritas and cocktails. It pours crystal clear with subtle aromas of citrus, agave and light malty notes; the palate is fresh and lively with citrus, agave and pepper on a medium body, finishing with a touch of bitter citrus. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Citrus, agave and pepper.

Nose: Subtle citrus, agave and light malty notes.

Palate: Fresh and lively, with citrus, agave and pepper on a medium body.

Finish: A touch of bitter citrus.

Serve: In margaritas and fruit-based cocktails.

tanqueray-london-dry-gin.title: Tanqueray London Dry Gin
tanqueray-london-dry-gin.bodyHtml:
Tanqueray London Dry Gin is an iconic, double-distilled London dry gin produced by Charles Tanqueray & Co., owned by Diageo. Crafted using a timeless recipe that dates back to the 1830s, it is distilled four times in copper pot stills (including the famous "Old Tom" No. 4 Still) using four core botanicals: piney juniper, coriander seed, angelica root, and sweet liquorice. This balanced, juniper-forward combination delivers a crisp, dry, and classic gin profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon crostini, lemon-herb grilled chicken, goat cheese salad, or cured meats.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear appearance with a light-to-medium, crisp, and clean body on the palate.

Nose : Direct and aromatic with dominant piney juniper, followed by bright citrus zest, herbal coriander, and earthy angelica root.

Palate : Crisp, dry, and balanced with prominent juniper, spicy coriander seeds, subtle citrus peel, and a smooth, bittersweet liquorice undertone.

Finish : Long, dry, and refreshing with lingering notes of piney juniper and warm herbal spice.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled over fresh ice with premium tonic water and a wedge of fresh lime in a classic Gin & Tonic, or as the base of a Dry Martini.

bacardi-gold-rum.title: Bacardi Gold Rum 375ml
bacardi-gold-rum.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Gold Rum is the amber-hued member of the Bacardí range, a 40% ABV rum shaped by the brand's Maestros de Ron. Its golden colour and rich character come from ageing in toasted oak barrels, while its mellow, rounded texture is credited to filtration through a blend of charcoals that Bacardí keeps secret. It closes dry with a gentle sweetness. Bacardí positions it as a rum for bold, zesty and punchy drinks, and it is the natural base for a Cuba Libre. This listing is the 375ml flask. The Canadian label notes that it is a blend of Puerto Rican rum.

Nose: Nutty and buttery.

Palate: Rich and toasted.

Finish: Dry with a light sweetness.

Serve: Top with cola and a squeeze of lime for a Cuba Libre, or use in citrus-forward rum cocktails.

red-tassel-vodka-1.title: Red Tassel Vodka
red-tassel-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Red Tassel Vodka is a budget-friendly European-style vodka distilled from grains for a clean and simple profile. Designed for utility and ease of mixing, it offers a straightforward taste with gentle grain notes and a light pepper warmth, making it a functional option for casual gatherings and mixed drinks.

Food Pairing: Salty snacks, pickles, cured meats, fried appetizers, or light pasta salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear and transparent appearance with a light-to-medium, straightforward body.

Nose : Subtle ethanol aroma with faint grain sweetness and light neutral mineral notes.

Palate : Simple and crisp with basic wheat grain sweetness and a light peppery spice.

Finish : Short to medium with a direct, warm pepper finish and slight grain bite.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled or mixed into highball cocktails such as a Vodka Soda or Vodka Cranberry.

johnnie-walker-red-label-6.title: Johnnie Walker Red Label 375ml
johnnie-walker-red-label-6.bodyHtml:
The Walkers' empire was built upon the Red Label, the best-selling Scottish whisky in the world today. It is appreciated for its pronounced, fruity, spicy and slightly smoky flavours. Perfect to liven up your cocktails, it remains a great choice to begin your exploration of whiskies.

Johnnie Walker Red Label is their Pioneer Blend, the versatile one that has introduced their whisky to the world. Crafted from the four corners of Scotland, it crackles with spice and is bursting with vibrant, smoky flavours, followed by a mellow bed of vanilla, a fresh zestiness and the Johnnie Walker signature of a long, lingering, smoky finish.

lambs-palm-breeze-rum-1.title: Lamb's Palm Breeze Amber Rum 375ml
lambs-palm-breeze-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Lamb's Palm Breeze Amber Rum is a smooth Canadian rum inspired by Caribbean rum-making traditions dating back to 1849. Crafted using sugar cane-based spirits, it offers a pale golden colour with inviting aromas of burnt sugar, vanilla and sweet molasses. Gentle island spices, subtle oak character and a warming finish make this approachable amber rum a versatile choice.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with barbecue pork ribs, jerk chicken, grilled pineapple, smoked sausages, caramelized desserts, dark chocolate and spiced nuts.

Tasting Notes: Smooth and lightly sweet with flavours of molasses, vanilla, caramel, subtle oak and warming island spices.

Nose: Sweet sugar cane, burnt sugar, butter-rum and soft vanilla aromas.

Palate: Smooth and balanced with rich molasses, gentle caramel sweetness, island spices and subtle oak notes.

Finish: Warm and lingering with a pleasantly dry, gently spiced character.

baby-champagne.title: Andres Baby Canadian Champagne 750ml
baby-champagne.bodyHtml: Baby Champagne is a sparkling blend of grapes, crafted with care and expertise to create a delicious and delightful libation.

alberta-premium-whisky-4.title: Alberta Premium Rye 375ml
alberta-premium-whisky-4.bodyHtml: The authentic flavour of prairie rye and careful barrel ageing gives this whisky a golden amber colour and an aromatic sweet bouquet of banana, toffee, and light spice. The flavour is mellow and slightly smoky with a lively woody edge on a medium weight palate that finishes with a hint of hot cinnamon spice.

remy-martin-vsop-very-special-old-pale-1.title: Remy Martin VSOP Cognac
remy-martin-vsop-very-special-old-pale-1.bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin V.S.O.P. is a world-renowned Fine Champagne Cognac, signifying a prestigious blend of eaux-de-vie sourced exclusively from the Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne crus. Since its creation, this expression has become a benchmark for the house style, characterized by its vibrant gold colour and exceptional silkiness. On the nose, it reveals a complex and elegant bouquet of vanilla, toasted oak, and dried apricots, nuanced by floral notes of violet and rose. The palate is perfectly balanced and well-rounded, showcasing flavours of ripe summer fruits and liquorice, leading to a long, sophisticated finish with a hint of warm baking spice. This versatile spirit is highly celebrated for its ability to be enjoyed neat, over ice, or as a premium base for classic cocktails like the Sidecar.

Food Pairing: Rémy Martin VSOP is incredibly versatile and pairs brilliantly with rich, savory appetizers. It is an exceptional match for duck rillettes, foie gras, or a cured ham like Jamón Ibérico. The Cognac's acidity and fruitiness also cut through the richness of aged cheeses like Comté or Parmesan, and it complements sweet desserts like dark chocolate mousse or an almond tart.

Tasting Notes : Vibrant golden amber with a structured, layered, and silky mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic harmony of vanilla, dried apricot, candied pear, subtle jasmine, and light oak spice.

Palate : Well-balanced with notes of ripe peach, cooked apricot, dried fruit, delicate liquorice, and soft oaky vanilla.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant with lingering dried fruit, sweet vanilla, and delicate oak warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, over ice in a tumbler glass, or topped with ginger ale.

deaubonne-vsop-brandy.title: D'Eaubonne VSOP Brandy
deaubonne-vsop-brandy.bodyHtml:
D'Eaubonne VSOP Brandy is a Canadian VSOP brandy from British Columbia. It pours a golden amber colour. On the nose there is citrus-orange and caramel with a hint of pineapple, while the palate is delicate, with citrus and oak leading to a warm, dry finish. Bottled at 40% ABV, it is a versatile bottle for the home bar: pour it neat after dinner, make it the base of a Spanish coffee, or use it in marinades in the kitchen. This listing is the 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Golden amber, with citrus, caramel and light oak.

Nose: Citrus-orange and caramel with a hint of pineapple.

Palate: Delicate citrus and oak.

Finish: Warm and dry.

Serve: Neat, in a Spanish coffee, or in marinades.

brights-74-tawny-port-1.title: Brights 74 Tawny Port 750ml
brights-74-tawny-port-1.bodyHtml:
74 refers to 1874, the year that Brights wines was established. This port-style wine has aromas of assorted berries jam, plum, spices and mushrooms. The palate is sweet, showing cooked berry and fruit, plum and nutty flavours, with notes of old wood and spices. Serve with chocolate desserts, pastries or rich cheese.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A classic, approachable Tawny with pleasant notes of caramel, dried fruit, and nuts. Smooth and well-balanced, offering great value."
88 Points - Wine Align
"A straightforward and sweet fortified wine with raisin and toffee flavors. A reliable, uncomplicated choice for casual sipping."

captain-morgan-gold-rum.title: Captain Morgan Gold Rum
captain-morgan-gold-rum.bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan Gold is a smooth, easy-mixing gold rum from Captain Morgan's Canadian range. The producer describes notes of sweet wood and hazelnut coming together in a well-balanced spirit with a smooth finish, a medium-weight palate and restrained sweetness. That restraint makes it a natural partner for cola. This listing is the 750ml bottle at 40% ABV, produced in Quebec.

Tasting Notes: Sweet wood and hazelnut with restrained sweetness.

Palate: Medium weight, balanced, with restrained sweetness.

Finish: Smooth.

Serve: With cola over ice and a wedge of lime.

lambs-white-rum.title: Lamb's White Rum
lambs-white-rum.bodyHtml: Enterprising merchant Alfred Lamb aged his fine rum in a cellar by the River Thames, producing a distinct, refined, classic rum reflecting the character of its creator. Aroma: Sweet cane, vanilla and molasses. Taste: Very flavourful with delicate island spice and freshly cut cane. Finish: Smooth and gentle lingering sweetness.

ballantines-finest-4.title: Ballantine's Finest 375ml
ballantines-finest-4.bodyHtml:
Ballantine's Finest is the signature blended Scotch whisky of Ballantine's, made by Allied Distillers in Scotland and bottled at 40% ABV. It is a smooth, approachable blend: a soft, floral and fruity nose with nutty tones, an oily texture with barley-sugar sweetness, and a fresh, creamy and fruity palate where spice builds steadily. The International Wine & Spirit Competition scored it 96 points in 2022. This listing is the 375ml half bottle, a handy size for travel or for trying the blend.

Nose: Soft, floral and fruity with nutty tones.

Palate: Fresh, creamy and fruity, with building spice.

Serve: Neat, on ice, or with soda or cola in a long drink.

meaghers-triple-sec-orange-liqueur.title: Meaghers Triple Sec Orange Liqueur
meaghers-triple-sec-orange-liqueur.bodyHtml:
Meaghers Triple Sec is a Canadian orange liqueur from the Meaghers range of Corby Spirit and Wine, produced in Quebec and bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Clear in the glass, it carries a fragrant orange-peel and juicy citrus character, with a bitter-sweet balance and a warm, smooth finish. Triple sec is one of the basic building blocks of a home bar, and this one is suited to the classic cocktails that call for it, from the Margarita to sours and punches, where it adds orange depth and gentle sweetness.

Tasting Notes: Orange peel and fresh citrus, balanced bitter-sweet, warm smooth finish.

Serve: Use in Margaritas and other citrus cocktails.

baileys-original-irish-cream-3.title: Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur
baileys-original-irish-cream-3.bodyHtml:
Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur is a luxurious, velvety classic that blends fine Irish whiskey and spirits with rich, luscious dairy cream and hints of cocoa and vanilla. First introduced in 1974, it is the world’s most celebrated cream liqueur, offering a beautifully balanced, indulgent, and decadent drinking experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with dark chocolate desserts, molten lava cakes, tiramisu, and fresh berries. It also makes a wonderful accompaniment to warm apple pie, pecan tarts, or simply drizzled over premium vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Opaque, creamy light brown with a rich, velvety, and thick mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet cream, dark chocolate, vanilla, and a subtle hint of warming Irish whiskey.

Palate : Smooth and indulgent with rich flavors of fresh dairy cream, milk chocolate, cocoa, sweet vanilla, and mild whiskey warmth.

Finish : Sweet, long, and coat-the-tongue smooth with lingering chocolate, cream, and soft whiskey notes.

Serve : Serve chilled, poured over ice, or as a rich addition to hot coffee, hot chocolate, or desserts.

pernod-bitter-liqueur.title: Pernod Bitter Liqueur
pernod-bitter-liqueur.bodyHtml: Electric deep yellow with lime tinges, the nose suggests medium aromas of fennel seeds and soft black licorice. It is viscous and creamy ending with a slight sweetness and tones of fennel seeds, herbs and light licorice.

lambs-navy-rum-1.title: Lamb's Navy Rum 375ml
lambs-navy-rum-1.bodyHtml: Alfred Lamb was known for producing the rum of choice for the British Navy. The hexagon shape of the bottle assured his smooth and refined rum wouldn't roll around on ships. Aroma: Natural sweet cane and butter-rum. Taste: Complex blend of sweet island spice and molasses with subtle oak. Finish: Warm and lingering spicy dry finish.

alberta-springs-whisky.title: Alberta Springs 10 Year Old Canadian Rye Whisky
alberta-springs-whisky.bodyHtml:
Alberta Springs Canadian Whisky is a classic, well-regarded Canadian rye whisky produced by Alberta Distillers Limited. Crafted from a blend of fine grains and glacier-fed Rocky Mountain water, this expression is notably aged for 10 years and then re-barreled after blending to allow the flavors to marry perfectly. This maturation process results in an exceptionally smooth, versatile, and approachable whisky that beautifully balances sweet oak notes with a signature peppery rye spice.

Food Pairing: Grilled pork chops, maple-glazed root vegetables, sharp cheddar cheese, pecan pie, or milk chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant golden amber in appearance with a soft, smooth, and welcoming mouthfeel.

Nose : Toasty grain, sweet vanilla, dusty rye spice, caramel, roasted nuts, mild oak, and hints of crisp green apple.

Palate : Soft, smooth, and well-rounded, featuring flavors of sweet vanilla, butterscotch, and toffee, balanced by a vibrant peppery rye spice, cinnamon, and subtle orchard fruit.

Finish : Medium-long, smooth, and warming, with lingering notes of baking spices, sweet oak, and a peppery rye kick.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed into a classic cocktail such as a Rye & Ginger, Whisky Sour, or Old Fashioned.

cointreau-orange-liqueur-1.title: Cointreau Orange Liqueur
cointreau-orange-liqueur-1.bodyHtml:
Cointreau Orange Liqueur (officially Cointreau L'Unique) is the world's most famous premium orange liqueur and the gold standard defining the "triple sec" style. Established in 1849 in Angers, France, by the Cointreau brothers, it is crafted from a precise, secret balance of dried and fresh peels from both sweet and bitter oranges sourced from around the globe. The orange peels are macerated in a neutral sugar beet spirit before undergoing distillation in traditional copper pot stills. Known for its perfect structural harmony, it delivers intense citrus oils with a less cloying sweetness than other triple secs, making it an indispensable staple in cocktail history.

Food Pairing: Duck à l'orange, dark chocolate soufflé, citrus-infused tart desserts, or spicy glazed shrimp.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear and brilliant in appearance, turning uniquely opalescent (cloudy) when mixed with ice or water; has a silky, velvety, and medium-to-full body.

NOSE Powerfully aromatic and complex, exploding with the fragrance of fresh orange zest, fragrant white blossoms, and bright citrus oils, underpinned by a mild warmth.

PALATE Beautifully balanced and crisp; an immediate, clean sweetness of candied orange gives way to a complex, multi-layered profile of bitter orange rind, mandarin, and a light trace of warm baking spice.

FINISH Long, clean, and refreshing with a lingering, dry essence of essential orange oils and a pleasant, warming spirit snap.

SERVE Exceptional when enjoyed neat or over ice as a digestif, and universally required as the premium modifier for classic cocktails like the Margarita, Cosmopolitan, Sidecar, and White Lady.

red-tassel-vodka-2.title: Red Tassel Vodka 1.14L
red-tassel-vodka-2.bodyHtml:
Red Tassel Vodka is a budget-friendly European-style vodka distilled from grains for a clean and simple profile. Designed for utility and ease of mixing, it offers a straightforward taste with gentle grain notes and a light pepper warmth, making it a functional option for casual gatherings and mixed drinks.

Food Pairing: Salty snacks, pickles, cured meats, fried appetizers, or light pasta salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear and transparent appearance with a light-to-medium, straightforward body.

Nose : Subtle ethanol aroma with faint grain sweetness and light neutral mineral notes.

Palate : Simple and crisp with basic wheat grain sweetness and a light peppery spice.

Finish : Short to medium with a direct, warm pepper finish and slight grain bite.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled or mixed into highball cocktails such as a Vodka Soda or Vodka Cranberry.

chivas-regal-12-year-old-1.title: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old
chivas-regal-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Chivas Regal 12 Year Old is a classic, world-renowned blended Scotch whisky created by the Chivas Brothers in Aberdeen, Scotland. Crafted from a selection of fine malt and grain whiskies—with Strathisla single malt at its heart—this signature expression is aged for a minimum of 12 years. It delivers a smooth, rich, and accessible Speyside-influenced profile known for its balance of orchard fruits, wild herbs, and sweet honey.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork loin, smoked salmon, creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert, apple pie, and shortbread biscuits.

Tasting Notes : Radiant, warm amber color. Smooth, round, and creamy texture with a light-to-medium body.

Nose : An aromatic infusion of wild herbs, heather, honey, and orchard fruits like ripe apples and peaches.

Palate : Rich and fruity with flavors of sweet honey, poached apples, vanilla, butterscotch, and subtle hazelnut notes.

Finish : Smooth and lingering with gentle notes of oak spice, honey, and subtle maltiness.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed into classic cocktail recipes such as a Highball or Rob Roy.

johnnie-walker-black-label-1.title: Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old
johnnie-walker-black-label-1.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old is an iconic and highly regarded blended Scotch whisky, crafted using whiskies drawn from the four corners of Scotland. Aged for a minimum of 12 years, this masterful blend combines the lighter, sweeter whiskies of the east with the robust, peaty malts of the west. The result is a deep, complex, and incredibly well-balanced spirit that has set the benchmark for premium blends worldwide.

Food Pairing: The smoky and rich flavor profile of this whisky pairs wonderfully with hearty and savory dishes like slow-cooked BBQ pork, smoked brisket, or a rich charcuterie board. It is also exceptional alongside dark chocolate or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep gold with rich amber highlights in appearance, offering a smooth, medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Bold and aromatic, featuring heavy notes of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, and dark orange peel, beautifully balanced by underlying wood spice and gentle, fragrant peat smoke.

Palate : Complex, smooth, and layered. Rich flavors of sweet vanilla, creamy toffee, and dark fruit give way to warm winter baking spices, toasted oak, and a distinct wave of peat smoke.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth, leaving a lingering impression of soft smoke, sweet malt, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, over ice in a double rocks glass, or mixed with high-quality ginger ale or soda water in a tall highball glass with a fresh orange wedge.

hennessy-vs-very-special-cognac-1.title: Hennessy VS Cognac
hennessy-vs-very-special-cognac-1.bodyHtml:
Hennessy VS Cognac is a vibrant, iconic French cognac crafted by Jas Hennessy & Co. Assembled from a blend of up to 40 different eaux-de-vie aged for at least two years in French oak casks, it delivers a lively, fruit-forward character balanced by toasted oak and subtle spice.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, braised pork chops, roasted duck, dark chocolate desserts, or rich creamy cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-copper in appearance with a full, round, and smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Toasted oak, fresh citrus, vanilla, subtle floral notes, and hints of brown sugar and almond.

Palate : Vibrant and fruit-driven with notes of fresh apple, ripe grape, warm baking spices, vanilla, and roasted nuts.

Finish : Medium-long, warm, and crisp with lingering notes of wood spice, cinnamon, and subtle fruit.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a foundational spirit for classic cocktails like a Sidecar or Hennessy Ginger.

bols-advocaat-egg-cream-liqueur.title: Bols Advocaat Egg Liqueur
bols-advocaat-egg-cream-liqueur.bodyHtml: Advocaat is a traditional Dutch liqueur, much like eggnog. Made from a combination of eggs, sugar and brandy, this decadent liqueur has a bright creamy yellow colour with rich egg custard aromas and flavours that are balanced by light brandy notes that come through on the palate.

forty-creek-barrel-select-whisky.title: Forty Creek Barrel Select Whisky 1.75L
forty-creek-barrel-select-whisky.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Barrel Select Whisky is an exceptionally smooth, award-winning Canadian blended whisky. It is crafted using a unique process where rye, barley, and corn are distilled and aged separately in selected oak barrels before being artistically blended together to create a complex, harmonious spirit with rich, approachable flavors.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoky barbecued pulled pork, maple-glazed ribs, sharp aged cheddar cheese, or sweet pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, honey, toasted oak, cocoa, and light butterscotch with subtle apricot fruitiness.

Palate : Smooth and complex with notes of dark sweet fruit, vanilla, toasted wood, rich caramel, and gentle rye spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of gentle oak spice, vanilla, and sweet honey.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as the base in a classic Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

crown-royal-whisky-2.title: Crown Royal Peach Whisky
crown-royal-whisky-2.bodyHtml: Crown Royal Peach Flavored Whisky is a new Limited Edition from Crown Royal, bringing some juicy sweetness to your summer season. To create this extraordinary blend, Crown Royal whiskies are carefully selected by our master blender and infused with the juicy flavor of fresh Georgia peaches. The result is a vibrantly delicious whisky, bursting with the luscious flavor of peach and the distinctive smoothness of Crown Royal.

wisers-de-luxe-whisky-2.title: J.P. Wiser's Deluxe 375ml
wisers-de-luxe-whisky-2.bodyHtml:
J.P. Wiser's Deluxe is the signature Canadian whisky of the J.P. Wiser's family, here in a 375ml half bottle. Blended and bottled in Windsor, Ontario, it pours a rich amber and combines caramel, toffee and vanilla sweetness with toasted grains and seasoned oak for a full, rounded palate. Deluxe earned a Silver Medal at the 2025 World Whiskies Awards. Bottled at 40% ABV, it works neat, over ice or mixed with soda or ginger ale.

Tasting Notes: Caramel, toffee and vanilla with toasted grains and seasoned oak.

Nose: Dried fruit, caramel and lush spring meadows.

Palate: Oak, toasted grains and rich toffee.

Finish: Full, warm and smooth.

Serve: On the rocks, with soda or ginger ale, or in a Whisky Smash.

courvoisier-vsop-very-special-old-pale.title: Courvoisier VSOP Cognac
courvoisier-vsop-very-special-old-pale.bodyHtml:
Courvoisier VSOP is a classic, deeply refined Cognac that beautifully showcases the delicate balance between floral elegance and rich oak maturation. Expertly blended from a selection of fine eaux-de-vie sourced from the Grande Champagne, Petite Champagne, Fins Bois, and Borderies crus, this Very Superior Old Pale expression is aged in fine French oak barrels for a minimum of four years, with some components aged up to a decade. The result is a highly versatile and harmonious spirit, renowned for its signature notes of ripe stone fruit, fragrant jasmine, and warm toasted almonds.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate, caramelized fruit tarts, roasted nuts, premium charcuterie, and strong cheeses like Roquefort or mature Gouda.

Tasting Notes : Radiant golden-amber in appearance with a smooth, well-rounded, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Elegant and highly aromatic, leading with delicate floral notes of jasmine and rose, followed by sweet peach, toasted almond, and soft vanilla oak.

Palate : Smooth, harmonious, and beautifully balanced. Rich flavors of baked apple, ripe peach, and dried apricot are layered with warm vanilla, toasted oak, and a subtle dusting of cinnamon and baking spice.

Finish : Warm, smooth, and of medium length, leaving an elegant, lingering impression of soft stone fruit, mild oak spice, and toasted nuts.

Serve : Serve neat in a tulip glass or snifter to concentrate its floral aromas, over a single large ice cube, or as a premium base for classic cocktails like the Sidecar or a French 75.

jameson-irish-whiskey-irish-whiskey-1.title: Jameson Irish Whiskey
jameson-irish-whiskey-irish-whiskey-1.bodyHtml:
Jameson Irish Whiskey is a globally renowned, exceptionally smooth spirit that embodies the classic taste of Ireland. Produced at the Midleton Distillery in County Cork, it is crafted using a blend of rich pot still and fine grain whiskeys. By triple distilling the spirit and aging it in fine oak casks for a minimum of four years, Jameson achieves its signature, perfectly balanced character that is celebrated for having no harsh edge.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pub classics like fish and chips, savory shepherd's pie, or a rich beef and Guinness stew. It also complements sharp Irish cheddar, smoked salmon, and desserts like bread pudding or dark chocolate squares.

Tasting Notes : Bright light-amber appearance with an exceptionally smooth, light-to-medium-bodied, and clean mouthfeel.

Nose : Light floral fragrance peppered with spicy wood, sweet notes of fresh orchard fruit, cut grass, and a gentle hint of vanilla.

Palate : Perfectly balanced fusion of sweet vanilla, crisp green apple, fresh pear, subtle toasted wood, and a touch of hazelnut.

Finish : Incredibly clean and smooth, leaving behind a brief, pleasant warmth and a lingering, soft note of spice and sweet grain.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, mixed with ginger ale and lime, or as the base in an Irish Coffee.

cointreau-orange-liqueur-2.title: Cointreau Orange Liqueur 375ml
cointreau-orange-liqueur-2.bodyHtml:
Cointreau Orange Liqueur (officially Cointreau L'Unique) is the world's most famous premium orange liqueur and the gold standard defining the "triple sec" style. Established in 1849 in Angers, France, by the Cointreau brothers, it is crafted from a precise, secret balance of dried and fresh peels from both sweet and bitter oranges sourced from around the globe. The orange peels are macerated in a neutral sugar beet spirit before undergoing distillation in traditional copper pot stills. Known for its perfect structural harmony, it delivers intense citrus oils with a less cloying sweetness than other triple secs, making it an indispensable staple in cocktail history.

Food Pairing: Duck à l'orange, dark chocolate soufflé, citrus-infused tart desserts, or spicy glazed shrimp.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear and brilliant in appearance, turning uniquely opalescent (cloudy) when mixed with ice or water; has a silky, velvety, and medium-to-full body.

NOSE Powerfully aromatic and complex, exploding with the fragrance of fresh orange zest, fragrant white blossoms, and bright citrus oils, underpinned by a mild warmth.

PALATE Beautifully balanced and crisp; an immediate, clean sweetness of candied orange gives way to a complex, multi-layered profile of bitter orange rind, mandarin, and a light trace of warm baking spice.

FINISH Long, clean, and refreshing with a lingering, dry essence of essential orange oils and a pleasant, warming spirit snap.

SERVE Exceptional when enjoyed neat or over ice as a digestif, and universally required as the premium modifier for classic cocktails like the Margarita, Cosmopolitan, Sidecar, and White Lady.

dujardin-vsop-brandy.title: Dujardin Fine VSOP Brandy
dujardin-vsop-brandy.bodyHtml:
Dujardin Fine VSOP Brandy is a German brandy from the Dujardin brand, now part of the Schwarze und Schlichte family spirits company. It brings together French wine-growing tradition and German distilling: the brandy is distilled from selected French wines and given extended maturation in Limousin oak barrels, which lend it a golden colour, a rich taste and an aromatic bouquet. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is an approachable VSOP for sipping or mixing.

Serve: Neat or over ice, with ginger ale, or in brandy cocktails such as a Sidecar.

grand-marnier-cognac-orange-liqueur-2.title: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge 375ml
grand-marnier-cognac-orange-liqueur-2.bodyHtml: Established in 1827, Grand Marnier is still made using the original recipe of Cognac blended with the essence of exotic, Caribbean-grown bitter oranges. Enjoy aromas and flavours of orange zest combined with the spicy and fruity notes of fine Cognac. Enjoy it in a Grand Margarita.

brotte-la-fiole-du-pape.title: Brotte Père Anselme "La Fiole du Pape" Châteauneuf-du-Pape
brotte-la-fiole-du-pape.bodyHtml:
Brotte Père Anselme "La Fiole du Pape" Châteauneuf-du-Pape is an iconic, richly textured, and expressive Southern Rhône red wine crafted by Maison Brotte in Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Famous for its distinctive twisted glass bottle inspired by wind-sculpted vines, this non-vintage cuvée is blended from Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre, and Cinsault sourced from vineyards characterized by rounded galets roulés stones, clay, and sandy soils. Combining mature reserve wines with vibrant younger vintages aged in traditional large oak foudres and concrete vats, it displays a luminous garnet-ruby hue in the glass. The aromatic bouquet opens with fragrant notes of ripe blackberries, wild strawberries, and dark plums layered with garrigue herbs, cracked black pepper, licorice, and warm spices. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, velvety mouthfeel balanced by refreshing acidity and supple, integrated tannins, culminating in a long, savory, and spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Slow-braised lamb shoulder, grilled ribeye steak, wild boar ragù, roasted duck breast, or aged Comté cheese.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Accessible and inviting, with rich red currant and blackberry fruit dusted in mocha. Soft and round on the palate, with a thread of firming graphite. A friendly, open style. Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre and Cinsault. Drink now through 2027. 42,000 cases made, 1,000 cases imported.

glenfiddich-12-year-old-signature-malt.title: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old
glenfiddich-12-year-old-signature-malt.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 12 Year Old is the world’s most awarded single malt Scotch whisky and the iconic flagship expression of the Glenfiddich Distillery. Carefully matured in a combination of the finest American oak (ex-bourbon) and European oak (ex-Oloroso sherry) casks for at least 12 years, it is then married in oak marrying tuns for up to nine months. This meticulous process yields an exceptionally smooth, fresh, and beautifully balanced whisky, famous for its signature notes of fresh green pear, subtle oak, and sweet maltiness.

Food Pairing: Soft cheeses like Camembert or Brie, smoked salmon, pork tenderloin with apple glaze, fresh fruit tarts, and shortbread biscuits.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber in appearance with a light, smooth, and easily approachable mouthfeel.

Nose : Distinctively fresh and fruity with a prominent hint of fresh green pear, subtle oak, floral notes, and a touch of sweet malt.

Palate : Smooth and beautifully balanced, featuring characteristic sweet, fruity notes of pear and orchard fruits, turning into subtle butterscotch, cream, malt, and subtle oak spice.

Finish : Long, smooth, and mellow, leaving a sweet and lingering oaky finish.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of water to open up the delicate fruit aromas, or over ice.

captain-morgan-deluxe-rum.title: Captain Morgan Private Stock Rum
captain-morgan-deluxe-rum.bodyHtml:
The Captain always has an appreciation for the finer things in life, whether it be a chest full of pieces of eight or a bottle of mature rum.

This one comes aged for two years in oak barrels to give it woody undertones that mingle effortlessly with spices and hints of creamy vanilla. The Captain?s Private Stock Rum is a special brew of barrel matured rum that?s infused with only the finest quality ingredients. It goes down a treat on its own or makes a treasured ingredient in any rum cocktail.

hakutsuru.title: Gekkeikan 18L Bag In Box
hakutsuru.bodyHtml:
Gekkeikan Traditional Sake is a classic Junmai-style sake produced in California. Smooth and approachable, it offers aromas of sweet banana, apricot, nectarine, roasted chestnut, and subtle mushroom notes. The palate is light-bodied with gentle umami character, refreshing acidity, and a clean, crisp finish. Enjoy chilled, at room temperature, or gently warmed.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with Sushi, grilled seafood, roasted meats, mushrooms, stir-fries, and Asian-inspired dishes.

lambs-white-rum-1.title: Lamb's Classic White Rum 375ml
lambs-white-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Lamb's White Rum is a classic Canadian white rum known for its smooth, approachable character and distinctive heritage. Inspired by the tradition established by Alfred Lamb in London in 1849, this versatile rum brings together the delicate sweetness of sugar cane with inviting notes of vanilla, molasses and gentle island spice. Crystal clear in appearance, it opens with subtle aromas of freshly cut sugar cane, green banana and vanilla bean. The palate is light yet flavourful, offering a balanced combination of soft sweetness, delicate spice and clean rum character. Its smooth texture leads to a crisp, refreshing finish with lingering hints of vanilla and sugar cane. Bottled at 40% ABV in a convenient 375ml format, Lamb's White Rum delivers the familiar character of a traditional white rum with a smooth and versatile profile.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled shrimp, jerk chicken, citrus-marinated fish, fish tacos, coconut prawns and Caribbean-style barbecue. Its delicate sweetness and subtle spice also complement pineapple salsa, grilled vegetables, spicy chicken wings and tropical fruit desserts.

Tasting Notes: A smooth and approachable white rum featuring sweet sugar cane, vanilla, molasses, delicate island spice and subtle tropical fruit notes.

Nose: Fresh sugar cane, vanilla bean, green banana and gentle molasses sweetness, accompanied by delicate spice.

Palate: Smooth and lightly sweet, offering freshly cut cane, vanilla, subtle molasses and soft island spice.

Finish: Clean, gentle and refreshing, with lingering sugar cane sweetness, delicate vanilla and subtle warmth.

captain-morgan-white-rum-4.title: Captain Morgan White Rum 375ml
captain-morgan-white-rum-4.bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan White Rum is a crisp, clean white rum made from a blend of Caribbean rums and distilled five times for a smooth finish. Medium-bodied and light, it pours crystal clear and leaves a slight sweetness on the finish, which makes it an easy base for mixed drinks. This listing is the 375ml half bottle at 40% ABV, produced in Quebec. Captain Morgan points to the Mojito, Cuba Libre and Planter's Punch, or simply rum with soda, ginger ale or cola.

Tasting Notes: Crisp and clean, light, with a slight sweet aftertaste.

Serve: With cola and lime, soda or ginger ale, or in a Mojito.

bushmills-original-irish-whiskey.title: Bushmills Original Irish Whiskey
bushmills-original-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml: Bushmills® Original Irish Whiskey is triple-distilled single malt whiskey combined with an aromatic, lighter grain Irish whiskey, aged at least 3 years in Kentucky bourbon barrels & Spanish Oloroso sherry casks. This is the highest quality blended Irish whiskey from Ireland's oldest whiskey distillery. A recipe unchanged since the 1800s. • 90 Points Wine Enthusiast (40% ABV – 80 proof)

burrowing-owl-meritage.title: Burrowing Owl Meritage 2021
burrowing-owl-meritage.bodyHtml: A concentrated and powerful Bordeaux-style red blend originating from the Black Sage Bench. The 2021 vintage features a vibrant nose of cassis, red currant, and violet, underscored by complex notes of cocoa and dried sage. The palate is full-bodied and firmly structured with ripe tannins and crisp acidity, delivering intense flavours of black cherry, blueberry, and plum that lead into a long, persistent finish of baking spices and dark chocolate.

finlandia-vodka-2.title: Finlandia Vodka
finlandia-vodka-2.bodyHtml:
Finlandia Vodka is the classic unflavoured vodka from Finland's Finlandia, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is made from golden Suomi barley and pure glacial water, and the brand credits Finland's midnight sun as part of its character. The style is dry and light, easy on the palate and silky-smooth with a gentle aroma, which makes it a versatile choice for mixing as well as for serving ice cold on its own.

Tasting Notes: Dry, light and silky-smooth with a gentle aroma.

Serve: Serve ice cold as a shot, or mix with soda, tonic or fruit juice over ice.

glenlivet-12-year-old-1.title: The Glenlivet 12 Year Old
glenlivet-12-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 12 Year Old is a classic single malt Scotch whisky crafted at The Glenlivet Distillery in Moray, Scotland. Matured in a combination of traditional oak and American oak casks, it is renowned for its smooth, well-balanced character, featuring distinct notes of summer fruit, floral honey, and subtle vanilla.

Food Pairing: Seared scallops, roasted chicken, mild creamy cheeses like Brie, or lemon tart.

Tasting Notes : Bright, pale gold with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic and delicate with notes of fresh green apple, ripe pineapple, citrus, floral blossoms, and sweet vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of sweet malt, juicy peach, pear, honey, and subtle oak spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and warm with lingering notes of sweet fruit and gentle oak.

Serve : Serve neat, with a splash of cool water, or over a large ice cube.

jim-beam-white-1.title: Jim Beam White Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon
jim-beam-white-1.bodyHtml:
Jim Beam White Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon is an iconic American whiskey crafted using a time-honored family recipe refined over more than seven generations. Aged for four years in newly charred American white oak barrels, it offers a classic bourbon character marked by smooth, approachable flavors and a balanced, oaky warmth.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with smoky barbecue ribs, grilled burgers, pulled pork, sharp cheddar cheese, pecan pie, or glazed bacon.

Tasting Notes : Bright, rich amber color with a medium body and a smooth, light-to-medium mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet oak, vanilla, spice, and subtle grain notes with light fruit and caramel undertones.

Palate : Smooth and mellow with flavors of oaky vanilla, toasted caramel, sweet corn, and gentle baking spices.

Finish : Clean, warm, and medium-length finish with lingering oak, subtle spice, and sweet corn notes.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as the core base in classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned, Manhattan, or Bourbon & Cola.

chateau-de-la-gardine-chateau-du-pape.title: Chateau de la Gardine Chateauneuf-Du-Pape 2022
chateau-de-la-gardine-chateau-du-pape.bodyHtml:
Château de la Gardine Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2022 is a powerful and classically styled Southern Rhône red, easily recognizable by its unique, asymmetric "Gardine" bottle shape. The 2022 vintage is characterized by its remarkable concentration and sun-drenched fruit profile, resulting from a warm and dry growing season. It offers an expressive bouquet of ripe black cherries, wild raspberries, and kirsch, seamlessly layered with notes of garrigue, liquorice, and black pepper. On the palate, it is full-bodied and robust, featuring a rich, velvety texture supported by firm yet well-integrated tannins and a long, warming finish with hints of toasted spice and dark chocolate.

91 Points - James Suckling

This traditional-style Chateauneuf is warm and spicy. Rich and fleshy on the full-bodied palate with plenty of red fruits alongside Mediterranean herbs. Just a tad chewy at the long, structured finish. Moderate alcohol for this appellation and vintage. Drink or hold.

benedictine-liqueur.title: Benedictine D.O.M. Liqueur
benedictine-liqueur.bodyHtml:
Bénédictine D.O.M. is a French herbal liqueur produced at Le Palais Bénédictine in Fécamp, Normandy, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is built on a secret recipe of 27 herbs and spices, selected from four continents with quality as the only criterion; some of them have been used since biblical times and still feature in folk remedies. The house traces the liqueur back to a Benedictine monk of the Abbey of Fécamp, and says the secrets of its production have been handed down from generation to generation for more than 500 years. In the glass it is rich and coppery with golden highlights. Alongside neat serves, the producer lists classic cocktails such as the Vieux Carré, Bobby Burns and Raffles Sling.

Nose: Herbal and spicy, with tangerine zest and a subtle note of pine.

Palate: Silky and rich, with light honey, citrus and soft almond.

Finish: Rich, warm and lengthy.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in a Vieux Carré or Bobby Burns.

bols-cherry-brandy.title: Bols Cherry Brandy Liqueur
bols-cherry-brandy.bodyHtml:
Bols Cherry Brandy is a ruby-red cherry liqueur from Bols of Amsterdam, bottled at 24% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Despite the traditional name it is a liqueur rather than a straight brandy: Bols traces the recipe to the old Eastern European cherry-brandy tradition and describes a flavour of fresh cherry with a light almond note. That almond hint comes from crushing the cherry stones, which lends a faint amaretto-like edge, and the liqueur is made with natural botanicals. Bols notes that it is a vegan product. Its bright fruit works well lengthened with soda or used as a cocktail modifier.

Tasting Notes: Fresh cherry with a light almond hint.

Serve: Topped with soda over ice, or in classic cocktails.

louis-roederer-brut-premier.title: Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2015
louis-roederer-brut-premier.bodyHtml:
Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2015 is an exceptionally precise and majestic prestige cuvée crafted by one of the most celebrated Champagne houses. Composed of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay meticulously harvested from 45 historic lieu-dit plots farmed with organic practices, this warm, dry vintage reveals a crystalline purity. The expressive bouquet unfolds with aromas of citrus oil, fresh chalk, white peach, and crushed mint, all underpinned by fine pastry notes and roasted almonds. On the palate, it delivers deep concentration and a chiseled structure, driven by a vibrant beam of salinity and an ultra-fine, persistent mousse that finishes with breathtaking vertical elegance and remarkable tension.

Food Pairing: This extraordinarily refined Champagne couples flawlessly with pan-seared sea scallops, fresh oysters, butter-poached lobster tails, or delicate caviar-topped blinis.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

From vineyards that are run organically, this iconic Champagne's latest iteration is as beautiful as ever. Textured, with a mineral undertow, the wine is just beginning to soften and show a balanced maturity. Drink this great wine now.

97 Points - James Suckling

For the warm and dry vintage this has tremendous freshness and elegance. The complex nose of citrus blossom, mint, lemon and lime zest opens up slowly as this aerates in the glass. The wine’s ample structure is still quite firm, which is a vintage characteristic, the mousse very fine but also very lively for an eight-year-old champagne. Cristal fans will love this as it is, but a year or two more in the bottle will do a lot for the very long mineral finish of this youthful masterpiece. A cuvee of 60% pinot noir and 40% chardonnay, picked from all 45 Cristal vineyard plots. Tasted at the Cristal vertical tasting at the champagne house on July 6th, 2023.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This mouthwatering Champagne has an ethereal quality, with a frame of chiseled acidity and focused precision to the pointillisme-like, vibrant mousse. Yet this shows depth and generous expression, with the finely spun notes of patisserie apple and blackberry fruit opening beautifully on the palate and through the minerally finish, with notes of grated ginger, blood orange granita, salted Marcona almond and anise.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

If the 2014 vintage was especially open and demonstrative, the 2015 Cristal is going to require more patience. Unwinding in the glass with aromas of citrus oil, crisp stone fruits, white flowers, crushed mint and subtle hints of buttery pastry, it's medium to full-bodied, deep and layered, with a deep, concentrated and rather introverted core of fruit framed by chalky extract and animated by a pretty pinpoint mousse. This is a serious, vinous Champagne that has considerable substance to age and may well evolve along the lines of the lovely 1985.

sauza-gold-tequila-1.title: Sauza Gold Tequila
sauza-gold-tequila-1.bodyHtml:
Sauza Gold is a classic gold tequila from Mexico, made with blue agave at the historic La Perseverancia distillery.
