It offers aromas of lime zest, vanilla, anise and spice with apricot, peach and pepper, and a dry, smooth palate of caramel, herbs and lime before a soft finish of vanilla and stone fruit. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Lime zest, vanilla, anise and spice with apricot, peach and pepper.

Palate: Dry and smooth, with caramel, herbs and lime.

Finish: Soft vanilla and stone fruit.

Serve: In a margarita, as a chilled shot with lime, or with soda.

grants-family-reserve.title: Grant's Triple Wood Blended Scotch Whisky
grants-family-reserve.bodyHtml:
Grant's Triple Wood is the signature blended Scotch whisky of William Grant & Sons, the fifth-generation Scottish family distiller that fully owns the Grant's brand. Known as Grant's Family Reserve until 2018, the blend was renamed to put the spotlight on its maturation in three different types of wood; the whisky itself stayed the same. Virgin oak casks give spicy robustness, American oak lends a soft vanilla smoothness and refill bourbon casks add brown-sugar sweetness, together creating a smoother, richer and mellower blend. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is an easy all-rounder, equally good neat, over ice or lengthened with a mixer.

Tasting Notes: Clean and fruity, with vanilla sweetness, malt and a light floral lift ahead of a gently smoky close.

Nose: Complex and clean, with ripe pear and summer fruits.

Palate: Vanilla sweetness balanced by malty and light floral notes.

Finish: Long and sweet, with a subtle hint of smoke.

Serve: Pour 50ml over ice in a rocks glass with a twist of orange peel, or top with cola in a highball glass and garnish with an orange wedge.

disaronno-amaretto-liqueur-2.title: Disaronno Originale Amaretto Liqueur 375ml
disaronno-amaretto-liqueur-2.bodyHtml:
Disaronno Originale Amaretto Liqueur is a famous Italian amber-colored almond-flavored liqueur produced in Saronno, Italy. Crafted from a secret formula unchanged since 1525, its distinctive flavor profile is derived from an infusion of apricot kernel oil combined with absolute alcohol, burnt sugar, and the pure essence of seventeen selected herbs and fruits.

Food Pairing: Tiramisu, dark chocolate tarts, biscotti, fruit tarts, vanilla gelato, or almond-based pastries.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper-amber in color with a velvety, rich, and syrupy mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense marzipan, sweet almond, toasted nuts, vanilla, and subtle herbal spices.

Palate : Sweet and smooth with dominant flavors of marzipan, bitter almond, toasted macadamia, sweet vanilla, and caramelized sugar.

Finish : Medium-to-long, sweet, and warming with lingering toasted almond, marzipan, and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, as a digestif, or as the core ingredient in classic cocktails like the Amaretto Sour or Godfather.

tanqueray-london-dry-gin-2.title: Tanqueray London Dry Gin 375ml
tanqueray-london-dry-gin-2.bodyHtml:
Tanqueray London Dry Gin is an iconic, double-distilled London dry gin produced by Charles Tanqueray & Co., owned by Diageo. Crafted using a timeless recipe that dates back to the 1830s, it is distilled four times in copper pot stills (including the famous "Old Tom" No. 4 Still) using four core botanicals: piney juniper, coriander seed, angelica root, and sweet liquorice. This balanced, juniper-forward combination delivers a crisp, dry, and classic gin profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon crostini, lemon-herb grilled chicken, goat cheese salad, or cured meats.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear appearance with a light-to-medium, crisp, and clean body on the palate.

Nose : Direct and aromatic with dominant piney juniper, followed by bright citrus zest, herbal coriander, and earthy angelica root.

Palate : Crisp, dry, and balanced with prominent juniper, spicy coriander seeds, subtle citrus peel, and a smooth, bittersweet liquorice undertone.

Finish : Long, dry, and refreshing with lingering notes of piney juniper and warm herbal spice.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled over fresh ice with premium tonic water and a wedge of fresh lime in a classic Gin & Tonic, or as the base of a Dry Martini.

wisers-de-luxe-whisky-3.title: J.P. Wiser's Deluxe Canadian Whisky 1.75L
wisers-de-luxe-whisky-3.bodyHtml:
J.P. Wiser's Deluxe Canadian Whisky is a rich, exceptionally smooth, and timeless Canadian spirit that stands as one of the country's most cherished everyday classics. Crafted from high-quality grains, traditionally distilled, and patiently aged for a minimum of five years in seasoned oak barrels, it pours a beautiful warm amber-gold colour in the glass. The nose lifts with an inviting, expressive bouquet of rich caramel, warm vanilla, and sweet honey, beautifully complexed by undertones of toasted oak, dried fruits, and a gentle wave of rye baking spice. On the palate, this medium-bodied whisky is remarkably smooth and approachable, delivering a full-flavored experience packed with creamy butterscotch, sweet corn, and toasted wood notes. Balanced by an underlying warmth, it transitions into a clean, smooth, and lengthy finish that leaves lingering hints of clove, black pepper, and toasted vanilla.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with hearty, savory foods such as slow-smoked beef brisket, barbecued pork ribs with sweet glaze, grilled steaks, mature cheeses like aged white cheddar or smoked Gouda, and rich desserts like pecan pie or dark chocolate fudge.

canadian-club-whisky-3.title: Canadian Club Whisky 1.75L
canadian-club-whisky-3.bodyHtml:
Canadian Club Whisky is a historic and universally recognized blended Canadian whisky, renowned for its smooth and highly approachable character. Produced at the legendary Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, this flagship expression (often known as 1858) has been a staple in homes and bars since the mid-19th century. Crafted from a careful selection of corn, rye, rye malt, and barley malt, it undergoes aging in white-oak American bourbon barrels, resulting in a crisp, slightly dry, and versatile profile that helped define the Canadian whisky category.

Food Pairing: The peppery rye notes make this a great match for smoked salmon or grilled steak. It also pairs beautifully with maple-glazed pork chops, aged cheddar cheese, or a dessert featuring dark chocolate.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, golden amber spirit that is exceptionally smooth, light, and approachable, offering a balanced interplay between sweet grain and gentle rye spice.

NOSE - Fresh and soft, opening with a mild almond nuttiness and sweet vanilla, followed by an inviting hint of zesty and peppery rye spice.

Palate - Zesty and slightly spicy on the entry with a clear rye character. The mid-palate softens into sweet vanilla, rich oak, caramel, and a pleasant, subtle creaminess.

FINISH - Clean, dry, and relatively short, leaving behind a lingering, gentle warmth with subtle oak tannins and a faint touch of vanilla.

SERVE - Excellent as a versatile mixer. It is perfect for a classic Highball with ginger ale or club soda, a Whisky Sour, a simple Old Fashioned, or simply poured over ice.

chartreuse-green.title: Chartreuse Green Liqueur 375ml
chartreuse-green.bodyHtml:
Chartreuse Green Liqueur 375ml is a world-renowned French herbal liqueur produced by the Carthusian Monks at their distillery in Entre-deux-Guiers (Aiguenoire), France. Based on a 1605 manuscript recipe for an "Elixir of Long Life," it is naturally colored and crafted from a closely guarded blend of 130 herbs, plants, and flowers macerated in a neutral alcohol base and aged in oak casks. Bottled at 55% ABV, it delivers a powerful, complex, and intensely botanical profile that is celebrated worldwide as both a traditional digestif and a staple cocktail ingredient.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with rich dark chocolate, dark chocolate mousse, lemon tart, blue cheeses like Roquefort, or rich herb-crusted poultry.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant natural bright chartreuse green color with a full body and a rich, oily, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Intensely aromatic and fresh, featuring pungent alpine herbs, peppermint, anise, pine, citrus peel, and crushed botanicals.

Palate : Complex and multifaceted, balancing natural sweetness with strong herbal spice, cooling spearmint, cracked pepper, anise, gentian, and citrus zest.

Finish : Very long, warming, and distinctly herbal with persistent notes of mint, sweet herbs, and subtle cracked pepper.

Serve : Serve chilled as a digestif after dinner, on the rocks, or as an essential base or accent in classic cocktails such as The Last Word, Bijou, or Green Chaud (mixed with hot chocolate).

smirnoff-vodka-4.title: Smirnoff Vodka 1.75L
smirnoff-vodka-4.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff No. 21 Vodka is a classic, globally recognized vodka originally created in 1864. Renowned for its purity and versatility, it undergoes a rigorous triple distillation process and is filtered ten times through seven columns of environmentally sustainable charcoal. This meticulous production method yields a pristine, neutral, and exceptionally smooth spirit that has become a staple for mixologists worldwide.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with caviar, pickled vegetables, cured charcuterie, and light seafood dishes.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear in appearance, delivering a crisp, clean, and light-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and highly neutral with very faint hints of grain sweetness, subtle black pepper, and light minerality.

Palate : Smooth and neutral with a very subtle touch of sweetness, a hint of charcoal, and light peppery spice.

Finish : Short, crisp, and exceptionally clean.

Serve : Best served well-chilled, neat, over ice, or mixed in classic cocktails such as a Moscow Mule, Bloody Mary, or Vodka Soda.

sambuca-luxardo-4.title: Luxardo Sambuca dei Cesari
sambuca-luxardo-4.bodyHtml:
Luxardo Sambuca dei Cesari is a classic Italian anise liqueur from Girolamo Luxardo, the family distillery in Torreglia near Padua. It is made from star anise, herbs and spices, alcohol, sugar and pure volcanic spring water from Luxardo's own sources, following the original family recipe. The anise plant, native to China, spread across the Mediterranean over the centuries and was long valued for its therapeutic properties as well as in local cooking and desserts. Crystal clear in the glass, Luxardo's sambuca is syrupy and sweet with clean aniseed and liquorice, framed by subtle coriander and a peppery lift. This 750ml bottle is presented at 38% alc./vol. It is GMO-free, kosher certified and vegan friendly.

Tasting Notes: Clean, rich aniseed and black liquorice with coriander and cracked pepper.

Nose: Pine and coriander gin-like notes with cracked black pepper, anise and black liquorice.

Palate: Syrupy and very sweet, with clean rich aniseed and liquorice and subtle coriander.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or "con la mosca" with three coffee beans; also with coffee, or diluted with water as an aperitivo.

barack-apricot-brandy.title: Zwack Pecsetes Barack Palinka Apricot Brandy
barack-apricot-brandy.bodyHtml:
Zwack Pecsetes Barack Palinka Apricot Brandy is a traditional Hungarian apricot spirit from the Budapest house of Zwack, bottled at 43% ABV (86 proof) in the brand's round 750ml flask. Barack is the Hungarian word for apricot, and Barack Pálinka is the name given to a spirit made only from fruit harvested in Hungary. The apricots are grown, distilled and then stored in oak barrels in the Hungarian lowlands, and no artificial colours or flavourings are added. It has a rich, fruity apricot aroma and a smooth, warming taste. The label carries the Zwack name and a red wax-style seal.

Tasting Notes: Rich, fruity apricot aroma with a smooth, warming palate.

Serve: Well chilled as a digestif, or in cocktails.

jack-daniels-old-no-7-whiskey.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey
jack-daniels-old-no-7-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey is an iconic, smooth American whiskey crafted in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Charcoal mellowed drop-by-drop through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before aging in handcrafted white oak barrels, it offers a distinct balance of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, and smooth caramel character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, pulled pork sandwiches, grilled burgers, smoked brisket, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold in appearance with a light-to-medium-bodied, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, banana, and subtle brown sugar.

Palate : Balanced mix of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, light spice, and rich caramel.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and medium-length with lingering toasted oak, charcoal, and sweet spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed with cola in a highball glass.

fundador-brandy.title: Fundador Solera Reserva Brandy de Jerez
fundador-brandy.bodyHtml:
Fundador Solera Reserva Brandy de Jerez is a Spanish grape brandy and one of the best-selling names in its category. Fundador, meaning founder, was the first brand to be sold as Brandy de Jerez. It is distilled from Airén and Palomino grapes and aged in a solera system of casks seasoned with sherry, which gives the brandy its rounded, gently sweet, nutty character. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat after dinner, over ice, or with cola or ginger ale.

hennessy-vsop-very-special-old-pale-cogn.title: Hennessy VSOP Privilege Cognac
hennessy-vsop-very-special-old-pale-cogn.bodyHtml:
Hennessy VSOP Cognac is a harmonious and balanced cognac produced by Jas Hennessy & Co. First created in 1817 at the request of the future King George IV of the United Kingdom, it is crafted from a blend of over 60 different eaux-de-vie aged in seasoned French oak casks, resulting in a rich, velvety profile marked by fresh fruit, toasted oak, and delicate spices.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, foie gras, dark chocolate desserts, aged gouda, or rich caramelized pork belly.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber in color with a velvety, rich, and well-rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh fruit, candied orange peel, vanilla, clove, cinnamon, and subtle toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of ripe apricot, dried fruit, vanilla, toasted almonds, and warm winter spices.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant with lingering notes of sweet spice, candied fruit, and subtle oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip glass, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic cocktails like a Sidecar or Sazerac.

dom-fabrice-vigot-nuits-st-georges-2011.title: Dom Fabrice Vigot Nuits St Georges 2011 750ml
dom-fabrice-vigot-nuits-st-georges-2011.bodyHtml: The 2011 Dom Fabrice Vigot Nuits-Saint-Georges is a red wine produced from Pinot Noir grapes grown in the Nuits-Saint-Georges appellation of Burgundy, France. It's a "Vieilles Vignes" (old vines) wine, meaning the grapes are from older, more established vines, which can contribute to more complex flavors and aromas.

deadhead-rum.title: Dead Man's Fingers Spiced Rum
deadhead-rum.bodyHtml:
Dead Man's Fingers Spiced Rum is a iconic craft spiced rum created at the famous Rum & Crab Shack in St. Ives, Cornwall, offering a unconventional blend of Caribbean rums infused with a unique selection of spices and exotic flavors. Crafted to depart from overly traditional spiced rum profiles, this spirit presents a well-rounded and versatile character featuring signature notes of saffron cake, spiced fruit, and creamy vanilla, making it a favorite for adventurous cocktail creation and modern rum enthusiasts.

Food Pairing: Jerk chicken, barbecue pork ribs, spicy seafood boil, dark chocolate tarts, or sweet plantains.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber hue with a smooth, medium-bodied texture and approachable mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense vanilla, toasted spices, sweet caramel, nutmeg, orange peel, and subtle hints of saffron cake.

Palate : Rich and complex with dominant flavors of creamy vanilla, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, candied orange, and subtle dried fruit.

Finish : Smooth and lingering with warm oak spice, gentle vanilla sweetness, and a soft touch of citrus zest.

Serve : Serve on the rocks, mixed with ginger beer or cola, or as a base in modern rum cocktails.

gekkeikan-plum.title: Gekkeikan Plum 750ml
gekkeikan-plum.bodyHtml:
Plum Gekkeikan is made with the choicest plums from the world-renowned orchard in Wakayama in central Japan. Tender and succulent, the plums are carefully hand-picked at the moment of perfect ripeness. In an aged-old tradition, they are fermented and then aged to ensure a rich, smooth flavor. Rich in mineral, citric acid and polyphenol.

Elegant and authentic; a perfect reflection of the fruit.


Style: Subtly sweet, full plum nectar with just a hint of apple and pear tartness. Rich and full-bodied with a long, smooth finish. Truly delightful!

Pairing Notes: Great for marinating, with lightly spiced food, and as an accompaniment to fruit or chocolate based desserts.

Serving Suggestions: Enjoy chilled or over ice, delicious with Zipang Sparkling Sake!

forty-creek-barrel-select-whisky-3.title: Forty Creek Barrel Select Whisky 375ml
forty-creek-barrel-select-whisky-3.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Barrel Select Whisky is an exceptionally smooth, award-winning Canadian blended whisky. It is crafted using a unique process where rye, barley, and corn are distilled and aged separately in selected oak barrels before being artistically blended together to create a complex, harmonious spirit with rich, approachable flavors.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoky barbecued pulled pork, maple-glazed ribs, sharp aged cheddar cheese, or sweet pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, honey, toasted oak, cocoa, and light butterscotch with subtle apricot fruitiness.

Palate : Smooth and complex with notes of dark sweet fruit, vanilla, toasted wood, rich caramel, and gentle rye spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of gentle oak spice, vanilla, and sweet honey.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as the base in a classic Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

mezcal-union.title: Mezcal Unión El Viejo Mezcal
mezcal-union.bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes:
Astringent, Dry, Butter, Herbs (mint, pine), Flowery, Sweet, Stone and New Woods.
notas de cata

Smell in the Mouth:
The first drink reveals its 100% artisan process with oak woods and mesquite. After you feel the agave caramelized notes, then flowery herbs tones of Tobalá Agave, which starts to turn off the alcohol power leaving a long back sweet taste of Espadín Agave.

Tasting Summary:
Artisan strong body, buttery, artringent, herbal and a sweet clean smoke.

drouhin-pouilly-fuisse.title: Joseph Drouhin Pouilly-Fuisse 2023
drouhin-pouilly-fuisse.bodyHtml:
Joseph Drouhin Pouilly-Fuissé 2023 is a beautifully luminous and expressive white Burgundy that offers a pure, vibrant showcase of the Chardonnay grape. Displaying a bright golden hue accented by delicate green reflections, this enticing wine opens with an aromatic, textbook bouquet dominated by ripe green apples, fresh pears, and white floral notes, subtly framed by nuances of toasted almonds and sweet citrus zest. On the palate, it balances an ethereal lightness with a surprisingly ample, medium-bodied mouthfeel, a direct reflection of the sunny, perfectly ripe 2023 vintage. The fermentation and aging process—divided between stainless steel vats and larger 500-liter oak barrels—imparts a creamy texture and sophisticated hints of vanilla and subtle spice, while preserving a lively, refreshing core of mineral tension that leads into a clean, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: This elegant white Burgundy pairs wonderfully with pan-roasted halibut, creamy chicken fricassee, a rich spring vegetable quiche, or delicate seafood risottos.

yukon-jack-1.title: Yukon Jack Original Recipe
yukon-jack-1.bodyHtml:
Yukon Jack Original Recipe is a Canadian liqueur made from Canadian whisky blended with honey, named after the pioneer Leroy Napoleon "Jack" McQuesten. Because it contains flavouring beyond whisky, it is labelled as a Canadian liqueur rather than a Canadian whisky. Long imported into the United States by Heublein and later held by Diageo, the brand was sold to the Sazerac Company in 2018. The Canadian bottling is 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle under the "Only the strong survive" label; the US version is stronger at 50%. Sweet and strong with a fruity edge, it is drunk neat, over ice, or as the base of the Snakebite shot with lime juice.

Tasting Notes: Very sweet and strong, honeyed whisky with fruity undertones.

Serve: Neat, on ice, or as a Snakebite shot with fresh lime juice.

alberta-pure-vodka-4.title: Alberta Pure Vodka 1.75L
alberta-pure-vodka-4.bodyHtml:
Alberta Pure Vodka is a Canadian vodka distilled by Alberta Distillers in Calgary, Alberta. Crafted from 100% locally grown Western Canadian prairie grain and blended with pure, glacier-fed Rocky Mountain water, it undergoes a triple distillation and charcoal filtration process to yield a clean, neutral, and exceptionally smooth spirit.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, caviar, pickled herring, oysters on the half shell, charcuterie, and pierogies.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and bright in appearance, featuring a crisp, light, and clean mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and subtle with faint notes of neutral grain and fresh mineral water.

Palate : Smooth and light-bodied with mild grain sweetness, delicate wheat notes, and a clean, neutral character.

Finish : Short, crisp, and refreshing with a soft, clean end.

Serve : Best served well-chilled, neat, over ice, or as a versatile base in cocktails such as a Vodka Soda, Caesar, or Moscow Mule.

havana-club-7-year-old-rum.title: Havana Club Añejo 7 Años Rum
havana-club-7-year-old-rum.bodyHtml: Havana Club Añejo 7 Años is a legendary Cuban dark rum, widely considered the gold standard for sipping rums and the quintessential expression of the Havana Club range. Created by the late Maestro Ronero Don José Navarro, this rum is crafted through a continuous aging process where a portion of every final blend is returned to the barrel to nurture future generations. It is composed of rums aged for a minimum of seven years in white oak casks, resulting in a rich, mahogany-hued spirit with a complex and silky texture. On the nose, it reveals an intense bouquet of roasted pecans, tobacco, honey, and tropical fruits, while the palate delivers deep notes of cocoa, vanilla, and warm cedar spice. This world-class rum is best enjoyed neat, over ice, or as a sophisticated base for a classic Cuba Libre or an authentic El Presidente.

royal-salute-21-year-old.title: Royal Salute 21 Year Old The Signature Blend

royal-reserve-whisky-3.title: Royal Reserve 1.75L
royal-reserve-whisky-3.bodyHtml:
Royal Reserve is a classic, value-driven Canadian rye whisky with roots dating back to the cocktail heyday of the 1960s and 70s. Produced by Corby Spirit and Wine at the historic Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, this quintessential mixing whisky is celebrated for its light, smooth, and highly approachable profile. Blended to achieve subtle elegance rather than overpowering heat, it balances sweet grain and toffee notes with a distinctly crisp, brittle Canadian rye character, making it a reliable staple for both casual sipping and traditional highballs.

Food Pairing: Grilled sausages, mild cheddar cheese, roasted salted mixed nuts, classic pub fare, and caramel-heavy desserts like butter tarts or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Light golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied, and slightly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Gentle and subtly complex, opening with mild aromas of sweet honey, vanilla, and caramel, followed by dusty rye grain, toasted almond, and a faint hint of clove and mild baking spice.

Palate : Smooth, light, and highly approachable. It begins with sweet notes of corn, toffee, and caramelized sugar, which are gracefully balanced by a contrasting, zippy bite of peppery rye spice and a touch of crisp lemon zest.

Finish : Clean, warm, and of medium length, fading gently from zesty rye spice to a lingering, soft vanilla and mild toasted oak sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat or over ice as an easy-drinking sipper, or mix it in classic Canadian whisky highballs like a Rye and Ginger (with ginger ale) or a classic Whisky Sour.

maraschino-luxardo.title: Luxardo Maraschino Originale
maraschino-luxardo.bodyHtml: When Luxardo marasca cherries are harvested at the beginning of every summer, they are put in alcoholic infusion in larch-wood vats together with some leaves and branches of the same trees for up to three years. When ready, both the liquid and the solid parts are distilled in traditional copper pot stills, separating the heart from heads and tails. Only the heart of the distillate is then allowed to mature in ash-wood vats. The last process consists in transforming the distillate in liqueur by adding a simple syrup of water and sugar lowering the ABV to 32%. Crystal clear in colour, the aroma is typical of marasca cherry distillate with strong alcohol spirit and roasted nuttiness, while the taste results smooth but sharp at the same time with hints of dark chocolate, vanilla and orange marmalade. The tall green bottle with its red cap is still hand-plaited in straw within the company, and resembles the Maraschino bottles produced in Zara in the early days, where the straw was placed in order to prevent damage during transportation. Luxardo Maraschino Originale can be enjoyed in many classic cocktails or neat as an after dinner drink. It is also ideal over fruits such as strawberries, pineapples, oranges etc. or as a flavor in confectionary and ice creams.

stolichnaya-vodka.title: Stoli Vodka
stolichnaya-vodka.bodyHtml:
Stoli Premium is the brand's original vodka, a classically styled and exceptionally smooth spirit from a story that began in 1938. It is made from natural grain and triple-filtered through quartz sand and a birch activated charcoal column, and Stoli has won more than 100 awards around the world. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear, with marshmallow, mineral and mild fruit peel aromas; soft and supple, with hints of creamy pastry frosting and sweet citrus rind.

Serve: Ice-cold and neat, in a Martini, or in a Moscow Mule.

carlo-rossi-california-red.title: Carlo Rossi California Red 1.5L Magnum
carlo-rossi-california-red.bodyHtml: Carlo Rossi California Red in a 1.5L Magnum is a popular, easy-drinking red wine known for its fruity and approachable flavor profile. It's a red blend from California, often described as having jammy, rich red and dark fruit flavors with a touch of sweetness, as described on Manila Wine. It's a good pairing with a variety of foods like pizza, pasta, or barbecue, according to Boozy.ph.

bacardi-white-rum-2.title: Bacardi Superior White Rum 50ml
bacardi-white-rum-2.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Superior White Rum is the definitive classic that established the standard for light, crisp Caribbean rum. First crafted in Cuba in 1862, it is charcoal-filtered both before and after aging in white oak barrels to achieve its signature crystal clarity and smooth, light-bodied character. The nose is subtly aromatic, offering delicate hints of vanilla, fresh almonds, and bright citrus. On the palate, it is clean and exceptionally well-rounded, delivering gentle notes of sweet brown sugar, white pepper, and a touch of tropical fruit, leading into a crisp, dry finish. Its balanced, unpretentious profile makes it the ultimate, indispensable backbone for legendary cocktails like the Mojito, Daiquiri, and Cuba Libre.

Food Pairing: The clean, crisp, and slightly sweet nature of this white rum pairs naturally with fresh, vibrant Caribbean and Latin flavors. Enjoy it alongside fish tacos with lime-cilantro crema, fresh mango salsa with tortilla chips, or a plate of hot, crispy tostones (fried green plantains). It also beautifully cuts through the richness of a classic Cuban sandwich.

carlo-rossi-california-white-2.title: Carlo Rossi California White NV 1.5L
carlo-rossi-california-white-2.bodyHtml: Carlo Rossi California White, in a 1.5L Magnum bottle, is a light-bodied, fruity, and often sweet white wine blend. It's known for its easy-drinking style and versatility, making it suitable for various occasions. It's a popular choice for those who enjoy a refreshing and not overly complex white wine.

baileys-original-irish-cream-4.title: Baileys Original Irish Cream Liqueur 375ml
baileys-original-irish-cream-4.bodyHtml:
Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur is a luxurious, velvety classic that blends fine Irish whiskey and spirits with rich, luscious dairy cream and hints of cocoa and vanilla. First introduced in 1974, it is the world’s most celebrated cream liqueur, offering a beautifully balanced, indulgent, and decadent drinking experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with dark chocolate desserts, molten lava cakes, tiramisu, and fresh berries. It also makes a wonderful accompaniment to warm apple pie, pecan tarts, or simply drizzled over premium vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Opaque, creamy light brown with a rich, velvety, and thick mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet cream, dark chocolate, vanilla, and a subtle hint of warming Irish whiskey.

Palate : Smooth and indulgent with rich flavors of fresh dairy cream, milk chocolate, cocoa, sweet vanilla, and mild whiskey warmth.

Finish : Sweet, long, and coat-the-tongue smooth with lingering chocolate, cream, and soft whiskey notes.

Serve : Serve chilled, poured over ice, or as a rich addition to hot coffee, hot chocolate, or desserts.

dr-zenzen-kabinett-blue-bottle.title: Dr. Zenzen Kabinett Blue Bottle 750ml
dr-zenzen-kabinett-blue-bottle.bodyHtml:
Critic tasting note: (2014 vintage) "Light gold with green tints. The nose is driven by lime, dried fruits, mineral and resin presence. Zippy, lip-smacking attack on the palate followed by a mid-palate and finish tinged by sweetness. Assertive mineral character. Ideal for a cocktail buffet." - 87/100, Gilbert & Gaillard

90 points Wine Spectator
A delicately sweet Kabinett with aromas of ripe peach, honeydew melon, and citrus blossom. The palate is lively and well-balanced, with vibrant acidity cutting through the subtle sweetness, leading to a clean, refreshing finish.

91 points James Suckling
An expressive and elegant Riesling showcasing notes of white peach, apricot, and honeysuckle. The texture is silky and refined, with perfectly balanced sweetness and acidity, culminating in a long, harmonious finish.

89 points Decanter
A soft and approachable wine featuring hints of pear, lemon, and floral undertones. Light-bodied and slightly off-dry, it offers a smooth mouthfeel and a pleasant, easygoing finish.

red-tassel-vodka-3.title: Red Tassel Vodka 1.75L
red-tassel-vodka-3.bodyHtml:
Red Tassel Vodka is a budget-friendly European-style vodka distilled from grains for a clean and simple profile. Designed for utility and ease of mixing, it offers a straightforward taste with gentle grain notes and a light pepper warmth, making it a functional option for casual gatherings and mixed drinks.

Food Pairing: Salty snacks, pickles, cured meats, fried appetizers, or light pasta salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear and transparent appearance with a light-to-medium, straightforward body.

Nose : Subtle ethanol aroma with faint grain sweetness and light neutral mineral notes.

Palate : Simple and crisp with basic wheat grain sweetness and a light peppery spice.

Finish : Short to medium with a direct, warm pepper finish and slight grain bite.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled or mixed into highball cocktails such as a Vodka Soda or Vodka Cranberry.

lambs-white-rum-2.title: Lamb's White Rum 1.75L
lambs-white-rum-2.bodyHtml: Enterprising merchant Alfred Lamb aged his fine rum in a cellar by the River Thames, producing a distinct, refined, classic rum reflecting the character of its creator. Aroma: Sweet cane, vanilla and molasses. Taste: Very flavourful with delicate island spice and freshly cut cane. Finish: Smooth and gentle lingering sweetness.

laurent-perrier-grand-siecle.title: Laurent Perrier Grand Siecle
laurent-perrier-grand-siecle.bodyHtml:
In the 17th Century, during the reign of Louis XIV, France enjoyed its most illustrious era. Louis XIV became known as the "Sun King" for his benevolence and his patronage of the Arts, which became the foundation of France's rich artistic heritage. At the Palace of Versailles Louis XIV was the first French King to drink Champagne.

Louis XIV's era became known as the Grand Siècle - the "Great Century". Bottled in a replica of a 17th Century bottle evoking the radiance of that period, Laurent-Perrier's prestige cuvées embody luxury, magnificence and elegance fit for a king.

When it came to his prestige cuvée, Bernard de Nonancourt decided to highlight two of Champagne's traditional realms of proficiency: the blending of different crus and different vintages. Grand Siècle is the epitome of Champagne cuvées, as it blends complementary wines from Laurent-Perrier's very best growths and most successful vintage years.

Grand Siècle is made with a pinot noir and chardonnay blend, with the latter being slightly dominant. Twelve of the most prestigious villages supply these grapes; all of them classified at 100% Grands Crus such as Ambonnay, Verzenay, Mailly, Avize, Cramant, Chouilly and Le Mesnil-sur-Oger. Within the vineyards of these villages, only the very best plots are selected, as are the finest musts from the pressings. The blended wine is then aged during the second fermentation on the yeast for approximately five years.

It has a bright color, with a brilliant yellow hue. Its subtle aromas of honey, hazelnuts, grilled almonds and brioche, make this the perfect companion for refined dishes. It pairs just as well with poultry and truffles as it does with veal and morel mushrooms.

e-j-brandy-vs-brandy.title: Hennessy VS Cognac
e-j-brandy-vs-brandy.bodyHtml:
Hennessy VS Cognac is a vibrant, iconic French cognac crafted by Jas Hennessy & Co. Assembled from a blend of up to 40 different eaux-de-vie aged for at least two years in French oak casks, it delivers a lively, fruit-forward character balanced by toasted oak and subtle spice.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, braised pork chops, roasted duck, dark chocolate desserts, or rich creamy cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-copper in appearance with a full, round, and smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Toasted oak, fresh citrus, vanilla, subtle floral notes, and hints of brown sugar and almond.

Palate : Vibrant and fruit-driven with notes of fresh apple, ripe grape, warm baking spices, vanilla, and roasted nuts.

Finish : Medium-long, warm, and crisp with lingering notes of wood spice, cinnamon, and subtle fruit.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a foundational spirit for classic cocktails like a Sidecar or Hennessy Ginger.

olmeca-gold-tequila.title: Olmeca Gold Tequila
olmeca-gold-tequila.bodyHtml:
Olmeca Gold is the golden tequila of the Olmeca brand, crafted with traditional methods in the Los Altos highlands of Mexico and carrying the signature of master distiller Jesús Hernández on its label. Made with blue agave, it pours a pale straw colour and opens with an expressive nose of white pepper, grain and floral notes. The palate is full and powerful, built around a distinctive coconut character, and the finish closes with flashes of hot cinnamon. The current bottle wears Olmeca's redesigned label with the Olmec head emblem on the familiar square, patterned bottle. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is an easy, approachable tequila for shots and mixed drinks.

Tasting Notes: White pepper, grain, florals, coconut, cinnamon.

Nose: White pepper, grain and floral notes.

Palate: Full and powerful, with distinctive coconut.

Finish: Flashes of hot cinnamon.

Serve: As a chilled shot with lime, or in a margarita.

henkell-trocken-sekt-1.title: Henkell Trocken Sekt 750ml
henkell-trocken-sekt-1.bodyHtml: Henkell Trocken Brut Sekt NV 750mL is a great German sparkling wine that's perfect if you're after something fresh and fruity. It's well-balanced and easy to drink, with some green apple, banana, and citrus flavours. This one's a top pick if you're looking for a tasty sparkling wine without breaking the bank. Grab a bottle of Henkell Trocken Brut Sekt NV 750mL today.

dassai-45-premium-jumai-daiginjo-sake.title: Dassai '45' Junmai Daiginjo 720ml
dassai-45-premium-jumai-daiginjo-sake.bodyHtml: Graceful and elegant, this sake offers notes of ripe melons and apples. Well-balanced with a light sweetness and vibrant acidity on the palate with a clean, dry finish. Enjoy this sake chilled, paired with sushi and sashimi or with fruits and cheeses.

sawmill-creek-chardonnay-1.title: Sawmill Creek Chardonnay
sawmill-creek-chardonnay-1.bodyHtml:
Sawmill Creek Chardonnay is a smooth, crisp, and easy-drinking Canadian white wine known for its approachable and fruit-forward style. In the glass, it displays a bright lemon-yellow to pale gold hue. The nose opens with inviting tropical fruit aromas of pineapple, mango, and white peach, layered with subtle hints of vanilla, sweet melon, and delicate toast. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-balanced, delivering soft orchard fruit flavors accompanied by a gentle buttery texture and crisp citrus acidity that leads into a clean, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roast chicken, creamy pasta dishes, grilled seafood, Caesar salad, crab cakes, and mild cheeses.

sawmill-creek-merlot-1.title: Sawmill Creek Merlot 750ml
sawmill-creek-merlot-1.bodyHtml: Sawmill Creek Merlot is an elegant, medium-bodied red wine with aromas of blackberry, cherry, and clove. Its medium tannins and balanced finish make it perfect for pairing with a variety of dishes. With 13.5% alcohol content, Sawmill Creek Merlot has the perfect balance of body and complexity. Enjoy its robust flavor and smooth finish.

campogiovanni-brunello-di-montepulciano.title: San Felice Campogiovanni Brunello di Montalcino 2019
campogiovanni-brunello-di-montepulciano.bodyHtml:
The San Felice Campogiovanni Brunello di Montalcino 2019 is a monumental, highly structural, and deeply traditional Old World red wine that beautifully showcases the legendary brilliance of this exceptional, highly celebrated vintage. Sourced from premium plots on the warm, south-facing slopes of the Montalcino hill, it pours a dense, deep ruby-red colour with elegant garnet tones. The nose unfurls with an expansive, complex bouquet of well-ripened black cherries, dark plum preserves, and wild berries, seamlessly layered with sophisticated undertones of cedar shavings, toasted oak, sweet tobacco leaf, and tanned leather. On the palate, this full-bodied, pure Sangiovese is remarkably velvety, powerful, and concentrated, coating the mouth with pure intensities of baked blackberry, savory mineral depth, and integrated hints of dark chocolate or espresso. Matured meticulously for 36 months in a combination of 500-liter French oak tonneaux and large Slavonian oak casks, its big-boned frame balances flawless fruit maturity against a racy, food-friendly acidity and firm, tightly knit noble tannins that carry into an exceptionally long, persistent finish.
Food Pairing: This muscular and brooding 2019 vintage demands rich, structured dishes to match its power, making it a perfect partner for traditional wild boar ragù over thick pasta, roasted venison, slow-cooked braised beef short ribs, or a platter of highly aged artisanal pecorino cheese.
93 Points - James Suckling
Aromas of blackberries, flint and matchstick. Medium body with firm, silky tannins and a lightly chewy finish. Structured and polished. Juicy at the end. Drink after 2025.
93 Points - Wine Spectator
There's an exotic boysenberry note to the fruit in this red, along with flavors of raspberry and kirsch, shaded by eucalyptus and wild rosemary, plus a chalky mineral element. Yet this remains slightly austere, with dense, linear tannins leaving a grip on the finish. Best from 2027 through 2043.

masi-vaio-amarone.title: Serego Alighieri Vaio Armaron Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2016/2017
masi-vaio-amarone.bodyHtml:
Deep ruby red, almost impenetrable. Elegant intensity of aromas: berry fruit preserved in spirit, dried plums and cocoa. Intense and well balanced on the palate: full bodied with silky tannins and a firm structure. Long finish of ripe cherries and sweet spices.

Ideal with red meats, game, quail, roasts, and other richly-flavored dishes. Excellent paired with strong cheeses (like parmesan, pecorino etc.). A noble after-dinner wine.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Elegant and finely meshed, with deft and pleasing interplay between traditional Amarone style and a more modern approach. There's a sanguine edge to this version, along with savory notes of smoke and black tea leaf, but also a core of dark, juicy black cherry and plum sauce flavors accented by vanilla and baking spices. The rich, expressive flavor profile is seamlessly knit with the dense, fine-grained tannins.

93 Points - James Suckling

While this is a far reach from the redder fruited, crunchier and pixelated expressions of Classico that increasingly define an exciting region, there is little debate as to the style sought at this address and the fine quality on offer. Cherry wood oak, unique and intriguing, makes its presence felt across a swathe of burly, dusty tannins. The nose, macerated boozy cherries, alpine pine, balsamic and freshly polished stairwell. The finish, strident and long-limbed.

chateau-montelena-estate-cabernet-sauvig.title: Chateau Montelena The Montelena Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
chateau-montelena-estate-cabernet-sauvig.bodyHtml:
Chateau Montelena The Montelena Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a structured and expressive flagship red wine produced from the historic estate vineyards in Calistoga. Demonstrating a harmonious balance of power and old-world restraint, it reveals rich aromatics of dark plum, blackberry compote, wild anise, turned earth, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it exhibits a dense, modern, and supple texture filled with black cherry, cocoa, and fine-grained tannins that frame a bright, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with prime dry-aged ribeye, herb-crusted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison, and aged hard cheeses.

pilsner-1.title: Pilsner 24 Cans
pilsner-1.bodyHtml: Brewed with Western Canada two-row barley to give it that select aroma and bittering hops. A medium-bodied lager that is true to its Western Canadian roots. It is a rich copper color, with a burst of freshly toasted barley enhanced with solid hop aroma. 16 IBU's.

shafer-hillside-cabernet.title: Shafer Hillside Select Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 1.5L Magnum
shafer-hillside-cabernet.bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon celebrates hillside vineyards. Rugged, arid vineyard blocks, such as these, with rocky, scant soils create ideal conditions for producing wine of classic richness and elegance. This wine also exhibits the structure and beauty that are the hallmarks of wines born of the winery's location within Napa Valley's Stags Leap District. Aged nearly four years prior to release, this wine offers the pleasures of youthful boldness on release and rich nuance after a decade or more of bottling.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

In the running for the wine of the vintage, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Hillside Select is an incredible success and offers more depth, opulence, and purity than just about every other wine out there. Revealing a dense purple color as well as a killer nose of blueberries, chocolate-covered cherries, scorched earth, tobacco, violets, and exotic spices, it hits the palate with full-bodied richness, a seamless, pure, incredibly layered mouthfeel, building tannins, and a great, great finish. As with most top 2017s, it stays tight and compact on the palate, with notable structure and impressive concentration. It has some up-front appeal given its purity of fruit and balance, yet it's going to take 7-8 years to hit prime time and will be a long-lived bottle of Napa Cabernet. Hats off to Doug Shafer and the team for yet another magical Cabernet Sauvignon!

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Hillside Select displays a deep garnet-purple color, bursting from the glass with scents of blueberry pie, crème de cassis, black cherry compote and chocolate box plus nuances of cedar chest, clove oil, lavender and menthol. The richly fruited, full-bodied palate has a lively skip in its step, featuring gorgeous ripe, velvety tannins and fantastic freshness to support all the spicy black fruit layers, finishing long and perfumed. An absolute triumph!

98 Points - James Suckling

Wild blackberries and brambleberries on the nose with raw cocoa, cloves and crushed gravel. Violets and orange peel, too. It’s medium-bodied with wonderful purity and depth of fruit, interlaced with dark-chocolate flavors. Firm, well-integrated tannins. Complex and refined with fantastic energy. One of the finest Hillside Selects I have had. Better from 2024.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is the 35th vintage of this 100% varietal powerhouse, a deeply concentrated, muscular and intensely flavored wine that offers equal parts grace and age ability. Blue fruit and notes of iron, crushed rock and cocoa powder deliver a seamless palate of opulence, with lasting hints of allspice, black pepper and oak. Best After 2027. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This drips with rich blackberry, boysenberry and raspberry fruit flavors and is liberally laced with licorice root and singed alder notes, delivering a nice tarry tug through the finish as the fruit drips. Shows a twinge of the vintage's rusticity in its tannins, but it's a heck of an effort in this tricky year. Best from 2023

chappellet-mountain-cuvee.title: Chappellet Mountain Cuvee Proprietor's Blend 2024
chappellet-mountain-cuvee.bodyHtml:
Chappellet Mountain Cuvee Proprietor's Blend 2024 is an expressive, fruit-forward, and beautifully textured California red blend that showcases the heritage of Napa Valley hillside winemaking. Sourced from premier volcanic mountain vineyards, it pours a vibrant ruby-garnet color. The nose is highly aromatic, leaping from the glass with layers of dark cherry, fresh cassis, and black plum, complemented by French oak nuances of vanilla, clove, and shaved cedarwood. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and incredibly smooth, displaying a rounded, supple mouthfeel driven by fine-grained tannins. Lush mountain berry flavors blend seamlessly with integrated hints of baking spice, dark chocolate, and anise, supported by a refreshing natural acidity that results in a long, balanced, and approachable finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled rosemary lamb chops, classic backyard cheeseburgers, wood-fired mushroom pizza, or slow-braised beef short ribs.

sailor-jerrys-navy-spiced-rum-1.title: Sailor Jerry Spiced Rum
sailor-jerrys-navy-spiced-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Sailor Jerry Spiced Rum is a blend of Caribbean rums with the brand's own recipe of natural spices, bottled at 46% ABV (92 proof) in a 750ml bottle. The brand belongs to William Grant & Sons, the family-owned Scottish distiller, and was created in honour of Norman “Sailor Jerry” Collins (1911–1973), whom the brand calls the father of old-school tattooing; a hula-girl tattoo design appears on the label. The recipe follows the old habit of sailors who improved their on-board rum rations by blending in spices. In the glass it is medium amber with a reddish tinge, with aromas of cinnamon, nutmeg, toasty oak, toffee and vanilla. The palate is dry and medium to full-bodied with a rich texture, showing sweet spiced fruit, caramel and chocolate before a long, warming, peppery finish.

Food Pairing: Smoky barbecue such as jerk chicken or pork ribs; spiced desserts such as gingerbread or pumpkin pie.

Nose: Cinnamon and nutmeg over toasty oak, toffee and vanilla.

Palate: Dry, medium to full-bodied and richly textured; sweet spiced fruit, caramel and chocolate.

Finish: Long, warming and peppery.

Serve: With cola over ice, or in rum cocktails.

ar-guentota-malbec.title: Belasco De Baquedano AR Guentota Old Vine Malbec 2017 750ml

san-polo-rosso-di-montalcino.title: San Polo Brunello di Montalcino 2018
san-polo-rosso-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
The 2018 San Polo Brunello di Montalcino is an elegant and nuanced expression of Sangiovese from a vintage defined by its finesse rather than sheer power. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards on the south-eastern slope of Montalcino, this wine offers a sophisticated bouquet of small red berries, violets, and earthy underbrush, with secondary notes of tobacco and vanilla from oak aging. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied with bright acidity and well-integrated, silky tannins that lead to a persistent and savory finish. This vintage is particularly praised for its approachability and classical balance, making it enjoyable in its youth while possessing the structure to age gracefully.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The primarily earthy, sanguine nose gets some pop from the slightly astringent sweetness of plums. That pleasing dynamism continues on the palate, before eventually giving way to a chocolatey, coffee finish. Grippy yet pliant tannins provide structure, while acid brings the heat.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of sour plums, cherry stones, bark and iodine, with some dried herbs. So fresh, tangy and flavorful, with bright berry fruit and savory moss notes. Fine and integrated tannins. Medium body. All about balance. From organically grown grapes.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A certified organic wine, the 2018 Brunello di Montalcino display a savory character that accompanies the wine from start to finish over the palate and then some. There is a core of black fruit, but the real takeaway is that spicy contour of dark chestnut husk, acacia honey, tilled earth and toasted rosemary that fills the balloon of your glass. This Brunello finishes on a tart note and shows tannins that could use a few extra years to soften

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Shows earthy, barnyard aromas that suggest a little reduction, giving way to plum, cherry, rose, juniper, eucalyptus and iron flavors. Reveals burly tannins that define the finish, which is compact and short. Decant now. Best from 2026 through 2046.

sequoia-grove-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Sequoia Grove Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
sequoia-grove-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Sequoia Grove Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a refined, classic expression of Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon, sourced predominantly from prime benchland vineyards across Rutherford, Oakville, and St. Helena. It presents inviting, layered aromas of ripe dark plum, black cherry, cassis, and cocoa powder, framed by subtle nuances of cedar, mocha, and toasted French oak. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied yet remarkably balanced structure, showcasing velvety tannins, refreshing acidity, and a long, seamless finish filled with dark fruit and delicate spice notes.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, braised short ribs, grilled lamb chops, roasted venison, or aged sharp cheddar cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

So toasty, espresso-like, dense and savory in aromas, then graphite, black currant, black olive and cocoa flavors on a firmly tannic texture. Very taut, structured, lithe and muscular, with iron, blackberries, tobacco and dark chocolate. Drinkable now and best from 2030.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

One of the more consistent, affordable Napa Valley Cabs, Sequoia Grove has hit the mark with its 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon, crafting a terrific value. Sourced primarily from the winery's two Rutherford vineyards, it offers up hints of violets, blackcurrants and black olives on the nose, while the medium- to full-bodied palate features ample concentration, silky, tight-grained tannins and a long, mouthwatering finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Menthol, licorice and violet notes lead off, followed quickly by a gush of warmed cassis and boysenberry compote flavors. The finish is frankly toasted, but there’s good energy to keep this honest. Drink now through 2032. 

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Juicy, layered and flavorful, this full-bodied Cabernet overdelivers with generous flavors of currants, dark chocolate, and spices with a crack of dried pine. Supple tannins linger into a lengthy finish.

hester-creek-cabernet-franc-reserve.title: Hester Creek Cabernet Franc 2022
hester-creek-cabernet-franc-reserve.bodyHtml:
Aromas of plum, raspberry, smokey bacon and an enticing hint of black pepper lead to a palate that showcases ripe plum, bright strawberry, fresh dill, pepper and soft vanilla overtones. This wine has multiple layers of complexity that give it the ability to age gracefully for up to 10 years given the proper cellaring conditions.

Try with wild mushroom crusted rack of lamb and sauces featuring fresh strawberries or cherries.

kistler-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2021
kistler-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
A compilation of ripe, red and blue fruit ignites the senses with slight undertones of forest rain. Soft and smooth on the palate with pure electric dark berry flavors and deep, unified tannins add volume to a refined finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of umami, seaweed, mushroom and bark follow through to a medium body, with firm and fine velvety tannins and a flavorful finish with a salty undertone at the end. Oyster shell. Drink now.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast was matured in 39% new oak for 15 months. The nose opens slowly from allspice and brown sugar to a core of red cherry and cranberry, tea leaves and lavender. The medium-bodied palate offers surprisingly concentrated fruit supported by grainy tannins and seamless freshness, and it has a long, spicy finish.

bols-vodka-1.title: Bolskaya Vodka
bols-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Bolskaya Vodka is an unflavoured vodka from Lucas Bols B.V. and a product of Alberta, Canada. It is bottled at 40% ABV and offered here in the 750ml size; the same vodka also comes in 200ml, 375ml, 750ml, 1.14L and 1.75L formats, so it is easy to match the bottle to the occasion. As a regular, unflavoured vodka it is made for mixing, from simple highballs with soda or tonic to Caesars, Moscow Mules and fruit punches.

Serve: Well chilled with soda or tonic and a wedge of lime, or as the base of a Caesar or Moscow Mule.

araujo-eisele-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Eisele Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2011
araujo-eisele-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Eisele Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon is an iconic and ultra-luxury Napa Valley Cabernet with extraordinary depth, precision, and elegance. Intense layers of blackcurrant, blackberry, graphite, cedar, violets, dark cocoa, and crushed stone unfold across a powerful yet refined full-bodied palate with exceptional aging potential and a remarkably long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with wagyu beef, dry-aged ribeye, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, truffle dishes, aged hard cheeses, wild mushroom risotto, and premium steakhouse favourites.

98 Points - James Suckling

Compelling aromas of black fruits such as brambleberries, plus blueberries and fresh mushrooms. Asphalt, too. Forest fruits. The tannins just melt into the wine as you taste it. Aristocratic and regal in style and length. A powdery, fascinating texture. From biodynamically grown grapes. Drink now, but better in 2017.

95 Points -Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2011 Cabernet Sauvignon Eisele Vineyard is simply beautiful. It is easily one of the most complete and compelling wines of the vintage. Rich, flashy and open, especially within the context of the vintage, the 2011 impresses for its depth and polish. Layers of blue and black fruit, savory herbs, mint and licorice come together in this complete Cabernet. A model of total class and elegance, the 2011 is simply remarkable for the year. This is one of the few wines of the vintage with real potential not just for the near-term, but also for the future. Anticipated maturity: 2015-2026. (

lysholm-linie-aquavit.title: Lysholm Linie Aquavit
lysholm-linie-aquavit.bodyHtml:
Lysholm Linie Aquavit is a Norwegian aquavit, a potato-based spirit distilled in pot stills with a blend of Nordic herbs and spices led by caraway and star anise. It has been made to the same botanical recipe for more than 200 years. What sets Linie apart is its maturation: the spirit rests for 16 months in oak casks that previously held Oloroso sherry, and four of those months are spent at sea on a voyage that crosses the equator - the "line" of the name - twice. The constant rolling and changing temperatures help shape a smooth, rounded aquavit, light amber in colour. It is bottled at 41.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Food Pairing: The producer suggests sipping it slowly alongside food.

Tasting Notes: Caraway and star anise with vanilla and a touch of sherry.

Nose: Caraway, aniseed and orange peel, then a delicate hint of vanilla.

Palate: Smooth and well balanced, with caraway, star anise, oak, subtle sweetness and vanilla.

Serve: At room temperature, as the producer recommends.

gerard-bertrand-cigalus-white.title: Gerard Bertrand Domaine de Cigalus Blanc 2022
gerard-bertrand-cigalus-white.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Domaine de Cigalus Blanc 2022 is an extraordinary, biodynamically farmed white wine that brilliantly showcases the richness and potential of the South of France. A meticulously crafted blend of Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, and Viognier, it reveals a clear, brilliant golden yellow hue in the glass. The bouquet is highly aromatic, intense, and complex, offering an alluring tapestry of ripe grapefruit, white peach, exotic mango, and quince zest, layered with delicate white blossoms, dried herbs, honey, and a beautifully toasted, buttery nuance from careful maturation in new French oak barrels. On the palate, the wine is opulent, velvety, and densely textured, masterfully balanced by a crisp, lively acidity and a vibrant mineral core. The finish is exceptionally long and elegant, leaving a lingering, mouth-watering trail of orchard fruit, warm baking spices, and a refreshing saline tension.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with pan-seared scallops, roasted poultry, creamy seafood pastas, grilled lobster, or a selection of fresh goat cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

An aromatic nose with lemon zest, pebbles, dried herbs and quince zest. Well-balanced and lively with a medium body and crisp acidity. Creamy texture with a fresh, fruity finish. Chardonnay, viognier and sauvignon blanc. From biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A decadent white, with an alluring mix of apple puree, warm cinnamon and salted brioche flavors. Delivers a deftly inlaid frame of minerality, which brings energy and vividness to the richly styled, savory palate. Silky textured and persistent, revealing hints of dried sage and thyme. Chardonnay, Viognier, Grenache Blanc, Vermentino and Sauvignon Blanc.

fossacolle-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Fossacolle Brunello di Montalcino 2017-2018-2019 6 x 750ml
fossacolle-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Fossacolle Brunello di Montalcino is produced from Sangiovese Grosso sourced from the estate's oldest vineyards. The wine shows intense ruby color, mature fruit aromas, notable tannins, and a persistent palate, combining balance, elegance, structure, and complexity with the capacity to develop further in bottle.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with braised red meats, roasted game, truffle dishes, mushrooms, and aged cheeses.

bulleit-rye-1.title: Michter's US*1 Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye
bulleit-rye-1.bodyHtml:
A stunning expression of premium Kentucky rye. Michter's US*1 Rye is a Single Barrel release, meaning every bottle is drawn from a solitary, hand-selected cask to ensure peak flavor. The distillery is famous for its low barrel entry proof and heavily toasted/fire-charred barrels, which extract an unbelievable amount of rich flavor from the wood. Bottled at 84.8 proof, it delivers a masterful balance of spicy rye kick, citrus, and deep, sweet butterscotch.

 

NOSE

Bright and fragrant with aromas of cracked black pepper, fresh mint, orange peel, and warm vanilla.

PALATE

Incredibly well-balanced and smooth. A gentle wave of peppery rye spice is beautifully tempered by rich butterscotch, sweet caramel, and toasted oak.

FINISH

Crisp, smooth, and lingering with a pleasant, spicy warmth and sweet citrus.

chinaco-anejo-tequila.title: El Tesoro Anejo Tequila
chinaco-anejo-tequila.bodyHtml:
El Tesoro Añejo Tequila is a highly acclaimed, masterfully crafted aged tequila that highlights the generational expertise of the Camarena family at the historic La Alteña distillery in the Jalisco highlands. Made from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agave, the pinas are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens and crushed using a two-ton volcanic stone tahona wheel. Following open-air fermentation and double distillation to proof in copper pot stills, this expression is matured for two to three years in hand-selected American oak ex-bourbon barrels. This extended aging process strikes a sublime balance between the vibrant, mineral-forward character of the agave and the rich, complex wood notes imparted by the oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with slow-braised carnitas, dark chocolate desserts, grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri, or aged cheeses like Gouda.

Tasting Notes : Light golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied, and silky mouthfeel.

Nose : Cooked agave, sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, light butterscotch, and subtle baking spices with hints of fresh mint and citrus zest.

Palate : Agave-forward sweetness integrated with toasted oak, vanilla, cinnamon, dark chocolate, maple, and a touch of white pepper and herbal complexity.

Finish : Long, warm, and clean with lingering notes of sweet cooked agave, soft oak tannins, pepper, and a touch of mint.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or a wide-rimmed tequila tasting glass, or over a large ice cube.

chinaco-blanco-tequila.title: Cincoro Blanco Tequila
chinaco-blanco-tequila.bodyHtml:
Cincoro Blanco is unaged, and is made with 100% Weber blue agave from both the highlands and lowlands of Jalisco, Mexico. By combining agave from two distinct appellations, our Blanco tequila is smooth on the palate, with great complexity and finish. Reflective of the terroir, fresh and cooked agave permeate, with light vanilla and citrus undertones, derived from a meticulous small-batch production process.


Cincoro tequilas are characterized by their smoothness, richness, and deliciousness. Words rarely used to describe tequila. Cincoro Blanco is incredibly versatile, it can be best enjoyed neat in proper stemware, or mixed in a classic cocktail. When enjoying neat, the layers of aroma and flavor evolve in the glass, reflecting the unique attributes of our highland and lowland agave. Even the shape of the bottle was inspired by the Weber Blue Agave leave. Perfect for any special occasion, especially sipping and savoring with family and friends.

chinaco-reposado-tequila.title: Cincoro Reposado Tequila
chinaco-reposado-tequila.bodyHtml:
Cincoro Reposado is aged at our distillery 8-10 months in our underground cellar, allowing more interaction between the tequila and wood. Cooked agave, with hints of vanilla on the nose, are complimented by spices and dried fruits. On the palate, cooked agave, light vanilla and baking spices complement toasted oak in perfect proportion.


Cincoro aged expressions are characterized by their smoothness, richness, and deliciousness. Words rarely used to describe tequila. Cincoro Reposado begins as Cincoro Blanco, aging in used American Whiskey barrels for 8-10 months. Our aging and blending process creates the rich and complex Cincoro taste profile, balancing the uniqueness of our agave profile, with time aging in specially selected barrels.

martini-rossi-asti-2.title: Martini & Rossi Asti 750ml
martini-rossi-asti-2.bodyHtml:
Martini & Rossi Asti is a fruity sparkling wine made from the finest 'Moscato Bianco' grapes grown in the heart of the prestigious Italian D.O.C.G. area. Top quality ripe grapes from a single variety are fermented once only. The fermentation is stopped at two thirds of its natural sugar potential. The resulting wine is low in alcohol, low in acidity, fresh, fruity and highly aromatic. This sparkling wine is a great partner to fruity desserts, pastry and ice cream.

87 points Wine Spectator 

 88 points James Suckling 

 86 points Decanter

jack-daniels-gold.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey
jack-daniels-gold.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey is an iconic, smooth American whiskey crafted in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Charcoal mellowed drop-by-drop through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before aging in handcrafted white oak barrels, it offers a distinct balance of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, and smooth caramel character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, pulled pork sandwiches, grilled burgers, smoked brisket, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold in appearance with a light-to-medium-bodied, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, banana, and subtle brown sugar.

Palate : Balanced mix of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, light spice, and rich caramel.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and medium-length with lingering toasted oak, charcoal, and sweet spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed with cola in a highball glass.

rolling-rock-1.title: Caves d'Esclans Rock Angel Rose 2024
rolling-rock-1.bodyHtml:
Caves d'Esclans Rock Angel Rosé 2024 is an exceptional, premium Provence rosé that stands as a more structured and sophisticated sibling to the globally renowned Whispering Angel. Crafted primarily from old-vine Grenache and Rolle (Vermentino) harvested early in the morning to lock in essential freshness, it undergoes optical eye sorting and a meticulous vinification process. Approximately 30% of the wine is fermented and aged in large 600-liter oak barrels (demi-muids) for six months with twice-weekly bâtonnage, while the remainder is handled in temperature-controlled stainless steel. This partial oak integration imparts a gorgeously rich, creamy texture and generous mouthfeel without adding overt oak flavors. In the glass, it shows a beautifully pale pink hue accompanied by an explosive bouquet of fresh redcurrants, frozen strawberries, dried apricots, and delicate floral and orange peel accents. The palate is dry, precise, and wonderfully energetic, effortlessly balancing vibrant stone fruit notes and crisp acidity with a complex layer of flinty, saline minerality that drives through to a long, silky, and powerful finish.

Food Pairing: This highly gastronomic rosé pairs beautifully with grilled Mahi Mahi, oysters, seared scallops, smoked salmon with dill, or spaghetti alle vongole.

92 Points - James Suckling

A well-rounded, juicy and flavorful rosé with frozen berries, dried apricots and wild herbs on the nose. Medium-bodied with delicious, fresh and seductive flavors on the palate. Crunchy red berries and an attractive finish. Drink now.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant version, offering complexity. Heather, verbena and juicy citrus notes are knit together with white tea tannins and flecked with blanched almond and herbs. Creamy and pure, with a rush of crushed stone cooling the stylish finish. Grenache, Rolle and Cinsaut. Drink now.

village-squeeze-lemon-berry-helles-1.title: Village Squeeze Lemon Berry Helles 4 Tall Cans
village-squeeze-lemon-berry-helles-1.bodyHtml: Village Squeeze Lemon Berry Helles 4 Tall Cans

belgian-moon-1.title: Blue Moon Belgian White 12 Cans
belgian-moon-1.bodyHtml: Blue Moon Belgian White is a 5.4% ABV unfiltered Belgian-style wheat ale known for its refreshing and smooth finish. It's characterized by a creamy body, a light spicy wheat aroma, and subtle citrus sweetness, thanks to the inclusion of Valencia orange peel and coriander. The beer is often garnished with an orange slice to enhance the citrus aroma.

moosehead-lager-3.title: Moosehead Canadian Lager 15 Cans
moosehead-lager-3.bodyHtml:
Moosehead Lager is Canada’s iconic, independent lager brewed by Canada's oldest independent brewery, Moosehead Breweries Limited in Saint John, New Brunswick. Brewed using a classic lager recipe with 100% Canadian 2-row malted barley, pure water, and a double-fermentation process, this pale lager delivers a finely balanced balance between sweet maltiness and mild hop bitterness. It is clean, crisp, and refreshing, making it an accessible and timeless Canadian classic.

Food Pairing: Grilled burgers, fish and chips, barbecue chicken, soft pretzels with mustard, and mild cheeses like young cheddar or Colby.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden straw yellow in color with a clear appearance and a light, crisp, and effervescent mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and clean with notes of sweet grain, light corn, subtle malted barley, and a faint touch of grassy floral hops.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with light malt sweetness, soft cereal grains, and a crisp, gentle hop bitterness that cleanses the palate.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing with a crisp, dry finish and slight lingering grain notes.

Serve : Serve well-chilled at 38–42°F (3–5°C) directly from the bottle or poured into a classic pilsner or pint glass.

cote-des-roses-rose.title: Gerard Bertrand Cote des Roses Rose 2023 1.5L Magnum
cote-des-roses-rose.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Côte des Roses Rosé is a celebrated, wonderfully elegant Mediterranean wine that beautifully encapsulates the sun-drenched, carefree Art of Living in the South of France. Presented in a striking, iconic glass bottle with its base intricately sculpted into the shape of a blooming rose, this exquisite Languedoc rosé reveals a brilliant, soft pink hue with subtle bluish tints. The bouquet is highly expressive and inviting, releasing a fragrant medley of summer fruits, wild raspberries, cassis, and redcurrant, beautifully interwoven with delicate floral notes of rose petals and a vibrant hint of pink grapefruit. On the palate, it is fresh, generous, and impeccably balanced, delivering a juicy, mouth-watering core of red berry flavors supported by a crisp, pure mineral tension. The finish is remarkably persistent and refreshing, leaving an elegant trail of bright fruit and a thirst-quenching zest.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with freshly shucked oysters, grilled shellfish, subtly spiced Asian cuisine, light summer salads, or simply enjoyed as a refreshing aperitif.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine invites you to experience a rosé with a rebel streak. Pink-orange in color, it opens with rosehip, dried cherry, cranberry, strawberry and white blossom. The midpalate trends towards fulsome in body with an assertive flash of heft on the finish.

patz-hall-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.title: Patz & Hall Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir
patz-hall-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Crafted from a collection of family-owned Sonoma Coast vineyards, this Pinot Noir reveals vibrant cherry, strawberry, cranberry, cassis, and subtle spice. Refined tannins, bright acidity, and layers of forest floor and floral notes create a beautifully balanced coastal expression.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with duck breast, cedar-planked salmon, mushroom risotto, roast pork, and herb-roasted chicken.

solaia-2015.title: Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2015
solaia-2015.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2015 is an extraordinary, full-bodied Super Tuscan crafted from a premier 20-hectare southwest-facing hillside vineyard situated on the Tenuta Tignanello estate in the heart of Chianti Classico. Aged for approximately 18 months in new French oak barriques, it displays an intense, deep ruby-purple color with an expansive, highly complex bouquet of ripe blackcurrant, dark plum, wild blackberry, and graphite, layered with nuances of sweet cocoa, white pepper, tobacco leaf, and crushed dried herbs. On the palate, it exhibits exceptional power, structure, and seamless balance, characterized by fine-grained, ultra-silky tannins and a vibrant line of acidity that carries a rich core of dark fruit through to a remarkably long, polished, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, or well-aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

100 Points - James Suckling

The nose to this Solaia is truly phenomenal with currants, blackberries, roses and violets. So perfumed. Full-bodied and everything is in check and harmony with polished tannins that last for minutes. Purity and focus. Is it the greatest Solaia ever? So drinkable already, but this is a wine for ages ahead.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

There is a magical infinity, a continuous loop of compatibilities, between the icon wines of Tuscany and the 2015 vintage. The stunning 2015 Solaia is solid evidence of this perfect alignment. This was a warm vintage that shows less favorably in my opinion in different parts of Italy and with other grapes that render their most elegant performances in the cooler vintages. I would put pure expressions of Nebbiolo and Sangiovese in this category. However, Tuscany and many of her great blended reds (made partially or fully with international grapes) operate according to a different logic. To me, their maximum expression comes when you can taste that Tuscan sunshine beaming from within. Its rays are brilliant and warm. They shine across the senses with opulence and intensity. The very name Solaia evokes the concept of sunshine and this unique Tuscan wine archetype I am referring to. With the 2015 vintage, Solaia is liquid sunshine not just in name but also in fact. The bouquet is immediately soft and sensual with dark fruit, spice and sweet tobacco. The mouthfeel shows intensity and power, but you don't get any heavy residue from the dry extract (measured at 33 grams per liter). Indeed, the wine feels glossy, tonic and fresh. It is composed of mostly Cabernet Sauvignon with Sangiovese and a tiny part Cabernet Franc. There is a bit of crunch or snap that comes thanks to the more acidity-prone Sangiovese grape (the wine measures 3.5 in pH). Finally, the tannins are beautifully sweet and ripe. This wine is meticulously executed, and the 2015 vintage lives up to an ideal of what we imagine Solaia to be. It will be released about a week after this review is published.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

Floral, mint and medicinal herb aromas introduce this rich, black currant–infused red. Firm and compact, with vibrant structure, youthful harmony and a lingering, fruit-, herb- and spice-tinged finish. Shows terrific balance and length, with the best yet to come. Cabernet Sauvignon, Sangiovese and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2022 through 2038.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Full-bodied and elegant, this gorgeous red offers aromas of ripe dark-skinned berry, fragrant blue flower, spice, menthol and a whiff of new leather. It’s structured and loaded with finesse, delivering cassis, ripe Marasca cherry, licorice and tobacco set against a firm backbone of smooth, velvety tannins. Surprisingly fresh acidity for the hot vintage keeps it balanced. It still needs a few more years to fully develop.

borgogno-barolo-cannubi-2015.title: Giacomo Bourgogne & Figli Borgogno Barolo Cannubi 2017
borgogno-barolo-cannubi-2015.bodyHtml:
The heart of the entire Barolo region, Cannubi originated around 11 million years ago through sedimentation from the Padano sea. It is the most famous and renowned cru of Barolo, mentioned in historical documents that date back to as early as 1700. It has an excellent soil intricacy, formed by large clayey limestone marls and pleasant climate that make this hill one of the most suitable vineyard farming areas in the world. The Barolo from Cannubi has more elegance and longevity than all other Barolo. In this cru the winery owns vineyards that cover around 1.30 hectares, with southern exposure and an altitude that varies from 290 to 320 meters above sea level.

Spontaneous fermentation carried out by indigenous yeasts for about 12 days in concrete tanks, controlled temperature (22 – 25 C initially, 29-30 at the end ), followed by submerged cup maceration for 40 – 50 days, stable temperature 29 C. After the racking off, the malolactic fermentation starts, and it lasts about 15 days at 22 C. Ageing: 4 years in Slavonian oak casks (4500L) with a further refining in bottle for 6 months.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Delicate scents recalling pressed rose, hay, eucalyptus and forest floor mingle with whiffs of spice. The full-bodied palate offers dried cherry, aniseed and ground clove alongside taut, fine-grained tannins that leave a drying close.

colt-46.title: Colt 45 710ml
colt-46.bodyHtml:
“Distinctive taste profile that starts off crisp and finishes smooth and easy.” 

“Well balanced and has a light malt hop flavour. Slightly sweet and super smooth.”

prairie-organic-vodka-1.title: Prairie Gold Berry Eh! Vodka
prairie-organic-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Prairie Gold Berry Eh! is a berry-flavoured vodka from the Prairie Gold range. It is made by The Fort Distillery in Alberta, Canada, and bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Over ice, with soda, or in mixed drinks.

shenks-homestead-bourbon-whiskey.title: Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve
shenks-homestead-bourbon-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve is a rich single malt Scotch whisky matured for 14 years in ex-bourbon American oak casks before being finished in deeply charred new American oak barrels from The Kelvin Cooperage in Louisville, Kentucky. This expression seamlessly combines Glenfiddich's classic Speyside orchard fruit character with the bold vanilla, warm oak spice, and sweet caramel notes typically associated with fine Kentucky bourbon.

Food Pairing: Smoked baby back ribs, grilled pork chops with apple glaze, pecan pie, aged cheddar cheese, or bourbon-glazed steak.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber hue with a smooth, velvety, and medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Vibrant aromas of baked apple, ripe pear, sweet vanilla, toasted oak, creamy caramel, and warm baking spices.

Palate : Rich and full-flavored with layers of caramelized apple, sweet vanilla fudge, toasted oak, woody spice, and soft honeyed malt.

Finish : Long, warm, and sweet with lingering notes of crisp oak, sweet vanilla, and subtle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks with a single large ice cube, or with a few drops of water in a Glencairn glass.

bombergers-declaration-bourbon.title: Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon
bombergers-declaration-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon is a landmark Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey widely recognized as the world's first commercially available single barrel bourbon, introduced in 1984 by Master Distiller Elmer T. Lee. Named in honor of Colonel Albert B. Blanton, who spent over five decades managing the historic Buffalo Trace Distillery (formerly the George T.
