Stagg Distillery), each bottle is drawn from an individual cask aged in the center-cut section of Warehouse H—the only metal-clad warehouse on the distillery grounds, known for rapid temperature fluctuations that accelerate wood interaction. Crafted from Buffalo Trace's high-rye Mashbill #2 and bottled at 93 proof, it delivers a rich, complex, and remarkably balanced profile of sweet vanilla, citrus, caramel, and warm baking spices, housed in its iconic round bottle topped with a collectible cast-metal horse and jockey stopper.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-smoked beef brisket, glazed pork ribs, seared duck breast, aged sharp cheddar or Gouda, dark chocolate pecan tarts, and warm bread pudding with caramel sauce.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber with warm copper-orange highlights, presenting a full, rich body with a velvety, smooth, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Warm vanilla, honey, caramel, dried orange peel, toasted oak, nutmeg, and subtle rye spice.

Palate : Rich and creamy with flavors of burnt sugar, sweet corn, dark toffee, clove, cinnamon, citrus zest, and seasoned charred oak.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warming with lingering notes of sweet vanilla, baking spices, honey, and subtle dry oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or rocks glass, over a single large ice cube, or as the rich centerpiece in classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

bud-light-orange-1.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-orange-1.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

rockbare-mclaren-vale-shiraz.title: Wolf Blass Grey Label McLaren Vale Shiraz 2018 750ml
rockbare-mclaren-vale-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Aromatic blue fruits are complexed with notes of dark chocolate, warm spice and subtle nougat oak

Medium to full bodied, the blue berried fruits are succulent and plush, filling the mouth without being heavy. The tannins are velvety and powdery, framing the palate and providing texture and length.

bacardi-gold-rum-1.title: Bacardi Carta Oro Superior Gold Rum 1.14L
bacardi-gold-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Gold, known as Bacardi Carta Oro, is a gold rum from Bacardi. The brand's Maestros de Ron age it in toasted oak barrels for its golden colour and then filter it through a blend of charcoals that Bacardi keeps secret, which gives the rum its mellow character. Bacardi describes rich, soothing flavours of vanilla, buttery caramel, toasted almond and sweet banana, lifted by orange peel and a light, oaky finish. It is a versatile mixing rum for bold, zesty cocktails such as the Cuba Libre. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 1.14L bottle.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla, buttery caramel, toasted almond, sweet banana and orange peel.

Nose: Nuts and butter.

Palate: Rich and toasted.

Finish: Dry and slightly sweet, with light oak.

Serve: With cola and lime as a Cuba Libre, or in other rum cocktails.

ezra-brooks-old-ezra-7.title: Ezra Brooks Old Ezra 7 Year Old Barrel Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon
ezra-brooks-old-ezra-7.bodyHtml:
We age this Kentucky straight bourbon in new, charred white oak barrels for seven years and bottle it at barrel strength. Seven just became your lucky number.


TASTING NOTES
Sweet floral notes with undertones of vanilla, cinnamon, and fine wood, ending in a warm, buttery finish.

INGREDIENTS
Corn, rye and barley

AWARDS

Platinum Medal, ASCOT, 2022

Double Gold Medal, San Francisco World Spirits, 2022  

Whisky Advocate Top 20 Whiskies of 2019 (#7 / 94 point rating)

forty-creek-double-barrel-whisky.title: Forty Creek Double Barrel
forty-creek-double-barrel-whisky.bodyHtml: An extra-aged whisky that is a true celebration of the intricate and subtle flavors imparted by barrel aging. The individual rye, barley and corn whiskies are extra-aged in a variety of barrels before being masterfully blended. The resulting liquid then goes through up to 2 years of secondary aging in once-used Bourbon barrels.

chateau-la-mission-haut-brion-la-chapell.title: La Chapelle de La Mission Haut-Brion 2016 750ml
chateau-la-mission-haut-brion-la-chapell.bodyHtml:
94 Points - Robert Parker The Wine Advocate
The 2016 La Chapelle de la Mission Haut-Brion is blended of 42% Cabernet Sauvignon, 36.5% Merlot and 21.5% Cabernet Franc. Medium to deep garnet-purple colored, it absolutely sings of red roses, black tea and tilled black soil with a core of crushed blackberries, Morello cherries and cassis plus a hint of cinnamon stick. Medium-bodied, the palate delivers a great intensity of ripe black berries and floral layers, framed by soft, silken tannins and seamless freshness, finishing long and mineral laced. 94/100. Date 2019-2035.

amahagan-whisky-world-malt-edition-no-1.title: Amahagan World Malt Edition No. 1 Whisky
amahagan-whisky-world-malt-edition-no-1.bodyHtml:
From Nagahama, one of Japan’s newest and smallest distilleries, this world blended whisky was matured in a bourbon barrel that helps to bring a really delicious array of aromas and flavors to your nose and palate. A member of a three bottle series, one of which won a World Whiskies Award, this is a really fine expression that allows you to explore what is possible in the World Blended Whisky category.

Amahagan World Malt Edition No.1 is the first release in a series of three world blended whiskies from Japan's Nagahama distillery. Aromas of milk chocolate, orange, vanilla and roast nuts fill the nose, complemented by notes of apple, honey, malt, clove-studded oranges and oaky vanilla.

barr-uisce-wicklow-hills.title: Barr an Uisce Wicklow Hills Blended Irish Whiskey
barr-uisce-wicklow-hills.bodyHtml:
Barr an Uisce Wicklow Hills is a blended Irish whiskey from Barr an Uisce, a brand named after Barraniskey, a townland in County Wicklow on Ireland's east coast (the Irish name means 'above the water'). The blend is 21% malt and 79% grain whiskey, matured in first-fill ex-bourbon barrels and then finished for three months in Oloroso sherry casks. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle, it is a mellow, warming dram: sponge candy, caramel and fruit come first, followed by a distinct toasted-almond nuttiness.

Tasting Notes: Sponge candy, caramel, fruit and toasted almond.

Palate: Mellow and warming; sponge candy and caramel leading to toasted almond.

Serve: Neat, over ice or with a splash of water.

giramonte-2016.title: Giovanni Sordo Barolo 2016
giramonte-2016.bodyHtml:
A magnificent and powerful traditional Piedmontese red wine hailing from the exceptional 2016 vintage. Crafted entirely from estate-grown Nebbiolo grapes, it opens with an expressive, complex bouquet of dried red cherries, dark plums, crushed roses, and tar, interlaced with classic notes of licorice and leather. The palate is full-bodied and tightly wound, boasting firm, age-worthy tannins balanced by a striking mineral precision and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with slow-braised beef in Barolo wine, rich truffle risottos, roasted game, wild boar ragù, or mature Castelmagno and Parmigiano-Reggiano cheeses.

lothian-elgin-chardonnay.title: The Fledge & Co. Elgin Chardonnay 2022
lothian-elgin-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
A refined cool-climate Chardonnay from The Fledge & Co., sourced from Elgin, South Africa. The wine combines citrus and orchard-fruit character with subtle oak and lees-derived texture, showing the region’s natural freshness and precision. Its balanced acidity and mineral character make it an elegant, food-friendly expression.

Food Pairing: Roast chicken, grilled prawns, seared scallops, creamy seafood pasta and soft cheeses complement its citrus freshness, orchard fruit and refined texture.

mitre-mezcal-joven-espadin.title: Mitre Espadin Joven Mezcal
mitre-mezcal-joven-espadin.bodyHtml:
Mitre Joven is a 100% handmade elixir that pays homage to the ancient shaman warriors, precisely embodied in the design of the bottle. Originally from Santiago Matatlán, Oaxaca. Made with double distillation that results in a mezcal that seduces with its flavor, thanks to the Agave Espadín blend.

View: Crystalline and Brilliant.

Nose: Complex aromas that remind us of citrus and herbaceous like the same stalk, with a slight touch of smoke.

Mouth: Soft that confirms aromas and leaves a fresh sensation thanks to its pleasant acidity that remains pleasant and long in the aftertaste. Accompanied by a light and pleasant citric bitterness.

romeos-gin-1.title: The London No. 1 Original Blue Gin

reina-maximiliana-raicilla.title: La Reina Raicilla Maximiliana
reina-maximiliana-raicilla.bodyHtml:
La Reina Raicilla Maximiliana is an artisanal raicilla from Rancho Nuevo in Atenguillo, in the western Sierra of Jalisco, made from 100% Agave Maximiliana by Maestro Raicillero Julio Topete Becerra. The agave is cooked in a standing adobe oven, crushed by hand with wooden mallets, fermented in 200-litre white oak tubs and distilled twice in stainless steel pots. The brand takes its name from the saying that mezcal is the king and raicilla the queen. It is an unaged (joven) spirit bottled at 42% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat in a copita or small glass, at room temperature.

solaia-2007.title: Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2007
solaia-2007.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2007 is a legendary, full-bodied Super Tuscan crafted from a premier 20-hectare southwest-facing hillside vineyard situated on the Tenuta Tignanello estate in the heart of Chianti Classico. Aged for approximately 18 months in new French oak barriques, this magnificent vintage displays an intense, deep ruby-red color. The nose opens with an extraordinarily complex bouquet of blackcurrant, dark plum, wild blackberry preserve, and graphite, layered with nuances of dark chocolate, sweet tobacco, crushed violet, espresso bean, and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it reveals remarkable richness, density, and structure, featuring fine-grained, velvety tannins and balanced acidity that carries its pure core of dark fruit through to an exceptionally long, refined, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, or well-aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

This is a subtle and racy wine. Balanced, with vibrant fruit and bright acidity and chocolate and spices. Full and racy. Very long. Austere. Fascinating. Very closed right now. Give it five or six years minimum now. Winemaker Renzo Cotarella says that Solaia is more reserved in character than the Antinori's Guado al Tasso from Bolgheri, which is more flashy. Makes me smile.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2007 Solaia saturates the palate with a heady array of super-ripe black cherries, plums, cassis, mocha and sweet French oak. There is an exotic quality to the Solaia I find totally irresistible. Despite its considerable ripeness and opulence, the 2007 Solaia is never heavy, rather it impresses for its extraordinary finesse and balance. Minerals, graphite and crushed rocks frame a long, seductive finish. This is a wonderful Solaia loaded with vintage and vineyard character. The 2007 Solaia is 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Sangiovese and 5% Cabernet Franc, aged in 100% new oak. Anticipated maturity: 2017-2027.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A racy wine that offers so much currant and blackberry character. Full and very silky. Goes on and on. Fascinating. Best after 2012. 6,500 cases made.

solaia-2006.title: Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2006
solaia-2006.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2006 is a monumentally structured, benchmark Super Tuscan red wine crafted from the famous 20-hectare southwest-facing Solaia vineyard, located on the Tenuta Tignanello estate in the heart of Chianti Classico. Aged for 18 months in new French oak barriques, it displays a deep ruby-purple hue accompanied by an extraordinarily complex bouquet of ripe blackcurrant, dark plum, wild blackberry, and graphite, seamlessly integrated with notes of dark chocolate, sweet tobacco, espresso bean, crushed violet, and dried herbs. On the palate, it exhibits immense power, weight, and focus, offering ultra-fine, velvety tannins and a vibrant line of acidity that carries its concentrated core of dark fruit into an extraordinarily long, elegant, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, or well-aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Displays loads of mint, eucalyptus, currant and meat on the nose. Full-bodied, with masses of fruit, yet reserved and structured. Mouthpuckering now from all the tannins, but this will give incredible pleasure in years to come. Cabernet Sauvignon, Sangiovese and Cabernet Franc. Best after 2014. 6,250 cases made.

95 Points - James Suckling

A clarity and brilliance to this Solaia now with plums, light chocolate and meat. Full body and round and soft tannins. Juicy and delicious. Just right now where it shows the fruit and light tertiary qualities on the nose and palate. Excellent.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Mostly Cabernet Sauvignon and Sangiovese (with a small touch of Cabernet Franc), Solaia's winning card is texture. The wine is soft, velvety and penetrating in the mouth with succulent flavors of blackberry, creamy cassis berry, chocolate and tobacco. Thick extraction and quality fruit craft a memorable wine that will last many long and happy years in your cellar.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The estate’s 2006 Solaia is a big, powerful offering loaded with ripe blackberry jam, herbs, minerals and French oak. Like all of the 2006s from Antinori, the Solaia remains extraordinarily dense and primary. Readers will have to be patient with this wine and give it plenty of bottle age before the full range of its aromas and nuances blossom fully. Solaia is 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Sangiovese and 5% Cabernet Franc. Anticipated maturity: 2014-2026.

rum-nation-guatemala-xo-20th-anniversary.title: Rum Nation Venezuela XO 25th Anniversary Edition Rum
rum-nation-guatemala-xo-20th-anniversary.bodyHtml:
Rum Nation Venezuela XO 25th Anniversary Edition is a Venezuelan rum released to mark 25 years of Rum Nation, for which the brand picked out what it regards as its best casks. It is a molasses-based, Spanish-style rum bottled at 43% ABV in a 700ml decanter. The producer's notes describe ageing in ex-bourbon casks in a tropical climate, and the rum is then refined in Oloroso and Pedro Ximénez sherry casks before bottling. It is presented in a squat, square-shouldered decanter with a gold label and stopper, packed in a matching gold gift box, and is offered as a limited release.

Nose: Roasted almonds, nougat and candied orange peel.

Palate: Rich dark chocolate, orange and exotic spices.

Finish: Long, smooth and creamy, balanced between sweetness and oak.

Serve: Neat, as a sipping rum.

solaia-2009.title: Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2009
solaia-2009.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2009 is a magnificent, full-bodied Super Tuscan sourced from the premier 20-hectare, southwest-facing Solaia vineyard at the Tenuta Tignanello estate in the heart of Chianti Classico. Aged for approximately 18 months in new French oak barriques, this warm vintage displays a deep ruby-red hue with dark garnet highlights. The expressive bouquet opens with rich aromas of ripe blackcurrant, blackberry jam, and dark plum, harmoniously layered with nuances of dark chocolate, sweet tobacco, crushed mint, espresso, and toasted oak. On the palate, it reveals exceptional richness and concentration, delivering ripe, supple tannins and well-integrated acidity that leads into a long, velvety, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, or well-aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Like its sunshine-inspired name suggests, Solaia is an opulent and generous achievement that represents the highest pedigree in Italian wine. The intensity is mind-blowing and the wine peels back slowly to reveal thick layers of blackberry, chocolate fudge, spice and general fruit decadence. The mouthfeel is super smooth yet powerful, delivered in the most elegant fashion.

96 Points - James Suckling

A Solaia with lots of currants, berries and milk chocolate yet reserved and focused. Full body, with refined tannins and an alluring finish. Needs at least two or three years to come together. Can't decide if I like this better than the superb 2008. Better in 2015.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

A pretty red, boasting floral, cherry, black currant, chocolate and spice aromas and flavors. The firm structure is assertive now, both acidity and tannins, but the sweet fruit and spice flavors persist and grace the long finish. Cabernet Sauvignon, Sangiovese and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2015 through 2030.

piper-brut-ice-cream.title: Piper-Heidsieck Cuvee Brut Ice Cream Limited Edition
piper-brut-ice-cream.bodyHtml:
Piper-Heidsieck Cuvée Brut Ice Cream Limited Edition combines the celebrated French Champagne house's signature non-vintage Brut with a playful, ice cream-inspired presentation. Featuring an eye-catching red cooler with a gold soft-serve-shaped lid, this collectible edition delivers elegant notes of fresh apple, pear, citrus, and toasted brioche. Crisp, balanced, and beautifully refreshing, it makes a distinctive gift or centrepiece for special celebrations.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, sushi, smoked salmon, grilled prawns, soft cheeses, light appetizers, and delicate seafood dishes.

torre-zambra-madia-incastro-white.title: Torre Zambra Incastro Bianco 2025
torre-zambra-madia-incastro-white.bodyHtml:
Torre Zambra Incastro Bianco 2025 is a vibrant, organic white blend from Abruzzo that offers a beautiful pale yellow color with luminous reflections. The expressive nose releases crisp aromas of fresh lemon, lime peel, white flowers, and juicy pineapple, underscored by a delicate hint of bitter almond. On the palate, this wine is delightfully bone-dry, light, and wonderfully lively, balancing the refreshing acidity and mineral structure of Pecorino with the effortless lightness of Passerina and the easy-drinking charm of Trebbiano.

Food Pairing: Superb as an aperitif or paired with light seafood starters, grilled fish, summer salads, fresh herb pasta dishes, and light poultry or vegetarian pizza.

glenfarclas-185th-anniversary.title: Glenfarclas 185th Anniversary
glenfarclas-185th-anniversary.bodyHtml: To mark the occasion, Callum Fraser (Distillery Manager) and Douglas Belford (Managing Director) were given the enviable task of going out in to the warehouses to hunt for casks from across the decades that they felt best represented our 185 year history. This was a long process, but after almost 2 years of adding a few casks at a time, they are more than delighted with the final result. This well layered dram with a phenomenal finish showcases the true Glenfarclas character. It was bottled at 46% and will be available soon from specialist whisky shops via our network of international distributors.

canadian-club-44-year-old.title: Canadian Club Invitation Series 15 Year Old Sherry Cask
canadian-club-44-year-old.bodyHtml: First, in the series, this one-time release whisky has all the hallmark notes of CC Classic 12 YO elevated to 15 years with the secondary aging in Oloroso sherry casks. The results are rich aromas of toffee, spice and subtle sweetness with warm and creamy flavours with mellow wood on the palate. Sip neat or over ice.

rey-campero-mezcal-espadin.title: Rey Campero Espadin Mezcal
rey-campero-mezcal-espadin.bodyHtml: The size of the espadin maguey is 1.5 m wide and 1 m high on average.It is the most used in Oaxaca for the production of mezcal, it is the maguey with the greatest geographical presence in Mexico, whose morphological plasticity caused the description of more than 20 species, the maturation time varies between 7 and 10 years.

rey-campero-mezcal-cuishe.title: Rey Campero Cuishe Mezcal
rey-campero-mezcal-cuishe.bodyHtml: The maguey cuishe grows in the lower areas of Oaxaca's central valleys, which have rocky terrain, the warmest temperatures, and generally dry conditions. Consequently, the flavors have a more savory minerality and an earthy reference. Cuishe mezcal is a mezcal made with totally wild maguey and which takes between 9 and 12 years to reach maturity.

rey-campero-mezcal-jabali.title: Rey Campero Jabali Mezcal
rey-campero-mezcal-jabali.bodyHtml: Due to its low sugar content, maguey wild boar is rarely used to make mezcal.It is a maguey with a lot of presence in the southern sierra of the state of Oaxaca, mainly with a dry climate.It grows wild and its maturation time is between 15 and 18 years.

rey-campero-mezcal-madrecuishe.title: Rey Campero Madre Cuishe Mezcal
rey-campero-mezcal-madrecuishe.bodyHtml: This agave is generally found in slightly higher and temperate areas than the cuishe, which gives it a balanced and fresh mineral taste, as well as its characteristic grassy aroma. It is an agave that matures between 9 and 12 years.

rey-campero-mezcal-mexicano.title: Rey Campero Mexicano Mezcal
rey-campero-mezcal-mexicano.bodyHtml:
Rey Campero Mexicano is a joven mezcal artesanal made entirely from Agave rhodacantha, known in Oaxaca as maguey Mexicano. The agaves are harvested at high altitude among pine and oak forests, roasted in earthen ovens, crushed in a mule-drawn stone mill, fermented in wooden vats and double-distilled in a copper alembic. The result is bottled unaged at 48.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle under the protected denomination of origin for mezcal. A traditional, small-batch expression for sipping neat.

Serve: Neat at room temperature, in a copita or small glass, with orange slices on the side if desired.

rey-campero-mezcal-sierra-negra.title: Rey Campero Sierra Negra Mezcal
rey-campero-mezcal-sierra-negra.bodyHtml: Maguey Sierra Negra, is a maguey that is located in the state of Oaxaca, it is cultivated and difficult to reproduce;it takes between 15, 18 or more years to mature depending on the region and climate where it grows, it is one of the largest agaves in size and weight.

rey-campero-mezcal-tepeztate.title: Rey Campero Tepextate Mezcal
rey-campero-mezcal-tepeztate.bodyHtml: The Maguey Tepextate, is one of the wildest Magueys with which mezcal is made, its Aromas and Flavors are Intense and unmistakable. 100% organic Mezcal, to reach its maturation it must take between 15 and 18 years depending on the region where it is located. Unique and special tepextate mezcal.

rey-campero-mezcal-tobala.title: Rey Campero Tobala Mezcal
rey-campero-mezcal-tobala.bodyHtml: Expertly crafted from the rare Tobala agave plant, this 750ml bottle of Rey Campero Mezcal offers a unique and complex flavor profile. With its smooth, smoky taste and hints of citrus and spice, this mezcal is perfect for sipping or mixing into cocktails. Experience the rich heritage and tradition of Oaxacan mezcal with every sip.

chateau-haut-bailly-2016.title: Chateau Haut Bailly 2020
chateau-haut-bailly-2016.bodyHtml:
A legendary Pessac-Léognan with captivating aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, graphite, cedar, cigar box, violet, and exotic spice. Exceptionally refined with silky tannins, remarkable freshness, extraordinary complexity, and one of Bordeaux's greatest aging potentials.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, aged Comté, or wild mushroom risotto.

 

100 Points - James Suckling

This has incredible power and drive with blackberry, black olive and graphite. It’s full-bodied, yet dynamic and agile, with so much polished and muscular tannin. Yet, it remains in harmony and balance. So much character. The head of the château calls it diabolical beauty. 25% less production than the 2019. 52% Cabernet Sauvignon, 42% Merlot, 3% Cabernet Franc and 3% Petit Verdot.

99 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Another wine I underrated on release, the 2020 Château Haut-Bailly is just about pure perfection, and whereas the 2018 is closer in style to the 2009, this plays things a little closer to its vest and is reminiscent of the 2010. Full-bodied, concentrated, and powerful, it nevertheless cuts a focused, precise path across the palate and brings incredible purity in its darker fruits, smoked tobacco, cedar pencil, and Asian spice-driven aromas and flavors. The tannin quality here is off the charts, and this beauty has everything you could want from wine.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine's texture is exceptional, with powerful dark fruits and rich tannins blending seamlessly. All this density is cut with the finest spice and fresh acidity. The result is a wine that has both power and delicacy that gives a lift to the aftertaste. It will certainly age so well.

97 Points - Decanter

Almost wild on the nose, aromatic and expressive, you can tell this is a powerful, concentrated wine with dark fruits, graphite, fresh mint and medicinal herbal touches. Pure and focused, clean, lean and multifaceted, the flavours hit the palate then melt away, giving the floor to liquorice, cedar, tobacco and soft clove spices. I love the sleekness and the sense of seriousness that the 2020 has compared to the more 'look at me' 2019 at this point. The texture and depth make this wine, with vertical layers and excellent acidity. A profound wine.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Haut-Bailly opens in the glass with attractive aromas of cassis, sweet berries, loamy soil, violets and pencil shavings. Medium to full-bodied, deep and layered, it's a concentrated, rather broad-shouldered wine built around a chassis of firm, powdery tannin that asserts itself on the finish. Haut-Bailly once rivaled Haut-Brion for the title of Pessac's most elegant wine, and I would love to see the team here ease off extraction, but this remains a strong effort that will reward patience. Best after 2030.

glenfiddich-23-year-old-grand-cru.title: Glenfiddich 23 Year Old Grand Cru
glenfiddich-23-year-old-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 23 Year Old Grand Cru is an exclusive single malt Scotch whisky matured for 23 years in American oak and European oak casks before undergoing a finishing period of up to six months in rare French Cuvée oak casks. This secondary maturation imparts an opulent profile of crisp baked pastries, floral fruitiness, and effervescent sweetness that bridges the richness of Speyside malt with the celebratory elegance of French sparkling wine.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh oysters, smoked salmon blinis, caviar, roasted duck breast with spiced cherry reduction, pear and almond tart, and mild artisanal cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden color with brilliant clarity, featuring a velvety, medium-to-full body with a soft and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Freshly baked brioche, sweet apple blossom, candied lemon, ripe pear, vanilla cream, and a touch of white grape sweetness.

Palate : Rich layers of vanilla oak, sweet brioche, poached pear, white peach, sandalwood, and gentle citrus sorbet balanced by delicate baking spice.

Finish : Long, sweet, and crisp with lingering notes of pastry, honeyed apple, and subtle floral oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip-shaped whisky glass, or with a few drops of water to open up the delicate floral aromas and sparkling wine-cask nuances.

jurame-mezcal-salmiana.title: Jurame Salmiana Mezcal
jurame-mezcal-salmiana.bodyHtml:
a young, crystalline mezcal made from wild Salmiana agave in San Luis Potosí. It has a clear appearance and a smooth, elegant character, with a more herbal and mineral profile and less smoke than many traditional mezcals.

Food Pairing: Fresh ceviche, grilled seafood, goat cheese, fresh citrus salads, and mild Mexican dishes.

Tasting Notes: Bright and clear with a light-to-medium body, featuring a smooth, crisp, and fresh character driven by green, herbaceous agaves with subtle, elegant smokiness.

Nose: Freshly cut grass, green herbs, citrus peel, cooked agave, and soft, clean smoke.

Palate: Well-balanced and crisp, with dominant notes of green pepper, fresh herbs, lime zest, sweet roasted agave, and gentle earthy minerals.

Finish: Clean, refreshing finish with lingering notes of citrus zest, light pepper, and soft, subtle smoke.

Serve: Served neat at room temperature in a traditional copita or wide-rimmed glass, or as a premium base in citrus-forward craft cocktails.

grand-love-cristalino-tequila.title: Gran Coramino Reposado Cristalino Tequila
grand-love-cristalino-tequila.bodyHtml: From our centuries old distilling process to our handcrafted methods, Gran Coramino™ honors dedication and grit. We plant and harvest the finest blue agaves in the heart of the Tequila Valley, cook them at peak maturity in traditional brick ovens before careful distillation in copper pot stills. Aged in Eastern European oak barrels, the tequila is then finished in California Cabernet wine casks. As a final step, it is meticulously filtered for flawless clarity and unparalleled smoothness, revealing subtle notes of caramel, honey, vanilla and berries.

elk-cove-pinot-noir-willamette-valley.title: Elk Cove Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2024
elk-cove-pinot-noir-willamette-valley.bodyHtml:
Elk Cove Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2024 is a lively, elegant, and beautifully balanced red wine crafted from 100% estate-grown fruit across six distinct site vineyards in Oregon's Northern Willamette Valley. Fermented in small open-top stainless steel tanks and aged for 10 months in French oak, it draws on diverse soil types and clones to deliver an expressive, fruit-forward profile. In the glass, it reveals inviting aromas of fresh red cherry, strawberry-rhubarb pie, wild raspberry, rose petal, and delicate oak spice. On the palate, it is light-to-medium-bodied and supple, offering flavors of ripe red currant, juicy plum, and dark berry compote layered with subtle earthy notes, fine-grained tannins, and a silky, refreshed finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast, grilled salmon, pork tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, and semi-soft cheeses like Brie.

91 Points - James Suckling

A fresh, juicy, light- to medium-bodied wine with loads of red-cherry, spice and rose-petal aromas. Fine, gentle tannins and a silky texture.

minor-case-straight-rye.title: Minor Case Straight Rye Whiskey Sherry Cask Finished
minor-case-straight-rye.bodyHtml:
A remarkable and innovative Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey produced by Limestone Branch Distillery. Named in honor of the founder's great-grandfather, the legendary Minor Case Beam, this straight rye is beautifully finished in cream sherry casks. Bottled at 90 proof, this exceptional secondary maturation process completely smooths out the sharp, spicy edges of the rye, imparting dark, sweet fruit notes and a luxurious, velvety texture that is dangerously easy to sip.

 

NOSE

Earthy and sweet with bright aromas of golden raisins, sweet sherry, butterscotch, and light floral notes.

PALATE

Smooth, sweet, and highly complex. A gentle rye spice is beautifully wrapped in flavors of dark cherry, sweet cream, vanilla, and rich sherry wine.

FINISH

Long, smooth, and warming with a lingering sweetness of dark fruit and butterscotch.

tignanello-2014.title: Marchesi Antinori Tignanello 2014
tignanello-2014.bodyHtml:
Ruby red in color with purple highlights, the 2014 Tignanello shows an intense nose of red fruit with hints of leather and sweet spice. The wine is ample and enveloping on the palate with supple tannins that respect the character and personality of the Sangiovese grape. The finish and aftertaste are of lovely length and persistence.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Exotic spice, cedar, purple flower, forest floor and wild berry are some of the aromas you’ll find in this fragrant, focused red. It’s loaded with finesse, delivering juicy Marasca cherry, cassis, star anise and white pepper with remarkable precision. It’s fresh and balanced by vibrant acidity and elegant, fine-grained tannins. Drink 2019–2029.

94 Points - James Suckling

Really pretty aromas of currants and roses follow through to a medium body, firm and silky tannins and a fresh finish. Very well done for 2014 and a wonderful Tignanello to drink now or later. Better in 2019.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Tignanello has this amazing ability of always being, well, Tignanello. Its very DNA makes it among the most distinctive and recognizable wines in the world. I'm happy to report that this is also the case for the 2014 Tignanello that faced very different growing conditions compared to most. The wine is beautiful and balanced with sweet tannins and a supporting oak texture that is neatly folded at the back. The wine is all about measure and proportion, and it aspires to these goals with an impressive sense of natural harmony. This is not an overtly powerful or muscular expression. Instead, it shows a tasty, almost savory form of elegance. This vintage was made with 75% Sangiovese, which means that the Cabernet presence is a tad bigger than normal. Ultimately, this wine is more finessed and delicate, and I appreciate the careful tannic management on display here.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A black currant thread winds through this dense red, with cherry, leather, earth, iron and mineral flavors. Sangiovese, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon. Best from 2020 through 2033.

tignanello-2011.title: Marchesi Antinori Tignanello 2011
tignanello-2011.bodyHtml:
The 2011 Tignanello is an intense ruby red in color with purple highlights. The wine is ripe on the nose with notes of dark fruit and with much underlying freshness on the aromatic finish; plum fruit dominates the aromatic gamut along with cherries, and the aromas evolve with vigor and balance towards sensations of mint and liquorice. On the palate, though still young, the wine is ready and inviting, rich and harmonious; excellent the balance of the flavors thanks to the tonic acidity and the solidity and suppleness of the tannins. The finish and aftertaste are rich and savory and are characterized by a sweet persistence and length.

95 Points - James Suckling

Ruby, rose, clear color. Fresh grapes, red fruit, marble and stone on the nose. Paprika, some cinnamon and fresh cherry on the palate. Light tannins develop structure and complexity. Sangiovese and cabernet sauvignon. Better in 2016.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2011 Tignanello demonstrates a very ripe and fruit-forward personality with bursting cherry and blackberry folded within sweet spice, moist tobacco and honey-almond paste. Its texture is heavy and dense with sticky spots of sweetness (the alcohol is recorded at 14.5%). With such a fruit-heavy personality, the wine doesn’t reach the soaring heights or brilliant complexity we see in cooler vintages. It should veer toward a greater sense of focus and tightness with more bottle age.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A powerful red, with plum, blackberry and black cherry flavors that border on jammy, all kept in check by juicy acidity and firm, dense tannins and leather and earth accents. Finishes long, with a mineral flourish. Best from 2015 through 2023.

grey-goose-vodka.title: Grey Goose Altius Vodka
grey-goose-vodka.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Altius Vodka is a ultra-premium luxury vodka crafted using French winter wheat sourced from the Picardie region and glacial spring water drawn from the French Alps. Distilled through a specialized process that includes sub-zero crystallization at -24°C, this high-altitude inspired expression achieves remarkable smoothness, extraordinary clarity, and an elevated, crisp mouthfeel.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, beluga caviar, smoked salmon, tuna sashimi, or chilled seafood platter.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear appearance with a smooth, velvety, and exceptionally cold, crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Clean and delicate with subtle floral aromas, light minerality, soft wheat, and a hint of fresh citrus.

Palate : Exceptionally smooth and rounded with delicate notes of sweet grain, soft minerality, and alpine freshness.

Finish : Ultra-clean, long, and silky with a refreshing, crisp finish and no harsh burn.

Serve : Serve neat well-chilled, served over a hand-carved ice sphere, or in an ultra-premium Vodka Martini.

mi-tierra-blanco-tequial.title: Volcan de Mi Tierra Blanco Tequila
mi-tierra-blanco-tequial.bodyHtml:
Volcan de Mi Tierra Blanco Tequila is a premium Mexican spirit crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave sourced from the Highlands and Lowlands of Jalisco. Combining traditional production techniques with careful distillation, it reveals vibrant citrus, sweet cooked agave, fresh herbs and delicate floral notes. Its smooth texture and refined peppery finish showcase the distinctive character of Jalisco's volcanic terroir.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with fresh ceviche, grilled shrimp, fish tacos, citrus-marinated chicken, tuna tartare, guacamole and spicy Mexican dishes.

Tasting Notes: Fresh and expressive with sweet cooked agave, grapefruit, lemon zest, delicate floral notes, herbal complexity and black pepper spice.

Nose: Aromas of cooked agave, fresh citrus, grapefruit, pear, delicate flowers and subtle herbal notes.

Palate: Smooth and vibrant with sweet agave, bright lemon and grapefruit, gentle tropical fruit, fresh herbs and white pepper.

Finish: Clean and balanced with lingering citrus freshness, cooked agave sweetness and a delicate warming pepper spice.

mi-tierra-reposado.title: Volcan de Mi Tierra X.A Tequila
mi-tierra-reposado.bodyHtml: Volcán X.A is an innovative blend of Reposado, Anejo and Extra Anejo tequilas made from 100% blue agave and aged in American oak casks. This unique tequila reveals aromas of vanilla, caramel and dried fruits with perfectly balanced flavours of cooked agave and sweet spice. Best enjoyed neat or on the rocks.

mi-tierra-extra-anejo-tequila.title: Tierra Noble Exquisito Extra Añejo Tequila
mi-tierra-extra-anejo-tequila.bodyHtml:
The emblem of the house is born from the tradition that our tequila teachers have of selecting year after year from among hundreds of Tierra Noble barrels only those that have developed the most subtle and elegant notes to celebrate the end of each season.

Over time the exquisite blend of these extra-añejo aging up to 85 months would become what is today the Selection of the Founder.

VIEW
Intense dark amber color, clean and bright with reddish sparkles, great grip in the glass forming tears and legs of great body.

NOSE
Very pleasant and soft on the nose with fruity and sweet aromas; notes of cooked agave honeys, vanilla, prune, chocolate, toasted almonds, apricot and tobacco in a perfect balance with woody notes.

PALATE
Soft on the palate, balanced and complex, with bitter chocolate flavors, nuts and red fruits, a light to tobacco and spices; of great persistence on the palate.

NOTES
Surprisingly elegant, harmonious and balanced, additional definitely the best expression of the Noble Earth house.

mi-tierra-extra-anejo-tequila-1.title: Tierra Noble Exquisito Extra Añejo Tequila
mi-tierra-extra-anejo-tequila-1.bodyHtml:
The emblem of the house is born from the tradition that our tequila teachers have of selecting year after year from among hundreds of Tierra Noble barrels only those that have developed the most subtle and elegant notes to celebrate the end of each season.

Over time the exquisite blend of these extra-añejo aging up to 85 months would become what is today the Selection of the Founder.

VIEW
Intense dark amber color, clean and bright with reddish sparkles, great grip in the glass forming tears and legs of great body.

NOSE
Very pleasant and soft on the nose with fruity and sweet aromas; notes of cooked agave honeys, vanilla, prune, chocolate, toasted almonds, apricot and tobacco in a perfect balance with woody notes.

PALATE
Soft on the palate, balanced and complex, with bitter chocolate flavors, nuts and red fruits, a light to tobacco and spices; of great persistence on the palate.

NOTES
Surprisingly elegant, harmonious and balanced, additional definitely the best expression of the Noble Earth house.

talisker-8-year-old-2021-special-release.title: Talisker 8 Year Old Special Release 2021
talisker-8-year-old-2021-special-release.bodyHtml:
Talisker 8 Year Old Special Release 2021 is a cask-strength single malt Scotch from Diageo's 2021 Special Releases. Distilled in 2012, it was drawn from refill casks selected for the heaviest peat character in Talisker's stocks and bottled at a natural cask strength of 59.7% ABV; this listing is the 750ml bottle. The result is a young, bold and briny Talisker that puts smoke, salt and pepper up front.

Tasting Notes: Oily and bold with savoury salt, light sweetness and plenty of smoke.

Nose: Cereal spice, briny seaweed and smoke.

Palate: Oily and bold, with savoury salt, a light sweetness and more smoke.

Finish: Long and heavily peated.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water to open it up.

cardhu-14-year-old-2021-special-release.title: Cardhu 14 Year Old 2021 Special Release
cardhu-14-year-old-2021-special-release.bodyHtml: Distilled in 2006, this 14-year-old Cardhu single malt was initially matured in refill American oak casks and finished in ex-red wine casks, before being bottled as part of the Diageo 2021 Special Releases. Aromas of white grape, lychee, tart green apple, orange zest and buttery pastries mingle with meadow flowers, honey and tannic oak on the nose. The palate offers notes of toffee, Parma violets, red apple, spicy oak, white pepper and green apple that linger in the finish.

barnett-rattlesnake-hill-cabernet-2018.title: Barnett Vineyards Rattlesnake Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
barnett-rattlesnake-hill-cabernet-2018.bodyHtml:
The color of the wine is a beautiful dark purple at the core with a crimson rim. Immediate dark chocolate and coffee jump out of the glass, as well as blackcurrant puree and fresh blackberries. Underlying elements of eucalyptus, gravel, and pepper spice complement the licorice and nutmeg spice. This is a very lush velvety wine on entry. The dark berry fruit is very pronounced, with other flavors of peppercorn and mocha. The sizeable tannins are in a chalky complex form that is matched by the acidity and demand cellaring. This beautiful and substantial wine will age amazingly over the next 15-17 years (2035-2037).

94 Points - Wine Spectator
Bright and lively, with a wide array of violet, sweet bay leaf and anise notes leading off, followed by a solid core of blackberry, boysenberry and plum paste flavors. Shows lots of energy through the finish, with a buried iron spine holding everything in place. Rock-solid. Best from 2022 through 2036.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Rattlesnake opens a little broody with notes of crushed rocks, tar and tilled soil over a core over baked plums, warm cassis and mulberries. Medium to full-bodied, firm and grainy-textured, it delivers lovely freshness and an elegant, well-poised finish.


92 Points - James Suckling

This shows ripe dark-fruit character with notes of licorice, cloves, leather and a touch of musk. Full-bodied and plush with a ripe-fruit core on the palate, chewy tannins and a long finish. This needs time for the tannins to soften.

jack-daniels-advent-calendar.title: Jack Daniel's Holiday Countdown Advent Calendar 12 x 50ml
jack-daniels-advent-calendar.bodyHtml: Jack Daniel’s wants to help you countdown to the holidays with its annual Jack Daniel’s Holiday Calendar, featuring various 50ml bottles from the Jack Daniel family of brands as well as additional premium items.  This item always sells out fast so get them now before the holidays are here!

blue-1.title: Kubota Senju Blue Junmai Ginjo 720ml
blue-1.bodyHtml:
Clean and refreshing, with a gentle aroma and subtle fruit character leading into a soft, smooth palate. Delicate rice umami is balanced by pleasant acidity and a distinctly dry profile, finishing crisp and refreshing with a subtle lingering savoury note.

Food Pairing: Sushi, sashimi, grilled seafood, shrimp pasta, tempura, chicken, vegetable dishes and other light or savoury cuisine.

naked-grape-shiraz-1.title: Naked Grape Shiraz 750ml
naked-grape-shiraz-1.bodyHtml: Naked Grape Shiraz is a 750ml bottle of red wine made from Syrah grapes, often known as Shiraz in some regions. It is described as having a clear ruby purple color with aromas of ripe raspberry and floral nuances. The taste is mellow, fruity, with a medium body, balanced acidity, and soft tannins. This wine is typically full-bodied with intense black fruit and complex flavors, potentially including animal notes like leather and smoky notes like tobacco, according to Virgin Wines.

naked-grape-merlot-1.title: Naked Grape Merlot 750ml
naked-grape-merlot-1.bodyHtml:
Naked Grape Merlot is a smooth and approachable red wine, offering rich fruit flavors balanced with soft tannins, making it perfect for casual sipping or pairing with a variety of dishes.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Deep ruby red with a vibrant and inviting appearance.

  • Aromas: Enticing scents of black cherry, plum, and a hint of vanilla from oak aging.

  • Palate: Smooth and velvety, with flavors of ripe red fruit, including blackberry and cherry, complemented by subtle hints of oak and spice. The finish is soft, with a well-rounded mouthfeel.

Wine Profile:

  • Region: California, USA

  • Varietal: Merlot

  • Alcohol: Approx. 13.5%

  • Bottle Size: 750ml

Food Pairing:

Perfect for pairing with grilled meats, pasta dishes with red sauce, roast chicken, and cheeses like cheddar or brie.

Naked Grape Merlot is a versatile and easy-to-enjoy red wine, great for everyday occasions, casual meals, or even a quiet evening of relaxation. Its smooth character makes it a crowd-pleaser at gatherings or dinners.

chateau-duhart-milon-2018.title:
Domaines Barons De Rothschild 
Chateau Duhart Milon 2019 750ml
chateau-duhart-milon-2018.bodyHtml:
96 Points James Suckling

A very balanced, refined Duhart with ever so fine tannins and currant, tobacco and cedar aromas and flavors. Medium to fine tannins. It’s extremely long and polished. Direct. You already want to drink this.
Barrel Sample:95-96

94 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Duhart-Milon is showing beautifully, mingling aromas of cassis and wild berries with notions of violets, cedar wood, orange rind, licorice and spice box in a perfumed bouquet. Medium to full-bodied, supple and seamless, it's charming and refined, with a deep core of fruit, powdery tannins and succulent acids. This château is going from strength to strength. Best after 2025.

94 Points Decanter

This one might sneak up on you, confirming the rise of this wine in recent years. Clear depth of fruit, and above all clear Pauillac character. This feels strict and confident, with beautiful balance and restraint. Duhart is one of the later-ripening and cooler Pauillac terroirs which is why in the past it could be overly austere when young, but it is benefitting from recent hot summers in terms of its fruit ripeness. Pencil lead is prominent here, along with cassis and bilberry. Very precise, very elegant, with a creaminess to the fruit through the mid palate, and overall this is an excellent Duhart. Barrel Sample:94


94 Points Wine Spectator

Racy and mineral-driven, with a chalky thread that runs from start to finish, adding a perfumed elegance to a core of steeped black currant and blackberry fruit flavors. This has a lushness to the fruit, with dark tobacco, steeped black tea and singed alder notes, but there's plenty of range, detail and textural nuance as well. Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Best from 2024

93 Points Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Château Duhart-Milon is another incredibly successful wine in the vintage. Offering up-front currant and cassis fruits, it's medium to full-bodied and has complex cedar and spicy nuances, ripe tannins, and a round, layered, balanced mouthfeel. It's slightly less sunny and opulent than the 2018 but still brings plenty of beautiful, sunny fruit.

villa-sandi-prosecco-il-fresco-brut.title: Villa Sandi Prosecco Il Fresco Brut 750ml
villa-sandi-prosecco-il-fresco-brut.bodyHtml:
Villa Sandi's award-winning Prosecco Il Fresco Brut is an expertly-crafted sparkling wine featuring aromas of apple, white flowers and citrus zest. With a crisp and balanced finish, this refreshing Italian classic pairs perfectly with appetize.

89 points Wine Spectator
A crisp and lively Prosecco with delicate aromas of green apple, pear, and white flowers. The palate is fresh and vibrant, featuring flavors of citrus and stone fruit, balanced by a fine, persistent mousse. Clean and refreshing, with a zesty finish ideal for aperitifs or light seafood dishes.

90 points James Suckling
Bright and fragrant with notes of apple blossom, lemon zest, and ripe peach. The palate is dry and refreshing, showing a harmonious balance of fruit and acidity. The bubbles are fine and elegant, leading to a smooth, mineral-driven finish. A polished and versatile sparkling wine.

88 points Decanter
An approachable Prosecco offering aromas of pear, citrus, and subtle floral tones. Light-bodied with gentle bubbles, it delivers straightforward fruit flavors and a clean, slightly dry finish. Perfect for casual occasions and everyday sipping.

calliope-figure-8-white.title: Calliope Figure 8 White 750ml
calliope-figure-8-white.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2022 vintage) "This year's Figure 8 blends sauvignon blanc, gewürztraminer, and riesling from the southern Okanagan into a steely, cool aromatic white. Tart and grassy up front, with some melon, yellow apple, and Asian pear on the middle, this easily displays the 3 grapes in the mix. Thankfully dry, and best with a brisk chill. (Treve Ring)." - 87/100, Gismondi on Wine

domaine-carneros-pinot-noir.title: Domaine Carneros Estate Pinot Noir 2022
domaine-carneros-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Domaine Carneros Estate Pinot Noir 2022 is a sophisticated and highly expressive red wine that captures the cool-climate elegance of the Carneros region. Sourced exclusively from the estate's six sustainably farmed vineyards, this wine benefits from the maritime influence of the San Pablo Bay, which provides the fog and cool breezes essential for developing complex aromatics while maintaining fresh acidity. The 2022 vintage was aged for approximately 10 months in small French oak barrels to enhance its structure and mouthfeel.
On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of black cherry, pomegranate, and wild strawberry, accented by delicate floral notes of violet and a hint of sandalwood. The palate is medium-bodied and silky, showcasing layers of juicy red fruit, plum, and savory earthy notes. It features fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that carries the flavours through to a long, graceful finish with a touch of baking spice and toasted oak.

94 Points - James Suckling

Vibrant aromas of strawberries, blueberry bush, citrus peel and cassia bark. The palate is medium-bodied with finely integrated tannins and bright acidity, showing a plush and generous mouthfeel with underlying tension. Very refined and pure, with a soft touch. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ripe, dark red fruits swirled through with baking spices and freshly cracked pine, reveal a mouthwatering, flavorful, and juicy still, Pinot Noir. Silken tannins and an ultra long finish.

aperol-cinzano-prosecco-combo-pack.title: Cinzano Prosecco 750ml
aperol-cinzano-prosecco-combo-pack.bodyHtml:
Fresh, fizzy and fruity, with mostly apple and pear-ish flavours. Prosecco has a sweet scent and a soft touch in the mouth. Perfect as an aperitivo, or for mixing in cocktails such as the Aperol Spritz. Prosecco is meant to be drunk young and cold. Perfect for everyday entertaining.

Very easy to pair, it's a perfect fit for every kind of aperitivo, as well as first and second courses made with seafood, white meat and vegetables, even when citrus fruits are used in preparation. Particular kind of pairings could be spicy food, when aromatic but not too hot, like curry chicken and tandoori chicken. Nice for veggies, it can be a nice pairing with legumes dishes and soups.

adelphi-breath-of-the-isles-2007-14yrs.title: Breath Of The Isles 2007 14 Year Old Adelphi
adelphi-breath-of-the-isles-2007-14yrs.bodyHtml: Breath Of The Isles 2007 14 Year Old Adelphi 700ml

freixenet-italian-rose.title: Freixenet Italian Sparkling Rose NV 750ml
freixenet-italian-rose.bodyHtml: Spanish bubbly-master Freixenet now produces fabulous Italian sparklers. This Charmat method glera/pinot noir blend is light and effervescent with notes of fresh red berries and hints of crisp apples. The finish is crisp and refreshing. Pair with salmon mousse or savory appetizers. Its crystal-like bottle is a stunner!

adelphi-caol-ila-2010.title: Caol Ila 2010 Adelphi
adelphi-caol-ila-2010.bodyHtml:
Adelphi Caol Ila is an independent bottling of Islay single malt Scotch whisky from the Caol Ila distillery, selected and bottled by Adelphi Distillery Limited. It is bottled at a full 55.4% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Bottled well above standard strength, it is best explored neat and then with a little water.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water.

freixenet-italian-rose-1.title: Freixenet Italian Sparkling Rose 200ml
freixenet-italian-rose-1.bodyHtml:
As with the white Prosecco, this Rose from the leading Spanish producer, Freixenet, is also available in the cute, yet extremely convenient size of just 200mls. An Italian classic, it also offers those delightfully refreshing notes of florals, apples and red berries in an extra-dry style.

85 points Wine Enthusiast

deadmans-fingers-spiced-rum.title: Dead Man's Fingers Pineapple Rum
deadmans-fingers-spiced-rum.bodyHtml:
Dead Man's Fingers Pineapple Rum is a bold, tropical flavoured rum from Dead Man's Fingers, a British spirits brand inspired by the Rum & Crab Shack in St. Ives, Cornwall. Crafted using Caribbean rum and vibrant pineapple flavours, this expression combines the sweetness of roasted and candied pineapple with soft brown sugar, nutmeg, aniseed, and refreshing lime zest. Bottled at 43% ABV for the Canadian market, it delivers a smooth, fruit-forward character that is perfect for tropical cocktails and refreshing mixed drinks.

Food Pairing: Grilled pineapple, jerk chicken, coconut shrimp, barbecue pork, tropical fruit salad, mango salsa, and pineapple upside-down cake.

Tasting Notes: Sweet and tropical, combining roasted pineapple, brown sugar, citrus zest, and warming spice.

Nose: Ripe pineapple, candied tropical fruit, soft brown sugar, nutmeg, and fresh lime zest.

Palate: Juicy pineapple, caramelized sugar, subtle vanilla, nutmeg, and a delicate touch of aniseed.

Finish: Smooth and warming, with lingering pineapple sweetness, gentle spice, and refreshing citrus.

Serve: Enjoy over ice with lemonade, a lime wedge, and fresh mint. Also excellent in a Pineapple Mojito, tropical rum punch, or Piña Colada.

deadmans-fingers-coffee-rum.title: Dead Man's Fingers Coffee Rum 50ml
deadmans-fingers-coffee-rum.bodyHtml:
Dead Man's Fingers Coffee Rum in a 50ml miniature is the brand's spiced rum infused with roasted coffee and an unconventional blend of spices. Coffee leads, with chocolate orange and a hint of cumin behind it. The miniature is bottled at 37.5% ABV, making it an easy way to try the coffee expression or to add a shot to a dessert drink.

Tasting Notes: Fresh coffee, chocolate orange and cumin.

Serve: Over ice, with cola, or in an Espresso Martini.

deadmans-fingers-pineapple-rum.title: Dead Man's Fingers Pineapple Rum
deadmans-fingers-pineapple-rum.bodyHtml:
Dead Man's Fingers Pineapple Rum is a bold, tropical flavoured rum from Dead Man's Fingers, a British spirits brand inspired by the Rum & Crab Shack in St. Ives, Cornwall. Crafted using Caribbean rum and vibrant pineapple flavours, this expression combines the sweetness of roasted and candied pineapple with soft brown sugar, nutmeg, aniseed, and refreshing lime zest. Bottled at 43% ABV for the Canadian market, it delivers a smooth, fruit-forward character that is perfect for tropical cocktails and refreshing mixed drinks.

Food Pairing: Grilled pineapple, jerk chicken, coconut shrimp, barbecue pork, tropical fruit salad, mango salsa, and pineapple upside-down cake.

Tasting Notes: Sweet and tropical, combining roasted pineapple, brown sugar, citrus zest, and warming spice.

Nose: Ripe pineapple, candied tropical fruit, soft brown sugar, nutmeg, and fresh lime zest.

Palate: Juicy pineapple, caramelized sugar, subtle vanilla, nutmeg, and a delicate touch of aniseed.

Finish: Smooth and warming, with lingering pineapple sweetness, gentle spice, and refreshing citrus.

Serve: Enjoy over ice with lemonade, a lime wedge, and fresh mint. Also excellent in a Pineapple Mojito, tropical rum punch, or Piña Colada.

new-amsterdam-pink-whitney-vodka.title: New Amsterdam Vodka Pink Whitney Pink Lemonade 375ml
new-amsterdam-pink-whitney-vodka.bodyHtml:
New Amsterdam Pink Whitney 375ml is New Amsterdam Vodka flavoured with pink lemonade, bottled at 30% ABV. It was conceived by Biz and Whit of Barstool Sports' Spittin' Chiclets, inspired by the favourite drink of former NHL player Ryan Whitney, and was then popularised by fans until it became a nationwide release in the United States. The result pairs the brand's smooth vodka with sweet, lemony pink lemonade flavour. The 375ml size is a portable bottle made for bringing along to a party.

Tasting Notes: Sweet pink lemonade with lemon zest over clean vodka.

Serve: As a chilled shot, on the rocks, or topped with club soda.

wolfs-head-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Wolf's Head Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
wolfs-head-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon has lifted, perfumed notes of orange blossom, plums, cassis, and some cedary spice and incense notes as well as medium to full-bodied richness on the palate. It?s an opulent, up-front, fruit-forward Cabernet. Deep garnet in colour, with sweet aromas of red cherry, sarsaparilla, Santa Rosa plum, cinnamon and dried herbs. Flavours of blackberry pie, baker?s chocolate, cigar and licorice with a long, dry finish. Fermented in small format stainless steel tanks. Cold soaked 4 days prior to fermentation. Temperature maintained below 80 degrees and a post-ferment extended maceration of an additional 5 days. Malolactic fermentation occurred in barrels with aging on lees for at least a year. 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. 30% New French Oak, and 70% Neutral French Oak.

johnnie-walker-xr-21-year-old-2021-year.title: Johnnie Walker XR 21 Year Old Year of the Tiger Lunar New Year 2022 Edition
johnnie-walker-xr-21-year-old-2021-year.bodyHtml: 2022 is a special year for John Walker & Sons King XR 21. Commemorating its first Chinese New Year limited edition collection with a golden design. On the box, an elegant dragon that represents Zhu Ge Liang peers at a gallant horse which in turn represents Guan Yu. An extremely rare three-stage blending method was used to create this mellow and indulgent whisky. Sweet, creamy and spicy vanilla aromas were combined together in order to brew an especially smooth texture.

pike-creek-22-year-old-px-cask.title: Pike Creek 22 Year Old PX Cask
pike-creek-22-year-old-px-cask.bodyHtml:
Pike Creek 22 Year Old PX Cask Finish is an exceptional limited-edition Canadian whisky crafted under the direction of Master Blender Dr. Don Livermore. Matured for 22 years and finished in sweet Pedro Ximénez sherry casks, this sophisticated blend of corn and rye whiskies offers remarkable richness, depth and complexity. Layers of dark fruit, warm spice and elegant oak culminate in a beautifully smooth, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with dark chocolate truffles, sticky toffee pudding, pecan pie, aged cheddar, roasted walnuts, crème brûlée, chocolate-covered raisins and rich caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes: A rich, fruit-forward Canadian whisky showcasing dried raisins, figs, plum, sweet sherry, vanilla and toasted oak, balanced by bright orchard fruit and warming spice.

Nose: Aromas of dark raisins, dried figs, toasted oak and warm baking spices, with delicate vanilla sweetness.

Palate: Rich plum, dates and sweet sherry unfold alongside green apple, creamy vanilla and gentle rye spice, creating a smooth, layered texture.

Finish: Long, silky and fruit-forward, with lingering dried fruit sweetness, refined oak and a gentle warming sensation.

amrut-peated-cask-strength.title: Amrut Single Cask Ex-Port Pipe #3880 Peated Indian Single Malt BSW Exclusive
amrut-peated-cask-strength.bodyHtml:
Limited Edition Cask Selected by BSW with Rohit & Friends.

Amrut Ex-Port Pipe Indian Single Malt Whisky is a rich and intensely fruity expression that highlights the accelerated maturation of the Bangalore climate combined with the deep influence of fortified wine. Initially matured in ex-bourbon casks, the spirit is finished in massive Portuguese Port Pipes (approximately 550 litres), which impart a distinctive "tawny" character and a lush, ruby-copper hue. This unpeated single malt is typically bottled at 46.2% ABV without chill-filtration, though single-cask versions (like the BSW Barrel) are often released at cask strength. The profile is defined by a dense bouquet of stewed plums, raisins, and dark chocolate, balanced by Amrut’s signature spicy malt. On the palate, it is full-bodied and "chewy," featuring layers of honeyed nuts, black cherries, and sweet oak, leading to a long, warming finish with lingering notes of port wine and cinnamon.

kavalan-solist-brandy-cask-57-80-abv.title: Kavalan Solist Brandy Cask Preferred Team Collection 01 Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-brandy-cask-57-80-abv.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Brandy Cask Preferred Team Collection 01 was the first brandy-cask Kavalan to reach Canada and the opening release of the Preferred Team Collection. Cask Y141119032A matured for about 6.8 years before being bottled at a cask strength of 57.8% ABV, filling 557 bottles of 700 ml. The brandy cask brings tropical fruit and butterscotch character to the whisky. Like every Solist release, it was distilled, matured and bottled at the Kavalan distillery in Yilan County, Taiwan, without chill filtration or added colour, and it comes in an orange gift box.

Nose: Peach, passion fruit, strawberry and mango, with vanilla, toffee, spice and honey in the background.

Palate: Oily, round and smooth, complex and long.

Finish: Long, ending on sweet lychee.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water if you like.

fontodi-vigna-del-sorbo.title: Fontodi Vigna Del Sorbo Gran Selezione 2022
fontodi-vigna-del-sorbo.bodyHtml:
Fontodi Vigna del Sorbo Gran Selezione is our curated offering for customers seeking a high-end Tuscan Sangiovese, but not a Brunello di Montalcino or some obscure IGT Toscana with a plain parchment label. Sometimes, only a true Chianti Classico Riserva will do, especially as a gift for that certain person. Fontodi's packaging is beautiful, the value and pedigree are there, and the wine is absolutely spectacular. With a south-west exposure, Vigna del Sorba is a 55+-year-old single vineyard whose Sangiovese (100%) is steel-fermented with indigenous yeast before aging in barriques and French oak for 24 months, qualifying it as a Riserva. This medium-to-full Chianti is elegant, decadent, and densely woven with cherries, bramble fruit, pomander orange, and leather over fine tannins. Age for another few years or decant now. 

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Blackberry, black currant, plum, tar and sweet spice flavors are aligned with thick, beefy tannins in this red. Unevolved at this stage, showing plenty of fruit that needs to come together with the structural components. Best from 2028 through 2045.

chum-churum-rich.title: Chum Churum Saero Zero Sugar Soju 375ml
chum-churum-rich.bodyHtml: Chum Churum Soju is a traditional Korean spirits that is distilled from rice, sweet potato, and tapioca that offers a crisp clean taste. Chum Churum - Saero Soju is completely sugar and fructose free with only 90 calories per serving, the first product of its kind in Korea. Saero is uniquely made with a distilled concentrated soju that provide more depth to the flavour.

chum-churum-original-soju.title: Chum Churum Original Soju
chum-churum-original-soju.bodyHtml:
Chum Churum Original Soju is the brand's original soju, bottled at 16.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Chum Churum (Cheoeumcheoreom, 'like the first time') is a soju brand of Lotte Chilsung Beverage, launched in 2006 and made with alkaline water, which the brand credits for its smoothness. Clear, light-bodied and velvety, it is a classic partner for Korean barbecue and spicy dishes.

Serve: Well chilled, neat in a shot glass or over ice.

sandhill-small-lots-sangiovese.title: Sandhill Small Lots Program Sangiovese 2018
sandhill-small-lots-sangiovese.bodyHtml:
Sandhill Small Lots Program Sangiovese 2018 is a refined, single-vineyard red wine crafted in small quantities from the Sandhill Estate Vineyard in the southern Okanagan Valley. Visually displaying a deep garnet hue with subtle ruby rim variations, it opens with an aromatic and complex bouquet of ripe strawberry, red cherry, and dried plum, accented by delicate notes of sweet spice, red licorice, white pepper, cedar, and light earthy nuances. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body structured with soft, silky tannins and lively natural acidity, delivering bright red fruit flavors alongside lingering hints of leather, tea leaves, and subtle oak toast on a clean, food-friendly finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with wood-fired Margherita pizza, pasta Bolognese with Parmigiano-Reggiano, grilled lamb chops, veal parmesan, and aged Pecorino cheese.

michele-satta-costa-di-giulia.title: Michele Satta Bolgheri Costa Di Giulia 2018 750ml
michele-satta-costa-di-giulia.bodyHtml: Presents a light yellow color with straw reflexes. On the nose, aromas of flowers, white peach and a slight hint of toasted vanilla. Wonderful mineral notes make this a round and weightier wine with a pleasant finish.

singulier-trousseau-benedicte-tissot.title: Benedicte Et Stephane Tissot Singulier Trousseau 2022 750ml

johnnie-walker-blue-label-year-of-tiger.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Year Old of the Tiger
johnnie-walker-blue-label-year-of-tiger.bodyHtml: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Year Old Of The Tiger 750ml

raymond-vineyards-napa-cabernet-sauvigno.title: Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
raymond-vineyards-napa-cabernet-sauvigno.bodyHtml:
Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is a rich, elegant, and full-bodied red wine from California's renowned Napa Valley. Crafted with carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine showcases the region's exceptional winemaking heritage and Beaulieu Vineyard's commitment to quality. It offers concentrated dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, and subtle oak influences, creating a beautifully balanced and sophisticated drinking experience. With its smooth texture, layered complexity, and lingering finish, this Cabernet Sauvignon is an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining, or enjoying with a hearty meal.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, barbecue, hearty pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses such as cheddar and Gouda.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Focused and brilliant flavors of red and black cherries and black currants drive this sleek and powerful wine, as minty, toasty, and tobacco-like accents stay subtly in the background until the finish. A full body, medium to full tannins and good fruit acidity lend tangy freshness. Best from 2026.

91 Points - James Suckling 

A juicy and delicious wine with a round and polished texture with hints of chocolate and walnuts. Some iron shavings, too. Medium body. Savory at the end. Lovely dark fruit in the finish. Juicy. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a light mesquite edge that mingles with gently mulled plum and blackberry fruit flavors, while lightly singed vanilla and tobacco fill in through the finish. Reveals a solid graphite spine, too. Drink now through 2033. Tasted twice, with consistent notes

the-prisoner-cabernet-sauvignon.title: The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
the-prisoner-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a luxurious, modern, and brilliantly textured expression that carries the bold and unrestricted winemaking philosophy of this iconic estate into a pure varietal focus. Sourced from premier vineyards across the valley, this vintage exhibits a deep magenta and purple-ruby core. On the nose, it offers an invitingly opulent bouquet of ripe black cherries, crème de cassis, and sweet blackberry pie, seamlessly layered with warm undertones of toasted vanilla bean, cinnamon bark, fresh coffee grounds, and hints of crushed wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is incredibly soft, plush, and full-bodied, delivering an expansive, fruit-forward mid-palate wrapped in supple, velvety tannins. Matured for 15 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels, its powerful dark fruit concentration remains beautifully balanced, showing remarkable structural harmony before concluding with a lengthy, decadent finish accented by a touch of holiday spice and subtle mineral depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with charcoal-grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-infused roasted lamb, or hunks of mature sharp white cheddar cheese.

freixenet-carta-nevada-extra-dry.title: Freixenet Carta Nevada Semi Seco
freixenet-carta-nevada-extra-dry.bodyHtml: Freixenet Carta Nevada is a versatile and popular Spanish Cava known for its refreshing and fruity character. It's a semi-dry sparkling wine, offering a balance between sweetness and acidity, making it suitable for various occasions and pairings.

freixenet-elyssia-gran-cuvee-bru.title: Freixenet Elyssia Gran Cuvee De Prestige Brut 750ml
freixenet-elyssia-gran-cuvee-bru.bodyHtml: Freixenet Elyssia Gran Cuvée Brut is a sparkling wine from Spain, known for its sophisticated bouquet, layered complexity, and a balanced flavor profile. It's made with a blend of traditional Macabeo and Parellada Cava grapes, as well as international Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. The aroma features roasted nuts, citrus fruit, and honey, while the palate exhibits flavors of lemon and melon, followed by a spicy finish.

ramazzotti-sambuca-black.title: Ramazzotti Black Sambuca
ramazzotti-sambuca-black.bodyHtml: Black sambuca is similar to white sambuca but with a slightly thicker and richer palate and slightly softer alcohol notes. The black liquorice flavours can be layered with orange liqueur in a shot glass for a flavourful treat that's perfect for entertaining.

chocolate-amore-alexander-valley.title: Decoy Limited Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
chocolate-amore-alexander-valley.bodyHtml:
Decoy Limited Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a highly polished, expressive, and deeply concentrated red wine that represents the pinnacle of the Decoy portfolio. Sourced from premier estate properties and acclaimed vineyards in the sun-drenched Alexander Valley—Sonoma County's premier region for Bordeaux varietals—this vintage benefited from a cool, extended growing season that allowed for exceptional flavor development and elegant structure. Composed of 94% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6% Merlot, the wine was meticulously aged for 15 months in 100% French oak barrels (40% new, 60% neutral). In the glass, it displays a deep ruby-purple core with bright clarity. The highly aromatic nose opens with striking scents of ripe blueberry, sweet blackberry, and dark plum, beautifully layered with nuanced undertones of violet, cardamom, clove spice, and a subtle touch of milk chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and structured, displaying an engaging fluid coherence where a juicy core of boysenberry and dark forest fruits is effortlessly framed by soft, silky, fine-grained tannins and an enlivening spine of natural acidity. It concludes with a long, plush finish marked by a lingering trace of dark fruit, savory herbs, and refined wood oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rosemary-infused grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, gourmet blue cheese burgers, or mature extra-sharp white cheddar cheese.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This ripe Cabernet delivers focused aromas of blackberry, balsamic, black pepper, and cinnamon on the nose. The palate possesses tannic grip, juicy acid, and flavors of cassis, blueberry, plum, and chopped herb mélange through the finish.

kosta-browne-gaps-crown-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Gap's Crown Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020
kosta-browne-gaps-crown-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Bursting with fresh-picked blueberries, blackberries, baking spices, and lifted vanilla aromatics. An iconic palate with dark fruit flavors underscored by elongated velvety tannins. A finish with a wealth of energy, drive, and power.

94 Points - James Suckling

Lovely depth of fruit and beauty to this, with crushed-strawberry, hazelnut and floral undertones. Full and deep. White pepper and cloves at the end. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This versatile, well-balanced and attractive wine can be enjoyed now for its elegant, moderately tannic texture and fresh red- and black-cherry flavors, or saved for a future dinner party.

road-13-syrah.title: Road 13 Syrah 750ml
road-13-syrah.bodyHtml: Meaty, Game notes take center stage but the black cherry, cooking spices, and a subtle smokey oak play deliciously supporting roles. The full-bodied, balanced and elegant nature of this Syrah makes it both food-friendly and sip-sational.

freixenet-prosecco-doc-extra-dry.title: Freixenet Prosecco D.O.C. 200ml
freixenet-prosecco-doc-extra-dry.bodyHtml: This sparkling cuvee's fine bubbles are combined with a nose of peaches, ripe pears, flowers and nuances of tropical fruits. The palate is creamy yet sweet with a long finish, making it really easy to drink.

ardbeg-arrrrrrrdbeg.title: Ardbeg Trudernish 15 Year Old
ardbeg-arrrrrrrdbeg.bodyHtml:
Ardbeg Trudernish 15 Year Old is a core-range expression from the Ardbeg Distillery on the southern coast of Islay, named after the ancient settlement of Trudernish near Claggain Bay. Aged for 15 years in a combination of ex-bourbon, new charred oak, and Oloroso sherry casks, this single malt balances Ardbeg's signature potent peat smoke with creamy vanilla, fudge, dark chocolate, and subtle maritime complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked brisket, charred ribeye steak, dark chocolate fudge tarts, raw oysters on the half shell, and strong blue cheeses like Stilton or Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Straw gold in color with a rich, silky, and oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Soft waves of earthy peat and woodsmoke intertwined with melted vanilla ice cream, rich fudge sauce, soft pine, and damp forest floor.

Palate : Creamy and silky with dark liquorice, chocolate lime, a touch of herbal mint, soft orchard fruits, floral sweetness, and nuts coated in milk chocolate, all tied together by rich vanilla.

Finish : Long, soothing, and smoky with lingering notes of warm peat embers, vanilla pod, and toasted nuts.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of water to open up the delicate orchard fruits, vanilla cream, and smoke.

penfolds-bin-704-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Penfolds Bin 704 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
penfolds-bin-704-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 704 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a modern, beautifully sculpted, and sophisticated Napa Valley red wine that showcases classic Californian terroir interpreted through Penfolds’ historic winemaking lens. Named as a reverse mirror image of its Australian counterpart Bin 407, it represents a French oak-matured expression of pure Cabernet Sauvignon. In the glass, it reveals a dense ruby-purple hue with a brilliant crimson rim. The aromatic profile is rich and layered, presenting ripe blackcurrant, dark plum, glazed cherries, and blackberry compote, underscored by subtle notes of cocoa powder, bay leaf, cedarwood, and delicate French oak spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, supple, and focused, offering concentrated dark fruit balanced by lively, mouthwatering acidity, fine-grained graphite minerality, and polished, silky tannins that carry through to an expansive, enduring finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, rosemary garlic roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison medallions, and aged sharp cheddar.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Napa wine from the Australian-based producer over delivers on its price point, offering tremendous flavor, complexity and approachability in its youth. Expansive in dense black and red fruit, cocoa powder and silky tannin, it offers breadth and depth and is intensely compelling.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The fruit for the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Bin 704 is from across Napa Valley, and the classy fruit is shaped by French oak (40% new) and firm tannins through the finish. This is supple and sweet and shows blood plum, raspberry, red licorice and even cocoa. The wine is long and lingering and shapely. Sophisticated.

appelton-gift-pack.title: Destilatum Per Se Aperitivo Gift Pack with Glass
appelton-gift-pack.bodyHtml:
Per Se Aperitivo is presented by its producer, Casa Redondo, as the first fully Portuguese aperitivo, taking its cue from the sunset rituals of Lisbon and the pre-dinner culture of southern Europe. It is built on a blend of 24 botanicals, with cardamom, orange, allspice (Jamaican pepper) and Portuguese hops among them, and has a warm, bright orange colour. Orange zest and cardamom lead on the nose with peppery spice behind; the palate is light, sweet and easy, with citrus oils, a gentle spiciness and a soft texture, before a fresh citrus close and a measured bitterness. It is bottled at 14.5% ABV in a 700ml bottle, here in a gift pack that includes a glass.

Tasting Notes: Orange zest, cardamom, allspice, citrus oils and a light, refreshing bitterness.

Nose: Orange zest and cardamom with hints of allspice and hops.

Palate: Light and sweet, with citrus oils and gentle spice.

Finish: Fresh and citric with a moderate bitterness.

Serve: Over ice with a twist of orange peel, or lengthened with tonic water.

innis-gunn-gift-pack-2021-edition.title: Innis & Gunn Gift Pack 2021 Edition 4 Bottles

kraken-unknown-deep.title: The Kraken 'Unknown Deep' Black Spiced Rum
kraken-unknown-deep.bodyHtml: One of the fastest growing rum brands, The Kraken® is the world’s first black spiced rum, housed in an iconic bottle. Taste the flavors of cinnamon, vanilla, and nutmeg and experience its magic. The Kraken® Original is 94 proof. It has a distinct aroma of caramel, toffee and spice with flavors of cinnamon and vanilla and a lingering spicy finish. (47% ABV - 94 proof) The Kraken®, blended with secret spices, is perfect to spice up classics and new favorite cocktails or as a shot.

nikka-taketsuru-pure-malt-japanese-whisk.title: Nikka Taketsuru Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
