nikka-taketsuru-pure-malt-japanese-whisk.bodyHtml:
Nikka Taketsuru Pure Malt Japanese Whisky is a highly disciplined, deeply expressive, and award-winning blended malt created as a tribute to Masataka Taketsuru, the legendary father of Japanese whisky and the founder of Nikka. This expression is a masterful exercise in harmony, meticulously blending aged single malts from Nikka's two drastically contrasting northern distilleries: Yoichi on the coast of Hokkaido and Miyagikyo in the misty valleys of Sendai. By marrying the robust, coastal, and heavily peated style of Yoichi with the soft, elegant, fruity, and sherry-cask-influenced profile of Miyagikyo, Nikka's master blenders achieve a balanced spirit that mirrors the silky drinkability of a blended grain whisky while maintaining the intense richness of pure malt.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted pork loin accented by root vegetables, Cantonese dim sum, pan-seared duck breast with an orange glaze, teriyaki salmon, or high-quality dark chocolate bark.

Tasting Notes : Citron gold in appearance, offering a smooth, silky, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Complex and expressive with aromas of citrus, orange peel, juicy pear, sweet vanilla, cereal malt, and a delicate touch of peat smoke.

Palate : Round and delicate with notes of sweet spice, cardamom, candied fruits, honey, yuzu, and gentle toasted oak.

Finish : Smooth, long, and graceful with lingering notes of dark chocolate, gentle peat, sweet citrus, and soft oak spice.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of pure water to unlock the floral and citrus notes, or over a large ice sphere in traditional Japanese style.

glenmorangie-vintage-1995.title: Glenmorangie The Quinta Ruban 14 Year Old
glenmorangie-vintage-1995.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie 14 Year Old The Quinta Ruban is a bold and velvety single malt Scotch whisky that stands as a testament to the art of wood finishing. The spirit is first aged for 10 years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks to establish a foundation of smooth, creamy vanilla notes. It is then transferred into hand-selected ruby port pipes and casks from the renowned Quinta wine estates of Portugal for a further four years of finishing. This extensive secondary maturation transforms the whisky into a dark, decadent dram with aromas of mandarin orange, dark chocolate, mint, and a touch of nutmeg. On the palate, a thick, voluptuous texture unfolds with flavors of rich walnut, dark chocolate-covered berries, Turkish delight, and sweet wood spice. The finish is long, silky, and deeply satisfying, leaving behind lingering traces of dark chocolate and orange zest.

Food Pairing The dark chocolate and rich fruit notes of this port-finished expression make it an spectacular match for desserts like a flourless chocolate torte, raspberry tart, or dark chocolate mousse. It also pairs wonderfully with savory dishes such as pan-seared venison with a blackberry reduction, roasted lamb chops, or a plate of rich blue cheeses like Stilton or Roquefort.

nikka-yoichi-non-peated-limited-edition.title: Nikka Discovery Series Yoichi Non-Peated Single Malt Japanese Whisky 2021
nikka-yoichi-non-peated-limited-edition.bodyHtml:
Nikka Discovery Series Yoichi Non-Peated Single Malt Japanese Whisky 2021 is a limited-edition release showcasing a different side of Japan's renowned Yoichi Distillery. Introduced in 2021 as the first instalment of the Nikka Discovery Series, this expression is crafted entirely from unpeated malted barley, highlighting the distillery's fruit-forward character while retaining subtle smokiness from its traditional coal-fired pot stills. Bottled at 47% ABV, it delivers a rich, rounded mouthfeel with layers of orchard fruits, gentle sweetness, and warming spice.

Food Pairing: Grilled seafood, roasted pork, smoked salmon, aged cheddar, caramelized nuts, dark chocolate, and lightly spiced Japanese dishes.

Tasting Notes: A rich, fruit-forward Japanese single malt featuring fresh orchard fruits, honeyed malt, citrus, gentle spice, and subtle coal-fired smokiness.

Nose: Fresh pears, apples, orange peel, toasted barley, floral notes, and gentle oak.

Palate: Ripe orchard fruits, honey, caramel, sweet malt, vanilla, and warming white pepper, with a rounded texture.

Finish: Long and balanced, with lingering fruit sweetness, caramel, citrus zest, and delicate spice.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a tulip-shaped whisky glass. A few drops of water can help reveal additional fruit and malt aromas.

nikka-miyagikyo-peated-limited-edition.title: Nikka Miyagikyo Peated Limited Edition Japanese Whisky
nikka-miyagikyo-peated-limited-edition.bodyHtml:
Nikka Miyagikyo Peated Limited Edition is a distinctive Japanese single malt whisky released in 2021 as part of Nikka's Discovery series. Produced at the Miyagikyo Distillery in Miyagi Prefecture, this limited-edition expression explores a smoky side of a distillery traditionally celebrated for its elegant, fruity, and floral character. Crafted using peated malt, it offers a sophisticated balance of delicate smoke, orchard fruit, gentle sweetness, and warming spice.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, grilled scallops, roasted duck, miso-glazed pork, aged Gouda, and dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: A golden Japanese single malt with an elegant, aromatic profile combining soft peat smoke, ripe orchard fruit, delicate floral notes, and gentle spice.

Nose: Fragrant peat smoke opens alongside fresh apple, pear, citrus, and subtle herbal notes, complemented by a delicate floral sweetness.

Palate: Smooth and expressive, with layers of ripe fruit, honeyed sweetness, malt, and gentle oak spice balanced by refined, earthy peat smoke.

Finish: Long and gently warming, with lingering fruit sweetness, delicate smoke, and subtle spice.

Serve: Best enjoyed neat in a tulip-shaped whisky glass. Add a few drops of water to explore its aromatic complexity.

redbreast-27-year-old.title: Redbreast 27 Year Old Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
redbreast-27-year-old.bodyHtml:
Redbreast 27 Year Old

The oldest permanent release in the Redbreast family, 27-Year-Old is a Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey comprising exclusively of Pot Still whiskeys which have been triple distilled, matured in the finest bourbon, sherry and ruby port casks for no less than 27 years, and left untouched.

NOSE

A succulent medley of exotic fruits, mango, pineapple, blood orange and ripe red berries are complemented by fresh herbs, aromatic oils and wood spices. Vanilla sweetness and treacle toffee add to the richness, while walnuts and toasted oak acknowledge the contribution from a supreme cask selection.

TASTE

Incredibly rich in texture with a luxuriously fruity introduction. Ripe red fleshed plums, black cherries and summer berries are balanced by the prickle of a hint of chili oil. The taste evolves as cherry menthol introduces vanilla and cinnamon sweet spices combined with red pepper, nutmeg and toasted oak for an intriguing complexity.

FINISH

A satisfyingly long balance of ripe fruit and wood spices, worthy of a journey of nearly three decades.

91.79 Points on Whisky base.

textbook-cabernet-sauvignon.title: The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
textbook-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a luxurious, modern, and brilliantly textured expression that carries the bold and unrestricted winemaking philosophy of this iconic estate into a pure varietal focus. Sourced from premier vineyards across the valley, this vintage exhibits a deep magenta and purple-ruby core. On the nose, it offers an invitingly opulent bouquet of ripe black cherries, crème de cassis, and sweet blackberry pie, seamlessly layered with warm undertones of toasted vanilla bean, cinnamon bark, fresh coffee grounds, and hints of crushed wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is incredibly soft, plush, and full-bodied, delivering an expansive, fruit-forward mid-palate wrapped in supple, velvety tannins. Matured for 15 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels, its powerful dark fruit concentration remains beautifully balanced, showing remarkable structural harmony before concluding with a lengthy, decadent finish accented by a touch of holiday spice and subtle mineral depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with charcoal-grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-infused roasted lamb, or hunks of mature sharp white cheddar cheese.

blue-run-straight-rye-whiskey.title: Blue Run Kentucky Straight High Rye Bourbon
blue-run-straight-rye-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Blue Run Kentucky Straight High Rye Bourbon Whiskey is a high-proof Kentucky bourbon from Blue Run Spirits, its label marked with an iridescent butterfly and the words High Rye. It is bottled at 111 proof (55.5% ABV) in a 750ml bottle. It was the first Blue Run whiskey made with bourbon veteran Jim Rutledge as the contracted master distiller, and it came out as the company's second fall release. A bold, full-strength bourbon for drinkers who like the spice that a rye-heavy recipe brings.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water or a large ice cube.

pajaru-meridonale-tre-tenute.title: Tenuta del Pajaru Meridionale Tre Tenute Cuvee Privata 2019
pajaru-meridonale-tre-tenute.bodyHtml:
Tenuta del Pajaru Meridionale Tre Tenute Cuvée Privata 2019 is a rich, robust, and captivating southern Italian red blend that masterfully unites three iconic regional grape varieties: Montepulciano, Primitivo, and Nerello Mascalese. Sourced from the organic and sustainably farmed estate vineyards of Famiglia De Cerchio, this vegan-friendly wine reveals a deep ruby-red color with slow-running tears in the glass. The highly expressive, dextrous nose balances ripe aromas of blackcurrant, dark chocolate, and cherry confiture with complex undertones of clove, tobacco leaf, balsamic notes, and a touch of blood orange peel. On the palate, the wine is intense, warm, and full-bodied, delivering a remarkably plush and velvety texture. A concentrated core of jammy dark forest fruits is thrown into sharp relief by a bold blaze of cinnamon and black pepper, supported by textured, substantial tannins and a lifting wave of natural acidity that carries into a long, savory, and beautifully sustained finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with slow-braised wild boar ragù, charcoal-grilled game burgers, rosemary-crusted roasted rack of lamb, and mature cheeses like aged Gouda.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A dexterous nose balances a tart, almost spicy quality drawn from aromas of blackberry, clove and blood orange peel with the fresh but substantial presence of crushed stone and warm earth. On the palate, a blaze of cinnamon and black pepper throws the blackberry, clove and citrus notes into sharp relief, while waves of acid crash against textured, substantial tannins. A very good value.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas and flavors of cherry-based confiture with hints of balsamic and cigar box. Full-bodied with the same savory tones dominating the palate. The tannins are fine and are sinking into the wine. Long, tasty finish. Montepulciano, primitivo and nerello mascalese. From organically grown grapes. Vegan. Sustainable. Enticing, if a little wild at present, this should calm down with a year or two in bottle. Try from 2024.

pajaru-picuraru-primitivo.title: Tenuta del Pajaru Picuraru Primitivo 2024
pajaru-picuraru-primitivo.bodyHtml:
Tenuta del Pajaru Picuraru Primitivo 2024 is a bold, velvety, and deeply expressive organic Italian red wine that brilliantly captures the sun-drenched, rustic soul of southern Italy. Named in honor of the traditional Puglian shepherds (Picuraru in the local dialect) and their timeless dedication to the land, this wine pours a majestic, dense ruby-red color with intense dark reflections. The nose opens with an alluring, highly concentrated bouquet of sweet plum, ripe black cherries, and wild blackberry jam, elegantly interwoven with complex undertones of dark cocoa, warm leather, and crushed black pepper. On the palate, this full-bodied powerhouse is remarkably warm and supple, wrapping a lush, fruit-forward core in fine-grained, satisfying tannins. Aged in a blend of French and Slavonian oak barrels, its rich layers of black chocolate and dark currant are masterfully balanced by a fresh wave of natural acidity, driving through to a long, persistent, and beautifully structured finish.

Food Pairing: This robust red pairs excellently with hearty slow-cooked meals such as wild boar ragù over fresh pasta, barbecued ribs, grilled lamb chops with rosemary, savory lentil soups with pancetta, or aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano and sharp Provolone.

90 Points - James Suckling

Bright fruit, black cherry and jam aromas. Medium- to full-bodied with moderate and lively acidity, sweet cherry flavors, lean tannins and a chalky finish. From organically grown grapes. Vegan. Drink now.

dom-perignon-rose-1.title: Dom Perignon Rose 2006 1.5L Magnum
dom-perignon-rose-1.bodyHtml:
The bouquet is mesmerizing, ripe, and complex. The opening notes are a blend of dark spices and cocoa which develop very quickly into fruit aromas. Fruit reigns supreme, with roasted fig and apricot and candied orange. The overall effect exudes smoky accents. On the palate, the fullness of the wine is immediately striking. Its intensity and succulence set the tone through the sweetness and crisp punch of the flavors. The silky mouthfeel melts into a smooth, tight, and grainy structure with just a hint of vegetable flavors. The wine expresses an appealing brininess and saline character.

Rosé Vintage 2006 demands a simple cuisine, modest, pure, authentic, a traditional cuisine from southern europe, originating from Italy, Spain or France. One can play on mellow and rich textures which the wine integrates perfectly.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This graceful 2006 shows lovely freshness, featuring a pronounced note of pink grapefruit granita layered with finely detailed accents of toasted nut, lemon thyme, smoky mineral and crystallized honey. Plushly creamy in texture, with a steely streak of acidity well-knit throughout and firming the lasting, spiced finish. Drink now through 2029.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2006 Dom Pérignon Rosé continues to show very well, unfurling in the glass with aromas of bitter orange, dried white flowers, red berries, toast and woodsmoke. On the palate, it's full-bodied, broad and muscular, with all the phenolic structure and depth that one would expect from a rosé that contains more than 20% still red wine, concluding with a sapid and chalky finish. As I wrote earlier this year, this is a vinous, gastronomic rosé that numbers among the decided successes of the 2006 vintage.

95 Points - James Suckling

Loads of complexity on offer here, from brioche to dried peaches to strawberries and cream and on to rhubarb fool, pomegranate pastries and bread crumbs. The mousse is wonderfully integrated to the edgy peaches and notes that feather the finest line between oxidation and reduction. Very layered and linear, this is an incredibly long and mind-bending Champagne.

henkell-rose-piccolo.title: Henkell Trocken Rose Piccolo 3 x 200ml
henkell-rose-piccolo.bodyHtml: This pale pink sparkler is sure to delight. Slightly off-dry, with a refreshing bubble structure, this German bubbly is highlighted by aromas and flavours of ripe red berry, vibrant citrus and subtle hints of chocolate. It's perfect as an aperitif or paired with lightly-sweet desserts or salty snacks.

segura-viudas-reserva-heredad.title: Segura Viudas Cava Reserva Heredad Brut 750ml
segura-viudas-reserva-heredad.bodyHtml:
The Segura Viudas Reserva Heredad Cava Brut has lightly smoky opening aromas with touches of biscuit and hints of honey and flower petals. The palate is excellent, fruity, and full of flavor, delivering a delightful sense of abundance.


94 Points by Tasting Panel

Aromas of brioche and lemon verbena intertwined with brine, tarragon, and honeysuckle keep you enthralled before the first sip. Persistent bubbles pave the way for a parade of florals and light, airy flavors touched with smoke. Minerality ensues on the mid-palate, where it’s joined by notes of bread dough, lemon, lime chiffon, and vanilla.

92 Points by Wine & Spirits
A selection of macabeo and parellada grown at estate vineyards in the Alt Penedès, Reserva Heredad is a complex and heady Cava that delivers on its richness without sweetness. Its potent depth of flavor has a smoky minerality and fresh apple-skin notes. This is full and meaty enough to serve with roast chicken or albóndigas de ternera (veal meatballs).
92 Points by Wilfred Wong of Wine.com
COMMENTARY: The Segura Viudas Brut Reserva Heredad Cava is bright, attractive, and lively. TASTING NOTES: This wine offers pleasing aromas of green apple and dried earth. Enjoy it with grilled shellfish. (Tasted: December 31, 2020, San Francisco, CA)

segura-viudas-brut-rose.title: Segura Viudas Cava Brut Rosado 750ml
segura-viudas-brut-rose.bodyHtml: Segura Viudas Cava Brut Rosado is a Spanish sparkling wine known for its bright, strawberry pink color and refreshing, fruity character. It features a fine, abundant mousse and aromas of strawberry, redcurrant, and grenadine, with flavors of cherry and a light acidity. The wine is described as delicate, crisp, and balanced, making it a very drinkable option.

henkell-blanc-de-blanc.title: Henkell Trocken Blanc de Blanc 750ml
henkell-blanc-de-blanc.bodyHtml: Henkell Trocken Blanc de Blancs is a dry, German sparkling wine produced using the Charmat method. It is a cuvée of selected white grapes, including Chardonnay, known for its delicate yellow color and aromas of ripe apples and pears. The wine offers a fresh, creamy, and powerful taste with a lingering finish.

black-fox-gin-3.title: Black Fox Canadian Dry Gin
black-fox-gin-3.bodyHtml:
Black Fox Farm & Distillery Canadian Dry Gin (also widely known as Gin #3) is an award-winning, farm-to-bottle craft spirit produced in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. Made with estate-grown triticale grain—a unique, hardy wheat and rye hybrid—this gin is infused with 15 carefully curated botanicals, including locally grown calendula flower, rhubarb, and native Canadian juniper. It offers a stunningly fresh, crisp, and robust northern terroir profile that sits comfortably between a traditional juniper-forward London Dry and a modern, citrusy botanical gin.

Food Pairing: Freshly shucked oysters with a squeeze of lemon, smoked salmon crostini with dill, grilled asparagus, or light artisanal goat cheeses.

TASTING NOTES - Crystal clear and perfectly transparent. It has a clean, crisp, and medium-to-full body with a remarkably smooth, slightly creamy mouthfeel.

NOSE - A vibrant opening of earthy juniper, damp forest floor, and zesty citrus peel, balanced by delicate floral notes of wild calendula and a sweet, subtle hint of tart rhubarb.

PALATE - Bold and complex on the tongue, showing sweet grain sugars from the triticale base paired with a burst of piney juniper, warm ginger spice, sweet citrus rind, and faint herbal undertones.

FINISH - Clean, medium-to-long, and highly refreshing, leaving a crisp trail of citrus oils, cooling juniper pine, and a lingering touch of warming black pepper.

SERVE - Excellent served in a classic, premium Gin & Tonic garnished with a wedge of pink grapefruit and a sprig of fresh rosemary, or stirred cold into an elegant dry Martini.

bollicini-sparkling-cuvee.title: Bollicini Sparkling Cuvee 4 x 250ml
bollicini-sparkling-cuvee.bodyHtml:
Bollicini Sparkling Cuvee is a refreshing and elegant sparkling wine presented in convenient 250ml bottles, perfect for individual servings or sharing with friends. This sparkling cuvée is crafted with care to offer a delightful bubbly experience.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Light, pale gold with a delicate effervescence.

  • Aromas: Fresh and fruity, with notes of green apple, citrus, and a hint of floral undertones.

  • Palate: Crisp and well-balanced, with a refreshing burst of citrus zest and apple flavors, complemented by a smooth finish.

Wine Profile:

  • Region: Italy

  • Type: Sparkling Cuvée

  • Alcohol: Approx. 11%

  • Bottle Size: 4 x 250ml

Food Pairing:

Ideal as an aperitif or with light appetizers, seafood, and fresh cheeses. It also pairs well with light salads or fried foods.

Bollicini Sparkling Cuvee is an excellent choice for those looking for an easy-to-enjoy, bubbly experience, perfect for casual gatherings, celebrations, or anytime you desire a refreshing sparkling wine.

segura-viudas-organic-brut.title: Segura Viudas Brut
segura-viudas-organic-brut.bodyHtml:
This classic Cava offers aromas of green apple, lemon zest, white flowers, and toasted brioche. Fine, persistent bubbles accompany a crisp palate with lively acidity, creamy texture, and delicate citrus flavors, finishing dry, elegant, and refreshingly balanced.

Food Pairing: Oysters, shellfish, sushi, grilled seafood, fried appetizers, soft cheeses, cured ham, and festive aperitifs.

mionetto-prestige-prosecco-rose-doc.title: Mionetto Prestige Prosecco Rose 750ml
mionetto-prestige-prosecco-rose-doc.bodyHtml: This refined sparkling extra dry rosé is obtained through soft pressing of the grapes which have been left to macerate for a few hours to give this cuvée its brilliant “peach blossom” pink hue. Fragrant nose featuring raspberry, cherry and wild strawberry and ahint of violet on the finish. Well-balanced acidity with notes of red raspberry and strawberry and a fine persistent perlage.

highland-park-cask-strength-no-2.title: Highland Park Cask Strength Release No. 2
highland-park-cask-strength-no-2.bodyHtml:
The clue is in the name really. Cask Strength Release No. 2 is bottled straight from the cask, without adding water to reduce alcohol content, to deliver an extraordinary depth, complexity and balance of flavours.

Casks have a huge influence on the flavour, character and natural colour of our whisky as it matures, so our Cask Strength series presents our whisky in its purest form, giving you the freedom to enjoy our whisky, your way. Discover the taste and strength that suits your palate by experimenting with the amount of water you add to reach your optimum flavour.

For this second release in the Cask Strength series, Gordon Motion, our Master Whisky Maker, selected mainly sherry seasoned European and American oak casks, along with just a few ex-bourbon casks. You’ll find aromas of summer rose, ripe pear and fresh coconut gathering on a wave of aromatic peat smoke, followed by a wild harmony of sweet and spicy flavours - poached pear and rich almond cake, a drizzle of cloudy honey and a twist of salty liquorice. There’s the suggestion of toasted oak and intriguing notes of orchard fruits, black pepper and sweet aniseed linger, in a satisfyingly long finish. In a word (or three) we call it ‘smoky peppered praline’

little-book-v-the-invitation.title: Little Book Chapter 5 The Invitation
little-book-v-the-invitation.bodyHtml:
Little Book Chapter 5 "The Invitation" is the 2021 release in the Little Book series from Freddie Noe, eighth-generation Beam family distiller. It is a blend of four straight whiskey streams covering a wide range of ages, flavours and distillation styles, three of which were distilled under Freddie's own watch. A 2 year old bourbon forms the base of the blend, which Freddie describes as one of the more difficult chapters to balance. The name is an invitation to both seasoned whiskey drinkers and newcomers to explore cask strength whiskey. It is bottled at 58.4% ABV (116.8 proof) in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Butterscotch, toasted bread and brown sugar with gentle smoke.

Nose: A complex mix of oak, caramel and subtle smoke.

Palate: Butterscotch and toasted bread with brown sugar undertones and a touch of sweetness.

Finish: A light, lingering warmth with smoked vanilla.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

oban-distillers-edition.title: Oban 14 Year Old
oban-distillers-edition.bodyHtml:
Oban 14 Year Old is a classic coastal single malt Scotch whisky produced at the historic Oban Distillery in the West Highlands of Scotland. Distilled using traditional copper pot stills and copper worm tubs, then aged in oak casks, it perfectly bridges the gap between light, fruity Highland malts and smoky, briny maritime whiskies.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, fresh oysters, grilled sea bass, roasted duck, or dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber with a smooth, medium-bodied, and slightly oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh sea salt, citrus peel, orange zest, dried figs, honey, and a soft waft of peat smoke.

Palate : Full-bodied and balanced with notes of sweet malted barley, orange, dried fruits, honey, soft oak spice, and subtle maritime salinity.

Finish : Long, warming, and clean with lingering notes of oak, baking spice, citrus zest, and delicate peat smoke.

Serve : Serve neat, with a few drops of water, or over a large ice cube.

talisker-distillers-edition.title: Talisker Distillers Edition
talisker-distillers-edition.bodyHtml:
Talisker Distillers Edition is a double-matured version of the single malt from Talisker, the oldest working distillery on the Isle of Skye, founded in 1830 by the brothers Hugh and Kenneth MacAskill. After its main maturation the whisky is finished in casks seasoned with Amoroso sherry, whose sweetness rounds off and tempers the distillery's robust maritime character. When the still house was destroyed by fire in 1960, Talisker rebuilt it with exact replicas of the old stills, keeping the U-shaped lyne pipes and traditional worm-tub cooling that still shape the spirit's texture. Bottled at 45.8% ABV in a 750ml bottle, the Distillers Edition is released in vintage-dated batches, so the distillation and bottling years printed on the label change from one release to the next.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

bushmills-10-year-old-cognac-finish.title: Bushmills 10 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bushmills-10-year-old-cognac-finish.bodyHtml: The Bushmills 10 Year Old is a marriage of single malts matured for at least 10 years in hand-selected bourbon barrels and sherry butts. Zesty and fresh on the nose, followed by notes of ripe fruit, creamy vanilla and soft toasted wood.

jaboulet-hermitage-la-chapelle-2017.title: Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aine Hermitage La Chapelle Rouge 2019
jaboulet-hermitage-la-chapelle-2017.bodyHtml:
Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aîné Hermitage La Chapelle Rouge 2019 is a legendary, monumental Northern Rhône red wine crafted from 100% Syrah sourced from old vines on the iconic slopes of Hermitage Hill, particularly the prized parcels of Les Bessards and Le Méal. Organically and biodynamically farmed, this exceptional vintage exhibits an opaque purple-ruby color. The deeply complex aromatic profile bursts with intense notes of crushed blackberries, crème de cassis, violet pastilles, and black olives, layered with nuanced undertones of roasted meats, espresso, licorice, and a profound, smoky graphite minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, concentrated, and muscular, yet it displays remarkable poise and weightless elegance. A dense, tightly wound core of pure dark fruit is masterfully framed by firm, fine-grained tannins and a crisp natural acidity, culminating in a spectacular, long, and savory finish showing notes of cracked pepper and salted licorice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted rack of lamb, thick-cut grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised venison stew, and wild mushroom risotto.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Last year, I giddily speculated whether the 2019 Hermitage La Chapelle would warrant a 100-point score. While close—and I wouldn't completely discount it reaching that pinnacle in another decade or two—I'm not sure this wine is as good as I thought. It boasts exciting aromas of roasted meat, mocha, crushed stone, plum and cassis on the nose. It's full-bodied, concentrated, richly tannic and velvety in texture. It's long and complex on the finish, adding hints of cracked pepper and salted licorice. And yet, as much as I enjoyed tasting it and as undeniably great it is, angels didn't sing from the heavens. Maybe next bottle. Best after 2025.

95 Points - James Suckling

A big, rich wine with intense fruit, showing blackberry, black olive and black truffle character. Full-bodied and layered with chewy tannins that are soft and juicy. It’s a little warm on the finish. Yet, the decadence is so attractive and the phenolics keep it in line. This is very solid.

pio-nebbiolo.title: Pio Cesare Langhe Nebbiolo 2022
pio-nebbiolo.bodyHtml:
Pio Cesare Langhe Nebbiolo 2022 is a refined, energetic, and wonderfully expressive Italian red wine that offers a brilliant, highly accessible introduction to the noble grape of Piedmont. Sourced from choice family-owned vineyards—including prestigious plots within the Barolo region at Serralunga d'Alba and the Barbaresco region at Treiso—this "baby Barolo" is crafted to highlight the variety's vibrant fruit and fragrance at an earlier stage in its life. In the glass, it pours a translucent ruby color with delicate garnet reflections. The nose is highly aromatic and classic, opening with a bouquet of fresh red cherries, wild raspberries, and crushed rose petals, layered with hints of dried herbs, white pepper, and dark tobacco. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied selection features a rich and ripe fruit core balanced beautifully by a lively, crunchy acidity. Aged for up to 24 months in large French oak casks with a small portion in barriques, its firm, traditional Nebbiolo structure is smoothed out by gentle, sweet tannins, leading to a clean, savory, and remarkably persistent finish.

Food Pairing: This food-friendly and structured red pairs excellently with roasted veal, lamb chops with rosemary, pasta with wild mushroom sauce, duck confit, or semi-firm cheeses like Fontina and young Pecorino.

waterkloof-circumstance-cabernet-franc.title: Waterkloof Circumstance Cabernet Franc 2018 750ml
waterkloof-circumstance-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml:
South Africa’s most famous wine-producing district, Stellenbosch, surrounds the historic town with the same name; fine winemaking here dates back to the late 1600s. Its valleys of granite, sandstone and alluvial loam soils between the towering blue-grey mountains of Stellenbosch, Simonsberg and Helderberg have the capacity to produce beautiful wines from many varieties. The climate is warm Mediterranean, tempered by the cool Atlantic air of nearby False Bay.

Perhaps most well-known for its Pinotage and Bordeaux blends, Stellenbosch also produces noteworthy wines from Syrah, Chenin blanc, Chardonnay and Sauvignon blanc. The district’s wards—Banghoek, Bottelary, Devon Valley, Jonkershoek Valley, Papegaaiberg, Polkadraai Hills and Simonsberg-Stellenbosch—all produce distinctive wines from vines with relatively low yields.

travaglini-gattinara-docg.title: Travaglini Gattinara 2021
travaglini-gattinara-docg.bodyHtml:
A sophisticated and high-toned expression of Alto Piemonte, the 2021 Travaglini Gattinara reflects the unique volcanic terroir of the Monte Rosa foothills. This 100% Nebbiolo pours a deep ruby red with elegant garnet reflections. The nose is complex and inviting, offering a bouquet of wild strawberries, crushed raspberries, and rose petals, layered with savory notes of leather, licorice, and a distinct iron-tinged minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and impeccably balanced, showcasing the characteristic "vertical" structure of the region with racy acidity and firm, noble tannins. Nuances of spice, balsamic herbs, and stony undertones lead to a long, precise finish. Having aged for approximately 30 months in large Slavonian oak barrels, it offers both immediate appeal and excellent cellaring potential.

96 Points - James Suckling

A restrained and smoky wine with a lot of freshness, showing aromas of potpourri, wild strawberries, citrus leaves and stony minerality. Full-bodied, it shows the firmness of nebbiolo well balanced by fruit concentration, refreshing acidity and a savory finish. Precise and balanced. Drinkable now, but best from 2026.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Vanilla, Bourbon and toasty oak accents frame cherry and strawberry flavors in this racy red. Underscored by eucalyptus and mineral notes, ending with a grip of chewy tannins. Give this time to absorb the oak. Best from 2027 through 2038.

stanley-park-trail-hopper-ipa.title: Stanley Park Trail Hopper Ipa 6 Cans

banded-oeak-microburst-hazy-ipa.title: Banded Peak Microburst Hazy IPA 4 Tall Cans
banded-oeak-microburst-hazy-ipa.bodyHtml: A Microburst is an intense small-scale downdraft produced by a thunderstorm. With the help of science we have created a new iteration of microburst: a powerful deluge of flavour  from new world hops that cascades your olfactory senses with tropical juiciness. The Microburst Hazy IPA will be gone as quickly as it arrived

banded-peak-mount-crushmore.title: Banded Peak Mount Crushmore 4 Tall Cans
banded-peak-mount-crushmore.bodyHtml: Welcome to the beer version of spring skiing. Mount Crushmore is audacious like wearing a vintage one-piece snowsuit with fluorescent racing stripes, effervescent like champagne powder and eminently crushable like hard-charging fresh tracks at the local hill on a sun drenched weekday morning. Fermented cold and conditioned for guaranteed crispiness. You have arrived at the pinnacle of pilsner

mangaroca-batida-de-coco.title: Mangaroca Batida De Coco
mangaroca-batida-de-coco.bodyHtml:
Mangaroca Batida de Côco is a creamy coconut liqueur made to a traditional Brazilian recipe and bottled at 16% ABV in a 750 ml bottle. From Henkell Freixenet, it is the leading coconut liqueur in Germany and carries the brand's long-running tagline, 'The Kiss of the Coconut'. The milky-white liqueur is sweet and coconut-forward, and it contains milk, so it is not suitable for anyone avoiding dairy. It is at its best served well chilled over ice, lengthened with fruit juice as a long drink, or used as the base for tropical cocktails.

Serve: Chilled over ice, topped up with pineapple or other fruit juice, or in exotic cocktails.

stanley-park-concession-mixer.title: Stanley Park Concession Mixer 12 Cans
stanley-park-concession-mixer.bodyHtml: The Stanley Park Concession Stand Mix Pack is a diverse, refreshing collection of easy-drinking beers inspired by the iconic concession stands of Vancouver’s Stanley Park. This 12-can variety pack typically features three cans each of four different fruit-forward or crisp styles, such as Sunsetter Peach Wheat Ale, Waypoint Hazy Pale Ale, Trail Hopper IPA, and Electro Lager. It is designed for high drinkability and social outdoor occasions, offering a balanced range from citrusy and tart to clean and malty.

banded-peak-plainsbreaker.title: Banded Peak Plainsbreaker 4 Tall Cans
banded-peak-plainsbreaker.bodyHtml: An aromatic, style bending approach to the pale ale. The Plainsbreaker is bursting with late addition hops, boasting a huge tropical flavour and aroma. Well balanced, interesting and very approachable, this beer is for every adventure

banded-peak-varity-pack.title: Banded Peak Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans

santa-carolina-reserva-de-familia-cabern.title: Santa Carolina Reserva De Familia Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
santa-carolina-reserva-de-familia-cabern.bodyHtml: Santa Carolina Reserva de Familia Cabernet Sauvignon is a Chilean Cabernet Sauvignon known for its rich, full-bodied character, with notes of ripe fruit, spice, and oak. It features a deep ruby red color and a palate with round, velvety tannins and a long, elegant finish.

drouhin-laroze-clos-de-beze-grand-cru.title: Drouhin-Laroze Chambertin-Clos De Beze Grand Cru 2020 / 2021
drouhin-laroze-clos-de-beze-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
The Chambertin Clos de Bèze displays an intense purple color with aromas of small red fruits and liquorice, offering a majestic and expressive bouquet. On the palate, it is balanced, clear, and rich, with melted, spicy, and precise tannins that provide roundness and a light, elegant finish accented by a hint of rose. This wine benefits from aging and pairs beautifully with rabbit in mustard sauce, moussaka, or ripened cheeses such as Morbier.

 

2020 Vintage Ratings

95 Points - Vinous

The 2020 Chambertin Clos-de-Bèze Grand Cru has a very elegant bouquet with Earl Grey tinged red fruit. Wonderful composure here and very focused. The palate is medium-bodied with supple tannins, vibrant and fresh with a dash of black pepper towards the finish. This is superb.

2021 Vintage Ratings

92 Points - Vinous

The 2021 Chambertin Clos-de-Bèze Grand Cru has noticeable menthol scents on the nose, not as strong as some of the other '21s in the tasting, yet it lurks behind the attractive red berry fruit and briar scents. The palate is ripe and sweet on the entry with that menthol note becoming more prominent. Fine definition, a little chewy and spicy towards the finish. It just misses a bit of grace and elegance, though that might well manifest with bottle age, during which I hope it dispenses with that incongruous menthol aroma.

drouhin-laroze-clos-vougeot-grand-cru.title: Drouhin-Laroze Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru 2020 / 2021
drouhin-laroze-clos-vougeot-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
The Domaine's Grands Crus are matured in oak barrels, 80% of which are new and crafted from wood sourced from the Allier and Nivernais regions, with light to medium-plus toasts used to ensure harmony between the wine and wood tannins. When young, the wine shows a raspberry red to deep garnet color, with a full-bodied bouquet reminiscent of black fruit, licorice, spices, and hints of wood and leather. On the palate, melted oak gently frames aromas of black fruit, truffle, anise, and cherry, while the intense, powerful, and precise tannins carry through a long, unctuous finish. This Grand Cru has been described by Camille Rodier as "a grave and wonderful thing, powerful and free of torment." It pairs beautifully with risotto with truffles or a thick steak with pepper sauce.

2021 Vintage Ratings

93 Points - Vinous

The 2021 Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru has a classy bouquet with slightly darker fruit, fine mineralité and impressive delineation. There is real "thrust" to these aromatics, though they remain quite primal. The palate is medium-bodied with rounded tannins that lend a more creamy texture. It feels just a little "worked" in the winery and as such loses some of the detail expressed by the nose, although there is decent substance and it should repay time in bottle.

drouhin-laroze-bonnes-mares-grand-cru.title: Drouhin-Laroze Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru 2020 / 2021
drouhin-laroze-bonnes-mares-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
The Domaine's Grands Crus are matured in oak barrels, 80% of which are new and crafted from wood sourced from the Allier and Nivernais regions, with light to medium-plus toasts used to ensure harmony between the wine and wood tannins. When young, the wine shows a raspberry red to deep garnet color, with a full-bodied bouquet reminiscent of black fruit, licorice, spices, and hints of wood and leather. On the palate, melted oak gently frames aromas of black fruit, truffle, anise, and cherry, while the intense, powerful, and precise tannins carry through a long, unctuous finish. This Grand Cru has been described by Camille Rodier as "a grave and wonderful thing, powerful and free of torment." It pairs beautifully with risotto with truffles or a thick steak with pepper sauce.

2021 Vintage Ratings

93 Points - Vinous

The 2021 Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru has a classy bouquet with slightly darker fruit, fine mineralité and impressive delineation. There is real "thrust" to these aromatics, though they remain quite primal. The palate is medium-bodied with rounded tannins that lend a more creamy texture. It feels just a little "worked" in the winery and as such loses some of the detail expressed by the nose, although there is decent substance and it should repay time in bottle.

clase-azul-reposado-1.title: Clase Azul Reposado Tequila 375ml
clase-azul-reposado-1.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila made from 100% Blue Weber Agave, harvested in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Cooked slowly in traditional brick ovens and distilled twice in copper pot stills, it is aged for eight months in American whiskey casks. This aging process imparts a silky texture, rich hazelnut and vanilla flavors, and a smooth profile. Encased in Clase Azul's iconic, hand-painted ceramic decanter featuring cobalt blue feather designs, it stands as an international symbol of luxury and Mexican craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-cooked pork carnitas, grilled ribeye steak, aged cheeses such as Manchego, mole poblano, dark chocolate desserts, or vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Intense amber color with copper highlights and a smooth, rich, medium-to-full body with a silky mouthfeel.

Nose : Agave nectar, vanilla, candied orange peel, toasted oak, hazelnut, and subtle hints of cinnamon.

Palate : Smooth and complex with rich flavors of cooked agave, toasted oak, vanilla, clove, hazelnut, and soft caramel.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant finish with lingering notes of sweet agave, vanilla, toasted wood, and gentle baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip-shaped glass or Tequila Riedel glass to fully appreciate its aromas and flavor profile.

inverroche-gin-amber.title: Empress 1908 Indigo Gin
inverroche-gin-amber.bodyHtml:
Empress 1908 Indigo Gin is a visually stunning and contemporary spirit, handcrafted in small batch copper pot stills and famous for its vibrant all-natural indigo hue. Infused with a unique blend of eight botanicals—including juniper, grapefruit peel, coriander, ginger, cinnamon, and a signature blend of black tea—its striking color comes entirely from the butterfly pea blossom. On the nose, it offers a bright, aromatic bouquet of soft citrus and earthy florals. The palate is elegant and crisp, delivering a delicate balance of traditional piney juniper, warm baking spices, and a subtle herbal sweetness. When mixed with tonic or citrus, the gin magically transforms from deep indigo to a soft, beautiful pink, making it as captivating to look at as it is to drink.

Food Pairing: The bright citrus and delicate floral profile of this gin make it a perfect match for light, fresh seafood like a classic shrimp cocktail, crab cakes, or a plate of fresh sushi and sashimi. It also pairs wonderfully with soft, creamy cheeses like brie or goat cheese served alongside fresh berries and artisanal crackers.

drouhin-laroze-gevrey-chambertin.title: Drouhin-Laroze Gevrey-Chambertin Dix Climats 2020 / 2021
drouhin-laroze-gevrey-chambertin.bodyHtml: The Gevrey-Chambertin is matured in oak barrels previously used for one wine and crafted from wood from the Allier and Nivernais regions with medium to medium-plus toasts, and it shows a fine color and texture while offering a palate marked by freshness, a delicate body, and subtle woody notes, with tannins that are seamlessly integrated into a tender, silky texture that enhances its aromatic refinement and subtlety, making it an excellent match for Époisses pie or beef fondue.

drouhin-laroze-morey-st-denis-1er-cru.title: Domaine Drouhin-Laroze Morey-Saint-Denis Tres Girard 2020
drouhin-laroze-morey-st-denis-1er-cru.bodyHtml:
Domaine Drouhin-Laroze Morey-Saint-Denis Très Girard 2020 is an elegant red Burgundy from the Côte de Nuits in France. Produced from 100% Pinot Noir grown in a small parcel planted in 1946, this village-level wine captures the finesse of the En Très Girard vineyard. Whole-cluster fermentation contributes floral complexity, vibrant raspberry and strawberry aromas, and delicate peppery spice. Matured in French oak, the 2020 vintage offers supple tannins, refreshing acidity, and a beautifully balanced palate, finishing with lingering red fruit and subtle earthy notes.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, herb-crusted lamb, mushroom risotto, roasted poultry, charcuterie, turkey with chestnuts, and aged Ossau-Iraty cheese.

drouhin-laroze-gevrey-chambertin-lavaux.title: Drouhin-Laroze Gevrey-Chambertin Lavaut St Jacques Premier Cru 2020 / 2021
drouhin-laroze-gevrey-chambertin-lavaux.bodyHtml:
Domaine Drouhin-Laroze Gevrey-Chambertin Premier Cru Lavaut-Saint-Jacques 2020 / 2021 is an elegant, terroir-driven red Burgundy from the prestigious Côte de Nuits. Produced from Pinot Noir grown in the historic Lavaut-Saint-Jacques Premier Cru vineyard, this refined wine offers aromas of wild cherry, raspberry, violet, and forest floor. French oak maturation contributes subtle spice and structure, while vibrant acidity and finely textured tannins create a beautifully balanced palate. Both vintages offer excellent complexity, depth, and ageing potential.

Food Pairing: Roast duck, beef bourguignon, grilled lamb, mushroom risotto, roasted pheasant, aged Comté, and herb-roasted pork.

amahagan-no-2-red-wine-wood-finish.title: Amahagan World Malt Edition No. 2 Red Wine Wood Finish
amahagan-no-2-red-wine-wood-finish.bodyHtml:
From Nagahama, one of Japan’s newest and smallest distilleries, this world blended whisky was given a finishing period in a red-wine cask that helps to bring a really delicious array of aromas and flavors to your nose and palate. A member of a three bottle series, one of which won a World Whiskies Award, this is a really fine expression that allows you to explore what is possible in the World Blended Whisky category.

Crossing wine aroma and malt sweetness. Based on Edition No. 1, we took on the challenge of ripening after taking advantage of the individuality of red wine cask flavours, and the outcome was outstanding! The appearance is a reddish and glossy brick colour. The flavour derived from red wine such as raisins and berries and the malty peculiar to Nagahama are in perfect harmony, and you can feel the refreshing orange peel afterwards. In the mouth, the unique sweetness of the grain spreads throughout, but the moderate astringency tightens the whole. Deep, integrated and complex. The color is reddish and glossy brick. The flavor from red wines such as raisins and berries is in perfect harmony with the unique malt flavour of Nagahama. A refreshing aftertaste of orange peel can be enjoyed. The sweetness of grain carries through the finish with a long, moderate astringent taste. The flavors linger long after the sip.

tamdhu-15-year-old.title: Tamdhu 15 Year Old
tamdhu-15-year-old.bodyHtml:
Tamdhu 15 Year Old is a magnificent and highly acclaimed Speyside single malt Scotch whisky that showcases the distillery's absolute dedication to traditional Sherry cask maturation. Following in the footsteps of their core expressions, this award-winning whisky is matured for a full fifteen years exclusively in the finest hand-selected American and European oak ex-Oloroso Sherry casks imported from Spain. This patient aging process yields a deeply complex dram with a spectacular natural amber hue. It delivers a rich, decadent profile where intense dried fruit flavors seamlessly harmonize with warming baking spices, embodying the classic, unpeated Sherry-bomb style for which Tamdhu is world-renowned.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with slow-roasted venison, rich dark chocolate truffles, artisanal fig cake, or mature cheeses like aged Manchego.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper amber hue with a rich, velvety, and full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Apple pastry, spiced currants, fresh oak, dark plum, sweet vanilla, and aromatic orange zest.

Palate : Rich and complex with juicy dried fruits, dark chocolate, apricot, warm cinnamon, nutmeg, and polished oak.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet sherry, dried fruit, dark cocoa, and lingering baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

smokehead-sherry-bomb.title: Smokehead Sherry Bomb Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
smokehead-sherry-bomb.bodyHtml:
Smokehead Sherry Cask Blast is a peaty Islay single malt that has well and truly earned its name. Blasted by rich, sweet and spicy Spanish sherry casks, it has emerged as fiery, explosive, heavy hitting dram that has even turned our skull red.

It might well be the exact, highly unusual taste you’ve been waiting for. It might be a cannonball careering towards you that you’re keen to avoid. Either way, we’ve taken our ‘brilliant rebellious’ mantra to a whole new level.

laphroaig-10-year-original-cask-o13-batc.title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 13
laphroaig-10-year-original-cask-o13-batc.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 13 is the thirteenth batch of the Islay distillery's Original Cask Strength, bottled in January 2021. Aged for ten years in charred ex-bourbon barrels, it is barrier-filtered only to remove char particles and bottled directly from the barrel at 57.9% ABV, in a 750ml bottle. Neat, it opens with pipe tobacco, leather and vanilla, while fudge, cinnamon and toffee fill the palate; a little water draws out sea salt and peat smoke.

Tasting Notes: Tawny colour; pipe tobacco, leather, vanilla, fudge, cinnamon, toffee, sea salt and peat smoke.

Nose: Sweet cereals, fresh oak and pipe tobacco, with leather, nutmeg and vanilla.

Palate: Sweet and spicy: vanilla, toffee and sea salt with hints of cinnamon and pepper.

Finish: Long, with lingering spice, oak tannins, iodine and sea salt.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water.

ornellaia-bolgheri-2018.title: Ornellaia 2023
ornellaia-bolgheri-2018.bodyHtml:
Ornellaia 2023 marks the beginning of a compelling new era for this legendary estate, being the first full vintage under the direction of winemaker Marco Balsimelli. A masterclass in understatement and finesse rather than raw power, this vintage stands out for its ethereal lightness of touch. The wine greets the senses with a highly complex, botanical bouquet woven with dark cherries, crushed plums, and wild Mediterranean herbs like thyme and rosemary, accented by delicate floral notes of rose and lavender. On the palate, it is remarkably velvety and polished, balancing a succulence of crunchy hedgerow berries with a striking, breezy freshness and ultra-fine, vertical tannins that promise superb aging potential.

Food Pairing: This highly finessed and sophisticated Super Tuscan pairs exceptionally well with classic Italian meat dishes such as Bistecca alla Fiorentina, slow-braised wild boar ragù, or a perfectly roasted rack of lamb crusted with Mediterranean herbs. It also complements roasted duck breast with a cherry-balsamic reduction, grilled veal chops, and aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

Specific labels cannot be requested. 

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Ornellaia 2023 Bolgheri Superiore Ornellaia is a blend of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Merlot, 12% Cabernet Franc and 7% Petit Verdot, and it is worth noting that Merlot remains present at nearly the same percentage as previous years, despite the greater challenges faced by early-ripening varieties in this mildew-prone vintage. Careful fruit selection made the difference. The wine shows impressive richness and concentration with a bouquet that leans botanical and complex, marked by dark fruit, Mediterranean thyme and rosemary. The nose was slightly closed when I tasted the wine, but it will open. The texture is velvety and polished, delivering beautiful richness with a sense of succulence that feels expansive on the palate. According to proprietor Lamberto Frescobaldi, the goal is to establish a clear through line focused on freshness and balancing fruit and spice while avoiding excess ripeness. This is a meticulously made Ornellaia that captures the vintage with remarkable elegance. The wine was bottled in July 2025 and is scheduled for release in March 2026.

ornellaia-le-serre-nuove.title: Ornellaia Le Serre Nuove 2019
ornellaia-le-serre-nuove.bodyHtml:
With its usual intense color, Le Serre Nuove dell’Ornellaia 2019 has a nose full of fresh notes of ripe red fruits, accompanied by a lively balsamic vein with aromatic hints of cypress and eucalyptus berries. The wine is soft and silky in the mouth, filling it with an elegant tannic texture and a sapid and persistent finish.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
A blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, the 2019 Bolgheri Rosso Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia shows a greater degree of focus and detail compared to the previous vintage that I tasted at the same time. This wine reveals the sharp contours and etched character of the Cabernet Franc, especially with black licorice and black pepper. The results are linear and pure. Elegant fruit notes of blackberry and dark currant add to the thick layering of the wine.

94 Points - Wine & Spirits

The 2019 Le Serre Nuove’s dark fruit flavors are juicy and vibrant, framed by velvety tannins and enlivened by notes of warm spice. The plum and blackberry flavors maintain freshness and verve after the second day, gaining intensity and depth as the wine reveals layers of fresh tobacco and soft licorice.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A well-defined red, with a streak of pure black currant, blackberry, cedar and rosemary. Linear and vibrant, with echoes of fruit and spice on the lingering finish. Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Drink now.

bud-light-strawberry-lemonade-seltzer.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-strawberry-lemonade-seltzer.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

lagavulin-distillers-edition-2021.title: Lagavulin Distillers Edition 2021
lagavulin-distillers-edition-2021.bodyHtml:
Lagavulin Distillers Edition 2021 is the 2021 bottling of the Islay distillery's double-matured Distillers Edition, distilled in 2006 and bottled in 2021 (batch lgv. 4/510). After its first maturation the Lagavulin spirit was finished in casks that had held Pedro Ximénez sherry, adding a deep, raisin-sweet richness to the distillery's intense peat smoke. The Distillers Edition line has collected Double Gold medals at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition (2008, 2009 and 2011) and Best Islay Single Malt at the World Whiskies Awards in 2007. Bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle and presented in a gift box, it is a richer, sweeter companion to the classic Lagavulin profile.

Tasting Notes: Intense peat, vanilla, raisins, roasted malt, salt and coffee.

Nose: Intense peat and vanilla, with raisiny sweetness checking the smoke and crisp, roasty malt.

Palate: Sweet and luscious; malt and mouth-filling smoke, a salty tang, coffee, vanilla and a glimmer of fruit.

Finish: Very long, with fruit, peat and lasting oak.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

amahagan-no-3-mizunara-wood-finish.title: Amahagan World Malt Edition No. 3 Mizunara Wood Finish
amahagan-no-3-mizunara-wood-finish.bodyHtml:
A world blended release from the exciting Nagahama distillery that is finished in Mizunara wood. This superb whisky was named “Best Japanese Blended Malt” at the 2020 World Whiskies Awards. It brings an elegantly balanced array of fruity and spicy notes that are perfect for delighting your palate and warming your belly.

  • Best Japanese Blended Malt (World Whiskies Awards, 2020)

Quercus crispula wood finish (mizunara oak) Bitter malt with an oriental scent. The oriental personality of Quercus crispula, also known as “Japanese oak”, which is native to Japan. After ripening, the oak imparts an unique flavorsome notes unlike any other oak finish in the world..The appearance is pale amber. The sweet malt scent of Nagahama malt that overflows in the glass mixes with warm fruits such as oranges and red apples, making it more mellow. As time goes by, the nuances of the fragrant wood derived from Quercus crispula are further reduced, and at the end, it feels like a sweet caramel woody. Pallett has an orange baked confectionery and a fragrant brown sugar flavour. After the sweetness, there is a rich finish that is like slowly melting bitter chocolate in the mouth.

This Amahagan World Malt Edition No.3 is a fantastic world blend produced at the Nagata distillery. It’s a smooth and mellow creation that brings gentle fruits, fragrant wood imparted by mizunara oak maturation, subtle peppery spice and sweet caramel. It’s a well-accomplished and carefully balanced creation that is further highlights the possibilities in the world blend category.

amahagan-no-4-yamazakura-wood-finish.title: Amahagan World Malt Edition No. 4 Yamazakura Wood Finish
amahagan-no-4-yamazakura-wood-finish.bodyHtml:
Amahagan Edition Wild Cherry Blossom. Yamazakura” native to Japan. “Edition Yamazakura” is characterized by a pleasant fragrance reminiscent of a fragrant tree wearing “Japanese” and a gentle finish.The appearance is reddish amber. While retaining the malty sweetness of Nagahama malt, it has a sweet, gentle and beautiful scent with a product derived from wild cherry blossoms. “Wa” flavor reminiscent of sakura mochi and plum. Gentle orange peel and black honey peculiar to the Amahagan series, and a gorgeous and elegant sweetness that spreads in the mouth. Aftertaste comes with a pleasant astringency like black tea. Incredibly interesting and complex. This one brings the essence of “Yamazakura” – Yama meaning mountains and Sakura referring to Cherry Blossom trees – to the bottle. Refreshing aromas of wild cherry blossom combine with hints of incense, orange peel and black honey to create a fantastic overall drinking experience.

Tasting notes: Long. Refreshing and comfortable astringency finish like tea.

AWARDS
Bronze Medal – Melbourne International Spirits Competition 2021

700mL, ABV 47%

amahagan-no-5-sherry-wood-finish.title: Amahagan World Malt Edition No. 5 Sherry Wood Finish
amahagan-no-5-sherry-wood-finish.bodyHtml:
This Amahagan World Malt Edition No.5 was finished in a Sherry wood. It’s an incredible creation that will no doubt delight fans of the Nagahama distillery.

AMAHAGAN World Malt Edition was founded base on one of the most important technique in Whisky – blending. This is the fifth release of World Malt  ‘AMAHAGAN’ series. Matured in sherry cask which is one of most popular type of casks all over the world.

Nose: impressive aroma of ripe fruit and fresh-baked apple. Brown sugar, dried citrus fruits, freshly grated leather.
Palate: Smooth taste with a tangy end of strawberry jam and end of sweetness. Swirling aromas of maple syrup and raisin over flow as the time pass by.
Finish: Lingering finish sings with dryness and gentle species which come from cask maturation.

AWARDS
Gold Medal – Melbourne International Spirits Competition 2021

ABV 47% 700ML

pine-ridge-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvigno.title: Pine Ridge Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
pine-ridge-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvigno.bodyHtml:
Pine Ridge Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a remarkably expressive, layered, and texturally rich red wine that beautifully exemplifies the concentration of a cool, extended growing season. Sourced from premier vineyard blocks across five distinct sub-appellations, including estate parcels in Stags Leap, Howell Mountain, Oakville, Rutherford, and Carneros, this vintage benefited from an exceptionally long hangtime. Following traditional temperature-controlled fermentation, the wine was aged for 18 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels. In the glass, it exhibits a vibrant cranberry-red hue with bright clarity. The highly aromatic, seductive nose opens with aromas of blueberry bramble, maraschino cherry, and Hungarian baking spice, intricately woven with nuances of dark chocolate, cocoa nibs, and a subtle touch of dried sage. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, expansive, and supple, offering a mouth-filling fluid coherence where a concentrated core of marionberry and dark forest fruits is masterfully supported by polished, fine-grained tannins and a crisp line of natural acidity. It concludes with a long, satisfying finish accented by lingering notes of slate, tobacco leaf, and refined wood oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pork loin dressed in cherry chipotle sauce, grilled rosemary-infused ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, or mature extra-sharp white cheddar cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Bright and lifted aromas of blueberries, blackcurrants, violets and raspberry coulis. The palate is medium-bodied with vibrant acidity, a textural mouthfeel and a finish of licorice, blackberries and bitter chocolate. Succulent and focused. Drink or hold.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

With fewer than 1,000 cases produced, it might not be easy to find Pine Ridge's 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon, but it is the sort of wine one would be happy to see on a steakhouse wine list at a reasonable price. Blended from five different AVAs in Napa Valley and aged in a combination of French and American oak (just 15%), it offers up attractive scents of mixed red and black cherries accented by vanilla and mossy oak. It's unabashedly full-bodied, expansive, supple and creamy but is balanced on the finish by soft tannins and bright acids.

carpineto-brunello-di-montalcino-docg.title: Carpineto Brunello di Montalcino 2021
carpineto-brunello-di-montalcino-docg.bodyHtml:
This distinguished Brunello di Montalcino presents a complex bouquet of dried cherry, wild berry, and plum, accented by notes of leather, tobacco, and earthy underbrush. The palate is full-bodied and beautifully structured with firm tannins and bright acidity, culminating in a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair this exceptional Tuscan red with roasted meats, hearty wild boar ragù, or aged pecorino cheese.


93 Points - James Suckling
Pretty red berries, plums, dried spices and orange peel on the nose. Firmly structured and medium-bodied, with fine-boned tannins and a long, lightly savory finish. Drink or hold.

viberti-buon-padre-barolo.title: Viberti Giovanni Barolo Buon Padre 2021
viberti-buon-padre-barolo.bodyHtml:
Viberti’s flagship Barolo is a blend of fruit from Viberti’s top vineyard sites.  Buon Padre is a complex, full bodied wine that opens with notes of preserved fruit and spices, and is backed by nuances of earth, leather, and wild flowers.  It is aged in tini for 36-40 months and is bottled unfiltered before further refining in bottle for 6 months.  Approachable upon release, Viberti Buon Padre will only improve with time.

Viberti Barolo Buon Padre is a garnet red color. Aromas of spices, undergrowth, game, dried fruit, and leather. 

This wine pairs well with game, red meats, cheeses and cured meats.

93 Points - James Suckling

A lot of transparency in this Barolo, with delicate strawberries, cinnamon, blood oranges and sweet violets on the nose. Tight and firm on the palate with dusty tannins, more bony than supple, medium body and a refreshing finish. Try after 2025.

duckhorhn-napa-valley-chardonnay.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Chardonnay 2024
duckhorhn-napa-valley-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Chardonnay 2024 pours a brilliant, shimmering yellow color into the glass. Crafted in celebration of Duckhorn Vineyards' 50th anniversary milestone, the highly expressive bouquet opens with captivating aromas of caramelized pineapple, ripe orchard pear, white stone fruits, and a delicate whisper of mango crème brûlée. Secondary nuances of lemon confit, salted nuts, wet stones, and a touch of warm baking spice add sophisticated layering. On the palate, this mid-weighted Californian white wine delivers a rounded, generous, and beautifully texturized mouthfeel. Its core of tropical and orchard fruit is masterfully balanced by a bright, vibrant line of natural acidity that imparts excellent tension and life. Nuanced notes of key lime pie, delicate white florals, and refined minerality extend effortlessly through to a polished, remarkably clean, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with butter-poached lobster, pan-roasted chicken with lemon and thyme, creamy Dungeness crab risotto, or a decadent wild mushroom tart.

93 Points - James Suckling

A well-balanced, generous chardonnay with aromas of lemon confit, salted nuts, wet stones and spices. The palate is mid-weighted with bright acidity and a textural, rounded mouthfeel. Drink now. Screw cap.

91 Points- Wine Spectator

Strikes a vivid balance between its juicy fruit flavors of lemon curd, tangerine and ripe melon and its touch of chewy dried apricot, plus toasty, spicy nuances. Salted butterscotch, black cardamom and gingersnap notes linger on the harmonious and creamy finish. Drink now through 2036.

lancaster-winemakers-cuvee-red.title: Ashes & Diamonds Bates Ranch Mountain Cuvee No.1 2016 750ml
lancaster-winemakers-cuvee-red.bodyHtml:
This strong and concentrated blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc was made by Diana Snowden Seysses of Burgundy’s famed Domaine Dujac. Fruit hails from dry-farmed soils and is co-fermented with native yeasts and aged in oak, 35% of which is new. The final wine is plush and balanced, marked by well-integrated tannins, dark fruit, and a lengthy finish. 

93 Points - Vinous

The 2016 Bates Ranch Mountain No. 1 is terrific. It is also one of the wines in this range where site and style are very well matched. The blend 65% Cabernet Sauvignon and 35% Cabernet Franc, co-fermented, works beautifully here. Savory, mineral and tightly wound, the 2016 is going to need time to unwind, but it is undoubtedly very promising. It will be interesting to see what winemaker Diana Snowden-Seysses does with this fruit in future vintages.

distinction-series-beringer-8th-maker.title: Beringer 8th Maker Cabernet Sauvignon 2016 750ml
distinction-series-beringer-8th-maker.bodyHtml:
Eighth Maker is a celebration of my family’s heritage brought full circle, the name a nod to my stepping in as Beringer’s eighth winemaker 139 years after my great-great-grandfather Jacob and his brother Frederick founded the winery. This wine is produced from the Beringer estate’s most prestigious vineyards and is a culmination of over a century of crafting iconic Napa wines. Lush, balanced, and with excellent potential for aging, Eighth Maker is both an achievement and a homecoming. 

99 Points - James Suckling


A dark and seductive cabernet, this has stunning forest berries and enormous concentration and freshness. But, as delicious as it is now, this is also built for the long term. Great finish, where the interplay of fruit and fine tannins is complex. Goes on for minutes with dark berries, blackberries and hot stones. A core of greatness. A new wine to give a nod to the eighth winemaker of Beringer, Mark Beringer. 

97 Points - Jeb Dunnick

The 2016 Cabernet Sauvignon 8th Maker is a tiny production, special cuvée by this estate that’s based on 100% Cabernet Sauvignon brought up in 80% new French oak. This beauty is a massive, full-bodied Cabernet that boasts a saturated purple color, classic crème de cassis fruit, loads of chocolate, espresso, and tobacco notes, building tannins, and a deep, opulent, powerful style on the palate that needs to be tasted to be believed. It shows the purity and classic style of the 2016 vintage yet certainly brings serious power and richness. It can be drunk any time over the coming two decades or more.


95 Points - Wine Advocate


Produced from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the deep garnet-purple 2016 Cabernet Sauvignon 8th Maker is a fantastic example of a top-notch Napa Valley Cab. It comes bounding out of the glass with exuberant scents of warm cassis and blackberry pie with subtle hints of dried Provence herbs, fertile loam, coffee, yeast extract, olives and crushed rocks. Medium to full-bodied, the generously fruited palate delivers plush-yet-firm tannins with seamless freshness and a lingering minty lift on the finish. 1,000 cases were made.

liger-belair-nuit-st-georges-les-ste-geo.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Les Saint-Georges 750ml
liger-belair-nuit-st-georges-les-ste-geo.bodyHtml: Liger-Belair Nuit St Georges Les Saint Georges 750ml

liger-belair-richebourg-grand-cru-ac.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Richebourg Grand Cru 750ml
liger-belair-richebourg-grand-cru-ac.bodyHtml: The Thibault Liger-Belair Richebourg Grand Cru is a renowned red wine from the Burgundy region of France, specifically from the Vosne-Romanee appellation. It is crafted from 100% Pinot Noir grapes. This Grand Cru Richebourg is known for its complex, elegant, and often savory profile, with notes of black fruit, red fruit, spices, violets, and undergrowth.

liger-belair-clos-vougeot-grand-cru-ac.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Clos Vougeot Grand Cru 750ml
liger-belair-clos-vougeot-grand-cru-ac.bodyHtml: The Thibault Liger-Belair Clos Vougeot Grand Cru 750ml is a renowned Burgundy wine, known for its vibrant red fruit, intriguing bouquet with brown spices and black pepper, and well-balanced palate with fine tannins. It's made from 100% Pinot Noir grapes. The wine is characterized by a beautiful intensity of color, and a subtle bouquet of flowers and earthiness. The wine is typically aged in oak barrels and bottled for future aging.

strada-al-sasso-chianti-tenuta-di-arceno.title: Tenuta di Arceno Strada al Sasso Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021
strada-al-sasso-chianti-tenuta-di-arceno.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Strada al Sasso Gran Selezione is a layered and elegant wine. Aromas of fresh mint, bay leaf and wild roses are supported by secondary notes of ripe strawberry and black pepper spice. The mouthfeel is complex, full of soft tannins and racy acidity that bears the signature of classic Sangiovese. Integrated flavors of tart cherry and dried cranberry are prominent on the palate, rounded out by an herbaceous finish of thyme and licorice with subtle notes of fresh orange peel.

95 Points - James Suckling

A well-driven, composed, textured and focused gran selezione. The nose shows aromas of dark cherries, dark plums, grilled herbs, chestnuts and baking spices. It’s full-bodied with fine, firm tannins. Dense and vibrant at the center, thanks to a lift of spices and dried herbs kicking in. Focused and well defined, with a long, flavorful finish. Try after 2025

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Packed with fresh black cherry, blackberry and black currant fruit, this red is smooth and enticing. Mineral, eucalyptus and tobacco elements add complexity, while the lively acidity drives the long finish. Offers terrific balance. A compelling red.

chateau-lamothe-bergeron.title: Chateau Lamothe-Bergeron Cru Bourgeois 2012
chateau-lamothe-bergeron.bodyHtml:
Château Lamothe-Bergeron Cru Bourgeois is a classic Haut-Médoc showcasing aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, cassis, cedar, graphite, tobacco, and toasted oak. Concentrated fruit, polished tannins, lively acidity, and balanced oak deliver a refined, full-bodied wine with remarkable structure, elegance, and excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled ribeye, roast lamb, braised beef, duck breast, mushroom risotto, aged Gruyère, or herb-crusted pork tenderloin.

liger-belair-haute-cotes-des-nuits.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Bourgogne Hautes Cotes de Nuits La Roche 750ml
liger-belair-haute-cotes-des-nuits.bodyHtml: This wine is very expressive on the nose and balanced with a nice acidity. Notes of leather, undergrowth and red fruits especially cherry. The finish is long with a touch of cocoa.

simonnet-febvre-chablis.title: Simonnet-Febvre Petit Chablis 2023
simonnet-febvre-chablis.bodyHtml:
Simonnet-Febvre Petit Chablis is a lively Chardonnay displaying lemon, green apple, white flowers, fresh pear, and subtle mineral notes. Crisp and refreshing, the palate combines bright acidity, clean citrus fruit, delicate texture, and characteristic Chablis freshness through a precise, clean finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with oysters, shellfish, grilled white fish, sushi, fresh goat cheese, or light salads for a crisp and refreshing Burgundy pairing.

la-capilla-crianza.title: Finca La Capilla Crianza 2016 750ml
la-capilla-crianza.bodyHtml:
Critic tasting note (2016 vintage):
"Restrained aromas of blackberries and garrigue herbs, accompanied by a hint of undergrowth and fresh, robust spice. Balanced on the palate, with noticeable yet well-integrated tannins and lovely fruit notes. A touch of sour cherry on the finish. Very enjoyable!"
– 17/20, Vinum Wine Magazine

le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia.title: Ornellaia Le Serre Nuove dell’Ornellaia 2022
le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia.bodyHtml:
Ornellaia Le Serre Nuove dell’Ornellaia 2022 is a radiant, deeply expressive, and impeccably balanced second wine from the legendary Tenuta dell'Ornellaia estate, reflecting its signature sophistication even in a warm, sun-drenched vintage. Exhibiting a deep red-purple hue in the glass, it opens with a highly aromatic and complex nose featuring notes of ripe blackcurrants, wild plums, and dark cherries, accented by elegant layers of violets, freshly ground coffee, sweet tobacco, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red is remarkably plush, juicy, and focused, displaying an exceptional purity of fruit that counters the vintage's natural weight. Matured for 15 months in French oak barriques, its velvety texture is beautifully supported by super-fine, structured tannins and a persistent, blood orange-tinged vein of freshness, culminating in a long, savory, and wonderfully polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with grilled rosemary lamb chops, slow-cooked beef brisket, rich wild boar ragù, or a prime ribeye steak cooked rare.

95 Points - James Suckling

The brightness and purity of fruit is so beautiful here, showing flowers and currants. Very aromatic. Lots of finesse and focus on the medium-bodied palate with super-fine tannins and a lovely finish.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is both savory and floral, with aromas of violets, crushed rose petals, fresh brewed coffee, top soil, mixed herbs and figs. The palate has the tangy richness of black cherries, black figs and dark chocolate, but a current of mint, saltwater and licorice creates a very fresh, vibrant overall feel.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Ornellaia 2022 Bolgheri Rosso Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia is a blend of 65% Merlot, 25% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Cabernet Franc that saw 15 months in barrique with one-third new oak. Following in the general Ornellaia philosophy, the team has been leaning off long maceration times for more delicate extraction. Blending for this wine usually occurs 12 months after fermentation. This vintage is structured and rich with sweet tannins and a supple texture. This hot vintage brings more fruit weight for sure, but the wine remains fresh and well balanced overall.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A smooth red, this evokes cedar, plum, black currant, blackberry, vanilla and resin aromas and flavors. Broad and dense, with accents of leather, earth and tobacco on the long finish. Cabernet Sauvignon.

duckhorn-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
duckhorn-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a refined and powerful red wine crafted from top-tier estate and independent grower vineyards across the Napa Valley. Blending 93% Cabernet Sauvignon with 6% Merlot, it opens with rich aromas of boysenberry, black currant, and dark cherry, accented by bay leaf, baking spice, and subtle cedar notes. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, well-sculpted texture packed with blueberry, blackberry, and plum flavors supported by fine, firm tannins and a long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, roasted lamb, duck breast, or aged cheddar cheese.

chateau-grand-puy-lacoste-pauillac-2016.title: Chateau Grand-Puy-Lacoste 2016
chateau-grand-puy-lacoste-pauillac-2016.bodyHtml:
Château Grand-Puy-Lacoste 2016 is a classic, beautifully structured Fifth Growth expression from Pauillac, showing incredible elegance, depth, and poise. It displays complex, expressive aromas of ripe black currant, dark cherry, cassis, and graphite, layered with accents of cedar, cigar box, crushed violet, and subtle tobacco leaf. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full-bodied presence with impressive fruit concentration, crisp acidity, fine-grained ascending tannins, and a long, persistent, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Roast rack of lamb with rosemary, prime rib eye steak, braised beef short ribs, venison ragù, or aged Comté cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling 

Firm, tight, and vibrant with aromas of blackberries and herbs. Vivid and expressive on the palate, with a thread of dark fruit framed by polished, refined tannins. Focused and contained. Good concentration with a long finish. Drink or hold. 10 Years On retrospective.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The deep garnet-purple colored 2016 Grand-Puy-Lacoste gives up pure kirsch and red and black currants with violets and baking spices. Medium-bodied, firm and grainy, it's very expressive with good concentration and length.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A lively style, with lots of briar and tobacco notes out front, backed by punchy plum and black currant paste flavors. Has a shot of sweet tobacco lining the finish, with echoes of savory and hints of iron giving this range and length. Best from 2023 through 2038.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Juicy and jammy, this wine is already smoothly textured. Its black fruits add a fresh touch and give a ripe feeling. Likely to develop quickly the wine will be ready to drink from 2022.

cristal-vinotheque-brut.title: Louis Roederer Cristal Rose Vinotheque 2004
cristal-vinotheque-brut.bodyHtml:
Cristal Vinothèque is the culmination of Louis Roederer's know-how. Twenty years of careful attention and unique winemaking techniques result in a limited number of Cristal bottles produced only in the most outstanding vintages for their sophistication and elegance.

Cristal Vinothèque offers exceptional freshness and the promise of eternal youth. It is the result of 20 years of aging in three successive stages.

97 Points - James Suckling

The complexity of chocolate, toasted almonds, praline, burnt toffee, mushrooms and earth here is stunning. There’s a beautiful, spiced cherry-biscuit edge, too. The palate has a suave, supple and silky feel with such fleshy depth and drive. So melted together in flavors, so succulently textural and full of dried-strawberry flavor. Long with plenty of time ahead. Disgorged in 2014 after seven years sur latte and seven years sur pointe. Drink or hold.

malecon-esplendida-1991.title: Rum Malecon Seleccion Esplendida Vintage 1991 Rum
malecon-esplendida-1991.bodyHtml:
Rum Malecon Seleccion Esplendida 1991 is a vintage rum from Panama, distilled in 1991 and bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle. It is made at an undisclosed Panamanian distillery using traditional Cuban production methods. It is presented in a hinged wooden case, making it a striking gift or collector's bottle for someone born in 1991.

Serve: Neat, in a tulip glass.

cristal-vinotheque-rose-brut.title: Louis Roederer Cristal Rose Vinotheque 2004
cristal-vinotheque-rose-brut.bodyHtml:
