Cristal Vinothèque is the culmination of Louis Roederer's know-how. Twenty years of careful attention and unique winemaking techniques result in a limited number of Cristal bottles produced only in the most outstanding vintages for their sophistication and elegance.

Cristal Vinothèque offers exceptional freshness and the promise of eternal youth. It is the result of 20 years of aging in three successive stages.

97 Points - James Suckling

The complexity of chocolate, toasted almonds, praline, burnt toffee, mushrooms and earth here is stunning. There’s a beautiful, spiced cherry-biscuit edge, too. The palate has a suave, supple and silky feel with such fleshy depth and drive. So melted together in flavors, so succulently textural and full of dried-strawberry flavor. Long with plenty of time ahead. Disgorged in 2014 after seven years sur latte and seven years sur pointe. Drink or hold.

g-m-highland-park-2005-connoisseurs-ch.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Highland Park 16 Year Old 2005 First Fill Bourbon Barrel Cask 2821 55.4% ABV
g-m-highland-park-2005-connoisseurs-ch.bodyHtml:
This Canadian exclusive was distilled in early 2005 and bottled in May 2021. Maturation was first fill ex-bourbon cask (cask #2821) and was bottled without chill filtration or added colour. Total outturn: 195 bottles. 

Nose: Initial aroma is vanilla custard but marzipan and heather come through as well.  

Palate: Some heat at full strength which dulls the tastes. Added droplets of water tames this and allows the flavours to blossom. Malty, chocolatey and hints of tropical fruits on the back palate. 

Finish: Short and astringent. Good whisky to couple with dinner.

lagavulin-12-year-old-2021-special-relea.title: Lagavulin 12 Year Old Special Releases 2021
lagavulin-12-year-old-2021-special-relea.bodyHtml: The King of Islay in his prime, fiercely rampant, with a clarity of vision and a sense of purpose none can deny. A glorious and classic Lagavulin, with an intensity, saltiness and sweetness that balance perfectly as perfumed wood smoke rises to envelop them all; absolutely delicious.

liger-belair-nuit-st-george-la-charmotte.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Nuits-Saint-Georges La Charmotte Cote de Nuits 750ml
liger-belair-nuit-st-george-la-charmotte.bodyHtml: This wine offers notes of raspberry and red currant with hints of rose petals. The palate is juicy, greedy and well balanced with ripe red berries with a fine touch of acidity. There is a nice roundness on the finish with delicate tannins.

pascal-jolivet-sancerre.title: Pascal Jolivet Sancerre Blanc 2024
pascal-jolivet-sancerre.bodyHtml:
A great example of unique style of the maison. The Sancerre is a perfectly balanced wine, elegant, perfumed, with great depth and flavor definition. A dry, mineral palate is the perfect frame for delicate aromas of white fruit, orchard flowers and a subtle smokiness.

A wine ideal as an aperitif and to accompany oysters, sashimi or white fish.

90 Points - Vinous 

The 2024 growing season presented huge challenges, but this 2024 Sancerre seems to defy them all. It's attractive and tender, with pure fruit and floral flavours. There's a delicious, succulent balance through the mid-palate, giving you something to really embrace. The gently refreshing finish has an assured sense of ease and line.

yangarra-estate-mclaren-vale-grenache.title: Yangarra Old Vine Grenache 2023 750ml
yangarra-estate-mclaren-vale-grenache.bodyHtml: These gnarly strugglers were planted in 1946 in a deep sandy dune we call The Beach, overlying the North Maslin Sands geological formation. The Old Vine Grenache is a complex, perfumed and elegant wine with a trademark tannin structure.

freemark-abbey-chardonnay-napa.title: Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Chardonnay 2024
freemark-abbey-chardonnay-napa.bodyHtml:
Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Chardonnay 2024 is an expressive, beautifully balanced California white wine sourced primarily from cool-climate vineyards in Los Carneros and Coombsville. Aged for eight months in French oak, it opens with bright aromas of fresh pear, green apple, and nectarine layered with toasted brioche, lemon curd, and subtle vanilla spice. The palate is medium-to-full-bodied and supple, offering a rounded, creamy texture balanced by crisp orchard acidity that carries through to a vibrant, lingering finish accented by roasted hazelnut and citrus zest.

Food Pairing: Butter-poached lobster tails, pan-seared sea scallops, roasted herb chicken, wild mushroom risotto, and creamy aged Gruyère or Brie cheeses.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Coming mostly from Coombsville and Carneros and aged eight months in 43% new French oak, the 2024 Chardonnay Napa Valley is a beautiful, classy, rich, yet fresh and vibrant expression of Chardonnay. Stone and orchard fruits, honeyed white flowers, spice, and a kiss of classy wood all shine on the nose, and it's medium-bodied on the palate, with a pure, focused, vibrant mouthfeel, integrated acidity, and a great finish.

lan-edicion-limitada.title: Bodegas Lan Rioja Reserva 2018 1.5L Magnum
lan-edicion-limitada.bodyHtml:
This classic 2018 Rioja Reserva displays a deep garnet color with excellent clarity. The nose opens with an elegant and layered bouquet of ripe red cherries, blackberries, and sweet plums, harmoniously integrated with sophisticated notes of vanilla, cedar wood, toasted almond, and sweet tobacco leaf derived from 18 months of aging in hybrid oak barrels. The medium-bodied palate is wonderfully polished and structured, balancing its dark fruit depth with a vibrant, food-friendly acidity, velvety tannins, and a long, savory, spice-kissed finish.

Food Pairing: A classic partner for roasted or barbecued lamb chops, slow-simmered beef or pork stews with smoked paprika, grilled ribeye steaks, or aged Spanish cheeses like Manchego.

louis-jadot-chateau-des-jacques-moulin.title: Louis Jadot Chateau Des Jacques Moulin-A-Vent 2022
louis-jadot-chateau-des-jacques-moulin.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Chateau Des Jacques Moulin-A-Vent 2022 is a robust, full-bodied, and serious expression of Gamay that showcases exceptional structure and longevity. It opens with an inviting, savory bouquet of crushed strawberries, dark cherries, and wild herbs, underlain by distinct minerally notes of wet stone, bark, and a subtle hint of mesquite smoke. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, fresh, and highly elegant, delivering a core of energetic red and dark fruit beautifully framed by fine-grained, polished tannins. It concludes with a wonderfully long, mouthcoating, and refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted chicken, seared duck breast, lighter red meats, veal chops, and classic French charcuterie boards.

92 Points - James Suckling

Minerally and savory Moulin-a-Vent showing wet stone, bark, strawberry and rosemary aromas. It’s medium-bodied, fresh and elegant with fine-grained tannins. Excellent length.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Round and mouthcoating, with a tug of tar and earth behind red currant and wild herbs. Hints of mocha and espresso add to the depth, with mesquite smoke hovering throughout. There's nice length to the salty close. Drink now through 2029.

bouchard-pere-meursault.title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Meursault Cru 750ml
bouchard-pere-meursault.bodyHtml:
Bright golden yellow with green tints. Open, woody aromas accompanied by vanilla, toast, russet apples and hazelnuts on the nose. Strong alcohol content with a woody quality and hints of vanilla. Round, smooth, velvety.

Intense bouquet of fruit and flowers combined with a delicate mineral hint. Rich and subtle wine with good crisp, which makes it very balanced. Good ageing potential.

harlan-estate-cabernet-sauvignon-2010.title: Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
harlan-estate-cabernet-sauvignon-2010.bodyHtml:
Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, expressive, and elegantly structured red wine that beautifully captures the distinct character of Sonoma County's rugged, rocky terroir. Sourced from the historic estate vineyards that Beringer pioneered in the mid-1960s, this vintage is crafted in the style of a classic Bordeaux blend, offering both immediate approachability and excellent cellaring potential. In the glass, it presents a deep crimson-ruby color. The aromatic profile opens with a perfumed and complex bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, boysenberries, and dark plum, beautifully lifted by traditional Knights Valley nuances of wild sage, fresh thyme, and lavender, along with hints of dark chocolate, mocha, and toasty cedar oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, balanced, and remarkably plush. It delivers a savory, fruit-forward core of raspberry coulis, black cherry, and red licorice, framed by fine-grained, chewy tannins and a vibrant acidity that carries through to a long, smooth, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, rosemary-roasted prime rib, venison stew, wild mushroom risotto, and mature, sharp cheddar cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

Perfumed aromas of red currants, lavender, fresh thyme and graphite. The palate is medium-bodied with plush tannins and balanced acidity, giving flavors of raspberry coulis, red licorice and baking spices. Very soft and delicate, with a nicely constructed backbone.

aia-vecchia-sor-ugo-bolgheri-doc.title: Aia Vecchia Sor Ugo Bolgheri Superiore 2022
aia-vecchia-sor-ugo-bolgheri-doc.bodyHtml:
Aia Vecchia Sor Ugo Bolgheri Superiore 2022 is the flagship red wine from this esteemed estate, presenting an exceptional expression of a Super Tuscan Bordeaux-style blend. In the glass, it displays a deep, dark ruby color with a complex bouquet layered with aromas of ripe cherries, dark plums, black currant, menthol, and a touch of rosemary. The palate is robust, rich, and highly structured, showing sweet dark fruit characteristics tightly intertwined with firm, velvety tannins, a lively thread of acidity, and elegant notes of espresso, licorice, and sweet tobacco. This powerful yet remarkably balanced red captures the full depth and coastal strength of the Maremma terroir, culminating in a long, savory, and beautifully sustained finish. It benefits significantly from a period of aging or decanting, allowing its sophisticated components and underlying freshness to integrate seamlessly.

Food Pairing: This highly structured red wine pairs perfectly with hearty main courses such as roasted rack of lamb, wild boar ragù, grilled ribeye steak, or mature hard cheeses.

sybille-kuntz-riesling-spatlese.title: Sybille Kuntz Mosel-Riesling Spatlese Trocken 2017
sybille-kuntz-riesling-spatlese.bodyHtml:
Sybille Kuntz Mosel-Riesling Spätlese Trocken 2017 is a dry, biodynamic white wine crafted by Weingut Sybille Kuntz in the Mosel region of Germany. Sourced from old vines in the steep, slate-rich Niederberg-Helden vineyard, the grapes are harvested late in the season to build intense phenolic complexity and concentration. In the glass, it shows a bright golden hue with vibrant aromas of ripe peach, nectarine, citrus zest, honeysuckle, and a distinct mineral spice note. The palate is rich, textured, and deeply focused, featuring concentrated flavors of sour-citrus, green apple, and tropical fruit backed by a firm, mouthwatering acidity and a long, saline finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted pork tenderloin, braised pork belly, pan-seared scallops, Thai green curry, and rich roasted vegetable or cabbage dishes.

harlan-estate-cabernet-sauvignon-2017.title: Harlan Estate 2021
harlan-estate-cabernet-sauvignon-2017.bodyHtml:
Founded in 1984 by Bill Harlan, Harlan Estate is a prestigious winegrowing estate nestled in the western hills of Oakville in Napa Valley. With a vision to create a Californian 'First Growth', the estate has become a benchmark for luxury and excellence in New World wines. Its vineyard spans approximately 240 acres, of which 40 are under vine, producing wines of remarkable depth and character.

The 2021 Harlan Estate displays a deep garnet-purple colour and opens with captivating aromas of wild blueberries, Morello cherries, violets, and crushed rock. The palate is layered and refined, offering a harmonious expression of black, red, and blue fruits with polished tannins and a medium to full-bodied frame. There is a purity and grace to this vintage, culminating in a long, poised finish. The wine is primarily composed of Cabernet Sauvignon, supported by Cabernet Franc and Merlot. It shows excellent balance and ageing potential, reflective of the estate’s meticulous vineyard and cellar practices.

100 Points - James Suckling

The aromas are subtle yet enticing with lavender and rose petal notes. So aromatic and perfumed. Lots of currants and hints of spearmint. Chanel No. 5? Medium-bodied with super fine tannins that run the length of the wine with crunchy tannins that are energetic and vivid. It grows and grows and turns almost flamboyant. Goes on for minutes with a compressed and vibrant finish. Mostly cabernet sauvignon with some cabernet franc and a tiny percent of merlot and petit verdot. Drink it now to love and understand the potential. But it will age beautifully. Try after 2030.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

This is packed with dark currant, bitter plum and blackberry paste flavors, all closely allied with a cold cast iron spine that provides a rock-solid underpinning. Flashes of ink, dried anise and roasted apple wood add terrific range through the energetic finish, as the cast iron minerality just sails on and on. This is set up for the long haul. Best from 2028 through 2045.

demuerte-gold.title: Demuerte Gold 2023
demuerte-gold.bodyHtml: Deep cherry red color with garnet rims. Reminiscent of ripe an liquorous red fruit. A scent that is also peppered with spices such as pepper, cloves and nutmeg. A very suggestive combination. Smooth, full bodied, ripe tannin and a silky texture.

borgogno-barolo-liste.title: Borgogno Barolo Liste 2017
borgogno-barolo-liste.bodyHtml:
The cru orginated around 13 millon years ago due to erosion of the overlying terrain. As a result its composition differs slightly from the other lanhe lands. Liste essentially acquired acompletion of macro and micro elements that give the future wine an unequalled complexity and longevity. Highly visible from the curves of the secondary road that rises from Barolo towards the old Castello della Volta, the vineyards of this renowed cru cover around 6.75 hectares, with a southern exposureand an altitude that varies from 270 to 330 meters above sea level.

Barolo goes well with important dishes, such as traditional Piedmontese meat main courses. Ranging from world traditions, there is gulasch in Eastern Europe. Going to Japan instead for example fish, such as Black Cod (Alaskan fish marinated with sugar, sake, miso). Moving to The United States of America, beef (angus, wagyu, bue nostral, longhorn) in the brisket cut. One recipe is, for example, onion stout beef. But if you have the pleasure, even a simple “special” toast is perfect!

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Iris, violet and ripe dark-skinned fruit aromas mingle with whiffs of leather and pipe tobacco. The full-bodied palate features prune, dried cherry and licorice alongside velvety tannins. Drink through 2029.

kweicho-moutai-golf-liquor.title: Kweichow Moutai Golf Liquor
kweicho-moutai-golf-liquor.bodyHtml: Kweichow Moutai Golf Liquor is a special edition Moutai that commemorates the return of golf at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics after over 100 years. Golf has become a game known for its class and sophisticated players. Golf Moutai Liquor is exquisitely packaged with yellow kraft paper packaging. The matte white bottle with golf ball impressions is a must for Moutai collectors.

jacobs-creek-double-barrel-shiraz.title: Jacob's Creek Double Barrel Shiraz 750ml
jacobs-creek-double-barrel-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Double barrel is finished in aged whiskey barrels for a richer, deeper, and smoother taste.

The Double Barrel range is crafted from superior quality grapes which are first matured in traditional wine barrels. Then, using our unique Double Barrel technique, they are finished in aged whisk(e)y barrels to build additional layers of complexity.

The intense nose offers cedar, vanilla bean and buttered toast with notes of pecan nut and roast cashew.

An attractive, savory palate of blackberry and ripe plum with integrated charry notes and a lovely soft finish.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Rich, robust, and full-bodied, this Shiraz is characterized by pronounced flavors of dark berries, black plum, and a distinctive smoky, charred oak character imparted by its unique secondary maturation in aged whiskey barrels. The palate is velvety and expansive, carrying the dense fruit and spice notes across a long, warming finish where hints of vanilla and toasted almond linger. This innovative process creates a wine of substantial depth and a modern twist on a classic Australian style.
91 Points - James Suckling
A boldly flavored and generously proportioned Shiraz, featuring deep layers of stewed plum, blackberry compote, and dark chocolate, all beautifully complemented by pronounced notes of vanilla, toasted coconut, and spice from its pioneering whiskey barrel finish. The innovative aging technique adds a remarkable complexity and a uniquely smooth, almost creamy texture that softens the wine's natural robust structure, making it exceptionally approachable despite its intensity.

macallan-classic-cut-2021-51-00-abv.title: The Macallan Classic Cut 2021 51% ABV
macallan-classic-cut-2021-51-00-abv.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Edition demonstrates our continuous quest to seek out the extraordinary, revealing a unique flavour and character.

A single malt matured in an exquisite union of oak casks, this single malt was carefully crafted by the Whisky Mastery Team to showcase the role of ex-bourbon American oak casks in our portfolio.

The expression perfectly combines sweet lightness brought by these casks with depth and complexity from The Macallan’s renowned sherry seasoned American oak casks, to uncover a new, uniquely heightened flavour experience.

The 2021 expression reveals sweeter flavour notes of gingerbread, fruit jellies and marzipan and provides an ideal platform for a refreshing whisky cocktail.

macallan-harmony-rich-cacao.title: The Macallan The Harmony Collection Inspired by Fresh Coconut
macallan-harmony-rich-cacao.bodyHtml:
The Macallan 'The Harmony Collection' Inspired by Fresh Coconut is the sixth and concluding release in The Macallan's sustainability-minded Harmony series. This vibrant, limited-edition expression departs from the distillery's signature heavy sherry-fruit profile to showcase a surprisingly bright, tropical character rarely seen from the estate. By carefully selecting sherry-seasoned American oak casks—which naturally possess high levels of oak lactones—and finessing the blend with ex-bourbon casks, Master Whisky Maker Kirsteen Campbell coaxed out a naturally developed fresh coconut flavor without the use of any added flavoring. Bottled at 46.3% ABV, it perfectly balances the science of wood management with the art of whisky making. In keeping with the collection's ethos, the presentation box is crafted from repurposed, discarded coconut fibers.

Food Pairing: Grilled pineapple, coconut and cocoa tartlets, white chocolate desserts, mango and lime sorbet, or delicate vanilla pastries.

Tasting Notes : Warm, golden "King Coconut" in appearance with a bright, vibrant, and softly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : A highly unusual profile for the distillery, leading with fresh coconut and zesty lime, followed by lemon, orange, ripe mango, and papaya, all lifted by sweet vanilla, toasted almond, sweet oak, and a delicate touch of nutmeg and cinnamon.

Palate : Sweet and creamy, unfolding with layers of coconut milk, sweet lime, vanilla sponge cake, icing sugar, and dried coconut, balanced by gentle American oak sweetness and dried tropical fruit.

Finish : Bright, floral, and honeyed, leaving a lingering, warming impression of fresh coconut and sweet floral honey.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to allow the layered tropical aromatics to fully open, or pair it beautifully against a coconut-forward dessert.

orin-swift-8-years-in-the-desert-1.title: Orin Swift Cellars 8 Years In The Desert 2020 750ml
orin-swift-8-years-in-the-desert-1.bodyHtml:
Bright violet in the glass, the 2020 8 Years in the Desert is the epitome of our style, the reason we are even here in the first place. As it’s being poured, the aromatics hit squarely on the nose with a perception of sweetness: pure brambly raspberry juice and blueberry preserves with a hint of white pepper and High Sierra forest floor. Yet, the perceived sweetness on the nose is just that, perceived, and doesn’t carry through to the palate. Lush and enveloping with a beam of acidity, notes of blackberry pie, plum and kirsch flourish. Ultra-round tannins and lingering raspberry, the wine finishes in slow-motion.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The exact proportions and origins of the 2020 Zinfandel Blend 8 Years in the Desert are deliberately kept fuzzy by the winery, but the wine does include Petite Sirah, Syrah and Barbera in addition to Zin. Aged in roughly half new oak, the nose brings an overlay of vanilla to a core of ripe blackberries. Full-bodied and open-knit, it adds briary, herbal notes on the palate, plus a bit of cracked pepper. Soft, dusty tannins mark the finish, along with hints of mocha and bittersweet chocolate. Drink it over the next several years.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A bold and brawny blend, offering straightforward dark berry and savory spice flavors. Ends with a peppery accent. Zinfandel, Syrah, Petite Sirah and Barbera.

louis-roedere-brut-rose-2014.title: Louis Roederer Brut Rose 2016 750ml
louis-roedere-brut-rose-2014.bodyHtml:
Salmon pink hue with bright red tints. Deep, intense color. The bubbles are fine yet vibrant and energetic. The summery bouquet shows exceptional intensity and freshness with its aromas of ripe, juicy stone fruit (wild peach) complemented by zesty red fruit (redcurrant) and citrus notes (blood orange). Upon aeration, the nose develops more jammy notes of Roussillon red apricot. The palate is soft, juicy and concentrated on entry and then quickly shows a chalky, saline freshness that structures the wine and lends it a voluptuous yet delicate mouthfeel. The juicy, ripe fruit (nectarine and wild peach) and citrus (lemon) give the wine a fresh, zesty character that is underpinned by a subtle hint of bitterness. The soft, delicate bubbles coat the palate and impart a velvety texture. The end palate is mouth-watering and ever so slightly salty with discreet tannins and a lovely subtle bitterness that complements the incredible dry chalkiness of the wine and lingers on the seemingly never-ending finish.

95 Points - James Suckling

Fantastic aroma of Mara des Bois strawberries. Very juicy with an explosion of strawberries and ripe nectarines. Stunning vitality due to the bright and fine mousse plus the lively acidity. Long and elegant finish that pulls you back for more. A cuvee of 60% pinot noir from Cumieres and 40% chardonnay from Chouilly. 8 g/l dosage. From biodynamically grown grapes. 

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Finely mature, this bottling is just right. Its fruit has softened and a touch of toastiness has come through to give great balance. The Champagne is totally ready to drink.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Firm and focused, this finely knit version offers a satiny texture and hints of smoke and oyster shell, which underscore flavors of pureed raspberry, peach skin and blood orange granita, with a rich touch of toasted brioche. Long, lightly spiced finish. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

screaming-eagle-sauvignon-blanc.title: Screaming Eagle 2023
screaming-eagle-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
An exceptionally rare expression of Napa Valley wine, the 2023 Screaming Eagle Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the estate’s vineyard in Oakville subregion of the Napa Valley in California. Screaming Eagle, founded in 1986 by Jean Phillips, is the quintessential American 'cult' winery, known for its tiny production and near mythical status among collectors. Now owned solely by businessman Stanley Kroenke, the estate maintains a philosophy of extreme quality control and 'patient winemaking', overseen by winemaker Nick Gislason. The vineyard is situated on a rocky, west-facing slope that benefits from excellent drainage and cooling breezes from the San Pablo Bay.

This vintage is characterized by its purity and structure. It displays a deep purple hue and a bouquet of crushed blackberries, crème de cassis, and spring flowers, integrated with notes of graphite and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, showcasing fine tannins. The finish is known for its persistence, leaving a trail of blue fruit, licorice, and stony minerality.
100 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The epitome of class and elegance, the 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon offers pure crème de cassis, liquid violets, crushed stone, graphite, and cedar notes on the nose. It's full-bodied on the palate, with remarkably polished tannins, flawless overall balance, and incredible length. This is never the biggest or richest wine in the vintage, yet the sheer level of purity, structure, and depth is absolutely incredible. Compared to the 2021, this is less powerful and made in a more elegant style, yet it's every bit as profound and compelling. It builds beautifully with time in the glass and already offers pleasure yet won't hit prime time for a decade and will cruise for 50+ years. Drink 2035-2075.

screaming-eagle-first-flight.title: Screaming Eagle The Flight 2020
screaming-eagle-first-flight.bodyHtml:
Screaming Eagle The Flight 2020 presents a deep garnet-purple or dark ruby colour. The nose is extraordinarily perfumed and aromatic, leading with violets, lavender, and crushed flowers layered with wild herbs, graphite, and cedarwood spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and refined, featuring a 'crunchy' energy and purity of red berry fruit—redolent of cranberry, raspberry, and mulberry—alongside dark cherry and blackberry preserves. It is characterized by its silkier texture and tantalizing acidity compared to the flagship, with fine-grained tannins and a mineral core that opens into notes of blood orange, star anise, and spearmint. The finish is long, polished, and sanguine, often revealing hints of black truffle. This blend consists of 64% Merlot and 36% Cabernet Sauvignon, with an ABV of 14.7%. The wine is not certified organic, though the estate is farmed with meticulous care. The optimal drinking window is from 2024 through 2050.

98 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackberries, red and black currants. Green olives, too. Dark roses and perfume. Medium-bodied with super crunchy energy and brightness. Very fine tannins. Elegant and precise. So subtle and complex, it’s really something...Needs four to five years to open and come together.

marda-loop-blackberry-porter.title: Marda Loop Blackberry Porter 4 Tall Cans

marda-loop-big-juice-neipa.title: Marda Loop Big Juice Neipa 4 Tall Cans
marda-loop-big-juice-neipa.bodyHtml: Marda Loop Big Juice Neipa 4 Tall Cans

glenmorangie-18-year-old-azumo-makoto.title: Glenmorangie 18 Year Old Azuma Makoto Limited Edition
glenmorangie-18-year-old-azumo-makoto.bodyHtml:
Captivated by the scents he found in our 18 Year Old’s bouquet, the floral artist likened our single malt to the wonder of a flower in bloom.

He explains: “It begins with rich, rounded aromas of dried fruits and honey, then unfurls into a bouquet of geranium, tuberose and jasmine. They dance on the tongue with honeysuckle and sweet pea, figs and nuts until the blossoms fade into a sweet and lingering finish.

As Azuma Makoto translated the whisky’s delicious bourbon cask softness and sweet, Oloroso sherry cask hints, he drew on the beauty of almost 100 different blooms from across the world.

He coaxed each one into blossom at his Tokyo studio for his floral masterpiece Dancing Flowers of Glenmorangie, which we share in this wondrous limited edition.

bruichladdich-octomore-12-3.title: Bruichladdich Octomore 12.3 5 Year Old Islay Barley
bruichladdich-octomore-12-3.bodyHtml: Octomore 12.3 is single vintage, single field, single malt. Raised in Church Field on Octomore Farm by friend and farmer James Brown, this Islay grown barley has been trickle distilled through our tall narrow necked stills just two miles from where it was grown. This terroir-driven spirit would take two separate journeys before being combined; 75% was filled into ex-American whiskey casks, while the remaining 25% spent five years maturing in genuine Pedro Ximenez Solera casks from Jerez bodega Fernando de Castilla. This Islay barley spirit has breathed slowly and delicately for five aged years, its salty citrus marine note resulting from the locale of where the barley was grown and our warehouses proximity to the sea. The Pedro Ximenez casks contribute sweet dried fruit notes which highlight the rich dry peat smoke of Octomore.

bruichladdich-octomore-12-5.title: Bruichladdich Octomore 12.1 5 Year Old
bruichladdich-octomore-12-5.bodyHtml:
Nowhere is the duality of our Octomore super heavily peated series more pertinent than in our 12.1 edition. Unexpected, delicate but powerful, this is unadulterated heavy smoke balanced with our vivacious fruity and floral distillate.

While Octomore in itself does not conform to tradition, our Head Distiller Adam Hannett is inclined to mature Octomore .1 editions solely in ex-American whiskey casks for five vibrant years.

Octomore 12.1 is the necessary control for the rest of the series, as experiments within an experiment, but our baseline should not be underestimated.

Mainland grown Scottish barley is distilled in a patient and considered trickle.

The stripped back maturation profile allows a sensory conversation that highlights the cereal-rich, malty notes of this barley-forward single malt. Vanilla, citrus and fudge culminate in an enigmatic challenge to received whisky wisdom.

Vibrant, punchy and lively before opening up to reveal layers of complexity, instilled through slow distillation, careful maturation and cask selection. A dram that rewards those who seek to discover the mysterious, convention defying whisky that is Octomore.

NOSE

Zesty citrus freshness and earthy peat smoke open to vanilla sponge cake and barley sugars with rich malt sweetness. Coconut, chocolate, vanilla and caramel follow and, as the aromas open further, cinder toffee, layers of peat smoke and honey come to the fore.
PALATE
Peppery and sweet on the palate, with a smooth texture of warm golden syrup. Honey and peat smoke then move to fired oak chips and peaty apricot jam. Another sip brings malted barley sugars and straw, heather flower and a nutty nougat sweetness. A mineral sandy note sits on the palate and brings through a dry phenolic earthy smoke, with hints of orange zest and pear drops.
FINISH
The finish brings salted caramel with floral and herbal notes. Honeysuckle, primrose and then, as ever, gentle peat smoke lingers.

bruichladdich-port-charlotte-pac-1.title: Bruichladdich Port Charlotte PAC:01 2011
bruichladdich-port-charlotte-pac-1.bodyHtml:
Bruichladdich Port Charlotte PAC:01 2011 is a Cask Exploration edition of Port Charlotte, Bruichladdich's heavily peated Islay single malt. Two parcels of Scottish barley spirit distilled in 2011 were matured for six years in ex-American oak casks, then transferred into red wine casks from the left bank of the Gironde in Bordeaux to finish, showing the versatility of Port Charlotte's soft, barbecue-style smoke. It was bottled at 56.1% ABV in a 700ml bottle as part of the Cask Exploration range, which pairs the heavily peated Port Charlotte spirit with different cask types; here the focus is Bordeaux red wine wood.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open up the aromas.

turnbull-cabenret-sauvignon.title: Austin Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon
turnbull-cabenret-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The AUSTIN Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon by Hope Family Wines is an exceptionally plush, rich, and approachable California red wine crafted by veteran winemaker Austin Hope. Conceived as an everyday luxury that celebrates the warmth and diversity of Paso Robles, it is produced using a purposeful multi-vintage approach to deliver peak flavor consistency and velvet smoothness upon release. It pours a deep ruby-purple color in the glass, unfurling an enticingly sweet bouquet of fresh black cherries, dark plum, and burnt sugar, woven with subtle layers of rich cocoa powder, fresh vanilla bean, and a wisp of smoky oak. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is lavish and fruit-forward, coating the mouth with succulent flavors of ripe blackberry, blueberry compote, and roasted coffee. Balanced by an undercurrent of lively acidity and framed by remarkably fine, dusty tannins, it transitions seamlessly into a long, warming finish accented by savory black pepper, tobacco leaf, and sweet baking spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with casual or upscale grilled fare, including New York strip steaks, charcoal-grilled gourmet bacon cheeseburgers, barbecued pork ribs, roasted lamb shank, hearty beef stews, or dark chocolate lava cakes.

chateau-haut-brion-le-clarence-de-haut-b.title: Le Clarence de Haut-Brion 2016 750ml
chateau-haut-brion-le-clarence-de-haut-b.bodyHtml: Le Clarence de Haut-Brion 2016 is a red wine from Bordeaux, France, specifically from the Pessac-Léognan region. It's a second wine from Château Haut-Brion, a renowned first-growth estate. This 2016 vintage is known for its elegant and refined profile, showcasing layers of black fruit, spice, and toasty oak, with smooth tannins and a balanced acidity.

ferrari-carano-tre-terre-chardonnay.title: Ferrari-Carano Chardonnay 2024
ferrari-carano-tre-terre-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Ferrari-Carano Chardonnay 2024 is a rich, full-bodied, and deliciously balanced white wine crafted from select vineyard lots across Sonoma County. Sourced primarily from cool-climate sites, this vintage undergoes partial barrel fermentation and aging in French oak to build a round, lush texture while preserving vibrant natural acidity. In the glass, it reveals bright pale-gold hues with inviting aromas of yellow apple, ripe pear, buttercream, graham cracker, and subtle citrus blossom. The palate is smooth and expansive, delivering concentrated flavors of baked apple, lemon chiffon, nutmeg, and butterscotch that lead into a crisp, clean, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with butter-poached lobster, crab cakes, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy pasta dishes, and wild mushroom risotto.

92 Points - James Suckling

Sweet aromas of vanilla bean and pear blossoms with a generous mouthfeel, a weighty creaminess and flavors of butterscotch and golden apples. A rich, satisfying, barrel-fermented wine. Screw cap.

khortytsa-platinum.title: Khor Platinum Vodka
khortytsa-platinum.bodyHtml:
Khor Platinum Vodka comes from Khor, a Ukrainian vodka brand launched in 1998 and part of the Global Spirits group, and is labelled Khor Khortytsa Platinum. Khor describes it as one of few corn-based vodkas: it is made from Luxe, a multi-distilled, 100% corn-based rectified spirit, and artesian drinking water that passes four separate stages of filtration, then silver-filtered and passed through a birch and alder charcoal filter. The producer credits this process with a clean, balanced and soft finish and recommends Platinum above all as a vodka for cocktails. Khor's vodkas are gluten free, and Drinks International has ranked Khor among the three best-selling vodkas in the world for five years running. This 750ml bottle is 40% ABV.

Tasting Notes: Clean and balanced.

Finish: Clean, balanced and soft.

Serve: Well chilled, or as the base for a Screwdriver, Moscow Mule or Bloody Mary.

pendleton-midnight.title: Pendleton Midnight Canadian Whisky
pendleton-midnight.bodyHtml:
Pendleton® Midnight is a super-premium, blended Canadian whisky. Musky leather and cinnamon aroma complements the well-balanced oak taste paired with warm spices for a full, authentic flavor. A portion of every batch is aged in American brandy barrels to provide a full and balanced flavor. (45% ABV – 90 proof).

Color: Rich amber
Aroma: Musky notes of leather with warm cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, and a trace of ginger.
Flavor: Full, well-balanced oak is paired with hints of coffee cake, nuts, caramelized bananas and candied figs.
Finish: A full-bodied and satiating finish with a lingering smolder of spices, pecans and walnuts.

leblon-cachaca.title: Leblon Cachaca
leblon-cachaca.bodyHtml:
Leblon Cachaca is a Brazilian cachaça distilled from sugarcane juice and rested in French oak casks for up to six months before bottling at 40% ABV. The producer describes a lively, fruity spirit layered with fresh-cut sugar cane, spice and fruit, with a light to medium body that makes it especially versatile behind the bar. It mixes easily with almost any fruit and pairs well with herbs, spices and liqueurs, and it is the natural base for a classic Caipirinha. 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Fresh-cut sugar cane, fruit and spice with a gentle sweetness.

Nose: Lively and fruity, with fresh-cut cane, spices and fruit.

Palate: Warming, with a gentle sweetness that blossoms mid-palate; light to medium bodied.

Finish: Very smooth.

Serve: Muddle with fresh lime and sugar over crushed ice for a Caipirinha, or mix with fruit juices.

orin-swift-mercury-head-cabernet-sauvign.title: Orin Swift Cellars Palermo Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
orin-swift-mercury-head-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:
Orin Swift Cellars Palermo Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a bold, expressive Napa Valley red wine with an opaque purple-ruby core. It opens with intense aromatics of cassis, dark plum, and blackberry preserves, seamlessly layered with accents of cocoa, toasted oak, sweet vanilla, and crushed graphite. On the palate, it is rich, full-bodied, and velvety, offering concentrated dark fruit flavors framed by fine-grained, structured tannins and a long, seamless finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, venison, and aged hard cheeses like sharp cheddar or Gouda.

kozak-vodka.title: Broken Oak Dill Pickle Vodka
kozak-vodka.bodyHtml:
Broken Oak Dill Pickle Vodka is a flavoured vodka from the Broken Oak range made in Grande Prairie, Alberta. It starts with a premium grain-based vodka that is given the savoury, tangy character of dill pickles, producing a smooth spirit with a bold, briny flavour. The producer recommends it for Caesars, and it can also be served as a chilled shot. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Savoury and tangy dill pickle over a smooth grain vodka.

Serve: In a Caesar with a pickle spear garnish, or ice-cold as a shot.

chateau-du-glana-cru-bourgeois.title: Chateau du Glana Saint-Julien 2015
chateau-du-glana-cru-bourgeois.bodyHtml:
The 2015 Château du Glana is a classic Saint-Julien offering aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, cherry, cedar, tobacco, graphite, and subtle vanilla. Aged in French oak, it delivers ripe dark fruit, velvety tannins, fresh acidity, and a balanced, elegant finish with excellent aging potential. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled ribeye, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, mushroom dishes, aged Comté, or hard cheeses.

 

90 Points - James Suckling

The full black-fruit aromas make this generous and well-rounded wine with rather gentle tannins easy to enjoy now. The finish is very supple and with clearer contors, this would rate even more highly. Drink now or in 2019 and 2020.

g-m-mortlach-25-year-distillery-label.title: Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Mortlach 25 Year Old
g-m-mortlach-25-year-distillery-label.bodyHtml: Rich and full; Sherry and orange marmalade notes combine with stewed dates and prunes. Underlying herbal aromas surface and transform into brown sugar with gentle toffee highlights. Pronounced Sherry influences join crème brûlée, orange marmalade, sultana, and raisin flavours. Hints of mature oak appear whilst an aniseed edge underscores dark chocolate notes. Medium finish with lingering charred oak and cocoa powder.

g-m-strathisla-1987-connoisseurs-choic.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Strathisla 33 Year Old 1987 Refill American Hogshead Cask 3053
g-m-strathisla-1987-connoisseurs-choic.bodyHtml:
Fresh APPLE aromas combine with hints of CINNAMON. Freshly cut GRASS and sweet HONEY notes complement LIME ZEST. Strong TROPICAL FRUIT flavours lead to CRACKED BLACK PEPPER and CINNAMON. GOLDEN SYRUP and LIME notes leave a soft NUTTY edge.

Strong TROPICAL FRUIT flavours lead to CRACKED BLACK PEPPER and CINNAMON. GOLDEN SYRUP and LIME notes leave a soft NUTTY edge.

33 Year Old, 174 Bottle Batch, Cask 3053, Refill American Hogshead.

dewars-white-label-1.title: Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky 1.14L
dewars-white-label-1.bodyHtml: Created in 1899, 'White label' is the pillar of the Dewar's portfolio, maintaining its flavour profile throughout the years has ensured its timelessness; pale amber colour with rich honey sweetness, hints of heather and a touch of peat smoke that add to the rounded flavours and smooth satisfying finish.

bumbu-creme.title: Bumbu Crème Rum Cream Liqueur
bumbu-creme.bodyHtml: Bumbu Creme is a perfect blend of Bumbu Rum, select spices, and rich, decadent, real dairy cream. It's an irresistible creation that is perfect chilled straight, on the rocks, or in a cocktail. Bumbu Creme shares the same heritage that has made Bumbu the world’s favorite craft rum maker.

ardbeg-monsters-of-smoke.title: Ardbeg 10 Year Old
ardbeg-monsters-of-smoke.bodyHtml:
Ardbeg 10 Year Old is a world-renowned Islay single malt Scotch whisky revered by peat enthusiasts for its intensely smoky, complex, and surprisingly balanced profile. Distilled on the rugged south coast of Islay, it is matured for a minimum of ten years in a combination of first-fill and second-fill American oak ex-bourbon casks. Bottled non-chill-filtered at 46% ABV to preserve maximum flavor and texture, it showcases Ardbeg's signature phenolic peat smoke—drawn from heavily peated malted barley—alongside bright lemon and lime zest, coastal sea spray, and creamy vanilla sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh Pacific oysters, smoked salmon, grilled langoustines, barbecued pork ribs, dark chocolate truffles, and pungent blue cheeses such as Roquefort or Stilton.

Tasting Notes : Pale straw gold with bright platinum highlights, presenting a full, oily body with a rich and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense bonfire peat smoke, fresh lemon and lime zest, coastal sea brine, cracked black pepper, sweet vanilla, and subtle menthol.

Palate : Explosive peat smoke balanced by bright citrus fruits, sweet malted cereal, espresso, dark chocolate, tarry rope, and creamy toffee.

Finish : Very long, smoky, and warming with lingering notes of sea salt, toasted malt, charred oak, and sweet aniseed.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip-shaped whisky tasting glass, or add a few drops of pure water to tame the intense smoke and highlight the underlying citrus and vanilla sweetness.

lagavulin-26-year-old-2021-special-relea.title: Lagavulin 12 Year Old Special Release 2024 Fireside Tales
lagavulin-26-year-old-2021-special-relea.bodyHtml:
This is Lagavulin character made sweet under the command of active oak. Bold smoke quietened to a hush, matured in first-fill ex-Bourbon and refill casks for a lush and glazed aroma. Experience a 12-year-old expression with thick toffee, vanilla, and coconut notes, unfurling with aromatic spice. A testament to oak's dynamic influence on bold character: powerful peat tempers into inviting sweetness.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements grilled oysters, smoked salmon, charred ribeye steak, barbecue lamb, aged cheddar, blue cheese, and dark chocolate desserts with sea salt or chili accents.

dusty-boots-hard-root-beer-1.title: Dusty Boots Hard Root Beer 6 Bottles

lvivske-1715.title: Lvivske 1715 450ml
lvivske-1715.bodyHtml:
Lvivske is the oldest Ukrainian beer, which monks began brewing back in 1715. Nowadays, Lvivske has become part of the Ukrainian history. It is a symbol of the epoch and pride of Ukraine.

Lvivske 1715 is a light beer of flawless quality that is based on tercentenary traditions and even more ancient secrets of Lviv brewers. The secrets of the ancient recipe were passed by word of mouth, from father to son. Light hoppy beverage with pure malt aroma and inimitable taste is a true discovery for all who are devoted to classics and ancient traditions.

plantation-barbados-10-year-old.title: Plantation Planteray Single Cask 10 Year Old Rum
plantation-barbados-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Plantation Barbados 10 Year Old is a single cask rum from the 2021 Single Cask release, distilled at West Indies Rum Distillery in Barbados. Following Plantation's double-ageing method, it spent four years in bourbon casks before a further five and a half years of maturation in Ferrand cognac casks, then finished for four months in an ex-Oloroso sherry cask. This bottling comes from cask number 16 and is bottled at 49.3% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

tavernello-sangiovese-cab-sauv-igt.title: Tavernello Sangiovese Cabernet Rubicone 2020 750ml
tavernello-sangiovese-cab-sauv-igt.bodyHtml:
With juicy flavours of ripe cherry and blackberry and a subtle hint of oak spice, Tavernello Sangiovese Rubicone IGT is a well balanced and fresh red wine from Romagna, with good body. The red fruit flavours and freshness of this wine complements a wide range of flavours, including tomato-based pasta, cold cuts and cheeses. Try it with the traditional local “piadina” (flat bread) with Parma ham, buffalo mozzarella and rocket.

Best served at room temperature, between 16-18 °C.

Bottle 750ml (12% VOL.)

cristal-brut-double-magnum-louis-roedere.title: Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2012 3L Double Magnum
cristal-brut-double-magnum-louis-roedere.bodyHtml:
2012 was one of the most challenging and complicated years ever experienced in Champagne. However, difficult conditions often lead to great things. Due to the unpredictable weather, the low yields and continental conditions towards the end of the season gave us exceptional levels of maturity, resulting in rich, full-bodied and structured wines worthy of the most outstanding vintages in Champagne.

Rich and complex aromas with notes of zesty and candied fruit (lemon) mingled with pollen (white flowers), roasted hazelnut and Madagascar vanilla. After aeration, the bouquet develops rich notes of fresh pastries and smoky notes from bottle ageing.

A delicious, concentrated and chalky palate. It shows incredible tension and perfectly honed aromatic precision. The attack is powerful, distinctive and concentrated and reveals a silky, mouth-coating texture characteristic of the ripe Pinot noirs from the 2012 vintage.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

As the first 100% biodynamic Cristal, entirely from Roederer-owned vineyards, this is an important milestone. This latest incarnation is a great Champagne with its density, elegance and poise. Still impressively young, the wine is taut, tightly wound and textured. At the same time, it has pure, ripe white and citrus fruits that are perfumed, and an important part of this wine’s long-term future. Drink at the earliest from 2023.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Aromas of clear honey, crisp green orchard fruit, white peach, pastry cream and dried white flowers introduce the 2012 Cristal, a full-bodied, concentrated and powerful wine that's built for the cellar. Broader, more textural and more muscular than the 2008 Cristal, with seemingly even greater reserves of structuring dry extract, the 2012 is incisive and searingly chalky. This is the first Cristal produced exclusively from organically farmed fruit, and it marks the opening of a new chapter for Louis Roderer. The blend is 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay, vinified without malolactic fermentation and disgorged with 7.5 grams per liter dosage. Chef de Caves Jean-Baptiste Lecaillon has once again excelled himself. 

97 Points - Wine Spectator
A classic beauty, fresh-faced and focused today but with a harmonious grace of form suggesting a long career ahead. There's a creamy, viscous quality to the mousse that swathes the palate, carrying finely detailed flavors of poached quince, Mandarin orange preserves, toasted almond and pickled ginger. Mouthwatering throughout, with a pleasing, soft zestiness to the mineral-laced finish. Drink now through 2035.

cedarcreek-merlot.title: CedarCreek Cabernet Sauvignon-Merlot
cedarcreek-merlot.bodyHtml:
A fresh, approachable Bordeaux-style red blend with red cherry, plum and dark berry fruit accompanied by leafy herbal notes and subtle spice. The palate is medium-bodied and dry, with bright acidity, supple tannins and a clean, savoury finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast beef, burgers, grilled lamb, steak frites, mushroom dishes, or aged cheeses.

kilchomam-100-islay.title: Kilchoman 100% Islay
kilchomam-100-islay.bodyHtml: Our 100% Islay range is Islay’s only Single Farm Single Malt Scotch Whisky. It represents the revival of traditional farm distilling; growing our own barley before malting, distilling, maturing and bottling every bottle of our 100% Islay range on site.

kilkerran-16-year-old.title: Kilkerran 16 Year Old
kilkerran-16-year-old.bodyHtml: A 16-year-old Kilkerran single malt. Has aromas of garden herbs, citrus, vanilla cream, lemon meringue pie and hints of brine on the nose. The palate offers notes of honeyed cereals, rich malt, dry peat smoke, dried herbs, black pepper and aniseed that linger in the finish alongside sea salt and ashy smoke.

trefethen-dragons-tooth-oak-knoll-2018.title: Trefethen Dragon's Tooth 2019
trefethen-dragons-tooth-oak-knoll-2018.bodyHtml:
Their Nana, Catherine Trefethen, was Welsh. Her twin loves of wine and family were the original inspiration for our estate in Napa Valley’s Oak Knoll District. Celebrating our heritage, “Y Ddraig Goch”, the symbol of Wales, adorns this bottle of Dragon’s Tooth, a provocative blend born from the rockiest part of the vineyard.

Bold, dark fruit aromas of blackberry, plum, and boysenberry are complemented by notes of clove, nutmeg, and cedar. Generous on the palate, the lively acidity and youthful tannins add depth and energy, leading to a long, concentrated finish. Winery Chef Chris Kennedy suggests pairing Dragon‘s Tooth with our Four Cheese Ravioli with Smoked Ham and Greens. The smoky flavor of the ham highlights the dark fruit notes of the wine and the greens complement its peppery notes while the complex richness of the cheese cuts nicely through the tannins on the finish.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This blend of Bordeaux grape varieties starting with Malbec offers deep black- and red-cherry aromas, a good, moderately tannic texture, substantive fruit flavors and oak spices ranging from clove to cedar to cinnamon.

chateau-canon-la-gaffeliere-grand-cru-cl.title: Chateau Canon La Gaffeliere 2016
chateau-canon-la-gaffeliere-grand-cru-cl.bodyHtml:
A prestigious Saint-Émilion Grand Cru Classé with expressive aromas of blackberry, black cherry, violet, graphite, cedar, and exotic spice. Silky tannins, vibrant freshness, and remarkable precision create an elegant Bordeaux with exceptional depth and outstanding aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, truffle dishes, aged Comté, or wild mushroom risotto.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

The aromas are wonderfully complex, revealing sweet tobacco, black truffle, blueberry, blackberry and subtle menthol notes. Full-bodied yet remarkably elegant, with finesse, purity and beautifully integrated tannins that melt seamlessly into the wine. A fabulous young Saint-Émilion. Try from 2023.

96 Points - Vinous

The 2016 Canon La Gaffelière is every bit as impressive from bottle as it was from barrel. Bright, intensely aromatic and exceptionally precise, it bursts with sweet red cherry, pomegranate, blood orange and rose petal aromas. Silky, refined and beautifully nuanced, this vintage emphasizes elegance and balance over sheer power. A compelling wine with tremendous class.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

One of the most elegant and seamless wines of the vintage, the 2016 Canon La Gaffelière is a blend of 55% Merlot, 35% Cabernet Franc and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, aged in 60% new French oak. Medium- to full-bodied, it combines brilliant minerality with cassis, spice box, cedar, licorice and dried earth. Silky tannins, flawless balance and a long finish highlight the purity and elegance of the vintage. Enjoy over the next 20+ years.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of 55% Merlot, 35% Cabernet Franc and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon from organically certified vines, the 2016 Canon La Gaffelière offers one of the estate's most cerebral aromatic profiles, combining mineral-rich red and black fruit with flinty precision. Beautifully balanced and driven by the Cabernet component, the palate features lifted black fruit, graphite notes and a distinctly Left Bank character. Fresh, taut and linear, it finishes with remarkable persistence. This wine deserves 4–5 years of bottle age and may ultimately surpass the outstanding 2015.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Bold tannins, rich fruit and vibrant acidity combine to create a wine that is powerful while remaining fresh and elegant. Black-currant flavors shine through the structure, leading to a juicy, perfumed finish. Best after 2025.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

A vibrant core of red and black currant preserves is layered with bramble, roasted applewood and sweet tobacco notes. Outstanding purity, energy and drive carry through to a mouthwatering, mineral-laced finish. Best from 2022 through 2038.

93 Points - Decanter

Another excellent Saint-Émilion from this estate, showcasing careful extraction and beautifully polished black fruit. Supple tannins, rich fruit and fresh acidity create an appealing push-and-pull balance. Certified organic since the 2014 vintage. Drinking Window: 2027–2045.

91 Points - Connoisseurs' Guide

Opening with inviting aromas of red cherries and fine hardwood, this graceful wine balances elegance with vibrant fruit richness. Polished rather than powerful, it possesses lively energy and silky, refined tannins that support at least another five to eight years of cellaring.

poplar-grove-csm.title: Poplar Grove CSM 2020
poplar-grove-csm.bodyHtml:
Poplar Grove CSM 2020 is an incredibly refined, energetic, and beautifully structured red blend from the Naramata Bench pioneer, Poplar Grove Winery. Crafted from estate-grown fruit sourced 60% from vineyards in Osoyoos and 40% in Penticton, this complex vintage pours a deep purple in the color. The nose opens with a fragrant, expressive bouquet of purple plum, baking spices, and wet tobacco. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-bodied, remarkably balanced mouthfeel driven by a core of sage, blackberry, dark cherry, and subtle vanilla bean. Supported by a crisp vein of natural acidity and smooth, rounded tannins, it glides seamlessly into a fresh, lively, and dry finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with charcoal-grilled gourmet sausages, wood-fired pepper salami pizza, slow-simmered savory meat stews, or grilled lamb chops.

castellani-michele-cinque-stelle-amarone.title: Castellani Michele Collezione Ca' Del Pipa Cinque Stelle Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico 2017 750ml

dirty-laundry-kay-syrah.title: Dirty Laundry 'Kay's Syrah' 2022
dirty-laundry-kay-syrah.bodyHtml: Perfumed violet, meaty, musk notes fill this full-bodied Syrah, propped up with cloves, mince, and pepper. The palate is a soft pillow of blackberry jam, cassis, sweet salami, milk chocolate and lingering pink peppercorn, tugged in at the sides with light tannins. It's co-fermented with five percent viognier skins to add some perfumed notes to this ample red.

bud-light-2.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-2.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

wolfberger-tokay-pinot-gris.title: Wolfberger Signature Collection Pinot Gris
wolfberger-tokay-pinot-gris.bodyHtml:
Wolfberger Signature Collection Pinot Gris is an exceptionally aromatic, rich, and beautifully balanced French white wine that showcases the true noble character of Alsatian Pinot Gris. Sourced from choice vineyards in Alsace, the grapes are harvested at optimal ripeness to highlight the varietal's natural complexity. In the glass, it reveals a brilliant golden-yellow hue. The nose is refined and highly expressive, offering luscious aromas of ripe yellow pears, dried apricots, and fresh peaches, beautifully layered with delicate hints of toasted almonds, wild honey, and subtle gingerbread spices. On the palate, this medium-dry white is wonderfully supple, round, and harmonious, striking a flawless balance between its slightly sweet, opulent fruit texture and a vibrant line of clean, refreshing acidity that leads to an elegant and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted duck breast, chicken in rich cream sauces, light veal dishes, or aged Comté cheese.

champagne-gremillet-rose-de-saignee.title: Gremillet Cuvee Brut Rose Champagne 750ml
champagne-gremillet-rose-de-saignee.bodyHtml: It offers a whole basket of sun-drenched red and black berries: Strawberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, Blackcurrants, Red Cherries and Redcurrants. The taste is full, mellow and fleshy, a perfect balance of flavour and softness. The intense richness of the fruit is amplified by its fine bubbles.

smirnoff-ice-24-bottles.title: Smirnoff Ice 24x330ml Bottles
smirnoff-ice-24-bottles.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Ice is the OG! This classic vodka-based cooler is lightly carbonated with natural citrus aromas and flavours of lemon-lime and grapefruit. The palate is delicately sweet with a zesty lemonade taste on the crisp and pleasantly effervescent finish. Enjoy chilled or over ice. Great with bbq, wings and finger foods.

pajaru-paritaru-negroamaro.title: Tenuta del Pajaru Paritaru Negroamaro 2024
pajaru-paritaru-negroamaro.bodyHtml:
Tenuta del Pajaru Paritaru Negroamaro 2024 is a bold, intensely rich, and full-bodied red wine that perfectly captures the sun-drenched terroir of Southern Italy. It pours a deep, almost impenetrable ruby color and opens with a powerful, persistent bouquet of dark fruit, featuring prominent notes of blackberry jam, black cherries, and ripe plums. These fruit aromas are seamlessly interwoven with complex nuances of baking chocolate, cloves, leather, and an appealing earthiness. On the palate, it is beautifully concentrated and smooth, delivering layered flavors of dark berries, toasted oak, and dark chocolate. The wine is balanced by soft, approachable tannins and a dense, mouthcoating texture, leading to a long, warm, and spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with hearty meat stews, roasted lamb, slow-cooked beef, rich and savory pasta dishes, and mature, aged cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

A restrained and spicy wine with leather, raspberry and earth aromas. Off-dry and medium-bodied with ripe fruit, firm and chalky yet ripe tannins, crisp acidity and a tight yet balanced finish. From organically grown grapes. Vegan. Drink now.

jadot-nuits-st-georges-les-boudots-gagey.title: Louis Jadot Nuits-Saint-Georges Les Boudots Premier Cru Domaine Gagey 2022
jadot-nuits-st-georges-les-boudots-gagey.bodyHtml:
This firm, full-bodied Premier Cru is vigorous on the palate, with deep aromas and considerable structure that will mellow with age. This will develop favorably in the bottle for 12 to 15 years.

Serve with meat in red wine sauce, marinated game and medium-intensity cheeses.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Nuits-Saint-Georges 1er Cru Les Boudots (Domaine Gagey) has turned out very nicely, wafting from the glass with aromas of plums, red berries, orange zest and baking spices. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and enveloping, it's supple and suave, with melting tannins and a saline finish.
93 Points - Wine Spectator
Enticing aromas of rose, cherry, strawberry, earth and black pepper introduce this silky red. Beautifully balanced and delineated, with a vibrant feel and refined tannins through the lingering, multidimensional aftertaste, which offers a smoky accent. Best from 2028 through 2045.

jadot-corton-greves-2014-magnum.title: Louis Jadot Corton Greves Grand Cru 2014 1.5L Magnum
jadot-corton-greves-2014-magnum.bodyHtml: The 2014 Louis Jadot Corton Grand Cru Les Grèves is a powerful, full-bodied red wine with silky tannins and a harmonious acidity. It showcases notes of red cherry, pomegranate, earth, game, oak, and menthol. The wine exhibits a broad-shouldered flavor profile with mouth-coating dry extract and a long, rustic, and austere finish, indicating a need for further aging.

jadot-corton-greves-2013-magnum.title: Louis Jadot Corton Greves Grand Cru 2013 1.5L Magnum
jadot-corton-greves-2013-magnum.bodyHtml:
The commune of Aloxe-Corton has the unusual distinction of having over half its area covered in Grand Cru vineyards. The Corton Grands Crus are situated on the famous "Rognon de Corton". They have an exposure ranging from East to South and Southwest.

The Grand Cru is a powerful wine with a structure similar to Côte de Nuits wines. The vineyard orientation allows to elaborate a wine with silky tannins and harmonious acidity. Les Grèves is a Southeast exposure vineyard based on a siliceous soil. This gives power and delicacy to the wine.

This exceptional site yields a powerful and delicate wine, with a deep color and powerful aromas of little red fruits and spicy notes. Its silky tannins and perfect structure will allow a good aging.

The red wines will complement fine dishes like meat in a highly-seasoned sauce, game, and most cheeses. This wine should not be drunk before 5 years and will certainly improve until 15 to 20 years.

blue-run-straight-bourbon.title: Blue Run Kentucky Straight High Rye Bourbon
blue-run-straight-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Blue Run Kentucky Straight High Rye Bourbon Whiskey is a high-proof Kentucky bourbon from Blue Run Spirits, its label marked with an iridescent butterfly and the words High Rye. It is bottled at 111 proof (55.5% ABV) in a 750ml bottle. It was the first Blue Run whiskey made with bourbon veteran Jim Rutledge as the contracted master distiller, and it came out as the company's second fall release. A bold, full-strength bourbon for drinkers who like the spice that a rye-heavy recipe brings.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water or a large ice cube.

marchesi-di-barolo-dolcetto-dalba-bosch.title: Marchesi Di Barolo Bosset Dolcetto d'Alba 2020
marchesi-di-barolo-dolcetto-dalba-bosch.bodyHtml: A vibrant and quintessential "everyday" red from Piedmont, the 2020 "Bossèt" Dolcetto d'Alba by Marchesi di Barolo is celebrated for its youthful energy and approachable style. This wine presents a brilliant ruby red color with intense purple highlights. The bouquet is fresh and highly aromatic, dominated by clear notes of Maraschino cherry and raspberry, complemented by whispers of aromatic herbs. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and dry, showcasing a harmonious balance between a rustic, fruity core and a refreshing, low-acidity profile. Vinified in steel and aged in vitrified concrete tanks to preserve its fruit-driven purity, it concludes with a clean, sapid finish.

roth-cabernet-sauvignon-alexander-valley.title: Rodney Strong Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020/2021 750ml
roth-cabernet-sauvignon-alexander-valley.bodyHtml:
Aromas of lush, red plum and dark berries with hints of cassis and milk chocolate. Dried fig and chewy tannins give this wine a strong backbone, while 24 months of barrel aging have softened this bold wine

92 Points Wine Enthusiast
Strength comes with finesse in this beautifully molded wine that wraps silky tannins around nicely ripe black cherries, blackberries and mint. The feel is lush yet balanced

louis-latour-chateau-corton-grancey-2017.title: Louis Latour Chateau Corton Grancey Grand Cru 2020
louis-latour-chateau-corton-grancey-2017.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Chateau Corton Grancey Grand Cru reveals a deep ruby color with a hint of garnet. It is complex on the nose with aromas of black cherry, blueberry, and mocha. Round in the mouth, it is lightly peppery on the final. This wine stands out for its complexity and the softness of its tannins.

98 Points - James Suckling

Complex meaty and spicy nose. This effortlessly marries the wild and refined sides of this Grand Cru! The fruit character stands on a mighty tower of tannins that are at once fine and slightly herbal. What an amazingly energetic finish!

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Delivers a velvety texture that wraps around flavors of black cherry, blackberry, plum, earth and spice. This is holding back a little now, with excellent balance and a finish that should develop even more length with time. Shows a solid core of fruit. Best from 2025 through 2045.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine reveals an umami-mushroom core, emerging from layers of black cherries and stone. The palate is sophisticated, with juicy tannins perfectly balanced by vibrant acidity, highlighting notes of black plum, wild thyme, and morello cherry.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Rich and round, the 2020 Château Corton-Grancey Grand Cru is a full-bodied, ample and layered wine evocative of raspberries, cherries, sweet spices, peonies and dark chocolate. Built around sweet, powdery tannins, a touch of subtle back-end warmth bears the signature of the hot, dry growing season.

la-caccia-toscana-rosso.title: Laterra Toscana Rosso Ritorno
la-caccia-toscana-rosso.bodyHtml:
This expressive Tuscan red offers aromas of black cherry, blackberry, plum, violet, and spice. Medium to full-bodied, the palate reveals ripe fruit, smooth tannins, balanced acidity, and subtle complexity, culminating in a long, polished, and harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled steak, braised beef, roast lamb, aged cheeses, charcuterie, mushroom dishes, rich pasta, hearty stews.

smokehead-high-voltage-single-malt.title: Smokehead High Voltage
smokehead-high-voltage-single-malt.bodyHtml: Deeply rich and intensely peaty, this one hits all the senses with a rush of black smoke, creamy, nutty notes and a tangy sea salt finish. Smokehead High Voltage is explosive and reserved for those who go all out. No matter what others think.

pyrat-xo-reserve-rum.title: Navy Island XO Reserve Jamaican Rum
pyrat-xo-reserve-rum.bodyHtml:
Navy Island XO Reserve is a blend of hand-selected Jamaican rums from the Navy Island Rum Company, named after the small island off Port Antonio that was once used by the British Royal Navy. The blend includes aged rums distilled in traditional Jamaican pot stills, giving the expressive, characteristically Jamaican nose the style is known for, with a full body and a long finish. Deep amber in colour, it is bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle and presented in a cylindrical gift tube. It took a Silver medal at the 2019 International Spirits Challenge in London.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla, ripe fruit, banana, baked apple, caramel.

Nose: Classic Jamaican character with vanilla, rich ripe fruit, banana, baked apple and caramel.

Palate: Full-bodied, elegant and well balanced.

Finish: Long and dry.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or in a rum Old Fashioned with Angostura bitters and dark cane syrup.

kujira-24-year-old-japanese-whisky.title: Kujira Ryukyu 24 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Japanese Whisky
kujira-24-year-old-japanese-whisky.bodyHtml:
This Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is 100% selected rice distilled and matured in first fill bourbon barrels for more than 24 years by Kumesen Shuzo in Okinawa. Okinawa is part of the Ryukyu Islands, which are a chain of subtropical islands located at the southernmost tip of Japan. Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is an utterly unique tropical style Japanese Whisky. Thanks to the island’s warm climate, whisky takes less time to mature and thus has a stronger aroma and a bolder taste.

Kumesen Syuzo has been operational since 1952, and its primary product is Awamori. Back in 1989, though, the distillery started experimenting with whisky making in different oak barrels. In 2018, it introduced its first 20 Year Old Single Grain Whisky aged in bourbon cask also known as Kujira Ryukyu whisky.

This small batch Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is matured in bourbon barrel for more than 24 years which is made entirely of rice provides a wonderful taste profile that has distinguished itself from its malt counterparts and creates a refreshing choice for spirits lovers.

Gold 95pts (International Wine & Spirit Competition 2021)

Nose: herbs, dried plum fruits hint, prune, mint candy
Palate: sweet, chocolate, vanilla, spice, light smoky woodiness
Finish: licorice, Japanese pepper, long finish

okayama-japanese-single-malt-whisky.title: Okayama Single Malt Japanese Whisky
okayama-japanese-single-malt-whisky.bodyHtml: Okayama Single Malt comes from Miyashita distillery in the south of Japan. Made from malted barley, of which half comes from Japan and half from Germany, and aged for three years in brandy barrels, this was released to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the distillery. This is floral and spicy with a malty backbone. Limited availability.

jack-daniels-single-barrel-coy-hill.title: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Coy Hill High Proof
jack-daniels-single-barrel-coy-hill.bodyHtml: Jack Daniel’s Single Barrel 2022 Special Release Coy Hill High Proof – This special release serieshighlights our innovation in whiskey making here at Jack Daniel Distillery. Hand-selected from the highest parts of our barrel houses and bottled from single barrels, we extend this one-of-kind craftmanship to you.

montecillo-vina-monty-gran-reserva.title: Montecillo Rioja Gran Reserva 2015
montecillo-vina-monty-gran-reserva.bodyHtml:
Montecillo Rioja Gran Reserva 2019 is an elegant, traditionally styled Spanish red wine from the renowned Rioja region. Produced by historic Bodegas Montecillo, this Gran Reserva combines ripe black cherry, blackberry, and redcurrant with complex notes of tobacco, leather, vanilla, and sweet spice. Extended oak and bottle maturation contribute polished tannins and a velvety texture, while balanced acidity maintains freshness. Its long, savoury finish makes it an excellent choice for roasted meats, aged cheeses, and special occasions.

Food Pairing: Roast lamb, grilled ribeye, braised beef, duck breast, mushroom risotto, aged Manchego, and slow-cooked stews.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This has a creamy blackberry and redcurrant texture and is lively with scents of sweet spice, tobacco, leather, and violets. Lingering graphite on the finish rounds out a superbly harmonious Rioja that, while excellent now, has plenty of life left ahead.

phillips-blackberry-brandy.title: Leroux Jeżynówka Polish Blackberry Brandy
phillips-blackberry-brandy.bodyHtml:
Leroux Jeżynówka Polish Blackberry Brandy is a blackberry flavoured brandy made in the style of the traditional Polish fruit cordial. Leroux blends premium blackberries with fine brandy and seasons the result with baking spice to suit the Polish taste, giving a smooth, gently spiced drink. The Leroux family of distillers traces its roots back more than 100 years to Belgium; today its flavoured brandies, liqueurs and schnapps are made in the United States. It is made for Old World-style shots and works equally well as a sweet, fruity accent in stirred cocktails. Bottled at 35% ABV in a 750 ml bottle.

Serve: Pour as a chilled shot, or add a splash to an Old Fashioned or a Blood and Sand.

pommery-champagne-brut-rose.title: Pommery Brut Rose Royal 750ml
pommery-champagne-brut-rose.bodyHtml: This rosé is a faithful variation of classic Pommery Brut Royal created through the assembly of a red wine made with this mind, and different wines vinified in white, within a great proportion of chardonnay.

caymus-cabernet-sauvingon-double-magnum.title: Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 3L Double Magnum
caymus-cabernet-sauvingon-double-magnum.bodyHtml: Caymus has a signature style that is dark in color, with rich fruit and ripe tannins – as approachable in youth as in maturity. Since its founding in 1972, Caymus has become renowned as a consistent leader in the production of Napa Valley Cabernet. Grapes for this wine are farmed in a range of Napa’s sub-appellations – from Coombsville to Calistoga – with fruit from the valley floor creating lushness and the hillsides providing backbone. Diversification enables us to make the best possible wine in a given year, featuring layered, lush aromas and flavors, including cocoa, cassis and ripe berries.

farnese-edizione-collection.title: Fantini Edizione Cinque Autoctoni 23
farnese-edizione-collection.bodyHtml:
Fantini Edizione Cinque Autoctoni 23 is a rich, full-bodied, and deeply structured non-vintage Italian red wine crafted from a master blend of five native grape varieties harvested from ancient vines across Abruzzo and Puglia. Cinque Autoctoni is Italian for “Five Native Grapes,” referring to the indigenous varieties selected for this bottling: Montepulciano adds dark fruit, body, and structure; Primitivo contributes ripe, jammy fruit and richness; Sangiovese brings acidity, red fruit, and freshness; Negroamaro adds deep color, spice, and earthy notes; while Malvasia Nera contributes aromatic intensity, softness, and fruity character. Visually displaying a dense, dark ruby-garnet hue, it opens with an intense and persistent bouquet of ripe blackberries, black currants, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with sweet exotic spices, cocoa, licorice, cedar, and crushed gravel minerality. On the palate, it delivers a plush, velvety mouthfeel balanced by a vibrant core of acidity, structured with softly integrated tannins that lead into a long, warm, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with braised beef short ribs, roasted lamb, wild boar ragù, grilled ribeye steak, and aged Pecorino cheese.

amrut-two-indies-rum.title: Amrut Two Indies Rum
amrut-two-indies-rum.bodyHtml:
Colour : Golden Amber;

Nose : Almond with freshly cut sugarcane, tropical fruits with a hint of ripened banana;

Taste : Sugarcane with a dash of tropical fruits and honey and running slightly dry;

Finish : Sweet and dry finish;

g-m-glenlivet-1978-private-collection.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glenlivet 1978 Bottled 2018 53.5% ABV
g-m-glenlivet-1978-private-collection.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet spirit continues to command respect and is highly revered around the world for its exceptionally smooth character and our Gordon & MacPhail 1978 from Glenlivet Distillery truly delivers on this promise. Matured in a refill Sherry hogshead, this exquisite single malt delicately balances sweet sherried aromas with warming chili and orange marmalade notes on the palate.

NOSE

Sweet sherried aromas weave into layers of roasted hazelnut, soft fudge, milk chocolate, and plump, rumsoaked raisins. Flashes of fresh citrus peel break through and, combined with polish notes, balance the sweetness.

TASTE

Smooth and spicy; warm demerara sugar disperses over warming chili, cinnamon, and clove spice flavors. Intense, thick-cut orange marmalade notes unfold into a lingering charred oak edge.

FINISH

Long, spicy, refined, and well-balanced.

eau-claire-christmas-gin.title: Eau Claire Distillery Christmas Gin
eau-claire-christmas-gin.bodyHtml:
Eau Claire Distillery Christmas Gin is a seasonal gin from Alberta's Eau Claire Distillery in Turner Valley, made each year for the holidays. Master Distiller Caitlin Quinn built it on the distillery's traditional London-style gin, adding frankincense and myrrh, two of the three gifts of the wise men, and later the third gift: flakes of 24 karat gold that sparkle in the bottle and the glass. The spice resins give the gin a rounded mouthfeel and a lemony, balsamic edge, while juniper and coriander keep it recognisably a gin. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle and was named Santa's Favourite Gin (Judges Selection) in 2021.

Nose: Balsamic and lemony, from the spice resins.

Palate: Juniper and coriander woven with frankincense and myrrh for a festive, floral character.

Finish: Long and floral with complex earthy notes.

Serve: On its own, in a martini or topped with Prosecco.

daou-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon.title: DAOU Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
daou-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
DAOU Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a voluptuous, deeply complex, and velvety expression of premium Bordeaux-style winemaking from the high-elevation slopes of Paso Robles. Pouring an opaque purple-ruby hue, it greets the senses with a classic, expressive bouquet of wild blackberries, Zante currants, and cherry pipe tobacco, gracefully interwoven with nuances of baking spice, slate, dark cacao, and a hint of forest floor. On the palate, this full-bodied red is remarkably plush and mouth-filling, balancing a concentrated core of blueberry compote, black raspberry, and cassis with a lively vein of natural acidity. Matured carefully in French oak, its substantial structure is framed by fine-grained, polished tannins that carry the rich layers of dark fruit effortlessly into a long, persistent, and elegant finish accented by subtle notes of truffle and sweet cherry.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with a grilled prime ribeye steak with truffle butter, roasted lamb chops, port-braised beef short ribs, or a rich wild mushroom ragût.

95 Points - James Suckling

A finely constructed cabernet showing the freshness of the cooler 2023 vintage but still with all the Paso generosity. Aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry and cassis with notes of graphite, cedar, black olive and spice. The palate is full-bodied with finely tuned tannins, bright acidity and a polished mouthfeel. A blend of 90% cabernet sauvignon with touches of petit verdot and cabernet franc. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Black plum and roasted walnut aromas meet with woodspice on the nose of this bottling. The palate is tense and firm yet still brighter with blackberry, pepper and nut flavors that cling to the persistent structure.

kim-crawford-illuminate-sauvignon-blanc.title: Kim Crawford Illuminate Sauvignon Blanc
kim-crawford-illuminate-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: New Zealand is at the forefront of lower-calorie, lower-alcohol wines. This one is produced using spinning cone distillation: a gentle process that doesn't use pressure or high temperatures and so has less impact on the aroma and flavour of the final wine. This fresh, aromatic Savvy shows tropical fruit, citrus and herbs and is perfect for seafood.

aberfeldy-18-year-old-pauillac-cask-1.title: Aberfeldy 18 Year Old Pauillac Cask
aberfeldy-18-year-old-pauillac-cask-1.bodyHtml: An incredibly elegant and fruitful whisky that initially spent 18 years in a combination of refill casks and a finishing period of around 4-5 months in first-fill Pauillac wine casks.
