Offers Aberfeldy’ s wonderfully soft signature honey and creamy vanilla notes invigorated with swathes of plush ripe fruits and lovely nutty aromas.

glen-grant-1990-duncan-taylor-octaves.title: Duncan Taylor The Octave Premium Glen Grant 30 Year Old 1990 55.8% ABV
glen-grant-1990-duncan-taylor-octaves.bodyHtml:
From The Octave range, this is a 30 year old Glen Grant.

A gloriously well-aged single malt from Glen Grant, a distillery that happens to produce single malt that ages gloriously well! Distilled in 1990, the whisky was matured for 30 years, including time in a single octave cask. Released by independent bottler Duncan Taylor who bottled it up in 2020 for its ongoing The Octave series, with a total outturn of 79 bottles.

amrut-neidhal-peated-indian-single-malt.title: Amrut Peated Indian Single Malt Whisky
amrut-neidhal-peated-indian-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Nose : Unusually dry peat; not dissimilar to peat reek absorbed by an old leather armchair; a hint of citrus, too;

Taste : Despite the nose, the immediate sensation is one of being caressed by molassed sugar and then a ratching up of the peat notes. As they get more forceful, so the experience becomes that little bit drier and spicier, though not without the molasses refusing to give way;

Finish : You can tell the quality of the distillate and the barrels it has been matured in by the crystalline depth to the finish. Everything is clear on the palate and the butterscotch vanillas wrap the phenols for a comfortable and clean finale;

blue-spot-irish-whiskey.title: Blue Spot 7 Year Old Cask Strength Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
blue-spot-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Blue Spot 7 Year Old is a vibrant and highly acclaimed single pot still Irish whiskey resurrected after a 56-year hiatus. Bottled uncut at cask strength, it undergoes a complex maturation process for at least seven years in a combination of ex-Bourbon casks, ex-Sherry butts, and Portuguese ex-Madeira casks. The nose is remarkably lively and tropical, bursting with aromas of pineapple, kiwi, and green banana, layered with baked apple, toasted hazelnuts, and signature pot still spices. On the palate, it delivers an intense, full-flavored punch with a viscous, mouth-coating texture. Flavours of creamy vanilla, milk chocolate, and sweet wine are balanced by a sharp wave of black pepper, clove oil, and cinnamon spice. The finish is exceptionally long and powerful, leaving a lingering trail of exotic fruits, earthy oak, and warming spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with savory snacks like roasted almonds or walnuts, dark chocolate-covered ginger, smoked salmon canapés, or rich bread pudding.

paul-john-christmas-edition-2021.title: Paul John Christmas Edition 2021 Indian Single Malt
paul-john-christmas-edition-2021.bodyHtml:
With tawny tints and aromas of malt-tinged caramel, a rare dash of coconut, and sweet berries balanced against dry raisins, Paul John Christmas Edition 2021 is crafted from malts finished in Ex-Bourbon and a melange of Port and Madeira casks. Entice the palate with creamy flavours of delicate spice and butterscotch riding on a light smoked-laced barley that lead to a long finish of alluring spices, light peat and a flavourful cocoa.The 4th release of the limited Christmas Edition series from the award-winning Paul John Indian Single Malt, this expression bespeaks the joys of Christmas.

Colours:

Tawny.

Nose:

Caramel, orange marmalade, berries, malty, coconut and dry raisins.

Taste:

Creamy, spicy, light smoke, butterscotch and barley.

Finish:

Rather long and warming notes with Cocoa, light peat and spices.

Balances:

An exotic and multi-faceted peated malt with deep, creamy flavours and a rich finish.

clynelish-hunter-laing-authors-series.title: Hunter Laing First Editions Authors' Series Clynelish 27 Year Old 1993 Bourbon Cask 53.8% ABV
clynelish-hunter-laing-authors-series.bodyHtml:
Clynelish 27 Year Old 1993 is a single cask single malt Scotch whisky from Hunter Laing & Co.'s The First Editions Authors' Series, release No. 52, dedicated to Edward Everett Hale. Distilled at Clynelish in November 1993 and matured in a bourbon cask, it was bottled in March 2021 at cask strength of 53.8% ABV, giving just 170 bottles of 700ml. Each Authors' Series release honours a great writer with their portrait on the front label and a short biography on the back. The casks are selected by Andrew Laing for their richness and complexity, and the wax-sealed, decanter-style bottles come in a hinged gift box.

Serve: Neat, adding a few drops of water to taste.

j-christopher-dundee-hills-pinot-noir.title: Domaine Drouhin Oregon Dundee Hills Pinot Noir 2024
j-christopher-dundee-hills-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Domaine Drouhin Oregon Dundee Hills Pinot Noir 2024 is an incredibly elegant and beautifully poised expression of Oregon's premier cool-climate terroir, crafted with traditional Burgundian expertise. Displaying a lovely luminous ruby color in the glass, this estate-grown Pinot Noir opens with a remarkably bright and fragrant bouquet of wild blackberries, fresh marionberries, and red plums, intricately layered with delicate nuances of sandstone, crushed violets, fresh rose petals, and a touch of thyme. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and seamlessly structured, balancing its juicy core of black cherry and dark plum flavors with sophisticated, chalky tannins and an underlying earthy complexity. Matured carefully in custom French oak barrels from the Drouhin family's own cooperage in Burgundy, it retains a fantastic sense of purity and vibrant freshness, leading into a long, polished finish defined by classic estate spice and wild herb flavors.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with classic roast duck, pan-seared pheasant, grilled salmon fillets with wild mushrooms, or herb-roasted pork tenderloin.

96 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of wild blackberries, marionberries, sandstone, crushed violets and rose petals. Medium-bodied with structured, chalky tannins, dark fruit flavors of black cherries and red plums and a long finish. Drink after 2028.

tobermory-2004-oloroso-17-year-old-55-90.title: Tobermory 2004 Oloroso 17 Year Old 55.9% ABV
tobermory-2004-oloroso-17-year-old-55-90.bodyHtml:
Tobermory 17 Year Old 2004 Oloroso Cask Matured is a limited edition single malt from the Tobermory distillery on the Isle of Mull. Distilled in 2004, it spent its full 17 years of maturation in Oloroso sherry casks, which have packed it with flavour, and it is bottled at a powerful 55.9% ABV. 750ml, presented in a gift box.

Tasting Notes: Caramel, fruit and rose petal balanced by oak and leather.

Finish: Unusually dry and nutty.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water at this strength.

deanston-2008-oloroso-cask-limite-52-70.title: Deanston 12 Year Old 2008 Oloroso Cask Limited Edition
deanston-2008-oloroso-cask-limite-52-70.bodyHtml:
Deanston 12 Year Old 2008 Oloroso Cask is a limited edition Highland single malt, distilled at Deanston in 2008 and matured in Oloroso sherry casks before being bottled at 12 years old. The sherry wood gives a dense, sweet character with dried fruit and festive spice, a richer take on the distillery's usually honeyed style. Bottled at a robust 52.7% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is made, like every Deanston, from unpeated, locally sourced Highland barley.

Nose: Black forest gateau notes of cherries and chocolate, then sweet spice, nutmeg and sultanas.

Palate: Treacle toffee, dark fruit and festive spice, with touches of mocha and pine.

Finish: Long and warming, with gingerbread and nutmeg.

Serve: Neat, with a splash of water to open it up.

bunnahabhain-aonadh-2011-10-year-old-56.title: Bunnahabhain Aonadh 10 Year Old
bunnahabhain-aonadh-2011-10-year-old-56.bodyHtml: Bunnahabhain Aonadh 10 Year Old has been matured in a combination of sherry and port casks, creating a fruity, spicy dram. Aromas of vanilla, brandy butter, caramel, dark berries and oak spice fill the nose, complemented by notes of cinnamon, plums, blackberries, roasted walnuts, dark chocolate and a salty tang throughout the palate.

bodegas-vinicola-real-200-monges-reserva.title: Bodegas Vinicola Real 200 Monges Reserva 2012
bodegas-vinicola-real-200-monges-reserva.bodyHtml: Bodegas Vinícola Real 200 Monges Reserva 2012 is a refined "modern classic" Rioja, celebrated for its extraordinary evolution in the bottle and meticulous artisan craftsmanship. Sourced from very old vines in the Iregua Valley, the hand-picked grapes underwent fermentation in Allier oak vats before aging for a minimum of 20 to 24 months in new French and American oak barrels. The 2012 vintage presents a deep cherry hue with a garnet rim, offering a powerful and complex nose of ripe red berries, tobacco, cedar, and truffles, accented by sweet spices and balsamic notes. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-balanced, featuring noble tannins, high acidity, and a long, silky finish with lingering flavors of liquorice, black cherry, and espresso.

voerzio-barolo-fossati-case-nere-2003.title: Roberto Voerzio Fossati Case Nere Barolo Riserva 10 Anni 2003 750ml

biondi-santi-brunello-riserva-2006.title: Biondi-Santi Tenuta Greppo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2006
biondi-santi-brunello-riserva-2006.bodyHtml:
The Biondi-Santi Tenuta Greppo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2006 is a critically acclaimed vintage known for its immense finesse and elegance. Often described as a "meditation wine," it balances the typical high acidity of the estate with the concentrated structure of the 2006 harvest. 
98 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This is a re-release of a wine that first hit the market some seven years ago. The Il Greppo estate did not make a Riserva in the 2011 vintage, and the 2006 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva is being reintroduced to the market (with only 2,500 bottles) to fill in this gap. This is a stunning wine that absolutely merits this considerable score increase. Made when dottore Franco Biondi Santi was alive and very present in the winery, this wine shows spectacular elegance and finesse, articulated with fine aromas of forest berry, blue flower, eucalyptus and lightly barbecued smoke. The wine shows extreme Sangiovese elegance and purity, and while the wine is almost fragile in approach, it ultimately reveals more brawn, volume and staying-power than anticipated.

95 Points - James Suckling

This is a beautiful Brunello with dark-berry, balsamic and cedar aromas and flavors. Medium-bodied, round and rich. Flavorful finish. Shows focus and balance. Traditional and fascinating. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Biondi-Santi performs exceptionally well in elegant vintages like 2006. This wine is balanced and fresh, with lingering notes of wild berry, white cherry, cola, spice and dark chocolate. Age this wine 10 years or more.

biondi-santi-brunello-riserva-1995.title: Biondi-Santi Tenuta Greppo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 1995
biondi-santi-brunello-riserva-1995.bodyHtml:
The Biondi-Santi Tenuta Greppo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 1995 is a legendary, high-investment vintage that has achieved "meditation wine" status. It was produced using the estate's exclusive BBS11 clone from vines older than 25 years and aged for three years in Slavonian oak before extended refinement in the estate's "La Storica" library.
98 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Just re-released, this supremely elegant complex red is a testament to Brunello's remarkable aging potential. It opens with aromas evoking sunbaked earth, underbrush, new leather and mature berry that mingle with whiffs of flint and tar. The silky palate is chock–full of flavor and finesse, boasting mature black cherry, raspberry compote, tobacco and black tea framed in polished tannins and still tangy acidity. Drink through 2035.
96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 1995 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva opens to a dark garnet appearance and shows more visible concentration compared to the other library selection vintages presented at this tasting. The bouquet is broad and far reaching in character with dried blackberry and plum followed by savory tobacco and spice. This vintage is fleshy, rich and powerful. It offers balanced tertiary aromas, but they are not the protagonist, and that sense of impeccable balance serves as a measure of how well this wine has held up over time.
93 Points - James Suckling
Aromas of walnuts, dark fruit and dark chocolate. Some leather and licorice. Full-bodied, rich and chewy with firm and lightly dry tannins. But there’s freshness and brightness. Tastes of tradition. Drink now.

biondi-santi-brunello-riserva-2011.title: Biondi-Santi Tenuta Greppo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2015
biondi-santi-brunello-riserva-2011.bodyHtml:
The Biondi-Santi Tenuta Greppo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2015 is a monumental wine from a warm, sunny vintage, released in late 2021. It is celebrated for its rare combination of ripe, seductive fruit and the estate's signature "mineral austerity" and high-altitude freshness.

98 Points - Wine Advocate

The Biondi-Santi 2015 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva is initially a reticent wine and one that does not immediately subscribe to the overstated abundance and exuberance of the vintage. Give it time. I wrote this review after several tastings over several days so I could ensure a more accurate account of the wine's elegant reveal. Contemplative and exceedingly nuanced in personality, with wild berry, underbrush, ferrous earth and candied orange peel, this has everything to look forward to in terms of its future evolution in the bottle. It displays a pretty ruby color that borders on garnet and polished copper. A silky, mid-weight palate is accented by beautifully managed and silky tannins (this aspect of the mouthfeel is extraordinary), bright freshness and long-lasting fruit momentum. The alcohol is a bit more powerful in this release (at 14.5%), but the effect is supple and smooth nonetheless. I tasted bottle number 256.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

New leather, pressed rose and mature berry aromas slowly appear in the glass along with whiffs of underbrush and pipe tobacco. On the structured, elegant palate, firm but ultrarefined tannins provide the backbone for juicy Morello cherry, crushed raspberry, licorice and cake spice. While it promises decades of evolution, it's already rewarding and almost at the start of its long drinking window.

97 Points - James Suckling

Complex yet pure, subtle and refined nose that gently evolves, with mossy red cherries, dried roses, chalk, tar and dried orange peel. There is a lift of clove and eucalyptus that makes it so distinctive. A powerful, medium-to full-bodied Brunello, but seamless and bright, with a fine, transparent mid-palate and restrained, mineral austerity. Understated complexity that will need time to bloom. Hold until 2026.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Round and fruity, with an accent of white pepper against cherry, raspberry and floral flavors. Elegant and verging on racy, with a firm, well-integrated structure and excellent length on the minerally finish. Best from 2025 through 2048.

wine-gift-basket.title: Connoisseur Package
wine-gift-basket.bodyHtml:
Indulge in the finer things in life with our Connoisseur Package. Delivering our premium selection, this set of wines is sure to satisfy the needs of wine lovers wanting to experience the pinnacle of sophistication and heritage. It’s the perfect way to discover a variety of wines that embody a rich history and elegant flair.

  • Sought-after premium Wines from renowned regions around the world.
  • Handpicked selection by our team of experts.
  • 6 Bottles of Red & White option includes 4 Reds and 2 Whites, while the 12 Bottles of Red & White option includes 8 Reds and 4 Whites.
  • Product information, taste notes, reviews and ratings, and best food pairing suggestions are included.

marcati-limoncello.title: Strega Limoncello di Sorrento
marcati-limoncello.bodyHtml:
A premium Italian liqueur crafted in Campania using strictly protected Sorrento Lemons (Limone di Sorrento IGP). Known for its bright, sunny yellow color and rich, naturally aromatic profile, this digestif captures the intense essential oils of hand-harvested lemons steeped in fine spirit to deliver an authentic, refreshing taste of the Amalfi Coast.

Food Pairing: Citrus desserts, lemon tart, fruit tarts, panna cotta, dark chocolate, or biscotti.

Tasting Notes - A vibrant, sunny yellow liquid with a smooth, rich body and a pleasantly velvety mouthfeel.

Nose - Intensely aromatic with fresh citrus oils, vibrant lemon zest, and subtle hints of Mediterranean floral sweetness.

Palate - Mellow, round, and sweet lemon attack balanced by tangy lemon zest and subtle herbal undertones.

Finish - Long, crisp, and persistent finish with lingering fresh citrus peel and faint hints of eucalyptus.

Serve - Serve ice-cold straight from the freezer in chilled shot glasses as a digestif, over crushed ice, or topped with prosecco or tonic water.

billecart-salmon-cuvee-nicolas-francois.title: Billecart-Salmon Cuvee Nicolas Francois Brut Champagne 2015
billecart-salmon-cuvee-nicolas-francois.bodyHtml:
Billecart-Salmon Cuvée Nicolas François Brut Champagne 2015 is a prestigious vintage Champagne from the historic house of Billecart-Salmon, crafted from Chardonnay and Pinot Noir sourced from distinguished vineyards in the Côte des Blancs and Montagne de Reims. This elegant cuvée reveals aromas of baked apple, ripe stone fruit, citrus, and delicate brioche, complemented by floral and savoury nuances. Its fine mousse, vibrant acidity, and refined mineral character create a beautifully balanced palate, leading to a long, fresh, and gently toasted finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, lobster, seared scallops, grilled turbot, roasted poultry, truffle risotto, aged Comté, and delicate seafood dishes.
95 Points - James Suckling
An overt style of baked apples and stone fruit with vibrant lemons and chalk, as well as subtle brioche character. Medium-bodied, generous and large, showing fine mousse and crisp acidity. Tight yet focused with a toasty finish. Drink now.

kavalan-solist-vinho-barrique-56-30-abv.title: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-vinho-barrique-56-30-abv.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Cask is a single cask strength single malt whisky distilled, matured and bottled at the Kavalan Distillery in Yuanshan Township, Yilan County, Taiwan. It is fully matured in American oak barriques that once held wine and were shaved, toasted and re-charred (STR), a treatment that coaxes fruity vanilla notes from the wood. Kavalan describes a complex, multi-dimensional malt with pepper, spice, dates, ripe melon, mango, kiwi and a burst of citrus. This cask was bottled at 56.3% ABV in a 700ml bottle, without chill filtration and with natural colour.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla, caramel and dark chocolate with tropical fruit and pepper.

Nose: Vanilla and caramelised sugar with dark chocolate, ripe melon, mango, kiwi and citrus, pepper in the background.

Palate: Clean and complex.

Finish: Long aftertaste.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass; at cask strength, a few drops of water can open it up.

chateau-cos-destournel-2017.title: Chateau Cos d'Estournel 2017
chateau-cos-destournel-2017.bodyHtml:
Château Cos d'Estournel 2017 is an exceptionally refined, balanced, and expressive Left Bank red wine from the prestigious Saint-Estèphe appellation of Bordeaux. Crafted from a classic blend dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon along with Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot, it is aged in French oak barrels (60% new) to develop rich structural complexity. In the glass, it exhibits a deep garnet-purple core. The bouquet unfurls with captivating aromas of preserved plum, blackcurrant, and boysenberry intertwined with violet petals, sandalwood, cassis, Indian spices, and crushed gravel. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied, delivering dense dark berry fruit, vibrant natural acidity, and silky, polished tannins that extend into a long, ethereal, spice-laced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, prime ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, venison stew, and aged hard cheeses.

98 Points - James Suckling

Quite the bottle here! Spices, such as nutmeg and cinnamon, as well as dried meat and plums with cedar and sandalwood. Full body. Deep and dense in the center palate and a long, long finish. Shows finesse and tightness. Very polished tannins. Long and ethereal. Try after 2023.

98 Points - Wine Advocate

Composed of 66% Cabernet Sauvignon, 32% Merlot, 1% Petit Verdot and 1% Cabernet Franc, yields for the grand vin in 2017 were 43 hectoliters per hectare, and it was aged in 60% new oak. It came in at an alcohol of 13% and an IPT of 68. Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2017 Cos d'Estournel needs a little coaxing to unfurl, revealing beautiful expressions of preserved plums, boysenberries, blackcurrant pastilles and wild blueberries with hints of Indian spices, menthol, lilacs and mossy tree bark plus a compelling suggestion of iron ore. Medium to full-bodied, the palate has a solid backbone of firm, grainy tannins and well-knit freshness supporting the tightly wound blue and black fruits layers, finishing long and fragrant. This wine will need a good 5-7 years in bottle before it begins to blossom and should go on for at least another 40 years. I expect this wine to be a blockbuster of a head-turner when I come back and taste it at 10 years of age!

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This impressive wine is structured yet well balanced by an attractive fruitiness that parallels the tannins and the smokiness from wood aging. The density of the palate is countered by fresh acidity that shines through. Drink 2024.
94 Points - Wine Spectator
Bright and expressive, with an extroverted core of loganberry, plum and black cherry fruit racing to the fore, carried by a polished and sleek structure. Reveals a subtle mineral edge through the finish, with alluring black and red tea notes swirling around. The rare seductive St.-Estèphe. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2036.

baileys-original-irish-cream-1.title: Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur 50ml
baileys-original-irish-cream-1.bodyHtml:
Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur is a luxurious, velvety classic that blends fine Irish whiskey and spirits with rich, luscious dairy cream and hints of cocoa and vanilla. First introduced in 1974, it is the world’s most celebrated cream liqueur, offering a beautifully balanced, indulgent, and decadent drinking experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with dark chocolate desserts, molten lava cakes, tiramisu, and fresh berries. It also makes a wonderful accompaniment to warm apple pie, pecan tarts, or simply drizzled over premium vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Opaque, creamy light brown with a rich, velvety, and thick mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet cream, dark chocolate, vanilla, and a subtle hint of warming Irish whiskey.

Palate : Smooth and indulgent with rich flavors of fresh dairy cream, milk chocolate, cocoa, sweet vanilla, and mild whiskey warmth.

Finish : Sweet, long, and coat-the-tongue smooth with lingering chocolate, cream, and soft whiskey notes.

Serve : Serve chilled, poured over ice, or as a rich addition to hot coffee, hot chocolate, or desserts.

appleton-12-year-old-rare-casks.title: Appleton Estate 12 Year Old Rare Casks Rum 1L
appleton-12-year-old-rare-casks.bodyHtml: Appleton Estate Rare Blend 12 Year Old is a ‘minimum age’ rum as indicated by the number 12 displayed on the bottle. The rum is carefully aged in Number One Select American Oak barrels for a deep bronze, honey color and bittersweet, luscious finish.

don-michael-andean-black-corn-whiskey.title: Jack Daniel's Limited Edition McLaren Version 3
don-michael-andean-black-corn-whiskey.bodyHtml:
The third highly anticipated limited-edition release in the partnership between Jack Daniel's and the McLaren Formula 1 team. Celebrating McLaren's racing dominance, this exclusive 2025 "Version 3" bottle features striking papaya orange accents and dynamic striping. Inside the collectible bottle is the classic Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey, but for this special edition, it has been bottled at a higher 86 proof (43% ABV). This elevated proof delivers a richer, more intense, and fuller-bodied tasting experience than the standard release.

 

NOSE

Classic aromas of caramel, vanilla, toasted oak, and a signature hint of sweet banana.

PALATE

A rich, medium-bodied blend of sweet caramel, brown sugar, creamy vanilla, and toasted oak with subtle underlying spice.

FINISH

Smooth, warming, and clean with gentle oak and lingering sweetness.

vietti-barbera-dalba-tre-vigne.title: Vietti Dolcetto d'Alba Tre Vigne 2023
vietti-barbera-dalba-tre-vigne.bodyHtml:
Purplish-red color with subtle violet hues. Blackberry and raspberry aromas. Notes of minerals and blueberry. Medium-bodied, with soft tannins, moderate acidity and good balance.

Pair with grilled vegetables, casual dishes like pizza, sandwiches, and pasta dishes with light sauces.

dom-perignon-x-lady-gaga-brut.title: Dom Perignon Vintage 2010
dom-perignon-x-lady-gaga-brut.bodyHtml:
Dom Perignon Vintage 2010 is a refined Champagne revealing lemon, green apple, white peach, brioche, toasted almond, chalk, and subtle smoky notes. Precise and energetic, the palate combines fine bubbles, vibrant acidity, concentrated fruit, creamy texture, and mineral tension through a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with lobster, oysters, seared scallops, roast poultry, grilled white fish, or aged Comte for an elegant vintage Champagne pairing.

 

98 Points - James Suckling

Mineral, stone and steel aromas mingle with dried flowers, peach and apricot in an intensely expressive bouquet. Full-bodied without feeling heavy, the palate delivers remarkable concentration, exotic fruit and pastry-like complexity. Wild, layered and distinctive, it combines richness with impressive energy and refinement. Drink now or hold.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Graceful and concentrated, this Champagne offers fragrant toasted brioche and grilled nut layered with vibrant tangerine. Candied ginger, toasted saffron and lime blossom add complexity, while the fine mousse gently caresses the palate. Despite its richness, the wine remains lithe and elegant through the long, persistent finish.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Rich and beautifully mature, this iconic Champagne opens with floral aromas before revealing impressive weight and density. Ripe fruit has developed into complex notes of nuts and toast, while a precise saline character provides freshness and balance through the finish. Drink through 2028.

dom-perignon-x-lady-gaga-rose.title: Dom Perignon Rose 2009
dom-perignon-x-lady-gaga-rose.bodyHtml:
Warm, dry and sunny, the summer of 2009 was emblematic of this vintage, where the grapes expressed their full majesty, maturity and richness. It reveals Dom Pérignon Rosé Vintage 2009 exactly as it is, intimate and caressing, a true embodiment of fruit.

The Dom Pérignon gastronomic experience radically explores an entire realm of possibilities while revealing the facets of the wine with its unique character and singular personality. To bring out the aromatic nuances of Dom Pérignon Rose Vintage 2009, the chef Alajmo have created a pairing featuring a spicy tarragon risotto with matcha, served with a yellow tomato sorbet and nigella powder. A combination of tastes that reveal the duality of the vintage wine, highlighting its fresh yet earthly notes.

98 Points - Vinous

The 2009 Dom Pérignon Rosé marks a return to a richer style of Rosé following the more ethereal 2008 Rosé. Sweet red cherry, blood orange, spice and pomegranate all build in a creamy, sensual DP Rosé that hits all the right spots. Over the last few years, Chef de Caves Vincent Chaperon and his team have lowered the still Pinot portion of the Rosé down to about 10% from a high of 28% or so, reached around 2004 and 2005. In 2009, the Rosé gains considerable textural presence from the generosity of the year. It is a superb Champagne. I preferred it to the 2008, which was also part of this tasting.

97 Points - James Suckling

Peaches, fresh crushed strawberries and roses on the nose. Full-bodied and generous. Fine tannins that frame the wine beautifully and set it up for a fresh finish. Some fruit tea and cedar undertones. Enticing finish with hints of bitterness. Savory.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A lovely rosé Champagne that waltzes gracefully across the palate, belying the concentrated range of macerated raspberry and strawberry, candied blood orange peel, toast and saffron notes carried on the elegant, satiny mousse. Long and fresh, with minerally smoke and oyster shell accents on the focused finish. Drink now through 2035.

secret-speyside-1994-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Secret Speyside 1994 26 Year Old 49.8% ABV
secret-speyside-1994-twa.bodyHtml:
The Whisky Agency Secret Speyside 1994 is an independently bottled single malt Scotch whisky from an undisclosed Speyside distillery, selected and bottled by the independent bottler The Whisky Agency. Distilled in 1994, it is bottled at 52.3% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water if desired.

braeval-2014-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Braeval 2014 7 Year Old 53.4% ABV
braeval-2014-twa.bodyHtml: The Whisky Agency Braeval 2014 7 Year Old 53.4% ABV 700ml

macduff-2013-twa.title: Macduff 2013
macduff-2013-twa.bodyHtml:
Macduff 2013 is a single malt Scotch whisky from the Macduff distillery in the Highlands, bottled by independent bottler The Whisky Agency. Distilled in 2013, it is bottled at 52% ABV in a 700ml bottle, a full-strength independent release.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

fess-parker-chardonnay.title: Fess Parker Santa Barbara Chardonnay 2022
fess-parker-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Fess Parker Santa Barbara Chardonnay offers notes of citrus, green apple, pear, honey, vanilla, almond and toasty oak and minerality.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Lean aromas of lemon pith and plaster of paris are tight on the nose of this countywide cuvée. Wet-clay aromas are cut by lemon peel on the brisk palate.

mount-gay-black-barrel-double-cask-blend.title: Mount Gay Black Barrel Double Cask Blend Rum
mount-gay-black-barrel-double-cask-blend.bodyHtml: Mount Gay Black Barrel is a bold and robust expression of the Barbadian rum tradition, meticulously crafted by Master Blender Trudiann Branker. This "Double Cask Blend" is created by marrying high-ester pot still rums with column still rums, all of which are aged for three to seven years in American whiskey casks. The spirit then undergoes a crucial secondary maturation in deeply charred Bourbon oak barrels for an additional six months. This intensive finishing process results in a mahogany-hued rum with an enhanced woody character and a complex spicy profile. On the nose, it offers an alluring bouquet of gingerbread, lychee, and toasted marshmallow, while the palate delivers rich layers of black pepper, dark chocolate, and warm vanilla. With its signature "burnt" oak intensity and smooth, persistent finish, Black Barrel is an exceptional choice for elevating classic cocktails like the Old Fashioned or for sipping neat.

mount-gay-xo-triple-cask-blend.title: Mount Gay XO Triple Cask Blend
mount-gay-xo-triple-cask-blend.bodyHtml: Mount Gay XO is a blend of spirits distilled in both column and pot stills. Maturation is 8 to 15 years in a combination of American whiskey, bourbon and Cognac casks. Look for flavours of caramel, dried fruit, dark chocolate and spice. Silky smooth, with a lengthy finish, this rum is perfect as an after-dinner sipper.

olmeca-silver-tequila-1.title: Olmeca Silver Tequila
olmeca-silver-tequila-1.bodyHtml:
Olmeca Silver is the clear blanco expression of Olmeca tequila, made with blue agave in the Los Altos highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. It leads with a fresh herbal scent and green pepper, with soft citrus notes coming through at the end, and carries a natural sweetness and freshness that makes it an easy partner for mixers and fruit. The current bottle wears Olmeca's redesigned teal label with the Olmec head emblem on the brand's square, patterned bottle. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a dependable everyday blanco for margaritas, Palomas and chilled shots.

Nose: Fresh herbs and green pepper, with soft citrus at the end.

Serve: In a margarita or Paloma, or as a chilled shot with lime.

1921-extra-anejo.title: Don Julio Ultima Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
1921-extra-anejo.bodyHtml: In 2006, Don Julio, with his family, planted their final agave field. In honor of his devotion and craftsmanship, this agave harvest was carefully distilled, barreled, and set aside for a special use. To preserve this tequila and the exquisite agave piñas behind it, we have implemented a Solera aging system. The Solera aging method combines and matures tequilas of different characteristics finished in unique casks, allowing the final agave harvest to remain at the heart of this rare Extra Añejo Tequila. Our Ultima Reserva has been rested in oak, previously used to age bourbon, and finished in Madeira wine-seasoned casks. Salud, to creating only the exceptional.

poplar-grove-syrah.title: Poplar Grove Syrah 2020
poplar-grove-syrah.bodyHtml:
Poplar Grove Syrah 2020 is an expressive, bold, and elegantly structured Canadian red wine crafted from estate vineyards in British Columbia’s premier Okanagan Valley. In the glass, it displays a deep, saturated purple-ruby hue. The aromatic profile reveals a fragrant bouquet bursting with notes of ripe cassis, violet florals, and subtle cedarwood, accented by layers of black cherry, dark plum, cracked pepper, and vanilla. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is rich and velvety, featuring concentrated dark berry fruit, savory mountain herbs, and a touch of mocha framed by smooth, polished tannins and lively natural acidity that carry through to a long, flavorful, and harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rosemary rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, grilled venison loin, and mature clothbound cheddar cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

A rich and intense red, showing blackberries, tar and licorice. Medium- to full-bodied with round tannins and a flavorful finish. Big syrah for the region. Drink or hold.

noble-ridge-pinot-noir.title: Noble Ridge Reserve Pinot Noir 2018
noble-ridge-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: The Noble Ridge Reserve Pinot Noir 2018 is a deeply complex and bold expression of the Okanagan Falls sub-appellation. Sourced from 100% estate-grown fruit from the winery's Home Vineyard, this vintage was crafted from four distinct Pinot Noir clones (113, 114, 115, and 777) planted between 2001 and 2010. After a five-day cold soak and fermentation, the wine was aged for 14 months in French oak barrels (20% new). The result is a fuller-style Pinot Noir with intense aromas of wild blue and black fruits, complemented by subtle floral notes. On the palate, it reveals rich layers of earth, spice, and dark berries, leading to a long, lingering finish. While robust, its balanced acidity makes it a classic pairing for meaty fish like grilled salmon or savory dishes like lamb pie.

noble-ridge-reserve-meritage.title: Noble Ridge Noble Meritage
noble-ridge-reserve-meritage.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "The 34 acre Okanagan Falls Vineyard at Noble Ridge is home to this fruit. Like last year, it is a spicy, savoury, soya balsamic style red with sour cherry and black raspberry and some bright acidity. A bit lean for 2020, this is best consumed with braised beef of a hearty winter stew. Ready to drink. The mix is 81 percent merlot (clone 118 planted in 1986, and an unknown clone planted in 1999) and 15 percent cabernet sauvignon (also an unknown clone from one of the oldest blocks of cab in the Okanagan, planted in 1986) with two percent cabernet franc and two percent malbec. It gets a standard, three day cold soak before fermentation. Post ferment, it spends 12 months in 20 percent new barrels, 75% French, and 25% American. (Anthony Gismondi)." - 88/100, Gismondi on Wine

culmina-hypothesis.title: Culmina Family Estate Hypothesis 2019
culmina-hypothesis.bodyHtml:
Culmina Family Estate Hypothesis 2019 is an opulent, refined, and classically structured flagship Bordeaux-style red blend produced by Culmina Family Estate Winery. Sourced exclusively from estate vineyards on the Arise Bench along the Golden Mile Bench in British Columbia, the grapes are hand-harvested and aged for 16 months in French oak barrels (31% new). The nose displays complex aromatics of black cherries, cedar bark, leather, and cocoa nibs interwoven with subtle notes of sage and warming eucalyptus. On the rich and full-bodied palate, concentrated wild red fruits, black currant, cloves, and licorice are seamlessly held together by finely structured, silky tannins and a vibrant line of natural acidity that carries into a long, persistent, and harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, roasted duck breast, braised short ribs, truffle risotto, or aged clothbound cheddar cheese.

tinhorn-creek-the-creek.title: Tinhorn Creek Pinot Gris VQA
tinhorn-creek-the-creek.bodyHtml:
Tinhorn Creek Pinot Gris VQA is a vibrant, refreshing, and highly approachable white wine from one of British Columbia's most celebrated estates, located in the beautiful Golden Mile Bench of the Okanagan Valley. Crafted with meticulous care and cool-fermented in stainless steel to preserve the grape's pure characteristics, this Canadian wine displays a pale straw-yellow hue in the glass. The inviting aromatic bouquet opens with lively notes of ripe Anjou pear, honeydew melon, and white peach, elegantly layered with subtle hints of Meyer lemon, fresh citrus blossom, and a delicate touch of honey. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, crisp, and beautifully focused, delivering a generous core of fresh orchard and soft tropical fruit. This juicy, fruit-forward profile is perfectly balanced by a bright, mouthwatering acidity and an underlying clean minerality, culminating in a snappy, refreshing, and highly versatile finish that makes it a perfect everyday sipper.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with freshly shucked oysters, lightly grilled halibut, fresh green salads, creamy lemon-herb chicken, and soft cheeses like fresh goat cheese.

kavalan-triple-sherry-cask.title: Kavalan Solist Fino Sherry Cask Year of the Snake Truth Malters Lunar Zodiac
kavalan-triple-sherry-cask.bodyHtml:
6th release in our TM Lunar Zodiac series: The Year of the Snake - The Kavalan Solist Fino Sherry Cask Single Malt Whisky.

Aged 11+ years and drawn from Cask #001 this is Kavalan’s first-ever Fino sherry private cask. This exceptional expression offers a refined sherry influence, unveiling layers of creamy toffee, indulgent fudge, and a subtle touch of chocolate, all balanced by the spirit’s vibrant fruit character.

ferrari-carano-reserv-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Beringer Knights Valley Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
ferrari-carano-reserv-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Beringer Knights Valley Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, beautifully structured, and concentrated California red wine produced from selected barrel lots sourced from stony, low-yielding vineyard blocks in Knights Valley. Exhibiting a deep ruby-purple core, it opens with expressive aromas of dark blackberry, cassis, and black cherry, seamlessly layered with notes of graphite, violet, cigar box, and dark chocolate. On the palate, it is full-bodied, savory, and focused, featuring supple, fine-grained tannins and balancing acidity that frame dark fruit, plum, and spice flavors through a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, venison stew, wild mushroom risotto, and aged cheddar cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

Lots of dark fruits with violets and peppery greens followed by cigar box, forest floor and graphite with cedar and dark chocolates. Wonderfully structured full-bodied wine. Very focused and concentrated with serious depth and length. Artful savory complexity to it. A blend of 80% cabernet sauvignon, 10% cabernet franc, 4% petit verdot, 4% merlot and 2% malbec. Released in spring 2024. It already has a nice drinkability but will age gracefully. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This complex Cabernet displays an impressive array of spice and mineral notes on the nose. The palate is loaded with plum, currant, licorice, graphite and tobacco flavors in a framework of supple tannin and balancing acidity. A little time in the cellar will soften this wine beautifully.

yangarra-estate-shiraz.title: Quarisa Johnny Q Shiraz 2020 750ml
yangarra-estate-shiraz.bodyHtml: Johnny Q Shiraz is a full-bodied red wine from South Australia, known for its intense red color with purple hues, ripe berry fruit flavors, and well-integrated vanilla oak notes. It's described as approachable, easy-going, and versatile, making it suitable for various occasions and food pairings.

will-harlan-promontory-2012.title: Promontory 2017
will-harlan-promontory-2012.bodyHtml:
The 2017 Promontory shares with predecessors an elusive scent of wet stones—though here, a minty, herbal note also rises from this mist. Subtle hints of red fruit cloak the wine’s finely articulated structure, overlaying a spine of acidity and chiseled tension. Energy livens the midpalate, almost like an electrical impulse, as the tannin—tightly coiled at first—gradually unwinds to reveal on the finish the delicate complexity of its many component strands. Although the 2017 is among the more introverted vintages to date, the patient listener is soon drawn into the entrancing interplay of the wine’s translucent layers.

98 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrant, tar, lead pencil and dark fruit. Full-bodied with resin, dark-berry and redwood undertones and firm, fine tannins. Salty. Leaner than some, but so long and bright. Vertical elegance here. Needs three to four years to soften and open.

97 Points - Robert Parker 

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2017 Promontory has a wonderfully fragrant nose of baked blackberries, plum preserves and black currant pastilles with an undercurrent of star anise, violets, espresso and tilled earth. Medium to full-bodied, it is soft-spoken and elegantly styled in the mouth, featuring skillfully managed, grainy tannins and bags of juicy black fruits, finishing long, earthy and remarkably energetic. This is certainly among the most profound of the 2017 Napa Cabernets and for followers of this vineyard, not one to be missed.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Winey and engaging, with steeped plum and blackberry fruit forming the core, while sleek, energetic apple wood and licorice snap accents fuel the finish. There's a hint of bramble along the edges, plus a long spine of dark earth and iron-accented minerality buried within. Impressive for the vintage. Best from 2024 through 2038.

jacobs-creek-moscato-rose.title: Jacob's Creek Moscato Rose 1.5L
jacobs-creek-moscato-rose.bodyHtml:
Jacob's Creek Moscato is a fresh and fragrant, low alcohol Australian rosé. It has aromas and flavours of ripe raspberry, strawberry and candied fruit with pear and sherbet notes. The palate is lightly sweet with a refreshing spritz and vibrant red berries on the finish

89 points Wine Spectator
A sweet and refreshing Moscato Rosé with aromas of ripe strawberry, peach, and orange blossom. The palate is lively and lightly effervescent, offering juicy red berry and tropical fruit flavors balanced by a gentle sweetness and bright acidity. The finish is clean and crisp, making it perfect for casual gatherings or pairing with light desserts.

90 points James Suckling
Vibrant and aromatic, this Moscato Rosé opens with fragrant notes of rose petals, watermelon, and fresh red berries. The palate is silky and playful, showcasing a balance of ripe fruit sweetness and refreshing acidity. The soft bubbles add elegance, while the finish lingers with floral and fruity charm. A crowd-pleasing wine with excellent freshness.

88 points Decanter
A simple, easy-drinking Moscato Rosé with aromas of strawberry, melon, and soft citrus. The palate is light and sweet, with moderate acidity and a soft, creamy mousse. The finish is pleasant and uncomplicated, ideal for casual sipping or pairing with fruit-based desserts.

krug-clos-du-mesnil.title: Krug Clos Du Mesnil 2009
krug-clos-du-mesnil.bodyHtml:
Maison Krug’s unique craftsmanship has revealed a rare champagne from a remarkable terroir, the Clos du Mesnil.
Born at a time when the conventions in Champagne concentrated on blending multiple wines from varied plots, Krug Clos du Mesnil offers a Champagne of exceptional beauty and poise, telling a story of this plot’s grapes, only on very special years.

88-brewing-pick-me-up.title: 88 Brewing Pick Me Up 4 Tall Cans
88-brewing-pick-me-up.bodyHtml: 88 Brewing Pick Me Up 4 Tall Cans

numanthia-termes.title: Bodegas Numanthia 'Termes' 2020
numanthia-termes.bodyHtml:
Bodegas Numanthia 'Termes' 2020 is a vibrant, energetic, and beautifully expressive red wine that serves as the lively introduction to the iconic Toro region. Pouring a deep cherry-red color with bright ruby highlights, it opens with a fragrant and multi-layered bouquet of fresh plum, ripe blackberry, and cassis, seamlessly framed by subtle undertones of wild herbs, sweet cinnamon, cocoa powder, and cigar box. On the palate, this full-bodied wine showcases a generous, fruit-forward core balanced by a surprisingly lively vein of natural acidity and velvety, fine-grained tannins. Having spent 14 months maturing in French oak barrels, it maintains its signature youthful vigor while displaying a sophisticated complexity that tapers into a long, polished finish accented by a lingering trace of graphite minerality and dark chocolate.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with charcoal-grilled dry-aged ribeye steak, smoky wild boar stews, thinly sliced jamón ibérico, or mature, nutty cheeses like aged Manchego.

94 Points - James Suckling

Gorgeous floral character to the crushed stone and purple fruit. Lavender and sage, too. Full-bodied with chewy tannins and a savory yet crunchy finish. Dark mushroom and fresh earth. Super length and brightness for this wine.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of cassis, dark chocolate and leather set the stage for blackberry, cocoa powder, caramel, violet, orange zest and sage leaf flavors. Plush tannins coat the tongue and gums and drift off into a milk chocolate and cherry finish. This fresh wine from Toro is a nice example of a Tinta de Toro, the local name for Tempranillo, that does not break the bank.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe and fruit-forward on the nose, though more restrained on the palate, this red offers flavors of blackberry paste, dried blueberry and cranberry fruit woven through dried sage, marjoram, warmed spices and cocoa powder, backed by rich notes of fresh earth and iron. There's a creamy nappe to the texture, while fine tannins firm up the supple finish.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Termes, the entry-level red, has 15.65% alcohol and a pH of 3.9 with 4.2 grams of acidity. The grapes from their younger vines, which have higher yields and keep more acidity, fermented with selected yeasts and 20 days of maceration and matured in 225- and 400-liter French oak barrels, 20% of them new, for 14 months with rackings every four months. It's creamy and spicy, round and soft, with fine-grained tannins and integrated oak (nearly 50% of the élevage was in 400-liter oak barrels), and it's rich but with the alcohol nicely integrated. This has a more commercial profile, more approachable than its siblings.

perrier-jouet-belle-epoque-rose.title: Perrier-Jouet Rose Belle Epoque 2013
perrier-jouet-belle-epoque-rose.bodyHtml:
Perrier-Jouët Belle Époque Rosé 2013 is an exceptional vintage Champagne crafted from Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and Pinot Meunier. Produced only in outstanding years, this elegant rosé displays a delicate salmon-pink hue with luminous orange highlights. Fragrant strawberries, peonies, and citrus mingle with rich brioche notes, creating a refined Champagne distinguished by its fine bubbles, vibrant freshness, and graceful complexity.

Food Pairing: Lobster, seared tuna, grilled salmon, duck breast, fresh figs, seafood risotto, and delicate fruit-based desserts.

 

 

96 Points - James Suckling

Very pretty aromas with peach and crabapple character, as well as cotton candy and light nutmeg. Medium-to full-bodied with very fine bubbles that run the length of the wine and persist. Really fine and beautiful. Ultra-complex and refined. 

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This famed Champagne in its Belle Epoque flower label remains a very fine wine. This latest release is still in its vibrant fruit stage, showing no signs of aging. The hints of strawberries are balanced against the fine texture. The wine is ready to drink.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This rich rosé Champagne is aromatic and minerally on the nose, with smoke and oyster shell notes that transition to accent the palate's baked white peach, grilled plum, toasted brioche and lemon curd flavors. Bright, with well-honed acidity and a crisp, lacy texture. Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier. Drink now through 2033.

perrier-jouet-belle-epoque-brut-magnum.title: Perrier-Jouet Belle Epoque Brut 2012 1.5L Magnum
perrier-jouet-belle-epoque-brut-magnum.bodyHtml:
A pale, translucent gold, with radiant clarity and subtle glints of apple green. An impression of freshness and delicacy, with distinctive aromas of white fruit and flowers. An exceptional combination of freshness and finesse.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast
The iconic Belle Epoque bottle reveals a well-structured, taut wine. With Chardonnay very much in evidence in the mineral texture, the wine is almost as floral as the bottle. Drink from 2021. Roger Voss

blenders-pride-rare-premium.title: Blenders Pride Rare Premium Indian Whisky
blenders-pride-rare-premium.bodyHtml: Blenders Pride is a blend of Indian grain spirit and imported Scotch malts from Chivas Brothers. Launched in 1995, this smooth and smoky premium whisky benefits from Scotland’s long tradition of blending fine whiskies, tailored to the tastes of this nation of whisky enthusiasts.

hennessy-xo-lny-edition.title: Hennessy XO Cognac x Xu Zhen Year of The Horse Lunar New Year 2026 Limited Edition
hennessy-xo-lny-edition.bodyHtml:
In 1870, the Master Blender Emile Fillioux crafted a special blend for Maurice Hennessy. More than 150 years later, Hennessy's powerful, balanced "Extra Old" blend remains the cognac of choice for sharing with one's inner circle.

Hennessy celebrates Chinese New Year 2026 with a limited edition X.O, honouring the Year of the Horse. The artistic design captures the animal's energy and grace with equine motifs on a dark red neck capsule and an eco-designed cream gift box with gold accents. The X.O carafe, adorned with a vibrant red and gold label, is an ideal gift for art and exceptional cognac lovers.

dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-petit-chappel.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Petite Chapelle Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes
dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-petit-chappel.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Petite Chapelle Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes is a remarkably deep and texturally complex Premier Cru sourced from old vines planted in 1964. Located immediately adjacent to the eastern border of the Chapelle-Chambertin Grand Cru, this wine consistently mirrors the scale and density of a Grand Cru while retaining excellent energetic balance. In the glass, it shows a rich ruby hue, leading into a highly fragrant, complex nose filled with sweet red berries, dark wild plums, and licorice, layered with delicate hints of fresh peony and exotic spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied, deeply concentrated, and vibrant. Its core of succulent, old-vine fruit is impeccably structured by powdery, fine-grained tannins and a lively spine of acidity, culminating in a driving, intensely mineral-driven finish built for extensive aging.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom tart, or slow-cooked venison.

dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-vielle-vignes.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2023
dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-vielle-vignes.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2023 is a concentrated and powerful village-level Burgundy sourced from eight premium plots, with the oldest vines dating back to 1915. Managed by thirteenth-generation winemaker Loïc Dugat, the 2023 vintage beautifully balances old-vine structural mass with modern refinement, utilizing 20% whole-cluster fermentation and a moderate 30% new French oak regime. In the glass, it pours a dark ruby color, opening with a highly fragrant nose of dark plums, black cherries, and musk, layered with light spicy notes and a hint of bay leaf. On the palate, it is dense and earthy, showing a smooth, richly rippling texture underpinned by a burly, structural grip and an prominent streak of mineral salinity. The finish is remarkably long and savory, concluding with a classic touch of licorice.

Food Pairing: Roast duck, beef bourguignon, wild mushroom risotto, or well-aged Comté cheese.

dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-coeur-de-roy.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Cuvee Coeur de Roy Tres Vieilles Vignes 2022
dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-coeur-de-roy.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Cuvée Coeur de Roy Très Vieilles Vignes 2022 is a stunning, deeply concentrated village-level wine produced from parcels of ancient vines ranging from 50 to nearly 100 years old. Reflecting the modern evolution of the domain under Loïc Dugat-Py, the 2022 vintage shifts beautifully away from historical over-extraction, utilizing 50% whole-cluster fermentation and a dialed-back 40% new French oak regime. In the glass, it shows a bright, glossy ruby profile. The aromatics are perfumed and forward, delivering vivid layers of fresh strawberry, pomegranate, and dark cherries intermingled with hints of rose petals, cracked pepper, and subtle forest floor. On the palate, it balances intense, old-vine fruit density with an ethereal, lithe texture, supported by seamless, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant core of natural acidity that carries into a long, beautifully balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté cheese.

92 Points - Wine Advocate

Tasted from a bottle that saw fully 24 months' élevage (which will be indicated on the label), the 2022 Gevrey-Chambertin Coeur du Roy is much more civilized than it was from barrel, offering up a pretty bouquet of red berries, plums and orange rind mingled with rose petals and incense. Medium to full-bodied, succulent and seamless, with integrated tannins and a lively, harmonious profile, it will offer a broader drinking window than I had originally anticipated.

woodford-reserve-bourbon-2.title: Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Bourbon
woodford-reserve-bourbon-2.bodyHtml:
Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Bourbon is an innovative, twice-barreled Kentucky straight bourbon produced at the Woodford Reserve Distillery in Versailles, Kentucky. First matured in handcrafted new white oak barrels, the bourbon is then transferred to a second, heavily toasted and lightly charred oak barrel for additional aging, extracting deep notes of dark caramel, hazelnut, apple, and rich oak spice.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, crème brûlée, pecan pie, smoked brisket, or blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber to dark copper in appearance with a rich, heavy, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich notes of dark fruit, caramel, honey, chocolate, marzipan, and toasted oak.

Palate : Full-bodied with layers of vanilla, dark caramel, hazelnut, apple, sweet baking spices, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, creamy, and lingering with notes of warm oak spice, honey, and subtle apple.

Serve : Serve neat, over a large ice cube, or as an elevated modifier in a classic Old Fashioned.

knob-creek-15-year-old-small-batch-bourb.title: Knob Creek 9 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
knob-creek-15-year-old-small-batch-bourb.bodyHtml:
Knob Creek 9 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a highly respected, pre-Prohibition style whiskey that serves as a cornerstone of the Jim Beam Small Batch Collection. Patiently aged for a full nine years in heavily charred new American white oak barrels, this bourbon delivers a robust, full-bodied, and deeply satisfying profile. Bottled at a hearty 100 proof, it perfectly balances the deep, rich flavors of dark oak and aged caramel with the classic sweetness of a traditional Kentucky straight bourbon.

Food Pairing: This bold, higher-proof bourbon pairs magnificently with rich, savory dishes like smoked beef brisket, charred ribeye steak, or sticky BBQ pork ribs. It is also an excellent companion to sharp, aged cheddar cheese, toasted pecans, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : A deep, rich amber-copper hue. The texture is full-bodied, warming, and pleasantly viscous on the palate.

Nose : Robust and inviting. Sweet aromas of toasted nuts, maple sugar, and rich vanilla bean are deeply intertwined with expressive notes of dark, seasoned oak and a hint of leather.

Palate : Big, rich, and naturally sweet. A luscious wave of rich caramel, brown sugar, and dark fruit quickly gives way to a complex, earthy core of heavily toasted oak, baking spices, and a pleasant rye pepperiness.

Finish : Long, rich, and glowing. It leaves a deeply warming trail of sweet vanilla, lingering oak, and a satisfying peppery spice.

Serve : Exceptional neat or poured over a large ice cube to soften the proof and open up the sweet aromatics. Its robust proof and deep flavor also make it the perfect foundation for a classic Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

arette-suave-gran-clase-cask-strength-48.title: Arette Suave Gran Clase Extra Anejo Cask Strength Tequila
arette-suave-gran-clase-cask-strength-48.bodyHtml:
Arette Tequila produces an ultra-premium lineup called Arette Suave at 120-year old Destileria El Llano. Arette Suave differs from Arette Classic by fermentation in permeable masonry tanks recessed into the ground, serving to soften the alcohols with cooler and longer fermentation. They also cut more of the heads and tails during distillation, leaving only the beautiful core of the heart of distillation for bottling. Finally, they age the Blanco in stainless steel tanks before bottling, and starting with Suave Blanco, they age Reposado, Añejo, and Gran Clase longer in American oak than Arette Classic. Arette Suave is truly for the aficionado.

The image is for display purposes only. The vintage and other details on it may be different than the actual product.

m-h-apex-dead-sea-israel-single-malt.title: Milk & Honey APEX Dead Sea Israeli Whisky 56.50% ABV
m-h-apex-dead-sea-israel-single-malt.bodyHtml:
This small batch single malt whisky is the first and only whisky ever aged in the lowest place on earth, The Dead Sea, where temperatures reach 50 degrees Celsius, giving it strong and intense flavors.

Sweet with French vanilla and mocha, notes of cigar box and a refreshing hint of spearmint, pleasant oakiness in the background.

A gentle beginning with black tea leaves followed by a powerful wave of warm spices such as cinnamon and coriander seeds, dark cocoa powder and a pinch of crushed white pepper.

Long and satisfying with candied ginger and cloves, joined by a bouquet of toasted herbs and coarse sea salt.

chum-churum-rich-1.title: Chum Churum Rich Soju 360ml
chum-churum-rich-1.bodyHtml:
Chum Churum Rich Soju is the brand's stronger Rich soju, bottled at 20% ABV in a 360ml bottle. Chum Churum (Cheoeumcheoreom, 'like the first time') is a soju brand of Lotte Chilsung Beverage, launched in 2006 and made with alkaline water, which the brand credits for its smoothness.

Serve: Well chilled, neat in a shot glass or over ice.

chum-churum-cala-mansi.title: Chum Churum Calamansi Soju 360ml
chum-churum-cala-mansi.bodyHtml:
Chum Churum Calamansi Soju is a calamansi-flavoured soju bottled at 12% ABV in a 360ml bottle. Chum Churum (Cheoeumcheoreom, 'like the first time') is a soju brand of Lotte Chilsung Beverage, launched in 2006 and made with alkaline water, which the brand credits for its smoothness.

Serve: Well chilled, neat in a shot glass or over ice.

groffier-chambolle-musigny-les-hauts-doi.title: Robert Groffier Chambolle-Musigny Les Hauts Doix Premier Cru 2021
groffier-chambolle-musigny-les-hauts-doi.bodyHtml:
Les Hauts Doix Chambolle-Musigny Premier Cru from Domaine Robert Groffier is the fruit of an ancient savoir-faire. The estate is managed by Nicolas and Julie Groffier, who can count on eight hectares of property distributed in parcels of the highest quality. The domaine's style is inspired by the search for finesse, which is expressed in wines with a harmonious and silky texture, elegant and long-lived. The Pinot Noir grapes come from a parcel located within the Premier Cru "Les Hauts Doix," which is located in the southeastern part of the Chambolle-Musigny communal area, in a particularly prized area, right on the border with the famous Les Amoureuses cru. The vines are grown on soils of a limestone nature, shallow, resting directly on the parent rock. The rich presence of crushed stone and pebbles makes them poor and very draining, ideal for quality viticulture based on high planting density and low yields. Fermentation takes place spontaneously with indigenous yeasts, and the wine matures for at least a year in French oak barrels.

Domaine Robert Groffier's Premier Cru "Les Hauts Doix" Chambolle-Musigny holds true to the reputation of Pinot Noirs from this terroir, which has always been known for the delicacy of its wines, which are among the finest in the entire Côte de Nuits. In the glass, it is bright ruby red in color. The bouquet gives splendid floral nuances of violet, iris, dried flowers, aromas of raspberry, red currant, morello cherry and wild strawberries, hints of licorice root and delicate spices. The sip is harmonious, soft, with a very elegant tannic texture and a smooth, fresh and savory finish.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Wild cherry, currant, hibiscus, sandalwood, mineral and oak spice aromas and flavors signal this supple, graceful red, which is well-delineated, complex and compelling. Shows terrific harmony and length. Best from 2028

groffier-chambolle-musigny-les-sentiers.title: Robert Groffier Chambolle-Musigny Les Sentiers Premier Cru 2021
groffier-chambolle-musigny-les-sentiers.bodyHtml:
80-year-old vines grown on clay soil which gets the afternoon sun, 13.5% alcohol, 100% whole bunch and 25% new wood. Another dense crimson-purple colour. The bouquet has more of a fruit compote style. You can see the stems, but they are more hidden in the fruit. There is a substantial mouthful of plummy dark raspberry, good oak integration, plenty of spice and excellent persistence.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Exhibiting rose, cherry, wild strawberry, sandalwood and oak spice flavors, this tangy, fragrant red tightens up as it builds to the long, mineral-tinged finish, with refined tannins. Sleek and intense.

groffier-bonnes-mares-grand-cru.title: Robert Groffier Bonnes Mares Grand Cru 2021
groffier-bonnes-mares-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Perched between Morey-St-Denis and Chambolle-Musigny in the heart of the Cotes de Nuits this Grand Cru appellation can balance the best characteristics of both. Bonnes Mares wines combine fragrance and femininity with body and power. A seductive combination indeed.

This wine displays a deep ruby color with aromas of fresh red fruits accented by a touch of pepper. The palate is exuberant, offering abundant, rich flavors of plums and berries, underpinned by intense complexity from two distinct soil types. It has a firm structure with pronounced minerality, reflecting the character of the Bonnes-Mares vineyard.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A suave, vibrant red hallmarked by haunting scents of rose, wild strawberry, raspberry, sandalwood and graphite. Linear and bordering on racy, thanks to the vivid acidity, with refined tannins. Silky and balanced, this cruises to a long, complex aftertaste. Best from 2028 through 2048.

ornus-dellornellaia.title: Ornellaia Ornus dell'Ornellaia 2020 375ml
ornus-dellornellaia.bodyHtml:
Ornellaia Ornus dell'Ornellaia 2020 is an exceptional late-harvest dessert wine from the coastal vineyards of Bolgheri in Tuscany. Crafted exclusively from Petit Manseng, it reveals luxurious aromas of honey, quince, dried apricot and candied citrus. Its rich sweetness, silky texture and refreshing acidity create an elegant, beautifully balanced expression of the estate's distinctive terroir.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with foie gras, blue cheese, Gorgonzola, apricot tart, almond biscotti, lemon meringue pie, aged Pecorino and fruit-based desserts.

 

95 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant dessert white, with complex and alluring aromas of coconut, honey, butterscotch, dried peach and apricot underlined by bright acidity. Reveals a saline element as this glides to a lingering conclusion with harmony and grace. Drink now through 2036. 25 cases imported.

groffier-gevrey-chambertin-les-seuvrees.title: Domaine Tortochot Gevrey Chambertin Les Corvees 2023
groffier-gevrey-chambertin-les-seuvrees.bodyHtml:
Domaine Tortochot Gevrey-Chambertin Les Corvées 2023 is an elegant French red Burgundy from the renowned Gevrey-Chambertin appellation in the Côte de Nuits. Produced by the family-owned Domaine Tortochot, this wine is crafted from Pinot Noir, a grape celebrated for its finesse, aromatic complexity and ability to express the distinctive character of Burgundy's vineyards. Sourced from the Les Corvées vineyard, this wine reflects the classic character of Gevrey-Chambertin, combining expressive red fruit with earthy complexity and refined structure. Aromas of ripe cherries, wild strawberries and raspberries mingle with notes of violet, forest floor and delicate spice. The palate is balanced and elegant, featuring fresh acidity, fine tannins and a lingering, savoury finish.

Food Pairing: Duck confit, roasted chicken, grilled lamb, beef bourguignon, veal, mushroom risotto, roasted game birds, truffle pasta, aged Comté and Gruyère cheese.

groffier-bourgogne-rouge.title: Robert Groffier Bourgogne Passetoutgrain 2021 / 2023
groffier-bourgogne-rouge.bodyHtml: Medium purple in color with fresh red fruit aromas on the nose. A blend of Pinot Noir and Gamay produced this juicy, delicious wine. Two barrels of the Pinot are from the Morey St. Denis village. Sweet red fruit flavors are mouth filling.

highland-park-triskelion.title: Highland Park Triskelion
highland-park-triskelion.bodyHtml:
The easy thing to do is to have one master Whisky Maker call the shots when making a whisky. Well, no one ever said we liked doing things the easy way. Triskelion is the product of three legendary Highland Park Whisky Makers – Gordon Motion, Max McFarlane and John Ramsay – coming together to explore the influence of wood and cask seasoning on our whisky.

Our three Master Whisky Makers hand-selected and combined three principal cask types: first-fill sherry seasoned Spanish oak butts, first-fill sherry seasoned American oak casks and ex-bourbon barrels and hogsheads, with a small number of refill casks added to provide a degree of softness to the single malt whisky’s final flavour.

The result is a complex and full-bodied expression of Highland Park – a vibrant union of tangy Seville oranges, sultanas and raisins, sweet apricots, heather honey, stomped coriander seeds and aromatic peat smoke. A single malt as full of character as its three creators.

veuve-clicquot-la-grand-dame-magnum.title: Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame 2008 1.5L Magnum
veuve-clicquot-la-grand-dame-magnum.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame 2008 1.5L Magnum is a spectacular prestige cuvée that brilliantly reflects the tension and energy of the legendary 2008 vintage, presented in an impressive, highly age-worthy magnum format. Pouring a light gold with a fine, persistent mousse, the wine opens with an aerial and delicate bouquet. It reveals layered aromas of white peach, ripe pear, and candied citrus, sophisticatedly interwoven with autolytic notes of dried figs, toasted almonds, hazelnut, and buttery brioche. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and remarkably textural. Built around a massive 92% core of Pinot Noir, it displays a powerful and muscular frame that is beautifully counterbalanced by the vintage's driving, high-tensile acidity and a deep, powdery chalk minerality. The silky texture carries flavors of lemon curd, red berries, and oyster shell, culminating in a long, sharply focused, and racy finish.

Food Pairing: This powerful and structurally magnificent Champagne pairs exceptionally well with refined, elegant dishes such as fresh oysters on the half shell, tuna or salmon tartare, butter-drawn lobster, roast quail, sablefish, and sesame-crusted chicken.


95 Points - James Suckling

Still very youthful, this proves that pinot noir can give super-elegant, cool and tightly focused Champagne. Toastiness and spice build on the very long and tightly wound finish. Almost a blanc de noir with just 10% chardonnay blended into the overwhelming majority of pinot noir. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant Champagne, powered by a sculpted frame of acidity and minerality, this wears the refined, lacy mousse and well-meshed flavors of black currant, lemon curd, toast and marzipan like finely tailored clothing. Fresh and lasting, with hints of spice and smoke on the finish.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Exhibiting aromas of pear, toasted brad, confit citrus and smoke, the 2008 Brut La Grande Dame is full-bodied, rich and textural, with a deep and layered core, ripe but racy acids and a saline finish. A blend dominated by fully 92% Pinot Noir, this is true to the cuvée's rich and muscular style, but the vintage lends it welcome additional cut and precision. It's showing a lot better than the bottles I tasted in the United States last year.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This rich Champagne is dominated, as usual, by Pinot Noir. Its ripe fruit is approaching maturity, the hints of toast and croissant becoming more apparent. It is balanced, rich but textured and with an opulent, ripe aftertaste. Drink now.

fuenteseca-cosecha-blanco-3-year-old.title: Fuenteseca Cosecha Blanco 3 Year Old 2018 Tequila
fuenteseca-cosecha-blanco-3-year-old.bodyHtml:
Fuenteseca Cosecha Blanco 2018 is a single-site blanco tequila from Fuenteseca Reserva that explores terroir through micro-harvested agave, made entirely from a single orchard. This 2018 harvest was made from over-ripe highland Blue Weber agave grown at about 5,019 feet in mineral-rich caliche soil, and the tequila carries a three-year age statement. It is bottled at 44.8% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat at room temperature in a tequila or tulip glass.

fuenteseca-extra-anejo-7-year-old-tequil.title: Fuenteseca Reserva Extra Anejo 5 Year Old 2015 Tequila
fuenteseca-extra-anejo-7-year-old-tequil.bodyHtml: 62% of this expression’s tequila was column-distilled, then aged in European barrels of the variety Quercus robur(also known as Common Oak or Pedunculate Oak) that were previously used to age wine. 38% of the tequila in this lot was distilled in an Alembic pot still, then aged in French Oak barrels from central Europe. The barrel staves are of delicate wood, previously used to aged Royal Lochnagar Select Reserve Sherry. Each cask fill provides a wide range of different flavor possibilities — one of the reasons why age is not a sole determining factor in quality.

fuenteseca-extra-anejo-8-year-old-tequil.title: Fuenteseca Reserva Extra Anejo 5 Year Old 2015 Tequila
