tolaini-al-passo.title: Tolaini Al Passo Toscana 2022
tolaini-al-passo.bodyHtml:
Tolaini Al Passo Toscana 2022 is an incredibly vibrant, polished, and beautifully structured Super Tuscan red wine that captures the meticulous care and unique high-altitude terroir of Castelnuovo Berardenga. Crafted from equal parts Sangiovese, Merlot, and Cabernet Sauvignon grown on gravelly limestone soils, it opens with an invitingly complex nose of dark cherries, blackberries, and ripe plums laced with spicy oak, walnuts, and subtle cocoa dust notes. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and impressively balanced, showing a lively, fruit-forward coherence where the bright, acidic backbone of Sangiovese seamlessly intertwines with the plush, rounded texture of Merlot and the robust body of Cabernet Sauvignon. Taut, fine-grained tannins and a crisp line of natural acidity provide a supple frame that guides the wine into a persistent, precise finish accented by lingering details of dried herbs and savory tobacco leaf.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with classic charcoal-grilled beef burgers, roasted rabbit with wild herbs, rich wild duck with juniper berries, and mature hard cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

Attractive nose of dark cherries, blackberries, walnuts, cocoa and subtle spices. The palate is compact and well-structured, with a medium to full body and a fine tannin texture, finishing with a lingering and precise focus.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Sour cherry, raspberry, almond, sanguine, iron and menthol flavors are the heart of this resonant red. Beautifully balanced and supple, this extends on the vibrant, fruit- and savory-tinged aftertaste. Sangiovese, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

An easy-drinking blend of equal parts Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, the Tolaini 2022 Al Passo is a plump and softly textured red wine that would taste great next to a classic burger and fries. This medium- to full-bodied red is very bright and primary, but it also shows good balance and freshness, which make it perfect for food.

true-myth-cabernet-sauvignon-paso-robles.title: True Myth Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
true-myth-cabernet-sauvignon-paso-robles.bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon is pure Paso Robles, full of polished aromas of blueberry, cherry and vanilla, leading to flavors of dark red fruits, black currants and hints of pepper, mocha and caramelized oak. Rich yet smooth, this wine is very approachable now, and will continue to mature for years to come.

88 Points - James Suckling

Ripe, almost candied aromas of dark cherries and black raspberry cobbler precede a plush yet tannin-framed palate with enough cocoa powder, warm vanilla and cedar to add depth to the cassis that rolls through the finish. Drink or hold.

yalumba-the-menzies-cabernet.title: Yalumba The Menzies Cabernet Sauvignon 2016 750ml
yalumba-the-menzies-cabernet.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2016 vintage) "From vines planted in 1975 on Coonawarra's distinctive terra rossa soil, this vintage of Menzies is aromatic and spicy, showing a touch of bottle age. There're layers of aromas, from plum preserves and cherry cordial to menthol, bay leaf, vanilla bean and mushroom. The palate is evolving beautifully, the silky fruit knitted with raspy and taut but fine tannins. Drink now with fatty cured meat or until 2030." - 95/100, Wine Enthusiast

tenuta-monteti-caburnio.title: Tenuta Monteti Caburnio 2019
tenuta-monteti-caburnio.bodyHtml:
Tenuta Monteti Caburnio 2019 is an elegant, structured Tuscan red blend presenting a bright, deep ruby color. The bouquet opens with vivid aromas of fresh red berries, dark plums, and cassis, complexly layered with notes of Mediterranean scrub, wild sage, thyme, and a hint of black pepper. On the palate, it is beautifully balanced and exceptionally fresh, showing sweet, well-integrated tannins that provide a smooth texture. Balanced acidity keeps the wine vibrant through to a juicy, lingering finish marked by a distinct mineral edge.

Food Pairing: Perfectly pairs with grilled or roasted meats, rich pasta dishes with meat sauces, wild boar ragù, roasted duck breast, seasoned cheeses, and savory Tuscan flatbreads.

bowmore-25-year-old.title: Bowmore 25 Year Old
bowmore-25-year-old.bodyHtml:
Bowmore 25 Year Old is a legendary and masterfully aged Islay single malt Scotch whisky, representing a quarter-century of careful maturation in a combination of North American ex-bourbon and Spanish sherry casks. This exceptional expression perfectly balances Bowmore's signature coastal peat smoke with rich, sweet sherry influence. On the nose, it offers an exquisite bouquet of dark chocolate, intense stewed fruits, classic Islay smoke, and a touch of sea salt. The palate is deeply complex, luxurious, and mellow, revealing layers of sweet toffee, hazelnut, rich dark cocoa, and gentle, warming peat smoke, culminating in a remarkably long, elegant, and smooth finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with rich, savory fare such as roasted lamb, smoked venison, or seared duck breast. For dessert, it is an absolute revelation alongside dark chocolate truffles, espresso-based desserts, sticky toffee pudding, or robust blue cheeses like Roquefort and Stilton.

TASTING NOTES - A beautiful, deep and mellow mahogany color with a full, exceptionally smooth, and velvety body that gently coats the palate.

NOSE - Rich and highly complex, featuring intense aromas of stewed fruits, dark raisins, and sweet sherry, beautifully balanced by baked butterscotch, toffee, and a delicate trace of gentle wood smoke.

PALATE - Incredibly elegant and multi-layered, revealing delicious flavors of sweet toffee, roasted hazelnuts, and dark chocolate, gracefully intermingled with hints of iron, saline minerality, and a soft whisper of sweet peat smoke.

FINISH - Remarkably long, warm, and highly complex, leaving a lingering, gentle trail of singed cocoa, sweet wood spice, and dry leather.

SERVE - Best enjoyed poured neat at room temperature in a classic Glencairn or spirits nosing glass, allowing the decades of barrel character to slowly unfurl.

perrin-chateau-de-beaucastel-red.title: Chateau de Beaucastel Chateauneuf-du-Pape 2022
perrin-chateau-de-beaucastel-red.bodyHtml:
Château de Beaucastel Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2022 is a masterfully balanced, complex, and benchmark southern Rhône red wine produced by the Perrin family at their legendary estate in Courthézon. Sourced from organically and biodynamically farmed vineyards rooted in the region's classic terroir of heat-retaining quartzite rolled pebbles (galets roulés), molasses, and porous marine sandstone, the fruit was vinified varietal by varietal following a brief flash-heating of the skins to preserve aromatics and purity. Matured entirely in large neutral oak foudres, the wine presents an opaque, deep ruby-purple core in the glass. The bouquet is intricate and deeply layered, revealing fragrant notes of dark cherries, ripe black raspberries, and wild mulberries intricately woven with garrigue herbs, cracked black pepper, smoked bacon, licorice, bay leaves, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body marked by seamless density, silty melted tannins, and vibrant natural freshness, culminating in a focused, lingering, and mineral-flecked finish of exceptional longevity.

Food Pairing: Roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, wild boar stew, braised beef short ribs, grilled venison loin, or aged farmhouse Comté cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

A textured, layered, precise red, showcasing aromas of cherries, raspberries, warm herbs, bay leaves and baking spices. It’s medium- to full-bodied with silty, beautifully melted tannins. So integrated. Lively and focused, with plenty of energy and verve complementing the ripe red fruit and dried herbs. Intense stream of spices in the long, flavorful finish. From organically grown grapes

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Matured 100% in foudres, the 2022 Chateauneuf du Pape from Château de Beaucastel evokes aromas of dark wild berries, dark cherries, spices and licorice mingled with a touch of chocolate. Medium to full-bodied, deep and dense, it’s perfectly balanced with a structured, textured and seamless mid-palate enhanced by velvety tannins and a peppery, delicate and long finish. Cesar Perrin is aiming to reduce the percentage of Syrah in favor of Counoise, so this harmonious Beaucastel, matured in foudres, is a blend of 30% Mourvèdre, 20% Grenache, 10% Counoise, 5% Cinsault, 5% Terret Noir, 5% Muscardin, 5% Vaccarèse and 20% of white grapes, such as Roussanne and Clairette.

tait-ball-buster-barossa-valley.title: Tait The Ball Buster 2022
tait-ball-buster-barossa-valley.bodyHtml:
Tait The Ball Buster 2022 is a bold, full-bodied Australian red blend that combines the power of Shiraz with the structure of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. It reveals an expressive bouquet of ripe blueberry compote, black cherry, and dark fruits, accented by hints of mocha, peppercorns, toffee, and a faint trace of spearmint. The palate is broad-shouldered and plushly textured, packing layers of dark berry flavors, espresso bean, and licorice that are held together by firm tannins and integrated oak.

Food Pairing: This powerful blend pairs exceptionally well with rich, greasy dishes like wood-fired barbecued beef short ribs, grilled ribeye steak, or slow-cooked lamb shanks.

92 Points - James Suckling

Rich dark berries are accented by walnuts, peppercorns and licorice. Full-bodied and structured yet velvety in texture, combining meaty depth with polished tannins. Well-integrated and persistent in the finish. A blend of 87% shiraz, 7% cabernet sauvignon and 6% merlot. Drink or hold. Screw cap.

nino-negri-sfursat-5-stelle.title: Nino Negri 5 Stelle Sfursat 2018
nino-negri-sfursat-5-stelle.bodyHtml: Nino Negri Sfursat (or Sforzato) is the preeminent expression of Valtellina's unique winemaking tradition, where Nebbiolo grapes (locally called Chiavennasca) are dried on straw mats for several months before pressing. This "Sfursat" process concentrates the sugars and aromas, resulting in a wine of immense power and elegance. The 2018 vintage is characterized by its refined complexity, offering an intense bouquet of dried marasca cherries, cloves, and mountain herbs, underpinned by notes of tobacco and cocoa. On the palate, it is full-bodied and velvety, with a robust structure of firm tannins and a vibrant acidity that reflects its high-altitude alpine origins.

joseph-phelps-freestone-chardonnay.title: Joseph Phelps Insignia 2019 1.5L Magnum
joseph-phelps-freestone-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The 2019 Insignia opens with heady aromatics of red fruit, crème de cassis, leafy tobacco and delicate dried rose petals. The palate is juicy and dense with expressive layers of blackberry, raspberry, black currant, and dark chocolate. A dynamic wine offering captivating energy, length, complexity and refinement. The 2019 Insignia marks the first vintage to include fruit from the new Joseph Phelps vineyard named El Venadito, located in the Oak Knoll District, just south of the winery’s Yountville Vineyard.

99 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Another beautiful wine from this team, the 2019 Insignia is mostly Cabernet Sauvignon but includes smaller amounts of Merlot and Malbec, brought up all in new barrels, sourced from seven estate vineyards. It has a classic varietal and incredibly complex nose of crème de cassis, freshly sharpened pencils, green tobacco, and damp earth, with a kiss of background sappy spring flowers. Seemingly from a cooler year with its freshness, vibrancy, and herbal, floral character on the nose, it's nevertheless full-bodied and beautifully concentrated on the palate, with ultra-fine tannins, a seamless, layered mouthfeel, and a gorgeous finish. Unquestionably up with the finest vintages of this cuvée, this is legit awesome juice that’s going to offer incredible pleasure over the coming 20-25 years. Hats off to winemaker Ashley Hepworth.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

More elegant and refined than the Napa Cab, the 2019 Insignia features restrained cedar and vanilla notes (despite spending two years in 100% new French oak) and delicate herbal shadings accenting cassis and black cherry fruit. Full-bodied, velvety and somewhat open-knit on the palate, it turns plush and long on the finish, adding a touch of warmth. Production this year is approximately 17,000 cases, reflecting the increased volume coming from recently replanted vineyards. It's remarkable what a good job they continue to do with this bottling year after year, without compromising on quality.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A solidly built Cabernet with a very direct persona, as dark currant, warmed fig reduction and blackberry fruit paste are bolted together with licorice root and singed cedar. Features an espresso crema hint on the finish, which keeps this on the dark, muscular side. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Best from 2023 through 2038.

ventisquero-vertice.title: Ventisquero Vertice 2019/2021
ventisquero-vertice.bodyHtml:
Deep red with violet hues. The nose reveals black fruit, such as blackberries, intermingled with gentle spices, such as black pepper, damp earth, notes of native forest and a hint of graphite and soft spices. This wine has a firm structure and silky tannins. Its black fruit and spicy flavors, together with medium to high acidity lend it balance in the mouth and persistence in the finish.

 

2019 Vintage Ratings

93 Points - James Suckling

Racy fruit, showing currants, plums and engaging black peppercorns. A hint of white pepper, too. This is a juicy, medium-bodied red, coated by firm but silky tannins with elegant expressions of red fruit in the middle. Carmenere and syrah. Drink or hold.


2021 Vintage Ratings

93 Points - James Suckling

A solid blend of carmenere and syrah showing aromas of berries, beeswax, mocha and sweet spices. Medium- to- full-bodied with fine, firm tannins. Spicy and flavorful with a vibrant, long finish. Best after 2025.

93 Points - Vinous

The 2021 Carménère - Syrah Vértice is 51% Carménère and 49% Syrah from Apalta, Colchagua, aged for 22 months in 40% new barrels. Dark garnet red. The nose presents herbal and ash notes with hints of boldo, ripe blackberry and oaky aromas. Broad on the palate with polished tannins, precise freshness and a silky texture. The lengthy finish delivers plenty of juice and fruit. The cold year brought out fresh, fruit-forward character.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
A blend of Carménère and Syrah, the top grape varieties from the winery's vineyards in Apalta, this red begins with aromas of lavender and cherries, along with a dash of black pepper. It's full-bodied, with ripe berries and spices adding dimension to its green character.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Vertice Apalta Vineyard is a classical blend of 52% Carmenère and 48% Syrah from a warm vineyard in Apalta in the Colchagua Valley, produced with the advice of Australian consultant John Duval of Penfolds fame. It fermented in stainless steel and matured in a combination of 300-liter French oak barrels, 40% of them new (70% of the volume) and untoasted 2,500-liter French oak foudres for 18 months. It's powerful and concentrated, with good ripeness, 14% alcohol and balanced acidity, spicy and expressive. They are in the process of certifying the vineyard in organic viticulture.

daou-pessimist.title: DAOU Pessimist Red Blend 2021
daou-pessimist.bodyHtml:
DAOU Pessimist Red Blend 2021 is a powerful, intensely aromatic, and opulent red blend dominated by Petite Sirah. It presents an opaque ruby-purple color in the glass and opens with a show-stopping bouquet of blueberry jam, boysenberry, and black plum. Secondary layers unfold to reveal complex notes of elderberry, dark cocoa, cardamom spice, and a subtle touch of leather and grilled meats. On the palate, this wine is broad, massive in weight, and structured with lush flavors of cassis, black cherry, and violet. Balanced by a persistent streak of freshness, it finishes long and smooth with grainy tannins and lingering notes of espresso bean, tobacco, and graphite.

Food Pairing: Smoked beef brisket, barbecued tri-tip, slow-braised short ribs, grilled pepper-crusted lamb chops, and aged hard cheeses like Gouda, Gruyère, or mature Cheddar.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This widely available red blend satisfies in so many ways. Hearty aromas of thick, dark fruit, smoke and anise lead from the nose into a rich palate that's loaded with cassis and violet. A persistent peel of acidity adds balance.
Editors' Choice

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Pessimist is a blend of 75% Petite Sirah, 10% Syrah, 11% Zinfandel, 2% Lagrein and 2% Malbec matured for 10 months in 60% new French oak. It has an opaque ruby-purple color and lush scents of cassis, blueberry jam, violet, lavender and hints of powdered sugar. The full-bodied palate is supple and fresh with gently candied fruits and a satisfying finish. This will be a crowd-pleaser.

arcane-xv-le-diable.title: Xavier Vignon Arcane XV Le Diable 2015 750ml
arcane-xv-le-diable.bodyHtml: The Xavier Vignon Arcane XV Le Diable 2015 is a Vin de France red wine, primarily made from Mourvèdre grapes. It is known for its full-bodied and rich flavors, with notes of dark berries, blueberries, herbs, pepper, and anise. The wine undergoes a three-week maceration and is aged in small oak tanks and concrete.

heitz-lochardet-meursault-1er-perrieres.title: Armand Heitz Meursault Premier Cru Les Perrieres 2021 750ml
heitz-lochardet-meursault-1er-perrieres.bodyHtml: Throughout history, the village of Meursault has never wanted to claim one or more great wines. It's a shame because the agronomic potential of its 1er crus has nothing to envy of the prestige of the grands crus of the hill of Montrachet or Corton. If Meursault had to have a grand cru, it would undoubtedly be Perrières. It is a powerful, intense wine, a rich and imposing terroir. Located mid-slopes like all the best wines in Burgundy, it benefits from the best agronomic conditions.

dario-princic-sivi.title: Dario Princic Sivi Pinot Grigio 2018
dario-princic-sivi.bodyHtml: This 2018 Pinot Grigio from the Venezia Giulia IGT defies expectations. Crafted in the orange wine style, skin contact imbues it with a fuller body and richer flavors compared to its unoaked counterpart. Expect a mix of citrus and stone fruit flavors like apricot and peach, along with herbal notes and a touch of grip from tannins. The crisp acidity will balance the slight tannic texture and lead to a dry finish.

el-enemigo-cabernet-franc.title: El Enemigo Cabernet Franc 2022
el-enemigo-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Cabernet Franc 2022 is a refined, high-altitude Argentine red wine crafted by winemaker Alejandro Vigil and Adrianna Catena at Bodega Aleanna in Mendoza's Uco Valley. Visually displaying a deep ruby-red color with bright violet tones, it opens with an intense and aromatic bouquet of ripe red cherries, cassis, and black currants, seamlessly interwoven with graphite minerality, crushed herbs, black pepper, and subtle cedar notes from oak aging. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, elegant, and fresh, offering a vibrant core of red fruit supported by fine chalky tannins and a persistent, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled lamb chops, roasted pork, braised beef short ribs, wild mushroom dishes, charcuterie, and aged Gouda.

94 Points - James Suckling

Wet earth and elderberries shape the nose with a touch of dark chocolate. The velvety palate is medium- to full-bodied with a hint of cedar that complements the polished dark fruit. Approachable and exceptional for an entry-level wine.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Sourced from Gualtallary's Adrianna Vineyard, the 2022 Cabernet Franc contains 10% Malbec and underwent a 60-day maceration and aged for 15 months in a mix of foudre, barrique and tank. Opening with a dark-fruited, floral and spice-inflected nose, the palate offers dramatic richness tempered by a sturdy, upright, mineral-driven core. It concludes with an explosive, long and layered finish that balances vibrant energy and staining intensity. This is a strikingly overperforming example of the variety that should develop beautifully in the cellar.

dewars-white-label-3.title: Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky
dewars-white-label-3.bodyHtml: Created in 1899, 'White label' is the pillar of the Dewar's portfolio, maintaining its flavour profile throughout the years has ensured its timelessness; pale amber colour with rich honey sweetness, hints of heather and a touch of peat smoke that add to the rounded flavours and smooth satisfying finish.

don-julio-ultima-reserva.title: Don Julio Ultima Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
don-julio-ultima-reserva.bodyHtml: In 2006, Don Julio, with his family, planted their final agave field. In honor of his devotion and craftsmanship, this agave harvest was carefully distilled, barreled, and set aside for a special use. To preserve this tequila and the exquisite agave piñas behind it, we have implemented a Solera aging system. The Solera aging method combines and matures tequilas of different characteristics finished in unique casks, allowing the final agave harvest to remain at the heart of this rare Extra Añejo Tequila. Our Ultima Reserva has been rested in oak, previously used to age bourbon, and finished in Madeira wine-seasoned casks. Salud, to creating only the exceptional.

laphroaig-cairdeas-2021-58-90-abv.title: Laphroaig Cairdeas 2025 Lore Cask Strength
laphroaig-cairdeas-2021-58-90-abv.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Cairdeas 2025 Lore Cask Strength is a highly anticipated, powerfully structured limited-edition single malt Scotch whisky crafted exclusively for the Friends of Laphroaig community. For the 2025 release, the distillery offers an uncut, cask-strength interpretation of its revered core expression, Laphroaig Lore. This complex liquid is artfully created by marrying five of Laphroaig’s all-time favorite cask styles: first-fill ex-bourbon barrels, quarter casks, virgin oak, European oak sherry butts, and refill Laphroaig casks. Non-chill filtered and bottled at a robust 59.6% ABV, this expression allows the drinker to experience the malt exactly as the whisky makers do. The resulting dram elevates Laphroaig's legendary peated profile, weaving heavy medicinal peat smoke and Islay sea spray through gorgeous layers of dark stone fruits, sweet vanilla fudge, and intense kitchen baking spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with rich, sticky barbecued beef brisket, heavily charred rosemary lamb chops, extra-mature blue cheeses like Roquefort or Stilton, or a premium dark chocolate bar infused with sea salt.

TASTING NOTES - An antique gold liquid appearance with brilliant clarity, showcasing a remarkably dense, viscous, and oily mouthfeel that heavily coats the palate and clings to the glass.

NOSE - High-toned, sweet, and boldly peaty, opening with prominent aromas of ripe apricot, peaches in syrup, and lemon cream, beautifully balanced by vanilla fudge sweetness, hints of toasted coconut, fresh basil, a touch of tobacco leaf, and white pepper.

PALATE - Bold, full-bodied, and flavor-forward, delivering an extraordinary explosion of heavy medicinal peat smoke mixed with salty sea spray. The high proof introduces a peppery tongue sparkle alongside vibrant notes of lemon zest, salted limes, and rich caramel, underpinned by background layers of fresh mint tea, cumin, cloves, and ginger.

FINISH - Exceptionally long-lasting, warm, and drying, leaving a deeply resonant, antiseptic trace of Islay peat smoke perfectly balanced by a lingering citrus sweetness and an everlasting clove-like aftertaste.

SERVE - Best enjoyed poured neat at room temperature in a traditional Glencairn glass to let its heavy peat and complex fruit notes fully unfold, or allowed to open up with a few drops of pure spring water to temper the high proof and release hidden nuances of cream and citrus.

johnnie-walker-gold-label-reserve-1.title: Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve
johnnie-walker-gold-label-reserve-1.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve is a luxury blended Scotch whisky crafted by Master Blender Jim Beveridge to celebrate the art of blending. Built around single malt whisky from Clynelish, alongside selected malt and grain whiskies from across Scotland, it is known for its sweet, honeyed profile and smooth, creamy character.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, dark chocolate desserts, fruit tarts, and mild cheeses such as Brie or Gruyère.

Tasting Notes : Bright gold in color with a full, smooth, and creamy mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Soft nectar, gentle floral aromas, and honeyed sweetness with underlying notes of subtle wood smoke and ripe fruit.

Palate : Smooth and rich with flavors of heather honey, vanilla, poached apples, and light wood spices.

Finish : Medium-long and warming with lingering notes of sweet honey, gentle oak, and faint peat smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, over a large ice cube, or with a splash of chilled apple juice and soda water for a signature highball.

fallentimber-mr-pink-honey-apple-raspber.bodyHtml: Fallentimber Mr Pink Honey Apple Raspber 4 Cans

macallan-m.title: The Macallan M
macallan-m.bodyHtml:
M is the iconic result of an unprecedented collaboration between three masters of their crafts who shared the same unique objective - to create the world's most sophisticated whisky contained in an exquisite, exclusively designed crystal decanter. A masterpiece of design, M is brought to conception by creative director and legendary designer Fabien Baron, brought to life by Lalique mastery of crystal and brought to purpose by The Macallan.

A single malt of exquisite complexity and character. Part of The Macallan Decanter Series created to showcase the beautiful range of The Macallan’s natural color, M is born of a collaboration between three masters of their crafts to create a completely individual spirit.

Fashioned in the highest grade crystal, each hand crafted M decanter unites proven tradition with originality, drawing on over 150 years of Lalique mastery and dedication in its refinement and flawless clarity. Its six striking facets are Baron’s homage to The Macallan’s Six Pillars; reflecting our deep rooted heritage at the heart of the decanter's unique design ethos and the vibrant natural colour of the whisky itself. Drawing on some of the richest and rarest casks maturing at the distillery, this is a complex and intense whisky. With a rich rosewood colour derived from the sherry seasoned Spanish oak casks that have nurtured this special whisky through its maturation process, M delivers a complexity and sumptuous intensity rarely experienced in a single malt.

craft-single.title: Milk & Honey Art & Craft Tokaji Casks Single Malt Whisky
craft-single.bodyHtml:
M&H Art & Craft Tokaji Casks is a single malt whisky from the Milk & Honey (M&H) Distillery in Tel Aviv, Israel, bottled at 52% ABV in a 700ml bottle. It belongs to the distillery's Art & Craft series, where its stablemates include bottlings from Madeira, Recioto and white Port casks. This expression was matured in casks that previously held Tokaji, the original white dessert wine of Hungary, which is characterised by tropical aromas and flavours. The distillery's own notes point to vanilla, white raisin and citrus blossom on the nose, stone fruit, citrus and toffee on the palate, and a medium, dry finish with an earthy, mineral edge.

Nose: Vanilla with white raisin, citrus blossom and a musty background note.

Palate: Stone fruits with citrus and vanilla, followed by toffee candy.

Finish: Medium and dry, with earthy minerals and caramel.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

long-shadows-sequel-syrah.title: Long Shadows Vintners Sequel Syrah 2020
long-shadows-sequel-syrah.bodyHtml:
Long Shadows Vintners Sequel Syrah 2020 pours a deep, opaque inky-ruby color in the glass. Conceived by legendary Australian winemaker John Duval as a continuing chapter to his iconic work with Penfolds Grange, this Washington State Syrah unfurls a highly expressive nose defined by wild blueberries, ripe cherries, and a complex savory note of black olive tapenade. Hints of ground pepper, liquid violets, and subtle cocoa oak spices float continuously into the foreground. On the palate, it delivers full-bodied power and a mouth-filling, opulent viscosity. A concentrated core of dark, brambly forest fruits is underpinned by fine-grained, refined tannins and a refreshing spine of natural acidity. After 18 months of maturation in 65% new French oak barrels, it cascades gracefully into a long, structured finish layered with notes of graphite and salted licorice.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled pepper-crusted ribeye steaks, smoked barbecue beef ribs, slow-braised venison stews, or sharp, aged artisanal Cheddar cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling
Inviting aromas of black and blue berries with violets, dark chocolate and spices. Medium- to full-bodied. Toned and focused with pure fruit and fine-grained, silky tannins. A little tight, yet delicate and attractive. Lingering blue-fruited finish. Try from 2025.

long-shadows-chester-red-blend.title: Long Shadows Vintners Chester-Kidder 2017
long-shadows-chester-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Long Shadows Vintners Chester-Kidder 2017 pours a deep, concentrated ruby-black color in the glass. Crafted by winemaker Gilles Nicault, this unique New World blend offers an expressive and layered bouquet featuring intense aromas of wild blackberries, cassis, and black plum compote, beautifully framed by earthy undertones, cocoa, anise, rosemary, and sweet barrel spices. On the palate, this full-bodied red delivers a rich, muscular, and hedonistic mouthfeel. Concentrated black fruit flavors, graphite, and savory hints of black pepper integrate seamlessly with firm, chewy, yet polished tannins and vibrant acidity. Following 30 months of maturation in predominantly new French oak barrels, it culminates in a remarkably long, structured, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, roasted rosemary lamb chops, or aged, hard artisanal cheeses like sharp white Cheddar.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of cassis, chocolate, charcoal and rosemary. It’s full-bodied with firm, chewy tannins. Rich and intense with a firm structure. Muscular and big. Still reserved with a tannic finish. A blend of mostly cabernet sauvignon and syrah. Try in 2024.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of black fruit, anise, vanilla, cocoa and other barrel spices are followed by pitch-black, rich, hedonistic fruit flavors that bring the acidity and tannin structure of the vintage. It's intense, but with plenty of sophistication. A lengthy finish caps it off. Best after 2025.

legendario-elixir-de-cuba-7-year-old-rum.title: Havana Club Añejo 7 Años Rum
legendario-elixir-de-cuba-7-year-old-rum.bodyHtml: Havana Club Añejo 7 Años is a legendary Cuban dark rum, widely considered the gold standard for sipping rums and the quintessential expression of the Havana Club range. Created by the late Maestro Ronero Don José Navarro, this rum is crafted through a continuous aging process where a portion of every final blend is returned to the barrel to nurture future generations. It is composed of rums aged for a minimum of seven years in white oak casks, resulting in a rich, mahogany-hued spirit with a complex and silky texture. On the nose, it reveals an intense bouquet of roasted pecans, tobacco, honey, and tropical fruits, while the palate delivers deep notes of cocoa, vanilla, and warm cedar spice. This world-class rum is best enjoyed neat, over ice, or as a sophisticated base for a classic Cuba Libre or an authentic El Presidente.

krug-clos-dambonnay.title: Krug Clos D'Ambonnay 2002
krug-clos-dambonnay.bodyHtml:
Krug Clos d’Ambonnay was born from the fifth generation of the Krug family, Rémi and Henri Krug’s quest to pay tribute to the Pinot Noir grapes of Ambonnay, a terroir dear to the Maison, while remaining loyal founder Joseph Krug’s plot-by-plot approach to winemaking.

Krug Clos d’Ambonnay is a rare gem epitomising the attention to detail, uncompromising quality and appreciation for unique terroirs inherited from Joseph Krug.

100 Points - Decanter

The bouquet has a magnificent classicism to it, comprising notes of yellow fruits, spices including white pepper, flowers and a mineral edge. With aeration, scents of menthol emerge from the glass. The palate is upright in character, but elegant and crystalline, with a long, structured finish of chalky density. A Champagne having both thrust, tension and aerial lightness in which finesse and power are allies.

secret-cellars-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
secret-cellars-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is an incredibly round, juicy, and highly approachable Californian red wine crafted as a comforting tribute by founder Joseph Carr in honor of his father. Sourced from premier vineyards across California's diverse growing regions, this vintage highlights the approachable and expressive potential of the state's signature red grape. In the glass, it pours a deep, rich dark ruby hue with a full coating rim. The forward and incredibly aromatic nose opens with inviting scents of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, and black currant, masterfully integrated with subtle undertones of toasted hazelnut, cinnamon, warm vanilla, and sweet toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and beautifully balanced, displaying a soft, velvety fluid coherence where its core of juicy dark forest fruit effortlessly intertwines with fine-grained, round tannins and a moderate spine of natural acidity, concluding with a long, smooth finish accented by lingering hints of mocha and subtle wood spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with charcoal-grilled gourmet beef burgers, slow-braised pork short ribs, rosemary-infused roasted lamb chops, and a block of mature sharp cheddar cheese.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas are notes of ripe dark berries, coriander, sage, florals, and toasty oak on the nose. The flavors are Blackberries, boysenberries, vanilla cream, nutmeg, and mocha with silky tannins on the finish.

laphroaig-quarter-cask.title: Laphroaig QA Cask Double Matured Whisky 1L
laphroaig-quarter-cask.bodyHtml:
Nose: Gasoline, medicinal (think band aids), burning rubber, matches, sea spray. After letting it breath, you get the addition of pear and vanilla. So basically, a Laphroaig through and through.

Taste: Light body, smooth texture, that has a rich and intense flavor. The translation from the nose is spot on. Peat spice, rubber, smoke, brine, ash, barley sweetness. The extra maturation however, makes this taste much more well put together than regular Laphroaig and gives it a smoothness that I don't recall in the other variations.

Finish: Peat, brine, ash, iodine, vanilla.

bodegas-ordonez-vatan-arena.title: Ordonez Vatan Arena Tinta De Toro 2014 750ml

el-enemigo-bonarda-la-esperanza.title: El Enemigo La Esperanza Bonarda 2022
el-enemigo-bonarda-la-esperanza.bodyHtml:
El Enemigo La Esperanza Bonarda 2022 Sourced from an 80-year-old historic pergola-trained vineyard in the San Martín district, this profound single-vineyard expression of Bonarda presents a deep, saturated purple color. The nose unfurls an intense, fruit-driven bouquet of black cherries, ripe plums, and blackberries, seamlessly interwoven with notes of underbrush, violets, dark chocolate, and a hint of subtle woodsmoke. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, energetic, and remarkably fresh. It features a velvety texture framed by fine-grained, supple tannins and a bright vein of acidity, leading to a long, lifted, and savory finish enriched by sweet spice from aging 12 months in century-old French oak foudres.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled red meats, traditional Argentine asado, hearty pasta with tomato-based sauces, and aged cheeses like Manchego or Parmigiano-Reggiano.

95 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackberries, underbrush, violets and a hint of geraniums. The palate shows a focused, well-defined thread of fruit complemented by subtle savoriness. Sourced from San Martín in the east. Drink now.

decoy-limited-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Decoy Limited Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
decoy-limited-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Decoy Limited Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a highly polished, expressive, and deeply concentrated red wine that represents the pinnacle of the Decoy portfolio. Sourced from premier estate properties and acclaimed vineyards in the sun-drenched Alexander Valley—Sonoma County's premier region for Bordeaux varietals—this vintage benefited from a cool, extended growing season that allowed for exceptional flavor development and elegant structure. Composed of 94% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6% Merlot, the wine was meticulously aged for 15 months in 100% French oak barrels (40% new, 60% neutral). In the glass, it displays a deep ruby-purple core with bright clarity. The highly aromatic nose opens with striking scents of ripe blueberry, sweet blackberry, and dark plum, beautifully layered with nuanced undertones of violet, cardamom, clove spice, and a subtle touch of milk chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and structured, displaying an engaging fluid coherence where a juicy core of boysenberry and dark forest fruits is effortlessly framed by soft, silky, fine-grained tannins and an enlivening spine of natural acidity. It concludes with a long, plush finish marked by a lingering trace of dark fruit, savory herbs, and refined wood oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rosemary-infused grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, gourmet blue cheese burgers, or mature extra-sharp white cheddar cheese.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This ripe Cabernet delivers focused aromas of blackberry, balsamic, black pepper, and cinnamon on the nose. The palate possesses tannic grip, juicy acid, and flavors of cassis, blueberry, plum, and chopped herb mélange through the finish.

krug-vintage-2008.title: Krug Vintage 2008
krug-vintage-2008.bodyHtml:
At Maison Krug, every Krug Vintage celebrates the distinct character of a particular year – a blend of its most expressive wines, enhanced by a stay of over ten years in the cellars. Each Krug Vintage is different: it tells the story of the unique circumstances of the year, of what surprised, enchanted or moved our Tasting Committee in the tasting room.

100 Points - James Suckling

Exceptional freshness with aromas of flinty white stones, flowers, almonds and lemons. There’s hazelnut and strawberry here, too. Complex. The palate has a long, powerful and smooth-honed feel with very assertive citrus flavors, driven by long acidity. A perfect 2008

paul-john-whisky.title: Paul John Brilliance Indian Single Malt Whisky
paul-john-whisky.bodyHtml:
From the Goan shores of India, this unpeated Indian Single Malt Whisky with hues of sparkling copper invites you to relish its sweet notes touched with a gentle whiff of spice. The honey-like smoothness entices the palate with its rare, cocoa flavoured crispiness, leading you to the deep woody finish of American oak blended with creamy tones of intense vanilla. Experience a taste of handcrafted, non chill-filtered brilliance.

Nose:

The Demerara sugars give off a whiff of sweet fragrances, with a hint of cinnamon, dash of honey and faint spices.

Palate:

Sweet and spice and all things nice, make this Single Malt. The honey-like smoothness is offset by the crunchy-bar-like crispness. Somewhere, there is also a tinge of cocoa.

Finish:

Brilliance has a smooth and beautifully relaxed finish, with a hint of mild spices and deep intense vanilla.

Colour:

Sparkling copper.

Pairing:

With its rich accents of vanilla and subtle hints of spice, this Single Malt is the ideal accompaniment to luscious fruit pies and Indian grilled meat dishes.

glenmorangie-lny-reserve.title: Glenmorangie Signet Reserve
glenmorangie-lny-reserve.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie Signet Reserve is an ultra-premium, deeply decadent evolution of the distillery's legendary original Signet single malt Scotch whisky. Crafted under the direction of Dr. Bill Lumsden, this highly limited expression starts with the unique "espresso-like" spirit distilled once a year from rare, high-roast "chocolate" malted barley. After initial maturation in a combination of bourbon, sherry, and virgin oak casks balanced by some of the distillery's oldest stocks, these choice parcels are extra-matured for an additional 12 months in hand-selected Pedro Ximénez (PX) sherry casks. This specialized double maturation takes the hallmark dark coffee and cocoa core of the original Signet and amplifies it into a richer, incredibly complex, and intensely luxurious dessert-like masterpiece.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with classic Italian tiramisu, dark chocolate espresso tortes, roasted venison with a blackberry reduction, or aged blue cheeses like Stilton.

TASTING NOTES - A rich burnt umber color with an unctuous, syrupy, and incredibly mouth-coating texture that heavily coats the tastebuds.

NOSE - Deep and powerful, offering intense aromas of dark chocolate sponge cake, roasted espresso beans, and muscovado sugar, layered with hazelnut cream, orange zest, and aromatic oak.

PALATE - Incredibly decadent and thick, revealing rich waves of chocolate truffles, toffee, fudge, and treacle, moving into Turkish coffee, toasted cinnamon, orange oil, and a sweet hint of raspberry.

FINISH - Remarkably long and complex, resolving with lingering notes of dark cocoa powder, baking spices, creamy toffee, and the distinct, indulgent finish of fresh tiramisu.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or tulip-shaped spirits glass to fully capture the deep layers of high-roast malt and sherry complexity.

gold-bar-american-whiskey.title: Gold Bar Original American Whiskey
gold-bar-american-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Gold Bar Original is the flagship American whiskey from Gold Bar Whiskey, presented in its unmistakable bottle shaped like a gold ingot. The company sources base whiskies from distilleries across the United States and finishes them in former Napa Valley wine barrels of French oak at its own distillery in San Francisco, California. The whiskey is distilled from a mash of 88% corn, 9% rye and 3% barley, and the time in ex-wine casks is meant to lift the fruit and keep the texture smooth and approachable. Each bottle is individually numbered. Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) in a 750ml bottle, Gold Bar Original won Double Gold at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and is built to work neat, on ice or in cocktails.

Tasting Notes: honeyed grain, orchard fruit, red berries, baking spice, vanilla

Nose: Burnt sugar and honeyed grain opening to fresh orchard fruit and red berries.

Palate: Bright and gently warming, softly sweet and creamy, with red fruit, baking spice and a wisp of wood smoke.

Finish: Smooth and clean with lingering vanilla sweetness.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in an Old Fashioned.

gold-bar-double-cask-straight-bourbon.title: Gold Bar Original American Whiskey
gold-bar-double-cask-straight-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Gold Bar Original is the flagship American whiskey from Gold Bar Whiskey, presented in its unmistakable bottle shaped like a gold ingot. The company sources base whiskies from distilleries across the United States and finishes them in former Napa Valley wine barrels of French oak at its own distillery in San Francisco, California. The whiskey is distilled from a mash of 88% corn, 9% rye and 3% barley, and the time in ex-wine casks is meant to lift the fruit and keep the texture smooth and approachable. Each bottle is individually numbered. Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) in a 750ml bottle, Gold Bar Original won Double Gold at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and is built to work neat, on ice or in cocktails.

Tasting Notes: honeyed grain, orchard fruit, red berries, baking spice, vanilla

Nose: Burnt sugar and honeyed grain opening to fresh orchard fruit and red berries.

Palate: Bright and gently warming, softly sweet and creamy, with red fruit, baking spice and a wisp of wood smoke.

Finish: Smooth and clean with lingering vanilla sweetness.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in an Old Fashioned.

bodega-izadi-rioja-reserva.title: Bodegas Izadi Rioja Reserva 2020
bodega-izadi-rioja-reserva.bodyHtml:
Bodegas Izadi Rioja Reserva 2020 is a sophisticated red wine from the Rioja Alavesa region, crafted primarily from 100% older-vine Tempranillo. This vintage is celebrated for its "crystalline precision," a style that balances the intense ripeness of high-altitude vineyards with vibrant freshness influenced by the nearby Atlantic Ocean. Aged for 16 months in a 50/50 split of French and American oak barrels, the wine develops a complex structure with refined, polished tannins and a persistent balsamic finish. 

92 Points - James Suckling

Cherries, currants, plums, plush chocolate and fine spices. Medium-bodied with ripe, juicy berry fruit and a tightly wound, creamy finish. Very good length with touches of hazelnuts, chocolate and orange peel at the end. Drink now.

chateau-viramiere-st-emilion-grand-cru.title: Chateau Viramiere Saint Emilion Grand Cru 2022
chateau-viramiere-st-emilion-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Château Viramière Saint-Émilion Grand Cru 2022 is a charming, fruit-forward, and elegantly structured Right Bank Bordeaux. Pouring a deep, luminous ruby red, it opens with an intense and inviting bouquet of ripe red fruits like cherry, raspberry, and strawberry, beautifully intertwined with delicate hints of vanilla, cedar, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, juicy, and perfectly balanced, showcasing a generous core of red plum and subtle iron nuances. Supported by fine-grained, approachable tannins and a refreshing acidity, it leads into a smooth, elegant, and persistent finish that faithfully reflects its renowned terroir.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled beef tenderloin, slow-braised veal cheeks, roasted duck breast, filet mignon with red wine sauce, or aged hard cheeses.

elizabeth-rose-chockablock-red.title: Elizabeth Rose Chockablock 2021
elizabeth-rose-chockablock-red.bodyHtml:
Elizabeth Rose Chockablock 2021 is a vibrant, boldly structured, and beautifully balanced Bordeaux-style red blend from the celebrated Napa Valley. Sourced from the organically farmed Block House Vineyard in Yountville and crafted by winemaker Jeff Onysko for Ghost Block Estate Wines (the Pelissa/Hoxsey family), this approachable yet complex wine seamlessly brings together Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Malbec. In the glass, it reveals a brilliant ruby color. The highly expressive aromatic bouquet opens with inviting notes of ripe dark cherries, red plums, and wild strawberries, beautifully layered with elegant hints of rose petals, cocoa, toasted vanilla, and a touch of white pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, delivering a lush, fruit-forward core of blackberry and boysenberry accompanied by warm baking spices. This generous fruit expression is perfectly framed by firm, fine-grained tannins and a bright, refreshing acidity that carries through to an outstanding, remarkably long, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steaks, slow-roasted lamb shanks, hearty venison stews, rich wild mushroom risotto, and mature aged cheddar.

marques-de-caceres-rioja-gran-reserva.title: Marques de Caceres Rioja Gran Reserva 2019
marques-de-caceres-rioja-gran-reserva.bodyHtml:
Marqués de Cáceres Rioja Gran Reserva 2019 is an exceptionally structured, refined, and classic Spanish red wine crafted from low-yielding, old vines in Rioja Alta and Rioja Alavesa. Displaying a deep ruby color with delicate brick-red reflections at the rim, it opens with a complex, expressive bouquet of stewed dark plums, dried figs, and roasted coffee, interwoven with subtle notes of leather, clove, dark chocolate, and elegant toasted oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied, polished, and lively, presenting concentrated dark fruit flavors framed by fine, velvety tannins and a persistent, savory mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with roasted leg of lamb, grilled ribeye steak, venison, braised beef short ribs, game meats, or well-aged Manchego cheese.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Smoke and espresso accents are a subtle, savory thread lacing flavors of macerated black cherry and black raspberry fruit and medicinal herbs, plus a fragrant streak of zesty spices. Structured by mandarin orange peel acidity and sculpted tannins, this is fresh and chewy on the finish. Tempranillo, Garnacha Tinta and Graciano. Best after 2027.

vogue-chambolle-musigny-1er-2019.title: Domaine Comte Georges de Vogue Chambolle-Musigny 1er Cru 2019
vogue-chambolle-musigny-1er-2019.bodyHtml:
A wine of crystalline purity but not lacking in depth. Produced from just over 2ha of vines, including a bit of Premier Cru Les Fuées and Les Baudes blended in. The grapes in 2019 were picked very ripe on September 14th, and have given a wine that has a lovely, rich dark fruit character, with a smoky edge and a texture on the palate that is silky and fine, yet lingers with satisfying persistence. Drinking Window 2024 - 2039.

94 Points - Decanter

This is aromatically similar to the villages in terms of the fruit but with more apparent spice and floral influences. The sleeker, more intense and bigger-bodied weight flavors exhibit more evident minerality on the focused and gorgeously textured finish where a touch of bitter cherry pit character slowly emerges. This markedly firmer effort is also a really lovely wine that possesses a similar degree of finesse but with plenty of punch to go with it. (Drink starting 2031).

montevertine-le-pergole-torte.title: Montevertine Le Pergole Torte 2020
montevertine-le-pergole-torte.bodyHtml:
The prestige wine of Montevertine is only produced in outstanding vintages. This ultimate wine is aged in large Slavonian oak barrels for 18 months and then racked into small French oak (Allier) barrels for the final six month stage of its élevage. It is produced primarily from a two hectare vineyard planted in 1968 exclusively to Sangiovese vines with a north-northeast exposure.

97 Points - James Suckling

Medium to pale purplish color, bright and precise cherry fruit character with bergamot, fresh violets and black cherries. The attack is almost sour, but with firm, integrated acidity and chalky tannins. It’s velvety and ripe with a super-savory finish that has a hint of licorice, a tight-knit structure enhancing the length. Amazing polished finish.
96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
This latest vintage of one of Italy's most important wines has an almost choreographed delivery with dramatic pause and high crescendos as it unfolds over the palate. The Montevertine 2020 Le Pergole Torte feels initially shy, but that is a fleeting impression because its all-around intensity builds beautifully upon dark cherry, blackcurrant, spice, iris root and warm earth. Those notes are followed by a delicate floral interlude, and the wine builds upward again with a very bright and lively mouthfeel fueled by fine tannins and lovely freshness. It is fleshy and rich. This is one of the best wines from this vintage in the region for sure. (ML)

longrow-18-year-old.title: Longrow 18 Year Old
longrow-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Longrow 18 Year Old is a peated Campbeltown single malt from Springbank Distillery, released in limited annual editions and bottled at 46% ABV. Longrow is Springbank's heavily peated style: the malt is dried over peat for around 48 hours in the distillery's own kiln and then double distilled, giving a weightier, oilier spirit than Springbank itself. The cask recipe changes from edition to edition, with sherry casks usually leading the vatting; the 2020 release combined sherry, bourbon and rum casks, the 2022 release was fully sherry matured and the 2024 release joined sherry with port casks. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

springbank-18-year-old.title: Caskshare Collective Series Springbank 30 Year Old 1993 Bourbon Cask 164 49.4% ABV
springbank-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Springbank 30 Year Old 1993 is a single-cask Campbeltown single malt bottled by Caskshare for its Collective Series, labelled 1993/164. Distilled at Springbank in 1993 and matured in bourbon cask number 164, it was bottled on 2 August 2023 at 49.4% ABV, with an outturn of just 144 bottles. It comes in a 70cl bottle with a presentation box. The label note describes fresh apple and pine with a touch of sherbet, then a tangy, almost fizzing palate of orchard fruit and lime pickle relish, and a long, nostalgic finish.

Nose: Fresh apple and pine with a lightly sweet sherbet note.

Palate: Tangy and fizzing, a funky mix of orchard fruit and lime pickle relish.

Finish: Long, with notes the bottler likens to a school gym, new rubber plimsolls and tuck-shop sweets.

Serve: Neat, with a drop of water if desired.

st-supery-moscato.title: St Supery Dollarhide Muscat Canelli 750ml
st-supery-moscato.bodyHtml: St Supery's Dollarhide Estate Vineyard Muscat Canelli is a sweet, rich, and well-balanced wine with a pale yellow color and hints of green. It exhibits aromas of floral white blossom, mandarin orange, and fresh apricot, while the palate offers flavors of ripe peach, honeysuckle, citrus undertones, and tangerine zest.

montevertine-le-pergole-torte-1.title: Montevertine Le Pergole Torte 2019 1.5L Magnum
montevertine-le-pergole-torte-1.bodyHtml:
The prestige wine of Montevertine is only produced in outstanding vintages. This ultimate wine is aged in large Slavonian oak barrels for 18 months and then racked into small French oak (Allier) barrels for the final six month stage of its élevage. It is produced primarily from a two hectare vineyard planted in 1968 exclusively to Sangiovese vines with a north-northeast exposure.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Holding back initially, this wine simply needs more time in bottle, and I have adjusted the drinking window accordingly. The 2019 Le Pergole Torte is a long-term proposition showing initial stirrings of tart cherry fruit, plum, licorice, tobacco and crushed stone. There is a pretty floral tone of violet or rosemary flower even now. Winemaking takes this special selection of 100% Sangiovese though cement and Allier and Slavonian oak. The balanced acidity stands out nicely. There are 29,000 bottles of the 2019 vintage, and I recommend you put yours in the cellar for five to 10 more years.

drouhin-chambolle-musigny.title: Joseph Drouhin Chambolle-Musigny 2022 1.5L Magnum
drouhin-chambolle-musigny.bodyHtml: Fine lace and silk are the words most often associated with this wine. Bright, intense color and complex aromas evoking violet, black cherry and damp earth. According to the vintages, there are also notes of truffle and game. Refined tannins coat the palate. Good balance between texture and acidity. Long aftertaste, with notes of cherry and candied fruit.

hubert-lamy-saint-aubin-la-princee.title: Domaine Hubert Lamy La Princee Saint-Aubin 750ml

hubert-lamy-saint-aubin-1er-les-frionnes.title: Domaine Hubert Lamy Saint-Aubin 1Er Cru 'Les Frionnes'

hennessy-vsop-lny-edition.title: Hennessy VSOP Privilege Cognac
hennessy-vsop-lny-edition.bodyHtml:
Hennessy VSOP Cognac is a harmonious and balanced cognac produced by Jas Hennessy & Co. First created in 1817 at the request of the future King George IV of the United Kingdom, it is crafted from a blend of over 60 different eaux-de-vie aged in seasoned French oak casks, resulting in a rich, velvety profile marked by fresh fruit, toasted oak, and delicate spices.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, foie gras, dark chocolate desserts, aged gouda, or rich caramelized pork belly.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber in color with a velvety, rich, and well-rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh fruit, candied orange peel, vanilla, clove, cinnamon, and subtle toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of ripe apricot, dried fruit, vanilla, toasted almonds, and warm winter spices.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant with lingering notes of sweet spice, candied fruit, and subtle oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip glass, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic cocktails like a Sidecar or Sazerac.

drouhin-puligny-1er-2018.title: Joseph Drouhin Puligny-Montrachet Folatieres Premier Cru 2022
drouhin-puligny-1er-2018.bodyHtml:
Beautiful harmony defines this precious wine. Golden and bright color. The complex and distinctive aromas of Puligny are here in evidence: honey, honeysuckle, fresh almond. As the wine matures, these aromas evolve towards dried fruit notes and spice. On the palate, a very nice balance between freshness and velvety texture. There is even a firm backbone that gives this wine a strong structure. Exceptionally long on the aftertaste, with refined and floral notes throughout.

Excellent with shellfish cooked in a light wine sauce or any delicate fish prepared grilled or poached.

johnnie-walker-blue-label-icon.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
johnnie-walker-blue-label-icon.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label is an iconic, ultra-premium blended Scotch whisky crafted by Johnnie Walker. Hand-selected by Master Blender Jim Beveridge from some of the rarest casks across Scotland—including irreplaceable stocks from ghost distilleries—only one in ten thousand casks possesses the quality and character required for this blend. It delivers a rich, velvety balance of sweet honey, dark chocolate, ripe fruits, and a gentle, lingering cloud of soft Islay smoke.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, caviar, seared duck breast, dark chocolate truffles, and aged blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a silky, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Mellow and rounded with aromas of dry smoke, raisins, sweet honey, toasted nuts, and subtle orange peel.

Palate : Complex and velvety, delivering flavors of hazelnut, dark chocolate, sandalwood, honey, Kumquat fruit, and sweet sherry wood spice.

Finish : Rich, long, and warming with lingering notes of gentle peat smoke, dark fruit, dried spice, and pepper.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass accompanied by a glass of ice water on the side to cleanse the palate between sips.

duckhorn-postmark-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
duckhorn-postmark-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a refined and powerful red wine crafted from top-tier estate and independent grower vineyards across the Napa Valley. Blending 93% Cabernet Sauvignon with 6% Merlot, it opens with rich aromas of boysenberry, black currant, and dark cherry, accented by bay leaf, baking spice, and subtle cedar notes. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, well-sculpted texture packed with blueberry, blackberry, and plum flavors supported by fine, firm tannins and a long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, roasted lamb, duck breast, or aged cheddar cheese.

calera-pinot-noir-central-coast.title: Calera Central Coast Pinot Noir 2022
calera-pinot-noir-central-coast.bodyHtml:
Calera Central Coast Pinot Noir 2022 is an inviting, supple, and beautifully balanced red wine that offers a harmonious expression of cool-climate maritime vineyards spanning California's Central Coast. It opens with alluring aromas of wild raspberry, Bing cherry, and pomegranate, accented by dried sage, green peppercorn, sweet tobacco leaf, and light oak spice. On the palate, it exhibits a smooth, medium-bodied texture framed by gentle, fine-grained tannins, delivering layers of baked plum, strawberry, and cranberry alongside subtle savory herbs, lavender, and citrus peel that carry into a long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with duck breast, roasted pork tenderloin, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, or mild cheeses like Gruyère and Comté.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This priced-to-sell appellation blend gives hints of what the single-vineyard expressions can do in a more accessible manner. Aromas of pomegranate, green peppercorn and oregano decorate the nose. The palate shows baked plum and strawberry flavors as well as Calera’s telltale showing of terpeneladen herbs like bay leaf and marjoram.

91 Points - James Suckling 

A beautiful, balanced and easygoing wine with almost-sweet cherry and plum flavors on a big, broad texture. Strawberries, red cherries, sweet plums, light baking spices and vanilla bean on light tannins

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Pinot Noir Central Coast is a lovely introduction to the modern era at Calera, opening with a fragrant, dark-fruited nose lifted by pure herbal and spice aromas. The palate is supple and deftly concentrated, finishing on a balanced note framed by gentle acidity and subtle grip.

honig-sauvignon-blanc.title: Honig Sauvignon Blanc 2023
honig-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Honig Sauvignon Blanc 2023 is a crisp, vibrant, and highly expressive California white wine that beautifully showcases the classic Honig style. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of bright citrus blossom, fresh lime, ruby grapefruit, and white peach, layered with subtle undertones of lemongrass, ginger, and jasmine. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied and incredibly refreshing, delivering juicy flavors of pomelo and Honeycrisp apple backed by a perfectly round mid-palate and balanced, mouthwatering acidity that carries into a clean, crisp finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light salads, fresh white fish, garlic-herb shrimp, raw oysters with mignonette, or tangy artisanal goat cheese.

bonanno-cabernet.title: BonAnno Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bonanno-cabernet.bodyHtml: A red fruit driven wine with underlying ripe cherry, raspberry and currants with a medium weight mid palate bursting with berry fruit flavors and asking for a savory dinner companion. The texture is smooth and elegant on the palate with balanced acidity. The palate is fresh berries, plum, and hints of cinnamon and vanilla. Crafted to be enjoyed upon release, this wine will also stand the test of time for those who can wait!

antinori-guado-al-tasso-contugo-merlot.title: Marchesi Antinori Tenuta Guado Al Tasso Cont' Ugo 2022
antinori-guado-al-tasso-contugo-merlot.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Tenuta Guado Al Tasso Cont' Ugo 2022 is a refined, single-varietal Merlot produced by the Antinori family at their prestigious Guado al Tasso estate in Bolgheri. Sourced from clay-loam alluvial vineyards situated near the Tuscan coast, the grapes are carefully hand-selected and fermented in stainless steel before aging for 12 months in French oak barriques. In the glass, it displays a deep ruby red color with inviting aromas of dark cherries, ripe blackberries, damson plum, licorice, Mediterranean scrub, and subtle cedar oak spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, supple, and well-balanced, delivering a lush core of dark fruit, fine-grained tannins, and a persistent, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, pork belly, duck breast, mushroom risotto, and aged hard cheeses.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Distinctly fruity, this red features black cherry, blackberry, plum, licorice, cedar and oak spice aromas and flavors. A supple version, with terrific balance and a long aftertaste. Shows just enough grip to lend serious weight. Merlot. Drink now through 2032.

93 Points - James Suckling

This is a wonderfully polished and creamy red. Notes of chocolate biscuits, dark plums, cloves and dark cherries on the nose, as well as some graphite, followed by a full-bodied, plush and supple palate. Merlot. Drink now or hold.

villa-antinori-chianti-classico-riserva.title: Marchesi Antinori Villa Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva 2023
villa-antinori-chianti-classico-riserva.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Villa Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva 2023 is a classic, refined, and deeply harmonious Italian red wine crafted predominantly from Sangiovese alongside complemental international varieties grown across historic estate vineyards in Chianti Classico. Displaying a brilliant ruby red hue, it opens with an elegant and lifted bouquet of marasca cherry, red pomegranate, and candied orange peel, intermingled with delicate floral notes of rose petals and sweet spice hints of vanilla, licorice, and cedar wood. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, velvety entrance and a well-balanced structure defined by vibrant natural acidity and smooth, silky tannins that flow seamlessly into a long, persistent, and subtly oak-accented finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled lamb chops, roasted venison, classic pasta Bolognese, lasagna, prime beef tenderloin, and aged Pecorino cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

A lush and ripe wine with pristine black cherries, pressed violets, subtle black pepper and licorice on the nose. Medium-bodied with brilliant acidity, velvety tannins and a bony finish. Well balanced. Drink or hold.

92 Points- Wine Spectator

Black currant, blackberry, violet and graphite aromas and flavors highlight this dense, concentrated red. Balanced, with refined tannins and vibrant acidity for support. Long aftertaste. Drink now through 2040.

banfi-aska-bolgheri-rosso.title: Banfi Aska Rosso 2022
banfi-aska-bolgheri-rosso.bodyHtml:
Banfi Aska Rosso 2022 is an incredibly focused, linear, and elegantly structured red wine produced by the renowned Castello Banfi estate from their dedicated vineyards in the prestigious coastal region of Bolgheri. A classic Tuscan expression crafted primarily from Cabernet Sauvignon blended with Cabernet Franc, it benefits from temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel and matures for approximately 10 months in French oak barriques. In the glass, it displays an intense, deep ruby core. The highly aromatic nose opens with a concentrated burst of ripe blackberries, mulberries, and dark blueberries, seamlessly layered with complex undercurrents of dried violets, sweet tobacco leaf, damp earth, and rich cocoa dust. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and beautifully vibrant, showing a compact texture seamlessly driven by a lively line of natural acidity and firm, finely integrated, lightly grainy tannins. Forward flavors of tart wild berries and black currant fill the mid-palate, leading into a long, persistent, and clean finish accented by lingering notes of dark chocolate and savory spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with charcoal-grilled ribeye steak, wild boar ragù over pappardelle pasta, roasted lamb shanks, and mature cheeses like an aged Pecorino Toscano.

93 Points - James Suckling

Focused and linear, this offers aromas of ripe blackberries, blueberries, spices, dried violets and wet stones. Juicy and bright, with a medium to full body, vivid acidity and firm, lightly grainy tannins. Bright and fruity in the vivid and agile finish. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Blackberries and mulberries pop with juice as they're crushed underfoot on the nose, and those tart and sweet berries with earth and underbrush continue on the palate before indulgent dark chocolate takes over the finish.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Bright and juicy, this red displays blackberry, black cherry, earth and tobacco flavors, plus a touch of rhubarb. Its thick tannins define the lengthy finish with a solid grip. Sleek and well-toned. Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2027 through 2038.

st-innocent-pinot-noir-momtazi-vineyard.title: St. Innocent Momtazi Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021
st-innocent-pinot-noir-momtazi-vineyard.bodyHtml:
St. Innocent Momtazi Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021 is a highly expressive, biodynamically grown Oregon red wine sourced from steep, exposed slopes in the McMinnville AVA. In the glass, it shows a bright garnet hue, yielding complex aromas of crushed blackberry, black cherry blossom, rosemary, pine, and dusty volcanic earth. On the palate, it exhibits a dark, elegant nature, balancing concentrated wild berry fruits with hints of orange zest, blood orange, cedarwood, and eastern spices. Supported by cool-toned, lively acidity and fine, crunchy tannins, it concludes with a persistent, savory mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with braised duck, mushroom cassoulet, roasted pork tenderloin, grilled salmon, and wild game stews.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

If you love ripe blackberries, you will fall head over heels for the way this wine smells. The berries are joined by aromas of cherry blossoms, wet stones and a touch of seared steak. There's balance here, with silky tannins and snappy acidity backing flavors like blackcap raspberries, orange zest and cedarwood.


90 Points - James Suckling

Notes of spiced cherries, dried strawberries, red licorice and hints of cocoa. Medium-bodied with dusty tannins and earthy, savory notes. Moderate finish. Drink now.

castello-di-bolgheri-superiore.title: Castello di Bolgheri Superiore 2020
castello-di-bolgheri-superiore.bodyHtml:
Castello di Bolgheri Superiore 2020 is an exceptionally structured, refined, and powerful Tuscan red wine hailing from the historic estate surrounding the castle of Bolgheri. In the glass, it exhibits an intense ruby-purple hue and opens with complex, fragrant aromas of ripe cassis, black cherries, and wild blueberries, layered with subtle hints of graphite, sweet cedar, tobacco leaf, and Mediterranean scrubland. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, compact, and perfectly balanced, featuring a rich core of dark fruit supported by firm, finely meshed tannins and a vibrant line of acidity that leads into a long, persistent, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled Bistecca alla Fiorentina, braised wild boar ragù, roasted rack of lamb, or mature aged Pecorino cheese.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This red leads off with ample iron and savory aromas and flavors, courtesy of eucalyptus, wild rosemary and mineral notes, all framing the core of pure black currant and blackberry fruit. Taut and firmly built, with fine length. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Merlot. Best from 2025 through 2040.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

In the bottle with the white label, the Castello di Bolgheri 2020 Bolgheri Superiore shows a hint of savory greenness with peppercorn, bay leaf, baked plum and blackberry preserves. The oak adds sweetness with cinnamon and nutmeg over a very generous mouthfeel with thick, chalky tannins that need a few more years of bottle age. With a 15% alcohol content, this wine is more intense on the palate compared to the bouquet. The effect is almost burly or pugilistic, setting this wine up for a pairing with hearty winter dishes. That hit of chili flake that we saw in the Bolgheri Rosso appears again here. Some 25,000 bottles were released, and the blend is 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 18% Cabernet Franc and 7% Merlot.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is a sun-soaked seafaring adventure, with savory notes of dried meat from the hold and leather belts and boots mixing with a rich fruitiness and the salty sea air. The rich, fruity, chocolaty palate eventually turns spicy, and that spice dances with searing acidity to prolong the finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

Notes of toasted spices, dark cedar, cocoa and bark with a mix of red and blue fruit in the background. Full, compact and lightly chewy with firm, vertical tannins. Spiced, ripe and intense, yet well-integrated and balanced with tension and persistence. Needs some time in the bottle. Try after 2025.

cecchi-chianti-classico-gran-selezione.title: Castelvecchi Madonnino Della Pieve Gran Selezione Chianti Classico 2017
cecchi-chianti-classico-gran-selezione.bodyHtml: Castelvecchi Madonnino Della Pieve Gran Selezione Chianti Classico

serafini-vidotto-phigaia-rosso.title: Serafini & Vidotto Phigaia (After The Red) 2018 750ml
serafini-vidotto-phigaia-rosso.bodyHtml: The Serafini & Vidotto Phigaia (After The Red) 2018 is a red wine described as intense and inviting, with aromas of sour cherries and blackcurrants, along with hints of officinal herbs and roasted peppers. It features a fresh, fruity palate with round, elegant tannins and a long, spicy finish with liquorice notes.

tommasi-il-sestante-ripasso-classico-doc.title: Tommasi Il Sestante Valpolicella Ripasso 2020 750ml
tommasi-il-sestante-ripasso-classico-doc.bodyHtml: A deep ruby red in color, on the nose it displays intense notes of ripe red fruits that broaden out into elegant floral and spicy hints. On the palate it is mellow, structured and with excellent balance, with a coherent aftertaste reminiscent of cheery preserve. Excellent with white and red meat dishes, or mature cheeses. With its well-balanced, rounded style, it can also accompany more delicate game dishes.

gamble-family-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Frank Family Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
gamble-family-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This is a quintessential Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon with pronounced aromas of blackberry, cassis, and vanilla that welcome you into the glass. Flavors of black plums, nutmeg, dark chocolate, and a touch of espresso enhance the wine's complex and full-bodied structure, with a core of elegant acidity from start to finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

The most widely available Frank Family cab is firm and structured in this drought vintage, wrapping moderate to full tannins around a mix of bright red cherries, black cherries, mint and cassis accents.

remelluri-reserva.title: Remelluri Rioja Reserva 2017
remelluri-reserva.bodyHtml: Remelluri Rioja Reserva 2017 is a landmark organic wine that represents the historic recovery of the traditional "Rioja Alavesa" estate style. Under the guidance of Telmo Rodríguez, this vintage was crafted from estate-grown grapes harvested from high-altitude terraces nestled against the Sierra de Cantabria mountains. The 2017 season was marked by a severe spring frost followed by a hot summer, resulting in a low-yielding crop with exceptional concentration and a powerful structural backbone. On the nose, it offers a sophisticated bouquet of black cherries and wild herbs, underpinned by deep mineral notes of damp earth and incense. The palate is medium-to-full bodied and remarkably fresh, showcasing vibrant dark fruit, firm tannins, and a savory complexity that leads to a long, elegant finish.

21-gables-chenin-blanc.title: Spier 21 Gables Chenin Blanc 2023
21-gables-chenin-blanc.bodyHtml:
Spier 21 Gables Chenin Blanc 2023 is a rich, complex, and beautifully structured white wine crafted from certified heritage old vines planted between 1983 and 1985 in the Tygerberg hills near Cape Town. Influenced by the nearby Atlantic Ocean and Malmesbury shale soils, the grapes were hand-picked in multiple passes to capture a range of ripeness levels before undergoing barrel fermentation and aging for 10 to 12 months in French oak barrels (50% new). In the glass, it displays a pale lemon-gold color with vibrant aromas of ripe peach, pear, yellow plum, quince, and citrus rind interwoven with toasted oak, white coriander spice, and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it is full-bodied yet elegant, showcasing a dense core of orchard fruit, creamy butterscotch nuances, crisp natural acidity, and a long, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with caramelised pork belly, roasted duck breast with fynbos honey, smoked mussels, creamy seafood pasta, butter-baked white fish, and aromatic vegetable korma.

92 Points- James Suckling

Aromas of nutmeg, apple crumble and toast are followed by a medium- to full-bodied palate with wood spices and pastry nuances. Bright, delicious finish. Sustainable. Drink now. Screw cap.

whistler-bear-paw-honey-lager.title: Whistler Bear Paw Honey Lager 6 Cans

el-enemigo-chardonnay.title: El Enemigo Chardonnay 2023
el-enemigo-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Chardonnay 2024 is a distinctive, mineral-driven Argentine white wine crafted by winemaker Alejandro Vigil and historian Adrianna Catena at Bodega Aleanna. Sourced from high-altitude vineyards at 1,470 meters above sea level in Gualtallary, Tupungato, the grapes grow on deep calcareous and rocky soils that impart intense freshness and tension. Fermented with wild yeasts in 500-liter French oak barrels (35% new) and aged for 9 to 12 months under a biological veil of flor yeast, the wine develops a unique saline complexity inspired by traditional Jura and Sherry methods. In the glass, it displays a luminous pale gold hue. The aromatic bouquet unfolds with expressive notes of fresh pear, pineapple, and lemon zest layered with toasted hazelnut, acacia blossom, and chalky minerality. On the palate, it delivers a dry, medium-to-full body balanced by vibrant natural acidity and a creamy, briny texture that carries into a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Herb-roasted chicken, grilled sea bass, creamy mushroom risotto, seared scallops, or soft triple-cream Brie cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

Youthful and lightly spicy aromas of freshly cut pineapple, chalk, star fruit and touches of kelp and nougat. Deliciously saline and pure on the medium-to full-bodied palate, with a long and lightly unctuous finish. The subtle salinity offers extra layers, length and definition to the wine. Drink from 2027.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Produced from sites in Gualtallary, including Adrianna Vineyard, the 2024 Chardonnay was vinified in 500-liter barrels, a portion of which underwent the biological aging that has become a signature of Alejandro Vigil's winemaking. Crushed stones, dried herbs, green fruits and saline overtones mark the nose, introducing one of the richer, broader palates in the introductory El Enemigo range. The finish recalls the energy of the nose, lingering long with pronounced salinity and herbal overtones.

contino-gran-reserva.title: Contino Gran Reserva 2018
contino-gran-reserva.bodyHtml:
A selection of the best soils from the vineyards is used to produce the Contino Reserva to offer the best possible wine in terms of acidity, concentration and maturity. The Tempranillo grapes are harvested primarily from an area of stony soil near the Ebro River, resulting in slower ageing due to the humidity of the ground.

Blend: 82% Tempranillo, 10% Graciano, 5% Mazuelo, 3% Garnacha

98 Points - James Suckling

A juicy and delicious red Contino with harmony and balance showing cherry, chocolate and sandalwood aromas and flavors. Extremely perfumed. Incense. Mushroom. Medium body, with firm, muscular and fine tannins that have excellent length and raciness and open nicely in the glass. 25% new French oak for 24 months. Beautiful now and will age wonderfully. Drinkable now, but even better in two or three years and onwards.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This dark garnet-colored wine has a bouquet of purple plum, mocha and violet. It is slightly spicy on entry, with opening notes of clove, mint leaf and dark chocolate that are accompanied by flavors of blackberry and black cherry swaddled in a layer of plush tannins that drift into a lasting finish.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
