The 2018 Gran Reserva comes from a rainier year at Contino, a challenging vintage that gave them a lot of work but with good results and healthy grapes. This was produced with a blend of 82% Tempranillo, 10% Graciano, 5% Mazuelo and 3% Garnacha selected by their ripeness, acidity and concentration. It fermented in concrete with indigenous yeasts and matured in 225-liter French oak barrels for two years. They aim for a renewed classical style. The parameters are 13.94% alcohol, a pH of 3.38 and 5.7 grams of acidity, a fresher wine reflecting a cooler year. There is more depth of fruit, more acidity and more complexity, while keeping the classical profile and with effect of the long élevage; it is spicy and developed, with a polished palate and a dry, chalky finish. 30,600 bottles and some larger formats produced. It was bottled in July 2021.

whistler-forager-gluten-free-pale-ale.title: Whistler Forager Gluten Free Pale Ale 6 Cans
whistler-forager-gluten-free-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Whistler Forager Gluten Free Pale Ale 6 Cans

glenallachie-11-year-old-grattamacco-fin.title: The GlenAllachie 11 Year Old Grattamacco Finish
glenallachie-11-year-old-grattamacco-fin.bodyHtml:
To craft The GlenAllachie Wine Series, we first expertly matured our spirit in American Oak Ex-Bourbon Barrels. Subsequently, the whisky underwent additional maturation for almost two years in Wine Barriques meticulously sourced by Master Distiller, Billy Walker, imparting a distinctive twist onto the GlenAllachie spirit.

This ruby blush malt, brimming with notes of toffee, stone fruits and orange peel, is crafted from wonderful medium toasted Super Tuscan Barriques. These certified Organic Barriques were carefully selected from the Grattamacco winery in the beautiful Bolgheri area of Tuscany in Italy, and then bottled once optimum balance of wood and spirit was achieved.

This expression is bottled unchilfiltered for flavour with no added colouring at 48% ABV.

glenallachie-13-year-old-rioja-finish.title: The GlenAllachie 13 Year Old Rioja Finish
glenallachie-13-year-old-rioja-finish.bodyHtml:
To craft The GlenAllachie Wine Series, we first expertly matured our spirit in American Oak Ex-Bourbon Barrels. Subsequently, the whisky underwent additional maturation for almost two years in Wine Barriques meticulously sourced by Master Distiller Billy Walker, imparting a distinctive twist onto the GlenAllachie spirit.

This golden bronze malt obtains its nutty and honeyed character from carefully sourced Rioja Barriques of Spanish Oak, with a medium level of toasting. Rioja hails from Spain’s most renowned wine region and delivers sophisticated fruit notes. These Barriques were bottled when the influences of the distillery and wood reached complete harmony.

This expression is bottled unchilfiltered for flavour with no added colouring at 48% ABV.

rey-sol-extra-anejo-10-year-old-single-b.title: Rey Sol 10 Year Old Extra Anejo Single Barrel 20th Anniversary Tequila
rey-sol-extra-anejo-10-year-old-single-b.bodyHtml: This single barrel cask strength extra anejo tequila is aged in new French Oak for 10 long years slowly developing caramel, vanilla, dark cherries, wood, toasted almonds and cinnamon followed by hints of maple and butterscotch, all while maintaining a sense of blue agave the whole way through.

glenallachie-10-year-old-cask-st-batch-6.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 6 57.8% ABV
glenallachie-10-year-old-cask-st-batch-6.bodyHtml: The GlenAllachie Cask Strength Batch 6 is a combination of Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry puncheons along with a small quantity of Virgin Oak and Rioja casks. The resulting whisky bursts with indulgent notes of of sticky honey, warming mocha, orange peel and spicy cinnamon. Batch 6 is bottled at 57.8%, non chill filtered and natural colour.

lismore-18-year-old.title: Lismore 18 Year Old
lismore-18-year-old.bodyHtml: A prestigious and refined Speyside single malt, the Lismore 18 Year Old is a well-aged "mystery malt" sourced from a renowned family-owned distillery. The extended maturation in oak casks has resulted in a whisky of great depth and elegance, presenting a rich mahogany color. The nose is complex and enticing, offering aromas of dark toffee, stewed orchard fruits, and a hint of old leather and spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied and exceptionally smooth, delivering a harmonious blend of honeyed sweetness, roasted malt, and dried fruits, followed by subtle notes of dark chocolate and toasted oak. The finish is remarkably long, sophisticated, and warming, characterized by lingering nuances of sweet spice and a delicate, drying wood tannin.

glenrothes-25-year-old-1.title: The Glenrothes 25 Year Old
glenrothes-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Taste: Coriander seeds, violets and a hint of salted caramel.

Matured in a high proportion of first fill sherry seasoned oak casks and bottled at natural colour. This expression delivers heady notes with a character defined by salted caramel, mango and coriander seeds.

chateau-des-laurets-st-emilion-lussac.title: Baron Edmond De Rothschild Chateau Des Laurets 2018
chateau-des-laurets-st-emilion-lussac.bodyHtml:
Baron Edmond De Rothschild Chateau Des Laurets 2018 is an elegant, classically styled Right Bank Bordeaux red blend composed of roughly 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc. Cultivated on south-facing clay-limestone hillsides, this vintage displays an intense aromatic complexity, offering vibrant notes of dark currants, black plums, morello cherries, and violets, balanced by subtle hints of espresso, licorice, and baking spices. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied, striking a remarkable balance between freshness and concentration. The well-integrated oak leads into a refined, long finish shaped by silky, polished tannins.

Food Pairing: Roasted or grilled red meats (such as duck breast, roasted lamb, or seared ribeye), rich mushroom-based dishes, venison, and mature cheeses like Comté or Brie.

91 Points - James Suckling

Pretty aromas of currants, blackberries, pine needles and cloves. It’s medium-bodied with firm, smooth tannins. Refined. Try from 2023.

beringer-private-reserve-chardonnay.title: Beringer Private Reserve Chardonnay 2024
beringer-private-reserve-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Beringer Private Reserve Chardonnay 2024 is a classic, rich, and beautifully crafted California white wine, representing the pinnacle of Beringer’s Chardonnay winemaking in Napa Valley. Displaying a luminous golden hue, it opens with fragrant aromas of ripe yellow apple, white peach, honeysuckle, and toasted brioche, seamlessly supported by delicate oak spices and vanilla notes. On the palate, it is full-bodied, opulent, and creamy, delivering a lush mouthfeel balanced by lively natural acidity that carries rich flavors of baked pear, lemon curd, and subtle toasted hazelnut through a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken with herbs, pan-seared sea scallops, creamy mushroom risotto, and aged Gruyère cheese.

96 Points - James Suckling

This has a vivid intensity balanced with freshness and just the right influence of oak. Aromas of preserved lemons, salted caramel, orange blossoms, lanolin and spices. The palate is tightly wound, showing mouthwatering acidity and a lovely texture with a flavorful finish. About 80% malolactic fermentation. Drink or hold.

wolfberger-tokay-pinot-gris-pfirsigberg.title: Wolfberger Alsace Grand Cru 'Pfersigberg' Pinot Gris 2019
wolfberger-tokay-pinot-gris-pfirsigberg.bodyHtml:
Wolfberger Alsace Grand Cru 'Pfersigberg' Pinot Gris 2019 is an opulent, highly aromatic, and elegant white wine produced by Wolfberger in the Alsace region. Sourced from the prestigious Pfersigberg Grand Cru site—a sheltered, limestone-marl terroir located near Eguisheim—this wine takes full advantage of the vineyard's warm, early-ripening microclimate. In the glass, it displays a radiant golden-yellow hue. The complex nose opens with expressive aromas of candied yellow peach, ripe Conference pear, acacia honey, gingerbread, and subtle sweet spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and velvety, offering a generous, off-dry core of orchard and tropical fruits balanced by a fine, chalky mineral acidity and a long, harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pan-seared foie gras, duck breast with orange glaze, roasted poultry, spicy Asian dishes, rich mushroom risotto, and aged Comté cheese.

beronia-rioja-gran-reserva.title: Beronia Gran Reserva 2018
beronia-rioja-gran-reserva.bodyHtml:
Beronia Gran Reserva 2018 is a sophisticated, complex, and deeply elegant red wine that beautifully reflects the prestigious terroir of Rioja Alta. Crafted primarily from the estate's oldest Tempranillo vines with thoughtful touches of Graciano and Mazuelo, this wine undergoes extensive aging—spending 28 months in French oak barrels followed by a minimum of three years resting in the bottle. In the glass, it pours a deep cherry red, opening with an intense and inviting bouquet of ripe black plum, earthy blackberries, and dark cherries, intricately interwoven with complex secondary notes of dark chocolate, roasted hazelnuts, vanilla, sweet baking spices, and a subtle hint of truffle. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, firm, and wonderfully juicy, delivering a beautifully balanced core of savory dark fruit framed by refined, fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity. Evolving elegantly in the glass, it culminates in a long, layered, and memorable finish, showcasing incredible structure and impressive cellaring potential.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with an herb-crusted rack of lamb, slow-roasted venison, savory wild mushroom and truffle risotto, or firm aged cheeses like sharp Manchego.

92 Points - James Suckling

Dark mushrooms, hazelnuts and chocolate, with earthy blackberries. A touch of dried black fruit, too. Firm and juicy, with medium to full body and a long, complex finish. Savory and appetizing. Drink now or keep holding for another three to four years.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Fresh and minerally, with iron and graphite notes underscoring a zesty range of wild cherry, black currant, green olive, tobacco and cola flavors. This is tightly meshed today, with fine, taut tannins enmeshed in the plush texture. Lively finish. Tempranillo, Graciano and Mazuelo. Drink now through 2030.

guigal-cote-rotie-brune-et-blonde.title: E. Guigal Cote Rotie Brune et Blonde 2018
guigal-cote-rotie-brune-et-blonde.bodyHtml:
The 2018 E. Guigal "Brune et Blonde" is a classical and incredibly consistent expression of Côte-Rôtie, sourced from a mosaic of nearly 40 different vineyard parcels across both the Côte Brune (known for its iron-rich schist and power) and the Côte Blonde (famous for its limestone and elegance). The 2018 vintage is noted for its generosity and ripeness, offering a seductive bouquet of blackberry, dark cherry, and red currant, accented by characteristic notes of violet, white pepper, and smoky bacon fat. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and remarkably round, showcasing silky tannins and a savory mineral core. Aged for 36 months in second-fill French oak, it offers a refined balance of fruit and wood, leading to a long, spicy finish with hints of licorice and forest floor.

95 Points - James Suckling

All of the classic Cote-Rotie aromas (leather, smoked bacon, spices and black cherry) pour from the glass of this rich and fleshy wine. Very silky texture, in spite of the generous, fine tannins, which build beautifully at the long, complete finish.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This pushes lots of alder, incense and singed tobacco notes to the fore, with commensurate cherry and red currant paste flavors following behind that, finishing with perfume and red tea accents. This is not shy with its oak treatment and very nicely done. Best from 2022.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Approachable and gentle, this wine has a dense core of brambly black and red berries, oak spice, warm earth and a stone minerality. It is balanced with round tannins, making the wine enjoyable now but it has enough structure to be easily cellared well past 2030+.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

While the 2018 Cote Rotie Brune et Blonde comes across as being slightly less complex than the 2017, it's also fruitier and more overtly charming. Cherries and berries abound in this supple, medium to full-bodied effort that finishes long and silky.

edmeades-zinfandel-mendocino.title: Edmeades Mendocino Zinfandel 2022
edmeades-zinfandel-mendocino.bodyHtml:
Edmeades Mendocino Zinfandel 2022 is a bold, fresh, and highly concentrated expression of coastal California winemaking. It opens with focused, inviting aromas of blackberries, black currants, and black cherries, seamlessly layered with warm baking spices like cinnamon and cloves, alongside hints of dried sage and delicate florals. On the palate, the wine is lush, round, and rich, delivering dynamic flavors of boysenberry, blood orange, dark chocolate, and ginger. Subtle, well-integrated tannins provide a firm structure that perfectly balances the generous fruit profile, while a bright, refreshing vein of acidity keeps the finish vibrant, dry, and exceptionally long.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with slow-cooked beef brisket, roasted lamb, hearty game meats, and rich barbecue dishes with smoky, savory glazes.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine is fresh, concentrated with aromas of blackberry, black cherry, ginger and dried florals. The palate has flavors of boysenberry, blood orange, coriander and dried sage intertwined with orange zest and dark chocolate. It finishes dry. Pair with brisket.

stags-leap-chardonnay.title: Stags' Leap Winery Chardonnay 2024
stags-leap-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Chardonnay 2024 is a remarkably expressive, bright, and beautifully balanced white wine that exemplifies the crisp vitality and rich texturing of southern Napa Valley. Sourced primarily from cooler sub-regions where morning coastal fog preserves essential natural acidity, this vintage delivers a complex bouquet of lemon confit, fresh sliced pears, wet slate, and light baking spices, accented by delicate hints of flaky pie crust and white magnolia blossoms. On the palate, the wine balances power and energy, driving a succulent core of Golden Delicious apples, citrus zest, and lemon curd across a rounded, generous mouthfeel. Enhanced by partial barrel fermentation and meticulous lees stirring without undergoing malolactic fermentation, it maintains striking mineral clarity and freshness before culminating in a long, beautifully polished, and vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with herb-roasted chicken, buttery Dungeness crab, creamy wild mushroom risottos, or aged Manchego cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A classic Napa Valley chardonnay that’s everything you could ask for. Aromas of lemon confit, fresh sliced pears, wet slate, spices and pie crust. The palate is bright, with fine acidity cutting through a rounded and generous mouthfeel. Nicely constructed.

becherovka.title: Becherovka Original Liqueur
becherovka.bodyHtml:
An iconic Czech herbal liqueur produced in Karlovy Vary for over 200 years. It’s timeless taste is based on a secret recipe – a balanced mix of approximately 20 herbs and spices from all over the world. This unique mix creates a pleasant bitter-sweet taste and prominent golden colour of the liqueur.

Becherovka’s timeless taste has remained proudly unchanged since 1807. Initially you will feel a prominent bitter taste with dominant notes of clove and cinnamon on your palate. After swallowing the real strength of herbs appears combined with bitter orange and sweet after taste.

quails-gate-old-vines-foch-reserve.title: Quails' Gate Old Vines Foch 2022 750ml
quails-gate-old-vines-foch-reserve.bodyHtml: Quail's Gate Old Vines Foch 2022 is a full-bodied red wine with a dark, inky color, showcasing robust aromas of black fruit, smoky notes, and earthy complexities. The palate is rich and round with soft tannins, offering flavors of ripe black cherry, plum, and blackberry, complemented by hints of vanilla and black pepper. The wine is made from Marechal Foch grapes grown on old vines in the Okanagan Valley, Canada, with a portion aged in new French oak, contributing to its complex flavor profile.

muga-reserva.title: Bodegas Muga Reserva 2022
muga-reserva.bodyHtml:
Bodegas Muga Reserva 2022 is an exceptionally elegant, structured, and deeply expressive Spanish red wine crafted by the historic Muga family in Haro, the heart of Rioja Alta. Sourced from estate vineyards planted on clay-limestone soils sheltered by the Obarenes Mountains, this vintage showcases a warm and early-ripening growing season that yielded immense aromatic intensity and pristine fruit character. The grapes are harvested by hand and fermented using indigenous yeasts in large wooden vats. True to the bodega's artisanal heritage, the wine is matured for up to 24 months in oak casks handcrafted in their own on-site cooperage, utilizing a combination of 80% to 90% French and 10% to 20% American oak, followed by traditional fining with fresh egg whites and extensive bottle aging. In the glass, it displays a bright ruby-red color with medium-deep intensity and a subtle garnet-tinged rim. The highly expressive and complex nose unrolls a magnificent bouquet of ripe forest fruits, wild blackberries, blueberries, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with notes of black licorice, toasted coffee beans, sweet vanilla, and delicate reminders of forest floor and savory spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red is concentrated yet sleek and polished, driving a juicy core of succulent dark berry fruits, chocolate, and baking spices. It perfectly balances its rich mid-palate depth with a vibrant, mouthwatering line of integrated acidity and a powerful frame of firm, silky, and fine-grained tannins that carry into a long, harmonious, and slightly chewy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled prime ribeye steaks, slow-cooked beef stews, roasted lamb shanks, cured Iberian ham, and mature hard cheeses like aged Manchego.

93 Points - James Suckling

Chocolate, dark fruit and spices with pinecone. Medium- to full-bodied, succulent, with polished tannins, length and definition on the finish. This comes from various plots planted within a radius of 25 km from the winery. A blend of tempranillo, garnacha, mazuelo and graciano. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Reserva, sold as Crianza in Spain, has more tertiary notes than other people's Gran Reserva, even though it has a very classical profile. It is mostly Tempranillo with some Garnacha Tinta, Mazuelo and Graciano from vineyards no more than 25 kilometers from the winery in Haro, cropped from a warm and dry year. Here, what they did was wait; it rained a little, the plants unblocked and they had the patience to wait for the grapes to ripen fully. So, the grapes were in a very healthy state, and winemaker Isaac Muga likes to ferment the grapes destemmed and lightly crushed in oak vats with indigenous yeasts and then mature the wine in 90% French and 10% American oak barrels for 22 months, with racking every eight to nine months. It has good ripeness, 14% alcohol, a pH of 3.59 and 5.45 grams of acidity, and it's medium- to full bodied, concentrated but sleek and polished, with fine-grained tannins, very supple flavors and a chalky finish. It still has some toasty notes in the finish that should integrate with a little bit more time. 945,000 bottles produced. It was bottled in January 2025. They are very happy with 2022, and they even produced Prado Enea and a tiny quantity of Aro.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A sleek red, with flavors of black cherry and cured tobacco, plus accents of anise, smoked paprika and espresso, all trimmed nicely by refined, chalky tannins. This is enjoyable today but shows the stuffing for cellaring. Tempranillo and Garnacha. Drink now through 2040. 82,000 cases made, 15,000 cases imported.

louis-jadot-bne-1cru-les-boucherottes.title: Louis Jadot Beaune Boucherottes Premier Cru Domaine des Heritiers 2022
louis-jadot-bne-1cru-les-boucherottes.bodyHtml:
A full-bodied, aromatic Pinot Noir with a rich roundness of fruit and plump texture arrayed around a rigorous structure. This wine has the structure to pair well with most meats, even those with strong sauces, as well as cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows fine depth, with a darker expression of fruit -- black cherry, blackberry and black currant -- backed by dense, refined tannins. A bit broader in profile, too, culminating in the long, sinewy finish, with mineral and spice elements.

belvedere.title: Belvedere Vodka Altitude Edition
belvedere.bodyHtml:
Belvedere Vodka Altitude Edition is a limited-edition bottling of Belvedere, the Polish rye vodka distilled and bottled by Polmos Zyrardow. The edition was released for the winter apres-ski season and takes its theme from high-altitude landscapes: the frosted bottle carries bare trees and a mountain peak in a copper tone. Inside is Belvedere vodka at 40% ABV, in a 750 ml bottle, made, as the brand puts it, from Polish rye, the grain that defines all Belvedere vodkas, and distilled by traditional methods. Only the bottle design is particular to this edition. The tasting notes published for the vodka describe a soft nose of vanilla and cream, a full, round and velvety palate with a little black pepper, and a lasting finish of almond and clotted cream.

Tasting Notes: Soft, round and creamy rye vodka.

Nose: Soft and inviting, with vanilla and cream.

Palate: Full and round with a velvety texture; light vanilla between sweet and savoury, a hint of black pepper and spice.

Finish: Sustained, with almond, clotted cream and a faint Brazil nut note.

Serve: Well chilled, neat or in a Martini.

domaine-du-pegau-cuvee-reserve-red.title: Domaine du Pegau Chateauneuf-du-Pape Cuvee Reservee 2023
domaine-du-pegau-cuvee-reserve-red.bodyHtml:
Domaine du Pégau Châteauneuf-du-Pape Cuvée Réservée 2023 is a powerful, rich, and deeply traditional Southern Rhône red wine crafted by Paul and Laurence Féraud from low-yielding old vines grown across key parcels in Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Visually displaying a dark red hue with purple body reflections, it opens with an intense and aromatic bouquet of ripe black cherry, wild raspberry, and kirsch, layered with juniper berries, garrigue herbs, lavender, white pepper, and subtle leather notes. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body featuring a plush, velvety texture, supple tannins, and a fresh core of dark berry fruit that flows into a long, complex, and spice-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted leg of lamb, wild boar ragù, braised beef short ribs, grilled ribeye steak, roasted duck breast, and aged French cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

Aromatic and perfumed with plum and dark cherry, with violets and lavender that follow through to a medium-bodied wine with firm tannins and a juicy, spicy finish. Old vine bark flavors. Just a hint of tannins to give depth and intensity to the wine. 80% grenache noir, 6% syrah, 4% mourvedre and 10% other varieties. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Châteauneuf-du-Pape Cuvée Réservée has turned out beautifully, opening with aromas of dark berries, rose petals, mulberries and spices. Medium- to full-bodied, round and sappy, it is deep and muscular, framed by velvety tannins and concluding with a long, spicy finish. Less dense and robust than in previous years, this blend of 80% Grenache Noir, 6% Syrah, 4% Mourvèdre and 10% permitted varieties should gain further depth and harmony with time in the cellar.

glenrothes-10-year-2010-carn-mor-strictl.title: Carn Mor Strictly Limited Glenrothes 2010 10 Year Old Sherry Hogshead Cask Strength 64.4% ABV
glenrothes-10-year-2010-carn-mor-strictl.bodyHtml: A Sherry Hogshead cask selected and bottled for Exclusively for Rare Drams. Aged for 10 years and bottled in 2021 with 271 bottles being produced. 64.4% alc./vol.

chateau-latour-pauillac-de-latour-2015.title: Chateau Latour Le Pauillac de Latour 2019
chateau-latour-pauillac-de-latour-2015.bodyHtml:
The Pauillac is made primarily from young vines, growing on the less prestigious terroirs in the vineyard, and from wines that do not meet the selection criteria for Forts de Latour (specific to each vintage).

94 Points - James Suckling

This has chocolate, cedar and walnuts as well as some currant aromas and flavors. Medium-bodied with some lovely fruit and juiciness. 55.8% cabernet sauvignon, 38.8% merlot and 5.4% petit verdot. Attractive now but another year or two will make it even better.

compass-box-no-name-no-3.title: Compass Box No Name No. 3 Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
compass-box-no-name-no-3.bodyHtml:
Compass Box No Name No. 3 Blended Malt Scotch Whisky is the third and final release in Compass Box's No Name series of heavily peated malt whiskies. Since 2017, the series has used the same recipe structure to explore different pairings of smoky whiskies.

No Name No. 3 is older and wilder than the previous releases. Seaweedy, barbecue-scented single malt from the Laphroaig Distillery takes the lead, with malt whisky from the Bowmore Distillery adding hints of very ripe mango and pineapple. Notes include seashells, sage, pineapple and allspice, with oily waves of smoke.

josephshofer-riesling-spatlese.title: Schweinhardt Rothenberg Riesling Spatlese 2022
josephshofer-riesling-spatlese.bodyHtml:
Schweinhardt Rothenberg Riesling Spatlese 2024 is an expressive, fruit-forward German white wine from the Nahe region. Sourced from the Langenlonsheimer Rothenberg vineyard, this late-harvest Riesling showcases luscious apricot, ripe peach, and juicy orchard fruit. Its generous sweetness is beautifully balanced by vibrant acidity, creating a refreshing, elegant palate. Fermented and matured in stainless steel to preserve its aromatic purity, this Spätlese delivers a smooth, lingering finish and excellent ageing potential.

Food Pairing: Blue cheese, smoked Gouda, spicy Thai curry, glazed pork, fruit tarts, apricot desserts, and lightly spiced Asian cuisine.

beringer-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Beringer 8th Maker Cabernet Sauvignon 2016 750ml
beringer-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Eighth Maker is a celebration of my family’s heritage brought full circle, the name a nod to my stepping in as Beringer’s eighth winemaker 139 years after my great-great-grandfather Jacob and his brother Frederick founded the winery. This wine is produced from the Beringer estate’s most prestigious vineyards and is a culmination of over a century of crafting iconic Napa wines. Lush, balanced, and with excellent potential for aging, Eighth Maker is both an achievement and a homecoming. 

99 Points - James Suckling


A dark and seductive cabernet, this has stunning forest berries and enormous concentration and freshness. But, as delicious as it is now, this is also built for the long term. Great finish, where the interplay of fruit and fine tannins is complex. Goes on for minutes with dark berries, blackberries and hot stones. A core of greatness. A new wine to give a nod to the eighth winemaker of Beringer, Mark Beringer. 

97 Points - Jeb Dunnick

The 2016 Cabernet Sauvignon 8th Maker is a tiny production, special cuvée by this estate that’s based on 100% Cabernet Sauvignon brought up in 80% new French oak. This beauty is a massive, full-bodied Cabernet that boasts a saturated purple color, classic crème de cassis fruit, loads of chocolate, espresso, and tobacco notes, building tannins, and a deep, opulent, powerful style on the palate that needs to be tasted to be believed. It shows the purity and classic style of the 2016 vintage yet certainly brings serious power and richness. It can be drunk any time over the coming two decades or more.


95 Points - Wine Advocate


Produced from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the deep garnet-purple 2016 Cabernet Sauvignon 8th Maker is a fantastic example of a top-notch Napa Valley Cab. It comes bounding out of the glass with exuberant scents of warm cassis and blackberry pie with subtle hints of dried Provence herbs, fertile loam, coffee, yeast extract, olives and crushed rocks. Medium to full-bodied, the generously fruited palate delivers plush-yet-firm tannins with seamless freshness and a lingering minty lift on the finish. 1,000 cases were made.

paolo-conterno-langhe-nebbiola-doc.title: Paolo Conterno A Mont Langhe Nebbiolo 2022/2023
paolo-conterno-langhe-nebbiola-doc.bodyHtml:
Paolo Conterno "A Mont" Langhe Nebbiolo is a beautifully expressive, entry-level red Burgundy alternative from the heart of Piedmont. Sourced from estate-owned, sustainably farmed vineyards in the Langhe hills (situated at an altitude of 300 to 350 meters on steep, clay-calcareous slopes), this wine serves as a brilliant showcase for the Nebbiolo grape’s natural freshness and aromatic charm.

To preserve the wine's vibrant, youthful character, fourth-generation winemaker Giorgio Conterno employs a short 7-to-8-day skin maceration for a soft extraction, followed by aging that completes without heavy wood influence. In the glass, it pours a bright garnet-red color. The nose is highly floral and lifted, offering pretty aromas of fresh red cherries, cranberries, and rose petals, complexed by subtle notes of dried orange peel, tobacco, and white pepper. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and exceptionally well-structured; its core of juicy, crunchy red fruit is supported by firm, lightly chewy tannins and a clean, mineral-driven line of natural acidity. This food-friendly, approachable style delivers classic Langhe Nebbiolo typicity with an easy-drinking elegance.

Food Pairing: Tagliolini with meat ragù, roasted chicken, grilled lamb chops, or semi-aged cheeses like young Fontina or Comté.

2022 Vintage Rating:

90 Points - James Suckling

A pale, zesty and lightly earthy red that has notes of cranberries, mushrooms and oranges. It’s medium-bodied and crunchy with salty undertones. Drink now.

2023 Vintage Rating:

91 Points - James Suckling

Spiced and red-fruited on the nose with hints of earth, iodine and walnuts. Firm and focused with medium body, showing spicy tobacco and juicy fruit underneath.

laroche-chablis-st-martin.title: Domaine Laroche 'Saint Martin' Chablis 2024
laroche-chablis-st-martin.bodyHtml:
Domaine Laroche 'Saint Martin' Chablis 2024 is a crisp, classic expression of pure Kimmeridgian terroir from historic plots in the Chablis region. Aged on fine lees in stainless steel vats to preserve its natural freshness and vibrant minerality, it exhibits enticing aromas of white flowers, green apple, fresh citrus, and crushed limestone. On the palate, it is light-to-medium-bodied with bright, laser-sharp acidity, offering layered flavors of lemon zest, white peach, and a distinct, long saline-mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, grilled prawns, pan-seared scallops, goat cheese, sushi, and light poultry dishes.

tenuta-di-castellaro-ottava-isola.title: Tenuta Di Castellaro LÕOttava Isola Etna Rosso 2017 750ml

viberti-barbera-dalba-la-gemella.title: Viberti Giovanni La Gemella Barbera D’Alba 2020 750ml
viberti-barbera-dalba-la-gemella.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "Blueberry pie filling, anise, cinnamon and vanilla define the aromas of this lush Barbera. Violets, black cherries and clove are all in concert with fine tannins and moderate acidity on the palate of this mouthfilling Barbera." - 88/100, Wine Enthusiast

chateau-minuty-m-de-minuty-rose.title: Chateau Minuty M Rose 2025
chateau-minuty-m-de-minuty-rose.bodyHtml:
Château Minuty M Rosé 2025 is a quintessential, bright, and brilliantly fresh Provençal rosé that captures the vibrant spirit of the French Riviera. Crafted by one of the region’s most historic and celebrated Crus Classés estates, this wine displays a remarkably clear, pale pink hue resembling delicate rose petals. The nose opens with an expressive and lively bouquet filled with zesty citrus, wild red berries, white peach, and hints of crisp exotic fruits. On the palate, it strikes a wonderful balance between a luscious, rounded fruit texture and a bracing, mouthwatering acidity, culminating in a clean, persistent, and subtly savory mineral finish that makes it incredibly refreshing.

Food Pairing:

Pair this lively rosé with fresh Caprese or Niçoise salads, grilled shrimp skewers, summer vegetable tapas, pistou soup, or light Mediterranean seafood dishes.

daou-cabernet-soul-of-a-lion.title: Daou Soul of a Lion Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 750ml
daou-cabernet-soul-of-a-lion.bodyHtml:
The 2020 vintage presents an alluring profusion of black cherry, mulberry and Oregon blackberry aromas with notes of leather, cigar box and dark chocolate. Hints of desert sage and crème de menthe accent the rich fruit. The palate is silky and voluptuous, delivering loads of currant, cassis, black raspberry and ripe cherry. Notes of fig and baking spice are underscored by earthy tones of dates and truffle. Mature, ripe tannins yield a weighty, velvety texture integrated with a limestone minerality and subtle oak. A lengthy finish leaves lingering impressions of blackberry, plum and espresso with a touch of white pepper. A wine of immense staying power that will evolve favorably for many years to come.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Impressively dark in the glass, this bottling pairs intense purple fruit and flower on this nose with more roasted, umami-laden aromas. The elegant palate is a master class in tannin management, proving firm in structure yet soft in mouthfeel. Flavors of blackberry jam, cocoa, walnut and cracked pepper ride a lingering acidity into the finish.

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The 2020 Soul Of A Lion is tighter and more backward than the 2019 (which was also tight and focused at this stage as well), offering lots of ripe black fruits, new leather, mineral, and iron nuances to go with a medium to full-bodied, concentrated, structured style on the palate. It's unquestionably a beautiful, outstanding wine.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2020 Soul Of A Lion, made from free-run juice, is a blend of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 13% Cabernet Franc and 7% Petit Verdot matured for 22 months in 100% new French oak. It has a deep ruby color and pure aromas of blackcurrants, tobacco, truffle and thyme with touches of leather and graphite. The full-bodied palate has a pleasantly rustic texture and savory character, finishing with tobacco accents.

95 Points - James Suckling
Seductive and enchanting nose with aromas of wild berries, dried herbs, pencil lead, bark and leather. It's full-bodied with fine tannins. Well-built with the harmonious structure supporting a velvety core of berries and chocolate which caress the mid-palate.

chateau-lassegue-2017.title: Chateau Lassegue 2020
chateau-lassegue-2017.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Lassègue expresses the complexity and power of the estate's clay and limestone soils with great elegance. This wine showcases a beautiful deep and shiny color. From the first aeration, the aromas express great freshness and a concentration with spicy notes. Then they evolve towards expressions of menthol, licorice, rose petals and violet. On the palate, this vintage expresses a nice concentration and abundance of red fruits, a beautiful tension in the mid-palate and a persistent finish carried by the minerality of its terroir. Endowed with great precision and remarkable balance, this wine joins the great vintages of Lassègue with panache.


94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep purple-black colored, the 2020 Lassegue needs a little swirling to begin, to unlock bright, cheery scents of fresh blackberries, black raspberries and redcurrants, plus hints of black cherry preserves, charcoal, woodsmoke and underbrush with a waft of tapenade. The medium to full-bodied palate has a firm structure of ripe, rounded tannins and just enough freshness to support the generous black fruits, finishing long and earthy.

93 Points - James Suckling

A very tannic and powerful red this year, with blueberry, walnut and stone character. Tar undertones. Full and chewy. Flavorful finish. A bit extracted, so needs time to soften. Try after 2028.

chateau-piney-st-emilion-grand-cru.title: Chateau Piney Saint-Emilion Grand Cru 2022
chateau-piney-st-emilion-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Château Piney is an expressive and opulent Saint-Émilion Grand Cru, benefiting from an exceptionally warm and sunny vintage. It reveals a deep purple-ruby colour and an intense aromatic profile of ripe blackberries, black plums, and crème de cassis, layered with sophisticated notes of toasted oak, vanilla, and sweet spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and richly textured, showcasing concentrated dark fruit supported by powerful yet well-integrated, velvety tannins. A balanced acidity provides necessary lift, leading to a long, decadent finish marked by lingering impressions of chocolate, licorice, and a subtle mineral streak typical of the region's limestone-influenced soils.

90 Points - James Suckling

Bright and juicy fruit such as fresh plums, cherries and a touch of minerals and grapefruit. Firm and pretty elegant for 2022 with a composed, medium-length finish. This has good short-term appeal. Drink now but should hold well in the next four to five years.

sybille-kuntz-riesling.title: Sybille Kuntz Mosel- Riesling Qualitatswein Trocken 2023 750ml
sybille-kuntz-riesling.bodyHtml: This wine is from mainly from old vines grown in the steep vineyards of Pauls Valley, a side valley formed by the River Mosel some thirty-five thousand years ago. Today it is part of the single vineyard site Lieser Schlossberg. Picking is done a little later than the Qualitätswein. A dry, aromatic and elegant wine.

cambria-chardonnay-katherines-vineyard.title: Cambria Katherine's Vineyard Chardonnay 2021 750ml
cambria-chardonnay-katherines-vineyard.bodyHtml:
Cambria's flagship Chardonnay is barrel-fermented giving it toasted oak, vanilla, and crème brûlée characteristics complemented by notes of citrus and baked apples. This white wine is known for its balance of oak and a refreshingly crisp finish.

Enjoy with grilled chicken and mango salsa, roast salmon and gruyere mac and cheese, or fish tacos.

94 Points - Vinous

The 2021 Chardonnay Katherine's Vineyard is notable. Bright and chiseled, the 2021 bristles with tension. Citrus peel, chamomile, white flowers, mint and tangerine oil are some of the notes that grace this exquisite Santa Maria Chardonnay. Partial aging in steel keeps the flavors bright.

torres-mas-la-plana.title: Familia Torres Mas La Plana 2019
torres-mas-la-plana.bodyHtml:
Familia Torres Mas La Plana 2019 is an iconic, legendary Spanish red wine that single-handedly put the Penedès region on the global fine-wine map after famously triumphing over Bordeaux's First Growths at the 1979 Wine Olympics. Sourced entirely from old vines on a single, 29-hectare estate, this 100% Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep garnet hue with a purple sheen. The highly refined nose reveals a textbook Mediterranean-influenced profile, bursting with intense aromas of blackcurrant, dark plum, and blackberry laced with fragrant notes of sandalwood, star anise, licorice, and tobacco leaf. On the palate, it is full-bodied, precise, and beautifully knit, delivering generous flavors of baked bitter cherry, dark chocolate, and a hint of spearmint. Framed by tight, sculpted, and perfectly ripe tannins alongside a vibrant, chalky mineral acidity, it finishes incredibly long, complex, and harmonious.

Food Pairing: Grilled rack of lamb with rosemary, slow-braised beef short ribs, roasted venison, thick-cut ribeye steak, and aged cheeses like Manchego or sharp white Cheddar.

95 Points - James Suckling

Excellent freshness and intensity of meaty blue fruit here with currants, blackberries, dark plums, peppercorns and chocolate, with dark earth and some spearmint. Crushed stone minerality on the palate, with fantastic freshness. Full-bodied, tight, caressing and perfectly ripe tannins. Already delicious, but will age beautifully. Cabernet sauvignon. Mas La Plana has become more refined and precise. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

An enticing red, exuding fragrant sandalwood and star anise notes, this is plush on the palate, offering generous flavors of black plum reduction, baked bitter cherry, tea leaves and a subtle base note of fresh earth. Defined by sculpted, fine-grained tannins and lively acidity, this is seamlessly knit and harmonious. Drink now through 2034. 6,262 cases made, 450 cases imported.

tommasi-caflorian-amarone-classico-rise.title: Tommasi Ca'Florian Amarone della Valpolicella Riserva 2016
tommasi-caflorian-amarone-classico-rise.bodyHtml:
Tommasi Ca' Florian Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Riserva 2016 is a prestigious, deeply concentrated Veneto red sourced from old Pergola-trained vines in the historic Ca' Florian cru. Following a traditional appassimento process and four years of wood aging, it reveals rich aromas of dried plums, dark cocoa, licorice root, and espresso. The palate is full-bodied, austere, and velvety, offering concentrated dark fruit balanced by fresh acidity and firm, noble tannins.

Food Pairing: Slow-braised beef short ribs, roasted venison loin, wild boar stew, jugged hare with polenta, and long-aged Parmigiano-Reggiano or Gorgonzola Piccante.

95 Points - James Suckling

A classic and restrained Amarone focused on freshness rather than obvious fruit. Aromas of bay leaves, vanilla, red cherries, raspberries, earth and chocolate. Dry, full-bodied, crisp and integrated, with firm, velvety tannins. Exotic spice, cocoa powder, curry and coffee ground flavors. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine walks the wild path. Forest floor and untamed earth take center stage while dried plums hover in the background, letting nature tell its story. The palate digs deeper into that same earthy groove, dusty minerals and dark soil leading the way. Time has transformed simple fruit into something beautifully primitive. Like finding truffles without even searching.
93 Points - Wine Spectator
Fragrant hints of leather and dried flowers offer an enticing entry point for this expressive, long and harmonious red, which layers its silky texture and fine-grained tannins atop a range of warm cherry and plum fruit, orange peel, baking spices and medicinal herbs. Corvina, Corvinone and Rondinella. Drink now through 2035. 700 cases made, 200 cases imported.

carpineto-chianti-classico-riserva.title: Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
carpineto-chianti-classico-riserva.bodyHtml:
Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 is an incredibly harmonious, traditional Tuscan red wine crafted with a core of Sangiovese. Following extensive maturation in a combination of Slavonian and French oak barrels, it reveals an elegant ruby hue alongside complex, expressive aromas of black cherries, wild blackberries, red plums, and violets, layered with hints of cedar, sweet vanilla, and earthy iron notes. The palate is full-bodied, dense, and beautifully framed by muscular, structured tannins and vibrant, balanced acidity, easing into a long, generous finish marked by warming spices.

Food Pairing: Pair this savory Riserva with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, rosemary-roasted lamb, wild boar ragù, or mature pecorino cheese.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This beefy red relies on its dense texture, concentrated flavors of black cherry and blackberry fruit, and muscular tannins to get its message across. Wild herb, iron and earth notes add depth, while the finish is long and spicy.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is savory and umami, with aromas of leather, graphite, underbrush, crushed rocks, bitter herbs and citrus swirling in the glass. Those earthy, bitter notes remain on the palate, but sweet cherries and wild strawberries pop overhead, while charged with powerful tannins and acid.

stags-leap-viognier.title: Stags' Leap Winery Viognier 2022
stags-leap-viognier.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Viognier 2022 is a bright, fresh, and lively white wine that presents a delicate straw hue with shimmering lemon-yellow flecks. The aromatic bouquet is highly expressive, featuring fragrant honeysuckle, elderflower, green apple, candied white peach, and lime zest, all elegantly lifted by hints of wet stone minerality. On the palate, it is clean, soft, and linear, showcasing a crisp, mouthwatering acidity that beautifully supports a generous core of white peach, Granny Smith apple, and tangy lime. Subtly nuanced with notes of Marcona almond, it concludes with a long, pleasing, and elegantly spiced white pepper finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with lighter fare, fresh charcuterie boards, grilled chicken, roasted turkey, or a delicately spiced fish tagine.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of Meyer lemons, yellow cherries, apricots and white roses followed by honeycomb and sliced ginger with an underlying seashell and saline minerality to it. Medium-bodied, soft acidity and a hint of phenolics in the mid-palate. Beautiful exotic notes without heaviness. Nice drinkability and freshness.

big-house-octavin-cardinal-zin.title: Big House Octavin Cardinal Zin 3L Bag in Box
big-house-octavin-cardinal-zin.bodyHtml: Big House Octavin Cardinal Zin 3L Bag in Box

marani-khvanchkara.title: Marani Khvanchkara 2024
marani-khvanchkara.bodyHtml:
Marani Khvanchkara 2024 is an exceptional, traditional semi-sweet red wine coming from the specific Khvanchkara micro-zone within the Racha-Lechkhumi region of Western Georgia. Crafted from a blend of two indigenous grape varieties, Aleksandrouli and Mujuretuli, this wine pours a lovely light ruby color. The expressive and complex aromatic nose bursts with juicy notes of wild strawberries, fresh raspberries, and pomegranates, beautifully interlaced with underlying hints of smoke, roasted almonds, and light caramel. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious, velvety texture with a delicate, balanced natural sweetness. A vibrant, refreshing line of natural acidity masterfully cuts through the rich red fruit flavors, keeping the mouthfeel lively and clean before easing into a long, supple finish that shows soft tannins and an intriguing touch of spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with walnut cake, fruit tarts, soft blue cheeses, roasted duck with cherry glaze, and traditional Georgian lobiani bean bread.

dr-loosen-wehlener-sonnenuhr-auslese.title: Dr. Loosen Wehlener Sonnenuhr Riesling Auslese 2021 375ml

cabana-coast-moscow-mule.title: Cabana Coast Original Mule 473ml
cabana-coast-moscow-mule.bodyHtml:
Cabana Coast Original Mule is a premium, ready-to-drink (RTD) cocktail handcrafted by Toronto-based Iconic Brewing Co. Designed for convenience without sacrificing quality, it combines ultra-premium vodka with spicy ginger beer and a touch of fresh, zesty lime. Packaged in a tall 473ml can and sitting at a robust 7.0% ABV, it delivers an authentic, smartly balanced Moscow Mule experience that is perfect for backyard barbecues, patios, and easy entertaining.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken skewers, spicy fish tacos, classic backyard burgers, jalapeño poppers, and salty snacks like potato chips or pretzels.

Tasting Notes : Lightly hazy and effervescent in appearance with a crisp, lively, and incredibly refreshing mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright and zesty, leading with forward aromas of fresh lime citrus and the sharp, earthy spice of ginger root.

Palate : Crisp and thirst-quenching, featuring a clean vodka base that perfectly supports the robust, slightly spicy kick of ginger beer and a tangy punch of refreshing lime.

Finish : Clean, sharp, and highly refreshing, with a lingering warmth from the ginger spice and a crisp citrus bite.

Serve : Best served chilled over ice in a traditional copper mug, garnished with a slice of fresh lime and a sprig of mint, or enjoyed ice-cold straight from the can.

old-forester-whiskey-row-gift-pack.title: Old Forester Whiskey Row Gift Pack 3 x 375ml
old-forester-whiskey-row-gift-pack.bodyHtml: The ultimate tasting flight for any bourbon enthusiast! This premium gift set features three 375ml bottles from Old Forester's highly acclaimed Whiskey Row series. It typically includes the 100-proof 1897 Bottled in Bond, the deeply charred, double-barreled 1910 Old Fine Whisky, and the intensely robust, 115-proof 1920 Prohibition Style. It is an incredible way to experience the historic timeline and the spectacularly diverse flavor profiles of America's first bottled bourbon.

tobermory-gin.title: Tobermory Hebridean Gin
tobermory-gin.bodyHtml:
Tobermory Hebridean Gin is a unique, handcrafted spirit produced at the historic Tobermory Distillery on the picturesque Isle of Mull. What sets this gin apart is its base: it is distilled using a splash of Tobermory's celebrated unpeated single malt Scotch whisky new-make spirit. This malty base is combined with a carefully selected array of local botanicals, including Hebridean heather, elderflower, wild tea, and juniper, which are steeped for 24 hours in a direct-fired copper pot still named "Wee John." The result is a vibrant, characterful gin that beautifully captures the wild, coastal essence of the Inner Hebrides.

Food Pairing: Freshly shucked oysters, smoked salmon with capers, goat cheese crostini, or grilled lemon-herb chicken skewers.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear in appearance with a smooth, crisp, and slightly oily mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Fresh juniper, sweet orange zest, delicate heather, subtle tea floral notes, and a hint of malty sweetness.

Palate : Creamy and balanced with vibrant juniper, citrus peel, gentle herbs, soft elderflower sweetness, and a subtle salinity.

Finish : Long, clean, and refreshing with lingering fresh citrus, subtle herb spice, and gentle sea salt.

Serve : Served over ice topped with premium tonic water and garnished with a slice of fresh orange or a sprig of thyme.

casa-lupo-valpolicella-ripasso.title: Paladin Casa Lupo Valpolicella Ripasso Superiore 2021
casa-lupo-valpolicella-ripasso.bodyHtml:
The Paladin Casa Lupo Valpolicella Ripasso Superiore 2021 is a rich and intense red wine produced in the Valpolicella region of Veneto, Italy. This vintage is crafted using the traditional "Ripasso" method, where the Valpolicella wine is macerated for 15–20 days on the pomace of freshly pressed Amarone, enriching it with greater structure and complexity. It presents an intense red colour with garnet reflections and a bouquet featuring red berries, violets, and sweet spices. On the palate, it is known for its velvety, balanced tannins and fresh notes of currants and blackberries.

92 Points - James Suckling

Rich and spicy with ripe dark berries, plum skin, dried flowers and hints of burnt oranges. Medium- to full-bodied, layered and intense, with a fine texture and delicious fruit. Succulent finish. Shows richness and exuberance, yet it’s balanced and focused. Drink or hold.

glenmorangie-tale-of-winter.title: Glenmorangie A Tale of Winter
glenmorangie-tale-of-winter.bodyHtml: Following on from Glenmorangie’s A Tale of Cake, the magnificent distillery has gone and created A Tale of Winter (we do like the idea that “cake” is in fact a season and that it precedes winter, but we don’t think that’s what they’re going for here)! Director of whisky creation Dr. Bill Lumsden wanted to evoke the feeling of winter, of sitting in front of a fireplace while the snow fall outside, and to do so, he finished a bourbon barrel-matured single malt in ex-Marsala wine casks. All those rich, comforting, chocolatey notes certainly put this one in the ‘winter warmer’ category.

opus-one-overture.title: Opus One Overture 750ml
opus-one-overture.bodyHtml:
Beginning in 1993 and following in the tradition of great Bordeaux estates, Opus One created a fine second wine called Overture. Every acre of the estate vineyard is meticulously farmed with the attention to detail and singular focus required to produce Opus One. This scrutiny carries through the blending process and certain lots will not be included in the final Opus One blend. Yet, when these lots are afforded additional time in barrel along with the added flexibility of blending across multiple vintages, the final wine achieves a remarkable elegance and complexity.

Overture displays a vibrant garnet color with expressive aromas of fresh red fruit. Notes of bright cherry and red currant are underpinned by more earthy tones of ground cocoa, cedar and vanilla. Extended barrel aging gives the wine an elegant texture accentuated by round tannins and a soft mouthfeel.

opus-one-2018.title: Opus One 2018 750ml
opus-one-2018.bodyHtml:
The Opus One 2018 offers profuse aromas of blackberry, cassis, and black cherry. Elegant notes of violets, white pepper, and rose petals follow and together they deliver a very seductive bouquet. The seamlessly layered flavors build to a crescendo of fresh and juicy black-fruit, accented with hints of orange zest, licorice, and dark chocolate. Beautifully balanced, the smooth round tannins and fresh acidity combine to create a soft, creamy mouthfeel and extend the flavors into a long persistent finish.

99 Points - James Suckling

Extremely perfumed and floral with lavender, lilacs and violets to the sweet, ripe berries, such as blackberries and blackcurrants. Some slate and graphite, too. It’s full-bodied, yet ever so balanced and refined, with super fine tannins that last for minutes. Fresh herbs, such as bay leaf and lemon grass highlight the dark fruit. The quality of tannin is exquisite with wonderful polish and refinement. Lasts for minutes. So wonderful to taste now, but better after 2026.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Very deep garnet-purple in color, the 2018 Opus One soars out of the glass with bright, bold boysenberries, warm cassis and ripe, juicy black plums notes, plus emerging nuances of lilacs, oolong tea, cinnamon stick, tilled soil and black truffles. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is packed with tightly wound layers of crunchy black fruits, supported by firm, grainy tannins and fantastic freshness, finishing with lifted fruitiness and on a lingering mineral note.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2018 Opus One is a blend of 84% Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Petit Verdot, and the rest Merlot and Cabernet Franc. This deep purple-hued effort leans to lively, fresher side of the vintage but has a brilliant, utterly classic style in its crème de cassis and blue-tinged fruit as well as notes of lead pencil, candied violets, damp earth, and chocolate-like nuances. With a Pomerol-like elegance and purity, it's medium to full-bodied and has wonderful tannins, flawless balance, and a great finish. It plays in the finesse-driven end of the spectrum yet is concentrated and seamless, with serious length. It offers pleasure today but should benefit from 4-5 years in the cellar, and my money is on it evolving for 30 years or more.

95 Points - Decanter

The 2018 Opus One is incredibly elegant and polished, right out of the bottle. Silky tannins and lifted, perfumed aromatics add to an impression of finesse that distinguishes the 2018 from some of the preceding vintages in a pretty big way. It will be interesting to see if the 2018 gains body with a bit of time in bottle. It is pretty rare for Opus One to be so approachable at this stage.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

The fruit is decidedly restrained in style, without the vivid punch typical of the vintage, but the gently mulled currant, cherry and bitter plum flavors are well-delineated and persistent, while notable savory, thyme and tobacco leaf notes play a prominent role alongside. There's a racy beam of acidity piercing through it all and a lingering iron note on the finish. An excellent example of the style. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Malbec.

turley-old-vines-zinfandel.title: Turley Zinfandel Rose
turley-old-vines-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Reimagining California's white Zinfandel history with dry, Provençal-style execution, this crisp rosé is picked early from organic estate vines. Alluring aromas of wild strawberry, pale rose petals, and petrichor give way to a mineral-driven, brilliantly high-acid palate.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spicy Thai garlic shrimp, a loaded charcuterie board with fresh goat cheese, grilled salmon burgers, or classic salade Niçoise.

ophelia-vodka.title: Ophelia Vodka (Cls)
ophelia-vodka.bodyHtml:
Ophelia Vodka is an unflavoured vodka from Krang Spirits, a small craft distillery in Cochrane, Alberta, that hand-crafts its spirits from carefully chosen ingredients. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 375ml bottle, it is a clean, versatile base for classic vodka cocktails, or for sipping well chilled.

Serve: Chilled and neat, or in a vodka martini, Caesar or highball.

ophelia-vodka-1.title: Ophelia Vodka (Cls)
ophelia-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Ophelia Vodka is an unflavoured vodka from Krang Spirits, a small craft distillery in Cochrane, Alberta, that hand-crafts its spirits from carefully chosen ingredients. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 375ml bottle, it is a clean, versatile base for classic vodka cocktails, or for sipping well chilled.

Serve: Chilled and neat, or in a vodka martini, Caesar or highball.

wyborowa.title: Wyborowa Vodka
wyborowa.bodyHtml:
Meet a classic whose iconic taste is recognized all over the world. Wyborowa meets the requirements of the Protected Geographical Indication – Polish Vodka. This means that every production stage takes place in Poland. It is the Polish rye that gives the classic well-recognised Wyborowa vodka its distinct taste mixed with subtle sweetness. Through the combination of centuries-old Polish distillery traditions and modern technology, Wyborowa has become part of our national heritage.

Wyborowa has been appreciated not only in Poland but also on 70 global markets, as evidenced by numerous awards and distinctions it has received over the decades. Thank You!

Gordon Brown, the author of “Classic Spirits of the World”, said that Wyborowa is a real classic with a clean and transparent character.

quails-gate-sf-reserve-pinot-noir.title: Quails Gate Stewart Family Reserve Pinot Noir 2023
quails-gate-sf-reserve-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The Quails' Gate Stewart Family Reserve Pinot Noir is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex New World red wine that beautifully captures the unique, sun-drenched volcanic slopes of West Kelowna in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. It pours a brilliant ruby red colour with subtle brick reflections in the glass, lifting with an immediate, aromatic bouquet of fresh Okanagan sage, wild strawberries, and ripe black cherries, seamlessly layered with intricate undertones of dried rose petals, warm baking spices, and a hint of forest floor. On the palate, this medium-bodied Pinot Noir is remarkably poised, graceful, and smooth, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of dark red fruits, cocoa, and a touch of savory earth. Aged carefully in French oak barrels to enhance its structural depth and natural sophistication, it is driven by a finely balanced, food-friendly acidity and strong, noble tannins that carry into a long, lingering finish accented by an integrated touch of clove and nutmeg.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of refined culinary options, including roasted glazed duck, tender turkey breast, savory pork chops with wild mushroom ragù, seared BC salmon, rack of lamb with French lentils, and earthy late-season mushroom or squash risottos.

silver-oak-cabernet-alexander-valley.title: Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
silver-oak-cabernet-alexander-valley.bodyHtml:
Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a benchmark, expressive California red crafted from estate-owned and grower vineyards across Sonoma County’s sun-drenched Alexander Valley. Vinified in temperature-controlled stainless steel and matured for 24 months exclusively in American oak barrels (roughly 50% new and 50% once-used) sourced from the winery's dedicated Missouri cooperage, it was aged an additional 15 months in bottle prior to release. In the glass, it displays a deep, opaque ruby core with vibrant violet edges. The bouquet reveals intense, inviting aromas of ripe cassis, black cherries, and wild blackberry compote, seamlessly layered over Silver Oak's signature hallmarks of sweet vanilla bean, toasted coconut, dried sage, cedar, and subtle pipe tobacco. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, supple mouthfeel driven by concentrated dark bramble fruit and mocha, framed by fine-grained, velvety tannins and lively natural acidity that lead into an elegant, persistent, and oak-spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, herb-roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild mushroom risotto, and aged sharp white cheddar cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

So full-bodied, ripe and robust, offering spicy, iron-like, black fruit aromas, with generous dark cherries on a firmly tannic palate. Concentrated black plum, graphite, black pepper, coffee bean, pine resin and oak toast flavors on a full body. The tannins are powerful and fine-grained, shaping the texture significantly at this stage. Drinkable now, but best from 2030.

faiveley-clos-de-vougeot-grand-cru.title: Domaine Faiveley Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru 2022 750ml
faiveley-clos-de-vougeot-grand-cru.bodyHtml: Deep ruby red with complex fruity and floral notes (rose, violet) and a subtle hint of oak on the nose. The attack is smooth with powerful tannins. This well-structured and very persistent wine is an honour to the reputation of this exceptional Grand Cru.

faiveley-chambertin-clos-de-beze.title: Domaine Faiveley Chambertin Clos de Beze Grand Cru 2022 750ml
faiveley-chambertin-clos-de-beze.bodyHtml: Intense ruby red hue and complex nose offering fruity and roasted notes. The palate is powerful, elegant and distinctive with smooth yet direct tannins and a remarkably long and elegant finish.

faiveley-bienvenues-batard-montrachet.title: Domaine Faiveley Bienvenues-Batard-Montrachet Grand Cru 2021 750ml
faiveley-bienvenues-batard-montrachet.bodyHtml: Pale, clear yellow color and an elegant yet powerful nose combining white and yellow fruits, white flowers (acacia and orange blossom) and freshly baked brioche. The palate is delicate yet distinctive and characterized by aromas of stewed fruits and candied lemon. The finish is fresh and lively with exceptional length.

tenuta-di-arceno-chianti-classico.title: Tenuta di Arceno Chianti Classico 2022
tenuta-di-arceno-chianti-classico.bodyHtml:
Tenuta di Arceno Chianti Classico 2022 is an incredibly sleek, vibrant, and beautifully tailored red wine that perfectly represents the cool, high-altitude estate vineyards situated in the Castelnuovo Berardenga subzone of Chianti Classico. Maturing gracefully for 10 months in French oak barrels, this classic Tuscan blend is dominated by Sangiovese and rounded out with Merlot. In the glass, it shows a luminous ruby red hue. The expressive and highly aromatic nose opens with striking scents of ripe strawberries, fresh raspberries, violets, and wild roses, finely laced with nuanced undertones of white pepper, sweet baking spices, tobacco leaf, and subtle cypress. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, showing an engaging, fruit-forward fluid coherence. Its concentrated core of dark cherry and wild blackberry is effortlessly supported by a crisp line of natural acidity and beautifully integrated, fine-grained tannins, leading to a long, precise finish accented by lingering notes of blood orange, cocoa bean, and savory cedar.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with classic charcoal-grilled beef burgers, slow-cooked wild boar ragù over pici pasta, roasted pork belly, and mature cheeses like aged Pecorino Toscano.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This red is sleek and engaging, offering cherry, raspberry, blackberry and mineral aromas and flavors. Harmonious, with beautifully integrated tannins and vibrant acidity. The finish is long and detailed. Sangiovese and Merlot.

91 Points - James Suckling

A solid, balanced and intense Chianti Classico with aromas of sweet cherries, raspberries and sweet spices. It’s full-bodied with fine tannins. Solid core of red berries at the center, with a refined texture and an intense development in the finish.

sichel-margaux.title: Maison Sichel Margaux 2023
sichel-margaux.bodyHtml:
Maison Sichel Margaux 2023 is a beautifully balanced and refined red Bordeaux wine that perfectly captures the elegance of its prestigious terroir. It displays a deep, intense ruby color with vibrant violet tints. The expressive and complex bouquet offers inviting aromas of blackcurrant, red cherry, and ripe plum, interwoven with delicate floral notes of violet. Underlying hints of vanilla, spice, cedar, graphite, and toasty oak reflect its traditional barrel aging. On the palate, the wine is generous, concentrated, and elegantly structured, framed by fine-grained, silky tannins and a vibrant acidity. It delivers classic Margaux finesse with a precise, velvety, and lingering finish that showcases purity and aromatic complexity.

Food Pairing: Roast beef, rack of lamb with rosemary, duck breast with a red berry jus, tournedos Rossini, hearty mushroom dishes, and fine aged cheeses such as Comté or Saint-Nectaire.

faiveley-nuits-st-george-les-porets.title: Domaine Faiveley Nuits-St-Georges Les Porets-Saint-Georges Premier Cru 2021/2022 750ml
faiveley-nuits-st-george-les-porets.bodyHtml: Deep ruby red color. The nose discloses black fruits, toasty notes and a hint of oak. The smooth, round attack gives way to a powerful and structured mid-palate. A well-balanced and very persistent wine with excellent ageing potential.

faiveley-gevrey-chambertin-combe-aux-moi.title: Domaine Faiveley Gevrey-Chambertin La Combe Aux Moines Premier Cru 2022 750ml
faiveley-gevrey-chambertin-combe-aux-moi.bodyHtml: The nose is very pleasant with aromas of fresh red fruits and spices. This wine is round and long on the palate with fruity and woody tastes. It is all elegance, with silky tannins and a sophisticated very long finish.

st-george-single-malt-lot-20.title: St George Single Malt American Whiskey Lot 20
st-george-single-malt-lot-20.bodyHtml: Back in 2000, there was no such thing as “American Single Malt Whiskey.” Our Lot Series is the single malt that earned master distiller Lance Winters his place in the Whisky Magazine Hall of Fame. His pioneering approach—using five roast levels of malted barley pot distilled once to maximize the flavor from the grain—remains as revolutionary as it is delicious.

benriach-smoke-season.title: Benriach The Smoky Ten 10 Year Old
benriach-smoke-season.bodyHtml: In the early 1970s, Benriach broke convention in Speyside by returning to distilling batches of whisky in the old, 19th century style, using malted barley smoked with Highland peat. This wood rich Highland peat imparts distinctly sweet and smoky notes into Benriach peated whiskies. Benriach The Smoky Ten has been crafted from a combination of unpeated and peated spirit and three cask matured for at least ten years in a combination of bourbon barrels, Jamaican rum casks and toasted virgin oak. The whisky is then expertly married together to create sublimely smooth layers of sunripe fruit, aromatic smoke and toasted oak spice, lingering into the perfectly balanced sweet and smoky finish.

stags-leap-karia-chardonnay-napa-valley.title: Stag's Leap Wine Cellars KARIA Chardonnay 2024
stags-leap-karia-chardonnay-napa-valley.bodyHtml:
The 2024 KARIA Chardonnay has aromas of white peach, zesty lemon-lime, luxurious crème brûlée, and refreshing honeydew melon, complemented by delicate floral notes and a whisper of clove and vanilla. The palate is treated to a velvety mouthfeel and medium body that exudes balance and sophistication. Expect vibrant citrus and luscious honeysuckle to dance on your taste buds, leading to an enchanting finish that lingers with a hint of oak.

Try pairing this Chardonnay with grilled chicken with lemon aioli, grilled salmon with a cucumber, tomato and fresh dill salsa or roast chicken breast stuffed with spinach and feta cheese.

93 Points - Vinous

The 2024 Chardonnay Karia is heady and racy from start to finish. Lemon confit, tangerine oil, marzipan and white flowers are beautifully laced together. The Karia offers a striking mix of vintage 2024 richness tempered by partially blocked malolactic fermentation.

chateau-tour-bayard.title: Chateau Tour Bayard 2023
chateau-tour-bayard.bodyHtml:
Château Tour Bayard 2023 is an expressive and remarkably well-balanced red wine hailing from Montagne-Saint-Émilion, one of the premier satellite appellations on Bordeaux's Right Bank. Owned by the Richard family, the estate features clay-limestone soils that lend both structure and a vivid fresh minerality to its Merlot-driven profile. In the glass, it reveals rich aromas of ripe black plum, cassis, and sweet black cherries, interwoven with subtle hints of licorice, cocoa, and gentle wood spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with supple, fine-grained tannins, vibrant natural acidity, and a smooth, savory fruit finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, duck breast, or aged hard cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Ripe plums and blackcurrants, complemented by spice and licorice notes. Medium- to full-bodied, leaning toward the latter, this shows round, expressive dark fruit and fine-grained, creamy tannins that lead to a focused finish. Drink or hold.

laughing-stock-portfolio-red-blend.title: Laughing Stock Vineyards Portfolio 2021
laughing-stock-portfolio-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Laughing Stock Vineyards Portfolio 2021 is a highly concentrated, complex, and beautifully structured Bordeaux-style red blend from British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Sourced from premium vineyard sites in Oliver and Osoyoos, this vintage was shaped by an exceptionally warm growing season that yielded small, intensely flavorful berries. It opens with a refined bouquet of cassis, blueberry, cedar box, and fresh tobacco. The palate is filled with layers of red fruits, cocoa powder, and smoked cherries, all balanced by robust, fine-grained tannins and a long, spicy finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted rosemary rack of lamb, slow-braised beef short ribs, or sharp aged cheddar cheese.

chateau-le-loup-st-emilion-grand-cru.title: Chateau Le Loup 2023
chateau-le-loup-st-emilion-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Château Le Loup 2023 is an elegant, structured, and sophisticated Right Bank red wine that beautifully expresses its clay-limestone terroir. Composed of an unusual and precise blend of Merlot and Cabernet Franc, it displays an open, fleshy profile upfront with vibrant notes of fresh black fruits, dark plums, and black cherries, accented by subtle hints of baking spices, cocoa powder, and stones. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and impressively concentrated, balanced by a lively acidity and firm, well-integrated tannins that give it a polished, linear finish. Crafted by the Union de Producteurs de Saint-Émilion via gravity flow winemaking, this wine shows an excellent balance of Medoc-style structure and Saint-Émilion plushness, making it highly expressive now while retaining great potential for short-to-medium-term aging.

Food Pairing: This balanced red wine makes an ideal partner for high-quality red meats and refined culinary dishes. It pairs wonderfully with a seared beef fillet steak with Bordelaise sauce, a rack of lamb, slow-roasted lamb shanks infused with rosemary, roasted duck breast, venison stews, wild mushroom risotto, or a selection of aged artisanal cheeses.

90 Points - James Suckling

A balanced red, showing dark berries and warm spices on the nose, following through to a medium body and chewy tannins. Firm and well-built with some chocolate and generous fruit in the finish. Drink now.

drouhin-oregon-pinot-noir.title: Domaine Drouhin Oregon Dundee Hills Pinot Noir 2024
drouhin-oregon-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Domaine Drouhin Oregon Dundee Hills Pinot Noir 2024 is an incredibly elegant and beautifully poised expression of Oregon's premier cool-climate terroir, crafted with traditional Burgundian expertise. Displaying a lovely luminous ruby color in the glass, this estate-grown Pinot Noir opens with a remarkably bright and fragrant bouquet of wild blackberries, fresh marionberries, and red plums, intricately layered with delicate nuances of sandstone, crushed violets, fresh rose petals, and a touch of thyme. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and seamlessly structured, balancing its juicy core of black cherry and dark plum flavors with sophisticated, chalky tannins and an underlying earthy complexity. Matured carefully in custom French oak barrels from the Drouhin family's own cooperage in Burgundy, it retains a fantastic sense of purity and vibrant freshness, leading into a long, polished finish defined by classic estate spice and wild herb flavors.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with classic roast duck, pan-seared pheasant, grilled salmon fillets with wild mushrooms, or herb-roasted pork tenderloin.

96 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of wild blackberries, marionberries, sandstone, crushed violets and rose petals. Medium-bodied with structured, chalky tannins, dark fruit flavors of black cherries and red plums and a long finish. Drink after 2028.

tokaji-yellow-muscat.title: Tokaji Yellow Muscat 750ml
tokaji-yellow-muscat.bodyHtml: Tokaji Yellow Muscat 750ml is a dry white wine made from the Muscat grape variety, grown in the Tokaj-Hegyalja region of Hungary. It's known for its refreshing, aromatic profile with notes of fresh pears and melons, and a hint of white peach and citrus. The wine is characterized by crisp acidity and a balanced, long finish, making it a great companion for fresh salads or fruit-based dishes.

jadot-moulin-a-vent-rochegres-chat-d-jac.title: Chateau des Jacques Moulin-a-Vent Clos de Rochegres 2015
jadot-moulin-a-vent-rochegres-chat-d-jac.bodyHtml:
The Moulin à Vent "Clos de Rochegrès" has a very nice garnet-red color with crimson tints. It releases very fine aromas of flowers (rose) with a touch of mineral. The wine is generous and tender on the palate thanks to the elegant and long lasting tannins. This wine will perfectly match red meats in sauce, game and most cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Extremely rich aromas of crushed ripe berries and hints of forest fruit. Stones, too. Dense, full-bodied, mineral and creamy with a stoney undertone. Crazy wine. Great Beaujolais.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

From this always impressive estate, owned by Louis Jadot in Beaune, this wine is richly structured and dense. With some wood aging, it has an extra ripeness and tannic concentration. This cru wine with its tight texture and minerality will age. Drink from 2018.
90 Points - Wine Spectator
A well-meshed red, with layers of plum compote, anise and blackberry reduction, edged with milk chocolate, floral and black tea elements. Ample spice notes linger onto the moderately tannic finish. Drink now through 2023.

catena-zapata-nicasia-malbec.title: Catena Zapata Argentino Malbec 2023
catena-zapata-nicasia-malbec.bodyHtml:
Catena Zapata Argentino Malbec 2023 is a magnificent, iconic, and deeply complex high-altitude Argentine red wine crafted from century-old pre-phylloxera massal selection vines from the historic Angélica and Nicasia vineyards. Visually displaying an intense dark violet-purple core, it opens with a beautifully perfumed nose featuring wild blackberries, black cherries, and underripe plums, intricately interwoven with notes of crushed violets, dried herbs, dark cocoa, and fresh flinty minerality. On the palate, it exhibits full-bodied richness and effortless elegance, balanced by vibrant natural acidity and ultra-fine, chalky tannins that carry a dense core of blue and dark fruit toward a long, expressive, and harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with grilled prime ribeye, prime bife de lomo, braised lamb shanks, roasted game meats, mushroom risotto, and aged Gouda.

95 Points - James Suckling

This has an intriguing combination of violets, crushed stones, underripe plums and a subtle touch of pepper on the nose. The palate is firm, with blue fruit, tight focused tannins and impressive concentration and depth. Structured yet long and beautiful. So harmonious. Drink now or hold.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A decidedly riper and more forward style than many of Catena Zapata's offerings, the 2023 Malbec Argentino combines ungrafted massal selections from two polar-opposite vineyard sources: the Angélica Vineyard in Maipú's Lunlunta district and Paraje Altamira's Nicasia Vineyard. It was vinified entirely in foudre with 20% whole clusters and aged for 12 months. The nose is deep and dark-fruited, welcomely lifted by a lovely floral component that builds with oxygen exposure. On the palate, it is velvety and rich yet impressively buoyant, transitioning to an explosive, ripe and powerful finish dominated by luscious fruits.

evan-williams-1783-bourbon.title: Evan Williams 1783 Bourbon
evan-williams-1783-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Evan Williams 1783 Bourbon is a Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey from Heaven Hill. This listing is the 43% ABV bottling in a 750ml bottle; the distillery's current 1783 Small Batch release is bottled at 90 proof (45% ABV) and is listed separately. The 1783 name honours the year Evan Williams founded what the brand calls Kentucky's First Distillery. The producer describes 1783 as an extra-aged small batch bourbon made with the same sour mash process and traditional recipe associated with its namesake.

Serve: Neat, over ice or in classic bourbon cocktails.

poggio-antico-brunello.title: Poggio Landi Brunello Riserva 2019
poggio-antico-brunello.bodyHtml:
Poggio Landi Brunello Riserva 2019 pours a luminous, compact garnet color with brilliant ruby highlights in the glass. The highly expressive bouquet opens with graceful, intoxicating aromatics of ripe red cherries, cranberries, and fresh blueberries, beautifully layered with secondary nuances of crushed violets, leather, sweet baking spices, and a distinctive balsamic depth. On the palate, this full-bodied and finely structured Tuscan red showcases immense depth and power, driven by a juicy, concentrated core of dark forest fruits. A vibrant line of natural acidity imparts healthy tension and precision, while fine-grained, velvety tannins seamlessly frame the rich texture. Following 48 months of meticulous maturation in French oak barrels, it carries subtle undercurrents of cedar, black pepper, and medicinal herbs effortlessly into an exceptionally long, elegant, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-braised wild boar ragù, grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rosemary lamb chops, truffle-infused mushroom risotto, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

High-end floral, strawberry and cherry notes are grounded with flavors of earth, iron, stone and underbrush in this intense, lively red. Well-mannered tannins come to the fore on the finish, leaving a firm grip. Shows fine equilibrium and terrific length. Best from 2028 through 2047. 750 cases made, 375 cases imported.

95 Points - James Suckling
