Approachable and graceful style here with intoxicating violet aromas, black cherries, superfresh and juicy fruitiness and spicy depth. Medium-bodied, this is focused on tension and vibrancy with firm, chalky tannins and a long, fruity finish. From organically grown grapes. Drinkable now but best from 2026.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Deliciously medicinal and herbaceous on the nose with intense salinity, like fresh herbs growing on seaside cliffs. The palate sweetens significantly with milk chocolate layered over cherries and orange slices, but abundant pepper and acid hold tension. 

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Also quite savory with cured tobacco and sweet cigar, the organic Poggio Landi 2019 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva is a bold and structured wine with thick layers of baking spice and brandied plum. Its texture is open knit, and I would consider it almost ready to drink now. A hint of candied maraschino cherry adds sweet brightness to the close.

glenmorangie-vintage-1997.title: Glenmorangie The Infinita 18 Year Old
glenmorangie-vintage-1997.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie 18 Year Old 'The Infinita' is a prestigious Highland single malt Scotch whisky matured for 15 years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before a portion is transferred to Spanish Oloroso sherry casks for an additional 3 years. Re-imagined under the name 'The Infinita' (formerly known simply as Glenmorangie 18 Year Old Extremely Rare), this expression combines Glenmorangie's signature tall-still delicate citrus floral character with complex layers of dried fruits, warm spice, and nutty sherry richness.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck with orange glaze, pan-seared scallops, dark chocolate tarts, or aged cheeses like Comté or Gouda.

Tasting Notes : Luminous honeyed gold hue with a silky, smooth, and velvety body on the palate.

Nose : Rich dried fruits, ripe figs, caramelized orange peel, sweet jasmine floral aromas, honeycomb, and gentle vanilla oak.

Palate : Vibrant and balanced with layers of sweet dried fruit, candied orange peel, toasted almonds, creamy honey, and soft wood spice.

Finish : Long, delicate, and elegant with persistent sweet floral notes, dried fruit sweetness, and lingering oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

chateau-ste-michelle-red-mtn-cabernet-sa.title: Chateau Ste. Michelle Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
chateau-ste-michelle-red-mtn-cabernet-sa.bodyHtml:
Chateau Ste. Michelle Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is an inviting, beautifully balanced, and approachable red wine that showcases the classic character of Washington State’s Columbia Valley. In the glass, it displays a deep ruby hue with vibrant violet reflections. The nose offers an expressive bouquet led by aromas of ripe blackberries, black currants, and blueberries, complemented by subtle nuances of sweet vanilla, leather, caramel, and warm baking spices from oak aging. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied with a supple, creamy texture, delivering concentrated dark fruit flavors layered with hints of cocoa and espresso. Structured yet velvety tannins and fresh natural acidity provide a harmonious frame, leading to a smooth, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted leg of lamb, gourmet burgers, hearty pasta, and aged cheddar cheese.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This excellent value in Cabernet Sauvignon opens with black-and-blueberry aromas that are backed by notes of leather and caramel. The wine's velvety tannins and creamy texture feel right at home with rich flavors of blackberries, cacao nibs and espresso.

highland-park-15-year-old.title: Highland Park 15 Year Old Viking Heart
highland-park-15-year-old.bodyHtml:
Highland Park 15 Year Old 'Viking Heart' is a rich and complex single malt Scotch whisky crafted at the Highland Park Distillery in the Orkney Islands. Matured predominantly in first-fill sherry-seasoned European oak casks along with first-fill sherry-seasoned American oak casks, it delivers a harmonious balance of warm spice, sweet vanilla, vibrant citrus, and signature aromatic heather peat smoke.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork belly, smoked salmon, dark chocolate tarts, aged Gouda, or duck breast with orange glaze.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance with a full-bodied, smooth, and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Crème brûlée, heather honey, crumbled cinnamon, fresh pineapple, lemon zest, and soft peat smoke.

Palate : Freshly baked sponge cake, warm vanilla, toasted cinnamon shards, zesty citrus, and subtle heathery smoke.

Finish : Mellow, medium to long, with lingering waves of aromatic peat smoke, sweet vanilla, and warm oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, with a few drops of water, or over a large ice cube.

liano-igt-rubicon-1.title: Umberto Cesari Liano 2022
liano-igt-rubicon-1.bodyHtml:
Umberto Cesari Liano 2023 is an expressive, richly structured Italian red blend crafted by Umberto Cesari in the rolling hills of Castel San Pietro Terme, Emilia-Romagna. Composed of 70% Sangiovese Grosso and 30% Cabernet Sauvignon sourced from estate vineyards planted on clay-rich hillside soils, the two varietals are harvested and vinified separately with temperature-controlled fermentation before being blended and matured for 18 months in French oak tonneaux and barriques, followed by bottle aging. In the glass, it displays a luminous, deep ruby-red hue with garnet reflections. The aromatic profile opens with intense notes of ripe black cherry, blackberry, and plum layered with sweet baking spices, vanilla, cocoa, and subtle Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, velvety mouthfeel balanced by lively acidity and smooth, well-integrated tannins, culminating in a long, harmonious, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù with tagliatelle, roasted lamb chops, or aged Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese.

bruichladdich-port-charlotte-2013.title: Bruichladdich Port Charlotte Islay Barley 8 Year Old 2013
bruichladdich-port-charlotte-2013.bodyHtml:
Our Port Charlotte Islay Barley expressions are a direct embodiment of everything an Islay whisky can and should be. Conceived, distilled, matured and bottled on the island, with barley raised on our home shores by seven of our farming partners.

Islay grown barley brings so much complexity to the character in this whisky. The peat smoke in this Port Charlotte is, as ever, beautifully evocative of that traditional Islay style. Purity from the distillation and complexity of maturation brings all the components together with harmony and balance.

Nose - The nose opens with delicate floral notes of lily and geranium before warm orange zest and dried earthy peat smoke brings body and gravity. Banoffee pie and digestive biscuit come out from behind the peat smoke and carry forward this dram’s malty, fruity character. Cherry coconut and malted barley counterbalance apricot and melon. Sweet and enticing; the oak and the outstanding peppery phenolic notes are balanced perfectly with the fruit and floral style of our slow, careful fermentation and distillation.

Palate - The first taste is a wondrous thing; all at once the salinity, ripe fruit, light peat smoke, and sweet oak show their presence in a whirl of complexity. There is great texture from the spirit and its maturation allows a subtle almond note to combine with coconut, caramel, vanilla, and muscovado sugar. The peat smoke is beautifully balanced. It is a dram that is gentle on the palate yet has a tremendous depth of flavor.

Finish - The finish is once more perfectly balanced. The smoke, fruit, oak and floral notes melt into each other, and a beautiful creamy texture allows melon, peach and cherry to come through before dwindling into the dry embers of peat in the hearth.

laphroaig-10-year-old-cask-strength-b13.title: Laphroaig Càirdeas 2024 Cask Favourites 10 Year Old
laphroaig-10-year-old-cask-strength-b13.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Càirdeas 2024 Cask Favourites 10 Year Old is a limited-edition single malt Scotch whisky released exclusively for the Friends of Laphroaig. Crafted to celebrate the distillery’s most beloved cask types, this 10-year-old expression combines spirit aged in first-fill ex-bourbon barrels with spirit finished in Pedro Ximénez sherry casks. Bottled at cask strength, non-chill filtered, and naturally colored, it seamlessly pairs Laphroaig's signature medicinal peat smoke and ocean brine with rich dried fruit, dark chocolate, and sweet oak warmth.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, oysters on the half shell, dark chocolate tarts, stilton or blue cheese, and venison stew.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper amber in appearance with a full-bodied, rich, and oily mouthfeel that delivers intense warmth and complex peat depth.

Nose : Smoldering peat smoke, medicinal iodine, damp seaweed, dark raisins, dried figs, sweet vanilla, and toasted oak.

Palate : Rich peat, sea salt, dark chocolate, caramelized brown sugar, sticky dates, black pepper spice, and subtle espresso.

Finish : Long, warming, and complex with lingering coastal smoke, dried fruit sweetness, and peppered oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

highland-park-wild-rose-single-cask.title: Highland Park Cask Strength Release No. 4
highland-park-wild-rose-single-cask.bodyHtml:
Our fourth release has been matured predominantly in first-fill sherry seasoned European oak casks, along with first-fill sherry seasoned American oak casks, a small quantity of refill casks, ex-bourbon casks and – for the first time – ex-port casks too. Bottled straight from the cask, without the addition of water to reduce alcohol content, our Cask Strength series marries the traditional craft of whisky making with a modern approach to flavor exploration.

Cask Strength Release No. 4 opens with enticing aromas of toasted coconut, driven by the ex-bourbon casks, along with crushed lemons and cedarwood; there’s a delightful hint of Turkish Delight in the aromatic peat smoke too, thanks to the influence of the ex-port casks. Intriguing flavors of zesty pink grapefruit and fragrant rose water emerge on the palate, expertly balanced by earthier suggestions of toasted oak and heather-rich peat, while the long finish reveals exotic sunbaked spices and a ribbon of liquorice running through the final breath of floral peat smoke.

We’ve been crafting our award-winning whisky at the Highland Park Distillery in Kirkwall, Orkney, since 1798. Age, experience and tradition may define our whisky, but it’s Orkney that sets it apart. Something magic happens here and the result is the wild harmony of flavors found in our whisky.

Pink grapefruit | Fragrant rose water | Toasted oak | Sun-baked spices | Liquorice | Floral peat smoke

laphroaig-33-year-old-ian-hunter-book-3.title: Laphroaig 33 Year Old Ian Hunter Story Book 3 Source Protector
laphroaig-33-year-old-ian-hunter-book-3.bodyHtml:
introducing the third release in our Ian Hunter series: a 33-year-old non-chill altered whisky with creamy liquorice notes, fully matured in ex-Bourbon barrels so that Laphroaig‘s characteristic peatiness shines through.

The third release of the Ian Hunter Series is to celebrate the legacy of the last of the Johnston family to own and manage the Laphroaig® distillery, and his fight to protect the Kilbride Stream. This is a story of uncompromising guardianship and a battle between neighbours, over every distillery’s essential lifeblood, its source of water.

TASTING NOTES

  • COLOUR

    Deep copper

  • NOSE
    Pears, peaches then apricots and lots of condensed sweetness open this delicious and vintage Laphroaig® up. Followed by notes of honey and rose petal, a dash of nutmeg, and finishing with ashy-dry peat
  • FINISH
    A very long nish with lingering, alternating ashy vanilla and peaty aromas.
  • TASTE
    A sweet, syrupy, fruity mouthfeel to start, it climbs and coats the whole of your palate. It dips to a huge second wave of aniseed, followed by creamy liquorice notes.

yellow-tail-pure-bright-pinot-grigio-1.title: Yellow Tail Pinot Grigio 750ml
yellow-tail-pure-bright-pinot-grigio-1.bodyHtml:
Style
Pinot Grigio is not only great drinking, but excellent for matching with food. It will feel like you've made a little trip to Italy – without the long haul flight!

Aroma
Delightfully fresh, with aromas of pear, hints of red apples and kiwi fruit.

Flavour
Fresh and zesty, bursting with red apple, pear and passionfruit flavours.

Enjoy
With Asian inspired food on a warm summer evening.

yellow-tail-pure-bright-chardonnay-1.title: Yellow Tail Chardonnay
yellow-tail-pure-bright-chardonnay-1.bodyHtml:
Yellow Tail Chardonnay is a vibrant, easy-drinking, and immensely popular Australian white wine crafted for effortless, everyday enjoyment. Displaying a clean, pale straw color with youthful golden hints, it opens with an inviting and highly expressive bouquet of ripe peach, tropical melon, and green apple, delicately accented by subtle notes of fresh citrus and soft vanilla. On the palate, this medium-bodied selection is silky and forward, delivering a smooth core of juicy orchard fruit balanced by a soft, approachable acidity and a whisper of toasty oak, leading into a clean, crisp, and crowd-pleasing finish.

Food Pairing: This versatile white pairs excellently with roasted chicken, grilled white fish, creamy garlic shrimp pasta, Caesar salads, or simple mild cheeses like Brie.

lindores-single-malt-1.title: Lindores MCDXCIV Single Malt
lindores-single-malt-1.bodyHtml:
The launch of Lindores Lowland Single Malt Scotch Whisky reconfirms Lindores as a place of real significance in the History of The Scotch Whisky Industry. As the officially recognized site of the first recorded  distillation of  Scotch Whisky in 1494, which appears in the Exchequer Roll of the same year, Lindores is again taking its place in history with its, now commercially available, Single Malt Scotch Whisky. Over 500 years after Brother John Cor, a Lindores monk, was commissioned by King James IV to turn 8 bolls of malt into Aqua Vitae. Lindores are delighted to re-open the history book and invite you to be part of it.

Colour: Golden.

Nose: Elegant, soft, mellow vanilla, caramel notes playing with orchard fruits and sweet pear drops. Reminiscent of toffee apples!

Palate: Smooth with a creamy texture and a perfect balance of mellow vanilla, dried fruits, citrus touches with a hint of spice.

Finish: Medium length, delicate but lingering finish.

lindores-commemorative-single-malt-1.title: Lindores MCDXCIV Single Malt
lindores-commemorative-single-malt-1.bodyHtml:
The launch of Lindores Lowland Single Malt Scotch Whisky reconfirms Lindores as a place of real significance in the History of The Scotch Whisky Industry. As the officially recognized site of the first recorded  distillation of  Scotch Whisky in 1494, which appears in the Exchequer Roll of the same year, Lindores is again taking its place in history with its, now commercially available, Single Malt Scotch Whisky. Over 500 years after Brother John Cor, a Lindores monk, was commissioned by King James IV to turn 8 bolls of malt into Aqua Vitae. Lindores are delighted to re-open the history book and invite you to be part of it.

Colour: Golden.

Nose: Elegant, soft, mellow vanilla, caramel notes playing with orchard fruits and sweet pear drops. Reminiscent of toffee apples!

Palate: Smooth with a creamy texture and a perfect balance of mellow vanilla, dried fruits, citrus touches with a hint of spice.

Finish: Medium length, delicate but lingering finish.

bowmore-21-year-old-aston-martin-ed-2.title: Bowmore 21 Year Old Aston Martin Edition 1 51.8% ABV
bowmore-21-year-old-aston-martin-ed-2.bodyHtml:
This is a collaboration of perfect proportions, the optimal combination of skill, passion and precision. Taking each Masters’ own creativity and character; bringing together harmoniously to create a beautiful, yet powerful equilibrium.

For Aston Martin proportionality defines every precise detail of the design process; in a quest to achieve the Golden Ratio, this guides the creation of absolute beauty by ensuring a perfectly symmetrical relationship between each proportion.

For Bowmore, proportions define character and shape flavour combinations; from cask selection and age to blending. But for the first time, the adoption of the Golden Ratio has inspired the combination of components, each of which add their own unique flavours and layers of complexity to the final whisky.

The result is a single malt which thrills all the senses for optimal enjoyment. But much like an Aston Martin, delivers a very powerful and memorable finish.

bruichladdich-black-art-9-1-29-year-old-.title: Bruichladdich Black Art Edition 09.1 29 Year Old 1992
bruichladdich-black-art-9-1-29-year-old-.bodyHtml: Inspiration was taken from the groundwork done in creating the first editions of this series, where there was a relentless pursuit of layers of flavour. Here we are, probably another 10 years later, again managing those stocks and recasking and blending more than we’ve done previously,” said Adam Hannett, Head Distiller at Bruichladdich Distillery, and added: “But it’s that time in the casks that we’re working with now, because when the Black Art series started it was around 20 years old, now its almost 30 years old. So the evolution of that whisky by using those same stocks is really different.

bruichladdich-octomore-12-6.title: Bruichladdich Octomore 12.2 5 Year Old Sauternes Cask Finish
bruichladdich-octomore-12-6.bodyHtml:
Produced from 2014 100% Scottish grown Concerto barley, peated to 129.7ppm, and distilled in 2015. Matured 3 1/2 years in a mix of 50% 1st and 50% 2nd fill American oak casks before finishing in Sauternes casks for 18 months. 57.3%

Octomore 12.2 follows in the footsteps of previous Sauternes legends. The now infamous Octomore 4.2 (Comus) became one of the most acclaimed and sought- after whiskies in our distillery’s portfolio, confirming that heavy peat smoke combined with sweet dessert wine of Sauternes is an incredible pairing. This Octomore 12.2 would spend three and a half years in ex-American oak casks, building a solid foundation of fruity and floral spirit in our lochside warehouses before being recasked in to impeccable quality Sauternes casks. The pivotal role of the Sauternes casks would add 18 months of supercharged fruit. Melon, white peach, honeysuckle and coconut add a real twist and sweetness to compliment the peat smoke of this heavily phenolic malt.

captain-morgan-cherry-vanilla-rum.title: Captain Morgan Private Stock Rum
captain-morgan-cherry-vanilla-rum.bodyHtml:
The Captain always has an appreciation for the finer things in life, whether it be a chest full of pieces of eight or a bottle of mature rum.

This one comes aged for two years in oak barrels to give it woody undertones that mingle effortlessly with spices and hints of creamy vanilla. The Captain?s Private Stock Rum is a special brew of barrel matured rum that?s infused with only the finest quality ingredients. It goes down a treat on its own or makes a treasured ingredient in any rum cocktail.

chateau-musar-white-1.title: Chateau Musar Blanc 2017 750ml
chateau-musar-white-1.bodyHtml:
ellow-gold, subtly oaky, and creamy-textured, rich yet dry and intensely citrusy, with honeyed nuances. Wholly unique, the style has been described as resembling 'dry Sauternes' or mature white Graves. Chateau Musar Whites develop tawny hues and mellow spicy characters as they age.

Professional Ratings

  • 90 Wine Spectator
    A late-release white, this has evolved to deliver a soft, supple nutty edge to the juicy lemon, honeyed apple and shortbread flavors. Boasts bitter herb, fleur de sel, jasmine and toasted macadamia nut elements cut with mouthwatering acidity. Elegant and still energetic. For fans of the mature style.

chivas-regal-62-gun-salute-1.title: Royal Salute 62 Gun Salute
chivas-regal-62-gun-salute-1.bodyHtml:
Chivas Royal Salute 62 Gun Salute is an exceptional blended Scotch whisky. This blend is a tribute to the four master blenders who have worked for Chivas since 1953. This year corresponds to the coronation of Queen Elizabeth II, and thus to the first edition of the Royal Salute. Each year, during the commemoration of this event, 62 cannons are fired in the Queen's honour. This is where this vintage gets its prestigious name from.

The decanter that contains this nectar is a true piece of goldsmithery. It is blown and cut by hand, surrounded by crystal and gold, from the stopper to the neck.

directors-special-black-deluxe-whisky-1.title: Director's Special Black Deluxe Indian Whisky
directors-special-black-deluxe-whisky-1.bodyHtml: DSP Black Whisky is the premium extension of Director’s Special Whisky. Every sip of this superb blend offers a rare and exquisite taste with a distinctive flavour. DSP Black Whisky is blended to perfection using quality Indian malts which are produced from the choicest barley for unmatched smoothness. Since its launch, DSP Black Whisky has also been known for its unique bell-shaped bottle that gives the brand an international look.

glenlossie-12-year-old-2009-red-wine-bar.title: Glenlossie 12 Year Old 2009 Red Wine Barriques Càrn Mòr Strictly Limited
glenlossie-12-year-old-2009-red-wine-bar.bodyHtml:
Glenlossie 12 Year Old 2009 is an independently bottled Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from the Glenlossie distillery, released by Morrison Scotch Whisky Distillers in its Càrn Mòr Strictly Limited range. Distilled in 2009, it spent 12 years maturing in red wine barriques, which gave the whisky its deep colour and a profile of red fruit and juicy blackberry. It was bottled in 2021 at 47.5% ABV, non-chill filtered and with no added colour, and the release ran to 1,603 bottles. Glenlossie is rarely seen as a single malt, so this is an unusual chance to taste it, here with a bold wine-cask influence. Presented in a 700ml bottle with a box.

Tasting Notes: Deep red fruits and juicy blackberries, with a thick, lingering finish.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

linkwood-9-year-old-2012-bourbon-barrel-.title: Linkwood 9 Year Old 2011 Bourbon Barrel Carn Mor Strictly Limited
linkwood-9-year-old-2012-bourbon-barrel-.bodyHtml:
Linkwood 9 Year Old 2011 Bourbon Barrel is a small-batch Speyside single malt from the Carn Mor Strictly Limited range of Morrison Scotch Whisky Distillers. Distilled at Linkwood in 2011, it matured in a handful of ex-bourbon barrels before bottling in 2021 at 9 years old, giving an outturn of 1,392 bottles. It is bottled at 47.5% ABV with natural colour and without chill filtration, in a 700ml bottle with presentation box. Linkwood is prized by blenders for its fruity, oily spirit, and bourbon wood lets that character show clearly.

Tasting Notes: The producer notes vanilla and fresh orchard fruits with a hint of citrus.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

macallan-a-night-on-earth-1.title: The Macallan A Night on Earth - The First Light
macallan-a-night-on-earth-1.bodyHtml: A limited edition single malt whisky matured in a harmonious combination of sherry seasoned European and American oak casks, with sparing inclusion of casks that previously held Bourbon. A Night on Earth - The First Light is a radiant tribute to the feeling of joy, renewal and shared beginnings at the very first light of the new year.

mcdowells-no-1-celebration-matured-xxx-1.title: McDowell's MrDowell's No. 1 Celebration Matured XXX Rum
mcdowells-no-1-celebration-matured-xxx-1.bodyHtml:
McDowell's No.1 Celebration Rum is a popular Indian rum brand that is known for its smooth and rich flavor. It is produced by United Spirits Limited, which is a subsidiary of Diageo, a global leader in alcoholic beverages.

This rum is made using a blend of imported Caribbean rums and Indian molasses, which gives it a unique and distinct taste profile. It is aged in oak casks to enhance its flavors and create a smooth and mellow drinking experience.

McDowell's No.1 Celebration Rum has a deep amber color and a rich aroma with notes of vanilla, caramel, and spices. On the palate, it offers a smooth and velvety texture with flavors of toffee, dark chocolate, and dried fruits. It has a long and satisfying finish, making it a favorite choice among rum enthusiasts.

This rum is often enjoyed neat or on the rocks, but it can also be used to make a wide range of cocktails and mixed drinks. It is a versatile spirit that can be enjoyed on any occasion, whether you are celebrating a special event or simply relaxing with friends.

nemiroff-deluxe-vodka-1.title: Nemiroff Vodka
nemiroff-deluxe-vodka-1.bodyHtml: Nemiroff De Luxe is a premium product with strong character. The drink is made to reflect the original recipe and keeps with high production standards. Production is based on natural ingredients, pure water and premium-class alcohol. In addition, high pressure, temperature and 11 stages of filtration make Nemiroff De Luxe a symphony of refined, rich taste with a light linden flower flavour.

royal-lochnagar-16-year-old-2021-sr-1.title: Royal Lochnagar 16 Year Old 2021 Sr
royal-lochnagar-16-year-old-2021-sr-1.bodyHtml:
Royal Lochnagar 16 Year Old Special Release 2021, nicknamed The Spring Stallion, is a limited Highland single malt from Diageo's 2021 Special Releases collection. Matured for 16 years in refill American oak and European oak casks, it is bottled at a powerful 57.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is a bright, fruity dram, where citrus and summer berries meet malt, heather and a faint wisp of smoke.

Tasting Notes: Lemon, strawberry, malt, heather and black pepper.

Nose: Lemon peel and grain, then spun sugar and strawberry.

Palate: Bright lemon and malt, with heather, a little ash and smoke, and berry fruit.

Finish: Dry, with black peppercorn.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

teaninich-11-year-old-2010-oloroso-sherr.title: Morrison Scotch Whisky Distillers Carn Mor Strictly Limited Teaninich 11 Year Old 2010 Oloroso Sherry Finish 47.5% ABV
teaninich-11-year-old-2010-oloroso-sherr.bodyHtml:
Teaninich 11 Year Old 2010 Oloroso Sherry Finish is a Highland single malt from the Càrn Mòr Strictly Limited range of Morrison Scotch Whisky Distillers, the family firm's line of small independent bottlings. Distilled at Teaninich Distillery in 2010 and bottled in 2021, it was finished in Oloroso sherry casks and released as an outturn of just 341 bottles. It is bottled at 47.5% ABV in a 70cl bottle, non-chill filtered and with no added colour, and comes in the cream Càrn Mòr presentation box.

Tasting Notes: Fruitcake, barley sugar and a touch of baking spice.

Serve: Neat, or with a dash of water.

teaninich-11-year-old-2010-str-cask-carn.title: Teaninich 11 Year Old 2010 Str Cask Carn
teaninich-11-year-old-2010-str-cask-carn.bodyHtml:
Teaninich 11 Year Old 2010 is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky from the Càrn Mòr Strictly Limited series of independent bottler Morrison Scotch Whisky Distillers. Distilled at Teaninich in 2010 and bottled in 2021, it was matured in STR casks. The release ran to 1,028 bottles, presented at 47.5% ABV without chill filtration or added colour, in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

maremma-toscana-la-querciolina-montecucc.title: Sassetti Livio La Querciolina Montecucco Rosso 2020
maremma-toscana-la-querciolina-montecucc.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Sassetti Livio La Querciolina Montecucco Rosso is a fresh, expressive, and beautifully balanced Italian red wine that showcases the excellent winemaking pedigree of the Sassetti family in the coastal Maremma region. It pours an intense, deep ruby red color in the glass, lifting with a beguiling bouquet of fresh sour cherries, candied plums, and blackberries. These vibrant fruit notes are seamlessly layered with traditional Tuscan undertones of dried sage, mint, cardamom, and clove. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied wine is smooth and fruit-forward, delivering fleshy red fruit intensities wrapped in sweet baking spices. Cultivated on volcanic hillside soils, its rich structure is perfectly balanced by a lively, food-friendly acidity and a fine network of juicy tannins, trailing off into a long, silky, and subtly earthy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a generous platter of Italian charcuterie, tomato-based pasta dishes, grilled beef burgers, wood-fired pizzas, roasted pork loin, or medium-aged cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

This shows notes of red fruit, dried herbs and walnuts with some earthy character to it. Medium-bodied with soft, juicy tannins and vivid fruit character. Flavorful finish.

torres-salmos-priorat.title: Familia Torres Salmos 2018
torres-salmos-priorat.bodyHtml:
Impressive dark cherry red color with great depth. Seductive floral and dark fruits (cassis, blackberry jam) aromas with undertones of Mediterranean woodland (eucalyptus) and spices (white pepper). Delicate, yet flavorful on the palate with a backbone of very fine-grained tannins and an elegant persistence that culminates — true to its name — in a chorus of aromas and flavors.

92 Points - James Suckling

Sweet cherries and berries on the nose with rose petals and lavender. Medium to full body, firm and chewy tannins and a flavorful finish. Another year or two will soften this. Try after 2021.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A toasty red, with smoke, mocha, grilled herb and iron notes accenting baked black cherry and plum fruit. Dense and medium- to full-bodied, with fine-grained tannins firming the tightly meshed finish. Carignan, Grenache and Syrah. Drink now through 2028.

nautilus-sauvignon-blanc.title: Nautilus Sauvignon Blanc 2023 750ml
nautilus-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: The 2022 Nautilus Sauvignon Blanc is a New Zealand white wine known for its intense, lifted aromas of passionfruit, lemongrass, and ripe grapefruit. The palate offers delightful lime zest flavors with mouthwatering intensity and finishes with a strong textural component. It's described as generous and harmonious, with ripe peach, tangerine, and mango flavors, along with lime zest, makrut lime leaf, and mineral notes.

decoy-sauvignon-blanc.title: Decoy California Sauvignon Blanc 2025
decoy-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Decoy California Sauvignon Blanc 2025 is a vibrant, refreshing white wine from California, produced by Decoy, part of The Duckhorn Portfolio. Crafted from 100% Sauvignon Blanc, this expressive wine offers inviting aromas of tropical fruit, citrus, and delicate vanilla spice. Aged for six months entirely in stainless steel, it preserves its bright fruit character while developing a smooth, rounded texture. Juicy stone fruit, lively acidity, and a lingering kiwi finish make it an excellent choice for warm-weather entertaining and everyday enjoyment.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp, fresh oysters, seafood pasta, roasted chicken, goat cheese, citrus salads, sushi, and lightly seasoned vegetables.

urbina-reserva-especial.title: Urbina Reserva Especial 2006
urbina-reserva-especial.bodyHtml:
The Bodegas Urbina Reserva Especial 2006 is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex Old World red wine that beautifully captures the unique, iron-rich clay soils and historic traditions of Rioja Alta. It pours a beautiful dark ruby red colour with deep tawny and brick reflections in the glass, lifting with an immediate, aromatic bouquet of dried cranberries, stewed plums, and wild red berries, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of sweet tobacco, cedar wood, leather, and moist earth. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Tempranillo blend is remarkably smooth, juicy, and round, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of dark stone fruits, balsamic notes, and hints of clove, nutmeg, and vanilla. Aged carefully for twenty-four months in oak barrels followed by extensive maturation in the bottle to maximize its structural depth and natural sophistication, it is driven by a finely balanced, food-friendly acidity and soft, polished noble tannins that carry into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by a lingering touch of spice and licorice.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of refined culinary options, including slow-roasted lamb shanks, grilled pork chops with wild mushroom ragù, prime cuts of beef steak, wild game dishes, rich stews, and aged artisanal Spanish cheeses like Manchego.
91 Points - James Suckling
A classic, mature Rioja with plenty of dried-banana character, but also blackberry and smoke notes. Supple and generous until you get to the crisp finish. A blend of tempranillo, graciano and mazuelo.

bowmore-25-year-old-1.title: Bowmore 25 Year Old
bowmore-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Bowmore 25 Year Old is a legendary and masterfully aged Islay single malt Scotch whisky, representing a quarter-century of careful maturation in a combination of North American ex-bourbon and Spanish sherry casks. This exceptional expression perfectly balances Bowmore's signature coastal peat smoke with rich, sweet sherry influence. On the nose, it offers an exquisite bouquet of dark chocolate, intense stewed fruits, classic Islay smoke, and a touch of sea salt. The palate is deeply complex, luxurious, and mellow, revealing layers of sweet toffee, hazelnut, rich dark cocoa, and gentle, warming peat smoke, culminating in a remarkably long, elegant, and smooth finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with rich, savory fare such as roasted lamb, smoked venison, or seared duck breast. For dessert, it is an absolute revelation alongside dark chocolate truffles, espresso-based desserts, sticky toffee pudding, or robust blue cheeses like Roquefort and Stilton.

TASTING NOTES - A beautiful, deep and mellow mahogany color with a full, exceptionally smooth, and velvety body that gently coats the palate.

NOSE - Rich and highly complex, featuring intense aromas of stewed fruits, dark raisins, and sweet sherry, beautifully balanced by baked butterscotch, toffee, and a delicate trace of gentle wood smoke.

PALATE - Incredibly elegant and multi-layered, revealing delicious flavors of sweet toffee, roasted hazelnuts, and dark chocolate, gracefully intermingled with hints of iron, saline minerality, and a soft whisper of sweet peat smoke.

FINISH - Remarkably long, warm, and highly complex, leaving a lingering, gentle trail of singed cocoa, sweet wood spice, and dry leather.

SERVE - Best enjoyed poured neat at room temperature in a classic Glencairn or spirits nosing glass, allowing the decades of barrel character to slowly unfurl.

chateau-la-sauvageonne-grand-vin-rouge.title: Gerard Bertrand Chateau La Sauvageonne Grand Vin Rouge 2022
chateau-la-sauvageonne-grand-vin-rouge.bodyHtml:
Intense, ruby robe with flashes of tile-red. Prominent echoes of the scrubland in the nose, with jammy fruit and lively spice. Subtle hints of dark fruit and gingerbread. Elegant and refined tannins frame the palate, with great balance and vivacity.

A perfect match for grilled Aubrac steaks, Larzac cheeses and other classics of southern French cuisine.

martins-lane-naramata-riesling.title: Martin's Lane Naramata Ranch Riesling 2022
martins-lane-naramata-riesling.bodyHtml:
Martin's Lane Naramata Ranch Riesling is a precise Okanagan white showing lime, lemon, green apple, white peach, citrus blossom, and mineral notes. Vibrant acidity and concentrated fruit create an energetic, finely textured palate with excellent tension, purity, and a long, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with shellfish, grilled fish, sushi, roast poultry, fresh salads, or lightly spiced Asian dishes for a vibrant and elegant pairing.

 

94 Points - James Suckling

Tense and crystalline, this remarkable medium-bodied dry riesling has a terrific smoky minerality and racy energy that make it leap over your palate. This pushes the fruit into the background, but as the wine aerates, fine pomelo, grapefruit and lime aromas emerge. Still very youthful, but the finish is extremely long and diamond bright. Quite salty, too. From vines planted in 1976 in a vineyard 470 meters above sea level. Drink or hold. Screw cap.

lachamte-sparkling-sake.title: Alain Ducasse Sparkling Sake
lachamte-sparkling-sake.bodyHtml:
Alain Ducasse Sparkling Sake opens with pronounced floral and fruity aromas of wild strawberry, aniseed and yogurt. Silky and lively on the palate, it balances gentle sweetness, tangy freshness and subtle bitterness before a clean finish. Secondary fermentation in bottle creates its distinctive sparkling character.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, scallop carpaccio, grilled white fish, or delicate poultry dishes.

bibi-graetz-testamatta-2018.title: Bibi Graetz Testamatta 2020
bibi-graetz-testamatta-2018.bodyHtml:
Bibi Graetz Testamatta 2020 is an elegant, pure, and vibrant Super Tuscan red wine crafted entirely from 100% Sangiovese sourced from old, high-altitude hilltop vineyards across Tuscany. Displaying a brilliant, luminous ruby color, it opens with fragrant and lifted aromas of sour red cherries, wild strawberries, and orange zest, beautifully intertwined with notes of crushed rock, delicate rose petals, peppery herbs, and subtle sweet baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-bodied, silky texture with a bright, vertical structure, characterized by lively, crunchy acidity and ultra-fine, chalky tannins that carry intense flavors of tart raspberry, graphite minerality, and savory herbs into a long, precise, and refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with herb-crusted rack of lamb, pan-seared Florentine steak, roasted duck breast, wild mushroom risotto, and aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

Beautiful, fresh aromas of sour cherries, orange peel and lemon bush. Medium-bodied with firm, racy acidity and ultra-fine tannins that add brightness and energy to the wine. This is definitely following the new wave of crunchy, vivid Tuscany sangioveses, which emphasize drinkability and transparency. Lighter than past vintages. Drink now or hold.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Production was greatly reduced in this vintage, down to about 53,000 bottles. The Bibi Graetz 2020 Testamatta is brilliant and vertical with a terrific sense of purity. The bouquet opens to tart cherry and cassis. The wine is vertical and lifted, and the acidity is nicely highlighted. The year 2020 was when Bibi Graetz bought a former hotel that he has since turned into his winery and home.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The subtle nose on this wine releases oak notes first, then cherries, soy sauce, herbs, pencil shavings and eraser, and finally a little orange peel. Graphite and soil come through on the palate alongside more cherries, orange and dried herbs. Tannins hold their shape but let the fruit speak, while acid cuts right down the tongue.

banded-plainsbreaker.title: Banded Peak Plainsbreaker 4 Tall Cans
banded-plainsbreaker.bodyHtml: An aromatic, style bending approach to the pale ale. The Plainsbreaker is bursting with late addition hops, boasting a huge tropical flavour and aroma. Well balanced, interesting and very approachable, this beer is for every adventure

teaninich-1999-the-whisky-agency.title: The Whisky Agency Teaninich 1999 20 Year Old 47.1% ABV
teaninich-1999-the-whisky-agency.bodyHtml:
The Whisky Agency Teaninich 1999 20 Year Old is an independently bottled Highland single malt Scotch whisky from the Teaninich distillery. Distilled in 1999, it matured for two decades in a sherry butt before The Whisky Agency bottled it in 2019 at 47.1% ABV. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

speyside-1994-the-whisky-agency.title: The Whisky Agency Glen Grant 1998
speyside-1994-the-whisky-agency.bodyHtml:
Glen Grant 1998 25 Year Old is a single cask Speyside single malt independently bottled by The Whisky Agency. Distilled at Glen Grant in 1998, it matured for 25 years in a hogshead before being bottled in 2023 at cask strength of 50.4% ABV, with natural colour and without chill filtration. Only 233 bottles were filled. The label features one of the bottler's illustrated designs. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

old-rhosdu-1993-the-whisky-agency.title: The Whisky Agency Old Rhosdhu 1993 27 Year Old 50.8% ABV
old-rhosdu-1993-the-whisky-agency.bodyHtml:
Old Rhosdhu 1993 is a single malt Scotch whisky distilled in 1993 and released as an independent bottling by The Whisky Agency. It is bottled at 50.8% ABV in a 700ml bottle, a rare chance to taste an aged malt under the Old Rhosdhu name.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

cambus-grain-1991-the-whisky-agency.title: The Whisky Agency Cambus 1991 29 Year Old 51.1% ABV
cambus-grain-1991-the-whisky-agency.bodyHtml: The Whisky Agency Cambus 1991 29 Year Old 51.1% ABV 700ml

tormore-1995-the-whisky-agency.title: The Whisky Agency Tormore 1995 25 Year Old 47.7% ABV
tormore-1995-the-whisky-agency.bodyHtml:
The Whisky Agency Tormore 1995 25 Year Old is an independently bottled Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from the Tormore distillery. Distilled in 1995, it spent 25 years maturing in a hogshead before being bottled by The Whisky Agency at 47.7% ABV. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, with a drop of water if you like.

blended-malt-2001-head-tails-2.title: Decadent Drinks Decadent Drams Sideburn 2007 18 Year Old Blended Malt Heads & Tails 10th Anniversary 56.3% ABV
blended-malt-2001-head-tails-2.bodyHtml:
Bottled to celebrate the 10th Anniversary of Heads & Tails, this 18 year old Sideburn (aka Burnside [aka teaspooned Balvenie]) was distilled in 2007, and bottled at 56.3% from a First Fill ex-Bourbon Barrel.

Producer Description

This 'Sideburn' blended malt Scotch whisky was distilled in 2007 and filled into cask as Burnside from William Grant & Sons. It has matured ever since in a single 1st fill Bourbon barrel for 18 years, before we bottled it at natural cask strength as this celebratory Decadent Drams release exclusively for the 10th anniversary of Heads & Tails. Congratulations Igor! Here's to another ten years of distillate-driven spirits and friendship! Please enjoy this special bottling with the smooth revelry and majestic groove of a veteran party Moose.

chateau-duhart-milon-2019.title:
Domaines Barons De Rothschild 
Chateau Duhart Milon 2019 750ml
chateau-duhart-milon-2019.bodyHtml:
96 Points James Suckling

A very balanced, refined Duhart with ever so fine tannins and currant, tobacco and cedar aromas and flavors. Medium to fine tannins. It’s extremely long and polished. Direct. You already want to drink this.
Barrel Sample:95-96

94 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Duhart-Milon is showing beautifully, mingling aromas of cassis and wild berries with notions of violets, cedar wood, orange rind, licorice and spice box in a perfumed bouquet. Medium to full-bodied, supple and seamless, it's charming and refined, with a deep core of fruit, powdery tannins and succulent acids. This château is going from strength to strength. Best after 2025.

94 Points Decanter

This one might sneak up on you, confirming the rise of this wine in recent years. Clear depth of fruit, and above all clear Pauillac character. This feels strict and confident, with beautiful balance and restraint. Duhart is one of the later-ripening and cooler Pauillac terroirs which is why in the past it could be overly austere when young, but it is benefitting from recent hot summers in terms of its fruit ripeness. Pencil lead is prominent here, along with cassis and bilberry. Very precise, very elegant, with a creaminess to the fruit through the mid palate, and overall this is an excellent Duhart. Barrel Sample:94


94 Points Wine Spectator

Racy and mineral-driven, with a chalky thread that runs from start to finish, adding a perfumed elegance to a core of steeped black currant and blackberry fruit flavors. This has a lushness to the fruit, with dark tobacco, steeped black tea and singed alder notes, but there's plenty of range, detail and textural nuance as well. Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Best from 2024

93 Points Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Château Duhart-Milon is another incredibly successful wine in the vintage. Offering up-front currant and cassis fruits, it's medium to full-bodied and has complex cedar and spicy nuances, ripe tannins, and a round, layered, balanced mouthfeel. It's slightly less sunny and opulent than the 2018 but still brings plenty of beautiful, sunny fruit.

the-prisoner-chardonnay.title: The Prisoner Chardonnay 2022
the-prisoner-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Chardonnay 2022 is a rich, full-bodied, and aromatic white wine crafted by The Prisoner Wine Company. Sourced predominantly from cool-climate vineyards in the Carneros region straddling Napa and Sonoma counties, this release breaks traditional single-varietal conventions by co-blending Chardonnay with small amounts of Roussanne and Gewürztraminer. Aged for 10 months in French oak barrels (50% new), it displays a pale yellow-straw hue. The complex nose opens with aromas of yellow peach, ripe pineapple, toasted vanilla, and baked apple, complemented by delicate honeysuckle floral notes. On the palate, it is opulent and creamy, featuring layered flavors of lemon curd, crème brûlée, butterscotch, and sweet baking spices balanced by a refreshing line of natural acidity that carries into a smooth, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pan-seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster tail, roasted herb chicken, creamy Fettuccine Alfredo, and aged Gruyère cheese.

chateau-cos-destournel-2019.title: Chateau Cos d'Estournel 2019
chateau-cos-destournel-2019.bodyHtml:
Chateau Cos d'Estournel is one of Saint Estephe's most iconic estates, celebrated for its depth, precision, and remarkable longevity. Dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon, it reveals aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, blackberry, graphite, cedar, cigar box, violet, and exotic spice. The palate is powerful yet impeccably balanced, with velvety tannins, vibrant freshness, and an exceptionally long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, or aged Comte for an unforgettable Left Bank Bordeaux experience.

 

99 Points - James Suckling

Exceptionally aromatic, with vibrant notes of black currants, blackberries and raspberries layered with hints of coffee and nutmeg. The fruit is remarkably pure, complemented by bright spice and freshness. Full-bodied yet reserved, it delivers fantastic structure, precision and remarkable length. A benchmark expression of Château Cos d'Estournel that is built for long-term cellaring.

98 Points - Decanter

A powerful yet refined Cos d'Estournel that benefits from time in the glass to fully reveal its luxurious character. Velvety textures support layers of bitter dark chocolate, black truffle and coffee, while the tannins gradually build to an impressive crescendo. Sophisticated and glamorous, it balances richness with freshness, showcasing the estate's signature style despite the warm growing season.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Beautifully perfumed from the outset, this stylish wine unfolds into concentrated black currant fruit supported by dark, polished tannins. Crafted from 65% Cabernet Sauvignon, it combines elegance with firm structure and possesses outstanding long-term aging potential. 

97+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Château Cos d'Estournel has turned out brilliantly, revealing aromas of minty cassis, sweet wild berries, wild plums, spices, loamy soil and potpourri. Full-bodied, broad and enveloping, it is polished and seamless, with a deep core of succulent fruit wrapped in fine, velvety tannins that are already beautifully integrated. Recent refinements in viticulture and winemaking are clearly evident, resulting in a wine of exceptional harmony, purity and finesse. Best after 2027.

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Château Cos d'Estournel Grand Vin is composed of 65% Cabernet Sauvignon and 35% Merlot, aged in 55% new French oak. Elegant and seamless, it offers expressive aromas of red currants, cassis, graphite, lead pencil and chalky minerality. Medium- to full-bodied with supple tannins, outstanding purity and a regal, refined profile, it is a graceful, finesse-driven Saint-Estèphe that already shows charm but will reach its full potential after 7–8 years of cellaring and continue evolving for more than 25 years. Best after 2029.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Dark, rich and beautifully layered, this wine delivers flavors of black currant, fig and blackberry preserves accented by cast iron, anise, apple wood, sweet bay leaf and warm earth. A long, savory, mineral-driven finish ties everything together with exceptional elegance and persistence. A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Best from 2024 onward.

chateau-lafite-carruades-lafite-rot-2018.title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild Carruades de Lafite 2015
chateau-lafite-carruades-lafite-rot-2018.bodyHtml:
Beautiful deep colour that sparkles in the glass. The nose is of course still very young, with primary notes of early ageing. Superb notes of spices and fresh raspberries. On the palate, the attack is supple and rounded. The wine then presents young, lively tannins, whose excellent quality will be revealed with time. The finish is complex and harmonious with beautiful burnt notes. This Carruades needs five to seven years to open up, and has all the characteristics of a wine that will continue to improve for many more.

94 Points - James Suckling
Lead-pencil aromas with currants and plums, too. Full body, silky tannins and a focused and very refined finish. It's the tannins that drive things. An excellent second wine of Lafite. Needs two or three years to soften. Start drinking in 2021.
94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This second wine of Lafite comes from young vines and wines selected during the blending. The result is a wine with the structure and nobility of the Lafite character but one that will age more quickly. It has great layers of black-currant fruits and acidity, with firm tannins as a background and rich potential. Drink from 2025. 

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2015 Carruades de Lafite is a blend of 57% Cabernet Sauvignon, 36% Merlot and 7% Cabernet Franc. This has a satisfying purity on the nose: blackberry and briary, a distant, cold slate-like note just underneath, with the new oak (close to 20%) neatly subsumed. The palate is medium-bodied with fine tannin. There is moderate depth to this slightly foursquare and conservative Carruades, but there is also plenty of freshness and it has an appealing, unassuming finish that is both harmonious and precise. Probably one of the most approachable deuxième vins, afford this 2-3 years in bottle before broaching.

91 Points - Wine Spectator
Warm plum, fig and black tea notes mix here, with a charcoal frame and a smoldering tobacco accent running through the finish. The velvety and slightly rugged textures are intertwined, showing a nice tug of earth at the end. Best from 2022 through 2030.

argiano-non-confunditur.title: Argiano Non Confunditur 2022
argiano-non-confunditur.bodyHtml:
Fruity notes with a touch of oak. Medium-bodied, savory mouthfeel with characteristic red fruits and underbrush notes. Quite persistent with a nice freshness that marries well with medium tannin.

93 Points - James Suckling

Complex aromas of blackcurrants, black licorice, violets, sandalwood and graphite. Medium-bodied with a solid core of fruit in the center palate and fine, chewy tannins that run the length of the wine. Crunchy and chewy.

cincoro-anejo.title: Cincoro Anejo Tequila
cincoro-anejo.bodyHtml:
Cincoro Añejo is aged at our distillery 24-28 months in our underground cellar, further enhancing the interaction between the barrel and tequila. Intense amber in color with copper overtones, wood and dried fruits on the nose elegantly resonate throughout. Notes of orange, fig and date, with hints of caramel and butterscotch are distinguished on the palate. Unforgettable mouth feel and smooth luxurious finish lay the foundation for both classic cocktails or sipping neat.


Cincoro aged expressions are characterized by their smoothness, richness, and deliciousness. Words rarely used to describe tequila. Cincoro Añejo begins as Cincoro Blanco, aging in used American whiskey barrels for 24-28 months. The aging and blending process is more robust for Añejo, as the master blender must distinguish more subtle notes from barrels over 3 years old, with a wide range of complexity from each barrel. Our aging and blending process creates the rich and complex Cincoro taste profile, balancing the uniqueness of our agave profile, with time aging in specially selected barrels. Cincoro Añejo has layers of complexity, similar to fine bourbon or single malt scotch.

cincoro-blanco.title: Cincoro Blanco Tequila
cincoro-blanco.bodyHtml:
Cincoro Blanco is unaged, and is made with 100% Weber blue agave from both the highlands and lowlands of Jalisco, Mexico. By combining agave from two distinct appellations, our Blanco tequila is smooth on the palate, with great complexity and finish. Reflective of the terroir, fresh and cooked agave permeate, with light vanilla and citrus undertones, derived from a meticulous small-batch production process.


Cincoro tequilas are characterized by their smoothness, richness, and deliciousness. Words rarely used to describe tequila. Cincoro Blanco is incredibly versatile, it can be best enjoyed neat in proper stemware, or mixed in a classic cocktail. When enjoying neat, the layers of aroma and flavor evolve in the glass, reflecting the unique attributes of our highland and lowland agave. Even the shape of the bottle was inspired by the Weber Blue Agave leave. Perfect for any special occasion, especially sipping and savoring with family and friends.

cincoro-reposado.title: Cincoro Reposado Tequila
cincoro-reposado.bodyHtml:
Cincoro Reposado is aged at our distillery 8-10 months in our underground cellar, allowing more interaction between the tequila and wood. Cooked agave, with hints of vanilla on the nose, are complimented by spices and dried fruits. On the palate, cooked agave, light vanilla and baking spices complement toasted oak in perfect proportion.


Cincoro aged expressions are characterized by their smoothness, richness, and deliciousness. Words rarely used to describe tequila. Cincoro Reposado begins as Cincoro Blanco, aging in used American Whiskey barrels for 8-10 months. Our aging and blending process creates the rich and complex Cincoro taste profile, balancing the uniqueness of our agave profile, with time aging in specially selected barrels.

summerhill-ehrenfelser.title: Summerhill Ehrenfelser Icewine 375ml
summerhill-ehrenfelser.bodyHtml:
Summerhill Ehrenfelser Icewine is a luscious Okanagan dessert wine with apricot, peach, tropical fruit, honey, citrus, and floral notes. Rich and concentrated, it balances intense sweetness with vibrant acidity, offering a silky texture and long, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with blue cheese, foie gras, fruit tarts, cheesecake, crème brûlée, fresh berries, and creamy desserts.

niebaum-coppola-rubicon.title: Inglenook Rubicon 2017/2018 750ml
niebaum-coppola-rubicon.bodyHtml:
Strikingly rich in colour and extract, the 2018 Rubicon is unquestionably a precocious, hedonistic wine. The exotic, well-knit aromas and flavours include ripe cassis, allspice, star anise, vanilla and black licorice. Upon entry, this full-bodied wine envelops the palate with its luxurious concentration and supple, silky tannins, supported by vibrant freshness from the balanced acidity and perfectly-integrated French oak. Very long and expansive in the finish, the 2018 Rubicon will be memorable for decades to come.

Ratings are for the 2018 Vintage

97 Points - James Suckling
Subtle and complex red with blackberry, black truffle, sweet tobacco and mahogany. Highlights of lavender and violets. Full-bodied and very tight with finesse and tension. Very polished, fine tannins. Long finish. It's delicious already, but best after 2022.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Rubicon is based on a blend of 89% Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Merlot, and the balance of Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. It's a more backward, closed wine, offering classy notes of crème de cassis, lead pencil shavings, freshly crushed stone, and cedar. More medium to full-bodied and elegant, I'd like to see a touch more density and richness on the mid-palate. Still, it's beautifully balanced and has gorgeous tannins, integrated acidity, and outstanding length on the finish. Give this classic, impressive, old-school beauty 4-5 years in the cellar and enjoy over the following 15-20.

beaulieu-vineyard-napa-valley-cab-sauv.title: Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
beaulieu-vineyard-napa-valley-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is a rich, elegant, and full-bodied red wine from California's renowned Napa Valley. Crafted with carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine showcases the region's exceptional winemaking heritage and Beaulieu Vineyard's commitment to quality. It offers concentrated dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, and subtle oak influences, creating a beautifully balanced and sophisticated drinking experience. With its smooth texture, layered complexity, and lingering finish, this Cabernet Sauvignon is an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining, or enjoying with a hearty meal.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, barbecue, hearty pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses such as cheddar and Gouda.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Focused and brilliant flavors of red and black cherries and black currants drive this sleek and powerful wine, as minty, toasty, and tobacco-like accents stay subtly in the background until the finish. A full body, medium to full tannins and good fruit acidity lend tangy freshness. Best from 2026.

91 Points - James Suckling 

A juicy and delicious wine with a round and polished texture with hints of chocolate and walnuts. Some iron shavings, too. Medium body. Savory at the end. Lovely dark fruit in the finish. Juicy. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a light mesquite edge that mingles with gently mulled plum and blackberry fruit flavors, while lightly singed vanilla and tobacco fill in through the finish. Reveals a solid graphite spine, too. Drink now through 2033. Tasted twice, with consistent notes

spearhead-chardonnay-clone-95.title: SpearHead Clone 95 Chardonnay 2020 750ml
spearhead-chardonnay-clone-95.bodyHtml: Clone 95 is considered a superior chardonnay clone originating in the Côte d'Or, Burgundy, and in this case, reveals some topical pineapple, butter, baked apple, honey and citrus. The finish has a lingering wood bitterness that could dissipate over time but will need two to three years to move on. Solid if less vibrant than their pinot noirs that are jumping to the top of BC offerings. More California style for those who love their chardonnay big and buttery. Stanley gets his Clone 95 chardonnay from Duncan Vineyard on the Naramata Bench. It's all hand harvested and whole bunch pressed before the ferment and ageing in French oak barrels for ten months. They use a mix of standard barrels and puncheons, of which 25 percent are new, and the wine goes through partial malolactic fermentation.

bv-reserve-george-de-latour-cab-sauv.title: Beaulieu Vineyard BV Georges de Latour Private Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bv-reserve-george-de-latour-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
Beaulieu Vineyard BV Georges de Latour Private Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is an opulent, intensely concentrated, and highly prestigious Napa Valley red wine. Born out of an unprecedented and deeply challenging growing season, this powerhouse flagship vintage opens with an expressive and highly fragrant bouquet of crème de cassis, wild blackberries, cooked black plums, and dried black cherries. These dense fruit layers are intricately intertwined with perfumed notes of wild violet, dark chocolate, fresh spearmint, tobacco leaf, and graphite, alongside sweet baking spices like vanilla, caramel, and nutmeg from extended French oak maturation. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, voluminous, and multi-layered, presenting a rich, mouth-coating density. Its defining feature is the prominent, structural framework of signature "Rutherford Dust" tannins, which provide a firm, chewy, cocoa-powder texture balanced seamlessly by a lively line of natural acidity that carries it into a legendary, velvety finish.

Food Pairing: This muscular and intensely structured Cabernet Sauvignon calls for exceptionally rich and savory dishes. It pairs magnificently with prime cuts of marbled meat, such as a dry-aged Wagyu ribeye pan-seared with black truffle butter, grilled prime rib, or a roasted rack of lamb crusted with rosemary and garlic. It is also a stunning match for a sophisticated beef tenderloin carpaccio garnished with shaved Parmesan and extra virgin olive oil, wild boar ragù, or rich, earthy mushroom risottos.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Fascinating, fresh and ripe fruit flavors fill this full-bodied, velvety-textured wine with blackberries, raspberries and cranberries. Subtle oak spices add interest from the aroma through the finish. Decant this time-tested wine if drinking soon.Best from 2027–2040.

94 Points - James Suckling

A very fine and polished BV private reserve that shows focus, tension and subtle complexity with lead pencil, fresh sage and dried herb undertones. Medium body, fine tannins and a pretty finish. Very refined. Drink or hold.

 92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

While some wineries opted to skip the 2020 vintage, BV has bottled a seemingly excellent 2020 Cabernet Sauvignon Private Reserve Georges de Latour. It features black cherries, cassis and toasty oak on the nose, while its medium to full-bodied palate is a bit coarse and open-knit, but it shows no overt evidence of smoke taint to this taster, as the wine finishes long and velvety.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A ripe, poised wine, with a core of warmed cassis and plum reduction notes, gilded with a hint of violet and underscored by a warm loamy edge. Offers a solid frame, thanks to generous toast, with apple wood and alder hints hanging through the finish as the dark, fleshy fruit slowly unwinds. Solid. Best from 2024 through 2035.

wente-riva-ranch-sgl-vineyard-pinot-noir.title: Wente Riva Ranch Pinot Noir 2023
wente-riva-ranch-sgl-vineyard-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: The 2023 Riva Ranch Vineyard Pinot Noir is a vibrant and expressive representation of the Arroyo Seco appellation. This vintage opens with youthful aromas of ripe black cherries, red currants, and earthy undertones, elegantly layered with notes of toasty oak spice, including hints of baked cinnamon, clove, and toasted brioche. On the palate, supple, rounded tannins and lively acidity create a harmonious balance, carrying the wine gracefully from start to finish.

pian-delle-vigne-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Antinori Pian delle Vigne Brunello di Montalcino 1.5L Magnum
pian-delle-vigne-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Deep ruby red in color, this Brunello di Montalcino offers aromas of ripe cherry, plum, violet, tobacco, leather, and sweet spice. The palate is full-bodied and elegant with layers of dark fruit, earthy complexity, and refined tannins balanced by vibrant acidity. The finish is long, structured, and exceptionally persistent.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with braised beef, lamb shanks, wild game, truffle dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged Pecorino cheese.

taylor-fladgate-40-year-old-port.title: Taylor Fladgate 10, 20, 30 ,40 Year Old Century of Port Gift Pack 4x375ml
taylor-fladgate-40-year-old-port.bodyHtml:
Taylor Fladgate holds one of the world's most extensive reserves of rare cask-aged Ports. This collection will give the Port lover on your list 100 reasons to thank you.

This gift pack contains 4x375ml bottles of Taylor Fladgate Tawny Port: 10 Year Old, 20 Year Old, 30 Year Old and 40 Year Old.

10 Year Old - Rich and elegant nose combining aromas of ripe berry fruit with a delicate nuttiness and subtle mellow notes of chocolate, butterscotch and fine oak wood. Smooth and silky on the palate and full of ripe figgy, jammy flavours which persist on the long finish.

20 Year Old - Opulent and voluptuous nose of complex spicy, jammy and nutty aromas, hints of orange flower and fine oak coming from the long period of aging in cask. The palate is full of very rich and concentrated flavour and has a long mellow finish.

30 Year Old - Hints of dried fruit and honey offset the rich nutty aromas. Lush, silky richness with an elegant, slightly austere quality which is quite distinctive. Subtle dried fruit flavours underlie exotic layers of caramel and nuts culminating in an endless finish.

40 Year Old - An exceptional density, with a powerful nose of dried fruit, honey and a touch of spice. Impressions of nutmeg, roasted coffee and an intense nuttiness converge both in the bouquet and on the palate. The wine’s rich, intense, voluptuous, almost viscous texture culminate in a finish of incredible length.

fonseca-vintage-port-2017.title: Fonseca Vintage Port 2017 375ml
fonseca-vintage-port-2017.bodyHtml:
This spectacular fortified wine opens with concentrated aromas of blackberry, cassis, dark chocolate, and exotic spices. On the palate, its voluptuous, velvety texture is seamlessly balanced by firm, muscular tannins and crisp acidity, culminating in an incredibly long, powerful finish.

Food Pairing: Perfect when served alongside robust blue cheeses like Stilton, toasted walnuts, or rich desserts made from artisanal premium dark chocolate.

 

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2017 Vintage Port, not quite bottled when originally seen, has now been in bottle for a couple of years. It is a field blend (with typical grapes like Touriga Nacional, Touriga Francesca, Tinto Cão, Tinta Roriz and Tinta Barroca) aged for approximately 20 months in used French oak. It comes in with 98 grams of residual sugar. This is a great Fonseca, distinctive, with a touch of eucalyptus and plums, but also loaded with delicious fruit. Like its Taylor's siblings, there is also a fine backbone. I'd say it is a step behind the Taylor's duo this year, but not by much. It will age well, to say the least. Beat after 2030.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The wine’s fine perfumed black plum fruits give a wonderful jammy character while bringing out a fresh edge. These are balanced by the dry core of this beautiful wine with its rich, generous tannins. It will all come together from 2030 in a very fine, integrated wine. Kobrand.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Dark and dense, with fig bread, baker’s chocolate and tar notes leading off before the core flavors of plum, black currant and blackberry paste finally start to emerge. The wild, spirited finish shows cast iron, licorice snap and roasted alder elements, delivering a decidedly chewy feel. A big, old-school, throwback Port that will age at a glacial pace. Best from 2035 through 2060

95 Points- Decanter

Already beautifully integrated, this is showing great purity and poise. It's open and in its first bloom of youth, with lovely aromatic red berry fruit and floral aromas, plus a touch of leafiness. It's soft and fleshy initially, seemingly not as big as its stablemate Taylor's - and not quite so deep in color - though with dark chocolate concentration and mid-palate firmness. Lovely full, ripe tannins mass in the mouth, well defined, with fresh berry fruit remerging on the broad, expansive finish.

95 Points - James Suckling

Ripe and soft with loads of plummy, smoky and earthy character. Full body. Very sweet. Round and very soft textured. Flavorful finish. Drink in 2025 and onwards.

bacoo-7-year-old.title: Bacoo 7 Year Old Rum
bacoo-7-year-old.bodyHtml:
Bacoo 7 Year Old is a seamless, versatile rum with enough barrel character for sipping and the balance to work in mixed drinks. Bacoo is produced in the Dominican Republic from fresh cane juice pressed from estate-grown sugar cane rather than molasses, distilled in both copper and stainless steel stills, and aged in ex-bourbon barrels; the brand describes this as a farm-to-glass process that gives it more control over quality and character. This expression is aged 7 years and bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Dark amber, with vanilla, banana, maple, molasses and creamy coffee flavours.

Nose: Vanilla.

Palate: Buttercream icing, banana, maple and molasses, with warm vanilla, banana cream and creamy coffee.

Finish: Very little heat, with a slight bitterness.

masseto-massetino-2019.title: Masseto Massetino 2019
masseto-massetino-2019.bodyHtml:
Massetino 2019 displays the typical characteristics of this vintage. The cooler is dark and youthful, the nose displays perfectly ripe black fruit underlined by spicy new oak and licorice. On the palate the wine is rich and dense, with a velvety and refined texture balanced by a frame of fresh acidity and firm tannins.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Tasted before bottling, the 2019 Massetino is shaping up beautifully. This is the third vintage made of the Merlot-based wine enhanced with a small part of Cabernet Franc. The Cabernet Franc is what distinguishes this euphemistically diminutive expression of Masseto, and it is its distinctive vinous signature. The 2019 vintage is soft and pliant but also incredibly rich and layered. It offers generous black fruit with ripe cherry and blackberry. Spice, tobacco and campfire ash fill in the rear and build the aromatic profile of this wine that is already stacked tall and proud. We still need to see how the 2019 plays out in the bottle, and I am especially interested to gauge how the thick and rich fruit concentration works against the less pronounced acidity of the vintage.
96 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Dense fruit and woody, medicinal notes brood on the nose of this iconic Tuscan expression of Merlot. Aromas range from black cherry, plum, fig and raisin to eucalyptus, fennel, wild mint and damp soil. The palate feels austere, with unrelenting tannins and acid that nearly vibrates. It has a pure linearity that will only reveal itself with quite a bit more time.

95 Points - Wine & Spirits
This is the third vintage of Massetino, made with fruit from recently replanted vines, not considered ready for the flagship Masseto wine. Merlot lovers are the winners from that decision, with a floral-scented wine that is rich and concentrated yet superbly balanced. Aromas of violets and fresh thyme accent its ripe plum flavors, gaining notes of dark chocolate along with a hint of tobacco that reflects a touch of cabernet franc (six percent of the blend). Delicious now, its length and verve bode well for even more pleasure in the years to come.

95 Points - James Suckling
Very attractive aromas of currants, spices and sweet tobacco with some graphite and slate. Full-bodied with a rich and rather dense mouth feel, plenty of fruit and a spicy, dark-chocolate aftertaste. A solid and sturdy second wine from Masseto. Try in 2023.
93 Points - Wine Spectator

Here's a plush, opulent, in-your-face kind of red, without being over the top. Toasty blackberry, black cherry and plum aromas and flavors ply the center, graced by leather, earth and tobacco accents. Dense, yet finishes long and light on its feet. Merlot and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2023.

barnett-spring-mountain-cabernet-sauvign.title: Barnett Vineyards Spring Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
barnett-spring-mountain-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:
Barnett Vineyards Spring Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a powerful, expressive, and mountain-grown Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon crafted from steep estate vineyards high on Spring Mountain. Visually displaying a deep ruby-purple core with vibrant violet rim highlights, it opens with an intense and aromatic bouquet of ripe cassis, dark plum, and black cherry, harmoniously integrated with nuances of sweet cocoa, crushed graphite, dried sage, and toasted French oak. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied structure supported by firm, fine-grained mountain tannins and a vibrant core of natural acidity, offering rich layers of dark berry fruit, dark chocolate, and subtle spice that flow into a long, structured, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison, and aged hard cheeses like gouda.

93 Points - James Suckling

A tightly focused, intense and structured red that should get even better with time. Dense layers of black cherries, cocoa, spearmint and iron on the palate, lifted by lively, fine-grained and persistent tannins. Tempting to drink now but best from 2030.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

There are just 120 cases of Barnett's 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon Spring Mountain District, sourced from their own property and the neighboring York Creek Vineyards, so readers may have to move quickly to grab some. This medium- to full-bodied wine is fresh, juicy, open-knit and easy to drink already, with notes of cigar wrapper, black cherries, cassis and bay leaf that linger on the long, mouthwatering finish.

glendronach-28-year-cask-2623-batch-17.title: The GlenDronach 28 Year Old Cask 2623 Batch 17 700ml

glendronach-26-year-cask-113-batch-17.title: The GlenDronach 26 Year Old Cask 113 Batch 17 700ml

glendronach-25-year-cask-416-batch-17.title: The GlenDronach 25 Year Old Cask 416 Batch 17 700ml

glendronach-23-year-cask-3040-batch-17.title: The GlenDronach 23 Year Old Cask 3040 Batch 17 700ml

ouzo-boutari.title: Ouzo Cambas (Boutari)
ouzo-boutari.bodyHtml:
Boutari Ouzo is a traditional Greek anise aperitif from Boutari, one of Greece's best-known wine and spirits houses. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a clear, aniseed-flavoured spirit in the time-honoured Greek style, made for slow, sociable sipping before a meal.

Serve: Over ice with a splash of cold water.

jack-daniels-limited-edition.title: Jack Daniel's Limited Edition McLaren Version 3
jack-daniels-limited-edition.bodyHtml:
The third highly anticipated limited-edition release in the partnership between Jack Daniel's and the McLaren Formula 1 team. Celebrating McLaren's racing dominance, this exclusive 2025 "Version 3" bottle features striking papaya orange accents and dynamic striping. Inside the collectible bottle is the classic Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey, but for this special edition, it has been bottled at a higher 86 proof (43% ABV). This elevated proof delivers a richer, more intense, and fuller-bodied tasting experience than the standard release.

 

NOSE

Classic aromas of caramel, vanilla, toasted oak, and a signature hint of sweet banana.

PALATE

A rich, medium-bodied blend of sweet caramel, brown sugar, creamy vanilla, and toasted oak with subtle underlying spice.

FINISH

Smooth, warming, and clean with gentle oak and lingering sweetness.

dom-perignon-brut.title: Dom Perignon Vintage 2017
dom-perignon-brut.bodyHtml:
Dom Pérignon Vintage 2017 è uno champagne di straordinaria eleganza, complessità e ricchezza strutturale, nato da un'annata sfidante caratterizzata da volumi di produzione estremamente ridotti. Alla vista si presenta di un brillante colore giallo dorato con riflessi verdolini e un perlage finissimo e persistente. Al naso si apre con un bouquet intenso ed avvolgente di petricore, gelsomino fresco, scorza di agrumi candita e albicocca essiccata, impreziosito da note di pan tostato, nocciola tostata, burro e lievi sfumature di cacao. Al palato offre una texture cremosa e voluttuosa, sostenuta da una viva acidità limata e una spiccata mineralità gessosa, sfociando in un finale lungo, teso e piacevolmente persistente.

Food Pairing: Si abbina felicemente con ostriche fresche, caviale, granseola, carne di capriolo, carré d'agnello alle erbe e formaggi a pasta dura stagionati.

98 Points - James Suckling

An edgy Dom Perignon with intense and singular aromas of lemons, toast and botanicals. Medium-bodied with a dense center palate and a vivid and rocking finish. Tight, muscular bubbles frame this nicely. Tense. Developing well in the bottle. 62% chardonnay and 38% pinot noir. 4.5 g/L dosage. Drink now or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Of the two releases—the 2017 and the 2018—the 2017 Dom Pérignon is the deeper and more structurally endowed wine, unfurling from the glass with a complex bouquet of orange peel, dried apricot and burnt buttered toast, mingling with nuances of dried flowers, toasted hazelnut and cacao bean, all strongly singed with the house’s signature smoky reduction. On the palate, it is full-bodied and concentrated, with a rich core of fruit. Its darker, open-knit profile is animated by a pillowy mousse, vibrant acidity and attractively bitter, structuring phenolics that assert themselves on a long, resonant finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A vivid Champagne, offering a finely detailed mousse, with a toasty overtone to the flavors of crushed white raspberry and white cherry fruit, grapefruit pith, toast point and oyster shell, all defined by chiseled, lemony acidity. A fine example from a challenging vintage. Drink now through 2037.

coors-light-6.title: Coors Light 15 Cans
coors-light-6.bodyHtml: Coors Light is a light lager with a crisp, clean, and refreshing taste, packaged in a convenient 15-can carry case. It's brewed with Coors' proprietary yeast and aged slowly for a smooth, easy-drinking experience. The beer features a light body with malt notes and low bitterness, making it a popular choice for various occasions like parties, barbecues, or tailgating. It has a 4.2% ABV and 99 calories per 12-ounce serving, according to Platina Liquor.

bodegas-borsao-tres-picos.title: Bodegas Borsao Tres Picos Garnacha 2020 750ml
bodegas-borsao-tres-picos.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2019 vintage) "This wine offers a nose of dark plum and raspberry with a hint of forest floor. It is soft in the mouth, with delicate tannins and flavors of black cherry, fennel pollen and coffee bean. There is a note of orange zest that lingers on the finish. Mike DeSimone" - 88/100, Wine Enthusiast

decoy-rose.title: Decoy Rose 2024
decoy-rose.bodyHtml: This Rosé shines with vibrant notes of white peach and ruby grapefruit, accented by a touch of lemon zest. The palate mirrors these bright aromatics, offering delicate stone fruit flavors and lively citrus. A crisp, dry mineral finish adds to its refreshing elegance, capturing the Decoy spirit – bright, expressive and effortlessly enjoyable. A sip of sunshine in every glass.

alma-negra-m-blend.title: Alma Negra M Blend 2022
alma-negra-m-blend.bodyHtml:
Alma Negra M Blend 2022 is an expressive, deeply concentrated, and harmonious Argentinian red blend created by winemaker Ernesto Catena in Mendoza. Translating to "black soul," the label celebrates the intense, dark-skinned grapes that form its core. Crafted predominantly from Malbec and Bonarda harvested from high-elevation vineyards, it reveals alluring aromas of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, roasted coffee beans, and subtle sweet baking spices with a touch of cocoa. On the palate, it is full-bodied, supple, and rich, framing lush dark berry fruit with fine-grained, powdery tannins and balanced acidity that leads into a long, satisfying finish.
