Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled flank steak, roasted lamb chops, empanadas, braised short ribs, barbecued meats, and aged hard cheeses like Gouda.

94 Points - James Suckling

A full-bodied blend of dark spices, dark chocolate and a solid fruit core, mixing red fruit with a black fruit background. On the palate there’s a nice chew of fine, dusty tannins that coat the fruit. It’s quite long and structured. Drink or hold.

feudi-san-gregorio-falanghina.title: Feudi Di San Gregorio Falanghina Del Sannio 2024 750ml
feudi-san-gregorio-falanghina.bodyHtml: Producer tasting notes: (2020 vintage) "The color is straw yellow that contains brilliant green reflections. The perfume is intense and persistent with sensations of delicate white flowers and fruit. The taste offers freshness and balance, with a clean finish." - Feudi Di San Gregorio

j-lohr-pure-paso.title: J. Lohr Pure Paso Proprietary Red 2023
j-lohr-pure-paso.bodyHtml:
This rich, deeply concentrated Paso Robles red blend opens with an expressive and sophisticated bouquet of black cherry compote, dark chocolate, and dried violets, harmonized by sweet nuances of caramel, cocoa powder, and anise. On the palate, it is full-bodied, supple, and intensely fruit-forward, showcasing layers of ripe blackberry, dark plums, and black coffee. Balanced by a refreshing thread of acidity and framed by firm, polished tannins, it concludes with a long, savory, and appetizing finish accented by notes of cedar and black pepper.

Food Pairing: This robust blend pairs wonderfully with a grilled New York strip steak, wood-fired barbecue beef brisket, hearty venison stews, or robust, mature cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Ripe, bold aromas of plums, blackberry compote, blackcurrants, mocha and spices. The palate is full-bodied with a creamy texture and firmly framed tannins. This blend of cabernet sauvignon and petite sirah is not for the faint-hearted.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This bold, attention-grabbing blend of Cab and Petite Sirah begins with rich aromas of stewed black cherry and caramelized oak. The palate's coffee and toffee flavors decorate the core of black cherry compote.

wente-riva-ranch-chardonnay.title: Wente Riva Ranch Chardonnay 2024
wente-riva-ranch-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Wente Vineyards Riva Ranch Chardonnay 2024 is a rich, full-bodied, and beautifully layered California white wine sourced from the family's cool-climate estate vineyards in Monterey County. Upfront, it displays vibrant aromas of ripe Honeycrisp apples, Bartlett pears, plumeria, and toasted brioche. On the palate, a lush, creamy mouthfeel delivers expressive flavors of lemon meringue, tropical pineapple, and crème brûlée, seamlessly supported by well-integrated oak spice and a refreshing beam of natural acidity that leads to a long, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared halibut with lemon-butter sauce, lobster bisque, roasted chicken with herbs, mushroom risotto, and creamy goat cheese dishes.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Sharp and yet floral aromas of lemon peel, plumeria and pineapple align on the nose of this bottling. The palate is slightly viscous and thick in mouthfeel, as mango and citrus flavros work into a harmonious balance.

90 Points - James Suckling

Golden apples, caramel apples and lemon candy on the nose, with apple pie and lemon meringue on the palate. It’s toasty, creamy, full-bodied and balanced by fresh acidity.

st-remy-x-o.title: St. Remy XO Brandy
st-remy-x-o.bodyHtml:
St-Rémy XO is a French brandy from St-Rémy, a Loire Valley house that has been distilling since 1886 and blends eaux-de-vie drawn from different regions, grape varieties and vineyards across France. Luminous amber with a golden glow, it is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle and shows a mature, oak-and-vanilla style with ripe fruit, honey and gingerbread spice.

Tasting Notes: Oak, vanilla, ripe fruit, honey and gingerbread.

Nose: Mature, with oak and delicate vanilla layered with ripe fruit and honey.

Palate: Wood and vanilla enriched by gingerbread, candied apricot, dates, figs and nuts; subtly spicy.

Finish: Long.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or with coffee after dinner.

catena-zapata-chardonnay-white-stones.title: Catena Alta Historic Rows Chardonnay 2024
catena-zapata-chardonnay-white-stones.bodyHtml:
Catena Alta Historic Rows Chardonnay 2024 is an elegant, high-altitude white wine crafted from select historic rows within the Catena family estate vineyards. Sourced primarily from the renowned Adrianna and Domingo vineyards in the Valle de Uco, it presents an intense greenish-yellow hue and an inviting bouquet of apricot, peach crumble, grilled lemon, and delicate jasmine, complemented by subtle hints of smoky French oak. The palate is full-bodied, rich, and delightfully creamy, balancing concentrated stone fruit flavors with a crisp, mineral-driven acidity that leads into a long, persistent, and perfectly poised finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with herb-marinated roasted chicken, pan-seared scallops in garlic butter, creamy seafood pasta, or mild artisanal soft cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

This shows attractive apricot, peach-crumble, grilled-lemon and whipped-butter aromas. It’s intense, ripe and delicious with a full body and a long, caressing finish. Drink now or hold.

catena-zapata-adrianna-fortuna-terrae.title: Catena Zapata Adrianna Vineyard Fortuna Terrae Malbec 2022
catena-zapata-adrianna-fortuna-terrae.bodyHtml:
A vibrant and profoundly aromatic expression of the Adrianna Vineyard, the 2022 Fortuna Terrae Malbec comes from a parcel with deep loamy soils that foster high-altitude grasses and delicate wildflowers. This "luck of the earth" translates into a wine with a deep violet hue and an expressive bouquet of raspberries, wild strawberries, and red cherries, layered with notes of lavender, fresh earth, and subtle spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and incredibly silky, characterized by its bright acidity and fine-grained tannins that provide a sense of lift and elegance. The finish is long and refreshing, showcasing a perfect harmony between concentrated fruit and mineral-driven freshness.

98 Points - James Suckling

Deep brooding nose with a touch of cocoa powder to the deep, fresh blueberries, chiles and chocolate. Impeccable chalky tannins confer structure and resolve. Full-bodied but super fresh and bright, with a long, long finish. Need two or three years at least to let complexity come through. 100% whole cluster. Drink from 2027.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Adrianna Vineyard Malbec Fortuna Terrae is pure, floral, herbal and elegant on the nose, followed by a svelte, soft and richly textured palate enlivened with an increasingly electric core of acidity. It concludes with a solid, vibrant finish framed by refined, discreet tannins, gradually gaining length and dimension with time in the glass. This is a fantastic cornerstone of the upper echelon of Catena Zapata Malbecs and a lovely midpoint between the more lifted and ethereal River and the more sumptuous Mundus Bacillus Terrae bottlings.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

This elegant version leads with fresh lilac and mineral aromas. The palate is polished yet defined, with precise mineral tension to the generous core of cherry and Santa Rosa plum flavors. Subtle guava details chime in and everything seems to swell midpalate around fresh acidity and carry onto the finish around fine tannins. Drink now through 2040.

stolichnaya-gold.title: Stoli Gold Vodka
stolichnaya-gold.bodyHtml:
Stoli Gold is a premium vodka from Stoli Group, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is produced at the historic Latvijas Balzams distillery in Riga, Latvia, from grain spirit that Stoli says is sourced only from certified European producers, blended with pure artesian water. After a traditional chill filtration through quartz sand and activated birch charcoal, the vodka receives a final filtration through coils of gold thread, the step that gives Stoli Gold its name. According to the producer, the gold filter adds depth, softens the spirit and brings the liquid into harmony. It has a lightly fruity nose, apricot and vanilla soufflé on the palate and a long, creamy finish.

Nose: Lightly fruity.

Palate: Apricot and vanilla soufflé.

Finish: Long and creamy.

Serve: Well chilled and neat, or in a classic vodka Martini.

cherry-pie-tri-county-pinot-noir.title: Cherry Pie Tri-County Pinot Noir 2023
cherry-pie-tri-county-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Cherry Pie Tri-County shines ruby red with hints of darker crimson in the glass. On the nose, aromas of dried black cherry, mocha and a touch of cedar. On the palate, this wine showcases flavors of fresh plum, raspberry and dried herbs carried by a well-developed tannic structure. The velvety and luscious finish rounds out this medium bodied wine that perfectly pairs with duck confit, grilled salmon, or sautéed mushrooms.

indoggo-gin.title: Empress 1908 Indigo Gin
indoggo-gin.bodyHtml:
Empress 1908 Indigo Gin is a visually stunning and contemporary spirit, handcrafted in small batch copper pot stills and famous for its vibrant all-natural indigo hue. Infused with a unique blend of eight botanicals—including juniper, grapefruit peel, coriander, ginger, cinnamon, and a signature blend of black tea—its striking color comes entirely from the butterfly pea blossom. On the nose, it offers a bright, aromatic bouquet of soft citrus and earthy florals. The palate is elegant and crisp, delivering a delicate balance of traditional piney juniper, warm baking spices, and a subtle herbal sweetness. When mixed with tonic or citrus, the gin magically transforms from deep indigo to a soft, beautiful pink, making it as captivating to look at as it is to drink.

Food Pairing: The bright citrus and delicate floral profile of this gin make it a perfect match for light, fresh seafood like a classic shrimp cocktail, crab cakes, or a plate of fresh sushi and sashimi. It also pairs wonderfully with soft, creamy cheeses like brie or goat cheese served alongside fresh berries and artisanal crackers.

cardinale-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: Caymus Special Selection Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 1.5L Magnum
cardinale-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
The Caymus 'Special Selection' Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptional wine made from this storied Napa Valley estate. Following some time to open, this incredible Cabernet begins to yield profound aromatics of black cherry compote, blueberry pie and boysenberry along with creosote, black tar, milk chocolate and licorice all soaring from the glass. The mouthfeel is rich, voluptuous and intense, as this wine offers exceedingly dense, concentrated flavors of black cherry reduction, blueberry pie, raspberry liquor and boysenberry, alongside milk chocolate shavings and tar, all cascading on to the long mouth coating finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Lush and polished, with waves of cassis and blackberry compote pouring through, underscored by chocolate, espresso crema and roasted vanilla bean. Maintains a lush, velvety feel through the lengthy finish, where flashes of sweet tobacco and warm earth peek through. For the power Cabernet crowd. Best from 2024 through 2038.

turnbull-black-label-cabenret-sauvignon.title: Wynns Coonawara Estate Black Label Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
turnbull-black-label-cabenret-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Wynns Black Label Cabernet is a true icon of Australian wine. First produced in 1954, it has a reputation for ageing gracefully and displaying excellent varietal and regional characteristics. The wine is produced from only the top quality 20 to 25 per cent of Cabernet Sauvignon fruit grown in our terra rossa vineyards.

A wine of style and stature - and a perennial favourite in auction circles - ‘Black Label’ is one of Australia’s most collectable wines and Australia’s benchmark Cabernet Sauvignon. It consistently delivers potential for medium to long-term cellaring.

Our 2019 Cabernet is a perfect amalgam of freshness, balance and power that will certainly reward good cellaring. A seamless line of fruit from our terra rossa vineyards is
supported by a fine tannin framework. Flavours of red cherry and plum are complimented by the secondary notes of walnuts and mixed cooking spice. Very intense yet elegant.

Pairs well with Spicy grilled salmon with Coriander Salsa

93 Points - Gismondi

The Black Label Coonawarra Cab has been a forever classic and a pet project of winemaker Sue Hodder for decades. From the tiny sliver of land that is Coonawarra's red terra rossa (iron oxide clays over limestone), Hodder created this affordable benchmark from 50+ year old organically farmed vines, and in 2019, it was the 64th vintage of the iconic label. The fermentation runs a month in a mix of open and static fermenters before it ages 14 months in French oak (31% new) and a mix of 61/26/13/ hogsheads / barriques / vats. 2019 was a year to remember in Coonawarra, and its ripe cherry, mulberry, blackcurrants, crushed chalk, mint, seawater, and that Coonawarra dried herb styling in the finish tell an amazing story. It will age for decades, but it has the class and balance to be drunk anytime now.

tomatin-decades-ii.title: Tomatin Decades II 46% ABV
tomatin-decades-ii.bodyHtml: A limited-edition single malt from Tomatin, matured in a collection of 21 casks laid down over the past five decades, including casks that previously held Scotch whisky, bourbon and sherry, as well as re-charred French oak casks. Aromas of sweet pastry, wood shavings, cooked fruit and floral coconut fill the nose. The palate offers notes of Christmas cake, malt syrup, red berries, tropical fruits and wax.

bowmore-30-year-old-2021-release-1.title: Bowmore 30 Year Old 2021 Release
bowmore-30-year-old-2021-release-1.bodyHtml:
This 2021 bottling was distilled in 1989 and rested for 30 years in a combination of sherry hogsheads and bourbon barrels. This edition is matured in the legendary Bowmore No. 1 Vaults, and is selected from just two casks each year. At 45.1% ABV, and distilled in 1989, this rare single malt whisky has been gently nurtured for three decades in our finest Sherry Hogsheads and Bourbon Barrels. Defined by a rich fruity flavour, tropical and sweet with butterscotch notes, rounded by the unmistakable subtle peat smoke of Bowmore.

Only 2976 bottles/sets have been made worldwide.

For over 240 years, Bowmore Distillery has been capturing the essence of Islay from the shores of its remote island home. Shaped by the 'sand of time', our single malt harnesses the power of time itself, even single drop telling a story of the past, savoured in the present.

This is a single malt defined, shaped and crafted by time.

hennessy-xo-nba-edition.title: Hennessy XO Cognac x NBA Limited Edition
hennessy-xo-nba-edition.bodyHtml:
Fans around the world will be able to toast with the new exclusive Hennessy X.O. Limited Edition bottle, specially designed to commemorate the partnership between Hennessy and the NBA.

In 1870, Maurice Hennessy, a 4th-generation member of the Hennessy family, asked the Master Blender Emile Fillioux, a descendant of the Hennessy Master Blender Jean Fillioux, to create a special cognac for his family and friends, using long-aged eaux-de-vie to perfect the blend. They called it “X.O” for “Extra Old”, the original, and a legend was born.

Hennessy X.O attained international renown and contributed to the development of the category XO which is a gauge of uncompromising quality. Thanks to 150 years of meticulous know-how, Hennessy X.O remains as inspiring today as it was the day Hennessy first shared it with his inner circle. The powerful and balanced structure of Hennessy X.O carries the promise of an extremely long finish, with each drop an invitation to embark on a journey of the senses through seven tasting notes.

morgan-bay-chardonnay.title: Morgan Bay Cellars Chardonnay
morgan-bay-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Morgan Bay Cellars Chardonnay is an incredibly vibrant, fruit-forward, and smooth California white wine crafted for effortless, everyday enjoyment. Produced by Rutherford Wine Company, it opens with an inviting bouquet of crisp green apples, ripe Bosc pear, and juicy melon, seamlessly layered with subtle undertones of sweet vanilla and creamy, lightly toasted oak. On the palate, this medium-bodied Chardonnay displays a wonderfully round, silky texture, delivering refreshing stone fruit and tropical fruit flavors balanced by a clean, balanced, and mouthwatering finish.

Food Pairing: This buttery, crisp Chardonnay pairs beautifully with pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken breast with herbs, or a creamy garlic-and-mushroom pasta.

hennessy-vsop-nba-edition.title: Hennessy VS Cognac x LeBron James Limited Edition
hennessy-vsop-nba-edition.bodyHtml: A world favorite since 1865, Hennessy V.S. impresses for its roundness, strength and unrivaled versatility. A unique signature for an all-time great, now in a limited edition celebrating LeBron James's boundary-breaking life and career as a legend of the NBA.

decoy-red-blend.title: Decoy California Red 2022 750ml
decoy-red-blend.bodyHtml: This Red Blend features olive tapenade, dark plum and boysenberry, rich in dark fruit with a noticeable oak presence. Its smooth, round mouthfeel leads to a warm, toasty finish. Ideal for tapas with friends or rich pasta dinners, this blend enhances every bite.

villa-poggio-salvi-brunello-riserva-docg.title: Villa Poggio Salvi Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2019
villa-poggio-salvi-brunello-riserva-docg.bodyHtml:
Villa Poggio Salvi Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2019 pours an intense ruby red color with brilliant, deep garnet reflections in the glass. The highly sophisticated and complex bouquet opens with expressive aromas of ripe red cherries, wild forest berries, and sweet tobacco, layered with delicate secondary notes of licorice, dark chocolate, and roasted espresso beans. On the palate, this full-bodied, prestigious Tuscan red showcases a powerful yet harmonious structure driven by a distinct freshness and firm, tightly woven, evolving tannins. Classic flavors of dark stone fruit, savory herbs, and crushed gravel minerality seamlessly persist into a long, beautifully balanced, and deeply persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled Florentine steaks, slow-braised wild boar ragù, roasted rosemary lamb chops, or mature aged pecorino cheeses.

90 Points - James Suckling

Smoky and flowery nose here, with some funky notes to the red cherries and roses. The attack is firm and quite austere, with medium to full body, refreshing acidity and a slightly bitter finish. Drink or hold.

spier-frans-k-smit.title: Spier Frans K. Smit Red 2017
spier-frans-k-smit.bodyHtml:
Spier Frans K. Smit Red 2017 pours a beautiful royal berry-red color with shifting ruby highlights at the rim. The highly expressive bouquet opens with captivating aromas of ripe blackcurrants, dark plums, and black cherries, seamlessly layered with complex nuances of tobacco leaf, cocoa powder, warm spices, and a delicate hint of earthy truffle perfume. On the palate, this flagship, medium-to-full-bodied South African red wine delivers exceptional structural depth and a wonderfully velvety texture. Crafted by legendary winemaker Frans Smit as a pinnacle expression of Stellenbosch terroir, its pure, concentrated core of black fruits is masterfully framed by firm, assertive, yet beautifully rounded tannins and a vivid line of natural acidity. A sophisticated touch of sweet oak integration and a light trace of cigar box spice carry effortlessly into a dry, nutty, and remarkably long-lasting finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with rosemary-crusted grilled lamb chops, slow-smoked beef brisket, roasted venison loin, or a rich wild mushroom ragout.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Winemaker: Frans Smit. The CWG Auction's first certified organic wine, this blend of 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon is a surprising stunner. There's a lovely balance to the nose of this wine, with pronounced fruit aromas of black plum, berry and cherry that are supported by accents of tree bark, fruit leather, licorice, bramble and boysenberry. Each sniff unveils more to discover, from fruit to earth to soil and spice. Medium in weight, there's a purity and focus to the palate, balanced by a lovely subtle ripeness and licorice charge that fuels the finish. It's superbly balanced between the ripe fruit, structured tannins, ample acidity and a long, lingering, evolving finish. Lauren Buzzeo

91 Points - James Suckling

Attractive aromas of blackcurrants and black cherries with hints of nut shell, tobacco, cocoa and spices. Medium- to full-bodied with polished tannins and a velvety texture. Structured and tight, yet vivid at the same time. Dry, nutty finish. Sustainable. Drink or hold.

blackpool-spiced-rum.title: Lemon Hart Blackpool Spiced Rum
blackpool-spiced-rum.bodyHtml:
Lemon Hart Blackpool Spiced Rum is a spiced rum from Lemon Hart & Son, bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is a product of Guyana, and the label states that it is distilled, aged and blended in Guyana and names Demerara and Bourbon barrels among its marks. The producer describes Blackpool as a British-style, single estate distilled spiced rum in which the dried fruit, island spice and vanilla bean notes given by Bourbon barrel ageing are balanced with an all natural spiced infusion. It won the Chairman's Trophy at the Ultimate Spirits Challenge. Lemon Hart & Son traces its rum-making back to 1804 and suggests Blackpool over ice or mixed.

Tasting Notes: Dried fruit, baking spices and vanilla, with toffee, butterscotch and cocoa.

Palate: Exotic dried fruit and island spices (cinnamon, nutmeg, clove and ginger) over warm vanilla, developing toffee, butterscotch, cocoa and butter rum.

Finish: Gentle Bourbon oak and steeped tea.

Serve: Over ice, or mixed.

moosehead-radler-variety-pack-1.title: Moosehead Radler Mixed Pack 12 Cans
moosehead-radler-variety-pack-1.bodyHtml:
Moosehead Radler Mixed Pack 12 Cans is a variety pack of fruit-infused radlers produced by Canada's oldest independent brewery, Moosehead Breweries. Blending Moosehead’s signature lager with natural fruit juices, this pack offers a diverse assortment of light, fruit-forward flavors including Grapefruit, Strawberry Lemonade, Peach Mango, and Raspberry.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken, fresh summer salads, fish tacos, spicy sausages, fruit tarts, or light appetizers.

Tasting Notes : Varies by flavor, presenting a colorful, lightly effervescent appearance with a light-bodied, crisp, and refreshing mouthfeel.

Nose : Vibrant aromas of fresh citrus, ripe berries, stone fruits, and sweet lemon zests layered over a light malt background.

Palate : Sweet and tangy fruit flavors—grapefruit citrus, sweet strawberry lemonade, stone fruit peach mango, and tart raspberry—balanced by a crisp lager base.

Finish : Clean, bright, and refreshing with lingering sweet fruit notes and a dry finish.

Serve : Serve well-chilled directly from the can or poured into a pint glass.

ridge-lytton-springs-zinfandel.title: Ridge Lytton Springs Red Blend 2022
ridge-lytton-springs-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Ridge Lytton Springs Red Blend 2022 is an iconic, full-bodied heritage field blend crafted by Ridge Vineyards from old-vine plantings in Sonoma County's Dry Creek Valley. Marking its 50th anniversary release, this wine is fermented on native yeasts and aged in 100% American oak barrels. In the glass, it yields an intense ruby color with vibrant aromas of boysenberry, wild blackberry, purple flowers, cigar box, and sage. The palate is rich, seamless, and finely structured, offering flavors of dark plum, black cherry, dark chocolate, licorice, and black pepper supported by supple, powdery tannins and lively acidity that extend into a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with slow-cooked lamb stew, barbecued pork ribs, grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The densely packed nose of this legendary old vine field blend of Zin, Petite Sirah, Carignane, and Alicante gives aromas of crushed blackberry, purple flowers and rich earthy spices, while the palate brings black cherry, olive and licorice flavors in a framework of opulent tannin that will age effortlessly for more than a decade.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The densely packed nose of this legendary old-vine field blend of Zin, Petite Sirah, Carignan and Alicante gives aromas of crushed blackberry, purple flowers and rich earthy spices. The palate brings black cherry, olive and licorice flavors in a framework of opulent tannin that will age effortlessly for more than a decade.

95 Points - James Suckling

This is the kingpin of Ridge’s Sonoma County heritage blends and it doesn’t disappoint. Equal parts fruity, spicy and savory on a full body braced by moderate tannins. Judicious oak spices like cedar and cigar box complement pure, ripe blackberries and raspberries and a dash of black pepper. Known to age well for decades.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Like a beast that's been tamed, this red is genteel and polished on the outside but dark and fervent deep down, with expressive flavors of blackberry, briar patch, savory anise and pepper. Zinfandel, Petite Sirah, Carignane and Alicante Bouschet.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Lytton Springs 50th Anniversary is composed of 67% Zinfandel, 19% Petite Sirah, 11% Carignane and 3% Alicante Bouschet. It opens with initial touches of glossy new American oak—dill and toasted coconut—and gives way to kaleidoscopic black and red plums, cherries and berries, plus accents of hibiscus and potpourri. The full-bodied palate features generous, spicy flavors. It’s structured by abundant, powdery tannins and lively acidity and has a long, detailed finish. Winemaker Shauna Rosenblum says this 2022 was crafted using only American oak, a shift from the blend of French and American oak used in the past. It has resulted in a particularly pure, transparent expression that opens dramatically with air, and this 2022 Lytton Springs will benefit from several years in the cellar.

pahlmeyer-red.title: Pahlmeyer Proprietary Red 2021
pahlmeyer-red.bodyHtml:
The Pahlmeyer Proprietary Red captures the essence of this stellar low-yielding vintage: powerful yet refined, intense yet luscious. Aromas of lingonberry and boysenberry interplay with flickerings of green peppercorn, saddle leather, and forest floor, culminating in a beautifully lifted bouquet. The tightly wound palate frames a core of intense plum and cassis layered with licorice spice. Polished tannins give way to a mid-palate rich with macerated blackberry and freshly grated nutmeg. This articulate, broad-shouldered blend is poised to evolve gracefully over the next two decades.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Proprietary Red blends estate fruit from Stagecoach (37%) and the Pahlmeyer Estate Vineyard (24%) with purchased elements from Upper Range (34%) and Vangone (5%). The varietal composition is 87% Cabernet Sauvignon, 8% Merlot, 2% Malbec, 2% Petit Verdot and 1% Cabernet Franc. Aging 18 months in 94% new French oak, it will be bottled unfined and unfiltered. Right now, it offers compelling fruit-driven aromas of ripe cherries, cassis, and blueberries—the oak is well concealed. Full-bodied and rich, this is dense and velvety on the palate, with a long, mouthwatering finish, despite an ample amount of dusty tannins.

97 Points - James Suckling

This gentle giant is the original Pahlmeyer red, first made in 1986. It’s always cabernet sauvignon dominant, and this year is 89%, plus 9% merlot and dashes of malbec and petit verdot. Lush with fruit and subtle spices, packed with blackcurrant, spearmint, cocoa and graphite flavors that swell on the palate and linger on the finish. So layered, intricate, supple and well structured for long aging.

 96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A sophisticated red blend with command of its style, this wine brings Cabernet Sauvignon together with the attributes of Merlot, Petit Verdot, and Malbec to deliver savory flavors of blue and black fruits, graphite and gravel, lifted by a waft of violet and fresh herbs. The tannins are abundant while approachable, balanced by persistent acidity that creates an upright structure and welcoming presentation. Delicious.

 92 Points - Wine Spectator

A hyperripe, polished style, offering creamy flavors of plum, boysenberry and blackberry puree laced with melted licorice and mocha notes. Cruises through steadily but is a touch shy on energy, giving this a frankly hefty feel. For fans of the maximum-impact style. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Best from 2025 through 2036.

still-austin-straight-bourbon-cask-stren.title: Still Austin Cask Strength Bourbon
still-austin-straight-bourbon-cask-stren.bodyHtml:
Still Austin’s Cask Strength Bourbon Whiskey, day becomes night as “The Musician” plays against a starry sky; the darker colors representing the more intense experience of the limited edition spirit.

Nose brandied cherries with fresh muddled mint, old fashioned blackberry cobbler with biscuit crust, and cinnamon toast in brown butter. notes of grilled peaches drizzled with balsamic vinegar, butterscotch pecan pie, and dark brown sugar waves of rye spice, nutmeg, and clove.  59% ABV

Mash bill: 70% Corn / 25% Rye / 5% Malted Barley

This deeper, more “metal” version of our beloved Straight Bourbon is made from a select blend of choice barrels, and bottled at a grow-hair-on-your-chest 118 proof.

In an act of masterful artistry, our distillers were able to combine power and subtlety into one gorgeous spirit.

Because of the demand for this magnificent juice we’ve decided to make it available year-round.

banff-ave-ride-or-dry-2.title: Banff Ave Ride Or Dry 6 Cans

lemon-hart-rum-2.title: Lemon Hart 151 Demerara Rum
lemon-hart-rum-2.bodyHtml:
Lemon Hart 151 is an overproof Demerara rum bottled at 75.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is distilled, aged and blended in Guyana from select high-proof Demerara rums to a long-established recipe, and the label lists bourbon as the barrel type. The label carries the date 1804 and recalls the origins of Lemon Hart & Son in London as a supplier of rum to the British Royal Navy. Called for by name in many classic tiki recipes from Trader Vic and Don the Beachcomber, it is widely treated as the benchmark overproof rum for tropical drinks, valued for the depth and strength it brings to a mixed drink.

Tasting Notes: Deep amber and mahogany in colour; balanced, round and velvety, with raw brown sugar, dried fruit, burnt caramel, exotic spice, vanilla and baked apple over gentle oak.

Finish: Warm, lingering, complex and smooth.

Serve: Use in small measures in tiki cocktails or as a float; the very high strength calls for careful handling.

chappellet-pritchard-hill-cabernet.title: Chappellet Pritchard Hill Estate Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
chappellet-pritchard-hill-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Embodying the essence of great mountain-grown Cabernet Sauvignon, and the majestic terroir of Pritchard Hill, this wine displays epic depth and complexity. Pure, intense aromas of blackberry, cassis, perfumed violets, graphite, and macerated berry skins leap from the glass, followed by layers of anise, vanilla, clove, and dark chocolate. The luxurious berry and spice notes continue on the palate, where polished, mouth-filling tannins and a powerful structure add gravitas to the deep, rich flavors, carrying the wine to a resonating dark berry and mocha finish.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Pritchard Hill is composed of 90% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Petit Verdot. It was aged in 100% new French oak for 22 months. The alcohol weighed in at 14.5%. Deep garnet-purple in color, it charges out of the gate with bold expressions of warm cassis, wild blueberries and black raspberries, plus hints of chocolate box, menthol, tapenade, smoked meats and pencil lead. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is bursting with vibrant black fruits, framed by fantastically ripe, fine-grained tannins and lovely freshness, finishing long and mineral laced.
96 Points - James Suckling
Blue fruit with boysenberry and floral aromas. Cassis, too. It’s full-bodied, yet very tight and toned on the palate with fine tannins that are formed and polished. A classic wine. Give this three or four years to soften. Best after 2024.

crystal-head-vodka-onyx.title: Crystal Head Vodka Onyx
crystal-head-vodka-onyx.bodyHtml:
Onyx is a unique new expression of Crystal Head Vodka, crafted from premium Blue Weber agave and sourced from a single farm in Mexico.

The bottle with its luxurious black finish and matching crest debossed cap, is a celebration of the powerful warrior crystal, Onyx. Sharing its powers of intuition, focus, positivity and protection to those who keep it close. Onyx holds connection to our earth with its protective energy allowing in no light. Onyx combines all colours of the spectrum and is said to absorb negativity; the darker the stone, the more energy it holds. Crafted from Blue Weber agave, Onyx acts as a symbol of the human journey. It is a focus on positivity, calling on one’s inner creative spirit. Like all Crystal Head expressions, Onyx is blended with the purest water from Newfoundland, Canada. This gives the final product a clean and semi-sweet finish. Staying true to Crystal Head values, Onyx does not contain any oils, sugars or additives.

Fresh green grass nuanced white pepper and hints of citrus on the nose. Soft and smooth with a touch of spice and sweetness which develop into the subtle, yet unmistakable earthy grip of agave. A medium finish of green grass, pepper and citrus.

krug-grande-cuvee-1.title: Krug Grande Cuvee Brut 375ml
krug-grande-cuvee-1.bodyHtml:
Krug Grande Cuvée 170ème Édition is a non-vintage champagne known for its complexity and elegance. It's a blend of 195 different wines from 12 years, ranging from 2014 to 1998, with 51% Pinot Noir, 38% Chardonnay, and 11% Meunier. This blend gives the champagne a rich, balanced profile with notes of ripe fruit, citrus, and pastry cream, complemented by hints of warm spices and toasted bread. 

This Champagne can be enjoyed as an aperitif with Jabugo ham and mature comté or served to accompany oysters, grilled shrimps, Indian or Moroccan food, as well as desserts such as carrot cake, tarte tatin and cheesecake.

waterford-luna-1-1.title: Waterford Biodynamic Luna 1.1 Irish Single Malt Whisky
waterford-luna-1-1.bodyHtml: Biodynamic: Luna – the world’s first whisky made from biodynamic barley. As part of our pioneering quest to unearth whisky’s most natural flavours, we have introduced the radical biodynamic farming philosophy, as lauded by many of the world’s legendary winemakers, to the conservative whisky industry. The bottling is the latest whisky in our Arcadian Series, which showcases the flavours produced by forgotten ways of farming and rare barley varieties.

macallan-30-year-old-double-cask.title: The Macallan 30 Year Old Double Cask
macallan-30-year-old-double-cask.bodyHtml:
The Macallan Double Cask 30 Years Old, aged for thirty years in a harmonious union of American and European oak sherry seasoned casks, to create a unique taste and character.

A perfectly balanced single malt matured for 30 years in sherry seasoned American and European oak casks. The Double Cask range tells the story of an incredible wood journey, from the vast green forests of northern Spain and the French Pyrenees and the lush forests of Ohio, Missouri and Kentucky, to create the perfect harmony.

This release showcases our unwavering commitment to uncompromised excellence as oak influence is the single greatest contributor to the quality, natural colour and distinctive aromas and flavours of our single malt whiskies.

carpineto-vino-nobile-di-montepulciano.title: Carpineto Vino Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva 2020
carpineto-vino-nobile-di-montepulciano.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Carpineto Vino Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva is a sophisticated and powerful expression of one of Tuscany's most historic appellations. It displays a brilliant ruby red colour with garnet reflections. The nose is intense and ethereal, offering a complex bouquet of ripe cherries and forest berries, elegantly layered with sophisticated notes of vanilla, violets, and tobacco from extended oak aging. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dry, and exceptionally well-structured, showcasing a velvety texture and firm, polished tannins. A vibrant line of acidity provides perfect balance to its rich fruit core, leading to a long, persistent finish marked by savory spice and a refined mineral undertone.

Food Pairing: Perfectly matches with roasted red meats, wild boar ragù, herb-crusted lamb, and aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano or Parmigiano-Reggiano.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Aromas and flavors of leather, tobacco and autumn woods augment the fading notes of cherry and plum in this maturing red. Dense, dusty tannins hang around the finish, yet this shows balance in a beefy, muscular way. Sangiovese and Canaiolo. Best from 2026 through 2040.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Blackberries provide pop on an otherwise savory, umami nose of coffee grinds, hot tires, top soil and pepper. The pepper, earth and berry elements swell on the palate before evolving smoothly into a long, spicy finish of warm citrus and mocha.

murrieta-ygay-gran-reserva-especial-rioj.title: Marques de Murrieta Castillo Ygay Gran Reserva Especial 2011
murrieta-ygay-gran-reserva-especial-rioj.bodyHtml:
An infinite and complex range of aromas define this Castillo Ygay 2011 that evokes aromas of ripe cherry, blueberries and cassis with refined touches of scrubland, Mediterranean herbs, black pepper, cloves and mocha. Balance defines this wine vintage after vintage; lively on the palate as well as enveloping and harmonious. With silky tannins and a long, elegant finish.

Blend: 84% Tempranillo,16% Mazuelo

2011 Vintage Ratings

98 Points - James Suckling

Extremely well-mannered, traditional character to this, showing layer upon layer of savory complexity on the nose, with iron, dried meat, tobacco, balsamic fruit, dried red berries, orange peel, leather and dried mushrooms. A medium-to full-bodied, linear and zesty Rioja that’s full of nuanced flavors that linger through the very long, savory finish. Floral, too. Yet, it remains bright and precise.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Deep violet-red to the eye, this wine has a nose of raspberry, white chocolate and juniper berry. Still youthful on the palate, it offers ever-present tannins supporting flavors of dark plum, black cherry, caramel and violet that slowly fade into a soft cherry-pie finish.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2011 Castillo Ygay Gran Reserva Especial was produced with a blend of 84% Tempranillo and 16% Mazuelo (Cariñena) from a plot called La Plana that was planted in 1950 at 485 meters in altitude, the highest in the Ygay property. The grapes were picked between September 17 and 22, and the Mazuelo was later, on September 28. The bunches were destemmed and lightly crushed and put to ferment in stainless steel for 11 days with constant pump-overs and punch-downs. The Tempranillo matured for 28 months in American oak barrels and the Mazuelo for 28 months in French barriques. It's 14% alcohol and has a pH of 3.65 with 5.6 grams of acidity (measured in tartaric acid per liter). It's very tough to follow a vintage like 2010, and 2011 was not an easy year; the wine is possibly more powerful and concentrated but keeping the freshness, with a longer élevage but very young and lively, with an elegant texture and mouthfeel, great balance and elegance. The wine feels lively, and it seems impossible that it has been in bottle for over six years. It has the classical profile with the effect of the American oak barrels, cigar box, cedar wood, sweet spices—aromatic, intoxicating, complex. This should age very slowly and for a very long time. 131,668 bottles produced. It was bottled in February 2016. No 2013, 2014 or 2015 will be produced. They have a 2012, and they will jump from that to 2016. The 2012 will be released in late 2023 or early 2024 and the 2016 in 2027 or 2028. Finger crossed...

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This polished red shows lots of depth, with cola-lined notes of glossy dark cherry and black olive hedged with wild herb, anise, loamy earth, mocha and clove. Refined, harmonious and expressive.

chateau-smith-haut-lafitte-rouge.title: Chateau Smith Haut Lafitte 2023
chateau-smith-haut-lafitte-rouge.bodyHtml:
A distinguished Pessac-Leognan red with aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, plum, graphite, cedar, and subtle tobacco. Concentrated fruit, polished tannins, and mineral freshness create a powerful yet elegant palate with impressive complexity, balance, and a persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef tenderloin, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, grilled ribeye, truffle dishes, aged Comte, or wild mushrooms.
98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2023 Château Smith Haut Lafitte offers black currants, smoky tobacco, graphite and subtle espresso. Composed of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 23% Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc and 1% Petit Verdot, it is medium- to full-bodied with impressive concentration and focus. Ripe tannins provide structure, while chalky minerality and freshness define the finish. Beautifully balanced and exceptionally pure.

98 Points - James Suckling

Currant, tobacco and hazelnut aromas lead into a medium-bodied palate with vibrant, crunchy fruit and attractive open-grained, velvety tannins. Graceful, fresh and beautifully composed, it combines immediate appeal with excellent underlying structure. From biodynamically grown grapes, the blend is 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 23% Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc and 1% Petit Verdot. Best from 2028 onward.

97 Points - Decanter

Dark and intensely fragrant, with roses and floral notes introducing a cool, fresh profile. The substantial palate combines powdery tannins with juicy fruit, mint, graphite, wet stone, herbs, cocoa and licorice. More muscular and streamlined than typically suave expressions of Smith Haut Lafitte, it nevertheless retains finesse, freshness and tension. Chewy strawberry and cranberry notes add further complexity to this structured, age-worthy wine. 

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Smith Haut Lafitte offers aromas of licorice, spices, dark berries, rose petals and clove. Medium- to full-bodied, dense and precisely structured, it possesses a fleshy, concentrated core surrounded by abundant yet seamlessly integrated tannins. A long, mineral and penetrating finish reinforces its impressive potential for extended cellaring.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Bold and generously styled, with mocha and bittersweet cocoa leading into plum reduction, blackberry preserves and melted black licorice. Roasted vanilla, chestnut and sweet tobacco enrich the finish, while an earthy, loamy element provides balance and structure. A powerful blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot.

1884-presidents-blend-malbec.title: Escorihuela Gascon The President's Blend 2019 750ml
1884-presidents-blend-malbec.bodyHtml:
The President’s Blend is our iconic blend made with three varieties marked by a strong identity: Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Syrah. It results from the search and accomplishment of refined elegance and outstanding precision in the blend.

93 Points James Suckling

opus-one.title: Opus One 2007 750ml
opus-one.bodyHtml:
Providing ideal weather for both budbreak and veraison, the 2007 growing season was picture perfect until late August, when a unique combination of extremes subverted the prospect of a quick and early harvest. A heat spell, unseasonably cool temperatures, rain and the threat of frost posed an unusual challenge for Opus One's harvesting crews. During the 21 days of crush, the crews worked 12 night harvests, delivering the first fruit on September 4th and the last on October 17th.

Reminiscent of the generous 2001 vintage in style and structure, the 2007 shows very high color intensity with aromas of cassis, nutmeg, raspberries, cola, fresh oats, dark chocolate and forest floor. Polished, supple and harmoniously precise, the 2007 fuses a seamless mid-palate with soft yet sinewy tannins. The wine will age effortlessly for decades.

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

I loved the 2007 Opus One, which certainly brings another level of richness and opulence compared to previous vintages. Cassis, lavender, dried flowers, and cedar are just some of its nuances, and this full-bodied, deep, velvety, uber-sexy 2007 is drinking perfectly today. It shows the ripe, up-front style of the vintage while staying nicely balanced. 

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate 

Two of the strongest wines ever made at Opus One, the 2007 has terrific black currant fruit, licorice, incense, and subtle smoke, an opulent, even voluptuous mouthfeel, dazzling purity and texture, and a skyscraper-like mouthfeel. This is a sensational Opus One, with sweet tannin and impressive precision and depth. It can be drunk now or cellared for 25+ years.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Tight and firm, with a chewy edge to the dried currant, graphite, blackberry and mineral notes. Full-bodied and intense, without being weighty, this is well-structured in a Bordeaux-like manner, ending with a complex, persistent finish. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Best from 2012 through 2022.

carolans-finest-irish-cream.title: Carolans Irish Cream Liqueur 1.14L
carolans-finest-irish-cream.bodyHtml:
Carolans Irish Cream Liqueur (1.14L) is the original Carolans, developed in Ireland in 1978 and named after the 17th-century Irish harpist Turlough O'Carolan. It blends Irish whiskey and Irish spirits with farm-fresh Irish cream and naturally harvested honey, the ingredient that sets it apart from other cream liqueurs. The result is rich and silky, with toffee, vanilla and honey flavours. Carolans has grown into one of the largest Irish cream brands in the world, and won Platinum at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition in 2025 for the second year running. Bottled at 17% ABV in a 1.14L bottle.

Tasting Notes: Silky and smooth.

Nose: Toffee, vanilla and honey.

Palate: Creamy and silky, with toffee, vanilla and honey.

Serve: On the rocks, in coffee, or in dessert cocktails.

vogue-musigny-vielles-vignes-grand-cru.title: Louis Jadot Musigny Grand Cru 2020
vogue-musigny-vielles-vignes-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Musigny Grand Cru 2020 is an exceptionally rare Grand Cru Chardonnay offering aromas of citrus, white flowers, orchard fruit, hazelnut, and subtle spice. The palate is rich yet precise with vibrant acidity, layered minerality, remarkable depth, and an extraordinarily long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with lobster, turbot, scallops, roasted poultry, creamy seafood dishes, and aged Comte.

ken-wright-willamette-valley-pinot-noir.title: Ken Wright Cellars Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2024
ken-wright-willamette-valley-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: The 2024 Ken Wright Cellars Willamette Valley Pinot Noir is a quintessential regional blend that serves as a vibrant introduction to the vintage and the diverse terroirs of the valley. This bottling is artfully crafted by combining fruit from various prestigious vineyard sites, balancing the bright red fruit and floral notes of volcanic soils with the darker fruit and structural depth found in marine sedimentary sites. Expect an expressive bouquet of fresh raspberry, wild strawberry, and Rainier cherry, accented by delicate hints of violet and savory spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and beautifully balanced, featuring the silky tannins and refreshing acidity that are hallmarks of Ken Wright's winemaking style. It is designed for early enjoyment while maintaining the elegance and purity characteristic of high-quality Oregon Pinot Noir.

salon-le-mesnil.title: Salon Le Mesnil Blanc De Blancs Brut Champagne 750ml

egans-irish-whiskey-vintage-grain-2009.title: Egan's Vintage Grain 2009 Single Grain Irish Whiskey
egans-irish-whiskey-vintage-grain-2009.bodyHtml:
Egan's Vintage Grain 2009 is a single grain Irish whiskey from Egan's of Tullamore, a family whiskey business established in 1852. Each Vintage Grain release is hand-selected by Jonathan V. Egan of the family's sixth generation, and this one was distilled in 2009 and matured in American oak bourbon barrels for at least eight years. It is bottled at 46% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is packed with fruit and spice, and the brand calls Vintage Grain a truly unique Irish whiskey expression.

Serve: Neat or over a large ice cube.

jura-seven-wood.title: Jura Seven Wood
jura-seven-wood.bodyHtml:
The ability of Jura’s tiny island community to reimagine and reinvent has allowed our distillery to thrive. Such vision has brought to life this complex single malt - a fitting tribute to our Master Blender’s skill. Thanks to the forestry commission, sawmill and cooperage in France, we use the finest virgin French oak casks to enhance our whisky.

Layers of complexity and flavour emerge from a maturation journey that begins in American White Oak ex bourbon casks before a portion of the whisky is split between six different virgin oak casks sourced from across various regions of France.

The result is a fruity and spicy whisky with flavours of crème caramel, baked peach and sweet liquorice.

lost-poet-red-blend.title: Lost Poet 2021 750ml
lost-poet-red-blend.bodyHtml: Succulent, plush flavors charm your senses in this juicy red blend. Bursting with luscious notes of red fruit, bacon, and bell pepper, this love potion will win over your taste buds. Fill your heart and your glass with the perfect dose of romance.

remy-martin-louis-xiii-cognac.title: Louis XIII Cognac Time Collection: Tribute to City of Lights 1900
remy-martin-louis-xiii-cognac.bodyHtml:
The cognac inside our limited-edition Tribute to City of Lights – 1900 decanter is made from a unique blend of the finest and most precious eaux-de-vie from grapes grown in the exceptional terroir of Cognac Grande Champagne. The specially selected eaux-de-vie are aged slowly in Limousin oak casks called tierçons before being expertly blended to create our signature cognac. Containing aged eaux-de-vie, each one carefully watched over by generations of Cellar Master, every drop of LOUIS XIII cognac represents decades of craftsmanship and know-how, resulting in a unique taste of time that will be similar in the next century.

The LOUIS XIII City of Lights – 1900 special edition is presented in a limited series of 2,000 numbered decanters. The decanter is based on the distinctive design, inspired by a 16th-century flask uncovered from the site of the Battle of Jarnac, and later owned by LOUIS XIII founder, Paul-Émile Rémy Martin.

Hand crafted by skilled artisans, the City of Lights – 1900 decanter features 13 dentelle spikes rather than the usual 10, seven fleur-de-lys in 18ct gold and a central medallion. A limited-edition stopper takes the form of an upturned decanter, and incorporates NFC technology that allows you to register your decanter with the LOUIS XIII Society, and receive a unique numbered medal minted by the Monnaie de Paris.

jura-journey.title: Jura Seven Wood
jura-journey.bodyHtml:
The ability of Jura’s tiny island community to reimagine and reinvent has allowed our distillery to thrive. Such vision has brought to life this complex single malt - a fitting tribute to our Master Blender’s skill. Thanks to the forestry commission, sawmill and cooperage in France, we use the finest virgin French oak casks to enhance our whisky.

Layers of complexity and flavour emerge from a maturation journey that begins in American White Oak ex bourbon casks before a portion of the whisky is split between six different virgin oak casks sourced from across various regions of France.

The result is a fruity and spicy whisky with flavours of crème caramel, baked peach and sweet liquorice.

tamnavulin-sherry-cask.title: Tamnavulin Sherry Cask Edition
tamnavulin-sherry-cask.bodyHtml:
Matured in American Oak Barrels and enhanced by a finesse in three different Sherry casks. A classic revelation from the Speyside Valley.

Colour - Amber gold.

Nose - A bouquet marked by freshly baked tarte tatin and vanilla pod, soon giving way to another level of charm as nuances of banana, caramelised orange and fresh ginger completes this tapestry of temptation.

Palate - Warm and inviting. The palate detects an avalanche of exotic flavours, glazed nectarines and frangipane, shortly enlightened by hints of sticky toffee pudding, Demerara sugar and Seville oranges.

Finish - Complex and rich. Fruit cake, over ripe apricots.

no-boats-cold-brew-iced-tea-1.title: Cold Lake Brewing Hard Iced Tea Box Cls
no-boats-cold-brew-iced-tea-1.bodyHtml: Cold Lake Brewing Hard Iced Tea Box Cls

no-boats-wild-strawberry-rhubarb-1.title: No Boats Wild Strawberry Rhubarb 6 Cans

old-forester-1898.title: Old Forester 1897 Bottled-in-Bond
old-forester-1898.bodyHtml: Old Forester 1897 Bottled in Bond is crafted to honor a watershed moment in bourbon history – the U.S. Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. This expression follows the Bottled in Bond standards that whisky must be aged in a federally bonded warehouse for at least four years, the product of one distillation season, one distiller and from one distillery and bottled at 100 Proof. The concept behind these regulations – the idea of ‘sealed in quality’ – was something Old Forester introduced in 1870, as America’s First Bottled Bourbon.

zaya-cocobana-1.title: Zaya Cocobana
zaya-cocobana-1.bodyHtml:
Zaya Cocobana is a blend of rums aged up to 16 years from Trinidad and Tobago, subtly flavoured with natural cocoa, banana and a touch of spice. It is golden amber in the glass and works both for sipping and for cocktails. Bottled at 40% ABV, 750ml.

Nose: Delicate, with ripe banana, citrus, tropical fruit and aromatic spice.

Palate: Subtle vanilla with banana, dark chocolate, cinnamon and black pepper.

Finish: Creamy and smooth, reminiscent of banana bread.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in rum cocktails.

o-leflaive-auxey-duresses-1.title: Olivier Leflaive Auxey-Duresses 2022
o-leflaive-auxey-duresses-1.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Olivier Leflaive Auxey-Duresses is a high-quality Chardonnay from the Côte de Beaune, crafted by one of Burgundy's most respected producers. Sourced from vineyards near the prestigious slopes of Meursault, it is known for its purity and finesse. The nose is fresh and precise, offering aromas of crisp green apple, fresh almond, and citrus zest, complemented by delicate floral hints and a touch of toastiness from 12 months of oak aging. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied yet soft, showcasing a silky texture beautifully balanced by lively acidity and a pronounced mineral character. The finish is long, elegant, and slightly saline, reflecting the unique calcareous clay and limestone terroir of the estate. 

Food Pairing: Perfectly complements grilled seafood, fish cooked in hot sauces, shrimp bisque, chicken gnocchi, or a sheep’s cheese like Ossau-Iraty.

o-leflaive-meursault-1.title: Olivier Leflaive Meursault 2021 750ml
o-leflaive-meursault-1.bodyHtml:
Bill Nanson - Burgundy Report
A good and classic, slightly spiced Meursault nose. Some gas, but nothing that hides the fullflavoured delicious wine – also classically Meursault and absolutely excellent! Lovely finishing – so delicious. Bravo!

o-leflaive-meursault-1er-cru-genevieres-.title: Olivier Leflaive Meursault 1er Cru Genevrieres 2018 750ml
o-leflaive-meursault-1er-cru-genevieres-.bodyHtml:
Bill Nanson - Burgundy Report
Ooh, directly an open an inviting nose with a small reductive touch and a finely granular spice. The spice on the palate, the freshness in the mouth – the last wine is more about contemplation compared to the dancing energy of this one. Bravo!

o-leflaive-puligny-montrachet-enseignere.title: Olivier Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet Blanc 2022
o-leflaive-puligny-montrachet-enseignere.bodyHtml:
Olivier Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet Blanc 2022 pours a bright, pale straw color with subtle silver reflections in the glass. The highly expressive and harmonious bouquet opens with inviting aromatics of fresh citrus zest, crisp green apple, and white orchard blossoms, layered with delicate nuances of toasted almonds, light spice, and wet stone minerality. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied white Burgundy showcases an exceptionally sleek frame and vibrant structure. A concentrated core of stone fruit and lemon curd is masterfully balanced by a refreshing, mouthwatering line of natural acidity and well-integrated French oak accents. Maturation on its fine lees imparts a textured, silky mouthfeel that glides into a remarkably persistent, clean, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared sea scallops in a citrus butter sauce, poached Dover sole, or a classic French roasted chicken with herbs.

94 Points - James Suckling

It shows a rather quiet, restrained fruit character as well as great harmony and seamlessness. Fermented in 20% new oak, alive with good acidity and highlighted by light toast, almond and mineral accents that add complexity. Medium- to full-bodied and quite well structured. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

This white is about finesse, with a lithe frame and vibrant structure setting the stage for apple, lemon and hazelnut flavors. Evolves to the long aftertaste, picking up mineral and baking spice notes, showing excellent length and balance. Best from 2026 through 2033.

o-leflaive-santenay-1.title: Olivier Leflaive Santenay Rouge 2018 750ml
o-leflaive-santenay-1.bodyHtml:
This wine shows an earthy but fresh nose which evolves into fruity glimpses on the palate. The flavors' weight, from light to medium, contribute to a beautiful balance and length, one of the best in its range.

Ideal with caramelized poultry or cheese such as Cîteaux and Bleu de Bresse.

cragganmore-12-year-old-2.title: Cragganmore 12 Year Old Single Malt Whisky
cragganmore-12-year-old-2.bodyHtml:
The Speyside representative of the Classic Malts series is rich and spicy, with a very satisfying complexity and well-sherried backbone.

A sherried 12 year old single malt from Diageo's Classic Malts range, this bottling from the Cragganmore distillery represents Speyside and proffers a rich, slightly floral whisky with barley notes.

smirnoff-ice-peach-lemonade-1.title: Smirnoff Peach Vodka
smirnoff-ice-peach-lemonade-1.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Peach is infused with the natural flavor of juicy peaches for a sweet and fruity taste. This spirit has a pleasant sweetness and pairs best with soda water, lemonade, or iced tea. Smirnoff Peach is Kosher Certified and gluten free.

smirnoff-vodka-soda-berry-blast-1.title: Smirnoff Vodka Soda Berry Blast 6 Cans

smirnoff-ice-lemonade-variety-pack-1.title: Smirnoff Ice Lemonade Variety Pack 12 Cans

tomatin-sauternes-cask-1.title: Tomatin Portuguese Collection 2006 15 Year Old Moscatel Cask
tomatin-sauternes-cask-1.bodyHtml:
Part of a trip of whiskies released in the Portugese Collection, this 15 year old Tomatin was originally filled into cask in 2006, and was finished for 7 years in Moscatel casks before bottling at 46%. 

About the Portuguese Collection

"The Portuguese Collection expressions were each distilled on 8th September 2006 and laid down in traditional Scotch Whisky oak casks for over 8 years. On 23rd April 2015 the whisky was then moved into Tawny Port, Moscatel de Setúbal and Madeira Wine casks for a further 7 years, resulting in a magnificent triad of single malt Scotch Whiskies."

Sweet aromas of marmalade, honey and salted caramel with a hint of citrus balance perfectly with ginger and star anise on the palate. A sweet whisky with a long, dessert wine finish.

tomatin-cognac-cask-1.title: Tomatin Portuguese Collection 2006 15 Year Old Moscatel Cask
tomatin-cognac-cask-1.bodyHtml:
Part of a trip of whiskies released in the Portugese Collection, this 15 year old Tomatin was originally filled into cask in 2006, and was finished for 7 years in Moscatel casks before bottling at 46%.
