"The Portuguese Collection expressions were each distilled on 8th September 2006 and laid down in traditional Scotch Whisky oak casks for over 8 years. On 23rd April 2015 the whisky was then moved into Tawny Port, Moscatel de Setúbal and Madeira Wine casks for a further 7 years, resulting in a magnificent triad of single malt Scotch Whiskies."

Sweet aromas of marmalade, honey and salted caramel with a hint of citrus balance perfectly with ginger and star anise on the palate. A sweet whisky with a long, dessert wine finish.

michael-david-winery-6th-sense-syrah.title: Michael David Winery 6th Sense Syrah 2022
michael-david-winery-6th-sense-syrah.bodyHtml:
Michael David Winery 6th Sense Syrah 2022 is a bold, deeply concentrated, and full-bodied California red wine produced by Michael David Winery in the Lodi region. Visually displaying a deep ruby-violet hue, it opens with rich, expressive aromas of blackberry compote, black cherry, dark plum, and espresso grounds, beautifully layered with nuances of black pepper, clove, tobacco, and toasted vanilla oak. On the palate, it delivers a plush, mouth-filling mouthfeel with robust dark fruit flavors and a subtle hint of chocolate mocha, supported by ripe, velvety tannins and balanced acidity that lead to a long, warm, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, slow-cooked barbecue pork ribs, roasted lamb chops, smoked brisket, spicy Italian sausage, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The wine is remarkably concentrated, with aromas of huckleberry and blackberry, as well as notes of toasty oak and dried florals on the nose. The flavors are dark raspberry, orange, vanilla cream, clove, and dried tobacco, leading to grippy tannins on the finish. Decant and Enjoy.

girard-cabernet-napa-valley.title: Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
girard-cabernet-napa-valley.bodyHtml:
Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is a rich, elegant, and full-bodied red wine from California's renowned Napa Valley. Crafted with carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine showcases the region's exceptional winemaking heritage and Beaulieu Vineyard's commitment to quality. It offers concentrated dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, and subtle oak influences, creating a beautifully balanced and sophisticated drinking experience. With its smooth texture, layered complexity, and lingering finish, this Cabernet Sauvignon is an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining, or enjoying with a hearty meal.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, barbecue, hearty pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses such as cheddar and Gouda.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Focused and brilliant flavors of red and black cherries and black currants drive this sleek and powerful wine, as minty, toasty, and tobacco-like accents stay subtly in the background until the finish. A full body, medium to full tannins and good fruit acidity lend tangy freshness. Best from 2026.

91 Points - James Suckling 

A juicy and delicious wine with a round and polished texture with hints of chocolate and walnuts. Some iron shavings, too. Medium body. Savory at the end. Lovely dark fruit in the finish. Juicy. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a light mesquite edge that mingles with gently mulled plum and blackberry fruit flavors, while lightly singed vanilla and tobacco fill in through the finish. Reveals a solid graphite spine, too. Drink now through 2033. Tasted twice, with consistent notes

clase-azul-mezcal-durango.title: Clase Azul Durango Mezcal
clase-azul-mezcal-durango.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Durango Mezcal is an ultra-premium mezcal crafted from 100% wild Cenizo Agave, which grows naturally in the state of Durango in Northern Mexico. Produced using traditional artisan methods, including underground pit roasting and distillation in copper stills, it captures a distinct, full-bodied character with a balanced profile of herbal, citrus, and subtle smoky notes. Presented in an iconic, handcrafted dark-gray ceramic decanter adorned with a copper cap and intricate beadwork inspired by the Wixárika culture, this expression stands as a remarkable celebration of Mexican heritage and artisanal craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fatty fish like roasted salmon or sea bass, grilled octopus, pork carnitas, aged goat cheeses, and dark chocolate desserts with sea salt or citrus.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant crystal-clear body with silver highlights and a rich, medium-to-full body with a smooth, velvety texture.

Nose : Bright citrus peel, herbal notes of sage and rosemary, green olive, roasted agave, and subtle hints of smoky oak.

Palate : Complex and well-balanced with flavors of sweet roasted agave, citrus zest, herbal tea, bright mineral undertones, and a gentle, delicate smokiness.

Finish : Long, smooth, and clean with lingering notes of sweet agave, light herbal spice, and soft wood smoke.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a wide-rimmed glass or traditional mezcal copita to fully appreciate its complex aromas and flavors.

darioush-caravan-1.title: Darioush Caravan Cabernet Sauvignon
darioush-caravan-1.bodyHtml: A rich and versatile Napa Valley blend designed for approachability without sacrificing complexity. It features an expressive aromatic profile of ripe blackcurrants, dark plum, and blackberry jam, accented by notes of cedar, sweet tobacco, and toasted vanilla. The palate is medium to full-bodied with a supple, velvety texture, polished tannins, and layers of dark fruit and cocoa that lead to a balanced, savory finish.

kentucky-owl-st-patricks-bourbon.title: Kentucky Owl Confiscated Kentucky Straight Bourbon
kentucky-owl-st-patricks-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Created as a tribute to the barrels seized from the original Kentucky Owl distillery by the government just prior to Prohibition. Confiscated is a premium, uncut-style Kentucky Straight Bourbon that delivers a masterful balance between sweet and savory notes. Bottled at 96.4 proof, it leans into an elegant, oak-forward, and slightly floral flavor profile, setting it apart as a highly unique and refined sip within the luxury bourbon category.

NOSE

Floral and inviting with aromas of gardenia, banana bread, toasted sourdough crust, and red apple.

PALATE

Soft and well-rounded, featuring prominent flavors of graham cracker, citrus peel, sweet toffee, and muted cinnamon spice.

FINISH

Medium-long and complex, balanced with white grape notes, seasoned oak, and a subtle hint of cayenne pepper on the tail end.

kentucky-owl-wiseman-bourbon.title: Kentucky Owl The Wiseman Bourbon
kentucky-owl-wiseman-bourbon.bodyHtml: Made by using four Kentucky Straight Bourbons masterfully blended to show their individual taste contributions. The aromas and flavors of sweet caramel, citrus and light oak flow through the palate with caramel and allspice on the lengthy finish. Great for cocktails or sipping neat. Serve with a decadent chocolate cake.

collective-arts-raspberry-dry-hop-4x355.title: Collective Arts Raspberry Dry Hop 4 Tall Cans
collective-arts-raspberry-dry-hop-4x355.bodyHtml: Collective Arts Raspberry Dry Hop 4 Tall Cans

chartreuse-yellow.title: Yellow Chartreuse
chartreuse-yellow.bodyHtml:
The Chartreuse Yellow is a legendary, profoundly complex, and sweet-toned French liqueur crafted by Carthusian Monks from a top-secret blend of 130 natural botanicals. It displays a brilliant, natural golden-yellow color in the glass, throwing off an intense and highly aromatic bouquet of honey, mint, citrus peel, and fresh wildflowers, deeply intertwined with exotic hints of saffron, turmeric, aniseed, and a touch of white pepper. On the palate, this full-bodied liqueur is incredibly viscous, smooth, and warming, coating the mouth in an intricate tapestry of sweet honeyed herbs, licorice, and cardamon. Naturally colored and driven by a fiery alcohol backbone, it transitions into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by a lingering touch of pine resin, spearmint, and botanical spice.
Food Pairing: This highly aromatic and intensely sweet liqueur pairs beautifully with rich desserts and savory delicacies, including dark chocolate mousse, lemon tarts, warm apple tarte Tatin, blue cheeses like Roquefort, or served as a digestif alongside roasted almonds and candied orange peel.

luxardo-amaretto.title: Luxardo Amaretto Di Saschira
luxardo-amaretto.bodyHtml:
Luxardo Amaretto Di Saschira is an exceptional, refined Italian liqueur that showcases the historic distillery's centuries-old expertise in crafting high-end spirits. Produced using the essential oils extracted from the pits of sweet peaches and cherries, blended with pure alcohol, sugar, and natural aromas, it offers an authentic, rich almond flavor profile without relying on artificial additive substitutes. The result is an impressively balanced, velvety liqueur that delivers a classic, sweet marzipan taste offset by a sophisticated, subtle touch of agreeable bitterness.

Food Pairing: Tiramisu, almond biscotti, dark chocolate torte, vanilla bean panna cotta, toasted almond tart, and drizzled over artisanal vanilla gelato.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant, deep amber with warm golden reflections in the glass. It presents a rich, smooth, and velvety mouthfeel with a pleasant, coating viscosity.

Nose : Intense and highly aromatic, dominated by rich marzipan, toasted almonds, and sweet cherry pit notes, accompanied by soft vanilla, caramelized sugar, and a hint of warm baking spice.

Palate : Velvety, smooth, and delightfully sweet. It delivers generous flavors of concentrated almond paste, marzipan, and sweet cherry blossom, beautifully balanced by underlying hints of cocoa, vanilla, and a faint, pleasing kernel bitterness.

Finish : Long, warm, and sweet, leaving a lingering, clean impression of toasted almonds, vanilla, and subtle stone fruit oils.

Serve : Serve neat or over ice in a rocks glass as a classic digestif, or use it as a premium base for cocktails such as an Amaretto Sour, Godfather, or mixed into warm coffee drinks.

sour-puss-green-apple.title: Sour Puss Green Apple
sour-puss-green-apple.bodyHtml:
Sour Puss Green Apple is a sweet-and-sour apple liqueur produced by Phillips Products Co. in Minnesota, USA. Instantly recognisable by its near-neon green colour and the scowling black cat on its label, it is built around an explosive sour apple flavour, with bold notes of Granny Smith apple backed by a hint of cotton candy sweetness. At 15% ABV it is light enough to drink chilled as a shooter, and it is a familiar ingredient in party cocktails such as the Sour Apple Martini. This is the standard 750ml bottle. The label identifies it as the Green (Apple) flavour of the Sour Puss range.

Tasting Notes: Sweet and sour, with Granny Smith apple and a hint of cotton candy.

Serve: Chilled as a shooter, or shaken into a Sour Apple Martini.

averna-amro.title: Averna Amaro Siciliano Liqueur
averna-amro.bodyHtml: Averna is the authentic Sicilian bitter, with an unchanged recipe since 1868. Deep brown in colour, this vibrant spirit is velvet on the palate and balanced in the mouth. A sip introduces a pleasant, approachable taste through bitter orange hints, balanced with sweet and spicy notes of licorice and Mediterranean herbs, giving Averna a smooth taste and unmistakable aroma.

cutty-sark-1.title: Cutty Sark Original Blended Scotch Whisky
cutty-sark-1.bodyHtml:
Cutty Sark Original Blended Scotch Whisky is the first and signature blend of Cutty Sark, a whisky launched in 1923 in the middle of the Prohibition era and named after the famous clipper ship. It was created to be different: lighter in taste, lighter in colour and fresher in personality than many traditional blends. Under Master Blender Stephen Woodcock, fine single malts and quality grain whiskies are matured separately and then married together, giving subtle vanilla flavours that make it ideal for mixing. In the glass it is pale and bright, with a fresh nose of fruit and flowers, a balanced, lively palate of vanilla and citrus fruits, and a smooth, vibrant finish. Distilled, blended and bottled in Scotland, it is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Pale and bright; fruity, floral, vanilla and citrus.

Nose: Fresh and enticing, with fruity and floral notes.

Palate: Balanced and lively, with vanilla and citrus fruits.

Finish: Smooth and vibrant.

Serve: As a highball with soda, ginger ale or cola over plenty of ice.

stags-leap-wine-cellars-hands-of-time.title: Stag's Leap Wine Cellars S.L.V. Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 750ml
stags-leap-wine-cellars-hands-of-time.bodyHtml:
The 2019 S.L.V. Cabernet Sauvignon offers generous dark fruit aromas of black currant, plum and candied fig along with cocoa dust. On the palate the wine has dense, yet polished, tannins that meld with layers of dark fruit, fig and violet. The tannin structure, dark fruit, and pleasing minerality point to this wine’s ability to age.

96 Points - James Suckling

Deep yet floral nose with pure cassis, blackberry and blueberry concentrate, as well as hints of sandalwood and pine. Quite ample on the palate, laden with velvety tannins in a mealy form. Rich and primary, yet juicy and supple. Densely packed.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon S.L.V. features perfumed aromas of violets and cassis. It's medium to full-bodied on the palate, nicely elegant while being powerful and sturdy at the same time. No, it's not made in a modern, blockbuster style, but it's true to its heritage, with subtle herb shadings and a long, silky finish. Best After 2024

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Pure crème de cassis, violets, and lead pencil shaving nuances emerge from the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon S.L.V., a concentrated, structured, almost austere 2019 that has terrific balance as well as a great mid-palate. Possessing youthful tannins and remarkable purity of fruit, this ultra-classic, flawlessly put together Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon will benefit from 4-5 years of bottle age and keep for 20-25 years. Count me impressed – this is brilliant juice.

michters-single-barrel-straight-rye.title: Michter's US*1 Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye
michters-single-barrel-straight-rye.bodyHtml:
A stunning expression of premium Kentucky rye. Michter's US*1 Rye is a Single Barrel release, meaning every bottle is drawn from a solitary, hand-selected cask to ensure peak flavor. The distillery is famous for its low barrel entry proof and heavily toasted/fire-charred barrels, which extract an unbelievable amount of rich flavor from the wood. Bottled at 84.8 proof, it delivers a masterful balance of spicy rye kick, citrus, and deep, sweet butterscotch.

 

NOSE

Bright and fragrant with aromas of cracked black pepper, fresh mint, orange peel, and warm vanilla.

PALATE

Incredibly well-balanced and smooth. A gentle wave of peppery rye spice is beautifully tempered by rich butterscotch, sweet caramel, and toasted oak.

FINISH

Crisp, smooth, and lingering with a pleasant, spicy warmth and sweet citrus.

benromach-15-year-old.title: Benromach 15 Year Old
benromach-15-year-old.bodyHtml:
Benromach 15 Year Old is a Speyside single malt from the Benromach Distillery in Forres, founded in 1898 and owned since 1993 by the family firm Gordon & MacPhail, who revived it to make whisky in a traditional, subtly smoky Speyside style. It is matured exclusively in first-fill casks: malts from first-fill bourbon and first-fill sherry casks are brought together and bottled at 43% ABV with natural colour. The result is a rich, fruity dram where toffee, forest fruits and dark chocolate meet cracked pepper and a gentle thread of peat smoke, with the sherry casks adding depth and the bourbon wood a creamy, orchard-fruit sweetness. Presented in a 700ml bottle with gift box.

Tasting Notes: Toffee, forest fruits, dark chocolate, black pepper and soft smoke.

Nose: Sweet toffee leading to cracked black pepper and peat smoke, with forest fruits, dark chocolate and dried banana.

Palate: Creamy and sweet, with ripe apples over charred oak, then dark chocolate, toasted malt and orange peel with a hint of smoke.

Finish: Medium length and creamy, with soft smoke and dried fruit.

Serve: Neat or with a few drops of water.

chateau-pontet-canet.title: Chateau Pontet Canet 2020
chateau-pontet-canet.bodyHtml:
One of Pauillac's most acclaimed estates, Château Pontet-Canet reveals intense aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, graphite, cedar, violet, and cigar box. Powerful yet seamlessly elegant, it delivers velvety tannins, vibrant freshness, exceptional concentration, and a remarkably long finish with extraordinary aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, grilled ribeye, roast lamb, venison, duck confit, truffle potatoes, aged Comté, or braised short ribs.

 

98 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackcurrants and black cherries with hints of crushed walnuts, grilled thyme, cocoa powder and graphite. It’s full-bodied with layers of ultra-fine, silky tannins that elegantly coat your palate, allowing the juicy and vibrant fruit to shine. Delicate and pristine, yet compact with lots of energy and power to uncover in the coming years. It lasts for minutes and is delicious now. The purity of fruit is really impressive. 60% cabernet sauvignon, 32% merlot, 4% cabernet franc and 4% petit verdot. 50% new oak 15% old oak and 35% concrete amphorae. Try after 2027.
97 Points - Decanter
Dark chocolate, bramble tones, not overly floral or fruity with some cedar and cinnamon notes. Lovely high acidity straight away, forward, bright and energetic with lovely crunchy blue fruit on the palate but creamy textured tannins giving a round and complete mouthful. Nothing feels overdone, this is quietly seductive and confident but not at all showing off. I love the minerality and the graphite grip with plum and black cherry and tons of slate, liquorice and menthol freshness. Long finish, slowly expansive, building and growing from start to finish showing an impressive structure overall. Nicely constructed, charming still with the Pauillac touch. A great Pontet - immediately seductive and enjoyable with a long ageing potential.
97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The flagship from this estate, the 2020 Château Pontet-Canet is a beauty based on 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 32% Merlot, and 4% each of Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, brought up in 50% new oak, with 35% in amphora. Deep purple-hued with a great nose of dark currants, plums, tobacco leaf, and truffly earth, it hits the palate with full-bodied richness, a layered, seamless mouthfeel and a great finish. The higher Merlot content here really shows in its overall sexy, supple, seamless style, and while this already offers pleasure, it's going to be one for the ages as well. Rating: 97+
97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The magnificent structure and balance of this wine are powerful. It shows poise between the black fruits and the freshness of the vintage, while the texture is almost velvet. The wine is juicy and seriously structured at the same time.

duckhorn-napa-valley-the-discussion.title: Duckhorn The Discussion 2018
duckhorn-napa-valley-the-discussion.bodyHtml:
A complex medley of brambly red currants, black raspberry, fig compote & rose petals grace the nose. The palate is supple and velvety with powdery tannins bolstering age-ability. Extended barrel aging yields wonderful complexity with hints of toasted hazelnut, cocoa powder and nutmeg.

94 Points - James Suckling

A deep but scented nose, with an attractive gravel note added to the aroma profile of blueberries, cassis and plums. Full-bodied and tight on the palate, showing well-crafted tannins that are tight and supportive to the juicy berries and plush oak spices. Long and layered finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Lively, with generous cassis bush and sassafras notes leading the way for friendly, polished cassis, plum puree and cherry preserves, with cedar toast asserting itself on the finish. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. Drink now.

st-george-single-malt-lot-21.title: St George Single Malt American Whiskey Lot 21
st-george-single-malt-lot-21.bodyHtml: Back in 2000, there was no such thing as “American Single Malt Whiskey.” Our Lot Series is the single malt that earned master distiller Lance Winters his place in the Whisky Magazine Hall of Fame. His pioneering approach—using five roast levels of malted barley pot distilled once to maximize the flavor from the grain—remains as revolutionary as it is delicious.

seven-falls-cabernet-sauvignon.title: J. Lohr 'Seven Oaks' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
seven-falls-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The 2022 J. Lohr 'Seven Oaks' Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic and fruit-forward icon that has defined the Paso Robles style for over thirty vintages. Born from a dry and warm growing season, it presents an exceptionally dark color and a layered bouquet of black cherry, currant, and plum, accented by an authentic barrel-aged bouquet of toasted pastry, hazelnut, and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and smooth, featuring juicy red-fruit flavors supported by velvety, softly textured tannins. Matured for 12 months in 60-gallon American oak barrels (18% new wood), it balances its concentrated ripeness with a long, gratifying finish. It is widely recognized as a "best buy" for its consistency and is ideal for pairing with grilled ribeye steak or hearty pasta dishes.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, hearty beef stews, sausage pasta, and aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

90 Points - James Suckling

Currants, sage, roasted plums and cloves on the nose of this rich and spicy red. It’s full-bodied, plush and toasty, with ripe tannins.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Damp earth aromas lead quickly into sharp yet ripe cherry aromas on the nose of this bottling. Likable flavors of black cherry greet the palate, as wet clay, cocoa, mint and mace flavors add impressive complexity at this price point.

tamnavulin-double-cask.title: Tamnavulin Double Cask
tamnavulin-double-cask.bodyHtml:
Matured in American oak barrels for a sweet, mellow taste with a rich, smooth Sherry cask finish.

Colour

Amber gold.

Nose

Rich, warm aromas of apple, toffee and honey with sweet marzipan and subtle tangy marmalade notes.

Palate

Fresh, mellow with pear creamy peaches and pineapple and a hint of Demerara sugar.

Finish

Rich, smooth and refreshing. A signature Speyside malt.

sandhill-sovereign-opal.title: Sandhill Terroir Driven Sovereign Opal 2021 750ml
sandhill-sovereign-opal.bodyHtml: Pale straw in the glass. Light body, slightly off dry, with zippy acidity. Primary tropical fruit aromas of lychee, and pineapple. Tree fruit aroma of quince. Citrus fruit aroma of orange, with a flower aroma of orange blossom. Notes of orange and white peach on the palate. The finish is floral, and the length carries on.

langlois-chateau-sancerre-fontaine-audon.title: Langlois-Chateau Chateau De Fontaine-Audon 2022 750ml
langlois-chateau-sancerre-fontaine-audon.bodyHtml:
Langlois-Château Château de Fontaine-Audon Sancerre Blanc 2022 is an elegant, mineral-driven Sauvignon Blanc from France's Loire Valley. Sourced from a 15-hectare estate vineyard in Sainte-Gemme-en-Sancerrois, this distinctive wine reflects the region's flint-rich soils. Aromas of grapefruit, gooseberry, tropical fruit, and fresh herbs lead to a vibrant palate of citrus, green apple, and white peach. Stainless steel fermentation and six months of lees ageing preserve its freshness, delivering a crisp, refined finish with characteristic flinty minerality.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, grilled fish, goat cheese, seared scallops, sushi, herb-roasted chicken, and lightly spiced Asian dishes.

mirafiore-barolo-docg.title: Casa E.di Mirafiore Barolo 2019
mirafiore-barolo-docg.bodyHtml:
Casa E. di Mirafiore Barolo 2019 is an extraordinarily classic and refined expression of Nebbiolo, sourced from sustainably farmed organic vineyards located in the sub-zones of Serralunga d'Alba and Barolo. Vinified traditionally using indigenous yeasts with an extended skin contact period of 30 to 45 days, it matures for two years in large Slavonian oak casks, followed by additional aging in the bottle. The nose reveals a complex bouquet of dried red rose petals, sour cherries, dark plum, tobacco leaf, and subtle forest floor nuances. On the palate, it exhibits impressive structure and balance, framed by taut, fine-grained tannins, vibrant mountain acidity, and a long, persistent finish marked by savory spice and crushed stone minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with braised beef short ribs, roasted lamb shank, truffled risotto, wild game dishes, and aged hard cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano or Castelmagno.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe and packed with plum, cherry, earth, iron, eucalyptus and leafy tobacco flavors. Delivers dry, dusty tannins that exert themselves on the finish, yet this maintains an impression of cherry and strawberry fruit. Best from 2026 through 2043.

band-of-vintners-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Sterling Vintner's Collection Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 / 2022
band-of-vintners-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Sterling Vintner's Collection Cabernet Sauvignon opens with rich aromas of blackberries, with accents of caramel and mocha. The palate is smooth, delivering a balanced expression of plum, blackberry pie, and toffee. Soft, supple, and chocolaty tannins hold the finish, which is long and luxurious.

With its bold flavors and an easy accessibility, this Cabernet Sauvignon pairs well with a variety of foods and occasions, from filet mignon to barbecued ribs.

2021 Vintage Ratings

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is a drink-me-now wine with approachable tannins and a balanced acidity. Find aromas and flavors of roasted coffee, toasted wood, blackberry, black cherry, black currant, black pepper, anise and nutmeg spice.

waterford-the-cuvee.title: Waterford The Cuvée Irish Single Malt Whisky
waterford-the-cuvee.bodyHtml: Awarded the "Irish Whisky of the Year" by the prestigious Meninger International Spirits Awards, The Cuvee is bottled at 50% after four and a half years in a mix of First Fill Ex-Bourbon, Virgin American Oak, Bordeaux, and Vin Doux Naturel casks. The Cuvee is "the "Definitive Waterford Whisky!"

drublin-city-irish-dry-gin.title: Dublin City Irish Dry Gin
drublin-city-irish-dry-gin.bodyHtml: A handcrafted gin distilled London Dry style in super premium small batch, an Irish Whey spirit base ideal for our recipe giving an extra silky finish you’ll love. Seven botanicals form the core recipe including locally grown Dublin Rhubarb. Distilled in super premium small batch in the finest London Dry style. Dublin City Gin has over 30 accolades, multiple gold medals and is simply delicious.

dublin-city-single-malt-irish-whiskey.title: Dublin City Single Malt Irish Whiskey
dublin-city-single-malt-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml: This Single Malt is a delicious deep natural gold spirit, inspired by the historical “Whisky” brands of olde, with a robust vintage flavour reminiscent of Dublin’s Victorian distilling heritage. The mash is 100% Irish grown malted barley, non-GM, and fully recycled to farming use. Produced in traditional copper pot stills and triple distilled for that classic Irish quality. Aged in specially charred America Oak and finished in Oloroso Sherry casks. A rich, well-balanced nose, perfect sipper with a distinct long finish and great sherry notes.

clos-apalta-2018.title: Clos Apalta 2018
clos-apalta-2018.bodyHtml:
Clos Apalta 2018 is a monumental, world-class blend from Chile that is widely regarded as one of the most balanced and precise vintages in the estate's history. Born from a cooler, ideal growing season, this wine exhibits extraordinary freshness and structural depth. It presents a deep, inky purple-red colour and an intense bouquet of blackberry, cassis, and plum, layered with complex notes of dried flowers, tobacco, graphite, and exotic spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied and hedonistic yet remarkably polished, showcasing a silky, concentrated texture with elegant, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that leads to an exceptionally long, harmonious finish.

98 Points James Suckling

So aromatic and fresh with dried flowers, sweet tobacco and hints of straw. Red fruit, cloves and green peppercorns. Medium-to full-bodied with fine tannins that are very fresh and refined. Fine, silky and beautiful. Hints of minerals and granite to the dark fruit. Such gorgeous length and beauty. 64% carmenere, 18% cabernet franc and 18% merlot. Extremely long and poised. Cooler wine. From biodynamically grown grapes. Delicious to drink already, but another three to four years will make it even better.

96 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

There is a lot of Carmenere character on the nose of the 2018 Clos Apalta, which was produced with 64% Carmenere, 18% Cabernet Sauvignon and 18% Merlot, a blend that is similar to the one used in 2016. The wine is not shy at all and hits the scale at 15% alcohol. It's showy, heady, hedonistic, aromatic, full-bodied and lush with abundant velvety tannins and a long and powerful finish where the notes of black peppercorns and tea and tobacco leaves dominate. This might not be a wine for everybody, but fans of the style will love it.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Displays a rich and ripe profile of plum and berry accented by mineral acidity and notes of singed alder and cinnamon bark, adding toasted herb notes that linger on the finish around fine tannins and details of kirsch.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of chalk and ripe black fruit are subtle and delicate. Well structured and balanced, this red delivers nutmeg, dried herbs and meaty plum over a mineral texture. Firm tannins and good acidity provide support to the savory mouthfeel. Oak flavors add to the complexity and extend the finish.

almaviva-2019.title: Almaviva 2019
almaviva-2019.bodyHtml:
In 1997, Baroness Philippine de Rothschild, owner of Mouton Rothschild, and Eduardo Guilisasti Tagle, owner of Viña Concha y Toro, entered into a partnership to create an exceptional Franco-Chilean wine called Almaviva. Almaviva was intentionally chosen to pay homage to Chile’s ancestral history, with three reproductions of a stylized design, which symbolizes the vision of the earth and the cosmos in the Mapuche civilization. The design appears on the kultrun, a ritual drum used by the Mapuche. Two great traditions thus join hands to offer the whole world a promise of pleasure and excellence.

97 Points - James Suckling

A very refined and polished red with currants and hints of cedar, chocolate and hazelnuts. Subtle and fine. Medium- to full-bodied, creamy and nicely textured. Friendly and caressing. Closing down. 68% cabernet sauvignon, 23% carmenere, 5% cabernet franc, 3% petit verdot and 1% merlot. Drink now or hold. Will age nicely.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The product of an overall warm, dry vintage that ended slightly cooler, the 2019 Almaviva opens with focused, red-fruited aromas supplemented by coffee, mint and red pepper, developing additional floral notes with aeration. It is suave and energetic on the palate, displaying an admirable balance between slightly elevated ripeness, fresh acidity and detailed, delineated tannins. It finishes with the velvety richness and elegantly drying structure typical of Almaviva. Within this vertical, it struck me as similar to the 2022—although a touch more lifted and less assertive—and further reinforced the stylistic improvements made at Almaviva in the last decade.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Cabernet Sauvignon-based blend shows dried herbs, nutmeg, green bell pepper, and hints of tobacco on the nose. The palate has good structure, medium acidity, and velvet tannins. Oak adds smoky notes to the mix of ripe blueberry and plum. It's delicate and has a smooth lingering finish. Jesica Vargas

epu-by-almaviva.title: Almaviva EPU 2019
epu-by-almaviva.bodyHtml:
Epu is the second label of Almaviva, and this 2019 is the very first international release. Made of  84% Cabernet Sauvignon, 13% Carmenere, 2% Merlot and 1% Cabernet Franc, the Epu is a terrific wine to drink in its youth, or to save for 3-10 years. Almaviva wines represent France joining Chile in the production of a prestigious red wine... in 1997, Baroness Philippine de Rothschild of Baron Philippe de Rothschild SA, and Eduardo Guilisasti Tagle of Viña Concha y Toro S.A., sealed a partnership agreement with a view to create an exceptional Franco-Chilean wine called Almaviva. 

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blueberries, blackberries and fresh flowers. Very cool and pure. Medium-bodied with fine, linear and very integrated tannins that are compressed and silky-textured. New second wine of Almaviva. Needs time to open. Try after 2024.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This red offers ripe plum and cherry cordial flavors up front, revealing layers of nuance as it unfolds, including intriguing orange zest, Calabrian chili and olive notes. Presents a fresh, minerally acidity midpalate that pushes all the flavors to the finish, with zesty but firm tannins and echoes back to the opening flavors. Shows tremendous length. Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenère, Merlot and Cabernet Franc.
93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The first truly international release of the second wine is going to be the 2019 Epu, which has changed image and label, looking a little more like Almaviva, and is going to be sold through the Bordeaux négoce. 2019 was a very dry vintage, and the blend is 84% Cabernet Sauvignon, 13% Carmenere, 2% Merlot and 1% Cabernet Franc with slightly higher alcohol than 2018 and with lower acidity, matured in used barriques for one year. In terms of freshness, the wine is quite similar to the 2018 that I tasted next to it, obviously a little younger, quite intense and fruit-driven, spicy and herbal, with a creamy texture and fine-grained tannins. It's a second wine, but they also want to do something different and Epu is perhaps a little more classical, perhaps this is more Bordeaux and Almaviva is more Chilean.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Inviting, the nose offers red berry aromas and hints of thyme and vanilla. It's full-bodied and well-structured, with silky tannins and good acidity. Hints of thyme and oak are followed by red fruit flavors. It finishes long. Jesica Vargas

macallan-master-of-photography-4-p50.title: The Macallan Masters of Photography Elliott Erwitt Edition Print 50 375ml
macallan-master-of-photography-4-p50.bodyHtml:
The Masters of Photography: Elliott Erwitt Edition was The Macallan’s most extensive, and ambitious to date, with 58 unique single cask whiskies being paired with a different signed print captured during his Scottish adventure. Only 35 of each of the exclusive pairings were made available, a complete global release of 2,030.

In 2013, Elliott Erwitt, legendary photographer known for his mastery of this practice, turned his eye to Scotland.

For the fourth chapter of The Masters of Photography, The Macallan commissioned Elliott Erwitt to capture the spirit of its heartland. In his ‘Great Scottish Adventure’, Erwitt interprets and showcases the unique richness and depth of Scottish character through his shrewd observational skill and subtle humorous style.

As Erwitt explains, “I wasn’t looking for anything specific, just everything in general. In short; total freedom. I hope that ‘Scottish Character’ is evident in the photographs.”

macallan-master-of-photography-5.title: The Macallan Master Of Photography 5 Martio Testino + 6 x 50ml
macallan-master-of-photography-5.bodyHtml:
The Masters of Photography: Mario Testino Edition brought together six different casks to showcase the complexity of The Macallan. Each of these six perfect whiskies is the definitive representation of one of The Six Pillars. They each have their own character, flavour and aroma which when brought together create the perfect single malt with unparalleled depth, darkness and diversity.

Each of the 1,000 editions comprised a different Mario Testino print capturing The Six Pillars, an exclusive photo-archival booklet featuring a total of 20 images shot by Testino during the process, one bottle of the single malt whisky and six miniatures from each of the selected six casks.

CONNECTION WITH HIS SUBJECTS, BE IT CELEBRITIES OR ROYALTY, MARIO TESTINO HAS MADE A LASTING IMPACT ON THE WORLD OF PHOTOGRAPHY.

In 2014, he directed his lens towards The Macallan in the fifth chapter of The Masters of Photography.

As one of the world’s most prolific portrait and fashion photographers, Testino brought the foundation stones of The Macallan to life; personified and characterised in Testino’s inimitable and luxurious style.

The setting for the shoot was The China Club in Beijing, in a former palace near the Forbidden City and Tian’anmen Square.

Testino's vision, inspired by this location, shone through every detail of the setting, casting and atmosphere. By bringing together a group of distinct characters, Testino captured the spirit of the ultimate party. Every character was cast on the basis of their visual qualities, each echoing one of The Macallan’s Six Pillars.

Testino’s signature style, and renowned ability to create an atmosphere, was celebrated in this fifth chapter and the photographs showcase the vibrancy and luxury of The Macallan, infused with subtle eclecticism and cultural allusions.

shin-select-blended-japanese-whisky.title: Shin Select Reserve Japanese Whisky
shin-select-blended-japanese-whisky.bodyHtml:
SHIN Select Reserve Whisky is blended with 2 years finished whisky of ex-bourbon and ex-sherry, that are both previously aged in Japanese Shochu cask (American Oak) for 3 years.
✔︎ Bronze (World Whisky Awards, 2022)
✔︎ Double Gold Medal (San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2021)
✔︎ Bronze Medal (IWSC 2020)

shin-serene-blended-japanese-whisky.title: Shin Serene Japanese Whisky
shin-serene-blended-japanese-whisky.bodyHtml: Eigashima Shin Serene whisky is named after Mr. Hiraishi, the eighth generation of Eigashima Shuzo. Mild and soft as the fascination towards Seto Inland Sea, light and smooth on the palate, just exactly the same as Mr. Hiraishi’s natural disposition in gentleness. Based on the unique centuries-old whisky blending skills and the tradition of sake brewery of Eigashima, Shin Serene whisky is carefully made by Toji, also the chief executive of Eigashima sake brewery. As a blend of whisky aged 3 years in a combination of sherry, bourbon, and Japanese shochu barrels, the fusion is well balanced and sublimated to a new level. Suitable for neat drink or with ice. A great match with seafood dishes.

deadhead-10-year-old-rum-1.title: Antigua Distillery English Harbour Reserve 10 Year Old Rum
deadhead-10-year-old-rum-1.bodyHtml: With a perfectly balance blend, English Harbour 10yr Reserve is a deep mahogany rum distilled from molasses Aged 10 years in used whisky and bourbon barrels. First unveiled in 2006, English Harbour 10yr Reserve, instantly began making a name for itself and gave English Harbour 5yr drinkers something to graduate to.

glen-garioch-2009-the-whisky-agency.title: The Whisky Agency Glen Garioch 2009 12 Year Old 53.2% ABV
glen-garioch-2009-the-whisky-agency.bodyHtml:
Glen Garioch 2009 12 Year Old is a Highland single malt distilled at Glen Garioch in 2009 and bottled in 2021 by the independent bottler The Whisky Agency. Drawn from a single ex-bourbon barrel, it was bottled at natural cask strength of 53.2% ABV, with natural colour and without chill filtration, giving an unadulterated look at the distillery's spirit. The label features one of the bottler's illustrated designs, a red stag. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

staoisha-2013.title: Staoisha 2013 Archives
staoisha-2013.bodyHtml:
Bunnahabhain Staoisha 2013 Archives is an independent bottling of Staoisha, the peated single malt made at Bunnahabhain on Islay, released under the Archives independent label. It was distilled in 2013 and bottled at 59.1% ABV in a 700ml bottle, giving a full-strength look at the smoky side of a distillery best known for its unpeated whisky.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

burnside-1996.title: Archives British Dragonflies Burnside 25 Year Old 1996 Hogshead 54.7% ABV
burnside-1996.bodyHtml:
Archives Burnside 1996 is a blended malt Scotch whisky from Speyside, bottled by the independent label Archives. The label describes it as Burnside distilled at two Speyside distilleries. 'Burnside' is a name bottlers use for a teaspooned malt that cannot carry the distillery name. It was distilled in 1996, matured in a hogshead and bottled in 2021 at 25 years old and 54.7% ABV in a 700ml bottle. It belongs to Archives' British Dragonflies series, and the label shows Uropetala carovei, a New Zealand dragonfly drawn by G.V. Hudson more than a century ago.

Serve: Neat, with a splash of water if wanted.

glen-moray-2007.title: Glen Moray 2007
glen-moray-2007.bodyHtml:
Glen Moray 2007 is an independent single malt Scotch whisky bottling of spirit distilled in 2007 at Glen Moray, which has made whisky on the banks of the River Lossie in Elgin, Speyside, since 1897. Known for a light, fruity and approachable house style, Glen Moray takes on a different dimension when bottled at full strength by an independent bottler. This release is presented at a powerful 58.8% ABV in a 700ml bottle, so it rewards patience and a little water to unlock its fruit and oak.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass; add a few drops of water to open it up.

schrader-giii.title: Schrader Beckstoffer Georges III Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
schrader-giii.bodyHtml:
Sourced from the Beckstoffer Georges III Vineyard in Rutherford, this wine is produced from 100% Clone 337 Cabernet Sauvignon. The grapes originated from a specific section of the vineyard that was formerly part of the Napa River riverbed. This section benefits from an abundance of minerals and rocks left behind that makes it distinct from the surrounding terroir. Medium- to full-bodied and approachable in its youth, this wine features notes of sweet tobacco, spearmint, and ripe red fruit with opulent and soft, rounded tannins.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Lots of classic darker, herbal notes define the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer Georges III Vineyard, a rich, medium to full-bodied Cabernet Sauvignon from winemaker Thomas Rivers Brown. With air, more chocolate, espresso, and spice notes emerge from the glass, and this medium to full-bodied, textured, ripe, yet also elegant 2019 is going to drink brilliantly for another 20 years or so. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A rock-solid Cabernet, with cassis and dark plum stitched together with dusty earth and iron notes, all set into an alder and savory frame. Grippy back end, but the fruit keeps pace and there's a buried violet note for purity. Best from 2023 through 2036.

rocca-delle-macie-chianti-classico-riser.title: Famiglia Zingarelli Rocca delle Macie Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 750ml
rocca-delle-macie-chianti-classico-riser.bodyHtml:
Made with primarily Sangiovese, this ruby-red wine has aromas of blackcurrant and marasca cherries, with notes of Peruvian pepper and sweet spices. Its balance makes it a suitable accompaniment for a range of dishes, but it is also a great match for a good seasoned cheese.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

An almost fiery nose has black pepper, grilled meat, hot tar and graphite, with earthy notes of mushroom and wet leaves underneath. Black cherry and plum sit on top of dark chocolate on the palate, where a bite of astringency from orange pith lifts up the finish.

bols-genever-gin.title: Bols Original Genever
bols-genever-gin.bodyHtml: Before there was gin, there was genever. An incomparable grain spirit from Holland, made from long-fermented corn, rye and wheat. Triple-distilled to create malt spirit, the heart of genever. Bols Original Genever blends our malt spirit with 22 botanicals ranging from juniper berries, hops and coriander, to cloves and ginger.

jackson-triggs-light-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Jackson Triggs Light Cabernet Sauvignon
jackson-triggs-light-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Jackson Triggs Light Cabernet Sauvignon is a lower-alcohol red wine produced by Jackson-Triggs, designed to offer the classic profile of Cabernet Sauvignon with a lighter body and reduced alcohol content. On the nose, it delivers aromas of ripe blackcurrant, dark berries, and subtle hints of vanilla, spice, and toasted oak. The palate is approachable and fruit-forward, featuring smooth tannins, vibrant blackberry flavors, and a soft, clean finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light appetizers, sirloin sliders, grilled burgers, pizza, pasta with tomato-based sauces, and mild cheeses.

jackson-triggs-light-pinot-grigio.title: Jackson Triggs Light Pinot Grigio
jackson-triggs-light-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Jackson Triggs Light Pinot Grigio is a refreshing, lower-alcohol Canadian white wine offering the bright, approachable character of Pinot Grigio in a lighter style. With just 8% ABV, this easy-drinking wine features delicate aromas of fresh melon, ripe figs, and orchard fruits, complemented by subtle nutty notes and gentle citrus freshness. Its light body and crisp finish make it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, warm afternoons, and lighter meals.

Food Pairing: Grilled seafood, fresh pasta, garden salads, roasted chicken, sushi, and light appetizers.

jim-beam-honey.title: Jim Beam Honey
jim-beam-honey.bodyHtml: The classic Jim Beam Bourbon is combined with golden honey to create a delicious liqueur. The mellow sweetness combined with the smoothness of the original bourbon creates a balanced flavour on the palate. Easy to sip on its own, or in a cocktail.

social-lite-lemonade-variety-pack.title: Simply Spiked Lemonade Variety Pack
social-lite-lemonade-variety-pack.bodyHtml: These sparkling spiked lemonades are juicy and refreshing. The variety pack includes the Signature Lemonade with sweet and tart lemon flavour, the Strawberry Lemonade with fresh berry fruit and the Blueberry Lemonade with subtle fruit. Great for get-togethers or sipping on a hot afternoon. Pair with savoury snacks.

wu-liang-bai-jia-yan.title: Wu Liang Bai Jia Yan
wu-liang-bai-jia-yan.bodyHtml:
Wu Liang Bai Jia Yan is a Chinese baijiu from the Wuliangye group, bottled at 52% alc./vol. in a 500ml bottle.

Serve: Traditionally served neat at room temperature in small cups alongside food.

cono-sur-organic-cabernet-sauvignon-rese.title: Cono Sur Organic Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml

bacardi-lime-rum-1.title: Bacardi Lime Rum
bacardi-lime-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Bacardí Lime is a lime-flavoured rum from Bacardí, made for easy mixing and labelled "Made for Mixing". Its light base is a blend of Bacardí white rums, including some aged rums, that is charcoal filtered for a balanced, rounded character. A Bacardí maestro de ron then blends in fresh lime essences, the rum and lime are left to marry, and the spirit is reduced with purified water to its bottling strength of 35% ABV. The result is a zesty, citrus-led rum in a 750ml bottle that shines in simple long drinks: Bacardí's own suggestion is a Lime and Soda, or club soda with a squeeze of fresh lime for a Lime Fizz.

Tasting Notes: Bright lime zest over a light, smooth white rum.

Serve: With club soda and a squeeze of lime over ice, or in a Lime Cooler or Rum Rita.

josh-cabernet-sauvignon-bourbon-barrel-1.title: Josh Cellars Reserve Bourbon Barrel Aged Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
josh-cabernet-sauvignon-bourbon-barrel-1.bodyHtml:
Josh Cellars Reserve Bourbon Barrel Aged Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a bold and "rustic" red wine that blends the structure of a premium California Cabernet with the intense, smoky nuances of American whiskey heritage. Sourced from prestigious vineyards across the state, this vintage undergoes a unique maturation process where a portion of the wine is aged for three months in charred Bourbon barrels. This secondary aging in charred bourbon barrels imparts a deep, saturated purple colour and an aromatic profile defined by blackberry, dark chocolate, and roasted nuts, layered with distinct notes of vanilla, brown sugar, and toasted oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied and powerful with a rich, "creamy" texture and a long, warm finish that carries hints of smoke and spice, making it a favorite for those who enjoy a more robust and decadent style of Cabernet.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with a coffee-rubbed steak, smoked vegetables, a bacon bourbon burger, barbecued ribs, or a hearty leg of lamb.

st-germain-elderflower-liqueur-gift-pack.title: St Germain Elderflower Liqueur
st-germain-elderflower-liqueur-gift-pack.bodyHtml: The regal bottle is a reflection of the fine artisanal French liqueur held within. Made with fresh hand-picked elderflower blossoms, without the use of preservatives. The aromas are fruit driven with floral hints. On the palate expect tropical fruit, citrus, pear and a hint of honeysuckle sweetness.

bower-hill-special-edition-1.title: Bower Hill Special Edition No. 1 Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bower-hill-special-edition-1.bodyHtml:
Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey with a high Rye mash bill rested in a #3 char new American oak barrel for 4 years or more. Non-Chill Filtered (NCF) bourbon retains the fatty acids found in both the grains and the barrel. This makes for an exceptional aroma, more complex flavor profile and a smoother finish than traditionally chill filtered bourbons.

APPEARANCE

Rich Nut Brown

AROMA

Rich in Vanilla, subtle fruit and spice and a touch of worn leather

TASTE

Lush and spicy, big smoky oak with notes of dried fruits

FINISH
Long, refined. Smooth, warm and comfortable

bower-hill-barrel-strength-bourbon-1.title: Bower Hill Barrel Strength Bourbon
bower-hill-barrel-strength-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey with a high Rye mash bill rested in a #3 char new American oak barrel for 4 years or more. Bottled at full proof, right from the barrel.

 

AROMA

Crème Brule and pecans, sweet

PALATE

Bold, sweet vanilla, hint of nuts

FINISH

Very long and complete balance of spices

mister-sam-straight-whiskey-1.title: Michter's US*1 Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye
mister-sam-straight-whiskey-1.bodyHtml:
A stunning expression of premium Kentucky rye. Michter's US*1 Rye is a Single Barrel release, meaning every bottle is drawn from a solitary, hand-selected cask to ensure peak flavor. The distillery is famous for its low barrel entry proof and heavily toasted/fire-charred barrels, which extract an unbelievable amount of rich flavor from the wood. Bottled at 84.8 proof, it delivers a masterful balance of spicy rye kick, citrus, and deep, sweet butterscotch.

 

NOSE

Bright and fragrant with aromas of cracked black pepper, fresh mint, orange peel, and warm vanilla.

PALATE

Incredibly well-balanced and smooth. A gentle wave of peppery rye spice is beautifully tempered by rich butterscotch, sweet caramel, and toasted oak.

FINISH

Crisp, smooth, and lingering with a pleasant, spicy warmth and sweet citrus.

stagg-jr-64-35-abv-1.title: Stagg JR Bourbon 64.20% ABV
stagg-jr-64-35-abv-1.bodyHtml: LIMIT OF 1 PER CUSTOMER. NO FURTHER DISCOUNTS APPLY.

high-coast-solera-1.title: High Coast Solera Single Malt Swedish Whisky
high-coast-solera-1.bodyHtml:
It would seem the wizards of the High Coast never rest. They keep launching new ideas. This time they reveal the first release from their solera system, which they have had going in one of their warehouses for years.

The solera system consists of six levels (criaderas), where the top five consist of 200 litre bourbon barrels (10 barrels on each level), and the lowest level, where they take out the whisky that is bottled, consists of 225 litre Swedish oak casks (13 casks).

glendronach-12-year-old-original-2.title: The GlenDronach 12 Year Old Original
glendronach-12-year-old-original-2.bodyHtml:
The GlenDronach 12 Year Old is a benchmark Highland single malt Scotch whisky renowned for its rich, traditional sherry-cask aging profile. Crafted at the historic GlenDronach distillery in the Valley of Forgue, this expression is matured for a minimum of 12 years in a fine combination of Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry casks imported from Andalusia, Spain. The Pedro Ximénez casks impart deep, sweet dried fruit notes, while the Oloroso casks contribute robust structure, warm oak spices, and complex nuttiness. Non-chill filtered and natural in color, it offers an exceptionally smooth, velvety character with a harmonious balance of decadent sweetness and refined spice.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate desserts, sticky toffee pudding, roasted venison, braised short ribs, or aged blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : A rich, full-bodied single malt featuring a deep amber hue with a reddish-gold glow and a silky, mouth-coating texture.

Nose : Sweet, creamy vanilla with hints of ginger, spiced mulled wine, autumn fruits, and toasted oak.

Palate : Rich and creamy on the palate, delivering flavors of sweet raisins, dried figs, dark chocolate, oak spice, and subtle orange peel.

Finish : Long, full, and firm with lingering dried fruit notes, warming spices, and a gentle nuttiness.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of water in a Glencairn or tulip-shaped whisky glass.

red-schooner-transit-2.title: Red Schooner Transit No 4
red-schooner-transit-2.bodyHtml:
Red Schooner Transit No. 4 is a bold Australian red blend crafted by the Wagner family, renowned for Caymus Vineyards in Napa Valley. Sourced from South Australia's Barossa Valley and McLaren Vale, this distinctive wine combines Grenache, Shiraz, Mataro, and a small proportion of Cabernet Sauvignon. The grapes are transported under refrigeration to California for winemaking, followed by French oak maturation. Rich aromas of blackberry, raspberry, leather, and black pepper complement a plush palate of dark fruit, chocolate, and subtle mint. Smooth tannins and a lingering, spiced finish complete this expressive wine.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, barbecue ribs, roasted lamb, duck breast, braised short ribs, venison, aged cheddar, and hearty stews.

tate-spring-street-cabernet-sauvignon-2.title: Tate Spring Street Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
tate-spring-street-cabernet-sauvignon-2.bodyHtml:
Tate Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley St. Helena Spring Street Wolf Family Vineyard 2022 is an expressive, impeccably balanced, and finely crafted single-vineyard red wine produced by winemaker David Tate. Sourced entirely from the historic Wolf Family Vineyard on the valley floor in St. Helena, the fruit benefits from well-draining benchland alluvial soils and warm Napa Valley sun exposure tempered by cool afternoon breezes. In the glass, it displays a medium-to-deep ruby core with bright purple tinges. The bouquet is complex and layered, opening with aromas of ripe blackberries, cassis, and dark plums intertwined with crushed violets, dried herbs, pencil shavings, cedar wood, and fine French oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full body marked by pure, focused dark fruit, velvety and fine-grained tannins, balanced natural acidity, and a seamless, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, braised short ribs, venison loin, or aged sharp cheddar cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackberries, cassis, plums, red currants, violets, cedar and licorice. The palate is full-bodied with finely integrated tannins and balanced acidity. Balanced, fresh and savory, with a persistent finish.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon Spring Street Wolf Family Vineyard is gently herbal, with cedary overtones to the blackberry and cassis fruit. Medium to full-bodied, this juicy, fruit-forward wine is supple, flattering and easy to drink.

tempo-gin-smash-blackberry-lime-1.title: Tempo Gin Smash Blackberry Lime 6 Cans

unibroue-blanche-de-chambly-1.title: Unibroue Blanche De Chambly 4 Tall Cans

unibroue-la-findu-monde-1.title: Unibroue La Findu Monde 4 Tall Cans

fortaleza-blanco-still-strength.title: Fortaleza Blanco Still Strength Tequila
fortaleza-blanco-still-strength.bodyHtml:
Aromas of fruit, baked fully-ripened agave, green olive, and earth are invitingly present. Slightly brighter and a touch more rustic than the regular blanco, the accents of butter, olive, earth, black pepper, and vegetal qualities in the flavor are enhanced because it comes straight from our small copper pot still, without adding water prior to bottling.

For years, the only way to sample this was to visit our distillery in Tequila, Jalisco. Until now.

fortaleza-reposado.title: Don Julio Reposado Tequila
fortaleza-reposado.bodyHtml:
Don Julio Reposado Tequila is the legendary flagship expression that effectively established the luxury Reposado category worldwide. Created by the visionary Don Julio González in the Highlands of Jalisco, this spirit represents a meticulous approach to aging. While Mexican law requires a Reposado to rest for a minimum of two months, Don Julio ages theirs for a full eight months in hand-selected American white oak ex-bourbon barrels—nearly four times the legal requirement. This extended time in the wood beautifully rounds out the raw, peppery edge of the estate-grown Highlands agave, adding a sophisticated layer of light caramel and spice without over-extracting the wood or masking the plant's natural citrus vibrancy.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken fajitas, Baja-style fish tacos with lime, mild semi-hard cheeses like Monterey Jack, or fresh pineapple carpaccio.

TASTING NOTES Luminous, light straw-gold in appearance with an incredibly smooth, elegant, and medium-bodied texture that glides across the tongue.

NOSE Remarkably inviting and fresh; opens with an aromatic burst of bright lemon zest, lime juice, and sweet cooked agave, smoothly layered with soft vanilla fudge, a hint of white chocolate, and a delicate kiss of dry oak wood.

PALATE Beautifully balanced and clean on the tongue; initial flavors of sweet honeyed agave and ripe orchard fruits are quickly complemented by a creamy wave of vanilla custard and light caramel. The mid-palate introduces a pleasant twist of dried herbs and a soft, warming spice.

FINISH Short to medium, exceptionally clean, and dry, leaving a refreshing trail of sweet citrus oils, soft vanilla cream, and a final, faint touch of white pepper.

SERVE Highly versatile; drinks beautifully neat or on the rocks, and serves as an incomparable, upscale choice for a luxury Paloma or a classic Margarita.

orkney-1998-archives.title: Orkney 1998 Archives
orkney-1998-archives.bodyHtml:
Orkney 1998 Archives is an independent single malt Scotch whisky from an Orkney distillery, distilled in 1998 and bottled under the Archives label. It is bottled at 52.6% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

baileys-original-irish-cream-6.title: Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur 1.14L
baileys-original-irish-cream-6.bodyHtml:
Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur is a luxurious, velvety classic that blends fine Irish whiskey and spirits with rich, luscious dairy cream and hints of cocoa and vanilla. First introduced in 1974, it is the world’s most celebrated cream liqueur, offering a beautifully balanced, indulgent, and decadent drinking experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with dark chocolate desserts, molten lava cakes, tiramisu, and fresh berries. It also makes a wonderful accompaniment to warm apple pie, pecan tarts, or simply drizzled over premium vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Opaque, creamy light brown with a rich, velvety, and thick mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet cream, dark chocolate, vanilla, and a subtle hint of warming Irish whiskey.

Palate : Smooth and indulgent with rich flavors of fresh dairy cream, milk chocolate, cocoa, sweet vanilla, and mild whiskey warmth.

Finish : Sweet, long, and coat-the-tongue smooth with lingering chocolate, cream, and soft whiskey notes.

Serve : Serve chilled, poured over ice, or as a rich addition to hot coffee, hot chocolate, or desserts.

kosta-browne-bootleggers-hill-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir 2021
kosta-browne-bootleggers-hill-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Kosta Browne Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir 2021 is a masterful exploration of one of California’s most dramatic cool-climate regions. Sourced from prestigious vineyards defined by maritime fog and transverse mountain ranges, this vintage captures the signature tension and intensity of the area. It offers a captivating bouquet of wild strawberries, hibiscus, and crushed pomegranate, layered with nuanced notes of orange zest and dried thyme. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and vibrantly structured, showcasing a core of bright red fruit supported by ultra-fine tannins and a distinct saline minerality. The finish is remarkably long and energetic, reflecting the cool, wind-swept terroir of the Sta. Rita Hills.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This beloved brand manages to click a lot of Pinot Noir boxes in each bottling, including the spice, herb and fruit combo of strawberry, cherry, cinnamon stick and bay leaf on the nose. The palate is ripe and expressive with cherry compote flavors that are enhanced by a toasted pecan warmth and leathery grip.

93 Points - James Suckling

A subtle and pretty pinot with a lovely middle palate with a fine dusty tannin texture to it. Medium body and succulent with a savory finish. Orange peel. Lovely finish. This is very tame.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Matured for 15 months in 52% new oak, the 2021 Pinot Noir Sta. Rita Hills has a very pretty expression this vintage. The nose features detailed scents of blueberries, strawberries, Earl Grey tea leaves and forest floor, and the medium-bodied palate offers generous, perfumed fruit on a delicate frame, finishing long and layered.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Tasty, with a large core of succulent cherry and blackberry fruit notes laced with a light briar note, all backed by subtle mesquite and savory elements on the racy finish.

wild-life-rundle-bar-gin.title: Wild Life Distillery Rundle Gin
wild-life-rundle-bar-gin.bodyHtml:
Wild Life Distillery 'Rundle Bar' Gin is a special collaborative craft spirit created by Wild Life Distillery in Canmore, Alberta, in partnership with the iconic Fairmont Banff Springs. Inspired by the surrounding Canadian Rockies and the hotel's famous Rundle Bar, this gin features a unique botanical blend—including butterfly pea flower, lavender, heather, and alpine botanicals—which gives it a striking natural deep blue hue that transforms to purple when mixed with acidic mixers like tonic or citrus juice.

Food Pairing: Fresh mountain trout, goat cheese crostini, oysters, summer berry salads, and citrus-infused pastries.

Tasting Notes: Deep indigo-blue in appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose: Fragrant floral aromas of lavender and heather up front, balanced by piney juniper, fresh citrus zest, and subtle herbal complexity.

Palate: Well-rounded and smooth, displaying notes of crisp alpine juniper, bright citrus, subtle earthy roots, and delicate floral layers.

Finish: Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering floral notes, light citrus, and a soft dry juniper finish.

Serve: Serve over ice, top with tonic water or fresh lemon juice to watch the natural color shift from indigo to vibrant purple, garnished with a grapefruit wheel or a sprig of fresh lavender.

wild-life-blackberry-gin.title: Wild Life Distillery Blackberry Gin 750ml
wild-life-blackberry-gin.bodyHtml:
Wild Life Distillery Blackberry Gin is an artisanal craft spirit produced in Canmore, Alberta. Distilled from a base of 100% local Alberta grains (hard red spring wheat and malted barley), it is infused with fresh British Columbia blackberries. The result is a fruit-forward spirit that balances vibrant, sweet-tart berry flavors with a structure of piney juniper and warm spice.

Food Pairing: Goat cheese and beet salad, bison burgers with juniper relish, duck breast, charcuterie, and blackberry pie with vanilla ice cream.

Tasting Notes: Rich, dark red-purple tint in appearance with a soft, smooth, and balanced mouthfeel.

Nose: Freshly picked BC blackberries and rich plum notes dancing alongside resinous piney juniper.

Palate: Soft, sweet, and warm with vibrant berry fruitiness balanced by crisp acidity and subtle gin botanicals.

Finish: Clean and refreshing with lingering notes of dark berry skin and winter spice.

Serve: Enjoy on its own over ice, or served in cocktails like a Gin Sour, Blackberry Vesper, or Fruit Smash.

zenato-sansonina-merlot-igt.title: Zenato Sansonina Merlot 2019/2020
zenato-sansonina-merlot-igt.bodyHtml:
Zenato Sansonina Merlot is an artisanal and "aristocratic" red wine born from a visionary project by Carla Prospero Zenato and her daughter Nadia. Sourced from an old-vine vineyard in Peschiera del Garda—a rare site for Merlot in a white wine-dominant zone—it offers an intense ruby-red colour and a concentrated bouquet of crushed black cherries, cocoa, and dried herbs, accented by evolved balsamic and chili notes. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and silky, strike a perfect balance between velvety tannins and an elegant acidity, with a characteristically savory and mineral finish. To ensure phenolic stability and depth, it undergoes long maceration in wooden vats before aging in new French oak barriques, resulting in a "sexy" and decadent texture built for longevity.

2019 Vintage Rating:

94 Points - James Suckling
Aromas of bright and ripe black cherries vie with lightly charred roasting herbs, mild chili and dark floral notes. Full-bodied and silky with very fine tannins that are well sunk into the wine, allowing the fruit to build through the palate. Long, long finish with a gentle expansion of tannin and fruit. Classy. So tempting now, but will gain in complexity over a few years.

2020 Vintage Rating:

92 Points - James Suckling
Lush blackberries, dark cherries, ground spices and hints of wet stones. Firm and textured, with a medium body and ripe, velvety tannins. It’s succulent with good fruit concentration in the middle and a lively aftertaste. Drink now or hold.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Dark plums and black cherries burst from the glass, wrapped in subtle hints of cocoa and fresh violets. Generous waves of succulent fruit roll across a surprisingly structured frame, where fine-grained tannins and bright acidity create an unexpected lift that brightens the plush finish.

painted-rock-red-icon-estate-grown.title: Painted Rock Red Icon 2021
painted-rock-red-icon-estate-grown.bodyHtml:
Painted Rock Red Icon 2021 is the flagship estate red blend from Painted Rock Estate Winery, situated on the Skaha Bench in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Aged for 18 months in French oak barrels (30% new), this ultra-premium, full-bodied red showcases an aromatic intensity of dark plum, blackberry, cassis, and cocoa, beautifully complemented by subtle notes of baking spice, dried herbs, and graphite. On the palate, it exhibits exceptional depth and structure, featuring rich dark fruit flavors, well-integrated, velvety tannins, and a long, polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, wild game dishes, or well-aged cheddar cheese.

amalaya-amalaya-gran-corte.title: Amalaya Gran Corte 2022 750ml
amalaya-amalaya-gran-corte.bodyHtml:
Opaque purple in colour with ruby tints. Profound aromas of blackberry, blackcurrant and blueberries with spice notes and touches of mint. On the palate, it is rich, velvety and robust with flavours of chocolate, blackberry jam and licorice notes. Well structured with firm, yet ripe tannins and a very long, spice-driven finish. The blend is 85/10/5 Malbec, Cabernet Franc and Tannat.

90 Points - James Suckling

This is blue fruited with notes of violets, black olives and wet stone. Compact and tense on the palate with a medium body and chalky tannins. Dry and textural with a flavorful, spicy finish. Drink now or hold..

kilchoman-twin-gift-pack.title: Kilchoman Machir Bay and Sanaig Twin Gift Pack 2 x 200ml
kilchoman-twin-gift-pack.bodyHtml: Can't choose between single mats Kilchoman Sanaig and Kilchoman Machir bay? Then this set is just for you! Taste great basic Scotch whiskey from the Kilchoman distillery from the Isle of Islay. You will be enchanted by the combination of aging in ex-bourbon and ex-Oloroso sherry barrels.

ron-relicario.title: Relicario Superior Rum
ron-relicario.bodyHtml:
Relicario Superior is a Dominican rum built from a blend of static-aged base rums of 5 and 10 years, which the producer defines as a light rum in the Dominican style. It is bottled at 40% ABV. Dark amber in colour, it shows the scent of oak-aged rum with prunes and dried grapes, followed by a lightly sweet palate of oak, vanilla and dry sweet almonds, and a full, slightly thick texture with gentle warmth. 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: prunes, dried grapes, oak, vanilla, almond

Nose: Oak-aged rum with light sweetness, prunes and dried ripe grapes.

Palate: Well-evolved and lightly sweet, with oak, vanilla and dry sweet almonds.

Finish: Full and slightly thick on the palate, with a light tingle and gentle warmth.

Serve: Neat, over a large ice cube, or in a rum Old Fashioned.

ron-relicario-peated-finish.title: Relicario Peated Finish Ron
ron-relicario-peated-finish.bodyHtml:
Ron Relicario Peated Finish is an aged Dominican rum that spends up to a decade maturing in the Dominican Republic before a final period in American oak hogsheads that previously held peated Speyside single malt Scotch whisky. The finish layers smoke, peat and malt over the rum's sugar cane and vanilla character. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Sugar cane, vanilla and nuts with smoke, peat and malt.

Nose: Sugar cane juice and vanilla, with hints of smoke, peat and malt and a nutty edge.

Palate: Robust and persistent, with lingering smoky touches.

Finish: Deep-bodied, balancing aged-rum character with smoky nuances.

Serve: Neat or over a single large ice cube.

ron-jungla.title: Ron Jungla Suau Rum
ron-jungla.bodyHtml:
Ron Jungla is a rum from the house of Suau, the Spanish brandy house founded in 1851, bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Caribbean rum is given a second period of ageing in American oak casks that previously held Suau's solera brandy, a double-ageing process that marries Caribbean rum with Suau's solera brandy. The label carries the signature of Cuban master rum maker Juan A. Alvarez, and the bottle is presented in a tube decorated with the Jungla elephant emblem.

Serve: Neat or with a single large ice cube.

macallan-master-of-photography-4-p13.title: The Macallan Master Of Photography 4 Elliot Erwitt Print 13 58.6% ABV 375ml
macallan-master-of-photography-4-p13.bodyHtml:
The Masters of Photography: Elliott Erwitt Edition was The Macallan’s most extensive, and ambitious to date, with 58 unique single cask whiskies being paired with a different signed print captured during his Scottish adventure. Only 35 of each of the exclusive pairings were made available, a complete global release of 2,030.

In 2013, Elliott Erwitt, legendary photographer known for his mastery of this practice, turned his eye to Scotland.

For the fourth chapter of The Masters of Photography, The Macallan commissioned Elliott Erwitt to capture the spirit of its heartland. In his ‘Great Scottish Adventure’, Erwitt interprets and showcases the unique richness and depth of Scottish character through his shrewd observational skill and subtle humorous style.

As Erwitt explains, “I wasn’t looking for anything specific, just everything in general. In short; total freedom. I hope that ‘Scottish Character’ is evident in the photographs.”
