dillons-gin-variety-pack.title: Dillon's Gin Cocktail Variety Pack 12 Cans

bud-light-seltzer-passionfruit.title: Passoa Passionfruit Liqueur
bud-light-seltzer-passionfruit.bodyHtml: #1 passion fruit liqueur in the world, made with real passion fruit juice from Brazil. Versatile and easy, Passoa mixes with anything in your fridge – from juices to flavored sodas to ginger ale. Or take it to the next level and add a passion fruit twist to your favorite cocktail from sangria to margarita to mojito.

dom-perignon-p3-1993.title: Dom Perignon P3 Plenitude 1993
dom-perignon-p3-1993.bodyHtml:
The maturation of Dom Pérignon occurs not in a simple linear trajectory, but in successive leaps into new expression, each of which are called Plénitudes. In the long journey of elaboration, the wine goes through this metamorphosis, a transformation. Each Plénitude contributes to Dom Pérignon’s singularity. In the darkness of the cellars, from one plénitude to the next, Dom Pérignon will grow and blossom, transmuting time into energy. 

96 Points - CellarTracker

murviedro-sericis-cepas-viejas-monastrel.title: Murviedro Sericis Cepas Viejas Monastrell 2019
murviedro-sericis-cepas-viejas-monastrel.bodyHtml:
Intense red with purple tones. Elegant, powerful aromas of ripe fruit and toasted oak. Full bodied, complex, ripe tannins and toasted flavours on the finish. Sericis Cepas Viejas Monastrell is an ideal wine to accompany red meats, game, stews, spicy dishes and strong cheeses. Serve between 16 and 18ºC.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine reveals the beauty of its age. Ruby in color with some garnet around the edges, the wine has a nose of black raspberry, cassis, dried cranberry skin and hibiscus tea. Reserved, well-integrated red fruit is lifted by a savory undercurrent that adds depth to the relaxed, velvety finish.

pablo-old-vines-garnacha.title: Bodegas Ateca 'Atteca' Old Vines Garnacha 2022
pablo-old-vines-garnacha.bodyHtml:
Bodegas Ateca 'Atteca' Old Vines Garnacha 2022 is an expressive, rich, and full-bodied Spanish red wine crafted from low-yielding, old-vine Garnacha grapes grown in high-altitude slate and limestone soils. Exhibiting a deep ruby-red color, it opens with intense aromas of ripe dark cherries, blackberries, and wild plums, seamlessly intertwined with notes of sweet spice, licorice, cocoa, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it is supple, smooth, and concentrated, featuring plush fruit flavors, fine-grained tannins, and balanced natural acidity that lead to a long, warm, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, grilled pork loin, barbecued meats, cured Spanish cheeses, and hearty mushroom stew.

duck-pond-pinot-noir.title: Duck Pond Pinot Noir 2024
duck-pond-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Duck Pond Pinot Noir 2024 is a wonderfully expressive and considered wine that perfectly highlights the cool-climate elegance of Oregon's renowned Willamette Valley. Bright ruby in color with a light rim, this vibrant Pinot Noir opens with an inviting and aromatic bouquet of dried cherries, wild berries, and warm baking spice, accented by delicate hints of white pepper, cola, and earthy soil. On the palate, it is beautifully balanced and medium-bodied, delivering rich, focused flavors of cranberry, pomegranate, and ripe stone fruit alongside darker cherry and plum. Mild notes of oak add subtle depth and complexity, while smooth, velvety tannins and bright acidity frame the fruit perfectly. The experience concludes with a clean, well-rounded finish that leaves a fresh, lingering echo of red fruit and gentle warmth. As a Clean Label Project Purity Award winner, this wine is a testament to twenty-five years of consistent, sustainable craft in the Dundee Hills.

Food Pairing: Grilled wild salmon, roasted duck breast, pork tenderloin with cherry glaze, mushroom risotto, earthy root vegetables, and mild soft cheeses such as Brie or Camembert.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of dried cherries, white pepper, and warm baking spice. Cranberry, pomegranate, and ripe stone fruit on the palate — brief yet clean finish with a fresh echo of red fruit and gentle warmth.

ricasoli-brolio-chianti-classico-riserva.title: Ricasoli Brolio Chianti Classico Riserva 2022
ricasoli-brolio-chianti-classico-riserva.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Brolio Chianti Classico Riserva is a refined and structured red that reflects the diverse geological terroirs of the Brolio estate. It displays a dark, bright ruby colour and opens with an intense bouquet of ripe black cherries, plums, and wilted roses, layered with complex notes of cloves, aniseed, and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is warm and full-bodied, showcasing a sturdier backbone than the standard bottling. It features a harmonious balance between velvety, well-integrated tannins and a vibrant acidity, leading to a long, persistent finish with hints of mineral-rich earth and savory spices. This vintage is noted for its resilience and fruit intensity, achieved despite a particularly hot growing season.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained and classic wine with aromas of smoke, woodland, graphite, leather, dried cherries and potpourri. Medium-bodied, this shows refined tannins, a velvety texture, crisp acidity and a chewy, dynamic finish with tension and balance. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A mouthwatering version, this red delivers plum, cherry, floral, earth, olive and bay flavors. Backed by vibrant acidity and resonant tannins, leaving a long, expansive finish. Elegant and intense. Best from 2027 through 2040.

santos-fino-blanco.title: Santo Fino Blanco Tequila
santos-fino-blanco.bodyHtml:
When Sammy Hagar gets together with friends in Cabo San Lucas you never know what's coming next. So begins the history behind Santo’s Tequila Blanco and Mezquila - both borne out of good friends, great food, a lot of tequila and the search for a taste revelation: “a higher spirit.”  Together, rocker Sammy Hagar and chef Guy Fieri found their virtuoso with Juan Eduardo Nuñez, the third-generation master distiller from the famed distillery El Viejito, founded in 1937, in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. 

Sammy’s history of making world-renowned tequila, Guy’s world-famous taste buds, and Juan Eduardo’s award-winning craftsmanship, bring to life the portfolio of Santo spirits; a sinfully smooth old world style tequila blanco, an oak-aged reposado, and the world’s first mezquila.

Santo Tequila Blanco is made from only the finest 100% Blue Weber Agave from the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. To the pure, all things are pure.  Their Tequila Blanco is smooth, with balanced and notable agave. Full and complex notes in taste are complimented by earthy, white pepper and citrus aromas. Delicate spice and floral flavors add to the intensity of the agave.

rock-island-sherry.title: Rock Island Sherry
rock-island-sherry.bodyHtml:
Douglas Laing Rock Island Sherry Edition is a limited partner to the core Rock Island blended malt: a marriage of single cask single malts from Scotland's whisky islands, including Islay, Arran, Jura and Orkney, which spent the final stage of its maturation in specially selected Spanish sherry butts. Douglas Laing describes an earthy, sweetly peated style balanced by spicy, sherried warmth – 'spicy sweet meets maritime peat'. It is bottled at 46.8% ABV in a 700ml bottle, without colouring or chill filtration, and was launched to coincide with National Oyster Day.

Food Pairing: Fresh seafood, especially oysters and other shellfish.

Tasting Notes: earthy, sweet peat, sherry spice, maritime

Serve: Neat or with a drop of water.

woodford-reserve-master-five-malt-stout.title: Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Malt Whiskey
woodford-reserve-master-five-malt-stout.bodyHtml:
An incredibly unique and historically significant expression from the Woodford Reserve portfolio. Unlike traditional Scottish single malts which use 100% malt, this expression leans heavily into American bourbon-making traditions by utilizing a mash bill of 51% malted barley, 47% corn, and 2% rye. Aged in heavily charred new American oak barrels and bottled at 90.4 proof, it offers an exceptionally rich, nutty, and sweet profile that beautifully bridges the gap between a classic Kentucky bourbon and a smooth Scottish malt.

 

NOSE

Rich and highly aromatic. Beautiful notes of dark chocolate, toasted nuts, sweet malt, and warm vanilla bean.

PALATE

Smooth, nutty, and slightly sweet. Deep flavors of toasted almond, milk chocolate, and sweet corn are balanced perfectly by gentle oak tannins and a touch of citrus.

FINISH

Clean, warm, and lingering with sweet malt and soft toasted wood.

high-coast-class-serie-02-peated-bourbon.title: High Coast Cigar C.L.A.S.S. 02 Peated Ex-Bourbon Cask Single Malt Swedish Whisky
high-coast-class-serie-02-peated-bourbon.bodyHtml: This release by Truth Malters is part of their Cigar CLASS series which feature unique artwork, and which are ideal for pairing with cigars. Aged 6 years, 9.75 months in ex-Bourbon, the whisky was produced from a heavily peated mash (55ppm). Bottled at 60.9%, only 53 bottles were produced

high-coast-class-serie-02-oloroso-sherry.title: High West Cask Collection Oloroso Sherry Barrel Finish
high-coast-class-serie-02-oloroso-sherry.bodyHtml:
A spectacular, limited-edition release from Utah's celebrated High West Distillery that builds brilliantly upon their legacy of exceptional barrel-finished whiskeys! This expression takes a meticulously selected blend of straight bourbon and straight rye whiskeys (ranging in age from 6 to 10 years) and finishes them for an additional 11 months in freshly emptied Oloroso Sherry casks. Bottled at a robust 100 proof (50% ABV), this secondary maturation imparts an incredibly deep, rich, and dark-fruit-forward complexity to the spicy, robust whiskey blend, resulting in an elegant and deeply layered sipping experience.

 

NOSE

Rich and highly inviting with complex aromas of smoked blackberries, sticky dates, warm vanilla bean, fresh waffles, and a touch of herbal amaro.

PALATE

Thick, velvety, and deeply layered. Lush, dessert-like flavors of blood orange reduction, cherry compote, and caramel shortbread drizzled with dark chocolate are beautifully balanced by cinnamon bark and a hint of dry tobacco.

FINISH

Long, luxurious, and elegant with a lingering, sweet trail of spiced baked apples and creamy vanilla.

champalou-vouvray-sec.title: Champalou Vouvray Sec 2023
champalou-vouvray-sec.bodyHtml:
Champalou Vouvray Sec 2023 is a crisp, highly aromatic, and beautifully balanced French white wine produced by Catherine, Didier, and Céline Champalou in the heart of the Loire Valley. Visually displaying a pale, brilliant yellow hue with faint greenish reflections, it opens with an inviting bouquet of white peach, crisp green apple, quince, and lemon blossom, interwoven with subtle hints of honeyed pear, white flowers, and crushed chalk. On the palate, it exhibits a light-to-medium body defined by a striking beam of vibrant acidity, delivering a fresh core of stone fruit and citrus flavors that flow seamlessly into a dry, persistent, and intensely mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh goat cheese, roasted poultry, grilled trout, oysters, shellfish, pork tenderloin, and light summer salads.

querciabella-chianti-classico-docg.title: Querciabella Chianti Classico 2021 750ml
querciabella-chianti-classico-docg.bodyHtml:
Bright ruby-red core with a slight purple hue. Aromas of rose, violet, redcurrant cherries and juniper berries with a hint of licorice. Juicy on the palate, confirming the red berry fruits on the nose. Fine tannins that integrate perfectly with nice acidity. Persistent finish with a pleasant, savory note. Enjoyable now with classic Tuscan dishes as well as fish and sashimi.

93 Points - James Suckling

Pure fruit on the nose, with rose hips, cherries, blueberries, lemon leaves and dried flowers. Medium-bodied with tangy acidity and firm tannins. Vibrant and elegant, with such purity of fruit. From organically grown grapes. Vegan. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2020 Chianti Classico is impressive and pure, with ripe black cherry, a hint of blue fruit, violets, and sweet herbs. It is medium to full-bodied, with supple fruit throughout, fine grained tannins, and a polished feel. It displays fresh acidity without any harsh edges, but it is mouthwatering and compels returning for more. This beautiful wine from Querciabella is drinking well now, and I imagine will continue to improve over the coming decade or more.

92 Points - Decanter

With an annual production of approximately 150,000 bottles, this is Querciabella’s calling card – and an impressive one at that. It also gives an incisive panoramic shot of the Chianti Classico region as it's a blend of estate vineyards in three different subzones. Bright and fresh, the 2020 annata emerges energetically out of the glass with exuberant and pure red cherry and currants. It gains intrigue with stylish touches of mocha, tarragon and truffles. It's full and vigorous yet light on its feet thanks to radiant acidity, while well-formed tannins lend just the right amount of chew. As suave as it is characterful.

la-mozza-i-perazzi-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Vint Bourbon Barrel Aged Cabernet Sauvignon
la-mozza-i-perazzi-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Deep rich ruby. Aromas of blackberry cobbler, ripe and dark mixed berries, graham cracker, brown sugar, vanilla, milk chocolate, toasty oak, with notes of coffee and smoke. On the palate, ripe blackberry cobbler, blueberry pie, pralines, sweet vanilla custard, brown sugar, caramel, mocha with hints of coffee. Ripe, dense and soft chewy tannins with toasty oak round the wine out with a lush, long, and lingering finish. A superb accompaniment to bourbon glazed ribs, charcuterie board, hearty pasta dishes, and strong cheeses.

gerard-bertrand-joy-rose.title: Gerard Bertrand Cote des Roses Rose 2025
gerard-bertrand-joy-rose.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Côte des Roses Rosé 2025 is a fresh, elegant, and vibrant Mediterranean rosé produced by Gérard Bertrand in the Languedoc region. Presented in its signature rose-shaped glass bottle, it is crafted from a classic blend of Grenache, Syrah, and Cinsault harvested from coastal vineyards. In the glass, it displays a soft, pale pink hue with brilliant reflections. The nose opens with inviting aromas of fresh redcurrant, cassis, pink grapefruit, and subtle floral notes of rose. On the palate, it is crisp, full, and wonderfully balanced, delivering lively fruit flavors, clean citrus zesty acidity, and a smooth, refreshing finish with subtle mineral undertones.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh shellfish, grilled salmon, crab cakes, cold turkey sandwiches, light salads, subtle spicy dishes, and goat cheese.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is a lovely afternoon sipper, starting with lean, brisk and clear aromas of watermelon rind and restrained bubblegum. The palate picks up banana flower and lightly tropical flavors, though stays delicate and refreshing.

chateau-cheval-blanc-grand-cru-2014.title: Leclerc Briant Chateau D'Avize 2014
chateau-cheval-blanc-grand-cru-2014.bodyHtml:
Leclerc Briant Chateau D'Avize 2014 is an elegant Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Champagne crafted exclusively from Chardonnay. Layers of citrus, white flowers, chalky minerality, and fine brioche are balanced by vibrant acidity and a persistent mousse, delivering precision, depth, and remarkable freshness.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, lobster, scallops, sushi, and creamy cheeses.

chateau-pavie-st-emilion-grand-cru-2016.title: Chateau La Mondotte 2016
chateau-pavie-st-emilion-grand-cru-2016.bodyHtml:
Château La Mondotte is an iconic Premier Grand Cru Classé Saint-Émilion with intense aromas of blackberry, black cherry, cassis, violet, graphite, licorice, and fine oak spice. Powerful yet remarkably elegant, it delivers velvety tannins, exceptional concentration, mineral freshness, and extraordinary aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle-infused dishes, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté cheese.

 

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Not far off the magical 2015, the 2016 La Mondotte comes from a tiny vineyard of clay and limestone soil located next to Pavie Decesse. A blend of 85% Merlot and 15% Cabernet Franc, this behemoth boasts a deep purple color as well as a brilliant array of crème de cassis, blackcurrants, crushed rocks, and graphite. Full-bodied and beautifully concentrated, with liquid minerality emerging with time in the glass, this legendary Saint-Émilion in the making needs 5-7 years of bottle age and will keep for 3-4 decades.

97 Points - James Suckling

So much black truffle and blueberry on the nose. Decadent and aromatic. Wet soil. Indian ink. Full-bodied, polished and so velvety with fantastic depth of fruit and ripe tannins, yet powerful and fresh. Slightly minerally and salty underneath.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Made by the winemaking team of Canon la Gaffelière, this wine is stylishly elegant, restrained in its structure and tannins. Its intensely juicy character is already attractive, giving the wine almost a refreshing character. This balanced wine will be ready from 2025.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This shows a dark, toasty style at first, with notes of ganache and plum reduction, but it unwinds steadily and slowly, revealing pure cassis, cherry and raspberry fruit flavors gilded liberally with violet and anise accents. The long finish is laced with a superfine chalky minerality that imparts mouthwatering cut even as the fruit gains steam. Best from 2023 through 2038.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 La Mondotte is a blend of 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc this year, picked between 29 September and 15 October and matured in 70% new oak. The alcohol level is around 14.5%. It has a lucid purple hue in the glass. The bouquet is very perfumed, very pure with luscious red cherries, blueberry and a hint of sloes, the new oak discrete and allowing the terroir to shine through perhaps more than the 2015 last year. The palate is silky smooth on the entry, but underneath the bonnet, there is considerable tannic backbone that certainly can be felt more towards the finish that exerts a light grip. In a strange way, it reminds me a little of Château Canon! Give this 4-5 years once in bottle.

silk-tassel-1.title: Silk Tassel
silk-tassel-1.bodyHtml:
Silk Tassel Canadian Whisky is a long-established Canadian blend from Quebec, aged in oak and blended from hand-selected barrels. Sold for decades as McGuinness Silk Tassel, the brand later dropped the McGuinness name from its label. It shows a rye-and-spice character with butterscotch, vanilla and orange peel, and is at its best as a mixer. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Rye spice, butterscotch, vanilla and orange peel.

Nose: Rye and wood spice with butterscotch, vanilla and orange zest, opening to dusty grain and dry hay.

Palate: Dry rye grain, light butterscotch and vanilla, warm wood spice and orange peel.

Finish: Short, with rye spice and orange peel.

Serve: In a highball with ginger ale or cola.

ruinart-rose.title: Ruinart Brut Rose
ruinart-rose.bodyHtml:
A sustainable luxury innovation from the first house of Champagne, made entirely from recyclable paper, preserves the quality of the wine, while reducing the carbon footprint by 60% vs the traditional gift box.

On the palate the attack is distinctive and full, cradled by a gentle effervescence. The balance brings together delightful freshness and a voluptuous body. An elegant burst of peppermint and pink grapefruit rounds out this cheeky palette of aromas.

The nose offers intense notes of exotic fruits (pomegranate, lychee and guava) that develop alongside soft floral essences (rose) and notes of freshly picked red fruits (cherry, raspberry and wild strawberry). These aromas splendidly showcase the wine’s subtle, spicy notes (tonka bean and nutmeg).

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A gorgeous rosé in a rich, vinous style, this shows a satiny mousse and well-honed acidity, which buoy a detailed range of macerated raspberry fruit, dried apricot, grated ginger, graphite and chopped roasted almond flavors. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Drink now through 2025.

92 Points - James Suckling

Rather dark-colored with cherry, watermelon and stone undertones. Full-bodied and layered, with iron and strawberry at the end. Drink now.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The latest rendition of Ruinart's NV Brut Rosé is a pretty, vibrant wine that offers up inviting aromas of tangerine, blood orange, plum and freshly baked bread. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and precise, with tangy acids and a pretty mousse, it's ca harming, comparatively vinous wine that is already showing well.

speri-valpolicella-ripasso-doc.title: Speri Valpolicella Ripasso Classico Superiore 2023
speri-valpolicella-ripasso-doc.bodyHtml:
A deep intense ruby red color, with hints of red fruit, spices and cocoa on the nose. Warming and smooth on the palate, nicely balanced by rounded tannins.

Perfectly matches with meat and cheese based dishes.

93 Points - James Suckling

Intense, graceful and perfumed, with sweet violets, blood oranges, dry mushrooms, pomegranates and black pepper. Silky and supple on the palate with medium body, crisp and brilliant acidity and firm, crunchy tannins. Long, savory and balanced.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

The tang of plum skin acidity is a pleasing counterpoint to flavors of Amarena cherry, spiced orange peel, dark chocolate, plus fragrant accents of dried thyme, graphite and baking spices. Lightly chalky tannins provide a focused frame that carries the well-balanced profile through the lasting, minerally finish. Drink now through 2035.

santa-teresa-gran-reserva-anejo-rum.title: Ron Abuelo Anejo 12 Year Old Gran Reserva Rum
santa-teresa-gran-reserva-anejo-rum.bodyHtml: A smooth and rich tasting rum from Panama where Abuelo grows its own sugar cane which from which they extract molasses for their rums. This is highly rated amonst rum enthusiasts.

mikes-hard-lemonade-variety-pack.title: Mike's Hard Lemonade Variety Pack 12 cans

justin-jnsq-rose.title: JNSQ Rosé Cru 2020
justin-jnsq-rose.bodyHtml: JNSQ Rosé Cru is summer in a glass, no matter what the calendar says. This Grenache-forward Rosé is clean and aromatic with a touch of strawberry and hints of Bing cherry. The dynamic flavors are accented with savory herbal and white floral notes that make it crisp and elegant, perfect for sipping by the pool, serving at a barbecue, or toasting over a candlelit dinner.

absolut-mango-mule.title: Absolut Mango Mule 4 Cans
absolut-mango-mule.bodyHtml:
Made with Absolut Vodka, all natural flavors, real fruit juice and second to none mixology expertise, we are bringing those highly sophisticated cocktails to your spur of the moment get-togethers.

By finding inspiration from our undisputed classics Absolut Moscow Mule, we might actually have invented another one. Our pre-prepared, ready-to-sip Absolut Mango Mule brings that balance of sweet and crisp tropical mango and spicy hot ginger, with a level of quality that you can only expect from your favorite cocktail bars.

Best enjoyed chilled straight from the can or – if you are an abiding advocate of tradition and chill keeping – served in a copper cup with garnish.

rampur-asava.title: Rampur Asava Indian Single Malt Whisky
rampur-asava.bodyHtml:
Rampur Asava Indian Single Malt Whisky is a single malt whisky produced at Radico Khaitan's Rampur Distillery situated in the foothills of the Himalayas in Uttar Pradesh, India. Matured initially in American ex-bourbon barrels and finished in casks that previously held Indian Cabernet Sauvignon wine, this non-chill filtered expression harmonizes Rampur's signature tropical fruit and malt character with the subtle tannins and rich fruitiness of Indian red wine.

Food Pairing: Tandoori chicken, grilled lamb chops, spicy Indian curries, roasted duck, aged cheddar, dark chocolate desserts, and dried fruit tarts.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant golden amber with copper hues, featuring a velvety, smooth, and medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Typical tropical fruit aromas of Rampur layered with apricot, blackberry, and plum, followed by a subtle hint of tobacco and warming spices.

Palate : Velvety and balanced with manuka honey sweetness, spicy oak, vanilla, and the structured dryness of Indian red wine.

Finish : Medium-to-long, lingering with warm spice, soft oak, sweet honey, and lingering wine tannins.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature, or with a few drops of pure water to release the layered tropical and red wine aromas.

jose-cuervo-playamar-mango.title: Jose Cuervo Playamar Mango 4 Cans
jose-cuervo-playamar-mango.bodyHtml: Jose Cuervo® Playamar® Hard Seltzer Mango is crafted using Cuervo tequila plus natural mango flavors. The result is a fizzy seltzer with a distinct, tropical taste. Its aroma is of buttery, sweet mango flesh with tropical floral backnotes. Its flavor starts bright citrus, followed by creamy mango puree and agave. All this flavor with only 90 calories per 355ml (12oz) can. The new hard seltzer flavor from the #1 selling tequila and the #1 selling prepared cocktails brand – Jose Cuervo. (ABV 4.5% - 9 proof).

rampur-double-cask.title: Rampur Double Cask Indian Single Malt Whisky
rampur-double-cask.bodyHtml:
Rampur Double Cask Indian Single Malt Whisky is a single malt whisky produced at Radico Khaitan's Rampur Distillery situated in the foothills of the Himalayas in Uttar Pradesh, India. Non-chill filtered and matured in a combination of American oak ex-bourbon barrels and European oak Oloroso sherry casks, this expression combines tropical fruit and warm spice notes with rich sherry depth.

Food Pairing: Tandoori meats, spicy curry, roasted duck, smoked venison, aged Gouda, dark chocolate desserts, and fruit tarts.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance, offering a smooth, warm, and medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Tropical fruits, dried fruits, and vanilla, accompanied by sweet malt, subtle oak, and warm baking spices.

Palate : Rich and well-rounded with flavors of sherry sweetness, dried fruit, honey, tropical fruits, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet oak, dried fruit, and soft spice.

Serve : Best served neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature, or with a few drops of pure water to open up the tropical fruit and sherry aromas.

diabolica-red.title: Diabolica Wines Red Wine 750ml
diabolica-red.bodyHtml: This blend explodes with juice in your mouth but still has that definite structure and complexity familiar to those of you who enjoy wines from the Okanagan Valley. Red cherry, pomegranate and violet are on the nose and continue with your first lush sip.

appleton-signature-rum-1.title: Appleton Estate Signature Blend Rum 375ml
appleton-signature-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Appleton Estate Signature Blend Rum is the flagship expression from Jamaica's oldest continuously operating sugarcane estate, located in the lush Nassau Valley. Crafted by legendary Master Blender Joy Spence, this spirit is a masterful blend of 15 different column and traditional copper pot still rums. Aged in the island’s tropical climate in small, selection-vatted American oak barrels, it offers a beautifully balanced, fruit-forward profile that serves as the gold standard for Jamaican mixing rums.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with traditional Jamaican jerk chicken, barbecued pork ribs, and spicy empanadas. It also makes an exceptional companion to grilled pineapples, coconut tarts, and premium dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance, offering a smooth, medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Ripe banana, dried apricot, orange peel, molasses, toasted oak, and subtle warm spices.

Palate : Smooth and round with flavors of sweet molasses, dried tropical fruits, nutmeg, orange zest, and gentle oak.

Finish : Medium-long, clean, and crisp with lingering notes of warm spice and sweet citrus peel.

Serve : Best served on the rocks, or as a versatile base in classic cocktails such as a Mai Tai, Rum Punch, or Jamaica Mule.

polar-ice-vodka-4.title: Polar Ice Vodka
polar-ice-vodka-4.bodyHtml:
Polar Ice is a Canadian vodka made from water and grain, distilled four times and filtered three times for a clean, smooth, crisp taste. It is made for mixing in cocktails or enjoying straight on the rocks. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: On the rocks, shaken, or in a vodka mojito.

malibu-strawberry-daiquiri.title: Malibu Strawberry Daiquiri Ready to Serve Cocktail
malibu-strawberry-daiquiri.bodyHtml:
Malibu Strawberry Daiquiri is a ready-to-serve take on the classic frozen-bar favourite, made with white rum and strawberry flavour. Made in Ontario and packed in a 1 litre carton at 12.5% ABV, it needs no mixing or blender: the carton holds about seven cocktails, ready to pour straight over ice for patios, parties and summer get-togethers.

Serve: Chill, then pour over ice and garnish with a fresh strawberry.

bacardi-mai-tai-ready-to-serve.title: Bacardi Mojito Cocktail Ready to Serve
bacardi-mai-tai-ready-to-serve.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Mojito Ready to Serve is a bottled Mojito from Bacardí's Ready to Serve range, built on a base of Bacardí rum. The label describes it as a premium rum cocktail made with lime juice and natural mint flavours and sweetened with cane sugar, and Bacardí notes that it is made with natural flavours and real ingredients. There is nothing to muddle or measure: simply pour it over ice. Bottled at 12.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a convenient choice for summer gatherings, picnics and patios when you want a crisp, minty rum drink without the work.

Serve: Chill and pour over ice; top with a splash of soda and garnish with mint and lime if you like.

absolut-grapefruit-paloma.title: Absolut Grapefruit Paloma 4 Cans
absolut-grapefruit-paloma.bodyHtml:
With our range of Absolut Cocktails featuring Grapefruit Paloma, Mango Mule and Berry Vodkarita, we believe we have hit the sweet spot between mixology and convenience. Made with Absolut Vodka, all natural flavors, real fruit juice and second to none mixology expertise, we are bringing those highly sophisticated cocktails to your spur of the moment parties.

Our Absolut Grapefruit Paloma pre-mix is sweet, sour, a little bitter with a bit of spice. Add Absolut Vodka, a little fizz and leave out the fuss of making it yourself. Great for your sunny spring day picnics, perfect for those summertime vibes. What’s not to like?

sway-vodka-soda-variety-pack.title: Nude Stiff Vodka Soda Variety Pack

canadian-club-ginger-2.title: Canadian Club & Ginger Ale 473ml Can
canadian-club-ginger-2.bodyHtml: Canadian Club and ginger ale were both created around in the 1850s, making this a historically delicious combination. This pre-mixed cocktail expertly blends the smooth honeyed notes of grain and spice of Canadian Club whisky with the sweet, candied notes of ginger ale. Pair it with saucy barbecued ribs or spicy curries.

unanime.title: Mascota Unanime Gran Vino Tinto 2021
unanime.bodyHtml:
The Mascota Unanime Gran Vino Tinto 2021 is an Argentinian red blend primarily consisting of 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Malbec, and 15% Cabernet Franc. It is characterized by its deep cherry-red colour and a complex aromatic profile that includes notes of chocolate, tobacco, and black pepper. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is structured and generous, offering flavors of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, and dried mint, all balanced by fine-grained tannins and a fresh, juicy acidity. . 

93 Points - James Suckling

Tarry blackberries, sweet dark cherries, creme de cassis, graphite and black bean sauce. Flavorful and full-bodied on the palate with a rich core of ripe, dark berries and tight, fine-grained tannins. Long, rich and voluptuous. 60% cabernet sauvignon, 25% malbec and 15% cabernet franc. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Blackberries and plums shape an aromatic nose. The palate feels plush, with round tannins and enjoyable dried herbs that complement the dark fruit flavors. It's a Cabernet-based blend, with laser-focused acidity and smoky notes in the aftertaste.

mcmanis-cabernet-sauvignon.title: McManis Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
mcmanis-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
McManis Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 is a rich, expressive, and fruit-forward red wine produced by McManis Family Vineyards from sustainably farmed estate vineyards in California's Central Valley. Dark garnet in hue, it opens with inviting aromatics of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, cassis, and subtle hints of vanilla, cedar, and toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and delightfully smooth, offering a juicy core of dark berries, mocha, and gentle spice framed by soft, creamy tannins and a balanced, clean finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled burgers, braised short ribs, pepperoni pizza, roasted chicken, mushroom risotto, and mild cheeses like Monterey Jack.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine is concentrated, with lush aromatics of dark blackberries, boysenberries, cinnamon, orange zest, and on the nose. supple acidity on the finish. The flavors on the palate are supple, rich, but not saturated, the lingering notes of mulberry, cassis, and red currant confiture, layered with mocha, cigar and silky tannins.

silver-ghost-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Silver Ghost Cellars Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
silver-ghost-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Silver Ghost Oakville Napa Cabernet Sauvignon (CS) is a full-bodied, richly expressive Cabernet Sauvignon from Napa Valley's Oakville region. It's known for its deep color, vibrant nose of blueberries, violets, and crème de cassis, and a palate revealing layers of red and blue fruits, mocha, and dark spice. The wine has a luxurious texture and long finish.

barr-an-uisce-16-year-old-limitid.title: Barr an Uisce 1803 16 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
barr-an-uisce-16-year-old-limitid.bodyHtml:
Barr an Uisce 1803 16 Year Old is a limited edition Irish single malt from Barr an Uisce, a brand named after the townland of Barraniskey in County Wicklow (the Irish words mean "above the water"). The whiskey spent 16 years in first-fill Kentucky bourbon barrels, long enough for the cereal character of the malted barley to merge with the vanilla, toasted coconut and caramelised notes of the American white oak. Only 1,803 bottles were produced, each numbered by hand, and it is bottled at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Bright gold, with citrus, toffee and vanilla over toasty oak.

Nose: Mandarin citrus first, then butterscotch, toffee and caramelised aromas.

Palate: Oily and mellow, with hints of toffee and vanilla.

Finish: Some spice, with toasty oak lingering.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

silk-spice-red-blend.title: Silk and Spice Red Blend
silk-spice-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Silk & Spice Red Blend is a rich, smooth, and approachable Portuguese red wine created as a tribute to the historic 15th-century spice routes. It opens with intense, inviting aromas of ripe black plum, blackberry jam, and warm sweet spices like vanilla, cinnamon, and mocha. On the palate, it delivers a plush, full-bodied structure with velvety soft tannins, balanced acidity, and a long, savory-sweet finish layered with oak spice nuances.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled meats, juicy beef burgers, tomato-based lasagna, sausage stews, pork chops, and savory barbecue dishes.

gp-vodka.title: GP Vodka 1.75L
gp-vodka.bodyHtml:
GP Vodka (also known as GP Brewing Handcrafted Vodka) is a smooth, easy-drinking Canadian craft spirit distilled by GP Brewing Company in Grande Prairie, Alberta. Multiple times distilled and constantly filtered for exceptional clarity, it is cut with pure glacier water to achieve a crisp, refreshing character.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with sour cream and caviar, fresh oysters, cured meats, and light appetizers.

Tasting Notes : Colorless, clear, and bright in appearance, providing a crisp, light, and exceptionally smooth mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and neutral with faint, subtle hints of fresh grain.

Palate : Soft, clean, and smooth with subtle grain sweetness and crisp, pure water undertones.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing.

Serve : Served well-chilled neat, over ice, or as a smooth base in classic mixed drinks and cocktails.

gp-vodka-1.title: GP Vodka 1.75L
gp-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
GP Vodka (also known as GP Brewing Handcrafted Vodka) is a smooth, easy-drinking Canadian craft spirit distilled by GP Brewing Company in Grande Prairie, Alberta. Multiple times distilled and constantly filtered for exceptional clarity, it is cut with pure glacier water to achieve a crisp, refreshing character.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with sour cream and caviar, fresh oysters, cured meats, and light appetizers.

Tasting Notes : Colorless, clear, and bright in appearance, providing a crisp, light, and exceptionally smooth mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and neutral with faint, subtle hints of fresh grain.

Palate : Soft, clean, and smooth with subtle grain sweetness and crisp, pure water undertones.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing.

Serve : Served well-chilled neat, over ice, or as a smooth base in classic mixed drinks and cocktails.

chivas-regal-xv-15-year-old.title: Chivas Regal XV 15 Year Old
chivas-regal-xv-15-year-old.bodyHtml:
Nose: Rich and sweet with concentrated notes of stewed red apples, homemade orange marmalade, honey, cinnamon and juicy sultanas.

Palate: Incredibly smooth and fruity. Flavours of poached pears intermingled with butterscotch and caramel toffee, all rolled up in a wonderfully velvety texture.

Finish: Rounded with a touch of vanilla on the finish.

Cask Finish: A portion of this blended Scotch whisky is finished in cognac casks for a refined, fruity and velvety taste.

linkwood-10-year-old-james-eadie.title: James Eadie Small Batch The Peacock Linkwood 10 Year Old 2010
linkwood-10-year-old-james-eadie.bodyHtml:
Linkwood 10 Year Old 'The Peacock' is a small-batch single malt Scotch from the Linkwood distillery in Speyside, bottled by James Eadie. Three re-charred hogsheads (casks 310619, 310620 and 310621), filled on 15 September 2010, were combined and bottled in 2021, yielding 1,182 bottles. The release takes its name from the peacocks illustrated on the label. It is bottled at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Nose: Floral and citrus notes with tangy orange peel and honey, lemon sherbet and icing sugar, plus light touches of cut grass and pear drops.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

patron-extra-anejo-tequila-1.title: Patrón Extra Añejo Tequila
patron-extra-anejo-tequila-1.bodyHtml:
Patrón Extra Añejo is the extra-aged member of Patrón's core range, made at Hacienda Patrón in Atotonilco El Alto, in the highlands of Jalisco (NOM 1492), from 100% Weber Blue agave. It rests for a minimum of three years in a combination of American, French and Hungarian oak barrels, which deepens the colour and adds wood and spice while keeping the cooked agave in view. It pours a bright, dark gold, with dried fruit, vanilla and a light banana note on the nose, followed by a fruity palate of light agave, honey and vanilla and an oaky finish with more vanilla and dried fruit. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it rewards slow sipping and can also replace whiskey in stirred cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

Tasting Notes: dried fruit, vanilla, banana, agave, honey, oak

Nose: Dried fruit, vanilla and light banana.

Palate: Fruity, with light agave, honey and vanilla.

Finish: Oak, vanilla and dried fruit.

Serve: Neat, over a large cube, or in place of whiskey in an Old Fashioned.

chateau-de-la-gardine-cotes-du-rhone-vil.title: Chateau De La Gardine Cotes Du Rhone Villages 2023
chateau-de-la-gardine-cotes-du-rhone-vil.bodyHtml:
Château de La Gardine Côtes du Rhône Villages 2023 is a classic, expressive Southern Rhône red wine bottled in the estate's signature, heavy-moulded Anonyme bottle. Dominated by Grenache alongside Syrah and Mourvèdre, it displays a deep ruby color with purple highlights. The nose opens with inviting aromas of ripe dark cherries, crushed raspberries, cracked black pepper, and subtle garrigue herbs. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, soft, and fruit-forward, featuring plush flavors of juicy dark berries and baking spices supported by fine-grained tannins and a balanced, warming finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted lamb chops, grilled sausages, beef stews, ratatouille, and herb-crusted pork tenderloin.

tinhorn-creek-cabernet-franc-vqa.title: Tinhorn Creek Cabernet Franc 2022
tinhorn-creek-cabernet-franc-vqa.bodyHtml: Tinhorn Creek Cabernet Franc is a quintessential example of South Okanagan winemaking, celebrated for its ability to balance the natural elegance of the varietal with the intensity of a warm desert climate. Sourced primarily from the Diamondback Vineyard on the Black Sage Bench, this wine is meticulously crafted using sustainable practices and aged in a combination of French and American oak to enhance its structural complexity. On the nose, it reveals a charming bouquet of ripe black cherries, plums, and dusty cocoa, nuanced by classic herbal undertones and a hint of violet. The palate is medium-bodied and harmonious, featuring fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that provides a tactile profile often compared to a well-crafted Chianti, yet with a distinct New World fruit-forward freshness. As a longtime champion of the varietal in British Columbia, Tinhorn Creek continues to produce a Cabernet Franc that is both approachable in its youth and capable of sophisticated evolution over several years in the cellar.

church-state-cabernet-franc.title: Church And State Cabernet Franc 2018 750ml
church-state-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml: This bold, ripe cabernet franc comes from Foundation Vineyard in the South Okanagan, showing cherry compote and dried stemmy herbs that are shrouded in smoke. That smoke dries out the finish, leaving this rather harsh and astringent. A good effort in a challenging vintage, this medium-full bodied cabernet franc will pair nicely with grilled dried ribs.

mure-mure-malbec-low-sulphites.title: Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023
mure-mure-malbec-low-sulphites.bodyHtml:
Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023 is a powerful yet incredibly elegant Argentine red crafted by Dr. Laura Catena, highlighting the genetic diversity and depth of Mendoza's historic, low-yielding vines. Sourced from high-altitude, ungrafted vines (averaging over 50 years old) across premier subregions of the Uco Valley—including La Consulta, Gualtallary, and Paraje Altamira—it pours a deep, luminous purplish-red. The nose is inviting and complex, offering expressive aromas of dark plums, ripe black cherries, and wild berries, thoughtfully accented by notes of cocoa, bark, charcoal, and subtle dried herbs. On the palate, it is precise, linear, and gracefully structured, showcasing a juicy core of crunchy red and blue fruit balanced by velvety, approachable tannins and a vibrant vein of natural acidity. Matured for 12 months in a combination of new and second-use French oak barrels, it delivers a deeply refined and stylish finish laced with savory hints of espresso and bright mineral tension.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with grilled venison, traditional Argentine ribeye steak with chimichurri, roasted lamb shanks, hearty pork roast, or medium-strong cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

This shows plums, bark and charcoal on the nose. The palate is precise, sharp, linear and super elegant, with velvety tannins and crunchy fruit. It’s long, refined and very stylish. Drink now.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Old Vine Malbec combines ungrafted vines from six Uco Valley growers who previously sold grapes for use in bulk wines. It was destemmed and fermented in stainless tank before maturing for 12 months in 35% new barrique. Opening with a pleasant nose of red and blue fruits, anise and dried spices, the palate is plush and straightforward, concluding with a lifted, fragrant finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose reveals enticing aromas of crushed berries leading the way to a juicy palate filled with rich dark fruit flavors and a hint of rosemary. Framed by gripping tannins and vibrant acidity, this full-bodied Malbec features a distinctive chalky texture and a long lasting finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Hints of roasted herbs and loam lead but quickly give way to the core flavors of Santa Rosa plum and cherry, culminating with crunchy acidity, mineral and cocoa powder notes that fill out the structured finish.

chateau-bel-air-rouge.title: Chateau Villa Bel-Air Graves 2019
chateau-bel-air-rouge.bodyHtml:
Château Villa Bel-Air Graves 2019 is a refined and elegant red Bordeaux blend crafted under the guidance of renowned consultant Stéphane Derenoncourt. Cultivated on the classic gravelly soils of the appellation, this wine reveals a fresh, expressive bouquet of crushed blackcurrants, ripe raspberries, oyster shells, and dried herbs, accented by subtle hints of forest floor and toasted cocoa. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, well-balanced, and juicy, driven by powdery, smooth tannins and a vibrant, mineral-laced acidity that leads to a lively, approachable, and earthy finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs wonderfully with grilled beef steak, roasted lamb chops, earthy mushroom risotto, or an assortment of medium-aged cheeses like Comté or Gouda.

90 Points - James Suckling
This has aromas of blackcurrants, oyster shells, dried herbs, lemon peel and forest floor. It’s medium-bodied with powdery tannins. Earthy and dusty character. 50% merlot, 40% cabernet sauvignon and 10% cabernet franc. Drink from 2023.

willakenzie-estate-gisele-pinot-noir.title: WillaKenzie Estate Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2021 750ml
willakenzie-estate-gisele-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
This wine offers notes of black cherry, black raspberry, rosewater, and rooibos tea along with hints of baking spice. Those flavors carry onto a supple and balanced palate with refined tannins and great length.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Fragrant and generous with elegantly structured raspberry and guava flavors that reveal baking spice and black tea accent that build tension toward refined tannins. Drink now through 2031. 5,232 cases made.

90 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of red cherries, moist earth and dried flowers leading to a refreshing palate of red and dark fruit. A medium-bodied wine with smooth tannins and nice balance that has a crunchy, satisfying finish.

gerard-bertrand-domaine-de-villemajou-re.title: Gerard Bertrand Domaine de Villemajou Corbieres Boutenac 2022
gerard-bertrand-domaine-de-villemajou-re.bodyHtml:
Gerard Bertrand Domaine De Villemajou Corbieres Boutenac 2022 is a robust, full-bodied red wine that showcases the exceptional terroir of the Corbières-Boutenac appellation in southern France. Displaying a deep garnet color, it opens with a highly expressive and seductive nose filled with powerful aromas of jammy blackberry, stewed dark plums, and sweet baking spices. As it breathes, complex layers of roasted meat, black olives, leather, coffee, toast, and subtle notes of licorice emerge. On the palate, this biodynamically farmed blend of old-vine Carignan, Syrah, Grenache Noir, and Mourvèdre is rich and concentrated yet elegantly balanced. It delivers a creamy, caressing texture supported by fine, firm tannins and a savory undertone, culminating in a long, intensely flavorful, and slightly spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Outstanding alongside grilled steaks, herb-crusted rack of lamb, osso bucco, rich Mediterranean stews, venison, or aged hard cheeses like sharp cheddar and Manchego.

senses-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2021
senses-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
A compilation of ripe, red and blue fruit ignites the senses with slight undertones of forest rain. Soft and smooth on the palate with pure electric dark berry flavors and deep, unified tannins add volume to a refined finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of umami, seaweed, mushroom and bark follow through to a medium body, with firm and fine velvety tannins and a flavorful finish with a salty undertone at the end. Oyster shell. Drink now.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast was matured in 39% new oak for 15 months. The nose opens slowly from allspice and brown sugar to a core of red cherry and cranberry, tea leaves and lavender. The medium-bodied palate offers surprisingly concentrated fruit supported by grainy tannins and seamless freshness, and it has a long, spicy finish.

les-cassagnes-de-la-nerthe.title: Chateau La Nerthe Les Cassagnes Cotes-Du-Rhone Villages Rouge 2021/2022 750ml
les-cassagnes-de-la-nerthe.bodyHtml:
In the glass this wine is a bright and deep ruby color with purple hints. On the nose there are lots of ripe (but not overripe) fruity notes with little black and red berries. On the palate we discover an elegant suppleness with fresh plum and wild herbs aromas. Tannins are polished, making the wine round and approachable. It is a very balanced red, combining rich flavor with freshness and delicacy.

Blend: 50% Grenache, 40% Syrah, 8% Mourvèdre, 2% Other varieties

92 Points - James Suckling

A round and fruity red with plenty of cherries, wild berries, dried herbs and baking spices. Medium body with fine tannins. Velvety with a caressing texture and a flavorful, juicy finish.

rockbare-mclaren-vale-grenache.title: Rockbare Grenache 2017 750ml
rockbare-mclaren-vale-grenache.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2017 vintage) "This is a pretty delicious grenache with bright cherry fruit and silky tannins. Lively and fresh, it is a lot of fun in the mouth and full of food possibilities. he wine is aged on lees to add complexity and savoury aspects. Well made and would be fun with Vancouver gyoza, pork dumplings, or Bejing duck. The ferment begins with whole berries tipped into open-top fermenters before a three-day cold soak and a cool ferment between 20-25°C for 15 days to retain the aromatics. The finished ferment was pressed through a basket press and run into a stainless steel tank and a few older French oak barriques. (Anthony Gismondi)." - 91/100, Gismondi on Wine

highest-beauty-to-kalon-vineyard.title: To Kalon Vineyard Co Highest Beauty Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
highest-beauty-to-kalon-vineyard.bodyHtml:
The goal for this namesake wine is working with To Kalon Vineyard as a whole, crafting a wine from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, while capturing the purity, intensity, and diversity of this special terroir. With soft tannins, plenty of structure, richness, and aromatic excitement, this wine tells the story of the nearly ideal 2018 growing season. The grapes were harvested at night to preserve the freshness of the fruit. Careful sorting and a long, slow fermentation and maceration round out the wine and bring forward the broad spectrum of flavors and aromas inherent in this noble variety.

99 Points - James Suckling

An intense wine from a super-concentrated vintage, this is totally loaded with ripe fruits, spicy oak and generous savory, minty flavors, wrapped in firm, fine-grained tannins. Black olives, black currants, earthy and sage-like notes. So dark, deep and age-worthy, with great balance for a wine so full-bodied.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

There are 700 cases of the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Highest Beauty, an expression of several blocks of pure Cabernet Sauvignon. Gentle thyme shadings accent black cherries and loamy earth in this rich, full-bodied wine. Coming dangerously close to being over the top, it's ripe and hedonistic, while at the same time developing classic To Kalon notes of baking spices and fine suede on the long, elegant finish.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

A richly fruited version, offering boysenberry, black currant and blackberry puree notes that stream through, yet this stays reserved in style, with a remarkable sense of polish. Loam, licorice root and singed alder elements emerge steadily through the long finish. A lovely late twang of iron adds to the range. Drink now through 2044.

leflaive-puligny-1er-2007.title: Olivier Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet 1er Cru Champ Gain 2023
leflaive-puligny-1er-2007.bodyHtml: A prestigious and highly structured Premier Cru Chardonnay that exemplifies the elegance of Puligny-Montrachet. The 2023 vintage presents an expressive bouquet of citrus blossoms, ripe lemon, and white peach, layered with subtle toasted hazelnuts and a distinctive chalky minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and precise, showing a beautiful tension between its creamy texture and vibrant, racy acidity. Flavours of green apple and almond lead to a long, aristocratic finish marked by intense saline notes and well-integrated French oak.

vogue-bonnes-mares-2019.title: Domaine Comte Georges de Vogue Bonnes-Mares Grand Cru 2022
vogue-bonnes-mares-2019.bodyHtml:
The estate's vines (nearly seven acres) are all located on the Chambolle side of Bonnes-Mares. The terroir here has more red clay (where Morey has more marl and limestone) for a more velvety-textured, rounder wine, with characteristic aromas of violets and wildflowers.

98 Points - James Suckling

This great Bonnes Mares starts cool and restrained, but expands rapidly as it moves over the palate, with delicate, spicy almond and cream character. Mouth-filling and generous yet subtle and light-footed, this is at the upper limit of medium-bodied. Then a huge wave of salty minerality comes through at the finish to give the wine a whole extra dimension and making this an almost overwhelming expression of beauty.

jadot-musigny-1er-cru-les-amoureuses.title: Louis Jadot Chambolle-Musigny Les Amoureuses Premier Cru 2020
jadot-musigny-1er-cru-les-amoureuses.bodyHtml:
This deeply colored wine shows subtle aromas of violets and spices, and round, firm flavors on the palate, with quite powerful tannins. This is a wine to age, and will improve in the bottle for 15 to 20 years.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

There are two barrels of the brilliant 2020 Chambolle-Musigny 1er Cru Les Amoureuses (Domaine Louis Jadot), an arresting wine that bursts from the glass with aromas of rose petals, orange rind, cherries, red berries, sweet spices and musk. Medium to full-bodied, velvety and enveloping, it's fine-boned and elegant, with a deep core of fruit and a long, perfumed finish. It's one of the finest wines in the cellar this year.

ardbeg-cask-2323.title: Ardbeg 10 Year Old
ardbeg-cask-2323.bodyHtml:
Ardbeg 10 Year Old is a world-renowned Islay single malt Scotch whisky revered by peat enthusiasts for its intensely smoky, complex, and surprisingly balanced profile. Distilled on the rugged south coast of Islay, it is matured for a minimum of ten years in a combination of first-fill and second-fill American oak ex-bourbon casks. Bottled non-chill-filtered at 46% ABV to preserve maximum flavor and texture, it showcases Ardbeg's signature phenolic peat smoke—drawn from heavily peated malted barley—alongside bright lemon and lime zest, coastal sea spray, and creamy vanilla sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh Pacific oysters, smoked salmon, grilled langoustines, barbecued pork ribs, dark chocolate truffles, and pungent blue cheeses such as Roquefort or Stilton.

Tasting Notes : Pale straw gold with bright platinum highlights, presenting a full, oily body with a rich and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense bonfire peat smoke, fresh lemon and lime zest, coastal sea brine, cracked black pepper, sweet vanilla, and subtle menthol.

Palate : Explosive peat smoke balanced by bright citrus fruits, sweet malted cereal, espresso, dark chocolate, tarry rope, and creamy toffee.

Finish : Very long, smoky, and warming with lingering notes of sea salt, toasted malt, charred oak, and sweet aniseed.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip-shaped whisky tasting glass, or add a few drops of pure water to tame the intense smoke and highlight the underlying citrus and vanilla sweetness.

barrell-craft-stellum-bourbon.title: Stellum Rye Whiskey
barrell-craft-stellum-bourbon.bodyHtml:
The identity of Stellum Rye is rooted in a tried and true 95% Rye Indiana mash bill. To enhance this classic style, we incorporate small amounts of more barley-forward rye and choice barrels from both Kentucky and Tennessee. This brings a full, round mouthfeel and flashes of buttery sweetness to an otherwise spicy and tightly focused Rye Whiskey.

  • A blend of straight Rye Whiskeys
  • Distilled and Aged in TN, KY, IN
  • Bottled in Kentucky
  • 116.24 proof cask strength bottling
    • AWARDS

    • San Francisco World Spirits Competition (2021) – DOUBLE gold
    • Ultimate Spirits Challenge (2021) – 94 points
    • Ascot Awards (2021) – DOUBLE platinum
    • John Barleycorn Awards (2021) – gold
    • L.A. spirits awards (2021) – platinum, best rye whiskey, best whiskey
    • New York International Spirits Competition (2021) – double Gold

barrell-craft-stellum-rye-whisky.title: Stellum Rye Whiskey
barrell-craft-stellum-rye-whisky.bodyHtml:

barrell-craft-armida-bourbon.title: Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon
barrell-craft-armida-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon is a landmark Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey widely recognized as the world's first commercially available single barrel bourbon, introduced in 1984 by Master Distiller Elmer T. Lee. Named in honor of Colonel Albert B. Blanton, who spent over five decades managing the historic Buffalo Trace Distillery (formerly the George T. Stagg Distillery), each bottle is drawn from an individual cask aged in the center-cut section of Warehouse H—the only metal-clad warehouse on the distillery grounds, known for rapid temperature fluctuations that accelerate wood interaction. Crafted from Buffalo Trace's high-rye Mashbill #2 and bottled at 93 proof, it delivers a rich, complex, and remarkably balanced profile of sweet vanilla, citrus, caramel, and warm baking spices, housed in its iconic round bottle topped with a collectible cast-metal horse and jockey stopper.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-smoked beef brisket, glazed pork ribs, seared duck breast, aged sharp cheddar or Gouda, dark chocolate pecan tarts, and warm bread pudding with caramel sauce.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber with warm copper-orange highlights, presenting a full, rich body with a velvety, smooth, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Warm vanilla, honey, caramel, dried orange peel, toasted oak, nutmeg, and subtle rye spice.

Palate : Rich and creamy with flavors of burnt sugar, sweet corn, dark toffee, clove, cinnamon, citrus zest, and seasoned charred oak.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warming with lingering notes of sweet vanilla, baking spices, honey, and subtle dry oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or rocks glass, over a single large ice cube, or as the rich centerpiece in classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

barrell-craft-seagrass-bourbon.title: Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon
barrell-craft-seagrass-bourbon.bodyHtml:

Lee. Named in honor of Colonel Albert B. Blanton, who spent over five decades managing the historic Buffalo Trace Distillery (formerly the George T. barrell-craft-infinite-barrel-project.title: Barrell Whiskey Infinite Barrel Project April 2021 Bottling
barrell-craft-infinite-barrel-project.bodyHtml:
Project is to create an ever-changing whiskey blended from barrels of mature whisk(e)y. We began by selecting barrels for their flavor contribution and complexity and blending them in a larger single, or "Infinite" vessel. At each bottling we remove a portion of that whiskey and replace it with other barrels that will complement the remaining blend. 

The Infinite Barrel Project is unpredictable and constantly evolving. We're certainly having fun blending it.

tanqueray-blackcurrnat-royale.title: Cointreau Noir
tanqueray-blackcurrnat-royale.bodyHtml:
Cointreau Noir is a luxurious, deeply sophisticated French orange liqueur that represents a historic collaboration between two iconic houses: Cointreau and Rémy Martin. Inspired by "The Majestic"—a recipe developed by Édouard Cointreau in the early 20th century—this premium expression masterfully marries the crystalline, vibrant citrus freshness of classic Cointreau triple sec (70%) with the velvety, opulent depth of Rémy Martin VSOP/XO-quality Cognac (30%). To add further complexity, the blend is infused with a maceration of hand-selected walnuts and almonds. This marriage of bright fruit essential oils and rich brandy creates an exceptional alternative to traditional dark spirits, offering a plush, multi-layered drinking experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with classic Crêpes Suzette, rich dark chocolate truffles, premium vanilla bean gelato, roasted duck breast with an orange glaze, or a selection of blue and aged cheeses.

TASTING NOTES - A luminous, brilliant gold color with warm amber highlights and broad legs; it features a silky, rounded, and plush texture that coats the palate elegantly.

NOSE - A rich and complex bouquet bursting with bright orange zest and marmalade, beautifully layered with dark vanilla bean, wild honey, dried fruits, and warm undertones of toasted almond and walnut.

PALATE - Harmonious, fresh, and remarkably smooth on the tongue; the bright, bittersweet punch of orange peel oils is perfectly balanced by the rich complexity of aged Cognac, yielding notes of soft oak, gingerbread, and creamy vanilla fudge.

FINISH - Long, highly persistent, and satisfyingly warm; it rounds out with a velvety, bittersweet fade of orange marmalade, lingering cognac spice, and a gentle touch of dry oak wood.

SERVE - Extremely versatile; best enjoyed neat at room temperature as a digestif, poured over a large ice cube (which yields beautiful pearly clouds in the glass), or utilized as a premium, texturally rich substitute for dark spirits in a high-end Old Fashioned or Sidecar.

barrell-craft-bourbon-batch-31.title: Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Bourbon Batch A124
barrell-craft-bourbon-batch-31.bodyHtml:
Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Bourbon Batch A124 is the first release of 2024 in Heaven Hill's highly acclaimed, uncut, and non-chill-filtered barrel proof series. True to the brand's batch naming convention ("A" denoting the first release of the year, "1" for January, and "24" for 2024), this specific expression carries an exact age statement of 10 years and 9 months. Bottled at a relatively approachable 119.0 proof, it delivers a rich, robust, and unadulterated bourbon experience that highlights the deep oak character and complex spice of Heaven Hill's traditional mashbill.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, smoked barbecue ribs, aged Gouda, dark chocolate, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany to dark amber in appearance with a thick, viscous, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich caramel, toasted oak, vanilla bean, baked apple, cinnamon spice, and a hint of dark chocolate and leather.

Palate : Intense and warming with bold flavors of brown sugar, butterscotch, black pepper, clove, toasted almonds, and sweet oak char.

Finish : Long, robust, and lingering with notes of baking spice, sweet caramel, and drying oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, allowing it to rest in the glass for a few minutes, or add a few drops of water to temper the proof and open up the complex aromatics.

barrell-craft-bourbon-new-year-2022.title: 1792 Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon
barrell-craft-bourbon-new-year-2022.bodyHtml:
1792 Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a sophisticated, pre-eminent bourbon celebrated for its precise craftsmanship and bold flavor profile. Originally created to commemorate the year Kentucky became a state, this expression is carefully crafted from a signature "high rye" recipe and a marriage of select barrels meticulously chosen by the Master Distiller. The result is an unmistakably brash and bold, yet exceptionally smooth and balanced spirit that elevates classic American whiskey to exceptional new heights.

Food Pairing: This rich and spicy bourbon pairs phenomenally well with savory, robust dishes like grilled flank steak, smoked pork ribs, or sharp aged cheddar. It also brilliantly complements sweet, decadent desserts like pecan pie or rich caramel créme brûlée.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber and bright bronze in appearance, with a smooth, rich, and full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Rich caramel, vanilla, toasted oak, sweet corn, and a sharp burst of rye spice with hints of dried fruit.

Palate : Expressive and bold with sweet honey, caramel, and vanilla upfront, moving into notes of black pepper, clove, baking spice, and charred oak.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of dry oak, dark cocoa, and lingering rye spice.

Serve : Best served neat in a Glencairn or rocks glass, over a single large ice cube, or as a spirit base in classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

boulder-bourbon-bottled-in-bond-50-00.title: Boulder Spirits Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
boulder-bourbon-bottled-in-bond-50-00.bodyHtml:
Boulder Spirits Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon is a straight bourbon whiskey from Vapor Distillery in Boulder, Colorado, made to the rules of the US Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. That means it is at least four years old, comes from a single distilling season, is bottled at exactly 100 proof (50% ABV) and states on the label where it was made and who bottled it. It matured for a minimum of four years in #3-char new American oak barrels and is presented in a 750 ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Oatmeal cookie, candied ginger and allspice.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or in an Old Fashioned.

jim-beam-single-barrel-54-00-abv.title: Jim Beam Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon
jim-beam-single-barrel-54-00-abv.bodyHtml:
A premium step up for any Jim Beam fan. Because it is a Single Barrel release, every bottle is completely unique and drawn from a single, hand-selected cask chosen by the Master Distiller for its exceptional flavor. Generally bottled at a robust 108 proof (54% ABV) to preserve its bold, uncut character, this bourbon delivers an intense, rich, and highly complex tasting experience that highlights the very best of what the distillery has to offer.

NOSE

Deep and aromatic with heavy notes of toasted oak, rich vanilla bean, dark caramel, and a hint of sweet tobacco.

PALATE

Bold, rich, and full-bodied. Prominent flavors of dark brown sugar, roasted nuts, baked apple, and heavy baking spices coat the palate.

FINISH

Exceptionally long, warming, and robust with lingering sweet oak and cinnamon spice.

bowmore-1969-50-year-old-vault-series.title: Bowmore 1969 50 Year Old Vaults Series Single Malt Scotch Whisky
bowmore-1969-50-year-old-vault-series.bodyHtml:
Bowmore 1969 50 Year Old is an extraordinary limited-edition Islay single malt Scotch whisky, distilled in 1969 and matured for half a century in the distillery's legendary vaults. The final release in Bowmore's prestigious 50 Year Old Vaults Series, this exceptional expression was bottled at 46.9% ABV, with only 339 bottles produced worldwide. Presented in an exquisite handcrafted cabinet designed by John Galvin, it represents a remarkable achievement in whisky maturation and craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with delicate dark chocolate, toasted almonds, lemon tart, crème caramel, honey-glazed nuts, aged Comté and elegant citrus-based desserts.

Tasting Notes: An exceptionally refined and mature single malt with elegant floral aromatics, vibrant citrus, acacia honey, delicate oak and subtle coastal complexity.

Nose: Delicate freesia, dried geranium and lily of the valley mingle with citrus, gooseberry, fine white wine and sweet acacia honey.

Palate: Initially dry and floral, developing into layers of lemon meringue, toasted almonds, creamy caramel fudge and gentle oak spice.

Finish: Beautifully lingering and gently warming, with delicate floral sweetness, soft malt and refined oak nuances.

livio-felluga-pinot-grigio.title: Livio Felluga Pinot Grigio 2024
livio-felluga-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
The nose is subtle, minerally and layered. Ripe peach and apricot fruit, candied orange peel, melon and lychees, blending with notes of broom, acacia and lime blossom. The palate is full-bodied, soft and nicely put-together. A tangy, mouth-filling entry followed by a return of beeswax, tea biscuits, Golden Delicious, pears, candied citrus fruit, winter melon and sage, interwoven with pleasing, lingering minerally grip.

91 Points - James Suckling
A fairly neutral yet focused wine with delicate aromas of fresh pears, beeswax, flowers. spices and pepper. Light- to medium-bodied, very silky, refined and savory, with Mirabelle plum flavors and a tight savory finish with a touch of bitterness.

chateau-argadens-blanc.title: Famille Sichel Chateau Argadens Bordeaux Blanc 2021
chateau-argadens-blanc.bodyHtml:
A dry white Bordeaux with brightness and freshness in abundance, made from sustainably grown grapes at a fine property owned by the exacting Sichel family. The blend, 65% sauvignon blanc and 35% semillon, was aged in stainless-steel tanks to capture its lovely notes of grapefruit and lemon zest. A soulmate of seafood, it also works brilliantly with soft, crumbly cheeses.

86 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Taut and full in the mouth, the wine is packed with fruit that is encased in a tight texture. Its acidity and citrus flavors are a little young, so the wine will be better from later this year.

via-edetana-blanc-terra-alta.title: Edetaria Via Edetana Blanca 2019 750ml
via-edetana-blanc-terra-alta.bodyHtml:
The Edetària Via Edetana Blanca 2019 is a distinguished white wine from Terra Alta, Catalonia, showcasing the elegance and complexity of Mediterranean whites. Crafted primarily from Garnatxa Blanca (White Grenache), this wine reflects the unique character of old vines and limestone-rich soils.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Pale yellow with golden reflections.

  • Aromas: Expressive nose of white peach, apricot, and blossoms, with underlying hints of fennel, almonds, and a subtle mineral edge.

  • Palate: Silky and full-bodied with balanced acidity and a layered texture. Flavors of ripe stone fruits, citrus zest, and wet stone evolve into a long, elegant finish.

Wine Profile:

  • Grape Varieties: Predominantly Garnatxa Blanca, with small portions of Viognier and Macabeu.

  • Region: Terra Alta D.O., Catalonia, Spain

  • Vintage: 2019

  • Aging: Aged partially in stainless steel and French oak barrels for added complexity

  • Alcohol: ~13.5%

Food Pairing:

Ideal with seafood paella, roast chicken, creamy cheeses, white fish, or Mediterranean tapas.

caymus-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
caymus-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 pours an opaque, deep purple-ruby color with brilliant violet edges in the glass. Sourced from a diverse palette of eight premium Napa Valley sub-appellations, this expressive Cabernet Sauvignon represents the Wagner family's iconic signature style of opulent fruit density and supple tannic structural power. The highly fragrant bouquet opens with lush aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis paste, and black cherry compote, intricately layered with secondary notes of cocoa powder, espresso bean, warm baking spices, and fine toasted cedarwood. On the palate, the wine delivers a full-bodied, texturally luxurious mouthfeel framed by incredibly soft, fine-grained tannins that eliminate any youthfully bitter edges. A dense mid-palate of concentrated dark orchard fruits and mocha flows seamlessly alongside well-balanced acidity, carrying outstanding weight into a long, satisfyingly plush finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime grilled ribeye steak with rosemary butter, slow-braised beef short ribs, or an artisanal board of aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

burwood-triple-berry-gin.title: Burwood Distillery Triple Berry Gin
burwood-triple-berry-gin.bodyHtml:
Handcrafted in Calgary, Alberta, by Burwood Distillery, Triple Berry Gin is a vibrant, fruit-forward craft spirit featured in their popular garden-inspired seasonal series. Distilled from locally sourced Alberta grains and enriched with pure local Alberta wildflower honey, this expression is steeped and infused with a blend of three sun-ripened berries—raspberries, blueberries, and blackberries. The resulting ruby-hued gin marries luscious berry sweetness and tart fruit acidity with traditional piney juniper and warm aromatic botanicals.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards with soft brie or chevre, dark chocolate desserts, fruit tarts, lemon meringue pie, duck breast with berry reduction, or goat cheese crostini.

Tasting Notes: Deep garnet to vibrant ruby red in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied mouthfeel and subtle fruit viscosity.

Nose: Intensely aromatic and berry-packed, bursting with fresh raspberries, jammy blackberries, and sweet blueberries upfront, grounded by delicate piney juniper, citrus peel, and honeyed floral undertones.

Palate: Richly layered and fruit-forward without being overly sweet, opening with ripe red and dark berries, tart berry skin, and citrus zest before evolving into subtle piney juniper berries, warm coriander, and earthy roots.

Finish: Medium-long, crisp, and refreshing with lingering notes of sweet-and-sour berry tartness, clean citrus oil, and dry herbaceous juniper.

Serve: Serve over ice topped with premium Mediterranean or elderflower tonic water, garnished with fresh raspberries and a wheel of lemon, or as a vibrant base for a Bramble, French 75, or Berry Gin Fizz.

burwood-cool-cocumber-gin.title: Burwood Cool Cucumber Gin
burwood-cool-cocumber-gin.bodyHtml:
Handcrafted in Calgary, Alberta, by Burwood Distillery, Cool Cucumber Gin is an artisanal craft expression featured in their popular garden-inspired seasonal series. Distilled in small batches from locally sourced Alberta grains and enriched with pure local honey, this spirit is vapor-infused and steeped with fresh, crisp greenhouse cucumbers and complimentary botanicals. The resulting gin offers a bright, crisp, and exceptionally refreshing profile that highlights green cucumber notes grounded by a smooth juniper base.

Food Pairing: Fresh sushi and sashimi, Greek salad with feta, tzatziki with pita, smoked salmon crostini, caprese salad, or grilled shrimp skewers.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear to pale jade-tinted in appearance with a light, crisp, and clean mouthfeel.

Nose: Intensely fresh and cooling, dominated by sweet fresh-cut cucumber and crisp green vegetable peel, followed by subtle piney juniper, zesty lime, and delicate floral wildflower honey undertones.

Palate: Refreshing, clean, and juicy, opening with a burst of crisp garden cucumber and bright citrus zest before giving way to resinous juniper, warm coriander, and a subtle, smooth honey sweetness.

Finish: Medium-long, crisp, and invigorating with lingering notes of cool cucumber, clean citrus oil, and dry piney herbs.

Serve: Serve over ice with premium Mediterranean or elderflower tonic water, garnished with a long ribbon of fresh cucumber and a mint sprig, or as an ideal base for a refreshed Gimlet, Southside, or Cucumber Collins.

burwood-grapefruit-lemonade-gin.title: Burwood Distillery Grapefruit & Lemongrass Gin
burwood-grapefruit-lemonade-gin.bodyHtml:
Handcrafted in Calgary, Alberta, by Burwood Distillery, Grapefruit & Lemongrass Gin is an artisanal craft expression featured in their garden-inspired seasonal series. Distilled in small batches from locally grown Alberta grains and naturally smoothed with local Alberta wildflower honey, this spirit vapor-infuses pink grapefruit zest and vibrant lemongrass alongside traditional botanicals. The result is a bright, tart, and aromatic citrus forward profile balanced by herbal depth and classic piney juniper.

Food Pairing: Fresh ceviche, spicy Thai papaya salad, grilled prawns, lemon-herb roasted chicken, goat cheese salad, or fruit tarts.

Tasting Notes: Translucent light golden-straw in appearance with a clean, lively, and refreshing medium body.

Nose: Vibrant and citrus-packed upfront with juicy ruby red grapefruit zest and fragrant, herbal lemongrass, backed by subtle piney juniper, floral honey, and coriander.

Palate: Crisp and tart without cloying sweetness, opening with bright pink grapefruit oils and zesty citrus pith before evolving into fragrant lemongrass, ginger spice, and resinous juniper berries.

Finish: Medium-long, crisp, and refreshing with lingering notes of bittersweet grapefruit peel, herbal lemongrass, and clean pine.

Serve: Serve over ice with premium Mediterranean or elderflower tonic water, garnished with a fresh wheel of pink grapefruit and a stalk of fresh lemongrass, or as an ideal base for a French 75, Paloma variation, or Gin Mule.

coke-5.title: Tenuta di Valgiano Palistorti Colline Lucchesi Bianco 2016 750ml
coke-5.bodyHtml:
The 2016 Tenuta Di Valgiano Palistorti Bianco is a white wine blend from Tuscany, Italy. It is known for its rich, full-bodied palate with intense fruity aromas, offering a distinctive and enduring character. The wine is made from Vermentino, Malvasia, Grechetto, and Trebbiano grapes. 

Key Features:
Region: Colline Lucchesi, Tuscany, Italy.
Grape Varieties: Vermentino, Malvasia, Grechetto, and Trebbiano.
Style: White wine blend.
Description: Rich and full-bodied with intense fruity aromas.
Additional notes: Some mentions of earthy notes.

jadot-gevrey-chambertin-1er-combe-moines.title: Louis Jadot Gevrey-Chambertin Combe aux Moines Premier Cru 2017
jadot-gevrey-chambertin-1er-combe-moines.bodyHtml:
This wine expresses the characteristic qualities of the commune: deep color, a multi-faceted berry and red fruit bouquet, and a full, tannic structure and mellow texture.

This powerful and perfumed wine matches game, marinated meet and cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of cherries and strawberries with hints of watermelon and flowers. Medium body, firm and chewy tannins and a flavorful finish. Shows depth of fruit and ripeness for the vintage. Drink after 2021.

adobe-sauvignon-blanc.title: Adobe Reserva Organic Sauvignon Blanc
adobe-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Adobe Reserva Organic Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant, crisp, and eco-friendly Chilean white wine produced from organically grown grapes in the Casablanca Valley. On the nose, it releases expressive aromas of lime, grapefruit, green apple, and fresh lawn grass, backed by delicate floral and mineral undertones. The palate is light to medium-bodied, delivering a juicy core of citrus and tropical fruit, bright mouth-watering acidity, and a clean, invigorating, dry finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, goat cheese crostini, grilled sea bass, ceviche, green garden salads, or served chilled as an apéritif.

new-belgium-voodoo-ranger-ipa.title: Brave New Spirits Whisky of Voodoo Serpent's Ember Blair Athol 11 Year Old 53.2% ABV
new-belgium-voodoo-ranger-ipa.bodyHtml:
Brave New Spirits Whisky of Voodoo Serpent's Ember is an adventurous 11 Year Old Highland single malt from Blair Athol Distillery.
