Released as part of Batch #3 of the Whisky of Voodoo series, this small-batch expression combines whisky matured in first-fill Rum casks and second-fill Islay hogsheads before bottling at a robust 53.2% ABV.

The unusual combination of rum and Islay casks brings tropical sweetness and subtle smoky character to Blair Athol's rich Highland malt. Ripe orchard fruit, caramelized sweetness and creamy vanilla are complemented by dried fruit, herbal nuances and gentle dying embers.

Food Pairing: Pair with barbecued pork, smoked cheddar, grilled pineapple, toasted nuts, apple crumble or caramel-based desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and expressive with red apple, tropical sweetness, creamy vanilla and subtle smoke balanced by mineral and herbaceous notes.

Nose: Rum raisin, malted barley and tropical citrus zest with red apple, sweet vanilla and a touch of smoke.

Palate: Creamy and full-bodied with vanilla, banana, dried apricot and caramelized sweetness followed by mineral and herbal notes.

Finish: Medium-long with apricot pastry, lingering malt sweetness and subtle dying embers.

shafer-td-9-cabernet-sauvignon-2022-3l-d.title: Shafer TD-9 Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
shafer-td-9-cabernet-sauvignon-2022-3l-d.bodyHtml:
The 2023 displays beautiful complexity with layers of blackberry, black plum, and spice, accented by layers of tobacco, toast, and savory herbs. Both lush and energetic, this mouth filling Cabernet Sauvignon is ripe, round, and perfectly balanced. Silky tannins provide structure and grace, promising even greater elegance and depth with time in your cellar.

95 Points - James Suckling

A classic Napa Valley cabernet that shows vivid flavors of red and black cherries on a big, broad texture and full body. Fine-grained tannins add structure and shape on the palate, as brilliant raspberry and cranberry flavors meet bold and deep blackberry and blueberry notes. Drink now or hold.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Shafer's 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon TD-9 was presented prior to bottling. It's a full-bodied, ripe, opulent style, supple and not overly tannic but still has enough backbone to partner a steak. Fruit-forward and dominated by black cherries and cassis, it finishes long and mouthwatering. Barrel Sample: 90-92.

stags-leap-the-investor-red-blend.title: Stags' Leap Winery 'The Investor' Red 2020
stags-leap-the-investor-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery The Investor Red 2020 presents an inky, dark color in the glass, unfolding with a luxurious and ultra-concentrated profile. The nose displays expressive aromas of juicy black cherry, crushed blueberry, and wild blackberry woven together with warm undertones of cedar, vanilla bean, and baking spices. On the palate, this full-bodied red blend is remarkably smooth and plush, balancing its immense fruit presence with savory hints of sage, fresh thyme, mint, and dark chocolate. Massive yet beautifully melted tannins carry through to a long, velvety finish packed with concentration and refined acidity.

Food Pairing: Pairs excellently with rosemary-crusted roasted lamb shanks, grilled prime ribeye steaks, rich wild mushroom risotto, or an assortment of mature, well-aged artisanal hard cheeses.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Red blends of this type rarely shine as brightly. This ultra concentrated and smooth-textured blend including Merlot, Petite Sirah and Malbec is inky dark in color, luxurious, aromatic of blueberries, black currants and mint followed by oak spices and dark chocolate on the palate. Creamy in texture, it is laden in massive but melted tannins.

93 Points - James Suckling

An open and delicious red with red fruit, plum and walnut aromas and flavors. Sage and thyme. Full-bodied with chewy tannins, yet it’s juicy and delicious. Dark chocolate at the end. Drink now

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A wine that captures both sides of the Stags' Leap Winery legacy, the 2020 The Investor Red Wine is a blend of Bordeaux varieties (Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Malbec aged in French oak, 35% new) and Petite Sirah (aged in American oak, 24% new). Framed by vanilla and cedar, the nose imparts notions of black cherries and blueberries. I didn't find any herbaceous notes here, but there's plenty of richness and concentration in this medium to full-bodied effort that finishes velvety and long.

mill-street-west-coast-ipa.title: Metas Wavelength West Coast Ipa Cls

stanley-park-noble-pilsner.title: Stanley Park Trail Hopper Ipa 6 Cans

angostura-amaro.title: Antica Torino Amaro della Sacra 700ml
angostura-amaro.bodyHtml:
Antica Torino Amaro della Sacra is a Piedmontese amaro inspired by the herbal remedies of the monks of Piedmont's medieval monasteries. Flowers, leaves, roots, seeds, bark and resins are cold-macerated for 45 days in wheat alcohol, then rested for months in steel tanks before filtering and bottling. The botanicals include local gentian and hop flowers alongside cardamom, Madagascar vanilla and cinchona bark. Amber-red in the glass, it is intense and spicy with cinnamon, cardamom and cinchona, and warm, full-bodied and lightly sweet on the palate (25% sugar). The label reproduces a 1925 ex-libris of a Benedictine monk with the Sacra di San Michele abbey behind him. It is bottled at 35% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Spicy and aromatic, with cinnamon, cardamom and cinchona over a warm, lightly sweet body.

Nose: Intense and spicy: cinnamon, cardamom and cinchona bark.

Palate: Warm, rich, fresh and full-bodied; balanced and persistent.

Serve: Neat as a digestif, or in a Manhattan, Boulevardier or Negroni; it pairs well with rye, bourbon, tequila and London dry gin.

michelob-ultra-2.title: Michelob Ultra 473ml Can
michelob-ultra-2.bodyHtml:
Michelob Ultra is a light lager produced by Anheuser-Busch, engineered to appeal to active and health-conscious consumers. First introduced in 2002, it features a lower carbohydrate and calorie count than traditional lagers, offering a clean, crisp, and refreshingly light taste with subtle citrus notes and a bright, effervescent carbonation.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken salad, fresh ceviche, light fish tacos, sushi, steamed seafood, and mild goat cheese.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant pale straw yellow in appearance with a thin white head and a light, crisp, and highly carbonated mouthfeel.

Nose : Subtle and clean with gentle notes of sweet malt, light rice, and a faint hint of citrus hops.

Palate : Exceptionally light and refreshing, featuring clean cereal grain, a touch of cracker malt sweetness, and minimal hop bitterness.

Finish : Very short, crisp, and clean with zero lingering aftertaste and a dry, fizzy close.

Serve : Serve ice-cold directly from the bottle or can, or poured into a chilled pilsner glass.

park-distillery-maple-rye.title: Park Distillery Maple Rye
park-distillery-maple-rye.bodyHtml:
PARK Maple Rye is an unaged blended spirit from PARK Distillery in Banff, Alberta, made by blending the distillery's Glacier Rye, distilled from 100% locally farmed Alberta rye, with hand-tapped, family-farmed Québec maple syrup. Sweet enough to pass for a liqueur, it keeps earthy spice from the rye grain to balance the maple. Bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Maple sweetness balanced by earthy rye spice.

Serve: In coffee, over ice, or stirred with bourbon and bitters in an Old Fashioned-style drink.

darioush-darius-ii-cabernet-sauvignon.title: DAOU Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
darioush-darius-ii-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
DAOU Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a remarkably rich, elegant, and beautifully structured Californian red wine that sets a benchmark for the incredible potential of Paso Robles mountain terroir. It pours a deep, shimmering ruby-purple color in the glass, unfurling a highly aromatic and expressive bouquet of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with complex notes of dried sage, cocoa dust, and toast. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is exceptionally balanced and fruit-forward, delivering lush, concentrated layers of black raspberry, pomegranate, and blueberry crumble. Its fine-grained, sappy tannins provide excellent structural backbone, while a touch of integrated French oak lends luxurious accents of mocha spice and sweet vanilla that carry through to an impeccably polished finish.

Food Pairing: This robust red pairs excellently with a grilled prime ribeye steak, rosemary-braised lamb shanks, wild mushroom risotto, savory wood-fired pepper pizzas, or mature cheeses like sharp aged Cheddar and Gruyère.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Clean lines of cherry, toasted wood, red flower and a pinch of thyme make for a satisfying nose on this widely available bottling. The palate pairs familiar blackberry flavors with mocha spice.

bud-light-lime-1.title: Bud Light Lime 12 Bottles
bud-light-lime-1.bodyHtml: Bud Light Lime is a light-bodied lager brewed with real lime peels to deliver a distinctively clean and refreshing citrus taste. It combines the crisp, easy-drinking profile of a light beer with a natural, zesty lime twist. The 12-pack of 341ml glass bottles offers a subtle malt sweetness balanced by a bright, tangy aroma and a fast, snappy finish. It is a popular choice for warm-weather occasions, emphasizing a refreshing and thirst-quenching character.

coors-original.title: Coors Original 15 Cans
coors-original.bodyHtml: Coors Original is a golden lager, known for its crisp, smooth finish and balance of subtle sweetness and malty refreshment. It has a sessionable ABV, inviting aromas of freshly baked bread with hints of banana and pear.

original-16-canadian-copper-ale.title: Original 16 Copper 15 Cans
original-16-canadian-copper-ale.bodyHtml: A smooth and refreshing beer brewed with 100% two-row Prairie barley, a blend of roasted black and caramel malts, and five hop varietals

88-brewing-tiffany-rose-saison.title: 88 Brewing Tiffany Rose Saison 4 Tall Cans
88-brewing-tiffany-rose-saison.bodyHtml: 88 Brewing Tiffany Rose Saison 4 Tall Cans

sea-change-prairie-fairy.title: Sea Change Prairie Fairy 4 Tall Cans

tribute-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Tribute Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
tribute-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This full-bodied, robust Cabernet Sauvignon offers an intense bouquet of ripe, jammy blackberry and dark cherry fruit, complemented with lightly toasted oak and hints of vanilla, tobacco, and spice. With well-balanced acidity, integrated tannins, and a smooth finish, it's the perfect choice for any special occasion.

90 Points - James Suckling
A well-structured and classic California Cabernet offering aromas of blackcurrant, dark plum, and a hint of toasted oak. The palate is medium to full-bodied with balanced tannins and a smooth, satisfying finish that pays tribute to the variety's core characteristics.
89 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This Cabernet delivers reliable notes of dark fruit and chocolate with a soft, approachable texture. It's a consistent and well-made wine that represents solid value from the 2019 vintage.

agd-red-lager.title: AGD Alberta Genuine Draft Red Lager 15 Cans
agd-red-lager.bodyHtml: This red lager is crisp and smooth. Balanced malty sweetness with very subtle hops from start to finish!

jadot-meursault.title: Louis Jadot Meursault 2022
jadot-meursault.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Meursault 2022 is a classic Burgundy Chardonnay offering aromas of citrus, white flowers, hazelnut, and ripe orchard fruit. The palate is full and expansive with balanced freshness, subtle oak integration, vibrant acidity, and a long, elegant mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with lobster, scallops, roasted chicken, creamy seafood dishes, veal, and soft-ripened cheeses.

 

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Verging on creamy in texture, this white exudes peach, apple and honey flavors wrapped in an embrace of toasty oak. Vibrant and harmonious, ending with a long, layered aftertaste, where a mineral element emerges.

voodoo-ranger-ipa.title: Wild Rose Sun Scout 4 Tall Cans

the-bruery-hold-the-spoon-can.title: The Bruery Hold The Spoon Can 0

annex-dimed-out-triple-ipa.title: Annex Dimed Out Triple Ipa 4 Tall Cans
annex-dimed-out-triple-ipa.bodyHtml: Annex Dimed Out Triple Ipa 4 Tall Cans

tomintoul-cigar-malt.title: Tomintoul Cigar Malt Oloroso Sherry Cask Matured
tomintoul-cigar-malt.bodyHtml:
Tomintoul Cigar Malt is an intricate combination of classic Tomintoul Single Malts and rare peated Tomintoul Single Malts. Each of these individual single malts have been either matured fully or finished in hand-selected Oloroso Sherry butts, sourced from Andalucía, Spain.

The rich and sweet sherry notes, creamy malt profile and gentle peat smoke make this single malt the perfect accompaniment to the world’s finest cigars.

banded-judy-in-the-sky.title: Banded Judy In The Sky 4 Tall Cans
banded-judy-in-the-sky.bodyHtml: Banded Judy In The Sky 4 Tall Cans

nude-vodka-soda-variety-pack-v2.title: Nude Vodka Soda Mixer V2 12 Cans

hornitos-black-barrel-anejo-tequila.title: Hornitos Black Barrel Añejo Tequila
hornitos-black-barrel-anejo-tequila.bodyHtml:
Hornitos Black Barrel is an añejo tequila bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle; the label reads 'Tequila Añejo' and '100% agave' and states that it is aged 18 months. It starts as an aged añejo, then spends four months in deep-charred oak barrels, which give it a rich, smoky flavour and golden amber colour, followed by two further months in specially toasted barrels for added depth and complexity. It pours dark amber, with aromas of oak, vanilla and pepper and a palate of agave and citrus that leads to a long, warm finish. This listing is the current brown bottle with the gold label.

Tasting Notes: Oak, vanilla and pepper over agave and citrus.

Nose: Oak, vanilla and pepper.

Palate: Agave and citrus.

Finish: Long and warm.

Food Pairing: Tequila-lime chicken.

Serve: Serve neat or over ice with a wedge of lime.

the-est-gold-past-life.title: The Est Gold Past Life 4 Tall Cans
the-est-gold-past-life.bodyHtml: The Est Gold Past Life 4 Tall Cans

baja-luna.title: Baja Luna Black Raspberry Tequila Cream Liqueur
baja-luna.bodyHtml:
Baja Luna Black Raspberry Tequila Cream Liqueur is a smooth, indulgent cream liqueur that blends real dairy cream with imported Mexican tequila and the sweet, tart flavor of black raspberries. Crafted for versatility, it strikes a balance between rich, velvety creaminess and subtle agave warmth.

Food Pairing: Vanilla bean ice cream, chocolate lava cake, cheesecake, fresh berries, and dark chocolate truffles.

Tasting Notes : Opaque, pale violet-pink in appearance with a rich, silky, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and aromatic with notes of ripe black raspberry, fresh cream, and a subtle hint of agave spirit.

Palate : Creamy and smooth, featuring sweet flavors of black raspberry jam, vanilla, and sweet cream balanced by soft tequila character.

Finish : Smooth, sweet, and lingering with notes of berry cream and a gentle warmth.

Serve : Serve chilled over ice, poured over ice cream, or mixed into coffee and dessert cocktails.

the-est-tangerine-trees.title: The Est Tangerine Trees 4 Tall Cans

the-est-seperate-togather.title: The Est Seperate Togather 4 Tall Cans

innis-gunn-mangoes-on-the-run-1.title: Innis & Gunn Mangoes On The Run 4 Tall Cans
innis-gunn-mangoes-on-the-run-1.bodyHtml: Innis & Gunn Mangoes On The Run 4 Tall Cans

88-brewing-double-night-gallery.title: 88 Brewing Double Night Gallery 4 Tall Cans
88-brewing-double-night-gallery.bodyHtml: 88 Brewing Double Night Gallery 4 Tall Cans

88-brewing-electric-circus.title: 88 Brewing Electric Circus 4 Tall Cans
88-brewing-electric-circus.bodyHtml: 88 Brewing Electric Circus 4 Tall Cans is a vibrant Hazy IPA crafted by Eighty-Eight Brewing Co. in Calgary, Alberta. Brewed with a soft malt base featuring barley, wheat, and oats, this juicy, hop-forward beer delivers tropical fruit flavours, bright citrus, and a smooth, pillowy mouthfeel. Aromas of ripe mango, passionfruit, and citrus complement its hazy golden appearance, while restrained bitterness creates a refreshing, approachable finish. At 6.9% ABV, Electric Circus offers a flavourful expression of the modern hazy IPA style.

the-est-pump-up-the-jam.title: The Est Pump Up The Jam 4 Tall Cans
the-est-pump-up-the-jam.bodyHtml: The Est Pump Up The Jam 4 Tall Cans

wild-rose-sun-scout.title: Wild Rose Sun Scout 4 Tall Cans

19-crimes-cali-chard.title: 19 Crimes Cali Red NV 750ml
19-crimes-cali-chard.bodyHtml: Full and dense, with strong black & blue fruit notes up front from the Petite Sirah, complemented by bright red, slightly candied fruit in the background from the Zinfandel. The darkly toasted oak ties it all together along with a slightly sweet finish.

muddlers-moscow-mule-variety-pack.title: Muddlers Moscow Mule Variety Pack 12 Cans

mxd-sour-cherry.title: The Crabbie Goat Sour Cherry Blast Moonshine
mxd-sour-cherry.bodyHtml:
The Crabbie Goat Sour Cherry Blast Moonshine is a flavored spirit produced by craft distillers, combining traditional moonshine with vibrant sour cherry flavor. It offers an easy-drinking, sweet-and-sour fruit profile with a warm, punchy corn spirit base.

Food Pairing: Barbecue pork ribs, spicy chicken wings, vanilla ice cream, cherry pie, and sharp cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Bright, translucent ruby red in appearance with a smooth, light-to-medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Tart sour cherry, candied red fruit, sweet corn, and a hint of warm grain alcohol.

Palate : Sweet and tangy, featuring bold flavors of sour cherry candy, ripe red berries, and subtle corn sweetness.

Finish : Medium-length and crisp, leaving a lingering tart cherry punch and a soft, warm kick.

Serve : Serve chilled as a shot, over ice, or mixed with lemonade or cola.

white-claw-iced-tea-lemon.title: American Vintage Hard Iced Tea Lemon 24 Cans
white-claw-iced-tea-lemon.bodyHtml: Proudly brewed in Ontario using real tea leaves for authentic character. Bright aromas of steeped tea with hints of white flowers and citrus lead to a light, moderately sweet palate balanced by a subtle bitterness from the slow-brewed tea leaves. Expect refreshing flavours of citrus, tea, and dried floral notes.

sans-by-nude-original-apple-cider.title: Sans By Nude Original Apple Cider 6 Cans
sans-by-nude-original-apple-cider.bodyHtml: Sans By Nude Original Apple Cider 6 Cans

chum-churum-original-soju-1.title: Chum Churum Original Soju 360ml
chum-churum-original-soju-1.bodyHtml:
Chum Churum Original Soju is the brand's original soju, bottled at 16.5% ABV in a 360ml bottle. Chum Churum (Cheoeumcheoreom, 'like the first time') is a soju brand of Lotte Chilsung Beverage, launched in 2006 and made with alkaline water, which the brand credits for its smoothness. Clear, light-bodied and velvety, it is a classic partner for Korean barbecue and spicy dishes.

Serve: Well chilled, neat in a shot glass or over ice.

single-cup.title: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
single-cup.bodyHtml:
Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and recharred in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the wood into the whisky overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness.
It has a complex and multi-dimensional background of pepper, spice, dates and other fruits, such as ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of bursting citrus fruits.

Colour
Deep autumn gold

Flavour
A rich fusion of vanilla and caramelized sugars with dark chocolate on top. Ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of citrus fruits burst. Pepper is also present in the background waiting to be noticed.

Palate
The taste ends with clean and complex flavours embodying all that is best in the finest malt whiskies enjoying a long aftertaste.

Tasting
We suggest drinking Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask neat.

prosecco-basket.title: Sorelle Bronca 'Particella 68' Spumante Extra Dry
prosecco-basket.bodyHtml:
A magnificent and iconic single-vineyard estate Prosecco Superiore born from old vines on a dizzyingly steep 60% slope in the heart of Colbertaldo. It opens with an expressive, graceful bouquet of crisp yellow apples, white blossoms, ripe juicy pears, and subtle mountain herbs, delivering a vertical, beautifully tense palate carrying an elegant mineral drive and a creamy, persistent mousse.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with delicate vegetable risottos, savory seafood pastas, fresh oysters, or a platter of medium-aged regional cheeses and artisanal cured meats.

wine-basket.title: Rockbare Grenache 2017 750ml
wine-basket.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2017 vintage) "This is a pretty delicious grenache with bright cherry fruit and silky tannins. Lively and fresh, it is a lot of fun in the mouth and full of food possibilities. he wine is aged on lees to add complexity and savoury aspects. Well made and would be fun with Vancouver gyoza, pork dumplings, or Bejing duck. The ferment begins with whole berries tipped into open-top fermenters before a three-day cold soak and a cool ferment between 20-25°C for 15 days to retain the aromatics. The finished ferment was pressed through a basket press and run into a stainless steel tank and a few older French oak barriques. (Anthony Gismondi)." - 91/100, Gismondi on Wine

wine-box.title: Black Cellar Malbec Merlot 4L Bag in Box
wine-box.bodyHtml:
Black Cellar Malbec Merlot is a smooth, full-flavoured Canadian red blend with generous aromas and flavours of sweet cherry, blueberry, and spice. Malbec and Merlot combine in a fruit-forward profile, offering an approachable expression with ripe berry character and balanced texture.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled steak, roasted garlic potatoes, sauteed mushrooms, and sharp cheddar.

burwood-alberta-prairie-whisky.title: Burwood Bee Whisperer Alberta Prairie Whisky
burwood-alberta-prairie-whisky.bodyHtml:
Burwood Bee Whisperer is an Alberta Prairie Whisky from Burwood Distillery in Calgary, part of the distillery's Grains of Truth whisky series. It marries Burwood's rich, full-bodied single malt whisky with a small amount of the distillery's own distilled, barrel-aged spirit made from local honey. Fruity malt flavours lead, and on closer tasting the honey spirit brings out wildflower, honeysuckle and warm caramel notes. Burwood grows, ferments, distils and bottles it in Calgary. The label tells a tongue-in-cheek newspaper story about the distillery's own bee whisperer. Bottled at 46% ABV in a 750 mL bottle.

Tasting Notes: Smooth and delicate, with honeysuckle and wildflowers alongside fresh Alberta barley and caramel.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

bud-light-peach.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-peach.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

yamahai-gold-omachi-junmai-daiginjo-sake.title: Yamahai Gold Omachi Junmai Daiginjo Sake 720ml

yamahai-junmai-ginjo-premium-sake.title: Tamanohikari Yamahai Junmai Ginjo Premium Sake 720ml
yamahai-junmai-ginjo-premium-sake.bodyHtml:
Tamanohikari Yamahai Junmai Ginjo Premium Sake is a traditional Japanese sake produced by Tamanohikari Sake Brewing in Fushimi, Kyoto. Crafted using the Yamahai method, which encourages the natural development of lactic acid in the fermentation starter, this Junmai Ginjo offers distinctive savoury complexity alongside a smooth, rounded texture. Aromas of shiitake mushrooms, toasted nuts, and creamy nougat complement its rich umami character and balanced acidity. Versatile and expressive, it can be enjoyed chilled or gently warmed.

Food Pairing: Barbecue chicken, coarse pâté, aged French cheeses, grilled mushrooms, roasted pork, savoury noodles, and creamy seafood dishes.

finca-los-primos-malbec-cabernet-savign.title: Finca Los Primos Malbec Cabernet Savign 1L
finca-los-primos-malbec-cabernet-savign.bodyHtml:
Finca Los Primos brings together the bold character of Malbec and the structure of Cabernet Sauvignon in this approachable and flavorful 1-liter blend from Argentina. Crafted to be smooth, fruit-forward, and versatile, this wine is perfect for casual sipping or pairing with hearty meals.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Deep ruby red with purple hues.

  • Aromas: Ripe blackberries, plums, and cherries, accented by hints of spice, tobacco, and a touch of vanilla.

  • Palate: Medium-bodied with a soft, velvety texture. Flavors of dark fruit, mocha, and subtle oak are well-integrated, leading to a smooth, lingering finish.

Style & Character:

  • Blend: Malbec & Cabernet Sauvignon

  • Origin: Mendoza, Argentina

  • Alcohol: ~13.5%

  • Style: Dry, fruit-forward red blend

Food Pairing Suggestions:

Pairs wonderfully with grilled meats, barbecue, pasta with tomato-based sauces, aged cheeses, and roasted vegetables.

whisp-dutch-grapefruit-gin.title: Royalmount Grapefruit and Elderflower
whisp-dutch-grapefruit-gin.bodyHtml:
Royalmount Gin Grapefruit & Elderflower is an artisanal flavored craft spirit produced by Distillerie Royalmount in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. Distilled using Canadian grain neutral spirit, this modern expression infuses traditional gin botanicals with real pink grapefruit and elderflower blossoms. The resulting gin pairs the bright, bitter-sweet zest of fresh citrus with delicate floral sweetness, backed by a crisp botanical spine.

Food Pairing: Fresh ceviche, grilled shrimp skewers, summer salads with goat cheese, lemon-herb chicken, and fruit parfaits.

Tasting Notes: Pale translucent straw to soft peach in appearance with a smooth, crisp, and inviting mouthfeel.

Nose: Intensely fragrant up front, bursting with sweet floral elderflower and zesty pink grapefruit oils, underlaid by soft piney juniper and subtle green herbal notes.

Palate: Vibrant and juicy on the palate, opening with a bold wave of tart pink grapefruit and sweet elderflower nectar, followed by resinous juniper, lemon zest, and a touch of coriander spice.

Finish: Medium-long, clean, and invigorating with lingering notes of grapefruit peel, lingering floral sweetness, and a crisp, dry citrus tail.

Serve: Serve over ice topped with premium Indian tonic water or sparkling water, garnished with a slice of fresh pink grapefruit, or build into a French 75, Paloma, or Hugo-style Spritz.

grand-marnier-revelation.title: Grand Marnier Grande Cuvee Revelation
grand-marnier-revelation.bodyHtml: Grande Cuvee Revelation is the prestige expression of Grand Marnier with the most full-bodied cognac taste. In Grande Cuvee Revelation, 68 eaux-de-vie exclusively from Grande Champagne are harmoniously blended in a rare XXO cognac. It contains 91% XXO Cognac from Grande Champagne, aged a minimum of 14 years. Thanks to its extremely high cognac content, it offers an exceptional depth and length to the palate.

georgian-bay-tequila-prickly-pear.title: Georgian Bay Tequila Prickly Pear 6 Cans

georgian-bay-tequila-grapefruit.title: Georgian Bay Tequila Smash Mixed 12 Cans
georgian-bay-tequila-grapefruit.bodyHtml: Georgian Bay Tequila Smash Mixed 12 Cans is a refreshing Canadian ready-to-drink cocktail variety pack crafted by Georgian Bay Spirit Co. in Ontario. Made with authentic Blue Agave tequila and natural flavours, this assortment features four tropical and citrus-inspired expressions: Chili Mango, Grapefruit, Pineapple, and Prickly Pear. Each flavour offers a distinctive balance of juicy fruit, bright acidity, and smooth tequila character. At 6.0% ABV, these crisp, flavourful cocktails are perfect for barbecues, summer gatherings, and entertaining.

kavalan-solist-ex-bourbon-insc-1-56-30.title: Kavalan Solist Ex-Bourbon Cask Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-ex-bourbon-insc-1-56-30.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist ex-Bourbon is a delightfully complex, multi-dimensional single malt whisky, with vanilla, fruit and coconut highlights. Matured in hand-selected fresh American ex-Bourbon casks, the whisky is available at cask strength and non chill-filtered, retaining the fuller flavour of a natural single malt whisky.

Colour: Luminous pale amber

Flavour: Clean & fresh tropical fruitiness with pleasant vanilla, coconut and spices.

Palate: Well-balanced natural sweetness, vanilla and oak spices, round and complex with silky smoothness.

Tasting: We suggest drinking Kavalan Solist ex-Bourbon Cask neat.

kavalan-solist-vinho-year-of-the-tiger.title: Kavalan Solist Fino Sherry Cask Year of the Snake Truth Malters Lunar Zodiac
kavalan-solist-vinho-year-of-the-tiger.bodyHtml:
6th release in our TM Lunar Zodiac series: The Year of the Snake - The Kavalan Solist Fino Sherry Cask Single Malt Whisky.

Aged 11+ years and drawn from Cask #001 this is Kavalan’s first-ever Fino sherry private cask. This exceptional expression offers a refined sherry influence, unveiling layers of creamy toffee, indulgent fudge, and a subtle touch of chocolate, all balanced by the spirit’s vibrant fruit character.

bunnahabhain-25-year-old.title: Bunnahabhain 18 Year Old
bunnahabhain-25-year-old.bodyHtml:
Bunnahabhain 18 Year Old is an exceptional, multi-award-winning Islay single malt Scotch whisky that beautifully showcases the distillery's signature unpeated coastal style. Matured for a full eighteen years exclusively in choice, hand-selected ex-Oloroso Sherry oak casks, this expression is bottled at its natural color without chill-filtration. The extended maritime aging process allows the spirit to interact deeply with the Spanish oak, tempering the classic coastal brine of its ocean-facing warehouse with an opulent, rich dried-fruit complexity. The result is an incredibly elegant, deeply satisfying dram that stands as a gold standard for Sherry-matured maritime whiskies.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast with a cherry reduction, prime rib eye steak, dark chocolate pecan pies, or a mature, salty blue cheese like Stilton.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber hue, offering a full-bodied, smooth, and beautifully creamy mouthfeel with warming weight.

Nose : Sweet milk chocolate, dark raisins, toffee, and warm baking spices.

Palate : Smooth and rich with stewed berries, crisp red apples, spicy black pepper, and subtle herbal complexity.

Finish : Medium-bodied and warm, transitioning from sweet fruit to lingering spice and ripe Morello cherry.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of water to soften the spice and open up the fruit and chocolate layers.

benromach-cask-strength-2010-batch-1.title: Benromach Cask Strength 2010 Batch 1
benromach-cask-strength-2010-batch-1.bodyHtml:
Benromach Cask Strength 2010 Batch 1 is a vintage-dated Speyside single malt from the Benromach distillery near Forres, the site Gordon & MacPhail acquired in 1993. Distilled in 2010 and bottled in 2021, it was presented at full cask strength of 58.5% ABV in a 700ml bottle, with natural colour and without chill-filtration, as stated on the carton. It was the first batch of the 2010 vintage in the distillery's cask strength series and pairs warming spice and fruit with the light smoke that runs through the Benromach style.

Tasting Notes: Spicy Sherry, orange zest and dark chocolate, then baked fruit, black pepper and soft smoke.

Serve: Neat, then with a splash of water.

zubrowka.title: Zubrowka Vodka
zubrowka.bodyHtml:
Zubrowka Bison Grass Vodka is the classic Polish vodka flavoured with bison grass and inspired by the Bialowieza Forest. Its recipe draws on more than 500 years of tradition, and every bottle carries a single hand-picked blade of bison grass, the brand's signature. The aroma is wonderfully complex, with bison grass, chamomile, green apple, lavender, vanilla and almond, while the palate brings herbal notes, creamy vanilla and gentle spice before a soft finish of spring flowers. Bottled at 40% ABV. 750ml.

Nose: Bison grass, chamomile, green apple, lavender, vanilla and almond.

Palate: Herbal notes, creamy vanilla and delicate spice.

Finish: Soft, with a touch of spring flowers.

Serve: Well chilled and neat, or with cloudy apple juice.

black-velvet.title: Black Velvet Toasted Caramel Whisky
black-velvet.bodyHtml:
Black Velvet Toasted Caramel Whisky is a flavoured Canadian whisky produced in Lethbridge, Alberta. Mature Black Velvet Canadian Whisky is infused with natural toasted caramel flavour, creating a rich and smooth expression that combines the underlying whisky's woody character with pronounced caramel, toffee, cream, and warming spice. Bottled at 35% ABV, it can be enjoyed neat, over ice, or incorporated into whisky cocktails.

Food Pairing: Apple pie, bread pudding, creme brulee, pecan pie, toasted nuts, vanilla ice cream, dark chocolate, and caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and sweet with creamy caramel, toasted oak, toffee, maple-like sweetness, warming spice, and a smooth texture.

Nose: Caramel cream, toasted oak, fresh toffee, and roasted sweetness.

Palate: Toffee and caramel with maple-like sweetness, warm pepper, citrus pith, and a rich buttery texture.

Finish: Long and warming with toasted caramel, peppery spice, and a clean, lightly tannic character.

fernie-brewing-co-what-the-huck.title: Fernie Brewing Co. What The Huck 4 Tall Cans

schloss-laderheim-1.title: Schloss Laderheim 4L Bag In Box
schloss-laderheim-1.bodyHtml:
The Schloss Laderheim Bag-in-Box is a classic, easy-drinking German white wine presented in a convenient 4-liter format—perfect for gatherings, events, or everyday enjoyment. Known for its smoothness and slightly off-dry profile, this wine delivers consistent quality and exceptional value.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Pale straw yellow.

  • Aromas: Delicate notes of green apple, pear, and a touch of citrus.

  • Palate: Light-bodied with a gentle sweetness, soft acidity, and flavors of ripe fruit and floral undertones. Clean and refreshing on the finish.

Style & Character:

  • Style: Off-dry white wine

  • Origin: Germany

  • Alcohol: Moderate ABV (typically around 9–10%)

The Schloss Laderheim is a versatile and approachable wine with a balanced character—ideal for casual sipping or pairing with food.

Food Pairing Suggestions:

  • Roast chicken, seafood, mild cheeses, spicy Asian dishes, or as a delightful companion to fruit platters and light desserts.

tres-generaciones-anejo.title: Sauza Tres Generaciones Anejo Tequila
tres-generaciones-anejo.bodyHtml: A complex blend of aged Tequilas crafted with the highest quality standards to create an extremely smooth and well-balanced Tequila. This top-shelf Tequila offers a robust flavor profile of agave, vanilla, citrus and sweet oak, with a long-lasting finish. Crafted by three generations of master distillers, Tres Generaciones Anejo is an optimal balance of quality, taste, and tradition.

mcguinness-amaretto-dellamorosa.title: Mcguinness Amaretto Dell'Amorosa
mcguinness-amaretto-dellamorosa.bodyHtml:
McGuinness Amaretto Dell'Amorosa is an almond liqueur from McGuinness, part of the Corby Spirit and Wine portfolio. Bottled at 23% ABV in a 750 ml bottle, it is a versatile, good-value amaretto for sipping over ice, adding to coffee or mixing into classics such as the Amaretto Sour.

Serve: Over ice, in coffee, or in an Amaretto Sour.

st-remy-vsop-w-bonus-playing-cards.title: St-Remy V.S.O.P. Brandy 1.14L with Bonus Playing Cards
st-remy-vsop-w-bonus-playing-cards.bodyHtml:
St-Remy V.S.O.P. Brandy 1.14L with Bonus Playing Cards is a value gift package featuring a 1.14L bottle of St-Rémy V.S.O.P. French Brandy paired with a custom deck of playing cards. Crafted from 100% French grapes and matured in French oak casks, this classic brandy delivers a smooth, balanced profile rich with aromas of fruit, oak, and soft vanilla.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, aged cheeses, dark chocolate, fruit tarts, roasted pork, and duck confit.

Tasting Notes : Amber-gold with yellow highlights, offering a smooth, light, and well-rounded mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Ripe red berries, peach, apricot, subtle oak, and light vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of candied fruit, sweet oak, delicate vanilla, and warm spice.

Finish : Smooth, short to medium, with lingering notes of sweet fruit and gentle wood.

Serve : Best served neat in a tulip or glass tumbler at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a versatile base in classic cocktails such as a Brandy Alexander or Sidecar.

giffard-ginger-of-the-indies.title: Giffard Ginger of the Indies
giffard-ginger-of-the-indies.bodyHtml: Ginger is part of the Zingiberaceae family, which also includes turmeric, cardamom, and galangal. Ginger is native to Maritime Southeast Asia and was probably first domesticated by Austronesian peoples. Ginger is one of the first spices to be exported from Asia, arriving in Europe with the spice trade, and was used by the ancient Greeks and Romans. The flavor of ginger is characterized by a unique combination of warm notes, lemon/citrus notes, and earthy notes. Ginger is an ingredient that has many properties and health benefits such as antioxidants, strengthening the immune system and digestion, among others. The growing interest in ginger in beverages is driven by tea in the winter, and ginger beer and ginger ale in the summer. Ginger is potent, but it pairs well with other flavors like blackberry, honey, turmeric, lemon, cinnamon, and fennel.

omission-gluten-free-pale-ale.title: Omission Gluten Free Pale Ale 6 Bottles

henry-pelham-baco-noir-vqa.title: Henry of Pelham Baco Noir
henry-pelham-baco-noir-vqa.bodyHtml:
Henry of Pelham Baco Noir is a rich, robust, and fruit-forward Canadian red wine produced by Henry of Pelham Family Estate Winery in Ontario’s Niagara Peninsula. Sourced from estate vineyards, it displays an intense ruby-purple color in the glass. The nose opens with expressive aromas of ripe blackberry, dark plum preserve, and black cherry, layered with subtle notes of smoky oak, vanilla, and toasted spice. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied, smooth, and supple, offering vibrant black fruit flavors balanced by lively natural acidity, gentle tannins, and a clean, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with barbecued pork ribs, grilled burgers, roasted chicken, savory sausages, pizza, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.
tags: Henry of Pelham Family Estate Winery

mt-begbie-tall-timber-ale.title: Mt Begbie Tall Timber Ale 6 Cans

summerhill-cipes-brut.title: Summerhill Cipes Brut 750ml
summerhill-cipes-brut.bodyHtml:
Summerhill Pyramid Winery (established 1991) is Canada's largest organic winery, BC's first Demeter biodynamic vineyard, and Canada's foremost producer of sparkling wine. Our winemaking philosophy is that organic and biodynamic provides the royal road to producing exceptionally beautiful, authentic, terroir-based wine that will connect you with the beautiful Okanagan Valley.

70% Riesling, 20% Pinot Blanc, 10% Chardonnay. 100% Organic.

This wine scored 90 Points and won Silver medal in Wine Align's National Wine Awards of Canada 2021!

Tasting Notes
On the nose, Honeycrisp apple, white flowers and lime zest. The palate is fresh and vibrant with juicy green apple, pear, lemon meringue and a hint of toasted brioche.

Ratings
92 points - Beppi Crosariol, Globe & Mail 91 points - John Schreiner, goodgrog.com

Awards
Double Gold Medal - 2016 San Francisco International Wine Competition Gold Medal - Taste BC, 2015 Gold Medal - 2015 BC Wine Awards Double Gold Medal TROPHY "Sparkling Wine of the Year" - 2014 All Canadian Wine Championships

Vineyard Notes
Grown in organic Okanagan vineyards especially suited for sparkling wine grape production.

Winemaker Notes
The grapes are whole cluster pressed and fermented dry in stainless steel before the cuvee is blended and bottled to undergo the second fermentation in the traditional method.

Food Pairing Notes
Supremely versatile! Enjoy with sushi, fresh seafood, grilled chicken, tapas, or fruit and cheese.

beringer-napa-valley-chardonnay.title: Beringer Napa Valley Chardonnay 2023
beringer-napa-valley-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Beringer Napa Valley Chardonnay 2023 is a refreshing, vibrant, and beautifully executed white wine that serves as a fine example of classically styled Napa Valley Chardonnay. Crafted by California’s longest continually operating winery, this radiant straw-yellow wine opens with an inviting and highly perfumed bouquet of crisp Asian pear, bright citrus, and fresh yellow plum, enlivened by delicate notes of orange blossom and honeysuckle. On the palate, it delivers a surprisingly plush, creamy, and round mouthfeel. Lush tropical flavors of grilled pineapple and white peach seamlessly integrate with decadent layers of lemon meringue pie, toasted almonds, and sea salt caramel. All of this rich complexity is effortlessly uplifted by a clean, vibrant line of natural acidity, leading into a long, mouthwatering finish defined by elegant hints of vanilla bean, warm nutmeg spice, and toasted brioche from subtle oak aging.

Food Pairing: Butter-poached lobster tails, dungeness crab cakes, pan-seared sea scallops, cream-based pasta dishes, roast chicken with garlic cream sauce, or mild cheeses like Brie.

bols-triple-sec-liqueur.title: Bols Triple Sec Liqueur
bols-triple-sec-liqueur.bodyHtml: Bols Triple Sec liqueur stands out due to its abundant use of Curacao orange peels combined with a blend of other citrus fruits. Bols Triple sec is infused with natural botanicals and is an essential orange liqueur thanks to its versatility!

centennial-premium-rye-whisky.title: Centennial 10 Year Old Canadian Rye Whisky
centennial-premium-rye-whisky.bodyHtml:
Centennial 10 Year Old Canadian Rye Whisky is a small-batch whisky from Highwood Distillers in High River, Alberta. Created to honour the 100th anniversary of the Western Stock Growers Association, Centennial is built around Alberta winter wheat, chosen for the smoothness it brings, and is made by batch distillation for close control of every run. Highwood's master blender set out to create a smoother, richer rye-style whisky, and its toasted notes come from ageing in Kentucky bourbon oak barrels; the current Limited Release label states 10 years in charred oak casks. It comes in a tall, slender bottle with a cork stopper, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml size.

Tasting Notes: Smooth and rich, with toasted oak from the bourbon barrels.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in a classic rye cocktail.

phillips-hot-100-cinnamon.title: Phillips Hot 100 Cinnamon
phillips-hot-100-cinnamon.bodyHtml:
Phillips Hot 100 Cinnamon is a 100-proof cinnamon schnapps from Phillips, bottled at 50% ABV in a 750 ml bottle. Phillips is a Minnesota spirits and liqueur brand whose history goes back to 1912, and it was a pioneer of the schnapps category: the company introduced its Peppermint Schnapps in 1935 and Root Beer Schnapps in 1984. At full 100 proof it is made for ice-cold shots, and a measure also livens up hot apple cider and other warm drinks.

Serve: Ice cold as a shot, or a measure added to hot apple cider.

wynns-coonawarra-shiraz.title: Wynns Coonawarra Estate Shiraz
wynns-coonawarra-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Fragrant and refined, with blackberry, plum and red cherry layered with black pepper, violets and subtle savoury spice. The palate is medium-bodied and poised, combining juicy dark fruit with fresh acidity, fine tannins and a persistent, peppery finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast lamb, grilled beef, duck, barbecue pork, mushroom dishes, sausages, or aged hard cheeses.

offley-baron-de-forrester-30-year-old.title: Offley 30 Anos Old Tawny Porto (Barao De Forrester) 750ml

banrock-station-unwooded-chardonnay.title: Accolade Wines Banrock Station Unwooded Chardonnay 2021 750ml

erdinger-variety-pack-w-bonus-glass.title: Erdinger Variety Pack W/ Bonus Glass 5 Bottles
erdinger-variety-pack-w-bonus-glass.bodyHtml: Erdinger Variety Pack W/ Bonus Glass 5 Bottles

baileys-original-irish-cream-7.title: Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur
baileys-original-irish-cream-7.bodyHtml:
Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur is a luxurious, velvety classic that blends fine Irish whiskey and spirits with rich, luscious dairy cream and hints of cocoa and vanilla. First introduced in 1974, it is the world’s most celebrated cream liqueur, offering a beautifully balanced, indulgent, and decadent drinking experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with dark chocolate desserts, molten lava cakes, tiramisu, and fresh berries. It also makes a wonderful accompaniment to warm apple pie, pecan tarts, or simply drizzled over premium vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Opaque, creamy light brown with a rich, velvety, and thick mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet cream, dark chocolate, vanilla, and a subtle hint of warming Irish whiskey.

Palate : Smooth and indulgent with rich flavors of fresh dairy cream, milk chocolate, cocoa, sweet vanilla, and mild whiskey warmth.

Finish : Sweet, long, and coat-the-tongue smooth with lingering chocolate, cream, and soft whiskey notes.

Serve : Serve chilled, poured over ice, or as a rich addition to hot coffee, hot chocolate, or desserts.

la-messagere-gluten-free-beer.title: La Messagere Rousse-Gluten Free Red Ale
tags: Les Bieres De La Nouvelle France

sichel-sirius-rouge.title: Maison Sichel Sirius Rouge 2019
sichel-sirius-rouge.bodyHtml: The grapes are carefully selected before being fermented and aged in oak in exactly the same way as the Grands Crus Classés of Graves and Pessac-Léognan. Sirius Red is situated at the high end of the Bordeaux category and the emphasis is on balance, finesse and the mutually complementary aromas of the three Bordeaux grape varieties, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc.

hpnotiq.title: Hpnotiq
hpnotiq.bodyHtml:
Hpnotiq is a blend of tropical fruit juices, French vodka and a touch of Cognac, made in France and sold in the liqueur category. It came onto the market in 2001, and the brand credits its signature colour, a bright blue, and its original flavour with winning it a following around the world. It is bottled at 17% ABV, well below the strength of a standard spirit. Expect tropical fruit on the nose, with mango, passion fruit and citrus, and a soft, lightly sweet palate that ends clean and refreshing. This listing is the 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Tropical fruit and citrus; soft, lightly sweet and refreshing.

Serve: Chilled, over ice, or mixed in cocktails.

nugan-estate-durif.title: Nugan Estate Manuka Grove Vineyard Durif 2018
nugan-estate-durif.bodyHtml:
Nugan Manuka Grove Vineyard Durif 2018 is a rich, robust, and full-bodied Australian red wine hailing from the warm, dry climate of the Riverina region in New South Wales. Crafted by the family-owned Nugan Estate, this wine is made from Durif (often known as Petite Sirah) that is fermented in rotary fermenters and matured in American oak hogsheads to build maximum complexity and texture. In the glass, it displays a deep garnet color with a youthful crimson hue. The highly expressive aromatic bouquet opens with generous notes of dark cherry, blood plum, and ripe blackberry, elegantly layered over toasty milk chocolate oak and subtle hints of bay leaf and black pepper. On the palate, the wine is powerful yet remarkably balanced, delivering a luscious core of black cherry, plum pudding, and dark chocolate intertwined with earthy vanillin notes. Soft, chewy tannins and a fine natural acidity frame this fruit intensity, driving toward a long, structured, and deeply satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with caramelized veal shanks, slow-cooked osso buco, rich seared lamb rump served with creamy polenta, and mature aged cheddar cheese.

villa-poggio-salvi-brunello-annata-docg.title: Villa Poggio Salvi Brunello di Montalcino DOCG 2021
villa-poggio-salvi-brunello-annata-docg.bodyHtml:
Villa Poggio Salvi Brunello di Montalcino 2021 is an elegant Italian red wine from the prestigious Montalcino appellation in Tuscany. Produced by Villa Poggio Salvi, an established estate known for its dedication to traditional Tuscan winemaking, this Brunello is crafted from Sangiovese grapes and reflects the distinctive character of the region's vineyards. The 2021 vintage offers an expressive combination of ripe red cherries, wild berries and plums, complemented by notes of dried flowers, tobacco, leather and subtle spice. Structured yet refined, the wine brings together vibrant acidity, firm tannins and a lingering savoury finish. Its depth and balance make it an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining and collectors seeking a classic Tuscan red wine.

Food Pairing: Florentine steak, roasted lamb, braised beef, wild boar ragù, porcini mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, roasted game, aged Pecorino Toscano and Parmigiano Reggiano.

 

92 Points - James Suckling

Pretty aromas of red cherries, plums and berries with some red roses. Medium-bodied with lightly chewy tannins and a subtle finish of fruit. Drink or hold.

rust-en-vrede-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Rust en Vrede Estate Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
rust-en-vrede-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Rust en Vrede Estate Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 pours a deep, intense ruby color in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and complex, opening with prominent aromas of ripe black currant, dark chocolate, and fragrant cedar wood, beautifully layered with secondary hints of nutmeg, tobacco leaf, and refined pencil shavings. On the palate, this full-bodied Stellenbosch red showcases an exceptional structural balance with generous volume, vibrant acidity, and robust, fine-grained tannins. Rich, concentrated layers of fresh plum, mulberry, and black cherry seamlessly drive into a long, polished finish characterized by a lingering note of cassis and savory spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-cooked venison, aged prime sirloin steak, roasted lamb chops, rich beef stews, or a selection of mature hard cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Attractive graphite, blackberry, tobacco and black-bean aromas here. It’s medium-bodied and fresh on the palate with fine-grained tannins and a sleek, savory finish. Drink now or hold.

drouhin-oregon-cloudline-pinot-noir.title: Cloudline Pinot Noir 2022
drouhin-oregon-cloudline-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The Cloudline Pinot Noir's lustrous garnet color is immediately striking, and aromatics of summery red cherry, red plum, and light warm spice characters leap from the glass. The palate is fresh and fruit-driven to the core.

From the Willamette Valley, a region renowned for the elegance and presence of its Pinot Noirs, this one stands out for its affordable price and its profile much appreciated by Quebecers. Very supple and with a pleasant liveliness, you’ll love it slightly chilled paired to a wide variety of grilled or roasted white meat dishes.

cafaggio-chianti-classico.title: Cafaggio Chianti Classico 2020 750ml
cafaggio-chianti-classico.bodyHtml:
A deliciously concentrated example of Chianti Classico, this has dark ruby colour and rich notes of black cherry, fruitcake and plum on the palate. Serve this wine at room temperature. It makes a versatile partner for lots of savoury dishes, but do try it above all with meaty pasta dishes, roast game or poultry and mature cheeses.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Warm aromas of brick and cherry line up against cooler notes of wet rock and wild herbs on the nose, before cherries and blood orange jam take over the palate, with firm but flexible tannins.

zenato-cormi-merlot-corvina-igt.title: Zenato Cormi Merlot Corvina 2015 750ml
zenato-cormi-merlot-corvina-igt.bodyHtml:
Cormì represents the blend of two grape varieties, Corvina and Merlot, while also serving as an abbreviation for the Italian phrase meaning “My Heart” (“Cuore” and “Mio”). This wine pairs excellently with traditional Mediterranean dishes.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

white-owl-whisky.title: White Owl Whisky
white-owl-whisky.bodyHtml:
White Owl Whisky from Highwood Distillers in Alberta was introduced as the first fully oak-matured white whisky. After a long period of testing, Highwood created a clear spirit that keeps the flavours of Canadian whisky while mixing as easily as a white spirit. The oak influence is gentle, with no harsh tannin or aggressive spice. It won the Innovation of the Year award from CanadianWhisky.org. Bottled at 40% alc./vol. in a 750ml frosted bottle.

Tasting Notes: Rye, light oak, vanilla, honey, licorice.

Nose: Mild rye and light oak, with vanilla, honey and a soft licorice background.

Palate: Mild oak, without harsh tannin or aggressive spice.

Serve: In cocktails in place of a white spirit, or over ice.

chasing-lions-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Chasing Lions Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
chasing-lions-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon has bright flavors with ripe blueberries and plum and a touch of oak. The delicate vanilla finish lingers and the oak tannins are soft and elegant

Enjoy this crowd-pleasing wine on its own, with steak, burgers, grilled meats or hearty vegetables.

old-falcon-apricot-fruit-brandy.title: Stara Sokolova Kajsija Apricot Eau-de-Vie
old-falcon-apricot-fruit-brandy.bodyHtml:
Stara Sokolova Kajsija, also sold as Old Falcon Apricot Fruit Brandy, is a Serbian apricot rakija bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle. It is distilled from carefully selected ripe, healthy fruit of old apricot varieties grown in Western Serbia and Sumadija, and made by a family that has been producing rakija for seven generations. The apricot, prized in Serbia as a royal fruit, gives the spirit its fragrant, fruity character, and the producer describes the result as harmonious and very easy to drink. It is a clear fruit brandy in the traditional Balkan style.

Serve: As an aperitif or digestif, chilled to about 14°C.

camarena-tequila-reposado.title: Camarena Reposado Tequila
camarena-tequila-reposado.bodyHtml:
Camarena Reposado Tequila comes from the Familia Camarena brand of Jalisco, Mexico, whose current label carries the signatures of Mauricio and Juan Carlos Camarena and NOM 1596. It is made from 100% blue agave and rested for 60 days in Tennessee whiskey barrels. That short stay in wood gives the tequila its golden colour and adds soft vanilla and caramel to the natural sweetness of the agave. Reposado means 'rested', and the resting makes the spirit mellower and smoother. The brand suggests it for bolder, smooth cocktails and recommends mixing it with tangy fruit, coffee or fresh herbs such as mint, basil and cilantro. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Golden reposado that balances agave sweetness with soft barrel notes.

Nose: Sweet toasted agave and soft spice.

Palate: Sweet potato with hints of fruit.

Finish: Soft, with lingering vanilla and caramel.

Serve: In a La Rosita or a spicy pineapple margarita, or with tangy fruit, coffee or fresh herbs.

siduri-russian-river-valley-pinot-noir.title: Siduri Russian River Pinot Noir 2021 750ml
siduri-russian-river-valley-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: The Siduri Russian River Valley Pinot Noir is sourced from a diverse array of sub-AVAs and neighborhoods that are harmoniously layered into a singular expression of this exceptional place to grow Pinot Noir. The Green Valley AVA, as well as the neighborhoods of The Laguna, Santa Rosa Plains and Sebastopol Hills are brought together to showcase the classic dark cherry and cola notes that Russian River Valley Pinot Noirs exhibit in spades.

chateau-de-gaudou-reserve-de-caillau-cah.title: Chateau De Gaudou Reserve De Caillau Cahors 2015 750ml
chateau-de-gaudou-reserve-de-caillau-cah.bodyHtml: Chateau De Gaudou Reserve De Caillau Cah 750ml

lonely-shaman-red-semisweet.title: Lonely Shaman Red Semisweet 750ml
lonely-shaman-red-semisweet.bodyHtml:
Lonely Shaman Red Semisweet is a 750ml red wine from Moldova, known for its smooth, velvety taste and a hint of fresh berries. It's a medium-bodied, semisweet wine with a flavor profile that's both inviting and versatile. 

Origin: Moldova 
Type: Red, Semisweet 
Volume: 750ml 
Flavor Profile: Medium-bodied, smooth, velvety taste, with a hint of fresh berries. It's described as a "delightful and versatile wine" that combines crispness with a touch of sweetness. 
Style: A smooth red wine with a touch of sweetness. It's described as the best-selling East European wine in Canada. 
Other details: Contains sulfites.

pump-house-sampler-variety-pack.title: Pump House Sampler Variety Pack 12 Bottles

tequila-gran-centenario-reposado.title: Gran Centenario Reposado Tequila
tequila-gran-centenario-reposado.bodyHtml: Gran Centenario Reposado ran Centenario Reposado is slowly double-distilled from carefully selected blue agave and rested in new oak casks. Then, the proprietary 'Selección Suave' process blends the richest and smoothest 100% agave tequilas to yield a smooth, complex taste profile. Evokes tones of cooked agave with hints of oak, vanilla, toasted almonds, and clove. • Winner of various awards including a GOLD MEDAL at the 2019 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

deadhead-rum-1.title: Hamilton The Breezeway Blend Rum 1L
deadhead-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Hamilton The Breezeway Blend Rum is a light, straw-coloured blended rum from Ed Hamilton's Ministry of Rum Collection, bottled at 42.5% ABV in a 1 litre bottle. It was created with Spike, host of the YouTube series Spike's Breezeway Cocktail Hour, a tiki and home-bartending show with more than 150 episodes, and his viewers. The blend combines two existing Hamilton rums, Jamaican Pot Still Blonde and White Stache, and the label describes it as a select blend of West Indies rum. It was put together as a cocktail rum, aimed at daiquiris, long drinks and tropical recipes that call for a lightly aged blend.

Tasting Notes: Pale straw in colour, with ripe banana and tropical fruit on the palate and a smooth finish.

Serve: In a daiquiri, a long drink or any tropical cocktail that calls for a blended light rum.

santa-isle-grand-reserve-pinot-noir.title: Santa Rita Secret Reserve Pinot Noir 750ml
santa-isle-grand-reserve-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Moderately intense violet-red in color with aromas of raspberries, cherries, and flowers combined with sweet notes of vanilla and caramel from the French oak. This is a silky, juicy, and very well-balanced wine with refreshing acidity that makes it very easy to drink.

bavaria-86-extreme.title: Bavaria 86 Extreme 500ml
bavaria-86-extreme.bodyHtml:
The most intense beer in our 8.6 range. 

This golden blonde beer is a real show-off and has a hearty and robust bite!

Its full and powerful flavour of honey and sweet fruit is combined with a unique bitterness, characterising the kick and character of this beer.

blue-chair-bay-coconut-rum.title: Ron Caribu Twist Coconut Rum
blue-chair-bay-coconut-rum.bodyHtml:
Ron Caribu Twist Coconut Rum is a coconut-flavoured rum from Venezuela, made by Bodegas Luediaz under the Caribu name. It is a lighter-strength flavoured rum, bottled at 25% ABV in a 700ml bottle, designed for easy tropical mixed drinks.

Serve: Over ice with soda or juice, or in tropical cocktails such as a pina colada.

girls-night-out-pineapple-mango-tango.title: Girls' Night Out Pineapple Mango Tango 750ml
girls-night-out-pineapple-mango-tango.bodyHtml:
Crisp and sweet with flavours of tropical pineapple, juicy mango and citrus.

PAIRINGS
Pairs perfectly with with Caribbean shrimp tacos.

DETAILS
Alcohol Content: 6.5%
Residual Sugar: 84g/L
Sugar Code: 8
Size: 750 mL Bottle

jack-daniels-tennessee-honey-1.title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Honey 1.14L
jack-daniels-tennessee-honey-1.bodyHtml: A blend of Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey and a unique honey liqueur of their own making, for a taste that's one-of-a-kind and unmistakably Jack. With hints of honey and a finish that's naturally smooth, Jack Daniel's Tennessee Honey offers a taste of the unexpected.

joseph-carr-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
joseph-carr-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is an incredibly round, juicy, and highly approachable Californian red wine crafted as a comforting tribute by founder Joseph Carr in honor of his father. Sourced from premier vineyards across California's diverse growing regions, this vintage highlights the approachable and expressive potential of the state's signature red grape. In the glass, it pours a deep, rich dark ruby hue with a full coating rim. The forward and incredibly aromatic nose opens with inviting scents of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, and black currant, masterfully integrated with subtle undertones of toasted hazelnut, cinnamon, warm vanilla, and sweet toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and beautifully balanced, displaying a soft, velvety fluid coherence where its core of juicy dark forest fruit effortlessly intertwines with fine-grained, round tannins and a moderate spine of natural acidity, concluding with a long, smooth finish accented by lingering hints of mocha and subtle wood spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with charcoal-grilled gourmet beef burgers, slow-braised pork short ribs, rosemary-infused roasted lamb chops, and a block of mature sharp cheddar cheese.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas are notes of ripe dark berries, coriander, sage, florals, and toasty oak on the nose. The flavors are Blackberries, boysenberries, vanilla cream, nutmeg, and mocha with silky tannins on the finish.

torres-chile-las-mulas-organic-rose.title: Miguel Torres Las Mulas Rose
torres-chile-las-mulas-organic-rose.bodyHtml:
Miguel Torres Las Mulas Rosé is a vibrant, organic rosé crafted from Cabernet Sauvignon vines grown in the Central Valley of Chile. Vinified to capture pure fruit expression and crisp freshness, it displays an attractive pale salmon-pink hue in the glass. The nose offers inviting aromas of fresh wild strawberries, raspberries, redcurrants, and subtle floral notes. On the palate, it is light-to-medium-bodied, clean, and well-balanced, delivering lively red fruit flavors backed by bright acidity and a dry, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh seafood salads, grilled shrimp, poached salmon, sushi, tapas, light pasta, and fresh goat cheese.

girls-night-out-sangria.title: Girls' Night Out Sangria 750ml
girls-night-out-sangria.bodyHtml:
Girls' Night Out Sangria is a vibrant and fruity wine cocktail that's perfect for casual get-togethers and easy sipping. Bursting with juicy flavors of ripe berries, citrus, and a touch of tropical fruit, this refreshing blend offers a sweet, smooth taste that's light on the palate. Serve chilled over ice with slices of fresh fruit for an easy, crowd-pleasing treat.

Whether it's a sunny afternoon or a cozy evening with friends, this sangria brings the fun to every moment.

beringer-main-vine-red-crush.title: Beringer Main & Vine Merlot 750ml
beringer-main-vine-red-crush.bodyHtml: Ripe plum and currant flavors are immediately evident in its aromas and flavors. A sweet, toasty note of oak rounds out the blend and gives the wine a nice body and mouth feel. Approachable and delicious from the first sip, this wine is an everyday indulgence.

la-casa-red-blend.title: La Storia Cuvee 32 Red Blend 2022
la-casa-red-blend.bodyHtml:
The La Storia Cuvée 32 Red Blend 2022 is a bold, expressive, and fruit-forward New World red wine that serves as a highly successful, Italian-inspired "Super Tuscan" expression of its estate vineyards. It pours an attractive dark red colour with a slightly garnet shimmer, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of intense dark cherries, cassis, and raspberry confit, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of plum, blueberry, pomegranate, and mocha. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red blend is remarkably smooth, juicy, and round, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of sarsaparilla, baking spices, and a lush mouthfeel that highlights the exceptional quality of the 2022 vintage. Matured thoughtfully for 17 months in European oak barrels to enhance its structural depth and savory complexity, its structural crunch is sustained by relatively high, food-friendly acidity and soft, well-integrated tannins that carry into a long, fresh finish accented by a lingering touch of cocoa, leather, and black licorice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with casual Italian or hearty Mediterranean fare, including tomato-based pasta dishes with meat ragù, wood-fired mushroom pizzas, grilled pork chops, gourmet beef burgers, slow-cooked lamb shanks, traditional lasagna, and semi-hard or aged cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of ripe raspberry, cinnamon and lemon zest burst from the glass on the nose of this Sangiovese and Merlot dominated blend. The palate brings waves of berry, spice and herb flavors in a richly tannic framework softened by zesty acidity. While delicious now, this will be best from 2028.

90 Points - James Suckling

Red-fruited aromas of dark cherries, raspberry confit and mocha. The palate is medium-bodied with a lush mouthfeel and balanced acidity, giving flavors of sarsaparilla and baking spices. A simple and early-drinking blend of sangiovese, merlot, montepulciano and malbec. Drink now.

opihr-oriental-spiced-gin.title: Barrister Mumbai Gin
opihr-oriental-spiced-gin.bodyHtml:
Crafted in the style of traditional dry gins infused with exotic exotic influences, Barrister Mumbai Gin features separate distillations of classic gin botanicals alongside rich Indian spices. By distilling key components like black pepper, cardamom, and cumin separately, it delivers a uniquely warm, aromatic, and spicy profile reminiscent of traditional Indian markets.

Food Pairing: Spicy Indian curries, vegetable samosas, chicken tikka, grilled kebabs, or flavorful street food.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear in appearance with a smooth, warm, and medium-bodied mouthfeel that coats the palate in aromatic spice oils.

Nose: Intensely aromatic with warm black pepper, cardamom, and cumin upfront, accompanied by piney juniper, fresh citrus peel, and sweet nutmeg.

Palate: Richly spiced and complex, opening with bold juniper before unfolding into layers of cracked black pepper, aromatic cardamom, warm coriander, and subtle citrus zest.

Finish: Long, warm, and spicy with lingering notes of pepper, oriental spices, and gentle pine.

Serve: Serve over large ice cubes with premium tonic water, garnished with a sprig of fresh mint and a twist of lime or a slice of fresh ginger.

olmeca-altos-tequila-plata.title: Olmeca Altos Plata Tequila
olmeca-altos-tequila-plata.bodyHtml:
Olmeca Altos Plata is a 100% agave blanco tequila from the Olmeca Altos range, produced in Arandas in the Mexican state of Jalisco. The agave used for it is crushed with a tahona, the traditional stone wheel, a method that adds complexity to the spirit. Clear and colourless in the glass, it opens with moderately intense aromas of smoky bacon, citrus and white pepper. The palate is full and warming, with floral and citrus flavours, and the finish is long with a fresh, lime-like edge. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a bright, characterful blanco that works as well in a margarita as it does sipped chilled.

Tasting Notes: Citrus, white pepper, smoky bacon, florals, lime.

Nose: Smoky bacon, citrus and white pepper.

Palate: Full and warming, with floral and citrus flavours.

Finish: Long and lime-like.

Serve: Chilled and neat, or in a margarita or Paloma.

hob-nob-wicked-red.title: Hob Nob Wicked Red Blend Limited Edition 2019 750ml

caposaldo-pinot-grigio.title: Caposaldo Pinot Grigio
caposaldo-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Caposaldo Pinot Grigio pours a bright, pale straw-yellow color with delicate greenish highlights in the glass. The highly expressive bouquet opens with fresh, inviting aromas of crisp green apple, Bartlett pear, and citrus zest, beautifully complemented by subtle undertones of white acacia blossoms and toasted almonds. On the palate, this medium-bodied white wine showcases a dry, exceptionally crisp, and vibrant structure. A pure fruit-forward core of white orchard fruit and clean lemon notes flows seamlessly across the palate, masterfully balanced by a refreshing line of natural acidity. Crafted completely unoaked to preserve its pristine varietal character, it glides into a clean, smooth, and remarkably refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with white meats, fresh seafood, grilled fish, delicate pasta dishes, light summer salads, or soft cheeses.

giusti-augusto-recantina.title: Giusti Augusto Recantina 2020
giusti-augusto-recantina.bodyHtml:
Smooth and intense, this full-bodied wine has a hint of mineral that gives it a touch of freshness. It is produced from a single variety, native Recantina grapes, a rare and precious treasure of the Montello.

Intense and bright ruby, excellent transparency. Intense with fruity notes of red plum and black currant (cassis) and floral notes of violets and cyclamen. This is also the moss and mineral notes reminiscent of freshly tilled soil. In the mouth it is soft and velvety, with sweet tannins and pleasantly acidic aftertaste.

Wine suited to red meat and game especially furred. also excellent with duck breast, baked guinea fowl, and the medium-aged cheeses.

giusti-antonio-rosso-veneto.title: Giusti Antonio Tenuta Aria Valentina 2020
giusti-antonio-rosso-veneto.bodyHtml:
Intense ruby red with slight violet hues. Intense with notes of red fruits and black currants. This is followed by spicy notes of vanilla and pepper. Fairly full with round tannins and elegant in the mouth; excellent persistence in aftertaste and flavour.

Wine suited to red meat but also perfect with braised veal and lamb. Also excellent with medium-aged cheeses.

89 Points - Decanter

errazuriz-aconcagua-alto-cabernet.title: Errazuriz Aconcagua Alto Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 750ml
errazuriz-aconcagua-alto-cabernet.bodyHtml: The Errázuriz Aconcagua Alto Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a full-bodied Chilean red wine known for its ripe fruit flavors, balanced acidity, and smooth tannins. This wine displays a deep ruby color and offers a complex palate with notes of cassis, cherry, and blackberry, alongside hints of vanilla, chocolate, and spice. The nose reveals aromas of red and black fruits, with touches of clove and coffee. Its fine-grained tannins and long persistence make it a well-structured and pleasing wine.

wine-doktor-blend-red-semisweet.title: Bostavan Wine Doktor Special Blend 2023
wine-doktor-blend-red-semisweet.bodyHtml: Wine Doktor Blend Red Semisweet is a special blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Saperavi grapes from the Etulia microzone in Southern Moldova. It is described as a fresh and juicy wine with a lovely garnet color and ruby reflections. Tasting notes include distinctive plum and chocolate aromas, with a smooth, soft finish and well-integrated tannins.

blindman-triphammer-robust-porter.title: Blindman Triphammer Robust Porter 4 Tall Cans

giusti-umberto-i-rosso-del-veneto-2011.title: Giusti Umberto I Veneto Rosso Superiore 2011
giusti-umberto-i-rosso-del-veneto-2011.bodyHtml:
Giusti Wine’s most iconic product, this wine is elegant, rich and enveloping, a masterful Bordeaux blend that has close ties with the land where international varieties were introduced by Napoleon Bonaparte.

Intense ruby red with light garnet hues. Intense with notes of red fruit spice, vanilla and pepper. Full-bodied, round and persistent with soft tannins and elegant.

Excellent with grilled meats, game and mature cheese. Excellent after a meal.

94 Points - James Suckling

A very spicy nose with red peppers, tobacco, blackcurrants and redcurrants, dark chocolate and mocha. Medium to full body, a lovely line of fresh acidity, structured tannins and a tight finish. Drink now.

blanche-de-namur-wit-bier.title: Cannery Naramata Nut Brown Ale 4 Tall Cans
blanche-de-namur-wit-bier.bodyHtml: Cannery Naramata Nut Brown Ale 4 Tall Cans

summer-water-rose.title: Summer Water Rose 750ml
summer-water-rose.bodyHtml: Our favorite for any season is delightfully dry, crisp and delicious with notes of grapefruit, watermelon, and lemon zest. Our grapes were grown on the Central Coast of CA and picked early in the season to achieve natural acidity and fresh, light taste. For the summer state of mind, anytime.

hermandad-blend.title: Familia Falasco Hermandad Red Blend 2022
hermandad-blend.bodyHtml: This wine offers a complex bouquet of ripe black fruits, sweet spices, tobacco, mocha, and delicate floral notes. The palate is full and ripe, beginning with blackberry flavors that evolve into defined cassis and plum, finishing with sweet yet firm tannins. It pairs wonderfully with roast beef, veal, venison, and game birds such as duck, partridge, and pheasant, as well as cheeses like Lincolnshire Poacher, Red Leicester, and Cheshire.

hard-ice-vodka-freezie-cream-soda.title: Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Cream Soda 200ml
hard-ice-vodka-freezie-cream-soda.bodyHtml: Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Cream Soda is a frozen vodka cocktail in a “freezie” tube / pouch format. You store it in the freezer until it reaches a slushy or partially frozen consistency, then squeeze or consume it like a frozen drink — similar to an alcoholic slush pop.

cantini-red.title: Cantina Zaccagnini Tralcetto 0.0% Red
cantini-red.bodyHtml:
Cantina Zaccagnini Tralcetto 0.0% Red is an exceptionally innovative, aromatic, and expressive alcohol-removed red wine from the Abruzzo region, keeping with the winery's signature style and iconic hand-tied "tralcetto" grapevine twig on the bottle. Produced from selected premium Italian red grapes (primarily Montepulciano), it undergoes a highly advanced vacuum evaporation process that extracts the alcohol at low temperatures while carefully preserving and reintegrating the delicate natural aromas. In the glass, it displays a vibrant purple-red color with bright violet highlights. The nose is highly inviting and direct, revealing a fragrant bouquet of ripe wild berries, fresh red cherries, and black plums, beautifully accented by a touch of white pepper and sweet spices. On the palate, this non-alcoholic red is medium-bodied, smooth, and remarkably balanced, offering juicy dark fruit flavors framed by a soft, rounded structure and a pleasantly fresh, clean finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light pasta dishes, grilled rosemary chicken breast, fresh garden salads, or a selection of mild semi-hard cheeses.

cantini-white.title: Cantina Zaccagnini Tralcetto 0.0% White
cantini-white.bodyHtml:
Cantina Zaccagnini Tralcetto 0.0% White is an exceptionally fresh, innovative, and fragrant alcohol-removed white wine from Abruzzo, maintaining the estate’s dedication to quality and traditional winemaking. Produced from selected Italian white grapes, it undergoes a highly advanced vacuum evaporation process that removes the ethanol while successfully capturing and reintegrating the delicate volatile aromas. The resulting non-alcoholic wine pours a brilliant straw-yellow color with golden highlights. The nose reveals an inviting bouquet of juicy yellow peach, sweet apricot, and delicate white flowers. On the palate, it is light, clean, and beautifully balanced, showing a lively fruit-forward sweetness and a crisp, refreshing finish that closely mimics its classic alcoholic counterpart.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light garden salads, fresh seafood skewers, classic bruschetta, steamed mussels, or creamy goat cheese.

mount-peak-rattlesnake-zinfandel.title: Turley Cedarman Zinfandel
mount-peak-rattlesnake-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
A proprietary, organically farmed Napa Valley assemblage from the high-elevation Dragon and Rattlesnake Ridge vineyards. Characteristic Howell Mountain blue fruits, white spice, and grippy tannin structure define a brooding, intense red wine that remains wonderfully lush and immediately approachable.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with a thick-cut grilled ribeye steak with garlic herb butter, smoked beef brisket, or slow-cooked wild boar ragù.

dog-island-saints-sinners-ipa.title: Dog Island Saints & Sinners Ipa 4 Tall Cans
dog-island-saints-sinners-ipa.bodyHtml: Dog Island Saints & Sinners Ipa 4 Tall Cans

bodacious-bubbles.title: Bodacious Bourbon Barrel Aged Red Blend 750ml
bodacious-bubbles.bodyHtml:
Aromas of blackberry burst with vibrancy on the palate, enhanced with decadent flavours of mocha and hints of vanilla for a silky, smooth finish.

88 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A smooth and approachable red blend with noticeable vanilla and caramel notes from bourbon barrel aging. Features soft dark fruit flavors and an easy-drinking finish."


87 Points - Tastings.com
"Offers straightforward notes of baked berries and sweet oak spice. A crowd-pleasing, dessert-like wine that appeals to both bourbon and wine drinkers."

brave-step-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Brave Step Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 750ml
brave-step-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon has a ruby red colour with bright red highlights. Intense strawberry and raspberry on the nose with a hint of cacao. Pleasant and lively on the palate, medium-bodied with well-forged tannins on the finish. This wine can be a great companion for a BBQ steak.

girls-night-out-white-sangria.title: Girls' Night Out White Sangria
girls-night-out-white-sangria.bodyHtml:
Bright pale straw-gold in colour, opening with vibrant, sun-drenched aromas of ripe white peach, sweet pineapple, Meyer lemon, and crisp green apple. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied, refreshing, and juicy, delivering lively tropical and orchard fruit flavours balanced by gentle sweetness and crisp citrus acidity on a clean, easy-drinking finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled shrimp skewers, fresh ceviche, caprese salad, fish tacos with mango salsa, light charcuterie and brie, or fresh fruit tarts.

barefoot-malbec.title: Barefoot Cabernet Sauvignon 1.5L Magnum
barefoot-malbec.bodyHtml: Barefoot Cabernet Sauvignon positively bursts with bold, round layers of raspberry and blackberry jam, making this smooth wine an instant sensation . It finishes with notes of currant and smooth vanilla, and its light tannins make it balanced and easy to drink . This versatile California red wine pairs perfectly with everything from backyard barbecues to beef, cheeseburgers, and red sauce pasta dishes .
