mcguinness-triple-sec-1.bodyHtml:
McGuinness Triple Sec is an orange liqueur from McGuinness, the Canadian liqueur range made by Corby Spirit and Wine. The name nods to the French sec, meaning dry, and the liqueur is packed with sweet orange, bringing zesty citrus to margaritas and daiquiris and a subtle orange note to a Cosmopolitan. A home-bar essential, bottled at 22% ABV in a handy 375 ml size.

Tasting Notes: Sweet, zesty orange.

Serve: In margaritas, daiquiris and Cosmopolitans.

summer-love-peach-vodka.title: Starr Distilling Summer Love Peach Vodka
summer-love-peach-vodka.bodyHtml:
Starr Distilling Summer Love Peach Vodka is a peach-flavoured vodka from Starr Distilling in Alberta. The distillery describes it as light and highly aromatic, with a ripe-peach character that recalls a summer orchard. Bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is made to sip on its own or to bring peach flavour to cocktails.

Serve: Over ice, with soda and a squeeze of lemon, or in a peach Bellini-style cocktail.

hard-ice-vodka-freezie-bent-orange.title: Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Watermelon 200ml
hard-ice-vodka-freezie-bent-orange.bodyHtml:
Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Watermelon is a ready-to-drink vodka freezie from Winterland Beverages Ltd. of British Columbia, in a single 200 ml serving at 6.8% ABV. The watermelon flavour is one of a family of Hard Ice vodka freezies made in Canada, alongside Bent Orange, Blue Bullet, Cream Soda, Grape, Pina Colada and Raspberry. Keep it in the freezer and enjoy it icy.

hard-ice-vodka-freezie-pina-colada.bodyHtml:
Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Watermelon is a ready-to-drink vodka freezie from Winterland Beverages Ltd. of British Columbia, in a single 200 ml serving at 6.8% ABV. goslings-gold-seal-rum.title: Goslings Black Seal Rum
goslings-gold-seal-rum.bodyHtml:
Goslings Black Seal is a dark rum from Bermuda, bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) in a 750ml bottle; the label calls it Bermuda Black Rum. The producer explains that the blend includes distillates from both pot stills and continuous stills, which it credits for the rum's nuanced character. It follows a Gosling family recipe more than 150 years old, is aged in charred American oak casks, has been exported to the United States since 1980 and is now Bermuda's largest export product. It is the rum used in the Dark 'n Stormy, the trademarked Bermudian cocktail made with Goslings Stormy Ginger Beer and a lime garnish. The colour is a dark copper mahogany.

Tasting Notes: Dark copper mahogany; rich and intricate, with sweet spice, stewed fruit and vanilla.

Nose: Fruitcake, herbs and spice, butterscotch, banana and vanilla.

Palate: Rich and well balanced, with thick sweet spices, stewed fruits and vanilla.

Finish: Spicy, crisp and tingling.

Serve: In a Dark 'n Stormy: fill a tall glass with ice, pour in 6 oz ginger beer and float 2 oz Black Seal on top, with a lime wedge.

new-level-haze-lord-new-england-ipa.title: Coll Arts Life In The Clouds Hazy IPA 473ml
new-level-haze-lord-new-england-ipa.bodyHtml: Our flagship New England style IPA. We dialed in the Simcoe and Mosaic hops and malt balance to optimize this juicy IPA’s pleasantly fruit forward (think citrus and melon) taste and aroma. Unfiltered, neither overly-sweet nor bitter, with a pillowy mouth feel

maya-rum-horchata.title: Dos Maderas 5+5 PX Triple Aged Rum
maya-rum-horchata.bodyHtml:
Dos Maderas 5+5 PX Cask Aged Rum is a fascinating, award-winning expression that showcases an extraordinary "triple-aging" process spanning two completely different continents. Crafted by the historic house of Williams & Humbert, the journey begins in the Caribbean, where fine rums from Barbados and Guyana are column-distilled and matured in American oak barrels for an initial 5 years.

The rum is then shipped to the sun-drenched region of Jerez, Spain, where it undergoes a double-phase finishing process using a traditional Sherry Solera system. It is first aged for 3 years in casks that previously held the distillery's internationally acclaimed "Dos Cortados" 20-Year-Old Palo Cortado Sherry. Finally, it spends an additional 2 years in casks that held "Don Guido" 20-Year-Old Pedro Ximénez (PX) Sherry. This final, heavy PX cask seasoning infuses the rum with an unparalleled, decadent richness, completely blurring the lines between a premium aged spirit and a luxurious dessert wine.

Food Pairing: Rich chocolate fondant, artisanal blue cheese, warm fig tarts, pan-seared duck with a cherry reduction, or a fine premium cigar.

TASTING NOTES Deep, dark mahogany amber with intense ruby highlights; offers a remarkably lush, viscous, and syrupy mouthfeel that entirely coats the tongue.

NOSE Powerfully aromatic and dessert-forward, opening with intense waves of dark molasses, sweet brown sugar, and vanilla fudge, quickly giving way to the heavy sherry influence of juicy raisins, dried figs, dates, and a gentle touch of toasted oak.

PALATE Luxuriously sweet, rich, and deeply complex; initial flavors of dark honey, maple syrup, and toffee are masterfully met by a wave of stewed plums, dark chocolate, and roasted nuts. The Palo Cortado wood breaks through on the mid-palate, adding structural balance with notes of aged leather, tobacco leaf, and a fine hint of spice.

FINISH Exceptionally long, warm, and velvety, leaving a lingering, mouth-coating trail of sweet Pedro Ximénez grapes, dark cocoa, vanilla bean, and a sophisticated, dry wood-smoke finish.

SERVE Best enjoyed strictly neat at room temperature in a snifter or a spirits tulip glass to fully appreciate the complex, slow-unraveling layers of the Solera wood.

wild-rose-barracks-brown-ale.bodyHtml: A dark brown and ruby-hued ale with rich notes of espresso and chocolate. It is mildly hopped with a medium body and a crisp, smooth finish

siempre-anejo.title: Siempre Anejo Tequila
siempre-anejo.bodyHtml:
Siempre Anejo Tequila is an ultra-premium, additive-free 100% Blue Weber agave tequila crafted using agave harvested from both the Highlands (Los Altos) and Lowlands (Valle) of Jalisco, Mexico. Double-distilled and aged in American white oak ex-bourbon barrels, it seamlessly bridges rich, oak-derived complexity with vibrant, natural agave character.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate tarts, grilled ribeye steak, aged gouda, or caramelized desserts like flan.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold appearance with a velvety, rich, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromas of sweet roasted agave, caramelized vanilla, toasted oak, butterscotch, and warm baking spices.

Palate : Rich flavors of cooked agave, dark cocoa, butterscotch, subtle orange peel, dried fruit, and toasted wood spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of vanilla, gentle black pepper, and toasted oak.

Serve : Serve neat or over a single large ice sphere, or enjoy as a base in spirit-forward cocktails such as an Añejo Old Fashioned.

yangarra-iron-heart-shiraz.title: Yarra Yering Underhill Shiraz 2016 750ml
yangarra-iron-heart-shiraz.bodyHtml:
New world cool climate Shiraz starts here. Heady black plum fruits and pretty violet aromatics interlaced with liquorice spice and nettle undergrowth. The heavier clay based soils produces wine dark fruits and spice, chewy tannins creating the framework to support the fruit and savoury undertones.

96 Points – James Halliday
Hand-picked from a 3.2ha block planted '73, whole berries fermented in half-tonne fermenters with stalk baskets, some batches with 20% whole bunches, one batch with 100%, matured for 12 months in French puncheons (30% new). Bright, deep colour; right from the outset, very different to the other wines in the release, with more spring in its step, more stalky/spice flavours behind black fruits, peppery notes inlaid into the broader mosaic of a constantly changing colour.”

yanjing-beer.title: Chang Beer 6 Bottles
yanjing-beer.bodyHtml: A smooth, easy-drinking Thai lager with a radiant amber-gold hue. It offers a well-balanced taste with a pleasant blend of malt sweetness and light hop bitterness, leading to a clean, crisp, and refreshing finish

royal-jamaican-spiced-rum.title: Royal Jamaican Spiced Rum
royal-jamaican-spiced-rum.bodyHtml:
Royal Jamaican Spiced Rum is a spiced rum from Jamaica, built on pot-stilled rums that are blended with an assortment of spices. Rather than relying on heavy sweetness, it leans on warm baking spice and citrus: orange peel and clove lead, with star anise, vanilla bean, allspice and cinnamon filling out the profile. The rum is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Its spice-forward character makes it a flexible bottle for highballs and punches, and it also holds up over ice for those who like a spiced rum to sip slowly.

Tasting Notes: Orange peel, clove, star anise, vanilla bean, allspice and cinnamon.

Serve: Over ice, with cola or ginger beer, or in a rum punch.

st-germain-elderflower-liquer.title: St Germain Elderflower Liqueur
st-germain-elderflower-liquer.bodyHtml: The regal bottle is a reflection of the fine artisanal French liqueur held within. Made with fresh hand-picked elderflower blossoms, without the use of preservatives. The aromas are fruit driven with floral hints. On the palate expect tropical fruit, citrus, pear and a hint of honeysuckle sweetness.

smirnoff-rose-sangria.title: Smirnoff Soda Rose Variety Pack 12 Cans
smirnoff-rose-sangria.bodyHtml: This variety pack offers crisp, and fruity zero sugar vodka sodas, elevated by the addition of rosé wine. Flavours include raspberry, strawberry, white peach and pink apple rosé.

sortilege-blueberry.title: Sortilege Blueberry
sortilege-blueberry.bodyHtml:
Sortilège Wild Blueberry is a Quebec whisky liqueur that takes the brand's classic blend of Canadian whisky and Quebec maple syrup and adds the flavour of wild blueberries from Quebec's Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean region. Bottled at 23% ABV in a 750 ml bottle, it offers a refreshingly unique taste in which maple sweetness and whisky warmth meet ripe wild blueberry. Sortilège draws on a recipe from Quebec's early settlers, who flavoured their spirits with local maple syrup, and its whisky matures for some 1,100 days in oak barrels before blending.

Serve: Chilled over ice, in a blueberry whisky sour, or in a blueberry iced tea.

stella-rosa-black.title: Stella Rosa Black 750ml
stella-rosa-black.bodyHtml: The highest quality Italian red wines and natural fruit flavors blended together to create an intense Stella Rosa with a touch of sparkle.  Refreshing and seductive.

stella-rosa-moscato.title: Stella Rosa Moscato 750ml
stella-rosa-moscato.bodyHtml:
The Stella Rosa Moscato wine is a semi-sweet wine from the Piedmont region of Italy. It’s sweet but not too sweet with just enough bubbles, great as an aperitif or with light meals, giving off a refreshing taste with a clean finish.

This Stella Rosa Moscato 750 ml size is perfect to share with a few loved ones over dinner or to treat yourself after a long week.

punjabi-club-rye-whisky.title: Alberta Premium Canadian Rye Whisky 1.75L
punjabi-club-rye-whisky.bodyHtml:
Alberta Premium Canadian Rye Whisky is a legendary staple of Canadian distilling, famous for being one of the few remaining 100% rye grain whiskies on the market. Highly revered by whisky connoisseurs and casual drinkers alike, it offers a distinctively bold, spicy, and robust flavor profile balanced by a subtle undercurrent of sweet vanilla, oak, and toffee. Its sharp, crisp finish makes it exceptionally versatile, performing beautifully neat, on the rocks, or as the spicy backbone of a classic Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

Food Pairing: The aggressive spice and rich oak of this 100% rye slice perfectly through rich, fatty foods. Pair it with slow-smoked BBQ beef brisket, sharp aged cheddar cheese, or a decadent dark chocolate tart to complement its deep, earthy undertones.

mcgraths-irish-cream-1-75.title: Mcgraths Irish Cream 1.75
mcgraths-irish-cream-1-75.bodyHtml:
McGrath's Irish Cream is a cream liqueur from Ireland, bottled at 13.9% ABV. This 1.75L bottle is a good-value option for sipping over ice, pouring into coffee or using in creamy cocktails and desserts.

Serve: Chilled over ice, in coffee, or in cream-based cocktails.

taynton-bay-spirits-ginger-matcha.title: Taynton Bay Spirits Ginger Matcha
taynton-bay-spirits-ginger-matcha.bodyHtml:
Taynton Bay Spirits Ginger Matcha is a ready-to-drink, tea-infused cocktail from Taynton Bay Spirits, a craft distillery in British Columbia, Canada. It is bottled at 14% ABV in a 750ml bottle, ready to pour.

jacobs-creek-double-barrel-cabernet.title: Jacob's Creek Double Barrel Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
jacobs-creek-double-barrel-cabernet.bodyHtml:
A distinctive Australian Cabernet Sauvignon matured in traditional oak barrels and finished in aged whisky barrels for added depth and complexity. Aromas of vibrant cassis, mint and dark olive lead into rich caramel, ripe dark fruit, smooth tannins and a lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled lamb, slow-roasted beef, smoked brisket and aged cheddar.

lucky-bastard-vodka-yellow-label.title: Lucky Bastard Yellow Label Vodka
lucky-bastard-vodka-yellow-label.bodyHtml:
Lucky Bastard Yellow Label Vodka is the flagship premium vodka from LB Distillers in Saskatchewan. It is made from 100% Saskatchewan wheat and distilled seven times for good luck, giving a crisp, clean and exceptionally smooth Canadian vodka. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle and listed by the producer as gluten free, it is versatile enough to sip neat, mix into cocktails, or raise in a toast to life's little wins.

Tasting Notes: Crisp, clean and smooth.

Serve: Chilled and neat, in a Caesar, or with soda and citrus.

giusti-amarone-della-valpolicella.title: Giusti Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2019
giusti-amarone-della-valpolicella.bodyHtml:
Giusti Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2019 is an opulent, powerful, and deeply expressive Venetian red wine crafted by Giusti Wine from historic old vines aged over 70 years in the heart of the Valpolicella Classica zone. Sourced from hillside vineyards rooted in limestone-rich, gravelly soils, the hand-selected clusters of Corvina Veronese, Corvinone, and Rondinella undergo traditional appassimento (drying on bamboo racks for several months to concentrate sugars, polyphenols, and aromatics) before temperature-controlled fermentation and extensive aging in large Slavonian and French oak casks. In the glass, it displays an intensely concentrated, deep ruby core with warm garnet highlights. The bouquet is lavish, perfumed, and layered, revealing concentrated scents of dried black cherries, stewed plums, and dried figs intertwined with nuances of dark chocolate, sweet licorice, cinnamon, warm cardamom, cigar box, and subtle balsamic earth. On the palate, it is full-bodied, expansive, and warmly coating, delivering an unctuous texture of ripe dark fruits framed by supple, velvety tannins, balanced natural acidity, and an enduring, spicy, and warming finish.

Food Pairing: Slow-braised beef short ribs, venison stew with juniper berries, roasted wild boar, osso buco, and mature Parmigiano-Reggiano or aged Gorgonzola cheese.

villa-sandi-asolo-prosecco-docg.title: Villa Sandi Asolo Prosecco Docg 750ml
villa-sandi-asolo-prosecco-docg.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: "The Italians love prosecco after work, served solo, or with finger foods, and I highly recommend you do the same. Expect a fruity, creamy prosecco with a pleasant fruity mid palate of red apples, peaches, with a hint of spice. The DOCG Asolo Prosecco lies in the Veneto region on the Montello and Colli Asolani hills, at the foot of the Dolomites. Whole grapes are pressed, fermented, and racked into controlled temperature tanks, remaining until they go through the sparkling wine tank process to be finally halted by refrigeration. (Anthony Gismondi)." - 88/100, Gismondi on Wine

bombay-sapphire.title: Bombay Sapphire Basquiat Special Edition London Dry Gin
bombay-sapphire.bodyHtml:
Crafted in partnership with the Estate of Jean-Michel Basquiat, this collectible special edition bottle honors the iconic Brooklyn-born artist by featuring his early work, "Untitled (L.A. Painting)," rendered across the signature blue glass bottle. Inside, it contains the classic Bombay Sapphire London Dry liquid—produced at Laverstoke Mill in Hampshire, England, using a signature vapor-infusion process with ten exotic botanicals for an exceptionally balanced and versatile taste.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, lemon-herb roasted chicken, smoked salmon crostini, goat cheese salad, or mild vegetable curry.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear in appearance with a clean, crisp, and light-to-medium mouthfeel.

Nose: Fresh and floral with bright piney juniper upfront, accompanied by zesty lemon peel, warm coriander, earthy angelica root, and subtle peppery spice.

Palate: Remarkably smooth and well-balanced, opening with gentle juniper berries and vibrant citrus oils before unfolding into complex layers of warm baking spice, floral orris, and subtle nutty almond nuances.

Finish: Medium-long, clean, and dry with lingering notes of citrus zest, peppery cubeb berries, and gentle pine.

Serve: Serve over ice with premium Indian tonic water, garnished with a fresh lime wedge, or use as a collectible centerpiece in classic Dry Martinis, Tom Collins, and French 75 cocktails.

well-juice-vodka-lemonade-charcoal.title: New Amsterdam Pink Whitney Pink Lemonade Flavoured Vodka
well-juice-vodka-lemonade-charcoal.bodyHtml:
New Amsterdam Pink Whitney is a pink lemonade flavoured vodka from the New Amsterdam range of E. & J. Gallo, bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The flavour grew out of a collaboration between Barstool Sports and New Amsterdam and was inspired by the favourite drink of former NHL player Ryan Whitney, co-host of the Spittin' Chiclets podcast, before going viral with hockey fans. New Amsterdam vodka is infused with pink lemonade flavour for a bright, sweet-tart profile with natural lemon zest and a clean, refreshing finish. Its lower strength and easy-going flavour make it a simple choice for highballs, shots and warm-weather pitchers.

Tasting Notes: Sweet pink lemonade, lemon zest and a clean finish.

Serve: On the rocks, or topped with club soda.

georgian-bay-smashed-tea-1.bodyHtml: Georgian Bay Tequila Smash Mixed 12 Cans is a refreshing Canadian ready-to-drink cocktail variety pack crafted by Georgian Bay Spirit Co. in Ontario. Made with authentic Blue Agave tequila and natural flavours, this assortment features four tropical and citrus-inspired expressions: Chili Mango, Grapefruit, Pineapple, and Prickly Pear. At 6.0% ABV, these crisp, flavourful cocktails are perfect for barbecues, summer gatherings, and entertaining.

alley-kat-scona-gold-kolsch-1.title: Alley Kat Scona Gold Kölsch Craft Beer 6 x 355ml Cans
alley-kat-scona-gold-kolsch-1.bodyHtml:
Alley Kat Scona Gold Kölsch is a refreshing, easy-drinking craft beer brewed in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Inspired by the traditional German Kölsch style, this golden ale offers a crisp, clean character with delicate malt sweetness, subtle fruity notes, and a gentle hop bitterness. Light-bodied and exceptionally smooth, Scona Gold delivers a balanced, refreshing drinking experience, making it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, barbecues, and everyday enjoyment. Available in a convenient pack of six 355ml cans.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled chicken, seafood, fish and chips, burgers, sausages, light salads, and mild cheeses. Its crisp, refreshing character also complements spicy dishes and classic pub favourites.

Tasting Notes: A light, refreshing golden ale featuring delicate malt sweetness, subtle fruity esters, mild floral hop notes, and a clean, balanced finish.

Nose: Gentle aromas of fresh bread, light cereal malt, subtle citrus, and delicate floral hops with a hint of fruity sweetness.

Palate: Light-bodied, crisp, and smooth with flavours of soft biscuit malt, fresh grain, mild citrus, and gentle hop bitterness. Balanced carbonation enhances its refreshing character.

Finish: Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering light malt sweetness and a subtle, pleasantly dry bitterness.

Serve: Best enjoyed chilled at 4–7°C in a Kölsch glass or traditional beer glass to appreciate its refreshing flavours and delicate aromas.

club-privado-reserva.title: Baron De Ley Club Privado Reserva
club-privado-reserva.bodyHtml: Barón de Ley Club Privado Reserva is an opulent and sophisticated expression of Rioja, crafted primarily from Tempranillo to showcase the depth of the region’s traditional aging process. This Reserva pours a deep ruby red and opens with an intense, expressive bouquet of ripe blackberries and forest fruits, seamlessly layered with savory notes of tobacco, peppery spice, and sweet vanilla. On the palate, it delivers a generous and plush mouthfeel characterized by supple tannins and a long, savory finish featuring hints of dark plum and black olive. Aged for a minimum of 18 to 20 months in oak barrels, it is a powerful yet balanced wine that pairs exceptionally well with roast lamb, grilled red meats, and aged cheeses.

alley-kat-dragon-double-ipa.title: Alley Kat Dragon Double IPA 4 Tall Cans
alley-kat-dragon-double-ipa.bodyHtml:
Alley Kat Dragon Double IPA is a bold and expressive craft beer from Edmonton, Alberta. Part of Alley Kat Brewing's rotating Dragon series, each release showcases a distinctive hop variety, delivering intense hop character, vibrant fruit aromas and satisfying bitterness. With a robust 7.5% ABV, this full-flavoured Double IPA offers an adventurous experience for craft beer enthusiasts in four convenient 473ml cans.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with spicy buffalo wings, barbecue ribs, grilled burgers, loaded nachos, pepperoni pizza, Thai curry, smoked brisket, sharp cheddar and spicy tacos.

Tasting Notes: A bold, hop-forward Double IPA featuring expressive citrus, tropical fruit and resinous hop characteristics, balanced by a supportive malt backbone and pronounced bitterness.

Nose: Inviting aromas of grapefruit zest, ripe tropical fruit, fresh pine and aromatic hops, with subtle floral or herbal nuances depending on the release.

Palate: Full-flavoured and assertively hoppy, revealing juicy citrus, tropical fruit, delicate malt sweetness and layered herbal or pine-like notes. A firm bitterness provides structure and balance.

Finish: Long, refreshing and pleasantly bitter, with lingering citrus peel, hop resin and gentle malt character.

black-fly-local-55-vodka-soda-lemon.title: Black Fly Vodka Cream Soda
black-fly-local-55-vodka-soda-lemon.bodyHtml: Black Fly Vodka Cream Soda Tall Can

peller-family-light-pinot-grigio.title: Peller Family Vineyards Light Pinot Grigio 750ml
peller-family-light-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Clear and bright with a straw yellow hue and notes of Bartlett pear, melon, red apple and pink grapefruit on the nose. This Pinot Grigio is light-bodied, off-dry, smooth yet refreshing with flavours of tropical fruit and melon on the palate, then notes of pink grapefruit and tangerine on the finish. Enjoy while young and fresh.

black-fly-lem-lime-vodka-soda-fizz-sleek.bodyHtml: Black Fly Vodka Cream Soda Tall Can

bask-sauvignon-blanc.title: Oyster Bay Sauvignon Blanc
bask-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Sauvignon Blanc is a benchmark, highly aromatic, and crisp white wine that captures the vibrant cool-climate essence of New Zealand. In the glass, it displays a pale straw color with green hues, opening with an intense and enticing bouquet of ripe passionfruit, bright citrus, and tropical fruits, underscored by signature notes of fresh lemongrass, green apple, and crushed herbs. On the palate, this wine is light-to-medium-bodied and wonderfully refreshing, bursting with lively flavors of zesty lime, grapefruit, and sweet white peach. Its crisp, mouth-watering acidity delivers a clean, focused palate and a long, zesty, and unmistakably refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: The vibrant acidity and intense tropical fruit profile of this Sauvignon Blanc make it a phenomenal match for fresh seafood and light, herb-driven dishes. It pairs beautifully with freshly shucked oysters, steamed green-lipped mussels, grilled prawns, and pan-seared sea bass. It is also an excellent complement to goat cheese crostini, fresh Greek salads, asparagus risotto, and light poultry dishes like lemon-herb grilled chicken.

syc-brewing-fjord-neipa.title: Syc Brewing Fjord Neipa 4 Tall Cans

ole-beautiful-okami-kasu-japanese-ale.title: Ol Beautiful Okami Kasu Japanese Ale 6 x 355ml Cans
ole-beautiful-okami-kasu-japanese-ale.bodyHtml: Taking inspiration from Japanese-style lagers, this ale includes a substantial portion of rice, which gives it a unique and silky mouthfeel, while still preserving its easy drinking and approachable qualities. Saké Kasu (rice leftover from saké production) is added to give the beer a subtle hint of boozy, creamy funk in the finish.

ol-beautiful-pegasus-pale-ale.title: Ol Beautiful Pegasus Pale Ale 6 Cans

ecd-saskatoon-honey-gin.title: Eau Claire Distillery Saskatoon Honey Gin
ecd-saskatoon-honey-gin.bodyHtml:
Eau Claire Distillery Saskatoon Honey Gin is an infused gin from Eau Claire Distillery in Alberta, created as a tribute to the Canadian prairies. The distillery modelled it on the British sloe gin style but reworked it with local ingredients: honey, Saskatoon berries, rose hips and Alberta malted barley join a base of classic gin botanicals. The result is a fruit-forward, gently sweet gin with a prairie character. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Over ice with tonic and a few berries, or in a gin sour or spritz.

township-24-stolen-canoe-pale-ale.title: Township 24 Sunset Cove Tropical Ipa 4 Tall Cans
township-24-stolen-canoe-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Township 24 Sunset Cove Tropical Ipa 4 Tall Cans

bent-stick-blood-orange-radler.title: Bent Stick Blood Orange Radler 4 Tall Cans
bent-stick-blood-orange-radler.bodyHtml: Bent Stick Blood Orange Radler 4 Tall Cans

moosehead-lager-5.title: Moosehead Canadian Lager 15 Cans
moosehead-lager-5.bodyHtml:
Moosehead Lager is Canada’s iconic, independent lager brewed by Canada's oldest independent brewery, Moosehead Breweries Limited in Saint John, New Brunswick. Brewed using a classic lager recipe with 100% Canadian 2-row malted barley, pure water, and a double-fermentation process, this pale lager delivers a finely balanced balance between sweet maltiness and mild hop bitterness. It is clean, crisp, and refreshing, making it an accessible and timeless Canadian classic.

Food Pairing: Grilled burgers, fish and chips, barbecue chicken, soft pretzels with mustard, and mild cheeses like young cheddar or Colby.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden straw yellow in color with a clear appearance and a light, crisp, and effervescent mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and clean with notes of sweet grain, light corn, subtle malted barley, and a faint touch of grassy floral hops.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with light malt sweetness, soft cereal grains, and a crisp, gentle hop bitterness that cleanses the palate.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing with a crisp, dry finish and slight lingering grain notes.

Serve : Serve well-chilled at 38–42°F (3–5°C) directly from the bottle or poured into a classic pilsner or pint glass.

moosehead-radler-variety-pack.title: Moosehead Radler Mixed Pack 12 Cans
moosehead-radler-variety-pack.bodyHtml:
Moosehead Radler Mixed Pack 12 Cans is a variety pack of fruit-infused radlers produced by Canada's oldest independent brewery, Moosehead Breweries. Blending Moosehead’s signature lager with natural fruit juices, this pack offers a diverse assortment of light, fruit-forward flavors including Grapefruit, Strawberry Lemonade, Peach Mango, and Raspberry.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken, fresh summer salads, fish tacos, spicy sausages, fruit tarts, or light appetizers.

Tasting Notes : Varies by flavor, presenting a colorful, lightly effervescent appearance with a light-bodied, crisp, and refreshing mouthfeel.

Nose : Vibrant aromas of fresh citrus, ripe berries, stone fruits, and sweet lemon zests layered over a light malt background.

Palate : Sweet and tangy fruit flavors—grapefruit citrus, sweet strawberry lemonade, stone fruit peach mango, and tart raspberry—balanced by a crisp lager base.

Finish : Clean, bright, and refreshing with lingering sweet fruit notes and a dry finish.

Serve : Serve well-chilled directly from the can or poured into a pint glass.

stanley-park-yuzu-sour.title: Stanley Park Yuzu Sour 4 Tall Cans

moutai-prince-chiew-gold.title: Moutai Prince Chiew Gold
moutai-prince-chiew-gold.bodyHtml: Moutai Prince Chiew - Gold is a luxury Chinese Baijiu (a type of distilled liquor) produced by the Moutai Distillery, which is located in the town of Maotai in Guizhou Province, China. It is considered one of the highest quality Baijiu products in the world and is often referred to as the "king of Baijiu".It is made using traditional fermentation and distillation methods, using only high-quality sorghum as the main ingredient. The production process is highly controlled and takes several years to complete, with the liquor being aged in ceramic jars and underground cellars. One of the distinguishing features of Moutai Prince Chiew - Gold is its smooth and complex flavor profile. It has a rich aroma with notes of fruit, grain, and flowers, followed by a velvety and full-bodied taste that is both sweet and slightly spicy. The finish is long and lingering, leaving a pleasant aftertaste.

stanley-park-fruit-stand-variety-pack.title: Stanley Park Fruit Stand Variety Pack 12 Cans
stanley-park-fruit-stand-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Stanley Park Fruit Stand Variety Pack 12 Cans

kavalan-solist-fino-sherry-57-80-abv.title: Kavalan Solist Fino Sherry Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-fino-sherry-57-80-abv.bodyHtml:
Fino, Spanish for 'Fine', is the driest and palest of all varieties of traditional sherry wine. Traditional Fino wine is usually dry and is best consumed shortly after the bottle is opened in order to avoid losing its flavor. Kavalan's Fino, matured in the finest Fino Sherry butts, however, provides mild sweetness that excites the palate.

Colour - Dark golden amber

Flavour - The rich aroma of sherry, with its creamy toffee and rich fudge qualities, and the slightest hint of chocolate blends with the fruity character of the spirit.The rich aroma of sherry, with its creamy toffee and rich fudge qualities and the slightest hint of chocolate, blends with the fruity character of the spirit. The fruitiness is a complex, multi-layered blend of mango and over-ripe citrus fruit flavours that ends with a touch of green apples.

Palate - Natural sweetness on the tongue is accentuated with a gentle fudge flavour. The complex fruity flavours are layered with dry smoked wood aromas. Solist Fino cask strength whisky has a long finish and natural sweetness giving way to a pleasant mouth-drying sensation that leaves the connoisseur ready for the next sip!

argiano-brunello-di-montalcino-riserva.title: Argiano Brunello di Montalcino 2021
argiano-brunello-di-montalcino-riserva.bodyHtml:
Argiano Brunello di Montalcino 2021 is a benchmark, certified organic Tuscan red crafted by the historic estate of Argiano, where winemaking traditions trace back to the late 16th century in the southwestern sector of Montalcino. In the glass, it presents an intense, radiant ruby hue with brilliant garnet reflections. The expressive and refined aromatic profile unfolds with scents of fresh red cherries, wild raspberries, and blood orange, interwoven with Mediterranean scrub, lavender, crushed gravel, dried pipe tobacco, and subtle cedarwood. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and taut, showcasing concentrated red berry fruit and dark cherry compote underpinned by energetic, mouthwatering acidity, fine-grained, sinewy tannins, and a persistent, savory, and mineral-laced finish.

Food Pairing: Bistecca alla Fiorentina, wild boar ragù with pappardelle, roasted rosemary rack of lamb, braised veal shank, and aged Pecorino Toscano.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This is dense and full of cherry, raspberry, earth, iron and tobacco flavors. A broad base of sinewy tannins lends support, while the lively acidity drives the long aftertaste of red fruit. All of the components are there; this just needs time. Best from 2029 through 2047. 10,830 cases made, 2,992 cases imported.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of cherries, orange blossom and white cedar with a hint of juniper follow through to a medium body, firm and silky tannins and a bright, polished finish. Linear and tight. Lovely length. Succulent and satisfying with a crisp finish. From organically grown grapes. Best after 2027.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

With more than 500 years of documented winemaking history (with a villa and cellars dating back to 1580), Argiano is one of the oldest and most important estates in Montalcino. The 2021 Brunello di Montalcino shows consistency and a velvety texture with blackberry and blackcurrant. There is good freshness here, and the wine is a rather lean in terms of mouthfeel.

trails-end-10-year-old-kentucky-bourbon.title: Trail's End 10 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
trails-end-10-year-old-kentucky-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Trail's End 10 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon is the older sibling in the Trail's End range from Hood River Distillers, Oregon's oldest distillery, made together with the team at its sister distillery Clear Creek. A select few barrels of 10-year-old Kentucky straight bourbon travel west to Hood River, where the whiskey is finished in toasted casks of native Oregon Garry oak to heighten its vanilla and spice, then brought to strength with glacier-fed spring water from Mt. Hood. Labelled Special Reserve, it is bottled non-chill filtered at 105 proof (52.5% ABV) in a 750ml bottle. Recent awards include gold at the 2022 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, gold with 95 points at the 2022 New York International Spirits Competition and platinum and double gold at Sip Magazine's Best of the Northwest competitions.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla, caramel and cherry framed by pine-like oak and earthy depth.

Nose: Vanilla, caramel and cherry, drifting into warm summer pine.

Palate: Caramel, vanilla, cherry and roasted corn over earthy notes of summer pine and high-desert moss, with bitter orange and a touch of lilac beneath the oak.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

banded-peak-storm-chaser.title: Banded Peak Storm Chaser 4 Tall Cans

banded-peak-rites-of-spring-barrel-aged.title: Banded Peak Rites Of Spring Barrel Aged 500ml
banded-peak-rites-of-spring-barrel-aged.bodyHtml: Banded Peak Rites Of Spring Barrel Aged 500ml

rombauer-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Rombauer Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 750ml
rombauer-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The nose is marked by interwoven, intense aromas of red currant, mint, and warm pie crust. These continue to the palate where they support concentrated flavors of blackberry and cassis. A densely structured mid palate is framed by balanced acidity and ends with exceptional length.

Pair this wine with braised short ribs, lasagna Bolognese, and pan roasted rack of lamb.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Almost entirely estate grown, Rombauer's 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon does include a bit of purchased fruit from Blair (Calistoga) and Renteria 360 (Oakville). Marked by scents of cherries, cedar and dusty earth, this wine is full-bodied, supple and silky, with softly dusty tannins on the finish.

rombauer-sauvignon-blanc.title: Rombauer Sauvignon Blanc 2023 750ml
rombauer-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Lifted aromas of Key lime, honeydew melon, and passion fruit all jump out of the glass, supported by hints of freshly cut grass in the background. Those fresh lime and honeydew flavors continue to the palate, joined by kiwi and subtle herbaceous notes, all mingling together in a lively way. The wine is linear and focused, ending with enticing, mouthwatering acidity that will leave you wanting more.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A refreshing, generous mix of apricot, grilled peach and mango flavors are accented with fresh, juicy pops of tangerine, lemon and yuzu, backed by a hint of wildflower honey.

club.title: Havana Club Añejo 7 Años Rum
club.bodyHtml: Havana Club Añejo 7 Años is a legendary Cuban dark rum, widely considered the gold standard for sipping rums and the quintessential expression of the Havana Club range. Created by the late Maestro Ronero Don José Navarro, this rum is crafted through a continuous aging process where a portion of every final blend is returned to the barrel to nurture future generations. It is composed of rums aged for a minimum of seven years in white oak casks, resulting in a rich, mahogany-hued spirit with a complex and silky texture. On the nose, it reveals an intense bouquet of roasted pecans, tobacco, honey, and tropical fruits, while the palate delivers deep notes of cocoa, vanilla, and warm cedar spice. This world-class rum is best enjoyed neat, over ice, or as a sophisticated base for a classic Cuba Libre or an authentic El Presidente.

budweiser-9.title: Budweiser 36 Cans
budweiser-9.bodyHtml: Budweiser is a medium-bodied, flavourful, and crisp American-style lager. Known as the "King of Beers," it is brewed using a blend of premium hop varieties, barley malt, rice, and water. A signature part of its production is the beechwood aging process, which results in a naturally carbonated beer with a smooth, clean finish. The 15-pack of 341ml glass bottles offers a subtle honey aroma and a trace of citrus, punctuated by notes of malt and noble hops.

kokanee-9.title: Kokanee 24 Cans
kokanee-9.bodyHtml: Kokanee Glacier Lager is a quintessential Western Canadian pale lager, celebrated for its exceptionally crisp and "crystalline" profile that mirrors its mountain heritage. Brewed with a blend of three different varieties of Pacific Northwest hops and mountain-pure water, it offers a light-bodied texture with a clean, refreshing taste and a subtle, grainy sweetness. The 18-can pack is a popular mid-sized format that balances portability with value, making it a reliable choice for camping, fishing, or backyard social gatherings. Each pour delivers a smooth, thirst-quenching experience with a dry finish that has established it as one of the most iconic beers in British Columbia and Alberta.

kokanee-10.title: Kokanee 740ml
kokanee-10.bodyHtml: Kokanee is a British Columbia-born "Glacier Fresh" lager, known for its crisp, clean, and highly refreshing profile. It is brewed using a blend of Western Canadian malts and a unique mix of three Pacific Northwest hops, then aged at cooler temperatures to ensure a smooth, easy-drinking finish. The 740ml single can is a large-format option that showcases the beer's light body, subtle grain sweetness, and minimal hop bitterness, making it a staple of the Western Canadian mountain lifestyle.

budweiser-11.title: Budweiser 36 Cans
budweiser-11.bodyHtml: Budweiser is a medium-bodied, flavourful, and crisp American-style lager. Known as the "King of Beers," it is brewed using a blend of premium hop varieties, barley malt, rice, and water. A signature part of its production is the beechwood aging process, which results in a naturally carbonated beer with a smooth, clean finish. The 15-pack of 341ml glass bottles offers a subtle honey aroma and a trace of citrus, punctuated by notes of malt and noble hops.

bud-light-11.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-11.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

lucky-lager-9.title: Lucky Lager 8 Cans
lucky-lager-9.bodyHtml: Lucky Lager is a classic Canadian lager that has been quality-brewed since 1934. Known for its clean, crisp, and refreshing taste, this easy-drinking beer is a lighter-tasting lager with a light body and balanced malt and hop flavors. It's a straightforward, no-fuss beer perfect for casual enjoyment.

kokanee-14.bodyHtml: Kokanee Glacier Lager is a quintessential Western Canadian pale lager, celebrated for its exceptionally crisp and "crystalline" profile that mirrors its mountain heritage.
