The 18-can pack is a popular mid-sized format that balances portability with value, making it a reliable choice for camping, fishing, or backyard social gatherings. Each pour delivers a smooth, thirst-quenching experience with a dry finish that has established it as one of the most iconic beers in British Columbia and Alberta.

club-1.title: Canadian Club 1858 Original Canadian Whisky 1.14L
club-1.bodyHtml:
Canadian Club Whisky is a historic and universally recognized blended Canadian whisky, renowned for its smooth and highly approachable character. Produced at the legendary Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, this flagship expression (often known as 1858) has been a staple in homes and bars since the mid-19th century. Crafted from a careful selection of corn, rye, rye malt, and barley malt, it undergoes aging in white-oak American bourbon barrels, resulting in a crisp, slightly dry, and versatile profile that helped define the Canadian whisky category.

Food Pairing: The peppery rye notes make this a great match for smoked salmon or grilled steak. It also pairs beautifully with maple-glazed pork chops, aged cheddar cheese, or a dessert featuring dark chocolate.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, golden amber spirit that is exceptionally smooth, light, and approachable, offering a balanced interplay between sweet grain and gentle rye spice.

NOSE - Fresh and soft, opening with a mild almond nuttiness and sweet vanilla, followed by an inviting hint of zesty and peppery rye spice.

Palate - Zesty and slightly spicy on the entry with a clear rye character. The mid-palate softens into sweet vanilla, rich oak, caramel, and a pleasant, subtle creaminess.

FINISH - Clean, dry, and relatively short, leaving behind a lingering, gentle warmth with subtle oak tannins and a faint touch of vanilla.

SERVE - Excellent as a versatile mixer. It is perfect for a classic Highball with ginger ale or club soda, a Whisky Sour, a simple Old Fashioned, or simply poured over ice.

bud-light-13.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-13.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

house-of-smith-substance-chardonnay.title: Substance 'Ch' Chardonnay 2020
house-of-smith-substance-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Substance 'Ch' Chardonnay 2020 is an incredibly refined, artisanal-style white wine crafted to bring authentic Burgundian-inspired restraint to Washington State. Barrel-fermented with 100% native yeasts and aged on its lees for ten months in French oak, it yields an inviting and complex bouquet of Fuji apples, glazed lemons, orange blossoms, and candied ginger, supported subtly by hints of brioche, toasted vanilla, and wet limestone. The palate is beautifully balanced and medium-to-full-bodied, delivering an oily yet crisp texture with layers of lemon meringue and fresh pear that glide effortlessly into a clean, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing:

This textured and vibrant Chardonnay pairs wonderfully with pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken with tarragon cream sauce, grilled halibut, or creamy pasta dishes.

93 Points by James Suckling
Aromas of candied ginger, baked pear and fresh herbs. Full-bodied with a lovely, oily texture. Layered flavors of chamomile and lavender at the beginning, but turns toward fresh cream and then the note of candied ginger on the nose returns. Linear and balanced.

paradiso-brunello-di-montalcino-moz-art.title: Il Paradiso di Manfredi Brunello Di Montalcino 2018
paradiso-brunello-di-montalcino-moz-art.bodyHtml:
This sophisticated, ethereal Italian red wine from the 2018 vintage stands as an iconic masterclass in traditional, low-intervention Sangiovese. It showcases wild strawberries, leather, and balsamic herbs over a chiseled, vibrant, and deeply savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, slow-simmered wild boar ragù, roasted duck breast, or matured artisanal Pecorino cheeses.

 

 

97 Points -  Wine Enthusiast

Carob, mature black-skinned berry, new leather and tobacco aromas follow over to the smooth, savoury palate along with ripe Marasca cherry and black olive. Liquorice and dried mint sensations linger on the close while velvety tannins provide the framework. It's well balanced, with fresh acidity. It's full of personality and already tempting but will develop even more complexity over the next few decades. Drink 2023–2043.

chateau-duhart-milon-2016.title: Chateau Duhart Milon 2022
chateau-duhart-milon-2016.bodyHtml:
Chateau Duhart-Milon is a Fourth Growth Pauillac from an estate vineyard planted predominantly to Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Gravel soils support a structured, refined expression with dark fruit, freshness and firm tannins. The wine combines classic Left Bank character with depth, balance and notable ageing potential.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roasted lamb shoulder, grilled ribeye, braised beef short ribs, or aged Comte.

 

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2022 Chateau Duhart-Milon shows finesse and elegance, with cassis, black raspberry, spring flowers, spicy wood and graphite. The medium- to full-bodied palate is pure, layered and seamless, displaying impressive class and long-term ageing potential.

96 Points - James Suckling

Chalky tannins provide tension alongside tobacco, herbs, cedar and cigar-box character, with currants and blue fruit. The medium-bodied palate combines attractive fruit with light citrus bitterness, finishing firm, intense and persistent.

94 Points - Decanter

Ripe cherries, blackcurrants and plums introduce a fresh, inviting palate. Chalky, fleshy tannins provide substantial texture, while saline spice, blueberry, mint and bright acidity bring freshness and definition to the powerful structure.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Mulberries, blackcurrants, pencil shavings and rose petal lead to a medium- to full-bodied, velvety and layered palate. A generous core of fruit is supported by powdery tannins and lively acidity, creating an integrated and harmonious expression.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A structured wine with ripe tannins and powerful dark chocolate flavors. Licorice aromas accompany layers of black plum and succulent acidity, giving the wine a firm yet balanced profile with the structure for further development.

jaboulet-hermitage-la-chapelle-2018.title: Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aine Hermitage La Chapelle Rouge 2020
jaboulet-hermitage-la-chapelle-2018.bodyHtml:
Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aîné La Chapelle Hermitage Rouge 2020 is a legendary, profoundly structured Northern Rhône red wine crafted from 100% Syrah sourced from ancient vines on the iconic, granite slopes of Hermitage Hill. Cultivated using strict biodynamic methods, this vintage showcases exceptional precision, aromatic purity, and structural definition. In the glass, it reveals an opaque, glass-staining purple-ruby hue. The deeply complex bouquet displays striking aromas of crushed blackberries, crème de cassis, violet pastille, and black olives, masterfully layered with notes of smoked bacon, licorice, espresso, and an intense graphite minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and muscular yet remarkable for its weightless elegance. A dense, tightly wound core of dark fruit and savory spice is beautifully supported by chiseled, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant, life-giving natural acidity that stretches into a spectacularly long, saline-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic roasted rack of lamb, thick-cut grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised venison stew, roasted duck breast, and wild mushroom risotto.

97 Points - James Suckling

At first this feels like you're standing in front of a set of locked gates. Huge power and structure without that much weight, thanks to the wonderful freshness that's intertwined with the tarry depths of this Hermitage masterpiece. As it aerates smoked bacon, menthol and licorice notes develop, but I'd need much more space to give you all the aromas! The huge tannins at the finish are finely chiseled, suggesting this has decades of life ahead of it. From 40 to 100-year-old syrah vines. From biodynamically grown grapes.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

While still a terrific wine that has come in at the upper end of my barrel-sample rating, I must confess to a modest level of disappointment in the 2020 Hermitage La Chapelle. On the nose, it's gently cedary, with crushed stone and pencil shavings accenting dark, plummy fruit, plus mocha, earth and black olives. It's full-bodied but not that rich or concentrated, with an open-knit feel and a shortage of energy and drive on the finish. Collectors may want to enjoy this over the (relatively) near term while waiting for their more-promising 2019s to mature.

croftengea-2007-51-30-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Croftengea 2007 12 Year Old 51.3% ABV
croftengea-2007-51-30-twa.bodyHtml:
The Whisky Agency Croftengea 2007 12 Year Old is an independently bottled Highland single malt from the Loch Lomond distillery, made in its Croftengea style. Loch Lomond is unusual among Scottish distilleries in producing several different spirit styles under one roof, and Croftengea is one of its named single malt styles. Distilled in 2007 and matured for 12 years in a hogshead, it was bottled by the independent bottler The Whisky Agency at 51.3% ABV in a 700ml bottle. A small-run bottling for those exploring the less familiar side of Loch Lomond.

Serve: Neat, adding a few drops of water to taste.

chateau-palmer-2015.title: Chateau Palmer 2014
chateau-palmer-2015.bodyHtml:
One of Margaux's most iconic estates, Château Palmer is celebrated for its extraordinary elegance and depth. It reveals captivating aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, violet, cedar, graphite, truffle, and exotic spice. Silky yet immensely powerful, it offers remarkable precision, velvety tannins, exceptional freshness, and an enduring finish built for decades of aging.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, truffle potatoes, wild mushrooms, aged Comté, or braised short ribs.

 

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

It's easy to call this a beautiful wine—it's dense and lush, with great layers of black fruit and acidity. The first fully biodynamic vintage from this estate has certainly yielded impressive ripe fruit, with structured tannins and dark berry flavors that linger long. It has enormous potential, certainly not be ready to drink before 2027.
95 Points - Decanter
Robust fruit from low yields but no less elegant. Wonderful richness, texture and structure, this will become a superbly balanced wine of great beauty.
95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The 2014 Palmer is up with the crème de la crème of the vintage and should merit an even higher score in 5-7 years. A blend of 49% Cabernet Sauvignon, 45% Merlot and the rest Petit Verdot brought up in 65% new French oak, its deep ruby/purple-tinged color is followed by a rich, opulent bouquet of blackcurrants, black cherries, chocolate, and tobacco, with hints of graphite and background oak. With more texture and mid-palate depth than most in the vintage, this terrific 2014 is medium to full-bodied, beautifully concentrated, layered and as hedonistic and sexy as it gets in the vintage. Give bottle 4-5 years and it should drink nicely for two decades.
95 Points - James Suckling

This really develops wonderfully in the glass starting out earthy with mushrooms and spices and then turns to dark fruit such as blackberries and blackcurrants. Full-bodied, very intense and minerally. Firm and silky tannins and a long, long finish. From biodynamically grown grapes.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2014 Palmer builds on the promise that it showed in barrel. It is clearly a more understated and nuanced Palmer from winemaker Thomas Duroux this year, but a Margaux with exquisite delineation and precision, hints of blackberry, boysenberry and a touch of pencil box. The palate is medium-bodied with very fine tannin. It feels supple and lithe in the mouth. It will not have the depth and power of the subsequent 2015 Palmer, yet the "flow" is very sensual and the Merlot (45% of the blend) just lends it roundness and a caressing texture. What a beautiful Margaux and I bet it will be deceptively long-lived.
94 Points - Wine Spectator
This has a fresh, energetic feel, with lots of bramble-edged grip pushing the core of raspberry, plum and cherry coulis flavors. The finish is very pure, punctuated by lively floral and iron notes. Flaunts minerality in the end. Best from 2020 through 2035.

b-l-e-s-s-hard-seltzer-mango.title: Drrip Hard Seltzer Mango
b-l-e-s-s-hard-seltzer-mango.bodyHtml:
Drrip Hard Seltzer Mango is a mango-flavoured hard seltzer from British Columbia, produced by Coupe Beverages, a Vancouver-based beverage company. It comes as a single 355ml serve at 5% ABV, a sparkling, easy-going option for patios, parties and casual get-togethers.

Serve: Serve well chilled, straight from the fridge or poured over ice.

b-l-e-s-s-hard-seltzer-black-cherry.title: Drrip Hard Seltzer Dark Cherry
b-l-e-s-s-hard-seltzer-black-cherry.bodyHtml:
Drrip Hard Seltzer Dark Cherry is a dark cherry-flavoured hard seltzer from British Columbia, produced by Coupe Beverages, a Vancouver-based beverage company. It comes as a single 355ml serve at 5% ABV, a sparkling, easy-going option for patios, parties and casual get-togethers.

Serve: Serve well chilled, straight from the fridge or poured over ice.

paul-hobbs-russian-river-chardonnay.title: Paul Hobbs Russian River Chardonnay 2021/2022 750ml
paul-hobbs-russian-river-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Crafted with precision from six pedigreed sites, our newest vintage shines with an opalescent, pale straw hue. Aromas of red apple skin, Asian pear, and Meyer lemon zest entices the nose, followed by delicate notes of gardenia. Lively flavors of apricot and nectarine emerge on the palate, giving way to lemon meringue and baking spice. Bright and energetic with a vibrant acidity, this graceful wine ends with a long, seamless finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

The fruit in this is very beautiful, with sliced apples, cream and hints of stone. Full-bodied with plenty of fruit and a creamy texture that shows tension and intensity. Just the right amount of oak to highlight this. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Vinous

The 2022 Chardonnay (Russian River Valley) is a delight. Tangerine peel, butter, ripe pear, apricot and white flowers open effortlessly. Medium in body and vibrant with terrific depth, the Russian River Chardonnay is a beautiful introduction to the range.

93 Points -Jeb Dunnuck
Bright yellow with a green tinge, the 2022 Chardonnay Russian River Valley was raised with 30% new French oak, as were the majority of these wines from Hobbs. In the glass it opens to elegant and ripe aromas of fresh salted pineapple, honeyed citrus, and fresh flowers. Medium to full-bodied, it’s elegant and long on the palate, with a wide window for enjoyment over the next 7-8 years.

berrys-sherry-cask-blended-malt.title: The Dalmore King Alexander III
berrys-sherry-cask-blended-malt.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore King Alexander III is a masterful and wildly complex Highland single malt crafted by legendary Master Distiller Richard Paterson to honor the heroic act of Colin of Kintail, Chief of the Clan Mackenzie, who saved King Alexander III of Scotland from a charging stag in 1263. To achieve its unparalleled depth, this whisky undergoes an incredibly ambitious six-cask maturation process. It is carefully aged in a bespoke combination of ex-bourbon casks, Matusalem Oloroso sherry wood, Madeira barrels, Marsala casks, Port pipes, and Cabernet Sauvignon wine barriques. This intricate vatting results in a luxurious, multi-layered whisky brimming with rich red berry fruits, sweet vanilla, and warm baking spices, showcasing the absolute pinnacle of The Dalmore's cask curation expertise.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate, roasted venison, duck breast with a cherry reduction, sticky toffee pudding, or a premium medium-bodied cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep polished mahogany in appearance with a remarkably smooth, velvety, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Exceedingly complex and aromatic, offering a rich bouquet of red berry fruits, passion fruit, warm vanilla pods, crème caramel, and crushed almonds.

Palate : Rich, sweet, and multi-layered, delivering bright notes of citrus zest, sweet vanilla, and crème caramel that seamlessly evolve into deeper flavors of red berries, fleshy plums, and roasted walnuts.

Finish : Long, warming, and elegant, leaving lingering impressions of sweet cinnamon, nutmeg, fresh ginger, and soft oak wood spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter. Allow it to rest in the glass for several minutes to let the intricate six-cask maturation fully express its complex aromatics.

granja-remelluri-gran-reserva.title: Remelluri Rioja Reserva 2017
granja-remelluri-gran-reserva.bodyHtml: Remelluri Rioja Reserva 2017 is a landmark organic wine that represents the historic recovery of the traditional "Rioja Alavesa" estate style. Under the guidance of Telmo Rodríguez, this vintage was crafted from estate-grown grapes harvested from high-altitude terraces nestled against the Sierra de Cantabria mountains. The 2017 season was marked by a severe spring frost followed by a hot summer, resulting in a low-yielding crop with exceptional concentration and a powerful structural backbone. On the nose, it offers a sophisticated bouquet of black cherries and wild herbs, underpinned by deep mineral notes of damp earth and incense. The palate is medium-to-full bodied and remarkably fresh, showcasing vibrant dark fruit, firm tannins, and a savory complexity that leads to a long, elegant finish.

nutrl-czr.title: Nutrl Cranberry 6 Cans
nutrl-czr.bodyHtml: A light and refreshing vodka soda. Made with real vodka, seltzer, and real juice for a clean, crisp taste with the fresh flavours of cranberry. No carbs, no sugar, no sweeteners.

santa-julia-cabernet-sauvignon-reserva.title: Santa Julia Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 750ml
santa-julia-cabernet-sauvignon-reserva.bodyHtml:
Santa Julia Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptional Argentine red wine crafted by Bodega Santa Julia, a winery known for its dedication to sustainable and organic winemaking practices. The Reserva designation signifies a wine of higher quality and careful aging, offering a more refined and complex expression of the Cabernet Sauvignon grape.

Tasting Notes

COLOR:
Santa Julia Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep and intense ruby-red color, showcasing its depth and richness.

NOSE:
The nose is filled with captivating aromas of blackberries, cassis, and dark cherries, intertwined with hints of cedar, tobacco, and subtle vanilla. It exudes a complex and enticing bouquet with both fruit and spice elements.

TASTE:
On the palate, this Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon offers a full-bodied and structured experience. It showcases the bold flavors of black fruits, particularly cassis and blackberry, complemented by nuanced tobacco, cedar, and oak notes.

FINISH:
The wine's firm tannins and balanced acidity lead to a satisfying and lingering finish, making it a wine of elegance and depth.

Food Pairing

Santa Julia Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon's complexity and refinement make it an excellent choice to pair with a variety of dishes. Here are some recommended food pairings to enhance your dining experience:

Grilled Steak:
Enjoy it with a perfectly grilled ribeye or New York strip steak, seasoned with herbs and served with a rich red wine reduction sauce.

Beef Bourguignon:
It complements classic French dishes like Beef Bourguignon, where the wine's structure enhances the flavors of slow-cooked beef and savory herbs.

Aged Cheeses:
Pair it with aged cheeses such as Parmigiano-Reggiano or Pecorino Romano for a delightful contrast of flavors.

Lamb Rack:
Savor it with a succulent rack of lamb, seasoned with rosemary and served with a mint sauce for a harmonious pairing.

grey-goose-vodka-7.title: Grey Goose Vodka 1.75L
grey-goose-vodka-7.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Vodka is an ultra-premium, world-renowned spirit crafted in the celebrated Cognac region of France. Created by Maître de Chais (Cellar Master) François Thibault, this expression is distilled using only two high-quality ingredients: single-origin soft winter wheat from the fertile Picardy region and pure spring water naturally filtered through limestone from a dedicated well in Gensac-la-Pallue. Distilled a single time using a continuous column still process to preserve the character of the grain, this vodka bypasses extensive filtration to ensure a naturally rich, soft, and round texture, setting a global standard for high-end luxury vodka.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with fresh oysters on the half shell, caviar with blinis, smoked salmon canapés, creamy goat cheese, or light lemon-herb grilled chicken skewers.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear with brilliant clarity, featuring a plush, smooth, and rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Delicate and floral with subtle notes of sweet winter wheat, citrus zest, and light almond.

Palate : Smooth, soft, and slightly sweet with notes of cracked grain, subtle almond, light cream, and fresh citrus.

Finish : Warm, ultra-clean, and satisfying with a lingering, gentle peppery warmth and soft grain sweetness.

Serve : Serve ice-cold neat from the freezer, on the rocks, or as the refined base in a classic Vodka Martini or Espresso Martini.

absolut-raspberri-vodka.title: Absolut Raspberri Vodka
absolut-raspberri-vodka.bodyHtml:
Absolut Raspberri is a premium flavoured vodka produced in Åhus, Sweden, by The Absolut Company (Pernod Ricard). Introduced in 2004, it pays homage to the wild raspberries (hallon) that grow abundantly across the Swedish hillsides. Like original Absolut Vodka, it is crafted using locally grown winter wheat from Southern Sweden and pristine deep-well water, distilled continuously hundreds of times via rectification. It is infused exclusively with natural raspberry flavouring, containing no added sugar. Bottled at 38.0%–40.0% ABV (market-dependent, standardly 40.0% ABV in North America), it offers an intensely aromatic, authentic red-berry profile with a clean, dry, and balanced palate.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with berry tarts, lemon cheesecake, dark chocolate mousse, fresh summer salads with goat cheese and berries, or grilled duck breast with raspberry reduction.

Tasting Notes: An authentic, fruit-forward flavoured vodka capturing the vibrant aroma and natural sweetness of sun-ripened wild raspberries without synthetic cloying sweetness.

Nose: Bursting with intense, natural aromas of ripe wild raspberries, red currants, and subtle jammy berry undertones.

Palate: Smooth, clean, and surprisingly dry on the palate, delivering vibrant flavours of fresh crushed red berries, raspberry compote, and a faint hint of citrus peel over a smooth wheat-spirit foundation.

Finish: Crisp, clean, and medium-long, lingering with the authentic essence of freshly picked raspberries and gentle grain warmth.

Serve: Superb served chilled over ice with tonic or soda water and a fresh raspberry or lime wedge; also an essential base for modern cocktails such as the Raspberry Collins, Cosmopolitan variations, or mixed simply with cranberry juice or lemonade.

laphroaig-25-year-old-2021-51-90.title: Laphroaig Càirdeas 2024 Cask Favourites 10 Year Old
laphroaig-25-year-old-2021-51-90.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Càirdeas 2024 Cask Favourites 10 Year Old is a limited-edition single malt Scotch whisky released exclusively for the Friends of Laphroaig. Crafted to celebrate the distillery’s most beloved cask types, this 10-year-old expression combines spirit aged in first-fill ex-bourbon barrels with spirit finished in Pedro Ximénez sherry casks. Bottled at cask strength, non-chill filtered, and naturally colored, it seamlessly pairs Laphroaig's signature medicinal peat smoke and ocean brine with rich dried fruit, dark chocolate, and sweet oak warmth.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, oysters on the half shell, dark chocolate tarts, stilton or blue cheese, and venison stew.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper amber in appearance with a full-bodied, rich, and oily mouthfeel that delivers intense warmth and complex peat depth.

Nose : Smoldering peat smoke, medicinal iodine, damp seaweed, dark raisins, dried figs, sweet vanilla, and toasted oak.

Palate : Rich peat, sea salt, dark chocolate, caramelized brown sugar, sticky dates, black pepper spice, and subtle espresso.

Finish : Long, warming, and complex with lingering coastal smoke, dried fruit sweetness, and peppered oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

blindman-passionfruit-strawberry-sour.title: Sour Puss Golden Passionfruit Mango
blindman-passionfruit-strawberry-sour.bodyHtml:
Sour Puss Golden Passionfruit Mango is a sweet-and-sour fruit liqueur from the Sour Puss range made by Phillips Distilling in Minnesota, USA. The bottle's label carries the "Golden" name and the flavour pairing of tart passionfruit with ripe, sweet mango, giving a bright tropical character with the brand's signature sour edge. It is bottled at 15% alcohol by volume in a 750ml bottle. Sour Puss is one of Canada's best-known liqueur brands and is built for easy, fun drinks rather than slow sipping: it works as a chilled shooter, topped up with a clear soda, or as a tropical sweet-sour accent in punches and sangria.

Tasting Notes: Tangy passionfruit and sweet mango in a sweet-and-sour style.

Serve: Well chilled as a shooter, with lemon-lime soda over ice, or in sangria and party punches.

peroni-nastro-azurro.title: Peroni Nastro Azurro 12 Cans
peroni-nastro-azurro.bodyHtml: Peroni Nastro Azzurro from Italy uses only the finest ingredients. This delivers a crisp and refreshing beer with a delicate balance of bitterness, citrus and spicy aromatic notes, combined with a fast and clean finish. 24 IBU's.

mi-terruno-limited-reserve-malbec-cabern.title: Mi Terruno Reserva Malbec 2020
mi-terruno-limited-reserve-malbec-cabern.bodyHtml:
This creamy and layered red has aromas and flavors of black plums, blackberries, chocolate and sweet tobacco. It’s full-bodied but fresh and balanced with lightly grainy, toasty tannins.
91 Points - James Suckling
This has aromas of raspberries, fresh plums, rosemary and clay on the nose, with hints of balsamic. Medium-bodied, juicy and supple, with fine tannins and a bright, fruity finish. Drink or hold.

toro-albala-don-px-convento-seleccion.title: Toro Albala Don PX Convento Seleccion 1929 750ml

gerard-bertrand-sauvageonne-la-villa-ros.title: Gerard Bertrand Chateau La Sauvageonne La Villa Rose 2021
gerard-bertrand-sauvageonne-la-villa-ros.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Château La Sauvageonne La Villa Rosé 2021 is an exceptional, biodynamic luxury rosé from the Languedoc region of France. Strikingly complex and gastronomy-focused, this wine often exhibits the power and structure more reminiscent of a fine white wine than a typical rosé. It delivers a rich bouquet of crushed strawberries, sweet baking spices, violets, and hawthorn. On the palate, it is full-bodied, generous, and velvety, perfectly balanced by a revitalizing acidity, mineral tension, and a distinctly saline finish derived from its unique volcanic schists and ruffes soils.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted poultry, grilled sea bass, savory warm appetizers, seared scallops, or fresh goat cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

A very pale rose that might have lost some pigments, but that doesn’t affect the quality. Vanilla, white nectarines, citrus, flowers and spices on the nose. Pretty full-bodied and fruity, with a creamy mid-palate followed by a mineral edge to the long, creamy finish. Dense and lightly structured. From organically and biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

An ultra-pale, concentrated rosé, with a crystal-clear beam of fruit -- juicy white peach and delicate apple -- driven by racy acidity. Offers mineral, floral notes and dried green herbs that line the palate, with the subtlest briny edge. A well-built, vibrant wine. Grenache, Mourvèdre, Vermentino and Viognier. Drink now through 2025.

campagnola-podere-frontino-riserva-monte.title: Podere Frontino Montepulciano d’Abruzzo Riserva 2018 / 2019
campagnola-podere-frontino-riserva-monte.bodyHtml:
Intense ruby red color with violet hues. Vinous bouquet accompanied by a balance of fruity and spicy notes with hints of maraschino cherry and ripe plum. Dry and slightly tannic taste.

Perfect with meat, game and mature cheeses. Wine of great longevity and structure. Recommended drinking temperature 18°C.

 

2018 Vintage Ratings

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of ripe black fruit, together with a good dose of pressed flowers and lightly peppery spice. Full-bodied with a good bead of fruit and lightly firm tannins that are sinking into the wine and will continue to do so. Drinkable now, but best from 2025.

2019 Vintage Ratings

92 Points - James Suckling

Black fruit, cloves, vanilla and black tea on the nose of this firm red. It’s full-bodied with sturdy tannins that are starting to integrate. Structured and focused. Drink from 2026.

cava-de-oro-black-extra-aged-anejo.title: Cava de Oro Extra Aged Añejo Black Tequila
cava-de-oro-black-extra-aged-anejo.bodyHtml:
Cava de Oro Extra Añejo Black is an ultra-aged tequila crafted in El Arenal, Jalisco by Tequilera Puerta de Hierro (NOM 1477) using 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agave. Aged for five years in deeply charred French oak barrels—giving the expression its signature dark "Black" profile—it yields an exceptionally rich, dessert-like tequila defined by intense sweetness, deep wood influence, and soft agave presence.

Food Pairing: Rich chocolate tortes, caramel flan, grilled steaks with demi-glace, aged gouda, or enjoyed as an after-dinner digestif alongside a fine cigar.

Tasting Notes : Dark mahogany with reddish-amber highlights. Extremely rich, velvety, and mouth-coating with a dense, viscous texture.

Nose : Dominant notes of dark chocolate, heavy caramel, toasted oak, and vanilla, accompanied by dried plums, roasted nuts, and a subtle background of cooked agave.

Palate : Very sweet and full-bodied, featuring prominent flavors of maple syrup, butterscotch, dark cocoa, cinnamon, roasted coffee, and charred oak.

Finish : Exceptionally long, smooth, and warming, with persistent sweetness, lingering vanilla, and subtle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a snifter or Riedel tequila glass.

wild-rose-treeline-tango-tangerine-pale.title: Wild Rose Treeline Tango Tangerine Pale 4 Tall Cans
wild-rose-treeline-tango-tangerine-pale.bodyHtml: Wild Rose Treeline Tango Tangerine Pale 4 Tall Cans

jack-daniels-old-no-7-whiskey-1.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey 3L
jack-daniels-old-no-7-whiskey-1.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey is an iconic, smooth American whiskey crafted in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Charcoal mellowed drop-by-drop through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before aging in handcrafted white oak barrels, it offers a distinct balance of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, and smooth caramel character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, pulled pork sandwiches, grilled burgers, smoked brisket, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold in appearance with a light-to-medium-bodied, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, banana, and subtle brown sugar.

Palate : Balanced mix of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, light spice, and rich caramel.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and medium-length with lingering toasted oak, charcoal, and sweet spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed with cola in a highball glass.

twisted-tea-half-half-hard-iced-tea-3.title: Twisted Tea Half & Half Hard Iced Tea 6 x 355ml Cans
twisted-tea-half-half-hard-iced-tea-3.bodyHtml: Half iced tea, half lemonade. Combines both classic flavors for those who need a little something extra. A refreshing hard iced tea with a kick.

coke-7.title: Tenuta di Valgiano Palistorti Colline Lucchesi Bianco 2016 750ml
coke-7.bodyHtml:
The 2016 Tenuta Di Valgiano Palistorti Bianco is a white wine blend from Tuscany, Italy. It is known for its rich, full-bodied palate with intense fruity aromas, offering a distinctive and enduring character. The wine is made from Vermentino, Malvasia, Grechetto, and Trebbiano grapes. 

Key Features:
Region: Colline Lucchesi, Tuscany, Italy.
Grape Varieties: Vermentino, Malvasia, Grechetto, and Trebbiano.
Style: White wine blend.
Description: Rich and full-bodied with intense fruity aromas.
Additional notes: Some mentions of earthy notes.

silk-tassel-3.title: Silk Tassel 1.75L
silk-tassel-3.bodyHtml:
Silk Tassel Canadian Whisky is a long-established Canadian blend from Quebec, aged in oak and blended from hand-selected barrels, offered here in a large 1.75L bottle. Sold for decades as McGuinness Silk Tassel, the brand later dropped the McGuinness name from its label. It shows a rye-and-spice character with butterscotch, vanilla and orange peel, and is at its best as a mixer. Bottled at 40% ABV.

Tasting Notes: Rye spice, butterscotch, vanilla and orange peel.

Nose: Rye and wood spice with butterscotch, vanilla and orange zest, opening to dusty grain and dry hay.

Palate: Dry rye grain, light butterscotch and vanilla, warm wood spice and orange peel.

Finish: Short, with rye spice and orange peel.

Serve: In a highball with ginger ale or cola.

appleton-12-year-rare-casks.title: Appleton Estate 12 Year Old Rare Casks Rum
appleton-12-year-rare-casks.bodyHtml:
Appleton Estate 12 Year Old Rare Casks Rum is a true expression of Jamaican rum craftsmanship, expertly blended by Master Blender Joy Spence. Crafted using limestone-filtered water, this exceptional spirit is a blend of hand-selected pot and column still rums that have been aged for a minimum of twelve years in Jamaica's tropical climate. Pouring a deep bronze with mahogany reflections, it offers an inviting nose of toasted oak, dried fruit, and toasted hazelnut. The palate is rich, luscious, and velvety, unraveling complex notes of dark cocoa, delicate molasses, vibrant orange peel, sweet vanilla, and subtle hints of freshly roasted coffee. The finish is exceptionally long, balancing a pleasant bittersweet oakiness with lingering warmth.

Food Pairing: The deep, roasted notes and rich dried fruit character of this rum make it a phenomenal pairing for dark chocolate desserts, such as a dense flourless chocolate cake, espresso brownies, or sea salt chocolate truffles. For a savory counterpart, it beautifully complements smoked meats, slow-cooked barbecue pork ribs, or a charcuterie board featuring strong, aged cheeses like an extra-aged Gouda or sharp cheddar.

pabst-blue-ribbon-2.title: Pabst Blue Ribbon 24 Cans
pabst-blue-ribbon-2.bodyHtml: Pabst Blue Ribbon (PBR) is an American classic, first brewed in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, in 1844. This American-style lager is characterized by its light and grainy flavor with a subtle malty note and clear, straw-gold appearance. With its light body and neutral taste, it provides a straightforward, no-frills beer experience that appeals to a broad audience. Its simple, consistent, and refreshing character makes it an ideal choice for casual gatherings, barbecues, or as a relaxing drink .

mission-hill-five-vineyards-pinot-blanc.title: Mission Hill Reserve Sauv Blanc
mission-hill-five-vineyards-pinot-blanc.bodyHtml:
Fresh and aromatic, with grapefruit, lime, passion fruit, green apple, and subtle herbal notes. The palate is crisp and lively, showing vibrant citrus fruit, refreshing acidity, gentle texture, and a clean, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with oysters, shellfish, grilled fish, goat cheese, salads, sushi, fresh vegetables, poultry, or light Mediterranean dishes.

glenlivet-18-year-old.title: The Glenlivet 18 Year Old Batch Reserve
glenlivet-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 18 Year Old Batch Reserve is an incredibly elegant and deeply complex Speyside single malt, long considered a gold standard for aged Scotch whisky. Master Distiller Alan Winchester expertly oversees the maturation process, utilizing a carefully calibrated combination of first- and second-fill American oak (ex-bourbon) and European oak (ex-sherry) casks. This specific cask maturation imparts a beautiful harmony between the tropical, vanilla-forward notes of the American oak and the rich, spicy fruitcake characteristics of the European oak. The result is a beautifully balanced, award-winning whisky that delivers a luxurious symphony of ripe orchard fruits, sweet toffee, and delicate winter spice.

Food Pairing: Seared scallops, roasted venison, aged gouda or cheddar, rich fruitcake, and dark chocolate-dipped candied orange peels.

Tasting Notes : Rich old gold with apricot hues in appearance, delivering a remarkably smooth, velvety, and well-rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich and deeply aromatic, featuring elegant notes of sweet toffee, ripe pear, dried apricot, baked apple, and subtle hints of fragrant oak and floral blossom.

Palate : Beautifully balanced and luxurious, bursting with flavors of sweet orange, ripe orchard fruits, rich raisins, and chewy fudge, perfectly complemented by warming winter spices and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, lingering, and elegantly dry, leaving warming notes of sweet citrus, gentle baking spice, and a whisper of raisin.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or with a single drop of water to further unlock its intricate floral and fruity aromatics.

boones-snow-creek-1.title: Boones Snow Creek 750ml
boones-snow-creek-1.bodyHtml: Intense blackberry & raspberry aromas; sweet berry flavours with a long fruity finish.

santa-rita-reserva-merlot.title: Santa Rita 120 Reserva Especial Merlot 2022 750ml
santa-rita-reserva-merlot.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "Initial aromas of tarry asphalt give way to leafy plum and tomato prior to a tight, rubbing palate that's lean to medium in body and slightly rough. Peppery berry and herbal flavors finish short, leaving a green final impression. Michael Schachner" - 84/100, Wine Enthusiast

dominus-double-magnum.title: Caymus Special Selection Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 3L Double Magnum
dominus-double-magnum.bodyHtml:
The Caymus 'Special Selection' Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptional wine made from this storied Napa Valley estate. Following some time to open, this incredible Cabernet begins to yield profound aromatics of black cherry compote, blueberry pie and boysenberry along with creosote, black tar, milk chocolate and licorice all soaring from the glass. The mouthfeel is rich, voluptuous and intense, as this wine offers exceedingly dense, concentrated flavors of black cherry reduction, blueberry pie, raspberry liquor and boysenberry, alongside milk chocolate shavings and tar, all cascading on to the long mouth coating finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Lush and polished, with waves of cassis and blackberry compote pouring through, underscored by chocolate, espresso crema and roasted vanilla bean. Maintains a lush, velvety feel through the lengthy finish, where flashes of sweet tobacco and warm earth peek through. For the power Cabernet crowd. Best from 2024 through 2038.

 

92 Points - CellarTracker

screw-it-malbec.title: Zuccardi Concreto Malbec 2020 750ml
screw-it-malbec.bodyHtml:
#43 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2022

Red color with violet hues. It expresses a great herbal character with notes of red fruits, strawberry, cherry and plum: which are complemented by distinctive mineral notes. In the mouth is prolonged and deep. A wine of grand structure and acidity. Super calcareous soil short alluvial soil, with a conglomerate of big rocks at 20 cm - 0.65 feet of depth. Fermentation and aging in Concrete Vats without oak. Half of the wine is fermented with whole cluster. Vegan.

95 Points - James Suckling

Such a brooding nose with black pepper, violet and fresh blueberry and blackberry fruit. Spicy and tight on the palate, but super polished, racy and refined. Medium-to full-bodied red with beautiful tannin tension and expressive, floral notes in the finish. Exemplary and authentic! So delicious now. Why wait?

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Concreto Malbec has to be one of the finest vintages of this wine despite its youth and still shy personality. But there are tons of flowers, wild herbs and berries there waiting to emerge in an insinuating way, with austerity but unfurling layers and layers as the wine sits in the glass. It's incredibly fine-boned with chalky tannins that scream limestone, full of precision and purity. For Sebastián Zuccardi, they didn't do anything different, it's just the character of the year. This is the wine that explains their philosophy without breaking your piggy bank.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
A youthful, lively and expressive red, showing floral macerated cherry and plum flavors amid toasted herb and espresso bean details. Ends with minerally tannins, which are firm yet perky, and a note of baker's chocolate.

moet-chandon-imperial-nebuchadnez.title: Moet & Chandon Imperial Brut
moet-chandon-imperial-nebuchadnez.bodyHtml:
An elegant golden straw yellow with amber highlights. Its aromas are radiant, revealing bright yellow-fleshed fruits (apple, pear, yellow peach), honey, floral nuances (lime blossom) and elegant blond notes (brioche and fresh nuts). The palate is seductive, richly flavorful and smooth combining generosity and subtlety, fullness and vigor, followed by a delicately fresh crispiness (fruit with seeds), to reveal the magical balance of Champagne.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant version, fine and creamy in texture and backed by lively, orange peel acidity. A streak of smoke-tinged minerality underscores flavors of almond madeleine, poached pear, anise and preserved lemon. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Champagne gets better and better. It has a fine dryness with a crisp apple and citrus character. That goes with the touches of maturity that give the wine fine balance.

90 Points - James Suckling

Nicely complex aromas here, from dried apples, peaches and pears to candied citrus and brioche. It’s fruity, soft and rounded on the palate. Medium-bodied, lightly honeyed and balanced. Blend of pinot noir, pinot meunier and chardonnay.

emmolo-sauvignon-blanc.title: Emmolo Sauvignon Blanc 2022
emmolo-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Guided by the idea that “less is more,” this wine is dry and fresh, with crisp fruit flavors and bright minerality. Some of their grapes come from family vineyards in Napa Valley, with the majority coming from Suisun Valley, a “hidden gem” wine region only 30 minutes from Napa. Suisun shares a similar maritime climate and produces exceptional fruit. Their farming practices enable us to create a wine that is not overly ripe – while also not herbaceous – featuring low alcohol and bright acidity.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant version, with graceful expressions of Meyer lemon, yuzu and lemon blossoms, plus notes of grated ginger. Fresh and juicy, this white is sleek and refreshing. Drink now. 47,850 cases made.

red-rooster-riesling.title: Red Rooster Reserve Viognier 750ml
red-rooster-riesling.bodyHtml: Our Viognier is clear and bright with aromas of apricot, yellow apple, honeycomb, and spring blossoms. This is a dry, medium-bodied wine with a smooth, slightly rich mouthfeel, along with flavours of tropical fruit, pear, and melon.

wild-vines-strawberry-white-zinfandel.title: Arbor Mist Strawberry White Zinfandel 750ml
wild-vines-strawberry-white-zinfandel.bodyHtml: What happens when you mix juicy, field ripened strawberry flavor and soft White Zinfandel? A total berry delight! Chill well before serving.

wild-vines-blackberry-merlot-1.title: Beringer Knights Valley Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
wild-vines-blackberry-merlot-1.bodyHtml:
Beringer Knights Valley Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, beautifully structured, and concentrated California red wine produced from selected barrel lots sourced from stony, low-yielding vineyard blocks in Knights Valley. Exhibiting a deep ruby-purple core, it opens with expressive aromas of dark blackberry, cassis, and black cherry, seamlessly layered with notes of graphite, violet, cigar box, and dark chocolate. On the palate, it is full-bodied, savory, and focused, featuring supple, fine-grained tannins and balancing acidity that frame dark fruit, plum, and spice flavors through a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, venison stew, wild mushroom risotto, and aged cheddar cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

Lots of dark fruits with violets and peppery greens followed by cigar box, forest floor and graphite with cedar and dark chocolates. Wonderfully structured full-bodied wine. Very focused and concentrated with serious depth and length. Artful savory complexity to it. A blend of 80% cabernet sauvignon, 10% cabernet franc, 4% petit verdot, 4% merlot and 2% malbec. Released in spring 2024. It already has a nice drinkability but will age gracefully. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This complex Cabernet displays an impressive array of spice and mineral notes on the nose. The palate is loaded with plum, currant, licorice, graphite and tobacco flavors in a framework of supple tannin and balancing acidity. A little time in the cellar will soften this wine beautifully.

bow-valley-lager-1.title: Bow Valley Lager 15 x 355ml
bow-valley-lager-1.bodyHtml:
Bow Valley Lager is a refreshing Canadian lager offering an approachable balance of crisp malt character and gentle hop bitterness. Light golden in appearance, it delivers subtle notes of toasted grain, biscuit and delicate herbal hops. Its smooth texture, lively carbonation and clean, dry finish make this convenient 15-can pack ideal for gatherings and casual occasions.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled burgers, barbecue chicken, pepperoni pizza, crispy fish and chips, salted pretzels and spicy chicken wings.

Tasting Notes: Crisp malt flavours, light grain sweetness, subtle herbal hops and a clean, refreshing character.

Nose: Fresh grain, mild malt aromas and delicate floral and herbal hop notes.

Palate: Light-bodied and smooth with gentle malt sweetness, biscuit notes and balanced hop bitterness.

Finish: Crisp, dry and refreshing with a subtle lingering malt and hop character.

oxford-landing-shiraz.title: Oxford Landing Shiraz 2021 750ml
oxford-landing-shiraz.bodyHtml:
88 Points - James Suckling
"A reliable and fruity Shiraz with ripe plum and blackberry notes. Soft and easy-drinking with a smooth finish, offering great everyday value."


87 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"Features straightforward dark fruit flavors and a hint of spice. A consistent, crowd-pleasing choice for casual enjoyment."

sawmill-creek-shiraz.title: Sawmill Creek Rose
sawmill-creek-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Sawmill Creek Rose is floral and perfumed, with fresh raspberry, strawberry, and watermelon character. The palate is crisp and light, showing lively red berry fruit and mouthwatering freshness through the finish. Its bright profile delivers an approachable and refreshing expression of Canadian rose wine.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled chicken, shrimp tacos, Margherita pizza, and pasta primavera.

gaja-conteisa.title: Gaja Conteisa Barolo 2019/2020
gaja-conteisa.bodyHtml:
Delicate nose, with hints of cherry compote, mint, marzipan, sweet and spicy notes of ginger, and pepper. In the mouth it is delicate, ethereal and elegant, with very sweet and spicy tannin, notes of wild mint and a long, lingering finish.

2019 Vintage Ratings:

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Gaja 2019 Barolo Conteisa is a smooth operator with forest floor, dried fruit, autumn leaf and pickled plum from Japan with elements of both saltiness and sweetness. Conteisa goes for the high notes with floral tones, violet and something brittle like a laurel leaf. Its texture is very silky and tight.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Located within the Cerequio cru with vines averaging 60 years, the wine opens with aromas of warmed cherries, wild thyme, rose and mixed spices. Forward on the palate with preserved mixed berries, pu’er tea, anise and a crushed stone minerality. Well-balanced with fine, yet firm tannins and a vivid acidity that keeps that palate fresh and mouthwatering.

2020 Vintage Ratings:

98 Points - James Suckling

This is a really enticing wine with an open and vivid nature that tells you right away it is Barolo, but it’s polished and sweetly tannic. You want to taste and taste. It’s medium- to full-bodied with rounded tannins and a savory finish. Juicy and so approachable now. Better in a couple of years, but hard to resist now. Try after 2026.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Gaja 2020 Barolo Conteisa offers subdued and unexpected elegance with great finesse and detailing. You might expect more concentration and power from this hot vintage; however, it instead reveals complexity over a lower overall intensity threshold. "The 2020 vintage offers a classic Nebbiolo profile," says Giovanni Gaja. He compares 2020 to upcoming vintages, describing 2021 as a vintage of power and 2022 as a vintage of concentration. The Conteisa with fruit from the Cerequio MGA shows a dark ruby hue with vibrant notes of wild cherry, crushed mint, dusty limestone and pressed violets. The tannins are especially elegant and fine.

shafer-hillside-select.title: Shafer Hillside Select Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 3L Double Magnum
shafer-hillside-select.bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon celebrates hillside vineyards. Rugged, arid vineyard blocks, such as these, with rocky, scant soils create ideal conditions for producing wine of classic richness and elegance. This wine also exhibits the structure and beauty that are the hallmarks of wines born of the winery's location within Napa Valley's Stags Leap District. Aged nearly four years prior to release, this wine offers the pleasures of youthful boldness on release and rich nuance after a decade or more of bottling.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

In the running for the wine of the vintage, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Hillside Select is an incredible success and offers more depth, opulence, and purity than just about every other wine out there. Revealing a dense purple color as well as a killer nose of blueberries, chocolate-covered cherries, scorched earth, tobacco, violets, and exotic spices, it hits the palate with full-bodied richness, a seamless, pure, incredibly layered mouthfeel, building tannins, and a great, great finish. As with most top 2017s, it stays tight and compact on the palate, with notable structure and impressive concentration. It has some up-front appeal given its purity of fruit and balance, yet it's going to take 7-8 years to hit prime time and will be a long-lived bottle of Napa Cabernet. Hats off to Doug Shafer and the team for yet another magical Cabernet Sauvignon!

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Hillside Select displays a deep garnet-purple color, bursting from the glass with scents of blueberry pie, crème de cassis, black cherry compote and chocolate box plus nuances of cedar chest, clove oil, lavender and menthol. The richly fruited, full-bodied palate has a lively skip in its step, featuring gorgeous ripe, velvety tannins and fantastic freshness to support all the spicy black fruit layers, finishing long and perfumed. An absolute triumph!

98 Points - James Suckling

Wild blackberries and brambleberries on the nose with raw cocoa, cloves and crushed gravel. Violets and orange peel, too. It’s medium-bodied with wonderful purity and depth of fruit, interlaced with dark-chocolate flavors. Firm, well-integrated tannins. Complex and refined with fantastic energy. One of the finest Hillside Selects I have had. Better from 2024.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is the 35th vintage of this 100% varietal powerhouse, a deeply concentrated, muscular and intensely flavored wine that offers equal parts grace and age ability. Blue fruit and notes of iron, crushed rock and cocoa powder deliver a seamless palate of opulence, with lasting hints of allspice, black pepper and oak. Best After 2027. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This drips with rich blackberry, boysenberry and raspberry fruit flavors and is liberally laced with licorice root and singed alder notes, delivering a nice tarry tug through the finish as the fruit drips. Shows a twinge of the vintage's rusticity in its tannins, but it's a heck of an effort in this tricky year. Best from 2023

shafer-hillside-select-1.title: Shafer Hillside Select Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 6L Imperial
shafer-hillside-select-1.bodyHtml:
