ravenswood-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
ravenswood-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

antinori-solaia-toscana-igt-3l.title: Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2020 3L Double Magnum
antinori-solaia-toscana-igt-3l.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2020 is an exceptional, full-bodied Super Tuscan sourced from the famed 20-hectare southwest-facing Solaia vineyard on the Tenuta Tignanello estate in the heart of Chianti Classico. Displaying an intense, deep ruby red color, it opens with a complex and expressive bouquet of wild blueberries, ripe raspberries, dark plum, and cassis, interwoven with delicate nuances of fresh mint, dried herbs, dark cocoa, and sweet spices. On the palate, it exhibits extraordinary power and seamless refinement, delivering rich layers of vibrant dark berry fruit supported by taut, velvety tannins and balanced acidity that carries through to an extraordinarily long, sophisticated, and mineral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted venison loin, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, or well-aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

98 Points - James Suckling

Subtle and beautiful on the nose with currants, flowers and light sage aromas that follow through to a full body with ultra-fine tannins and a long and flavorful finish. Extremely polished and poised.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Dripping with black currant, blackberry, black cherry, iron and toasty oak flavors, this red is suave and polished. Features flashes of tobacco and wild herbs that add even more detail as this builds to a long, kaleidoscopic finish. Presents civilized tannins that are well-integrated and provide structure. Cabernet Sauvignon, Sangiovese and Cabernet Franc.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A torrent of blackberries, blueberries and currants jump off the nose before giving way to soil and wild fennel. On the palate berries remain as exuberant as they were on the nose, equally balanced by wild herbs and pepper, with a spicy heat that feels like the peel of an orange set on fire over a glass of amaro. Tannins are taut and smooth and give the sensation of actually being able to bite into the wine.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Inky dark in appearance, the 2020 Solaia is mostly Cabernet Sauvignon with smaller percentages of Cabernet Franc and Sangiovese. This vintage unfolds to exuberant richness and thick layers of blackberry and plum. The tannins are sweet and expertly crafted, adding both depth and fruit weight. The 2020 vintage is quite bold, and it plays its best cards in terms of texture and mouthfeel. It’s a bigger, more accessible wine compared to the last two vintages on the market. Spice, toasted coffee bean and more dark fruit color this full-bodied Tuscan red.

spy-valley-marlborough-pinot-noir.title: Spy Valley Pinot Noir 2022
spy-valley-marlborough-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Spy Valley Pinot Noir 2022 is an elegant, multi-layered New Zealand red wine crafted from estate-grown fruit in the cool-climate Waihopai Valley. The 2022 growing season benefited from excellent flowering conditions, followed by careful canopy management to preserve vibrant, pure varietal characteristics. Vinified in separate batches with gentle plunging in open-top fermenters, the wine was matured for 11 months in French oak barrels. In the glass, it exhibits a bright ruby hue, leading to an aromatic bouquet of ripe red cherries, wild raspberries, and sweet plums, accented by notes of cinnamon spice and a subtle forest-floor earthiness. The palate is structured and linear, showing sweet red berry fruits upfront that transition into fine, structural tannins and balanced acidity, finishing with persistent, savory spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted duck breast, herb-crusted lamb chops, pan-seared venison, wild mushroom risotto, and mature brie cheese.

91 Points - James Suckling

A fresh and easy pinot with candied strawberries, lemon peel and flowers. Medium-bodied with nice fruit and a firm finish. Drink now and enjoy. Screw cap.

twin-islands-sauvignon-blanc.title: Nautilus Twin Islands Sauvignon Blanc 2022 750ml
twin-islands-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Twin Islands Sauvignon Blanc is described as a crisp, fresh white wine with a pale straw color, offering a fragrant aroma of passionfruit, grapefruit, and fresh mint. The palate is characterized by its crispness and intensity, showcasing flavors of grapefruit, and hints of fresh herbs and citrus peel, leading to a zesty and mouthwatering finish.

three-olives-cherry-vodka.title: Three Olives Cherry Vodka
three-olives-cherry-vodka.bodyHtml:
Three Olives Cherry Vodka is a cherry-flavoured vodka from Three Olives, bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle. This version is produced in Kentucky, USA. It is designed for easy mixing: serve it chilled as a shot, over ice, or as the base of fruity long drinks and cocktails.

Serve: Pour over ice with soda or lemon-lime, or shake into a martini-style cocktail.

gaja-sperss-nebbiolo-langhe-doc.title: Gaja Sperss Barolo 2018/2020
gaja-sperss-nebbiolo-langhe-doc.bodyHtml:
A powerhouse from the legendary Serralunga d'Alba terroir, Gaja Sperss is a commanding Barolo defined by its "muscular" structure and profound depth. The palate delivers a dense core of black cherry and wild plum, layered with sophisticated notes of tar, licorice, and truffle. Known for its firm tannic spine and distinct stony minerality, this is an austere, age-worthy Nebbiolo that perfectly balances raw Piedmontese power with Gaja’s signature elegance.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Forward and lifted, this Barolo boasts blackberries, plums, thyme, rosemary, clove, and allspice. Elegant yet powerful, the lush palate is dominated by juicy blackberries and cherries, while savory earth notes emerge on the lengthy finish, supported by ultra-fine tannins. A mouth-filling and substantial wine with captivating depth.

97 Points - James Suckling

Very spiced with deep, dark earth and forest aromas of black truffles, bark, mushrooms, licorice and iodine. Full-bodied and very reserved, with a linear and racy palate that goes on for minutes. Gunpowder highlights to the dark fruit and forest floor character. Structured.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Showing the power and the contoured definition that is typical of Serralunga d'Alba, the Gaja 2020 Barolo Sperss is a wine of greater brawn and intensity. Yet its power remains elegantly in line with the character of the vintage that is ultimately more subdued compared to 2019 or the upcoming 2021. It offers a complete photograph of its territory with rusty ferrous notes, orange peel, dark fruit and licorice. There is a fun end note of dark Amarena cherry to conclude. That hint of sweetness ties into elegantly chalky tannins.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Reduced aromas are earthy, with flashes of cherry and raspberry fruit. The flavors are fresh and lively, with fine precision and a tightly wound structure boosting the notes of cherry, raspberry, iron, tobacco and underbrush. The excellent length on the mineral-infused finish indicates this wine's future potential.

santa-julia-malbec-reserva.title: Santa Julia Reserva Malbec
santa-julia-malbec-reserva.bodyHtml:
Santa Julia Reserva Malbec pours a dark violet-red color with rich blue hues in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and varietally pure, opening with intense aromas of ripe black cherries, dark plums, and sweet blackberries, beautifully layered with delicate undertones of vanilla, chocolate, and a hint of sweet spices from its time spent aging in French oak barrels. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Malbec showcases a smooth, fleshy texture with very soft, fine-grained tannins and a perfectly balanced mountain acidity. A core of juicy dark fruits and subtle earthy undertones carries through to a wonderfully round, clean, and fruit-forward finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled skirt steak, barbecued ribs, charbroiled burgers, roasted lamb chops, or traditional beef empanadas.

villa-maria-pinot-gris.title: Villa Maria Private Bin Pinot Gris 2023
villa-maria-pinot-gris.bodyHtml:
Villa Maria Private Bin Pinot Gris 2023 is an expressive Marlborough white offering ripe pear, red apple, honeysuckle, peach, citrus, and baking spice. The palate is rich and textured, with balanced acidity, subtle sweetness, gentle spice, and a refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Seafood, roasted chicken, creamy pasta, Asian cuisine, fresh salads, soft cheeses, pork, and lightly spiced dishes.

sobieski-vodka-1.title: Sobieski Vodka
sobieski-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Sobieski Vodka is a Polish vodka named for King Jan III Sobieski, made from 100% Polish rye and Polish spring water. It is continuously distilled in Poland in the country's tallest rectification column, close to 40 metres high, then filtered and reduced with clear water before bottling in Poland. The rye gives a subtle scent of matured grain and a silky, well-balanced taste with a deep finish, making it a natural fit for cocktails. Bottled at 40% ABV, 750ml.

Serve: Chilled, or in cocktails such as a Polish Mule, Bloody Mary or Espresso Martini.

wine-by-joe-pinot-noir.title: Joel Gott Wines Pinot Noir
wine-by-joe-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: The 2022 California Pinot Noir has aromas of Bing cherries, black plum, and red currants with notes of vanilla cream and baking spices. On the palate, bright red fruit flavors and acidity are followed by soft, velvety tannins on the mid-palate and a long, elegant finish.

1921-tequila-cream-1.title: 1921 Tequila Crema
1921-tequila-cream-1.bodyHtml:
1921 Tequila Crema is a Mexican cream liqueur from Casa 1921, which presents it as the first tequila cream and calls it 'The Cream of Mexico'. It combines cream with the house's own 1921 Tequila Blanco and classic Mexican flavours led by real coffee, and is bottled at 15% ABV. The producer describes a creamy liqueur with a caramel hue, a delicate, sweet aroma of tequila blanco, coffee and cinnamon, and a taste of coffee, vanilla, cinnamon, nuts and chocolate with a pleasant aftertaste. It recommends serving it cold, at 4 to 6 degrees Celsius. Casa 1921 takes its name from the year the Mexican Revolution came to a close, and it lists a Double Gold medal for the cream at the 2024 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. The liqueur is sold in two bottle colours with the same contents; this listing is the 750ml bottle.

Nose: Delicate and sweet, with tequila blanco, coffee and cinnamon.

Palate: Creamy, with coffee, vanilla, cinnamon, nuts and chocolate.

Finish: Creamy and enveloping, with a pleasant aftertaste.

Serve: Well chilled (4-6 C), neat or over ice.

dugat-py-charmes-chambertin-grand-cru.title: Domaine Feuillet Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru
dugat-py-charmes-chambertin-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Domaine Feuillet Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru is a luxurious Pinot Noir with aromas of black cherry, ripe raspberry, rose petals, forest floor, truffle, and sweet spice. Rich concentration, velvety tannins, vibrant acidity, and refined minerality deliver an elegant Grand Cru with remarkable depth and a persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast duck, venison, beef tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, truffle dishes, or aged Époisses and Comté cheeses.

brewhouse-pilsner-4.title: Brewhouse Pilsner 24 Cans
brewhouse-pilsner-4.bodyHtml: A tasty and refreshing pilsner-style beer, crafted from premium ingredients including Western Canadian barley. It is cold filtered and naturally aged without any preservatives, offering a light, malty flavour with a crisp and balanced finish and no aftertaste .

skyy-infusions-pineapple-vodka.title: Skyy Infusions Pineapple Vodka
skyy-infusions-pineapple-vodka.bodyHtml:
SKYY Infusions Pineapple is a smooth, sweet, and tangy pineapple-infused, gluten-free vodka. Its vibrant juiciness and tropical tartness of real pineapple make for your favourite fruit-forward cocktails.SKYY Infusions are made with real fruit flavors using only natural aromas, extracts, essences, and juices to provide the fresh taste of true-to-life ingredients. San Francisco in every drop, SKYY Vodka is made with water enriched with local Pacific minerals from the San Francisco Bay, quadruple distilled, then filtered through California limestone for a clean, fresh taste and subtle minerality designed to add character to your cocktail experience.

Pineapple Vodka & Soda- Ingredients: 1.5 Parts SKYY Pineapple, 4.5 parts soda water, Cubed ice Garnish: Pineapple slice and rosemary Glass: Highball glass

canadian-67.title: Canadian Club Premium 1.14L with 50ml Pack
canadian-67.bodyHtml:
A Canadian Club Premium value pack with a total volume of 1.19 L at 40% ABV. Canadian Club Premium is the brand's flagship blended Canadian whisky, made from corn, rye, rye malt and barley malt and aged in white-oak American bourbon barrels for longer than the three years Canadian law requires. The brand describes it as bright gold, with almond and peppery spice on the nose, zesty spice, oak and vanilla on the palate, and a clean, dry finish.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or with soda or ginger ale.

canadian-68.title: Canadian Club Premium 1.14L with 50ml Pack
canadian-68.bodyHtml:
A Canadian Club Premium value pack with a total volume of 1.19 L at 40% ABV. Canadian Club Premium is the brand's flagship blended Canadian whisky, made from corn, rye, rye malt and barley malt and aged in white-oak American bourbon barrels for longer than the three years Canadian law requires. The brand describes it as bright gold, with almond and peppery spice on the nose, zesty spice, oak and vanilla on the palate, and a clean, dry finish.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or with soda or ginger ale.

highwood-black-russian.title: Highwood Paralyzer Mix 1.14L
highwood-black-russian.bodyHtml:
Highwood Paralyzer Mix is a ready-to-pour cocktail base from Highwood Distillers of High River, Alberta, and one of the distillery's top-selling premixes. It blends Highwood's premium vodka with Colita Coffee del Sol, the distillery's coffee liqueur made from a special blend of natural coffee flavours. Bottled at 34.9% ABV, it does two jobs: pour it over ice for a traditional Black Russian, or add milk and cola to build the Paralyzer that gives the mix its name. This listing is the 1.14L plastic bottle.

Serve: Over ice as a Black Russian, or topped with milk and cola as a Paralyzer.

highwood-black-russian-1.title: Highwood Paralyzer Mix
highwood-black-russian-1.bodyHtml:
Highwood Paralyzer Mix is a ready-to-pour cocktail base from Highwood Distillers of High River, Alberta, and one of the distillery's top-selling premixes. It blends Highwood's premium vodka with Colita Coffee del Sol, the distillery's coffee liqueur made from a special blend of natural coffee flavours. Bottled at 34.9% ABV, it does two jobs: pour it over ice for a traditional Black Russian, or add milk and cola to build the Paralyzer that gives the mix its name. This listing is the 750ml glass bottle.

Serve: Over ice as a Black Russian, or topped with milk and cola as a Paralyzer.

chivas-regal-12-year.title: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old 1.14L
chivas-regal-12-year.bodyHtml:
Chivas Regal 12 Year Old is a classic, world-renowned blended Scotch whisky created by the Chivas Brothers in Aberdeen, Scotland. Crafted from a selection of fine malt and grain whiskies—with Strathisla single malt at its heart—this signature expression is aged for a minimum of 12 years. It delivers a smooth, rich, and accessible Speyside-influenced profile known for its balance of orchard fruits, wild herbs, and sweet honey.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork loin, smoked salmon, creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert, apple pie, and shortbread biscuits.

Tasting Notes : Radiant, warm amber color. Smooth, round, and creamy texture with a light-to-medium body.

Nose : An aromatic infusion of wild herbs, heather, honey, and orchard fruits like ripe apples and peaches.

Palate : Rich and fruity with flavors of sweet honey, poached apples, vanilla, butterscotch, and subtle hazelnut notes.

Finish : Smooth and lingering with gentle notes of oak spice, honey, and subtle maltiness.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed into classic cocktail recipes such as a Highball or Rob Roy.

mumm-cuvee-napa-brut-prestige.title: G.H. Mumm Napa Brut Prestige Cuvee
mumm-cuvee-napa-brut-prestige.bodyHtml:
The Mumm Napa Brut Prestige is a crisp, vibrant, and multi-layered New World sparkling wine that acts as the acclaimed signature benchmark of the estate. It pours a beautiful pale gold colour with a fine, persistent stream of energetic bubbles, releasing an expressive bouquet of bright citrus peel, crunchy red apple, and white peach, deeply underscored by hints of fresh-baked bread, vanilla custard, and ginger spice. On the palate, this medium-bodied sparkler delivers a refreshing, juicy core of stone fruits and melon, textured beautifully by light bready notes from aging on its yeast lees. Driven by a bright, food-friendly acidity and a clean, structural crunch, it finishes with a long, elegant persistence accented by a touch of honey and delicate minerality.

Food Pairing: This highly versatile sparkler pairs beautifully with a broad range of culinary options, including oysters on the half shell, pan-seared sea scallops, eggs benedict, stuffed mushrooms, roasted poultry, light appetizers, and mild cheeses.
92 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Floral in lemon blossom, this tastes of lemon peel, grapefruit and spicy gingerbread, its acidity persistent and uplifting. A bite of texture gives it heft without too much ripeness, finishing lean and crisp.
90 Points - Wine Spectator

Delicate in style yet plush, with pretty cherry, lemon verbena and yeast roll flavors that linger on the supple, refreshing finish. Drink now.

stolichnaya-vanil-vodka.title: Stoli Vanil Vodka
stolichnaya-vanil-vodka.bodyHtml: 750ml bottle Stolichnaya Vanil Vodka is the perfect choice for any occasion. Crafted from world-class ingredients, it offers a deliciously smooth taste and a delightful vanilla scent. With natural extracts and a special distillation process, this vodka has a 50% alcohol content that is sure to delight. Enjoy a classic vodka experience with a smooth, velvety finish.

wild-turkey-kentucky-spirit.title: Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Bourbon
wild-turkey-kentucky-spirit.bodyHtml:
Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a legendary, high-proof American masterpiece that has stood as the flagship expression of the distillery for over 60 years. Crafted by the iconic father-and-son Master Distiller team, Jimmy and Eddie Russell, it utilizes Wild Turkey’s signature high-rye mashbill and is distilled at a lower proof to retain maximum flavor. Aged in the deepest No. 4 "alligator" char American white oak barrels, it is bottled at an explicit 101 proof, delivering an uncompromisingly bold, rich, and spicy character that remains a benchmark for real Kentucky bourbon.

Food Pairing: Rich barbecue burnt ends, smoked venison or beef jerky, mature extra-sharp cheddar, or dark chocolate pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber and burnished copper hue with a bold, rich, and medium-to-full body on the palate.

Nose : Intense aromas of sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, honey, baking spices, and subtle orange peel.

Palate : Full-flavored and dynamic with upfront notes of sweet vanilla, rich caramel, toasted oak, rye spice, cinnamon, and a touch of dark chocolate.

Finish : Long, warm, and spicy with lingering notes of bold oak, baking spice, and a distinctive orange zest tail.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks with a single large ice cube, or as a robust base in classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned or Boulevardier.

captain-morgan-gold-rum-1.title: Captain Morgan Gold Rum 1.14L
captain-morgan-gold-rum-1.bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan Gold is a smooth, easy-mixing gold rum from Captain Morgan's Canadian range. The producer describes notes of sweet wood and hazelnut coming together in a well-balanced spirit with a smooth finish, a medium-weight palate and restrained sweetness. That restraint makes it a natural partner for cola. This listing is the 1.14L bottle at 40% ABV, produced in Quebec.

Tasting Notes: Sweet wood and hazelnut with restrained sweetness.

Palate: Medium weight, balanced, with restrained sweetness.

Finish: Smooth.

Serve: With cola over ice and a wedge of lime.

dom-perignon-blanc-6l.title: Dom Perignon Vintage 2010 6L Imperial
dom-perignon-blanc-6l.bodyHtml:
Dom Pérignon Vintage 2010 was a bold wager, the fruit of an unwavering commitment to expressing nature, coupled with the freedom that makes audacious endeavors possible. Dom Pérignon pairs beautifully with seafood and fish such as oysters, scallops, and sea bass; and meats such as veal, quail, and foie gras. It also pairs well with cheese such as parmesan, vegetables such as leeks, truffles, and mushrooms, and herbs and spices including ginger, cumin, and saffron.

98 Points - James Suckling

A pretty DP now with richness and freshness, showing dried-lemon and light apricot character. Some pineapple, too. It’s full-bodied and grows on the palate, with intensity and maturity. Goes on for a long time. This is nicely framed and focused. One for the cellar.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A graceful Champagne, featuring fragrant notes of toasted brioche and grilled nut that are more subtle on the palate, transitioning to a rich underpinning layered with a pure chime of tangerine and accents of candied ginger, toasted saffron and lime blossom. This bundles a lot of concentrated flavor into a lithe frame. The fine mousse caresses the palate through to the lasting finish. Drink now through 2035.

93 Points - Decanter

Soft gold, with a gentle green luminescence and a paler rim. A fine bead and immediately reassuring nose…. classic DP this, citric fruit, slate, sourdough, soft spice and the softly whispered intimations of tropical decadence. Pedigree writ large. The palate continues the theme, albeit with great subtlety. Vincent describes sapidity, itself buttressing the fruit which now recalls nectarines and pineapple, maybe a hint of crystallised grapefruit. The finish unfurls neatly, a gentle phenolic kick of salinity underwriting structure and potential alike.

mcgraths-irish-cream.title: Mcgrath's Irish Cream
mcgraths-irish-cream.bodyHtml:
McGrath's Irish Cream is a cream liqueur from Ireland, bottled at 13.9% ABV. This 750ml bottle is a good-value option for sipping over ice, pouring into coffee or using in creamy cocktails and desserts.

Serve: Chilled over ice, in coffee, or in cream-based cocktails.

van-gogh-rich-dark-chocolate.title: Vincent Van Gogh Dutch Caramel Vodka
van-gogh-rich-dark-chocolate.bodyHtml:
Vincent Van Gogh Dutch Caramel Vodka is a premium flavored vodka handcrafted at the Royal Dirkzwager Distillery in Schiedam, Netherlands. Made by double-infusing high-quality grain spirit with natural Dutch caramel, it offers a decadent, rich flavor profile that strikes a balance between buttery sweetness and smooth, clean vodka strength without being overly syrupy.

Food Pairing: Vanilla bean ice cream, chocolate lava cake, pecan pie, apple crisp, espresso desserts, and mild creamy cheeses like Brie.

Tasting Notes : Clear to pale warm amber in appearance with a smooth, velvety, and rich mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and inviting, featuring prominent aromas of rich burnt sugar, buttery caramel, subtle vanilla, and warm toasted sugar.

Palate : Smooth and decadent, delivering upfront flavors of creamy caramel, soft butterscotch, and subtle dark chocolate balanced by a clean grain base.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and lingering with sweet notes of natural caramel and soft vanilla.

Serve : Serve chilled straight up, over ice, or mixed in dessert cocktails like a Caramel Espresso Martini, or topped with iced coffee or cream liqueur.

jack-daniels-old-no-7-tennessee-whisky-1.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey 3L
jack-daniels-old-no-7-tennessee-whisky-1.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey is an iconic, smooth American whiskey crafted in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Charcoal mellowed drop-by-drop through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before aging in handcrafted white oak barrels, it offers a distinct balance of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, and smooth caramel character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, pulled pork sandwiches, grilled burgers, smoked brisket, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold in appearance with a light-to-medium-bodied, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, banana, and subtle brown sugar.

Palate : Balanced mix of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, light spice, and rich caramel.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and medium-length with lingering toasted oak, charcoal, and sweet spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed with cola in a highball glass.

white-owl-spiced-whisky.title: White Owl Spiced Whisky
white-owl-spiced-whisky.bodyHtml:
White Owl Spiced Whisky is a spiced Canadian whisky from Highwood Distillers of High River, Alberta, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750 ml frosted bottle. It starts from the distillery's White Owl Whisky, into which natural ingredients including vanilla and rich butterscotch are blended. According to the producer, the result is an even smoother, longer finish followed by a spicy mix of ginger and cloves, perhaps with a touch of cumin, without the spices ever overpowering the light character of the base whisky. It is a Canadian whisky from Alberta.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla and butterscotch, then ginger and clove spice on a smooth, long finish.

Serve: Neat, over ice or in mixed drinks.

corsairs-spiced-rum.title: Bacardi Spiced Rum 1.75L
corsairs-spiced-rum.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Spiced Rum is a smooth, spirit drink crafted using aged and unaged rum made from sugarcane molasses, infused with natural spices and flavors. Matured in charred American white oak barrels to impart a golden hue and a subtle oaky depth, this rum blends warm cinnamon, vanilla, and nutmeg flavors with a gentle rum kick.

Food Pairing: Barbecue pulled pork, grilled jerk chicken, spicy ribs, dark chocolate desserts, or vanilla pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber and golden-brown appearance with a light-to-medium, smooth body.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, warm cinnamon, nutmeg, brown sugar, and toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and sweet with dominant notes of creamy vanilla, cinnamon spice, soft caramel, and gentle oakiness.

Finish : Medium-length, warm, and sweet with lingering notes of spice and subtle vanilla.

Serve : Serve mixed with cola over ice, blended into tropical cocktails, or served on the rocks.

lopez-de-haro-reserva.title: Hacienda Lopez de Haro Reserva 2019
lopez-de-haro-reserva.bodyHtml:
Medium-high depth wine, ruby red color with roof tile rim, which denotes its long barrel ageing and its peaceful bottle ageing. Powerful on the nose with primary aromas of ripe fruit accompanied by complex spicy and balsamic notes and a slight touch of vanilla. Balanced on the palate, it is a round and unctuous wine with ripe and sweet tannins, providing the wine with a long aftertaste: an elegant Rioja classic.

91 Points - James Suckling

Some graphite and mussel shells to the ripe, slightly dried plums and berries, a light white-pepper note showing through. Medium-bodied on the palate with fluid fruit, fine-grained tannins and a medium-long finish. Drink now or hold.

canadian-69.title: Canadian Club Premium 1.14L with 50ml Pack
canadian-69.bodyHtml:
A Canadian Club Premium value pack with a total volume of 1.19 L at 40% ABV. Canadian Club Premium is the brand's flagship blended Canadian whisky, made from corn, rye, rye malt and barley malt and aged in white-oak American bourbon barrels for longer than the three years Canadian law requires. The brand describes it as bright gold, with almond and peppery spice on the nose, zesty spice, oak and vanilla on the palate, and a clean, dry finish.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or with soda or ginger ale.

trapiche-extravaganza-red-blend.title: Trapiche Broquel Malbec 2017/2019 750ml
trapiche-extravaganza-red-blend.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "This malbec from Trapiche comes off 25 year old vineyards between 900-1000m, and aged 1 year in oak. The final blend is a barrel selection. Dark cocoa dusts blackberry, blueberry compote, with sueded tannins and a clipped, pasty finish. One for taking with grilled burgers now. (Treve Ring)." - 87/100, Gismondi on Wine

smirnoff-ice-light-1.title: Smirnoff Ice Light Original 4 Cans
smirnoff-ice-light-1.bodyHtml: The classic Smirnoff Ice made lighter. Lively, refreshing, and bursting with the zesty flavours of lemon and lime. It's perfectly carbonated and thirst-quenching, with a light, easy-drinking profile and a balanced blend of citrus flavors

arbor-mist-pink-raspberry-moscato.title: Arbor Mist Exotic Fruits 750ml
arbor-mist-pink-raspberry-moscato.bodyHtml: A fine wine product with delicious raspberry, lime, and other natural flavors.

the-macallan-1824-sienna.title: The Macallan 1824 Sienna
the-macallan-1824-sienna.bodyHtml: The Macallan Sienna forms part of our 1824 Series which exemplifies our commitment to 100% natural color, present in each and every Macallan single malt. The color of each expression becomes richer as the range progresses and its flavors more intense.

original-16-copper-ale-1.title: Original 16 Copper 15 Cans
original-16-copper-ale-1.bodyHtml: A smooth and refreshing beer brewed with 100% two-row Prairie barley, a blend of roasted black and caramel malts, and five hop varietals

wild-turkey-bourbon-barrel-aged-barrel.title: Wild Turkey Rare Breed Barrel Proof Bourbon
wild-turkey-bourbon-barrel-aged-barrel.bodyHtml:
Wild Turkey Rare Breed Barrel Proof Bourbon is an absolute benchmark expression in the world of premium American whiskey, celebrated for delivering the true, uncompromised flavor of the distillery. Crafted by legendary father-and-son Master Distillers Jimmy and Eddie Russell, this bourbon is a proprietary marriage of hand-selected barrels aged for six, eight, and twelve years. Bottled directly from the barrel without the addition of any water, it retains its natural, high-proof intensity and robust character. The classic high-rye mashbill and heavy char oak maturation yield an exceptionally deep, bold, and complex spirit that remains remarkably smooth despite its formidable barrel proof strength.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with rich, smoky Texas-style beef brisket, dark chocolate pecan tarts, blue cheeses like Roquefort, or thick-cut maple glazed bacon.

TASTING NOTES - A deep, rich amber-copper color with a full-bodied, heavy, and exceptionally oily mouthfeel that completely coats the palate.

NOSE - Intense and sweet, bursting with aromas of rich caramel, warm vanilla bean, and toasted oak, followed by notes of sweet pipe tobacco, orange zest, and deep baking spices.

PALATE - Bold and explosive on the tongue, delivering thick layers of sweet honey, dark molasses, and toffee, perfectly balanced by sharp rye spice, cinnamon, nutmeg, and a touch of dark chocolate.

FINISH - Long, exceptionally warm, and powerful, leaving lingering notes of toasted oak, dry spice, vanilla cream, and a satisfying, sweet alcohol warmth.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass to experience the full barrel-proof intensity, or with a splash of limestone water to open up the underlying fruit and spice layers.

dugat-py-bourgogne-rouge.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Bourgogne Rouge 2022
dugat-py-bourgogne-rouge.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Bourgogne Rouge 2022 is a powerhouse regional red Burgundy produced by one of the most revered and meticulous domains in Gevrey-Chambertin. The 2022 vintage yielded beautifully ripe, expressive fruit, resulting in a Bourgogne Rouge that displays remarkable depth and old-vine concentration well beyond its regional classification. Grown entirely under strict organic practices, the wine undergoes traditional, low-intervention vinification and is aged for 15 to 18 months in French oak casks before being bottled unfined and unfiltered. In the glass, it shows a luminous, deep ruby hue, revealing a highly aromatic nose packed with fresh redcurrants, dark cherries, and wild raspberries, complexed by savory elements of cracked black pepper, wet stone minerality, smoky oak, and dried flowers. The palate is medium-bodied yet densely textured, balancing the classic, muscular structure and fine-grained tannins characteristic of the Dugat-Py style with a vibrant, refreshing core of acidity. While incredibly expressive in its youth, its balance and concentration ensure it will evolve gracefully over the next several years.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared duck breast, roasted pork tenderloin, Coq au Vin, wild mushroom risotto, or mild semi-hard cheeses like Comté.

bruichladdich-port-charlotte.title: Bruichladdich Port Charlotte
bruichladdich-port-charlotte.bodyHtml: Port Charlotte's long-awaited 10-year-old, rich and smoky whisky made by the independently minded folks at Bruichladdich distillery on Islay. PC, as it's known to its friends, is heavily peated to 40PPM, putting it up with Islay's other heavy hitters. The resulting whisky is big and peaty with a maritime tang—the Bruichladdich team would claim that it's because their warehouses are so close to the sea, we're still undecided. In the end, the most important thing is the taste: it's rather good.

new-belgium-fat-tire-2.title: The Macallan 12 Year Old Double Cask
new-belgium-fat-tire-2.bodyHtml:
The Macallan 12 Year Old Double Cask is an exceptional Speyside single malt Scotch whisky matured in a harmonious combination of handcrafted sherry-seasoned American oak and sherry-seasoned European oak casks. The American oak imparts delicate vanilla, citrus, and soft butterscotch notes, while the European oak delivers the subtle spice and rich dried fruit complexity classic to The Macallan.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork tenderloin, grilled scallops, sticky toffee pudding, dark chocolate desserts, or mild creamy cheeses like Brie.

Tasting Notes : Rich sunburst gold hue with a smooth, velvety, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Creamy butterscotch, candied orange peel, toffee apple, fresh vanilla, and subtle toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of honeyed malt, sweet vanilla, raisins, wood spice, and subtle ginger.

Finish : Warm, lingering, and sweet with persistent oak spice and soft dried fruit character.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, over a large ice sphere, or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

wolf-blass-gold-label-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Wolf Blass Gold Label Cabernet Sauvignon 2020/2021 750ml
wolf-blass-gold-label-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Soft, rich and elegant, Wolf Blass Gold Label Shiraz displays intense dark berry aromas with supporting spice and chocolate leaping from the glass. The full and well rounded palate offers layers of bright plum and berry fruit alongside well-integrated oak, fine acid and balanced tannins.

wild-turkey-rye-whiskey.title: Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
wild-turkey-rye-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Rye is a bold, legendary, and highly dependable American whiskey that serves as a benchmark for the classic "Kentucky style" rye profile. Crafted under the expert watch of legendary Master Distillers Jimmy and Eddie Russell, this expression uses a traditional rye mashbill that features a generous amount of corn. This achieves a beautifully balanced, sweet, and approachable core rather than the intensely herbal, dry character found in high-rye alternatives. Bottled at the distillery's iconic 101 proof after aging a minimum of four years in deeply charred new American oak barrels, it delivers a robust punch of flavor that stands up magnificently in classic cocktails like a Manhattan or Old Fashioned while remaining wonderfully smooth to enjoy on its own.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with slow-smoked pork belly, grilled ribeye steak with a peppercorn crust, dark chocolate pecan pie, sharp aged white cheddar, or savory charcuterie like prosciutto and spicy salami.

Tasting Notes : Deep rich amber hue with a full-bodied, oily, and mouth-coating structure on the palate.

Nose : Bold rye spice, sweet vanilla, dark caramel, charred oak, fresh mint, and subtle citrus zest.

Palate : Complex and dynamic with upfront rye pepper, sweet honey, vanilla bean, clove, cinnamon, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, warm, and spicy with lingering notes of pepper, baking spices, and bold oak warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks with a single large ice cube, or as an exceptional base in classic rye cocktails like a Manhattan or Sazerac.

masi-passo-doble.title: Masi Passo Doble Valle de Uco 2021
masi-passo-doble.bodyHtml: Deep ruby red in colour with violet tinged reflections. Ripe plums, blackberry jam and cocoa on the nose. Firm and well balanced on the palate with soft tannins and supporting acidity. A long lingering finish of fruit and spices.

rolling-rock-2.title: Rolling Rock 24 Cans
rolling-rock-2.bodyHtml: A classic American Premium Extra Pale Lager, well-known for its distinctive, full-bodied taste, craftsmanship, and heritage. Brewed as a balanced, medium-light bodied lager with a unique and flavorful malt character and a subtle hop finish

magellan-gin.title: Magellan Gin
magellan-gin.bodyHtml: This smooth, well-balanced gin is named for the 16th-century explorer whose remaining crew members returned with barrels of cloves, a key ingredient to this gin. Iris root and flower provide Magellan with its beautiful blue color while enhancing its crisp taste.

glenfarclas-family-cask-1954-rel-s14.title: Glenfarclas 'The Family Casks' 1954 Release S14 Cask 1259 Plain Butt
glenfarclas-family-cask-1954-rel-s14.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 1954 59 Year Old S14 Cask 1259 4th Fill Butt 46.7% ABV 700ml

THIS IS A PREORDER ITEM. STOCK WILL ARRIVE IN FEBRUARY 2024.

matusalem-platino-rum.title: Ron Matusalem Gran Reserva 23 Solera
matusalem-platino-rum.bodyHtml: Designed to challenge the most sophisticated palates, Grand Reserva 23 is one of the biggest honors of the family. Let yourself go and explore the astonishing foodpairing combinations, its sophisticated flavor and as a legendary tool in classic cocktails with a twist.

ole-smoky-original-1.title: Ole Smoky Salty Caramel Whiskey
ole-smoky-original-1.bodyHtml: Might be the best thing to happen to whiskey since, well, whiskey. Savor every sip of this blend of rich, sweet 60 proof whiskey that tastes like liquid caramel with a hint of salt at the end of it. Whiskey never tasted so decadent.

grey-goose-le-citron-vodka.title: Grey Goose Le Citron Vodka
grey-goose-le-citron-vodka.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Le Citron is a lemon flavoured vodka from Grey Goose, produced and bottled in France at 40% ABV. It starts from Grey Goose vodka, made from French soft winter wheat and spring water, which is blended with essential oils from fine lemons, including those from the renowned Menton region of France. Menton lemons are larger and thicker skinned than most, giving a concentrated, less acidic oil with bold flavour. The result is a bright, clean citrus vodka that works as well in a Bloody Mary as with soda.

Nose: Bright and balanced lemon.

Palate: Clean and bold.

Finish: Fresh and warm.

Serve: With soda and a lemon twist, or in a Le Citron Bloody Mary.

roca-patron-silver-tequila.title: Patron Silver Tequila
roca-patron-silver-tequila.bodyHtml:
Patrón Silver Tequila is a smooth, handcrafted ultra-premium blanco tequila produced in small batches at the Hacienda Patrón distillery in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Made from 100% Weber Blue Agave harvested at peak maturity, the agave piñas are slowly baked in traditional brick ovens, crushed using both a volcanic stone tahona wheel and a modern roller mill, fermented, and distilled in small copper pot stills. Bottled immediately without aging, it captures the crisp, pure, and vibrant essence of fresh sweet agave balanced with bright citrus and subtle peppery notes.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh ceviche, grilled shrimp tacos, guacamole with tortilla chips, seared scallops, citrus-marinated chicken, and fresh queso fresco.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and bright with a smooth, light-to-medium body and a clean, crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh cooked agave, sweet citrus zest, green pear, white flowers, and subtle herbal notes.

Palate : Crisp and smooth with flavors of sweet roasted agave, lemon and lime peel, fresh tropical fruit, and a touch of cracked white pepper.

Finish : Clean, light, and warming with lingering notes of sweet agave and gentle black pepper spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tequila tasting glass or flute, chilled on the rocks with a lime wedge, or as the crisp foundation in classic cocktails such as a Margarita or Paloma.

port-ellen-32yo.title: Port Ellen 32 Year Old
port-ellen-32yo.bodyHtml:
Port Ellen 32 Year Old is a 1983 vintage single malt from the closed Port Ellen distillery on the Isle of Islay, released as part of Diageo's Special Releases in 2015. It matured for more than three decades in refill European oak sherry butts and is bottled at 53.9% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Whisky Advocate scored it 89 points, with Dave Broom describing more weight than many earlier releases and a distinctive smokiness like a freshly lit fire, with walnut skin and rich dried fruit from the more active oak, balanced by gentle sweetness.

Tasting Notes: Fire lighter, burning paper and wood smoke, walnut skin, rich dried fruits, then smoke again with balancing sweetness.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water if desired.

glenlivet-founders-reserve.title: The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve 375ml
glenlivet-founders-reserve.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve is an exceptionally smooth, bright, and approachable Speyside single malt Scotch whisky created as a tribute to the distillery's pioneering founder, George Smith. To capture the signature fruitiness and elegant character of the original 1824 expression, this non-age-statement malt is distilled in The Glenlivet's classic lantern-shaped copper pot stills. The spirit is then matured in a combination of traditional oak casks alongside a high proportion of first-fill American white oak ex-bourbon barrels. This specialized wood selection infuses the whisky with creamy vanilla sweetness and subtle tropical undertones, making it a highly accessible and delightfully smooth dram for both newcomers and seasoned whisky enthusiasts alike.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light lemon tarts, creamy brie or Camembert cheeses, roasted chicken with herbs, or a traditional vanilla panna cotta.

Tasting Notes : Pale gold in color with a smooth, light, and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Citrus fruit, sweet orange, pear, zesty lime, and a hint of delicate oak.

Palate : Smooth and creamy with flavors of sweet orange, pear, red apple, toffee, and subtle vanilla.

Finish : Long, smooth, and clean with lingering oak warmth and gentle fruit sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, over ice, or with a few drops of water.

robert-mondavi-private-heritage-red-blen.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
robert-mondavi-private-heritage-red-blen.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

smirnoff-electric-berry.title: Smirnoff Ice Berry Blast 6 Cans
smirnoff-electric-berry.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Ice Berry Blast is a pre-mixed, flavored malt beverage produced by Smirnoff, combining its signature vodka-inspired flavor base with a sweet, tart blend of blue raspberry, blackberry, and cherry fruit flavors. Known for its distinct electric-blue appearance and crisp, fizzy texture, it offers a sweet, refreshing, and accessible taste profile designed for casual occasions.

Food Pairing: Spicy chicken wings, loaded nachos, fish tacos, barbecue pulled pork, and fresh fruit skewers.

Tasting Notes : Electric vibrant blue in appearance with a light, crisp, and carbonated mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and aromatic, dominated by prominent notes of artificial blue raspberry, ripe blackberry, candied cherry, and citrus zest.

Palate : Sweet, tart, and carbonated, delivering forward flavors of sweet blue raspberry, tangy berry punch, and lemon-lime citrus.

Finish : Quick, crisp, and refreshing, leaving a lingering sweet berry taste with a clean, effervescent bite.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled or poured over ice in a highball glass, optionally garnished with a fresh lime wheel or raspberries.

grizzly-paw-rundlestone.title: Grizzly Paw Rutting Elk Red 20L Cls

grizzly-paw-evolution-ipa.title: Grizzly Paw Evolution Ipa 4 Tall Cans

woodford-reserve-mas-coll-straight-malt.title: Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Malt Whiskey
woodford-reserve-mas-coll-straight-malt.bodyHtml:
An incredibly unique and historically significant expression from the Woodford Reserve portfolio. Unlike traditional Scottish single malts which use 100% malt, this expression leans heavily into American bourbon-making traditions by utilizing a mash bill of 51% malted barley, 47% corn, and 2% rye. Aged in heavily charred new American oak barrels and bottled at 90.4 proof, it offers an exceptionally rich, nutty, and sweet profile that beautifully bridges the gap between a classic Kentucky bourbon and a smooth Scottish malt.

 

NOSE

Rich and highly aromatic. Beautiful notes of dark chocolate, toasted nuts, sweet malt, and warm vanilla bean.

PALATE

Smooth, nutty, and slightly sweet. Deep flavors of toasted almond, milk chocolate, and sweet corn are balanced perfectly by gentle oak tannins and a touch of citrus.

FINISH

Clean, warm, and lingering with sweet malt and soft toasted wood.

park-barrel-aged-gin.title: Peddlers Gin Co. Barrel Aged Gin
park-barrel-aged-gin.bodyHtml:
Peddlers Gin Co. Barrel Aged Gin is an artisanal Chinese craft gin rested for three months in French oak barrels that previously held Napa Valley Pinot Noir. Combining traditional gin botanicals with organic flora sourced across China, it harmonizes deep fruit and oak nuances with a signature spicy botanical core.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, smoked duck breast, grilled lamb skewers, dark chocolate tarts, and aged hard cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Warm golden-amber with light pinkish undertones, offering a rich, smooth, and full, almost chewy mouthfeel.

Nose : Soft cinnamon spice, subtle zesty lime, warm vanilla, oak shavings, and sweet Pinot Noir grape nuances.

Palate : Smooth caramel and mellow cherry stone fruit from French oak, complemented by smoked Sichuan pepper and floral pepper flavors.

Finish : Long and drying with a piquant pepperiness, trailing off into notes of angelica, licorice, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Best served on the rocks, topped with premium tonic, or used as a rich, complex substitute for bourbon in a Martinez or Old Fashioned.

gp-brewing-mercury-1.title: GP Vodka 1.75L
gp-brewing-mercury-1.bodyHtml:
GP Vodka (also known as GP Brewing Handcrafted Vodka) is a smooth, easy-drinking Canadian craft spirit distilled by GP Brewing Company in Grande Prairie, Alberta. Multiple times distilled and constantly filtered for exceptional clarity, it is cut with pure glacier water to achieve a crisp, refreshing character.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with sour cream and caviar, fresh oysters, cured meats, and light appetizers.

Tasting Notes : Colorless, clear, and bright in appearance, providing a crisp, light, and exceptionally smooth mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and neutral with faint, subtle hints of fresh grain.

Palate : Soft, clean, and smooth with subtle grain sweetness and crisp, pure water undertones.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing.

Serve : Served well-chilled neat, over ice, or as a smooth base in classic mixed drinks and cocktails.

tomintoul-40-yo.title: Tomintoul 40 Year Old
tomintoul-40-yo.bodyHtml:
Distilled on 11th January 1974, Tomintoul Aged 40 Years Old 2nd Edition is an outstanding single malt which has been matured for over 40 years in the finest hand-selected American oak ex-bourbon hogshead casks.

Our Master Distiller, Robert Fleming, a fourth-generation distiller, personally selected each cask to create this rich and complex whisky, which has been bottled at a cask strength of 43.1%, unchill-filtered and at natural colour. 

Limited to only 165 bottles, this remarkable single malt displays a rich fruity sweetness perfectly balanced with gentle notes of oak spice and rolling tobacco. The finish is warming and long with lingering notes of chocolate, cinnamon and toasted oak.

g-m-longmorn-1967.title: Gordon & MacPhail Longmorn 1967
g-m-longmorn-1967.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Longmorn 1967 is a long-aged single malt from Longmorn, the Speyside distillery whose rich, fruity spirit has long been a favourite of master blenders. Distilled in 1967, it was matured in a refill sherry butt and bottled by Gordon & MacPhail at 43% ABV. The bottling was recognised at the 2016 International Spirits Challenge as the Master of Speyside single malts aged over 31 years. Gentle sherry, ripe nectarine and marzipan open the nose; the palate begins sweet before warming ground black pepper, stewed fruit and citrus take over. A rare chance to taste a late-1960s Longmorn from one of Scotland's most respected independent bottlers.

Tasting Notes: Soft sherry, nectarine, marzipan, black pepper, stewed fruit, citrus.

Nose: Soft and delicate sweet sherry with ripe nectarine and a hint of marzipan.

Palate: Sweet at first with warming ground black pepper, then stewed fruit and citrus.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass at room temperature; add a few drops of water to open it up if you like.

port-ellen-37-year-old-55-2.title: Port Ellen 37 Year Old 55.2%
port-ellen-37-year-old-55-2.bodyHtml:
Port Ellen 37 Year Old was part of Diageo's Special Releases 2016 and, at the time, the oldest bottling ever released from the closed Port Ellen distillery on Islay. Distilled in 1978, it matured in refill American oak hogsheads and refill European oak butts, and only 2,940 individually numbered bottles were filled. Bottled at 55.2% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it pairs gentle smoke with layers of sweet wood, smoked meat, citrus and toffee.

Tasting Notes: Hessian, honey-cured smoked meat, mint, citrus, treacle toffee and wood smoke.

Nose: Faint smoke growing sweet with hessian and warm wood, then honey-cured smoked meats, sweet mint and sharp citrus, finally dark cocoa, vanilla and more wood smoke.

Palate: Wood ash, jam tarts, treacle toffee and caramelised orange, with smoke throughout.

Finish: Long and cooling, with toffee apple and wood smoke.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water if desired.

reyka-small-batch-vodka.title: Grumpy Bastard Vodka 1.75L
reyka-small-batch-vodka.bodyHtml:
Grumpy Bastard Vodka is an unflavoured vodka from Copper Cork Distillery, a locally owned craft distillery on the main street of Vermilion, Alberta. Copper Cork began as a far-fetched idea among four Alberta friends and grew into a full-fledged distillery producing a line of small-batch spirits, with its copper still on view behind the bar of the rustic, antique-styled tasting room. Grumpy Bastard is the distillery's house vodka, bottled at 40% ABV and offered here in the 1.75 L size, a practical choice for highballs and mixed drinks.

Serve: Over ice with soda and lime, in a Caesar, or with your favourite mixer.

rolling-rock-3.title: Lokoya Howell Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
rolling-rock-3.bodyHtml:
Traveling the road on an 1100cc American motorcycle with the engine’s low rumble and vibration under you, the wind in your face, and the feeling of power and acceleration in your grip—that’s how the 2018 Howell Mountain feels on the palate. With its low rumbling tannins, its depth of flavor, and its power-driven mouthfeel, you’ll be singing ‘Born to be Wild’ with each sip. This powerful Cabernet Sauvignon offers an ideal balance of acid and middle body weight.Blackberry, sourdough toast, crushed stone, and a little herb shine through in an intense depth of flavor.
96 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain was aged in French oak barrels for 22 months, 97% new. Deep garnet-purple colored, it rolls effortlessly out of the glass with notes of warm cassis, black cherries, mulberries and plum preserves plus hints of dark chocolate, crushed rock and tree bark with a waft of truffles. The full-bodied palate is densely laden with earthy/savory black fruit layers and super firm, rugged tannins, delivering a tightly wound, lively finish. Give it a good 5 years in bottle and drink it over the next 20+ years.
Rating: 96(+)

g-m-glen-grant-1952.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glen Grant 1952 70 Year Old 52.3% ABV
g-m-glen-grant-1952.bodyHtml:
On 26th January 1952, Mr George Urquhart filled spirit from Glen Grant distillery into our own bespoke casks. A few weeks later, Queen Elizabeth II acceded to the throne of the United Kingdom and became head of the Commonwealth. Through her seven decade reign there has been much change within the UK, but the cask laid down by George quietly slumbered in the corner of a warehouse in Elgin, Scotland.


Bottled on the 6th February 2022, the anniversary of the Queen’s

Platinum Jubilee, this whisky is an example of how character, resilience and wisdom can mature over decades to bring about something exceptional.


Notes of beeswax polish give way to ripe fig aromas, toffee and orange zest. Aged leather tempers rum and raisin. Stewed blackberry compote, sweet clementine and rich chocolate chocolate flavours are followed by a menthol overtone. A long finish with a touch of smoke and a hint of pepper.

menage-a-trois-gold-chardonnay.title: Ménage à Trois Red Blend
menage-a-trois-gold-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Ménage à Trois Red Blend is a famously approachable, lush, and unapologetically fruit-driven California red blend originally created to challenge traditional winemaking conventions by uniting three distinct grape varieties. Sourced from sun-drenched vineyards across California's prime growing regions, each varietal is fermented separately to preserve its individual character and aromatics before being harmoniously blended prior to bottling. In the glass, it displays a vibrant, deep ruby-garnet core. The expressive bouquet offers aromas of ripe blackberry jam, dark cherry compote, and crushed raspberries, layered with warm vanilla, mocha, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, plush texture marked by rounded, silky tannins, generous berry sweetness, and gentle acidity, culminating in a soft, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Barbecue pulled pork sliders, grilled burgers, pepperoni pizza, glazed ribs, roasted chicken, or rich dark chocolate brownies.

moosehead-pale-ale-1.title: Moosehead Canadian Lager 24 Cans
moosehead-pale-ale-1.bodyHtml:
Moosehead Lager is Canada’s iconic, independent lager brewed by Canada's oldest independent brewery, Moosehead Breweries Limited in Saint John, New Brunswick. Brewed using a classic lager recipe with 100% Canadian 2-row malted barley, pure water, and a double-fermentation process, this pale lager delivers a finely balanced balance between sweet maltiness and mild hop bitterness. It is clean, crisp, and refreshing, making it an accessible and timeless Canadian classic.

Food Pairing: Grilled burgers, fish and chips, barbecue chicken, soft pretzels with mustard, and mild cheeses like young cheddar or Colby.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden straw yellow in color with a clear appearance and a light, crisp, and effervescent mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and clean with notes of sweet grain, light corn, subtle malted barley, and a faint touch of grassy floral hops.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with light malt sweetness, soft cereal grains, and a crisp, gentle hop bitterness that cleanses the palate.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing with a crisp, dry finish and slight lingering grain notes.

Serve : Serve well-chilled at 38–42°F (3–5°C) directly from the bottle or poured into a classic pilsner or pint glass.

two-oceans-duo-gift-pack.title: Two Oceans Duo Gift Pack 2 X 750ml
two-oceans-duo-gift-pack.bodyHtml: This gift pack includes a bottle of the winery's flagship Cabernet Sauvignon/Merlot blend with ripe berry notes and their fine Sauvignon Blanc showing crisp, citrus and melon flavours.

tomatin-warehouse-collection-1971.title: Tomatin Warehouse Collection 1971 45.8% ABV
tomatin-warehouse-collection-1971.bodyHtml:
The first release of this refined and rare collection of Tomatin single malt was filled on August 7, 1971, and was soon singled out as our most special exclusive whisky. Lying undisturbed in Warehouse 6 the precious spirit gently matured in a hand-selected Spanish Oloroso Sherry cask, developing natural, subtle fruit tones.  Time – indeed four and a half decades of watchful waiting by the cask’s custodians – has seen this exclusive expression instilled with great depth and rich flavours. 

Forty-four years after it was declared extraordinary by his forebears, distillery manager, Graham Eunson, believes Cask No. 30041 to be at its peak

CASK NUMBER - 30041
DISTILLED ON - 7 August 1971
BOTTLED ON - 16 May 2016
STRENGTH - 45.8% alc./vol.
CASK TYPE - Spanish Oloroso Sherry
BOTTLES - 252 Bottles

wild-rose-ponderosa-gose-1.title: Wild Rose Ponderosa Gose 4 Tall Cans

stanley-park-noble-pilsner-1.title: Stanley Park Trail Hopper Ipa 6 Cans

stanley-park-windstorm-pale-ale.title: Stanley Park Waypoint Hazy Pale Ale 6 Cans
stanley-park-windstorm-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Stanley Park Waypoint Hazy Pale Ale 6 Cans

dalmore-constellation-1991-cask-27.title: The Dalmore Constellation 20 Year Old 1991 #27
dalmore-constellation-1991-cask-27.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore Constellation 20 Year Old 1991 #27 is an exceptional Highland single malt Scotch whisky from the prestigious Constellation Collection. Distilled on April 16, 1991, this limited single-cask release spent 17 years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before a further three years in Amoroso Oloroso sherry butts. Bottled at natural cask strength of 56.6% ABV, with only 761 bottles produced, it delivers remarkable depth, balancing rich dark chocolate, roasted nuts, tropical fruit, and warming spice.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, roasted hazelnuts, aged cheddar, caramel desserts, dried figs, and rich fruitcake.

Tasting Notes: Rich and complex, combining roasted nuts, dark chocolate, dried fruits, tropical sweetness, and warming spice.

Nose: Roasted hazelnuts, Colombian coffee, fresh dates, cigar tobacco, mulled wine, dark chocolate, raisins, and black toffee.

Palate: Muscovado sugar, Demerara sweetness, crushed almonds, ripe pineapple, coconut, maple syrup, tangerine, and liquorice.

Finish: Long and warming, with lingering dark chocolate, caramelized sugar, roasted nuts, and gentle oak spice.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature. Allow the whisky to develop in the glass, adding a few drops of water if desired.

mission-hill-estate-series-pinot-noir.title: Mission Hill Family Estate Reserve Merlot 2022
mission-hill-estate-series-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Mission Hills's 2022 Reserve Merlot was grown in two of our estate vineyards. Osoyoos, the region’s most southern area, is comprised of arid benchlands that benefit from the lake’s effect providing the region with more than 200 frost-free days. This warm climate allows our Bordeaux varietals to completely ripen for full flavour. The Oliver Vineyard estate is a diverse vineyard with more than 60 different individual blocks, affording us an amazing array of premium quality fruit.

On this nose, this wine displays a rich bouquet of wild blackberry and red plum complemented by subtle notes of cedar and mocha. On the palate, this vintage reveals a blend of ripe fruit and earthy undertones, finishing with a smooth, velvety texture.

lonetree-pear-apple-cider.title: Lonetree Ginger Apple 6 Cans
lonetree-pear-apple-cider.bodyHtml: We believe the old ways are still the best. That's why we always use genuine apples to craft our authentic cider selections. Now, we've added a zesty twist of real ginger, for an exotic and lightly spicy cider experience. We know you'll taste the difference. This cider is crafted with locally sourced genuine apples, making it naturally gluten-free.

port-ellen-37-year-old-51.title: Port Ellen 37 Year Old 51%
port-ellen-37-year-old-51.bodyHtml:
Port Ellen 37 Year Old is the 17th Port Ellen bottling in Diageo's Special Releases, distilled in 1979 at the closed distillery on the Isle of Islay and released in 2017. Drawn from refill American oak hogsheads and butts, it was limited to 2,988 individually numbered bottles and shares the title of oldest Port Ellen released to that date. Bottled at 51% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Whisky Advocate awarded it 93 points.

Tasting Notes: Cut grass, ripe pear, smoked fish, bonfire, spicy peat and peaches in syrup.

Nose: Fresh-mown grass, ripe pears and damp tweed, then smoked fish and bonfire aromas.

Palate: Oily, with spicy peat, barbecued meat and peaches in syrup.

Finish: Very long, smoky and earthy, with a hint of chili and drying tannins.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water if desired.

brora-34-year-old-51-9.title: Brora 34 Year Old 1982 Special Release 2017
brora-34-year-old-51-9.bodyHtml:
Brora 34 Year Old is a single malt from the long-closed Brora distillery in the Scottish Highlands, released by Diageo as part of its 2017 Special Releases. Distilled in 1982 and matured in refill American oak, it was the 16th Brora in the Special Releases series and was limited to 3,000 bottles. Bottled at 51.9% ABV, it shows the waxy texture Brora is known for, set against maritime and mineral notes, fruit, pepper and soft barrel-char smoke. This 750ml bottle is a rare release from a distillery Diageo has announced it will reopen.

Nose: Maritime and mineral, with dried seaweed, cider apples and green leaves on a faintly waxy base.

Palate: Waxy and sharp at first, with fruit, chili and black pepper, then dark chocolate and soft barrel-char smoke.

Finish: Aniseed spice fading to sweet-spicy oak, with a last burst of black pepper and fruit.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water to open it up.

convalmore-32-year-old-48-2.title: Convalmore 32 Year Old 1984 Special Releases 2017
convalmore-32-year-old-48-2.bodyHtml:
Convalmore 32 Year Old is a 1984 vintage single malt released in Diageo's Special Releases programme of 2017. Convalmore was a Speyside distillery near Dufftown that opened in 1897, survived a fire in 1909 and closed in 1985, so this bottling comes from one of the last years of production at a lost distillery. Bottled at 48.2% ABV, here in a 750ml bottle, it shows the classic old-style Speyside profile: waxy and oily with orchard fruit, then a rich, layered palate of fruit and spice. A collector's whisky and a rare chance to taste a silent distillery.

Tasting Notes: Melted candle wax, orchard fruits, dried apricot and old leather.

Nose: Bold and slightly oily, with soft wax, orchard fruits, peach, caramel and a leathery note.

Palate: Rich fruit and spice, fruit cake, candied orange peel, tropical fruit and toasted brioche.

Finish: Long and balanced, with a tangy sweetness.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water if desired.

port-dundas-52-year-old-44-6.title: Port Dundas 52 Year Old 44.6%
port-dundas-52-year-old-44-6.bodyHtml:
Port Dundas 52 Year Old 1964 Special Release 2017 is a single grain Scotch whisky distilled at Port Dundas in 1964 and released in Diageo's Special Releases series in 2017, after more than half a century in refill American oak hogsheads. Only 752 bottles were released, at 44.6% ABV; this is the 750ml bottle. Whisky Advocate rated it 90 points, describing a nose of rich toffee, weighty oak, allspice, dried apple and banana chips, a palate of red apple ripening into gumdrops, golden syrup, lime zest, caramel and vanilla, and a finish of nutmeg, oak and apple peel.

Tasting Notes: Toffee, oak, red apple, golden syrup, caramel, nutmeg.

Nose: Rich toffee, weighty oak, allspice, dried apple and banana chips.

Palate: Red apple, gumdrops, golden syrup, lime zest, caramel and vanilla.

Finish: Nutmeg, oak and apple peel.

Serve: Neat.

woodford-reserve-w-rock-glasses.title: Woodford Reserve Bourbon Gift Pack With Rocks Glasses
woodford-reserve-w-rock-glasses.bodyHtml:
The art of making fine bourbon first took place on the site of the Woodford Reserve Distillery, a National Historic Landmark, in 1812. The perfectly balanced taste of our Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is comprised of more than 200 detectable flavor notes, from bold grain and wood, to sweet aromatics, spice, and fruit & floral notes.

Full-bodied , rounded and smooth, with notes of toffee, citrus, cinnamon, and cocoa, with a long warm finish, the classic Woodford Reserve Bourbon comes with a premium tumbler glass.

1573-national-cellar-53.title: National Cellar 1573 Guojiao Baijiu 500ml
1573-national-cellar-53.bodyHtml:
Guojiao 1573 is a commemorative baijiu product specially made in honour of 1573 National Treasures Cellars which is included in the UN preliminary list as the world’s tangible cultural heritage and the traditional brewing craftsmanship of Luzhou Laojiao liquor as the world’s intangible heritage; it’s the highest level for protection of Chinese cultural heritage - and it’s also the greatest representative of Chinese traditional culture and craftsmanship which passed on over centuries.

National Cellar 1573 is a commemorative spirit, a strong aroma baijiu made in honor of 1573 National Treasures Cellars listed as a National Key Cultural Relic in 1996 and the traditional brewing craftsmanship of Luzhou Laojiao liquor honored as China’s Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2006. Made in 1573 National Treasures Cellars of 430 years old, applying traditional craftsmanship passing on twenty-two generations, it is a representative of national cultural heritage and intangible heritage. This rare spirit is ready for your celebration!

benromach-heritage-1977.title: Benromach Cask Strength Vintage 2014 Batch 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
benromach-heritage-1977.bodyHtml:
Benromach Cask Strength Vintage 2014 Batch 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a limited-release Speyside single malt distilled in 2014 and bottled in 2024 at its natural cask strength of 60.6% ABV. Matured for a decade exclusively in first-fill Sherry and bourbon casks, this powerful expression combines rich fruitcake character with stewed fruit, warming spice, toasted oak and Benromach's distinctive smoky character. It is bottled at natural colour and without chill filtration.

Food Pairing: Pair with smoked beef, glazed pork ribs, mature cheddar, dark chocolate, fruitcake or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and concentrated with fruitcake, stewed plum, marmalade, warming spice, toasted oak and lingering smoke.

Nose: Sweet vanilla leads into fruitcake, brown sugar and spicy ginger, followed by cinnamon, milk chocolate and oak.

Palate: Creamy and spicy with stewed plum, Seville orange and cracked black pepper, developing toasted oak and subtle liquorice.

Finish: Long and full with lingering smoke and a touch of aniseed.

woodford-reserve-double-oaked-duty-free.title: Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Bourbon
woodford-reserve-double-oaked-duty-free.bodyHtml:
Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Bourbon is an innovative, twice-barreled Kentucky straight bourbon produced at the Woodford Reserve Distillery in Versailles, Kentucky. First matured in handcrafted new white oak barrels, the bourbon is then transferred to a second, heavily toasted and lightly charred oak barrel for additional aging, extracting deep notes of dark caramel, hazelnut, apple, and rich oak spice.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, crème brûlée, pecan pie, smoked brisket, or blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber to dark copper in appearance with a rich, heavy, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich notes of dark fruit, caramel, honey, chocolate, marzipan, and toasted oak.

Palate : Full-bodied with layers of vanilla, dark caramel, hazelnut, apple, sweet baking spices, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, creamy, and lingering with notes of warm oak spice, honey, and subtle apple.

Serve : Serve neat, over a large ice cube, or as an elevated modifier in a classic Old Fashioned.

glenfarclas-family-cask-1969-rel-s16.title: Glenfarclas The Family Casks 1969 Refill Butt Cask 2451 Summer 2016 Release
glenfarclas-family-cask-1969-rel-s16.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas The Family Casks 1969 is a single cask Highland single malt from the Summer 2016 release of the Grant family's celebrated vintage series. Distilled in 1969 at Glenfarclas in Speyside, it matured in a refill butt, cask 2451, before being bottled on 25 July 2016 at 56.1% ABV; just 387 bottles of 700ml were filled. The Family Casks exist thanks to George S. Grant, who chose to lay down mature stock for the distillery's own bottlings instead of relying on blenders, so Glenfarclas now holds casks from eight decades. Owned by the Grant family since 1865 and still independent, the distillery sits at the foot of Ben Rinnes and distils twice in direct-fired stills. Each bottle is presented in the series' wooden case.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a tulip glass; let it rest a few minutes before nosing and add a few drops of water only if wanted.

sandhill-terroir-driven-syrah.title: Sandhill Syrah
sandhill-terroir-driven-syrah.bodyHtml:
Sandhill Syrah is a full-bodied red with soft tannins and a juicy, rounded mouthfeel. Dark plum, blueberry, and blackberry aromas meet spice, smoky oak, and vanilla, while chocolate, ripe dark fruit, violet, roasted coffee bean, and fresh herbs carry through the lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with peppercorn steak, braised beef, short ribs, game meats, and aged Gouda.

xop-port-ellen-34yo.title: XOP Port Ellen 34 Year Old
xop-port-ellen-34yo.bodyHtml:
Port Ellen 34 Year Old 1982 is a single cask Islay single malt from Douglas Laing's Xtra Old Particular range. Distilled at the long-closed Port Ellen distillery in May 1982, it matured in a single refill hogshead (cask reference DL11481) before being bottled in November 2016. The cask yielded just 219 bottles at 48.5% ABV, making this a genuinely scarce example of one of Islay's most sought-after lost distilleries.

Nose: Chimney soot, juicy fruit and damp leather with a touch of spice.

Palate: Bonfire ash and sea air with candied fruit, golden syrup and sweet seaweed.

Finish: Long and elegant, with leather, earthy peat and brown sugar.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

xop-garnheath-43yo-single-grain.title: XOP Garnheath 43 Year Old Single Grain

xop-north-british-55y0-single-grain.title: XOP North British 55 Year Old Single Grain

whiskybase-glenrothes-1997.title: Whiskybase Glenrothes 1997
whiskybase-glenrothes-1997.bodyHtml:
Glenrothes 19 Year Old 1997 is a single cask Speyside single malt from an independent bottling. Distilled at Glenrothes in 1997, it matured for 19 years in sherry butt #15404 and was bottled in 2017 at a full cask strength of 58.8% ABV, as an outturn of 562 bottles in 700ml format. A long-aged, sherry-matured Glenrothes at natural strength, it suits a slow, considered pour.

Serve: Neat, adding a few drops of water to open it up at this strength.

sapporo-5.bodyHtml: Clear bright gold with light foamy head; malt, citrus and hop aromas; light to medium body, dry style; citrus and light hops for a clean refreshing finish.

village-neighbour-1.title: Armand Heitz Morey-Saint-Denis 1er Cru Monts Luisants 2021 750ml
village-neighbour-1.bodyHtml: Morey-Saint-Denis is a small village located between Gevrey-Chambertin and Chambolle-Musigny. The wines produced there have a strong identity that I really like. Morey-Saint-Denis also saw very recently the two largest families of world luxury put down their suitcases. The 1er Cru Les Monts-Luisants is a star climate of the village of Morey-Saint-Denis. Interspersed between the Clos de la roche and the Grand Cru Latricières-Chambertin, it is almost impossible to find better neighbors.
