granville-island-raspberry-ale.bodyHtml: Granville Island Brewing Lions Winter Ale 6 Cans

glenfarclas-family-cask-1982-rel-w17.title: Glenfarclas 'The Family Casks' 1982 Winter 2017 Cask 4565 Refill Hogshead
glenfarclas-family-cask-1982-rel-w17.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 'The Family Casks' 1982 is a single cask Highland single malt from the Winter 2017 release of the Grant family's celebrated vintage series, distilled and bottled at Glenfarclas Distillery on Speyside. Distilled in 1982, it matured in a refill hogshead (cask 4565) and was bottled on 8 November 2017, some 35 years later, at a cask strength of 52.4% ABV. Only 225 bottles of 700ml were filled from the cask. The Family Casks collection exists thanks to the foresight of George S Grant: Glenfarclas holds casks from the last eight decades, and each release captures the character of a single year in the distillery's history. Each bottle comes in the series' wooden presentation box, with the distillation year, cask number and bottling details printed on the label - a natural gift for a birth year or anniversary.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a nosing glass. Give it time in the glass and add water only a drop at a time, if at all.

st-lucia-premium-gold-bounty-rum.title: Admiral Rodney HMS Royal Oak Rum
st-lucia-premium-gold-bounty-rum.bodyHtml:
Admiral Rodney HMS Royal Oak is an aged rum from Saint Lucia, produced by Saint Lucia Distillers. Admiral Rodney is the distillery's super-premium range, and HMS Royal Oak is one of its aged expressions. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle and is made for slow sipping.

Serve: Neat or with a single large ice cube.

med-hat-patio-tart-cherry.title: Med Hat Patio Tart Cherry 6 Cans

wild-turkey-kentucky-spirit-priv-barrel.title: Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Bourbon
wild-turkey-kentucky-spirit-priv-barrel.bodyHtml:
Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a legendary, high-proof American masterpiece that has stood as the flagship expression of the distillery for over 60 years. Crafted by the iconic father-and-son Master Distiller team, Jimmy and Eddie Russell, it utilizes Wild Turkey’s signature high-rye mashbill and is distilled at a lower proof to retain maximum flavor. Aged in the deepest No. 4 "alligator" char American white oak barrels, it is bottled at an explicit 101 proof, delivering an uncompromisingly bold, rich, and spicy character that remains a benchmark for real Kentucky bourbon.

Food Pairing: Rich barbecue burnt ends, smoked venison or beef jerky, mature extra-sharp cheddar, or dark chocolate pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber and burnished copper hue with a bold, rich, and medium-to-full body on the palate.

Nose : Intense aromas of sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, honey, baking spices, and subtle orange peel.

Palate : Full-flavored and dynamic with upfront notes of sweet vanilla, rich caramel, toasted oak, rye spice, cinnamon, and a touch of dark chocolate.

Finish : Long, warm, and spicy with lingering notes of bold oak, baking spice, and a distinctive orange zest tail.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks with a single large ice cube, or as a robust base in classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned or Boulevardier.

canmore-brewing-misty-mountain-hops-neip.title: Canmore Brewing Misty Mountain Hops Neip 4 Tall Cans
canmore-brewing-misty-mountain-hops-neip.bodyHtml: Canmore Brewing Misty Mountain Hops Neip 4 Tall Cans

masseto-2015-1-5l.title: Masseto Tuscany 2015 1.5L Magnum
masseto-2015-1-5l.bodyHtml:
The particularly regular vintage, along with an ideal temperature during the harvest, is reflected in a classic Masseto, with a perfect balance between a mature, yet complex, aromatic expression of great freshness and a rare quality of ample, silky and smooth tannins. The dark and intense colour is followed by a rich aroma with hints of fully ripe red fruit and spicy, balsamic and cocoa notes. In the mouth it becomes sensual and rich, with great density and an ample and perfectly smooth tannin. The fruity notes are underlined by the subtle presence of oak – terminating in a fresh and vivid finish with pronounced hints of cocoa.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The release of this wine comes at a very happy time for the Masseto brand. The stunning 2015 Masseto is hitting the market just as the final touches are being made to the new Masseto winery. I'm told that Masseto might one day see other wines made under that same roof, so we can't exclude a future enlargement of the Masseto portfolio. The Masseto vineyard now covers seven hectares (divided into three plots), and the vines range from 30 to 40 years old. The wine is absolutely teeming with sensorial spirit that is transmitted through the bounty of the bouquet and the solid tannins of the mouthfeel. Nothing about the wine goes unnoticed or unchecked. Its many working pieces fit together with precision like a well-oiled machine. The 2015 vintage is characterized by a level of sheer exuberance that also defined the 2004 and 2007 vintages. Yet, it also reveals similar power, directness and linearity that we saw in the 2010 vintage. The 2015 Masseto takes the best of all those past vintages and confines those qualities to this single, spectacular bottle.

99 Points - James Suckling

The aromas are profound here with a deep and vast character of black olives, cedar, chocolate and berries, as well as vanilla essence and light coffee. Flamboyant. Full-bodied, this powerful young Masseto is chewy, muscular and rich. Dusty tannins, yet wonderfully polished. A wine for the cellar. Try in 2022.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

This red leads off with exquisite notes of vanilla and toast, framing black cherry, blackberry, cedar and iron flavors. Ripe and powerful, yet polished and silky, with dense tannins well-integrated into the structure. The fruit returns in the end, along with a licorice note. A superb young version, showing fine potential. Merlot. Best from 2021 through 2035.

carlsberg-lager-1.title: Carlsberg 6 Bottles
carlsberg-lager-1.bodyHtml: Carlsberg is a classic Danish pilsner known for its well-balanced and refreshing taste. Brewed since 1847, this iconic beer is characterized by its crisp hop bitterness, subtle malt sweetness, and a clean, smooth finish. Its distinctive flavor profile makes it a globally recognized and perfectly sessionable European lager.

bruichladdich-islay-barley.title: Bruichladdich Islay Barley 8 Year Old 2013
bruichladdich-islay-barley.bodyHtml:
Showcasing the permanence of our commitment to barley provenance, this Bruichladdich Islay Barley 2013 is our eighth edition of unpeated, locally grown single malt. Fully traceable and high provenance with honeyed porridge and lemon meringue pie notes, it evokes a true sense of place.

For almost two decades now, we have shown the permanence of our commitment to barley provenance. Aided by the determination of our farming partners, this Bruichladdich Islay Barley 2013 is our eighth edition of unpeated, locally grown single malt.

While each expression from the individual growing season is subtly nuanced, a signature maritime-citrus, barley forward style has developed in these complex single malts.

Our newest vintage of unpeated Bruichladdich Islay Barley features the harvest from the 2012 growing season, later distilled in 2013.

The crop was raised across seven island farms, by Hunter Jackson at Cruach, Andrew and Donald Jones at Coull, Mark French at Rockside, Ian McKerrell at Island, Alistair Torrance at Mulindry, Raymond Fletcher at Dunlossit and Raymond Stewart at Sunderland.

The resulting spirit was matured in a combination of ex-American and ex-European oak casks for eight aged years.

bruichladdich-octomore-9-3.title: Bruichladdich Octomore 9.3
bruichladdich-octomore-9-3.bodyHtml:
The Octomore 9.3 was produced from barley grown on "Irene's field on Octomore farm", peated to 133 parts per million and was matured predominantly in refill ex-Bourbon casks. Bottled at 62.9%.

Just 52 tonnes of precious Islay barley were malted to produce this single farm Octomore 09.3 edition. Raised in Irene’s Field on Octomore Farm in 2011, this uber-provenance single malt was later distilled and filled into 134 casks. Predominantly second-fill, the gentler influence of the wood allows more of the locally grown barley flavours to cut through the legendary peat smoke.

Distiller's Tasting Note

Character: Wild, Ileach, if this whisky could speak it would only speak in Gaelic. Atlantic coast raised. Out on the edge, the sense of place is strong.

Aroma: Malted barley, Horlicks, the smell of the mash going into the mashtun. Heather wildfire, black tea, golden syrup, lemon sponge.

Taste: Golden syrup in the tin, smoked tea, wort, malted barley, pear, peach melba. Sea spray, heather flowers.

Finish: Smoke, toasted oak, rye bread, salt, ozone.

g-m-strathisla-collection.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Strathisla Collection 6 x

g-m-glen-grant-1965.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glen Grant 1965 54 Year Old
g-m-glen-grant-1965.bodyHtml:
Made at Glen Grant distillery in 1965, this Speyside single malt has been matured in a single sherry hogshead for 54 years, before being bottled in March 2019 by independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail, as a part of its Private Collection.

TASTING NOTES

A basket laden with windfall apples. Aromas of clementine and vibrant orange sit upon intense polished oak. Touches of vanilla begin to come through with flashes of nutmeg and cinnamon. Sweetness working in harmony with dashes of white pepper. Delicate herbal elements remain. Slowly fading into eucalyptus.

benromach-1978.title: Benromach Cask Strength Vintage 2014 Batch 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
benromach-1978.bodyHtml:
Benromach Cask Strength Vintage 2014 Batch 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a limited-release Speyside single malt distilled in 2014 and bottled in 2024 at its natural cask strength of 60.6% ABV. Matured for a decade exclusively in first-fill Sherry and bourbon casks, this powerful expression combines rich fruitcake character with stewed fruit, warming spice, toasted oak and Benromach's distinctive smoky character. It is bottled at natural colour and without chill filtration.

Food Pairing: Pair with smoked beef, glazed pork ribs, mature cheddar, dark chocolate, fruitcake or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and concentrated with fruitcake, stewed plum, marmalade, warming spice, toasted oak and lingering smoke.

Nose: Sweet vanilla leads into fruitcake, brown sugar and spicy ginger, followed by cinnamon, milk chocolate and oak.

Palate: Creamy and spicy with stewed plum, Seville orange and cracked black pepper, developing toasted oak and subtle liquorice.

Finish: Long and full with lingering smoke and a touch of aniseed.

grizzly-paw-three-sisters-pale.title: Grizzly Paw Three Sisters Pale 4 Tall Cans
grizzly-paw-three-sisters-pale.bodyHtml: Grizzly Paw Three Sisters Pale 4 Tall Cans

tomatin-warehouse-collection-1972.title: Tomatin Warehouse Collection 1972 42.1% ABV
tomatin-warehouse-collection-1972.bodyHtml:
Cask numbers 23404, 23405 and 23406 have been lying peacefully in Warehouse 6 since being filled on November 20, 1972, gently and slowly maturing this exclusive whiskywithin.

Over time – indeed over four decades of watchful waiting by the casks’ custodians – the spirit has given way to the angels who have claimed more than their fair share.

Having waited patiently for the perfect moment to catch this spirit in its prime, our distillery men have captured the heart of the distillery in this bottling.

In perfect harmony, aromas of autumn fruits, golden syrup and bursts of summer meadow wildflowers meet soft flavours of sweet almond, brown sugar, coffee and winter spices before a full, oily finish.

CASK NUMBER - 23404, 23405 & 23406
DISTILLED ON - 20 November 1972
BOTTLED ON - 10 February 2014
STRENGTH - 42.1% alc./vol.
CASK TYPE - Sherry Hogsheads
BOTTLES - 380 Bottles

screaming-eagle-the-flight.title: Screaming Eagle The Flight 2018
screaming-eagle-the-flight.bodyHtml:
Screaming Eagle The Flight 2018 presents a deep garnet-purple or dark ruby colour. The nose is extraordinarily perfumed and aromatic, leading with violets, lavender, and crushed flowers layered with wild herbs, graphite, and cedarwood spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and refined, featuring a 'crunchy' energy and purity of red berry fruit—redolent of cranberry, raspberry, and mulberry—alongside dark cherry and blackberry preserves. It is characterized by its silkier texture and tantalizing acidity compared to the flagship, with fine-grained tannins and a mineral core that opens into notes of blood orange, star anise, and spearmint. The finish is long, polished, and sanguine, often revealing hints of black truffle. This blend consists of 64% Merlot and 36% Cabernet Sauvignon, with an ABV of 14.7%. The wine is not certified organic, though the estate is farmed with meticulous care. The optimal drinking window is from 2024 through 2050.

100 Points - James Suckling

This is an incredible wine with such depth and energy and ethereal, mind-blowing sensibility. It sent shivers down my spine tasting it. It just shines on the nose, like bright sunlight breaking through a dark sky. Aromas of raspberries, citrus, violets and dark earth. Full-bodied with extremely fine tannins that go vertical and endless, from top to bottom. A monument for merlot-based wines.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Medium to deep garnet-purple colored, the 2018 The Flight drifts sensuously out of the glass with the most gorgeous perfume of red roses, kirsch, black raspberries and fresh blackcurrants followed by hints of iron ore, tilled soil, lavender and star anise plus a touch of powdered cinnamon. Medium to full-bodied, the palate has a fantastically chiseled structure of ripe, grainy tannins and bold freshness supporting the black fruit and floral layers, finishing with bags of minerals.

wild-rose-industrial-park-ale-2.title: Wild Rose Industrial Park Ale 4 Tall Cans
wild-rose-industrial-park-ale-2.bodyHtml: A beautiful copper-coloured ale, rich in caramel malt character and well balanced with plenty of hops; handcrafted for the true ale drinker. We recognize the birthplace of our brewery in Calgary’s Foothills Industrial Park with this time-honoured recipe for a well-balanced IPA .

mt-begbie-cream-ale.title: Mt. Begbie Cream Ale 4 Tall Cans

g-m-pc1-glenrothes-1974.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glenrothes 1974 49.5% ABV
g-m-pc1-glenrothes-1974.bodyHtml:
A sister release to the Inverleven is this 43 year old gem from Glenrothes, matured in a refill Sherry Puncheon with an outturn of just 276 bottles. Showing spectacular colour, this promises all you'd expect and more from a Glenrothes at such a venerable age.

Colour: Mahogany. Aroma: Complex; aromas of sherry soaked fruitcake filled with stewed sultanas mingle with sticky medjool dates. Dark chocolate and citrus peel notes develop; a gentle woodiness with a delicate herbal edge comes to the fore. Taste: Elegant, smooth, and sweet; subtle cinnamon and nutmeg flavours balance the mature oak and sherry influences. Notes of fruit and nut chocolate, toasted walnut, and hint of raisin emerge and evolve into zesty citrus. Salted toffee develops towards the end. Finish: A modest, medium sweet finish fades; hints of charred oak and chocolate remain. 49.5% Alc./Vol.

port-askaig-45-yr-islay-single-malt.title: Port Askaig 45 Year Old Islay Single Malt
port-askaig-45-yr-islay-single-malt.bodyHtml:
A very rare example of Islay whisky at this age. Distilled in 1968, this is a combination of five sherry butts, which were married together for the final year. An exceptionally complex whisky that any Islay fan will savor.

Producer's Tasting Notes

NOSE

Even before you taste this, your senses are filled with full, thick, ripe fruit and heavy, sweet, sticky nectar. A touch of menthol gives a clue to the long ageing of this whisky.

PALATE

Rich Navel oranges and fleshy mango sit on a thick and warming palate, with flavours reminiscent of green tea, mint leaves and tropical fruit. The flavours are incredibly well balanced with elegance and poise.

FINISH

Clean and long with carefully balanced minerality.

tags: Tuff City Brewery O/A Tofino Brewing

g-m-strathisla-1949.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Strathisla 1949
g-m-strathisla-1949.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Strathisla 1949 is a remarkably old Speyside single malt, distilled in 1949 and matured in a sherry butt for 57 years before being bottled in 2006 at 40% ABV. Strathisla is the oldest continuously operating distillery in Scotland, founded in 1786 and famous for its twin pagoda roofs and cobbled courtyard; much of its spirit goes into Chivas Regal. Gordon & MacPhail of Elgin, one of Scotland's oldest independent bottlers, laid down this spirit in its own cask, and bottlings of this age from a working distillery are seldom seen. Presented in a 700ml bottle, it is a whisky for collectors and for marking a truly special occasion.

Nose: Sweet, floral and perfumed, with spice and a slightly oily edge.

Palate: Opens with peat and smoke, then grows fruity with grapes and raisins over sherry-cask depth.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, with time in the glass to open.

g-m-strathisla-1960.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Strathisla 1960
g-m-strathisla-1960.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Strathisla 1960 is a 54 year old Speyside single malt, matured in sherry butts and bottled in 2014 at 43% ABV. Strathisla is the oldest continuously operating distillery in Scotland, founded in 1786 and famous for its twin pagoda roofs and cobbled courtyard; much of its spirit goes into Chivas Regal. After more than half a century in wood this is a deeply sherried, silky dram, built on sweet wine, rum-and-raisin and brown sugar notes with prunes and fruitcake. Very few bottles of this vintage reached Canada. 700ml.

Nose: Sweet wine, rum and raisin, rich brown sugar and prunes; water adds cigar box.

Palate: Silky and sweet, heavily sherried, with fruitcake and brown sugar.

Finish: Long and smooth.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

nutrl-vodka-soda-7-blackberry.title: Nutrl 7% Vodka Soda Berries 12Cans
nutrl-vodka-soda-7-blackberry.bodyHtml: A refreshingly simple vodka soda with 7% alc./vol. Made with just three ingredients - vodka, soda, and natural flavour and containing 0g of sugar and carbs per 355mL can

g-m-strathisla-1953.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Strathisla 1953
g-m-strathisla-1953.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Strathisla 1953 is a single sherry butt of Speyside single malt, filled on 19 December 1953 and bottled on 21 November 2012 at 43% ABV, after almost six decades in the cask. Strathisla is the oldest continuously operating distillery in Scotland, founded in 1786 and famous for its twin pagoda roofs and cobbled courtyard; much of its spirit goes into Chivas Regal. This bottling is distinct from the later 2019 Private Collection release of the same vintage. Scored 85 points by Whisky Fun. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, with a few minutes in the glass before tasting.

michelob-ultra-keg.title: Michelob Ultra 710ml Can
michelob-ultra-keg.bodyHtml:
Michelob Ultra is a light lager produced by Anheuser-Busch, engineered to appeal to active and health-conscious consumers. First introduced in 2002, it features a lower carbohydrate and calorie count than traditional lagers, offering a clean, crisp, and refreshingly light taste with subtle citrus notes and a bright, effervescent carbonation.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken salad, fresh ceviche, light fish tacos, sushi, steamed seafood, and mild goat cheese.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant pale straw yellow in appearance with a thin white head and a light, crisp, and highly carbonated mouthfeel.

Nose : Subtle and clean with gentle notes of sweet malt, light rice, and a faint hint of citrus hops.

Palate : Exceptionally light and refreshing, featuring clean cereal grain, a touch of cracker malt sweetness, and minimal hop bitterness.

Finish : Very short, crisp, and clean with zero lingering aftertaste and a dry, fizzy close.

Serve : Serve ice-cold directly from the bottle or can, or poured into a chilled pilsner glass.

philippe-gavignet-nuits-saint-georges-vv.title: Domaine Philippe Gavignet Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru Aux Thorey 2021
philippe-gavignet-nuits-saint-georges-vv.bodyHtml:
A structured Burgundy Pinot Noir showing blackcurrant, blueberry, cherry, licorice, floral nuances, and subtle spice. Fine tannins and pronounced minerality give the palate impressive depth and freshness, while careful barrel aging contributes complexity and a long, saline finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast beef, coq au vin, duck, veal, game, mushroom dishes, brie, camembert, or other soft cheeses.

aquarelle-passionfruit.title: Giffard Creme de Fruits de la Passion (Passion Fruit)
aquarelle-passionfruit.bodyHtml: Passion fruit is a climbing plant of the Passifloraceae family, native to Latin America. Also called granadilla, this fruit is a small tropical berry with fragrant flesh that differs from other fruits by its small black seeds. Giffard Crème de Fruit de la Passion brings the flavour of this fruit to cocktails with exotic accents.

tomatin-50-year-old-1.title: Tomatin 50 Year Old 44% ABV
tomatin-50-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
This exceptional whisky is securely encased within an individually numbered, handblown Glencairn crystal decanter. The decanter is luxuriously presented within a striking Italian crafted wooden box, furnished with soft, premium Italian leather. Sealed with a wooden transit cork, an engraved, solid brass and gold plated glass stopper is also provided. Finally, a premium leather carry bag completes the presentation.

Tasting notes by Master Distiller, Graham Eunson:
In true celebratory fashion, this single malt is bursting with aroma. Dried tropical fruits are first to greet the nose before a mix of nuts, dark chocolate and honey. Much like the history of Tomatin itself, the palate is slow to open with gentle hints of fresh orange and apricot, it then becomes more intense with notes of dried fruit and spices before a wave of Oloroso Sherry driven flavours. The flavour recedes, leaving an elegant, rich sweetness to linger.

CASK NUMBER - 30040
DISTILLED ON - 7th August 1971
BOTTLED ON - 8th June 2022
STRENGTH - 44% alc./vol.
CASK TYPE - 1st Fill Oloroso Sherry Hogshead
BOTTLES - 125 Bottles

woodford-reserve-derby-edition.title: Woodford Reserve Bourbon Kentucky Derby Edition 1L
woodford-reserve-derby-edition.bodyHtml:
Woodford Reserve, the Presenting Sponsor of the Kentucky Derby honors “The Greatest Two Minutes in Sports” with the release of this commemorative Derby bottle.

This year’s special release celebrates the 50th anniversary of one of the most iconic moments in sports history – Secretariat winning the 1973 Derby, still the fastest at 1:59 2/5.

The bottle features the artwork of Kentucky native Jaime Corum, known for her stunning horse portraits. Her painting captures Secretariat in the Winner’s Circle at Churchill Downs, entitled “Secretariat – Still the Greatest”.

1982-port-ellen-55-1-30th-anniv.title: Port Ellen 1982 55.1% 30th Anniversary Signatory
1982-port-ellen-55-1-30th-anniv.bodyHtml:
Port Ellen 1982 35 Year Old Cask #2040 Signatory Vintage 30th Anniversary is a single cask from the lost Islay distillery of Port Ellen, released in the first series of Signatory Vintage's 30th Anniversary bottlings. Distilled in 1982 and matured for 35 years in refill sherry butt #2040, it was bottled in June 2018 at 55.1% ABV, yielding 567 bottles of 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

grizzly-paw-hefeweizen.title: Grizzly Paw Grumpy Bear Honey Wheat 6 Cans
grizzly-paw-hefeweizen.bodyHtml: A pale golden, light-bodied, and sweet easy-drinking ale with a touch of honey flavour. If the beer list has you a bit overwhelmed, this is a great place to start. Brewed with real honey, local pale malts and wheat

benromach-1977.title: Benromach Heritage Vintage 1977 49.6% ABV
benromach-1977.bodyHtml: Handcrafted using the finest natural ingredients at our distillery, Benromach 1977 is an exceptional whisky with real heritage and an original tale or two. Just 122 bottles available from one precious cask, cask number 1269.

nutrl-vodka-soda-7-black-raspberry.title: Nutrl 7% Vodka Soda Berries 12Cans
nutrl-vodka-soda-7-black-raspberry.bodyHtml: A refreshingly simple vodka soda with 7% alc./vol. Made with just three ingredients - vodka, soda, and natural flavour and containing 0g of sugar and carbs per 355mL can

long-hop-brewing-red-ale.title: High Key Brewing - Jolly Roger Red Ale
long-hop-brewing-red-ale.bodyHtml: High Key Brewing - Jolly Roger Red Ale

glenfarclas-family-cask-1978-rel-w18.title: Glenfarclas 'The Family Casks' 1978 Winter 2018 Cask 661 4th Fill Hogshead
glenfarclas-family-cask-1978-rel-w18.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 'The Family Casks' 1978 is a single cask Highland single malt from the Winter 2018 release of the Grant family's celebrated vintage series, distilled and bottled at Glenfarclas Distillery on Speyside. Distilled in 1978, it matured in a fourth-fill hogshead (cask 661) and was bottled on 5 December 2018, some 40 years later, at a cask strength of 42.7% ABV. Only 156 bottles of 700ml were filled from the cask. The Family Casks collection exists thanks to the foresight of George S Grant: Glenfarclas holds casks from the last eight decades, and each release captures the character of a single year in the distillery's history. Rated 90 points by Whiskyfun. Each bottle comes in the series' wooden presentation box, with the distillation year, cask number and bottling details printed on the label - a natural gift for a birth year or anniversary.

Nose: Ripe apple, banana, pineapple and guava with honey, pollen, green tea, sultanas, candied fruit and damson.

Palate: Honey, candied citrus peel, herbal tea, wormwood, mint jelly and wildflowers with a touch of cinnamon, nutmeg and clove.

Finish: Medium, with tea, lemon balm, pineapple jelly and a hint of old Sauternes.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a nosing glass. Give it time in the glass and add water only a drop at a time, if at all.

glenfarclas-family-cask-1970-rel-sp15.title: Glenfarclas The Family Casks 1970 Sherry Hogshead Cask 2026 Spring 2015 Release
glenfarclas-family-cask-1970-rel-sp15.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas The Family Casks 1970 is a single cask Highland single malt from the Spring 2015 release of the Grant family's celebrated vintage series. Distilled in 1970 at Glenfarclas in Speyside, it matured in a sherry hogshead, cask 2026, before being bottled on 1 December 2014 at 53% ABV; just 148 bottles of 700ml were filled. The Family Casks exist thanks to George S. Grant, who chose to lay down mature stock for the distillery's own bottlings instead of relying on blenders, so Glenfarclas now holds casks from eight decades. Owned by the Grant family since 1865 and still independent, the distillery sits at the foot of Ben Rinnes and distils twice in direct-fired stills. Each bottle is presented in the series' wooden case.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a tulip glass; let it rest a few minutes before nosing and add a few drops of water only if wanted.

glenfarclas-family-cask-1960-rel-s14.title: Glenfarclas The Family Casks 53 Year Old 1960 Release S14 #1775
glenfarclas-family-cask-1960-rel-s14.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas The Family Casks 53 Year Old 1960 Release S14 #1775 is an exceptionally rare Speyside single malt Scotch whisky, distilled in 1960 and bottled on March 25, 2014. Matured for 53 years in a single sherry hogshead, this extraordinary expression represents more than five decades of traditional Glenfarclas craftsmanship. Bottled at its natural cask strength of 45.2% ABV, only 194 bottles were produced worldwide. Part of the prestigious Family Casks collection, this historic release showcases the remarkable depth, elegance, and complexity achievable through extended sherry cask maturation.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate, aged Gouda, roasted walnuts, dried figs, fruitcake, and rich caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes: An exceptionally mature Speyside single malt with rich sherry influence, aged oak, dried fruit, and warming spice. The following notes are indicative of its maturation style rather than verified bottle-specific tasting notes.

Nose: Dried raisins, polished oak, orange peel, antique leather, toasted walnuts, and subtle baking spices.

Palate: Rich dried fruits, dark chocolate, caramelized nuts, mature oak, gentle spice, and delicate sherry sweetness.

Finish: Long and elegant, with lingering dried fruits, refined oak tannins, warming spice, and subtle sweetness.

Serve: Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn or tulip-shaped whisky glass. Allow time for the aromas to develop naturally before tasting.

glenfarclas-family-cask-1984-w15-6033.title: Glenfarclas 1984 30 Year Old W15 Cask 6033 Plain Hogshead 49.4% ABV
glenfarclas-family-cask-1984-w15-6033.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 1984 30 Year Old W15 Cask 6033 Plain Hogshead 49.4% ABV 700ml

THIS IS A PREORDER ITEM. STOCK WILL ARRIVE IN FEBRUARY 2024.

glenfarclas-family-cask-1968-s16.title: Glenfarclas The Family Casks 1968 47 Year Old Sherry Hogshead Cask 5243 Summer 2016 Release
glenfarclas-family-cask-1968-s16.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas The Family Casks 1968 is a single cask Highland single malt from the Summer 2016 release of the Grant family's celebrated vintage series. Distilled in 1968 at Glenfarclas in Speyside, it matured in a sherry hogshead, cask 5243, for 47 years, before being bottled on 25 July 2016 at 41.7% ABV; just 149 bottles of 700ml were filled. The Family Casks exist thanks to George S. Grant, who chose to lay down mature stock for the distillery's own bottlings instead of relying on blenders, so Glenfarclas now holds casks from eight decades. Owned by the Grant family since 1865 and still independent, the distillery sits at the foot of Ben Rinnes and distils twice in direct-fired stills. Each bottle is presented in the series' wooden case.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a tulip glass; let it rest a few minutes before nosing and add a few drops of water only if wanted.

g-m-private-collection-caperdonich-1982.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Caperdonich 1982 46.6% ABV
g-m-private-collection-caperdonich-1982.bodyHtml:
Caperdonich casks still in existence are rare and highly desirable chapters in Scotland’s liquid history and our Private Collection 1982 from Caperdonich Distillery is no different. An exquisite whisky, it provides distinctly sweet notes, with a slight hint of oak on the finish.

Soft and gentle aromas of citrus peel and traces of toffee combine with sweet hay and dried flower notes. Nuances of honeysuckle emerge, balanced by fresh highlights of newly-harvested mint. Gentle flavours of liquorice root initially. Crisp red apple notes emerge; a drying oak undertone lingers before nutty notes surface. A generous sweetness remains. Sweet flavours evolve into a refreshing element akin to newly-harvested hops. Mature oak endures on the finish.

g-m-private-collection-coleburn-1981.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Coleburn 1981
g-m-private-collection-coleburn-1981.bodyHtml: Spirit from Coleburn was traditionally used in blending but Gordon & MacPhail recognised its potential and carefully matched the spirit with our own casks. This Private Collection 1981 from Coleburn Distillery is a rare single malt with a distinct mahogany hue. It delivers a delicious mix of Sherry-soaked fruit, liquorice and dark chocolate flavours, complemented by a hint of smoke on the finish.

glenfarclas-family-cask-trunk.title: Glenfarclas The Family Casks 2007 15 Year Old Refill Sherry Butt Cask 2669 Summer 2023 Release
glenfarclas-family-cask-trunk.bodyHtml: Glenfarclas 15 Year Old 2007 Family Casks Release S23 #2669, a distinguished single malt whisky that embodies the rich heritage and exceptional craftsmanship of the Glenfarclas distillery. Crafted with precision and aged to perfection, this expression represents a harmonious balance of time, expertise, and tradition. Distilled in 2007 and aged for 15 years in carefully selected refill sherry butt, this release is a testament to the distillery’s commitment to quality and excellence. Each bottle of Glenfarclas 15 Year Old Family Casks Release S23 #2669 is a reflection of the Grant family’s legacy, showcasing their passion for producing exceptional whisky. 634 bottles.

fettercairn-50-year-old-scotch-whisky.title: Wm Cadenhead Original Collection Fettercairn 19 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
fettercairn-50-year-old-scotch-whisky.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead Original Collection Fettercairn 19 Year Old is an independently bottled Highland single malt Scotch whisky from Fettercairn, the distillery in the foothills of the Cairngorms known for its heavy, sweet spirit. Distilled in 2006 and fully matured in bourbon barrels, this small-batch release was bottled by Wm Cadenhead of Campbeltown at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle, non-chill filtered and with no added colouring. Fruit salad sweets and quince open on the nose, and the dram builds as you sip with custard, toffee popcorn and gorse.

Tasting Notes: Fruit salad sweets, quince, custard, toffee popcorn, gorse.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

masseto-2016-1-5l.title: Masseto Tuscany 2016 1.5L Magnum
masseto-2016-1-5l.bodyHtml:
2016 is a textbook year for the Masseto, with a typically Tuscan coastal climate which saw a dry and sunny vegetative season, with abundant sunshine and the right one amount of rain for perfect ripeness. 2016 presents itself with a particular color intense and young, the intense aroma of ripe dark fruit blends with subtle cocoa notes spices. On the palate, the rich and dense structure of ripe and silky tannins is balanced by a fruity note sensual and vibrant and with a lively acidity that keeps the long finish clean and full-bodied.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Masseto has pulled off back-to-back home runs. This is the first time that an Italian wine has earned 100 points in successive vintages. The 2016 Masseto is a thunderstorm of emotions, but it manages to keep them under perfect control. Like the 2015 Masseto before it, this vintage is a seamless wine of the highest pedigree. It represents an encore performance, continuing the string of successes that is bringing Italy to the forefront of the wine world. The first thing you'll notice is the thickness and concentration of the fruit that makes an immediate impact on all the senses, in terms of appearance, aroma and mouthfeel. There is no overstating the sheer power and richness of this iconic vintage of Italy's groundbreaking Merlot. Despite that considerable mass, this Masseto remains delicate and graceful. You gain better perspective as the wine opens in the glass and reveals deeper layers that were not immediately apparent on first nose: dark fruit, spice, sweet tobacco and black cherry. There is great tightness and laser focus to the fruit. I tasted the 2016 and 2015 vintages together for comparison when I scored this wine, and then I tasted this 2016 edition alone about a month later to confirm my impressions. These vintages are identical twins, two perfect wines.

100 Points - James Suckling
This is so solid and powerful with incredible vertical dense that goes down and down on the palate. Compacted and thick with caressing and polished tannins that are powerful yet refined. Super concentration yet agile and energetic. This is a wine that needs time to come together and resolve all of its amazing components. Reminds me of the legendary 2001. Try after 2023.

97 Points - Wine Spectator
A flashy style, featuring concentrated yet fluid flavors of blackberry, plum, violet, cedar and iron, wrapped in toasty, vanilla-scented oak. The acidity is vibrant and refined, but dense tannins provide support as this cruises to a long finish. Best from 2022 through 2045.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Subtle aromas of underbrush, cedar, camphor and cassis waft out of the glass along with a whiff of blue flower. The firmly structured, full-bodied palate offers dried cherry, black currant jam, grilled sage and espresso alongside tightly-knit close-grained tannins. You’ll also notice the warmth of evident alcohol on the close but the rich fruit stands up to it.

dujac-chambolle-musigny.title: Joseph Drouhin Chambolle-Musigny 2022 1.5L Magnum
dujac-chambolle-musigny.bodyHtml: Fine lace and silk are the words most often associated with this wine. Bright, intense color and complex aromas evoking violet, black cherry and damp earth. According to the vintages, there are also notes of truffle and game. Refined tannins coat the palate. Good balance between texture and acidity. Long aftertaste, with notes of cherry and candied fruit.

dujac-charmes-chambertin.title: Domaine Feuillet Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru
dujac-charmes-chambertin.bodyHtml:
Domaine Feuillet Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru is a luxurious Pinot Noir with aromas of black cherry, ripe raspberry, rose petals, forest floor, truffle, and sweet spice. Rich concentration, velvety tannins, vibrant acidity, and refined minerality deliver an elegant Grand Cru with remarkable depth and a persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast duck, venison, beef tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, truffle dishes, or aged Époisses and Comté cheeses.

xop-port-ellen-35yo.title: XOP Port Ellen 35 Year Old
xop-port-ellen-35yo.bodyHtml:
Port Ellen 35 Year Old 1983 is a single cask Islay single malt from Douglas Laing's Xtra Old Particular range. It was distilled at Port Ellen in March 1983, shortly before the distillery fell silent, and spent 35 years in a single sherry hogshead (cask DL13101) before bottling in March 2019. Only 128 bottles were filled, at natural cask strength of 54.3% ABV, without added colouring or chill-filtration, and each is presented in a wooden XOP case. A rare chance to taste a lost Islay distillery shaped by sherry wood.

Nose: Smoky, with burnt brown sugar and cured meats.

Palate: Mocha and cocoa, BBQ smoke and sweet stewed fruit.

Finish: Very long, with rich spice, peat and treacle.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

g-m-pc2-longmorn-1966.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Longmorn 1966 46% ABV
g-m-pc2-longmorn-1966.bodyHtml:
Featured as part of our 2019 Summer Collection, Private Collection 1966 from Longmorn Distillery has been matured in a first fill Sherry butt. This cask has gifted the spirit a medley of sweet fruitcake aromas and dark fruits on the palate, leading to a hint of oak on the finish.

Intense sweet fruitcake aromas align with brown sugar, sticky prunes, and candied citrus peel. Spice provides warmth with cinnamon and clove. Hints of vanilla come to the fore followed by forest fruits. A delicate oak smoke is present. Sweet with bursts of pepper. Steeped dark fruits - blackberry and ripe cherries envelop warming spice leading to flavours of liquorice with dried tobacco and oak. Long; mulled fruits and charred oak providing a subtle ash finish.

collective-arts-nature-of-things-can.title: Collective Arts Nature Of Things Can 473ml

collective-arts-circling-the-sun-can.title: Collective Arts Circling The Sun Can 473ml

trolley-five-upbeat-wheat.title: Trolley Five Upbeat Wheat 4 Tall Cans

chateau-lafite-rothschild-2016-3l.title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild Carruades de Lafite 2016
chateau-lafite-rothschild-2016-3l.bodyHtml:
Château Lafite Rothschild’s second wine, Carruades de Lafite presents similar characteristics to the Grand Vin, but with its own personality linked to a higher proportion of Merlot and to specific plots that are used to produce Carruades. The name comes from the Carruades plateau, a group of plots acquired in 1845 just next to the vines on the Château hilltop.

93 Points - James Suckling

Sweet-tobacco and berry aromas here with fresh herbs, too. Full-bodied, dense and chewy with a savory edge, bright acidity and a long, flavorful finish. Iron and graphite at the finish with Indian ink. Second wine of Château Lafite Rothschild. Try after 2022.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This smoothly rich wine offers elegant tannins and spice as well as juicy acidity. With a good proportion of Merlot in the blend, the wine already shows great fruitiness as well as the intense freshness of the vintage. Drink this fine second wine of Lafite from 2023.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of 49% Merlot, 44% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Cabernet Franc and 2% Petit Verdot, the deep garnet-purple colored 2016 Carruades de Lafite opens with expressive baked plums, Morello cherries and blackcurrant cordial scents with touches of stewed tea, bay leaves and tilled soil plus a waft of tree bark. Medium-bodied with a great mid-palate core of red and black fruits, it has a solid, grainy frame and compelling freshness, finishing long and minerally.

champagne-salon-mixed-case.title: Bollinger Special Cuvee Brut Champagne
champagne-salon-mixed-case.bodyHtml:
Bollinger Special Cuvée Brut Champagne is an elegant, richly textured non-vintage Champagne produced by the historic Bollinger house in Aÿ, France. Crafted from 60% Pinot Noir, 25% Chardonnay, and 15% Meunier, this distinguished blend incorporates a significant proportion of reserve wines to achieve remarkable depth and consistency. Aromas of roasted apples, ripe peaches, and delicate spices lead into a refined palate of fresh pear, toasted brioche, and walnuts. Fine bubbles, vibrant acidity, and a beautifully balanced finish make it an exceptional expression of traditional Champagne craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, sushi, sashimi, grilled lobster, seared scallops, roasted poultry, aged Parmesan, smoked salmon, and creamy seafood dishes.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A graceful Champagne, with flavors of black cherry, Asian pear, toast point and salted almond dancing across the palate. Bright and buoyant, with a fine, lacy mousse and delicate notes of lime blossom, ground coffee and exotic spices playing on the finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

A polished palate of fine bubbles with pears, light bread dough and caramel undertones. Medium-bodied with pretty toasted-oak and vanilla flavors. Refined finish. Touch of quince and grapefruit with dried apples. Base wine 2021 plus nine different vintages. A blend of 61% pinot noir, 25% chardonnay and 14% pinot meunier.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Disgorged in May 2021, the latest rendition of Bollinger's NV Brut Special Cuvée is showing beautifully, offering up aromas of ripe orchard fruit, citrus oil and peach, mingled with hints of walnuts and freshly baked bread. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and enveloping, with a generous core of fruit, lively acids and a pillowy mousse, it's seamless and complete, concluding with an expansive finish.

1980-glenlochy-51-1-signatory-vintage.title: Signatory Vintage Cask Strength Collection Glenlochy 35 Year Old 1980 Hogshead Cask 3232 51.1% ABV
1980-glenlochy-51-1-signatory-vintage.bodyHtml:
Glenlochy 35 Year Old 1980 is a rare single cask Highland single malt Scotch whisky from a closed distillery, bottled by Signatory Vintage for its Cask Strength Collection. Whisky from Glenlochy has become very hard to find. This cask was distilled on 6 November 1980 and matured for 35 years in a single hogshead, cask 3232, before being bottled on 2 December 2015, giving 218 numbered bottles. It is presented at its natural cask strength of 51.1% ABV in a 700ml decanter-style bottle, at natural colour, in a Signatory presentation box. A genuine piece of lost-distillery history for collectors and drinkers of old Highland malt.

Serve: Neat, with a drop of water if you wish; give it time in the glass.

1973-bunnahabhain-47-9-signatory-vintag.title: Signatory Bunnahabhain 1973 42 Year Old 47.9%
1973-bunnahabhain-47-9-signatory-vintag.bodyHtml:
Bunnahabhain 1973 Aged 42 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky – Signatory Vintage

Cask Number: 12145 Date of Distilling: 16/12/1973 Date of Bottling: 11/01/2016 Matured In: a Refill Sherry Butt

This independent bottle by Signatory has been matured in a refill Sherry butt for 42 years. The bottling is part of the cask strength collection Rare reserve from Signatory Vintage and has naturally been bottled at 47.9% abv.

Tasting Notes
Nose: Toasted almonds, freshly shucked oysters, red berries and apple compote married with black peppercorns.

Palate: Apple strudel, chewy oak and toffee crisp and ash.

Finish: Lots of luscious tropical fruits

1973-craigduff-45-4-30th-anniv.title: Signatory Vintage 30th Anniversary Craigduff 1973 45 Year Old 45.4% ABV
1973-craigduff-45-4-30th-anniv.bodyHtml:
Craigduff 1973 45 Year Old is a rare Speyside single malt bottled by Signatory Vintage for its 30th anniversary (1988-2018). Craigduff is a little-known name whose history Signatory itself has done much to piece together. This single cask was distilled on 4 April 1973, matured in refill sherry butt 2518 and bottled on 13 June 2018, giving 575 numbered bottles. It is bottled at 45.4% ABV with natural colour, in a 700ml decanter-style bottle.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a nosing glass; take time and add water only drop by drop.

tullibardine-1964-custodian-collection.title: Tullibardine 1964 Custodian Collection
tullibardine-1964-custodian-collection.bodyHtml:
Custodian 1964 has been drawn from Tullibardine's cellars and carefully nurtured over the years before being bottled at cask strength, 40.4%.

On the nose, it intrigues the senses with the delicate aroma of leather armchairs set against fragrant floral meadows, gently mingling with fresh summer fruits drizzled with cream.

A subtle hint of milk chocolate coated almonds with hints of freshly cut pineapple tease the tongue.

The exclusive whisky enjoys light and gentle flavours of fresh summer strawberries, hints of rich espresso and slightly spicy but warming ground nutmeg, with creamy milk chocolate coated oranges and hints of subtle oak on the finish.

xop-speysides-finest-50yo.title: XOP Speyside's Finest 50 Year Old
xop-speysides-finest-50yo.bodyHtml:
Probably Speyside's Finest Distillery 50 Year Old 1967 is a single cask Speyside single malt from Douglas Laing's Xtra Old Particular range, released without naming the distillery. Distilled in November 1967, it spent half a century in a single refill sherry butt (cask DL12786) before bottling in August 2018. Only 248 bottles were hand filled at natural cask strength of 52.2% ABV, with no added colouring and no chill-filtration, and each is presented in a wooden XOP box. A heavily sherried, genuinely rare half-century-old malt.

Nose: Big sherry sweetness, chocolate orange, stewed plums and cherries, and chewed leather.

Palate: Zesty orange, then fruitcake and cocoa developing into winter spice and smoky espresso.

Finish: Lingering peppery chocolate, malted barley, ginger and treacle toffee.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

wisconsin-club-pilsner-beer.title: Pilsner 24 Cans
wisconsin-club-pilsner-beer.bodyHtml: Brewed with Western Canada two-row barley to give it that select aroma and bittering hops. A medium-bodied lager that is true to its Western Canadian roots. It is a rich copper color, with a burst of freshly toasted barley enhanced with solid hop aroma. 16 IBU's.

krug-collection-1990.title: Krug Brut Collection 1990 1.5L Magnum
krug-collection-1990.bodyHtml: To the delight of collectors around the world, a very limited number of bottles of Krug Vintage are kept in ideal conditions in the House’s cellars. They are tasted and appraised as they wait to blossom into a second life. Krug Vintage then becomes Krug Collection and reveals a new personality. Krug Collection Champagnes are true examples of time sublimation; maturity exposes hidden facets and depth. New flavours surprise, while old ones have gained structure. Krug Collection is always a wonderful discovery, a deeper story of the Krug Vintage. Krug Collection 1990 is time’s second revelation of Krug 1990.

g-m-glen-grant-1956-mr-george.title: Gordon & MacPhail Mr George Centenary Edition Glen Grant 1956 62 Year Old 51.7% ABV
g-m-glen-grant-1956-mr-george.bodyHtml:
To commemorate what would have been his centenary year in 2019, Gordon & MacPhail is proud to release this superb example of Mr George Urquhart's legacy. The spirit, from one of his favourite distilleries, Glen Grant, was personally matched by Mr George to an oak cask made to his specific requirements. It was laid down in 1956, the year he became the company's senior partner. With rich fruitcake aromas and dark chocolate notes, this 62-Year-Old single malt embodies the qualities that made Mr George a master of his craft; patience, depth of character and exquisite taste.

Producer Tasting Note

Nose: Rich fruitcake aromas complement notes of raisin and dried fig. Dark molasses entwines with Seville orange peel leading to beeswax polish. Fresh roasted walnut and burnt toffee notes come to the fore.

Taste: Sweet initially with bursts of vibrant citrus. A slight humidor edge transforms into juicy sultanas and dark chocolate coated coffee beans. Liquorice toffee flavours develop alongside mature charred oak and mouth-warming spice.

Finish: Long and complex; subtle hints of smoke with lingering dark liquorice.

screaming-eagle-sauvignon-blanc-1.title: Screaming Eagle 2023
screaming-eagle-sauvignon-blanc-1.bodyHtml:
An exceptionally rare expression of Napa Valley wine, the 2023 Screaming Eagle Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the estate’s vineyard in Oakville subregion of the Napa Valley in California. Screaming Eagle, founded in 1986 by Jean Phillips, is the quintessential American 'cult' winery, known for its tiny production and near mythical status among collectors. Now owned solely by businessman Stanley Kroenke, the estate maintains a philosophy of extreme quality control and 'patient winemaking', overseen by winemaker Nick Gislason. The vineyard is situated on a rocky, west-facing slope that benefits from excellent drainage and cooling breezes from the San Pablo Bay.

This vintage is characterized by its purity and structure. It displays a deep purple hue and a bouquet of crushed blackberries, crème de cassis, and spring flowers, integrated with notes of graphite and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, showcasing fine tannins. The finish is known for its persistence, leaving a trail of blue fruit, licorice, and stony minerality.
100 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The epitome of class and elegance, the 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon offers pure crème de cassis, liquid violets, crushed stone, graphite, and cedar notes on the nose. It's full-bodied on the palate, with remarkably polished tannins, flawless overall balance, and incredible length. This is never the biggest or richest wine in the vintage, yet the sheer level of purity, structure, and depth is absolutely incredible. Compared to the 2021, this is less powerful and made in a more elegant style, yet it's every bit as profound and compelling. It builds beautifully with time in the glass and already offers pleasure yet won't hit prime time for a decade and will cruise for 50+ years. Drink 2035-2075.

kinship-mix-case-whisky.title: Johnnie Walker Family Collection 4x200ml
kinship-mix-case-whisky.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Family Collection 4x200ml is an exceptional sampler gift set showcasing the remarkable depth, blending mastery, and iconic flavor spectrum of the House of Walker. Perfect for both discerning connoisseurs and those looking to discover premium Scotch, this exclusive taster pack contains four 200ml bottles, each representing a celebrated tier of the portfolio:

  • Johnnie Walker Black Label – The Original Walker Whisky – Aged 12 Years and a rock solid blend.
  • Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve – A multi-layered blend, it offers a smooth balance of sweet fruits and creaminess that evolves into deeper honeyed tones before finishing in lingering waves of wood, fruit, and light, sweet west coast smoke.
  • Johnnie Walker 18 Year Old – A complex, luxurious blend harboring deep layers of flavor that perfectly balance the diverse character of the distilleries from which it came and the wood in which it has rested.
  • Johnnie Walker Blue Label – An exquisite blend made from some of Scotland’s rarest and most exceptional Scotch Whiskies.

Together, they guide you on a comprehensive tasting journey through the finest single malt and grain distillates across Scotland, bound by Johnnie Walker's signature whisper of coastal peat smoke.

Food Pairing: This diverse collection pairs beautifully with a multi-course tasting menu. Enjoy the smoky depth of the Black Label with grilled lamb chops or smoked brisket. Transition to the sweet creaminess of the Gold Label alongside aged Gouda cheese or a fruit tart. Pair the sophisticated 18 Year Old with seared duck breast, and culminate the experience by sipping the rare Blue Label alongside high-quality dark chocolate truffles or a delicate seared ribeye steak.

new-level-black-no-1-porter.title: Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10 Year Old
new-level-black-no-1-porter.bodyHtml:
Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10 Year Old is a flagship heavily peated Islay single malt Scotch whisky crafted from 100% Scottish barley and peated to 40 PPM. Matured for 10 years on Islay in a combination of 65% first-fill American whiskey casks, 10% second-fill American whiskey casks, and 25% second-fill French wine casks, this non-chill filtered expression marries intense marine peat smoke with rich sweet vanilla, coconut, and vibrant orchard fruit complexity.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, oysters on the half shell, dark chocolate, blue cheese, or barbecue pork ribs.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber appearance with a rich, oily, and coating texture on the palate.

Nose : Heavy peat smoke balanced with sweet vanilla, caramel, sea salt spray, charred oak, lemon curd, and dried floral notes.

Palate : Smooth and rich with dominant barbecue smoke, sweet malt, coconut, fudge, orange peel, and gentle baking spice.

Finish : Long, warming, and smoky with lingering dried oak, marine salt, sweet barley, and soft fudge.

Serve : Served neat at room temperature or with a few drops of water in a Glencairn glass.

louis-xiii-black-pearl.title: Louis XIII Cognac
louis-xiii-black-pearl.bodyHtml:
Louis XIII Cognac is an pinnacle luxury spirit produced by the House of Rémy Martin, representing an exquisite blend of up to 1,200 individual eaux-de-vie harvested, distilled, and aged exclusively in the Grande Champagne region—the premier cru of Cognac. Each handcrafted crystal decanter contains a masterfully aged spirit matured over generations in historic tierçon oak casks, capturing decades of terroir, artisan heritage, and unmatched blending expertise.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with Iberico Bellota ham, aged Comté or Roquefort cheese, rich dark chocolate with high cocoa content, fine beluga caviar, and dried figs or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant mahogany and deep amber color with golden highlights, exhibiting a dense, full-bodied viscosity and a velvety, opulent texture on the palate.

Nose : A remarkably rich and expressive bouquet featuring intense floral notes of dried rose and jasmine, interwoven with honey, passion fruit, fig, plum, leather, cigar box, myrrh, and delicate baking spices like nutmeg and cinnamon.

Palate : Intensely complex and multi-layered, delivering flavors of candied fruits, dried aprons, passionfruit, saffron, gingerbread, rich oak, floral rancio, sandalwood, and warm spice that unfold seamlessly across the tongue.

Finish : Unrivaled length and depth, persisting for up to an hour with evolving hints of dried fruits, warm spice, aged leather, sweet oak, and subtle floral notes.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a traditional Cognac tulip glass or a crystal drop glass designed to concentrate its complex aromas.

collective-arts-pink-gin-soda-raspberr.title: Collective Arts Rhubarb & Hibiscus Gin
collective-arts-pink-gin-soda-raspberr.bodyHtml:
Collective Arts Rhubarb & Hibiscus Gin is a contemporary Canadian gin from Collective Arts in Ontario, bottled at 43.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Its botanicals are rhubarb, hibiscus, juniper, coriander, fresh orange, lemon and lime peel, ginger and orris root. The result is bright, juicy and floral, with fresh citrus on the palate and a tart, warming ginger finish.

Tasting Notes: Juicy, floral and citrusy, finishing tart with warm ginger.

Palate: Juicy and floral with fresh citrus.

Finish: Tart, with warm ginger.

Serve: With tonic or soda and a citrus garnish.

g-m-glen-albyn-1979.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glen Albyn 1979 52.2% ABV
g-m-glen-albyn-1979.bodyHtml: Wonderfully rich. Aromas of juicy black cherries and intense orange peel transform into velvety milk chocolate. Sweet toffee comes to the fore alongside mature oak with fragrant lavender. Creamy with hints of white pepper and Sherried stewed fruits. Sweet baked apple flavours with autumnal spice - cinnamon and aniseed with a slight menthol edge. Delicate cinnamon and baked apple notes linger on the finish.

screaming-eagle-magnum.title: Screaming Eagle 2017 1.5L Magnum
screaming-eagle-magnum.bodyHtml:
If any wine exemplifies the California Cult wine phenomena, it’s Screaming Eagle, which made its auspicious debut with their 1992 vintage. Within two short years, the wine quickly shot to the top of the hot must-have collectible charts driving collectors into a frenzy and creating a phenomena that had enthusiasts tripping over each other to obtain. This majestic wine continues to drive commanding prices. Allocating this wine is like grasping oil with your hands.

This luxury liquid is rarely tasted outside the winery, as much of the wine goes to collectors whom are more likely to sell their allocation than drink it; however, those who have had the unique opportunity are overwhelmed with its upfront elegance. This flagship Screaming Eagle, being very age worthy, is more classic Bordeaux than modern Napa, yet, still with the perfumed nose and mineral line that speaks of Oakville.  Screaming Eagle isn’t about power, but rather elegance, refined and pure, with a rich, silky, velvety texture. Though scarce and nearly mythical, if the wine somehow lands in a lucky individual’s hands and is willing to uncork the bottle, they would be taken on a flight to ecstasy and back.

The smallest production for Screaming Eagle in any vintage, the 2017 is a true achievement for them. So small, it has only been released in magnums, and just 600 mags were produced! Screaming Eagle is always super limited around the globe, but this takes it to a whole new level - this is true collectors centerpiece.

99 Points - James Suckling   

 A very vertical wine with creamy, silky tannins running through the center of the wine and plenty of berries, herbs and currants intertwined with the tannins. Some tile and licorice undertones. It's medium-to full-bodied. Excellent complexity. Extremely long. Svelte and racy. Drink after 2025. Only 600 magnums made.

96 Points - Wine Spectator    

The team at Screaming Eagle first declared that they wouldn’t be releasing their flagship Cabernet Sauvignon in 2017, yet they were able to make a draconian selection, so there’s a minuscule amount of the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon scheduled to be released only in magnums. It’s unquestionably a beautiful wine and has the classic elegance and regal quality this cuvée always shows as well as pure aromatics of crème de cassis, graphite, acacia flowers, and subtle background oak. With medium to full body, a seamless, multi-dimensional texture, and great tannin quality, it’s going to be accessible with short-term cellaring and, given the magnum-only format, evolve at a glacier pace.

glenfarclas-family-cask-1977-w19.title: Glenfarclas 'The Family Casks' 1977 Winter 2019 Cask 7293 Sherry Hogshead
glenfarclas-family-cask-1977-w19.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 'The Family Casks' 1977 is a single cask Highland single malt from the Winter 2019 release of the Grant family's celebrated vintage series, distilled and bottled at Glenfarclas Distillery on Speyside. Distilled in 1977, it matured in a sherry hogshead (cask 7293) and was bottled on 18 October 2019, some 42 years later, at a cask strength of 43.6% ABV. Only 210 bottles of 700ml were filled from the cask. It is bottled without chill filtration and with its natural colour. The Family Casks collection exists thanks to the foresight of George S Grant: Glenfarclas holds casks from the last eight decades, and each release captures the character of a single year in the distillery's history. Each bottle comes in the series' wooden presentation box, with the distillation year, cask number and bottling details printed on the label - a natural gift for a birth year or anniversary.

Nose: Dried fig, polished oak, dark chocolate and old leather, lifted by spiced orange and pipe tobacco.

Palate: Molasses, walnut cake and burnt toffee moving to black cherry, clove and a little earthy rancio.

Finish: Long, with roasted nuts, demerara sugar and sherried oak.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a nosing glass. Give it time in the glass and add water only a drop at a time, if at all.

roederer-cristal-brut-6l.title: Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2012 6L Imperial
roederer-cristal-brut-6l.bodyHtml:
2012 was one of the most challenging and complicated years ever experienced in Champagne. However, difficult conditions often lead to great things. Due to the unpredictable weather, the low yields and continental conditions towards the end of the season gave us exceptional levels of maturity, resulting in rich, full-bodied and structured wines worthy of the most outstanding vintages in Champagne.

Rich and complex aromas with notes of zesty and candied fruit (lemon) mingled with pollen (white flowers), roasted hazelnut and Madagascar vanilla. After aeration, the bouquet develops rich notes of fresh pastries and smoky notes from bottle ageing.

A delicious, concentrated and chalky palate. It shows incredible tension and perfectly honed aromatic precision. The attack is powerful, distinctive and concentrated and reveals a silky, mouth-coating texture characteristic of the ripe Pinot noirs from the 2012 vintage.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

As the first 100% biodynamic Cristal, entirely from Roederer-owned vineyards, this is an important milestone. This latest incarnation is a great Champagne with its density, elegance and poise. Still impressively young, the wine is taut, tightly wound and textured. At the same time, it has pure, ripe white and citrus fruits that are perfumed, and an important part of this wine’s long-term future. Drink at the earliest from 2023.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Aromas of clear honey, crisp green orchard fruit, white peach, pastry cream and dried white flowers introduce the 2012 Cristal, a full-bodied, concentrated and powerful wine that's built for the cellar. Broader, more textural and more muscular than the 2008 Cristal, with seemingly even greater reserves of structuring dry extract, the 2012 is incisive and searingly chalky. This is the first Cristal produced exclusively from organically farmed fruit, and it marks the opening of a new chapter for Louis Roderer. The blend is 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay, vinified without malolactic fermentation and disgorged with 7.5 grams per liter dosage. Chef de Caves Jean-Baptiste Lecaillon has once again excelled himself. 

97 Points - Wine Spectator
A classic beauty, fresh-faced and focused today but with a harmonious grace of form suggesting a long career ahead. There's a creamy, viscous quality to the mousse that swathes the palate, carrying finely detailed flavors of poached quince, Mandarin orange preserves, toasted almond and pickled ginger. Mouthwatering throughout, with a pleasing, soft zestiness to the mineral-laced finish. Drink now through 2035.

amalfi-apertivo-spritz.title: ArtSpritz Aperitivo Bitter
amalfi-apertivo-spritz.bodyHtml:
ArtSpritz Aperitivo Bitter is the Italian spritz liqueur from ArtSpritz, a brand of Tosti S.p.A. of Canelli in Piedmont. It is a low-alcohol aperitivo built on orange and infusions of aromatic herbs, made as the base for a spritz and for new aperitivo cocktails. In the glass it is a light orange-red. Bottled at 11% ABV in a 700ml bottle, it is not the ready-to-drink ArtSpritz Ready, which is a separate 8% product.

Nose: Orange in several shades, with gentian and other bitter aromatic herbs.

Palate: Sweet, full and persistent, with pleasant fruity notes.

Serve: The classic mix is 40% ArtSpritz to 60% Prosecco, a splash of soda, ice and an orange peel; it can also be served straight over ice with orange peel and soda.

louis-xiii-time-collection.title: Louis XIII Cognac Time Collection: Tribute to City of Lights 1900
louis-xiii-time-collection.bodyHtml:
The cognac inside our limited-edition Tribute to City of Lights – 1900 decanter is made from a unique blend of the finest and most precious eaux-de-vie from grapes grown in the exceptional terroir of Cognac Grande Champagne. The specially selected eaux-de-vie are aged slowly in Limousin oak casks called tierçons before being expertly blended to create our signature cognac. Containing aged eaux-de-vie, each one carefully watched over by generations of Cellar Master, every drop of LOUIS XIII cognac represents decades of craftsmanship and know-how, resulting in a unique taste of time that will be similar in the next century.

The LOUIS XIII City of Lights – 1900 special edition is presented in a limited series of 2,000 numbered decanters. The decanter is based on the distinctive design, inspired by a 16th-century flask uncovered from the site of the Battle of Jarnac, and later owned by LOUIS XIII founder, Paul-Émile Rémy Martin.

Hand crafted by skilled artisans, the City of Lights – 1900 decanter features 13 dentelle spikes rather than the usual 10, seven fleur-de-lys in 18ct gold and a central medallion. A limited-edition stopper takes the form of an upturned decanter, and incorporates NFC technology that allows you to register your decanter with the LOUIS XIII Society, and receive a unique numbered medal minted by the Monnaie de Paris.

masseto-2017-3l.title: Masseto Tuscany 2017 3L Double Magnum
masseto-2017-3l.bodyHtml:
Masseto 2017 manages to encapsulate all the ripeness and concentration of a particularly sunny and dry vintage. The color is almost black, the nose reveals a rich and ripe expression of concentrated black fruit, with hints of spices and liquorice. On the palate the wine manages to combine great intensity and ripeness of fruit with a remarkable sense of balance and freshness. The tannins are densely knit, the texture velvety, the finish shows lingering fruitiness and a vibrant acidity giving a final touch of freshness. Although it comes from one of the warmest vintages, 2017 can be considered a very typical Masseto in its unmistakeable combination of richness and elegance.

98 Points - James Suckling

The clarity of the ripe blackcurrants, black cherries and flowers in the nose is entrancing. Lavender, too. It’s full-bodied with firm, silky tannins that run long and straight through the wine, providing brightness and focus. Goes on for minutes. Strength with finesse Drink after 2024, but already wonderful to taste.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Masseto 2017 Masseto puts on another exhilarating, knock-out performance for the third year in a row. The Masseto vineyard is a triangular-shaped plot tucked in at the back of the same property that houses vineyards and winery. This special site is located at the base of the mountains that rise gently from the Tyrrhenian Sea, with the picturesque silhouette of the Castiglioncello castle at the top. The vines are planted at an altitude of 80 to 100 meters above sea level in blue clay soils that are unique to Bolgheri. That ideal position opens the vineyards to soft breezes, proximity to the sea, long daylight hours and cool diurnal shifts from the protective wall of low mountains at the back. It's a little garden of Merlot Eden. The center of the vineyard now is home to the new Masseto winery and an adjacent tasting room built into a pre-existing farmhouse. This wine was made in the old winery. Fermentation kicks off in a combination of steel and oak tanks before the wine is racked over to barrique, where it rests for two years. The wine then goes into bottle for 12 months before its release. Like most vintages of Masseto tasted this early in the game, the oak is omnipresent, and it grounds the wine in terms of texture and structure. It is powerful, but that's always the case with Masseto (this vintage records a 15.5% alcohol content). I tasted this wine next to the decidedly more playful Massetino, and the Masseto moves over the palate with substantial fruit weight and concentration gained over the course of this hot and dry growing season (which produced smaller, richer and more compact berries). Perhaps, what this vintage lacks is that profound varietal character that we saw in recent vintages like 2016 and 2015. If concerned that the hot vintage would draw out too many ripe fruit tones, the oak serves to soften some of the more volatile components of the fruit. Those distinctive notes of macchia mediterranea (wild bush) that I always associate with Masseto are less present in this vintage. You feel the oak tannins on the finish with toast and vanilla that will certainly shed as the wine ages. In fact, I went back to taste the wine 12 hours later, and they had already softened considerably.


95 Points -  Wine Spectator

There's a meaty character to this intense, polished red, adding a seriousness to the dark plum, blackberry, iron, vanilla and chocolate flavors. A beam of bright acidity keeps this focused and drives the fruit- and spice-filled finish. Merlot. Best from 2022 through 2042.

This special site is located at the base of the mountains that rise gently from the Tyrrhenian Sea, with the picturesque silhouette of the Castiglioncello castle at the top. The vines are planted at an altitude of 80 to 100 meters above sea level in blue clay soils that are unique to Bolgheri. That ideal position opens the vineyards to soft breezes, proximity to the sea, long daylight hours and cool diurnal shifts from the protective wall of low mountains at the back. It's a little garden of Merlot Eden. The center of the vineyard now is home to the new Masseto winery and an adjacent tasting room built into a pre-existing farmhouse. This wine was made in the old winery. Fermentation kicks off in a combination of steel and oak tanks before the wine is racked over to barrique, where it rests for two years. The wine then goes into bottle for 12 months before its release. Like most vintages of Masseto tasted this early in the game, the oak is omnipresent, and it grounds the wine in terms of texture and structure. It is powerful, but that's always the case with Masseto (this vintage records a 15.5% alcohol content). I tasted this wine next to the decidedly more playful Massetino, and the Masseto moves over the palate with substantial fruit weight and concentration gained over the course of this hot and dry growing season (which produced smaller, richer and more compact berries). Perhaps, what this vintage lacks is that profound varietal character that we saw in recent vintages like 2016 and 2015. If concerned that the hot vintage would draw out too many ripe fruit tones, the oak serves to soften some of the more volatile components of the fruit. Those distinctive notes of macchia mediterranea (wild bush) that I always associate with Masseto are less present in this vintage. You feel the oak tannins on the finish with toast and vanilla that will certainly shed as the wine ages. In fact, I went back to taste the wine 12 hours later, and they had already softened considerably.


95 Points -  Wine Spectator

There's a meaty character to this intense, polished red, adding a seriousness to the dark plum, blackberry, iron, vanilla and chocolate flavors. A beam of bright acidity keeps this focused and drives the fruit- and spice-filled finish. Merlot. Best from 2022 through 2042.

g-m-private-collection-port-ellen-1979.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Port Ellen 1979 40 Year Old
g-m-private-collection-port-ellen-1979.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Port Ellen 1979 40 Year Old is a single cask Islay single malt from the long-closed Port Ellen distillery. Distilled on 11 December 1979, it matured in refill sherry puncheon no. 7236 and was bottled on 19 December 2019, forty years and eight days later, at a natural cask strength of 54.7% ABV, without added colour or chill filtration. Just 407 bottles were filled, each presented in a wooden box. Port Ellen whisky at this age is exceptionally scarce: red apple, sweet spice and strawberry liquorice meet a subtle smoked-fish note, with pepper, baked apple and orange on the palate and gentle peat smoke on the finish.

Tasting Notes: Red apple, sweet spice, strawberry liquorice, black pepper, orange, peat smoke.

Nose: Sun-ripened red apple and delicate sweet spice, strawberry liquorice and tangy citrus, then a subtle smoked kipper note.

Palate: Intense; crushed black pepper followed by baked apple, fresh orange, mature oak and a slight herbal edge.

Finish: Long and sweet, with wisps of peat smoke.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass at room temperature; add a few drops of water to open it up if you like.

new-level-heavy-metal-horchata.title: RumChata Cream Liqueur
new-level-heavy-metal-horchata.bodyHtml:
RumChata is a cream liqueur inspired by horchata, the cinnamon-scented drink of Spain and Latin America; its label sums it up as "Horchata con Ron". It blends Caribbean rum with real dairy cream and is flavoured with sweet vanilla and warm cinnamon, giving a smooth, creamy sip. The liqueur is made in Wisconsin and bottled at 13.75% ABV in the brand's white 750ml bottle with a gold cap. Its versatility is a big part of its appeal: it can be enjoyed chilled as a shot, poured over ice, stirred into coffee in place of creamer or used in sweet, dessert-style cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Milky white, rich and full.

Nose: Spice, ginger, toast and vanilla.

Palate: Creamy and sweet, with honeycomb and spiced flavours.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, on the rocks, in coffee or in cocktails.

dugat-py-mazis-chambertin.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2022
dugat-py-mazis-chambertin.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2022 is a brilliant, deeply reflective village-level wine that captures the superb fruit ripeness and energy of the 2022 Burgundy vintage. Sourced from choice parcels of ancient vines averaging over 50 years of age, this wine highlights the domain's contemporary shift under Loïc Dugat-Py toward a more ethereal, fruit-forward style while maintaining its signature old-vine concentration. In the glass, it reveals a bright, glossy ruby profile. The aromatics are highly expressive and perfumed, leaping forward with a sophisticated medley of fresh strawberries, dark raspberries, and black cherries, layered with subtle hints of rose petals, wet stone minerality, and fine baking spice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, velvety, and exceptionally well-balanced. Its dense core of succulent fruit is seamlessly supported by fine-grained, chalky tannins and a refreshing spine of natural acidity, leading into a long, vibrant, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom risotto, or slow-cooked beef bourguignon.

ol-beautiful-brass-monkey-blood-orange.bodyHtml: An easy-going blonde ale coupled with organic blood orange puree. A beer that combines a crisp blonde base hopped with Mandarina and a healthy dose of orange juice tartness. Perfect for long patio sessions or morning brunch.
