screaming-eagle-second-flight-2012.title: Screaming Eagle Second Flight 2012
screaming-eagle-second-flight-2012.bodyHtml:
Screaming Eagle Second Flight 2012 is an exceptional Bordeaux-style red blend from the prestigious Screaming Eagle estate in Oakville, Napa Valley. Crafted from 48% Cabernet Sauvignon, 43% Merlot and 9% Cabernet Franc, this celebrated vintage showcases the richness, elegance and remarkable precision for which the estate is renowned. Deeply concentrated yet beautifully refined, it reveals layers of ripe blackcurrant, dark plum and crème de cassis intertwined with savoury nuances of truffle, smoked meats, dark chocolate and exotic spice. Full-bodied and luxuriously textured, the palate is supported by firm, velvety tannins and vibrant freshness, leading to a long, sophisticated finish. A remarkable expression of Napa Valley craftsmanship, this highly sought-after wine combines power, finesse and exceptional ageing potential.

Food Pairing : An outstanding companion to prime ribeye steak, herb-crusted rack of lamb, slow-braised beef short ribs, roasted duck breast and wild mushroom risotto. Its concentrated dark fruit, savoury complexity and structured tannins also pair beautifully with truffle-infused dishes, aged Comté, mature cheddar and rich beef Wellington.

 

97 Points - James Suckling

A concentrated, structured wine with ripe, silky tannins, dense fruit and a lively, full-bodied character. Suckling highlights its impressive balance and form, recommending drinking from 2019. 

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A deeply coloured, full-bodied wine offering cassis, preserved plum, smoked meat, truffle, olive tapenade and exotic spice. Firm yet velvety tannins and refreshing acidity support the rich fruit, leading to a long, spicy finish. Reviewed by Lisa Perrotti-Brown. 


95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Rich aromas and flavours of black cherry, blueberry, white chocolate, dried flowers and graphite. Powerful yet graceful, with a remarkably light impression despite its concentration. 

94 Points - Vinous

Dark cherry, mocha, liquorice, tobacco, dried herbs and earthy notes define this savoury expression. Floral nuances add complexity and extend the finish.

screaming-eagle-second-flight-2013.title: Screaming Eagle Second Flight 2013
screaming-eagle-second-flight-2013.bodyHtml:
Screaming Eagle Second Flight 2013 is an exceptional Bordeaux-style red blend from the prestigious Screaming Eagle estate in Oakville, Napa Valley. Produced as the winery's highly sought-after second wine, the 2013 vintage combines 65% Merlot, 22% Cabernet Franc, and 13% Cabernet Sauvignon. Rich and concentrated, it reveals layers of dark berries, blackcurrant, lavender, and exotic spice, supported by refined tannins and remarkable depth. This limited-production wine offers an elegant expression of Napa Valley's celebrated 2013 vintage, with excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, venison, wild mushroom risotto, aged Comté, and truffle-infused dishes.

 

 

97 Points - James Suckling

Very bright and aromatic with dark purple fruits on the nose. Mint, floral and vine bark. Spearmint. Full body, very firm tannins, wonderful savoriness. Flavorful finish. A fabulous mouthfeel. Very, very long. Mostly merlot with cabernet sauvignon and cabernet franc.  

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Very deep garnet-purple colored, the 2013 Second Flight simply sings of spiced blueberries, black forest cake and preserved plums with suggestions of star anise, baker’s chocolate, fertile loam and dried Provence herbs with a hint of lavender. Big, concentrated, full-bodied and packed to the gills with black fruits, exotic spice and floral layers, it has a firm frame of grainy tannins and just enough freshness, finishing with epic length and loads of layers. Still very taut, it needs at least another 2-3 years in bottle. Interestingly, this full-on hedonistic vintage has one of the largest Merlot contributions ever for this wine: 65% Merlot with 13% Cabernet Sauvignon and 22% Cabernet Franc.

dujac-gevrey-chambertin-fils-pere.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Cuvee Coeur de Roy Tres Vieilles Vignes 2022
dujac-gevrey-chambertin-fils-pere.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Cuvée Coeur de Roy Très Vieilles Vignes 2022 is a stunning, deeply concentrated village-level wine produced from parcels of ancient vines ranging from 50 to nearly 100 years old. Reflecting the modern evolution of the domain under Loïc Dugat-Py, the 2022 vintage shifts beautifully away from historical over-extraction, utilizing 50% whole-cluster fermentation and a dialed-back 40% new French oak regime. In the glass, it shows a bright, glossy ruby profile. The aromatics are perfumed and forward, delivering vivid layers of fresh strawberry, pomegranate, and dark cherries intermingled with hints of rose petals, cracked pepper, and subtle forest floor. On the palate, it balances intense, old-vine fruit density with an ethereal, lithe texture, supported by seamless, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant core of natural acidity that carries into a long, beautifully balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté cheese.

92 Points - Wine Advocate

Tasted from a bottle that saw fully 24 months' élevage (which will be indicated on the label), the 2022 Gevrey-Chambertin Coeur du Roy is much more civilized than it was from barrel, offering up a pretty bouquet of red berries, plums and orange rind mingled with rose petals and incense. Medium to full-bodied, succulent and seamless, with integrated tannins and a lively, harmonious profile, it will offer a broader drinking window than I had originally anticipated.

rad-water-honeydew-grape.title: Chateau Purcari Negru de Purcari 2022
rad-water-honeydew-grape.bodyHtml:
Château Purcari Negru de Purcari 2022 is a noble, rich, and deeply structured red wine crafted from a harmonious blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Saperavi, and Rara Neagră. Visually displaying an intense dark ruby color with purple reflections, it opens with an alluringly complex nose of dark ripe plums, black currants, figs, and juicy blackberries, interwoven with delicate nuances of sweet spices, vanilla, oak, and subtle earthy mineral tones. On the palate, it is full-bodied, smooth, and velvety, offering concentrated dark fruit flavors framed by noble, polished tannins and a refreshing core of balanced acidity that leads to a long, elegant, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, venison, rich beef stews, pork tenderloin, cured meats, and mature aged hard cheeses.

muskoka-ebb-flow-plum-boysenberry-sour.bodyHtml: Muskoka Ebb & Flow Plum Boysenberry Sour 4 Tall Cans

stella-artois-15.title: Stella Artois 473ml
stella-artois-15.bodyHtml: Stella Artois is a premium European pilsner lager known for its iconic clarity, crispness, and full-flavoured profile. Originally brewed as a Christmas gift for the people of Leuven, Belgium, it is crafted using a specific strain of yeast and the finest Saaz hops to provide a sophisticated balance of malt sweetness and floral bitterness. It features a bright golden colour and a well-defined white head, offering a clean, refreshing palate with a dry and slightly hoppy finish.

ardbeg-private-cask-10.title: Ardbeg 10 Year Old
ardbeg-private-cask-10.bodyHtml:
Ardbeg 10 Year Old is a world-renowned Islay single malt Scotch whisky revered by peat enthusiasts for its intensely smoky, complex, and surprisingly balanced profile. Distilled on the rugged south coast of Islay, it is matured for a minimum of ten years in a combination of first-fill and second-fill American oak ex-bourbon casks. Bottled non-chill-filtered at 46% ABV to preserve maximum flavor and texture, it showcases Ardbeg's signature phenolic peat smoke—drawn from heavily peated malted barley—alongside bright lemon and lime zest, coastal sea spray, and creamy vanilla sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh Pacific oysters, smoked salmon, grilled langoustines, barbecued pork ribs, dark chocolate truffles, and pungent blue cheeses such as Roquefort or Stilton.

Tasting Notes : Pale straw gold with bright platinum highlights, presenting a full, oily body with a rich and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense bonfire peat smoke, fresh lemon and lime zest, coastal sea brine, cracked black pepper, sweet vanilla, and subtle menthol.

Palate : Explosive peat smoke balanced by bright citrus fruits, sweet malted cereal, espresso, dark chocolate, tarry rope, and creamy toffee.

Finish : Very long, smoky, and warming with lingering notes of sea salt, toasted malt, charred oak, and sweet aniseed.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip-shaped whisky tasting glass, or add a few drops of pure water to tame the intense smoke and highlight the underlying citrus and vanilla sweetness.

barefoot-fruitscato-peach.bodyHtml: Barefoot Fruitscato Peach is a sweet and fruity wine from California. It offers flavors of ripe peaches, with a touch of sweetness and a refreshing finish. The wine's balanced acidity makes it perfect for casual sipping, picnics, and pairing with light desserts and fruit salads. This Fruitscato captures the essence of peaches in a fun and enjoyable wine. Serve well-chilled to enjoy its vibrant and fruity profile.

tignanello-2007.title: Marchesi Antinori Tignanello 2007 3L Double Magnum
tignanello-2007.bodyHtml:
The original Super Tuscan, Tignanello is produced exclusively from a 116-acre vineyard site at Antinori's Tignanello Estate. The 2007 Tignanello is intense ruby redin color with primary aromas of concentrated,ripe fruit and spice, which give way to mildernotes of vanilla and toast. Generous, richlytextured and intense on the palate, this winepossesses a complex structure and long persistentflavors with hints of chocolate, huckleberriesand black plums on the finish.The well-managed tannin blends perfectlywith the oak, for a complex and elegant wine. 

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Antinori's 2007 Tignanello is wonderfully ripe and seductive in its dark cherries, flowers, spices, tobacco, sage, cedar, mint and minerals. This is as opulent a Tignanello as I have ever tasted but there is just enough acidity and structure from the Sangiovese to keep things from going over the top. The wine's richness and warmth are such that in a blind tasting I mistook the 2007 Tignanello for a wine from Maremma! The dense, muscular fruit follows through to an impeccable finish with no hard edges and impossibly fine, silky tannins. Simply put, the 2007 is a magnificent Tignanello. The 2007 Tignanello is 80% Sangiovese aged in 300-liter French oak barrels (1/3 new), 15% Cabernet Sauvignon and 5% Cabernet Franc, both aged in 100% new 225-liter French oak barriques. Anticipated maturity: 2012-2027.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

You can't help but love this wine. The richness, density and intensity are all outstanding and Tignanello is extraordinary in terms of aromas and flavors. The traditional formula for this groundbreaking super Tuscan was Sangiovese with a small percentage of Cabernet Sauvignon. This vintage sees 5% Cabernet Franc for additional texture and longevity.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Displays sweet plum and berry aromas and flavors, with hints of toasty oak and cappuccino. Full-bodied, yet reserved and fine. Turns chewy and juicy.

village-black-current-cider.bodyHtml: The Village Apple Cider blends the sweet, tart and refreshingly crisp flavour of apples with subtle notes of pear and earl grey tea. Smooth, semi-dry and balanced this all-natural hard apple cider will get you straight through those hot summer days.

el-dorado-pecan-rum-cream.bodyHtml:
El Dorado Butter Pecan Rum Cream Liqueur comes from Demerara Distillers in Guyana, the home of El Dorado rum. It blends carefully selected aged Demerara rums with full dairy cream and butter pecan flavour, aiming for a rich taste with a very smooth, rounded texture. It is bottled at 16.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle and belongs to the El Dorado speciality range together with the Original and Espresso rum creams.

Nose: Roasted pecans, toffee and vanilla.

Palate: Full and creamy, round and very smooth.

Serve: Chilled, on its own or over ice.

Intense dried fruit aromas with plenty of oak and spices. A subtle hint of roasted hazelnut and underlying soft smoke. Mouth clinging and spicy – cloves, bitter orange and oak tannins offer a robust palate. Mouth drying, dark liquorice and oak persevere on the finish.

DISTILLED: 23rd February 1967

STRENGTH: 42.4%

1972-coleburn-125th-anniversary.title: Gordon & MacPhail 125th Anniversary Edition Coleburn 47 Year Old 1972 Refill Sherry Puncheon Cask 3511 62.4% ABV
1972-coleburn-125th-anniversary.bodyHtml:
The first of the 125th anniversary whiskies to be released is the Gordon & MacPhail 1972 from Coleburn Distillery in Speyside. Coleburn Distillery, situated just four miles from the company’s Elgin home, started production in 1897 and it remained active until 1985.

Just 363 bottles of the sweet, intense and complex 47-Year-Old whisky from Coleburn Distillery are available. After spending its entire maturation in cask 3511, a refill sherry puncheon, the golden-hued whisky has been bottled at cask strength (62.4% ABV), developing a sweet aroma with butterscotch notes.

1984-glenury-royal-125th-anniversary.title: Gordon & MacPhail 125th Anniversary Edition Glenury Royal 35 Year Old 1984 First Fill Sherry Butt Cask 2335 49.1% ABV
1984-glenury-royal-125th-anniversary.bodyHtml:
The second of the 125th anniversary whiskies to be released is the Gordon & MacPhail 1984 from Glenury Royal Distillery in Stonehaven. No spirit has been distilled at Glenury since 1985, when it closed its doors for the final time and was demolished after a long history stretching back 160 years.

Just 397 bottles of this elegant 35-year-old whisky are available.  Laid down on Thursday 7 June 1984 and has been fully matured in cask number 2335, a first-fill Sherry Butt.

Bottled at 49.1% ABV, the liquid itself is a rich amber in colour, with aromas of stewed fruit, cocoa powder, cinnamon, and toasted oak. On the palate, the whisky provides sweet orange peel, cherry, burnt sugar and dried fig giving way to a medium and fruity finish with notes of aniseed and sherry.

1979-mosstowie-125th-anniversary.title: Gordon & MacPhail 125th Anniversary Edition Mosstowie 40 Year Old 1979 Refill Sherry Hogshead Cask 20323 49.8% ABV
1979-mosstowie-125th-anniversary.bodyHtml: The penultimate of the 125th anniversary whiskies to be released is the Gordon & MacPhail 1979 Mosstowie from Miltonduff Distillery. Located within Miltonduff Distillery in Morayshire, Mosstowie was founded in 1964 under the ownership of industry pioneer Hiram Walker – who championed the use of longer, more versatile Lomond Stills to give a variety of flavour profiles. This stills, which produced Mosstowie’s smoky, soft spirit operated for just 17 years as the longer arms of the stills were notoriously difficult to clean, resulting in their removal in 1981. Only 164 bottles are available worldwide of this full-bodied whisky, full of sherry influences and dark chocolate notes. The 40-year-old whisky was laid down in Gordon & MacPhail’s Elgin warehouse on Thursday 13 September 1979 in cask number 20323, a refill Sherry Hogshead.

1975-glencraig-125th-anniversary.title: Gordon & MacPhail 125th Anniversary Edition Glencraig 44 Year Old 1975 Refill American Hogshead Cask 9686 54.2% ABV
1975-glencraig-125th-anniversary.bodyHtml:
The fourth and final rare whisky released to celebrate our 125th anniversary is the Gordon & MacPhail 1975 Glencraig from Glenburgie Distillery.

The 44-year-old whisky was distilled in Lomond Stills, which operated within Speyside’s Glenburgie Distillery, before production ceased after just 23 years.

The majority of the Glencraig whisky was destined for blended malts, with the scarcely seen light and fruity single malt becoming a prized addition to any whisky collection. 

Just 110 bottles are available of the Gordon & MacPhail 1975 Glencraig from Glenburgie Distillery, which was laid down on Thursday 30 October 1975 and bottled on Thursday 28 May 2020 at 54.2% ABV.

original-16-canadian-pale-ale.title: Original16 Pale Ale 15 Cans
original-16-canadian-pale-ale.bodyHtml: A smooth, refreshing beer, with a real beer taste. Brewed using only the finest, two-row Prairie barley, five choice hop varietals, and 100% Copeland malt.

quails-gate-le-rose.title: Quails Gate Rose
quails-gate-le-rose.bodyHtml:
Quail's Gate Rosé from British Columbia displays a pale salmon hue with aromas of fresh strawberry, watermelon, and delicate floral notes. On the palate it is crisp and refreshing with bright red fruit flavours, subtle citrus zest, and a clean, dry finish with lively acidity.


Food Pairing: Grilled salmon, charcuterie boards, fresh summer salads, light pasta dishes, and soft cheeses such as brie or goat cheese.

syc-brewing-hot-summer-nights.bodyHtml: Syc Brewing Hot Summer Nights 4 Tall Cans

benromach-heritage-1979.title: Benromach Cask Strength Vintage 2014 Batch 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
benromach-heritage-1979.bodyHtml:
Benromach Cask Strength Vintage 2014 Batch 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a limited-release Speyside single malt distilled in 2014 and bottled in 2024 at its natural cask strength of 60.6% ABV. Matured for a decade exclusively in first-fill Sherry and bourbon casks, this powerful expression combines rich fruitcake character with stewed fruit, warming spice, toasted oak and Benromach's distinctive smoky character. It is bottled at natural colour and without chill filtration.

Food Pairing: Pair with smoked beef, glazed pork ribs, mature cheddar, dark chocolate, fruitcake or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and concentrated with fruitcake, stewed plum, marmalade, warming spice, toasted oak and lingering smoke.

Nose: Sweet vanilla leads into fruitcake, brown sugar and spicy ginger, followed by cinnamon, milk chocolate and oak.

Palate: Creamy and spicy with stewed plum, Seville orange and cracked black pepper, developing toasted oak and subtle liquorice.

Finish: Long and full with lingering smoke and a touch of aniseed.

whisky-trail-cars-ardmore-1998-20-yr.title: Whisky Trail Cars Ardmore 1998 20 Year Old
whisky-trail-cars-ardmore-1998-20-yr.bodyHtml:
This Ardmore is a single hogshead (cask 750789) filled in 1998 and bottled at 20 years old by independent bottler Elixir Distillers for its Whisky Trail series, dressed in the Vintage Cars label. It is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky bottled at 51.4% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Elixir Distillers bottles single casks from across Scotland in its Whisky Trail series, each with its own illustrated label.

Nose: Vanilla ice cream on a breezy beach, sherbet lemons, freshly cut seaside links and beach-bonfire smoke.

Palate: Rich, rounded and sweet – apples and pears roasted over a barbecue, candied lemon, sweet peat and savoury woodsmoke.

Finish: Lemon and incense slowly give way to sweet vanilla and soft smoke.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

whisky-trail-cars-glenrothes-1989-30-yr.title: Whisky Trail Cars Glenrothes 1989 30 Year Old
whisky-trail-cars-glenrothes-1989-30-yr.bodyHtml:
This Glenrothes is a single hogshead (cask 18169) filled in 1989 and bottled after 30 years by independent bottler Elixir Distillers for its Whisky Trail series, under the Vintage Cars label. A Speyside single malt Scotch whisky, it is bottled at 46.1% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Elixir Distillers bottles single casks from across Scotland in its Whisky Trail series, each with its own illustrated label.

Nose: Waxed old oak floors, polished wooden shelves and old books, a bowl of exotic fruit, saffron buns and oatcakes with cinnamon and mint.

Palate: Dried mango and pineapple with a hint of menthol; water brings out beeswax, sweet Madeira, toasted brioche and sunflower seeds.

Finish: Long and complex, with coconut and mint, soft wood and a touch of pine resin.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

whisky-trail-cars-glen-elgin-2007-12-yr.title: Whisky Trail Cars Glen Elgin 2007 12 Year Old
whisky-trail-cars-glen-elgin-2007-12-yr.bodyHtml:
This Glen Elgin is a single hogshead (cask 801516) distilled in 2007 and bottled at 12 years old by independent bottler Elixir Distillers for its Whisky Trail series, under the Vintage Cars label. A Speyside single malt Scotch whisky, it is bottled at 56.4% ABV in a 700ml bottle, and shows the fresh, springtime character the distillery is known for. Elixir Distillers bottles single casks from across Scotland in its Whisky Trail series, each with its own illustrated label.

Nose: Dried raspberries and strawberries, marshmallow and Turkish delight, with green notes of cornflowers and freshly cut grass.

Palate: Jammy fruit layered in a Victoria sponge, then apricot and cantaloupe, and porridge with honey and cinnamon.

Finish: Soft and warm, with freshly milled barley, golden syrup and banana.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

ornellaia-2017-6l.title: Ornellaia 2017 6L Imperial
ornellaia-2017-6l.bodyHtml:
The Ornellaia 2017 masterfully interprets what was a particularly warm and sunny year. The intense and dark color heralds a wine of beautiful concentration; the nose, rich and complex, releases scents of ripe red fruits, accompanied by notes of sweet tobacco and vanilla. The taste reveals an Ornellaia of great balance, a combination of firmness and pleasant freshness.

97 Points - James Suckling

A big, rich wine for the vintage, yet poised and lively with firm, chewy tannins that give form and intensity to the wine. It shows loads of blackberry, blackcurrant and walnut flavors. Ripe yet polished tannins. Give this three or four years to come together.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This vintage of Ornellaia is called Solare and represents the 12th edition in the estate's Vendemmia d'Artista series featuring artwork by Tomás Saraceno. His beautiful art depicts a radiant sun halo and is intended as a symbol of sustainability. That theme of sunshine and warmth is particularly well suited to a vintage such as this. The Ornellaia 2017 Bolgheri Superiore Ornellaia is generous and fruit-forward with dense richness and concentration all driven by the smaller and more compact berry size that characterizes this dry, hot growing season. Black and purple fruits segue to spice, tobacco, leather and some of those beautiful Mediterranean notes of black olive and wild sage. These various moving pieces work together in perfect harmony. The tannins are beautifully managed here. If you consider the more astringent and rougher approach of the mid-tier Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia, this wine shows a whole other level of magnificent tannic management that could not have been easy given the diminutive berry size. This vintage sees a blend of 56% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot, 10% Petit Verdot and 9% Cabernet Franc. The vineyard soils are characterized by reddish sand with calcareous rock. The wine is fermented in both stainless steel and cement and is transferred over to barrique to finish malolactic fermentation. It ages in barrique for 18 months followed by another 12 months in bottle.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Though well-oaked, this features ample black cherry, plum and loam flavors to match the vanilla and sweet spice elements. Harmonious and accessible at this young stage, but will be better in a few years once the components harmonize. Vibrant and long. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Best from 2022 through 2038.

woodford-reserve-baccarat.title: Woodford Reserve Baccarat Edition
woodford-reserve-baccarat.bodyHtml: History and heritage meet innovation and sophistication. Woodford Reserve Baccarat Edition is crafted by uniquely finishing the most complex and balanced Kentucky Bourbon in select XO Cognac barrels. Sourced by our Master Distiller Chris Morris, each barrel has seen three seasons of cognac before being filled with Woodford Reserve.The result is the best of both spirits – a balance of crisp American and French oak notes, complex fruit character, subtle spiciness and a creamy confectionary finish. Presented in a bespoke Baccarat decanter, Woodford Reserve Baccarat Edition is the ultimate expression of American Whiskey at its finest.

hennessy-xo-limited-edition.title: Hennessy XO Cognac x Xu Zhen Year of The Horse Lunar New Year 2026 Limited Edition
hennessy-xo-limited-edition.bodyHtml:
In 1870, the Master Blender Emile Fillioux crafted a special blend for Maurice Hennessy. More than 150 years later, Hennessy's powerful, balanced "Extra Old" blend remains the cognac of choice for sharing with one's inner circle.

Hennessy celebrates Chinese New Year 2026 with a limited edition X.O, honouring the Year of the Horse. The artistic design captures the animal's energy and grace with equine motifs on a dark red neck capsule and an eco-designed cream gift box with gold accents. The X.O carafe, adorned with a vibrant red and gold label, is an ideal gift for art and exceptional cognac lovers.

dugat-gevrey-chambertin-2013.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2022
dugat-gevrey-chambertin-2013.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2022 is a brilliant, deeply reflective village-level wine that captures the superb fruit ripeness and energy of the 2022 Burgundy vintage. Sourced from choice parcels of ancient vines averaging over 50 years of age, this wine highlights the domain's contemporary shift under Loïc Dugat-Py toward a more ethereal, fruit-forward style while maintaining its signature old-vine concentration. In the glass, it reveals a bright, glossy ruby profile. The aromatics are highly expressive and perfumed, leaping forward with a sophisticated medley of fresh strawberries, dark raspberries, and black cherries, layered with subtle hints of rose petals, wet stone minerality, and fine baking spice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, velvety, and exceptionally well-balanced. Its dense core of succulent fruit is seamlessly supported by fine-grained, chalky tannins and a refreshing spine of natural acidity, leading into a long, vibrant, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom risotto, or slow-cooked beef bourguignon.

dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-1er-cru-l2017.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes 2017
dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-1er-cru-l2017.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes 2017 is a masterfully crafted, rare blend sourced from the estate's choice Premier Cru plots of old vines. The 2017 growing season yielded a remarkably classic, supple, and expressive style of Burgundy, allowing this wine to showcase its deep old-vine density without the severe youthful austerity often found in cooler years. In the glass, it shows a luminous, translucent ruby color. The bouquet is highly refined and seductive, opening with bright aromas of black and red cherry, raspberry, and crushed violets, balanced by complex undertones of sweet baking spices, damp earth, and gentle wood smoke. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, harmonious, and exquisitely balanced. Velvety, integrated tannins seamlessly frame a deep core of pure fruit and chalky mineral depth, while a fresh vein of natural acidity provides excellent lift and length.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast with cherry reduction, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom tart, or aged Comté cheese.

And at 100 Proof, it’s versatile no matter how you drink it. Ingenuity, determination, and a fearless pursuit of flavor led us here, and we never turned back. 96 Points from Wine Enthusiast, one of the highest rated Rye Whiskeys of all time. Certified Kosher.

xop-black-port-ellen-40yo-1979.title: XOP Black Port Ellen 40 Year Old 1979
xop-black-port-ellen-40yo-1979.bodyHtml:
XOP Black Port Ellen 40 Year Old 1979 is a single cask Islay single malt from the long-closed Port Ellen distillery, bottled by Douglas Laing for its Xtra Old Particular Black Series. Distilled in December 1979, it matured for four decades in a single refill butt before bottling in January 2020 at a natural cask strength of 49.6% ABV, without colouring or chill-filtration. Just 299 numbered bottles exist, each in a luxury gift box with a certificate hand-signed by Fred and Cara Laing. 700ml.

Nose: Gently burnt scone at first, then the softest peated barley and brown sugar.

Palate: An eclectic mix of fudge, spices, chewed leather and subtle peat, with a saline edge and late coal dust and ash.

Serve: Neat; a rare dram to take slowly.

glenfarclas-family-cask-1961-sp17.title: Glenfarclas The Family Casks 1961 Sherry Hogshead Cask 4896 Spring 2017 Release
glenfarclas-family-cask-1961-sp17.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas The Family Casks 1961 is a single cask Highland single malt from the Spring 2017 release of the Grant family's celebrated vintage series. Distilled in 1961 at Glenfarclas in Speyside, it matured in a sherry hogshead, cask 4896, before being bottled on 23 January 2017 at 43.1% ABV; just 160 bottles of 700ml were filled. The Family Casks exist thanks to George S. Grant, who chose to lay down mature stock for the distillery's own bottlings instead of relying on blenders, so Glenfarclas now holds casks from eight decades. Owned by the Grant family since 1865 and still independent, the distillery sits at the foot of Ben Rinnes and distils twice in direct-fired stills. Each bottle is presented in the series' wooden case.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a tulip glass; let it rest a few minutes before nosing and add a few drops of water only if wanted.

whisky-trail-cambus-1990-cask-93596.title: The Whisky Trail Cambus 29 Year Old 1990 Cask 93596 52% ABV
whisky-trail-cambus-1990-cask-93596.bodyHtml:
Cambus 29 Year Old 1990 Cask 93596 is a single cask grain whisky from Cambus, a closed distillery in Scotland's Lowland region, bottled by The Whisky Trail. Spirit filled into a single hogshead, cask #93596, in 1990 matured for 29 years before being bottled at 52% ABV. The release wears The Whisky Trail's 'Video Games' label, a nod to the games of 1990. Long ageing in a single hogshead gives a grassy, biscuity whisky with creamy citrus, orchard fruit and gentle sweetness. 700ml.

Tasting Notes: Grassy and biscuity, with creamy citrus, sweet fruit and a dusty old-wood character.

Nose: Grassy, with sugar-coated butter biscuits and brioche, creamy lemon and white chocolate, and the dustiness of an old wooden box.

Palate: Hazelnut-covered candy apples, vanilla essence, crystallised pineapple and chocolate-coated honeycomb, with a light floral hint of chamomile.

Finish: Mellow and slightly grassy, with sweet mead, nutmeg and sticky almond syrup.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

whisky-trail-invergordon-1987-cask-88799.title: Whisky Trail Invergordon 1987 Cask 88799
whisky-trail-invergordon-1987-cask-88799.bodyHtml:

It is bottled at 52.7% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Elixir Distillers bottles single casks from across Scotland in its Whisky Trail series, each with its own illustrated label.

Nose: Pear-and-almond cake, a spicy-sweet note like cayenne on honey-glazed sweet potato, crisp paper and wilting lilies.

Palate: Tonka beans, a flaky maple-and-pecan pastry, lucuma caramel and sweet strawberry candy floss.

Finish: Star anise and dusty dark chocolate, rounded off by dried lemon.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

boldr-ruby-grapefruit-vodka-soda.title: Deep Eddy Ruby Red Grapefruit Vodka
boldr-ruby-grapefruit-vodka-soda.bodyHtml:
Deep Eddy Ruby Red Grapefruit Vodka is made in Austin, Texas by Deep Eddy Distilling Co. It starts with the brand's award-winning Original Vodka, distilled from corn, which is then blended with real ruby red grapefruit juice for a flavour that is both sweet and tart. Bottled at 35% ABV (70 proof) in a 750ml bottle, it is a bright, easy mixer for summer drinks.

Tasting Notes: Sweet and tart ruby red grapefruit.

Serve: With soda and a squeeze of lime, or in a Ruby Paloma with silver tequila, grapefruit and lime juice topped with club soda.

dugat-gevrey-chambertin-2014.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2022
dugat-gevrey-chambertin-2014.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2022 is a brilliant, deeply reflective village-level wine that captures the superb fruit ripeness and energy of the 2022 Burgundy vintage. Sourced from choice parcels of ancient vines averaging over 50 years of age, this wine highlights the domain's contemporary shift under Loïc Dugat-Py toward a more ethereal, fruit-forward style while maintaining its signature old-vine concentration. In the glass, it reveals a bright, glossy ruby profile. The aromatics are highly expressive and perfumed, leaping forward with a sophisticated medley of fresh strawberries, dark raspberries, and black cherries, layered with subtle hints of rose petals, wet stone minerality, and fine baking spice. dugat-charmes-chambertin-grand-cru-2018.title: Louis Jadot Chambertin Grand Cru 2018
dugat-charmes-chambertin-grand-cru-2018.bodyHtml:
Meaty and tannic with aromas and flavors of licorice and brush, this is a wine for cellaring 5 years before opening, and 20 or more in the finest vintages.

Serve with game and mushroom dishes.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Purchased as wine, the 2018 Chambertin Grand Cru (Maison Louis Jadot) is more overtly marked by new oak than the domaine's Clos de Bèze that preceded it, revealing vanillin-inflected aromas of ripe red fruits and spices. On the palate, it's full-bodied, velvety and enveloping, with a ripe and charming profile.

Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes 2017 is a masterfully crafted, rare blend sourced from the estate's choice Premier Cru plots of old vines. The 2017 growing season yielded a remarkably classic, supple, and expressive style of Burgundy, allowing this wine to showcase its deep old-vine density without the severe youthful austerity often found in cooler years. In the glass, it shows a luminous, translucent ruby color. The bouquet is highly refined and seductive, opening with bright aromas of black and red cherry, raspberry, and crushed violets, balanced by complex undertones of sweet baking spices, damp earth, and gentle wood smoke. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, harmonious, and exquisitely balanced. Velvety, integrated tannins seamlessly frame a deep core of pure fruit and chalky mineral depth, while a fresh vein of natural acidity provides excellent lift and length.

dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-vieilles-2016.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2016
dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-vieilles-2016.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes 2016 is a sensational, highly structured village-level Burgundy possessing the depth and seriousness of a Premier Cru. The 2016 vintage is widely celebrated for its remarkable freshness, purity of fruit, and classic structural framing. Sourced from ancient massal-selection vines between 30 and 60 years old, this wine pours a deep ruby color. The nose is highly complex, revealing precise aromas of crisp blackberry, wild raspberry, and licorice, seamlessly interwoven with undertones of rich soil, grilled meat, and fine wood smoke. On the palate, it is full-bodied and incredibly dense, balancing its compact, old-vine concentration with a spine of vibrant, mouth-watering acidity. Its firm, muscular chassis of tannin provides a strong structural foundation that carries into an exceptionally long, chalky, and beautifully linear finish. While beginning to show great complexity now, it has the stamina for extensive cellaring.

Food Pairing: Slow-cooked beef bourguignon, roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, or wild mushroom tart.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes, which comes from vines between 30 and 50 years old and matured in 30% to 40% new oak with a small amount of whole cluster, has a crisp stony, blackberry and bilberry-scented bouquet, not powerful but precise. The palate is marked by slight chalky tannin, linear and strict, full of energy with a smudge of raspberry preserve hanging around on the aftertaste. Give this Vieilles Vignes three or four years in bottle just to abrade those tannins.

hennessy-double.title: Hennessy XO Cognac
hennessy-double.bodyHtml:
Hennessy XO Cognac is a world-renowned, ultra-premium cognac originally created in 1870 by Maurice Hennessy for his close circle of friends. It is a masterful, complex blend of over 100 different eaux-de-vie sourced from the finest terroirs of the Cognac region, each meticulously aged in French oak barrels for up to 30 years. This long and patient maturation process gives the cognac its iconic, deep amber color and a legendary, multi-layered profile characterized by intense flavors of candied fruit, wild cocoa, and robust wood spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with rich dark chocolate truffles, slow-cooked duck breast with cherry glaze, dry-aged ribeye steak, or a selection of aged cheeses like Roquefort.

TASTING NOTES - A deep, intense ochre-amber color with a remarkably rich, full-bodied, and velvety smooth mouthfeel.

NOSE - Extremely rich and expressive with dominant notes of candied orange, dried figs, sweet plums, fresh-grated cinnamon, and toasted oak.

PALATE - Robust and deeply complex on the tongue, offering powerful layers of warm chocolate, sweet honey, ground black pepper, leather, and oaky vanilla.

FINISH - Exceptionally long, warm, and elegant with lingering nuances of sweet cinnamon spice, dark cocoa, and refined, smoky wood.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat in a tulip glass, on the rocks, or with a splash of cold spring water to release its deeply nested aromas.

mudshake-salted-caramel.title: Crown Royal Salted Caramel
mudshake-salted-caramel.bodyHtml: Crown Royal Salted Caramel Flavored Whisky is a limited edition flavor, available only in the winter months to bring a little festive sweetness to your holiday season. A blend of the finest Canadian whiskies, carefully selected by our Master Blenders and infused with the subtly salty-sweet taste of indulgent salted caramels ? imparting lush, creamy notes that perfectly compliment the richness of Crown Royal Whisky

diamond-creek-mixed-6-pack-2018.title: Diamond Creek Mixed Pack 2021 6 x 750ml
diamond-creek-mixed-6-pack-2018.bodyHtml:
The Diamond Creek Mixed 6 Pack 2021 is an exclusive collection of single-vineyard Cabernet Sauvignons from one of Napa Valley's most historic estates. The 2021 vintage was heavily impacted by drought, resulting in the lowest overall yields in over a decade. These smaller berries produced wines of remarkable concentration and depth. This specific mixed case typically contains two bottles of each of the estate's primary vineyard designates: Volcanic Hill, Red Rock Terrace, and Gravelly Meadow.

Diamond Creek Volcanic Hill Cabernet Sauvignon 2021

99 Points - James Suckling

Amazing aromas of red currants, blackcurrants, lavender and violets, as well as some black ink and graphite. The tannins are totally integrated into the wine. They are melted into the fruit, giving a tension and magic that is seldom seen. It goes on for minutes. Tight at the end. A blend of 97% cabernet sauvignon and 7% petit verdot. It’s just a baby, but you’ll want to drink it already. Better after 2029.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Volcanic Hill is a 313-case blend of 93% Cabernet Sauvignon and 7% Petit Verdot. Scents of crushed stone accent plummy, black cherry fruit on the nose, while the medium to full-bodied palate includes some cooling overtones to the dark fruit. Ripe, silky and long on the finish, it expresses Napa fruit while remaining supremely elegant.

Diamond Creek Red Rock Terrace Cabernet Sauvignon 2021

97 Points - James Suckling

The red currant, red rose, bark and mushroom character comes through on the nose. Graphite undertones and a medium to full body with very fine tannins that are silky textured in nature. Creamy, friendly, transparent and vivid. Mostly cabernet sauvignon with some petite verdot and malbec. Needs three or four years to come around.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of 88% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6% each Malbec and Petit Verdot, the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Red Rock Terrace features a dusting of dried spices over a bed of mixed red and black cherries. It's medium to full-bodied, firmly structured but ripe. Yes, the cherries and red raspberries on the lingering finish are coated in dusty tannins, but the wine is still not completely unapproachable.

Diamond Creek Gravelly Meadow Cabernet Sauvignon 2021

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Gravelly Meadow includes 16% Merlot and 8% Malbec. It's a red-fruited effort, with bright cherries complemented by some herbal notes. In the mouth, the wine is medium to full-bodied, silky textured and elegant, with hints of toasty oak and red berries lingering on the finish. Not particularly tannic, it should be approachable within a few years and drink well for at least 10 to 15 years after that. At just 267 cases produced, it's the smallest production of the three single-vineyard wines this year.

woodford-reserve-batch-proof.title: Woodford Reserve Distiller's Select Kentucky Straight Bourbon
woodford-reserve-batch-proof.bodyHtml:
Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a flagship premium bourbon crafted at the historic Woodford Reserve Distillery in Versailles, Kentucky. Distilled using a combination of pot stills and column stills, then matured in handcrafted new charred oak barrels, it offers a rich, complex, and balanced flavor profile with notes of dried fruit, vanilla, toasted oak, and rye spice.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, glazed pecans, dark chocolate, pecan pie, or aged cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant honey amber with a smooth, rich, and rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Heavy with rich dried fruit, subtle cocoa, vanilla, tobacco leaf, and toasted oak.

Palate : Citrus, cinnamon, cocoa, toffee, caramel, and warm rye spice layered over sweet corn and oak.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with a satisfyingly crisp finish and lingering spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as the foundation for a classic Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

tomatin-highland-single-malt-1977.title: Tomatin Legacy Single Malt Scotch Whisky
tomatin-highland-single-malt-1977.bodyHtml: When Tomatin Distillery was established in 1897, the isolated and idyllic setting of  Tomatin was almost perfect. However there wasn’t a local workforce; the local inhabitants were scattered shepherds and cattle drovers. The company began a project of construction to accommodate its workforce. Since that time the distillery has been at the heart of the community and the community at the heart of the distillery. This legacy has continued and Tomatin remains one of the few distilleries to provide a home for its dedicated craftsmen.Time in Bourbon barrels and Virgin Oak casks brings a light sweetness to The Tomatin Legacy, a non-peaty scotch which boasts aromas of vanilla bean, white chocolate and cinnamon. On the palate gentle waves of fresh fruit peppered with ginger emerge ahead of a light, clean finish.

port-ellen-35-yo-1983-release-11535.title: Port Ellen 35 Year Old 1983 Release 11535
port-ellen-35-yo-1983-release-11535.bodyHtml:
Port Ellen 35 Year Old 1983 Release No. 11535 is a rare Islay single malt Scotch whisky from The Character of Islay Whisky Company's The Stories of Wind & Wave range. It was distilled in 1983 at Port Ellen, among the last spirit made on the original stills before the distillery closed that year, and bottled in 2020 after 35 years. Presented at 47.9% ABV in a 700ml bottle with a tube, this limited release offers a taste of historic Islay: peat smoke and charcoal balanced by tropical fruit, sea salt and gentle sweetness.

Nose: Distinct smoke and oak charcoal, flinty notes, toasted almonds and fresh barley, with hints of citrus, barley sugar and iodine.

Palate: Old-style Islay peat with tangy sweet smoke and charcoal, peaty salinity and tropical fruit, sweet spices and a creamy chocolate note.

Serve: Neat, with time to breathe in the glass.

sarl-daucourt-moulin-vodka.title: Sarl Daucourt Moulin Vodka
sarl-daucourt-moulin-vodka.bodyHtml:
Moulin Vodka is a French wheat vodka made by Daucourt in Angoulême, in the Charente region of western France. It is distilled from French wheat seven times and then refined in a three-stage process that includes aeration and charcoal filtration, giving a clean spirit with a satiny texture. The vodka was created by its master distiller as a tribute to his grandfather and draws on a family distilling heritage of seven generations. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle and is equally suited to sipping on the rocks or mixing into a classic Martini.

Tasting Notes: Lime zest, bison grass, whipped cream, vanilla, pear and sweet wheat pastry.

Nose: Fresh and delicate, with zested lime, bison grass and whipped cream.

Palate: Subtle vanilla, pear and sweet wheat pastry.

Finish: Light and balanced, with a gentle peppery edge.

Serve: Well chilled and neat, over ice, or as the base of a Martini or highball.

glenfiddich-40yr-old.title: Glenfiddich 15 Year Old Solera
glenfiddich-40yr-old.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 15 Year Old Solera is an exceptionally distinct and innovative Speyside single malt Scotch whisky that showcases the revolutionary Solera process pioneered by Glenfiddich in 1998. This rich, complex spirit is matured in three distinct types of oak casks: European oak sherry, American bourbon, and brand-new virgin oak casks. After fifteen years, these whiskies are married together in a massive, handcrafted Douglas Fir Solera Vat that is kept permanently at least half-full, a method inspired by the sherry bodegas of Spain. This continuous marriage ensures an incredibly harmonious profile, infusing the whisky with deep layers of warm spice, honey, and rich fruit that make it stand out as a true benchmark of modern malt craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with dark chocolate truffles, caramelized pear tart, roasted venison with a berry reduction, or aged cheeses like Gouda and Comté.

Tasting Notes : Luminous golden amber appearance with a smooth, velvety, and silky medium-to-full body on the palate.

Nose : Intriguingly complex aroma with sweet heather honey, vanilla fudge, rich dark fruits, citrus zest, and delicate warm oak.

Palate : Silky smooth with rich layers of sherry sweetness, raisins, marzipan, cinnamon, ginger, candied orange peel, and toasted oak.

Finish : Rich and sweet with a satisfyingly long, warm, and lingering oak spice finish.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature or with a few drops of spring water in a Glencairn glass.

glen-grant-mr-george-legacy-1st-ed-1953.title: Gordon & MacPhail Mr George Legacy First Edition Glen Grant 67 Year Old 1953 Cask #4209 59.4% ABV
glen-grant-mr-george-legacy-1st-ed-1953.bodyHtml:
Distilled at the Glen Grant Distillery, this fantastic malt was originally laid down on the 24th of December 1953 by Mr George Urquhart where it spent the next 67 years in first-fill sherry butt #4209. Bottled on the 5th of January 2021 by Gordon & MacPhail, this is one of just 355 bottles produced. Dedicated to the man who originally laid down this whisky, this is a fitting tribute to his lifelong love of whisky.

COLOUR: Darkest Mahogany

AROMA: Soft aromas of BEESWAX POLISH give way to STEWED FRUIT and TOASTED HAZELNUTS. Subtle ORANGE PEEL complements rich GINGER notes.

TASTE: AUTUMNAL SPICE and ripe PLUM flavours combine with light BLACKCURRANT undertones. TREACLE comes to the fore alongside a light touch of FRESH MINT.

FINISH: A full bodied and long finish with lingering FRUIT, SPICE and a delicate hint of BONFIRE EMBERS.

hells-basement-fruited-sour.title: Hell's Basement Arak Baladi
hells-basement-fruited-sour.bodyHtml:
Hell's Basement Arak Baladi is an arak produced in Alberta by Hell's Basement, bottled at a robust 50% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Arak is the anise-flavoured spirit traditional across the Levant, and a local Alberta take on the style makes an interesting alternative for fans of anise spirits.

Serve: Traditionally diluted with chilled water over ice, which turns it cloudy white.

town-square-chiquita-mexican-cerveza.title: Town Sq 2D Sour IPA 4 Tall Cans
town-square-chiquita-mexican-cerveza.bodyHtml: Dimensions collide as two styles become one. New England IPA and Kettle Sour blend into a potent mix of sour, sweet, and juicy. A super sour base with Mosaic hops creates the first dimension. A New England haze bomb with a monstrous dry hop of Citra, Mosaic, and El Dorado adds the second dimension. Passion Fruit and Mango start up front, sour in the middle, and then a juicy finish

whisky-trail-glenburgie-21yr-cask-751398.title: Whisky Trail Glenburgie 21 Year Old Cask 751398
whisky-trail-glenburgie-21yr-cask-751398.bodyHtml:
This Glenburgie was distilled in 1998 and matured for 21 years in a single hogshead (cask 751398) before independent bottler Elixir Distillers released it in its Whisky Trail series, under a label titled 'The Glenburgie Jamboree'. A Speyside single malt Scotch whisky, it is bottled at 56.7% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Elixir Distillers bottles single casks from across Scotland in its Whisky Trail series, each with its own illustrated label.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

whistlepig-15-year-old.title: WhistlePig PiggyBack 6 Year Old Bourbon
whistlepig-15-year-old.bodyHtml: PiggyBack 100 Proof Bourbon gives our bold approach to whiskey a sweeter spin.Born from our signature grain’s other half, it starts with a high Corn mash bill (keeping a dash of Rye of course). Six long years of age in Char #3 barrels adds layers of flavor before bottling at 100 Proof, so you can keep it 100 whether you choose Bourbon or Rye.Sip it neat or shake it in a classic. With its sweeter profile, PiggyBack 100 Proof Bourbon shines in citrus and sour drinks – like our Barrel Aged Maple Bourbon Sour.

1976-glencraig-42-6.title: Signatory Glencraig 1976 40 Year Old 42.6% ABV
1976-glencraig-42-6.bodyHtml:
A single cask 1976 Glencraig 40-year-old bottled without colouring or chill filtration in 2017 by Signatory Vintage for their Rare Reserve Cask Strength Collection.

Glencraig is very rare to see now – this was an experimental single malt whisky made separately on Lomond stills at the Glenburgie distillery between 1958 and 1981. Signatory have bottled several outstanding Glencraig malt whiskies, and this 1976 40-year-old is one of their finest, bottled from a single hogshead cask #4253 that yielded 192 bottles at its natural strength of 42.6%.

xop-port-ellen-35yo-1983.title: XOP Port Ellen 35 Year Old 1983
xop-port-ellen-35yo-1983.bodyHtml:
Port Ellen 35 Year Old 1983 is a single cask Islay single malt bottled by Douglas Laing for its Xtra Old Particular range. Distilled in March 1983, one of the final months of production before the distillery closed, it matured in a single refill hogshead (cask DL13765) and was bottled in February 2019. Just 133 bottles were hand filled at natural cask strength of 54.3% ABV, with no added colouring and no chill-filtration, and each comes in a wooden XOP presentation box. A collectable piece of Islay history.

Nose: Sweet leather with gentle peat smoke and salted caramel.

Palate: Damp ash, charred oak and burnt-sugar sweetness.

Finish: Long, with hints of coffee and candied ginger in a sweetly smoked style.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

dalmore-rare-fine-35-year-old.title: The Dalmore 12 Year Old
dalmore-rare-fine-35-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore 12 Year Old is a benchmark Highland single malt Scotch whisky recognized for its rich, complex, and deeply sherried character. The spirit is masterfully guided through an intricate maturation process overseen by the distillery's legendary blenders; it is aged for its first nine years in American white oak ex-bourbon barrels before being split. Half remains in the bourbon casks, while the other half is transferred to premium rare 30-year-old Matusalem Oloroso sherry butts for the final three years, creating a beautifully balanced whisky that drinks well beyond its age.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate, sticky toffee pudding, roasted almonds, or a fine maduro cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber in appearance with a rich, smooth, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Citrus fruits, chocolate, orange marmalade, sweet spices, and rich malt.

Palate : Citrus, Seville oranges, dried fruit, dark chocolate, vanilla, and hints of cinnamon.

Finish : Medium to long with lingering roasted coffee, dark chocolate, and warm oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of water, or over a large ice cube.

hardy-lalique-printemps.title: Hardy Cognac Lalique Le Printemps
hardy-lalique-printemps.bodyHtml:
Hardy Cognac Le Printemps opens Maison Hardy's Four Seasons collection, made with the Lalique crystal house, and carries a green crystal crown sculpted with vine leaves. For this blend the cellar master selected exceptional Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie, chosen by Armand Hardy and gathered between the two world wars for their finesse; they are among the rarest in Hardy's Paradis, the cellar holding its oldest stocks. The result is a vibrant cognac with delicate floral notes, the first stage in the collection's aromatic journey through the seasons. The eaux-de-vie come from Ugni Blanc, Folle Blanche and Colombard grapes, and the cognac is bottled at 41% ABV in a 750 ml Lalique decanter.

Tasting Notes: Floral and vibrant, with dried and candied fruit and a rancio finish.

Nose: Floral and charming, with iris and hawthorn.

Palate: Prune and crystallised orange.

Finish: Rancio.

Serve: Neat, in a tulip glass at room temperature.

hardy-lalique-lete.title: Hardy Cognac Lalique L'Été
hardy-lalique-lete.bodyHtml:
Hardy Cognac L'Été is the second decanter in Maison Hardy's Four Seasons collection, made with the Lalique crystal house. Its amber crystal crown is sculpted with bunches of grapes, as if gilded by the summer sun. For this blend the cellar master used exceptional batches of Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie selected by Armand Hardy, building a gourmet cognac with sweet notes of honey and apricot: a different blend from Le Printemps, with a more honeyed development that marks the second stage in the collection's aromatic journey. The eaux-de-vie come from Ugni Blanc, Folle Blanche and Colombard grapes, and the cognac is bottled at 41% ABV in a 750 ml Lalique decanter.

Tasting Notes: Honeyed and gourmet, with apricot sweetness and a rancio finish.

Nose: Hay, fig and plum.

Palate: Honey, cinnamon and a hint of coffee.

Finish: Rancio.

Serve: Neat, in a tulip glass at room temperature.

hardy-lalique-lautomne.title: Hardy Cognac Lalique L'Automne
hardy-lalique-lautomne.bodyHtml:
Hardy Cognac L'Automne is the third decanter in Maison Hardy's Four Seasons collection, made with the Lalique crystal house. Its red crystal crown, sculpted with vine leaves, sits on a decanter of rare Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie that the house gathered between the two world wars for their finesse, drawn from its Paradis, the cellar holding Hardy's oldest stocks. The cellar master chose this blend to express autumn, with citrus and candied-fruit character. The eaux-de-vie come from Ugni Blanc, Folle Blanche and Colombard grapes, and the cognac is bottled at 41% ABV in a 750 ml Lalique decanter.

Tasting Notes: Citrus and candied fruit leading to a rancio finish.

Nose: Cherry kernel, citrus and candied orange.

Palate: Suave, with candied apricot and raisins.

Finish: Rancio.

Serve: Neat, in a tulip glass at room temperature.

hardy-lalique-lhiver.title: Hardy Cognac Lalique L'Hiver
hardy-lalique-lhiver.bodyHtml:
Hardy Cognac L'Hiver closes Maison Hardy's Four Seasons collection, made with the Lalique crystal house. The ice-blue crystal crown on the decanter stands for the dormant winter vines, and inside is a blend of century-old Grande Champagne cognacs: eaux-de-vie gathered between the two world wars for their finesse and counted among the rarest in Hardy's Paradis, the cellar of its oldest stocks. Oak and candied orange are lifted by touches of cardamom and cloves. The eaux-de-vie come from Ugni Blanc, Folle Blanche and Colombard grapes, and the cognac is bottled at 41% ABV in a 750 ml Lalique decanter.

Tasting Notes: Oak and candied orange with cardamom and clove spice and a very long finish.

Nose: Oak and candied orange.

Palate: Hints of cardamom and cloves.

Finish: Exceptionally long.

Serve: Neat, in a tulip glass at room temperature.

iceberg.title: Iceberg Vodka with Bonus 50ml
iceberg.bodyHtml:
Iceberg Vodka is a Canadian vodka made with water from real icebergs. This pack pairs a 750ml bottle with a bonus 50ml bottle. Each spring a crew harvests icebergs that have broken away from Arctic glaciers and drifted past the coast of Newfoundland; the ice, frozen for thousands of years, is melted in a controlled environment and blended with a triple-distilled neutral spirit made from Canadian corn, then charcoal filtered. The company says every step, from foraging the ice to distilling and bottling, happens in Canada. The result is a crystal-clear, gluten-free vodka with delicate citrus aromas, bottled at 40% ABV. Iceberg Vodka won Gold at the 2019 San Francisco World Spirits Competition and at the 2023 SIP Awards.

Nose: Delicate citrus.

Serve: Neat and well chilled, or in your favourite vodka cocktail.

canmore-brew-pit-stop-phuzzy-peach-sour.bodyHtml: Canmore Brewing Misty Mountain Hops Neip 4 Tall Cans

tobermory-42yo.title: Tobermory 42 Year Old 47.7%
tobermory-42yo.bodyHtml:
An 42 year old single malt Scotch whisky from Tobermory! An extraordinarily well-aged whisky from the distillery on the Isle of Mull, which even contains some of the first spirit produced when the distillery was reopened in 1972! A release of only 650 bottles.

Nose: Massive waves of dark chocolate, tobacco, Sherry-soaked raisins and roasted chestnuts. A touch of liquorice root.

Palate: More roasted chestnut, now with notes of oily walnut and dry oak. Cherry, redcurrant, thick treacle and a touch of cracked black pepper.

Finish: Dry spices last ages on the finish, with chocolate-covered raisins bringing a balancing sweetness.

hard-ice-peach-party.title: Twisted Tea Party Pack 24 x 355ml Cans
hard-ice-peach-party.bodyHtml: The Twisted Tea Party Pack is the ultimate collection for fans of hard iced tea, offering a diverse selection of non-carbonated, refreshing malt beverages in a convenient large-format pack. This 24-can variety collection features the flagship Original Hard Iced Tea alongside a range of popular fruit-infused flavours, typically including Half & Half (Lemonade), Peach, and Raspberry. Each style is crafted with real brewed tea and natural fruit flavours, delivering a smooth, "easy-drinking" profile that perfectly balances sweetness with a crisp, clean finish. Because these teas are non-carbonated, they offer a unique and refreshing alternative to traditional beers and sparkling coolers, making the Party Pack a perennial favorite for large social gatherings, beach days, and backyard celebrations.

hennessy-vs-very-special-nba-edition.title: Hennessy VS Cognac x NBA Limited Edition
hennessy-vs-very-special-nba-edition.bodyHtml:
Hennessy Very Special (V.S) is one of the most popular cognacs in the world. Matured in new oak barrels, Hennessy V.S is bold and fragrant. Its beguiling character is uniquely Hennessy, a timeless choice with an intensity all its own. Hennessy V.S offers toasted and fruit notes  with a rich, clearly defined palate and a welcoming exuberance.

Hennessy V.S expresses its vibrant and dynamic personality through unique artist partnerships and annual limited editions. Easy to enjoy, it’s a perfect cognac for high-energy occasions and sharing the moment.

The round and robust flavours of Hennessy V.S make it very versatile and ideal for any cocktail possibility, from classic recipes and sophisticated cocktail creations to easy mixed drinks.

xop-black-bunnahabhain-1990-30yo.title: XOP Black Bunnahabhain 1990 30 Year Old
xop-black-bunnahabhain-1990-30yo.bodyHtml:
Bunnahabhain 30 Year Old 1990 is a single cask Islay single malt from Douglas Laing's Xtra Old Particular (XOP) The Black Series. Distilled at Bunnahabhain in November 1990, it spent three decades in a single refill hogshead before bottling in April 2021 at its natural cask strength of 43.5% ABV, with no added colouring and no chill filtration. Just 291 bottles were filled, each presented in the Black Series box.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla and honeyed barley lead to citrus and dried fruit with a gentle coastal edge.

Nose: Vanilla pods, honeyed barley, creamy caramel and charred oak.

Palate: Tangy citrus, juicy sultanas and dried apricots with a slight coastal quality.

Finish: Tangerine zest, milk chocolate and candied nuts with hints of seaweed.

Serve: Neat, adding a few drops of water if desired.

xop-caol-ila-1980-40yo.title: XOP Caol Ila 1980 40 Year Old
xop-caol-ila-1980-40yo.bodyHtml:
XOP Caol Ila 1980 40 Year Old is a single cask Islay single malt from Douglas Laing's Xtra Old Particular range. Distilled at Caol Ila in September 1980, it spent four decades in a refill hogshead before bottling in June 2021 at a natural cask strength of 54.6% ABV. Only 206 bottles exist worldwide. After 40 years the peat has softened into a subtle, coastal smokiness, with leather, spice and honey-glazed smoked meat on the palate. 700ml.

Nose: Immediately oceanic, with classic West Coast character and subtle phenols.

Palate: Leather, malted barley, spices and a honey-glazed smoked meat quality.

Finish: More peat smoke, dried citrus fruit and oak bonfire embers.

Serve: Neat, with time to open in the glass.

xop-glen-grant-1985-35yo.title: XOP Glen Grant 1985 35 Year Old 55.5% ABV

private-collection-3-glen-grant-1948.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glen Grant 1948 70 Year Old 48.6% ABV
private-collection-3-glen-grant-1948.bodyHtml:
THE OLDEST GLEN GRANT EXPRESSION EVER BOTTLED

The oldest release from the famous Glen Grant distillery, bottled by Gordon & MacPhail for its Private Collection series, is a stunning 70-year-old Speyside single malt that has been aged in a single, first-fill sherry butt. Initially sweet on the nose, it has aromas of vanilla fudge, strawberries and raspberries, developing into waxy notes of orange peel and cinnamon sticks. The palate is smooth and subtle; sherry-soaked fruits mix with fresh orange zest and cardamom. A dry, herbal element develops and brings cracked black pepper and aniseed notes, then a delicate smoke carries through to a long, smooth finish.

glenfarclas-family-cask-1983-w18.title: Glenfarclas 'The Family Casks' 1983 Winter 2018 Cask 28 Refill Hogshead
glenfarclas-family-cask-1983-w18.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 'The Family Casks' 1983 is a single cask Highland single malt from the Winter 2018 release of the Grant family's celebrated vintage series, distilled and bottled at Glenfarclas Distillery on Speyside. Distilled in 1983, it matured in a refill hogshead (cask 28) and was bottled on 6 December 2018, some 35 years later, at 48.8% ABV. Only 272 bottles of 700ml were filled from the cask. The Family Casks collection exists thanks to the foresight of George S Grant: Glenfarclas holds casks from the last eight decades, and each release captures the character of a single year in the distillery's history. Each bottle comes in the series' wooden presentation box, with the distillation year, cask number and bottling details printed on the label - a natural gift for a birth year or anniversary.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a nosing glass. Give it time in the glass and add water only a drop at a time, if at all.

g-m-private-collection-glenlivet-1975.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glenlivet 1975 45 Year Old 55.6% ABV
g-m-private-collection-glenlivet-1975.bodyHtml: ‘Private Collection’ features a truly exceptional and unique range of greatly aged single malts from a mixture of celebrated, little-known and now closed distilleries across Scotland. Personally selected by members of the Urquhart family, owners of Gordon & MacPhail, each release in our 'Private Collection' is a unique and exquisite chapter in Scotland's history of whisky.

g-m-pc-glenlivet-1976-cask-1565.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glenlivet 1976 45 Year Old Cask #1565 43.9% ABV
g-m-pc-glenlivet-1976-cask-1565.bodyHtml: Sweet citrus notes are followed by rich fruitcake and butterscotch. Cinnamon and ginger spice complement subtle liquorice and oak. Smooth tobacco flavours give way to rich raisins and subtle white pepper. Stewed fruits combine with walnut and plum. A long finish with roasted nuts and fresh garden mint.

g-m-private-collection-glenlivet-1980.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glenlivet 1980 40 Year Old 42.6% ABV
g-m-private-collection-glenlivet-1980.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glenlivet 1980 40 Year Old is a rare, long-aged single malt from the Glenlivet distillery in Speyside, distilled in 1980 and bottled after four decades at 42.6% ABV. Gordon & MacPhail have filled and matured Glenlivet spirit for generations, and this Private Collection release shows how gracefully the distillery's soft, fruity style develops with time. Tropical fruit and tart lemon lead the nose, joined by peach, baked apple and dark honey; the palate is creamy with Seville orange, lemon zest, a flicker of fresh mint and almond, before a gentle, herbal finish. A 700ml bottling for the collector or a milestone celebration.

Tasting Notes: Tropical fruit, lemon, peach, baked apple, dark honey, Seville orange, almond.

Nose: Rich tropical fruit with a tart lemon edge; sweet peach, baked apple and dark honey.

Palate: Smooth and creamy with Seville orange and lemon zest, a hint of fresh mint, almond and mature oak.

Finish: Soft and delicate, with subtle herbal notes.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass at room temperature; add a few drops of water to open it up if you like.

g-m-private-collection-convalmore-1975.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Convalmore 1975 45 Year Old 47.9% ABV
g-m-private-collection-convalmore-1975.bodyHtml: Orange sherbet and lemon peel give way to subtle notes of rhubarb. Rose petal aromas develop with lime bitters and mature oak. Lemon drizzle cake flavours combine with orange oil and toasted almonds. Honeysuckle gives way to a soft herbal note and brown sugar. Full and creamy finish with lingering citrus and vanilla pod.

g-m-private-collection-glentauchers-1979.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glentauchers 1979 53.6% ABV
g-m-private-collection-glentauchers-1979.bodyHtml:
Producer Tasting Note

Nose: Sweet toffee and candied orange aromas with silky white chocolate and sugared violets. Tropical fruit notes come to the fore with hints of coconut and ripe banana. A nutty note lingers in the background.

Taste: Intense sweetness to begin then fading to reveal herbal aniseed and peppery notes. Dried tropical fruit; pineapple, lime, and coconut flavours complement madagascan vanilla pod.

Finish: Rounded, with lingering vanilla tones with an herbal edge.

g-m-private-collection-pulteney-1982.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Pulteney 1982 38 Year Old 57.1% ABV
g-m-private-collection-pulteney-1982.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Pulteney 1982 38 Year Old is a single cask Highland single malt from the Pulteney distillery. Distilled in 1982, it matured in a refill American oak hogshead and was bottled late in 2020 at a remarkably robust 57.1% ABV after 38 years in wood. This is the 750ml bottling from the Private Collection, Gordon & MacPhail's range of greatly aged single malts. The refill American oak keeps the spirit bright and honeyed: honey, lime zest and vanilla on the nose, apple, fudge, melon and lemon on the palate with soft white pepper, and a smooth finish of toasted oak.

Tasting Notes: Honey, lime zest, vanilla, apple, fudge, honeydew melon, lemon, toasted oak.

Nose: Rich honey with sweet lime zest and vanilla.

Palate: A gentle apple note and a hint of fudge, then honeydew melon and lemon with soft white pepper.

Finish: Medium-bodied and smooth, with toasted oak.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass at room temperature; add a few drops of water to open it up if you like.

g-m-benromach-heritage-1977.title: Benromach Heritage 1977 Single Cask 622
g-m-benromach-heritage-1977.bodyHtml:
Benromach Heritage 1977 is a single cask Speyside single malt from cask 622, distilled in 1977 at the Benromach distillery in Forres, long before Gordon & MacPhail bought the then-silent distillery in 1993. The spirit matured for some 42 years in a refill American oak hogshead and was bottled in 2019 at 42.1% ABV, giving just 154 bottles of 700ml. A rare survivor from the original distillery's stocks, it is a collector's whisky from one of the few casks of that era still in existence.

Serve: Neat, with time in the glass.

g-m-generations-glenlivet-80-yo.title: Gordon & MacPhail Generations Glenlivet 80 Year Old 44.9% ABV
g-m-generations-glenlivet-80-yo.bodyHtml:
On 3rd February 1940 in a quiet corner in the north of Scotland, George Urquhart and his father, John, had the extraordinary foresight and vision to lay down spirit from Glenlivet Distillery in a bespoke Gordon & MacPhail cask to be enjoyed by future generations. The stunning concept and presentation of the Generations 80YO was created by internationally acclaimed architect and designer, Sir David Adjaye OBE.


On 5th February 2020, leaning on the unique skill and experience acquired by over more than 125 years, the decision was taken to finally bottle the cask’s precious out-turn of 250 decanters.


From whisky writer, Charlie MacLean: "A complex, mellow nose-feel, still vivacious after all these years. Top notes of almond oil, scented hand-soap, backed by sandalwood and gorse flowers on a warm day. A whiff of peat-smoke in the empty glass. An oily texture, and lightly sweet to start, drying elegantly, towards a lengthy menthol finish. Vibrant and wholly satisfying. One of the finest malts I have ever encountered. "


As part of the project launch, colleagues at Gordon & MacPhail have been actively involved in personally planting trees – including oaks - at Glen Affric as part of our partnership with charity partner, Trees for Life. With a mission to rewild The Caledonian Forest, Trees for Life will receive proceeds, minus costs, from the Sotheby’s auction of Generations decanter #1 in Hong Kong on 2nd October 2021.

smirnoff-ice-peach-lemonade.title: Smirnoff Peach Vodka
smirnoff-ice-peach-lemonade.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Peach is infused with the natural flavor of juicy peaches for a sweet and fruity taste. This spirit has a pleasant sweetness and pairs best with soda water, lemonade, or iced tea. Smirnoff Peach is Kosher Certified and gluten free.

xop-craigellachie-1995-25-yo.title: XOP Craigellachie 1995 25 Year Old
xop-craigellachie-1995-25-yo.bodyHtml:
Craigellachie 25 Year Old 1995 is a single cask Speyside single malt from Douglas Laing's Xtra Old Particular (XOP) range. Distilled in September 1995, it spent 25 years in one refill sherry butt before bottling in June 2021 at its natural cask strength of 53.7% ABV, with no added colouring and no chill filtration. Only 219 bottles exist, each presented in an XOP wooden box.

Tasting Notes: Citrus and baking notes, leather and oak, then a long, fruity finish.

Nose: Waxed lemon, warmed pecans, golden syrup and home baking.

Palate: New leather, fresh oak and Speyside malted barley.

Finish: Exceptionally long, with glazed red apple, strawberry candyfloss and raspberry creme brulee.

Serve: Neat, adding a few drops of water if desired.

Nose : Tropical aromas featuring sweet papaya, juicy pineapple, exotic dragonfruit, ripe mango, fragrant blueberry, white peach, tart passionfruit, and kiwi.

Palate : Crisp and lively with a balance of sweet and sour fruit notes, showcasing bold dual-fruit flavours of tropical papaya-pineapple, dragonfruit-mango, sweet blueberry-peach, and zesty passionfruit-kiwi.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering sweet tropical fruit notes and a bubbly carbonated finish.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled straight from a cold tall can or poured over fresh ice in a glass.

Good Day Peach Soju is a refreshing fruit-flavoured Korean spirit produced by Muhak in South Korea. Nose: Pleasant aromas of ripe peaches with delicate fruity sweetness.

woodford-reserve-do-personal-barrel.title: Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Bourbon
woodford-reserve-do-personal-barrel.bodyHtml:
Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Bourbon is an innovative, twice-barreled Kentucky straight bourbon produced at the Woodford Reserve Distillery in Versailles, Kentucky. First matured in handcrafted new white oak barrels, the bourbon is then transferred to a second, heavily toasted and lightly charred oak barrel for additional aging, extracting deep notes of dark caramel, hazelnut, apple, and rich oak spice.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, crème brûlée, pecan pie, smoked brisket, or blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber to dark copper in appearance with a rich, heavy, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich notes of dark fruit, caramel, honey, chocolate, marzipan, and toasted oak.

Palate : Full-bodied with layers of vanilla, dark caramel, hazelnut, apple, sweet baking spices, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, creamy, and lingering with notes of warm oak spice, honey, and subtle apple.

Serve : Serve neat, over a large ice cube, or as an elevated modifier in a classic Old Fashioned.

analog-ipa-jam-dipa.title: Analog Ready Paler Two 4 Tall Cans
analog-ipa-jam-dipa.bodyHtml: Refreshing and approachable, this session IPA is clean and citrusy with a dry finish. Pack with Citra, Mosiac, El Dorado and Simcoe this beer is hop forward without being bitter. Expect citrusy and tropical notes, with a classic West Coast IPA clean finish.

springbank-30-yo.title: Caskshare Collective Series Springbank 30 Year Old 1993 Bourbon Cask 164 49.4% ABV
springbank-30-yo.bodyHtml:

It comes in a 70cl bottle with a presentation box. The label note describes fresh apple and pine with a touch of sherbet, then a tangy, almost fizzing palate of orchard fruit and lime pickle relish, and a long, nostalgic finish.

Nose: Fresh apple and pine with a lightly sweet sherbet note.

Palate: Tangy and fizzing, a funky mix of orchard fruit and lime pickle relish.

Finish: Long, with notes the bottler likens to a school gym, new rubber plimsolls and tuck-shop sweets.

Serve: Neat, with a drop of water if desired.

g-m-private-collection-mortlach-1974.bodyHtml: Sherry aromas are followed by brown sugar, rum and raisin and warm spices. Smooth and rich; flavours of ripe forest fruits and fragrant blood orange peel are complemented by subtle traces of white pepper. Cinnamon comes to the fore alongside intense dark chocolate with mature oak. Long and smooth with lingering chocolate smothered almonds and oak tannins.
