veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-ro96.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut Rose 1996 3L Double Magnum
veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-ro96.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Cave Privée Brut Rosé 1996 is a prestigious, rare vintage Champagne crafted from exceptional Grand and Premier Cru vineyards across the Montagne de Reims, Grande Vallée de la Marne, and Côte des Blancs. Having spent decades resting on its lees in the chalk cellars of Reims, this mature cuvée exhibits a brilliant amber-copper hue with extremely fine, delicate effervescence. The complex nose opens with rich, evolved aromas of dried red berries, candied orange peel, dried apricot, and roasted hazelnut, grounded by tertiary hints of truffle, smoked spice, and toasted brioche. On the palate, it exhibits extraordinary structure, combining a rich, creamy texture with the sharp, driving acidity characteristic of the legendary 1996 vintage, finishing with immense length and chalky mineral complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with roasted duck breast, seared venison, wild mushroom risotto, pan-roasted pigeon, aged Comté, or lobster thermidor.

veuve-clicquot-la-grande-dame-2008.title: Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame 2008 3L Double Magnum
veuve-clicquot-la-grande-dame-2008.bodyHtml:
La Grande Dame, the prestige cuvée of Veuve Clicquot was created in tribute to Madame Clicquot. The finest expression of the House style it is a wine of incomparable finesse.

Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame 2008 is a great wine for gastronomy. This cuvée will pair extremely well with oysters, fish tartare, seafood or even chicken with sesame.

On the eye, La Grande Dame 2008 light gold color has a surprising glint. The initial nose reveals a strong attack, both aerial and delicate. Upon being released it presents notes of dried fruits (almonds, figs, apricots), ripe white fruits (pears), and finally, subtle toasted notes of hazelnut and praline. Thus, those luscious pastry notes are well balanced with the blend’s freshness and clarity.

On the palate, the attack is strong and sharp. La Grande Dame 2008 bestows a silky texture upon young fruits, carried by citrus and red fruits (cherry) notes. The Pinot Noir, a signature of the Veuve Clicquot’s style, shines extraordinarily by its freshness, minerality, and power. La Grande Dame 2008 is a perfect combination of complexity, structure, and strength.

La Grande Dame 2008 is an exclusive blend of 6 of the House’s 8 historical Grands Crus. 

97 Points - Decanter

Now almost blanc de noirs, boasting 92% Pinot Noir and just 8% Chardonnay from 60%-70% estate vineyards. La Grande Dame is one of the most affordable of Champagne’s elite prestige set, and the stunning 2008 vintage was intricately engineered by the masterful Dominique Demarville for the long haul. It unites all of the enduring potential of its thundering grands crus with the tension and energy of this legendary season, colliding high-tensile acidity with deep, fine, powdery chalk minerality, bringing its finish into stark focus.

95 Points - James Suckling

Still very youthful, this proves that pinot noir can give super-elegant, cool and tightly focused Champagne. Toastiness and spice build on the very long and tightly wound finish. Almost a blanc de noir with just 10% chardonnay blended into the overwhelming majority of pinot noir. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Exhibiting aromas of pear, toasted brad, confit citrus and smoke, the 2008 Brut La Grande Dame is full-bodied, rich and textural, with a deep and layered core, ripe but racy acids and a saline finish. A blend dominated by fully 92% Pinot Noir, this is true to the cuvée's rich and muscular style, but the vintage lends it welcome additional cut and precision. It's showing a lot better than the bottles I tasted in the United States last year.

kinship-mix-case-whisky-2022.title: Johnnie Walker Family Collection 4x200ml
kinship-mix-case-whisky-2022.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Family Collection 4x200ml is an exceptional sampler gift set showcasing the remarkable depth, blending mastery, and iconic flavor spectrum of the House of Walker. Perfect for both discerning connoisseurs and those looking to discover premium Scotch, this exclusive taster pack contains four 200ml bottles, each representing a celebrated tier of the portfolio:

  • Johnnie Walker Black Label – The Original Walker Whisky – Aged 12 Years and a rock solid blend.
  • Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve – A multi-layered blend, it offers a smooth balance of sweet fruits and creaminess that evolves into deeper honeyed tones before finishing in lingering waves of wood, fruit, and light, sweet west coast smoke.
  • Johnnie Walker 18 Year Old – A complex, luxurious blend harboring deep layers of flavor that perfectly balance the diverse character of the distilleries from which it came and the wood in which it has rested.
  • Johnnie Walker Blue Label – An exquisite blend made from some of Scotland’s rarest and most exceptional Scotch Whiskies.

Together, they guide you on a comprehensive tasting journey through the finest single malt and grain distillates across Scotland, bound by Johnnie Walker's signature whisper of coastal peat smoke.

Food Pairing: This diverse collection pairs beautifully with a multi-course tasting menu. Enjoy the smoky depth of the Black Label with grilled lamb chops or smoked brisket. Transition to the sweet creaminess of the Gold Label alongside aged Gouda cheese or a fruit tart. Pair the sophisticated 18 Year Old with seared duck breast, and culminate the experience by sipping the rare Blue Label alongside high-quality dark chocolate truffles or a delicate seared ribeye steak.

g-m-private-collection-mortlach-1978.bodyHtml: Sweet Seville orange aromas complement fragrant pineapple alongside a hint of preserved quince. Crystallized violet notes develop alongside lime, hazelnuts and black pepper. Ripe red apples intertwine with dark honey and subtle ginger. Rich exotic fruit flavours give way to a faint herbal edge. Full and lightly spiced with lasting citrus and aniseed.

glen-grant-mr-george-legacy-2nd-ed-1957.title: Gordon & MacPhail Mr George Legacy Second Edition Glen Grant 64 Year Old 1957 Cask #3483 56.1% ABV
glen-grant-mr-george-legacy-2nd-ed-1957.bodyHtml:
Glen Grant 1957 Gordon and MacPhail 64 Year Old Mr George Legacy / 2nd Edition

A remarkable 1957 Glen Grant, bottled as a 64-year-old for the second edition of Gordon & MacPhail’s Mr. George Legacy. Mr George, of course, refers to George Urquhart, the legendary director who invented the Connoisseurs Choice range in 1968, and grandfather of G&M’s current Operations Director, Stuart Urquhart.

This 64-year-old Glen Grant 1957 is from a first fill sherry butt, Cask #3483, that has given it an extraordinarily dark chestnut colour, and yielded a batch of 298 bottles at a jaw-dropping 56.1%. The list of incredible Glen Grants bottled by Gordon & MacPhail is a very long one, but this 1957 64-year-old looks destined to go straight into the pantheon.

This incredible whisky was filled into single first-fill ex-Sherry butt #3483 on 10th October 1957. It was bottled at cask strength in 2021 and resulted in 298 bottles.

glen-grant-platinum-jubilee-1952.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Platinum Jubilee Glen Grant 1952 70 Year Old Cask #381 52.3% ABV
glen-grant-platinum-jubilee-1952.bodyHtml:
For 125 years, Gordon & Macphail has been driven by a simple mission: To create Single Malt Scotch Whisky of exceptional quality. The Private Collection is a range of bottlings personally selected by members of the Urquhart family that has owned Gordon & Macphail for four generations. Private Collection whiskies are greatly‐aged single malts from celebrated, little‐known, or closed distilleries.

The Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection 1952 from Glen Grant Distillery has spent the past 70 years maturing in a first fill Sherry butt. It was bottled on 6th February, the date of the Queen’s accession, and serves as a fitting tribute, exemplifying how character, patience and wisdom can mature over decades to deliver an exceptional legacy.

In support of the Queen’s ‘green canopy’ initiative and build on the successful 2021 partnership with Scottish charity Trees for Life, Gordon & MacPhail is donating a further £20,000 from the proceeds of the release.

Only 256 bottles of the ultra-rare commemorative whisky are available worldwide from the single cask laid down in 1952, some of the oldest Glen Grant whisky ever released from Gordon & MacPhail’s revered warehouse in Elgin.

Tasting Notes:

Colour: Dark Gold

Nose: Notes of beeswax polish give way to ripe fig aromas, toffee and orange zest. Ages leather tempers rum and raisin.

Taste: Stewed blackberry compote, sweet clementine and milk chocolate flavours are followed by a menthol undertone.

Finish: A long finish with a touch of smoke and a hint of pepper.

armand-de-brignac-brut-ace-of-spades.title: Armand De Brignac Ace of Spades Brut Gold Champagne 3L Double Magnum
armand-de-brignac-brut-ace-of-spades.bodyHtml:
Armand De Brignac Ace of Spades Brut Gold Champagne is a prestige, multi-vintage cuvée produced by the Cattier family in the Montagne de Reims region of Champagne. Handcrafted using traditional pressings and a blend of three distinct vintages, this flagship expression is composed of 40% Chardonnay, 40% Pinot Noir, and 20% Pinot Meunier. In the glass, it displays a brilliant golden color with fine, persistent bubbles. The nose opens with vibrant aromas of yellow peach, baked brioche, candied citrus peel, and white flowers. On the palate, it is rich, creamy, and complex, featuring layers of ripe stone fruit, honey, and subtle toasted brioche, all balanced by a crisp, mineral-driven acidity that carries through to a long, silky finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, caviar, butter-poached lobster, pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken, and aged Comté cheese.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The NV Brut Gold is fleshy and expressive and opens in the glass with aromas of Anjou pear, dried apricot, yellow apple and buttery pastry, complemented by hints of almond paste. Medium- to full-bodied, flavorful and giving, it possesses a sweet core of fruit that's underpinned by succulent yet vibrant acidity. Soundly made and harmonious, it is a decidedly stronger effort than the house's latest Blanc de Blancs. It was disgorged with a dosage of nine grams per liter.

92 Points - James Suckling

Lots of orchard fruit and grapefruit character. Medium-bodied with a creamy texture and a lightly spicy finish, this delivers a nice balance of fresh fruit like lychees and pears. Drink now.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant, creamy Champagne, with pretty apple blossom and spice notes leading to finely meshed flavors of ripe white cherry, whole-grain toast and spun honey, framed by fresh, citrusy acidity. Drink now through 2021.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A blend of Chardonnay, Pinot Meunier and Pinot Noir, this ripe, well-balanced wine has some toast that adds complexity and richness to the apple and lemon fruit, indicating a mature bottling. The wine in a gold-foil bottle is one of five made by the Cattier house for rapper and entrepreneur Jay Z's Armand de Brignac Empire brand with the “Ace of Spades” logo.

budweiser-15.title: Budweiser 15 Bottles
budweiser-15.bodyHtml: Budweiser is a medium-bodied, flavourful, and crisp American-style lager. Known as the "King of Beers," it is brewed using a blend of premium hop varieties, barley malt, rice, and water. A signature part of its production is the beechwood aging process, which results in a naturally carbonated beer with a smooth, clean finish. The 15-pack of 341ml glass bottles offers a subtle honey aroma and a trace of citrus, punctuated by notes of malt and noble hops.

budweiser-16.title: Budweiser 36 Cans
budweiser-16.bodyHtml: Budweiser is a medium-bodied, flavourful, and crisp American-style lager. Known as the "King of Beers," it is brewed using a blend of premium hop varieties, barley malt, rice, and water. A signature part of its production is the beechwood aging process, which results in a naturally carbonated beer with a smooth, clean finish. The 15-pack of 341ml glass bottles offers a subtle honey aroma and a trace of citrus, punctuated by notes of malt and noble hops.

kokanee-16.title: Kokanee 24 Cans
kokanee-16.bodyHtml: Kokanee Glacier Lager is a quintessential Western Canadian pale lager, celebrated for its exceptionally crisp and "crystalline" profile that mirrors its mountain heritage. Brewed with a blend of three different varieties of Pacific Northwest hops and mountain-pure water, it offers a light-bodied texture with a clean, refreshing taste and a subtle, grainy sweetness. The 18-can pack is a popular mid-sized format that balances portability with value, making it a reliable choice for camping, fishing, or backyard social gatherings. Each pour delivers a smooth, thirst-quenching experience with a dry finish that has established it as one of the most iconic beers in British Columbia and Alberta.

blue-2.title: Kubota Senju Blue Junmai Ginjo 720ml
blue-2.bodyHtml:
Clean and refreshing, with a gentle aroma and subtle fruit character leading into a soft, smooth palate. Delicate rice umami is balanced by pleasant acidity and a distinctly dry profile, finishing crisp and refreshing with a subtle lingering savoury note.

Food Pairing: Sushi, sashimi, grilled seafood, shrimp pasta, tempura, chicken, vegetable dishes and other light or savoury cuisine.

domaine-de-la-janasse-chateauneuf-du-pap.title: Domaine de Cristia Chateauneuf du Pape Rouge 2022
domaine-de-la-janasse-chateauneuf-du-pap.bodyHtml:
Domaine de Cristia Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2022 is a rich and expressive French red wine from the prestigious Châteauneuf-du-Pape appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by the family-owned Domaine de Cristia, this wine reflects the estate's dedication to traditional Rhône grape varieties, careful vineyard management and the distinctive terroir of one of France's most celebrated wine regions. The 2022 vintage showcases the warmth and generosity of the Southern Rhône, offering aromas of ripe black cherries, raspberries, blackberries and plums, complemented by notes of lavender, liquorice, black pepper and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and beautifully structured, combining concentrated red and dark fruit with rounded tannins, balanced freshness and subtle earthy complexity. Its lingering, spice-driven finish makes it an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining and cellaring.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, duck confit, venison, beef bourguignon, herb-roasted pork, mushroom risotto, ratatouille, grilled Mediterranean vegetables, aged Comté and Manchego cheese.

 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Velvety and seductive, with smoothly polished tannins holding up ripe red currant and cherry flavors edged in iron and baking spices. A bitter cherry pit note at the end contributes to the focused, dry finish, which stretches out. Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre. Best from 2026 through 2040. 500 cases made, 125 cases imported.

92 Points - James Suckling

A well-built, balanced and lively red with notes of sweet berries, dried herbs, stones and peppercorns. Full-bodied with velvety tannins and a silky core of berries on the palate. Refined and elegant, with a caressing touch challenged by a lift of peppercorns kicking in toward the finish. From organically grown grapes. Drink or hold.

poli-moka-coffee-cream.title: Poli Moka Coffee Cream
poli-moka-coffee-cream.bodyHtml:
Poli Moka Coffee Cream is a rich, velvety, and delightfully indulgent Italian cream liqueur crafted by the historic Poli Distillerie in Schiavon, Veneto. Made according to a time-honored traditional recipe from the Bassano region, this artisanal creation skillfully balances premium roasted coffee essences and fresh dairy cream. What truly elevates this expression is its spirit base: instead of utilizing cheap neutral grain alcohols, it is built upon the region’s most symbolic distillate, authentic craft Grappa. The result is a highly elegant, beautifully integrated liqueur that seamlessly marries the bold, robust characteristics of an Italian espresso with the luxurious texture of fresh cream and the subtle, structured warmth of fine pomace brandy.

Food Pairing: The luscious coffee and dairy cream components of this liqueur make it a natural match for various sweet treats. It pairs exceptionally well with classic Italian desserts like tiramisu, biscotti, almond cantucci, and dark chocolate panna cotta. It can also be poured directly over premium vanilla bean or hazelnut gelato for an elevated affogato experience, or served alongside a fruit tart featuring roasted figs and nuts.

TASTING NOTES - A rich, opaque, milky espresso-brown color. The texture is full-bodied, remarkably smooth, and coats the palate with a luxuriously soft, velvety, and creamy weight.

NOSE - Deeply harmonious and intensely comforting, opening with upfront aromas of freshly brewed Italian espresso and roasted coffee beans, beautifully rounded by sweet notes of milky vanilla fudge, fresh cream, and a faint, warm hint of rustic grappa.

PALATE - Elegantly sweet, creamy, and layered. The entry is dominated by a luxurious wave of sweet milk cream and toasted coffee flavors, which are quickly complemented mid-palate by notes of dark cocoa, buttery toffee, and a gentle, structural warmth from the grappa base that cuts through the dairy richness.

FINISH - Medium to long, clean, and pleasantly smooth. The thick cream coating slowly recedes, leaving a comforting, long-lasting aftertaste of dark roasted espresso, caramelized sugar, and a delicate touch of warming spirit spice.

SERVE - Best served slightly chilled or over a few cubes of high-quality ice in a traditional tulip-shaped glass or spirits snifter to appreciate its velvety elegance. It also works beautifully as an indulgent addition to hot coffee, or as a premium, creamy substitute in sophisticated coffee-based cocktails.

kingston-62-white-rum-by-appleton.title: Kingston 62 White Rum 1.14L
kingston-62-white-rum-by-appleton.bodyHtml:
Kingston 62 White Rum 1.14L is a smooth, medium-bodied Jamaican white rum produced by J. Wray & Nephew at the renowned Appleton Estate Distillery. Formerly known as Appleton White Rum, this expression blends two column-still rums aged for up to three years in oak barrels. Charcoal filtration removes the colour while preserving its rounded character and subtle tropical flavours. Bottled at 40% ABV, Kingston 62 White offers delicate notes of coconut, pineapple, banana, and gentle sweetness, making it an excellent choice for Mojitos, Daiquiris, and refreshing rum cocktails.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp, jerk chicken, fish tacos, coconut rice, citrus-marinated seafood, tropical fruit salads, and pineapple desserts.

Tasting Notes: Smooth and medium-bodied, featuring subtle coconut, tropical fruit, gentle sweetness, and a clean, refreshing character.

Nose: Fresh tropical fruit, delicate coconut, light sweetness, and subtle banana.

Palate: Soft coconut, ripe pineapple, banana, gentle oak influence, and rounded sweetness.

Finish: Clean and smooth, with lingering tropical fruit and gentle warmth.

Serve: Enjoy over ice, mixed with ginger ale, or in classic cocktails such as a Mojito, Daiquiri, or Rum Punch.

idi-di-marzo-family-select-montepulciano.title: Idi di Marzo Amarne Family Selection Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2022
idi-di-marzo-family-select-montepulciano.bodyHtml:
Idi di Marzo Amarne Family Selection Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2022 pours a deep ruby red color with brilliant violet highlights in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and complex, opening with intense aromas of ripe black plums, wild brambles, and fresh violets, seamlessly layered with tertiary nuances of cedar, vanilla, and mocha. On the palate, this full-bodied red showcases an opulent and fleshy texture, supported by chewy yet ripe tannins and a beautifully balanced core of fresh acidity. Savory layers of dark chocolate, black pepper, and graphite carry through to a long, persistent, and satisfyingly structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-cooked lamb shanks with mint, grilled prime ribeye steaks, rich orecchiette pasta ragù, or traditional four-cheese artisanal pizzas.

91 Points - James Suckling

Ripe black plums, brambles, and violets with cedar, vanilla and mocha. The full-bodied palate is loaded with chewy but ripe tannins with balanced acidity. Opulent and fleshy. From organically grown grapes. Vegan. Sustainable. Give two more years to soften. Try in 2026.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The supertangy, earthy nose features aromas of smoke, iron, blood orange peel and red plum skin, while the palate brings not just more meat and tart fruit, but also bouncy, effervescent acid. A true crowd-pleaser from first sip to last drop

bonanza-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Bonanza Cabernet Sauvignon
bonanza-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Bonanza Cabernet Sauvignon is a rich, supple, and exceptionally approachable non-vintage red wine created by Chuck Wagner, the renowned owner and winemaker of Caymus Vineyards. Produced as a multi-vintage blend to ensure delicious consistency, this wine explores broader vineyard sites across the state of California that are ideally suited for farming quality Cabernet Sauvignon. In the glass, it possesses a dark, deep ruby hue. The forward and highly aromatic nose opens with luxurious aromas of ripe blackberries, dark blueberries, and dark currants, seamlessly layered with warm undertones of vanilla bean, brown sugar, toasted oak, and a touch of subtle smokiness. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, soft, and distinctly fruit-driven, displaying a smooth and plush texture with low acidity and very gentle, melted tannins. Forward flavors of cassis, blueberry pie, and sweet vanilla cream dominate the mid-palate, concluding with a round, clean finish that leaves lingering hints of dark unsweetened chocolate and toasted bread.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with charcoal-grilled gourmet burgers, slow-braised beef short ribs, smoked barbecue brisket, and mature hard cheeses like an aged cheddar.

zaya-alta-fuerza-rum.title: Zaya Alta Fuerza Rum
zaya-alta-fuerza-rum.bodyHtml:
Zaya Alta Fuerza Rum is a bold, deeply complex, and intensely flavorful overproof aged dark rum that showcases the fiery, high-proof potential of Trinidadian distilling. "Alta Fuerza," which translates to "High Force," represents an elevated, cask-strength iteration within the Zaya portfolio. It is meticulously crafted from a molasses base and column-distilled before undergoing a patient maturation process in small, charred oak barrels. By blending rare, premium rums aged up to 16 years, this overproof expression balances its fiery 115-proof strength with a heavy, decadent sweetness. The high alcohol content beautifully cuts through and amplifies the rum's signature sugary traits, creating an assertive, flavor-forward profile that stands up exceptionally well when sipped or mixed into premium tropical cocktails.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with dense dark chocolate truffles, roasted pecans, a glazed pork belly, rich bananas foster, or a full-bodied, premium cigar.

TASTING NOTES - A deep mahogany brown color with rich reddish highlights and a heavy, full-bodied, and slightly syrupy texture that coats the palate.

NOSE - Deep and penetratively sweet, opening with strong aromatic spices, dark roasted coffee, and brown sugar, complemented by rich notes of buttery maple syrup, vanilla bean, and banana candy.

PALATE - Robust and exploding with character, delivering an immediate wave of black pepper and warming baking spices that seamlessly give way to dense layers of toffee, cream, maple, and sweet dark chocolate sauce.

FINISH - Long, powerful, and mouth-coatingly sweet, leaving a lingering trail of sticky brown sugar, dark raisins, and roasted coffee beans balanced by a sharp, pleasant alcoholic heat.

SERVE - Best enjoyed poured neat or over a single large ice cube in a rocks glass to help tame the proof, or utilized as a powerful, flavor-boosting base for high-end Tiki cocktails.

uko-old-vines-cabernet-sauvignon.title: UKO Old Vines Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
uko-old-vines-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
UKO Old Vines Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a bold Argentinian red wine crafted from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon grown in vineyards more than 60 years old in Paraje Altamira, Mendoza's renowned Uco Valley. Situated approximately 1,070 metres above sea level, these vineyards produce concentrated fruit with distinctive freshness and structure. Fermented with indigenous yeasts and matured in new French oak, this expressive wine reveals rich blackcurrant, dark berries, pepper, eucalyptus, chocolate, and tobacco. Silky tannins and a long, persistent finish complete this elegant high-altitude Cabernet Sauvignon.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, wild game, beef ragù, aged Gouda, roasted walnuts, and dark chocolate.

 

92 Points - James Suckling

This generous, spicy red has aromas of coffee, roasted herbs, licorice and spiced plums. Some caramel, too. It’s full-bodied, plush and chewy, with excellent concentration and opulent spice notes. Cabernet sauvignon and malbec. Drink now or hold.

uko-old-vines-malbec.title: Uko Old Vines Malbec 2021
uko-old-vines-malbec.bodyHtml:
Deep red color with violet hints. In the nose, aromas of plum marmalade, cassis, raspberry, ripe berries, vanilla, leather and tobacco highlight. In the mouth, it is gentle, with round and sweet tannins, and with great structure and complexity.

93 Points - James Suckling

Attractive herbs like basil and oregano mingling with ripe, dark berry fruit and mocha. It’s fleshy and flavorful with a full body and broad, ripe tannins. Expansive. 50% cabernet sauvignon and 50% malbec. Drink or hold.

g-m-ardmore-2000-distillery-label.title: Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Ardmore 2000
g-m-ardmore-2000-distillery-label.bodyHtml: This Ardmore distilled in 2000 is bottled by Gordon & MacPhail in the famous Distillery Labels range. This single malt pleasantly blends fruity (citrus, white fruit) and spicy (cinnamon) notes. The Distillery Labels range reflects Gordon & MacPhail’s unique relationship with a handful of distilleries for over a century. Being entrusted year after year with new make spirits (distillates), Gordon & Macphail has developed its art for the maturation of whiskey and highlights each expression under a unique label. An honor for these distilleries, now emblematic, which bottled little or no single malt under their own brand.

g-m-glentauchers-2007-distillery-label.title: Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Glentauchers 2007
g-m-glentauchers-2007-distillery-label.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Glentauchers 2007 is a Speyside single malt distilled at Glentauchers in 2007, matured in refill sherry hogsheads and bottled in 2021 at 46% ABV. The Distillery Labels range comes from relationships Gordon & MacPhail has built with distillery owners over generations, filling new-make spirit into its own casks for more than 120 years. The sherry casks give milk chocolate, orange peel and dates, followed by stewed apple, nougat and treacle toffee, all presented under the range's retro-style Glentauchers label. 700ml.

Tasting Notes: Sherry, chocolate, orange, dates, nougat and toffee.

Nose: Sherry and milk chocolate with vanilla pod, fresh orange peel, cinnamon and Medjool dates.

Palate: Smooth, with stewed apples, nougat and roasted almonds, then treacle toffee and a touch of white pepper.

Finish: Sweet, with lingering spice, dried banana and toasted oak.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

g-m-benriach-2005-connoisseurs-choice.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice BenRiach 15 Year Old 2005 Refill American Hogshead Cask 116 57.9% ABV
g-m-benriach-2005-connoisseurs-choice.bodyHtml:
Really good BenRiach has been in rather short supply 'round here for quite some time now. When that happens, we turn to the indie bottlers. And when we turn to the indies, it's almost always Gordon & MacPhail standing head and shoulders higher than the rest of the pack. They know their spirits, they know their wood, and they know how to pair them to create something that is so much more than the sum of its parts. 

Refill hoggies are where most whisky really shines, so we expect this one will almost certainly be a fruit bomb with impeccable balance. 

Refill American Hogshead Cask No. 116 had an outturn of 238 bottles. 

Natural colour, non-chill filtered, 15 years, and bottled at 57.9% abv

g-m-ardmore-1994-connoisseurs-choice.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Ardmore 26 Year Old 1994 Refill American Hogshead 53.1% ABV
g-m-ardmore-1994-connoisseurs-choice.bodyHtml:
Distilled in 1994, this 26 year old Ardmore matured in a Refill American Oak Hogshead before bottling at 53.1%.
CASK TYPE Refill American hogshead

NOSE

VANILLA and HONEYDEW MELON notes give way to subtle CURED MEATS. Soft ripe PEAR leads to toasted OAK and a hint of LEMON.

TASTE

Sweet and creamy with APRICOT, APPLE and spicy PEPPER. PINEAPPLE and CITRUS FRUIT notes come to the fore alongside soft FLORAL notes.

FINISH

A medium-bodied finish with TROPICAL FRUIT and smouldering SMOKE.

RANGE Connoisseurs Choice
REGION Highland
DISTILLERY Ardmore
VINTAGE 1994
STRENGTH 53.1%

g-m-dailuaine-2008-connoisseurs-choice.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Dailuaine 13 Year Old 2008 First Fill Sherry Hogshead Cask 18602801 59.4% ABV
g-m-dailuaine-2008-connoisseurs-choice.bodyHtml:
Dailuaine 13 Year Old 2008 First Fill Sherry Hogshead Cask 18602801 is a single cask Speyside single malt from the Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice range. Distilled in 2008 at Dailuaine, it matured in a single first fill sherry hogshead and was bottled on 7 June 2021 at a natural cask strength of 59.4% ABV. The label lists batch 21/151 and an outturn of 322 bottles, presented in 750 ml bottles without chill filtration and with no added colour. The first fill sherry cask gives a rich, spiced and fruit-laden dram.

Tasting Notes: Festive spice, hazelnut, raisin, forest fruit, butterscotch, fig.

Nose: Festive spices with hazelnut and stewed raisins.

Palate: Black pepper first, then rich forest fruit and butterscotch.

Finish: Full and long, with lingering figs.

Serve: Neat, adding water a few drops at a time.

g-m-glenburgie-1995-connoisseurs-choic.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Glenburgie 25 Year Old 1995 Refill Bourbon Barrel Cask 9916 53.6% ABV
g-m-glenburgie-1995-connoisseurs-choic.bodyHtml:
Aromas of vanilla butterscotch, ripe apples and intense lime zest. Subtle toasted malt notes develop alongside hints of fresh peaches. Creamy and smooth on the palate with rich orange flavours followed by mango, pineapple and fresh garden mint. A medium finish with undertones of MENTHOL, OAK and a hint of PEPPER.

25 Year Old, Refill Bourbon Barrel, 148 Bottle Batch
53.6% ABV
Cask Number 9916

ramos-pinto-20-year-old-tawny-port.title: Ramos Pinto 20 Years Old Tawny Port
ramos-pinto-20-year-old-tawny-port.bodyHtml:
Ramos Pinto 20 Year Old Tawny Port is an elegant Portuguese fortified wine aged in oak casks for an average of 20 years. Complex aromas of dried figs, toasted almonds, orange peel, caramel, and warm spice lead to a silky palate with remarkable freshness, balanced sweetness, and a long, refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with crème brûlée, pecan pie, roasted nuts, dried fruits, blue cheese, and caramel desserts.

big-rock-pilsner-1.title: Jasper Crisp Pils 6 Cans
big-rock-pilsner-1.bodyHtml: A true pilsner-style lager showcasing local malt from the foothills of the Canadian Rockies. It isn't surprising that this beer is approachable, polite and apologetically hoppy. Sorry.

hopopotamus-norweigan-pale-ale.title: Pale Horseman New England Pale Ale Cls
hopopotamus-norweigan-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Pale Horseman New England Pale Ale Cls

leroy-bourgogne-blanc.title: Maison Leroy Bourgogne Blanc 2018 750ml
leroy-bourgogne-blanc.bodyHtml: From the legendary Bourgogne house of Leroy. One of the best values in this portfolio is the Maison Leroy Bourgogne Blanc. Do not be deceived by the designation. While Lalou Bize Leroy never reveals the source of the grapes, it is known that these are usually grapes from villages and 1er Cru plots, and she blends each vintage to best represent her wines for that vintage. From the cooler 2017 vintage, this is tight and compact, with lemon, light cream, broken stones, and a hint of lemon verbena that stretches long along the svelte palate, finishing with a hum of limestone and wash of salinity. This humble wine grows as it opens in the glass, so give yourself time to fully enjoy. Smart now, and with time ahead in the cellar.

leroy-bourgogne-rouge.title: Henri & Gilles Buisson Bourgogne Rouge 2023
leroy-bourgogne-rouge.bodyHtml:
This classic red Burgundy delivers vibrant wild strawberry, crisp red cherry, and tart raspberry aromas met by subtle earth and rose petal nuances. The palate is finely etched and elegant, showcasing a thread of crushed limestone minerality, fine tannins, energetic acidity, and a pretty, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with roasted chicken with herbs, seared duck breast, mushroom ragout, roasted pork tenderloin, grilled salmon fillets, and aged Comté cheese.

 

93 Points - James Suckling

This is a very good generic red. There is lovely Burgundy pinot character, with aromas of dried roses, moss and hints of grapefruit and dried herbs. Quite flavorful but still elegant as a pinot should be, with fine tannins and a pretty finish. From organically grown grapes.

wisers-whisky-blending-kit.title: J.P. Wiser's 24 Year Old
wisers-whisky-blending-kit.bodyHtml:
J.P. Wiser's 24 Year Old is a premium, long-aged Canadian whisky produced at the Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario. Matured for 24 years in oak barrels, this smooth, well-aged blended whisky offers exceptional complexity with a balance of rich oak character, deep caramel sweetness, and refined rye spice.

Food Pairing: Slow-cooked beef short ribs, dark chocolate tarts, aged Gouda, pecan pie, or roasted pork with a maple-bourbon glaze.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a full, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Warm oak, green apple, toffee, dried fruit, vanilla, and subtle baking spices.

Palate : Rich caramel, toasted oak, butterscotch, ripe orchard fruit, and a gentle dusting of rye spice.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warming with lingering notes of sweet vanilla, soft oak tannins, and spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or tasting glass, or add a few drops of water to unlock its rich aromas.

hop-head-tropic-haze-micro-ipa.title: Hop Head Tropic Haze Micro Ipa 4 Tall Cans
hop-head-tropic-haze-micro-ipa.bodyHtml: Hop Head Tropic Haze Micro Ipa 4 Tall Cans

cottage-springs-summer-variety-pack.title: Cottage Springs Summer Variety Pack 12 Cans

bow-valley-lager-2.title: Bow Valley Lager 15 x 355ml
bow-valley-lager-2.bodyHtml:
Bow Valley Lager is a refreshing Canadian lager offering an approachable balance of crisp malt character and gentle hop bitterness. Light golden in appearance, it delivers subtle notes of toasted grain, biscuit and delicate herbal hops. Its smooth texture, lively carbonation and clean, dry finish make this convenient 15-can pack ideal for gatherings and casual occasions.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled burgers, barbecue chicken, pepperoni pizza, crispy fish and chips, salted pretzels and spicy chicken wings.

Tasting Notes: Crisp malt flavours, light grain sweetness, subtle herbal hops and a clean, refreshing character.

Nose: Fresh grain, mild malt aromas and delicate floral and herbal hop notes.

Palate: Light-bodied and smooth with gentle malt sweetness, biscuit notes and balanced hop bitterness.

Finish: Crisp, dry and refreshing with a subtle lingering malt and hop character.

alberta-genuine-draft-light.title: AGD Alberta Genuine Draft Light 15 Cans
alberta-genuine-draft-light.bodyHtml: All natural and batch brewed. That’s the Big Rock difference inside every can of Alberta Genuine Draft light beer. As always, our Brewmaster doesn’t cut any corners and in this beer you’ll find a light pale lager, brewed with the highest quality of ingredients including selected Willamette hops. No additives, unpasteurized…this is a pure malt beer. A great beer, great value…by Big Rock Brewery.

alberta-genuine-draft-light-1.title: AGD Alberta Genuine Draft Light 24 Cans
alberta-genuine-draft-light-1.bodyHtml: All natural and batch brewed. That’s the Big Rock difference inside every can of Alberta Genuine Draft light beer. As always, our Brewmaster doesn’t cut any corners and in this beer you’ll find a light pale lager, brewed with the highest quality of ingredients including selected Willamette hops. No additives, unpasteurized…this is a pure malt beer. A great beer, great value…by Big Rock Brewery.

big-rock-rhine-stone-cowboy-2.title: Big Rock Rhine Stone Cowboy 4 Tall Cans
big-rock-rhine-stone-cowboy-2.bodyHtml:
Big Rock Rhine Stone Cowboy 4 Tall Cans is a refreshing Kölsch-style lagered ale brewed by Big Rock Brewery in Calgary, Alberta. Cold-conditioned for a clean and crisp character, it offers a harmonious blend of delicate light maltiness, subtle fruitiness, and a soft noble hop bitterness.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken, fish tacos, bratwurst, light salads, soft cheeses, or pork schnitzel.

Tasting Notes : Light golden and bright in appearance with a light-bodied, smooth, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Clean pale malt, subtle orchard fruitiness, and delicate noble herbal hops.

Palate : Soft cereal grain, light honeyed malt, subtle fruit accents, and a mild, balanced hop bitterness.

Finish : Clean, dry, and crisp with a brief, refreshing malt finish.

Serve : Serve well-chilled in a tall Kölsch stange or pint glass.

big-rock-honey-brown-4.title: Big Rock Honey Brown 4 Tall Cans

white-peaks-peach-apricot.title: O'Rourke'S Peak Cellars Gewurztraminer 2019
white-peaks-peach-apricot.bodyHtml:
Fragrant and expressive, with lychee, ripe peach, apricot, citrus blossom, rose petal, and delicate spice. The palate is aromatic and refreshing, combining generous stone fruit with lively acidity, gentle richness, and a flavorful, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with spicy Asian cuisine, curries, roasted pork, poultry, seafood, aromatic cheeses, fresh salads, or lightly spiced appetizers.

rock-creek-cider-variety-pack-1.title: Rock Creek Cider Variety Pack 12 Cans

big-rock-variety-pack-1.title: Big Rock The Rock Box Variety Pack
big-rock-variety-pack-1.bodyHtml: The Rock Box is the premier signature variety pack from Big Rock Brewery, a pioneer of the Canadian craft beer movement. This pack is designed to offer a "best of" experience, featuring a curated selection of the brewery's award-winning ales and lagers. Known for its versatility, the collection typically highlights Big Rock's commitment to using high-quality, regionally sourced ingredients like Alberta-grown malted barley. Whether in its "Signature" form or limited-edition "Untamed Hop Edition," the pack remains a staple for those seeking a broad range of classic and contemporary beer styles.

big-rock-tragically-hip-lake-fever-lager.title: Big Rock Bright Side Crisp Lager
big-rock-tragically-hip-lake-fever-lager.bodyHtml: Big Rock Bright Side North American Styl

white-peaks-original-with-meyer-lemon.title: White Peaks Original With Meyer Lemon 12 Cans
white-peaks-original-with-meyer-lemon.bodyHtml:
White Peaks Original With Meyer Lemon is a craft vodka-based hard tea made with real brewed tea and natural Meyer lemon juice. Blended to offer a clean, refreshing profile without carbonation, it balances the smooth citrus warmth of Meyer lemon with the crispness of real tea and premium vodka.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken, fish tacos, summer salads, BBQ pork, or light seafood dishes.

Tasting Notes : Translucent pale tea amber in appearance with a light, non-carbonated, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright Meyer lemon citrus combined with earthy black tea notes and a hint of natural sweetness.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with vibrant, slightly sweet Meyer lemon, clean brewed tea flavor, and a silky spirit base.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering citrus zest and gentle tea tannins.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled straight from the can, or poured over ice in a tall glass with a lemon wheel.

gp-vodka-2.title: GP Vodka
gp-vodka-2.bodyHtml:
GP Vodka (also known as GP Brewing Handcrafted Vodka) is a smooth, easy-drinking Canadian craft spirit distilled by GP Brewing Company in Grande Prairie, Alberta. Multiple times distilled and constantly filtered for exceptional clarity, it is cut with pure glacier water to achieve a crisp, refreshing character.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with sour cream and caviar, fresh oysters, cured meats, and light appetizers.

Tasting Notes : Colorless, clear, and bright in appearance, providing a crisp, light, and exceptionally smooth mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and neutral with faint, subtle hints of fresh grain.

Palate : Soft, clean, and smooth with subtle grain sweetness and crisp, pure water undertones.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing.

Serve : Served well-chilled neat, over ice, or as a smooth base in classic mixed drinks and cocktails.

gp-vodka-3.title: GP Vodka 1.75L

GP Vodka (also known as GP Brewing Handcrafted Vodka) is a smooth, easy-drinking Canadian craft spirit distilled by GP Brewing Company in Grande Prairie, Alberta. Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing.

Serve : Served well-chilled neat, over ice, or as a smooth base in classic mixed drinks and cocktails.

tree-brewing-season-pass-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Tree Brewing Season Pass Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans

k-vintners-motor-city-kitty-syrah.title: K Vintners M.C.K. (Motor City Kitty) Syrah 2019
k-vintners-motor-city-kitty-syrah.bodyHtml:
K Vintners M.C.K. (Motor City Kitty) Syrah 2019 is an incredibly expressive, deeply layered, and distinct New World Syrah sourced entirely from the high-elevation Boushey Oldfield Block vineyard. Fermented completely with native yeasts and utilizing whole-cluster pressing, this dark purple-hued wine bursts with complex aromatics of wild lavender, fresh black plum, and cracked white pepper, layered seamlessly with savory hints of grilled charcuterie, cold fireplace ash, and crushed seashells. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, highly engaging profile balancing concentrated dark fruits with firm, gripping mineral tannins and a smooth finish with a striking note of cocoa powder.

Food Pairing:

This complex and deeply savory Syrah pairs magnificently with slow-braised beef short ribs, grilled rosemary lamb chops, venison steaks, or rich mushroom risotto with truffle oil.

98 Points - James Suckling

Layered aromas of plums, black cherries, leather, bark and iron. Full-bodied with a lot of nuances. Firm, gripping tannins. Dried roses and crushed blackberries mix with dark, mineral complexity, leaving a buzz on the palate. A clear note of cocoa powder comes through. It is concentrated and dynamic. Superb.

jadot-volnay-1er-cru-clos-de-la-barre.title: Louis Jadot Volnay Clos de la Barre Premier Cru 2015 1.5L Magnum
jadot-volnay-1er-cru-clos-de-la-barre.bodyHtml:
This is a fruity wine with vanilla and violet aromas, a young Volnay will be perfect with roast meats and poultry. In great vintages this wine will be very good with richer red meat dishes. With mellow cheeses like Brie, Chaource or Reblochon, drink an old vintage. This wine will age for 8-12 years in a good cellar.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Wholly controlled by the producer, this walled vineyard on the edge of Volnay village has made a beautifully concentrated, balanced wine. Still young, it already has ripe red fruits with shapely tannins and acidity to match. The smoky aftertaste adds to the complexity. Drink from 2022.
94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2015 Volnay 1er Cru Clos de la Barre has a more detailed and focused bouquet than the Santenots and en l'Ormeau, subtle sous-bois scents infusing the detailed red berry fruit mixed with cranberry and wild hedgerow. The palate is fresh and vibrant on the entry with tart red cherries and raspberry, well structured and very focused. This shows the most class within the five Volnay 2015s that I tasted from Maison Louis Jadot. This is excellent.

pio-cesare-barolo-ornato-docg.title: Pio Cesare Ornato Barolo 2019
pio-cesare-barolo-ornato-docg.bodyHtml:
Pio Cesare Ornato Barolo 2019 is a powerful, tightly wound, and monumental single-vineyard Italian red wine that represents the historic estate’s original cru bottling from the famous commune of Serralunga d'Alba. Displaying a bright ruby-garnet color in the glass, it opens with a classic, deeply complex bouquet of ripe dark cherries, red raspberries, and wild herbs, interwoven with sophisticated layers of cardamom, eucalyptus, tar, and sweet pipe tobacco smoke. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied masterpiece showcases the signature muscle and concentration of the Ornato terroir, delivering waves of deep plum and savory spice driven by a racy, mineral-laden acidity. Its imposing, tightly knit structure is framed by incredibly ultra-fine, chalky tannins that seamlessly integrate with a long, saline, and endlessly persistent finish.

Food Pairing: This robust and cellaring-grade Barolo pairs magnificently with rich, savory dishes like slow-cooked beef osso buco, truffle-infused wild mushroom risotto, wild boar ragù, roasted rack of lamb, or mature hard cheeses like Castelmagno and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano.

97 Points - James Suckling

This is beautifully crafted with ultra-fine tannins with cherries, berries, and flowers. Medium to full body. Lovely length. Very classic in structure. Linear and racy. Tight at the end. Give it four to six years of bottle age. Try after 2027.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The 2019 Ornato highlights how special this vineyard is with grace and structure combined into pure class. Dark cherry aromas are nestled between wild herbs, flowers and savory spices that push and pull your attention with each taste. Sturdy and well-structured, this wine is built for tomorrow, when all parts will relax into one another to reveal just how great this wine is. Drink 2028–2045.
95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The Pio Cesare 2019 Barolo Ornato sources its fruit from one of the best-known MGA sites in Serralunga d'Alba. The character of this wine always prizes structure and power, and these qualities are especially evident in a vintage like 2019 that offers more concentrated fruit to begin with. Ornato is infused with dark berry nuances contrasted against savory tones of spice, tar and smoke. It closes with finely textured tannins.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

An inviting red, offering ripe plum, cherry, earth, eucalyptus, iron and tobacco flavors. Turns denser and slightly chewy on the finish, where earth and vegetal elements echo. All the components are here, so be patient. Best from 2027 through 2047.

pio-cesare-il-bricco-barbaresco-docg.title: Pio Cesare Il Bricco Barbaresco 2018
pio-cesare-il-bricco-barbaresco-docg.bodyHtml:
Pio Cesare Il Bricco Barbaresco 2018 is a big, powerful, and single-vineyard Italian red wine that represents the pinnacle of elegance and prestige from one of the family’s most celebrated estates. Sourced from a meticulous selection of the ripest grapes across three distinct plots in the highest, coolest part of the Cascina Il Bricco vineyard in the village of Treiso, this exceptional selection pours a pale ruby color with elegant garnet highlights. The nose displays a beautiful, highly complex aromatic bouquet of candied raspberry, red cherry, and crushed rose petals, underpinned by sophisticated tertiary notes of lilac, tarry smoke, cedarwood, and gentle white pepper spice. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied masterpiece offers a classic, muscular structure packed with rich flavors of plum, redcurrant, and dark fruit preserves. Seamlessly balanced by a bright, energetic acidity and framed by silky, remarkably refined tannins, it layers savory touches of iron mineral ore and cured tobacco that carry through to an incredibly long, pure, and harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: This sophisticated and powerful Barbaresco pairs magnificently with traditional Piedmontese dishes like white truffle risotto, braised beef, truffle agnolotti, wild boar ragù, roasted venison, or mature, hard Italian cheeses like Castelmagno and Parmigiano-Reggiano.

95 Points James Suckling

This is a very solid red for the vintage, with a medium to full body and extremely refined and focused tannins that run the length of the wine. Bitter-lemon, strawberry and spice flavors. Compact and long.

94 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Barbaresco Il Bricco shows ample depth and intensity with dark fruit, smoke, toasted spice and cured tobacco. This is a production of 6,393 numbered bottles. This vintage shows a mid-weight approach with rich fruit weight and polished tannins.

93 Points Wine Spectator

A rich, well-defined style, this red evokes cherry, raspberry, iron, menthol and tobacco flavors. Broad tannins announce the finish, yet this remains balanced, intense and energetic, with a lingering aftertaste. Best from 2026 through 2040.

gaja-pieve-brunello.title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello di Montalcino 2020
gaja-pieve-brunello.bodyHtml: The 2020 Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello di Montalcino is a monumental and polished expression of Sangiovese that reflects the elegance of a classic vintage. It opens with a layered and expressive bouquet of wild cherry, ripe plum, and wild strawberry, uplifted by aromatic Mediterranean herbs like thyme and rosemary, as well as notes of dried rose, balsamic, and blood orange. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and harmonious, showcasing a core of juicy red fruit and mineral tension framed by silky, fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity. The finish is long and persistent, leaving lingering impressions of savory herbs, licorice, and subtle oak.

aultmore-21-year-old-1.title: Aultmore 21 Year Old
aultmore-21-year-old-1.bodyHtml: Aultmore is from the Gaelic term meaning "Big Burn", a burn being a small river or large stream. The "burn" in discussion is the Burn of Auchinderran, the water source for the distillery. This 21 year bottling is aged in refill hogsheads and bottled at 92 proof.

can-blau-blau-gil-family-estates.title: Gil Family Estates Blau Red Blend 2022
can-blau-blau-gil-family-estates.bodyHtml:
Gil Family Estates Blau Red Blend 2022 is an expressive, mineral-laced red blend crafted by Cellers Can Blau from vines rooted in clay, limestone, and slate soils across the Montsant hills. It opens with fragrant aromas of ripe plums, wild blackberries, and dried herbs, seamlessly interwoven with cracked black pepper and subtle oak spice. On the palate, juicy red and blue fruits are framed by supple, fine-grained tannins and vibrant natural acidity, leading into a textured, savory, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled lamb chops with rosemary, barbecued beef skewers, chorizo and white bean stew, roasted pork tenderloin, and aged Manchego cheese.

lermita-priorat.title: Alvaro Palacios L'Ermita Velles Vinyes Priorat 2018 750ml
lermita-priorat.bodyHtml:
99 Points - Robert Parker

The flagship 2018 L'Ermita is already classified as Gran Vinya Classificada, the new category of grand cru vineyards from the Priorat appellation of origin. Like the 2017, the blend here is mostly Garnacha with about 20% Cariñena (the highest for this wine) and 2% of white grapes. It fermented with indigenous yeasts in oak vats with a maceration of 56 days and matured in oak barrels of different sizes for 14 months. The grapes were picked quite late but on the same date as the previous year, the 17th of October, because the vineyard is so regular. The wine is aromatic, intense and elegant, with a lifted nose and a high-pitched note of violet pastille, more refined than the Aubaguetes and Baixada. It is classical and proportioned, with contained and complex aromas and flavors and lots of energy, light in its feel but with inner power and strength. As with most great wines, it should develop nicely and for a long time in bottle but will drink well throughout its life. Grand vin, yes. 2,440 bottles were filled in April 2020.

98 Points Wine Spectator

So perfumed with violets, lavender and purple fruit, as well as slate. Full-bodied with tight, polished tannins that are layered and compact at the same time. Chewy, yet refined. Superb finesse and precision.

pio-cesare-barolo-mosconi-docg.title: Pio Cesare Barolo Mosconi 2021
pio-cesare-barolo-mosconi-docg.bodyHtml:
Pio Cesare Barolo Mosconi 2021 is a majestic, brawny, and deeply expressive single-vineyard Italian red wine that perfectly captures the structural intensity and unbridled power of one of Monforte d'Alba’s most prized terroirs. Sourced from old vines within the historic Mosconi estate, this exceptional selection pours a dark, deep garnet-red in the glass. The nose is remarkably floral and regal, opening with a procession of dusty dried cherries, fragrant violets, and fresh roses, beautifully layered with complex notes of sandalwood, black tea leaves, cedarwood box spice, and a touch of flinty mineral ore. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied masterpiece delivers a dense, concentrated core of warmed plums, dark raspberries, and fruit compote, effortlessly lifted by a bright blood orange zest and fresh-cut savory herbs. Its muscular, noble structure is shaped by 30 months of aging in French oak, yielding finely sculpted, elegant tannins that seamlessly integrate with a deep, sanguine iron mineral drive and a finish that lingers with endless persistence.

Food Pairing: This powerful and structured Barolo pairs magnificently with rich, savory dishes like slow-cooked beef osso buco, truffle-crusted prime ribeye, wild boar ragù, roasted duck with cherry reduction, or mature, hard Italian cheeses like aged Parmigiano-Reggiano and Castelmagno.

97 Points - James Suckling

This is so floral, with violets, roses, dark fruit and lovely sandalwood and cedar. A touch of flint, too. Medium- to full-bodied with such elegance and a long and rather endless finish. It goes on and on. What a wine. Drink after 2027.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This regal expression of Barolo comes from old vines in Monforte d'Alba's prized Mosconi vineyard. Aromas of dusty dried cherries lead a procession down a gravel path, accompanied by black tea leaves and whispers of cigar box spice. Warmed plums and fruit compote ascend on the palate, lifted by blood orange zest and fresh cut herbs. The elegant tannins, shaped by 30 months in French oak, descend like royalty on a grand staircase, floating not walking. The finish refuses to bid farewell, lingering like the last dance at a royal ball. A wine that makes time stand still. Drink from 2027.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Pure and expressive flavors of cherry and raspberry highlight this enticing, harmonious red, which is elegant yet well-structured, with dense tannins lining the finish. Though tight in the end, this reveals layers of mineral and savory elements, plus plenty of ripe fruit. Best from 2029 through 2047.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Pio Cesare 2021 Barolo Mosconi draws its fruit from one of the most celebrated MGA sites in Monforte d'Alba recognized for its rich and powerful wines. This expression does indeed open to a dark color and medium-rich concentration with a texture that is both velvety and smooth. Aromas recall sweet earth, spice, blackcurrant and cured tobacco. The wine is quite elaborate and complete, showing multiple dimensions of Nebbiolo both in terms of elegance and brawn. It ends with well-managed tannins that give this wine a slightly more approachable personality.

theorize-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Theorize Cabernet Sauvignon
theorize-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Crafted by world-renowned winemaker Jean Hoefliger, the Theorize Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold and polished expression of Napa Valley that prioritizes fruit intensity and luxurious texture. Sourced from prime vineyard sites across Oak Knoll, Yountville, and various mountain AVAs, this wine presents a saturated deep ruby or purple hue. The nose is opulent and layered, offering high-toned aromas of blackcurrants, ripe cherries, and plum, seamlessly interwoven with notes of espresso, cacao nibs, and cigar box. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and remarkably plush, showcasing a dense core of dark fruit balanced by refined, velvety tannins and a vibrant, linear acidity. Subtle savory undertones of graphite, leather, and loamy earth emerge on a persistent, resonant finish, reflecting its extensive maturation in French oak.

continuum-red-1.title: Continuum Proprietary Red 2019 1.5L Magnum
continuum-red-1.bodyHtml:
The 2019 Continuum showcases the highest percentage of Cabernet Franc to date revealing the volcanic site and native attributes of Sage Mountain Vineyard. A lively and expressive nose with lifted red fruit, hibiscus, and delicate floral notes. The plush entry on the palate reveals concentrated dark fruit, and youthful black mulberry interweaving with layers of savory wild herb, exotic spice, and graphite. The 2019 Continuum’s mountain fruit expression is enveloped by a supple and silky texture with velvety fine tannins and ferrous minerality. Pleasing all the way though- the 2019 Continuum is an elevated and lush dance of power and grace on the palate. 


99 Points - James Suckling

Blackberries, dark wet soil and blackcurrants. Graphite, too. So aromatic. Pure fruit. Full-bodied with superbly polished, fine tannins that draw you down through the center of palate. Extremely layered and the texture is so curated, giving wonderful persistence. Real plushness and fine, velvety texture. 50% cabernet sauvignon, 37% cabernet franc, 7% petit verdot and 6% merlot. Better after 2026.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Continuum's 2019 Proprietary Red is 50% Cabernet Sauvignon, 37% Cabernet Franc, 7% Petit Verdot and 6% Merlot, all from the estate vineyard on Pritchard Hill. Aged in two-thirds new French oak, with the balance in second or third-use barrels and a single concrete amphora, it's remarkably dark in hue, a deep, saturated purple in the glass. On the nose, it's floral and herbal yet fruit-driven, with violets, sage and bay leaf adding nuance to black cherries, while the palate is full-bodied, plush and silky. There's an enticing yin-yang to the interplay between high-toned herbals and bass notes of dark chocolate in this dense, concentrated effort that finishes lush and long. It's a magnificent wine that should drink well for at least two decades.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

From the mighty estate site on Pritchard Hill, this robustly muscular wine consists of 50% Cabernet Sauvignon, 37% Cabernet Franc (the highest amount ever), 7% Petit Verdot and 6% Merlot. Herbal, it shows notes of violet, graphite and tobacco alongside layers of rich red and black currant. The tannins are substantial and grippy, not quite ready to play nice on the palate. Lay this one down and enjoy it best 2029.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Expressive and vivid, with cassis, blueberry reduction and plum preserves mixed amicably together, while licorice, warm fruitcake, sassafras and baker's chocolate line the finish. A long, subtle cast iron note echoes as the fruit lingers, making for an alluring contrast. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot and Merlot. Best from 2023 through 2038.

kavalan-paul-chiang-peated-cask-strength.title: Kavalan Solist Peaty Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-paul-chiang-peated-cask-strength.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Peaty Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky (Exclusively bottled for Sierra Springs Liquor) is a cask-strength single malt produced at the King Car Kavalan Distillery in Yilan County, Taiwan. Matured in a cask previously used to hold peated whisky, this release combines Kavalan’s signature tropical fruit profile with balanced, earthy peat smoke, bottled exclusively for Sierra Springs Liquor at a robust 53.2% ABV.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, smoked barbecue brisket, dark chocolate tarts, braised pork belly, and rich blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a rich, oily, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Earthy peat smoke integrated with sweet honey, ripe mango, tropical fruit, vanilla, and gentle oak spice.

Palate : Complex and intense with initial peat smoke opening up to red apple, coconut, toasted malt, dark cocoa, and warming black pepper.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of smoky embers, sweet tropical fruit, and toasted oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to tame the high proof and release lush fruit and floral aromas.

red-schooner-malbec.title: Red Schooner Voyage 12
red-schooner-malbec.bodyHtml: Grapes for this Malbec are grown in the Andes Mountains of Argentina, then chilled and transported by ocean voyage to Caymus, where Red Schooner uses their winemaking techniques to create a style that is dense, dark and supple. Falling outside standard labeling rules, Red Schooner does not include a vintage date but is known by the voyage from which it traveled (i.e. Voyage 12 is the 2022 vintage). Strikingly smooth, with scents and flavors of dark fruit and fine, textural tannins.

stagg-jr-65-45-abv.title: Stagg JR Bourbon 65.45% ABV
stagg-jr-65-45-abv.bodyHtml:
Stagg Jr. Bourbon is a barrel-strength Kentucky bourbon from Buffalo Trace Distillery in Frankfort, Kentucky. It is distilled from the same mash bill as George T. Stagg, the flagship of the Buffalo Trace Antique Collection, and bottled at cask strength with no age statement. Each batch differs slightly in strength and profile, and this listing is the 65.45% ABV release in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat with a few drops of water, or over a large ice cube to tame the proof.

yjar-2018.title: Yjar 2018
yjar-2018.bodyHtml:
This reveals a deep, perfumed nose of wild black cherries, crushed blueberries, and violet extract, masterfully layered with Spanish cigar box, truffles, black pepper, incense, and fresh Mediterranean herbs. The palate is medium-to-full-bodied, intensely vital, and impeccably dry, framed by abundant, remarkably fine-grained tannins and a powerful, limestone-driven mineral finish that effortlessly evolves in the glass.

Food Pairing: A world-class pairing for a sophisticated rosemary-and-herb-crusted rack of lamb, roasted duck breast withx a dark cherry reduction, or prime-grade grilled wagyu ribeye steaks.

 

100 Points - James Suckling 

Such a deep yet complex and sophisticated nose, showing discretion, perfume and finesse. A hint of violet extract to the black cherries, crushed blueberries and cocoa powder aromas, together with Spanish cigars that slowly evolve to truffle, black pepper, incense and freshly chopped herbs. Juicy, yet really composed and dry, with medium to full body and abundant, immaculately fine-grained tannins that unwind evenly on the palate. A style that is restrainedly plush and refined, showing superb precision, cohesion and length, when you give it enough time in your glass. If Las Beatas is the fine Burgundy, then this would be Telmo Rodriguez’s Rioja answer to world-class Bordeaux. Decant it to let the complexity come through. Drink through the next 20 plus years.

 

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate 

The second vintage of the top-of-the-range 2018 Yjar was produced with Tempranillo, Garnacha, Graciano and other grapes from selected plots from Remelluri. It has 14.6% alcohol and a pH of 3.45. This has a more modern profile than the other wines from Remelluri, with more sophisticated tannins, a wine that is different, ripe and powerful, with the depth of the Remelluri wines. It's spicy and peppery, long and chewy with a long finish marked by the limestone from the soils. 5,700 bottles produced. It was bottled in May 2021.

glencadam-2012-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Glencadam 2012 8 Year Old 51% ABV
glencadam-2012-twa.bodyHtml:
Vintage 2012

Bottled 2021

Stated Age 08 years old

Casktype PX Hogshead

Strength 51.0 % Vol.

guigal-chateau-de-nalys-cdp-rouge-2018.title: E. Guigal Chateau De Nalys Chateauneuf-Du-Pape Rouge 2018
guigal-chateau-de-nalys-cdp-rouge-2018.bodyHtml:
The 2018 E. Guigal "Château de Nalys" Grand Vin is a highly acclaimed and structured red, representing the first vintage fully managed by Philippe Guigal from budbreak to bottling. Sourced from the estate's three distinct terroirs—La Crau (50%), Nalys (27%), and Bois Sénéchal (23%)—this wine captures the complexity of ancient alluvial stones and red sandstone. It offers a deep, concentrated bouquet of steeped blackberry, raspberry, and black cherry, elegantly interwoven with notes of sanguine, bay leaf, and licorice root. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and regal, showcasing a plush, silky texture balanced by firm tannins and a vibrant acidity. Aged for 18 months in wood (30%) and concrete (70%), it was ranked #10 in Wine Spectator's Top 100 of 2021 and concludes with a long, noble finish of peppery garrigue and sweet incense.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The flagship wine of de Nalys is sourced from the famed La Crau vineyard. This powerful, complex red highlights Grenache, augmented by Syrah, Mourvèdre, Counoise and Vacarèse. Matured partially in oak, it offers black-plum flavours muted by shades of earth, sun-scorched garrigue and a lingering vein of salty minerality. While soft in tannin, the wine needs time to tease out its smoky, stony nuances.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

A bright savoury note leads off this red, followed quickly by sanguine and bay leaf accents, melding nicely with the core of steeped blackberry, raspberry and plum fruit flavours as they move through the rich, licorice root–tinged finish. Best from 2022 through 2035.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackberry, cocoa, black cherry and a hint of cedar. Full-bodied with slightly chewy tannins. Tannins and fruit are very nicely integrated with real composure and structure. Focused and succinct. Coffee and plum. This will age very nicely. 59% grenache, 32% syrah, 5% mourvedre, 3% counoise, 1% vacarese. Drink or hold.

guigal-chateau-de-nalys-cdp-rouge-2016.title: E. Guigal Chateau De Nalys Chateauneuf-Du-Pape Rouge 2016
guigal-chateau-de-nalys-cdp-rouge-2016.bodyHtml:
The 2016 E. Guigal "Château de Nalys" Grand Vin is a monumental and intensely expressive red, marking the debut vintage of this historic estate under the Guigal family's ownership. Sourced from three exceptional terroirs—Nalys (27%), Bois Sénéchal (23%), and La Crau (50%)—this wine captures the diverse geology of Châteauneuf-du-Pape, from red sandstone to large round pebbles (galets). It offers an intense bouquet of ripe black cherries, blackberries, and raspberries, woven with sophisticated notes of exotic spices, incense, licorice, and sandalwood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, featuring a beautiful composition of power and elegance with silky tannins and a vibrant mineral energy. Aged for 18 months in a combination of wood (30%) and concrete (70%), it concludes with an exceptionally long and noble finish.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

2016 marks the first bottling of de Nalys under the Guigal umbrella and this intensely ripe but pristine wine makes a promising debut. It's luscious but elegant, loaded with rich black-plum and cassis flavors firmed by piquant hits of licorice and pepper. Silky tannins make it approachable already but the wine should improve through 2036 and hold further still.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Destined to become Nalys's new flagship (unless the white version steals the show), the 2016 Chateauneuf du Pape Grand Vin is a blend of 59% Grenache, 32% Syrah, 5% Mourvedre, 3% Counoise and 1% Vaccarese. It's full-bodied and velvety, offering hints of vanilla and sandalwood, but there also are layers of dark cherry fruit. Subtle notes of cinnamon, clove and allspice add interest to the long, silky finish. It's an auspicious debut for the Guigal team.

93 Points - James Suckling

Very rich, multilayered Chateauneuf with ripe red-plum and dark-berry aromas. The palate has such intense and fresh, juicy-fruit drive. Long and focused finish. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This is a fleshy and dense offering, with layers of warm cassis, plum sauce and cherry preserve flavors seamlessly entwined, while warm fruitcake and melted red licorice notes fill in through the finish. There's a whiff of smoky tea at the very end, while the fruit plays out. Best from 2020 through 2034.

palacios-descendientes-la-faraona.title: Descendientes De J.Palacios La Faraona 2018 750ml
palacios-descendientes-la-faraona.bodyHtml:
From tiny vineyard in Paraje El Ferro, located in the town of Corullón, that produce 1660 bottles a year, La Faraona: one of the great wines from Bierzo is subtle with a complex combination of flowers, herbs, spices and an Atlantic breath that smeels of fern and moss. It has freshness and lightness but also lot of energy. 

100 Points - Robert Parker

The often-mysterious and ever-changing 2018 La Faraona comes from the vineyard called El Ferro, a very special plot ("I personally prune each single vine from La Faraona," Ricardo once told me. "She's mine!") of only 0.55 hectares that probably has 8% white grapes of the Godello and Jerez varieties. The vines are 72 years old on a very steep southeast-facing slope at 800 to 860 meters in altitude, and there is a tectonic fault that crosses the land and brings an unusual combination of elements and very shallow soils with the mother rock barely 30 centimeters down. The partly destemmed grapes fermented with indigenous yeasts in an oak vat, and the wine matured in foudre and barrique for 12 months. The perfume coming out of the glass was simply mind-boggling, a subtle and complex combination of flowers, herbs and spices that had taken me to different places (often the Loire) in the past, but this time it took me to the green and humid slopes of the Bierzo, the wet soils and the Atlantic smell of the ferns and moss. This is the most Atlantic of the 2018s. It has freshness and lightness but also lots of energy and light. It has great purity, a very strong sense of place, and it encapsulates the humid slopes of Corullón like no other. This is nothing short of amazing. Ricardo told me this has been the only vintage of La Faraona where the wine was harmonious all the way, starting from the grapes, which gives me an idea of a wine that is going to show and drink nicely throughout its life. It's different from the 2014, which was from a cooler year, but this is every bit as good. 1,666 bottles, 54 magnums, 10 double magnums and six jeroboams were filled the 22nd of January 2020. They've been regrafting a good percentage of the white vines to red for eight years. Drink 2020-2035.

salcheto-riserva-2016.title: Salcheto Riserva Di Vino Nobile 2016
salcheto-riserva-2016.bodyHtml:
Salcheto Riserva Di Vino Nobile 2016 is a beautifully crafted, classic-style organic Tuscan red wine representing a stellar, "old-school" vintage for the estate. Composed primarily of estate-grown Prugnolo Gentile (Sangiovese) with a small touch of Colorino, this wine underwent 24 months of aging in oak barrels (70% in large casks, 30% in tonneaux) followed by at least 12 months of bottle refinement. On the nose, it reveals an incredibly expressive, fragrant bouquet of ripe red cherries, dark plums, and wild violets, gracefully layered with notes of sweet tobacco, warm baking spices, and fresh mint. The palate is polished, elegant, and medium-bodied, balancing its vibrant dark berry fruit core with a lively line of mineral acidity and tightly knit, silky tannins that carry through to a persistent, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with rosemary-infused roasted lamb chops, slow-braised wild boar ragù over pappardelle pasta, or aged pecorino Toscano cheese.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Boasting ripe black cherry, blackberry, floral and licorice flavors, this red is expressive and balanced. Firm tannins offer structure as this remains on the elegant side, lingering with echoes of fruit, wild herbs and mineral. Drink now through 2032.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of plum, violet and tobacco are front and center along with a whiff of camphor on this fragrant, savory red. The smooth, enveloping palate has a weightless quality, featuring spiced blueberry, dried cherry and licorice framed in tightly knit but elegant tannins. Drink through 2031.

91 Points - James Suckling

Dried flowers, black cherries and sage on the nose. Full-to medium-bodied with fine, well integrated tannins. Light licorice character to the palate. Sweet herbs and melted chocolate at the finish. From organically grown grapes. Drink or hold.

g-m-glentauchers-2006-connoisseurs-cho.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Glentauchers 15 Year Old 2006 Refill Bourbon Barrel Cask 703714 57.6% ABV
g-m-glentauchers-2006-connoisseurs-cho.bodyHtml: The Connoisseur's Choice range is an ever-changing collection of unique perspectives on distilleries’ own bottlings, non-chill-filtered single cask and small batch expressions bottled at cask strength. Orange and malted biscuit aromas are balanced by white pepper. Smooth lemon and lime zest give way to the flavours of toasted almonds. A slightly dry finish with citrus fruits.

benromach-cara-gold-malt.title: Benromach Cask Strength Vintage 2014 Batch 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
benromach-cara-gold-malt.bodyHtml:
Benromach Cask Strength Vintage 2014 Batch 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a limited-release Speyside single malt distilled in 2014 and bottled in 2024 at its natural cask strength of 60.6% ABV. Matured for a decade exclusively in first-fill Sherry and bourbon casks, this powerful expression combines rich fruitcake character with stewed fruit, warming spice, toasted oak and Benromach's distinctive smoky character. It is bottled at natural colour and without chill filtration.

Food Pairing: Pair with smoked beef, glazed pork ribs, mature cheddar, dark chocolate, fruitcake or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and concentrated with fruitcake, stewed plum, marmalade, warming spice, toasted oak and lingering smoke.

Nose: Sweet vanilla leads into fruitcake, brown sugar and spicy ginger, followed by cinnamon, milk chocolate and oak.

Palate: Creamy and spicy with stewed plum, Seville orange and cracked black pepper, developing toasted oak and subtle liquorice.

Finish: Long and full with lingering smoke and a touch of aniseed.

domaine-de-chevalier-blanc-2019.title: Domaine de Chevalier Blanc 2019
domaine-de-chevalier-blanc-2019.bodyHtml:
One of Bordeaux's finest white wines, Domaine de Chevalier Blanc offers captivating aromas of grapefruit, lemon zest, white peach, pear, acacia blossom, flint, and delicate toasted oak. Richly textured yet brilliantly fresh, it delivers crystalline acidity, remarkable precision, profound minerality, and an exceptionally long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with lobster, seared scallops, grilled turbot, oysters, roast chicken, creamy seafood pasta, goat cheese, or butter-poached asparagus.

 

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

I loved the 2019 Domaine De Chevalier Blanc, which has the crisp, racy, yet concentrated style of the estate that few others can achieve. Gorgeous white peach, mandarin orange, honeyed minerality, and a kiss of toast all define the bouquet, and it hits the palate with medium to full-bodied richness, integrated acidity, plenty of concentration, and a great finish that picks up some obvious minerality. This stunning juice needs 3-4 years of bottle age and will evolve for 2-3 decades if stored correctly. It's probably the white of the vintage. Best After 2025

96 Points - James Suckling

Very pretty with lovely apple, cream, lavender, pineapple and light honey. Full-bodied, yet creamy and refined, with great length and polish. Fresh acidity, but the finish is polished and pretty. Subtle. 70% sauvignon blanc and 30% semillon.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Domaine de Chevalier's 2019 Blanc is performing brilliantly, unwinding in the glass with notes of citrus pith, white currants, crisp orchard fruit, spring flowers, lemongrass and beeswax. Medium to full-bodied, deep and layered, it's concentrated and structured, with terrific depth at the core, racy acids and a long, sapid finish. This is a white Bordeaux where the vulgarity of Sauvignon is sublimated rather than emphasized, and the result is a compelling wine of considerable complexity and aging potential. Best after 2025.

93 Points - Decanter

Grip, power, nectarine, citrus, slate, this is an excellent Chevalier white that is clearly going to age extremely well. White flowers play around the edges, but it is the texture that appeals the most, reflecting its cooler terroir that works in hot summers like 2019.
Barrel Sample
93 Points - Wine Spectator

Plump and with good underlying juiciness, this lets white peach, lemon peel and fleur de sel notes move through at a steady pace, featuring flashes of acacia and brioche on the finish. Understated and nicely done for the vintage. Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon. Drink now.

chateau-levangile-2019.title: Chateau L'Evangile 2019 750ml
chateau-levangile-2019.bodyHtml: Expert tasting note: (2019 vintage) "The deep, dark, virtually opaque color seems a little developed at the rim. The dark-fruit aromas are chocolatey, a touth leathery and very ripe. The palate shows opulent black-cherry, chocolate, vanilla & beautifully integrated cedary new-oak notes. The wine is full-bodied, chocolatey-smooth & velvety textured. Fresh acidity keeps the opulent, hedonistic, ripe, dark-fruit juicy to the end while warming alcohol enhances sweet-spice hints." - 10/23 DCAMW

domaine-de-chevalier-rouge-2019.title: Domaine de Chevalier 2019
domaine-de-chevalier-rouge-2019.bodyHtml:
One of Pessac-Léognan's most revered estates, Domaine de Chevalier reveals refined aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, graphite, cedar, violet, and cigar box. Elegant yet powerfully structured, it delivers silky tannins, vibrant freshness, remarkable complexity, and an exceptionally long finish with outstanding aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, grilled ribeye, roast lamb, duck confit, venison, truffle potatoes, aged Comté, or braised short ribs.

 

97 Points - Decanter

Beautiful fragrance on the nose, blackcurrant and floral reflections with violets. Smells expressive and round. Smooth on the palate, filling but calm and controlled. Suave and sophisticated, plump with lovely high acidity that lifts the palate and creates a nice tangy contrast to the soft spices and the clear minerality. Where the 2018 has more muscle and fleshiness the 2019 has more depth and class. It's fun, playful, clean, the acidity is gorgeous and this will carry to a longlife.
