Still a baby, I wouldn't drink this right now, but this has exceptional potential and I love the minty freshness and salty stone touches at the end. Sweet, succulent and precise. Gorgeous.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

I loved the 2019 Domaine De Chevalier, which is unquestionably up with the crème de la crème of the vintage. A blend of 65% Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot, and 5% Petit Verdot that saw just 35% new oak, it sports a dense purple hue as well as a killer, quintessential Graves bouquet of darker black fruits, scorched earth, truffle, cold fireplace, tobacco, and graphite. More medium to full-bodied on the palate, it has brilliant purity, ultra-fine tannins, flawless balance, and a great, great finish. It's not a blockbuster but has this incredible sense of class, balance, and finesse while being rich and concentrated. It's a gorgeous wine, and wine lovers will adore being able to compare this side by side with the 2015, 2016, and 2018 over the coming 3-4 decades. Best After 2022.

97 Points - James Suckling

Beautiful, ripe redcurrants, bay leaf, violets and raspberries on the nose. Full-bodied with firm and very tight tannins that are polished and layered. Crushed stones highlight the beautiful blue fruit. Poised and refined.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Domaine de Chevalier is a magical wine in the making, wafting from the glass with aromas of wild plums, crushed blackcurrants and violets mingled with hints of pencil shavings, subtle spices and coniferous forest floor. Medium to full-bodied, deep and seamless, with a vibrant core of fruit, beautifully refined tannins and lively acids, it's exquisitely elegant and harmonious, concluding with a long, perfumed finish. Stylistically, this wine exhibits a much closer affinity with the great Domaine de Chevalier of yesteryear than much of what was produced here in the early 2000s. It's a masterclass in what contemporary Bordeaux can deliver, and worth a special effort to seek out. Best after 2029.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

With its finely structured tannins and juicy black currant fruits, this has the potential to be an important wine. The balance between the fruit and structure is already there, promising richness as the wine matures. Barrel Sample: 95-97
94 Points - Wine Spectator

Very lush and forward, with a lovely wave of warmed plum reduction, cassis and blackberry preserve flavors. Features a subtle rumble of dark earth and warm stone through the finish, where licorice and apple wood accents also peek in. Delivers spine for form, but this is going to provide its best showing in the medium-term, as the fruit is so precocious.

chateau-leoville-poyferre-2019.title: Chateau Leoville Poyferre 2021
chateau-leoville-poyferre-2019.bodyHtml:
96 Points - Vinous

The 2021 Léoville-Poyferré has developed into a fabulous wine. Surprisingly rich, the 2021 possesses notable depth. Kirsch, blood orange and wildflowers open first, lending a decidedly exotic, perfumed quality. On the palate, the 2021 is fleshy and expressive. There's a bit of new oak that needs to integrate. Otherwise, the 2021 is impeccably balanced. Tasted two times. –Antonio Galloni

96 Points - James Suckling

Excellent depth and complexity with a nice modern touch of cocoa powder to the black olives, pencil shavings, cassis, violets, black mushrooms and dark earth. Full-bodied palate with fresh, vertical tannins and lots of juicy fruit that seamlessly dissolve into the flavorful, persistent finish. Refined power with real length.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The Grand Vin 2021 Château Léoville Poyferré from this brilliant estate checks in as 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Merlot, 9% Cabernet Franc, and the rest Petit Verdot. It has a serious, concentrated, inward style as well as impressive red and black currant-like fruit supported by notes of graphite, smoked tobacco, spicy oak, and chocolate. With terrific richness, a layered, concentrated mid-palate, and fine tannins, this is clearly one of the gems in the vintage. It needs to be forgotten for just 4-5 years, and I wouldn't be surprised to see it evolve for over two decades.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A rich, ripe toasted nose, clearly concentrated. Good fruit density, underlying power and sense of structure. This has personality, it does feel a tiny bit pushed on the palate with acidity opening the expression but the fruitiness fades quite quickly and is replaced by the tannic structure and menthol, herbal Cabernet aspects. It's smooth with a long length. Nice bones for ageing, so give this a few years.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Léoville Poyferré opens in the glass with notes of minty berries, dark berry compote, pencil shavings and toasty oak, followed by a medium to full-bodied, deep and dense palate that's quite muscular and extracted, built around a chassis of sweet, abundant tannins that assert themselves on the youthfully firm finish.

chateau-cos-destournel-2019-1.title: Chateau Cos d'Estournel Pagodes de Cos 2019
chateau-cos-destournel-2019-1.bodyHtml:
A creamy attack, buttery and spicy, characteristic of Pagodes de Cos precedes elegantly balanced aromas of blackcurrant, blueberry,blackberry, violet, bergamot and black tea. The 2019 vintage also presents velvety tannins and a very long finish with a magnificent,refreshing touch of salinity. Incredibly dense and elegant, Pagodes de Cos 2019 is a wine with instantaneous powers of seduction.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The powerful tannins of the wine show its considerable aging potential. The second wine of Cos d'Estournel, this is a great wine in its own right showing a rich structure and dark fruits.
94 Points - James Suckling
This is very spicy and linear with fine tannins that run the length of the wine. It’s medium-bodied with freshness and lovely length. Very classic in style. Closed at the end.
94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Les Pagodes de Cos (14.03% alcohol) is a blend of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 36% Merlot, 4% Petit Verdot and 5% Cabernet Franc, aging in 20% new barriques. Medium to deep garnet-purple in color, notions of wild blueberries, boysenberries and redcurrant jelly come bounding out of the glass, followed by a profound core of warm cassis, licorice and bouquet garni with a touch of cinnamon stick. Medium to full-bodied, the palate bursts with bright, expressive black and red fruit flavors, framed by firm, fine-grained tannins and loads of freshness, finishing on a lingering spicy note.

91 Points - Wine Spectator
A floral, piercing style, with lilac, red currant, rooibos tea and iron notes allied as they race through the fresh finish. Shows lovely precision, in an unadorned style. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Drink now.

chateau-pontet-canet-2019.title: Chateau Pontet Canet 2020
chateau-pontet-canet-2019.bodyHtml:
One of Pauillac's most acclaimed estates, Château Pontet-Canet reveals intense aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, graphite, cedar, violet, and cigar box. Powerful yet seamlessly elegant, it delivers velvety tannins, vibrant freshness, exceptional concentration, and a remarkably long finish with extraordinary aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, grilled ribeye, roast lamb, venison, duck confit, truffle potatoes, aged Comté, or braised short ribs.

 

98 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackcurrants and black cherries with hints of crushed walnuts, grilled thyme, cocoa powder and graphite. It’s full-bodied with layers of ultra-fine, silky tannins that elegantly coat your palate, allowing the juicy and vibrant fruit to shine. Delicate and pristine, yet compact with lots of energy and power to uncover in the coming years. It lasts for minutes and is delicious now. The purity of fruit is really impressive. 60% cabernet sauvignon, 32% merlot, 4% cabernet franc and 4% petit verdot. 50% new oak 15% old oak and 35% concrete amphorae. Try after 2027.
97 Points - Decanter
Dark chocolate, bramble tones, not overly floral or fruity with some cedar and cinnamon notes. Lovely high acidity straight away, forward, bright and energetic with lovely crunchy blue fruit on the palate but creamy textured tannins giving a round and complete mouthful. Nothing feels overdone, this is quietly seductive and confident but not at all showing off. I love the minerality and the graphite grip with plum and black cherry and tons of slate, liquorice and menthol freshness. Long finish, slowly expansive, building and growing from start to finish showing an impressive structure overall. Nicely constructed, charming still with the Pauillac touch. A great Pontet - immediately seductive and enjoyable with a long ageing potential.
97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The flagship from this estate, the 2020 Château Pontet-Canet is a beauty based on 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 32% Merlot, and 4% each of Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, brought up in 50% new oak, with 35% in amphora. Deep purple-hued with a great nose of dark currants, plums, tobacco leaf, and truffly earth, it hits the palate with full-bodied richness, a layered, seamless mouthfeel and a great finish. The higher Merlot content here really shows in its overall sexy, supple, seamless style, and while this already offers pleasure, it's going to be one for the ages as well. Rating: 97+
97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The magnificent structure and balance of this wine are powerful. It shows poise between the black fruits and the freshness of the vintage, while the texture is almost velvet. The wine is juicy and seriously structured at the same time.

g-m-ledaig-2004-connoisseurs-choice.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Ledaig 17 Year Old 2004 Refill Bourbon Barrel Cask 16600609 54.6% ABV
g-m-ledaig-2004-connoisseurs-choice.bodyHtml:
Ledaig 2004 17 Year Old is a single cask Island single malt from Gordon & MacPhail's Connoisseurs Choice Cask Strength series, made at the Tobermory distillery under its Ledaig name. Distilled in 2004, it matured for 17 years in refill bourbon barrel cask 16600609 and was bottled on 16 February 2022 at a natural cask strength of 54.6% ABV. Only 120 bottles were filled, all destined for Alberta. Non-chill filtered and with no added colour, it pairs savoury smoke with bright fruit: cured meat, vanilla and lime on the nose, apricot and tropical fruit with chilli heat on the palate, and a citrus finish with bonfire embers. 700ml.

Tasting Notes: Smoke, cured meat, lime, apricot and chilli spice.

Nose: Cured meat opening onto vanilla, zesty lime and rich smoke.

Palate: Sweet apricot and tropical fruit building to chilli spice.

Finish: Medium, with citrus and bonfire embers.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

continuum-novicium.title: Continuum Novicium 2019/2020 750ml
continuum-novicium.bodyHtml:
Continuum is yet another page in the Mondavi family legacy, a “5th beginning”. Founded in 2005, it is a partnership between members of the Robert, Marcia and Tim Mondavi families. It is a rededication and refinement of the family’s longstanding commitment to excellence in winemaking. Continuum’s goal is to produce a single wine that is recognized among the finest in the world.

Novicium is so-named for being the ongoing study of the winery’s Sage Mountain Vineyard. This “novitiate” offers a decidedly different glimpse, giving the winegrowers greater freedom to further explore the myriad of elements that give our Sage Mountain Vineyard distinction.

Novicium displays its predecessors’ signature approachability with a fresh and playful nose of red fruit and candied apple mixed with autumn leaves, bay laurel and the slightest hint of dewy spring peonies. A vibrant and direct wine, it has a plush entry and weighted mid palate of dark chocolate, black fruit, brown spice and tapenade. A vintage character both friendly and powerful, with Sage Mountain Vineyard’s iron core and a brightly expressed structure and finish.

95 Points - James Suckling

“Very fruity on the nose with black cherries, blueberries and graphite. Full-bodied with a center-palate of ripe fruit and dark chocolate. Iron, too. Soft tannins and a flavorful finish. Layered. Drink or hold.”

vallein-tercinier-lot-68-asta-maurice.title: Asta Maurice Vallein Tercinier Lot 68 1968 Cognac

jean-filoux-la-fleche-de-feu-malternativ.title: Malternative #12 'La Fleche de Feu' Jean Fillioux Lot 92 1992 Grande Champagne Cognac
jean-filoux-la-fleche-de-feu-malternativ.bodyHtml:
La Flèche de Feu is a Grande Champagne cognac from the house of Jean Fillioux, distilled in 1992 and bottled in 2021 by the Belgian independent bottler Malternative Belgium, at just under 30 years of age one of the younger cognacs in its range. It was bottled at 43% ABV, with 252 bottles of 700ml released.

Nose: Bright, floral and juicy: stewed apple, orange and nectarine with acacia honey, light vanilla and a hint of jasmine.

Palate: Notably sweet, with mirabelle, orange and quince jam, melon and honey, then light herbs, chocolate, toffee and vanilla.

Finish: Medium length, with nutmeg, cinnamon, red fruit and wood.

la-boutique-lot-69-cognac-malternative.title: Malternative #36 'En Danseuse' Paul Beau Lot 70 1970 Grande Champagne Cognac
la-boutique-lot-69-cognac-malternative.bodyHtml:
Produced by Maison Paul Beau in Segonzac and selected by independent bottler Malternative Belgium, this single-cask release originates from the prestigious Grande Champagne terroir. Sourced from the 1970 harvest (designated as Lot 70), this ultra-aged cognac spent over five decades maturing in French oak cellars. It demonstrates classic Grande Champagne complexity, highlighting deep tropical fruitiness, polished oak, floral undertones, and well-developed rancio.

Food Pairing: Aged Comte cheese, dark chocolate with candied orange peel, roasted duck with plum sauce, pecan pie, or enjoyed as a contemplative digestif alongside a fine cigar.

Tasting Notes: Deep mahogany amber with brilliant copper highlights and heavy, slow-forming legs along the glass.

Nose: Complex and expressive, opening with dried mango, passionfruit, and candied orange peel, followed by old leather, cigar box, polished cedarwood, and gentle rancio.

Palate: Rich, round, and elegant on the palate, featuring sweet papaya, dried apricot, honeyed tropical fruit, and gentle wood tannins before evolving into tobacco leaf, nutmeg, and soft cocoa spice.

Finish: Long, warming, and remarkably refined with lingering notes of tropical fruit, old oak, subtle rancio, and dried flowers.

Serve: Enjoy neat at room temperature in a tulip glass, letting it breathe for a few minutes before sipping.

daniel-bouju-lot-60-le-brule-malternativ.title: Malternative #14 'Le Brule' Daniel Bouju Lot 60 1960 Grande Champagne Cognac
daniel-bouju-lot-60-le-brule-malternativ.bodyHtml:
Le Brûlé is the first release from the house of Daniel Bouju by the Belgian independent bottler Malternative Belgium, a Lot 60 Grande Champagne cognac bottled in 2022. Bouju is a family producer in the heart of Grande Champagne dating from 1805, with around 15 hectares of vines, and it controls every step from vine to bottle. The house is known for its bousinage: casks are heavily toasted to caramelise the wood, and after some years the spirit moves to older, less active barrels. Bottled at 50.5% ABV, 246 bottles of 700ml.

Nose: Deep, with a rum-like edge: demerara sugar, tobacco leaf, cigar box and lightly charred oak, then nutmeg, clove, cinnamon, rancio and leather.

Palate: Rich brown sugar and molasses with fig and prune jam, then liquorice, tobacco, leather and herbal, slightly medicinal notes.

Finish: Quite long, chalky and mineral, with salty notes.

grossperin-lot-84-cognac-malterna-x-asta.title: Malternative x Asta Maurice Grosperrin Lot 84 1984 Petite Champagne Cognac
grossperin-lot-84-cognac-malterna-x-asta.bodyHtml:
Grosperrin Lot 84 1984 Petite Champagne Cognac is the first 'Les Bons Vivants' release (LBV1), a joint label from Belgian independent bottlers Malternative Belgium and Asta Morris. For their debut the two friends chose a single cask of 1984 Petite Champagne from the cellars of Grosperrin in Saintes. Bottled in March 2022 at 56.6% ABV, the cask filled just 263 bottles of 70cl. The bottlers describe it as a 38-year-old Petite Champagne caught at its best moment of maturity, its tropical fruit balanced by sweet spice. It earned 90 points from Whiskyfun, 89/100 from Whiskynotes and 88/100 from Whivie.

Tasting Notes: Tropical fruit, soft peppery spice and a long, warming finish.

Nose: Lean and fresh at first, with mint, grassy and mineral touches, opening to pineapple, nectarine and jasmine tea.

Palate: Juicy mirabelle, kiwi, bergamot and passion fruit, with soft pepper, a génépi-like herbal note, polished oak and grapefruit peel.

Finish: Very long and warm, with bright fruit, verbena and oak spice.

Serve: Neat in a tulip glass at room temperature; a few drops of water can open it up.

jadot-beaune-1er-clos-des-ursules.title: Louis Jadot Beaune Clos des Ursules Premier Cru Monopole Domaine des Heritiers 2022 1.5L Magnum
jadot-beaune-1er-clos-des-ursules.bodyHtml:
A full, firm, rich wine, Clos des Ursules has aromas of earth and red fruit and perfectly balances elegance and power.

Serve with delicate meat dishes or cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

A big, rounded and generous wine that wraps fine-grained tannins around gorgeous red and black fruit on a full body. Clos des Ursules is a monople of Jadot’s and one of the vineyards they have used for generations. Opens with spicy cinnamon, cloves and toast, then vivid raspberries, red plums and mint on the palate.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Pure and bursting with energy and tension, this red's cherry, blackberry, floral and mineral flavors are locked tight today. Nonetheless, this offers terrific balance and intensity, with just a hint of oak spice. The long, resonant aftertaste is driven by vibrant acidity. Shows excellent potential.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Beaune 1er Cru Clos des Ursules (Domaine des Héritiers Jadot) unwinds in the glass with aromas of sweet berries, cherries, spices and vine smoke. Medium to full-bodied, layered and seamless, with sweet, powdery tannins and a long, spicy finish, this site, an enclave in Vignes Franches that's one of the house's emblematic wines, always performs well.

jadot-beaune-savigny-les-beaune-narbanto.title: Louis Jadot Savigny-les-Beaune La Dominode Premier Cru 2017
jadot-beaune-savigny-les-beaune-narbanto.bodyHtml:
Bright red berry aromas and flavors lead this vivacious wine. It will develop in the bottle for 7 to 10 years.

This versatile red wine will pair well with light red or white meat dishes and fowl. The more mature wine will complement highly flavored sauces.

91 Points - Decanter

Demonstrating once again that Jadot has a long and distinguished track record in Savigny, this premier cru red is appealingly forward, enticing and floral, unfurling aromas and flavours of rose petal and wild strawberry with savoury tannins adding depth to the finish.

blended-malt-2001-moon-twa.title: The Whisky Agency x Moonbroch Blended Malt 2001 19 Year Old 45.8% ABV
blended-malt-2001-moon-twa.bodyHtml: Introducing the 2001 Blended Malt by Moonbroch, a blend of exceptional single malt whiskies aged a minimum 19 years. Distilled in 2001 and bottled in 2021, this whisky has been carefully married in a Sherry Butt to impart a rich and complex flavor profile. The result is a smooth and delicious whisky that is perfect for sipping neat. Experience the depth and complexity of a well-aged single malt with the 2001 Blended Malt by Moonbroch.

glenrothes-1997-peace-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Glenrothes 1997 23 Year Old Peace 51.3% ABV
glenrothes-1997-peace-twa.bodyHtml:
The Whisky Agency/ Heads & Tails brings us a very special bottling of Glenrothes, matured in an ex-Bourbon Hogshead for 23 years. Our dear friend (and the agent who brings this to our market) Igor Kossov, has dedicated this release - and a portion of the proceeds - to Ukraine. He's also The peace symbol on the label speaks volumes. We'll let that and whisky speak for themselves. 

Distilled in 1997 and bottled in 2021. Natural colour and non chill-filtered. 51.3%

balmenach-1989-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Balmenach 1989 32 Year Old Bourbon Hogshead 45.4% ABV
balmenach-1989-twa.bodyHtml: The Whisky Agency Balmenach 1989 32 Year Old 45.4% ABV 700ml

fernandes-rum-1999.title: Rhumb Runner Fernandes Trinidad 1999 18 Year Old Rum

ardmore-2013-moon-twa.title: Moonbroch Spaceman Ardmore 2010 12 Year Old 53.7% ABV
ardmore-2013-moon-twa.bodyHtml:
DISTILLED June 2010
BOTTLED August 2022
AGE 12
CASK Bourbon Barrel
ABV% 53.7
TASTING NOTE Delicate earthy peatiness, almost petrol-y. Turkish delight and dried pineapple aromas lead to a palate that presents similarly finishing with a mellow sweetness. Gentle and inviting for a spirit-forward dram.

craigellachie-2008-moon-twa.title: The Whisky Agency x Moonbroch Craigellachie 2008 13 Year Old 55.2% ABV
craigellachie-2008-moon-twa.bodyHtml: The 2008 Craigellachie 13 Year Old from Moonbroch is a premium Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the Craigellachie Distillery. Distilled in 2008, this whisky has been aged for 13 years in a Sherry Butt before being bottled in 2022. This aging process has imparted a rich and complex flavor profile. The Craigellachie distillery is known for its bold and assertive style, and the Sherry Butt maturation adds notes of dried fruits, nuttiness, and a hint of spice. Enjoyed best neat or with a few drops of water, our 2008 Craigellachie 13 Year Old is a truly satisfying whisky experience. A perfect choice for whisky lovers who appreciate a full-bodied and robust flavor profile.

glen-moray-2007-moon-twa.title: The Whisky Agency x Moonbroch Glen Moray 2007 14 Year Old 52.2% ABV
glen-moray-2007-moon-twa.bodyHtml: Our 2007 Glen Moray 14 Year Old is a premium Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the Glen Moray Distillery. Distilled in 2007, this whisky has been aged for 14 years in a barrel before being bottled in 2021. This aging process has imparted a complex and rich flavor profile, making it a true gem of a whisky. The Glen Moray distillery is known for its smooth and approachable style, and the barrel maturation adds notes of vanilla, caramel, and oak. Perfect for those who appreciate the traditional style of Scotch whisky. Whether enjoyed neat or with a drop of water, Moonbroch 2007 Glen Moray 14 Year Old is a truly satisfying whisky experience. A perfect choice for both whisky connoisseurs and those new to the world of single malts.

ledaig-2008-moon-twa.title: The Whisky Agency x Moonbroch Ledaig 2008 13 Year Old 51.4% ABV
ledaig-2008-moon-twa.bodyHtml: Moonbroch 2008 Ledaig 13 Year Old is a premium Island Single Malt Scotch Whisky from Tobermory/Ledaig Distillery. Distilled in 2008, this whisky has been aged for 13 years in a Hogshead before being bottled in 2021. This aging process has allowed the whisky to develop a complex and rich flavor profile, making it a true connoisseur's choice. Ledaig is known for its unique peated style, which gives this whisky a distinct smoky and earthy character. Whether you're a seasoned whisky drinker or just starting to explore the world of single malts, Moonbroch's 2008 Ledaig 13 Year Old is sure to impress.

linkwood-2009-moon-twa.title: The Whisky Agency x Moonbroch Linkwood 2009 12 Year Old 52.5% ABV
linkwood-2009-moon-twa.bodyHtml: Moonbroch’s premium Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the Linkwood Distillery. Aged for 12 long years, this whisky has been distilled in 2009 and bottled in 2021, making it a perfect choice for those who appreciate aged, mature spirits. Matured in a barrel, this whisky boasts a rich and complex flavor profile, with notes of vanilla, chamomile, and oak. Perfect for sipping neat, this is a must-have for any whisky lover. Enjoy the smooth and refined taste of Linkwood's finest with Moonbroch.

secret-islay-2011-moon-twa.title: The Whisky Agency x Moonbroch Secret Islay 2011 10 Year Old 53.8% ABV
secret-islay-2011-moon-twa.bodyHtml: Moonbroch's 2011 Secret Islay 10 year old is a rare and exclusive Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky. From a secret distillery on the island of Islay, aged for a decade, this whisky was distilled in 2011 and bottled in 2021, making it a truly unique and special spirit. Matured in a Port Barrique, it offers a complex and rich flavor profile with notes of peat smoke, dark fruit, and a hint of sweetness. Savor every sip of this limited release whisky and the craftsmanship and tradition of Islay's distilleries.

tamdhu-2007-moon-twa.title: The Whisky Agency x Moonbroch Tamdhu 2007 14 Year Old 52.9%
tamdhu-2007-moon-twa.bodyHtml:
The Tamdhu Distillery, located in the heart of Speyside, Scotland, has been producing high-quality single malt whisky since 1897. The Moonbroch 2007 Tamdhu 14 Year Old is a true representation of the distillery's expertise and commitment to quality. Aged for 14 years in a Hogshead cask, this whisky was distilled in 2007 and bottled in 2021, making it a perfect choice for those who appreciate a well-matured and complex whisky.

With its rich and nuanced flavor profile, this Tamdhu is a true connoisseur's choice. The Hogshead cask imparts a delicate balance of flavours, with notes of honey, vanilla, and grasses. The 14 years of aging lends a depth and complexity that is sure to please even the most discerning palate.

glentauchers-2009-moon-twa.title: Moonbroch The Whisky Agency Glentauchers 2009 54.1% ABV
glentauchers-2009-moon-twa.bodyHtml:
The Moonbroch 2009 Glentauchers 12 Year Old is a Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the Glentauchers Distillery. Distilled in 2009, this whisky has been aged for 12 years in a Sherry Butt before being bottled in 2021. This aging process has imparted a rich and complex flavor profile, making it a true connoisseur's choice. The Glentauchers distillery is known for its fruity and floral style, and the Sherry Butt maturation adds notes of dried fruits, nuttiness, and a hint of spice. The Moonbroch 2009 Glentauchers 12 Year Old is a truly satisfying whisky experience. A perfect choice for whisky lovers who appreciate the subtler, more nuanced side of Scotch.

Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky from Glentauchers Distillery
Aged for 12 Years.
Distilled in 2009 and Bottled in 2021
Matured in a Sherry Butt

dailuaine-1997-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Dailuaine 1997 23 Year Old 50.9% ABV
dailuaine-1997-twa.bodyHtml:
Dailuaine 1997 The Whisky Agency is a Scotch whisky distilled at Dailuaine in 1997 and released by the independent bottler The Whisky Agency. It is bottled at 50.9% ABV in a 700ml bottle and is listed in Alberta through Heads & Tails Spirit Co.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

ledaig-2008-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Ledaig 2008 13 Year Old 51.3% ABV
ledaig-2008-twa.bodyHtml:
Beauty and the beast. A gorgeous label wrapped around a fierce style of peated island whisky. You may have to fight Evan for this one, but we'll tie him down if need be. Ledaig continues to slouch toward cult status. A challenging whisky always worth a try.

Matured for 13 years in a Hogshead, before bottling at 51.3%. Natural colour, non chill-filtered.

glentauchers-2009-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Glentauchers 2009 12 Year Old 54.2% ABV
glentauchers-2009-twa.bodyHtml:
Glentauchers 2009 12 Year Old is a Speyside single malt distilled at Glentauchers in 2009 and bottled in 2021 by the independent bottler The Whisky Agency. It spent 12 years in a sherry butt and was bottled at cask strength of 54.2% ABV, with natural colour and without chill filtration. The watercolour label is one of the bottler's striking designs. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

secret-islay-1990-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Secret Islay 1990 31 Year Old 51.5% ABV
secret-islay-1990-twa.bodyHtml:
This Secret Islay 31 Year Old is a single malt Scotch from an undisclosed Islay distillery, distilled in 1990 and matured in a hogshead before The Whisky Agency bottled it in 2022. Only 252 bottles were released at 51.5% ABV. It opens gently and refined, then grows intensely coastal and medicinal on the palate before a long, salty, citrus finish. 700ml.

Nose: Wet wool, minerals, leather and waxy notes with faded ash, lime, pineapple, bright mint and a whiff of sea breeze.

Palate: Medicinal and saline at first, then grapefruit, passion fruit and guava, olives in brine and bitter almond, ending on herbal tea.

Finish: Long, with citrus, verbena, iodine and lingering coastal salinity.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

ledaig-2011-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Ledaig 10 Year Old 2011 Refill Sherry Butt 53.2% ABV
ledaig-2011-twa.bodyHtml:
Ledaig 10 Year Old 2011 is a single cask bottling of the peated malt from Tobermory Distillery on the Isle of Mull, released by the German independent bottler The Whisky Agency, run by Carsten Ehrlich. Distilled in 2011, it matured in a refill sherry butt and was bottled in 2022 at ten years old, with 361 bottles produced. It is bottled at cask strength, 53.2% ABV, in a 700ml bottle. Ledaig is Tobermory's heavily peated spirit, and the refill sherry wood adds fruit and depth to its smoky style.

Serve: Neat, then with a little water to open up the peat.

bunnahabhain-2010-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Bunnahabhain 2010 11 Year Old 53.8% ABV
bunnahabhain-2010-twa.bodyHtml:
The Whisky Agency Bunnahabhain 2010 11 Year Old 53.8% ABV 700ml

This 11 Year Old Bunnahabhain from The Whisky Agency has been aged in sherry casks and boasts a 53.8% ABV. The 700ml bottle is perfect for whisky connoisseurs looking to enjoy a smooth, robust single malt. Rich aromas of fruit, nuts and spices await, culminating in a warm, mellow finish.

bruichladdich-2010-twa.title: Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10 Year Old
bruichladdich-2010-twa.bodyHtml:
Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10 Year Old is a flagship heavily peated Islay single malt Scotch whisky crafted from 100% Scottish barley and peated to 40 PPM. Matured for 10 years on Islay in a combination of 65% first-fill American whiskey casks, 10% second-fill American whiskey casks, and 25% second-fill French wine casks, this non-chill filtered expression marries intense marine peat smoke with rich sweet vanilla, coconut, and vibrant orchard fruit complexity.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, oysters on the half shell, dark chocolate, blue cheese, or barbecue pork ribs.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber appearance with a rich, oily, and coating texture on the palate.

Nose : Heavy peat smoke balanced with sweet vanilla, caramel, sea salt spray, charred oak, lemon curd, and dried floral notes.

Palate : Smooth and rich with dominant barbecue smoke, sweet malt, coconut, fudge, orange peel, and gentle baking spice.

Finish : Long, warming, and smoky with lingering dried oak, marine salt, sweet barley, and soft fudge.

Serve : Served neat at room temperature or with a few drops of water in a Glencairn glass.

aultmore-2007-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Aultmore 14 Year Old 2007 Fino Sherry Butt 52.7% ABV
aultmore-2007-twa.bodyHtml:
Two casks from the latest batch of Whisky Agency releases. Somehow they ended up in the back of my sample boxes but it’s never too late. The first release is a 14 year old Aultmore matured in a Fino sherry butt, the other a similarly aged Mannochmore.

Nose: very fresh, with lots of green apples, juicy lemons and a hint of greengages. There’s a soft oiliness (sunflower oil), as well as gristy notes and whiffs of wax candles. Also a very subtle note that keeps the middle between floral and coastal. Prefect brightness.

Mouth: a similar mix of gristy and grainy notes with some lemon balm, verbena and unripe, green fruits. Lime (blossom). A very light saline touch again, with a peppery edge too. Very chisseled with a restrained cask influence.

Finish: medium long, becoming zesty and slightly chalky.

royal-salute-21-year-old-1.title: Royal Salute 21 Year Old The Signature Blend
royal-salute-21-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Royal Salute 21 Year Old The Signature Blend is a remarkably prestigious and luxurious blended Scotch whisky, famously created in 1953 as a tribute to Queen Elizabeth II on the day of her coronation. Housed in its iconic porcelain flagon, the "Signature Blend" ensures that every single drop of whisky in the bottle has been aged for a minimum of 21 years. Crafted primarily with malts from the Strathisla distillery in Speyside, it is an exquisitely balanced and sophisticated whisky that delivers an opulent symphony of sweet fruits, delicate floral notes, and a subtle wisp of elegant smoke.

Food Pairing: This deeply complex and regal whisky pairs exquisitely with rich, gamey dishes such as roasted duck or venison. It is also an exceptional companion to fine dark chocolate desserts or a sophisticated cheese board featuring mature cheddar and rich Roquefort.

TASTING NOTES - A deep, rich golden amber. The texture is profoundly smooth, velvety, and luxurious on the palate.

NOSE - A beautifully fragrant and complex bouquet. Notes of sweet pears and citrus fruits are elegantly balanced with the soft fragrance of autumn flowers, vanilla, and dry oak.

PALATE - Decadent, rich, and mouth-coating. The welcome warmth of sweet orange marmalade and fresh pears is followed by a brave explosion of winter spices, hazelnut, and a rich, underlying sherry sweetness.

FINISH - Exceptionally long, dry, and slightly spicy, trailing off with a gentle, lingering touch of soft smoke.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its intricate aromas, or with a few drops of pure water to unlock its rich floral and fruity complexities.

kavalan-solist-oloroso-sherry-cask.title: Kavalan Peatist Oloroso Sherry Cask Single Cask Strength Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-oloroso-sherry-cask.bodyHtml: Distilled from premium peated malt and matured in the finest Oloroso sherry casks from Spain’s Sherry Triangle, this whisky melds rich dried fruit notes with Kavalan’s signature tropical vibrancy, offering a lightly smoky yet profoundly complex flavour and non-chill filtered to preserve its pure, unrestrained character.

buoncristiani-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvi.title: Buoncristiani Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
buoncristiani-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvi.bodyHtml:
95 Points - The Wine Independent

Deep garnet-purple in color, it comes bounding out with exuberant notes of warm cassis, blueberry pie, and chocolate-covered cherries, plus wafts of cinnamon toast. The full-bodied palate is packed with juicy black and blue fruits, supported by velvety tannins and a lively backbone, finishing long and spicy.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
"A quintessential Napa Cabernet, boasting opulent aromas of blackberry liqueur, blueberry, and mocha. Incredibly rich and layered on the palate with a seamless texture and a long, hedonistic finish. A spectacular achievement."

chateau-boutisse.title: Chateau Boutisse Saint-Emilion Grand Cru 2022 750ml
chateau-boutisse.bodyHtml:
These vineyards are planted on the plateau of Saint-Émilion. The limestone in the area allows for wines to be produced with the consistent quality that Château Boutisse is known for. The vines have to work hard to find nutrients and water, creating a lower yield, which is what winemakers are looking for! Saint-Émilion is known for this terroir, which is why such high quality grapes are found in this region.

91 Points - James Suckling

A tight and linear wine with blackberry and black-cherry notes. It’s medium-bodied, fine and racy at the end.

clos-de-tart-2019.title: Mommessin Clos De Tart Grand Cru 2019 750ml

clos-de-tart-la-forge-de-tart-2019.title: Clos de Tart La Forge de Tart 2019 750ml
clos-de-tart-la-forge-de-tart-2019.bodyHtml: Clos de Tart La Forge de Tart 2019 750ml

bodega-colome-autentico-malbec.title: Colome Autentico Malbec 2021
bodega-colome-autentico-malbec.bodyHtml:
Harvested from Bodega Colome's best vineyard located at 2300 metres, Auténtico Malbec is produced in the old winemaking style – ancient techniques such as pigeage (punch down) and no oak influence to retain freshness and purity of fruit.

92 Points - James Suckling

A medium-to full-bodied red with aromas of stewed cherries, cassis, oyster shell and smoked meat. Firm, grainy tannins and a chalky texture with fresh acidity.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This aromatic red offers blackberry and blueberry on the nose. It's full bodied and delivers juicy black-fruit flavors that linger through the long finish.

super-punch-jannamico.title: Jannamico Super Punch Liqueur
super-punch-jannamico.bodyHtml: A liqueur of ancient Abruzzese tradition, produced by the Jannamico family since 1888, and today it continues to entice with its versatility thanks to the citrus notes of the fruit and its heart based on rum. Excellent addition to delicious appetizers and to desserts, it is also extraordinary when served hot.

domaine-fournier-pouilly-fume-caillots.title: Fournier Pere & Fils Pouilly-Fume Les Deux Cailloux 2024
domaine-fournier-pouilly-fume-caillots.bodyHtml:
Fournier Père & Fils Pouilly-Fumé Les Deux Cailloux 2024 is a crisp, terroir-expressive Loire Valley white wine crafted from estate vineyards rooted in the region’s signature flint (silex) and Kimmeridgian limestone marl soils. In the glass, it presents a pale straw hue with luminous green reflections. The bouquet is aromatic and mineral-driven, revealing vibrant notes of citrus blossoms, lemon zest, green apple, and white peach seamlessly intertwined with hints of fresh herbs, gunflint, and crushed wet stone. Vinified with temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats and aged on fine lees, it delivers a focused, medium-bodied palate balanced by crisp natural acidity and a clean, persistent, and saline-etched finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, pan-seared sea scallops, grilled sea bass with herbs, goat cheese crostini, seafood risotto, and delicate white fish.

domaine-carneros-famous-gate-pinot-noir.title: Domaine Carneros Estate Pinot Noir 2022
domaine-carneros-famous-gate-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Domaine Carneros Estate Pinot Noir 2022 is a sophisticated and highly expressive red wine that captures the cool-climate elegance of the Carneros region. Sourced exclusively from the estate's six sustainably farmed vineyards, this wine benefits from the maritime influence of the San Pablo Bay, which provides the fog and cool breezes essential for developing complex aromatics while maintaining fresh acidity. The 2022 vintage was aged for approximately 10 months in small French oak barrels to enhance its structure and mouthfeel.
On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of black cherry, pomegranate, and wild strawberry, accented by delicate floral notes of violet and a hint of sandalwood. The palate is medium-bodied and silky, showcasing layers of juicy red fruit, plum, and savory earthy notes. It features fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that carries the flavours through to a long, graceful finish with a touch of baking spice and toasted oak.

94 Points - James Suckling

Vibrant aromas of strawberries, blueberry bush, citrus peel and cassia bark. The palate is medium-bodied with finely integrated tannins and bright acidity, showing a plush and generous mouthfeel with underlying tension. Very refined and pure, with a soft touch. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ripe, dark red fruits swirled through with baking spices and freshly cracked pine, reveal a mouthwatering, flavorful, and juicy still, Pinot Noir. Silken tannins and an ultra long finish.

bandistas-blanco-tequila.title: Bandistas Blanco Tequila
bandistas-blanco-tequila.bodyHtml:
Bandistas Blanco Tequila is an unaged tequila made from 100% agave and bottled in Mexico by La Cofradia S.A. de C.V. at 40% ABV. Crystal clear in the glass, it is a medium-bodied blanco built around clean agave character: a smooth agave aroma with a gentle cooked-agave note, then blue agave flavour lifted by delicate citrus and a touch of sweetness. The distinctive squat bottle with its bright blue crest label makes it an easy one to spot on the back bar. 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Clean agave, citrus and light sweetness.

Nose: Smooth agave with a soft cooked-agave note.

Palate: Blue agave with delicate citrus and sweet notes.

Serve: Neat, chilled, or in a Margarita or Paloma.

bandistas-reposado-tequila.title: Bandistas Blanco Tequila
bandistas-reposado-tequila.bodyHtml:
Bandistas Blanco Tequila is an unaged tequila made from 100% agave and bottled in Mexico by La Cofradia S.A. de C.V. at 40% ABV. Crystal clear in the glass, it is a medium-bodied blanco built around clean agave character: a smooth agave aroma with a gentle cooked-agave note, then blue agave flavour lifted by delicate citrus and a touch of sweetness. The distinctive squat bottle with its bright blue crest label makes it an easy one to spot on the back bar. 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Clean agave, citrus and light sweetness.

Nose: Smooth agave with a soft cooked-agave note.

Palate: Blue agave with delicate citrus and sweet notes.

Serve: Neat, chilled, or in a Margarita or Paloma.

bandistas-anejo-tequila.title: Rock N Roll Cristalino Anejo Tequila
bandistas-anejo-tequila.bodyHtml:
Rock n Roll Cristalino Anejo Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave harvested in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Barrel-aged for 12 months in oak casks to acquire rich añejo character, it undergoes a filtration process that strips away color while retaining its deep wood-aged complexity. The resulting spirit is crystal-clear with a subtle silver-gold shimmer, seamlessly blending the smooth elegance of an aged tequila with a clean, pristine profile.

Food Pairing: Slow-cooked pork carnitas, chicken mole, grilled steak with chimichurri, ceviche, churros with dulce de leche, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : A rich, silver body with a brilliant touch of gold, delivering a silky, soft, and rounded mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Barrel-aged aromatics of sweet vanilla, caramel, dark chocolate, and toasted coconut, blended with rich cooked agave, fresh mint, cedar, and fruity accents of orange and cherry.

Palate : Smooth and complex with rising notes of ripe fruit and cedar wood, mellowed by rich vanilla, caramel, dark chocolate, and a core of cooked agave.

Finish : Long, clean, and smooth, leaving lingering baseline notes of cooked agave, subtle oak, dark cocoa, and sweet vanilla.

Serve : Best served neat or over a single large ice cube in a spirits snifter or tasting glass to fully appreciate its complex wood-aged aromatics.

bandistas-extra-anejo-tequila.title: Adictivo Extra Añejo Tequila
bandistas-extra-anejo-tequila.bodyHtml:
Adictivo Extra Añejo Tequila is an ultra-aged artisanal tequila crafted in Jalisco, Mexico, by Gildardo Partida at Tequilas González Lara (NOM 1560). Made from 100% pure Blue Weber agave and aged for seven years in French oak barrels, it delivers a deeply rich, full-bodied, and intensely sweet profile with dark amber reddish hues and dessert-like smoothness.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, flan, caramel cheesecake, churros, or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Dark amber with reddish hues, presenting a very thick, oily, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet toasted agave, maple syrup, vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, and dried fruits.

Palate : Silky and complex with honey, butterscotch, toffee, maple, and roasted nuts layered over smooth agave notes.

Finish : Long, rich, and velvety with lingering sweet oak, caramel warmth, and subtle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tequila glass or over a large ice cube.

bui-by-bandistas-mezcal.title: Bandistas Blanco Tequila
bui-by-bandistas-mezcal.bodyHtml:
Bandistas Blanco Tequila is an unaged tequila made from 100% agave and bottled in Mexico by La Cofradia S.A. de C.V. at 40% ABV. Crystal clear in the glass, it is a medium-bodied blanco built around clean agave character: a smooth agave aroma with a gentle cooked-agave note, then blue agave flavour lifted by delicate citrus and a touch of sweetness. The distinctive squat bottle with its bright blue crest label makes it an easy one to spot on the back bar. 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Clean agave, citrus and light sweetness.

Nose: Smooth agave with a soft cooked-agave note.

Palate: Blue agave with delicate citrus and sweet notes.

Serve: Neat, chilled, or in a Margarita or Paloma.

strait-narrow-explorer-pack-yuzu-huckl.title: Strait & Narrow Explorer Pack Yuzu Huckl 6 Cans
strait-narrow-explorer-pack-yuzu-huckl.bodyHtml: Strait & Narrow Explorer Pack Yuzu Huckl 6 Cans

jim-barry-lodge-hill-shiraz.title: Jim Barry The Lodge Hill Shiraz 2021 750ml
jim-barry-lodge-hill-shiraz.bodyHtml: The Jim Barry Lodge Hill Shiraz 2017 is a Clare Valley Shiraz with deep red and bright magenta hues. It offers a vibrant aroma of red and black berry fruits, violet florals, clove spice, and mixed garden herbs. The palate features a lively burst of berry fruits with fine, powdery tannins. It also showcases juicy plum and blackberry flavors, along with sweet spice.

mudshake-pumpkin-spice.title: Mudshake Pumpkin Spice Latte 4x270ml Bottles
mudshake-pumpkin-spice.bodyHtml: Creamy pumpkin spice, cinnamon clove, nutmeg with a touch of coffee combined with triple distilled vodka

med-hat-patio-series-variety-pack.title: Med Hat Patio Series Variety Pack 12 Cans
med-hat-patio-series-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Med Hat Patio Series Variety Pack 12 Cans

on-point-smooth-red.title: Copper Moon Smooth Red 750ml
on-point-smooth-red.bodyHtml:
This wine is an approachable, food friendly red. Notes of red berry and cherry on the nose stay consitent through the taste profile. This is a meduim bodied red, with good acidity to pair with a wide range of foods.

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast
A soft and approachable red blend featuring straightforward notes of ripe berries and a hint of mocha. Easy-drinking with a smooth texture and crowd-pleasing profile that offers reliable everyday value.
86 Points - Tastings.com
Features simple, fruity flavors with minimal tannins and a clean finish. A consistent and uncomplicated choice for casual enjoyment.

pian-delle-vigne-rosso-di-montalcino-1.title: Marchesi Antinori Pian delle Vigne Rosso di Montalcino 2023 750ml
pian-delle-vigne-rosso-di-montalcino-1.bodyHtml:
Pian delle Vigne Rosso di Montalcino DOC is ruby red in color. The nose offers pleasant impressions of strawberries and cherries together with delicate citrusy hints of blood oranges and floral aromas. The complex bouquet is completed by balsamic notes of eucalyptus and hints of tobacco. Pleasant freshness on the palate is accompanied by silky tannins and distinctive sapidity. The long aftertaste echoes notes of red fruit blood oranges perceived on the nose.

92 Points - James Suckling

Vinous and fragrant nose of strawberries and fresh violets with touches of cinnamon, rhubarb and pepper. Light-bodied on the palate, it shows drinkability, silkiness, crisp acidity and a graceful aftertaste.

90 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

A youthful medium red hue, the 2023 Rosso Di Montalcino is expressive and ripe out of the gate, with notes of baked red cherries, leather, and balsamic herbs. Plush and inviting, the palate is ripe with pliant tannins and medium to full-bodied richness. It's delightful now and will drink well over the coming 5-6 years.

innis-gunn-gift-pack-pximenez.title: Innis & Gunn Gift Pack Pximenez 4 Bottles

eau-claire-earl-grey-gin.title: Eau Claire Parlour Cherry Gin
eau-claire-earl-grey-gin.bodyHtml:
This London-dry style gin is infused with sour cherries and over 12 unique botanicals.
The barley-based gin has a hint of natural sweetness, with a tart, pleasant, long silky finish and a unique mouth feel.
Enjoy in a Cherry Gin fizz or aviation!

motts-clamto-pickled-bean.title: Mott'S Clamato Caesar Pickled Bean 458 D

motts-clamato-extra-spicy.title: Mott's Clamato Extra Spicy 945ml
motts-clamato-extra-spicy.bodyHtml: We’ve figured out how to double the spice in your Mott’s Clamato Extra Spicy and still make room for all the other flavours. And you can take it from us, with great spice, comes great responsibility. This Mott’s Clamato goes well with listening to an extra spicy story around brunch, or with living your spiciest life by being a part of that story the night before.

voerzio-barbera-dalba-vigneti-cerreto.title: Roberto Voerzio Barbera d'Alba Vigneti Cerreto
voerzio-barbera-dalba-vigneti-cerreto.bodyHtml:
Rich and expressive, with ripe blackberry, dark cherry, plum, violet, spice, and subtle earthy notes. The palate is concentrated yet vibrant, combining generous fruit with Barbera's lively acidity, smooth texture, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with braised beef, roasted pork, grilled meats, mushroom pasta, hearty risotto, charcuterie, or mature Piedmontese cheeses.

corralejo-reposado.title: Corralejo Triple Distilled Reposado Tequila
corralejo-reposado.bodyHtml:
Corralejo Triple Distilled Reposado is a 100% agave reposado tequila from Tequilera Corralejo in Guanajuato, Mexico, bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) in a 750ml bottle. Its label reads Triple Destilado and carries NOM 1368; the squat, faceted cobalt-blue bottle sets it apart from the tall bottle of the standard Corralejo Reposado. Where the house style is double distilled, this expression goes through a third distillation, and the result is a notably smooth, clean and citrusy reposado. Hacienda Corralejo is one of the few distilleries permitted to make tequila outside Jalisco, and its importer, Infinium Spirits, notes that the estate grows its own agave and makes its own bottles. It is made entirely from blue Weber agave and rested in American oak.

Nose: Fresh agave with light vanilla, honey and soft oak, plus hints of citrus and spice.

Palate: Smooth and balanced, with cooked agave, caramel, vanilla, mild spice and a touch of toasted oak.

Finish: Clean and gently warming, with sweet agave, light oak and subtle pepper.

Serve: Neat, over ice or in tequila cocktails.

josh-legacy-red-blend.title: Josh Cellars Legacy Red Blend 2022
josh-legacy-red-blend.bodyHtml: Josh Cellars Legacy Red Blend is a rich and velvety multi-varietal wine crafted as a tribute to the "legacy" of founder Joseph Carr’s father, Josh. Sourced from premium vineyards across California, this wine is designed to be exceptionally smooth and approachable, offering a "crystalline precision" that balances bold fruit with a soft, round mouthfeel. The blend is characterized by its deep ruby-purple colour and an expressive aromatic profile of ripe plums, black cherries, and blueberries, layered with secondary notes of toasted hazelnuts, milk chocolate, and vanilla from careful oak aging. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied with juicy, "velvety" tannins and a long, fruit-forward finish, making it an ideal choice for casual sipping or pairing with diverse cuisines.

faiveley-pinot-noir-bourgogne.title: Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023
faiveley-pinot-noir-bourgogne.bodyHtml:
Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023 is a classic, expressive, and finely structured French red wine produced by the prestigious Domaine Faiveley. Displaying a beautiful bright ruby-red color, it opens with pleasant and generous aromas of fresh red cherries, ripe raspberries, and redcurrants, accompanied by subtle nuances of violets, wild herbs, and delicate earthy forest floor notes. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, medium-bodied mouthfeel featuring juicy red fruit flavors, a well-defined line of refreshing acidity, and fine, rounded tannins that lead into a smooth, clean, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken, duck breast, pork tenderloin, seared salmon, wild mushroom risotto, charcuterie, and mild semi-firm cheeses.

luxardo-black-sambuca.title: Luxardo Passione Nera Black Sambuca 375ml
luxardo-black-sambuca.bodyHtml: Aromatized with licorice, with a production recipe entailing several levels of successive infusions to blend the different ingredients. The predominant taste is star anise, combined with a new velvety sensation on the palate of lightly spicy hints of cardamom and coriander and an aftertaste dominated by licorice aromas.

ardmore-legacy.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No.76 Ardmore 24 Year Old 1997 Refill Hogshead 52.4% ABV
ardmore-legacy.bodyHtml:
Since the dawn of creation, conscious beings have been asking themselves one thing: why does Ardmore taste like the smelly matter you find in Scottish farmyards...? 

The answer to this question has eluded the greatest scientific minds in the cosmos. Mayans, Vulcans, Time Lords, Vogons and David Attenborough have all tried, and failed, to discover the pungent truth. 

All we can do is play Sponge scrabble and ruminate deeply and profoundly, on the sheer number of silly toilet-centric words you can invent in association with Ardmore and all its bum-scented glory. 

Please enjoy this extremely classical 25 year old Ardmore that has been matured full term in a withered old refill hogshead and bottled at natural cask strength, thus retaining its maximum dung-addled distillate potency.

Headily yours

Whisky Sponge 

PS: you may also be interested to compare this bottling with Whisky Sponge Edition No.69, which is also a highly delicious old Ardmore, except that one is drenched in sticky, dark, gooey old sherry. Why not buy both of them and guzzle both bottles simultaneously at a festive dinner party? Enjoy the looks upon your friends and family's faces as you cackle, splutter and gurgle your way through the bottles. Thrill to their gasping intakes of breath as the viscous nectars drizzle and blend their way in rivulets down your chin and pool upon the platters of partially consumed pigs in blankets... Just an idea.

jackson-estate-hawkeye-mountain-cabernet.title: Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
jackson-estate-hawkeye-mountain-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, expressive, and elegantly structured red wine that beautifully captures the distinct character of Sonoma County's rugged, rocky terroir. Sourced from the historic estate vineyards that Beringer pioneered in the mid-1960s, this vintage is crafted in the style of a classic Bordeaux blend, offering both immediate approachability and excellent cellaring potential. In the glass, it presents a deep crimson-ruby color. The aromatic profile opens with a perfumed and complex bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, boysenberries, and dark plum, beautifully lifted by traditional Knights Valley nuances of wild sage, fresh thyme, and lavender, along with hints of dark chocolate, mocha, and toasty cedar oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, balanced, and remarkably plush. It delivers a savory, fruit-forward core of raspberry coulis, black cherry, and red licorice, framed by fine-grained, chewy tannins and a vibrant acidity that carries through to a long, smooth, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, rosemary-roasted prime rib, venison stew, wild mushroom risotto, and mature, sharp cheddar cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

Perfumed aromas of red currants, lavender, fresh thyme and graphite. The palate is medium-bodied with plush tannins and balanced acidity, giving flavors of raspberry coulis, red licorice and baking spices. Very soft and delicate, with a nicely constructed backbone.

vega-sicilia-unico-reserva-especial-edic.title: Vega Sicilia Unico Reserva Especial 750ml
vega-sicilia-unico-reserva-especial-edic.bodyHtml:
This is a non-vintage Vega Sicilia and a tribute to tradition. Unico Reserva Especial is a true homage to the history of Spanish wine, perfectly combining the characteristics of different Unico vintages. Only the best Unico vintages are used to produce this iconic and remarkably complex wine. It is a blend of time, virtues, experiences, and emotions that shape the most profound nature of a proprietary, unique style: the Vega Sicilia style. Unico Reserva Especial 2022 is a blend of the 2008, 2010, and 2011 vintages.

Blend: 95% Tinto Fino, 5% Cabernet-Sauvignon

100 Points Tim Atkin
Vega's Reserva Especial is surely the only world-class unfortified red that's a blend of vintages - 2008, 2010 and 2011 in this instance. Made from Tinto Fino and 5% Cabernet Sauvignon, it’s the result of long and harmonious slumber in large wooden foudres after previous ageing in smaller barrels. Structured, complex and elegant, with hints of tobacco leaf and balsam, a sprinkling of sweet baking spices, focused acidity and palate-caressing tannins. Perfection.

99 Points James Suckling
Extremely nuanced and complex nose that shows high-grade cigar box and cigars, fresh blackberries, orange peel, together with red-chili chocolate, walnut, iron and hints of cocoa powder. This is intense, elegant and savory with real finesse, savoriness and complexity. Juicy, dusty and immaculate tannins and an extremely long, savory finish that lasts over a minute. Mainly a blend of 2009 and 2011 and 2012. Surprisingly, this is already approachable now, but better after 2024.

98 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The NV Único Reserva Especial 2022 Release is a blend of wines from 2008, 2010 and 2011, mostly Tinto Fino with some Cabernet Sauvignon mixing lots from the Único wines from those years. In the past, the blend was older vintages, but now it's wines that are around the same age as the Único. It has the complexity of mixing terroirs, vintages and grapes with parameters very similar to Único, 14.5% alcohol and good balance with a pH of 3.83 and 5.4 grams of acidity (measured in tartaric acid per liter). In the blend, they look for keeping the style of past blends, combining the more aged notes of the older wines and the freshness of the younger ones. I was very pleasantly surprised by the performance of this Reserva Especial, which seems to be going back to the character of the blends from yesteryear, with more finesse, elegance and nuance. This is perfumed, elegant, harmonious and balanced. It has very fine, already polished tannins and integrated acidity. 2008 and 2010 are cooler years, and they seem to give the blend this freshness and elegance. It has all the components, and especially the balance between all of them, to age nicely in bottle.

97 Points Wine & Spirits

This is a blend of 2008, 2010 and 2011 and though Iturriaga did not make those vintages, he was the point person on a blending team of five, determining what wines would combine in the most long-lived synergy. The wine centers around a plump texture, racy flavors of fig and bloodorange, and fruit tannins edging from purple to black. Compelling now, it’s built for the ages.

96 Points Wine Spectator
Delivers a gorgeous nose of tobacco, tar, leather and cured meat as a savory skein, which winds through the palate's notes of mulled black cherry, black plum reduction, wild sage and dried flowers. Medium- to full-bodied and plush in texture, this wine is both rich and expressive yet graceful and finely tailored. Tinto Fino with Cabernet Sauvignon. This edition blends the 2008, 2010 and 2011 vintages. Drink now through 2035.

artingstalls-london-dry-gin.title: Artingstall's Brilliant London Dry Gin 375ml
artingstalls-london-dry-gin.bodyHtml:
Artingstall's London Dry Gin is an award-winning, brilliant London Dry Gin created by Hollywood director Paul Feig in collaboration with the Minhas Micro Distillery. Formulated after a worldwide search for the perfect martini gin, it is crafted with a meticulously balanced blend of eleven botanicals, including juniper, orris root, cassia, elderberries, and bright citrus. This highly refined and structured spirit offers exceptional clarity and precision, delivering a crisp, clean palate with subtle spices and an elegant, delicate finish. It shines beautifully in classic cocktails like Martinis and refreshing Gin & Tonics.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, fresh oysters, cucumber tea sandwiches, light seafood dishes, and soft goat cheeses.

bodacious-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Bodacious Cabernet Sauvignon 4L Bag In Box
bodacious-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Bodacious wines are gaining a following for their bold, yet smooth character. Bright ruby red in the glass with aromas of sweet red berry fruit and vanilla. Lively flavours of strawberry, cranberry, and vanilla on the palate. Medium-bodied and fruity with a soft, silky finish, this is great for peppercorn steak.

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A smooth and approachable Cabernet with soft dark fruit flavors and easy-drinking tannins. Reliable and great value for everyday enjoyment."

uko-estate-chardonnay.title: Uko Estate Chardonnay
uko-estate-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Uko Estate Chardonnay is a bright, refreshing, and beautifully balanced Argentine white wine that captures the high-altitude purity of the Uco Valley terroir. Pours a brilliant pale yellow color with subtle green shades and golden hints, it displays a complex, intense bouquet highlighting tropical fruits like pineapple and banana alongside delicate floral notes. On the palate, this unoaked selection is exceptionally fresh, soft, and easy-drinking, pairing its juicy fruit concentration with a silky, well-balanced acidity that leads into a clean, smooth, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: This crisp white wine pairs excellently with roasted chicken, pan-seared trout, grilled white fish, garlic shrimp, seafood pasta, summer salads, or mild soft cheeses.

aperol-spritz-kit.title: Aperol Spritz Kit (2 x 375ml)
aperol-spritz-kit.bodyHtml:
The Aperol Spritz Kit pairs a 375ml bottle of Aperol with a 375ml bottle of Cinzano Sparkling D.O.C., the two key ingredients for an Aperol Spritz. Aperol is an Italian aperitif with a distinctive orange colour, made with bitter orange, gentian, rhubarb and cinchona among other aromatics. The spritz, also called Spritz Veneziano, originated in northeastern Italy and is traditionally served in a white wine glass with an orange slice. The kit is 11% alcohol by volume and 750ml in total, a handy size for trying the cocktail at home or giving as a gift.

Serve: Fill a large wine glass with ice, pour 3 parts prosecco and 2 parts Aperol, top with 1 part soda water and garnish with a slice of orange.

jim-beam-peach.title: Jim Beam Peach Flavored Bourbon
jim-beam-peach.bodyHtml:
A perfect blend of sweet Southern flavor and classic Kentucky Straight Bourbon. Jim Beam Peach masterfully infuses real peach liqueur with their signature oak-aged bourbon. Bottled at an easy-drinking 65 proof, it strikes a beautiful balance between the juicy, fresh sweetness of ripe peaches and the warm, woody undertones of traditional whiskey. It is perfect for summertime highballs, mixed with iced tea, or simply poured over ice.

 

NOSE

Bright and inviting aromas of fresh, juicy peaches with a subtle hint of bourbon vanilla.

PALATE

Sweet and fruit-forward, delivering the lush flavor of sun-drenched peaches beautifully balanced by light caramel and woody bourbon notes.

FINISH

Smooth, sweet, and lingering, with a pleasant fruity warmth.

lugnaquilla-peated-irish-whiskey.title: Connemara Peated Single Malt Irish Whiskey
lugnaquilla-peated-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Connemara Peated Single Malt Irish Whiskey is a distinctive peated single malt produced at Cooley Distillery in Ireland. Inspired by the historic practice of drying malted barley over peat fires, it combines the smooth, sweet character associated with Irish whiskey with an expressive layer of clean peat smoke. Bottled at 40% ABV, it balances sweet barley, honey, baked apple, vanilla oak, gentle spice, and earthy peat for a smoky yet approachable style.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, grilled lamb, roast pork, smoked cheddar, roasted almonds, baked apples, dark chocolate, and vanilla bread pudding.

Tasting Notes: Smooth and lightly sweet with malted barley, honey, baked apple, vanilla oak, gentle spice, and clean peat smoke.

Nose: Sweet barley with wafts of peat smoke, baked apple, honeyed sweetness, and subtle smoky character.

Palate: Lightly honeyed with sweet barley, clean peat smoke, vegetal peat notes, gentle spice, and vanilla oak.

Finish: Lingering smoke with warming oak, gentle spice, sweet almond, and persistent peat.

The core tasting profile is taken from Connemara's official notes.

woodford-reserve-wheat.title: Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Wheat Whiskey
woodford-reserve-wheat.bodyHtml:
A beautifully soft, fruit-forward offering that completes Woodford Reserve's core grain portfolio. Utilizing an incredibly unique mash bill of 52% wheat, 20% malted barley, 20% corn, and 8% rye, it highlights the floral and delicate flavors of wheat while still maintaining a robust character. Aged in newly charred oak and bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), it delivers an exceptionally creamy, mellow, and approachable sipping experience that is bursting with bright apple, soft vanilla, and sweet floral notes.

 

NOSE

Light, sweet, and highly floral. Inviting aromas of fresh apple pie, warm honey, cedar wood, and bright citrus.

PALATE

Incredibly smooth, creamy, and fruit-forward. Lush flavors of baked pear, sweet vanilla custard, and toasted coconut are balanced by subtle oak tannins.

FINISH

Clean, smooth, and refreshing with a gentle, sweet vanilla warmth.

kill-devil-rum-jamaica-hampden-pot-still.title: Hamilton Jamaican Pot Still Gold Rum
kill-devil-rum-jamaica-hampden-pot-still.bodyHtml:
Hamilton Jamaican Pot Still Gold Rum is a Jamaican rum from the Hamilton range, bottled under Ed Hamilton's Ministry of Rum Collection. As the label states, it is distilled by Worthy Park Estate in Jamaica, and it is a pot still rum. The spirit is unaged. It is bottled at 46.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The style is characterful rather than neutral: expect butter, fresh grass and funky notes alongside cream, florals, leather and coconut.

Tasting Notes: Butter, grass and Jamaican pot still funk with hints of cream, flowers, leather and coconut.

Serve: In classic rum cocktails or neat for those who enjoy pot still character.

burwood-grapefruit-lemongrass.title: Burwood Distillery Grapefruit & Lemongrass Gin
burwood-grapefruit-lemongrass.bodyHtml:
Burwood Grapefruit & Lemongrass Gin belongs to the Garden Party series of small-batch seasonal gins from Burwood Distillery in Calgary, Alberta. Tangy grapefruit and lemongrass are layered over a juniper base, and the gin carries a light pink tint that makes it a natural starting point for summer drinks. Burwood suggests topping it with prosecco or cava for a twist on the French 75, and it also works simply with tonic over ice. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750 mL bottle.

Tasting Notes: Tangy grapefruit and citrus with lemongrass over a juniper backbone.

Serve: With tonic over ice, or topped with sparkling wine as a French 75.

camigliano-brunello-di-montalcino-gualto.title: Valdicava Brunello di Montalcino 2021
camigliano-brunello-di-montalcino-gualto.bodyHtml:
Valdicava Brunello di Montalcino 2015 is an extraordinarily deep, expressive, and dark Tuscan red that perfectly captures one of Montalcino's most legendary vintages. It greets the nose with beautiful, complex aromas of fresh roses, sliced black plums, and black cherries, seamlessly layered with damp soil, wild truffles, and cured tobacco. On the palate, this full-bodied Sangiovese is powerful yet remarkably refined, displaying a dense core of dark fruits, cacao, and balsam spice, all framed by incredibly polished, tightly integrated tannins and a vibrant line of acidity that extends into a long, majestic finish.

Food Pairing: This structured red is best paired with hearty Tuscan wild boar ragù, slow-cooked beef brisket, or well-matured hard cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

99 Points - James Suckling

Wonderful aromas of roses and sliced plums with wet earth and truffles. Then turns to raspberries and blackberries. Cherries, too. Full and firm with super integrated tannins that melt into the wine. It flows from the center palate in a beautiful sheet of fruit and tannins. Extremely long and coated with great finesse. Goes on for minutes. Better in 2022, but already a joy to taste.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Valdicava 2015 Brunello di Montalcino is a dark and sultry wine with a beautiful presentation of aromas. This full-bodied Sangiovese opens to aromas of plumy dark fruit, black cherry, cured tobacco, cola and balsam spice. There are earthy or savory tones as well, with some fragrant crushed flower or wild rose that come straight out of the classic Sangiovese playlist. Generally speaking, this Brunello veers toward black fruit aromas (as opposed to red fruits), and its smooth texture and elegant tannins are well suited to a classic Tuscan dish of pappardelle con sugo di lepre (wild rabbit) or another game sauce. Production is 37,000 bottles.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe cherry, plum, raspberry, earth and almond flavors combine in this supple red. Vivid and well-defined by the sleek structure, ending with earth, wild herb and mineral accents. Very pure, verging on racy. Best from 2023 through 2045. 3,000 cases made, 1,000 cases imported.

nelson-brewing-organic-hooligan-pilsner.title: Nelson Brewing Silver King Czech Pilsner

trapiche-broquel-malbec-1.title: Trapiche Broquel Malbec 2017/2019 750ml
trapiche-broquel-malbec-1.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "This malbec from Trapiche comes off 25 year old vineyards between 900-1000m, and aged 1 year in oak. The final blend is a barrel selection. Dark cocoa dusts blackberry, blueberry compote, with sueded tannins and a clipped, pasty finish. One for taking with grilled burgers now. (Treve Ring)." - 87/100, Gismondi on Wine

grizzly-paw-larch-valley-porter.title: Grizzly Paw Larch Valley Porter 4 Tall Cans
grizzly-paw-larch-valley-porter.bodyHtml: Grizzly Paw Larch Valley Porter 4 Tall Cans

waterkloof-circumstance-mourvedre.title: Waterkloof Circumstance Mourvedre 2017 750ml
waterkloof-circumstance-mourvedre.bodyHtml: The Waterkloof Circumstance Mourvèdre 2017 is a single-varietal red wine from the Stellenbosch region of South Africa, produced using organic and biodynamic farming methods. It's described as a dense and savory wine with notes of violets, spice, and herbs. The wine is made from Mourvedre grapes grown in a windswept, south-facing block, which contributes to its low yields and balanced flavors.

bottega-pesca-grappa.title: Bottega Pesca & Grappa Peach Liqueur
bottega-pesca-grappa.bodyHtml:
Bottega Pesca & Grappa, sold in the Succo Natura range, is a peach liqueur from Bottega, the wine, grappa and liqueur house of the Veneto in north-east Italy. Natural juice from peaches is blended with grappa, alcohol and sugar, and the natural extraction method keeps the fruit character fresh and recognisable. This version is bottled at 16% ABV in a 700 ml bottle. Light and sweet, it suits an aperitivo moment, a dessert course or a simple spritz.

Serve: Well chilled or over ice, or topped up with sparkling wine.

analog-tavern-amber-ale.title: Analog Tavern Amber Ale 4 Tall Cans

bask-sauvignon-blanc-spritzer.title: Bask Sauvignon Blanc 3L Bag in Box

bask-rose-spritzer.title: Bask Rose 3L Bag in Box
bask-rose-spritzer.bodyHtml:
This rosé is very dry, low in sugar, and soft and round in texture. Enjoy flavours of red pear, watermelon, caramel and honey with a hint of spice. The perfect match for year-round casual entertaining; superb with salads, grilled fish or chicken with herbs.

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A refreshing and dry rosé with crisp strawberry and citrus notes. Perfectly balanced and ideal for casual sipping, offering great value in a convenient format."

bladnoch-samsara-single-malt.title: Bladnoch Samsara Single Malt
bladnoch-samsara-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Gold Medal  Scotch Whisky Masters Awards

Gold Medal  San Francisco Spirits Competition

The first of three new releases from Bladnoch in early 2017 to celebrate the reopening of this Lowland distillery. Although it doesn't carry an age statement, it's said to be made up of whiskies that are a minimum or 8 years old and well as older, rarer whiskies. First fill Californian red wine and bourbon casks were used for maturation, whilst Samsara appropriately enough means rebirth.

baileys-smores.title: Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur 1.14L
baileys-smores.bodyHtml:
Baileys The Original Irish Cream Liqueur is a luxurious, velvety classic that blends fine Irish whiskey and spirits with rich, luscious dairy cream and hints of cocoa and vanilla. First introduced in 1974, it is the world’s most celebrated cream liqueur, offering a beautifully balanced, indulgent, and decadent drinking experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with dark chocolate desserts, molten lava cakes, tiramisu, and fresh berries. It also makes a wonderful accompaniment to warm apple pie, pecan tarts, or simply drizzled over premium vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Opaque, creamy light brown with a rich, velvety, and thick mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet cream, dark chocolate, vanilla, and a subtle hint of warming Irish whiskey.

Palate : Smooth and indulgent with rich flavors of fresh dairy cream, milk chocolate, cocoa, sweet vanilla, and mild whiskey warmth.

Finish : Sweet, long, and coat-the-tongue smooth with lingering chocolate, cream, and soft whiskey notes.

Serve : Serve chilled, poured over ice, or as a rich addition to hot coffee, hot chocolate, or desserts.

reifel-rye.title: Reifel Rye
reifel-rye.bodyHtml: Reifel Rye has been created in honour of George H. Reifel. The legendary master distiller who laid the foundations of Alberta Distillers 75 years ago, and whose standards, commitment to the craft, belief in local ingredients, obsession with extraordinary flavour, and adventurous spirit still characterize ADL’s distilling culture today. Reifel Rye – a “high rye” – is a masterpiece George would be proud of. This high-rye spirit is aged in charred white oak and ex-bourbon barrels. It is a feast of a whisky – with notes of toffee, banana bread, chocolate, poached pear and crème brûlée. An unconventional whisky with unexpected depths. Reifel Rye – High Rye. Deep Character.

assorted-6pk.title: Field House Hazy Six Mix Pack

culmina-dilemma-chardonnay.title: Conundrum Red Blend 2023
culmina-dilemma-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Conundrum Red Blend 2023 is a bold, highly approachable, and delightfully unconventional California red wine crafted by Charlie Wagner II of the acclaimed Wagner Family of Wine (makers of Caymus). Sourced from premier vineyard sites across the state, this proprietary blend features dark red varietals, predominantly Zinfandel, Petite Sirah, and Cabernet Sauvignon. In the glass, it pours a deep, inky ruby color. The inviting aromatic bouquet bursts with generous notes of ripe blackberries, sweet plums, and warm baking chocolate, gracefully layered with a wisp of gentle smokiness. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, plush, and distinctly fruit-forward, delivering a luscious core of chocolate-covered cherries, crème de cassis, and dried fruit. This rich profile is supported by soft, velvety tannins, culminating in a smooth, slightly sweet, and highly versatile finish. The winemaker playfully suggests serving it slightly chilled to further enhance the vibrant fruit character.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with smoky barbecued ribs, hearty lamb burgers, spicy Mexican fajitas, robust Asian cuisine, and savory grilled meats.

fortaleza-anejo-tequila.title: Don Julio Ultima Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
fortaleza-anejo-tequila.bodyHtml: In 2006, Don Julio, with his family, planted their final agave field. In honor of his devotion and craftsmanship, this agave harvest was carefully distilled, barreled, and set aside for a special use. To preserve this tequila and the exquisite agave piñas behind it, we have implemented a Solera aging system. The Solera aging method combines and matures tequilas of different characteristics finished in unique casks, allowing the final agave harvest to remain at the heart of this rare Extra Añejo Tequila. Our Ultima Reserva has been rested in oak, previously used to age bourbon, and finished in Madeira wine-seasoned casks. Salud, to creating only the exceptional.

b-l-e-s-s-hard-seltzer-lemon-lime.title: Honey Pup Hard Seltzer Lemon Lime Cls
b-l-e-s-s-hard-seltzer-lemon-lime.bodyHtml: Honey Pup Hard Seltzer Lemon Lime Cls

old-monk-gold-reserve-12-year-old-rum.title: Old Monk XXX Very Old Vatted 7 Year Old Blended Rum
old-monk-gold-reserve-12-year-old-rum.bodyHtml:
Old Monk XXX Very Old Vatted 7 Year Old Blended Rum is the well-known Indian dark rum from Mohan Meakin, produced at Ghaziabad in Uttar Pradesh. It is distilled from sugarcane molasses, then vatted and matured for a minimum of seven years in oak barrels before being bottled at 42.8% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Mohan Meakin is one of India's oldest brewing and distilling companies and has traditionally not advertised Old Monk, so the rum's following has been built by word of mouth. Expect a sweet, rounded style centred on caramel, chocolate and vanilla with a peppery, lightly smoky edge.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, or grilled lamb with warm spices.

Nose: Warm caramel and milk chocolate with vanilla, subtle oak, toffee and a faint smokiness.

Palate: Smooth, sweet and creamy, with caramel and dark chocolate, building peppery spice and dark dried fruit.

Finish: Medium in length, with molasses, leather, cigar box, pepper, vanilla and oak.

Serve: Neat, over a single ice cube, or with cola or ginger beer.

hells-basement-all-hops-for-a-basement.title: Hell's Basement All Hops For A Basement 6 Cans
hells-basement-all-hops-for-a-basement.bodyHtml: Hell's Basement All Hops For A Basement 6 Cans

hells-basement-deep-roots-red-ale.title: Hell's Basement Deep Roots Red Ale 6 Cans
hells-basement-deep-roots-red-ale.bodyHtml: Hell's Basement Deep Roots Red Ale 6 Cans

whistler-forager-gluten-free-lager.title: Whistler Forager Gluten Free Lager 6 Cans

tomatin-2001-10th-anniversary.title: Sansibar 10th Anniversary Tomatin 19 Year Old 2001 #34870
tomatin-2001-10th-anniversary.bodyHtml:
Sansibar 10th Anniversary Tomatin 19 Year Old 2001 #34870 is a limited-edition Highland single malt Scotch whisky bottled to celebrate the tenth anniversary of independent bottler Sansibar Whisky. Distilled at Tomatin on November 30, 2001, and bottled on May 17, 2021, this exceptional single cask spent over 19 years maturing in a Pedro Ximénez sherry butt. Bottled at natural cask strength of 56% ABV, it delivers concentrated dark chocolate, rich dried fruits, roasted nuts, and warming spices. Limited to 670 bottles, this collectible release showcases the depth and complexity of long-matured Highland whisky.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate brownies, roasted almonds, fruitcake, aged cheddar, caramel desserts, dried figs, and espresso-based desserts.

Tasting Notes: A rich, heavily sherried Highland single malt featuring dark chocolate, dried fruits, roasted nuts, coffee, and warming oak spice.

Nose: Dark chocolate, coffee, fudge, toasted almonds, maple syrup, cloves, and plum jam.

Palate: Rich cocoa, cappuccino, forest honey, ripe red fruits, raisins, roasted nuts, and sweet sherry.

Finish: Long and warming, with lingering chocolate, honey, roasted coffee, orange zest, and gentle spice.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass. Allow several minutes to breathe, adding a few drops of water to explore its concentrated sherry character.

squish-hard-seltzer-variety-pack.title: Vizzy Exotic Twist Max Variety Pack 12 Cans
