squish-hard-seltzer-variety-pack.bodyHtml:
Vizzy Exotic Twist Max Variety Pack 12 Cans 7% is a high-ABV hard seltzer variety pack produced by Molson Coors under the Vizzy brand. Formulated at a bold 7% ABV, this 12-can variety pack features four vibrant dual-fruit flavour combinations: Papaya Pineapple, Dragonfruit Mango, Blueberry White Peach, and Passionfruit Kiwi. Each style delivers a higher-proof wave of tropical refreshment with active effervescence, balancing sweet and sour fruit notes.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp tacos, spicy Thai noodles, citrus-marinated chicken, fresh fruit platters, or summer salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear appearance with bright effervescence and a crisp, light, yet full-flavoured mouthfeel across the assortment.

Nose : Tropical aromas featuring sweet papaya, juicy pineapple, exotic dragonfruit, ripe mango, fragrant blueberry, white peach, tart passionfruit, and kiwi.

Palate : Crisp and lively with a balance of sweet and sour fruit notes, showcasing bold dual-fruit flavours of tropical papaya-pineapple, dragonfruit-mango, sweet blueberry-peach, and zesty passionfruit-kiwi.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering sweet tropical fruit notes and a bubbly carbonated finish.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled straight from a cold tall can or poured over fresh ice in a glass.

ballantines-finest-1.title: Ballantine's Finest 1.75L
ballantines-finest-1.bodyHtml: Ballantine's Finest Blended Malt Scotch Whisky is the oldest recipe created by the Ballantine family, in 1910. It's a brilliant golden colour, the nose is fragrant with barley grain and light peat aromas while the palate is soft, round and slightly sweet with dried fruit and grain flavours. Enjoy neat or on the rocks.

meta-wavelength-west-coast-ipa.title: Metas Wavelength West Coast Ipa Cls

domaine-bulliat-morgon-nature.title: Vignobles Bulliat Morgon Nature 2020/2022 750ml
domaine-bulliat-morgon-nature.bodyHtml: Vignobles Bulliat Morgon Nature 2020 is a Beaujolais red wine from the Morgon appellation, made from 100% Gamay grapes. It's an organic wine, naturally fermented, and bottled without added sulfur. This wine is known for its vibrant red-cherry flavors and a tannic structure, giving it aging potential. The Bulliat family farms 28 hectares scattered across Beaujolais, slowly transitioning to organic agriculture.

danzante-pinot-grigio.title: Danzante Pinot Grigio 750ml
danzante-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2012 vintage) "Fresh, floral, grassy, nectarine skin aromas with light lees and green apple bits. The attack is dry with grapefruit, pear, quince and spice flavours. A spare style best with food. Try this with your favourite vegetarian pasta dish. (Anthony Gismondi and Stuart Tobe)." - 86/100, Gismondi on Wine

pewsey-vale-the-contours-riesling.title: Hill-Smith Family Estates Pewsey Vale The Contours Riesling 2015 750ml

laurent-perrier-grand-siecle-2.title: Laurent Perrier Grand Siecle No. 27
laurent-perrier-grand-siecle-2.bodyHtml:
A fresh and vibrant attack on the palate confirms the aromatic impressions, with flavors of ripe fruit, dried apricot, candied citrus, and hazelnut. The palate is long and harmonious, with refined minerality and a wine full of smooth nuances and vitality.

99 Points - James Suckling

Impressively aromatic, showing honeysuckle, violets and lavender with bread dough and just a hint of light caramel as well as dried apples, cooked pears and tarte tatin. Reductive with graphite, stone and iodine. Some chalk too. Full-bodied but not at all heavy, turning almost weightless. Nine years on the lees and 7 g/L dosage give energy, length and form. Goes on for minutes. This will age beautifully but is already fascinating, evolving in the glass. Available in the US market in November. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Disgorged in January 2025 with a dosage of seven grams per liter, the forthcoming NV Grand Siècle N°27 already demonstrates considerable promise. A blend of the 2015, 2013 and 2012 vintages—predominantly anchored in the youngest—it draws from eight villages, comprising 60% Chardonnay and 40% Pinot Noir, with an intentional emphasis on Chardonnay to counterbalance the concentration of Pinot Noir. The 2015 imparts expressiveness, echoing the 2012, while the cool, late-ripening 2013 contributes freshness and cut. Unfurling in the glass with aromas of pear, peach, lemon confit and freshly baked bread, framed by a subtle smoky reduction, it is full-bodied and concentrated, built around a generous and charming core of fruit, underpinned by tangy acidity driving toward a long, resonant finish. Slightly fleshier and broader shouldered than the Grand Siècle N°24 tasted alongside, it indicates yet another distinguished Grand Siècle in the making.




95 Points Decanter
The newest release of Grand Siècle is based upon the superb and structured 2008 vintage (65% of the blend), along with the vivacious 2007 vintage (25%), and the creamy, luxurious 2006 (10%). The final blend is 60% Chardonnay from the Côte des Blancs and 40% Pinot Noir from the Montagne de Reims. The result at this stage exhibits its Chardonnay character, with toasty notes of ripe pear and spice on the nose and a creamy, silky texture and an edge of citrus. Although elegant and refined at present, the underlying power will doubtless come to the fore with time. Dosage: 7g/L.

95 Points Wine Spectator
Reveals rich and concentrated flavors of pear tart and dried mango, roasted hazelnut and ground coffee, preserved lemon and candied ginger enlivened by a spine of racy acidity and an underlying streak of minerally smoke and brine. Offers a fine and creamy mousse, with pleasing viscosity to the overall impression. Long, spiced finish.

old-forester-bourbon.title: Old Forester 86 Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon 50ml
old-forester-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Created in 1870 by George Garvin Brown, Old Forester holds the prestigious title of being the first commercially bottled bourbon, and the only one continuously distilled and marketed by the founding family before, during, and after Prohibition. Bottled at a classic 86 proof, it delivers a genuinely rich, full, and exceptionally balanced flavor profile. It is a true Kentucky staple that provides a beautiful harmony of sweet fruit, warm oak, and gentle spice, making it a highly versatile everyday pour.

 

NOSE

Sharp and sweet, featuring a strong floral character that swirls with hints of fresh mint, rich tobacco leaf, and vanilla.

PALATE

A touch of oak and pine provides a strong underpinning. It opens with a bright, spicy snap that softens quickly into sweet corn, warm vanilla, and light orange notes.

FINISH

Long, warm, and slightly drying with a perfectly balanced, lingering sweetness.

jack-daniels-single-barrel-1.title: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Select Tennessee Whiskey
jack-daniels-single-barrel-1.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Select is a Tennessee whiskey from the Jack Daniel Distillery in Lynchburg, Tennessee, established in 1866. Every bottle comes from one individual barrel, chosen for its character from the upper levels of the maturation warehouses, where greater temperature swings drive the whiskey deeper into the toasted oak. Like all Jack Daniel's, the spirit is mellowed through sugar maple charcoal before ageing in American white oak barrels. Bottled at 94 proof (47% ABV) in a 750ml bottle, it offers a more concentrated oak, caramel and spice profile than Old No. 7, lifted by bright fruit and sweet aromatics, and each barrel brings its own variation.

Tasting Notes: Caramel and spice with bright fruit.

Nose: Sweet fruit and vanilla with a touch of spice underneath.

Palate: Spice with warm, rich caramel.

Finish: Medium oak, clove and banana.

Serve: Neat, or in an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

faustino-gran-reserva.title: Faustino I Gran Reserva
faustino-gran-reserva.bodyHtml:
Faustino I Gran Reserva displays a clean, brilliant ruby-red color developing toward elegant maroon and brick reflections in the glass. The nose is remarkably complex and expressive, unfolding with intense aromas of ripe forest berries, stewed plums, and dried cherries, beautifully layered with traditional nuances of vanilla, cedarwood, sweet tobacco, and sweet baking spices like cinnamon and cloves. On the palate, this iconic Rioja blend showcases a medium body with a beautifully rounded, velvety mouthfeel. Soft, fully integrated tannins and a vibrant backbone of fresh acidity carry savory layers of dried red fruit, licorice, and mahogany into a very long, silky, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with rosemary-roasted lamb loin, grilled prime ribeye steaks, savory duck breast, rich wild mushroom risotto, or medium-aged cheeses like Emmental and Gruyère.

skyy-vodka-4.title: Skyy Vodka 1.14L
skyy-vodka-4.bodyHtml:
Enjoy smoother cocktails with SKYY Vodka. Made with water enriched by Pacific Minerals, sourced from the San Francisco Bay Area and filtered through California Limestone, SKYY Vodka offers a taste as smooth as the tide rolling out to sea. This premium spirit goes through the process of quadruple distillation and triple filtration for a vodka of proven, exceptional quality and softness. Its clean, crisp taste can be enjoyed on the rocks or in your favorite drinks.

SKYY Vodka & Soda:1.5 oz SKYY Vodka 4.5 oz soda water Cubed ice Garnish: Grapefruit peel Glass: Highball glass

bladnoch-19-year-old.title: Bladnoch 19 Year Old
bladnoch-19-year-old.bodyHtml:
The 19 Year Old is the first PX Sherry expression that Bladnoch has released.
The flavorful casks have imparted delectable notes of dark liquorice sticks, dried apricots and warming nutmeg into the golden-hued whisky.
World Whisky Award 2022 - Category Winner Single Malt 13 to 20yo

TASTING NOTES - Liquorice, dried apricots, aged oak
COLOURS - Dark sunset
NOSE - Dark liquorice sticks and aged oak with a floral background.
PALATE - Liquorice sticks with dried apricots, almonds and nutmeg.
FINISH - Long with a dry sweetness.

bladnoch-vinaya.title: Bladnoch Vinaya
bladnoch-vinaya.bodyHtml: Made with the finest local ingredients, Bladnoch Vinaya has been matured in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks to create a sweet, refreshing character with aromas of summer flowers, grass and boiled sweets on the nose. The palate offers notes of fresh green apples, milk chocolate and white pepper that linger in the finish.

bladnoch-14-year-old.title: Bladnoch 14 Year Old
bladnoch-14-year-old.bodyHtml:
From the world's oldest privately owned Scotch Whisky Distillery comes a Single Malt reimagined. Bladnoch Distillery is their over 200 year old home where they craft the finest Lowland Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

The Bladnoch 14 Year Old is aged exclusively in Oloroso Sherry casks. Bladnoch’s Master Distiller, Dr Nick Savage hand selects every cask to bring together this rich expression showing notes of fruit cake, dark chocolate, and subtle sweet cinnamon on the palate. 

Rich and long with a slight dryness.

bladnoch-11-year-old.title: Bladnoch 11 Year Old
bladnoch-11-year-old.bodyHtml:
The limited first release of Bladnoch 11 Year Old Single Malt was matured in a combination of ex-Californian red wine and ex-Bourbon casks for vibrant, refreshing notes of apples, cherries and vanilla.

Aromas: Delicate floral with notes of honey, refreshing citrus and cut grass
Palate: Floral Parma Violets with fresh cut apples and hints of wood spice
Finish: Sweet mouth coating leading to a refreshing finish

bladnoch-alinta.title: Bladnoch Alinta
bladnoch-alinta.bodyHtml:
Alinta’, an indigenous Australian word from several Southeast Australian language groups means ‘fire’ and ‘flames’, and evokes the notes of Campfire Embers found in each sip.

This expression utilizes PX Sherry and ex-bourbon casks combined together with a sweet smoky peated spirit, sets Alinta apart from anything previously released by Bladnoch.

TASTING NOTES - Campfire, floral, sweet

COLOUR - copper

NOSE - Smoky ice cream, delicate floral with sweet oak

PALATE - Campfire smoke, almonds, raisins with a white chocolate body

FINISH - Long with a sweet smoke

cune-vina-real-gran-reserva-rioja.title: CVNE Vina Real Gran Reserva 2018
cune-vina-real-gran-reserva-rioja.bodyHtml:
CVNE Viña Real Gran Reserva 2018 is a classic, deeply aromatic, and finely structured Spanish red wine crafted from estate vineyards in Rioja Alavesa. Exhibiting an intense ruby hue with brick reflections, it opens with complex aromas of fresh blackberries, ripe dark plums, bay leaf, sandalwood, graphite, and cocoa powder. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, elegant, and energetic, showcasing vibrant fruit, polished chalky tannins, fine minerality, and a long, lingering, oak-spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, prime ribeye, braised beef, cured Spanish jamón, and aged Manchego cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

Bay leaf, quince, sandalwood, new leather, cassis and tapenade aromas with a floral touch. Intense and compact, but nothing heavy. Firm, structured tannins and a long, creamy finish extended by some wood spices. Drink from 2025.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The classical red 2018 Viña Real Gran Reserva Especial (this year, it has the word Especial on the label) was produced with grapes from their own vineyards in the villages of Laguardia and Labastida in search of a gastronomical wine that is supple and complex. In 2018, the wine has a little more acidity even if the grapes were picked between October 1 and 26. It's mostly Tempranillo with 5% Graciano, moved by gravity. It matured in barrels for 24 months to qualify for the category. It achieved 13.9% alcohol, with a pH of 3.55 and 5.8 grams of acidity. It's serious and a little closed at first, nuanced and subtle. It closes the classical range at Viña Real where they have now added more modern wines, Bakeder and La Virgen. It has more finesse and might be a little lighter, with no exuberance. I sometimes like austerity... 30,000 bottles produced. It was bottled in March 2021.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An expressive red fragrant with mineral and crushed rosemary notes, this offers flavors of ripe black cherry and black plum, with a touch of cocoa powder, all enlivened by bright, mandarin orange peel acidity. Well-structured, integrating fine, taut tannins that provide crisp definition on the lasting, smoke-laced finish. Tempranillo and Graciano. Drink now through 2034. 2,500 cases made, 600 cases imported.
tags: Compañía Vinícola del Norte de España

tapiz-alta-malbec.title: Tapiz Alta Collection Malbec 2018 750ml
tapiz-alta-malbec.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "A bouquet of toasty smoky red berry fruits and milk chocolate, clove and vanilla, baked caly and black currant. Youthful with a finer complexity and lots of charm. Lots of intensity on the palate with a firm texture and core berry fruit flavours that reflect thebouquet, dark cpices of oak, medium+ acidity, toasty barrel and dried herb. Dry, medium+ weight and intensity, youthful and demanding, well made and lengthy. Best drinking from 2023 through 2029." - Cameron Douglas MS

cune-imperial-reserva.title: CVNE Imperial Rioja Reserva 2019
cune-imperial-reserva.bodyHtml:
CVNE Imperial Rioja Reserva 2019 is a distinguished Spanish red wine from the prestigious Rioja DOCa region, produced by Compañía Vinícola del Norte de España (CVNE). Imperial is one of the winery's most celebrated collections, renowned for its traditional Rioja winemaking techniques, carefully selected grapes and exceptional ageing potential. Crafted primarily from Tempranillo, complemented by Graciano, Garnacha and Mazuelo, the 2019 vintage offers a rich and refined expression of Rioja Alta. Aromas of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, red plums and dried herbs mingle with notes of vanilla, cedar, tobacco and sweet spice from oak maturation. The palate is structured yet elegant, with polished tannins, balanced acidity and a long, savoury finish. This classic Rioja Reserva is ideal for special occasions, fine dining and collectors seeking a wine with ageing potential.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, Iberico pork, venison, chorizo, mushroom risotto, aged Manchego and other mature cheeses.

 

95 Points - James Suckling

A precise, layered nose that shows excellent purity despite some sweet oak spices. More berry fruit comes out as you give it some time in the glass. Plums, cherries, red berries with dark mushrooms, cured meat, grilled spices, stones, vanilla and iodine. Juicy, spiced berries quickly tighten up on the medium- to full-bodied palate with dusty, powerful tannins, allowing it to expand into the finish. It grows on the palate and the creaminess is already chiselled. This will age beautifully in the next 10-15 years. Drinkable now, but better from 2026.

94 Points - Wine Advocate

The 2019 Imperial Reserva was cropped from a very healthy year with good ripeness and balance, a powerful vintage with a 185-day vegetative cycle. They look for finesse, precision and power, a blend of Tempranillo and 15% Graciano, Mazuelo and Garnacha put through optical sorting and fermented in oak vats with yeasts selected from the Imperial vineyards and a 20-day maceration, then it matured in barrels, 70% French and the rest American, for 24 months. It has 14% alcohol and a pH of 3.61. It feels very classical, with finesse and power, balanced and serious. It has tannins that call for food. 150,000 bottles produced. It was bottled in June 2022.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A sculpted red, with ripe red cherry and currant fruit accented by briary herb, spice and floral notes. Reveals a plush quality to the texture without imparting too much weight, while a minerally underpinning pushes through to drive the lasting finish. Tempranillo, Graciano, Mazuelo and Garnacha. Drink now through 2029. 12,500 cases made, 1,500 cases imported.

chateau-larose-perganson.title: Chateau Larose Perganson 2018
chateau-larose-perganson.bodyHtml:
Château Larose Perganson 2018 is a refined Haut-Médoc offering aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, dark cherry, cedar, graphite, tobacco, and subtle spice. Ripe fruit, silky tannins, vibrant acidity, and well-integrated oak create a balanced, elegant palate with impressive concentration and excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled ribeye, roast lamb, beef tenderloin, duck confit, mushroom risotto, aged Comté, or herb-roasted vegetables.

 

92 Points - James Suckling

Currant, plum, red-tea and oyster-shell aromas. It’s medium-bodied with sleek tannins and crisp acidity. Fresh, succulent and lightly saline finish.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Associated with Larose-Trintaudon, this estate has produced a dense wine. Rich tannins, spice, blackberry fruits and smoky acidity are all set for good aging. The wine's concentration is impressive and it should not be drunk before 2024.

91 Points - Decanter

A consistently successful wine, here showing ripe black fruits that remain tight through the finish. Needs a few years to settle down. Not generous but has mouthwatering crushed mint and plenty of Médoc typicity. A yield of 22hl/ha, aged in 25% new oak for 12 months.

91 Points - Vinous

The 2018 Larose Perganson is flat-out delicious. Sweet floral aromatics meld into a core of ripe, red-toned fruit. Cedar, tobacco and grilled herbs develop later, adding pretty layers of savoriness. Beautifully long and persistent through to the finish, Larose Perganson is a winner in 2018.

finca-los-primos-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Finca Los Primos Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
finca-los-primos-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Aromas of spices, herbs, paprika, and vanilla. These aromas are reflected on the palate and complemented by firm and well-mature tannins that give very good structure and complexity. There is a balanced, elegant, and spicy finish.

gp-brewing-cold-ones-lager.title: Gp Brewing Cold One'S Lager 15 Cans
gp-brewing-cold-ones-lager.bodyHtml: GP Brewing's Cold Ones Lager is described as a well-balanced, crisp lager with flavors of sweet grain and toasted bread, along with subtle caramel notes on the finish according to Liquor Lodge. The lager is brewed by GP Brewing Co in Alberta, Canada.

gp-brewing-cold-ones-strong.title: Gp Brewing Cold One'S Strong 15 Cans

kavalan-solist-madeira-canada-cask.title: Kavalan Solist Madeira Cask Truth Malters Chapter #5 Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-madeira-canada-cask.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Madeira Cask Truth Malters Chapter #5 is an exceptionally limited single-cask Taiwanese single malt selected by Truth Malters. Distilled in 2015 and matured for five years and six months in a Madeira cask, this cask-strength release yielded just 223 bottles. Bottled at 57.8% ABV, it combines Kavalan's concentrated tropical fruit character with rich Madeira influence, delivering layers of ripe fruit, honey, toffee, nuts, warming spice and aromatic oak.

Food Pairing: Pair with roasted duck, grilled beef, glazed pork, mature cheeses, toasted almonds, dried figs, fruitcake or dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: Rich and fruit-forward with grape, apple, melon, apricot, fig and marmalade layered with honey, toffee, vanilla, cinnamon and aromatic oak.

Nose: Fresh grape and apple open into honey and cinnamon, followed by buttery toffee, almond and vanilla with red fruit, baked fruit, tobacco leaf, sandalwood and sweet cherry.

Palate: Exceptionally creamy with melon and apricot developing into fig, marmalade and grape, accented by white pepper, cinnamon, cherry, sweet toffee and honey.

Finish: Long and juicy with persistent fruit, oak spice, cinnamon and caramelized butter.

kavalan-solist-peated-canada-cask.title: Kavalan Solist Virgin Oak 2016 Team Canada R
kavalan-solist-peated-canada-cask.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Virgin Oak Team Canada R is an ultra-premium, single-cask-strength single malt whisky produced by King Car Kavalan Distillery in Yilan County, Taiwan. This specific bottling represents an exclusive private single-cask selection curated directly for the Canadian market ("Team Canada"), with the "R" designating the specific barrel allocation in the release. Matured in a new, unaged virgin oak cask under Yilan's intense subtropical climate, the accelerated interaction between wood and spirit develops remarkable depth. It presents a rich, indulgent profile balancing sweet tropical fruits, honey, beeswax, and warm oak spices unique to this cask.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork belly, prime rib steak, dark chocolate tarts, dried fruits, or strong aged cheeses like stilton.

Tasting Notes : Deep black cherry and soft treacle appearance with a rich, full-bodied, and velvety texture on the palate.

Nose : Smoked plum, purple grapes, buttery vanilla, rich beeswax, subtle floral notes, apricot, and honeyed peach.

Palate : Full-bodied and indulgent with subtle oak spice, sweet honey, autumn pear, roasted chestnuts, ripe guava, and warming cinnamon.

Finish : Long, rich, and enduring with lingering notes of ripened tropical fruit, sweet oak spice, and cinnamon warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of pure water to open the complex aromatic fruit and spice layers.

edradour-46-sherried.title: Signatory Vintage Un-Chillfiltered Collection Edradour 10 Year Old Sherry Cask
edradour-46-sherried.bodyHtml:
As always this sherry bomb is bottled at 46% ABV with natural colour and un-chill-filtered from a single first fill sherry butt.

A customer tip lead us to this whisky, we've seen a few batches of these very sherried single malt. Always from a single ex-Sherry Butt, bottled at 46% after 10 years, under the Signatory label.

treana-chardonnay.title: Treana Red Blend 2022
treana-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Treana Red Blend 2024 is a rich and expressive California red wine produced by Hope Family Wines in Paso Robles, California. Created by the renowned Hope family, Treana celebrates the unique terroir and winemaking heritage of California's Central Coast. This bold red blend brings together the richness of Cabernet Sauvignon and the smooth, fruit-forward character of Syrah, delivering a harmonious combination of ripe dark fruits, warm spices, and elegant oak influences. The 2024 vintage offers a full-bodied drinking experience with velvety tannins, balanced acidity, and a lingering finish. Its approachable yet sophisticated character makes it an excellent choice for special occasions, dinner gatherings, and lovers of bold California red wines.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, barbecue ribs, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, beef tenderloin, smoked brisket, grilled pork chops, mushroom risotto, aged cheddar, Gouda, and rich pasta dishes.

martini-rossi-asti-3.title: Martini & Rossi Asti Spumante DOCG 375ml
martini-rossi-asti-3.bodyHtml:
Martini & Rossi Asti Spumante DOCG is a delightfully aromatic Italian sparkling wine crafted from Moscato Bianco grapes grown in Piedmont's prestigious Asti region. Bursting with fragrant peach, ripe pear, pineapple and delicate floral notes, this gently sweet wine offers lively bubbles, refreshing fruit character and a beautifully balanced finish. Its convenient 375ml half-bottle is perfect for intimate celebrations and indulgent desserts.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh strawberries, peach tart, fruit pavlova, vanilla panna cotta, creamy zabaglione, almond pastries, lemon cake, fruit sorbet and delicate pastries.

bacardi-8-year-old-rye-cask.title: Alberta Premium Cask Strength 10 Year Old 2025 Release
bacardi-8-year-old-rye-cask.bodyHtml:
A standout Canadian rye whisky bottled at full strength, this 10-year-old release from Alberta Premium blends decades of refinement with the bold flavor that defines 100 % prairie rye. From the heart of Calgary, it showcases intensity, depth, and character rarely seen in the rye whisky world.

On the nose, warm caramel and vanilla mingle with toasted oak, wild honey, and a swirl of ripe apple and apricot. A subtle undercurrent of rye spice—white pepper and tobacco leaf—sits alongside soft floral whispers of lilac and mint.
The palate opens rich and full, offering butterscotch, dark chocolate, candied apple, and stewed plums, balanced by the unmistakable grain-driven rye heat.
The finish is long and vibrant: lingering waves of cinnamon bark, leather, oak tannin and a bright citrus-peel lift teasing at the edges.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements smoked brisket, grilled steak, maple-glazed pork, pecan pie, dark chocolate desserts, and aged cheeses such as cheddar, Gouda, or blue cheese.

blackwell-rum.title: Appleton Estate 15 Year Old Black River Casks Rum
blackwell-rum.bodyHtml: Appleton Estate 15 Year Old is a tribute to the Black River, the source of the limestone-filtered water used in all of Appleton Estate rums. The blend of rare pot and column still rums have all been aged for a minimum of 15 years. A Beautiful copper hue appearance with a honey gold ring of age this rum is rich and full-bodied. With aromas of toasted almond and hazelnut, followed by notes of orange peel, vanilla and hints of roasted coffee and molasses you'll regret having only five senses.

forty-creek-art-of-the-blend.title: Forty Creek Art of the Blend
forty-creek-art-of-the-blend.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Art of the Blend is the 2022 limited release from the Grimsby, Ontario distillery, created by Master Blender Bill Ashburn to mark 35 years of his career, first in winemaking and then in whisky blending. To tell that story he infused Forty Creek's Niagara whisky with grapes picked in the depths of winter, and the label carries the words Winter Harvest. Warm and golden in the glass, it opens with fruit-forward aromas before brown sugar, toffee and oak develop into complex spice and a hint of stone fruit. Bottled at 45% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Brown sugar, toffee, oak, spice and stone fruit.

Nose: Fruit-forward.

Palate: Brown sugar, toffee and oak, developing into complex spice and hints of stone fruit.

Finish: Soft and harmonious.

Serve: A sipping whisky, best enjoyed neat.

robert-craig-affinity-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
robert-craig-affinity-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

irish-single-malt-xo-twa-48-40-abv.title: The Whisky Agency Irish Single Malt XO 2002 48.4% ABV
irish-single-malt-xo-twa-48-40-abv.bodyHtml:
The Whisky Agency Irish Single Malt XO is an independent bottling of Irish single malt whiskey from Northern Ireland, selected by the independent bottler The Whisky Agency. Made from malted barley, it was bottled at 48.4% ABV in a 700ml bottle. The release does not identify the distillery. A bottle for drinkers who enjoy comparing independent Irish releases with the official distillery ranges.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

islay-single-malt-2008-twa-53-60-abv.title: The Cooper's Choice Caol Ila 13 Year Old 2008 Bourbon Cask 51.5% ABV
islay-single-malt-2008-twa-53-60-abv.bodyHtml:
Caol Ila 13 Year Old 2008 Bourbon Cask is an Islay single malt Scotch whisky from Caol Ila distillery, independently bottled by The Vintage Malt Whisky Co. for The Cooper's Choice, its range of single cask releases named in tribute to the craft of the cooper. Distilled in 2008, the whisky spent 13 years maturing in a bourbon cask before being bottled at 51.5% ABV in a 700ml bottle. It is presented in the series' Limited Edition single cask release box. As a single cask bottling, it offers a one-off look at Caol Ila's spirit shaped by American oak.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

on-the-rocks-hornitos-margarita-1.title: On The Rocks Hornitos Margarita 100ml
on-the-rocks-hornitos-margarita-1.bodyHtml:
On The Rocks Hornitos Margarita in the compact 100ml size is the single-bottle version of the bottled, ready-to-drink margarita from On The Rocks, the bartender-created cocktail range from Suntory Global Spirits. It is mixed with Hornitos tequila (the producer names Hornitos Blanco, also called Plata), tart lime and triple sec, and is designed to deliver the balance of a classic bar margarita with no measuring or shaking. Bottled at 20% ABV, it is a convenient size for sampling, gift baskets, picnics or travel. The OTR Margarita won Double Gold at the 2024 San Francisco Ready-To-Drink Competition, Gold at the International Spirits Challenge and Bronze at the 2024 Bartender Spirits Awards.

Tasting Notes: Tequila, tart lime and triple sec in balance.

Serve: Pour over ice in a rocks glass; add a lime wedge if you like.

on-the-rocks-effen-cosmopolitan-1.title: On The Rocks Effen Cosmopolitan
on-the-rocks-effen-cosmopolitan-1.bodyHtml:
On The Rocks Effen Cosmopolitan is a ready-to-serve bottled cocktail from On The Rocks Premium Cocktails, the Dallas, Texas company whose founders set out to bring bar-quality cocktails wherever you go. This is the brand's take on the Cosmopolitan, the modern classic known for its vibrant pink hue, made with smooth imported EFFEN vodka with flavours of cranberry, triple sec, lemon zest and lime. It is bottled at 20% ABV in a 100ml bottle and needs no mixing: simply chill, pour and garnish. It earned a Platinum Medal at the 2024 L.A. Spirits Awards and Bronze at the IWSC 2024.

Serve: Shake or stir with ice and strain into a chilled martini glass; garnish with a lime wheel or orange twist.

on-the-rocks-knob-creek-old-fashioned-1.title: On The Rocks Knob Creek Old Fashioned 100ml
on-the-rocks-knob-creek-old-fashioned-1.bodyHtml:
On The Rocks Knob Creek Old Fashioned is a ready-to-drink Old Fashioned cocktail from On The Rocks, made with Knob Creek Kentucky straight bourbon, bitters and orange. Staying close to the classic recipe, it is strong, balanced and simple, and is bottled at 35% ABV so it only needs to be poured over ice. This listing is the 100ml bottle.

Serve: Pour about 1.5 oz over a large ice cube and garnish with an orange peel.

tullamore-dew-xo-rum-finish-1.title: Tullamore D.E.W. XO Caribbean Rum Cask Finish Irish Whiskey
tullamore-dew-xo-rum-finish-1.bodyHtml:
Tullamore D.E.W. XO Caribbean Rum Cask Finish takes the brand's classic triple-distilled, triple-blend Irish whiskey and finishes it in barrels that previously aged Demerara rum. The rum casks add sweet, fruity tropical character: caramel and banana, with hints of dates and raisins. The release pays tribute to the part Irish immigrants played in the development of rum in the Caribbean in the 17th century, summed up by the distillery as 'Irish heart and Caribbean soul'. It is made by Tullamore D.E.W. in Tullamore, County Offaly, and bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Caramel, banana, dates and raisins with soft spice.

Serve: Neat, or in an XO Daiquiri.

keenan-cabernet-sauvignon-napa-valley.title: Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
keenan-cabernet-sauvignon-napa-valley.bodyHtml:
Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a classic, classic-styled Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon crafted from premium vineyard sources across the valley floor and mountain slopes. In the glass, it displays a deep garnet-purple color with intense clarity. The bouquet opens with inviting aromas of blackberry jam, dark plum, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with notes of milk chocolate, baking spices, cedar, dried tobacco, and subtle forest floor. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and supple, offering a dense core of black fruit flavor underpinned by fine-grained, firm tannins and a balanced, lively acidity that leads to a long, polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, savory venison stews, and aged hard cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This bold, ripe but nicely polished wine wraps black cherries, black currants and mint in moderate, fine-grained tannins that will help carry it for several years. Subtle cinnamon, clove and cedar accents keep it interesting on the finish. Best through 2030.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, polished style, with a relatively open-knit core of boysenberry and black cherry compote backed by friendly singed vanilla and licorice notes. A crowd-pleaser. Drink now through 2031.

robert-craig-howell-mountain-cuvee.title: Robert Craig Howell Mountain Cuvee
robert-craig-howell-mountain-cuvee.bodyHtml:
Robert Craig Howell Mountain Cuvée is a highly structured, vibrant, and expressive Bordeaux-style red blend that brilliantly serves as an accessible introduction to the rugged power of Napa Valley's high-altitude terroir. Sourced primarily from the young vines of the estate's organically farmed Candlestick Ridge Vineyard, which sits along the northern summit of Howell Mountain at an elevation of 2,250 feet, this wine thrives in lean, white volcanic tufa soils. In the glass, it presents a deep dark ruby and purplish hue. The aromatic nose opens with intense notes of wild, thorny vine fruits, deep cassis, and black cherry pie, beautifully accented by mountain-grown complexities of fresh lavender, wild sage, cedar, crushed red rock, and lead pencil. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and supple, offering an early-drinking framework that marries approachable, velvety textures with Howell Mountain's signature gravitas. A concentrated core of dark chocolate-covered blackberry and juicy plum fruit is supported by a solid spine of fine-grained tannins and a bright, refreshing line of natural acidity, finishing with outstanding length and a lingering touch of savory spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with rosemary-crusted roasted lamb chops, slow-braised wild boar stew, thick-cut grilled ribeye steak, wood-fired mushroom pizza, and mature aged Gouda cheese.

monte-rodrigo-airen.title: Monte Rodrigo Airen 750ml
monte-rodrigo-airen.bodyHtml:
This refreshing Spanish Airén offers aromas of green apple, pear, citrus zest, and delicate floral notes. Light-bodied and crisp, the palate delivers gentle acidity, clean orchard fruit flavors, and subtle minerality, finishing fresh, smooth, and pleasantly easy-drinking.

Food Pairing: Grilled white fish, shellfish, roasted chicken, fresh salads, vegetable tapas, soft cheeses, seafood pasta, and light Mediterranean cuisine.

hirsch-bourbon-the-horizon.title: Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon
hirsch-bourbon-the-horizon.bodyHtml:
Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon is a landmark Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey widely recognized as the world's first commercially available single barrel bourbon, introduced in 1984 by Master Distiller Elmer T. Lee. Named in honor of Colonel Albert B. Blanton, who spent over five decades managing the historic Buffalo Trace Distillery (formerly the George T. Stagg Distillery), each bottle is drawn from an individual cask aged in the center-cut section of Warehouse H—the only metal-clad warehouse on the distillery grounds, known for rapid temperature fluctuations that accelerate wood interaction. Crafted from Buffalo Trace's high-rye Mashbill #2 and bottled at 93 proof, it delivers a rich, complex, and remarkably balanced profile of sweet vanilla, citrus, caramel, and warm baking spices, housed in its iconic round bottle topped with a collectible cast-metal horse and jockey stopper.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-smoked beef brisket, glazed pork ribs, seared duck breast, aged sharp cheddar or Gouda, dark chocolate pecan tarts, and warm bread pudding with caramel sauce.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber with warm copper-orange highlights, presenting a full, rich body with a velvety, smooth, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Warm vanilla, honey, caramel, dried orange peel, toasted oak, nutmeg, and subtle rye spice.

Palate : Rich and creamy with flavors of burnt sugar, sweet corn, dark toffee, clove, cinnamon, citrus zest, and seasoned charred oak.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warming with lingering notes of sweet vanilla, baking spices, honey, and subtle dry oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or rocks glass, over a single large ice cube, or as the rich centerpiece in classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

garrison-brothers-honeydew.title: Garrison Brothers HoneyDew Bourbon
garrison-brothers-honeydew.bodyHtml:
Texas- Aged four years in new American white oak casks and infused with Texas-local Burleson’s wildflower honey oak cubes. Notes of Elderberry Syrup, Yellow-Flesh Peaches, Apricots. Awarded 99 points and Best Small Batch at Sunset Intl. Spirits Competition 2020.

Aroma is sweet elderberry syrup,wildflowers and Mom’s honey-pineappleupside-down cake, baking in the oven. taste of wildflowers, plum jelly, vanilla and cloves. Sweet honey butter on a warm yeast roll. Delicate hibiscus tea and saltwater taffy tingling the roof of your mouth. Finish of stewed apricots, cinnamon-toast-crunch cereal and El Rey white chocolate. A pleasing mouthful of summertime joy that sneaks in like a spring rain shower.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked pork belly, sharp aged cheddar cheese, grilled peaches, dark chocolate truffles, or a classic warm pecan pie.

cameronbridge-1984-37-year-old-xop.title: XOP Cameronbridge 1984 37 Year Old 54.4%
cameronbridge-1984-37-year-old-xop.bodyHtml: Made in 1984 at Cameronbridge distillery, this single grain whisky has been matured in a single refill hogshead for more than three decades, before being bottled by Douglas Laing in May 2019 as part of its Xtra Old Particular series.

speyside-1991-30-year-old.title: Douglas Laing Xtra Old Particular Glen Grant 30 Year Old 1991 Refill Hogshead 46.9% ABV
speyside-1991-30-year-old.bodyHtml:
This limited release 30 year old Speyside single malt was distilled at Glen Grant in June 1991 and bottled in December 2021 for Douglas Laing's revered Xtra Old Particular series.

Charged from refill hogshead number 15427 at a natural cask strength 46.9%, this is one of only 254 bottles that comes complete with glass stopper decanter, wooden presentation case and COA insert.

bowmore-1996-25-year-old-xop.title: Douglas Laing XOP Bowmore 25 Year Old 1996 #DL15624
bowmore-1996-25-year-old-xop.bodyHtml:
Douglas Laing XOP Bowmore 25 Year Old 1996 #DL15624 is an exceptional single-cask Islay Scotch whisky distilled at Bowmore in November 1996 and bottled by Douglas Laing in March 2022. Matured for 25 years in a refill hogshead, this limited release yielded just 202 bottles at a natural cask strength of 52.7% ABV. Layers of tropical fruit, citrus, honey, and coastal peat smoke create a beautifully complex whisky, complemented by earthy undertones and a long, maritime finish. Bottled without chill filtration or added colouring, it preserves the distinctive character of mature Bowmore.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, grilled scallops, roasted lamb, smoked Gouda, aged cheddar, dark chocolate, and salted caramel.

Tasting Notes: Complex and coastal, combining tropical fruit, earthy peat smoke, honeyed sweetness, citrus, and maritime salinity.

Nose: Earthy peat smoke, damp soil, charred wood, citrus, tropical fruit, honey, and delicate tea notes.

Palate: Rich and oily, with mango, pineapple, citrus, honeycomb, gentle peat smoke, and sea salt.

Finish: Exceptionally long, with lingering tropical fruit, zesty citrus, maritime salt, soft smoke, and subtle herbal freshness.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass. Add a few drops of water to explore the fruit and smoke.

tormore-1995-25-year-old-xop.title: Douglas Laing Xtra Old Particular Tormore 1995 25 Year Old Single Cask 51.1% ABV
tormore-1995-25-year-old-xop.bodyHtml:
The beautiful distillery of Tormore in Speyside is a lesser known distillery, but if you have driven in Speyside, you will no doubt have passed this visually striking distillery. Most of Tormore's production is purchased by blenders, so it is quite rare and exciting to see a 25 year old single cask bottling.

Bottled from a refill Hogshead by the Douglas Laing team, this is one of 314 bottles.

Official Tasting Notes 

Nose – The nose opens with summer straw and tangy gooseberries developing to green apples and candied nuts. The palate bursts with vanilla'd oak, warming nutmeg and buttery oat biscuits. There's a dried banana chip sweetness on the finish with orchard fruits and lemon rind.

auchentoshan-1990-30-year-old-xop.title: Douglas Laing Xtra Old Particular Auchentoshan 30 Year Old 1990 Refill Hogshead Cask 14568 56.2% ABV
auchentoshan-1990-30-year-old-xop.bodyHtml: A 1990 Auchentoshan single malt from indie bottler Douglas Laing, matured in a single refill hogshead for three decades before being bottled in December 2020 as part of its Xtra Old Particular series. Aromas of vanilla, malted barley and boiled sweets fill the nose, complemented by notes of toasted oak, candied nuts, green apples, pineapple chunks and creamy porridge throughout the palate.

auchroisk-1991-30-year-old-xop.title: XOP Auchroisk 1991 30 Year Old 51.2% ABV
auchroisk-1991-30-year-old-xop.bodyHtml: A 1991 Auchroisk single malt from independent bottler Douglas Laing that was matured in a single refill hogshead for three decades, before being bottled in December 2021 as part of its Xtra Old Particular series.

glen-grant-1991-30-year-old-xop.title: Douglas Laing Xtra Old Particular Glen Grant 30 Year Old 1991 Refill Hogshead 46.9% ABV
glen-grant-1991-30-year-old-xop.bodyHtml:
This limited release 30 year old Speyside single malt was distilled at Glen Grant in June 1991 and bottled in December 2021 for Douglas Laing's revered Xtra Old Particular series.

Charged from refill hogshead number 15427 at a natural cask strength 46.9%, this is one of only 254 bottles that comes complete with glass stopper decanter, wooden presentation case and COA insert.

north-british-1988-33-year-old-xop.title: XOP North British 1988 33 Year Old
north-british-1988-33-year-old-xop.bodyHtml: An impressive single grain Scotch whiskey from the North British Distillery, matured for 33 years between July 1988 and December 2021. The whisky was treated to a finishing period in a single Pedro Ximénez sherry butt before eventually being bottled up by Douglas Laing for the Xtra Old Particular series, with a total of 674 bottles produced.

kujira-10-year-old-bourbon-barrel.title: Kujira Ryukyu 10 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Japanese Whisky
kujira-10-year-old-bourbon-barrel.bodyHtml:
Kujira Ryukyu Single Grain Whisky 10 years was distilled from 100% premium Indica rice and matured in White Oak Virgin casks for more than 10 years.
Masahiro Distillery was founded in 1883, its history could trace back to Ryukyu Kingdom era. Masahiro Distillery is known for its production techniques, prominent qualities, and passion for innovation.
Masahiro Distillery was founded in 1883 by Shobun Higa. His father – Shozoku Higa (the master chef for Ryuku Kingdom) had an established reputation in Ryuku Kingdom and he was awarded with the license for Awamori production (Okinawa’s spirits). Shozoku’s passion for cuisines is still alive and Masahiro Distillery is famous for its production techniques, prominent qualities, and passion for innovation over 130 years. It is also the first distillery that produces the first gin in Okinawa region, Masahiro gin.
Nose:Rich and sweet butter with caramel, spices from sapwood like bourbon whisky.

Palate:sweet and buttery, like caramel, roasted wood, liquorice. With an extinguish taste of spice such as cloves and cinnamon.

Finish:bitterness with long finish of spices, that brings back the sweetness
Distillery:Masahiro Shuzo

Alcohol Content:43%

Volume:700ml

pol-roger-sir-winston-churchill-1.title: Pol Roger Cuvee Sir Winston Churchill  2013
pol-roger-sir-winston-churchill-1.bodyHtml:
Pol Roger Cuvée Sir Winston Churchill 2013 is a monumentally structured, regal, and deeply complex prestige Champagne created to honor the house's most legendary patron. Sourced entirely from historical Grand Cru vineyards that were under vine during Churchill's lifetime, this 20th release is built around a heavy dominance of Pinot Noir for aristocratic muscle and breadth, refined by a smaller percentage of elegant Chardonnay. Pouring a radiant golden-straw color with an ultra-fine, persistent trail of microscopic bubbles, the nose reveals a brilliant symphony of dried flowers, orange marmalade, gingerbread, and apple pie, layered with evolving notes of toasted hazelnuts, fresh brioche, and warm honey. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, vinous, and flawlessly seamless texture that effortlessly balances a texturally dense core of orchard fruits against a driving spine of crystalline mountain acidity and an incredibly fine, pillowy mousse. Hand-riddled and aged for over seven years on its fine lees in the coldest subterranean chalk cellars of Épernay, it culminates in a majestic, penetrating finish defined by a long, noble vein of chalky, saline minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted capon with morel mushrooms, butter-poached lobster tails, pan-seared sweetbreads, or 18-month aged Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Although ready to drink, this very fine Champagne has plenty of aging to go. With its rich Pinot Noir and ripe fruits, it is generous while also fully textured. Complex and balanced, mature fruit and toast working together, this is a great wine.

97 Points - James Suckling

Complex and subtle aromas of dried ginger, pie crust, cooked apple and cooked peach follow through to a full body with ginseng, toasted bread and dried apple. Very fine and multidimensional. Great wine. Drink now.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2013 Cuvée Sir Winston Churchill continues to show beautifully, wafting from the glass with aromas of crisp yellow orchard fruit, mandarin oil, freshly baked bread and pastry cream. Medium to full-bodied, pillowy and precise, it's deep and vinous, with a racy spine of an acidity and a tensile but relatively charming profile that means it's already approachable. In style, the 2013 is in contrast with the broader, fleshier 2012, but the two vintages are very close in ultimate quality.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

An expressive Champagne, with ripe and juicy pineapple, cassis and apricot fruit flavors married to notes of brioche, saline, lemon curd and honeysuckle. Backed by a spine of fresh acidity, this is well-cut and harmonious, with the fine and creamy mousse carrying the flavor range on the lasting finish. Drink now through 2035.

bulleit-bourbon-barrel-strength-batch-7.title: Bulleit Bourbon Barrel Strength Batch No. 8
bulleit-bourbon-barrel-strength-batch-7.bodyHtml:
Bulleit Barrel Strength Batch No. 8 is made from a high-rye mash bill (28%) that imparts a distinct spiciness to the whiskey, differentiating it from bourbons with higher corn content. The spice shows on the nose, paired with hints of vanilla and oak. The palate is smooth, with maple, toffee and nutmeg shining through.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements smoked brisket, grilled ribeye steak, barbecue ribs, roasted duck, spicy glazed pork, aged cheddar, and dark chocolate desserts.

pocas-colheita.title: Poças Colheita 2000
pocas-colheita.bodyHtml:
Poças Colheita 2000 is a single-harvest Tawny Port from Portugal's Douro Valley, aged in seasoned oak casks to develop exceptional complexity. Rich notes of dried fruit, caramel, toasted nuts, orange peel, and warming spice are balanced by vibrant acidity and a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with crème brûlée, pecan pie, roasted nuts, blue cheeses, dried fruits, and dark chocolate desserts.

 

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

As Colheitas (aged tawnies) go, this is young. It has good nut and raisin flavors, with a burst of orange zest and sweet cherries. Once open, it will keep for several weeks if the air is pumped out.

ruinart-blanc-de-blancs.title: Ruinart Brut Blanc de Blancs
ruinart-blanc-de-blancs.bodyHtml:
A supple, harmonious attack on the palate, firm but rounded. A voluptuous texture and vinosity that is not excessive, supported by excellent freshness. A very refreshing mineral finish.

At first very intense on the nose, giving way to fresh fruit notes, particularly ripe citrus and exotic fruits (pineapple). A highly refined floral second nose with notes of linden and white fruits (white peach).

Beautiful pale yellow color with glints of gold and green, a vibrant, luminous color. Active effervescence with a fine, persistent release of bubbles.

Ruinart Blanc de Blancs is a champagne for all occasions: aperitifs, lunch, dinner or celebratory meals. The vivacity is a perfect complement to seafood and white fish, pairing perfectly with dishes such as sea scallop carpaccio and sea bream tartare.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ruinart is a specialist in Blanc de Blancs Champagne. This wine is finely balanced between maturity and taut fresh, mineral-driven fruit.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A toasty blanc de blanc with an aromatic overtone of smoke and lemon peel notes accenting flavors of poached apricot, brioche, passion fruit coulis and fresh thyme. Fine and creamy in texture, with a racy finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Lemon tart, grapefruit and almonds on the nose, followed by a rounded, silky palate with soft bubbles. Pretty lemon curd and vanilla flavors to close.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Based on the 2019 vintage and disgorged in 2022, Ruinart's newly released NV Blanc de Blancs bursts with characteristically reductive aromas of yellow orchard fruit, citrus oil, iodine and toasted bread. Medium-bodied, pillowy and fleshy, with lively acids and a saline finish, it is an attractive Champagne that incorporates 20% reserve wines.

rhum-barbancourt-reserve-spec-8-year-old.title: Rhum Barbancourt Five Star Reserve Speciale 8 Year Old Rum
rhum-barbancourt-reserve-spec-8-year-old.bodyHtml: Unlike industrial rum made from the fermentation of molasses, a by-product of the production of cane sugar, Rhum Barbancourt is an agricultural rum, rum made from fermented sugar cane juice. Rhum Barbancourt is aged in Limousin oak barrels in the Domaine's chais, and it is in these oak barrels that Rhum Barbancourt expresses its unique flavor and bouquet; a subtle blending of Haiti's sun and soil.

tekirdag-raki.title: Tekirdag Raki
tekirdag-raki.bodyHtml:
Tekirdag Raki (Tekirdağ Rakısı) is a classic Turkish rakı made by Mey İçki, part of Diageo Türkiye, whose rakı portfolio also includes Yeni Rakı and Kulüp Rakı. It is bottled at 45% ABV in a 700 ml bottle. Under Turkish rules, rakı is made by distilling suma, a spirit made from Anatolian grapes, a second time with aniseed (Pimpinella anisum) in traditional copper stills of no more than 5,000 litres, using only raw materials grown in Turkey, and it must reach at least 40% alcohol. The style takes its name from the Thracian town of Tekirdağ, where the first registered rakı in Turkish history was produced on an estate in the 1800s. The aniseed gives the spirit its signature aroma and the milky-white colour it takes on when water is added.

Serve: Chilled, traditionally mixed with cold water and served with ice alongside meze.

bonterra-zinfandel.title: Bonterra Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bonterra-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Bonterra Sauvignon Blanc 2023 is a crisp, refreshing organic white wine crafted primarily from organically farmed vineyards in Mendocino County, California. Cool stainless steel fermentation without malolactic conversion preserves its vibrant varietal expression and natural acidity. On the nose, it delivers lively, inviting aromas of fresh grapefruit, lime zest, green apple, and lemongrass accenting subtle notes of white peach and orange blossom. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied and zesty, showing a clean, juicy mouthfeel driven by citrus flavors and a hint of flinty minerality that leads into a crisp, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh goat cheese salad, pan-seared white fish, grilled shrimp skewers, fish tacos, and light pasta dishes.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast:

This vibrant wine is zesty with aromas of lemon curd, papaya, citrus blossoms, and green bell pepper on the nose. The flavors on the palate are white grapefruit, guava and lime zest, layered with dried fennel, sedimentary rock, and lemon cream. Great acidity gives the wine a dry mouthwatering finish. A great example of an industry leader producing wine with organic grapes and doing it with a neutral footprint. Pair with fried calamari.

gaja-camarcanda-bolgheri.title: Gaja Ca'Marcanda Camarcanda 2020/2022
gaja-camarcanda-bolgheri.bodyHtml:
This wine shows a refined and elegant profile with smoky aromas, red berries—especially currants—aromatic herbs, and subtle camphor notes. More concentrated and powerful than previous vintages, it maintains perfect balance. The palate is intense yet smooth, offering a mellow structure, good length, and a finish that combines salinity with delicate vegetal notes.

2020 Vintage Ratings:

95 Points - James Suckling

Currants, rose petals and ink with some fresh herbs as well. Medium-bodied with fine and tensioned tannins that give focus and beauty to the wine. This will come together beautifully. A blend of cabernet sauvignon and cabernet franc. Try after 2028, but already excellent.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Bolgheri Rosso Camarcanda is mostly Cabernet Sauvignon with Cabernet Franc in a supporting role. Showing youthful primary fruit at this young stage, the wine delivers impressive balance and fruit versus oak integration. Angelo Gaja and his team are dedicated to the pursuit of elegance in these two grape varieties that can often deliver too much power and concentration when unchecked. Timing the harvest correctly and the careful use of French oak is key to these overall results, especially with regard to the medium to full-bodied mouthfeel and the long silkiness of this age-worthy vintage.

2022 Vintage Ratings:

95 Points - James Suckling

A smoky wine with graphite, licorice, restrained cassis and leather on the nose. Full-bodied and firm in tannins, with a velvety texture, supple fruit, chewy acidity and an integrated, structured finish. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

This red is lithe and supple, boasting cherry, blackberry, black currant, violet and mineral flavors. Tense, with a dense matrix of refined tannins ushering in the long aftertaste. Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2027 through 2042.

pellegrino-marsala-fine.title: Cantine Pellegrino Marsala Fine Italia Particolare Semisecco 750ml

poplar-grove-cabernet-franc.title: Poplar Grove Cabernet Franc 2020
poplar-grove-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml:
Poplar Grove Cabernet Franc 2020 is an exceptionally elegant, expressive, and beautifully structured Canadian red wine displaying the superb potential of the Naramata Bench. Sourced from low-yielding estate vineyards, it opens with a fragrant, multi-layered bouquet of dark cherry and ripe blackberry, intricately framed by subtle notes of smoky tobacco, sweet mountain sage, dried lavender, and a touch of black tea. On the palate, this medium- to full-bodied wine reveals a concentrated core of red and dark forest fruits, seamlessly balanced by a vibrant vein of natural acidity and bold, velvety tannins. Matured for 21 months in a combination of 30% new and older French oak barriques, it delivers remarkable depth and a smooth, persistent finish accented by suggestions of dark chocolate, vanilla, and savory baking spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with rosemary-crusted grilled lamb chops, charcoal-grilled dry-aged ribeye steak, slow-cooked beef brisket, or roasted duck breast with a spiced berry reduction.

domaine-langlois-chateau-sancerre-red.title: Domaine Langlois-Chateau Sancerre Red 2020 750ml
domaine-langlois-chateau-sancerre-red.bodyHtml: Langlois-Chateau Sancerre Rouge is a red wine from the Sancerre appellation in the Loire Valley, France. It's made with Pinot Noir grapes and known for its pale ruby color, and notes of strawberry, violet, raspberry, and baking spice on the nose. On the palate, it offers flavors of red fruit with a spicy and earthy undertone. This wine is characterized by its supple mouthfeel, silky tannins, and a slight peppery edge. It's a wine that can be enjoyed young or can age well for 5-6 years after bottling.

legendario-anejo-9-year-old-rum.title: Legendario Ron Anejo 9 Year Old
legendario-anejo-9-year-old-rum.bodyHtml:
Legendario Ron Anejo 9 Year Old is a golden Cuban rum aged for nine years, from the Legendario brand founded in Havana in 1946. Medium-bodied, it shows tropical fruit, oak, vanilla, chocolate and molasses, and works both neat and mixed. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle and presented in a gift pack.

Tasting Notes: Tropical fruit, oak, vanilla, chocolate and molasses; medium body.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in rum cocktails.

vina-cobos-cobos-malbec.title: Cobos Malbec 2020
vina-cobos-cobos-malbec.bodyHtml:
Brillant inky, vibrant violet hue. Aromas of ripe gooseberry, fig, and rosemary herb. The palate bursts with freshly picked red currant and blueberry notes leading to a profound complexity that persists through a long fine grain finish. This is a multi-layered wine, well rounded, full-bodied of exceptional balance, power, and finesse.

98 Points - James Suckling

There’s a pure ripeness and freshness to this malbec despite the hot growing season. Blackberry, red licorice, and flowers. Lilac and lavender. White rose petal. Sage and mint. Full and very fine tannins. Salty undertones. Reserved and closed at the end. Linear line through it. Tannin tension gives this energy. 75% Chanares Estate and 25% Hobbs Estate. Give it four or five years to open.

400-conejos-mezcal.title: 400 Conejos Espadin Joven Mezcal
400-conejos-mezcal.bodyHtml: <meta charset="UTF-8">400 Conejos is well-balanced and smooth with soft hints of wood, sweet notes of cooked agave, and a pleasant smoky finish. Our award-winning mezcal is perfect to enjoy on its own or in your favorite cocktail to add a bit of smoke.

neptune-rum.title: Neptune Gold Rum 50ml
neptune-rum.bodyHtml:
Neptune Gold Rum is Neptune's Barbados Gold, an aged golden rum distilled at the Foursquare Distillery in southern Barbados and aged in American bourbon oak barrels. It is blended from 8, 5 and 3-year-old rums and made with no added sugar or sweeteners and no artificial flavours or colours. The brand presents it as a light-bodied sipping rum that also works with a mixer or in cocktails. Bottled at 40% ABV, this is the 50ml size.

Tasting Notes: Natural sweetness opening to apricot, bitter orange peel, chocolate and vanilla, fading into peppercorn and coconut husk.

Serve: Neat, with your favourite mixer or in cocktails.

chateau-darcie-saint-emilion-grand-cru.title: Chateau d'Arcie Saint-Emilion Grand Cru 2020
chateau-darcie-saint-emilion-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Aromas of ripe dark berries. A medium bodied approachable claret with juicy berry fruit backed up by savoury tobacco notes. This wine is classically proportioned and well balanced. Elegant tannic structure releasing a delicious range of fruity flavours with crisp acidity, lingering hints of spice. A fabulous dry red.

92 Points -James Suckling

Tasty and layered, with dark plums, ash, dried herbs and blackcurrants on the nose. Medium to full body with firm yet rounded tannins. Excellent balance and depth. Drink from 2024.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The wine was aged in wood for 12 months and is full of pepper and juicy black fruits. It is a powerful wine, dense with firm tannins and ready to age further. Drink from 2026.

marques-de-riscal-xr-reserva.title: Marques de Riscal 'XR' Reserva 2022
marques-de-riscal-xr-reserva.bodyHtml:
Marqués de Riscal 'XR' Reserva 2022 is an intensely expressive and classic Rioja that showcases deep aromas of ripe dark plum, black cherry, dried licorice, and sweet spice, complemented by refined toasted notes, vanilla, and subtle graphite. On the palate, it delivers impressive concentration and balance, offering silky, chalky tannins, vibrant refreshing acidity, and a long, complex, balsamic-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, pork belly, aged manchego cheese, or heartier game dishes.

95 Points - James Suckling

A powerful and structured red with flavors of plums, blueberries and a hint of cedar that are nicely framed by fine tannins. Tempranillo with a touch of graciano. Needs three or four years of bottle age. Best after 2028.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Mashed black and red cherries and baked black plum swirl with mullings spices, violets, and caramelized cedar in this standout bottling. It's silky soft in texture with fine plummy tannins lingering, all while freshly focused. Pair it up with rich duck dishes and drink through 2031 and then some.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A classy red, with good density and focus to the range of baked black raspberry, mocha and black olive tapenade notes. Fresh with plum skin–infused acidity and refined; chalky tannins firm the finish, showing anise, graphite and sweet paprika flavors. Drink now through 2037.

giant-steps-fatal-shore-pinot-noir.title: Giant Steps Applejack Vineyard Pinot Noir 2025
giant-steps-fatal-shore-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Giant Steps Applejack Vineyard Pinot Noir 2025 is a vibrant, highly elegant, and terroir-driven Australian red wine produced from the high-altitude Applejack Vineyard situated in the upper Yarra Valley. Visually displaying a translucent ruby hue with bright crimson highlights, it opens with a lifted bouquet of red cherry, wild strawberry, and pomegranate, seamlessly layered with subtle spice, crushed herbs, dried roses, and a delicate earthy minerality. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-bodied, fine-grained structure framed by silky tannins and a energetic core of natural acidity, delivering fresh red fruit and savory nuances that flow effortlessly into a long, fragrant, and poised finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with duck breast, pan-seared pork chops, roasted chicken, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, and mild creamy cheeses.

yellow-tail-whiskey-barrel-cabernet-sauv.title: Casella Family Yellow Tail Whiskey Barrel Aged Cabernet Sauvignon
yellow-tail-whiskey-barrel-cabernet-sauv.bodyHtml:
Casella Family Yellow Tail Whiskey Barrel Aged Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold Australian red wine that combines the rich fruit character of Cabernet Sauvignon with the distinctive influence of whisky-seasoned oak barrels. Aged for 30 days in specially prepared Australian whisky barrels, this full-bodied wine develops layers of blackcurrant, dark cherry, plum, and vanilla. Subtle hints of malt, cigar box, and warming spice complement its smooth tannins and velvety texture, creating a distinctive expression of Australian Cabernet Sauvignon.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, barbecue ribs, smoked brisket, roasted lamb, beef burgers, mushroom pasta, aged cheddar, and pepper-crusted beef.

crabbie-goat-orange-creamsicle-moonshine.title: The Crabbie Goat Orange Creamsicle Moonshine
crabbie-goat-orange-creamsicle-moonshine.bodyHtml:
The Crabbie Goat Orange Creamsicle Moonshine comes from The Crabbie Goat Distillery near Valleyview, Alberta, a family-run farm distillery founded by Cheryl and Jamie Gordon that opened its doors on 1 July 2020 and describes itself as the province's first farmstand distillery. The flavour is built to recall an orange creamsicle, pairing fresh orange with smooth ice-cream character, and the producer notes that it is dairy free. It is bottled at 20% ABV in a 750ml glass bottle, making it light enough for easy summer mixing. The distillery suggests it with orange soda, orange juice or sparkling water with a few orange slices, and also offers recipes such as a classic creamsicle with cream soda.

Serve: Over ice with orange soda, orange juice, cream soda or sparkling water and orange slices.

glenburgie-21-year-g-m-distillery-label.title: Gordon & MacPhail Distillery Labels Glenburgie 21 Year Old
glenburgie-21-year-g-m-distillery-label.bodyHtml:
A long-aged dram from lesser-known Glenburgie, a big distillery with spirit that normally disappears into the Chivas Brothers blends. It's an important component and this release shows why: floral, fruity and complex, it's a pity we don't see more of it bottled as a single malt, especially after two decades of layering on complexity and flavour. Fortunately, Gordon & MacPhail have our backs.

Nose: Rich stewed fruits and roasted hazelnut aromas with hints of brown sugar. 

Taste: Cooked apple and cinnamon flavours mix with red berries, with a lingering charred oak finish. 

This 21 year old "Distillery Label" bottling from Gordon & MacPhail was matured in Refill Sherry Butts and bottled at 46%.

lagavulin-12-year-old-2022-special-relea.title: Lagavulin 12 Year Old Special Releases 2022
lagavulin-12-year-old-2022-special-relea.bodyHtml:
As our legend goes, one extraordinary day the King of Islay was reborn. A spark of sunlight fell from the sky, and set the land ablaze. When the flames subsided, the scorched earth was veiled in thick smoke. Suddenly, new life rose from the ashes in shimmering feathers of honeyed gold and rich crimson. A regal Phoenix soared above its wings of fire powering the stills of Lagavulin, amplifying its spiced intensity.

Lagavulin has long been the home of legends. Its rocky bay was crowned with a castle by Lords of the Isles who ruled long ago. The distillery rose in succession; deeply respected, a king born to power. Made in the birthplace of distilling, this iconic Islay malt is intense and smoky, steeped in history and lore for over two hundred years.

In this deep expression from virgin oak and our smokiest reserves, peaty casks lead spice and smoke on their eternal dance with deep sweetness. The smooth, oily start shines with sweet richness, before lemony citrus and sea salt add freshness and an explosion of spice to savour. Mid-palate, the taste becomes more drying, its smoky intensity ever-growing. Great waves of peat wreathe the long, smoky-spicy finish. New-fired, Lagavulin soars to fresh heights of spiced smoke.

cadenhead-highland-distillery-37-year-ol.title: Wm Cadenhead Original Collection Fettercairn 19 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
cadenhead-highland-distillery-37-year-ol.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead Original Collection Fettercairn 19 Year Old is an independently bottled Highland single malt Scotch whisky from Fettercairn, the distillery in the foothills of the Cairngorms known for its heavy, sweet spirit. Distilled in 2006 and fully matured in bourbon barrels, this small-batch release was bottled by Wm Cadenhead of Campbeltown at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle, non-chill filtered and with no added colouring. Fruit salad sweets and quince open on the nose, and the dram builds as you sip with custard, toffee popcorn and gorse.

Tasting Notes: Fruit salad sweets, quince, custard, toffee popcorn, gorse.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

cadenhead-a-tennessee-distillery-18-year.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey 1.14L
cadenhead-a-tennessee-distillery-18-year.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey is an iconic, smooth American whiskey crafted in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Charcoal mellowed drop-by-drop through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before aging in handcrafted white oak barrels, it offers a distinct balance of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, and smooth caramel character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, pulled pork sandwiches, grilled burgers, smoked brisket, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold in appearance with a light-to-medium-bodied, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, banana, and subtle brown sugar.

Palate : Balanced mix of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, light spice, and rich caramel.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and medium-length with lingering toasted oak, charcoal, and sweet spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed with cola in a highball glass.

don-julio-70th.title: Don Julio 70 Anejo Cristalino Tequila
don-julio-70th.bodyHtml:
Don Julio 70 Añejo Cristalino Tequila is a pioneering spirit that celebrates the 70th anniversary of Don Julio's tequila-making legacy. It is a unique clear Añejo tequila, traditional añejo aged for 18 months in American white oak barrels and then carefully charcoal-filtered to restore the crisp agave flavor and clear appearance of a Blanco. This process masterfully combines the complex, rich flavors of an aged tequila with the smooth, lively notes of a silver tequila.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri, rich dark chocolate desserts (70% cocoa or higher), or savory carnitas tacos.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri, dark chocolate truffles, roasted carnitas tacos, aged cheeses, or flan.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and bright with a rich, smooth, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Crisp and complex with notes of cooked agave, wild honey, sweet vanilla, and subtle toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and velvety with dominant flavors of sweet cooked agave, honey, warm vanilla, toasted almonds, and light baking spice.

Finish : Clean, warm, and lingering with soft hints of toasted oak and delicate vanilla sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat or on the rocks in a tequila snifter or rocks glass.

lochlea-our-barley.title: Lochlea Our Barley
lochlea-our-barley.bodyHtml:
Lochlea Distillery is in the heart of Ayrshire, a farm growing their own barley, which they have been quietly distilling and ageing for a few years to release their own whisky.

The Our Barley Edition is their ongoing core expression, crafted by John Campbell, who joined Lochlea from Laphroaig distillery.
A combination of Bourbon casks, Sherry casks and STR casks, creating a dram with spice and complexity.
Official Tasting Notes
Nose – Pear syrup, fruit bon bons, warm cut grass, marmalade.
Palate – Golden syrup, pepper, rye bread, macadamia nuts, cream soda.
Finish – Long finish with a lasting orange beeswax note.

on-the-rocks-effen-espresso-martini.title: On The Rocks Effen Espresso Martini
on-the-rocks-effen-espresso-martini.bodyHtml:
On The Rocks Effen Espresso Martini is a ready-to-serve bottled cocktail from On The Rocks Premium Cocktails, the Dallas, Texas company whose founders set out to bring bar-quality cocktails wherever you go. A little dark and a little daring, it pairs rich espresso coffee liqueur with ultra-smooth EFFEN vodka for a dark, coffee-forward martini. It is bottled at 20% ABV in a 375ml bottle and needs no mixing: simply chill, pour and garnish. It won Gold at the 2024 L.A. Spirits Awards and the 2024 SF Ready-To-Drink Competition.

Serve: Serve well chilled in a martini glass, or shake with ice and strain; garnish with three coffee beans.

on-the-rocks-effen-espresso-martini-1.title: On The Rocks Effen Espresso Martini
on-the-rocks-effen-espresso-martini-1.bodyHtml:
On The Rocks Espresso Martini is a ready-to-drink cocktail made with EFFEN Vodka and a rich espresso coffee liqueur, for a dark, coffee-forward martini without the shaker. Bottled at 20% ABV in a 100ml bottle, it took Gold at the 2024 L.A. Spirits Awards and the 2024 San Francisco Ready-To-Drink Competition, and Silver at the 2024 Bartender Spirits Awards.

Serve: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled martini glass; garnish with three coffee beans.

the-est-rearrange-us.title: The Est Rearrange Us 4 Tall Cans

lochlea-harvest-edition-first-crop.title: Lochlea Harvest Edition Second Crop
lochlea-harvest-edition-first-crop.bodyHtml:
From the Lochlea distillery comes the second of four planned annual releases, Harvest Edition follows Lochlea Sowing Edition First Crop and combines a trio of cask maturations, for a gloriously fruit rich profile. A combination of Port casks, first-fill oloroso sherry casks, and first-fill bourbon barrels have certainly worked their magic here, in yet another stunning release from the young Lowlands-based distillery.

This expression highlights stewed apples, pear drops and marshmallows, followed by strawberries and violet, then finishing with hints of signature Lochlea ceral and freshly cut grass.

wisers-10-year-old-whisky.title: J.P. Wiser's 10 Year Old Triple Barrel Canadian Whisky
wisers-10-year-old-whisky.bodyHtml: This award-winning blend of corn and rye is triple barrel aged 10 years in new white oak, American bourbon and used Canadian whisky barrels. The complex flavors of caramel, honey, vanilla, dried fruit and spices are balanced by subtle notes of green apple and pear. Smooth with a pleasant finish. Sip neat or on the rocks.

scallywag-winter-edition-2022.title: Scallywag Winter Edition 2022
scallywag-winter-edition-2022.bodyHtml:
Scallywag The Winter Edition 2022 is the third annual Winter Edition of Douglas Laing's Scallywag Speyside blended malt Scotch whisky. The Laing family hand-selected single cask single malts matured exclusively in Oloroso and Pedro Ximénez sherry butts, and the vatting is bottled at a natural cask strength of 54% ABV without colouring or chill-filtration. The 2022 release was limited to 5,400 bottles of 700ml and is finished with the red-and-white candy-striped capsule and knitted scarf that mark the festive edition.

Tasting Notes: Douglas Laing describes a spicy dram, with cinnamon and ginger alongside sweet, indulgent dark chocolate.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

scallywag-chocolate-edition-2022.title: Scallywag Chocolate Edition 2022
scallywag-chocolate-edition-2022.bodyHtml:
Scallywag The Chocolate Edition 2022 is a limited-edition Speyside blended malt Scotch whisky from Douglas Laing & Co.'s Scallywag range. It brings together Speyside single malts fully matured in sherry casks, including whisky from Macallan, Mortlach and Glenrothes, chosen for a rich, cocoa-led character. The whisky is bottled at 48% ABV without colouring or chill-filtration, and the 2022 release was limited to 3,600 bottles, each 700ml and presented in a gift tube. Whisky Advocate scored it 91 points.

Tasting Notes: Dark chocolate, walnut, apricot, raspberry, pepper, tobacco and dark cocoa.

Nose: Rich and fruity, with dark chocolate, walnuts, wood spice, leather, vanilla seed, chocolate pralines and ground pepper.

Palate: Sweet milk chocolate, grilled apricot, peach and raspberry with a lively pepperiness, backed by dried citrus, vanilla, walnut, tobacco and black tea.

Finish: Dark cocoa.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

the-est-hello-euphoria.title: The Est Hello Euphoria 4 Tall Cans

makers-mark-holiday-2022-edition.title: Maker's Mark Holiday 2022 Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon
makers-mark-holiday-2022-edition.bodyHtml:
Maker's Mark Holiday 2022 Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a seasonal release of the iconic handcrafted Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey. Made with soft red winter wheat instead of traditional rye, it delivers a rich, smooth, and sweet profile that Maker's Mark is famous for. Presented in the brand's signature wax-dipped bottle with festive holiday-themed packaging, it embodies the warm, welcoming spirit of the holiday season.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with roasted turkey with cranberry sauce, pecan pie, glazed holiday ham, dark chocolate truffles, or aged cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Rich amber hue with a medium-bodied, soft, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, spiced oak, caramel, fresh fruit, and subtle wheat notes.

Palate : Smooth and creamy on the palate with flavors of sweet vanilla, toasted oak, caramel, and light cinnamon spice.

Finish : Clean, soft, and warming with lingering notes of oak spice, vanilla, and sweet caramel.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as the foundation for festive classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Boulevardier.

glenburgie-1967-g-m-archive-release-3709.title: Gordon & MacPhail Archive Release Glenburgie 53 Year Old 1967 Refill Sherry Hogshead Cask 3709 48.8% ABV
glenburgie-1967-g-m-archive-release-3709.bodyHtml:
Distilled in 1967, and filled into a Refill Sherry Hogshead, cask 3709, this 53 year old Glenburgie has been bottled at a cask strength of 48.8%.

Stewed raisin aromas and autumnal spice complement rich fruitcake. Sweet and smooth with ripe blackcurrant, dark honey, toasted almonds and mature oak. Full and long finish with lingering notes of mixed nuts.

allegrini-la-grola.title: Allegrini La Grola 2020
allegrini-la-grola.bodyHtml:
