An intense and elegant red wine with great character and personality, La Grola is the extraordinary result of the meeting between the hill of La Grola and Valpolicella's autochthonous grapes. The 2020 vintage offers a broad and enveloping scent with hints of blackcurrant, juniper, and black pepper, combined with subtle notes of tobacco and coffee. On the palate, it is fresh and intense with a solid tannic structure balanced by refreshing acidity and ripe red fruit, leading to a long finish of wild berries and dark chocolate.

94 Points - James Suckling

A single vineyard iteration, drawing fruit from an historically crucial site, quite steep and chalky-calcareous and dropping to the Adige river. Corvina (80%) and oseleta (20%). No dried fruit. The brusque, firm and punchy nature of oseleta's tannins are evident on the attack. Yet the mid-palate is spherical and energetic, serving to mitigate any sense of stiffness, while splaying anise, mint, leather varnish and dark, saturated berry. This is a very good wine, built for the cellar. Drinkable now, but best from 2025.
93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

La Grola has been a stalwart wine of the Allegrini family since 1989. This 90% Corvina and 10% Oseleta blend opens with aromas of black plum, macerated black cherries, clove, cinnamon, black pepper and violets. As the wine further opens, cedar, cigar box and tobacco notes develop. On the palate, there is a dance between rich black-hued fruits and taut well-structured tannins as savory and earthy notes add to the intrigue.
92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant red, with fine tannins seamlessly meshed with the ripe black and red cherry flavors. Accents of cured tobacco, rose hip, cocoa powder and anise wind through the fruit profile, and a subtle, minerally streak of fresh earth and iron lingers on the finish. Corvina and Oseleta. Drink now through 2034.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Made with 90% Corvina with 10% Oseleta, the 2020 La Grola shows ripe fruit, some background herbal notes, licorice, tar and soft spice. There is a slightly wild side to this easy red wine with fresh acidity and a whistle-clean finish. With 70,000 bottles released, La Grola paints a more focused picture of Corvina specifically, a grape normally used in traditional Amarone blends.

beringer-founders-estate-merlot.title: Beringer Founders' Estate Merlot 750ml
beringer-founders-estate-merlot.bodyHtml: The Beringer Founders’ Estate Merlot is immediately approachable with lush flavors of blueberry, blackberry and plum complemented by dark chocolate and spice. Its well balanced, soft tannins make this wine a perfect accompaniment to a variety of foods, such as beef tenderloin, spaghetti bolognese, or aged gouda.

domaine-weinbach-pinot-blanc.title: Domaine Weinbach Pinot Blanc 2023
domaine-weinbach-pinot-blanc.bodyHtml:
A crystalline and high-toned expression of Alsace, the 2023 Domaine Weinbach Pinot Blanc is crafted from biodynamically grown grapes sourced from the valley floor around the historic Clos des Capucins. This wine presents a brilliant pale straw hue and opens with a delicate bouquet of white orchard fruits, including Bosc pear and Granny Smith apple, layered with notes of acacia honey and wet stones. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and remarkably precise, showcasing a supple, slightly creamy texture balanced by a vibrant, racy acidity. Subtle nuances of apricot and white flowers emerge on a clean, persistent finish that reflects the estate's signature purity and elegance.

93 Points - James Suckling

Although this is bone dry, the aromas of oranges and slightly caramelized pears make it very enticing on the super-clean and wonderfully harmonious medium-bodied palate. The fine oak tannins add intensity in the long finish. From biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification. Drink or hold.

fords-gin-officers-reserve.title: Fords Gin Officers' Reserve
fords-gin-officers-reserve.bodyHtml:
Fords Gin Officers' Reserve is an overproof take on Fords Gin, made as a tribute to navy strength gin, the high-proof style once set aside for officers of the British Royal Navy. It starts with the same nine-botanical London dry recipe as Fords Gin, distilled at the Thames Distillery in London, and is then rested for three weeks in Amontillado sherry casks, which lend the spirit character from the wood. Bottled at 54.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it was released as a limited edition and the first instalment of the brand's Journeys in Gin series.

Serve: Use in a Gimlet, a strong gin and tonic with a dash of bitters, or stirred with blanc vermouth and fino sherry.

herradura-ultra-anejo-cristalino.title: Herradura Ultra Anejo Cristalino Tequila
herradura-ultra-anejo-cristalino.bodyHtml:
The crisp taste of Herradura Ultra starts with one of our finest anejos filtered to remove color and enhance smoothness. Prior to filtering, a subtle hint of pure agave nectar is added giving Ultra subtle notes of cooked agave, caramel, and honey with toasted almonds and a finish that is beyond smooth. ULTRA is the perfect balance of our aged expressions.

Enjoy shaken hard with ice, strained neat in a shot glass to celebrate.

fords-gin.title: Fords London Dry Gin
fords-gin.bodyHtml:
Fords Gin is a London Dry gin created by bartender and spirits veteran Simon Ford with 11th-generation master distiller Charles Maxwell at Thames Distillers in London, designed from the outset as a cocktail gin. The recipe, settled on at attempt number 83, uses nine botanicals sourced through Joseph Flach & Sons: juniper and coriander seed, bitter orange, lemon and grapefruit peel, jasmine flower and orris, and angelica and cassia. The botanicals are steeped for 15 hours, then distilled for five hours in the John Dore copper stills nicknamed Tom Thumb and Thumbelina, before the gin is shipped to Newbridge, Scotland, cut with spring water and bottled at 45% ABV (90 proof). Bright and aromatic, it holds its own in a Martini, Negroni or G&T.

Food Pairing: Savoury dishes.

Tasting Notes: Bright, aromatic and medium-bodied.

Nose: Citrus fruit, jasmine and juniper with coriander, angelica and a hint of vanilla.

Finish: Lingering grapefruit, juniper and floral notes.

Serve: In a Martini, Negroni or gin and tonic.

ophelia-vodka-2.title: Ophelia Vodka (Cls)
ophelia-vodka-2.bodyHtml:
Ophelia Vodka is an unflavoured vodka from Krang Spirits, a small craft distillery in Cochrane, Alberta, that hand-crafts its spirits from carefully chosen ingredients. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 375ml bottle, it is a clean, versatile base for classic vodka cocktails, or for sipping well chilled.

Serve: Chilled and neat, or in a vodka martini, Caesar or highball.

gerard-bertrand-cigalus-red.title: Gerard Bertrand Domaine de Cigalus Rouge 2022
gerard-bertrand-cigalus-red.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Domaine de Cigalus Rouge 2022 is an exceptional, biodynamically farmed red blend that brilliantly showcases the innovative spirit and unique terroir of the South of France. A masterful, unconventional marriage of classic Bordeaux and Mediterranean varietals, this wine pours an intense, deep ruby color with subtle mahogany highlights. The bouquet is remarkably expressive and complex, offering a concentrated aromatic profile of very ripe black fruits, including blackberries, dark cherries, and plums, seamlessly interwoven with elegant notes of grilled spices, dried herbs, toasted oak, and a distinct hint of fresh mint. On the palate, it is lush, full-bodied, and incredibly opulent, framed by beautifully velvety, perfectly integrated tannins. A vibrant core of dark berry fruit is balanced by a precise structure and a incredibly long, sophisticated finish, making this a truly harmonious and captivating wine.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, slow-cooked beef stews, grilled ribeye steak, hearty mushroom dishes, or a selection of mature artisan cheeses.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This layered red blend would flatter many a meal. Toasted red cherry tart and muddled strawberry aromas are enhanced by hints of soy sauce and black olive on the nose. The restrained palate delves into pencil-lead shavings, dry grape stalk and semi-dry, barely-trodden earth.

hester-creek-merlot-vqa.title: Hester Creek Merlot 750ml
hester-creek-merlot-vqa.bodyHtml: Hester Creek Merlot (750ml) is a red wine known for its medium-bodied, easy-drinking style with soft tannins and a focus on red fruit flavors like plum and cherry. It often exhibits notes of blackberry, cocoa, and malt, with a smooth, luscious finish. The wine is a pure expression of Merlot, showcasing a vibrant palate with well-integrated tannins and a juicy vibrancy.

jackson-triggs-gold-sunrock-cabernet-sau.title: Jackson Triggs Black Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
jackson-triggs-gold-sunrock-cabernet-sau.bodyHtml: Jackson Triggs Black Cabernet Sauvignon is a full-bodied, fruit-forward red wine with notes of blackcurrant, cherry, and cassis. It is known for its rich, bold aromas and pairs well with rich, rare game meats or braised beef dishes.

capensis-chardonnay.title: Capensis Silene Chardonnay 2023
capensis-chardonnay.bodyHtml: A blend of our estate Fijnbosch vineyard and neighboring mountain vineyards, the 2023 Silene offers alluring notes of lemon-lime, peach, and citrus blossom, carried by a bright salinity and richly textured, mineral finish.

black-bridge-milk-stout.title: Black Bridge Milk Stout 4 Tall Cans
black-bridge-milk-stout.bodyHtml: Darker doesn't always mean stronger! A stouts roasty signature quality comes from barley that is roasted and unmalted. This beer pours a dark black with the aroma of dark chocolate and dried fruit. The sweetness is balanced by the roasted malt, with a rich and creamy mouthfeel.

the-growlery-vega-west-coast-ipa.title: The Growlery Vega West Coast Ipa 4 Tall Cans

good-mood-hibiscus-rosehip-sparkling-tea.title: Good Mood Hibiscus Rosehip Sparkling Tea 6 Cans

good-mood-earl-grey-sparkling-hard-tea.title: Good Mood Earl Grey Sparkling Hard Tea 6 Cans

lola-cabernet-sauvignon-cabernet-franc.title: Lola Cabernet Sauvignon Cabernet Franc 250ml
lola-cabernet-sauvignon-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml: The Lola Cabernet Sauvignon/Cabernet Franc is a red wine blend from Pelee Island Winery in Ontario, Canada. It's known for its dark berry, spicy, and cedar aromas, and is often paired with charcuterie, cheese, or deli meats. The blend combines the rich flavors of Cabernet Sauvignon with the lighter, more fruity notes of Cabernet Franc.

bask-pinot-grigio.title: Bask Pinot Grigio
bask-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: BASK Pinot Grigio is a dry, crisp white wine known for its low sugar content, offering 0g of sugar per serving. It is described as having bright, fresh aromas of pear and lime, with a clean, refreshing finish. The wine has a citrusy, crisp taste, often with notes of green apple and pear, and a light body. It is a popular choice for those looking for a light and refreshing wine with a low sugar profile.

vignamaggio-gherardino-chianti-class-ris.title: Marchese Antinori Tenuta Tignanello Chianti Classico Riserva 2023
vignamaggio-gherardino-chianti-class-ris.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Tenuta Tignanello Chianti Classico Riserva 2023 (labeled as Marchese Antinori) is a vibrant, elegant, and beautifully structured Tuscan red wine crafted exclusively from grapes harvested at the prestigious Tenuta Tignanello estate in San Casciano in Val di Pesa. Grown on southwest-facing hillsides characterized by limestone- and schist-rich marine marlstone (alberese and galestro), this vintage demonstrates remarkable purity and depth. Following destemming, soft crushing, and temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks, the wine was matured for approximately twelve months in French and Hungarian oak barriques. In the glass, it pours an intense, luminous ruby red. The aromatic profile is expressive and complex, opening with fragrant notes of ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and redcurrants, accompanied by delicate undertones of crushed violets, licorice, tobacco leaf, cocoa, and sweet baking spices like clove and nutmeg. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full body marked by plush, velvety tannins, energetic natural acidity, and a seamless, savory core of fruit that carries through to an expansive, mineral-edged finish.

Food Pairing: Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted rack of lamb, pappardelle with wild boar ragù, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A classic Chianti with exquisite aromas of vibrant black cherries, licorice, bark, earth and violets. Medium-bodied, firm and velvety, with sweet grainy tannins, crisp and exuberant acidity and savory, spicy length. Drinkable now, but best over the next decade.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Big fruit and some ripeness emerge from the bouquet of the Marchesi Antinori 2023 Chianti Classico Riserva Tenuta Tignanello Marchese Antinori. The wine is open-knit and generous, with rich fruit, tart spice and a savory side. Hints of clove and nutmeg add complexity and warmth. The Sangiovese and complementary varieties are aged in French and Hungarian oak barriques for about a year.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Licorice, tar and iron aromas embrace the plum, black cherry, iron and sweet spice flavors in this powerful red. Dense tannins lend support, while the finish echoes earth and tar accents. Best from 2028 through 2042.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose entices with aromas of malted chocolate, orange zest and luxardo cherries, and the palate stays rich with notes of chocolate cake and dried cherries, plus an espresso bean finish. Tannins are sleek but strong.

stiegl-advent-calendar-1.title: JP Chenet Advent Calendar 12 x 200ml
stiegl-advent-calendar-1.bodyHtml: Creatively crafted by JP Chenet, this festive advent calendar features a mix of 12 x 200 mL bottles of sparkling wine, including white and rosé varieties. Discover a different bubbly behind each door for 12 days of holiday bliss. This pack is the perfect seasonal gift for the wine enthusiast in your life.

ezy-whisky.title: Ezra Brooks Old Ezra 7 Year Old Straight Rye Whiskey
ezy-whisky.bodyHtml:
A premium release from Lux Row Distillers, Old Ezra 7 Year Straight Rye Whiskey is aged for a full seven years and bottled at a robust barrel strength of 114 proof. This whiskey is a blend of two distinct rye mash bills (a 95% rye and a 51% rye) to achieve a perfect, complex balance. It delivers a rich, full-bodied experience where bold rye spices are beautifully tempered by mature oak and surprising sweetness.

 

NOSE

Rich brown sugar, dark caramel, vanilla, and sweet cherry, backed by bright orange peel and rye spice.

PALATE

Full-bodied and syrupy sweet with flavors of burnt caramel, cherry candy, and warm baking spices.

FINISH

A long, warming finish with lingering brown sugar, tangs of citrus, and a crack of white pepper.

dubonnet.title: Dubonnet Aperitif 750ml
dubonnet.bodyHtml:
Critic tasting note: "A 150-year old grape based sweet wine infused with other natural fruit and spice components. There's no doubt about the composition here with the black raspberry, orange, licorice, spicy, coffee, dried lychee aromas and flavours. Somewhat sweet, it has good fruit and balance when served over ice or with soda. Apertif diluted or on the rocks after dinner. Very inexpensive considering a little bit goes a long way. (Anthony Gismondi and Stuart Tobe)." - Gismondi on Wine

90 Points - Ultimate Spirits Challenge
"A classic and well-balanced aperitif with nuanced notes of citrus peel, spice, and gentle quinine bitterness. Perfect for sipping or cocktails."


88 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"Offers a pleasant blend of herbal and fruit flavors with a smooth, slightly sweet finish. A timeless and versatile fortified wine."

cavit-collection-pinot-grigio-1.title: Cavit Collection Pinot Grigio
cavit-collection-pinot-grigio-1.bodyHtml:
Cavit Collection Pinot Grigio is a crisp, light, and wonderfully refreshing dry white wine that stands as America's pioneer favorite for the classic Northern Italian style. Sourced from the scenic, sun-drenched hillsides of Trentino, Friuli, and the Veneto regions, the hand-harvested grapes undergo temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation to lock in maximum fruit purity. In the glass, it shows a pale, luminous straw-gold color. The highly expressive, clean nose opens with bright aromas of green apple, crisp Bosc pear, and fresh citrus, layered with delicate undertones of white blossoms and a hint of wild honey. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, lively, and beautifully balanced, showing a seamless fluid coherence where its core of juicy orchard fruit is effortlessly supported by a racy spine of natural acidity, concluding with a clean, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light pasta salads, grilled sea bass, pan-seared chicken breast, or fresh goat cheese.

canalicchio-di-sopra-brunello-riserva.title: Canalicchio Di Sopra Brunello Di Montalcino 2018 375ml
canalicchio-di-sopra-brunello-riserva.bodyHtml:
Canalicchio Di Sopra Brunello Di Montalcino 2018 is an elegant, highly aromatic, and finely structured classic Tuscan red wine crafted by Canalicchio Di Sopra. Blending Sangiovese grapes sourced from the estate's premier holdings in the Montosoli and Canalicchio sub-zones, it is fermented naturally and aged in Slavonian oak casks. In the glass, it delivers refined aromas of wild red cherries, dried rose petals, Mediterranean herbs, tobacco leaf, and subtle crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and wonderfully balanced, displaying a core of bright red fruits, silky yet persistent tannins, vibrant acidity, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops, wild boar ragù, Florentine T-bone steak, braised duck breast, mushroom risotto, and aged Pecorino cheese.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Brunello di Montalcino is elegant and tight with dried cherry, earthy root, pressed violet and exotic spice. The wine's long mandatory aging period has added to its aromatic intensity and textural weight. You also recognize that special complexity that comes with Sangiovese when grown in this sunny appellation on the southern side of Tuscany. This is a solid wine with 36,237 bottles released.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

An intensely savory, umami nose of hot tar, oregano and espresso draws balance from succulent undertones of brown butter and stewed plums. On the palate, blackberries underscore the plum element, but a curl of orange peel and persistent tar and herbs preserve the savory backbone of the wine. Tannins are round and smooth.

92 Points - James Suckling

Perfumed nose of neroli, bergamot, sandalwood, cherry stones and plums. Full-bodied and richly fruity with gently grainy tannins. Drink after 2023.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

This juicy red is highlighted by plum, black cherry, tomato leaf, eucalyptus and mineral flavors. Starts out ripe and balanced, turning drier on the tobacco- and spice-tinged finish. Vibrant and long. Best from 2025 through 2040.

travaglini-gattinara-tre-vigne.title: Travaglini Gattinara Tre Vigne 2018
travaglini-gattinara-tre-vigne.bodyHtml:
A refined and age-worthy Nebbiolo from Gattinara, offering aromas of dried cherry, rose petals, orange peel, tobacco, and earthy mineral notes. Elegant yet structured, the palate delivers vibrant acidity, fine tannins, and layers of red fruit, spice, and savory complexity that linger through a long, graceful finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with braised beef, osso buco, roast lamb, mushroom risotto, truffle dishes, and aged cheeses.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

As its name suggests, this wine is a blend of three specific vineyards within Gattinara. It opens with dried black cherry and balsamic and pine notes, leading to dried red and purple flowers with sweet spices. The generous palate gives warmed red berries framed by firm yet elegantly placed tannins. Mouthwatering acidity lingers on the finish. Drink from 2025–2045.

charles-heidsieck-brut-reserve.title: Charles Heidsieck Brut Reserve 750ml
charles-heidsieck-brut-reserve.bodyHtml:
A deep golden robe. Delicate vivacious and long-lasting bubbles are the result of more than 36 months of ageing in chalk cellars. With 40% of reserve wines (the maximum possible amount), the blend offers a complex, voluptuous nose with notes of freshly baked brioche and the richness of roasted coffee beans. A precise selection of wines, purposely limited to 60 crus, ensures the Charles Heidsieck Brut Reserve a deliciously sophisticated harmony. An opulent selection of ripe, sun-drenched fruits such as mango, apricot, and greengage plum combines with dried fruits, pistachio and almond. The texture is reminiscent of a crisp layer of nougatine on a velvety cream pastry filled with plump red plums and ripe cherries. The reserve wines, some dating back ten years give the wine lushness. The depth of the thousand-year-old chalk quarries where the wine matures offers a touch of praline along with notes of amber and vanilla.

Wine Spectator - 93 Points

This vibrant version shows a range of toasted brioche, baked cherry, crystalized honey, and grated ginger and coconut flavours, remaining light-footed and lively throughout. Beautifully balanced, with a lasting, mouthwatering finish.

lemelson-cuvee-x-pinot-noir.title: Lemelson Pinot Noir Willamette Valley
lemelson-cuvee-x-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
An elegant Oregon Pinot Noir featuring aromas of cherry, raspberry, rose petal, and forest floor. The palate offers layers of red berries, cranberry, spice, and subtle earthiness balanced by silky tannins and vibrant acidity. Refined and expressive, this wine captures classic Willamette Valley character beautifully.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roast salmon, duck breast, mushroom risotto, grilled pork tenderloin, herb-roasted chicken, brie cheese, or truffle pasta dishes.

chocalan-vitrum.title: Vina Chocalan 'Vitrum' Blend 2019 750ml
chocalan-vitrum.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "A blend of varieties planted at the Chocalán property in the coastal Maipo Valley, about 35 kilometers from the Pacific. This is a big red, concentrated in the ripeness of its flavors, the black and candied fruits, and the mouth-filling sensation of voluptuousness. One for lamb, this is 46% cabernet sauvignon, 25% cabernet franc, 13% malbec, 8% syrah, and another 8% carmenere with petit verdot, all from their Chocalán's own vineyards in the Maipo Costa." - 90/100, Patricio Tapia - Descorchados

glenallachie-8-year-old.title: The GlenAllachie 8 Year Old
glenallachie-8-year-old.bodyHtml:
We are proud to present the latest expression to join our award-winning core range, The GlenAllachie 8-year-old. Guided by his half-century of experience, Master Distiller Billy Walker has implemented a philosophy of wood innovation and sourced the world’s finest casks to elevate the spirit to its optimum, delivering a truly exceptional single malt.

Created from a combination of Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry puncheons along with a small quantity of Virgin Oak casks and red wine barriques, the resulting bronze spirit delivers sherry-matured sophistication.

The GlenAllachie 8 Year Old is bottled at 46%, non chill filtered and natural colour for maximum flavour experience.

yukon-single-malt-two-brewers-release-36.title: Two Brewers Yukon Single Malt Release 36
yukon-single-malt-two-brewers-release-36.bodyHtml: The fragrant bronzed dram attracts, scents of apricot and golden raisins, toasty fruit jam. The swallow starts clean and gently sweet, dry malt tones opening across the palate, shrouded by mounting oak and sherry. A classic Two Brewers finish with fleeting Moscatel.

laws-four-grain-bourbon.title: Penelope Four Grain Bourbon
laws-four-grain-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Penelope Four Grain Bourbon is an exceptionally smooth, well-rounded, and highly approachable straight bourbon whiskey that serves as the flagship expression of Penelope Bourbon. Uniquely blended from three distinct bourbon mash bills comprising four grains (corn, rye, wheat, and malted barley), this signature whiskey is skillfully master-blended to highlight sweet, delicate flavor notes. Sourced from MGP in Lawrenceburg, Indiana, and aged in new charred American oak barrels, it deliberately leans into a lighter, softer grain profile that makes it highly versatile, appealing equally to new whiskey enthusiasts and seasoned bourbon drinkers alike.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with glazed pork belly bites, smoked gouda, light fruit tarts, sweet pecan praline, or a savory charcuterie board featuring mild cured meats.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, clear honey-amber color with a light-to-medium body and a remarkably smooth, soft, and approachable mouthfeel.

NOSE - Sweet and highly inviting, opening with forward aromas of balanced corn sweetness, vanilla bean, and rich caramel, complemented by a delicate hint of fresh fruit and light oak wood.

PALATE - Light and fruit-forward on the tongue, delivering dominant flavors of sweet creamed corn, maple syrup, and vanilla fudge, seamlessly transitioning into gentle notes of baking spices, sweet rye, and marshmallow.

FINISH - Medium in duration, clean, and pleasantly subtle, leaving a sweet trailing hint of vanilla cream, soft wood spice, and a gentle, warming touch of brown sugar.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat or on the rocks in a standard rocks glass, or used as a clean, accommodating base for classic bourbon cocktails like a Paper Plane or an Old Fashioned.

laws-rye-whiskey.title: Laws San Luis Valley Straight Rye
laws-rye-whiskey.bodyHtml:
A beautifully unapologetic, terroir-driven craft whiskey from Colorado's celebrated Laws Whiskey House! This flagship expression is crafted from a mash bill of 95% heirloom San Luis Valley rye and 5% heirloom barley (with some batches utilizing 100% rye). Sourced exclusively from the Cody family farm at 7,500 feet above sea level, this semi-wild, low-yield grain imparts a distinctly floral and mineral-rich flavor profile that is completely unique to the region. Aged for a minimum of three years in heavily charred American white oak and bottled at an approachable 95 proof (47.5% ABV), it delivers a wonderfully fragrant, brilliantly balanced, and distinctly Colorado sipping experience.

 

NOSE

Bright, floral, and deeply perfumed. Highly inviting aromas of sweet grass, fresh mint, orange blossom, wild honey, and a lively dash of baking spice.

PALATE

Smooth, complex, and beautifully balanced. Lush flavors of salted toffee, stewed fig, and sweet black tea are perfectly countered by a crisp, refreshing wave of sweet mint and orange peel.

FINISH

Medium-long, crisp, and exceptionally satisfying, leaving a lingering, radiant trail of green peppercorn spice and a whisper of dry tobacco.

laws-bottled-in-bond-four-grain-bourbon.title: Old Grand-Dad 7 Year Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
laws-bottled-in-bond-four-grain-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Old Grand Dad 7 Year Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon is a highly anticipated, limited annual release that elevates the beloved high-rye Kentucky straight bourbon with a 7-year age statement. Produced by the James B. Beam Distilling Co. and adhering to the strict requirements of the 1897 Bottled-in-Bond Act, this expression takes the brand's signature spicy, nutty character and softens the edges through extended oak maturation, resulting in a more robust, deeply rounded, and complex profile than its standard non-age-stated counterpart.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, pulled pork sandwiches, aged cheddar cheese, pecan pie, or caramel popcorn.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper to dark amber in appearance with a smooth, slightly creamy, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Classic high-rye bourbon aromatics featuring sweet caramel, toasted oak, and vanilla, accented by peanut brittle, citrus peel, saltwater taffy, and a hint of mint.

Palate : Rich and warming, opening with brown sugar and vanilla, followed closely by a robust wave of cinnamon, baking spices, nutty undertones, and a touch of sweet cedar wood and orange zest.

Finish : Long, balanced, and pleasantly warming, leaving lingering notes of baking spice, sweet oak, caramel apple, and a signature rye pepper heat.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate the age and proof, or poured over a large ice cube in a rocks glass.

laws-bottled-in-bond-rye.title: Rittenhouse Straight Rye Bottled-in-Bond
laws-bottled-in-bond-rye.bodyHtml:
An absolute legend in the whiskey world and a permanent staple in almost every high-end cocktail bar on the planet! Produced by Heaven Hill, Rittenhouse is a historic Pennsylvania-style rye whiskey crafted to the strict standards of the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. Aged for at least four years and bottled at exactly 100 proof, it delivers a spectacular, punchy, and intensely spicy profile that cuts perfectly through sweet vermouth or simple syrup, making it the undisputed king of the classic Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

NOSE

Classic and inviting with prominent aromas of dry rye grass, black pepper, sweet vanilla, and toasted oak.

PALATE

Bold, spicy, and robust. A bright punch of peppery rye and cinnamon is beautifully softened by warm caramel, dark chocolate, and subtle fruit.

FINISH

Crisp, exceptionally clean, and long-lasting with a satisfying, dry spicy warmth.

pertimali-rosso-di-montalcino.title: Sassetti Livio Pertimali Rosso di Montalcino 2019
pertimali-rosso-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
The 2019 Sassetti Livio Pertimali Rosso di Montalcino is an exceptional, serious, and deeply refined Italian red wine that functions beautifully as a "baby Brunello." Sourced from the family's iconic hillside vineyards on the northern slope of Montalcino's famed Montosoli hill, it pours a deep ruby red color with subtle purple hues in the glass. The nose lifts with a vibrant, highly expressive bouquet of rosy florals, ripe black plum, and crushed stone, layered over undertones of fresh dark earth and animal musk. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied wine is dense and fruit-forward, delivering nearly velvety intensities of black raspberry preserves, cassis, and wild berries. Fermented and matured for 12 months entirely in stainless steel tanks followed by a year of bottle refinement to preserve absolute purity, it is driven by a line of thirst-quenching, balanced acidity and structured by plush, even tannins that carry into an incredibly long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, roasted pork loin, wild mushroom risotto, rich tomato-based pasta dishes, steak florentine, and aged Italian cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

burrowing-owl-sauvignon-blanc.title: Burrowing Owl Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
burrowing-owl-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Burrowing Owl Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a powerful, full-bodied, and tightly structured red wine crafted by Burrowing Owl Estate Winery from its estate vineyards in the South Okanagan Valley. Sourced from the warm Oliver and Osoyoos benches, it undergoes temperature-controlled fermentation before aging in a combination of oak barrels to develop depth and complexity. In the glass, it displays a deep garnet-ruby color. The nose opens with intense aromas of cassis, black cherry, and wild blackberry layered with hints of graphite, sage, tobacco, cacao, and toasted cedar wood. On the palate, it exhibits strong concentration, delivering rich black fruit and dark chocolate flavors framed by firm, drying tannins, crisp natural acidity, and a long, warm, savory finish with notes of espresso and iron.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye, roasted leg of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild game stews, and aged cheddar cheese.

zenato-recioto-valpolicella-classico-doc.title: Zenato Recioto Della Valpolicella Classico 2020 500ml
zenato-recioto-valpolicella-classico-doc.bodyHtml:
The term Recioto comes from the Veronese dialectal word recia meaning ear. The name is used to denote the small side bunches that “crown” the larger clusters. According to local tradition, their fruit is considered to be the best.

The 2020 Zenato Recioto della Valpolicella Classico is a luxurious and seductive dessert wine, crafted using the traditional appassimento method where grapes are dried for several months to concentrate sugars and flavours. It presents an intense ruby red colour with deep violet reflections. The bouquet is extraordinarily rich and complex, bursting with aromas of marasca cherry jam, wild blackberries, and dried plums, elegantly interwoven with notes of dark chocolate, tobacco, and sweet balsamic spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied, dense, and velvety, offering a perfect harmony between its opulent sweetness and a refined tannic structure. A balanced acidity ensures the wine remains fresh and lively, leading to a monumental and persistent finish marked by lingering notes of cocoa and spiced red fruit.

il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-riser.title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Vigna Paganelli 2018 3L Double Magnum
il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-riser.bodyHtml: Intense ruby-red color. Layers of red fruit, savory spices and leather notes. The tannins are silky, and the fruit comes back in multiple layers. Its long finish confirms that this wine is ready to drink now but can be enjoyed for 20 years or more.

il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-1.title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020
il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-1.bodyHtml:
Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020 is an exceptional, classic expression of Sangiovese produced from hand-picked grapes grown on the oldest vines at Tenuta Il Poggione in southern Montalcino. Aged for three years in traditional large Slavonian oak casks (botti) followed by extended bottle maturation, it exhibits an alluring, complex bouquet of dark cherry, tart blackberry, and wild plum, seamlessly interwoven with nuances of licorice root, cloves, coffee, fresh mint, and fragrant dried rose petals. On the palate, the wine delivers a harmonious balance of power and grace, combining dense, velvety red and black fruit flavors with polished, grippy tannins, a refreshing vein of acidity, and savory hints of iron-rich earth, tobacco, and subtle mocha that carry through to a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted red meats, grilled bistecca, wild game, braised beef short ribs, ossobuco, rich mushroom dishes, and mature hard cheeses.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is both perfumed and spicy, with aromas of cloves, coffee, vanilla bean and black cherry. Flavors of tart blackberry, bergamot and flaky salt define the palate, before a touch of mocha creeps onto the finish. Tannins are polished, but grippy.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained mix of licorice and graphite, bright red cherries and toasted notes. Firm tannins on the medium- to full-bodied palate with refreshing acidity. Chewy style overall. Try in 2025, but best after 2026.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Showing very nice results, with greater accessibility in this vintage, the Il Poggione 2020 Brunello di Montalcino has dark fruit aromas with blackcurrant followed by something spicy or herbal. I am reminded of licorice root, exotic spice, pressed rose and fragrant tea leaf. It finishes smoothly with silky tannins and an open-knit approach. This vintage is almost ready to drink, and you get elegant complexity at the same time. It sees three years in oak botti. Fruit is sourced across vineyards with 25-year-old-plus vines. This is an ample production of 200,000 bottles.

94 Points - Wine Spectator 

This red is rich and dense, woven with flavors of cherry, blackberry, plum, black pepper, earth, iron and tobacco. Combines power and grace, with fine balance. The finish echoes the fruit and spice notes. Best from 2028 through 2045.

macnairs-lum-reek-12-yo-blended-scotch.title: MacNairs Lum Reek 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 3 Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
macnairs-lum-reek-12-yo-blended-scotch.bodyHtml:
MacNair’s Lum Reek 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 3 is a limited-edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky created under the direction of Master Blender Billy Walker. It combines selected Speyside and Islay single malts, including aged GlenAllachie, balancing rich fruit with gentle peat smoke. After blending, the whisky undergoes further maturation in a combination of Spanish sherry casks, wine barriques and virgin oak casks. Batch 3 is bottled at its natural cask strength of 58.7% ABV, with natural colour and without chill filtration. 

Food Pairing: Pair with smoked or barbecued meats, mature cheddar, dark chocolate, roasted nuts, sticky toffee pudding or orange-infused desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich, smoky and full-bodied, combining dark sweetness, warming spice, roasted flavours and layers of peat smoke.

Nose: Toffee brittle, chocolate-covered raisins and caramelised brown sugar, complemented by grated ginger, cigar box and toasted cinnamon.

Palate: Intense coffee, ginger and mocha with cinnamon and grilled honeycomb, developing into smoked spices, butterscotch and orange peel.

Finish: Long, warming and smoky, with lingering dark sweetness, spice, roasted coffee and citrus.

Serve: Best enjoyed neat or with a few drops of water to explore the full character of its 58.7% cask-strength profile.

omc-ben-nevis.title: Old Malt Cask Ben Nevis 1996 24 Year Old 50% ABV
omc-ben-nevis.bodyHtml:
Old Malt Cask Ben Nevis 24 Year Old is a single cask Highland single malt Scotch whisky from Ben Nevis Distillery, bottled by Hunter Laing & Co. in The Old Malt Cask series at 50% ABV in a 700ml bottle. It was distilled in 1996 and spent 24 years in a single refill sherry butt, cask 18761, before bottling in June 2021 with an outturn of 296 bottles. In keeping with the series, the label states single cask, no chill filtration and no colouring. Ben Nevis is known for a robust, characterful spirit, and long ageing in a refill cask lets that distillery character show alongside toffee, fruit and gentle oak.

Tasting Notes: Toffee, red and orchard fruit, liquorice and peppery oak.

Nose: Toffee, strawberries and vanilla.

Palate: Sweet, with liquorice, apples and caramel.

Finish: Long, with lingering pepper and oak.

Serve: Serve neat, with a few drops of water if desired.

glenallachie-21-yo-single-malt-scotch.title: The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old
glenallachie-21-yo-single-malt-scotch.bodyHtml:
The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a rich, robust, and masterfully crafted flagship expression that showcases the independent distillery's commitment to bold flavor and exceptional wood management. Reconstructed under the guidance of legendary master blender Billy Walker, this single malt is matured for at least twelve years in a premium combination of Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheons, Oloroso sherry hogsheads, and virgin oak casks. It pours a 100% natural, deep mahogany-bronze hue in the glass, immediately releasing an intense, expressive bouquet of heather honey, dark chocolate, and cinnamon, elegantly layered with complex undertones of sticky raisins, mocha, and candied orange peel. On the palate, the whisky is full-bodied, smooth, and incredibly rich, delivering a luscious wave of sweet honey, dark plums, and marzipan alongside warm notes of grated ginger, espresso bean, and toasted oak spice. Balanced by a refined, satisfying spirit presence, it glides into a long, warming finish that leaves a dry, lingering impression of dark chocolate, sweet baking spices, and caramelized brown sugar.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with rich dishes and artisanal treats, including slow-braised beef short ribs with a dark ale reduction, pan-seared duck breast with cherry sauce, smoked venison, sticky toffee pudding, dark chocolate hazelnut truffles, or mature blue cheeses like Stilton.

il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-riser.title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Vigna Paganelli 2019
il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-riser.bodyHtml:
Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Vigna Paganelli 2019 is an aristocratic, remarkably structured, and deeply expressive Tuscan red wine produced only in exceptional vintages by Tenuta Il Poggione. Sourced exclusively from the estate’s historic 12-hectare single vineyard “I Paganelli,” originally planted in 1964 and perched on the southern slopes of Sant'Angelo in Colle, this wine represents the pinnacle of traditional Montalcino winemaking. Following a temperature-controlled submerged-cap fermentation on the skins lasting about 20 days, it matured for an extensive 48 months in large French oak botti before completing additional refinement in bottle prior to release. In the glass, it reveals a luminous, deep ruby core with garnet undertones. The bouquet is complex, balsamic, and multi-layered, offering perfumed aromas of ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and dark plums, seamlessly intertwined with crushed dried roses, cured tobacco, incense, exotic spices, sweet cedar, leather, and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it exhibits profound depth and full-bodied grandeur, propelled by a core of energetic natural acidity and refined, chalky tannins that provide remarkable grip and elegance, culminating in an extraordinarily long, savory, and mineral-edged finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled Florentine steak, roasted venison loin, wild boar ragù with pappardelle, braised beef shank, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A mix of fruity and savory, this red offers a distinctive ray of graphite, along with cherry, strawberry, juniper, tomato leaf, earth and sanguine flavors. There's good grip on the finish, but the tannins are softer and broader, more chalky than piercing. Shows fine balance and length, needing a little more time to knit together. Best from 2028 through 2046. 3,300 cases made, 1,500 cases imported.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Il Poggione 2019 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Vigna Paganelli (with 40,000 bottles produced) sees a prolonged 48 months in oak botti with an additional 12 months in bottle. Fruit comes exclusively from a 12-hectare vineyard that was originally planted in 1964. We haven't seen this Riserva since the 2016 vintage. It starts off with broad richness, and the bouquet fires on all cylinders. It shows tart blackberry and plum with cured tobacco leaf and sweet baking spice. You feel a rich buildup on the palate from what is a naturally concentrated vintage. I have adjusted the drinking window to be a bit shorter compared to past vintages.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose opens savory with leather and tar, then sweet with bing and black cherries, currants, and figs that ripen and mature on the palate, anchored in more savory, sanguine notes of herbs and earth that carry a lingering finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

This has a concentrated nose of blackberries, licorice and notes of espresso. The palate is medium- to full-bodied with supple tannins and red-fruit flavors complemented by cedar. Elegant Brunello. Drink or hold.

elijah-craig-toasted-barrel.title: Elijah Craig Toasted Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon
elijah-craig-toasted-barrel.bodyHtml:
A sweetly perfumed nose, with fruity aromas of date and raisin, alongside notes of caramel, charred oak and vanilla. The mouthfeel is velvety and luxurious, revealing butterscotch, black treacle and dark honey. Rich, indulgent and extremely long. Exquisite!

The award-winning Bourbon that started it all. Our signature Small Batch owes its distinctive warm spice & subtle smoke flavor to Level 3 charred oak barrels. Handcrafted by our Master Distillers, it’s a favorite of Bourbon connoisseurs and casual whiskey fans alike.

95 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2023

perrier-jouet-belle-ep-blanc-de-blancs.title: Perrier-Jouet Belle Epoque Blanc de Blancs 2014
perrier-jouet-belle-ep-blanc-de-blancs.bodyHtml:
Perrier Jouet Belle Epoque Blanc de Blancs 2014 is the ultra-prestige, crown jewel of the Maison’s collection, representing the ultimate, rarest expression of 100% Grand Cru Chardonnay. Sourced from just two legendary, historic vineyard plots in Cramant, this exceptional Champagne pours a pale, luminous gold with delicate green highlights and an extraordinarily fine mousse. The nose is a masterclass in elegance, unveiling aromas of white wild flowers, acacia blossom, and citrus zest layered with complex hints of brioche, white chocolate, and fresh ginger. On the palate, a remarkably silk-like, satiny texture meets a precise, driving chalky minerality. Vibrant tension and pristine flavors of lemon curd, yellow peach, and poached pear melt into a long, majestic finish marked by a subtle touch of white pepper.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters on the half shell, caviar, king crab legs with drawn butter, seared sea scallops, pan-roasted turbot, or a delicate lobster risotto.

96 Points - James Suckling

Intense chalky-mineral drive with a lot of leesy, buttery aromas, together with brioche, yogurt and white chocolate. The attack is crisp yet with delicate integration, light to medium body, fine mousse and a long, long finish of lemon curd. Drink now.

kujira-31-year-old-japanese-whisky.title: Kujira Ryukyu 31 Year Old Japanese Whisky
kujira-31-year-old-japanese-whisky.bodyHtml:
The Kujira 31 Years Old Ryukyu Whisky is the embodiment of Masahiro Distillery’s exceptional craftsmanship in the past 140 years. Handpicked by the Master Blender, Mr. Arakaki Sunao, this exquisite single grain whisky is distilled from 100% premium rice and matured more than three decades in ex-Sherry, Bourbon and White Oak Casks before finishing in first-fill Oloroso casks.

Surrounded by sea and mountains, Masahiro Shuzo locates in Okinawa, situated at blessed subtropical climate that brings subtle fruity and floral flavors and robust body to the whisky during maturation process. Highly complex and beautifully balanced, this whisky exhibits delicate sweet elements of caramel, dried fruits and oriental botanicals. Each bottle of the Kujira 31 Years Old Ryukyu Whisky is individually numbered and labeled in handmade Japanese paper. With only 999 bottles released globally, this is the apex of Ryukyu Whisky and the jewel in the crown, for now or never.

knob-creek-18-year-old-bourbon.title: Knob Creek 9 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
knob-creek-18-year-old-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Knob Creek 9 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a highly respected, pre-Prohibition style whiskey that serves as a cornerstone of the Jim Beam Small Batch Collection. Patiently aged for a full nine years in heavily charred new American white oak barrels, this bourbon delivers a robust, full-bodied, and deeply satisfying profile. Bottled at a hearty 100 proof, it perfectly balances the deep, rich flavors of dark oak and aged caramel with the classic sweetness of a traditional Kentucky straight bourbon.

Food Pairing: This bold, higher-proof bourbon pairs magnificently with rich, savory dishes like smoked beef brisket, charred ribeye steak, or sticky BBQ pork ribs. It is also an excellent companion to sharp, aged cheddar cheese, toasted pecans, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : A deep, rich amber-copper hue. The texture is full-bodied, warming, and pleasantly viscous on the palate.

Nose : Robust and inviting. Sweet aromas of toasted nuts, maple sugar, and rich vanilla bean are deeply intertwined with expressive notes of dark, seasoned oak and a hint of leather.

Palate : Big, rich, and naturally sweet. A luscious wave of rich caramel, brown sugar, and dark fruit quickly gives way to a complex, earthy core of heavily toasted oak, baking spices, and a pleasant rye pepperiness.

Finish : Long, rich, and glowing. It leaves a deeply warming trail of sweet vanilla, lingering oak, and a satisfying peppery spice.

Serve : Exceptional neat or poured over a large ice cube to soften the proof and open up the sweet aromatics. Its robust proof and deep flavor also make it the perfect foundation for a classic Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

macnairs-lum-reek-10-yo-cask-strength.title: MacNair's Lum Reek 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 1
macnairs-lum-reek-10-yo-cask-strength.bodyHtml:
MacNair’s Lum Reek Cask Strength Batch 1 is an excellent 10-year-old Scotch blended malt whiskey from the first batch. It is a stunning blend of the best Speyside and Islay single malt whiskies, including aged GlenAllachie. This combination resulted in a fine peat mixture, which is rich but above all perfectly balanced.

But that’s not all. The mixture still awaits 10 years of aging in different types of barrels. The first maturation takes place in premium ex-sherry Spanish casks. It is then filled into ex-wine barrique barrels and finally into virgin oak barrels in the cellars of the GlenAllachie distillery. Thanks to these barrels, the whiskey acquired an unmistakable taste of wood along with sweet but slightly smoky notes.

The matured whiskey is then bottled with a natural 55.4 % alcohol content. It is without added dyes and cold filtration . The bottle is housed in a red-gold gift tube.

Color: Amber With Red Highlights
Aroma: Earthy, Raisin, Red Fruit, Smoke, Oak, Brandy, Vanilla

Taste: Slightly Sweet, Chocolate, Cinnamon, Caramel, Nuts, Wood, Smoke

Finish: Long, Slightly Spicy, Caramel, Bananas, Smoke , Ginger, Citrus

tamnavulin-1979-scotch-whisky.title: Tamnavulin 1979 39 Year Old Vintages Collection Single Malt Scotch Whisky
tamnavulin-1979-scotch-whisky.bodyHtml:
This last batch of whisky from the 1970s was laid down in a combination of first fill Sherry butts and Bourbon barrels. Non-Chill Filtered.

Tasting Notes

Maturation
Initially matured in Bourbon barrels then transferred to 30 Years Old Matusalem Oloroso Sherry butts before being returned to First Fill Bourbon barrels for a final maturation period to conclude the 39 year maturation.
Colour
Amber gold.
Nose
Mediterranean oranges, figs, almonds and freshly baked ginger cake.
Palate
Tropical pineapple, roasted coffee and decadent Black Forest fruits.

glenallachie-10-yo-cask-strength-batch-7.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 7 56.8% ABV
glenallachie-10-yo-cask-strength-batch-7.bodyHtml: The GlenAllachie Cask Strength Batch 7 is a combination of Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry puncheons along with a small quantity of Virgin Oak and Rioja casks. The resulting whisky bursts with indulgent notes of of ripe plums, dark chocolate and sticky raisins, all coupled with classic GlenAllachie honeyed charm. Batch 7 is bottled at 56.8%, non chill filtered and natural colour.

ao-yun-2018.title: Ao Yun 2018
ao-yun-2018.bodyHtml:
Ao Yun 2018 is a historic, groundbreaking luxury red blend that marks a massive milestone for Chinese viticulture, representing the first vintage of Ao Yun distributed globally through the prestigious La Place de Bordeaux. Owned by luxury conglomerate LVMH, the estate is located at the foothills of the Himalayas in Yunnan, where vines are split across four distinct mountain villages (Xidang, Sinong, Shuori, and Adong) at staggering high-altitudes ranging from 2,200 to 2,600 meters.

The 2021-bottled 2018 vintage benefited from a cooler, highly balanced growing season. It signals an increased confidence in the estate’s secondary varieties, featuring a higher percentage of Cabernet Franc and Merlot to flesh out the mid-palate. Meticulously crafted using an innovative two-phase aging process—spending its first 5 months in traditional Chinese earthenware pots before transitioning to French oak barrels (30% new) for 10 months—the wine shows a very deep, opaque purple color. The nose is spectacularly lifted and perfumed, bursting with super-ripe cassis, crushed blackberries, and dark plums, beautifully complexed by cool-climate herbaceous notes of mint leaf, sage, incense, and cocoa powder. On the palate, it is full-bodied, dense, and vertical, delivering immense structural authority ($14.5\%$ to $15\%$ ABV) that draws comparisons to top-tier Napa and Mendoza blends. A core of dark savory fruit is supported by a millefeuille-like layering of abundant, fine-grained coating tannins and an exceptionally vibrant line of high-altitude acidity, carrying into a remarkably long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, slow-braised venison loin, or Peking duck.

98 Points - James Suckling

I love the depth and complexity of the nose, which brings you down deeply into the wine, showing blackberry, ink, tar, earth, incense, cloves, and black licorice. Thyme, too. The purity of the fruit, including cassis, is the real thing. This is full-bodied, but remains so fresh and vertical on the palate. The tannins are so fine and integrated, producing a millefeuille-like layering of tannin and cool, blue fruit. Incredible wine. The greatest wine made in China so far. 60% cabernet sauvignon, 19% cabernet franc, 10% merlot, 7% syrah and 4% petit verdot. 26,000 bottles made. Drinkable now, but will be so much better in four or five years.

aile-dargent-2019.title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild Aile d'Argent Blanc 2019
aile-dargent-2019.bodyHtml:
The color is light yellow with bright reflections. The nose, very complex and elegant, exudes aromas of ripe fruits to which are added notes of acacia flower. Good grip in the mouth, frank and clear, marked by peach and apricot scents. The middle of the mouth reveals a harmonious balance between acidity and a silky texture. The finish is mineral and very long.

98 Points - James Suckling

A very exotic Aile d’Argent with dried-mango, fresh-pineapple, and sliced-lemon aromas and flavors. Full-bodied and very ripe, yet it’s framed by bright acidity. Tangy and vivid with a long, intense finish. Exciting. Contrastive. 38% semillon and the rest sauvignon blanc and gris.

laphroaig-cairdeas-2022-52-2.title: Laphroaig Càirdeas 2022 Warehouse 1
laphroaig-cairdeas-2022-52-2.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Càirdeas 2022 Warehouse 1 is the 2022 edition of Càirdeas, the limited release Laphroaig creates each year for the Friends of Laphroaig. It was aged in first-fill Maker's Mark bourbon barrels in Warehouse 1, the distillery's oldest warehouse, which stands on the Islay shoreline with the Laphroaig name painted across it. The four-storey building's fluctuating temperatures and exposure to sea spray and storms give the whisky an extra maritime edge. It is bottled at a fixed strength of 52.2% ABV in a 700ml bottle: pale gold, peaty and sweet, with medicinal notes and a floral aftertaste.

Nose: Peaty, sweet and nutty with medicinal notes, vanilla cake, fudge, heather honey, golden syrup, walnut and nutmeg.

Palate: Powerful peat reek and ashy tar with sweet manuka honey and burnt toffee.

Finish: Peaty and acidic, with lingering herbal and spicy notes and a floral aftertaste.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

chateau-brane-cantenac-margaux-aoc-2018.title: Chateau Brane Cantenac 2023
chateau-brane-cantenac-margaux-aoc-2018.bodyHtml:
Château Brane-Cantenac 2023 is a remarkably sophisticated and elegant French red wine hailing from the Margaux appellation. Visually displaying a deep dark cherry color with bright ruby highlights, it opens with a highly complex and perfumed bouquet featuring wild blackberries, ripe cassis, dark cherry, and orange peel, seamlessly layered with dried herbs, crushed stone minerals, espresso, and delicate floral nuances of violet and rose petals. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body with svelte, velvety tannins and a vibrant, driving core of energetic acidity. Elegant, refined, and precise, it delivers layered red and black fruit flavors interwoven with graphite, cigar box spice, and cacao, culminating in a long, harmonious, and finely structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with roasted rack of lamb, pan-seared duck breast, prime ribeye steak, braised veal shanks, wild mushroom risotto, and aged hard cheeses.

97 Points - James Suckling

This is really structured, with intense tannins that run the length of the wine and give it verve and vibe. Medium-bodied with lovely berry, light vanilla and currant flavors. The tannins are exceptional. This is a very structured Margaux that needs three or four years to come around. Best after 2028.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Brane-Cantenac is a blend of 77% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Merlot (which saw some saignée), 1% Cabernet Franc, 1% Carmenère and 1% Petit Verdot, and it completed its malolactic fermentation in barrels as has been the rule at this estate since the 1990s. Offering up aromas of dark cherries, cassis and spices framed by creamy new oak, it's medium to full-bodied, rich and fleshy, with a creamy core of fruit and a long, gently lactic finish.

chateau-cantenac-brown-margaux-aoc-2018.title: Chateau Cantenac Brown Margaux (Grand Cru Classe) 2018 750ml

chateau-lagrange-st-julien-aoc-2019.title: Chateau Lagrange 2019 750ml
chateau-lagrange-st-julien-aoc-2019.bodyHtml:
The character of our unique terroir and our technical team’s expertise have allowed this vintage to surpass itself. It boasts both phenolic richness and freshness in the fruit. This is a powerful, creamy, smooth wine. With a record 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, the Lagrange 2019 blend will go down in history. The expressive, aromatic nose opens with black cherry, blackcurrant and licorice. In the palate, the entry is silky and plump with powerful, velvety tannins. This distinguished and elegant 2019 will take its place among our iconic vintages. The ageing potential is simply remarkable!

Blend: 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 18% Merlot, 2% Petit Verdot

The Barrel Sample for this wine is under 14% ABV.

95 Points Jeb Dunnuck

While I don't think the 2019 Château Lagrange matches the 2018, it's not far off, with a more elegant yet still concentrated style. Beautiful crème de cassis, spicy oak, tobacco, chocolate, and new saddle leather notes all emerge on the nose, and it stays tight, compact, and focused on the palate, with plenty of firm tannins. It opens up beautifully with time in the glass but merits 4-6 years of bottle age, and it should evolve for 20-25 years or more. Best after 2026.

95 Points Decanter

Dark plum in colour, medium intensity, this is sleek, well-defined and has an extremely pure expression of cassis fruit. Just enormously elegant, with tons of St Julien balance, and fine tannins that are sure to take it through the next few decades with ease. I love this wine, one of the most enjoyable of the vintage in St Julien, with a strikingly seductive texture. Tasted twice two weeks apart, sure to become a standout with some bottle age. When you look at the figures (which I only did after tasting) you start to understand why this is so good - highest level of Cabernet in the estate's recent history, longest harvest ever through to October 14, and only 1/3 of overall production in the 1st wine, lowest amount to date. Whatever they are doing, they are getting it right.

95 Points Wine Enthusiast

This full-bodied wine is open in style, with lashings of rich black fruits alongside dense tannins. This is a wine for some long-term aging.
Barrel Sample: 93-95

95 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate 

The 2019 Lagrange has turned out beautifully in bottle, wafting from the glass with aromas of cherries, blackberries and cassis mingled with hints of loamy soil, pencil shavings and bay leaf. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and enveloping, with an ample core of lively fruit, powdery tannins and succulent acids, it's suave and seamless, concluding with a long, expansive finish. The result of an extremely rigorous selection, and incorporating fully 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, this is the finest wine this château has produced in the modern era. Remarkably, it was released at the same price en primeur as the 2005! Best After 2025

94 Points James Suckling

A red with dark fruit and plenty of dark chocolate, as well as spice undertones. Full body. Juicy finish. Extremely balanced and refined.
Barrel Sample: 93-94

93 Points Wine Spectator

Juicy and flush, with steeped red and black currant and plum fruit flavors, this has a generous edge from start to finish. Features notes of tobacco, singed cedar, warm earth and iron throughout, with a seductive hint of incense curling around the tail end of the finish. This has a generosity that makes it approachable, but there's no rush at all to drink this one. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Petit Verdot. Best from 2023

chateau-lynch-bages-pauillac-aoc-2017.title: Chateau Haut-Bages Liberal 2017
chateau-lynch-bages-pauillac-aoc-2017.bodyHtml:
A refined Pauillac with expressive aromas of cassis, blackberry, graphite, cedar, tobacco, and violet. Elegant yet concentrated, it delivers silky tannins, vibrant freshness, exceptional balance, and remarkable depth with excellent long-term aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, aged Comté, or wild mushroom risotto.

chateau-smith-haut-lafitte-rouge-2019.title: Chateau Smith Haut-Lafitte Pessac-Leognan (Grand Cru Classe De Graves) 2019 750ml

chateau-rauzan-segla-2019.title: Chateau Rauzan-Segla 2019
chateau-rauzan-segla-2019.bodyHtml:
The 2019 vintage is alluring because of its discreet elegance. It is as if the winemaker sensed the appeal of revealing its photo in black and white while leaving a tantalizing graininess. It emits an aura of mystery, a veil of modesty that creates a gentle and cocooning atmosphere that accounts for its charm. The fruit seems to develop smoothly on the palate before reaching an uplifting finale. It has a lot of class. Vibrancy, too. Aromas of morello cherry, iris and rosemary. The fresh fig confers an aromatic hint that seems to last for ever and it has the texture of all great Margaux wines, between power and sophistication. A great Rauzan.

96 Points - James Suckling

Subtle and complex aromas of sweet berries, rose stems and lavender with some sandalwood. Medium-to full-bodied with beautiful depth of fruit, creamy tannins and lots of chocolate and berry character. Yet, it’s tight at the end, showing beautiful depth and length. So structured. Try after 2027.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

 

The 2019 Rauzan-Ségla has turned out brilliantly, unwinding in the glass with fragrant aromas of cassis, blackberries, violets, rose petals and sweet soil tones. Medium to full-bodied, seamless and concentrated, it's deep and layered, with beautifully refined tannins, lively acids and a long, perfumed finish. This is a sensual, elegant Rauzan-Ségla from Nicolas Audebert and his team. Best After 2029.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers a very elegant core of red and black currant and damson plum fruit that glides through with silky structure for support, while light mulling spice and incense notes infuse the finish. A rather understated style, but sneaky long and very refined. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc.

chateau-montrose-2019.title: Chateau Montrose 2020 750ml
chateau-montrose-2019.bodyHtml:
The result of rigorous selection at each stage of production, in both the vineyard and the winery, this great, predominantly Cabernet Sauvignon wine is typical of the Saint-Estèphe appellation. Structured and tannic but with all the elegance and refinement of a Grand Cru Classé, with time it develops a delicate and complex bouquet.

Blend: 71% Cabernet Sauvignon, 23% Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc, 1% Petit Verdot

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Surpassing the 2019 and rivaling the 2016 as this estate's finest vintage of the last few decades, the 2020 Montrose is a monument in the making. Wafting from the glass with aromas of violets, dark berries, licorice, loamy soil, black truffle and subtle spices, it's full-bodied, deep and layered, with a seamless, elegantly muscular profile, terrific purity and energy, beautifully powdery tannins and a long, resonant finish. It checks in at 13.7% alcohol, the same as the superb 2009, but it is even deeper, more vibrant and more complex than the 2009.

99 Points - James Suckling
The nose is really fantastic with lead pencil shavings, iron shavings, blackcurrants and lavender. Full- to medium-bodied with ultra-fine tannins that run the length of the wine. Wonderful persistence and personality. Juicy and savory finish. Always classy and sophisticated at the end.

98 Points - Decanter
Scented and perfumed on the nose with a delicate charm. Striking, full, round, juicy and crisp - this has bite and a sense of strictness in the frame that keeps things relatively narrow at this point but comes with excellent definition of elements. Great classicism with lots of freshness. Really very seductive, the black and blue fruit, graphite and touch of smoke grow and expand with richness and intensity but staying friendly at the same time thanks to the soft sweetness and juicy acidity. I just love the interplay between being serious and generous, structured but racy, intense yet precise. Such purity, and focus. Energetic and pent up, this is raring to go to show off its beauty but just being held back. Effortless, complex and compelling. I loved it a tiny bit less than the 2019 but it’s still one of the best in 2020.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The Grand Vin 2020 Chateau Montrose is brilliant and unquestionably in the lineup of the truly greats from this chateau, including the 1989, 1990, 2009, 2010, 2015, 2018, and 2019. With an IPT of 80 and a natural alcohol of 13.4%, its deep, saturated purple hue is followed by quintessential Saint-Estephe notes of pure cassis, graphite, tobacco leaf, acacia flowers, and loamy earth. Full-bodied, concentrated, and powerful, it nevertheless stays incredibly pure, elegant, and seamless, with perfectly ripe tannins. A blend of 71% Cabernet Sauvignon, 23% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, and the rest Petit Verdot, is shines even today for its purity and balance, and it should be in the early stages of its prime drink window within a decade.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Gorgeously rendered for the vintage, with a well-endowed core of loganberry, mulberry and cassis flavors that roll through and are laced with a cast iron hint, while tobacco, warm stone and black tea accents swirl in the background. The long, authoritative finish steadily melds the fruit with the cast iron edge. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot.

chateau-ducru-beaucaillou-2019.title: Chateau Ducru-Beaucaillou 2020
chateau-ducru-beaucaillou-2019.bodyHtml:
The style of 2020 is reminiscent of the academic 2010 but with a higher concentration of flavours and greater density of anthocyanins and tannins, underlined with the Ducru’s trademark freshness, giving an exquisite, succulent texture.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The tannins are dense while the texture shows a dusty suspended character that gives the wine great charm. Yet, having said that, the concentration will give this wine long term aging both from the acidity and the structure.

97 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrants and blueberries with violets and crushed stone. Extremely aromatic. Full-bodied but very tight and reserved, with racy, almost steely tannins. Some subtle sweet fruit in the center palate. Great transparency and clarity. Super precision here. Vertical and polished.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Ducru-Beaucaillou unwinds in the glass with aromas of dark berries, pencil shavings, violets and pipe tobacco, all framed by creamy new oak. On the palate, it's medium to full-bodied, fleshy and concentrated, with a deep but tightly wound core that's still quite wrapped up in extract and oak tannin, even if it isn't quite as big-boned as its 2019 counterpart. It will require some patience. Best After 2030

ao-yun-2018a.title: Ao Yun 2018
ao-yun-2018a.bodyHtml:
Ao Yun 2018 is a historic, groundbreaking luxury red blend that marks a massive milestone for Chinese viticulture, representing the first vintage of Ao Yun distributed globally through the prestigious La Place de Bordeaux. Owned by luxury conglomerate LVMH, the estate is located at the foothills of the Himalayas in Yunnan, where vines are split across four distinct mountain villages (Xidang, Sinong, Shuori, and Adong) at staggering high-altitudes ranging from 2,200 to 2,600 meters.

The 2021-bottled 2018 vintage benefited from a cooler, highly balanced growing season. It signals an increased confidence in the estate’s secondary varieties, featuring a higher percentage of Cabernet Franc and Merlot to flesh out the mid-palate. Meticulously crafted using an innovative two-phase aging process—spending its first 5 months in traditional Chinese earthenware pots before transitioning to French oak barrels (30% new) for 10 months—the wine shows a very deep, opaque purple color. The nose is spectacularly lifted and perfumed, bursting with super-ripe cassis, crushed blackberries, and dark plums, beautifully complexed by cool-climate herbaceous notes of mint leaf, sage, incense, and cocoa powder. On the palate, it is full-bodied, dense, and vertical, delivering immense structural authority ($14.5\%$ to $15\%$ ABV) that draws comparisons to top-tier Napa and Mendoza blends. A core of dark savory fruit is supported by a millefeuille-like layering of abundant, fine-grained coating tannins and an exceptionally vibrant line of high-altitude acidity, carrying into a remarkably long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, slow-braised venison loin, or Peking duck.

98 Points - James Suckling

I love the depth and complexity of the nose, which brings you down deeply into the wine, showing blackberry, ink, tar, earth, incense, cloves, and black licorice. Thyme, too. The purity of the fruit, including cassis, is the real thing. This is full-bodied, but remains so fresh and vertical on the palate. The tannins are so fine and integrated, producing a millefeuille-like layering of tannin and cool, blue fruit. Incredible wine. The greatest wine made in China so far. 60% cabernet sauvignon, 19% cabernet franc, 10% merlot, 7% syrah and 4% petit verdot. 26,000 bottles made. Drinkable now, but will be so much better in four or five years.

ao-yun-2020.title: Ao Yun 2018
ao-yun-2020.bodyHtml:

domaine-de-chevalier-rouge-2020.title: Domaine de Chevalier 2020
domaine-de-chevalier-rouge-2020.bodyHtml:
One of Pessac-Léognan's most iconic estates, Domaine de Chevalier displays captivating aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, graphite, cedar, violet, and cigar box. Powerful yet exceptionally elegant, it reveals silky tannins, vibrant freshness, remarkable complexity, and an extraordinarily long finish with outstanding aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, grilled ribeye, roast lamb, duck confit, venison, truffle potatoes, aged Comté, or braised short ribs.

 

99 Points - James Suckling

The purity of fruit is really something here, with blackcurrants and blackberries, together with orange, stone and granite character. Mind-boggling in many ways. Full-bodied with very fine tannins that are polished and pure. Such a fine texture. Lots of primary fruit. Like picking wonderfully ripe grapes. Great length. One for the cellar.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

From an estate that’s been on fire over the past decade, the 2020 Domaine De Chevalier is another brilliant wine in the making and checks in as 65% Cabernet Sauvignon, 27% Merlot, 5% Petit Verdot, and 3% Cabernet Franc. Offering impressive cassis and darker berry fruits, it has complex notes of crushed flowers, violets, and damp earth-like nuances. Medium to full-bodied on the palate, with ultra-fine tannins and a silky, layered, seamless texture, it shines for both its richness and its balance. It also shuts down quite quickly, so if you’re going to drink bottles, try one in its youth. Otherwise, be sure to give bottles 7-8 years in a cold cellar. It should have 30-40 years of overall longevity.
Barrel Sample: 95-97+
97 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This impressively rich wine is centered on great swathes of black fruits. The tannins, with their stylish swagger, are a fine complement to the fruit, giving the wine structure and the potential for elegant aging. Barrel Sample: 95-97
96 Points - Decanter
Blueberry and blackcurrant fruit on the nose, touches of ripeness and freshness. juicy and lively, but straight and tense too, with such liquorice and tobacco and chocolate bitter spices. It's quite constricted and focused right now. Generous but not necessarily charming on the palate. Precision and clarity is there no doubt, this has been well made and it has that mature ripe fruit aspect that gives a wide mouthfeel with lots of tension and direction. Super young but super promising. Rich, heady, a touch high alcohol on the finish though. 5% Petit Verdot completes the blend.
95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Domaine de Chevalier is a touch more tightly wound than the brilliant 2019 out of the gates, but it seems likely to equal that vintage with a bit of time. Unwinding in the glass with aromas of minty blackberries and cassis mingled with notions of burning embers, spices, rose petals and orange rind, it's medium to full-bodied, fleshy and concentrated, with a deep core of fruit, powdery structuring tannins and a long, saline finish. As I wrote last year, this estate in recent vintages has arrived at a sort of stylistic contemporary classicism that evokes the great wines of yesteryear from this address, and the 2020 continues that trend. Best After 2028 Rating : 95+

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Well-built, pulling ample and weighty waves of cassis, plum reduction and blackberry preserves along, atop a broad spine of warm loam, smoldering tobacco and singed alder. Long and deep through the fine-grained finish, with a warm paving stone note that won't quit, thanks to well-buried acidity—not an easy feat in this vintage. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc.

chateau-troplong-mondot-2019.title: Chateau Troplong Mondot Saint-emilion Grand Cru (Premier Grand Cru Classe) 2019 750ml

solaia-toscana-igt-2017.title: Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2007
solaia-toscana-igt-2017.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Solaia 2007 is a legendary, full-bodied Super Tuscan crafted from a premier 20-hectare southwest-facing hillside vineyard situated on the Tenuta Tignanello estate in the heart of Chianti Classico. Aged for approximately 18 months in new French oak barriques, this magnificent vintage displays an intense, deep ruby-red color. The nose opens with an extraordinarily complex bouquet of blackcurrant, dark plum, wild blackberry preserve, and graphite, layered with nuances of dark chocolate, sweet tobacco, crushed violet, espresso bean, and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it reveals remarkable richness, density, and structure, featuring fine-grained, velvety tannins and balanced acidity that carries its pure core of dark fruit through to an exceptionally long, refined, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, or well-aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

This is a subtle and racy wine. Balanced, with vibrant fruit and bright acidity and chocolate and spices. Full and racy. Very long. Austere. Fascinating. Very closed right now. Give it five or six years minimum now. Winemaker Renzo Cotarella says that Solaia is more reserved in character than the Antinori's Guado al Tasso from Bolgheri, which is more flashy. Makes me smile.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2007 Solaia saturates the palate with a heady array of super-ripe black cherries, plums, cassis, mocha and sweet French oak. There is an exotic quality to the Solaia I find totally irresistible. Despite its considerable ripeness and opulence, the 2007 Solaia is never heavy, rather it impresses for its extraordinary finesse and balance. Minerals, graphite and crushed rocks frame a long, seductive finish. This is a wonderful Solaia loaded with vintage and vineyard character. The 2007 Solaia is 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Sangiovese and 5% Cabernet Franc, aged in 100% new oak. Anticipated maturity: 2017-2027.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A racy wine that offers so much currant and blackberry character. Full and very silky. Goes on and on. Fascinating. Best after 2012. 6,500 cases made.

highland-park-cask-strength-2022.title: Highland Park Cask Strength Release No. 5
highland-park-cask-strength-2022.bodyHtml:
Highland Park Cask Strength Release No.5 is a robust and captivating Orkney single malt Scotch whisky bottled at its natural cask strength without chill filtration or added color. Master Whisky Maker Gordon Motion crafted Release No.5 with a high proportion of European oak sherry-seasoned casks, complemented by American oak sherry-seasoned casks, a small quantity of ex-bourbon casks, and first-fill stalk oak casks. This wood combination delivers an exceptional balance of deep dried fruit complexity, warm baking spices, heather honey, and Highland Park's signature delicate aromatic peat smoke.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with smoked venison, dark chocolate tarts, sticky barbecue ribs, aged Gouda, or blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper and amber with a rich, full-bodied viscosity and a velvety, coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic peat smoke, clove, dried fruit, dark chocolate, toasted oak, and sweet heather honey.

Palate : Rich and complex with notes of sun-dried raisins, warm cinnamon, dark cocoa, toasted oak, and lingering heather peat.

Finish : Long, warm, and satisfying with sweet spices, rich oak, and gentle aromatic peat smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to open up the intense cask-strength aromas and soften the ABV.

rossville-union-master-crafted-whiskey.title: Rossville Union Master Crafted Rye 47% ABV
rossville-union-master-crafted-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Aged for 5 and 6 years, Rossville Union’s Master Crafted Straight Rye Whiskey delivers a smooth, slightly smoky taste—and a robust, spicy finish with a hint of cherry.

Imagine a Master Crafted Straight Rye Whiskey, aged for 5 and 6 years, and bound to create an eye-opening rush. Now imagine it bottled in a distinctive bottle inspired by the amber hue of a setting sun and adorned with a label depicting a mountaintop view. It’s the last drop in the bottle that best captures this spirit

taylor-fladgate-50-year-tawny-golden-age.title: Taylor Fladgate 50 Year Old Tawny Golden Age
taylor-fladgate-50-year-tawny-golden-age.bodyHtml:
Chestnut, copper color core with a light golden rim. The primary aromas are elegant, rich and very delicate. Notes of rum and raisin, clove, nutmeg and a hint of cracked black pepper. Prunes, quince and apricot dance on your palate as the zest of lemon and orange deliver a freshness of acidity to balance the richness of the wine. Notes of scorched pineapple, passion fruit and lychee balance beautifully with the toasted coconut, almonds and butterscotch. The texture and weight of the wine wraps the palate and finishes bright, fresh and poised. The wine lingers for an eternity, beckoning you in for more.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The NV 50 Year Old Tawny Port is a field blend bottled with a bar-top cork in 2022 and with 158 grams of residual sugar. Mature, with dark chocolate nuances, this is rich, deep and sensationally delicious. The concentration is exceptional too. Then, there's the long, long finish, filled with fruit and sugar.
