It is irresistible, in addition to being nuanced and complex. It's young enough so that it is never just a curiosity. The fruit is certainly not cracking.
97 Points - James Suckling
Aromas of balsamic, mahogany, Georgian furniture and dried fruits. Salted dried almonds. Medium-bodied, very sweet. Sultanas. Figs. Yet fresh and intensely flavored with a long, long finish. Love the finish. Salted caramel. Drink or hold.
96 Points - Wine Spectator
A bird of a different feather, this sports a range of date, mulled plum and persimmon fruit flavors that are curvaceous in feel, allied to a racy green tea and hazelnut spine. Picks up singed white sesame, walnut husk, alder smoke and sandalwood along the way. Reveals terrific tension between the viscous and nervy sides from start to finish.

veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-vi90.title: Veuve Clicquot Brut
veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-vi90.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label manages to reconcile two opposing factors, strength and silkiness and to hold them in perfect balance with aromatic intensity and a lot of freshness. With golden yellow tiny bubbles, this non-vintage Champagne shows the fruitiness of peach, Mirabelle plum, and pear alongside notes of vanilla and toasted brioche. This consistent power to please makes it ideal as an aperitif, and perfect as the Champagne to enjoy with a meal.

92 Points - James Suckling

This has aromas of grapefruit, citrus peel, quince, toast and almonds. It’s medium-bodied with creamy, fine tannins. Silky texture. Nutty complexity at the end.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Lively, with tangy acidity and a zesty mousse, this aperitif-style Champagne shows notes of mandarin orange, blackberry, toast and a touch of pastry cream. Subtle, smoke-tinged finish. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Drink now.

veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-vi89.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut 1989 1.5L Magnum
veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-vi89.bodyHtml:
1989 marked the return of the hot, dry vintages, similar to the legendary years of 1945, 1959 and 1964. After very early budding, the vines suffered from a cold spell. On April 27, a severe spring frost hit a large section of the Champagne vineyard.

The Vallée de la Marne and the East of the Montagne de Reims suffered enormous damage, whereas the Côte des Blancs remained intact. Overall, thanks to its very advantageous location in the heart of the best vineyards in Champagne, the House vineyard was spared. Later on, summer conditions set in, allowing the vine to regain its normal cycle. A few cold days, when the vines were in the sensitive flowering period, temporarily clouded our hopes for a good quality harvest. But these worries soon disappeared as exceptional weather soon set in and continued for a long time. From mid-June right up to harvesting, there was a succession of hot sunny days. The first grapes, ripened in perfect conditions, were picked on September 4 in our Côte des Blancs Grands Crus. The Pinots Noirs and the Meuniers were left to ripen a few more days before picking, which gave grapes of perfect quality in an excellent state of health. In the end, an average degree of 10° GL was obtained for the whole of the vineyard, with some vines even approaching 11° GL.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-ro96-1.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut Rose 1996
veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-ro96-1.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Cave Privée Brut Rosé 1996 is a prestigious, rare vintage Champagne crafted from exceptional Grand and Premier Cru vineyards across the Montagne de Reims, Grande Vallée de la Marne, and Côte des Blancs. Having spent decades resting on its lees in the chalk cellars of Reims, this mature cuvée exhibits a brilliant amber-copper hue with extremely fine, delicate effervescence. The complex nose opens with rich, evolved aromas of dried red berries, candied orange peel, dried apricot, and roasted hazelnut, grounded by tertiary hints of truffle, smoked spice, and toasted brioche. On the palate, it exhibits extraordinary structure, combining a rich, creamy texture with the sharp, driving acidity characteristic of the legendary 1996 vintage, finishing with immense length and chalky mineral complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with roasted duck breast, seared venison, wild mushroom risotto, pan-roasted pigeon, aged Comté, or lobster thermidor.

veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-ro96-2.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut Rose 1996 1.5L Magnum
veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-ro96-2.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Cave Privée Brut Rosé 1996 is a prestigious, rare vintage Champagne crafted from exceptional Grand and Premier Cru vineyards across the Montagne de Reims, Grande Vallée de la Marne, and Côte des Blancs. Having spent decades resting on its lees in the chalk cellars of Reims, this mature cuvée exhibits a brilliant amber-copper hue with extremely fine, delicate effervescence. The complex nose opens with rich, evolved aromas of dried red berries, candied orange peel, dried apricot, and roasted hazelnut, grounded by tertiary hints of truffle, smoked spice, and toasted brioche. On the palate, it exhibits extraordinary structure, combining a rich, creamy texture with the sharp, driving acidity characteristic of the legendary 1996 vintage, finishing with immense length and chalky mineral complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with roasted duck breast, seared venison, wild mushroom risotto, pan-roasted pigeon, aged Comté, or lobster thermidor.

laphroaig-10-year-old-cask-strength-b15.title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 15
laphroaig-10-year-old-cask-strength-b15.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 15 is the fifteenth batch of the distillery's Original Cask Strength, bottled in December 2021. The Islay single malt spends ten years in charred ex-bourbon barrels, is barrier-filtered only to remove char particles and then goes straight into the bottle at its natural strength - for this batch 56.5% ABV, here in a 700ml bottle. Neat it shows vanilla, pipe tobacco and leather on the nose with toffee, fudge and cinnamon on the palate; a few drops of water bring out more peat smoke and sea salt.

Tasting Notes: Tawny colour; vanilla, pipe tobacco, leather, toffee, fudge, cinnamon, peat smoke and sea salt.

Nose: Sweet cereals, fresh oak and pipe tobacco, with leather, nutmeg and vanilla.

Palate: Sweet and spicy: vanilla, toffee and sea salt with hints of cinnamon and pepper.

Finish: Long, with lingering spice, oak tannins, iodine and sea salt.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water.

dom-perignon-p2-2000.title: Dom Perignon P2 Plenitude 2000
dom-perignon-p2-2000.bodyHtml:
The bouquet is ripe, lively and generous. The warm aromas of hay and brioche mingle with those of bergamot orange and russet stone fruit. The overall effect exudes smoky grey accents. On the palate, the vibrant opening strikes the first chord, a prelude to a complexity that is more tactile than plump, and only gives of itself gradually. The distinguished viscosity is understated and simply fits around the contours of the wine. The length is exquisitely bitter and abounds with sap, a mingling of liquorice and toasted malt.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

A beautiful nose of baked peach, lime blossom and graphite draws you into the glass of this stunning 2000, whose flavors of brioche, salted almond and spun honey are wrapped around sleek, mouthwatering acidity and a streak of smoke-tinged mineral. This deftly meshed Champagne is hard to stop sipping. Drink now through 2030.

97 Points - James Suckling

A Champagne that has turned to a very fine texture with dried pineapple and lemon character. Medium to full body, complex and flavorful palate. Shows length and beauty. Pie crust, cooked apple and lemon rind continue on the finish. A truly great 2000 with a combination of finesse and strength. It’s very, very minerally to a point of sea salt. It was disgorged in first half of 2016.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

 

The 2000 Dom Pérignon P2 opens in the glass with aromas of waxy citrus oil, warm bread, dried fruits, fresh peach and iodine. On the palate, it's medium to full-bodied, satiny and textural, with a sweet core of mature fruit, ripe acids and a sapid, elegantly toasty finish. As I wrote earlier this year, the 2000 vintage delivered a precocious Dom Pérignon, and this recently disgorged rendition has really benefited from the additional time sur lattes, acquiring notably more complexity—while retaining more energy—than the original disgorgement.

alberta-premium-cask-strength-batch-4.title: Alberta Premium Cask Strength 10 Year Old 2025 Release
alberta-premium-cask-strength-batch-4.bodyHtml:
A standout Canadian rye whisky bottled at full strength, this 10-year-old release from Alberta Premium blends decades of refinement with the bold flavor that defines 100 % prairie rye. From the heart of Calgary, it showcases intensity, depth, and character rarely seen in the rye whisky world.

On the nose, warm caramel and vanilla mingle with toasted oak, wild honey, and a swirl of ripe apple and apricot. A subtle undercurrent of rye spice—white pepper and tobacco leaf—sits alongside soft floral whispers of lilac and mint.
The palate opens rich and full, offering butterscotch, dark chocolate, candied apple, and stewed plums, balanced by the unmistakable grain-driven rye heat.
The finish is long and vibrant: lingering waves of cinnamon bark, leather, oak tannin and a bright citrus-peel lift teasing at the edges.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements smoked brisket, grilled steak, maple-glazed pork, pecan pie, dark chocolate desserts, and aged cheeses such as cheddar, Gouda, or blue cheese.

george-remus-straight-bourbon-whiskey.title: Remus Highest Rye Bourbon 6 Year Old
george-remus-straight-bourbon-whiskey.bodyHtml:
A spectacularly crafted bourbon from the legendary Ross & Squibb Distillery in Indiana, paying homage to the "King of the Bootleggers," George Remus. This 6-year-old release pushes the legal definition of bourbon to its absolute limit, featuring a mash bill composed of a staggering 39% rye grain! Bottled at a robust 109 proof, it delivers a massive, intensely spicy, and deeply complex flavor profile that completely bridges the gap between a high-rye bourbon and a sweet straight rye.

 

NOSE

Deep and aromatic with heavy notes of sweet candied fruit, dark caramel, intense baking spice, and a hint of leather.

PALATE

Full-bodied, rich, and mouth-coating. A massive wave of cinnamon and peppery spice is beautifully rounded out by deep vanilla, dark chocolate, and toasted oak.

FINISH

Exceptionally long, warm, and spicy, leaving a lasting trail of dry oak and sweet brown sugar.

blood-oath-pact-8.title: Blood Oath Pact No. 8 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
blood-oath-pact-8.bodyHtml:
A masterful union of three well-bred bourbons. One, a 14-year ryed bourbon. Two, an 11-year ryed bourbon. And three, and 8-year ryed bourbon finished in Calvados casks from the Normandy region of France to impart slight apple on the nose with hints of vanilla and cinnamon. With each sip, feel transported to Northern France by way of Kentucky.

INGREDIENTS

Corn, rye, and barley

APPEARANCE

Deep, dark amber color with long legs

AROMA

Slight apple on the nose with hints of vanilla and cinnamon

PALATE

Ripe apples and juicy pears combined with butterscotch and hints of chocolate

FINISH

Apples, pears, butterscotch, and chocolate

BARREL DETAILS

Blood Oath Pact 8 adds additional flavors from the Calvados Casks, sourced from the Normandy region of France

49.3% ALC/VOL / 98.6 PROOF

jameson-18yo-irish-whiskey.title: Jameson 18 Year Old Irish Whiskey
jameson-18yo-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml: Jameson 18 Year Old is a prestige blended Irish whiskey that represents the pinnacle of the brand's core range. It is a masterful marriage of three different distillates that have matured for at least 18 years in hand-selected American bourbon barrels and European sherry casks at the Midleton Distillery. After the initial aging, the blend is finished in first-fill bourbon barrels for an additional six months to add a layer of complexity and a silky texture. On the nose, it offers an aromatic bouquet of oily wood, spicy toffee, and aromatic oils. The palate is wonderfully mellow and smooth, showcasing complex flavours of fudge, toffee, spice, and hints of wood and leather, followed by a long, lingering finish that carries notes of wood, spice, and vanilla.

canadian-club-45-year-old.title: Canadian Club Invitation Series 15 Year Old Sherry Cask
canadian-club-45-year-old.bodyHtml: First, in the series, this one-time release whisky has all the hallmark notes of CC Classic 12 YO elevated to 15 years with the secondary aging in Oloroso sherry casks. The results are rich aromas of toffee, spice and subtle sweetness with warm and creamy flavours with mellow wood on the palate. Sip neat or over ice.

little-book-vi-cask-strength.title: Little Book Chapter 10 'All The Wiser'
little-book-vi-cask-strength.bodyHtml:
Little Book Chapter 10 'All The Wiser' Blended Straight Whiskey is the tenth release in the annual series created by 8th Generation Master Distiller Freddie Noe at James B. Beam Distilling Co. Bottled uncut and unfiltered at cask strength, this release blends mature bourbons from across the portfolio with additional components finished in sherry casks and toasted bourbon casks. It marries signature beam oak and caramel with rich dried fruits, warm spice, and toasted wood undertones.

Food Pairing: Smoked beef brisket, dark chocolate tarts, pecan pie, aged sharp cheddar cheese, and grilled ribeye steak.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance, offering a full, mouth-coating, viscous, and warm cask-strength mouthfeel.

Nose : Toasted oak, dark caramel, dried figs, sweet molasses, vanilla bean, and light baking spices.

Palate : Rich and full-bodied with notes of sweet cooked agave and rich caramel, toasted oak, brown sugar, cinnamon spice, dark raisins, and subtle sherry sweetness.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of dark fruits, toasted wood, warm cinnamon, and a pleasant oak structure.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of water to open up the complex aromatics and tame the high proof.

macnairs-lum-reek-21-yo-blended-scotch.title: MacNair's Lum Reek 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 1
macnairs-lum-reek-21-yo-blended-scotch.bodyHtml:
MacNair’s Lum Reek Cask Strength Batch 1 is an excellent 10-year-old Scotch blended malt whiskey from the first batch. It is a stunning blend of the best Speyside and Islay single malt whiskies, including aged GlenAllachie. This combination resulted in a fine peat mixture, which is rich but above all perfectly balanced.

But that’s not all. The mixture still awaits 10 years of aging in different types of barrels. The first maturation takes place in premium ex-sherry Spanish casks. It is then filled into ex-wine barrique barrels and finally into virgin oak barrels in the cellars of the GlenAllachie distillery. Thanks to these barrels, the whiskey acquired an unmistakable taste of wood along with sweet but slightly smoky notes.

The matured whiskey is then bottled with a natural 55.4 % alcohol content. It is without added dyes and cold filtration . The bottle is housed in a red-gold gift tube.

Color: Amber With Red Highlights
Aroma: Earthy, Raisin, Red Fruit, Smoke, Oak, Brandy, Vanilla

Taste: Slightly Sweet, Chocolate, Cinnamon, Caramel, Nuts, Wood, Smoke

Finish: Long, Slightly Spicy, Caramel, Bananas, Smoke , Ginger, Citrus

lanson-black-label-brut.title: Lanson Le Black Label Brut 750ml
lanson-black-label-brut.bodyHtml:
The Black Label's brilliant color recalls the characteristic tones of the Pinot Noir, with glints of amber. It is lively in the flute, with a fine stream of persistent bubbles. Its fresh aromas combine the impression of vitality and spring-time scents, together with hints of toast and honey. On the palate, bouquets of ripe fruits and citrus create a sensation of opulence yet lightness.

Professional Ratings

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Lanson’s famed nonvintage cuvée is back on form, giving a ripe style dominated by Pinot Noir. It has weight and already a fine balance between the fruits and touches of toast from four years on the lees. This bottling of this Champagne is very ready to drink.

92 Points - Decanter
50% Pinot Noir, 35% Chardonnay and 15% Meunier from 100 villages in all, and including 30% reserves from 10 vintages back to 1995; a small proportion now being produced with malolactic. Black Label remains the confident barometer of Lanson, and Hervé Dantan’s first blend is a class act, a resounding statement of his talent in preserving the style and integrity of the house while meticulously polishing the edges. It’s a very important cuvée in the grand scheme of Champagne: one of the best and most consistent of the bargain set.

92 Points - Tasting Panel
Balanced and refined yet ripe, rich, and generous with sweet fruit, charm, and good length, this is a marvelous sparkler from an always reliable house.

92 Points - James Suckling
A fresh, balanced palate with green apples, pie crust and pears. Medium body, fine bubbles and a crisp, dry finish. Nice center palate. Four years on the lees. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator
Racy acidity is tightly meshed to flavors of ripe red and black currant, preserved lemon, chopped almond and honeycomb in this sleek Champagne, with a fine, chalky bead. Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier.

90 Points - Wine & Spirits
Soft, chalky tannins structure this wine, sur-rounded by notes of pink grapefruit and russet apple. That balance of sweet fruit and tannins will meld with pate de foie.

90 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The flagship of the brand, the NV Champagne Le Black Label Brut release is based on the 2016 vintage with 40% reserve wine spanning 10 vintages. Some of the reserve wine is aged in cask, the remainder in stainless steel. The nose is expressive and fragrant with ripe red fruits, white strawberry, red roses, and brioche. The palate is juicy and round, with primary juicy Anjou pear, Mirabel plum, and honeycomb. A crowd pleaser, this is perfect as an aperitif and for parties. Best after 2022.

joseph-phelps-insignia-magnum.title: Joseph Phelps Insignia 2019 1.5L Magnum
joseph-phelps-insignia-magnum.bodyHtml:
The 2019 Insignia opens with heady aromatics of red fruit, crème de cassis, leafy tobacco and delicate dried rose petals. The palate is juicy and dense with expressive layers of blackberry, raspberry, black currant, and dark chocolate. A dynamic wine offering captivating energy, length, complexity and refinement. The 2019 Insignia marks the first vintage to include fruit from the new Joseph Phelps vineyard named El Venadito, located in the Oak Knoll District, just south of the winery’s Yountville Vineyard.

99 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Another beautiful wine from this team, the 2019 Insignia is mostly Cabernet Sauvignon but includes smaller amounts of Merlot and Malbec, brought up all in new barrels, sourced from seven estate vineyards. It has a classic varietal and incredibly complex nose of crème de cassis, freshly sharpened pencils, green tobacco, and damp earth, with a kiss of background sappy spring flowers. Seemingly from a cooler year with its freshness, vibrancy, and herbal, floral character on the nose, it's nevertheless full-bodied and beautifully concentrated on the palate, with ultra-fine tannins, a seamless, layered mouthfeel, and a gorgeous finish. Unquestionably up with the finest vintages of this cuvée, this is legit awesome juice that’s going to offer incredible pleasure over the coming 20-25 years. Hats off to winemaker Ashley Hepworth.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

More elegant and refined than the Napa Cab, the 2019 Insignia features restrained cedar and vanilla notes (despite spending two years in 100% new French oak) and delicate herbal shadings accenting cassis and black cherry fruit. Full-bodied, velvety and somewhat open-knit on the palate, it turns plush and long on the finish, adding a touch of warmth. Production this year is approximately 17,000 cases, reflecting the increased volume coming from recently replanted vineyards. It's remarkable what a good job they continue to do with this bottling year after year, without compromising on quality.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A solidly built Cabernet with a very direct persona, as dark currant, warmed fig reduction and blackberry fruit paste are bolted together with licorice root and singed cedar. Features an espresso crema hint on the finish, which keeps this on the dark, muscular side. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Best from 2023 through 2038.

white-owl-caramel-whisky.title: White Owl Caramel Whisky
white-owl-caramel-whisky.bodyHtml:
White Owl Caramel Whisky is a caramel expression of White Owl, the clear, oak-matured Canadian whisky made by Highwood Distillers in Alberta. The producer compares it to Halloween caramels: creamy toffee and soft caramel notes sit on top of White Owl's oaky, woody whisky character. Bottled at 40% alc./vol. in a 750ml frosted bottle.

Tasting Notes: Toffee, soft caramel, oak.

Nose: Creamy toffee and soft caramel.

Palate: Rich and luscious, with caramel and toffee over oaky whisky character.

Finish: Creamy and lingering.

Serve: Over ice, or with a splash of mixer.

giant-steps-pinot-noir-applejack.title: Giant Steps Applejack Vineyard Pinot Noir 2025
giant-steps-pinot-noir-applejack.bodyHtml:
Giant Steps Applejack Vineyard Pinot Noir 2025 is a vibrant, highly elegant, and terroir-driven Australian red wine produced from the high-altitude Applejack Vineyard situated in the upper Yarra Valley. Visually displaying a translucent ruby hue with bright crimson highlights, it opens with a lifted bouquet of red cherry, wild strawberry, and pomegranate, seamlessly layered with subtle spice, crushed herbs, dried roses, and a delicate earthy minerality. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-bodied, fine-grained structure framed by silky tannins and a energetic core of natural acidity, delivering fresh red fruit and savory nuances that flow effortlessly into a long, fragrant, and poised finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with duck breast, pan-seared pork chops, roasted chicken, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, and mild creamy cheeses.

giant-steps-chardonnay-sexton.title: Giant Steps Sexton Vineyard Chardonnay 2020
giant-steps-chardonnay-sexton.bodyHtml:
Giant Steps Sexton Vineyard Chardonnay 2020 is a highly characterful single-vineyard white from the Yarra Valley, crafted from fruit grown on the steep, north-facing slopes of the Warramate Ranges. The 2020 vintage was defined by a cool spring that resulted in exceptionally low yields and small, concentrated bunches with high natural acidity. Winemaking involved 100% hand-picking and whole-bunch pressing, followed by indigenous yeast fermentation in 500L French puncheons and ten months of maturation in a mix of new and seasoned oak. The wine offers a complex aromatic profile of grapefruit pith, flint, and roasted almonds, leading to a palate of white peach, nectarine, and candied citrus peel. It is noted for its "laser-like" focus, balanced by a creamy texture and a long, savory finish with subtle notes of ginger and matchstick.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This single vineyard beauty, from a restrained and acid-driven Chardonnay vintage in the Yarra Valley, leads with reductive flint and nut characters. They're woven in with more delicate aromas like stone fruit, waxy lemon, white spice, orchard blossoms and wet stones. Toasty oak is there too, but it's well tucked. The mouthfeel is beautifully balanced, with prickly, citrusy acidity and supportive oak. Precise yet still characterful, this is an excellent, food friendly example of modern Aussie Chard.

angry-orchard-fall-haul-variety-pack.title: Angry Orchard Fall Haul Variety Pack 12 Cans
angry-orchard-fall-haul-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Angry Orchard Fall Haul Variety Pack 12 Cans

omc-glenburgie.title: Omc Glenburgie
omc-glenburgie.bodyHtml:
Hunter Laing Old Malt Cask Glenburgie 21 Year Old 2000 is a single cask Speyside single malt Scotch from Glenburgie Distillery, bottled by Glasgow's Hunter Laing & Co. in its Old Malt Cask series. Distilled in 2000, it spent 21 years in a refill hogshead before being bottled at 50% ABV. In line with the Old Malt Cask philosophy it is bottled from one cask with no chill filtration and no added colouring, letting the spirit and the cask speak for themselves. Hunter Laing's tasting panel selects each Old Malt Cask release from the company's stocks, and the label carries the blender's own notes. A 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Orchard and red fruit with toffee, then chocolate and spice.

Nose: Cherries, apples and toffee.

Palate: Chocolate, liquorice and peppery notes.

Finish: Long, with spice that lingers.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

on-the-rocks-knob-creek-old-fashioned-2.title: On The Rocks ‘Knob Creek’ The Old Fashioned Premium Cocktails
on-the-rocks-knob-creek-old-fashioned-2.bodyHtml:
On The Rocks ‘Knob Creek’ The Old Fashioned Premium Cocktails is a ready-to-serve, bottled craft cocktail produced in partnership with Knob Creek Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey. Blended with Knob Creek bourbon, bitters, and natural orange flavor, it captures the classic, timeless profile of a traditional Old Fashioned, delivering rich oak, sweet caramel, and warm rye spice balanced by zesty citrus peel.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, smoked brisket, dark chocolate truffles, pecan pie, charcuterie, and sharp cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber and copper in appearance, offering a smooth, rich, and full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet oak, dark caramel, vanilla, candied orange peel, and subtle baking spice.

Palate : Smooth and complex with bold bourbon oak, rich caramel sweetness, aromatic bitters, and vibrant orange zest.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with sweet oak, dark sugar, and gentle herbal spice.

Serve : Best served poured directly over a large ice cube or sphere in a rocks glass, garnished with an orange peel or a Maraschino cherry.

bolla-valpolicella-ripasso.title: Bolla Valpolicella Ripasso Classico Superiore
bolla-valpolicella-ripasso.bodyHtml: After going through the grape marc (solid parts like the skins of the grapes) left over from the region's prestigious appellation, Amarone della Valpolicella, this wine acquires more character than the regular version of Valpolicella, on top of gaining woody notes in this case. A great choice for BBQ fare.

aultmore-18-year-old-1.title: Aultmore 18 Year Old
aultmore-18-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Aultmore 18 Year Old is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from the Aultmore distillery, part of the Bacardi family of brands. Eighteen years in cask give it a fruit-led character, with cereal and vanilla behind peach and grapefruit. It is bottled at 46% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Cereal, fruit salad, vanilla, peach and grapefruit.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

faiveley-nuit-st-george-les-damodes-1er.title: Domaine Faiveley Nuits-Saint-Georges Les Damodes Premier Cru 2022 750ml
faiveley-nuit-st-george-les-damodes-1er.bodyHtml: The term "Les Damodes" makes reference to the Druidesses who previously inhabited the area. These vines are planted at high altitude, bordering Vosne-Romanée, and produce a mineral wine with very delicate tannins. A smooth and very feminine wine!

chamisul-fresh-soju-jinro-17.title: Jinro Chamisul Fresh Soju 360ml
chamisul-fresh-soju-jinro-17.bodyHtml: Jinro Soju Fresh, made from rice but other starches are also used. Soju is much loved in Korea and is one of the most popular spirits in the world, with millions and millions of cases sold each year. Similar in profile to vodka, with a slight sweetness and a touch of pepper on the palate.

luce-2019.title: Tenuta Luce Toscana 2021 3L Double Magnum
luce-2019.bodyHtml:
The wine displays an intense, almost impenetrable, ruby red color. On the nose, the wine introduces itself with intense red fruits and subtle hints of incense and spicy notes that bequeath extraordinary complexity. In the mouth, the bouquet’s complexity comes alive through elegant tannins that gift the wine with unique balance and structure.

96 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrants, minerals, mint and hints of chocolate follow through to a medium to full body with linear fruit and tannins that run the length of the wine. The tannins are extremely polished, with beauty and style. Needs three or four years to come together. Best after 2027.
95 Points - Wine Spectator

Aromas and flavors of lavender, plum, black cherry, vanilla, earth and resin are the hallmarks of this concentrated yet lively red. Firm, ripe tannins give the finish grip for now, yet this red is complex and long, with all of its components in the right place. Sangiovese and Merlot. Best from 2026 through 2042.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
This is an iconic bottle that has seen mild stylistic tweaks but that fundamentally has remained quite consistent over the years. Sticking to its blueprint, the Tenuta Luce 2021 Luce della Vite remains a "super Tuscan-styled" blockbuster that speaks more of the grapes used in the blend than it does its territory. It is made with Sangiovese and Merlot. It shows thick extraction, soft tannins and a velvety mouthfeel. The oak tannins are a little dry, but the wine remains plush and accessible overall.

luce-2020.title: Tenuta Luce Lux Vitis 2020 1.5L Magnum
luce-2020.bodyHtml:
Tenuta Luce Lux Vitis 2020 is an exceptionally structured, full-bodied Super Tuscan sourced predominantly from high-density Cabernet Sauvignon vines planted on the sandy-clay soils of Montalcino, enriched with a small touch of Sangiovese. Aged for 24 months in new French oak barriques, it showcases a dense, dark purple-ruby hue with brilliant aromatic complexity. The nose displays intense aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, crushed violets, cedarwood, and graphite, complemented by subtle notes of dark chocolate, sweet spices, and resinous Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it exhibits immense power and seamless depth, featuring velvety, tightly woven tannins and driving acidity that carries a rich core of ripe dark fruits into an extraordinarily long, elegant, and mineral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted venison loin, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, or well-aged Pecorino cheese.

luce-brunello-di-montalcino-magnum.title: Tenuta Luce Brunello di Montalcino 2019 1.5L Magnum
luce-brunello-di-montalcino-magnum.bodyHtml:
Luce Brunello 2019 appears an intense ruby red. The nose immediately impresses, with intensely-fragrant liqueur cherries, red plum, and orange zest that meld into smooth impressions of pipe tobacco and black licorice. The palate is striking for its approachability, vibrant and enfolding, with a structure admirably bolstered by perfectly ripe tannins that proceed to a citrus-edged finish.

98 Points - James Suckling

Black cherries and blueberries with walnut and lavender undertones. Medium body with very fine tannins that run the length of the wine and caress every inch of your palate. Fresh and vivid. A wine for the cellar, but already fantastic to taste. Best after 2027.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Frescobaldi’s Luce is always attention-worthy, and if you couldn’t make a good Brunello in 2019 you never will, but the Luce 2019 still managed to make my jaw. From the comforting whisper of a nose to the cool night air of the palate, this is an evocative, truly memorable expression.
 
95 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe and opulent, this red is packed with black cherry, blackberry and plum flavors, grabbing your attention from the first sip. Vibrant and solidly built, with notes of wild thyme, earth and sweet spices, this shows terrific balance and length, remaining fresh and juicy on finish. Best from 2027 through 2043..

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Tenuta Luce 2019 Brunello di Montalcino carries a good amount of oak spice with campfire ash, forest floor, dried cherry, cassis, rye bread and something floral like a hydrangea or pressed rose. There is a balsamic note as well with Sambuca or aniseed. This is a medium to full-bodied Brunello (with 35,000 bottles made) that shows dried fruit flavors and a substantial 15% alcohol pull on the lengthy finish.

faiveley-meursault.title: Domaine Faiveley Meursault 2023
faiveley-meursault.bodyHtml:
Domaine Faiveley Meursault 2023 is an expressive Chardonnay offering aromas of ripe pear, citrus blossom, toasted hazelnut, and fresh butter. The palate is rich yet beautifully balanced by vibrant acidity and refined mineral tension, leading to a long, elegant finish with remarkable precision.

Food Pairing: Pair with butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken, grilled halibut, creamy mushroom risotto, Comté cheese, or seared scallops in beurre blanc.

faiveley-gevrey-chambertin-1er-cru-combe.title: Domaine Faiveley Gevrey-Chambertin La Combe Aux Moines Premier Cru 2022 750ml
faiveley-gevrey-chambertin-1er-cru-combe.bodyHtml: The nose is very pleasant with aromas of fresh red fruits and spices. This wine is round and long on the palate with fruity and woody tastes. It is all elegance, with silky tannins and a sophisticated very long finish.

faiveley-gevrey-chambertin-les-cazetiers.title: Domaine Faiveley Gevrey-Chambertin Les Cazetiers Premier Cru 750ml
faiveley-gevrey-chambertin-les-cazetiers.bodyHtml:
Deep ruby red hue with an intense and complex nose characterized by red fruits, toast and subtle roasted notes. The palate is rich and round with a firm structure and direct tannins. This remarkably powerful wine offers a silky mouthfeel and exceptional length.

94 Points - Burghound.com

A classic Gevrey nose displays an abundance of that sauvage character that adds breadth to the intensely earthy plum, spice and black currant scents. The exceptionally rich, powerful and imposingly concentrated middle weight plus flavors possess plenty of minerality that adds a sense of lift to the palate coating finish where the supporting tannins are notably firm. Even so, in much the same fashion as the Combe aux Moines this is a bit less youthfully austere than it usually is. Good stuff and worth considering.
Barrel Sample: 91-94

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Elegant and firmly structured, boasting cherry, currant and floral flavors, with spice and licorice hints. Finishes with a juicy blast of fruit and spice. Best from 2017 through 2025. 170 cases imported.

92 Points - James Suckling

This has some concentration and ripeness with blueberry and blackberry. Full to medium body, firm tannins and a long finish. Extremely attractive. Drink or hold.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Tasted blind at the Burgfest tasting in Beaune, the 2013 Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru Les Cazetiers is darker in color than its peers and the aromatics are more broody: blackberry and dark plum, a little sullen in the context of the vintage. The palate is medium-bodied with supple tannin, tightly coiled and like the aromatics, it feels a little contained and takes time to unfurl, though it does with several minutes in the glass. I would wait another 3-4 years or at least give this a couple of hours decanting -- this is certainly on of the better Cazetiers in this vintage. Tasted September 2016.

faiveley-corton-clos-des-cortons-grand-c.title: Domaine Faiveley Corton Clos des Cortons Faiveley Grand Cru 2023
faiveley-corton-clos-des-cortons-grand-c.bodyHtml:
Domaine Faiveley Corton Clos des Cortons Faiveley Grand Cru 2023 is a powerful and distinguished Pinot Noir from the domaine's historic monopole vineyard. Aromas of black cherry, blackberry, violet, forest floor, cedar, and sweet spice lead to a concentrated palate with refined tannins, vibrant acidity, exceptional depth, and an extraordinarily long finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast venison, duck breast, herb-crusted lamb, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comte for a magnificent Grand Cru Burgundy pairing.


96 Points - James Suckling

Really cool and stony for the very warm vintage, this is a great expression of Corton with bright red berry fruit and a touch of blood oranges but all the structure we expect from this amazing site. The straight, long finish has a radical minerality that makes this extremely exciting. From organically grown grapes. Matured in a half-and-half mix of new oak barriques and once-used casks. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Well-marked by toasty new oak, this red is silky, complex and beautifully balanced. Cherry, strawberry, currant, sandalwood, iron and sweet spice aromas and flavors permeate the elegant profile, while the long, detailed aftertaste reveals its pedigree. Offers plenty of structure. Best from 2029 through 2048. 620 cases made, 124 cases imported.

masahiro-okinawa-gin-2.title: Masahiro Okinawa Gin Recipe 02
masahiro-okinawa-gin-2.bodyHtml: “Masahiro Okinawa Gin Recipe 02” uses a large amount of Okinawa’s local citrus variety Tankan as its main gin spice, combined with southern-style mint, cloves, moon peach, ginger, and lemongrass to create a craft gin with a refreshing taste and aroma. “Recipe 2” has a distinct herbal and citrus flavor different from that of “Recipe 01” Making a Gin Tonic or Gin Rickey to best enjoy its aromatic and refreshing taste.

phillips-dinosour-jurassic-mix-pack.title: Phillips Dinosour Jurassic Mix Pack 8 Tall Can
phillips-dinosour-jurassic-mix-pack.bodyHtml: Phillips Dinosour Jurassic Mix Pack 8 Tall Can

schenley-ofc.title: Schenley OFC 1.75L
schenley-ofc.bodyHtml:
Schenley OFC is a Canadian whisky from the Schenley brand, produced by Heaven Hill Distilling Canada. This large-format 1.75L bottle is bottled at 40% ABV, a practical size for an everyday Canadian whisky to enjoy on the rocks or in mixed drinks.

Serve: On the rocks, with ginger ale or cola, or in a highball.

pertimali-brunello-di-montalcino-reserva.title: Sassetti Livio Pertimali Brunello di Montalcino Riserva
pertimali-brunello-di-montalcino-reserva.bodyHtml:
The Sassetti Livio Pertimali Brunello di Montalcino Riserva is a monumental, deeply complex, and collector-worthy Italian red wine produced only in exceptional vintage years. It pours a deep, dark ruby red color with subtle garnet edges in the glass, lifting with an ethereal and multi-layered bouquet of ripe wild berries, Marasca cherry, and crushed raspberry, beautifully interwoven with sophisticated nuances of black truffles, leather, star anise, and pressed rose. On the palate, this full-bodied masterpiece is incredibly powerful, structured, and fruit-forward, coating the mouth with thick intensities of dark fruit preserves, black olive, and savory spice. Patiently aged for a generous 48 months in large Slavonian oak barrels followed by a year of bottle refinement, it expertly balances its immense fruit fiber with a racy, mouth-filling acidity and robust, polished tannins that carry into a legendary, endlessly persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Perfectly pairs with traditional, rich Tuscan dishes such as a classic thick-cut Bistecca alla Fiorentina (Chianina beef), slow-roasted rack of wild boar, braised venison stew, truffle-infused pastas, and mature cheeses like aged Pecorino Toscano.

pertimali-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Sassetti Livio Pertimali Brunello di Montalcino
pertimali-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
The Sassetti Livio Pertimali Brunello di Montalcino is a sophisticated, deeply complex, and world-renowned Italian red wine that represents one of the historical benchmarks of the region. Sourced from the family's prized 40-acre estate on the cooler northern slopes of the famed Montosoli hill, it pours an intense ruby red color in the glass. The nose lifts with a dark, alluring bouquet of black cherry, wild blackberry, and lavender, seamlessly layered with traditional nuances of leather, underbrush, crushed black olive, and exotic brown spice. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is rich and fruit-forward, delivering a dense wave of dark stone fruits, licorice, and salty minerals. Matured for 36 months in traditional Slavonian oak barrels, it expertly marries powerful concentration with a racy, vibrant acidity and firm, mouth-coating tannins that journey into a dry, legendary finish echoing with wood smoke and cacao.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with robust, flavorful dishes such as a classic thick-cut Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, wild boar ragù over pappardelle, braised beef short ribs, or mature cheeses like aged Pecorino Toscano.

jack-daniels-gift-pack-with-2-glasses.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey Gift Pack with 2 Glasses
jack-daniels-gift-pack-with-2-glasses.bodyHtml: The perfect gift for any whiskey enthusiast, this set features a 750ml bottle of the world-famous Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey paired with two signature rocks glasses. Mellowed drop by drop through 10 feet of sugar maple charcoal and aged in handcrafted barrels, this whiskey is renowned for its unmistakable smoothness. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a classic cocktail, this pack provides everything needed for a premium tasting experience.

chateau-haut-bailly-2014.title: Chateau Haut Bailly 2020
chateau-haut-bailly-2014.bodyHtml:
A legendary Pessac-Léognan with captivating aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, graphite, cedar, cigar box, violet, and exotic spice. Exceptionally refined with silky tannins, remarkable freshness, extraordinary complexity, and one of Bordeaux's greatest aging potentials.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, aged Comté, or wild mushroom risotto.

 

100 Points - James Suckling

This has incredible power and drive with blackberry, black olive and graphite. It’s full-bodied, yet dynamic and agile, with so much polished and muscular tannin. Yet, it remains in harmony and balance. So much character. The head of the château calls it diabolical beauty. 25% less production than the 2019. 52% Cabernet Sauvignon, 42% Merlot, 3% Cabernet Franc and 3% Petit Verdot.

99 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Another wine I underrated on release, the 2020 Château Haut-Bailly is just about pure perfection, and whereas the 2018 is closer in style to the 2009, this plays things a little closer to its vest and is reminiscent of the 2010. Full-bodied, concentrated, and powerful, it nevertheless cuts a focused, precise path across the palate and brings incredible purity in its darker fruits, smoked tobacco, cedar pencil, and Asian spice-driven aromas and flavors. The tannin quality here is off the charts, and this beauty has everything you could want from wine.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine's texture is exceptional, with powerful dark fruits and rich tannins blending seamlessly. All this density is cut with the finest spice and fresh acidity. The result is a wine that has both power and delicacy that gives a lift to the aftertaste. It will certainly age so well.

97 Points - Decanter

Almost wild on the nose, aromatic and expressive, you can tell this is a powerful, concentrated wine with dark fruits, graphite, fresh mint and medicinal herbal touches. Pure and focused, clean, lean and multifaceted, the flavours hit the palate then melt away, giving the floor to liquorice, cedar, tobacco and soft clove spices. I love the sleekness and the sense of seriousness that the 2020 has compared to the more 'look at me' 2019 at this point. The texture and depth make this wine, with vertical layers and excellent acidity. A profound wine.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Haut-Bailly opens in the glass with attractive aromas of cassis, sweet berries, loamy soil, violets and pencil shavings. Medium to full-bodied, deep and layered, it's a concentrated, rather broad-shouldered wine built around a chassis of firm, powdery tannin that asserts itself on the finish. Haut-Bailly once rivaled Haut-Brion for the title of Pessac's most elegant wine, and I would love to see the team here ease off extraction, but this remains a strong effort that will reward patience. Best after 2030.

blue-chair-bay-key-lime-cream.title: Blue Chair Bay Key Lime Rum Cream
blue-chair-bay-key-lime-cream.bodyHtml:
Blue Chair Bay Key Lime Rum Cream is a Caribbean rum cream from the Blue Chair Bay range, blended with real cream, key lime and other natural flavours. Bottled at 15% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is styled after a slice of key lime pie: bright citrus up front, a rich and buttery middle, and a finish that recalls a graham cracker crust. The producer describes it as creamy, opaque white in the glass with a rich, well-rounded body. It works on its own over ice or as a creamy base for blended tropical drinks.

Tasting Notes: Creamy, opaque white; rich, buttery and well rounded.

Nose: Bright, fresh citrus.

Palate: Tart key lime balanced by creamy meringue sweetness, with hints of cinnamon, almond and amaretto.

Finish: Rich, with a graham cracker crust note.

Serve: Chilled over ice, or blended with coconut rum, pineapple juice and cream of coconut for a key lime colada.

jack-daniels-gift-pack-with-coffee-mug.title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey Gift Pack with Coffee Mug
jack-daniels-gift-pack-with-coffee-mug.bodyHtml: Mellowed drop by drop through 10-feet of sugar maple charcoal, then matured in handcrafted barrels of our own making. And our Tennessee Whiskey doesn’t follow a calendar. It’s only ready when our tasters say it is. We judge it by the way it looks. By its aroma. And of course, by the way it tastes. It’s how Jack Daniel himself did it over a century ago. And how we still do it today.

adictivo-whiskey.title: Adictivo Small Batch Whiskey
adictivo-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Introducing Adictivo Small Batch Whiskey. This is a 100% Single Malt Whiskey, aged in new hand-picked American Oak casks and finished in Adictivo Tequila casks, delivering a natural dark amber color.

This comes from the iconic brand known for their amazing tequilas, they have now released their own Whiskey and it's unlike anything you've ever had before.

This is the first Whiskey produced by Adictivo, and what makes this Whiskey so special is that it's finished in Adictivo Tequila Casks, giving it a unique and great flavor that other Whiskey's just can't compete with.

Nose:Notes of vanilla bean, sweet fruit, and fresh mint.

Palate:Pleasantly woody with accents of spice, smoke, and nutmeg.

Finish:Long, Sweet, Slightly toasty.

Aging:5 years.

Category:100% Single Malt.

Batch Size:Small Batch

Alc. Vol:40% (80º Proof).

mate-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Mate Veltha Brunello Di Montalcino
mate-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml: Máté Veltha Brunello di Montalcino is an exclusive, high-end, single-vineyard Sangiovese selection from the Máté estate in Tuscany, offering deeper fruit concentration and more structure than their classic Brunello. Highly rated for its aromatic complexity (blackberries, lavender, mineral), it features firm tannins, requiring significant aging potential (2025–2048+).

springbank-local-barley-10-year-old.title: Springbank Local Barley 10 Year Old 2022 Release
springbank-local-barley-10-year-old.bodyHtml: The 2022-release of Springbank's annual Local Barley 10 Year Old single malt has been made with Belgravia barley from Glencraigs Farm near Campbeltown. Aromas of digestive biscuits, summer flowers, rich malt, vanilla custard, custard cream biscuits and vibrant cherry fill the nose, complemented by notes of Victoria sponge, honey, sweet barley, sticky syrup and salted caramel throughout the palate.

busch-light-lager.title: Busch Light 15 Cans
busch-light-lager.bodyHtml: Busch Light is a light American-style lager known for its smooth, easy-drinking taste. First introduced in 1989, it undergoes a longer brewing process that produces a lighter body and a well-balanced flavor with a pleasant hop aroma and a smooth, slightly sweet finish. It is a crisp and refreshing beer with fewer calories than regular Busch.

erbaluna-barolo.title: Erbaluna Barolo 2018
erbaluna-barolo.bodyHtml: Erbaluna is an understated organic producer in Barolo, in the heart of La Morra, working in a traditional style and making gentle, less powerful versions of the Nebbiolos that are grown in this famous place. The village-level bottling is from a collection of different vineyards, all between 250-280 msl on calcareous clay soils, planted with southeast exposure. Aged two years in very large botti and two more years in bottle. Notes of violet, mushroom, dried tobacco, and rose. Best paired with getting outside with your truffle pigs and dogs and ending the day by a crackling fire.

take-it-to-the-grave-shiraz.title: Fourth Wave Wine Take It To The Grave Shiraz 2021 750ml
take-it-to-the-grave-shiraz.bodyHtml: This full-bodied Shiraz is made with low yields, reflecting the superior quality and care that went into its production. The wine is aged in French oak barrels and has a deep garnet colour, with aromas of jammy fruit and earthy oak. On the palate, the wine reveals a velvety texture and notes of blackberry, cassis and clove. Enjoy now or cellar for up to 10 years.

a-mavam-passion-moscato.title: A Mavam Tennation Pink Strawberry NV 750ml

fireball-candy-cane.title: Fireball Cinnamon Whisky Fire Keg 5.25L
fireball-candy-cane.bodyHtml:
The absolute ultimate party centerpiece! The Fireball Fire Keg takes the wildly popular, cinnamon-infused Canadian whisky and packs a massive 5.25 liters of it into a bright red, fully functional keg equipped with a dual-spout dispenser. Bottled at an easy-drinking 66 proof (33% ABV), it delivers the iconic "sweet-heat" experience—a perfect balance of smooth whisky and fiery cinnamon spice. Whether you are hosting a tailgate, a backyard barbecue, or a massive celebration, this eye-catching keg holds over 115 shots and guarantees the party won't run dry anytime soon.

 

NOSE

Massive, unmistakable aromas of sweet cinnamon candy, warm baking spices, and a subtle hint of vanilla.

PALATE

Thick, syrupy, and intensely flavorful. A heavy rush of sweet, sugary cinnamon is quickly followed by a signature, fiery chili-like heat that completely masks the underlying whisky base.

FINISH

Long, lingering, and fiercely warm, leaving a highly satisfying sweet and spicy cinnamon burn.

well-juice-charcoal-lemonade-vodka.title: New Amsterdam Pink Whitney Pink Lemonade Flavoured Vodka
well-juice-charcoal-lemonade-vodka.bodyHtml:
New Amsterdam Pink Whitney is a pink lemonade flavoured vodka from the New Amsterdam range of E. & J. Gallo, bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The flavour grew out of a collaboration between Barstool Sports and New Amsterdam and was inspired by the favourite drink of former NHL player Ryan Whitney, co-host of the Spittin' Chiclets podcast, before going viral with hockey fans. New Amsterdam vodka is infused with pink lemonade flavour for a bright, sweet-tart profile with natural lemon zest and a clean, refreshing finish. Its lower strength and easy-going flavour make it a simple choice for highballs, shots and warm-weather pitchers.

Tasting Notes: Sweet pink lemonade, lemon zest and a clean finish.

Serve: On the rocks, or topped with club soda.

township-24-sunset-cove-tropical-ipa.title: Township 24 Sunset Cove Tropical Ipa 4 Tall Cans
township-24-sunset-cove-tropical-ipa.bodyHtml: Township 24 Sunset Cove Tropical Ipa 4 Tall Cans

amarula-plant-based-cream.title: Amarula Vegan Marula Liqueur
amarula-plant-based-cream.bodyHtml: Fruit derived exclusively from the South African marula tree is blended in a coconut milk-based recipe. This guilt-free indulgence boasts exotic notes of vanilla caramel and the distinctive marula fruit. Flavours of sweet toffee and a velvety creamy texture on the palate. Perfect mixed with brandy as a cocktail.

bellwoods-jelly-king-dry-hopped-sour-ale.title: Bellwoods Jelly King Dry Hopped Sour Ale 473ml
bellwoods-jelly-king-dry-hopped-sour-ale.bodyHtml: Bellwoods Jelly King Dry Hopped Sour Ale 473ml

bira-91-white-wheat-beer.title: White Raven India Pale Ale Cls

lagunitas-india-pale-ale-1.title: White Raven India Pale Ale Cls

dictador-xo-aurum-rum.title: Dictador XO Aurum Rum
dictador-xo-aurum-rum.bodyHtml:
Dictador Aurum Rum is made from the fermentation of unique virgin sugar cane honey, distilled in an antique alembic copper still, then aged in the highest quality pre-used oak barrels from ex-bourbon.

Finally, we use our family’s traditional method which our master blender conceives with all his skills and senses. The result is the most exquisite blend using only the finest barrels from each vintage year, approved for bottling under the highest quality control.

faiveley-chassagne-montrachet.title: Domaine Faiveley Chassagne-Montrachet 2023
faiveley-chassagne-montrachet.bodyHtml:
Domaine Faiveley Chassagne-Montrachet 2023 is a refined Chardonnay with aromas of ripe pear, white peach, lemon zest, acacia blossom, toasted hazelnut, and flinty minerality. Rich yet beautifully balanced, it offers vibrant acidity, silky texture, remarkable precision, and a long, elegant finish that reflects the character of Chassagne-Montrachet.

Food Pairing: Pair with butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken, grilled turbot, seared scallops, creamy mushroom risotto, or aged Comte for a classic white Burgundy pairing.

faiveley-mercurey-clos-des-myglands.title: Domaine Faiveley Mercurey Clos des Myglands Premier Cru Monopole 750ml
faiveley-mercurey-clos-des-myglands.bodyHtml: The nose reveals notes of black and red fruits combined with subtle woody and smoky notes. The palate offers the same rich, fruity aromas as the nose. This full-bodied wine has a velvety tannic backbone which gives a sensation of warmth on the smooth finish.

caol-ila-12-year-old-coopers-choice-bou.title: The Cooper's Choice Caol Ila 13 Year Old 2008 Bourbon Cask 51.5% ABV
caol-ila-12-year-old-coopers-choice-bou.bodyHtml:
Caol Ila 13 Year Old 2008 Bourbon Cask is an Islay single malt Scotch whisky from Caol Ila distillery, independently bottled by The Vintage Malt Whisky Co. for The Cooper's Choice, its range of single cask releases named in tribute to the craft of the cooper. Distilled in 2008, the whisky spent 13 years maturing in a bourbon cask before being bottled at 51.5% ABV in a 700ml bottle. It is presented in the series' Limited Edition single cask release box. As a single cask bottling, it offers a one-off look at Caol Ila's spirit shaped by American oak.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

tomatin-8-year-old-coopers-choice-port.title: The Cooper's Choice Tomatin 8 Year Old 2013 Tawny Port Cask Finish 57% ABV
tomatin-8-year-old-coopers-choice-port.bodyHtml: This Tomatin 2013 started life in an ex-bourbon cask before being transferred to a port cask to finish its maturation, hence the deep ruby colour. Cask 9531 yielded a total of 360 bottles of this 2013 Tomatin 8-year-old, at a natural strength of 57%.

tamdhu-winter-fruit-nas-coopers-choice.title: Tamdhu Winter Fruit Nas Cooper'S Choice
tamdhu-winter-fruit-nas-coopers-choice.bodyHtml:
Tamdhu Winter Fruits is a single cask Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from The Cooper's Choice range of The Vintage Malt Whisky Company. The spirit, distilled at Tamdhu, began its maturation in American oak before being moved into a ruby port pipe for a second period of ageing. Cask no. 9522 was bottled in 2022 at its natural cask strength of 59% ABV, without colouring or chill filtration, and yielded just 762 bottles. It carries no age statement and comes in a 700ml bottle with presentation box.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up at this strength.

borgogno-cannubi-docg-2017.title: Giacomo Bourgogne & Figli Borgogno Barolo Cannubi 2017
borgogno-cannubi-docg-2017.bodyHtml:
The heart of the entire Barolo region, Cannubi originated around 11 million years ago through sedimentation from the Padano sea. It is the most famous and renowned cru of Barolo, mentioned in historical documents that date back to as early as 1700. It has an excellent soil intricacy, formed by large clayey limestone marls and pleasant climate that make this hill one of the most suitable vineyard farming areas in the world. The Barolo from Cannubi has more elegance and longevity than all other Barolo. In this cru the winery owns vineyards that cover around 1.30 hectares, with southern exposure and an altitude that varies from 290 to 320 meters above sea level.

Spontaneous fermentation carried out by indigenous yeasts for about 12 days in concrete tanks, controlled temperature (22 – 25 C initially, 29-30 at the end ), followed by submerged cup maceration for 40 – 50 days, stable temperature 29 C. After the racking off, the malolactic fermentation starts, and it lasts about 15 days at 22 C. Ageing: 4 years in Slavonian oak casks (4500L) with a further refining in bottle for 6 months.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Delicate scents recalling pressed rose, hay, eucalyptus and forest floor mingle with whiffs of spice. The full-bodied palate offers dried cherry, aniseed and ground clove alongside taut, fine-grained tannins that leave a drying close.

borgogno-liste-docg-2017.title: Borgogno Barolo Liste 2017
borgogno-liste-docg-2017.bodyHtml:
The cru orginated around 13 millon years ago due to erosion of the overlying terrain. As a result its composition differs slightly from the other lanhe lands. Liste essentially acquired acompletion of macro and micro elements that give the future wine an unequalled complexity and longevity. Highly visible from the curves of the secondary road that rises from Barolo towards the old Castello della Volta, the vineyards of this renowed cru cover around 6.75 hectares, with a southern exposureand an altitude that varies from 270 to 330 meters above sea level.

Barolo goes well with important dishes, such as traditional Piedmontese meat main courses. Ranging from world traditions, there is gulasch in Eastern Europe. Going to Japan instead for example fish, such as Black Cod (Alaskan fish marinated with sugar, sake, miso). Moving to The United States of America, beef (angus, wagyu, bue nostral, longhorn) in the brisket cut. One recipe is, for example, onion stout beef. But if you have the pleasure, even a simple “special” toast is perfect!

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Iris, violet and ripe dark-skinned fruit aromas mingle with whiffs of leather and pipe tobacco. The full-bodied palate features prune, dried cherry and licorice alongside velvety tannins. Drink through 2029.

borgogno-fossati-docg-2017.title: Giacomo Bourgogne & Figli Borgogno Barolo Fossati 2017
borgogno-fossati-docg-2017.bodyHtml:
This cru originated around 6 million years ago through sedimentation from the Padano sea, after which the African earth plates collided with those of the Italian peninsula. Being a relatively young plot, it has a good percentage of sand in its composition that ensures that the wines are characterized by explosive floral and red fruit notes. It can be found along the secondary road that runs from Barolo to La Morra. This vineyard measures around 3.20 hectares with a south-eastern exposure that varies from 290 to 50 meters above sea level.

Barolo goes well with important dishes, such as traditional Piedmontese meat main courses. Ranging from world traditions, there is gulasch in Eastern Europe. Going to Japan instead gyoza (fried dumplings stuffed with spring onion, marinated pork and spices). Moving to The United States of America, beef (angus, wagyu, bue nostral, longhorn) in the brisket cut. But if you have the pleasure, even a simple “special” toast is perfect!

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of red berry and violet waft out of the glass along with dark culinary spice. Full-bodied but surprisingly lithe, the palate shows spiced cranberry, sour cherry, star anise and blood orange framed in taut, fine-grained tannins before a steely mineral finish

paul-john-christmas-edition-2022.title: Paul John Christmas Edition 2022 Indian Single Malt
paul-john-christmas-edition-2022.bodyHtml:
Crafted from malts finished in ex-bourbon, brandy and peated Oloroso casks, the chestnut-hued Paul John Christmas Edition 2022 from the exotic shores of Goa, offers rich aromas of sweet oak, dry spice and baked apples and peaches, enhanced with dark chocolate. Soft flavours of mellow peat, orange dark chocolate and a light peppery spice laced with delicious plum cake and butterscotch lead to a deep, creamy, and lingering finish of a profuse hazelnut.

The 5th Edition of the limited Christmas Edition series from the award-winning Paul John Indian Single Malt, this rare malt presents the delightful magic of Christmas!

Nose:

Rich aromas of sweet oak, dry spice, baked apples and peaches, enhanced with dark chocolate.

Palate:

Soft and sweet flavours of mellow peat, orange dark chocolate, and a light peppery spice laced with delicious plum cake and butterscotch.

Finish:

Deep, creamy and lingering with a profuse hazelnut laced with dark chocolate.

Colour:

Rich chestnut

old-monk-7-year-old-blended-rum.title: Old Monk XXX Very Old Vatted 7 Year Old Blend Rum 375ml
old-monk-7-year-old-blended-rum.bodyHtml:
Old Monk XXX Very Old Vatted Rum is a blended dark rum from India, aged 7 years, and made by Mohan Meakin Ltd., whose works are at Mohan Nagar in Uttar Pradesh. It is bottled at 42.8% ABV; this is the 375ml size.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or with cola or ginger ale.

crystal-head-vodka-gift-pack-w-2-glasses.title: Crystal Head Vodka Gift Pack with 4 Skull Shot Glasses
crystal-head-vodka-gift-pack-w-2-glasses.bodyHtml:
Crystal Head Vodka Gift Pack with 4 Skull Shot Glasses pairs the brand's original vodka in its iconic 750ml skull-shaped bottle with a set of four skull shot glasses. Launched in 2008, the original Crystal Head is made from locally sourced Canadian corn, distilled four times into a neutral grain spirit and blended with water from Newfoundland. It is then filtered seven times, three of them through layers of Herkimer diamonds, a type of semi-precious quartz crystal. The skull bottle is made in Europe, with crystal melted into the glass for clarity. Bottled at 40% ABV.

Nose: Neutral grain with a delicate hint of citrus.

Palate: Silky and smooth, with a touch of sweetness and vanilla.

Finish: Sweet and creamy.

Serve: Well chilled as a shot in the included glasses, or as the base of a clean vodka cocktail.

remus-gatsby-reserve-bourbon-15-year-old.title: Remus Gatsby Reserve Bourbon 15 Year Old 2022
remus-gatsby-reserve-bourbon-15-year-old.bodyHtml:
Crafted with the finest 15-year-old reserves, this ultra-limited, cask strength straight bourbon celebrates F. Scott Fitzgerald’s iconic novel “The Great Gatsby”, from its events in 1922 to its publication in 1925.

Legend has it, Fitzgerald’s titular character ‘Jay Gatsby’ was inspired by Remus. Some say Fitzgerald and Remus’ fortuitous 1918 meeting began the ‘drums of destiny’. Others believe Fitzgerald gathered plenty of influence from Remus’ many newspaper exposés.

shelter-point-cask-strength-single-malt.title: Shelter Point Cask Strength Single Malt Canadian Whisky
shelter-point-cask-strength-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Shelter Point Cask Strength Single Malt is the barrel-strength version of the classic single malt from Shelter Point Distillery on the coast of northern Vancouver Island, British Columbia. It is made in small batches from 100% malted BC barley, double distilled in copper wash and spirit pot stills built by Forsyths using water from the distillery's own aquifer, and this expression is bottled straight from the barrel at 58.7% ABV. Natural in colour and non-chill filtered, it matures in a range of selected casks under a strong coastal influence. The distillery describes a balanced mix of fruit, caramel, barley, baking spices and honey with a seaside whiff, hints of wine and smoke, and a sweet, leathery mouthfeel. Sold in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Fruit, caramel, barley, baking spice, honey, sea air, a touch of wine and smoke.

Serve: Neat, then with a little water to open it up.

amrut-spectrum-single-malt.title: Amrut Spectrum 004 Indian Single Malt Whisky
amrut-spectrum-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Spectrum 004 is an exclusive whisky that took quite a journey from grain to bottle. This spirit was initially matured in an ex-bourbon barrel before it was transferred to a custom-built, unique barrel which was constructed out of four different varieties of oak. Spectrum 004 was named after this Spectrum cask it was aged in. The four varieties of oak included American Oak with level three charring, French Oak with slight toasting, Ex-Oloroso Sherry Stave and Ex-Px Sherry Stave. Together they create a complex single malt that whisky enthusiasts are raving about.

This dark honey colored whisky offers quite the tasting journey, beginning with very strong scents of dried fruits and Christmas pudding with a near-perfect companion of coconut cream dosed with vanilla. Next, the spirit shows off an element of sticky toffee pudding with a shade of sandalwood and the phenol that is completely dusked due to the dominating influence of sherry is said to be mesmerizing.

Tasting Spectrum 004 is a jammy and syrupy affair, and you’ll experience a cloud of mild spice dust that is quite lovely. The dust is enveloped by vanilla pudding and a creamy texture and there are juicy sultanas with an aromatic mask joined by the mildest hint of phenol and a perfect degree of wood tone. To finish, the whisky is brilliantly refreshing with a minty shade, ending with a sweet tone

macallan-classic-cut-2022-52-00-abv.title: The Macallan Classic Cut 2022 52.5% ABV
macallan-classic-cut-2022-52-00-abv.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Edition celebrates our commitment to seek out the extraordinary, revealing a unique character and flavour.

Matured in a unique combination of casks with two distinctive wood types, this special single malt exudes flavours of both European and American oak, married together to create a unique tasting experience.

With a distinct grapefruit flavour, this whisky emphasises a wide range and complexity of flavours. The two wood types complement and balance together beautifully and offer an experiential journey through flavour, aroma, colour and texture.

The 2022 expression reveals flavour notes of grapefruit, peach, caramel and light spice, a refreshing combination for a whisky cocktail to savour in an exceptional sensory revelation.

cardhu-16-year-old-2022-special-release.title: Cardhu 16 Year Old 2022 Special Release
cardhu-16-year-old-2022-special-release.bodyHtml:
Legend has it, one day the ancient black rock beneath Cardhu gave an earth- shaking crack and a great warmth rushed forth from within, unleashing a tropical paradise. Biting wind became a soft breeze and lush aromas of passion-flower and pineapple danced through the distillery and its grounds, enveloping all it touched with a rare, exotic quality. At midnight, the chasm closed, silent once again forevermore. Only the vibrant whisky distilled that day remained to tell the tale.

Standing on the wind-whipped heather fields that surround the Cardhu distillery today, the verdant lilac grounds belie the truth of Cardhu’s origin name, ‘the black rock’, Carn Dubh. From this splendoured hill, the Cardhu distillery grew with unmistakable allure. From its iconic red door, the distillery welcomed passers-by for centuries, inviting them with a vibrant whisky, crisp with the sweet taste of Scottish orchards.

Here, finishing in Jamaican Rum casks, a vibrant tropical sweetness awakens. Golden colour vies with smooth texture, as heady sweet aromas of pink grapefruit and ripe mango beguile the nose. On the palate the smooth rum toffee-sweet taste offers drying, exotic hints of spiced pineapple and green banana. Bursting with lush aromas- a whisky that tastes of paradise.

Appearance

Clear gold.

Body

Light to medium.

Nose

Beguiling first impressions begin with the fresh, sweet fruitiness of lemon zest and white grape enriched by exotic notes of pink grapefruit and ripe mango, all on a faintly mossy base, a note that evolves into freshly ironed linen. A notably spicy and woody note soars high above. A drop of water dries these aromas and introduces a pinch of white pepper.

Palate

A creamy-smooth and full texture, the taste erupting with sweet flavour. Tingling on the tongue, the fruity and malty sweetness behind this suggesting home- made rum toffee and more exotic hints of spiced pineapple and green banana, made more appetising still by spicy and drying, bracingly crisp, clean oak. A dash of water creates a delightful and even smoother texture, still strong in peppery spice.

Finish

Quite short, sweet and peppery. With water, the oaky spiciness is even more forward.

oban-10-year-old-2022-special-release.title: Oban 10 Year Old 2022 Special Release 57.1%
oban-10-year-old-2022-special-release.bodyHtml:
As our legend goes, a vivid blaze of light grew against the ink-black sky above Oban, driven by a celestial being. A sprightly and energetic creature carried on the stars, charged across the heavens and showered the sky in an explosion of violet brilliance, shedding its ethereal light on the Oban distillery. An intense vibrancy lit the grounds with hues of plum and blackberry, infusing Oban with an other-worldly sweetness, rarely seen.

On a rare autumn night at Oban bay, the shimmering lights of the Aurora Borealis illuminate this quaint coastal town and its namesake distillery. One of the oldest and smallest distilleries in Scotland, in 1794 Oban rose, bringing an electric vibrancy to the quiet surroundings. Small as it may be, its mythical nature has been written in the stars for centuries.

Maturation in refill and new American Oak, then double maturation in ex- Sherry & Amontillado seasoned casks, brings a mild nose with maritime salt and sea air. The creamy texture introduces a taste rich in sweet hints of wine- poached spiced plum, balanced by vibrant salt and spice, before finishing as chilli pepper. Rich, sticky sweetness sparkles through light smoke and salt, in an Oban of super-natural character.

Appearance

Pale, ethereal gold.

Body

Medium.

Nose

Gentle in feel, with no prickle. The top notes are faint at first yet grow easier to make out, studded with maritime hints of salt crystal, edible seaweed, and ozone-fresh sea air. As the senses adjust a very faint smokiness appears, infused with mere suggestions of lint and light olive oil, and a light note of lemon citrus fruit.

Palate

The texture is soft and creamy-smooth, while the taste shines brightly with wine-fruit notes that carry hints of sweet violet and spiced plum. The fruit is balanced by a lively spiciness first met as saltiness mid- palate, then in a blazing dash of chili pepper. A little water softens the taste, taming the spiciness without altering the balance overall.

Finish

Quite long and surprisingly peppery, leaving a smooth memory of chili pepper in the maritime aftertaste.

talisker-11-year-old-2022-special-releas.title: Talisker 11 Year Old 2022 Special Release 55.1%
talisker-11-year-old-2022-special-releas.bodyHtml:
As our legend goes, when the tides at Talisker Bay flowed with an unusual force, a luminous creature was drawn from the blackest depths, flooding the deep-sea darkness with its captivating glow. This powerful luminescence was carried on storm-tossed currents to the Talisker distillery, illuminating its new-make spirit. In that spirit too, the vivid luminosity shone, its classic smokiness fading before a radiant tide of spice-bright sweetness rarely seen.

On the shores of Loch Harport, near the western edge of the rugged Isle of Skye, legends easily ring true. Standing apart, its new make spirit cooled by the sea, Talisker has forged its own maritime destiny here since 1830. Sweet, salt-laced, thunderous and smoky, as elemental as land, sea or storm, this is a whisky for the wild at heart, Made by the Sea.

Light shines in every element here. Amid a deep golden glow, salty, smoky hints of a beach bonfire give the mild nose a maritime feel. First fill ex- bourbon casks gift layers of luminous flavour, the texture smoothly oily, the taste sweet and smoky-spicy, salty and fruity, like an orchard in sea mist. Peaty power appears in the chilli-spiced catch of the long finish. This is a legendary Talisker, of ethereal beauty.

Appearance

Deep, glowing gold.

Body

Medium.

Nose

Maritime in feel, with light spice-prickle, the first impression suggests a beach bonfire of dry seaweed, then deep-seated notes of maritime saltiness and marine engines take over, on a base of drying fresh linen. All these scents hold together well at reduced strength.

Palate

Smoothly oily in texture, while the taste is gloriously sweet throughout and smoky-spicy, with a distinct fruity hint, all of which evokes an orchard seen through smoke and sea mist. A fine salty balance in the middle leads the spiciness on into a powerful chili pepper catch as you swallow. With a drop of water, the sweet fruitiness and saltiness come into their own.

Finish

Long, sustained and lightly smoky, with lingering warming spice.

johnnie-walker-ghost-rare-port-dundas.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Ghost & Rare Port Dundas
johnnie-walker-ghost-rare-port-dundas.bodyHtml:
A blend of eight exquisite Scotch whiskies, including three 'ghost' whiskies, Cambus, Pittyvaich and the Highland Single Malt, Brora. This masterful blend shows subtle sweet flavours of pineapple and rich flavours of hazelnut and chocolate. Silky and smooth on the palate with a lightly smoky finish, best served neat.

Creamy, wood notes from Port Dundas embrace the vanilla and soft smoke from the "ghost" whiskies of Cambus and original stocks of Brora. Other very rare whiskies from Cameronbridge and Glenkinchie reveal notes of spiced apples alongside Clynelish, Dailuaine and Auchroisk, bringing aromas of peaches and berries.

nikka-yoichi-aromatic-yeast-edition.title: Nikka Discovery Series 2022 Yoichi Aromatic Yeast Japanese Whisky
nikka-yoichi-aromatic-yeast-edition.bodyHtml: This rare version of Miyagikyo single malt is part of the “Nikka Discovery” series: an inside look at the various experiments made during the whisky-making process at Nikka. Focusing on the distinctive aromas generated by yeast selected from Nikka’s vast “culture collection”, this expression is partly made from a batch which offers fruity aromas of peach and apricot. Please discover an exquisite combination of these fresh aromas and Miyagikyo’s original comforting, elegant style.

nikka-miyagikyo-aromatic-yeast-edition.title: Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt Japanese Whisky
nikka-miyagikyo-aromatic-yeast-edition.bodyHtml:
Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt Japanese Whisky is an elegant and fruit-forward single malt produced at Nikka's Miyagikyo Distillery in Japan's Miyagi Prefecture. Established in 1969 by Masataka Taketsuru, the distillery is known for its gentle, indirect steam distillation, which produces a refined and delicate spirit. Matured in a selection of oak casks with a notable sherry influence, this no-age-statement whisky offers layers of orchard fruits, floral aromas, vanilla, and gentle spice. Bottled at 45% ABV, Miyagikyo showcases the smooth, balanced character of Japanese single malt whisky.

Food Pairing: Grilled salmon, sushi, roasted almonds, Manchego cheese, dried fruits, and lightly spiced dishes.

Tasting Notes: An elegant Japanese single malt featuring orchard fruits, floral sweetness, delicate malt, gentle spice, and subtle oak.

Nose: Fresh apples, pears, vanilla, floral aromas, malted barley, and hints of exotic fruit.

Palate: Smooth and delicate, with dried fruits, malt sweetness, ginger, cinnamon, chocolate, and gentle oak.

Finish: Long and soft, with lingering orchard fruits, toasted nuts, delicate spice, and subtle oak sweetness.

Serve: Enjoy neat, over a large ice cube, or with a small amount of chilled water to highlight its delicate fruit and floral character.

rosebank-31-year-old.title: Rosebank 31 Year Old 48.1%
rosebank-31-year-old.bodyHtml:
This alluringly light and vibrant 31 Year Old leads with citrus bursts, soft vanilla and candied almonds. Camomile, berry and baked banana grace the palate, with a signature smooth finish of sweet peach, oak and herbal notes. The second in the global series of legacy Rosebank releases epitomises the qualities that earned Rosebank reverence as 'The King of the Lowlands’.

The 2nd release of these remarkable Rosebank releases, a 31 year old bottled at 48.1%. This bottling is comprised of casks that were filled in the last few years before Rosebank was mothballed in 1993.

A distillery that was held in high regard by whisky drinkers and whisky makers, it is now being revived. It will will be exciting to compare these old Rosebanks with new Rosebank when it finally hits the market.

Official Tasting Notes

Nose – Citrus burst, lime, lemongrass and coriander seed, clove with soft vanilla and sugar coated almonds

Palate – Fantastic age while still light and vibrant, mint, camomile with leather, berry and banana bread

Finish – Sweetens with hints of peach, oak and long herbal notes

chateau-dissan-2016.title: Chateau D'Issan 2016 750ml
chateau-dissan-2016.bodyHtml:
Third Growth. Troisieme Grand Cru Classe in 1855.

Expert tasting note: (2016 vintage) "Darkly pigmented, medium riby-red in color. The aromas are fresh & lifted with a violetey, red-fruit perfume. The whole wine is beautifully balanced, it is mid-weight with fine, silky tannins, lovely redcurrant & cranberry fruit. Alcohol is balanced. The acidity is fresh & there are crunchy and leafy aspects on the finish, which lasts well. Elegant & poised, it will age beautifully." - 03/23 DCAMW

chateau-puybarbe.title: Astral de Chateau Puybarbe
chateau-puybarbe.bodyHtml:
Astral de Château Puybarbe is a vibrant, elegant, and deeply expressive red wine crafted at the highest elevation of the Right Bank within the historic Côtes de Bourg appellation. Commanding a south-sloping plateau looking over the Gironde estuary, this sustainably farmed property shapes a beautifully balanced and terroir-driven blend led predominantly by Merlot. Following meticulous berry selection, a extensive cold maceration, and extended concrete-tank and oak vinification, the wine unrolls an opulent, layered profile in the glass. It exhibits a deep, inky ruby core with shimmering purple reflections along the rim. On the nose, it delivers a striking aromatic bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, wild dark bramble berries, and black plums, seamlessly layered with subtle nuances of sweet vanilla, fresh lemongrass, cedar, and discreet baking spices. The palate is medium-to-full-bodied, driving a juicy, dense core of concentrated dark fruit flavors across a fresh backbone of lively acidity and grainy, fine-grained structural tannins before concluding with a long, clean, and mildly spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted duck breast, savory game meats, grilled chicken skewers, or hearty mediterranean salads.

pavillon-rouge-du-ch-margaux.title: Chateau Margaux Pavillon Rouge Du Chateau Margaux 2016 750ml

old-forester-birthday-bourbon-2022.title: Old Forester Birthday Bourbon 2022
old-forester-birthday-bourbon-2022.bodyHtml:
Old Forester’s 22nd iteration of its limited-edition, vintage-dated Birthday Bourbon created in celebration of founder George Garvin Brown’s birthday. This year marks the 152nd year of the company he began in 1870.
