The 2022 Birthday Bourbon is presented at 96 proof. After showing exceptionally unique character during a tasting panel, the 11-year old barrels were chosen specifically for Birthday Bourbon. The full allotment of product represents one day’s production of Old Forester.

sawtooth-brewery-hop-squish-no-2-ipa.title: Sawtooth Brewery Hop Squish No.2 Ipa 4 Tall Cans
sawtooth-brewery-hop-squish-no-2-ipa.bodyHtml: Sawtooth Brewery Hop Squish No.2 Ipa 4 Tall Cans

saintly-the-good-sparkling-rose.title: Saintly The Good Sparkling Rose Gold 750ml

absolut-vanilia.title: Absolut Vanilia Vodka
absolut-vanilia.bodyHtml:
Absolut Vanilia Vodka is a premium flavored vodka produced by Absolut in Åhus, Sweden. Crafted using natural vanilla flavor with no added sugar, it features a rich, robust character with subtle notes of dark chocolate and butterscotch.

Food Pairing: Vanilla bean desserts, dark chocolate truffles, berry tarts, caramel puddings, or fruit salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear and colorless in appearance with a smooth, velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich, sweet vanilla, accompanied by subtle hints of dark chocolate and caramel.

Palate : Complex and smooth with distinct vanilla flavors, gentle grain sweetness, and undertones of cocoa.

Finish : Clean, warm, and persistent with a long-lasting vanilla sweetness.

Serve : Serve chilled neat, on the rocks, or as a key base ingredient in cocktails such as an Espresso Martini or Passion Fruit Martini.

alias-pinot-noir.title: Alias Pinot Noir
alias-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: A shining ruby color in the glass. Delicious notes of raspberry and vanilla fill the bouquet, rounded out with softer notes of black cherry, cola, and light minerality. Creamy flavors of raspberry continue onto the palate, met with rich vanilla, lively acid, and a decadent chocolatey finish. This is a perfect wine to enjoy on its own, and can also pair with any chicken or pork dish, and just about anything else.

seguin-manuel-mercurey-vieilles-vignes.title: Seguin-Manuel Mercurey Vieilles Vignes 2019 750ml
seguin-manuel-mercurey-vieilles-vignes.bodyHtml: This red wine is relatively light and can pair with a wide variety of foods. The grape prefers cooler climates and the wine is most often associated with

islay-violets-33.title: Lagavulin 16 Year Old
islay-violets-33.bodyHtml: Considered by many to be the benchmark for Islay malts this classic pours a golden amber colour and wafts from your glass with intense smoky peat and iodine. The palate is full flavour, rich and smooth with peat, figs, dates, and vanilla followed by an enduring smoky and dry finish.

leviathan-red.title: Leviathan Red 2021
leviathan-red.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Leviathan reveals distinct aromas of blackberry bramble, black cherry, and chaparral. Savory spices and star anise meld with mineral, graphite, bay, and laurel reflective of the rocky Northern California terrain. With finely structured tannins, this wine is silky and elegant — yet persistent.

Blend: 63% Cabernet Sauvignon, 12% Merlot, 10% Petite Sirah, 6% Syrah, 6% Petit Verdot, 3% Cabernet Franc

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Always a good value, the 2021 California Red Wine is no exception and has darker berry fruits, some leafy herb, sage, lavender, and chocolate nuances, full-bodied richness, and a lush, round, seamless style that's already impossible to resist. This is primarily Cabernet Sauvignon (with plenty of other red varieties), and it should shine for 7-8 years, if not a decade, although I would drink this puppy in its youth.

93 Points - James Suckling

Blueberries, black berries, and flowers. Some stone. Spearmint and fresh bay leaves. Medium to full body with layers of juicy tannins that are rounded and textured. Creamy and caressing. 65% cabernet sauvignon with cabernet franc, petite sirah, petit verdot and merlot.

shibumi-knoll-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
shibumi-knoll-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, expressive, and elegantly structured red wine that beautifully captures the distinct character of Sonoma County's rugged, rocky terroir. Sourced from the historic estate vineyards that Beringer pioneered in the mid-1960s, this vintage is crafted in the style of a classic Bordeaux blend, offering both immediate approachability and excellent cellaring potential. In the glass, it presents a deep crimson-ruby color. The aromatic profile opens with a perfumed and complex bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, boysenberries, and dark plum, beautifully lifted by traditional Knights Valley nuances of wild sage, fresh thyme, and lavender, along with hints of dark chocolate, mocha, and toasty cedar oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, balanced, and remarkably plush. It delivers a savory, fruit-forward core of raspberry coulis, black cherry, and red licorice, framed by fine-grained, chewy tannins and a vibrant acidity that carries through to a long, smooth, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, rosemary-roasted prime rib, venison stew, wild mushroom risotto, and mature, sharp cheddar cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

Perfumed aromas of red currants, lavender, fresh thyme and graphite. The palate is medium-bodied with plush tannins and balanced acidity, giving flavors of raspberry coulis, red licorice and baking spices. Very soft and delicate, with a nicely constructed backbone.

titos-handmade-vodka-with-titos-50ml.title: Tito's Handmade Vodka
titos-handmade-vodka-with-titos-50ml.bodyHtml:
Tito's Handmade Vodka is a premium American vodka produced in Austin, Texas, by Fifth Generation, Inc. at the Mockingbird Distillery. Founded in 1997 by Tito Beveridge, it is micro-distilled six times in traditional copper pot stills from a 100% yellow corn mashbill, resulting in an unaged, naturally gluten-free spirit renowned for its smooth texture and subtle corn sweetness.

Food Pairing: Fresh seafood (such as oysters and shrimp cocktail), smoked salmon, cured meats, light salads, caviar, and citrus-infused poultry dishes.

Tasting Notes - A crystal-clear spirit with a smooth, slightly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose - Light and clean, featuring subtle hints of sweet corn, soft grain, and gentle citrus.

Palate - Exceptionally smooth and clean with a mild sweetness from the corn base, accompanied by subtle notes of black pepper, roasted grain, and light vanilla.

Finish - Clean, crisp, and warm with a lingering smoothness and a subtle sweet grain note.

Serve - Serve chilled, on the rocks, straight from the freezer as a shot, or mixed into cocktails such as a Moscow Mule, Bloody Mary, or Vodka Soda.

glenfarclas-105-cask-strength-mini.title: Glenfarclas 105 Cask Strength 50ml
glenfarclas-105-cask-strength-mini.bodyHtml: The youthful grape comes in clean, juicy bunches; the herbs and spices on a rack on the kitchen wall; Taste: Any lovers of the old Jennings books will here do a Mr Wilkins explosive snort as the magnificent barley-grape mix is propelled with the force of dynamite into the taste buds; survivors of this experience still able to speak may mention something about cocoa notes forming; Finish: Long, luxurious, with a pulsing vanilla-grape mix and a build up of spices; light oils intensify and elongate; Balance: I doubt if any restorative on the planet works quite as well as this one does. Or if any sherry cask whisky is so clean and full of the joys of Jerez. A classic malt which has upped a gear or two and has become exactly what it is: a whisky of pure brilliance … Score – 95.5. (Jim Murray, Whisky Bible, 2017).

private-collection-linkwood-1973.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Linkwood 1973 47 Year Old 51.4%
private-collection-linkwood-1973.bodyHtml:
Rich vanilla aromas complement sweet treacle and Medjool dates. Milk chocolate notes develop alongside festive spice. Smooth and creamy flavours of stewed apples lead to soft citrus zest. Subtle cracked black pepper gives way to sultanas and toasted almonds.

Refill Sherry Hogshead

Cask #4359

188 Bottle

g-m-connoisseurs-choice-linkwood-1988.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Linkwood 32 Year Old 1988 First Fill Sherry Butt Cask 2779 55% ABV
g-m-connoisseurs-choice-linkwood-1988.bodyHtml:
A first fill sherry butt of Linkwood 1988, bottled as a 32-year-old by Gordon & MacPhail for their Connoisseurs Choice Cask Strength series, yielding 489 bottles at 55%.

Linkwood's quintessential Speyside spirit makes a perfect foil for either bourbon or sherry casks, and at a natural cask strength of 55% we'd expect this heavily-sherried 32-year-old to be a fabulous drop.

First Fill Sherry Butt

Cask Number #2779

Bottle release of 489 bottles

g-m-connoisseurs-choice-mortlach-1989.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Mortlach 31 Year Old 1989 Refill Sherry Hogshead Cask 4304 54.2% ABV
g-m-connoisseurs-choice-mortlach-1989.bodyHtml: Rich brown sugar and stewed apples lead to glacé cherries and raisins alongside a subtle touch of honey and ginger. Dark honey and almond flavours lead to raisins, warm ginger and lingering fruit loaf. A light and delicate finish with soft cherries and toasted almonds.

chappellet-signature-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Chappellet Signature Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
chappellet-signature-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Chappellet Signature Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a hallmark Napa Valley red wine crafted by the legendary Chappellet Winery, situated on the high-elevation slopes of Pritchard Hill. Sourced predominantly from rugged, well-drained volcanic soils, this mountain-grown Cabernet Sauvignon is blended with small percentages of complementary Bordeaux varietals to enhance its depth and complexity. Aged in French oak barrels, the 2022 vintage presents a deep ruby-purple hue accompanied by expressive aromas of dark blackberry, cassis, black cherry, graphite, sweet tobacco, and toasted cocoa spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and impeccably structured, framing intense dark stone fruit with firm, fine-grained mountain tannins and vibrant acidity that leads into a long, memorable finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime grilled ribeye, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison tenderloin, wild mushroom ragù, and aged cheddar.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Concentration and complexity join forces with aromas of mountain herbs, cedar carrying into flavors of cassis and dark chocolate, graphite and integrated oak spices. Juicy with intensity and an a mouthwatering finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

The nose is deep and savory with aromas of poached blood plums, cedar and tobacco leaves. The palate is full-bodied with finely integrated tannins and bright acidity, showing notes of mulberries, blackcurrants and mocha. Giving and powerful. Drinkable now, but best from 2028.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Well-priced for the quality, Chappellet's 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon Signature serves up bold aromas of mocha, cassis and black cherries. In the mouth, it's full-bodied and packed with flavor, nicely concentrated and framed by supple tannins. It's not overripe—a real risk this vintage—but does have a pronounced mocha note on the lingering finish.

khortytsa-platinum-1.title: Khor Platinum Vodka 1L
khortytsa-platinum-1.bodyHtml:
Khor Platinum Vodka comes from Khor, a Ukrainian vodka brand launched in 1998 and part of the Global Spirits group, and is labelled Khor Khortytsa Platinum. Khor describes it as one of few corn-based vodkas: it is made from Luxe, a multi-distilled, 100% corn-based rectified spirit, and artesian drinking water that passes four separate stages of filtration, then silver-filtered and passed through a birch and alder charcoal filter. The producer credits this process with a clean, balanced and soft finish and recommends Platinum above all as a vodka for cocktails. Khor's vodkas are gluten free, and Drinks International has ranked Khor among the three best-selling vodkas in the world for five years running. This 1L bottle is 40% ABV.

Tasting Notes: Clean and balanced.

Finish: Clean, balanced and soft.

Serve: Well chilled, or as the base for a Screwdriver, Moscow Mule or Bloody Mary.

old-falcon-williams-pear-brandy.title: Stara Sokolova Viljamovka Williams Pear Brandy
old-falcon-williams-pear-brandy.bodyHtml:
Stara Sokolova Viljamovka is a Serbian fruit brandy (rakija) distilled from ripe Williams pears, bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle. In Alberta it is listed under the English name Old Falcon Williams Pear Brandy. The producer, which bills itself as the most awarded Serbian rakija house, points to a family tradition of rakija making that goes back seven generations. The spirit is made entirely from Williams pear, a variety valued for its gentle sweetness and soft flavour, and it is double distilled in old copper stills. The result is a clear brandy with a refined aroma, a pronounced, pleasant pear scent and a fruity taste that lingers.

Tasting Notes: Fresh Williams pear, light floral notes and a soft, subtly sweet fruitiness.

Nose: Light and crisp, with floral notes and a pronounced pear aroma.

Palate: Soft and subtly sweet, with a fruity pear taste that lingers.

Serve: As an aperitif, chilled to about 14°C, as the producer recommends.

old-falcon-quince-brandy.title: Stara Sokolova Dunja Quince Eau-de-Vie
old-falcon-quince-brandy.bodyHtml:
Stara Sokolova Dunja is a Serbian quince brandy (rakija) bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle; it is also known by the English name Old Falcon Quince Brandy. The producer makes it from selected, fully ripe fruit of what it calls the highest quality quince variety in Serbia, the Leskovac quince. It is double distilled in old copper stills to balance the natural sweetness and tartness of the fruit. The carton names R.B. Global of Užice as the maker and the label describes the spirit as a fruit rakija made from quince. It is a clear, intensely aromatic fruit spirit in the traditional Balkan style.

Tasting Notes: Strongly aromatic quince; penetrating, long-lasting and powerful on the palate with fruity freshness.

Serve: Slightly chilled to cellar temperature, about 16°C.

zuta-dunja-quince-brandy.title: Distillery Zaric Dunjevaca Quince Brandy
zuta-dunja-quince-brandy.bodyHtml: Zuta Dunja Quince Brandy is a unique spirit crafted in Serbia using traditional distilling methods. Produced from quince harvested from local orchards and aged in small oak barrels, the brandy has a delicately balanced flavor of stone fruit and a light, fresh finish.

nativ-quattronotti.title: Montemajor Quattronotti Appassimento Limited Edition Night Harvest
nativ-quattronotti.bodyHtml:
The Montemajor Quattronotti Appassimento Limited Edition Night Harvest is a monumental, deeply concentrated, and unapologetically rich Old World red wine that celebrates the unique sun-drenched viticulture of southern Puglia. It pours a dense, impenetrable ruby-garnet colour with deep purple reflections in the glass. The nose opens with a brooding, highly aromatic bouquet of blackberry compote, plum jam, and black dates, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of sweet vanilla, dried tobacco leaf, and warm baking spices. On the palate, this full-bodied Negroamaro is remarkably velvety, plush, and heavy-set, enveloping the mouth with pure intensities of jammy dark fruits and an obvious structural richness. Vinified using the traditional appassimento method where grapes are intentionally partially dried to concentrate sugars and flavor extract, its residual sweetness is neatly integrated. It features chewy, supple tannins and a well-balanced framework, carrying into a long, warming finish accented by a trailing note of bitter chocolate, mint, and savory wild herbs.
Food Pairing: This intensely rich, sweet-toned style pairs beautifully with bold, savory, or smoky options, including slow-cooked barbecued ribs, gourmet beef burgers, caramelized eggplant parmigiana or lasagna, roasted lamb shanks, and hard or aged artisanal cheeses.

malecon-12-year-old-gift-pack.title: Rum Malecon Reserva Superior 12 Year Old Rum Gift Pack
malecon-12-year-old-gift-pack.bodyHtml:
Rum Malecon 12 Year Old is an aged rum from Panama, matured for 12 years and bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle. This gift pack includes two glasses, making it a ready-made present for a rum lover.

Serve: Neat or over a large ice cube.

nederburg-hh-motorcycle-marvel-red-blend.title: Nederburg Heritage Heroes 'The Motorcycle Marvel' 2017
nederburg-hh-motorcycle-marvel-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Nederburg Heritage Heroes 'The Motorcycle Marvel' 2017 is a rich, full-bodied, Rhône-style red blend honoring legendary former cellar-master Günter Brözel. Aged for 26 months in French, American, and Eastern European oak, it exhibits complex aromas of sweet spices, dark berries, dates, pepper, and subtle tobacco leaf. The palate is rich and intense with supple, silky tannins, delivering a harmonious balance of dark fruit flavors, warm spice notes, and integrated wood structure.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with roasted meats, barbecued steaks, spicy chicken dishes, five-spice pork ribs, and intensely flavored pasta.

three-olives-triple-shot-espresso-vodka.title: Three Olives Espresso Vodka
three-olives-triple-shot-espresso-vodka.bodyHtml:
Three Olives Espresso Vodka is a vibrant, flavored vodka designed for effortless mixing. Recently rebranded and now crafted in the USA, this zero-sugar expression is built on a smooth vodka base and infused with the rich, all-natural flavors of roasted Arabica coffee beans.

On the nose, it delivers bold, dark roasted coffee aromas underlain by hints of dark chocolate and vanilla bean. The palate is rich, balanced, and deeply chocolatey, making it a perfect, straightforward base for Espresso Martinis, Mudslides, or pouring directly over ice.

strathcona-big-sexy-funk-ipa.title: Strathcona Big Sexy Funk Ipa 4 Tall Cans
strathcona-big-sexy-funk-ipa.bodyHtml: Strathcona Big Sexy Funk Ipa 4 Tall Cans

cavit-roscato-gold.title: Cavit Roscato Gold Rosso Dolce Sweet Red
cavit-roscato-gold.bodyHtml:
Cavit Roscato Gold Rosso Dolce Sweet Red is a charming, beautifully balanced, and highly expressive Italian sweet red wine that elevates the brand's signature profile into a slightly more refined, premium expression. Expertly crafted by the renowned Cavit winemaking cooperative, this "Gold" rendition is sourced from select, sun-drenched vineyards across Northern Italy's expansive Trevenezie zone. To lock in its vibrant character, a proprietary blend of native and international red grape varieties undergoes low-temperature skin maceration for several days before fermentation is carefully stopped. This precise technique captures the fruit's rich natural sugars while adding a slightly fuller body and an extra touch of lively frizzante effervescence compared to the classic Rosso Dolce. In the glass, it reveals a bright, pale ruby-red color with persistent, fine bubbles. The highly expressive nose opens with a varied and aromatic bouquet of sweet red cherries, blackberries, and wild strawberries, beautifully laced with sophisticated undertones of fresh violet petals and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-light-bodied, crisp, and remarkably smooth, showing an engaging, fruit-forward fluid coherence. Its lush core of dark berry sweetness is effortlessly counterbalanced by a clean line of natural acidity, leading into a soft, persistent finish that fades gently without feeling cloying.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with loaded homemade beef lasagna, spicy Buffalo wings with blue cheese dip, rich chocolate fudge cake, or mild creamy cheeses.

peaky-blinder-blended-irish-whiskey.title: Peaky Blinders Irish Whiskey
peaky-blinder-blended-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Peaky Blinder Irish Whiskey is a small-batch, triple-distilled blended Irish whiskey associated with Sadler’s Peaky Blinder range. It combines grain and malt whiskey and is bottled at 40% ABV, with a fruit-forward profile featuring apple, blackcurrant, apricot, chocolate, toasted oak and spice.

Food Pairing: Roast pork, smoked meats, mature cheddar, roasted nuts, dark chocolate and fruit-based desserts.

Tasting Notes: Blackcurrant, apple, vanilla toffee, apricot, chocolate, toasted oak, dried citrus peel and cinnamon.

Nose: Blackcurrant and apple with vanilla, toffee and gentle malt notes.

Palate: Smooth and fruity with melted chocolate, apricot, toasted oak and dried citrus peel.

Finish: Warm with lingering fruit, oak and cinnamon spice.

Serve: Neat, over ice or in classic Irish whiskey cocktails.

bodyguard-by-daou.title: DAOU Bodyguard Red 2022 750ml
bodyguard-by-daou.bodyHtml:
The Bodyguard is the latest masterwork from Winemaker Daniel Daou. Bodyguard is an innovative blend of predominately Petit Verdot and Petite Sirah - two varieties that achieve elegant harmony in the hands of Chief Winemaker Daniel Daou. The 2022 vintage boasts a deep garnet hue with aromas of ripe plum, berry compote, blackberry and clove, underlain by hints of pine, cedar and vanilla. Juicy, velvety textures expand with layers of mixed berry flavors. A medium-bodied mouthfeel finishes with bright, silky tannins.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

 Toasted pecan, baked blackberry and cardamom aromas make for a soothing nose on this bottling. The palate is toasty as well, with espresso bean, blackberry and pepper flavors.

malecon-15-year-old-gift-pack.title: Rum Malecon Reserva Superior 15 Year Old Rum Gift Pack
malecon-15-year-old-gift-pack.bodyHtml:
Malecon Reserva Superior 15 Year Old Gift Pack is an aged rum from Panama made by Rum Malecon, which follows an old-school Cuban-style recipe. It comes in a gift pack. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or over a large ice cube.

malecon-10-year-old-gift-pack.title: Rum Malecon Reserva Superior 10 Year Old Rum Gift Pack
malecon-10-year-old-gift-pack.bodyHtml:
Malecon Reserva Superior 10 Year Old Gift Pack is an aged rum from Panama made by Rum Malecon, which follows an old-school Cuban-style recipe. It comes in a gift pack. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or over a large ice cube.

fantini-impari-nero-davola.title: Vigneti Zabu Impari Nero d'Avola 2021
fantini-impari-nero-davola.bodyHtml: Vigneti Zabu Nero d'Avola is an intense, ruby red with purplish highlights and aromas of red berries, balsamic and floral notes. Warm on the palate with a long-lasting finish and a finale of woodland flowers.

malecon-esplendida-1992.title: Rum Malecon Seleccion Esplendida Vintage 1992 Rum
malecon-esplendida-1992.bodyHtml:
Malecon Seleccion Esplendida 1992 is an aged rum from Panama made by Rum Malecon, which follows an old-school Cuban-style recipe. Distilled from molasses in 1992, it was aged for 25 years in oak casks. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or over a large ice cube.

laphroaig-quarter-cask-2.title: Laphroaig Quarter Casks
laphroaig-quarter-cask-2.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Quarter Cask is an iconic Islay single malt Scotch whisky that revives the historic tradition of aging whisky in smaller casks. After an initial maturation in standard ex-bourbon barrels, the spirit is transferred into smaller American oak quarter casks, creating up to 30% greater contact between the wood and the liquid. This accelerated maturation imparts a soft, velvety sweetness that balances Laphroaig's signature powerful peat smoke, medicinal brine, and coastal intensity without chill filtration.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked meats, charred steak, oysters on the half shell, strong blue cheeses such as Roquefort or Stilton, and rich dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Sparkling golden amber with a medium-to-full body and a rich, oily, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Powerful peat smoke, medicinal iodine, sea salt spray, sweet coconut, soft vanilla, and ripe banana.

Palate : Deep, complex, and full-bodied with a surge of peat embers, ash, and brine balanced by sweet vanilla cream, coconut, toffee, and toasted oak spice.

Finish : Very long, dry, and smoky with lingering notes of wood ash, coastal salt, sweet vanilla, and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of pure water to open up the sweet oak and vanilla layers beneath the heavy smoke.

terrazas-reserva-chardonnay.title: Terrazas De Los Andes Reserva Chardonnay 2020 750ml
terrazas-reserva-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Terrazas de los Andes Chardonnay is a beautiful expression of Argentina's high elevation vineyards. The wine's pale yellow color with hints of green gives way to aromas of ripe tropical fruit, such as pineapple and mango, alongside floral notes and a subtle hint of vanilla. On the palate, the wine is fresh and lively, with bright acidity balancing delicate flavors of pear, apple, and citrus. The finish is long and elegant, with a toasty, nutty character that is emblematic of barrel fermentation and aging in French oak. Overall, Terrazas de los Andes Chardonnay is a complex and satisfying wine that pairs well with rich seafood dishes, creamy pastas, and roasted poultry.

92 Points - Decanter

From high-altitude vineyards planted at 1,250m in the Uco Valley, this is a classy cool climate style with lemon and grapefruit citrus, underpinned by linear acidity. There's some weight, from partial oak ageing, which makes it a great choice for food. Crisp, clean, mineral.

terrazas-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Terrazas De Los Andes Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva 2020 750ml
terrazas-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: This premium wine is crafted with a blend of 85% Cabernet Sauvignon and 15% Malbec grapes for a complex and complex flavor. The flavors of dark fruit, black pepper, and oak mingle in a balanced and smooth finish. Enjoy this full-bodied Cabernet Sauvignon with a meal or on its own.

liger-belair-la-toppe-au-vert-aloxe-2018.title: Domaine Thibault Liger-Belair Aloxe-Corton La Toppe Au Vert Premier Cru 2018 750ml
liger-belair-la-toppe-au-vert-aloxe-2018.bodyHtml:
This vintage has a tightly perfumed bouquet of violets, dark berries and earth, just a touch of foliage. The palate is medium-bodied with grainy tannins, a touch of acidity and cassis towards a well-defined finish. It is also delicate and straightforward with a floral note and a silky, easy finish.
Enjoy it for the next 6-8 years.

liger-belair-cortons-les-renardes-2018.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Corton Les Renardes Grand Cru 2018 750ml

liger-belair-chambolle-musigny-vv-2018.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Chambolle-Musigny Vieilles Vignes Cote de Nuits 2018 750ml
liger-belair-chambolle-musigny-vv-2018.bodyHtml: This wine has notes of red and black cherry, violet and spice. The light but well-defined licorice-tinged bouquet opens nicely with aeration. The medium-bodied palate offers succulent black cherries and cassis on the entry and fine acidity. The finish is a bit tight but with time it softens.

liger-belair-moulin-a-vent-les-rouchaux.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Moulin-a-Vent Les Rouchaux 2018
liger-belair-moulin-a-vent-les-rouchaux.bodyHtml:
Thibault Liger-Belair Moulin-à-Vent Les Rouchaux 2018 is an expressive, single-vineyard red wine from the prestigious Moulin-à-Vent appellation in Beaujolais, France. Crafted from 100% Gamay grown on mature vines in the Les Rouchaux vineyard, this wine showcases the richness and elegance of the 2018 vintage. Deep clay-rich soils over blue granite contribute to its rounded texture and concentrated fruit character. Traditional whole-cluster fermentation and maturation in large oak foudres produce a beautifully balanced wine with vibrant red berries, delicate floral aromas, refined tannins, and a lingering spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck, grilled lamb, mushroom risotto, charcuterie, herb-roasted chicken, veal, and aged cheeses.

veuve-clicquot-extra-brut-extra-old.title: Veuve Clicquot Extra Brut Extra Old Champagne
veuve-clicquot-extra-brut-extra-old.bodyHtml:
In the art of blending Champagne at the House of Veuve Clicquot, reserve wines play one of the noblest parts, adding depth, complexity, and mystery to the House’s flagship Yellow Label. The House pays homage to its heritage and writes another page of its history with the launch of an entirely new wine: Extra Brut Extra Old, a premium cuvee blended exclusively from its precious reserve wines’s collection.

The collection’s first premium cuvée was introduced in 2017. It assembles six years of Veuve Clicquot’s finest reserve wines, chosen for their freshness, generosity and structure: Cramant 1988, Aube 1996, Verzy 2006, Villers-Marmery 2008, Aÿ 2009 and Ville-Dommange 2010.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A new approach for this producer, this Champagne is almost dry and has also had six years' aging before release. The result is a taut, nervy and well-structured wine that is wonderfully crisp. Great acidity and citrus flavors add to the effect. Drink now

freemark-abbey-rutherford-napa-cabernet.title: Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
freemark-abbey-rutherford-napa-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a classic, classic-styled Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon crafted from premium vineyard sources across the valley floor and mountain slopes. In the glass, it displays a deep garnet-purple color with intense clarity. The bouquet opens with inviting aromas of blackberry jam, dark plum, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with notes of milk chocolate, baking spices, cedar, dried tobacco, and subtle forest floor. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and supple, offering a dense core of black fruit flavor underpinned by fine-grained, firm tannins and a balanced, lively acidity that leads to a long, polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, savory venison stews, and aged hard cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This bold, ripe but nicely polished wine wraps black cherries, black currants and mint in moderate, fine-grained tannins that will help carry it for several years. Subtle cinnamon, clove and cedar accents keep it interesting on the finish. Best through 2030.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, polished style, with a relatively open-knit core of boysenberry and black cherry compote backed by friendly singed vanilla and licorice notes. A crowd-pleaser. Drink now through 2031.

liger-belair-moulin-a-vent-roche.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Moulin-a-Vent La Roche 2018 750ml
liger-belair-moulin-a-vent-roche.bodyHtml: Notes of dried rose petals, black fruits and soft spices are subtly revealed. The first impression in mouth is fleshy but if you prefer it more silky and delicate, then wait 3 to 4 years so that tannins can soften.

glenmorangie-accord-12yr-1l.title: Glenmorangie The Accord 12 Year Old 1L
glenmorangie-accord-12yr-1l.bodyHtml:
Originally released for the Travel Retail market, The Accord from Glenmorangie is a 12 year old single malt matured in a combination of American oak bourbon casks and hand-selected Oloroso sherry casks. The whiskies are married together, created a well-balanced expression filled with juicy red berry notes and waves of warming butterscotch.

Nose:Vanilla fudge, strong coffee with hints of cherry underneath, apricot and liquorice.

Palate:Raisins, dates, hazelnuts, milk chocolate, butterscotch, a pinch of cassia, espresso, marmalade on toast.

Finish:Drying and malty, with sultana sweetness remaining.

champagne-bartel-brut.title: Champagne Andreas Bartel Brut Tradition
champagne-bartel-brut.bodyHtml: Pale gold colour. Fine, delicate bubbles. Clean, elegant, fresh and complex nose with notes of white flowers and yellow fruit. The palate is fresh, generous, balanced and long.

courvoisier-xo-royal.title: Courvoisier XO Royal Cognac
courvoisier-xo-royal.bodyHtml:
Courvoisier XO Royal Cognac is an exceptional and historically inspired expression that pays tribute to the historic cognacs served at the royal courts of Europe in the early 20th century. Master Blender Patrice Pinet meticulously crafted this luxurious spirit by selecting and marrying deeply aged Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie with rare Fins Bois de Jarnac. Matured for up to 30 years in French oak casks, this sophisticated blend results in an extraordinarily rich, full-bodied, and beautifully complex cognac. It delivers profound layers of decadent truffle, roasted hazelnuts, and vibrant floral notes, capturing the ultimate elegance of Maison Courvoisier.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, roasted hazelnuts, duck à l'orange, rich fruit tart, aged cheeses, or a fine cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep, radiant mahogany in appearance with a remarkably rich, velvety, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Opulent and highly aromatic, bursting with elegant summer flowers, decadent truffle, toasted hazelnuts, sweet honey, and warm cinnamon spice.

Palate : Full-bodied and deeply complex, delivering rich layers of caramelized orchard fruits, toasted almonds, sweet honey, and earthy truffle, all perfectly balanced by elegant oak and warm baking spices.

Finish : Exceptionally long, rich, and lingering, leaving a warming impression of cinnamon, toasted oak, and delicate floral honey.

Serve : Serve neat in a tulip-shaped tasting glass or snifter at room temperature to fully appreciate its complex aromatics and deeply aged character.

chateau-deyssan.title: Chateau Coufran Haut Medoc 2010
chateau-deyssan.bodyHtml:
Chateau Coufran Haut Medoc is a distinguished Cru Bourgeois Superieur renowned for its Merlot-dominant style, uncommon on Bordeaux's Left Bank. Aromas of black cherry, plum, cassis, cedar, tobacco, graphite, and baking spice unfold into a rich, velvety palate with polished tannins, balanced freshness, and excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast lamb, grilled ribeye, braised beef, duck confit, mushroom dishes, or aged Comte for a classic Haut Medoc experience.

 

88 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blueberries and delicate floral notes lead into a medium- to full-bodied palate with firm, chewy tannins. The wine shows an austere, structured character and finishes a little short, though it has the balance to improve with additional bottle age. Best from 2015.

chateau-crusquet-de-lagarcie.title: Chateau Malartic-Lagraviere Pessac-Leognan Grand Cru Classe 2023
chateau-crusquet-de-lagarcie.bodyHtml:
Château Malartic-Lagravière Pessac-Léognan Grand Cru Classé 2023 is an elegant Bordeaux red wine from the prestigious Pessac-Léognan appellation in Graves. Crafted from 53% Cabernet Sauvignon, 42% Merlot, 4% Petit Verdot, and 1% Cabernet Franc, this distinguished Left Bank wine combines ripe blackberry, cassis, and dark cherry with floral aromas, cedar, and subtle smoky minerality. Matured in French oak barrels, including 60% new oak, it offers polished tannins, vibrant freshness, and a beautifully balanced palate. Its long, refined finish highlights the exceptional character and aging potential of this Grand Cru Classé estate.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, beef tenderloin, venison, wild mushroom risotto, aged Comté, and truffle dishes.

 

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Barrel Sample. The wine has powerful tannins as well as ripe smoky fruits. With its red-fruit aroma and a salinity that is typical of Bordeaux, it is a fine, structured wine with black fruits and layers of tannins. It will age well.

94 Points - James Suckling

Enticing aromas of black currants, sweet tobacco, orange peel and peach blossoms follow through to a medium body with fine tannins and spicy, meaty and lightly chocolaty flavors. It's long and flavorful yet refined. Drink in two or three years.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Plump and generous, with cassis and black cherry compote notes that sparkle with mesquite, violet, iris and savory hints. The sleek structure harnesses the fruit nicely, giving this a stylish finish. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. Drink now through 2037.

chateau-palais-cardinal-la-fuie.title: Chateau Palais Cardinal La Fuie 2018
chateau-palais-cardinal-la-fuie.bodyHtml:
The Château Palais Cardinal La Fuie 2018 is an elegant, structured, and deeply expressive Old World red wine that serves as the exceptional second label of this historic Saint-Émilion estate. It pours a beautiful, deep ruby-red colour with garnet highlights, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of graphite, cedar wood, sweet tobacco leaves, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Bordeaux blend is remarkably smooth, juicy, and round, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of dark stone fruits, cocoa powder, and a balanced freshness that highlights the excellent concentration of the solar 2018 vintage. Matured thoughtfully in French oak barrels to maintain maximum fruit purity and natural sophistication, it is driven by a food-friendly acidity and soft, well-integrated tannins that carry into a clean, savory finish accented by a lingering touch of licorice and crisp earthiness.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of refined culinary options, including prime cuts of grilled beef steak, roasted duck breast, slow-roasted lamb chops with rosemary, wood-fired mushroom pizzas, gourmet beef burgers, savory beef stews, and a selection of semi-hard or aged artisanal cheeses.

courvoisier-mizunara.title: Courvoisier XO Royal Cognac
courvoisier-mizunara.bodyHtml:
Courvoisier XO Royal Cognac is an exceptional and historically inspired expression that pays tribute to the historic cognacs served at the royal courts of Europe in the early 20th century. Master Blender Patrice Pinet meticulously crafted this luxurious spirit by selecting and marrying deeply aged Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie with rare Fins Bois de Jarnac. Matured for up to 30 years in French oak casks, this sophisticated blend results in an extraordinarily rich, full-bodied, and beautifully complex cognac. It delivers profound layers of decadent truffle, roasted hazelnuts, and vibrant floral notes, capturing the ultimate elegance of Maison Courvoisier.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, roasted hazelnuts, duck à l'orange, rich fruit tart, aged cheeses, or a fine cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep, radiant mahogany in appearance with a remarkably rich, velvety, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Opulent and highly aromatic, bursting with elegant summer flowers, decadent truffle, toasted hazelnuts, sweet honey, and warm cinnamon spice.

Palate : Full-bodied and deeply complex, delivering rich layers of caramelized orchard fruits, toasted almonds, sweet honey, and earthy truffle, all perfectly balanced by elegant oak and warm baking spices.

Finish : Exceptionally long, rich, and lingering, leaving a warming impression of cinnamon, toasted oak, and delicate floral honey.

Serve : Serve neat in a tulip-shaped tasting glass or snifter at room temperature to fully appreciate its complex aromatics and deeply aged character.

belize-travellers-rum.title: Valinch & Mallet The Spirit of Art Travellers 16 Year Old 2006 Belize Rum 56.3% ABV
belize-travellers-rum.bodyHtml:
Travellers 16 Year Old 2006 Belize Rum is a single-cask release from Italian independent bottler Valinch & Mallet in its 'The Spirit of Art' series. The rum was distilled in 2006 at Travellers in Belize, the family distillery that makes molasses rum on a column still, and drawn from cask #3 after 16 years. Only 317 bottles were filled, at 56.3% ABV, with no added sugar. A collectible sipping rum for fans of aged, unsweetened Caribbean and Central American rum.

Tasting Notes: Coconut, vanilla, milk chocolate, toasted oak, roasted peanuts and coffee.

Serve: Neat, after a short rest in the glass; a drop of water opens it up.

caroni-rum.title: Duncan Taylor Quarterdeck Caroni Trinidad 1998 24 Year Old Single Cask #37 Rum
caroni-rum.bodyHtml:
Duncan Taylor Quarterdeck Caroni Trinidad 1998 24 Year Old Single Cask #37 is an exceptionally rare, cask-strength rum from the legendary Caroni Distillery in Trinidad and Tobago. Selected and bottled by renowned Scottish independent bottler Duncan Taylor as part of its prestigious Quarterdeck collection, this remarkable expression captures the distinctive character of one of the Caribbean's most celebrated closed rum distilleries. Distilled on January 30, 1998, using a column still and bottled on February 18, 2022, the rum spent 24 years maturing in oak before being released at its natural cask strength of 50.7% ABV. Drawn exclusively from cask #37, this limited edition yielded just 281 bottles worldwide. Produced from molasses and bottled without chill filtration or added colouring, it preserves the authentic character of its extended maturation. Caroni's closure in the early 2000s has made its surviving aged rums particularly sought after by collectors and enthusiasts. Rich and complex, this exceptional rum reveals inviting aromas of vanilla pods, raisins, cocoa, marzipan and toasted pineapple. The palate unfolds with cinnamon, dried winter berries, toffee apples, honey and espresso, supported by mature oak and warming spice. Its long, dry finish offers delicate sweetness and lingering complexity. A remarkable collector's bottling, Duncan Taylor Quarterdeck Caroni 1998 represents a rare opportunity to experience the distinctive heritage of Trinidadian rum.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with dark chocolate truffles, espresso-infused desserts, caramelized pineapple, toasted almonds, pecan tart and aged hard cheeses. Its rich oak, dried fruit and spice character also complements smoked brisket, slow-roasted pork, glazed ribs and savoury charcuterie.

Tasting Notes: A rich, mature and complex cask-strength Trinidadian rum featuring vanilla, dried fruit, cocoa, tropical fruit, warm baking spices, caramel and espresso, with an elegant balance of sweetness and oak-driven dryness.

Nose: Vanilla pods, raisins, cocoa, marzipan and toasted pineapple.

Palate: Cinnamon sticks, dried winter berries, toffee apples, honey and espresso.

Finish: Long and dry, with delicate lingering sweetness, mature oak and warming spice.

auchentoshan-21-year-old.title: Auchentoshan 12 Year Old
auchentoshan-21-year-old.bodyHtml:
Auchentoshan 12 Year Old is a signature Lowland single malt Scotch whisky, famously triple-distilled for an exceptionally smooth and approachable character. Matured for twelve years in a carefully selected combination of ex-Bourbon American oak and Spanish Oloroso sherry casks, it offers an inviting, fragrant nose of sweet pastry, toasted almonds, and vibrant citrus zest. The palate is light and easygoing, delivering sweet notes of vanilla cream, tangerine, and white peach, underscored by a subtle hazelnut undertone. It concludes with a crisp, slightly dry, and gingery finish that leaves a pleasant, lingering nuttiness.

Food Pairing: Thanks to its light, floral, and creamy profile, this whisky pairs beautifully with herb-roasted chicken or mild seafood dishes. For dessert or lighter snacking, it is an excellent match for classic buttery shortbread, almond pastries, or a cheese board featuring mild, creamy options like young Gouda or Edam.

amstel-ultra.title: Molson Ultra 24 Cans
amstel-ultra.bodyHtml: Molson Ultra is a premium light lager designed for active, health-conscious consumers who prioritize a low-calorie and low-carbohydrate profile without sacrificing a clean beer taste. It is brewed in a traditional lager style but underwent specialized processes to minimize its caloric footprint while maintaining a refreshing character. On the nose, it offers subtle grainy malt aromas with a touch of herbal hops. The palate is exceptionally light-bodied and crisp, delivering a dry, smooth finish with very little bitterness. With only 70 calories and 2 grams of carbohydrates per 355 ml serving, it is one of the lightest options in the Molson portfolio.

diamond-20yr-mds-rum.title: Single Cask Nation Diamond Uitvlugt 24 Year Old 1999 Guyana Rum 50.1% ABV
diamond-20yr-mds-rum.bodyHtml:
Diamond Uitvlugt 24 Year Old 1999 is a single cask Guyanese rum bottled by the independent bottler Single Cask Nation. Distilled in 1999 at Diamond Distillery from molasses on the double wooden pot still known by the Uitvlugt name, it spent 24 years in cask (cask 28) before bottling in 2023. The outturn was just 219 bottles at 50.1% ABV, in a 70cl bottle. A rare, long-aged expression of one of Guyana's heritage stills.

Serve: Neat, with time in the glass.

hampden-dok-13yr-rum.title: Valinch & Mallet 2009 Hampden DOK Collection Antipodes 13 Year Old Rum

venezuela-18yr-rum.title: Valinch & Mallet The Spirit of Art CADCA Venezuela 2004 18 Year Old Traditional Rum
venezuela-18yr-rum.bodyHtml:
Valinch & Mallet The Spirit of Art CADCA Venezuela 2004 18 Year Old is a single cask traditional rum distilled at CADCA in Venezuela and bottled by the independent bottler Valinch & Mallet for its Limited Edition Spirit of Art series. Distilled in 2004 in a column still, it spent four years maturing in the tropics and a further 14 years in Europe before being bottled in Scotland in 2022 from cask no. 3. It is bottled at 56.3% ABV with natural colour and without chill filtration, in a 700ml bottle. The front label reproduces Giacomo Modolo's 2020 artwork Disappearing. A mature, cask-strength style Venezuelan rum for collectors of independent single casks.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

new-yarmouth-27yr-rum.title: Bedford Park Rum Club Canada & UK Rum Club New Yarmouth 16 Year Old 2008 Madeira Hogshead Jamaican Rum 58.4% ABV
new-yarmouth-27yr-rum.bodyHtml:
Bedford Park New Yarmouth 2008 is a 16 year old single barrel Jamaican rum distilled at New Yarmouth distillery and bottled by the independent bottler Bedford Park. It was released as a joint bottling for Rum Club Canada and The UK Rum Club. The rum was distilled in 2008 and bottled in 2025 from first fill Madeira hogshead number 5, which yielded 305 bottles of 700ml at a cask strength of 58.4% ABV. It is non-chill filtered and has no additives, and the label notes that it was matured and bottled in Scotland by North Coast Distillers. Bedford Park describes the meeting of Jamaican punch and Madeira flavours as something that grabs attention at once and keeps developing as the opened bottle takes on air. The label artwork, a shelf of books, is by Toronto artist James Tuer.

Serve: Neat; the bottler suggests going back to it once the opened bottle has had some air.

benrinnes-14yr-v-m-52-1.title: Firkin Benrinnes 2010 Madeira Cask
benrinnes-14yr-v-m-52-1.bodyHtml:
Firkin Benrinnes 2010 Madeira Cask is a single malt Scotch whisky from the Benrinnes distillery, distilled in 2010 and released by The Firkin Whisky Co with a Madeira cask influence. It is bottled at 48.9% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Enjoy neat, or add a few drops of water to open it up.

bunnahabhain-9yr-v-m-52-8.title: Bunnahabhain Toiteach A Dhà
bunnahabhain-9yr-v-m-52-8.bodyHtml: This Islay single malt from Bunnahabhain offers a gentler approach to peat, with a balanced and nuanced profile. Toiteach a Dha combines the distillery's signature sherry cask influence with a touch of peat smoke, resulting in a whiskey that boasts notes of dried fruit, nuts, and a subtle smoky backbone.

linkwood-13-year-old-v-m-52-90-abv.title: La Maison du Whisky Artist Collective 4.6 Linkwood 13 Year Old 2006 Sherry Butt 58.1% ABV

staoisha-8-year-old-v-m-52-20-abv.title: Valinch & Mallet Bunnahabhain Staoisha 2013 8 Year Old 52.2% ABV
staoisha-8-year-old-v-m-52-20-abv.bodyHtml:
Valinch & Mallet Staoisha 8 Year Old is an independent bottling of Staoisha, the name Bunnahabhain uses for its robustly peated spirit, taken from one of the lochs that supply the Islay distillery's water. This single cask spent eight years in ex-bourbon barrel #238, which yielded 258 bottles. It is bottled at 52.2% ABV with natural colour and without chill filtration, in a 700 ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

ardmore-12-year-old-v-m-52-20-abv.title: Valinch & Mallet Ardmore 2009 12 Year Old 52.2% ABV
ardmore-12-year-old-v-m-52-20-abv.bodyHtml:
Collection: The Peat(y)ful Pack Madness
Type: Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Distillery: Ardmore
Region: Highland
Distilled in: 2009
Bottled in: 2021
Cask type: Sherry Hogshead
Outturn: 338 bottles
Format: 70 cl
ABV: 52.2%

caol-ila-10-year-old-52-60-abv.title: Adelphi's Islay 10 Year Old Caol Ila
caol-ila-10-year-old-52-60-abv.bodyHtml:
Adelphi's Islay 10 Year Old is a small-batch Islay single malt Scotch whisky sourced from Caol Ila Distillery and independently bottled by Adelphi. Aged for 10 years in a combination of refill sherry and bourbon casks, it is bottled at 46% ABV with natural colour and without chill filtration. Classic Caol Ila maritime peat takes centre stage, combining coastal smoke and sea spray with bright citrus, vanilla sweetness and gentle sherry richness.

Food Pairing: Pair with smoked salmon, grilled oysters, barbecue pork, aged cheddar, roasted nuts, dark chocolate or charred seafood.

Tasting Notes: Smoky and maritime with bright citrus, briny coastal character and earthy peat balanced by vanilla sweetness, gentle fruit and warming spice.

Nose: Mineral peat smoke and sea spray mingle with lemon zest, vanilla and subtle sweet malt.

Palate: Ashy peat and coastal salinity lead into citrus, salted nuts, light honey, vanilla and gentle warming spice.

Finish: Long and maritime with lingering bonfire smoke, citrus peel, brine and soft malt sweetness.

glenburgie-11-year-old-v-m-52-60-abv.title: Gordon & MacPhail Archive Release Glenburgie 53 Year Old 1967 Refill Sherry Hogshead Cask 3709 48.8% ABV
glenburgie-11-year-old-v-m-52-60-abv.bodyHtml:
Distilled in 1967, and filled into a Refill Sherry Hogshead, cask 3709, this 53 year old Glenburgie has been bottled at a cask strength of 48.8%.

Stewed raisin aromas and autumnal spice complement rich fruitcake. Sweet and smooth with ripe blackcurrant, dark honey, toasted almonds and mature oak. Full and long finish with lingering notes of mixed nuts.

devona-washington-state-chardonnay.title: Chateau Ste. Michelle Chardonnay 2022
devona-washington-state-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Chateau Ste. Michelle Chardonnay 2022 is a bright, beautifully balanced, and classic expression of Washington State’s premier cool-climate winemaking. Sourced from both warm and cool vineyard sites throughout the expansive Columbia Valley, this wine crafted by Washington's oldest winery nicely captures the natural fruit purity of the region. The nose opens with juicy aromas of sweet citrus, crisp green apple, and melon, delicately interwoven with undertones of fresh vanilla and toasted oak. On the palate, a portion of stainless-steel fermentation preserves its refreshing acidity and clean mineral line, while sur lie aging and partial malolactic fermentation contribute a rich, silky texture with nuances of peach, salted butter, and soft baking spices.

Food Pairing: This versatile white pairs elegantly with grilled chicken breast, crab cakes, pan-fried prawns, pasta primavera, roasted turkey, or soft cheeses like Camembert.

silent-sam.title: Silent Sam Vodka 375ml
silent-sam.bodyHtml:
Silent Sam Vodka is a Canadian vodka produced in Quebec, offered here in a compact 375ml bottle. The brand describes it as triple distilled, filtered four times and then "polished" through pure silk for purity, clarity and smoothness. It pours clear and colourless, with mineral aromas and a light palate that closes with a gentle touch of warmth. Bottled at 40% ABV.

Tasting Notes: Clean, mineral and light.

Nose: Mineral aromas.

Palate: Light and clean.

Finish: A touch of warmth.

Serve: Well chilled, over ice, or with soda, tonic or juice.

smokehead-islay-single-malt-1.title: Smokehead Original Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
smokehead-islay-single-malt-1.bodyHtml:
Smokehead Original is a bold, heavily peated Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky produced by Ian Macleod Distillers using whisky sourced from an undisclosed Islay distillery. Bottled at 40.0% ABV, it is the flagship expression of the Smokehead range and delivers the classic intensity associated with Islay: dense peat and woodsmoke, coastal salinity, citrus and spice balanced by a layer of honeyed sweetness. The distillery behind Smokehead is intentionally undisclosed, so it should not be attributed to a specific Islay producer without confirmation. 

Food Pairing: Pair with smoked brisket, barbecue ribs, grilled steak, smoked salmon, charred vegetables, mature cheddar or dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: Intensely smoky and peaty with coastal saltiness, bright citrus, warming spice and underlying fruit and honey sweetness.

Nose: Heavy woodsmoke and earthy peat with fresh lemon, ginger and rich plum notes.

Palate: Peppery peat smoke and warming spice balanced by honeyed sweetness, followed by salt, seaweed and another wave of smoke.

Finish: Smoky and warming with exotic spice, mandarin-like citrus and returning earthy peat.

Serve: Enjoy neat or with a small splash of water. Its robust peat character also works well over ice or in smoky whisky cocktails.

calera-selleck-pinot-noir.title: Calera Mt. Harlan 'Selleck' Vineyard Pinot Noir 2009 750ml
calera-selleck-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Calera’s Mt. Harlan Vineyards are located in the Gavilan Mountains 25 miles east of the Monterey Bay. The site was chosen for its limestone soils and ideal climate. At an average elevation of 2,200 feet it is among the highest and coolest vineyard sites in California.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Another highlight among these new releases, the 2009 Pinot Noir Selleck Vineyard is made in a much more fruit-driven style than some of the other Pinots in this lineup. It boasts stunning depth and richness, but in the classic Calera style that never abandons a sense of structural finesse. Juicy dark berries, hard candy, flowers and herbs wrap around the rich, textured finish. This is yet another dazzling Pinot from Calera. Selleck is a site with a south/southwestern exposure.

92 Points - Wine & Spirits

This rocky, south-southwest facing hillside was planted in 1975, where the granitic and limestone soils helped define the Calera style of Pinot Noir, seemingly light in body with powerful flavors that extend through the wine into a lasting finish. This vintage requires a day or more of air before the depth and ripeness of its fruit become apparent, darkening from red cherry toward blue highlights, long on umami in its savor. The energy in the wine is more like the gentle glow of moonlight than the brightness of the sun. Destined for the cellar, this needs five or six years to begin to show its best.

calera-chardonnay-central-coast.title: Calera Central Coast Chardonnay 2023 750ml
calera-chardonnay-central-coast.bodyHtml:
Both energetic and enticing, this impeccably balanced Chardonnay shows its cool-climate coastal roots with aromas of Meyer lemon, white peach, and fragrant honeysuckle. On the palate, notions of tropical pineapple mingle with zesty citrus flavors, with bright underlying acidity adding poise and energy to a long, refreshing finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

A vivid, well-balanced and mineral-infused wine that punches above its weight. Flinty, stony, earthy aromas, then generous lemon curd, green apple and Bosc pear flavors lifted by lively acidity at 6.3 grams per liter.

90 Points - Vinous

The 2022 Chardonnay Central Coast comes from a blend of Edna Valley, San Benito and Monterey sites. It's a rich, forward white with lots of richness but also a bracing structure. Toasted hazelnut, apricot, lemon zest, petrol and slate build in the glass, pressing onward through the voluptuous, mouth-coating finish.

calera-reed-pinot-noir.title: Calera Mt. Harlan 'Reed' Vineyard Pinot Noir 2017 750ml
calera-reed-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Planted in 1975, and featuring a northern exposure, Reed Vineyard is always the last vineyard harvested on Mt. Harlan, yielding a wine with fascinating aromatic complexity. On the nose, red cherry and rhubarb mingle with layers of smoked game and hints of dried herbs and spice. The lush red fruit is echoed on the palate, where it is underscored by supple, flowing tannins that carry the flavors to a long, compelling finish.

95 Points - Wine & Spirits 

Reed, along with Selleck, contains Calera’s oldest pinot vines, planted in 1975 at 2,200 feet of elevation on a north-facing slope. That northern aspect may account for this wine’s gentle savor—the tobacco, the Korean pepper flake, the hint of clove and leather. The flavors are spicy and sour, the wine’s acidity rendering the texture supple and suave, like the first wisps of fog striking the hill on a summer afternoon in coastal California. Open one bottle now, but cellar the others.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Sappy herbs, flowers, forest floor, sour cherries, and raspberry notes all emerge from the 2017 Pinot Noir Reed Vineyard. This lively, elegant Pinot Noir has nicely integrated acidity, beautiful balance, and a great finish.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

There's a stunning purity of intense Bing cherry fruit that hits the nose first on this bottling, and then the region's expected waves of wild sage, dank forest herbs and spicy peppercorn converge as well. Black sage oil makes for a sappy palate, which surrounds a cranberry and pomegranate core.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Pale to medium ruby in the glass, the 2017 Pinot Noir Reed Vineyard, aged 17 months in 30% new French oak, has a very pretty nose of prosciutto, pepper, autumn leaves, rooibos tea leaves, dust and graphite with wild blackberries and earthy notions in the undercurrent. The palate is light to medium-bodied, intense and layered with finely grained tannins and juicy freshness, finishing layered.

calera-jensen-pinot-noir.title: Calera Pinot Noir Muns
calera-jensen-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Calera Pinot Noir Muns 2021 is an elegant California Pinot Noir offering layered notes of wild cherry, raspberry, cranberry, baking spice, forest floor, and subtle floral character. Silky tannins and vibrant acidity create a refined, medium-bodied palate with excellent balance and complexity.

Food Pairing:
Pairs beautifully with duck breast, roasted chicken, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, charcuterie boards, soft cheeses, herb-roasted vegetables, and earthy pasta dishes.

calera-viognier.title: Calera Pinot Noir de Villiers
calera-viognier.bodyHtml:
A gracefully luxurious Pinot Noir drawing you in with deep aromas of blackberry, briar patch, soft leather, and allspice. The dark-fruited palate delivers juicy blackberry and black raspberry framed by velvety tannins, finishing with subtle notes of nutmeg and cracked pepper.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with roasted duck breast, fennel-garlic pork roast, smoky glazed ham, or mushroom risotto dishes.

sonoma-cutrer-russian-river-chardonnay.title: Sonoma-Cutrer Russian River Ranches Chardonnay 2023
sonoma-cutrer-russian-river-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Sonoma-Cutrer Russian River Ranches Chardonnay 2023 is a crisp, fruit-forward, and beautifully balanced California white wine produced by Sonoma-Cutrer Vineyards. In the glass, it displays a pale straw hue with light green highlights. The nose opens with vibrant aromas of lime zest, Meyer lemon, green apple, and white pear, supported by subtle notes of toasted almond, pastry, and flinty minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with bright, mouthwatering acidity, delivering crisp citrus and stone fruit flavors, a silky texture, and a clean, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pan-seared halibut, roast chicken, creamy seafood pasta, crab cakes, grilled vegetables, and mild goat cheese.

91 Points - James Suckling

Bright aromas of lemon peel, hazelnuts, pastry and flint. The palate is medium-bodied with bright acidity, giving notes of grapefruit pith, lime curd and spices. Generous, with a light touch.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of orange blossom and other white flowers, lemon balm and citrus pith dominate the nose of this wine. The palate displays a streak of lemony acidity and flavors of roasted pear, cinnamon, green herbs and salty lime peel.

spottswoode-sauvignon-blanc.title: Spottswoode Sauvignon Blanc 2024
spottswoode-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Spottswoode Sauvignon Blanc 2024 is a vibrant, elegant, and exceptionally nuanced California white wine blended with a small portion of Sémillon. Visually displaying a pale straw color with brilliant clarity, it opens with a fragrant, complex bouquet of white grapefruit, passion fruit, lime zest, and white peach, beautifully intertwined with lemongrass, subtle floral nuances, and fresh herbal accents. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-bodied, silky, and mouth-watering structure driven by crisp, integrated acidity, carrying juicy citrus, tropical fruit, and crushed-stone mineral tones seamlessly into a long, clean, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, grilled sea bass, goat cheese crostini, pan-seared scallops, and asparagus risotto.

93 Points - James Suckling

So fresh, citrusy, clean and minerally. A classic style of white that blends herbaceous aromas of snap peas and thyme with lemon, grapefruit and white peach flavors. Contains 5% semillon grapes from old vines. Drink now.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Spottswoode's 2024 Sauvignon Blanc draws fruit from both Sonoma (57%) and Napa (43%), incorporating 6% Sémillon as well. Fermented and matured in a mix of new and used French oak, stainless steel and "other" vessels (amphora, ceramic, concrete), it's a lively wine, with white grapefruit easily combining and underpinning riper notes of fig and guava. Medium- to full-bodied, it's silky, elegant and long on the finish.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Showcasing impressive fruit quality, deft winemaking, and an exciting vintage, this Sauvignon Blanc from Spottswoode shows off what is so consistently compelling about this wine. Lively aromatics of citrus blossoms and a compelling mix of white herbs spin into flavors of ripe peach and white nectarine and carry into a sea fresh, mineral finish.

 

92 Points - Wine Spectator

White grapefruit, pomelo and fresh ginger notes are light and fresh on first impression, but the flavors and intensity grow, with lemongrass, vetiver and coriander details, plus a crystalline lemon salt element. Shows elegance on the long finish. Drink now. 4,801 cases made.

vino-nobile-di-mont-grandi-annate-riserv.title: Tenuta Di Gracciano Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano Riserva 2019 750ml
vino-nobile-di-mont-grandi-annate-riserv.bodyHtml: Ruby red tending towards garnet. Intense, complex, delicate, with hints of violet, morello cherry, ripe plum, red berries, leather, spices. Dry, with velvety tannins, sapid, balanced, elegant, with a persistent and vibrant finish.

beringer-knights-valley-cab-sauv-1-5l.title: Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 1.5L Magnum
beringer-knights-valley-cab-sauv-1-5l.bodyHtml:
Always an appealing Cabernet Sauvignon, this deep plum-colored vintage showcases a gorgeous Bordeaux-varietal blend, with sandy, fine-grained tannins, and a plush, velvety-rich mouthfeel. Built to age and develop further complexity over time, the wine is ripe and juicy in its youth with aromas and flavors of vibrant boysenberry, strawberry preserves, and cassis alongside earthier notes of crushed stone, iron, bay laurel, and cedar. Baking spice elements from the well-integrated oak work well with the more traditional Knights Valley tones of wild lavender and bittersweet chocolate. Poised and lively with a structured, juicy, mouthwatering acidity and a finish that’s elegant, long, savory, and pleasing.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with grilled steak, lamb, mushrooms, aged cheddar, and roasted vegetables complementing dark fruit flavors beautifully together.

 

93 Points - James Suckling

A full-bodied red with redcurrants, rust and black chocolate aromas and flavors. Savory. Granular soft tannins. Very drinkable. Give it a year or two to make it even better.

shafer-hillside-selct-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Shafer Hillside Select Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 1.5L Magnum
shafer-hillside-selct-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon celebrates hillside vineyards. Rugged, arid vineyard blocks, such as these, with rocky, scant soils create ideal conditions for producing wine of classic richness and elegance. This wine also exhibits the structure and beauty that are the hallmarks of wines born of the winery's location within Napa Valley's Stags Leap District. Aged nearly four years prior to release, this wine offers the pleasures of youthful boldness on release and rich nuance after a decade or more of bottling.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

In the running for the wine of the vintage, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Hillside Select is an incredible success and offers more depth, opulence, and purity than just about every other wine out there. Revealing a dense purple color as well as a killer nose of blueberries, chocolate-covered cherries, scorched earth, tobacco, violets, and exotic spices, it hits the palate with full-bodied richness, a seamless, pure, incredibly layered mouthfeel, building tannins, and a great, great finish. As with most top 2017s, it stays tight and compact on the palate, with notable structure and impressive concentration. It has some up-front appeal given its purity of fruit and balance, yet it's going to take 7-8 years to hit prime time and will be a long-lived bottle of Napa Cabernet. Hats off to Doug Shafer and the team for yet another magical Cabernet Sauvignon!

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Hillside Select displays a deep garnet-purple color, bursting from the glass with scents of blueberry pie, crème de cassis, black cherry compote and chocolate box plus nuances of cedar chest, clove oil, lavender and menthol. The richly fruited, full-bodied palate has a lively skip in its step, featuring gorgeous ripe, velvety tannins and fantastic freshness to support all the spicy black fruit layers, finishing long and perfumed. An absolute triumph!

98 Points - James Suckling

Wild blackberries and brambleberries on the nose with raw cocoa, cloves and crushed gravel. Violets and orange peel, too. It’s medium-bodied with wonderful purity and depth of fruit, interlaced with dark-chocolate flavors. Firm, well-integrated tannins. Complex and refined with fantastic energy. One of the finest Hillside Selects I have had. Better from 2024.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is the 35th vintage of this 100% varietal powerhouse, a deeply concentrated, muscular and intensely flavored wine that offers equal parts grace and age ability. Blue fruit and notes of iron, crushed rock and cocoa powder deliver a seamless palate of opulence, with lasting hints of allspice, black pepper and oak. Best After 2027. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This drips with rich blackberry, boysenberry and raspberry fruit flavors and is liberally laced with licorice root and singed alder notes, delivering a nice tarry tug through the finish as the fruit drips. Shows a twinge of the vintage's rusticity in its tannins, but it's a heck of an effort in this tricky year. Best from 2023

grgich-hills-cab-sauv-yountville-resrv.title: Grgich Hills Estate Yountville Old Vine Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 750ml
grgich-hills-cab-sauv-yountville-resrv.bodyHtml:
This wine is made from some of the oldest Cabernet Sauvignon vines in the Napa Valley, planted in 1959 to the Inglenook clone (also known as Niebaum Cabernet Sauvignon #29) on St. George rootstock in Yountville. Closer to San Pablo Bay than warmer Rutherford, this relatively cool region allows the grapes plenty of time to develop unique flavor characteristics. This complex wine with moderate tannins is aged in French oak for 21 months then moved to large oak casks for six additional months. This is a full-bodied and well balanced Cabernet Sauvignon with rich flavors of blackberries, black licorice and a hint of allspice with a long, seductive finish.

Having the patience to cellar this wine will reward you in the glass years from now. Serve with simply roasted meat dishes or all by itself to fully enjoy the wine’s complex flavors.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Yountville Selection is scented of ripe blackcurrants, black cherries and black raspberries with touches of camphor, cardamom, dark chocolate and rose oil. Medium- bodied, the palate is delicately played, elegant, soft-textured and refreshing, delivering loads of black and red berry sparks and a mineral-laced finish.


93 Points -James Suckling
Lots of currants and blackberries on the nose with some violets, following through to a full body with round, creamy tannins and a flavorful finish. Nice balance and freshness to this. Always well balanced. From organically grown grapes. Drink or hold.
90 Points - Decanter
Ripe blackcurrant and prune aromas with nutty oak spice. Rich palate with inky black fruit, massive ripe tannins, and a juicy velvety finish.

wu-liang-chun-golden-light.title: Wu Liang Chun Golden Light
wu-liang-chun-golden-light.bodyHtml:
Wu Liang Chun Golden Light is a Chinese baijiu from the Wuliangye group, bottled at 50% alc./vol. in a 500ml bottle.

Serve: Traditionally served neat at room temperature in small cups alongside food.

dassai-45-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake.title: Dassai '45' Junmai Daiginjo 1.80L
dassai-45-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake.bodyHtml:
To craft the ultimate Junmai-Daiginjo sake, we polished down Yamada-Nishiki rice to 23%. Delivering delicate floral aromas with a palate reminiscent of honey and an elegant lasting finish.

We have donated a portion of the sales of Dassai 23(1.8L/100yen, 720ml/50yen, 300ml/20yen, 180ml/15yen) to support medical professionals working on the front lines of COVID‑19.

From October 2020 to September 2021, this initiative enabled us to donate 37,664,955 yen to the Japan Medical Association, supporting those who tirelessly cared for patients during the pandemic.

We remain committed to continuing our support for those who dedicate themselves to protecting people’s health.

bouchard-pere-puligny-montrachet.title: Louis Jadot Puligny-Montrachet 2021
bouchard-pere-puligny-montrachet.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Puligny-Montrachet 2021 is a refined, classic, and beautifully balanced village-level white Burgundy crafted by Maison Louis Jadot from select vineyard sites across the Puligny-Montrachet appellation. Fermented and matured in French oak barrels (a third new) for up to 15 months, it opens with pure and elegant aromas of white flowers, lemon curd, green apple, and blanched almond, layered over subtle notes of fresh butter and wet stone minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with crisp, vibrant acidity and a satiny texture, delivering focused flavors of orchard fruit and citrus that lead to a long, chalky, and precise finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with poached lobster in butter sauce, pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken with cream, Dover sole, and aged goat cheese.

siro-pacenti-rosso-di-montalcino.title: Siro Pacenti Rosso di Montalcino 2020/2021 750ml
siro-pacenti-rosso-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
92 Points by James Suckling

Focused and fresh with crushed-berry and cherry aromas with some peach. Medium body, firm tannins and a bright, linear finish. Solid Rosso, as always. Drink or hold.

drouhin-oregon-chardonnay.title: Domaine Drouhin Oregon Arthur Chardonnay 2023
drouhin-oregon-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The 2023 Domaine Drouhin Oregon Arthur Chardonnay 2023 Chardonnay Arthur offers freshness, complexity and gorgeous flavors – a combination of the winery's specific place in the Dundee Hills and well-loved vines that were planted 30 years ago. Right up front, the nose opens with clear notes of orange orchard, lemon, green apple, and a hint of baking spice. On the palate, a delightful minerality intertwines withflavors of citrus, baked apple and honeysuckle. Drinking beautifully now,this Chardonnay should be something to behold over the next 7-10 years.

93 Points - James Suckling

Nicely broad and rich in texture, ample and welcoming, with baked apple, cinnamon, light butter and vanilla flavors. Easy and rather soft, with gentle acidity and good length in the finish.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Elegantly structured, rich and refined, with polished apple, lemongrass and spice flavors that build tension on the sleek finish. Drink now.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Chardonnay Arthur is scented of yellow apple, white peach, beeswax, hazelnuts and seamlessly integrated oak spice. The medium-bodied palate is satiny and expansive with concentrated, savory flavors. It’s balanced by bright acidity and has a long, energetic finish.

gaja-sito-moresco-langhe-doc.title: Gaja Sito Moresco Langhe 2023
gaja-sito-moresco-langhe-doc.bodyHtml: The 2023 Gaja Sito Moresco Langhe is a vibrant, early-drinking red blend from Piedmont that combines the structure of Nebbiolo with the approachability of Barbera. While earlier vintages often included Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, recent technical notes for the 2023 release primarily highlight a Nebbiolo and Barbera composition.

gaja-rossj-bass-chardonnay-sauvignon.title: Gaja Rossj-Bass Langhe 2024
gaja-rossj-bass-chardonnay-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Gaja Rossj-Bass Langhe 2024 is a refined, expressive, and luminous white wine produced by the renowned Gaja estate, blending predominantly Chardonnay with a touch of Sauvignon Blanc from vineyards in Barbaresco and Serralunga d'Alba. It exhibits a pale straw-yellow color with golden highlights, opening on the nose with vibrant aromas of ripe pear, white peach, green apple, and fresh citrus blossoms, beautifully accented by white pepper, crushed-stone minerality, and subtle oak undertones. On the palate, it delivers a medium-bodied, silken texture balanced by crisp natural acidity and a clean, long finish marked by persistent stony minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted poultry, pan-seared sea bass, grilled langoustines, mushroom risotto, herb-crusted pork, and mild semi-aged cheeses.

gaja-pieve-sugarille-brunello.title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Sugarille Brunello di Montalcino 2020
gaja-pieve-sugarille-brunello.bodyHtml:
A prestigious single-vineyard expression, Gaja’s Sugarille is the most "muscular" and structured Brunello in the Pieve Santa Restituta portfolio. Sourced from ancient, rocky galestro soils, it delivers a concentrated core of black cherry and plum layered with sophisticated notes of licorice, balsamic herbs, and crushed stone. Often compared to a Barolo for its brooding intensity and firm tannic spine, this wine offers incredible depth and a long, savory finish. It is a definitive collector's bottle built for decades of aging.

95 Points - James Suckling

Blackberry, tobacco, cedar, dark-earth and walnut aromas follow through to a full body with chewy tannins and a flavorful finish. A little austere at the end. Very structured. Needs three or four years to soften.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Macerated cherry, plum, fruitcake and iron flavors signal this ripe, brooding red. Offers plenty of fruit and a glycerol texture midpalate. Backed by broad, dusty tannins, leaving a clipped feel on the gripping finish despite the lingering essence of sweet fruit.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Pieve Santa Restituta 2020 Brunello di Montalcino Sugarille shows sweet tannins and lots of fruit at its core. This wine comes from a single plot of vines on schistic galestro clay soils. Sugarille is well-integrated in terms of its oak and its acidity, and there is enough of both to prop up the fruit and keep the momentum for long cellar aging. There is a succession of purple and blue fruits on the pretty close.

duckhorn-napa-cabernet.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
duckhorn-napa-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a refined and powerful red wine crafted from top-tier estate and independent grower vineyards across the Napa Valley. Blending 93% Cabernet Sauvignon with 6% Merlot, it opens with rich aromas of boysenberry, black currant, and dark cherry, accented by bay leaf, baking spice, and subtle cedar notes. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, well-sculpted texture packed with blueberry, blackberry, and plum flavors supported by fine, firm tannins and a long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, roasted lamb, duck breast, or aged cheddar cheese.

frescobaldi-brunello-riserva.title: Frescobaldi CastelGiocondo Ripe di Convento Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2018
frescobaldi-brunello-riserva.bodyHtml:
Frescobaldi CastelGiocondo Ripe al Convento Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2018 presents a brilliant ruby-red color with garnet reflections. The expressive nose unfolds with a rich kaleidoscope of aromas, blending ripe wild berries, cherry, and pomegranate with complex tertiary notes of graphite, bitter cocoa, and Cuban cigar. On the palate, this full-bodied Riserva shows incredible power balanced by a dense, velvety tannic texture and lively acidity, leading into an extraordinarily long, elegant, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with rosemary-roasted lamb shanks, grilled T-bone steaks, wild boar ragù, or mature hard cheeses like aged Pecorino Toscano.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Laced with bright cherry and raspberry fruit, this red is juicy and harmonious. Mineral, almond and wild herb notes make their presence felt as this plays out on the resonant finish, showing excellent length. Best from 2026 through 2042.

92 Points - James Suckling

A juicy and open Brunello with ripe fruit and soft tannins. Medium-bodied and slightly fluid on the center palate. Firm at the end. 

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Frescobaldi 2018 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Ripe al Convento di CastelGiocondo is more evolved with even more oak intensity next to the village bottling. This Riserva feels older than it really is, and this impression is underlined by the evident 15% alcohol content. The bouquet opens to dried rose, autumnal leaf and trail mix fruit or raisin. The tannins are chalky and grippy.

drouhin-montrachet-marquis-de-laguiche.title: Joseph Drouhin Montrachet Marquis de Laguiche Grand Cru 2020
drouhin-montrachet-marquis-de-laguiche.bodyHtml:
The color has a splendid golden sheen. On the nose, a multitude of aromas are a pleasure to discover: floral notes of lily of the valley, peach blossom, exotic fruit, honey, grilled almonds, even exotic woods at times. On the palate, the structure is dominated by a harmonious roundness which never imparts any heaviness. The aftertaste is exceptionally long and enhances the finesse of the whole. A glorious symphony of sensations!

97 Points - Vinous
The 2020 Montrachet Marquis de Laguiche Grand Cru is consistent with my previous tasting in January. Exquisite definition on the nose, real mineralité here. The palate is intense and penetrating, touches of orange zest and spice building wonderfully towards the finish.

gaja-pieve-estate-rennina-brunello-docg.title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Rennina Brunello di Montalcino 2020
gaja-pieve-estate-rennina-brunello-docg.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Rennina is a sophisticated, single-varietal Sangiovese drawn from three neighbouring estate vineyards in the southwest of Montalcino.
