Known for its aromatic finesse and balanced structure, the 2021 vintage is praised by critics for its "sweet and well-hydrated" tannins and exceptional integration, even following a hot growing season.

96 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of dark fruit, mushrooms and rich earth follow through to a full body with creamy, round tannins that are long and beautiful. Deep fruit and a polished, velvety texture. Excellent depth and intensity to this. Drink after 2027.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Fresh and focused, this red exhibits cherry, plum, hibiscus, eucalyptus and mineral aromas and flavors. Racy and elegant, with superb intensity and harmony. Its youthful exuberance plays out on the finish, with dense, dusty tannins and excellent length. Best from 2028 through 2045.

j-lohr-cab-sauv-carols-vineyard.title: J. Lohr Carol's Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
j-lohr-cab-sauv-carols-vineyard.bodyHtml:
J. Lohr Carol's Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is an opulent, structured, and richly textured Napa Valley red wine crafted by J. Lohr Vineyards & Wines as part of their dedicated Vineyard Series. Sourced exclusively from Carol's Vineyard—a 35-acre estate property situated in northern St. Helena along the gravelly, well-drained alluvial soils of the Napa River—the vineyard was named in honor of founder Jerry Lohr’s late wife, Carol Waldorf Lohr. Fermented with hand-picked fruit and aged for 19 months in French oak barrels (53% new), it displays an opaque, deep ruby core with purple edges. The bouquet is complex and fragrant, revealing concentrated aromas of ripe black cherry, cassis, and dark plum compote layered alongside notes of toasted hazelnut, vanilla bean, cedar, dark chocolate, and subtle cinnamon spice. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, saturated core of dark forest berries framed by fine-grained, firm tannins and balancing acidity, carrying into a long, polished, and warming finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rosemary rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison loin, or aged sharp cheddar cheese.

91 Points - James Suckling

Rich and generous, with plenty of dark fruit and aromas of blackberries, cassis, plums, cedar and spices. The palate is full-bodied with firm tannins and bright acidity, giving a structured, generous finish. Drink or hold.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A dark, extroverted style, with cherry paste and black currant reduction alongside a noticeable edge of melted licorice. There’s an inky aspect on the finish, along with a dose of ganache. A bit obvious in style but will have its fans. Best from 2027 through 2033. 1,125 cases made.

everclear-vodka-151-proof.title: Everclear 190 Proof Grain Alcohol
everclear-vodka-151-proof.bodyHtml:
Everclear 190 Proof Grain Alcohol is a world-famous, ultra-high-proof neutral grain spirit produced by the Luxco spirit company. Distilled from 100% selected grains, it is filtered through a meticulous purification process to achieve maximum neutrality, clarity, and potency. Bottled at an unadulterated 95% alcohol by volume (190 proof), Everclear is virtually odorless, colorless, and tasteless beyond its intense, immediate alcoholic burn. Due to its extreme purity and neutral profile, it is rarely consumed straight; instead, it serves as an industry-standard extraction base for homemade liqueurs, bitters, botanical tinctures, fruit infusions, and high-potency party punches.

Food Pairing: Not intended to be paired directly with food due to its high proof; however, fruit infusions or homemade cordials crafted from it pair well with light fruit tarts, citrus sorbets, or spicy cured meats.

TASTING NOTES - Crystal clear and completely water-white, featuring a thin, highly mobile texture in the glass that drops instantly without leaving traditional legs.

NOSE - Extremely pungent and sharp, dominated entirely by an overwhelming vapor of pure, clean grain alcohol with subtle, dry underlying cereal grain graininess.

PALATE - Extremely intense, hot, and instantly drying on the palate, delivering an explosive surge of pure alcoholic heat with minimal underlying flavor other than a faint, neutral grain sweetness.

FINISH - Short, intensely fiery, and deeply warming, leaving a clean, completely neutral, and rapidly drying sensation across the entire mouth and throat.

SERVE - Strictly recommended to be used in tiny quantities as an ingredient base for fruit-infused liqueurs, homemade bitters, or heavily diluted into batch punch bowls; never recommended to be consumed neat or un-diluted.

brancaia-in-maremma-ilatraia.title: Brancaia Ilatraia 2020
brancaia-in-maremma-ilatraia.bodyHtml:
Brancaia Ilatraia 2020 is an exceptionally elegant, complex, and full-bodied Super Tuscan red wine sourced from the estate's coastal vineyards in the warm Maremma region. Representing a flawless marriage of French Bordeaux varieties with the unique maritime terroir of the Tuscan coast, this modern blend displays a striking balance between structural power and refined finesse. In the glass, it reveals an inky dark appearance with intense, expressive aromas of blackberries, dark cherries, and wild blueberries, beautifully layered with suggestions of cedarwood, sweet tobacco leaf, cocoa, and scorched earth. On the palate, it is impressively concentrated, revealing a rich, savory core of black fruit and plum flavors supported by fine-grained, powdery tannins and a precise line of mineral acidity that carries through to a persistent, silky, and extraordinarily long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled beef tenderloin, herb-crusted roasted rack of lamb, slow-braised wild boar ragù over fresh pappardelle, or aged pecorino.

95 Points - James Suckling

Very pure and attractive fruit character here with blackberries and blueberries with crushed violets, dark chocolate and savory herbs undertones. Some citrus peel and wet stones, too. Full-bodied with super fine tannins and crunchy acidity that gives tension and energy to the fruit. So polished and silky. Very long. A blend of petit verdot, cabernet sauvignon and cabernet franc. From organically grown grapes.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

An organic blend of 40% Petit Verdot, 40% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Cabernet Franc, the Brancaia 2020 Ilatraia (in the bottle with the black label) shows an inky dark appearance with lots of black and purple fruit intensity. This beautiful estate is nestled within the thick forests of Radda in Chianti, one of the wildest corners of the appellation. 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is intensely spicy and warm with chili pepper and highlighting an umami meatiness. Cherries, blackberries and chocolate on the palate nonetheless give way again to pepper notes, from fresh cracked black peppercorns to chilis, through a hot finish.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Saturated with black currant, blackberry, plum, chocolate and dark spices, this red is also dense with gravelly tannins. Features flashes of medicinal herbs as this plays out on the long finish. Petit Verdot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2025 through 2037. 3,333 cases made, 810 cases imported.

miner-viognier.title: Stags' Leap Winery Viognier 2022
miner-viognier.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Viognier 2022 is a bright, fresh, and lively white wine that presents a delicate straw hue with shimmering lemon-yellow flecks. The aromatic bouquet is highly expressive, featuring fragrant honeysuckle, elderflower, green apple, candied white peach, and lime zest, all elegantly lifted by hints of wet stone minerality. On the palate, it is clean, soft, and linear, showcasing a crisp, mouthwatering acidity that beautifully supports a generous core of white peach, Granny Smith apple, and tangy lime. Subtly nuanced with notes of Marcona almond, it concludes with a long, pleasing, and elegantly spiced white pepper finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with lighter fare, fresh charcuterie boards, grilled chicken, roasted turkey, or a delicately spiced fish tagine.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of Meyer lemons, yellow cherries, apricots and white roses followed by honeycomb and sliced ginger with an underlying seashell and saline minerality to it. Medium-bodied, soft acidity and a hint of phenolics in the mid-palate. Beautiful exotic notes without heaviness. Nice drinkability and freshness.

miner-napa-chardonnay.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Chardonnay 2024
miner-napa-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Chardonnay 2024 pours a brilliant, shimmering yellow color into the glass. Crafted in celebration of Duckhorn Vineyards' 50th anniversary milestone, the highly expressive bouquet opens with captivating aromas of caramelized pineapple, ripe orchard pear, white stone fruits, and a delicate whisper of mango crème brûlée. Secondary nuances of lemon confit, salted nuts, wet stones, and a touch of warm baking spice add sophisticated layering. On the palate, this mid-weighted Californian white wine delivers a rounded, generous, and beautifully texturized mouthfeel. Its core of tropical and orchard fruit is masterfully balanced by a bright, vibrant line of natural acidity that imparts excellent tension and life. Nuanced notes of key lime pie, delicate white florals, and refined minerality extend effortlessly through to a polished, remarkably clean, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with butter-poached lobster, pan-roasted chicken with lemon and thyme, creamy Dungeness crab risotto, or a decadent wild mushroom tart.

93 Points - James Suckling

A well-balanced, generous chardonnay with aromas of lemon confit, salted nuts, wet stones and spices. The palate is mid-weighted with bright acidity and a textural, rounded mouthfeel. Drink now. Screw cap.

91 Points- Wine Spectator

Strikes a vivid balance between its juicy fruit flavors of lemon curd, tangerine and ripe melon and its touch of chewy dried apricot, plus toasty, spicy nuances. Salted butterscotch, black cardamom and gingersnap notes linger on the harmonious and creamy finish. Drink now through 2036.

frescobaldi-montesodi-chianti-ruffina.title: Frescobaldi Montesodi Chianti Rufina Riserva 2017 750ml
frescobaldi-montesodi-chianti-ruffina.bodyHtml:
As usual, Montesodi 2017 has an intense ruby-red color with tinges of purple, and this is just a foretaste to the wine's striking concentration and undeniable strength. The nose is powerful and utterly elegant, presenting an alluring succession of floral scents that blend harmoniously with rich notes of ripe fruit, red berries, black berries and plum. Hints of sweet spices bring these aromas together in an elegant way. When tasted, the density, balance, elegance and silky-smooth tannins that accompany the taste, which culminates in a pleasant and persistent finish, are truly astounding.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Balance and long, a deep well of plum, earth, leather and iron aromas and flavors show in this version, which is round fleshy, yet offers lively acidity and dense tannins. Best from 2023 through 2036.

frescobaldi-mormoreto-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
frescobaldi-mormoreto-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

penfolds-magill-estate-shiraz.title: Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet-Shiraz 2023
penfolds-magill-estate-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet-Shiraz 2023 is an iconic, deeply concentrated, and beautifully structured Australian red wine blend affectionately known as "Baby Grange." It opens with an intricate and shifting bouquet of blackcurrants, dark plums, and Black Forest cake, layered with aromatic nuances of dark chocolate, sweet licorice, star anise, and savory rosemary. On the palate, this wine is full-bodied, dense, and tightly coiled, expertly using the prism of a cooler growing season to maintain freshness and poise. The structural Cabernet Sauvignon lends focused notes of graphite, cassis, and black olive, while the Shiraz grounds the mid-palate with rich plum flavors, warmth, and fleshy fruit. Supported by a frame of fine, powder-gravel tannins and sweet American oak vanillin, it glides into a lingering, muscular, and exceptionally savory finish built for long cellaring.

Food Pairing: The bold structural framework, rich black fruits, and pronounced American oak influence of this classic blend make it a spectacular match for heavy, savory dishes. It pairs magnificently with a grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb crusted with herbs, slow-braised beef short ribs, or osso buco. It also provides a fantastic complement to wild boar ragù, roasted venison, wood-fired peppered pizzas, or a board of intense, full-flavored cheeses like aged sharp Cheddar and Gouda.

96 Points - James Suckling

This wine has been made every vintage since 1960. Refined, generous and polished aromas of blackberries, blackcurrants, cured meat, crushed stones and iodine. The palate is full-bodied with a rounded, textural palate and ultra-refined tannins that lead to a silky, savory, black-fruited finish. 51% cabernet sauvignon and 49% shiraz. Excellent. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Bin 389 Cabernet Shiraz is inky, complete, powerful and structured, with black berries, sweet licorice, star anise and fennel. There are also notes of roasted meat juices and cedar wood. The expression of this wine is very attractive—the prism of the cooler season works well in this wine. The fruit is sourced from McLaren Vale, Padthaway and Barossa Valley, matured for 12 months in American oak hogsheads, 33% new.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Distinctive for its appealing savory thread, with notes of crushed pine needle, forest floor, sage, olive tapenade, rosemary and tobacco leaf that complement the core of spiced plum, dried cherry and blackberry preserves. Offers a firm, muscular structure for an appealing backbone. Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz. Drink now through 2037.

montrachet.title: Alain Chavy Puligny Montrachet Premier Cru Les Clavoillons 2022
montrachet.bodyHtml:
Alain Chavy Puligny-Montrachet Premier Cru Les Clavoillons is a refined Chardonnay offering aromas of lemon curd, white peach, acacia blossom, and toasted hazelnut. The palate is precise and mineral-driven with vibrant acidity, subtle oak integration, and a long, elegant finish that rewards aging.

Food Pairing: Pair with lobster, grilled halibut, scallops, roast chicken, creamy pasta, aged Comté, or buttery shellfish dishes.

perrier-jouet-grand-brut.title: Perrier-Jouet Grand Brut
perrier-jouet-grand-brut.bodyHtml:
Perrier-Jouët Grand Brut is a classic and elegantly crafted non-vintage Champagne that beautifully reflects the historic house's signature floral and refined style. Pouring a luminous silvery-gold with a vibrant, fine mousse, it opens with an inviting bouquet of white flowers, honeysuckle, and fresh citrus notes of Meyer lemon and bergamot, elegantly rounded out by warm hints of buttery brioche and vanilla. On the palate, it is crisp, light, and perfectly balanced, offering lively flavors of white peach, green pear, and bright grapefruit acidity. Woven with a subtle nuttiness and a clean, creamy texture, this sophisticated blend culminates in a generous, lingering, and beautifully chalky mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared scallops, fresh oysters, roasted chicken breast in a creamy mushroom sauce, light sushi sashimi, and soft-ripened Brie.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Features a rich range of blackberry coulis, lemon curd, toasted brioche and hazelnut flavors defined by well-honed acidity. An elegant Champagne, with a satiny mousse, revealing delicate white blossom and spice notes on the finish. Pinot Noir, Meunier and Chardonnay. Drink now through 2028.

91 Points - James Suckling

A silky Champagne with aromas of apricot pie, shortcrust, croissants, lemon curd and seashells. Very fine, soft bubbles. Gentle salinity underneath the pastry notes, with a soft finish. Drink now.

decoy-napa-valley-zinfandel.title: Decoy California Zinfandel 2021/2022 750ml
decoy-napa-valley-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Big, bold and delicious, this wine greets you with alluring aromas of boysenberry, black cherry, mocha and cinnamon spice. On the palate, voluptuous berry pie and juicy plum flavors are framed by rich, supple tannins, with undercurrents of oak spice adding depth and complexity to the powerful, mouth-filling finish.

Perfectly paired with Grilled Ribeye Steaks, Truffle Risotto or Dark Chocolate Truffles.

patron-anejo-1.title: Patron Anejo Tequila
patron-anejo-1.bodyHtml:
Patrón Añejo Tequila is an ultra-premium, masterfully crafted spirit renowned for its delicate balance of sweet agave flavor and rich wood complexity. Distilled from 100% highest-quality Weber Blue Agave in the Highlands of Jalisco, it is aged for a minimum of 12 months in a combination of French oak, Hungarian oak, and used American whiskey barrels. This extensive aging process imparts deep, warm oak complexities and a rich golden color, resulting in a remarkably smooth and sophisticated sipping tequila.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with rich savory dishes like grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised lamb shanks, or dark mole chicken. It is also an exquisite companion for desserts, particularly dark chocolate lava cakes, churros with caramel dipping sauce, or a fine cigar.

TASTING NOTES A warm amber-gold color with brilliant clarity. It possesses a smooth, velvety, and full-bodied mouthfeel that elegantly coats the palate.

NOSE A rich and complex bouquet dominated by oak wood, sweet caramel, and dried fruits, underscored by soft vanilla and a gentle hint of roasted agave.

PALATE Luxuriously smooth and well-rounded. Initial flavors of sweet honey, cooked agave, and brown sugar blend seamlessly with deep undertones of toasted oak, vanilla, and a touch of baking spice.

FINISH Long, smooth, and warming with a sophisticated finish that leaves lingering notes of dark caramel, light smoke, and a trace of black pepper.

SERVE Best appreciated when sipped neat or over a single large ice sphere in a snifter or heavy rocks glass. It also makes a magnificent, ultra-premium substitute for whiskey in a classic Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

kahlua-mint-mocha.title: Kahlua Mint Mocha 375ml
kahlua-mint-mocha.bodyHtml:
Kahlúa Mint Mocha is a flavoured edition of Kahlúa, the coffee liqueur brand born in Veracruz, Mexico, in 1936 and part of Pernod Ricard since 2005. As its name says, it brings mint and mocha flavours to the brand's coffee liqueur style. This bottling comes from Mexico and is bottled at 20% ABV in a 375 ml bottle.

Serve: Over ice, stirred into hot coffee or hot chocolate, or with cream as a minty twist on a White Russian.

canalicchio-di-sopra-rosso-di-montalcino.title: Canalicchio Di Sopra Rosso Di Montalcino 2020 750ml
canalicchio-di-sopra-rosso-di-montalcino.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2022 vintage) "Produced mostly from their youngest vineyards, this Rosso represents their calling card for Canalicchio di Sopra wines: a young, fruity, and versatile expression of their estate Sangiovese. This comes mainly from vineyards located in the Canalicchio Cru, with ample clay, magnesium, iron and Manganese soils. It was macerated and fermented in stainless over three weeks, before resting one year in Slavonian Oak Barrels (50 hl and 25 hl), and French oak barrels (750L). Wild cherry, dark raspberry, balsam flood the floral palate, with graphite and gravels rolling underneath. Crunchy acidity stream this along the palate, while tight, finely sticky / grippy tannins house this through the saline finish. Ample Brunello fruit gets declassified into here, making their Rosso a hot ticket. Super smart. (Treve Ring)." - Gismondi on Wine

azelia-barolo-bricco-fiasco-docg.title: Azelia Barolo Bricco Fiasco 2018 750ml
azelia-barolo-bricco-fiasco-docg.bodyHtml:
From the top of this steep and warm hill in Castiglione Falletto, the first Cru vinified separately. Historical Cru produced since 1978.

A unique value for the family. Superlative harmony and elegance: the vines age, 85 years on average, gives indescribable aspects. Enveloping and never-ending flowers and fruits.

Bricco Fiasco shows perfectly the radiant personality of Castiglione Falletto. Extremely perfumed, floral, with a core of red fruit. Rich, warm, intensely fresh.

94 Points - Robert ParkerThe 2018 Barolo Bricco Fiasco reveals a dark and brooding character with dark fruit, iron ore, rusty earth, tar and licorice. It shows enormous precision and sharpness, especially in terms of the bouquet, with tight tannins and nice acidity.
91 Points - James SucklingThere’s a decent bead of red-berry fruit and some nut and citrus character. Medium-bodied palate with rather light tannin this year. It may expand with time.

paul-hobbs-crossbarn-sonoma-chardonnay.title: Paul Hobbs Crossbarn Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2023 750ml
paul-hobbs-crossbarn-sonoma-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Hailing from the cool Sonoma Coast appellation, the 2023 vintage showcases pale straw in the glass and opens with aromas of green apple, lemon zest, and honeysuckle. Alluring flavors of Honeycrisp apple and Asian pear are balanced by a flinty minerality and creamy texture on the mid-palate. A vibrant acidity accented by flaky sea salt provides tension and length that drives a lingering finish with notes of tangerine and guava.

93 Points - James Suckling

Very clean and bright white with sliced apples, ripe pears and crushed stone undertones. Medium-bodied, crunchy, flavorful, crisp and bright.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Bright yellow/green-hued, the 2023 Chardonnay Sonoma Coast is bottled under screwcap and is lifted and fresh with lime, white flowers, green apples, and lemon zest. It’s fantastic on the palate, with ripe acidity, a silky, stony texture, elegant ripeness, and a cleansing finish. A great value, it’s lovely now, but don’t feel hurried with this one.

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
Bright yellow/green-hued, the 2023 Chardonnay Sonoma Coast is bottled under screwcap and is lifted and fresh with lime, white flowers, green apples, and lemon zest. It’s fantastic on the palate, with ripe acidity, a silky, stony texture, elegant ripeness, and a cleansing finish. A great value, it’s lovely now, but don’t feel hurried with this one.

whispering-angel.title: Caves d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rose 2024 1.5L Magnum
whispering-angel.bodyHtml:
Made from Grenache, Cinsault and Rolle (Vermentino) grapes, its pale color is pleasing to the eye and draws one in. The rewarding taste profile is full and lush while being bone dry with a smooth finish. A blend of the best free run juices and press juices, fermented and aged in stainless steel with temperature control.

A beautifully pale pink, which is pleasing to the eye and draws one in. Fresh red berry fruit characteristics with floral notes. Ripe and fleshy feel on the palate. Great concentration. Smooth and round finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

A well-rounded, focused and delicious rosé showing dried raspberries, frozen strawberries and mild spices on the nose. Medium-bodied with bright acidity. Balanced and driven, with a lively center palate and a persistent, flavorful finish

grgich-hills-zinfandel.title: Grgich Hills Estate Grown Chardonnay 2023
grgich-hills-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Grgich Hills Estate Grown Chardonnay 2023 is a crisp, bright, and classically structured white wine that showcases the cool-climate estate vineyards of American Canyon and Carneros in the Napa Valley. Made without malolactic fermentation to preserve its vibrant natural acidity, it displays a pale gold color and opens with expressive aromas of lemon curd, yellow apple, green tea, and quince, complemented by delicate notes of toasted almonds, ginger, and struck flint minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, energetic, and perfectly balanced, featuring a silky texture, bright citrus and orchard fruit flavors, and a clean, refreshing, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roast chicken, seared sea scallops, lobster tail, wild mushroom risotto, crab cakes, or mild creamy goat cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripe yet restrained, this sits on the edge of reduction, showing aromas of yellow apples, grilled peaches, lemon curd and a touch of struck flint. The palate reflects the cool vintage with bright acidity and a layered feel, delivering baked citrus, toasted almonds and subtle spices. Rounded and fresh with a savory, lingering finish. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Vibrant, flavorful, and energetic, this Chardonnay delivers the lush, ripe fruits of its region with palate stimulating structure and poise. Charismatic and well crafted, combining ripe quince, lemon curd, lime zest, and grapefruit pith through a silken mouthfeel.

azelia-barolo-margheria.title: Azelia Barolo Margheria 2017
azelia-barolo-margheria.bodyHtml:
From the heart of Serralunga d’Alba, with all its complexity. Intense aromas, black fruits, licorice and spices in the typical Serralunga style. Energetic. The tannins frame the structure giving density and deepness to the wine. Conclusion with a persistent sapidity. Mineral, earthy, salty. Impressive. Bright, saline and sculpted in feel.

Pair it with grilled steak, roast beef, rack of lamb, lamb shank, osso bucco, and sharp cheddar.

96 Points - James Suckling    Smells like a bunch of fresh roses with strawberries and white mushrooms. It’s full-bodied with a very fine, layered palate with lightly dusty tannins. It’s extremely long and sophisticated.

94 Points - Vinous    The 2017 Barolo Margheria is gorgeous. Open, perfumed aromatics are immediately alluring. On the palate, the 2017 is a dark, mysterious wine, with layers of flavor that continue to develop over time. Dark cherry, blood orange, spice, leather, iron and scorched earth add striking layers of nuance. The tannins are potent - we are in Serralunga after all - but the 2017 has so much to offer. It's a gorgeous Barolo to enjoy over the next two decades, maybe more.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    The most structured and tannic of these new releases from Azelia is the 2017 Barolo Margheria. The tannins are quite present, meaning that you are required to afford generous aging time to this Barolo from Serralunga d'Alba, hoping that the fruit intensity will run the course. At this young stage, the wine shows blackberry and plum, with licorice, rusty nail and some crushed stone or terracotta clay. The wine's mineral signature is strong and elegant. In appearance, it reveals a lean and bright ruby color, and the power and natural richness of the mouthfeel come as a welcome surprise.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast    This opens with aromas of scorched earth that eventually give way to toasted hazelnut, forest floor, dried herbs and whiffs of iris. Full-bodied and elegant, the palate recalls cranberry, star anise and orange zest before an almost salty finish. Tightly knit, finegrained tannins provide support. Give it time to fully develop.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck    The 2017 Barolo Margheria is herbaceous with sweet tobacco, dried black raspberry, and gentian root. The palate is drying with fast building tannins and notes of tea leaf, cherry pit, and orange pith.

90 Points - Wine Spectator    Tight and firmly tannic, this red's cherry, plum, eucalyptus, tar and mineral flavors are locked in for now. Though lightly astringent on the finish, this shows good balance overall. This just needs time.

brunello-di-montalcino-vigna-loreto.title: Argiano Vigna del Suolo Brunello di Montalcino 2018 1.5L Magnum
brunello-di-montalcino-vigna-loreto.bodyHtml:
The nose is extremely complex and broad. Classic Sangiovese notes are ondisplay, particularly marasca cherry and flowers, but there are also scents oforange peel, sage, and balsamic, among others. Dense, structured, and savory inthe mouth with silky, integrated tannins and a fragrant acidity. Very long finish. 

97 Points - Wine Spectator

This sleek, delineated red grabs your attention with a beam of cherry and black currant, while pointed tannins line the finish. Shows earth, menthol, white pepper and juicy red berry flavors that are expressive and mouthwatering. Superlong finish. Best from 2026 through 2048. 415 cases made, 84 cases imported.

96 Points - James Suckling

A very fine and polished Brunello with fine, creamy tannins that are polished and very curated. Cherry and bark character. Medium to full body with ripe tannins. Juicy. Orange peel. Try this after 2025, but already delicious.

abeja-cabernet-magnum.title: Mayacamas Cabernet Sauvignon Mt. Veeder Magnum 1.5L Magnum 2019
abeja-cabernet-magnum.bodyHtml:
Mayacamas Cabernet Sauvignon Mt. Veeder Magnum 2019 is an iconic collector-worthy Napa Valley mountain Cabernet from one of California’s most legendary historic estates. Sourced from the rugged high-elevation vineyards of Mt. Veeder, this age-worthy Cabernet reflects Mayacamas’ unmistakable old-school restrained style rather than overt ripeness. The 2019 vintage reveals profound layers of blackcurrant, cassis, dark cherry, graphite, cedar, crushed herbs, tobacco leaf, forest floor, and striking mineral tension. Full-bodied yet impeccably structured, with firm mountain tannins, vibrant acidity, and extraordinary longevity, this is a serious cellar-worthy Napa Cabernet presented in impressive magnum format for optimal aging.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with dry-aged ribeye, herb-crusted lamb, venison, braised beef short ribs, aged gouda, truffle mushroom dishes, roast duck, and refined steakhouse cuisine.

 

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Loaded with character and energy, this version reveals heavy notes of zesty sweet bay leaf and sassafras that infuse a core of steeped red currant and mulberry fruit, all carried by bright acidity and iron-laced tannins. The long finish pulls everything together, with the fruit, savory and mineral elements in harmony. Showing an old-school touch, this has a long life ahead. Best from 2025 through 2045. 4,000 cases made.

95 Points - James Suckling

Seductive aromas of dark cherries, mulberries, spiced plums, wild herbs and dried spices. Medium to full body with finely grained tannins. Textural and suave with a voluptuous array of berries, cherries and raw cocoa on the palate. Velvety and well-balanced with a focused developing finish. Drink or hold.

tomatin-legacy-single-malt-scotch-whisky.title: Tomatin Legacy Single Malt Scotch Whisky
tomatin-legacy-single-malt-scotch-whisky.bodyHtml: When Tomatin Distillery was established in 1897, the isolated and idyllic setting of  Tomatin was almost perfect. However there wasn’t a local workforce; the local inhabitants were scattered shepherds and cattle drovers. The company began a project of construction to accommodate its workforce. Since that time the distillery has been at the heart of the community and the community at the heart of the distillery. This legacy has continued and Tomatin remains one of the few distilleries to provide a home for its dedicated craftsmen.Time in Bourbon barrels and Virgin Oak casks brings a light sweetness to The Tomatin Legacy, a non-peaty scotch which boasts aromas of vanilla bean, white chocolate and cinnamon. On the palate gentle waves of fresh fruit peppered with ginger emerge ahead of a light, clean finish.

penfolds-bin-707-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Penfolds Bin 707 Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 750ml
penfolds-bin-707-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Bin 707 is a perfect Cabernet Sauvignon representation of Penfolds House Style: intensely flavoured fruit, with the completion of fermentation and maturation in new oak. It expresses a Penfolds understanding of multi-vineyard, multi-region fruit sourcing. Like Grange, it is a blend of the best Cabernet fruit from the vintage. First vintaged in 1964, Bin 707 has long retained a secure place among the ranks of Australia’s finest Cabernets.

97 Points - James Suckling

This is a very fine 707. Often a bit of a yeoman, this is more sophisticated than I recall. Gun barrel tannins with the glint of steely intent. Like a slick of alloyed ball bearings, rolling across the generously weighted palate while delivering iodine, bouquet garni, a swab of tapenade and cassis in all the right places. Rich and powerful, yet detailed and savory all at once. The juiciness of the fruit effortlessly transcends the slathering of oak, predicting a very bright future. A wonderful wine in the making. Best after 2027.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Stylish, aromatic and flashy, this offers mocha, peppermint, blackberry, currant and Kalamata olive notes up front, giving way to details of palo santo, sandalwood, dark chocolate–covered espresso bean and savory herbs, followed by a plush, creamy finish. Drink now through 2043. 63 cases imported.

siro-pacenti-pelagrilli-brunello.title: Siro Pacenti 'Pelagrilli' Brunello di Montalcino 2020
siro-pacenti-pelagrilli-brunello.bodyHtml:
Siro Pacenti 'Pelagrilli' Brunello di Montalcino 2020 is an elegant, full-bodied, and beautifully structured red wine crafted by Siro Pacenti in Montalcino, Tuscany. Sourced from vines aged 25 to 35 years old located primarily on the cooler northern slopes of the region, this wine undergoes 24 months of aging in French oak barriques. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby-red color. The complex nose displays rich aromas of ripe wild cherries, blackberries, and plums interwoven with nuance of mint, violets, crushed rocks, and eucalyptus. On the palate, it delivers a round, polished, and supple texture, featuring concentrated flavors of dark berries, baked fruit, and sweet spice backed by powdery, integrated tannins and vibrant natural acidity that extend into a long, mouthwatering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye, roasted leg of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, and aged Pecorino cheese.

96 Points - James Suckling

A round and juicy red with berry, cherry, mushroom and wet-earth character on both the nose and palate. It’s full-bodied with integrated tannins that are soft and luscious. Long, flavorful finish.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Showing an especially bold bouquet and rich concentration, the Siro Pacenti 2020 Brunello di Montalcino Pelagrilli is a big expression of Sangiovese by all means, but the wine is also balanced. The intensity is played up with aromas of baked fruit, toasted spice, sweet herb and grilled rosemary, and there is a hint of redwood and cedar or barbecue smoke. To the palate, the wine is very round and fleshed out. It covers all corners of the mouth. This is a big-boned wine with powdery young tannins and a velvety finish. Aging takes place in French barrique, which has always been the stylistic choice favored by this estate.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The floral, saline nose features aromas of peonies, mandarin blossoms, wild cherries and crushed rocks. Raspberries join the cherries to headline the palate, but more flowers and an earthy salinity keep you on your toes. Grippy tannins keep vibrant acid in check.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

There's a mix of cherry, plum, earth and oak spice flavors in this red, which starts out linear in profile, yet fluid, before expanding on the finish as the dense, dusty tannins flex their muscles. Best from 2027 through 2042. 2,167 cases made, 750 cases imported.

brandlin-estate-mount-veeder-cabernet.title: Mount Veeder Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
brandlin-estate-mount-veeder-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Mount Veeder Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a rich, robust, and beautifully structured mountain Cabernet Sauvignon sourced from steep, high-elevation hillside vineyards in the Mount Veeder appellation of Napa Valley. In the glass, it exhibits a deep ruby to dark brick color with a concentrated rim. The nose unfolds with expressive aromas of ripe black plum, blackberry compote, and açaí berries, seamlessly accented by notes of wet sage, bay laurel, anise, mocha, and toasted oak. On the palate, this full-bodied red is dense and layered, offering concentrated dark fruit flavors balanced by lively acidity and a firm, fine-grained tannic backbone that leads to a persistent, savory finish with flashes of dark cocoa and crushed stone.

Food Pairing: Dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison tenderloin, mushroom risotto, and mature sharp cheddar cheese.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This shows off the vintage character nicely, with a burst of friendly, juicy boysenberry, açaí and mulberry compote notes that show flashes of anise, wet sage and bramble. A twinge of tarry grip holds the finish. Best from 2027 through 2038. 13,000 cases made.

azelia-bricco-fiasco-barolo-1999.title: Azelia Barolo Bricco Fiasco 1999 750ml
azelia-bricco-fiasco-barolo-1999.bodyHtml:
93 Points - Vinous
Tar, smoke, licorice, menthol and leather emerge from the 1999 Barolo Bricco Fiasco. Still fresh and vibrant, the 1999 has lost most of its baby fat and is at the early part of its drinking window. The wine turns darker with time in the glass, but never loses its mid-weight personality. This is an immensely appealing Barolo to drink now and over the next handful of years. The characteristic energy of Bricco Fiasco comes through nicely on the finish.

93 Points - Wine Spectator
Displays violet, raspberry, mineral and rose petal on the nose. Full-bodied, with firm, chewy tannins that follow through to a rich, fruity palate, with new wood and sweet tobacco.

92 Points - Robert Parker
Pale garnet-brick colour. Alluringly fragrant aromas of dried roses and violets, moss, black truffles and cassia with a core of warm raspberry. Crisp acidity and a medium level of chewy tannins with plenty of mouthfilling berry and spice flavours on the palate. Long, layered finish.

azelia-bricco-fiasco-barolo-2001.title: Azelia Barolo Bricco Fiasco 2001 750ml
azelia-bricco-fiasco-barolo-2001.bodyHtml:
Bricco Fiasco shows perfectly the radiant personality of Castiglione Falletto. Extremely perfumed, floral, with a core of red fruit. Rich, warm, intensely fresh.

94 Points - Vinous
The 2001 Barolo Bricco Fiasco is one of the most impressive wines in this ten-year retrospective of the 2001 Baroli. The Bricco Fiasco remains vibrant, fresh and beautifully delineated from start to finish. Bright flowers, ripe red cherries, mint and iron flow onto the palate in this gorgeous, totally impeccable Barolo. The 2001 doesn't taste or feel that much different than it did as a young wine. There is plenty of energy and focus for the 2001 to make it to its 20th birthday. If opened today the wine needs at least a few hours of air for the tannins to soften.

93 Points - Wine Spectator
A soft and ripe red with plum and cherry character and just a hint of meat. Full-bodied, with velvety tannins and a long finish.

beringer-the-waymaker-paso-robles-red.title: St. Hubert'S The Stag Paso Robles Red
beringer-the-waymaker-paso-robles-red.bodyHtml:
The Stag Paso Robles Red Blend offers rich aromas of blackberry, plum, and dark cherry layered with cocoa, vanilla, and spice. Smooth and fruit-forward, it delivers soft tannins, balanced structure, and an easy-drinking finish with warm Paso Robles character.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled burgers, barbecue ribs, pizza, pasta with red sauce, and hearty comfort dishes.

belle-glos-pinot-noir-clark-telephone.title: Belle Glos Clark and Telephone Pinot Noir 2022 1.5L Magnum
belle-glos-pinot-noir-clark-telephone.bodyHtml:
Deep purple with flecks of garnet in color with lavish aromas of warm blackberry pie, raspberry, licorice, and white pepper. Bold and sophisticated on the palate with flavors of dry cherry, crushed lavender, and chocolate covered blueberries. The texture is rich and velvety which leads to a long, structured finish.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

This is a bold Pinot Noir, ideal for the steakhouse. Aromas of roasted boysenberry, rose and violet lead from the nose into a ripe palate of lush black cherry, cocoa and caramel flavors. The wine retains some freshness while veering toward sweetness.

belle-glos-las-alturas.title: Belle Glos Las Alturas Pinot Noir 2022 1.5L Magnum
belle-glos-las-alturas.bodyHtml:
Rich crimson in color with fragrant aromas of bing cherry, dried fig, black cassis and hints of rich dark chocolate. Bold and elegant on the palate with marionberry pie, boysenberry preserves, dark plum, and subtle notes of mocha. Balanced and structured, this wine has beautiful acidity that lingers through to a long, mouthwatering finish.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Deep and dark aromas of black cherry, sandalwood and incense make for a heady nose on this bottling. The palate is big and bold, loaded with ripe black cherry and boysenberry flavors, as peppery, incense-like spices add complexity and the texture stays lusciously creamy.

beringer-knights-valley-cabernet-reserve.title: Beringer Knights Valley Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
beringer-knights-valley-cabernet-reserve.bodyHtml:
Beringer Knights Valley Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, beautifully structured, and concentrated California red wine produced from selected barrel lots sourced from stony, low-yielding vineyard blocks in Knights Valley. Exhibiting a deep ruby-purple core, it opens with expressive aromas of dark blackberry, cassis, and black cherry, seamlessly layered with notes of graphite, violet, cigar box, and dark chocolate. On the palate, it is full-bodied, savory, and focused, featuring supple, fine-grained tannins and balancing acidity that frame dark fruit, plum, and spice flavors through a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, venison stew, wild mushroom risotto, and aged cheddar cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

Lots of dark fruits with violets and peppery greens followed by cigar box, forest floor and graphite with cedar and dark chocolates. Wonderfully structured full-bodied wine. Very focused and concentrated with serious depth and length. Artful savory complexity to it. A blend of 80% cabernet sauvignon, 10% cabernet franc, 4% petit verdot, 4% merlot and 2% malbec. Released in spring 2024. It already has a nice drinkability but will age gracefully. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This complex Cabernet displays an impressive array of spice and mineral notes on the nose. The palate is loaded with plum, currant, licorice, graphite and tobacco flavors in a framework of supple tannin and balancing acidity. A little time in the cellar will soften this wine beautifully.

black-stallion-transcendent.title: Black Stallion Winery Transcendent 2019
black-stallion-transcendent.bodyHtml:
Sourced from the highest regarded vineyards in the Napa Valley, Transcendent is an expression of the best of Napa Valley. The wide range of AVA sources allows the winemaking team to create an exquisitely balanced wine with utmost elegance. The Cabernet Sauvignon sourced from the higher elevations contribute to the structure, texture and concentrated favor in the wine. Cabernet Sauvignon from the valley contributes to the notes of tobacco and herbs and to the elegant tannins of the wine.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A super effort, blended from some of Napa's top vineyards, Black Stallion's 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Transcendent delivers waves of loamy earth, cassis and plum, all artfully framed by a judicious amount of cedar. Full-bodied and richly textured on the palate, the wine adds attractive hints of vanilla and mocha on the lingering, velvety finish.
93 Points - James Suckling
Black fruit, dried herbs, mocha, sweet tobacco and bark on the nose. Full-bodied with plush tannins. Rich and creamy with a chalky texture and a chewy finish.

il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-2.title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020
il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-2.bodyHtml:
Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020 is an exceptional, classic expression of Sangiovese produced from hand-picked grapes grown on the oldest vines at Tenuta Il Poggione in southern Montalcino. Aged for three years in traditional large Slavonian oak casks (botti) followed by extended bottle maturation, it exhibits an alluring, complex bouquet of dark cherry, tart blackberry, and wild plum, seamlessly interwoven with nuances of licorice root, cloves, coffee, fresh mint, and fragrant dried rose petals. On the palate, the wine delivers a harmonious balance of power and grace, combining dense, velvety red and black fruit flavors with polished, grippy tannins, a refreshing vein of acidity, and savory hints of iron-rich earth, tobacco, and subtle mocha that carry through to a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted red meats, grilled bistecca, wild game, braised beef short ribs, ossobuco, rich mushroom dishes, and mature hard cheeses.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is both perfumed and spicy, with aromas of cloves, coffee, vanilla bean and black cherry. Flavors of tart blackberry, bergamot and flaky salt define the palate, before a touch of mocha creeps onto the finish. Tannins are polished, but grippy.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained mix of licorice and graphite, bright red cherries and toasted notes. Firm tannins on the medium- to full-bodied palate with refreshing acidity. Chewy style overall. Try in 2025, but best after 2026.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Showing very nice results, with greater accessibility in this vintage, the Il Poggione 2020 Brunello di Montalcino has dark fruit aromas with blackcurrant followed by something spicy or herbal. I am reminded of licorice root, exotic spice, pressed rose and fragrant tea leaf. It finishes smoothly with silky tannins and an open-knit approach. This vintage is almost ready to drink, and you get elegant complexity at the same time. It sees three years in oak botti. Fruit is sourced across vineyards with 25-year-old-plus vines. This is an ample production of 200,000 bottles.

94 Points - Wine Spectator 

This red is rich and dense, woven with flavors of cherry, blackberry, plum, black pepper, earth, iron and tobacco. Combines power and grace, with fine balance. The finish echoes the fruit and spice notes. Best from 2028 through 2045.

wu-liang-chun-third-generation.title: Wu Liang Chun---Third Generation
wu-liang-chun-third-generation.bodyHtml:
Wu Liang Chun Third Generation is a Chinese baijiu from the Wuliangye group, bottled at 50% alc./vol. in a 500ml bottle.

Serve: Traditionally served neat at room temperature in small cups alongside food.

black-stallion-heritage-sauvignon-blanc.title: Black Stallion Winery North Coast Sauvignon Blanc 2023
black-stallion-heritage-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Black Stallion Estate Winery Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc opens with vibrant, tropical aromas of mango, lemongrass, and honeysuckle, complemented by flavors of lime, lemon, ripe tropical fruit, and jasmine. This wine offers bright acidity, light to medium-body and a remarkable finish. The beauty of this wine offers three dimensions of aroma and flavor: tropical, citrus, and hints of grass notes.

tate-merlot.title: Tawse Merlot/Cabernet
tate-merlot.bodyHtml:
Tawse Merlot/Cabernet is a Niagara Peninsula red blend combining Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc. It offers blackberry, plum, dark cherry, cassis, herbs, espresso, spice, and subtle green pepper, with balanced acidity, ripe tannins, medium-full body, and a savoury finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roast beef, grilled steak, lamb, hearty pasta, mushroom dishes, burgers, roasted vegetables, and aged cheeses.

brancaia-ilatraia.title: Brancaia Ilatraia 2017 1.5L Magnum
brancaia-ilatraia.bodyHtml:
Brancaia Ilatraia 2017 is an exceptionally elegant, complex, and full-bodied Super Tuscan red wine crafted from the estate's coastal vineyards in Maremma. Representing a perfect marriage of French Bordeaux varieties with the unique maritime terroir of the Tuscan coast, this modern blend displays a striking balance between structural power and refined finesse. In the glass, it shows an inky dark color, opening with intense, expressive aromas of blackberries, dark cherries, and wild blueberries, beautifully layered with suggestions of cedarwood, sweet tobacco leaf, cocoa, and scorched earth. The palate is impressively concentrated and thick, revealing a rich, savory core of black fruit and plum flavors supported by fine-grained, powdery tannins and a precise line of mineral acidity that carries through to a persistent, silky, and extraordinarily long finish.

Food Pairing: This robust, elegant red pairs beautifully with a prime grilled Fiorentina steak, rosemary-roasted rack of lamb, or slow-braised wild game.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc, the 2017 Ilatraia is a real beauty and one of the only wines that has taken on the challenges of this hot and dry vintage with undisputed results. Ilatraia opens to an inky dark appearance and thick phenolic weight that is given extra volume and depth thanks to layers of cherry, dried blackberry and plum. This is a full-bodied red wine worthy of a big Fiorentina steak.

94 Points - James Suckling

A big, rich red with lots of blackberry and chocolate character. Walnuts, too. It’s full-bodied. Lots of blueberry and chocolate at the finish. Needs a few years to come together.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Delivers intense aromas and flavors of violet, black currant, black cherry, ink and earth, which are the hallmarks of this dry, dusty red. Linear in profile and long. Petit Verdot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Made with 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, 40% Petit Verdot and 20% Cabernet Franc, this opens with heady aromas of ripe black-skinned berries, cedar and scorched earth. The concentrated, full-bodied palate offers dried black cherry, clove, mocha and tobacco alongside fine-grained tannins.

duckhorn-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
duckhorn-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon-.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a refined and powerful red wine crafted from top-tier estate and independent grower vineyards across the Napa Valley. Blending 93% Cabernet Sauvignon with 6% Merlot, it opens with rich aromas of boysenberry, black currant, and dark cherry, accented by bay leaf, baking spice, and subtle cedar notes. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, well-sculpted texture packed with blueberry, blackberry, and plum flavors supported by fine, firm tannins and a long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, roasted lamb, duck breast, or aged cheddar cheese.

tenuta-sette-ponti-oreno-1-5l.title: Tenuta Sette Ponti Oreno 2021 1.5L
tenuta-sette-ponti-oreno-1-5l.bodyHtml:
Ruby red with violet hues. Intense and broad aromatics, where notes of succulent red fruits initially emerge and then give way to spicy characters of licorice and roasted coffee. Powerful and structured, with velvety tannins in balance with a vibrant, crisp character. Finish of remarkable length and savoriness.

98 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrants and black cherries with lovely flowers on the nose. Medium-bodied with ultra fine tannins that give focus and tension to the wine.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Fruity, floral aromas of dried cherries, raspberries and violets on the nose open up into more savory notes of pencil shavings and hot tar before a palate of more mixed berries rolls over savory, earthy notes, with a hint of orange pith adding astringency through a long, umami-rich finish.

bulleit-bourbon-frontier-whiskey.title: Bulleit Bourbon 1.75L
bulleit-bourbon-frontier-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Bulleit Bourbon is a highly popular, frontier-inspired Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey renowned for its distinctive high-rye mashbill and bold, spicy character. Originally revived in 1987 by Tom Bulleit, it follows a multi-generational family recipe that uses a high proportion of rye alongside corn and malted barley. The whiskey is aged for a minimum of six years in charred American white oak barrels, which softens the intense rye spice and imparts classic oak sweetness. This aging process creates a clean, robust, and highly versatile bourbon that has become a staple in bars worldwide for both sipping and premium cocktail creation.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with slow-cooked barbecue pulled pork, glazed pecan pie, smoked beef brisket, or sharp cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Medium amber in appearance with a rich, smooth, and satiny mouthfeel.

Nose : Gentle spiciness, sweet oak, vanilla, honey, and subtle hints of baked apple and clove.

Palate : Sweet entry with vanilla and caramel, transitioning into maple, toasted oak, nutmeg, and a signature peppery warmth from the high rye content.

Finish : Long, dry, and satiny with lingering light toffee, cinnamon, and warm spicy oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a classic base for cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

jadot-chateau-des-jacques-mav-rochegres.title: Louis Jadot Chateau des Jacques Morgon
jadot-chateau-des-jacques-mav-rochegres.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Chateau des Jacques Morgon is an expressive Gamay offering black cherry, raspberry, violet, ripe plum, subtle spice, and mineral notes. Structured yet vibrant, the palate combines juicy fruit, fresh acidity, fine tannins, and earthy complexity through a persistent, balanced finish with classic Morgon character.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast chicken, grilled pork, charcuterie, mushroom dishes, duck breast, or semi-hard cheeses for a classic Beaujolais pairing.

quilt-chardonnay.title: Quilt Chardonnay 2023
quilt-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Pale yellow with straw highlights. Aromatics of peach honeysuckle, apple blossom, and lemon balm. Flavors of pear, yellow apple, baked tart and with notes of vanilla. This is a classic Napa Valley Chardonnay with bright acidity, medium bodied, and a smooth, creamy finish. Complex and well-balanced with a lively finish.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Heavy aromas of oak char and toasted almonds lead to a spicy, rich palate of white and black pepper, pineapple and butter in this robust, swaggering wine.

barbi-brunello-riserva-magnum.title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Vigna Paganelli 2018 3L Double Magnum
barbi-brunello-riserva-magnum.bodyHtml: Intense ruby-red color. Layers of red fruit, savory spices and leather notes. The tannins are silky, and the fruit comes back in multiple layers. Its long finish confirms that this wine is ready to drink now but can be enjoyed for 20 years or more.

kosta-browne-one-sixteen-chardonnay.title: Kosta Browne One-Sixteen Chardonnay 2022
kosta-browne-one-sixteen-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Kosta Browne One-Sixteen Chardonnay 2022 is a refined, complex, and generously textured California white wine sourced from top cool-climate vineyards across the Russian River Valley. Visually displaying a bright pale yellow-gold hue, it opens with fragrant aromas of preserved lemon, Gala apple, citrus blossom, and buttered popcorn layered with cinnamon and subtle hazelnut notes. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, medium-to-full body balanced by crisp, acid-driven freshness, delivering juicy flavors of Meyer lemon peel, poached pear, and flaky pastry that lead into a long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with butter-poached lobster, pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken, halibut in lemon-herb cream sauce, and creamy mushroom risotto.

95 Points - James Suckling

Expressive aromas of preserved lemons, lime zest, flint and river stones. The palate is medium-bodied with bright acidity and a creamy texture, giving notes of orchard fruit, grapefruit, yellow apples and pastry. A good balance of power and finesse.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

There's a whiff of buttered popcorn, layered with Gala apple, cinnamon and flowers on the nose of this Chardonnay. The palate is generously textured, with flavors of ripe pear, toasted hazelnuts, flaky pastry and an acid-driven finish with echoes of salty Meyer lemon peel and ginger. This is delicious now, but patience will be rewarded.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A bold expression of Chardonnay, offering succulent notes of butterscotch, grilled peach, lemon curd and mango puree. Smooth and creamy, with sleek acidity, plus accents of orange blossoms, lemon zest, tangerine and ginger. Mouthwatering finish. Drink now. 3,700 cases made.

goodridge-williams-western-grains-whisky.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey 1.14L
goodridge-williams-western-grains-whisky.bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey is an iconic, smooth American whiskey crafted in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Charcoal mellowed drop-by-drop through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before aging in handcrafted white oak barrels, it offers a distinct balance of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, and smooth caramel character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, pulled pork sandwiches, grilled burgers, smoked brisket, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber-gold in appearance with a light-to-medium-bodied, smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, banana, and subtle brown sugar.

Palate : Balanced mix of sweet corn, vanilla, toasted oak, light spice, and rich caramel.

Finish : Smooth, warm, and medium-length with lingering toasted oak, charcoal, and sweet spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed with cola in a highball glass.

three-palms-merlot.title: Duckhorn Three Palms Merlot 2020 1.5L Magnum
three-palms-merlot.bodyHtml:
Epic, elegant and profoundly complex, this stunning wine draws you in with aromas of fresh cranberry, huckleberry, crushed rose petals, raspberry and graham crackers. On the palate, mesmerizing layers of black fig and cocoa powder mingle with the lush berry flavors, with a sophisticated note of minerality emerging on the long, resonant finish.

91 Points - James Suckling

Black olives with some fresh basil and lemongrass aromas that follow through to a medium body with a juicy center palate. Savory and delicious. A little simple this year but well done for the vintage.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Tense with structure, this red slowly reveals itself with savory plum and dried cherry flavors, highlighted by dusky spices and anise as this builds toward broad-shouldered tannins. Best from 2025 through 2031. 4,793 cases made.

daou-chardonnay.title: DAOU Chardonnay 2025
daou-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
DAOU Chardonnay 2025 is an expressive, beautifully balanced, and textural California white wine crafted by brothers Georges and Daniel Daou in the hills of Paso Robles. Sourced from premium vineyard sites across the calcareous clay and limestone terroirs of the Central Coast, the grapes benefit from warm daytime sunshine tempered by coastal breezes and dramatic diurnal shifts. Fermented with careful temperature regulation and aged in French oak to marry richness with precision, it reveals a luminous, pale straw-gold hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is fragrant and layered, unfurling with scents of lemon zest, yellow apple, crisp nectarine, and honeysuckle, complemented by subtle nuances of baking spices, toasted hazelnut, and vanilla cream. On the palate, it delivers a medium-bodied, rounded mouthfeel framed by vibrant natural acidity and tropical hints of melon and ripe orchard fruit, finishing clean, polished, and persistent with delicate touches of toasted oak.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops in lemon-butter sauce, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy mushroom risotto, grilled halibut, or mild artisanal triple-cream cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

Quite subtle and restrained with aromas of lemon, yellow apple, melon, baking spice and nectarine. The palate is medium-bodied with a textural, rounded mouthfeel, bright acidity and a generous finish. Fresh and polished with plenty of flavor and balance. Drink now. Screw cap.

eisele-vineyard-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Eisele Vineyard Altagracia Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
eisele-vineyard-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Eisele Vineyard Altagracia Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is an exceptionally elegant, terroir-driven Bordeaux-style blend sourced primarily from the eastern, volcanic-soil parcels of the iconic, biodynamically farmed Eisele Vineyard estate. In the challenging, low-yielding 2020 vintage—which resulted in the smallest harvest at the estate since the early 1990s—all fruit was meticulously selected and picked prior to autumn wildfires. Aged for 18 months in a combination of French oak barrels (90%) and Austrian foudres (10%), the wine displays a beautiful garnet-purple color. The nose is highly fragrant and expressive, revealing a floral bouquet of dried rose petals and potpourri intertwined with wild strawberries, red currants, and complex undertones of black tea, cinnamon, and volcanic earth. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, showing a round, silky texture. Its concentrated red and dark fruit flavors are tightly balanced by fine, chalky tannins and a vibrant, refreshing core of natural acidity that leads to a long, savory finish accented by aniseed and cocoa.

Food Pairing: Prime rib, roasted lamb chops with rosemary, duck breast with berry reduction, or slow-cooked beef stews.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Cabernet Sauvignon Altagracia was tasted as a finished blend barrel sample. Deep purple-black in color, it has a fragrant nose of potpourri and Indian spices over a core of kirsch, warm cassis and plum preserves, plus a waft of camphor. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is wonderfully juicy and perfumed, with alluring elegance and freshness, finishing long.

grgich-hills-napa-valley-chardonnay.title: Grgich Hills Estate Grown Chardonnay 2023
grgich-hills-napa-valley-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Grgich Hills Estate Grown Chardonnay 2023 is a crisp, bright, and classically structured white wine that showcases the cool-climate estate vineyards of American Canyon and Carneros in the Napa Valley. Made without malolactic fermentation to preserve its vibrant natural acidity, it displays a pale gold color and opens with expressive aromas of lemon curd, yellow apple, green tea, and quince, complemented by delicate notes of toasted almonds, ginger, and struck flint minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, energetic, and perfectly balanced, featuring a silky texture, bright citrus and orchard fruit flavors, and a clean, refreshing, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roast chicken, seared sea scallops, lobster tail, wild mushroom risotto, crab cakes, or mild creamy goat cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripe yet restrained, this sits on the edge of reduction, showing aromas of yellow apples, grilled peaches, lemon curd and a touch of struck flint. The palate reflects the cool vintage with bright acidity and a layered feel, delivering baked citrus, toasted almonds and subtle spices. Rounded and fresh with a savory, lingering finish. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Vibrant, flavorful, and energetic, this Chardonnay delivers the lush, ripe fruits of its region with palate stimulating structure and poise. Charismatic and well crafted, combining ripe quince, lemon curd, lime zest, and grapefruit pith through a silken mouthfeel.

kosta-browne-keefer-ranch-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Anderson Valley Pinot Noir 2020
kosta-browne-keefer-ranch-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Kosta Browne Anderson Valley Pinot Noir 2020 is an elegant, expressive California Pinot Noir crafted from select vineyard sites in Mendocino County's cool, coastal Anderson Valley, including the Cerise, Ferrington, Gowan Creek, Confluence, and Narrows vineyards. Aged for 15 months in French oak barrels (38% new) and neutral oak casks, it showcases a brilliant ruby hue with complex aromas of dark cherry, cranberry, fresh blueberry, wild rose, and forest floor. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, expansive, and nicely layered, balancing vibrant acidity with ripe red and dark berry flavors, subtle baking spice notes, fine tannins, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with duck breast, roasted pork tenderloin, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, and mild cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Attractive, complex and ripe tasting, this medium-bodied wine blends black cherry and warm black-plum flavors on light tannins and good fruit acidity. Freshness aligns with nice balance, showing off intricate rhubarb and sour-cherry notes on repeated sipping.
91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Pinot Noir Anderson Valley has a nose of cranberries and blackberries with accents of burnt orange peel, forest floor and allspice. The medium-bodied palate is grainy and fresh, with earth-laced fruits and a long finish laced with baking spices.

joseph-phelps-cabernet-sauvignon-3l.title: Joseph Phelps Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
joseph-phelps-cabernet-sauvignon-3l.bodyHtml:
The Cabernet Sauvignon opens with an enticing bouquet of black and red fruits - juicy black cherry intertwined with fresh pomegranate and bright cassis. Notes of cedar spice and toasted coconut add intrigue and sophistication to the aromatic profile. On the palate, layers of raspberry compote anddried wild berries unfold across a full-bodied frame. The wine shows impressive density while maintaining elegance, supported by well-integrated tannins that provide structure without overwhelming. This is a wine of both power and finesse.

94 Points - James Suckling

Bright, lifted, black and red fruits with aromas of dark cherries, damson plums, cedar box and fresh herbs. The full-bodied palate has a supple, rounded mouthfeel and softly integrated tannins. 91% cabernet sauvignon with smatterings of the other main Bordeaux varieties. Lively and approachable yet plush with plenty of years ahead.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Joseph Phelps 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon is dominated by fruit from Yountville and Suscol; only 21% of the blend is from growers, as there's a push toward estate fruit. As always, there's some American oak in the mix, but that proportion is evolving downward. Redcurrants and cherries are joined by gentle dusty earth notes and hints of vanilla and cedar on the nose, while the medium to full-bodied palate is a bit more dusty and drying than the 2021, yet it remains soft and approachable.

calera-selleck-pinot-noir-1.title: Calera Mt. Harlan 'Selleck' Vineyard Pinot Noir 2009 750ml
calera-selleck-pinot-noir-1.bodyHtml:
Calera’s Mt. Harlan Vineyards are located in the Gavilan Mountains 25 miles east of the Monterey Bay. The site was chosen for its limestone soils and ideal climate. At an average elevation of 2,200 feet it is among the highest and coolest vineyard sites in California.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Another highlight among these new releases, the 2009 Pinot Noir Selleck Vineyard is made in a much more fruit-driven style than some of the other Pinots in this lineup. It boasts stunning depth and richness, but in the classic Calera style that never abandons a sense of structural finesse. Juicy dark berries, hard candy, flowers and herbs wrap around the rich, textured finish. This is yet another dazzling Pinot from Calera. Selleck is a site with a south/southwestern exposure.

92 Points - Wine & Spirits

This rocky, south-southwest facing hillside was planted in 1975, where the granitic and limestone soils helped define the Calera style of Pinot Noir, seemingly light in body with powerful flavors that extend through the wine into a lasting finish. This vintage requires a day or more of air before the depth and ripeness of its fruit become apparent, darkening from red cherry toward blue highlights, long on umami in its savor. The energy in the wine is more like the gentle glow of moonlight than the brightness of the sun. Destined for the cellar, this needs five or six years to begin to show its best.

calera-jensen-pinot-noir-14-9.title: Calera Mt. Harlan 'Jensen' Vineyard Pinot Noir 2012 750ml
calera-jensen-pinot-noir-14-9.bodyHtml:
Beautifully integrated eccentric aromas of cherry, raspberry, red licorice, charcuterie and fine saddle leather lead into a soft round mouthful of black raspberry, rhubarb and a hint of steak blood. This wine is a fascinating combination of deep, tart fruit, tension from mineral and a savory, soy accent. This wine will gain even more complexity with time.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A thrilling Pinot Noir that comes from a 13.8-acre vineyard planted in 1975 on mostly on limestone, at an elevation of 2,200 feet, the 2012 Pinot Noir Jensen Vineyard was harvested September 24 to October 21 and was aged 16 months in 30% new French oak. It offers a dark ruby color to go with a big, sweet nose of cranberry, wild strawberries, crushed flowers, forest floor and spice. Full-bodied, layered and elegant, with a supple, rounded and sexy texture, it packs plenty of fruit, yet is graceful, beautifully balanced and seamless. It's hard to resist now, yet should cruise for a decade in the cellar.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Pioneering winemaker Josh Jensen delivers pure and focused aromas of deep red pomegranate and dark purple fruits, a shred of violet, a noticeable chalkiness and a hint of sweet sage. It’s rich and zesty on the palate, offering dark fruit flavors with a pine sap backbone, finishing strong on chocolate-dipped cherries.

rebel-yell-with-rebel-yell-50ml.title: Rebel Yell Bourbon 750ml + 50ml
rebel-yell-with-rebel-yell-50ml.bodyHtml:
This value pack pairs a 750ml bottle of Rebel Kentucky Straight Bourbon (formerly sold as Rebel Yell) with a bonus 50ml bottle. The brand traces its recipe to 1849, when it began using wheat in place of rye in the mash bill, and the bourbon is made from corn, wheat and malt for a soft, smooth character with full flavour. It is bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof). It won a Platinum medal at the 2018 SIP Awards and Double Gold at the 2016 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

Tasting Notes: Honey, butter, raisin and warm spice.

Nose: Honey and butter.

Palate: Smooth and full-flavoured, with traces of raisin.

Finish: Warm spice.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks or in cocktails such as a bourbon cola or whiskey sour.

black-stallion-lr-merlot-2013.title: Black Stallion Winery Limited Release Merlot 2013
black-stallion-lr-merlot-2013.bodyHtml: An extraordinary Merlot with aromas of plum, chocolate and a hint of vanilla: As the winemaker himself says: "Our 2013 Merlot opens with aromas of black plums, rich dark chocolate and hints of toasty vanilla. Flavors of ripe boysenberry and black cherry intermingle on the palate with subtle nuances of freshly roasted espresso beans and allspice. With nicely balanced acidity, the wine has a long finish with soft and silky tannins."

black-stallion-lr-syrah-2013.title: Black Stallion Winery Limited Release Syrah 2013
black-stallion-lr-syrah-2013.bodyHtml: Twelve years after arriving in America, in 1924, Gaspare Indelicato planted a vineyard in Manteca, California. With it, he planted the foundation of his eventual success in the California wine trade. Since that first vineyard flourished, Gaspare’s children, grandchildren and great-grandchildren have honored his legacy through dedication to his steadfast values of family, hard work and integrity.

patron-reposado-1.title: Patron Reposado Tequila
patron-reposado-1.bodyHtml:
Patrón Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium, handcrafted tequila that delivers a sophisticated balance of fresh agave flavor and subtle oak complexity. Masterfully distilled from 100% highest-quality Weber Blue Agave in the Highlands of Jalisco, it is aged for a minimum of two months in a combination of fresh and used oak barrels. This careful aging process rounds out the spirit, giving it a beautifully smooth finish and a delicate golden hue that appeals to both silver tequila purists and aged spirit enthusiasts.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled sea bass, garlic butter shrimp, pork carnitas tacos, or grilled chicken breasts marinated in citrus. It also complements slightly spicy dishes, creamy guacamole, or a cheese board featuring medium-aged Gouda and Manchego.

Tasting Notes : Bright, clear with a light amber tint and a smooth, medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh agave, light oak, citrus peel, and gentle honeyed vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of fresh agave, subtle toasted oak, citrus, and light honey.

Finish : Light, clean, and warming with lingering oak spice and agave.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as the base for a premium Paloma or Tommy's Margarita.

patron-anejo-2.title: Patron Anejo Tequila 375ml
patron-anejo-2.bodyHtml:
Oak aged for over 12 months to produce a tequila perfect for sipping.

Patrón Añejo is handcrafted from the finest 100% Weber Blue Agave and is carefully distilled in small batches at Hacienda Patrón distillery in Jalisco, Mexico. It's then aged in a combination of French oak, Hungarian oak and used American whiskey barrels.

glenfarclas-21-yr-mini.title: Glenfarclas 21 Year Old 50ml
glenfarclas-21-yr-mini.bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 21 Year Old in a 50ml miniature is an easy way to try one of Speyside's classic sherried single malts. Glenfarclas is the independent, family-owned distillery at Ballindalloch, bought by John Grant in 1865 and run by the Grant family ever since. This 21 Year Old is matured exclusively in casks seasoned with Oloroso sherry and bottled at 43% ABV, giving a full, rounded whisky of sherried and tropical fruit, nutmeg and almond that finishes on chocolate. The miniature makes a thoughtful tasting sample, stocking stuffer or addition to a whisky flight.

Tasting Notes: Dark amber-gold in the glass, with the rich sherried depth typical of Glenfarclas.

Nose: Intense and aromatic: sherried fruit, tropical fruit, nutmeg and almonds, with a touch of citrus at the end.

Palate: Full-bodied, rich and rounded, slowly opening into fruity and spicy flavours.

Finish: Long and smooth, with a chocolate note lingering at the back of the throat.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass; add a drop or two of water to open it up if you wish.

austin-hope-cabernet-sauvignon-1-5l.title: Austin Hope Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 1.5L Magnum
austin-hope-cabernet-sauvignon-1-5l.bodyHtml:
Austin Hope Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 is a bold, lush, and richly expressive California red wine crafted by Austin Hope at Hope Family Wines in Paso Robles. Sourced from sustainably farmed vineyard parcels spanning six of Paso Robles' eleven sub-districts—anchored by fruit from Geneseo, Paso Robles Highlands, and Estrella—this flagship release showcases the sun-drenched concentration and calcareous-soil depth of the Central Coast. Aged in French oak barrels to balance opulent dark fruit with nuanced barrel complexity, it pours a saturated, deep purple-ruby hue in the glass. The bouquet opens with vibrant aromas of ripe black cherry, blackberry, and dark plum layered with delicate notes of crushed violets, dried herbs, warm baking spices, and vanilla bean. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, velvety mouthfeel propelled by concentrated dark berry fruit, rich cocoa, and roasted coffee flavors, framed by lively acidity and smooth, polished tannins that resolve into a long, harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, herb-crusted lamb chops, slow-braised beef short ribs, hearty pasta Bolognese, or sharp aged cheddar cheese.

louis-latour-chateau-corton-grancey-2010.title: Louis Latour Chateau Corton Grancey Grand Cru 2010
louis-latour-chateau-corton-grancey-2010.bodyHtml:
With a purple hue this Grand Cru exhales aromas of cassis, saffron and earthiness. In the mouth the tannins envelop a lovely cherry fruitiness and are powerful yet silky.

95 Points - James Suckling

Bright and intense with blackberry, blueberry, and lemon rind. Full-bodied, yet tight with tannin tension and form. Mineral and Asian mushroom too, plus a bright finish. Just about ready. Love tasting this.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A firm, powerful wine, its tannins still very dominant. Acidity is a factor, along with deep red-plum fruit. Some sweetness will develop in the next several years, although this concentrated and complex wine will also have a solid core of dry, structured tannin. Age for at least five years.

chappellet-grower-char-el-novillero.title: Chappellet Grower Collection El Novillero Vineyard Chardonnay 2020
chappellet-grower-char-el-novillero.bodyHtml:
This alluring wine begins with aromas of fragrant pineapple, guava, lychee, lemon zest and tropical flowers, with hints of crème brûlée, vanilla bean and nutmeg. On the palate it is vibrant and mouthcoating, with toned acidity and notes of spicy French oak adding brightness and sophistication to lush layers of Meyer lemon, clementine and exotic fruit. 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Well integrated, lengthy and spiced, this white is high in fresh acidity, with abundant layers of Gravenstein apple, pineapple and stone. As it develops on the palate it builds richness and intensity in the form of crème brûlée and vanilla cookie, finding balance on the lengthy finish.

93 Points - Wine & Spirits

Scents of white roses and savory green tea meld into this wine’s lasting white peach flavor. The buzz of acidity snaps it to a clean line, all the components held tight and finely knit. This is a property farmed by the Sangiacomos, in the hills above the southern boundary of Sonoma Valley.

wolf-blass-makers-project-pink-pinot.title: Wolf Blass Makers' Project Pink Pinot Grigio 2021 750ml
wolf-blass-makers-project-pink-pinot.bodyHtml: Marker’s Project Pink Pinot Grigio is a refreshing drop that will tantalise the taste buds. Made by fermenting free run juice, and enhancing the natural pink colour of the Pinot Grigio skins, this is a light-bodied style with a crisp, dry finish, that’s packed with flavour.

wolf-blass-makers-project-reserve-shiraz.title: Wolf Blass MakersÕ Project Reserve Project Shiraz 750ml

1999-champagne-le-mesnil-bruno-paillard.title: Bruno Paillard Le Mesnil Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut 1999 1.5L Magnum
1999-champagne-le-mesnil-bruno-paillard.bodyHtml: Champagne LE MESNIL Bruno Paillard was born from the idea to create the greatest possible Champagne wine, whatever the constraints. For this, decisions were made at the highest level for each stage of its development. From this crazy dream was created a champagne at the height of winemaking.
