titos-handmade-vodka-5.title: Tito's Handmade Vodka 3L
titos-handmade-vodka-5.bodyHtml:
Tito's Handmade Vodka is a premium American vodka produced in Austin, Texas, by Fifth Generation, Inc. at the Mockingbird Distillery. Founded in 1997 by Tito Beveridge, it is micro-distilled six times in traditional copper pot stills from a 100% yellow corn mashbill, resulting in an unaged, naturally gluten-free spirit renowned for its smooth texture and subtle corn sweetness.

Food Pairing: Fresh seafood (such as oysters and shrimp cocktail), smoked salmon, cured meats, light salads, caviar, and citrus-infused poultry dishes.

Tasting Notes - A crystal-clear spirit with a smooth, slightly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose - Light and clean, featuring subtle hints of sweet corn, soft grain, and gentle citrus.

Palate - Exceptionally smooth and clean with a mild sweetness from the corn base, accompanied by subtle notes of black pepper, roasted grain, and light vanilla.

Finish - Clean, crisp, and warm with a lingering smoothness and a subtle sweet grain note.

Serve - Serve chilled, on the rocks, straight from the freezer as a shot, or mixed into cocktails such as a Moscow Mule, Bloody Mary, or Vodka Soda.

piper-heidsieck-luminous.title: Piper-Heidsieck Cuvee Brut Luminous 1.5L Magnum
piper-heidsieck-luminous.bodyHtml:
Piper-Heidsieck Brut champagne brings its own lively, vivacious and exuberant character to dry champagne’s traditional elegance and finesse. It combines 50 rigorously selected growths. Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier grapes give this cuvee its structure and elegance. Reserve wines from earlier years are used to create a more rounded blend and ensure the originality of the Piper-Heidsieck style. The wine’s harmony develops over the course of slow aging in Piper-Heidsieck’s chalk cellars.

Sparkling clarity, pale gold in color. On the nose, the very first impressions are of bright, fresh mornings. It is reminiscent of spring blossom such as hawthorn. They lead into more fruity notes such as summer apple and pear, then citrus, with hints of warm toastiness. The palate is lively and fresh. The citrus notes take on a certain maturity. There is passion with gentleness, lightness with spontaneity.

absolut-rainbow-flag-limited-edition.title: Absolut Limited Edition Rainbow Flag Vodka
absolut-rainbow-flag-limited-edition.bodyHtml:
Absolut Limited Edition Rainbow Flag Vodka celebrates diversity, equality, and self-expression through a vibrant bottle inspired by the iconic rainbow Pride flag. Created as part of Absolut's longstanding support for the LGBTQ+ community, this special edition features the brand's original Swedish vodka in distinctive rainbow-themed packaging. Crafted from winter wheat and pure water, it delivers Absolut's signature smooth, full-bodied character with subtle grain sweetness, delicate dried fruit, and a clean finish. Bottled at 40% ABV, it offers the same versatile vodka as Absolut Original in a colourful collector-friendly presentation.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, sushi, seafood, light appetizers, citrus-marinated chicken, and creamy cheeses.

Tasting Notes: Clean and smooth, with gentle grain character, subtle dried fruit, and delicate sweetness.

Nose: Soft grain aromas, light cereal sweetness, and a hint of dried fruit.

Palate: Smooth and rounded, with subtle grain, vanilla, and a touch of caramel sweetness.

Finish: Clean and refreshing, with gentle warmth and lingering grain notes.

Serve: Enjoy chilled, over ice, with soda water and lime, or mixed into a classic Vodka Martini, Moscow Mule, or Cosmopolitan.

highland-park-12-yr-old.title: Highland Park 12 Year Old 350ml
highland-park-12-yr-old.bodyHtml: Matured predominantly in European and American sherry seasoned oak casks, our iconic 12 Year Old single malt whisky is spicy and well-rounded, packed with the flavours of sun-kissed Seville oranges and rich fruitcake spiced with cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves; you’ll find molten heather honey in this whisky’s waves of heathery peat smoke. Why not try it with a handful of wasabi peas on the side or alongside a sizzling, pan-fried rib-eye steak or with smoked salmon and sour cream.\

il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-12l.title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020
il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-12l.bodyHtml:
Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020 is an exceptional, classic expression of Sangiovese produced from hand-picked grapes grown on the oldest vines at Tenuta Il Poggione in southern Montalcino. Aged for three years in traditional large Slavonian oak casks (botti) followed by extended bottle maturation, it exhibits an alluring, complex bouquet of dark cherry, tart blackberry, and wild plum, seamlessly interwoven with nuances of licorice root, cloves, coffee, fresh mint, and fragrant dried rose petals. On the palate, the wine delivers a harmonious balance of power and grace, combining dense, velvety red and black fruit flavors with polished, grippy tannins, a refreshing vein of acidity, and savory hints of iron-rich earth, tobacco, and subtle mocha that carry through to a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted red meats, grilled bistecca, wild game, braised beef short ribs, ossobuco, rich mushroom dishes, and mature hard cheeses.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is both perfumed and spicy, with aromas of cloves, coffee, vanilla bean and black cherry. Flavors of tart blackberry, bergamot and flaky salt define the palate, before a touch of mocha creeps onto the finish. Tannins are polished, but grippy.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained mix of licorice and graphite, bright red cherries and toasted notes. Firm tannins on the medium- to full-bodied palate with refreshing acidity. Chewy style overall. Try in 2025, but best after 2026.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Showing very nice results, with greater accessibility in this vintage, the Il Poggione 2020 Brunello di Montalcino has dark fruit aromas with blackcurrant followed by something spicy or herbal. I am reminded of licorice root, exotic spice, pressed rose and fragrant tea leaf. It finishes smoothly with silky tannins and an open-knit approach. This vintage is almost ready to drink, and you get elegant complexity at the same time. It sees three years in oak botti. Fruit is sourced across vineyards with 25-year-old-plus vines. This is an ample production of 200,000 bottles.

94 Points - Wine Spectator 

This red is rich and dense, woven with flavors of cherry, blackberry, plum, black pepper, earth, iron and tobacco. Combines power and grace, with fine balance. The finish echoes the fruit and spice notes. Best from 2028 through 2045.

casamigos-reposado-2.title: Casamigos Reposado Tequila 375ml
casamigos-reposado-2.bodyHtml:
Casamigos Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. The agave pinas are slow-roasted in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours and fermented using a proprietary yeast blend. Aged for 7 months in premium American white oak barrels, it offers a smooth, balanced combination of sweet cooked agave, rich oak, and subtle spices.

Food Pairing: Grilled meats, pork carnitas, chicken mole, fish tacos, roasted vegetables, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : Golden honey in appearance with a smooth, soft, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet agave, vanilla, toasted oak, caramel, and light cocoa.

Palate : Smooth and rich with flavors of sweet cooked agave, vanilla, oak, caramel, and subtle hints of dried fruit and spice.

Finish : Smooth, long, and clean with lingering notes of warm oak and sweet vanilla.

Serve : Best served neat, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic tequila cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Reposado Paloma.

penfolds-bin-138-grenache-shiraz.title: Penfolds Bin 138 GSM 2020
penfolds-bin-138-grenache-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 138 Shiraz draws its inspiration from the wines of Southern Rhône, where shiraz, grenache and mataro (mourvèdre) are blended in varying proportions to create full-bodied wines possessing rich and heady perfume. Each year fruit for Bin 138 is sourced from old Barossa Valley vines (some more than 100 years old) and then matured for 12 to 15 months in seasoned oak hogsheads to allow the different varietals to shine through. The first vintage release of this varietal blend was the 1992, labelled ‘Old Vine Barossa Valley’ – it was then elevated to Bin status with the 1998 vintage.

93 Points - James Suckling

This has a complex nose, with raspberries and blackberries, as well as savory, tarry elements. Fruit-focused. The palate has a dark-berry fruit core with nicely balanced and approachable style. A regional expression of Barossa. Aged for 12 months in 300-liter French oak barrels. A blend of 65% shiraz, 29% grenache and 6% mataro. Drink or hold. Screw cap.

badia-a-passignano-riserva-chianti-2009.title: Marchesi Antinori Badia a Passignano Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2009 750ml
badia-a-passignano-riserva-chianti-2009.bodyHtml:
The wine, one with an important impact, shows an intense ruby red in its tonality. It is complex on the nose with aromas of red berry fruit, raspberries, blackberries, and ripe cherries in addition to its notes of spice and licorice on the finish. The flavors are ripe and sweet and are sustained by substantial tannins, round and ample in support of the supple and velvety structure. Long and persistent, its tonic acidity is a classic characteristic of the Sangiovese cultivated at the Badia a Passignano.

93 Points - James Suckling

A wine with minerals, light herbs, spices and blueberries. Hints of walnuts. Full body, fine tannins and a long, long finish. Really excellent. Drink now.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Newly promoted to Grand Selezione status, the 2009 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Badia a Passignano shows evolved tones of charred earth, dried cherry, chewing tobacco, tar, black olive and toasted hazelnut. Dusty spice and crushed mineral appear as the wine warms in the glass. The wine stills needs time to fully blossom and soften the remaining tannic sharpness.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Made entirely with Sangiovese, this wine starts with scents of blue flower, plum, leather and spice. The palate delivers juicy black cherry and raspberry layered with vanilla and dark chocolate notes that add to the depth of flavors. The firm tannins are ripe and round, giving this structure but also a smooth texture.

pian-delle-vigne-brunello-2007.title: Marchesi Antinori Pian delle Vigne Brunello di Montalcino 2007 1.5L Magnum
pian-delle-vigne-brunello-2007.bodyHtml:
Ruby red color with garnet hues. Aromatic and complex on the nose, with hints of spices, cherries, blackberries, light tobacco and pleasant chocolate undertones. Very full-bodied and broad on the palate, with an intense sweetness. Decisive but smooth, with elegant tannins and a long, persistent finish.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Antinori's 2007 Brunello di Montalcino Pian delle Vigne flows across the palate with sweet red cherries, flowers, spices, leather and tobacco, all of which come together in a rich, sensual style. The aromas and flavors are just a touch forward, suggesting the 2007 is likely to be a relatively early-maturing wine. Anticipated maturity: 2014-2022.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich, yet sleek, delivering cherry, raspberry, floral and spice flavors, vivid acidity and refined tannins for support. Turns elegant and almost ethereal on the long aftertaste. Best from 2014 through 2025.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Bramble and forest floor, cherry cola and savory bresaola notes amount to pretty aromatics with less bulkiness in the mouth. The structure is there but this wine is a bit dry, sharp and less fleshy than many others.

argiano-brunello-suolo-1-5.title: Argiano Vigna del Suolo Brunello di Montalcino 2018 1.5L Magnum
argiano-brunello-suolo-1-5.bodyHtml:
The nose is extremely complex and broad. Classic Sangiovese notes are ondisplay, particularly marasca cherry and flowers, but there are also scents oforange peel, sage, and balsamic, among others. Dense, structured, and savory inthe mouth with silky, integrated tannins and a fragrant acidity. Very long finish. 

97 Points - Wine Spectator

This sleek, delineated red grabs your attention with a beam of cherry and black currant, while pointed tannins line the finish. Shows earth, menthol, white pepper and juicy red berry flavors that are expressive and mouthwatering. Superlong finish. Best from 2026 through 2048. 415 cases made, 84 cases imported.

96 Points - James Suckling

A very fine and polished Brunello with fine, creamy tannins that are polished and very curated. Cherry and bark character. Medium to full body with ripe tannins. Juicy. Orange peel. Try this after 2025, but already delicious.

sena-1-5l.title: Sena 2022 1.5L Magnum
sena-1-5l.bodyHtml:
Seña 2022 1.5L Magnum is an exceptional premium Chilean red wine produced by Seña Winery in the prestigious Aconcagua Valley of Chile. Established through a partnership between Eduardo Chadwick and Robert Mondavi, Seña has become one of Chile's most celebrated fine wines, recognized for its Bordeaux-inspired blends and distinctive South American character. The 2022 vintage combines Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Carménère, and Petit Verdot, delivering remarkable concentration, elegance, and complexity. Rich dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, vibrant acidity, and subtle oak influences create a beautifully structured wine with excellent aging potential. Presented in an impressive 1.5-litre magnum bottle, Seña 2022 is an outstanding choice for collectors, luxury gifting, fine dining, and special celebrations.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, beef tenderloin, venison, wild mushroom risotto, truffle dishes, aged cheddar, Manchego cheese, and premium barbecue.

 

98 Points - James Suckling 

Extremely bright flowers and citrus with graphite, currants and blueberries. The nose is like going into a flower shop. Medium- to full-bodied with extremely polished tannins that caress your palate. Firm at the finish, which tells you that there is plenty coming in the future. A blend of 60% cabernet sauvignon, 25% malbec, 9% carmenere, 6% petit verdot. Try after 2028, but already open and enticing.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate 

The 2022 Seña enters on a reticent note, quietly opening up to reveal a dark, leather-bound nose with hints of turned earth, cedar, licorice and graphite accents that manage a levity and high-toned energy. The palate is lively and spry, driven by bright treble tones balanced with weighty, broad depth and a perfectly suave texture. The finish is juicy yet tense, structured and refined, with impressive length and coiled energy. Ever-expanding in the glass, this is a gorgeous, energetic and exuberant example of poise and clarity that should be a pleasure to follow in the cellar. It's a blend of 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Malbec, 9% Carmenere and 6% Petit Verdot aged 18 months mainly in French barrique with some foudre.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Elegant and balanced, this offers floral blueberry and cocoa nib details inflected with lemon thyme and anise notes. The palate is smooth in texture, with generous plum and berry flavors. There's a late burst of energy, yet this keeps its focus around polished tannins and a late twinge of coffee bean. Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Carmenère and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2035.

vinedo-chadwick-1-5l.title: Vinedo Chadwick 2018 1.5L Magnum
vinedo-chadwick-1-5l.bodyHtml:
Viñedo Chadwick 2018 is an extraordinarily elegant, precise, and masterfully structured icon red wine from Chile, crafted primarily from Cabernet Sauvignon with a 3% addition of Petit Verdot. Sourced entirely from the historic, high-altitude alluvial gravel terraces of Puente Alto in the Maipo Valley—originally the personal polo field of Alfonso Chadwick—this exceptional vintage benefits from long, gentle ripening conditions. Aged for 22 months in a combination of 80% new French oak barrels and 20% Stockinger foudres, it displays a deep ruby-red color with violet reflections. The bouquet reveals a beautifully layered and linear aromatic profile of blackcurrant, red cherry, and raspberry, intricately woven with notes of pine tree, violet, fresh tarragon, dark chocolate, and cedar wood. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied yet remarkably agile and tight framework, driven by a concentrated core of dark forest fruits that is seamlessly balanced by a fine line of refreshing acidity and ultra-fine, silky, cream-textured tannins, leading into an extraordinarily long, sophisticated, and layered finish with a lingering chalky and mineral-filled complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with charcoal-grilled dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted venison loin with juniper reduction, slow-braised wild boar stew, or rosemary-crusted rack of lamb.

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Viñedo Chadwick is a spectacular wine from front to back, opening with a refined, poised and perfumed nose that seamlessly combines floral-herbal and toasted dark-fruited aromas with ever-increasing complexity. The palate is svelte and seamless, exuding a perfectly textured polish with a rich yet composed intensity. It explodes into a long, layered, paradoxically energetic and yet slow-moving finish, remaining perfectly focused while expanding horizontally and vertically with an ultra-refined, impeccable tannin structure. The combination of the obvious exactitude that goes into this wine and the outstanding nature of this vintage have made a bona fide modern classic. The blend is 97% Cabernet Sauvignon and 3% Petit Verdot, aged for 22 months in 80% new barrels and 20% foudre.

98 Points - James Suckling

The aromas show blackcurrant, pine-tree, violet and light spearmint character. Full-bodied, yet reserved and tight with fine, creamy tannins. Hints of currants and fresh herbs. Extremely long and layered. Try after 2022.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Refined, with a fine-grained texture to the vibrantly structured dried red fruit and spice flavors that show an umami-like richness. Lithe accents of dried green herbs midpalate lead to a mineral-filled finish, with plenty of savory muscle. Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2027.

siro-pacenti-brunello-vecchie-vigne.title: Siro Pacenti Brunello di Montalcino Vecchie Vigne 2018 750ml
siro-pacenti-brunello-vecchie-vigne.bodyHtml:
97 Points - Raffaele Vecchione 

Polyhedric and decidedly 'wild' in the mixed floral and fruity profile showing notes of lavender, hibiscus, hyacinth, plums, pressed blueberries, white pepper, crushed chalk, guaranà, pink grapefruit and pomegranate. Medium to full bodied, concentrated and harmonic closing by tightening from the centre palate onwards in search of a notable persistency. Better from 2024.

95 Points - Falstaff

Clear ruby with a fine garnet edge. Clear and memorable nose of blackberries, fresh plums, with hints of cloves and undergrowth behind. Plenty of ripe, juicy fruit on the palate, opens with clear, finely meshed tannin, embedded in sweet texture, rich drive on the finish.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A deeply savory nose opens with aromas of grilled meat and iron-rich soil before revealing balsamic vinegar and graphite and then cranberries and hibiscus. The fruit becomes fuller and lusher on the palate, pushing up against chalky tannins and razor sharp acid.

liberty-school-reserve-cab-sauv.title: Liberty School Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 750ml
liberty-school-reserve-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
This storied wine has been a staple on dinner tables for more than 40 years.  The warm rich ruby color fills your glass along with aromas of vanilla bean, fresh cedar, and dense black currants.  On the palate, earthy notes mingle with crushed peppercorn, sweet oak, and dark fruit.  This medium bodied wine is balanced with dusty tannins and a soft lingering finish. 

 

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose on this bottling is clean, fresh with blackberry fruit and yet still quite savory with wood and earth aromas. The palate is rich and ripe with black cherry, cocoa and caramel flavors that make for a very comforting and well-structured sip.

camigliano-brunello-di-montalcino-docg.title: Pinino Brunello Di Montalcino Vigna Docg

camigliano-rosso-di-montalcino-docg.title: Camigliano Rosso Di Montalcino 2019 750ml
camigliano-rosso-di-montalcino-docg.bodyHtml:
The vintage has developed frank, clean, fragrant aromas, a strong acidic shoulder that guarantees a long aging and an intense and lively color.

The wine goes well with dressed pork products, mature cheeses and fairly strong-flavored main dishes.

90 Points by James Suckling
Dried cherries, tobacco and herbs on the nose. It’s medium-bodied with firm, chewy tannins. Savory and rustic with some bitter peel notes on the finish. From organically grown grapes.

glengoyne-legacy-chapter-2.title: Glengoyne The Legacy Series Chapter One
glengoyne-legacy-chapter-2.bodyHtml:
Chapter Two in our Legacy Series marries spirits matured in two distinct cask types – first fill bourbon and refill sherry barrels. Every drop embodies Peter’s combination of forward-thinking and respect for tradition.

On the palate, Creamy and well-balanced, apple crumble, honey drizzled toast, green grape and gentle spice, this richness builds in the warming finish, syrupy with hints of sweet oak and dates.

APPEARANCE

Bright gold

NOSE

Full of vanilla and banana, maple syrup, peaches, coconut, fruit soaked trifle sponge, hint of lime and mint.

PALATE

Creamy and well balanced, apple crumble, honey drizzled toast, green grape and gentle spice.

FINISH

Richness builds in the warming finish, syrupy with hints of sweet oak and dates.

WOOD TYPE

5% 1st Fill European Oak Sherry. 12% 1st Fill American Oak Sherry. 48% 1st Fill Bourbon, 35% Hand-selected quality Oak Refill cask

makers-mark-holiday-gift-pack.title: Maker's Mark Kentucky Straight Bourbon Gift Pack with Rocks Glasses
makers-mark-holiday-gift-pack.bodyHtml:
Maker's Mark Kentucky Straight Bourbon Gift Pack with Rocks Glasses is a beautifully curated holiday and special-occasion gift set featuring a standard bottle of the iconic wheated bourbon alongside two heavy-bottomed, branded rocks glasses. The bourbon inside delivers its legendary, multi-award-winning recipe crafted with soft red winter wheat instead of the traditional rye, offering a remarkably smooth, mellow flavor profile. Complete with the distillery's signature hand-dipped red wax seal, this premium set is designed to elevate the home bar experience, making it an excellent present for whiskey enthusiasts and collectors alike.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with smoky barbecue beef brisket, glaze-dripping pork belly sliders, and aged Gouda or sharp cheddar. It is also an exceptional partner for sweet desserts like classic pecan pie, apple crisp, or dark chocolate truffles.

TASTING NOTES A bright, rich amber-copper clarity. The mouthfeel is remarkably smooth, clean, and gentle, showing a medium-bodied texture without any aggressive alcohol burn.

NOSE Sweet and inviting with prominent aromas of toasted oak, rich caramel, vanilla bean, and a pleasant, fruity undertone.

PALATE Wonderfully balanced and mellow. It opens with front-of-the-mouth flavors of sweet caramel, brown sugar, and vanilla, followed by subtle hints of dried fruit and light toasted nuts.

FINISH Clean, smooth, and moderately brief, leaving behind a comforting warmth and a lingering, sweet whisper of oak and spice.

SERVE Enjoy the bourbon neat or on the rocks by utilizing the heavy-bottomed glasses included in the pack, or use them to stir up a premium, classic cocktail like an Old Fashioned or a Manhattan.

penfolds-california-bin-149.title: Penfolds Bin 149 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
penfolds-california-bin-149.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 149 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is an ambitious, dual-hemisphere "Wine of the World" red blending predominantly Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon with a touch of flagship-grade South Australian Cabernet. Sourced across premier Napa terroirs and aged for 17 months in 100% new oak (80% French, 20% American), it opens with complex aromas of ripe cassis, dark plum compote, dehydrated blood orange, cedar, dried savory herbs, and dark mocha. On the palate, it delivers a powerful, concentrated core of black fruits supported by firm, fine-grained tannins, balancing freshness, and a persistent, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rosemary rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison tenderloin, and mature clothbound cheddar cheese.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Bin 149 saw 100% new oak, 80% French and 20% American. The fruit here is really powerful and drives the wine through the front palate, middle and finish. It is concentrated and long and undeterred. This is seriously smart and shows precision and detail in both the winemaking and fruit. The three Californian wines form an equal step up each time of quality, concentration and complexity—as it should be, frankly—which makes for very satisfying drinking. It contains 10.9% Australian Cabernet Sauvignon (a blend of A1 grade Coonawarra and Barossa Valley). This will drink very well early, but it will also cellar gracefully for over a decade or more. My assessment of the blend in this instance is that the sweetness of the American and Australian fruit find simpatico with one another—the dovetail is seamless.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

An outstanding marriage of 90% American Cabernet with 10% Australian, showing juicy layers of seductive and lengthy flavor. Dried herb, dark cherry, blackberry and cassis play around an elegant structure of full-bodied complexity that should age well. Enjoy best 2029–2039.

penfolds-california-bin-600-cab-shiraz.title: Penfolds Bin 600 California Cabernet-Shiraz 2019
penfolds-california-bin-600-cab-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 600 California Cabernet-Shiraz 2019 is an expressive, full-bodied red blend representing the realization of Penfolds' historic multi-decade venture in California winemaking. Sourced from vineyard parcels in Napa Valley, Sonoma County, and Paso Robles, and incorporating Shiraz budwood traced directly from Penfolds' revered South Australian heritage vine cuttings, this cuvée was matured for 17 months in American oak. In the glass, it reveals a shimmering garnet core with a bright cherry-red rim. The bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of ripe cassis, black cherries, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with notes of cured meats, dried savory herbs, clove, mocha, and toasted sweet oak. On the palate, it delivers a generous, glossy texture underpinned by concentrated dark fruit flavors, supple yet structured fine tannins, and vibrant natural acidity that carries through to a lingering, spicy, and polished finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rosemary rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, barbecue brisket, and mature hard cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Advocate

The 2019 Bin 600 is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz. The Cabernet Sauvignon is from a selection of vineyards across Napa, "and there is a little it of Sonoma in there as well," says Peter Gago. The Shiraz is from the Paso Robles vineyard; it's a 78/22 blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz. The fruit heres is so sweet and plush—there is a distinct red berry character that settles and plumes on the mid-palate. Texturally, it is supple, silky and almost plump. 2019 was generally mild and good, and it has produced a suite of wines that are luscious and opulent. The tannins are the framework that drags the fruit back from the edge and brings balance and form to the wine. Smart.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Sourcing 83% Cabernet Sauvignon from the Napa Valley and 17% Shiraz from Paso Robles, this imaginative blend is structured and meaty, showing notes of cigar box, toasted oak and wild game. Red fruit-dominant, it unfurls layers of cassis and red cherry with ease, finishing in creamy mocha.

forty-creek-copper-pot-old-fashioned-kit.title: Forty Creek Copper Pot Old Fashioned Kit
forty-creek-copper-pot-old-fashioned-kit.bodyHtml:
The Forty Creek Copper Pot Old Fashioned Kit has everything needed to make a classic Old Fashioned at home. The gift box holds a 750ml bottle of Forty Creek Copper Pot Canadian whisky at 43% ABV, a 59ml bottle of Jolly Cut Old Fashioned cocktail syrup and a Forty Creek rocks glass. Copper Pot, since renamed Copper Bold, is made by blending separately aged corn, rye and barley whiskies and then giving them extra time in oak and a higher proof, which brings bold toffee, nut and spice notes that stand up well in a stirred drink.

Tasting Notes: Toffee, nuts, brown spice, dried stone fruit and marmalade.

Nose: Bold toffee, nuts and spice.

Palate: Full-bodied, with rich brown spice, dried stone fruit and hints of marmalade.

Finish: Long and bold.

Serve: Stir 2 oz of Copper Pot with 1/2 oz of the syrup over ice in the rocks glass.

glenfarclas-25-yr-mini.title: Glenfarclas 25 Year Old 50ml
glenfarclas-25-yr-mini.bodyHtml: From a long-time family-owned distillery, this 25-year-old single malt from Glenfarclas spent its days in 100% Oloroso sherry casks. It’s complex and delicately sherried, a whisky that’s sure not to disappoint. The price for a similar 25-year-old whisky is typically double or triple what this bottle costs making this an extraordinary value.

dassai-39-junmai-daiginjo-sake.title: Dassai '39' Junmai Daiginjo 1.80L
dassai-39-junmai-daiginjo-sake.bodyHtml: Made with 100% Yamada-Nishiki rice polished to 39% of the original rice grain. Aromas of fresh pineapple, ripe pear, mango and light notes of anise. Tropical fruit flavours are delicate and soft on the palate, with a clean and dry finish. Enjoy served chilled with grilled seafood and sashimi.

dassai-23-junmai-daiginjo-sake.title: Dassai '23' Junmai Daiginjo 1.80L
dassai-23-junmai-daiginjo-sake.bodyHtml:
To craft the ultimate Junmai-Daiginjo sake, we polished down Yamada-Nishiki rice to 23%. Delivering delicate floral aromas with a palate reminiscent of honey and an elegant lasting finish.

A Gold Medal winner at IWC 2021 this elegant sake is produced using Yamada Nishiki rice milled to 23%. Intense aromatics of melon fruit with fresh cucumber and floral notes. Incredibly balanced with a great depth of flavours, rich and smooth on the palate with a long, dry finish. Serve chilled with raw oysters.

tenjaku-japanese-whisky.title: Tenjaku Japanese Whisky
tenjaku-japanese-whisky.bodyHtml:
Tenjaku Japanese Whisky is a blended whisky from Japan, named with the characters for the skylark, the songbird that heralds spring. Rich malt whiskies are balanced with softer grain whisky and natural spring water to give a clear amber, crisp and mellow blend crafted under master blender Kenji Watanabe. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Pear and dried fruit with a light touch of smoke.

Nose: A faint smoky accent with sweet pear and dried fruit.

Palate: A slightly edgy attack that turns rounded and mellow.

Finish: Long and slightly spicy, with a hint of white oak and spreading sweetness.

Serve: On the rocks first, as the producer suggests, or in a highball or with water.

arthur-barolet-savigny-les-beaune-1er-c.title: Arthur Barolet Savigny-lès-Beaune Villages
arthur-barolet-savigny-les-beaune-1er-c.bodyHtml:
Arthur Barolet Savigny-lès-Beaune Villages is an elegant red Burgundy produced by Arthur Barolet & Fils in the Côte de Beaune region of France. Crafted from Pinot Noir, this village-level wine showcases the finesse and expressive fruit character associated with Savigny-lès-Beaune. Aromas of ripe cherries, raspberries, and delicate florals lead into a smooth palate featuring red berries, subtle earthiness, and gentle spice. Silky tannins and refreshing acidity provide balance, while the lingering finish highlights the wine's refined structure. An approachable yet sophisticated Burgundy, it pairs beautifully with roasted meats, poultry, and traditional French cuisine.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck, grilled pork tenderloin, herb-roasted chicken, mushroom risotto, braised veal, lamb chops, and aged Brie.

daou-eye-of-the-falcon.title: DAOU Reserve Eye of the Falcon 2018 750ml
daou-eye-of-the-falcon.bodyHtml:
The DAOU Eye of the Falcon showcases the mutual power and synergy of Cabernet Sauvignon (77%) and Petit Verdot (23%). The deep, concentrated color is just the beginning of this massive blend. A complex, sophisticated nose offers aromas of black currant, cassis, sweet cherry and blackberry, with underlying layers of graphite, tobacco leaf, leather and wet gravel.Stunningly bright fruit flavors cascade across the palate, with impressions of juicy boysenberry, fresh blueberries and black currant accented by cedar, black plum and dried herbs. The opulent fruit core transitions seamlessly to a robust mid-palate showing black olive, licorice and eastern spices, all finishing long and elegantly with black cherry, cocoa and plum. Powerful and rich, and polished in style and structure, this is nothing short of a blockbuster vintage.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This blend of 75% Cabernet Sauvignon and 25% Petit Verdot begins with aromas of charred coffee beans, blistered black plums and cherries, with accents of lilac and dried beef. The roasted flavors extend across the palate, bringing together espresso, soy, charred meat and dark fruit. The tannins are polished yet hefty

absolut-voices-limited-2021.title: Absolut 2021 Limited Edition Voices Vodka
absolut-voices-limited-2021.bodyHtml:
Absolut 2021 Limited Edition 'Voices' Vodka is a collectible Swedish vodka release celebrating individuality, creativity, and the power of human connection. Launched in October 2021, this special edition features Absolut's original premium vodka presented in a striking sapphire-blue bottle with embossed soundwave patterns and a colourful decorative medallion. Crafted from Swedish winter wheat and pure water sourced near Åhus, it delivers the clean, smooth character for which Absolut is known. The bottle contains 80% recycled glass, combining distinctive design with a focus on sustainability. Produced in a limited global run, Absolut Voices is equally suited to cocktails and display collections.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, fresh oysters, caviar, pickled vegetables, sushi, creamy cheeses, and lightly seasoned seafood dishes.

Tasting Notes: Clean, smooth, and balanced, featuring subtle grain sweetness, delicate citrus, and gentle peppery warmth.

Nose: Soft wheat grain, faint citrus, and delicate hints of fresh bread.

Palate: Smooth and rounded, with mild grain sweetness, subtle citrus, and a clean, neutral character.

Finish: Crisp and refreshing, with gentle warmth and a subtle grain-driven sweetness.

Serve: Serve well chilled or over ice. Ideal for a Vodka Martini, Moscow Mule, Cosmopolitan, or Vodka Soda.

bruno-brunello-di-montalcino-docg.title: Pinino Brunello Di Montalcino Vigna Docg

arcanum-valadorna-1-5.title: Tenuta di Arceno Valadorna 2018 1.5L Magnum
arcanum-valadorna-1-5.bodyHtml:
Expressive aromas of nutmeg spice are supplemented by notes of fresh strawberry and vanilla. A soft and supple mouthfeel is underscored by elegant tannins that envelope the mid-palate. Optimal acidity keeps this wine bright and balanced. Flavors of ripe black cherry and sweet balsamic are accompanied by a lingering finish with notes of tobacco, cedar and a hint of cinnamon. The 2018 Valadorna is a stunning wine that can be enjoyed for years to come.

Blend: 100% Merlot

94 Points - Wine Spectator

An evolving red, supple and boasting cherry, raspberry, vanilla, coffee and spice flavors. Fresh and harmonious, fluid on the palate, with fine tannins uplifting the long finish. Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot. Best from 2025 through 2038.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Available in a heavy glass bottle, this is now 100% Merlot with fruit from two late-ripening vineyard sites (Valadorna and Capraia). The Tenuta di Arceno 2018 Valadorna is a dense, full-bodied Tuscan wine with hints of rosemary and grilled spice and plenty of velvety softness. This vintage shows extra spiciness for barbecued meat on the grill. This wine started off with only Merlot but became a Bordeaux blend in later years; however, the 2018, 2019 and 2021 vintages are 100% Merlot.

92 Points - James Suckling

This is a soft red with the texture of fine velvet, offering dark-berry and chocolate aromas and flavors. Medium-bodied palate that’s attractive and delicious. Seductive. Drink or hold.

solengo-igt-toscana-1.title: Il Borro Igt Toscana 2019 750ml
solengo-igt-toscana-1.bodyHtml:
Critic tasting note (2020 vintage):
“Absolutely solid and focused, it displays notes of black plums, blackberries, juniper berries, black plums, sour cherries, licorice, dark chocolate, guarana, green tea leaves, eucalyptus, sage, and calamint. Medium to full body, soft tannins, and a finish of great grace and lightness. Better from 2025.”
— Raffaele Vecchione, WinesCritic.com

corton-charlemagne-grand-cru-2018.title: Armand Heitz Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 2018
corton-charlemagne-grand-cru-2018.bodyHtml: Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted chicken, seared scallops in butter, grilled salmon, or a selection of soft French cheeses like Brie.

olivier-leflaive-chablis-les-deux-rives.title: Olivier Leflaive Chassagne-Montrachet 2023
olivier-leflaive-chablis-les-deux-rives.bodyHtml:
Olivier Leflaive Chassagne-Montrachet 2023 is 100% Chardonnay from estate vineyards and selected Chassagne-Montrachet parcels. Fermented in oak and matured for 18 months, it combines Japanese grapefruit aromas with a juicy palate, subtle humus and fern notes, balancing substance, freshness, power and finesse.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with mustard-glazed mackerel, creamy shrimp blanquette, roasted turbot, or herb-roasted chicken.

 

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of crushed stone, fresh herbs and light pineapple entice, while the palate shows a medium-body with good depth of fruit and flavor. Clear fruit and tension from fine, integrated grape tannins.

o-leflaive-chablis-1er-cru-montee.title: William Fevre Chablis 1er Cru Montee de Tonnerre
o-leflaive-chablis-1er-cru-montee.bodyHtml:
William Fèvre Chablis 1er Cru Montée de Tonnerre is a prestigious Burgundy white wine crafted from 100% Chardonnay. This exceptional Premier Cru reveals aromas of citrus, white flowers, oyster shell, and flinty minerality, with a precise palate featuring vibrant acidity, elegant texture, chalky freshness, refined structure, and a long complex finish.

Food Pairing :Oysters, lobster, grilled fish, shellfish, scallops, goat cheese, sushi, and delicate white meat dishes.

olivier-leflaive-montagny-1er-cru.title: Olivier Leflaive Montagny 1er Cru 2021 750ml
olivier-leflaive-montagny-1er-cru.bodyHtml: Full and round on the palate with notes of minerality, spices and hazelnut. It is fresh and pleasing in the first two to three years with seven years aging potential. Ideal with cheeses such as the goat's milk cheeses, le Beaufort, le Comté, l'Emmental or le Saint-Paulin.

o-leflaive-bourgogne-cuvee-margot.title: Olivier Leflaive Bourgogne Cuvee Margot 2022 750ml
o-leflaive-bourgogne-cuvee-margot.bodyHtml: A flattering nose with aromas of small red berries (strawberry, raspberry). A fresh and elegant palate on crunchy fruits and fine tannins. Ideal with meat pies and spicy food.

burwood-bee-whisperer-whisky-cls.title: Burwood Bee Whisperer Alberta Prairie Whisky
burwood-bee-whisperer-whisky-cls.bodyHtml:
Burwood Bee Whisperer is an Alberta Prairie Whisky from Burwood Distillery in Calgary, part of the distillery's Grains of Truth whisky series. It marries Burwood's rich, full-bodied single malt whisky with a small amount of the distillery's own distilled, barrel-aged spirit made from local honey. Fruity malt flavours lead, and on closer tasting the honey spirit brings out wildflower, honeysuckle and warm caramel notes. Burwood grows, ferments, distils and bottles it in Calgary. The label tells a tongue-in-cheek newspaper story about the distillery's own bee whisperer. Bottled at 46% ABV in a 750 mL bottle.

Tasting Notes: Smooth and delicate, with honeysuckle and wildflowers alongside fresh Alberta barley and caramel.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

burwood-spiced-apple-gin-cls.title: Burwood Distillery Spiced Apple Gin
burwood-spiced-apple-gin-cls.bodyHtml:
Burwood Spiced Apple Gin is part of the Winter Festival series of small-batch seasonal gins from Burwood Distillery in Calgary, Alberta, and takes its inspiration from hot spiced apple cider. Apple stays in the background as a canvas for the spices, with cinnamon, clove and juniper on the tongue. Add tonic or soda and the gin changes colour in the glass, an effect Burwood likens to the Northern Lights. Bottled at 44% ABV in a 750 mL bottle.

Tasting Notes: Apple with cinnamon, clove and juniper.

Serve: With tonic and lime, or in a spiced apple sangria.

burwood-mandarin-or-cranberry-gin-cls.title: Burwood Distillery Mandarin Orange & Cranberry Gin
burwood-mandarin-or-cranberry-gin-cls.bodyHtml:
Burwood Mandarin Orange & Cranberry Gin is part of the Winter Festival series of small-batch seasonal gins from Burwood Distillery in Calgary, Alberta. It pairs two holiday favourites: mandarin orange takes the lead as the main flavour, while cranberry adds a subtle layer of complexity that rounds out each sip. Burwood describes it as an easy-drinking gin for sipping on the rocks or mixing in cocktails such as a Cranberry Mandarin Fizz, or topping with soda or prosecco in the style of a French 75. Bottled at 44% ABV in a 750 mL bottle.

Tasting Notes: Mandarin orange up front with a subtle cranberry note.

Serve: On the rocks, with soda, or topped with prosecco.

burwood-winter-berry-gin-cls.title: Burwood Distillery Winter Berry Gin
burwood-winter-berry-gin-cls.bodyHtml:
Burwood Winter Berry Gin is one of the Winter Festival small-batch seasonal gins from Burwood Distillery in Calgary, Alberta, created as a winter follow-up to the distillery's summer Garden Party gins. Mulberry is the dominant flavour and brings a sweet, gummy-candy note, persimmon gives a silky mouthfeel, and cranberry adds complexity while keeping the sweetness in balance. Burwood encourages getting creative with it: try it with soda, in a Winter Berry Fizz, or topped with prosecco in the manner of a French 75. Bottled at 44% ABV in a 750 mL bottle.

Tasting Notes: Sweet mulberry, silky persimmon and a balancing touch of cranberry.

Serve: With soda, in a gin fizz, or topped with prosecco.

belle-glos-las-alturas-gold-wax.title: Belle Glos Las Alturas Pinot Noir - Gold Wax 2020 750ml
belle-glos-las-alturas-gold-wax.bodyHtml:
Ruby red in colour with fragrant aromas of blueberry pie, dried fig, kola nut and hints of coffee grounds. Dark berry fruit on the palate with flavours of blackberry pie, black cherry, creamy milk chocolate and subtle notes of nutmeg. Rich and structured, this wine has beautiful acidity that lingers through to a long, mouthwatering finish.

91 Points  - Wine Spectator

Ripe and decadently spiced, with concentrated kirsch, dark plum and cola flavors that are well-knit. The plush, creamy finish packs Asian spice notes. Drink now.

belle-glos-las-alturas-green-wax.title: Belle Glos Las Alturas Pinot Noir 2020
belle-glos-las-alturas-green-wax.bodyHtml:
Ruby red in colour with fragrant aromas of blueberry pie, dried fig, kola nut and hints of coffee grounds. Dark berry fruit on the palate with flavours of blackberry pie, black cherry, creamy milk chocolate and subtle notes of nutmeg. Rich and structured, this wine has beautiful acidity that lingers through to a long, mouthwatering finish.

91 Points  - Wine Spectator

Ripe and decadently spiced, with concentrated kirsch, dark plum and cola flavors that are well-knit. The plush, creamy finish packs Asian spice notes. Drink now.

kahlua-vanilla.title: Kahlua Vanilla 375ml
kahlua-vanilla.bodyHtml:
Kahlúa Vanilla is a vanilla-flavoured version of Kahlúa, the coffee liqueur brand that began in Veracruz, Mexico, in 1936 and has been part of Pernod Ricard since 2005. This bottling is produced in Arkansas in the United States and is bottled at 20% ABV in a 375 ml bottle.

Serve: Over ice, with milk or cream, or added to coffee and coffee-based cocktails.

evan-williams-1783-bourbon-1.title: Evan Williams 1783 Small Batch Bourbon
evan-williams-1783-bourbon-1.bodyHtml:
Named after the year Evan Williams first established his distillery on the banks of the Ohio River, 1783 Small Batch is a brilliant step up from the standard black label. This award-winning Kentucky Straight Bourbon is pulled from a small batch of barrels (no more than 300 at a time) and bottled at 90 proof, delivering a richer, more complex flavor profile with exceptional smoothness.

 

NOSE

Rich aromas of oaky vanilla, sautéed butter, and sweet corn.

PALATE

Semi-sweet and oaky with robust flavors of honey, rich caramel, and subtle baking spices.

FINISH

Lean, off-dry, and lingering with a warm, satisfying oak influence.

bread-and-butter-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Bread & Butter Cabernet Sauvignon
bread-and-butter-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Bread & Butter Cabernet Sauvignon is an approachable, full-bodied, and luscious red wine crafted to highlight classic California fruit intensity. Sourced from vineyard parcels across the state, it undergoes controlled barrel aging to integrate smooth tannins with rich, comforting flavors. In the glass, it displays a deep ruby hue with inviting aromas of dark plum, ripe boysenberry, mocha, and toasted oak. On the palate, it delivers a round, velvety texture filled with juicy blackberry, dark cherry, and cassis, seamlessly framed by subtle nuances of vanilla, sweet tobacco, and gentle baking spices that carry through to a soft, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted whole lamb shoulder, grilled ribeye steak, juicy bacon cheeseburgers, barbecued ribs, hearty beef stew, and aged cheddar cheese.

el-tequileno-sassenach-select-reposado.title: El Tequileno Gran Reserva Reposado Tequila
el-tequileno-sassenach-select-reposado.bodyHtml:
El Tequileño Gran Reserva Reposado Tequila is a premium additive-free Reposado tequila produced at Destiladora del Valle de Tequila (NOM 1108) in Tequila, Jalisco. Crafted using 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agave from the Highlands of Jalisco (Los Altos), it is cooked in autoclaves, fermented in open-air cement tanks with volcanic spring water, and copper pot distilled. Aged for a minimum of 8 months in American oak barrels and expertly blended with a small portion of 18-month aged Añejo, it offers a harmonious profile of rich cooked agave, sweet vanilla, caramel, and gentle oak spice.

Food Pairing: Grilled carne asada, fish or pork carnitas tacos, mole poblano, roasted poultry, or flan.

Tasting Notes : Light golden amber with a smooth, rich, and creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Cooked agave, vanilla, caramelized pear, honey, subtle nutmeg, and a touch of oak.

Palate : Creamy and balanced with flavors of sweet cooked agave, light oak, vanilla, macadamia nut, toffee, and subtle white pepper spice.

Finish : Long, soft, and velvety with lingering agave sweetness, gentle drying warmth, and delicate oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Riedel tequila glass or Glencairn, over a large ice cube, or as an elevated base for a Mexican Old Fashioned or Tommy's Margarita.

sailor-jerry-spiced-rum-pet.title: Sailor Jerry Spiced Navy Rum Plastic Bottle 375ml
sailor-jerry-spiced-rum-pet.bodyHtml:
Sailor Jerry Spiced Rum is a spiced Caribbean rum blended with natural spices, created in honour of Norman "Sailor Jerry" Collins (1911-1973), the father of old-school tattooing. The brand is fully owned by William Grant & Sons, the fifth-generation Scottish family distiller. This Canadian bottling is at 46% ABV in a 375ml plastic bottle.

Serve: With cola and a wedge of lime (the classic Jerry Cola), or in rum punches.

adobe-road-bavarian-lion-cabernet-sauvig.title: Adobe Reserva Organic Cabernet Sauvignon
adobe-road-bavarian-lion-cabernet-sauvig.bodyHtml:
Adobe Reserva Organic Cabernet Sauvignon is an appealing, organic Chilean red wine displaying a bright ruby-red color. The nose offers expressive aromas of black cherries, ripe plums, and subtle cassis, elegantly blended with delicate notes of black pepper, chocolate, and lightly toasted oak. On the palate, it is smooth and well-balanced, featuring a medium body, soft velvety tannins, balanced acidity, and a fruit-forward finish with gentle hints of spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled red meats, juicy burgers, pasta with tomato sauce, roasted pork loin, or medium-aged cheeses like gouda.

latitude-50-white-domestic.title: Gray Monk L50 (Latitude 50) White
latitude-50-white-domestic.bodyHtml:
Gray Monk L50 (Latitude 50) White is a bright, refreshing, and aromatic Canadian white blend. It offers an inviting, pale straw color and opens with expressive notes of citrus, green apple, peach, and tropical fruit, paired with delicate hints of orange blossom and soft spice. Light-to-medium-bodied and smooth on the palate, this just off-dry wine balances a juicy core of orchard fruit flavors with crisp acidity, leading to a refreshing and cleanly spiced finish.

Food Pairing: This versatile white wine pairs perfectly with fresh seafood salad, crab cakes, spicy jambalaya, baked salmon, or a creamy Brie cheese platter.

spottswoode-estate-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Spottswoode Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
spottswoode-estate-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Spottswoode Estate Cabernet Sauvignon is a benchmark Napa Valley Cabernet, offering layered aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, violet, graphite, and cedar. Powerful yet impeccably balanced, it delivers remarkable depth, freshness, and elegance with exceptional aging potential.
 
Food Pairing: Pairs best with dry-aged ribeye, rack of lamb, beef tenderloin, wild mushroom dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

 

99 Points - James Suckling

Pure black currants on the nose with an incredible al dente grape character. It’s almost like grape must. Undertone of ink and violets and sandalwood. Perfumed. Hints of spearmint. Full-bodied, but so well-formed and reserved. A touch of mint on the palate with dark fruits. It is very complete and reminds me of the classy Spottswoode 2001. I keep being impressed with the purity of fruit with the earthy undertones and stones. Savory. A fitting 40th anniversary wine. 90% cabernet sauvignon, 7% cabernet franc, and 3% petit verdot. Best after 2027.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Moving to the Grand Vin, the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon reveals a deep, dense purple color as well as a primordial nose of ripe black fruits, cassis, camphor, scorched earth, violet, and lead pencil aromas and flavors. Reminding me of a young Leoville Las Cases with its closed, dense, structured style, it's concentrated, has a pure, layered, focused style, ripe tannins, and a great finish. It needs 5-7 years of bottle age and will evolve for 30+ years. The blend of the 2021 is 87% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Cabernet Franc, and the rest Petit Verdot.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Slated for a September 2024 release, Spottswoode's 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon comes across as more vibrant, floral and fresh than the 2020. Violet and cassis notes are accented by hints of crushed stone and pencil shavings on the nose. Hugely complex yet harmonious, this medium-bodied effort is firm but silky in feel, with a long, elegant finish. Lovely stuff.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

This offers a gorgeous display of pure, unadulterated mulberry, boysenberry and plum fruit puree flavors that glisten as they move along, throwing off light accents of anise, violet and hibiscus along the way. Inlaid with an underlying fine-grained structure in the form of sleek threads of iron and alder, this shows tensile strength while extending through the long, refined finish.

sailor-jerry-spiced-rum-pet-1.title: Sailor Jerry Spiced Navy Rum Plastic Bottle 375ml
sailor-jerry-spiced-rum-pet-1.bodyHtml:
Sailor Jerry Spiced Rum is a spiced Caribbean rum blended with natural spices, created in honour of Norman "Sailor Jerry" Collins (1911-1973), the father of old-school tattooing. The brand is fully owned by William Grant & Sons, the fifth-generation Scottish family distiller. This Canadian bottling is at 46% ABV in a 375ml plastic bottle.

Serve: With cola and a wedge of lime (the classic Jerry Cola), or in rum punches.

kentucky-owl-wiseman-rye.title: Kentucky Owl The Wiseman Rye
kentucky-owl-wiseman-rye.bodyHtml:
THE WISEMAN™ Straight Rye is a traditional Rye made with a mash bill of 95% Rye. A spicy nose progresses to the taste, filling the mouth and tickling the tastebuds. The long finish starts as fresh rye bread and moves slowly toward buttered cinnamon toast, ending with just a hint of English walnut.

The Awards

Gold Medal winner at the 2022 San Francisco World Spirits Competition

casamigos-blanco-tequila.title: Casamigos Blanco Tequila 375ml
casamigos-blanco-tequila.bodyHtml:
Casamigos Blanco Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. The agave pinas are roasted in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours and undergo an extra-slow 80-hour fermentation process. Rested for two months in stainless steel tanks, it presents a crisp, clean spirit with a smooth, sweet agave-forward profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh ceviche, fish tacos, grilled shrimp, guacamole with tortilla chips, chicken fajitas, and key lime pie.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear in appearance, delivering a smooth, light, and crisp mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Hints of citrus, sweet cooked agave, subtle vanilla, and light floral notes.

Palate : Smooth and clean with prominent notes of sweet agave, vanilla, fresh lime, and soft mint.

Finish : Long, smooth, and crisp with a clean, lingering sweetness and subtle spice.

Serve : Best served neat, on the rocks, or as a base in a premium cocktail like a Margarita or Paloma.

clynelish-12-year-2022-special-release.title: Clynelish 12 Year Old Special Release 2022
clynelish-12-year-2022-special-release.bodyHtml:
Clynelish 12 Year Old Special Release 2022 is a single malt Scotch whisky from Diageo's annual Special Releases collection of cask strength malts, chosen that year by master blender Dr Craig Wilson. The famously waxy Clynelish spirit was given a secondary maturation in Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry-seasoned casks, which brings out a darker, sweet-spiced side of the distillery character. It is bottled at natural cask strength of 58.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle. A splash of water brings out herbal and waxy notes.

Tasting Notes: Mincemeat, pear, heather honey, sherry sweetness and pepper.

Nose: Creamy and fruity, with mincemeat, tinned pears and heather honey.

Palate: Rich and wine-sweet, balanced by peppery oak spice.

Finish: Long, chilli-spiced and drying, with lingering pepper.

Serve: Neat, or with a dash of water to lift the herbal and waxy notes.

mortlach-2022-special-release.title: Mortlach Special Release 2022
mortlach-2022-special-release.bodyHtml:
Mortlach, a Speyside distillery with a reputation for its rich and meaty character, produces this limited-edition expression. The 2022 release, bottled at a robust 57.8% ABV, boasts an intensified flavour profile with dark fruit notes, hints of chocolate, and a touch of spice. This is a whiskey for those who appreciate bold, full-bodied drams.

Nestled in its dark, historic vale, Mortlach has long lured aficionados to its deep and magnetic character. It has its own aura; the light seems to draw lower through its hallowed doors. Even the way of things is different, the whisky 2.81 times distilled in six singing stills arranged in a pattern found nowhere else. Part science, part mystery. Bold, yet enigmatic.

Gleaming with ruby light, this legendary whisky was finished in a combination of Virgin Oak, Tawny Port and Red Muscat wine casks enhancing its deep amber colour. Robust aromas of rich wine and sweet grape entwine with Mortlach meatiness. Dark and richly layered, the intense, lively and sweetly fruity taste glows with gingery depth spiced by original part-maturation in Virgin Oak. Late at night, in flickering light, the finish soars above all. A whisky to cherish; sweetness, darkness and depth drawn together in mystical union.

  • A wonderfully intense, structured Mortlach that ensnares the meaty “Beast of Dufftown” in a deep, spicy, ruby-red fruitiness forged in a highly unusual combination of maturation casks.
  • Dark, sweet, ruby richness entwined with gingery depth. Finished in Tawny Port, Red Muscato and Virgin Oak casks.
  • A deliciously rich expression of Mortlach’s dark, meaty character that draws sweetness, darkness, and depth together in a mystical, intensely fruity union.
  • Best served neat, pour 60ml of Mortlach SR22 in a whisky glass and enjoy.
  • Mortlach SR22 is a unique gift that stands out within the Special Releases collection, and is perfect for get-togethers with friends or family.

roserock-zephirine-pinot-noir.title: Roserock Zephirine Pinot Noir 2022
roserock-zephirine-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Zéphirine Pinot Noir embodies the poetic qualities of the Roserock vineyard. It is alive with aromas of freshly picked raspberries, citrus, and marionberries, followed by delicate traces of rose petals and violets. On the palate, there is a vibrant mix of juicy strawberries, cardamom, fruit, and spice. Both subtle and strong-willed, the 2022 Zéphirine is charming in its youth, with a silky-smooth texture and balanced structure that promise a long future.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

A richer red hue, the 2022 Pinot Noir Zephine Roserock is also more floral and has some savory elements, but it also has a more pronounced dark stone mineral tone, with violets, black raspberries, tea leaf, and toasted spices. Medium-bodied, it’s ripe but has fantastic linear drive through its floral-noted finish, and the lift almost suggests whole cluster, yet it’s entirely destemmed. Drink it over the next 15 or more years.

 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This version is loaded with tension and tightly structured at this point, but also dynamic with cherry and blueberry flavors that are laced with clove, cardamom and other dusky spices as this builds tension toward refined tannins.

glenallachie-14yo-bourbon-discovery-g-m.title: Gordon & MacPhail Discovery Glenallachie 14 Year Old 43% ABV
glenallachie-14yo-bourbon-discovery-g-m.bodyHtml:
Bottled at 43% after maturing in ex-Bourbon casks, this 14 year old GlenAllachie has been bottled under Gordon & MacPhail's Discovery label

Aroma: Perfumed green apples with dried banana and lime zest. Soft milk chocolate gives way to salted almonds and vanilla pod.

Taste: Smooth and creamy custard combines with lemon posset and malted biscuit. Blossom honey undertones develop alongside subtle white pepper.

Finish: Medium bodied with spice.

grgich-hill-cabernet-sauvignon-2013.title: Grgich Hills Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2010 750ml
grgich-hill-cabernet-sauvignon-2013.bodyHtml:
Grgich Hills crafts their Cabernet Sauvignon with minimal intervention, farming our vineyards naturally, without artificial pesticides or herbicides. This wine is packed with rich aromas of black cherry and licorice with a hint of mocha and vintage leather. Its full body and fine-grained tannins make it the perfect partner with grilled steak, rack of lamb or roasted duck.
91 Points - Wine Spectator
A wine that offers a tight, focused beam of loamy earth, dried dark berry, cedar, anise and espresso. Features good length, with gripping tannins. Shows Grgich Hills at the top of its Cabernet game. Best from 2015 through 2026.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This valley-wide blend comes from Yountville, Calistoga and Rutherford. It combines the best fruit of the appellations, resulting in a dry, full-bodied and tannic young wine, with classic Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon flavors of cassis. Beautiful now, after a few hours of decanting, and should hold in the bottle for at least eight years.

grgich-hill-cabernet-sauvignon-2014.title: Grgich Hills Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2010 750ml
grgich-hill-cabernet-sauvignon-2014.bodyHtml:
Grgich Hills crafts their Cabernet Sauvignon with minimal intervention, farming our vineyards naturally, without artificial pesticides or herbicides. This wine is packed with rich aromas of black cherry and licorice with a hint of mocha and vintage leather. Its full body and fine-grained tannins make it the perfect partner with grilled steak, rack of lamb or roasted duck.
91 Points - Wine Spectator
A wine that offers a tight, focused beam of loamy earth, dried dark berry, cedar, anise and espresso. Features good length, with gripping tannins. Shows Grgich Hills at the top of its Cabernet game. Best from 2015 through 2026.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This valley-wide blend comes from Yountville, Calistoga and Rutherford. It combines the best fruit of the appellations, resulting in a dry, full-bodied and tannic young wine, with classic Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon flavors of cassis. Beautiful now, after a few hours of decanting, and should hold in the bottle for at least eight years.

luce-brunello-di-montalcino-2017.title: Tenuta Luce Brunello di Montalcino 2017
luce-brunello-di-montalcino-2017.bodyHtml:
Tenuta Luce Brunello di Montalcino 2017 is an exceptional Tuscan red wine crafted exclusively from Sangiovese grapes grown in the elevated vineyards of Montalcino. Produced by the renowned Tenuta Luce estate, this prestigious Brunello reflects the warmth and concentration of the 2017 vintage. Matured for at least 24 months in Slavonian oak barrels, it reveals rich cherry, ripe red orange, delicate spice, and refined tannins. Its elegant structure, vibrant acidity, and remarkable depth create a sophisticated wine with excellent ageing potential.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised beef, wild boar ragù, truffle risotto, aged Pecorino, and roasted mushrooms.


94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Here's a handsome bottle inside and out. The 2017 Brunello di Montalcino Luce is an exuberant and flashy expression of Sangiovese. Just like the etched label design that features sunbeams, the wine radiates fresh fruit, cherry, spice, tar, licorice and grilled herb. The house style favors a contemporary and rich style of Sangiovese, and the wine's velvety approach is measured against the ample texture and fruit weight presented here. This warm 2017 vintage is well interpreted by the folks at Tenuta Luce.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Underbrush, violet and baked plum are some of the aromas you'll find on this bold red. Big and savory, the warm palate is brawny but polished, offering fleshy black cherry, licorice and tobacco framed in velvety, enveloping tannins. It's already almost accessible but also offers good midterm aging potential. Drink through 2027.

91 Points - Wine Spectator
A rich red, this boasts cherry, plum, leather, tobacco, bitter almond and herb flavors. Taut and dense, with brisk acidity and dusty tannins that truncate the finish for now. Traditional style. Best from 2025 through 2040.

rombauer-napa-valley-merlot.title: Rombauer Merlot 2022 750ml
rombauer-napa-valley-merlot.bodyHtml:
Ripe black plum, black tea and mint aromas mingle in the glass with subtle scents of spice, freshly baked pie crust, and vanilla. This wine's lively palate jumps with cherry and plum flavors with a touch of mint and hint of spice, all giving way to notes of dark chocolate and vanilla. Its signature palate is framed by very fine, yet soft tannins and a refreshing length, enhanced by its acidity.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Clear, direct fruit flavors such as red cherries and cranberries are nicely framed in moderate tannins and balanced acidity, while spicy accents of clove and cedar weave in as you sip.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of ripe cherries and red plums with red licorice, mocha and wet stones. Medium- to full-bodied with polished tannins and chalky texture. Fresh mix of red and dark fruit on the mid-palate, with a juicy finish and notes of savory herbs at the end.

summer-love-peach-vodka-3.title: Starr Distilling Summer Love Peach Vodka
summer-love-peach-vodka-3.bodyHtml:
Starr Distilling Summer Love Peach Vodka is a peach-flavoured vodka from Starr Distilling in Alberta. The distillery describes it as light and highly aromatic, with a ripe-peach character that recalls a summer orchard. Bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is made to sip on its own or to bring peach flavour to cocktails.

Serve: Over ice, with soda and a squeeze of lemon, or in a peach Bellini-style cocktail.

jordan-chardonnay-russian-river.title: Jordan Chardonnay 2023
jordan-chardonnay-russian-river.bodyHtml:
The Jordan Chardonnay 2023 is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex New World white wine that beautifully captures the unique, sun-drenched alluvial soils and natural concentration of this exceptionally cool, extended growing season in Sonoma County. It pours a brilliant pale gold colour with subtle greenish reflections in the glass, lifting with an immediate, aromatic bouquet of white peach, citrus zest, and delicate floral blossoms, seamlessly layered with intricate undertones of Fuji apple, orange peel, crisp red Bosc pear, and a hint of warm baking spices. On the palate, this medium-bodied Chardonnay is remarkably poised, graceful, and smooth, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of zesty lime, fresh kumquats, Gravenstein apples, and a fine-boned framework driven by chalky, tingly minerality that balances the naturally crisp, vibrant profile of the 2023 vintage. Aged carefully for 6 months in French oak barrels (with components fermented in stainless steel and concrete eggs) to enhance its structural depth and natural sophistication, it is driven by a finely balanced, food-friendly acidity and a super-sleek texture that carries into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by an integrated touch of vanilla and lightly toasted oak.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of refined culinary options, including Dungeness crab, pan-seared sea scallops in brown-butter sauce, poached Atlantic lobster with drawn butter, roasted chicken or turkey breast, creamy wild mushroom risottos, grilled veal chops with morel cream sauce, and premium Tsar Nicoulai caviar.

93 Points - James Suckling

A tight and bright citrus- and mineral-driven wine. Aromas of flint, wet stones, Meyer lemons and lime zest with subtle white flowers. The palate is focused and textural, with loads of minerals and citrus oil in the finish.

90 Wine Spectator

Crisp and fresh, with lemon curd, tangerine and apple flavors that are vibrant, plus accents of tarragon, vetiver, jasmine and lime salt. The frame is sleek and mouthwatering, offering a long, lingering finish. Drink now.

jordan-cabernet-sauvignon-alexander-vall.title: Jordan Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
jordan-cabernet-sauvignon-alexander-vall.bodyHtml:
The 2021 vintage delivered ideal conditions for slow, even ripening, producing concentrated fruit and a cabernet of remarkable depth, balance and finesse. Harvested at peak maturity, this wine highlights the refined structure and elegance that define Alexander Valley, offering both early appeal and excellent aging potential.

Deep and complex, this Old-World-style vintage offers a harmonious blend of dark fruit, spice and earth. Mixed berries and bright blueberry meet a subtle hint of clove on the nose, leading to rich layers of blackberry, cocoa nib and white pepper on the palate. Structured tannins provide depth and balance, while extended aging in French oak enhances its elegance.

94 Points - James Suckling

The nose is slightly restrained and intriguing, with graphite, dried herbs, black cherries, red cherries, anise and stones. The palate is incredibly silky and complete, with rose petals in the finish. A very pretty cabernet that is wonderful now and will reveal more with time. Drink or hold.

tequila-cascahuin-cerro-de-luz-blanco.title: Cascahuin Blanco Tequila
tequila-cascahuin-cerro-de-luz-blanco.bodyHtml:
Cascahuín Blanco Tequila is a phenomenal, deeply traditional expression that stands as a benchmark for authentic, artisanal blanco tequila. Produced at the renowned Cascahuín Distillery (NOM 1123) in El Arenal, Jalisco, this spirit is crafted using 100% blue Weber agave cooked in traditional stone ovens (hornos) for up to 72 hours. The cooked agave is crushed using a combination of a roller mill and a traditional tahona, fermented in masonry tanks, and double-distilled in small copper pot stills. Unaged and bottled directly from the still, Cascahuín Blanco showcases the raw, unadulterated essence of highland agave, offering a vibrant balance of earthy minerals, bright citrus, and pungent herbal complexities.

Food Pairing: This crisp, mineral-forward blanco pairs exquisitely with fresh seafood like ceviche, fish tacos, raw oysters, or grilled shrimp with garlic and lime. It also beautifully cuts through the richness of traditional Mexican dishes like chicken enmoladas, pork carnitas, or fresh guacamole with salty tortilla chips.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh aguachile, tuna tostadas, grilled octopus, street-style carne asada tacos, guacamole with roasted tomatillo salsa, and fresh panela cheese.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and bright with silver reflections, presenting a light-to-medium body with a clean, silky, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh cooked agave, earthy wet stone, bright lime and grapefruit zest, sweet mint, and subtle black pepper.

Palate : Vibrant and clean with flavors of sweet roasted agave, citrus peel, herbal anise, mineral salinity, and cracked white pepper.

Finish : Crisp, clean, and warming with lingering notes of sweet cooked agave, earthy minerality, and gentle pepper spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tequila tasting glass or flute, chilled on the rocks with a lime twist, or as the pure agave foundation in a classic Margarita, Paloma, or Batanga.

benriach-malting-season-batch-1.title: Benriach Malting Season Third Edition
benriach-malting-season-batch-1.bodyHtml:
The Third Edition of Malting Season is crafted from concerto barley, chosen by Master Blender Dr. Rachel Barrie. The floor malted spirit slowly matures in virgin oak and first-fill bourbon casks giving a natural cask-imparted golden barley color.

“Every year during ‘Maltings Season’ our team hand malt select barley onsite. This historic process pays tribute to our founder, John Duff, and the slow craft of his historic maltings which we continue to this day in the pursuit of exceptional flavor,” said Stewart Buchanan, Global Brand Ambassador at Benriach. “Each new addition of Malting Season uses carefully chosen barley types and individual bottling strengths, making each annual edition one of a kind in its own right.

Malting Season Third Edition has malt sweetness on the nose with wild bergamot, pear, and meadowsweet honey. The palate leads to flavors of clementine, floral honey, and gentle barley spice, followed by flavors of malted almond, apricot, and traces of wild cherry.

benriach-malting-season-batch-2.title: Benriach Malting Season Second Edition
benriach-malting-season-batch-2.bodyHtml:
Benriach Malting Season Second Edition is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky made entirely from barley malted by hand on the distillery's own historic floor maltings. Master Blender Rachel Barrie chose concerto barley for its wholesome cereal flavour, and the spirit was matured in first-fill bourbon casks in Benriach's earthen-floored dunnage warehouses. The release comprises 30 first-fill bourbon barrels, all distilled on 20 November 2013; the label gives the malting season as autumn 2013 and the bottling year as 2022. It is bottled at 48.9% ABV in a 700ml bottle and comes in a presentation tube. The result is a smooth, richly creamy malt with layers of roasted malt and barley sweetness.

Nose: Rich malt sweetness with barley sugar and mandarin wrapped in creamy white chocolate.

Palate: Smooth honeycomb with citrus and orchard apple.

Finish: Enveloping fruit, malt and vanilla cream.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

bakesale-cookie-liqueur.title: Buffalo Trace Bourbon Cream Liqueur
bakesale-cookie-liqueur.bodyHtml: Indulgently creamy and remarkably smooth, the Buffalo Trace Distillery Bourbon Cream Liqueur is a decadent fusion of rich dairy cream and award-winning Kentucky Straight Bourbon. Unlike traditional cream liqueurs, this small-batch spirit highlights the bold character of its base bourbon, offering a sophisticated profile of caramel, toffee, and sweet vanilla. The palate is velvety and lush, delivering a dessert-like experience with a subtle hint of oak and spice that cuts through the sweetness for a balanced finish. At 15% ABV, it is highly versatile, whether enjoyed neat, chilled over ice, or as a spirited addition to hot coffee. It has even inspired the "Buffalo Float," a signature serve where the liqueur is paired with root beer for a nostalgic, adult twist. A consistent favourite for its quality and texture, it remains a top-tier choice for those seeking a premium, bourbon-forward cream liqueur.

bakesale-cookie-box.title: BakeSale Chocolate Chip Cookie Liqueur Cookie Box 12 x 50ml
bakesale-cookie-box.bodyHtml:
BakeSale Chocolate Chip Cookie Liqueur Cookie Box 12 x 50ml is a liqueur made from thousands of pounds of real chocolate chip cookies, so it tastes like cookies with a kick. Created in New York by founder William Kehler, it is bottled at 40% ABV, the strength of a vodka or tequila, and is gluten-free and dairy-free. The Cookie Box holds twelve 50ml tear-top pouches in a gift box made to look like a box of cookies. It won Double Gold at the 2022 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. Use it for cookie-flavoured shots, dessert martinis or boozy milkshakes.

Tasting Notes: Chocolate chip cookie, vanilla and chocolate.

Nose: Chocolate chip cookie.

Palate: Cookie dough sweetness and vanilla with a candied feel.

Finish: Sweet, with chocolate lingering.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, over ice, in coffee or blended with vanilla ice cream.

bakesale-cookie-pouches.title: BakeSale Chocolate Chip Cookie Liqueur Pouch 50ml
bakesale-cookie-pouches.bodyHtml:
BakeSale Chocolate Chip Cookie Liqueur Pouch 50ml is a liqueur made from thousands of pounds of real chocolate chip cookies, so it tastes like cookies with a kick. Created in New York by founder William Kehler, it is bottled at 40% ABV, the strength of a vodka or tequila, and is gluten-free and dairy-free. This listing is a single 50ml tear-top pouch, one shot's worth. It won Double Gold at the 2022 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. Use it for cookie-flavoured shots, dessert martinis or boozy milkshakes.

Tasting Notes: Chocolate chip cookie, vanilla and chocolate.

Nose: Chocolate chip cookie.

Palate: Cookie dough sweetness and vanilla with a candied feel.

Finish: Sweet, with chocolate lingering.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, over ice, in coffee or blended with vanilla ice cream.

talisker-distillers-edition-2.title: Talisker Distillers Edition
talisker-distillers-edition-2.bodyHtml:
Talisker Distillers Edition is a double-matured version of the single malt from Talisker, the oldest working distillery on the Isle of Skye, founded in 1830 by the brothers Hugh and Kenneth MacAskill. After its main maturation the whisky is finished in casks seasoned with Amoroso sherry, whose sweetness rounds off and tempers the distillery's robust maritime character. When the still house was destroyed by fire in 1960, Talisker rebuilt it with exact replicas of the old stills, keeping the U-shaped lyne pipes and traditional worm-tub cooling that still shape the spirit's texture. Bottled at 45.8% ABV in a 750ml bottle, the Distillers Edition is released in vintage-dated batches, so the distillation and bottling years printed on the label change from one release to the next.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

barnett-spring-mountain-cabernet-sauvign.title: Barnett Vineyards Spring Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
barnett-spring-mountain-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:
The 2019 Spring Mountain Cabernet is one concentrated wine. The opaque purple color is much darker than previous years. The aromatics fill the air with cassis, dark plum and black licorice. Coffee grounds, cola and dark chocolate are also prevalent. The wine is full and silky on the palate. Flavors of mocha, anise and dark cherries fill the mouth. The tannins are full and chalky with some firm mountain acidity for balance. The chocolate covered dark cherry finish lingers for a long time. This concentrated dark Cabernet will only get better over time.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Spring Mountain District bursts with vivacious cassis, wild blueberries and black raspberries scents plus touches of underbrush, pencil lead, violets and espresso. Full-bodied, tightly wound and supported by fine-grained tannins, the palate is beautifully pure, with a long fruity finish.

castiglion-del-bosco-millecento-riserva.title: Castiglion del Bosco Brunello di Montalcino 2019
castiglion-del-bosco-millecento-riserva.bodyHtml:
Castiglion del Bosco Brunello di Montalcino 2019 is a magnificent, highly refined expression of 100% Sangiovese reflecting an exceptional growing season in Tuscany. Sourced from the estate's organically farmed Capanna vineyard in the northwestern zone of Montalcino, this wine underwent natural fermentation followed by 24 months of maturation in French oak barrels. It possesses a bright, luminous ruby-red color, introducing an aromatic bouquet of ripe cherries, wild strawberries, and mandarin orange blossoms seamlessly woven with hints of cedar, sweet tobacco, and fresh Mediterranean herbs. The medium-to-full-bodied palate reveals a creamy texture, weightless concentration, and crisp acidity, wrapped in beautifully integrated, fine-grained tannins that carry into an incredibly long, vivid, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-braised wild boar, grilled Florentine steaks, roasted rosemary leg of lamb, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

96 Points - James Suckling

This is really fine on the palate with wonderfully integrated tannins that give tension and focus. It’s medium-bodied with lovely berry, cherry, cedar and spice. Peaches and flower stems, too. Creamy texture. Extremely long and vivid. Structured, but showing beautiful drinkability with wonderful balance and form. One to drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Cherry, plum, leather, earth and tomato leaf flavors highlight this broad, beefy red, with iron and sanguine accents creeping in as this winds down on the finish. Succulent and long, with a dusty grip in the end. Best from 2027 through 2043.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose starts floral, with aromas of roses, vanilla and cherry, then turns earthy, before spiced undertones of cloves and bergamot float to the surface. The cherries return on the palate, with more bitter citrus and earth tones, while finely grained tannins tickle the back of your tongue.
