kavalan-solist-ex-bourbon-53-20.title: Kavalan Solist Ex-Bourbon Cask Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-ex-bourbon-53-20.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist ex-Bourbon is a delightfully complex, multi-dimensional single malt whisky, with vanilla, fruit and coconut highlights. Matured in hand-selected fresh American ex-Bourbon casks, the whisky is available at cask strength and non chill-filtered, retaining the fuller flavour of a natural single malt whisky.

This was Bottled for Sierra Springs Liquor

2013 - Sept 6, 2021 (7 to 8 years old)


Colour
Luminous pale amber

Flavour
Clean & fresh tropical fruitiness with pleasant vanilla, coconut and spices.

Palate
Well-balanced natural sweetness, vanilla and oak spices, round and complex with silky smoothness.

Tasting
We suggest drinking Kavalan Solist ex-Bourbon Cask neat.

kaiyo-the-sheri-third-edition-whiskey.title: Kaiyo The Sheri Third Edition Mizunara Oak Finish Japanese Whisky
kaiyo-the-sheri-third-edition-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Kaiyo The Sheri Third Edition is a Japanese whisky from Kaiyo, the brand built around Japanese Mizunara oak and a spell of maturation at sea. The Sheri sits in Kaiyo's limited release series rather than its core range, and the third edition is described as the richest whisky the brand has released so far: a sherry-cask whisky finished in Mizunara oak, with its final stage of maturation spent on an ocean voyage. It is bottled un-chillfiltered at 46% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Kaiyo publishes no tasting notes for The Sheri: its master blender holds that this whisky does not need them, and regards it as the finest work of his career, a bottle meant to be shared and savoured.

Serve: Neat or with a few drops of water.

opus-one-2019f.title: Opus One Overture 2022
opus-one-2019f.bodyHtml: Overture 2022 captivates you from the start. Its aromatic profile weaves a complex tapestry of bright cherry, fresh forest berries, and cut rose stems interwoven with delicate scents of violets, toasted almond, and anise. Blackberry, blueberry, and wild cherry take the lead on the palate with a lively acidity that adds a vibrant edge. The finish is long and rounded, with a touch of mocha and black tea that showcase the wine’s depth. This expression of selected parcels from our estate vineyards will age gracefully for years to come.

krug-tribute-to-time.title: Krug Grand Cuvee Tribute To Time 159e
krug-tribute-to-time.bodyHtml:
Every year, the Krug House seeks to create the richest expression of champagne. This limited edition box of three bottles allows you to discover the influence of time on the 159th Edition of the house.

97 Points - James Suckling

A beautiful array of complex toastiness, fresh and roasted mushrooms, lemon, tangerine and peach, with honeysuckle and some spicy elements, too. The complexity and comfortingly rich, warming aromatic depth is in full song. The palate has vivacious, rich orange grapefruit, peach and lemon rind, with some exotic moments, and spicy flashes, too. There's a distinctive, plush and alluringly long, grapefruit and hazelnut finish.

louis-xiii-ruby.title: Louis XIII Cognac Ruby Red
louis-xiii-ruby.bodyHtml: The decanter and glasses were created by French glassmaker Saint Louis. To obtain the red hue, a "confidential" process involving the addition of gold was used. The decanter is blown, cut, decorated and engraved by hand. It features the brand’s iconic dentelle spikes and sports a palladium neck. The fleur de lys-shaped stopper is NFC-enabled, providing access to Louis XIII's membership society. Each decanter is individually numbered, with just 200 available worldwide.

promontory-2017.title: Promontory 2017
promontory-2017.bodyHtml:
The 2017 Promontory shares with predecessors an elusive scent of wet stones—though here, a minty, herbal note also rises from this mist. Subtle hints of red fruit cloak the wine’s finely articulated structure, overlaying a spine of acidity and chiseled tension. Energy livens the midpalate, almost like an electrical impulse, as the tannin—tightly coiled at first—gradually unwinds to reveal on the finish the delicate complexity of its many component strands. Although the 2017 is among the more introverted vintages to date, the patient listener is soon drawn into the entrancing interplay of the wine’s translucent layers.

98 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrant, tar, lead pencil and dark fruit. Full-bodied with resin, dark-berry and redwood undertones and firm, fine tannins. Salty. Leaner than some, but so long and bright. Vertical elegance here. Needs three to four years to soften and open.

97 Points - Robert Parker 

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2017 Promontory has a wonderfully fragrant nose of baked blackberries, plum preserves and black currant pastilles with an undercurrent of star anise, violets, espresso and tilled earth. Medium to full-bodied, it is soft-spoken and elegantly styled in the mouth, featuring skillfully managed, grainy tannins and bags of juicy black fruits, finishing long, earthy and remarkably energetic. This is certainly among the most profound of the 2017 Napa Cabernets and for followers of this vineyard, not one to be missed.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Winey and engaging, with steeped plum and blackberry fruit forming the core, while sleek, energetic apple wood and licorice snap accents fuel the finish. There's a hint of bramble along the edges, plus a long spine of dark earth and iron-accented minerality buried within. Impressive for the vintage. Best from 2024 through 2038.

jadot-chateau-des-jacques-mav-gr-carquel.title: Louis Jadot Chateau des Jacques Morgon
jadot-chateau-des-jacques-mav-gr-carquel.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Chateau des Jacques Morgon is an expressive Gamay offering black cherry, raspberry, violet, ripe plum, subtle spice, and mineral notes. Structured yet vibrant, the palate combines juicy fruit, fresh acidity, fine tannins, and earthy complexity through a persistent, balanced finish with classic Morgon character.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast chicken, grilled pork, charcuterie, mushroom dishes, duck breast, or semi-hard cheeses for a classic Beaujolais pairing.

joseph-phelps-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Joseph Phelps Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
joseph-phelps-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The Cabernet Sauvignon opens with an enticing bouquet of black and red fruits - juicy black cherry intertwined with fresh pomegranate and bright cassis. Notes of cedar spice and toasted coconut add intrigue and sophistication to the aromatic profile. On the palate, layers of raspberry compote anddried wild berries unfold across a full-bodied frame. The wine shows impressive density while maintaining elegance, supported by well-integrated tannins that provide structure without overwhelming. This is a wine of both power and finesse.

94 Points - James Suckling

Bright, lifted, black and red fruits with aromas of dark cherries, damson plums, cedar box and fresh herbs. The full-bodied palate has a supple, rounded mouthfeel and softly integrated tannins. 91% cabernet sauvignon with smatterings of the other main Bordeaux varieties. Lively and approachable yet plush with plenty of years ahead.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Joseph Phelps 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon is dominated by fruit from Yountville and Suscol; only 21% of the blend is from growers, as there's a push toward estate fruit. As always, there's some American oak in the mix, but that proportion is evolving downward. Redcurrants and cherries are joined by gentle dusty earth notes and hints of vanilla and cedar on the nose, while the medium to full-bodied palate is a bit more dusty and drying than the 2021, yet it remains soft and approachable.

montes-alpha-syrah.title: Montes Alpha Syrah 2021 750ml
montes-alpha-syrah.bodyHtml:
Deep red-violet in color, the nose is full of Syrah character, with strong notes of ripe blackberry and blueberry. On the palate, strawberry and cherry are underscored by meringue and liquorice with a subtle hint of leather. The palate is balanced and very smooth, with good body and a very appealing elegance.

Highly recommended with red meats, Mongolian beef, spaghetti with Bolognese sauce, and lambchops with Cabernet and mushroom sauce.

93 Points - James Suckling

Peppery and floral nose with some dark cherries, graphite, peppermint and wild herbs. Juicy and fine-grained on the palate with silky, close-knit tannins. Pretty long and bright. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

This is an intense full-bodied Syrah that offers bramble fruit intertwined with toasted oak aromas. Rich flavors of black and red fruit, along with coffee beans and graphite, are framed by firm tannins.

barossa-valley-estate-gsm.title: Barossa Valley Estate GSM
barossa-valley-estate-gsm.bodyHtml:
Barossa Valley Estate GSM is a beautifully crafted, luscious, and highly expressive red wine blend that perfectly epitomizes the contemporary, fruit-forward winemaking style of South Australia's premier valley. Combining three classic Rhône varieties, this wine captures the unique harmony between bright fruit, enticing spices, and a supple texture. In the glass, it displays a vibrant, deep ruby hue. The highly fragrant and expressive nose opens with dominant aromas of juicy red berries, ripe raspberries, and dark plums, beautifully integrated with complex notes of fragrant violets and subtle white pepper spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and incredibly smooth, offering an accessible, mouth-filling core of plush berries and black currants. This rich fruit profile is elegantly balanced by soft, gentle tannins and a freshness that carries into a long, flavorful, and clean finish underscored by a light touch of mocha.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-roasted rosemary lamb, grilled pork skewers, wood-fired Mediterranean vegetable flatbreads, or artisanal charcuterie boards.

barefoot-rose-spritzer-1.title: Barefoot Rose Spritzer 250ml
barefoot-rose-spritzer-1.bodyHtml:
Formerly labelled 'Perfectly Pink'. Depending on the release there may be limited edition labels. Please ensure your merchant has the wine you are looking for.

Critic tasting note: "Here's a light, sweet and aromatic pink wine with a definite Moscato flavor. A slight spritz and welcome acidity keep the texture lively, and the floral, candylike flavors last on the finish. Should go well with appetizers or dessert." - 86/100, Wine Enthusiast

pitu-cachaca.title: Pitu Cachaca
pitu-cachaca.bodyHtml:
Pitu Cachaca is the flagship cachaca from Pitu of Vitoria de Santo Antao, in the Brazilian state of Pernambuco, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750 ml bottle. Pitu is one of Brazil's best-known cachaca brands: it is the country's most exported cachaca, sold in more than 50 countries, the second most consumed cachaca across Brazil and the leader in the north-east of the country, and it holds a leading position in markets including Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico and Canada. Distilled from sugar cane, it is the essential base for a Caipirinha.

Serve: In a Caipirinha with fresh lime and sugar over crushed ice, or in a Batida with fruit juice.

sentir-rose-organic.title: Virgen De Las Vinas Sentir Rose NV 750ml
sentir-rose-organic.bodyHtml: The Sentir Rose Organic 750ml is a rosé wine that is certified organic. It is produced in Spain, specifically in the "OTHER (SPANISH)" region. This wine is a part of the Virgen de las Vinas range, and it is distributed in the US by BM Group Inc.

cachaca-51.title: Cachaça 51 1L
cachaca-51.bodyHtml:
Cachaça 51 is Brazil's best-known cachaça, made by Companhia Müller de Bebidas and sold here in the export 'Edição Internacional' packaging, which reaches more than 60 countries. It is produced entirely in the company's own distillery; the historic Pirassununga distillery farm grows its own sugar cane on a vast scale. The spirit is bright and crystal clear, with a soft, intense and slightly sweet taste and a rich nose of fruity and floral notes. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 1L bottle, it is made for mixing and is the classic base for a Caipirinha with fresh lime and sugar.

Tasting Notes: Bright and crystal clear.

Nose: Smooth and rich, with marked fruity and floral notes.

Palate: Soft, intense and slightly sweet.

Serve: In a Caipirinha, or with orange slices over ice.

captain-morgan-gingerbread-spiced.title: Captain Morgan Original Spiced Rum 1.75L
captain-morgan-gingerbread-spiced.bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan Original Spiced Rum is a world-renowned Caribbean classic, celebrated for its warm, approachable, and smooth character. Expertly blended with a secret recipe of mellow Caribbean rums, natural spices, and a hint of vanilla, it is aged in charred white oak barrels to create a perfectly balanced spirit that has become a staple of casual gatherings and vibrant cocktails.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoky barbecue ribs, jerk chicken, pulled pork sliders, or spicy buffalo wings. For dessert, it beautifully complements dark chocolate brownies, pecan pie, or a warm bread pudding.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber appearance with a smooth, light, and easy-drinking body on the palate.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, brown sugar, subtle toasted oak, cinnamon, and gentle baking spices.

Palate : Smooth and sweet featuring dominant vanilla, warm caramel, brown sugar, rich oak, and light spice accents.

Finish : Smooth and medium in length with a clean, warm finish of lingering vanilla and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve mixed with cola over fresh ice with a lime wedge, or as a classic cocktail base.

trolley-5-shes-crafty-strawberry-bl-cls.title: Trolley 5 She'S Crafty Strawberry Bl Cls 4 Tall Cans
trolley-5-shes-crafty-strawberry-bl-cls.bodyHtml: Trolley 5 She'S Crafty Strawberry Bl Cls 4 Tall Cans

liger-belair-bourgogne-les-grnd-chailots.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Bourgogne Rouge Les Grands Chaillots 750ml

molly-dooker-blue-eyed-boy-shiraz.title: Mollydooker Blue Eyed Boy Shiraz 2022 750ml
molly-dooker-blue-eyed-boy-shiraz.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Blue Eyed Boy is impressively deep in colour, displaying vibrant dark purple hues. Its aromatic profile is both intricate and inviting, with scents of blueberry, fresh plum, and subtle hints of mocha cream bursting from the glass. This wine is a balance of strength and finesse, delivering layers of lush, fresh berries and a touch of aniseed spice, culminating in a final note of creamy chocolate. With generous and dynamic layers, the wine allows the gentle tannins to craft a smooth and enduring finish, ensuring a truly memorable experience. 

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Juicy and seamless, this is impressive for its generosity and plush texture, with kirsch, morello cherry and raspberry flavors at the core. Shows milk chocolate, vanilla crème anglaise, toasted cardamom, chicory and French press coffee notes on the finish. Drink now through 2037.

norton-privada-malbec.title: Norton Privada Family Blend 2024
norton-privada-malbec.bodyHtml:
Norton Privada Family Blend 2024 is a rich, full-bodied, and deeply complex Argentine red wine crafted from 50 to 90-year-old estate vineyards in Mendoza's premier Luján de Cuyo district. Originally created as an exclusive private cuvée for the Swarovski family, this blend of Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot undergoes aging in French oak barrels. The nose opens with expressive aromas of ripe black plum, blackberry, kirsch, mocha, and toasted cedar. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, harmonious entry with dense layers of dark cocoa, cassis, fine-grained, polished tannins, and a persistent, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with prime grilled ribeye steak, braised ossobuco, roasted lamb shanks, rich mushroom ragù, and aged, hard cheeses.

revel-stoke-cherry.title: Revel Stoke Roadkill Cherry Whisky
revel-stoke-cherry.bodyHtml: Revel Stoke Cherry Whiskey delivers a unique fusion of smooth, aged whiskey and the vibrant, juicy essence of cherries. This premium spirit combines the bold, rich flavors of whiskey with the sweet, tart complexity of ripe cherries, creating an indulgent, yet perfectly balanced drink. The result is a mellow, slightly fruity profile that appeals to whiskey lovers and newcomers alike. Whether sipped neat, poured over ice, or mixed into a refreshing cocktail, Revel Stoke Cherry Whiskey adds a deliciously distinctive twist to any occasion. For those seeking a whiskey with an exciting burst of flavor, Revel Stoke Cherry Whiskey is a must-try.

o-leflaive-saint-aubin-1er-cru-champ.title: Olivier Leflaive Saint-Aubin 1er Cru Les Champlots Blanc 2019 750ml
o-leflaive-saint-aubin-1er-cru-champ.bodyHtml: Champlots is always lean, even angular at times. An excellent canvas for Chardonnay’s iodine, limestone and citrus qualities. Ideal with langoustine, crab and lobster and goes really well with grilled white meat and soft cheese.

unshackled-sauvignon-blanc.title: Unshackled Sauvignon Blanc by The Prisoner 2021 750ml
unshackled-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Gooseberry, lychee, white flowers on the nose. Crisp acidity, with soft but rich mouthfeel, ripe pineapple, crisp pear, gooseberry finish. Albariño, Malvasia Bianca and Chardonnay blended in.

88 Points - CellarTracker

ol-chassagne-montrachet-houilleres.title: Olivier Leflaive Chassagne-Montrachet 2023
ol-chassagne-montrachet-houilleres.bodyHtml:
Olivier Leflaive Chassagne-Montrachet 2023 is 100% Chardonnay from estate vineyards and selected Chassagne-Montrachet parcels. Fermented in oak and matured for 18 months, it combines Japanese grapefruit aromas with a juicy palate, subtle humus and fern notes, balancing substance, freshness, power and finesse.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with mustard-glazed mackerel, creamy shrimp blanquette, roasted turbot, or herb-roasted chicken.

 

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of crushed stone, fresh herbs and light pineapple entice, while the palate shows a medium-body with good depth of fruit and flavor. Clear fruit and tension from fine, integrated grape tannins.

lagavulin-11-year-old-offerman-charred-c.title: Lagavulin 11 Year Old Offerman Edition Charred Oak Cask
lagavulin-11-year-old-offerman-charred-c.bodyHtml: For their third limited release, Lagavulin and Nick Offerman crafted this whisky as the perfect whisky to sip with the perfect steak. This single malt is matured for at least 11 years in heavily charred former bourbon and red wine barrels. The resulting flavour features hints of round red berries, a touch of briny saltiness, notes of vanilla and the signature Lagavulin intense peat. Best enjoyed as Offerman intended, with a grilled medium-rare rib-eye steak-or any robust meal-either neat or on the rocks.

signos-de-origen-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Emiliana Signos De Origen Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 750ml
signos-de-origen-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The Emiliana Signos De Origen Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a premium red wine hailing from the prestigious Colchagua Valley in Chile. Produced by Emiliana, one of the leading organic wineries in the country, this wine showcases the region's unique terroir and commitment to sustainability, delivering a wine that is both elegant and expressive.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Deep ruby with purple tinges.

  • Aromas: Aromatic and complex, with prominent notes of blackcurrant, blackberries, and cherry, complemented by hints of tobacco, spices, and subtle cedar.

  • Taste: On the palate, this Cabernet Sauvignon is full-bodied and well-structured, with rich flavors of dark fruits and a touch of vanilla from the oak aging. The tannins are firm and refined, providing a smooth mouthfeel and excellent balance between fruit and acidity. A long, satisfying finish with lingering hints of dark chocolate and spice.

Vineyard & Terroir:

The grapes are sourced from sustainable vineyards in the Colchagua Valley, an area renowned for its ability to produce world-class Cabernet Sauvignon. The vineyards benefit from a combination of cool evenings and warm days, allowing the grapes to ripen slowly and develop concentrated flavors.

Aging:

Aged for 12 months in French oak barrels, which impart subtle notes of oak, enhancing the wine's complexity and depth.

Food Pairing:

This wine pairs beautifully with grilled meats, steak, roasted lamb, or hard cheeses like aged cheddar or Parmesan.

harvey-harriet-red-blend.title: Harvey & Harriet Red Blend 2023
harvey-harriet-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Harvey & Harriet Red Blend 2023 is a luxurious, expressive, and incredibly overachieving red wine crafted by master winemaker Eric Jensen of Booker Vineyard. Named in heartfelt tribute to his parents, this Paso Robles powerhouse is designed to offer world-class depth and ultimate drinkability without the ultra-premium price tag. It pours a deep, dark garnet and opens with an alluring bouquet of wild blueberries, boysenberries, and crushed cassis, intricately accented by elegant notes of espresso bean, violets, tobacco leaf, and warm clove. On the palate, the wine is silky, seamless, and round, delivering full-bodied layers of ripe black cherry, rich cocoa nibs, and savory leather. Supported by a brisk, balancing acidity and tightly knit, chalky tannins, it masterfully melds the sophisticated structure of Cabernet with the brambly fruit characteristics of its blending partners before wrapping up on a long, balanced finish with a bitter tinge of dark chocolate.

Food Pairing: Flame-grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-roasted rack of lamb, smoky barbecue brisket, wood-fired meat-lovers pizza, or mature hard cheeses like aged Gouda and sharp Cheddar.

 90 Points - James Suckling

Juicy with copious upfront fruit and an elegant underpinning of structure, this is a friendly cabernet-based blend with tones of peppercorns, currants and quietly sweet spices. Charming. Drink now.

aberlour-abunadh-alba-1.title: Aberlour A'bunadh Alba
aberlour-abunadh-alba-1.bodyHtml:
Aberlour A’bunadh Alba is the heir to A’bunadh whisky: from the Gaelic “origin”, in homage to the founder of Aberlour, James Fleming, it honours the whisky tradition of the 19th century. It is indeed a “strength cask” Single Malt, bottled without adding water. Its production method recalls the powerful taste of ancient malts.

Unlike Aberlour A’bunadh aged only in Sherry casks, A’bunadh Alba is a cask strength aged 100% in first-fill Bourbon casks, for a whisky that is both pure and invigorating.

Alba refers to Quercus Alba, the type of American white oak used when ageing this whisky. This oak is particularly suitable for making bourbon barrels thanks to its durability and its ability to absorb water and oxygen.

Coincidentally, Alba also means Scotland in Gaelic.

truly-lemonade-variety-pack-2.title: Truly Lemonade Variety Pack 12 Cans
truly-lemonade-variety-pack-2.bodyHtml: Lemonade and Summer: A match made in refreshment heaven. Truly Lemonade is the ideal warm weather drink, featuring a perfectly balanced blend of sweet lemonade and refreshing seltzer that’s big on flavor but low on calories.

pommery-brut-royal.title: Pommery Brut Royal 750ml
pommery-brut-royal.bodyHtml:
The Pommery Brut Royal shows a pale yellow color with light green accents. On the nose, it is vivacious and cheerful, fresh, easy, fine, delicate, and open. It has notes of citrus and white flowers combined with small berry notes. Elegant and vibrant in the mouth, it opens with initial notes of berries. The wine is round, ample, and delicate, with a nice finish. Clear end notes without any dryness. This wine is harmonious and never grows tiresome to the palate.

Enjoy it at any time of day or night.

93 Points - Decanter

Civilised apple, lemon and dried fruit nose. There's a nice lift in the mouth with citric balance and real poise. Full of character.

92 Points - James Suckling
Peach, lemon, grapefruit, biscuit and some honey on the nose. Creamy and round with a juicy, peachy and lightly off-dry palate. Sleek bubbles. One third each of chardonnay, pinot noir and pinot meunier. Base vintage 2018. 9-10g/L dosage. Drink now.

castello-di-fonterutoli-chianti.title: Mazzei Fonterutoli Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2019
castello-di-fonterutoli-chianti.bodyHtml:
Mazzei Castello Fonterutoli Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2019 exhibits an intense and profound colour. On the nose, it reveals distinct aromas of blackberries, cherries, violets, and flowers, with a hint of nougat. On the palate, it is a full-bodied wine with a captivating sweetness and smooth tannins. Its flavour is intense and concentrated, delighting the senses. The finish is long and full of elegance, leaving a lasting and sophisticated impression.                      

Beautiful combination of elegance, structure and minerality, with orange peel, red fruits and a touch of licorice. 

Pair with savory game dishes, stews, truffles and aged, strong tasting cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

A very linear and fine-tannin'd Chianti Classico with crunchy cherry fruit and hints of minerals. Medium body. Crisp and lively finish. Closed and tight in the mid-palate. Drink or hold [for another 15+ years].

95 Points - Falstaff

Bright, radiant ruby red. Slightly restrained on the nose, gentle hints of orange zest and raspberry. Juicy on the palate with a red berry fruit core, elegant and gluggable, currently still very young, delicate drive with lots of finesse on the finish, salty.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

chateau-des-bareilles.title: Chateau De Carles Haut-Carles 2020 750ml
chateau-des-bareilles.bodyHtml:
This exceptional vintage from plot selections of old vines is superb in concentration. It was launched in 1994 to compete with the most prestigious Bordeaux wines. After gentle extraction during vinification, Haut-Carles is aged for nearly 18 months in French oak barrels (40% of which are new). With elegance, it reveals the bright fruit of Merlot, a delicate woodiness and a creamy mouthfeel lined with silky tannins. Delicious in its youth, it lets an even more complex and harmonious bouquet emerge over time.

Haut Carles, located in the Fronsac appellation in the Right Bank of Bordeaux is one of the older estates in the appellation. The actual Haut Carles chateau dates its creation back to the 1400s when it was used as a fortress. The vineyard is planted to a vine density of 10,000 vines per hectare for their newer plantings, which is quite high for the Right Bank, especially in Fronsac. The vineyard is managed using 100% organic farming techniques.

Haut Carles is best paired with all types of classic meat dishes, veal, pork, beef, lamb, duck, game, roast chicken, roasted, braised, and grilled dishes. It's also excellent when matched with Asian dishes, and rich fish courses like tuna, mushrooms, and pasta.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of olives, chocolate orange, toffee, plums, peppercorns and cherries. Creamy and mouth-filling with velvety tannins and a full body. Plush and polished. Chocolaty finish

norton-cosecha-especial-brut-rose.title: Norton Cosecha Especial Brut Rose
norton-cosecha-especial-brut-rose.bodyHtml:
Cosecha Especial is Norton's flagship sparkling wine line. Its distinctive bell-shaped bottle pays homage to the winemakers' tradition of announcing when the grapes have reached their perfect ripeness for harvest, signaling the beginning of the harvest. The ringing of a bell then becomes an element associated with joy and celebration.

The Norton Cosecha Especial Brut Rosé is an elegant, refreshing sparkling wine produced by Bodega Norton in the foothills of the Andes. Crafted using the traditional Charmat method, it is characterized by its delicate pink hue and persistent bubbles. The wine offers a vibrant aromatic profile of fresh red fruits, specifically strawberries and raspberries, with subtle floral hints. On the palate, it is crisp and well-balanced, featuring a creamy texture and a lively acidity that makes it an ideal choice for aperitifs, light salads, or seafood dishes.

veuve-clicquot-coloring-pack-brut.title: Veuve Clicquot Brut with Cooler Gift Pack
veuve-clicquot-coloring-pack-brut.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label manages to reconcile two opposing factors, strength and silkiness and to hold them in perfect balance with aromatic intensity and a lot of freshness. With golden yellow tiny bubbles, this non-vintage Champagne shows the fruitiness of peach, Mirabelle plum, and pear alongside notes of vanilla and toasted brioche. This consistent power to please makes it ideal as an aperitif, and perfect as the Champagne to enjoy with a meal.

92 Points - James Suckling

This has aromas of grapefruit, citrus peel, quince, toast and almonds. It’s medium-bodied with creamy, fine tannins. Silky texture. Nutty complexity at the end.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Lively, with tangy acidity and a zesty mousse, this aperitif-style Champagne shows notes of mandarin orange, blackberry, toast and a touch of pastry cream. Subtle, smoke-tinged finish. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Drink now.

collosorbo-le-due-gemme-rosso.title: Collosorbo Due Gemme Toscana Rosso 2022
collosorbo-le-due-gemme-rosso.bodyHtml:
Le Due Gemme is a blend of Sangiovese and Merlot both grown in their “Il Quercione” vineyard that was planted in 2001 and has been farmed organically. This wine shows rich red and black fruit with a touch of exotic spices. It's generous on the palate, with fine tannins and a refreshing finish. Ruby red dress with purplish highlights. Merlot meets Sangiovese in this deep, fresh, and fruity blend. The nose is intensely aromatic, with notes of black berries, cherry, strawberry, and rose. Fresh and lively, beautiful tannins, present but not too aggressive.

Perfect with pasta, pizza, meat dishes and mild cheeses.

robert-hall-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Hall Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 750ml
robert-hall-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: This full-bodied wine has a core of black currant and hints of cedar and spice along with cocoa aromas. Rich flavors of ripe fruit, dark chocolate and anise are all supported by balanced, velvety tannins.

fleur-du-cap-cabernet-sauvignon.title: The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
fleur-du-cap-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a luxurious, modern, and brilliantly textured expression that carries the bold and unrestricted winemaking philosophy of this iconic estate into a pure varietal focus. Sourced from premier vineyards across the valley, this vintage exhibits a deep magenta and purple-ruby core. On the nose, it offers an invitingly opulent bouquet of ripe black cherries, crème de cassis, and sweet blackberry pie, seamlessly layered with warm undertones of toasted vanilla bean, cinnamon bark, fresh coffee grounds, and hints of crushed wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is incredibly soft, plush, and full-bodied, delivering an expansive, fruit-forward mid-palate wrapped in supple, velvety tannins. Matured for 15 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels, its powerful dark fruit concentration remains beautifully balanced, showing remarkable structural harmony before concluding with a lengthy, decadent finish accented by a touch of holiday spice and subtle mineral depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with charcoal-grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-infused roasted lamb, or hunks of mature sharp white cheddar cheese.

loudenne-le-chateau-blanc-bordeaux.title: Chateau Guiraud Le G De Guiraud Bordeaux Blanc Sec 2020 750ml
loudenne-le-chateau-blanc-bordeaux.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "Apricots, almonds, flowers, and a dab of honey create the perfume. The palate is even better with its layers of lusciously-textured, oranges, candied lemon, and notes of white peach that show up in the vibrant, creamy finish. This is the debut of this new wine from Guiraud which is the brainchild of Sandrine Garbay. The wine truly tastes exactly like what you want from a dry Sauternes. Drink from 2023-2035." - Jeff Leve, The Wine Cellar Insider

exitus-bourbon-barrel-red-blend.title: Exitus Red 2017 750ml
exitus-bourbon-barrel-red-blend.bodyHtml: California- Bold and unconventional, Exitus provides a deep ruby color with aromas of blackberry compote, leather and dusty dark chocolate. Bourbon barrel aging offers aromas of fire toasted oak, baking spice, caramel and loose-leaf tobacco.

bruichladdich-islay-barely-2013.title: Bruichladdich Islay Barley 8 Year Old 2013
bruichladdich-islay-barely-2013.bodyHtml:
Showcasing the permanence of our commitment to barley provenance, this Bruichladdich Islay Barley 2013 is our eighth edition of unpeated, locally grown single malt. Fully traceable and high provenance with honeyed porridge and lemon meringue pie notes, it evokes a true sense of place.

For almost two decades now, we have shown the permanence of our commitment to barley provenance. Aided by the determination of our farming partners, this Bruichladdich Islay Barley 2013 is our eighth edition of unpeated, locally grown single malt.

While each expression from the individual growing season is subtly nuanced, a signature maritime-citrus, barley forward style has developed in these complex single malts.

Our newest vintage of unpeated Bruichladdich Islay Barley features the harvest from the 2012 growing season, later distilled in 2013.

The crop was raised across seven island farms, by Hunter Jackson at Cruach, Andrew and Donald Jones at Coull, Mark French at Rockside, Ian McKerrell at Island, Alistair Torrance at Mulindry, Raymond Fletcher at Dunlossit and Raymond Stewart at Sunderland.

The resulting spirit was matured in a combination of ex-American and ex-European oak casks for eight aged years.

remy-martin-vsop-heritage-2nd-edition.title: Remy Martin VSOP Cognac Heritage Edition 2
remy-martin-vsop-heritage-2nd-edition.bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin VSOP Heritage Edition 2 presents the house's classic VSOP in limited-edition second-volume packaging, bottled at 40% ABV in a 700 ml bottle. Created in 1927, Rémy Martin VSOP was the original Fine Champagne VSOP, blended only from eaux-de-vie of the chalky Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne crus at the heart of the Cognac region. The eaux-de-vie are distilled on the lees and aged in large-grain French oak barrels toasted to a consistent medium-plus level, which gives the spirit its warm colour over time. In the glass it is a vibrant gold, with a harmonious nose of vanilla, dried apricot and candied pear and a structured, layered palate of dried fruit and delicate liquorice with a silky texture.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla, dried apricot, candied pear and liquorice.

Nose: Vanilla, dried apricot and candied pear.

Palate: Aromatic dried fruit and delicate liquorice; structured, layered and silky.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks or in a long drink.

remy-martin-xo-lee-broom.title: Remy Martin XO Cognac Lee Broom Limited Edition
remy-martin-xo-lee-broom.bodyHtml:
Remy Martin XO teams up with award-winning furniture and lighting designer Lee Broom to reveal new facets of the XO decanter and Rémy Martin XO on ice.

The biggest celebration calls for the finest cognac in the most opulent decanter – a memo that Remy Martin certainly didn’t miss. The expert distillery have teamed up with the award winning furniture and lighting desginer Lee Broom, to craft a limited edition bottle of its XO fine champagne cognac. By carving hundreds of fine ‘starburst’ cuts into the indents of its solar shape the designer has added a certain splendour to the full-bodied drink.

forty-creek-cream-1.title: Forty Creek Original Whisky Cream Liqueur 1.14L
forty-creek-cream-1.bodyHtml: A truly flavourful spirit, Original Cream Liquor is crafted using our award-winning Forty Creek Canadian whisky and fresh dairy cream. Unlike other cream liquors on the market, our Original Cream Liquor focuses on flavours that highlight the quality of our whisky, resulting in a sweet, whisky-forward finish.

bridgeland-old-fashioned.title: Bridgeland Distillery Old Fashioned
bridgeland-old-fashioned.bodyHtml:
Bridgeland Distillery Old Fashioned is a bottled Old Fashioned cocktail made in Calgary, Alberta, by Bridgeland Distillery. According to the label, it is built from the distillery's own oaked three-grain spirit, organic sugar and oranges, and Bridgeland's house bitters, and it is fermented, distilled and bottled in the Bridgeland neighbourhood. The result is a spirit-forward, ready-to-serve cocktail in which whisky richness meets bitters, citrus and a gentle sweetness, capturing the character of the classic drink without any mixing. Each 500ml bottle is hand-numbered by batch and bottle.

Tasting Notes: Whisky richness, bitters, citrus, subtle sweetness.

Serve: Pour over a large ice cube and garnish with an orange twist.

bridgeland-taber-corn-berbon.title: Bridgeland Distillery Taber Corn Whisky
bridgeland-taber-corn-berbon.bodyHtml:
This is the  Taber Corn Whisky you know and love — with a new twist: It's older and it's at an elevated ABV ie 50.5% (101 proof) This product is inspired by Alberta nature. With the best grain in the world, this Corn whisky is the result of what our agriculture offers best: Taber Corn and Penhold Wheat and Barley grown by two incredible families: the Molnar’s in Taber and the Hamill’s in Penhold. 


Tasting Notes  

The first aromas that greet you when you open the bottle are reminiscent of a peach custard pie — rich, creamy, and sweet, with a hint of fruitiness that makes your mouth water.  Subtle notes of sweet oak come through, adding a layer of warmth and complexity.The finish lingers with a gentle spark of pepper and a whisper of sweet fennel.


Production and distillation Notes

Still: Custom-designed traditional Copper Pot Still

Base: 60% Taber Corn, 32% Penhold Barley, 8% Penhold Wheat

Distillation: Small-batch, 2x distilled

Oak Barrels: New America Oak, Char#4

Without additives, colouring or chill filtration.

bridgeland-glenbow-whisky-single-malt.title: Bridgeland Distillery Innisfail Single Pot Still Whisky
bridgeland-glenbow-whisky-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Single Pot Still Whisky is made by a single distillery from a mixed mash of malted and unmalted barley distilled in a Pot Still. Raw & Malted Barley and Oats are part of this special Whisky’s grain bill. This Single Pot Still Whisky has been distilled 3 times and aged in different casks (American oak, French oak, new and used). Like all Bridgeland Whisky; without additives, coloring or chill filtration; just the wonderful whisky straight from the cask.

Orchard fruits on the nose, particularly apple and pear. Subtle sweetness lingering. The palate is floral, sweet and delicate with a great thick mouthfeel. Hints of baked spices. The finish linger and reveal a hint of sherry.

stroh-54-spiced-rum.title: Bacardi Spiced Rum 1.75L
stroh-54-spiced-rum.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Spiced Rum is a smooth, spirit drink crafted using aged and unaged rum made from sugarcane molasses, infused with natural spices and flavors. Matured in charred American white oak barrels to impart a golden hue and a subtle oaky depth, this rum blends warm cinnamon, vanilla, and nutmeg flavors with a gentle rum kick.

Food Pairing: Barbecue pulled pork, grilled jerk chicken, spicy ribs, dark chocolate desserts, or vanilla pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm amber and golden-brown appearance with a light-to-medium, smooth body.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, warm cinnamon, nutmeg, brown sugar, and toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and sweet with dominant notes of creamy vanilla, cinnamon spice, soft caramel, and gentle oakiness.

Finish : Medium-length, warm, and sweet with lingering notes of spice and subtle vanilla.

Serve : Serve mixed with cola over ice, blended into tropical cocktails, or served on the rocks.

glenmorangie-10-year-old-original.title: Glenmorangie 'The Original' 12 Year Old
glenmorangie-10-year-old-original.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie 'The Original' 12 Year Old is the recently upgraded flagship single malt from the renowned Highland distillery, elegantly replacing its classic 10-year-old predecessor. Distilled in Scotland's tallest copper stills—which ensure only the lightest, purest vapors reach the condenser—this delicate spirit is then aged for a full 12 years in a combination of first- and second-fill American white oak ex-bourbon casks. The additional two years of maturation deepen its signature creamy complexity, resulting in a supremely smooth, approachable, and fruit-forward whisky that perfectly balances vibrant citrus, sweet peach, and rich vanilla.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, seared scallops, soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert, lemon tart, peach cobbler, or vanilla panna cotta.

Tasting Notes : Bright, pale lemon gold in appearance with a soft, creamy, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and highly fragrant, bursting with vibrant aromas of mandarin orange, ripe peach, sweet vanilla bean, and delicate floral notes.

Palate : Creamy and elegant, delivering a luscious wave of rich vanilla, sweet honey, and zesty orange citrus, perfectly intertwined with ripe stone fruit and a gentle whisper of warming baking spice.

Finish : Clean, medium-length, and highly refreshing, leaving a lingering sweetness of peach, orange peel, and soft oak vanilla.

Serve : Serve neat, with a few drops of water to open up the floral aromatics, or poured over ice with premium soda water for a classic Highball.

larkin-cabernet-franc.title: Jack Larkin Larkin Cabernet Franc 750ml
larkin-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml: Cabernet Franc is not simply an important grape varietal for the fact that it is one of the most widely grown strains of vine in the world, but also because it is a vital grape in the production of many of the finest wines the world has ever seen. For centuries in its native France, it has been a varietal synonymous with elegance and high quality, and has become a key fruit in the production of the Bordeaux and Bordeaux-style blended wines which have gone down in history thanks to their magnificent flavors, aromas and levels of aged complexity. However, Cabernet Franc is also a wine grape varietal for use in single variety, unblended wines, and has plenty to offer on its own. Most commonly, it is renowned for its wide bouquet, which often includes fascinating notes of tobacco, violets or bell pepper over a beautifully pale and decadent liquid.

raymond-family-classic-cabernet.title: Raymond Family Classic Cabernet Sauvignon
raymond-family-classic-cabernet.bodyHtml: This wine opens with alluring aromas of dark plums and blackberry that are complimented by notes of earthiness. Vibrant flavors of black cherry and baked berry cobbler are balanced with a hint of all spice and nutmeg. This is a soft and approachable wine with a plush mid-palate and a lingering finish.

whitehaven-pinot-noir-rose.title: Whitehaven Pinot Noir Rose 2022 750ml
whitehaven-pinot-noir-rose.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2022 vintage) "Bright, pale blush pink, even colour throughout. The nose is intense and vibrant with aromas of strawberry, raspberry, rose petals and lily. Medium-bodied, dry to taste, aromas of raspberry and strawberry melded with a hint of cream, rose petals and lily. Mouth-watering acidity provides good energy and drives to a crisp, fragranced finish. This dry Pinot Noir Rosé is crisp and generous, packed with red fruit on a creamy, delicate palate. Serve as an aperitif or match with sushi over the next 2-3 years. Fermented to 12.5% alc, 1 g/l RS. Vegan friendly. AMW accredited." - Raymond Chan Wine Reviews

penfolds-maxs-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Penfolds Max's Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
penfolds-maxs-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Max's Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a structured South Australian red with redcurrant, cranberry and dark fruit aromas accented by dried herbs. The palate combines red, blue and black fruits with cinnamon, vanilla chai and cedar, supported by refreshing acidity and fine, silky tannins.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled lamb chops, beef tenderloin, roast vegetables, and aged cheddar.

whitehaven-sauvignon-blanc-1.title: Whitehaven Sauvignon Blanc 375ml
whitehaven-sauvignon-blanc-1.bodyHtml:
Whitehaven Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc 375ml is a half-bottle of a well-regarded New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc, known for its crisp, refreshing flavors and aromatic profile. It typically features notes of grapefruit, passion fruit, and grassy undertones. 

Origin: Marlborough, New Zealand. 
Aromas: Grapefruit, passion fruit, lime zest, and hints of lemongrass and green pepper. 
Taste: Bright and tangy acidity, with flavors of white peach, guava, and passion fruit. It also features notes of wet river stone and fresh green herbs. 
Style: Medium-bodied, dry, and crisp with a lingering, textured finish. 
Food Pairing: Great with fresh seafood, summer salads, light poultry, and goat cheese. 
Serving: Best enjoyed lightly chilled.

penfolds-maxs-chardonnay.title: Penfolds Max's Chardonnay 2022 750ml
penfolds-maxs-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Max’s Chardonnay is a tribute to former Chief Winemaker Max Schubert 1948-1975, a legend in Penfolds' history. Max’s constant pursuit of excellence paved the way for those who followed in his footsteps and also allowed the status and heritage of Penfolds to grow. Max’s Chardonnay continues the evolution of the Penfolds white wine program, drawing inspiration from the legacy and spirit of the many wine trials of Max Schubert, a wine-making legend.

89 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Delicate floral, white peach and tangerine aromas lead to a textural, full-figured palate that's sliced with mouthwatering acidity. Flavor is a bit muted, but there's nevertheless a gentle flower-and-fruit appeal that makes for a modern, crowd-pleasing white.

11th-hour-cellars-pinot-noir.title: 11th Hour Cellars Pinot Noir NV 750ml
11th-hour-cellars-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: A classic combination of subtle raspberry and black cherry flavours with soft tannins and a very smooth finish. Serve with Roasted Pork Tenderloin, Glazed Duck, and Roasted Mushrooms with Herbs.

wayne-gretzky-whisky-cream-1.title: Wayne Gretzky Canadian Cream Liquor 1.14L
wayne-gretzky-whisky-cream-1.bodyHtml:
Wayne Gretzky Whisky Cream is a Canadian cream liqueur made with Wayne Gretzky No. 99 Red Cask Whisky as its base, blended with fresh Ontario cream. It pours a creamy tan colour and is bottled at 17% ABV in a large 1.14 litre bottle.

Nose: Cream, almond, biscuits and nutmeg.

Palate: Velvety and smooth, rich, sweet and creamy, with a lasting finish.

Serve: Over ice, or in coffee.

nemiroff-deluxe-vodka.title: Nemiroff Vodka
nemiroff-deluxe-vodka.bodyHtml: Nemiroff De Luxe is a premium product with strong character. The drink is made to reflect the original recipe and keeps with high production standards. Production is based on natural ingredients, pure water and premium-class alcohol. In addition, high pressure, temperature and 11 stages of filtration make Nemiroff De Luxe a symphony of refined, rich taste with a light linden flower flavour.

temple-bar-distillery-cask.title: Redbreast 12 Year Old Cask Strength Irish Whiskey
temple-bar-distillery-cask.bodyHtml:
Redbreast 12 Year Old Cask Strength Irish Whiskey is an exceptional, full-bodied single pot still Irish whiskey produced at the Midleton Distillery in County Cork. Triple distilled from a combination of malted and unmalted barley and matured in a combination of bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks, this un-chill-filtered cask strength bottling delivers an intense, rich concentration of spicy, fruity, and oak-driven flavors.

Food Pairing: Rich venison stew, roasted pork belly, dark chocolate, aged cheddar cheese, or fruitcake.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber gold in color with a full, heavy, and oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Succulent exotic fruits, dried fruits, toasted wood, warm baking spices, subtle citrus, and rich pot still spice.

Palate : Rich, round, and explosive with notes of ripe figs, sultanas, toasted oak, creamy vanilla, dark fruit, and vibrant pot still pepperiness.

Finish : Exceptionally long, complex, and warm with lingering dried fruit, oak tannins, and spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn tasting glass, or add a few drops of room-temperature water to open up the complex aromas and soften the alcohol strength.

a-mavam-orange.title: A Mavam Moscato - Orange 750ml
a-mavam-orange.bodyHtml: A Mavam Moscato - Orange 750ml is a sparkling wine with an orange flavor. It is a semi-sweet, light-bodied wine from Spain. The brand, Mavam, is known for its sparkling wines and the Orange Moscato is part of their sparkling wine collection. It has an ABV of 5.5%. The wine pairs well with desserts, fruit trays, or can be enjoyed on its own.

a-mavam-mango.title: A Mavam Tennation Pink Strawberry NV 750ml

bruichladdich-black-art-10-1-29yr.title: Bruichladdich Black Art Edition 10.1 29 Year Old
bruichladdich-black-art-10-1-29yr.bodyHtml: The tenth edition of this limited edition series, Black Art Edition 10 encapsulates the enigmatic alchemy of whisky making; with a reliance on nature, craftsmanship and the passing of time. The barley and cask type remain a mystery, with the final recipe undisclosed.

bruichladdich-port-charlotte-sautern-cas.title: Port Charlotte SC:01 2012 9 Year Old Sauternes Cask Finish
bruichladdich-port-charlotte-sautern-cas.bodyHtml:
Port Charlotte SC:01 marries impeccable provenance with high-quality French oak. For the first time in our cask exploration series, this release contains 100% Islay grown barley

This SC: 01 2012 vintage has been conceived, grown, distilled, matured and bottled only on Islay. The 2011 harvest was raised by seven of our farming partners, all within 10 miles of our distillery. In a stunning display of Islay terroir, this locally grown barley is combined with an intricate cask recipe.

Malted to 40ppm by our maltsters on the Scottish mainland, it is returned home to be distilled through tall narrow-necked stills for ultimate elegance and finesse, before taking three separate paths in its maturation journey.

A combination of sherry butts and first and second fill American whiskey barrels were recasked at different points of maturation into some of the finest Sauternes wine casks from the left bank of the Garonne River in Bordeaux.

The result is a complex recipe which culminates in a classic example of our peated single malt; the mellow, floral-style hints of gorse complement honeyed coconut and fudge before opening into the Port Charlotte BBQ peat smoke.

bruichladdich-octomore-13-1.title: Bruichladdich Octomore 13.1 5 Year Old Scottish Barley
bruichladdich-octomore-13-1.bodyHtml: A youthful, dynamic Islay single malt, Octomore 13.1 was distilled in 2016 using 100% Scottish barley, malted to a mind-boggling 137.3ppm, and matured in first-fill American oak ex-bourbon barrels for five years. The palate offers notes of coconut, treacle toffee and vanilla, wrapped in layer upon layer of rich peat smoke.

bruichladdich-octomore-13-2.title: Bruichladdich Octomore 15.2 5 Year Old
bruichladdich-octomore-13-2.bodyHtml: Peated to 108.2 PPM and distilled from 100% Scottish barley, matured in a combination of American oak, red wine, and French ex-cognac casks. This unique trifecta adds layers of intrigue, resulting in a complex yet exceedingly elegant single malt Scotch whisky.

bruichladdich-octomore-13-3.title: Bruichladdich Octomore 13.3 5 Year Old Islay Barley
bruichladdich-octomore-13-3.bodyHtml:
The Octomore 13.3 Islay Whiskey comes from the famous Bruichladdich distillery in Scotland. You can be sure that the quality is right and that you are holding an absolute top product in your hands. The phenol level is a concentrated 129.3 PPM and thus ensures an intensely smoky aroma that is second to none. The basis is 100% Scottish Concerto barley, which is grown on the Octomore Farm. The harvest dates back to 2015, the whiskey was distilled in 2016. It was allowed to mature for five years on the island of Islay, in former American first-fill whiskey casks and former second-fill oak casks. The use of cold filtration and the addition of dyes was completely dispensed with.

On the nose, the whiskey impresses with its multifaceted aroma, which ranges from brown sugar to vanilla and marzipan to green fruits. On the palate, these notes are complemented by salty nuances, smoke aromas, sweet honey notes and a touch of coconut. Dry smoke, fine fruity nuances of peach and stewed pear determine the long, slightly sweet finish of this complex whiskey.

Enjoy this noble drop pure at room temperature. A few drops of water in the glass help to exude the variety of aromas even better.

forty-creek-barrel-select-whisky-1.title: Forty Creek Barrel Select Whisky
forty-creek-barrel-select-whisky-1.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Barrel Select Whisky is an exceptionally smooth, award-winning Canadian blended whisky. It is crafted using a unique process where rye, barley, and corn are distilled and aged separately in selected oak barrels before being artistically blended together to create a complex, harmonious spirit with rich, approachable flavors.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoky barbecued pulled pork, maple-glazed ribs, sharp aged cheddar cheese, or sweet pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, honey, toasted oak, cocoa, and light butterscotch with subtle apricot fruitiness.

Palate : Smooth and complex with notes of dark sweet fruit, vanilla, toasted wood, rich caramel, and gentle rye spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of gentle oak spice, vanilla, and sweet honey.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as the base in a classic Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

greywacke-pinot-noir.title: Greywacke Pinot Noir 2019 750ml
greywacke-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: A deliciously spicy Marlborough pinot, bursting with ripe fruit fragrance. Red and black cherries, super-ripe strawberries, dark-fleshed plums and juicy blackberries – poached with a stick of cinnamon, some cloves and a sprinkle of nutmeg. The ethereal, but finely structured palate combines concentrated varietal character, with earthy nuances and a distinctive smoky complexity.

veuve-clicquot-rose-ice-dress.title: Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame Rose 2015 750ml
veuve-clicquot-rose-ice-dress.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot's latest cuvée harmoniously blends the sun-filled 2015 vintage with the precision, depth, and character of Pinot Noir red wine. Spice notes, such as pepper, nutmeg, and clove, intertwine with the delicate aromas of red fruit, as well as floral hints of rose and violet.

Pinot Noir's unique, precise quality stands as the backbone of Veuve Clicquot champagnes. The versatility and freshness of Pinot Noir capture the essence of the Champagne region's unique terroir

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Steeped cherry and raspberry fruit flavors are accented by tea rose, grated ginger and blood orange zest aromatics in this graceful rosé Champagne, in a vinous style. Lively on the palate, with bright acidity and a fine mousse, plus a minerally underpinning of smoke, oyster shell and chalk notes driving the racy, well-spiced finish. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Disgorged March 2023. Drink now through 2035.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The rosé version of this iconic brand has a strawberry aroma and a toasty flavor from its maturity and its balanced dosage. It is a rich Champagne, textured and with soft acidity.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of 90% Chardonnay and 10% Pinot Noir (with 13% of red wine), the 2015 Brut Rosé La Grande Dame exhales a complex, elegant bouquet of red berries, flowers, spices, pastry and citrus blossom. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and vinous, it’s perfectly balanced with a pinpoint mousse, a delicate core of fruit and an ethereal, long and mineral finish. This lovely rendition of La Grande Dame Rosé could age well over the next decade

forty-creek-barrel-select-whisky-4.title: Forty Creek Barrel Select Whisky 1.14L
forty-creek-barrel-select-whisky-4.bodyHtml:
Forty Creek Barrel Select Whisky is an exceptionally smooth, award-winning Canadian blended whisky. It is crafted using a unique process where rye, barley, and corn are distilled and aged separately in selected oak barrels before being artistically blended together to create a complex, harmonious spirit with rich, approachable flavors.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoky barbecued pulled pork, maple-glazed ribs, sharp aged cheddar cheese, or sweet pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet vanilla, honey, toasted oak, cocoa, and light butterscotch with subtle apricot fruitiness.

Palate : Smooth and complex with notes of dark sweet fruit, vanilla, toasted wood, rich caramel, and gentle rye spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of gentle oak spice, vanilla, and sweet honey.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as the base in a classic Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

black-angus-cabernet-sauvignon-1.title: Black Angus Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
black-angus-cabernet-sauvignon-1.bodyHtml:
Black Angus Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 is the flagship, single-vineyard release from the Aberdeen Wine Company, crafted to showcase the premier terroir of Heathcote. Sourced exclusively from the Colbinabbin Vineyard, this powerful expression of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep, dense purple-red color in the glass. The aromatic bouquet is wonderfully complex and inviting, opening with vibrant notes of blackcurrant, black cherry, and dark plum, gracefully layered with signature regional nuances of eucalyptus, cedarwood, black tea, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is richly concentrated and full-bodied, delivering a generous core of dark berry fruit and subtle dark chocolate that is impeccably structured by firm, well-resolved tannins and a balancing acidity, culminating in an elegant, savory, and remarkably long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with premium cuts of prime beef, thick-cut grilled ribeye steaks, roasted leg of lamb, hearty venison stews, and mature cheddar cheeses.

g-m-benrinnes-connoisseurs-collection-1.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Benrinnes 30 Year Old 1990 First Fill Sherry Hogshead Cask 18600301 55.1% ABV
g-m-benrinnes-connoisseurs-collection-1.bodyHtml:
An independent, well aged single malt from Benrinnes distillery, matured for over 30 years in a first fill sherry hogshead. Distilled in 1990 and matured in single cask 18600301 until 4th November 2020. Bottled by Gordon & MacPhail for the Connoisseurs Choice series, with only 227 bottles being filled.

A very rare bottling.

glenmorangie-1998.title: Glenmorangie The Infinita 18 Year Old
glenmorangie-1998.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie 18 Year Old 'The Infinita' is a prestigious Highland single malt Scotch whisky matured for 15 years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before a portion is transferred to Spanish Oloroso sherry casks for an additional 3 years. Re-imagined under the name 'The Infinita' (formerly known simply as Glenmorangie 18 Year Old Extremely Rare), this expression combines Glenmorangie's signature tall-still delicate citrus floral character with complex layers of dried fruits, warm spice, and nutty sherry richness.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck with orange glaze, pan-seared scallops, dark chocolate tarts, or aged cheeses like Comté or Gouda.

Tasting Notes : Luminous honeyed gold hue with a silky, smooth, and velvety body on the palate.

Nose : Rich dried fruits, ripe figs, caramelized orange peel, sweet jasmine floral aromas, honeycomb, and gentle vanilla oak.

Palate : Vibrant and balanced with layers of sweet dried fruit, candied orange peel, toasted almonds, creamy honey, and soft wood spice.

Finish : Long, delicate, and elegant with persistent sweet floral notes, dried fruit sweetness, and lingering oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

glenmorangie-a-tale-of-forest.title: Glenmorangie A Tale of Spices
glenmorangie-a-tale-of-forest.bodyHtml:
Travelling the world in search of extraordinary casks to bring new flavours to Glenmorangie, Dr Bill has always been drawn to spice markets, with their fragrant aromas and rainbow hues.

Envisioning a whisky infused with such variety, he and Master Blender Gillian Macdonald experimented by finishing bourbon-aged Glenmorangie in four different types of cask for the first time.

Never used before at Glenmorangie, Moroccan red wine casks crafted from French oak give this creation mouth-watering layers of sweet spice. New charred oak casks add another spicy dimension. Shaved, toasted red wine casks offer nuanced, fruity notes. Pedro Ximénez sherry casks bring rich, sweet depths.

From this unusual cask combination comes a uniquely complex Glenmorangie – perfumed, sweet, and spicy. A Tale of Spices brims with sweet spice, floral notes of rose and jasmine are lifted by sugar-coated almonds and a distinct eucalyptus note.

johnnie-walker-blue-year-of-the-rabbit.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Year of the Rabbit
johnnie-walker-blue-year-of-the-rabbit.bodyHtml:
This Johnnie Walker Blue Label Chinese New Year limited edition comes encased in a luxurious gift box with exclusive illustrations by world-renowned designer Angel Chen, in honour of the Chinese New Year festival and the coming “Year of the Rabbit”.
Johnnie Walker Blue Label is crafted from rare handpicked whiskys from the four corners of Scotland, each bringing unique flavors and distinctive character – including some from long-closed so-called “ghost” distilleries. Only 1 in 10,000 casks from our unparalleled reserves of aging Scotch has the depth of character required to craft Blue Label.

lui-wind-blend-cab-sauv-merlot.title: Lui Wind Blend Rose
lui-wind-blend-cab-sauv-merlot.bodyHtml:
Lui Wind Blend Rosé is an elegant Argentine rosé wine crafted in Mendoza, showcasing freshness, fruit character, and a vibrant style. This expressive blend offers aromas of strawberry, raspberry, red cherry, and floral notes, with a crisp palate featuring bright acidity, delicate fruit flavours, balanced texture, and a refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Seafood, grilled salmon, fresh salads, soft cheeses, charcuterie, light pasta, roasted poultry, and Mediterranean dishes.

kilkerran-heavily-peated-batch-5.title: Kilkerran Heavily Peated Batch 5
kilkerran-heavily-peated-batch-5.bodyHtml: Early reports on Whisky Base for Kilkerran Heavily Peated Batch 5 is that this expression is Batch # 5 is much smokier than Batch # 4. It is described as having a nose that opens up to reveal citrus notes, vanilla cheesecake, rhubarb and custard sweets with delicate peat smoke. The palate reminds one of freshly baked Bramley apple pie and sweet salted caramel. The peat is prolific yet well integrated. A fresh coastal influence evokes memories of a blustery, busy, sea sprayed harbour. The finish is long and creamy with notes of pencil shavings, and toasted oak that give way to a fruity, sweet peat smoke.

springbank-longrow-23-yo.title: Longrow 23 Year Old
springbank-longrow-23-yo.bodyHtml: Springbank’s heavily peated malt, first distilled in 1973, is named after the nearby Longrow distillery, which operated between 1824 and 1896. When Longrow closed, the Mitchell family bought the distillery’s buildings. One of Longrow’s surviving warehouses is still used by Springbank as a bottling hall. Longrow 23 Years Old Limited Release 2022 is a rare single cask release of Longrow. The whisky aged for 23 years in a single refill sherry butt, and was bottled in April 2022 at 58.1%. Just 546 bottles were produced.

springbank-hazelburn-15-yo.title: Hazelburn 15 Year Old 2006 Oloroso Cask Matured
springbank-hazelburn-15-yo.bodyHtml: Hazelburn 15 Year Old Oloroso Cask Matured 2022 Release features a nose of zesty orange and tangerine notes initiate this dram, opening up to hints of milk chocolate, wine gums and fruit cake. On the palate, the oloroso maturation presents itself in notes of cinnamon, hard to¬ffee and milk chocolate. There is a musty element reminiscent of cigar boxes and nutmeg. The finish: cinnamon note persists, with notes of gingerbread and ground pepper developing in the finish.An official distillery bottling, Hazelburn Single malt Scotch Whiskey was distilled in 2006 and then aged in fresh Oloroso Sherry Casks for 15 years. Only 9,000 bottles were produced of this gorgeous non-chill filtered and colour free expression. Established in 1828, Springbank is Scotland’s oldest independent, family-owned distillery. 100% of the production process is carried out on site using traditional methods, making the distillery and whiskies, truly unique. Hazelburn Single Malt Whisky was first produced at Springbank in 1997. Triple distilled and unpeated it is more elegant and light in style.

suntory-ao.title: Suntory World Whisky Ao
suntory-ao.bodyHtml:
Bringing Japan closer to the world,
Suntory journeys into uncharted territory with Ao.

Enjoy the world’s first in-house blend of the five most celebrated whisky regions.
Suntory World Whisky Ao.

Ireland. Scotland. America. Canada. Japan. The world’s most prestigious whisky regions, each with its unique history and climate, reveal personality traits through the Ao blend. A blend that represents nearly a century of countless Suntory challenges.

Suntory blends, such as Hibiki, seek harmony, unifying individual whisky personalities. Ao, though, achieves harmony at its base while layering and highlighting characteristics. The blend allows traits to manifest differently. Aromas and flavors change with temperatures and where, when and how one enjoys Ao.

Experience a cascade of contrasting expressions—glamorous and sublime or mellow and intense—and enjoy Ao in all its colorful characteristics that transform with environments and how it’s served.

Suntory’s Fifth-Generation Chief Blender

chateau-rousselle-prestige.title: Chateau Rousselle Prestige 2016 750ml
chateau-rousselle-prestige.bodyHtml:
Chateau Rousselle Prestige Cotes de Bourg is a Bordeaux Blend Red from Cotes de Bourg. It is packaged in a 750ml bottle.
Another fine Bordeaux Blend Red from Chateau Rousselle.

brewer-clifton-sta-rita-hills-chardonnay.title: Brewer-Clifton Sta. Rita Hills Chardonnay 2021
brewer-clifton-sta-rita-hills-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Aromas of lemon, kiwi, orange blossom, and sweet basil blend seamlessly with flavors of jasmine, lime, ginger, and mineral, while notes of peel, orange zest, and fresh sea salt contribute to a textured mouthfeel that ultimately harmonizes in the finished wine.

94 Points - James Suckling
Attractive aromas of candied lemons, peaches and dried mangoes with hints of honeysuckle and praline. Some crushed almonds, too. Medium- to full-bodied. Shows concentration, focus and tension. It has vivid acidity and delicious fruit with a bright, tangy feeling on the finish.

 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

There's terrific focus and intensity to the bright citrus flavors at the core of this white, with yuzu, ruby grapefruit, Meyer lemon and lime zest notes, plus plenty of salty, minerally accents that add a mouthwatering minerality, followed by hints of lemon basil that linger on the finish.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Citrusy tonic aromas meet with a light wood spice on the nose of this bottling. The palate brightens with lemon rind and balm flavors, as Mandarin orange pith and a zippy acidity pushes long into the finish.
92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2021 Chardonnay Sta. Rita Hills opens with lots of flinty, matchstick tones over a core of spicy white peach and citrus blossoms. The light-bodied palate balances juicy acidity with a touch of textural grip. It has youthfully toasty, beeswax-laced fruit and a long, flinty finish. It will benefit from some time in a decanter.

valinch-mallet-peatyful-pack.title: Valinch & Mallet The Peat(Y)Ful Pack Madness 4 x 700ml
valinch-mallet-peatyful-pack.bodyHtml:
Four peaty bottlings from a Valinch and Mallet series titled The Peat(y)ful Pack Madness

Includes 1 of each of the following for a complete set of 4:

1) Caol Ila 2011 Single Entre-Deux-Mers Cask 10 Year Old 52.6% 70cl one of 374 bottles

2) Ledaig 2008 Single Bourbon Cask 13 Year Old 52.4% 70cl one of 303 bottles

3) South Shore Islay 2008 Single Caroni Cask 13 Year Old 52.9% 70cl one of 292 bottles

4) Ardmore 2009 Single Sherry Cask 12 Year Old 52.2% 70cl one of 338 bottles

haymans-sloe-gin.title: Hayman's Sloe Gin
haymans-sloe-gin.bodyHtml:
Hayman's Sloe Gin is a traditional English sloe gin from Hayman's of London, the family gin distillers whose distillery is on Weir Road in London. It is made to a family recipe in which wild-harvested sloe berries are steeped in Hayman's own London Dry Gin for up to four months and then blended with natural sugar, giving a ruby-red spirit with the plummy tang of the fruit. It is bottled at 26% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Hayman's describes it as neither too sweet nor too tart, balanced and fruity with real depth, and notes that it has been voted World's Best English Sloe Gin. It is as good sipped on its own as it is lengthened with citrus tonic or topped with sparkling wine.

Tasting Notes: Sloe berry, almond and subtle plum; fruity, rich and tangy, with a slightly warming spice.

Serve: Neat, with citrus tonic, or as a Sloe Royale: 35ml in a flute, topped with sparkling wine and garnished with a strawberry.

maestro-dobel-diamond-tequila.title: Maestro Dobel Diamante Cristalino Tequila
maestro-dobel-diamond-tequila.bodyHtml: Maestro Dobel® Diamante® is the original Cristalino. Blended extra añejo, añejo and reposado tequilas are aged in Balkan new white wood barrels, then filtered again to retain an elegant flavor. The Cristalino tequila has a mild oak aroma with a touch of vanilla. It has a citrus and prickly pear flavor with a smooth, crisp, clean finish. Pour one shot of straight Diamante Tequila to sip, into an old-fashioned glass with ice and a lemon slice or as a Margarita. (ABV 40% - 80 proof)

hennessy-very-special-gift-box.title: Hennessy XO Cognac Gift Box
hennessy-very-special-gift-box.bodyHtml:
In 1870, Maurice Hennessy, a 4th-generation member of the Hennessy family, created a special cognac for his family and friends. This new style of long-aged, “Extra Old” cognac has become the original and emblematic icon of the Maison – a complex blend to transcend time.

Deep and powerful, with a balanced structure, Hennessy X.O promises an intriguing sensation on the palate. With each drop, an invitation to embark on a journey of the senses through the seven tasting notes.

hard-knox-grunt-work-vienna-4-x-473ml.title: Hard Knox Grunt Work Vienna 4 Tall Cans
hard-knox-grunt-work-vienna-4-x-473ml.bodyHtml: Hard Knox Grunt Work Vienna 4 Tall Cans

hard-knox-black-diamond-blonde-4x473ml.title: Hard Knox Black Diamond Blonde 4 Tall Cans
hard-knox-black-diamond-blonde-4x473ml.bodyHtml: Hard Knox Black Diamond Blonde 4 Tall Cans

bacardi-coquito.title: Bacardi Coconut Rum
bacardi-coquito.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Coconut Rum is a smooth and refreshing flavored rum crafted by infusing Bacardi's signature spirit with natural coconut flavors. Designed to capture a tropical flavor profile, it blends light, clean rum character with the sweet, creamy taste of ripe coconut.

Food Pairing: Tropical fruit platters, grilled pineapple, coconut shrimp, jerk chicken, lime bars, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear in appearance with a light, smooth, and supple mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and tropical, dominated by vibrant aromas of toasted coconut, coconut milk, and subtle underlying cane sugar.

Palate : Smooth and sweet, delivering rich, creamy flavors of fresh coconut and sweet vanilla balanced by a clean rum base.

Finish : Light, sweet, and clean with lingering notes of tropical coconut and soft vanilla.

Serve : Serve chilled over ice, mixed with pineapple juice for a quick Piña Colada style drink, or topped with cola or lemon-lime soda.

bushmills-original-irish-whiskey-1.title: Bushmills Original Irish Whiskey 375ml
bushmills-original-irish-whiskey-1.bodyHtml:
Bushmills Original Irish Whiskey is a classic blended Irish whiskey from the historic Bushmills Distillery in County Antrim, Northern Ireland. It combines triple-distilled single malt whiskey with lighter grain whiskey and is matured for at least three years in Kentucky Bourbon barrels and Spanish Oloroso Sherry casks. Smooth and approachable, it offers a gently warming profile of light fruit, vanilla, honeyed sweetness, and delicate spice with a fresh, clean finish.

Food Pairing: Roast chicken, glazed ham, grilled pork, mild cheddar, toasted almonds, apple tart, vanilla shortbread, and bread pudding.

Tasting Notes: Light, smooth, and approachable with fresh fruit, velvety vanilla, honeyed sweetness, and gentle warming spice.

Nose: Light and fruity with delicate spice, soft vanilla, and subtle honeyed sweetness.

Palate: Smooth and gently warming with honey, vanilla, light fruit, and soft grain character.

Finish: Crisp and refreshing with lingering sweetness and a gentle touch of spice.

two-rivers-jalapeno-vodka.title: Two Rivers Jalapeno Vodka
two-rivers-jalapeno-vodka.bodyHtml:
Two Rivers Jalapeno Vodka is made by Two Rivers Distillery, a craft distillery and cocktail bar in Calgary, Alberta. Smooth Canadian vodka is infused with real jalapenos for a lively, peppery kick that stays balanced rather than overpowering, making it a great base for spicy Caesars, margarita-style cocktails and bold highballs. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Fresh jalapeno heat with a clean vodka base.

Serve: In a spicy Caesar or with soda and lime.

two-rivers-coffee-vodka.title: Two Rivers Coffee Vodka
two-rivers-coffee-vodka.bodyHtml:
Two Rivers Coffee Vodka is a coffee-flavoured vodka from Two Rivers Distillery, a craft distillery and cocktail bar in Calgary, Alberta. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle and is a natural fit for coffee cocktails, from an espresso martini to a White Russian or a spiked iced coffee.

Serve: Shaken with espresso and ice, or over ice with cream.

cerbaia-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Altesino Brunello di Montalcino 2021
cerbaia-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Altesino Brunello di Montalcino is a vibrant and highly aromatic expression of a stellar vintage, noted for its exceptional freshness and "crunchy" fruit profile. It presents a bright ruby-red colour and opens with an ethereal bouquet of violets, lavender, and fresh red berries, seamlessly layered with sophisticated notes of tobacco, dark chocolate, and a hint of cedar. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and impeccably balanced, showcasing a silky texture supported by fine-grained tannins and a focused line of acidity. The finish is remarkably long and energetic, leaving persistent impressions of raspberry, savory herbs, and a refined mineral lift.

Food Pairing: Perfectly matches with roasted lamb, Bistecca alla Fiorentina, wild boar ragù over pappardelle, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

95 Points - James Suckling

A lively Brunello with aromas of plums, ripe cherries, cedar and teak that follow through to a medium body with fine tannins and a crisp finish. Crunchy and linear. Lovely energy at the end. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Altesino 2021 Brunello di Montalcino was a little shy when I tasted it, but knowing the track record of this estate, I have no doubt that the wine will flesh out with bottle age. Give it a year or two more. The bouquet offers blackcurrant and wild berry with a dark mineral note and grilled herb. Pressed violet also rises to the top of the wine, which is firmly structured and very lively in terms of mouthfeel. This popular release of 110,000 bottles ages in Slavonian oak casks only.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

The flavors of black cherry, blackberry and black currant are pure, with accents of violet, wild herbs and earth. This is smooth, picking up chalky tannins as the flavors build to the lengthy conclusion. Best from 2028 through 2045.

top-shelf-butter-tart-liquor-375ml.title: Top Shelf Peach Crumble Liquor 375ml
top-shelf-butter-tart-liquor-375ml.bodyHtml:
Top Shelf Peach Crumble Liquor is a sweet, dessert-style liqueur produced by Top Shelf Distillers in Perth, Ontario. Crafted to capture the nostalgic taste of a home-baked dessert, it combines the juicy flavor of fresh peaches with warm baking spices and toasted oat notes.

Food Pairing: Vanilla bean ice cream, Belgian waffles, fruit tarts, peach cobbler, pecan pie, and aged cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Clear to faintly warm amber in appearance, with a sweet, smooth, and light-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic and sweet, dominated by freshly squeezed juicy peaches, baked crust, and warm cinnamon spice.

Palate : Fruit-forward and decadent, featuring flavors of ripe Niagara peaches, toasted granola, baked pie crust, and subtle sweet baking spices.

Finish : Smooth and sweet with lingering notes of natural peach, toasted oats, and a touch of warm cinnamon.

Serve : Serve chilled over ice, mixed with chilled black iced tea or soda water, or drizzled directly over desserts.

top-shelf-cream-puff-liquor-375ml.title: Top Shelf Cream Puff Liquor
top-shelf-cream-puff-liquor-375ml.bodyHtml:
Top Shelf Cream Puff Liquor is a dessert liqueur from Top Shelf Distillers in Ontario. Part of the distillery's Taste of Canada dessert liquor line, it was inspired by the cream puffs of La Boulangerie, a small bakery in Kapuskasing in Northern Ontario, and created with the town for its KAP100 centennial celebrations. Bottled at 17% ABV in a 375ml bottle.

Serve: In coffee or cappuccino, or poured over ice cream.

veuve-clicquot-brut-smeg-fridge.title: Veuve Clicquot Brut with Cooler Gift Pack
veuve-clicquot-brut-smeg-fridge.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label manages to reconcile two opposing factors, strength and silkiness and to hold them in perfect balance with aromatic intensity and a lot of freshness. With golden yellow tiny bubbles, this non-vintage Champagne shows the fruitiness of peach, Mirabelle plum, and pear alongside notes of vanilla and toasted brioche. This consistent power to please makes it ideal as an aperitif, and perfect as the Champagne to enjoy with a meal.

92 Points - James Suckling

This has aromas of grapefruit, citrus peel, quince, toast and almonds. It’s medium-bodied with creamy, fine tannins. Silky texture. Nutty complexity at the end.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Lively, with tangy acidity and a zesty mousse, this aperitif-style Champagne shows notes of mandarin orange, blackberry, toast and a touch of pastry cream. Subtle, smoke-tinged finish. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Drink now.

mission-hill-quatrain-2017.title: Mission Hill Quatrain 2017
mission-hill-quatrain-2017.bodyHtml:
Mission Hill Quatrain 2017 is a rich, complex, and full-bodied red blend from Mission Hill Family Estate's flagship Legacy Series. Sourced from meticulously managed estate vineyard blocks in the warm Osoyoos and Oliver sub-regions of the southern Okanagan Valley, this vintage is Syrah-led, fermented in specialized French oak fermenters, and aged for 18–19 months in French oak barrels. The nose presents expressive aromas of dark berries, wild blueberry, and red currant layered with notes of cinnamon, crushed pepper, dried herbs, dark chocolate, and menthol. On the palate, it delivers dense, opulent black and blue fruit flavors supported by an elegant structure, fine-grained tannins, and balanced acidity that leads into a long, persistent, and savory finish.
