Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, braised short ribs, duck breast, venison, wild mushroom risotto, and sharp aged cheddar.

veuve-clicquot-brut-rose-smeg-fridge.title: Veuve Clicquot Rose Brut with SMEG Fridge 750ml
veuve-clicquot-brut-rose-smeg-fridge.bodyHtml:
This non-vintage Rose is the end result of a desire to create a Rose champagne with a delightfully luscious, fruit-based charm. Jacques Peters, the cellarmaster, and his team wanted a champagne that would be accessible and naturally engaging while conserving Veuve Clicquot's essential values in terms of style.

The wine has a luminous color with attractive pink glints. The nose is generous and elegant, with initial aromas of fresh red fruit (raspberry, wild strawberry, cherry, blackberry), leading to biscuity notes of dried fruits and Viennese pastries (almonds, apricots and brioche).

The fresh attack is followed by a fruity harmonious sensation on the palate. The wine is perfectly balanced in the best Veuve Clicquot style of pink champagnes, combining elegance and flair. The wine works its magic—this delectably full champagne can be enjoyed as a true delicacy. A deliciously fruity wine in earlybloom, this is a wonderful aperitif to be shared as a twosome or simply with friends.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Minerally on the nose and lacy in texture on the palate, this layers tangy mandarin orange peel acidity with rich hints of toasted brioche and vanilla as well as flavors of wild strawberry, candied ginger and pastry cream. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Drink now.

91 Points - James Suckling

Grapefruit color with aromas of cherries, strawberries, almonds, pastries and honey. Creamy and rounded, with a medium body and soft bubbles. All nicely integrated. Blend of majority pinot noir with chardonnay and meunier, with 12% red wine.

armagnac-castarede-1982.title: Bas Armagnac Castarède 1986
armagnac-castarede-1982.bodyHtml:
Bas Armagnac Castarede 1986 is a vintage Armagnac produced by Maison Castarède, the oldest registered Armagnac trading house in France. Distilled in 1986 from grapes grown in the Bas-Armagnac region, this spirit was aged for decades in local oak barrels, resulting in exceptional depth, elegant structure, and rich fruit complexity.

Food Pairing: Duck breast with fig sauce, roasted pheasant, dark chocolate desserts, aged cheeses, or tarte Tatin.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber-copper with mahogany highlights, featuring a rich, velvety, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Expressive aromas of dried figs, prunes, orange peel, toasted oak, cocoa, and subtle rancio notes.

Palate : Complex and smooth with flavors of candied fruit, dark plum, tobacco leaf, nutmeg, and warm oak spice.

Finish : Long, refined, and lingering with notes of dried fruit, delicate wood tannins, and soft spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip-shaped tasting glass or snifter, allowing it to warm gently in the hand.

wines-of-substance-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Substance 'Cs' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
wines-of-substance-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Substance Cs Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a bold, deeply colored, and exceptionally pure red wine crafted to deliver an authentic, small-batch style expression of classic Washington Cabernet. This compelling, value-driven bottle bursts with inviting aromas of dark chocolate-covered cherries, black plums, mocha, and fresh aniseed, seamlessly underscored by savory hints of dried herbs, cedar, and No. 2 pencil shavings. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, concentrated experience that is beautifully firm yet creamy and plush, carrying soft, grainy tannins and a refreshing acidity through to a layered and remarkably long finish.

Food Pairing: This structured and fruit-forward Cabernet Sauvignon pairs perfectly with grilled ribeye steaks, gourmet beef burgers, slow-braised short ribs, or rich tomato-based pasta dishes.

92 Points - James Suckling

Dark chocolate, nutmeg, sage and blackcurrants on the nose, followed by a full-bodied, focused and juicy palate. Firm yet ripe tannins. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon offers high quality for its modest price. Matured for 10 months in 15% new French oak barriques, it's scented of red cherries, charcuterie, aniseed and dried herbs. The full-bodied palate is concentrated and savory with soft, grainy tannins, refreshing acidity and a layered finish. 140,000 cases produced.

decoy-limited-pinot-noir.title: Decoy Limited Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2018/2022 750ml
decoy-limited-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
This lush and graceful cool-climate Pinot Noir draws you in with enticing aromas of blackberry, bramble, currant, cedar, and earthy forest floor, as well as oak-inspired hints of baking spices. On the palate, alluring red berry flavors are framed by soft, supple tannins, with bright acidity adding freshness to the long, vibrant finish.
92 Points - James Suckling
A robust, flavorful red that's full of dark cherries and smoky accents on a medium to full body. Broad and generous in mouthfeel, deep in black fruit, cedar and forest floor notes with savory mushroom accents.

ardbeg-ardcore-committee-release.title: Ardbeg Ardcore Committee Release 50.1% ABV
ardbeg-ardcore-committee-release.bodyHtml:
From a Distillery with more ups and downs that a pogoing punk comes Ardcore. Created with roasted black malt, roasted to the extreme, this spirit is all about what happens up front ¬¬– centre stage. The malt is what defines its distinctive profile. Described as tasting like ‘biting on a spiky ball’, Ardcore is a dram that wears its heart on its sleeve… its black heart!

Notes of charcoal and sweet smoke make for an in-your-face nose, while potent notes of aniseed and dark chocolate stamp this bottle out as one fit only for the most Ardcore of fans.

Non chill-filtered at 50.1% ABV.

1800-cristalino-tequila.title: 1800 Cristalino Anejo Tequila
1800-cristalino-tequila.bodyHtml: An ultra-premium clear Añejo Tequila finished in port wine casks. 1800® Cristalino is a beautiful contradiction. It is aged in French and American oak barrels, married together, then rested in port wine casks. Finally, it is meticulously filtered to crystal clear clarity while retaining the depth and complexity of Añejo along with the silky smoothness of a Claro. (ABV 40% - 80 proof)

clynelish-1990-31-year-43-5-signatory.title: Signatory Vintage Cask Strength Collection Clynelish 1990 31 Year Old 43.5% ABV
clynelish-1990-31-year-43-5-signatory.bodyHtml:
Clynelish 1990 31 Year Old is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky bottled by the independent bottler Signatory Vintage in its Cask Strength Collection. The spirit was distilled at Clynelish in 1990 and matured for 31 years in a pair of ex-bourbon barrels, which were married and bottled in January 2022. After more than three decades in wood the whisky came out of the casks at 43.5% ABV, and it was bottled at that strength rather than diluted. Each 700ml bottle carries the vintage, the distillation and bottling dates, the cask numbers and an individual bottle number on the label, and it is presented in a Signatory Vintage tin.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water if preferred.

top-shelf-taste-of-canada-dessert-pack.title: Top Shelf Taste Of Canada Dessert Pack 3 x
top-shelf-taste-of-canada-dessert-pack.bodyHtml:
The Top Shelf Taste of Canada Dessert Pack is a gift set of three 375ml dessert liqueurs (1.125L in total) from Top Shelf Distillers in Ontario, Canada, each bottled at 17% ABV. It is an easy way to sample the distillery's dessert-inspired liqueurs side by side or to give as a gift.

Serve: Chilled, over ice, or poured over desserts.

springbank-10-year-old.title: Springbank 10 Year Old
springbank-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Our 10 year old provides the perfect introduction to the Springbank range. Matured in a combination of bourbon and sherry casks, it is complex yet perfectly balanced from the first sip through to the sweet, salty finish.

46% ABV
60% Bourbon, 40% Sherry

springbank-15-year-old.title: Caskshare Collective Series Springbank 30 Year Old 1993 Bourbon Cask 164 49.4% ABV
springbank-15-year-old.bodyHtml:
Springbank 30 Year Old 1993 is a single-cask Campbeltown single malt bottled by Caskshare for its Collective Series, labelled 1993/164. Distilled at Springbank in 1993 and matured in bourbon cask number 164, it was bottled on 2 August 2023 at 49.4% ABV, with an outturn of just 144 bottles. It comes in a 70cl bottle with a presentation box. The label note describes fresh apple and pine with a touch of sherbet, then a tangy, almost fizzing palate of orchard fruit and lime pickle relish, and a long, nostalgic finish.

Nose: Fresh apple and pine with a lightly sweet sherbet note.

Palate: Tangy and fizzing, a funky mix of orchard fruit and lime pickle relish.

Finish: Long, with notes the bottler likens to a school gym, new rubber plimsolls and tuck-shop sweets.

Serve: Neat, with a drop of water if desired.

macallan-harmony-intense-arabica.title: The Macallan Harmony Intense Arabica 44%
macallan-harmony-intense-arabica.bodyHtml:
The second edition in our limited annual release series, this special single malt exudes flavours of sweet oak, tiramisu and dark chocolate, and provides a delightful whisky and coffee pairing experience.

This special single malt is inspired by the Ethiopian Arabica bean. Ethiopia is claimed to be the birthplace of coffee as the Arabica bean was the first species of coffee to be cultivated. ​​ 

With a distinct coffee flavour, this whisky exudes notes of espresso, dark chocolate and sweet oak. The intensely flavoured single malt invites you to immerse yourself in a sensory journey through flavour and aroma.

The Harmony Collection is a limited annual release series inspired by our inherent curiosity, and our innovative and creative mindset. The Macallan Whisky Maker Steven Bremner hosted a masterclass with world renowned coffee masters to explore the process from field to cup.

dom-perignon-x-lady-gaga-rose-2008.title: Dom Perignon x Lady Gaga Rose Edition Rose 2008
dom-perignon-x-lady-gaga-rose-2008.bodyHtml:
The creative dialogue continues: Dom Perignon and Lady Gaga bring a new creation to life, the fruit of their shared ambition to discover harmony in tensions, and create by juxtaposing polarities and dualities.

For Dom Perignon there is an interplay between the personality of the year and the timeless aesthetic ideal, the dialogue of freshness and maturity, shadows and light. For Lady Gaga there is the clashing of cultural codes, the paradox between the popular and the avant-garde, seizing possession of the classical rules and bending them to push the boundaries of creativity.

The bouquet of Dom Perignon Rose Vintage 2008 instantly opens with raspberries, rapidly joined by notes of violet. Greener nuances then arrive, evoking angelica. On the palate the acidic foundation – the signature of the vintage – articulates the structure of the pinot, vibrating the heart of the wine. The affirmed, persistent finish is peonies and white pepper.

99 Points - James Suckling

This shows incredible depth of fruit with strawberry, cherry and phenolics. Full-bodied and layered with an incredible, three-dimensional element to the wine. This is so transparent and dynamic with dark fruit, yet it remains vivid and bright. Refined and precise, it goes on and on. Really savory, fresh and incredibly pinot-noir-like. What a wine. So drinkable now, but it will age for many years ahead.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

An impeccably balanced and graceful sparkling rosé with a plushly cream mousse flavors. It's hard to tell where the firm spine of well-honed acidity and the expressive range of pureed raspberry, candied ginger, tangerine and lemon thyme flavors begin or end. A rich hint of smoky toasted brioche plays on the finish. Drink now through 2033.

95 Points - Decanter

Offering up aromas of white flowers, red berries, toast and fresh pastry, Dom Pérignon rosé 2008 is medium to full-bodied, tense and vibrant, with a vinous texture and sapid nuances. Delicately phenolic, this is a pure and racy gastronomic Champagne that’s beginning to drink with style, and concludes with a long and penetrating finish.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2008 Champagne Rosé is another elegant expression, offering notes of cardamom, strawberry, and dried flowers. The palate is dry and well-structured and is balanced and long on the finish, with notes of dried orange peel, redcurrant, and fantastic salinity. It has a great application at the table and should continue to improve.

two-stacks-dram-in-a-can-single-malt.title: Two Stacks Dram In A Can Blue Can 100ml
two-stacks-dram-in-a-can-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Two Stacks Dram In A Can (Blue Can) is an Irish whiskey from Two Stacks, packed in a 100 ml can at 43% ABV. Two Stacks presents Dram In A Can as the first 43% whiskey to be sold in a can, offering the same focus on spirit quality as its bottled range in a format built for travel, festivals and the outdoors. The can is far lighter than a glass miniature and easy to slip into a bag or pocket.

Serve: Pour neat into a tumbler, add a splash of water, or use as the base of a highball with soda and ice.

louis-jadot-corton-pougets-grand-cru.title: Louis Jadot Corton Greves Grand Cru 2017
louis-jadot-corton-pougets-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Corton Greves Grand Cru 2017 is a Grand Cru Pinot Noir offering layered aromas of red berries, floral notes, spice, and subtle earth. The palate is refined and structured with silky tannins, vibrant acidity, concentrated fruit, and a long mineral-driven finish, delivering excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roast duck, venison, beef tenderloin, mushroom dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

louis-jadot-chambolle-musigny.title: Louis Jadot Musigny Grand Cru 2020
louis-jadot-chambolle-musigny.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Musigny Grand Cru 2020 is an exceptionally rare Grand Cru Chardonnay offering aromas of citrus, white flowers, orchard fruit, hazelnut, and subtle spice. The palate is rich yet precise with vibrant acidity, layered minerality, remarkable depth, and an extraordinarily long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with lobster, turbot, scallops, roasted poultry, creamy seafood dishes, and aged Comte.

jadot-chambertin-clos-de-beze.title: Louis Jadot Chambertin Clos de Beze Grand Cru 2019
jadot-chambertin-clos-de-beze.bodyHtml:
This rich, sumptuous wine has an extraordinary balance of power and elegance. The finely wrought texture finishes with lingering notes of berries and oak. This wine will improve in the bottle for 20 to 25 years.

Serve with sophisticated dishes such as meat in sauce, game and strong cheeses.

98 Points - James Suckling

Deep, dark and mysterious, this is a full-bodied but almost perfectly proportioned red Burgundy. So much forest-berry character with delicate bitter chocolate. Densely concentrated and structured, the overall impression is one of imposing stature, but there’s nothing monumental about this wine. Very firm at the finish now, but this has been built for the long aging. Drinkable now, but best from 2024.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Chambertin Clos de Bèze Grand Cru (Domaine Louis Jadot) is extremely promising, unfurling in the glass with aromas of rich, plummy fruit mingled with orange rind, exotic spices, raw cocoa and espresso roast. Full-bodied, layered and velvety, it's muscular and concentrated, with lively acids and a long, penetrating finish.

louis-jadot-chambolle-msgy-1er-les-baude.title: Louis Jadot Chambolle-Musigny Les Baudes Premier Cru Domaine Gagey 2019
louis-jadot-chambolle-msgy-1er-les-baude.bodyHtml:
With a powerful nose of red berries, this wine is nevertheless delicate, with a silky texture and graceful finish. It will develop for 15 to 20 years in the bottle. This wine is a lovely match with meats in sauce, game and strong cheeses.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Aromas of raspberries, rose petals, sweet soil tones and warm spices introduce the 2019 Chambolle-Musigny 1er Cru Les Baudes (Domaine Gagey), a medium to full-bodied, fleshy and elegantly muscular wine with a concentrated core of fruit, ripe tannins and a long, sapid finish. This cuvée is another fixture among the portfolio's highlights.

jadot-gevrey-chambertin-1r-les-cazetiers.title: Louis Jadot Gevrey-Chambertin Les Cazetiers Premier Cru 2019
jadot-gevrey-chambertin-1r-les-cazetiers.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Gevrey-Chambertin Les Cazetiers Premier Cru 2019 is an exceptional red Burgundy crafted from 100% Pinot Noir in the prestigious Côte de Nuits. Sourced from the highly regarded Les Cazetiers Premier Cru vineyard, situated on an east-facing slope near the celebrated Clos Saint-Jacques, this distinguished wine captures the elegance, depth and remarkable terroir expression of Gevrey-Chambertin. The vineyard's stony limestone and clay soils contribute to a wine of impressive structure and mineral complexity. Matured for approximately 18 months in oak barrels, with around one-third new oak, the 2019 vintage reveals expressive aromas of ripe black cherries, wild raspberries and blackberries, complemented by subtle liquorice, violet, earthy spice and refined oak. Rich yet beautifully balanced, the palate combines concentrated red and dark berry fruit with vibrant acidity, fine-grained tannins and a silky texture. Its long, elegant finish and exceptional ageing potential make this Premier Cru a captivating expression of one of Burgundy's most celebrated appellations.

Food Pairing: An outstanding accompaniment to roasted duck breast, herb-crusted rack of lamb, beef tenderloin, venison, coq au vin and wild mushroom risotto. Its elegant fruit character, earthy complexity and refined tannins also complement truffle-infused dishes, roasted game birds, grilled portobello mushrooms and mature cheeses such as Comté and Époisses.

94 Points - Jasper Morris

Mid red crimson, some oak, slightly muddled fruit showing in the bouquet of this sample. In the plump cherry style, an attractive sweetness, enhanced by slightly over present oak, looking for the typical mineral behind and only just finding them. However, a sumptuous level of fruit, which continues on for a very long time, beyond the oaky carapace. I suspect that there are enough positives in this wine that my rating is on today’s sample is on the severe side.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Rich and dramatic, the sample I tasted of the 2019 Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru Les Cazetiers (Domaine Louis Jadot) was a little marked by its élevage, a liberal application of toasty new oak mingling with its bouquet of sweet berry fruit. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and nicely balanced, I suspect it wasn't showing its best when I encountered it.

chateau-la-cardonne-medoc.title: Chateau Bourbon La Chapelle Medoc
chateau-la-cardonne-medoc.bodyHtml:
Chateau Bourbon La Chapelle Medoc is a classic Bordeaux red from the Medoc appellation, offering ripe black fruit, subtle spice, refined tannins, and balanced acidity. Elegant and approachable, it delivers excellent structure with a smooth, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled steak, roast lamb, beef stew, duck confit, mushroom dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

chateau-mongravey-margaux.title: Chateau Mongravey Margaux Cru Bourgeois Superiore
chateau-mongravey-margaux.bodyHtml:
The Château Mongravey Margaux Cru Bourgeois Supérieur is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex Old World red wine that beautifully captures the unique, gravelly terroir and timeless elegance of the Left Bank. It pours a brilliant, dense deep ruby-purple colour with vibrant violet reflections in the glass, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of ripe black currants, wild blackberries, and red plums, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of fresh violet flowers, cedar wood, sweet tobacco leaves, and subtle warm spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Bordeaux blend is remarkably smooth, juicy, and round, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of dark stone fruits, graphite, and black tea that showcase the classic, well-balanced character of the estate. Matured meticulously in fine French oak barrels to maximize its structural depth and natural sophistication, it is driven by a balanced, food-friendly acidity and firm, silky noble tannins that carry into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by a lingering touch of woodsmoke and crisp iron minerality.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of refined culinary options, including prime cuts of grilled beef steak, classic Boeuf en Croûte, slow-roasted lamb shanks with rosemary, roasted duck breast with berry reduction, wild game stews, and aged artisanal cheeses.

two-stacks-smoke-and-mirrors-maple-cask.title: Two Stacks Smoke and Mirrors Maple Cask Irish Whiskey
two-stacks-smoke-and-mirrors-maple-cask.bodyHtml: Two Stacks Smoke And Mirrors Maple Cask 700ml

don-julio-blanco-1.title: Don Julio Blanco Tequila 50ml
don-julio-blanco-1.bodyHtml:
Don Julio Blanco Tequila is a premium, luxury silver tequila that serves as the foundation for all of Don Julio's expressions. Crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in the mineral-rich, red clay soils of the Jalisco Highlands (Los Altos), the agave is slow-roasted in traditional masonry ovens for 72 hours before being double-distilled. Unaged and bottled immediately, it captures the raw, pure essence of the agave plant, delivering a crisp, bright, and citrus-forward profile that helped set the benchmark for the ultra-premium blanco tequila category.

Food Pairing: Fresh fish ceviche, grilled shrimp tacos, guacamole with lime-salted tortilla chips, fresh oysters, and light, zesty citrus salads.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and brilliant in appearance, offering a remarkably crisp, light, and pristine mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright and highly aromatic, leading with crisp, fresh cooked agave, vibrant citrus notes of lemon, lime, and grapefruit, along with subtle floral and sweet herbal undertones.

Palate : Smooth, fresh, and naturally sweet. A clean wave of pure agave and bright citrus zest is beautifully balanced by a gentle, earthy minerality and a touch of light black pepper.

Finish : Crisp, whistle-clean, and refreshing, fading elegantly with lingering notes of grassy agave, bright citrus, and a gentle peppery warmth.

Serve : Serve neat or on the rocks in a traditional copita glass, or use it to elevate classic premium cocktails like a traditional Margarita, a Tommy's Margarita, or a refreshing Paloma.

crown-royal-canadian-whisky.title: Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky With Gift Box
crown-royal-canadian-whisky.bodyHtml:
Crown Royal Fine De Luxe Canadian Whisky is the legendary flagship expression that set the standard for Canadian whisky. Originally crafted in 1939 to celebrate the first grand tour of Canada by King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, it is meticulously blended from over 50 distinct whiskies. Aged to perfection in oak barrels, it delivers a remarkably smooth, approachable, and consistently rich flavor profile that has made it a staple in bars and homes worldwide.

Food Pairing: This versatile whisky pairs beautifully with savory, slightly sweet dishes like smoked pulled pork, BBQ chicken, or maple-glazed salmon. For dessert or cheese boards, serve it alongside aged cheddar or milk chocolate.

TASTING NOTES - A warm, golden amber spirit that feels exceptionally smooth and velvety in the glass, offering an inviting and medium-bodied texture.

NOSE - Rich and robust, featuring clear notes of vanilla, toasted oak, dark caramel, and a gentle waft of ripe orchard fruit.

Palate - Delicately smooth and creamy. Soft caramel and brown sugar lead the way, followed by hints of toasted oak, vanilla cream, and a very mild rye baking spice.

FINISH - Long, lingering, and exceptionally smooth, fading out with soft oak, gentle sweetness, and vanilla.

SERVE - Extremely versatile; enjoy it neat, on the rocks, or as the foundation for cocktails like a Crown and Cola, a Whisky Sour, or a classic Washington Apple.

marques-de-caceres-gaudium-2014.title: Marques de Caceres Gaudium Gran Vino 2020
marques-de-caceres-gaudium-2014.bodyHtml:
Marqués de Cáceres Gaudium Gran Vino 2020 is a distinguished Rioja red wine crafted from 100% Tempranillo sourced from exceptionally old vineyards in Rioja Alta and Rioja Alavesa. Selected from vines over 70 years old, including some pre-phylloxera parcels, this limited-production wine combines concentrated black fruit with balsamic complexity, warm spices, and refined oak. Aged for at least 18 months in new French oak barrels and further refined in bottle, it delivers a full-bodied palate with rounded tannins, elegant structure, and a long, harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, Iberian pork, venison, mushroom risotto, aged Manchego, and traditional Spanish meat dishes.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Intensity of aromatics joins palate coating flavors in a velvety mouthfeel for a satisfying, generous while refined Tempranillo. Dark ruby in the glass, followed by dark fruits robed in spices followed by leather and wet tobacco. Aging in cellar has integrated and polished the wine with smooth tannins, mineral lines, and a lengthy finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Savory on the nose, with a fragrant mesh of underbrush, leather, bouillon and loamy earth notes that then underscore the palate’s flavors of black plum, mocha, licorice string and toast. The rich profile is layered with creamy-edged tannins that firm the spiced finish. Drink now through 2035.

los-siete-misterios-doba-yej-espadin.title: Los Siete Misterios Doba-Yej Espadin Mezcal
los-siete-misterios-doba-yej-espadin.bodyHtml:
Siete Misterios Doba-Yej is made from agave Espadin. Doba-Yej is Zapotec for agave Espadin, and they chose this name as this mezcal is different from the Siete Misterios Espadin. It is the first expression from Siete Misterios that is made in a copper still rather than the clay pot still seen in their other mezcals. The milling for this mezcal is also done by horse-drawn tahona, rather than by hand like the other Siete Misterios mezcal. In typical Siete Misterios fashion, each batch is made by a different mezcalero, and depending on the batch, your bottle of Doba-Yej either came from Santiago Matatlan or San Luis del Rio. Make sure to check your bottle for these details.

Siete Misterios was founded in 2010 by brothers Julio and Eduardo Mestre with the intent of keeping traditional mezcal production at the forefront of the mezcal industry. The company sources a wide range of mezcals that all highlight a single agave varietal. They are backed by those who are deeply saddened by the industrialization seen in most tequila and some low-grade mezcal, and they’re doing everything in their power to keep the art of the mezcalero alive. The mezcaleros making their bottles change batch to batch, so one batch’s bottles may taste entirely different from the next batch’s bottles. This gives Siete Misterios a lot of variety in it’s bottling as each batch is made by a different person, with agave grown in a slightly different micro-climate, and the

three-olives-vodka.title: Three Olives Espresso Vodka
three-olives-vodka.bodyHtml:
Three Olives Espresso Vodka is a vibrant, flavored vodka designed for effortless mixing. Recently rebranded and now crafted in the USA, this zero-sugar expression is built on a smooth vodka base and infused with the rich, all-natural flavors of roasted Arabica coffee beans.

On the nose, it delivers bold, dark roasted coffee aromas underlain by hints of dark chocolate and vanilla bean. The palate is rich, balanced, and deeply chocolatey, making it a perfect, straightforward base for Espresso Martinis, Mudslides, or pouring directly over ice.

canadian-club-premium.title: Canadian Club Premium 50ml
canadian-club-premium.bodyHtml:
Canadian Club Whisky is a historic and universally recognized blended Canadian whisky, renowned for its smooth and highly approachable character. Produced at the legendary Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, this flagship expression (often known as 1858) has been a staple in homes and bars since the mid-19th century. Crafted from a careful selection of corn, rye, rye malt, and barley malt, it undergoes aging in white-oak American bourbon barrels, resulting in a crisp, slightly dry, and versatile profile that helped define the Canadian whisky category.

Food Pairing: The peppery rye notes make this a great match for smoked salmon or grilled steak. It also pairs beautifully with maple-glazed pork chops, aged cheddar cheese, or a dessert featuring dark chocolate.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, golden amber spirit that is exceptionally smooth, light, and approachable, offering a balanced interplay between sweet grain and gentle rye spice.

NOSE - Fresh and soft, opening with a mild almond nuttiness and sweet vanilla, followed by an inviting hint of zesty and peppery rye spice.

Palate - Zesty and slightly spicy on the entry with a clear rye character. The mid-palate softens into sweet vanilla, rich oak, caramel, and a pleasant, subtle creaminess.

FINISH - Clean, dry, and relatively short, leaving behind a lingering, gentle warmth with subtle oak tannins and a faint touch of vanilla.

SERVE - Excellent as a versatile mixer. It is perfect for a classic Highball with ginger ale or club soda, a Whisky Sour, a simple Old Fashioned, or simply poured over ice.

vecchio-amaro-del-capo.title: Vecchio Amaro del Capo
vecchio-amaro-del-capo.bodyHtml: Vecchio Amaro Del Capo is an Italian liqueur made with a selection of herbs and roots with an alcohol content of 38%. It has a complex and balanced flavor, making it an ideal digestif to enjoy neat or by itself.

grahams-vintage-gift-pack.title: W. & J. Graham's Port Selection Gift Pack 5 x 200ml
grahams-vintage-gift-pack.bodyHtml:
W. & J. Graham's Vintage Gift Pack 5 x 200ml is an exceptionally curated, elegant collection showcasing the supreme versatility, consistency, and signature rich style of one of the historic houses of the Douro Valley. Also commercially recognized as the Graham's Selection Pack, this collection highlights five beautifully distinct styles packaged in 200ml bottles: the crisp and fragrant Fine White Port, the concentrated Late Bottled Vintage (LBV), the famously fruity Six Grapes Reserve Ruby, and the masterfully wood-aged 10 Year Old and 20 Year Old Tawny Ports. Across the entire assortment, tasters are treated to a dynamic progression of flavors—ranging from fresh green apples and almond blossoms to intense dark bramble fruit, honeyed figs, sweet toffee, and toasted walnuts. Each individual expression is balanced seamlessly by a vibrant streak of natural acidity and a firm, warming structure. This magnificent set serves as a comprehensive masterclass in classic Port winemaking, offering a stunning sensory journey across various traditional maturation styles and techniques.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with multi-course tastings featuring dry-roasted nuts, creamy lemon-goat cheese, dark chocolate truffles, warm fruit tarts, and sharp blue cheeses.

galliano-laperitivo.title: Galliano L'Aperitivo Liqueur
galliano-laperitivo.bodyHtml:
Galliano L'Aperitivo is a bittersweet Italian-style aperitivo bitter, or amaro, built on extracts and infusions of Mediterranean citrus: orange, bergamot, bitter orange, chinotto, tangerine and grapefruit. A touch of the heart of Galliano L'Autentico adds anise, juniper, cardamom, sandalwood, sage, lavender, peppermint, cinnamon and vanilla, and the ingredients are macerated and rested for at least two weeks to bring the flavours together. Bottled at 24% ABV in a 375ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Fresh Mediterranean citrus with subtle herbs and a bittersweet edge.

Nose: Bright Mediterranean citrus with soft herbal notes.

Palate: Fresh citrus balanced by gentle herbs and bitterness.

Finish: Long, gentle and bittersweet.

Serve: With tonic over ice, in a Spritz, or in a Negroni, Americano or Sbagliato.

galliano-ristretto.title: Galliano Espresso Coffee Liqueur
galliano-ristretto.bodyHtml:
Galliano Espresso is an intense espresso liqueur with a more concentrated character than most coffee liqueurs. It is made with two dark-roasted coffees: 55% Arabica from Colombia and Brazil, which gives a chocolatey, creamy top note, and 45% Robusta from India and Kenya, which brings body and bitter coffee tones. Bottled at 30% ABV in a 375ml bottle, it works as an after-dinner sipper or as the backbone of coffee cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Strong caffè corretto with dark-chocolate-covered roasted coffee beans.

Palate: Full and concentrated, with heavily roasted coffee and dark chocolate.

Finish: Oily espresso with an almost peppermint-like freshness.

Serve: Neat after dinner, in an Espresso Martini, or with tonic over ice.

campari-negroni.title: Campari Negroni Ready to Drink Cocktail 375ml
campari-negroni.bodyHtml:
Campari Negroni Ready to Drink is a bottled version of the classic Negroni, made by Campari with the same three ingredients bartenders use: Campari, vermouth and gin. The Negroni was created in Florence in 1919 and remains one of the most requested cocktails worldwide; this pre-mixed version lets you pour a balanced serve at home without measuring. It comes in a 375ml bottle at 26% ABV. Campari Negroni Ready to Enjoy was named a Finalist at the 2021 Ultimate Spirits Challenge with a score of 94 points.

Tasting Notes: Crimson red; herbal and dark-fruited, with Campari bitterness, vermouth sweetness and juniper.

Nose: Herbal notes and layers of dark fruit, with lemon and coriander seed from the gin.

Palate: The bitterness of Campari balanced by fruity, sweet vermouth and the juniper tang of gin.

Serve: Pour over ice in a rocks glass and garnish with a slice of orange.

moet-chandon-brut-milestones.title: Moet & Chandon Brut Imperial Milestones 750ml
moet-chandon-brut-milestones.bodyHtml:
An elegant golden straw yellow with amber highlights. Its aromas are radiant, revealing bright yellow-fleshed fruits (apple, pear, yellow peach), honey, floral nuances (lime blossom) and elegant blond notes (brioche and fresh nuts). The palate is seductive, richly flavorful and smooth combining generosity and subtlety, fullness and vigor, followed by a delicately fresh crispiness (fruit with seeds), to reveal the magical balance of Champagne.

 

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant version, fine and creamy in texture and backed by lively, orange peel acidity. A streak of smoke-tinged minerality underscores flavors of almond madeleine, poached pear, anise and preserved lemon. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Champagne gets better and better. It has a fine dryness with a crisp apple and citrus character. That goes with the touches of maturity that give the wine fine balance.

90 Points - James Suckling

Nicely complex aromas here, from dried apples, peaches and pears to candied citrus and brioche. It’s fruity, soft and rounded on the palate. Medium-bodied, lightly honeyed and balanced. Blend of pinot noir, pinot meunier and chardonnay.

jagermeister-herbal-liqueur-3.title: Jagermeister Herbal Liqueur
jagermeister-herbal-liqueur-3.bodyHtml:
Every German masterpiece contains equal parts precision and inspiration. Bold, yet balanced, our herbal liqueur is no different.

Blending 56 botanicals, our ice-cold shot has always been embraced by those who take originality to the next level.

Nature made it, we put it in a bottle. The highest-grade herbs, blossoms, roots and fruits from around the globe are crafted into 4 distinct macerates, then combined in modern-day alchemy into our herbal spirit. The full ingredient list is a closely guarded secret, but raise a glass to your lips and you?ll taste all 4 corners of the world.

founders-original-ultimate-cocktail-box.title: Founder'S Original Ultimate Cocktail Box 8 Cans

north-star-teaninich-12-yo.title: North Star Teaninich 12 Year Old 50.7%
north-star-teaninich-12-yo.bodyHtml:
This Teaninich 12 Year Old is a single cask, single malt Scotch whisky from Glasgow independent bottler North Star Spirits. Distilled at Teaninich in the Northern Highlands and matured for 12 years in an Oloroso sherry hogshead, it was bottled at 50.7% ABV, with just 226 bottles of 700ml filled from the cask.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water to open it up.

orkney-2006-57-1.title: The First Editions Orkney 2006 15 Year Old Single Cask 62.8% ABV
orkney-2006-57-1.bodyHtml:
The First Editions Orkney 2006 is a single cask Island single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Edition Spirits for the First Editions range of independent bottler Hunter Laing. It was distilled in 2006 at an Orkney distillery that the label does not name, matured for 15 years in a single refill hogshead and bottled in 2021 at a cask strength of 62.8% ABV, in a 700 ml bottle. The label states that the whisky is non-chill filtered and not coloured, and the bottle comes in a presentation tube.

Tasting Notes: Coastal and peppery with toffee sweetness, as described on the label.

Nose: Sea spray, pepper and toffee.

Palate: Sweet, with apple, chocolate and spice.

Finish: Long, with lingering heat.

Serve: Neat, with water added to taste at this strength.

alley-kat-wandering-trails-westcoast-ipa.title: Alley Kat Arctic Aurora Cold Ipa

kings-ginger.title: The King's Ginger Liqueur 500ml
kings-ginger.bodyHtml:
The King's Ginger is a ginger liqueur owned by Berry Bros. & Rudd, the London wine and spirit merchant. It was created in 1903, when the royal physician asked the firm for a warming, reviving drink for King Edward VII, who drove his Daimler in all weathers. The recipe has evolved since then; the current version, introduced with a new, fully recyclable bottle, is made in the UK again after a period of production in Holland, and uses a higher level of ginger alongside lemon. It is bottled at 29.9% ABV in a 500ml bottle. The brand notes a gold medal at the 2021 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

Tasting Notes: Hay-gold in colour, with fresh ginger and lemon zest.

Nose: Fresh natural ginger with a faint note of zesty lemon.

Palate: Ginger-syrup sweetness, then a tingle of fresh ginger and a gentle lift of lemon; warm and long.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in cocktails and long drinks.

moneybag-vodka.title: New Amsterdam Pink Whitney Pink Lemonade Flavoured Vodka
moneybag-vodka.bodyHtml:
New Amsterdam Pink Whitney is a pink lemonade flavoured vodka from the New Amsterdam range of E. & J. Gallo, bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The flavour grew out of a collaboration between Barstool Sports and New Amsterdam and was inspired by the favourite drink of former NHL player Ryan Whitney, co-host of the Spittin' Chiclets podcast, before going viral with hockey fans. New Amsterdam vodka is infused with pink lemonade flavour for a bright, sweet-tart profile with natural lemon zest and a clean, refreshing finish. Its lower strength and easy-going flavour make it a simple choice for highballs, shots and warm-weather pitchers.

Tasting Notes: Sweet pink lemonade, lemon zest and a clean finish.

Serve: On the rocks, or topped with club soda.

revel-stoke-smorgasm.title: Revel Stoke S'moregasm Toasted S'mores Flavoured Whisky
revel-stoke-smorgasm.bodyHtml:
A wildly fun, unapologetically sweet, and highly mixable flavored whiskey from Revel Stoke. This expression takes a smooth, easy-drinking whiskey base and expertly blends it with the nostalgic, campfire flavors of toasted marshmallow, melted milk chocolate, and graham cracker. Bottled at an approachable 70 proof (35% ABV), it is perfectly designed to be thrown back as a chilled shot, poured over ice, or spiked into a hot chocolate or coffee for the ultimate sweet treat.

 

NOSE

Massive, sweet aromas of toasted marshmallow, dark chocolate, and sweet vanilla cream.

PALATE

Incredibly sweet and smooth, delivering an exact replica of a classic s'more—lush chocolate, sweet graham cracker, and creamy vanilla dominate the palate.

FINISH

Smooth, velvety, and lingering with a pleasant, dessert-like sweetness.

shede-classic.title: Shede Classic Baijiu 500ml
shede-classic.bodyHtml:
Shede Classic is a strong-aroma baijiu from Sichuan, China, bottled at 52% ABV in a 500ml bottle. The base spirit is aged for more than six years before it is blended, and it is made by traditional solid-state fermentation of pure grain in the classic Luzhou strong-aroma style, the style for which Sichuan is best known. It is a smooth, mellow and layered spirit: grain sweetness with a soft floral lift and a little spice on the nose, a full palate of honeyed grain, ripe orchard fruit and gentle pepper warmth, and a long, harmonious finish. It is a baijiu often chosen for gifting, celebrations and business occasions.

Tasting Notes: Grain sweetness, floral notes, orchard fruit and gentle spice.

Nose: Rich grain sweetness with a soft floral lift and subtle spice.

Palate: Smooth and full-bodied, with honeyed grain, ripe orchard fruit and gentle pepper warmth.

Finish: Long, mellow and harmonious.

Serve: Neat at room temperature in small baijiu glasses.

nearly-nude-smash-mixer-pack-12pk.title: Nearly Nude Smash Mixer Pack 12 Cans

hennessy-vsop-uvas-limited-edition.title: Hennessy VSOP Cognac Year of the Horse Lunar New Year 2026 Limited Edition
hennessy-vsop-uvas-limited-edition.bodyHtml:
Hennessy VSOP Cognac Year of The Horse Lunar New Year 2026 Limited Edition is an extraordinary collector's bottling celebrating the 2026 Lunar New Year with bespoke festive artwork designed in collaboration with contemporary artist Xu Zhen. Honoring the noble spirit, power, and vitality of the Year of the Horse, this edition houses Hennessy's signature Very Superior Old Pale blend, masterfully crafted from up to 60 distinct eaux-de-vie aged in French oak barrels to deliver timeless elegance, structure, and balance.

Food Pairing: Peking duck, glazed pork belly, rich dark chocolate tarts, aged Gouda, or candied nuts.

Tasting Notes : Luminous warm amber with a silky, well-rounded texture and balanced body on the palate.

Nose : Refined aromas of sweet vanilla, candied fruits, gentle oak spice, fresh clove, and subtle honeyed blossom.

Palate : Smooth and creamy with layers of toasted almond, cinnamon, nutmeg spice, dried apricot, and warm oak undertones.

Finish : Long, elegant, and gracefully lingering with notes of soft oak, sweet toffee, and delicate spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks with a single large ice cube, or as an elevated base in classic cocktails like a Sidecar or Old Fashioned.

jadot-gevrey-chambertin-petit-chapelle.title: Louis Jadot Gevrey-Chambertin Clos St. Jacques Premier Cru 2017
jadot-gevrey-chambertin-petit-chapelle.bodyHtml:
A full-bodied, complex wine, this Premier Cru has a broad array of aromas and fine expression of terroir as well as impressive length on the palate. It will develop for more than 10 years in the bottle—or up to 40 in great vintages.Serve with game, meats, mushroom dishes and strong cheeses.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

With its dense tannins and concentration, this wine is impressive both for aging and for its power. With bold structure the wine sustains the black fruits with verve. It will age well and will not be ready before 2025.


94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2017 Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru Clos Saint-Jacques (Domaine Louis Jadot) unfurls in the glass with an incipiently complex bouquet of sweet red berries, coffee roast, raw cocoa, candied peel and cedary new wood. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, ample and layered, with an abundance of satiny structuring tannin, juicy acids and a long, pure finish. As usual, this will require some bottle age, but it's one of the high points of the collection. 

93 Points - James Suckling
Shows a solid finish with ripe and linear tannins, as well as attractive sliced-strawberry, raspberry and citrus flavors. Medium to full body. Solid. Give it three to four years to soften. Try after 2023.

hennessy-vsop-holiday-deluxe.title: Hennessy VSOP Privilege Cognac
hennessy-vsop-holiday-deluxe.bodyHtml:
Hennessy VSOP Cognac is a harmonious and balanced cognac produced by Jas Hennessy & Co. First created in 1817 at the request of the future King George IV of the United Kingdom, it is crafted from a blend of over 60 different eaux-de-vie aged in seasoned French oak casks, resulting in a rich, velvety profile marked by fresh fruit, toasted oak, and delicate spices.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, foie gras, dark chocolate desserts, aged gouda, or rich caramelized pork belly.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber in color with a velvety, rich, and well-rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh fruit, candied orange peel, vanilla, clove, cinnamon, and subtle toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of ripe apricot, dried fruit, vanilla, toasted almonds, and warm winter spices.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant with lingering notes of sweet spice, candied fruit, and subtle oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip glass, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic cocktails like a Sidecar or Sazerac.

connoisseurs-choice-tormore-1991.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Tormore 29 Year Old 1991 Refill Sherry Butt Cask 15384 51.5% ABV
connoisseurs-choice-tormore-1991.bodyHtml: Rich sherry aromas combine with stewed raisins and toffee apples. Notes of fruitcake come to the fore alongside baked apples and subtle tobacco notes. Sweet and smooth flavours of festive spice and milk chocolate. Undertones of dried banana develop with orange marmalade and butterscotch.

bodyguard-by-daou-chardonnay.title: DAOU Bodyguard Chardonnay 2020 750ml
bodyguard-by-daou-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Conceived by brothers Georges and Daniel Daou, Bodyguard Chardonnay is a wine of uncommon opulence. The 2020 vintage offers fragrant aromas of golden apple, buttered toast, honey and lilac. Subtle notes of Bartlett pear, star fruit, hibiscus and nutmeg round out the elegant, floral bouquet. The texture is smooth and silky, cascading across the palate with enticing flavors of spiced pear, Granny Smith apple, golden kiwi and honeysuckle, all underlain by mouthwatering minerality. Secondary layers reveal nuances of white peach and toasty oak, hazelnut, honeydew melon and citrus zest. A crisp, clean finish shows remarkable length with lingering notes of lemon curd and pineapple.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Lime leaf, crumbled herb and chiseled stone aromas hit the nose in this bottling, a new project for the Daou brothers. The palate is bright in a citrus tonic flavor, with a Key lime pie element that arises as well

daou-family-estates-sequentis-merlot.title: DAOU Sequentis Reserve Merlot 2020 750ml
daou-family-estates-sequentis-merlot.bodyHtml:
Sequentis is a limited release Reserve Merlot that is a testament to our devotion to Bordeaux varietals. The spectacular 2020 vintage offers an intensely expressive nose of ripe boysenberry, black raspberry and plum with warm notes of espresso and cocoa. Subtle cherry aromas are complemented by cedar, graphite and lavender. On the palate, a plush texture delivers rich, fleshy flavors of black currant, blueberry, blackberry and pomegranate. Secondly layers reveal fresh cherry, cassis, licorice, fig compote and black olive. Exquisitely balanced and focused, this wine shows elegant complexity with superb harmony. The silky mouthfeel glides gracefully into a long finish, lingering with lovely notes of juicy berries, dark chocolate and sage

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Dark and thick in the glass, this top-shelf Merlot offers aromas of toasted pecan, roasted cocoa nibs and smoky oak on the nose. The palate is wrapped in tight tannins that envelop the blackberry sauce and dark-chocolate flavors.

el-tequileno-dual-pack-2-x-375ml.title: El Tequileño Dual Pack Platinum Blanco & Reposado Gran Reserva Tequila 2 x 375ml
el-tequileno-dual-pack-2-x-375ml.bodyHtml:
Founded in 1959 by Don Jorge Salles Cuervo, El Tequileno is a certified additive-free distillery and this gift pack includes one 375ml each of their Platinum and Reposado Gran Reserva Award winning Tequila

ADDITIVE FREE

whisky-sponge-edradour-equilibrium-16yr.title: Whisky Sponge Equilibrium Edition No.2 Edradour 16 Year Old 55% ABV
whisky-sponge-edradour-equilibrium-16yr.bodyHtml:
Equilibrium is our ongoing attempt to create whiskies that display a balanced sherry and peat flavour profile. Always featuring the two single malts from Edradour distillery. 

This second release is a mix of a 2005 Edradour and a 2005 Ballechin, both matured full term for 16 years in 2nd fill sherry hogsheads and bottled with slight reduction at 55%.

We're very happy with the result. It's a slightly lighter and more subtle expression than Equilibrium One, showing more complex earthy notes, dry wood smoke, herbs, cured meats, dark fruits and tobaccos. Layered, rich and highly sessionable. 

We think anyone who enjoys peat and sherry together will find plenty to enjoy here. However, as ever, we'd be very keen to hear what you think. Has 'balance' been achieved? Do the peat and sherry get along together? And can the Sponge justify the extravagant, ongoing business expense of doing all his blending in outer space?

whisky-sponge-pulteney-13yr-48-5.title: Old Pulteney 18 Year Old
whisky-sponge-pulteney-13yr-48-5.bodyHtml:
Old Pulteney 18 Year Old is an indulgent and deeply warming single malt Scotch whisky that represents the peak of the distillery’s reimagined core range. Matured for 18 years, this exquisite expression is initially aged in second-fill American oak ex-bourbon casks before being finished in first-fill Spanish oak Oloroso sherry butts. This dual maturation introduces a decadent layer of rich chocolate, Christmas cake sweetness, and deep baking spices to Old Pulteney's legendary coastal, sea-salt identity. Bottled at 46% ABV without chill-filtration or added coloring, it beautifully balances mature sherry complexity with a vibrant, refreshing marine character.

Food Pairing: The exquisite sweet-and-saline nature of this 18-year-old malt pairs wonderfully with rich seafood dishes like smoked salmon or pan-seared scallops. It also beautifully complements nutty, aged cheeses such as Manchego and Comté, or sweet desserts like dark chocolate truffles and salted caramel tarts.

TASTING NOTES - A rich, natural copper-amber hue. The texture is noticeably thick, oily, and luxuriously mouth-coating on the palate.

NOSE - Deep and highly aromatic, opening with creamy vanilla and milk chocolate, followed by rich honey, orange marmalade, baked apples, and a distinct thread of coastal sea air.

PALATE - Rich, full, and complex. Decadent notes of dark chocolate, brown sugar, and dense Christmas cake are balanced beautifully by a prickle of black pepper, clove, zesty lemon peel, and a persistent wave of maritime brine.

FINISH - Long, elegant, and warming. The rich chocolate and dried fruit sweetness slowly give way to a lingering finish of dry oak spice, ginger, citrus rind, and a satisfying saline crispness.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn tasting glass to appreciate its full structural complexity, or with just a few drops of pure water to further open up the floral and softer citrus layers.

whisky-sponge-glen-keith-27yr.title: Whisky Sponge Exclusive Edition No.9 Bottled for Heads & Tails Glen Grant 20 Year Old 57.8% ABV
whisky-sponge-glen-keith-27yr.bodyHtml:
Whisky Sponge Bottled for Heads & Tails Glen Grant 20 Year Old 57.8% ABV Exclusive Edition No.9 700ml

This 20 year old Whisky Sponge Glen Grant has been selected by and bottled exclusively for Heads & Tails. Distilled in 2003 the spirit matured 20 long years in a First Fill ex-Bourbon Barrel before bottling at 57.8%. Only 169 bottles!

whisky-sponge-knockdhu-16yr.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No. 63 Knockdhu 2006 16 Year Old Refill Hogshead 55% ABV
whisky-sponge-knockdhu-16yr.bodyHtml:
This is a single refill hogshead of 2006 16 year old Knockdhu. It's also very peaty and quite ridiculously pale, pure and razor-sharp. A singular and almost ideological style of whisky. 

The original cask strength of this one was up over 67%. Once we'd found a glass that didn't dissolve on contact with the sample, we played around with water and various strengths for ages before settling on 55% as delivering the most balance between raw peat ashes, frothy seawater, lemon juice drizzled directly over your tonsils and having pickled green olives fired at you from a blunderbuss. 

Why not sip it casually while playing a few rounds of BogSponge3000 down the arcade...

whisky-sponge-caol-ila-2009-12yr-56-3.title: Decadent Drinks Islay Sponge Part VI Caol Ila 13 Year Old 53% ABV
whisky-sponge-caol-ila-2009-12yr-56-3.bodyHtml:
This is Islay Sponge Part VI. It’s a 13 year old lightly sherried Caol Ila, cooked up by smooshing together a 2009 refill sherry hogshead and a 2010 1st fill sherry hogshead. 

The resulting potion was bottled with a couple of degrees reduction at 53% to help knit everything together. It makes for a superbly peaty and rich dram, full of up front distillery character with an elegant tinting of sherry over everything.  

Please take large mouthfuls of this super Caol Ila while emitting loud, evil cackles in the manner of an unhinged, but irrefutably talented middle-aged artist about to do their best work. Please make sure some of it courses down your chin in smoky, viscous rivulets in a way which onlookers cannot help but find both disturbing and captivating.  

Thank you for your custom and attention  

Whisky Sponge 

Xxx

whisky-sponge-ben-nevis-7yr-48-5.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No. 58A Ben Nevis 25 Year Old 1996 Refill Butt 53% ABV
whisky-sponge-ben-nevis-7yr-48-5.bodyHtml:
This is a hyper-distillate driven, almost ideologically 'refill' profile Ben Nevis 1996. You have been warned! 

However, for those of you who also enjoy this extremely pure, naked and invigorating style of highland malt whisky - you shall find yourself contorted with satisfaction. 

For this edition, the Sponge interviews his older self about his successes, failures and unrequited vengeances. You'll have to wait until next year, when we bottle the other half of this cask, to find out what his answers are...

The first half of this stark-naked refill butt has been bottled reduced to 53% to bring out a slightly fruitier style on the palate. Next year we will likely do the rest at cask strength. If civilisation remains moderately intact. Stay tuned...

armagnac-sponge-49yr-42-9.title: Decadent Drinks Armagnac Sponge Edition No. 2 49 Year Old 1972 42.9% ABV
armagnac-sponge-49yr-42-9.bodyHtml:
Armagnac Sponge Edition 2 is a 49 year old, 1972 vintage Bas Armagnac. Composed of an equal parts mix of two sibling casks and bottled at natural cask strength of 42.9%. 

This is essentially a luscious old Armagnac cosplaying as a 1972 Glen Grant. Obscenely bloated with honeys, honeycomb, pollens, flower nectars, sweet fruit cordials and elegant rancio. It is illegally delicious and will induce socially awkward states of pleasure. You will hate it so please don't buy any.

rum-sponge-clarendon-2007-15yr-57-1.title: Rum Sponge Edition No.13 Clarendon 2007 15 Year Old
rum-sponge-clarendon-2007-15yr-57-1.bodyHtml:
Rum Sponge Edition No.13 is a single barrel of Clarendon 2007, aged for 15 years and bottled with a fair chunk of reduction at 57.1%. 

Originally this stock was up at 67%, which is patently outrageous so we improved/ruined, it depending on your point of view, with some dilution. We are very happy with the result as we feel it brings out more exuberant tropical fruitiness on top of all those jangly coastal and ester notes. 

Overall another funky, fun, fruity and charismatic young Jamaican.

rum-sponge-barbados-2000-21yr-49.title: Rum Sponge Edition No.14 Barbados 2000 21 Year Old
rum-sponge-barbados-2000-21yr-49.bodyHtml:
Rum Sponge Edition 14 is a single barrel of 2000 Barbados rum, aged for 21 years and bottled at natural cask strength of 49%.

This rum has been selected four squares like you who enjoy these kinds of nerdy single cask rums. It is a softer and more elegant style, full of freshly baked brown breads, bandages, ointments and spiced exotic fruits. Ideal for sipping in the shade of your own sense of foreboding while watching Jurassic Park and wishing you could go back to how easy and simple everything seemed in the 1990s. 

Please remember to use a cocktail umbrella when nosing and sipping this rum. Thank you.

vogue-chambolle-musigny.title: Bruno Clair Chambolle Musigny Les Charmes Premier Cru 2022
vogue-chambolle-musigny.bodyHtml:
Domaine Bruno Clair Chambolle-Musigny Premier Cru Les Charmes  is an elegant Pinot Noir from one of Chambolle's finest Premier Cru vineyards. Aromas of red cherry, raspberry, rose petals, and subtle spice lead to a silky palate with refined tannins, vibrant minerality, and exceptional length, promising graceful aging. 

Food Pairing: Pair with roast duck, veal tenderloin, herb-crusted lamb, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté for an elegant Burgundy pairing.

red-truck-beer-classic-lager-15-can.title: Red Truck Classic Lager Tall Can 473Ml

red-truck-pick-up-pack-12can-mixerf2021.title: Red Truck Pick Up Pack 12 Cans

veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-rose-89.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut Rose 1989 1.5L Magnum
veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-rose-89.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Cave Privée Brut Rosé 1989 is a rare, mature prestige Champagne crafted predominantly from Grand and Premier Cru vineyards in the Montagne de Reims, Grande Vallée de la Marne, and Côte des Blancs. Aged for over two decades in the house's historic chalk cellars, it displays a copper-gold hue with pale salmon undertones. The nose opens with aromas of dried apricots, candied orange peel, saffron, roasted nuts, and warm brioche. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, velvety texture balanced by fine-grained minerality and vibrant acidity, leading to a complex, long finish with notes of dried red berries, spice, and toasted almonds.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom risotto, grilled lobster, or aged Comté cheese.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This very pale rosé has the richness of toast and croissant that comes from complete maturity. It also features fresh hints of the red and white fruits that were present during the wine's younger years. This is ready to drink now.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich and creamy, this is aging gracefully. The finely tuned acidity and lightly beaded texture provide an elegant frame for the layers of coffee liqueur, toasted almond, cherry bonbon, iodine and orange peel flavors. The long finish is tinged subtly with smoky mineral. Disgorged October 2008.

veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-rose-78.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut Rose 1978
veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-rose-78.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Cave Privée Brut Rosé 1978 is a magnificent, highly aged prestige Champagne crafted from exceptional Grand and Premier Cru vineyards across the Montagne de Reims and the Côte des Blancs. Having rested for decades in the house's historic chalk cellars before release, this fully evolved rosé exhibits a mesmerizing amber-copper hue with extremely delicate, fine effervescence. The bouquet offers deeply complex tertiary notes of dried cherries, fig paste, orange marmalade, toasted walnuts, truffles, and warm brioche. On the palate, it delivers remarkable depth and a silky, vinous texture with refined acidity and a long, savory mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast, pan-seared venison, wild mushroom risotto, roasted pigeon, or aged Comté cheese.

veuve-clicquot-la-grande-dame-1990.title: Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame 1990 1.5L Magnum
veuve-clicquot-la-grande-dame-1990.bodyHtml:
A rare and historic year, 1990 is celebrated for its exceptional amount of radiant sunshine. Nearly 2,100 hours of light shined down upon the vines, setting a 30-year record. Over the course of a seemingly endless summer, the warming rays gently but steadily intensified the grapes’ colors and aromas until peak maturity. The enveloping sunshine bestowed on its champagne vintage the unique and special qualities that have made it the magnificent creation it is today. 

La Grande Dame 1990’s signature blend draws traditionally on the eight Grands Crus, which are among the most prestigious in Champagne. It is dominated by Pinot Noir, with nearly 61%. These grapes come from Aÿ, in the Grande Vallée de la Marne, and Verzenay, Verzy, Ambonnay and Bouzy in the Montagne de Reims. The Chardonnay portion of 39% was harvested from the vines in the Grands Crus of Avize, Oger and Mesnil-sur-Oger in the Côte des Blancs.

 

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

I highly recommend the Veuve Clicquot 1990 La Grande Dame. It is exquisitely rich and accessible, yet bursting with potential.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Tight and straightforward, but quite complex. Licorice and lime grace the linear palate. A lot of intense but soft fruit in the mouth. An immensely clear, forward and stately Champagne. One of those “big name” status bubblies that does what it takes to deserve its praise.

veuve-clicquot-cave-privee-rose-1990-pcm.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut Rose 1990
veuve-clicquot-cave-privee-rose-1990-pcm.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Cave Privée Brut Rosé 1990 is a mature, rare vintage Champagne crafted from exceptional Grand and Premier Cru vineyards across the Montagne de Reims, Grande Vallée de la Marne, and Côte des Blancs. Having rested for decades in the historic chalk cellars of Reims before release, this fully evolved rosé displays an intense copper-gold hue with extremely fine, delicate effervescence. The complex nose opens with tertiary aromas of dried red fruit, orange marmalade, dried figs, roasted hazelnut, and warm brioche, accompanied by subtle nuances of truffles, saffron, and sweet spice. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, silky texture with remarkable depth, harmoniously balanced acidity, and a long, savory mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs delightfully with roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom risotto, grilled lobster, or well-aged Comté cheese.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

An ethereal rosé, still fresh and persistent, with rich flavors of briny oyster shell, cognac and dried strawberry, accented by hints of exotic ground spice. Soft and creamy on the palate, presenting a fine, subtle bead that leads to a lightly smoked finish. Drink now through 2024.

wild-turkey-masters-keep-unforgotten.title: Wild Turkey Master's Keep 2022 Unforgotten
wild-turkey-masters-keep-unforgotten.bodyHtml:
Wild Turkey Master's Keep Unforgotten is a blend of 13 year old Kentucky straight bourbon with 8 and 9 year old straight rye whiskeys, given a second period of maturation in rye casks. The idea of marrying Wild Turkey's bourbon and rye dates to 2010, when a crew member accidentally mixed a batch of young rye into a barrel of mature bourbon. Master Distiller Eddie Russell revisited that happy accident with older stocks and finished the blend in the pre-Prohibition Rickhouse B, the favourite warehouse of his father, Jimmy Russell. It is bottled at 105 proof (52.5% ABV) in a 750ml decanter presented in a gift box.

Tasting Notes: Caramel, sweet oak, dried fruit and honey.

Nose: Fruit-forward, with caramel and oak.

Palate: Caramel and sweet oak with dried fruit and honey.

Finish: Black pepper and warm baking spices.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

black-angus-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Black Angus Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
black-angus-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Black Angus Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 is the flagship, single-vineyard release from the Aberdeen Wine Company, crafted to showcase the premier terroir of Heathcote. Sourced exclusively from the Colbinabbin Vineyard, this powerful expression of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep, dense purple-red color in the glass. The aromatic bouquet is wonderfully complex and inviting, opening with vibrant notes of blackcurrant, black cherry, and dark plum, gracefully layered with signature regional nuances of eucalyptus, cedarwood, black tea, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is richly concentrated and full-bodied, delivering a generous core of dark berry fruit and subtle dark chocolate that is impeccably structured by firm, well-resolved tannins and a balancing acidity, culminating in an elegant, savory, and remarkably long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with premium cuts of prime beef, thick-cut grilled ribeye steaks, roasted leg of lamb, hearty venison stews, and mature cheddar cheeses.

julienas-domaine-de-la-conseillere.title: Chateau Fuisse Julienas Domaine de la Conseillere 2022
julienas-domaine-de-la-conseillere.bodyHtml:
Château-Fuissé Juliénas Domaine de la Conseillere 2022 is an elegant, expressive, and beautifully structured French red wine that brilliantly captures a "Burgundian" approach to the Gamay grape. While Château-Fuissé is legendary for its white Pouilly-Fuissé landmarks, the Vincent family has expertly managed this prized Juliénas estate since 2009. Sourced from south-facing, well-drained hillsides rich in granite, sand, and clay, it pours a vibrant ruby-red color in the glass. The nose is highly refined, offering a delicate floral bouquet layered with aromas of red currants, fresh cherries, and black tea, underpinned by a distinct mineral line and a hint of white pepper. On the palate, this medium-bodied selection is fleshy and structured, balancing a ripe core of dark red fruits with a stimulating, racy acidity. Partial vinification in oak barrels lends a subtle, velvety weight to the wine, integrating soft, compact tannins that carry through to a long, harmonious finish accented by licorice and savory spice.

Food Pairing: This sophisticated and versatile Beaujolais Cru pairs beautifully with roasted poultry, duck breast with cherry reduction, cold charcuterie boards, pork chops with sage, wild mushroom pasta, or mild semi-firm cheeses like Comté.

mollydooker-carnival-of-love-shiraz-1.title: Mollydooker Carnival Of Love Shiraz 2023
mollydooker-carnival-of-love-shiraz-1.bodyHtml: The 2023 Carnival of Love Shiraz is a vibrant and expressive wine. It starts with raspberry and cherry scents, with a touch of aniseed spice. The taste is filled with rich red fruit, hints of coffee, coconut, and deeper plum flavors. Chocolate and spice add extra dimensions to this McLaren Vale Shiraz, making it a delightful wine to celebrate.

martini-rossi-prosecco.title: Martini & Rossi Prosecco 750ml
martini-rossi-prosecco.bodyHtml: Martini & Rossi Prosecco Sparkling Wine is a dry, aromatic Italian sparkling wine made from the Glera grapes that grow in the lush, sun-drenched foothills of the Veneto and Friuli regions of north-eastern Italy. Ripened in this ideal climate, they give this Prosecco wine a stimulating fragrance.

gallo-family-vineyards-sweet-apple.title: Gallo Family Vineyards White Zinfandel
gallo-family-vineyards-sweet-apple.bodyHtml: The Gallo Family Vineyards White Zinfandel is a widely popular, fruit-forward rosé wine from California, known for its light body and approachable, medium-sweet style. It typically features vibrant aromas of strawberry, raspberry, and watermelon, making it a versatile choice for casual dining and warm-weather gatherings.

josh-cellars-pinot-grigio.title: Josh Cellars Pinot Grigio 2023
josh-cellars-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Josh Cellars Pinot Grigio is a bright and refreshing California white wine crafted in an Italian-inspired style that emphasizes crispness and stone fruit character. Sourced from premium vineyards across the state, this vintage captures a "crystalline precision" by balancing zesty citrus notes with a subtle, juicy sweetness. The wine is characterized by its pale straw colour and an expressive aromatic profile of fresh pear, melon, and green apple, accented by delicate floral notes and a touch of lemon zest. On the palate, it is light-to-medium-bodied with a clean, vibrant acidity and a smooth, thirst-quenching finish, making it an ideal choice for warm-weather sipping or as a versatile aperitif.

lunae-vermentino-etichetta-nera.title: Lvnae Colli Di Luni Vermentino (Etichetta Nera/Black Label) 2022 750ml
lunae-vermentino-etichetta-nera.bodyHtml:
Cantine Lunae Vermentino Colli di Luni Etichetta Nera is a prestigious Italian white wine with a rich history dating back to ancient times. Made from the Vermentino grape variety grown in the picturesque Colli di Luni region, this wine boasts a golden yellow color and a complex bouquet of ripe fruits, citrus, and floral notes. On the palate, it is full-bodied with a perfect balance of acidity, minerals, and a lingering finish. This wine is aged in stainless steel tanks to preserve its purity and freshness. Cantine Lunae Vermentino Colli di Luni Etichetta Nera is a true expression of the terroir and craftsmanship of this renowned winery.

Straw yellow colour. The nose opens with hints of ripe fruit with yellow flesh, in particular apricot and peach. The fruit is embellished with notes of acacia flowers and Mediterranean scrub and accompanied by briny and balsamic notes. In the mouth the vertical and vibrant freshness and sapidity balance the large and rounded body, with good alcohol content. The long and persistent finish has notes of almond and recalls the pleasant notes of ripe fruit.

95 Points - Decanter

Lemon curd, saline and nutty nose. Concentrated white peach, sage and apricot on the palate. Lovely, long, saline finish.

fling-cucumber-mint-vodka-soda.title: Fling Cucumber Mint Vodka Soda 6 Cans

red-truck-golden-hour-cranberry-ale.title: Red Truck West Coast Pale Ale

st-germain-elderflower.title: St Germain Elderflower Liqueur
st-germain-elderflower.bodyHtml: The regal bottle is a reflection of the fine artisanal French liqueur held within. Made with fresh hand-picked elderflower blossoms, without the use of preservatives. The aromas are fruit driven with floral hints. On the palate expect tropical fruit, citrus, pear and a hint of honeysuckle sweetness.

screaming-toller-peaky-hikers-vienna-lag.title: Screaming Toller Peaky Hikers Vienna Lag 4 Tall Cans
screaming-toller-peaky-hikers-vienna-lag.bodyHtml: Screaming Toller Peaky Hikers Vienna Lag 4 Tall Cans

takara-sho-chiku-bai.title: Sho Chiku Bai Classic Junmai Sake 750ml
takara-sho-chiku-bai.bodyHtml:
Do you crave an oaky Chardonnay at the end of the day? Or is a velvety Merlot more your style? You can get the flavor of both when you purchase our award-winning Sho Chiku Bai Classic Junmai. When you serve it warm or at room temperature, the flavor changes, giving you the best of two worlds. You don't have to choose between flavors tonight — just pull out a bottle of classic Junmai sake, and work your way from one flavor profile to the next over a lingering meal. With a savory complex taste, it is the best sake for food-pairing sake and great served both chilled or warmed.

Served chilled this Classic Junmai Sake offers a very fine texture with harmonious aromas and flavors of macadamia nuts, Chai spice (cardamom, nutmeg), vanilla, heavy cream, and freshly sliced bread.

Served at room temperature, notes of mineral, creme fraiche, sourdough bread, custard, umami, and apples emerge.

When warmed to around 100º F., the texture and flavor build, bringing out more intense umami while still retaining softness of texture. Savory elements of salted custard, cocoa nib, banana bread, toasted nuts, and mineral are evident.

quinta-do-crasto-douro-reserva.title: Quinta do Crasto Douro Reserva Old Vines Red 2021
quinta-do-crasto-douro-reserva.bodyHtml:
Deep dark ruby in color. The nose impresses for its depth and complexity, showing aromas of ripe red fruits in perfect harmony with notes the wood forest and hints of fresh gum cistus. The palate starts in an elegant way, evolving into solid, structured wine, with velvet-textured tannins. Engaging, with a balanced, fresh, and persistent finish. This is a wine with an extraordinary complexity that fully reflects the essence of the old vines of Quinta do Crasto.

Excellent wine for hearty meals with red grilled or roast meat, lamb and game dishes

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

One of the icons of the modern Douro reds, from 42 plots of old vines on the beautiful Quinta do Crasto property (three plots didn't make it to the final blend in 2021), the 2021 Reserva Old Vines (or Vinhas Velhas) comes from different plots averaging 70 years of age. It has the perfumed, outgoing and exuberant nose it has always had, floral, spicy and showy, smoky and nuanced. The destemmed grapes fermented with indigenous yeasts in stainless steel, and the wine matured for 18 months in oak barrels, 85% French and 15% American. The palate is medium to full-bodied with superb balance and very fine tannins. It still shows very good value for money. It has 14% alcohol with a pH of 3..66 and 5.2 grams of acidity. It's approachable but with aging potential. 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Black plum, mint and dense wood aromas are the result of oak aging and concentrated fruit from 70-year-old vines. The Crasto vineyard is rich in mixed plantings and this wine shows the resulting complexity alongside the fruits.

sheringham-seaside-gin.title: Sheringham Distillery Seaside Gin
sheringham-seaside-gin.bodyHtml: Inspired by the Vancouver Island coast, with its clean surf and appealing fragrance of wild roses, evergreen forests, and ocean air, our flagship spirit has a deliciously complex yet impeccably balanced botanical profile. Made from botanicals such as juniper, rose, lavender, citrus, coriander, cardamom, and—most notably—local, sustainably harvested winged kelp, which gives it a subtle taste of the ocean, Seaside Gin is an elegant choice on its own and a winning ingredient in your favorite cocktail.

field-forge-light-golden-ale-6can.title: Field & Forge Light Golden Ale 6Can 6 Cans

bodegas-viyuela-seleccion.title: Bodegas Muga Reserva 2022
bodegas-viyuela-seleccion.bodyHtml:
Bodegas Muga Reserva 2022 is an exceptionally elegant, structured, and deeply expressive Spanish red wine crafted by the historic Muga family in Haro, the heart of Rioja Alta. Sourced from estate vineyards planted on clay-limestone soils sheltered by the Obarenes Mountains, this vintage showcases a warm and early-ripening growing season that yielded immense aromatic intensity and pristine fruit character. The grapes are harvested by hand and fermented using indigenous yeasts in large wooden vats. True to the bodega's artisanal heritage, the wine is matured for up to 24 months in oak casks handcrafted in their own on-site cooperage, utilizing a combination of 80% to 90% French and 10% to 20% American oak, followed by traditional fining with fresh egg whites and extensive bottle aging. In the glass, it displays a bright ruby-red color with medium-deep intensity and a subtle garnet-tinged rim. The highly expressive and complex nose unrolls a magnificent bouquet of ripe forest fruits, wild blackberries, blueberries, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with notes of black licorice, toasted coffee beans, sweet vanilla, and delicate reminders of forest floor and savory spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red is concentrated yet sleek and polished, driving a juicy core of succulent dark berry fruits, chocolate, and baking spices. It perfectly balances its rich mid-palate depth with a vibrant, mouthwatering line of integrated acidity and a powerful frame of firm, silky, and fine-grained tannins that carry into a long, harmonious, and slightly chewy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled prime ribeye steaks, slow-cooked beef stews, roasted lamb shanks, cured Iberian ham, and mature hard cheeses like aged Manchego.

93 Points - James Suckling

Chocolate, dark fruit and spices with pinecone. Medium- to full-bodied, succulent, with polished tannins, length and definition on the finish. This comes from various plots planted within a radius of 25 km from the winery. A blend of tempranillo, garnacha, mazuelo and graciano. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Reserva, sold as Crianza in Spain, has more tertiary notes than other people's Gran Reserva, even though it has a very classical profile. It is mostly Tempranillo with some Garnacha Tinta, Mazuelo and Graciano from vineyards no more than 25 kilometers from the winery in Haro, cropped from a warm and dry year. Here, what they did was wait; it rained a little, the plants unblocked and they had the patience to wait for the grapes to ripen fully. So, the grapes were in a very healthy state, and winemaker Isaac Muga likes to ferment the grapes destemmed and lightly crushed in oak vats with indigenous yeasts and then mature the wine in 90% French and 10% American oak barrels for 22 months, with racking every eight to nine months. It has good ripeness, 14% alcohol, a pH of 3.59 and 5.45 grams of acidity, and it's medium- to full bodied, concentrated but sleek and polished, with fine-grained tannins, very supple flavors and a chalky finish. It still has some toasty notes in the finish that should integrate with a little bit more time. 945,000 bottles produced. It was bottled in January 2025. They are very happy with 2022, and they even produced Prado Enea and a tiny quantity of Aro.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A sleek red, with flavors of black cherry and cured tobacco, plus accents of anise, smoked paprika and espresso, all trimmed nicely by refined, chalky tannins. This is enjoyable today but shows the stuffing for cellaring. Tempranillo and Garnacha. Drink now through 2040. 82,000 cases made, 15,000 cases imported.

staglin-rutherford-napa-cabernet-sauvign.title: Rutherford Hill Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
staglin-rutherford-napa-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:
Rutherford Hill Cabernet Sauvignon is an outstanding example of the bold personality and unbridled flavour characteristics of a Napa Valley Cabernet.

Pair with steak, burgers, bison, lamb, mushroom dishes & eggplant.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of dark and purple fruits, spices, cedar, tobacco leaves and licorice. The full-bodied palate has firmly framed tannins and balanced acidity that lead to a savory, rustic finish. Plenty to like. Drink or hold.

clase-azul-dia-de-muertos.title: Clase Azul Día de Muertos Música Limited Edition 2024 Añejo Tequila 1L
clase-azul-dia-de-muertos.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Tequila Día de Muertos Limited Edition Música captures the vibrant and mystical atmosphere of this tradition’s music to share it with the entire world.

This is the fourth installment of Nuestros Recuerdos, an annual series of five limited-edition creations dedicated to the most exquisite aspects of Día de Muertos.

Tequila
For this limited edition, our Master Distiller has crafted an exquisite, 26-month añejo tequila, aged in American whiskey casks and finished in casks of Scotch whisky.
Decanter
The decanter for this limited edition, with its deep plum color, embodies the soft and calming cadence of Día de Muertos melodies.

On the back of the base, an illustration in golden and lilac hues depicts an eclectic musical ensemble parading to the sound of traditional instruments, reflecting the diverse musical traditions of this festivity.
Ornament
