This is borderline rambunctious, but it's bridled well enough, and when the fruit and wood sides mesh fully, this will be a rock star. Best from 2025 through 2040.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

As so often with this estate, this is a generous, opulent wine. This year a strong tannic element gives the wine a good structure. Smoky, textured and powerful, it needs many years to mature. Do not drink this wine before 2026.

chateau-la-mission-haut-brion-2014.title: Chateau La Mission Haut Brion 2014
chateau-la-mission-haut-brion-2014.bodyHtml:
Chateau La Mission Haut Brion is one of Bordeaux's greatest wines, revered for its extraordinary power, elegance, and longevity. Aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, graphite, cedar, cigar box, violet, and exotic spice unfold into a concentrated palate with velvety tannins, exceptional depth, and a remarkably persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, or aged Comte for an unforgettable Bordeaux experience.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

The typicity of La Mission is really here. Aromas of iodine, oyster shell, currants and orange peel are evident. Full-bodied, tight and tannic with a muscular and toned texture that holds the wine down at the moment, but it’s waiting to release its joy and true nature. Fine-grained. Give it until 2023.

95 Points - Decanter

Medium-bodied, fresh attack, dominated by late summer fruits, suggesting perfectly but not overly ripe fruit with great integrity. A floating, gossamer quality to the structure, the tannins are deceptively fine, yet they hold the wine together very tightly. You feel it on the finish, where blackberry and raspberry fruits are kept firmly in check. A lovely wine with medium- to long-term potential and great capacity to provide pleasure.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2014 Château La Mission Haut-Brion is slightly more elegant and pretty compared to the richer, slightly more masculine Haut-Brion. A blend of 54% Merlot, 45% Cabernet Sauvignon and a splash of Cabernet Franc, it shows a kiss of red fruits in its core of darker currants, smoked tobacco, scorched earth, vanilla bean and spice-driven aromas and flavors. With medium- to full-bodied richness, impeccable balance, fine tannins and a great finish, it’s a downright classy La Mission that will benefit from 4–5 years of bottle age and keep for 20+ years.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2014 Château La Mission Haut-Brion is a blend of 54% Merlot, 1% Cabernet Franc and 45% Cabernet Sauvignon, picked between September 15 and October 8 and raised in 55% new oak. It has retained that engagingly fresh and vibrant bouquet, the bashful nature that it showed in barrel replaced by a more outgoing personality. This is an exquisite bouquet with pure black fruit, cold stone, a touch of black olive and later a suggestion of boysenberry preserve. The palate is still structured and, considering that a majority is Merlot, quite masculine. There remains some new oak to be fully assimilated, although there is clearly the fruit to soak that up. It comes more alive on the second half with a lovely spiciness and impressive persistence. It will have more to give down the line, and the strictness implies that this La Mission Haut-Brion should be afforded a decade in the cellar before it will show what it can do.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Richly endowed, the wine is beautifully concentrated. Still young, it has considerable potential with its rich fruits and firm tannins. There is a strongly juicy aftertaste that brings in the freshness of the year. The wine will age well and should not be drunk before 2026.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Fleshy and very compact, with layers of dark fig, black currant paste and blackberry reduction still sorting themselves out. Sports a serious spine of tar while a well-roasted apple wood element forms the backdrop on the dense finish. The range and density set this apart. Should be rather long-lived for the vintage. Best from 2020 through 2030.

valdicava-madonna-del-piano-docg-2013.title: Valdicava Madonna del Piano Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2013 1.5L Magnum
valdicava-madonna-del-piano-docg-2013.bodyHtml:
Valdicava Madonna del Piano Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2013 is a monumental single-vineyard Tuscan masterpiece that captures the exceptional structural focus of a classic, long-aging vintage. This deep ruby-red wine displays a highly sophisticated and layered bouquet, unfolding with intense aromas of ripe black cherries, wild berries, and red rose potpourri, seamlessly complexed by savory notes of truffles, new leather, tobacco, and exotic cedar spices. On the palate, it is powerfully built and medium-to-full-bodied, showing an incredibly sturdy core of concentrated plum and dark stone fruits balanced by vibrant, elegant acidity. Broad, firm, yet beautifully polished tannins provide a majestic structure, carrying the fruit into a remarkably long, savory, and minerally persistent finish.

Food Pairing: This highly structured, robust Tuscan reserve pairs magnificently with slow-braised wild boar ragù, grilled prime ribeye steak, or roasted rack of lamb.

98 Points - James Suckling

This opens with savory, truffle and meaty aromas with a complex and quite cryptic nose that delivers a wealth of ripe plums and cherries, cedar and fresh, violet-like flowers, as well as some earthy nuances. The palate has a very sturdy, intense and power-charged core of rich plums and dark cherries, framed in quite fierce tannins that are so long. Super Brunello Riserva here with great potential. Try from 2022.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Showing ripe and balanced fruit, the Valdicava 2013 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Madonna del Piano (with 15,666 bottles produced) offers many very positive attributes. The wine flaunts a slightly contemporary or international side, and it does so with extreme confidence and elegance. Much of that natural balance comes directly from the classic vintage that exhibits both the structure and acidity necessary for prolonged cellar aging. Now, in the wine's youngest phase, it offers lush primary cherry and blackberry flavors followed carefully by measured spice, toast and red rose potpourri.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Earthy aromas of wild berry, new leather, truffle and exotic spice emerge from the glass. The concentrated, vibrant palate delivers dried black cherry, licorice, tobacco and black pepper alongside fine-grained tannins. Drink 2022–2029.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe, offering cherry, plum and floral aromas and flavors, matched to a rich texture. Tobacco and iron notes emerge as this builds to a lengthy finish. A touch dry on the finish, but the sweet fruit returns in the end. Best from 2022 through 2038.

dunn-howell-mountain-cabernet-sauvingnon.title: Dunn Vineyards Howell Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
dunn-howell-mountain-cabernet-sauvingnon.bodyHtml:
Dunn Howell Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a powerful, age-worthy Napa Valley mountain Cabernet known for its structure, intensity, and restrained elegance despite its concentration. It typically shows deep blackberry, cassis, black cherry, and plum layered with graphite, crushed rock, tobacco leaf, and subtle cedar spice. The palate is full-bodied with firm, mountain-grown tannins, vibrant acidity, and a long, structured finish built for extended aging.

Food pairing: grilled ribeye, dry-aged steak, lamb chops, venison, braised short ribs, mushroom-based dishes, and aged hard cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano or Pecorino.

98 Points - James Suckling

This minerally, earthy wine is highly impressive, with aromas of black and red currants, wet stones, bay laurel, bitter chocolate, dried flowers and walnuts. The palate is seamlessly balanced, showing depth of fruit, melting tannins and a silken, rounded mouthfeel that has no hard edges. Firm, mouthwatering finish. This is drinking very well now, but can age for decades. Drink or hold.
97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Dunn's 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain is the first vintage in a while that didn't get 100% new French oak—it's just 84%. Subtle, cedary oak frames bold cherry and blueberry fruit on the nose of this medium- to full-bodied wine. It's bigger-feeling than the Napa bottling, despite being lower in alcohol (13.9%). Round but structured, firm but silky, with undertones of crushed stone and pencil shavings on the lingering finish, it's a particularly strong effort.

pym-rae-napa-valley.title: Pym-Rae The Twins Red Blend
pym-rae-napa-valley.bodyHtml:
Pym-Rae The Twins is a refined and expressive Napa Valley red blend crafted with precision and elegance. Aromas of black cherry, cassis, violet, and graphite are layered with hints of cocoa, spice, and subtle oak. The palate is rich and structured, offering concentrated dark fruit, silky tannins, and balanced acidity. It finishes long, polished, and complex with excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Filet mignon, lamb chops, braised short ribs, duck, and aged cheeses.

banded-peak-microburst-hazy-ipa.title: Banded Peak Microburst Hazy Ipa 59L Keg

opus-one-2020.title: Opus One Overture 2022
opus-one-2020.bodyHtml: Overture 2022 captivates you from the start. Its aromatic profile weaves a complex tapestry of bright cherry, fresh forest berries, and cut rose stems interwoven with delicate scents of violets, toasted almond, and anise. Blackberry, blueberry, and wild cherry take the lead on the palate with a lively acidity that adds a vibrant edge. The finish is long and rounded, with a touch of mocha and black tea that showcase the wine’s depth. This expression of selected parcels from our estate vineyards will age gracefully for years to come.

long-dai-2018.title: Cune Gran Reserva 2018
long-dai-2018.bodyHtml:
Garnet color with reddish notes. In terms of aroma, there is a great balance between the ripe black fruit and the aromas from its time in the barrel, such as vanilla, toffee, tobacco leaves, etc. On the palate it shows a smoothness and gentleness that gives us a length with an aftertaste of balsamic and fruity notes. It is a round wine, with a pleasant tannin that allows us a very versatile pairing due to its balance.

Recommended with all Mediterranean dishes.

Blend: 85% Tempranillo, 10% Graciano, 5% Mazuelo


94 Points - James Suckling

Spices, chocolate, vanilla and lots of vibrant, youthful plums, cherries and berries. A medium-bodied, very approachable Rioja with juicy fruit and fine tannins that make you want to drink a bottle. Such a pleasing, well-made and youthful gran reserva, Drink now or hold.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2018 Cune Gran Reserva was produced with grapes picked between the 8th and 26th of October, quite late into the season, reflecting a cooler year with frost and snow and a mild summer. The vegetative cycle was long, 180 days, and the final blend was 85% Tempranillo, 10% Graciano and 5% Mazuelo or Cariñena, mostly from their 70 hectares in Torremontalbo. The grapes fermented with indigenous yeasts in stainless steel and concrete after a 24-hour cold soak, and the wine matured in French and American oak barrels for 24 months. They bottled the wine with 14% alcohol, a pH of 3.6 and 5.76 grams of acidity. It has spicy notes from the oak, vanilla and coconut, and is aromatic and expressive, clean, with a classic Gran Reserve profile.
90 Points - Wine Spectator
A savory red, leading with smoke and espresso notes before a plushly textured mix of black cherry, Kalamata olive and black tea pushes through. Sinewy tannins firm the fresh, spiced finish. Tempranillo, Graciano and Mazuelo.

ramos-pinto-vinces.title: Ramos Pinto Adriano White Reserva
ramos-pinto-vinces.bodyHtml:
Ramos Pinto Adriano White Reserva is an elegant Portuguese White Port from the Douro Valley, aged in oak barrels to develop exceptional complexity. Aromas of tropical fruit, crystallized orange peel, honey, balsamic notes, and warm spices lead to a rich yet balanced palate with vibrant freshness and a long, refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with foie gras, roasted nuts, soft cheeses, fruit-based desserts, pastries, and served chilled as an aperitif.

chateau-haut-brion-grand-cru-2008.title: Chateau Haut-Brion 2019 750ml
chateau-haut-brion-grand-cru-2008.bodyHtml:
The wine is a superb, deep purple-red color. The first nose is at once intense and subtle. It has a ripe fruitiness, and swirling brings out its aromatic complexity.The first expression is incredibly smooth and delicate,expanding and filling the palate without ever “flexing its muscles”. The tannins are precise but not aggressive, and subtly enchanting. The finish is long and fragrant. Once again, Haut-Brion surprises for its ability to enhance the complementarity of Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon.

This Haut-Brion 2019 vintage is one of the most successful vintages produced after a hot and dry summer. This fine wine has the structure of a 2005, with the freshness of a 2010. A modern, richer version of the 1990 vintage.

100 Points - James Suckling

The is very refined and elegant with a fine-tannined line running through the center of the palate. It’s very intense and precise. Full-bodied with great, tight fruit. This is subtle and complex, then it opens on the palate and shows incredible depth and intensity. Great length, going on and on for minutes.
Barrel Sample: 99-100

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Haut-Brion is a blend of 48.7% Merlot, 43.2% Cabernet Sauvignon and 8.1% Cabernet Franc, harvested from the 10th of September to the 3rd of October. The estimated label alcohol degree is 14.5%. Displaying a deep garnet-purple color, it comes off incredibly shy and reticent to begin, needing considerable coaxing to reveal notes of dark chocolate-covered cherries, blackberry preserves, woodsmoke and sandalwood, before launching into a full-scale fireworks display of iron ore, cumin seed, redcurrant jelly, red roses, oolong tea and Sichuan pepper scents plus a waft of cardamom. The medium to full-bodied palate delivers the most exquisitely ripe, finely grained tannins with a lively backbone of freshness supporting the tightly wound, earth-laced black fruit layers, finishing very long and minerally. This is one of the most finely structured, tightly knit wines of the vintage. Given time, I wouldn't be at all surprised if it goes atomic and eventually takes top place for the vintage.
Barrel Sample: 97-99+

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The Grand Vin 2019 Château Haut-Brion checks in as a classic blend of 49% Merlot, 43% Cabernet Sauvignon and the rest Cabernet Franc. Its deep purple hue is followed by a stunning bouquet of ripe black cherry and currant-like fruit as well as classic Graves cold fireplace, burning embers, tobacco, and cedar pencil. More regal, firm, and classically structured on the palate, this full-bodied beauty has a deep, concentrated mid-palate, building tannins, background oak, and a great, great finish. It's very much in the focused, elegant, yet still concentrated and powerful style of the vintage. It will need a solid decade of cellaring, but it’s a brilliant wine. Best after 2032. Rating: 98+

97 Points - Decanter
Powerful and confident, there is no mistaking this concentration of ripe damson and black cherry fruits, set against coffee, earth, sage and black chocolate. Tons of tannins on display but extremely fine, to the point that you almost don't notice them, then once the wine has left your mouth you suddenly realise how many there are, and how they are still exerting a pressure. Great persistency, slowing everything down and asking you to stop and think. Clear ageing ability here. Harvest September 10 to October 3.
Barrel Sample: 97

chateau-latour-2006.title: Chateau Latour 2016
chateau-latour-2006.bodyHtml:
Chateau Latour is one of Bordeaux's most legendary First Growth estates, revered for its extraordinary concentration, structure, and unparalleled longevity. Aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, graphite, cedar, cigar box, violet, and fine spice unfold into a powerful palate with refined tannins, remarkable depth, and an exceptionally persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, or aged Comte for an unforgettable First Growth Bordeaux experience.

 

100 Points - Decanter

The 2016 blend is 92.9% Cabernet Sauvignon and 7.1% Merlot, with an IPT of 83. It represents just 36% of the overall production. At this stage, you are almost as aware of how much is being held back as how much is being revealed. The power in reserve is thrilling, even more so because although there is a lightness and florality running through the palate, it sacrifices none of Latour's signature character. This is more 2005 than 2010 in expression, a beautiful wine with the length and texture of the great vintages, lifted by exceptional salinity on the finish. Fine, refined tannins, crushed tobacco and mint leaves create a momentum that is unmistakable and even more "Latour" than the 2015 was at this stage. Hélène Génin is the winemaker and Vincent Masson (son of Pierre Masson) is the estate's biodynamic consultant. This vintage is 50% biodynamic for the Grand Vin (entirely organic), with the estate moving to 100% biodynamic from 2017 onward. My guess is that we should expect to wait around eight years before this wine reaches the market.

100 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Retasting the 2016 Château Latour alongside both the 2010 and 2022 made me feel like a kid in a candy store. Needing plenty of air to show at its best, its deep purple hue is followed by quintessential Latour aromas of smoky black currants, scorched earth, graphite and freshly sharpened lead pencil. These carry through to a medium- to full-bodied Pauillac with lively acidity, a pure, seamless and layered mouthfeel, building yet perfectly ripe tannins, and that rare Latour combination of power, austerity and elegance that makes this château so compelling. Produced from just 36% of the estate's total production, the 2016 is composed of 92.9% Cabernet Sauvignon and 7.1% Merlot, reaching 13.5% alcohol with an IPT of 83. While still primarily an academic wine at this stage, it is beginning to turn the corner and already offers pleasure thanks to its remarkable fruit and balance. Give it another 5–7 years before opening and expect a lifespan of 75–100 years.

100 Points - James Suckling

I am dreaming as I smell this wine—perfectly ripe Cabernet Sauvignon with currants, tobacco, fresh mint and orange blossoms. The bouquet is incredibly complex. Medium- to full-bodied, with perfectly integrated tannins that you hardly feel but know are there, lifting the wine to another level. It is already remarkably drinkable because of its stellar balance, yet the underlying tannic tension provides tremendous energy and a seamless texture. A benchmark Latour that reminds me of the legendary 1982 in many ways.

100 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Reaching for perfection, this Château Latour possesses immense structure and power. Almost entirely Cabernet Sauvignon, it is a monumental wine packed with tannins, rich black fruits and a solid core that will allow it to age for decades. Bright acidity and crisp black currant flavors on the finish ensure the fruit will become even more expressive as it matures. Superb.

valdicava-madonna-del-piano-docg-2015.title: Valdicava Madonna del Piano Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016 1.5L Magnum
valdicava-madonna-del-piano-docg-2015.bodyHtml:
Valdicava Madonna del Piano Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016 is a monumental and classic expression of single-vineyard Brunello from one of Montalcino's most legendary and structured vintages. This deep ruby-red wine reveals a highly sophisticated, complex, and perfumed bouquet filled with fresh violets, lavender, black cherry, and cassis, seamlessly layered with sweet sandalwood, damp earth, sage, and a touch of fresh leather. On the palate, it is full-bodied and impeccably balanced, displaying deep inner power and focused, ultra-fine, velvety tannins that glide with amazing fresh acidity into an incredibly persistent, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with slow-braised wild boar ragù, thick-cut charcoal-grilled Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted leg of lamb, or mature aged Pecorino Toscano.

99 Points - James Suckling

This is heavenly on the nose with fresh flowers such as violet and cherries with undertones of freshly shaved sandalwood. It’s full-bodied with very fine tannins that are focused and intense with a polished nature. This is a complete wine that impresses at every level. Give it at least five to six years to come together and resolve the tannin structure. Better after 2027.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

Expressive yet complex, this red is already revealing tertiary hints of truffle, fading roses and spice. Features cherry, raspberry, iron, eucalyptus and anise flavors allied to a firm, compact structure. Balanced and long, with fresh fruit, spice and mineral accents lingering on the endless finish.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Valdicava 2016 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Madonna del Piano impresses for its intensity, its balance and its freshness. The wine is medium to full-bodied with a good amount of fruit weight and power that is offset by acidity and the lifted, vibrant quality of the bouquet. If balance is the objective, this wine meets it goals, although like with many of its peers, you certainly won't miss the deep inner power of this determined Brunello.

chateau-cheval-blanc-2014.title: Chateau De Fieuzal Blanc 2014 750ml
chateau-cheval-blanc-2014.bodyHtml:
94 Points-Wine Enthusiast "This is a beautiful tropical fruit and spice-flavored wine. It has an exotic, ripe feel to it that is already attractive. The tight, mineral texture promises good aging."

93 Points-Robert Parker's Wine Advocate "The Chateau de Fieuzal Blanc 2014 has an attractive nose: lime mixed with citrus fruit and touches of grilled walnut coming through with aeration. The palate is quite shrill on the entry with attacking lime and citrus scents. The acidity is quite strong here, but there is plenty of fruit and a lovely sense of tension on the finish. This is an excellent Pessac-Leognan from this rejuvenated estate. Range: 91-93"

93 Points-James Suckling "A dry white with lots of mineral and white-pepper character as well as lightly cooked apples and lemons. Full-bodied, yet this remains agile and lively. Intense finish. Layered and structured. Little oily. Drink now or hold."

dalmore-rare-fine-45-year-old.title: The Dalmore 12 Year Old
dalmore-rare-fine-45-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore 12 Year Old is a benchmark Highland single malt Scotch whisky recognized for its rich, complex, and deeply sherried character. The spirit is masterfully guided through an intricate maturation process overseen by the distillery's legendary blenders; it is aged for its first nine years in American white oak ex-bourbon barrels before being split. Half remains in the bourbon casks, while the other half is transferred to premium rare 30-year-old Matusalem Oloroso sherry butts for the final three years, creating a beautifully balanced whisky that drinks well beyond its age.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate, sticky toffee pudding, roasted almonds, or a fine maduro cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber in appearance with a rich, smooth, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Citrus fruits, chocolate, orange marmalade, sweet spices, and rich malt.

Palate : Citrus, Seville oranges, dried fruit, dark chocolate, vanilla, and hints of cinnamon.

Finish : Medium to long with lingering roasted coffee, dark chocolate, and warm oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of water, or over a large ice cube.

brand-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
brand-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 pours an opaque, deep purple-ruby color with brilliant violet edges in the glass. Sourced from a diverse palette of eight premium Napa Valley sub-appellations, this expressive Cabernet Sauvignon represents the Wagner family's iconic signature style of opulent fruit density and supple tannic structural power. The highly fragrant bouquet opens with lush aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis paste, and black cherry compote, intricately layered with secondary notes of cocoa powder, espresso bean, warm baking spices, and fine toasted cedarwood. On the palate, the wine delivers a full-bodied, texturally luxurious mouthfeel framed by incredibly soft, fine-grained tannins that eliminate any youthfully bitter edges. A dense mid-palate of concentrated dark orchard fruits and mocha flows seamlessly alongside well-balanced acidity, carrying outstanding weight into a long, satisfyingly plush finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime grilled ribeye steak with rosemary butter, slow-braised beef short ribs, or an artisanal board of aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

chateau-gruaud-larose-95-00-05-10-15.title: Chateau Gruaud Larose Vertical 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015 5 x 750ml
chateau-gruaud-larose-95-00-05-10-15.bodyHtml: This Chateau Gruaud Larose Vertical includes one bottle each of the 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015 vintages

chateau-lafite-rothschild-2010.title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild 2003
chateau-lafite-rothschild-2010.bodyHtml:
Chateau Lafite Rothschild is one of the world's most iconic Bordeaux wines, celebrated for its extraordinary elegance, precision, and longevity. Aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, cedar, graphite, violet, cigar box, and fine spice unfold into a seamless palate with silky tannins, exceptional depth, and a remarkably persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, or aged Comte for an unforgettable First Growth Bordeaux experience.

 

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2003 Château Lafite Rothschild comes as close to perfection as any of the great Lafites made over the past three decades (1982, 1986, 1996, 2000, 2005, 2008, 2009 and 2010). This sensational effort came in at 12.7% natural alcohol and is made in the style of one of the estate’s great classics, the 1959. Composed of 86% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Merlot and the balance Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, it exhibits a dense ruby-purple color to the rim along with a luxurious bouquet of cedarwood, lead pencil shavings, white chocolate, cocoa and cassis. Rich, opulent and full-bodied with low acidity and stunning seductiveness and complexity, this noble wine possesses a generous, heady style. It is just coming into its plateau of maturity, where it should hold for 20–25 years. This is one of the candidates for wine of the vintage—make no mistake about that.

98 Points - James Suckling

Spicy and rich, with tobacco and berry character on both the nose and palate. I love the nose. Full-bodied, with soft, velvety tannins that give you so much. This goes on and on. Sexy and exciting.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is a splendid wine. Yes, it is more powerful than the usual aristocratic Lafites, but it still manages to retain a special air of great elegance and presence. The fruit is dark, the tannins immensely powerful, and the flavors recall black figs, dates and cocoa. At the end, a vibrant acidity shines through, promising a long life for this great wine.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Subtle, complex aromas of berries, licorice and currants. Full-bodied, with well-integrated tannins and a long finish. A beautifully integrated wine with wonderful length and finesse.

morgans-way-cabernet-sauvignon-2020.title: Caymus Special Selection Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
morgans-way-cabernet-sauvignon-2020.bodyHtml: Caymus Special Selection Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is the flagship "prestige" bottling from the Wagner family, crafted only in years where the fruit meets their highest standards for concentration and depth. This wine is unique for being a "Selection of Selections," where the best barrels from the Napa Valley estate are chosen for extended aging and refinement. The 2020 vintage is characterized by a dark, opaque purple hue and an explosive aromatic profile of crème de cassis, huckleberry, and ripe figs, underpinned by savory notes of espresso, toasted oak, and vanilla bean. On the palate, it is exceptionally lush and full-bodied, offering a "creamy" mouthfeel with dense, supple tannins and a remarkably long, fruit-forward finish that masks its structural power.

bonny-doon-syrah.title: Bonny Doon Vineyard Le Cigare Volant
bonny-doon-syrah.bodyHtml:
Bonny Doon Vineyard Le Cigare Volant is a vibrant, iconic, and masterfully balanced red blend that stands as California's definitive homage to the classic, history-steeped wines of Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Crafted by the pioneering "Rhône Ranger" Randall Grahm and now under the stewardship of WarRoom Cellars, this celebrated cuvée has evolved over the decades into a beautifully fresh, food-friendly style that emphasizes purity of fruit over heavy oak manipulation. In the glass, it casts a brilliant, clear ruby-violet hue. The highly expressive and lifted nose unrolls an alluring bouquet of wild strawberries, red currants, and pomegranate, seamlessly interwoven with complex undertones of lavender, white pepper, licorice, and a subtle touch of garrigue chaparral spice. On the palate, this medium-bodied red is remarkably supple and bright, driving a succulent, crunchy core of dark raspberry jam, boysenberry, and mace over exceptionally fine-grained, elegant tannins. Driven by a vitalizing line of mouthwatering natural acidity, it carries excellent focus and fruit transparency into a long, beautifully clean finish marked by savory hints of tobacco and black olive.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with herb-roasted lamb, grilled sausages served with ratatouille, savory mushroom risottos, or duck confit.

sambuca-luxardo-2.title: Luxardo Sambuca
sambuca-luxardo-2.bodyHtml: This classic Italian liqueur has been family owned for generations. The use of essential oils from the star anise seed provide intense aromatics and concentrated flavours that are balanced by light bitterness and velvety smooth texture on the palate.

chateau-de-beaucastel-chateauneuf-du-pap.title: Chateau de Beaucastel Chateauneuf-du-Pape 2022
chateau-de-beaucastel-chateauneuf-du-pap.bodyHtml:
Château de Beaucastel Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2022 is a masterfully balanced, complex, and benchmark southern Rhône red wine produced by the Perrin family at their legendary estate in Courthézon. Sourced from organically and biodynamically farmed vineyards rooted in the region's classic terroir of heat-retaining quartzite rolled pebbles (galets roulés), molasses, and porous marine sandstone, the fruit was vinified varietal by varietal following a brief flash-heating of the skins to preserve aromatics and purity. Matured entirely in large neutral oak foudres, the wine presents an opaque, deep ruby-purple core in the glass. The bouquet is intricate and deeply layered, revealing fragrant notes of dark cherries, ripe black raspberries, and wild mulberries intricately woven with garrigue herbs, cracked black pepper, smoked bacon, licorice, bay leaves, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body marked by seamless density, silty melted tannins, and vibrant natural freshness, culminating in a focused, lingering, and mineral-flecked finish of exceptional longevity.

Food Pairing: Roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, wild boar stew, braised beef short ribs, grilled venison loin, or aged farmhouse Comté cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

A textured, layered, precise red, showcasing aromas of cherries, raspberries, warm herbs, bay leaves and baking spices. It’s medium- to full-bodied with silty, beautifully melted tannins. So integrated. Lively and focused, with plenty of energy and verve complementing the ripe red fruit and dried herbs. Intense stream of spices in the long, flavorful finish. From organically grown grapes

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Matured 100% in foudres, the 2022 Chateauneuf du Pape from Château de Beaucastel evokes aromas of dark wild berries, dark cherries, spices and licorice mingled with a touch of chocolate. Medium to full-bodied, deep and dense, it’s perfectly balanced with a structured, textured and seamless mid-palate enhanced by velvety tannins and a peppery, delicate and long finish. Cesar Perrin is aiming to reduce the percentage of Syrah in favor of Counoise, so this harmonious Beaucastel, matured in foudres, is a blend of 30% Mourvèdre, 20% Grenache, 10% Counoise, 5% Cinsault, 5% Terret Noir, 5% Muscardin, 5% Vaccarèse and 20% of white grapes, such as Roussanne and Clairette.

peju-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon-napa.title: Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
peju-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon-napa.bodyHtml:
Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 pours an opaque, deep purple-ruby color with brilliant violet edges in the glass. Sourced from a diverse palette of eight premium Napa Valley sub-appellations, this expressive Cabernet Sauvignon represents the Wagner family's iconic signature style of opulent fruit density and supple tannic structural power. The highly fragrant bouquet opens with lush aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis paste, and black cherry compote, intricately layered with secondary notes of cocoa powder, espresso bean, warm baking spices, and fine toasted cedarwood. On the palate, the wine delivers a full-bodied, texturally luxurious mouthfeel framed by incredibly soft, fine-grained tannins that eliminate any youthfully bitter edges. A dense mid-palate of concentrated dark orchard fruits and mocha flows seamlessly alongside well-balanced acidity, carrying outstanding weight into a long, satisfyingly plush finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime grilled ribeye steak with rosemary butter, slow-braised beef short ribs, or an artisanal board of aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

on-the-rocks-variety-pack.title: Big Rock The Rock Box Variety Pack
on-the-rocks-variety-pack.bodyHtml: The Rock Box is the premier signature variety pack from Big Rock Brewery, a pioneer of the Canadian craft beer movement. This pack is designed to offer a "best of" experience, featuring a curated selection of the brewery's award-winning ales and lagers. Known for its versatility, the collection typically highlights Big Rock's commitment to using high-quality, regionally sourced ingredients like Alberta-grown malted barley. Whether in its "Signature" form or limited-edition "Untamed Hop Edition," the pack remains a staple for those seeking a broad range of classic and contemporary beer styles.
