woodford-reserve-baccarat-edition.title: Woodford Reserve Baccarat Edition
woodford-reserve-baccarat-edition.bodyHtml: History and heritage meet innovation and sophistication. Woodford Reserve Baccarat Edition is crafted by uniquely finishing the most complex and balanced Kentucky Bourbon in select XO Cognac barrels. Sourced by our Master Distiller Chris Morris, each barrel has seen three seasons of cognac before being filled with Woodford Reserve.The result is the best of both spirits – a balance of crisp American and French oak notes, complex fruit character, subtle spiciness and a creamy confectionary finish. Presented in a bespoke Baccarat decanter, Woodford Reserve Baccarat Edition is the ultimate expression of American Whiskey at its finest.

tamdhu-18-year-old.title: Tamdhu 18 Year Old
tamdhu-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Tamdhu 18 Year Old Old Speyside single malt Scotch whisky. Matured in Oloroso Seasoned Sherry Casks sourced from Spain. Limited release.

Combining American Oak Oloroso and European Oak Oloroso casks, the 18-Year-Old unites Tamdhu’s signature fruity spirit and 18 long years of full-term sherry maturation to deliver layers of indulgent flavour and a deep natural colour which reflects the quality of the oak.

Bottled at 46.8% abv and non-chill filtered, on the nose the Tamdhu 18-Year-Old delivers rich dark fruits with ripe cherry and plum. Zesty citrus notes cut through an indulgent base of nutty milk chocolate and honey-baked oats.

To taste, crisp red apple emerges alongside dried fruits, with some sweet spice coming in the form of cinnamon, vanilla, and brown sugar.

A long, lingering, and rewarding finish brings spiced stewed apple and an unmistakable hint of sherry.

verite-la-muse-2019.title: Verite La Muse 2019 750ml
verite-la-muse-2019.bodyHtml:
2019 La Muse shimmers with a deep violet-ruby core of color, expressing opulent fruit aromas of candied red & black cherry, and wild fresh blackberry, with perfumed notes of dried potpourri, dried rosemary, and essences of sandalwood, toasted cinnamon, nutmeg, and clove from French oak aging. The palate perfectly mirrors the nose, along with tannins reminiscent of dark cocoa nib, bright acidity, and petrichor minerality, all of which work to balance the supple texture of this wine, driving to a very long finish.

Blend: 90% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, 5% Malbec

99 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2019 La Muse is a blend of 90% Merlot, 5% Cab Franc and 5% Malbec. Deep ruby-purple, it explodes with cassis, violets and aniseed, with wafts of thyme, tobacco and iron, offering new nuances with each return to the glass. The full-bodied palate is powerful and refined, with loads of rounded tannins, focused freshness and ethereal character. It's exceptionally expressive and structured and should be very long lived in the cellar.
99 Points James Suckling
Blueberries, blackberries and crushed stones. Pure fruit. Full-bodied with round tannins that have powdery character. Creamy and round mouth-feel. Very unique. Great finish. 90% merlot, 5% cabernet franc and 5% malbec. Best from 2026.
98 Points Jeb Dunnuck
The 2019 La Muse offers a luxurious and layered perfume of red apple, sweet tobacco, and fresh leather. The palate is generous, with velveteen texture, noes of cassis, violets, and fresh earth, and a weightless feel. The most open of the three presented by Verite, this is an incredible wine and will be fantastic to check in on over the next two or more decades.
94 Points Decanter
Smooth and well defined, this Merlot-dominant wine has a nice delicacy to it. Lifted and bright, there is a sense of joy to this with excellent detail and definition to the fruit and the fine tannins. Clearly powerful with concentration but well delivered. I like the liquorice and the subtle herbal spiced edges - rosemary and cinnamon giving nuance as well as the slightly sweet but supple red and black cherry and blueberries fruit which mingle with scented dried flower notes. A refined style with a lifted finish that is really enjoyable. Ageing 16 months in French oak (95% new).

verite-le-desir-2019.title: Verite Le Desir 2019 750ml
verite-le-desir-2019.bodyHtml:
2019 Le Désir has a rich violet hue, ringed by a slender rim of incandescent purple-ruby color. Beautifully characteristic of Cabernet Franc, the aromatics of this wine are expressive and exotic, showing fresh rose petal perfume, fresh cherry blossom, California bay laurel, crushed pomegranate, blackberry coulis, and well-integrated French oak aromas of ground cinnamon, and brown buttered toast. On the palate, a robust structure defined by powdery tannins and lively acidity delivers a very fine balance, with an exceptionally long finish.

Blend: 83% Cabernet Franc, 8% Merlot, 5% Malbec, 4% Cabernet Sauvignon

100 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2019 Le Désir is an exceptional blend of 83% Cabernet Franc, 8% Merlot, 5% Malbec and 4% Cabernet Sauvignon, offering complex, layered flavors, soaring aromatics and very detailed expression. Deep ruby-purple in color, its aromas unfold slowly and offer new nuances with each return to the glass: Morello cherries, warm chocolate, dried thyme, desiccated roses and dried herbs. The full-bodied palate offers concentrated, floral fruits, pixelated tannins, bursts of fresh acidity and a very long finish with layer after layer of detailed flavor.
100 Points James Suckling

Sublime cabernet franc aromas of currants, flowers and citrus. Full-bodied with incredible purity of fruit and length. You don’t feel the tannins, but they are there. The acidity gives you dynamic reality and perfect length. A truly great wine. 83% cabernet franc, 8% merlot, 5% malbec, and 4% cabernet sauvignon. Best from 2026.

98 Points Jeb Dunnuck
The 2019 Le Desir is based on Cabernet Franc, with the remainder 8% Merlot, 5% Malbec, and 4% Cabernet Sauvignon. It is complex and layered, with hints of saddle leather, pencil shavings, tangy red cherry, and blackcurrant. The palate is full and elegantly structured, with mocha, red plum, and turned soil. This is an incredible wine with lots of underlying tension that will be a pleasure to revisit if afforded the opportunity. Drink over the next 20 or more years.
94 Points Decanter
Such a beautiful fragrance to the nose, you can really tell the three wines apart and identity the aromatic Cabernet Franc on this one. Chewy and ripe fruit on the palate, this has grip and flesh from the start but also a nice liquorice spiced aspect which combines well with the pink rose, cherry, blackcurrant and cinnamon aspects. Tannins are fine and powdery, just a touch dry and chalky but this has nice detail and vibrant acidity. 4% Cabernet Sauvignon completes the blend. Ageing 16 months in French oak (95% new).

verite-la-joie-2019.title: Verite La Joie 2019 750ml
verite-la-joie-2019.bodyHtml:
2019 La Joie shows a rich core of black-violet concentration, ringed with a very thin, youthful looking violet rim. The fruit aromatics are fresh and vibrant, with black currant & black plum compote, joined by elements of fresh cut greenery, subtle pine resin, iodine, and roasted baking spices. The palate illustrates the power and suppleness of the 2019 vintage, lending a purity and sweetness to each of the flavors described. The texture is balanced by tannins evocative of dark baking cocoa and robust acidity, both of which lead to a long, persistent finish.

Blend: 84% Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, 4% Petit Verdot

99 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2019 La Joie is an elegant expression that offers power, freshness and expressive, floral character. A blend of 84% Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc and 4% Petit Verdot, it has a deep ruby color and opens slowly from black cherries and blueberries to accents of violets, ground coffee and licorice. The full-bodied palate has generous, grainy tannins, detailed, perfumed flavors and bright acidity, finishing with an alluring iron character.
99 Points Jeb Dunnuck

Composed of 84% Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, and the remainder of Petit Verdot, the 2019 La Joie is compact and unfolds more slowly in the glass. The nose is rich with graphite, sage oil, and black plum. The palate is full of kirsch, fresh leather, currant, and tobacco, with fine tannins that go for ages, along with the fruit and well-balanced acidity.

98 Points James Suckling
The purity of fruit with currants, spices and flowers is very impressive, as is the long, creamy texture. Full-bodied with medium, round tannins and a fresh finish. Oyster and iodine notes come through. Excellent. Drink after 2026.
95 Points Decanter
Grippy and structured, this is bold and powerful Cabernet Sauvignon-dominant wine with grippy tannins, a chalky texture almost with liquorice spice and blackcurrant fruit. I love the gentle sweetness here and the lifted acidity that keeps it all fresh. A complex and characterful style with plenty to like. On the rich side, but there is nuance here. 4% Petit Verdot completes the blend. Ageing 16 months in French oak (95% new).

cardinale-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.title: Penfolds Bin 704 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
cardinale-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 704 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a modern, beautifully sculpted, and sophisticated Napa Valley red wine that showcases classic Californian terroir interpreted through Penfolds’ historic winemaking lens. Named as a reverse mirror image of its Australian counterpart Bin 407, it represents a French oak-matured expression of pure Cabernet Sauvignon. In the glass, it reveals a dense ruby-purple hue with a brilliant crimson rim. The aromatic profile is rich and layered, presenting ripe blackcurrant, dark plum, glazed cherries, and blackberry compote, underscored by subtle notes of cocoa powder, bay leaf, cedarwood, and delicate French oak spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, supple, and focused, offering concentrated dark fruit balanced by lively, mouthwatering acidity, fine-grained graphite minerality, and polished, silky tannins that carry through to an expansive, enduring finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, rosemary garlic roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison medallions, and aged sharp cheddar.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Napa wine from the Australian-based producer over delivers on its price point, offering tremendous flavor, complexity and approachability in its youth. Expansive in dense black and red fruit, cocoa powder and silky tannin, it offers breadth and depth and is intensely compelling.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The fruit for the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Bin 704 is from across Napa Valley, and the classy fruit is shaped by French oak (40% new) and firm tannins through the finish. This is supple and sweet and shows blood plum, raspberry, red licorice and even cocoa. The wine is long and lingering and shapely. Sophisticated.

glenrothes-1997-a-d-rattray.title: A.D. Rattray Cask Collection Glenrothes 24 Year Old 1997 Bourbon Hogshead Cask 717972 54.1% ABV
glenrothes-1997-a-d-rattray.bodyHtml:
This exceptional hogshead was filled in the same month as the premiere of the movie “Titanic”. From a distillery that built its reputation on vintages rather than age statements, this epic cask proves 1997 to be a truly blockbuster year.

Tasting Notes – Waxy with tropical fruit.

Colour: Polished copper.
Nose: Orange peel, candlewax, dried coconut and leather.
Palate: Barley sugar, pink grapefruit and crystallized pineapple.
Finish: Vanilla fudge crumbles gently to red grape and dark chocolate.

jadot-hospices-1er-dames-hospitalieres.title: Hospices de Beaune Dames Hospitalieres Premier Cru 2018
jadot-hospices-1er-dames-hospitalieres.bodyHtml: This wine stays true to the qualities of the 2018 vintage, showcasing ripe, dark berry fruit flavors with notes of blackberry and dark raspberry that convey intensity and power through the finish. The cuvee benefits from a significant portion of old vines, which contribute to its concentration and structured quality on the palate. Overall, this wine offers a fruit-forward character that is typical of the 2018 vintage, making it the boldest selection in this lineup.

jadot-morey-ste-denis-1er-clos-des-ormes.title: Louis Jadot Morey-Saint-Denis Clos des Ormes Premier Cru 2022
jadot-morey-ste-denis-1er-clos-des-ormes.bodyHtml:
Deep crimson. Seductively rich and fresh at the same time. Both red and black fruits and subtle spice. Morey's complex fragrance that is both slightly floral and slightly peppery. Firm and a little bit chewy on the palate, the tannins giving shape to the lovely fruit depth. Refined and long.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A delineated, velvety red, boasting black cherry, blackberry, earth, tamarind and spice flavors. Sinewy tannins take over on the back half, leaving a solid grip on the finish. Best from 2028 through 2042. 15 cases imported.

laws-origins-intention-bourbon.title: Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon
laws-origins-intention-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon is a landmark Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey widely recognized as the world's first commercially available single barrel bourbon, introduced in 1984 by Master Distiller Elmer T. Lee. Named in honor of Colonel Albert B. Blanton, who spent over five decades managing the historic Buffalo Trace Distillery (formerly the George T. Stagg Distillery), each bottle is drawn from an individual cask aged in the center-cut section of Warehouse H—the only metal-clad warehouse on the distillery grounds, known for rapid temperature fluctuations that accelerate wood interaction. Crafted from Buffalo Trace's high-rye Mashbill #2 and bottled at 93 proof, it delivers a rich, complex, and remarkably balanced profile of sweet vanilla, citrus, caramel, and warm baking spices, housed in its iconic round bottle topped with a collectible cast-metal horse and jockey stopper.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-smoked beef brisket, glazed pork ribs, seared duck breast, aged sharp cheddar or Gouda, dark chocolate pecan tarts, and warm bread pudding with caramel sauce.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber with warm copper-orange highlights, presenting a full, rich body with a velvety, smooth, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Warm vanilla, honey, caramel, dried orange peel, toasted oak, nutmeg, and subtle rye spice.

Palate : Rich and creamy with flavors of burnt sugar, sweet corn, dark toffee, clove, cinnamon, citrus zest, and seasoned charred oak.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warming with lingering notes of sweet vanilla, baking spices, honey, and subtle dry oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or rocks glass, over a single large ice cube, or as the rich centerpiece in classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

laws-cognac-finish-bourbon.title: Chicken Cock Chanticleer Cognac Barrel Finish Bourbon
laws-cognac-finish-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Chanticleer celebrates the long time French-American friendship dating back to the 1700’s and to Paris, Kentucky where Chicken Cock was founded in 1856. Sealed in a prohibition era collectible tin, this Kentucky Straight Bourbon finished in fine French Cognac casks has vibrant notes of ripened peaches with tannic bursts of vanilla and cherry.

 

NOSE

Vibrant notes of ripened peaches, delicate sweet cream, and succulent honey.

PALATE

Tannic bursts of vanilla and cherry complimented by softened plums, candied dates, and banana flambe.

FINISH

Hot caramelized sugar, melted butter, and fresh citrus zest.

smokehead-rum-rebel-1.title: Smokehead Rum Rebel Rum Cask Finish Islay Single Malt
smokehead-rum-rebel-1.bodyHtml:
Smokehead Rum Rebel is an Islay single malt Scotch whisky from Ian Macleod Distillers, given a rum cask finish and bottled at 46% ABV; this listing is the 750 ml bottle. It belongs to Smokehead's experimental cask series, which sets the brand's heavy Islay peat smoke against other cask types, in this case the sweetness of Caribbean rum casks. The label and presentation tin mark it as a limited edition with a rum cask finish. It is a smoky, tropical whisky showing medicinal peat, sweet caramel, burnt pineapple and caramelised banana, and the brand's own playful note adds citrus, marshmallow and bacon.

Tasting Notes: Medicinal peat smoke, sweet caramel, burnt pineapple, caramelised banana, citrus and tropical fruit.

Serve: Neat, with a splash of water or over ice.

freemark-abbey-merlot-napa.title: Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
freemark-abbey-merlot-napa.bodyHtml:
Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a quintessentially classic and beautifully structured expression from one of Napa Valley's pioneering and historic estates. Pouring a deep garnet hue, this meticulously crafted blend of 90% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Merlot, 2% Malbec, 2% Petit Verdot, and 1% Cabernet Franc yields an inviting and complex nose of dark chocolate, blackberry, fresh pomegranate, cedar shavings, and subtle leather. On the palate, it is rich, bold, and delightfully fruit-forward. Generous flavors of blueberry compote, ripe black cherry, espresso, and sweet cigar box are beautifully framed by well-structured, fine-grained tannins and a bright, juicy natural acidity. Aged for 24 months in French oak barrels (41% new), this polished and highly approachable Cabernet concludes with a warm, beautifully integrated, and satisfyingly long finish, showcasing excellent potential in the cellar.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with a hearty ribeye steak, grilled venison, classic beef Wellington, roasted lamb chops, or aged Gouda cheese.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This bold, ripe but nicely polished wine wraps black cherries, black currants and mint in moderate, fine-grained tannins that will help carry it for several years. Subtle cinnamon, clove and cedar accents keep it interesting on the finish. Best through 2030.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, polished style, with a relatively open-knit core of boysenberry and black cherry compote backed by friendly singed vanilla and licorice notes. A crowd-pleaser. Drink now through 2031.

albert-bichot-chablis-1er-cru-vaillons.title: Jean Collet & Fils 'Vaillons' Chablis 1er Cru 2024
albert-bichot-chablis-1er-cru-vaillons.bodyHtml:
Jean Collet & Fils 'Vaillons' Chablis 1er Cru 2024 is an exceptional, crisp, and beautifully expressive white Burgundy crafted from Premier Cru vineyards in Chablis. Visually displaying a brilliant pale yellow hue with greenish highlights, it opens with vibrant aromas of green apple, lemon zest, white flowers, and crushed oyster shells, underpinned by a distinct flinty minerality. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body driven by energetic, precise acidity and a focused core of citrus and orchard fruit, leading into a long, saline, and refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, pan-seared sea scallops, grilled halibut, goat cheese, poultry in light cream sauce, and delicate seafood dishes.

albert-bichot-echezeaux-grand-cru-domain.title: Albert Bichot Savigny-les-Beaune Les Grands Picotins Domaine Pavillon 2020
albert-bichot-echezeaux-grand-cru-domain.bodyHtml:
Albert Bichot Savigny-Les-Beaune Les Grands Picotins 2020 is a Pinot Noir from Domaine du Pavillon. Red and black fruit aromas mingle with gentle spice, leading to a balanced, fleshy and rounded palate with delicate structure. Oak ageing supports a long, fruity and generous finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roasted beef, braised pork, roast chicken, or medium-aged cheeses.

albert-bichot-vosne-romanee-1er-malconso.title: Albert Bichot Vosne-Romanee Malconsorts Premier Cru Domaine du Clos Frantin 2020 750ml
albert-bichot-vosne-romanee-1er-malconso.bodyHtml:
On the nose, it is thin and complex, at first glance marked by a delicate and discreet wooded area. Its notes of stone fruit, evolve towards a finish on spices. This nose is gradually discovered, and after good ventilation, it will bring out subtle notes of peppermint and cedar. On the palate, we can see all the crunch of the Pinot Noir grape variety, with a pretty tannic texture that coats the palate without aggressiveness.

Taste this Vosne-Romanée 1er Cru "Les Malconsorts" with red meats, game in sauce and on the majority of cheeses.

96 Points - Decanter
The wine shows a pronounced aroma of ripe black cherry and floral notes the winemaker describes as peony, mingled with notes of mineral, spice and smoke. Initially somewhat reserved on the palate, the texture is silky and with time reveals substantial but fine-grained tannins, good freshness and impressive length. Bichot owns two parcels of Malconsorts that total 1.75ha at the southern extremity of the lieu-dit bordering Nuits. Picking began on the 31st August, right after the first small shower that refreshed the vines.

albert-bichot-chablis-gc-vaudesir.title: Albert Bichot Chablis Domaine Long-Depaquit 2023
albert-bichot-chablis-gc-vaudesir.bodyHtml:
Albert Bichot Chablis Domaine Long-Depaquit 2023 is a vibrant Chardonnay that expresses the purity of Chablis through aromas of candied lemon, white flowers and flinty minerality. Fresh and precise on the palate, it delivers crisp acidity, saline notes and a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, prawns, crab, grilled fish or fresh goat cheese.

 

90 Points - James Suckling

Very light, clean and fresh-tasting, this is an unoaked, straightforward and lively wine. Has a bit more body than in many years at 13% plus alcohol, with crisp apples, lemon zest and hints of bananas and pineapple. From organically grown grapes.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers richness underlined by lively acidity, setting the boundaries for lemon, yellow plum, summer meadow and flint flavors. This white is balanced and long on the finish.

albert-bichot-griotte-chambertin-gc.title: Albert Bichot Crémant de Bourgogne Brut Reserve
albert-bichot-griotte-chambertin-gc.bodyHtml:
Albert Bichot Crémant de Bourgogne Brut Réserve is a traditional method sparkling wine offering fine, persistent bubbles with aromas of citrus, white blossoms and stone fruit. Fresh and vibrant on the palate, it displays lively acidity, elegant minerality and a clean, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, seafood, grilled fish, smoked salmon or poultry in a cream sauce.

drouhin-chablis-1er-cru-mont-de-milieu.title: Fourrey Mont De Milieu Chablis 1Er Cru

g-m-longmorn-1966.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Longmorn 1966
g-m-longmorn-1966.bodyHtml:
Made in 1966 at Longmorn distillery, this Speyside single malt has been matured in a first-fill sherry butt for more than half a century, before being bottled in March 2019 for Gordon & MacPhail's Private Collection.

Intense sweet fruitcake aromas align with brown sugar, sticky prunes, and candied citrus peel. Spice provides warmth with cinnamon and clove. Hints of vanilla come to the fore followed by forest fruits. A delicate oak smoke is present. Sweet with bursts of pepper. Steeped dark fruits - blackberry and ripe cherries envelop warming spice leading to flavours of liquorice with dried tobacco and oak.

jaboulet-hermitage-la-chapelle-blanc.title: Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aine Hermitage La Chapelle Blanc 2020
jaboulet-hermitage-la-chapelle-blanc.bodyHtml:
Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aîné Hermitage La Chapelle Blanc 2020 is an extraordinary, rare Northern Rhône white wine that marks the triumphant return of the estate's flagship white cuvée. Produced from 100% old-vine Marsanne grapes entirely grown within the Maison Blanche lieu-dit, this wine shows off a brilliant pale gold color with bright blonde highlights. The sophisticated nose reveals an expressive and complex bouquet of fresh apricot, pear blossom, lemon verbena, and crushed flint, accented by subtle hints of cream and sandalwood. On the palate, it breaks from typical Hermitage Blanc convention by offering an exceptionally crisp, linear energy and elevated natural acidity. Its medium-to-full-bodied texture remains incredibly elegant and focused, seamlessly carrying a seamless core of stone fruit and vibrant citrus notes through to a textured, intensely mineral, and long-lasting finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared scallops, roasted free-range chicken in a creamy mushroom sauce, grilled lobster, veal cutlets, and mature goat cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling
Fresh apricot, pear blossom, lemon verbena, crushed flint, cream and sandalwood on the nose. Full-bodied, yet elegant and fresh, with vibrant acidity and a supple, seamless palate. Mineral, textured finish. From...

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Hermitage la Chapelle Blanc (last bottled in 2014) comes entirely from the Maison Blanche lieu-dit and is 100% Marsanne. Like the other Jaboulet whites from 2020, it's on the leaner side, with pear and citrus enriched by some leesy character. Medium-bodied, it's long and elegant, even if it's a significant departure in style from most examples of Hermitage Blanc. With it's higher-than-normal acid levels and crisper feel, it's conceivable that I've underrated it as a young wine and that it will blossom in time.

midori-melon-liquor.title: Midori Melon Liqueur
midori-melon-liquor.bodyHtml: The quality and delicious taste of Midori Melon liqueur come from the blending of juices from premium rare muskmelons. Grown in only one region of Japan, they are incredibly hard to find. Because of this, they can sell for as much as US$20,000 in their first harvest. They extract the essence from two different melons using two different production methods to create a premium melon flavour.

benjamin-bridge-nova-7.title: Benjamin Bridge Nova 7 2024
benjamin-bridge-nova-7.bodyHtml:
Benjamin Bridge Nova 7 2024 is an exceptionally vibrant, aromatic, and iconic lightly sparkling off-dry wine that beautifully showcases the unique cool-climate viticulture of Nova Scotia. Crafted from a proprietary blend of aromatic varieties, this low-alcohol wine undergoes a careful fermentation process to protect its intense, natural fruit purity and crisp freshness. In the glass, it displays a delicate, luminous pale salmon-pink hue with glistening highlights. The nose is highly expressive and floral, opening with a radiant bouquet of orange blossom, fresh lychee, and white peach, seamlessly layered with notes of wild rose and mandarin peel. On the palate, this lightly effervescent wine is medium-bodied and beautifully balanced, driving a succulent core of ripe apricot, red grapefruit, and tangerine zest. The natural, elegant grape sweetness is perfectly countered by a striking, mouthwatering line of marine-influenced crisp acidity, leading into a long, clean, and remarkably refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh pan-seared scallops, spicy Thai green curry, coconut-lime shrimp skewers, prosciutto-wrapped melon, or light fruit desserts.

benjamin-bridge-riesling.title: Benjamin Bridge Riesling 750ml
benjamin-bridge-riesling.bodyHtml: Lively and energetic on the nose with zesty citrus notes and a cool maritime breeze suggesting sea minerals. On the palate, complex and layered hints of lemongrass, beeswax, lime preserve, and raw acacia honey combine for a wine of substantial depth and structure.

lightfoot-wolfville-ancienne-wild-char.title: Lightfoot & Wolfville Ancienne Chardonnay 750ml
lightfoot-wolfville-ancienne-wild-char.bodyHtml: Lightfoot & Wolfville Ancienne Chardonnay is a wild-fermented Chardonnay from the Annapolis Valley in Nova Scotia. The family-owned winery combines organic and biodynamic farming with Old World winemaking. It shows Meyer lemon and yellow pear with hazelnut and white truffle, a palate balanced between texture and acidity, and a citrus-zest finish; it pairs with roast poultry, fish, warm vegetable dishes and cream sauces. 750ml, 12% ABV.

lightfoot-wolfville-ancienne-wild-pino.title: Lightfoot & Wolfville Ancienne Pinot Noir 2020 750ml
lightfoot-wolfville-ancienne-wild-pino.bodyHtml: Lightfoot & Wolfville Ancienne Pinot Noir 2020 is a wild-fermented Pinot Noir from the Annapolis Valley in Nova Scotia. It is pale ruby, with brambleberry, dark cherry, brown spice and sandalwood, fine grippy tannins and bright acidity, and suits duck, roast pork, tuna or grilled vegetables. 750ml, 11% ABV.

confessions-cabernet-sauvignon.title: The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
confessions-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a luxurious, modern, and brilliantly textured expression that carries the bold and unrestricted winemaking philosophy of this iconic estate into a pure varietal focus. Sourced from premier vineyards across the valley, this vintage exhibits a deep magenta and purple-ruby core. On the nose, it offers an invitingly opulent bouquet of ripe black cherries, crème de cassis, and sweet blackberry pie, seamlessly layered with warm undertones of toasted vanilla bean, cinnamon bark, fresh coffee grounds, and hints of crushed wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is incredibly soft, plush, and full-bodied, delivering an expansive, fruit-forward mid-palate wrapped in supple, velvety tannins. Matured for 15 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels, its powerful dark fruit concentration remains beautifully balanced, showing remarkable structural harmony before concluding with a lengthy, decadent finish accented by a touch of holiday spice and subtle mineral depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with charcoal-grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-infused roasted lamb, or hunks of mature sharp white cheddar cheese.

benjamin-bridge-cabernet-franc-rose.title: Benjamin Bridge Brut Rose
benjamin-bridge-cabernet-franc-rose.bodyHtml:
Benjamin Bridge Brut Rose is a traditional-method sparkling rose from Nova Scotia, crafted with an expressive fruit profile and refreshing structure. Extended lees aging contributes texture and complexity, while vibrant acidity and fine bubbles create a precise, elegant sparkling wine suited to both aperitif service and dining.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled Atlantic salmon, lobster rolls, tuna tartare, or strawberry goat cheese salad.

lagavulin-distillers-edition-islay.title: Lagavulin 16 Year Old
lagavulin-distillers-edition-islay.bodyHtml: Considered by many to be the benchmark for Islay malts this classic pours a golden amber colour and wafts from your glass with intense smoky peat and iodine. The palate is full flavour, rich and smooth with peat, figs, dates, and vanilla followed by an enduring smoky and dry finish.

tarapaca-gran-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Tarapaca Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
tarapaca-gran-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This wine from Chile's Maipo Valley has ripe, fruity and complex aromas of plum, blackberry and cassis, with subtle notes of bay leaves. Aged for 12 months in French and American oak barrels, it has notes of cloves, black pepper and vanilla. The influence of the soil (angular stones, and loamy-sandy texture) is evident in this wine's good structure and medium body with soft and round tannins. The mineral soils of volcanic origin also aid in achieving a deep and balanced wine.

91 Points - James Suckling

Spiced berries, ash, blackcurrants and touches of olives and fine herbs on the nose. Fruit-expressive, with fine-grained tannins and a juicy finish. Drink now.

admiral-rodney-officers-release-no-2.title: Admiral Rodney Officer's Release No. 2 2009 Irish Whiskey Cask Finish Rum
admiral-rodney-officers-release-no-2.bodyHtml: The second entry in Admiral Rodney’s Officer’s Release series, distilled in 2009 and finished in ex-Irish whiskey casks. The nose entices you with notes of clove, allspice, baked honey, prunes and rapsberries. The palate is fruity and spicy, expertly combining cherry, blackcurrant, sweet chilli and Asian spices with a hint of saltiness to finish.

a-mavam-silver-grape-flavor.title: Mavam Silver Grape NV 750ml
a-mavam-silver-grape-flavor.bodyHtml:
Its characteristic silver color together with the metallic sparkles will be the protagonists of any celebration. Its light grape flavor, floral aromas and intense notes of fresh frujit make it a different, sweet and cheerful product that is irresistible to any palate. 

Tasting Note

At sight it presents a silver color together with a metallic effect in silver color and a fine and bright bubble. In the olfactory phase, intense aromas of fresh fruit and citrus notes stand out, well assembled with floral memories. Great freshness, structured background and delicate effervescence give character to a difference product, sweet, cheerful and with a great weight of fruit.

williams-humbert-dry-sack.title: Williams & Humbert Dry Sack 750ml
williams-humbert-dry-sack.bodyHtml: Williams & Humbert Dry Sack is a medium sherry from Jerez in southern Spain, bottled at 19.5% ABV. Dry Sack is the Williams & Humbert brand recognisable by its dark bottle and torn-paper orange label. The label describes the wine as a distinctive blend aged in oak casks and classes it as a Medium sherry. It is amber in colour, with intense aromas suggesting dried nuts, and it is full-bodied and balanced with low acidity and a touch of sweetness. The label recommends serving it chilled. Enjoy it as an aperitif or with nuts, olives, cured meats and mild cheeses. A 750ml bottle.

red-truck-hard-day-northwest-ipa.title: Red Truck Hard Day Northwest IPA 8 Cans
red-truck-hard-day-northwest-ipa.bodyHtml: Red Truck Hard Day Northwest Ipa 8 Cans

codigo-1530-blanco-w-bonus-rosa-50ml.title: Codigo 1530 Blanco Tequila 750ml with Bonus Rosa Tequila 50ml
codigo-1530-blanco-w-bonus-rosa-50ml.bodyHtml:
Código 1530 Blanco Tequila is an ultra-premium, unrested tequila crafted at Destiladora Código (NOM 1616) in Amatitán, Jalisco. Made using 100% fully matured estate-grown Blue Weber agave cooked in stainless steel ovens and fermented using organic baker's yeast, this unaged expression delivers a pure, crisp agave flavor profile with brilliant notes of fresh citrus, floral blossoms, and black pepper spice.

Food Pairing: Fresh ceviche, grilled shrimp tacos, oysters on the half shell, fish tostadas, guacamole, or goat cheese.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear with bright silver highlights, offering a clean, silky, and medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright citrus peel (lemon and lime), fresh floral notes, mint, cooked agave, and a touch of black pepper.

Palate : Crisp and balanced with vibrant cooked agave, fresh lime zest, subtle minerality, light herbal notes, and warm pepper spice.

Finish : Clean, dry, and refreshing with lingering sweet agave, mineral notes, and soft white pepper warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tequila glass or over a large ice cube, or as an elevated base for a Paloma or Tommy's Margarita.

piper-heidsieck-rare-2008.title: Piper-Heidsieck Cuvee Brut Rare 2008
piper-heidsieck-rare-2008.bodyHtml:
In a subtle, joyful effervescence, the intense crystalline golden robe evokes yellow diamonds. The initial nose shines by the pure vivacity of this vintage. As Rare Millésime 2008 gradually warms in the glass, a vast range of orange blossom, hyacinth and white flowers is released. This leads to the delicacy of vanilla blossoms, a touch of fresh coconut, aromas of just ripe Williams pear and fresh almond, enhanced by notes of tangerine and blackcurrant buds. The second nose reveals the saline minerality, abundant and refined, an iodine-smoky harmony and a touch of licorice. On the palate the crispy, precise attack is followed by exuberant aromas of fresh pineapple, freshly cut and crisp, passion fruit, kiwi and coconut, nuanced with tangy citrus notes. These combine with plush springlike flavours with unparalleled length. The finish, with remarkable saline and iodine notes, perpetuates the journey into an endless spring.

99 Points - James Suckling

A restrained Champagne that displays the producer’s style quite clearly. On the nose it shows coconut, white chocolate, chalk, lemon zest, green apples and iodine. Amazing white chocolate flavors on the palate. It’s full-bodied and zesty with tingling bubbles and a silky texture in the finish. Great tension and complexity, with a lemony finish.

97 Points - Wine Spectator
Like a stallion out of the gate, this shows an initial explosion of power, in the form of mouthwatering flavors and fine texture, before quickly settling into an elegant gait. The racy acidity is seamlessly knit, buoying the lacy mousse and flavors of cassis, toasted brioche and tangerine, with accents of candied ginger, hazelnut and fleur de sel lingering on the long, creamy finish. Drink now through 2035.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast
The new release of this producer's prestige cuvée comes in its usual beautifully sculpted bottle. The Champagne, from a great vintage in the region, is just approaching maturity still showing minerality from the high amount of Chardonnay in the blend. Nutty flavors are creeping in, keeping the great texture adding complexity. Drink this very fine wine now although it will also age further.
93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The newly released 2008 Brut Cuvée Rare is very promising, unwinding in the glass with a youthfully reserved nose of citrus oil, crisp green apple, freshly baked bread, iodine and oyster shell, as well as some rather herbaceous characteristics that depress my score a little, even if I suspect that they will resolve with a bit more bottle age. Medium to full-bodied, incisive and tightly wound, if the 2006 vintage was gourmand and demonstrative, the 2008 is slower to show all its cards. Built around racy acids and complemented by a pillowy mousse, this rendition of Cuvée Rare will reward a few years more on cork.

whisky-sponge-glen-grant-24-year-49-8.title: Whisky Sponge Exclusive Edition No.9 Bottled for Heads & Tails Glen Grant 20 Year Old 57.8% ABV
whisky-sponge-glen-grant-24-year-49-8.bodyHtml:
Whisky Sponge Bottled for Heads & Tails Glen Grant 20 Year Old 57.8% ABV Exclusive Edition No.9 700ml

This 20 year old Whisky Sponge Glen Grant has been selected by and bottled exclusively for Heads & Tails. Distilled in 2003 the spirit matured 20 long years in a First Fill ex-Bourbon Barrel before bottling at 57.8%. Only 169 bottles!

sadashi-japanese-blended-whisky.title: Sadashi Mizunara Oak Japanese Whisky
sadashi-japanese-blended-whisky.bodyHtml:
Sadashi Mizunara Oak is a Japanese whisky whose character is shaped by time in casks made from Mizunara, the rare oak native to Japan. Mizunara is a porous wood that encourages close contact between spirit and cask, and here it brings sandalwood and incense alongside spice, tropical fruit, vanilla and a light coconut edge, giving a refined and layered dram. Bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Sandalwood, incense, tropical fruit, vanilla and gentle spice.

Nose: Sandalwood and incense with spices, tropical fruit, vanilla and a hint of coconut.

Palate: Smooth and balanced, with harmonious sweetness and spice.

Finish: Long and satisfying.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

idi-di-marzo-primitivo-puglia.title: Idi di Marzo Carnalis Appassimento 2022
idi-di-marzo-primitivo-puglia.bodyHtml:
Idi di Marzo Carnalis Appassimento 2022 is a rich, velvety Italian red wine crafted from Montepulciano and Primitivo grapes sourced from Abruzzo and Puglia. Made using the traditional appassimento technique, which partially dries grapes to concentrate their flavours, this expressive blend offers aromas of ripe cherries, blackberries, dried plums, and sweet spice. Its generous palate combines dark fruit richness with smooth tannins and a rounded texture. Matured in stainless steel to preserve its fruit character, it delivers a warming, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Slow-cooked beef ragù, grilled lamb, barbecued meats, wood-fired pizza, aged Pecorino, cured meats, and hearty pasta dishes.

new-amsterdam-pink-whitney.title: New Amsterdam Pink Whitney Pink Lemonade Flavoured Vodka
new-amsterdam-pink-whitney.bodyHtml:
New Amsterdam Pink Whitney is a pink lemonade flavoured vodka from the New Amsterdam range of E. & J. Gallo, bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The flavour grew out of a collaboration between Barstool Sports and New Amsterdam and was inspired by the favourite drink of former NHL player Ryan Whitney, co-host of the Spittin' Chiclets podcast, before going viral with hockey fans. New Amsterdam vodka is infused with pink lemonade flavour for a bright, sweet-tart profile with natural lemon zest and a clean, refreshing finish. Its lower strength and easy-going flavour make it a simple choice for highballs, shots and warm-weather pitchers.

Tasting Notes: Sweet pink lemonade, lemon zest and a clean finish.

Serve: On the rocks, or topped with club soda.

penderyn-icon-of-wales-hiraeth.title: Penderyn Icons of Wales Hiraeth Single Malt Welsh Whisky
penderyn-icon-of-wales-hiraeth.bodyHtml:
Penderyn Hiraeth is number 8 in Penderyn's Icons of Wales series, launched in December 2021. It celebrates the Welsh word hiraeth, hard to translate but often rendered as yearning or homesickness: a longing for your homeland, your heritage and your very being. It was the first time Penderyn released a core-range single malt made mainly with spirit from its pot stills, introduced in 2014. The whisky is finished in ex-bourbon casks, non-chill filtered and bottled at 46% ABV, presented in a gold bottle and black dragon tube, 700ml.

Nose: Elegant and floral, with light oak, vanilla, raisins, toffee apple, citrus peel and a hint of lime.

Palate: Delicate and smooth, with honeyed fruit, vanilla, cinnamon and a touch of nutmeg.

Finish: Soft honey and vanilla fading to malt.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

benriach-16-year-old.title: Benriach The Sixteen 16 Year Old
benriach-16-year-old.bodyHtml:
Benriach The Sixteen 16 Year Old is a rich, multi-layered Speyside single malt Scotch whisky crafted at the historic Benriach Distillery near Elgin. Revived as the flagship age-statement release in Benriach's core range under Master Blender Rachel Barrie, this unpeated expression undergoes a signature three-cask maturation for a minimum of sixteen years in bourbon barrels, sherry casks, and virgin oak casks. This intricate wood management harmonizes Benriach's vibrant orchard-fruit distillery character with decadent notes of baked stone fruit, wild honey, roasted hazelnuts, and warm oak spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-roasted duck breast with an orange or fig glaze, seared pork tenderloin with apple chutney, aged hard cheeses such as Comté or mature cheddar, spiced pecan tarts, and dark chocolate truffles.

Tasting Notes : Rich burnished gold with warm amber reflections, presenting a medium-to-full body with a silky, creamy, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Baked orchard apples, stewed apricots, wildflower honey, toasted hazelnuts, warm ginger, and seasoned oak.

Palate : Lush and rounded with flavors of caramelized stone fruits, rich malt, dark toffee, roasted nuts, orange peel, and gentle wood spices.

Finish : Long, warming, and balanced with lingering notes of honeyed malt, dried fruit sweetness, and toasted oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or tulip-shaped whisky tasting glass, or add a few drops of pure spring water to unlock deeper orchard fruit and floral undertones.

ardnamurchan-madeira-cask-single-malt.title: Ardnamurchan AD Madeira Cask Release 2025
ardnamurchan-madeira-cask-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Ardnamurchan Madeira Cask Release 2025 is a captivating and textural Highland single malt Scotch whisky that brilliantly balances sweet wine influences with coastal character. Distilled in 2018, this limited-edition release utilizes a composition of roughly 57% unpeated and 43% peated spirit. The liquid was initially matured in ex-bourbon barrels before undergoing a secondary finishing period of over two years in rich Madeira wine casks. The nose opens with notes of cocoa powder, stewed plums, sugared almonds, and warm nutmeg. On the palate, it unfolds with layers of cinnamon candy, salted trail mix, dark chocolate, toffee apple, and fresh rosemary, all pinned down by a gentle, piney peat smoke and a whisper of maritime minerality. It is bottled with its natural color and without chill filtration.

Food Pairing: Complements rich dessert and savory pairings beautifully, such as dark chocolate lava cake, artisanal blue cheese, pan-seared duck breast with a cherry reduction, or smoked venison.

patron-gran-burdeos-tequila.title: Gran Patron Burdeos Anejo Tequila
patron-gran-burdeos-tequila.bodyHtml:
A luxury añejo tequila finished in Bordeaux wine barrels.

Gran Patrón Burdeos is crafted in very limited quantities from the finest 100% Weber Blue Agave grown in the Highlands of Jalisco. Twice distilled and aged in used American and new French oak barrels, it is then finished in vintage Bordeaux wine barrels, which impart a dark amber color and a taste that´s velvety smooth with hints of vanilla and raisins.

dewars-double-double-21-year-old.title: Dewar's Double Double 21 Year Old 375ml
dewars-double-double-21-year-old.bodyHtml:
Experience the epitome of Scotch whisky craftsmanship with Dewar's Double Double 21 Year Old Blended Scotch Whisky, presented in an accessible 375ml bottle. This meticulously crafted, limited edition blend is the result of a unique four-step maturation process that delivers an unmatched balance of flavours and an unparalleled smoothness.

Aged for a minimum of 21 years, this premium blend features a rich and sophisticated flavour profile. Indulge in sumptuous notes of dark chocolate, ripe stone fruits, and warm spices, enhanced by the subtle sweetness imparted by the sherry cask finish. The Dewar's Double Double 21 Year Old is a true testament to the brand's dedication to innovation and excellence in whisky production.

Whether you're a whisky connoisseur seeking a rare and exceptional addition to your collection or looking for an unforgettable gift, Dewar's Double Double 21 Year Old Blended Scotch Whisky is the perfect choice. Don't miss the opportunity to experience this remarkable, limited edition blend—order yours today!

ornellaia-bolgheri-2019.title: Ornellaia 2019
ornellaia-bolgheri-2019.bodyHtml:
With an intense ruby-red colour, Ornellaia 2019 has a bouquet full of intriguing spicy and balsamic notes, including aromas of black pepper, sage, and aromatic herbs. The wine is both full-bodied and vibrant in the mouth, filling the palate with its dense and elegant tannic texture and ending with a persistent and beautifully crisp finish.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
This is a beautiful expression of coastal Tuscany and the sunny Mediterranean. The Ornellaia 2019 Bolgheri Superiore Ornellaia (a blend of 62% Cabernet Sauvignon, 31% Merlot, 4% Cabernet Franc and 3% Petit Verdot) pours from the bottle with a specific darkness that has elements of both inky saturation and ruby highlights. The wine is saturated and rich—this is something you notice off the bat—but it also reveals a pleasing lightness or grace that is transmitted to both the bouquet and the palate. Dark fruit, pressed blackberry and plum mingle with more substantial aromas of spice, leather and sweetly cured tobacco. The tannins are beautifully managed, and the wine sports considerable heft and density on the palate that drives a very long and pleasurable mouthfeel.

97 Points - James Suckling
The aromas of blackcurrants, fresh basil and thyme, as well as cedar and sandalwood are so attractive. It’s full-bodied and very linear with tight tannins that draw you down the length of this young wine. Wet-earth and cool-stone undertones. It’s solid and so structured. A classic Ornellaia for the cellar. Best after 2027.
96 Points - Wine Spectator
A youthful red, concentrated and balanced, with blackberry, plum, earth and spice flavors gaining lift from the vibrant structure, while tannins envelop the lively fruit components. The finish is shored up by fine-grained tannins. This has all the components in the right place. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2025 through 2043. 2,000 cases imported.

cognac-lot-75-gc-htibg.title: Malternative x Heads & Tails x Moonbroch Laurichesse Lot 75 1975 Grand Champagne Cognac
cognac-lot-75-gc-htibg.bodyHtml:
Bottled exclusively for Canada by Heads & Tails and Moonbroch, this is possibly part of the same Lot 75 that was bottled on the same date as "cognac #18 "Le Chef de Meute" (Lot 75) - Malternative Belgium - 50,3%" that was scored 91 points by Whiskynotes.be. This Lot 75 is also bottled at 50.3%.

Another gem of a Cognac!

cognac-lot-82-pc-htibg.title: Malternative x Heads & Tails x Moonbroch Lot 82 1982 Petite Champagne Cognac
cognac-lot-82-pc-htibg.bodyHtml:
Malternative Belgium Lot 82 Petite Champagne Cognac is an independent bottling selected by Belgian bottler Malternative Belgium, whose range concentrates mainly on Cognac. The label identifies it as Lot 82 from the Appellation Cognac Petite Champagne Contrôlée, gives its origin as Archiac, and states that it was bottled at the property. It is presented at 44% ABV in a 70cl bottle, under a painted label of a rearing black horse leaping from the water in front of two startled figures.

Serve: Neat in a tulip glass at room temperature.

ao-yun-2017.title: Ao Yun 2017
ao-yun-2017.bodyHtml:
Ao Yun 2017 is a concentrated, velvety Himalayan icon that represents the historic fifth vintage from this pioneering LVMH estate. Rooted at staggering altitudes between 2,200 and 2,600 meters in Yunnan, China, the vines are meticulously tended by hand across 314 tiny parcels belonging to local farming families. The 2017 growing season was defined by extreme climate variations—including a wet summer and a record-breaking late harvest that concluded on November 22nd. Crucially, this vintage marks the first time winemaker Maxence Dulou introduced Merlot into the blend to soften the variety's intense high-altitude structure. To counteract the 25% lower oxygen levels at the cellar's altitude, the winemaking team increased micro-oxygenation during its 14-month aging regime (38% new French oak, 62% older barrels).

In the glass, it reveals an opaque, exceptionally deep dark ruby color. The bouquet is remarkably intense, unfolding with ripe blackcurrants, wild blackberries, and plums, layered over complex, savory nuances of game, damp autumn forest floor, cold fireplace ash, and black tea. On the palate, it is full-bodied, dense, and remarkably round ($14.5\%$ ABV), displaying more immediate, plush mid-palate flesh than previous years. A massive concentration of dark savory fruit is framed by powdery, velvety tannins and balanced by Ao Yun’s signature spine of crisp Himalayan acidity, concluding with a long, distinctly saline mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Slow-cooked beef short ribs, roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, peking duck, or grilled venison loin.

97 Points - James Suckling

Another step up in quality from 2016. Lots of blackberry and blueberry aromas with plenty of richness and ripeness on the nose. Spicy notes, too with dried chili, sweet tobacco and some pine. Very aromatic. Full-bodied and round with creamy, ripe tannins and lots of ripe fruit. Yet, it remains fresh and vivid. A little bit of merlot in the blend for the first time Mostly cabernet sauvignon with cabernet franc, syrah, petit verdot and merlot. Delicious now, but will age nicely. It’s more approachable than the 2016 now. Superb length here. Give it time in the bottle. Better after 2025.

armand-de-brignac-blanc-de-blancs.title: Armand De Brignac Ace of Spades Brut Gold Champagne
armand-de-brignac-blanc-de-blancs.bodyHtml:
Armand De Brignac Ace of Spades Brut Gold Champagne is a prestige, multi-vintage cuvée produced by the Cattier family in the Montagne de Reims region of Champagne. Handcrafted using traditional pressings and a blend of three distinct vintages, this flagship expression is composed of 40% Chardonnay, 40% Pinot Noir, and 20% Pinot Meunier. In the glass, it displays a brilliant golden color with fine, persistent bubbles. The nose opens with vibrant aromas of yellow peach, baked brioche, candied citrus peel, and white flowers. On the palate, it is rich, creamy, and complex, featuring layers of ripe stone fruit, honey, and subtle toasted brioche, all balanced by a crisp, mineral-driven acidity that carries through to a long, silky finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, caviar, butter-poached lobster, pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken, and aged Comté cheese.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The NV Brut Gold is fleshy and expressive and opens in the glass with aromas of Anjou pear, dried apricot, yellow apple and buttery pastry, complemented by hints of almond paste. Medium- to full-bodied, flavorful and giving, it possesses a sweet core of fruit that's underpinned by succulent yet vibrant acidity. Soundly made and harmonious, it is a decidedly stronger effort than the house's latest Blanc de Blancs. It was disgorged with a dosage of nine grams per liter.

92 Points - James Suckling

Lots of orchard fruit and grapefruit character. Medium-bodied with a creamy texture and a lightly spicy finish, this delivers a nice balance of fresh fruit like lychees and pears. Drink now.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant, creamy Champagne, with pretty apple blossom and spice notes leading to finely meshed flavors of ripe white cherry, whole-grain toast and spun honey, framed by fresh, citrusy acidity. Drink now through 2021.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A blend of Chardonnay, Pinot Meunier and Pinot Noir, this ripe, well-balanced wine has some toast that adds complexity and richness to the apple and lemon fruit, indicating a mature bottling. The wine in a gold-foil bottle is one of five made by the Cattier house for rapper and entrepreneur Jay Z's Armand de Brignac Empire brand with the “Ace of Spades” logo.

armand-de-brignac-demi-sec.title: Armand De Brignac Ace of Spades Demi-Sec Champagne 750ml
armand-de-brignac-demi-sec.bodyHtml:
The only prestige cuvée Demi Sec in the world, this unique champagne is crafted using just the ultra-selective first portion of the cuvée press – a winemaking signature of all Armand de Brignac assemblages. With a dosage on the lowest end of the Demi Sec spectrum, it delivers powerful fruit flavor, complexity from additional age on lees, and a balanced sweetness that makes it the perfect accompaniment to an array of cuisines.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is the sweetest of the five Champagnes by rapper and entrepreneur Jay Z under the Armand de Brignac Empire brand. It is a well-tuned wine—fruity while maintaining the soft aftertaste of a demi-sec. The balance is impeccable: ripe and full. In its shiny purple bottle with the signature Ace of Spades logo, it is ready to drink.

taynton-bay-spirits-raspberry-vodka.title: Taynton Bay Blueberry Lemon & Rooibos
taynton-bay-spirits-raspberry-vodka.bodyHtml: Our Wild Cocktails are destined to be the life of the party, and all your favourite flavours are invited. Blueberry & Lemon come together with a sweet touch of Rooibos Tea to create a delightfully refreshing ready-to-go cocktail. Keep it simple and pour over ice, or unlock your inner mixologist with one of our fave recipes below.

wayne-gretzky-double-oaked-whisky.title: Wayne Gretzky No. 99 Double Oaked Canadian Whisky
wayne-gretzky-double-oaked-whisky.bodyHtml:
Wayne Gretzky Double Oaked Whisky is a bold, deeply flavorful, and highly acclaimed Canadian blended whisky that showcases an intensive wood-finishing process. Crafted from 100% locally sourced Ontario grains—including rye, malted rye, and corn—the individual components are distilled and initially matured in a combination of once-used American bourbon barrels and new American oak casks. The spirits are then masterfully blended and transferred into custom, in-house recouped American oak barrels featuring a medium-plus toast and a Char level no. 3. This secondary maturation infuses the spirit with a rich, complex wood character that balances sweet, maple-driven tones with a distinct, smoky wood character.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully alongside sticky maple-glazed barbecue ribs, smoked beef brisket, grilled steaks, molasses-marinated meats, extra-aged gouda cheese, or a warm pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber-bronze in appearance with a rich, smooth, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Robust aromas of toasted oak, sweet vanilla, dark caramel, butterscotch, and warm baking spices with a subtle hint of smoke.

Palate : Full and warm on the palate with distinct layers of charred oak, dark chocolate, vanilla, rye spice, and rich brown sugar.

Finish : Long, warm, and satisfying with persistent notes of sweet wood spice, toasted oak, and smooth caramel.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tasting glass, on the rocks, or as a bold base for classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned.

whistlepig-farmstock-rye.title: WhistlePig Farmstock Rye
whistlepig-farmstock-rye.bodyHtml:
A fantastic milestone release that celebrates WhistlePig’s journey toward becoming a fully grain-to-glass distillery. FarmStock is a meticulously crafted "Triple Terroir" blend that marries their own young, punchy Vermont-distilled rye (made with their own grain, water, and custom oak) with heavily aged, deeply complex sourced ryes. Bottled at 86 proof, this masterful blending results in a highly approachable, incredibly dynamic, and deeply flavorful whiskey that offers the absolute best of both worlds.

 

NOSE

Bright, earthy, and aromatic with prominent notes of fresh-cut rye grass, warm vanilla, sweet honey, and heavily charred oak.

PALATE

Smooth, rich, and highly balanced. A lively rush of peppery spice and citrus is beautifully rounded out by deep caramel, toasted nuts, and baked apple.

FINISH

Clean, medium-length, and satisfying with a gentle, lingering spice and sweet wood.

dalwhinnie-distillers-edition.title: Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition 2022
dalwhinnie-distillers-edition.bodyHtml:
“Madly sited”, perched high between two mountain ranges on a pass once a meeting point for cattle drovers on their way to market. The name Dalwhinnie translates from Gaelic as “Plain of Meetings”. Surviving periods of closure, the distillery has produced its distinctive single malt since 1947, only being completely modernized in 1996. Dalwhinnie has the coldest annual mean temperature of any inhabited place in Scotland and is so cold in winter, that the water in the outside worm tubs can freeze. That very coldness lends an intensity to the spirit that is even more marked in winter.

The DISTILLERS EDITION is a collection of master-craftsmanship. Each cask in the series is individually selected and perfectly matched to the character of each of the single malts refined here. The two-parted maturation process gives more depth and complexity, which is the idea behind the limited DISTILLERS EDITION: preserving the perfection of the single malts that have already been awarded for their outstanding flavours. The selected taste nuances are more strongly accentuated in a way that is not found in the regular bottlings, but with fully maintaining the original character of these fine single malts.

glenkinchie-distillers-edition.title: Glenkinchie 2022 Distillers Edition
glenkinchie-distillers-edition.bodyHtml:
Glenkinchie 2022 Distillers Edition is a Lowland single malt Scotch whisky from the distillery known as The Edinburgh Malt, founded in 1837 by farmers George and John Rate some twenty miles from the city. The Distillers Edition series, released annually in limited quantities since 1997, gives each classic malt a second maturation in a cask chosen to suit its character. This edition was first matured in refill American and European oak casks, then finished in re-charred American oak casks seasoned with Amontillado sherry, which adds a nutty, gently dry layer to Glenkinchie's light, grassy style. Bottled at 43% ABV; this listing is the 750ml bottle.

Nose: Crisp and complex, balancing dry wine notes with sweeter, nutty notes of barley and cask wood.

Palate: Lightly oily and malty-sweet, then spicy with raisin and date; creamy and lightly grapey, drying with wood spice.

Finish: Very long, drying and oaky, with a light white-pepper spice.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

honig-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Honig Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
honig-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The wine displays ripe blackberry fruit complemented by cherry and cassis on the finish, with seamlessly integrated spice and vanilla notes, a rich midpalate, and a lingering finish balanced by just the right amount of acidity and tannin.

91 Points - James Suckling

Attractive nose of blackberries, kirsch and hints of dried flowers and walnuts. Full and well-structured with ripe yet lightly chewy tannins and deep, succulent fruit underneath. Intense, bitter-spice finish.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Honig's 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon delivers notes of cedar, loam, black cherries and dried spices. Matured in a combination of French and American oak, it's full-bodied, silky-velvety in texture and softly tannic, with ample length and texture on the finish, which reveals a subtle hint of raisined fruit. Don't expect it to age much past a decade from the vintage, so enjoy this fine value while it's young.

alpha-zeta-ripasso-superiore.title: Alpha Zeta 'R' Valpolicella Ripasso Superiore 2021
alpha-zeta-ripasso-superiore.bodyHtml:
Ruby red in colour, with a concentrated perfume of red and black cherries, with the ripasso adding a dried cherry intensity. Full-bodied on the palate, with a lovely balance between opulent cherry-pie character and supple structure. Good length with a mouthwatering bitter-cherry twist on the finish.

91 Points - James Suckling
"A rich and layered Ripasso with dark fruit, chocolate, and spice notes. Balanced and robust, offering great depth and complexity for its price."


90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"Boasts concentrated flavors of dried cherry, fig, and a touch of mocha. Full-bodied and smooth, representing excellent value in the Ripasso category."

harlan-estate-2009.title: Harlan Estate 2009
harlan-estate-2009.bodyHtml:
The 2009 Harlan Estate is a legendary and high-scoring vintage from a year characterized by a long, warm growing season. This wine is celebrated for its immense power, structural integrity, and extraordinary depth. It offers an opaque purple color and an intense bouquet of crème de cassis, black cherries, and blackberries, seamlessly integrated with notes of graphite, forest floor, and espresso. On the palate, it is full-bodied and opulent, showcasing a massive core of ripe fruit supported by velvety, fine-grained tannins and a persistent mineral-driven finish. It is a monumental expression of the Oakville terroir with a lifespan capable of several decades.

97 Points - Robert Parker's The Wine Advocate

The 2009 Proprietary Blend Harlan Estate is just as impressive from bottle as it was from barrel. Cloves, dark plums, cherries, smoke and graphite add richness and resonance to this powerful, incisive wine. Juicy and exuberant, the 2009 has always had a certain raciness that is impossible to resist. Layers of fruit continue to build to the enveloping, sensual finish. Readers will have a hard time keeping their hands off this hugely delicious wine. Anticipated maturity: 2019-2034.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Offering a Pomerol-like silkiness, this is very rich and layered, with ripe dark berry, roasted plum and cassis flavors. Yet what's striking is the texture, which has the density of the proverbial iron fist in a velvet glove.

la-crema-oregon-pinot-noir.title: La Crema Monterey Pinot Noir 2023
la-crema-oregon-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
La Crema Monterey Pinot Noir 2023 is an elegant, expressive, and highly acclaimed cool-climate red wine that brilliantly highlights the unique terroir of California's Central Coast. On the nose, enticing aromas of freeze-dried strawberry, black plum, and fresh rhubarb mingle with hints of earthy loam and a dusty mineral note. The palate entry is snappy, bright, and richly textured, revealing layered flavors of red cherry, raspberry, and pomegranate balanced by a subtle undercurrent of black tea, white pepper, and sagebrush. Supported by integrated toast from oak aging and juicy, well-calibrated acidity, it culminates in a soft, supple finish.

Food Pairing: Pan-roasted duck breast, wild mushroom risotto, grilled salmon, herb-roasted chicken, and aged Gruyère cheese.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This bottling from what's turning out to be an epic vintage punches far above its price class, and stays on point even days after being opened. Aromas of freeze-dried strawberries set in a pile of dusty white rocks combines freshness with earthiness on the nose. The palate is snappy, bright and yet rich with raspberry, rose petal, white pepper and sagebrush flavors.

jayson-cabernet.title: Jayson Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
jayson-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Jayson Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a plush, deeply concentrated, and beautifully balanced Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon crafted by Pahlmeyer. Sourced from choice vineyard sites across the valley floor and steep mountain slopes, it offers classic varietal aromas of ripe blackberry, dark plum, cassis, and black cherry, interwoven with notes of dark forest floor, cedar, cocoa, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, the wine is rich, full-bodied, and layered, displaying a generous core of dark fruit supported by smooth, polished tannins and a vibrant line of acidity that carries through to a long, decadent, oak-accented finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison, and aged hard cheeses such as sharp Cheddar or Gouda.

94 Points - James Suckling

So creamy, chocolatey and layered despite full tannins and a full body, this is a rich, oak-spiced and saturated, classic Napa cabernet. Aged in 70% new French barrels for 15 months, it offers black cherries and blackberries with vanilla bean, cocoa, cassis and toasted walnut accents. A big wine that’s drinkable now with a rich protein. Best from 2028.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Frankly ripe, offering an enticing gush of açaí, blackberry and black currant compote notes that roll through, carried by warm humus, licorice root and singed alder notes. A muscular style, this is defined, with subtle, latent energy through the finish. Best from 2025 through 2037. 

93 points - Wine Enthusiast

Juicy and full of flavor, this savory Cabernet Sauvignon-based blend brings together all five Bordeaux varieties for a complete and mouthwatering wine. Flavors of ripe black fruits and bramble combine with tobacco and herbs for a lengthy and enticing wine.

jayson-red.title: Pahlmeyer Jayson Red 2021
jayson-red.bodyHtml:
Pahlmeyer Jayson Red 2021 is a lush, expressive, and exquisitely balanced Napa Valley red blend anchored by mountain-grown Merlot. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby-purple hue with brilliant crimson reflections. The aromatic profile is rich and layered, opening with notes of ripe black cherries, macerated plums, and fresh blackcurrants interwoven with nuances of mocha, forest floor, cedar, and delicate baking spices from Taransaud French oak aging. On the palate, it delivers a generous, velvety texture with a concentrated core of dark fruit, framed by fine-grained, supple tannins and lively natural acidity that culminate in a long, polished, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Char-grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted duck breast with cherry reduction, rosemary rack of lamb, braised short ribs, and mature aged cheddar.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackcurrants come through clearly along with hints of lead pencil. It’s medium- to full-bodied with fine velvety tannins and a flavorful finish. Caressing texture and not overdone. Lovely now to drink as a young wine but it will be even better in three to five years.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Juicy and full of flavor, this savory Cabernet Sauvignon-based blend brings together all five Bordeaux varieties for a complete and mouthwatering wine. Flavors of ripe black fruits and bramble combine with tobacco and herbs for a lengthy and enticing wine.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich and handsomely structured, this blend is generous, with black cherry, toasty spice and licorice flavors as this builds tension toward refined tannins. Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. Drink now through 2031. 6,077 cases made.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of 76% Merlot, 12% Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Malbec, 4% Petit Verdot and 1% Cabernet Franc, the 2021 Jayson Red Wine offers up seductive scents of black cherries, mocha and cassis. It's medium to full-bodied, silky and refined, but it's also a bit modest in intensity, much like the Jayson Chardonnay.

banded-peak-tooth-claw-cherry-saison-3.title: Banded Peak Tooth & Claw Cherry Saison 500ml

michelob-ultra-10.title: Michelob Ultra 473ml Can
michelob-ultra-10.bodyHtml:
Michelob Ultra is a light lager produced by Anheuser-Busch, engineered to appeal to active and health-conscious consumers. First introduced in 2002, it features a lower carbohydrate and calorie count than traditional lagers, offering a clean, crisp, and refreshingly light taste with subtle citrus notes and a bright, effervescent carbonation.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken salad, fresh ceviche, light fish tacos, sushi, steamed seafood, and mild goat cheese.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant pale straw yellow in appearance with a thin white head and a light, crisp, and highly carbonated mouthfeel.

Nose : Subtle and clean with gentle notes of sweet malt, light rice, and a faint hint of citrus hops.

Palate : Exceptionally light and refreshing, featuring clean cereal grain, a touch of cracker malt sweetness, and minimal hop bitterness.

Finish : Very short, crisp, and clean with zero lingering aftertaste and a dry, fizzy close.

Serve : Serve ice-cold directly from the bottle or can, or poured into a chilled pilsner glass.

stanley-park-peach-vibes-hazy-ipa.title: Stanley Park Concession Mixer 12 Cans
stanley-park-peach-vibes-hazy-ipa.bodyHtml: The Stanley Park Concession Stand Mix Pack is a diverse, refreshing collection of easy-drinking beers inspired by the iconic concession stands of Vancouver’s Stanley Park. This 12-can variety pack typically features three cans each of four different fruit-forward or crisp styles, such as Sunsetter Peach Wheat Ale, Waypoint Hazy Pale Ale, Trail Hopper IPA, and Electro Lager. It is designed for high drinkability and social outdoor occasions, offering a balanced range from citrusy and tart to clean and malty.

lucky-lager-11.title: Lucky Lager 8 Cans
lucky-lager-11.bodyHtml: Lucky Lager is a classic Canadian lager that has been quality-brewed since 1934. Known for its clean, crisp, and refreshing taste, this easy-drinking beer is a lighter-tasting lager with a light body and balanced malt and hop flavors. It's a straightforward, no-fuss beer perfect for casual enjoyment.

glengoyne-25-year-old.title: Glengoyne 12 Year Old
glengoyne-25-year-old.bodyHtml: The Glengoyne 12-Year-Old is an unpeated Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky, a testament to a production process that prides itself on patience, one of  Scotland’s slowest distillations. Matured for 12 years in hand-selected sherry casks, it has a well-balanced character where fruit and sweetness take center stage without a hint of smoke. At 43% ABV, it is a complex yet approachable dram, certified vegan and sustainably produced.

brewhouse-lager-2.title: Brewhouse Light 36 Cans
brewhouse-lager-2.bodyHtml: A crisp, perfectly balanced light lager made with 100% Western Canadian barley. It is precision-crafted and cold-filtered for a refreshingly smooth taste

brewhouse-lager-3.title: Brewhouse Light 36 Cans
brewhouse-lager-3.bodyHtml: A crisp, perfectly balanced light lager made with 100% Western Canadian barley. It is precision-crafted and cold-filtered for a refreshingly smooth taste

great-western-lager.title: Bow Valley Lager 15 Cans
great-western-lager.bodyHtml:
Bow Valley Lager is a refreshing Canadian pale lager with an easy-drinking character inspired by the Rocky Mountains. Featuring a clean malt profile, subtle toasted grain notes and gentle herbal hop bitterness, this approachable beer delivers a crisp, dry finish. Packaged in fifteen 355ml cans at 5.0% ABV, it is ideal for gatherings.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with grilled burgers, barbecue chicken, pepperoni pizza, crispy fries, nachos and salted pretzels.

Tasting Notes: Light-bodied and refreshing with subtle toasted malt, grain character and restrained herbal hop bitterness.

Nose: Light cereal malt, toasted grain and delicate herbal hop aromas.

Palate: Gentle malt sweetness, cracker notes and lively carbonation with balanced bitterness.

Finish: Crisp, clean and dry with mild lingering hop character.

original-16-canadian-pale-ale-1.title: Original16 Pale Ale 15 Cans
original-16-canadian-pale-ale-1.bodyHtml: A smooth, refreshing beer, with a real beer taste. Brewed using only the finest, two-row Prairie barley, five choice hop varietals, and 100% Copeland malt.

lacrima-di-morro-superiore.title: Velenosi Lacrima di Morro Superiore 2022
lacrima-di-morro-superiore.bodyHtml:
Intense ruby red with violet hues. A particularly rich suite of aromas. Intense fruity scents of strawberry and morello cherries along with floral nuances of violet and rosebuds. A supple sip reveals a rounded, lingering richness of flavor. Succulent with a mild tannin content and a dominant smoothness, all in harmony with the bouquet.

91 Points - James Suckling

Ripe black fruit and dried herbs on the nose, as well as a deep, savory note that’s a little like toasted coconut. Medium- to full-bodied with the same mix of fruity and savory elements. The tannins are well immersed in the wine, giving both a silky texture and some length. Drink now.

dominus-estate-imperial.title: Dominus Estate 2019 6L Imperial
dominus-estate-imperial.bodyHtml:
Dominus Estate is the Napa Valley property of Bordeaux producer Christian Moueix. The wine is bottled from the historic Napanook Vineyard. Located at the foothills of the Mayacamas, the vineyard was planted in 1838 and continues to evolve under the stewardship of Christian Moueix. The estate’s Bordeaux varietals benefit from the Yountville microclimate where temperatures are moderated by cool breezes from the San Pablo Bay. The resulting wine is a uniquely refined expression of this special terroir.

98 Points - James Suckling

Lots of crushed stone, lead pencil and licorice aromas that are extremely aromatic and bright. Black cherries, cloves and purple fruit, too. Full body and a round and ripe center-palate with a juicy interior. It opens at the end with a savory and juicy finish. Layered and beautiful. Drinkable now, but better in three or four years.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Dominus is blend of 90% Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Petit Verdot and 4% Cabernet Franc, aged in 40% new French oak. Impressively dark-hued in the glass, it yields scents of cherries and cassis on the nose—or is it black cherries and redcurrants? Subtle notes of mocha, pencil shavings and almost Graves-like earthiness wind through the concentrated, medium to full-bodied palate, giving it a sense of savory gravitas, while the finish is silky and long, leaving a lingering residue of soft tannins and mouthwatering freshness.
96 Points - Wine Spectator
A loaded wine, though reserved in style, with waves of dense cassis, plum reduction and blackberry preserves moving through authoritatively, while sweet bay leaf, warm loam and tobacco accents fill in the background. The long cast iron spine is deeply buried in the fruit, and this has superior cut and drive. Built for serious cellaring, too. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Best from 2024.

joseph-phelps-insignia-1.title: Joseph Phelps Insignia 2019 6L Imperial
joseph-phelps-insignia-1.bodyHtml:
The 2019 Insignia opens with heady aromatics of red fruit, crème de cassis, leafy tobacco and delicate dried rose petals. The palate is juicy and dense with expressive layers of blackberry, raspberry, black currant, and dark chocolate. A dynamic wine offering captivating energy, length, complexity and refinement. The 2019 Insignia marks the first vintage to include fruit from the new Joseph Phelps vineyard named El Venadito, located in the Oak Knoll District, just south of the winery’s Yountville Vineyard.

99 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Another beautiful wine from this team, the 2019 Insignia is mostly Cabernet Sauvignon but includes smaller amounts of Merlot and Malbec, brought up all in new barrels, sourced from seven estate vineyards. It has a classic varietal and incredibly complex nose of crème de cassis, freshly sharpened pencils, green tobacco, and damp earth, with a kiss of background sappy spring flowers. Seemingly from a cooler year with its freshness, vibrancy, and herbal, floral character on the nose, it's nevertheless full-bodied and beautifully concentrated on the palate, with ultra-fine tannins, a seamless, layered mouthfeel, and a gorgeous finish. Unquestionably up with the finest vintages of this cuvée, this is legit awesome juice that’s going to offer incredible pleasure over the coming 20-25 years. Hats off to winemaker Ashley Hepworth.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

More elegant and refined than the Napa Cab, the 2019 Insignia features restrained cedar and vanilla notes (despite spending two years in 100% new French oak) and delicate herbal shadings accenting cassis and black cherry fruit. Full-bodied, velvety and somewhat open-knit on the palate, it turns plush and long on the finish, adding a touch of warmth. Production this year is approximately 17,000 cases, reflecting the increased volume coming from recently replanted vineyards. It's remarkable what a good job they continue to do with this bottling year after year, without compromising on quality.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A solidly built Cabernet with a very direct persona, as dark currant, warmed fig reduction and blackberry fruit paste are bolted together with licorice root and singed cedar. Features an espresso crema hint on the finish, which keeps this on the dark, muscular side. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Best from 2023 through 2038.

joseph-phelps-insignia-3l.title: Joseph Phelps Insignia 2019 3L Double Magnum
joseph-phelps-insignia-3l.bodyHtml:

adelphi-ardmore-2002.title: Adelphi Ardmore 18 Year Old 2002 Refill Bourbon Hogshead Cask 285 55.8% ABV
adelphi-ardmore-2002.bodyHtml:
Ardmore 18 Year Old 2002 is a single cask Highland single malt bottled by the independent bottler Adelphi. Ardmore has long produced peated malt, much of it for blending, and this cask shows that smoky mainland character after 18 years in a refill bourbon hogshead, cask 285. It was bottled at a cask strength of 55.8% ABV, with only 226 bottles of 700 ml. Adelphi notes a yellow-gold colour with a good bead and a pungent, spicy, smoky profile.

Tasting Notes: Dark fruit, smoked fish and cured meat with earthy smoke.

Nose: Prunes, forest floor, peanut brittle, kippers, speck and soot.

Palate: Leather, pine needles, green peppercorn, brine and smouldering barbecue embers.

Finish: Long and green.

Serve: Neat, then with a splash of water.

aberlour-2006.title: Maltbarn Aberlour 2006 12 Year Old 52.1% ABV
