aberlour-2006.bodyHtml:
Aberlour 12 Year Old 2006 Maltbarn is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from the German independent bottler Maltbarn, released as Maltbarn No. 110. It was distilled at Aberlour Distillery in 2006 and matured in a single sherry cask for 12 years before being bottled in 2018. The cask yielded just 155 bottles. It is bottled without added colouring and without chill filtration at 52.1% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Small single-cask outturns like this are rarely repeated, which makes it a bottle for collectors and for drinkers who enjoy comparing distillery character across independent releases.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

adelphi-distilled-in-dufftown.title: Adelphi Selection Penderyn 8 Year Old 2015 Cask #1177 Welsh Single Malt Whisky
adelphi-distilled-in-dufftown.bodyHtml:
Adelphi Selection Penderyn 8 Year Old 2015 Cask #1177 Welsh Single Malt Whisky is a limited single-cask release from Penderyn Distillery in Wales, selected and bottled by independent bottler Adelphi as part of the Adelphi Selection. Distilled in 2015 and bottled in 2024 after eight years of maturation, the whisky was drawn from Cask #1177, a single first-fill bourbon barrel. Bottled at natural cask strength of 56.9% ABV without chill filtration or added colouring, the cask yielded only 247 bottles.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, roast pork with apple, aged cheddar, lemon tart, vanilla crème brûlée, toasted almonds, and buttery shortbread.

Tasting Notes: A bright, concentrated Welsh single malt combining delicate fruit and citrus character with vanilla sweetness and fresh herbal notes from its first-fill bourbon maturation.

Nose: Fresh-cut basil, biscuit, birch and lemon marmalade, with delicate vanilla and orchard-fruit character.

Palate: Bright citrus and apple character with vanilla sweetness, biscuit and fresh herbal accents, carried by the whisky's full cask-strength texture.

Finish: Lingering citrus, vanilla and gentle bourbon-oak character with a fresh herbal edge.

2009-ardmore-46-signatory-vintage.title: Signatory Vintage Ardmore 2009 46%
2009-ardmore-46-signatory-vintage.bodyHtml:
Ardmore 2009 from Signatory Vintage's Un-Chillfiltered Collection is a Highland single malt from Ardmore, the Aberdeenshire distillery known for its peated spirit. It was drawn from two bourbon barrels, nos. 800976 and 800989, and bottled at 46% ABV with natural colour and no chill filtration, in a 700ml bottle. Bottlings like this offer a rare look at Ardmore as a single malt, as most of the distillery's output goes into blends.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

1997-glentauchers-48-9-signatory.title: Signatory Vintage Glentauchers 1997 22 Year Old 48.9%
1997-glentauchers-48-9-signatory.bodyHtml: A 1997 Glantauchers single malt from indie bottler Signatory Vintage, matured in a pair of bourbon barrels for 22 years, before being bottled in March 2020 as part of its Cask Strength Collection.

2007-knockando-46-signatory.title: Signatory Vintage Knockando 13 Year Old 2007
2007-knockando-46-signatory.bodyHtml:
Knockando 13 Year Old 2007 Signatory Vintage is a Speyside single malt from the Knockando distillery, bottled by the independent bottler Signatory Vintage. Distilled in 2007, the spirit was filled into a pair of hogsheads, casks 304100 and 304104, and bottled at 13 years old at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Independent Knockando bottlings appear only rarely, and this one shows a fresh, fruity side of the distillery. The nose is honeyed, with melon, dried apricot and cranberry over malt and heather honey. The palate is big, lush and warming, floral with vanilla, fig jam and marmalade, gentle toasted oak, almond and chewy barley.

Nose: Honeyed melon, dried apricot, cranberry, malt and heather honey.

Palate: Lush and warming, with vanilla, fig jam, marmalade, toasted oak, almond and barley.

Finish: Medium, soft and warming, with bright fruit and toasted oak.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

adelphi-benriach.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Benriach 1999 Cask #63204 57.1% ABV
adelphi-benriach.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseur's Choice Benriach 1999 Cask # 63204 is an exceptional single cask Speyside single malt Scotch whisky. Distilled at the Benriach Distillery in 1999, it was matured for 24 years in a single refill sherry butt (#63204) before being bottled at cask strength by independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail in 2024.

Food Pairing: Rich venison stew, roasted duck breast with fruit reduction, aged Gouda or Manchego cheese, dark chocolate tarts, or sticky toffee pudding.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber in appearance with a full-bodied, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Brazil nut combines with Seville orange, subtle lavender, raisin, baked apple, and a hint of aniseed.

Palate : Sweet raspberry liquorice leads to prunes, ashy undertones, treacle toffee, ginger spice, and charred oak.

Finish : Full, long, and spicy with lasting citrus notes.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or tulip-shaped tasting glass, or add a few drops of water to open up its rich cask-strength aromas.

adelphi-ben-nevis.title: Decadent Drinks Decadent Drams Ben Nevis 2012 12 Year Old Sherry Hogshead 53% ABV
adelphi-ben-nevis.bodyHtml: This Decadent Drams bottling is a dense, sticky, weighty and tooth-adheringly viscous single sherry hogshead of Ben Nevis highland single malt. Distilled in 2012, aged for 12 years and bottled with a few degrees reduction at 53%. It brims with all the classical 'Dad's toolbox as a smoothie' vibes you have deservedly come to expect from this workhorse west highland distillate. Please enjoy it while meticulously setting up a workshop and teaching yourself how to saw a dovetail joint.

adelphi-deanston.title: Adelphi Deanston 7 Year Old 2013 Cask 7402 58.1% ABV
adelphi-deanston.bodyHtml:
This Deanston single cask was bottled by the independent bottler Adelphi in its Adelphi Selection. Distilled at Deanston in the Scottish Highlands in 2013, it was fully matured in a first-fill bourbon barrel, cask 7402, and bottled at 7 years old at a cask strength of 58.1% ABV. The outturn was just 231 bottles of 700ml. In the glass it shows the colour of barley, with bright citrus and confectionery notes leading into cocoa and spice.

Nose: Lime leaf, Creamola foam, fruity sweets, lavender, flapjack and crème caramel.

Palate: Lime marmalade and waxy bitter orange, moving to cocoa powder, strawberry milkshake, white pepper and cardamom.

Finish: Medium length.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to tame the cask strength.

adelphi-dailuaine.title: Adelphi Dailuaine 12 Year Old Laudale Batch 6
adelphi-dailuaine.bodyHtml:
Dailuaine 12 Year Old Laudale Batch 6 Adelphi is a sherry-matured single malt Scotch from the Dailuaine distillery in Speyside, bottled by the independent bottler Adelphi for its Laudale series, a range devoted to heavily sherried whiskies. The series takes its name from Laudale, a river and estate on the west coast of Scotland near Glenborrodale. Batch 6, the first Laudale release in close to two years, spent all 12 years of its maturation in sherry casks and was bottled without chill filtration, with an outturn of 2,100 bottles. Bottled at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle and presented in a box.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

24-days-of-rum-advent-calendar-2021.title: 24 Days of Rum Advent Calendar 2021 24 x 20ml
24-days-of-rum-advent-calendar-2021.bodyHtml:
The 24 Days of Rum Advent Calendar 2021 is the 2021 edition of the rum advent calendar put together by 1423 World Class Spirits, a Danish independent bottler. Behind each of its 24 doors is a different rum in a 20ml bottle, 480ml in all, drawn from producers across the Americas, the Caribbean, Europe and the Indian and Pacific Oceans, with none repeated from earlier editions. Each 2cl measure is enough for a tasting for two, and the box includes two tasting glasses and two notebooks for recording impressions.

Serve: Neat, one rum a day, at room temperature.

adelphi-dalmore.title: The Dalmore King Alexander III
adelphi-dalmore.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore King Alexander III is a masterful and wildly complex Highland single malt crafted by legendary Master Distiller Richard Paterson to honor the heroic act of Colin of Kintail, Chief of the Clan Mackenzie, who saved King Alexander III of Scotland from a charging stag in 1263. To achieve its unparalleled depth, this whisky undergoes an incredibly ambitious six-cask maturation process. It is carefully aged in a bespoke combination of ex-bourbon casks, Matusalem Oloroso sherry wood, Madeira barrels, Marsala casks, Port pipes, and Cabernet Sauvignon wine barriques. This intricate vatting results in a luxurious, multi-layered whisky brimming with rich red berry fruits, sweet vanilla, and warm baking spices, showcasing the absolute pinnacle of The Dalmore's cask curation expertise.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate, roasted venison, duck breast with a cherry reduction, sticky toffee pudding, or a premium medium-bodied cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep polished mahogany in appearance with a remarkably smooth, velvety, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Exceedingly complex and aromatic, offering a rich bouquet of red berry fruits, passion fruit, warm vanilla pods, crème caramel, and crushed almonds.

Palate : Rich, sweet, and multi-layered, delivering bright notes of citrus zest, sweet vanilla, and crème caramel that seamlessly evolve into deeper flavors of red berries, fleshy plums, and roasted walnuts.

Finish : Long, warming, and elegant, leaving lingering impressions of sweet cinnamon, nutmeg, fresh ginger, and soft oak wood spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter. Allow it to rest in the glass for several minutes to let the intricate six-cask maturation fully express its complex aromatics.

aberlour-1990wf.title: Whisky-Fassle Aberlour 1990 30 Year Old 44.8% ABV
aberlour-1990wf.bodyHtml:
Aberlour 30 Year Old 1990 is a rare independent bottling of Speyside single malt Scotch, selected and bottled by Whisky-Fässle of Besigheim, Germany. Distilled at Aberlour in 1990, it matured for 30 years in a single barrel before bottling in 2020 at 44.8% ABV. It is unchill-filtered and of natural colour, and its label carries the duck artwork used by Whisky-Fässle. Independent releases from Aberlour are seldom seen, which makes this three-decade-old single malt a notable bottle for collectors and Speyside enthusiasts. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, with time to open in the glass.

2000-caperdonich-58-1-signatory.title: Signatory Vintage Cask Strength Collection Caperdonich 20 Year Old 2000 Hogshead 58.1% ABV
2000-caperdonich-58-1-signatory.bodyHtml:
Caperdonich 20 Year Old 2000 is a single cask release from Signatory Vintage's Cask Strength Collection. Distilled at Caperdonich in Speyside on 6 July 2000, it matured for 20 years in a single hogshead (cask no. 29498) before bottling on 28 April 2021 at a natural strength of 58.1% ABV, with natural colour. The cask yielded only 244 bottles of 70cl.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water.

1995-glenburgie-54-7-signatory.title: Signatory Vintage Cask Strength Collection Glenburgie 25 Year Old 1995 54.7% ABV
1995-glenburgie-54-7-signatory.bodyHtml:
Glenburgie 25 Year Old 1995 is a Speyside single malt from Signatory Vintage's Cask Strength Collection. Distilled on 15 June 1995, it matured for a quarter century in two hogsheads, casks 6528 and 6582, which were married and bottled on 26 April 2021 without reduction at 54.7% ABV. The release ran to 383 numbered 700ml bottles, presented in the collection's signature decanter-style bottle and black tin, with natural colour. As part of a cask strength range, it is best explored first neat and then with a little water.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to soften the cask strength.

19-crimes-shiraz-3l.title: 19 Crimes Shiraz Durif 2022
19-crimes-shiraz-3l.bodyHtml: Dark red in the glass, its legs cascade slowly due to its concentration and power. Possessing aromas of licorice, dark fruits and vanilla, this theme carries through on the palate with loads of rich, sweet fruit all wrapped in chalky, ripe tannins with persistence and structure to support the concentration of flavour. A wine that boldly showcases the beauty of blending two varieties that match like hand and glove delivering a memorable wine with loads of personality.

adelphi-linkwood-2012.title: Adelphi Selection Linkwood 9 Year Old 2012 First Fill Bourbon Hogshead 59.9% ABV
adelphi-linkwood-2012.bodyHtml:
Linkwood 9 Year Old 2012 First Fill Bourbon Hogshead is a single cask Speyside single malt from the Adelphi Selection, the range of casks chosen by independent bottler Adelphi. Distilled at Linkwood in 2012, it matured in a single first-fill American bourbon hogshead (cask 305945) and was bottled in 2022 at 9 years old. The cask yielded just 304 bottles, presented at full cask strength of 59.9% ABV without chill filtration, in a 700ml bottle with presentation box.

Tasting Notes: Creamy vanilla, honey and apple, with pepper and fruity sweetness on the palate.

Nose: Rich, creamy vanilla, honey, oak and fresh apple.

Palate: Peppery at first, followed by fruity sweetness and more vanilla.

Finish: Long, with continued vanilla and more fruit.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up at cask strength.

adelphi-fascadale-highland-park.title: Adelphi's Fascadale 14 Year Old Highland Park Batch 10
adelphi-fascadale-highland-park.bodyHtml:
Adelphi’s Fascadale has been distilled at Highland Park Distillery and aged for 14 years in Oloroso Sherry casks.

The Fascadale has been bottled at 46% ABV, only 1498 bottles produced.

Tasting Notes

Nose: Summer fruits and barley before notes of oak.

Palate: Lots of bold malt meets peaches and cream, with a touch of smoky spice.

Finish: Apple pie with a smoky note at the end.

adelphi-bunnahabhain-1998.title: Adelphi Bunnahabhain 1998 23 Year Old 53.5% ABV
adelphi-bunnahabhain-1998.bodyHtml:
Bunnahabhain 1998 23 Year Old is an Islay single malt from the independent bottler Adelphi. Distilled at Bunnahabhain in 1998 and matured for 23 years in refill oloroso sherry casks, it was bottled at 53.5% ABV in a 70cl bottle.

Tasting Notes: Dark fruits, damson jam, figs, dates, cocoa, plums and toasted coffee.

Nose: Damson jam, strawberry cheesecake, soft figs and ripe dates, dark cocoa and a hint of coastal candy floss.

Palate: Smooth at first with peach and pear, building to dark plums and red grapes, gentle iodine and toasted coffee beans.

Serve: Neat; add a few drops of water to open it up.

adelphi-glen-elgin-1995.title: Adelphi Archive Glen Elgin 20 Year Old 1995 Cask 3216
adelphi-glen-elgin-1995.bodyHtml:
Glen Elgin 20 Year Old 1995 is a single cask Speyside malt from the Adelphi Archive series. Distilled at Glen Elgin in 1995, it matured in cask 3216, a refill ex-bourbon barrel, and was bottled by Adelphi in 2016 at a natural cask strength of 53.1% ABV, non-chill filtered and with no added colour. Just 210 bottles were produced, presented in 700ml with a black gift box. Autumn gold in the glass, it is fresh, fragrant and gently mineral rather than heavy.

Tasting Notes: Moorland herbs, bog myrtle and a distant whiff of peat, then buttery shortbread and chocolate.

Nose: Open moorland, fresh and fragrant, with bog myrtle, distant peat, bay leaf and olive leaf.

Palate: Quite mineral, with buttery shortbread and a dusting of chocolate.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water.

24-days-of-rum-advent-calendar-2022.title: 24 Days of Rum Advent Calendar 2022 24 x 20ml
24-days-of-rum-advent-calendar-2022.bodyHtml:
The 24 Days of Rum Advent Calendar 2022 comes from 1423, the Danish independent bottler behind the 24 Days of Rum series. Each of the 24 compartments holds a different rum in a 20ml bottle, 480ml in all, with rums gathered from the Americas, the Caribbean, Europe and the Indian and Pacific Oceans. The series is released in several differently coloured editions, each with its own selection, so buying a different edition means a different set of rums.

Serve: Neat, one rum a day, at room temperature.

1884-ltd-production-syrah.title: 1884 Estate Grown Syrah
1884-ltd-production-syrah.bodyHtml:
1884 Estate Grown Syrah is an expressive Argentine red wine from Escorihuela Gascón, showcasing the rich character of Mendoza Syrah. Aromas of blackberry, blueberry, plum, black pepper, and spice lead into a smooth palate with ripe dark fruit, balanced acidity, soft tannins, and subtle earthy complexity. A versatile and elegant Syrah with excellent depth.

Food Pairing: Grilled lamb, roasted beef, barbecue ribs, smoked meats, mushroom dishes, aged cheeses, and hearty stews.

1884-ltd-production-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Escorihuela Gascon 1884 Limited Production Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 750ml

1792-single-barrel-personal-barrel.title: 1792 Single Barrel Bourbon
1792-single-barrel-personal-barrel.bodyHtml:
In order to create this unique bourbon, the finest barrels are selected and tasted from the best aging warehouses. Only those barrels deemed "exceptional" are then bottled individually, one by one. This preserves the distinct character of each barrel.

Tasting notes:

This superior bourbon has flavors of rich butterscotch and caramel notes, delicately balanced with hints of fruit and toffee.

19-crimes-sauvignon-blanc.title: 19 Crimes Sauvignon Block
19-crimes-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
19 Crimes Sauvignon Block is a crisp, bright, and vibrant white wine produced by 19 Crimes in South Eastern Australia. Light to medium-bodied, it offers an approachable and fruit-forward profile packed with aromatic aromas of passionfruit, ripe grapefruit, gooseberry, and guava. On the palate, it delivers punchy tropical fruit and zesty citrus flavors balanced by lively, mouthwatering acidity that leads to a clean, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh goat cheese, grilled prawns, fish tacos, green salads with citrus vinaigrette, ceviche, and chicken piccata.

19-crimes-shiraz.title: 19 Crimes Shiraz 2021 750ml
19-crimes-shiraz.bodyHtml:
19 Crimes Shiraz 2021 is a bold and expressive Australian red wine inspired by the country's convict history. Produced by 19 Crimes, this Shiraz celebrates the rebellious spirit of the individuals transported to Australia for committing one of the 19 crimes that could result in exile during the 18th and 19th centuries. The 2021 vintage delivers a rich, fruit-forward character with aromas of ripe blackberries, dark plums, black cherries and raspberries, complemented by hints of vanilla, mocha, chocolate and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and smooth, featuring generous dark fruit flavours, rounded tannins and a subtle oak influence. Its rich texture and lingering, spice-driven finish make it an enjoyable choice for barbecue, hearty meals and casual gatherings.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, barbecue ribs, smoked brisket, roasted lamb, beef burgers, spicy sausages, pulled pork, mushroom pizza, rich tomato-based pasta, aged cheddar, smoked Gouda and dark chocolate.

1995-meursault-blagny-louis-latour.title: Louis Latour Meursault-Blagny Chateau de Blagny Premier Cru 1995
1995-meursault-blagny-louis-latour.bodyHtml:
The 1995 Louis Latour Meursault 1er Cru "Château de Blagny" is a well-made white wine from Burgundy, France. It's known for its pale yellow color, a nose with acacia flower and brioche aromas, and a taste profile of grilled almond. The wine also offers a nice tension and a lot of freshness. The 1995 vintage was a good one in Burgundy, despite some initial weather challenges.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Extremely well made, and a good reflection of its minerally terroir. It's vibrant yet full-bodied, and firmly structured with subtle honey, fresh herbs, citrus and green apple flavors, well concentrated, with that mineral overtone. Hold until 2000 or so. 2,080 cases made.

86 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Meursault Blagny did not perform well as it was being fined when it was tasted. (I've tasted many previous vintages of this wine and know it well.) It offered moderate quantities of red berries in the mouth as well as a sweet, fruity nose, yet not much structure. This note is the result of tastings I did in Burgundy between January 7 and January 29. Ratings with a range of scores in parentheses indicate the wine was tasted from cask, not bottle. At Louis Latour the wine making is entrusted to Jean-Pierre Jobard, the brother of Francois and Charles Jobard, two well-known names in Meursault. Jobard commented that the acid in 1995 reminded him of the 1988.

1995-meursault-goutte-dor-louis-latour.title: Louis Latour Meursault Goutte d'Or Premier Cru 1995 750ml
1995-meursault-goutte-dor-louis-latour.bodyHtml: The Louis Latour Meursault Goutte d'Or Premier Cru 1995 is a white wine from the Meursault region of Burgundy, France. It is known for its rich, buttery style with notes of peach, citrus blossom, and vanilla. The wine firms up with stone and seashore elements, adding a mineral dimension. It is described as complex and long with a pale gold hue.

1995-meursault-perrieres-louis-latour.title: Louis Latour Meursault Perrieres Premier Cru 1995 750ml
1995-meursault-perrieres-louis-latour.bodyHtml: Louis Latour Perrieres is a single vineyard premier cru white Burgundy from Meursault. This unique white Burgundy is composed of 95% Chardonnay and 5% other varietals and has a distinguished flavour profile with coconut, vanilla and buttery notes. The Louis Latour Meursault Perrieres Premier Cru 1995 has a high aging potential of 20+ years.

1995-meursault-blagny-louis-latour-1.title: Louis Latour Meursault-Blagny Chateau de Blagny Premier Cru 1995
1995-meursault-blagny-louis-latour-1.bodyHtml:
The 1995 Louis Latour Meursault 1er Cru "Château de Blagny" is a well-made white wine from Burgundy, France. It's known for its pale yellow color, a nose with acacia flower and brioche aromas, and a taste profile of grilled almond. The wine also offers a nice tension and a lot of freshness. The 1995 vintage was a good one in Burgundy, despite some initial weather challenges.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Extremely well made, and a good reflection of its minerally terroir. It's vibrant yet full-bodied, and firmly structured with subtle honey, fresh herbs, citrus and green apple flavors, well concentrated, with that mineral overtone. Hold until 2000 or so. 2,080 cases made.

86 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Meursault Blagny did not perform well as it was being fined when it was tasted. (I've tasted many previous vintages of this wine and know it well.) It offered moderate quantities of red berries in the mouth as well as a sweet, fruity nose, yet not much structure. This note is the result of tastings I did in Burgundy between January 7 and January 29. Ratings with a range of scores in parentheses indicate the wine was tasted from cask, not bottle. At Louis Latour the wine making is entrusted to Jean-Pierre Jobard, the brother of Francois and Charles Jobard, two well-known names in Meursault. Jobard commented that the acid in 1995 reminded him of the 1988.

1884-ltd-production-cabernet-franc.title: Escorihuela Gascon 1884 Limited Production Cabernet Franc 2021 750ml
1884-ltd-production-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml: Extremely heavy bottle. A bold, brash cabernet that evokes sun-soaked brambles and blueberries alongside mint and sweet chocolatey oak. Like the Gran Reserva, this is a bit forced on the palate, with firm, chewy tannins and marked acidity. It's full bodied, but slightly hollow on the midpalate, with moderate fruit weight and length. Bold red drinkers will find lots to like here.

1921-tequila-blanco.title: 1921 Tequila Crema
1921-tequila-blanco.bodyHtml:
1921 Tequila Crema is a Mexican cream liqueur from Casa 1921, which presents it as the first tequila cream and calls it 'The Cream of Mexico'. It combines cream with the house's own 1921 Tequila Blanco and classic Mexican flavours led by real coffee, and is bottled at 15% ABV. The producer describes a creamy liqueur with a caramel hue, a delicate, sweet aroma of tequila blanco, coffee and cinnamon, and a taste of coffee, vanilla, cinnamon, nuts and chocolate with a pleasant aftertaste. It recommends serving it cold, at 4 to 6 degrees Celsius. Casa 1921 takes its name from the year the Mexican Revolution came to a close, and it lists a Double Gold medal for the cream at the 2024 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. The liqueur is sold in two bottle colours with the same contents; this listing is the 750ml bottle.

Nose: Delicate and sweet, with tequila blanco, coffee and cinnamon.

Palate: Creamy, with coffee, vanilla, cinnamon, nuts and chocolate.

Finish: Creamy and enveloping, with a pleasant aftertaste.

Serve: Well chilled (4-6 C), neat or over ice.

1921-tequila-irresistible-cream.title: 1921 Crema de Tequila Irresistible Edition
1921-tequila-irresistible-cream.bodyHtml:
1921 Cream is a gourmet product distinguished by in the fresh agave from 1921 Tequila Blanco and an exquisite mix of typical Mexican flavors. Beyond any doubt is a tempting product.

Sweet and creamy flavor with a hint of coffee and tequila which makes it unique.
Gluten free. It's great as an after dinner drink, neat or over ice. It’s ideal for cocktails, your imagination is the limit!

1921-tequila-reposado.title: 1921 Reposado Tequila
1921-tequila-reposado.bodyHtml:
Crafted from 100% Weber Blue Agave harvested in the Jalisco Highlands. Double-distilled in copper pot stills and aged for 6 months in charred American oak barrels, this expression provides a balanced profile featuring rich agave sweetness harmonized with oak, caramel, and warm spices.

Food Pairing: Grilled meats, pork carnitas, roasted chicken, mild cheeses, mole dishes, and cinnamon desserts.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden amber liquid with light honey hues and a smooth, medium body.

Nose : Sweet agave, vanilla, roasted oak, honey, and subtle spices like cinnamon and nutmeg.

Palate : Smooth and rich with sweet cooked agave, caramel, roasted nuts, vanilla, and gentle oak spice.

Finish : Medium-to-long, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of pepper, caramel, and subtle oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic craft cocktails.

aberlour-16yo-whisky-cask.title: Aberlour 18 Year Old Double Sherry Cask
aberlour-16yo-whisky-cask.bodyHtml:
The Aberlour 18 Year Old Double Cask is a rich, opulent, and deeply complex single malt Scotch whisky that beautifully showcases the mastery of dual maturation. It displays a luxurious, deep amber-gold hue in the glass, releasing an intense, warm bouquet of plum jam, orange marmalade, and toffee buns, layered with notes of old leather cigar boxes, honey, and vanilla bean. The palate is thick, velvety, and exceptionally smooth, enveloping the mouth in luscious flavours of chocolate-coated raisins, ripe apricots, and sweet sherry, accented by warm undertones of freshly grated nutmeg, cinnamon, and black tea. Maturing for nearly two decades in a combination of high-quality American oak ex-bourbon barrels and Spanish Oloroso sherry butts lends it an exquisite structural depth. Driven by a fine-boned balance and subtle warmth, it finishes with a long, satisfying, and seductive persistence marked by cocoa, orange zest, and a lingering touch of sweet oak spice.
Food Pairing: This highly decadent dram pairs beautifully with rich, savory, or sweet options, including duck liver mousse with fig compote, slow-cooked braised pork sliding, high-quality dark chocolate-covered ginger, roasted lamb cutlets, artisanal nutty cheeses like aged Gouda, and triple-crème Brie.

aberlour-18y0-single-malt-scotch-whisky.title: Aberlour 18 Year Old Double Sherry Cask
aberlour-18y0-single-malt-scotch-whisky.bodyHtml:
The Aberlour 18 Year Old Double Cask is a rich, opulent, and deeply complex single malt Scotch whisky that beautifully showcases the mastery of dual maturation. It displays a luxurious, deep amber-gold hue in the glass, releasing an intense, warm bouquet of plum jam, orange marmalade, and toffee buns, layered with notes of old leather cigar boxes, honey, and vanilla bean. The palate is thick, velvety, and exceptionally smooth, enveloping the mouth in luscious flavours of chocolate-coated raisins, ripe apricots, and sweet sherry, accented by warm undertones of freshly grated nutmeg, cinnamon, and black tea. Maturing for nearly two decades in a combination of high-quality American oak ex-bourbon barrels and Spanish Oloroso sherry butts lends it an exquisite structural depth. Driven by a fine-boned balance and subtle warmth, it finishes with a long, satisfying, and seductive persistence marked by cocoa, orange zest, and a lingering touch of sweet oak spice.
Food Pairing: This highly decadent dram pairs beautifully with rich, savory, or sweet options, including duck liver mousse with fig compote, slow-cooked braised pork sliding, high-quality dark chocolate-covered ginger, roasted lamb cutlets, artisanal nutty cheeses like aged Gouda, and triple-crème Brie.

2017-barnett-spring-mountain-cabernet.title: Barnett Vineyards Spring Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 1.5L Magnum
2017-barnett-spring-mountain-cabernet.bodyHtml:
The 2017 Spring Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon is one of the darkest we’ve made. Big black raspberry jumps from the glass as well as blueberry jam and black pepper. There is a bright chocolate element surrounded by cedar notes. The mouthfeel is rich and lush

with a lot more dark fruit as well as cigar box and mocha. The tannins are significant, very big, and chalky. While the mountain acidity is firm it is the tannins that dominate. There is a long black raspberry and mocha finish to the wine. This sizeable Cabernet will age amazingly over the next 14-15 years (2033-2034).

92 Points - Wilfred Wong
The 2017 Barnett Vineyards Spring Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon offers excellent and persistent density on the palate. This wine brings black fruit, pencil lead, and violets to the table. Pair it with a well-marbled, grilled steak.

adelphi-laudale.title: Adelphi Dailuaine 12 Year Old Laudale Batch 6
adelphi-laudale.bodyHtml:
Dailuaine 12 Year Old Laudale Batch 6 Adelphi is a sherry-matured single malt Scotch from the Dailuaine distillery in Speyside, bottled by the independent bottler Adelphi for its Laudale series, a range devoted to heavily sherried whiskies. The series takes its name from Laudale, a river and estate on the west coast of Scotland near Glenborrodale. Batch 6, the first Laudale release in close to two years, spent all 12 years of its maturation in sherry casks and was bottled without chill filtration, with an outturn of 2,100 bottles. Bottled at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle and presented in a box.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

molson-ultra-7.title: Molson Ultra 24 Cans
molson-ultra-7.bodyHtml: Molson Ultra is a premium light lager designed for active, health-conscious consumers who prioritize a low-calorie and low-carbohydrate profile without sacrificing a clean beer taste. It is brewed in a traditional lager style but underwent specialized processes to minimize its caloric footprint while maintaining a refreshing character. On the nose, it offers subtle grainy malt aromas with a touch of herbal hops. The palate is exceptionally light-bodied and crisp, delivering a dry, smooth finish with very little bitterness. With only 70 calories and 2 grams of carbohydrates per 355 ml serving, it is one of the lightest options in the Molson portfolio.

hess-mt-veeder-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Hess Collection Mount Veeder Cabernet Sauvignon 2018/2019 750ml
hess-mt-veeder-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The 2019 estate-grown Cabernet provides an exemplary expression of the sophistication, complexity, and structure that we’ve come to expect from their mountain fruit. The Cabernet Sauvignon produces aromas of ripe, wild, mountain raspberry, along with gentle notes of vanilla caramel. The subtle touch of Malbec adds a soft, mouth-filling texture on the palate. Enticing flavors of dark plum, licorice, cocoa and vanilla oak spice unite to create a supple wine that lingers for a pleasing finish.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This complex and well-balanced wine seamlessly blends black fruits, oak spices and a beefy accent on a full body backed by moderate tannins. It feels velvety, almost silky, but has the structure to improve with age. Best from 2025.
92 Points - James Suckling

A very soft and friendly red with plum and blackberry character. Medium body with medium firm tannins and a delicious finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator
Shows a toasty overlay, with singed vanilla coating a core of blackberry, black cherry and boysenberry paste flavors. A tug of loam and a cedary frame emerge on the finish. Offers more oomph than purity, with the toasty edge asserting itself through the finish. Best from 2023 through 2034. 6,300 cases made.

volcan-cristalino-tequila.title: Don Julio 70 Anejo Cristalino Tequila
volcan-cristalino-tequila.bodyHtml:
Don Julio 70 Añejo Cristalino Tequila is a pioneering spirit that celebrates the 70th anniversary of Don Julio's tequila-making legacy. It is a unique clear Añejo tequila, traditional añejo aged for 18 months in American white oak barrels and then carefully charcoal-filtered to restore the crisp agave flavor and clear appearance of a Blanco. This process masterfully combines the complex, rich flavors of an aged tequila with the smooth, lively notes of a silver tequila.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri, rich dark chocolate desserts (70% cocoa or higher), or savory carnitas tacos.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri, dark chocolate truffles, roasted carnitas tacos, aged cheeses, or flan.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and bright with a rich, smooth, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Crisp and complex with notes of cooked agave, wild honey, sweet vanilla, and subtle toasted oak.

Palate : Smooth and velvety with dominant flavors of sweet cooked agave, honey, warm vanilla, toasted almonds, and light baking spice.

Finish : Clean, warm, and lingering with soft hints of toasted oak and delicate vanilla sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat or on the rocks in a tequila snifter or rocks glass.

bisquit-dubouche-xo.title: Bisquit & Dubouché XO Cognac
bisquit-dubouche-xo.bodyHtml:
Bisquit & Dubouché XO Cognac is a luxurious French cognac crafted by the historic House of Bisquit & Dubouché, founded in 1819. Produced in the renowned Cognac region of France, this exceptional Extra Old expression is created from carefully selected eaux-de-vie aged in French oak barrels, developing remarkable depth, elegance, and complexity. Known for its rich aromatic profile and exceptionally smooth character, Bisquit & Dubouché XO offers a sophisticated combination of dried fruits, honey, warm spices, chocolate, and refined oak. Its velvety texture and lingering finish make it an excellent choice for cognac enthusiasts, collectors, and special occasions.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate, aged cheeses, roasted almonds, dried figs, caramel desserts, crème brûlée, and rich fruitcake.

Tasting Notes: Deep amber with golden highlights, offering a rich, smooth, and complex profile featuring dried fruits, sweet spices, chocolate, and elegant oak.

Nose: Expressive aromas of dried apricots, ripe plums, honey, vanilla, cinnamon, and toasted oak, complemented by delicate floral notes.

Palate: Rich and velvety, featuring flavours of candied orange, dried figs, dark chocolate, caramel, and warm baking spices. Subtle oak and nutty undertones add depth and balance.

Finish: Long, smooth, and elegant, with lingering notes of dried fruit, vanilla, gentle spice, and refined oak.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a tulip-shaped cognac glass at approximately 18–20°C to appreciate its complex aromas and flavours. It may also be enjoyed over a large ice cube.

axr-napa-valley-proprietary-red.title: AXR Proprietary Red 2021
axr-napa-valley-proprietary-red.bodyHtml:
Nestled at the Mayacamas Mountain Range base, across from Ehlers Estate, AXR’s historic St. Helena estate’s soils have benefited from thousands of years of sediment runoff, resulting in wines with undeniable character. The winery’s proprietors have an unwavering goal of extracting the uniqueness of their vineyard, with renowned winemaker Jean Hoefliger acting as the human conduit for the vines to tell their story.

Jean draws on his experiences working in the cellars at Chateau Carbonnieux and Chateau Lynch-Bages in Bordeaux, bringing a Grand Cru Classé prestige to his Napa Valley masterpieces. This Proprietary Red Blend is a classic Left Bank style with 90% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Cabernet Franc, 4% Merlot, and 1% Petit Verdot, but for a much friendlier price than a comparable quality French Bordeaux.

94 Points - James Suckling

Blackberry, blackcurrant, dark chocolate and spices. Bright and vivid. Medium-bodied with firm, racy tannins and excellent length. There’s an energy and focused directness with lovely length. 75% cabernet sauvignon, 15% mablec, 7% cabernet franc and 3% petit verdot. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

AXR's 2021 Proprietary Red has aromas defined by notes of crushed stone and dried herbs. Yes, they're backed by decent blackberry fruit, but this wine may prove a touch too herbal for some. Otherwise, this blend of 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Malbec, 7% Cabernet Franc and 3% Petit Verdot is full-bodied and rather chunky in feel, yet it finishes silky and satisfying.

la-posta-paulucci-malbec.title: La Posta Paulucci Malbec 2021
la-posta-paulucci-malbec.bodyHtml:
A vibrant and terroir-driven expression of a single-grower vineyard, the 2021 Paulucci Malbec is sourced from Angel Paulucci’s 50-year-old vines in the Ugarteche district of Luján de Cuyo. This wine presents a deep violet color and an inviting bouquet of ripe red cherries and plums, layered with delicate notes of violets, vanilla, and milk chocolate. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and remarkably smooth, showcasing a plush texture with soft, velvety tannins and a bright acidity. Subtle hints of spice and a touch of earthiness emerge on the finish, reflecting the traditional clay-loam soils of this historic sub-region.

91 Points - James Suckling

Dark berries and blueberries with pureness and brightness. Medium-bodied with crushed-stone and floral character. Medium finish. Drink or hold.

mcmanis-petite-sirah.title: Stags' Leap Winery Petite Sirah 2018
mcmanis-petite-sirah.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Petite Sirah 2018 is dark, inky, and dense, with layers of bramble berry fruit, touches of earth, and lovely floral tones interwoven with more savory notes of black pepper and cigar box spice, all supported by balanced oak integration. On the palate, ripe saturated flavors of cassis, blackberry preserves, blueberry creme, cherry kirsch, vanilla spice, and dark plum envelope the intense mouthfeel. A silky viscosity with voluminous texture, wrapped in velvety mouth-coating tannins, completes the generous and lengthy finish. Perfectly drinkable upon release, but also has the depth and complexity to age for many years to come.

Food Pairing: Perfectly balances robust, high-flavor dishes such as pan-seared venison medallions, thick-cut barbecued ribeye steak, slow-roasted pork tenderloin, wild mushroom ragù, or rich game tourtière.

93 Points - James Suckling

Lots of ripe plums and blueberries, together with smoked meat, licorice and dried flowers. Dark chocolate and wet forest floor, too. Tight and meaty with a dense, chewy tannin structure. Full-bodied, ripe and fruit-driven. Long, savory finish.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Sourced from Calistoga all the way down to Coombsville, the 2018 Petite Sirah is inky purple-black in color. Vanilla notes—it spends 14 months in 25% new American oak—accent blackberries and blueberries on the nose, while it's full-bodied on the palate, where it's a bit chunky but not unfriendly, with a long, dusty finish.

scarpetta-pinot-grigio-delle-venezie-igt.title: Scarpetta Pinot Grigio 2024
scarpetta-pinot-grigio-delle-venezie-igt.bodyHtml:
Scarpetta Pinot Grigio 2024 is an vibrant, elegant, and beautifully structured Italian white wine produced by Scarpetta in Friuli-Venezia Giulia. Sourced from graveled soils in Friuli Grave and steep hillside "Ponca" soils in Colli Orientali, it displays a light straw-yellow hue with subtle pale salmon reflections. On the nose, it offers fragrant aromas of honeydew melon, white peach, crushed stone, and delicate floral notes. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied and lively, featuring mouthwatering natural acidity, ripe orchard fruit flavors, and a clean, refreshing mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Excellent on its own as an aperitivo, or paired with fresh ceviche, pesce crudo, grilled sea bass, goat cheese salads, and vegetable quiche.

long-barn-pinot-noir.title: Long Barn Pinot Noir 2024
long-barn-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Long Barn Pinot Noir 2024 is a charming and approachable expression of California’s coastal viticulture, designed to offer high-quality varietal character with exceptional value. Sourced from vineyards where cool maritime breezes help maintain a balanced ripening season, this wine is crafted to emphasize bright fruit and a supple texture. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of fresh strawberries, red cherries, and a touch of rose petal, nuanced by subtle notes of toasted oak and vanilla. The palate is light-to-medium bodied and incredibly smooth, showcasing a soft mouthfeel with flavours of ripe raspberry and a hint of baking spice, leading to a clean, lingering finish. Its versatile and fruit-forward nature makes it an excellent pairing for roasted poultry, grilled salmon, or a simple charcuterie board.

big-hat-hazy-ipa.title: Big Hat Hazy Ipa Keg 50 Cls [Ff]

inamore-pinot-grigio-igt-terre-di-chieti.title: Inamore Rosato Igt Terre Di Chieti 750ml

inamore-rosato-igt-terre-di-chieti.title: Inamore Rosato Igt Terre Di Chieti 750ml

double-canyon-horse-heaven-hills-caberne.title: Double Canyon Horse Heaven Hills Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
double-canyon-horse-heaven-hills-caberne.bodyHtml:
Impactful deep cherry aromas with hints of vanilla, dark chocolate and clove open your mind to the tasting experience to ensue. The first entry to the pallet is silky smooth, brimming with notes of ripe blackberry and tart currant, and finishes with toasted vanilla, oak, and baking spices. With approachable tannins, the finish is lengthy and subtle.

Pairs nicely with hearty meat dishes such as roasted lamb with grilled asparagus or for a meatless pairing try it with eggplant parmesan. 

90 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrant, tobacco and tar on the nose, with some spice box and coffee. It’s full-bodied, mouthfilling and chewy with ripe and broad tannins. Drink after 2025.

89 Points - Wine Enthusiast

An earthy-funky aroma offers a wild backdrop for notes of boysenberry and lilacs. Each sniff is a meadow walk after a downpour. Elevated acidity lends some juiciness to flavors like tart raspberry, anise and black tea with a slice of lemon. This would be a perfect pour with turkey burgers.

glengoyne-18-year-old.title: Glengoyne 12 Year Old
glengoyne-18-year-old.bodyHtml: The Glengoyne 12-Year-Old is an unpeated Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky, a testament to a production process that prides itself on patience, one of  Scotland’s slowest distillations. Matured for 12 years in hand-selected sherry casks, it has a well-balanced character where fruit and sweetness take center stage without a hint of smoke. At 43% ABV, it is a complex yet approachable dram, certified vegan and sustainably produced.

kavalan-solist-vinho-barrique-58-60-abv.title: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Cask Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-vinho-barrique-58-60-abv.bodyHtml:
Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and recharred in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the wood into the whisky overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness.
It has a complex and multi-dimensional background of pepper, spice, dates and other fruits, such as ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of bursting citrus fruits.

Colour
Deep autumn gold

Flavour
A rich fusion of vanilla and caramelized sugars with dark chocolate on top. Ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of citrus fruits burst. Pepper is also present in the background waiting to be noticed.

Palate
The taste ends with clean and complex flavours embodying all that is best in the finest malt whiskies enjoying a long aftertaste.

Tasting
We suggest drinking Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask neat.

masahiro-pure-malt-whisky-12-year-old-sh.title: Masahiro Pure Malt 12 Year Old Oloroso Sherry Cask Whisky
masahiro-pure-malt-whisky-12-year-old-sh.bodyHtml:
Masahiro Pure Malt 12 Year Old Oloroso Sherry Cask Whisky is a distinctive world malt whisky matured at Masahiro Distillery in Okinawa, Japan. Crafted from 100% malted barley sourced internationally, this expression spends at least 11 years in American oak ex-bourbon hogsheads before receiving a 12-month finish in first-fill Oloroso sherry casks. Okinawa's subtropical climate contributes to its expressive character, bringing together ripe citrus, dried apricots, plums, and honey. Bottled at 43% ABV, it offers a rich yet approachable palate of candied fruit, toasted bread, and roasted nuts, followed by a lingering oak-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork, glazed duck, aged Gouda, toasted almonds, dried apricots, dark chocolate, fruitcake, and caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and fruit-forward, combining ripe citrus, dried stone fruits, honey, candied fruit, malt sweetness, and toasted nuts.

Nose: Ripe citrus, dried apricots, jammy plums, honey, and delicate nuttiness.

Palate: Juicy orchard fruit, candied citrus, malt syrup, toasted almonds, and warm bread, with balanced oak influence.

Finish: Lingering oak, roasted hazelnuts, walnuts, cashews, and gentle sweetness.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature. Add a few drops of water to explore its dried fruit and nutty characteristics.

jack-ginger.title: Jack And Ginger 473ml
jack-ginger.bodyHtml:
Jack & Ginger is a ready-to-drink cocktail that brings together the rich, distinctive character of whiskey and the refreshing spice of ginger. Inspired by the classic whiskey-and-ginger combination, this convenient 473ml format offers an easy way to enjoy a familiar cocktail without the need for mixing. Ideal for casual gatherings, barbecues, and relaxed evenings, Jack & Ginger delivers a balance of whiskey warmth and lively ginger character. Best served chilled, it offers a convenient alternative to preparing a traditional mixed drink.

Food Pairing: Barbecue pork ribs, grilled burgers, spicy chicken wings, smoked brisket, aged cheddar, and salted pretzels.

Tasting Notes: A refreshing whiskey-and-ginger cocktail with gentle sweetness, warming spice, and a lively character.

Nose: Ginger spice with subtle whiskey aromas.

Palate: A combination of ginger sweetness, light spice, and whiskey character.

Finish: Refreshing and gently warming, with lingering ginger notes.

Serve: Enjoy well chilled directly from the can or pour over ice with a fresh lime wedge.

petirrojo-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Bisquertt Family Vineyards 'Petirrojo' Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 750ml
petirrojo-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This is comparatively inexpensive for Colchagua Valley wines. The price has been stable over the past year.

Critic tasting note: (2010 vintage) "Herbal plum and olive aromas are robust and far from generic. The palate is lush and layered, with baked berry, pepper, spice and tobacco flavors. Lifted and sturdy on the finish, with ripeness and power. A steal for the money." - 87/100, Wine Enthusiast

dirty-laundry-woo-woo-vines-gewurz.title: Dirty Laundry Vineyard Woo Woo Gewurztraminer 2023 750ml
dirty-laundry-woo-woo-vines-gewurz.bodyHtml: It is made from the oldest Gewurztraminer vines in the valley. Lychee, spicy floral notes with mango, pear & loganfruit on the finish. Excellent with spicy foods such as Thai & East Indian or Asian fusion dishes. Great with mild cheeses as well.

bieler-family-born-to-run-cab-sauvignon.title: Peller Family Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 200mL
bieler-family-born-to-run-cab-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Smooth and approachable, with blackberry, black currant, plum, dark cherry, and subtle spice. The palate is medium-bodied and fruit-forward, offering ripe dark fruit, soft tannins, balanced acidity, and a clean finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled beef, burgers, barbecue, roast meats, hearty pasta, pizza, charcuterie, or semi-aged cheeses.

torre-zambra-pecorino-poggio-salaia.title: Torre Zambra Poggio Salaia Pecorino 2025
torre-zambra-pecorino-poggio-salaia.bodyHtml:
Torre Zambra Poggio Salaia Pecorino 2025 is a vibrant Italian white wine from Abruzzo, crafted from 100% Pecorino grown on the limestone-rich hillside of Poggio Salaia. Fermented in stainless steel and matured on fine lees, this expressive wine reveals aromas of white flowers, mango, pineapple, and fresh herbs. Bright citrus and lychee flavours are complemented by refreshing acidity and distinctive minerality, creating a beautifully balanced, elegant white wine with a crisp, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled seafood, fresh oysters, lemon-herb chicken, seafood risotto, grilled vegetables, soft cheeses, and light Mediterranean pasta dishes.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Green apples and white peaches kick off the nose, followed by crushed shells, and finally wild herbs, especially fennel and mint. A similarly layered palate sees Meyer lemon and green apple candy flavors emerge first, then the fresh, green notes of herbs return. A razor blade of acid zips down the tongue. 

91 Points - James Suckling

Restrained aromas of lemons, lime peel and chalk. Smooth and silky, with a medium body, a zesty and tingling palate and savory depth. From organically grown grapes.

psicosis-malbec.title: Psicosis Malbec NV 750ml
psicosis-malbec.bodyHtml:
Psicosis Malbec is an Argentine red wine from Mendoza, known for its full-bodied, velvety texture with flavors of ripe plums, blackcurrants, and a hint of fig. It often exhibits notes of vanilla and cedar from oak aging, and a long, satisfying finish with dark chocolate and espresso. The wine is generally characterized by its smooth, well-integrated tannins. 

93 Points - James Suckling
"A powerful and intense Malbec, bursting with flavors of blackberry, dark chocolate, and violet. Full-bodied with a rich, concentrated palate and a long, impressive finish that showcases its Argentine origin."

faiveley-gevrey-chambertin-les-cazetiers.title: Domaine Faiveley Gevrey-Chambertin Les Cazetiers Premier Cru 1.5L Magnum
faiveley-gevrey-chambertin-les-cazetiers.bodyHtml: Deep ruby red hue with an intense and complex nose characterized by red fruits, toast and subtle roasted notes. The palate is rich and round with a firm structure and direct tannins. This remarkably powerful wine offers a silky mouthfeel and exceptional length.

collective-arts-ood-bellwoods-short-can.title: Collective Arts Ood Bellwoods Short Can 355ml

copperworks-sm-r43-peated-ardbeg-cask.title: Copperworks Peated American Single Malt Whiskey Ardbeg Cask R43
copperworks-sm-r43-peated-ardbeg-cask.bodyHtml:
Copperworks Peated American Single Malt Whiskey Ardbeg Cask R43 is a distinctive limited-release whiskey from Copperworks Distilling Co. in Seattle, Washington. This expression brings together the character of American single malt whiskey and the influence of an Ardbeg cask, associated with Scotland's renowned Islay whisky tradition. Bottled at 50% ABV, it offers an intriguing exploration of malt, oak, and smoky whisky character.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, grilled ribeye, barbecue pork ribs, roasted lamb, aged cheddar, smoked Gouda, and dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: A peated American single malt whiskey with an oak-influenced profile. Exact release-specific tasting characteristics require verification.

Nose: Toasted marshmallow, buttery pastry, campfire smoke, blackberry, and a subtle balsamic accent.

Palate: Roasted apple, caramelized sugar, dried fruit, and vanilla, layered with pronounced Islay-style smoke.

Finish: Lingering smoky brisket, gentle iodine, sweet red candy, and cigar notes.

armand-de-brignac-green.title: Armand De Brignac Ace of Spades Brut Limited Edition Green Champagne 750ml
armand-de-brignac-green.bodyHtml:
The Armand de Brignac Golfer’s Limited Edition is a brut cuvée with an elegant, vibrant style, that provides the perfect toast at the end of a successful day of golfing. Proudly wearing its green jacket, the bottle is delivered inside of a lacquered wooden case with French pewter labeling– a hallmark of Armand de Brignac champagnes.

95 Points - Decanter

This is a three-way assemblage: three grape varieties – and equal percentage of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay with 20% of Pinot Meunier – and a blend of 3 vintages, 2009, 2010 and 2012. The nose is full of flavors and rich with notes of white flowers and crème patissière. However, the palate is crisp, fresh and delicate with a lovely creamy texture. It is elegant, refined and very stylish (unlike the bottle!). It’s a pleasant combination of power and concentration blended with finesse and elegance. While the dosage is 9g/l, it feels much drier, more like a 5g/l and this probably due to the spinal cord of acidity.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Tasted from magnum, the NV Brut (Gold) opens with lovely matured brioche, toast and ripe fruit flavors. Fresh, pure and elegant on the palate, with beautifully matured flavors and an elegant creaminess I don't find in the other cuvées, the "Gold" is a blend of 40% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay and 20% Pinot Meunier as well as the vintages of 2009, 2010 and 2012. The wine reveals good grip and mineral tension and drinks well as an aperitif or with seafood and fish.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant, creamy Champagne, with pretty apple blossom and spice notes leading to finely meshed flavors of ripe white cherry, whole-grain toast and spun honey, framed by fresh, citrusy acidity. Drink now through 2021.

kilchoman-casado.title: Kilchoman 100% Islay 10 Year Old 2015 Madeira Hogshead Single Cask 15/768
kilchoman-casado.bodyHtml:
Kilchoman 10 Year Old Single Cask 15/768 2015 Madeira Cask Canadian Prairies Exclusive is a rare and highly sought-after single-cask Islay single malt Scotch whisky bottled exclusively for the Canadian Prairies market. Distilled in 2015 and aged for 10 years in a single fresh Madeira cask (#15/768) before being bottled at natural cask strength, it offers a rich and harmonious fusion of Kilchoman's signature peaty, citrus-forward distillate with the luscious dried fruit, nutty sweetness, and fortified wine complexity imparted by Madeira oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with dark chocolate tarts, venison stew, smoked beef brisket, sticky barbecue ribs, or sharp blue cheeses like Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Rich copper amber with a full-bodied viscosity and an oily, mouth-coating texture.

Nose : Warm peat smoke, dark raisins, caramelized figs, orange peel, toasted almonds, and sweet oak spice.

Palate : Rich and complex with layers of dark stone fruits, Demerara sugar, roasted coffee beans, red berry jam, and lingering campfire smoke.

Finish : Long, warm, and satisfying with lingering notes of peat ash, sweet wine fruitiness, dark cacao, and gentle wood spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of pure water to unlock the complex Madeira fruit and peat aromas while softening the cask-strength heat.

arnot-roberts-chardonnay-watson-ranch.title: Rombauer Chardonnay 2024
arnot-roberts-chardonnay-watson-ranch.bodyHtml:
Rombauer Chardonnay 2024 is a lush, opulent, and iconic California white wine crafted by Rombauer Vineyards. Sourced primarily from sustainably farmed vineyards in the cool, fog-shrouded Carneros region—where marine breezes from San Pablo Bay preserve bright natural acidity—the grapes were gently whole-cluster pressed and fermented in French oak barrels. Following fermentation, the wine underwent full malolactic fermentation and aged for nine months on its lees with regular stirring (bâtonnage) in new and used French oak, imparting its signature creamy texture and decadent barrel spice. In the glass, it displays a luminous pale yellow hue with shimmering green-gold highlights. The aromatic profile opens with expressive notes of ripe yellow peach, melon, and Meyer lemon zest layered with vanilla bean, toasted oak, and subtle baking spice. On the palate, it delivers a rich, full-bodied mouthfeel balanced by crisp citrus acidity, culminating in a long, smooth, and buttery finish.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy fettuccine Alfredo, or mild triple-cream Brie cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Classic in every sense, with freshness and purity underneath the generosity and richness this wine is known for. Cookies, pastry and sweet spices alongside ripe orchard fruit, apples and vanilla. The textural palate shows bright acidity and lovely balance, with saline notes and preserved lemons. Consistent and well-made. Drink or hold.

kilchoman-machir-bay-cask-strength.title: Kilchoman Machir Bay Whisky
kilchoman-machir-bay-cask-strength.bodyHtml:
Named after the most spectacular beach on Islay, Machir Bay is the flagship of the Kilchoman range. Machir Bay is a unique and complex combination of ex-bourbon barrels and oloroso sherry butts. There is a predominantly ex-bourbon influence on this release which is indicated in the cask influence graph on the front of the carton.

“Machir Bay has a beautiful balance of vanilla, smokey butterscotch and rich fruitiness each contributing in complexity and combining to create a truly unique Islay dram” Robin Bignal, Production Manager.

les-terrasses-de-saint-christophe.title: Chateau Tour Saint-Christophe Les Terrasses De SaintChristophe Saint-emilion Grand Cru 2014 750ml

iron-sand-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Iron & Sand Cabernet
iron-sand-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
A bold Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon with dark plum, blackberry, black cherry, cassis, graphite, baking spice, and chocolate notes. Full-bodied and richly textured, it combines ripe dark fruit with lively acidity and fine tannins, finishing long, supple, and mouthwatering.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled steak, Santa Maria barbecue, tri-tip, braised short ribs, roasted lamb, hearty pasta, or aged hard cheeses.

giusti-grapp-riserva.title: Giusti Acquavite di Vinaccia Riserva 500ml
giusti-grapp-riserva.bodyHtml:
Giusti Riserva is our first trail of grappa aged in “barriques” previously used to hold local superior red wines and for which a new one-of-a-kind technique has been to treat the staves. Giusti Riserva grappa is a blend, that is, a grappa made up from several spirits made from different grape marcs of different vintages. In this case the grappa has been aged for 6 years. The one-wine Troncais oak barrels imaprt characteristic features to the product

Intense brown with amber glints. Heady sensations of liquorice and subtle notes of walnut, cinnamon and vanilla on the nose. A “mellow” aroma of mature date and carob add a further distinctive touch to the already elegant bouquet. Fine, intense, complex and velvety with no harshness. Hints of dried fruit and spicy nots are delicately embraced by a pleasant alcoholic sensation. Regal persistence.

wayne-gretzky-red-cask-whisky-1.title: Wayne Gretzky Red Cask Canadian Whisky 1.14L
wayne-gretzky-red-cask-whisky-1.bodyHtml:
Whisky made the Canadian way - locally sourced grains are individually distilled, matured and blended, then finished in red wine casks from our Wayne Gretzky winery. This process 'polishes' the whisky, adding rich oak, vanilla and spice, and balancing all the elements to produce a refined and smooth whisky.

Our Ontario climate has an influence on barrel ageing; high annual temperature fluctuations in a non-temperature-controlled environment drives the whisky deep into the oak during warmer periods and draws it out during cooler periods. The location of the barrel within the rickhouse influences how it ages, depending on temperature, air flow and height within the room. This gives our distiller near infinite options when blending, to create the taste profile selected by Wayne himself.

A bright straw gold colour with a ruby red hue. At first swirl of the glass look for top notes of toasty new oak, almond nuttiness, caramel and vanilla. Then underlying notes appear suggesting nutmeg spice and stone fruit. After adding a touch of water, added notes of sweet spice and dark raisin develop. The mouth-feel is smooth, round and robust, with a touch of woody tannins for structure, along with deep notes of toasted nuts and allspice. The finish is long and lingering with a delicately sweet, smooth texture and flavours of nut and allspice.

castello-di-monsanto-nemo-cabernet-sauv.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
castello-di-monsanto-nemo-cabernet-sauv.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

vite-colte-barolo-essenze.title: Vite Colte Essenze Barolo Del Comune Di Barolo 2018 750ml
vite-colte-barolo-essenze.bodyHtml: The appearance is a red tending towards garnet. Intense and complex, with notes of violet, vanilla, tobacco and goudron. Dry and warm, with great body and structure. The lingering persistent finish reveals ripe black and red fruit and an evident balsamic note.

single-cask-nation-paul-john-4yr.title: Paul John Port Select Cask Indian Single Malt Whisky
single-cask-nation-paul-john-4yr.bodyHtml:
Paul John Port Select Cask is an Indian Single Malt Whisky from John Distilleries in Goa, India. The expression uses Port cask maturation/finishing to add rich fruit sweetness and depth to Paul John’s tropical single malt character.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate, fruitcake, roasted nuts, mature cheese, grilled meats and berry-based desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich red fruits, raisins, berries, honey, vanilla, malt, dark chocolate and warming spice.

Nose: Sweet dried fruit and berries with honey, vanilla and gentle malt.

Palate: Rich and fruity with raisins, dark berries, caramel sweetness, chocolate and oak spice.

Finish: Lingering and warming with sweet fruit, oak and spice.

Serve: Best enjoyed neat or with a few drops of water.

single-cask-nation-ardmore-23yr.title: The Single Malts of Scotland Ardmore 23 Year Old 1998 Hogshead Cask 750768 51.2% ABV
single-cask-nation-ardmore-23yr.bodyHtml: his Highland single malt whiskey from the Ardmore Distillery was distilled in 1998 and matured in a Hogshead #750768 for a full 23 years. Here it is: In 2022, this single cask whiskey was bottled by independent bottler Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland range at a cask strength of 51.2%. Don't miss the chance to taste this exquisite whisky!

single-cask-nation-foursquare-11yr.title: Single Cask Nation Caol Ila 11 Year Old
single-cask-nation-foursquare-11yr.bodyHtml:
Cask Type: Refill Bourbon Hogshead
ABV: 58.8%
Outturn: 259 Bottles

Nose: White chocolate fattiness with fresh jalapeno skin, green bananas, lemon salt,
smoked salt, freshly peated barley, coal dust.
Palate: Leads with freshly peated malted barley, abundant salt (even Veruca!),
freshly shelled peanut skins, lemon curd, orange blossom honey, and Walker’s
shortbread.

tequila-clase-azul-ultra-aged-box.title: Clase Azul Reposado Tequila
tequila-clase-azul-ultra-aged-box.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila made from 100% Blue Weber Agave, harvested in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Cooked slowly in traditional brick ovens and distilled twice in copper pot stills, it is aged for eight months in American whiskey casks. This aging process imparts a silky texture, rich hazelnut and vanilla flavors, and a smooth profile. Encased in Clase Azul's iconic, hand-painted ceramic decanter featuring cobalt blue feather designs, it stands as an international symbol of luxury and Mexican craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-cooked pork carnitas, grilled ribeye steak, aged cheeses such as Manchego, mole poblano, dark chocolate desserts, or vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Intense amber color with copper highlights and a smooth, rich, medium-to-full body with a silky mouthfeel.

Nose : Agave nectar, vanilla, candied orange peel, toasted oak, hazelnut, and subtle hints of cinnamon.

Palate : Smooth and complex with rich flavors of cooked agave, toasted oak, vanilla, clove, hazelnut, and soft caramel.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant finish with lingering notes of sweet agave, vanilla, toasted wood, and gentle baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip-shaped glass or Tequila Riedel glass to fully appreciate its aromas and flavor profile.

cavit-roscato-moscato.title: Cavit Roscato Moscato
cavit-roscato-moscato.bodyHtml:
Cavit Roscato Moscato is an incredibly radiant, charming, and beautifully balanced Italian sweet white wine that stands as a true celebration of northern Italy’s historic aromatic varietals. Crafted by Cavit’s renowned cooperative of family growers, this highly popular expression is expertly sourced from steeply rolling, limestone-rich vineyard hills along the right bank of the Po River in southwestern Lombardy’s Provincia di Pavia. To lock in its signature pure fruit profile, the hand-selected Muscat grapes undergo cold fermentation with brief skin contact, precisely halted before completion to preserve the fruit's natural residual sugars and capture a delicate, low-alcohol frizzante effervescence. In the glass, it reveals a pale yellow hue with vibrant greenish highlights and a light, playful bead of persistent bubbles. The highly expressive, generous nose opens with an enchanting bouquet of juicy white peach, ripe apricot, and crushed sage, beautifully accented by subtle undercurrents of sweet melon and candied citrus peel. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, crisp, and velvety, displaying a seamless, fruit-driven fluid coherence where its core of lush orchard fruit sweetness is masterfully counterbalanced by a racy spine of natural acidity and an unexpected hint of warm baking spice, concluding with a soft, clean, and highly refreshing finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with New York cheesecake, fruit tarts, spicy Thai appetizers, or mild creamy cheeses.

kendall-jackson-chardonnay-low-cal.title: Kendall-Jackson Low Calorie Chardonnay
kendall-jackson-chardonnay-low-cal.bodyHtml: Kendall-Jackson Low Calorie Chardonnay is a lighter, "wellness-focused" expression of the winery’s coastal style, specifically crafted to contain fewer calories and lower sugar without sacrificing varietal character. Sourced from cool-climate vineyards in California, the grapes are harvested with lower potential alcohol and fermented to a bone-dry finish. The winemaking process maintains the signature Kendall-Jackson profile of vibrant citrus, crisp green apple, and subtle floral notes, while keeping the calorie count to approximately 80–85 calories per 5 oz serving and zero grams of sugar. On the palate, it is light-to-medium-bodied and refreshing, offering a clean, zesty finish with a hint of toasted oak from partial barrel maturation.

deveron-12-year-old.title: The Deveron 12 Year Old
deveron-12-year-old.bodyHtml: Unique horizontal condensers on the wash stills of the Macduff distillery are thought to be responsible for this drams light consistency. Golden and light bodied with aromas of honey, vanilla, baked pear and heather; the palate opens up with tart green apple, cereal and mineral on the medium length finish.

crabbie-goat-salted-caramel-moonshine.title: The Crabbie Goat Salted Caramel Moonshine
crabbie-goat-salted-caramel-moonshine.bodyHtml:
The Crabbie Goat Salted Caramel Moonshine is an ultra-smooth, craft-flavored wheat moonshine produced by The Crabbie Goat Distillery in Valleyview, Alberta. Handcrafted in small batches, it balances rich caramelized cane sugar and sweet butterscotch with a delicate touch of sea salt, delivering a silky and indulgent dessert-style spirit without harsh burn.

Food Pairing: Vanilla bean ice cream, warm apple pie, chocolate brownies, pecan pie, or shortbread cookies.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden caramel in appearance with a silky, smooth, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich buttery caramel, warm toasted sugar, sweet butterscotch, and light vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and creamy with deep caramel, sweet butterscotch, toffee, and a subtle ribbon of sea salt.

Finish : Warm, savory, and balanced with lingering sweet caramel and a clean salty edge.

Serve : Serve chilled over ice, poured over ice cream, added to coffee or hot cider, or mixed with ginger ale or cream soda.

crabbie-goat-kickin-coffee-moonshine.title: The Crabbie Goat Distillery Kickin Coffee Moonshine
crabbie-goat-kickin-coffee-moonshine.bodyHtml:
The Crabbie Goat Distillery Kickin Coffee Moonshine is an espresso-flavoured moonshine from a family-run craft distillery in Alberta known for its smooth, wheat-based moonshine. It is infused with rich espresso and roasted coffee, brown sugar, vanilla, a hint of cinnamon and a touch of caramel, for the flavour of a Spanish coffee with a moonshine kick. Bottled at 20% ABV (40 proof) in a 750ml mason jar, it can stand in for coffee liqueur in any cocktail.

Tasting Notes: Espresso, roasted coffee, brown sugar, vanilla, cinnamon and caramel.

Serve: Neat or on ice, in an Espresso Martini, in cold brew, or with cola and milk as a Paralyzed Goat.

rossville-union-single-barrel-54-1-abv.title: Rossville Union Single Barrel 54.10% ABV
rossville-union-single-barrel-54-1-abv.bodyHtml: This limited release is a bolder-than-ever cask strength whiskey offered in three premium mash bills. Rossville Union Single Barrel Straight Rye whiskey is a limited, private barrel selection available only at participating retailers. All of our whiskies enter the barrel at 60 abv. Single Barrel is uncut, therefore, the proof will be plus or minus 60 abv.

rossville-union-single-barrel-56-6-abv.title: Rossville Union Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey Cask Strength
rossville-union-single-barrel-56-6-abv.bodyHtml:
An ultra-premium, uncut expression for serious rye enthusiasts! Every bottle of Rossville Union Single Barrel is drawn from a solitary, carefully selected cask to showcase the absolute pinnacle of Ross & Squibb's legendary distilling capabilities. Bottled at a blistering cask strength of 56.60% ABV (113.2 proof), it provides an incredibly intense, robust, and full-bodied tasting experience, completely enveloping the palate in massive waves of dark spice, heavy oak, and sweet caramel without any dilution holding it back.

 

NOSE

Intense and complex with deep notes of heavily charred oak, dark caramel, baking spices, and a hint of old leather.

PALATE

Thick, oily, and mouth-coating. Huge waves of spicy rye grain and white pepper are perfectly balanced by rich vanilla bean, brown sugar, and dark cherry.

FINISH

Exceptionally long and chest-warming with a lasting, dry trail of spicy rye and sweet toasted wood.

verdon-reserve-no-5-blueline-red.title: Verdon Estate Reserve No.5 Blueline Vineyards Proprietary Red 750ml
verdon-reserve-no-5-blueline-red.bodyHtml:
The Verdon Estate Reserve No.5 is a remarkable red wine sourced from Blueline Vineyards in Napa Valley. This proprietary blend is crafted to highlight the elegance and intensity of the region’s best fruit, offering a bold yet refined expression.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Deep, rich ruby.

  • Aromas: A complex bouquet of dark fruits such as blackberries, cassis, and ripe plums, accented by hints of baking spices, tobacco, and a touch of vanilla.

  • Taste: Full-bodied and structured, with concentrated flavors of black fruit, dark chocolate, and subtle oak influence. The wine has a smooth, velvety texture, with balanced acidity and ripe tannins that lead to a long, lingering finish.

Blend Composition:

Typically led by Cabernet Sauvignon, complemented by Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot, creating a well-rounded and dynamic profile.

Aging:

Aged for 18–22 months in French oak barrels, giving the wine added depth and complexity.

Food Pairing:

Pair this wine with grilled meats, roasted lamb, charcuterie, or rich, aged cheeses.

arling-blaze-love-needs-courage-cab-sauv.title: Arling Blaze Love Needs Courage Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 750ml
arling-blaze-love-needs-courage-cab-sauv.bodyHtml: Young-at-heart, juicy and exuberant. Though, for all its fun, it tastes like a Cab from the heart of California’s North Coast. Raucously red fruited. Raucously red fruited, with 10% American oak to give it some spice, it is compact and punchy in form. Enjoy freely, pour liberally, and love heartily!

rockslide-stoneface-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Stonestreet Estate Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
rockslide-stoneface-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Stonestreet Estate Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 showcases the incredible depth and structure that comes from high-elevation mountain viticulture. The nose presents savory, expressive aromas of wild blackberry, dark plum, blood orange, star anise, and toasted cedar, layered with undertones of graphite and bay laurel. On the palate, this full-bodied mountain Cabernet is rich and inviting, displaying a lush mouthfeel balanced by fresh acidity and firm, chewy tannins. Deep flavors of plum skin, cocoa, sage, and red peppercorn dance across the palate, carrying through to an exceptionally long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, venison loin, or rich, slow-cooked beef stews.

93 Points - James Suckling

Bright purple fruit with lifted notes of bramble berries, violets and bergamot. The palate is full-bodied with chewy tannins, a lush mouthfeel, fine acidity and notes of dark plums, cocoa, sage and red peppercorns. A blend of multiple blocks made up of 98% Cabernet Sauvignon with smaill amounts of petit verdot, merlot and malbec. Drink or hold.

glengoyne-15-year-old-1.title: Glengoyne 15 Year Old
glengoyne-15-year-old-1.bodyHtml: The depth and sweetness of dried fruit. Complex depths and bright tropical notes - with a spicy oak finish. Hints of candied lemon and pineapple reveal the influence of first-fill bourbon casks, balanced by the rich intensity of our signature sherry wood.

beau-vigne-amendment-red.title: Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
beau-vigne-amendment-red.bodyHtml:
Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is a rich, elegant, and full-bodied red wine from California's renowned Napa Valley. Crafted with carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine showcases the region's exceptional winemaking heritage and Beaulieu Vineyard's commitment to quality. It offers concentrated dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, and subtle oak influences, creating a beautifully balanced and sophisticated drinking experience. With its smooth texture, layered complexity, and lingering finish, this Cabernet Sauvignon is an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining, or enjoying with a hearty meal.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, barbecue, hearty pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses such as cheddar and Gouda.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Focused and brilliant flavors of red and black cherries and black currants drive this sleek and powerful wine, as minty, toasty, and tobacco-like accents stay subtly in the background until the finish. A full body, medium to full tannins and good fruit acidity lend tangy freshness. Best from 2026.

91 Points - James Suckling 

A juicy and delicious wine with a round and polished texture with hints of chocolate and walnuts. Some iron shavings, too. Medium body. Savory at the end. Lovely dark fruit in the finish. Juicy. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a light mesquite edge that mingles with gently mulled plum and blackberry fruit flavors, while lightly singed vanilla and tobacco fill in through the finish. Reveals a solid graphite spine, too. Drink now through 2033. Tasted twice, with consistent notes

dolum-cask-11-sonoma-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Dolum Estates Cask 11 Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
dolum-cask-11-sonoma-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Dolum Estates Cask 11 Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 pours a deep, ink-like ruby red color into the glass, boasting rich highlights at its rim. The bouquet is highly expressive and forward, unfolding with concentrated aromas of bright red cherry, wild blackberry compote, and dark cassis, seamlessly framed by a good dash of oak spice, vanilla, and sweet tobacco leaf. On the palate, this full-bodied Californian red delivers a lush and velvety texture. Its powerful structure relies on a firm core of dark stone fruits and berry compote, beautifully supported by tightly woven, refined tannins and a fresh, lively acidity that keeps it energetic. The finish is remarkably long and harmonious, closing with lingering accents of baking spice, mocha, and a subtle savory touch.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised venison stews, rich pulled pork, wild mushroom risotto, or hard artisanal cheeses.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Quite fresh in flavor and firm in texture, this full-bodied wine offers bright cherry and blackberry aromas that lead to nicely concentrated fruits and a good dash of oak spice from barrel aging. Drinkable now with rich foods, but better from 2025.

antinori-chianti-classico-riserva-2014.title: Marchese Antinori Tenuta Tignanello Chianti Classico Riserva 2023
antinori-chianti-classico-riserva-2014.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Tenuta Tignanello Chianti Classico Riserva 2023 (labeled as Marchese Antinori) is a vibrant, elegant, and beautifully structured Tuscan red wine crafted exclusively from grapes harvested at the prestigious Tenuta Tignanello estate in San Casciano in Val di Pesa.
