Grown on southwest-facing hillsides characterized by limestone- and schist-rich marine marlstone (alberese and galestro), this vintage demonstrates remarkable purity and depth. Following destemming, soft crushing, and temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks, the wine was matured for approximately twelve months in French and Hungarian oak barriques. In the glass, it pours an intense, luminous ruby red. The aromatic profile is expressive and complex, opening with fragrant notes of ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and redcurrants, accompanied by delicate undertones of crushed violets, licorice, tobacco leaf, cocoa, and sweet baking spices like clove and nutmeg. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full body marked by plush, velvety tannins, energetic natural acidity, and a seamless, savory core of fruit that carries through to an expansive, mineral-edged finish.

Food Pairing: Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted rack of lamb, pappardelle with wild boar ragù, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A classic Chianti with exquisite aromas of vibrant black cherries, licorice, bark, earth and violets. Medium-bodied, firm and velvety, with sweet grainy tannins, crisp and exuberant acidity and savory, spicy length. Drinkable now, but best over the next decade.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Big fruit and some ripeness emerge from the bouquet of the Marchesi Antinori 2023 Chianti Classico Riserva Tenuta Tignanello Marchese Antinori. The wine is open-knit and generous, with rich fruit, tart spice and a savory side. Hints of clove and nutmeg add complexity and warmth. The Sangiovese and complementary varieties are aged in French and Hungarian oak barriques for about a year.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Licorice, tar and iron aromas embrace the plum, black cherry, iron and sweet spice flavors in this powerful red. Dense tannins lend support, while the finish echoes earth and tar accents. Best from 2028 through 2042.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose entices with aromas of malted chocolate, orange zest and luxardo cherries, and the palate stays rich with notes of chocolate cake and dried cherries, plus an espresso bean finish. Tannins are sleek but strong.

pian-delle-vigne-brunello-2004.title: Marchesi Antinori Pian delle Vigne Brunello di Montalcino 2004 3L Double Magnum
pian-delle-vigne-brunello-2004.bodyHtml:
Ruby red color with garnet hues.Aromatic and complex on the nose, withhints of spices, cherries, blackberries,light tobacco and pleasant chocolateundertones. Very full-bodied and broadon the palate, with an intense sweetness.Decisive but smooth, with eleganttannins and a long, persistent finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Has dried cherry and berry aromas, with hints of flowers, following through to a full body, with silky tannins and a delicate finish. A little reserved, but there's lots of fresh fruit and racy acidity. Best after 2010.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Antinori's 2004 Brunello di Montalcino Pian delle Vigne is a sweet, perfumed offering. Medium in body, the wine offers up scents of tobacco, wild cherries, spices and flowers in an elegant, restrained style for this bottling. The silky, finessed tannins frame the fruit nicely and carry through all the way to the long finish. Anticipated maturity: 2011-2019.

antinori-le-mortelle-poggio-alle-nane.title: Marchesi Antinori Le Mortelle Poggio Alle Nane 2019/2022 750ml
antinori-le-mortelle-poggio-alle-nane.bodyHtml:
Poggio alle Nane is an intense ruby red color. On the nose spicy and balsamic scents of cloves, coffee, and licorice merge with notes of ripe dark fruit such as plums and black currants. Its bouquet is completed by delicate minty notes. Its palate is rich, elegant and mouth-filling with vibrant tannins. Its lingering finish is characterized by notes of roasted coffee, dark chocolate, and currants.

93 Points - Falstaff 

Rich ruby with fine purple shimmer. Very lush nose with pronounced Mediterranean notes of cedar and thyme, then mulberries, blueberries and carob. Shows a lot of rich ripe berry fruit on the palate, lots of sweet texture, grippy tannins, hearty, with an aftertaste of prunes and dark chocolate.

le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia-2020.title: Ornellaia Le Serre Nuove dell’Ornellaia 2022
le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia-2020.bodyHtml:
Ornellaia Le Serre Nuove dell’Ornellaia 2022 is a radiant, deeply expressive, and impeccably balanced second wine from the legendary Tenuta dell'Ornellaia estate, reflecting its signature sophistication even in a warm, sun-drenched vintage. Exhibiting a deep red-purple hue in the glass, it opens with a highly aromatic and complex nose featuring notes of ripe blackcurrants, wild plums, and dark cherries, accented by elegant layers of violets, freshly ground coffee, sweet tobacco, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red is remarkably plush, juicy, and focused, displaying an exceptional purity of fruit that counters the vintage's natural weight. Matured for 15 months in French oak barriques, its velvety texture is beautifully supported by super-fine, structured tannins and a persistent, blood orange-tinged vein of freshness, culminating in a long, savory, and wonderfully polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with grilled rosemary lamb chops, slow-cooked beef brisket, rich wild boar ragù, or a prime ribeye steak cooked rare.

95 Points - James Suckling

The brightness and purity of fruit is so beautiful here, showing flowers and currants. Very aromatic. Lots of finesse and focus on the medium-bodied palate with super-fine tannins and a lovely finish.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is both savory and floral, with aromas of violets, crushed rose petals, fresh brewed coffee, top soil, mixed herbs and figs. The palate has the tangy richness of black cherries, black figs and dark chocolate, but a current of mint, saltwater and licorice creates a very fresh, vibrant overall feel.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Ornellaia 2022 Bolgheri Rosso Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia is a blend of 65% Merlot, 25% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Cabernet Franc that saw 15 months in barrique with one-third new oak. Following in the general Ornellaia philosophy, the team has been leaning off long maceration times for more delicate extraction. Blending for this wine usually occurs 12 months after fermentation. This vintage is structured and rich with sweet tannins and a supple texture. This hot vintage brings more fruit weight for sure, but the wine remains fresh and well balanced overall.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A smooth red, this evokes cedar, plum, black currant, blackberry, vanilla and resin aromas and flavors. Broad and dense, with accents of leather, earth and tobacco on the long finish. Cabernet Sauvignon.

le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia-2021.title: Ornellaia Le Serre Nuove dell’Ornellaia 2022
le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia-2021.bodyHtml:

luce-2021.title: Tenuta Luce Toscana 2021
luce-2021.bodyHtml:
A monumental and aristocratic expression of the Frescobaldi family's Montalcino estate, the 2021 Tenuta Luce is a powerful "Super Tuscan" that balances opulence with structural elegance. This vintage presents an impenetrable ruby-purple color and opens with a complex, expansive bouquet of blackcurrants, ripe blackberries, and blueberries, seamlessly layered with notes of dark chocolate, licorice, and balsamic herbs. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and remarkably dense, showcasing a silky, velvety texture and firm, perfectly integrated tannins. The 2021 is noted for its exceptional energy and precision, leading to an extraordinarily long finish marked by savory minerality and refined oak spice.

96 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrants, minerals, mint and hints of chocolate follow through to a medium to full body with linear fruit and tannins that run the length of the wine. The tannins are extremely polished, with beauty and style. Needs three or four years to come together. Best after 2027.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Aromas and flavors of lavender, plum, black cherry, vanilla, earth and resin are the hallmarks of this concentrated yet lively red. Firm, ripe tannins give the finish grip for now, yet this red is complex and long, with all of its components in the right place. Sangiovese and Merlot. Best from 2026 through 2042.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This is an iconic bottle that has seen mild stylistic tweaks but that fundamentally has remained quite consistent over the years. Sticking to its blueprint, the Tenuta Luce 2021 Luce della Vite remains a "super Tuscan-styled" blockbuster that speaks more of the grapes used in the blend than it does its territory. It is made with Sangiovese and Merlot. It shows thick extraction, soft tannins and a velvety mouthfeel. The oak tannins are a little dry, but the wine remains plush and accessible overall.

luce-lux-vitis.title: Tenuta Luce Lux Vitis 2020 1.5L Magnum
luce-lux-vitis.bodyHtml:
Tenuta Luce Lux Vitis 2020 is an exceptionally structured, full-bodied Super Tuscan sourced predominantly from high-density Cabernet Sauvignon vines planted on the sandy-clay soils of Montalcino, enriched with a small touch of Sangiovese. Aged for 24 months in new French oak barriques, it showcases a dense, dark purple-ruby hue with brilliant aromatic complexity. The nose displays intense aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, crushed violets, cedarwood, and graphite, complemented by subtle notes of dark chocolate, sweet spices, and resinous Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it exhibits immense power and seamless depth, featuring velvety, tightly woven tannins and driving acidity that carries a rich core of ripe dark fruits into an extraordinarily long, elegant, and mineral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted venison loin, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, or well-aged Pecorino cheese.

luce-lux-vitis-1.title: Tenuta Luce Lux Vitis 2021 3L Double Magnum
luce-lux-vitis-1.bodyHtml:
Tenuta Luce Lux Vitis 2021 is an extraordinarily rich, powerful, and deeply complex red wine produced in Montalcino by Tenuta Luce. Crafted primarily from Cabernet Sauvignon with a small touch of Sangiovese, it undergoes aging in new French oak barrels for 24 months. In the glass, it displays a dense, opaque ruby-purple color. The nose opens with intense aromas of ripe cassis, black cherry, dried violets, and espresso bean, underpinned by notes of dark chocolate, tobacco leaf, and exotic spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied, opulent, and impeccably structured, offering layers of dark berry fruit framed by firm, velvety tannins and lively acidity that ensures exceptional aging potential through a long, luxurious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with Florentine bistecca, braised beef short ribs, venison tenderloin, roasted rack of lamb, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano or Pecorino cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

A complex and restrained wine. The nose shows an elegant mix of leafy notes, cloves and subtle cassis, with graphite and licorice depth. Balanced attack with juicy acidity, firm ripe tannins and a full body. Great integration and length. Drink or hold.

quintessa-estate-2016.title: Quintessa 2016
quintessa-estate-2016.bodyHtml:
The 2016 Quintessa is a generous wine, with complex and elegant layers than envelop you from the first sip. Welcoming with aromas of cassis, blackberry, red currant and undertones of sage, thyme, crushed rocks, and rose petals, the 2016 Quintessa continues to expand in the glass as notes of exotic citrus, clove and fresh tobacco mingle with bright fruit. Full and rich, the wine is held together with fine-grained tannins that interweave beautifully with flavors of dark chocolate, crushed rocks, black cherry, and blueberries. The wine is distinct for its energy and depth of flavor and will leave a lasting impression with its velvety texture and intoxicating perfume.

98 Points - James Suckling

Phenomenal aromas of crushed berries, forest fruit, mushrooms and iron. Medium to full body, with layers of soft and refined tannins that follow through to a beautiful finish. Extremely long and refined. This shows depth and structure with balance and harmony. Hard not to open the bottle now and drink it, but it appears to be closing down now. Needs four to five years to show it all.

95  Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Quintessa's 2016 Proprietary Red Wine boasts relatively youthful, primary fruit, with cherries and black cherries both appearing on the nose. Medium to full-bodied, it's silky and suave on the palate, framed by ripe, supple tannins that linger elegantly on the finish.Best After 2022

93  Points - Wine Spectator
A ripe, fleshy style, with dark currant, fig and blackberry fruit, steeped with sage, tobacco and warm licorice notes. A light alder hint stitches up the finish, showing latent, mineral-tinged grip. Solid. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot and Carmenère. Best from 2020 through 2032.

quintessa-estate-2012.title: Quintessa 2012
quintessa-estate-2012.bodyHtml:
Rarely do you find a wine that is seamless from start to finish. This wine entices with aromas of violets mingled with red and black fruit. On the palate, it is rich and concentrated, finishing with elegant well-balanced tannins. This is truly an exceptional wine from a textbook growing season.

96 Points - James Suckling

Purity of blackberry, black currant and hints of toasted oak. Full body, yet refined and very elegant. The tannins are extremely polished and beautiful. It's so beautiful to drink now. Goes on for minutes. From biodynamically grown grapes. Hard not to drink now but will improve with age.

94  Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The outstanding 2012 Proprietary Red Blend Quintessa is composed of Bordeaux varietals dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon followed by Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot and Carmenère. One of the strongest efforts to date from this winery, it possesses a deep ruby/purple color as well as abundant aromas of sweet white chocolate, acacia flowers, and black and red fruits, full-bodied opulence, velvety tannins, and enough acidity to provide freshness and focus. It can be drunk now or cellared for another 10-15+ years.

92  Points - Wine Spectator

Pleasantly rich, graceful and elegant, with a tapered mix of currant, blueberry and blackberry flavors that are ripe, firm and deep, but not weighty or excessive. A seductive push of black licorice adds dimension. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Carmenère and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2027.

petrolo-boggina-c.title: Petrolo Boggina C 750ml
petrolo-boggina-c.bodyHtml: Petrolo Bòggina C is a single-vineyard, 100% Sangiovese from the Petrolo estate in Tuscany's Val d'Arno di Sopra DOC, certified organic. The wine comes from the Bòggina vineyard, the estate's historic Sangiovese plot planted in the early 1950s by Gastone Bazzocchi, grandfather of the current owners, and later replanted in sections using massal selection of the original vines. Petrolo regards it as its best Sangiovese site. Grapes are hand-picked and sorted, fermented spontaneously with native yeasts in glass-lined concrete tanks, then matured for about 16 to 18 months in French oak casks of 22 hl and 7 hl tonneaux. Production is around 5,000 bottles. 750ml.

malibu-pineapple-rum.title: Malibu Pineapple Flavoured Rum
malibu-pineapple-rum.bodyHtml:
Malibu Pineapple is a flavoured rum from the Malibu brand, made with Caribbean rum infused with pineapple flavour. The Canadian bottling is 21% ABV in a 750ml bottle, making it a light, easy-drinking option. Expect a refreshing pineapple aroma lifted by citrus notes, followed by a smooth, sweet finish. A natural fit for tropical highballs, punches and frozen drinks.

Nose: Fresh pineapple with citrus notes.

Finish: Smooth and sweet.

Serve: Over ice with soda or juice, or in tropical cocktails.

hendricks-flora-adora.title: Hendrick's Flora Adora Gin
hendricks-flora-adora.bodyHtml:
Hendrick's Flora Adora Gin is a wonderfully enticing, limited-edition release from Master Distiller Lesley Gracie’s "Cabinet of Curiosities." Inspired by the fascinating, buzzing wildflower gardens at the Hendrick's Gin Palace, this expression takes the signature house foundation of 11 botanicals, rose, and cucumber, and heavily layers it with a secret selection of deeply aromatic, sweet floral botanicals. The result is an intensely perfumed, vibrant, and summer-inspired gin designed to celebrate nature in full bloom.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with light, garden-fresh dishes such as a summer goat cheese salad with strawberries, lemon-herb grilled chicken skewers, or classic cucumber finger sandwiches. It is also a delightful match for sweet floral treats like lavender shortbread, lemon tarts, or raspberry macarons.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear and transparent. It features a lush, velvety, and unctuous mouthfeel that heavily coats the palate with aromatic sweetness.

NOSE Extremely fragrant and intensely perfumed. A dramatic, heavy bouquet of pungent rose water, fresh lavender, and sweet hibiscus takes center stage, accompanied by notes of honeysuckle, citrusy chamomile, and a soft backdrop of clean juniper.

PALATE Lush, sweet, and highly flower-forward. Flavors of fresh lavender, violet, and elderflower flood the entry, closely followed by fruity hints of ripe peach and orange oil. The mid-palate introduces a green, herbaceous counterweight of earthy juniper, coriander, and fresh-cracked pepper.

FINISH Moderately long, crisp, and cooling. The intense floral perfume transitions into a dry, refreshing close marked by lingering lavender, grassy chamomile, and a soft, peppery sting.

SERVE Superb when lengthened in refreshing, effervescent long drinks. Enjoy it in the signature "Wildgarden Cup" (mixed with fresh mint, cooling cucumber, juicy raspberries, and lemon soda), or build a simple Flora Adora & Tonic garnished with a thin ribbon of cucumber.

adelphi-benrinnes.title: Cadenhead's Original Collection Benrinnes 11 Year Old
adelphi-benrinnes.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead's Original Collection Benrinnes 11 Year Old is an independently bottled Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from Benrinnes Distillery. Matured for 11 years in Palo Cortado sherry hogsheads, this expression combines Benrinnes' weighty malt character with rich dried fruit, nutty sherry notes and warming spice. Bottled by William Cadenhead at 46% ABV, it is presented without chill filtration or added colouring.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast pork, cured meats, aged Manchego, toasted walnuts, fruitcake or dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: Rich and sherried with dried fruit, roasted nuts, dark sweetness, malt and warming spice.

Nose: Dried fruits, toasted nuts and rich malt with hints of dark caramel and spice.

Palate: Full and rounded with raisins, dark fruit, nutty sherry character, malt sweetness and warming spice.

Finish: Lingering dried fruit, walnuts, oak spice and rich malt.

adelphi-breath-of-the-highlands.title: Adelphi Breath of the Highlands 12 Year Old 2009 55.2% ABV
adelphi-breath-of-the-highlands.bodyHtml:
Adelphi is Scotland’s most acclaimed bottler of rare single cask and limited edition single malt whisky.

They exist to identify the very small number of casks that have produced the ultimate whiskies. The criteria for selection include rarity and maturity, but above all flavour.

Adelphi whiskies are both rare and sought-after – these very special casks are so rare that, on average, Adelphi accepts a mere 4% that it is offered.

Each single cask of whisky matures its contents very differently, imparting its own character to the whisky it holds and, as a result, there are never two Adelphis quite the same.

This bottling is a 2009 vintage from the Highlands region.

Leather, mahogany. Very good bead. Allspice, Pimento Dram, Gammel Dansk, eucalyptus, liquorice, bitter dark chocolate, Angostura bitters, Riesen toffee, redcurrant
Camp Coffee, espresso martini, burnt toffee, pine resin, madeira cake.

adelphi-mortlach-1986.title: Mortlach 1986 Adelphi
adelphi-mortlach-1986.bodyHtml:
Mortlach 36 Year Old 1986 is a single cask bottling of Mortlach single malt from the independent bottler Adelphi, released in its Limited series. Distilled in 1986 at Mortlach in Dufftown, Speyside, it spent 36 years in cask number 2040 before being bottled in 2022 at its natural cask strength of 51.4% ABV. Presented in a 700ml bottle, it offers very old Mortlach from a single cask, bottled outside the distillery's own range, and will appeal to collectors and to drinkers who enjoy long-aged Speyside whisky. As with any single cask release, the character is specific to this one cask.

Serve: Neat; add a drop of water if desired, as it is bottled at cask strength.

jameson-irish-whiskey-x-dickies-leb.title: Jameson Irish Whiskey x Dickies Limited Edition
jameson-irish-whiskey-x-dickies-leb.bodyHtml:
Jameson Irish Whiskey x Dickies is a limited-edition bottle from 'Crafted Together', a 2023 collaboration between Jameson and the Dickies workwear brand that celebrates the modern craftsperson. The collection, which also included Dickies clothing featuring Jameson's original 'Barrelman' symbol, launched in June 2023 in 26 markets including Canada. Inside the specially dressed bottle is classic Jameson Irish Whiskey: a triple-distilled blend of pot still and grain whiskeys, matured in oak, bottled at 40% alcohol by volume in a 750 ml bottle. Jameson points out that when it was founded in 1780, workwear was the uniform of the working community, often seen in the local pub after a hard day's work, which is the link behind this collectable bottle.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or with ginger ale and a wedge of lime.

grgich-hills-chardonnay-2020-100th-anniv.title: Grgich Hills Estate Chardonnay Miljenkos Selection 2020
grgich-hills-chardonnay-2020-100th-anniv.bodyHtml:
The Paris Tasting Commemorative Chardonnay is a recreation of the now-famous 1973 Chardonnay crafted by Mike Grgich that beat the best French white wines in the historic Judgement of Paris. This wine has an elegant bouquet of fresh peach, key lime, and pineapple, enhanced by hints of Madagascar vanilla and caramel. Both soft and dense on the palate, it exudes juicy aromatics of green apple and fresh pineapple harmoniously balanced by crisp and refreshing acidity.

For this wine Grgich selected only the best grapes, which are primarily from their oldest block of Chardonnay, the Old Wente clone planted in 1989. Through a combination of clone, age, and cool climate, this single block in their estate vineyard in the chilly Carneros region of Napa Valley creates wonderfully rich flavors, balanced with crisp acidity. They farm all their certified organic vineyards naturally, using the principles of regenerative agriculture.

93 Points - James Suckling

An aromatic nose of white peach, green apple and pear. Medium-bodied with a silky texture. A little chalky on the palate, with a wash of charming bright fruit and berries. From organically grown grapes. Drink now.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Vivid peach and apricot aromas and flavors backed by lively acidity give this medium-bodied wine a bit of a Riesling spin. That's to say that it is delicate, silky and charming to sip.

henri-rebourseau-gevrey-chambertin-2002.title: Henri Rebourseau Gevrey Chambertin 2002 750ml
henri-rebourseau-gevrey-chambertin-2002.bodyHtml: The 2002 Domaine Henri Rebourseau Gevrey-Chambertin is a red wine from the Côte de Nuits region of Burgundy, France, produced from the Pinot Noir grape. It is described as having a robust, velvety, and expressive style with notes of black fruit, black liquorice, and chocolate, and after some time in the bottle, can exhibit bright, candied fruit and aromas of musk, truffle, and forest floor. Specifically, the 2002 vintage is described as having a nose with jammy red fruit and dried fig, and a palate that is firm and solid with dark fruits, such as damsons, black plums, and dried raisins, entangled in a firm structure. The wine is also noted for its intense acidity and spice, along with honeyed sweetness, and is recommended to be aged for several more years.

henri-rebourseau-gevrey-chambertin-2012.title: Henri Rebourseau Gevrey Chambertin 2012 750ml
henri-rebourseau-gevrey-chambertin-2012.bodyHtml: The Henri Rebourseau Gevrey Chambertin 2012 is a Burgundy red wine made from Pinot Noir, showcasing a vibrant and structured style with a bouquet of red and black fruits, and earthy notes. It is known for its firm structure, velvety tannins, and a complex, savory character.

henri-rebourseau-clos-vougeot-grand-cru.title: Domaine Henri Rebourseau Clos de Vougeot Vieilles Vignes Grand Cru
henri-rebourseau-clos-vougeot-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Domaine Henri Rebourseau Clos de Vougeot Vieilles Vignes Grand Cru is a profound Pinot Noir with aromas of black cherry, blackberry, violet, rose petals, forest floor, truffle, graphite, and exotic spice. Rich yet impeccably refined, it offers velvety tannins, vibrant acidity, remarkable mineral depth, and an extraordinarily long, age-worthy finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast venison, duck breast, herb-crusted lamb, wild mushroom dishes, or aged Comte for an exceptional Grand Cru Burgundy pairing.

bombay-sapphire-basquiat-limited-edition.title: Bombay Sapphire Basquiat Special Edition London Dry Gin
bombay-sapphire-basquiat-limited-edition.bodyHtml:
Bombay Sapphire Basquiat Special Edition is the classic Bombay Sapphire London dry gin in a collectible bottle created with the Estate of Jean-Michel Basquiat, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The bottle carries Untitled (L.A. Painting), licensed for the first time for this release: a work drawn from Basquiat's time near Venice Beach in Los Angeles and shown in his second exhibition, with his signature crown, bird, coin and skull motifs collaged over soft blues. Inside is the familiar Bombay Sapphire gin, made with hand-selected botanicals that Bombay says are 100% certified sustainably sourced, and known for a smooth, balanced taste with a crisp yet delicate finish. It works as well in long drinks as in a well-balanced Martini.

Finish: Crisp yet delicate.

Serve: In the official Basquiat cocktail, King Pleasure: Bombay Sapphire with pineapple puree, lemon, honey syrup and tonic water, garnished with pineapple leaves and a slice of jalapeno.

banded-peak-dry-camp-non-alcoholic.bodyHtml: Banded Peak Non Alc Sunsetter Ale 4 Cans

giant-steps-applejack-pinot-noir.title: Giant Steps Applejack Vineyard Pinot Noir 2025
giant-steps-applejack-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Giant Steps Applejack Vineyard Pinot Noir 2025 is a vibrant, highly elegant, and terroir-driven Australian red wine produced from the high-altitude Applejack Vineyard situated in the upper Yarra Valley. Visually displaying a translucent ruby hue with bright crimson highlights, it opens with a lifted bouquet of red cherry, wild strawberry, and pomegranate, seamlessly layered with subtle spice, crushed herbs, dried roses, and a delicate earthy minerality. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-bodied, fine-grained structure framed by silky tannins and a energetic core of natural acidity, delivering fresh red fruit and savory nuances that flow effortlessly into a long, fragrant, and poised finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with duck breast, pan-seared pork chops, roasted chicken, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, and mild creamy cheeses.

poggio-storico-brunello-riserva.title: Poggio Landi Brunello Riserva 2019
poggio-storico-brunello-riserva.bodyHtml:
Poggio Landi Brunello Riserva 2019 pours a luminous, compact garnet color with brilliant ruby highlights in the glass. The highly expressive bouquet opens with graceful, intoxicating aromatics of ripe red cherries, cranberries, and fresh blueberries, beautifully layered with secondary nuances of crushed violets, leather, sweet baking spices, and a distinctive balsamic depth. On the palate, this full-bodied and finely structured Tuscan red showcases immense depth and power, driven by a juicy, concentrated core of dark forest fruits. A vibrant line of natural acidity imparts healthy tension and precision, while fine-grained, velvety tannins seamlessly frame the rich texture. Following 48 months of meticulous maturation in French oak barrels, it carries subtle undercurrents of cedar, black pepper, and medicinal herbs effortlessly into an exceptionally long, elegant, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-braised wild boar ragù, grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rosemary lamb chops, truffle-infused mushroom risotto, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

High-end floral, strawberry and cherry notes are grounded with flavors of earth, iron, stone and underbrush in this intense, lively red. Well-mannered tannins come to the fore on the finish, leaving a firm grip. Shows fine equilibrium and terrific length. Best from 2028 through 2047. 750 cases made, 375 cases imported.

95 Points - James Suckling

Approachable and graceful style here with intoxicating violet aromas, black cherries, superfresh and juicy fruitiness and spicy depth. Medium-bodied, this is focused on tension and vibrancy with firm, chalky tannins and a long, fruity finish. From organically grown grapes. Drinkable now but best from 2026.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Deliciously medicinal and herbaceous on the nose with intense salinity, like fresh herbs growing on seaside cliffs. The palate sweetens significantly with milk chocolate layered over cherries and orange slices, but abundant pepper and acid hold tension. 

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Also quite savory with cured tobacco and sweet cigar, the organic Poggio Landi 2019 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva is a bold and structured wine with thick layers of baking spice and brandied plum. Its texture is open knit, and I would consider it almost ready to drink now. A hint of candied maraschino cherry adds sweet brightness to the close.

idi-di-marzo-perfectly-imperfect-rose.title: Dominio imperfetto "Perfectly Imperfect" Rose 2024
idi-di-marzo-perfectly-imperfect-rose.bodyHtml:
Dominio Imperfetto "Perfectly Imperfect" Rosé 2024 is an organic, light pink Italian rosé crafted from the rugged, sea-facing hills of Abruzzo along the Trabocchi Coast. Grown on sandy and limestone-rich soils, the wine undergoes a brief skin-contact maceration before stainless steel fermentation to retain maximum freshness. The nose reveals a fragrant, delicate bouquet of fresh wild strawberries, tart cherries, and pink grapefruit, layered with subtle floral notes of red roses and white flowers. On the palate, it is crisp, vibrant, and light-bodied, delivering refreshing mineral acidity, savory undertones, and a clean, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh seafood crudo, light fish pasta dishes, grilled prawns, summer caprese salad, and mild goat cheese.

viberti-langhe-nebbiolo.title: Viberti Giovanni Langhe Nebbiolo 2021 750ml
viberti-langhe-nebbiolo.bodyHtml:
Marked by ripe red fruit flavours, particularly cherries, and soft tannins, Viberti Nebbiolo is a fresh expression of Piedmont's signature varietal. Vinified in stainless steel, the wine was aged for 9 months before being transferred into neutral oak barrels known as tini where it rested 2-3 months prior to bottling. An additional 3 months of bottle ageing followed. Best within 3-5 years of the vintage. 

A beautiful perfume of deep red cherries and plums along with the beguiling scents of roses and sandalwood had us even before the first sip. Elegant and hauntingly beautiful in the mouth, the Viberti Langhe Nebbiolo flows on ripe and juicy tannins that complement the wine’s fruit and floral tones. Boldly flavored, yet elegantly structured, Viberti’s Langhe Nebbiolo finishes long and lovely with a hint of aromatic wood smoke. 

Pairs with savory dishes like red sauce, pork sausage, hard cheeses, and dishes with mushrooms, truffle, or winter squash.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ripe aromas of both fresh and preserved raspberries leap out of the glass of this plush Nebbiolo. As the wine opens, fresh floral aromas seamlessly combine with forward fruit notes and a hint of earth. The palate showcases juicy and plush fruits, dominated by tart plums and cherries. Ripe tannins and zippy acidity giving the mouthfilling wine lift on the finish.

vouvray-moelleux-reserve.title: Philippe Foreau Reserve Vouvray Moelleux 2018 750ml
vouvray-moelleux-reserve.bodyHtml: It is the rare vintage that is blessed with the conditions necessary for Foreau to release a Moelleux Réserve. Wines so declared frequently have levels of residual sugar that are in excess of 150 grams of residual sugar. It is not, however, simply the level of ripeness that creates the Moelleux Réserve; it is as much the conditions of the growing season that produce grapes that have a level of complexity and ripeness that demand this sort of classification. An error that many make in assessing and utilizing these wines is to consider the sugar quotient as a disqualifier for use of this wine during any stage of a meal. Our experience is such that these wines can marry well with a wide range of dishes served at the beginning, middle or end of a meal. Recent vintages that have seen the release of a Moelleux Réserve are: 2015, ’09, ’05, ’03.

henri-rebourseau-gev-chamb-la-brunelle.title: Henri Rebourseau Gev Chamb La Brunelle 750ml
henri-rebourseau-gev-chamb-la-brunelle.bodyHtml: Henri Rebourseau Gevrey-Chambertin "La Brunelle" is a dry, medium-bodied red wine made from Pinot Noir grapes. It's characterized by a nose of ripe plum liqueur, earth, and soft floral notes, and a palate with creamy fruit, saline edge, and ripe blackcurrant notes, according to Berry Bros. & Rudd. The wine also features a lingering finale with a hint of warmth.

blasted-church-syrah-vqa.title: Blasted Church Syrah 750ml
blasted-church-syrah-vqa.bodyHtml: Blasted Church Syrah is a Canadian Syrah from the Blasted Church Vineyards, offering a full-bodied, complex, and elegant wine with red berry and dark fruit notes, a peppery finish, and fine-grained tannins. It's known for its balance of fruit, acidity, and alcohol.

689-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.title: 689 California Red 2023
689-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The 2022 growing season started with ideal conditions. However, a Labor Day heat wave split the harvest season into earlier and later picks for many of the state’s wine regions. While the strain on the grapes caused lower yields than expected, it also produced memorable wines of exceptional concentration and complexity.

This year’s release bursts out of the glass with rich aromas of ripe wild berries. Plush notes of blackberry, cherry, and a touch of chocolate tantalize the palate, while hints of oak, spice, and licorice provide a finish with depth, balance, and soft tannins.

noughty-sparkling-rose.title: Thomson & Scott 'Noughty' Alcohol Free Organic Sparkling Rose 750ml
noughty-sparkling-rose.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: "This non-alc organic tempranillo fizz comes from vineyards across southern Spain. To make up for the lack of alcohol, and body, it is dosed with just under 60 g/L RS (!!). Even with all that sugar, it still comes across as sharp and searing, with tart cranberry fruit, candied red apple, on a short, pasty finish. Find a San Pellegrino instead. (Treve Ring)." - Gismondi on Wine

bask-sauvignon-blanc-1.title: Bask Sauvignon Blanc 3L Bag in Box

adaro-de-pradorey.title: PradoRey Real Sitio De Ventosilla Adaro 2018 750ml
adaro-de-pradorey.bodyHtml: 100% Tempranillo named after the winery’s founder, from perhaps the most carefully-tended Pradorey single vineyard, currently being converted to organic status. Temperature-controlled fermentation, aged in 12 months in French and Slavonian oak barrels, then a further 3 months in Nevers oak vats. Colour is dark cherry -red, deep, yet bright. Intense red fruit aromas mingle with vanilla and licorice. Tasty, fresh, with ripe fruit and velvety tannins, Pleasant mouthfeel, very elegant finish.

pradorey-elite.title: PradoRey Real Sitio De Ventosilla Elite 2019 750ml
pradorey-elite.bodyHtml:
From limited production vines this 100% Tempranillo displays incredible complexity and depth with notes of ripe dark fruits, minerality, and oak treatment. The tannins are present, yet round with a persistent long finish making this ageable red perfectly suited to pair with lamb, stew, or grilled steaks.

Sight- Bluish-red with garnet rim. An intense, bright wine. Nose - A wine of great aromatic complexity, with outstanding notes of ripe fruit, ink, and mineral essences, typical of the Tinta Fina variety. Central European hardwoods used in aging are assembled perfectly with the wine, ensuring at all times that they do not overpower the grape variety. Mouth - Round in the mouth, with tasty, well integrated tannins and a long and pleasant aftertaste with noticeable ripe red fruit.

96 Points - Guia Penn

Style, jammy, needs time. Colour, cherry, garnet rim. Aroma, fruit preserve, powerful, toasty, black fruit. Flavour, flavourful, long, round tannins.

92 Points - James Suckling

Fresh mulberries, violets, dried herbs, bark, vanilla and baking spices on the nose. A full-bodied red with tightly wound tannins. Firm and chewy with a dark character to the palate and quite a juicy, compact finish. Vegan.

finca-real-sitio-de-ventosilla.title: PradoRey Finca Real Sitio De Ventosilla Gran Reserva 2009 750ml

soda-jerk-root-beer-shot.title: Soda Jerk Root Beer Shot
soda-jerk-root-beer-shot.bodyHtml:
The crisp, classic and nostalgic taste of root beer (without the bubbles) with a smooth creamy finish.

Soda Jerk Root Beer Shot is 70 Proof (35% ABV), and available in 50ml individual shots, and 750ml bottles for sharing.

The best tasting shot and ideally served chilled.

soda-jerk-orange-cream-shot.title: Soda Jerk Orange Cream Shot
soda-jerk-orange-cream-shot.bodyHtml:
The classic and nostalgic blend of bright orange soda (without the bubbles) and smooth creamy vanilla ice cream, with a little bit of kick.

Soda Jerk Orange Cream Shot is 70 Proof (35% ABV), and available in 50ml individual shots, and 750ml bottles for sharing.

The best tasting shot and ideally served chilled.

ardbeg-single-cask-2406.title: Ardbeg 1994 26 Year Old Private Reserve Single Cask 2406
ardbeg-single-cask-2406.bodyHtml: Ardbeg 1994 26 Year Old Private Reserve Single Cask 2406

moet-chandon-brut-nba-edition.title: Moet & Chandon Brut with Red Gift Box
moet-chandon-brut-nba-edition.bodyHtml:
An elegant golden straw yellow with amber highlights. Its aromas are radiant, revealing bright yellow-fleshed fruits (apple, pear, yellow peach), honey, floral nuances (lime blossom) and elegant blond notes (brioche and fresh nuts). The palate is seductive, richly flavorful and smooth combining generosity and subtlety, fullness and vigor, followed by a delicately fresh crispiness (fruit with seeds), to reveal the magical balance of Champagne.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant version, fine and creamy in texture and backed by lively, orange peel acidity. A streak of smoke-tinged minerality underscores flavors of almond madeleine, poached pear, anise and preserved lemon. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Champagne gets better and better. It has a fine dryness with a crisp apple and citrus character. That goes with the touches of maturity that give the wine fine balance.

90 Points - James Suckling

Nicely complex aromas here, from dried apples, peaches and pears to candied citrus and brioche. It’s fruity, soft and rounded on the palate. Medium-bodied, lightly honeyed and balanced. Blend of pinot noir, pinot meunier and chardonnay.

bunnahabhain-abhainn-araig.title: Bunnahabhain Abhainn Araig Feis Ile 2022
bunnahabhain-abhainn-araig.bodyHtml:
Bunnahabhain Abhainn Araig Fèis Ìle 2022 is a limited festival release created to celebrate Fèis Ìle 2022. It is a marriage of Bunnahabhain spirit matured in ex-Bourbon casks and in ex-Pedro Ximénez sherry octave casks made from specially seasoned European oak, giving an unpeated, sherried, bold and complex single malt. It is bottled at 50.8% ABV with natural colour and without chill-filtration.

The name means 'Araig River' in Scots Gaelic. The Abhainn Araig is a river on Islay that feeds into the Margadale River, the spring water source for all Bunnahabhain whisky, and its water supplies cooling water for the distillery's condensers. This was the first whisky Bunnahabhain's Master Distiller, Brendan McCarron, tasted on his first visit to the distillery after joining in 2021.

Nose: Chocolate, powdered ginger and cigar box.

Palate: Velvety and rich, with creamy milk chocolate, then sweet raisins and dried raspberries; as the PX develops, balsamic vinegar and honeyed macadamias come through.

Finish: Deep and rich, with dark toffee and a final spicy burst of cinnamon.

bowmore-30-year-old-2022-release.title: Bowmore 30 Year Old 2022 Release
bowmore-30-year-old-2022-release.bodyHtml:
This 2022 bottling was distilled in 1989 and rested for 30 years in a combination of the finest Sherry hogsheads and Bourbon barrels. This edition is matured in the legendary Bowmore No. 1 Vaults, and is selected from just two casks each year. Bottled at a cask strength of 45.1% ABV, this 30-Year-Old is a celebration of Bowmore’s rich fruity and subtly smoky style. With only 2556 bottles available in 2022, Bowmore 30-Year-Old inspired by the terrain that surrounds the Bowmore Distillery and the legendary landscape that defines our whisky. Capturing the art of time, this whisky takes cues from the detailed markings on driftwood and the refined polish of sea glass, reflecting its eternal connection with Islay .

For over 240 years, Bowmore Distillery has been capturing the essence of Islay from the shores of its remote island home. Shaped by the 'sand of time', our single malt harnesses the power of time itself, even single drop telling a story of the past, savoured in the present.

This is a single malt defined, shaped and crafted by time.

TASTING NOTES

COLOUR: Burnished gold

NOSE: Heather honey, bananas and peaches, with pineapple, vanilla and butterscotch.

TASTE: Tropical fruits with honey sweetness, subtle peat smoke and hints of eucalyptus

FINISH: Mouth warming, with ripe fruits lingering on the tongue.

ABV: 45.3% - Cask Strength

opus-one-2019e.title: Opus One Overture 2022
opus-one-2019e.bodyHtml: Overture 2022 captivates you from the start. Its aromatic profile weaves a complex tapestry of bright cherry, fresh forest berries, and cut rose stems interwoven with delicate scents of violets, toasted almond, and anise. Blackberry, blueberry, and wild cherry take the lead on the palate with a lively acidity that adds a vibrant edge. The finish is long and rounded, with a touch of mocha and black tea that showcase the wine’s depth. This expression of selected parcels from our estate vineyards will age gracefully for years to come.

bowmore-22-year-old-aston-martin-ed-2.title: Bowmore Masters' Selection 22 Year Old Aston Martin Edition 2
bowmore-22-year-old-aston-martin-ed-2.bodyHtml:
Bowmore Masters' Selection 22 Year Old Aston Martin Edition 2 is an exceptional Islay single malt Scotch whisky created through a collaboration between Bowmore Distillery and British luxury carmaker Aston Martin. Released in 2022, this limited-edition expression combines whiskies distilled in 1997 and 2000, matured in American oak hogsheads and sherry butts. Bottled at 51.5% ABV, it offers an elegant balance of heather honey, ripe orchard fruit, vanilla fudge, oak spice, and Bowmore's signature gentle peat smoke. Limited to 12,800 bottles worldwide, it celebrates the shared craftsmanship of two iconic British brands.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, grilled lamb, roasted duck, aged cheddar, dark chocolate, toasted hazelnuts, and caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and complex, featuring heather honey, ripe fruit, vanilla fudge, butterscotch, oak spice, and delicate peat smoke.

Nose: Heather honey, vanilla, cherries, lychee, eucalyptus, oak spices, liquorice, tobacco leaves, and fresh mint.

Palate: Vanilla fudge, golden syrup, butterscotch, thyme, white pepper, hazelnut, demerara sugar, maple syrup, and dates.

Finish: Long, sweet, and woody, with lingering liquorice, warming spice, and gentle peat smoke.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature. Allow the whisky to rest before tasting, or add a few drops of water to reveal its layered fruit and oak characteristics.

quintessa-2019.title: Quintessa 2019
quintessa-2019.bodyHtml:
The 2019 Quintessa offers nuance, depth, and great persistence. A complex of flower, forest, fruit, and earth notes harmonize with fine-grained tannin and vibrant acidity. It is a wine of precision as well as transparency. The 2019 Quintessa will drink well now for those that prefer a youthful expression but will also last in cellar for at least another twenty years for those who enjoy the complexities of age.

100 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is a winemaker's master class in blending and understanding of a long-standing site. Dried herb, cedar and pencil shavings accent lifted red fruit and brilliant acidity on the palate, with a supple yet still youthfully grippy texture that is framed by structured, graceful tannins. Enjoy from 2029–2039

99 Points - James Suckling

So much earth and spice with walnut and wet earth. Like fog laying over the valley in the morning. Black fruit. Medium-to full-bodied with super-fine tannins that are long and persistent, with graceful progression and length on the palate. So long, with real definition. September 2022 release. From biodynamically grown grapes. Hard not to drink now, but will age wonderfully.


95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Proprietary Red Wine is more open and effusive than the 2018 version, with gentle floral nuances set against a backdrop of black cherries and cassis, joined by subtle notes of tobacco, cedar and vanilla. In the mouth, it's medium to full-bodied, streamlined, silky and lush, nicely balanced and elegant, with a long, softly dusty finish tinged with licorice and caramel. Tasted twice, with consistent notes. 

93  Points - Wine Spectator

Sports a very forward set of cassis and creamed plum notes before giving way to a firmer, more authoritative iron, warm earth and singed alder profile. Grippy and dense through the finish, but there's cut and drive, with a savory edge adding good energy. This just needs some time for the mineral side to settle in with the fruit. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Carmenère. Best from 2024

edradour-ballechin-sftc-bourbon-53.title: Ballechin 12 Year Old 2010 Straight From The Cask Bourbon Casks 500ml
edradour-ballechin-sftc-bourbon-53.bodyHtml:
Ballechin 12 Year Old 2010 Straight From The Cask is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky from Ballechin, the peated spirit made at Edradour Distillery in Pitlochry. Distilled on 3 September 2010, it was fully matured in two bourbon casks, numbers 214 and 219, and bottled on 30 September 2022, giving 703 bottles. Bottled straight from the cask at natural cask strength of 53% ABV with natural colour, it presents Ballechin's smoke through the vanilla-led lens of bourbon wood. 500ml bottle in a presentation tube.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water to taste.

edradour-natural-ibisco-bourbon-58-9.title: Edradour 2012 Natural Cask Strength Bourbon Casks Ibisco Decanter
edradour-natural-ibisco-bourbon-58-9.bodyHtml:
Toffee, coconut and toasted bread coat the palate, before a heady delivery of cask spices (pepper and allspice) take hold – they too are zingy and awakening. In the background, vanilla and toasted corn offer more typical ex-bourbon joys whilst coconut oils an butter hark to the underlying weight of the Edradour spirit.

The finish is Medium in length with heavily charred casks and a fading juicy young oak adding dryness.

almaviva-2020.title: Almaviva 2020
almaviva-2020.bodyHtml:
In 1997, Baroness Philippine de Rothschild, owner of Mouton Rothschild, and Eduardo Guilisasti Tagle, owner of Viña Concha y Toro, entered into a partnership to create an exceptional Franco-Chilean wine called Almaviva. Almaviva was intentionally chosen to pay homage to Chile’s ancestral history, with three reproductions of a stylized design, which symbolizes the vision of the earth and the cosmos in the Mapuche civilization. The design appears on the kultrun, a ritual drum used by the Mapuche. Two great traditions thus join hands to offer the whole world a promise of pleasure and excellence.

98 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of herbs and fresh flowers with currants and blackberries follow through to a full body with chewy yet polished and refined tannins. This is so harmonious and beautiful. So real and such a great Chilean. 68% cabernet sauvignon, 24% carmenere, 6% cabernet franc and 2% petit verdot. Give it another two or three years, but already gorgeous.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

2020 was exceptionally dry, with 75% less rain than usual in the period between May and September, which resulted in an earlier harvest to produce a 2020 Almaviva with 68% Cabernet Sauvignon, 24% Carmenere (from Peumo), 6% Cabernet Franc and 2% Petit Verdot, so with no Merlot this time. The process was as careful as possible, without using any pumps, doing manual and optical sorting of the grapes, pressing in small vertical presses and aging of 20 months in French oak barrels, 73% of them new and the rest second use. The wine reached good ripeness with 14.9% alcohol. It still shows the effect of the élevage a bit, with abundant notes of sweet spices, a creamy touch and some smoke. I tasted it next to the 2019, and the wines have a very similar aromatic palette with a clear note of baked peppers. What was amazing in 2020 was that they harvested the Carmenere almost five weeks earlier than they normally would, and the result is not a green wine at all.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Beguiling on the nose, this red offers layers of cardamom, chrysanthemum, balsam and loganberry. Offers a palate that's equally engaging and elegant yet powerful, with a silky smooth frame and concentrated blackberry and cassis flavors. Packs lively acidity that brings freshness and cohesion and extends the finish, where details of peppercorn and olive emerge around fine tannins, all while echoing back to the core flavors. Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenere, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot.

opus-one-2019d.title: Opus One Overture 2022
opus-one-2019d.bodyHtml: Overture 2022 captivates you from the start. Its aromatic profile weaves a complex tapestry of bright cherry, fresh forest berries, and cut rose stems interwoven with delicate scents of violets, toasted almond, and anise. Blackberry, blueberry, and wild cherry take the lead on the palate with a lively acidity that adds a vibrant edge. The finish is long and rounded, with a touch of mocha and black tea that showcase the wine’s depth. This expression of selected parcels from our estate vineyards will age gracefully for years to come.

quintessa-rutherford-2020.title: Quintessa Rutherford 2016
quintessa-rutherford-2020.bodyHtml: Quintessa 2016 comes from the Quintessa estate in Rutherford, Napa Valley, farmed according to organic principles since its planting in 1989 and with biodynamic practices since 1996. The estate calls 2016 a near-perfect season: an early budburst, ideal spring and summer weather and a cooler August gave long hang time, and harvest ran before dawn from 15 September to 13 October. The blend is 89% Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Merlot, 2% Cabernet Franc, 2% Carménère and 1% Petit Verdot from sixteen vineyard blocks, aged for 20 months in barrel (70% new French oak). The estate describes a round, elegant wine with dark red and black fruit, floral notes, succulent acidity and a long finish. James Suckling rated it 98 points.

opus-one-2019c.bodyHtml: Overture 2022 captivates you from the start.
