secret-barrel-7-year-old.title: Secret Barrel Distillery 7 Year Old Rum
secret-barrel-7-year-old.bodyHtml:
Secret Barrel Distillery 7 Year Old Rum comes from Secret Barrel Distillery, a distillery based in Alberta, Canada. This rum carries a seven-year age statement and is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. A locally produced aged rum for anyone who likes to support Alberta distilling, suited to sipping neat or over ice as well as to classic rum cocktails.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in a rum Old Fashioned.

black-stallion-bucephalus-2017.title: Black Stallion Bucephalus Red 2019
black-stallion-bucephalus-2017.bodyHtml:
The Bucephalus showcases aromas of cassis, sandalwood and clove. The opulent aromas integrate beautifully with the rich, ripe, fruit flavors of blackberry and dark cherry and a subtle nuisance of maple syrup. This full bodied wine has intense depth and broad rich flavors.

93 Points - James Suckling

Lots of blackberry and blueberry aromas and flavors with chocolate and hazelnut. It’s full-bodied with firm tannins and lots of blue fruit on the finish. Firm and polished. Cabernet sauvignon, malbec, petit verdot and syrah. Very nicely done. Drink or hold.

bowmore-27-year-old-sherry-oak-timeless.title: Bowmore 12 Year Old Sherry Oak Cask
bowmore-27-year-old-sherry-oak-timeless.bodyHtml:
Bowmore 12 Year Old Sherry Oak Cask is a brilliant, sherried evolution of the beloved Islay classic. Part of Bowmore’s meticulously crafted Sherry Oak Collection, this expression highlights the distillery’s mastery of flavor integration. It is matured in a careful combination of European oak Oloroso sherry casks and American oak ex-bourbon barrels for a full 12 years. This dual maturation bridges the rich, sweet fruit and spice notes of the sherry wood with Bowmore’s signature moderate coastal peat smoke and maritime salinity. The result is a beautifully balanced, highly approachable single malt that marries bright red berries, dark chocolate, and vanilla caramel with smoldering Islay smoke, offering a sophisticated and decadent experience for fans of both sherried and peated whiskies.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck with plum or cherry sauce, dark chocolate tortes, smoked almonds, rich charcuterie boards featuring prosciutto, and pungent blue cheeses like Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Radiant vermillion and mahogany in appearance, delivering a smooth, layered, and gently warming mouthfeel.

Nose : An intricate, inviting aroma combining mouth-watering vanilla caramel, fresh red berries, and sweet marzipan, all layered seamlessly over hints of dried fruit, sweet cinnamon, and gentle, smoldering coastal peat smoke.

Palate : Sensationally balanced and softly sweet. A rich wave of peaches in syrup, dark chocolate, and toasted almonds gives way to cinnamon and subtle clove spice, while the signature Bowmore wood smoke slowly crescendos in the background.

Finish : Pleasingly long, wooded, and elegantly spiced, leaving a lingering warmth of sweet baking spice, zesty citrus peel, and a comforting wisp of maritime smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or with a single drop of room-temperature water to help awaken its full symphony of rich fruit and slightly soften the peaty edges.

black-fly-tequila-margarita-tall-can.title: Black Fly Tequila Margarita Tall Can

black-fly-tequila-sunrise-tall-can.title: Black Fly Tequila Sunrise Tall Can

black-fly-rum-banana-strawberry-daiquiri.title: On The Rocks Cruzan Strawberry Daiquiri
black-fly-rum-banana-strawberry-daiquiri.bodyHtml:
On The Rocks Cruzan Strawberry Daiquiri is a ready-to-serve bottled cocktail from On The Rocks Premium Cocktails, the Dallas, Texas company whose founders set out to bring bar-quality cocktails wherever you go. This elevated spin on the classic rum daiquiri blends refreshing strawberry and lime with a custom blend of Cruzan rums for a balanced, vibrant cocktail. It is bottled at 20% ABV in a 750ml bottle and needs no mixing: simply chill, pour and garnish. It took Bronze at the 2024 L.A. Spirits Awards and the IWSC 2024.

Serve: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled coupe, or serve over ice; garnish with a fresh strawberry.

arrow-branch-vine-hill-ranch-cabernet.title: Austin Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon
arrow-branch-vine-hill-ranch-cabernet.bodyHtml:
The AUSTIN Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon by Hope Family Wines is an exceptionally plush, rich, and approachable California red wine crafted by veteran winemaker Austin Hope. Conceived as an everyday luxury that celebrates the warmth and diversity of Paso Robles, it is produced using a purposeful multi-vintage approach to deliver peak flavor consistency and velvet smoothness upon release. It pours a deep ruby-purple color in the glass, unfurling an enticingly sweet bouquet of fresh black cherries, dark plum, and burnt sugar, woven with subtle layers of rich cocoa powder, fresh vanilla bean, and a wisp of smoky oak. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is lavish and fruit-forward, coating the mouth with succulent flavors of ripe blackberry, blueberry compote, and roasted coffee. Balanced by an undercurrent of lively acidity and framed by remarkably fine, dusty tannins, it transitions seamlessly into a long, warming finish accented by savory black pepper, tobacco leaf, and sweet baking spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with casual or upscale grilled fare, including New York strip steaks, charcoal-grilled gourmet bacon cheeseburgers, barbecued pork ribs, roasted lamb shank, hearty beef stews, or dark chocolate lava cakes.

veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-1983.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut 1983 750ml
veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-1983.bodyHtml: The modern day Maison of Veuve Clicquot possesses one of the finest champagne vineyards, both in terms of its size and the quality of its vines. Its 390 hectares are divided between 12 of the 17 Grands Crus, and between 20 of the 44 Premiers Crus that constitute the entire Champagne region. This exceptional heritage was built up over the centuries, founded upon the parcels first established by the founder, and added to by subsequent vineyard directors. In particular, Veuve Clicquot bears the fortuitous territorial mark of Madame Clicquot.

martins-lane-simes-pinot-noir-2017.title: Martin's Lane Dehart Vineyard Pinot Noir 2018 750ml
martins-lane-simes-pinot-noir-2017.bodyHtml: High elevation and a warm, west-facing aspect conspire to produce a polished wine of earthiness and sensuality.

krug-collection-1989.title: Krug Brut Collection 1989
krug-collection-1989.bodyHtml:
To the delight of collectors around the world, a very limited number of bottles of Krug Vintage are kept in ideal conditions in the House’s cellars. They are tasted and appraised as they wait to blossom into a second life. Krug Vintage then becomes Krug Collection and reveals a new personality. Krug Collection Champagnes are true examples of time sublimation; maturity exposes hidden facets and depth. New flavours surprise, while old ones have gained structure. Krug Collection is always a wonderful discovery, a deeper story of the Krug Vintage. Krug Collection 1988 is time’s second revelation of Krug 1988.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a lovely interplay between the creamy bead and rich notes of almond financier, apricot preserves, treacle and cardamom, with finely cut, persistent acidity and flavors of pastis, raspberry puree, fennel seed and fleur de sel. Offers a refined, lasting finish, with a push of saline-tinged minerality.

krug-grande-cuvee-echoes.title: Krug Grande Cuvee Echoes 170eme
krug-grande-cuvee-echoes.bodyHtml:
New limited thematic box with Krug Grande Cuvee 170th Edition that enables storytelling around Krug x Music. Exclusive immersive experience only accessible via QR code inside the offer. Through a multisensory musical journey, we invite you to discover the act of creation and revelation of the most generous expression of Champagne, Krug Grande Cuvee.

It can be served with oysters, grilled shrimps, Indian or Moroccan food, as well as desserts such as carrot cake, tarte-tatin, and cheesecake.

harmand-geoffroy-gevrey-chambertin.title: Harmand-Geoffroy Gevrey-Chambertin 750ml
harmand-geoffroy-gevrey-chambertin.bodyHtml: Harmand-Geoffroy Gevrey-Chambertin is a classic Burgundy red wine known for its rich Pinot Noir character. It's a wine that balances power and finesse, with earthy red berry notes and soft tannins.

the-lash-spiced-rum.title: The Lash Spiced Rum
the-lash-spiced-rum.bodyHtml:
The Lash Spiced Rum is a West Indies rum aged four years in used bourbon casks, then blended with spices, bourbon vanilla extract and natural flavours. Dark walnut in the bottle with ruby hues, it carries cinnamon, vanilla, clove, orange zest and cola on the nose. The palate is rich and built on vanilla, with cinnamon building over a honeyed undertone before clove and almond linger in a spicy finish. Bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Cinnamon, vanilla, clove, orange zest and cola.

Palate: Rich vanilla with growing cinnamon and a honey undertone.

Finish: Spicy, with clove and almond.

Serve: With cola or ginger beer over ice.

glenallachie-12-year-old.title: The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old
glenallachie-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a rich, robust, and masterfully crafted flagship expression that showcases the independent distillery's commitment to bold flavor and exceptional wood management. Reconstructed under the guidance of legendary master blender Billy Walker, this single malt is matured for at least twelve years in a premium combination of Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheons, Oloroso sherry hogsheads, and virgin oak casks. It pours a 100% natural, deep mahogany-bronze hue in the glass, immediately releasing an intense, expressive bouquet of heather honey, dark chocolate, and cinnamon, elegantly layered with complex undertones of sticky raisins, mocha, and candied orange peel. On the palate, the whisky is full-bodied, smooth, and incredibly rich, delivering a luscious wave of sweet honey, dark plums, and marzipan alongside warm notes of grated ginger, espresso bean, and toasted oak spice. Balanced by a refined, satisfying spirit presence, it glides into a long, warming finish that leaves a dry, lingering impression of dark chocolate, sweet baking spices, and caramelized brown sugar.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with rich dishes and artisanal treats, including slow-braised beef short ribs with a dark ale reduction, pan-seared duck breast with cherry sauce, smoked venison, sticky toffee pudding, dark chocolate hazelnut truffles, or mature blue cheeses like Stilton.

masahiro-pure-malt-whisky.title: Masahiro Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
masahiro-pure-malt-whisky.bodyHtml:
This Japanese pure malt whisky is a blend of carefully selected 100% malt whiskies. It has been aged for more than three years in old Sherry butt and bourbon casks, then finished in Jack Daniel’s first fill bourbon casks for an additional 6 months. It features notes of vanilla, coconut and all-spice in a rich and balanced flavour with hints of tropical fruits. This whisky reflects the dedication of Japanese craftsmanship and Masahiro Distillery’s 140 years history dating back to 1883.
✔︎ Silver 90pts (International Wine & Spirit Competition 2023)
✔︎ Master (DB & SB Spring Tasting 2022)
✔︎ Bronze (World Whisky Awards 2022)
✔︎ Gold Medal (San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2021)

moet-chandon-brut-imperial-2.title: Moet & Chandon Imperial Brut
moet-chandon-brut-imperial-2.bodyHtml:
An elegant golden straw yellow with amber highlights. Its aromas are radiant, revealing bright yellow-fleshed fruits (apple, pear, yellow peach), honey, floral nuances (lime blossom) and elegant blond notes (brioche and fresh nuts). The palate is seductive, richly flavorful and smooth combining generosity and subtlety, fullness and vigor, followed by a delicately fresh crispiness (fruit with seeds), to reveal the magical balance of Champagne.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant version, fine and creamy in texture and backed by lively, orange peel acidity. A streak of smoke-tinged minerality underscores flavors of almond madeleine, poached pear, anise and preserved lemon. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Champagne gets better and better. It has a fine dryness with a crisp apple and citrus character. That goes with the touches of maturity that give the wine fine balance.

90 Points - James Suckling

Nicely complex aromas here, from dried apples, peaches and pears to candied citrus and brioche. It’s fruity, soft and rounded on the palate. Medium-bodied, lightly honeyed and balanced. Blend of pinot noir, pinot meunier and chardonnay.

terrazas-reserva-torrontes.title: Terrazas De Los Andes Torrontes Reserva 2021 750ml
terrazas-reserva-torrontes.bodyHtml: Pale yellow with greenish highlights. Intense tropical fruit notes as passion fruit and litchi combine with balanced aromas of white peach, ripe apricot and white roses with a nice amount of crisp acidity.

carillon-dangelus-2016.title: Carillon de l'Angelus 2016 750ml
carillon-dangelus-2016.bodyHtml:
Chateau Angelus has one of the longer histories in the St. Emilion appellation. The de Bouard family has a long history in the region. In fact, the de Bouard family has been in Bordeaux for more than 700 years. They arrived in St. Emilion in 1782.
Carillon d’Angélus was first released in the 1987 vintage. Over the years it has acquired its very own identity. Reflecting the high, rigorous standards of our teams, the wine is a variable blend of Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon selected from different Saint-Emilion terroirs. The vinification and ageing techniques are adapted with precision to its particular style. It is highly appreciated for the purity of its fruit aromas, its velvety tannins and elegant finish.

elderton-ode-to-lorraine.title: Elderton Ashmead Ode to Lorraine Barossa Valley 2022
elderton-ode-to-lorraine.bodyHtml:
Elderton Ashmead Ode to Lorraine 2022 is a premium Australian red wine from the renowned Barossa Valley in South Australia. Produced by the family-owned Elderton Wines, this distinguished blend pays tribute to Lorraine Ashmead and the family's longstanding dedication to producing exceptional Barossa wines. Crafted from a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz and Merlot, the 2022 vintage showcases the richness and elegance of Barossa Valley winemaking. It offers inviting aromas of ripe blackberries, dark cherries and blackcurrants, complemented by notes of chocolate, cedar, vanilla and subtle spice. The palate is rich and beautifully structured, with concentrated dark fruit, polished tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long, satisfying finish. Its combination of power, complexity and refinement makes it an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining and cellaring.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison, beef Wellington, barbecue brisket, mushroom risotto, slow-cooked pork, aged cheddar, Manchego and Gouda.

cantina-di-montalcino-brunello-docg.title: Pinino Brunello Di Montalcino Vigna Docg

galassi-sangiovese-appassimento-doc.title: Galassi Sangiovese Appassimento 2023
galassi-sangiovese-appassimento-doc.bodyHtml:
Galassi Sangiovese Appassimento 2023 is a remarkably rich, velvety, and deeply concentrated Italian red wine crafted in the Emilia-Romagna region. Produced using the traditional appassimento method, where a portion of the Sangiovese grapes are carefully dried before fermentation to concentrate their sugars, extract, and flavors, this wine shows an extraordinary aromatic depth and depth of body. In the glass, it displays an intense, deep crimson-red color with vibrant purplish edges. The highly expressive nose opens with a seductive bouquet of ripe red cherries, dark plums, and dried fruits, beautifully interwoven with complex notes of roasted peppers, sweet cocoa, chocolate, and freshly brewed coffee. On the palate, this wine is beautifully structured with a dense, mouth-filling, and velvety body. It seamlessly balances its concentrated black and red fruit core with remarkably soft, fine-grained tannins and a subtle, lingering sweetness on the clean, warm finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-cooked beef stews, roasted rosemary lamb, hearty pasta with rich meat ragù, or a selection of sharp, well-aged Italian cheeses.

baileys-vanilla-mint-shake.title: Baileys Vanilla Mint Shake Cream Liqueur
baileys-vanilla-mint-shake.bodyHtml: Baileys Vanilla Mint Shake a delicious Irish twist to a classic dessert-yum! The flavors of Vanilla, mint and a hint of chocolate blended with our Irish Cream for a sweet treat, perfect for celebrating with friends. Enjoy over ice cream, in a shot or drizzled in a milkshake.

kentucky-owl-batch-12-whiskey-57-9.title: Kentucky Owl Batch No. 12 Kentucky Straight Bourbon
kentucky-owl-batch-12-whiskey-57-9.bodyHtml:
An ultra-premium, highly sought-after release crafted by Master Blender John Rhea. Kentucky Owl Batch 12 is an intricate and masterful blend of 7 to 14-year-old Kentucky straight bourbons married with two distinct 4-year-old bourbons to create a perfectly balanced, multi-layered profile. Bottled at a robust 115.8 proof (57.9% ABV), it delivers a thick, heavy, and complex tasting experience that collectors and serious bourbon aficionados actively hunt down.

 

NOSE

A beautiful bouquet of sweet spice and caramel, accompanied by hints of butterscotch, rich vanilla, and dark chocolate.

PALATE

A rich, warm rush of baking spice hits first, followed by a heavy, mouth-coating sensation of robust caramel, toasted oak, cream, and a touch of dark fruit.

FINISH

Incredibly long, pleasant, and lingering, leaving luxurious notes of caramel, cream, and lingering spice.

kentucky-owl-takumi-edition-50-750ml.title: Kentucky Owl Takumi Edition
kentucky-owl-takumi-edition-50-750ml.bodyHtml:
Kentucky Owl® Takumi Edition is an artfully blended bourbon that provides whiskey lovers an insight into the flavor profiles sought after by a Japanese Whisky Master Blender. It is a special release that brings the best of Japanese whisky making skills to Kentucky Owl’s bourbon range.

Kentucky Owl® Takumi Edition has been awarded 97 points by Tasting Panel magazine.

50% ABV- 100 Proof

aberfeldy-18yr-old-bolgheri.title: Aberfeldy 18 Year Old Bolgheri Tuscan Wine Cask Finish
aberfeldy-18yr-old-bolgheri.bodyHtml:
The 2022 release is full of heady notes of cherry frangipane. The Bolgheri Tuscan red wine casks impart robust, dark fruit flavors and an intense oak finish to Aberfeldy’s malt.

This Robust wine has intensified the honeyed richness of Aberfeldy.

With heady of notes of cherry frangipane and vanilla spice. It’s then freshened with sliced green pepper and limes, and finishes with soft oak.

Bolgheri wines are robust, full of dark fruit flavors (blackberry, dark cherry) with an intense oak finish.

summerhill-merlot.title: Summerhill Cabernet Franc Organic 750ml
summerhill-merlot.bodyHtml:
Velvety, fresh and characterful. This classic Cabernet Franc gives ripe,
zesty notes of black plum, capsicum, red raspberry with a hint of crushed
gravel minerality. Amidst the intensely concentrated fruit flavours,
savoury notes of graphite and sage intrigue the palate. Pillowy and soft
on the palate, while bright acidity and ripe tannins lead to a rounded
finish with notes of tart red fruit lingering.

Try with roasted chicken, smoky sausages or aged cheeses.

dalmore-18-year-old.title: The Dalmore 18 Year Old
dalmore-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore 18 Year Old is a magnificent, ultra-premium Highland single malt that showcases the distillery’s mastery of extended maturation and sherry cask finishing. The whisky begins its journey in American white oak ex-bourbon barrels for 14 years before being transferred into rare 30-year-old Matusalem Oloroso sherry butts from the renowned Gonzalez Byass bodega for a further four years of aging. The married spirit is then allowed to harmonize in upright sherry casks before bottling. The resulting malt is exceptionally rich, dark, and complex, delivering an indulgent tapestry of dark chocolate, candied citrus, dense dried fruits, and sophisticated espresso notes that embody the signature Dalmore house style.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate torte, venison with a blackberry reduction, pecan pie, roasted chestnuts, and mature blue cheeses like Stilton or Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Rich mahogany with deep golden highlights in appearance, featuring a heavy, velvety, and luxuriously coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich and aromatic, opening with vibrant notes of vanilla, dark chocolate, and orange marmalade, followed by sweet cinnamon, nutmeg, and dark roasted coffee beans.

Palate : Full-bodied and indulgent, delivering dark chocolate, candied citrus peel, and juicy raisins, seamlessly integrated with notes of sweet spice, rich espresso, and toasted oak.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warm, and refined, leaving lingering notes of dark cocoa, orange zest, sweet spices, and seasoned wood.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter to fully appreciate its age and rich aromatics, or gently opened with a few drops of room-temperature water.

enclos-de-viaud.title: Enclos De Viaud Lalande-De-Pomerol 2018 750ml
enclos-de-viaud.bodyHtml: The 2018 Enclos De Viaud Lalande-De-Pomerol is a wine known for its elegant and balanced character. It's a red blend of 85% Merlot and 15% Cabernet Sauvignon, showcasing notes of blueberry, blackberry, lavender, and spice on the palate. The wine is medium-bodied, with a crisp finish and undercutting acidity.

glenallachie-10-yo-cask-strength-batch-8.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 8 57.2% ABV
glenallachie-10-yo-cask-strength-batch-8.bodyHtml:
The GlenAllachie Cask Strength Batch 8 is a marriage of whisky from Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso Sherry puncheons, along with a small quantity of Virgin Oak and Rioja casks. The resulting liquid is rich with sweet spices, tangy orange and indulgent mocha.

Batch 8 is bottled at natural cask strength of 57.2%, without chill-filtration or added colour.

catena-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Catena High Mountain Vines Cabernet Sauvignon 2023/2024
catena-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Catena High Mountain Vines Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is an expressive, dark ruby-red Argentinian red wine sourced from high-altitude estate vineyards in Mendoza. The nose offers alluring aromas of red berries, cassis, and white pepper laced with delicate hints of tamarind, fresh herbs, and soft baking spices. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-structured, featuring bright red-fruited intensity, fine-grained firm tannins, balanced acidity, and a clean, savory-earthy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, empanadas, hearty beef stews, sausage pasta, and aged hard cheeses like gouda.

92 Points - James Suckling

White pepper and spices on top of red berries and tamarind. Juicy and medium-bodied on the palate with firm tannins and a linear, medium-long finish.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Containing 8% Cabernet Franc and 2% Petit Verdot, the 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon is beautifully varietal throughout, exuding a red-fruited, herbal and savory profile that is impressively vibrant. It sits high in the mouth with a high-toned, clean energy, concluding with a pleasantly earth-tinged and fine-grained finish.

luca-malbec.title: Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023
luca-malbec.bodyHtml:
Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023 is a powerful yet incredibly elegant Argentine red crafted by Dr. Laura Catena, highlighting the genetic diversity and depth of Mendoza's historic, low-yielding vines. Sourced from high-altitude, ungrafted vines (averaging over 50 years old) across premier subregions of the Uco Valley—including La Consulta, Gualtallary, and Paraje Altamira—it pours a deep, luminous purplish-red. The nose is inviting and complex, offering expressive aromas of dark plums, ripe black cherries, and wild berries, thoughtfully accented by notes of cocoa, bark, charcoal, and subtle dried herbs. On the palate, it is precise, linear, and gracefully structured, showcasing a juicy core of crunchy red and blue fruit balanced by velvety, approachable tannins and a vibrant vein of natural acidity. Matured for 12 months in a combination of new and second-use French oak barrels, it delivers a deeply refined and stylish finish laced with savory hints of espresso and bright mineral tension.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with grilled venison, traditional Argentine ribeye steak with chimichurri, roasted lamb shanks, hearty pork roast, or medium-strong cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

This shows plums, bark and charcoal on the nose. The palate is precise, sharp, linear and super elegant, with velvety tannins and crunchy fruit. It’s long, refined and very stylish. Drink now.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Old Vine Malbec combines ungrafted vines from six Uco Valley growers who previously sold grapes for use in bulk wines. It was destemmed and fermented in stainless tank before maturing for 12 months in 35% new barrique. Opening with a pleasant nose of red and blue fruits, anise and dried spices, the palate is plush and straightforward, concluding with a lifted, fragrant finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose reveals enticing aromas of crushed berries leading the way to a juicy palate filled with rich dark fruit flavors and a hint of rosemary. Framed by gripping tannins and vibrant acidity, this full-bodied Malbec features a distinctive chalky texture and a long lasting finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Hints of roasted herbs and loam lead but quickly give way to the core flavors of Santa Rosa plum and cherry, culminating with crunchy acidity, mineral and cocoa powder notes that fill out the structured finish.

checkmate-attack-chardonnay-2018.title: CheckMate 'Attack' Chardonnay 2018
checkmate-attack-chardonnay-2018.bodyHtml:
CheckMate 'Attack' Chardonnay 2018 is a remarkably bright, sophisticated, and complex single-varietal Chardonnay produced by CheckMate Artisanal Winery in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Fermented and aged in large 1,600-liter oak foudres, it offers an alluring, seaside-like minerality coupled with fragrant aromas of fresh citrus, guava, lightly grilled peach, and toasted hazelnut. On the palate, it exhibits a taut, tightly structured texture showing pure notes of passionfruit, lemon tart, mandarin, and subtle exotic spices that lead to a exceptionally long, refined, and saline-inflected finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster, king crab legs, roasted halibut, and creamy wild mushroom risotto.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This does, in fact, attack the palate with a burst of raw wood that sharpens up the mouthfeel. More time in bottle and plenty of aeration will help to smooth that out. Vinified in a brand new foudre, the Dijon 76 clone fruit is polished and mixes apple, pear and peach with a touch of fruit skin. 

92 Points - James Suckling

Fresh-baked pastry with spices, nougat and some lemons. Creamy and full-bodied with buttery and slightly chewy character. Drink now.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate 

The 2018 Attack Chardonnay was aged for 16 months in new French foudres (rather than barriques) and comes in at 14.1% alcohol. There's a big hit of sweet wood up front, a lot of vanilla and a touch of coconut. Overall, however, this is a well-balanced and very elegant Chardonnay that is never overwhelmed by the wood impact. It maintains good depth and feels solid in the mid-palate as well. Undeveloped and in need of some development, this will show better in a couple of years, acquiring a bit of complexity along the way. Right now, it is one-dimensional and a little flamboyant, at least relative to the balanced Chardonnays in this group. It should hold for at least a decade from now, maybe more. There were 153 cases produced.

checkmate-knights-challenge-chard-2018.title: Checkmate Knight's Challenge Chardonnay 2018 750ml
checkmate-knights-challenge-chard-2018.bodyHtml: This is an enticing Chardonnay with aromas of sagebrush, cold tea and lychee underscored by subtle fruit and lifted oak notes. The palate is vibrant and textural, displaying mineral and sea salt characters, backed by herbs, cloves and fruit in the background.

kentucky-owl-mardi-gras-xo-cask.title: Kentucky Owl Mardi Gras XO Cask Limited Edition 11 Year Old Kentucky Straight Rye
kentucky-owl-mardi-gras-xo-cask.bodyHtml:
The Kentucky Owl Mardi Gras XO Cask Limited Edition is an extremely small release created thanks to Stoli Group's diverse portfolio. Beginning with a Kentucky Owl 11-year-old Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey, the product was then finished for over one year in Bayou Rum XO Casks. Created in celebration of the spirit of Mardi Gras and the pride of Louisiana, the rare Bayou XO Casks create a unique whiskey. The Mardi Gras edition is bottled at 102.8 proof (51.4% ABV).

On the nose, Kentucky Owl® Mardi Gras XO Cask Limited Edition greets drinkers with robust toasted rye bread notes, smothered in farm fresh sweet butter, with hints of cinnamon, allspice and nutmeg. The mouthfeel begins with a robust, flavorful Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey, followed by a flurry of sweet butter whipped with allspice. The finish is smooth, with the sweet softness of butter and allspice giving way to a long and warming nutmeg coda.

glen-scotia-25-year-old-1.title: Glen Scotia 25 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
glen-scotia-25-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Winner of Best In Show at the prestigious 2021 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, this 25-year-old single malt from Glen Scotia was matured in American oak barrels and married in first-fill bourbon basks before bottling. Aromas of sweet vanilla, salty sea breezes and clove-studded oranges fill the nose, complemented by notes of red apples, tangy orange, caramel, ground ginger and sea salt throughout the palate.

TASTING NOTES

NOSE:Bracing Atlantic breeze gives strong maritime influence.

TASTE:Coastal air, red apple and tangy orange peel with vanilla syrup and caramel sweetness.

FINISH:Long lingering sea salt with a spicy note of ground ginger.

bombay-presse.title: Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin 1.75L
bombay-presse.bodyHtml:
Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin is an iconic, world-renowned gin crafted using a proprietary vapor-infusion process. First created in 1987 based on an 1761 recipe, ten sustainably sourced botanicals are held separately from the spirit in perforated copper baskets and infused with hot spirit vapor, yielding a delicate, bright, and perfectly balanced botanical profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, seafood tapas, goat cheese crostini, lemon tarts, or sushi.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and luminous in appearance with a smooth, light, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh juniper, bright citrus, floral notes, subtle pine, and warm earthy spices.

Palate : Clean, balanced, and round with vibrant juniper berries, zesty lemon, peppery coriander, subtle liquorice, and almond sweetness.

Finish : Medium, crisp, and refreshing with lingering hints of citrus zest and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve as the foundational spirit in a classic Gin & Tonic with fresh lime, in a Dry Martini, or over ice with tonic water.

cazadores-margarita.title: Cazadores Pineapple Tequila
cazadores-margarita.bodyHtml:
Cazadores Pineapple Tequila is a refreshing, fruit-infused spirit crafted using a 100% Blue Weber Agave Blanco tequila base from the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Infused with natural ripe pineapple flavor, it offers an approachable balance between bright, juicy tropical sweetness and classic crisp cooked agave.

Food Pairing: Tacos al pastor, grilled shrimp, spicy ceviche, fruit tarts, or tropical fruit salads.

Tasting Notes : Light gold with pale straw highlights, featuring a smooth, medium-bodied, and silky mouthfeel.

Nose : Tropical and fresh with aromas of juicy ripe pineapple, sweet cooked agave, and bright citrus zest.

Palate : Smooth and approachable with notes of sweet tropical fruit, natural pineapple juice, roasted agave, light herbal undertones, and a touch of black pepper.

Finish : Clean, dry, and refreshing with lingering tropical pineapple sweetness and a delicate touch of agave warmth.

Serve : Serve chilled, over ice, or as the base in a Pineapple Margarita or tropical highball.

cazadores-paloma.title: Cazadores Reposado Tequila
cazadores-paloma.bodyHtml:
Cazadores Reposado Tequila is an authentic, 100% blue agave tequila crafted in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Double-fermented and double-distilled using traditional methods, it is aged in virgin American oak barrels for up to one year, achieving a delicate balance between crisp, cooked agave and smooth, wood-influenced notes of vanilla and caramel.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken, pork carnitas, fish tacos, quesadillas, or mild Mexican cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Pale gold in appearance with a clean, medium-bodied, and smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright cooked agave, fresh citrus, vanilla, toasted oak, and light floral accents.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with notes of sweet agave, vanilla, light caramel, toasted wood, and soft baking spice.

Finish : Clean, short-to-medium with lingering notes of gentle oak and warm agave spice.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as the base for a classic Margarita or Paloma.

lindores-oloroso.title: Glencadam Reserva Andalucía Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish
lindores-oloroso.bodyHtml:
Glencadam Reserva Andalucía Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky crafted at Glencadam Distillery. Carefully selected whisky from sherry butts and bourbon casks is married together before being finished in Oloroso sherry butts sourced from Andalucía, Spain. Bottled at 46% ABV with natural colour and without chill filtration, Reserva Andalucía balances Glencadam's signature fruit-forward character with rich sultana, orchard fruit, creamy toffee and sweet spice from the Oloroso finish. 

Food Pairing: Pair with Manchego cheese, roasted almonds, prosciutto, apple tart, crème brûlée, fruitcake or caramelized desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and smooth with ripe fruit, creamy sweetness and Oloroso sherry character, bringing together sultanas, orchard fruits, vanilla, fudge and gentle sweet spice.

Nose: Ripe soft fruits with soft nougat, oaky vanilla and freshly made fudge.

Palate: Smooth and creamy with sultanas, orchard fruits and toffee apple sweetness.

Finish: Long and silky with honey, muscovado sugar and lingering green tea.

lindores-red-wine-barrique.title: Lindores Abbey Friar John Cor Chapter II Cask Strength Single Malt Scotch Whisky 60.9% ABV
lindores-red-wine-barrique.bodyHtml:
Lindores Abbey Friar John Cor Chapter Two is a remarkable limited-edition Lowland single malt Scotch whisky from the historic Lindores Abbey Distillery in Fife, Scotland. Released in 2023 as the second chapter of the celebrated Cask Strength Congregation series, this distinctive expression honours Friar John Cor, the Lindores monk associated with the earliest surviving written reference to Scotch whisky production in 1494. Crafted from a carefully selected combination of bourbon casks, shaved, toasted and re-charred (STR) wine barriques, and rum and peat-influenced casks, this exceptional bottling captures the distillery's adventurous approach to maturation while celebrating centuries of Scottish whisky heritage.

Bottled on-site at a powerful natural cask strength of 60.9% ABV, without chill filtration or added colouring, Chapter Two delivers an extraordinarily expressive interplay of ripe tropical fruit, rich caramelized sweetness, warming spice and delicate earthy smoke. The influence of peated casks introduces a distinctive smoky dimension to Lindores Abbey's naturally elegant Lowland spirit, creating a beautifully textured and complex whisky with remarkable depth. Presented in its striking dark bottle, this collectible release offers an exceptional experience for enthusiasts seeking distinctive cask-strength Scotch whisky.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted pork, glazed duck, smoked chicken, grilled lamb and mature cheddar. Vegetarian accompaniments include roasted butternut squash, caramelized onion tartlets, grilled halloumi, toasted almonds and wild mushroom risotto. Banana bread, sticky toffee pudding, date cake and dark chocolate provide particularly appealing dessert pairings that complement its rich fruit and caramelized sweetness.

Tasting Notes: A richly expressive Lowland single malt combining luscious tropical and orchard fruits, caramelized brown sugar, toasted nuts and warming spice. Layers of maple syrup, roasted banana, ripe pears, sweet dates and subtle earthy peat smoke create a beautifully balanced profile with a smooth, velvety texture.

Nose: Inviting aromas of mellow maple syrup, roasted banana, ripe dates and fresh apples mingle with sweet cinnamon and caramelized demerara sugar. Gentle earthy peat smoke and delicate oak spice add an intriguing layer of complexity.

Palate: Rich and velvety, revealing layers of juicy pears, roasted banana, toasted almonds and golden caramel. Warming cinnamon, sweet malt and brown sugar unfold alongside subtle maritime notes and delicate waves of earthy smoke, creating an exceptional balance of fruit, sweetness and spice.

Finish: Long, warming and characterful, with lingering caramelized fruit, toasted nuts, cinnamon spice and gentle earthy peat smoke. Soft oak, sweet malt and a delicate maritime impression provide a memorable Lowland conclusion.

lindores-casks-of-lindores-oloroso.title: Glencadam Reserva Andalucía Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish
lindores-casks-of-lindores-oloroso.bodyHtml:
Glencadam Reserva Andalucía Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky crafted at Glencadam Distillery. Carefully selected whisky from sherry butts and bourbon casks is married together before being finished in Oloroso sherry butts sourced from Andalucía, Spain. Bottled at 46% ABV with natural colour and without chill filtration, Reserva Andalucía balances Glencadam's signature fruit-forward character with rich sultana, orchard fruit, creamy toffee and sweet spice from the Oloroso finish. 

Food Pairing: Pair with Manchego cheese, roasted almonds, prosciutto, apple tart, crème brûlée, fruitcake or caramelized desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and smooth with ripe fruit, creamy sweetness and Oloroso sherry character, bringing together sultanas, orchard fruits, vanilla, fudge and gentle sweet spice.

Nose: Ripe soft fruits with soft nougat, oaky vanilla and freshly made fudge.

Palate: Smooth and creamy with sultanas, orchard fruits and toffee apple sweetness.

Finish: Long and silky with honey, muscovado sugar and lingering green tea.

inniskillin-chardonnay.title: Inniskillin Chardonnay 750ml
inniskillin-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Aromas of vanilla, toast, ripe apple and pear integrate well in this Chardonnay. The aromas replay in the flavours, with citrus notes and a touch of clove that carry through to a clean and extended finish.

inniskillin-pinot-noir.title: Inniskillin Pinot Noir
inniskillin-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Inniskillin Pinot Noir is an Ontario red wine from Inniskillin, established in 1975, bottled in its Estate Series under VQA Ontario. Made from Pinot Noir, it shows a ruby red colour and lifted aromas of smoky oak, black plum, nuts and earth with a touch of spice. On the palate it is extra dry and medium-bodied, with good varietal character. It is a versatile, food-friendly red: try it with roast turkey, grilled salmon, mushroom dishes or a charcuterie board, served slightly cool. It comes in a 750ml bottle at 12% alcohol.

bouchard-pere-fils-corton-charlemagne.title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 2022 750ml
bouchard-pere-fils-corton-charlemagne.bodyHtml:
Intense bouquet with aromas of fruit and toast married to mineral notes typical of this appellation. Rich and powerful wine with an assertive personality.

Pairs well with fish and shellfish in sauce and foie gras

bouchard-pere-fils-vosne-romanee-de-ch.title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Beaune Du Chateau Premier Cru Blanc 2019
bouchard-pere-fils-vosne-romanee-de-ch.bodyHtml:
Bouchard Père & Fils 'Beaune du Château' Premier Cru Blanc 2019 is a magnificent and historic white Burgundy that beautifully captures the diverse facets of the Beaune terroir. This flagship cuvée is a masterfully crafted blend of Chardonnay harvested from four distinct Beaune Premier Cru parcels chosen for their complementary traits: Les Aigrots, Les Tuvilains, Les Sizies, and Sur les Grèves. In the glass, it radiates a luminous pale gold hue with subtle green reflections. The energetic and highly expressive nose opens with aromas of white-fleshed peach, crisp pear, honeysuckle, and candied citrus peel, seamlessly nuanced by elegant undertones of brioche, fresh gingerbread, and smoky oak. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, combining an enveloping, rich texture with a vibrant core of citrus oil and lemon zest. Finely structured by subtle oak integration and refreshing natural acidity, it carries through to a long, beautifully focused finish characterized by a distinctive, salty mineral precision.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken in a creamy chanterelle sauce, traditional French escargot, or a delicate lobster risotto.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, clean white, offering apple, lemon and floral notes. Light-bodied and harmonious, ending with baking spice accents. Drink now through 2026.

pear-kruskovac-liqueur.title: Darna Kruskovac Pear Liqueur
pear-kruskovac-liqueur.bodyHtml:
Darna Kruskovac is a sweet Croatian pear liqueur from Darna, the liqueur factory of Rovinj in Istria, which has been producing since 1925. Made to traditional recipes, it has an intense orange colour and a sweet pear flavour. It is bottled at 21% ABV in a 700ml bottle and is among Darna's most popular liqueurs.

Palate: Sweet ripe pear.

Serve: Neat or chilled as a dessert drink, in cocktails such as a Kruskovac Spritz, or with fruit salad.

cusumano-syrah.title: Cusumano Syrah 750ml
cusumano-syrah.bodyHtml: Cusumano Syrah is a red wine from Sicily, Italy, known for its deep ruby color, balanced flavors, and well-priced accessibility. It exhibits notes of wild berries, ripe fruit, and spices, with a smooth, warm, and velvety texture on the palate. The wine is fermented and aged in steel tanks, resulting in a fruity and persistent finish.

black-fly-peach-gin-fizz.title: Black Fly Gin Soda Fizz Black Currant
black-fly-peach-gin-fizz.bodyHtml: Black Fly Gin Soda Fizz Black Currant

aberfeldy-16-year-old-1.title: Aberfeldy 16 Year Old
aberfeldy-16-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Aberfeldy 16 Year Old is a premium and luxuriously rich Highland single malt Scotch whisky that exemplifies the distillery's signature honeyed profile, elevated by an indulgent wood finish. Matured for 16 years in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks, this expression undergoes a crucial finishing period in premium Spanish Oloroso sherry casks. This additional step introduces deep layers of dark fruits, baking spices, and fruitcake complexity to the classic "Golden Dram" foundation of lush heather honey and smooth malt, creating a beautifully rounded and mature sipping experience.

Food Pairing: This richly sherried and honeyed whisky pairs magnificently with slow-roasted pork belly, duck breast with a cherry reduction, or prime rib. It is also an exceptional companion to rich desserts like sticky toffee pudding, dark chocolate truffles, and a mature cheese board featuring aged Gouda or Stilton blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber with copper reflections, exhibiting a medium-to-full body with a soft, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Heather honey, rich stewed dark fruits, raisins, vanilla fudge, cloves, and polished oak.

Palate : Creamy and mouth-coating with flavors of honeyed cereal, sweet citrus, dark chocolate, fruitcake, dried figs, and warm baking spices.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with lingering notes of sherry sweetness, cocoa, gentle spice, and toasted oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of spring water to open up the delicate floral honey and rich sherry fruit layers.

meukow-cognac-vs.title: Meukow VS Cognac
meukow-cognac-vs.bodyHtml:
Meukow VS Cognac is the entry expression from the House of Meukow, a Cognac house established in 1862 by the brothers Auguste-Christophe and Gustav Meukow. It is a VS, or Very Special, blended from eaux-de-vie aged for at least two years, the minimum the VS grade requires, and it is bottled at 40% ABV in the 750ml bottle that carries the house's panther emblem, a symbol Meukow uses for strength, elegance and suppleness. In the glass it is clear amber with golden tints. The style is approachable and balanced between fruit and a light touch of oak, which makes it easy to drink neat and useful as a base for mixed drinks.

Nose: Caramel, dried apricot, vanilla, allspice and nutmeg.

Palate: Smooth and medium-bodied, with orange peel, caramel, honey and subtle oak.

Finish: Well rounded, with liquorice and nutmeg.

Serve: Neat as a digestif, over ice, or in cocktails.

bouchard-pere-fils-meursault-les-clous.title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Meursault Cru 750ml
bouchard-pere-fils-meursault-les-clous.bodyHtml:
Bright golden yellow with green tints. Open, woody aromas accompanied by vanilla, toast, russet apples and hazelnuts on the nose. Strong alcohol content with a woody quality and hints of vanilla. Round, smooth, velvety.

Intense bouquet of fruit and flowers combined with a delicate mineral hint. Rich and subtle wine with good crisp, which makes it very balanced. Good ageing potential.

grey-goose-lorange-1.title: Grey Goose L'Orange Vodka
grey-goose-lorange-1.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose L'Orange is an orange-flavoured vodka from the French house of Grey Goose, made with the natural essence of fresh oranges: more than two pounds of fruit for every litre. Essential oils from the oranges are combined with Grey Goose's soft winter wheat spirit and distilled, giving a bold, zesty citrus character with no added sugar. Cellar Master François Thibault insists on the finest oranges, in the same spirit as the quality bread-making wheat behind Grey Goose vodka. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a natural fit for a Cosmopolitan, an orange vodka soda or a citrus-led martini.

Nose: Fresh and fruity.

Palate: Full and fragrant.

Finish: Refreshing and warm.

Serve: Chilled, with soda and an orange slice, or in a Cosmopolitan.

bodegas-esmeralda-catena-chardonnay.title: Catena High Mountain Vines Chardonnay
bodegas-esmeralda-catena-chardonnay.bodyHtml: A benchmark for high-altitude Argentinian white wine, the Catena High Mountain Vines Chardonnay is a blend of four different estate vineyards ranging from 3,100 to 4,750 feet in elevation. This unique combination of altitudes and soil types produces a wine of great complexity and balance. It presents a brilliant yellow colour with greenish reflections and opens with an intense bouquet of citrus fruits, white peach, and apricot, layered with delicate floral notes and a touch of vanilla. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and clean, showcasing a rich, oily texture perfectly counterbalanced by a vibrant, stony acidity and a characteristic saline minerality. The finish is long and refreshing, featuring subtle toasted notes from partial aging in French oak.

dram-mor-clarendon-rum-2010.title: Dram Mor Clarendon Estate 10 Year Old Single Cask Rum 63% ABV
dram-mor-clarendon-rum-2010.bodyHtml:
Dràm Mòr Clarendon Estate 10 Year Old is a single cask Jamaican rum from Clarendon Estate, selected and bottled by the independent bottler Dràm Mòr. It matured for 10 years in American oak, cask #433043, and was bottled at a towering 63% ABV, with 295 bottles of 70 cl released in Dràm Mòr's first single cask rum release in 2021. Dràm Mòr calls it a monster of a dram: smoky and woody on the nose with charred oak, cigar smoke, orange, dark chocolate and marzipan, a palate of firewood, oak, spice and ashy smoke, and a long, dry finish of baking spice, chilli, dark chocolate and coffee.

Tasting Notes: Charred oak, smoke, orange, dark chocolate, baking spice and coffee.

Nose: Quite smoky, with dark woody spice, charcoal, charred oak and cigar smoke layered with orange, dark chocolate and marzipan.

Palate: Huge, with firewood, lots of oak and spice, and ashy smoke.

Finish: Long and dry: a spicy burst of clove, nutmeg, cinnamon and chilli turning to dark chocolate and coffee.

Serve: Neat with water to hand; at 63% ABV a few drops help it open.

macallan-18-year-old-sherry-cask.title: The Macallan 18 Year Old Sherry Oak
macallan-18-year-old-sherry-cask.bodyHtml:
The Macallan Sherry Oak 18 Years Old forms part of our Sherry Oak range which features a series of single malt whiskies matured in exceptional sherry seasoned oak casks from Jerez for richness and complexity. A full bodied palate of mature oak, ginger and raisin flavors is complimented by a light mahogany natural color.

When matured exclusively in Oloroso sherry seasoned oak casks from Jerez, Spain, our rich, fruity and full bodied ‘new make’ spirit is transformed into an iconic single malt. Once filled, the maturing spirit remains undisturbed in the same casks for 18 years and is brought together in this rich and complex single malt characterized by mature oak, ginger and raisin flavors.

tri-carragh-bunnahabhain-2013-9yr-58-3.title: Tri Carragh Bunnahabhain 2013 9 Year Old 58.3% ABV
tri-carragh-bunnahabhain-2013-9yr-58-3.bodyHtml:
DISTILLED 2013
BOTTLED 2022
AGE 9
CASK Refill Bourbon Hogshead
ABV% 58.3

TASTING NOTE "From Tri Carragh – Nose: Initial unreduced nose of boozy vanilla sponge and marzipan, followed by sweet tobacco, fresh sea air – almost like when a freshwater river meets the sea with beach fire embers with a hint of burnt marshmallow from yesterday’s s’mores. The nose with water is moral floral, heather, grassy sand dunes, seaside leaves with a hint of lemon. Taste: First a lovely sweet and salted under ripe pear, lingering lemon and mint cordial, sherbet, white pepper, and lasting apple flavoured vape. With water it still has a hint of smoke with a slight spice bite, much more juicy sweetness now with more apple and melon. Seaside freshness throughout."

tri-carragh-linkwood-2010-12-yr-51-5.title: Tri Carragh Linkwood 2010 12 Year Old 51.5% ABV
tri-carragh-linkwood-2010-12-yr-51-5.bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Appearance: Deep umber, cream sherry. First-fill American oak cask? Excellent beading, good legs – both indicating texture.

Aroma: A mild nose-feel, nose drying with light prickle. A shy nose which takes time to open, the top notes start faintly herbal and mentholic (spearmint?), then develop towards caramel toffee (even chocolate coated toffee). A little water introduces a spicy note and also, for me, a fleeting suggestion of Turkish Delight!

Taste: A smooth texture and a taste which interprets the aroma in every particular: lightly tannic overall, but with a sweetish start, some spice in the medium-length finish and a mouth-cooling after taste.

Comment: An unusual example of Linkwood, which is usually matured in refill American oak to preserve a ‘green-grassy’ spirit character. This cask has filled out and developed the flavour in an interesting way.

rare-find-longmorn-1999-22yr-54-3.title: Rare Find Longmorn 1999 22 Year Old 54.3%
rare-find-longmorn-1999-22yr-54-3.bodyHtml:
DISTILLED 1999
BOTTLED 2022
AGE 22
CASK Refill Bourbon Hogshead
ABV% 54.3
PRODUCT NOTES Cask no. 80036
TASTING NOTE From Gleann Mòr: Coconut, tropical fruits, and hints of golden honey on the nose. Blackcurrant, pears and peaches laced with vanilla custard in the mouth; a long, sweet finish bursting with fruit

castello-di-bolgheri-varvara.title: Castello di Bolgheri Varvara 2022
castello-di-bolgheri-varvara.bodyHtml:
Castello di Bolgheri Varvara 2022 is an incredibly refined and elegant Tuscan red wine that strikes a beautiful balance between immediate fruit expression and structural depth. It pours an attractive, youthful magenta-red color with bright ruby highlights. The highly aromatic and complex nose opens with an entrancing bouquet of fresh wild raspberries, black cherries, and sappy blackcurrant, tightly intertwined with subtle hints of thyme, mint, dusty cedar, and crushed violets. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it exhibits a polished, linear, and direct style that showcases great purity of dark fruit. A lively spine of refreshing coastal acidity and fine, silky tannins give the wine a sophisticated, savory edge, finishing with a lingering touch of Mediterranean brush, iron, and a distinct mineral freshness.

Food Pairing: This polished Tuscan red pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops with rosemary, grilled ribeye steaks, rich wild boar ragù, traditional meat lasagna, or aged pecorino cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

The aromas of raspberries and cherries with thyme and mint are entrancing and they follow through to a medium body with a lovely depth and purity of fruit and long, refined tannins. Very polished. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 28% Merlot and 12% Cabernet Franc, the Castello di Bolgheri 2022 Bolgheri Rosso Varvàra reveals a smart and easy-drinking style with tight aromas of dark fruit and blackcurrant. It remains linear and direct, including the mouthfeel, finishing with medium build and good freshness. It ages in tonneaux and botte for a quick 12 months, and 100,000 bottles were created.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

This red is graceful yet concentrated, with flavors of black currant, blackberry, eucalyptus and iron. The tannins emerge on the long aftertaste, buffered by ripe fruit. Fine balance. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2032.

errazuriz-max-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Errazuriz Max Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
errazuriz-max-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Sourced from estate vineyards in the Aconcagua Valley, the Errazurriz Max Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon shows balance and complexity well beyond its price point. Rich chocolate and floral aromas complement the flavours of ripe blackberry, currant, and sweet herbs. This exceptional red would pair well with prime rib or steak.

plantation-canerock-jamaican-spiced-rum.title: Canerock Jamaican Spiced Rum
plantation-canerock-jamaican-spiced-rum.bodyHtml: The Plantation Canerock Spiced Rum comes from the Clarendon Distillery and the Long Pond Distillery in Jamaica. The basis is Jamaican rum varieties, which were flavored by an infusion of vanilla pods, coconut meat, ginger and other delicate spices. Distilled was in the column and pot still process. The rums used matured for up to 3 years, a small proportion even 5 to 10 years in American oak barrels. 10 to 15% of the Plantation Canerock Spiced Rum received a finish in Sherry PX barrels. This resulted in a spirit drink with aromas of pastries, coconuts and vanilla. In the taste, fine caramel notes and raisins are accompanied by allspice and oak notes.

martins-lane-simes-vineyard-riesling.title: Martin Lane Simes Vineyard Riesling 2025
martins-lane-simes-vineyard-riesling.bodyHtml: Martin's Lane Simes Vineyard Riesling 2025 is a single-vineyard Riesling from the East Kelowna area of British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Martin's Lane is a gravity-fed winery designed by architect Tom Kundig and led by winemaker Shane Munn, devoted solely to Pinot Noir and Riesling. The Simes Vineyard faces north on a steep, cool slope of granite-rich glacial till, silt and clay; the northern aspect shields the grapes from hot afternoon sun and allows a long, slow ripening season that keeps natural acidity high. BC VQA, 750ml, 11% ABV.

renacer-milamore.title: Bodegas Renacer Milamore 2019/2020 750ml
renacer-milamore.bodyHtml: Deep ruby red color. The nose expresses great complexity of flowers, honey, dried plum jam. After a few minutes notes of vanilla and sweet spices from the French oak appear. Creamy mouthfeel, firm and sweet tannins. Long and persistent finish with dried fruits as a final note.

shelter-point-single-malt-whisky.title: Shelter Point Canadian Single Malt Whisky
shelter-point-single-malt-whisky.bodyHtml:
92 points - Whisky Advocate "A splendid finish brings out more balanced fruit character"
Whisky Magazine - "Incredibly fruity, light yet syrupy. Delicious."

The whisky shows a balanced marriage of fruits, caramel, barley, baking spices, honey, seaside whiff, hints of wine, smoke and the sweet leathery mouthfeel of a high-quality single malt.

nutrl-juicd-variety-pack-1.title: Nutrl Juic'D Variety Pack 12pk Cans
nutrl-juicd-variety-pack-1.bodyHtml: NÜTRL JUIC’D is simple, clean and super refreshing, a classic Vodka Soda with a little something more – a splash of REAL fruit juice. REAL JUICE. MORE FLAVOUR. The new 12 pack features all of the fan favourites: Fruit Punch, Blood Orange, Watermelon and Raspberry Lemonade.

dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-1er-cru.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Petite Chapelle Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes 2021
dugat-py-gevrey-chambertin-1er-cru.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Petite Chapelle Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes 2021 is a highly elite, deeply concentrated Premier Cru that performs with the scale and density of a Grand Cru. Sourced from a tiny 0.32-hectare parcel of old vines planted in 1964, this wine highlights the cooler, highly elegant nature of the 2021 Burgundy vintage. In the glass, it reveals a bright, translucent ruby profile. The sophisticated bouquet wafts with intense aromas of sweet red berries, wild plums, licorice, and herbal tea, seamlessly integrated with beautiful floral elements and warm exotic spices. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, layered, and deeply penetrating. The core of succulent fruit is supported by rich, powdery tannins and a lively line of acidity, delivering excellent structural tension and a long, savory, and fragrant finish built for cellaring.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom tart, or slow-cooked venison.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru Petite Chapelle transcends the challenges of the vintage, offering up a deep bouquet of dark berries, plums, burning embers, orange zest, spices and peony, followed by a full-bodied, layered and complete palate with a rich and multidimensional core of fruit that's framed by sweet, powdery tannins.

dugat-py-gevrey-chamb-1er-cru-petit-chap.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Petite Chapelle Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes 2021
dugat-py-gevrey-chamb-1er-cru-petit-chap.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Petite Chapelle Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes 2021 is a highly elite, deeply concentrated Premier Cru that performs with the scale and density of a Grand Cru. Sourced from a tiny 0.32-hectare parcel of old vines planted in 1964, this wine highlights the cooler, highly elegant nature of the 2021 Burgundy vintage. In the glass, it reveals a bright, translucent ruby profile. The sophisticated bouquet wafts with intense aromas of sweet red berries, wild plums, licorice, and herbal tea, seamlessly integrated with beautiful floral elements and warm exotic spices. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, layered, and deeply penetrating. The core of succulent fruit is supported by rich, powdery tannins and a lively line of acidity, delivering excellent structural tension and a long, savory, and fragrant finish built for cellaring.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru Petite Chapelle transcends the challenges of the vintage, offering up a deep bouquet of dark berries, plums, burning embers, orange zest, spices and peony, followed by a full-bodied, layered and complete palate with a rich and multidimensional core of fruit that's framed by sweet, powdery tannins.

dugat-py-charmes-chambertin-grand-cru-vv.title: Domaine Feuillet Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru
dugat-py-charmes-chambertin-grand-cru-vv.bodyHtml:
Domaine Feuillet Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru is a luxurious Pinot Noir with aromas of black cherry, ripe raspberry, rose petals, forest floor, truffle, and sweet spice. Rich concentration, velvety tannins, vibrant acidity, and refined minerality deliver an elegant Grand Cru with remarkable depth and a persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast duck, venison, beef tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, truffle dishes, or aged Époisses and Comté cheeses.

dugat-py-mazis-chambertin-grand-cru-vv.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Mazis-Chambertin Grand Cru Tres Vieilles Vignes
dugat-py-mazis-chambertin-grand-cru-vv.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Mazis-Chambertin Grand Cru Très Vieilles Vignes is a monumental, ultra-rare masterpiece and one of the most powerful expressions of Pinot Noir in the entire Côte de Nuits. Sourced from ancient massal-selection vines planted as far back as 1947, this tiny production Grand Cru is legendary for its wild, brooding character and immense longevity. Under Loïc Dugat-Py’s modern direction, the wine masterfully balances its historical muscularity with refined winemaking, incorporating significant whole-cluster fermentation and a highly integrated oak profile. In the glass, it shows an opaque, deep ruby-purple color. The nose is spectacularly complex and multi-dimensional, bursting with black raspberries, dark wild plums, and cassis, seamlessly interwoven with tertiary notes of game, smoked meat, iron ore, licorice, and exotic spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied, immense, and incredibly multi-layered, showing massive old-vine dry extract and structural authority. A rock-solid frame of mineral-drenched, chiseled tannins is perfectly countered by a brilliant line of energy, driving a finish that lasts for several minutes. This is a legendary vin de garde built to age for decades.

Food Pairing: Slow-roasted venison loin with a juniper-berry reduction, pan-seared squab with truffles, roasted wild boar, or a rich wagyu beef ribeye.

san-marzano-collezione-cinquanta-vino-ro.title: San Marzano Collezione Cinquanta 7th Edition
san-marzano-collezione-cinquanta-vino-ro.bodyHtml:
San Marzano Collezione Cinquanta 7th Edition is a celebrated, non-vintage flagship red wine crafted by Cantine San Marzano to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the winery's founding. Created as a harmonious blend of 50% Primitivo and 50% Negroamaro harvested from old-vine, bush-trained (alberello) plots across Salento, it undergoes 12 months of aging in French oak barriques to build depth and refined structure. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby red color with vibrant purple highlights. The complex nose reveals rich aromas of ripe plum, blackberry jam, and dark cherries balanced by sweet notes of vanilla, cocoa, and licorice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, opulent, and exceptionally smooth, offering a luscious layer of concentrated dark fruit supported by soft, polished tannins and a long, warm, spice-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb shoulder, beef stew, pasta with rich meat ragù, grilled sausages, and aged cheeses like Pecorino.

dewars-27-year-old-double-double-1.title: Dewar's 27 Year Old Double Double 375ml
dewars-27-year-old-double-double-1.bodyHtml:
Dewar's 27 Year Old Double Double is an ultra-premium blended Scotch whisky crafted by Master Blender Stephanie Macleod, utilizing a unique and meticulous four-stage "Double Double" aging process. First, single malts and single grains are aged separately for at least 27 years. Second, the malts are blended together and rested, while the grains are blended and rested. Third, the malt and grain blends are married together and rested again. Finally, the resulting blend is finished in rare Palo Cortado sherry casks. This labor-intensive method yields an incredibly smooth, complex whisky that beautifully balances Dewar's signature honeyed elegance with the rich, delicately nutty, and subtly spicy influence of the Palo Cortado wood.

Food Pairing: Manchego or aged Comté cheese, roasted duck with a dark fruit glaze, salted caramel desserts, dark chocolate with hazelnuts, or a fine, mild cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep, radiant amber in appearance with an exceptionally silky, luxurious, and viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Intoxicating and highly aromatic, leading with heady floral notes, sweet heather honey, toasted almonds, dried apricot, and a hint of exotic baking spices.

Palate : Sumptuous and refined, delivering rich layers of ripe peaches, caramelized orchard fruits, sweet honey, and toasted walnuts, all elevated by the delicate, nutty, and slightly spicy influence of the Palo Cortado sherry cask.

Finish : Incredibly long, velvety, and complex, leaving a lingering sweetness of dried fruits, warm oak spices, and an elegant floral honey.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter to fully appreciate the complex aromatics and the incredibly silky texture achieved through the four-stage aging process. A single drop of water may be added to unlock further floral notes.

dewars-32-year-old-double-double-1.title: Dewar's Double Double 32 Year Old 375ml
dewars-32-year-old-double-double-1.bodyHtml:
Dewar's 32 Year Old Double Double is an exquisite, ultra-premium blended Scotch whisky crafted by Master Blender Stephanie Macleod using the brand's meticulous four-stage "Double Double" aging process. First, single malts and single grain whiskies are aged separately for at least 32 years. Next, the malts are blended together and rested, while the grains are blended and rested. In the third stage, the malt and grain blends are married together and rested once more. Finally, this expertly crafted blend undergoes a finishing period in exceptional Pedro Ximénez (PX) sherry casks. This incredibly demanding process results in a rich, deeply complex, and silky-smooth whisky characterized by intense notes of dark treacle, rich fruitcake, and decadent chocolate.

Food Pairing: Rich fruitcake, dark chocolate truffles, sticky toffee pudding, mature blue cheeses like Stilton or Roquefort, or roasted duck with a dark berry or plum reduction.

Tasting Notes : Deep, dark mahogany in appearance with an exceptionally viscous, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Intensely rich and decadent, bursting with aromas of dark treacle toffee, ripe peaches, dark chocolate, and heavy dried fruits like raisins and figs.

Palate : Luscious, sweet, and full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark molasses, dense fruitcake, roasted nuts, vanilla, and the distinct, syrupy sweetness characteristic of Pedro Ximénez sherry casks.

Finish : Exceptionally long, sweet, and silky, leaving a lingering, warming impression of dark chocolate, dried dark fruits, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter to fully appreciate its depth and the luxurious texture created by the four-stage aging process.

green-spot-quails-gate-irish-whiskey.title: Green Spot Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
green-spot-quails-gate-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Green Spot Irish Whiskey is a highly celebrated, exceptionally smooth Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey that carries a rich heritage dating back to the early 1900s. Originally crafted exclusively for the Mitchell family of Dublin, this iconic whiskey is produced at the historic Midleton Distillery in County Cork. It is composed of a select blend of single pot still whiskies aged between seven and ten years, matured in a combination of first-fill and refill American bourbon oak casks, along with seasoned Spanish Oloroso sherry butts. The result is a beautifully balanced, light, and approachable spirit that serves as the perfect introduction to the traditional, fruity, and spicy character of Irish pot still whiskey.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with light seafood dishes like seared scallops, roast chicken with fresh herbs, mild creamy cheeses like a young Gouda, or a classic warm apple tart.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, pale straw-gold color with a medium-bodied, silky, and delightfully mouth-coating pot still texture.

NOSE - Fresh and aromatic, bursting with notes of green apples, ripe pears, and citrus oils, balanced by warm toasted oak, light barley, and soft baking spices.

PALATE - Light and spicy on the tongue, showing sweet flavors of vanilla, honey, and fresh orchard fruits, quickly followed by cloves, toasted wood, and a touch of hazelnut.

FINISH - Medium to long, clean, and elegant, leaving a lingering warmth of sweet wood spice, toasted oak, and barley.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat or with a few drops of pure room-temperature water in a tulip-shaped glass to fully release its delicate fruit and spice aromas.

san-marzano-anniversario-62-primitivo-ri.title: San Marzano Anniversario 62 Primitivo di Manduria Riserva 2019
san-marzano-anniversario-62-primitivo-ri.bodyHtml:
San Marzano Anniversario 62 Primitivo di Manduria Riserva 2019 is an opulent, deeply concentrated red wine crafted to commemorate the year Cantine San Marzano was founded in 1962. Sourced from very old bush vines (alberello) in San Marzano and Sava, the hand-harvested, slightly overripe grapes undergo 18 months of maturation in fine French and American oak barriques. In the glass, it displays an intense ruby red color with garnet reflections. The complex nose delivers expressive aromatics of prune, sweet cherry jam, tobacco, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied, velvety, and plush, wrapping rich dark fruit flavors in fine-grained tannins with hints of cocoa, coffee, and vanilla on a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, braised beef, game meats, rich pasta with meat ragù, and sharp aged cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

A spiced nose of dark berries, smoked herbs and hints of mushrooms and moist earth. Full-bodied, dense and plush, with firm tannins and rich, almost sweet berry character.

holmes-cay-barbados-foursquare-12-yr-rum.title: Holmes Cay Barbados Foursquare 2010 12 Year Old Single Cask Rum 58% ABV
holmes-cay-barbados-foursquare-12-yr-rum.bodyHtml:
Holmes Cay Barbados 2010 12 Year Old is a single cask rum from the Foursquare Rum Distillery in St. Philip, Barbados, bottled by the independent bottler Holmes Cay. A blend of pot and column still rum made from molasses, it was distilled in 2010 and aged 12 years in ex-bourbon casks before bottling in 2022. This is cask 99, bottled at barrel proof with no additives at 58% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water to open it up at this strength.

holmes-cay-barb-foursqua-15yr-wine-cask.title: Holmes Cay Barbados Foursquare 2007 15 Year Old Whisky Wine Cask Single Cask Rum 58.2% ABV
holmes-cay-barb-foursqua-15yr-wine-cask.bodyHtml:
Single cask, aged rum distilled by Foursquare Rum Distillery in Saint Philip, Barbados, and bottled by Holmes Cay. Blend of double retort copper pot still and twin column Coffey still rums distilled from molasses. Aged 15 years; tropically aged in Barbados for 11 years in ex-bourbon casks; aged in Liverpool, UK, for 4 years in ex-English whisky casks that previously held red wine. Sweet, yeasted bread, hot pepper, and fresh coconut on the nose transition to cinnamon, toasted coconut, plum, and vanilla on the palate with cracked pepper and toffee on a mineralic finish. No sugar, coloring, or other additives .Non-chill filtered; bottled at a cask strength of 58.6% ABV

One of only two casks released in North America, this bottling originally comes from the legendary Foursquare Rum Distillery in Barbados where it was aged 11 years before making its way to the U.K. for an additional 4 years of maturation in ex-English whisky casks that previously held red wine. The result is a bold and refined expression that masterfully integrates the subtleties of its multi-cask maturation with Foursquare’s confectionary, faintly herbal blended rum.

social-lite-variety-pack-1.title: Social Lite Variety Pack 12 Can
social-lite-variety-pack-1.bodyHtml: Social Lite came to light in 2013, in a Whitby, Ontario kitchen and has been crafting less sweet, low-calorie ready-to-drink alternatives ever since. This refreshed mixer pack includes Field Strawberry, Pineapple Mango, and two exclusive flavours; Peach and Blood Orange. A lighter option, at only 80 calories per serving.

motts-caesar-variety-pack.title: Mott's Clamato Caesar Variety Pack 12 Cans
motts-caesar-variety-pack.bodyHtml: The Mott's Clamato Variety Pack includes the 3 top-selling customer favourites: Original, Extra Spicy and Pickled Bean. There's something in this pack for every Caesar lover. Serve chilled or over ice with your favourite Caesar garnish.

gaja-barbaresco-docg.title: Gaja Barbaresco 2021 1.5L Magnum
gaja-barbaresco-docg.bodyHtml:
The nose is dominated by fruit, but also citrus and floral hints emerge. On the palate it’s juicy and the floral notes persist alongside scents of licorice. Subtle hints of cherry and strawberry create a harmonious blend of floral elegance and vibrant fruit flavors.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This was an epic vintage, and the entire Gaja family is ready to sing its praises. The 2021 Barbaresco sets the tone with sweet cherry flavors framed by spice, earthy notes and elegantly sweet tannins. Giovanni Gaja says the 2021 growing season had two phases: the first six months of the year saw rain and cool temperatures with some frost and soggy conditions until May; however, from June forward, the season saw sunny days without excessive heat spikes. In line with the character of the vintage, this wine shows succulent fruit that is balanced and not too ripe. There is depth and volume here.

95 Points - James Suckling
The aromas of licorice, minerals, light tar and dark berries such as raspberry are so attractive. It’s medium-bodied with a tight and integrated palate of fine tannins that are seamless and unseen. It’s long and lively.
95 Points - Wine Spectator

A pretty red, elegant and expressive, offering strawberry, cherry, rose and mineral flavors. Refined tannins and vibrant acidity provide the right amount of support, giving an overall sense of harmony. This firms up nicely, turning more austere, with red fruit and savory notes on the long aftertaste. 

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A pure embodiment of Nebbiolo’s elegance, this opens with enticing aromas of ripe red berries, violet petals and earthy undertones. The palate leaps forward with flavors of juicy cherries, plums and a touch of spice. A chalky minerality sits at the core, with fine-grained tannins that create a structure that’s perfectly balanced. Each part of the wine is precise and effortlessly flows into the next.

gaja-grappa-barbaresco.title: Gaja Barbaresco 2021 3L Double Magnum
gaja-grappa-barbaresco.bodyHtml:
