gaja-grappa-brunello.title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello di Montalcino 2021
gaja-grappa-brunello.bodyHtml:
The Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello di Montalcino 2021 is an elegant, structured, and deeply sophisticated Old World red wine that reflects the legendary precision of the Gaja family during a growing season marked by rare, cool-toned transparency. It pours a beautiful, deep ruby red colour with silver highlights in the glass, releasing a highly expressive, pure bouquet of red cherries, wild strawberries, and sweet Parma violets, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of earth, tamarind, licorice, and exotic spices. On the palate, this full-bodied, sleek Sangiovese displays an amazingly dense mid-palate, coating the mouth with velvety, powerful yet beautifully ripe tannins and a crystalline, cool-toned acidity that mirrors the distinct diurnal temperature shifts of the 2021 vintage. Sourced across premium plots and aged for 24 months in oak barrels followed by six months of refinement in concrete vats to ensure a perfectly integrated structure, it carries into an exceptionally long, chewy finish accented by a polished trailing note of graphite, mint, and sour cherry pit.

Food Pairing: This structured, noble Brunello pairs beautifully with a wide range of refined culinary options, including slow-cooked osso buco, prime cuts of grilled dry-aged beef steak with a side of truffle risotto, roasted wild game birds, savory lamb chops, and a selection of hard, aged artisanal cheeses like Pecorino Toscano

96 Points - James Suckling

A restrained wine with a graceful nose of subtle red cherries, wild strawberries, sweet violets and complex earth and tamarind. Full-bodied with licorice flavors, a dense mid-palate and velvety tannins that are powerful yet ripe. Slightly lifted acidity and a long,chewy finish. Drinkable now, but best from 2027.

gaja-grappa-gaia-rey.title: Gaja Grappa Gaia & Rey 500ml
gaja-grappa-gaia-rey.bodyHtml:
Gaja & Rey Gaja Grappa is produced by distilling the Chardonnay pomace used for Gaja Rey.

The distillation of this Grappa Gaja takes place in a discontinuous alembic which perfectly preserves the varietal aromas.

It is therefore a very delicate grappa, where white fruit dominates the bouquet and is also found on the palate, with a soft and not at all aggressive sip.

benromach-cask-strength-2012-batch-2.title: Benromach Cask Strength 2012 Batch 2
benromach-cask-strength-2012-batch-2.bodyHtml:
Benromach Cask Strength 2012 Batch 2 is a Speyside single malt from the Benromach distillery in Forres, owned by Gordon & MacPhail since 1993. Distilled in 2012 and bottled in 2022, it marries first-fill Sherry and bourbon casks and was bottled at full cask strength of 59.9% ABV in a 700ml bottle, with natural colour and no chill-filtration. This second batch of the 2012 vintage was produced for the North American market and offers a bold, spicy and fruity take on the distillery's gently smoky style.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water.

benromach-triple-distilled.title: Benromach Contrasts: Unpeated 12 Year Old Sherry Cask Matured
benromach-triple-distilled.bodyHtml:
Benromach Contrasts : Unpeated 12 Year Old Sherry Cask Matured is an exceptional single malt Scotch whisky from Benromach Distillery's experimental Contrasts series. Departing from the distillery's signature subtle peat smoke style, this expression is distilled using 100% unpeated malted barley and matured for 12 years exclusively in first-fill Sherry casks, delivering a rich, full-bodied Speyside whisky bursting with dense dried fruit sweetness, warm oak spice, and classic sherry character.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate, sticky toffee pudding, aged Stilton cheese, or roasted venison.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany hue with a rich, full-bodied, and silky mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich sherry notes, stewed raisins, dark chocolate, sweet orange peel, cinnamon spice, and warm oak.

Palate : Creamy and rich with layers of fruitcake, candied cherries, cloves, cocoa, toasted nuts, and sweet honeyed malt.

Finish : Long, warming, and sweet with lingering dried fruit, gentle oak tannins, and warm winter spices.

Serve : Served neat at room temperature or with a few drops of water in a Glencairn glass.

laphroaig-25-year-old-2022-53-40-abv.title: Laphroaig 25 Year Old Cask Strength 2022 Edition
laphroaig-25-year-old-2022-53-40-abv.bodyHtml:
Aged for 25 years in ex-Bourbon barrels. The exquisite flavor, supremely smooth texture and 53.4% vol of Laphroaig 25 Cask Strength prove patience pays off.

COLOUR

  • Pale gold, a peek of the complexity created by the careful aging process

NOSE

  • Restrained smoky flavours and aromas of sweet vanilla, wood spice and smoked bacon, plus a hint of dried fruit

FINISH

  • Lingering with waves of smoke and a peppery conclusion

PALATE

  • Layered and creamy, with flavours of pepper, iodine and peat smoke along with hints of green apple

MATURATION

  • This cask strength single malt spends a quarter of a century in ex-Bourbon casks and Oloroso sherry barrels

muga-seleccion-especial.title: Bodegas Muga Seleccion Especial 2020
muga-seleccion-especial.bodyHtml:
Bodegas Muga Selección Especial 2020 is an elegant, highly expressive red wine produced by Bodegas Muga in Haro, located within the Rioja Alta subregion of Spain. Crafted from a traditional blend of 70% Tempranillo, 20% Garnacha, with the remainder split between Mazuelo and Graciano, the grapes are fermented using indigenous yeasts in oak vats before aging 26 months in oak barrels made in the winery's own cooperage. In the glass, it displays an intense ruby-red color with a garnet rim. The bouquet features vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, cassis, and black raspberries layered with graphite, cocoa powder, violets, and subtle spicy oak nuances. On the palate, it is full-bodied, structured, and textured, delivering concentrated dark berry fruit, silky yet firm tannins, fine-grained acidity, and a long, persistent finish with hints of sweet tobacco and dark chocolate.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, game dishes, and aged Manchego cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

Mint, blackberries, cocoa powder, graphite, black pepper and roasted dark spices. Full-bodied and juicy, with lots of tannins that are quite sinewy and fine-grained. Really long. Needs at least two more years to come around. Tempranillo, garnacha, mazuelo and graciano. Drink after 2026.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Their most gastronomical red is the 2020 Selección Especial, a blend of the four traditional varieties from Rioja—Tempranillo, Garnacha Tinta, Mazuelo and Graciano—fermented in oak vats. Half of the destemmed grapes were put through an optical sorting machine. The wine matured in French oak barrels, 40% of them new, for 26 months and was racked every eight to nine months. 2020 was a warm year, and the wine comes in at 14.5% alcohol, with a pH of 3.56 and 5.75 grams of acidity. Manu Muga likes 2020 very much and says it's a year that suffers because it's in between 2019 and 2021. This is also a textbook example of this wine, a little more developed and tertiary, with generous spice and toast and a palate with more grip. The tannins are not as precise and elegant as those from 2021 (yeah, it suffers in the comparison), but it's a very worthy wine.

93 Points Wine Spectator

Hints of smoke, dark chocolate and loamy earth underscore a rich core of ripe black plum and mulberry fruit, with rose hip, iron and macchia notes. This is tightly meshed and fresh, opening nicely in the glass and showing good tension and chalky tannins on the well-spiced finish. Enjoy this today, but it should really shine with a little cellaring. Tempranillo, Garnacha, Mazuelo and Graciano. Best from 2026 through 2034.

la-mula-de-la-quietud-tinta-de-toro.title: Quinta De La Quietud La Mula De La Quietud 2016 750ml
la-mula-de-la-quietud-tinta-de-toro.bodyHtml: La Mula de la Quietud 2016 is the top red of Quinta de la Quietud, an estate in Toro in the Spanish region of Castilla y León. It is made entirely from Tinta de Toro, the local form of Tempranillo, picked from estate vines planted between 1900 and 1920. Fermentation starts spontaneously, without added sulphites, in open temperature-controlled stainless-steel tanks, followed by about three weeks of skin maceration with twice-daily pump-overs and two final délestages. The wine then spends 24 months in 225-litre barrels of new French oak. The estate describes a very deep cherry colour, potent aromas of ripe black fruit, liquorice and black pepper with balsamic, mineral and cigar-box tones, and a powerful yet balanced palate. This bottle is 15.6% ABV.

fenocchio-barolo-cannubi.title: Giacomo Fenocchio Barolo Cannubi 2018 750ml
fenocchio-barolo-cannubi.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "Aromas of underbrush, new leather and botanical herb mingle with a whiff of tobacco. Linear and vibrant, the full-bodied palate shows tart red cherry, red currant and star anise before finishing on a green walnut note. Tight, close-grained tannins and bright acidity keep provide support. Kerin O’Keefe" - Wine Enthusiast

zorzettig-schioppettino.title: Zorzettig Schioppettino Venezia Giulia IGT 2016 750ml
zorzettig-schioppettino.bodyHtml: A ruby red colour with small red fruits, cherries, blackberries and sweet spices on the nose. On the palate, a sip from the Vispi Tannins, fresh and savoury, with fruity returns.

villa-guelpa-lessona.title: Villa Guelpa Lessona Rosso 2017
villa-guelpa-lessona.bodyHtml: Villa Guelpa Lessona 2017 is a Nebbiolo from Lessona in northern Piedmont, at 13.5% alcohol. The tasting profile shows rose petal, forest berry, herbs, menthol and truffle, then juicy red cherry, raspberry, star anise and mint with taut, refined tannins, bright acidity and a savoury, saline finish.

passobianco.title: Vini Franchetti Passopisciaro Passobianco 2022 750ml
passobianco.bodyHtml:
Passopisciaro is the Sicilian winery developed by Andrea Franchetti, located in the homonymous hamlet of Castiglione di Sicilia, in an uncontaminated and wild landscape, where the rows of vines grow in harmony with nature and are lost behind the hills, surrounded by black volcanic soils. The 26 hectares of the very old vines of Passopisciaro, trained as a sapling, develop between 550 and 1000 meters on very different soils. Each plot is raised separately and follows different growth processes to bring the grapes to maturity.

Unlike most of the Etna white wines, usually produced with the autochthonous Carricante, Passobianco is produced with 100% Chardonnay. The harvest is carried out meticulously by tasting the grains to ensure full and homogeneous ripeness of all the clusters, harvesting only small portions of the vine per day.

The result is a rich, fresh, bright, and multifaceted wine. Its complexity is due to the combination of light conditions, temperature range, high altitude, and volcanic soil that are found only on Etna.

The color is intense straw yellow. On the nose, the wine is elegant, with notes of yellow fruit, tropical fruit, and sweet sensations of honey and delicately toasted. The good body, and the pleasant fresh closure with savory and mineral notes typical of the volcanic terroir, make it the perfect partner for fish soups and white meats.

filipa-pato-dnmc-bical-arinto.title: Filipa Pato FP Bical - Arinto 2020 750ml
filipa-pato-dnmc-bical-arinto.bodyHtml: The 2020 Filipa Pato FP Bical - Arinto is a Portuguese white wine, a blend of Bical and Arinto grapes, made by the biodynamic and organic winery Filipa Pato & William Wouters. The wine is characterized by its vibrant acidity and notes of white flowers, nectarine pit, sea, salt, and stone on the nose. On the palate, it showcases flowery lemon notes, herbs, mint, stones, and a touch of orange.

san-marzano-edda-bianco-salento.title: San Marzano Edda Bianco 2024
san-marzano-edda-bianco-salento.bodyHtml:
San Marzano Edda Bianco 2024 is an opulent and aromatic Italian white wine that showcases the unique beauty of Puglia's maritime terroir. Crafted predominantly from Chardonnay alongside native Apulian grape varieties like Fiano and Moscatello Selvatico, it undergoes cold maceration followed by fermentation and four months of aging on the lees in French oak barrels. The wine displays a straw-yellow color with vibrant golden reflections, opening with complex aromas of white flowers, ripe peach, candied citrus, and subtle hints of warm vanilla. On the palate, it is generous, broad, and smooth, offering a creamy, envelopingly textured mouthfeel that is beautifully balanced by a crisp, persistent line of acidity and a distinct saline minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rich seafood risottos, shellfish, roasted poultry, white meats, and aged, artisanal cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

A delicious, dense and aromatic white. It showcases quince peels, flowers, lemon curds and some wild herbs on the nose. Medium- to full-bodied with medium acidity. Lovely lemon character on the mid-palate brings freshness to the creamy texture. Vivid and flavorful with a persistent finish. Drink or hold.

plano-malagousia-wine-art-estate.title: Wine Art Estate Plano Malagousia 2019 750ml
plano-malagousia-wine-art-estate.bodyHtml:
Plano Malagousia by Wine Art Estate is a wine that manages to maintain its role at the table, perfectly matching plenty of dishes from the Mediterranean cuisine, without sacrificing the well-known extroversion of the variety. A balanced and at the same time expressive Malagousia that can play all roles, moving along the tasting area between the explosiveness of Techni Alipias white and the austerity of Plano Assyrtiko.

The label featuring a drawing compass and the name ‘Plano’, ‘Plan’ in Greek, remind us of the two founders of the Estate, civil engineer Giannis Papadopoulos and architect engineer Giannis Kalaitzidis.

APPEARANCE / Light lemon color with green highlights

NOSE / Intense character that brings a Mediterranean garden with green herbs to mind. Citrus fruits, unripe peach, four o'clock flower and a wonderful green character reminiscent of green pepper, freshly cut grass, fennel and mint.

PALATE / Its wonderfully refreshing acidity in combination with the moderate body and medium alcohol make a real flexible wine, easily paired with different foods without losing its expressiveness.

cartuxa-pera-manca-branco.title: Cartuxa Pera Manca Vinho Branco 2022
cartuxa-pera-manca-branco.bodyHtml: This wine is based on the Antão Vaz and Arinto varieties, presenting a citrus color and a persistent, fine and complex fruity aroma. In the mouth it is soft, dry, complex and balanced. When the grapes reach the right point of maturation they are carefully picked, destalked and gently crushed. Fermentation takes place in stainless steel vats and in french oak barrels, at controlled temperature of 16ºC. Then the wine matures on the lees for further 12 months with battonage and another 12 months in bottle, prior to release.

hardys-stamp-riesling-gewurztraminer.title: Hardys Stamp Riesling Gewurztraminer 750ml
hardys-stamp-riesling-gewurztraminer.bodyHtml: Hardy's Stamp Riesling Gewürztraminer is a medium-bodied white wine blend from South Eastern Australia. It's known for its aromatic citrus notes, delicate tropical flavors like lychee and rose petal, and a crisp, clean finish. The wine offers a blend of sweetness with a refreshing acidity, making it a versatile pairing for a variety of dishes.

highlandpark-1988-g-m-connoisseurschoice.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Highland Park 32 Year Old 1988 Refill American Hogshead Cask 1284 52.8% ABV
highlandpark-1988-g-m-connoisseurschoice.bodyHtml:
One of 207 Bottles

Producer Tasting Note

Nose: Crystalized violets and soft coconut give way to hints of cured meat. White chocolate comes to the fore, followed by subtle notes of bonfire embers.

Taste: Sweet and smooth flavours of red apple and malted biscuit. Rich vanilla develops alongside dried banana pieces and light citrus zest.

Finish: A medium-bodied finish with lingering soft fruit and smoke.

cazadores-paloma-1-75l.title: Cazadores Paloma 1.75L
cazadores-paloma-1-75l.bodyHtml:
Cazadores Paloma 1.75L is a premium ready-to-drink cocktail crafted using authentic 100% Blue Weber Agave Tequila Cazadores Blanco from the Highlands of Jalisco, combined with real grapefruit juice and agave nectar. It offers a perfectly balanced, bar-quality classic Paloma experience in a convenient, large-format bottle.

Food Pairing: Tacos al pastor, grilled shrimp, ceviche, spicy nachos, or citrus-marinated chicken.

Tasting Notes : Pale pinkish-grapefruit with bright, clear highlights, featuring a smooth, refreshing, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright ruby red grapefruit, fresh citrus peel, sweet agave nectar, and crisp cooked agave.

Palate : Tart and juicy with lively pink grapefruit juice, sweet agave sweetener, subtle lime notes, and smooth Blanco Tequila warmth.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering sweet-tart grapefruit citrus and mild agave warmth.

Serve : Serve chilled, poured directly over ice in a glass with a salt rim and a fresh grapefruit or lime wheel.

cazadores-margarita-1-75l.title: Cazadores Blanco Tequila 1.75L
cazadores-margarita-1-75l.bodyHtml:
Cazadores Blanco Tequila is an authentic, 100% blue agave tequila crafted in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Double-fermented and double-distilled using traditional methods, it is bottled unaged to retain the pure, vibrant character of fresh agave, citrus, and sweet herbs.

Food Pairing: Fresh ceviche, fish tacos, guacamole, grilled shrimp, or lime-marinated chicken.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear with brilliant silver hues, featuring a light-to-medium-bodied and clean mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh green agave, bright citrus, lime zest, sweet herbs, and a touch of black pepper.

Palate : Crisp and vibrant with flavors of sweet cooked agave, lemon peel, fresh herbs, and light spice.

Finish : Short, clean, and dry with lingering citrus and gentle pepper warmth.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as the base in a classic Paloma or Margarita.

empress-cocktail-gin.title: Empress 1908 Cocktail Gin
empress-cocktail-gin.bodyHtml:
Empress 1908 Cocktail Gin is a visually stunning, hand-crafted spirit famous for its vibrant, all-natural indigo hue. Created in a collaborative effort between Victoria Distillers and the iconic Fairmont Empress Hotel in British Columbia, this gin is distilled in small-batch copper pot stills. The signature color and distinct earthy profile come from the infusion of butterfly pea blossom, which magically transforms into a bright lavender, pink, or fuchsia when mixed with citrus or tonic. The aromatic nose presents bold juniper, vibrant citrus, and a delicate floral elegance. On the palate, it is beautifully balanced, featuring a curated blend of eight botanicals including rose petal, coriander, grapefruit peel, ginger root, cinnamon bark, and the hotel's signature black tea. It finishes smooth, crisp, and clean, with a gentle tannin structure from the tea.

Food Pairing: The elegant citrus, floral, and tea notes of this gin make it a phenomenal match for delicate seafood dishes, such as fresh shrimp ceviche, oysters on the half shell, or lightly seared scallops. It also pairs beautifully with classic afternoon tea fare, like cucumber sandwiches, Earl Grey infused macarons, or a zesty lemon tart.

cote-rotie-la-mouline.title: E. Guigal Cote Rotie La Turque 2019
cote-rotie-la-mouline.bodyHtml:
The 2019 E. Guigal "La Turque" is a monumental Côte-Rôtie that perfectly balances the exotic aromatics of the Côte Blonde with the structural power of the Côte Brune. Sourced from a steep, one-hectare parcel with ancient schist and iron-rich soils, the 2019 vintage is noted for its extraordinary intensity and "perfect" critical reception. It presents an opaque purple hue and an explosive nose of blackberry jam, maraschino cherry, and roasted coffee, layered with complex notes of black truffle, oriental spices, and smoky bacon fat. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and seamless, featuring massive concentration, silky yet dense tannins, and a vibrant acidity that ensures decades of longevity. Aged for 40 months in 100% new French oak, it concludes with an endlessly persistent, savory finish.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Austere and somewhat somber—no doubt influenced by the high proportion of iron oxide in the soils—the 2019 Côte-Rôtie La Turque is nonetheless elegant and remarkably delicate. It unfurls from the glass with aromas of spices, gentian, dark berries, bell pepper and baked mulberries, mingled with subtle hints of oak. Full-bodied, structured and robust, it delivers a multidimensional core of fruit and firm, finely extracted tannins that channel its controlled power, concluding with an endless, delicately spicy finish.

98 Points - James Suckling

From the haunting nose through to the end of the extremely long finish this wine embodies the rocky personality of Cote-Rotie, along with the special ripeness that the syrah achieves here. As floral as it is stony, as structured as it is concentrated, yet all of this builds an imposing and enchanting whole. A cuvee of 93% syrah and 7% viognier. Matured in 100% new oak for 42 months. Drinkable now, but best from 2025.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Powerful and broad, with a velvety robe of charred apple wood and savory spices surrounding a core of winey red currant and cherry preserves, flecked with olive tapenade. Texturally stunning, with polished, softened tannins keeping this poised. Showing impressive freshness and tension, this is a compelling, well-meshed wine that stretches way out.

cote-rotie-la-turque.title: E. Guigal Cote Rotie La Turque 2019
cote-rotie-la-turque.bodyHtml:

chateau-clos-des-menuts-st-emilion-grand.title: Chateau Clos Saint-Emilion Philippe Cuvee 122 Grand Cru 2022
chateau-clos-des-menuts-st-emilion-grand.bodyHtml:
Château Clos Saint-Emilion Philippe Cuvée 122 Grand Cru 2022 is an elegant, well-defined red wine produced by the family-owned Château Clos Saint-Émilion Philippe estate. Sourced from selected plot harvests in the Right Bank's Saint-Émilion Grand Cru appellation, this Merlot-dominant blend with Cabernet Franc presents a dark crimson-ruby color. The expressive nose opens with enticing aromas of luscious cassis, wild forest berries, and soft plum, layered with delicate baking spices, subtle cocoa, and fine toasted oak. On the palate, it is supple, medium- to full-bodied, and nicely concentrated, offering pure dark-berry fruit flavors framed by silky, velvety tannins, well-balanced acidity, and a long, refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, duck breast, braised beef short ribs, wild game dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

macintyre-reserve-astra-chardonnay.title: Macintyre Astra 2021
macintyre-reserve-astra-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The 2021 'Astra' Chardonnay is a testament to Lake Breeze's commitment to excellence. While specific tasting notes for this vintage are not available, previous releases have showcased a pale straw hue with aromas of citrus and green apple. The palate typically offers a balance of bright acidity and subtle oak influences, leading to a clean, crisp finish. Earlier vintages have been noted for their mix of citrus, pear, and spicy hazelnut flavours, with a nose combining bright green apple and citrus with buttery tones.

This Chardonnay pairs excellently with dishes such as lobster, roasted chicken, or grilled halibut. Its crisp acidity and subtle oak nuances complement creamy or buttery sauces, while its fresh citrus notes enhance delicate seafood flavours. Together, these pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating a memorable dining experience.

three-olives-bubble-gum-vodka.title: Three Olives Vodka
three-olives-bubble-gum-vodka.bodyHtml:
Three Olives® is a premium vodka 4x distilled and filtered yielding an exceptionally pure and smooth vodka that is 100% GMO-free. The palate entry is silky, textured and enhanced with mineral notes. It is extremely mixable and can be used in a variety of cocktails ranging from a vodka soda to a Bloody Mary. (40% ABV – 80 proof).

Color: crystal clear
Aroma: Clean aroma with subtle notes of buttercream and wheat.
Flavor: Starts full and smooth with slight woodiness and vanilla bean pod.
Finish: Finishes with traces of hyssop and eucalyptus bringing mild cooling and astringency.

collefrisio-semis-montepulciano-dabruzzo.title: Torre Zambra Colle Maggio Riserva Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2021
collefrisio-semis-montepulciano-dabruzzo.bodyHtml:
Torre Zambra Colle Maggio Riserva Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2021 pours an intense, impenetrable ruby red color with vibrant violet highlights at the rim. The highly expressive nose opens with enticing aromas of ripe blackberries, fresh blueberries, and dark plum fruit, beautifully layered with secondary hints of graphite, new leather, and dark baking spice. On the palate, this full-bodied Italian red delivers a remarkably plush, creamy, and powerful texture. The rich mouthfeel seamlessly balances dense dark forest fruits with a core of refreshing natural acidity and a plethora of fine, dusty tannins. Maturation lends subtle undercurrents of cocoa powder, black tea, and wood spice that carry effortlessly into a tight, structured, and long-lasting finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled ribeye steaks, slow-roasted lamb chops, wild boar osso buco, grilled game sausages, or rich pasta dishes with savory ragù.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Delicate and floral, sweet and tart on the nose, with aromas of sour cherry, raspberry candy, violets, mocha and white pepper. Macerated berries and abundant milk chocolate headline the palate, before an earthy, herbaceous, peppery finish lifted by a current of acid. Another deeply pleasurable wine from Torre Zambra that doesn't sacrifice depth or sophistication.

91 Points - James Suckling

Lots of dark fruits and purple flowers followed by bitter chocolate, coffee beans and a touch of wet leaves. Full-bodied with chewy and juicy tannins, and balanced acidity. A rich, young red showing some good tension. From organically grown grapes. Vegan. Sustainable. Keep this for two or three years to let it come around. Try in 2025.

aix-rose.title: AIX Rose 2024 750ml
aix-rose.bodyHtml:
A hypnotizing pale pink color with notes of citrus, wild berries, and white peach. Refreshingly crisp and dry with a mineral finish

89 Points - Decanter

A blend of Grenache, Syrah and Cinsault from some of the appellation's highest vineyards at 420m above sea level. Delicate and fruity, raspberry and marshmallow spring to mind, the palate following on with a dry, gastronomic character, small red berries but a very clean mineral and lemon finish

dom-perignon-p2-rose.title: Dom Perignon P2 Plenitude Rose 2000
dom-perignon-p2-rose.bodyHtml:
Fresh, crystalline, and sharp, the first nose unveils an unusual dimension, an aquatic vegetal world with secret touches of white pepper and gardenia. The wine reveals a light, gentle maturity before exhaling peaty scents. The attack bursts forth, before maturing into a sensual fullness that winds around itself, like a tendril of foliage. Notes of liquorice and dried ginger linger on the skin of fruit (pear and mango), more textured than ripe. The finish gradually unfurls and then settles, smooth, mellow, all-encompassing. An indefinable je ne sais quoi, never upsetting the integrity of the wine, has worked its charm.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2000 Dom Pérignon Rosé P2 is a sapid, gastronomic wine, unfurling in the glass with attractive aromas of iodine, blood orange, dried white flowers and oyster shell. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, ample and elegantly textural, with a rich and open-knit core of distinctly savory fruit, a fine but youthfully boisterous mousse and a long, saline finish. This almost Burgundian-styled rosé is fully mature and drinking very well today, and I would be inclined to open bottles over the coming decade.

domaine-le-colombier-cuvee-g-vacqueyras.title: Domaine Le Colombier Cuvee G Vacqueyras 2017 750ml

san-marzano-sessantanni-primitivo-di-man.title: San Marzano 60 Sessantanni Primitivo di Manduria 2020
san-marzano-sessantanni-primitivo-di-man.bodyHtml:
San Marzano 60 Sessantanni Primitivo di Manduria 2020 is an iconic, rich, and highly opulent Italian red wine crafted from low-yielding bush vines (alberello) aged at least sixty years old in the heart of the Primitivo di Manduria DOP. Vinified with hand-harvested, late-ripening grapes and aged for 12 months in French and American oak barrels, it displays a deep, dark ruby red color. The complex nose delivers intense aromatics of plum jam, dark cherry preserves, sweet tobacco, cocoa, and subtle hints of vanilla. On the palate, it is full-bodied, velvety, and deeply concentrated, featuring plush tannins and a long, warm, spice-accented finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with braised beef short ribs, roasted lamb shoulder, wild boar ragù, venison, barbecue meats, and sharp, aged cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

A rich and generous red showcasing black berries, dark plums and sweet spices. It’s full-bodied with plush tannins. Creamy and densely fruited with more spice character toward the fleshy finish. Drink or hold.

f-negroamaro-salento-i-g-p.title: San Marzano F Negroamaro 2021
f-negroamaro-salento-i-g-p.bodyHtml:
San Marzano F Negroamaro 2021 is an opulent, velvety, and deeply structured Italian red wine produced by Cantine San Marzano. Sourced from select old-vine parcels in the Monte La Conca area of Salento, it undergoes maturation in French and Caucasian oak barrels for 12 months. In the glass, it shows a very deep purple-red color with rich aromas of wild dark berries, cherry jam, roasted mushrooms, and sweet spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, supple, and beautifully balanced, framed by fine-grained tannins and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with braised beef shanks, roasted lamb chops, rich wild mushroom risotto, pasta with tomato-based meat ragù, and aged cheeses.

90 Points - James Suckling

Roasted mushrooms, olives, baked black fruit and gravy on the nose. It’s full-bodied, lightly jammy and sweet-savory in character with well-integrated tannins.

schrader-cabernet-sauvignon-1.title: Schrader Old Sparky Beckstoffer To Kalon Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 1.5L Magnum
schrader-cabernet-sauvignon-1.bodyHtml:
The most coveted bottling in our portfolio, Old Sparky To Kalon Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon is blended from a selection of only the best barrels from the vintage. The wine is full-bodied with concentrated black and purple fruit balanced with elegant floral and spice notes, fresh acidity, and firm ripe tannins. A wine that is built to age and recommended to cellar for 15+ years.

100 Points - James Suckling

This elite wine in the Schrader lineup is a selection of the best barrels from three cabernet clones planted in the Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville. Ultra ripe in flavor, creamy in texture, with tannins that are soft at first but firm up on the finish. Generous in chocolate, black cherries, blueberries and those broad, melted tannins. Very full-bodied at 15.5% alcohol, but it has inherent acidity for balance. Tasted from a magnum. Drinkable now, but best from 2030.

98 Points - Robert Parker's The Wine Advocate

A best-barrel selection and blend chosen and made by Thomas Rivers Brown, the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Old Sparky Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard essentially takes the characters of the Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard bottling and ratchets up the intensity. Raspberries, blackberries and black cherries cascade over a base of deep Oakville loam and dried spices. It's full-bodied, rich, concentrated and almost creamy in texture, finishing lush and long. Bottled in magnum.

lokoya-mt-veeder-cabernet-2018.title: Lokoya Howell Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
lokoya-mt-veeder-cabernet-2018.bodyHtml:
Traveling the road on an 1100cc American motorcycle with the engine’s low rumble and vibration under you, the wind in your face, and the feeling of power and acceleration in your grip—that’s how the 2018 Howell Mountain feels on the palate. With its low rumbling tannins, its depth of flavor, and its power-driven mouthfeel, you’ll be singing ‘Born to be Wild’ with each sip. This powerful Cabernet Sauvignon offers an ideal balance of acid and middle body weight.Blackberry, sourdough toast, crushed stone, and a little herb shine through in an intense depth of flavor.
96 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain was aged in French oak barrels for 22 months, 97% new. Deep garnet-purple colored, it rolls effortlessly out of the glass with notes of warm cassis, black cherries, mulberries and plum preserves plus hints of dark chocolate, crushed rock and tree bark with a waft of truffles. The full-bodied palate is densely laden with earthy/savory black fruit layers and super firm, rugged tannins, delivering a tightly wound, lively finish. Give it a good 5 years in bottle and drink it over the next 20+ years.
Rating: 96(+)

girolamo-russo-a-rina-etna-rosso.title: Girolamo Russo 'A Rina Etna Rosso 2019 750ml
girolamo-russo-a-rina-etna-rosso.bodyHtml: Girolamo Russo's 'A Rina Etna Rosso 2019 is a red wine from Sicily, Italy, specifically from the Etna region. It is known for its ruby red color, complex aromas of fruit (like plum and cherry), leather, and tobacco, and a palate with velvety tannins and good structure.

girolamo-russo-feudo-etna-rosso.title: Pietradolce Feudo Di Mezzo Etna Rosso 2020
girolamo-russo-feudo-etna-rosso.bodyHtml:
Brilliant ruby red in color, this single-vineyard Etna Rosso reveals aromas of wild strawberry, red cherry, rose petals, crushed herbs, and volcanic stone. The palate is elegant and finely structured with vibrant red fruit, savory complexity, and silky tannins supported by lively acidity. The finish is long, mineral-driven, and exceptionally refined.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled lamb, roasted poultry, mushroom risotto, charcuterie, tuna dishes, and aged cheeses.

 

94 Points - James Suckling

Pale to medium ruby-garnet hue. A very mineral nose with crushed stones, iron, some bitter oranges, wild herbs and savory berries. Huge tannins and high acidity on an austere palate with a full body and a mineral-driven finish. Lots of bones and tension here, but no heft. Drinkable now, but better in two years. A mineral and more Barolo-like Etna Rosso.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A primarily sanguine, umami nose features aromas of soil, tar, underbrush and soy sauce, but undertones of tart fruit provide a spark. On the palate, a sprinkle of salt and pepper, along with fierce tannins and acid, help develop both the slightly metallic earthiness and the astringent fruit element into a layered tapestry.

allegrini-oasi-mantellina-lugana-doc.title: Allegrini Lugana Oasi Mantellina 2024
allegrini-oasi-mantellina-lugana-doc.bodyHtml:
Allegrini Lugana Oasi Mantellina 2024 is a wonderfully vibrant, crisp, and refreshing white wine that showcases the expert craftsmanship of the historic Allegrini family from their vineyards near the shores of Lake Garda. Composed of a thoughtful blend of Turbiana and a small touch of Cortese, this wine undergoes soft pressing and temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation with no oak contact, allowing its pure varietal characteristics to take center stage. In the glass, it exhibits a beautiful pale straw-yellow hue with delicate green highlights. The expressive aromatic profile greets the senses with a fragrant bouquet of jasmine, white peach, bergamot, and fresh citrus blossoms, underscored by subtle notes of green almond and a light, breezy salinity. On the palate, it is beautifully structured, balanced, and tensed with a lively acidity that perfectly frames the juicy pomelo and ripe stone fruit layers, concluding with a persistent, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with fresh sushi and sashimi, salt-crusted sea bass, pasta with clams, vegetable couscous, or a Mediterranean herb-baked bream.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Turbiana and Cortese channeling childhood memories through adult tastebuds. That orange vitamin C tablet meets ripe fruits and flowers while stones keep it fresh. Creamy texture plays with citrus zip before salt comes to play. When wine decides to have some fun.

chateau-lynch-bages-pauillac-gcc-2014.title: Famille J.M Cazes Pauillac 2021
chateau-lynch-bages-pauillac-gcc-2014.bodyHtml:
Famille J.M. Cazes Pauillac 2021 is a classic Bordeaux red wine from the prestigious Pauillac appellation on France's Left Bank. Produced by the Cazes family, owners of Château Lynch-Bages, this Cabernet Sauvignon-led blend showcases the region's signature depth and elegance. Rich aromas of blackcurrant, dark cherry, cedar, and tobacco lead into a structured palate with ripe dark fruit, subtle oak spice, and refined tannins. Fresh acidity and a lingering, savoury finish make it an approachable introduction to the celebrated wines of Pauillac.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, venison, beef bourguignon, mushroom risotto, aged cheddar, and traditional French cuisine.

ruinart-blanc-de-blancs-1.title: Ruinart Brut Blanc de Blancs
ruinart-blanc-de-blancs-1.bodyHtml:
A supple, harmonious attack on the palate, firm but rounded. A voluptuous texture and vinosity that is not excessive, supported by excellent freshness. A very refreshing mineral finish.

At first very intense on the nose, giving way to fresh fruit notes, particularly ripe citrus and exotic fruits (pineapple). A highly refined floral second nose with notes of linden and white fruits (white peach).

Beautiful pale yellow color with glints of gold and green, a vibrant, luminous color. Active effervescence with a fine, persistent release of bubbles.

Ruinart Blanc de Blancs is a champagne for all occasions: aperitifs, lunch, dinner or celebratory meals. The vivacity is a perfect complement to seafood and white fish, pairing perfectly with dishes such as sea scallop carpaccio and sea bream tartare.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ruinart is a specialist in Blanc de Blancs Champagne. This wine is finely balanced between maturity and taut fresh, mineral-driven fruit.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A toasty blanc de blanc with an aromatic overtone of smoke and lemon peel notes accenting flavors of poached apricot, brioche, passion fruit coulis and fresh thyme. Fine and creamy in texture, with a racy finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Lemon tart, grapefruit and almonds on the nose, followed by a rounded, silky palate with soft bubbles. Pretty lemon curd and vanilla flavors to close.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Based on the 2019 vintage and disgorged in 2022, Ruinart's newly released NV Blanc de Blancs bursts with characteristically reductive aromas of yellow orchard fruit, citrus oil, iodine and toasted bread. Medium-bodied, pillowy and fleshy, with lively acids and a saline finish, it is an attractive Champagne that incorporates 20% reserve wines.

dom-perignon-p2-rose-2000.title: Dom Perignon P2 Plenitude Rose 2000
dom-perignon-p2-rose-2000.bodyHtml:
Fresh, crystalline, and sharp, the first nose unveils an unusual dimension, an aquatic vegetal world with secret touches of white pepper and gardenia. The wine reveals a light, gentle maturity before exhaling peaty scents. The attack bursts forth, before maturing into a sensual fullness that winds around itself, like a tendril of foliage. Notes of liquorice and dried ginger linger on the skin of fruit (pear and mango), more textured than ripe. The finish gradually unfurls and then settles, smooth, mellow, all-encompassing. An indefinable je ne sais quoi, never upsetting the integrity of the wine, has worked its charm.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2000 Dom Pérignon Rosé P2 is a sapid, gastronomic wine, unfurling in the glass with attractive aromas of iodine, blood orange, dried white flowers and oyster shell. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, ample and elegantly textural, with a rich and open-knit core of distinctly savory fruit, a fine but youthfully boisterous mousse and a long, saline finish. This almost Burgundian-styled rosé is fully mature and drinking very well today, and I would be inclined to open bottles over the coming decade.

vigneti-massa-derthona-tappo-classico.title: Vigneti Massa Derthona 2020 750ml
vigneti-massa-derthona-tappo-classico.bodyHtml: Vigneti Massa Derthona 2020 is a white wine made from Timorasso in the Colli Tortonesi hills of south-eastern Piedmont. Derthona is the historic name for Timorasso from around Tortona, a native white grape long grown in the Apennine foothills that came close to extinction after phylloxera. Vigneti Massa is the family estate at Monleale, its label noting roots going back to 1879, and Timorasso plantings in the area have since grown from about 4 hectares in 2000 to some 150 hectares farmed by more than forty producers. The wine undergoes a cold maceration of around 40 to 45 hours, then ferments and rests in stainless steel with regular lees stirring. 750ml, 13.5% alcohol.

martoccia-brunello-di-montalcino-riserva.title: Martoccia Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016
martoccia-brunello-di-montalcino-riserva.bodyHtml:
The 2016 Martoccia Brunello di Montalcino Riserva is a powerful and exceptionally refined wine from what is widely considered a legendary vintage in Tuscany. It exhibits a deep garnet red colour with luminous reflections. The nose is highly complex and expansive, offering concentrated aromas of ripe black cherries, plums, and dried figs, seamlessly integrated with sophisticated notes of tobacco leaf, dark chocolate, leather, and elegant balsamic spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and monumental, showcasing a perfect harmony between its rich fruit core, vibrant acidity, and dense, velvety tannins. This Riserva is built for long-term aging, concluding with an incredibly persistent and sapid finish that lingers with notes of savory spice and earthy minerality.

92 Points - James Suckling

Mushrooms, truffles, lemon peel, dried cherries and dried roses on the nose. Balanced and layered, with a full body and firm, fine-grained tannins. Fresh at the end. Drink or hold.

schrader-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.title: Schrader Beckstoffer Georges III Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
schrader-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.bodyHtml:
Sourced from the Beckstoffer Georges III Vineyard in Rutherford, this wine is produced from 100% Clone 337 Cabernet Sauvignon. The grapes originated from a specific section of the vineyard that was formerly part of the Napa River riverbed. This section benefits from an abundance of minerals and rocks left behind that makes it distinct from the surrounding terroir. Medium- to full-bodied and approachable in its youth, this wine features notes of sweet tobacco, spearmint, and ripe red fruit with opulent and soft, rounded tannins.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Lots of classic darker, herbal notes define the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer Georges III Vineyard, a rich, medium to full-bodied Cabernet Sauvignon from winemaker Thomas Rivers Brown. With air, more chocolate, espresso, and spice notes emerge from the glass, and this medium to full-bodied, textured, ripe, yet also elegant 2019 is going to drink brilliantly for another 20 years or so. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A rock-solid Cabernet, with cassis and dark plum stitched together with dusty earth and iron notes, all set into an alder and savory frame. Grippy back end, but the fruit keeps pace and there's a buried violet note for purity. Best from 2023 through 2036.

schrader-giii-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.title: Schrader Beckstoffer Georges III Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
schrader-giii-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.bodyHtml:
Sourced from the Beckstoffer Georges III Vineyard in Rutherford, this wine is produced from 100% Clone 337 Cabernet Sauvignon. The grapes originated from a specific section of the vineyard that was formerly part of the Napa River riverbed. This section benefits from an abundance of minerals and rocks left behind that makes it distinct from the surrounding terroir. Medium- to full-bodied and approachable in its youth, this wine features notes of sweet tobacco, spearmint, and ripe red fruit with opulent and soft, rounded tannins.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Lots of classic darker, herbal notes define the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer Georges III Vineyard, a rich, medium to full-bodied Cabernet Sauvignon from winemaker Thomas Rivers Brown. With air, more chocolate, espresso, and spice notes emerge from the glass, and this medium to full-bodied, textured, ripe, yet also elegant 2019 is going to drink brilliantly for another 20 years or so. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A rock-solid Cabernet, with cassis and dark plum stitched together with dusty earth and iron notes, all set into an alder and savory frame. Grippy back end, but the fruit keeps pace and there's a buried violet note for purity. Best from 2023 through 2036.

schrader-ccs-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.title: Schrader CCS Beckstoffer To Kalon Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
schrader-ccs-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.bodyHtml:
Extraordinarily rich and inky dark, the opulent 2019 Schrader CCS is loaded with gobs of ultra-ripe blue and black fruit aromas and flavors. Summer-picked blackberries, boysenberries, wild blueberries, and plum preserves abound and are layered with alluring notes of violets, black truffles, sweet earth, graphite, and fruitcake spice. Offering lavish fruit character, fine structure, and silky-smooth tannins, the 2019 Schrader CCS carries forward the tradition of excellence for the marque as one of the most honored and adored wines in our portfolio.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

Throws off a range of sassafras, chaparral and anise aromas before yielding up a prodigious core of açaí berry, plum and blackberry compote. Offers a great power/purity interplay throughout, with tarry violet and loamy incense accents. While tannic through the finish, this also reveals a subtle ripple of acidity and a hint of iron. Terrific. Best from 2024 through 2040.

98 Points - Robert Parker's The Wine Advocate

Sourced from Block C1 (planted to Clone 4), the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon CCS Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard, like all the other Schrader wines, matured in 100% new French oak from Darnajou and Taransaud. Hugely concentrated black cherries are joined by dried spices, slightly peppery notes and cedar on the nose, while the palate is full-bodied and plush yet firm at its core. It's a well-rounded, elegant example of Oakville Cabernet, nicely balanced, with attractive notions of blueberry and mint on the lengthy finish.
98 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of mint, eucalyptus, crushed blackcurrants and lead pencil follow through to a full body with dark fruit and mint on the palate. Velvety tannins and a long finish. Fantastic structure. Savory. Minerally. Drinkable now, but this will age really beautifully.

schrader-old-sparky-2018.title: Schrader Old Sparky Beckstoffer To Kalon Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 1.5L Magnum
schrader-old-sparky-2018.bodyHtml:
Blended from the finest barrels of Cabernet in the cellar, Schrader Old Sparky is a wine for the ages. Magnificent and important, it reveals an extraordinarily dense fruit core, especially blackberries and blueberries, layered with gorgeous notes of dark chocolate, roasted coffee, sweet earth, and cedar. Profoundly rich, the purity and concentration of this wine is legendary. The well-woven tannins provide great texture and natural acidity that perfectly support the broad volume of fruit. The 2018 vintage is extraordinary and will continue to evolve and gain further complexity with time in the cellar.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Produced predominately from clone 4, as always, the “Old Sparky” label is a best barrel selection from Beckstoffer's To Kalon vineyard in Oakville. The 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Old Sparky Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard was aged in 100% new Darnajou and Taransaud French oak barrels for 18 months. Deep garnet-purple in color, it needs a little coaxing to begin to reveal fragrant notions of crushed black currants, mulberries, juicy red and black plums and lilacs with hints of dark chocolate, rose oil and tilled soil plus a waft of unsmoked cigars. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is rich yet not at all heavy, featuring loads of bright red fruit accents among the profound black berry and savory elements. Multilayered, shimmering with energy and beautifully perfumed, it has gorgeous, ripe, plush tannins and a lively backbone, finishing very long and mineral laced. Bottled in magnums, 418 nine-liter cases were made.


100 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

There are few vintages of Old Sparky that don't merit a perfect rating, and the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard Old Sparky isn't one of them. This flawless wine offers up a wild smorgasbord of aromas and flavors, with loads of crème de cassis, blueberries, scorched earth, lead pencil, violets, blood orange, tobacco, and flowery incense all developing with time in the glass. Deep purple-hued and incredibly full-bodied, it has ripe, silky tannins, perfect balance, and a finish that won't quit. This magical wine stays weightless and elegant on the palate, never seeming heavy, cumbersome, or over the top, and it's a wine that just begs to be drunk yet will evolve for decades. Hats off to winemaker Thomas Rivers Brown for yet another heavenly Napa Cabernet Sauvignon that could come from nowhere else in the world. Life is too short not to have experienced this cuvée!

99 Points - James Suckling

A great expression of cabernet sauvignon. Full-bodied with notes of crushed berries and nuts. Well balanced,with great quality to the tannins and pleasant acidity. The structure and texture are in harmony, leading to a long, flavorful finish. Shows wonderful length and beauty. Goes on and on. Needs at least five years to mellow.

schrader-sparky-2019.title: Schrader Old Sparky Beckstoffer To Kalon Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 1.5L Magnum
schrader-sparky-2019.bodyHtml:
Garnet-purple and inky opaque, the wine delivers a perfumed cavalcade of ripe blackberry, black currant, and mixed plum aromas complemented by enticing notes of warmed earth, savory, aged tobacco leaf, pencil lead, anise, floral incense, and mandarin orange. Full-bodied and generous, the massive fruit core is beautifully supported by the well woven tannins, great balance, and fine acidity. This silky-smooth, polished wine glides seamlessly across the palate and continues to expand and enchant throughout the very long, satisfying finish.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A selection put together by winemaker Thomas Rivers Brown, the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard Old Sparky is one of the true gems in the vintage, as well as a perfect wine. Thrilling black fruits, crème de cassis, tobacco, tapenade, and iron notes all emerge from the glass, and it's full-bodied and has a similar purity to the CCS release, with ultra-fine tannins and one hell of an incredible finish. Napa Valley Cabernet, or red wine for that matter, doesn't get any better. Give bottles 2-4 years, count yourself lucky, and enjoy over the following two decades or more.
99 Points - James Suckling
Really deep, yet scented, with dark spices, minerals, flower extract, black tea, graphite, pine needle, sandalwood, incense and purple fruit. There is a linear quality to the immaculate tannins, which are dense, but delivered in a melted, chocolatey way, cutting through from the entry to the finish. So svelte and cocoa-powdery in the finish, giving it attractive savoriness. Very ripe and extremely long and precise. Drinkable now, but better after 2025.

opus-one-2019.title: Opus One Overture 2022
opus-one-2019.bodyHtml: Overture 2022 captivates you from the start. Its aromatic profile weaves a complex tapestry of bright cherry, fresh forest berries, and cut rose stems interwoven with delicate scents of violets, toasted almond, and anise. Blackberry, blueberry, and wild cherry take the lead on the palate with a lively acidity that adds a vibrant edge. The finish is long and rounded, with a touch of mocha and black tea that showcase the wine’s depth. This expression of selected parcels from our estate vineyards will age gracefully for years to come.

benromach-40-year-old-2022.title: Benromach 40 Year Old 2022 Release Batch 2
benromach-40-year-old-2022.bodyHtml:
Benromach 40 Year Old 2022 Release Batch 2 is an exceptionally old Speyside single malt from the Benromach distillery in Forres, produced, distilled, matured and bottled in Scotland by The Benromach Distillery Company. It spent four decades in oak casks before being bottled at 56.5% ABV, and this second batch of the 2022 release was limited to just 1,098 bottles of 700ml, each presented in a wooden case. The batch label describes a fruit-and-spice character, with ripe red apple and clove on the nose alongside tangerine peel and a waxy, beeswax-polish note, followed by orange oil, black pepper and raspberry compote on the palate. A rare collector's bottling to be savoured slowly.

Tasting Notes: Red apple, clove, tangerine peel, beeswax, orange oil, black pepper, raspberry compote, festive spice

Nose: Ripe red apple and fragrant clove, opening into tangerine peel and a subtle beeswax polish.

Palate: Orange oil and peppery spice with raspberry compote.

Finish: Long, with warming festive spices.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass; add a few drops of water to taste.

arca-x-2016-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Arca X Cabernet Sauvignon 2016
arca-x-2016-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
ARCA X presents a firm and powerful tannic structure, artfully bringing together the intensity of New American Oak, and signature Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon character. 2016 was an exceptional year in Napa Valley, with a long growing season, and excellent fruit ripeness. Although drinking well now, sources agree this vintage is very well suited to holding in your cellar.

Ripe cassis and dark fruits are accompanied by layers of dark chocolate, anise, and toasted oak, with a beautiful elegance and balance. Pair with washed rind, raw milk cheeses, grilled beef, and wild game.

arca-v-2016-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Arca V Cabernet Sauvignon 2016 750ml
arca-v-2016-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: The ARCA V 2016 Cabernet Sauvignon is a wine that boasts a rich and complex flavor profile. This wine is made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon grapes that are grown in Napa Valley, which is known for producing some of the finest wines in the world. The grapes are hand-picked and fermented in small batches to ensure that the wine's unique character is captured. The wine is then aged for 24 months in oak barrels, which gives it a smooth, full-bodied finish with notes of black cherry, cassis, and vanilla.

napa-cellars-cabernet.title: Napa Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
napa-cellars-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Napa Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is an approachable, full-bodied, and classic expression of Napa Valley hillside and valley floor viticulture. Sourced from premier vineyard sites across the valley—including St. Helena, Oak Knoll, and Atlas Peak—this 100% Cabernet Sauvignon pours a deep ruby-purple color. The highly inviting nose displays classic aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, and black plum, intermingled with sweet nuances of molasses, cocoa, and cedar box. On the palate, it delivers a generous core of juicy dark fruits, baking spices, and black pepper, supported by a refreshing natural acidity. Having been aged for 21 months in French oak barrels, its rich texture is beautifully structured by supple, easygoing tannins that lead into a smooth, velvety, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with port-braised beef short ribs, a grilled ribeye steak with truffle butter, gourmet wood-fired bacon cheeseburgers, or a savory mushroom ragût.

90 Points - James Suckling

A less-expensive choice in Napa cabernet that punches the right buttons. This offers bold, fresh black fruit and spicy oak aromas, then a full body backed by firm tannins. Black cherries, blackcurrants, cedar, chocolate, black pepper and cinnamon on the palate.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Sweet black fruits, both spiced and dripping ripe, join with textural tannin for an ample Cabernet Sauvignon.

napa-cellars-chardonnay.title: Napa Cellars Chardonnay 2023
napa-cellars-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Napa Cellars Chardonnay 2023 is a classic, vibrant, and beautifully balanced California white wine that captures the unique terroirs of the Napa Valley floor and its cooler southern AVAs. Pouring a clear, pale straw-gold, it opens with an inviting and highly expressive nose of baked Fuji apple, fresh white peach, and lemon curd, elegantly underpinned by nuances of toasted brioche, warm vanilla bean, and a sweet hint of clove. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Chardonnay is creamy and well-textured, delivering a rich core of ripe pear and tropical fruit flavors that are neatly elevated by a crisp, bright vein of integrated natural acidity. Having undergone partial malolactic fermentation and careful aging in French oak barrels, it moves seamlessly across the tongue into a clean, smooth, and persistent finish layered with subtle notes of pastry crust and toasted hazelnuts.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken breast with tarragon cream sauce, rich Dungeness crab cakes, or creamy fettuccine Alfredo.

90 Points - James Suckling

Ripe aromas of yellow peaches, baked apples, lemon curd and toasted spices. The palate is creamy and rounded, with soft acidity and layers of orchard fruit and oak. Easy and smooth. Drink now.

g-m-connoisseurs-choice-linkwood-1991.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Linkwood 30 Year Old 1991 Refill Sherry Hogshead 56.7% ABV
g-m-connoisseurs-choice-linkwood-1991.bodyHtml:
This Linkwood 1991 is a 30 year old Speyside single malt from Gordon & MacPhail's Connoisseurs Choice range, matured for three decades in a refill sherry hogshead and bottled at 56.7% ABV. It was bottled for Moonbroch. Connoisseurs Choice was launched by Gordon & MacPhail in 1968, when few distilleries bottled their own single malts, to showcase whiskies from distilleries across Scotland, and the Elgin-based family firm is known for filling its own casks with new make rather than only buying mature stock. Here the sherry wood brings stewed fruit, fruitcake and spice to the Speyside spirit. This listing is the 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Sherry, black pepper, orange peel, fruitcake and forest fruit.

Nose: Sherry aromas balanced by cracked black pepper and orange peel.

Palate: Sweet stewed fruit gives way to chilli spice, rich fruitcake and blackcurrant.

Finish: Full, with lingering spice and forest fruit.

Serve: Neat; a few drops of water will open it up at this strength.

bushmills-12-year-old-irish-whiskey.title: Bushmills 12 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bushmills-12-year-old-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml: Our Bushmills 12 Year Old is a marriage of single malts matured for a minimum of 12 years in hand-selected Oloroso sherry butts and bourbon barrels, including a finish of six months in marsala barriques. These dark, sweet Italian fortified wine casks impart further succulent spiced dried fruit notes and a decadent honey sweetness.

laphroaig-34-ian-hunter-4.title: Laphroaig 34 Year Old Ian Hunter Story Book 4 Malt Master
laphroaig-34-ian-hunter-4.bodyHtml:
This is the man who shaped us, built us, into what we are today. Ian Hunter resides in the soul of our whisky, and in the Laphroaig Ian Hunter Book 4: Malt Master, we honour his memory with a whisky every bit as rare and distinctive as him. Book 4: Malt Master is a tribute to Hunter’s love for being boldly different, this is a whisky with real character born of the signature Laphroaig peat.

  • Aged for 34 years
  • Matured in ex-Bourbon barrels and Oloroso Sherry casks
  • Signature American white oak casks
  • Limited edition
  • Collectable aged whisky
  • Fourth installment in the Ian Hunter series

IAN HUNTER HISTORY

Ian Hunter is the man who made Laphroaig what it is today. He was an uncommon soul, with his own distinct manners and moods, not too unlike the whisky he gave to the world. We honour his memory with this series of rare and collectable aged whiskies in his name. Book 4: Malt Master, the latest in our limited series, celebrates Ian Hunter’s establishing of our malting floors and his legacy as the Malt Master of Laphroaig.

 

Ian secured the distillery’s lease in 1922, broke into America in the time of Prohibition, was the catalyst for a revolution in the use of American White Oak and is the reason why we are still among a handful of distilleries to maintain our own malting floors today. He put his heart and soul into ensuring Laphroaig was a whisky like no other.

flat-rock-gravity-pinot-noir.title: Flat Rock Cellars Gravity Pinot Noir 2020 750ml
flat-rock-gravity-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: The Flat Rock Cellars Gravity Pinot Noir 2020 is a full-bodied red wine with notes of red and dark fruit, spice, and earth. It has a distinct intensity of fruit on the palate, with flavors matching the aromas and a long, lingering finish. It's a wine that showcases ageing potential, with grippy tannins that soften with time in the glass.

signorello-hopes-cuvee-chardonnay.title: Signorello Estate Chardonnay Hope's Cuvee 2019 750ml
signorello-hopes-cuvee-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Signorello Estate Hope's Cuvée Chardonnay 2019 is a single-block, estate-grown Chardonnay from Napa Valley. The wine comes from a five-acre parcel first planted in 1980 and has been bottled separately for some 35 years. The fruit is picked in several passes according to vine age, clone and ripeness, then whole-cluster pressed and fermented in oak barrels with native yeast. The wine rests on its lees with occasional stirring and is bottled unfined and unfiltered to keep its density and concentration. 750ml, 14.6% ABV.

2012-seven-stones-row-128-merlot.title: Emmolo Merlot 2022
2012-seven-stones-row-128-merlot.bodyHtml:
Emmolo Merlot 2022 is a captivating, richly styled Napa Valley red wine crafted by winemaker Jenny Wagner. Defying the softer, traditional expectations of the varietal, this exceptional wine is sourced from vineyards with light, gravelly soils to achieve extended hang time, full ripeness, and maximum concentration. In the glass, it reveals a deep, almost impenetrable dark ruby hue. The highly expressive bouquet opens with inviting aromas of cocktail cherries, ripe blackberries, and sweet plums, elegantly layered with complex notes of newly oiled leather, mocha, and pronounced French oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, opulent, and sumptuously smooth, delivering a luscious core of dark berry compote, cassis, and savory baking spice. This rich, generously fruit-forward profile is perfectly balanced by an underlying fresh earthiness and fine, powdery tannins, culminating in a lush, highly persistent finish laced with toasted oak and vanilla.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with savory mushroom risotto, hearty grilled sausages, roasted pork chops, rich eggplant parmesan, and rustic ratatouille.

drouhin-macon-villages-blanc.title: Joseph Drouhin Macon-Villages 2023
drouhin-macon-villages-blanc.bodyHtml:
The Joseph Drouhin Mâcon-Villages 2023 is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex Old World white wine that beautifully showcases the sunny concentration and natural aromatic precision of this remarkably warm vintage. It pours a bright, limpid pale gold colour in the glass, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of white flowers, crisp green apples, and fresh citrus blossoms, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of ripe yellow fruits, wild honey, and delicate mineral flint. On the palate, this medium-bodied Chardonnay is remarkably smooth, direct, and straightforward, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of fresh pear, lemon curd, and a vibrant, juicy fruit crunch that mirrors the sensation of biting straight into a grape. Vinified entirely in stainless steel tanks and aged on its fine lees to preserve its natural vivacity and finesse, it is driven by a finely balanced, food-friendly acidity and a super-sleek texture that carries into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by a lingering touch of chalky limestone salinity.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of fresh or refined culinary choices, including pan-seared trout amandine, delicate salmon omelets, grilled white fish, roasted chicken or turkey breast, fresh seafood salads, light pasta dishes, and artisanal soft French cheeses like goat cheese or young Comté.

perinet-doq-priorat.title: Perinet Priorat 2016 750ml
perinet-doq-priorat.bodyHtml: Perinet 2016 is the flagship red of Perinet, a Priorat winery set between Poboleda, Porrera and La Morera de Montsant, with a modernist cellar inspired by Gaudí. The wine is a blend of old-vine Garnacha with Merlot, Syrah and Cariñena, grown on the region's slate llicorella soils under a Mediterranean climate and bottled under the Priorat DOQ, one of only two qualified appellations in Spain. Winemaker Toni Sánchez Ortiz leads the estate. Wine Review Online rated the 2016 95 points, praising its power, palate weight and length and recommending a further six to ten years in the cellar from early 2020. 750ml.

piccini-brunello-di-montalcino-docg.title: Piccini Brunello di Montalcino
piccini-brunello-di-montalcino-docg.bodyHtml:
Deep ruby red in color, this Brunello di Montalcino offers aromas of ripe cherry, plum, violet, tobacco, leather, and sweet spice. The palate is full-bodied and structured with layers of red and dark fruit, earthy complexity, and refined tannins balanced by vibrant acidity. The finish is long, elegant, and beautifully persistent.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with braised beef, lamb shanks, wild game, truffle dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged Pecorino cheese.

sandhill-small-lots-three.title: Sandhill Small Lots Three 2018
sandhill-small-lots-three.bodyHtml: Bright ruby red colour with a bouquet of red cherry and notes of tea leaves, oak and sweet spice. This medium to full-bodied wine has notes of red plum and raspberry along with a touch of leather that complement its bright acidity, silky tannins and long finish.

gruner-veltliner-smaragd-terrassen.title: Domane Wachau Terrassen Smaragd Gruner Veltliner 2022
gruner-veltliner-smaragd-terrassen.bodyHtml:
Domäne Wachau Terrassen Smaragd Grüner Veltliner 2022 is an incredibly elegant, mineral-driven, and complex dry white wine produced by the renowned cooperative Domäne Wachau. Sourced from a selection of steep, hand-harvested terraced vineyards scattered along the Danube River between Loiben and Spitz, this wine is the quintessential expression of the Wachau region's primary rock soils and unique microclimate. On the nose, it is highly expressive and welcoming, releasing layered aromas of ripe yellow apples, white peaches, and fresh citrus peel, all underpinned by white pepper spice and a subtle hint of smoky tobacco. The palate is powerful, concentrated, and beautifully balanced, highlighting vibrant, refreshing acidity, juicy exotic fruit flavors, and a salty, lingering mineral finish that offers superb tension.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with Wiener Schnitzel, roasted pork with cabbage, characterful Mediterranean seafood paella, grilled white fish, or spicy Thai Satay chicken skewers.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Very crunchy and bright, with grapefruit and ripe pear flavors that are piercing in their intensity, this features expressive, spicy notes that carry through to the minerally finish.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Displays a beautiful mix of fruit and earth, with its savory beam of tarragon, celery root and salty mineral notes infusing a tasty core of apple and nectarine flavors, while subtle, chalky tannins give shape. Mouthcoating and pure, with lemon zest and floral high notes echoing on the refined finish. Drink now through 2028.

riviere-chateau-smith-haut-lafite-2018.title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild 2018
riviere-chateau-smith-haut-lafite-2018.bodyHtml:
Chateau Lafite Rothschild is one of the world's most iconic Bordeaux wines, celebrated for its extraordinary elegance, precision, and longevity. Aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, cedar, graphite, violet, cigar box, and fine spice unfold into a seamless palate with silky tannins, exceptional depth, and a remarkably persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, or aged Comte for an unforgettable First Growth Bordeaux experience.

 

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Château Lafite Rothschild is blended from 91% Cabernet Sauvignon, 8.5% Merlot and 0.5% Petit Verdot and has 13.3% alcohol. Deep purple-black in color, it needs a fair bit of swirling to unlock intoxicating scents of blackcurrant cordial, baked plums and black cherry compote with an undercurrent of dark chocolate, licorice, cast-iron pan, cedar chest and fertile loam, plus a waft of pencil lead. The delicately crafted, medium-bodied palate is dripping with class, featuring layers of mineral-laced black fruits and exquisitely ripe, singularly Lafite tannins, finishing with epic length and depth. This simply stunning, delicately crafted expression of the 2018 vintage, with its singularly evocative imprint of Lafite, will require a good 7–8 years in bottle, then should continue to inspire awe over the following 40+ years.

99 Points - James Suckling

Wow. The aromas are so intense and refined at the same time, offering gorgeous blackcurrant, lead pencil and orchid character. Such purity of fruit. Sleek and finely polished, with a fine cut to the tannins that provides such grace and glamour. Yet it’s got the power and structure to age for decades. On and on. Try after 2029.

98 Points - Decanter

This stood out during en primeur, not just for itself but also in comparison to so many estates around it. While several properties had an unusual vintage, where their personalities were subverted by the weather conditions, Lafite just continued being Lafite—a true mark of its character and terroir. This is still, of course, extremely young, keeping its cards close to its chest; the power for now is hidden, waiting, and will slowly unveil. This is going to be a beautiful Lafite in the future, a brilliant wine with bilberry, slate, pencil lead and eucalyptus mint character.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Checking in as a blend of 91% Cabernet Sauvignon, 8.5% Merlot and 0.5% Petit Verdot, the 2018 Château Lafite Rothschild is one of those magical Lafites that offers an already upfront, complex, nuanced style yet has the class and balance to evolve for 40–50 years. As always, this wine is never about sheer power, and the 2018 offers a full-bodied, incredibly elegant and weightless style that carries textbook blackcurrant fruit, lead pencil shavings, green tobacco, cedarwood and camphor aromas and flavors. I compared this wine to a more elegant version of the 2016 from barrel, and I think that comparison still holds. Incredibly upfront and charming, and already drinkable with sweet tannins, it will unquestionably pick up more complexity and nuance over the coming 4–6 years. It should hit maturity around age 10 and evolve for 75 years or more given its perfect balance. This is a beautiful, quintessential Lafite that exudes elegance and charm.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Very pure, with a sleek and extremely focused beam of cassis, black cherry purée and blackberry preserves streaming through, lined along the edges with savory, sweet bay leaf and black tea details. Those extra notes assert themselves through the finish, but without intruding too much on the fruit, letting it play out over a long iron spine. Hums with precision. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Petit Verdot. Best from 2030 through 2045.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Named after a hamlet on the Lafite estate, this new creation from Château Lafite Rothschild comes from selected parcels of the vineyard. It is a rich wine, worthy of both the vintage and the estate. Balancing elegance with ripe black currant fruit, the wine is restrained and has good aging potential.

forman-vineyard-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Black Stallion Gaspare Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
forman-vineyard-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The Gaspare Estate Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon is an elegant and powerful wine that is iconic of the Oak Knoll District. The aromas of blackberry and blueberry also have a note of brown sugar and cedar. The flavors are dark fruit with ripe, fruit sweetness. The structure of this wine is balanced with tannins that are robust, but not too aggressive.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This tempting, concentrated yet well-structured wine packs abundant black cherries, black olives, rosemary and dark chocolate flavors into a velvety, strong frame of tannins and subtle acidity that holds it rather tightly. It should drink best from 2028–2040.

91 Points - James Suckling

Notes of toasted spices, black coffee and chocolate with dark plums and blackberries. Medium- to full-bodied with sleek tannins and a juicy dark-berry backbone. Tasty and firm at the end.

decero-syrah-remolinos-vineyard.title: Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Syrah 2021
decero-syrah-remolinos-vineyard.bodyHtml:
Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Syrah 2021 is a highly precise, elegant, and aromatically complex high-altitude red wine sourced exclusively from the single-vineyard Remolinos Vineyard in Alto Agrelo. Named after the "remolinos" (tiny whirlwinds) that weave through the vines to provide a natural cooling effect, this Syrah thrives in sandy, calcareous soils at an elevation of 3,500 feet. The 2021 vintage highlights a cooler growing season, yielding a wine of immense freshness and varietal typicity rather than jammy weight. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of wild blackberries, dark cherries, and lavender, beautifully accented by classic notes of cracked black pepper, savory dried herbs, and a subtle hint of smoked meat. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and texturally silky, featuring a focused core of dark forest fruits, supple, fine-grained tannins, and a vibrant line of natural acidity. Maturation for 14 months in French oak barrels provides excellent polish and structural depth, carrying into a long, clean finish with a persistent mineral undertone.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with rosemary-infused roasted lamb chops, slow-cooked wild boar stew, grilled ribeye steak with garlic butter, and mature semi-hard cheeses.

decero-amano-remolinos-vineyard.title: Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Amano 2020
decero-amano-remolinos-vineyard.bodyHtml:
Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Amano 2020 is an exceptional, icon red blend produced by Finca Decero in the Agrelo subregion of Mendoza's Luján de Cuyo. Sourced entirely from the single-vineyard Remolinos Estate, named after the unique micro-whirlwinds that cool the vines, this flagship wine is crafted only in optimal vintages from a hand-selected blend of Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, and Tannat. In the glass, it displays a deep, dark violet color. The nose opens with an alluring, complex bouquet of dark plums, black cherries, wild blueberries, violet florals, and subtle notes of graphite, cedar, and dark cocoa. On the palate, it is rich, full-bodied, and layered, delivering ripe dark fruit flavors underpinned by fine-grained tannins, fresh acidity, and a long, structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steak, roasted leg of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison stews, and aged hard cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

This has aromas of toasted nuts, blackberries, blackcurrants, roasted peppers, cedar and chocolate. Full-bodied, polished and firm, with gently chewy tannins and a toasty finish. 62% malbec, 31% cabernet sauvignon, 4% petit verdot and 3% tannat. Better from 2024.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The winery's top wine is a full-bodied blend of Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon and a splash of other red varieties. It starts with light notes of vanilla and herbs. The palate shows a good amount of red and black fruity flavors that mix with black pepper, chocolate and rosemary. Enough acidity adds freshness amid the warm vintage.

chateau-beychevelle-st-julien-cc.title: Chateau Beychevelle Amiral de Beychevelle 2015
chateau-beychevelle-st-julien-cc.bodyHtml:
Amiral de Beychevelle is the second wine of Chateau Beychevelle, offering a more immediate expression of its Saint-Julien character. Floral and spicy aromas accompany vibrant fruit, freshness and natural balance. The palate combines structured yet silky tannins with elegance and enough depth to support graceful bottle ageing.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roast lamb, grilled beef, duck breast, mushroom dishes, or aged hard cheeses.

 

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The second wine from the Saint-Julien estate, this is every bit as elegant as the grand vin, its black currant fruit developing to envelop the fine tannins. There is fine fruit, plenty of acidity and a rich texture. It needs time, so drink from 2020. - Roger Voss

92 Points - James Suckling

There's a wealth of cedar and attractive earthy aromas with blackberry and mulberry fruits laced in oak spices. The palate has a sleek, polished and crisp feel with a core of warm oak spices and deep-set dark plums all nicely resolved. Second wine of Chateau Beychevelle. Try from 2021.

perrin-chateauneuf-du-pape-les-sinards.title: Famille Perrin Chateauneuf-du-Pape Les Sinards 2021/2022
perrin-chateauneuf-du-pape-les-sinards.bodyHtml:
Beautiful garnet-red colour with shiny reflections. The nose reveals a complex and warm aromatic bouquet with notes of leather. The palate is elegant with delicious aromas of dried fruit, dates, dried figs and candied grapes with a long finish.

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Blackberries, spicy garrigue, herbes de Provence, and some peppery nuances all emerge from the 2022 Châteauneuf Du Pape Les Sinards, a medium-bodied, supple, elegant red with tons of character.

black-hills-alibi.title: Black Hills Hiatus Collection Bona Fide

chateau-potensac-medoc-cru-bourg.title: Chateau Potensac 2018/2019
chateau-potensac-medoc-cru-bourg.bodyHtml:
Château Potensac is often cited as the quintessential expression of the "pure Médoc style," known for its exceptional aging potential and structured elegance. The wine displays a deep ruby-garnet colour and an aromatic profile of ripe blackcurrants, cherries, and plums, layered with classic notes of tobacco, cedar, and savory herbs. On the palate, it is full-bodied and powerful, featuring a tight, dense texture and firm, spicy tannins balanced by a vibrant mineral freshness. Often compared to its prestigious sibling, Château Léoville-Las Cases, it offers a formal and refined character with a long, energetic finish marked by dark fruit and forest floor. Food Pairing: Perfectly complements classic meat dishes like roast beef, herb-crusted lamb rack, or pork tenderloin, as well as hearty mushroom risotto, lasagna, and aged cheeses such as Comté or sharp Cheddar.
