2018 Vintage Ratings:

94 Points - James Suckling

Fruity nose of blackcurrant and blueberry with sage and vanilla. It’s full-bodied with firm tannins. Savory and juicy with pleasant acidity. Compact and long. Racy. 45% merlot, 36% cabernet sauvignon,18% cabernet franc and 1% petit verdot. Try after 2023.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

The dark cherry and plum fruit is fresh and direct, with light tobacco and toast accents hanging on the finish.
Barrel Sample: 89-92
90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Potensac is composed of 45% Merlot, 36% Cabernet Sauvignon, 18% Cabernet Franc and 1% Petit Verdot. The wine has 14.42% alcohol and was aged in 35% new barriques. Medium to deep garnet-purple colored, it rolls out of the glass with open-knit scents of ripe, juicy black plums, boysenberries, redcurrant jelly and cassis, plus hints of dried Provence herbs, cinnamon stick and dusty soil. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is chock-full of lively black and red berry layers, supported by soft tannins and a racy line, finishing with a lively skip in its step.

2019 Vintage Ratings:

94 Points - James Suckling

Bright, with crushed-stone and floral character on the nose. Medium body with a firm core, expanding through the palate. Vivid and bright. Lots of good energy. Crushed-stone and lightly chalky character at the end. Needs two or three years to come around.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Always a dependable bottling, the 2019 Potensac opens in the glass with aromas of dark berries, cherries and pencil shavings. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and nicely concentrated, with lively acids and powdery tannins, the vintage has made for an unusually polished Potensac that will offer a broad drinking window. Best After 2025

chateau-chasse-spleen-cru-bourgois.title: Chateau Chasse Spleen 2022
chateau-chasse-spleen-cru-bourgois.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Château Chasse-Spleen is a classic and intensely structured Moulis, benefiting from a high-concentration vintage that produced small, flavor-dense berries. It presents a deep ruby-red hue and opens with a complex, primary bouquet of blackcurrant, Bing cherry, and blackberry, seamlessly layered with notes of pencil shavings, tobacco leaf, and subtle licorice spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and powerful, showcasing a "tightly knit" texture with firm, chalky tannins and a vibrant, saline acidity. Aged for 12 to 18 months in French oak (40% new), it delivers a long, precise finish with lingering impressions of graphite, dark fruit, and cocoa.

Food Pairing: Perfectly complements classic meat dishes such as roasted lamb, Bistecca alla Fiorentina, duck confit, or grilled portobello mushrooms with truffle oil.

94 Points - James Suckling

An excellent Chasse-Spleen that shows fine sweet spices and creamy yet vibrant plums and cassis. Lovely precision, with minerals and berries on the palate. Bright and refined, with dense, chalky tannins and a lengthy finish. Drink from 2027.

champagne-pierre-paillard.title: Champagne Pierre Paillard Bouzy  Grand Cru Les Parcelles XIX 750ml
champagne-pierre-paillard.bodyHtml: Champagne Pierre Paillard Brut Grand Cru is a sparkling wine from the Bouzy Grand Cru region of Champagne, France. It is known for its rich, ripe flavors, balanced acidity, and fresh minerality, with notes of yellow stone fruit and toasty almonds. The wine is produced by the Paillard family, who have been cultivating vineyards in Bouzy since 1768.

chateau-carbonnieux-pessac-leognan.title: Chateau Carbonnieux Pessac-Leognan 2018 750ml
chateau-carbonnieux-pessac-leognan.bodyHtml:
Pessac-Leognan Wine
Bordeaux, France
Recognized for its superior reds as well as whites, Pessac-Léognan on the Left Bank claims classified growths for both—making it quite unique in comparison to its neighboring Médoc properties.

Pessac’s Chateau Haut-Brion, the only first growth located outside of the Médoc, is said to have been the first to conceptualize fine red wine in Bordeaux back in the late 1600s. The estate, along with its high-esteemed neighbors, La Mission Haut-Brion, Les Carmes Haut-Brion, Pique-Caillou and Chateau Pape-Clément are today all but enveloped by the city of Bordeaux. The rest of the vineyards of Pessac-Léognan are in clearings of heavily forested area or abutting dense suburbs.

Arid sand and gravel on top of clay and limestone make the area unique and conducive to growing Sémillon and Sauvignon blanc as well as the grapes in the usual Left Bank red recipe: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and miniscule percentages of Petit Verdot and Malbec.

The best reds will show great force and finesse with inky blue and black fruit, mushroom, forest, tobacco, iodine and a smooth and intriguing texture.

Its best whites show complexity, longevity and no lack of exotic twists on citrus, tropical and stone fruit with pronounced floral and spice characteristics.
Bordeaux Blends
One of the world’s most classic and popular styles of red wine, Bordeaux-inspired blends have spread from their homeland in France to nearly every corner of the New World. Typically based on either Cabernet Sauvignon or Merlot and supported by Cabernet Franc, Malbec and Petit Verdot, the best of these are densely hued, fragrant, full of fruit and boast a structure that begs for cellar time. Somm Secret—Blends from Bordeaux are generally earthier compared to those from the New World, which tend to be fruit-dominant.

clos-du-soleil-signature-red-meritage.title: Clos du Soleil Signature 2019
clos-du-soleil-signature-red-meritage.bodyHtml:
Signature is our flagship blend of red Bordeaux varieties, produced by hand, and aged for 16 months in French oak barrels.

A delicate nose of pencil shavings, raspberry compote, cedar, blackberry and crushed black pepper. Beautifully integrated flavours of ripe raspberry and blackberry, notes of pomegranate and fig, hints of baking spices, followed by a long mineral-flecked finish.

tridente-tempranillo.title: Tridente Tempranillo 2021
tridente-tempranillo.bodyHtml:
Tempranillo grapes with which it is produced this wine are from very old vines with very little production in the areas of Villanueva de Campeán and El Pego, within the province of Zamora. These vineyards are generally planted on a top layer of gravel over very sandy soils. The fermentation was carried out in stainless steel tanks and then moved to french oak barrels for a period of 15 months.

Deep red cherry color with garnet edges, displaying intense and complex black fruits and apple jam aromas, cocoa and spices. On the palate, powerful and complex with high roast and coca notes, tasty, mouth filing and rounded tannins due to the long ageing, delight us with a long and silky aftertaste

Perfect to pair with game meat or creamy rices, stewed vegetables, mushrooms, game and poultry, casserole, smoked, blue and cured cheeses, grilled and/or barbecued white and red meat, roast lamb, pork or beef.

88 Points - Wine Spectator

A chewy, medium-bodied red, with hints of toast and smoke accenting flavors of baked black plum, olive, dried dill and anise. Drink now.

clos-du-soleil-celestiale.title: Clos Du Soleil Celestiale 2022
clos-du-soleil-celestiale.bodyHtml: Célestiale is Clos du Soleil’s Bordeaux blend that is soft and full of fruit with a classic and elegant structure. The taster is greeted with aromas of fresh ripe raspberries and blackberries, baking spices and forest underbrush. On the palate the wine is soft and layered, dominated by fresh ripe fruit flavours of raspberry, blackberry, and pomegranate, with more subtle notes of forest undergrowth and spice, with juicy acidity. This wine is both approachable and totally food-friendly, yet retains all of the complexity and depth to truly engage the taster,

riesling-eblin-fuchs-grand-cru-rosacker.title: Eblin Fuchs Alsace Grand Cru 'Rosacker' Riesling 2016 750ml

champ-guy-charlemagne-mesnillesime-blanc.title: Valentin Leflaive Le Mesnil Sur Oger Grand Cru Extra Brut
champ-guy-charlemagne-mesnillesime-blanc.bodyHtml:
Sourced from Grand Cru vineyards in Le Mesnil Sur Oger, this Blanc de Blancs Champagne shows citrus, green apple, and chalky minerality. The palate is precise and vibrant with fine mousse, crisp acidity, and a long, elegant finish reflecting purity and finesse.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, caviar, sushi, grilled seafood, and soft cheeses.

chartron-trebuchet-pouilly-fuisse.title: Chartron et Trebuchet Pouilly-Fuisse 2024
chartron-trebuchet-pouilly-fuisse.bodyHtml:
Chartron et Trébuchet Pouilly-Fuissé 2024 is an elegant, vibrant, and mineral-driven white Burgundy crafted by the historic house of Chartron et Trébuchet. Sourced from south-facing clay-limestone slopes flanking the iconic Jurassic limestone escarpments of the Roche de Solutré and Roche de Vergisson in the southern Mâconnais, the Chardonnay grapes benefit from abundant sunshine combined with cooling hillside breezes. After gentle pressing and temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel, the wine undergoes maturation in oak barrels with regular stirring on the lees to build texture and roundness while preserving freshness. In the glass, it displays a bright, pale gold color with shimmering green reflections. The nose opens with a fragrant bouquet of ripe Meyer lemon, green apple, white peach, and grapefruit, underpinned by nuances of white blossoms, roasted nuts, and flinty minerality. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance of richness and tension, marked by crisp orchard fruit, subtle toasted brioche, and a refreshing, limestone-etched mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster, roast chicken with tarragon cream sauce, grilled salmon, or aged goat cheeses.

maculan-fratta.title: Maculan Fratta 2017 750ml
maculan-fratta.bodyHtml: Maculan Fratta 2017 is the flagship red of the Maculan family winery in Breganze, in the Veneto hills. It blends Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot from two of the estate's best low-yielding vineyards: the Cabernet from a densely planted site of 10,000 vines per hectare at Ferrata, the Merlot from the Branza vineyard at Fratta, both on volcanic and tufa hillsides. The grapes are hand-picked and carefully sorted, then fermented in small steel vats with frequent punch-downs over eight days of maceration, and aged eighteen months in French oak barriques, 80% new. Maculan describes a deep ruby wine with violet tints, red berries, blueberry and raspberry, spice, cocoa and coffee, and sweet, well-integrated tannins. 750 ml, 14.5% alcohol.

le-piane-boca.title: Le Piane Boca 2017
le-piane-boca.bodyHtml:
Le Piane Boca 2017 is a majestic, deeply structured, and extraordinarily age-worthy Italian red wine from the volcanic hills of Alto Piemonte. Crafted primarily from 85% Nebbiolo (locally known as Spanna) and 15% Vespolina, the fruit is meticulously hand-harvested from mature vines rooted in rare, acidic porphyry volcanic gravel soils. Matured for up to 3 to 4 years in large oak casks, this vintage gracefully navigates a dry, warm growing year to deliver exceptional aromatic brilliance and a surprisingly weightless, elegant poise. In the glass, it reveals a translucent garnet-red hue with a light orange-tinged rim. The highly complex nose opens with expressive aromas of sour cherries, wild strawberries, and crushed rose petals, intricately layered with complex notes of sweet pipe tobacco, cedar wood, white pepper, and a soft touch of balsam. On the palate, it delivers deep, concentrated red fruit and savory spice flavors supported by a firm, finely woven grid of silky tannins and a bracing line of volcanic acidity, concluding with an exceptionally long, clean, and noble mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rustic wild mushroom risotto, slow-braised beef short ribs, roasted duck breast, or robustly mature Italian cheeses like Castelmagno.

rocche-costamagna-barolo-rocche-dellann.title: Roberto Voerzio Rocche Dell'Annunziata Torriglione Barolo 2011 750ml

guigal-gigondas.title: E. Guigal Gigondas 2019
guigal-gigondas.bodyHtml:
Gigondas 2020 presents a beautiful purplish robe, captivating at first glance. The nose is intense, showcasing dominant aromas of stone fruits, licorice, and delicate forest floor scents, creating a complex and inviting bouquet. The 2020 vintage in the Southern Rhône was marked by ideal ripening conditions, with warm days and cool nights lending remarkable balance and concentration to the wines. On the palate, it reveals itself as generous, powerful, and full-bodied, with a long and elegant finish that lingers gracefully. The attack is bold and refined, supported by well-integrated tannins that add structure and sophistication, making for a harmonious and memorable tasting experience.

  • 93 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

    Notes of cassis, mulberry, garrigue and sweet spices preface the 2020 Gigondas, a medium- to full-bodied, supple and charming wine with a layered, delicately tensile profile. It’s framed by fine-grained tannins and lifted by notes of pepper and spice, concluding with a firm, savory finish that hints at the presence of Mourvèdre. This is a beautifully balanced Gigondas with the depth and structure to evolve gracefully over the coming decade.

  • 92 Points James Suckling
    Here's an excellent introduction to Gigondas with the richness and spice, plus the ample tannins we expect from this appellation. Long, well-structured finish with excellent balance. A cuvee of 70% grenache, 20% syrah and 10% mourvedre that was aged completely in large oak foudre. Drink or hold.
  • 92 Points Wine Spectator
    A winey version, with steeped cherry and kirsch, this is ripe and broad, starting off glossy and then reined in by cashmere-fine tannins that give real textural framework. A modern, stylish, full-bodied red that's very well-executed, with roasted apple wood in the background. Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre. Drink now through 2030.
  • 91 Points Vinous
    Ripe strawberry, raspberry, cranberry, dried herbs and a touch of cedar introduce the 2020 Gigondas. Concentrated and expressive, the 2020 is a classic rendition of this red that’s going to drink well over the next five years. A savory finish of good length rounds it up.

tasca-rosso-del-conte.title: Tenuta Regaleali Rosso Del Conte 2012 750ml
tasca-rosso-del-conte.bodyHtml: Tenuta Regaleali Rosso del Conte 2012 is the flagship red of Tasca d'Almerita, from the family's Regaleali estate in the high hills of central Sicily. It comes from San Lucio, the first 'grande vigna' planted at Regaleali in 1959, where Nero d'Avola and Perricone grow side by side as bush vines at about 480 metres on loamy-sandy, slightly calcareous soil. Both varieties ripen late, and the estate notes that the wine is energetic when young and gains a velvety touch with age while keeping its structure. It is bottled under the Contea di Sclafani DOC. The 2012 was rated 93 points by Robert Parker's Wine Advocate. 750 ml, 14.5% ABV.

travaglini-gattinara-riserva.title: Travaglini Gattinara Riserva 2017
travaglini-gattinara-riserva.bodyHtml:
A powerful and age-worthy Nebbiolo showcasing aromas of crushed strawberry, wild berries, dried roses, herbs, and earthy spice. Full-bodied and structured, it delivers layers of red fruit, savory complexity, and firm tannins balanced by vibrant acidity, culminating in a long and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with braised beef, osso buco, venison, roast lamb, truffle dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses.

 

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Crushed strawberries, wild berries and wild herbs define the aromas of this northern Piedmont red from Gattinara. Mouthfilling with a bold tannic structure shaping the palate to yield fewer dried cherry flavors and more savory herbs and spiced tea on the lifted and earthy finish.

landmark-overlook-chardonnay.title: Wente Vineyards Morning Fog Chardonnay
landmark-overlook-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Wente Vineyards Morning Fog Chardonnay is a beautifully balanced, crisp, and expressive white wine named after the cooling maritime fog that rolls through the valley each morning. Crafted by America's oldest continuously operated, family-owned winery—the pioneers responsible for the legendary "Wente Clone" that defines California Chardonnay—this wine opens with enticing aromas of green apple, citrus blossom, and fresh-cut pear alongside a delicate hint of graham cracker. On the palate, a fruit-forward core of lemon curd, gala apple, and melon is beautifully integrated with subtle nuances of sweet cream, vanilla, and toasty oak derived from partial barrel fermentation. It finishes clean and refreshing with a lively, natural acidity and lingering stony minerality.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops with citrus butter, roasted chicken breast, grilled salmon, cream-based pasta dishes, steamed mussels, or mild cheese boards.

ramos-pinto-duas-quintas.title: Ramos Pinto Duas Quintas Tinto 2022
ramos-pinto-duas-quintas.bodyHtml:
Ramos Pinto Duas Quintas Tinto 2022 is a refined, expressive, and characterful Portuguese red wine originating from two distinct estates in the Upper Douro: Quinta de Ervamoira, bringing warmth, dense structure, and ripe fruit, and the high-elevation Quinta dos Bons Ares, providing freshness, floral aromatics, and vibrant acidity. In the glass, it displays a radiant, deep garnet-red hue with bright violet reflections. The bouquet is complex and inviting, revealing aromas of ripe plums, wild blackberries, and dark cherries, elegantly woven with nuances of sweet spice, tobacco leaf, menthol, and violet petals. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red offers a smooth, fleshy texture underpinned by fine-grained tannins, juicy blue and dark fruit flavors, and crisp natural acidity that culminates in a clean, persistent, and delicately spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted leg of lamb, grilled Iberian pork, duck rice, Portuguese beef stew, mushroom risotto, and cured sheep's milk cheeses.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

One of the original brands that heralded the renaissance of Douro wines in the 1990s, Duas Quintas comes from Quinta de Ervamoira and Quinta das Bons Ares, both owned by Ramos Pinto. This latest release is balanced and fruity, ripe with red berry fruits and generous tannins. A smoky aroma indicates the wood aging. Drink from 2026.

weinert-cavas-de-weinert.title: Bodega Y Cavas De Weinert Cask Selection 2012
weinert-cavas-de-weinert.bodyHtml:
Bodega y Cavas de Weinert Cask Selection 2012 is the winery's iconic flagship blend, crafted from old-vine fruit grown in Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza. A decade of maturation in large French oak casks develops remarkable complexity, revealing aromas of blackcurrant, ripe plum, cedar, cocoa, baking spice, leather, and tobacco. Rich yet impeccably balanced, the palate is framed by refined tannins and vibrant acidity, culminating in an elegant, exceptionally persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Wagyu ribeye, dry-aged striploin, braised beef short ribs, roast lamb, venison, aged Manchego, and wild mushroom risotto.

brocard-premiere-cru-montmains.title: Jean-Marc Brocard Chablis Premier Cru 'Montmains' 2023
brocard-premiere-cru-montmains.bodyHtml:
The Jean-Marc Brocard Chablis Premier Cru 'Montmains' 2023 is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex Old World white wine that beautifully captures the unique, fossil-rich Kimmeridgian clay and limestone soils of this iconic left-bank Premier Cru vineyard. It pours a brilliant white-gold colour with distinct green and silvery reflections in the glass, lifting with an immediate, aromatic bouquet of fresh citrus zest, green apples, and white orchard fruits, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of crushed flint, anise, aniseed, and a crisp marine ozone note. On the palate, this medium-bodied Chardonnay is remarkably poised, graceful, and smooth, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of ripe grapefruit, nectarine, and a dense, chalky core that balances the naturally sunny ripeness of the 2023 vintage. Partially matured in large oak foudres to enhance its structural depth and natural sophistication, it is driven by a finely balanced, food-friendly acidity and a racy, thirst-quenching tension that carries into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by a lingering touch of iodine and savory oyster-shell salinity.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of refined culinary options, including fresh or grilled oysters, pan-seared scallops, poached Atlantic lobster or crab with drawn butter, grilled white fish, roasted chicken or turkey breast in a light herb cream sauce, creamy wild mushroom risottos, and artisanal French cheeses like Comté or fresh goat cheese.

autumn-gold.title: Wild Goose Vineyards Autumn Gold White 2017
autumn-gold.bodyHtml:
Wild Goose Vineyards Autumn Gold White 2017 is an aromatic white blend from British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, combining Riesling, Gewürztraminer, and Pinot Blanc. This refreshing, off-dry wine offers inviting aromas of orchard fruits, citrus, and delicate florals, followed by flavours of ripe peach, spiced apple, and candied ginger. Its soft, rounded texture and crisp acidity create a beautifully balanced wine suited to casual gatherings, festive meals, and warm-weather enjoyment.

Food Pairing: Grilled salmon, roasted turkey, spicy Asian dishes, seafood, chicken, fresh salads, mild cheeses, and pan-fried dumplings.

luigi-bosca-cabernet.title: Luigi Bosca Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
luigi-bosca-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Luigi Bosca Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is an expressive, structured, and varietally pure Argentine red wine crafted by the historic Arizu family from estate vineyards in Mendoza. In the glass, it presents a deep and brilliant ruby-red hue with bright violet undertones. The nose is layered and perfumed, offering rich aromas of ripe black cherries, plums, and cassis, intermingled with nuances of black pepper, sweet paprika, dried herbs, fine tobacco, and a hint of leather. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, firm, and juicy, delivering concentrated dark berry and stone fruit flavors supported by fine-grained, grippy tannins and vibrant acidity that lead to a polished, long, and savory finish accented by subtle toasted oak and spice notes.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted venison loin, braised beef short ribs, hearty game dishes roasted with herbs, and aged hard cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Nicely fruity nose with ripe cherries, plums, ashes and a touch of paprika. Firm and juicy with lovely ripe fruit on the palate. Nice spices and herbs at the end. Drink now.

luigi-bosca-chardonnay.title: Luigi Bosca Chardonnay 2025
luigi-bosca-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
An elegant and expressive Chardonnay from Mendoza, Argentina. Aromas of ripe pear and apple mingle with delicate tropical fruit, citrus and floral notes. The palate is round and beautifully textured, with generous ripe fruit, refreshing acidity and a lively, balanced finish.

Food Pairing:
Excellent with seafood, grilled fish, shellfish, sushi, ceviche, roast or grilled chicken, creamy pasta dishes, fresh salads and soft cheeses.

Serving: Best served chilled.

luigi-bosca-pinot-noir.title: Luigi Bosca 'Insignia Collection' Pinot Noir 2025
luigi-bosca-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Luigi Bosca 'Insignia Collection' Pinot Noir 2025 is an elegant, vibrant, and fresh Argentine red wine sourced from naturally balanced, high-altitude vineyards in the Uco Valley. Displaying a bright ruby-red hue, it opens with delicate and expressive aromas of fresh red cherries, wild strawberries, and ripe raspberries, accented by subtle spicy, floral, and flinty nuances. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, supple, and finely textured, offering a clean, vivacious core of red fruit underpinned by lively natural acidity, silky tannins, and a persistent, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast, pan-seared salmon, grilled pork tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, roasted chicken, and soft creamy cheeses like Brie.

vasse-felix-filius-cabernet.title: Vasse Felix Filius Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
vasse-felix-filius-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Vasse Felix Filius Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 displays vibrant aromas of blackcurrant, blueberry, and crushed violet integrated with undertones of cedar, bay leaf, graphite, and subtle baking spice. On the palate, it delivers a medium-bodied, bright profile featuring concentrated dark berry flavors framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins, crisp acidity, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted lamb, grilled ribeye, venison, braised beef short ribs, mushroom risotto, and aged hard cheeses like Gouda.

94 Points - James Suckling

Abundant black-fruit aromas supported by spices, cedar, crushed stones and violets. The medium-bodied palate has a creamy texture and finely tuned, generous tannins with so much purity of fruit. Grown further away from the ocean with a more continental feel. Delicious and early-drinking yet serious. Drink or hold. Screw cap.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

An excellent intro to this famed Western Australian Cab style, this vintage is, compared to the previous two, on the richer, denser side. Supple dark berry fruit with salt-flecked herbs, seaweed savoriness and a dark chocolate underbelly are woven with powdery, chiseled tannins and tangy blackcurrant acidity. Drink now with plenty of protein or age for several more years.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A generous mix of kirsch, cassis and blackberry flavors is dense and dark, accented by notes of palo santo, tobacco and cardamom. The tannins are dense, and a grace note of malty Assam black tea lingers on the finish, with plenty of harmony and firming tannins. Drink now through 2032. 14,500 cases made, 2,000 cases imported.

woodward-canyon-merlot-columbia-valley.title: Kettle Valley Merlot 2022
woodward-canyon-merlot-columbia-valley.bodyHtml:
This Merlot comes from Brar Vineyard in Kaleden and McGraw Estate Vineyard in Naramata. Handpicked in October 2022, the fruit completed full malolactic fermentation before aging in French oak for 20 months, producing a structured expression of British Columbia Merlot.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with braised beef short ribs, roasted mushrooms, garlic potatoes, and aged cheddar.

nsg-les-terrasses-des-vallerots-machgra.title: Bertrand Machard De Gramont Nuits-Saint-Georges Les TerrassesDes Vallerots 2017 750ml
nsg-les-terrasses-des-vallerots-machgra.bodyHtml: Bertrand Machard De Gramont Nuits-Saint-Georges Les TerrassesDes Vallerots 2017 750ml

henry-pelham-sfr-baco-noir-vqa.title: Henry of Pelham 'Speck Family Reserve' Baco Noir 2022
henry-pelham-sfr-baco-noir-vqa.bodyHtml:
Henry of Pelham 'Speck Family Reserve' Baco Noir 2022 is an iconic, deeply expressive, and full-bodied Canadian red wine crafted from old vines planted on the Short Hills Bench in the Niagara Peninsula. Sourced from the Speck family's highest-quality estate blocks and aged in American oak barrels, it displays a dense, dark ruby-purple hue in the glass. The nose opens with vibrant aromas of ripe dark plum, crushed blackberry preserve, sweet cherry, and smoky vanilla, layered with nuances of baking spices, toasted cedar, and subtle black pepper. On the palate, it is smooth, supple, and mouth-coating, featuring concentrated black fruit flavors balanced by lively natural acidity, velvety tannins, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with barbecued ribs, braised short ribs, roasted duck breast, grilled venison steak, venison burgers, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.
tags: Henry of Pelham Family Estate Winery

macintyre-reserve-ardua.title: Macintyre Heritage Reserve Ardua 2018 750ml
macintyre-reserve-ardua.bodyHtml: MacIntyre Heritage Reserve Ardua 2018 is a Merlot-led red blend with Cabernet Franc from British Columbia, made under the MacIntyre Heritage Reserve label with Lake Breeze Vineyards. The producer describes Ardua as inspired by the great wines of Pomerol. Its notes are blackberry jam, ripe blueberry and blackcurrant at the core, with earthy notes, liquorice and an underlying herbal thread; the palate is full-bodied and generous, with a layered texture and a very long finish. The producer suggests decanting it to drink now or cellaring it for 10 to 15 years. 750ml, 15.5% ABV.

black-swift-vineyards-stones-throw-pinot.title: Cambria Julia's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021
black-swift-vineyards-stones-throw-pinot.bodyHtml:
Cambria Julia's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021 is an exceptionally expressive, elegant, and character-driven cool-climate red wine from the heart of Santa Barbara County. Sourced from its namesake estate vineyard—originally planted in 1972 on the ancient alluvial benchmarks of the Santa Maria Valley—this single-vineyard bottling benefits from a uniquely prolonged growing season shaped by consistent Pacific fog and ocean breezes. The fruit is carefully fermented and aged for several months in French oak barrels (a small portion being new) to beautifully synthesize structural depth with pristine varietal purity. In the glass, it reveals a brilliant, translucent ruby color. The highly aromatic and fragrant nose opens with radiant layers of ripe pomegranate, wild strawberries, and dark maraschino cherries, intricately woven with nuance of lavender, fresh rose petals, toasted sage, and a delicate hint of earthy underbrush. On the palate, this medium-bodied Pinot Noir is remarkably vibrant, sleek, and lively, driving juicy cran-raspberry and dark berry flavors over a framework of supple, fine-grained tannins and a crisp line of natural, refreshing acidity before culminating in a long, beautifully balanced, and subtly spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared duck breast, cedar-plank grilled salmon, rustic wild mushroom risotto, or herb-roasted pork tenderloin.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Tart and fresh aromas of red plum, strawberry and lightly toasted sage and marjoram draw the nose into this zesty, widely available bottling. The palate lands with pleasantly brisk cran-pom-raspberry flavors, as lavender and rose petal qualities add nuance.

penfolds-st-henri-shiraz-1.title: Penfolds St. Henri Shiraz 2020
penfolds-st-henri-shiraz-1.bodyHtml:
Penfolds St. Henri Shiraz is a garnet red with a dark purple core. The fruit profile is a delight, oak playing no role in the aromatics. Shiraz, unadulterated! The descriptors need to be coaxed from the glass with a gentle swirl. Fruits of the forest are first to emerge, berry conserve, strawberry flan and rhubarb tart. There is a hit of confectionary, reminiscent of red glace cherries. Savory notes include German Blutwurst spiced sausage, pan scrapings from roast lamb and salt cured beef with black peppercorns. Ferric notes of iron filings and whetstone swarf round out an impressive showing. True to form, the palate is quite savory. Japanese nori paper and olive brine offer a very morish umami nuance. Fresh blueberry and mulberry leaf anchor the core of the mid-palate. Exotic spices adding intrigue, Alleppey turmeric, toasted cumin, pimento. The tannins are very tactile, comparable to Dutch cocoa. A classic St Henri that will reward extended time in the cellar.
95 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Plush, rich and perfumed, the 2020 St. Henri shows intensity and layers of aromas from blackberry jam and plum to roasted root veg seasonings such as ground pepper, sage and fennel seed. The plush palate is harmonious, with concentrated fruit and powerful, chalky tannins. Still in its infancy, this is a classic choice for the cellar and should age gracefully for many decades to come.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Stunning for its intensity and appealing for its density and purity of fruit flavors, this red features huckleberry, marionberry and wild blackberry notes at the core, with details of salted black licorice, toasted cumin, bittersweet chocolate and gingerbread, backed by perfumed notes of violet and lavender that linger on the finish, where the tannins have an appealing grip. Drink now through 2039.

94 Points - James Suckling

Dense, dank and brooding. A very warm vintage, serving an incantation of licorice strap, clove, camphor, dried nori and a spicy backdrop to a flood of dark, saturated fruits. Often the cuvee that I prefer most, however the tannins in this instance are more four-square, burlier, thick grape skin-gritty and less resolved than usual. A bit drying. The oak, classy and firm, compressing and directing. Best after 2028.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Routinely my favorite red cuvée in the Penfolds Collection (matured in large-format seasoned French oak), there is always a freshness and suppleness to the fruit that is most elegant in the glass. Here, the 2020 St Henri Shiraz shows the warm and low-yielding season from whence it came in the splay of roasted beetroot, red fruits and meats on the mid-palate. A chunky, meaty iteration of this wine, the tannins are grippy and full in the mouth. You get aniseed and clove through the finish.

stags-leap-merlot.title: Stags' Leap Winery Merlot 2023
stags-leap-merlot.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Merlot 2023 is a plush, fruit-driven, and elegantly structured red wine from Napa Valley. In the glass, it presents a deep amethyst color and opens with vibrant aromas of blueberry, black cherry, ripe plum, and red berries, accented by delicate floral violet, potpourri, and spiced notes of mocha, cedar, and clove. The palate is medium-bodied and mouthwatering, offering bright, crunchy tannins, vibrant acidity, and layered flavors of black raspberry, tobacco leaf, and bittersweet dark chocolate that flow into a long, mineral-edged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with herb-crusted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, grilled pork tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Gouda cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

Lush, fruit-driven and perfumed, with aromas of blueberries, black cherries, raspberries, citrus peel and potpourri. The palate is mid-weighted with bright, crunchy tannins and fresh acidity that lead to a mineral-edged, mouthwatering finish. Bright, fresh and engaging. Drink or hold.

grgich-hills-estate-chardonnay.title: Grgich Hills Estate Grown Chardonnay 2023
grgich-hills-estate-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Grgich Hills Estate Grown Chardonnay 2023 is a crisp, bright, and classically structured white wine that showcases the cool-climate estate vineyards of American Canyon and Carneros in the Napa Valley. Made without malolactic fermentation to preserve its vibrant natural acidity, it displays a pale gold color and opens with expressive aromas of lemon curd, yellow apple, green tea, and quince, complemented by delicate notes of toasted almonds, ginger, and struck flint minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, energetic, and perfectly balanced, featuring a silky texture, bright citrus and orchard fruit flavors, and a clean, refreshing, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roast chicken, seared sea scallops, lobster tail, wild mushroom risotto, crab cakes, or mild creamy goat cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripe yet restrained, this sits on the edge of reduction, showing aromas of yellow apples, grilled peaches, lemon curd and a touch of struck flint. The palate reflects the cool vintage with bright acidity and a layered feel, delivering baked citrus, toasted almonds and subtle spices. Rounded and fresh with a savory, lingering finish. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Vibrant, flavorful, and energetic, this Chardonnay delivers the lush, ripe fruits of its region with palate stimulating structure and poise. Charismatic and well crafted, combining ripe quince, lemon curd, lime zest, and grapefruit pith through a silken mouthfeel.

yalumba-the-signature-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Yalumba The Signature Cabernet Sauvignon/Shiraz 2019 750ml
yalumba-the-signature-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
A very deep, dense, red in color. Aromas of red currants, perfumed cedar and complex, savory dried herbs. This Cabernet-Shiraz blend shows precise aromatics and is classically rich through the middle palate with exotic florals, cranberry complexity and dark chocolate. A full-bodied wine complemented with a long, flowing, precise tannin profile.

Pair with beef fillet with beetroot and horseradish or a vegan BBQ pinto bean burger patty with mushrooms, soy sauce, black pepper and molasses.

96 Points - James Suckling

A very youthful vintage, this is taut and will age very well. Aromas of blackcurrants, tar, blackberries and baking spices lead to a palate that has such an intense, gently smoky thread with a succulent, juicy red-plum, berry and spice finish. Light espresso.

96 Points - Decanter

Cool summer and autumn nights tempered warm days in 2016, producing great intensity to the iodine and espresso-edged nose and palate here. With silky blackberry and currant, fleshier mulberry and refreshing blood plum, the palate is motile, its juicy persistence a foil to the creamy, savoury oak (French barriques, Hungarian and American hogsheads, 28% new) and dynamic snare of ripe but present tannins.

kettle-valley-hayman-pinot-noir.title: Kettle Valley Hayman John's Block Pinot Noir 2021 750ml
kettle-valley-hayman-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: This wine is a blend of Pinot Noir grown in the Thibault vineyard in Summerland, and the Cole vineyard in Naramata. The wine was allowed to go through a full malolactic fermentation and was barrel fermented in French oak for 19 months before being bottled. Earthy light oak and a hint of tart berries cut a swath through this otherwise earthy Pinot Noir.

yalumba-the-virgilius-viognier.title: Yalumba Y Series Shiraz Viognier
yalumba-the-virgilius-viognier.bodyHtml:
Vibrant and aromatic, with ripe blackberry, plum and blueberry complemented by violet, pepper and subtle floral notes. The palate is juicy and smooth, combining generous dark fruit with fresh acidity, supple tannins and a lingering, gently spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled lamb, barbecue beef, roast pork, burgers, tomato-based pasta, pizza, or mildly spiced meat dishes.

kettle-valley-pinot-noir-reserve.title: Kettle Valley Reserve Pinot Noir 2021 750ml
kettle-valley-pinot-noir-reserve.bodyHtml: The inspiration for Kettle Valley Winery's name is the famed Kettle Valley Railway which ran through Naramata between 1915 and 1961, connecting the Southern Interior of British Columbia to the markets of the Pacific Northwest. Passion and a dedication to excellence were requirements for building the railway, and at Kettle Valley, they feel that same passion and dedication for their red wines which are known for their elegant and well-structured natures and their white wines that are flavourful and aromatic with a rich mouth feel.

chateau-ste-michelle-eroica-riesling.title: Chateau Ste Michelle Riesling 2022 750ml
chateau-ste-michelle-eroica-riesling.bodyHtml:
Our Columbia Valley Riesling is a blend of Riesling from throughout Washington’s Columbia Valley. The wine offers crisp apple and white peach aromas and flavors with subtle mineral notes. This is our go to Riesling that is incredibly refreshing and flavorful and easy to match with a variety of foods.

89 points Wine Spectator

 90 points James Suckling

88 points Decanter

rodney-strong-symmetry.title: Rodney Strong 'Symmetry' Red 2021
rodney-strong-symmetry.bodyHtml:
Rodney Strong 'Symmetry' Red 2021 is a luxurious, full-bodied Bordeaux-style red blend crafted from select vineyard blocks in Sonoma County's Alexander Valley. Aged for over two years in French oak barrels, it opens with opulent aromas of cassis, brambleberry, and dark cocoa, accented by subtle hints of sweet baking spices and toasted oak. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, supple mouthfeel layered with dark fruit flavors, rounded tannins, and a long, harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with hearty beef stew, grilled pork tenderloin, roasted lamb, or an assortment of seasoned roasted vegetables.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Punchy aromas of black plum, spiced blackberry compote, bitter cocoa, cinnamon, and cedar drive the nose of this blend. The palate displays opulent tannic structure, bright acid, and flavors of concentrated raspberry, dark chocolate, cracked pepper, violets, and balsamic across the finish. Yummy now, cellar this for five plus years for maximum enjoyment.

boekenhoutskloof-syrah.title: Boekenhoutskloof Syrah 2021
boekenhoutskloof-syrah.bodyHtml:
Boekenhoutskloof Syrah 2021 is a benchmark, highly focused, and profoundly savory South African red wine crafted by the acclaimed Boekenhoutskloof estate. Sourced from two distinguished vineyard parcels in the Swartland—Porseleinberg (rooted in rocky bedrock of decomposed mica-schist) and Goldmine on the slopes of Kasteelberg (brown schist with Table Mountain sandstone)—the vines benefit from low yields and exceptional drainage. Hand-harvested and vinified in Franschhoek, the fruit was fermented in concrete tulip-shaped vats utilizing 60% to 65% whole bunches and spontaneous native fermentation, followed by 18 months of maturation in 2,500-liter Austrian oak foudres and 600-liter demi-muids. In the glass, it reveals an opaque, deep purple-ruby hue. The aromatic profile is complex and perfumed, offering lifted notes of wild blackberries, dried thyme, cracked black and white peppercorn, violets, and black cardamom, seamlessly integrated with nuances of cured meat, tapenade, iron, and subtle wood smoke. On the palate, it exhibits refined tension and structure, showing compact dark berry fruit framed by sappy, fine-grained mineral tannins and vibrant natural acidity that carries into a focused, persistent, and stony finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, grilled venison loin, braised beef short ribs, smoked duck breast, or aged hard farmhouse cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Lovely fragrance with thyme, cracked pepper, iron, coriander and black berry fruit. Medium-bodied, peppery and compact, with vibrant acidity and a focused finish. Long and persistent. Drink or hold.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Syrah, crafted with 60% whole-cluster fruit, offers a red-fruited character with dusty, herbaceous and spicy undertones. Medium-bodied, it features a firm, dusty texture with a pronounced tannic edge, hints of red peppercorn and a spicy finish. This wine requires some time to develop fully, but it shows promising structure and potential. Aged for 18 months in a mix of Stockinger barrels, it's a wine with good bones that will reward patience.

rdm-chianti-classico-riserva-gr-sel-fiz.title: Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
rdm-chianti-classico-riserva-gr-sel-fiz.bodyHtml:
Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 is an incredibly harmonious, traditional Tuscan red wine crafted with a core of Sangiovese. Following extensive maturation in a combination of Slavonian and French oak barrels, it reveals an elegant ruby hue alongside complex, expressive aromas of black cherries, wild blackberries, red plums, and violets, layered with hints of cedar, sweet vanilla, and earthy iron notes. The palate is full-bodied, dense, and beautifully framed by muscular, structured tannins and vibrant, balanced acidity, easing into a long, generous finish marked by warming spices.

Food Pairing: Pair this savory Riserva with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, rosemary-roasted lamb, wild boar ragù, or mature pecorino cheese.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This beefy red relies on its dense texture, concentrated flavors of black cherry and blackberry fruit, and muscular tannins to get its message across. Wild herb, iron and earth notes add depth, while the finish is long and spicy.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is savory and umami, with aromas of leather, graphite, underbrush, crushed rocks, bitter herbs and citrus swirling in the glass. Those earthy, bitter notes remain on the palate, but sweet cherries and wild strawberries pop overhead, while charged with powerful tannins and acid.

trinoro-cupole-igt.title: Tenuta Di Trinoro Toscana Le Cupole Rosso 2022
trinoro-cupole-igt.bodyHtml:
Tenuta di Trinoro 'Le Cupole' Rosso 2023 is an expressive, richly textured, and approachable Tuscan red blend crafted by the Franchetti family in southeastern Tuscany's Val d'Orcia. Introduced in 1995 as the estate's second wine, it is produced from younger vines planted at elevations between 450 and 600 meters on clay, limestone, and gravel soils in Sarteano. Composed of 46% Merlot, 36% Cabernet Franc, 15% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 3% Petit Verdot, the grapes were vinified by parcel in stainless steel vats before undergoing malolactic fermentation and aging for 8 months in used French oak barriques, followed by 10 months in cement tanks. In the glass, it displays a deep, luminous ruby-purple hue. The aromatic bouquet opens with vibrant notes of ripe blackberry, black cherry, and plum layered with Mediterranean herbs, sweet spice, licorice, and subtle cocoa. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full body marked by plush, velvety tannins, bright acidity, and a juicy, mineral-laced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled Florentine T-bone steak, wild boar ragù with pappardelle, herb-roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A spicy and peppery wine with aromas of eucalyptus, red cherries and leather. Silky, almost creamy tannins with crisp acidity and a medium body. Good licorice finish. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Tenuta di Trinoro 2023 Le Cupole hits its marks squarely, delivering luxurious quality at a highly accessible price point. The blend of 41% Merlot, 39% Cabernet Franc, 14% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6% Petit Verdot shows dark fruit flavors of blackberry framed by velvety richness that spreads broadly across the palate. Crafted from the same high-elevation Val d’Orcia vineyards as the estate’s flagship wines, Le Cupole benefits from the same rigorous selection and low-yield philosophy. The 2023 tannins are especially well managed, giving the wine a more approachable personality. 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Vibrant and complex, this red starts out with cherry, blackberry, rose and mineral flavors supported by bracing acidity and a dense layer of tannins. Overall, this is refined and intense, with terrific harmony and length. Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2035.

prunotto-mompertone-doc.title: Prunotto Mompertone Monferrato 2016
prunotto-mompertone-doc.bodyHtml:
Mompertone is an intense rub red color. The nose offers captivating notes of spices, vanilla, cacao, forest floor and cherries. Mompertone’s rich and velvety palate is persistent and well balanced with supple elegant tannins.

92 Points - James Suckling

This is always a really delicious red and shows reserved violet character, dark-cherry compote, plums and vanilla. Medium-bodied with lovely lilac and lavender character throughout, accentuated by clove undertones and juicy tannins. Drink now.

antonelli-montefalco-sagrantino.title: Antonelli San Marco Montefalco Sagrantino 2020
antonelli-montefalco-sagrantino.bodyHtml:
Antonelli San Marco Montefalco Sagrantino 2020 is a rich, powerful, and richly structured organic Italian red wine produced in the heart of Umbria. Crafted entirely from 100% Sagrantino grown on hillside vineyards with clay-limestone soils, it undergoes lengthy skin-contact fermentation before extended aging across oak barrels, cement vats, and bottle. In the glass, it displays a deep, dark ruby-red color. The complex nose presents aromas of dark cherry, wild blackberry, citrus zest, oregano, and dried herbs, overlaid with notes of tobacco, mint, and graphite. On the palate, it is full-bodied, robust, and beautifully balanced, offering a core of dense fruit framed by firm, muscular tannins and bright acidity that carries through to a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with braised beef short ribs, roasted wild boar, grilled lamb chops, venison stew, black truffle dishes, and aged Pecorino cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

Graphite, cedar, smoke and licorice aromas enhanced by fresh violets. A soft attack with velvety tannins that are well tamed and integrated, crisp acidity and a tight finish. Best after 2026.

akarua-rua-pinot-noir.title: Akarua Rua Pinot Noir 2023
akarua-rua-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Akarua Rua Pinot Noir 2023 is a fresh, vibrant, and approachable expression of Central Otago Pinot Noir, crafted from premium fruit sourced from the Bannockburn and Pisa subregions. Pouring a bright ruby red, it opens with an expressive and fragrant bouquet of dark cherry, wild raspberry, and juicy red plum, elegantly interwoven with classic regional nuances of dried wild thyme, lavender, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, rich, and juicy, delivering a concentrated core of sweet red berries and blackcurrant. Harmoniously balanced by bright structural acidity and soft, silky tannins, it features a touch of oak-derived vanilla and a stony mineral thread that carry through to a long, beautifully fruit-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with herb-crusted lamb chops, roasted duck breast, savory pork and mushroom dumplings, or a rich wild mushroom risotto.

oraculo-ribera-del-duero-in-gift-box.title: Pago de Carraovejas Ribera del Duero 2022
oraculo-ribera-del-duero-in-gift-box.bodyHtml:
Pago de Carraovejas Ribera del Duero 2022 is an exceptionally expressive and powerful Spanish red that beautifully reflects its unique terroir. It opens with intense, fragrant aromas of ripe blackberry, purple plum, and crushed violets, elegantly layered with notes of dark chocolate, sweet baking spices, and a subtle touch of sandalwood. On the palate, this full-bodied blend of predominantly Tinto Fino is dense yet remarkably fresh, delivering a lush core of dark fruit perfectly balanced by chalky, fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity. Aging for 12 months in French and American oak provides a seamless, harmonious texture that leads into a persistent, tension-filled, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with traditional roasted suckling pig, grilled lamb chops, savory game meats, hearty beef stews, and aged Spanish cheeses like Manchego.

93 Points - James Suckling

A concentrated, dense Ribera del Duero, but there is a lot to like if you enjoy plushness, with its lush blackberry fruit and dark chocolate. Fine-grained and full-bodied on the palate, but fresh and still pretty tense, with chalky tannins. Drink from 2025.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Pago de Carraovejas wants to be the expression of the valley that names the wine. It was produced with 93% Tempranillo, 4% Cabernet Sauvignon and 3% Merlot in a very warm and dry and challenging year when the wine achieved a whopping 15.5% alcohol after spending 12 months in 226- and 600-liter French and American oak barrels. It's dark, aromatic and heady, juicy and a little decadent, with ripe flavors and fine tannins, clearly reflecting the conditions of the year.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A well-balanced red, with a concentrated core of blackberry paste and crushed mulberry flavors, plus appealing milled pepper, mocha, dried thyme and licorice aromatics. Rich but not overly weighty, integrating supple, fine-grained tannins and lively acidity. Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Drink now through 2035.

piper-heidsieck-brut-1.title: Piper-Heidsieck Brut Vintage 2014
piper-heidsieck-brut-1.bodyHtml:
Opens with radiant aromas of orange blossom, apricot, toasted brioche, and roasted almonds. The palate is refined and vibrant with a delicate, creamy mousse, revealing flavours of mandarin, lime zest, golden pear, and subtle liquorice, balanced by crystalline acidity and a long, chalky mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with fresh oysters, butter-poached lobster, sea scallops, prawn gratin, black truffle tartines, or aged Comté cheese.


93 Points - James Suckling

Showing nicely complex notes of figs, red apples, golden pears, walnuts and lemon conserve on toast, with a touch of beeswax. It’s medium-bodied, with bright acidity and a textured, phenolic palate. Tight bubbles. Dry feel.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2014 Brut Vintage, a blend of 55% Pinot Noir and 45% Chardonnay with a dosage of seven grams per liter, has turned out nicely with aromas of pear, peach, almonds and smoky hints. Medium to full-bodied, supple and fruity with a delicate mousse, this is a structured, tension-filled but airborne Champagne with high acidity, the sign of a cool weather vintage.

fess-parker-syrah.title: Fess Parker Syrah 2019 750ml
fess-parker-syrah.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2019 vintage) "This brawny style of Syrah offers grilled meat, elderberry, leather and mesquite aromas on the nose. Iodine, smoked-meat and roasted-berry flavors show on the bold palate, which would handle any type of roasted beef. Matt Kettmann" - 91/100, Wine Enthusiast

vicchiomaggio-chianti-riserva-petri.title: Castello Vicchiomaggio Agostino Petri Chianti Classico Riserva 2022
vicchiomaggio-chianti-riserva-petri.bodyHtml:
Castello Vicchiomaggio Agostino Petri Chianti Classico Riserva 2022 is an elegant and structured red wine that reflects the prestige of a historic estate in Greve in Chianti. This Riserva is dedicated to Agostino Petri, the grandfather of the current owner, and is crafted from a selection of the estate's best Sangiovese grapes, often rounded out with a small amount of Cabernet Sauvignon. The 2022 vintage benefited from a warm season that provided excellent ripeness and fruit concentration.
On the nose, it delivers an inviting bouquet of ripe red cherries, blackberries, and violets, seamlessly layered with sophisticated notes of leather, tobacco, and sweet baking spices from its time in oak. The palate is full-bodied and velvety, showcasing a dense core of dark fruit supported by firm, polished tannins and a vibrant acidity. The finish is long and persistent, leaving a lingering impression of savory herbs and a touch of dark chocolate.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense wine focused on kiwi peel, leafy lightness and citrus leaves, together with red cherries and raspberries. Light- to medium-bodied, it shows crisp if not zesty acidity, with well-extracted and ripe tannins. Slightly chalkier on the savory, licorice finish, yet good. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

This red is all about the vibrant personality, laying the foundation for cherry and blackberry fruit, while earth, Tuscan scrub and mineral notes add depth. Tannic, yet with all of its components in the right places. Shows fine balance and length. Best from 2027 through 2040.

darenberg-the-dead-arm-shiraz.title: d'Arenberg The Footbolt Shiraz
darenberg-the-dead-arm-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Rich and expressive Shiraz with blackberry, plum and dark cherry fruit layered with black pepper, spice and savoury notes. The palate is full and generous, supported by firm tannins and balanced acidity, finishing long with persistent dark fruit and spice.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled steak, roast lamb, barbecue ribs, braised beef, venison, hearty stews, mushrooms, or mature cheddar.

cade-rocchi-cab-sauv-merlot-dugal.title: Tinazzi Ca' De' Rocchi Dugal Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2015 750ml
cade-rocchi-cab-sauv-merlot-dugal.bodyHtml: Tinazzi Ca' De' Rocchi Dugal Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2015 750ml

col-solare.title: Col Solare Red 2018 750ml
col-solare.bodyHtml: Col Solare 2018 is a red wine from Col Solare, the Red Mountain estate in Washington State founded on the vision of Tuscany's Marchese Piero Antinori, with a first vintage in 1995. Red Mountain is a tiny appellation and the warmest in Washington; heat, nutrient-poor soils, low rainfall and cool nights give concentrated fruit with structure and elegance, and the area is best known for Cabernet Sauvignon. The estate vineyard was laid out to the same specifications the Antinori family uses in its own vineyards in Tuscany and Umbria, joining Washington terroir with Tuscan winemaking style. 750 ml, 14.5% alcohol.

bucci-verdicchio-castelli-di-jesi.title: Bucci Bucci Verdicchio Dei Castelli Di Jesi Classico Superiore 2023 750ml
bucci-verdicchio-castelli-di-jesi.bodyHtml: Bucci Bucci Verdicchio Dei Castelli Di Jesi Classico Superiore 750ml

torbreck-run-rig.title: Torbreck RunRig 2022
torbreck-run-rig.bodyHtml: Torbreck RunRig 2022 is the Barossa Valley flagship of Torbreck, a blend of Shiraz from old, dry-grown Barossa vineyards with a little Viognier, at 15.5% ABV. The winery compares it with the fragrant, tautly structured wines of Côte-Rôtie in the Northern Rhône, while noting that its power and latent richness bring it closer to the concentrated, long-lived wines of Hermitage. Torbreck takes its name from a forest near Inverness in Scotland, and the RunRig name refers to the Highland system of sharing out dispersed plots of land among clansmen, managed communally rather than as one farm, much as this blend of individual parcels becomes greater than the sum of its parts.

boekenhoutskloof-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Boekenhoutskloof Stellenbosch Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
boekenhoutskloof-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Bold aromas of ripe brambles, mulberries, blackberries, and cassis dominate an inviting, sophisticated nose with whiffs of graphite and cedar. The complex berry fruit character of the nose follows through onto a juicy palate with flavors of blueberries, plum sauce, and nuances of Cape fynbos, bay leaf, wet gravel, and pencil lead. Fine-grained, powdery tannins and integrated lemony acidity add to the fine structure of the wine and its exceptional balance. Subtle notes of cocoa powder, dark chocolate and oregano persist on a smooth, rich finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

Pretty nose of blackcurrants, sage, blackberry leaves and nutmeg. Firm and well-framed, with a full body and solid tannin structure. Excellent freshness, too. Drink or hold.

boekenhoutskloof-semillon.title: Boekenhoutskloof Semillon 2021
boekenhoutskloof-semillon.bodyHtml:
Boekenhoutskloof Semillon 2021 is a highly acclaimed, old-vine white wine that showcases the heritage and aging potential of South African Semillon. Sourced from historic vineyards in the Franschhoek Valley—some planted as early as 1902—the wine is crafted with a small addition of Muscat d'Alexandrie for added acidity and structural lift. It features a complex bouquet of melon, acacia flower, and kumquat, leading to a textured, medium-bodied palate of poached pear and fresh lemon. The 2021 vintage is noted for its precision and mineral-driven character, having benefited from a cooler growing season that allowed for slow, even ripening.

94 Points - James Suckling

Always an excellent semillon, textured and compact. Complex aromas of apricots, beeswax, Asian pears and hints of white chocolate. Some almonds. Medium- to full-bodied with a long, creamy finish. From old vines planted in 1902, 1942 and 1936. Drink or hold.

voerzio-barbera-pozzo.title: Voerzio Barbera Pozzo 1.5L Magnum
voerzio-barbera-pozzo.bodyHtml: Roberto Voerzio Barbera d'Alba Riserva Pozzo dell'Annunziata comes from the Pozzo dell'Annunziata vineyard near La Morra, in the heart of Piedmont's Barolo zone. Voerzio, who founded his winery in the 1980s, is known for extremely low yields and precise, terroir-driven viticulture. This listing is the 1.5-litre magnum at 14.5% ABV. Please contact us to confirm the vintage.

buehler-chardonnay.title: Buehler Vineyards Chardonnay 2019
buehler-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Buehler Vineyards Chardonnay 2019 pours a bright golden straw hue in the glass. The highly expressive nose showcases an abundance of floral and ripe stone fruit aromas, lightly accented by complex undertones of toasty graham cracker, vanilla, and warm baking spices derived from traditional sur-lie aging. On the palate, this full-bodied Russian River Valley white wine delivers a rich, creamy, and velvet-textured mouthfeel. A core of fresh peach, apricot, and green apple is beautifully framed by the crisp, vibrant natural acidity characteristic of the region, carrying the wine to a remarkably clean, balanced, and long-lasting finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with pan-seared salmon, roasted chicken in cream sauce, rich pork tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, or artisanal soft cheeses.

buehler-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Buehler Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
buehler-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Buehler Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, expressive, and full-bodied California red wine that captures the classic character and depth of Napa Valley. Sourced from a mix of hillside estate vineyards and select valley floor parcels, it opens with dense aromas of plum, blackberry, and dark cassis, accented by hints of tobacco leaf, earth, and subtle oak spice. On the palate, the wine delivers a rounded, textural mouthfeel supported by integrated tannins and vibrant fruit concentration, carrying into a structured, long-lasting finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, or hearty beef stews and aged cheddar cheese.

91 Points - James Suckling

Dark-fruited aromas with real intensity and depth, supported by undertones of mulberry bush, earth, tobacco and dried herbs. The palate is full-bodied with a textural, rounded mouthfeel, integrated tannins and a long, persistent finish. Not for the faint-hearted, but plenty to like. Drink or hold.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Full-bodied with ample intensity, this Cabernet Sauvignon showcases the bold side of the variety with black fruits and savory flavors. Lightly tactile tannins linger.

pieri-agostina-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Agostina Pieri Brunello di Montalcino 2020
pieri-agostina-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
The southern exposure here gives ripe fruit with rounder tannins than northern parts of Montalcino. The precocious charm of the wine can sometimes hide the underlying structure, but there is plenty of structure for aging.

93 Points - James Suckling

A floral wine focused on roses and violets, with lots of raspberries and blood oranges. Firm tannin on the palate, with supple fruit, a medium body, crisp acidity and a long finish showing fruit and aromatic herbs. Drinkable now, but best from 2026.

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
Pouring a transparent medium ruby color with a watery rim, the 2020 Brunello Di Montalcino has a Grenache-like feel, with highly floral notes of candied roses, strawberry preserves, and sweet herbs. Mid-weight and light on its feet, it offers ultra-fine tannins, fresh and even acidity, and a clean, balanced finish with hints of ripe orange and saline. It's a more approachable and charming Brunello to enjoy over the coming 8-10 years.

delamotte-blanc-de-blanc-vintage.title: Delamotte Blanc de Blancs 2018
delamotte-blanc-de-blanc-vintage.bodyHtml:
Its pale gold color, glinting with emerald, illuminates the delicate necklace of bubbles rising to the disc's surface in the glass. On the nose, the wine's noble origins are unmistakable in the energy of its bouquet: pure, direct, and deep, a strong personality. Its lively attack, palate freshness, and mouth-watering minerality are a delight. But it doesn't end there. The gourmet will appreciate the supple fruit and notes of brioche that explode in a dreamy finish.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Like a prima ballerina, this elegant Champagne shows effortless precision and grace. The lacy mousse carries a layered range of creamed apple, yellow plum, pickled ginger and lemon curd flavors, aligned with more subtle hints of rich vanilla-infused pastry cream and brioche. Long and creamy, with a succulent quality to the well-cut acidity and a mineral-driven finish of smoke, chalk and oyster shell. Drink now through 2038. 

93 Points - James Suckling

This is creamy and ripe, with inviting aromas of baked apples, custard, vanilla pastry and dried pineapple. It's silky and rounded on the palate, with excellent freshness backing up the creamy fruit. 100% chardonnay from the six grand crus in the Cote des Blancs. Disgorged late 2024. 5 g/L dosage after six years on the lees. Delicious now.

92 Points - James Suckling

Delamotte's 2018 Blanc de Blancs is only the fourth edition since 2008. Since Michel Fauconnet found it expressive earlier, it was disgorged after four and half years of aging on the lees (as opposed to the six years typical of previous editions) with a dosage of 5.5 grams per liter. Sourced from Le Mesnil-sur-Oger, Avize, Oger, Cramant, Chouilly and Oiry, it comes from a lower-acid vintage that’s charming and inviting, revealing aromas of tangerine, dried white flowers and pear. Full-bodied, generous and even powerful, it is underpinned by ripe yet vibrant acidity. It will offer a broad drinking window, but to minimize the vintage signature and maximize reflection of its origins, a few extra years under cork are advisable.

zind-humbrecht-pinot-gris-heimbourg.title: Pinot Gris Zind Humbrecht Alsace
zind-humbrecht-pinot-gris-heimbourg.bodyHtml:
A rich Alsace Pinot Gris offering ripe pear, peach, apricot, honey, white flowers, and subtle spice. The palate is textured and concentrated, balanced by refreshing acidity and mineral depth, finishing long, savory, elegant, and beautifully persistent.

Food Pairing: Enjoy with foie gras, roasted poultry, duck, pork, creamy mushroom dishes, seafood, soft cheeses, quiche, and mildly spiced Asian cuisine.

hugo-shiraz.title: Hugo Shiraz 2020
hugo-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Hugo Shiraz 2020 is an expressive, small-batch red wine crafted from estate-grown vines planted in the elevated foothills of McLaren Flat in South Australia. Sourced from vines aged over 30 and 50 years, it displays a deep garnet-maroon color with vibrant crimson highlights. On the nose, it delivers inviting aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blueberry, juicy plum, and subtle hints of winter spices and oak. The palate is rich yet well-balanced and approachable, featuring luscious black fruit flavors backed by fine, velvety tannins, balanced acidity, and a smooth, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exce. beef fillet with horseradish and prosciutto, locally sourced T-bone steak, braised short ribs, grilled lamb chops, and aged cheddar cheese.

truchard-chardonnay.title: Truchard Estate Chardonnay 2023
truchard-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Floral aromas of pineapple, quince, and honeysuckle; with a touch of nutmeg, fig, and toasted oak. The mouth is clean and bright; filled with flavors of green apple, fresh pear, and Meyer lemon. Firm acidity provides a crisp finish of citrus, mineral, and spice.

92 Points - James Suckling

Lemon balm, orange blossoms and lime curd on the nose. The palate is focused, with a full-bodied mouthfeel and integrated acidity, giving notes of grapefruit sherbet, graham crackers and river stones. Very well balanced and energetic.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Truchard's 2023 Chardonnay is loaded with scents of spicy oak, pear and melon, plus hints of citrus and sweet corn. All barrel fermented in one-third new French oak, it's medium to full-bodied, plump, rounded and generous but balanced, silky and flat-out satisfying.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a supple, elegant mix of orange blossom and creamsicle flavors, with notes of mango, tangerine, lemon zest and dried apricot. The intensity of flavor is matched by the rich body and fresh thread of acidity. Drink now

chateau-de-sancerre-cuvee-du-connetable.title: Chateau de Sancerre Cuvee du Connetable 2022 750ml
chateau-de-sancerre-cuvee-du-connetable.bodyHtml: The Cuvee du Connetable is made from a selection of Sauvignon Blanc grapes harvested from the best plots in the Chateau de Sancerre's vineyards which are composed essentially of flint and chalky stones. This exceptional, estate-bottled wine is obtained by blending 2/3 of oak-fermented wine with 1/3 of tank-fermented wine, which gives structure and complexity.

rust-en-vrede-estate.title: Rust En Vrede Stellenbosch Estate Red Blend 2020
rust-en-vrede-estate.bodyHtml:
Rust En Vrede Stellenbosch Estate Red Blend 2020 pours a deep, intense ruby color in the glass. The nose is remarkably expressive and complex, opening with prominent aromas of dark plums, blackcurrant, and dried herbs, beautifully layered with secondary hints of cedar, tobacco, and oak spices. On the palate, this full-bodied South African red blend showcases an exceptional structural balance with generous volume and firm, well-integrated tannins. Rich, concentrated layers of dark berries and dark chocolate seamlessly carry through to a firm, lengthy finish driven by a subtle, deep earthy undertone.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with tandoori lamb chops, slow-cooked Moroccan beef tagine, grilled ribeye steak, venison stew, or a selection of mature, hard artisanal cheeses.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, focused red, with rich notes of roasted plum, bay leaf, black currant and hints of mint, mocha and smoke married to fine, sculpted tannins and a plush texture. Shows good harmony, and you don't initially notice the depth of flavor and concentration until this echoes on the superlong finish. Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah and Merlot. Drink now through 2034.

91 Points - James Suckling

A medium-bodied red with dark plums, currants, dried herbs, cedar and oak spices on the nose. Firm tannins with a core of dark berries and dark chocolate . Firm with an earthy touch to it. 64% cabernet sauvignon, 28% syrah and 8% merlot. Try after 2024.

guardian-peak-syrah-mourvedre-grenache.title: M. Chapoutier La Bernardine Chateauneuf-du-Pape 2022
guardian-peak-syrah-mourvedre-grenache.bodyHtml:
M. Chapoutier La Bernardine Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2022 is an elegant, structured, and expressive Southern Rhône red wine produced by the iconic Maison M. Chapoutier. Sourced from a mix of Châteauneuf-du-Pape terroirs characterized by galets roulés (rolled pebbles) and clay-matrix soils, this Grenache-dominant blend undergoes traditional vinification and is aged for 15 to 16 months in concrete vats to preserve fruit purity and freshness. In the glass, it presents an intense crimson-red hue, opening with refined aromas of blackcurrant, plum, garrigue herbs, and baking spices. The palate is medium-to-full-bodied and layered with fine, ripe tannins, vibrant acidity, and flavors of wild berries, liquorice, and roasted coffee that linger into a long, flavorful finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, duck confit, wild mushroom risotto, and aged Gruyère or Comté cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

A succulent, well-balanced and fine-tuned red with notes of red berries, wild herbs, meat and some baking spices as well. It’s medium- to full-bodied with fine, ripe tannins. Well-driven and structured but in control, with an long, intense and flavorful finish.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Softened plum and wild berry notes share the stage with herbs and savory power. Brown bread, toasted anise and juniper merge in on the harmonious palate, with all of the elements firing in sync. The beautiful texture -- mostly glossy, with a hint of chewy meatiness -- and chalk-fine tannins hold a gentle grip as grilled sandalwood smoke closes out. Grenache and Syrah. Drink now through 2030.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Chateauneuf du Pape la Bernardine, a blend of Grenache Noir, Mourvèdre and Syrah in unknown proportions, offers up aromas of cardamom, garrigue, spices and pepper. Medium to full-bodied, concentrated and generously extracted, with plenty of youthfully chewy tannins, it's framed by a muscular, rather dense palate with a firm, slightly dry finish.

piper-heidsieck-rose-sauvage.title: Piper-Heidsieck Rose Sauvage
piper-heidsieck-rose-sauvage.bodyHtml:
Rose Sauvage, meaning Wild Rose in French, is not your typical Champagne Rose. A high proportion of Pinot Noir results in a bold, deep-hued rosé and a palate that is structured, full-bodied, and yet distinctly elegant. This unique, fruity Champagne, carefully crafted from over 100 crus, is guaranteed to delight all the senses.

A brisk, original and juicy wine which simultaneously offers black cherry, blackberry, pink grapefruit and blood orange notes. This structure and fruitiness are enriched with warm, spicy notes of Espelette pepper, tea, and licorice.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Sleek and finely-knit, with firm acidity and a chalky underpinning married to a lovely range of steeped raspberry, wild strawberry and dried fig fruit flavors. Hints of salted almond, blood orange zest and smoke play on the finish. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.

90 Points - James Suckling

A fruity and playful champagne rosé with small berries, raspberry wafers and warm spices on the nose. It’s well-rounded, fruity and refreshing with a salivating, grenadine-like finish.

bourgogne-pinot-noir-maison-champy.title: Maison Champy Bourgogne Pinot Noir Cuvee Edme 2024
bourgogne-pinot-noir-maison-champy.bodyHtml:
Maison Champy Bourgogne Pinot Noir Cuvée Edme 2024 is an expressive, harmonious, and classically styled red Burgundy crafted by Burgundy’s oldest wine house, founded in Beaune in 1720. Sourced from carefully selected parcels rooted in traditional clay-limestone soils across Burgundy, the wine undergoes temperature-controlled fermentation before aging for 12 months in French oak barrels (approximately 20% new oak). In the glass, it displays a bright, radiant ruby-red core with youthful violet reflections. The aromatic profile is fresh and open, revealing scents of red cherries, wild raspberries, and blackcurrants layered with delicate nuances of sweet vanilla, subtle baking spice, forest floor, and a finely woven woody foundation. On the palate, it enters supple, fresh, and round, balancing succulent red fruit with lively natural acidity and fine, coated tannins that carry through to a crisp, savory, and mineral-etched finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted chicken or duck breast, grilled pork tenderloin, mushroom risotto, charcuterie boards, seared salmon, and mild soft-ripened cheeses like Brie or Comté.

waterstone-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Waterstone Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
waterstone-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Waterstone Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 comes from Waterstone Winery, founded in 2000 with the idea of making luxury wines at affordable prices. Drawing on long-standing relationships with Napa Valley growers and vintners, the winery set out to make balanced wines of true varietal character through careful sourcing. Rather than accumulating land and facilities, Waterstone owns no vineyards and does not own the facility where its wines are made; dedicated winemaking, close ties with top growers and long-term grape contracts are central to its approach. This 2018 vintage is a 750ml bottle at 14.5% ABV.

frei-bros-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Frei Brothers Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 750ml
frei-bros-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Frei Brothers Reserve Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic expression of a deftly balanced Cabernet from this acclaimed region. Aromas of blackberries and dark cherry open in the glass. On the palate, this wine is medium bodied with silky tannins and great structure. Brimming with layers of Mission plum and cassis, this Cabernet Sauvignon reveals touches of caramel and cocoa that complement a long, detailed finish.

93 Points - James Suckling
I like the dark-fruit and herbal aromas with mushroom, bark and dried-flower character, following through to a full body with round, juicy tannins and a savory finish. Hints of black olives to the fruit at the end.

lungarotti-rubesco-riserva-monticchio.title: Lungarotti Rubesco Vigna Monticchio Torgiano Rosso Riserva 2012 750ml
lungarotti-rubesco-riserva-monticchio.bodyHtml: The 2012 Lungarotti Rubesco Vigna Monticchio Torgiano Rosso Riserva is a red wine with a deep ruby color and a complex, elegant profile. It exhibits aromas of marasca cherries, blackberries, violets, and subtle hints of menthol and spices. The palate is concentrated and fruity, with soft tannins and a long, smooth finish. This wine is known for its impressive structure and well-integrated oak.

la-spinetta-barbera-d-asti-superiore-bio.title: La Spinetta Bionzo Barbera d'Asti Superiore 2016 750ml
la-spinetta-barbera-d-asti-superiore-bio.bodyHtml: Balanced, succulent, precious. This Barbera exhibits natural complexity and concentration coming from almost century old vines. Mineral notes, together with hints of chamomile and blackberry, all resonate in unique harmony.

la-spinetta-barbaresco-valeirano.title: La Spinetta Vursu Barbaresco Valeirano 2017 750ml
la-spinetta-barbaresco-valeirano.bodyHtml: Complex, profound, elegant. Valeirano displays surprising minerality, supported with phenomenal structure. Hints of tea leaf and balsamic notes on the nose and palate recur. The finish is intense, while tannins are noble.

la-spinetta-barbaresco-gallina.title: La Spinetta Vursu Barbaresco Gallina 2021 750ml
la-spinetta-barbaresco-gallina.bodyHtml: Attractive, sensual, balanced. A soft and persuasive Barbaresco. Velvety tannins and great body define this wine, that ends with a fruity finish and floral note.

noble-ridge-reserve-chardonnay-2018.title: Noble Ridge Reserve Chardonnay 2018
noble-ridge-reserve-chardonnay-2018.bodyHtml: The Noble Ridge Reserve Chardonnay 2018 is a rich, full-bodied white wine that exemplifies the "California style" often found in the Okanagan Falls sub-appellation. It is crafted from 100% estate-grown fruit from the home vineyard, where the grapes benefit from the unique glacial fluvial soils of sand, gravel, and rock. The 2018 vintage was harvested relatively early in mid-October to balance its natural ripeness with fresh acidity. On the nose, look for complex layers of butter, toasted macadamia nuts, and baked apple, followed by a palate rich with butterscotch, marmalade, and honey. The wine's generous texture is a result of 14 months of aging in a 50/50 split of French and American oak barrels, providing a long, spicy finish with hints of vanilla and caramel.

la-montesa.title: Palacios Remondo Finca La Montesa 2018 750ml
la-montesa.bodyHtml: Palacios Remondo Finca La Montesa 2018 is a red Rioja from the Palacios Remondo estate in Alfaro, in the eastern part of Rioja, Spain, bottled under the Rioja Denominación de Origen Calificada. The wine is named after La Montesa, a hillside vineyard on the northeastern slope of Monte Yerga, and is built on Garnacha together with other traditional varieties grown on the estate. The label of the current release highlights the estate's ecological viticulture, and the wine is made in a fresh, flowing, food-friendly style that lets the Garnacha fruit lead. Bottled at 14% alcohol in a 750ml bottle, the 2018 vintage pairs well with grilled lamb, chorizo or roast vegetables.

summerhill-cabernets.title: Summerhill Cabernet Franc Organic 750ml
summerhill-cabernets.bodyHtml:
Velvety, fresh and characterful. This classic Cabernet Franc gives ripe,
zesty notes of black plum, capsicum, red raspberry with a hint of crushed
gravel minerality. Amidst the intensely concentrated fruit flavours,
savoury notes of graphite and sage intrigue the palate. Pillowy and soft
on the palate, while bright acidity and ripe tannins lead to a rounded
finish with notes of tart red fruit lingering.

Try with roasted chicken, smoky sausages or aged cheeses.

barolo-docg-lecinquevigne.title: Damilano Barolo Lecinquevigne 2020 750ml
barolo-docg-lecinquevigne.bodyHtml:
