Ruby red in color with orange reflections. An intense bouquet, with tertiary notes of rose, leather, tobacco and emerging notes of violet and tar. The palate is ample and embracing, with prevailing impressions of a soft, persistent long finish.

Lecinquevigne is perfect for braised meat , game, mushrooms and aged cheeses.

  • 93 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

    With fruit from Brunate, Liste, Cerequio, Cannubi and Raviole, the 2019 Barolo Lecinquevigne is a little subdued on first nose and would benefit from more time in bottle. This wine offers an appellation-wide taste of Nebbiolo, and the focus, consequently, is on the grape more than any single vineyard. These kinds of blends work very well in a vintage like 2019 that holds its own in terms of balance, intensity and texture.

  • 93 Points - James Suckling

    Very perfumed and pretty with ripe berry, terra-cotta, and rose petal aromas and flavors. Medium-bodied with fine tannins and a lovely creamy texture. Fresh and bright. Delicious now but will age nicely.

  • 92 Points - Wine Spectator

    A taut, linear red, with macerated cherry and plum flavors augmented by hay, spices and iron. This has ample fruit and savory notes waiting to shine through once the tannic structure mellows.

lagarde-malbec-single-vineyard-doc.title: Lagarde Guarda Malbec 2021
lagarde-malbec-single-vineyard-doc.bodyHtml:
Lagarde Guarda Malbec 2021 is an elegant, structured, and deeply layered red wine produced by the historic Bodega Lagarde, established in 1897. Sourced from old, low-yielding vines planted in 1906 and 1937 on clay-loam soils in the Mayor Drummond vineyard in Luján de Cuyo, this cuvée reflects pure Argentine heritage. The wine undergoes spontaneous fermentation in stainless steel before aging for 12 months in French oak barrels, followed by further bottle maturation. In the glass, it displays an intense ruby-violet color with expressive aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, floral violet notes, subtle tobacco, and sweet spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied and refined, offering a dense core of dark fruit balanced by crisp acidity and fine, velvety tannins that lead to a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, empanadas, wild mushroom ragù, and aged hard cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Attractive nose with black cherries, currants, dried citrus peel, walnut and cigar box. Medium-bodied with firm tannins, that are polished and velvety. Crunchy and spiced dark fruit character with a flavorful finish. 40% malbec, 30% cabernet sauvignon, 20% merlot and 10% syrah. Drink or hold.

marimar-torres-dona-margarita-p-noir.title: Marimar Estate Dona Margarita Vineyard Mas Cavalls Pinot Noir 2014 750ml
marimar-torres-dona-margarita-p-noir.bodyHtml: Elegant nose, with classic varietal aromas of wild cherry, clove and sandalwood plus the characteristic note of forest floor from this special vineyard. The tannins are supple and graceful, and the palate is round, complex and fleshy. I would recommend serving it at cellar temperature, between 58-60° F.

luigi-dalessandro-il-bosco-cortona-syra.title: Tenimenti DÕAlessandro Il Bosco Syrah 2018 750ml
luigi-dalessandro-il-bosco-cortona-syra.bodyHtml: Tenimenti d'Alessandro Il Bosco Syrah 2018 comes from an estate in Cortona, Tuscany, that describes itself as a pioneer of fine wine there and focuses on Rhône varieties; Il Bosco was first made in 1992. It is 100% Syrah from the best sections of two hillside parcels, about 3.5 hectares in all, on the Manzano hills at 290 to 300 metres, on clay-limestone soils, densely planted and cordon-trained. Harvest usually falls in the first ten days of September. The grapes ferment in oak, about two-thirds as whole bunches, with 30 to 45 days on the skins; the wine then ages 24 months in used oak casks and barriques and a further 12 to 18 months in bottle. The estate describes an intense, concentrated Syrah with notes of ground coffee, mocha, cigar box, fresh mint, red fruit and Mediterranean herbs. Around 15,000 bottles are made each year. 14% ABV, 750 ml.

alexander-valley-cab-sauv.title: Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
alexander-valley-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a benchmark, expressive California red crafted from estate-owned and grower vineyards across Sonoma County’s sun-drenched Alexander Valley. Vinified in temperature-controlled stainless steel and matured for 24 months exclusively in American oak barrels (roughly 50% new and 50% once-used) sourced from the winery's dedicated Missouri cooperage, it was aged an additional 15 months in bottle prior to release. In the glass, it displays a deep, opaque ruby core with vibrant violet edges. The bouquet reveals intense, inviting aromas of ripe cassis, black cherries, and wild blackberry compote, seamlessly layered over Silver Oak's signature hallmarks of sweet vanilla bean, toasted coconut, dried sage, cedar, and subtle pipe tobacco. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, supple mouthfeel driven by concentrated dark bramble fruit and mocha, framed by fine-grained, velvety tannins and lively natural acidity that lead into an elegant, persistent, and oak-spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, herb-roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild mushroom risotto, and aged sharp white cheddar cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

So full-bodied, ripe and robust, offering spicy, iron-like, black fruit aromas, with generous dark cherries on a firmly tannic palate. Concentrated black plum, graphite, black pepper, coffee bean, pine resin and oak toast flavors on a full body. The tannins are powerful and fine-grained, shaping the texture significantly at this stage. Drinkable now, but best from 2030.

duval-plexus-shiraz-grenache-mourvedre.title: John Duval Concilio Grenache Shiraz
duval-plexus-shiraz-grenache-mourvedre.bodyHtml:
A vibrant Barossa red led by old-vine Grenache with a smaller portion of Shiraz. Bright raspberry, cherry and cranberry fruit meets savoury spice, with a soft, medium-bodied palate and juicy freshness. Fine tannins and subtle earthy complexity carry the fruit through a smooth, food-friendly finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled lamb cutlets, roasted pork shoulder, barbecue ribs, or charcuterie.

yangarra-gsm-2017.title: Yangarra GSM 2017 750ml
yangarra-gsm-2017.bodyHtml: Yangarra Estate Vineyard GSM 2017 is a blend of Grenache, Shiraz and Mourvèdre from the Blewitt Springs district of McLaren Vale, South Australia. The estate was established in 2001 when the Jackson family bought the historic Lalla Rookh property, whose oldest vines were planted in 1946. Today it covers about 87 hectares, led by Grenache and Shiraz, and is farmed biodynamically. Under winemaker Peter Fraser, Yangarra focuses on single-vineyard estate wines with a clear sense of place, shaped by McLaren Vale's Mediterranean climate of warm, dry summers and cool, wet winters. 750ml, 15% ABV.

delas-freres-hermitage-les-bessards.title: Delas Les Bessards Hermitage 2018 750ml
delas-freres-hermitage-les-bessards.bodyHtml:
The wine is a brilliant, deep red hue with lots of depth. The nose shows great class, with soft aromas of blackberries and violets. Hermitage "Les Bessards" shows plenty of concentration in its fruit. This is a wine with a particularly dense tannic structure, and extremely good balance.

98 Points by The Wine Advocate

Boasting classic Les Bessards notes of sun-warmed cassis and crushed stone, the 2018 Hermitage Les Bessards has turned out to be a magnificent wine—a close rival to the potentially perfect 2015. Full-bodied and velvety, concentrated and tannic, overflowing with notes of grilled plums, grilled meat and black olives, it's all topped off by a forever finish that remains fresh and cleansing, courtesy of lingering salted-licorice flavors and the texture of finely ground stone dust. Try a bottle after 2025, if you can wait that long.

97 Points by Wine Enthusiast

Les Bessards is a single-vineyard selection limited to 6,000 majestic bottles in any vintage it's produced. Made from 100% Syrah, its black-cherry coulis and crème de cassis flavors are spicy, marked by hits of scorched anise and peppercorn. Anchored by zesty acidity and a bristling mineral undertow, it's a structured red wrapped in tannins that feel feel fierce now but should meld from 2023. The wine will improve well through 2035 and hold much longer still.

96 Points by Wine Spectator

This is packed with intense dark fig, blackberry and boysenberry reduction flavors that show a subtle singed alder thread as they assert themselves, weaving around while mouthwatering anise and bay leaf notes filter through. The finish shows a late echo of scorched earth, with the fruit keeping pace. A dense and muscular wine, yet with superb detail. One for the cellar. Best from 2024 through 2038.

dleas-freres-cote-rotie-la-landonne.title: Delas Freres Cote-Rotie La Landonne 2018 750ml
dleas-freres-cote-rotie-la-landonne.bodyHtml: The wine‘s deep color is underscored by plummy hues. A complex nose shows deep, fruity aromas with hints of licorice and roasted coffee. Endowed with a dense and silky tannic structure, this is a full, fleshy wine that provides an ample and generous palate. Its lasting finish speaks of considerable ageing potential.

dry-creek-the-mariner.title: Dry Creek Chenin Blanc
dry-creek-the-mariner.bodyHtml:
A crisp California Chenin Blanc with honeydew melon, white peach, Meyer lemon, pear, mango, orange blossom, honeysuckle, and chamomile. Fresh acidity and subtle creaminess create a lively yet rounded palate, with clean fruit character and a refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Enjoy with oysters, grilled seafood, sushi, Asian cuisine, fresh salads, roast chicken, soft cheeses, or lightly spiced dishes.

sartori-valpolicella-ripasso-doc.title: Sartori Di Verona Valpolicella Ripasso 2021 750ml
sartori-valpolicella-ripasso-doc.bodyHtml:
Vineyard selection of the best grape bunches. The grapes are subsequently pressed gently, followed by skin maceration at low temperature for 8-10 days. The fresh wine then goes through the unique “ripasso” process, wherein it is passed through the pomace of Amarone. During this second fermentation, the wine receives from the dried pomace part of the characteristics that are typical of Amarone. After the malolactic fermentation, the refinement of about 12-18months begins, which also includes medium and large barrels. After bottling the wine rests for at least 6 months in the bottle. 

It goes perfectly with savory first courses such as risotto with porcini mushrooms, grilled meats, roasts, and medium-aged cheeses.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"This Ripasso offers an inviting nose of ripe cherry, dark plum, and a distinct note of bitter chocolate. On the palate, it is warm and generously flavored, with a velvety texture and a satisfying, medium-bodied finish that speaks to its skillful appassimento technique."


91 Points - James Suckling
"A well-made and approachable Ripasso, bursting with aromas of morello cherry and sweet spice. It is round and fleshy on the palate, with soft, well-integrated tannins and a clean, fruity aftertaste that makes it both easy to enjoy and an excellent companion for food."

john-duval-eligo-shiraz.title: John Duval Eligo Shiraz 2019 750ml
john-duval-eligo-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Released only from the best Barossa vintages, a meticulous selection of the most exceptional Shiraz we can produce. The latest release  displays the palate texture, length and restrained power that has defined this wine since the inaugural 2005 vintage release.

97 Points - James Halliday 

Fermentation with submerged cap; up to two weeks on skins, then matured for 18 months in French hogsheads (55% new). Opaque purple; incredible depths to the velvety black fruits that run on oiled stainless steel rails, making it impossible to deny.

henschke-keyneton-estate-euphonium.title: Henschke Keyneton Euphonium 2021 750ml
henschke-keyneton-estate-euphonium.bodyHtml: Henschke Keyneton Euphonium 2021 is a red blend from Henschke, the family winery founded in 1868 and run today by fifth-generation winemaker Stephen Henschke with viticulturist Prue Henschke. Keyneton Euphonium is built on Shiraz from vines up to 50 years old grown in the Eden and Barossa valleys, blended with Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Merlot. The label names the Barossa as its region, and the wine is part of Henschke's Vineyard Selection range. This 2021 vintage comes in a 750ml bottle at 14.5% ABV and is sealed with a screw cap.

vietti-barbaresco-masseria.title: Marchesi di Gresy Barbaresco Martinenga 2019
vietti-barbaresco-masseria.bodyHtml:
In the heart of Barbaresco appellation, Martinenga is among the most important MeGA of the area, confining with Asili, on the western side, and Rabaja, towards northeast. 

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Always a classical wine, the Tenute Cisa Asinari dei Marchesi di Gresy 2021 Barbaresco Martinenga brings us the sharpness and power of an epic vintage. This wine has a medium-dark luminous color and is light on its feet. The aromas are bright and lively with fresh berry and cassis. The oak contouring is delicate, and the wine benefits structurally from healthy skins, grapes and pulp. There is a delightful hint of Nebbiolo sweetness on the close.

94 Points - James Suckling

A graceful style for this wine, showing strawberries, blood oranges, peachy vibrancy and mint. Medium-bodied on the palate, it has gentle tannins with woven acidity and overall freshness. The superpolished aftertaste is juicy, youthful and flavorful. A contemporary Barbaresco. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine's nose offers a delightful blend of cranberry and cherry, accompanied by a whisper of rose, palo santo, and dried herbs. On the palate, it shines with the richness of wild berry jam and the comforting warmth of black tea. Its bright finish, reminiscent of cherry skin, adds a final touch of elegance, ensuring an assured and regal experience.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
A racy style, this red delivers cherry, raspberry and sweet spice flavors, with touches of eucalyptus, all matched to a solid base of tannins. Ends with notes of coffee and spices. Best from 2027 through 2040.

portal-gran-reserva.title: Quinta do Portal Grande Reserva 2019
portal-gran-reserva.bodyHtml:
Quinta do Portal Grande Reserva 2019 is an exceptional, full-bodied Portuguese red wine produced from select old-vine parcels in the heart of the Douro Valley. Matured in French oak barrels, it exhibits a dark ruby-violet color with complex aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis, wild violet, and dark chocolate, complemented by subtle notes of cedar and toasted oak. On the palate, it is dense, rich, and beautifully structured, balancing deep black fruit flavors with firm, refined tannins, vibrant acidity, and a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted leg of lamb, grilled ribeye steak, wild boar ragù, venison roast, and aged hard sheep's milk cheeses.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Eighteen months in old wood have left a wine that has firm tannins and rich fruit. Its concentration, from the blend of Touriga Nacional, Tinta Roriz and Touriga Franca, is impressive. This powerfully expressive wine will be ready to drink from 2025.

91 Points - James Suckling

Dark cherries, plums, blackcurrants and rosemary on the nose. Full-bodied with fine tannins. Plush and balanced with a velvety texture and a fruity, delicious finish. 60% Touriga Nacional, 30% Tinta Roriz and 10% Touriga Franca. Drink or hold.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Grande Reserva is mostly a 60/30 blend of Touriga Nacional and Tinta Roriz, with 10% Touriga Franca, aged for 14 months in new French oak. It comes in at 14.8% alcohol. The Portal red blends have been lovely and succulent this year, wines everyone will enjoy, but they mostly also are a little soft, making me wonder if they have the wherewithal to age and improve. In the $22 price range, I might say, "Who cares?" That's not really part of my analysis in terms of whether I want to buy a red wine in that price range. At $60, that's another calculation. Here, too, there needs to be a bit more evidence of developmental abilities, but this is certainly the best structured of the red blends this issue. It has more firmness on the finish, while still seeming surprisingly soft for such a young, upper-level wine. That said, it certainly lingers more on the finish than its red-blend siblings this issue. It has some finesse and persistence to go with the big fruit. On the whole, this is a success. It needs to show more after cellaring to become a bigger one, but let's start here for the moment.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Fragrant, with hints of black licorice and crushed pine, this chewy, medium- to full-bodied red features flavors of crème de cassis, plum sauce, hot stone, orange peel and black tea. Firm, spiced finish. Touriga Nacional, Tinta Roriz and Touriga Franca. Drink now through 2028.

mr-blacks-concoction-shiraz-viognier.title: Small Gully Mr. Black's Concoction Shiraz-Viognier 2015 750ml
mr-blacks-concoction-shiraz-viognier.bodyHtml: Small Gully Mr. Black's Concoction Shiraz - Viognier 2015 750ml

domaines-de-la-janasse-cnp-red.title: Domaine de la Janasse Chateauneuf-du-Pape 2020 750ml
domaines-de-la-janasse-cnp-red.bodyHtml:
• 94 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
    A terrific wine that harkens back to the 2016, the 2020 Chateauneuf du Pape delivers black cherries, blackberries and black olives, plus intriguing notes of garrigue. Full-bodied, rich and silky, it finishes long, with a wash of softly dusty tannins.
    Barrel Sample: 92-94

 

  • 93 Points Jeb Dunnuck

    The classic 2020 Châteauneuf Du Pape from this team is a winner, offering a medium to full-bodied, finesse-driven style as well as terrific aromatics of darker berries, raspberries, garrigue, and flowers, with a kiss of background peppery spice. It's balanced, medium to full-bodied, has ripe, soft tannins, and is loaded with character. Drink bottles over the coming 10-15 years. Best after 2022.

  • 93 Points Vinous

    Offering up enticing aromas of very ripe red and black fruits, dried herbs, licorice and hints of white pepper, the complex 2020 Châteauneuf-du-Pape is full-bodied, muscular and firmly structured. Already drinking well today, it will develop a wide array of tertiary characteristics after a few more years in bottle.

chateau-rousselle-aoc-cotes-de-bourg.title: Chateau Rousselle Cotes De Bourg 2019 750ml
chateau-rousselle-aoc-cotes-de-bourg.bodyHtml: A wine that finds a perfect balance between fruit tannins and wood tannins. The aromas of red and black fruits - raspberry, blueberry, cherry - are enriched by the licorice tones of Merlot, to which are added spicy notes of wild dry herbs - thyme, rosemary - and mineral notes of the terroir.

kenwood-jack-london-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
kenwood-jack-london-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon is a quintessential, fruit-forward California wine crafted from a multi-appellation blend of primarily mountain and hillside vineyards in Sonoma and Mendocino counties. On the nose, it reveals an inviting and lush bouquet of black cherry, ripe blackberry, and cassis, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of dried culinary herbs, mocha, and toasted vanilla. The palate is medium-bodied and robust yet exceptionally supple, offering a round mid-palate framed by smooth, seamless tannins. Artisan winemaking techniques, including extended maceration and careful maturation in a mix of French and American oak barrels, impart a balanced structural backbone without overpowering the fruit, culminating in an elegant, velvety finish.

 

Food Pairing: Pairs excellently with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, savory mushroom risotto, hearty lasagna, and aged cheeses like sharp cheddar or Gouda.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This complete and well-balanced wine is a pleasure to drink soon, but will also develop more nuances for a few years. Fresh blackberries and blueberries are accented by light vanilla and cinnamon-scented oak spices on a lightly tannic texture.

louis-latour-grand-ardeche-chardonnay.title: Louis Latour Grand Ardeche Chardonnay 2023
louis-latour-grand-ardeche-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Louis Latour Grand Ardèche Chardonnay 2023 is a sophisticated white wine that demonstrates the Maison's ability to apply traditional Burgundian winemaking techniques to the sun-drenched terroir of the Ardèche. This wine is treated exactly like a premier cru from the Côte d’Or: the grapes are harvested at peak maturity, fermented in oak barrels, and aged for approximately ten months in toasted French oak. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of ripe yellow apple, honey, and vanilla, accented by subtle toasted notes. The palate is rich and buttery yet balanced by a refreshing acidity, showcasing flavours of tropical fruit, almond, and a touch of spice. This 2023 vintage maintains a beautiful harmony between the ripeness of the southern fruit and the elegant structure provided by the oak maturation.

painted-rock-merlot-estate-grown.title: Painted Rock Estate Grown Merlot 2020
painted-rock-merlot-estate-grown.bodyHtml: Chocolate, figs and dark cherries and vanilla jump out of the glass. Well balanced and rounded on the palate, the red fruit journey continues with added baking spices and a subtle orange peel note.

baron-de-ley-7-vinas-reserva.title: Baron De Ley Siete Vinas Reserva Rioja 2017
baron-de-ley-7-vinas-reserva.bodyHtml:
Barón de Ley Siete Viñas Reserva is a unique "Slow Rioja" and a tribute to biodiversity, crafted from a single 70-year-old vineyard containing all seven authorized Rioja grape varieties: Tempranillo, Graciano, Garnacha Tinta, Mazuelo, Viura, Malvasía, and Garnacha Blanca. This complex blend undergoes four separate vinifications before aging for 36 months in various oak casks and an additional 12 months in large French oak foudres. The resulting wine displays an elegant cherry colour with ruby hues, offering a fragrant bouquet of ripe berries, roses, and violets accented by hints of black cherry, butterscotch, and ground anise. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and rich in nuances with silky tannins and a tobacco undertone

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A blend of Tempranillo and six other varieties including tiny amounts of three white grapes, this wine has aromas of cherry, caramel and lilac. A bold floral note underlies flavors of black cherry, pomegranate, milk chocolate, butterscotch, licorice and black tea set into generous tannins. The enduring finished is marked with notes of caramel and rose petal.

terra-dalter-alentejano-outeiro-2018.title: Terra D'Alter Alentejano Outeiro 2019 750ml
terra-dalter-alentejano-outeiro-2018.bodyHtml:
50% of Syrah and Petit Verdot, from a high vineyard. Coffee and earth, pepper and spice, and I love the lift on this with some herbal and cool game notes, but really all about the black fruit again. There's a sophisticated layer of creamy but also fragrant oak, adding vanilla and more spices, but a lovely freshness again, and a big, dry tannin background. Lovely again, and so layered and complex.

Pairs best with Red Meats, Roast Beef and Grilled Meats.

90 Points - Wine Advocate

Dense red-ruby, purple meniscus. Aroma Great intensity with red and black fruit with notes of spices and mocha. Palate Notes of red and black fruit, good acidity, structure and great complexity. Abundant tannins, fine grained, with creamy palate from barrel fermentation. A steel fist in a velvet glove.

la-spinetta-barbaresco-bordini.title: La Spinetta Barbaresco Bordini 2022 750ml
la-spinetta-barbaresco-bordini.bodyHtml: Fresh, elegant, seductive. An explosion of fresh perfumes, with raspberry and rose nuances. Red fruit flavors well integrated with aromatic, light and delicate aromas. Fine tannins and breathtaking elegance.

cherry-pie-pinot-noir.title: Cherry Pie San Pablo Bay Block Pinot Noir 2022
cherry-pie-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The 2022 San Pablo Bay Block opens with aromatics with notes of ripe cherry, cedar and vanilla cream. The palate is layered with bright red fruit, currant and pomegranate framed by baking spices with a subtle hint of vanilla that leads to a lingering, caramel-kissed finish.

Tucked within a larger vineyard estate in Napa Valley’s Carneros AVA are several blocks of vines producing singularly distinctive Pinot Noir. Marine-influenced by morning fog from the San Pablo Bay just to the south and the cool evening wind gap from the Pacific Ocean farther to the west, the blocks are sheltered in a rolling swale which warms considerably during the daytime. As a result of this dramatic diurnal shift, the grapes display lush, ripe fruit balanced with bright acidity. Cherry Pie San Pablo Bay Block Pinot Noir is produced from this site.

robert-keenan-chardonnay-spring-mountain.title: Barnett Vineyards Spring Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
robert-keenan-chardonnay-spring-mountain.bodyHtml:
Barnett Vineyards Spring Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a powerful, expressive, and mountain-grown Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon crafted from steep estate vineyards high on Spring Mountain. Visually displaying a deep ruby-purple core with vibrant violet rim highlights, it opens with an intense and aromatic bouquet of ripe cassis, dark plum, and black cherry, harmoniously integrated with nuances of sweet cocoa, crushed graphite, dried sage, and toasted French oak. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied structure supported by firm, fine-grained mountain tannins and a vibrant core of natural acidity, offering rich layers of dark berry fruit, dark chocolate, and subtle spice that flow into a long, structured, and elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison, and aged hard cheeses like gouda.

93 Points - James Suckling

A tightly focused, intense and structured red that should get even better with time. Dense layers of black cherries, cocoa, spearmint and iron on the palate, lifted by lively, fine-grained and persistent tannins. Tempting to drink now but best from 2030.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

There are just 120 cases of Barnett's 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon Spring Mountain District, sourced from their own property and the neighboring York Creek Vineyards, so readers may have to move quickly to grab some. This medium- to full-bodied wine is fresh, juicy, open-knit and easy to drink already, with notes of cigar wrapper, black cherries, cassis and bay leaf that linger on the long, mouthwatering finish.

louis-martini-alexander-valley-cabernet.title: Louis Martini Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021/2022
louis-martini-alexander-valley-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Louis M. Martini Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a classic, richly layered California red wine crafted by historic Napa Valley producer Louis M. Martini Winery. Sourced from select mountain and benchland vineyards across the Napa Valley, the 2019 blend is composed of 89% Cabernet Sauvignon, 4% Merlot, 3% Petit Verdot, 3% Cabernet Franc, and 1% Malbec, aged in French and American oak barrels to integrate sweet barrel spice with concentrated dark fruit. In the glass, it displays a deep, saturated ruby-garnet hue. The aromatic bouquet opens with expressive notes of ripe blackberry, blackcurrant, and blueberry layered with dried herbs, cedarwood, mocha, and well-integrated oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a rich, full-bodied mouthfeel framed by velvety, fine-grained tannins and bright natural freshness, culminating in a long, smooth finish accented by hints of dark chocolate and torn mint.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, herb-marinated leg of lamb, braised beef short ribs, grilled Portobello mushrooms, or aged sharp cheddar cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

Currant, green pine-cone and bark aromas follow through to a medium body with fine tannins and a creamy texture. Reserved at the end. Very fine and elegant.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Layered and lavish, this superconcentrated wine blankets dark chocolate, dried blueberries and mocha flavors in thick, velvety tannins for a powerful effect that lasts through a lingering finish. Best through 2033.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe, but with freshness to help carry off the well-laden core of blackberry, boysenberry and black cherry compote. Reveals a nice backdrop of singed alder and mesquite as well as licorice snap, with good underlying juiciness. Best from 2023 through 2036.

bellingham-bernard-old-vine-chenin-blanc.title: Bellingham The Bernard Series Old Vine Chenin Blanc 2025
bellingham-bernard-old-vine-chenin-blanc.bodyHtml:
Bellingham The Bernard Series Old Vine Chenin Blanc 2025 is an exceptional, lavishly perfumed white wine crafted from low-yielding, certified heritage bush vines averaging over 35 to 45 years of age. Sourced from premier high-altitude and coastal vineyards across South Africa's Western Cape, this hand-harvested cuvée undergoes whole-bundle pressing and barrel maturation in French oak with regular lees stirring (bâtonnage). In the glass, it shows a brilliant pale gold color with a delicate green tint. The highly aromatic and complex nose unfolds with bold layers of ripe tropical fruits, grilled pineapples, fresh peaches, and lemon curd, beautifully accented by fragrant honeysuckle, sweet baking spices, vanilla, and a distinct flinty mineral undertone. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, fleshy, and broad, yet balanced beautifully by Chenin Blanc's signature line of vibrant natural acidity. A concentrated, fruit-dense core of melon, stone fruit, and cream seamlessly carries through to a long, textured, and slightly spicy finish showing sophisticated oak integration.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with almond-crusted sea bass, pan-seared scallops, roasted chicken breast in a creamy mushroom sauce, Quiche Lorraine, and mature semi-hard cheeses like Gruyère.

90 Points - Decanter

Nectarine, white peach and guava aromas with lemon curd and leesy nuance, revealing crisp fruit, creamy softness and crisp acidity.

cabernet-sauvignon-de-purcari.title: Chateau Purcari Cabernet Sauvignon De Purcari 2022 750ml
cabernet-sauvignon-de-purcari.bodyHtml: Château Purcari Cabernet Sauvignon de Purcari 2022 comes from Purcari, the historic winery in the Republic of Moldova whose label records its founding in 1827. It is a dry red, aged in French oak, with blackcurrant, black cherry and spice, velvety tannins and a long, slightly savoury finish. 750ml, 12.8% alcohol.

merlot-de-purcari.title: Chateau Purcari Merlot De Purcari 2022
merlot-de-purcari.bodyHtml:
Luscious dark fruit notes dominate the nose including cassis, blackberries and ripe black cherries along with subtle hints of dark chocolate and tobacco leaf. On the palate the tannins are smooth and well-rounded and there are ample fruit flavours which linger on the tongue. The fruit-forward flavour profile makes it a great match for smoked duck breast, veal, charcuterie or a pork steak.

It is perfect with grilled meats, roasted duck, veal dishes, and aged cheeses. Serve at 18-20°C.

chardonnay-de-purcari.title: Chateau Purcari Chardonnay De Purcari 2022 750ml
chardonnay-de-purcari.bodyHtml: Château Purcari Chardonnay de Purcari 2022 comes from Purcari, the historic winery in the Republic of Moldova whose label records its founding in 1827. It is made from 100% Chardonnay, from grapes harvested and selected by hand, using traditional methods. Suggested pairings include fresh cheese, salads and grilled turbot. 750ml, 12.8% alcohol.

barolo-via-nouva-2014.title: Giribaldi Ravera Barolo 2014
barolo-via-nouva-2014.bodyHtml:
Giribaldi Ravera Barolo 2014 is an organic, austere, and traditional Italian red wine produced from Nebbiolo grapes grown in the acclaimed Ravera cru of Novello. Displaying a clear ruby-red hue with garnet highlights, it opens with an aromatic nose featuring scents of wild berries, balsamic nuances, wet stones, dried flowers, and subtle dark chocolate. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied structure supported by firm, fine-grained tannins and bright natural acidity, showing vibrant cherry, crushed earth, and warm oak spices that flow into a persistent, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with braised beef, osso buco, wild boar ragù, roasted lamb, truffle risotto, and aged hard cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano.

barolo-cannubi-2014.title: E. Pira e Figli Chiara Boschis Cannubi Barolo 2020
barolo-cannubi-2014.bodyHtml:
Barolo Cannubi by Francesco Rinaldi & Figl is an elegant expression of this famous red wide, made with 100% Nebbiolo grapes coming from Cannubi cru in Baorlo. It's a strong, classic wine, with an excellent ageing potential. In the glass it is ruby red with bright maroon shades. The bouquet is intense, wide, floral and fruity, with hints of cherry, ripe strawberry, plum, sweet spices and dried flowers. The sip is vigorous, balanced with great persistence and soft tannic texture. Barolo Cannubi by Francesco Rinaldi & Figli is recommended with red meat, roasts, game and matured cheese.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The E. Pira e Figli - Chiara Boschis 2020 Barolo Cannubi is a fine and delicate wine, although there is a little more grit and richness in this warm vintage. The quality of the fruit is exceptional, especially its crisp ripeness. Dark cherry, blackcurrant, rose blossom, pink pepper and white limestone add considerable high-toned notes. The freshness is great and the fruit stays juicy, fueling a long, elegant finish. Only 4,000 bottles were made.

97 Points - James Suckling

Nervy and complex nose with excellent depth. Oranges, nutmeg, steel, mineral and a touch of white pepper and oyster shell. Broad and expansive on the palate with very structured, chalky tannins that extend to a lengthy, mineral finish. Long and youthful. From organically grown grapes. Can drink now, but better from 2027.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A well of pure cherry bubbles up in this red, complemented by rose, strawberry, mineral, wet pine and underbrush aromas and flavors. Though exuding finesse, this is layered with chalky tannins, yet still extends with a kaleidoscope of red fruit, mineral and savory notes on the long finish. Best from 2028 through 2046. 3,330 cases made, 1,110 cases imported.

uccelliera-rapace-igt-toscana-rosso.title: Uccelliera Rapace Toscana 2019 750ml
uccelliera-rapace-igt-toscana-rosso.bodyHtml:
Marked tannins but very smooth, soft and structured, well blending with the woods with which it is refined.

Pairs well with first courses with a savory sauce, meat, cheeses and in general with savory foods.

Blend: 70% Sangiovese, 20% Merlot, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This is finding its sweet spot, with sappy cherry and blackberry fruit accented by rose hip, leather, orange peel and sweet spice aromas and flavors. Harmonious and juicy, with a lingering aftertaste. Sangiovese, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. Drink now through 2038.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of 70% Sangiovese, 20% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2019 Rapace opens to a medium-dark color and nice concentration that is not too heavy and not too light (although the 15% alcohol content is a lot). It's perfect as an all-meal option or a versatile wine that can pair with everything from appetizers to meat-based mains. The bouquet offers dark fruit and plum. Those primary aromas are framed by sweet spice, cedar and tobacco. Those oak elements work to create greater depth and texture in the wine. This is a production of 10,365 bottles and 484 magnums.

91 Points - James Suckling
A medium-to full-bodied red with currant and plum character and some sandalwood. Rather chewy tannins. Fresh at the end.

lan-reserva.title: Bodegas Lan Reserva 2019
lan-reserva.bodyHtml:
Bodegas LAN Reserva 2019 is an elegant, well-structured, and classic expression of Rioja, crafted primarily from carefully selected Tempranillo vines with an average age of 30 years, complemented by small proportions of Mazuelo and Graciano. Cultivated in alluvial and clay-limestone soils across the Rioja Alta and Rioja Alavesa subzones, the hand-harvested grapes undergo temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks, followed by extended maceration to extract optimal color and fine tannins. The wine is aged for 20 months in the estate’s signature hybrid barrels—featuring American oak staves for delicate sweetness and French oak bottoms for subtle spice and structure—before resting for an additional 20 months in bottle prior to release. In the glass, it displays an intense, brilliant ruby-red core with garnet reflections. The bouquet is complex and harmonious, revealing ripe aromas of red and black cherries, wild blackberries, and plum compote, gracefully interwoven with nuances of sweet vanilla, cedar wood, clove, roasted cocoa, and subtle earthy forest floor. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full body characterized by polished, fine-grained tannins, fresh and balancing natural acidity, and a fleshy, savory fruit core that unfolds into a long, persistent, and delicately spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled lamb chops, roast beef, braised beef short ribs, pork tenderloin, cured Iberian meats, and aged Manchego or Idiazábal cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Spiced plums, dark cherries and wet earth funk with some hazelnuts and chocolate. Juicy and firm with medium body and nicely chewy tannins. Long finish. Drink from 2026.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe black cherry and black plum fruit flavors are laced with lavish hints of vanilla, tar and cedar in this dark, deep red, animated by mandarin orange peel acidity. The lingering finish, trimmed by fine, taut tannins, offers medicinal herb and mineral details. Tempranillo, Mazuelo and Graciano. Drink now through 2035.

marques-carmenere.title: Marques de Casa Concha Carmenere 2023
marques-carmenere.bodyHtml:
Deep violet red. An intense, pure Carmenère, packed with blueberries and wild berries. Floral hints like violets and a pinch of roast red pepper. Fruity and flavorful with delicious acidity, sweet, friendly tannins and a long, creamy finish.

This pairs with all types of red meat, mature cheese and typical Chilean cuisine.

91 Points - James Suckling

A spicy nose of olives and some charcoal. Medium-bodied with round, juicy tannins and a lightly saline touch in the finish. The tannins are soft-grained and almost chalky.

los-colmillos-tinta-del-toro.title: Ernesto del Palacio Tinta de Toro Joven
los-colmillos-tinta-del-toro.bodyHtml:
A youthful and expressive red wine from Toro, showcasing vibrant aromas of blackberry, plum, cherry, and subtle spice. The palate is fresh and fruit-driven with soft tannins, balanced acidity, and a smooth finish that highlights the character of the region's native grape.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled meats, burgers, roast pork, tapas, cured meats, and semi-aged cheeses.

tenuta-frescobaldi-di-castiglioni-toscan.title: Frescobaldi CastelGiocondo Brunello di Montalcino 2021
tenuta-frescobaldi-di-castiglioni-toscan.bodyHtml:
Frescobaldi CastelGiocondo Brunello di Montalcino 2021 is an elegant Tuscan red wine produced from 100% Sangiovese at the historic CastelGiocondo estate in Montalcino. Grown across vineyards with diverse clay, marl, and sandy soils, this distinguished Brunello combines ripe red fruit with floral elegance and savoury complexity. Aromas of black cherry, wild berries, violets, and tobacco lead into a beautifully structured palate with polished tannins and refreshing acidity. Extended oak maturation contributes depth and harmony, while a long, persistent finish highlights the wine's excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Braised short ribs, roasted lamb, wild boar ragù, grilled ribeye steak, porcini mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, aged Pecorino Toscano, and traditional Tuscan dishes.

95 Points - James Suckling

Very attractive aromas of red cherries, mushrooms and flowers follow through to a medium body with firm and integrated tannins and a vivid, subtle, fruity finish. A lovely young Brunello that you can enjoy now or age for many years to come. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Black cherry and black currant flavors are the main themes in this intense red, with iron and wild herbs adding complexity. Balanced and vibrant, with resonant tannins guarding the long aftertaste. This feels more modern in style, with an emphasis on bright fruit. Best from 2030 through 2047.

coho-stanly-ranch-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir 2021
coho-stanly-ranch-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Kosta Browne Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir 2021 is a masterful exploration of one of California’s most dramatic cool-climate regions. Sourced from prestigious vineyards defined by maritime fog and transverse mountain ranges, this vintage captures the signature tension and intensity of the area. It offers a captivating bouquet of wild strawberries, hibiscus, and crushed pomegranate, layered with nuanced notes of orange zest and dried thyme. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and vibrantly structured, showcasing a core of bright red fruit supported by ultra-fine tannins and a distinct saline minerality. The finish is remarkably long and energetic, reflecting the cool, wind-swept terroir of the Sta. Rita Hills.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This beloved brand manages to click a lot of Pinot Noir boxes in each bottling, including the spice, herb and fruit combo of strawberry, cherry, cinnamon stick and bay leaf on the nose. The palate is ripe and expressive with cherry compote flavors that are enhanced by a toasted pecan warmth and leathery grip.

93 Points - James Suckling

A subtle and pretty pinot with a lovely middle palate with a fine dusty tannin texture to it. Medium body and succulent with a savory finish. Orange peel. Lovely finish. This is very tame.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Matured for 15 months in 52% new oak, the 2021 Pinot Noir Sta. Rita Hills has a very pretty expression this vintage. The nose features detailed scents of blueberries, strawberries, Earl Grey tea leaves and forest floor, and the medium-bodied palate offers generous, perfumed fruit on a delicate frame, finishing long and layered.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Tasty, with a large core of succulent cherry and blackberry fruit notes laced with a light briar note, all backed by subtle mesquite and savory elements on the racy finish.

girard-artistry-red-napa-valley.title: Schrader Double Diamond Proprietary Red 2021
girard-artistry-red-napa-valley.bodyHtml:
Schrader Double Diamond Proprietary Red 2021 is the inaugural release of this richly layered, approachable Napa Valley Bordeaux-style red blend crafted by winemaker Thomas Rivers Brown for Schrader Cellars. Composed of 50% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot, and 25% Cabernet Franc sourced from premier Napa Valley vineyards, it captures the concentration and freshness of the acclaimed 2021 growing season. Aged in French oak barrels to integrate refined barrel complexity without overshadowing varietal purity, it pours a deep, saturated ruby-garnet hue in the glass. The aromatic profile opens with expressive notes of ripe black cherry, blueberry, and cassis layered with hints of mint, bay leaf, dark chocolate, and sandalwood. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, sleek mouthfeel framed by balanced natural acidity and fine-grained, velvety tannins, culminating in a long, savory, and floral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, herb-roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, seared venison medallions, or aged sharp cheddar cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

This Bordeaux-style blend is elegant, approachable and packed with beautiful black fruit. Black cherries, blueberries and hints of mint and bay leaves are wrapped in fine-grained tannins for a sleek texture. 50% cabernet sauvignon, 25% merlot and 25% cabernet franc. it’s a new product from Schrader. Drink or hold.

chateau-dissan.title: Chateau d'Issan 2017 750ml
chateau-dissan.bodyHtml: The 2017 Chateau D'Issan offers more of everything, with a deep ruby/plum color and rocking notes of black raspberries, cassis, spring flowers, violets, loamy earth, and dried tobacco. Beautifully textured, elegant, and finesse-oriented, it has excellent tannins, medium to full body, and an outstanding finish.

chateau-margaux.title: Chateau Margaux 2006 750ml
chateau-margaux.bodyHtml:
This wine has an extraordinary aromatic finesse, a tannic richness and a particularly dense and tight-knit texture. The finish is very long, fresh and lively, a little bit firm but already packed with flavor. Such balance is a brilliant expression of Chateau Margaux's noble terroir.

95 Points - Wine Advocate
The 2006 Château Margaux remains a very youthful wine, unfurling in the decanter and glass with a deep bouquet of blackcurrants, cigar wrapper, black truffles, loamy soil and nicely integrated new oak. Medium to full-bodied, deep and concentrated, with a rich and vibrant core of fruit, lively acids and refined but authoritative tannins, it's a rather powerful, elegantly muscular Margaux that's still a decade from maturity.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This is not a big Château Margaux, its style showing more elegance and discretion. The tannins are soft, although producing a dense web that lies underneath the black currant and plum fruit flavors. It is a wine that envelops the mouth, an edge of firmness over velvet fruit textures. The wine floats away slowly on the close.

chateau-perron.title: Chateau Perron Lalande-De-Pomerol 2020
chateau-perron.bodyHtml:
Château Perron Lalande-de-Pomerol 2020 is an elegant, balanced, and classic Right Bank red wine. It presents a profound garnet-red color and opens with inviting aromas of red berries, sour cherry, menthol, and oak spice. The palate is supple and delicate, featuring velvety tannins, flavors of fresh currant and blackberry, and a lingering, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs excellently with roast lamb, prime beef, duck breast, or aged cheeses.

90 Points - James Suckling

Fresh currants, blackberries, bay leaves and chili chocolate on the nose. It’s medium-bodied with sleek tannins. Savory and balanced. Merlot, cabernet sauvignon and cabernet franc. Drink in 2024.

poplar-grove-chardonnay.title: Poplar Grove Chardonnay 2025
poplar-grove-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Poplar Grove Chardonnay 2025 is a Canadian white wine from British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Known for its balance of vibrant fruit and gentle oak influence, Poplar Grove Chardonnay offers an appealing combination of orchard fruit, citrus, and subtle toasted notes. The winery's established Chardonnay style brings together stainless steel fermentation and selective French oak treatment, creating a refreshing yet textured wine suited to both casual enjoyment and food pairing.

Food Pairing: Roasted chicken, grilled salmon, seared scallops, creamy mushroom pasta, lobster, roasted vegetables, and soft cheeses.

pinot-noir-de-purcari.title: Chateau Purcari Pinot Noir De Purcari 2022 750ml
pinot-noir-de-purcari.bodyHtml: Pinot Noir de Purcari 2022 is a dry red from Château Purcari in the Ștefan Vodă region of Moldova, an estate whose wines have won awards at international competitions including Decanter, the Challenge International du Vin and the Concours Mondial de Bruxelles. The grapes are harvested and selected by hand, the wine is made by traditional methods and it is aged for six months in French oak barriques. Purcari describes it as light and delicate, with a purplish-red colour and a layered bouquet of strawberry, raspberry and violet. Pair it with lamb, mushroom and asparagus dishes or Gruyère. 750ml, 13% ABV.

200-monges-gran-reserva.title: Bodegas Vinicola Real 200 Monges Gran Reserva 2006
200-monges-gran-reserva.bodyHtml: Bodegas Vinicola Real 200 Monges Gran Reserva 2006 is a prestigious, well-aged Rioja red that represents the pinnacle of the estate's slow-aging philosophy. Crafted from a traditional blend of Tempranillo, Garnacha, and Graciano, this wine undergoes an extensive maturation process in both French oak barrels and the bottle to achieve its signature elegance and complexity. The 2006 vintage presents a deep cherry red hue with a slight tawny rim, offering an exceptionally aromatic nose filled with ripe fruit compote, balsamic overtones, and hints of tobacco and cedar. On the palate, it is full-bodied and velvety, showcasing soft tannins and rich nuances of black fruit and licorice that lead to a long, silky finish.

200-monges-seleccion-especial.title: Bodegas Vinicola Real 200 Monges Seleccion Especial Reserva 2006
200-monges-seleccion-especial.bodyHtml: Bodegas Vinícola Real 200 Monges Selección Especial Reserva 2006 is an ultra-premium, single-varietal Rioja crafted from a rigorous selection of the estate's finest Tempranillo grapes. Sourced from vines averaging 50 years of age, the fruit is hand-harvested in small boxes to ensure pristine condition before undergoing fermentation in Allier oak vats. This specific "Special Selection" is aged for 18 to 24 months in new French oak barrels within a rock-hewn cellar, followed by nearly two years of further refinement in the bottle. The 2006 vintage is celebrated for its concentration and balance, offering a complex aromatic profile of black cherries, espresso coffee, mint chocolate, and dark licorice. On the palate, it is full-bodied and robust with firm, well-integrated tannins and a long, velvety finish featuring nuances of cocoa and ripe red plums.

albert-grivault-pommard-clos-blanc.title: Albert Grivault Pommard Clos Blanc 1er Cru 2020 750ml
albert-grivault-pommard-clos-blanc.bodyHtml: Albert Grivault Pommard Premier Cru Clos Blanc 2020 750ml

buoncristiani-napa-valley-chardonnay.title: Buoncristiani Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
buoncristiani-napa-valley-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
95 Points - The Wine Independent

Deep garnet-purple in color, it comes bounding out with exuberant notes of warm cassis, blueberry pie, and chocolate-covered cherries, plus wafts of cinnamon toast. The full-bodied palate is packed with juicy black and blue fruits, supported by velvety tannins and a lively backbone, finishing long and spicy.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
"A quintessential Napa Cabernet, boasting opulent aromas of blackberry liqueur, blueberry, and mocha. Incredibly rich and layered on the palate with a seamless texture and a long, hedonistic finish. A spectacular achievement."

stoneleigh-latitude-sauv-blanc.title: Stoneleigh Latitude Sauv Blanc
stoneleigh-latitude-sauv-blanc.bodyHtml:
Stoneleigh Latitude Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant Marlborough white offering passionfruit, grapefruit, guava, citrus, and tropical fruit. The palate is weighty and textured, with concentrated fruit, clean minerality, fresh acidity, grapefruit pith, and a long, complex finish.

Food Pairing: Pulled pork tacos, fresh lime, coriander, pineapple salsa, mango salsa, grilled seafood, and vibrant citrus-forward dishes.

switchback-ridge-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Switchback Ridge Peterson Family Vineyard Merlot 2017 750ml
switchback-ridge-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Intense aromas of ripe black fruits are complemented by very pretty floral notes. The rich mid-palate is a pleasant flood of texture and flavor with an explosive bright natural acidity. The tannin is quite soft and frames a subtle hint of espresso and toffee in the finish. This Merlot is very Cabernet-like with added fullness in the middle and beautiful balance.

switchback-ridge-merlot.title: Switchback Ridge Peterson Family Vineyard Merlot 2017 750ml
switchback-ridge-merlot.bodyHtml: Intense aromas of ripe black fruits are complemented by very pretty floral notes. The rich mid-palate is a pleasant flood of texture and flavor with an explosive bright natural acidity. The tannin is quite soft and frames a subtle hint of espresso and toffee in the finish. This Merlot is very Cabernet-like with added fullness in the middle and beautiful balance.

rara-neagra-de-purcari.title: Rara Neagra-Saperavi de Purcari
rara-neagra-de-purcari.bodyHtml:
Crafted by the historic Château Purcari in the Ștefan Vodă wine region of southeastern Moldova, 'Maluri de Prut' (Banks of the Prut River) is a red blend showcasing two of Eastern Europe's most intriguing grape varieties: Moldova’s indigenous Rară Neagră and Georgia’s ancient Saperavi. Sourced from vineyards situated along the Prut River, where cool river breezes balance warm sunny days, the grapes are hand-picked and vinified to preserve fruit purity and regional character. Matured in French oak barriques, the wine harmonizes the light, fragrant red-fruit elegance of Rară Neagră with the deep, structured power and dark fruit intensity of Saperavi.

Food Pairing: Grilled lamb chops, roasted pork tenderloin, slow-cooked beef ragù, smoked meats, and aged cheeses.

ridge-petite-sirah-lytton-springs.title: Ridge Lytton Estate Petite Sirah 2021
ridge-petite-sirah-lytton-springs.bodyHtml:
Deep, dark, inky purple in color. Nose of freshly cracked pepper, ripe blackberry, violets, cocoa and minerality. Juicy blue and black fruit on the palate with well coated tannins and a lengthy finish.

93 Points - Decanter

The Ridge Petite Syrah from 115-year-old, gnarly, bush-trained vines at the Lytton Springs estate. Farmed organically and with a deference to the site's tremendous history. The tannins are undeniable in this variety, known for its prominent structure, but Ridge manages to coax elegance from this burly big grape. That said, it is a wine meant to be drunk in time and is likely best after 2030. Big violet aromatics, boysenberries and dashes of white pepper leap forward. The palate shows a depth of fruit, a black peppery character aided by the tannins, with black tea, ripe, juicy fig flesh and notes of tart early-season blackberries finishing long and fresh.

92 Points - Vinous

Comprising 100% Petite Sirah from Ridge’s Lytton Estate in the Dry Creek Valley, the 2021 Petite Sirah Estate is a brooding, savory, forbiddingly tannic red that clubs you over the head with power and intensity. Leather, oil-cured olive, lavender and sappy blackberry fruit run through this particularly rustic, animalistic edition of Lytton Petite. The fruit is plush and velvety beneath the monstrous structure, but it’s going to take a while to settle this beast down.

91 Points - James Suckling

A 100% petite sirah that showcases the variety’s intensity without totally overwhelming your senses. A deep, inky color with potent blueberry syrup and black pepper aromas, then a flood of dark chocolate and blackberry jam that a firm layer of tannins keeps from being sweet. Full-bodied. It will truly benefit from aging. Best after 2029.

kilbeggan-irish-whiskey.title: Kilbeggan Traditional Irish Whiskey
kilbeggan-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Kilbeggan Traditional Irish Whiskey is the core blended whiskey from Kilbeggan, named for the Irish town whose distillery, established in 1757, bills itself on the label as Ireland's oldest continually licensed distillery. The brand describes it as a traditional Irish whiskey double distilled the old way, to keep more flavour while holding on to the classic smoothness Irish whiskey is known for. A blend of malt and grain whiskeys, it is easygoing and honeyed, equally at home neat or in an Irish coffee. Distilled, matured and bottled in Ireland and bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Nose: Clean and fresh, with hints of lemon, honey and barley.

Palate: Smooth and silky, sweet honey over a spicy malt undertone.

Finish: Satisfying and malty.

Serve: Neat, in an Irish Coffee, or in a whiskey sour.

emeritus-vineyards-hallberg-pinot-noir.title: Cambria Julia's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021
emeritus-vineyards-hallberg-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Cambria Julia's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021 is an exceptionally expressive, elegant, and character-driven cool-climate red wine from the heart of Santa Barbara County. Sourced from its namesake estate vineyard—originally planted in 1972 on the ancient alluvial benchmarks of the Santa Maria Valley—this single-vineyard bottling benefits from a uniquely prolonged growing season shaped by consistent Pacific fog and ocean breezes. The fruit is carefully fermented and aged for several months in French oak barrels (a small portion being new) to beautifully synthesize structural depth with pristine varietal purity. In the glass, it reveals a brilliant, translucent ruby color. The highly aromatic and fragrant nose opens with radiant layers of ripe pomegranate, wild strawberries, and dark maraschino cherries, intricately woven with nuance of lavender, fresh rose petals, toasted sage, and a delicate hint of earthy underbrush. On the palate, this medium-bodied Pinot Noir is remarkably vibrant, sleek, and lively, driving juicy cran-raspberry and dark berry flavors over a framework of supple, fine-grained tannins and a crisp line of natural, refreshing acidity before culminating in a long, beautifully balanced, and subtly spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared duck breast, cedar-plank grilled salmon, rustic wild mushroom risotto, or herb-roasted pork tenderloin.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Tart and fresh aromas of red plum, strawberry and lightly toasted sage and marjoram draw the nose into this zesty, widely available bottling. The palate lands with pleasantly brisk cran-pom-raspberry flavors, as lavender and rose petal qualities add nuance.

clos-des-lunes-lune-dargent.title: Clos des Lunes Lune d'Argent 2023
clos-des-lunes-lune-dargent.bodyHtml:
Lune d’Argent is the heart of Clos des Lunes’ production. They firmly believe in the future of this legendary terroir and its truly original style. With a touch of French oak, the Sémillon is dense and rich, the Sauvignon Blanc refined and precise. This cuvée of dry white wine promises to convey all the magic of Sauternes.

The 2023 Lune d'Argent is a refined and vibrant dry white Bordeaux that showcases the unique potential of the Sauternes terroir for non-sweet wines. It presents a pale gold colour with youthful green reflections. The nose is intense and aromatic, offering a complex bouquet of citrus zest, white peach, and exotic fruits like lychee, beautifully accented by floral notes of acacia and linden blossom. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and generous, where the richness of ripe Sémillon is perfectly balanced by the crisp acidity of Sauvignon Blanc. It features a silky texture and a distinctive mineral salinity that leads into a long, precise, and refreshing finish with subtle hints of vanilla from partial oak aging.

93 Points - James Suckling

A timid nose of pears, grapefruit and nectarines with stony austerity. The medium- to full-bodied palate shows precise texture and a growing saline note that adds complexity, turning incisive yet textural.

sartori-amarone-della-valpolicella-doc.title: Sartori Di Verona Amarone della Valpolicella 2020
sartori-amarone-della-valpolicella-doc.bodyHtml: Shimmering ruby. Bouquet of dried fruits, raisins, and cherry compote with cocoa notes. Round and full-bodied; deep fruit flavours, and supple tannins. A cinnamon spice finish. Ideal with roasts, stews, grilled meats, and aged cheese.

chapoutier-cotes-du-roussillons.title: M. Chapoutier Les Vignes de Bila-Haut Cotes du Roussillon Blanc 2023
chapoutier-cotes-du-roussillons.bodyHtml:
The Chapoutier family can trace their history in the Rhône region back to 1808, but it was in 1879 that Polydor Chapoutier bought his first vineyards and started the actual business. In the mid-20th century Max Chapoutier led the business until his retirement in 1977, after which his sons Michel Chapoutier and Marc Chapoutier took over. The decade of the 1980s saw quality improvements under Michel Chapoutier’s leadership over the vineyards and winemaking facilities. By the late 1980s, Chapoutier had started to receive considerable international attention due to the quality of its wines.

91 Points - James Suckling

A delicious, round and juicy white blend of roussanne, marsanne, grenache blanc and macabeu, with aromas of sweet lemons, pears, dried herbs and almond powder. It’s medium-bodied with a comforting character. Silky and supple with a fruity finish. Drink now.

lenoble-cuvee-gentilhomme-blc-de-blancs.title: Lenoble Gentilhomme Blanc De Blancs Brut Champagne Grand Cru 2009 750ml
lenoble-cuvee-gentilhomme-blc-de-blancs.bodyHtml: The A.R. Lenoble Gentilhomme Blanc de Blancs Brut Champagne Grand Cru 2009 is a 100% Chardonnay Champagne produced from Grand Cru vineyards in Chouilly. It's known for its bright yellow color, fine bubbles, and a complex flavor profile that includes notes of white fruit, citrus, buttery, and pineapple. The palate is described as rich, round, fresh, and balanced, with a creamy texture and a long, elegant finish.

tolpuddle-vineyard-chardonnay.title: DAOU Chardonnay 2025
tolpuddle-vineyard-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
DAOU Chardonnay 2025 is an expressive, beautifully balanced, and textural California white wine crafted by brothers Georges and Daniel Daou in the hills of Paso Robles. Sourced from premium vineyard sites across the calcareous clay and limestone terroirs of the Central Coast, the grapes benefit from warm daytime sunshine tempered by coastal breezes and dramatic diurnal shifts. Fermented with careful temperature regulation and aged in French oak to marry richness with precision, it reveals a luminous, pale straw-gold hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is fragrant and layered, unfurling with scents of lemon zest, yellow apple, crisp nectarine, and honeysuckle, complemented by subtle nuances of baking spices, toasted hazelnut, and vanilla cream. On the palate, it delivers a medium-bodied, rounded mouthfeel framed by vibrant natural acidity and tropical hints of melon and ripe orchard fruit, finishing clean, polished, and persistent with delicate touches of toasted oak.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops in lemon-butter sauce, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy mushroom risotto, grilled halibut, or mild artisanal triple-cream cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

Quite subtle and restrained with aromas of lemon, yellow apple, melon, baking spice and nectarine. The palate is medium-bodied with a textural, rounded mouthfeel, bright acidity and a generous finish. Fresh and polished with plenty of flavor and balance. Drink now. Screw cap.

southern-belle-red-wine.title: Southern Belle Red 2021 750ml
southern-belle-red-wine.bodyHtml: An excellent red blend from Murcia, Spain. Varietal includes Mourvedre and Shiraz yet so much more. Beautiful aromas with deep purple hues and layers of dark fruits and hints of nuts & pistachios. Really opened up with time and had an extremely smooth and balanced finish.

prieur-beaune-greves-1er-cru-rouge.title: Domaine Jacques Prieur Beaune-Greves Premier Cru Rouge 2022
prieur-beaune-greves-1er-cru-rouge.bodyHtml:
The Domaine Jacques Prieur Beaune-Grèves 1er Cru 2022 (Pinot Noir) is an elegant, structured, and deeply sophisticated Old World red wine from a highly celebrated, sun-kissed growing season. It displays a stunning dark ruby-crimson hue with bright purple reflections in the glass. The nose releases an expressive bouquet of fresh red berries, juicy black cherries, and cherry pits, layered with refined undertones of sweet tobacco leaf, forest floor, and slightly toasty vanilla spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Pinot Noir is exceptionally pure, tasty, and dense, coating the mouth with vibrant stone fruit flavors, savory red plums, and a solid backbone that balances the natural warmth of the 2022 vintage. Fully destemmed and aged for over 18 months in fine oak barrels, it shows ripe, digestible tannins and a well-integrated, food-friendly acidity that carries into a remarkably persistent, crisp finish.

Food Pairing: This structured and classic Burgundy pairs beautifully with refined culinary options, including roasted duck breast with a dark cherry reduction, slow-roasted goose, wild game birds, grilled lamb chops with rosemary, pan-seared veal cutlets, and a selection of aged artisanal cheeses.

craggy-range-te-muna-pinot-noir.title: Craggy Range Sauvignon Blanc 2025
craggy-range-te-muna-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Craggy Range Sauvignon Blanc 2025 is a bright, aromatic, and vibrant white wine crafted by Craggy Range in the Te Muna Road Vineyard in Martinborough, New Zealand. Sourced from stony, limestone-rich soils, this wine displays a pale straw-gold hue with vivid green highlights. The expressive nose opens with lifted aromas of lime zest, passion fruit, lemongrass, and fresh-cut herbs, backed by a subtle flinty minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering a core of citrus and tropical fruit flavors balanced by a lively, mouthwatering acidity and a long, clean finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, goat cheese salads, pan-seared white fish, grilled shrimp, asparagus, and light summer pasta dishes.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Intense Key lime, lemongrass and pear flavors are fleshy, bright and precise in this white, showing details of tangerine, kiwifruit and grapefruit, with sleek notes of saline and green tea, plus a hint of white pepper on a mouthwatering frame.
92 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Basil, nettles, fresh grass, grapefruit and passionfruit rinds open on this pungent yet well made Sauvignon. The palate is all vim and vigor, with punchy acidity, pithy flavors and a whole slew tongue-tingling refreshment amidst subtle textural padding. Still young, this could evolve and gain honeyed complexity with another few years in bottle.

tormaresca-torcioda-igt-salento.title: Tormaresca Torcicoda Salento Primitivo 2022 750ml
tormaresca-torcioda-igt-salento.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Torcicoda has an intense ruby red color with light violet hues. Notes of fruit dominate the nose, particularly blackberries and raspberries that meet spicy hints of licorice and chocolate. Entry on the palate is soft and generous with good structure sustained by elegant tannins. It closes with a long, persistent finish accented by a pleasant aftertaste of cherry jam.
91 Points - Wine Spectator
There's a dark core of ripe black plum, mulberry and sun-dried black cherry fruit in this refined red, backed by lively acidity. Medium-bodied and balanced, with the fruit profile enmeshed with fine, taut tannins and notes of bay leaf, black licorice, minerals and sandalwood. Drink now through 2032.
91 Points - Vinous
Rich plum sauce, sage and sweet smoke come to life in the 2022 Primitivo Torcicoda's bouquet. Balanced, medium-bodied and soft in texture, its ripe red and black fruits swirl are complemented by a tinge of cocoa. The 2022 finishes tactile and long, gently tannic and incredibly fresh with citrus-laced blackberries and dark chocolate tones.

zorzal-porfiado.title: Zorzal Porfiado 750ml
zorzal-porfiado.bodyHtml: Zorzal Porfiado is an unusual non-vintage Pinot Noir from Gualtallary in Tupungato, high in Mendoza's Uco Valley. Its name means "obstinate", a nod to a wine the winery says refused to be released until it was ready: it is built as a solera, blending several harvests aged in 500-litre French oak barrels, and the label stamp marks each release by the number of harvests and the corte. The fruit comes from a 70-year-old trellised vineyard on deep alluvial soils, picked by hand into 16-kilo boxes in the early morning. About a fifth of the bunches are fermented whole in concrete with native yeasts, followed by malolactic fermentation. The producer describes a bright red wine with spice, black fruit and dark earth, mineral hints of graphite, a full, textured palate with fresh acidity and a long finish. 12% ABV, 750ml.

verite-la-joie-2010.title: Verite La Joie 2010 750ml
verite-la-joie-2010.bodyHtml:
A beautiful wine with intense color and a red crown along the edges, the 2010 La Joie reveals a silky, soft, and voluptuously fruity nose with a touch of discreet oak and fine spices. It opens with an opulent palate of red and black fruits, spices, and licorice before giving way to an impressively long finish. This is a wine with very fine tannins, a wine of balance between fruit and minerality. While it can be enjoyed young, this wine will be able to age for at least 20 years.

 

Blend: 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 14% Merlot, 6% Petit Verdot,5% Cabernet Franc

92 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
With the lowest alcohol (14%), the 2010 La Joie is composed of 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 14% Merlot, and the rest Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. Copious aromas of incense, unsmoked cigar tobacco, Christmas fruitcake, cedar, underbrush, black currants and a hint of espresso roast emerge from this medium to full-bodied, rich, concentrated red. It needs 4-5 years of cellaring and should keep well for 2 to 3 decades.
Rating: 92+

vega-sicilia-alion.title: Tempos Vega Sicilia Alion 2022
vega-sicilia-alion.bodyHtml:
Tempos Vega Sicilia Alion 2022 is an exceptional, modern, and highly refined Spanish red wine produced by Bodegas Alión, part of the prestigious Tempos Vega Sicilia family in the Ribera del Duero region. Sourced from carefully managed 100% Fine Tinto (Tempranillo) vines, this warm and dry vintage was handled with gentle extraction and aged in French oak barrels alongside concrete vats to preserve purity, structure, and freshness. In the glass, it displays a deep ruby hue. The nose is precise and restrained, revealing aromas of ripe black cherry, dark plum, subtle cacao, crushed stone, and graphite. On the palate, it is rich, supple, and beautifully balanced, offering juicy dark fruit supported by polished, fine-grained tannins and a long, energetic finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, venison stew, braised beef short ribs, and mature hard cheeses like Manchego.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Alión comes from a year they considered to be a challenge; it was warm and dry and ripeness didn't follow the usual pattern: late vineyards ripened earlier and early vineyards took longer this year. Their obsession was to keep the freshness in the wine, so they did a softer vinification and employed more careful use of oak, using larger volumes and other materials like concrete to tame a powerful and solar vintage. The nose is serious and even has some austerity. The wine is obviously juicier and rounder, with 14.5% alcohol, a pH of 3.89 and 4.58 grams of acidity, but it has very good balance overall. The tannins are round, polished and slightly dustier than other vintages, and the wine has a tender mouthfeel. A total of 270,870 bottles, 7,040 magnums and some larger formats were produced. It was bottled in May 2024 and released in 2026.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

This is alluring, with a core of warmed black cherry and plum sauce flavors laced with fragrant accents of cinnamon, violet, licorice, dried mint and bay leaf. There's a suave feel to this red, which effortlessly enmeshes a firm core of fine-grained tannins with a plush texture and fresh focus. Expands beautifully on the palate, revealing additional details of espresso, smoked paprika and mineral that linger on the finish. Drink now through 2040.

93 Points - James Suckling

A structured and chewy wine from this challenging hot, dry year. On the nose it is profound and floral at the same time, with graphite, blackberries and dark chocolate. Full-bodied and tightly wound. Give it two or three more years. Drink from 2027.

pape-clement-blanc-aoc-pessac-leognan.title: Bernard Margrez Chateau Pape Clement Blanc 2010

le-plus-fleur-oac-lalande-de-pomerol.title: Ch Moncets Lalande De Pomerol Aoc

recaredo-rose-brut.title: Louis Roederer Brut Nature Rose 2015 750ml
recaredo-rose-brut.bodyHtml:
An extraordinary vintage which is also the year in which the Champagne region was recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site! 2015 followed the continental trend of that decade: a mild, wet winter and a hot, dry summer. The summer, hot and sunny, brought record-breaking temperatures and water stress. The second half of August brought some very welcome rain, giving the vines some much needed relief. Thanks to this fresh finish, the vines produced juicy, ripe and concentrated grapes. Our ambition for this vintage? To capture the concentration which is the hallmark of this spectacular vintage!

Pink hue with bright, fresh tints and generous, slow- moving bubbles.

The deep Pinot noir bouquet is a blend of delicate citrus notes (Etna blood oranges), red fruit (blackcurrants) and spice (a touch of camphor). After aeration, the red fruit becomes intertwined with notes of honey and gingerbread.

On entry, the wine is juicy, fruity, concentrated and palate- coating. The sun-drenched fruit and its slightly sweet texture give one the impression of biting into a perfectly ripe blackberry. The wine shows remarkable poise thanks to the sensual, almost powdery texture that balances the zero dosage. The end palate reveals slightly spicy (camphor), smoky (bacon) and iodised notes that usher in a sensation of Umami.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

To produce the 2015 Brut Nature Rosé, Lécaillon and his team picked the ripest Pinot Noir in Roederer's holdings in lieu-dit Les Chèvres a week before the rest of their fruit there, macerating it at low temperature for four to five days before adding some 20% of this Pinot Noir to the same base that produces the regular Brut Nature. Delivering aromas of peach, clear honey, freshly baked bread and almond paste, it's medium to full-bodied, ample and fleshy, with a rich, vinous profile, racy acids and a long, chalky finish. This has always been a structured wine, but in 2015, that structure is cloaked in more flesh and texture.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A vivacious rosé, with a minerally overtone and a well-meshed range of crunchy pear, peach skin, pickled ginger and blood orange zest flavors set on a refined, lacy mousse. Ends with a long, creamy finish. Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier. 

93 Points - James Suckling
Crisp, tangy and focused, with aromas of raspberries, biscuits, watermelon, seashells, lemons and pink grapefruit. Sharp acidity with very fine bubbles. Field blend from a single plot in Cumieres. 80% field blend of chardonnay, pinot meunier, pinot noir, pinot blanc, arbanne and petit meslier, with 20% of cold-soaked pinot noir. Mineral and bone dry. Dosage 0g/L. From biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification. Drink or hold.

recaredo-brut-nature.title: Recaredo Terrers Brut Nature Gran Reserva 2018 750ml
recaredo-brut-nature.bodyHtml:
Depth and transparency. Complexity and freshness. The truest expression of Recaredo's landscape emerges from the Alt Penedès region's mosaic of calcareous soils.

Blend: 65% Xarel·lo, 18% Macabeo, 17% Parellada 

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Terrers is a different blend than in the past, and this year its composed of 65% Xarel.lo, higher and higher because of climate change, 18% Macabeo and 17% Parellada from a rainy year, more relaxed than the previous 2017 and 2016. Yields are around 7,000 kilos (when the average was 5,600), so good yields and fresh wines, with 11.5% alcohol and a pH of 3.12. It matured in bottle for some three years. It's bone dry, very long and tasty and showcases the house style, elegant and nuanced wines, here with tension and ripeness with fine bubbles but with the wine clearly more important than the bubbles (they use less sugar in the tirage for the second fermentation to have less bubbles). 260,000 bottles produced in a generous vintage. Impressive, quality and quantity...

brunelli-brunello-di-montalcino-riserva.title: Martoccia Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016
brunelli-brunello-di-montalcino-riserva.bodyHtml:
The 2016 Martoccia Brunello di Montalcino Riserva is a powerful and exceptionally refined wine from what is widely considered a legendary vintage in Tuscany. It exhibits a deep garnet red colour with luminous reflections. The nose is highly complex and expansive, offering concentrated aromas of ripe black cherries, plums, and dried figs, seamlessly integrated with sophisticated notes of tobacco leaf, dark chocolate, leather, and elegant balsamic spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and monumental, showcasing a perfect harmony between its rich fruit core, vibrant acidity, and dense, velvety tannins. This Riserva is built for long-term aging, concluding with an incredibly persistent and sapid finish that lingers with notes of savory spice and earthy minerality.

92 Points - James Suckling

Mushrooms, truffles, lemon peel, dried cherries and dried roses on the nose. Balanced and layered, with a full body and firm, fine-grained tannins. Fresh at the end. Drink or hold.

syrah-cornas-vincent-paris-la-geynale.title: Domaine Dumien-Serrette Cornas Patou 2020
syrah-cornas-vincent-paris-la-geynale.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dumien-Serrette Cornas Patou 2020 is a powerful yet refined Syrah showcasing aromas of blackberry, blackcurrant, smoked meat, violet, cracked pepper, and graphite. Concentrated dark fruit, firm tannins, vibrant freshness, and mineral depth lead to a long, age-worthy finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled ribeye, braised lamb shanks, venison, wild mushroom dishes, hearty stews, or aged hard cheeses for exceptional harmony.

 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows great focus and freshness, with a gorgeous stream of blackberry, blueberry and violet supported by a bed of ultrafine tannins and chalky minerals. Offers olive tapenade and wood spice flecks, which add a savory detail to the silky, long palate. Best from 2025 through 2040. 125 cases made, 50 cases imported.

michael-david-inkblot-petit-verdot.title: Michael David Winery Inkblot Petit Verdot 2022
michael-david-inkblot-petit-verdot.bodyHtml: Michael David Winery Inkblot Petit Verdot 2022 is an exceptionally bold, "teeth-staining" red wine that showcases Petit Verdot as a standalone varietal rather than its traditional role as a blending grape. True to its "Inkblot" name, it is deeply concentrated and opaque in the glass, appearing almost "midnight" or "deep midnight" in hue. The 2022 vintage offers a rich aromatic profile of blackberry and dark cherry mingled with hints of fig preserves. On the palate, it is powerful and full-bodied, featuring voluptuous layers of plum, dark cocoa, and toasted caramel flavors. It is framed by a high level of tannin and a prolonged, complex finish inspired by savory licorice notes.

crystal-head-vodka-1.title: Crystal Head Vodka 3L
crystal-head-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Crystal Head Vodka is crafted from locally sourced, Canadian corn. It is distilled four times into a neutral grain spirit and blended with pristine water from Newfoundland, Canada. The vodka is filtered seven times, of which three are through layers of semi-precious crystals known as Herkimer diamonds.

Our iconic skull-shaped bottle is produced in Europe, where bits of crystal are melted into the glass to ensure absolute clarity.

Crystal Head Vodka offers a clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose–neutral grain aromas with a delicate touch of citrus. Silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla. Ending with a sweet, creamy finish.
