lavau-gigondas.title: Lavau Gigondas 2019 750ml
lavau-gigondas.bodyHtml: The 2019 Lavau Gigondas is a red wine blend from the Rhône Valley in France, specifically from the Gigondas appellation. It's crafted from Grenache, Syrah, and Mourvedre grapes. The wine is known for its full-bodied character, ripe tannins, and a complex flavor profile with notes of blackcurrants, raspberries, plums, and spicy aromas like pepper and nutmeg. It's often described as having a "meaty, fleshy palate".

chateau-maucoil-chateauneuf-du-pape-blan.title: Clos de l Oratoire des Papes Chateauneuf du Pape Blanc 2025
chateau-maucoil-chateauneuf-du-pape-blan.bodyHtml:
Clos de l'Oratoire des Papes Châteauneuf-du-Pape Blanc 2025 is an elegant French white wine from the prestigious Châteauneuf-du-Pape appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by the historic Clos de l'Oratoire des Papes estate, part of Maison Ogier, this wine showcases the richness, freshness and refined character of traditional white Rhône varieties. The 2025 vintage is expected to offer an inviting combination of ripe pear, white peach, citrus and apricot, complemented by delicate floral aromas, Mediterranean herbs and subtle mineral notes. On the palate, the wine is anticipated to be beautifully textured, with generous orchard-fruit flavours, balanced acidity and an elegant, lingering finish. Its combination of richness and freshness makes it an excellent choice for seafood, refined cuisine and special occasions.

Food Pairing: Grilled sea bass, roasted halibut, lobster, seared scallops, prawns, seafood risotto, herb-roasted chicken, pork tenderloin, creamy mushroom pasta, roasted vegetables, Brie, Comté and aged goat cheese.

chateau-maucoil-chateauneuf-du-pape-roug.title: Domaine de Cristia Chateauneuf du Pape Rouge 2022
chateau-maucoil-chateauneuf-du-pape-roug.bodyHtml:
Domaine de Cristia Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2022 is a rich and expressive French red wine from the prestigious Châteauneuf-du-Pape appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by the family-owned Domaine de Cristia, this wine reflects the estate's dedication to traditional Rhône grape varieties, careful vineyard management and the distinctive terroir of one of France's most celebrated wine regions. The 2022 vintage showcases the warmth and generosity of the Southern Rhône, offering aromas of ripe black cherries, raspberries, blackberries and plums, complemented by notes of lavender, liquorice, black pepper and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and beautifully structured, combining concentrated red and dark fruit with rounded tannins, balanced freshness and subtle earthy complexity. Its lingering, spice-driven finish makes it an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining and cellaring.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, duck confit, venison, beef bourguignon, herb-roasted pork, mushroom risotto, ratatouille, grilled Mediterranean vegetables, aged Comté and Manchego cheese.

 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Velvety and seductive, with smoothly polished tannins holding up ripe red currant and cherry flavors edged in iron and baking spices. A bitter cherry pit note at the end contributes to the focused, dry finish, which stretches out. Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre. Best from 2026 through 2040. 500 cases made, 125 cases imported.

92 Points - James Suckling

A well-built, balanced and lively red with notes of sweet berries, dried herbs, stones and peppercorns. Full-bodied with velvety tannins and a silky core of berries on the palate. Refined and elegant, with a caressing touch challenged by a lift of peppercorns kicking in toward the finish. From organically grown grapes. Drink or hold.

trentham-reserve-heathcote-shiraz.title: Trentham Reserve Shiraz 2015 750ml
trentham-reserve-heathcote-shiraz.bodyHtml: Trentham Estate Reserve Shiraz 2015 is a Heathcote Shiraz from the family-owned Trentham Estate, which sources its Reserve wines from Australian regions chosen to suit each variety. Heathcote, in Victoria, is the source of this full-bodied red. 750ml, 14.8% ABV.

trentham-reserve-coonawarra-cab-sauv.title: Trentham Family Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
trentham-reserve-coonawarra-cab-sauv.bodyHtml: Trentham Estate Family Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 is a Coonawarra Cabernet from the family-owned Trentham Estate, which is based on the Murray River in New South Wales and sources its Reserve wines from the regions best suited to each variety. Coonawarra's terra rossa soils of red clay over limestone are known for Cabernet with mint and cassis character. 750ml, 13% ABV.

montezemolo-barolo-enrico-vi.title: Cordero Di Montezemolo Barolo Enrico VI 2015 750ml

giusti-umberto-i-rosso-del-veneto.title: Giusti Umberto I Montello Rosso Superiore 2021
giusti-umberto-i-rosso-del-veneto.bodyHtml:
Giusti Wine’s most iconic product, this wine is elegant, rich and enveloping, a masterful Bordeaux blend that has close ties with the land where international varieties were introduced by Napoleon Bonaparte.

Intense ruby red with light garnet hues. Intense with notes of red fruit spice, vanilla and pepper. Full-bodied, round and persistent with soft tannins and elegant.

Excellent with grilled meats, game and mature cheese. Excellent after a meal.

92 Points - James Suckling

A smoky and restrained wine with aromas of ash, cassis and flowers. Extraction, juicy acidity, firm grainy tannins and a tight finish. Drink or hold.

inglenook-1882-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Inglenook 1882 Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
inglenook-1882-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Inglenook 1882 Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 is a classic, expressive, and historic Napa Valley red wine crafted to honor Gustave Niebaum’s inaugural vintage at Inglenook. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyard blocks—including Chateau, Cohn, and Red Barn—rooted in the deep, gravelly loam soils of the Rutherford Bench, it displays a deep garnet-red hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is inviting and nuanced, revealing aromas of ripe black cherries, macerated plums, and fresh cassis layered over undertones of dark cocoa powder, cedar, sweet pipe tobacco, and subtle baking spices derived from 18 months of aging in French oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied, vibrant, and supple, delivering a solid core of juicy dark fruits framed by refined, fine-grained "Rutherford dust" tannins and balanced natural acidity, concluding in a structured, long, and lightly spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, rosemary venison medallions, and aged white cheddar or gouda cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A solid cabernet with lots of blackberry, chocolate and walnut character. It's full-bodied with plenty of fruit and a flavourful finish. Juicy and intense. Needs time to soften and mellow.

volver.title: Bodegas Volver 'Volver' Single Vineyard Tempranillo 2018 750ml
volver.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "Dark ruby color, black cherry, plum, tobacco, mocha aromas, mouth-filling black cherry, plum and dusty, cocoa powder flavors, lifted by clear cut acidity and followed by husky tannins. Have it ready when you fire up the charcoal. The grapes were grown in the Finca Los Juncare vineyard located at over 2000 feet elevation, where temperatures are cooler allowing grapes to take their time maturing and developing complex flavors. The other advantage of altitude is the difference between day and night temperatures. The warmer daytime temperature ripens the grapes and nighttime temperatures help preserve the grape’s acidity, providing a balanced structure for wine.---- Rebecca Murphy" - 91/100, Wine Review Online

la-stella-fortissimo.title: La Stella Fortissimo 2021 750ml
la-stella-fortissimo.bodyHtml:
The La Stella Fortissimo 2021 is a bold yet elegant red blend from British Columbia’s Okanagan Valley, inspired by the great Super Tuscan wines of Italy. It artfully combines Old World finesse with New World power, delivering richness, structure, and aromatic complexity.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Deep ruby with purple highlights.

  • Aromas: Lifted notes of ripe black cherry, plum, and dark berries layered with hints of tobacco leaf, cedar, and espresso.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and smooth with supple tannins. The Sangiovese brings freshness and vibrancy, while Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc add depth, texture, and savory complexity. Balanced acidity keeps the finish long and lively.

Blend Composition:

  • Primarily Sangiovese, supported by Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc.

Aging:

Aged in a combination of large format neutral oak and smaller barrels for integration and finesse.

Cellaring Potential:

Drinks beautifully now but will evolve gracefully over the next 5–8 years.

Food Pairing:

Pairs well with osso buco, grilled meats, hearty pasta dishes, or aged cheeses.

This is a refined yet robust wine—a standout expression of BC terroir with a nod to Tuscany’s heart. Let me know if you’d like this in a shorter format or for retail display!

galerie-napa-valley-sauvignon-blanc.title: Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2022
galerie-napa-valley-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2022 is a vibrant, gentle, and fruit-forward white wine that beautifully captures the character of its world-renowned terroir. It opens with bright, inviting aromas of citrus blossom, lime zest, and subtle jasmine, perfectly layered with notes of fresh green apple, honeydew melon, and yellow peach. On the palate, this estate-grown wine is medium-to-full-bodied and elegantly balanced, offering a softly rounded texture achieved through partial barrel fermentation. Juicy flavors of candied orange, tropical fruit, and a distinct underlying minerality are lifted by refreshing, mild acidity, leading to a long, crisp, and beautifully harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spring vegetable frittatas, fresh fish tacos, grilled asparagus, zesty citrus ceviche, and vibrant mixed green salads.

91 Points - James Suckling

This is a gentle, fruit-forward, estate-grown wine with fresh citrus flavors and mild acidity. Partially barrel fermented, which gives some richness to the fruit and roundness to the texture. Includes 7% semillon blended in. Full-bodied and well balanced.

marcati-amarone-della-valpolicella-2011.title: Giuseppe Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2021
marcati-amarone-della-valpolicella-2011.bodyHtml:
Giuseppe Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2021 is a rich, full-bodied, and elegantly structured Italian red wine produced in the historic Classico zone of Valpolicella. Sourced from hill-sloped vineyards in Marano di Valpolicella and naturally dried via the traditional appassimento method for around 100 days, this expression displays a deep ruby color with violet reflections. The nose opens with expressive aromas of cherry liqueur, dark plums, sandalwood, and dark chocolate. On the palate, it delivers a compact and velvety mouthfeel loaded with black fruit, subtle spice, and fine-grained tannins, balanced by vibrant natural acidity through a long, warm finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with braised beef short ribs, roasted venison, wild boar ragù, osso buco, truffle risotto, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Spicy, savory and full of dark fruit, this offers cherry liqueur, chocolate and sandalwood on the nose. Full and compact, with velvety tannins on the juicy palate. Solid and lingering. Drink or hold.

noble-ridge-stony-knoll-chardonnay-2019.title: Noble Ridge Noble Stony Knoll Chardonnay 2019
noble-ridge-stony-knoll-chardonnay-2019.bodyHtml: The Noble Ridge Noble Stony Knoll Chardonnay 2019 is a crisp, fruit-forward expression of the Okanagan Falls terroir, characterized by its bright acidity and refreshing un-oaked style. The 2019 vintage was predominantly fermented in stainless steel (94%), with a small portion (6%) aged in one-year-old barrels to add a subtle roundness to the mouthfeel without masking the natural fruit. On the nose, it reveals vibrant aromas of pear, white peach, and ripe apples, with delicate undertones of vanilla. The palate is defined by luscious tree fruit flavours—namely apple and pear—and is balanced by a medium acidity and a distinct, lingering minerality on the finish. This clean and pure style makes it an excellent match for light seafood dishes, paella, or soft cheeses.

zorzal-piantao.title: Zorzal Piantao 2015 750ml
zorzal-piantao.bodyHtml: Zorzal Piantao 2015 is a red from Zorzal Wines in Gualtallary, Tupungato, in Mendoza's Uco Valley. The producer calls it "the Argentine red": the wine began as a Cabernet Franc from Tupungato that only showed its true character as it evolved, and is a blend of Cabernet Franc with small proportions of other varieties from different barrels. Its name comes from the line "Piantao, piantao, piantao" in the tango Balada para un loco. The vineyard sits on alluvial soils with sand on the surface and calcium-carbonate-rich stones below. The producer ferments in cement tanks with native yeasts, then ages the wine in French oak barrels, where malolactic fermentation takes place. Winemaker Juan Pablo Michelini oversees the range. 14.8% ABV, 750ml.

le-plus-de-la-fleur-de-bouard-lalande.title: Chateau La Fleur Le Plus de La Fleur de Bouard 2011
le-plus-de-la-fleur-de-bouard-lalande.bodyHtml:
The Château La Fleur de Boüard Le Plus de La Fleur de Boüard 2011 is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex Old World red wine that represents the ultra-luxury flagship cuvée of the estate. It pours an opaque, fully saturated inky purple colour with deep violet reflections, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of cassis, black raspberries, and blueberry compote, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of espresso dust, mocha, sweet tobacco, and cedar wood. On the palate, this full-bodied, low-yield Merlot is remarkably smooth, juicy, and dense, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of syrupy blackberries, chocolate-covered cherries, and warm baking spices that reflect the concentrated character of the 2011 vintage. Crafted exclusively from ancient 60-year-old vines and aged for an extensive 30 months in 100% new French oak barrels without fining or filtration to maximize its structural depth, its structural crunch is balanced by thick, velvety tannins and a firm acidity that carries into a long, persistent, and powerfully robust finish accented by a lingering touch of woodsmoke, anise, and mineral complexity.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with a wide range of premium culinary options, including prime cuts of grilled beef steak, classic Boeuf en Croûte, slow-roasted venison or wild boar, rack of lamb with rosemary, rich meat stews, and a selection of aged artisanal cheeses.
93 Points - James Suckling
This is very powerful with a wonderful length. Full-bodied, with ultra-fine tannins and a bright fruit and acidity. Mineral. Wow.

chateau-brande-bergere-cuvee-obyrne.title: Chateau Brande-Bergere Cuvee O'Byrne 2014 750ml
chateau-brande-bergere-cuvee-obyrne.bodyHtml: Château Brande-Bergère Cuvée O'Byrne 2014 is a red Bordeaux from Château Brande-Bergère, labelled Grand Vin de Bordeaux. The label shows the château drawn in gold beneath its name, with the Cuvée O'Byrne name below. 750ml bottle, 13.5% ABV.

chateau-magrez-fombrauge-saint-emilion.title: Bernard Magrez Chateau Fombrauge 2019
chateau-magrez-fombrauge-saint-emilion.bodyHtml:
A refined Saint-Emilion Grand Cru Classe red wine offering concentration, elegance, and complexity. Crafted from fruit grown on the historic Château Fombrauge estate, it displays a balanced structure with depth and a polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled beef, lamb, duck, roasted game, mushroom dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

 

95 Points - James Suckling

Lots of intense blackberries, dark chocolate, toasted oak and black olives follow through to a full-bodied palate with layers of pretty fruit and plush tannins. Yet, it shows tension and focus. Richer style for 2019, but I like its lavish character. Needs four or five years to come together even more. Try after 2026.

quinta-quietud-toro-tinto-de-toro-bold.title: Quinta Quietud Reserva 2020
quinta-quietud-toro-tinto-de-toro-bold.bodyHtml:
Quinta Quietud Reserva 2020 is an exceptionally powerful, deeply complex, and elegant organic red wine that perfectly captures the bold spirit of the Toro region. Crafted from old-vine Tinta de Toro grapes harvested from vines planted between 1960 and 1988, this wine pours a dense, opaque dark cherry color with a black-purple rim. The highly expressive nose opens with concentrated aromas of black fruit confit, black plums, and liquorice, beautifully layered with nuances of dark cacao, graphite minerals, and dried Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is dense, meaty, and velvety, offering a rich core of ripe blackberry flavor well-supported by muscular yet refined tannins and a refreshing streak of natural acidity. Aged for 24 months in French oak barrels, it moves into a long, persistent, and satisfyingly warm finish characterized by fine toasted oak notes.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb ribs, grilled thick-cut ribeye steaks, wild boar stews, or a selection of well-matured cured cheeses.

henri-de-villamont-grands-echezeaux.title: Charles Henri Bourguignon Grands-Echezeaux Grand Cru 2017 750ml

pocas-vintage-port.title: Pocas Vintage Port 2011 750ml
pocas-vintage-port.bodyHtml: Poças Vintage Port 2011 is a single-year Port from the family house of Manoel D. Poças Junior in Portugal. The label marks it as a Vintage Port from 2011, a style made from one exceptional harvest and bottled young so it can mature in bottle for many years. This is a 750ml bottle at 20% ABV.

voerzio-barolo-torriglione.title: Voerzio Barolo Torriglione 1.5L Magnum
voerzio-barolo-torriglione.bodyHtml: Roberto Voerzio Barolo Torriglione is a single-vineyard Barolo DOCG from Torriglione in La Morra, bottled at the Azienda Agricola Roberto Voerzio. Made from Nebbiolo, it reflects the estate's founding principles: prime vineyard sites, natural farming and meticulous vineyard work with high-density planting, very low yields and strict green harvesting to concentrate each site's character. Roberto Voerzio began working beside his father and grandfather in the vineyards of La Morra and has become one of the reference growers of the Langhe. This bottling comes in a 1.5L magnum, a format well suited to long cellaring. Magnum at 15% alcohol.

baron-de-ley-3-vinas-blanco-reserva.title: Baron De Ley Tres Vinas Blanco Reserva 2020
baron-de-ley-3-vinas-blanco-reserva.bodyHtml:
Baron De Ley Tres Vinas Blanco Reserva 2020 is an exceptional, traditional-style white Rioja made as a tribute to the historic oxidative white wines of the region. On the nose, it displays a complex and intense bouquet characterized by notes of nutmeg, autumn fruits, orange rind, and roasted nuts, all seamlessly integrated with hints of mellow sweet oak from barrel aging. The palate is wonderfully unctuous, silky, and deep, balancing its precision acidity with a long, persistent finish showing distinct mineral and chalky undertones derived from the estate's calcareous soils.

Food Pairing:

An ideal accompaniment for lighthearted meals such as fresh sushi, seared scallops, autumn vegetables including artichokes, wild mushroom risottos, and cured Iberian ham platters.

91 Points - James Suckling

A smoky, toasty white that has roasted almond, toasted coconut and stone fruit aromas. It’s medium-bodied and lively with bright acidity, although the toastiness is rich and dominant. Viura, malvasia and garnacha blanca. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A well-cut white, with a minerally, petrol-laced overtone. This shows a pleasing, creamy nappe on the palate, carrying flavors of baked melon, Meyer lemon peel, honeycomb, chopped hazelnut and warm spices. Rich and expressive without excessive weight, with a tang of salinity offering a refreshing swathe on the finish. Viura, Malvasia and Garnacha Blanca. Drink now through 2030.

90 Points - Wine Enthisiast

Deep straw to the eye, this wine offers aromas of Granny Smith Apple and a touch of cocoa butter. It is well textured and has flavors of Golden Delicious apple, passion fruit, pie crust and eucalyptus. The zesty finish is marked with a note of grapefruit.

kunde-sonoma-county-cabernet-sauvignon.title: La Crema Sonoma County Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
kunde-sonoma-county-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The nose reveals aromas of dried cherries, plums, and black currant. On the palate, notes of boysenberry, dark cherry, and subtle hints of coffee are followed by approachable tannins that are round, soft, and balanced by a juicy acidity.

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripe aromas of Damson plums, dark cherries, spices and cassia bark. The palate is full-bodied with finely integrated tannins and balanced acidity, giving notes of blackberry bush, potpourri, mocha and tobacco leaves. Well constructed.

chianti-vigna-del-capannino.title: Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
chianti-vigna-del-capannino.bodyHtml:
Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 is an incredibly harmonious, traditional Tuscan red wine crafted with a core of Sangiovese. Following extensive maturation in a combination of Slavonian and French oak barrels, it reveals an elegant ruby hue alongside complex, expressive aromas of black cherries, wild blackberries, red plums, and violets, layered with hints of cedar, sweet vanilla, and earthy iron notes. The palate is full-bodied, dense, and beautifully framed by muscular, structured tannins and vibrant, balanced acidity, easing into a long, generous finish marked by warming spices.

Food Pairing: Pair this savory Riserva with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, rosemary-roasted lamb, wild boar ragù, or mature pecorino cheese.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This beefy red relies on its dense texture, concentrated flavors of black cherry and blackberry fruit, and muscular tannins to get its message across. Wild herb, iron and earth notes add depth, while the finish is long and spicy.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is savory and umami, with aromas of leather, graphite, underbrush, crushed rocks, bitter herbs and citrus swirling in the glass. Those earthy, bitter notes remain on the palate, but sweet cherries and wild strawberries pop overhead, while charged with powerful tannins and acid.

bowmore-23-yr-old-port-matured.title: Bowmore 23 Year Old 1989 Port Cask Matured
bowmore-23-yr-old-port-matured.bodyHtml:
From one of the oldest and most iconic disilleries in Scotland (not to mention, one of my favorites as well) comes this extremely limited special release. If you've ever been fortunate enough to visit the distillery, and have navigated your way through some of the most esteemed warehouses in the world, you'll know there are many different barrel types slumbering away at Bowmore. Some turn out...well...just 'okay' and end up being married with other barrels in mass vattings for the mainstream releases. Others are special. They get put aside and lovingly doted on until the time is right for bottling. And in 2013, it was finally decided the time was right for this one. 

An outturn of 12,000 bottles doesn't go very far, and I'm sad to say that we only have one bottle left of this gorgeous 1989 vintage. Don't sleep on this one.

charles-heidsieck-rose-reserve.title: Charles Heidsieck Rose Reserve 750ml
charles-heidsieck-rose-reserve.bodyHtml: A sophisticated powdery pink robe with luminous glints of wild rose. Delicate, vivacious bubbles are the result of an ageing period of 36 months. A base of 20% of reserve wines, white and red, gives this rose blend a subtle, yet complex nose. The initial fragrances from the 5-6% of elegant red wines are redolent of homemade strawberry jam mixed with the fruitiness of blood peach. A meticulous selection of crus gives the Charles Heidsieck Rose Reserve the rich warm notes of gingerbread and cinnamon. The deep powerful mouthfeel, the result of ageing in thousand-year-old cellars offers a burst of strawberry, raspberry and blackberry nestled in velvety whipped cream.

selvapiana-riserva-vigneto-bucerchiale.title: Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
selvapiana-riserva-vigneto-bucerchiale.bodyHtml:
Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 is an incredibly harmonious, traditional Tuscan red wine crafted with a core of Sangiovese. Following extensive maturation in a combination of Slavonian and French oak barrels, it reveals an elegant ruby hue alongside complex, expressive aromas of black cherries, wild blackberries, red plums, and violets, layered with hints of cedar, sweet vanilla, and earthy iron notes. The palate is full-bodied, dense, and beautifully framed by muscular, structured tannins and vibrant, balanced acidity, easing into a long, generous finish marked by warming spices.

Food Pairing: Pair this savory Riserva with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, rosemary-roasted lamb, wild boar ragù, or mature pecorino cheese.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This beefy red relies on its dense texture, concentrated flavors of black cherry and blackberry fruit, and muscular tannins to get its message across. Wild herb, iron and earth notes add depth, while the finish is long and spicy.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is savory and umami, with aromas of leather, graphite, underbrush, crushed rocks, bitter herbs and citrus swirling in the glass. Those earthy, bitter notes remain on the palate, but sweet cherries and wild strawberries pop overhead, while charged with powerful tannins and acid.

aquinas-pinot-noir.title: Aquinas Pinot Noir 2018 750ml
aquinas-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Earthy tones are dominant with notes of black currant and toasted clove. A remarkably round wine with bright raspberry, blueberry and blackberry flavors reminiscent of a berry mélange. Napa Carneros fruit shines through with smoky flavors and a lingering, beautiful finish.

piper-heidsieck-brut-1-5l.title: Piper-Heidsieck Cuvee Brut 1.5L Magnum
piper-heidsieck-brut-1-5l.bodyHtml:
The Brut NV represents the epitome of the Piper-Heidsieck style: a classic, well-structured, and fruit forward champagne. Piper-Heidsieck carefully selects fruit from more than 100 of Champagne’s crus to blend the Brut NV. This adds great complexity and dimension to the wine and allows the bold Piper-Heidsieck style to shine through. A majority blend of Pinot Noir provides structure to the composition while Pinot Meunier expands the wine with its brilliant fruit expression and fleshiness and Chardonnay bring elegant tones and acidity. The precious reserve wines create a consistent flavor profile year after year.

This Champagne teases and allures us with its festive, light-drenched, pale gold shimmer and joyful display of neat, lively bubbles. Notes of almond and fresh hazelnut accompany the precise ascent of its bubbles. It is lively, subtle and light, leaving a deliciously incisive sensation of smoothness, marked by the pureness of fresh pear and apple and a delicate hint of citrus fruits. A harmonious mixture of bright, crunchy pomelo, blonde grapes and juicy white fruits creates the delightfully surprising sensation of lightness embraced by the structure and depth from the Pinot Noir; all beautifully balanced.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Creamy and well-balanced, this lively Champagne offers flavors of ripe black currant and black cherry, candied lemon peel, and brioche, plus fragrant notes of anise and clove. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The Champagne is balanced between a soft Brut character and crisper lemon flavors. That balance gives a fine wine, open and easy, but with a fine bite of acidity at the end.

90 Points - James Suckling

Croissants, sliced apples and lemon pastries on the nose of this creamy Champagne. It’s rounded and soft with attractive pastry character.

lail-blueprint-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Penfolds Bin 704 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
lail-blueprint-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 704 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a modern, beautifully sculpted, and sophisticated Napa Valley red wine that showcases classic Californian terroir interpreted through Penfolds’ historic winemaking lens. Named as a reverse mirror image of its Australian counterpart Bin 407, it represents a French oak-matured expression of pure Cabernet Sauvignon. In the glass, it reveals a dense ruby-purple hue with a brilliant crimson rim. The aromatic profile is rich and layered, presenting ripe blackcurrant, dark plum, glazed cherries, and blackberry compote, underscored by subtle notes of cocoa powder, bay leaf, cedarwood, and delicate French oak spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, supple, and focused, offering concentrated dark fruit balanced by lively, mouthwatering acidity, fine-grained graphite minerality, and polished, silky tannins that carry through to an expansive, enduring finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, rosemary garlic roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison medallions, and aged sharp cheddar.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Napa wine from the Australian-based producer over delivers on its price point, offering tremendous flavor, complexity and approachability in its youth. Expansive in dense black and red fruit, cocoa powder and silky tannin, it offers breadth and depth and is intensely compelling.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The fruit for the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Bin 704 is from across Napa Valley, and the classy fruit is shaped by French oak (40% new) and firm tannins through the finish. This is supple and sweet and shows blood plum, raspberry, red licorice and even cocoa. The wine is long and lingering and shapely. Sophisticated.

j-christopher-lias-vineyard-pinot-noir.title: J. Christopher Lia's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2012
j-christopher-lias-vineyard-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The 2012 J. Christopher Lia's Vineyard Pinot Noir is a lush, highly expressive, and beautifully evolved Oregon red wine from an exceptional, warm, and dry growing season. Sourced from a south-facing site planted in 1992 on volcanic Jory soils, it pours a lovely translucent ruby-garnet color in the glass. The nose lifts with an inviting, fragrant bouquet of fresh red cherry, rose blossoms, and sweet berries, seamlessly intertwined with complex nuances of dried earth, cedar, and a delicate hint of butterscotch. On the palate, this medium-bodied Pinot Noir is remarkably round, supple, and fruit-forward, delivering concentrated, hedonistic flavors of juicy black cherries, plums, and a faint touch of vanilla. Partially fermented whole-cluster with native yeasts and aged for 20 months in French oak barrels, it shows incredible texture balanced by a fresh acidity and fine, integrated tannins that resolve into a long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with wild salmon teriyaki, grilled lamb chops with rosemary, roasted duck breast with cherry reduction, pan-seared pork belly, wild mushroom risotto, and mild cheeses like Brie or aged Gruyère.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is introduced by scents of rose and cherry blossoms, with a hint of butterscotch. Once tasted it's a lush, forward, sweetly appealing wine with the impressive fruit concentration of the 2012 vintage, underscored with a layer of mineral. It's delicious already, but destined to improve. Drink some now, and put away some to taste between 2018 and 2025.

siepi-i-g-t.title: Mazzei Fonterutoli Siepi 2022
siepi-i-g-t.bodyHtml:
Mazzei Castello di Fonterutoli Siepi 2022 is an exceptionally structured, elegant, and monumental Tuscan red wine produced by Marchesi Mazzei at their historic estate in Castellina in Chianti. Marking the 30th anniversary vintage of this iconic Super Tuscan, it displays an intense ruby-purple hue with brilliant clarity. The nose opens with an enchanting and complex bouquet of fresh dark berries, wild blackberries, and plum, harmoniously interwoven with sweet lavender, violets, menthol, dark chocolate, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body defined by a rich core of ripe red and black fruit, perfectly balanced by lively natural acidity and ultra-fine, silky tannins that carry through to an extraordinarily long, classy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted venison, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, and aged hard cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano.

97 Points - James Suckling

The aromas of dark berries, violets and perfume are enchanting. The palate is medium-bodied with ultra-fine tannins that are polished and so elegant and they run the length of the wine. They are rather endless. Very classy and balanced. A merlot and sangiovese blend. Give this a year or two, but it’s already a joy to drink. Drink or hold.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Mazzei 2022 Siepi marks this wine's 30th anniversary. I have a special connection to this wine, as I was present when some of the final blending options (with fruit from various parcels within the greater Siepi vineyard) were being decided. My personal preference was for the interpretation that showed the brightest fruit and the most energy. Those qualities are transferred over to this bottle, and I do agree that this celebratory vintage offers an excellent opportunity to tweak the winemaking of this historic blend of Sangiovese and Merlot. This warm vintage offers plenty of primary fruit with bold cherry as the protagonist. Softer tones of blue flower and grilled rosemary appear at the back. However, the oak spice and cinnamon need time to integrate. The results put the 2022 vintage on par with classic years such as 2021 and 2019.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Macerated cherry, blackberry and black currant fruit is shaded by mint, iron and spicy oak in this dense, linear red. Quickly takes on the character of its chewy tannins, yet the ripe fruit lingers. Though balanced and long, this needs time for its elements to come together. Sangiovese and Merlot. Best from 2028 through 2042.

zorzal-eggo-tinto-de-tiza.title: Zorzal Eggo Tinto De Tiza Malbec 2018 750ml
zorzal-eggo-tinto-de-tiza.bodyHtml:
This hand harvested, single vineyard wine from Gualtallary is 100% Malbec. This unique wine is completely fermented and aged in a large concrete egg and sees no oak. It is a dense, dark purple color with rich fruit flavors of blueberry and boysenberry, lilac and wet rain bounce on the nose, and has a strong mineral undertone of crushed wet rock and chalk. Eggo is the perfect combination of a chalky, terroir driven wine, with vibrant fruit and a long smooth finish.

95 Points - Wine Advocate

My favorite of the Malbecs is the 2018 Eggo Tinto de Tiza, from a Mendoza year—mild and dry—and aged exclusively in concrete eggs, which to me is the Zorzal signature. This is elegant, nuanced and pure, with great aromatics, clean and precise and with a medium-bodied palate, with moderate ripeness and red rather than black fruit. This is superb.

rodney-strong-knights-valley-cab-sauv.title: Rodney Strong Knights Valley Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
rodney-strong-knights-valley-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is deeply colored and bursting with aromas of crushed blackberries, spicy dark plum, dusty cocoa powder, cassis and wild raspberry. The complex layers of spice, red fruit and chocolate on the palate are framed in rich, velvety tannins with a long lingering finish.

Enjoy this Cabernet Sauvignon with braised short ribs, ravioli or lamb shanks, or cellar it to enjoy over the next several years.

The label for Rodney Strong Knights Valley Estate Cabernet Sauvignon is in the process of changing. You may receive either of these two labels featured above. Specific labels cannot be requested

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This powerful Cabernet delivers aromas of roasted black cherry, dark cocoa, violets and cinnamon on the nose, while the palate displays rich berry character and flavors of currant, saddle leather, black pepper and a wave of raspberry lemon acidity across the middle before a powerful, tannic finish takes over. Best from 2030-2045.

rose-de-purcari.title: Chateau Purcari Rose De Purcari 2024
rose-de-purcari.bodyHtml:
Château Purcari Rosé de Purcari 2024 is a vibrant, fresh, and aromatic rosé crafted in the famous Ștefan Vodă region of southeastern Moldova. Sourced from high-quality estate-grown vineyards situated near the Black Sea, this cuvée combines international varieties with Moldova's indigenous grape tradition. In the glass, it exhibits a bright, delicate pale pink hue. The bouquet opens with fragrant notes of pink grapefruit, fresh orchard fruits, wild strawberries, and exotic papaya blossom. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and beautifully crisp, delivering a core of ripe raspberry, red currant, and citrus flavors balanced by a lively acidity that carries into a soft, clean, and refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh Mediterranean salads, grilled prawns, sushi, light pasta with seafood, goat cheese appetizers, and pan-seared white fish.

halos-chateauneuf-du-pape-adrastee.title: Les Halos De Jupiter Chateauneuf-Du-Pape Adrastee 2019 750ml
halos-chateauneuf-du-pape-adrastee.bodyHtml: Like Leo, noble and engaging, this cuvée is the quintessence of Châteauneuf du Pape, where Grenache is king, and “La Crau” is its secret garden. Adrastée is rare -- the singular satellite of the Halos de Jupiter.

vilmart-grand-cellier-dor-brut-1er-cr.title: Vilmart & Cie Grand Cellier D'Or Brut Champagne Premier Cru 2017 750ml
vilmart-grand-cellier-dor-brut-1er-cr.bodyHtml: Vilmart & Cie Grand Cellier d'Or 2017 is a vintage Brut Champagne from the family house in Rilly-la-Montagne, a Premier Cru village on the Montagne de Reims. Grand Cellier d'Or is the house's vintage-dated Premier Cru cuvée. 750ml, 12.5% ABV.

arnot-roberts-chardonnay-trout-gulch.title: Arnot-Roberts Trout Gulch Vineyard Chardonnay 2020 750ml
arnot-roberts-chardonnay-trout-gulch.bodyHtml:
Planted around 40 years ago, the Trout Gulch vineyard in the Santa Cruz Mountains winemaking region sits at around 250 metres above sea level just four miles from the Pacific Coast. This is truly cool climate grape-growing territory, making elegant wines worthy of Grand Cru status!

Arnot-Roberts have been using grapes from this site for a few years now, using a gentle touch in the winery to maintain the pure expression of terroir from the vines. With wild yeast and just under a year of ageing in old French oak, this is a wine that speaks to place more than anything else.

Gorgeously balanced and with a real mineral streak, this will age well for years to come.

vilmart-coeur-de-cuvee-brut-1er-2007.title: Vilmart Grand Cellier Brut 1er Cru
vilmart-coeur-de-cuvee-brut-1er-2007.bodyHtml:
Vilmart Grand Cellier Brut 1er Cru is a prestigious grower Champagne crafted from Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. This elegant cuvée reveals aromas of citrus, nectarine, green apple, brioche, jasmine, and toasted nuts, with a refined palate featuring fine bubbles, vibrant acidity, chalky minerality, creamy texture, and a long elegant finish.

Food Pairing:Oysters, lobster, seafood platters, smoked salmon, roasted poultry, soft cheeses, and elegant French appetizers.


93 Points - Wine Spectator

A vivid Champagne, with chiseled acidity enmeshed with flavors of crushed boysenberry and chopped yellow peach fruit, lime peel, fragrant nutmeg and cumin, plus hints of crystallized honey and oyster shell. This is tightly meshed and racy, yet the raw silk–like mousse carries the flavor profile nicely through the persistent finish. Enjoy this today as well as with cellaring. Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. Disgorged July 2024. Drink now through 2033.
91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Vinified and matured in foudres, the NV Brut Cuvee Grand Cellier unfurls with aromas of spices, white flowers, lemon oil and pear, followed by a medium to full-bodied, tense and seamless palate built around a fleshy, vinous core of fruit enhanced by an ethereal and saline finish. Based on the 2021 vintage complemented with the 2020 and 2019 vintages, this blend of 70% Chardonnay and 30% Pinot Noir was disgorged with a dosage of seven grams per liter.

caspar-rutherford-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Rutherford Hill Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
caspar-rutherford-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Rutherford Hill Cabernet Sauvignon is an outstanding example of the bold personality and unbridled flavour characteristics of a Napa Valley Cabernet.

Pair with steak, burgers, bison, lamb, mushroom dishes & eggplant.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of dark and purple fruits, spices, cedar, tobacco leaves and licorice. The full-bodied palate has firmly framed tannins and balanced acidity that lead to a savory, rustic finish. Plenty to like. Drink or hold.

bedrock-heritage-red-wine.title: Caymus California Zinfandel 2022
bedrock-heritage-red-wine.bodyHtml:
Caymus California Zinfandel 2022 is a rich, expressive, and full-bodied red wine that pays homage to late co-founder Charlie Wagner Sr.'s fondness for California's heritage grape. Sourced from select vineyards across the state, this wine pours a deep ruby color and opens with an inviting bouquet of ripe blackberry, boysenberry, and dark cherry, seamlessly intertwined with notes of sweet vanilla, toasted oak, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a generous, densely concentrated fruit profile balanced by a round, lush mouthfeel, moderate acidity, and supple tannins, leading to a long, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing:

This robust Zinfandel is a perfect match for hearty dishes such as classic barbecued pork ribs, beef bourguignon, savory mushroom pizza, and aged cheeses.

catena-san-carlos-cabernet-franc.title: Catena Appellation San Carlos Cabernet Franc 2023
catena-san-carlos-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml:
Catena Appellation San Carlos Cabernet Franc 2023 is a refined and aromatic red that highlights the unique high-altitude terroir of the southern Uco Valley. Sourced from the El Cepillo vineyard in San Carlos, where cold nights and alluvial soils promote a slow ripening process, this vintage is characterized by its remarkable freshness and varietal purity. It offers an expressive bouquet of ripe red berries and blackcurrants, seamlessly layered with signature notes of eucalyptus, fresh mint, and cracked black pepper. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and elegant, showcasing a silky texture with fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that leads to a long, mineral-inflected finish.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with rosemary-infused roasted lamb, hearty beef stews, spicy pork enchiladas, tomato-based pasta dishes, or rich dark chocolate desserts.

91 Points - James Suckling

Spices and cedar. The firm and juicy palate shows floral notes and rich dark fruit. Bold, vibrant and expressive.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Sourced from plantings spanning 1997-2005, the 2023 Appellation San Carlos Cabernet Franc leads with aromas of dark chocolate, cocoa powder, tobacco and black fruits. The palate is plush and lusciously textured, concluding with a vibrant, herbal finish that retains a touch of the sweet concentration displayed on the palate.

sanford-chardonnay-6p.title: Sanford Santa Rita Hills Chardonnay
sanford-chardonnay-6p.bodyHtml:
An elegant California Chardonnay from Sanford Winery grown in the cool-climate Sta. Rita Hills AVA. Layers of crisp orchard fruit, citrus zest and subtle tropical notes are balanced by vibrant acidity and a hint of minerality, showcasing refined structure and refreshing clarity.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled halibut with lemon herb sauce, roasted chicken with tarragon, creamy pasta with mushrooms, fresh oysters with mignonette, or goat cheese salad

rumchata-cream-liquor-1.title: RumChata Cream Liqueur 375ml
rumchata-cream-liquor-1.bodyHtml:
RumChata is a horchata-inspired cream liqueur that blends Caribbean rum with real dairy cream, sweetened with vanilla and warmed with cinnamon. The brand describes it as soft, creamy and lightly spiced, with the rum giving balance rather than heat, and it is bottled at a modest 13.75% ABV. RumChata comes from E & J Gallo Winery, with Wisconsin, USA as its origin. This listing is the 375ml bottle. RumChata is at its best well chilled and poured over ice, and it also works stirred into coffee or hot chocolate, in creamy cocktails such as the brand's Cinna-Ruski with vodka and coffee liqueur, or served alongside dessert.

Tasting Notes: Cream, vanilla, cinnamon, Caribbean rum.

Serve: Chilled over ice, in coffee or hot chocolate, or in creamy cocktails.

rumchata-cream-liquor-2.title: RumChata Cream Liqueur 1L
rumchata-cream-liquor-2.bodyHtml:
RumChata is a horchata-inspired cream liqueur that blends Caribbean rum with real dairy cream, sweetened with vanilla and warmed with cinnamon. The brand describes it as soft, creamy and lightly spiced, with the rum giving balance rather than heat, and it is bottled at a modest 13.75% ABV. RumChata comes from E & J Gallo Winery, with Wisconsin, USA as its origin. This listing is the 1L bottle. RumChata is at its best well chilled and poured over ice, and it also works stirred into coffee or hot chocolate, in creamy cocktails such as the brand's Cinna-Ruski with vodka and coffee liqueur, or served alongside dessert.

Tasting Notes: Cream, vanilla, cinnamon, Caribbean rum.

Serve: Chilled over ice, in coffee or hot chocolate, or in creamy cocktails.

black-stallion-limited-release-syrah.title: Black Stallion Limited Release Syrah 2016
black-stallion-limited-release-syrah.bodyHtml: A sophisticated and intensely structured Napa Valley red, the 2016 Black Stallion Limited Release Syrah showcases the exceptional quality of a standout vintage. This wine pours a deep, opaque purple and opens with a complex aromatic profile of ripe blackberries, blueberries, and plum, interwoven with savory notes of cracked black pepper, smoked meats, and dried violets. On the palate, it is full-bodied and concentrated, offering a velvety texture and firm, polished tannins. Layers of dark fruit are complemented by nuances of espresso, dark chocolate, and a touch of vanilla from aging in French oak. The finish is remarkably long and persistent, marked by a perfect balance of fruit intensity and earthy complexity.

black-stallion-limited-release-cab-sauv.title: Black Stallion Limited Release Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
black-stallion-limited-release-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Limited Release Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is made from a blend of vineyards from across Napa Valley. A portion of grapes are from vineyards located in the high elevation mountains that surround the valley. These mountain top vineyards are known for creating wines with intense power and concentration. A large portion of this wine comes from the valley floor regions of Napa Valley, which help to balance and soften the texture of the complete blend.

It begins with aromas of blackberry, cinnamon and cassis. Flavors of ripe fruit, dark jam and savory are followed by velvety tannins and balanced finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of dark plums, mulberries, dried herbs and bark. Full-bodied with firm tannins. Chewy with a silky core of sweet berries and raw chocolate and a focused, vivid finish with excellent length. Try from 2026.

le-dix-de-los-vascos.title: Los Vascos Le Dix 2017 750ml
le-dix-de-los-vascos.bodyHtml:
This wine presents a deep ruby red color. The nose is beautifully complex with notes of plums, cherries and licorice with spicy undertones of nutmeg, cinnamon and white pepper. On the palate, the wine shows a good volume and structure with nice mature tannins balanced by a good concentration.

Blend: 85% Cabernet sauvignon, 10% Carménère, 5% Syrah

95 Points - James Suckling

Sweet berries, black olives and hints of thyme, tobacco and chocolate. Full-bodied with a dense, agile palate of pretty ripe fruit and spice, earth and cocoa undertones to the currant flavors. Drinkable now, but much better in 2024.

93 Points - Decanter

Made for the first time in 1996 to commemorate Domaines Barons de Rothschild’s first decade in Chile, Le Dix is a Bordeaux blend with a classical, elegant character. Its 20th edition is 95% Cabernet Sauvignon with 5% Syrah, delivering a nose of herbs, spices, dark fruit, graphite, minerals and a slightly rustic quality. This is a firm, concentrated wine with polished tannins and a lengthy finish. Drinking Window: 2021 - 2028.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Refined and minerally style, with ripe dark fruit and plum tart flavors that are supported by medium-grained tannins. Rich and contoured in the midpalate, with cappuccino notes on the finish with green herbal hints.

xavier-vignon-chateauneuf-du-pape-cuvee.title: Clos de l'Oratoire des Papes Chateauneuf du Pape Cuvee Les Choregies Rouge
xavier-vignon-chateauneuf-du-pape-cuvee.bodyHtml:
Clos de l'Oratoire des Papes Les Chorégies Rouge is a powerful yet elegant Châteauneuf-du-Pape crafted from traditional Southern Rhône varieties. Aromas of blackberry, black cherry, plum, lavender, licorice, and warm spices lead to a full-bodied palate with silky tannins, remarkable depth, and a persistent, complex finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast lamb, grilled ribeye, duck confit, braised beef, wild game, Provençal cuisine, or aged hard cheeses.

denavolo-dinavolo.title: Dinavolo Bianco 2020 750ml
denavolo-dinavolo.bodyHtml: Denavolo Rivergaro Dinavolo Bianco 2020 is a natural wine from Emilia-Romagna, Italy, known for its unfiltered, rustic style. It features a blend of Malvasia di Candia, Ortrugo, and Marsanne grapes. This wine is described as having yellow fruit and saline mineral notes, with a structured acidity and tannins that provide a long, lingering finish. It's often described as having a cloudy appearance, a light yellow color, and notes of honey, minerals, dried apricot, peach, and orange zest.

arkenstone-nvd-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Argot Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
arkenstone-nvd-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Argot Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is a rich, expressive red wine from California's renowned Napa Valley. Crafted to showcase the depth and character of Cabernet Sauvignon, this wine offers a generous combination of dark fruit, elegant structure, and savoury complexity. Aromas of blackberry, blackcurrant, ripe plum, and subtle baking spices lead into a full-bodied palate with notes of dark cherry, cocoa, vanilla, and oak. Smooth yet structured tannins provide balance, while a lingering finish makes it an excellent choice for special occasions, hearty meals, or cellaring.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, beef tenderloin, venison, aged cheddar, and mushroom-based dishes.

arkenstone-obsidian-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Obsidian Ridge Volcanic Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
arkenstone-obsidian-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Obsidian Ridge Volcanic Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, robust, and intense California red wine crafted from high-elevation, volcanic soils planted with obsidian glass gravel in the Mayacamas Mountain Range. On the nose, it unveils expressive aromas of lush boysenberry, dark plum, clove, and toasted oak, intertwined with delicate floral notes of violet and black pepper. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied structure brimming with concentrated blackberry, blood orange peel, dark chocolate, and sarsaparilla flavors, framed by grippy, firm tannins and vibrant acidity that leads into a persistent, structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs fantastically with braised lamb shanks, grilled ribeye steak, roasted venison, wild mushroom risotto, or sharp aged cheeses.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine is aromatic, with lush boysenberry, star anise, clove, violets, and toasted oak on the nose. The palate offers blackberry, blood orange peel, sarsaparilla, bittersweet chocolate, vanilla cream, and grippy acidity on the finish. Aerate and pair with lamb shank.

azul-y-garanza-desierto.title: Azul Y Garanza Desierto 2013 750ml
azul-y-garanza-desierto.bodyHtml: Made only with grapes from the Desert vineyard, a single plot located very close to the natural park of the Bardenas Reales de Navarra, which is characterized by a very arid soil and a great variation in temperatures between day and night. With an aging of 15 months in French oak barrels, it has an intense cherry color with purple tones. On the nose it stands out for its aroma of black fruits and its minerality, while in the mouth the black fruits come out again and a long finish.

champagne-dampierre-brut-gc-family-res.title: Comte Audoin De Dampierre Family Reserve Blanc De Blancs Brut Champagne Grand Cru 2012 750ml
champagne-dampierre-brut-gc-family-res.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2012 vintage) "Sealed with string, the traditional 18th-century technique of closing Champagne corks, this rich wine is from three Grand Cru villages in the Côte des Blancs. Richness is offset by intense mineral freshness that lies in the background. This well-balanced wine is ready to drink. Roger Voss" - Wine Enthusiast

vatan.title: Atanasio Añejo Tequila
vatan.bodyHtml:
Lightly rested Añejo, spending only 13 months in American white oak barrels allowing pure agave flavors of the base Tequila to really shine Small batch, hand-crafted by Maestro Tequilero Rene Carranza

Prominent flavors of sweet cooked agave, peppery oak, and vanilla

quinta-das-carvalhas-touriga-nacional.title: Quinta Das Carvalhas Touriga Nacional 2022
quinta-das-carvalhas-touriga-nacional.bodyHtml:
A refined and expressive Portuguese red from the Douro Valley, showcasing the distinctive character of Touriga Nacional. Aromas of ripe dark berries, black plum and violets are complemented by subtle spice and floral notes. The palate is rich and well-structured, with concentrated fruit, smooth tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing:
Excellent with grilled or roasted red meats, lamb, game, hearty stews, sausages, mushroom dishes and mature cheeses.

Serving: Serve slightly below room temperature. Decanting is recommended to allow the wine to fully open.

falernia-single-vineyard-carmenere.title: Falernia Pedriscal Single Vineyard Reserva Carmenere 2019 750ml

charles-heidsieck-blanc-de-mille-giftbox.title: Charles Heidsieck Blanc des Millenaires 2007
charles-heidsieck-blanc-de-mille-giftbox.bodyHtml:
An exceptional vintage Blanc de Blancs Champagne crafted entirely from Chardonnay, showcasing refined aromas of grapefruit, yuzu, quince, toasted notes and delicate smoke. The palate reveals vibrant acidity, creamy lemon meringue, saline minerality and an elegant, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Excellent with oysters, lobster, shellfish, smoked eel and fine Italian cheeses.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

One of the great Blanc de Blancs Champagnes, this wine only hints of its age and maturity. Up front, the wine has layers of white fruits and a steely texture. It is behind those features that the brioche and almond character begins to show. This is a wonderfully balanced wine, ready to drink now.
96 Points - James Suckling
Intense oyster-shell and candied-lemon aromas pull you into this very elegant champagne, which is so precise on the sleek and focused palate with a finish of crystalline purity and brightness. Still really youthful, thanks to the uplifting freshness! A Blanc de Blancs from 5 top Crus in the Côte des Blancs.
95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Cyril Brun considers the 2007 vintage more interesting for Chardonnay than 2008, and Charles Heidsieck's 2007 Brut Blanc de Blancs Blanc des Millénaires is certainly a compelling wine. Unwinding in the glass with scents of crisp stone fruits, honeycomb, buttered pastry, yellow apples, pear and freshly baked bread, it's full-bodied, ample and seamless, with a concentrated core of fruit and a chiseled, racy profile. Combining generosity and tension, it's a terrific new release.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Sleek and linear, with racy acidity defining the up-front impact on the palate, but then the plushly creamy texture deftly delivers woven aromas and flavors of apricot and ripe white raspberry, pickled ginger, white blossoms and salted Marcona almond, allowing them to expand through to the mineral-laced finish. Disgorged 2021. Drink now through 2030. 259 cases imported.

reinisch-grillenhugel-pn.title: Johanneshof Reinisch Grillenhugel Pinot Noir 2016 750ml
reinisch-grillenhugel-pn.bodyHtml: The Johanneshof Reinisch Grillenhügel Pinot Noir 2016 is a Pinot Noir from the Thermenregion in Austria. It is known for its aromas of wild berries, fine spices, and floral hints, with a palate that is supple and dense with flavors like crushed raspberry, ginger, and spice box. The wine is described as having a medium deep ruby red color and a long, polished finish.

fritz-roter-veltliner-steinberg.title: Weingut Josef Fritz Steinberg Roter Veltliner 750ml
fritz-roter-veltliner-steinberg.bodyHtml: Delicate nutty biscuit notes, fine blossom honey, yellow fruit; a fresh, crisp texture on the palate, well-rounded at the core, with a good length, pleasant fruit sweetness in the finish, potential for 10 years aging; a Roter Veltliner from one of the best locations in the Wagram, fermented spontaneously and matured in large wooden barrels for four months. Very powerful, fine and minerally flavor.

jim-beam-bonded.title: Jim Beam White Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon 1.14L
jim-beam-bonded.bodyHtml:
Jim Beam White Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon is an iconic American whiskey crafted using a time-honored family recipe refined over more than seven generations. Aged for four years in newly charred American white oak barrels, it offers a classic bourbon character marked by smooth, approachable flavors and a balanced, oaky warmth.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with smoky barbecue ribs, grilled burgers, pulled pork, sharp cheddar cheese, pecan pie, or glazed bacon.

Tasting Notes : Bright, rich amber color with a medium body and a smooth, light-to-medium mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet oak, vanilla, spice, and subtle grain notes with light fruit and caramel undertones.

Palate : Smooth and mellow with flavors of oaky vanilla, toasted caramel, sweet corn, and gentle baking spices.

Finish : Clean, warm, and medium-length finish with lingering oak, subtle spice, and sweet corn notes.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as the core base in classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned, Manhattan, or Bourbon & Cola.

chateau-lafon-rochet.title: Chateau Lafon Rochet
chateau-lafon-rochet.bodyHtml:
A respected Fourth Growth Saint-Estèphe, Château Lafon-Rochet reveals classic aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, black cherry, cedar, graphite, tobacco, violet, and subtle baking spice. Richly structured yet beautifully refined, it delivers polished tannins, vibrant freshness, remarkable precision, and a long, elegant finish with excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, grilled ribeye, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, mushroom risotto, aged Comté, or braised short ribs.

optima-alexander-valley-cabernet.title: Decoy Limited Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
optima-alexander-valley-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Decoy Limited Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a highly polished, expressive, and deeply concentrated red wine that represents the pinnacle of the Decoy portfolio. Sourced from premier estate properties and acclaimed vineyards in the sun-drenched Alexander Valley—Sonoma County's premier region for Bordeaux varietals—this vintage benefited from a cool, extended growing season that allowed for exceptional flavor development and elegant structure. Composed of 94% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6% Merlot, the wine was meticulously aged for 15 months in 100% French oak barrels (40% new, 60% neutral). In the glass, it displays a deep ruby-purple core with bright clarity. The highly aromatic nose opens with striking scents of ripe blueberry, sweet blackberry, and dark plum, beautifully layered with nuanced undertones of violet, cardamom, clove spice, and a subtle touch of milk chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and structured, displaying an engaging fluid coherence where a juicy core of boysenberry and dark forest fruits is effortlessly framed by soft, silky, fine-grained tannins and an enlivening spine of natural acidity. It concludes with a long, plush finish marked by a lingering trace of dark fruit, savory herbs, and refined wood oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rosemary-infused grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, gourmet blue cheese burgers, or mature extra-sharp white cheddar cheese.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This ripe Cabernet delivers focused aromas of blackberry, balsamic, black pepper, and cinnamon on the nose. The palate possesses tannic grip, juicy acid, and flavors of cassis, blueberry, plum, and chopped herb mélange through the finish.

bergevin-lane-intuition-cab-blend.title: Bergevin Lane Vineyards Stone Tree Vineyard Intuition Reserve Red 2008 750ml
bergevin-lane-intuition-cab-blend.bodyHtml: Bergevin Lane Vineyards Stone Tree Vineyard Intuition Reserve Red 2008 750ml

chiappini-felciaino-igt.title: Giovanni Chiappini Felciaino Bolgheri Rosso 2019 750ml
chiappini-felciaino-igt.bodyHtml: The 2019 Giovanni Chiappini "Felciaino" Bolgheri Rosso is a full-bodied red wine with an intense ruby-red color. It features a rich bouquet of dark fruits accented with notes of spice and vanilla. On the palate, it is complex and concentrated, with flavors of spiced plum, blackberries, and cherries. The wine is well-structured, with smooth, integrated tannins that lead to a long, harmonious finish.

caparzo-la-casa-brunello-docg.title: Caparzo La Casa Brunello Di Montalcino 2019 750ml
caparzo-la-casa-brunello-docg.bodyHtml: Ripe and inviting, the 2019 Brunello Di Montalcino Vigna La Casa pours a deep ruby/red color and reveals intertwining notes of kirsch, fresh leather, dried roses, and sweet Mediterranean herbs. It's elegant and full-bodied, with ripe tannins, a plush texture, and wonderful length that floats away gently.

caparzo-brunello-riserva-docg.title: Caparzo Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2016 750ml
caparzo-brunello-riserva-docg.bodyHtml: Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016 is made only in the finest vintages, from grapes personally selected by winemaker Massimo Bracalente. The fruit comes partly from vineyards in the north of the Montalcino appellation at about 220 metres and partly from sites south of Montalcino at about 270 metres, all on sandy, stony Pliocene soils facing south-southeast. The 2016 spent two years in Slavonian and French oak barrels. Caparzo produced its first Brunello Riserva in 1980, and the Riserva is made to show its best several years after bottling, with the capacity for long ageing. 750ml, 14% ABV.

elio-sandri-barolo.title: Elio Sandri Cascina Disa 'Perno' 2018 750ml
elio-sandri-barolo.bodyHtml:
The Elio Sandri Barolo Perno 2018 is a Nebbiolo-based Barolo wine known for its rich, complex flavors and structure. It features aromas of red fruits, herbs, and subtle earthiness, along with a captivating bouquet of leather and orange peel. The wine exhibits a powerful, concentrated profile with a remarkable structure, thanks to the 2018 vintage. 
Key characteristics of the Elio Sandri Barolo Perno 2018:
Vintage: 2018.
Grape: Nebbiolo.
Style: A traditional, long-macerated Barolo with a wild, exotic character.
Aromas: Red fruits, herbs, subtle earthiness, leather, orange peel.
Palate: Powerful, concentrated, with a remarkable structure, balanced acidity, and smooth tannins.
Aging: Aged in Slavonian oak, typically for 60 months or more, says Cave Bristol. 

95 Points - Vinous
"A profound and captivating Barolo from a traditionalist producer, the 'Perno' unfolds with a complex bouquet of rose petal, tar, wild cherry, and dried herbs. The palate is simultaneously powerful and elegant, with a firm tannic backbone that is perfectly woven into the vibrant fruit, leading to a finish of remarkable length and mineral drive. This is a wine of great personality and aging potential."


96 Points - James Suckling
"The purity of fruit here is stunning, with layers of crushed strawberry, orange zest, and licorice. It's full-bodied and muscular, yet remains incredibly refined and polished, showcasing the unique terroir of the Perno cru. The balance and energy are breathtaking."

elio-sandri-barbera-superiore.title: Elio Sandri Barbera d'Alba Superiore 2020 750ml
elio-sandri-barbera-superiore.bodyHtml: The 2020 Elio Sandri Barbera d'Alba Superiore 750ml is a dry, full-bodied red wine from Piedmont, Italy. It features an intense ruby-red color with hints of purple and exhibits aromas of black currants and spicy dark chocolate. The wine is known for its fresh, energetic character and balanced acidity.

chateau-la-lagune-gcc-haut-medoc.title: Chateau Lagune
chateau-la-lagune-gcc-haut-medoc.bodyHtml:
Château La Lagune is an elegant Third Growth Haut-Médoc renowned for its refined aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, violet, cedar, graphite, tobacco, and subtle baking spices. Silky tannins, vibrant acidity, and beautifully integrated oak create a harmonious palate with remarkable complexity, finesse, and exceptional aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, grilled ribeye, duck breast, venison, aged Comté, or truffle-infused mushroom dishes.

montezemolo-langhe-nebbiolo.title: Cordero Di Montezemolo Nebbiolo Langhe 2022 750ml
montezemolo-langhe-nebbiolo.bodyHtml: ruby red, some transparency. Nose is rose petals, orange rind, dash of tar, grippy tannins and black red fruit. Fine mesh of peppery tannins laced across red fruit, blood orangeade tar, the tannins are ever present and peppy - very good. Like the refinement of this and could easily take a few more years. With more air this simplifies with the fruit but tannins still there.

chateau-troplong-mondot.title: Chateau Troplong Mondot 2016
chateau-troplong-mondot.bodyHtml:
A Premier Grand Cru Classé B of Saint-Émilion, Château Troplong Mondot is renowned for its limestone terroir and exceptional depth. It reveals aromas of black cherry, blackberry, plum, violet, graphite, dark chocolate, truffle, and exotic spice. Richly concentrated yet impeccably refined, it delivers velvety tannins, remarkable freshness, extraordinary precision, and a long, powerful finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, black truffle dishes, mushroom risotto, aged Comté, or braised short ribs.

 

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Coming from one of the coolest terroirs in Saint-Emilion, the 2016 Château Troplong Mondot is a blend of 89% Merlot, 9% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 2% Cabernet Franc brought up in 77% new French oak. This deep purple-hued effort offers a smorgasbord of powerful blue and black fruits, smoked earth, truffle, chocolate, and licorice. Full-bodied, deep, and opulent on the palate, it’s a truly great wine as well as one of the superstars in 2016. It should drink well for upwards of three decades.
96 Points - James Suckling
Love the aromas of redcurrants and cherries with flowers. Full body and tight, finely chewy tannins that impress. Linear and focused young red. Try from 2021.
95 Points - Decanter

This is stunning. Troplong never has trouble conjuring up wonderfully rich fruit, but here it is plump and dense without being pumped up. The tannins are chewy rather than chalky, but the elegance of the vintage is unmistakable, and the rich chocolate flavours are dusted with mint. There is a very pretty salinity on the finish that lasts for minutes. I had a fascinating visit here at the start of the week, and retasted several times as this is a wine that I sometimes have trouble understanding. My main takeout is that the majority of the richness here is found naturally in the terroir - limestone on the plateau but with cool clay over the top, which explains why they are such late harvesters.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Aged in 77% new and 23% of one year-old French oak barrels and composed of 89% Merlot, 9% Cabernet Sauvignon and 2% Cabernet Franc, the 2016 Troplong Mondot has a deep garnet-purple color and comes bursting out of the glass with bold preserved plums, Black Forest cake and Indian spices scents plus suggestions of espresso, black olives, cigar box and tilled soil. Full-bodied, rich, plushly textured and oh-so-decadent, it packs in the spiced black fruit layers and finishes with fantastic persistence.
95 Points - Wine Spectator
Ripe and focused, with a pure, unadulterated beam of raspberry and cherry preserve flavors that is both wide and deep, gilded prettily with a lilting violet note and infused with subtle chalky minerality through the finish. Beautiful. Best from 2023 through 2038.
94 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This wine has power and a rich character that almost overwhelms. Intense tannins along with dark-chocolate flavors and huge concentration give a massive wine that shows some of the alcohol in its edge of pepper. The wine will calm and soften although it will always remain huge. Drink from 2026.

fenocchio-langhe-nebbiolo.title: Giacomo Fenocchio Nebbiolo Langhe 2023
fenocchio-langhe-nebbiolo.bodyHtml: The 2020 Giacomo Fenocchio Nebbiolo Langhe is a deep ruby red wine with notes of plum and cherry. It is known for its dry, full-bodied flavor with balanced tannins and hints of licorice and rose. The wine is aged for six months in stainless steel tanks and then for an additional six months in large Slavonian oak casks.

fenocchio-barolo-bussia.title: Giacomo Fenocchio Barolo Bussia 2020 750ml
fenocchio-barolo-bussia.bodyHtml: Giacomo Fenocchio Barolo Bussia 2020 is a single-cru Barolo DOCG from the Fenocchio family estate in Bussia Sottana, Monforte d'Alba, in Piedmont, bottled at the estate by Giacomo Fenocchio. The Bussia is deep garnet in colour, with a fine bouquet of spiced rose and liquorice, and a dry, warm, full-bodied and balanced palate with pronounced tannins and a persistent finish. It is particularly suited to ageing. Pair it with meat, game and aged cheeses, the typical dishes of the local Piedmontese cuisine, or rich international dishes. 750ml, 14.5% ABV.

fenocchio-barolo-riserva.title: Giacomo Fenocchio Barolo Bussia 2020 750ml
fenocchio-barolo-riserva.bodyHtml: Giacomo Fenocchio Barolo Bussia 2020 is a single-cru Barolo DOCG from the Fenocchio family estate in Bussia Sottana, Monforte d'Alba, in Piedmont, bottled at the estate by Giacomo Fenocchio. The Bussia is deep garnet in colour, with a fine bouquet of spiced rose and liquorice, and a dry, warm, full-bodied and balanced palate with pronounced tannins and a persistent finish. It is particularly suited to ageing. Pair it with meat, game and aged cheeses, the typical dishes of the local Piedmontese cuisine, or rich international dishes. 750ml, 14.5% ABV.

deutz-amour-de-deutz-millesime-brut-cham.title: Deutz Amour de Deutz Millesime Brut Champagne 2013
deutz-amour-de-deutz-millesime-brut-cham.bodyHtml:
Deutz Amour de Deutz Millésimé Brut Champagne 2013 is an exceptional prestige cuvée from Champagne Deutz, crafted exclusively from Chardonnay grown in some of Champagne's finest vineyards. This elegant Blanc de Blancs combines delicate floral aromas with roasted pineapple, ripe pear, citrus, and refined pastry notes. Its silky texture and fine, persistent bubbles are balanced by vibrant acidity and a distinctive mineral finish. Complex yet remarkably fresh, this vintage Champagne offers impressive depth, sophistication, and excellent cellaring potential.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, langoustine carpaccio, seared scallops, lobster, steamed turbot, delicate seafood risotto, and aged Comté cheese.

 

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Harvested in October, the 2013 Amour de Deutz—disgorged in September 2022 with a dosage of seven grams per liter—has evolved beautifully with additional post-disgorgement maturation. Based heavily on the Côte des Blancs fruit, it offers a profound bouquet of candied lemon, peach, pear, roasted pineapple and gooseberry layered with roasted cacao bean and smoky accents that underscore its subtly reductive signature. These olfactory impressions transition seamlessly onto the medium- to full-bodied palate, which is unusually generous in context of the vintage: fleshy, multidimensional and with a sweet fruit core enlivened with pinpoint mousse. This Blanc de Blancs culminates in a lingering, toasty finish, rendering it irresistibly approachable even at this early stage.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

A rich Champagne, with a lush, almost viscous creaminess, reined in nicely by vivid, mouthwatering acidity -- a finely knit frame for flavors of white peach puree, passion fruit, toasted brioche and accents of elderflower, fleur de sel and candied grapefruit peel. Long, lasting finish. Drink now through 2035.

94 Points - James Suckling

Elegant and refreshing nose, with a chalky layer to the lemony citrus and fine, creamy pastry aromas. Fresh delivery of creamy mousse, followed by a nice grip of fruit and autolysis. Long and subtle, with a bright, almost zesty finish. Drink now or hold.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Light minerality in this Champagne gives it structure and tension. At the same time, it has softness alongside the fine, elegant fruitiness. Despite its 10 years in age, the wine is still fresh, just hinting at maturity. Drink now.

valdicava-brunello-di-montalcino-riserva.title: Valdicava Madonna Del Piano Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2007
valdicava-brunello-di-montalcino-riserva.bodyHtml:
Valdicava Madonna del Piano Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2007 is an extraordinary, single-vineyard Tuscan masterpiece produced only in the most exceptional vintages. It pours a dense, deep garnet red and immediately unfurls a powerful, multi-layered bouquet featuring aromas of sweet blueberries, ripe blackberries, and wild violets, complemented by masculine notes of cured leather, dark tobacco, and dry espresso. On the palate, this full-bodied Riserva shows incredible structure, balance, and volume, delivering rich, concentrated flavors of dark stone fruits and balsamic spice. This is beautifully framed by dense, velvety, and polished tannins that carry into an endlessly complex, majestic finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with slow-braised wild boar ragù, grilled Bistecca alla Fiorentina, or mature, sharply flavored aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

98 Points - James Suckling

An impressively structured wine. Aromas of blueberries and blackberries with hints of violets. Full body, with velvety and rich tannins. Very tannic and powerful yet the tannins are polished and pretty. Layers of everything here. Give this another three to four years before opening.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Here's an unforgettable wine that absolutely makes the case for 2007 being one of the best vintages of late in Montalcino. The wine is broad and polished with masculine tones of dark fruit, leather and tobacco. These aromas evolve so quickly and with such pulsing intensity, the wine comes alive suddenly. There are dusty mineral shadings at the back with tightly textured tannins.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2007 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Madonna del Piano is another super-finessed wine. Subtle floral notes meld into expressive red berries in a sumptuous Brunello that captures the essence of the vintage. The style is rich and deeply textured, but the 2007, as outstanding as it is, needs at least a few more years in bottle. Once again, finesse rules the day. Anticipated maturity: 2017-2027.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

A vibrant, taut style, delivering aromas and flavors of cherry, raspberry, spice and mineral tightly wound around a core of steely acidity and dense tannins. Well-proportioned and set for a long evolution, this version is very fresh and long. Best from 2016 through 2035.

vinsobres.title: Domaine Constant-Duquesnoy 'Vinsobres' 2013
vinsobres.bodyHtml:
Domaine Constant-Duquesnoy 'Vinsobres' 2013 is a complex, structured, and deep Southern Rhône red wine sourced from terraced, limestone-pebble vineyards situated at high elevations in the Vinsobres appellation. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color. The nose opens with inviting aromas of black cherry, wild blackberry, and crushed plum, layered with Mediterranean scrubland herbs, dried thyme, licorice, and a subtle crushed-rock minerality. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, offering a generous core of dark fruit balanced by lively, fresh acidity and well-structured, fine-grained tannins that resolve into a savory, warming finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, duck breast, game stews, wild mushroom risotto, and aged hard cheeses.

robert-mondavi-bourbon-barrel-chardonnay.title: Vint Bourbon Barrel Aged Cabernet Sauvignon
robert-mondavi-bourbon-barrel-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Deep rich ruby. Aromas of blackberry cobbler, ripe and dark mixed berries, graham cracker, brown sugar, vanilla, milk chocolate, toasty oak, with notes of coffee and smoke. On the palate, ripe blackberry cobbler, blueberry pie, pralines, sweet vanilla custard, brown sugar, caramel, mocha with hints of coffee. Ripe, dense and soft chewy tannins with toasty oak round the wine out with a lush, long, and lingering finish. A superb accompaniment to bourbon glazed ribs, charcuterie board, hearty pasta dishes, and strong cheeses.

v36-foundation-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
v36-foundation-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 pours an opaque, deep purple-ruby color with brilliant violet edges in the glass. Sourced from a diverse palette of eight premium Napa Valley sub-appellations, this expressive Cabernet Sauvignon represents the Wagner family's iconic signature style of opulent fruit density and supple tannic structural power. The highly fragrant bouquet opens with lush aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis paste, and black cherry compote, intricately layered with secondary notes of cocoa powder, espresso bean, warm baking spices, and fine toasted cedarwood. On the palate, the wine delivers a full-bodied, texturally luxurious mouthfeel framed by incredibly soft, fine-grained tannins that eliminate any youthfully bitter edges. A dense mid-palate of concentrated dark orchard fruits and mocha flows seamlessly alongside well-balanced acidity, carrying outstanding weight into a long, satisfyingly plush finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime grilled ribeye steak with rosemary butter, slow-braised beef short ribs, or an artisanal board of aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

chateau-la-font-du-loup-chateauneuf-du-p.title: Chateau De La Font Du Loup Chateauneuf-Du-Pape Rouge 2022 750ml
chateau-la-font-du-loup-chateauneuf-du-p.bodyHtml: In this wine, hints of fresh garrigue and bramble accent sun-kissed black cherry flavor. It's a fleshy, full-bodied wine with a juicy fruit profile but darker earth tones and dense, chalky tannins anchor the finish. Approachable already the wine should hold well through 2030.

caparzo-brunello-riserva-docg-2011.title: Caparzo Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2016 750ml
