caparzo-brunello-riserva-docg-2011.bodyHtml: Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016 is made only in the finest vintages, from grapes personally selected by winemaker Massimo Bracalente. The fruit comes partly from vineyards in the north of the Montalcino appellation at about 220 metres and partly from sites south of Montalcino at about 270 metres, all on sandy, stony Pliocene soils facing south-southeast. The 2016 spent two years in Slavonian and French oak barrels. Caparzo produced its first Brunello Riserva in 1980, and the Riserva is made to show its best several years after bottling, with the capacity for long ageing. 750ml, 14% ABV.

chateau-prieure-lichine-2014.title: Chateau Prieure-Lichine 2014
chateau-prieure-lichine-2014.bodyHtml:
Château Prieuré-Lichine 2014 is an incredibly elegant, refined, and classic Left Bank red wine from the prestigious Margaux appellation. Sourced from Garonne gravel soils, this blend benefits from the precision of a state-of-the-art gravity-fed vat cellar, which was newly completed for this vintage. On the nose, the wine reveals a fragrant, expressive bouquet of blackcurrants, ripe plums, and red cherries, beautifully complexed by notes of lavender, licorice, smoke, and fine tobacco. The palate is medium-bodied, remarkably silky, and harmonious, offering a supple, velvety texture backed by fine-grained, chalky tannins and a lively, mineral-driven freshness that sweeps into a long, persistent, and delicately spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with roasted rack of lamb, slow-braised veal chops, duck breast with berry reduction, or classic beef tenderloin.

93 Points Wine Enthusiast

This is a concentrated wine, packed with tannins and black plum fruits. It has some of the fruity crispness of the vintage although with its dark structure and concentration it is obviously a wine that needs to soften over time. Rich and juicy at the end, it will be ready to drink from 2024.

93 Points James Suckling

This is a fragrant and very attractive mid-weight wine with plenty of ripe fruit to balance the full, dry tannins, which give it some real power on the finish. Drink or hold.

chateau-troplong-mondot-2014.title: Chateau Troplong Mondot Saint-emilion Grand Cru (Premier Grand Cru Classe) 2014 750ml
chateau-troplong-mondot-2014.bodyHtml: Château Troplong Mondot 2014 is a Saint-Émilion Premier Grand Cru Classé from an estate on the highest point of Saint-Émilion's famous limestone plateau, on Bordeaux's Right Bank. The 43-hectare property enjoys ideal soils and exposure, and its wines combine strength with elegance and complexity with precision. The 2014 blends 90% Merlot with 8% Cabernet Sauvignon and 2% Cabernet Franc, showing blackcurrant, blackberry and raspberry with graphite, espresso and earth, and a fresh, precise, elegant palate. 750ml, 14.5% ABV.

jamet-vin-de-pays-syrah.title: Domaine Jamet 'Collines Rhodaniennes' Syrah 2023
jamet-vin-de-pays-syrah.bodyHtml:
Domaine Jamet 'Collines Rhodaniennes' Syrah 2023 is a remarkably vibrant, aromatic, and expressive Northern Rhône red wine produced by the legendary Jean-Paul and Corinne Jamet. Visually displaying a brilliant ruby-purple hue with dark violet highlights, it opens with highly fragrant notes of fresh raspberries, wild blackberries, and crushed blueberries, layered with complex savory accents of cracked black pepper, violet petals, tapenade, and delicate smoked bacon fat. On the palate, it exhibits a silky medium body framed by fine-grained, approachable tannins and lively, mouth-watering acidity, delivering pure red and dark fruit flavors coupled with an elegant, spicy, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled lamb chops, duck breast, cured charcuterie, roasted pork tenderloin, wild mushroom dishes, and medium-aged sheep's milk cheeses.

dragon-de-quintus-2014.title: Domaine Clarence Dillon 'Le Dragon de Quintvs' 2014 750ml
dragon-de-quintus-2014.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2014 vintage) "Ripe Merlot gives this wine its richness and concentration. It is filled with black fruits, hints of the wood aging and with tannins cushioned by the fruit. Acidity shows strongly at the end, leaving a bright aftertaste. Drink from 2020." - 91/100, Wine Enthusiast

pittnauer-pinot-noir.title: Pittnauer Pinot Noir 2019 750ml
pittnauer-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Gerhard Pittnauer produces some of Austraia’s most famed modern wines. This deep coloured pinot noir is rich and ripe with strawberry, cherry and spice on the palate. It finishes with silky tannins. Break out and try a new region for pinot – you won’t regret it.

ricasoli-brolio-bettino-chianti-classico.title: Ricasoli Brolio Chianti Classico Riserva 2022
ricasoli-brolio-bettino-chianti-classico.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Brolio Chianti Classico Riserva is a refined and structured red that reflects the diverse geological terroirs of the Brolio estate. It displays a dark, bright ruby colour and opens with an intense bouquet of ripe black cherries, plums, and wilted roses, layered with complex notes of cloves, aniseed, and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is warm and full-bodied, showcasing a sturdier backbone than the standard bottling. It features a harmonious balance between velvety, well-integrated tannins and a vibrant acidity, leading to a long, persistent finish with hints of mineral-rich earth and savory spices. This vintage is noted for its resilience and fruit intensity, achieved despite a particularly hot growing season.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained and classic wine with aromas of smoke, woodland, graphite, leather, dried cherries and potpourri. Medium-bodied, this shows refined tannins, a velvety texture, crisp acidity and a chewy, dynamic finish with tension and balance. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A mouthwatering version, this red delivers plum, cherry, floral, earth, olive and bay flavors. Backed by vibrant acidity and resonant tannins, leaving a long, expansive finish. Elegant and intense. Best from 2027 through 2040.

west-cape-howe-book-ends-cab-sauv.title: West Cape Howe Book Ends Cabernet Sauvignon 2015 750ml
west-cape-howe-book-ends-cab-sauv.bodyHtml: West Cape Howe Book Ends Cabernet Sauvignon 2015 750ml

conde-valdemar-gran-reserva.title: Bodegas Valdemar Conde de Valdemar Gran Reserva 2015 750ml
conde-valdemar-gran-reserva.bodyHtml:
85% Tempranillo 15% Graciano After destemming and crushing, a cold pre-fermentation takes place for 48 hours at 17º to extract primary aromas. The alcoholic fermentation begins in stainless steel tanks at 26º to get structure and color. After 12 days maceration malolactic in oak barrels follows and 32 months of aging in French and American oak barrels.

This wine is the crown jewel for Bodegas Valdemar. They just make this wine when the quality of the grapes are outstanding to make sure they maintain their premium quality standards of this wine through the vintages. The ageing potential is superb for the Gran Reserva.

This wine displays attractive red cherry color with a burgundy rim. Potent spicy aromas, together with vanilla and cocoa notes. Very potent on the palate, rounded, with a long aftertaste and personality. This wine matches perfectly with red meat, stews and roasted dishes as well as game.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Dark ruby in the glass, this wine has a nose of Chambord, toffee and dried Mediterranean herbs. A sheath of opulent tannins is wrapped around fruit of the wood, caramel, anisette and dark chocolate flavors. Pleasant touches of cedar chest and cigar box extend into the enduring finish. Drink until 2040.

chateau-grand-puy-ducasse-2014.title: Chateau Grand Puy Ducasse 2014 750ml
chateau-grand-puy-ducasse-2014.bodyHtml:
This is a particularly rich wine for the vintage offering a well structured palate with ripe black fruit flavors of cassis and plum with some licorice on the finish.  Well defined supporting tannins and a streak of graphite.  Enjoy this classy red with grilled steak, mushrooms and roasted vegetables. 

92 Points Wine Enthusiast

For the vintage, this is a particularly rich wine. It is structured and firm with opulent black-plum fruit that gives the wine a ripe character. Dense with supporting tannins, the wine is going to develop well over the medium term. Drink from 2022. (RV)  (2/2017)

91 Points James Suckling

The forthright cassis note is immediately appealing, then the rather bold tannic structure sneaks up on you and shows that this is a serious wine. Maybe not quite the power and length of the appellation’s top wines in 2014, but still an impressive wine.  (2/2017)

90 Points Wine Spectator

Ripe and racy, with a graphite streak that drives the core of cassis and plum fruit along, picking up an anise edge on the finish. Not big, but fresh and well-defined. Shows some sneaky grip. Best from 2018 through 2026. (JM)  (3/2017)

chateau-branaire-ducru-2014.title: Chateau-Branaire Ducru 2014 750ml
chateau-branaire-ducru-2014.bodyHtml: Château Branaire-Ducru 2014 is a Saint-Julien from a Fourth Growth estate, classified in the 1855 Classification of the Médoc, on Bordeaux's Left Bank. The 2014 Branaire-Ducru is known for an elegant, fresh and balanced style, with a fragrant nose of violet, cassis and spice, and a structured yet silky palate showing plum, blackcurrant and graphite. It was judged ready to drink from 2021 onwards. The estate's label carries the words Grand Cru Classé en 1855 above the Château Branaire-Ducru name and the Saint-Julien appellation. 750ml bottle, 13.5% ABV.

arette-suave-blanco-tequila.title: Arette Artesanal Suave Blanco Tequila
arette-suave-blanco-tequila.bodyHtml:
Arette Artesanal Blanco Tequila is an exceptional, unaged spirit crafted by the Orendain family at Destileria El Llano, one of the oldest operating distilleries in the heart of the town of Tequila. Honoring traditional, time-tested production methods, this artisanal expression is made using estate-grown 100% Blue Weber agave that is slowly roasted in classic masonry ovens, fermented with natural yeast in open concrete vats, and double-distilled in copper pot stills. The meticulous process results in an incredibly authentic, agave-forward profile that beautifully captures the terroir of the Tequila Valley, offering a pure, vibrant, and remarkably smooth experience.

Food Pairing: Fresh, bright dishes such as white fish ceviche with lime and cilantro, Baja-style fish tacos, vibrant citrus and avocado salads, or simply enjoyed alongside fresh tortilla chips and house-made guacamole.

Arette Artesanal Blanco Tequila is an artisanal 100% blue agave tequila produced by the Orendain family at El Llano distillery in Tequila, Jalisco. Slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens, double-distilled in small copper pot stills, and bottled directly after distillation, it highlights the bright, fresh, and herbaceous profile of estate-grown blue Weber agave.

Food Pairing: Ceviche, fresh fish tacos, guacamole, grilled shrimp, goat cheese, and citrus-based dishes.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear with bright silvery highlights, offering a clean, crisp, and smooth mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Fresh cooked agave, herbal notes, citrus zest, green pepper, and subtle earthy minerality.

Palate : Crisp and vibrant with flavors of sweet cooked agave, lemon peel, herbal mint, and a touch of black pepper.

Finish : Clean, medium-length, and refreshing with lingering agave sweetness and light pepper spice.

Serve : Best served neat in a Riedel tequila glass, over ice, or as an elevated base in classic cocktails such as a Margarita or Paloma.

arette-suave-reposado-tequila.title: Arette Artesanal Reposado Tequila
arette-suave-reposado-tequila.bodyHtml:
Arette Artesanal Reposado Tequila is an elegantly crafted spirit that honors the rich heritage of the Tequila Valley. Produced by the renowned Orendain family at Destileria El Llano, this artisanal reposado is made using 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agave, which is slowly baked in traditional brick masonry ovens, naturally fermented in open-air concrete vats, and double-distilled in classic copper pot stills. It is then carefully rested for up to 11 months in American white oak barrels—just shy of the requirement for an añejo. This extended resting period imparts a beautiful complexity, marrying the bright, peppery essence of the pure agave with the warm, sweet influences of the wood to create a deeply balanced and exceptionally smooth tequila.

Food Pairing: Excellent alongside traditional Mexican cuisine such as slow-roasted pork carnitas, chicken tamales with salsa verde, grilled shrimp skewers, or a rich dessert like caramel flan or cinnamon churros.

Tasting Notes : Pale golden amber in appearance, offering a smooth, soft, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Cooked agave, fresh citrus, vanilla, subtle oak, and light herbal notes.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of roasted agave, sweet vanilla, mild oak spice, and a touch of black pepper.

Finish : Smooth, medium-length finish with lingering notes of warm agave, light vanilla, and soft wood spice.

Serve : Best served neat in a Riedel tequila glass, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic cocktails such as a Reposado Paloma or Margarita.

arette-suave-anejo-tequila.title: Arette Artesanal Suave Blanco Tequila
arette-suave-anejo-tequila.bodyHtml:
Arette Artesanal Blanco Tequila is an exceptional, unaged spirit crafted by the Orendain family at Destileria El Llano, one of the oldest operating distilleries in the heart of the town of Tequila. Food Pairing: Fresh, bright dishes such as white fish ceviche with lime and cilantro, Baja-style fish tacos, vibrant citrus and avocado salads, or simply enjoyed alongside fresh tortilla chips and house-made guacamole.

Palate : Crisp and vibrant with flavors of sweet cooked agave, lemon peel, herbal mint, and a touch of black pepper.

Finish : Clean, medium-length, and refreshing with lingering agave sweetness and light pepper spice.

Serve : Best served neat in a Riedel tequila glass, over ice, or as an elevated base in classic cocktails such as a Margarita or Paloma.

arette-suave-gran-clase-tequila.title: Arette Gran Clase Extra Anejo Tequila
arette-suave-gran-clase-tequila.bodyHtml:
Arette Gran Clase Extra Añejo Tequila is a premium 100% blue agave extra añejo tequila produced by the Orendain family at El Llano distillery in Tequila, Jalisco. Slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens, double-distilled in small copper pot stills, and aged for at least 48 months in single American white oak casks, it delivers a rich, complex profile balancing deep oak, roasted agave, dark chocolate, and subtle dried fruits.

Food Pairing: Ribeye steak, mole negro, dark chocolate tarts, aged gouda, churros, and fine cigars.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber with brilliant copper highlights, offering a silky, rich, and full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Rich oak, cooked agave, caramel, dark chocolate, dried fruit, vanilla, and subtle baking spices.

Palate : Smooth and complex with layers of toasted oak, roasted agave, butterscotch, dark cocoa, cinnamon, and subtle dried cherries.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant with lingering oak spice, sweet caramel, and soft roasted agave.

Serve : Best served neat in a Riedel tequila glass or Glencairn glass at room temperature.

hermandad-malbec.title: Hermandad Ferus Malbec Single Vineyard
hermandad-malbec.bodyHtml:
Hermandad Ferus Malbec Single Vineyard is an elegant Argentine red wine crafted from 100% Malbec vineyards in Altamira and Vista Flores, Uco Valley, Mendoza. This expressive wine offers aromas of red fruit, violet, vanilla, tobacco, and chocolate, with a refined palate of ripe fruit, balanced acidity, smooth tannins, and subtle oak complexity.

Food Pairing: Grilled steak, roasted lamb, Argentine barbecue, hard cheeses, charcuterie, mushroom dishes, braised meats, and hearty pasta.

2001-castellin-villa-riserva.title: Castell'In Villa Riserva Chianti Classico 2010 750ml
2001-castellin-villa-riserva.bodyHtml: Castell'in Villa Chianti Classico Riserva 2010 is a mature Tuscan red made entirely from Sangiovese. The estate aims for high quality from low-yielding vineyards, and for the Riserva it selects the best bunches from vines 15 to 25 years old, planted at 250–320 metres with north-west and south-east exposures. Fermentation uses indigenous yeasts in steel tanks at 28–30°C, followed by 36 to 48 months in large oak casks and a further 12 months of bottle ageing in the cellar before release. The estate notes that its Riserva is built for long ageing, reaching its peak between 6 and 30 years after the harvest, and describes red fruit, spice and woodland notes with firm tannins and balanced acidity.

2006-castellin-villa-riserva.title: Castell'In Villa Riserva Chianti Classico 2010 750ml
2006-castellin-villa-riserva.bodyHtml: Castell'in Villa Chianti Classico Riserva 2010 is a mature Tuscan red made entirely from Sangiovese. The estate aims for high quality from low-yielding vineyards, and for the Riserva it selects the best bunches from vines 15 to 25 years old, planted at 250–320 metres with north-west and south-east exposures. Fermentation uses indigenous yeasts in steel tanks at 28–30°C, followed by 36 to 48 months in large oak casks and a further 12 months of bottle ageing in the cellar before release. The estate notes that its Riserva is built for long ageing, reaching its peak between 6 and 30 years after the harvest, and describes red fruit, spice and woodland notes with firm tannins and balanced acidity.

tandem-ars-nova-navarra.title: Bodega Tandem Ars Nova 2016 750ml
tandem-ars-nova-navarra.bodyHtml: Red ruby colour with violet tints. Complex nose and palate. Black and red wild fruit. Blackberries, blueberries, liquorice, low mountain (scrubland), thyme and mint. In the palate is very pleasant, elegant, long and surprising. Fresh, mountain wine with a powerful expression of its terroir.

voerzio-sarmassa-di-barolo-2012.title: Voerzio Sarmassa Di Barolo 2012 1.5L Magnum
voerzio-sarmassa-di-barolo-2012.bodyHtml: Roberto Voerzio Barolo Sarmassa 2012 is a single-cru Barolo DOCG from the Sarmassa vineyard, offered here in a 1.5-litre magnum. Roberto Voerzio is a family-run estate founded in La Morra in 1986, with vineyards in La Morra and in the Barolo area and a production focused on single Barolo crus such as Brunate, Cerequio, La Serra and Sarmassa. The estate is known for strict summer crop thinning, avoiding chemical fertilizers, and gentle extraction, maturing its Barolo in a combination of large oak casks and barriques. Made entirely from Nebbiolo, Sarmassa is one of the Barolo crus in the estate's range. The 2012 vintage in magnum format is a cellar-worthy bottle for Barolo collectors.

voerzio-barolo-torriglione-2011.title: Voerzio Barolo Torriglione 2011 1.5L Magnum
voerzio-barolo-torriglione-2011.bodyHtml: Roberto Voerzio Barolo Torriglione 2011 is a single-vineyard Barolo DOCG from Torriglione in La Morra, bottled at the Azienda Agricola Roberto Voerzio. Made from Nebbiolo, it reflects the estate's founding principles: prime vineyard sites, natural farming and meticulous vineyard work with high-density planting, very low yields and strict green harvesting to concentrate each site's character. Roberto Voerzio began working beside his father and grandfather in the vineyards of La Morra and has become one of the reference growers of the Langhe. This bottling comes in a 1.5L magnum, a format well suited to long cellaring. Magnum at 14.5% alcohol.

voerzio-barbera-pozzoannunziata-2012.title: Voerzio Barbera Pozzoannunziata 2012 1.5L Magnum
voerzio-barbera-pozzoannunziata-2012.bodyHtml: Roberto Voerzio Barbera d'Alba Riserva Pozzo dell'Annunziata 2012 comes from the Pozzo dell'Annunziata vineyard near La Morra in Piedmont's Barolo zone. Voerzio, who founded his winery in the 1980s, is known for very low yields and meticulous vineyard work. This listing is the 2012 vintage in the 1.5-litre magnum format, at 15% ABV.

voerzio-barolo-rocche-dellannunziat-12.title: Roberto Voerzio Rocche Dell'Annunziata Torriglione Barolo 2012 750ml
voerzio-barolo-rocche-dellannunziat-12.bodyHtml: Roberto Voerzio Barolo Rocche dell'Annunziata Torriglione 2012 is a single-vineyard Barolo DOCG, estate-bottled by Roberto Voerzio in La Morra, Piedmont. The label names the vineyard as Rocche dell'Annunziata Torriglione. The 2012 is bottled at 14.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

voerzio-barolo-rocche-dellannunziat-11.title: Roberto Voerzio Rocche Dell'Annunziata Torriglione Barolo 2011 750ml

voerzio-barolo-rocche-dellannunziat-09.title: Roberto Voerzio Rocche Dell'Annunziata Torriglione Barolo 2009 750ml

tenuta-di-castellaro-ossidiana-nero.title: Tenuta Di Castellaro Nero Ossidiana 2018 750ml
tenuta-di-castellaro-ossidiana-nero.bodyHtml: Tenuta di Castellaro Nero Ossidiana 2018 is a red wine from the island of Lipari in Italy's Aeolian Islands, made by Tenuta di Castellaro. The estate presents it as the first great classic red wine of the Aeolian Islands, with a strong, decisive character and an enveloping structure, inspired by Lipari's volcanic landscape and sunsets. The bottle is embossed with the estate's '1435 I Vigneri' mark above a label of black obsidian-like shapes. 750ml bottle, 13.5% ABV.

la-magia-rosso-di-montalcino.title: La Magia Rosso di Montalcino 2024
la-magia-rosso-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
The 2024 La Magia Rosso di Montalcino is a vibrant and high-energy expression of 100% Sangiovese, reflecting the freshness of the vintage. It presents a bright ruby-red colour with violet reflections. The nose is immediate and inviting, offering a complex bouquet of ripe marasca cherries, wild strawberries, and raspberries, layered with floral notes of violet and subtle hints of orange peel and black pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and exceptionally dynamic, showcasing a smooth, juicy texture supported by dense yet velvety tannins and a lively acidity. Fermented in stainless steel and aged for approximately 9 months in a combination of 500L tonneaux, large barrels, and amphora, it concludes with a persistent, clean finish marked by savory mineral notes and a touch of Mediterranean scrub.

Food Pairing: Perfectly complements pasta with meat sauces, grilled steaks, braised lamb, and hard cheeses like aged Pecorino.

91 Points - James Suckling

Ripe cherries and raspberries, orange peels and floral notes on the nose. The palate is smooth and juicy with a medium body, while a gentle grip of tannins adds structure to the finish. Drink now.

maso-cervara-teroldego.title: Cavit Maso Cervara Teroldego Rotaliano Superiore Riserva 2017
maso-cervara-teroldego.bodyHtml:
Cavit Maso Cervara Teroldego Rotaliano Superiore Riserva 2017 is an exceptionally structured, velvety, and deeply complex expression of Trentino’s indigenous "princely" red grape. Sourced from choice, low-yielding alluvial plots in the historic Campo Rotaliano plain, the old-vines fruit benefits from well-drained gravelly soils left by the Noce river. After traditional skin-contact fermentation, the wine undergoes a patient 24-month maturation phase in French oak barriques followed by extensive bottle refinement. In the glass, it presents an opaque, dense ruby-red core with vibrant violet highlights. The highly expressive, refined nose opens with rich aromas of wild blackberries, fresh violets, and forest floor, layered with sweet undertones of vanilla bean, cocoa dust, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, enveloping, and seamless, displaying an engaging fluid coherence where its core of dark bramble fruit is effortlessly balanced by silky, well-rounded tannins and a crisp line of alpine acidity, concluding with a long, elegant finish marked by a lingering taste of fresh blueberries.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted prime rib, wild boar ragù, slow-braised venison, or heavily aged Trentino cheeses like Trentingrana.

maso-toresella-cuvee.title: Cavit Maso Toresella La Cuvee Vigneti Delle Dolomiti
maso-toresella-cuvee.bodyHtml:
Cavit Maso Toresella La Cuvée is a refined, complex, and crisp dry white wine from a premier single estate at the foot of the Italian Dolomites. A masterful blend of Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay, Gewürztraminer, and Riesling, it benefits from cooling alpine lake breezes that lock in intense aromatic freshness. In the glass, it shows a bright straw-yellow color with green highlights. The expressive nose opens with citrus zest, green apple, and white peach, layered with hints of sage and tropical pineapple. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, harmonious, and beautifully structured, balancing a core of juicy orchard fruits with racy acidity and a clean, chalky mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with pan-seared sea bass, raw seafood crudo, light spring vegetable pastas, or herb-roasted chicken.

chateau-grand-puy-ducasse-2015.title: Chateau Grand-Puy Ducasse 2014 750ml
chateau-grand-puy-ducasse-2015.bodyHtml:
This is a particularly rich wine for the vintage offering a well structured palate with ripe black fruit flavors of cassis and plum with some licorice on the finish.  Well defined supporting tannins and a streak of graphite.  Enjoy this classy red with grilled steak, mushrooms and roasted vegetables. 

92 Points Wine Enthusiast

For the vintage, this is a particularly rich wine. It is structured and firm with opulent black-plum fruit that gives the wine a ripe character. Dense with supporting tannins, the wine is going to develop well over the medium term. Drink from 2022. (RV)  (2/2017)

91 Points James Suckling

The forthright cassis note is immediately appealing, then the rather bold tannic structure sneaks up on you and shows that this is a serious wine. Maybe not quite the power and length of the appellation’s top wines in 2014, but still an impressive wine.  (2/2017)

90 Points Wine Spectator

Ripe and racy, with a graphite streak that drives the core of cassis and plum fruit along, picking up an anise edge on the finish. Not big, but fresh and well-defined. Shows some sneaky grip. Best from 2018 through 2026. (JM)  (3/2017)

bowmore-12-yr-old.title: Bowmore 12 Year Old 350ml
bowmore-12-yr-old.bodyHtml: Bowmore 12 Year Old is a masterclass in balance, representing the soul of Islay’s oldest distillery. Combining the raw power of maritime peat smoke with the elegance of citrus and honey, this single malt is matured with care to deliver a remarkably complex yet smooth drinking experience. On the palate, you'll discover layers of dark chocolate and subtle cocoa, followed by a refreshing burst of lemon and a gentle, smoky finish that reflects the Atlantic air of its seaside home. Whether enjoyed neat or with a drop of water to unlock its deeper floral notes, Bowmore 12 is an essential addition to any Scotch collection.

chateau-branaire-ducru-2015.title: Chateau-Branaire Ducru 2014 750ml
chateau-branaire-ducru-2015.bodyHtml: Château Branaire-Ducru 2014 is a Saint-Julien from a Fourth Growth estate, classified in the 1855 Classification of the Médoc, on Bordeaux's Left Bank. The 2014 Branaire-Ducru is known for an elegant, fresh and balanced style, with a fragrant nose of violet, cassis and spice, and a structured yet silky palate showing plum, blackcurrant and graphite. It was judged ready to drink from 2021 onwards. The estate's label carries the words Grand Cru Classé en 1855 above the Château Branaire-Ducru name and the Saint-Julien appellation. 750ml bottle, 13.5% ABV.

checkmate-attack-chardonnay-2014.title: CheckMate 'Attack' Chardonnay 2014
checkmate-attack-chardonnay-2014.bodyHtml:
CheckMate 'Attack' Chardonnay 2014 is an expressive, highly sophisticated single-varietal white wine produced by CheckMate Artisanal Winery in the Okanagan Valley. Sourced from fruit grown in the Black Sage Bench and Osoyoos East Bench, this wine was fermented and aged for 16 months in large French oak foudres. In the glass, it exhibits a brilliant golden hue. The nose opens with aromas of flint, sea salt, white peach, and orange blossom, complemented by hints of subtle five-spice and toasted butter cookie. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied with a rich, textured mouthfeel and vibrant acidity, delivering complex flavors of citrus, lychee, Asian pear, and mineral earthiness that extend into a long, savoury finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with pan-seared sea scallops, fresh Dungeness crab with drawn butter, roasted halibut, lobster risotto, and creamy poultry dishes.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Fermented in large oval casks, this wine is lush in aromas of seashell, flint and peaches. Those flavors combine in a textured, complex midpalate, adding orange, apple and butter cookie along the way. Drink now through the late 2020s. Paul Gregutt

vina-ventisquero-enclave.title: Ventisquero Enclave Cabernet Sauvignon 2012
vina-ventisquero-enclave.bodyHtml:
Enclave is deep, dark red in colour. The nose reveals red fruit such as plums and cherries, a touch of cassis, white pepper, damp earth and a hint of black fruit. It has an intriguing aromatic complexity. Elegant and well-structured on the palate with firm, yet silky tannins. Persistent in the finish. This blend has layers of flavours. The firm tannins of Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot intermingle with the softness and complexity of Carménère and the elegance of Cabernet Franc. Its blend means that Enclave can be cellared for 10 to 15 years.

93 Points - Wine & Spirits

From Pirque, one of the highest areas in the Maipo Valley, this wine shows all the best qualities of Andean cabernet with a crystal-clear transparency. It’s soft and gentle, the acidity and tannins weaving a fine structural network to carry the earthy, eucalyptus-scented fruit. It’s a classic example that captures the freshness of the Andean snow-capped peaks even in a warm vintage like 2012.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Earthy aromas include herbal notes, a hint of tomato sauce, asphalt and dusty berry fruits. This has a raw tannic exterior but is softer in the middle. Flavors of saucy, herbal plum and blackberry come with notes of tobacco and olive, while this is drawing and gritty on the finish, with a roasted quality.

92 Points - James Suckling

Clear and beautiful aromas with crushed blackberry, blueberry and mineral character. Full body, chewy tannins, and structured. Shows tannin and fruit tension. A little austere, but it will come around with bottle age. Made with John Duval of Australia. A blend of cabernet sauvignon, carmenere, petit verdot, and cabernet franc made in Pirque in Valle de Maipo

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2012 Enclave Cabernet Sauvignon is Ventisquero's top of the range, a blend with a pinch of Carménère (5%), Petit Verdot (3%) and Cabernet Franc (2%) from two vineyards in Pirque in the Alto Maipo; situated at some 9000 meters altitude, this is a fresher zone in Maipo, which compensated the heat of the vintage. It had a classical vinification with a post fermentation maceration of three to five weeks with malolactic in barrel and an élevage of 18 months. The nose is classical and quite complex for such an early age, with aromas of tobacco, earth, cigar box and blackberries. The tannic structure is quite large and the telltale Cabernet tannins are there, with a dusty texture, a little rustic with good freshness. Powerful red for powerful food that would welcome some time in bottle.

edetaria-seleccio-red-terra-alta.title: Edetària Selecció Terra Alta Red Wine 2019
edetaria-seleccio-red-terra-alta.bodyHtml:
Edetària Selecció 2019 is an elegant and expressive Spanish red wine produced by Edetària in Gandesa, within Catalonia's renowned Terra Alta wine region. Recognized as a Vi de Finca Qualificada, this distinctive estate wine showcases the exceptional character of traditional Mediterranean grape varieties and the region's diverse terroirs. Crafted from 60% Garnacha Peluda, 30% Garnacha Fina and 10% Cariñena, the wine draws its character from three distinctive soil types known locally as còdols, tapàs and tapàs blanc. The Garnacha Peluda vines, planted more than 40 years ago in the ancient riverbed soils of còdols, contribute remarkable aromatic complexity and depth. Following fermentation, the wine matures for 12 months in French oak barrels, developing harmonious structure while preserving its vibrant fruit character. Deep ruby-red in appearance, Edetària Selecció 2019 reveals inviting aromas of ripe cherries, raspberries, balsamic herbs, menthol and warm spices, complemented by subtle cocoa and tobacco nuances. The palate is rich yet beautifully balanced, offering concentrated red fruit, silky texture, rounded tannins and refreshing acidity. Its long, elegant finish captures the complexity and distinctive Mediterranean character of Terra Alta.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, rosemary-crusted rack of lamb, slow-braised beef, roasted pork shoulder, wild boar stew and duck breast. Its ripe fruit, savoury herbal notes and balanced tannins also complement mushroom risotto, roasted eggplant, grilled vegetables, aged Manchego and other mature hard cheeses.

beaulieu-vineyard-rutherford-cab-sauv.title: Beaulieu Vineyard Rutherford Cabernet Sauvignon 2015
beaulieu-vineyard-rutherford-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon boldly boasts its Rutherford AVA sourcing with its great saturation of color, aromas and flavors. Its massive brambly blackberry, cassis and black plum expressionintermingles with nuances of earthy forest loam, mocha, pipe tobacco, caramel and sweet oak spices. The structured "Rutherford dust" tannins give this wine its dense texture and expansivemouthfeel, while balanced acidity from the excellent growing season adds vibrancy.

91 Points - James Suckling
A soft and juicy red with a blackberry and black-olive character. Dark chocolate, too. Some green olives. Medium to full body, firm tannins and a flavorful finish. Drink or hold.

lieu-dit-gigondas.title: Domaine Des Bosquets Gigondas Le Lieu Dit 2020 750ml
lieu-dit-gigondas.bodyHtml: Domaine Des Bosquets Gigondas Le Lieu Dit 2015 750ml

colline-gigondas-red.title: Domaine des Bosquets 'Le Plateau' Gigondas 2020
colline-gigondas-red.bodyHtml:
Domaine des Bosquets 'Le Plateau' Gigondas 2020 is a structured, concentrated, and deeply expressive Southern Rhône red wine crafted by winemaker Julien Bréchet at the historic Domaine des Bosquets in Gigondas. Sourced from an organically farmed, north-facing single parcel of nearly century-old vines planted in 1922 on blue marl and limestone soils at high elevation, this cuvée represents a distinctive, cool-toned expression of the appellation. Following hand harvesting and whole-cluster fermentation with indigenous yeasts, the wine was matured for 18 months in used French oak demi-muids. In the glass, it pours a saturated, deep purple-violet hue. The aromatic profile is complex and savory, opening with notes of blackcurrant, kirsch, and damson plum layered with cracked black pepper, garrigue herbs, licorice, and earthy graphite. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full body defined by muscular, finely textured tannins, vibrant acidity, and a long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Slow-braised lamb shoulder, grilled ribeye steak, roasted venison loin, wild boar ragù, or aged Comté cheese.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Dark and solidly built, with a stylish mix of cassis, blackberry and damson plum all edged in graphite. Savory acidity courses throughout, and black pepper, tar and smoke make this more savory than sweet; still-tight tannins will soften with time. Mourvèdre, Grenache, Syrah, Cinsault and Clairette. Best from 2030 through 2030.

poderi-colla-barbaresco.title: Poderi Colla Roncaglie Barbaresco 2018 750ml
poderi-colla-barbaresco.bodyHtml:
Sourced from the historic Roncaglie cru in Barbaresco, this elegant Nebbiolo expresses classic aromas of red cherry, rose petals, dried herbs, and spice layered with subtle earthy complexity. Structured and refined, it offers vibrant acidity, polished tannins, and exceptional balance, culminating in a long, age-worthy finish.

Food Pairing: Braised beef, osso buco, truffle risotto, roast lamb, game dishes, and aged cheeses.

poderi-colla-barolo-bussia.title: Poderi Colla Dardi Le Rose Bussia Barolo 2017 750ml
poderi-colla-barolo-bussia.bodyHtml: Poderi Colla Barolo Bussia Dardi Le Rose 2017 is a single-vineyard Barolo DOCG from Poderi Colla in Piedmont, north-west Italy. The wine comes from the Dardi Le Rose holding within the Bussia cru, and it is bottled at the estate by Poderi Colla near Alba. The 2017 is a red wine of 14% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Its label names the vineyard, Dardi Le Rose, above the Barolo and Bussia designations and the Poderi Colla name, with Alba, Italia as the place of bottling.

hares-chase-lepus.title: Hare's Chase Lepus 2013 750ml
hares-chase-lepus.bodyHtml: Hare's Chase Lepus Shiraz 2013 is the flagship wine of Hare's Chase, a family estate at Marananga in the western Barossa Valley of South Australia. It is made from Shiraz grown on the estate's own Marananga vines and is named after the constellation Lepus, the hare that lies just south of the celestial equator, bounding ahead of Orion and his hounds; the winery chose the name to symbolise its aim of making the very best Shiraz from its own fruit. The producer describes Lepus in general as dark and brooding, rich and full, with layered black and savoury fruit such as black cherry, dark plum and blackberry, black olive and charcuterie, framed by whole black pepper and five-spice, with warmth, generosity and finesse.

william-hill-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvig.title: William Hill California Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
william-hill-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvig.bodyHtml:
William Hill California Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 opens with aromas of blackberry compote, Mission plum, and dark cherry layered with notes of toasted oak, molasses, and dried herbs. Smooth and fruit-forward, it delivers a rich palate with balanced tannins and a polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled ribeye steak, roast lamb, beef stew, barbecue dishes, and aged cheddar or gouda cheese.

powell-son-steinert-shiraz.title: Mollydooker The Boxer Shiraz 2024
powell-son-steinert-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Mollydooker The Boxer Shiraz 2024 is an unashamedly bold, rich, and deeply concentrated red wine crafted from 100% Shiraz grown across premium vineyards in McLaren Vale and Langhorne Creek. Matured in 100% American oak barrels (40% new), it displays an opaque crimson-purple hue with expressive aromas of fresh black plum, ripe blackberry jam, dark cherry, mocha, and licorice. On the palate, it is full-bodied and mouth-filling, offering layers of plush dark fruit, soft and well-measured tannins, and subtle toasted oak spice that carry through to a broad, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with honey miso beef cheeks, slow-roasted barbecue ribs, grilled ribeye steak, peppered venison, and aged sharp cheddar cheese.

martins-lane-fritzis-pinot-noir-2014.title: Martin's Lane Fritzi's Vineyard Pinot Noir 2014 750ml
martins-lane-fritzis-pinot-noir-2014.bodyHtml: A single, complex block from our oldest Pinot Noir vines. Granite-based soils & a South-Eastern aspect yield a wild wine of complexity and tension.

marchesi-di-gresy-martinenga-barbaresco.title: Marchesi di Gresy Barbaresco Martinenga 2019
marchesi-di-gresy-martinenga-barbaresco.bodyHtml:
In the heart of Barbaresco appellation, Martinenga is among the most important MeGA of the area, confining with Asili, on the western side, and Rabaja, towards northeast. 

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Always a classical wine, the Tenute Cisa Asinari dei Marchesi di Gresy 2021 Barbaresco Martinenga brings us the sharpness and power of an epic vintage. This wine has a medium-dark luminous color and is light on its feet. The aromas are bright and lively with fresh berry and cassis. The oak contouring is delicate, and the wine benefits structurally from healthy skins, grapes and pulp. There is a delightful hint of Nebbiolo sweetness on the close.

94 Points - James Suckling

A graceful style for this wine, showing strawberries, blood oranges, peachy vibrancy and mint. Medium-bodied on the palate, it has gentle tannins with woven acidity and overall freshness. The superpolished aftertaste is juicy, youthful and flavorful. A contemporary Barbaresco. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine's nose offers a delightful blend of cranberry and cherry, accompanied by a whisper of rose, palo santo, and dried herbs. On the palate, it shines with the richness of wild berry jam and the comforting warmth of black tea. Its bright finish, reminiscent of cherry skin, adds a final touch of elegance, ensuring an assured and regal experience.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
A racy style, this red delivers cherry, raspberry and sweet spice flavors, with touches of eucalyptus, all matched to a solid base of tannins. Ends with notes of coffee and spices. Best from 2027 through 2040.

marchesi-di-gresy-camp-gros-barbaresco.title: Marchesi Di Gresy Barbaresco Camp Gros Martinenga Riserva 2013 750ml
marchesi-di-gresy-camp-gros-barbaresco.bodyHtml: Marchesi di Grésy Barbaresco Riserva Camp Gros Martinenga 2013 is the estate's Riserva bottling from Camp Gros, a parcel within Martinenga. Marchesi di Grésy is a historic Piedmont wine house that has farmed vineyards in the hills of the Langhe and Monferrato since the late 18th century. Of its four estates, the main seat is Martinenga, an extraordinary natural amphitheatre of vines in the heart of the Barbaresco DOCG, which also gives the house's Martinenga and Gaiun Martinenga Barbarescos. This Riserva is bottled under the Barbaresco DOCG at 14.5% alcohol in a 750ml bottle.

marchesi-di-gresy-la-serra-moscato-dast.title: Marchesi Di Gresy La Serra Moscato D'Asti 2022 750ml
marchesi-di-gresy-la-serra-moscato-dast.bodyHtml: Obtained in purity from Moscato grapes, this lightly sparkling wine has hints of exotic fresh fruits, intense, full and harmonious on the palate. It is the dessert wine par excellence, and finds the ideal pairing with dry pastries and fruit

optima-knights-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
optima-knights-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, expressive, and elegantly structured red wine that beautifully captures the distinct character of Sonoma County's rugged, rocky terroir. Sourced from the historic estate vineyards that Beringer pioneered in the mid-1960s, this vintage is crafted in the style of a classic Bordeaux blend, offering both immediate approachability and excellent cellaring potential. In the glass, it presents a deep crimson-ruby color. The aromatic profile opens with a perfumed and complex bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, boysenberries, and dark plum, beautifully lifted by traditional Knights Valley nuances of wild sage, fresh thyme, and lavender, along with hints of dark chocolate, mocha, and toasty cedar oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, balanced, and remarkably plush. It delivers a savory, fruit-forward core of raspberry coulis, black cherry, and red licorice, framed by fine-grained, chewy tannins and a vibrant acidity that carries through to a long, smooth, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, rosemary-roasted prime rib, venison stew, wild mushroom risotto, and mature, sharp cheddar cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

Perfumed aromas of red currants, lavender, fresh thyme and graphite. The palate is medium-bodied with plush tannins and balanced acidity, giving flavors of raspberry coulis, red licorice and baking spices. Very soft and delicate, with a nicely constructed backbone.

folk-machine-pinot-noir.title: Little Engine Gold Pinot Noir 2022 375ml
folk-machine-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Little Engine Gold Pinot Noir 2022 offers dried herbs, forest floor, cranberry, earthy cherry, dark plum, and spice, supported by a silky texture and long saline finish. Fifteen months of barrel maturation, including new French puncheons, adds structure and complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled salmon, mushroom cherry sauce, roasted potatoes, and sauteed greens.

zind-humbrecht-riesling-rangen-de-thann.title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht Rangen de Thann Clos St. Urbain Grand Cru Riesling 2022 750ml
zind-humbrecht-riesling-rangen-de-thann.bodyHtml: The steep slopes of the Grand Cru Rangen overlook the old town of Thann and the River Thur which flows at its feet. This hillside is certainly one of the most spectacular in Alsace (and France?) but its reputation in the history of Alsace wine actually comes from its unique and rare geology. Composed of greywackes (compressed volcanic ash), the terroir of Rangen is capable of making wines that have a strength of taste that defies understanding. More than anything, the Rangen also produces wines with incomparable energy. As with many Pinot-Gris produced on the estate, obtaining dry wines is now easier than sweet wines (quality botrytis is rare) provided of course that harvest is done at the optimal date. In the past, the harvest in Alsace was spread over several weeks or months. With global warming, it is necessary to be able to harvest the same surface two to three times faster, which also implies an organization allowing to be more reactive in the cellar. Pinot Gris Rangen is a wine that ferments quickly, but prolonged aging (17 months for the 2020) in foudres on total lies allows its powerful balance to be more refined.

valdicava-madonna-del-piano-docg.title: Valdicava Madonna del Piano Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016
valdicava-madonna-del-piano-docg.bodyHtml:
Valdicava Madonna del Piano Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016 is a monumental and classic expression of single-vineyard Brunello from one of Montalcino's most legendary and structured vintages. This deep ruby-red wine reveals a highly sophisticated, complex, and perfumed bouquet filled with fresh violets, lavender, black cherry, and cassis, seamlessly layered with sweet sandalwood, damp earth, sage, and a touch of fresh leather. On the palate, it is full-bodied and impeccably balanced, displaying deep inner power and focused, ultra-fine, velvety tannins that glide with amazing fresh acidity into an incredibly persistent, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with slow-braised wild boar ragù, thick-cut charcoal-grilled Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roasted leg of lamb, or mature aged Pecorino Toscano.

99 Points - James Suckling

This is heavenly on the nose with fresh flowers such as violet and cherries with undertones of freshly shaved sandalwood. It’s full-bodied with very fine tannins that are focused and intense with a polished nature. This is a complete wine that impresses at every level. Give it at least five to six years to come together and resolve the tannin structure. Better after 2027.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

Expressive yet complex, this red is already revealing tertiary hints of truffle, fading roses and spice. Features cherry, raspberry, iron, eucalyptus and anise flavors allied to a firm, compact structure. Balanced and long, with fresh fruit, spice and mineral accents lingering on the endless finish.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Valdicava 2016 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Madonna del Piano impresses for its intensity, its balance and its freshness. The wine is medium to full-bodied with a good amount of fruit weight and power that is offset by acidity and the lifted, vibrant quality of the bouquet. If balance is the objective, this wine meets it goals, although like with many of its peers, you certainly won't miss the deep inner power of this determined Brunello.

sperling-amber-pinot-gris.title: Amelie & Charles Sparr Pinot Gris Sensation
sperling-amber-pinot-gris.bodyHtml:
This expressive Alsace Pinot Gris is crafted from organically and biodynamically farmed vineyards, offering aromas of peach, melon, citrus, and subtle smoky mineral notes. Rich and dry on the palate with a smooth texture, balanced freshness, and impressive depth, it finishes with refined complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with Asian cuisine, Korean dishes, roast pork, grilled poultry, mushroom dishes, rich seafood and soft washed-rind cheeses.

finca-de-los-arandinos-el-conjuro.title: Finca De Los Arandinos El Conjuro 2019 750ml
finca-de-los-arandinos-el-conjuro.bodyHtml: The Finca De Los Arandinos El Conjuro 2017 is a Rioja DOCa red wine blend, predominantly Tempranillo and Garnacha. It's known for its rich, powerful, and well-balanced flavor profile, often described as having notes of black cherry, blackberry, damson, and raspberry, along with hints of licorice and spice. The wine has a garnet-cherry color with a purple border and a complex, persistent nose. It's aged in French barriques and foudres.

dusted-valley-chardonnay.title: Dusted Valley Olsen Vineyard Chardonnay 2018 750ml
dusted-valley-chardonnay.bodyHtml: The Dusted Valley Olsen Vineyard Chardonnay 2018 is a Washington State Chardonnay that highlights the fruit flavors of the Olsen Vineyard's high-elevation, cool site. It is known for its racy acidity and natural balance, making it a versatile wine for pairing with a variety of dishes.

dusted-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Dusted Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
dusted-valley-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This is just a spectacular Cabernet Sauvignon from the Walla Walla Valley! This medium bodied wine is both lithe and expressive, with embracing tannins wrapping gently around a focused core of dried herb-accented black cherry and licorice flavors, dancing with finesse on the finish.

91 Points - James Suckling

Bright and focused, this full-bodied yet refined red offers ripe dark berries, hints of cedar and wet earth with spicy complexity. Firm, chiseled tannins nicely frame the ripe-fruit core, leading to a velvety, lingering finish. Drink or hold.

dusted-valley-petite-sirah.title: Dusted Valley Petite Sirah 2020 750ml
dusted-valley-petite-sirah.bodyHtml: This Petite Sirah hails from Stone Tree Vineyard in the heart of the Wahluke Slope AVA and exemplifies the luscious fruit and power that this vineyard is so well known for. Bound by the Columbia River and the Saddle Mountains, the rapid cooling in the evening helps retain naturally high levels of acidity, which in turn preserves the varietal characters of the grape. Get ready – this wine starts big, stays big and finishes big!

dusted-valley-v-r-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Dusted Valley V.R. Special Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 750ml
dusted-valley-v-r-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Dusted Valley V.R. Special Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 is the top Cabernet Sauvignon of Dusted Valley in Walla Walla, Washington. The cuvée comes from the Southwind Vineyard on the Oregon side of the Walla Walla Valley, set high on a ridge of ancient lava flows, where the range of elevations and soils makes for an exceptional growing site. The wine is dedicated to the memory of Chad's grandfather, Vernon Rhodes, and takes its name from his celebrated chocolate chip cookie, the 'V.R. Special'. This listing is the 2017 vintage, a powerful red at 15.7% alcohol in a 750 ml bottle.

esperanto-rosso-offida.title: Ciu Ciu Offida Esperanto Rosso 2010 750ml
esperanto-rosso-offida.bodyHtml: The Ciù Ciù Offida Esperanto Rosso 2010 is a DOCG red wine from the Marche region of Italy, specifically from the towns of Offida and Acquaviva Picena. It is made from a blend of Montepulciano and Cabernet grapes, aged for 24 months and refined for 3 months in bottles. The wine is known for its intense aromas of Marasca cherry, dried floral notes, and hints of vegetable undergrowth and spices like licorice and balsamic eucalyptus.

hollis-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
hollis-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is a rich, elegant, and full-bodied red wine from California's renowned Napa Valley. Crafted with carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine showcases the region's exceptional winemaking heritage and Beaulieu Vineyard's commitment to quality. It offers concentrated dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, and subtle oak influences, creating a beautifully balanced and sophisticated drinking experience. With its smooth texture, layered complexity, and lingering finish, this Cabernet Sauvignon is an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining, or enjoying with a hearty meal.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, barbecue, hearty pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses such as cheddar and Gouda.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Focused and brilliant flavors of red and black cherries and black currants drive this sleek and powerful wine, as minty, toasty, and tobacco-like accents stay subtly in the background until the finish. A full body, medium to full tannins and good fruit acidity lend tangy freshness. Best from 2026.

91 Points - James Suckling 

A juicy and delicious wine with a round and polished texture with hints of chocolate and walnuts. Some iron shavings, too. Medium body. Savory at the end. Lovely dark fruit in the finish. Juicy. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a light mesquite edge that mingles with gently mulled plum and blackberry fruit flavors, while lightly singed vanilla and tobacco fill in through the finish. Reveals a solid graphite spine, too. Drink now through 2033. Tasted twice, with consistent notes

de-martino-viejas-t-muscat.title: De Martino Viejas Tinajas Muscat 2018 750ml
de-martino-viejas-t-muscat.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "Lightly hazy, medium straw-yellow with a gold-amber hue. The nose is full and complex, with good energy, aromas of rambutan, dried apricot, orange zest, interweave candied orange, Turkish delight and lavender. Medium-bodied, dry to taste, very fresh on the palate, nuances of citrus and zest lead the flow with dried apricot, candied orange, perfumes of lavender, and Turkish delight linger. Great energy flow carried by vibrant acidity. The skin contact element contributes to an unctuous palate, leaves a slightly chewy mouthfeel. This is a complex, on-skins Muscat with great energy, bright acid tension and depth of purity. Match with Époisses and chanterelle mushroom in butter & herb over the next 8+ years. 100% Muscat de Alexandria, fermented in tinajas (terracotta amphorae), 6 months maceration on skins, 12.5% alc. 18.5+/20" - Raymond Chan Wine Reviews

cabernet-merlot-the-summit.title: Hester Creek Select Vineyards Cabernet Merlot
cabernet-merlot-the-summit.bodyHtml:
Hester Creek Select Vineyards Cabernet Merlot 2022 opens with fruit-forward blueberry and blackberry aromas layered with cacao, caramel, and sage. Blackberry and cherry flavours lead the palate, complemented by herbaceous spice, approachable tannins, and a lengthy, rounded finish shaped by French and American oak aging.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with BBQ pork chops, roasted root vegetables, grilled steak, or braised beef.

morgenster-lourens-river-valley.title: Morgenster Estate Lourens River Valley 2016
morgenster-lourens-river-valley.bodyHtml:
Morgenster Estate Lourens River Valley 2016 is a classic, complex South African Bordeaux-style red blend produced by the historic Morgenster Estate in Somerset West, Stellenbosch. Aged for 18 months in French oak barrels, it opens with enticing aromas of red and black currants, ripe raspberries, black cherries, and sweet spices complemented by dried rosemary and licorice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied with silky tannins, vibrant acidity, and succulent fruit flavors layered with notes of cedar, cassis, and tobacco leading into a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with braised lamb shanks, roasted beef tenderloin, grilled ribeye steak, wood-fired pizza, and aged hard cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of red and black currants, red cherries, red licorice and rosemary. Medium- to full-bodied with silky tannins. Succulent and fresh on the palate with a good concentration and fruity intensity. A blend of merlot, cabernet sauvignon, petit verdot and cabernet franc. Sustainable. Drink now.

morgenster-reserve.title: Morgenster Estate The Reserve Red 2015
morgenster-reserve.bodyHtml:
A prestigious Stellenbosch Bordeaux-style red blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Dark berries, plum, spice, dried herbs, cigar box, cedar and eucalyptus lead into a powerful, full-bodied palate with chalky tannins, balanced acidity and excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb shanks, grilled ribeye steak, prime rib, venison stew, wild mushroom dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

 

92 Points - James Suckling

This shows notes of blackcurrants and blackberries, together with cocoa, cloves, licorice and cedar. Medium- to full-bodied with a creamy texture and a plush, polished tannin structure. Lots of ripe black fruit on offer, with a lingering finish that shows notes of sweet tobacco and earth. A blend of cabernet sauvignon, merlot, cabernet franc and petit verdot. Sustainable. Drink or hold.

patatsfontein.title: Patatsfontein Montagu 2024
patatsfontein.bodyHtml:
Patatsfontein Montagu 2024 is an exceptional, terroir-driven white wine produced as a joint venture between Reenen Borman of Boschkloof and Henk Kotze. Sourced from a cool-climate, high-altitude single vineyard planted in 1984 on rugged slate and limestone soils in Montagu, this wine captures incredible purity and tension. Fermented with native yeasts and aged in neutral French oak puncheons, it displays brilliant light straw hues with expressive aromas of white peach, green apple, crushed flint, and delicate lemon blossom. On the palate, it is focused, dry, and electric, featuring crisp tree fruit flavors integrated with fine texture, mouthwatering acidity, and a distinctly long, chalky mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pan-seared scallops, grilled sea bass, goat cheese crostini, roasted chicken, or delicate vegetable quiches.

sons-of-sugarland.title: Boschkloof Sons Of Sugarland Syrah 2023 750ml
sons-of-sugarland.bodyHtml:
One grape...one clone...one vineyard...one immensely explosive Syrah that is truly a Syrah for Syrah lovers. The SH99 Syrah clone from the ‘Karibib Vineyard’ in the Polkadraai Hills in addition to a bit of sulfur is all that makes up this sublime wine. Reenen shares the 11 rows of Syrah with Lukas Van Loggerenberg (for his ‘Graft’ Syrah), Sam Lambson’s Minimalist Wines, as well as Jean Smit’s Damascene wines. This is the highest parcel of this ocean-facing vineyard that gets rammed by the cool breezes. Reenen’s goal with this wine is to make it as raw as possible but still with a pretty side. In a very short time this has risen to Syrah royalty in South Africa alongside Reenen’s ‘Epilogue’.

The fruit was hand-harvested in one morning and brought back to the winery where the fruit was placed into a concrete fermenter. Fermentation kicked off naturally with the juice on the skins and stems, and continued for 10 days. The lot was pressed to a 15hL concrete egg with gross lees intact and left to age for 10 months. It was bottled without fining or filtration and just a small addition of sulfur.

avignonesi-chardonnay-il-marzzoco.title: Avignonesi Il Marzocco Chardonnay 2022
avignonesi-chardonnay-il-marzzoco.bodyHtml:
An elegant, dynamic and profound wine, Marzocco will enchant you with its explosive notes of fresh flowers such as acacia and ripe pineapple accompanied by intriguing nuances of vanilla. The palate is sumptuous and creamy with notes of elderflower, apricot and honey. The mouth is delighted by a vibrant, mineral finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Fine reductive nose with creamed apples, lemon zest, fine lees and flinty stones. Textured and almost full-bodied on the palate with fresh, high acidity and a subtle and rather mineral finish. From biodynamically grown grapes. Vegan. Drink now through to 2028.

liberty-school-classic-cab-sauv.title: Liberty School 'Classic' Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
liberty-school-classic-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
Liberty School 'Classic' Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 is an approachable, fruit-driven, and well-balanced red wine crafted by Hope Family Wines in Paso Robles. Displaying a deep ruby hue in the glass, it opens with inviting aromas of black currant, ripe dark plum, and fresh vanilla, accented by hints of cedar and subtle sweet spice. On the palate, vibrant cherry and dark berry fruit flavors blend smoothly with touches of warm cocoa, herbs, and sweet oak, supported by supple, silky tannins and a clean, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, barbecued pork ribs, roasted lamb chops, black pepper portobello mushrooms, and aged sharp cheddar cheese.

prieler-rose-vom-stein.title: Prieler Rose Vom Stein 2021 750ml
prieler-rose-vom-stein.bodyHtml:
The Prieler Rosé Vom Stein 2021 is a refined Austrian rosé that captures the elegance and mineral purity of Burgenland's Leithaberg region. Crafted primarily from Blaufränkisch grapes grown on stony, calcareous soils, this rosé delivers freshness, finesse, and complexity.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Pale salmon pink with a luminous clarity.

  • Nose: Delicate aromas of wild strawberries, white peach, citrus zest, and a hint of crushed herbs.

  • Palate: Dry, crisp, and vibrant with notes of red berries, stone fruit, and a stony minerality. The texture is silky with a clean, refreshing finish that leaves you wanting more.

Highlights:

  • Grape Variety: Blaufränkisch (primarily)

  • Region: Burgenland, Austria

  • Alcohol: ~12% ABV

  • Style: Dry Rosé

  • Farming: Sustainable practices

Perfect Pairings:

Ideal with grilled seafood, summer salads, charcuterie, or as a stylish aperitif on a warm day.

This is a serious rosé with both charm and structure—elegant enough for food, but refreshing enough to sip solo.

bourgogne-clos-de-montmeix-sarl-michot.title: Domaine Michelot 'Clos De Montmeix' Monopole Bourgogne 2016 750ml

hugel-classic-gewurztraminer.title: Hugel Classic Gewurztraminer 2018 750ml
hugel-classic-gewurztraminer.bodyHtml: The 2018 Hugel Classic Gewurztraminer is a dry, aromatic white wine from Alsace, France, showcasing a distinctive floral and spicy profile. It is known for its expressive bouquet with notes of rose, lychee, and a touch of spice, alongside flavors of peach and honey on the palate.

cotes-du-rhone.title: Domaine Paul Autard Cotes du Rhone
cotes-du-rhone.bodyHtml:
Domaine Paul Autard Cotes du Rhone is a classic Southern Rhone red crafted primarily from Grenache with Syrah and Mourvedre. Fermented traditionally and aged in concrete tanks and large oak foudres, it offers ripe blackberry, cherry, garrigue, and pepper notes with supple tannins and a fresh, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled sausages, roast chicken, lamb chops, beef stew, and semi-aged cheeses.

palistorti-di-valgiano-bianco.title: Tenuta di Valgiano Palistorti Colline Lucchesi Bianco 2016 750ml
palistorti-di-valgiano-bianco.bodyHtml:
The 2016 Tenuta Di Valgiano Palistorti Bianco is a white wine blend from Tuscany, Italy. It is known for its rich, full-bodied palate with intense fruity aromas, offering a distinctive and enduring character. The wine is made from Vermentino, Malvasia, Grechetto, and Trebbiano grapes. 

Key Features:
Region: Colline Lucchesi, Tuscany, Italy.
Grape Varieties: Vermentino, Malvasia, Grechetto, and Trebbiano.
Style: White wine blend.
Description: Rich and full-bodied with intense fruity aromas.
Additional notes: Some mentions of earthy notes.

rivera-puer-apuliae.title: Rivera Puer Apuliae Nero Di Troia Riserva 2015 750ml
rivera-puer-apuliae.bodyHtml: Rivera Puer Apuliae Nero Di Troia Riserva 2015 750ml

barolo-classico.title: Borgogno Barolo Classico 2020
barolo-classico.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Barolo produced by the Piedmontese winery Borgogno is born from the union of five cru vineyards in Barolo, Liste, Cannubi, Fossati, Cannubi San Lorenzo and San Pietro delle viole. Obtained from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, on the palate it is spicy, structured, tannic and ethereal.

93 Points - James Suckling

Bright and fresh with sliced berries, peaches and citrus. Cranberries, too. Roses. Medium body. Firm and silky tannins and a bright and vivid finish. Best after 2026.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The wine captivates, with dark roasted cherries and incense, carrying a mélange of spices seemingly suspended in the glass. A hint of forest floor and dried leaves adds depth to the bouquet. A concentrated palate where the flavors of black cherries macerated in spirits dominate, accented by nuances of worn leather, tea leaves, and dried herbs. Fine tannins provide a structured finish to this complex ensemble. Drink Now - 2035.

masi-costasera-contemporary-art-edition.title: Masi Costasera Amarone Classico 2000
masi-costasera-contemporary-art-edition.bodyHtml:
Amarone is a majestic wine which combines dignity with power and grace.

Amarone is a full-bodied wine for red meats, game, and tasty and piquant cheeses, like parmesan. Generally considered a wine for meditation, it is a great after-dinner wine.

87 Points - Wine Spectator

duorum-reserva-old-vines.title: Duorum Reserva Vinhas Velhas (Old Vines) 2018 750ml
duorum-reserva-old-vines.bodyHtml:
This wine is an old-vine field blend up to 100 years old consisting mainly of Touriga Nacional and Touriga Franca with small quantities of Tinta Roriz and Sousao. The grapes are sourced from the Cima Corgo and Douro Superior sub-regions, which offer exceptional terroir and a range of elevations and vineyard characteristics. The grapes are harvested from September to October and undergo a cold maceration in lagares for two to three days. The wine is aged approximately 12 to 18 months in French oak barrels.
 
 Upon arrival at the winery, the grapes originating from 100-year-old vines are carefully selected and de-stemmed. Pre-fermentive maceration at low temperatures with machine treading in stainless steel troughs takes place, following fermentation at controlled temperatures between 25 C and 28 C in stainless steel tanks.
 
Deep red color. Concentrated, intense and complex aroma dominated by ripe black fruits, blackberries, carries, and gooseberry, also showing floral aromas of violet and exotic wood.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This rich, field blend wine, with its mint and spice aromas, is impressive and certainly worth aging further. A strongly mineral texture with dark black fruits, and layers of richness and acidity, this fine wine should be ready from 2025.

renato-ratti-barolo-docg-marcenasco.title: Renato Ratti Barolo Marcenasco 2020
renato-ratti-barolo-docg-marcenasco.bodyHtml:
The Renato Ratti Barolo Marcenasco 2020 is an elegant, medium-bodied red wine from the La Morra commune of Piedmont. Known for its "classicism with transparency," this vintage offers assertive aromas of graphite, violets, and mint. On the palate, it is linear and racy, featuring bright flavours of dried strawberry, citrus, and spice, supported by velvety tannins and a stony, mineral texture. It is crafted from 100% Nebbiolo grapes grown in the historic Marcenasco sub-zone, which has been planted with vines since the 12th century. 

96 Points - James Suckling

This is linear and so racy with a structure and length and focused energy that takes you long and deep. It’s medium-bodied with dried strawberry, citrus and spice. Tight at the end. Classicism with transparency. Drink after 2029.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A beam of cherry and red currant courses through this racy red, revealing flashes of rose and wild herbs, with a mineral underpinning. This is persistent, with a long aftertaste that emphasizes the pure fruit. Best from 2026 through 2042.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Barolo Marcenasco is an international classic, and I have had the fortune of following this wine over 20-plus vintages. I always like the unassuming personality of Marcenasco. It gives you character but never stretches too far in any one stylistic direction. This vintage shows some sweet oak and cinnamon, but you also get plenty of bright fruit. You could fault it for a little too much oak, which appears with more strength in 2020.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Crushed raspberries and ripe black cherries dusted with sweet spices lift from the glass of this Barolo. Showcasing elegant tannins that frame the generous fruit flavors and allow the savory herbal undertones to stand tall in the glass finishing with lifted acidity. Drink Now - 2045.

mouchao.title: Mouchao Tinto 2014 750ml
mouchao.bodyHtml: Mouchão Tinto 2014 is the flagship red of the Mouchão estate in Portugal's Alentejo. It is made mainly from Alicante Bouschet from the estate's oldest vineyard, some vines more than a century old, with a little Trincadeira, and aged in the estate's old 5,000-litre casks of Portuguese oak and mahogany. 750ml, 14% alcohol.

palari-faro.title: Palari Faro 2015 750ml
palari-faro.bodyHtml: From the tiny Faro denomination overlooking the Strait of Messina, this cult red opens with earthy aromas of tilled soil, leather, dried berry, smoke, savory herb and a hint of game. Displaying compelling earthy elegance, the palate offers black cherry, raspberry, tobacco, truffle, tobacco, soil, graphite and licorice.

la-mozza-aragone.title: La Mozza Aragone Maremma Toscana 2010 750ml
la-mozza-aragone.bodyHtml: The La Mozza Aragone Maremma Toscana 2010 is a robust red wine with a unique blend of Sangiovese, Syrah, Alicante, and Carignan grapes. It is described as having a deep ruby red color with violet reflections. The wine offers a complex flavor profile with notes of spice, licorice, and dark berries, along with hints of tobacco and dried fruit. It is known for its full body, firm tannins, and a chewy finish. The 2010 vintage is considered a powerful wine with a bold and intense palate.

julian-reynolds-grand-reserva-2010.title: Reynolds Wine Growers Julian Reynolds Grande Reserva 2016
julian-reynolds-grand-reserva-2010.bodyHtml:
Reynolds Wine Growers Julian Reynolds Grande Reserva 2016 pours a deep, intense pomegranate color with brilliant ruby highlights in the glass. The highly expressive and layered nose opens with rich aromas of fresh plums, wild blackberries, and dark cherries, beautifully integrated with secondary complexities of green coffee beans, tobacco leaf, toasted cedar, and a touch of earth. On the palate, this full-bodied Portuguese red blend delivers a remarkably smooth, fresh, and rounded structure. It showcases a concentrated core of juicy dark fruits framed by vigorous yet well-coated, elegant tannins and a vibrant streak of natural acidity. Having spent 18 months maturing in French oak vats followed by extensive bottle aging, it finishes with incredible length, balance, and a persistent, savory mineral touch.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-braised beef stews, roasted rosemary lamb chops, grilled game meats, spicy chorizo pasta, or strong, hard artisanal cheeses.

amarone-docg-classico.title: Coali Docg Amarone Valpolicella Classico
amarone-docg-classico.bodyHtml: I Coali is the Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOCG of Coali – Tenuta Savoia, a family winery at Sant'Ambrogio di Valpolicella in the heart of Valpolicella Classica, making wine since 1997. It is made only from the estate's own grapes, carefully selected and dried on racks for three to four months before pressing and fermentation. The blend is 60% Corvina, 20% Corvinone, 10% Rondinella, 5% Molinara and 5% other red grapes from calcareous clay soils. The wine ages about five years in oak casks, then rests further in bottle. The producer notes ripe fruit, preserves, black pepper, leather and chocolate, with elegant tannins and a long finish, and suggests serving it at 16–18°C with red meats and aged cheeses. 750ml.

chateau-des-laurets-baron.title: Baron Edmond De Rothschild Chateau Des Laurets Baron 2016 750ml
chateau-des-laurets-baron.bodyHtml:
The Puisseguin Saint-Émilion of Château des Laurets comes from vines with an average age of 33, located in the prestigious wine-growing region of Bordeaux.

It is produced entirely with Merlot grapes, harvested and selected only by hand in October. Fermentation takes place between stainless steel tanks and oak barrels at a controlled temperature. After malolactic fermentation, the wine ages for 16 months in new oak barrels and for a further 12 months in glass, before being put on the market.

This Puisseguin Saint-Émilion is characterized by an intense purple red color, with violet reflections. The nose opens with elegant hints of blackberry and black cherry, enriched by pleasant vanilla notes. On the palate it is of great aromatic complexity, well structured, with dense tannins that accompany towards a fruity and persistent finish.

Perfect to accompany first and second courses based on red meat, it is ideal in combination with game and aged cheeses.

casa-raia-supertoscan-bevilo-rosso.title: Casa Raia Bevilo Toscana 2018 750ml
casa-raia-supertoscan-bevilo-rosso.bodyHtml: Casa Raia Bevilo 2018 is a Toscana IGT red from a small, certified-organic estate just two kilometres from Montalcino, at about 375 metres. Most of its 4.5 hectares were planted in the late 1970s by Ludmilla Temertey, who handed the estate to her daughter Kalyna and son-in-law Pierre-Jean Monnoyer in 2006. Their guiding idea is that wine is made in the vineyard, so the focus is on biodiversity and natural balance, with the lunar calendar followed in the work. Harvest is by hand. Bevilo is mostly Sangiovese with small amounts of Canaiolo, Cabernet Franc and Merlot, all fermented together. 750ml, 14.5% ABV.

vespa-rosso.title: Bastianich Vespa Rosso 2015 750ml
vespa-rosso.bodyHtml: Bastianich Vespa Rosso is aged in oak barrels for 24 months, giving it a rich, full-bodied structure that pairs well with hearty meat dishes and aged cheeses. This wine is characterized by its ruby red color, intense aromas of black cherry and plum, and a spicy finish that lingers on the palate.

domaine-vernay-cote-rotie.title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot Saint-Veran 'La Cote Rotie 2022
domaine-vernay-cote-rotie.bodyHtml:
Domaine Sangouard-Guyot Saint-Véran 'La Côte Rôtie' 2022 is a refined, beautifully balanced white Burgundy produced by Domaine Sangouard-Guyot from old vines in the 'La Côte Rôtie' lieu-dit. In the glass, it displays a bright golden hue with green highlights. The nose reveals expressive aromas of white peach, ripe pear, citrus blossom, and subtle toasted brioche, complemented by a distinct stony minerality. On the palate, it is rich yet energetic, featuring dense orchard fruit flavors balanced by crisp natural acidity and a long, savory, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pan-seared sea scallops, roasted poultry in cream sauce, grilled salmon, goat cheese crostini, and mushroom risotto.

poggio-il-seggio-bolgheri-rosso.title: Poggio Al Tesoro Il Seggio 2023
poggio-il-seggio-bolgheri-rosso.bodyHtml:
Poggio Al Tesoro Il Seggio 2023 is a remarkably smooth and expressive Bordeaux blend from the prestigious Bolgheri coast. Named after the primary watercourse running through the municipality of Castagneto Carducci, this wine delivers a vibrant ruby red profile with an enticing bouquet of fresh bramble fruits, ripe plums, and subtle hints of cocoa, tobacco, and wild Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body characterized by silky, enveloping tannins and a core of vertical acidity that adds beautiful precision. The structural depth gained from 15 months of French oak aging culminates in a lively, clean, and beautifully toasted finish that balances classic Tuscan character with global appeal.

Food Pairing: Matches effortlessly with grilled Chianina beef, wild boar charcuterie, mushroom risottos, savory white meat ragout pasta, and fully matured pecorino cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of leaves and bramble fruit with Mediterranean nuances. Full-bodied, it shows velvety tannins that are precise and elegant, with refreshing acidity and a toasted finish. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Poggio al Tesoro 2023 Bolgheri Rosso Il Seggio offers an appealing mix of ripeness and crunchiness that provides a clear read of this underdog vintage. A blend of 50% Merlot, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Cabernet Franc and 10% Petit Verdot, it delivers a naturally gastronomic profile with soft tannins and good acidity, making it an easy match for baked lasagna or cheese-filled ravioli. Approachable and generous in style, the wine is released in a substantial production of 165,000 bottles.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Blackberry, plum and black currant fruit takes center stage in this juicy, accessible red. Lively and harmonious, with a moderately long finish, but why wait? Offers accents of earth and wild herbs. Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2032.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose sparks with metallic, earthy aromas of top soil, pepper, graphite, gun metal, bergamot and blackberry, while the palate provides balance with berries, stone fruit and an undertone of peach tea. Tannins are big and solemn.

sao-del-coster-la-pujada-2014.title: Sao Del Coster La Pujada 2014 750ml
sao-del-coster-la-pujada-2014.bodyHtml: Saó del Coster La Pujada 2014 is a red from Priorat, in Catalonia, at 14.5% ABV. It comes from the estate's old Cariñena (Carignan) vines near Gratallops, from a steep vineyard planted in 1927, and the wine is given an extended maturation in French oak. La Pujada is a concentrated expression of Carignan from one of Catalonia's most distinctive wine landscapes, labelled Priorat DOQ. The 2014 vintage now has more than a decade of bottle age. It is bottled in the standard 750ml format.

delas-haute-pierre-chateau-neuf-du-pape.title: Delas Freres Chateauneuf-du-Pape Haute Pierre 2018 750ml
delas-haute-pierre-chateau-neuf-du-pape.bodyHtml:
93 Points Wine Spectator

Alluring, with a range of dark plum, raspberry and boysenberry compote flavors that have a lightly mulled edge, showing hints of dried garrigue and juniper. There's a nice caressing feel on the finish. Grenache and Syrah. Best from 2022 through 2034.

champ-rene-geoffroy-millesime-extra-brut.title: Geoffroy Millesime Extra Brut Champagne 2008 750ml
champ-rene-geoffroy-millesime-extra-brut.bodyHtml: The Geoffroy Millesime Extra Brut Champagne 2008 is a dry, vintage Champagne from the house of Rene Geoffroy, known for its light golden yellow color with silver reflections and a delicate, fine-pearl mousseux. The wine is a blend of 50% Pinot Noir and 50% Chardonnay, offering notes of peach, brioche, blackberry leaf, and delicate cassis.

deutz-brut.title: Deutz Millesime Brut Champagne 2015 750ml
deutz-brut.bodyHtml: Deutz Brut Millésimé 2015 is the vintage Brut of Champagne Deutz, the Aÿ house founded in 1838. The house makes its vintage cuvées only in years it judges exceptional; the Brut Millésimé is a blend led by Pinot Noir with Chardonnay, aged for at least five years in the house's historic cellars after blending, and is meant to show the character of its year within the Deutz style. 750ml, 12% alcohol.

cabriz-reserva-red-dao.title: Cabriz Dao Reserva 2017 750ml
