cabriz-reserva-red-dao.bodyHtml: Cabriz Reserva 2017 is a Portuguese red wine from Quinta de Cabriz, bottled under the DOC Dão in central Portugal. The wine has an intense ruby colour with brick-tinged nuances and a nose of balsamic notes, floral scents and ripe wild red fruit. On the palate the tannins are round and firm, full of fruit, and the finish is elegant and persistent. Serve with roast kid or lamb, grilled pork, bacalhau dishes or aged cheeses. This 2017 vintage comes in a 750ml bottle at 13.5% alcohol. Store the bottle on its side in a cool, dark place, and open it shortly before serving at cellar or room temperature.

palazzi-brunello.title: La Palazzetta Brunello Di Montalcino 2020
palazzi-brunello.bodyHtml:
La Palazzetta Brunello di Montalcino 2020 is an exceptionally pure, organic red wine that captures the warm, generous personality of south-eastern Montalcino. It opens with an inviting bouquet of sweet wild cherries, ripe red plum, and wild strawberries, layered with undertones of Mediterranean dried herbs, licorice root, and a hint of smoky minerality. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, structured, and vibrant, balancing its rich core of red and dark fruit with firm, fine-grained tannins, refreshing acidity, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, Florentine T-bone steak, wild boar ragù, braised game meats, and aged Pecorino cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

Polished and precise wine with bright aromas of licorice root, pure leather, violets and cherry stones. Full-bodied, elegant palate with velvety tannins soaked in fruit and flowers, refreshing acidity and a good, savory aftertaste. Plenty of substance, yet the finish remains supple and juicy. Drinkable now, but best from 2026.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Sweet wild cherries and strawberries headline the nose, while undertones of herbs and earth provide balance. The palate is cohesive, but tangy, as the berries and cherries turn tart and the herbs freshen. On the finish, lots of chilli pepper heat and citrus zest combine with vibrant acid to create a very bright sensation.

pouilly-fuisse-la-marechaude.title: Eve & Michel Rey La Marechaude Pouilly-Fuisse 1er Cru 2020 750ml
pouilly-fuisse-la-marechaude.bodyHtml: The nose is subtle and elegant. No excessive power or intensity here, just ripe white fruits, floral notes and nuances of coffee which give all its complexity to this wine which also presents a beautiful delicacy.The palate is at the same level, rich and subtle, fresh and long, combining fresh wood and citrus notes

jim-beam-repeal-batch.title: Baker's 7 Year Old Single Barrel Bourbon
jim-beam-repeal-batch.bodyHtml:
Crafted as part of Jim Beam’s Small Batch Bourbon Collection, Baker’s 7 Year Old was created by Booker Noe and named after his grand-uncle, Baker Beam. Formerly a small batch release, it transitioned to an ultra-premium single barrel expression, ensuring every bottle possesses a unique character. Made using the Beam family’s jug yeast strain and aged for a minimum of seven years in the lower floors of the rackhouses, it yields a classic, full-bodied Kentucky bourbon with high-proof punch and rich oak character.

Food Pairing: Charred ribeye steak, smoked brisket, spicy BBQ ribs, pecans, dark chocolate brownies, and aged cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber with dark copper highlights. Rich, full-bodied, and robust on the palate with a warm, viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Complex and aromatic with dominant notes of vanilla, toasted oak, caramel, dried fruit, subtle nutmeg, and underlying spice.

Palate : Bold and well-rounded, delivering flavors of sweet vanilla, dark caramel, butterscotch, toasted oak, baking spices, and a hint of charred wood.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet oak, subtle rye spice, vanilla, and gentle campfire smoke.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat, with a few drops of water to open up the flavors, or over a large ice cube.

underhill-shiraz.title: Yarra Yering Underhill Shiraz 2016 750ml
underhill-shiraz.bodyHtml:
New world cool climate Shiraz starts here. Heady black plum fruits and pretty violet aromatics interlaced with liquorice spice and nettle undergrowth. The heavier clay based soils produces wine dark fruits and spice, chewy tannins creating the framework to support the fruit and savoury undertones.

96 Points – James Halliday
Hand-picked from a 3.2ha block planted '73, whole berries fermented in half-tonne fermenters with stalk baskets, some batches with 20% whole bunches, one batch with 100%, matured for 12 months in French puncheons (30% new). Bright, deep colour; right from the outset, very different to the other wines in the release, with more spring in its step, more stalky/spice flavours behind black fruits, peppery notes inlaid into the broader mosaic of a constantly changing colour.”

viognier-collines-rhodaniennes.title: Domaine Jamet 'Collines Rhodaniennes' Syrah 2023
viognier-collines-rhodaniennes.bodyHtml:
Domaine Jamet 'Collines Rhodaniennes' Syrah 2023 is a remarkably vibrant, aromatic, and expressive Northern Rhône red wine produced by the legendary Jean-Paul and Corinne Jamet. Visually displaying a brilliant ruby-purple hue with dark violet highlights, it opens with highly fragrant notes of fresh raspberries, wild blackberries, and crushed blueberries, layered with complex savory accents of cracked black pepper, violet petals, tapenade, and delicate smoked bacon fat. On the palate, it exhibits a silky medium body framed by fine-grained, approachable tannins and lively, mouth-watering acidity, delivering pure red and dark fruit flavors coupled with an elegant, spicy, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled lamb chops, duck breast, cured charcuterie, roasted pork tenderloin, wild mushroom dishes, and medium-aged sheep's milk cheeses.

condrieu-lieu-dit-la-cote-chatillon.title: Xavier Gerard Cote Chatillon Condrieu 2022 750ml
condrieu-lieu-dit-la-cote-chatillon.bodyHtml: Xavier Gérard Condrieu Côte Châtillon 2022 is the flagship Condrieu of Domaine Xavier Gérard, a grower-estate in Condrieu in the northern Rhône. It comes from the domaine's finest holding, in the famed Côte Châtillon lieu-dit, mid-slope above the Rhône. After fermentation in tank, the wine spends about a year in a mix of 500-litre and 225-litre barrels, most of them old, which keeps the focus on fruit balanced by bright acidity. The label states estate bottling (mis en bouteille à la propriété). This 2022 vintage is a 750ml bottle at 14% ABV.

xavier-gerard-cote-rotie.title: Xavier Gerard Cote-Rotie 2021 750ml
xavier-gerard-cote-rotie.bodyHtml: Xavier Gérard Côte-Rôtie 2021 comes from one of the rising grower names of the northern Rhône. Xavier took over prime parcels from his father in Côte-Rôtie, including a tiny holding in La Landonne, as well as in Condrieu and Saint-Joseph, and made his first vintage in 2013. The family owns most of its 3.2 hectares of Côte-Rôtie vines, on steep, terraced slopes of granite and schist where all work is done by hand. In the cellar he keeps to traditional practice, with spontaneous fermentation and ageing mostly in older demi-muids. The wine is based on Syrah and is bottled at the property. 750ml.

senses-mcm-88-pinot-noir.title: Bollinger Special Cuvee Brut Champagne
senses-mcm-88-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Bollinger Special Cuvée Brut Champagne is an elegant, richly textured non-vintage Champagne produced by the historic Bollinger house in Aÿ, France. Crafted from 60% Pinot Noir, 25% Chardonnay, and 15% Meunier, this distinguished blend incorporates a significant proportion of reserve wines to achieve remarkable depth and consistency. Aromas of roasted apples, ripe peaches, and delicate spices lead into a refined palate of fresh pear, toasted brioche, and walnuts. Fine bubbles, vibrant acidity, and a beautifully balanced finish make it an exceptional expression of traditional Champagne craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, sushi, sashimi, grilled lobster, seared scallops, roasted poultry, aged Parmesan, smoked salmon, and creamy seafood dishes.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A graceful Champagne, with flavors of black cherry, Asian pear, toast point and salted almond dancing across the palate. Bright and buoyant, with a fine, lacy mousse and delicate notes of lime blossom, ground coffee and exotic spices playing on the finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

A polished palate of fine bubbles with pears, light bread dough and caramel undertones. Medium-bodied with pretty toasted-oak and vanilla flavors. Refined finish. Touch of quince and grapefruit with dried apples. Base wine 2021 plus nine different vintages. A blend of 61% pinot noir, 25% chardonnay and 14% pinot meunier.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Disgorged in May 2021, the latest rendition of Bollinger's NV Brut Special Cuvée is showing beautifully, offering up aromas of ripe orchard fruit, citrus oil and peach, mingled with hints of walnuts and freshly baked bread. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and enveloping, with a generous core of fruit, lively acids and a pillowy mousse, it's seamless and complete, concluding with an expansive finish.

nervi-gattinara-docg.title: Nervi Gattinara 2018 750ml
nervi-gattinara-docg.bodyHtml: Gattinara 2018 from Cantine Nervi, the oldest winery in the Gattinara appellation of Alto Piemonte, founded in 1906. In 2018 the estate was bought by Roberto Conterno of the Giacomo Conterno Barolo house, making this the first vintage under his direction. He brought his traditional approach: long macerations and extended ageing in large oak casks to express the volcanic, mineral soils of the area. It is a Nebbiolo bottled under the Gattinara DOCG. 750ml, 14% ABV.

baron-de-ley-varietal-graciano.title: Baron De Ley Reserva 2020
baron-de-ley-varietal-graciano.bodyHtml:
Baron de Ley Rioja Reserva is a clean, vibrant ruby red. Varietal character with plenty of red fruits and compote with sweet spice and balsamic notes. After a powerful attack the sensation of soft, supple volume gradually extends across the palate for a creamy finish. The aftertaste reminds you of the red berry fruit mingled with hints of wild herbs.

92 Points - James Suckling

A full-bodied, focused Rioja that has mocha, toast, black-plum and clove aromas. It’s flavorful and well-framed with broad, ripe tannins. Long, spicy finish. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Fresh and elegant, with a lively mix of wild cherry, pomegranate puree, rose hip and red licorice flavors underscored by a touch of fragrant earth. Lightly chewy and well-knit, with a well-spiced finish. Tempranillo, Graciano and Mazuelo. Drink now through 2030

corton-charlemagne-hospices-2016.title: Albert Bichot Hospices de Beaune Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 2016 750ml
corton-charlemagne-hospices-2016.bodyHtml: The nose boasts aromas of sweet spices, citrus including seville orange and grapefruit, pineapple, rocky minerality. On the palate, it is spirited and powerful, fleshy and well structured. This wine will reach its potential after several years’ ageing. Cellar for 7 to 10 years or more.

meursault-charmes-premier-cru-2016.title: Domaine Faiveley Meursault Premier Cru Charmes 2023
meursault-charmes-premier-cru-2016.bodyHtml:
Domaine Faiveley Meursault Premier Cru Charmes 2023 is a luxurious Chardonnay with aromas of ripe pear, white peach, lemon curd, toasted hazelnut, brioche, and flinty minerality. Rich and beautifully textured, it delivers vibrant acidity, remarkable precision, exceptional balance, and a long, elegant finish worthy of this celebrated Premier Cru.

Food Pairing: Pair with butter-poached lobster, roasted turbot, seared scallops, creamy mushroom risotto, roast chicken, or aged Comte for an exceptional white Burgundy pairing.


95 Points - James Suckling

This great chardonnay marries exceptional freshness and minerality with the generosity associated with this famous site. Medium-bodied with excellent mineral energy that lifts and animates. The long, citrusy finish is very precise. Still quite young. From organically grown grapes. Fermented and matured in barrique casks, one-third new. Drink or hold.

cune-corona-blanco-semidulce.title: Imperial Corona Semidulce Blanco 2015 500ml
cune-corona-blanco-semidulce.bodyHtml: The 2015 Corona Semidulce Blanco is a semi-sweet white wine from Rioja, Spain. It's known for its pale yellow color with golden highlights and an intense aroma of white flowers, citrus, and subtle hints of green apple and tropical notes. The taste is lively and crisp, with a good balance of acidity and fruitiness, and a clean, refreshing finish.

marchesi-di-gresy-langhe-chardonnay.title: Marchesi Di Gresy Langhe Gresy Chardonnay 2021
marchesi-di-gresy-langhe-chardonnay.bodyHtml: The Marchesi di Grésy Langhe "Grésy" Chardonnay 2021 is a sophisticated, barrel-aged white wine that stands as one of Piedmont's finest interpretations of the grape. Produced by the historic Tenute Cisa Asinari dei Marchesi di Grésy, the wine is crafted from estate-grown fruit sourced from two distinct parcels: one in the famed Martinenga vineyard in Barbaresco and another in Monte Aribaldo in Treiso. The 2021 vintage is noted for its exceptional balance between vibrant acidity and a creamy, oak-influenced depth. Fermented and aged for nearly two years in new French oak barriques, it offers a rich profile of ripe tropical fruit, toasted hazelnut, and vanilla, underpinned by a distinct flinty minerality.
tags: Tenute Cisa Asinari dei Marchesi di Grésy

piper-cuvee-sublime.title: Piper Cuvee Sublime 750ml
piper-cuvee-sublime.bodyHtml: Piper-Heidsieck Cuvée Sublime is a Demi-Sec Champagne from the Reims house founded in 1785. It is a blend led by Pinot Noir, drawn from more than 100 crus, with Pinot Meunier from the Grande and Petite Montagne de Reims, and it carries a sweeter dosage than a Brut. The Demi-Sec style suits desserts and can also be enjoyed on its own as an aperitif. 750ml, 12% alcohol.

descendientes-de-j-palacios-las-lamas-b.title: Descendientes De J. Palacios Las Lamas Bierzo (Corullon) 2017 750ml
descendientes-de-j-palacios-las-lamas-b.bodyHtml: Ricardo Perez and his cousin Alvaro Palacios are making some of Spain's most delicious wines in the northeastern region of Bierzo and the top wines are several different single vineyard wines that are made in tiny quantities. This is amazing with beautiful aromatics and incredible length and elegance.

piper-heidsieck-french-riviera-edition.title: Piper-Heidsieck French Riviera Edition
piper-heidsieck-french-riviera-edition.bodyHtml: Created in 2006, the Piper On Ice ritual is an ode to the art de vivre in southern France. Accompanied by a couple of ice cubes and a citrus twist, Riviera delivers refreshing aromas of luscious fruits. Piper-Heidsieck Riviera is spontaneous, refreshing and invigorating. Initial cool notes of orange, lychee and yellow peach sorbet give way to luscious aromas of vanilla and fresh melon. Ideal for enjoying a beautiful sunny day, Riviera guarantees a refreshing tasting experience.

piper-heidsieck-essentiel-blanc-de-blanc.title: Piper-Heidsieck Essentiel Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut
piper-heidsieck-essentiel-blanc-de-blanc.bodyHtml:
Since its founding in 1785, the House of Piper-Heidsieck has proven its innovative prowess in selecting and blending wines of exception. A quest for excellence and open-mindedness are reflected in the entire range of champagnes created by Chief Winemaker Emilien Boutillat, serve as guarantor the Piper-Heidsieck style.

Essentiel Blanc de Blancs is sourced from the most magnificent Chardonnay vineyards in Champagne. A large proportion of reserve wines are harmoniously blended with wines of the year to ensure the purest expression of the varietal.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Chardonnay from the Côte des Blancs has produced this classic, mineral and tight-textured Champagne. With its low dosage and emphasis on white fruits and structure, the wine is still young and fresh. This bottling will be best from late 2022.

92 Points - James Suckling

Very nutty and buttery, this focuses more on spices than fruit, showing tarte tatin aromas, cotton candy, roasted nuts and candied lemons. Light-bodied with fine bubbles, it has a slightly phenolic yet fresh palate, if not zesty and balanced. Drink now

estate-cabernet.title: Morgenster Estate Cabernet Franc 2021
estate-cabernet.bodyHtml:
A refined Stellenbosch Cabernet Franc from Morgenster Estate, showcasing cassis, red cherry, blueberry, cranberry, lavender, roasted bell pepper and sweet tobacco. The palate is juicy and elegant, with savoury depth, chalky tannins and a lingering finish of red fruit and spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops, grilled duck breast, beef tenderloin, pork loin with herbs, wild mushroom risotto, and aged goat cheese.

 

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripe blackberries and mulberries with hints of walnut, licorice and cedar. Medium- to full-bodied with chalky tannins and impressive tension. Layered and textured, with vivid fruit character and spicy finish. Drink or hold.

estate-chardonnay.title: DuMOL Estate Chardonnay Sonoma Coast
estate-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
DuMOL Estate Chardonnay Sonoma Coast is a richly textured yet beautifully precise Chardonnay sourced from the winery's estate vineyards. Aromas of white peach, lemon curd, pear, citrus blossom, and flint lead into a layered palate of orchard fruit, mineral notes, and subtle oak complexity. Concentrated and elegant, it is balanced by vibrant acidity and finishes long with exceptional purity and finesse.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with Lobster, grilled scallops, roast chicken, halibut, creamy pasta dishes, and triple-cream cheeses.

chateau-la-mondotte.title: La Mondotte Premiere Grand Cru Classe 2016 750ml
chateau-la-mondotte.bodyHtml: La Mondotte 2016 is a Saint-Émilion Premier Grand Cru Classé from the Comtes von Neipperg. The 4.5-hectare vineyard sits on the eastern edge of the Saint-Émilion limestone plateau, beside Troplong Mondot, on clay-limestone soil with very silty clay over a rocky subsoil. Good natural water regulation pushes the vine roots deep, while the steep slope gives excellent sun exposure and drainage, making it a very early-ripening site. Merlot and Cabernet Franc make up the blend. La Mondotte is known for powerful tannins and vivid fruit that keep their elegance as the wine ages. 750ml, 14% ABV.

chateau-troplong-mondot-1.title: Chateau Troplong Mondot 2016 750ml
chateau-troplong-mondot-1.bodyHtml:
Critic tasting note: (2016 vintage) "The inky hue in the wine clearly matches up with the level of concentration in the ripe, dark berries. Add in liberal doses of black licorice, smoke, espresso, chocolate and boysenberry, and you have the core of the wine. Powerful, full, rich and with real depth of flavor, give this 10-12 years before popping a cork." - 97/100, Jeff Leve, The Wine Cellar Insider

Classification
Saint-Emilion Premier Grand Cru Classé B


Producer Notes
The power of the ‘terroir’ tempered by the glistening fruit. The aromatic richness enhanced with elegant precision. The perfect balance of elements that respond to one another. The revelation of a unique universe that opens itself up over time. A feeling of fullness.

Drinking Window 2021-2050

Blend

90% Merlot, 8% Cabernet Sauvignon, & 2% Cabernet Franc
Vineyard Notes
Troplong Mondot dominates the landscape. Located at the highest point of the appellation, its ‘terroir’ benefits from an exceptional 360° exposure and incomparable soil complexity. In this atypical panorama, the vineyard is part of a natural heritage whose biodiversity is a long-standing reality. As the outcome of this perfect balance, the wines reflect the estate’s riches and reveal an identity like no other.

chateau-margaux-1.title: Chateau Margaux Pavillon Rouge 2021
chateau-margaux-1.bodyHtml:
The renowned second wine of Château Margaux offers expressive aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, violet, cedar, graphite, and delicate spice. Elegant and beautifully structured, it delivers silky tannins, vibrant freshness, exceptional purity, and a refined, persistent finish that mirrors the grandeur of the Grand Vin.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, truffle potatoes, aged Comté, wild mushrooms, or braised short ribs.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

This wine has a tightness and linear energy, with red currants, herbs, plums and hints of dark chocolate. Medium-bodied with beautiful integration and length. Racy and focused. Just the right amount of wood and fruit with tannins. Second wine of Chateau Margaux.
95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The aromas of rich black-currant fruits dominate this second-label wine. With its blackberry fruits and rich, supple tannins, this shows strongly in its structure, complex black fruits and acidity.

93 Points - Decanter

Rich and intense on the nose, fragranced red and pink flowers with red cherries and plums. Really vibrant pink rim to the glass too. Touches of dark chocolate, cedar and green pepper, herbal, and eucalyptus. Round and vibrant, a playfulness - super high acidity, almost sharp and tart and tangy, with grippy tannins that give the texture and structure. Half crushed velvet and half lean and austere so you get both weight and direction. Feels quite youthful and buzzy right now but this has a nice juiciness, great fresh acidities, bite on the tongue, a clean - wet stone slate feeling and texture. A touch of green peppercorn and toast gives the spicy angles and the minerality on the finish. Well constructed, not the most easy to drink at the moment, this is more serious, but there's good potential and a lot of flavour. It has a certain intensity, a touch of green leeness sets it apart from being totally charming right now, but this certainly carries interest and nuance.
92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
Mostly likely the second wine of the vintage, the 2021 Château Margaux Pavillon Rouge boasts a deep ruby/purple hue as well as beautiful aromatics of red and blue fruits, smoke tobacco, violets, and graphite. It's medium-bodied, has remarkable purity, integrated acidity, and one heck of a beautiful finish. You can taste more than a little Grand Vin in this, yet it clearly has more up-front charm and appeal. A blend of 73% Cabernet Sauvignon, 18% Merlot, 5% Petit Verdot, and the rest Cabernet Franc, it benefits from air and should be at its best from 2029-2041.
91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2021 Pavillon Rouge offers up aromas of raspberries, sweet cherries and white flowers, followed by a medium to full-bodied, lively palate that's quite taut and youthfully structured out of the gates, with good depth at the core and powdery tannins. It will reward a bit of bottle age.

chateau-fleur-cardinale.title: Chateau Fleur Cardinale 2021 750ml
chateau-fleur-cardinale.bodyHtml: Château Fleur Cardinale 2021 is a Saint-Émilion Grand Cru Classé from Saint-Étienne-de-Lisse, on the eastern side of the appellation. After thirty years in the porcelain business in Limoges, Dominique and Florence Decoster bought the estate in 2001 and moved onto the property; with the existing team they saw it promoted to Grand Cru Classé de Saint-Émilion in 2006. The family's stated aim is to produce, ethically and sustainably, a wine of very high quality that respects its clay-limestone terroir. The 27.6-hectare vineyard is planted with about 74% Merlot, 18% Cabernet Franc and 8% Cabernet Sauvignon, with vines averaging 30 years; grapes are hand-picked and fermented in stainless-steel vats, and average production is around 110,000 bottles. 14.5% ABV, 750 ml.

merlot-di-santa-maria-vignamaggio.title: Santa Maria Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2018
merlot-di-santa-maria-vignamaggio.bodyHtml:
Deep and complex, this Brunello di Montalcino Riserva reveals aromas of black cherry, dried plum, violet, tobacco, cedar, leather, and baking spice. The full-bodied palate is rich and concentrated with layered dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, vibrant acidity, and remarkable depth leading to a long, elegant finish marked by savoury and earthy complexity.

Food Pairing: Braised lamb shanks, dry-aged steak, wild boar, truffle risotto, and aged Pecorino Toscano.

chateau-dissan-1.title: Chateau d'Issan Blason d'Issan 2014
chateau-dissan-1.bodyHtml:
Blason D'Issan is the second wine of Chateau d'Issan, crafted from estate vineyards in the Margaux appellation of Bordeaux. Produced with the same attention to detail as the Grand Vin, it offers expressive dark berry fruit, refined structure, and elegant tannins that reflect the character of its prestigious terroir.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled lamb, roast beef, duck breast, mushroom dishes, aged hard cheeses, and herb-roasted poultry.

 

92 Points - James Suckling

Very aromatic and bright with currants and orange peel on the nose. Full body, velvety tannins and a delicious finish. Love the texture to this. Fantastic second wine of Issan. Majority is merlot. Beautiful now but better in two or three years.

domaine-de-chevalier-gcc.title: Domaine de Chevalier Rouge 2016
domaine-de-chevalier-gcc.bodyHtml:
Domaine de Chevalier Rouge 2016 is a profoundly elegant, sophisticated, and deeply structured Grand Cru Classé red wine from the Pessac-Léognan appellation. Crafted from a classic Graves blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot, and Cabernet Franc, it presents an intense dark ruby color in the glass. The complex nose bursts with expressive aromas of blackcurrants, dark plums, blueberry compote, tobacco, wood smoke, cedar, and crushed gravel minerality. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and incredibly racy, delivering concentrated layers of sappy dark berry fruit framed by fine, velvety tannins, vibrant acidity, and an extraordinarily long, earthy, saline finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, pan-seared duck breast, prime ribeye steak, venison, wild mushroom risotto, and aged hard cheeses.

98 Points - James Suckling

Tobacco, dark fruit and earth on the nose. The palate shows exceptional balance, with incisive acidity and precise dark fruit that are deeply appealing for their harmony. A blend of 55% cabernet sauvignon, 35% merlot, 5% cabernet franc and 5% petit verdot. This is appealing now, but it will evolve wonderfully. Drink now or hold. 10 Years On retrospective.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

The core of fruit flavor here is sappy and dense, with lots of kirsch, raspberry pâte de fruit and plum reduction notes, yet this stays fresh and racy overall, with a bright iron spine, flashes of tea and tobacco and a long finish that shows a wonderful infusion of alder and tobacco flavors. Offers a lovely combination of prodigious fruit details, with a tug of earth. Best from 2024 through 2038.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This elegant wine wears its firm tannic structure lightly. It is densely textured, just starting on its road to maturity. Black-plum and berry fruits give the wine its weight as much as the tannins. It will age well over many years. Drink from 2026.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Domaine de Chevalier is a blend of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 35% Merlot, 5% Petit Verdot and 5% Cabernet Franc. Deep garnet-purple colored, it rocks up with expressive warm plums, blueberry compote and cassis scents with suggestions of sandalwood, baking spices and potpourri. Medium-bodied and delicately styled yet with a rock-solid frame of grainy tannins, it sports restrained earth-laced fruit and a long finish.

chateau-pape-clement-pessac-leognan.title: Chateau Carbonnieux Pessac-Leognan 2018 750ml
chateau-pape-clement-pessac-leognan.bodyHtml:
Pessac-Leognan Wine
Bordeaux, France
Recognized for its superior reds as well as whites, Pessac-Léognan on the Left Bank claims classified growths for both—making it quite unique in comparison to its neighboring Médoc properties.

Pessac’s Chateau Haut-Brion, the only first growth located outside of the Médoc, is said to have been the first to conceptualize fine red wine in Bordeaux back in the late 1600s. The estate, along with its high-esteemed neighbors, La Mission Haut-Brion, Les Carmes Haut-Brion, Pique-Caillou and Chateau Pape-Clément are today all but enveloped by the city of Bordeaux. The rest of the vineyards of Pessac-Léognan are in clearings of heavily forested area or abutting dense suburbs.

Arid sand and gravel on top of clay and limestone make the area unique and conducive to growing Sémillon and Sauvignon blanc as well as the grapes in the usual Left Bank red recipe: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and miniscule percentages of Petit Verdot and Malbec.

The best reds will show great force and finesse with inky blue and black fruit, mushroom, forest, tobacco, iodine and a smooth and intriguing texture.

Its best whites show complexity, longevity and no lack of exotic twists on citrus, tropical and stone fruit with pronounced floral and spice characteristics.
Bordeaux Blends
One of the world’s most classic and popular styles of red wine, Bordeaux-inspired blends have spread from their homeland in France to nearly every corner of the New World. Typically based on either Cabernet Sauvignon or Merlot and supported by Cabernet Franc, Malbec and Petit Verdot, the best of these are densely hued, fragrant, full of fruit and boast a structure that begs for cellar time. Somm Secret—Blends from Bordeaux are generally earthier compared to those from the New World, which tend to be fruit-dominant.

pievalta-verdicchio-riserva.title: Pievalta San Paolo Verdicchio Dei Castelli Di Jesi Riserva Classico 2021 750ml
pievalta-verdicchio-riserva.bodyHtml:
Pievalta San Paolo Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Riserva 2022 is an elegant and sophisticated Italian white wine from the renowned Marche region of Italy. Produced from 100% Verdicchio grapes grown in organically and biodynamically farmed vineyards, this premium Riserva showcases the exceptional character of the San Paolo vineyard. Rich, expressive, and beautifully structured, it combines vibrant citrus flavours, ripe orchard fruits, delicate floral aromas, and distinctive mineral notes. Its refreshing acidity, refined texture, and impressive depth make it an excellent choice for fine dining and special occasions.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled seafood, lobster, oysters, roasted fish, creamy risotto, seafood pasta, roasted chicken, grilled vegetables, and aged cheeses.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

An elegant and complex wine with aromas of minerals, gunpowder, candied citrus. Vibrant, with buttery depth. Medium-bodied, it shows substance, a silky texture, sharp acidity and a long, savory finish with an almost briny aftertaste. Focused and fine. Drink or hold.

brut-prestige.title: Jean Vesselle Prestige Millesime Brut Champagne Grand Cru 'Bouzy' 2011 750ml
brut-prestige.bodyHtml: Jean Vesselle Brut Prestige Millésime 2011 is a vintage Champagne from a grower-producer (récoltant-manipulant) in Bouzy, one of the Montagne de Reims villages classified Grand Cru and best known for its Pinot Noir. The label carries the Bouzy Grand Cru designation, and the wine is finished as a Brut. 750ml, 12% ABV.

merf-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Don Melchor Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
merf-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Don Melchor Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is an iconic, exceptionally structured, and refined Chilean red wine crafted predominantly from old-vine Cabernet Sauvignon grown in the acclaimed Puente Alto vineyard in the Maipo Valley. Displaying a deep garnet core with a purplish rim, it opens with a fragrant, complex bouquet of cassis, dark plum, and wild blackberry, beautifully interwoven with graphite, cedar, graphite earth, mint, and sweet spices. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied, dense, and energetic profile balanced by vibrant acidity and polished, fine-grained tannins, delivering a long and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted leg of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison, and aged hard cheeses.

99 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrants, cassis and graphite on the nose. Pure and fragrant. Full-bodied with superb density and tannins that are so polished. The texture is like touching a silk ball. Its finish is very long and compact with slightly chewy tannins, but it will come together beautifully with time in the bottle. Try after 2028.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Elegant, nuanced and concentrated, with a loamy-clay cast to the fresh thyme and subtle tuberose aromas, which give way to a rich yet balanced core of blackberry and cassis notes lifted by saline-edged acidity. Wonderfully fresh while moving toward the finish, where the flavors come together and linger harmoniously around well-formed tannins. Drink now through 2040.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Puente Alto, located in the highest part of the Maipo Valley, is a renowned appellation for producing some of Chile's finest wines. This elegant Cabernet opens with sweet blackberry aromas and subtle hints of licorice. Sip it slowly allowing its flavorful profile to fully unfold, offering ripe red berries intertwined with delicate oak spices. Energized acidity enhances the wine's structure, carrying through to a finish highlighted by a touch of peppercorn.

collemassari-poggio-lombrone-montecucco.title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020
collemassari-poggio-lombrone-montecucco.bodyHtml:
Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020 is an exceptional, classic expression of Sangiovese produced from hand-picked grapes grown on the oldest vines at Tenuta Il Poggione in southern Montalcino. Aged for three years in traditional large Slavonian oak casks (botti) followed by extended bottle maturation, it exhibits an alluring, complex bouquet of dark cherry, tart blackberry, and wild plum, seamlessly interwoven with nuances of licorice root, cloves, coffee, fresh mint, and fragrant dried rose petals. On the palate, the wine delivers a harmonious balance of power and grace, combining dense, velvety red and black fruit flavors with polished, grippy tannins, a refreshing vein of acidity, and savory hints of iron-rich earth, tobacco, and subtle mocha that carry through to a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted red meats, grilled bistecca, wild game, braised beef short ribs, ossobuco, rich mushroom dishes, and mature hard cheeses.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is both perfumed and spicy, with aromas of cloves, coffee, vanilla bean and black cherry. Flavors of tart blackberry, bergamot and flaky salt define the palate, before a touch of mocha creeps onto the finish. Tannins are polished, but grippy.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained mix of licorice and graphite, bright red cherries and toasted notes. Firm tannins on the medium- to full-bodied palate with refreshing acidity. Chewy style overall. Try in 2025, but best after 2026.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Showing very nice results, with greater accessibility in this vintage, the Il Poggione 2020 Brunello di Montalcino has dark fruit aromas with blackcurrant followed by something spicy or herbal. I am reminded of licorice root, exotic spice, pressed rose and fragrant tea leaf. It finishes smoothly with silky tannins and an open-knit approach. This vintage is almost ready to drink, and you get elegant complexity at the same time. It sees three years in oak botti. Fruit is sourced across vineyards with 25-year-old-plus vines. This is an ample production of 200,000 bottles.

94 Points - Wine Spectator 

This red is rich and dense, woven with flavors of cherry, blackberry, plum, black pepper, earth, iron and tobacco. Combines power and grace, with fine balance. The finish echoes the fruit and spice notes. Best from 2028 through 2045.

1000-stories-cabernet-sauvignon.title: La Storia Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
1000-stories-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The La Storia Cabernet Sauvignon is a premium, fruit-forward red wine from the historic Trentadue Winery, a family estate in the Alexander Valley since 1959. This wine is known for its deep red colour and an expressive aromatic profile of blueberries, blackberries, and dark plums. Aging in French oak barrels adds sophisticated layers of cocoa, maple, and toasted vanilla, resulting in a medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel with ripe, velvety tannins. It is a highly consistent wine that frequently earns 90+ point ratings for its approachable yet structured "California sunny" personality.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of black currants, dark cherries and plums with notes of cedar, dried herbs, sweet spices and earth. The full-bodied palate has firmly framed tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a generous, fruit-driven finish with a savory edge. Drink or hold.

boschkloof-syrah.title: Boschkloof Syrah 2021
boschkloof-syrah.bodyHtml:
Crafted in a beautifully classic Rhône style, this Syrah boasts a complex and attractive bouquet of oriental spices, pronounced violet, and distinct white pepper. The nose is highly perfumed, brimming with pure red fruit aromatics. On the palate, it is exceptionally well-balanced and elegant, offering savory, spicy overtones that carry through to a long, lingering finish. While it is highly approachable and enjoyable now, it has the structure to develop and mature gracefully over the next decade.

It pairs beautifully with roasted or grilled red meats, making it the perfect match for a classic roast leg of lamb with rosemary, grilled ribeye steak, or a hearty venison stew. For vegetarian options, it shines alongside earthy flavors like wild mushroom risotto, roasted eggplant, or a platter of mature, hard cheeses and artisanal charcuterie.

boschkloof-conclusion.title: Boschkloof Conclusion 2018/2020 750ml
boschkloof-conclusion.bodyHtml: Boschkloof Conclusion is a true expression of good grape quality and terroir. The wine was made as natural as possible. On the nose the aromas are mixed herbs, bruised plum and some lovely cigar box flavours. The wine is highly concentrated with a big, but elegant mid-palate and a long finish.

elvio-cogno-barbera-pre-phylloxera.title: Elvio Cogno Barbera D'Alba Pre-Phylloxera 2021 750ml
elvio-cogno-barbera-pre-phylloxera.bodyHtml: Elvio Cogno Barbera d'Alba Pre-Phylloxera 2021 comes from a 0.25-hectare plot at Berri, near La Morra, one of the last archaic vineyards of the Langhe. Its Barbera vines are more than a hundred years old, grow on their own Vitis vinifera roots and are propagated by layering; the sandy-chalky soil has kept phylloxera away. The site lies at 520 metres and yields only about 2,000 bottles. Picked at the start of October, the grapes are fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel, and the wine is aged 12 months in large Slavonian oak casks and six months in bottle. The estate describes a bright ruby colour with purple highlights, spice, raspberry, strawberry and ripe cherry on the nose, and a fresh, structured palate of sour cherry, blackberry and prune. Serve at 16–18°C with meaty sauces, red meat, game or strong cheeses. 14% ABV, 750 ml.

elvio-cogno-barolo-ravera.title: Elvio Cogno Barolo Ravera 2019 750ml
elvio-cogno-barolo-ravera.bodyHtml: Elvio Cogno Barolo Ravera 2019 is a single-vineyard Barolo from Ravera, one of the celebrated crus of Novello, one of the eleven communes where Barolo may be made. The Cogno family has made wine in Piedmont for four generations; the estate is now run by Elvio's daughter Nadia and her husband Valter Fissore, who is the winemaker. Ravera is a powerful Nebbiolo, and the estate is regarded among the vineyard's top growers. This 2019 is a 750ml bottle at 14.5% ABV.

elvio-cogno-barolo-ravera-bricco-pernice.title: Elvio Cogno Bricco Pernice Barolo 2018 750ml
elvio-cogno-barolo-ravera-bricco-pernice.bodyHtml: Elvio Cogno Barolo Ravera Bricco Pernice 2018 comes from a one-hectare plot in the most historic part of the Ravera cru at Novello, named after the small hill where partridges nest. It is made only from Lampia, a sub-variety of Nebbiolo, planted at 5,000 vines per hectare at 320 metres and picked in October. Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel, followed by a 30-day submerged-cap maceration; the wine then ages 36 months in large Slavonian oak barrels and six months in bottle. Only 5,000 to 6,000 bottles are made. The winery describes violet, damp earth, ripe red fruit and gentle spice, with a harmonious palate and fine, soft tannins. Serve at 16–18°C with game, braises or hard aged cheese. 750ml, 14.5% alcohol.

francis-coppola-archimedes-cab-sauv.title: Francis Coppola Archimedes 2019
francis-coppola-archimedes-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
Francis Coppola Archimedes 2019 is an exceptionally structured, opulent, and refined flagship Napa/Sonoma Cabernet Sauvignon crafted by Francis Ford Coppola Winery. Sourced primarily from the warm, gravelly benchlands of Alexander Valley, it exhibits a deep ruby-purple core with vibrant clarity. The nose opens with intense, inviting aromas of cassis, black raspberries, dark plums, and black cherries, seamlessly layered with notes of clove, gingerbread, star anise, cedar wood, and toasted oak. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, mouth-filling entrance supported by a firm, suede-textured tannic backbone and bright natural acidity. Generous layers of ripe dark fruits, cocoa, espresso, and subtle graphite lead into a remarkably long, polished, and fruit-stained finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, roasted leg of lamb, grilled venison chops, wild mushroom ragù, and aged sharp cheddar cheese.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Striking aromas of menthol and clove leads to black cherries, mint and blueberries on the palate of this full-bodied but supple-textured wine. Moderate tannins are well integrated for drinking the wine now through 2027.

tenuta-di-trinoro.title: Vini Franchetti Tenuta Di Trinoro Toscana Rosso 2021 750ml
tenuta-di-trinoro.bodyHtml:
Vini Franchetti Tenuta di Trinoro Toscana Rosso 2021 is an exceptional Super Tuscan red wine from the Val d'Orcia in southern Tuscany. Crafted from 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Franc, this limited-production Bordeaux-style blend delivers concentrated blackberry, ripe plum, violet, and savoury herbs. Eight months in French oak followed by twelve months in concrete creates remarkable depth, silky tannins, and vibrant freshness. Powerful yet elegant, it offers a long, mineral-driven finish and outstanding ageing potential.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye, braised short ribs, roasted lamb, venison, truffle risotto, wild mushrooms, and aged Pecorino.

 

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Made with Cabernet Franc and a smaller part Merlot, the 2021 Tenuta di Trinoro has a very generous and open-knit character with thick layers of dark fruit, blackberry confit, rhubarb, sweet earth and toasted spice. The wine's appearance is inky dark, and like the other wines in this portfolio of new releases, the alcohol is recorded at a high 15.5%. I have adored recent vintages of this wine, especially the 2019, and this 2021 feels a little more open and accessible in comparison.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Juicy and packed with black currant and blackberry fruit, this red is bright and balanced, with graphite, tobacco and black pepper elements adding complexity. Refined tannins are well-integrated with the graceful profile, while the lingering finish adds graphite, olive and oak spice details. Cabernet Franc and Merlot. Drink now through 2032.

95 Points - James Suckling

Super clean and rich with ripe currants on the nose, together with floral notes of violets and bright spices, such as nigella seeds and cardamom. Medium- to full-bodied with a very focused drive through the palate. The bright spices latch onto the firm tannins and combine with the fruit to give a long, vibrant finish. This is very tight and brimming with life. Needs a year or two to soften the tannins, but already showing class. Best from 2027.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The sweet richness of vanilla bean, toasted coconut, blackberry tart and milk chocolate on the nose then evolves to reveal the savory flintiness of soil, graphite, spices and pepper. Tart and sweet blackberries and cherry syrup on the palate top an indulgent slice of flourless chocolate cake, with a sprig of fresh mint for garnish. A long, dynamic finish is guaranteed with the support of athletic tannins.

emeritus-estate-pinot-noir.title: Domaine Carneros Estate Pinot Noir 2022
emeritus-estate-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Domaine Carneros Estate Pinot Noir 2022 is a sophisticated and highly expressive red wine that captures the cool-climate elegance of the Carneros region. Sourced exclusively from the estate's six sustainably farmed vineyards, this wine benefits from the maritime influence of the San Pablo Bay, which provides the fog and cool breezes essential for developing complex aromatics while maintaining fresh acidity. The 2022 vintage was aged for approximately 10 months in small French oak barrels to enhance its structure and mouthfeel.
On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of black cherry, pomegranate, and wild strawberry, accented by delicate floral notes of violet and a hint of sandalwood. The palate is medium-bodied and silky, showcasing layers of juicy red fruit, plum, and savory earthy notes. It features fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that carries the flavours through to a long, graceful finish with a touch of baking spice and toasted oak.

94 Points - James Suckling

Vibrant aromas of strawberries, blueberry bush, citrus peel and cassia bark. The palate is medium-bodied with finely integrated tannins and bright acidity, showing a plush and generous mouthfeel with underlying tension. Very refined and pure, with a soft touch. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ripe, dark red fruits swirled through with baking spices and freshly cracked pine, reveal a mouthwatering, flavorful, and juicy still, Pinot Noir. Silken tannins and an ultra long finish.

morgenster-nabucco-nebbiolo.title: Morgenster Estate Giulio Nabucco Nebbiolo 2018
morgenster-nabucco-nebbiolo.bodyHtml:
Morgenster Estate Giulio Nabucco Nebbiolo 2018 is an artisanal, Italian-inspired South African red wine crafted as part of The Giulio Range to celebrate estate founder Giulio Bertrand. Sourced from estate vineyards in Somerset West, Stellenbosch, it showcases a pale garnet color with evolving aromas of dried red cherry, wild strawberry, rose petal, leather, and earthy spice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and finely structured, offering savory cranberry and sour cherry flavors underpinned by Nebbiolo's signature firm, chalky tannins and vibrant natural acidity.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast, truffle pasta, osso buco, wild mushroom risotto, braised beef, and aged Parmesan cheese.

morgenster-tosca-blend.title: Morgenster Estate Giulio Tosca Sangiovese Blend
morgenster-tosca-blend.bodyHtml:
Morgenster Giulio Tosca Sangiovese Blend is an elegant, Tuscan-inspired South African red blend crafted as part of The Giulio Range to honor estate founder Giulio Bertrand. Combining Italian Sangiovese with classic Bordeaux varieties Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon, it is aged in French oak barrels. In the glass, it opens with rich aromas of dried cherries, plums, tomato leaf, and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full-bodied structure with silky tannins, balanced acidity, and lingering notes of spice and dark berry fruit.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spaghetti al pomodoro, rich beef bolognese, roasted lamb chops, wood-fired pizza, and aged hard cheeses.

tightrope-rose.title: Clos Cibonne Cuvee Tradition Rose 2023
tightrope-rose.bodyHtml:
Clos Cibonne Cuvée Tradition Rosé is the estate's iconic Provençal rosé, crafted primarily from the rare Tibouren grape. Aromas of wild strawberry, blood orange, rose petals, herbs, and sea breeze lead to a textured palate with bright acidity, savory minerality, and a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled seafood, bouillabaisse, Niçoise salad, sushi, roast chicken, Mediterranean vegetables, or fresh goat cheese.

 

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Not your typical Côtes de Provence rosé. Weighty and phenolic, with real structure behind its notes of creamed melon and blood orange. A bitter mineral spine brings form. Substantial in weight and complexity, with warm spices and sun tea on the smoky finish alongside a tug of earthiness. Tibouren and Grenache. Drink now through 2027.

jamet-cotes-du-rhone.title: Domaine Jamet Cotes du Rhone Rouge 2023
jamet-cotes-du-rhone.bodyHtml:
Domaine Jamet Côtes du Rhône Rouge 2023 is a remarkably expressive, savory, and pure red wine crafted by the legendary Jean-Paul, Corinne, and Loïc Jamet. Sourced from estate vineyard plots located on the granite and schist plateau above Ampuis in the Northern Rhône, this 100% Syrah is vinified with partial whole-cluster fermentation using native yeasts and aged for 12 months in neutral oak casks. In the glass, it reveals a bright ruby-purple hue accompanied by vibrant aromas of dark cherries, wild raspberries, crushed black pepper, tapenade, and delicate violet florality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and energetic, balancing a juicy core of crunchy dark fruits with fine-grained tannins, fresh acidity, and a long, peppery finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with herb-crusted rack of lamb, grilled pork chops, duck breast, wild mushroom ragù, roasted chicken, and aged goat cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

A serious, driven and lively 100% syrah Cotes-du-Rhone from northern sites. Aromas of dark cherries, dark berries, mocha and some baking spices. It's medium-bodied with fine tannins and fresh acidity. Plenty of verve, with a lift of peppercorns on the mid-palate, adding energy. Succulent finish. 

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A savory, slightly chewy red, with a fresh profile of red berries woven with earthy, meaty tones of bacon lard, coffee grounds, bay leaf and warm earth, plus a subtle tug of tar. Stays peppery and fresh, with beautiful range and complexity emerging with time in glass. Long and salty. Drink now through 2030.

jamet-fructus-voluptas.title: Domaine Jamet Cote-Rotie 'Fructus Voluptas' 2021
jamet-fructus-voluptas.bodyHtml:
Domaine Jamet Côte-Rôtie 'Fructus Voluptas' 2021 is a youthful, highly expressive, and refined red wine crafted by Jean-Paul and Corinne Jamet in the Northern Rhône Valley. Produced from younger Syrah vines planted across various terraced granite slopes, it is designed to showcase the fresh, fruit-forward side of Côte-Rôtie while maintaining the estate’s signature whole-cluster structure and complexity. Aged in old oak barrels to preserve vibrant primary aromas, the wine offers an inviting bouquet of wild raspberries, red currants, violet flowers, black pepper, and subtle granite minerals. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, bright, and silky, delivering juicy red fruit flavors, supple tannins, and a fresh, mouthwatering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast, pan-seared pork chops, grilled rack of lamb, wild mushroom tart, and mild charcuterie.

domaine-santa-duc-les-saintes-vierges.title: Domaine Santa Duc Cotes Du Rhone Les Quatre Terres 2020 750ml
domaine-santa-duc-les-saintes-vierges.bodyHtml: Domaine Santa Duc C™tes Du Rh™ne Les Quatre Terres 2021 750ml

le-potazzine-rosso-di-montalcino.title: Le Potazzine Rosso Di Montalcino (Gorelli) 2021/2023 750ml
le-potazzine-rosso-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Le Potazzine Rosso di Montalcino (Gorelli) 2023 is a full-bodied, red wine from Montalcino, Tuscany, made entirely from Sangiovese grapes. It's known for its aromas of black cherry and wild-berry fruit, and a hint of spice and vanilla from its oak aging. The wine is unfiltered and aged in Slavonian oak barrels. 

Region: Montalcino, Tuscany, Italy.
Grape Variety: 100% Sangiovese.
Aging: Aged in 30/50 hl barrels in Slavonian oak for 12 months.
Taste Profile: Black cherry, wild-berry fruit, and hints of spice and vanilla.
Other Notes: The wine is not filtered.
Food Pairing: Ideal with cold cuts and meat sauce pasta, as well as grilled meats and red meat.

93 Points - James Suckling
A brilliant and expressive Rosso di Montalcino that far exceeds the expectations of its appellation. It offers a stunningly pure nose of red cherries, violets, and earthy undertones. The palate is silky and vibrant, with refined tannins and bright acidity carrying the wine to a long, mineral-driven finish. A gorgeous wine from a stellar producer.
92 Points - Wine Advocate
The 2021/2023 Rosso from Le Potazzine is wonderfully precise and elegant, showcasing crisp red fruit, floral notes, and a distinct saline character. It is beautifully balanced and approachable now, yet possesses the structure to improve in the bottle for several years. A top-tier example of Rosso.

le-potazzine-brunello-di-montalcino-rsva.title: Le Potazzine Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2015 750ml
le-potazzine-brunello-di-montalcino-rsva.bodyHtml: The 2015 Le Potazzine Brunello di Montalcino Riserva is a highly-regarded Brunello, known for its elegant, full-bodied profile with notes of cherry, spice, and cedar. It's a wine that benefits from aging, with critics recommending drinking it after 2023.

fontanavecchia-aglianico-riserva.title: Fontanavecchia Aglianico del Taburno Riserva 2010
fontanavecchia-aglianico-riserva.bodyHtml:
A structured Aglianico with ripe dark fruit, dried cherry, spice, tobacco and earthy notes. The palate is full-bodied and concentrated, supported by firm tannins and balanced acidity, with savory complexity and a persistent finish that reflects the character of this Campania red.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with braised beef short ribs, roasted lamb, aged cheeses, or wild mushroom ragu.

silenus-tyros-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Silenus Tyros Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
silenus-tyros-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: The 2019 Silenus Tyros Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic and inviting expression of Napa Valley, crafted for balance and immediate approachability. This vintage showcases the concentration of a high-quality growing season, offering an aromatic profile of black cherry, plum, and pomegranate, layered with hints of mocha, dried herbs, and sweet oak. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and fruit-forward, featuring smooth layers of dark berries and cassis supported by soft, well-integrated tannins. The finish is long and dry, with subtle notes of toasty vanilla and oregano.

silenus-oak-knoll-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Silenus Tyros Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
silenus-oak-knoll-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: The 2019 Silenus Tyros Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic and inviting expression of Napa Valley, crafted for balance and immediate approachability. This vintage showcases the concentration of a high-quality growing season, offering an aromatic profile of black cherry, plum, and pomegranate, layered with hints of mocha, dried herbs, and sweet oak. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and fruit-forward, featuring smooth layers of dark berries and cassis supported by soft, well-integrated tannins. The finish is long and dry, with subtle notes of toasty vanilla and oregano.

prieler-blaufrankish-leithaberg.title: Prieler Leithaberg Blaufrankisch 2015 750ml
prieler-blaufrankish-leithaberg.bodyHtml:
The source of Austria’s finest botrytized sweet wines, Burgenland covers a lofty portion of Austria's wine producing real estate. It encompasses the smaller regions of Neusiedlersee, Neusiedlersee-Hügelland, Mittelburgenland and Südburgenland. The latter two are most associated with their exceptional red wines. The region as a whole produces no shortage of important whites.

Neusiedlersee, named for the lake that it surrounds to the east, is home to a great diversity of grape varieties. The region’s most notable wines, however, are the botrytis-infected, sweet versions.

Neusiedlersee-Hügelland, which wraps the lake on its western side, includes the town of Rust, a historically esteemed wine community. Its close proximity to the lake’s fog and mist make it another source of some of the more prestigious botrytized wines. Neusiedlersee-Hügelland also produces fine Blaufränkisch, Pinot Blanc, Neuburger and Grüner Veltliner, though a label will usually name the more general, Burgenland, so as not to confuse it with its eastern cousin, Neusiedlersee, across the lake.

Blaufränkisch is well suited to and makes up over half of the vineyard area in Mittelburgenland. The region’s hills and plateaus, which are composed of variations in schist, loess and clay-limestone, produce high quality reds with interesting diversity.

Südburgenland, also known for its deep, complex and age-worthy Blaufränkisch, is beginning to turn out some alluring whites from Grüner Veltliner, Welschriesling and Weissburgunder (Pinot Blanc).

corton-marechaudes-grand-cru.title: Domaine Michel Mallard et Fils Corton Les Marechaudes 2019
corton-marechaudes-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Domaine Michel Mallard et Fils Corton Grand Cru Les Maréchaudes is a structured Pinot Noir from an old-vine parcel near the base of the Corton slope. Aromas of blackberry, black cherry, cassis, smoke, spice, leather, and crushed stone lead to concentrated fruit, muscular tannins, vibrant acidity, and an exceptionally long finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, duck breast, venison, mushroom risotto, game birds, aged Gruyère, or truffle-infused dishes.

pinot-gris-rangen-de-thann-clos-st-urba.title: Zind-Humbrecht Pinot Gris Clos Windsbuhl
pinot-gris-rangen-de-thann-clos-st-urba.bodyHtml:
Zind-Humbrecht Pinot Gris Clos Windsbuhl is an exceptional Alsace white wine crafted from 100% Pinot Gris grown in the renowned Clos Windsbuhl monopole vineyard. This elegant cuvée reveals aromas of pear, quince, citrus, wet stone, and iodine, with a rich palate featuring silky texture, vibrant acidity, chalky minerality, refined structure, and a remarkably long finish.

Food Pairing: Pâté, roasted poultry, pork, mushroom dishes, creamy pasta, aged cheeses, and refined Alsatian cuisine.

 

97 Points - James Suckling

Pinot gris has the reputation of being easygoing, but this dry pinot gris from Alsace has enormous energy and vitality. The staggering citrusy juiciness electrifies the super-concentrated, medium-bodied palate. At this stage in the wine’s very long life, the finish is a wild ride thanks to the chalky intensity. From biodynamically grown grapes. Drinkable now, but best from 2026.
94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Clos Windsbuhl Hunawihr Pinot Gris fermented slowly until July and opens with a pure, rich, saline, lemony and slightly flinty bouquet of ripe white fruits and sur lie aromas. Full-bodied, intense and elegant on the palate, this is a rich and powerful Windsbuhl with a saline texture and a long, finely bitter finish. The cru yielded 31 hectoliters per hectare in 2022 from 50-year-old vines. 12.9% alcohol with 5.7 grams per liter of residual sugar.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Long and drawn out, with a harmonious stream of heather, anise, dried apricot and mandarin. Creamy and briny, with salty mineral accents soaring through. Fluid, with spicy ginger notes enlivening the racy finish, marked by bitter bergamot and lime peel. Excellent, with a perfect mix of richness and energy. Drink now through 2032. 100 cases imported.

casa-de-santar-reserva-red.title: Casa De Santar Dao Reserva 2020 750ml
casa-de-santar-reserva-red.bodyHtml:
91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A jammy, full-bodied wine, this is now mature. With its wood aging and opulent black fruits, it is spicy, perfumed with a core of dark tannins. Drink this powerful wine now. Roger Voss

chiara-condello-le-lucciole-riserva.title: Chiara Condello Le Lucciole 2018
chiara-condello-le-lucciole-riserva.bodyHtml:
Chiara Condello Le Lucciole 2018 is an elegant Sangiovese Riserva from Predappio in Italy's Emilia-Romagna region. Produced from a small, organically farmed vineyard parcel, it undergoes native yeast fermentation and extended maturation in Slavonian oak. The wine offers expressive dark fruit, floral complexity, vibrant acidity and refined tannins.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with slow-braised beef, roasted lamb, wild mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, grilled pork and aged Pecorino cheese.

 

94 Points - Vinous

The 2018 Sangiovese Riserva Le Lucciole is spellbinding, as it keeps you coming back to the glass

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Fresh acidity keeps it balanced. Though it's already enjoyable, it will offer several more years of pleasure.

rizzi-barbaresco-pajore.title: Rizzi Barbaresco Pajore 2017 750ml
rizzi-barbaresco-pajore.bodyHtml:
A wine that most perfectly conveys the spirit and essence of its place, Barbaresco is true reflection of terroir. Its star grape, like that in the neighboring Barolo region, is Nebbiolo. Four townships within the Barbaresco zone can produce Barbaresco: the actual village of Barbaresco, as well as Neive, Treiso and San Rocco Seno d'Elvio.

Broadly speaking there are more similarities in the soils of Barbaresco and Barolo than there are differences. Barbaresco’s soils are approximately of the same two major soil types as Barolo: blue-grey marl of the Tortonion epoch, producing more fragile and aromatic characteristics, and Helvetian white yellow marl, which produces wines with more structure and tannins.

Nebbiolo ripens earlier in Barbaresco than in Barolo, primarily due to the vineyards’ proximity to the Tanaro River and lower elevations. While the wines here are still powerful, Barbaresco expresses a more feminine side of Nebbiolo, often with softer tannins, delicate fruit and an elegant perfume. Typical in a well-made Barbaresco are expressions of rose petal, cherry, strawberry, violets, smoke and spice. These wines need a few years before they reach their peak, the best of which need over a decade or longer. Bottle aging adds more savory characteristics, such as earth, iron and dried fruit.

saintsbury-carneros-pinot-noir.title: Aquinas Pinot Noir 2018 750ml
saintsbury-carneros-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Earthy tones are dominant with notes of black currant and toasted clove. A remarkably round wine with bright raspberry, blueberry and blackberry flavors reminiscent of a berry mélange. Napa Carneros fruit shines through with smoky flavors and a lingering, beautiful finish.
