Sourced from one of the highest and steepest cru sites on Mount Etna at an altitude of up to 1,000 meters, this limited-edition wine comes from ancient vines up to 150 years old that are deeply rooted in mineral-rich lava rock. It displays a transparent ruby color with a brick-red rim, offering a complex, restrained bouquet of sour cherry, dried flowers, orange zest, and thyme, underlined by smoky, wet-stone minerality. On the palate, it is slender and vertically structured, balancing nervy acidity and silky, fine-grained tannins with cool, precise flavors, culminating in a long, salty, and crystal-clear finish that beautifully expresses its pure, uncompromising terroir.

Food Pairing:

Matches beautifully with grilled lamb chops with rosemary, roasted pork tenderloin, dark poultry dishes, rich white meat ragù, or mildly matured pecorino cheese.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Alta Mora's top-shelf red is the 2020 Etna Rosso Guardiola. This limited release of 3,000 bottles is made with fruit from exceptionally old vines (up to 160 years old) on their own roots in bush-trained vines placed on steep stone terraces at 900 meters in elevation. Guardiola is one of the best-performing growing sites on the volcano, and it always shows an especially polished mineral character. The wine sees 20 days of skin contact during fermentation and ages in large oak casks. This wine has complexity and depth, but ultimately it adheres to the accessible and mid-weight identity of the vintage.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Enticing aromas of anise, cinnamon, graphite and leather lace flavors of fig cake, baked cherry and Earl Grey in this supple red, with fine-grained tannins. Shows lovely integration and overall balance, with its ripe fruit juiciness carrying the flavor profile through the lasting finish. Drink now through 2040.
92 Points - James Suckling
Showing plums and cherries with tobacco and smoke undertones throughout, this is medium-bodied, round and fruity. Hints of wood at the end. Needs two or three years to come together. Drink or hold.

amarone-valpolicella-colle-cristi-docg.title: Coali Docg Amarone Valpolicella Classico
amarone-valpolicella-colle-cristi-docg.bodyHtml: I Coali is the Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOCG of Coali – Tenuta Savoia, a family winery at Sant'Ambrogio di Valpolicella in the heart of Valpolicella Classica, making wine since 1997. It is made only from the estate's own grapes, carefully selected and dried on racks for three to four months before pressing and fermentation. The blend is 60% Corvina, 20% Corvinone, 10% Rondinella, 5% Molinara and 5% other red grapes from calcareous clay soils. The wine ages about five years in oak casks, then rests further in bottle. The producer notes ripe fruit, preserves, black pepper, leather and chocolate, with elegant tannins and a long finish, and suggests serving it at 16–18°C with red meats and aged cheeses. 750ml.

suertes-del-marques-vidonia.title: Suertes Del Marques Vidonia 2020 750ml
suertes-del-marques-vidonia.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "Colour, golden, pale. Aroma, white fruit, pattiserie, sweet spices, hint of anise, dry stone. Flavour, elegant, good acidity, fresh. Color, dorado, pálido. Aroma, fruta blanca, pastelería, especias dulces, anisado, piedra seca. Boca, elegante, buena acidez, fresco. Farbe, goldfarben, blass. Aroma, helle Früchte, Feingebäck, süße Gewürze, Anisnoten, trockener Stein. Mund, elegant, schöne Säure, frisch." - 97/100, Guia Penin

baron-de-ley-blanco-semidulce.title: Baron De Ley Blanco Semi Dulce
baron-de-ley-blanco-semidulce.bodyHtml: Barón de Ley Blanco Semidulce is a seductive and approachable white wine that offers a perfect harmony between natural sweetness and refreshing acidity. Sourced from the high-altitude Finca Carbonera vineyard—the highest in Rioja—this wine is crafted primarily from Sauvignon Blanc to capture maximum aromatic intensity. It presents a straw-yellow hue with golden glints, leading into a complex nose of exotic passion fruit, fresh mint, and delicate honey. On the palate, it is light and silky with a subtle "plummy" texture, maintaining a vibrant freshness that prevents the sweetness from being cloying. An ideal companion for cured cheeses, foie gras, and fruit-based desserts, it also serves as a sophisticated aperitif when served well-chilled.

ch-mouton-rothschild-premier-cru-classe.title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild 2022
ch-mouton-rothschild-premier-cru-classe.bodyHtml:
Chateau Mouton Rothschild is a First Growth Pauillac produced from deep gravel soils on the Plateau de Mouton. Cabernet Sauvignon dominates the vineyard and provides tannic richness, aromatic complexity and ageing capacity, complemented by Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot in proportions that vary by vintage.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roasted rack of lamb, grilled ribeye, braised beef cheeks, or aged Comte.

 

100 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2022 Chateau Mouton Rothschild checks in as classic blend of 92% Cabernet Sauvignon and 8% Merlot that was raised all in new barrels. Incredibly concentrated yet light on its feet and graceful, this inky-hued beauty has sensational notes of cassis, graphite, crushed stone, and chocolate that are to die for. It shows the ripe, opulent style of the vintage yet brings sensational purity, loads of tannins, and a gorgeous finish. For the tech geeks out there, this hit 14% alcohol, a pH of 3.86, and an IPT (tannins) of 76.

100 Points - James Suckling

The aromas here are so complete with blackcurrants, asphalt, violets, lead pencil, orange blossoms and black truffles. A perfect nose. It's full-bodied yet tied down with seamless tannins that run the length of the wine and give such a seductive mouthfeel and persistence. A vintage with one of the highest percentages of cabernet sauvignon ever. Quintessential, great Bordeaux with no limits.

98 Points - Decanter

One of my favourite 2022s, technically very brilliant but it's the texture that wows, generous, fruity, sleek, supple, it gives stone and graphite touches putting the terroir in the glass and overall this just screams elegance and finesse and above all drinkability! Smooth and shiny, silky, sleek, delicious from the first sip. Mouthwatering acidity combined with tannins that have the perfect balance of flinty grip, fleshy fruit and cool minerality. Certainly not shouting, they haven't pushed too far at all, more restrained and refined while still delivering a gorgeous mouthful of wine. Classy and refreshing. Concentrated but clean, pure and vibrant. Wonderful, magical - giving the concentration of the hot vintage which is want you want, but this is moreish and so succulent. One you'll want to finish the glass and then have more immediately. Barrel Sample: 98

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Mouton Rothschild is one of the most muscular, almost brutally powerful wines of the vintage. Unfurling in the glass with aromas of dark berries, plums and sweet creme de cassis mingled with notions of espresso roast, pencil lead and petroleum jelly, it's full-bodied, dense and concentrated, with huge reserves of tannin and fruit. A blend of 92% Cabernet Sauvignon and 8% Merlot that represents 49% of the estate's production, this is a prodigious Mouton that's built for the cellar.

essere-sauv-blanc.title: Mission Hill Reserve Sauv Blanc
essere-sauv-blanc.bodyHtml:
Fresh and aromatic, with grapefruit, lime, passion fruit, green apple, and subtle herbal notes. The palate is crisp and lively, showing vibrant citrus fruit, refreshing acidity, gentle texture, and a clean, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with oysters, shellfish, grilled fish, goat cheese, salads, sushi, fresh vegetables, poultry, or light Mediterranean dishes.

essere-franco-chardonnay.title: Frank Family Chardonnay 2022
essere-franco-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Frank Family Chardonnay 2022 is a generous, luscious, and barrel-fermented California white wine sourced primarily from cool-climate estate vineyards in the Carneros region. Visually displaying a brilliant golden-yellow color, it opens with vibrant aromas of ripe peach, white nectarine, orange blossom, and yellow apple, elegantly complemented by subtle nuances of toasted oak, vanilla spice, and buttery shortbread. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied, rich texture balanced by lively natural acidity, delivering layered flavors of lemon curd, tropical fruit, and salted butterscotch that linger into a long, juicy finish accented by candied ginger.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with herb-roasted chicken, pan-seared halibut, lobster bisque, creamy mushroom risotto, and aged Gruyère or Comté cheese.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

This seamlessness version is impressive for its aromatics and generosity, with ripe peach, apricot preserves, orange blossom and lemon blossom flavors, plus a hint of salted, buttery shortbread. Shows a candied ginger accent on the long, juicy finish. Drink now.

martins-lane-dehart-vineyard-pinot-noir.title: Martin's Lane Dehart Vineyard Pinot Noir 2018 750ml
martins-lane-dehart-vineyard-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: High elevation and a warm, west-facing aspect conspire to produce a polished wine of earthiness and sensuality.

adelsheim-staking-claim-chehalem-chard.title: Adelsheim Staking Claim Chardonnay 2018
adelsheim-staking-claim-chehalem-chard.bodyHtml:
There is a ton of perfect, ripe Bosc pear on the nose, accompanied by fragrant, spicy florals and an elusive note. The texture is luscious yet refreshing. This wine will pair well with a late spring picnic, dappled sunshine, and nothing else to do.

93 Points - James Suckling

This has a complex and composed feel with a well fitted array of peach and citrus, praline and honeysuckle. Smooth-honed palate that holds a long, fresh and linear shape. Gently stony notes to close. Fruit and oak so melted together.

91 Points - Wine & Spirits

Dusty and bright, this homage to Adelsheim’s home appellation leads with a limeade briskness, offset by mild, nutty lees. The fruit is lean and vibrant, bristling with tense acidity; it needs a bit of cellar time to knit.

chateau-mouton-rothschild.title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild 2023
chateau-mouton-rothschild.bodyHtml: Château Mouton Rothschild 2023 is the grand vin of the Pauillac Premier Grand Cru Classé. A mild, wet winter refilled the soils after dry 2022, flowering went perfectly in late May, five days ahead of average, and June was the hottest the estate has recorded since 1962. Harvest ran from 7 to 30 September in changeable weather that alternated sunny days with storms. The blend is 93% Cabernet Sauvignon and 7% Merlot. The château describes a gleaming garnet-red wine with a crimson hue, ripe blackberry aromas with touches of pastry, candy and dark chocolate, a smooth, full-bodied palate on powerful, stylish tannins with lead pencil and smoky notes, and a long finish of toasted hazelnut and cocoa bean. 750ml, 14% ABV.

chateau-carbonnieux.title: Chateau Carbonnieux Pessac-Leognan 2018 750ml
chateau-carbonnieux.bodyHtml:
Pessac-Leognan Wine
Bordeaux, France
Recognized for its superior reds as well as whites, Pessac-Léognan on the Left Bank claims classified growths for both—making it quite unique in comparison to its neighboring Médoc properties.

Pessac’s Chateau Haut-Brion, the only first growth located outside of the Médoc, is said to have been the first to conceptualize fine red wine in Bordeaux back in the late 1600s. The estate, along with its high-esteemed neighbors, La Mission Haut-Brion, Les Carmes Haut-Brion, Pique-Caillou and Chateau Pape-Clément are today all but enveloped by the city of Bordeaux. The rest of the vineyards of Pessac-Léognan are in clearings of heavily forested area or abutting dense suburbs.

Arid sand and gravel on top of clay and limestone make the area unique and conducive to growing Sémillon and Sauvignon blanc as well as the grapes in the usual Left Bank red recipe: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and miniscule percentages of Petit Verdot and Malbec.

The best reds will show great force and finesse with inky blue and black fruit, mushroom, forest, tobacco, iodine and a smooth and intriguing texture.

Its best whites show complexity, longevity and no lack of exotic twists on citrus, tropical and stone fruit with pronounced floral and spice characteristics.
Bordeaux Blends
One of the world’s most classic and popular styles of red wine, Bordeaux-inspired blends have spread from their homeland in France to nearly every corner of the New World. Typically based on either Cabernet Sauvignon or Merlot and supported by Cabernet Franc, Malbec and Petit Verdot, the best of these are densely hued, fragrant, full of fruit and boast a structure that begs for cellar time. Somm Secret—Blends from Bordeaux are generally earthier compared to those from the New World, which tend to be fruit-dominant.

r-reserve.title: El Dorado 21 Year Old Special Reserve Rum
r-reserve.bodyHtml:
El Dorado 21 Year Old Special Reserve Rum is a luxury Demerara rum produced in Guyana by Demerara Distillers Limited at the Diamond Distillery. It is crafted from a blend of rums aged for a minimum of 21 years in ex-bourbon oak casks, utilizing historical stills including the Enmore wooden Coffey still, the Versailles single wooden pot still, and the Port Mourant double wooden pot still. The resulting spirit is exceptionally smooth, full-bodied, and deeply complex.

Food Pairing: High-percentage dark chocolate, artisanal aged cheeses, dried fig or date desserts, roasted nuts, and fine cigars.

Tasting Notes - A deep bronze amber rum with rich legs and a velvety, heavy-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose - Complex and aromatic with notes of mocha, dark chocolate, ripe tropical fruits, toasted nuts, and oak spice.

Palate - Rich and smooth with layers of dark brown sugar, roasted coffee, dried fruits, buttery caramel, and subtle wood influence.

Finish - Very long, smooth, and warming with lingering notes of dark cocoa, toasted oak, and dry spice.

Serve - Serve neat or with a single large ice cube.

citation-willamette-valley-pinot-noir.title: Resonance Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2022
citation-willamette-valley-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
A beautiful bright ruby color for this expressive wine, with aromas of blueberry, raspberry, orange peel, rose, lavender, black pepper, and morel mushroom. The palate is generous, fresh, and fruity, and the tannins are well balanced by a pleasant acidity.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Fragrant raspberry and fresh violet aromas lead to elegantly layered cherry, mineral and savory tea flavors, with a silky mouthfeel that slowly builds tension on the polished finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas rich in savory, woodsy and spicy notes lead to vibrant black cherries, grilled plums, mushrooms, star anise and a touch of black pepper. Distinctive for a broad Willamette Valley bottling, this is lively and medium-bodied.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Pinot Noir Willamette Valley is bursting with aromas of pomegranate, lavender, forest floor and herbal hints. The palate is open and inviting, offering concentrated, spicy flavors. It’s structured by silky tannins and mouthwatering acidity and has a long, nuanced finish.

citation-oregon-pinot-noir.title: Resonance Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2022
citation-oregon-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
A beautiful bright ruby color for this expressive wine, with aromas of blueberry, raspberry, orange peel, rose, lavender, black pepper, and morel mushroom. The palate is generous, fresh, and fruity, and the tannins are well balanced by a pleasant acidity.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Fragrant raspberry and fresh violet aromas lead to elegantly layered cherry, mineral and savory tea flavors, with a silky mouthfeel that slowly builds tension on the polished finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas rich in savory, woodsy and spicy notes lead to vibrant black cherries, grilled plums, mushrooms, star anise and a touch of black pepper. Distinctive for a broad Willamette Valley bottling, this is lively and medium-bodied.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Pinot Noir Willamette Valley is bursting with aromas of pomegranate, lavender, forest floor and herbal hints. The palate is open and inviting, offering concentrated, spicy flavors. It’s structured by silky tannins and mouthwatering acidity and has a long, nuanced finish.

spearhead-pinot-noir-cuvee.title: SpearHead Dual Citizen Pinot Noir 2024
spearhead-pinot-noir-cuvee.bodyHtml:
SpearHead Dual Citizen Pinot Noir is an elegant, medium-bodied red with bright cherry, raspberry, plum, earthy spice, and subtle oak. Crafted in British Columbia from Oregon Pinot Noir fruit, it offers silky texture, vibrant acidity, refined tannins, and a lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted duck, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, herb-roasted chicken, pork tenderloin, wild mushrooms, charcuterie, and soft cheeses.

2016-kenefick-ranch-cab-franc.title: Kenefick Ranch 'Caitlin's Select' Cabernet Franc 2016
2016-kenefick-ranch-cab-franc.bodyHtml:
Kenefick Ranch 'Caitlin's Select' Cabernet Franc 2016 is a beautiful, deeply aromatic, and masterfully structured estate-grown red wine that captures the generous warmth and distinctive volcanic terroir of the Vaca Mountain foothills in northern Napa Valley. A selective blend featuring a predominant core of Cabernet Franc enriched with small portions of Petit Verdot and Merlot, it displays a deep, concentrated ruby hue in the glass. The expressive nose unrolls an alluring bouquet of ripe black cherries, fresh violet petals, and dried herbs, seamlessly interwoven with undercurrents of forest floor, cedar box, and savory tobacco leaf. On the palate, this full-bodied and robust wine is exceptionally well-balanced, driving a rich, fleshy core of blackcurrants, wild dark berries, and baking spices over an integrated framework of fine-grained, grippy tannins. Accented by a lively line of integrated natural acidity, it carries excellent focus and mid-palate depth into a remarkably persistent, dry, and clean finish accented by subtle vanilla oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with rosemary-crusted grilled lamb shanks, peppercorn-sauced prime ribeye steaks, roasted duck breast, or a selection of mature, sharp Mimolette cheese.

91 Points - James Suckling
Brimming with fresh red cherries, yet quite full-bodied and well structured, this is a generous Napa Valley cabernet franc with a rather long, crisp and dry finish. Drink or hold.

bernardeschi.title: Bernardeschi Governo all'Uso Toscano 2022
bernardeschi.bodyHtml:
The blend combines the nobility of Sangiovese with the roundness of Merlot. After manual harvesting, part of the grapes is dried for 20 days to concentrate and enhance their aromatic profile. The grapes are vinified separately, but both undergo maceration for at least 14 days to extract color and polyphenols.

It has an intense ruby red color. The bouquet is dominated by elegant and refined aromas of red berries, complemented by a delicate vanilla finish. On the palate, it stands out for its full-bodied, rich, and creamy texture, with well-defined tannins that blend into a long, slightly spicy finish.

It pairs ideally with red meats, especially beef, and game. It also enhances a platter of aged cheeses.

lotto-unico.title: Terrescure Lotto Unico 2018 750ml
lotto-unico.bodyHtml:
Governo is the magic word that provides a plus in power and extract here through dried grapes. A full-fruited Rosso with 99 points and two gold medals in the luggage.

Tasting Notes
Expressive aromas of plum, morello cherry, blackberry and mulberry, rounded out by baking spice.  The palate is rich with concentrated plum and spice, the acidity keeps the wine from feeling heavy. The tannins are firm yet the layers of flavours carry onto a long satisfying finish.

brunello-di-montalcino.title: Banfi Brunello di Montalcino 2021
brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Banfi Brunello di Montalcino 2021 is a rich, powerful, and elegantly structured red wine from the rolling hills of southern Montalcino. Displaying a deep ruby hue with garnet reflections, it opens with sweet, fragrant aromas of black cherry, plum, and redcurrant, seamlessly integrated with complex undertones of licorice, pipe tobacco, and subtle baking spice. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied texture backed by dense, fine-grained tannins, vibrant natural acidity, and layers of dark berry fruit, iron, and earthy Mediterranean herbs that carry through to a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with prime beef, braised wild boar ragù, roasted lamb, osso buco, or aged Pecorino cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

Solid, showing dusty spices, dried citrus and an earthy, savory undertone. Traditional in style, with tight tannins and a nice grilled-orange character. Very well-balanced, supple and composed. Try from 2027.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers power in the form of dense tannins and intense flavors of black cherry, blackberry and black currant. Iron, tomato leaf and Mediterranean scrub notes add depth as this expands midpalate and through the detailed finish. Best from 2029 through 2046.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Supporting good concentration and volume, the Castello Banfi 2021 Brunello di Montalcino checks all the boxes for the vintage, reflecting careful blending and cellar precision in a warm year. There is richness and freshness, with layers of plum, blackcurrant and sweet spice. The tannins are well managed. The wine delivers exactly what is expected without pushing beyond its stylistic boundaries. This is a fine choice for near- to mid-term drinking, and like many new releases in this portfolio, it shows a high level of alcohol at 15.5%.

st-joseph-reflets-de-syrah.title: Domaine Grangier Reflets De Syrah Saint-Joseph Rouge 2018 750ml
st-joseph-reflets-de-syrah.bodyHtml:
Saint-Joseph, in France's northern Rhône Valley, is comfortably the region's largest appellation in terms of geographical coverage. The appellation title covers both red wine made mainly from Syrah, and white wine made from Marsanne and Roussanne blended in varying proportions.

Characteristics
Forest floor, tannin, acidity, blackcurrant, mint, eucalyptus.

Syrah has proved successful in multiple viticultural areas around the world; wines are produced in many styles and display myriads of dark-fruit flavors. Varietal Syrah can be quite floral in its youth, developing white and black pepper aromas and herbaceous notes as it ages. Some examples show tanned leather and smoky scents, while the fruit in these wines tends towards the very dark flavors of blackcurrant and licorice.

Old World styles of Syrah are generally produced in a more earthy and savory style in comparison to the New World where fruit-forward notes are more common.

The most searched-for Syrah on Wine-Searcher is Domaine Jean-Louis Chave Hermitage.

2016-mate-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Beringer 8th Maker Cabernet Sauvignon 2016 750ml
2016-mate-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Eighth Maker is a celebration of my family’s heritage brought full circle, the name a nod to my stepping in as Beringer’s eighth winemaker 139 years after my great-great-grandfather Jacob and his brother Frederick founded the winery. This wine is produced from the Beringer estate’s most prestigious vineyards and is a culmination of over a century of crafting iconic Napa wines. Lush, balanced, and with excellent potential for aging, Eighth Maker is both an achievement and a homecoming. 

99 Points - James Suckling


A dark and seductive cabernet, this has stunning forest berries and enormous concentration and freshness. But, as delicious as it is now, this is also built for the long term. Great finish, where the interplay of fruit and fine tannins is complex. Goes on for minutes with dark berries, blackberries and hot stones. A core of greatness. A new wine to give a nod to the eighth winemaker of Beringer, Mark Beringer. 

97 Points - Jeb Dunnick

The 2016 Cabernet Sauvignon 8th Maker is a tiny production, special cuvée by this estate that’s based on 100% Cabernet Sauvignon brought up in 80% new French oak. This beauty is a massive, full-bodied Cabernet that boasts a saturated purple color, classic crème de cassis fruit, loads of chocolate, espresso, and tobacco notes, building tannins, and a deep, opulent, powerful style on the palate that needs to be tasted to be believed. It shows the purity and classic style of the 2016 vintage yet certainly brings serious power and richness. It can be drunk any time over the coming two decades or more.


95 Points - Wine Advocate


Produced from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the deep garnet-purple 2016 Cabernet Sauvignon 8th Maker is a fantastic example of a top-notch Napa Valley Cab. It comes bounding out of the glass with exuberant scents of warm cassis and blackberry pie with subtle hints of dried Provence herbs, fertile loam, coffee, yeast extract, olives and crushed rocks. Medium to full-bodied, the generously fruited palate delivers plush-yet-firm tannins with seamless freshness and a lingering minty lift on the finish. 1,000 cases were made.

pretium-garnacha-la-rioja.title: Sierra de Toloño 'Tereseño' Garnacha Rioja 2023
pretium-garnacha-la-rioja.bodyHtml:
A magnificent and savory Spanish red wine masterfully crafted by Sierra de Toloño in Rioja Alavesa. Sourced from high-altitude, centenarian Garnacha vines on limestone soils, it undergoes spontaneous fermentation in amphorae, revealing expressive notes of red flowers, wild strawberries, and graphite.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with slow-roasted lamb shoulder, grilled venison loin, charcoal-broiled ribeye steak, wild boar ragout, or mature sheep milk cheeses.

pretium-tempranillo-la-rioja.title: Bodegas Muga Reserva 2022
pretium-tempranillo-la-rioja.bodyHtml:
Bodegas Muga Reserva 2022 is an exceptionally elegant, structured, and deeply expressive Spanish red wine crafted by the historic Muga family in Haro, the heart of Rioja Alta. Sourced from estate vineyards planted on clay-limestone soils sheltered by the Obarenes Mountains, this vintage showcases a warm and early-ripening growing season that yielded immense aromatic intensity and pristine fruit character. The grapes are harvested by hand and fermented using indigenous yeasts in large wooden vats. True to the bodega's artisanal heritage, the wine is matured for up to 24 months in oak casks handcrafted in their own on-site cooperage, utilizing a combination of 80% to 90% French and 10% to 20% American oak, followed by traditional fining with fresh egg whites and extensive bottle aging. In the glass, it displays a bright ruby-red color with medium-deep intensity and a subtle garnet-tinged rim. The highly expressive and complex nose unrolls a magnificent bouquet of ripe forest fruits, wild blackberries, blueberries, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with notes of black licorice, toasted coffee beans, sweet vanilla, and delicate reminders of forest floor and savory spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red is concentrated yet sleek and polished, driving a juicy core of succulent dark berry fruits, chocolate, and baking spices. It perfectly balances its rich mid-palate depth with a vibrant, mouthwatering line of integrated acidity and a powerful frame of firm, silky, and fine-grained tannins that carry into a long, harmonious, and slightly chewy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled prime ribeye steaks, slow-cooked beef stews, roasted lamb shanks, cured Iberian ham, and mature hard cheeses like aged Manchego.

93 Points - James Suckling

Chocolate, dark fruit and spices with pinecone. Medium- to full-bodied, succulent, with polished tannins, length and definition on the finish. This comes from various plots planted within a radius of 25 km from the winery. A blend of tempranillo, garnacha, mazuelo and graciano. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Reserva, sold as Crianza in Spain, has more tertiary notes than other people's Gran Reserva, even though it has a very classical profile. It is mostly Tempranillo with some Garnacha Tinta, Mazuelo and Graciano from vineyards no more than 25 kilometers from the winery in Haro, cropped from a warm and dry year. Here, what they did was wait; it rained a little, the plants unblocked and they had the patience to wait for the grapes to ripen fully. So, the grapes were in a very healthy state, and winemaker Isaac Muga likes to ferment the grapes destemmed and lightly crushed in oak vats with indigenous yeasts and then mature the wine in 90% French and 10% American oak barrels for 22 months, with racking every eight to nine months. It has good ripeness, 14% alcohol, a pH of 3.59 and 5.45 grams of acidity, and it's medium- to full bodied, concentrated but sleek and polished, with fine-grained tannins, very supple flavors and a chalky finish. It still has some toasty notes in the finish that should integrate with a little bit more time. 945,000 bottles produced. It was bottled in January 2025. They are very happy with 2022, and they even produced Prado Enea and a tiny quantity of Aro.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A sleek red, with flavors of black cherry and cured tobacco, plus accents of anise, smoked paprika and espresso, all trimmed nicely by refined, chalky tannins. This is enjoyable today but shows the stuffing for cellaring. Tempranillo and Garnacha. Drink now through 2040. 82,000 cases made, 15,000 cases imported.

chateau-maucoil-cndp-privilege.title: Chateau Maucoil Chateauneuf-du-Pape Privilege 2017
chateau-maucoil-cndp-privilege.bodyHtml:
Famous for its full-bodied, seductive and spicy reds with flavor and aroma characteristics reminiscent of black cherry, baked raspberry, garrigue, olive tapenade, lavender and baking spice, Châteauneuf-du-Pape is the leading sub-appellation of the southern Rhône River Valley. Large pebbles resembling river rocks, called "galets" in French, dominate most of the terrain. The stones hold heat and reflect it back up to the low-lying gobelet-trained vines. Though the galets are typical, they are not prominent in every vineyard. Chateau Rayas is the most obvious deviation with very sandy soil.

93 Points - James Suckling

This has some impressively complex aromas of dark, toasted spices, dark plums and berries and crushed flowers. The palate has grainy, assertive tannins that carry long and deliver plentiful flavors. From organically grown grapes. Drink or hold.

lecu-trinity.title: Domaine De L'Ecu Trinity 2019 750ml
lecu-trinity.bodyHtml:
Cinsault – Grenache blends are made up of two important grape varieties from southern France, and are vinified as either red or rosé wines. The two varieties have much in common; both Grenache and Cinsault are lighter bodied than other Rhône varieties, have strong resistance to droughts, and perform best when overcropping is avoided.

Grenache is of particular importance in the south of France. It is the predominant variety in the prestigious wines of Châteauneuf-du-Pape, and is used in myriad appellations all along the Mediterranean coast. Cinsault is also permitted in many appellations, but its main function is as a blending variety – while Grenache has sufficient character to be made into a wine on its own, Cinsault rarely does.

As such, most Grenache – Cinsault blends have much more of the former, adding structure to the wines. Grenache is herbaceous and spicy, with plenty of berryfruit flavors, and in particular raspberry. It has ample tannins and, usually, reasonably high alcohol, particularly as it is often grown in hot environments.

Cinsault, on the other hand, lacks structure, color and tannin, and is usually employed to give an aromatic lift to the wine, or to help pad out a wine in smaller vintages, as it is a high-yielding variety. The two varieties are commonly joined by Syrah, making a Cinsault – Grenache – Syrah blend.

Grenache – Cinsault blends are permitted in a wide range of appellations in southern France, from Châteauneuf-du-Pape to the simple IGP wines of the area. Perhaps the blend's most important expression is in the fresh, fruit-driven rosé wines of the Côtes de Provence appellation in southeastern France.

antinori-guado-al-tasso-matarocchio.title: Tenuta Guado al Tasso Matarocchio 2016 750ml
antinori-guado-al-tasso-matarocchio.bodyHtml:
Matarocchio 2016 shows a great aromatic complexity with notes of dark berry fruit which alternate with sensations of powdered chocolate, exotic spices, and toasted coffee. The palate is an enveloping one, rich, one of excellent tension and of long persistence on the finish and aftertaste.

98 Points - Vinous

The 2016 Bolgheri Superiore Matarocchio, the estate's pure Cabernet Franc, is stunning. Dark, sumptuous and super-expressive, the 2016 is a seamless, exotic beauty. Even with all of its richness, the 2016 remains finessed and nuanced to the core, with exceptional balance and tons of energy. This vibrant Bolgheri Cabernet Franc will drink well for many years.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Matarocchio is a wine of muscle and brawn that opens to dark thickness and deep layers of black fruit, spice, leather and tar. If you like big and bold, this Tuscan Cabernet Franc will prove quite agile when pairing with coal-fired barbecued T-bone steak. This wine was produced in 2017, but it was not made in 2018 because the variety had a hard time reaching optimal ripeness. This full-bodied wine is absolutely linear and direct in terms of aromas; however, it shows fleshy succulence in terms of mouthfeel. It closes with midnight black notes of dried berry and exotic spice.

la-croix-des-aubrais-pichon-lalande.title: Chateau Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2023
la-croix-des-aubrais-pichon-lalande.bodyHtml:
An exceptional Pauillac offering cassis, blackberry, violet, cedar, graphite, and tobacco aromas. Silky tannins meet impressive concentration and freshness, creating a graceful, structured palate with layered complexity and a remarkably persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, truffle dishes, aged Comte, or grilled ribeye.

 

 

99 Points - James Suckling

A racy and focused Pichon Lalande with expressive aromas and flavors of black currant, blackberry and black cherry accented by licorice. Medium- to full-bodied, it features tight yet beautifully polished tannins, followed by layers of black currant, chocolate, walnut and subtle spice. With air, the wine reveals remarkable class, refinement and grace, supported by a silky tannic backbone. From organically and biodynamically grown grapes. A blend of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 17% Merlot and 3% Cabernet Franc.

98 Points - Decanter

A beautifully aromatic Pauillac with lush black currant and black cherry complemented by pencil lead, graphite, licorice and menthol. Supple and energetic on the palate, vibrant acidity provides freshness and drive while generous minerality adds a cool, classical character. Sleek, precise and refined, it maintains impressive structure and directness from beginning to end. One of the standout Pauillac wines of the vintage. Barrel Sample: 98.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Composed of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 17% Merlot and 3% Cabernet Franc, the 2023 Pichon Lalande offers dark currants, violets, smoky tobacco, lead pencil and graphite alongside the estate's signature floral character. Medium- to full-bodied, pure and beautifully layered, it combines a graceful texture with polished, steadily building tannins and outstanding length. A classic expression with approximately four decades of aging potential. Drink 2027–2067.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande reveals a serious, structured personality with aromas of blueberries, blackberries and plums layered with pencil shavings, violet and crushed mint. Medium- to full-bodied, deep and concentrated, it is supported by sweet, well-integrated tannins and concludes with a long, penetrating finish. A blend of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 17% Merlot and 3% Cabernet Franc.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Warm cassis, plum and cherry reduction flavors are complemented by subtle wet earth, ink and iris notes. The tannic grip is juicy yet seamlessly integrated, while fresh cedar emerges through the finish. Solidly structured and balanced throughout, this is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Cabernet Franc.

2015-rubinelli-ripasso.title: Rubinelli Vajol Valpolicella Ripasso Classico Superiore 2015 750ml
2015-rubinelli-ripasso.bodyHtml:
Valpolicella Ripasso Classico wines are produced under the Valpolicella Ripasso DOC, specifically from grapes grown within the traditional classico vineyard area of the Valpolicella ('Valley of Many Cellars'). 

Valpolicella's Ripasso wines are more complex than their regular Valpolicella counterparts, and are generally higher in tannins due to the ripasso production process used. In this method, the wine is re-fermented on the pre-fermented, tannin-rich skins of grapes used to make the area's dried-grape passito wines (see Recioto della Valpolicella and Amarone della Valpolicella).

Because Valpolicella's wines have traditionally been light in body, local winemakers have employed various techniques to create greater depth and complexity. The passito and ripasso methods have been the most successful by far. The former is used in Recioto della Valpolicella and Amarone della Valpolicella, and the latter used to make Valpolicella Ripasso.

Valpolicella is the most famous red wine to come out of the Veneto wine region in the northeast of Italy. The defining character of all quality Valpolicella is its fragrant, tangy cherry aroma, a quality which is carried through into the ripasso wines, particularly those from the classico viticultural areas.

marie-lancelot-champagne-grand-cru.title: Lancelot-Pienne Cuvee Marie Lancelot Brut Champagne Grand Cru 'Cramant' 2014 750ml
marie-lancelot-champagne-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
The Côte des Blancs is the center for Blanc de Blanc production within the Champagne region. "The Hill of Whites", to the south of Epernay, is an east or southeast-facing slope around 15 kilometers (9 miles) in length. Its chalky soil is more suited to white grape growing production than the more clay-based soils elsewhere. 96 percent of vineyards here are planted with Chardonnay.

Blanc de Blanc Champagnes tend to taste different to the most familiar non vintage cuvées. Those usually include considerable proportions of black-skinned Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier. That said, it is hard to identify any stylistic characteristics that are common to all Blanc de Blancs bottlings.

This is true when one tastes those few wines made from less common white grape varieties (see below). Chardonnay does tend to taste more citrussy than wines with red grape components. They tend to be (or appear to be) crisper and drier and more likely to be considered as an aperitif or partner to seafood. Still, there is also considerable variation between wines made only from Chardonnay.

Even within the Côte de Blancs, terroir variations seem to play a strong role. For example, A. Jacquart's Le Mesnil cuvées emphasizes acid structure, elegance and minerality. But their Premier Cru Vertus, from the southern end of the Côte de Blancs, is much rounder and more peach-laden.

Le Mesnil sur Oger is a Grand Cru-rated commune within the Côte de Blancs. (In Champagne villages gain Premier or Grand Cru status, not individual plots). Salon's Le Mesnil and Krug's Clos de Mesnil are made entirely from Chardonnay grapes sourced from here. Other Blanc de Blanc Grand Cru villages are Cramant, Avize and Oger.

The Côte de Sezanne zone lies a little to the south of the Côtes de Blancs. It is also southeast-facing and has a similar focus on Chardonnay. But the heavier soils tend to produce wines with a little less finesse.

Maturity can also play a role in how a Blanc de Blancs tastes. Chardonnay-based wines can show more citrus, green apple and minerality when young. They often gain honeyed, buttered toast characters in time. Top quality blanc de blanc vintage Champagnes are among the longest-lived of any category of sparkling wine.

It follows that the amount of reserve wine in any non-vintage Champagne can play a big part in the style. Other important winemaking considerations include whether the base wine saw any oak and the length of maturation in the bottle with the spent yeast before disgorgement.

The sweetness of the wine as determined by dosage is also important. Wines made only from Chardonnay are likely to undergo malolactic fermentation, as with other styles. However, Salon (which needs time in the cellar) is one example where the process is suppressed.

el-enemigo-semillion.title: El Enemigo Semillon 2020
el-enemigo-semillion.bodyHtml:
One of Argentina's most acclaimed wineries, El Enemigo, has rocketed to superstardom in just a few short vintages. El Enemigo is a joint venture of two big names in Argentine wine, Catena's winemaker Alejandro Vigil and Dr. Catena's younger daughter, Adrianna. These two were drawn together by a passion for creating more approachable and mineral-driven wines that express the nuances of Mendoza's unique terroirs.

A sophisticated and groundbreaking expression of old-vine white wine, the 2020 El Enemigo Semillón is sourced from 70-year-old vineyards in the Agrelo district of Luján de Cuyo. This wine is celebrated for its unique winemaking process, which includes aging for 15 months in French oak barrels with approximately 20% to 35% of the wine maturing under a "veil of flor." It presents a brilliant golden-yellow hue and opens with an intense, complex bouquet of dried honey, grilled pineapple, and citrus zest, layered with nutty undertones of almond, cashew, and a distinct flinty minerality. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and remarkably creamy, showcasing a voluminous flow balanced by a vibrant, saline acidity and savory notes of green olive and salted butter. The finish is long and elegant, marked by lingering hints of toasted oak and ginger.

94 Points - James Suckling 

This has an intense nose of dried apple, grilled pineapple, cedar, salted butter, waxed lemon, green olive and smoked almond. It’s medium-bodied with a layered and concentrated palate. Saline, toasty and smoky.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Sémillion old vines are being rescued in Argentina to make high-end wines with complexity. This is the case of this white from 50-year-old vines in Luján de Cuyo with a small percentage aged under flor. The nose shows subtle almond and acacia aromas that complement its citrus and saline notes. The medium-weight palate offers almond, grapefruit, pear and elevated acidity, finishing with light smoky notes.

stewart-thistle-thorne-napa-cabernet.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
stewart-thistle-thorne-napa-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a refined and powerful red wine crafted from top-tier estate and independent grower vineyards across the Napa Valley. Blending 93% Cabernet Sauvignon with 6% Merlot, it opens with rich aromas of boysenberry, black currant, and dark cherry, accented by bay leaf, baking spice, and subtle cedar notes. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, well-sculpted texture packed with blueberry, blackberry, and plum flavors supported by fine, firm tannins and a long, vibrant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, roasted lamb, duck breast, or aged cheddar cheese.

ungeheuer-gg-riesling.title: Schloss Lieser Niederberg Helden Gg 750ml
ungeheuer-gg-riesling.bodyHtml: Schloss Lieser Niederberg Helden GG is a top-tier dry Riesling from the Mosel region in Germany, known for its exceptional concentration and complexity. This Grosses Gewächs (GG) bottling showcases the Mosel's ability to produce powerful, elegant, and minerally driven Rieslings. It's characterized by a balance of intense minerality and vibrant freshness, with flavors of citrus, green apple, and flinty notes. The wine is dry, long, and focused, with a vibrant acidity that complements the slate minerality.

billecart-salmon-brut-reserve.title: Billecart-Salmon Brut Reserve
billecart-salmon-brut-reserve.bodyHtml:
Fine bubbles which rise slowly, persistent mousse. Straw-colored. A nose of ripe pear with some touches of cut hay. Full fruit, but clean in the mouth. All wines from the best sites in the department of the Marne, from more than twenty top vineyards in Champagne. The overall composition of this cuvée has not changed much for almost fifty years.

Fresh and long tasting, the Brut Réserve may be drunk on all occasions.

93 Points - James Suckling

Lovely aromas of raspberries, gingerbread, toast and honey on the nose. I like the generosity and concentration of flavor on the palate, with a medium body and soft, creamy bubbles. Long finish. 43% meunier, 29% chardonnay and 28% pinot noir, with over 50% reserve wines. Blend of 15 vintages, with percentages based on the 2020 vintage, back to 2006.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Champagne is a classic. The nonvintage wine shows real richness and depth. It is structured, open with a honeyed aroma and ripe, rounded white fruits.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Based on the 2020 vintage (the youngest vintage serves as the “base” of a bottling, even if it does not represent the majority of the blend) and incorporating 71% reserve wines—half stored as individual vintages and the other half as a perpetual reserve initiated in 2006—Billecart-Salmon’s latest NV Le Réserve is showing nicely. It offers aromas of green pear, honeysuckle, brioche and white peach. Disgorged in early 2024 with a dosage of three grams per liter, this reimagined cuvée has recently undergone a significant reduction in dosage. The sweetness that so often presents itself on the finish of NV Champagnes from Grandes Marques is no more. Medium to full-bodied, lively and charming, with a textural attack and vibrant acidity, it culminates in a long, precise finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Firm and minerally, this well-knit Champagne layers flavors of grainy pear, preserved lemon, toast point and crystallized honey on a creamy mousse. Reveals hints of smoke and saline on the finish.

hornitos-anejo-cristalino.title: Hornitos Cristalino Reserve 75th Anniversary Tequila
hornitos-anejo-cristalino.bodyHtml:
Crafted in Tequila, Jalisco, Mexico, at the historic Destilería La Perseverancia, Hornitos Cristalino 75th Anniversary is a commemorative 100% Weber Blue Agave expression celebrating seven and a half decades of Casa Sauza production. Harvested from estate-grown agave, the piñas are cooked in steam autoclaves, crushed in roller mills, and double-distilled in stainless steel pot stills. The spirit is aged in oak barrels for 12 to 18 months before undergoing a specialized activated charcoal filtration process. This filtration strips away the dark amber color while retaining the complex vanilla, toasted oak, and dried fruit characteristics imparted by barrel aging, yielding a crystal-clear spirit with refined smoothness and core agave character.

Food Pairing: Grilled sea bass, lobster tail with butter sauce, fresh oyster ceviche, goat cheese crostini, roasted pork tenderloin, or dark chocolate truffles.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear with brilliant, luminous clarity, a rich medium body, and smooth, slow-dripping legs.

Nose: Elegant and complex, opening with sweet cooked agave, soft vanilla bean, and toasted oak, supported by subtle floral notes, light cocoa, and fresh citrus zest.

Palate: Silky, round, and remarkably smooth on the palate, featuring caramelized agave and sweet butterscotch upfront before unfolding into layers of toasted oak, vanilla cream, subtle herbal tea, and mild pepper warmth.

Finish: Long, clean, and velvety with lingering notes of sweet agave nectar, gentle oak spice, and a crisp, warm vanilla finish.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn or Riedel Tequila glass, over a single large ice sphere, or as an ultra-smooth base for an elevated Cristalino Cocktail or White Tequila Manhattan.

jacobs-creek-moscato-rose-1.title: Jacob's Creek Moscato Rosé
jacobs-creek-moscato-rose-1.bodyHtml:
Jacob's Creek Moscato Rosé is a light, delightfully sweet, and wonderfully refreshing Australian rosé that offers a playful, semi-sparkling spritz. Crafted by one of Australia's most renowned estates, this low-alcohol wine exhibits a vibrant strawberry-pink blush in the glass. The highly inviting and aromatic bouquet opens with fresh, fragrant notes of ripe raspberry, wild strawberry, and juicy pear, beautifully accented by a touch of candied fruit and white citrus blossom. On the palate, it is light-bodied, clean, and beautifully balanced, delivering a luscious core of summer red berries and a vibrant, sherbet-like quality. A crisp, zesty acidity perfectly counterbalances the natural grape sweetness, ensuring the palate remains clean, bright, and incredibly refreshing through to a snappy, fruit-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh fruit platters, light berry pavlova, moderately spicy Thai noodle dishes, and soft cheeses like creamy brie.

poli-miele-1.title: Poli Miele Grappa and Honey Liqueur 500ml
poli-miele-1.bodyHtml:
Poli Miele is a delightfully soothing, smooth, and aromatic honey liqueur crafted by the historic Poli Distillerie in Schiavon, Veneto. Made according to a traditional recipe, this premium liqueur combines a pure grape spirit base with high-quality, natural acacia honey. Rather than using artificial flavorings or syrupy sweeteners, Poli relies on the pure essence of the honeybees' work, which is further enriched by a delicate infusion of aromatic herbs and essential oils like pine, juniper, and mint. The result is a beautifully balanced, sweet elixir that shows a velvety texture perfectly countered by a crisp alpine freshness, preventing it from ever feeling heavy or cloying on the palate.

Food Pairing: The elegant sweetness and soft herbal undertones of this honey liqueur make it a wonderful companion to light pastries, apple tarts, lemon bars, and traditional almond biscotti. It also serves as a brilliant counterpoint to savory bites, pairing exceptionally well with mild, creamy cheeses like fresh ricotta, goat cheese drizzled with honey, or a selection of blue cheeses like Gorgonzola Dolce.

TASTING NOTES - A brilliant, warm golden-amber with clear yellow reflections. The texture is medium-bodied, remarkably smooth, and coats the palate in a velvety, soft, and comforting layer of natural honey viscosity.

NOSE - Forward, sweet, and highly aromatic, opening with a prominent bouquet of fresh acacia honey and wildflower meadows, beautifully supported by subtle balsamic notes of mountain pine, wild mint, and a delicate touch of citrus blossom.

PALATE - Rich, sweet, and masterfully balanced. Luscious layers of pure liquid honey and sweet royal jelly seamlessly coat the mouth, enlivened mid-palate by a refreshing wave of alpine herbs, soft pine needles, and a gentle, clean spirit warmth.

FINISH - Medium to long, clean, and beautifully comforting. The initial heavy sweetness gently recedes, leaving a highly satisfying, lingering aftertaste of warm honey tea, soft vanilla, and a refreshing, crisp herbal dryness.

SERVE - Highly versatile. Best served slightly chilled or at a cellar temperature of 10-15°C (50-59°F) in a traditional tulip-shaped glass or spirits snifter as a relaxing after-dinner digestif. It can also be served over crushed ice, added to hot tea for a comforting winter warmer, or used as a sweet floral modifier in modern craft cocktails.

poli-mirtillo-1.title: Poli Mirtillo
poli-mirtillo-1.bodyHtml:
Poli Mirtillo is a lively, delightfully sweet, and highly aromatic Italian liqueur crafted by the historic Poli Distillerie in Schiavon, Veneto. Masterfully bridging the gap between traditional Italian distillation and wild alpine flavors, this premium creation is made by naturally infusing whole wild blueberries (Vaccinium Myrtillus) in authentic, estate-distilled copper pot still Grappa. Rather than masking the spirit, the high-purity Grappa base provides a sturdy structural elegance that frames the natural juices and essential oils of the fruit. The result is a beautifully balanced liqueur bursting with authentic, unadulterated berry flavor, reminiscent of fresh blueberry jam spread over morning toast.

Food Pairing: The deep, sweet, and pleasantly tart berry profile of this liqueur makes it an exceptional companion to a variety of desserts. It pairs beautifully with lemon pound cake, fresh fruit tarts, vanilla panna cotta, and traditional Italian biscotti or cantucci. It also serves as a brilliant counterpoint to savory and salty dishes, pairing wonderfully with fresh goat cheese, rich ricotta drizzled with honey, or a high-end charcuterie board featuring cured meats and duck liver pâté.

TASTING NOTES - A medium ruby-purple hue with violet highlights. The texture is medium-bodied, remarkably smooth, and offers a pleasant, well-rounded, and juicy viscosity across the palate.

NOSE - Forward, bright, and intensely fruity, opening with prominent aromas of freshly picked wild blueberries, red berry compote, and a delicate floral touch of lily of the valley, all resting on a clean, soft Grappa foundation.

PALATE - Generous, sweet, and perfectly balanced. Rich flavors of sweet caramelized blueberries and dark forest berries seamlessly coat the mouth, enlivened mid-palate by a subtle, refreshing tartness and the gentle, structured warmth of fine pomace brandy.

FINISH - Clean, sweet, and of medium length. The heavy fruit characteristics slowly fade away, leaving a highly satisfying, lingering aftertaste of blueberry jam, subtle grape skins, and a soft, comforting warmth.

SERVE - Best served slightly chilled at a cellar temperature of 10-15°C (50-59°F) in a traditional tulip-shaped glass or spirits snifter as an elegant after-dinner digestif. It can also be served over crushed ice, poured directly over a scoop of premium vanilla bean gelato, or topped with cold Prosecco for a vibrant, fruity summer spritz.

port-askaig-8-year-old.title: Port Askaig 8 Year Old Islay Single Malt
port-askaig-8-year-old.bodyHtml:
Port Askaig 8 Year Old Islay Single Malt is an exceptional, highly acclaimed small-batch single malt Scotch whisky that serves as the flagship expression of the Port Askaig range. Sourced from an undisclosed distillery on the northeastern coast of Islay—widely recognized to be Caol Ila—it is aged for a minimum of 8 years in a combination of refill American oak ex-bourbon casks. The spirit balances Islay’s signature peaty, smoky, and salty maritime character with soft, creamy fruitiness, resulting in a remarkably approachable, clean, and elegant dram.

Food Pairing: Freshly shucked oysters with lemon, smoked salmon, grilled sea bass, blue cheese like Roquefort, dark chocolate, and salted caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes : Pale straw and golden amber in appearance, featuring a light to medium, clean, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and vibrant, opening with crisp lime, lemon zest, and green apples, layered over soft wood smoke, damp peat, sea spray, and subtle vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and balanced, delivering initial flavors of sweet citrus, light honey, and soft malty grain, followed by smoldering peat smoke, charcoal, and a distinct salty brine.

Finish : Medium to long, crisp, and warming, leaving a lingering impression of gentle peat smoke, zesty lime, and a touch of maritime salt.

Serve : Best served neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its aromatic smoke and citrus notes, or with a few drops of water to bring out its sweet malt and fruit character.

powers-gold-label-irish-whisky.title: Powers Gold Label Irish Whiskey
powers-gold-label-irish-whisky.bodyHtml:
Gold Label, one of the best selling whiskey in Ireland, is now available in a new version at 43.2° ABV instead of 40°. This change in alcohol volume lifts up the distinctive taste of Powers' Pot Still distillation and ranks this bottle as a Super Premium Irish Whiskey.

Bill Leighton, Master Blender at Powers, explains: "this change from 40° to 43.2° intensifies the spicy character, lowers the taste of cereal grains and highlights Powers very style. Indeed, we believe in aromas brought by distillation rather than those emerging from cask maturation."

red-rooster-pinot-gris-1.title: Red Rooster Pinot Gris 2025
red-rooster-pinot-gris-1.bodyHtml:
Red Rooster Pinot Gris 2025 is a vibrant, refreshing, and beautifully aromatic Canadian white wine that brilliantly showcases the bright fruit character of British Columbia's premier wine-growing regions. Sourced from carefully selected vineyards across both the North and South Okanagan Valley, as well as the Similkameen Valley, a portion of the fruit spent additional time on the skins to enhance its texture and aromatic complexity, while the remainder was cool-fermented entirely in stainless steel vats. It pours a radiant, clear straw-yellow hue in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and welcoming, opening with inviting aromas of honeyed yellow apple, ripe white peach, and fresh melon, accented by a delicate touch of white blossoms. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, lightly textured mouthfeel, delivering succulent layers of juicy pear and tropical pineapple. Perfectly balanced by a bright, refreshing touch of citrus zest and lively acidity, this easygoing yet expressive white wine finishes clean and crisp.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with wood-fired cheese pizzas, fresh pear and goat cheese salad, lemon-herb roasted chicken, grilled fish tacos, and seared scallops.

redbreast-15-year-old.title: Redbreast 15 Year Old Irish Whiskey
redbreast-15-year-old.bodyHtml:
Redbreast 15 Year Old Irish Whiskey is a rich, robust, and beautifully complex expression that showcases the pinnacle of the traditional Single Pot Still style. Originally created as a limited-edition release for La Maison du Whisky in Paris, it proved so exceptional that it earned a permanent place in the core Redbreast family. Crafted at the famed Midleton Distillery, it is made from a traditional mash of malted and unmalted barley, triple distilled in copper pot stills, and meticulously matured in a careful balance of first-fill and refill Spanish Oloroso sherry casks and American oak ex-bourbon barrels. Bottled at an elevated 46% ABV and without chill-filtration, the 15 Year Old delivers a fuller, more earthy, and highly textured profile compared to its younger sibling, packed with fleshy stone fruits, rich aromatic oils, and profound toasted wood spice.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork belly, spiced lamb chops, sharp aged cheddar or Comté cheese, rich fruitcake, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance with a full-bodied, incredibly smooth, and oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Highly aromatic and complex, bursting with dark berry fruits, fleshy peach, and sweet citrus, seamlessly interwoven with aromatic oils, toasted wood, and warm winter spices.

Palate : Full, rich, and elegantly textured. A harmonious wave of fleshy orchard fruits, berries, and sweet vanilla gives way to the signature pot still spice—featuring vibrant ginger, white pepper, and a deep, warming toasted oak character.

Finish : Exceptionally long, sophisticated, and evolving, leaving a lingering warmth of complex pot still spices, toasted wood, and sweet dried fruit.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or gently open it with a few drops of room-temperature water to further release its rich aromatic oils and fruity esters.

redbreast-21-year-old.title: Redbreast 21 Year Old Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
redbreast-21-year-old.bodyHtml:
Redbreast 21 Year Old is the pinnacle expression in the core range of the legendary Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey brand, crafted at the Midleton Distillery in County Cork, Ireland. Regarded globally as one of the finest Irish whiskeys ever produced, it is made from a traditional mashbill of malted and unmalted barley, triple-distilled in copper pot stills, and aged for a minimum of 21 years in a combination of ex-bourbon American oak barrels and first-fill Spanish Oloroso sherry butts. Non-chill filtered and bottled at an optimal 46.0% ABV, the extensive aging introduces extraordinary depth, delivering lush tropical fruit notes, rich Oloroso sherry character, toasted wood spices, and the signature oily, creamy pot still mouthfeel.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with slow-roasted duck breast with cherry reduction, seared venison medallions, artisanal blue cheeses such as Cashel Blue or Roquefort, dark chocolate truffles, sticky toffee pudding, and toasted spiced pecans.

Tasting Notes: An exceptionally complex, elegant, and voluptuous pot still whiskey showcasing ripe tropical fruits, dried figs, roasted nuts, creamy vanilla, and warming pot still spices.

Nose: Abundantly aromatic with ripe pineapple, mango, and guava layered over sultanas, dried apricots, toasted hazelnuts, vanilla fudge, and polished antique oak.

Palate: Viscous and silky on the palate, revealing fleshy stone fruit, juicy citrus oils, brown sugar, and Oloroso sherry nuttiness, beautifully counterbalanced by vibrant pot still spices including cinnamon, clove, and cracked black pepper.

Finish: Remarkably long, warm, and lingering with sweet oak, persistent baking spices, dried orchard fruit, and a final, tactile return of malty pot still barley.

Serve: Best enjoyed neat in a tulip-shaped tasting glass or Glencairn to explore the unfolding aromas, or with just a few drops of spring water to unlock deeper tropical and floral notes.

redbreast-lustau-edition.title: Redbreast Lustau Edition Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
redbreast-lustau-edition.bodyHtml: A unique and aromatic expression of triple-distilled single pot still Irish whiskey, representing a collaborative marriage between the traditions of Midleton Distillery and the Sherry expertise of Bodegas Lustau. Initially matured in a combination of traditional bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks, it undergoes a finishing period of one year in seasoned first-fill Sherry butts from Jerez, Spain. This process yields a deep mahogany hue and an intense bouquet of dark fruits, prunes, and roasted walnuts. The palate is exceptionally creamy and spicy, offering rich flavours of honeyed malt and figs, culminating in a long, sophisticated finish with lingering notes of sweet sherry and toasted oak.

redwood-empire-lost-monarch-rye-bourbon-.title: Redwood Empire Lost Monarch Bourbon & Rye Blend American Whiskey
redwood-empire-lost-monarch-rye-bourbon-.bodyHtml:
Redwood Empire Lost Monarch is a blended straight whiskey crafted by Redwood Empire Distilling in Sonoma County, California. Named after the world's largest coastal redwood tree, it is a marriage of straight bourbon whiskey and straight rye whiskey aged in new charred oak barrels. The blend combines the sweet corn and vanilla characteristics of bourbon with the bold, peppery botanical complexity of high-rye whiskey, producing a layered, balanced, and spicy American whiskey profile.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked pork ribs, grilled duck breast with cherry glaze, charcuterie with sharp aged cheddar, dark chocolate truffles, and warm pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Warm golden amber with copper highlights, offering a medium-to-full body with a smooth, coating, and balanced mouthfeel.

Nose : Warm spices, sweet vanilla bean, caramel, toasted brioche, fresh mint, dried apricot, and seasoned oak.

Palate : Brown sugar, toffee, baking cinnamon, cracked black pepper, sweet corn, dried stone fruits, and subtle citrus peel.

Finish : Long, warm, and spicy with lingering notes of pepper, caramel, clove, and toasted oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, over a large ice sphere, or as a rich base in classic whiskey cocktails like a Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

remy-martin-1738.title: Rémy Martin 1738 Accord Royal Fine Champagne Cognac
remy-martin-1738.bodyHtml:
The connoisseur's choice: aged in toasted oak barrels, it is the embodiment of traditional craftsmanship.

Behind its regal appearance lie mellow and rich flavours that are smooth and well-balanced on the palate. This is an authentic cognac, deeply rooted in the terroir and tradition once honoured by the French king himself.

NOSE
Generous notes of plum and fig marmalade rounded out by intense oaky notes of toffee and toasted bread.

TASTE
The mellowness of butterscotch and baked spices with hints of dark chocolate.

BODY
Exceptionally round with a creamy aftertaste and a concentration of nutty aromas imparted by a careful blend of eaux-de-vie aged in toasted French oak casks.

remy-martin-centaure-de-diamant.title: Remy Martin Centaure de Diamant Cognac
remy-martin-centaure-de-diamant.bodyHtml:
Cellar Master Pierrette Trichet created R?my Martin Centaure de Diamant in 2010. It contains only the most elegant eaux-de-vie from R?my Martin's precious reserves, making it the jewel of the Fine Champagne.

R?my Martin Centaure de Diamant won a Tasting Gold Award, Best in Class, at the 2011 International Wine and Spirit Competition as well as a gold medal at the 2013 International Wine and Spirit Competition.

Nose: The precious Fine Champagne reserves reveal delicate floral notes of honeysuckle and iris, married with rare aromas such as hazelnuts and dried figs.

Taste: A myriad of flavours bursts forth, like the many facets of a diamond, with melting sensations of candied fruit.

Body: A soft satin texture with a magnificently long finish.

remy-martin-louis-xiii-50ml.title: Louis XIII Cognac The Miniature 50ml
remy-martin-louis-xiii-50ml.bodyHtml:
Louis XIII Cognac is an pinnacle luxury spirit produced by the House of Rémy Martin, representing an exquisite blend of up to 1,200 individual eaux-de-vie harvested, distilled, and aged exclusively in the Grande Champagne region—the premier cru of Cognac. Each handcrafted crystal decanter contains a masterfully aged spirit matured over generations in historic tierçon oak casks, capturing decades of terroir, artisan heritage, and unmatched blending expertise.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with Iberico Bellota ham, aged Comté or Roquefort cheese, rich dark chocolate with high cocoa content, fine beluga caviar, and dried figs or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant mahogany and deep amber color with golden highlights, exhibiting a dense, full-bodied viscosity and a velvety, opulent texture on the palate.

Nose : A remarkably rich and expressive bouquet featuring intense floral notes of dried rose and jasmine, interwoven with honey, passion fruit, fig, plum, leather, cigar box, myrrh, and delicate baking spices like nutmeg and cinnamon.

Palate : Intensely complex and multi-layered, delivering flavors of candied fruits, dried aprons, passionfruit, saffron, gingerbread, rich oak, floral rancio, sandalwood, and warm spice that unfold seamlessly across the tongue.

Finish : Unrivaled length and depth, persisting for up to an hour with evolving hints of dried fruits, warm spice, aged leather, sweet oak, and subtle floral notes.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a traditional Cognac tulip glass or a crystal drop glass designed to concentrate its complex aromas.

remy-martin-louis-xiii-6l-mathusalem.title: Louis XIII Cognac 6L Mathusalem
remy-martin-louis-xiii-6l-mathusalem.bodyHtml:
Louis XIII Cognac is an pinnacle luxury spirit produced by the House of Rémy Martin, representing an exquisite blend of up to 1,200 individual eaux-de-vie harvested, distilled, and aged exclusively in the Grande Champagne region—the premier cru of Cognac. Each handcrafted crystal decanter contains a masterfully aged spirit matured over generations in historic tierçon oak casks, capturing decades of terroir, artisan heritage, and unmatched blending expertise.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant mahogany and deep amber color with golden highlights, exhibiting a dense, full-bodied viscosity and a velvety, opulent texture on the palate.

Nose : A remarkably rich and expressive bouquet featuring intense floral notes of dried rose and jasmine, interwoven with honey, passion fruit, fig, plum, leather, cigar box, myrrh, and delicate baking spices like nutmeg and cinnamon.

Palate : Intensely complex and multi-layered, delivering flavors of candied fruits, dried aprons, passionfruit, saffron, gingerbread, rich oak, floral rancio, sandalwood, and warm spice that unfold seamlessly across the tongue.

Finish : Unrivaled length and depth, persisting for up to an hour with evolving hints of dried fruits, warm spice, aged leather, sweet oak, and subtle floral notes.

ricasoli-casalferro-2016.title: Ricasoli Casalferro 2018 750ml
ricasoli-casalferro-2016.bodyHtml: Casalferro was first produced in 1993 when Francesco Ricasoli became president of the company. A pure Merlot produced only during the best years, Casalferro is obtained from the vineyard of the same name located at 400 meters above sea level and facing south. The brown clay loam soil with little organic content contributes to the exclusive personality of this great Chianti Merlot.

robert-mondavi-reserve-cabernet-sauvigno.title: Robert Mondavi ‘60th Anniversary’ Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
robert-mondavi-reserve-cabernet-sauvigno.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi ‘60th Anniversary’ Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 shimmers with a vibrant ruby-purple color and opens with a complex, expressive bouquet of ripe raspberry, blackberry, and dark blueberry accented by notes of dried herbs, graham cracker, and gravelly minerality. The full-bodied palate is incredibly plush and elegant, layering juicy red berries, cranberry, and cassis with sweet toasted oak and savory depth, supported by beautifully polished tannins and an incredibly long, fresh finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled prime ribeye, pan-seared venison loin, rosemary-infused roasted lamb chops, or rich, earthy wild mushroom risotto with aged Parmigiano-Reggiano.

96 Points - James Suckling

A terrific, one-time bottling of 100% cabernet sauvignon from two distinct vineyards owned by Robert Mondavi Winery. Deep and delicious, with black cherry, blackberry, creme de cassis and dark chocolate notes wrapped in a firm, polished texture and impressively rich, fine-grained tannins. From To Kalon and Wappo Hill sites. Drink or hold.
93 Points - Wine Spectator
A reserved style, with a slow but steady-moving core of plum, black currant and morello cherry compote notes carried by a silky structure and subtle juiciness. Anise and violet lay gently over the top, while graphite and cedar provide the spine. Best from 2027 through 2039. Tasted twice, with consistent notes. 3,004 cases made.

royal-stag-barrel-select.title: Royal Stag Barrel Select Indian Whisky
royal-stag-barrel-select.bodyHtml: Royal Stag Barrel Select is the premium whisky for the discerning consumer who seeks an evolved taste. This superior blend of imported scotch malts and Indian grain sprits is matured in hand-picked oak barrels to create an inimitable harmony of aroma, flavour, taste and colour.

royal-stag-deluxe.title: Royal Stag Deluxe Indian Whisky
royal-stag-deluxe.bodyHtml: An iconic brand among Indian spirits, Royal Stag has redefined the category in the country by offering an international quality blend and pioneering the “grain spirit blended with Scotch malts” revolution. Today, Royal Stag enjoys a fiercely loyal consumer franchise built on not just an excellent blend but a tagline that encapsulates a modern India: “MAKE IT LARGE”.

rum-nation-panama-21-year-old-rum.title: Rum Nation Panama Limited Edition 10 Year Old Rum
rum-nation-panama-21-year-old-rum.bodyHtml:
Rum Nation Panama 10 Year Old is an aged Panamanian rum selected and bottled under the Rum Nation label of Italy's Rossi & Rossi. It is distilled in column stills from molasses and matured for ten years in ex-bourbon casks, which the producer credits for its fragrant aroma of sun-dried raisins and chocolate. Light, delicately sweet and clean, it is bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle and works equally well neat, over ice or in classic rum cocktails.

Nose: Delicate, fresh, light, sweet and fruity.

Palate: Light bodied yet slightly unctuous; sugarcane sweetness with acacia honey, sun-dried raisins, milk chocolate and a hint of orange and apricot.

Finish: Clean and soft, with a gentle sweetness.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in traditional rum cocktails.

sena-chadwick-aconcagua-valley-2018.title: Sena 2020
sena-chadwick-aconcagua-valley-2018.bodyHtml:
Seña 2020 is an exceptionally elegant, structured, and masterfully balanced biodynamic icon Chilean red wine, representing a spectacular achievement from a warm and early growing season. Sourced entirely from the hillside vineyards of Panquehue in the Aconcagua Valley, this sophisticated Bordeaux-style blend presents a deep garnet-red hue with bright violet reflections. The expressive nose uncoils with an intense, multi-layered bouquet of fresh red cherries, raspberries, and dark cassis, seamlessly intertwined with delicate notes of violets, tobacco leaf, wild rosemary, and sweet baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full-bodied framework driven by a remarkably pure, juicy core of dark forest fruits and savory balsamic undertones. It possesses a surprising, lively linear acidity and extremely tight, fine-grained tannins that provide an aristocratic grip and velvet-smooth texture. Having aged for 22 months in French oak barrels (78% new) and 10% in large Stockinger foudres, it culminates in an extraordinarily long, harmonious, and highly polished finish marked by a distinctively fresh, mineral complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with charcoal-grilled dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted venison loin with a juniper reduction, rosemary-crusted rack of lamb, or slow-braised wild boar stew.

98 Points - James Suckling

Complex, with savory, spicy character, showing tobacco, salted plums, olives, black cherries, cassis and a hint of white pepper on the nose, followed by a refined, savory, balsamic accent. A full-bodied Seña with juicy fruit chiseling into the tight, extremely fine-grained tannins. Long, bright and still elegant from this warm vintage. 53% cabernet sauvignon, 25% malbec, 15% carmenere and 7% petit verdot. A wine with lots of harmony now, but better to drink from 2025.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Seña is a blend of 53% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Malbec, 15% Carmenere and 7% Petit Verdot (a little higher in search of acidity) from grapes harvested early, the second week of March, and fermented mostly in stainless steel and 10% in concrete eggs. It has a moderate 13.5% alcohol and good freshness. It's subtle and layered, not only fruit but with more spice; it has polished tannins and very integrated oak after 22 months in barrique, 78% new, and with 10% of the volume in large Stockinger barrels. The warmer years seem to be nicely managed, so that it's not reflected in the ripeness but is more a matter of texture and quality of the tannins; in the warmer years, like 2017 or this 2019, the wines have a little more grip, but these are definitely finer than those from the 2017 vintage. This wine has intensity and complexity, with no mintiness or herbal notes; it's spicy and juicy, with energy and depth. It has structure, color, stuffing and acidity to develop nicely in bottle.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Violets, ripe cherry and red-plum aromas are delicate. Light notes of cinnamon and dried herbs fill up the bouquet. This is one of Chile's iconic wines from a warm vintage in Aconcagua Valley that delivers good concentration of fruit on the ripe palate. Blackberry and cherry flavors are followed by light notes of oak spice. It has lively linear acidity and big tannins. It's good to drink now and promise a good future. Drink through 2030.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Suave and polished, featuring flavors of floral currant and plum preserves, with a mineral underpinning and fresh acidity. Ends with loam and spice nuances and firm tannins. Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Carmenere and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2032.

shelter-point-canadian-single-malt.title: Shelter Point Smoke Point Canadian Single Malt Whisky
shelter-point-canadian-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Produced by Shelter Point Distillery on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Smoke Point is a smoky Canadian single malt made from 100% malted B.C. barley. The current expression takes a distinctive approach to smoke: rather than relying solely on peated malt, Shelter Point ages the whisky in barrels smoked with driftwood gathered from its shoreline and native woods surrounding the distillery. Bottled at 53% ABV, it combines coastal smoke and maritime salinity with chocolate, fruit, toffee and creamy sweetness.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, barbecue pork, grilled beef, aged cheddar, dark chocolate, or crème brûlée with toasted nuts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and smoky, balancing campfire and cigar smoke with chocolate, ripe fruit, toffee, creamy sweetness, coastal salinity and subtle iodine.

Nose: Bold and aromatic, with campfire and cigar smoke accompanied by seasoned oak, maritime character and subtle sweet malt.

Palate: Rich and creamy, developing chocolate, fruit and toffee alongside smoky wood, gentle iodine and a distinctive salty coastal character.

Finish: Long and satisfying, with crème brûlée sweetness and salty graham cracker joined by lingering smoke, oak and maritime salinity.

Serve: Enjoy neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or tulip-shaped whisky glass; at 53% ABV, a few drops of water can help open its chocolate, fruit and smoky coastal character.

spicebox-chocolate-spiced-whisky.title: Spicebox Chocolate Spiced Whisky
spicebox-chocolate-spiced-whisky.bodyHtml: Often, Canadian bootleggers would blend, age and transport Whisky in used cocoa barrels — after all Canada is famous for having invented the world’s first wrapped chocolate bar! The leftover cocoa husks would infuse the smooth rye with rich, warm chocolate flavours, creating something unique and delicious.

spicebox-spiced-whisky-1.title: Spicebox Spiced Whisky
spicebox-spiced-whisky-1.bodyHtml: The rye in our blend emerges on the palate with notes of pepper and fruit, and is complemented with hints of vanilla and dried spices. Exceptionally smooth on the palate with a long warm finish. Try it straight up, on the rocks, or with your favourite mix.

st-lucia-admiral-rodney-hms-princessa.title: St. Lucia Distillers Admiral Rodney 'HMS Princessa' Rum
st-lucia-admiral-rodney-hms-princessa.bodyHtml:
HMS Princessa was originally a Spanish vessel captured by the British in 1780 at the battle of Cape St. Vincent. Captained by Charles Knatchbull with Rear Admiral Francis Samuel Drake abroad, this 70 gun ship of the line was one of the first ships to engage the French in the Battle of the Saints. Fighting valiantly, the Princessa engaged the enemy throughout the battle and inspired us to create this rum which embodies power and integrity.

Rum Blend: Admiral Rodney Princessa contains Coffey still rum pulled off lower sections of the still resulting in a robust and complex flavor profile. This rum is aged from 5-9 years in Bourbon and Port casks before being blended together by our Master Blender.
