Tasting Notes: Deep mahogany color with honeyed raisins on the nose and a hint of vanilla and tobacco. Sweet with intense brown sugar, cre?me brulee tones balanced by dry toasty oak. Complex finish with good oak integration, caramel, and tropical spice.

st-supery-cabernet-sauvignon-2017.title: St. Supery Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
st-supery-cabernet-sauvignon-2017.bodyHtml:
A deeply concentrated Cabernet Sauvignon with an intense bouquet of black plum, dried fig, black pepper, roasted coffee and notes of anise. A richly textured wine with pleasing round tannins and a freshness on the palate that highlights ripe blueberries, dark cherry, baking spices and caramel notes along the satisfying lengthy finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

A juicy, generous, fluid quality makes this full-bodied wine accessible and easy to sip. Attractive raspberry and red cherry aromas are followed by blackberry, sage and black olive nuances on the palate. Gentle tannins. Drink now or hold.

stags-leap-artemis-cabernet-sauvignon-na.title: Stag's Leap Wine Cellars Artemis Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
stags-leap-artemis-cabernet-sauvignon-na.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Artemis Cabernet Sauvignon offers inviting aromas of boysenberry, plum, currant, chocolate and baking spice. The rich and creamy entrance leads to a fresh and flavorful mid-palate. The wine is full-bodied with rich fruit flavors and integrated tannins that are persistent and plush.

Enjoy this Cabernet Sauvignon with grilled tri-tip, braised short ribs, or pasta with wild mushrooms and prosciutto.

93 Points - James Suckling

This supple but structured wine is sourced from various parts of the valley, yet still has the gentle power of the Stags Leap District. Suave oak spices, rich dark fruit and a full body give a generous, broad feel that is nicely freshened by fine-grained tannins.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Generous flavors of boysenberry, plum, spiced cocoa and vanilla bean are carried on a structure of succulent tannins and persistent, mouthwatering acidity that invites another sip. This wine includes hints of Cabernet Franc, Malbec and Merlot to enhance aromatic freshness.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Delivers a lovely burst of boysenberry and mulberry puree flavors that glide through, marrying well with judicious accents of glossy toast, anise, sweet tobacco and apple wood through the finish. Drink now through 2036.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The only one of these releases to contain purchased fruit, the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Artemis draws from such diverse sources as Atlas Peak, Calistoga, Coombsville, Saint Helena and Wooden Valley. It's rather fresh and primary, with almost grapey notes, black cherries and cassis. In the mouth, it's full-bodied and plush, with a soft, velvety finish.

strathcona-spirits-gin-1.title: Strathcona Spirits Badlands Seaberry Gin
strathcona-spirits-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Strathcona Spirits Badland Seaberry Gin is distilled in Edmonton in the traditional London dry style from 10 botanicals. Part of the juniper is wild-foraged in the fossil-filled Badlands along the Red Deer River, and the sour, bitter and tangy native seaberry, picked around the City of Edmonton, balances the other botanicals. Bottled at 44% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: In a gin and tonic, a Martini, or a seaberry lime rickey.

tenshen-red-blend.title: Tenshen Red 2018 750ml
tenshen-red-blend.bodyHtml: The Tenshen Red 2018 is a Rhône-style red blend from California's Central Coast, known for its rich, complex flavors. It features a combination of dark cherry, white pepper, and spring floral aromas, complemented by dense blackberry flavors, sweet tannins, and a juicy finish. This blend typically includes grapes like Syrah, Grenache, Mourvèdre, Petite Sirah, and Merlot, offering a sophisticated and well-rounded wine.

the-dalmore-12-year-old.title: The Dalmore 12 Year Old
the-dalmore-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore 12 Year Old is a benchmark Highland single malt Scotch whisky recognized for its rich, complex, and deeply sherried character. The spirit is masterfully guided through an intricate maturation process overseen by the distillery's legendary blenders; it is aged for its first nine years in American white oak ex-bourbon barrels before being split. Half remains in the bourbon casks, while the other half is transferred to premium rare 30-year-old Matusalem Oloroso sherry butts for the final three years, creating a beautifully balanced whisky that drinks well beyond its age.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate, sticky toffee pudding, roasted almonds, or a fine maduro cigar.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany amber in appearance with a rich, smooth, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Citrus fruits, chocolate, orange marmalade, sweet spices, and rich malt.

Palate : Citrus, Seville oranges, dried fruit, dark chocolate, vanilla, and hints of cinnamon.

Finish : Medium to long with lingering roasted coffee, dark chocolate, and warm oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of water, or over a large ice cube.

the-dalmore-15-year-old.title: The Dalmore 15 Year Old
the-dalmore-15-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore 15 Year Old is a magnificent Highland single malt that showcases the distillery’s mastery of sherry cask finishing. Initially aged for 12 years in American white oak ex-bourbon barrels, the whisky is then divided equally and finished for a further three years in three distinct 30-year-old Amoroso, Apostoles, and Matusalem Oloroso sherry butts from the historic Gonzalez Byass bodega. These casks are then married back together in an upright sherry cask to create a harmonized, rich, and regal expression. The result is an exceptionally opulent, smooth, and aromatic whisky packed with sweet baking spices, rich orange marmalade, and dark chocolate.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate desserts, venison stew with berry reduction, fruit cake, roasted chestnuts, and mature cheeses like Stilton or aged Gouda.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber and shimmering mahogany in appearance, delivering a smooth, velvety, and luxuriously coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic and indulgent, leading with prominent aromas of orange marmalade, cinnamon, and nutmeg, followed by sweet ginger, dried fruit, and a subtle hint of rich espresso.

Palate : Rich, sweet, and full-bodied. A delightful rush of mandarin orange, crushed apples, and dark chocolate leads the palate, layered with warm spices like cloves and cinnamon, alongside notes of toasted oak and sweet vanilla.

Finish : Long, warming, and deeply satisfying, leaving a lingering impression of caramelized citrus, sweet baking spices, dark cocoa, and lingering oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or snifter to fully appreciate its complex aromatics, or add a few drops of room-temperature water to open up the citrus and spice layers.

the-macallan-m.title: The Macallan M
the-macallan-m.bodyHtml:
M is the iconic result of an unprecedented collaboration between three masters of their crafts who shared the same unique objective - to create the world's most sophisticated whisky contained in an exquisite, exclusively designed crystal decanter. A masterpiece of design, M is brought to conception by creative director and legendary designer Fabien Baron, brought to life by Lalique mastery of crystal and brought to purpose by The Macallan.

A single malt of exquisite complexity and character. Part of The Macallan Decanter Series created to showcase the beautiful range of The Macallan’s natural color, M is born of a collaboration between three masters of their crafts to create a completely individual spirit.

Fashioned in the highest grade crystal, each hand crafted M decanter unites proven tradition with originality, drawing on over 150 years of Lalique mastery and dedication in its refinement and flawless clarity. Its six striking facets are Baron’s homage to The Macallan’s Six Pillars; reflecting our deep rooted heritage at the heart of the decanter's unique design ethos and the vibrant natural colour of the whisky itself. Drawing on some of the richest and rarest casks maturing at the distillery, this is a complex and intense whisky. With a rich rosewood colour derived from the sherry seasoned Spanish oak casks that have nurtured this special whisky through its maturation process, M delivers a complexity and sumptuous intensity rarely experienced in a single malt.

the-macallan-m-black.title: The Macallan M
the-macallan-m-black.bodyHtml:
M is the iconic result of an unprecedented collaboration between three masters of their crafts who shared the same unique objective - to create the world's most sophisticated whisky contained in an exquisite, exclusively designed crystal decanter. A masterpiece of design, M is brought to conception by creative director and legendary designer Fabien Baron, brought to life by Lalique mastery of crystal and brought to purpose by The Macallan.

A single malt of exquisite complexity and character. Part of The Macallan Decanter Series created to showcase the beautiful range of The Macallan’s natural color, M is born of a collaboration between three masters of their crafts to create a completely individual spirit.

Fashioned in the highest grade crystal, each hand crafted M decanter unites proven tradition with originality, drawing on over 150 years of Lalique mastery and dedication in its refinement and flawless clarity. Its six striking facets are Baron’s homage to The Macallan’s Six Pillars; reflecting our deep rooted heritage at the heart of the decanter's unique design ethos and the vibrant natural colour of the whisky itself. Drawing on some of the richest and rarest casks maturing at the distillery, this is a complex and intense whisky. With a rich rosewood colour derived from the sherry seasoned Spanish oak casks that have nurtured this special whisky through its maturation process, M delivers a complexity and sumptuous intensity rarely experienced in a single malt.

the-macallan-no-6.title: The Macallan 18 Year Old Double Cask
the-macallan-no-6.bodyHtml:
The Macallan Double Cask 18 Years Old, a perfectly balanced single malt whisky matured for 18 years in both American and European sherry seasoned oak casks. Sherry seasoned American oak adds delicate vanilla to the subtle spice of European oak, delivering a whisky with a sweeter, warmer taste and character.

Two oaks, creating the perfect harmony within one exceptional single malt whisky. Our Double Cask whiskies are aged in two types of oak, in specially selected hand-crafted casks seasoned with dry Oloroso sherry. American oak imparts delicate flavours of vanilla, citrus and butterscotch. European oak delivers the unmistakable subtle spice of The Macallan. Once matured, two exceptional whiskies unite to create a distinctive single malt with a sweeter, warmer taste and character. Enjoy it neat, over ice or in a serve.

the-macallan-rare-cask-2020-release.title: The Macallan Rare Cask 2023 Release
the-macallan-rare-cask-2020-release.bodyHtml:
Rare Cask is crafted from the finest and rarest sherry seasoned oak casks, unearthed by The Macallan Whisky Mastery Team using their knowledge, skill, passion, and creativity in their quest to seek out the extraordinary.

This single malt whisky reveals the remarkable art and science of the Whisky Maker in selecting unique oak casks that exhibit a distinctive and complex flavour profile. They were curated for maturation by The Macallan Master of Wood and delivered to the exacting specifications of The Macallan Whisky Mastery Team to create Rare Cask. This luxurious expression highlights the magic and science in The Macallan’s intricate whisky making process, as the whisky maker identifies the exceptional oak casks which impart the intense and highly complex flavour profile.

Soft aromas of vanilla with rich raisin lead the journey of discovery into this single malt whisky, followed by a sweet fusion of fresh apple, lemon and orange. Intense sweet raisin flavours dominate the palate, before giving way to vanilla and dark chocolate, with layers of light citrus zest. The finish is long, rich and velvety to offer a decadent whisky experience that will leave a lasting impression.

the-macallan-reflexion.title: The Macallan A Night on Earth - The First Light
the-macallan-reflexion.bodyHtml: A limited edition single malt whisky matured in a harmonious combination of sherry seasoned European and American oak casks, with sparing inclusion of casks that previously held Bourbon. A Night on Earth - The First Light is a radiant tribute to the feeling of joy, renewal and shared beginnings at the very first light of the new year.

the-singleton-glen-ord-18-year-old-55-00.title: The Singleton Of Glen Ord 18 Year Old
the-singleton-glen-ord-18-year-old-55-00.bodyHtml: Part of Diageo’s 2019 Special Releases, this limited edition Speyside single malt was distilled at the Glen Ord distillery and matured in recharred American oak hogsheads for 18 years before bottling at a natural cask strength of 55% abv. Available in limited quantities worldwide.

the-singleton-of-dufftown-12-year-old.title: The Singleton of Dufftown 12 Year Old
the-singleton-of-dufftown-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Singleton of Dufftown 12 Year Old is a classic Speyside single malt Scotch whisky distilled at the Dufftown Distillery in Banffshire, Scotland. Matured for 12 years in a mix of European and American oak casks, it delivers a smooth, well-balanced profile renowned for its sweet fruitiness, toasted nuts, and soft warm finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted nuts, dark chocolate, apple strudel, manchego cheese, duck breast, and shellfish.

Tasting Notes - A deep gold, polished mahogany single malt with a smooth, medium body.

Nose - Rich and approachable, featuring toasted hazelnuts, polished wood, stewed apples, dried dates, brown sugar, and subtle hints of liquorice.

Palate - Smooth and fruity with notes of crunchy nuts, blackcurrant, brown sugar, espresso coffee, and subtle oak spice.

Finish - Medium to long, elegantly drying and crisp with a lingering, sweetly nutty warmth.

Serve - Serve neat, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or mixed in a highball with apple juice or ginger ale.

tierra-noble-anejo.title: Tierra Noble Anejo Tequila
tierra-noble-anejo.bodyHtml:
The aging years give our Añejo an elegant and refined personality that becomes a wide bouquet of notes and tastes typical of the careful assembly of American and French white oak woods.

VIEW
Intense amber color with shades of old gold, perfectly clean with a strong grip to the cup, resulting in a great body.

NOSE
Rich and complex; nice notes of wood, dehydrated fruits, vanilla and a light touch of chocolate.

PALATE
Superbly structured; creamy balance, silky, sweet and with subtle touches of dry fruit.

tierra-noble-blanco.title: Tierra Noble Blanco Tequila
tierra-noble-blanco.bodyHtml:
he perfect manifestation of the 7,200 concept where agaves of the two main producing regions converge; “Valley of Tequila” with its aromatic complexity and “Los Altos de Jalisco” that bring sweet and floral notes, making this the most noble of all.

VIEW
Bright crystalline with silver iridescence; with a high grip in the cup, showing great body.

NOSE
Well defined; Strong presence of cooked Agave, herbal, mint and citrus notes, with a slight flash of anise.

PALATE
Soft and fresh of increasing intensity; notes of raw agave, a long finish, rich and balanced.

tierra-noble-extra-anejo.title: Tierra Noble Exquisito Extra Añejo Tequila
tierra-noble-extra-anejo.bodyHtml:
The emblem of the house is born from the tradition that our tequila teachers have of selecting year after year from among hundreds of Tierra Noble barrels only those that have developed the most subtle and elegant notes to celebrate the end of each season.

Over time the exquisite blend of these extra-añejo aging up to 85 months would become what is today the Selection of the Founder.

VIEW
Intense dark amber color, clean and bright with reddish sparkles, great grip in the glass forming tears and legs of great body.

NOSE
Very pleasant and soft on the nose with fruity and sweet aromas; notes of cooked agave honeys, vanilla, prune, chocolate, toasted almonds, apricot and tobacco in a perfect balance with woody notes.

PALATE
Soft on the palate, balanced and complex, with bitter chocolate flavors, nuts and red fruits, a light to tobacco and spices; of great persistence on the palate.

NOTES
Surprisingly elegant, harmonious and balanced, additional definitely the best expression of the Noble Earth house.

tignanello-2017.title: Marchesi Antinori Tignanello 2023
tignanello-2017.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Tignanello 2023 is a legendary, groundbreaking Super Tuscan produced from the estate's historic single vineyard in the heart of Chianti Classico. Aged in French and Hungarian oak barrels, it displays expressive aromas of dark cherry, ripe pomegranate, dried violets, and blood orange, complemented by accents of cocoa, pencil lead, cedar, and fresh balsamic herbs. The palate is precise, energetic, and mouth-filling, offering fine-grained, silky tannins and vibrant acidity that lead to a long, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roast leg of lamb, braised short ribs, wild boar ragù, and long-aged Pecorino cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

Dark and profound wine of great precision, vibrant cassis, graphite and cedar wood, very balsamic with eucalyptus and camphor. Full-bodied with weight and substance on the mid-palate. It shows an elegant attack with velvety tannins, refreshing acidity and long graphite depth. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Cherry, black currant, violet, mineral, vanilla and toasty oak aromas and flavors are the hallmarks of this polished, complex red. Shows terrific balance and intensity, while a cascade of fruit and spices infuses the aftertaste. Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2028 through 2047.

togouchi-kiwami.title: Togouchi Kiwami Blended Japanese Whisky
togouchi-kiwami.bodyHtml:
Togouchi Kiwami, which is the latest Chugoku Jozo release, is a limited edition exclusively reserved for the French market. This new blended whisky reveals its Scottish origins while claiming a strong Japanese character. Kiwami version is made from a selection of the best casks entering Togouchi Premium vatting mix. As its name suggests, Kiwami meaning "Height" in Japanese, this Togouchi will show you the excellence by being the equivalent in the world of wine of a "Prestige" vintage.

With its nose both bright and elegant revealing fresh notes of grass and nuts, this blended whisky will lead you in the mouth in a gourmet trip with hazelnut, chocolate and honey aromas, ending on subtle spicy notes of pepper and nutmeg.

Togouchi whiskies specificity is to be aged, blended and diluted in Japan. Scotch whisky barrels aging is held in a unique location : a 361 meters long tunnel dug in 1970 that offers ideal maturation conditions (constant temperature of 14°C and 80% humidity). Part of their Japanese character is transmitted by the soil through the source of water used for reducing the alcohol content which is drawn from the heart of Sandankyo Nature Park unspoilt mountains.

tomatin-12-year-old-french-oak.title: Tomatin 12 Year Old French Oak 46% ABV
tomatin-12-year-old-french-oak.bodyHtml:
This North America exclusive bottling of Tomatin 12 year old was matured in ex Bourbon Hogsheads for the first 9 years and finished in French Oak casks for the final 3 years. The casks were specially sourced from various European cooperages, including Lafite, Vicard and Seguin Moreau, and originally contained red wine from the Bacalhoa winery which was formerly owned by Rothschild.

The casks have been de-charred and re-charred to give a sweet and creamy flavour, like virgin oak casks.

Nose
Malty biscuits, vanilla, coconut. Red fruits, white peach and cashew nuts with fresh rocket. Candy sweets, toffee and butterscotch come through as it warms.

Mouth
Delicious sweetness, candy and marzipan, cheesecake base peppered with cloves.

Finish
Light and creamy.

tomatin-21-year-old-bourbon-cask.title: Tomatin 12 Year Old
tomatin-21-year-old-bourbon-cask.bodyHtml:
The Tomatin 12 Year Old is classically smooth, having been matured in traditional Scotch Whisky, ex-Bourbon and ex-Spanish Sherry casks. Aromas of wild heather, pine and cedar soon sweeten to reveal notes of crème caramel with apples, pears and mango before a full bodied and buttery finish.

Cask Type: Matured in a combination of Bourbon barrels and Sherry casks
Strength: 43% alc./vol.

AWARD MEDALS

DOUBLE GOLD 2019 San Francisco WSC
GOLD 2018 San Francisco WSC
GOLD 2017 San Francisco WSC
DOUBLE GOLD 2016 San Francisco WSC
GOLD 2015 San Francisco WSC
SILVER 2015 IWSC
GOLD 2014 San Francisco WSC
SILVER 2014 IWSC
BEST HIGHLAND MALT 2013 WWA

tomatin-cu-bocan-1.title: Tomatin Cu Bocan 46% ABV
tomatin-cu-bocan-1.bodyHtml:
Tomatin Cù Bòcan is the lightly peated Highland single malt from the Tomatin distillery, named after a ghost dog said to haunt the village of Tomatin. It is distilled every winter in limited batches from lightly peated Scottish barley, giving a signature wisp of smoke. Bottled at 46% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

torres-10-year-old-brandy-1.title: Torres 10 Year Old Gran Reserva Imperial Brandy
torres-10-year-old-brandy-1.bodyHtml:
Torres 10 Gran Reserva Imperial Brandy is the best-known brandy from the Torres family of Penedès in Catalonia, described by its producer as the most recognised Spanish brandy in the world. It is aged in American oak barrels using the traditional solera method, which gives it a dark topaz colour with glints of gold. The aroma is intense, with warm hints of cinnamon and vanilla, and the finish is full and persistent with aromatic oak notes. This listing is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Beyond sipping, the producer also suggests it as a long drink mixed with cola.

Nose: Intense, with warm hints of cinnamon and vanilla.

Palate: Round and rich in tannins.

Finish: Full and persistent, with aromatic oak notes.

Serve: Neat in a snifter, over ice, or lengthened with cola.

trivento-reserve-malbec.title: Trivento Reserve Malbec
trivento-reserve-malbec.bodyHtml:
Trivento Reserve Malbec is a highly popular, vibrant, and incredibly approachable expression of Argentina's signature red grape. Sourced from premium high-altitude vineyards located in Mendoza's renowned Luján de Cuyo and Uco Valley subregions, this wine captures the outstanding natural climate of the Andes foothills. To achieve its layered profile, 20% of the wine is matured in a combination of French and American oak barrels for six months, while the remaining portion is kept in stainless steel tanks to safeguard the grape's pure, bright fruit character. In the glass, it displays an intense crimson-red color with bright violet undertones. The nose is highly inviting, offering rich aromas of ripe plums, dark cherries, and raspberries, beautifully complemented by delicate notes of fresh violet, sweet spices, and a whisper of toasted vanilla from the oak. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and remarkably balanced, showing a velvety texture, sweet and well-integrated tannins, and a fresh line of acidity that leads into a smooth, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri sauce, roasted lamb chops, rich beef empanadas, or a selection of aged Gouda and sharp cheddar.

truly-berry-variety-pack-12-cans.title: Truly Berry Variety Pack 12 Cans 12 Cans

unshackled-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.title: Unshackled Cabernet Sauvignon by The Prisoner 2023
unshackled-cabernet-sauvignon-2019.bodyHtml:
Unshackled Cabernet Sauvignon by The Prisoner 2023 is a bold, modern, and delightfully unconventional red wine focused on capturing intense fruit vibrancy and immediate accessibility. It displays a deep purple hue in the glass, opening with an aromatic bouquet of dark plum, ripe blackberry, and cassis, seamlessly accented by subtle undertones of black tea, olive, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, delivering rich layers of black stone fruits seamlessly integrated with hints of mocha, dried herbs, and toasted oak shavings. The soft, well-rounded tannins and moderate acidity provide a smooth, approachable texture that coats the mouth completely and drives into a long, satisfyingly plush finish. This expressive blend benefits from grapes sourced across premium vineyards, ensuring a consistently rich flavor profile year after year. The meticulous fermentation process ensures that the wine retains its youthfully expressive and fruit-forward nature without becoming overly aggressive. It represents a highly versatile and reliable crowd-pleaser that delivers a bold, uncompromised California taste experience.

Food Pairing: This bold and smooth Cabernet Sauvignon pairs excellently with charcoal-grilled beef burgers, braised short ribs, gourmet wood-fired meat pizzas, or rich dark chocolate desserts.

waterford-ballymorgan-1-2.title: Waterford Single Farm Origin Ballymorgan Edition 1.2 Irish Single Malt Whisky
waterford-ballymorgan-1-2.bodyHtml:
Distilled in 2016 and bottled in 2020, this 4 year old Irish single malt whisky was bottled at 50% after maturing in a typical Waterford mix of casks: 34% First Fill ex-Bourbon, 20% Virgin American Oak, 23% ex-Wine French Oak and 23% Vin Doux Naturel. The barley for the whisky was grown by Robert Milne in County Wexford. Produced from Overture barley, and fermented with Mauri Distiller's Yeast for 136 hours.

Producer Tasting Note

Nose: Dried herbs, malt, red apple, plums, milk chocolate, vanilla, fennel seeds and custard.

Taste: Apple crumble with toffee, milk chocolate, slight fudge, cloves, a green apple collated in caramel, with pepper heat and aniseed.

Finish: Lingering spice heat with a mouth-watering oiliness that turns mouth puckering.

whitley-neill-lemongrass-ginger-gin-1.title: Whitley Neill Lemongrass & Ginger Gin
whitley-neill-lemongrass-ginger-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Whitley Neill Lemongrass & Ginger Gin is a flavoured gin from the Whitley Neill range of English gins, pairing the citrus lift of lemongrass with the warmth of ginger. Bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: With tonic or ginger ale and a twist of lime.

whitley-neill-raspberry-gin-1.title: Whitley Neill Raspberry Gin
whitley-neill-raspberry-gin-1.bodyHtml:
Whitley Neill Raspberry Gin is a flavoured gin from Whitley Neill, bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The producer says it was inspired by childhood memories of picking wild raspberries in Scotland. Its botanicals are juniper berries, coriander seed, cassia bark, orris root, angelica root, liquorice root, sweet orange, lemon peel and raspberry. On the palate an initial, distinct juniper, coriander and liquorice character gives way to bright, fresh Scottish raspberry, with a delicate sweetness and a lasting citrus and raspberry finish. Whitley Neill suggests serving it with tonic or in contemporary cocktails, and lists silver medals for the gin at the 2021 IWSC, the 2022 London Spirits Competition and the 2022 World Spirits Award.

Tasting Notes: Juniper-led gin with bright raspberry and a delicate sweetness.

Palate: Juniper, coriander and liquorice, then fresh Scottish raspberry.

Finish: Lasting citrus and raspberry.

Serve: Serve with tonic over ice, or use in gin cocktails.

wild-turkey-russells-reserve-10-year-old.title: Russell's Reserve 10 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
wild-turkey-russells-reserve-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Russell's Reserve 10 Year Old is a classic Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey hand-selected by legendary Master Distillers Jimmy and Eddie Russell. Matured for a minimum of 10 years in No. 4 "alligator" charred American white oak barrels, it exemplifies the signature rich, spicy, and deep oak-driven character of Wild Turkey. Bottled at a approachable 90 proof, this small-batch bourbon offers a perfectly balanced combination of sweet caramel, vanilla, rich oak, and gentle rye spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked pork ribs, grilled ribeye steak, sharp cheddar cheese, pecan pie, dark chocolate desserts, and glazed ham.

Tasting Notes : Rich copper amber in color with a medium-to-full body and a warm, smooth, velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich caramel, sweet vanilla, toasted oak, dried fruit, baking spices, and a touch of orange peel.

Palate : Smooth and complex on the palate with flavors of sweet butterscotch, toasted oak, rye spice, dark cherry, and subtle dark chocolate.

Finish : Long, warm, and dry with lingering notes of sweet oak, spice, and soft vanilla.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic bourbon cocktails like an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

wisers-23-year-old.title: J.P. Wiser's 23 Year Old
wisers-23-year-old.bodyHtml: LIMIT OF 1 PER CUSTOMER. NO FURTHER DISCOUNTS APPLY.

wisers-old-fashioned.title: J.P. Wiser's Old Fashioned Whisky Cocktail
wisers-old-fashioned.bodyHtml:
A ready-to-serve cocktail crafted with quality whisky, orange essence and natural flavour to bring the experience of the classic whisky cocktail from behind the bar to more convenient occasions. Simply pour J.P. Wiser’s® Old Fashioned Whisky Cocktail over ice and garnish with a twist of orange (garnish is optional).

Pour over ice, Stir, Add an orange peel (optional)

wisers-special-blend.title: J.P. Wiser's Special Blend 1.14L
wisers-special-blend.bodyHtml:
J.P. Wiser's Special Blend is an easygoing Canadian whisky crafted in Windsor, Ontario, offered here in a 1.14L bottle. Medium amber in the glass, it opens with gentle vanilla and fresh-cut wood, then settles into subtle sweetness and mellow oak with a hint of spice before a clean, compact finish. Smooth and versatile at 40% ABV, it is at home over ice or mixed tall with ginger ale or your favourite soda, and the larger bottle keeps an everyday whisky on hand for gatherings.

Nose: Fresh wood with hints of spice and vanilla.

Palate: Subtle sweetness with mild, mellow oak.

Finish: Clean and compact.

Serve: On the rocks or mixed with ginger ale or soda.

frescobaldi-remole-sangiovese-igt.title: Frescobaldi Remole Toscana Rosso 2021
frescobaldi-remole-sangiovese-igt.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Rèmole Toscana Rosso has a purple-red color. The nose reveals delightful notes of red and black berries, such as currants, raspberry and blueberry, as well as a delicate hint of strawberry-tree fruit. These are followed by spiced notes, including black pepper. It is pleasant on the palate with a nice persistence and a taste and smell that correspond well. The softness rounds it off seamlessly.

A delightful wine, perfect with mildly spiced cured meats and full-flavored pasta dishes.

southern-comfort-whiskey-liqueur-2.title: Southern Comfort Original Whiskey Liqueur
southern-comfort-whiskey-liqueur-2.bodyHtml:
Southern Comfort Original is the whiskey liqueur created by M.W. Heron in New Orleans in 1874. The Canadian bottling is produced in Quebec for Sazerac and bottled at 35% ABV; this is the 750ml bottle. Deep amber in colour, it balances sweetness and spice, with ripe apricot, peach, cinnamon and vanilla leading into a sweet, luscious palate and a long, warm finish. Smooth and easygoing, it is equally at home over ice or as the base for classic mixed drinks.

Nose: Ripe apricot, peach, cinnamon and vanilla.

Palate: Sweet and luscious with spice.

Finish: Long and warm.

Serve: Over ice, with cola, or with orange juice and lemon.

frescobaldi-nipozzano-chianti-riserva.title: Frescobaldi Nipozzano Chianti Rufina Riserva 2022
frescobaldi-nipozzano-chianti-riserva.bodyHtml:
Frescobaldi Nipozzano Chianti Rufina Riserva 2022 is a brilliant, structured, and historic expression of Tuscan winemaking stemming from the rocky, well-ventilated hills of the Castello di Nipozzano estate northeast of Florence. In the glass, it radiates an intense ruby-red color with bright purple reflections. The nose is highly aromatic and complex, opening with vibrant layers of dark cherries, wild blackberries, and plum fruit, seamlessly interwoven with delicate floral notes of violet and rose, sweet hints of cotton candy, and an elegant undercurrent of cloves, rosemary, and sandalwood. On the palate, this medium-bodied red shows exceptional balance and tension. It frames its juicy core of red and black fruits with a dense, silky-smooth tannic texture and a beautifully crisp vein of natural acidity that lends great brightness. Having been meticulously aged for 24 months in seasoned French oak barriques, it glides across the tongue into a remarkably persistent, dry, and mineral-tinged finish filled with lingering echoes of warm baking spices and earthy undertones.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with grilled rosemary lamb chops, traditional Tuscan wild boar stews, slow-cooked beef roasts, or matured pecorino cheeses.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackberries, dark cherries, cloves, sandalwood and rosemary. Medium-bodied with very fine tannins and crispness giving it tension and brightness. Sangivoese with touches of malvasia and merlot. A sure bet for Tuscan red, with lower alcohol. Drink now.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Dark cherry, plum, earth and tobacco flavors are enmeshed in the lush texture of this broad red. There are solid tannins and bright acidity for support as this fades on the lingering finish. Drink now through 2030.

bulleit-bourbon-4.title: Bulleit Bourbon 375ml
bulleit-bourbon-4.bodyHtml:
Bulleit Bourbon is a highly popular, frontier-inspired Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey renowned for its distinctive high-rye mashbill and bold, spicy character. Originally revived in 1987 by Tom Bulleit, it follows a multi-generational family recipe that uses a high proportion of rye alongside corn and malted barley. The whiskey is aged for a minimum of six years in charred American white oak barrels, which softens the intense rye spice and imparts classic oak sweetness. This aging process creates a clean, robust, and highly versatile bourbon that has become a staple in bars worldwide for both sipping and premium cocktail creation.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with slow-cooked barbecue pulled pork, glazed pecan pie, smoked beef brisket, or sharp cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Medium amber in appearance with a rich, smooth, and satiny mouthfeel.

Nose : Gentle spiciness, sweet oak, vanilla, honey, and subtle hints of baked apple and clove.

Palate : Sweet entry with vanilla and caramel, transitioning into maple, toasted oak, nutmeg, and a signature peppery warmth from the high rye content.

Finish : Long, dry, and satiny with lingering light toffee, cinnamon, and warm spicy oak.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a classic base for cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

marchesi-barolo-barbera-paiagal.title: Marchesi Di Barolo Peiragal Barbera d'Alba Superiore 2023
marchesi-barolo-barbera-paiagal.bodyHtml:
The Marchesi di Barolo Peiragal Barbera d'Alba Superiore 2023 is an elegant, structured, and vibrant Old World red wine that beautifully exemplifies the depth of estate-grown fruit from compact limestone-clay formations. It pours a dense purple-red color with bright violet reflections, lifting with an immediate, refreshing bouquet of morello cherries, wild berries, and graphite, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of vanilla bean, incense, toasted hazelnut, and milk chocolate. On the palate, this full-bodied red wine is remarkably smooth, focused, and persistent, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of blackcurrant and wild berries that balance the naturally crisp, integrated acidity of the 2023 vintage. Aged for one year in a combination of French oak barriques and large Slavonian oak barrels followed by resting in cement vats, it shows a lightly toasted boisé complexity supported by robust yet sweet, enveloping tannins that carry into a long, crisp, and focused finish.
Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with casual or traditional Langhe fare, including vitello tonnato, hearty pasta dishes with meat ragù, wood-fired mushroom pizzas, vegetable flans, traditional thick minestrone soup, slow-roasted or boiled meats, and medium-ripened toma cheeses.
93 Points - James Suckling
A spicy yet typical barbera with aromas of graphite, milk chocolate, restrained red cherries and touches of flowers and incense. Light- to medium-bodied, toasted and focused, with long, crisp, integrated acidity and silky tannins. Drink now.

truchard-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Truchard Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
truchard-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Cabernet Sauvignon is planted in several different sites on steep, southwestern facing hillsides. The vines range from 20-42 years old. Luscious aromas of raspberry, plum and cassis fill your senses with a touch of cedar and vanilla. Layers of ripe cherries, red currants and berry jam provide a rich mouth feel. Ripe tannins focus the palate and provide a lengthy finish of spice and deep red fruit.

faiveley-corton-charlemagne-2018.title: Domaine Faiveley Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 2021
faiveley-corton-charlemagne-2018.bodyHtml: The nose reveals oaky, fruity and floral notes. The palate is concentrated and well-balanced with excellent aromatic persistence. The rich aromas make this Grand Cru enjoyable in its youth although it only develops its full character after a few years of bottle age. An exceptional wine with depth and minerality.

stroh-jagertree.title: STROH Jagertree
stroh-jagertree.bodyHtml: Like STROH Inländer Rum, STROH Jagertee is an Austrian spirit with a geographically protected trademark. Based on an old family recipe from 1864, Jagertee is still made with STROH Inländer Rum, black tea extracts and carefully selected essences. It is refined with a hint of orange and lemon aromas as well as vanilla, cinnamon and cloves. The award-winning STROH Jagertee is the “aromatic” expression of true Austrian lifestyle and very convenient: with one bottle of STROH Jagertee (0.5 liters), you can prepare approximately 2.5 liters of ready-to-drink Jagertee, which is equivalent to approximately 10 cups.

bertani-amarone-valpolicella-classico.title: Bertani Amarone Classico 2016
bertani-amarone-valpolicella-classico.bodyHtml:
Bertani Amarone Classico 2016 (Amarone della Valpolicella Classico) is a monumental, deeply complex, and world-class Italian red wine that represents the pinnacle of traditional, uncompromising winemaking in the Veneto. Crafted from a meticulous hand-harvested blend of Corvina and Rondinella grown on the historic limestone-marl slopes of the Tenuta Novare estate, the grapes are dried on bamboo racks for over 120 days via the ancestral appassimento method. After slow fermentation, this flagship cuvée undergoes a staggering seven years of aging in large Slavonian oak barrels. It pours a dark, intense ruby color, unfurling an extraordinary, multi-layered bouquet of prunes, sweet tobacco, and dried black cherries, interwoven with notes of cocoa powder, truffles, wood smoke, and wild lavender. On the palate, this full-bodied masterpiece delivers remarkable transparency and old-school elegance. A dense, silken wave of plush black plums and dark chocolate is effortlessly enlivened by a tight-knit, unexpectedly zesty acidity, while opulent, velvety tannins frame a beautifully savory finish accented by balsamic spice, rhubarb, and roasted nuts.

Food Pairing: This powerful and meditative red pairs magnificently with slow-cooked wild boar ragù, braised beef cheeks, roasted venison with a berry reduction, truffle-infused dishes, or mature, pungent cheeses like aged Parmigiano-Reggiano, Pecorino, and Gorgonzola.

97 Points - James Suckling

A vivid ruby color with a garnet tinge and super-restrained nose of licorice, oak bark, smoke, wood, cigar box, leather, dark chocolate, smashed violets and prunes. It has a fresh subtleness. Full-bodied and elegant on the palate due to ripe, filigreed tannins with long acidity and a toasty, savory aftertaste. One of the greatest Amarone. Corvina and Rondinella.

tecate.title: Catena Alta Historic Rows Malbec 2022
tecate.bodyHtml:
Catena Alta Historic Rows Malbec 2022 is an iconic, richly layered, and structured Argentine red wine crafted by Bodega Catena Zapata from an assemblage of historic vineyard rows across Mendoza. Sourced from high-altitude estate parcels in Luján de Cuyo (Angélica and La Pirámide) and the Uco Valley (Nicasia, Adrianna, and Angélica Sur) sitting between 920 and 1,450 meters above sea level, the hand-harvested whole berries are fermented individually with wild yeasts in small-format bins and barrels before aging for 12 to 18 months in French oak barrels (first, second, and third use). In the glass, it displays a deep, saturated violet-purple hue. The aromatic bouquet opens with expressive notes of ripe cassis, blackberry, and fresh plum layered with violets, lavender, black pepper, and subtle hints of vanilla and leather. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, silky mouthfeel framed by lively natural acidity and fine-grained, plush tannins, culminating in a long, sapid, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled beef tenderloin, herb-roasted rack of lamb, braised duck breast, wild venison stew, or aged sharp cheddar cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

Racy berries, cherries and touches of white pepper and tamarind. Very juicy and fluid, with fine-grained tannins and a mouthwatering finish. Long, succulent and very poised. Drink or hold.

annex-xpa.title: Forward Progress Pale Ale 473 Ml Can

offley-vintage-porto-2018.title: Offley Vintage Porto 2018 750ml
offley-vintage-porto-2018.bodyHtml: Offley Vintage Port 2018 comes from one of the historic Port houses now owned by Sogrape. Sogrape's head winemaker Luís Sottomayor declared 2018 as a Vintage Port year for Offley, Sandeman and Ferreira, calling it one of the best, if not the best, vintages he had seen. A dry, cold winter and a wet spring cut yields, and a long, steady ripening through a hot, dry summer produced concentrated grapes that combine elegance with unusual structure and great ageing potential. Offley's 2018 shows the house's famously lighter style, expressive and fruit-forward, making it a fine introduction to Vintage Port. 20% ABV, 750 ml.

yellowstone-select-46-50.title: Yellowstone Select Kentucky Straight Bourbon
yellowstone-select-46-50.bodyHtml:
Yellowstone Select Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a masterful blend of four-year-old and seven-year-old select Kentucky straight bourbons, crafted to honor a distilling legacy that dates back to 1872. This smooth, expressive whiskey features a delicate amber color and opens with a nose of spicy rye, crisp leather, and soft cherries. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance of rich caramel, vanilla, and toasted oak, followed by a satisfyingly clean finish with notes of brown sugar and smoky autumn wood.

Food Pairing: This versatile, rye-forward bourbon pairs brilliantly with classic American barbecue dishes, such as smoked beef brisket or sticky glazed pork ribs. It also complements sharp cheeses like a mature white cheddar, and for a sweet pairing, it elevates desserts like a traditional pecan pie or spiced apple crisp.

eternally-silenced-pinot-noir.title: Meiomi Pinot Noir 2022/2023
eternally-silenced-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Meiomi Pinot Noir 2023 is a deeply concentrated, intensely jammy, and unapologetically bold California red wine that breaks away from traditional delicate profiles in favor of pure, opulent fruit power. It floods the glass with a dark ruby-crimson hue, giving off an expressive and rich bouquet of macerated boysenberries, dark cherry cola, and strawberry jam, heavily layered with fragrant notes of sweet vanilla bean, mocha, and toasted graham cracker. On the palate, it behaves with a velvety, full-bodied weight, coating the mouth with plush, sweet-toned intensities of dark bramble fruits, mocha powder, and a soft, supple texture that defines this intensely warm and ripe 2023 vintage. Devoid of any aggressive tannins and structured with gentle, low acidity, it glides effortlessly into a smooth, decadent finish that leaves a long, lingering signature of brown sugar and sweet oak spice.

Food Pairing: This rich, fruit-forward style pairs excellently with smoky or slightly sweet savory dishes, including slow-cooked barbecued pulled pork sliders, wood-fired Peking duck pizzas, teriyaki-glazed salmon, gourmet lamb burgers with goat cheese, and standard charcuterie boards stacked with mild gouda or cured meats.

roserock-pinot-noir.title: Roserock Pinot Noir 2024
roserock-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Roserock Pinot Noir 2024 is an elegant, terroir-driven red wine crafted by the Drouhin family from their estate vineyard situated at the southern tip of the Eola-Amity Hills. Sourced from vines rooted in shallow, ancient volcanic basalt soils and shaped by the cooling winds of the Van Duzer Corridor, it displays a luminous, translucent ruby core. The bouquet is perfumed and refined, offering aromas of fresh red raspberries, wild strawberries, pomegranate, and dark cherries intricately layered with notes of crushed violets, dried rose petals, subtle baking spices, and a distinctive stony volcanic minerality. On the palate, it delivers medium-bodied tension and poise, featuring bright natural acidity and silky, fine-grained tannins that glide into a graceful, vibrant, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pan-roasted duck breast with cherry reduction, cedar-plank grilled wild salmon, roasted quail, mushroom risotto, and creamy cow's milk cheeses.

95 Points - James Suckling

Wonderful aromas of lavender, roses and pure red fruit. The palate is silky and elegant, with mineral tension and flavors of pomegranates and wild berries. Fine tannins, tea and hibiscus in the long, floral finish. Medium-bodied. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Graceful yet dynamic, with multilayered raspberry and blueberry flavors framed by fresh violet, orange peel and cinnamon as this builds richness and tension toward refined tannins. Drink now through 2035. 22,500 cases made.

ravenswood-lodi-zinfandel.title: Cline Lodi Old Vine Zinfandel 2021
ravenswood-lodi-zinfandel.bodyHtml:
Lodi is one of the world's legendary growing areas for Zinfandel. This Old Vine Zin has a wide array of strawberry and plum aromas followed by black cherry and vanilla flavors with a smooth finish.

88 Points - Wine Spectator

A juicy quaff, with easygoing cherry and toasty spice flavors that finish on a snappy accent. Drink now through 2030.

the-est-part-time-model.title: The Est Part Time Model 4 Tall Cans
the-est-part-time-model.bodyHtml: The Est Part Time Model 4 Tall Cans

the-est-more-than-rain.title: The Est More Than Rain 4 Tall Cans
the-est-more-than-rain.bodyHtml: The Est More Than Rain 4 Tall Cans

the-est-brighten-the-corners.title: The Est Brighten The Corners 4 Tall Cans
the-est-brighten-the-corners.bodyHtml: The Est Brighten The Corners 4 Tall Cans

ch-fuisse-pouilly-fuisse-le-clos-monopol.title: Chateau Fuisse Pouilly-Fuisse Le Clos Monopole 2023
ch-fuisse-pouilly-fuisse-le-clos-monopol.bodyHtml:
Château Fuissé Pouilly-Fuissé Le Clos Monopole 2023 is a benchmark, highly complex, and opulent Premier Cru white Burgundy produced by the Vincent family at Château Fuissé. Sourced from an exclusive 2.7-hectare walled vineyard (monopole) surrounding the château—boasting vines ranging from 40 to 90 years old—this wine displays a brilliant pale yellow-gold hue. Vinified and aged in French oak barrels (80% new), the nose reveals intense aromas of white peach, citrus blossom, toasted brioche, and crushed limestone, alongside subtle notes of fresh butter and sweet spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, concentrated, and rich, balancing powerful orchard fruit with vibrant acidity, marly soil complexity, and a long, saline-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with butter-poached lobster, pan-seared sea scallops, roasted Bresse poultry, turbot in cream sauce, veal sweetbreads, and aged goat cheese.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Marked by vanilla and toasted brioche notes, this white evokes lemon, apple and seashore flavors. Well-defined by vivid acidity, yet with plenty of flesh for balance. Refreshing finish. Drink now through 2030.

tomintoul-peaty-single-malt-speyside.title: Tomintoul Peated
tomintoul-peaty-single-malt-speyside.bodyHtml: Unlike other Tomintoul expressions, Tomintoul Peated has been distilled using peated malted barley to impart a distinctive smoky flavour. Matured in the finest American oak ex-bourbon barrels, Tomintoul Peated retains the core approachable, sweet and fruity characteristics associated with Tomintoul Single Malts but with the addition of a subtle campfire smoke.

grey-goose-la-poire-pear-vodka.title: Grey Goose La Poire Vodka
grey-goose-la-poire-pear-vodka.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose La Poire Vodka is an exceptionally elegant, smooth, and vibrant premium flavored spirit that seamlessly captures the fresh, juicy essence of the classic Anjou pear. Conceived by the Maître de Chai to reflect the rich flavors found in classic French pastries like tarte aux poires, it infuses the world-renowned smoothness of original wheat-based Grey Goose with essential oils of real fruit. It pours perfectly crystal clear in the glass, lifting with a fragrant, fruity bouquet of sliced green apples and earthy pear skin, delicately layered with aromatic notes of wildflower and fresh honeysuckle. On the palate, this medium-bodied spirit is crisp, light, and naturally sweet, coating the mouth with the generous, velvety taste of fresh orchard fruit and a touch of brightening citrus zest. Balanced by a refined alcohol warmth, it transitions into a broad, round finish that leaves a long, clean pear impression accented by a subtle hint of nuttiness or bitter almond.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fine desserts like a warm pear tart, vanilla bean panna cotta, or white chocolate mousse, as well as light savory dishes like brie or goat cheese crostini with honey, fresh fruit platters, and smoked salmon canapés.

catoctin-creek-roundstone-rye-80-proof.title: Catoctin Creek Roundstone Rye 80 Proof
catoctin-creek-roundstone-rye-80-proof.bodyHtml:
Roundstone Rye® is a very unique rye whisky, made completely from scratch at our distillery in Purcellville, Virginia.  This pre-Prohibition style rye whisky is made from 100% rye grain, sourced locally when available.  It is mashed, fermented, distilled and aged completely in our distillery, before bottling it at a very sippable 80 proof.  Aged in new charred white oak casks for a period of around two years, the whisky is smooth, woody, with that full-bodied fruity-nutty grain flavor typical of a Virginia rye whisky. Roundstone Rye has a delicious woody taste, with notes of caramel, rich butter toffee, and just a hint of lemon in the nose.

Roundstone Rye is a superb sipping whisky, a great whisky in Manhattans, or your favorite rye whisky cocktails. 

Delicious mixed, on the rocks, or neat.  Try some this evening!

catoctin-creek-roundstone-rye-92-proof.title: Catoctin Creek Roundstone Rye 92 Proof Distiller's Edition
catoctin-creek-roundstone-rye-92-proof.bodyHtml:
Only one in every ten barrels gets selected to be in the Roundstone Rye "92 Proof" whisky.

This whisky is the culmination of several years of planning.  "For a few years now, we've been putting whisky away for storage," remarked Becky Harris, Chief Distiller and President of Catoctin Creek Distilling Company.  "We pulled some of the more interesting barrels from the back of the warehouse and decided to release these at a higher proof:  a whisky specially curated for flavor, while still being remarkably smooth, as is our existing 80 proof Roundstone."

"We are very excited about this new product," said Scott Harris, Founder and General Manager of Catoctin Creek.  "We discussed this new product with customers like Jack Rose Whisky Saloon, The Passenger, and our distributors, and all agreed that this would be a great new product for the distillery.  And what's cool, since we're a small distillery, we can be responsive to this kind of market input."

sleeman-clear-4.title: Sleeman Clear 2.0 24 Cans
sleeman-clear-4.bodyHtml: Sleeman Clear 2.0 is the ultimate light lager for those who refuse to compromise on flavor or their fitness goals. With only 80 calories and 2g of carbs per serving, this 24-can pack offers a crisp, refreshing experience that is perfectly balanced and easy to enjoy. Its light-bodied profile and clean, citrusy finish make it a favorite for backyard gatherings, post-workout relaxation, or sunny days on the patio. Proudly brewed with Sleeman's signature quality, it’s the clear choice for a refreshing, guilt-free beer that keeps you at the top of your game.

jadot-chapelle-chambertin-2016.title: Louis Jadot Chapelle-Chambertin Grand Cru 2019
jadot-chapelle-chambertin-2016.bodyHtml:
This is a wine of delicacy and finesse, with notes of berries, earth and oak in a silken texture. This wine will improve in the bottle for 20 to 25 years.

Pair with sophisticated dishes such as sauced meats, game and strong cheeses such as Reblochon.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
One of the highlights of the range, the 2019 Chapelle-Chambertin Grand Cru (Domaine Louis Jadot) mingles aromas of sweet red berries with hints of raw cocoa, spices, licorice, loamy soil and truffles. Medium to full-bodied, deep and multidimensional, it's velvety and concentrated, with considerable depth and mid-palate amplitude despite its elegant, seamless profile.

nikka-yoichi-single-malt-japanese-whisky.title: Nikka Yoichi Single Malt Japanese Whisky
nikka-yoichi-single-malt-japanese-whisky.bodyHtml:
Nikka Yoichi Single Malt Japanese Whisky is the flagship single malt from Nikka's first distillery, built in 1934 by Masataka Taketsuru on the northern island of Hokkaido. Distilled using traditional direct coal-fired pot stills, this whisky is celebrated for its bold, rich, and gently peaty character, which is beautifully balanced by maritime influences from the nearby Ishikari Bay.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, grilled scallops, roasted root vegetables, charcuterie, dark chocolate, or mature aged cheddar.

Tasting Notes: Rich golden amber in appearance with a full-bodied, robust, and slightly oily mouthfeel.

Nose: Gentle peat smoke, fresh maritime sea breeze, candied citrus peel, melon, subtle vanilla, and a touch of roasted nuts.

Palate: Bold and well-rounded, delivering flavors of sweet barley malt, baked apple, gentle coal smoke, subtle sea salt, toasted oak, and a hint of dark chocolate.

Finish: Long, warming, and complex with lingering maritime peat smoke, sweet oak spice, and crisp orchard fruit.

Serve: Serve neat, with a few drops of water to open up the aromas, or over a large ice cube in a rocks glass.

le-g-de-chateau-guiraud-boreaux-blanc.title: Chateau Guiraud Le G De Guiraud Bordeaux Blanc Sec 2020 750ml
le-g-de-chateau-guiraud-boreaux-blanc.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "Apricots, almonds, flowers, and a dab of honey create the perfume. The palate is even better with its layers of lusciously-textured, oranges, candied lemon, and notes of white peach that show up in the vibrant, creamy finish. This is the debut of this new wine from Guiraud which is the brainchild of Sandrine Garbay. The wine truly tastes exactly like what you want from a dry Sauternes. Drink from 2023-2035." - Jeff Leve, The Wine Cellar Insider

lake-sonoma-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2021
lake-sonoma-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
A compilation of ripe, red and blue fruit ignites the senses with slight undertones of forest rain. Soft and smooth on the palate with pure electric dark berry flavors and deep, unified tannins add volume to a refined finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of umami, seaweed, mushroom and bark follow through to a medium body, with firm and fine velvety tannins and a flavorful finish with a salty undertone at the end. Oyster shell. Drink now.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast was matured in 39% new oak for 15 months. The nose opens slowly from allspice and brown sugar to a core of red cherry and cranberry, tea leaves and lavender. The medium-bodied palate offers surprisingly concentrated fruit supported by grainy tannins and seamless freshness, and it has a long, spicy finish.

compass-box-orchard-box.title: Compass Box Orchard House Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
compass-box-orchard-box.bodyHtml:
What is more universally delicious than ripe fruit? Even the greatest chefs have been known to serve a simple dish of strawberries or a single, perfect peach as a dessert.

Orchard House gathers together some of the fruitiest malts Scotland has to offer, including whiskies from the Linkwood and Clynelish distilleries; what’s more, we have sourced many of these whiskies as new spirit and laid them down in our own oak casks. This, our monument to fresh fruitiness in Scotch whisky, has been many years in the making.

When neat or poured over a large ice cube, Orchard House makes for an outstanding pre-dinner malt. It will ably partner amber and pale ales, as well as swathes of soft cheeses. Welcome to our home among the fruit trees – the door is unlocked.

compass-box-canvas.title: Compass Box Canvas Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
compass-box-canvas.bodyHtml:
This is an exceedingly colourful and vibrant Scotch whisky, thanks to a parcel of single malt re-racked into experimental barrels for three years.

Seasoned with Vino Naranja (Spanish fortified wine infused with orange peel), these unusual casks bring new shades of deliciousness to Canvas with their chocolatey richness and sticky marmalade fragrance.

Single malts from the Tomatin, Glenburgie, Glen Elgin and Imperial distilleries, all aged in American oak, bring further generous flavours of custard, honey and frangipane. Rather than restrained watercolours, this is a work in decadent oil paints.

gray-jay-deluxe-canadian-whisky.title: Gray Jay Deluxe Canadian Whisky
gray-jay-deluxe-canadian-whisky.bodyHtml:
Gray Jay Deluxe Canadian Whisky is handcrafted in small batches by a craft distillery in Niagara Falls, Ontario, and made in Canada from Canadian ingredients. It is named after the gray jay, also called the Canada jay, which was voted Canada's national bird in 2016. Built to be easy-drinking for newcomers and experienced whisky drinkers alike, it combines vanilla and caramel with charred oak and spice, leading to a medium-bodied, fruity palate and a long, warm, lightly sweet finish. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is as comfortable neat or on the rocks as it is in cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla and caramel, balanced with charred oak and spice.

Palate: Medium-bodied and fruity.

Finish: Long, warm and lightly sweet.

Serve: Neat, on ice, in a whisky Caesar with Clamato, or with sweet apple cider and a squeeze of fresh lemon.

walker-special-old.title: Walker Special Old
walker-special-old.bodyHtml:
Walker's Special Old is a long-established Canadian whisky in the Hiram Walker family, made since the 1850s and known for a bold, spicy style that appeals to seasoned whisky drinkers and newcomers alike. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Its toasty, spicy character and grain-driven palate make it a versatile, great-value choice for mixed drinks and classic whisky cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Toasty and spicy, with vanilla, caramel and pepper.

Nose: Toast and spice with vanilla, caramel and peppercorn.

Palate: Cereal grains, cinnamon and pepper.

Serve: In cocktails, with ginger ale or cola, or on the rocks.

santa-rita-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Santa Rita 120 Reserva Especial Cabernet Sauvignon
santa-rita-reserva-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Santa Rita 120 Reserva Especial Cabernet Sauvignon is a versatile and accessible Chilean red wine hailing from the Central Valley. On the nose, it delivers ripe aromas of black cherry, plum, and cassis complemented by subtle notes of vanilla, clove, and toasted oak. The palate features a smooth, medium-bodied structure with silky tannins, balanced acidity, and a fruit-forward finish with delicate hints of spice.

Food Pairing: Complements grilled steaks, roasted pork loin, beef empanadas, tomato-based pasta dishes, sausage stews, and medium-aged cheeses like gouda or cheddar.

schmitt-winzertanz.title: Schmitt Winzertanz 750ml
schmitt-winzertanz.bodyHtml: Schmitt Winzertanz is a 750ml German white wine, specifically an off-dry Riesling blend, known for its crisp, clean, and fruit-forward profile with notes of ripe apple, peach, and citrus. It's a popular choice for its affordability and versatility, often recommended as a match for spicy dishes or schnitzel.

ole-smoky-apple-pie-mini-moonshine.title: Ole Smoky Apple Pie Moonshine 50ml
ole-smoky-apple-pie-mini-moonshine.bodyHtml:
The legendary, quintessential American moonshine that put Ole Smoky on the map! Handcrafted in Gatlinburg, Tennessee, this iconic spirit captures the comforting, nostalgic flavors of a fresh-baked apple pie cooling on a Southern windowsill. Ole Smoky starts with their authentic corn whiskey and infuses it with pure apple juice, ground cinnamon, and a proprietary blend of baking spices, creating a deeply flavorful spirit that revolutionized the modern craft moonshine industry.

Bottled at a highly approachable 40 proof (20% ABV), it drinks exactly like a liquid dessert. The palate is rich with flavors of warm baked apples, buttery pie crust, and a soothing wave of sweet cinnamon and nutmeg. It is phenomenal served warm on a chilly autumn evening, chilled straight from the mason jar, or poured over a bowl of vanilla bean ice cream.

banrock-station-shiraz.title: Banrock Station Shiraz 2021 750ml
banrock-station-shiraz.bodyHtml: The Banrock Station Shiraz is a rich, full-bodied red wine featuring intense blackberry and mulberry fruit flavors complemented by coffee and oak aromas with a hint of clove and cinnamon. It's a dry wine with a savory tannin structure and a lingering blackberry finish. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 13%.

alamos-chardonnay.title: Alamos Chardonnay
alamos-chardonnay.bodyHtml: A bright and refreshing high-altitude Chardonnay, the Alamos Chardonnay is crafted to highlight the clean, citrus-driven profile of the Uco Valley. It presents a straw-yellow color with greenish reflections and opens with an aromatic bouquet of crisp green apple, pear, and white peach, layered with subtle notes of tropical fruit and floral honeysuckle. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and well-balanced, showcasing a smooth, slightly creamy texture that is perfectly offset by a vibrant, stony acidity. Subtle hints of vanilla and toasted oak from partial barrel fermentation add depth without overpowering the fruit, leading to a clean, lingering finish with a touch of citrus zest.

skyy-vodka-2.title: Skyy Vodka
skyy-vodka-2.bodyHtml:
Skyy Vodka is a premium American vodka known for its exceptional smoothness and clarity. Developed in San Francisco, it undergoes a proprietary quadruple-distillation and triple-filtration process using 100% pure American grain and filtered water. This creates a clean, crisp, and incredibly versatile spirit that serves as the perfect canvas for a wide array of cocktails or as a chilled, standalone drink.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked salmon canapés, fresh oysters, caviar, cured meats, and light Mediterranean appetizers like olive tapenade and feta cheese.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear in appearance with a light, silky body and a remarkably clean, neutral profile on the palate.

NOSE Extremely clean and subtle with faint traces of sweet grain and a touch of mineral freshness.

FINISH Short, crisp, and bright with a very smooth, warming touch and absolutely no harsh bite.

SERVE Best served ice-cold straight from the freezer as a shot, on the rocks, or as the crisp foundation of a classic Vodka Martini or Moscow Mule.

sassicaia-2019.title: Tenuta San Guido Sassicaia 2020 3L Double Magnum
sassicaia-2019.bodyHtml:
The 2020 is a beautiful vintage of Sassicaia that presents itself at a young age with a marked acidity and freshness and beautiful complexity both on the nose and in the mouth. It well identifies the style of elegance typical of Sassicaia in which the structure never dominates the elegance and flavor of the wine. The bouquet is especially intriguing with a very lively plummy fruit element that is enhanced by baker's chocolate, pepper spice, iron ore, caramel, and pie crust. The tannins, although noble and silky, require a longer period of maturation in glass compared to other previous years, but already at a young age the wine presents itself with a beautiful freshness and very harmonious.

97 Points - Decanter

Frosts damaged the the earlier-developing Cabernet Franc in late March, leading to reduced production but superb quality fruit. Spring was mild and summer was generally warm, but a rapid acceleration of maturation in late summer forced the team to begin picking in the first week of September to avoid any overripeness. A traditional 85% Cabernet Sauvignon and 15% Cabernet Franc blend, its blackcurranty, dusty, leafy and cedary character is brought into focus by an intense and balsamic palate. It's poised and light on its feet with super-fresh acidity and a fine-grained, almost imperceptible tannic structure. Ripe and tangy raspberry and blueberry fruits linger on the mid-palate, leading to a long, fresh finish with some cream and chocolate notes. This will reward cellaring into the 2050s, yet you'll get plenty of pleasure from it in its youth. 'We advise to keep it at least 10 months in the bottle before opening,' states third-generation Priscilla Incisa della Rocchetta.

97 Points - James Suckling

A very perfumed Sassicaia on the nose with forest floor, citrus and deep dark fruits. Blackcurrants. Cedar and black tea. Some balsamic. Pine needles. Full and very succulent. Really long, structured and complete. Tangy and energetic with a linear line of fresh tannins and acidity. Very Sassicaia throughout. 85% cabernet sauvignon and the rest is cabernet franc. Very attractive now in a youthful and vibrant way, but this will be better in three to four years. Try after 2027.

97 Points - Vinous

The 2020 Sassicaia is a bold, rapturous wine. Dark, fleshy and expansive on the palate, the 2020 offers up scents of blackberry jam, gravel, spice, new leather, licorice and crème de cassis. Potent tannins are nearly buried by the sheer intensity of the fruit. Sassicaia is never a huge wine, the 2020 does seem to have an extra dimension of textural intensity. It's an intensity that is hugely appealing.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Complex aromas and flavors of black currant, blackberry, iron, sweet tobacco and Mediterranean herbs are the hallmarks of this elegant, tensile red, which is already revealing plenty, yet still feels reserved, as though there were many more facets to be discovered. Superb harmony, freshness and a long aftertaste prevail. Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The Tenuta San Guido 2020 Bolgheri Sassicaia speaks to those who seek a more voluptuous, opulent and, ultimately, more accessible wine. This vintage is a precise reflection of Coastal Tuscany, as opposed to a more generic "Tuscan" wine from elsewhere in this large central Italian region. You taste the ripeness and soft fruit weight that comes from a coastal appellation with especially bright luminosity and warm Mediterranean offshore breezes. Sassicaia from the cool vintages is a famously reticent or withholding wine in its earliest years, requiring a long lead time before it eases into an ideal drinking window. That's definitely not the case here. This wine is beautiful and compelling straight out of the gate, showing a lovely mix of dark fruit, oak spice, balanced freshness, textural richness, soft tannins and an expertly contained 14% alcohol content. The wine's immediate character is what distinguishes this vintage, and I wouldn't get too fussed by exaggerated cellar-aging ambitions. The wine awards sheer pleasure in its current form, with dazzling primary fruit and soaring intensity over the near and medium term.

woodbridge-merlot.title: Woodbridge Merlot 750ml
woodbridge-merlot.bodyHtml: Our Merlot displays rich aromas of cherry, chocolate, and red berries with enticing flavors of cherry cola and toasty mocha oak. This full-bodied wine possesses well-balanced acidity and beautifully integrated tannins, creating complexity and structure. Its soft, versatile style complements grilled meats, especially steak, lamb, pork chops, and hamburgers. Enjoy this savory wine with hearty pasta with Bolognese sauce.

sour-puss-sour-apple.title: Sour Puss Sour Apple
sour-puss-sour-apple.bodyHtml:
Sour Puss Sour Apple is the brand's signature neon-green sweet-and-sour liqueur from Phillips Distilling of Minnesota. It is built around a bold sour Granny Smith apple flavour, softened by a hint of cotton candy. This 375ml bottle is bottled at 15% ABV, a handy size for parties and for mixing a round of apple shooters or cocktails.

Palate: Sour Granny Smith apple with hints of cotton candy.

Serve: Chilled as a shooter, or shaken into a Sour Apple Martini.

copper-moon-pinot-grigio-2.title: Copper Moon Pinot Grigio 1.5L Magnum
copper-moon-pinot-grigio-2.bodyHtml:
An easy-drinking, light-bodied, and delightfully crisp white wine, this Pinot Grigio captures a vibrant and highly approachable style. The nose opens with refreshing aromas of bright citrus zest, juicy green apple, and ripe pear, accented by a delicate touch of summer florals. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, clean texture filled with refreshing flavors of honeydew melon, white peach, and soft lemon drop. Fermented cool in stainless steel to maximize its fruit expression, it maintains an energetic acidity that finishes clean and dry, making it a perfect everyday refresher.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh garden salads, pan-seared halibut, light seafood appetizers, grilled chicken skewers, and mild vegetable stir-fries.

wine-oclock-shiraz.title: Yalumba Barossa Shiraz 2023
wine-oclock-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Crafted in the world-renowned Barossa Valley of South Australia, this classic Shiraz showcases generous aromas of dark plum, wild blackberry, sweet spice, and subtle oak. Medium-to-full-bodied and smoothly textured, it delivers a rich, fruit-driven palate framed by velvety tannins and a long, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with grilled ribeye steak, slow-cooked beef brisket, roasted lamb shoulder, or aged cheddar.

 

 

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Fragrant and stylish, with ripe blueberry and blackberry flavors at the core, complemented by notes of dried violet and Earl Grey tea, with a hint of lavender. The tannins are polished and elegant, and this shows wonderful freshness, with a touch of French press coffee alongside notes of dried sage and bay leaf. Drink now through 2038. 18,000 cases made, 1,800 cases imported.

90 Points - James Suckling

This meaty and juicy red has aromas of currants, cracked pepper, iron and smoked meat. It’s full-bodied with good freshness and smooth, ripe tannins. Drink now. Screw cap.

peller-estates-dry-white.title: Peller Family Vineyards Dry White 750ml
peller-estates-dry-white.bodyHtml: Pale yellow straw; grapefruit, yellow melon and floral aromas; extra dry with soft round fruit flavours and light tropical fruit notes; easy drinking wine.

evolution-white.title: Sokol Blosser Evolution Lucky No. 9 White Blend 750ml
evolution-white.bodyHtml:
Aromatic wine with heaps of citrus notes like lychee and lime zest, hints of tropical fruit and just a touch melon. Bright acidity lingers on the finish to balance with residual sugar.

Pair with anything with a kick. Thai curry, tandoori chicken, spicy tuna rolls, chili lime peanuts, you name it!

j-bouchon-assemblage-premium.title: J. Bouchon Mingre Premium Assemblage
j-bouchon-assemblage-premium.bodyHtml:
J. Bouchon Mingre Premium Assemblage is a distinguished, full-bodied Chilean red wine blend produced by J. Bouchon from dry-farmed, old vines growing in granitic soils at the Mingre estate in the Maule Valley. Crafted predominantly from Carménère, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, and Carignan, this complex assemblage undergoes extended aging in French oak barrels to harmonize its rich fruit and structured frame. In the glass, it displays a deep ruby color with expressive aromas of blackberry, cassis, dried tobacco leaves, dark chocolate, and subtle toasted spices. On the palate, it is opulent and well-balanced, featuring juicy dark fruit flavors, soft, velvety tannins, and a long, persistent, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with slow-cooked beef brisket, roasted lamb leg, wild boar ragù, grilled ribeye steak, and mature hard cheeses.

prop-reserve-pinot-grigio.title: Prop Reserve Pinot Grigio 1.5L Magnum
prop-reserve-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: The Prop Reserve Pinot Grigio 1.5L Magnum is a white wine made from Pinot Grigio grapes. It is known for its light-to-medium body and crisp, refreshing flavors, often featuring notes of citrus, green apple, and pear. It's a versatile wine that can be enjoyed on its own or paired with a variety of foods, including salads, seafood, and poultry.

villa-maria-cellar-sauvignon-blanc.title: Villa Maria Cellar Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
villa-maria-cellar-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2022 vintage) "A vibrant and distinctive bouquet, classic with fresh white fleshed fruits, citrus and herbaceous drive. Aromas of peaches and gooseberry, green apple and grapefruits flesh. A layer of wet stone minerality adds depth and complexity. Crisp, dry, fruity, salivating, saline and dry on the palate. Flavours reflect the bouquet with a vibrant, tasty finish. Best drinking from 2022 through 2025." - 92/100, Cameron Douglas MS

little-penguin-pinot-noir.title: Little Penguin Pinot Noir 750ml
little-penguin-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: The Little Penguin Pinot Noir 750ml is a smooth, fruity red wine with aromas of strawberries and tart cherries, along with pleasant earth undertones. It has a light to medium body with a well-balanced acidity and gentle tannins. The wine pairs well with various dishes like roasted chicken, mushroom risotto, and pizza.

menage-a-trois-white.title: Menage A Trois White 750ml
menage-a-trois-white.bodyHtml: Menage a Trois White is a California white wine blend, typically 750ml in size, made with Chardonnay, Muscat, and Chenin Blanc grapes. It's known for its refreshing, fruity profile with notes of citrus, tropical fruits, and a smooth finish. The blend combines the rich, firm character of Chardonnay with the wild, exotic flavor of Muscat and the soft, supportive qualities of Chenin Blanc.

rutherford-ranch-chardonnay-napa-valley.title: Duckhorn Napa Valley Chardonnay 2024
rutherford-ranch-chardonnay-napa-valley.bodyHtml:
Duckhorn Napa Valley Chardonnay 2024 pours a brilliant, shimmering yellow color into the glass. Crafted in celebration of Duckhorn Vineyards' 50th anniversary milestone, the highly expressive bouquet opens with captivating aromas of caramelized pineapple, ripe orchard pear, white stone fruits, and a delicate whisper of mango crème brûlée. Secondary nuances of lemon confit, salted nuts, wet stones, and a touch of warm baking spice add sophisticated layering. On the palate, this mid-weighted Californian white wine delivers a rounded, generous, and beautifully texturized mouthfeel. Its core of tropical and orchard fruit is masterfully balanced by a bright, vibrant line of natural acidity that imparts excellent tension and life. Nuanced notes of key lime pie, delicate white florals, and refined minerality extend effortlessly through to a polished, remarkably clean, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with butter-poached lobster, pan-roasted chicken with lemon and thyme, creamy Dungeness crab risotto, or a decadent wild mushroom tart.

93 Points - James Suckling

A well-balanced, generous chardonnay with aromas of lemon confit, salted nuts, wet stones and spices. The palate is mid-weighted with bright acidity and a textural, rounded mouthfeel. Drink now. Screw cap.

91 Points- Wine Spectator

Strikes a vivid balance between its juicy fruit flavors of lemon curd, tangerine and ripe melon and its touch of chewy dried apricot, plus toasty, spicy nuances. Salted butterscotch, black cardamom and gingersnap notes linger on the harmonious and creamy finish. Drink now through 2036.

crema-giandoia-dark-chocolate-grappa.title: Bottega Gianduia Fondente Crema di Cioccolato Gianduia 500ml
crema-giandoia-dark-chocolate-grappa.bodyHtml:
Bottega Gianduia Fondente Crema di Cioccolato Gianduia 500ml is a luxurious, intensely rich Italian cream liqueur that elevates the classic chocolate-and-hazelnut pairing with a sophisticated dark chocolate profile. Handcrafted by the historic, family-owned Bottega SpA distillery in the Veneto region, this premium expression serves as a darker, bolder interpretation of traditional Piedmontese gianduia. It is expertly prepared by blending a fragrant, expertly roasted hazelnut paste with select, high-quality dark cocoa. Formulated specifically to be completely vegan, dairy-free, and lactose-free, its velvety texture relies entirely on the natural oils of the nuts and rich cocoa fats. A signature touch of artisanal Venetian grappa is added to the base, providing an elegant structural contrast and a refined depth that masterfully cuts through the decadent sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with butter cookies and shortbread biscuits for dipping, dark chocolate mousse, fresh raspberries, or poured directly over rich cream-flavored gelatos.

TASTING NOTES - A deep, dark brown color with beautiful reddish highlights, displaying a highly viscous, thick, and velvety body that luxuriously coats the tongue.

NOSE - A complex and highly aromatic bouquet driven by prominent aromas of expertly toasted hazelnuts and rich dark chocolate, subtly layered with delicate floral undertones and hints of exotic fruit.

PALATE - Soft, velvety, and deeply seductive on the tongue, delivering a powerful, balanced explosion of bittersweet dark cocoa and sweet hazelnut paste, supported by a clean, subtle warmth from the grappa.

FINISH - Long and highly persistent, leaving a clean, comforting trail of premium dark chocolate flavor, roasted nuts, and a gentle, satisfying warmth.

SERVE - Best served thoroughly chilled or ice-cold at a refreshing 3°C (37°F) in a small tumbler or dessert glass as an elegant after-dinner digestif, or utilized as a premium ingredient in decadent dessert cocktails.

mudshake-creamy-vanilla.title: Mudshake Creamy Vanilla 4x270ml Bottles
mudshake-creamy-vanilla.bodyHtml: Dense and delightfully sweet, creamy vanilla flavours with a hint of caramel combined with triple-distilled vodka

mission-hill-reserve-riesling-icewine-1.title: Mission Hill Family Estate Reserve Rose
mission-hill-reserve-riesling-icewine-1.bodyHtml:
Crisp and vibrant, with fresh strawberry, raspberry, watermelon, citrus, and delicate floral notes. The palate is dry and refreshing, showing juicy red fruit, bright acidity, elegant texture, and a clean, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with seafood, salmon, fresh salads, poultry, charcuterie, grilled vegetables, soft cheeses, or light Mediterranean dishes.
