el-dorado-spiced.title: El Dorado 12 Year Old Rum
el-dorado-spiced.bodyHtml:
El Dorado 12 Year Old Rum is a premium Demerara rum produced in Guyana by Demerara Distillers Limited at the Diamond Distillery. Crafted from a blend of distillates produced in historic wooden pot and column stills—including the Enmore wooden Coffey still—it is aged for a minimum of 12 years in ex-bourbon oak casks, resulting in a rich, full-bodied spirit renowned for its complex notes of tropical fruit, dark sugar, and baking spices.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate, aged cheeses (such as Gouda or aged cheddar), glazed pork, barbecue ribs, pecan pie, and dried fruits.

Tasting Notes - A deep amber rum with copper highlights and a thick, smooth, full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose - Rich and inviting, featuring aromas of dark sugar, honey, lush tropical fruit, raisins, toasted coconut, and gentle baking spices.

Palate - Smooth, round, and full-flavored with notes of caramel, dark sugar, toffee, dried fruit, baking spice, and subtle oak.

Finish - Elegant, long, and dry with lingering warmth, gentle spice, soft oak, and hints of cocoa.

Serve - Serve neat, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as a spirit base in cocktails like a Rum Old Fashioned or Rum Manhattan.

crystal-head.title: Crystal Head Vodka
crystal-head.bodyHtml:
Crystal Head Vodka is crafted from locally sourced, Canadian corn. It is distilled four times into a neutral grain spirit and blended with pristine water from Newfoundland, Canada. The vodka is filtered seven times, of which three are through layers of semi-precious crystals known as Herkimer diamonds.

Our iconic skull-shaped bottle is produced in Europe, where bits of crystal are melted into the glass to ensure absolute clarity.

Crystal Head Vodka offers a clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose–neutral grain aromas with a delicate touch of citrus. Silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla. Ending with a sweet, creamy finish.

mirassou-pinot-grigio.title: Mirassou Pinot Noir
mirassou-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml: Pinot Noir can be challengingly difficult to grow, but in the hands of the right winemaker it produces some of the world's most sought-after wines. California Pinot Noir tends to be more fruit-forward than its international counterparts. Mirassou Pinot Noir shows toasty oak, vanilla and plum; perfect for roast chicken.

santa-cristina-chianti-superiore.title: Santa Cristina Chianti Superiore 2021 750ml
santa-cristina-chianti-superiore.bodyHtml:
Santa Cristina Chianti Superiore is a red wine from the Chianti region of Tuscany, Italy. It is made by one of the oldest and most respected winemaking families in Italy, Antinori. This wine is made with Sangiovese grapes, which are the classic grapes of this region. The wine has a bright ruby-red color and aromas of ripe dark fruit with hints of spice and vanilla. On the palate, it is full-bodied with good acidity and flavors of cherry, plum, and blackberry with a long finish and soft tannins. This wine is a great choice to pair with grilled meats, pasta, and aged cheeses.

88 Points - Wine Spectator
87 Points - CellarTracker

pinnacle-tropical-punch.title: Truly Punch Mix Pack 12 Cans
pinnacle-tropical-punch.bodyHtml:
The Truly Punch Mixed Pack is a 12-can variety pack of hard seltzers crafted with real fruit juice. It is widely distributed across Canada and features bold fruit flavor combinations. 
The assortment provides three 355 mL cans of each of the following four styles:
  • Fruit Punch: A classic, lively mashup of mixed fruits with a sweet, crisp finish.
  • Berry Punch: A bold blend highlighting ripe strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries.
  • Tropical Punch: A smooth mix featuring tropical notes of pineapple, mango, and passionfruit.
  • Citrus Punch: A bright, zesty combination of lemon, lime, and orange.

argento-malbec.title: Argento Malbec 2018 750ml
argento-malbec.bodyHtml: Bright ruby red colour. Fresh raspberry, cherry, sweet plum compote and milk chocolate aromas with hints of violets and herbs. Dry, medium-bodied, with balanced acidity and silky tannins supporting flavours of ripe black fruits.

dictador-12-year.title: Dictador Solera System 12 Year Old Rum
dictador-12-year.bodyHtml:
Dictador 12 Years Rum is made from the fermentation of virgin sugar cane honey distilled partly in copper alembic and partly in steel continuous column, to achieve a medium body rum.

Aged in pre-used oak barrels and finally bottled under the highest quality control to ensure all the secrets are contained in the liquid flavour.

chivas-regal-12-year-old.title: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old
chivas-regal-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Chivas Regal 12 Year Old is a classic, world-renowned blended Scotch whisky created by the Chivas Brothers in Aberdeen, Scotland. Crafted from a selection of fine malt and grain whiskies—with Strathisla single malt at its heart—this signature expression is aged for a minimum of 12 years. It delivers a smooth, rich, and accessible Speyside-influenced profile known for its balance of orchard fruits, wild herbs, and sweet honey.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork loin, smoked salmon, creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert, apple pie, and shortbread biscuits.

Tasting Notes : Radiant, warm amber color. Smooth, round, and creamy texture with a light-to-medium body.

Nose : An aromatic infusion of wild herbs, heather, honey, and orchard fruits like ripe apples and peaches.

Palate : Rich and fruity with flavors of sweet honey, poached apples, vanilla, butterscotch, and subtle hazelnut notes.

Finish : Smooth and lingering with gentle notes of oak spice, honey, and subtle maltiness.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed into classic cocktail recipes such as a Highball or Rob Roy.

revel-stoke-spiced-whisky.title: Revel Stoke Nut Crusher Peanut Butter Whisky
revel-stoke-spiced-whisky.bodyHtml:
Revel Stoke Nut Crusher is a peanut butter flavoured Canadian whisky, bottled at 35% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It pairs buttery, nutty peanut butter notes with the mild spice of Canadian whisky, and the brand pitches it with a nod to the classic peanut butter and jelly combination. Light in strength and sweet in style, it is made for easy shots and simple mixed drinks rather than serious sipping.

Tasting Notes: Buttery, nutty peanut butter with mild whisky spice.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, over ice, or with a mixer.

legendario-ron-dorado.title: Legendario Ron Dorado
legendario-ron-dorado.bodyHtml:
Legendario Ron Dorado is a golden Cuban rum from the Legendario house, bottled at 38% alcohol by volume in a 700ml bottle. Dorado is the Spanish term for golden, and this lighter-bodied rum sits in the light and gold style of Cuban rum, making it a versatile pick for the home bar.

Serve: Enjoy over ice, with cola, or as the base for classic Cuban cocktails such as a Mojito or Daiquiri.

stolichnaya-ohranj.title: Stoli Ohranj Vodka
stolichnaya-ohranj.bodyHtml: Stoli Ohranj has a light and floral aroma of orange zest and essential oils, the more toppy scents of orange blossom balanced by richer elements of orange liqueur and marmalade. Stoli Ohranj has orange cream on its palate, hints of dark chocolate and more varied flavors of tangerine, mandarin and kumquat, and a lingering fresh zesty note of Lemon.

grand-marnier-cognac-orange-liqueur-1.title: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge 1.14L
grand-marnier-cognac-orange-liqueur-1.bodyHtml: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge is a renowned French orange liqueur created in 1880 by Louis-Alexandre Marnier Lapostolle. Combining fine French Cognac with distilled essence of Caribbean bitter oranges and a touch of sugar, this iconic expression delivers a rich balance of candied orange zest, vanilla, toasted hazelnuts, and toffee. Bottled at 40% ABV, its smooth, full-bodied character makes it ideal for sipping neat, enjoying over ice, or elevating classic cocktails.

moselland-red-cat-qualitatswein.title: Moselland Red Cat Qualitatswein 500ml
moselland-red-cat-qualitatswein.bodyHtml: Light straw in color, it shows aromas of nectarine, peach and citrus. Crisp, refreshing and straight- forward, it pairs well with salads and chicken dishes, or enjoyed on its own as an aperitif. Assorted colors may vary. Please specify desired color.

santa-margherita-chianti-classico-docg.title: Borgo Scopeto Chianti Classico Docg
santa-margherita-chianti-classico-docg.bodyHtml:
A premium and wonderfully elegant Tuscan red wine that beautifully embodies the rich, traditional heritage of the historic Chianti Classico zone. The palate is dry, smooth, and beautifully layered, unfolding with expressive notes of ripe red cherries, wild raspberries, and dark plums, seamlessly integrated with sophisticated undertones of dried earth, fresh violet petals, leather, and a delicate touch of wood spice. It features a medium-bodied texture framed by fine-grained, elegant tannins and a mouthwatering, vibrant vein of typical Sangiovese acidity. The finish is remarkably long, clean, and balanced with an appetizing savory persistence.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with wood-fired margherita pizza, roasted lamb chops, pasta with rich meat ragù, and medium-aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

koloa-dark-rum.title: Royal Jamaican Blackstrap Molasses Dark Rum

troika-vodka.title: Troika Vodka
troika-vodka.bodyHtml:
Troika Vodka is a Canadian vodka produced in Quebec for Diageo. It is an unflavoured vodka bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Chilled, or mixed with soda, tonic or juice.

revolution-white.title: Revolution White 750ml
revolution-white.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: "Lemon oil, floral, almond, grassy, grapefruit rind and matchstick aromas. Fresh, crisp, slightly oily palate with canned grapefruit, light jalapeno, spicy, green apple skin and almond flavours. Tart, simple, white wine. (Anthony Gismondi and Stuart Tobe)." - Gismondi on Wine

bitch-white.title: Bitch White 750ml
bitch-white.bodyHtml: Reminiscent of cantaloupe on the nose, this semi-sweet white, showcases green apple, pear and honey suckle, with a soft vanilla bean flavor that lingers. The name is great and the taste is bursting with crisp flavors!

santa-carolina-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Santa Carolina Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
santa-carolina-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Santa Carolina Cabernet Sauvignon (750ml) is a red wine from Chile, characterized by its deep ruby-red color and a bouquet of dark fruits like blackcurrant and blackberry, with notes of cedar and tobacco. It exhibits full-bodied flavors of black cherry, cassis, and black plum, along with hints of chocolate and espresso, and a long, refined finish with balanced acidity.

casillero-devils-red.title: Casillero del Diablo Devil's Red
casillero-devils-red.bodyHtml:
Casillero del Diablo Devil's Red is a bold, velvety Chilean red blend crafted by Concha y Toro. Displaying an intense, dark purple hue, it opens with rich, inviting aromas of ripe cassis, black cherries, plums, and subtle hints of mocha, vanilla, and toasted oak. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red offers smooth, round dark fruit flavors balanced by soft, silky tannins and a touch of dark chocolate spice on a clean finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled red meats, roasted lamb, hearty beef stews, barbecued pork ribs, and mature hard cheeses.

casillero-del-diablo-devils-white.title: Casillero Del Diablo Devil's White 750ml
casillero-del-diablo-devils-white.bodyHtml: Casillero del Diablo Devil's White is a Chilean white wine, bottled in a 750ml bottle. It's known for its bright, pale yellow color, delicate bubbles, and fresh, fruity aroma.

yellow-tail-sangria.title: Yellow Tail Sangria 750ml
yellow-tail-sangria.bodyHtml:
Style
Inspired by the traditional drink of Spain, [yellow tail] Sangria combines premium red wine with a splash of sweet citrus. A party favourite! 

Aroma
Perfumed aromas with intense mandarin, citrus and orange peel. 

Flavour
Sweet and citrusy, bursting with mandarin and orange flavours with a hint of red fruits.

Enjoy
Enjoy in a jug with lots of ice, diced orange and lemon at a party with friends.

josh-chardonny.title: Josh Cellars Chardonnay 2023
josh-chardonny.bodyHtml:
Josh Cellars Chardonnay 2023 is an incredibly bright, approachable, and beautifully balanced Californian white wine crafted by founder Joseph Carr as an expressive tribute to his father. Sourced from premier vineyard sites across California's top cool-climate growing regions, including parts of the North Coast and Sonoma County, this vintage relies on a distinctive split-fermentation process using both stainless steel tanks and French oak barrels. In the glass, it reveals a luminous, pale straw-yellow hue with youthful greenish highlights. The highly aromatic nose opens with clear, enticing scents of Golden Delicious apple, ripe pear, and yellow plum, seamlessly woven with tropical details of juicy peach, pineapple, and a delicate touch of citrus blossom. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and texturally pleasing, showing an engaging, fruit-driven fluid coherence where its crisp fruit core is beautifully counterbalanced by a refreshing line of citrus acidity and the soft creaminess of malolactic fermentation. Subtle undertones of sweet honey, vanilla bean, and light butterscotch follow on the mid-palate, concluding with a clean, uplifting finish that leaves a delicate kiss of toasted oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with garlic butter shrimp scampi, creamy fettuccine Alfredo, pan-roasted herb chicken, steamed mussels, or mild cheeses like Brie.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine is crisp, with aromas of Golden Delicious apple, yellow plum, Satsuma orange and notes of toasted oak on the nose. The flavors on the palate are peach, pineapple, pink grapefruit and dried herbs, with a dry, long finish.

blazon-pinot-noir.title: Blazon Pinot Noir 750ml
blazon-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Blazon Pinot Noir is a medium-bodied red wine with a flavor profile of black cherry and currant, complemented by a hint of spice. It is known for its balanced palate and aromatic notes. The wine is typically produced in California, utilizing grapes from various Central Coast vineyards. The 2020 vintage is described as having notes of rich raspberry and cherry cola, framed by anise and clove, with vanilla and soft tannins.

river-retreat-chardonnay.title: Trentham Estate River Retreat 2018 Chardonnay 750ml
river-retreat-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Trentham Estate River Retreat Chardonnay 2018 is a white wine from the Murray Darling region, in the Big Rivers zone of New South Wales, Australia, bottled at 13% ABV. Trentham Estate created the River Retreat range to raise awareness of the fragile wetlands of the Murray Darling Basin, with proceeds from every bottle going to the Murray Darling Wetlands Working Group, and the label carries the line "Supporting our Natural Wetlands". This 2018 Chardonnay is light straw in colour, with enticing stone fruit and melon on the nose and palate, and a soft, fresh texture with good balance and length. Serve chilled with chicken, seafood or creamy pasta. A 750ml bottle.

jagermeister-spice.title: Jagermeister Herbal Liqueur 1L
jagermeister-spice.bodyHtml:
Jägermeister is the original German herbal liqueur, made from a secret recipe of 56 herbs, roots and spices and matured for a long time in oak barrels. It is the origin and inspiration of the whole Jägermeister family, and every later creation is built on its secret recipe; the brand puts only natural ingredients in the bottle. This 1 litre bottle is at 35% ABV, a practical size for parties and a well-stocked home bar.

Serve: Ice cold, as a shot.

artuke-pies-negros-tempranillo-graciano.title: Artuke Pies Negros Tempranillo Graciano 2018 750ml
artuke-pies-negros-tempranillo-graciano.bodyHtml: Pies Negros is a blend of Tempranillo and 10% Graciano from (mostly) Ábalos and Samaniego. Reflecting the cooler 2018 vintage, it's dense, focused and comparatively restrained, with subtle 15% new wood, racy dark berry fruit and the balance and precision that are typical of the Artuke style. Nuanced and long on the palate. 2023-28 (Tim Atkin MW, 2018 vintage)

hennessy-vs-very-special-cognac-3.title: Hennessy VS Cognac
hennessy-vs-very-special-cognac-3.bodyHtml:
Hennessy VS Cognac is a vibrant, iconic French cognac crafted by Jas Hennessy & Co. Assembled from a blend of up to 40 different eaux-de-vie aged for at least two years in French oak casks, it delivers a lively, fruit-forward character balanced by toasted oak and subtle spice.

Food Pairing: Charcuterie boards, braised pork chops, roasted duck, dark chocolate desserts, or rich creamy cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Brilliant amber-copper in appearance with a full, round, and smooth mouthfeel.

Nose : Toasted oak, fresh citrus, vanilla, subtle floral notes, and hints of brown sugar and almond.

Palate : Vibrant and fruit-driven with notes of fresh apple, ripe grape, warm baking spices, vanilla, and roasted nuts.

Finish : Medium-long, warm, and crisp with lingering notes of wood spice, cinnamon, and subtle fruit.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature, on the rocks, or as a foundational spirit for classic cocktails like a Sidecar or Hennessy Ginger.

anthonij-rupert-optima.title: Anthonij Rupert Optima 2022
anthonij-rupert-optima.bodyHtml:
Anthonij Rupert Optima 2022 is an elegant, full-bodied, and harmonious South African red blend crafted in the traditional Bordeaux style by Anthonij Rupert Wyne. Sourced from premium vineyards in Franschhoek and coastal districts, it opens with enticing aromas of dark berries, ripe cassis, dark fruitcake, and warm baking spices, complemented by subtle floral nuances, cracked black pepper, and pencil shavings. The palate is plush, supple, and textured, delivering concentrated flavors of black cherry, plum, and cocoa framed by silky, fine-grained tannins, fresh natural acidity, and well-integrated French oak that lead to a long, poised, and spice-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted leg of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison ragù, duck breast, and aged hard cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Cassis, blackberries, bay leaves and cedarwood, with delicate earthy spice and violets. Refined and layered, with a poised structure, vibrant fruit freshness and fine chalky tannins. Persistent and complex, with a long structured finish. Drink or hold.

elderton-command-shiraz.title: Elderton E Series Shiraz 2023 750ml
elderton-command-shiraz.bodyHtml: The E Series Shiraz / Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic Australian medium bodied blend with notes of raspberry and plum, hints of vanilla toast.

la-spinetta-barbera-d-asti-ca-di-pian.title: La Spinetta Ca' Di Pian Barbera D'Asti 2023
la-spinetta-barbera-d-asti-ca-di-pian.bodyHtml:
La Spinetta Ca' Di Pian Barbera D'Asti 2023 is a remarkably vibrant, expressive, and food-friendly red wine crafted by the visionary Rivetti family. Sourced from mature vines averaging 40 years of age planted in the calcareous marl soils of Castagnole Lanze and Costigliole d'Asti, this wine undergoes fermentation in roto-fermenters before aging for 12 months in a combination of new and used French oak barriques. It pours an intense ruby-red color with purple reflections. On the nose, it offers an alluring bouquet of ripe blackberries, black cherries, and wild plums, beautifully layered with hints of lavender, sweet spices, menthol, and cocoa. The palate is medium-to-full-bodied, showcasing the grape's signature refreshing acidity, silky tannins, and a persistent, savory finish filled with spice and dark fruit character.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-cooked beef stews, roasted duck breast, herb-crusted pork chops, fresh tomato-based pasta dishes, or a selection of aged cheeses.

catena-zapata-adrianna-bacillus-malbec.title: Catena Zapata Adrianna Vineyard Mundus Bacillus Terrae Malbec 2021
catena-zapata-adrianna-bacillus-malbec.bodyHtml:
A monumental and profoundly complex Malbec, the 2021 Mundus Bacillus Terrae originates from a small, high-altitude parcel in the Adrianna Vineyard defined by its limestone-rich soils and beneficial "world of bacteria." This vintage displays an intense violet color and an extraordinary bouquet of crushed blackberries, blueberries, and red currants, seamlessly woven with notes of damp earth, violets, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied yet remarkably weightless and ethereal, showcasing a vertical structure, chalky tannins, and a piercing, stony acidity. This ultra-refined Malbec delivers immense depth and a precision that leads to a persistent, mineral-driven finish, reflecting its unique cool-climate terroir.

99 Points - James Suckling

A complex yet super discreet nose with hints of wet stone, wet earth, peppercorn and graphite to the red and blue fruits. An elegant expression but this has an intense mid-palate with tight but silky tannins. Long, complex and soft-spoken. Nothing conspicuous here. Impeccable interplay between concentration and purity.


98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Adrianna Vineyard Mundus Bacillus Terrae comes from 1.4 hectares within the Adrianna vineyard in Gualtallary, planted in 1992 at 1,390 meters above sea level. It's from a cooler year in Mendoza with some frost that delivered low yields and wines of good concentration and ripeness. It has 13.9% alcohol and notable acidity (7.3 grams of tartaric acid per liter of wine). Seventy-five percent of the volume started fermenting in concrete with 50% full clusters and the rest without stems or skins, only juice, in oak foudres and aged in oak barrels for 15 to 18 months. This is very straight, elegant and balanced, following the path toward elegance that started in 2019. The wine closed down in the glass and slowly unfurled layers of complexity. It's textured, with very fine-grained tannins and great balance, a very subtle note of spices and a very elegant mouthfeel.

decero-mini-ediciones-cabernet-franc.title: Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Mini Ediciones Cabernet Franc 2020
decero-mini-ediciones-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml:
Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Mini Ediciones Cabernet Franc 2020 is an exceptional, limited-edition single-vineyard red wine that highlights the incredible potential of this varietal in high-altitude Argentine terroirs. Sourced from the unique, low-vigor soils of the Remolinos Vineyard in Agrelo, situated over 3,500 feet above sea level, it undergoes pre-fermentation cryo-maceration and unique malolactic fermentation inside 600-liter French oak barrels. In the glass, it reveals a deep ruby color with complex, signature varietal aromas of blueberries, fresh mint, espresso, pine cones, and dark chocolate. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is highly expressive and beautifully framed, balancing its rich, succulent dark fruit and savory herbal complexity with bright acidity and tight-grained, velvety tannins. It offers an incredibly sophisticated and polished Argentine expression of Cabernet Franc that finishes with lasting notes of licorice, thyme, and smoky oak.

Food Pairing: This savory and structured Cabernet Franc pairs beautifully with grilled flank steak, roasted lamb shank with rosemary, wild mushroom risotto, or braised venison.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

It's easy to fall for the savory palate of this Cabernet Franc. There is a delicious mix of thyme, eucalyptus, espresso and licorice, accenting mulberry and blackberry flavors. Lively acidity adds energy throughout the lasting finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Refreshing nose, showing minerals, graphite, herbs, blackberries and blue fruit. A hint of cocoa powder, too. A medium-to full-bodied cabernet franc with juicy berries and creamy, fine-grained tannins. Better from 2024.

canadian-3.title: Canadian Club Premium 1.14L with 50ml Pack
canadian-3.bodyHtml:
A Canadian Club Premium value pack with a total volume of 1.19 L at 40% ABV. Canadian Club Premium is the brand's flagship blended Canadian whisky, made from corn, rye, rye malt and barley malt and aged in white-oak American bourbon barrels for longer than the three years Canadian law requires. The brand describes it as bright gold, with almond and peppery spice on the nose, zesty spice, oak and vanilla on the palate, and a clean, dry finish.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or with soda or ginger ale.

coors-light-4.title: Coors Light 15 Cans
coors-light-4.bodyHtml: Coors Light is a light lager with a crisp, clean, and refreshing taste, packaged in a convenient 15-can carry case. It's brewed with Coors' proprietary yeast and aged slowly for a smooth, easy-drinking experience. The beer features a light body with malt notes and low bitterness, making it a popular choice for various occasions like parties, barbecues, or tailgating. It has a 4.2% ABV and 99 calories per 12-ounce serving, according to Platina Liquor.

ledaig-1995-the-whisky-agency.title: The Whisky Agency x Moonbroch Ledaig 2008 13 Year Old 51.4% ABV
ledaig-1995-the-whisky-agency.bodyHtml: Moonbroch 2008 Ledaig 13 Year Old is a premium Island Single Malt Scotch Whisky from Tobermory/Ledaig Distillery. Distilled in 2008, this whisky has been aged for 13 years in a Hogshead before being bottled in 2021. This aging process has allowed the whisky to develop a complex and rich flavor profile, making it a true connoisseur's choice. Ledaig is known for its unique peated style, which gives this whisky a distinct smoky and earthy character. Whether you're a seasoned whisky drinker or just starting to explore the world of single malts, Moonbroch's 2008 Ledaig 13 Year Old is sure to impress.

banded-peak-ride-on-lager-1.title: Banded Peak Ride On Lager 4 Tall Cans
banded-peak-ride-on-lager-1.bodyHtml: Banded Peak Ride On Lager 4 Tall Cans

sandhill-merlot.title: Sandhill Sandhill Estate Vineyard Merlot 2020
sandhill-merlot.bodyHtml:
Deep ruby in colour, this Okanagan Merlot from Sandhill Estate Vineyard offers ripe plum, dark cherry, and blackberry aromas with hints of cedar, mocha, and subtle earthy notes. The palate is full and structured with velvety tannins, balanced acidity, and a lingering finish of dark fruit and spice.


Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, mushroom risotto, aged cheddar, and hearty pasta dishes with red meat sauces.

buccella-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Buck Shack Bourbon Barrel Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
buccella-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Aging cabernet sauvignon in bourbon barrels highlights the wine's natural ripe fruit flavors, while softening the tannins and creating a well-aged balance. Each sip is enriched with rich hints of bourbon.

whispering-angel-provence-rose-1.title: Caves d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rose 2025
whispering-angel-provence-rose-1.bodyHtml:
Caves d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rosé 2025 is a highly refined and vibrant expression of the world's most famous premium rosé, celebrating its landmark 20th anniversary vintage. Sourced from choice clay and limestone vineyards in the heart of Provence, the hand-harvested grapes undergo meticulous optical sorting and are vinified entirely in temperature-controlled stainless steel to maintain maximum purity. In the glass, it displays a delicate, pale salmon-pink hue. The nose is highly expressive and perfumed, offering elegant aromas of wild strawberries, red cherry pits, and white peach, layered with fresh citrus blossoms and subtle flinty minerals. On the palate, this dry, medium-bodied rosé is incredibly smooth, seamless, and creamy, integrating a juicy core of red berries with a vibrant line of crisp acidity that leads to a clean, remarkably refreshing, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with fresh Mediterranean salads, grilled seafood skewers, classic Niçoise salad, or simply enjoyed chilled as a summer aperitif.

91 Points - James Suckling

An elegant and scented nose of pink cherry pits, peach skin and cherry blossoms. Medium-bodied with fresh, round acidity and a textured finish. Elegant and pure finish. Drink in 2027.

knob-creek-twice-barreled-rye.title: Knob Creek Twice Barreled Rye
knob-creek-twice-barreled-rye.bodyHtml:
Knob Creek Twice Barrelled Rye is a Kentucky straight rye whiskey with a secondary oak finish. It’s full-flavored using only highest-quality rye to create the World’s Best Straight Rye whiskey.

92 Points, Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2019: "Scintillating spice meets deep wood characteristics on the nose, hinting that a remarkable rye awaits in the glass. The palate follows through with full body of roasted nut, brown butter biscuit, and candied maple dusted with clove and cinnamon that carry through the long finish."

scapa-glansa.title: Scapa Glansa
scapa-glansa.bodyHtml:
Scapa Glansa is a single malt Scotch whisky from Scapa, the Orcadian distillery. Its name is Norse for shining, storm-laden skies. Scapa takes its signature smooth, fruity single malt, aged in American oak, and rests it in casks that previously held peated whisky, adding richness and depth and a gentle wisp of smoke. It carries no age statement and is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Glansa scored 93 points at the 2018 Ultimate Spirits Challenge.

Tasting Notes: Heather honey, soft and stone fruits, butterscotch and a subtle smoky finish.

Nose: Stone fruits intertwined with hardwood smoke.

Palate: Soft and smooth, with toasted butterscotch, golden and heather honey and soft fruits.

Finish: A lasting yet balanced note of wood smoke.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

sortilege-prestige-maple-syrup-whisky.title: Sortilège Prestige 7 Year Old Maple Syrup Whisky Liqueur
sortilege-prestige-maple-syrup-whisky.bodyHtml:
Sortilège Prestige is a Quebec liqueur that marries seven-year-old Canadian whisky with pure first-run Quebec maple syrup. The producer selects whisky aged for more than seven years in oak barrels and blends it with maple syrup from the first run of the season, the extra-clear top grade. It is bottled at 40.9% ABV in a 750ml bottle, noticeably stronger than most whisky liqueurs. It is sweet without being cloying, with true maple flavour held in balance by the strength of the whisky. The Sortilège recipe is traced by the brand to the settlers of New France, who began combining their whisky with maple syrup.

Tasting Notes: Maple syrup sweetness balanced by oak-aged Canadian whisky.

Serve: Neat or over ice; the producer also mixes it with brandy and apple juice over ice in its Maple Apple cocktail.

imagery-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Imagery Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
imagery-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Opulent, dark fruit of black cherry with spice, cinnamon and clove on the entry. Smooth integrated oak brings out cola flavors in the mid-palate and a vanilla toast on the finish that enhances the wine's soft balanced texture.

speyside-dist-1995-archives.title: Speyside Distillery 1995 Archives
speyside-dist-1995-archives.bodyHtml:
Speyside Distillery 1995 Archives is a single malt Scotch whisky distilled in 1995 and released under the Archives independent bottling label. It is bottled at 51.4% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat first, then with a few drops of water.

fortaleza-blanco.title: Frontera Sauvignon Blanc
fortaleza-blanco.bodyHtml:
Frontera Sauvignon Blanc is a bright, ultra-crisp, and refreshing Chilean white wine produced by the globally renowned Concha y Toro estate. Sourced from the sun-drenched vineyards of the Central Valley, where cool Pacific breezes help preserve the grapes' natural acidity, this wine is designed for immediate enjoyment and everyday approachability. In the glass, it displays a pale greenish-yellow hue. The lively bouquet opens with vibrant aromas of grapefruit zest, fresh lemon, and green apple, beautifully layered with subtle hints of white peach and delicate wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, zesty, and exceptionally clean, delivering a mouthwatering core of juicy citrus and orchard fruit. A crisp, well-balanced acidity carries this fruit-forward profile through to a refreshing, lightly mineral, and snappy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh shrimp ceviche, light white fish tacos, tangy goat cheese salads, and grilled chicken finished with an herbaceous chimichurri sauce.

canadian-club-ginger-1.title: Canadian Club & Ginger Ale 4 x 355ml
canadian-club-ginger-1.bodyHtml:
Canadian Club & Ginger Ale is a ready-to-drink highball that pairs Canadian Club whisky with ginger ale, sold here as a four-pack of 355ml cans. Canadian Club and ginger ale both date to around the 1850s, which makes this an old pairing. The pre-mix brings together the smooth, honeyed grain and spice of Canadian Club whisky and the sweet, candied character of ginger ale. In the glass it is golden amber with foamy carbonation, subtle ginger and sweet rye on the nose, and preserved ginger, rye and spice on the palate before a ginger-ale-like finish. Each can is 5% ABV. Canadian Club suggests it with saucy barbecued ribs or spicy curries.

Food Pairing: Saucy barbecued ribs or spicy curries.

Tasting Notes: Golden amber with foamy carbonation, well balanced and sweet.

Nose: Subtle ginger and sweet rye, with grain and spicy wood.

Palate: Preserved ginger with subtle rye and spice.

Finish: Sweet, with a ginger ale character.

Serve: Well chilled, straight from the can or over ice with a lime wedge.

royal-lochnagar-12-year-1.title: Royal Lochnagar 12 Year Old
royal-lochnagar-12-year-1.bodyHtml:
Royal Lochnagar 12 Year Old is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky from the Royal Lochnagar distillery at Crathie, near Ballater in Aberdeenshire, bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle. The distillery was established in 1845 beside the Balmoral estate and took its royal title after a visit from Queen Victoria and Prince Albert; it remains one of the smallest distilleries in Scotland. Its malt was once a key component of the VAT 69 blend, although most of the production is now bottled as single malt. The label describes a sweetly perfumed, subtle and woody Highland malt with a lingering sandalwood finish.

Nose: Soft floral heather and light honey with fresh orchard fruit.

Palate: Sweet cereal, caramel and gentle spice with a faint, warming smokiness.

Finish: Medium and delicately drying, with sweet malt and a hint of wood spice.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

mount-peak-gravity-red-blend.title: Mount Peak Gravity Red Blend 2020 750ml
mount-peak-gravity-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Gravity Red Blend is named for a remote, hard-to-reach block on Mount Peak's historic Monte Rosso Vineyard, where Petite Sirah vines cling to a steep slope on the edge of a canyon. The wine opens with aromas of baked blueberry, freshly brewed coffee and dried apricot. The concentrated and multifaceted palate adds notes of acai berry, dark plum, cocoa powder and underpinnings of tar and cracked pepper. Lengthy and well-structured, supported by fine, but firm, tannins.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Here is a testament to good-quality, California-appellated wines. This red blend opens with immediate aromas of fresh violets, plump black cherry, black currant, chocolate, tarragon, fennel and toasted wood. The palate mirrors those aromatics, but they jump with vivacity from the solid dose of acidity and generous alcohol. Firm tannic texture adds structural integrity, leading toward a fairly lengthy finish.
91 Points - Wine Spectator
Ripe and gutsy, with a dense core of tannins framed by blackberry and currant flavors. Reveals espresso, cracked pepper and grilled anise accents that finish with tannic grip. Hands off for now. Petite Sirah, Zinfandel, Syrah, Sangiovese, Viognier, Grenache and Malbec. Best from 2025 through 2031.

lambs-spiced-rum-2.title: Lamb's Spiced Rum
lambs-spiced-rum-2.bodyHtml: The true character of Alfred Lamb is reflected in this bold but smooth vanilla spiced rum. Aroma: Sweet vanilla and Demerara sugar. Taste: Well balanced with sweet vanilla and hints of caramel followed by the unique Lamb's smooth rum character. Finish: Warm, lingering flavour.

fontodi-meriggio-sauvignon-blanc.title: Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2022
fontodi-meriggio-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2022 is a vibrant, gentle, and fruit-forward white wine that beautifully captures the character of its world-renowned terroir. It opens with bright, inviting aromas of citrus blossom, lime zest, and subtle jasmine, perfectly layered with notes of fresh green apple, honeydew melon, and yellow peach. On the palate, this estate-grown wine is medium-to-full-bodied and elegantly balanced, offering a softly rounded texture achieved through partial barrel fermentation. Juicy flavors of candied orange, tropical fruit, and a distinct underlying minerality are lifted by refreshing, mild acidity, leading to a long, crisp, and beautifully harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spring vegetable frittatas, fresh fish tacos, grilled asparagus, zesty citrus ceviche, and vibrant mixed green salads.

91 Points - James Suckling

This is a gentle, fruit-forward, estate-grown wine with fresh citrus flavors and mild acidity. Partially barrel fermented, which gives some richness to the fruit and roundness to the texture. Includes 7% semillon blended in. Full-bodied and well balanced.

tempo-gin-smash-variety-pack-3.title: Tempo Gin Smash Variety Pack 12 Cans

rekorderlig-passionfruit-cider.title: Rekorderlig Passion Fruit 500ml
rekorderlig-passionfruit-cider.bodyHtml: Rekorderlig Passion Fruit Cider is a refreshingly sweet and exotic Swedish cider that blends crisp apple cider with the vibrant, tropical flavor of passion fruit. This lightly sparkling beverage offers a smooth, fruity taste with a well-balanced sweetness, making it a perfect choice for warm weather and casual enjoyment. Its distinctive flavor profile has made it a popular choice among fruit cider enthusiasts.

michael-david-lodi-red.title: Michael David Winery Lodi Red 2021 750ml
michael-david-lodi-red.bodyHtml:
Originally released in 1999 to celebrate Michael and David’s father on his 75th birthday, Lodi Red is back and better than ever! Bottled just before the holidays, this easy sipping red wine is comprised of three of Lodi’s heritage varietals: Petite Sirah, Zinfandel and Carignane.

Embodying Michael David Winery's family spirit and hometown roots, their 2021 Lodi Red is ruby red in color with classic aromas of black cherry, strawberry jam and vanilla in the glass. Full bodied with delicious flavors of dried fig, clove and dark chocolate, this wine is rounded out by an oak-inspired finish that will have you reaching for another sip.
86 Points - Wine Enthusiast 
A straight-forward red blend with simple notes of cranberry, raspberry and strawberry.

syc-brewing-first-timer-ipa.title: Syc Brewing Fjord Neipa 4 Tall Cans

stella-rosa-peach.title: Il Conte Stella Rosa Peach 750ml
stella-rosa-peach.bodyHtml:
Stella Rosa Peach is a Moscato-based blend infused with natural white and yellow peaches from the Piedmont region of Italy.  Sweet but not overly sweet with just enough bubbles.

BEST PAIRED WITH

Aged Cheddar and Dubliner Irish Cheddar cheeses, summer salad with field greens and strawberries, chicken dumplings, vanilla or peach ice cream, vanilla custard.

stella-rosa-watermelon.title: Stella Rosa Watermelon 750ml
stella-rosa-watermelon.bodyHtml:
Stella Rosa Watermelon is crisp, refreshing, and making a splash among Stella Rosa®️ lovers. Could this be your new favorite too? You won’t know unless you Taste The Magic for yourself.

Tasting Notes:

Taste: Fresh watermelon

Light body, Semi sweet

ABV: 5%

FOOD RECOMMENDATION PAIRING: Salads, Cheese, Fruit, & Desserts

analog-ready-paler-two.title: Analog Ready Paler Two 4 Tall Cans
analog-ready-paler-two.bodyHtml: Refreshing and approachable, this session IPA is clean and citrusy with a dry finish. Pack with Citra, Mosiac, El Dorado and Simcoe this beer is hop forward without being bitter. Expect citrusy and tropical notes, with a classic West Coast IPA clean finish.

folding-mount-afternoon-social-hazy-ipa.title: Folding Mount Afternoon Social Hazy Ipa 4 Tall Cans
folding-mount-afternoon-social-hazy-ipa.bodyHtml: Folding Mount Afternoon Social Hazy Ipa 4 Tall Cans

uko-estate-malbec-rose.title: Uko Estate Malbec Rose 2019 750ml
uko-estate-malbec-rose.bodyHtml:
The Uko Estate Malbec Rosé is a vibrant and expressive rosé wine from Argentina, crafted with finesse from Malbec grapes. It captures the fresh, fruity essence of Malbec in a lighter, more refreshing style perfect for warm days and relaxed moments.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Bright pale pink with rose gold hues.

  • Aromas: Fresh and lively aromas of strawberries, raspberries, and red cherries, complemented by floral hints and a touch of citrus zest.

  • Palate: Crisp and juicy on the palate with delicate red fruit flavors, refreshing acidity, and a smooth, dry finish. The wine offers a well-balanced structure with a clean, elegant mouthfeel.

Style & Character:

This rosé highlights Malbec’s versatility, delivering bright fruit and vibrant energy in a polished, easy-drinking form. It’s a modern, stylish rosé that remains true to its Argentinian roots.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with grilled seafood, light pasta dishes, summer salads, sushi, or as a chilled aperitif.

candoni-moscato.title: Ca ed Balos Moscato d'Asti 2025
candoni-moscato.bodyHtml:
Ca ed Balos Moscato d'Asti 2025 is an exceptionally vibrant, aromatic, and delightfully fresh semi-sparkling white wine that beautifully captures the quintessential charm of Piedmont's premium dessert wines. Pouring a delicate straw yellow color with a fine, lively effervescence, it opens with a highly expressive bouquet of fresh white peaches, ripe apricots, and elderflower, seamlessly layered with sweet nuances of orange zest, wild honey, and a touch of delicate musk. On the palate, this lightly sparkling (frizzante) treat delivers a perfectly balanced, low-alcohol framework where a juicy, concentrated core of stone fruits and tangerine mousse is animated by a racy, refreshing vein of natural acidity. The natural residual sweetness wraps seamlessly around the palate without feeling heavy or cloying, gliding into a clean, cheerful, and beautifully persistent finish highlighted by lingering notes of floral syrup and white almond.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with classic dry pastries, panettone, fresh peach tarts, creamy panna cotta with berry coulis, or mildly spicy Vietnamese summer rolls.

quidi-vidi-aloha-sour-ipa.title: Quidi Vidi Aloha Sour Ipa 4 Tall Cans
quidi-vidi-aloha-sour-ipa.bodyHtml: Quidi Vidi Aloha Sour Ipa 4 Tall Cans

dandy-bunbury-pineapple-wheat-ale.title: Dandy Wild Sour 4 Tall Cans
dandy-bunbury-pineapple-wheat-ale.bodyHtml: This beer is a bold, malty sour ale known for its pleasing tartness. It is soured with lactobacillus and fermented with a wild yeast strain. The flavor offers a balanced complexity, where the upfront sourness is complemented by notes of green mango, pineapple, and a hint of Sauvignon Blanc.

small-mercy-easygoing-red.title: Small Mercy Easygoing Red 750ml
small-mercy-easygoing-red.bodyHtml: Small Mercy Easy Going Red is an approachable Canadian red wine. It shows juicy, jammy notes of strawberry and cherry, with well-integrated tannins and a refreshing, clean finish. This listing is a 750ml bottle at 12% ABV.

99-root-beer.title: 99 Root Beer Schnapps
99-root-beer.bodyHtml:
99 Root Beer Schnapps captures the nostalgic flavour of classic root beer in a bold, high-proof liqueur. Bursting with sweet vanilla, aromatic spices and rich root beer character, this American schnapps delivers an intensely flavoured experience. Bottled at 99 proof in a convenient 50ml miniature, it combines playful sweetness with a warming finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with vanilla ice cream, chocolate brownies, caramel desserts, spiced cookies, chocolate cake or barbecue dishes.

Tasting Notes: Bold and sweet, featuring classic root beer flavours, creamy vanilla and warming spice.

Nose: Sweet root beer aromas with vanilla, herbal nuances and gentle baking spices.

Palate: Rich root beer sweetness complemented by creamy vanilla, herbal spice and pronounced alcoholic warmth.

Finish: Long and warming, with lingering root beer, sweet vanilla and subtle spice.

township-24-city-limits-craft-lager.title: Township 24 City Limits Craft Lager 4 Tall Cans
township-24-city-limits-craft-lager.bodyHtml: Township 24 City Limits Craft Lager 4 Tall Cans

senses-russian-river-valley-pinot-noir.title: Merry Edwards Russian River Pinot Noir 750ml
senses-russian-river-valley-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
On the nose, aromas of red cherries, ripe raspberries, brambleberries and blueberries mingle with violets. Toasted brioche and sweet tea tease you to take a sip. Offering immediate palate appeal, the wine displays a beautiful balance of bright acidity and well-integrated tannins supported by a touch of warm French oak. Velvety and ripe with a lingering finish, all indications point to a long life ahead.

96 Points - Wine Advocate
A benchmark Russian River Valley Pinot Noir from a legendary winemaker, this wine bursts from the glass with an intoxicating perfume of black cherry, ripe strawberry, sassafras, and a signature note of French roast coffee. The palate is rich, velvety, and full-bodied, displaying a stunning concentration of fruit that is perfectly balanced by bright acidity and supple tannins. The finish is exceptionally long and complex, leaving impressions of cola and sweet oak. It is a hedonistic and profoundly satisfying wine.
95 Points - James Suckling
An opulent and beautifully crafted Pinot Noir that showcases the sun-kissed character of the Russian River Valley. Aromas of black raspberry, plum, and vanilla cream lead to a palate that is both lush and structured. The mouthfeel is dense and plush, yet it maintains a wonderful sense of balance and freshness, culminating in a long, spice-laden finish. A magnificent expression of New World Pinot.

laurent-perrier-brut-millesime.title: Laurent-Perrier Brut Millesime 2018
laurent-perrier-brut-millesime.bodyHtml: A distinguished vintage Champagne that exemplifies Laurent-Perrier's signature style of freshness and elegance combined with the richness of a single harvest. It presents a brilliant pale gold colour with a persistent, fine bead. The nose is complex and expressive, opening with notes of citrus zest and white peach, followed by more evolved aromas of toasted brioche, honey, and a hint of roasted almonds. On the palate, the wine is precise and well-balanced, featuring a silky texture and a vibrant acidity that carries the flavours of candied lemon and white flowers into a long, mineral-inflected finish. This Millésimé is crafted from a selection of the finest Grands Crus and is aged significantly on its lees to achieve a perfect harmony between its youthful energy and mature depth.

no-boats-on-sunday-cider-variety-pack.title: No Boats On Sunday Cider Variety Pack 12 Cans
no-boats-on-sunday-cider-variety-pack.bodyHtml: No Boats On Sunday Cider Variety Pack offers a premium selection of craft ciders that celebrate a relaxed, "island time" philosophy. This 12-can collection typically features a mix of the brand’s most popular expressions, including their flagship Original Apple, alongside refreshing fruit-infused options like Peach and Mixed Berry. Each cider is crafted using 100% locally sourced apples and natural ingredients, avoiding artificial flavours or colours to ensure a crisp, authentic taste. The profile across the pack is characterized by a perfect balance of natural sweetness and bright acidity, with a fine carbonation that makes them exceptionally refreshing. Designed for sharing at social gatherings or casual outdoor events, this variety pack provides a versatile tasting experience that highlights the quality and craftsmanship of Canadian maritime-style cider.

motts-siracha.title: Mott's Clamato Extra Spicy 945ml
motts-siracha.bodyHtml: We’ve figured out how to double the spice in your Mott’s Clamato Extra Spicy and still make room for all the other flavours. And you can take it from us, with great spice, comes great responsibility. This Mott’s Clamato goes well with listening to an extra spicy story around brunch, or with living your spiciest life by being a part of that story the night before.

bombay-sapphire-gin-tonic.title: Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin 1.14L
bombay-sapphire-gin-tonic.bodyHtml:
Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin is an iconic, world-renowned gin crafted using a proprietary vapor-infusion process. First created in 1987 based on an 1761 recipe, ten sustainably sourced botanicals are held separately from the spirit in perforated copper baskets and infused with hot spirit vapor, yielding a delicate, bright, and perfectly balanced botanical profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, seafood tapas, goat cheese crostini, lemon tarts, or sushi.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and luminous in appearance with a smooth, light, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh juniper, bright citrus, floral notes, subtle pine, and warm earthy spices.

Palate : Clean, balanced, and round with vibrant juniper berries, zesty lemon, peppery coriander, subtle liquorice, and almond sweetness.

Finish : Medium, crisp, and refreshing with lingering hints of citrus zest and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve as the foundational spirit in a classic Gin & Tonic with fresh lime, in a Dry Martini, or over ice with tonic water.

bison-coffe-cafe-vodka.title: Bison Vodka Cafe
bison-coffe-cafe-vodka.bodyHtml:
Bison Vodka Cafe is a coffee (cafe) flavoured vodka from Manitoba, Canada. It is bottled at 25% ABV, a lighter strength than standard vodka, in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Serve chilled or over ice, or add to coffee-based cocktails.

canella-lido-prosecco-rose-doc.title: Canella 'Lido' Prosecco Rose 2020 750ml
canella-lido-prosecco-rose-doc.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "Wildflowers, ripe red fruits, and a hint of lemon zest define the aroma of this wine. Crunchy and vibrant flavors of fresh red berries, subtle blood orange notes, and a bright, mineral-driven finish lift the palate yielding a refreshing and bright structure." - 88/100, Wine Enthusiast

loveblock-pinot-gris.title: Loveblock Pinot Noir 2021
loveblock-pinot-gris.bodyHtml:
This is a delicious Pinot Noir, with fleshy black plum, layers of cherry and sweet berries that play on the palate and dance with hints of violet and savory notes.

Dry tannins and hints of cigar make this a versatile wine to pair with turkey, salmon, lamb and beef.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Presents pretty clove, nutmeg and cardamom details that are a lovely complement to the sleek maraschino cherry, raspberry and cranberry flavors at the core. A touch of malty Assam tea lingers on the finish, adding a firm note. Drink now through 2035.
91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of red cherries, raspberries and dried herbs with stony austerity. The palate is fresh and forward, with red cherry flavors and a medium to full body, finishing with nervy energy.

georgian-bay-raspberry-rhubarb-vodka6pk.title: Georgian Bay Raspberry Rhubarb Vodka6Pk 6 Cans

black-fly-vodka-mixed-berry.title: Black Fly Vodka Maxx Raspberry Rush

nutrl-cherry.title: Nutrl Vodka Soda Classics 24 Cans
nutrl-cherry.bodyHtml:
Made with craft vodka from British Columbia, Nutrl Vodka Soda has NO CARBS, NO SUGAR, and NO SWEETENERS!!

  • 6 x Lemon
  • 6 x Cherry
  • 6 x Lime
  • 6 x Cranberry

martini-frose.title: Martini Rosso 1L
martini-frose.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: "Cola hue. Sensuous nose features ginger, prunes, sap and bark aromas. In the mouth, it's supple, sweet, winey and almost Sherry-like at entry, then at midpalate citrus and grape flavors appear. Finishes luscious and semisweet." - 92/100, Wine Enthusiast

martini-frosecco.title: Martini & Rossi Prosecco 750ml
martini-frosecco.bodyHtml: Martini & Rossi Prosecco Sparkling Wine is a dry, aromatic Italian sparkling wine made from the Glera grapes that grow in the lush, sun-drenched foothills of the Veneto and Friuli regions of north-eastern Italy. Ripened in this ideal climate, they give this Prosecco wine a stimulating fragrance.

goldschlager-cinnamon-schnapps.title: Goldschlager Cinnamon Schnapps
goldschlager-cinnamon-schnapps.bodyHtml:
Goldschläger Cinnamon Schnapps is a clear cinnamon liqueur known for the flakes of real gold leaf that drift through the bottle. The name comes from the German word for gold beaters, the craftsmen who hammered soft gold bars into wafer-thin sheets, and the light, edible flakes give every pour its signature shimmer. The Canadian release is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle and is a product of Switzerland from Sazerac. Spicy cinnamon aromas lead into a sweet, syrupy palate with hot spice underneath. Serve it ice-cold as a shot, sip it from a rocks glass, or use it to add cinnamon warmth to seasonal cocktails such as a gingerbread-style drink.

Tasting Notes: Sweet cinnamon with a hot, spicy edge.

Nose: Spicy cinnamon.

Palate: Sweet and syrupy with hot, spicy undertones.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, neat in a rocks glass, or in cocktails.

twisted-tea-mango.title: Twisted Tea Original Hard Iced Tea 6 x 355ml Cans
twisted-tea-mango.bodyHtml:
Twisted Tea Original Hard Iced Tea is a refreshing, smooth and easy-drinking alcoholic iced tea crafted with real brewed tea and natural lemon flavour. Produced by The Twisted Tea Brewing Company, this popular malt-based beverage combines the familiar taste of classic iced tea with a balanced touch of sweetness and a refreshing citrus character. Pouring a clear amber-tea colour, it opens with inviting aromas of freshly brewed black tea, zesty lemon and delicate sweetness. The palate is light, smooth and refreshing, delivering authentic tea flavour, gentle malt character and lively lemon notes without the carbonation of traditional beer or hard seltzer. Its balanced sweetness and clean finish make it an approachable alternative to conventional ready-to-drink alcoholic beverages. At 5% ABV, Twisted Tea Original delivers a refreshing iced tea experience with a subtle alcoholic kick. Conveniently packaged in six 355ml cans, it is a popular choice for backyard barbecues, outdoor gatherings, casual entertaining and relaxed occasions.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled burgers, barbecue chicken, pulled pork sandwiches, crispy chicken wings, fish tacos, grilled shrimp and spicy nachos. Its refreshing lemon and tea character also complements fried chicken, loaded fries, pizza, salty pretzels, grilled vegetables and classic pub appetizers.

Tasting Notes: A smooth, refreshing and non-carbonated hard iced tea featuring real brewed black tea, balanced sweetness, gentle malt character and bright lemon citrus.

Nose: Fresh aromas of brewed black tea, lemon zest and subtle sweetness, with delicate herbal tea nuances.

Palate: Light-bodied and smooth, delivering freshly brewed tea flavours, gentle sweetness and refreshing lemon citrus, balanced by a subtle malt-based alcoholic character.

Finish: Clean, refreshing and lightly sweet, with lingering black tea, soft citrus zest and a pleasantly smooth finish.

summer-water-bubbly-rose.title: Summer Water Bubbly Rose 750ml
summer-water-bubbly-rose.bodyHtml: Summer Water Bubbly is a sparkling rosé from the Summer Water brand. It is made by the Charmat method, with the second fermentation in pressure tanks, and aged in stainless steel for six months. Like the original still Summer Water rosé, the bubbly version is designed to be light and refreshing, with just a hint of sweetness, and is meant for easy, anytime drinking. 750ml, 12.5% alcohol.

alley-kat-the-mangolorian-mango-ale.title: Alley Kat The Mangolorian Mango Ale

canadian-boreal-gin.title: Distillerie Arsenal Gin Canadien No. 13
canadian-boreal-gin.bodyHtml:
Gin Canadien No. 13 is a botanical gin from Distillerie Arsenal & Co. in Quebec, a distillery founded by four travellers whose spirits are inspired by journeys around the world. The number refers to its thirteen featured plants and aromatics, one drawn from each of Canada's thirteen provinces and territories and listed on the back label. The recipe combines juniper, coriander and angelica root with Canadian botanicals such as sweet gale, lovage, wild caraway, black spruce needles and white spruce tips, sweetfern, bee balm, goldenrod and wild rose, plus lavender, sage and lemon verbena. The botanicals are hot-macerated and slowly distilled, giving a gin with herbal, floral and forest notes. Bottled at 40% ABV in a striking red 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Herbaceous, floral and foresty.

Serve: With tonic over ice, or in a Martini.

tavernello-pinot-grigio.title: Tavernello Organic Pinot Grigio delle Venezie
tavernello-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
A magnificent, eco-conscious, and thoroughly refreshing Italian white wine crafted by Caviro, Italy's leading agricultural cooperative. Sourced from organically cultivated, certified vineyards sprawling across the pristine delle Venezie zone in northeastern Italy, it is vinified entirely in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats to preserve its bright, natural fruit clarity. It displays a luminous, pale straw-yellow profile bursting with crisp aromas of fresh green apples, juicy white pears, and delicate citrus blossoms. On the palate, it is light, clean, and highly vibrant, balanced by a thirst-quenching acidity and a smooth, delightfully mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with light appetizers, fresh garden salads, delicate seafood pasta, grilled white fish, or simple vegetarian risottos.

delta-catalyst-lager.title: Delirium Nocturnum 330ml
delta-catalyst-lager.bodyHtml: Delirium Nocturnum is a dark, complex Belgian Strong Ale. It boasts a rich, malty base with notes of caramel, chocolate, and dark fruit, along with a hint of spice and mild bitterness. The beer is brewed by Huyghe Brewery in Belgium and comes in a 330ml bottle.

bouchard-aine-pinot-noir.title: Bouchard Aine & Fils Bourgogne Pinot Noir 750ml
bouchard-aine-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
A crimson ruby red color, the Bouchard Aine & Fils Bourgogne Pinot Noir is fine and subtle on the nose, with nice aromas of small red and black fruits. The mouth is supple, round, with soft tannins and a nice freshness.

Serve with small feathered game, mild red meats or soft cheeses.

aberfeldy-21-year-old-1.title: Aberfeldy 21 Year Old
aberfeldy-21-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
Aberfeldy 21 Year Old is a luxurious and richly textured Highland single malt, proudly known as the "Golden Dram" due to the distillery's water source, the Pitilie Burn, which is famous for its historical deposits of alluvial gold. Matured for over two decades in a combination of carefully selected ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks, this distinguished whisky develops profound depth, revealing layers of signature heather honey, creamy macadamia nuts, and rich dried fruits. It is a masterclass in balance and elegance, perfect for those seeking a highly refined and exceptionally smooth Highland malt.

Food Pairing: This rich, honeyed whisky pairs exceptionally well with roasted pork belly, honey-glazed duck, or a sophisticated dessert like sticky toffee pudding or crème brûlée. It also beautifully complements aged gouda or a mild, creamy blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Rich amber-gold in appearance with a smooth, rich, and velvety mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Heather honey, dried fruits, toasted macadamia nuts, citrus zest, and soft oak spices.

Palate : Creamy and full-bodied with notes of orange peel, floral honey, vanilla fudge, soft peat smoke, and gentle baking spices.

Finish : Long, warm, and refined with lingering notes of sweet honey, oak, and dried fruit.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature, or with a few drops of pure water to unlock its full aromatic complexity.

oharas-irish-stout-nitro.title: O'Hara's Irish Stout Nitro 4 Tall Cans

bacardi-gold.title: Bacardi Gold Rum 200ml
bacardi-gold.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Gold Rum is the amber-hued member of the Bacardí range, a 40% ABV rum shaped by the brand's Maestros de Ron. Its golden colour and rich character come from ageing in toasted oak barrels, while its mellow, rounded texture is credited to filtration through a blend of charcoals that Bacardí keeps secret. It closes dry with a gentle sweetness. Bacardí positions it as a rum for bold, zesty and punchy drinks, and it is the natural base for a Cuba Libre. This listing is the 200ml flask.

Nose: Nutty and buttery.

Palate: Rich and toasted.

Finish: Dry with a light sweetness.

Serve: Top with cola and a squeeze of lime for a Cuba Libre, or use in citrus-forward rum cocktails.

one-for-the-road-n-alc-saskaberry-blonde.title: One For The Road N/Alc Saskaberry Blonde 4 Tall Cans
one-for-the-road-n-alc-saskaberry-blonde.bodyHtml: One For The Road N/Alc Saskaberry Blonde 4 Tall Cans

rush-canadian-golden-ale.title: Henderson Brew Rush Canadian Golden Ale 4 Tall Cans
rush-canadian-golden-ale.bodyHtml: Henderson Brew Rush Canadian Golden Ale 4 Tall Cans

phillips-eclipse-stout.title: Phillips Gorilla Mode Thunder Punch Ipa

winemaker-red-wine.title: Hess Select Treo Winemakers Blend California Red Wine 2023
winemaker-red-wine.bodyHtml:
Hess Select Treo Winemaker's Blend 2023 is a rich and approachable California red wine produced by The Hess Collection, a winery recognized for its commitment to quality and expressive winemaking. Named Treo, meaning a group of three, this wine celebrates the art of blending complementary grape varieties to create a harmonious balance of fruit, structure and complexity. The 2023 vintage delivers inviting flavours of ripe blackberry, dark cherry and plum, complemented by notes of vanilla, mocha and gentle baking spice. Smooth tannins and a rounded texture make this wine enjoyable on its own or alongside a variety of dishes. Its generous fruit character and balanced finish make it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, dinners and special occasions.

Food Pairing: Grilled steak, barbecue ribs, roasted lamb, beef burgers, braised short ribs, mushroom pizza, tomato-based pasta, smoked meats and aged cheddar.

winemaker-white-wine-vinolei-rslg.title: Rombauer Chardonnay 2024
winemaker-white-wine-vinolei-rslg.bodyHtml:
Rombauer Chardonnay 2024 is a lush, opulent, and iconic California white wine crafted by Rombauer Vineyards. Sourced primarily from sustainably farmed vineyards in the cool, fog-shrouded Carneros region—where marine breezes from San Pablo Bay preserve bright natural acidity—the grapes were gently whole-cluster pressed and fermented in French oak barrels. Following fermentation, the wine underwent full malolactic fermentation and aged for nine months on its lees with regular stirring (bâtonnage) in new and used French oak, imparting its signature creamy texture and decadent barrel spice. In the glass, it displays a luminous pale yellow hue with shimmering green-gold highlights. The aromatic profile opens with expressive notes of ripe yellow peach, melon, and Meyer lemon zest layered with vanilla bean, toasted oak, and subtle baking spice. On the palate, it delivers a rich, full-bodied mouthfeel balanced by crisp citrus acidity, culminating in a long, smooth, and buttery finish.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy fettuccine Alfredo, or mild triple-cream Brie cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Classic in every sense, with freshness and purity underneath the generosity and richness this wine is known for. Cookies, pastry and sweet spices alongside ripe orchard fruit, apples and vanilla. The textural palate shows bright acidity and lovely balance, with saline notes and preserved lemons. Consistent and well-made. Drink or hold.

olmeca-gold-tequila-1.title: Olmeca Gold Tequila
olmeca-gold-tequila-1.bodyHtml:
Olmeca Gold is the golden tequila of the Olmeca brand, crafted with traditional methods in the Los Altos highlands of Mexico and carrying the signature of master distiller Jesús Hernández on its label. Made with blue agave, it pours a pale straw colour and opens with an expressive nose of white pepper, grain and floral notes. The palate is full and powerful, built around a distinctive coconut character, and the finish closes with flashes of hot cinnamon. The current bottle wears Olmeca's redesigned label with the Olmec head emblem on the familiar square, patterned bottle. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is an easy, approachable tequila for shots and mixed drinks.

Tasting Notes: White pepper, grain, florals, coconut, cinnamon.

Nose: White pepper, grain and floral notes.

Palate: Full and powerful, with distinctive coconut.

Finish: Flashes of hot cinnamon.

Serve: As a chilled shot with lime, or in a margarita.

diabolica-white-1.title: Diabolica White 750ml
diabolica-white-1.bodyHtml:
Diabolica White is a seductive and vibrant white wine blend crafted to captivate your senses with lush fruit, smooth texture, and an irresistible finish. This devilishly delicious wine is made for those who crave bold flavor and a touch of indulgence in every sip.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Pale golden with a hint of green.

  • Aromas: Bursting with tropical fruits, peach, and citrus, layered with floral notes and a whisper of vanilla.

  • Palate: Lush and juicy, with flavors of pineapple, mango, melon, and ripe pear, all wrapped in a silky mouthfeel. A touch of sweetness is balanced by bright acidity, leading to a clean, refreshing finish.

Style & Personality:

Playful yet sophisticated, Diabolica White is a harmonious blend—often including varietals like Chardonnay, Gewürztraminer, and Viognier—designed to please a wide range of palates. It's both easy-drinking and elegantly layered.

Food Pairing:

Delightful with creamy pastas, grilled chicken, spicy Thai or Indian dishes, soft cheeses, or enjoyed on its own as a crisp aperitif.

iron-maiden-trooper-beer-the-collection2.title: Iron Maiden Trooper Beer The Collection2 12 Bottles
iron-maiden-trooper-beer-the-collection2.bodyHtml: Iron Maiden Trooper Beer The Collection2 12 Bottles

dewars-white-label.title: Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky 1.75L
dewars-white-label.bodyHtml:
Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky 1.75L is one of the world’s most recognizable and highly awarded blended Scotch whiskies, first created in 1899 by Master Blender A.J. Cameron. This classic blend brings together up to 40 of Scotland’s finest single malt and grain whiskies, with Aberfeldy single malt at its sweet, honeyed heart. Dewar’s is renowned for its signature double-aging process, wherein the whiskies are blended together and then returned to oak casks to mature further, ensuring an uncommonly smooth and seamlessly integrated flavor profile.

Food Pairing: Traditional fish and chips, honey-glazed ham, mild cheddar cheeses, or shortbread biscuits.

TASTING NOTES Clear, pale golden amber in appearance with a light, crisp, and exceptionally smooth mouthfeel.

NOSE Clean and invitingly sweet, opening with distinct aromas of heather honey, fresh orchard fruits like green apples and pears, and a subtle undertone of warm unbaked dough.

PALATE Light and well-rounded, delivering dominant flavors of golden honey, sweet malt, and subtle vanilla fudge, beautifully balanced by a touch of fresh citrus and a faint trace of oak wood.

FINISH Short to medium, clean, and refreshing with a gentle, trailing warmth of black pepper and a brief, clean dry note.

SERVE Highly versatile; perfect enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as the quintessential base for a refreshing Scotch Highball mixed with club soda and a lemon twist.

bud-light-seltzer-black-cherry-1.title: Bud Light Seltzer Black Cherry 6 Cans

lakefront-new-grist-gluten-free-beer.title: Lakefront New Grist Gluten Free 4 Tall Cans

alley-kat-buena-vista-brown-ale.title: Alley Kat Bee League Honey Brown Ale
alley-kat-buena-vista-brown-ale.bodyHtml: Alley Kat Bee League Honey Brown Ale

ariel-chardonnay-non-alcoholic-wine.title: Ariel Chardonnay Non Alcoholic 2023 750ml
ariel-chardonnay-non-alcoholic-wine.bodyHtml:
ARIEL Chardonnay, with its tropical fruit character and subtle oak from barrel aging, has a distinctive combination of buttery apple and butterscotch flavors, combined with a toasty French oak bouquet. This is a dealcoholized wine that will continue to develop complexity as it ages.

Try it with spaghetti carbonara, mango mahi-mahi, sautéed scallops, crispy duck.

roserock-chardonnay.title: Roserock Eola-Amity Hills Chardonnay 2021
roserock-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Roserock Chardonnay is defined by balance and precision, two trademark characteristics of this Eola-Amity Hills vineyard. A layered bouquet includes fragrant gardenia and perfumed honeysuckle, while acidity and nuanced stone fruit flavors energize the palate. Subtle minerality adds depth and refinement. It is another classic expression of the site.

94 Points - James Suckling

Notes of dried apples, glazed lemons, orange curd, roasted almonds and crushed stones. Hints of dried lemon peel, too. Full-bodied and broad yet it is delicate with impressive fresh acidity. Incredible minerality here with a touch of zestiness at the end. Lingering finish. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Driven by electrifying acidity and a texture as crisp as a new dollar bill, this is a wine for fans of the lean, but hardly mean, style of Chardonnay. Pineapple and chamomile aromas are complemented by bits of fresh-cut grass and thyme. Flavors of chilled orange segments, lemon verbena and toasted filberts go on forever.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Brisk and fresh, with pear and grapefruit flavors accented by spice and white blossom aromatics as this glides on the steely finish. Drink now. 2,405 cases made.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Chardonnay features singular, exotic aromas of lemongrass, green herbs, citrus blossom and peach preserves. The medium-bodied palate is silky and energetic with perfumed flavors accented by touches of allspice, and it has a long, layered finish.

mg-spirit-mojito.title: Ginebra San Miguel Blue Mojito
mg-spirit-mojito.bodyHtml:
Ginebra San Miguel Blue Mojito is a flavored gin spirit from the Philippines, combining the light character of GSM Blue with the refreshing profile of a classic mojito. The expression is built around bright lime and cooling mint flavours, creating a smooth, approachable drink designed for easy serving and mixing.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled shrimp, fried calamari, chicken skewers, fresh spring rolls, salty appetizers, or other light dishes that complement lime and mint.

Tasting Notes: Light, refreshing and citrus-driven, combining zesty lime character with cooling mint and a smooth, easy-drinking texture. The mojito-inspired flavour profile makes this a lively flavored gin suited to casual sipping and mixed drinks.

Nose: Fresh mint with bright citrus and lime character.

Palate: Smooth and light with refreshing lime, mint and gently sweet character.

Finish: Clean and refreshing with lingering citrus and cooling mint.

Serve: Serve neat and chilled, over ice, or mixed. The producer specifically recommends enjoying GSM Blue Flavors neat, chilled or mixed.

chateau-terre-de-grand.title: Chateau Terre de Grand Bordeaux Superieur 2023
chateau-terre-de-grand.bodyHtml: Perfectly balanced with earthy notes mid-palate. Medium to strong tannins that are both subtle and complex .

temple-bar-15-year-old-single-malt-irish.title: Redbreast 15 Year Old Irish Whiskey
temple-bar-15-year-old-single-malt-irish.bodyHtml:
Redbreast 15 Year Old Irish Whiskey is a rich, robust, and beautifully complex expression that showcases the pinnacle of the traditional Single Pot Still style. Originally created as a limited-edition release for La Maison du Whisky in Paris, it proved so exceptional that it earned a permanent place in the core Redbreast family. Crafted at the famed Midleton Distillery, it is made from a traditional mash of malted and unmalted barley, triple distilled in copper pot stills, and meticulously matured in a careful balance of first-fill and refill Spanish Oloroso sherry casks and American oak ex-bourbon barrels. Bottled at an elevated 46% ABV and without chill-filtration, the 15 Year Old delivers a fuller, more earthy, and highly textured profile compared to its younger sibling, packed with fleshy stone fruits, rich aromatic oils, and profound toasted wood spice.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork belly, spiced lamb chops, sharp aged cheddar or Comté cheese, rich fruitcake, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance with a full-bodied, incredibly smooth, and oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Highly aromatic and complex, bursting with dark berry fruits, fleshy peach, and sweet citrus, seamlessly interwoven with aromatic oils, toasted wood, and warm winter spices.

Palate : Full, rich, and elegantly textured. A harmonious wave of fleshy orchard fruits, berries, and sweet vanilla gives way to the signature pot still spice—featuring vibrant ginger, white pepper, and a deep, warming toasted oak character.

Finish : Exceptionally long, sophisticated, and evolving, leaving a lingering warmth of complex pot still spices, toasted wood, and sweet dried fruit.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass or gently open it with a few drops of room-temperature water to further release its rich aromatic oils and fruity esters.

origins-aglianico-sangiovese-classico.title: Marchesi Antinori Tignanello 2023
origins-aglianico-sangiovese-classico.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Tignanello 2023 is a legendary, groundbreaking Super Tuscan produced from the estate's historic single vineyard in the heart of Chianti Classico. Aged in French and Hungarian oak barrels, it displays expressive aromas of dark cherry, ripe pomegranate, dried violets, and blood orange, complemented by accents of cocoa, pencil lead, cedar, and fresh balsamic herbs. The palate is precise, energetic, and mouth-filling, offering fine-grained, silky tannins and vibrant acidity that lead to a long, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Bistecca alla Fiorentina, roast leg of lamb, braised short ribs, wild boar ragù, and long-aged Pecorino cheese.

97 Points - James Suckling

Dark and profound wine of great precision, vibrant cassis, graphite and cedar wood, very balsamic with eucalyptus and camphor. Full-bodied with weight and substance on the mid-palate. It shows an elegant attack with velvety tannins, refreshing acidity and long graphite depth. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Cherry, black currant, violet, mineral, vanilla and toasty oak aromas and flavors are the hallmarks of this polished, complex red. Shows terrific balance and intensity, while a cascade of fruit and spices infuses the aftertaste. Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2028 through 2047.

slipknot-no-9-whiskey.title: Slipknot No. 9 Whiskey
slipknot-no-9-whiskey.bodyHtml:
A spectacular collaboration between the iconic heavy metal band Slipknot and the award-winning Cedar Ridge Distillery in Iowa. No. 9 Whiskey is a bold, no-nonsense blend of straight bourbon and straight rye whiskeys sourced entirely from Iowa farms. Bottled at a sturdy 90 proof (45% ABV), the high corn content of the bourbon provides a deep, sweet, and heavy foundation, while the rye component kicks in with a sharp, aggressive, and perfectly rebellious peppery spice.

 

NOSE

Earthy and sweet with aromas of fresh sweet corn, toasted oak, honey, and bright apple.

PALATE

Rich, warm, and highly balanced. Lush flavors of caramel and vanilla cream are quickly met by a sharp, lively punch of black pepper and cinnamon spice.

FINISH

Long, warm, and highly satisfying with a lingering trail of sweet butterscotch and dry rye spice.

twisted-tea-slightly-sweet.title: Twisted Tea Slightly Sweet Tall Can 473ml

benromach-peat-smoke-sherry-2012.title: Benromach Contrasts: Peat Smoke Sherry 2012
benromach-peat-smoke-sherry-2012.bodyHtml:
Finished in first-fill Sherry hogshead casks and produced in very small batches, using barley malted with high levels on peat smoke at 57ppm.

Offering sweet vanilla and stewed fruit aromas, citrus and summer berry flavours and finishing with peat smoke and ginger.

benromach-40-year-old-2021-edition.title: Benromach 40 Year Old 2021 Release
benromach-40-year-old-2021-edition.bodyHtml:
Benromach is a traditional Speyside distillery owned by a family intent on producing single malt using time honoured methods. Its small team of distillers rely entirely on their expertise and senses to make the finest handmade whisky. A small number of casks maturing in its dunnage warehouses were selected for this first annual batch release, with a further release planned each year. In 2022 the Benromach Distillery unveiled the first annual batch release of its 40 Year Old. Bottled at a cask strength this rare single malt whisky is natural in colour and was laid down in 1981 - spending four decades maturing in the finest first-fill Oloroso sherry casks. The result is an exquisite single malt and the oldest expression released in Benromach’s new look line up which was launched in June 2020. Total outturn: 1047 bottles worldwide.

Matured in the finest hand-selected first-fill Oloroso sherry casks, our FORTY YEAR OLD single malt delivers rich ginger and stewed fruit aromas. Seville orange, red apple and demerara sugar followed by a citrus zest finish.

bali-water-vodka-watermelon.title: Bali Water Vodka Watermelon 4x355ml Cans
bali-water-vodka-watermelon.bodyHtml:
A brand new three-ingredient ready-to-drink cocktail in a can containing no added sugar or artificial ingredients.

Our founders travelled Southeast Asia in a search for the best possible fresh juices they could source. Within the lush jungle landscape of Bali our unique flavor was found. Working exclusively with suppliers in the region, we’ve blended premium rice vodka, lightly carbonated spring water, and vine-ripened tropical fruit juices to create Bali Water – Nothing else.

bali-water-vodka-coconut.title: Bali Water Vodka Mango 4x355ml Cans
bali-water-vodka-coconut.bodyHtml:
A brand new three-ingredient ready-to-drink cocktail in a can containing no added sugar or artificial ingredients.

Our founders travelled Southeast Asia in a search for the best possible fresh juices they could source. Within the lush jungle landscape of Bali our unique flavor was found. Working exclusively with suppliers in the region, we’ve blended premium rice vodka, lightly carbonated spring water, and vine-ripened tropical fruit juices to create Bali Water – Nothing else.

mayacamas-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Mayacamas Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 750ml
mayacamas-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The 2019 Mayacamas Mt. Veeder Cabernet Sauvignon opens with lilac, dried sage, and graphite. Wild mountain blueberry, maraschino cherry, and blackberry round out the fruit profile. A very elegant wine with wonderful detail and nuance.


97 Points by Vinous
The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon is a pretty rich, bombastic wine, especially for Mayacamas. A blast of dark fruit, incense, tobacco, licorice, spice and mocha hits the palate. I would give the 2019 at least a few years in bottle to settle down, as it is quite the powerhouse today. This is an unusually flamboyant wine with plenty of richness and a bit less in the way of subtlety. The opulence of the vintage comes through loud and clear.

96 Points by Wine Spectator
Loaded with character and energy, this version reveals heavy notes of zesty sweet bay leaf and sassafras that infuse a core of steeped red currant and mulberry fruit, all carried by bright acidity and iron-laced tannins.
