The long finish pulls everything together, with the fruit, savory and mineral elements in harmony. Showing an old-school touch, this has a long life ahead. Best from 2025 through 2045.

94 Points by Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon remains true to the winery's historic style, offering complex notes of dried herbs and mixed berries, carried across the palate by a wine that's medium-bodied, crisp and somewhat lean by modern Napa standards. It finishes long and dusty, promising well for the future.

smirnoff-ice-3.title: Smirnoff Ice 12 Cans
smirnoff-ice-3.bodyHtml: Smirnoff Ice Original is the definitive premium malt beverage that set the standard for the ready-to-drink category with its crisp, citrus-forward profile. This 12-can pack offers the classic, refreshing taste of natural lemon-lime flavours combined with a smooth malt base and a lively carbonation. Characterized by its clean sweetness and zesty finish, it is designed to be served extra chilled directly from the can or over ice. As a versatile and convenient choice for social gatherings, beach days, or casual backyard BBQs, Smirnoff Ice Original remains a global favorite for those seeking a reliable, easy-drinking alternative to traditional beer or spirits.

chapoutier-bila-haut-lesquerda.title: M. Chapoutier Domaine de Bila-Haut "L'Esquerda" Côtes-du-Roussillon 2019
chapoutier-bila-haut-lesquerda.bodyHtml:
More wild scrub brush, violets, and peppery notes emerge from the 2019 Côtes Du Roussillon Villages Lesquerde L'Esquerda, a Syrah-dominated blend (there is 30% Grenache) that’s medium-bodied, nicely textured, balanced, and even elegant. It’s another seamless, beautifully done Roussillon from this estate that will deliver loads of pleasure over the coming 4-6 years or more.

92 Points - James Suckling

An intense nose with wild dark berries, dark plums, game, cloves and some undergrowth. Mineral driven with firm but precise tannins, a characteristic of the granite soil. Medium to full body with good balance. Crunchy fruit with plenty of juicy cherries and black pepper at the end. From biodynamically grown grapes. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The cement-aged 2019 Cotes du Roussillon Villages Lesquerde l'Esquerda is a blend of 85% Syrah and 15% Grenache, from relatively high-altitude (400-500 meters above sea level), granitic sites. Scents of crushed stone and blueberries mark the nose, while the medium to full-bodied palate finishes dusty and long, framed by fine-grained tannins.

hetszolo-tokaji-sweet-szamorodni.title: Hetszolo Domaine Imperial Tokaj 2017 500ml
hetszolo-tokaji-sweet-szamorodni.bodyHtml: Pale gold color. Medium intense apricot jam and honey in the nose. Medium plus body, high acidity. Pronounced intense apricot and honey on the palate with long finish. 84g/l residual sugar

jayson-chardonnay.title: Jayson Chardonnay 2022
jayson-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Jayson Chardonnay achieves a beautiful equilibrium of richness, buoyancy, and intricacy. Aromas of sweet Meyer lemon, crushedalmond, and grilled pineapple lead to a concentrated palate of bright lemon curd and orange blossom honey underscored by fresh pear andtoasted nuttiness with a hint of baking spice. The texture is classic Pahlmeyer, plush and detailed, while the presence of bright Carneros fruitbrings energy and litheness. Flavors are lifted and extended on a spine of bright acidity, the lingering finish striking an ideal balance between opulence and mouthwatering freshness.

93 Points -James Suckling

This generous, buttery and spicy wine is sourced from several parts of Napa Valley and brings gorgeous richness to the nose, palate and finish. Elements of brown butter, marzipan, toasted almonds and poached pears flood the flavors, with vanilla bean and a touch of sweet coconut. Barrel fermented in 36% new French oak, it’s full-bodied and nicely viscous in texture.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Layers of pleasing and mouthwatering flavor—spiced apples and baked pears with accents of lemon cream and cloves—abound. A creamy mouthfeel carries a generous wine that’s full of length and humming persistence.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers ripe, plump notes of salted melon, pear, peach pastry and lemon curd. Details of pineapple, baked apple and orange blossoms add intrigue, and a bright, fresh thread of acidity keeps the flavors fresh and in focus, gaining spice and white tea hints on the finish. Drink now.

pahlmeyer-merlot.title: Pahlmeyer Jayson Red 2021
pahlmeyer-merlot.bodyHtml:
Pahlmeyer Jayson Red 2021 is a lush, expressive, and exquisitely balanced Napa Valley red blend anchored by mountain-grown Merlot. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby-purple hue with brilliant crimson reflections. The aromatic profile is rich and layered, opening with notes of ripe black cherries, macerated plums, and fresh blackcurrants interwoven with nuances of mocha, forest floor, cedar, and delicate baking spices from Taransaud French oak aging. On the palate, it delivers a generous, velvety texture with a concentrated core of dark fruit, framed by fine-grained, supple tannins and lively natural acidity that culminate in a long, polished, and satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Char-grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted duck breast with cherry reduction, rosemary rack of lamb, braised short ribs, and mature aged cheddar.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackcurrants come through clearly along with hints of lead pencil. It’s medium- to full-bodied with fine velvety tannins and a flavorful finish. Caressing texture and not overdone. Lovely now to drink as a young wine but it will be even better in three to five years.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Juicy and full of flavor, this savory Cabernet Sauvignon-based blend brings together all five Bordeaux varieties for a complete and mouthwatering wine. Flavors of ripe black fruits and bramble combine with tobacco and herbs for a lengthy and enticing wine.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich and handsomely structured, this blend is generous, with black cherry, toasty spice and licorice flavors as this builds tension toward refined tannins. Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. Drink now through 2031. 6,077 cases made.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of 76% Merlot, 12% Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Malbec, 4% Petit Verdot and 1% Cabernet Franc, the 2021 Jayson Red Wine offers up seductive scents of black cherries, mocha and cassis. It's medium to full-bodied, silky and refined, but it's also a bit modest in intensity, much like the Jayson Chardonnay.

irish-whiskey-2002.title: The Whisky Agency Irish Single Malt XO 2002 48.4% ABV
irish-whiskey-2002.bodyHtml:
The Whisky Agency Irish Single Malt XO is an independent bottling of Irish single malt whiskey from Northern Ireland, selected by the independent bottler The Whisky Agency. Made from malted barley, it was bottled at 48.4% ABV in a 700ml bottle. The release does not identify the distillery. A bottle for drinkers who enjoy comparing independent Irish releases with the official distillery ranges.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

carpano-botanic-bitters.title: Carpano Botanic Bitter 1L
carpano-botanic-bitters.bodyHtml: Carpano Botanic Bitter is a premium Italian aperitif crafted with a complex blend of ten select botanicals, including sandalwood, myrrh, rhubarb, and gentian. It is designed to offer a balanced and sophisticated profile that bridges the gap between traditional herbal bitterness and bright citrus freshness. On the nose, it delivers an aromatic bouquet of orange zest and dried herbs, accented by earthy and spicy undertones. The palate is brilliantly structured, showcasing a vibrant initial sweetness followed by a persistent, elegant bitterness and a long, harmonious finish. The 1L format is a favorite for high-volume premium mixology, serving as an exceptional base for a Negroni or Spritz.

dalwhinnie-distillers-edition-2021.title: Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition 2021
dalwhinnie-distillers-edition-2021.bodyHtml:
Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition 2021 is Dalwhinnie distilled in 2006 and double-matured in ex-bodega Oloroso cask wood, adding rich sweetness and spicy complexity to the heathery, honeyed character of the regular release. It is part of the 2021 Distillers Edition range, made in limited quantities worldwide.

Nose: Fresh Oloroso notes over malty, honeyed Dalwhinnie; peaty and still heathery, spicy yet grapey.

Palate: A big, spicy buzz with clear, well-defined malt; a quick burst of sweetness, then rich and grapey.

Finish: Plenty of oak; very dry, with vanilla dominating.

g-m-caol-ila-1997-connoisseurs-choice.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Caol Ila 23 Year Old 1997 First Fill Sherry Butt Cask 12494 59.9% ABV
g-m-caol-ila-1997-connoisseurs-choice.bodyHtml:
Caol Ila 1997 23 Year Old is a single-cask Islay malt from Gordon & MacPhail's Connoisseurs Choice range, created in 1968 by George Urquhart to showcase single malts from across Scotland. Filled in 1997 into first-fill sherry butt cask 12494, it was bottled on 2 July 2021 at a natural cask strength of 59.9% ABV, giving 469 bottles, non-chill-filtered and with no added colour. Amber in the glass, it pairs Caol Ila's smoke with rich sherry: cured meat, baked apple and stewed raisins with festive spice, then a smooth, smoky palate of black pepper, nuts, cocoa and red berries, and a long, ashy finish of bonfire embers. 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Smoke, cured meat, dried fruit and spice.

Nose: Cured meat, baked apple and stewed raisins; festive spice, brown sugar and soft lemon peel.

Palate: Smooth and smoky; black pepper giving way to mixed nuts, cocoa, citrus, toasted almond and red berries.

Finish: Long and ashy, with lingering bonfire embers.

Serve: Neat, or with water to tame the cask strength.

banded-peak-mount-crushmore-keg-1.title: Banded Peak Mount Crushmore Keg 59L Keg

mouton-cadet-bordeaux-1.title: Mouton Cadet Rouge 2023
mouton-cadet-bordeaux-1.bodyHtml: The iconic Bordeaux wine, modern, assured and generous, with powerful red fruit and elegant black fruit aromas and flavours, as well as delicate touches of spice that give it an attractive freshness.

woodbridge-chardonnay-1.title: Woodbridge Chardonnay 750ml
woodbridge-chardonnay-1.bodyHtml: Woodbridge Chardonnay is a California white wine bottled at 13.5% ABV. Woodbridge is a California wine label based in Acampo, and the winery lists its Chardonnay among its best sellers. The producer describes a wine that opens with pear and slightly tropical aromas, then shows a palate that is clean and crisp yet silky, with notes of ripe peach and toasty tropical fruit. The winery suggests pairing it with roast chicken, or with a warm peach cobbler for dessert, and recommends serving it slightly chilled. Its easy-going style makes it a versatile choice for weeknight dinners and casual entertaining. A 750ml bottle.

warres-warrior-reserve-port.title: Warre's Warrior Reserve Port 750ml
warres-warrior-reserve-port.bodyHtml:
Warre's Warrior Reserve Port is a renowned fortified wine, a premium offering from the oldest British Port wine company established in Portugal. This wine presents a luscious array of deep, dark fruit flavors, with notes of blackberry, plum, and hints of rich dark chocolate and exotic spices.

On the palate, it is full-bodied and impressively rich, yet beautifully balanced, with a sweetness that is perfectly offset by its sturdy tannic structure and vibrant acidity. Its lingering, velvety finish makes it a thoroughly enjoyable sipping wine. An excellent accompaniment to cheese boards, desserts, or as a standalone after-dinner indulgence, the Warre's Warrior Reserve Port is a testament to the house's tradition of crafting superior Port wines.
Critic Ratings
Wine Spectator Review - Rated 90:
A fruity style, with luscious plum, raspberry and cherry flavors that are deep and rich. Asian spice and dark chocolate notes linger on the fresh, minerally finish. Drink now through 2025. 11,500 cases imported.

Wine & Spirits Review - Rated 90:
Fresher in style than the Warrior of the '90s, this blend is bright and vibrant, filled with luscious fruit inflected by the black pepper of schisty tannins. It's like a small-scale vintage, beautifully balanced.

kendall-jackson-pinot-noir.title: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Pinot Noir 2021
kendall-jackson-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Pinot Noir 2021 is a bright and approachable regional blend that highlights the vivid fruit character of California’s cool coastal growing regions. Sourced primarily from the benchlands of Monterey, Santa Barbara, and Sonoma counties, the grapes develop small, concentrated clusters due to persistent maritime influences and fog. The winemaking process involves keeping individual vineyard lots separate until the final blend, with the wine aging for 9.5 months in 98% French oak barrels (18% new) to integrate structure and aromatic depth. It delivers a classic aromatic profile of ripe cherry, strawberry, and raspberry intertwined with elegant earthy notes, cola, and mild spice. On the palate, it is supple and well-balanced, offering a smooth texture with hints of vanilla, toasted cedar, and a soft, lingering finish.

peller-family-dry-red.title: Peller Family Vineyards Dry Red 4L Bag in Box
peller-family-dry-red.bodyHtml: Dry and medium-bodied, this red wine has flavours of red berry fruit and hints of spice. An excellent wine for everyday enjoyment, special occasions or family gatherings.

kendall-jackson-sauvignon-blanc.title: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Sauvignon Blanc
kendall-jackson-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Kendall-Jackson Vintner’s Reserve Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp and aromatic regional blend primarily sourced from cool-climate vineyards in Lake, Mendocino, and Monterey Counties. This "Best Buy" staple is designed for immediate enjoyment, featuring a convenient screw cap for freshness and ease of pouring. The winemaking process involves small-lot fermentation, with a small portion (approximately 15%) matured in mostly neutral American oak to add gentle texture and complexity without overshadowing the fruit. It presents a pale straw hue with an expressive bouquet of honeysuckle, ripe pear, and lemongrass. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and refreshing, offering a zesty interplay of tropical grapefruit, tangerine, and white peach balanced by a subtle mineral quality and a hint of fig.

erben-auslese.title: Erben Auslese 750ml
erben-auslese.bodyHtml: Erben Auslese is a German Riesling from Rheinhessen, bottled at 10% ABV. Auslese is one of Germany's Prädikat ripeness levels, and the label describes this wine as edelsüss, or nobly sweet. The Erben label is produced by the Zimmermann-Graeff & Müller wine house, and its packaging carries the brand's black-and-red crest on a tall green flute bottle in the traditional German style. Rheinhessen is Germany's largest wine-growing region and enjoys some of the country's warmest and driest conditions. Serve chilled with spicy dishes, blue cheese or fruit desserts, or on its own. A 750ml bottle.

jam-jar-sweet-shiraz.title: Jam Jar Sweet Shiraz 2024 750ml
jam-jar-sweet-shiraz.bodyHtml: Jam Jar Sweet Shiraz is more fun style than your typical Shiraz, this fresh, fruity, semi-sweet wine displays aromas and flavors of ripe, juicy berries with dark chocolate undertones. The perfect balance between sweetness and acidity makes for a refreshing approachability. It is versatile food wine, best served lightly chilled. Jam Jar Sweet Shiraz tasting notes: mixed berries, dark chocolate undertones. Fruit-forward and sweet, with a clean finish.

frontera-merlot.title: Frontera Merlot
frontera-merlot.bodyHtml:
Frontera Merlot is a smooth, approachable, and fruit-forward Chilean red wine crafted by Concha y Toro. In the glass, it presents an attractive ruby-red color with bright violet undertones. The nose reveals fresh aromas of ripe red plums, dark cherries, and blackberries, subtly layered with touches of black pepper, vanilla, and cocoa. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and supple, displaying round fruit flavors supported by soft, velvety tannins, balanced acidity, and a clean, easy-drinking finish.

Food Pairing: Roast chicken, pasta with marinara sauce, grilled pork chops, mushroom quesadillas, and mild cheeses like Gouda.

wolf-blass-yellow-label-merlot.title: Wolf Blass Yellow Label Merlot 750ml
wolf-blass-yellow-label-merlot.bodyHtml: Wolf Blass Wines, established in 1966, has grown from a humble tin shed to become one of the world’s most successful and awarded wineries. Today, Wolf Blass wines are exported to more than 50 countries and are recognised internationally as icons of modern winemaking. The essence of Wolf Blass wines is exemplified through the passion of its custodians, past and present as they continue to create wines of quality, character and consistency.

peller-family-dry-white.title: Peller Family Vineyards Dry White 4L Bag In Box
peller-family-dry-white.bodyHtml:
Our Dry White (Vidal Blanc and Riesling) is made with grapes picked from the finest vineyards in Canada and around the world. Traditional white wine making with cool fermentation and aging in stainless steel tanks assists in enhancing aromatics and pure fruit flavours.

Clear and bright with aromas of yellow apple, pear and a hint of floral. The Dry White blend is a medium-bodied, easy-drinking white wine with flavours of apple, pear and melon. The refreshing finish has notes of green apple and citrus. Enjoy while young and fresh.

lindemans-bin-50-shiraz-2.title: Lindeman's Bin 50 Shiraz 2021 1.5L Magnum
lindemans-bin-50-shiraz-2.bodyHtml:
Lindeman's Bin 50 Shiraz 2021 is a generous Australian red showing ripe berry, plum and spice characters. The medium-to-full-bodied palate combines bright fruit with attractive oak influence, while a soft texture and smooth, persistent finish make this Shiraz an approachable expression with ample flavour and balance.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with barbecue beef ribs, grilled lamb chops, peppered steak, and slow-cooked brisket.

gray-monk-riesling-1.title: Gray Monk Riesling 750ml
gray-monk-riesling-1.bodyHtml: Clear and bright with pure fruit aromas of yellow apple, white peach, and sweet citrus. This light-bodied, refreshing white wine is medium-dry with great balancing acidity. Flavours of Meyer lemon, pineapple, and peach excite the palate. Fresh and clean with a citrus medley and green apple flavours lingering on the finish.

peller-family-chardonnay.title: Peller Family Vineyards Chardonnay 750ml
peller-family-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Chardonnay is the world’s most popular white wine, known for its flavours of ripe pear, hazelnuts and vanilla. Smooth and light to medium-bodied, this wine has a hint of spicy oak, and a mellow, balanced finish. Serve with roast chicken, grilled vegetables or salads.

peller-family-chardonnay-1.title: Peller Family Vineyards Chardonnay 1.5L Magnum
peller-family-chardonnay-1.bodyHtml: A light to medium-bodied, smooth yet refreshing Chardonnay with apple, pear and oak flavours.

peller-family-chardonnay-2.title: Peller Family Vineyards Chardonnay 4L Bag In Box
peller-family-chardonnay-2.bodyHtml: A light to medium-bodied, smooth yet refreshing Chardonnay with apple, pear and oak flavours.

peller-family-dry-white-1.title: Peller Family Vineyards Dry White 4L Bag In Box
peller-family-dry-white-1.bodyHtml:
Our Dry White (Vidal Blanc and Riesling) is made with grapes picked from the finest vineyards in Canada and around the world. Traditional white wine making with cool fermentation and aging in stainless steel tanks assists in enhancing aromatics and pure fruit flavours.

Clear and bright with aromas of yellow apple, pear and a hint of floral. The Dry White blend is a medium-bodied, easy-drinking white wine with flavours of apple, pear and melon. The refreshing finish has notes of green apple and citrus. Enjoy while young and fresh.

peller-family-dry-red-1.title: Peller Family Vineyards Reserve Dry Red 4L Bag In Box
peller-family-dry-red-1.bodyHtml: Dry and medium-bodied, this red wine has flavors of red berry fruit and hints of spice. An excellent wine for everyday enjoyment, special occasions or family gatherings.

lindemans-bin-85-pinot-grigio-1.title: Lindemans Bin 85 Pinot Grigio 750ml
lindemans-bin-85-pinot-grigio-1.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2015 vintage) "Every year I say the same thing about this wine but it is the truth – this is a well-made, fun to drink, grigio for the price. As fresh as it gets, this light, lean, northern Italian style grigio opens with bits of citrus fruit and honey. The attack mirrors the nose with round, citrus, watery, gulpable, grapefruit flavors. Good value in a clean, fresh, white wine for only $11. A super mid-week bargain. (Anthony Gismondi)." - 86/100, Gismondi on Wine

peller-family-shiraz.title: Peller Estates Family Vineyards Shiraz
peller-family-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Peller Estates Family Vineyards Shiraz is an approachable and medium-bodied red wine crafted to deliver a bold, fruit-forward profile with a smooth and easy-drinking texture. Sourced from vineyards across Ontario, this wine is designed for everyday enjoyment, offering a reliable character that balances ripe fruit with subtle savoury notes. It presents a deep ruby colour and an expressive aromatic bouquet of blackberries, dark plums, and black currants, accented by a signature hint of cracked black pepper and soft toasted oak. On the palate, it is supple and well-rounded, featuring velvety tannins and a clean, spicy finish that makes it a versatile choice for casual dinners, backyard barbecues, or social gatherings. 

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with hearty, medium-flavoured foods such as barbecued ribs, smoked brisket, grilled hamburgers with cheese and mushrooms, juicy sausages, roasted lamb, wild mushroom dishes, or a casual charcuterie platter featuring medium cheeses.

peller-family-shiraz-1.title: Peller Family Vineyards Shiraz 1.5L Magnum
peller-family-shiraz-1.bodyHtml: Soft and generous with upfront black plum and licorice flavours supported by a hint of coffee beans on the finish. Shiraz is a great choice for entertaining; serve with barbecued ribs, smoked brisket, burgers with cheese and mushrooms or a charcuterie platter.

peller-family-shiraz-2.title: Peller Family Vineyards Shiraz 4L Bag In Box
peller-family-shiraz-2.bodyHtml: An easy drinking red wine with plenty of plum, cherry and spice flavours.

fat-bastard-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Fat Bastard Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
fat-bastard-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: FAT bastard Cabernet Sauvignon is sourced from low-yielding vines grown in the foothills of Pézenas near the revered Minervois appellation in the heart of Languedoc-Roussillon, in the South of France. There the vines thrive in an ideal environment offering soils and climates particularly diversified. Our cabernet-Sauvignon is expressive, powerful and smooth all at once.

barefoot-merlot-1.title: Barefoot Merlot 750ml
barefoot-merlot-1.bodyHtml: A consistently good, award-winning merlot from California. Valued priced and made in a crowd-pleasing style. Ruby red in colour, the nose reveals upfront toast, prune and cassis aromas with notes of spiced chocolate. Dry, light to medium-bodied and rounded, with balanced silky tannins on the long lively berry fruit finish.

copper-moon-sauvignon-blanc-1.title: Copper Moon Sauvignon Blanc
copper-moon-sauvignon-blanc-1.bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh, crisp, and easy-drinking Canadian white wine crafted to be light-bodied and accessible. In the glass, it displays a bright pale-yellow hue accompanied by lively, uplifting aromas of lime, pink grapefruit, fresh green apple, and subtle herbal notes. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, vibrant texture with crisp citrus fruit flavors, clean acidity, and a refreshing, dry finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs delightfully with fresh garden salads, goat cheese crostini, grilled chicken breast, pan-seared white fish, oysters, or light pasta dishes.

blu-giovello-prosecco-doc.title: Piera Martellozzo Blu Giovello Prosecco 750ml
blu-giovello-prosecco-doc.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: "In the distinctive blue glass, this glera comes off vineyards at 400m, and is finished with 16 g/L RS. Apricot blossoms, white peach, crunchy pear fills a short palate, finishing with a bitter lemon twist. Simple stuff, and ready to use in a spring punch. (Treve Ring)." - 86/100, Gismondi on Wine

canella-prosecco-docg.title: Canella Prosecco
canella-prosecco-docg.bodyHtml:
Canella Prosecco is a classic, brightly aromatic Italian sparkling wine produced by Cantina Canella. It exhibits a straw-yellow color with a fine, persistent perlage. On the nose, it offers delicate aromatics of crisp green apple, white peach, citrus peel, and soft floral notes. The palate features a smooth, refreshing texture with lively acidity, balanced fruit flavors, and a clean, crisp finish.

Food Pairing: Light appetizers, seafood pasta, vegetable risotto, fresh cheeses, and cured meats.

copper-moon-sauvignon-blanc-2.title: Copper Moon Sauvignon Blanc
copper-moon-sauvignon-blanc-2.bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh, crisp, and easy-drinking Canadian white wine crafted to be light-bodied and accessible. In the glass, it displays a bright pale-yellow hue accompanied by lively, uplifting aromas of lime, pink grapefruit, fresh green apple, and subtle herbal notes. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, vibrant texture with crisp citrus fruit flavors, clean acidity, and a refreshing, dry finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs delightfully with fresh garden salads, goat cheese crostini, grilled chicken breast, pan-seared white fish, oysters, or light pasta dishes.

sledgehammer-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
sledgehammer-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a highly refined, elegant, and classic expression of Napa Valley. It presents a deep, saturated ruby color and features a vibrant nose of black raspberry, blackcurrant, and dark blackberry preserves, layered with delicate floral notes of violet and lavender. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, its boisterous and bright dark fruit flavors are supported by savory hints of chaparral sagebrush, bay laurel, and subtle cedar. The texture is soft and silky, framed by velvety-rich tannins and crisp acidity that offer a balanced, firm grip leading into a long, sumptuous finish.

Food Pairing: This savory, structured Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, herb-crusted rack of lamb, or rich mushroom ravioli.

93 Points - James Suckling

A very refined and polished red with fine tannins, bright acidity and a tangy undertone. Medium-bodied, juicy and savory. Citrusy. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Earthy, cocoa powder aromatics combine with ripe black fruits on the palate. Lengthy, robust, full bodied and fully flavored, this powerful wine is carried by powdery-fine tannins and a persistent, palate-cleansing acidity.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

There's a caressing feel to the mix of cassis and boysenberry puree flavors that are gilded with a pretty violet note. The long finish has a toasty edge and lingers prettily.

pasqua-prosecco.title: Pasqua Prosecco Treviso Extra Dry
pasqua-prosecco.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: "This pretty, polished sparkler has delicate aromas of white spring flowers and orchard fruit. Dry and tangy, the fruity palate offers creamy white peach, pear and green melon alongside crisp acidity. Kerin O’Keefe" - 88/100, Wine Enthusiast

chocovine-chocolate-and-french-wine.title: Chocovine Chocolate And French Wine 750ml
chocovine-chocolate-and-french-wine.bodyHtml: ChocoVine is a fine French Cabernet subtly combined with a rich dark chocolate from Holland, paired together to make a decadent, silky smooth drink. It can be served on the rocks or as the main ingredient to an array of sinful cocktails.

cliff-79-chardonnay.title: Rombauer Chardonnay 2024
cliff-79-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Rombauer Chardonnay 2024 is a lush, opulent, and iconic California white wine crafted by Rombauer Vineyards. Sourced primarily from sustainably farmed vineyards in the cool, fog-shrouded Carneros region—where marine breezes from San Pablo Bay preserve bright natural acidity—the grapes were gently whole-cluster pressed and fermented in French oak barrels. Following fermentation, the wine underwent full malolactic fermentation and aged for nine months on its lees with regular stirring (bâtonnage) in new and used French oak, imparting its signature creamy texture and decadent barrel spice. In the glass, it displays a luminous pale yellow hue with shimmering green-gold highlights. The aromatic profile opens with expressive notes of ripe yellow peach, melon, and Meyer lemon zest layered with vanilla bean, toasted oak, and subtle baking spice. On the palate, it delivers a rich, full-bodied mouthfeel balanced by crisp citrus acidity, culminating in a long, smooth, and buttery finish.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy fettuccine Alfredo, or mild triple-cream Brie cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Classic in every sense, with freshness and purity underneath the generosity and richness this wine is known for. Cookies, pastry and sweet spices alongside ripe orchard fruit, apples and vanilla. The textural palate shows bright acidity and lovely balance, with saline notes and preserved lemons. Consistent and well-made. Drink or hold.

cliff-79-cabernet-shiraz.title: Penfolds Bin 600 California Cabernet-Shiraz 2019
cliff-79-cabernet-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 600 California Cabernet-Shiraz 2019 is an expressive, full-bodied red blend representing the realization of Penfolds' historic multi-decade venture in California winemaking. Sourced from vineyard parcels in Napa Valley, Sonoma County, and Paso Robles, and incorporating Shiraz budwood traced directly from Penfolds' revered South Australian heritage vine cuttings, this cuvée was matured for 17 months in American oak. In the glass, it reveals a shimmering garnet core with a bright cherry-red rim. The bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of ripe cassis, black cherries, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with notes of cured meats, dried savory herbs, clove, mocha, and toasted sweet oak. On the palate, it delivers a generous, glossy texture underpinned by concentrated dark fruit flavors, supple yet structured fine tannins, and vibrant natural acidity that carries through to a lingering, spicy, and polished finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rosemary rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, barbecue brisket, and mature hard cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Advocate

The 2019 Bin 600 is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz. The Cabernet Sauvignon is from a selection of vineyards across Napa, "and there is a little it of Sonoma in there as well," says Peter Gago. The Shiraz is from the Paso Robles vineyard; it's a 78/22 blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz. The fruit heres is so sweet and plush—there is a distinct red berry character that settles and plumes on the mid-palate. Texturally, it is supple, silky and almost plump. 2019 was generally mild and good, and it has produced a suite of wines that are luscious and opulent. The tannins are the framework that drags the fruit back from the edge and brings balance and form to the wine. Smart.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Sourcing 83% Cabernet Sauvignon from the Napa Valley and 17% Shiraz from Paso Robles, this imaginative blend is structured and meaty, showing notes of cigar box, toasted oak and wild game. Red fruit-dominant, it unfurls layers of cassis and red cherry with ease, finishing in creamy mocha.

screw-it-pinot-grigio-1.title: Screw It! Pinot Grigio 750ml
screw-it-pinot-grigio-1.bodyHtml: Plump peach and citrus aromas, blend to create this light and crisp Pinot Grigio with a refreshing finish. Unscrew it with your favourite pan-seared seafood choice, artisanal cheeses or perfect for enjoying on its own.

johnny-q-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Quarisa Johnny Q Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 750ml
johnny-q-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: These bold wines incorporate rich black fruit flavours and spice in a densely structured profile with firm tannins, making them great pairings for steaks, barbeque fare and full-flavoured cheeses. Typical flavours include cassis, plum, black cherry, cedar, oak, vanilla, spice and smoke.

donini-pinot-grigio.title: Scarpetta Pinot Grigio 2024
donini-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Scarpetta Pinot Grigio 2024 is an vibrant, elegant, and beautifully structured Italian white wine produced by Scarpetta in Friuli-Venezia Giulia. Sourced from graveled soils in Friuli Grave and steep hillside "Ponca" soils in Colli Orientali, it displays a light straw-yellow hue with subtle pale salmon reflections. On the nose, it offers fragrant aromas of honeydew melon, white peach, crushed stone, and delicate floral notes. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied and lively, featuring mouthwatering natural acidity, ripe orchard fruit flavors, and a clean, refreshing mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Excellent on its own as an aperitivo, or paired with fresh ceviche, pesce crudo, grilled sea bass, goat cheese salads, and vegetable quiche.

van-ruiten-pinot-grigio.title: ViNO Pinot Grigio
van-ruiten-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
ViNO Pinot Grigio is a stunning, crisp, and engaging white wine crafted exclusively from premium fruit grown along the steep cliffs of the Columbia River. Completely fermented and aged in stainless steel with zero malolactic fermentation, it opens with a lively, expressive bouquet of Meyer lemon, Italian melon, white peach, white lilac, and fresh-cut golden hay. The palate is beautifully balanced and focused, delivering a mouthful of wet slate, kumquat, and guava supported by a refreshing, vibrant acidity that extends into an incredibly satisfying, minerally finish.

Food Pairing:

This bright, high-acid Pinot Grigio pairs excellently with fresh oysters, grilled halibut, light cream-sauce pastas, chicken piccata, or a crisp goat cheese salad.

winters-kiss-riesling-ice-wine.title: Cave Spring Riesling Ice Wine 750ml
winters-kiss-riesling-ice-wine.bodyHtml: Cave Spring Riesling Ice Wine is a sweet, concentrated wine made from 100% Riesling grapes that are naturally frozen on the vine in the Lincoln Lakeshore region of Ontario, Canada. It's known for its intense citrus and floral aromas, along with flavors of pear drops, herbs, peach pie, and a rich, crisp acidity. The wine has a balance of sweetness and acidity, making it a delicious and versatile dessert wine.

winters-kiss-cabernet-franc-icewine.title: Inniskillin Icewine Cabernet Franc 2023 375ml
winters-kiss-cabernet-franc-icewine.bodyHtml:
Inniskillin Icewine Cabernet Franc 2023 is a luxurious, world-renowned Canadian dessert wine harvested at frozen temperatures in the Niagara Peninsula. Sourced from naturally frozen vines, it displays an alluring dark garnet-pink hue and opens with vibrant, decadent aromatics of fresh field strawberries, red cherry preserve, rhubarb, and citrus zest. On the palate, it delivers a rich, velvety texture driven by concentrated sweet red berry flavors and a subtle leafy spice, perfectly balanced by a striking, bright acidity that ensures a clean, lively, and incredibly long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with dark chocolate tarts, berry crumbles, strawberry cheesecake, artisan blue cheese, or seared foie gras with berry reduction. 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

The fruit expression exudes black currant and cassis, accented by coffee and clove. Juicy and sweet, this is defined by vivid acidity, ending with a blackberry candy element. Shows excellent drive and length. Drink now through 2036.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Whoever first decided to make icewine with Cabernet Franc grapes should be given a medal. Inniskillin's latest version is a holiday aroma extravaganza of spicy plum pudding and a bowl of earthy wild strawberries. The wine's peach pie, sweet rhubarb tartlet and rose water flavors feel right at home slipping and sliding all over its lubricious texture. Somehow, someday, I will find the perfect dark chocolate to pair with this crimson-colored treat.

cassone-siete-cuchillos-white-blend.title: Conundrum White Blend
cassone-siete-cuchillos-white-blend.bodyHtml:
Conundrum White Blend pours a vibrant pale straw-gold color in the glass. Created by the legendary Wagner family of Caymus fame, this exotic and highly popular Californian multi-varietal blend delivers an remarkably fragrant bouquet. Layers of ripe apricot, white peach, honeysuckle, and tropical mango mingle with zesty accents of ruby grapefruit, tangerine, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine balances a rich, round, and texturally generous medium-to-full body with a crisp vein of natural acidity. Luscious orchard fruits and a touch of off-dry melon sweetness flow into a beautifully clean, bright, and persistent finish marked by a subtle, refreshing minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spicy Thai coconut curry, grilled chicken with mango salsa, blackened Cajun shrimp, or fresh fish tacos.

red-truck-blend.title: The Prisoner Red Blend 2021/2022
red-truck-blend.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Red Blend 2022 is a rich, full-bodied, and deeply concentrated California red wine anchored by Zinfandel and supported by Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Sirah, Syrah, and Charbono. On the nose, it opens with bold, inviting aromas of ripe black cherry, dark plum, and blackberry jam, interwoven with warm notes of vanilla bean, dark chocolate, sweet clove, and toasted oak. The palate delivers a lush, velvety mouthfeel packed with ripe dark fruit flavors, smooth, polished tannins, and balanced acidity, leading into a long, persistent, and oak-spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, barbecued pork ribs, roasted lamb chops, rich beef stews, and sharp aged cheeses.

eipca-malbec.title: Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023
eipca-malbec.bodyHtml:
Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023 is a powerful yet incredibly elegant Argentine red crafted by Dr. Laura Catena, highlighting the genetic diversity and depth of Mendoza's historic, low-yielding vines. Sourced from high-altitude, ungrafted vines (averaging over 50 years old) across premier subregions of the Uco Valley—including La Consulta, Gualtallary, and Paraje Altamira—it pours a deep, luminous purplish-red. The nose is inviting and complex, offering expressive aromas of dark plums, ripe black cherries, and wild berries, thoughtfully accented by notes of cocoa, bark, charcoal, and subtle dried herbs. On the palate, it is precise, linear, and gracefully structured, showcasing a juicy core of crunchy red and blue fruit balanced by velvety, approachable tannins and a vibrant vein of natural acidity. Matured for 12 months in a combination of new and second-use French oak barrels, it delivers a deeply refined and stylish finish laced with savory hints of espresso and bright mineral tension.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with grilled venison, traditional Argentine ribeye steak with chimichurri, roasted lamb shanks, hearty pork roast, or medium-strong cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

This shows plums, bark and charcoal on the nose. The palate is precise, sharp, linear and super elegant, with velvety tannins and crunchy fruit. It’s long, refined and very stylish. Drink now.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Old Vine Malbec combines ungrafted vines from six Uco Valley growers who previously sold grapes for use in bulk wines. It was destemmed and fermented in stainless tank before maturing for 12 months in 35% new barrique. Opening with a pleasant nose of red and blue fruits, anise and dried spices, the palate is plush and straightforward, concluding with a lifted, fragrant finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose reveals enticing aromas of crushed berries leading the way to a juicy palate filled with rich dark fruit flavors and a hint of rosemary. Framed by gripping tannins and vibrant acidity, this full-bodied Malbec features a distinctive chalky texture and a long lasting finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Hints of roasted herbs and loam lead but quickly give way to the core flavors of Santa Rosa plum and cherry, culminating with crunchy acidity, mineral and cocoa powder notes that fill out the structured finish.

las-nencias-family-select-malbec.title: Altamira de Los Andes Navigato Family Selection Grand Reserve 2010
las-nencias-family-select-malbec.bodyHtml:
Altamira de Los Andes Navigato Family Selection Grand Reserve 2010 is a bold, expressive, and deeply complex New World red blend that beautifully showcases the aging potential and structural density of high-altitude old vines. It pours an inviting, dark black-garnet colour in the glass, lifting with a bright, layered bouquet of melted chocolate, wild blueberry paste, olive tapenade, and toasted herbs, seamlessly accented by warm vanilla custard and delicate spices. On the palate, this full-bodied blend is remarkably smooth, juicy, and massive, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of concentrated raspberry, blackberry, and cocoa shavings that balance the naturally potent, well-evolved character of the 2010 vintage. Hand-harvested and aged meticulously in new French oak barrels, its structural crunch is sustained by chewy, firm tannins and a balanced acidity that carries into a long, warming, and mineral-driven finish with lingering hints of black pepper and cedar wood.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with hearty or premium red meat fare, including juicy grilled steaks served rare, slow-roasted venison or wild game stews, roasted duck breast, wood-fired mushroom pizzas, and a platter of hard, aged artisanal cheeses.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Concentrated berry and plum aromas are potent. In the mouth, this blend of Malbec, Petit Verdot and Cab Franc is massive but also abrasive and narrowing due to fierce tannins. Giant raspberry and blackberry flavors include chocolate and coffee notes. It settles on the finish but remains scratchy out the back door. Drink through 2025.

91 Points - James Suckling

A finely crafted red with blueberry, blackberry and hints walnuts. Full body, fine tannins and a fresh finish. A delicious blend of malbec, petit verdot and cabernet franc. Drinking very well now.

errazuriz-max-reserva-sauvignon-blanc.title: Errazuriz Max Reserva Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
errazuriz-max-reserva-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: The citric notes, green apple and herbal touches dominate the palate, giving an intense varietal character and tension. It has excellent persistence, medium volume, broad entrance, and acidity, creating a vertical, balanced, refreshing wine.

invisibull-malbec.title: Invisibull Malbec
invisibull-malbec.bodyHtml:
Invisibull Malbec is a smooth, fruit-forward Canadian red wine from British Columbia. Offering an approachable expression of Malbec, it features rich blackberry and ripe plum flavours complemented by black cherry, subtle mocha, and gentle spice. Its medium-to-full body, velvety texture, and soft tannins create an enjoyable balance of fruit and structure. Bottled at 12.5% ABV, this versatile red is an excellent choice for casual gatherings, barbecues, and everyday dining.

Food Pairing: Grilled steak, barbecue ribs, beef burgers, roasted lamb, spicy empanadas, mushroom dishes, and smoky grilled eggplant.

masi-modello-rosso.title: Masi Modello Rosso 2023 3L Bag In Box
masi-modello-rosso.bodyHtml: A full-bodied wine with soft, silky tannins. Fruity notes of Marasca cherry, plums and raspberries leave a lasting impression. Medium intensity nose of forest underbrush.

the-winemakers-house-pinot-grigio-1.title: The Winemaker's House Pinot Grigio 4L Bag In Box
the-winemakers-house-pinot-grigio-1.bodyHtml: The Winemaker's House Pinot Grigio 4L Bag In Box

the-winemakers-house-merlot-1.title: Ghost Pines "Winemaker's Blend" Merlot 2020
the-winemakers-house-merlot-1.bodyHtml: A rich and multifaceted California red, the 2020 Ghost Pines Merlot is a masterclass in multi-appellation blending, sourcing premium fruit from both Sonoma and Napa counties. This wine presents an intense dark ruby color and opens with an inviting bouquet of ripe black cherry, plum, and marionberry, complemented by sophisticated notes of mocha, toasted oak, and a touch of savory dried herbs. On the palate, it is full-bodied and supple, offering a velvety mouthfeel with plush tannins and balanced acidity. Layers of dark chocolate and vanilla bean emerge through the mid-palate, leading to a smooth, long-lasting finish that reflects the depth and structure of its high-quality coastal vineyard origins.

lindemans-bin-85-pinot-grigio-2.title: Lindemans Bin 85 Pinot Grigio 750ml
lindemans-bin-85-pinot-grigio-2.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2015 vintage) "Every year I say the same thing about this wine but it is the truth – this is a well-made, fun to drink, grigio for the price. As fresh as it gets, this light, lean, northern Italian style grigio opens with bits of citrus fruit and honey. The attack mirrors the nose with round, citrus, watery, gulpable, grapefruit flavors. Good value in a clean, fresh, white wine for only $11. A super mid-week bargain. (Anthony Gismondi)." - 86/100, Gismondi on Wine

lindemans-bin-65-chardonnay-2.title: Lindemans Bin 65 Chardonnay 250ml
lindemans-bin-65-chardonnay-2.bodyHtml: Lindeman's Chardonnay in a 250ml can is the Australian winery's best-known wine in a single-serve format. The Lindeman's name dates back to 1843 and Dr Henry John Lindeman, as shown on the can. This is a fresh, vibrant Chardonnay with generous flavour: aromas of peach, fig, tropical fruit and toasty oak lead to a medium-bodied palate with a fresh, crisp finish. 250ml can at 8.5% ABV.

gemma-di-luna-prosecco.title: Gemma Di Luna Prosecco 750ml
gemma-di-luna-prosecco.bodyHtml: Italy - "Gemma di Luna Prosecco is full of bubble goodness. It has notes of ripe citrus, lemon, apple, and grapefruit with finishing touches that are light, refreshing, and crisp."

copper-moon-smooth-red-1.title: Copper Moon Smooth Red 750ml
copper-moon-smooth-red-1.bodyHtml:
This wine is an approachable, food friendly red. Notes of red berry and cherry on the nose stay consitent through the taste profile. This is a meduim bodied red, with good acidity to pair with a wide range of foods.

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast
A soft and approachable red blend featuring straightforward notes of ripe berries and a hint of mocha. Easy-drinking with a smooth texture and crowd-pleasing profile that offers reliable everyday value.
86 Points - Tastings.com
Features simple, fruity flavors with minimal tannins and a clean finish. A consistent and uncomplicated choice for casual enjoyment.

copper-moon-smooth-white-1.title: Copper Moon Smooth White 4L Bag in Box
copper-moon-smooth-white-1.bodyHtml:
Bright, inviting aromas of crisp green apple, ripe pear, white peach, and delicate citrus blossom greet the nose. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied, smooth, and approachable, offering juicy orchard and tropical fruit flavours balanced by gentle sweetness and clean, refreshing acidity on a soft, easy-drinking finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast chicken, grilled shrimp skewers, garden salads, mild white fish, creamy pasta dishes, or soft cheeses.

le-blanc-deulalie.title: La Garreliere Le Blanc De La Mariee Sauv
le-blanc-deulalie.bodyHtml:
Produced from 100% Sauvignon Blanc grown on sandy soils over flint clay in the Loire Valley, this wine is gently pressed, fermented with native yeasts and aged on fine lees before spring bottling. It offers freshness, purity and mineral character.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, shellfish, grilled white fish, goat cheese and fresh seasonal salads.

mula-velha-white.title: Mula Velha White 2021 750ml
mula-velha-white.bodyHtml:
Formerly, this wine was part of Quinta do Gradil

Critic tasting note: (2015 vintage) "A fruity blend of local Lisboa grapes along with Chardonnay, this wine is rich and full of citrus and crisp apple flavors. It is a ripe wine with a creamy texture enhanced by toast from the wood aging. Drink this wine from late 2017." - 88/100, Wine Enthusiast

la-marca-prosecco-2.title: La Marca Prosecco 375ml
la-marca-prosecco-2.bodyHtml: The delicate La Marca Prosecco has a pale, golden straw color and sparkles with lively effervescence. Opening with aromas of fresh-picked citrus and honeysuckle blossoms, the crisp, clean palate brings fruity notes of green apple, juicy peach and ripe lemon, framed by hints of minerality.

evindencia-dao-reserva-white.title: Taboadella Encruzado Reserva 2022 750ml
evindencia-dao-reserva-white.bodyHtml:
Encruzado, also known as Salgueirinho, is an endemic grape variety from the Dão region. Cultivated in the sheltered highlands of Taboadella’s vineyard, in granites that have metamorphosed over hundreds of thousands of years, this lot of wines shares the special care taken with the Encruzado grape variety. The delicate cultivation of the Encruzado vines requires increased attention during the growing season, delivering tremendous rewards - the Taboadella Encruzado Reserva white is firm and exuberant, with a silky texture, linear structure and notable depth. It is a wine of the present and future.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The wine, made from Encruzado, the signature white variety of the Dão, is endowed with richness and layers of toasty wood. Creamy in texture, with baked apple and spice flavors, the wine is already delicious but will improve further. Drink from 2026.

trivento-reserve-white-malbec.title: Trivento Reserve White Malbec
trivento-reserve-white-malbec.bodyHtml:
Trivento Reserve White Malbec is an innovative, crisp, and refreshing Argentine white wine crafted by Bodega Trivento in Mendoza from early-harvested red Malbec grapes. Gently pressed without skin contact to prevent pigment extraction and fermented at low temperatures in stainless steel tanks to preserve aromatic purity, it pours a crystalline, pale silver-lemon hue in the glass. The bouquet opens with vibrant notes of green apple, red apple, white peach, and subtle tropical hints of lychee and citrus zest. On the palate, it delivers a light-to-medium body marked by lively, mouthwatering acidity and delicate orchard fruit flavors, culminating in a clean, dry, and mineral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh ceviche, grilled shrimp skewers, summer salads with goat cheese, spicy Thai chicken salad, or soft triple-cream Brie cheese.

naked-grape-cabernet-sauvignon-1.title: Naked Grape Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
naked-grape-cabernet-sauvignon-1.bodyHtml: Naked Grape Unoaked Cabernet Sauvignon is an easy-drinking Canadian red made without oak ageing, letting the fruit lead. It is medium ruby in colour, with forward aromas and flavours of ripe plum, currant and black cherry and a light herbal touch. Dry and medium-bodied, it has rounded tannins, a juicy core of fruit and a moderate finish. Enjoy it with grilled sandwiches, braised beef, grilled white meats or pizza. This listing is a 750ml screw-cap bottle at 12.5% ABV.

jackson-triggs-malbec.title: Jackson Triggs Malbec 750ml
jackson-triggs-malbec.bodyHtml: Jackson Triggs Malbec is a 750ml bottle of red wine made from Malbec grapes. It's known for its medium body, smooth finish, and flavors of berries, plum, spice, and subtle floral notes. This Malbec is a Canadian wine from the Niagara Peninsula, with an ABV of 13.0%.

jackson-triggs-malbec-2.title: Jackson Triggs Malbec 750ml
jackson-triggs-malbec-2.bodyHtml: Jackson Triggs Malbec is a 750ml bottle of red wine made from Malbec grapes. It's known for its medium body, smooth finish, and flavors of berries, plum, spice, and subtle floral notes. This Malbec is a Canadian wine from the Niagara Peninsula, with an ABV of 13.0%.

greystone-park-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
greystone-park-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a classic, classic-styled Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon crafted from premium vineyard sources across the valley floor and mountain slopes. In the glass, it displays a deep garnet-purple color with intense clarity. The bouquet opens with inviting aromas of blackberry jam, dark plum, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with notes of milk chocolate, baking spices, cedar, dried tobacco, and subtle forest floor. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and supple, offering a dense core of black fruit flavor underpinned by fine-grained, firm tannins and a balanced, lively acidity that leads to a long, polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, savory venison stews, and aged hard cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This bold, ripe but nicely polished wine wraps black cherries, black currants and mint in moderate, fine-grained tannins that will help carry it for several years. Subtle cinnamon, clove and cedar accents keep it interesting on the finish. Best through 2030.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, polished style, with a relatively open-knit core of boysenberry and black cherry compote backed by friendly singed vanilla and licorice notes. A crowd-pleaser. Drink now through 2031.

greystone-park-sauvignon-blanc.title: Oak & Priest Sauvignon Blanc 'Out of the Park' 750ml
greystone-park-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Oak & Priest's "Out of the Park" Sauvignon Blanc is a rich and full-bodied white wine blend, featuring fresh citrus and stone fruit flavors, along with notes of minerality and crisp acidity. The addition of Semillon adds a touch of weight and viscosity, deepening the mid-palate and lengthening the finish.

castello-di-monsanto-chianti-class-riser.title: Castello Di Monsanto Chianti Classico Riserva 2019
castello-di-monsanto-chianti-class-riser.bodyHtml:
Castello Di Monsanto Chianti Classico Riserva 2019 is an exceptionally elegant, vibrant, and traditional Tuscan red wine that beautifully captures the balance of an exceptional, highly celebrated growing season. Pouring a radiant ruby-red color with slight garnet hues, it unfurls a complex and layered bouquet marked by aromas of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and crushed violets, beautifully complexed by savory nuances of tobacco leaf, dried sage, flinty minerals, and a touch of black pepper. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red shows superb concentration, energy, and precision, matching a juicy core of dark berry fruit with a linear vein of crisp natural acidity. Aged for 18 months in a combination of large oak casks and small French oak barrels, its firm, tightly knit mountain tannins provide a sturdy structure that drives the wine into a remarkably long, savory, and focused finish accented by lingering traces of iron, blood orange peel, and earthy undertones.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with grilled Bistecca alla Fiorentina, slow-braised wild boar ragù, roasted rosemary lamb chops, or an earthy wild mushroom truffle risotto.

94 Points - James Suckling

Crushed stones with black cherries and fresh flowers. Medium to full body, firm tannins and a flavorful finish. Still so young and fruity with wonderful energy. Give it another two or three years, if you can bear to wait.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Riservas from across the appellation are showing very well in 2019. This wine is no exception. The 2019 Chianti Classico Riserva (which is a blend of 90% Sangiovese with Canaiolo and Colorino aged in different-sized oak barrels for up to 18 months) offers pretty richness and concentration. The wine's ample volume is fleshed out with dark fruit, spice and blue flower. It should be fun to try this wine in five years' time, when it loses its baby fat. Happily, production is very generous, with 200,000 bottles made.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A sleek, tightly wound red, with black cherry and blackberry fruit shaded by iron, herbs and tobacco. Linear in profile and vibrant, with a long, slightly chewy finish. Best from 2024 through 2037.

emilio-moro-tempranillo.title: Emilio Moro 2023
emilio-moro-tempranillo.bodyHtml:
Emilio Moro 2023 is a refined, classic, and expressive Spanish red wine crafted by the legendary Bodegas Emilio Moro in the heart of the Ribera del Duero region. Made from 100% Tinto Fino (Tempranillo) sourced from middle-aged vines grown on a mix of clay, limestone, and gravelly soils, it undergoes temperature-controlled fermentation before aging for 12 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels. In the glass, it presents an intense cherry-red color with dark ruby reflections. The bouquet opens with fragrant, vibrant aromas of ripe dark plum, blackberry, and Morello cherry, layered with subtle undertones of cocoa, toasted spice, licorice, and sweet vanilla. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied, juicy, and polished, featuring dense, ripe black fruit supported by fine-grained, velvety tannins and fresh natural acidity that leads into a long, harmonious, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with roasted rack of lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, wild boar ragù, roasted pork tenderloin, and aged Manchego cheese.

jaboulet-chateauneuf-du-pape-les-cedres.title: Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aine Chateauneuf-du-Pape Les Cedres 2020
jaboulet-chateauneuf-du-pape-les-cedres.bodyHtml:
Domaine Paul Jaboulet Aîné Châteauneuf-du-Pape Les Cèdres 2020 is an exceptional, organically certified red wine that demonstrates the remarkable elegance and balance of this renowned Southern Rhône vintage. On the nose, it offers a fragrant, expressive bouquet filled with ripe red wild berries, succulent dark cherries, and fresh plum, layered with complex notes of sandalwood, mocha, dried rose petals, and a touch of game. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and mouth-coating, yet beautifully framed by a lively natural acidity and fresh mineral undertones. The plush, juicy core of sweet dark fruit is expertly supported by ripe, fine-grained tannins, leading into a long, harmonious finish featuring a subtle lift of garrigue and savory baking spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with herb-crusted grilled lamb chops, slow-roasted venison stew, jasmine tea smoked pork ribs, and aged hard cheeses like Mimolette.

romain-duvernay-chateauneuf-du-pape.title: Romain Duvernay Chateauneuf-du-Pape Red 2022
romain-duvernay-chateauneuf-du-pape.bodyHtml:
Romain Duvernay Châteauneuf-du-Pape Red 2022 is a rich, full-bodied, and harmonious Southern Rhône red blend crafted by talent talent and talented oenologist Romain Duvernay. Sourced from the prestigious stony, quartz-covered soils of Châteauneuf-du-Pape, this wine is dominated by Grenache and complemented by Syrah and Mourvèdre. The 2022 vintage displays an intense ruby-garnet color with rich aromatics of ripe dark cherries, red plums, and kirsch, alongside garrigue herbs, black pepper, and subtle smoky undertones. On the palate, it exhibits a plush, well-structured mouthfeel with ripe, well-integrated tannins, fresh balanced acidity, and a long, warming finish filled with dark fruit and spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, venison stew, wild mushroom ragù, and aged hard cheeses.

staglin-salus-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
staglin-salus-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a highly refined, elegant, and classic expression of Napa Valley. It presents a deep, saturated ruby color and features a vibrant nose of black raspberry, blackcurrant, and dark blackberry preserves, layered with delicate floral notes of violet and lavender. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, its boisterous and bright dark fruit flavors are supported by savory hints of chaparral sagebrush, bay laurel, and subtle cedar. The texture is soft and silky, framed by velvety-rich tannins and crisp acidity that offer a balanced, firm grip leading into a long, sumptuous finish.

Food Pairing: This savory, structured Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, herb-crusted rack of lamb, or rich mushroom ravioli.

93 Points - James Suckling

A very refined and polished red with fine tannins, bright acidity and a tangy undertone. Medium-bodied, juicy and savory. Citrusy. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Earthy, cocoa powder aromatics combine with ripe black fruits on the palate. Lengthy, robust, full bodied and fully flavored, this powerful wine is carried by powdery-fine tannins and a persistent, palate-cleansing acidity.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

There's a caressing feel to the mix of cassis and boysenberry puree flavors that are gilded with a pretty violet note. The long finish has a toasty edge and lingers prettily.

ezra-brooks-bourbon.title: Ezra Brooks 99 Proof Bourbon
ezra-brooks-bourbon.bodyHtml:
A stepped-up expression of the classic Ezra Brooks Kentucky Straight Bourbon. Bottled at an elevated 99 proof and charcoal-filtered for ultimate smoothness, it uses the traditional ryed bourbon mash bill (78% corn, 10% rye, 12% malt). The higher proof delivers a bolder, more concentrated flavor that shines in cocktails while remaining incredibly approachable for neat sipping.

 

NOSE

Soft and sweet with aromas of corn, vanilla, subtle rye spice, and a hint of peanut butter.

PALATE

 Smooth and sweet with notes of buttery caramel, vanilla, milk chocolate, and a pleasant touch of cinnamon.

FINISH

Medium length and sweet, leaving lingering caramel, subtle oak, and warm spice.

hahn-pinot-noir.title: Hahn Pinot Noir 2023 750ml
hahn-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Vibrant aromas of red and dark cherry, raspberry and plum with subtle touches of vanilla and toasted oak. On the palate, silky tannins and excellent acid balance are joined by delicate flavors of red cherry and raspberry, culminating with notes of earthiness on a long and lingering finish.

giffard-violette-liquor.title: Giffard Crème de Violette
giffard-violette-liquor.bodyHtml:
Giffard Crème de Violette is a delicate and aromatic liqueur made from violet flowers, offering fragrant notes of fresh blossoms, candy and subtle citrus. The palate is smooth and lightly sweet, delivering floral elegance balanced with gentle freshness and a hint of herbal complexity. Its silky texture leads to a long, perfumed finish with refined floral character.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with Desserts, pastries, cocktails and light fruit dishes.

fireball.title: Fireball Cinnamon Whisky Liqueur 1.75L
fireball.bodyHtml: The blending of smooth Canadian whisky and intense cinnamon flavour result in a bold shot that is fragrant with pronounced aromas of cinnamon and spice; on the palate the spicy flavours of cinnamon intermingle with caramel notes on a long, hot finish. Serve well chilled. Great on its own, use in cocktails or apple desserts.

dalmore-constellation-1992-cask-18.title: The Dalmore Constellation Collection 1992 19 Year Old #18
dalmore-constellation-1992-cask-18.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore Constellation Collection 1992 19 Year Old #18 is an exceptionally rare Highland single malt Scotch whisky distilled on December 17, 1992, and bottled in 2012. Selected by Master Distiller Richard Paterson, this expression spent its first 10 years in first-fill American white oak Kentucky bourbon barrels before undergoing nine additional years of maturation in Tawny Port pipes from Portugal. Bottled at natural cask strength of 53.8% ABV, it reveals rich layers of ripe plum, citrus, marzipan, dark chocolate, and sweet spice. Limited to just 737 individually numbered bottles, this release represents the distinctive cask maturation philosophy of Dalmore's prestigious Constellation Collection.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, roasted duck, aged Gouda, caramelized walnuts, almond tart, dried figs, and rich fruit desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and complex, combining ripe plums, citrus marmalade, marzipan, dark chocolate, tropical fruit, and warming oak spice.

Nose: Ripe plums, citrus fruits, marzipan, ginger spice, mango, and fresh grape pulp.

Palate: Sweet pear, thick orange marmalade, bitter chocolate, crushed almonds, dark berries, and gentle oak spice.

Finish: Long and warming, with lingering dark fruit, citrus peel, toasted almonds, and rich chocolate.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature. Allow several minutes to open before tasting. Add a few drops of water if desired.

chanson-pouilly-fuisse.title: Chanson Pouilly-Fuisse 2016 750ml
chanson-pouilly-fuisse.bodyHtml: Pale yellow colour. Very fresh aromas of white peach mixed with almond. Subtle minerality. Well-balanced structure. Deep texture. Delicate minerality. Tense acidity. Long and generous finish.

temple-bar-12-year-old-single-malt-irish.title: Dunville’s PX 12 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
temple-bar-12-year-old-single-malt-irish.bodyHtml:
Dunville’s PX 12 Year Old is a mature single malt Irish whiskey bottled by Echlinville Distillery. Aged for 12 years and finished in Pedro Ximénez (PX) Sherry casks, it delivers a rich combination of tropical and orchard fruit, dried fruit, sweet sherry and well-integrated oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with dark chocolate, fruitcake, roasted nuts, mature cheese, crème brûlée, bread pudding and dried-fruit desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich, fruity and sherried, combining fresh orchard fruit with dried fruits, vanilla sweetness and controlled oak spice.

Nose: Tropical and orchard fruits, gentle pepper spice, mature oak and Christmas cake with a pronounced PX sherry influence.

Palate: Green apple, fresh-cut grass, banana cake and spiced vanilla custard, followed by candied orange, raisins, figs and rich sweet sherry.

Finish: Medium, juicy and warming with lingering sweet sherry and mature oak.

Serve: Best enjoyed neat or with a few drops of water.

el-tequileno-cristalino-reposado.title: El Tequileño Cristalino Reposado Tequila
el-tequileno-cristalino-reposado.bodyHtml:
El Tequileño Cristalino Reposado tequila is rested for 4 months in American Oak.

Aroma:

Pineapple, mango, pear, and light vanilla.

TASTE:

Tropical fruits, mango, and light vanilla.

ENJOY:

Best enjoyed on the rocks, or in a tall Collins glass with ice and topped with soda.

russell-punch-bowl-ipa.title: Russell Punch Bowl Ipa 4 Tall Cans

andina-brewing-brumosa-hazy-ipa.title: Fernie Brewing Hit The Deck Hazy Ipa
andina-brewing-brumosa-hazy-ipa.bodyHtml: Fernie Brewing Hit The Deck Hazy Ipa

flying-monkeys-memories-of-the-future.title: Flying Monkeys Memories Of The Future 473ml

ale-architect-django-spiced-white-beer.title: Banff Ave White Wit 6 Cans
ale-architect-django-spiced-white-beer.bodyHtml: Our take on a classic Belgian white wheat ale. Spiced with a hint of citrus and coriander for a crisp and tart finish. Alpine sunshine in a glass. A refreshing Belgian-style wheat beer brewed in the heart of the Rockies. Crafted with orange peel and coriander, it delivers a smooth, citrusy character with a crisp finish — the perfect companion for any adventure

jacobs-creek-double-barrel-cabernet-sau.title: Jacob's Creek Double Barrel Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
jacobs-creek-double-barrel-cabernet-sau.bodyHtml:
A distinctive Australian Cabernet Sauvignon matured in traditional oak barrels and finished in aged whisky barrels for added depth and complexity. Aromas of vibrant cassis, mint and dark olive lead into rich caramel, ripe dark fruit, smooth tannins and a lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled lamb, slow-roasted beef, smoked brisket and aged cheddar.

ghostfish-grapefruit-ipa-gluten-free.title: Ghostfish Grapefruit Ipa Gluten Free 4 Tall Cans
ghostfish-grapefruit-ipa-gluten-free.bodyHtml: Ghostfish Grapefruit Ipa Gluten Free 4 Tall Cans

diamond-10x-vodka.title: Crystal Head Gold Vodka
diamond-10x-vodka.bodyHtml:
Crystal Head Gold Vodka is an ultra-premium, ultra-luxurious vodka crafted in Newfoundland, Canada, by Globefill Inc. (founded by actor Dan Aykroyd and artist John Alexander). Distilled seven times from high-quality Canadian corn and blended with pristine water from St. John's, Newfoundland, this expression is filtered seven times—including three distillations through Herkimer diamonds. Encased in a showstopping, 18-karat gold-metallized version of Crystal Head's signature skull-shaped decanter, it offers an exceptionally clean, smooth, and creamy profile with subtle natural sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters on the half shell, caviar, smoked salmon, sushi, creamy cheeses, and dark chocolate truffles.

Tasting Notes : Crystal-clear and brilliant with a smooth, medium-to-full body and a rich, creamy mouthfeel.

Nose : Subtle aromas of sweet corn, soft vanilla, delicate citrus, and a clean, fresh minerality.

Palate : Exceptionally smooth and round with layers of sweet grain, creamy vanilla, soft caramel, and gentle warmth.

Finish : Clean, long, and elegant with lingering hints of sweet corn and soft vanilla.

Serve : Serve ice-cold straight from the freezer, neat in a chilled vodka glass, or over a large ice sphere.

juyondai-junmai-ginjo-ryuu-no-otoshiko.title: Juyondai Junmai Ginjo Omachi 1.8L 十四代 中取り 純米吟釀　備前雄町　生詰
juyondai-junmai-ginjo-ryuu-no-otoshiko.bodyHtml:
Juyondai Junmai Ginjo Omachi 1.8L pours a bright, crystal-clear appearance with soft silver highlights in the glass. The highly expressive nose opens with enticing aromas of sweet melon, candied peach, and restrained toasted rice, layered with gentle floral accents. On the palate, this medium-sweet, premium Japanese sake offers a remarkably plush, creamy, and powerful texture with a deep sense of rice umami. The mouthfeel is perfectly balanced by a soft acidity and crisp fruitiness, culminating in a long, beautifully sustained, and pleasantly warm, sweet, and spicy finish.

Juyondai means "14th generation", as the current president is the 14th generation owner of Takagi Shuzo brewery, which started in 1615. Juyondai is one of Yamagata Prefecture's most well-known premium sake labels.

Japanese Name:

十四代 中取り 純米吟釀　備前雄町　生詰

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with white fish sashimi, pan-seared duck breast, grilled wagyu beef, rich unagi don (grilled eel), or savory mushroom dishes.

88-fruity-pebble-triple-berry-sour.title: 88 Fruity Pebble Triple Berry Sour 4 Tall Cans
88-fruity-pebble-triple-berry-sour.bodyHtml: 88 Fruity Pebble Triple Berry Sour 4 Tall Cans

nutrl-bar-classics-variety-pack-1.title: Nutrl Bar Classics Variety Pack 12 Cans

kavalan-solist-oloroso-sherry-tm-3rd-ann.title: Kavalan Solist Oloroso Sherry Cask Truth Malters 3rd Anniversary Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-oloroso-sherry-tm-3rd-ann.bodyHtml:
Kavalan, imported into Canada by Truth Malters, occasionally does a special barrel release for their partner. This is one such case with the release of the Truth Malters 3rd Anniversary bottling of the Solist Oloroso Sherry Cask. The total out turn for this release was 217 bottles. 

 

56.3% ABV

g-m-connoisseurs-choice-caol-ila.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Caol Ila 2010 12 Year Old Sassicaia Cask Finish 45% ABV
g-m-connoisseurs-choice-caol-ila.bodyHtml:
A great 2010 vintage Caol Ila from Gordon & MacPhail’s Connoisseurs Choice range of single malts. This release has been carefully and expertly matured in G&M's own casks with spirit entrusted to them from the Caol Ila distillery. After a years finish in ex-Sassicaia wine casks this lovely dram has lots stewed red berry flavours complimented by demerara sugar and lemon zest notes. A perfect whisky gift to to be savoured and enjoyed.

Official Tasting Notes

Nose: Medjool date aromas with sweet cured meats and pineapple. 

Palate: Stewed red berry flavours complement demerara sugar and lemon zest. 

Finish: A medium-bodied, spicy finish with lingering citrus peel and bonfire embers.

motts-clamato-reserve.title: Mott's Clamato Original 1.89L
motts-clamato-reserve.bodyHtml:
It’s hard to stay humble when you’re such a classic taste, but we still give it our best shot. The fact is, before Mott’s Clamato The Original came along, the official drink of brunch was just tap water. And don’t even get us started about how much better cottaging is now. Cheersed across the country, this is the Mott’s Clamato that started it all.

Pair this Original flavour with a classic activity by hosting a backyard BBQ, or with being an original by hosting a front yard BBQ.

juyondai-junmai-muroka.title: Naminooto Tokubetsu Junmai Muroka Nama Genshu 720ml
juyondai-junmai-muroka.bodyHtml:
Rich and vibrant, with concentrated rice character and deep savoury umami. The palate is full and rounded, showing the richness of Yamada Nishiki alongside fresh acidity, while its unfiltered, unpasteurized and undiluted character delivers a lively, powerful and clean finish.

Food Pairing: Yakitori, grilled pork, mushrooms, hot pot, tempura, grilled fish, roasted vegetables and other rich, savoury dishes.

brewhouse-pilsner.title: Brewhouse Pilsner 24 Cans
brewhouse-pilsner.bodyHtml: A tasty and refreshing pilsner-style beer, crafted from premium ingredients including Western Canadian barley. It is cold filtered and naturally aged without any preservatives, offering a light, malty flavour with a crisp and balanced finish and no aftertaste .

drappier-carte-dor.title: Drappier Carte D'Or Brut Champagne
drappier-carte-dor.bodyHtml:
The Carte d'Or cuvée is the very expression of the Drappier style. With its very high proportion of Pinot Noir, one is almost tasting a Blanc de Noirs. Champagne with a fine aromatic richness, it opens with aromas of stoned fruits such as white vineyard peach. A spicy hint announces a powerful complex palate. A vinous Champagne of lovely complexity with a characteristic note of quince jelly. Ideal as an aperitif. At the table, it goes with white meats, rolled fish fillets, and Chaource cheese.

Blend: 75% Pinot Noir, 15% Chardonnay, 10% Meunier

athenaeum-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Napa Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
athenaeum-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Napa Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is an approachable, full-bodied, and classic expression of Napa Valley hillside and valley floor viticulture. Sourced from premier vineyard sites across the valley—including St. Helena, Oak Knoll, and Atlas Peak—this 100% Cabernet Sauvignon pours a deep ruby-purple color. The highly inviting nose displays classic aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, and black plum, intermingled with sweet nuances of molasses, cocoa, and cedar box. On the palate, it delivers a generous core of juicy dark fruits, baking spices, and black pepper, supported by a refreshing natural acidity. Having been aged for 21 months in French oak barrels, its rich texture is beautifully structured by supple, easygoing tannins that lead into a smooth, velvety, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with port-braised beef short ribs, a grilled ribeye steak with truffle butter, gourmet wood-fired bacon cheeseburgers, or a savory mushroom ragût.

90 Points - James Suckling

A less-expensive choice in Napa cabernet that punches the right buttons. This offers bold, fresh black fruit and spicy oak aromas, then a full body backed by firm tannins. Black cherries, blackcurrants, cedar, chocolate, black pepper and cinnamon on the palate.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Sweet black fruits, both spiced and dripping ripe, join with textural tannin for an ample Cabernet Sauvignon.

overture.title: Opus One Overture 2022
overture.bodyHtml: Overture 2022 captivates you from the start. Its aromatic profile weaves a complex tapestry of bright cherry, fresh forest berries, and cut rose stems interwoven with delicate scents of violets, toasted almond, and anise. Blackberry, blueberry, and wild cherry take the lead on the palate with a lively acidity that adds a vibrant edge. The finish is long and rounded, with a touch of mocha and black tea that showcase the wine’s depth. This expression of selected parcels from our estate vineyards will age gracefully for years to come.

castelvecchi-chianti-gran-selezione.title: Castelvecchi Madonnino Della Pieve Gran Selezione Chianti Classico 2017
castelvecchi-chianti-gran-selezione.bodyHtml: Castelvecchi Madonnino Della Pieve Gran Selezione Chianti Classico

ricasoli-castello-di-brolio-chianti-clas.title: Barone Ricasoli Castello di Brolio Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021 750ml
ricasoli-castello-di-brolio-chianti-clas.bodyHtml:
Castello di Brolio is Barone Ricasoli's flagship wine created from a meticulous selection of estate-grown grapes. Produced only in the best years, this is an iconic wine which will leave a lasting impression. Its most salient features are the concentration and tannic structure.

Blend: 100% Sangiovese

Castello di Brolio is produced with the best selection of grapes from dedicated Sangiovese vineyards, adjacent to the Castle and planted on three of the most typical types of Chianti soils: Macigno del Chianti (sandy soil), Scaglia Toscana (schist) and Monte Morello (limestone). The blend from the different vineyards brings out all of Brolio’s classic qualities, and while the wine can immediately be paired perfectly with white and red grilled meats or aged cheeses, it can also be held a long time in the cellar before being opened.

Castello di Brolio in the wineglass is a characteristic ruby red and has the intense red fruit notes typical of Sangiovese - black cherry and raspberry, as well as flowers and spices. It is wonderfully full-bodied, but it has soft tannins, very refined, which enhance the pleasantness of each sip.

96 Points - James Suckling

Bright and floral on the nose with orange blossom to the vivid sliced cherry character. Medium body, with ultra-fine tannins that are supple and caressing. Gorgeous cooked peach pie and cherry aftertaste.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

One of the estate's most important and successful bottles, the Barone Ricasoli 2020 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Castello di Brolio is plump and rich with warm-vintage layers of blackberry, juicy cherry, spice and soft earth. It ages in tonneaux for 22 months, of which only 30% is new oak, yet that is more than enough to impart savory tones, soft tannins and rich textural support to this full-bodied Sangiovese.

voerzio-barolo-fossati-case-nere-2005.title: Roberto Voerzio Fossati Case Nere Barolo Riserva 10 Anni 2005 750ml
voerzio-barolo-fossati-case-nere-2005.bodyHtml: Roberto Voerzio Barolo Riserva 10 Anni Fossati Case Nere 2005 is a single-vineyard Barolo from the Fossati Case Nere site, bottled by Roberto Voerzio in La Morra, Piedmont, under the Barolo DOCG. As the name says, this Riserva is a ten-year selection, released with long ageing behind it. This 2005 is a 750ml bottle at 14.5% ABV.

latour-giraud-meursault-cuvee-charles-ma.title: Domaine Latour-Giraud Cuvee Charles Maxime Meursault 2018
latour-giraud-meursault-cuvee-charles-ma.bodyHtml: The 2018 Cuvée Charles Maxime is an elegant and quintessential Meursault, crafted as a tribute to the estate's ancestors. It presents a brilliant pale gold colour and opens with an expressive nose of ripe yellow orchard fruits, citrus zest, and white flowers, underpinned by classic Meursault notes of toasted hazelnut and flinty minerality.
