On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and beautifully textured, showcasing a harmonious balance between its rich, buttery mouthfeel and a vibrant line of acidity. Flavours of lemon curd and almond paste are complemented by a subtle touch of spice from careful oak aging, leading to a long, polished finish with a persistent mineral lift. Food Pairing: Perfectly complements butter-poached lobster, pan-seared scallops, roasted poultry with a creamy mushroom sauce, or refined cheeses like Delice de Bourgogne and aged Comté.

old-speckled-hen-fine-ale.title: Old Speckled Hen Fine Ale 4 Tall Cans
old-speckled-hen-fine-ale.bodyHtml: Old Speckled Hen Fine Ale 4 Tall Cans

benriach-curiositas-10-year-old.title: Benriach Curiositas 10 Year Old
benriach-curiositas-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Benriach Curiositas 10 Year Old is the peated single malt from Benriach, a Speyside distillery that broke with regional habit by distilling some of its spirit from malt dried over peat smoke. Matured for at least ten years in a combination of ex-bourbon, virgin oak and rum casks, it is bottled at 46% ABV in 700ml bottles, without chill filtration and without added colouring. Curiositas shows that heavy smoke is not only an Islay trait: it pairs honeyed, malty Speyside sweetness with campfire peat, apple and oak spice. The expression has since been followed in the Benriach range by The Smoky Ten.

Tasting Notes: peat smoke, honey, orchard fruit, heather, nuts, oak spice.

Nose: A burst of aromatic peat reek with honey, fruit and mellow oak.

Palate: Waves of peat followed by fruit, heather, nuts, oak and spice.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

latour-giraud-meursault-1cru-genevrieres.title: Domaine Latour-Giraud Meursault-Genevrieres Premier Cru 2023
latour-giraud-meursault-1cru-genevrieres.bodyHtml: The Domaine Latour-Giraud Meursault-Genevrières Premier Cru 2023 is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex Old World white wine that beautifully captures the unique, sun-drenched limestone soils and natural concentration of this exceptionally balanced vintage. It pours a beautiful mid-yellow colour with subtle greenish reflections in the glass, lifting with an immediate, aromatic bouquet of fresh lime blossom, verbena, and delicate fresh apples, seamlessly layered with intricate undertones of jasmine tea, gardenia, and a hint of warm baking spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Chardonnay is remarkably poised, graceful, and smooth, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of white peach, ripe citrus rind, and a fine-boned framework driven by chalky, tingly minerality. Aged carefully in French oak barrels (25% new) to enhance its structural depth and natural sophistication, it is driven by a finely balanced, food-friendly acidity and a super-sleek texture that carries into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by an integrated touch of spice and lemon confit.

dzama-rhum-de-madagascar-cuvee-blanche.title: Dzama Cuvée Blanche White Rum
dzama-rhum-de-madagascar-cuvee-blanche.bodyHtml:
Dzama Cuvée Blanche White Rum is a refined expression of Madagascar's distinctive rum-making heritage, crafted by Rhum Dzama to showcase the island's vibrant tropical character. Produced from molasses and rested for approximately two to four weeks, this elegant white rum offers remarkable aromatic complexity while maintaining a fresh, approachable personality. Crystal clear in appearance, it reveals enticing citrus aromas complemented by delicate floral nuances, gentle vanilla and warm island spices. The palate is smooth and rounded, delivering lively lime flavours, subtle fruity sweetness and a harmonious balance of freshness and spice. Bottled at 40% ABV, Dzama Cuvée Blanche captures the distinctive character of Madagascar in a sophisticated white rum with an aromatic, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled prawns, coconut shrimp, citrus-marinated seafood, jerk chicken and lightly spiced pork skewers. Its refreshing citrus character also complements tropical fruit salads, mango salsa, coconut-based curries, grilled pineapple and lime-infused desserts.

Tasting Notes: A fresh and aromatic white rum showcasing vibrant citrus, delicate floral notes, soft vanilla and warming spice, balanced by a smooth, rounded texture.

Nose: Bright lime zest and fresh citrus lead into delicate aromas of nutmeg, vanilla, rose petals and peony, accompanied by subtle confectionery sweetness.

Palate: Smooth, rounded and pleasantly fruity, with lively citrus flavours, gentle vanilla sweetness, delicate floral undertones and a touch of warming spice.

Finish: Refreshing and aromatic, with lingering citrus zest, soft clove spice and a delicate sweetness that gradually fades into a clean, satisfying finish.

latour-giraud-meursault-charmes-1er-cru.title: Domaine Latour-Giraud Meursault-Genevrieres Premier Cru 2023
latour-giraud-meursault-charmes-1er-cru.bodyHtml: The Domaine Latour-Giraud Meursault-Genevrières Premier Cru 2023 is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex Old World white wine that beautifully captures the unique, sun-drenched limestone soils and natural concentration of this exceptionally balanced vintage. It pours a beautiful mid-yellow colour with subtle greenish reflections in the glass, lifting with an immediate, aromatic bouquet of fresh lime blossom, verbena, and delicate fresh apples, seamlessly layered with intricate undertones of jasmine tea, gardenia, and a hint of warm baking spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Chardonnay is remarkably poised, graceful, and smooth, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of white peach, ripe citrus rind, and a fine-boned framework driven by chalky, tingly minerality. Aged carefully in French oak barrels (25% new) to enhance its structural depth and natural sophistication, it is driven by a finely balanced, food-friendly acidity and a super-sleek texture that carries into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by an integrated touch of spice and lemon confit.

latour-giraud-pommard-cuvee-carmen.title: Domaine Latour-Giraud Cuvee Carmen Pommard 2018 750ml
latour-giraud-pommard-cuvee-carmen.bodyHtml: Domaine Latour-Giraud Pommard Cuvée Carmen 2018 is a red Burgundy from a family domaine based in Meursault, where the Giraud family has been established since 1850 and the Latour family for far longer. Jean-Pierre Latour joined his father in 1983 and took over ten years later; the domaine now covers about 11 hectares and is farmed organically, though without certification. Cuvée Carmen is named after Jean-Pierre Latour's grandmother and comes from the Les Vignots vineyard in Pommard, acquired after the family sold its Maranges holding. It is traditionally the last parcel the domaine picks. 750ml, 13% alcohol.

woodford-reserve.title: Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Bourbon
woodford-reserve.bodyHtml:
Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Bourbon is an innovative, twice-barreled Kentucky straight bourbon produced at the Woodford Reserve Distillery in Versailles, Kentucky. First matured in handcrafted new white oak barrels, the bourbon is then transferred to a second, heavily toasted and lightly charred oak barrel for additional aging, extracting deep notes of dark caramel, hazelnut, apple, and rich oak spice.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, crème brûlée, pecan pie, smoked brisket, or blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber to dark copper in appearance with a rich, heavy, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich notes of dark fruit, caramel, honey, chocolate, marzipan, and toasted oak.

Palate : Full-bodied with layers of vanilla, dark caramel, hazelnut, apple, sweet baking spices, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, creamy, and lingering with notes of warm oak spice, honey, and subtle apple.

Serve : Serve neat, over a large ice cube, or as an elevated modifier in a classic Old Fashioned.

keep-calm-laugh-sauvignon-blanc.title: Keep Calm & Laugh Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
keep-calm-laugh-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
White wine, Sauvignon blanc.
Sizes: 750 ml, 250 ml, 4 L.
Alcohol: 12% alc./vol.
Sugar: 6.5 g/L.

Food pairings: Apéritif, Fish, Sushis.

Tasting info: Livelyand fresh. Citrus notes, passion fruit. Lively, fresh and intense.

jack-daniels-tennessee-fire-1.title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Fire 50ml
jack-daniels-tennessee-fire-1.bodyHtml: The addition of fiery spice to the mellow character of Jack Daniel's creates this unique spirit. Shows bold aromas of cinnamon candy and honey. The palate is sweet and spicy with a warming mouthfeel and flavours of cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla that repeat on a long finish. Serve straight up, over ice, or use in cocktails.

keep-calm-thrive-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Keep Calm & Thrive Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
keep-calm-thrive-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
This cabernet sauvignon pours ruby and has enticing aromas of allspice, black currant, cranberry, and pomegranate. Full-bodied with moderate tannins, blackberry fruit and sandalwood are rounded out from the oak. Discover this wine barbecued burgers with aged cheddar or steak fajitas and fresh guacamole.

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A straightforward, fruit-forward Cabernet with notes of black cherry and a hint of oak. Soft tannins and a smooth finish make it an easy, approachable choice."

bowmore-40-year-old.title: Bowmore 40 Year Old 2021 Release
bowmore-40-year-old.bodyHtml:
Inspired by time and the sea front location of the Bowmore Distillery, the colors and textures of Islay’s ancient stone and bleached driftwood are encompassed within this limited release. This whisky is on a limited run of 159 bottles globally.

Bottled at a cask strength of 48.7%, the 40-Year-Old is a deep mahogany color and offers up aromas of honey, treacle and exotic fruits combined with beeswax and caramel. On the palate, pipe tobacco and chocolate unite with spices, leather, chestnuts, and pralines giving the whisky a long, lingering, and luxurious finish.

saintly-sauvignon-blanc.title: Saintly Sauvignon Blanc Limited Release
saintly-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Bright and aromatic, this Sauvignon Blanc delivers vibrant notes of citrus zest, fresh-cut grass, and tropical fruit with a crisp, refreshing acidity. The palate is clean and lively, showing classic varietal character with a lingering mineral finish that reflects its cool-climate Canadian origins.


Food Pairing: Grilled seafood, goat cheese salads, fresh oysters, herb-crusted chicken, and light vegetable dishes with citrus vinaigrette.

shinobu-10-year-old-peated-pure-malt.title: Shinobu 10 Year Old Peated Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
shinobu-10-year-old-peated-pure-malt.bodyHtml:
The SHINOBU Distillery is located in the Japanese seaside region of Niigata on the country’s western coast. The area is famous for its “Three White Treasures”: snow, rice and sake which have been cultivated for centuries. SHINOBU Pure Malt whiskies are crafted by master blender, Mr. Usami Ken who blended and aged the SHINOBU Pure Malt Whisky 10YO Lightly Peated in sherry and bourbon hogshead casks for more than 10 years, before finishing them in precious Japanese Mizunara Oak. Famous for imparting rich, luscious flavors of apples, pears, cloves and nutmegs, Mizunara Oak has been used in Japan since the 1930s and is now sought-after by whisky makers around the world. The peated flavors brings the SHINOBU 10YO Pure Malt Lightly Peated Whisky into another aspect, with complex aromas and different layers of tastes of seaweed and smoky flavors. All SHINOBU whiskies are created without chill-filtration nor added color to protect and enhance their complex and robust character.
✔︎ Silver 91pts (International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022)

shinobu-peated-pure-malt-whisky.title: Shinobu Peated Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
shinobu-peated-pure-malt-whisky.bodyHtml:
The SHINOBU Distillery is located in the Japanese seaside region of Niigata on the country’s western coast. The area is famous for its “Three White Treasures”: snow, rice and sake which have been cultivated for centuries. SHINOBU Pure Malt whiskies are crafted by master blender, Mr. Usami Ken who blends malts aged in sherry and bourbon hogshead casks before finishing them in precious Japanese Mizunara Oak. Famous for imparting rich, luscious flavors of apples, pears, cloves and nutmegs, Mizunara Oak has been used in Japan since the 1930s and is now sought-after by whisky makers around the world. The SHINOBU Lightly Peated Pure Malt Whisky blends shows a robust and profound body structure, with smoky and toasty oaks flavors. All SHINOBU whiskies are created without chill-filtration nor added color to protect and enhance their complex and robust character.
✔︎ Double Gold (San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2022)
✔︎ Gold 96pts (International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022)
✔︎ Gold (DB & SB Spring Tasting 2022)

latour-giraud-puligny-montrachet-champs.title: Olivier Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet 1er Cru Champ Gain 2023
latour-giraud-puligny-montrachet-champs.bodyHtml: A prestigious and highly structured Premier Cru Chardonnay that exemplifies the elegance of Puligny-Montrachet. The 2023 vintage presents an expressive bouquet of citrus blossoms, ripe lemon, and white peach, layered with subtle toasted hazelnuts and a distinctive chalky minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and precise, showing a beautiful tension between its creamy texture and vibrant, racy acidity. Flavours of green apple and almond lead to a long, aristocratic finish marked by intense saline notes and well-integrated French oak.

jura-21-year-old-tide-single-malt.title: Jura 21 Year Old Tide
jura-21-year-old-tide-single-malt.bodyHtml:
In the vast wilderness of our island home, it’s easy to lose track of time. But if you stop a moment in that beautiful wilderness and take in the silence, eventually you’ll notice the rhythm of the tide bringing you back. Like the whisky in our casks, it’s an irresistible reminder of time’s power.

Matured in American white oak ex bourbon barrels, this whisky is then finished in hand-selected virgin American white oak casks, giving it a sweet, fruity and nutty flavour. This truly special whisky is available worldwide.

goldschmidt-yardstick-ruths-reach-cab.title: Goldschmidt Vineyards Yardstick Ruth's Reach Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
goldschmidt-yardstick-ruths-reach-cab.bodyHtml:
Goldschmidt Vineyards Yardstick Ruth's Reach Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a sophisticated and fruit-driven wine designed to showcase the refined elegance of the Napa Valley floor. Named after Nick Goldschmidt’s mother, Ruth, this wine is sourced from the "Ruth’s Reach" vineyard in the Oakville and Rutherford regions, areas famous for their "dusty" tannins and deep red fruit profiles. The 2019 vintage is noted for its exceptional balance, having matured in a combination of new and seasoned French oak to add complexity without masking the varietal character.
On the nose, it offers a vibrant bouquet of black cherry, red currant, and raspberry, accented by subtle hints of vanilla, cocoa, and dried herbs. The palate is medium-to-full bodied and remarkably smooth, showcasing a polished texture with layers of succulent dark fruit and fine-grained tannins. The finish is clean and persistent, leaving a lingering impression of sweet oak and bright berry fruit.

truly-punch-variety-pack.title: Truly Punch Mix Pack 12 Cans
truly-punch-variety-pack.bodyHtml:
The Truly Punch Mixed Pack is a 12-can variety pack of hard seltzers crafted with real fruit juice. It is widely distributed across Canada and features bold fruit flavor combinations. 
The assortment provides three 355 mL cans of each of the following four styles:
  • Fruit Punch: A classic, lively mashup of mixed fruits with a sweet, crisp finish.
  • Berry Punch: A bold blend highlighting ripe strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries.
  • Tropical Punch: A smooth mix featuring tropical notes of pineapple, mango, and passionfruit.
  • Citrus Punch: A bright, zesty combination of lemon, lime, and orange.

undurraga-altazor.title: Undurraga Altazor 2023
undurraga-altazor.bodyHtml:
Undurraga Altazor 2023 is an exceptional, icon-level red blend produced by Viña Undurraga in Chile's Maipo Valley. Predominantly composed of Cabernet Sauvignon with small additions of Carménère and Carignan, it exhibits a deep plum and garnet hue with violet undertones. On the nose, it delivers rich, complex aromas of crème de cassis, ripe blackberries, quince, dried herbs, and tomato leaves, beautifully accented by cedar, cigar box, and dark chocolate notes. The palate is medium- to full-bodied, structured, and radiant, featuring fine-grained tannins, vibrant natural acidity, and a long, savory finish driven by deep dark fruit and subtle graphite undertones.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, game meats, and rich, aged hard cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Rich, ripe nose of creme de cassis, quince, dried Mediterranean herbs, tomato leaves, cigar box and Mexican chocolate. Medium- to full-bodied with plenty of fine-grained tannins and a flavorful, lengthy finish. Juicy, complex and quite sunny, with hearty fruit. Cabernet sauvignon with some carmenere and carignan. Drink from 2027.

le-pich-cabernet-sauvignon.title: The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
le-pich-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a luxurious, modern, and brilliantly textured expression that carries the bold and unrestricted winemaking philosophy of this iconic estate into a pure varietal focus. Sourced from premier vineyards across the valley, this vintage exhibits a deep magenta and purple-ruby core. On the nose, it offers an invitingly opulent bouquet of ripe black cherries, crème de cassis, and sweet blackberry pie, seamlessly layered with warm undertones of toasted vanilla bean, cinnamon bark, fresh coffee grounds, and hints of crushed wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is incredibly soft, plush, and full-bodied, delivering an expansive, fruit-forward mid-palate wrapped in supple, velvety tannins. Matured for 15 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels, its powerful dark fruit concentration remains beautifully balanced, showing remarkable structural harmony before concluding with a lengthy, decadent finish accented by a touch of holiday spice and subtle mineral depth.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with charcoal-grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-infused roasted lamb, or hunks of mature sharp white cheddar cheese.

dassai-39-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake-1.title: Dassai '39' Junmai Daiginjo 720ml
dassai-39-premium-junmai-daiginjo-sake-1.bodyHtml: Made with 100% Yamada-Nishiki rice polished to 39% of the original rice grain. Aromas of fresh pineapple, ripe pear, mango and light notes of anise. Tropical fruit flavours are delicate and soft on the palate, with a clean and dry finish. Enjoy served chilled with grilled seafood and sashimi.

j-cuvee-20-nv-brut.title: J Vineyards Cuvee 20 Brut
j-cuvee-20-nv-brut.bodyHtml:
J Vineyards Cuvée 20 Brut is a wonderfully expressive, crisp, and beautifully structured sparkling wine that celebrates the house's hallmark style and the vibrant, cool-climate terroir of the Russian River Valley. Hand-harvested at night and gently pressed using traditional methods, this classic sparkling cuvée opens with nuanced aromas of fresh sourdough bread, toasted almonds, green apple, and bright tangerine. On the palate, a delicate dance of fine, lively bubbles leads to a beautifully balanced profile of juicy raspberry, wild strawberry, and lemon meringue pie. The wine's creamy texture and underlying hint of ginger snap are cleanly whisked away by a crisp, refreshing natural acidity, culminating in an exceptionally vibrant and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with Asian shrimp dumplings with yuzu glaze, raw oysters, seared black cod, or creamy triple-cream cheeses like St. André.

94 Points - James Suckling

Light-bodied, full-flavored and complex, this wine is dry, toasty and handsomely mature in flavor. Made primarily from the 2017 vintage, it offers brioche, white pepper, citrus, ginger and grilled baguette notes on a vibrant texture of fine-grained bubbles.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Steely and full of snappy acidity, with accents of red apple, gingerbread and lemon tart that build richness and plushness on the lingering finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Broadly defined in honeysuckle, peach, brioche and moderate acidity, this is a crowd-pleasing and immensely likable sparkling wine. The finish lingers on a deep, nutty tone.

limoncino-dellisola.title: Caffo Limoncino dell'Isola
limoncino-dellisola.bodyHtml:
Limoncino dell'Isola is a Calabrian lemon liqueur from Distilleria Fratelli Caffo, made by infusing the fragrant zest of Calabrian lemons following the long-standing traditions of the region. Unlike the famous limoncello of the Amalfi Coast, it is produced from small Calabrian lemons with plenty of punch. Its colour and flavour are entirely natural, with no added yellow colouring, so instead of a neon glow it has the cloudy, natural hue of freshly squeezed lemonade and a pithy, real-lemon character. Bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle; serve it ice-cold.

Tasting Notes: Fresh lemon zest and pith, sweet and natural.

Serve: Straight from the freezer in chilled glasses, or topped with prosecco or soda.

voga-sparkling-rose.title: Voga Sparkling Rose 187ml
voga-sparkling-rose.bodyHtml: VOGA Sparkling Rosé of Pinot Grigio 187ml is a crisp and refreshing sparkling wine with a light, fruity profile. It's made from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes, showcasing flavors of ripe orange, lime, pear, and grapefruit, according to VOGA Italia. The wine pours a vibrant pink color, and the bubbles add a lively touch, as described by Enovation Brands. It's a good choice for a light and refreshing aperitif or paired with light seafood or soft cheeses, says VOGA Italia.

screaming-toller-birdwood-mountain-blond.title: Screaming Toller Birdwood Mountain Blond 4 Tall Cans
screaming-toller-birdwood-mountain-blond.bodyHtml: Screaming Toller Birdwood Mountain Blond 4 Tall Cans

screaming-toller-alpenglow-orange-vanill.title: Screaming Toller Alpenglow Orange Vanill 4 Tall Cans
screaming-toller-alpenglow-orange-vanill.bodyHtml: Screaming Toller Alpenglow Orange Vanill 4 Tall Cans

screaming-toller-kananaskis-ipa.title: Screaming Toller Kananaskis Ipa 4 Tall Cans

smirnoff-vodka-peach-lemonade.title: Smirnoff Peach Lemonade Vodka
smirnoff-vodka-peach-lemonade.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Peach Lemonade is a flavoured vodka beverage infused with natural peach and lemonade flavours, giving a bright, sweet and summery profile. It is bottled at 30% ABV in a 750 ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Ripe peach and fresh lemonade.

Serve: Over ice with soda water or lemon-lime soda, or in a summer punch.

village-squeeze-raspberry-lemon-ale.title: Village Squeeze Raspberry Lemon Ale 6 Cans

louis-roederer-collection.title: Louis Roederer Collection 246
louis-roederer-collection.bodyHtml:
Champagne colored with bright, luminous reflections. Very fine, even bubbles. The bouquet reveals yellow fruits (mirabelle plum and nectarine) and candied citrus (lemon), complemented by toasted, oaky notes (vanilla) which come from the 24%of wines vinified in our French oak foudres. The fine reductive notes (shellfish) weave their spell, giving the wine a very chiselled character sculpted by the Chardonnay. The palate is very light and delicate with fruity (peach) and floral (pollen) flavors. The gently releasing bubbles are soft and creamy, creating a mouth-watering impressionthanks to the savory and dry-chalk sensations created on the tongue and lips. The texture on the mid-palate is fresh, oily, powdery and vibrant. The finish is serene and graceful, and lifted by some smoky and toasty reductive notes that are very definitely from the Perpetual Reserve.

Collection 246 is a precise, soft and lively champagne. Its thirst-quenching lightness comes from the exceptional proportion of Chardonnay, which creates finesse, elegance,chalkiness and salinity. It is not unlike the character of certain Blancs de Blancs.

93 Points - James Suckling

This has pretty and elegant aromas of pears, apple blossoms, grapefruit and chalk. It’s silky, fresh and beautifully balanced on the palate, with very soft bubbles. Based on 2021, with reserve wine from a perpetual reserve created in 2012, plus reserve wines kept in oak from 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2017.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A harmonious Champagne that shows impeccable balance, with depth and focus to its flavors of white cherry, Honeycrisp apple, tangerine peel and biscuit, while retaining vibrancy and grace. A chalky underpinning comes to the fore on the creamy finish, joining delicate spice and floral accents. Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Meunier.

ardbeg-cask-343.title: Ardbeg Uigeadail
ardbeg-cask-343.bodyHtml:
Uigeadail (pronounced ‘Oog-a-dal’) is Gaelic for “a dark, mysterious place.”

Named after the distillery’s water source, this whisky is a marriage of sweetness, spice and deep smokiness. The peat-laden waters of Loch Uigeadail provide the smoky tones in this whisky, while maturation in ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks imparts rich, warm flavours – perfect for a dramatic, stormy night.

But the true secret behind Ardbeg Uigeadail's success? A unique vatting method that marries the deep, smoky notes from ex-bourbon American oak with the luscious, raisin-like character of ex-sherry Oloroso casks.

Non chill-filtered.

ardbeg-fermutation-committee-release.title: Ardbeg Fermutation 13 Year Old Committee Release
ardbeg-fermutation-committee-release.bodyHtml:
In November 2007, when a broken boiler threatened six washbacks filled with precious liquid, Dr Bill (Ardbeg’s Director of Distilling and Whisky Creation) sensed an opportunity. He quickly instructed the Distillery folk to throw open the washback lids and expose the liquid to the air. Tiny beings descended from the sky and landed in the spirit… The ‘Fermutation’ process had begun. An epic 3 week-long fermentation – the longest in Ardbeg’s history – eventually gave rise to this wild, zingy and vibrant spirit.

In a dram that tastes like pure science fiction, peat and smoke meld beautifully with fresh, floral flavours, while sharp, more malty notes give Fermutation a uniquely Ardbeggian profile.

poli-segretario-di-sato-pure-malt-whisk.title: Poli Segretario di Stato Pure Malt Italian Whisky
poli-segretario-di-sato-pure-malt-whisk.bodyHtml:
Poli Segretario di Stato Pure Malt Italian Whisky is a highly innovative, premium Italian craft whisky created by the historic Poli Distillerie in Veneto. Named "Segretario di Stato" (Secretary of State) in honor of Pietro Parolin, a prominent citizen of Schiavon who was appointed Secretary of State of the Holy See, this expression marks an audacious foray into whisky-making by one of Italy’s most legendary grappa families. Crafted from a combination of 60% unpeated and 40% pleasantly peated malted barley, the spirit is meticulously distilled in small batches using the distillery's custom-modified, artisanal copper bain-marie pot stills. It is aged for five years in European oak casks before undergoing a long finishing period in first-fill ex-Amarone wine barrels, resulting in an international spirit with an elegantly complex, Venetian soul.

Food Pairing: The combination of rich dried fruits from the Amarone finish and light peat smoke makes this whisky a magnificent companion to slow-braised meats like wild boar ragù, duck breast with a cherry reduction, or grilled venison. It also pairs spectacularly well with aged Italian cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano, Pecorino Riserva, or Gorgonzola, as well as rich desserts such as dark chocolate soufflé, panettone with raisins, or artisanal fig tarts.

TASTING NOTES - A deep, warm golden-amber with polished copper highlights. The texture is medium-to-full-bodied, pleasantly oily, and remarkably smooth with a velvety, mouth-coating softness.

NOSE - Deeply aromatic, solemn, and highly complex, opening with a rich bowl of toasted hazelnuts, plump raisins, and dark plums, beautifully integrated with notes of milk chocolate, warm vanilla, and a gentle wisp of smoked spices and herbal tea.

PALATE - Warm, soft, and beautifully balanced. An initial sweetness of caramelized brown sugar, honey, and stewed dark fruits from the Amarone cask is seamlessly balanced mid-palate by a subtle wave of earthy peat smoke, toasted wood tannins, and baking spices like cinnamon and clove.

FINISH - Long, elegant, and comforting. The rich dark fruit and chocolate notes slowly give way to a lingering, pleasant dryness marked by toasted nuts, a touch of tobacco leaf, and a soft, smoky herbal warmth.

SERVE - Best enjoyed strictly neat at room temperature (around 16-18°C) in a traditional tulip-shaped Glencairn or spirits glass to fully appreciate its intricate, multi-layered aromatics and wine-cask finish. Avoid ice, though one or two drops of pure water can be added to open up the lighter orchard fruit notes.

ardbeg-cask-247.title: Ardbeg Uigeadail
ardbeg-cask-247.bodyHtml:
Uigeadail (pronounced ‘Oog-a-dal’) is Gaelic for “a dark, mysterious place.”

Named after the distillery’s water source, this whisky is a marriage of sweetness, spice and deep smokiness. The peat-laden waters of Loch Uigeadail provide the smoky tones in this whisky, while maturation in ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks imparts rich, warm flavours – perfect for a dramatic, stormy night.

But the true secret behind Ardbeg Uigeadail's success? A unique vatting method that marries the deep, smoky notes from ex-bourbon American oak with the luscious, raisin-like character of ex-sherry Oloroso casks.

Non chill-filtered.

twisted-tea-island-variety-pack.title: Twisted Tea Island Variety Pack 12 x 355ml Cans

ardbeg-8-year-old.title: Ardbeg 10 Year Old
ardbeg-8-year-old.bodyHtml:
Ardbeg 10 Year Old is a world-renowned Islay single malt Scotch whisky revered by peat enthusiasts for its intensely smoky, complex, and surprisingly balanced profile. Distilled on the rugged south coast of Islay, it is matured for a minimum of ten years in a combination of first-fill and second-fill American oak ex-bourbon casks. Bottled non-chill-filtered at 46% ABV to preserve maximum flavor and texture, it showcases Ardbeg's signature phenolic peat smoke—drawn from heavily peated malted barley—alongside bright lemon and lime zest, coastal sea spray, and creamy vanilla sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh Pacific oysters, smoked salmon, grilled langoustines, barbecued pork ribs, dark chocolate truffles, and pungent blue cheeses such as Roquefort or Stilton.

Tasting Notes : Pale straw gold with bright platinum highlights, presenting a full, oily body with a rich and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense bonfire peat smoke, fresh lemon and lime zest, coastal sea brine, cracked black pepper, sweet vanilla, and subtle menthol.

Palate : Explosive peat smoke balanced by bright citrus fruits, sweet malted cereal, espresso, dark chocolate, tarry rope, and creamy toffee.

Finish : Very long, smoky, and warming with lingering notes of sea salt, toasted malt, charred oak, and sweet aniseed.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip-shaped whisky tasting glass, or add a few drops of pure water to tame the intense smoke and highlight the underlying citrus and vanilla sweetness.

tahiti-treat-vodka.title: Tahiti Treat Fruit Punch Soda & Vodka 473ml
tahiti-treat-vodka.bodyHtml: Tahiti Treat Fruit Punch Soda & Vodka is a grown-up way to return to your childhood one sip at a time. The Fruit Punch Soda is perfectly mixed with vodka to give you all the taste of Tahiti Treat with a boost of flavour. Enjoy by the pool, chilled or over ice.

axr-napa-valley-sauvignon-blanc.title: AXR Sauvignon Blanc 2021/2023 750ml
axr-napa-valley-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
AXR Sauvignon Blanc is an elegant Napa Valley white wine crafted by acclaimed winemaker Jean Hoefliger in California. Made entirely from Sauvignon Blanc grapes, it combines vibrant citrus and tropical fruit with floral aromas, refreshing acidity, and distinctive minerality. Notes of grapefruit, Meyer lemon, peach, and delicate vanilla create a beautifully balanced wine with a rounded mouthfeel and crisp finish. Both the 2021 and 2023 vintages showcase AXR's expressive approach to Sauvignon Blanc, although their alcohol content and individual tasting profiles differ.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, grilled shrimp, pan-seared halibut, goat cheese, citrus salads, sushi, herb-roasted chicken, and light seafood pasta.

mount-riley-sauvignon-blanc.title: Mount Riley Sauvignon Blanc
mount-riley-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Mount Riley Sauvignon Blanc is an incredibly vibrant, crisp, and beautifully expressive white wine that captures the classic, energetic style of the Marlborough region. Crafted from a careful blend of grapes sourced from select vineyards in both the Wairau and Awatere Valleys, it opens with intense, lifted aromatics of ripe passionfruit, pink grapefruit, and zesty citrus, accented by fresh herbal notes of lemongrass, capsicum, and crushed gooseberries. On the palate, this white wine is remarkably bright and focused, showcasing a weighty mouthfeel, concentrated tropical and citrus fruit flavors, and a lively, mouthwatering acidity that extends into a clean, persistent, and refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with fresh oysters, grilled sea bass, garlic-herb prawns, goat cheese salad, or light Thai and Vietnamese dishes.

rum-nation-peruano-8-year-old.title: Rum Nation Specially Peruano 8 Year Old Rum
rum-nation-peruano-8-year-old.bodyHtml:
Rum Nation Peruano 8 Year Old is a limited-edition rum from the Lambayeque region of northern Peru, made in the classic Spanish style at a distillery founded in the first half of the 20th century and still working the same way today. Molasses from sugarcane grown in very fertile soils is distilled in old Scottish column stills, then aged in a solera-like system using various kinds of barrels before being blended to a long-standing recipe. Selected by Rum Nation, the independent rum house founded by Fabio Rossi in 1999, it is bottled at 42% ABV in a 700ml bottle and presented in a gift box.

Tasting Notes: Sweet and syrupy, with figs and dates, balanced by a fresh, crisp and lightweight character.

Serve: Neat or on the rocks.

pingus.title: PSI by Pingus 2021 / 2022
pingus.bodyHtml:
PSI is the 23rd letter in the Greek alphabet and is the name of Peter Sisseck's (of the coveted Pingus and Flor de Pingus) utopian wine from Ribera del Duero. Peter has sought out the best independent vineyard growers in Ribera and is incentivizing them to improve viticultural practices and shun chemicals, lower yields and practice biodynamics by paying them increasingly for the fruit as they improve. The result is a "give back" to the region wine that also expresses the "soul" of Ribera.

 

2021 Vintage Ratings

96 Points - Vinous

The 2021 PSI is 90% Tempranillo and 10% Garnacha sourced from old vines planted in calcareous soils and was aged for up to 16 months in mostly sizable French oak barrels. In the glass, it's garnet-red with a light purple sheen. The nose offers blood notes along with sour cherry and blackberry, intertwined with violets and dried flowers, resulting in a layered, complex profile. On the palate, it's dry and velvety. Chalky tannins define a compact mouthfeel and long-lasting fruit and floral flavors. The 2021 is a distinctive Ribera del Duero with excellent nuance and agility.

94 Points - James Suckling

Black cherries, asphalt, hedgerow, dark spices and dried Mediterranean herbs. Medium- to full-bodied on the palate with dusty, effusive tannins and a vertical finish. Pristine and stripped-down. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The bottled 2021 PSI is a bit reticent and closed, the most backward of the 2021s—it's even a bit reductive. This has some 8% Garnacha In 2021, he decided to start buying some of the vineyards; until then, he bought the grapes from these old vineyards, but most of the growers who work these vineyards are also old and some cannot work anymore. So, the solution is to buy their vineyards, which represents an administrative problem too, as the ownership and legal aspects of these vines is sometimes not clear. He now has 50 hectares, with the idea to own 100 hectares of the 200 they use for the wine. That also represents a change, as they need more people to work the vineyards, tractor drivers and so on. "Which is a lot of work," he told me, "but very good fun." The wine takes time to open up; the nose is hard to read, but the palate is much better.

 

2022 Vintage Ratings

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The bottled 2022 PSI follows the character of the sample I tasted last year: it's clean, expressive and open. It's perfumed, elegant, floral and quite attractive and does not transmit any heat. In fact, it has contained ripeness and around 13.8% alcohol. They have improved the selection tremendously, and the wine has gained in precision; it's better each year. There is something that reminds me of the old vintages of Pesquera (1994 and before), with notes of orange peel and aromatic herbs. It's medium-bodied, has fine tannins and very good freshness.

hard-ice-watermelon-freezie.title: Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Watermelon 200ml
hard-ice-watermelon-freezie.bodyHtml:
Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Watermelon is a ready-to-drink vodka freezie from Winterland Beverages Ltd. of British Columbia, in a single 200 ml serving at 6.8% ABV. The watermelon flavour is one of a family of Hard Ice vodka freezies made in Canada, alongside Bent Orange, Blue Bullet, Cream Soda, Grape, Pina Colada and Raspberry. Keep it in the freezer and enjoy it icy.

Serve: Freeze until firm, then enjoy straight from the pack.

hard-ice-grape-freezie.title: Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Blue Bullet 200ml
hard-ice-grape-freezie.bodyHtml:
Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Blue Bullet is a ready-to-drink vodka freezie from Winterland Beverages Ltd. of British Columbia, in a single 200 ml serving at 6.8% ABV. The blue bullet flavour is one of a family of Hard Ice vodka freezies made in Canada, alongside Bent Orange, Cream Soda, Grape, Pina Colada, Raspberry and Watermelon. Keep it in the freezer and enjoy it icy.

Serve: Freeze until firm, then enjoy straight from the pack.

hard-ice-raspberry-freezie.title: Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Raspberry 200ml
hard-ice-raspberry-freezie.bodyHtml:
The Hard Ice Raspberry Freezie (200 ml) is a frozen vodka cocktail in “freezie” / freeze pop form. The idea is you place the tube in the freezer until it gets slushy or semi-frozen, then squeeze / suck the frozen cocktail, similar to an alcoholic slush.

It combines vodka with raspberry flavoring (or “raspberry colada” in some listings) plus sweeteners, water, and flavoring agents. The product is marketed as a convenient, fun, pre-mixed frozen drink in a portable pouch.

g-m-speyside-malt-1989.title: The Glenlivet 14 Year Old Cognac Cask Selection
g-m-speyside-malt-1989.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 14 Year Old Cognac Cask Selection Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a ground-breaking and highly innovative Speyside single malt that brings a unique twist to a historic distillery's signature style. It is selectively matured in traditional American oak and Sherry casks for fourteen years before being finished for at least six months in high-quality ex-Cognac casks. This specialized finishing process beautifully layers sweet, fruity, and spicy French cognac influences over the classic, smooth, and floral honeyed character of The Glenlivet. The result is a wonderfully rich, inviting, and highly accessible dram that seamlessly bridges the worlds of Scottish distilling and French cognac craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rich chocolate-dipped raisins, warm apple pie, baked brie, caramelized pecan tarts, or slow-cooked duck breast with orange glaze.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance, offering a smooth, velvety, and well-balanced mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet and fruit-forward with aromas of ripe pears, cooked apples, honey, creamy milk chocolate, and subtle sultanas.

Palate : Rich and luscious with flavors of sweet raisins, poached pears, warm cinnamon, honeyed citrus, and gentle oak spice.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warm with lingering notes of sweet spice, dried fruit, and rich oak.

Serve : Best served neat in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of water to release its fruit and spice aromatics, or on the rocks.

rum-nation-jamaica-5-year-old.title: Rum Nation Jamaica Pot Still 5 Year Old Rum
rum-nation-jamaica-5-year-old.bodyHtml:
Rum Nation Jamaica Pot Still 5 Year Old Oloroso Sherry Finish is a pot still rum from the parish of St. Catherine, Jamaica, bottled by Rum Nation, the Italian independent rum house founded by Fabio Rossi in 1999. The rum first matured in ex-bourbon casks in the Caribbean, then was refined for 15 to 18 months in second-fill Oloroso sherry barrels, with a small share of Pedro Ximénez casks added to the blend. The result pairs the lively, funky character of young Jamaican pot still rum with the winey, fruity depth of sherry wood. It is bottled at 50% ABV in a 700ml bottle and comes in a gift box.

Tasting Notes: Ripe banana and pot still funk meet dried fruit, cocoa and sweet spice.

Nose: Very ripe banana, pot still funk, resinous pine, candied cherry and spice, opening to tea, honey and marzipan.

Palate: Powerful and lightly smoky, with cocoa, black liquorice, dried banana and currants.

Finish: Sweet spices with a lingering medicinal edge.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

rum-nation-trinidad-5-yr-old.title: Rum Nation Jamaica Pot Still 5 Year Old Rum
rum-nation-trinidad-5-yr-old.bodyHtml:

chappellet-sugar-loaf-cabernet-sauvginon.title: Chappellet Signature Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
chappellet-sugar-loaf-cabernet-sauvginon.bodyHtml:
Chappellet Signature Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a hallmark Napa Valley red wine crafted by the legendary Chappellet Winery, situated on the high-elevation slopes of Pritchard Hill. Sourced predominantly from rugged, well-drained volcanic soils, this mountain-grown Cabernet Sauvignon is blended with small percentages of complementary Bordeaux varietals to enhance its depth and complexity. Aged in French oak barrels, the 2022 vintage presents a deep ruby-purple hue accompanied by expressive aromas of dark blackberry, cassis, black cherry, graphite, sweet tobacco, and toasted cocoa spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and impeccably structured, framing intense dark stone fruit with firm, fine-grained mountain tannins and vibrant acidity that leads into a long, memorable finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime grilled ribeye, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison tenderloin, wild mushroom ragù, and aged cheddar.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Concentration and complexity join forces with aromas of mountain herbs, cedar carrying into flavors of cassis and dark chocolate, graphite and integrated oak spices. Juicy with intensity and an a mouthwatering finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

The nose is deep and savory with aromas of poached blood plums, cedar and tobacco leaves. The palate is full-bodied with finely integrated tannins and bright acidity, showing notes of mulberries, blackcurrants and mocha. Giving and powerful. Drinkable now, but best from 2028.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Well-priced for the quality, Chappellet's 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon Signature serves up bold aromas of mocha, cassis and black cherries. In the mouth, it's full-bodied and packed with flavor, nicely concentrated and framed by supple tannins. It's not overripe—a real risk this vintage—but does have a pronounced mocha note on the lingering finish.

honest-lot-sauvignon-blanc.title: Honest Lot Sauvignon Blanc
honest-lot-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Honest Lot Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh, crisp, and highly approachable white wine designed for effortless everyday enjoyment. It opens with an aromatic and lively bouquet of zesty citrus, green apple, and white peach, complemented by subtle, clean herbal notes. On the palate, this wine is light-to-medium-bodied and refreshingly dry, balancing its bright, fruit-forward flavors with a clean, mouth-watering acidity. Carefully crafted to be naturally smooth with very low sugar content, it delivers a remarkably clean, crisp, and uplifting finish.

Food Pairing: The vibrant acidity and clean fruit profile of this Sauvignon Blanc make it a fantastic match for fresh, lighter fare. It pairs beautifully with goat cheese crostini, mixed green salads with a lemon vinaigrette, grilled asparagus, and fresh seafood dishes like garlic butter shrimp or pan-seared white fish. It also serves as an excellent, palate-cleansing companion to salty appetizers and light chicken dishes.

honest-lot-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Honest Lot Cabernet Sauvignon
honest-lot-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Honest Lot Cabernet Sauvignon is a smooth, approachable, and fruit-driven red wine crafted as an easy-drinking "everyday" selection. It opens with inviting aromas of ripe blackcurrant, dark plum, and blueberry, accented by delicate hints of violet, soft sweet spice, and a touch of tobacco leaf. On the palate, this wine is medium-bodied and dry, striking an effortless balance between its rich black fruit flavors, soft acidity, and naturally smooth, supple tannins. Engineered specifically to be naturally smooth with very low sugar content, it offers a remarkably clean and velvety finish.

Food Pairing: This highly versatile and smooth Cabernet Sauvignon makes an excellent partner for casual, comforting meals. It pairs perfectly with wood-fired pizzas, gourmet bacon cheeseburgers, portobello mushroom burgers, or a board of flavorful medium-aged cheeses. It also complements roasted poultry, grilled sirloin steak, or herb-crusted roast lamb.

the-glenlivet-14-year-old.title: The Glenlivet 14 Year Old Cognac Cask Selection
the-glenlivet-14-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 14 Year Old Cognac Cask Selection Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a ground-breaking and highly innovative Speyside single malt that brings a unique twist to a historic distillery's signature style. It is selectively matured in traditional American oak and Sherry casks for fourteen years before being finished for at least six months in high-quality ex-Cognac casks. This specialized finishing process beautifully layers sweet, fruity, and spicy French cognac influences over the classic, smooth, and floral honeyed character of The Glenlivet. The result is a wonderfully rich, inviting, and highly accessible dram that seamlessly bridges the worlds of Scottish distilling and French cognac craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rich chocolate-dipped raisins, warm apple pie, baked brie, caramelized pecan tarts, or slow-cooked duck breast with orange glaze.

Tasting Notes : Rich golden amber in appearance, offering a smooth, velvety, and well-balanced mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet and fruit-forward with aromas of ripe pears, cooked apples, honey, creamy milk chocolate, and subtle sultanas.

Palate : Rich and luscious with flavors of sweet raisins, poached pears, warm cinnamon, honeyed citrus, and gentle oak spice.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warm with lingering notes of sweet spice, dried fruit, and rich oak.

Serve : Best served neat in a Glencairn glass, with a few drops of water to release its fruit and spice aromatics, or on the rocks.

hard-ice-strawberry-dreamsicle-freezie.title: Hard Ice Strawberry Dreamsicle Freezie 6 X 200ml

hard-ice-peach-freezie.title: Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Watermelon 200ml
hard-ice-peach-freezie.bodyHtml:
Hard Ice Vodka Freezie Watermelon is a ready-to-drink vodka freezie from Winterland Beverages Ltd. of British Columbia, in a single 200 ml serving at 6.8% ABV. The watermelon flavour is one of a family of Hard Ice vodka freezies made in Canada, alongside Bent Orange, Blue Bullet, Cream Soda, Grape, Pina Colada and Raspberry. Keep it in the freezer and enjoy it icy.

Serve: Freeze until firm, then enjoy straight from the pack.

freemark-abbey-bosche-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
freemark-abbey-bosche-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a classic, classic-styled Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon crafted from premium vineyard sources across the valley floor and mountain slopes. In the glass, it displays a deep garnet-purple color with intense clarity. The bouquet opens with inviting aromas of blackberry jam, dark plum, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with notes of milk chocolate, baking spices, cedar, dried tobacco, and subtle forest floor. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and supple, offering a dense core of black fruit flavor underpinned by fine-grained, firm tannins and a balanced, lively acidity that leads to a long, polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, savory venison stews, and aged hard cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This bold, ripe but nicely polished wine wraps black cherries, black currants and mint in moderate, fine-grained tannins that will help carry it for several years. Subtle cinnamon, clove and cedar accents keep it interesting on the finish. Best through 2030.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, polished style, with a relatively open-knit core of boysenberry and black cherry compote backed by friendly singed vanilla and licorice notes. A crowd-pleaser. Drink now through 2031.

freemark-abbey-sycamore-cabernet-sauvign.title: Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
freemark-abbey-sycamore-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:

g-m-speymalt-macallan-2000-1763.title: Gordon & MacPhail Speymalt From Macallan Distillery 2000 21 Year Old Cask #1763 55.5% ABV
g-m-speymalt-macallan-2000-1763.bodyHtml:
Established in 1824 and situated overlooking the fishing beats on the River Spey, the Macallan Distillery produces a wonderfully complex spirit which we then carefully mature in quality oak casks ordered specifically for the 'Speymalt from Macallan Distillery' range.

Each bottling carries the vintage of distillation and the year of bottling, capturing an exceptionally mature single malt whisky.


Fruitcake aromas with brown sugar and orange zest. The palate has raspberry and dried cherry with hints of earth and cocoa powder. A long and full finish of marzipan and spice.

jack-daniels-triple-mash.title: Jack Daniel's Triple Mash Blended Straight Whiskey
jack-daniels-triple-mash.bodyHtml:
A ground-breaking addition to the Jack Daniel’s Bonded Series, Triple Mash is a "Bottled-in-Bond" blend of three straight whiskeys: 60% Jack Daniel’s Tennessee Rye, 20% Jack Daniel’s Tennessee Whiskey, and 20% Jack Daniel’s American Single Malt. Each component is distilled in Lynchburg during the same season and aged according to strict bonded regulations before being married together. The result is a highly complex, 100-proof spirit that offers a unique departure from the traditional Jack Daniel's profile.

NOSE

Aromatic and rich with notes of honey, toasted oak, and dried fruit.

PALATE

Full-bodied and complex, featuring layers of dried fig, baking spices, and charred oak, balanced by a subtle sweetness.

FINISH

Long and robust with a lingering warmth of rye spice and toasted grain.

jack-daniels-bonded.title: Jack Daniel's Bonded Tennessee Whiskey
jack-daniels-bonded.bodyHtml:
A massive step up from the classic Old No. 7, Jack Daniel's Bonded honors the strict requirements of the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. This means the whiskey must be distilled by a single distiller during a single season, aged in a government-bonded warehouse for at least four years, and bottled at a robust 100 proof. The higher ABV and rigorous standards take the classic, sweet Jack Daniel's flavor profile and crank up the intensity, richness, and oak influence for a bolder, more complex sip.

NOSE 

The classic Jack Daniel's caramelized banana notes are amplified, joined by toasted oak, rich vanilla, and butterscotch.

PALATE

Bold and full-bodied with layered, heavily sweet flavors of toasted marshmallow, maple sugar candy, and warm baking spice.

FINISH

Long, sweet, and slightly herbal with a robust, oaky warmth.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements smoked brisket, barbecue ribs, grilled burgers, fried chicken, maple-glazed pork, pecan pie, and dark chocolate desserts.

glendalough-7-year-old-mizunara-cask.title: Glendalough 7 Year Old Single Malt Mizunara Finish Irish Whiskey
glendalough-7-year-old-mizunara-cask.bodyHtml: Glendalough's Mizunara 7-year single malt is vivid, but delicate with seamless depth. It is vibrant, fruity, and floral on the nose, enjoying a luxuriously smooth mouthfeel with notes of dark chocolate orange, sandalwood and cinnamon synonymous with Mizunara whiskeys. This unique whiskey benefits from an exceptionally long finish of toasted oak and oriental spices, with the dark chocolate lingering even longer

mcguinness-melon.title: Mcguinness Melon
mcguinness-melon.bodyHtml:
McGuinness Melon is a melon liqueur from McGuinness, the Canadian liqueur range made by Corby Spirit and Wine. Bright green with a gentle melon flavour, it is a fun pick for St. Patrick's Day and the essential ingredient in the classic Melon Ball shot. Bottled at 15% ABV in a 750 ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Gentle melon flavour.

Serve: In a Melon Ball shot or fruity cocktails.

dangerville-meursault-2018.title: Domaine Marquis D'Angerville Meursault Santenots 1er Cru 2018 750ml

dangerville-meursault-2015.title: Domaine Marquis d'Angerville Meursault-Santenots 2015 750ml
dangerville-meursault-2015.bodyHtml:
A rare white Burgundy from a domaine best known for its reds, the 2015 Meursault Santenots 1er Cru is a powerful yet refined expression of Chardonnay. Grown in the prestigious Santenots vineyard, this wine opens with elegant aromas of ripe citrus, white flowers, and toasted almonds, underpinned by subtle hints of oak and mineral. On the palate, it is full-bodied and richly textured, delivering layers of stone fruit, lemon curd, and delicate spice, balanced by a vibrant acidity and a long, focused finish.

This vintage showcases remarkable depth and aging potential, making it a standout for collectors and enthusiasts alike. Best enjoyed with lobster, roasted poultry, or creamy mushroom risotto.

dangerville-champans-2017.title: Domaine Marquis D'Angerville Volnay Champans 1er Cru 2017 750ml
dangerville-champans-2017.bodyHtml: Domaine Marquis d'Angerville Volnay Premier Cru Champans 2017 comes from the domaine’s 3.98 hectares in Champans, two parallel parcels running from the top to the bottom of this south-east-facing climat just north of Caillerets, at the centre of Volnay’s premiers crus. Soils are thin over limestone at the top of the slope, becoming deeper, more clayey and stony lower down. Historically ranked among the Têtes de Cuvée of Volnay, Champans is described by the domaine as the archetype of great Volnay premier cru – fine, broad and long, with added generosity – usually needing five to ten years to show fully. The estate has been biodynamic since 2009 and ages its wines about 18 months in barrel.

dangerville-taillepieds-2017.title: Domaine Marquis d'Angerville Volnay Premier Cru Taillepieds 2023
dangerville-taillepieds-2017.bodyHtml:
A refined Volnay showing dark berries, ripe plum, orange zest, violet, subtle spice, and pronounced mineral character. Concentrated Pinot Noir combines vibrant acidity with fine, structured tannins, creating a harmonious Premier Cru with impressive precision, depth, elegance, and a long mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast duck, veal, beef tenderloin, game birds, mushroom dishes, pork tenderloin, truffle preparations, or aged cheeses.

dangerville-combes-dessus-2018.title: Domaine Marquis D'Angerville Pommard 1er Cru 'Combes Dessus' 2018 750ml

clos-de-tart-la-forge-de-tart.title: Domaine du Clos de Tart La Forge De Tart 2017/2018
clos-de-tart-la-forge-de-tart.bodyHtml:
This Forge de Tart shows great concentration on the nose and unveils lashings of dark fruit (plum, cassis, black cherry), spice and a savoury, black olive note. It shows great balance with smooth, velvety tannins and a lingering, energetic finish.

92 Points - Decanter

This was previously a cuvée made by Clos de Tart only in certain years (often when they needed greater selection for the first wine) but it will now be produced annually from the vines that are under 20 years old. Touches of caramel-edged oak at first that is slightly intrusive, but as it opens up there is tons of blueberry and raspberry fruit. Fresh and appealing, silky with edges of steel.

penfolds-grange-shiraz-2015.title: Penfolds Bin 95 Grange 2015 750ml
penfolds-grange-shiraz-2015.bodyHtml:
Crafted utilising fully-ripe, intensely-flavoured and structured shiraz grapes, the result is a unique Australian style that is now recognised as one of the most consistent of the world’s great wines.
100 Points - James Suckling

Much anticipated vintage for Grange and it is a powerhouse of concentration and complexity. Aromas of orange and lemon peel to start, then graphite, blackberries, plum paste, black cherries, boundless sweet oak spice, fresh cedar, tar, mahogany, roasted coffee and chocolate - the list goes on. Such complexity. Classic Grange, offers such deep, dark intensity. The palate has immense richness and depth with a super succulent and very long, fleshy, deeply weighted array of dense, velvet-wrapped tannins that run so long. The fruit flavours sit in the blackberry, blood-plum and blueberry zone with succulent, long and assertive structure, carrying through in an utterly seamless mode. The finish is tightly wrenched, in spectacularly powerful style, locking this wine in for a very long haul. Best from 2030.

99 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The flagship 2015 Grange is a monster of wine and one of those rare wines that blend power and elegance perfectly. Revealing a saturated purple colour, it’s seemingly more forward and seductive than past great vintages, which I suspect is due to the incredible purity of fruit as well as the wine’s flawless balance than any change in winemaking or stylistic shifts. I also think the acidity is healthy, and 2015 tips the scales at 14.5% alcohol, which is certainly in the sweet spot, if not tame, for beautifully ripe Syrah these days. A blend of 98% Shiraz and 2% Cabernet Sauvignon that spent 20 months in new American oak hogsheads, it offers an extraordinary perfume of sweet crème de cassis, lead pencil shavings, camphor, Asian spices, licorice, and wildflowers. This is followed by a full-bodied, powerful yet incredibly seamless and elegant Shiraz that has no hard edges, a big, dense mid-palate, ripe tannins, and a great finish. Coming close to 1986, which has always been a benchmark vintage of Grange for me, 2015 offers a more polished, elegant, approachable style. Vintage comparisons aside, this is a legendary example of Grange in the making. The savvy wine lovers out there will give this 7-8 years of bottle age (I’ll probably be out of bottles by then) and enjoy it over the following 2-3 decades.

99 Points - James Halliday

Bang. The first whiff cries, Grange. A lifted, fragrant, harmonious blend of fruit, oak (American, of course) and finely pitched tannins. Faultless. It's all relative, but this is starting to relax its grip. And the length is very, very special.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The nose of the 2015 Grange features the wine's characteristic lifted aromas, joined by pronounced American oak influence and bold blackberry fruit, plus hints of red meat, raspberries, asphalt and vanilla. It's dense and concentrated on the palate, full-bodied yet balanced and firm, with a rich, velvety texture and long, plush finish.

98 Points - Vinous

Saturated ruby. Deeply pitched spice-accented aromas of cassis, smoky minerals, incense and dark chocolate. Large-scaled and broad in the mouth, offering intense blackcurrant, cherry-vanilla, mocha and candied violet flavours that are supported by a core of juicy acidity. Shows superb density and vivacity as well, with no rough edges. Finishes extremely long and precise, with building tannins and resonating bitter chocolate, exotic spice and floral notes. 

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This vintage of the famed wine is perhaps the most approachable to date. The nose is open and expressive, with waves of aromas ranging from licorice, currant and plum to baking spice, furniture polish, freshly picked olive, mushroom and vanilla. The mouthfeel is satiny in texture, awash with fruit and spices of all shapes and sizes, all wound by fine tannins.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Distinctive and powerful, yet still elegant, showing restraint despite the dense and generous flavours. Precise notes of dark chocolate, maraschino cherry, mahogany and toasted coconut complement the core of wild blackberry and blueberry fruit. The tannins are smooth and polished, delivering some tug on the finish, which persists as subtle hints of dried lavender and white pepper linger. Drink now through 2040.

lindemans-bin-45-cabernet-sauvignon-1.title: Lindeman's Bin 45 Cabernet Sauvignon
lindemans-bin-45-cabernet-sauvignon-1.bodyHtml:
Lindeman's Bin 45 Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptionally approachable, full-bodied, and fruit-forward Australian red wine that consistently delivers remarkable value and reliable, everyday-drinking enjoyment. Sourced from the broad, sun-drenched vineyards of the South Eastern Australia wine region, this classic expression showcases a deep ruby red color in the glass. The highly inviting aromatic bouquet opens with robust notes of dark ripe berries, juicy blackcurrant, and fresh dark plum, beautifully interwoven with subtle hints of cool mint, warm vanilla, and a touch of toasted cedar oak. On the palate, the wine is delightfully smooth and well-rounded, offering a generous core of dark fruit flavors that are perfectly supported by soft, velvety tannins. A gentle, balanced acidity carries this highly versatile profile through to a clean, crowd-pleasing finish laced with a whisper of spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic grilled hamburgers, hearty beef stews, slow-roasted leg of lamb, rich tomato-based pasta dishes, and mature cheddar cheese.

lindemans-bin-65-chardonnay-3.title: Lindemans Bin 65 Chardonnay 3L Bag In Box

penfolds-grange-shiraz-2017.title: Penfolds Grange Shiraz
penfolds-grange-shiraz-2017.bodyHtml: Penfolds Grange Shiraz is a South Australian Shiraz from Penfolds. This listing is a 750ml bottle at 14.5% ABV. Please ask our team to confirm the vintage before ordering.

nutrl-juicd-variety-pack.title: Nutrl Juic D Variety Pack 8 Cans
nutrl-juicd-variety-pack.bodyHtml:
NÜTRL JUIC'D Variety Pack brings together the crisp refreshment of vodka soda with a splash of real fruit juice for a vibrant, fruit-forward drinking experience. Crafted with vodka, sparkling soda water, and real juice, NÜTRL JUIC'D offers a refreshing balance of juicy flavour and lively carbonation without added sugar. Perfect for casual gatherings, summer barbecues, and entertaining, this convenient eight-can variety pack makes it easy to enjoy a selection of refreshing vodka-based drinks. Serve well chilled or over ice for a crisp, easy-drinking experience.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken skewers, fish tacos, shrimp ceviche, barbecue wings, fresh fruit platters, and light summer salads.

Tasting Notes: Light, crisp, and sparkling, with juicy fruit character, refreshing carbonation, and a clean vodka soda profile.

Nose: Bright fruit aromas with subtle citrus freshness.

Palate: Refreshing fruit flavours balanced by gentle vodka character and lively bubbles.

Finish: Clean, crisp, and refreshing, with lingering fruit notes.

Serve: Best enjoyed chilled directly from the can or poured over ice with a fresh citrus garnish.

marchesi-di-barolo-cannubi-cru.title: Marchesi Di Barolo Cannubi Barolo 2019
marchesi-di-barolo-cannubi-cru.bodyHtml:
A monumental and prestigious expression of Barolo’s most famous "Cru," the 2019 Cannubi is a testament to the exceptional elegance and complexity of this historic site. Characterized by sand-rich Tortonian soils, this vintage presents a brilliant garnet color with ruby highlights. The nose is extraordinarily layered, offering a high-toned bouquet of dried cherries, wild strawberries, and rose petals, seamlessly interwoven with sophisticated notes of tobacco, black tea, and a distinct spicy minerality. On the palate, it is full-bodied and aristocratic, showcasing a velvety texture with noble, well-integrated tannins and a vibrant, long-lived acidity. Following approximately two years of aging in large Slavonian oak casks, it delivers an extraordinarily persistent finish with lingering nuances of licorice and forest floor.

94 Points - James Suckling

Beautiful perfumes and fresh flowers come out of the glass with undertones of sandalwood. It’s medium- to full-bodied with fine tannins and a polished and seductive finish. Drinkable but better with a few years of bottle age. Try after 2025.
93 Points - Wine Spectator
Though marked by new oak, this red also boasts generous cherry and raspberry fruit, with hints of eucalyptus and tar. Elegant overall, yet will need time to absorb the oak. Vanilla-tinged finish. Best from 2026 through 2042.
92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Barolo Cannubi is another wine in this series that feels weighed down by oak, making it more difficult to recognize the delicate nuances of site, especially for a wine born in one of the most celebrated vineyards in Italy. Cannubi shows floral tones and crushed limestone, but just like Sarmassa and Coste di Rose (the two other special selections in a tall bottle with the light blue capsule), there is a lot of cinnamon and toasted spice to distract you.
91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Spiced cherries macerating in their juices with candied roses and cedar aromas fill the glass of this forward and generous Barolo. Fruit of the forest preserves with licorice, anise and clove drive the palate as rounded tannins offer a generosity and approachability to the wine today. Drink now–2040.

la-spinetta-barolo-campe.title: La Spinetta Vursu Barolo Campe 2020
la-spinetta-barolo-campe.bodyHtml:
The 2020 La Spinetta Barolo Campè Vürsù is a majestic and highly approachable expression from a vintage noted for its beautifully open-knit personality. Sourced from 70-year-old vines in the prestigious Campè vineyard in Grinzane Cavour, it offers an elegant bouquet of small red berries, rose petals, jasmine, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is precise and structured, showcasing a dark fruit core with smoky layers of campfire ash, flinty stone, and blueberry jam. Despite its power, the 2020 vintage is praised for its "easy-to-drink" nature at a young age, featuring fine-grained, powdery tannins and a wide, persistent finish.

95 Points - James Suckling

Rich and inviting Barolo with notes of peach pits, sandalwood, red cherries, sweet basil and potpourri. It’s full-bodied and encompassing with fine-grained, powdery tannins. Powerful fruit. Try from 2027.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The La Spinetta 2020 Barolo Campè Vürsù depicts a lion on the label that represents the "king of wines, the wine of kings" as Barolo is often described. It has a dark core of fruit with smoky layers of campfire ash and flinty stone. The definition is medium-sharp and the wine reveals a darkly concentrated appearance. The bouquet is still a little closed at this young stage and in need of a more cellaring.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Rose, cherry and pomegranate flavors are framed with juniper, eucalyptus, spice and iron notes in this elegant yet intense red. Firmly structured and builds nicely to the long, complex aftertaste. Best from 2028 through 2042.

tiefenbrunner-pinot-grigio.title: Tiefenbrunner Pinot Grigio 2023 750ml
tiefenbrunner-pinot-grigio.bodyHtml:
Straw yellow in color with lemon reflexes, this Pinot Grigio is youthful and lively. In the nose this wine has aromas of citrus, white blossoms, pears, apples and meadow grass. There is a fresh, crisp minerality and a clear finish.

Wonderful as an aperitif as well as a wine that pairs well with butter-poached fish, scampi's, and pasta dishes such as pasta primavera.

justin-savant.title: Justin Savant 2021
justin-savant.bodyHtml: Bright with a purple-ruby core that lightens at the rim, with thick, heavy moderately stained tears on the glass. Aromatic with ripe plum, fresh mission fig, black currant fruit, vanilla, tobacco leaf, dried violet flower, cinnamon, clove, eucalyptus bark, and oak. Full-bodied with very ripe black and blue fruits on entry. Boysenberry, blackberry, and black cherry lead to a midpalate that is robust, with savory elements of black olive, cured meat, dried sage, and autumn leaves, surrounded by balanced moderate-plus tannins. The long finish is highlighted by smooth, balanced fruit with barrel spice, smoky black tea, and toasted oak flavors.

el-enemigo-gran-ememigo-gualtallary.title: El Enemigo Gran Enemigo Gualtallary Cabernet Franc 2020
el-enemigo-gran-ememigo-gualtallary.bodyHtml:
A monumental and crystalline expression of high-altitude viticulture, the 2020 Gran Enemigo Gualtallary is sourced from a single vineyard characterized by its intense limestone and rocky soils at nearly 5,000 feet. This vintage presents a deep, saturated ruby color and an extraordinarily complex nose of crushed blackcurrants, wild raspberries, and violets, interwoven with high-toned notes of graphite, jarilla (wild herbs), and a distinct stony minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied yet remarkably lithe, showcasing a vertical structure with fine-grained, chalky tannins and a vibrant, racy acidity. Matured for 18 months in century-old French oak foudres, it delivers an exceptionally long, savory finish marked by lingering floral nuances and a cool-climate precision.

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Gran Enemigo Gualtallary Single Vineyard is nothing but phenomenal. It's very fresh and balanced and, for a warm year like 2020, doesn't show any heat or excess; it's subtle and has an ethereal character within the powerful and exuberant character from Gualtallary. It fermented in concrete with indigenous yeasts and some full clusters, sometimes up to 70% of the volume. It's intense and powerful, but something makes if feel light on its feet and with great inner power. This is still young and should develop nicely in bottle and for a long time.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

Ink and licorice with blackberry and black olive aromas. Medium-to full-bodied with round, fine tannins that are crunchy and refined. It has a juicy undertone and a savory finish. Just a hint of cedar and caramel at the end.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Fresh rosemary, graphite and tobacco accents meld with an elegant, orange peel–accented raspberry and plum core that reveals cocoa nib details while unfurling around a nice lift of fresh acidity, driving the flavors onto the finish structured around tannins. Drink now through 2040.

gp-brewing-vodka.title: GP Vodka
gp-brewing-vodka.bodyHtml:
GP Vodka (also known as GP Brewing Handcrafted Vodka) is a smooth, easy-drinking Canadian craft spirit distilled by GP Brewing Company in Grande Prairie, Alberta. Multiple times distilled and constantly filtered for exceptional clarity, it is cut with pure glacier water to achieve a crisp, refreshing character.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with sour cream and caviar, fresh oysters, cured meats, and light appetizers.

Tasting Notes : Colorless, clear, and bright in appearance, providing a crisp, light, and exceptionally smooth mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and neutral with faint, subtle hints of fresh grain.

Palate : Soft, clean, and smooth with subtle grain sweetness and crisp, pure water undertones.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing.

Serve : Served well-chilled neat, over ice, or as a smooth base in classic mixed drinks and cocktails.

jiangsi-yanghe-dream-blue-m6-meng-zhi-l.title: Yanghe Mengzhilan-Dream Blue M6+
jiangsi-yanghe-dream-blue-m6-meng-zhi-l.bodyHtml:
Yanghe Mengzhilan Dream Blue M6+ is a Chinese baijiu from Jiangsu Yanghe Distillery, part of the Yanghe Blue Classic range (梦之蓝 Mengzhilan, "Dream Blue"). It is made from a multi-grain recipe of water, sorghum, rice, glutinous rice, wheat, corn, barley and peas. The M6+ is a premium expression in the Dream Blue line, presented in a deep blue bottle. Bottled at 52% ABV in a 550ml bottle.

Serve: Neat at room temperature in small cups, traditionally alongside a meal.

lagala-aquila-del-vulture-magnum.title: Lagala Massaron Aglianico del Vulture Riserva 1.5L Magnum
lagala-aquila-del-vulture-magnum.bodyHtml:
Produced from 100% Aglianico del Vulture, this Riserva reveals ripe berries, bitter almond, chocolate, and vanilla aromas. Full-bodied and elegant, the palate is round, smooth, and structured with mature tannins and a lingering finish.

 Food Pairing: Grilled steaks, roasted lamb, wild game, braised beef, aged cheeses, hearty stews, mushroom dishes, rich pasta preparations.

lagala-aquila-del-vulture.title: Lagala Aquila del Vulture Aglianico del Vulture
lagala-aquila-del-vulture.bodyHtml:
A magnificent Southern Italian red wine displaying an intense ruby color with orange-tinted edges. The highly complex nose opens with ripe forest fruits, masterfully layered with dark chocolate, bitter almond, and vanilla notes. On the palate, it balances structured, noble tannins.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with slow-braised beef, grilled ribeye steaks, roasted wild boar ragù, rich truffle-infused pastas, and mature pecorino cheeses.

lagala-maddalena-bianco-white.title: Lagala Maddalena Bianco 2020
lagala-maddalena-bianco-white.bodyHtml:
Lagala Maddalena Bianco 2020 is an elegant, expressive Italian white wine produced by Cantine Lagala in the Basilicata region. Visually displaying a bright straw-yellow hue with greenish reflections, it opens with a delicate and aromatic bouquet of white peach, crisp green apple, and citrus blossom, interwoven with subtle herbal accents and crushed stone mineral notes. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with a fresh, vibrant acidity and a clean, dry finish that highlights its pleasant minerality and fruit purity.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh seafood, grilled white fish, light pasta dishes, goat cheese crostini, chicken piccata, and seasonal green salads.

lagala-massaron-red-aglianico.title: Lagala Massaron Aglianico del Vulture Riserva
lagala-massaron-red-aglianico.bodyHtml:
Produced from 100% Aglianico del Vulture, this Riserva offers aromas of ripe blackberry, plum, cocoa, and spice. Full-bodied and refined, the palate delivers concentrated fruit, balanced acidity, and polished tannins with a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled steaks, roasted lamb, braised beef, aged cheeses, mushroom risotto, game dishes, hearty pasta, rich stews.

lagala-nero-degli-orsini-dod-red.title: Lagala Nero Degli Orsini Aglianico del Vulture
lagala-nero-degli-orsini-dod-red.bodyHtml:
Made from Aglianico grown on volcanic slopes of Monte Vulture, this wine offers blackberry, plum, violet, and spice aromas. Rich and structured, the palate delivers dark fruit, balanced acidity, and firm tannins with a persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled lamb, braised beef, wild game, aged cheeses, mushroom risotto, roasted vegetables, hearty pasta, savory stews.

lagala-maddalena-rosso-red.title: Tenuta Lagala Maddalena Rosso Basilicata
lagala-maddalena-rosso-red.bodyHtml:
A magnificent and beautifully expressive Southern Italian red wine crafted from 100% Aglianico grapes grown on the volcanic slopes of Mount Vulture in Venosa. It opens with an elegant and fresh bouquet of wild forest berries, dark cherries, and a classic hint of bitter almond. On the palate, it delivers a well-structured and pleasantly tannic profile balanced by a vibrant mineral backbone, showing a deep ruby-red color that develops delicate orange hues with age.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with grilled or roasted meats, rich pasta dishes with savory meat ragù, mixed antipasti platters, or a selection of medium-aged cheeses.

ricasoli-torricella.title: Ricasoli Torricella 2021 750ml
ricasoli-torricella.bodyHtml: Extremely complex on the nose it shows all of its energy and sensory depth from the start with notes of acacia, juniper, walnut husk, bergamot and litchee. A lot of lemon rind and grapefruit juice describe the central character of the matrix. Medium to full bodied, a balanced and harmonic structure and a finale of extreme beauty that demands a return to the glass. Great growth from this pure Chardonnay, one of the best from Tuscany.

lostal-cazes-grand-vin.title: Famille J.M Cazes Lostal Cazes Grand Vin Minervois La Liviniere 2018 750ml
lostal-cazes-grand-vin.bodyHtml: L'Ostal Cazes Grand Vin 2018 is a red from the Minervois La Livinière appellation in the Languedoc, made by the Cazes family, Famille J.M. Cazes, whose name appears on the label. It is the domaine's grand vin. 750ml, 14.5% alcohol.

1573-national-cellar-spirit-of-china.title: National Cellar 1573 Spirit of China Baijiu 500ml
1573-national-cellar-spirit-of-china.bodyHtml: <meta charset="UTF-8">Luzhou Laojiao Distillery dates back to 1573, to the Ming dynasty, and is the oldest continuously producing baijiu distillery in the world.  It was included in the first 'List of National Intangible Cultural Heritage' in 2006 and continues to represent Chinese traditional culture and craftsmanship passed on through the centuries.  Their 'National Cellar 1573 • Spirit of China' is a commemorative baijiu product specially made in honor of China's 1573 National Treasures Cellars.  'Spirit of China' possesses softness, mellowness, and elegance, with a texture that is mild, sweet, and clear, free from impurities, while carrying the sentiments of Chinese traditional culture, scholars, and literary pursuits.

rabbit-hole-cavehill.title: Rabbit Hole Cavehill Kentucky Straight Bourbon
rabbit-hole-cavehill.bodyHtml:
Rabbit Hole Cavehill Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a highly innovative, four-grain premium whiskey that honors the rich distilling heritage of Louisville, Kentucky. Crafted by founder Kaveh Zamanian, this expression sets itself apart by incorporating honey malted barley into its unique mashbill, adding a distinct, sweet, and bready complexity. The spirit is distilled using a modern vendome copper column still before undergoing a patient maturation process in hand-selected, toasted and charred new American oak barrels. Rather than leaning purely into heavy wood tannins, Cavehill focuses on a fruit-forward and creamy profile, offering an approachable yet deeply layered character that serves as a shining example of modern craft bourbon innovation.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with slow-roasted pork tenderloin with an apricot glaze, warm brioche bread pudding, sea salt caramels, light charcuterie, or a mild blue cheese.

TASTING NOTES - A bright honey-amber color with a medium body and a notably creamy, smooth, and velvety texture on the palate.
