NOSE - Aromatic and highly inviting, opening with sweet aromas of honeyed malt, vanilla cream, and fresh apple, followed by subtle hints of orange zest, toasted brioche, and a touch of light baking spice.

PALATE - Soft and complex on the tongue, leading with a distinct initial sweetness of toasted nuts and butterscotch, which transitions beautifully into flavors of fresh red fruit, creamed corn, sweet honey, and gentle baking spices.

FINISH - Medium to long and pleasantly warming, resolving smoothly with lingering notes of sweet vanilla fudge, dry wood spice, and a subtle touch of custody cream.

SERVE - Best enjoyed poured neat at room temperature in a classic Glencairn or spirits nosing glass to savor its unique honey malt characteristics, or with a single large ice cube to enhance its bright fruit notes.

alley-kat-seven-variety-pack-seltzer.title: Alley Kat Seven Variety Pack Seltzer 12 Cans
alley-kat-seven-variety-pack-seltzer.bodyHtml: Alley Kat Seven Variety Pack Seltzer 12 Cans

truly-iced-tea-variety-pack-1.title: White Peaks Iced Tea Variety Pack 2026

summer-love-peach-vodka-2.title: Starr Distilling Summer Love Peach Vodka
summer-love-peach-vodka-2.bodyHtml:
Starr Distilling Summer Love Peach Vodka is a peach-flavoured vodka from Starr Distilling in Alberta. The distillery describes it as light and highly aromatic, with a ripe-peach character that recalls a summer orchard. Bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is made to sip on its own or to bring peach flavour to cocktails.

Serve: Over ice, with soda and a squeeze of lemon, or in a peach Bellini-style cocktail.

folly-of-the-beast-pinot-noir.title: Folly Of The Beast Pinot Noir 750ml
folly-of-the-beast-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2019 vintage) "Slightly tarry aromas of cranberry, charred beef and dusty, baked earth show on the nose of this bottling. Blistered cranberry flavors meet with slightly bitter earth tones on the palate. Matt Kettmann" - 87/100, Wine Enthusiast

unnamed-orkney-signatory-46.title: Signatory Vintage Un-Chillfiltered Collection Unnamed Orkney 2009 Bourbon Hogsheads
unnamed-orkney-signatory-46.bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch whisky comes from an undisclosed distillery on Orkney and is bottled by Signatory Vintage as part of its Un-Chillfiltered Collection. It was distilled in 2009 and matured in bourbon hogsheads before being bottled at 46% ABV. As the collection name says, it is bottled without chill filtration and at natural colour, so it may turn slightly cloudy when stored somewhere cool. Signatory notes that this presentation keeps the whisky fuller in body and flavour. This listing is the 700ml bottle in a Signatory presentation tube.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

bread-and-butter-sauvignon-blanc.title: Bread & Butter Sauvignon Blanc 2023 / 2024
bread-and-butter-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Expressive and shining with aromas of lemon zest and a hint of tropical fruit. Lively flavors of fresh citrus lead to a rich texture that is completed by enticing minerality and a clean, refreshing finish.

The wine goes well with appetizers featuring savory meats and juicy fruits, goat cheese salads or sandwiches, and the simplicity of staycations especially those with a pool or beach nearby.

 

2024 Vintage Ratings

89 Points - James Suckling

A fresh, clean, transparent wine that’s full-bodied and fruity with a good nip of acidity to energize the mouthfeel. Green-apple, lemon-zest and cucumber flavors. 

2023 Vintage Ratings

86 Points - James Suckling

The nose offers classic aromas of peaches, nectarines and fresh pineapple. The palate is medium-bodied and lacks acidity, flavor and freshness, with notes of guavas and cut grass.

ben-nevis-2011-signatory-46.title: Signatory Vintage Ben Nevis 2014 9 Year Old 46% ABV
ben-nevis-2011-signatory-46.bodyHtml:
Distilled in 2014 and matured 9 years in a pair of Bourbon Barrels before bottling at 46% without added colouring of chill filtering.

Nose: Jujubes, gristy malt, and toasted oak; Boursin and a bit of chevre; nutty,  lemongrass, and herbs. 

Palate: still malty and grassy with soft toasted oak and cracked walnuts; chevre with lemon slices; white pepper, melons, and herbal tea.

Finish: medium long, warming and fresh; more herbal notes, malt, white pepper, and subtle fruits.

Comment: this is a rather naked, malty Ben Nevis, brimming with some of the cheesy-fruity spirit character the distillery is famous for.

vallein-tercinier-fins-bois-1989-48-50.title: Vallein Tercinier 1989 Fins Bois Cognac
vallein-tercinier-fins-bois-1989-48-50.bodyHtml:
Vallein Tercinier Lot 89 is a 1989 vintage Fins Bois Très Vieux Cognac, bottled brut de fût at its natural cask strength of 48.5% ABV after about 29 years in oak. Selected by the family's cellar master for its depth and character, it is presented in the house's traditional wooden case. It scored 90 points from Whisky Fun.

Tasting Notes: citrus, fennel, vanilla, apricot and candied prune.

Nose: Vegetal and citrus notes, opening to fennel, tobacco, vanilla, cinnamon and candied prune.

Palate: Rich and full, with pear, vanilla and apricot.

Finish: Madeira and prune, moving towards praline and roasted walnut.

Serve: Neat in a tulip glass at room temperature; add a drop of water to open it up if you like.

chadwick.title: Vinedo Chadwick 2019
chadwick.bodyHtml:
Viñedo Chadwick 2019 is an extraordinarily elegant, precise, and masterfully structured icon red wine from Chile, celebrating the 25th anniversary vintage of this historic estate. Sourced entirely from the high-altitude alluvial gravel terraces of Puente Alto in the Maipo Valley—originally the personal polo field of Alfonso Chadwick—this vintage benefited from a moderately warm growing season balanced by a cooler March, allowing for a long, gentle maturation of the grapes. Displaying a beautiful, brilliant ruby-red color with a violet shimmer, the wine opens with an alluring, multi-layered bouquet of fresh cherries, raspberries, and black fruits, delicately framed by notes of sweet baking spices like cloves and nutmeg, alongside pastries and a subtle floral touch. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied yet remarkably agile and focused mouthfeel driven by a concentrated core of red berries and raspberry pie, seamlessly balanced by great tension, crystalline freshness, and incredibly polished, silky tannins before tapering into an endlessly persistent and sophisticated mineral-drenched finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with rosemary-crusted rack of lamb, charcoal-grilled dry-aged ribeye steak, slow-braised wild boar stew, or roasted venison loin with a juniper reduction.

99 Points - James Suckling

Subtle and very beautiful with currants, tarragon, basil and rose petals in the aromas. It’s full-bodied, yet agile and so fine-textured with superb tannins that provide multi-layers on the palate. It’s refined, yet powerful at the end. Suggests greatness and longevity. Lots of blackcurrants, stones and violets in the after taste. Cabernet sauvignon with a touch of petit verdot. This needs three or four years to show its true greatness.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate 

The 2019 Viñedo Chadwick is a classical Cabernet Sauvignon from Puente Alto, one of the best zones within Maipo. It's from a moderately warm vintage that delivered a wine with only 13% alcohol and good freshness. It contains some 3% Petit Verdot. The vines were planted in 1992, and its gapes fermented in equal parts in stainless steel and concrete or troncoconic vats. Three-fourths of the wine matured in new barriques and the rest in Stockinger foudres for 22 months, including time for the malolactic fermentation. I was truly impressed by this vintage, especially because of its elegance and freshness. There are showy aromas reminiscent of tangerine and flowers, ripe red berries (rather than black) and a spicy twist from the oak but nothing herbal or balsamic that one could expect given the moderate ripeness. The grapes were picked very early, and the wine follows the path of the 2016, the coolest vintage so far, with juicy fruit, elegance and great tension. This feels exceptional and transcends the style of the year. 10,000 bottles produced. It was bottled the 25th of January 2021.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Very elegant and refined, with a suave minerality to the red cherry and dried raspberry flavors, which are backed by crisp acidity and tannins. The fine-grained finish has hints of underbrush, notes of dried savory spice and a dollop of mint. Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2026.

pahlmeyer-chardonnay.title: Pahlmeyer Chardonnay 2021 / 2022
pahlmeyer-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The Pahlmeyer Chardonnay is a masterful balance of opulence and vibrancy. Stone fruit aromatics give way to a fresh tropical lift with underscoring hints of toasted marshmallow and flint. This Chardonnay is concentrated and focused on the palate, unfurling a rich tapestry of crushed Marcona almond, freshly baked macaroon, and preserved lemon buoyed by dynamic acidity. The palate is textured and rich while bright and lively, with intense, ever-evolving flavors that linger through the finish.

2021 Vintage Ratings

98 Points - James Suckling

Sliced cooked apples with biscuit and pie crust undertones, as well as hints of spices with some salted caramel. Hints of apricot. Full-bodied with a firmness and depth. Creamy-textured phenolics and great length. One of the best I have tasted. It is rich and flavorful, yet it shows great depth and length. Drinkable, but better in two or three years.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The price has almost quintupled since the 1991 played an instrumental role in the film "Disclosure" (1994; Michael Douglas, Demi Moore), but Pahlmeyer's 2021 Chardonnay remains a stunningly seductive wine. All barrel fermented and matured 11 months in 91% new French oak—mostly François Frères—bottled unfixed and unfiltered, it boasts an intoxicating perfume of gently toasted brioche, roasted cashews and hazelnuts, grilled pear and pineapple. In the mouth, it's medium to full-bodied, concentrated and dense, yet silky and fine, with a lingering, elegant finish. Fruit sources include the Pahlmeyer Estate Vineyard but also Stagecoach, , Hudson and Hyde. Best After 2023

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Packs an exotic note of litsea oil and a hint of flint, which becomes a smoky grace note for the core of ripe pear, lemon sherbet, makrut lime leaf, sweet grass, salted caramel and toffee. Reveals honeysuckle elements that linger on the long, expressive finish, with a fresh thread of acidity. Drink now through 2028.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This effusive, ripe and buttery wine pulls out all the stops to offer a luxurious, creamy texture, tropical fruit flavors and a full body. Pineapples, Fuji apples, buttered toast, blackened oak and cream notes make a rich harmony.

 

2022 Vintage Ratings

 

97 Points - James Suckling

Extremely rich, ripe and creamy, this luxurious wine ferments and ages in 90% new French barrels, and a majority of the grapes come from Old Wente clone vines from Atlas Peak AVA vineyards. Aromas of butterscotch, vanilla bean, poached pears and toasted baguette lead to an incredibly silky palate of ripe fruit and oak spices.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Expansive, broad and aromatic, the notes of toasted fennel, lemon thyme, litsea oil and vetiver leap out of the glass, giving way to opulent flavors of grilled peach, caramelized pineapple and spiced, baked apples. Shows power and elegance, with crisp acidity pushing the flavors into clarity and helping them linger on the fresh finish.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Richly flavored and mouthwatering, this wine offers a well-balanced expression of a generous style. Juicy, ripe yellow fruits and sweet pear are pleasantly spiced, carried through a long finish by brightening acidity.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Winemaker Katie Vogt started picking for Pahlmeyer's 2022 Chardonnay in August, with just a couple of blocks hanging into September. As always, it's all fermented in roughly 90% new François Frères barrels. The nose boasts scents of toasted hazelnuts and white peaches, plus hints of cashew and grilled pineapple. In the mouth, this vintage is full-bodied, broad and expansive—perhaps a bit warm. Fruit this vintage came from Antinori, Hyde, Toyon, Stagecoach and Waters Ranch (Pahlmeyer's estate vineyard).

secret-speyside-1998-50-30-the-whisky-a.title: Tamdhu 15 Year Old
secret-speyside-1998-50-30-the-whisky-a.bodyHtml:
Tamdhu 15 Year Old is a magnificent and highly acclaimed Speyside single malt Scotch whisky that showcases the distillery's absolute dedication to traditional Sherry cask maturation. Following in the footsteps of their core expressions, this award-winning whisky is matured for a full fifteen years exclusively in the finest hand-selected American and European oak ex-Oloroso Sherry casks imported from Spain. This patient aging process yields a deeply complex dram with a spectacular natural amber hue. It delivers a rich, decadent profile where intense dried fruit flavors seamlessly harmonize with warming baking spices, embodying the classic, unpeated Sherry-bomb style for which Tamdhu is world-renowned.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with slow-roasted venison, rich dark chocolate truffles, artisanal fig cake, or mature cheeses like aged Manchego.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper amber hue with a rich, velvety, and full-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Apple pastry, spiced currants, fresh oak, dark plum, sweet vanilla, and aromatic orange zest.

Palate : Rich and complex with juicy dried fruits, dark chocolate, apricot, warm cinnamon, nutmeg, and polished oak.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet sherry, dried fruit, dark cocoa, and lingering baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

lignier-charmes-chambertin-grand-cru.title: Lignier-Michelot Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru 2020
lignier-charmes-chambertin-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
97 Points - Jasper Morris

Two barrels, not new. 100% whole bunch, from a farming contract in the upper part of Mazoyères. Virgile is keen to avoid any potential monolithic aspect. Black with purple rim, dark fruit, black pepper, exciting stuff, with a dark peony floral note. More red fruit Charmes lurks beneath, discernible on the palate, enough volume of fruit to flirt with lushness, then a clean pure finish. Really persistent too! Very good indeed. Barrel Sample: 94-97

pierre-girardin-bourgogne-chardonnay.title: Justin Girardin Bourgogne Chardonnay 2021
pierre-girardin-bourgogne-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Produced from estate Chardonnay grown on clay-limestone soils in southern Burgundy, this wine offers fresh orchard fruit, citrus and delicate floral aromas with a rounded palate. Twelve months of ageing on fine lees adds texture while preserving freshness, balance and vibrant mineral character.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, grilled fish, shellfish, roast chicken and creamy cheeses.

glen-grant-1995-50-00-signatory.title: Signatory Vintage Glen Grant 1995 25 Year Old 50.0%
glen-grant-1995-50-00-signatory.bodyHtml:
25 Year Old Glen Grant bottled at 50% from Bourbon Barrel. 385 bottle batch.

Glen Grant's fruity character comes into his own best when he is old. At 25 years old, this Signatory certainly meets that. The fruitiness is accompanied by rich spiciness and almost creamy sweetness. In short, a delicious dram. The whisky was distilled on May 31, 1995. He got his maturation on bourbon barrels. For bottling on April 22, 2021, two were selected, Nos. 88176 and 88179. That yielded 385 bottles with a barrel strength of 50.0%.

glenrothes-1996-50-90-signatory.title: Signatory Vintage Glenrothes 1996
glenrothes-1996-50-90-signatory.bodyHtml:
Glenrothes 1996 is an independent bottling of Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from the Glenrothes distillery by Signatory Vintage. Distilled in 1996, it is bottled at 50.9% ABV in a 700ml bottle; a few drops of water help open up a whisky of this strength.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

linkwood-1997-55-40-abv-signatory.title: Signatory Vintage Linkwood 1997 55.4% ABV
linkwood-1997-55-40-abv-signatory.bodyHtml:
Linkwood 1997 is an independent bottling of single malt Scotch from Speyside's Linkwood distillery, distilled in 1997 and bottled by Signatory Vintage at 55.4% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

juyondai-junmai-daiginjo-morohaku-gokujo.title: Chiyomusubi Junmai Daiginjyo Goriki 30 720ml
juyondai-junmai-daiginjo-morohaku-gokujo.bodyHtml:
Aromatic and luxurious, it opens with a fresh apple-like fragrance before revealing a rich, smooth palate and polished, lingering finish. Chiyomusubi recommends enjoying this Junmai Daiginjo from a wine glass, allowing its expressive aroma and depth to fully develop.

Food Pairing: Sashimi, sushi, crab, seared tuna, scallops, grilled seafood.

william-fevre-chablis-2019.title: William Fevre Chablis 2023
william-fevre-chablis-2019.bodyHtml:
The 2023 vintage was characterized by a mild and dry winter, followed by frosts in April, with no major impact on the vines. After a hot and dry month of May, storms in June led to a high but well-managed health pressure by the estate's teams. During the summer, alternating heat and rainfall accelerated the ripening of the grapes despite a veraison slowed by the lack of water in August. The harvest, which began in early September under high temperatures, yielded generous volumes with excellent health conditions.

Fresh and elegant bouquet opening with notes of citrus, white-fleshed fruits, and flowers.
The palate is both fresh and supple, supported by a beautiful minerality.

90 Points - James Suckling

Biscuits, chopped apples and almonds on the nose, followed by a fresh, mineral and medium-bodied palate. Nicely balanced. From organically grown grapes. Drink now.

william-fevre-petit-chablis-2019.title: William Fevre Petit Chablis 2023 750ml
william-fevre-petit-chablis-2019.bodyHtml: Cool and crisp lime and peaches with a very polished feel to it. There's a handy array of crisp peaches and lime citrus on offer with an easygoing, crisp and tangy palate with lime.

bud-light-faves.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-faves.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

vallein-tercinier-bon-bois-1941-1943.title: Vallein Tercinier 1941-3 Bon Bois Cognac
vallein-tercinier-bon-bois-1941-1943.bodyHtml:
Vallein Tercinier 1941-1943 Bons Bois Small Batch is a Très Vieux Cognac from the family estate at Domaine des Forges in Chermignac, made from eaux-de-vie distilled during the Second World War. Drawn from the Bons Bois cru and labelled as a single-estate small batch, it was bottled in 2021 at 48.2% ABV after roughly eight decades in wood. Only 78 bottles were filled, each presented in a wooden case. A remarkable piece of Cognac history from one of the region's most respected family houses.

Serve: Neat in a tulip glass at room temperature; add a drop of water to open it up if you like.

juyondai-honmaru.title: Juyondai Honmaru 1.8L
juyondai-honmaru.bodyHtml:
Juyondai means "14th generation", as the current president is the 14th generation owner of Takagi Shuzo brewery, which started in 1615. Juyondai is one of Yamagata Prefecture's most well-known premium sake labels.

Japanese Name:
十四代 本丸 秘伝玉返し

juyondai-yamadanishiki-kakushin.title: Juyondai Yamadanishiki Kakushin 1.8L 十四代 角新純米吟醸 生酒
juyondai-yamadanishiki-kakushin.bodyHtml:
Juyondai Yamadanishiki Kakushin is a prestigious Junmai Ginjo Namazake crafted by Takagi Shuzo in Japan's Yamagata Prefecture. Brewed using premium Banshu Yamadanishiki rice polished to 50%, this unpasteurized sake showcases elegant aromas of white peach, melon and fresh orchard fruits. Its silky texture, delicate sweetness and refreshing acidity create an exceptionally refined and beautifully balanced expression.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with premium sashimi, sushi, seared scallops, grilled sea bass, steamed crab, wagyu beef, delicate tempura, fresh oysters and Japanese seasonal appetizers.

Tasting Notes: Elegant and fruit-forward with white peach, ripe melon, green grapes, subtle floral notes and a delicate balance of sweetness and acidity.

Nose: Fragrant aromas of white peach, cantaloupe, fresh green grapes, jasmine and delicate orchard blossoms.

Palate: Silky and refined with luscious white peach, melon, gentle honeyed sweetness, subtle umami and refreshing acidity.

Finish: Clean, graceful and lingering with delicate fruit, floral elegance and a refreshing final impression.

juyondai-junmai-ginjo-omachi.title: Juyondai Junmai Ginjo Omachi 1.8L 十四代 中取り 純米吟釀　備前雄町　生詰
juyondai-junmai-ginjo-omachi.bodyHtml:
Juyondai Junmai Ginjo Omachi 1.8L pours a bright, crystal-clear appearance with soft silver highlights in the glass. The highly expressive nose opens with enticing aromas of sweet melon, candied peach, and restrained toasted rice, layered with gentle floral accents. On the palate, this medium-sweet, premium Japanese sake offers a remarkably plush, creamy, and powerful texture with a deep sense of rice umami. The mouthfeel is perfectly balanced by a soft acidity and crisp fruitiness, culminating in a long, beautifully sustained, and pleasantly warm, sweet, and spicy finish.

Juyondai means "14th generation", as the current president is the 14th generation owner of Takagi Shuzo brewery, which started in 1615. Juyondai is one of Yamagata Prefecture's most well-known premium sake labels.

Japanese Name:

十四代 中取り 純米吟釀　備前雄町　生詰

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with white fish sashimi, pan-seared duck breast, grilled wagyu beef, rich unagi don (grilled eel), or savory mushroom dishes.

juyondai-black-string.title: Juyondai Junmai Ginjo Omachi 1.8L 十四代 中取り 純米吟釀　備前雄町　生詰
juyondai-black-string.bodyHtml:
Juyondai Junmai Ginjo Omachi 1.8L pours a bright, crystal-clear appearance with soft silver highlights in the glass. The highly expressive nose opens with enticing aromas of sweet melon, candied peach, and restrained toasted rice, layered with gentle floral accents. On the palate, this medium-sweet, premium Japanese sake offers a remarkably plush, creamy, and powerful texture with a deep sense of rice umami. The mouthfeel is perfectly balanced by a soft acidity and crisp fruitiness, culminating in a long, beautifully sustained, and pleasantly warm, sweet, and spicy finish.

Juyondai means "14th generation", as the current president is the 14th generation owner of Takagi Shuzo brewery, which started in 1615. Juyondai is one of Yamagata Prefecture's most well-known premium sake labels.

Japanese Name:

十四代 中取り 純米吟釀　備前雄町　生詰

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with white fish sashimi, pan-seared duck breast, grilled wagyu beef, rich unagi don (grilled eel), or savory mushroom dishes.

vallein-tercinier-grand-rue-1934-42-00.title: Vallein Tercinier 1934 Grand Rue Cognac
vallein-tercinier-grand-rue-1934-42-00.bodyHtml:
Vallein Tercinier Grand Rue 34 is a very old Grande Champagne cognac from the Vallein Tercinier family house in Chermignac, labelled Brut de Fût and Très Vieux Cognac. Distilled in the 1930s, in the years between the Great Depression and the Second World War, it spent around 80 years ageing before bottling, a genuine piece of liquid history. It was bottled at a naturally reduced 42% ABV, with no added colour and without chill filtration, in a 700ml bottle. WhiskyFun awarded it 93 points, praising its freshness and fruit despite its great age.

Tasting Notes: Fresh and fruity for its age, with floral, tropical fruit and spice.

Nose: Floral notes, tropical fruits and soft spices; fresher and less oaky than expected.

Palate: Oak at first, then orange, pink grapefruit and guava, followed by menthol, pine sap, aniseed and Earl Grey tea.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, in a tulip glass.

wakefield-the-visionary-cabernet.title: Taylors Wakefield The Visionary Cabernet Sauvignon 2012 750ml
wakefield-the-visionary-cabernet.bodyHtml: Wakefield The Visionary Cabernet Sauvignon 2012 is the Taylor family's pinnacle Cabernet, made from their very finest fruit selection and entirely estate grown and bottled on the family estate in the Clare Valley, South Australia. The wine is named in honour of Bill Taylor Snr, the family's founder and visionary, and is released as an exceptional parcel, with each bottle individually numbered. The wine is given extended maturation in premium oak before release, and the label carries the signature of the family. 750ml, 14% alcohol.

chateau-rieussec.title: Chateau Rieussec Sauternes
chateau-rieussec.bodyHtml:
A Premier Cru Classé Sauternes from the Rothschild family, Château Rieussec reveals luxurious aromas of apricot, peach, pineapple, candied orange peel, honey, saffron, vanilla, and acacia blossom. Richly concentrated yet impeccably balanced, it delivers vibrant acidity, remarkable freshness, extraordinary complexity, and an exceptionally long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with foie gras, Roquefort, blue cheese, crème brûlée, fruit tarts, roasted peaches, apricot desserts, or enjoy on its own.

henri-gouges-chaignots-2019.title: Domaine Henri Gouges Chaignots 2019 750ml
henri-gouges-chaignots-2019.bodyHtml: Domaine Henri Gouges Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru Les Chaignots 2019 is a red Burgundy from one of the founding family domaines of Nuits-Saint-Georges. Henri Gouges established the estate in 1920 and was bottling and selling his own wine by 1933; he later helped delineate the crus of Burgundy for the newly formed appellation authority, and the domaine remains an undivided family property. Les Chaignots is the domaine's only Premier Cru in the northern part of the appellation: a 0.46-hectare parcel at the foot of the slope, on grassed clay-limestone soils mixed with alluvium washed down from the Combe de la Serrée. This terroir is known for wines of subtlety and delicacy. The 2019 is 13.5% ABV.

henri-gouges-porrets-2019.title: Domaine Henri Gouges Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru 'Clos Des Porrets St-Georges' Monopole 2019
henri-gouges-porrets-2019.bodyHtml:
Domaine Henri Gouges Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru 'Clos Des Porrets St-Georges' Monopole 2019 is a distinguished, deeply structured, and classic Premier Cru red Burgundy crafted from a 3.57-hectare monopole vineyard owned entirely by the Gouges family. Located on clay-limestone soils rich in limestone gravel, these older vines yield a Pinot Noir of remarkable intensity, depth, and aging potential. In the glass, it reveals a dark ruby color along with complex aromatics of ripe black cherry, cassis, wild plum, crushed rocks, leather, and subtle smoky oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied, dense, and tightly wound, featuring rich dark fruit flavors, prominent yet fine-grained tannins, vibrant natural acidity, and a long, savory, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, grilled duck breast, venison roast, mushroom ragout, and aged Comté cheese.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Graphite, black cherry, blackberry and baking spices are the hallmarks of this opulent red, which is backed by a spine of dusty tannins that leave a tactile feel on the long finish. Best from 2024 through 2040.

henri-gouges-vaucrains-2019.title: Domaine Henri Gouges Vaucrains 2019 750ml
henri-gouges-vaucrains-2019.bodyHtml: Domaine Henri Gouges Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru Les Vaucrains 2019 is a red Burgundy made from Pinot Noir in Les Vaucrains, one of the leading Premier Cru vineyards of Nuits-Saint-Georges. The domaine's old-vine parcels here give very small berries and a powerful, intense wine, shaped by red, stony clay soils and the cooling influence of the nearby forest. The 2019 was cropped at about 25 hl/ha. 750ml, 13% alcohol.

domaine-leflaive-bourgogne-blanc-2019.title: Domaine Leflaive Bourgogne Blanc 2019 750ml
domaine-leflaive-bourgogne-blanc-2019.bodyHtml: A cool, pure and very pretty nose reflects notes of green apple, citrus and discreet spice wisps. There is very good delineation to the delicious middle weight flavors that are suffused with underlying tension and fine balance on the clean and dry finale. This is an excellent Bourgogne - moreover, it is one that should reward short to mid-term cellaring. Burghound

domaine-leflaive-puligny-montrachet-2019.title: Olivier Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet 1er Cru Champ Gain 2023
domaine-leflaive-puligny-montrachet-2019.bodyHtml: A prestigious and highly structured Premier Cru Chardonnay that exemplifies the elegance of Puligny-Montrachet. The 2023 vintage presents an expressive bouquet of citrus blossoms, ripe lemon, and white peach, layered with subtle toasted hazelnuts and a distinctive chalky minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and precise, showing a beautiful tension between its creamy texture and vibrant, racy acidity. Flavours of green apple and almond lead to a long, aristocratic finish marked by intense saline notes and well-integrated French oak.

domaine-leflaive-clavoillon-2007.title: Domaine Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet Clavoillon Premier Cru 2007 750ml
domaine-leflaive-clavoillon-2007.bodyHtml: Domaine Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet Clavoillon Premier Cru is a 100% biodynamic wine that is matured 12 months in cask, then aged 6 months in tank, where it is prepared for bottling.

domaine-leflaive-clavoillon-2019.title: Domaine Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet Clavoillon Premier Cru 2019 750ml
domaine-leflaive-clavoillon-2019.bodyHtml:
94 Points - Burghound.com

An overtly floral suffused nose displays notes of pear compote, citrus confit and subtle spice wisps. There is excellent vibrancy to the attractively textured medium weight flavors that also exude a refreshing salinity on the citrusy, dry and notably more complex finish that is perceptibly firmer. This should age well.
Barrel Sample: 91-94

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Puligny-Montrachet 1er Cru Clavoillon has turned out very nicely, mingling aromas of pear and citrus oil with hints of wheat toast, fresh bread and hazelnuts in an inviting bouquet. Medium to full-bodied, satiny and concentrated, with terrific cut and a long, saline finish, it's taut and incisive, showing promise for the cellar.

93 Points - Jasper Morris

Fresh vibrant lemon and lime colour. There is plenty of energy to the nose, a juicy quality, pear and fresh but ripe apple. Plenty of volume from the start then draws in to a tighter finish. Juicy and agreeable but not quite the precision. Will be ready soon and will keep well also.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A sleek, focused white defined by lemon cream, peach, vanilla and pastry aromas and flavors. This converges on the finish, with apple and stone notes leaving a mouthwatering impression.

domaine-leflaive-pucelles-2019.title: Domaine Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet Les Pucelles Premier Cru 2019 750ml
domaine-leflaive-pucelles-2019.bodyHtml: Domaine Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet Les Pucelles Premier Cru is matured 12 months in cask, then aged 6 months in tank and prepared for bottling. Homeopathic fining and very light filtering at bottling, if necessary.

chocovine-raspberry-chocolate-wine.title: Chocovine Raspberry-Chocolate Wine 750ml
chocovine-raspberry-chocolate-wine.bodyHtml: Award tasting note: "Raspberry milk chocolate and red berries notes, with a thick and creamy palate, offering a delightful chocolate and berry experience." - Silver, USA Spirits Ratings

hiedler-langenlois-riesling.title: Hiedler Langenlois Riesling 2019 750ml
hiedler-langenlois-riesling.bodyHtml:
91 Points - James Suckling

Lots of lemon, ripe pear, lime and hints of mineral and stone character. It’s medium-bodied with lovely fruit and a creamy, minerally aftertaste.

korlat-syrah.title: Michael David Winery 6th Sense Syrah 2022
korlat-syrah.bodyHtml:
Michael David Winery 6th Sense Syrah 2022 is a bold, deeply concentrated, and full-bodied California red wine produced by Michael David Winery in the Lodi region. Visually displaying a deep ruby-violet hue, it opens with rich, expressive aromas of blackberry compote, black cherry, dark plum, and espresso grounds, beautifully layered with nuances of black pepper, clove, tobacco, and toasted vanilla oak. On the palate, it delivers a plush, mouth-filling mouthfeel with robust dark fruit flavors and a subtle hint of chocolate mocha, supported by ripe, velvety tannins and balanced acidity that lead to a long, warm, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, slow-cooked barbecue pork ribs, roasted lamb chops, smoked brisket, spicy Italian sausage, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The wine is remarkably concentrated, with aromas of huckleberry and blackberry, as well as notes of toasty oak and dried florals on the nose. The flavors are dark raspberry, orange, vanilla cream, clove, and dried tobacco, leading to grippy tannins on the finish. Decant and Enjoy.

bond-plurbius.title: Bond Pluribus 2018
bond-plurbius.bodyHtml:
The 2018 Bond Pluribus is a monumental and high-altitude expression from a near-perfect growing season. Sourced from a seven-acre vineyard situated at 1,100 feet on Spring Mountain, the volcanic soils and cooler mountain climate produce a wine of immense structure and dark intensity. This vintage reveals a deep, brooding bouquet of blackcurrants, blueberries, and forest floor, accented by signature notes of cedar, sandalwood, and crushed rock. On the palate, it is full-bodied and massive yet remarkably focused, featuring a formidable framework of ripe, gravelly tannins and a vibrant mountain acidity that suggests decades of aging potential.

99 Points - James Suckling

Tight and focused, dusty tannins to this full-to medium-bodied red with a focal point in the palate that shows blackcurrants, conifer and dark earth. Chewy and tight. Long finish, but rather reserved now. Drink from 2025.

fonseca-bin-27-vintage-character-port.title: Fonseca Bin 27 Vintage Character Port 750ml
fonseca-bin-27-vintage-character-port.bodyHtml:
Intense, rich and fruity nose, full of pure blackberry, cassis, cherry and plum aromas intertwined with hints of spice. In the mouth it is full-bodied and round, with a soft and velvety texture, balanced by firm tannins that fill the mouth. The juicy black fruit flavors continue on the delicious, rich finish.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast
A rich and opulent Port that consistently delivers a deep, complex profile of blackberry, dark chocolate, and spice. Full-bodied and luscious with a velvety texture and a long, warming finish that showcases its superb blending from multiple vintages.
91 Points - James Suckling
Intense and fruity with concentrated berry flavors and a robust structure. This is a reliably excellent Port that offers outstanding quality and approachability for its category, perfect for both immediate enjoyment and casual cellaring.

beanball-bourbon.title: Jim Beam White Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon 1.14L
beanball-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Jim Beam White Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon is an iconic American whiskey crafted using a time-honored family recipe refined over more than seven generations. Aged for four years in newly charred American white oak barrels, it offers a classic bourbon character marked by smooth, approachable flavors and a balanced, oaky warmth.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with smoky barbecue ribs, grilled burgers, pulled pork, sharp cheddar cheese, pecan pie, or glazed bacon.

Tasting Notes : Bright, rich amber color with a medium body and a smooth, light-to-medium mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet oak, vanilla, spice, and subtle grain notes with light fruit and caramel undertones.

Palate : Smooth and mellow with flavors of oaky vanilla, toasted caramel, sweet corn, and gentle baking spices.

Finish : Clean, warm, and medium-length finish with lingering oak, subtle spice, and sweet corn notes.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, with a splash of water, or as the core base in classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned, Manhattan, or Bourbon & Cola.

groffier-chambolle-1er-cru-les-amoureuse.title: Robert Groffier Chambolle-Musigny Les Amoureuses Premier Cru 2021
groffier-chambolle-1er-cru-les-amoureuse.bodyHtml:
It must be impossible to praise Groffier's wines in a way that hasn't been done before. In every recent vintage, this Domaine has produced complex, delicious, lushly textured wines that are immediately appealing but also have the balance to improve for many years. Chambolle-Musigny represents the charm of the Cote de Nuits district of Burgundy. But you'll find that term mainly about the vineyards in its southern stretches, which border Clos Vougeot: the Grand Cru of Le Musingy and, in part, its neighbouring and most exceptional Premier Cru, Les Amoureuses. 

Les Amoureses is an elegant, floral wine and mineral at the same time, offering a very dense ruby colour with effusive aromas of flowers, sandalwood, black currant and blackberry allied to a delicate frame. The nose is complex and refined, opening with notes of red fruits such as light raspberry or cherry. 

On the palate, it gradually unfolds and reveals its incomparable texture. The aromatic richness is developed on a very long finish. 

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This perfumed version features aromas and flavors of rose, wild strawberry, cherry, green olive, sandalwood, oak spice and incense. Offering a yin-yang of airiness and structure, this is linear, verging on racy. The silky texture, harmony and salty, mineral finish bode well for the future.

les-sinards-chateauneuf-du-pape-blanc.title: Domaine de Beaurenard 'Le Boisrenard' Chateaneuf-du-Pape Blanc 2023
les-sinards-chateauneuf-du-pape-blanc.bodyHtml:
Domaine de Beaurenard 'Le Boisrenard' Châteauneuf-du-Pape Blanc 2023 is a rare, organically and biodynamically farmed white Rhône wine crafted from a field blend of old vines up to 100 years of age across 13 allowed grape varieties, dominated by Roussanne, Clairette, and Grenache Blanc. Fermented and aged in oak foudres and barrels on fine lees, it reveals an alluring bright gold color and a complex nose of ripe white peach, poached pear, acacia honey, candied citrus peel, and toasted brioche, complemented by subtle crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and impeccably structured, offering a lush, silken texture supported by vibrant acidity and a long, saline, aromatic finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pan-seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster, roasted halibut, creamy wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté and goat cheeses.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Expressive and juicy, with mandarin orange and yellow peach on a nicely ripe and concentrated palate. Slightly waxy in feel, with layers of flavor and savory detail gliding along -- ginger, chamomile, fleur de sel, dried garrigue. A big, rich white, with excellent energy and balance that stretch out endlessly. Offers tons of delicious appeal right now but will go the distance in the cellar. Clairette and Roussanne. Drink now through 2032. 

93 Points - James Suckling

A round, dense, seductive and textured white. It has notes of dried lemons, spiced apples, flowers and herbs. It’s medium-bodied with a juicy, charming and delicious character developing on the palate. Attractive fruit and white flowers at the center with a long, zesty finish. From biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification. Drink or hold.

navy-island-xo-reserve.title: Navy Island XO Reserve Jamaican Rum
navy-island-xo-reserve.bodyHtml:
Navy Island XO Reserve is a blend of hand-selected Jamaican rums from the Navy Island Rum Company, named after the small island off Port Antonio that was once used by the British Royal Navy. The blend includes aged rums distilled in traditional Jamaican pot stills, giving the expressive, characteristically Jamaican nose the style is known for, with a full body and a long finish. Deep amber in colour, it is bottled at 40% ABV in a 700ml bottle and presented in a cylindrical gift tube. It took a Silver medal at the 2019 International Spirits Challenge in London.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla, ripe fruit, banana, baked apple, caramel.

Nose: Classic Jamaican character with vanilla, rich ripe fruit, banana, baked apple and caramel.

Palate: Full-bodied, elegant and well balanced.

Finish: Long and dry.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or in a rum Old Fashioned with Angostura bitters and dark cane syrup.

isle-of-raasay-single-malt.title: Isle of Raasay 'The Draam' Single Malt Whisky
isle-of-raasay-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Isle of Raasay 'The Draam' Single Malt Whisky is the flagship expression from the first legal distillery on the Hebridean Isle of Raasay. Master Distiller Alasdair Day crafted this lightly peated single malt using a highly innovative six-cask maturation recipe. Both peated and unpeated spirits are matured separately in a unique combination of first-fill ex-rye whiskey casks, virgin Chinkapin oak, and first-fill Bordeaux red wine casks before being expertly vatted together. Bottled at 46.4% ABV with its natural color and without chill-filtration, 'The Draam' beautifully balances classic Hebridean maritime smoke with vibrant, dark fruit flavors, delivering a Scotch whisky of unparalleled elegance, complexity, and depth.

Food Pairing: Grilled venison, smoked salmon, charcuterie boards with aged cheddar, rich dark chocolate, or desserts featuring dark berry compote.

Tasting Notes : Natural dark amber in appearance with a silky, rich, and elegantly textured mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet and richly aromatic, leading with notes of wood smoke, stewed plum, ripe papaya, and dark cherries, intertwined with maritime sea salt, toasted cedar, and a hint of aged leather.

Palate : Honeyed, rich, and complex. A beautiful balance of sweet peaches, dark blackberry compote, and strawberry jam gives way to warming cinnamon spice, black pepper, and gentle Hebridean peat smoke.

Finish : Medium to long, slightly salinic and chocolaty, leaving a lingering warmth of sweet dark fruit, baking spice, and a wisp of maritime bonfire smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass. A few drops of water can be added to open up the complex fruity esters and further reveal the subtle coastal salinity.

georgian-bay-gin.title: Georgian Bay Distillery Gin
georgian-bay-gin.bodyHtml:
Georgian Bay Gin is the London dry gin that started it all for Georgian Bay Spirit Co., handcrafted on the shores of Georgian Bay by the Collingwood, Ontario distillery established in 2013. Its character is inspired by the rugged beauty of the bay, where gnarled white pines and granite meet cool water. Juniper and citrus lead the aroma, followed by a dry profile layered with coriander, angelica root and grains of paradise. The gin has won recent medals including Silver at the 2026 London Spirits Competition and Bronze at the 2025 International Wine and Spirits Competition. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle and is a versatile choice for a gin and tonic or classic cocktails.

Nose: Juniper and citrus.

Palate: Dry, layered with coriander, angelica root and grains of paradise.

Serve: With tonic over ice and a citrus twist, or in a Martini.

black-tot-master-blenders-reserve.title: Black Tot Master Blender's Reserve 2023 Rum
black-tot-master-blenders-reserve.bodyHtml:
Black Tot Master Blender’s Reserve 2023 is (at least mostly) molasses based, pot and column distilled and aged for an indefinite amount of time in (mostly) ex-Bourbon and some ex-Sherry casks. Bottled at navy strength, 54.5% ABV, without any sweeteners or chill filtering, but it’s likely it contains a small amount of caramel from some of the Guyanese components and/or the original Navy rum.

On the nose it really feels dark and spicy. Tar, black pepper, sandalwood, cloves and treacle. Luxardo cherries, cocoa biscuits, pears, dried figs and sultanas. It does smell closer to the original Navy rum, but with more intricate layers. Liquorice, black tea, peaches, dusty old books, nail varnish and cola. Walnuts, burnt orange zest, allspice and pencil shavings. It has a Pedro Ximenez sherry aroma as well.

opus-one-2016-magnum.title: Opus One 2016 1.5L Magnum
opus-one-2016-magnum.bodyHtml:
The 2016 Opus One is remarkably elegant and bright offering sumptuous aromas of fresh red and blue fruit, baking spices and vanilla, and a delicate fragrance of spring florals. The initial bouquet is augmented by more nuanced notes of sage, rosemary, and black olive. Juicy flavors of black cherry, blackberry and cassis flood the palate and creamy, fine-grained tannins deliver a delightfully round structure. Harmonious and lively, the flavors linger to create an enduring finish with touches of dark chocolate and espresso.

99 Points - James Suckling

Fantastic aromas that are complex and complete with blackcurrants, blueberries and herbs, such as basil and bay leaf. But always subtle. Full-bodied yet linear and very refined with a very persistent finish. It shows drive and brightness. So refined at the end. Needs at least three to five years to come together.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2016 Opus One bursts from the glass with ripe blueberries, black cherry jam and crème de cassis with hints of violets, dark chocolate, cedar chest and cardamom, plus a touch of charcoal. Full-bodied, rich and concentrated, the palate delivers layer upon layer of opulent stewed black fruit with amazing tension and firm, ripe, fine-grained tannins, finishing long with a whole array of exotic spices coming through.

98 Points - Decanter
Love the juiciness of this, right off the bat, rich deep black cherry rippling with menthol and eucalyptus notes, and these beautiful floral aromatics that Opus gets in the best years. A very classic style, touches of baked vanilla, rosemary and olive. Harvest 9th September to 12th October (starting off slowly then speeding up as the heat rose). 1% Malbec, 8% Petit Verdot completes the blend, 17 days skin contact.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2016 Opus One is brilliant and shows yet again that 2016 was a magical vintage for Napa Valley. Based largely on Cabernet Sauvignon mixed with 8% each of Petit Verdot and Merlot, with 5% Cabernet Franc and a splash of Malbec, its deep purple hue is followed by a beautiful bouquet of black cherries, crème de cassis, and blueberry fruit intermixed with notions of cedary spice, toasty oak, graphite, and flowers. With an almost Bordeaux-like class and structure, this full-bodied beauty has no hard edges, plenty of ripe tannins, and is extraordinarily pure, elegant, and long. It can be drunk today (give it a healthy decant) or cellared for 2-3 decades. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator
A focused, restrained style, with a steady beam of fresh red and black currant preserve flavors, laced with bay leaf, cedar and tobacco notes. An iron edge pierces the finish, while the fruit keeps pace. A bit more classically backward than its Oakville peers, so tuck this away in the cellar. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Malbec. Best from 2020 through 2038.

hendricks-gin-neptunia.title: Hendrick's Neptunia Gin
hendricks-gin-neptunia.bodyHtml:
Hendrick's Neptunia Gin is a delightfully refreshing, limited-edition release from Master Distiller Lesley Gracie’s "Cabinet of Curiosities." Inspired by the enchanting sensory mysteries of the sea, this maritime expression uses Hendrick's signature foundation of 11 botanicals, crisp cucumber, and red rose as its canvas. It is masterfully infused with a selection of locally sourced coastal botanicals, deep sea kelp, and a invigorating touch of coastal brine, capturing the magical essence of the rugged Scottish coast in a bottle.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with fresh seafood dishes, such as raw oysters with mignonette sauce, garlic butter shrimp, sea bass ceviche, or smoked salmon bites. Its briny complexity also makes it an exceptional match for a charcuterie board featuring salty prosciutto and sharp cheeses like Manchego.

TASTING NOTES Crystal clear and brilliantly transparent. It presents a smooth, medium-bodied mouthfeel that delivers a distinctive, crisp coastal roundness on the palate.

NOSE A bright and bracing bouquet where classic piney juniper and sweet citrus are enlivened by a fresh ocean breeze aroma, underwritten by earthy sea kelp and soft floral notes.

PALATE Deeply complex, clean, and refreshing. The entry opens with a bold wave of herbal juniper and zesty citrus peel, which smoothly transitions into the unique savory depth of coastal vegetation, sweet thyme, and a subtle, satisfying hint of sea salt.

FINISH Clean, dry, and exceptionally crisp, leaving behind a lingering, cooling sensation of signature cucumber alongside a delicate, briny ocean finish.

SERVE Superb in clean, coastal cocktails. Enjoy it in a "Neptunia Fizz" by combining it with fresh lime juice, simple syrup, and premium soda water, or build a classic Neptunia & Tonic garnished with a thin wedge of lime and a slice of cooling cucumber.

renato-ratti-barolo-conca.title: Renato Ratti Marcenasco Barolo 2021 3L Double Magnum
renato-ratti-barolo-conca.bodyHtml:
A magnificent Northern Italian red wine presented in an impressive 3-liter Double Magnum large-format bottle, displaying a classic garnet red color with subtle orange reflections. Hailing from the historic Marcenasco zone in La Morra, the highly complex nose opens with an aristocratic bouquet of dried cherries, wild strawberries, and blood orange peel, masterfully layered with sophisticated notes of licorice, sweet tobacco, tar, and crushed red roses. On the full-bodied yet profoundly elegant palate, it balances a rich, concentrated fruit core and vibrant, linear acidity with a tight, chalky structure of velvety tannins that unfold at a remarkably slow, age-worthy pace in this larger format, carrying into a persistent, savory finish of graphite and mineral spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with slow-braised beef (brasato al Barolo), fresh handmade tajarin pasta tossed in white Alba truffles, roasted wild game, and aged hard cheeses.

 

 

97 Points - James Suckling

Assertive aromas of graphite, violets, mint and chalky minerality. A stunning, precise wine focused on elegance, with citrus flavors, a full body and lavish, velvety tannins supported by freshness. Long, youthful and savory aftertaste. Try from 2026, but best after 2030.

san-polo-brunello-di-montalcino-podernov.title: San Polo Brunello di Montalcino 2018
san-polo-brunello-di-montalcino-podernov.bodyHtml:
The 2018 San Polo Brunello di Montalcino is an elegant and nuanced expression of Sangiovese from a vintage defined by its finesse rather than sheer power. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards on the south-eastern slope of Montalcino, this wine offers a sophisticated bouquet of small red berries, violets, and earthy underbrush, with secondary notes of tobacco and vanilla from oak aging. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied with bright acidity and well-integrated, silky tannins that lead to a persistent and savory finish. This vintage is particularly praised for its approachability and classical balance, making it enjoyable in its youth while possessing the structure to age gracefully.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The primarily earthy, sanguine nose gets some pop from the slightly astringent sweetness of plums. That pleasing dynamism continues on the palate, before eventually giving way to a chocolatey, coffee finish. Grippy yet pliant tannins provide structure, while acid brings the heat.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of sour plums, cherry stones, bark and iodine, with some dried herbs. So fresh, tangy and flavorful, with bright berry fruit and savory moss notes. Fine and integrated tannins. Medium body. All about balance. From organically grown grapes.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A certified organic wine, the 2018 Brunello di Montalcino display a savory character that accompanies the wine from start to finish over the palate and then some. There is a core of black fruit, but the real takeaway is that spicy contour of dark chestnut husk, acacia honey, tilled earth and toasted rosemary that fills the balloon of your glass. This Brunello finishes on a tart note and shows tannins that could use a few extra years to soften

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Shows earthy, barnyard aromas that suggest a little reduction, giving way to plum, cherry, rose, juniper, eucalyptus and iron flavors. Reveals burly tannins that define the finish, which is compact and short. Decant now. Best from 2026 through 2046.

glenfiddich-single-cask.title: Glenfiddich Gran Reserva 21 Year Old Rum Cask Finish
glenfiddich-single-cask.bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 21 Year Old Gran Reserva is an exquisite Single Malt Scotch Whisky that brings a touch of the Caribbean to the Scottish Highlands. Patiently mellowed for 21 years in traditional oak casks, this exceptional expression is then finished for up to four months in hand-selected Caribbean rum reserves. This unique finishing process elevates the whisky, imparting decadent notes of toffee, fig, and vibrant tropical fruits, making it an incredibly rich, complex, and rewarding dram for special occasions.

Food Pairing: This rich and subtly sweet whisky pairs exceptionally well with dark chocolate truffles, caramelized pear tarts, sticky toffee pudding, or a high-quality mildly spiced cigar. It also complements savory dishes like seared scallops or a rich duck à l'orange.

Tasting Notes : A rich, dark amber liquid that feels velvety, luxurious, and pleasantly viscous in the glass, hinting at its long and careful maturation.

Nose : Intensely sweet and deeply floral. Enticing aromas of creamy vanilla, ripe banana, fig, rich dark toffee, new leather, and polished oak mingle beautifully.

Palate : Initially soft and smooth, it quickly reveals a vibrant, slightly drying complexity. Flavors of peppery spice, dark chocolate, ginger, lime zest, and a subtle whisper of wood smoke unfold over a rich malty base.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warming, and sophisticated, leaving a lasting impression of dry oak, exotic spices, and lingering sweet marmalade.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass to fully appreciate its complex aromas. A few drops of room-temperature water can be added to unlock further fruity and floral notes.

calgary-beer-session-ale.title: Citizen Session Ale 4 Tall Cans
calgary-beer-session-ale.bodyHtml: A clean and crisp dry-hopped blonde ale with a gentle malt approach and big aromatics of citrusy hops. Designed for days when just one won't do, this style is clean, simple and very crushable

aguardiente-nectar.title: Aguardiente Nectar Liqueur
aguardiente-nectar.bodyHtml:
Aguardiente Nectar Traditional offers an intense experience between aroma and flavor. Colorless, crystalline, bright, intense aniseed semi-dry. Perfect as a base to create cocktails. Its production combines tradition and high technology. For decades it has been one of the most desired spirits by Colombians who enjoy an intense drink. Main features:

• With sugar added

• Aroma and flavor to Anis

• Final thermogenic feeling

• Touch spicy spices

• Middle body

london-dock-57-10-abv.title: Kilchoman Batch Strength
london-dock-57-10-abv.bodyHtml:
Kilchoman Batch Strength is a bold, permanently available addition to the Islay distillery's core range, crafted to amplify the raw intensity and depth of the classic Kilchoman farm spirit. This expression is expertly composed from a vatting of roughly 70% ex-bourbon barrels, 20% re-charred Portuguese red wine (STR) casks, and 10% Oloroso sherry butts, with just a few drops of water added post-maturation to bring it to a consistent 57% ABV. On the nose, it delivers a massive wave of intense earthy peat smoke, coastal air, red fruits, fresh cherries, and heather blossom. The palate boasts a rich, silky viscosity that unfurls with layers of sweet toffee, vanilla, dark chocolate, and salted caramel, balanced beautifully by warming baking spices and prominent, lingering peat.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with robust dishes like smoked beef brisket, charbroiled ribeye steak, mature blue cheeses (like Roquefort or Stilton), or rich dark chocolate desserts.

veuve-clicquot-vintage-reserve.title: Veuve Clicquot Vintage Brut 2015 750ml
veuve-clicquot-vintage-reserve.bodyHtml: This top-tier champagne is made with a blend of 45-55% Pinot Noir, 25-35% Meunier, and 10-20% Chardonnay. All of the grapes come from vineyards that have been selected specifically for their ripe, full-bodied flavors. The wine has been aged for three years in Veuve Clicquot's cellars, resulting in a perfectly balanced taste and subtle notes of raisins, toasted bread, and hazelnuts. Enjoy it chilled and enjoy true excellence.

veuve-clicquot-brut-magnum.title: Veuve Clicquot Brut 1.5L Magnum
veuve-clicquot-brut-magnum.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label manages to reconcile two opposing factors, strength and silkiness and to hold them in perfect balance with aromatic intensity and a lot of freshness. With golden yellow tiny bubbles, this non-vintage Champagne shows the fruitiness of peach, Mirabelle plum, and pear alongside notes of vanilla and toasted brioche. This consistent power to please makes it ideal as an aperitif, and perfect as the Champagne to enjoy with a meal.

92 Points - James Suckling

This has aromas of grapefruit, citrus peel, quince, toast and almonds. It’s medium-bodied with creamy, fine tannins. Silky texture. Nutty complexity at the end.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Lively, with tangy acidity and a zesty mousse, this aperitif-style Champagne shows notes of mandarin orange, blackberry, toast and a touch of pastry cream. Subtle, smoke-tinged finish. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Drink now.

three-olives-grape-vodka.title: Three Olives Grape Vodka
three-olives-grape-vodka.bodyHtml:
Three Olives Grape Vodka is a grape-flavoured vodka from Three Olives, bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle. This version is produced in Kentucky, USA. It is designed for easy mixing: serve it chilled as a shot, over ice, or as the base of fruity long drinks and cocktails.

Serve: Pour over ice with soda or lemon-lime, or shake into a martini-style cocktail.

westons-cider-stowford-press.title: Westons Cider Stowford Press 4 Tall Cans

real-mccoy-5-year-old-rum.title: Rum Rats Arco Seco 5 Year Old rum
real-mccoy-5-year-old-rum.bodyHtml:
Rum Rats Arco Seco 5 Year Old is a single-origin Panamanian rum from Rum Rats, the partnership of Canadians Shamus Hewitt and Jason Gardner, who met over a small-batch Panamanian rum while living on the Latin American coast. The rum is made with master blender Don Pancho Fernandez and Carlos Esquivel of the Pilsa rum distillery in the Arco Seco region of southern Panama, where dry Pacific air meets Caribbean heat. It starts from dark Panamanian molasses, is distilled in a single column still and spends five years in American white oak barrels that previously held bourbon, ageing in Panama's heat and humidity. It is non-chill filtered, with no added sugar, flavouring or other additives, and is bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle under the brand's line, born in Panama, finished in Canada.

Tasting Notes: Butterscotch, honey, vanilla and almond with fine oak spice.

Nose: Mild butterscotch and honey with vanilla and almond, orange peel, fine oak spices and hints of banana and coconut.

Serve: Neat or over ice, or in a rum Manhattan, a Mai Tai or a rum and cola highball.

boxer-gluten-free.title: Tito's Handmade Vodka 1.75L
boxer-gluten-free.bodyHtml:
Tito's Handmade Vodka is a premium American vodka produced in Austin, Texas, by Fifth Generation, Inc. at the Mockingbird Distillery. Founded in 1997 by Tito Beveridge, it is micro-distilled six times in traditional copper pot stills from a 100% yellow corn mashbill, resulting in an unaged, naturally gluten-free spirit renowned for its smooth texture and subtle corn sweetness.

Food Pairing: Fresh seafood (such as oysters and shrimp cocktail), smoked salmon, cured meats, light salads, caviar, and citrus-infused poultry dishes.

Tasting Notes - A crystal-clear spirit with a smooth, slightly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose - Light and clean, featuring subtle hints of sweet corn, soft grain, and gentle citrus.

Palate - Exceptionally smooth and clean with a mild sweetness from the corn base, accompanied by subtle notes of black pepper, roasted grain, and light vanilla.

Finish - Clean, crisp, and warm with a lingering smoothness and a subtle sweet grain note.

Serve - Serve chilled, on the rocks, straight from the freezer as a shot, or mixed into cocktails such as a Moscow Mule, Bloody Mary, or Vodka Soda.

moet-chandon-nectar-imperial-rose.title: Moet & Chandon Nectar Imperial Rose 750ml
moet-chandon-nectar-imperial-rose.bodyHtml: Nectar Impérial Rosé brings its savvy and vibrant style to create a unique night experience. Moët & Chandon decided to come up with a new cuvée, intense and fruity, perfect for nightlife.

sawback-hazy-blonde-ale.title: Sawback Hazy Blonde Ale 4 Tall Cans
sawback-hazy-blonde-ale.bodyHtml: Strong aroma from Mosaic dry hop with some mango and citrus on the nose. It’s light-bodied, less malty with no lingering bitterness.

schrader-ccs-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Schrader CCS Beckstoffer To Kalon Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
schrader-ccs-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Extraordinarily rich and inky dark, the opulent 2019 Schrader CCS is loaded with gobs of ultra-ripe blue and black fruit aromas and flavors. Summer-picked blackberries, boysenberries, wild blueberries, and plum preserves abound and are layered with alluring notes of violets, black truffles, sweet earth, graphite, and fruitcake spice. Offering lavish fruit character, fine structure, and silky-smooth tannins, the 2019 Schrader CCS carries forward the tradition of excellence for the marque as one of the most honored and adored wines in our portfolio.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

Throws off a range of sassafras, chaparral and anise aromas before yielding up a prodigious core of açaí berry, plum and blackberry compote. Offers a great power/purity interplay throughout, with tarry violet and loamy incense accents. While tannic through the finish, this also reveals a subtle ripple of acidity and a hint of iron. Terrific. Best from 2024 through 2040.

98 Points - Robert Parker's The Wine Advocate

Sourced from Block C1 (planted to Clone 4), the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon CCS Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard, like all the other Schrader wines, matured in 100% new French oak from Darnajou and Taransaud. Hugely concentrated black cherries are joined by dried spices, slightly peppery notes and cedar on the nose, while the palate is full-bodied and plush yet firm at its core. It's a well-rounded, elegant example of Oakville Cabernet, nicely balanced, with attractive notions of blueberry and mint on the lengthy finish.
98 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of mint, eucalyptus, crushed blackcurrants and lead pencil follow through to a full body with dark fruit and mint on the palate. Velvety tannins and a long finish. Fantastic structure. Savory. Minerally. Drinkable now, but this will age really beautifully.

jackson-triggs-light-rose.title: Jackson Triggs Light Rose 750ml
jackson-triggs-light-rose.bodyHtml: On-trend with the move toward lower- alcohol wines, this easy-going and fruity, light rosé is a health-conscious choice that tastes good too! Its aromas and flavours of strawberry and tropical fruit are expressed in a fresh, off-dry style. Enjoy with appetizers, pasta salad, mildly-spicy curries or cherry tarts.

sunora-mocha-cream.title: Sunora Mocha Cream
sunora-mocha-cream.bodyHtml:
Sunora Cream de Bacanora Mocha combines Sunora Bacanora, the additive-free agave spirit from Sonora, Mexico, with cream and mocha coffee. Bottled at 15% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it brings hints of cocoa and a smooth sweetness. It is made with dairy cream yet is lactose-free and gluten-free. Bacanora itself is distilled from Agave Pacifica, the agave native to Sonora, and carries its own denomination of origin.

Tasting Notes: Mocha coffee and cocoa with smooth, creamy sweetness.

Serve: Well chilled, on the rocks, or added to coffee.

peller-family-light-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Peller Family Vineyards Light Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
peller-family-light-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Ruby red in colour with a bouquet of black cherry, blue plum and a touch of sweet spice. The Cabernet Sauvignon is a light-bodied, fruit-forward wine with flavours of cherry and blackberry. The slightly off-dry finish has notes of field berries and black tea. Enjoy while young and fresh.

nude-watermelon.title: Absolut Watermelon Vodka
nude-watermelon.bodyHtml:
Absolut Watermelon Vodka is a refreshing flavoured vodka produced by The Absolut Company in Åhus, Sweden. Crafted with natural watermelon flavour and no added sugar, this vibrant expression captures the juicy sweetness of ripe watermelon while maintaining Absolut's signature smooth character. Fresh melon aromas lead into a light, fruity palate with subtle cucumber notes and a clean, refreshing finish. Bottled at 38% ABV, Absolut Watermelon is a versatile spirit ideal for summer cocktails, sparkling mixers, and entertaining.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp, watermelon and feta salad, spicy chicken tacos, fresh fruit platters, citrus-marinated seafood, and light summer appetizers.

Tasting Notes: Fresh and fruity, featuring ripe watermelon, subtle cucumber, natural melon sweetness, and a smooth, refreshing character.

Nose: Juicy watermelon, fresh melon, delicate cucumber, and subtle fruity sweetness.

Palate: Ripe watermelon, soft melon sweetness, light cucumber notes, and a clean vodka base.

Finish: Smooth and refreshing, with lingering watermelon and delicate fruit sweetness.

Serve: Enjoy chilled over ice, mixed with soda water or lemonade, or in a Watermelon Spritz or Watermelon Cosmopolitan.

glenmorangie-19-year-old.title: Glenmorangie The Quinta Ruban 14 Year Old
glenmorangie-19-year-old.bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie 14 Year Old The Quinta Ruban is a bold and velvety single malt Scotch whisky that stands as a testament to the art of wood finishing. The spirit is first aged for 10 years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks to establish a foundation of smooth, creamy vanilla notes. It is then transferred into hand-selected ruby port pipes and casks from the renowned Quinta wine estates of Portugal for a further four years of finishing. This extensive secondary maturation transforms the whisky into a dark, decadent dram with aromas of mandarin orange, dark chocolate, mint, and a touch of nutmeg. On the palate, a thick, voluptuous texture unfolds with flavors of rich walnut, dark chocolate-covered berries, Turkish delight, and sweet wood spice. The finish is long, silky, and deeply satisfying, leaving behind lingering traces of dark chocolate and orange zest.

Food Pairing The dark chocolate and rich fruit notes of this port-finished expression make it an spectacular match for desserts like a flourless chocolate torte, raspberry tart, or dark chocolate mousse. It also pairs wonderfully with savory dishes such as pan-seared venison with a blackberry reduction, roasted lamb chops, or a plate of rich blue cheeses like Stilton or Roquefort.

g-m-caol-ila-2007-connoisseurs-choice.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseur's Choice Caol Ila 2007 13 Year Old 45% ABV
g-m-caol-ila-2007-connoisseurs-choice.bodyHtml: Fruitcake and cherry aromas combine with sweet smoke. Cured meat flavours are balanced by summer berries and almond. A medium bodied finish with lingering bonfire embers.

amrut-greedy-angels-12-year-old.title: Amrut Greedy Angels 12 Year Old Chairman's Reserve Indian Single Malt
amrut-greedy-angels-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Amrut Greedy Angels 12 Year Old is an ultra-rare, benchmark expression in the history of world whisky, crafted by Amrut Distilleries in Bangalore (Bengaluru), India. Situated roughly 3,000 feet above sea level with a tropical climate, Bangalore experiences an extreme angel's share evaporation rate of 10% to 12% annually, making long-term maturation extraordinarily difficult. Maturing a single malt for a full 12 years under these climatic conditions resulted in an angel's share exceeding 70%, leaving only a precious fraction of liquid in the casks—hence the name "Greedy Angels." Produced from 100% Indian six-row malted barley grown in the foothills of the Himalayas, mashed, fermented, and double-distilled in traditional copper pot stills, it was matured in virgin American oak and ex-bourbon casks before being bottled at a commanding cask strength (typically around 60.0% ABV) without chill filtration or artificial colouring.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with roasted rack of venison with blackberry reduction, slow-braised short ribs, rich roasted duck, 85% single-origin dark chocolate, decadent sticky toffee pudding, or mature aged blue cheeses like Stilton.

Tasting Notes: An immense, layered, and profoundly rich tropical single malt brimming with deep rancio, decadent dark stone fruits, polished oak, and intoxicating warming spices.

Nose: Profound and dense with aromas of dark raisins, rum-soaked sultanas, dried figs, and caramelized blood orange peel, followed by sandalwood, antique polished oak, vanilla pod, and roasted cacao.

Palate: Viscous, enveloping, and explosive on the palate; delivers a powerhouse of dark chocolate, dried dates, stewed plums, and honeycomb, seamlessly balanced by vibrant tropical fruit sweetness, toasted wood tannins, and warming pot still spices including nutmeg, cinnamon, and clove.

Finish: Monumentally long and complex, fading slowly with notes of dry antique oak, roasted nuts, lingering dark cocoa, sweet baking spices, and a delicate touch of tropical leather.

Serve: Best served neat in a Glencairn glass or tulip tasting snifter. Due to the high cask strength, letting it rest in the glass for 10 to 15 minutes and adding a few drops of soft spring water will open up deep floral and candied citrus layers.

dom-perignon-brut-1.title: Dom Perignon Vintage 2017
dom-perignon-brut-1.bodyHtml:
Dom Pérignon Vintage 2017 è uno champagne di straordinaria eleganza, complessità e ricchezza strutturale, nato da un'annata sfidante caratterizzata da volumi di produzione estremamente ridotti. Alla vista si presenta di un brillante colore giallo dorato con riflessi verdolini e un perlage finissimo e persistente. Al naso si apre con un bouquet intenso ed avvolgente di petricore, gelsomino fresco, scorza di agrumi candita e albicocca essiccata, impreziosito da note di pan tostato, nocciola tostata, burro e lievi sfumature di cacao. Al palato offre una texture cremosa e voluttuosa, sostenuta da una viva acidità limata e una spiccata mineralità gessosa, sfociando in un finale lungo, teso e piacevolmente persistente.

Food Pairing: Si abbina felicemente con ostriche fresche, caviale, granseola, carne di capriolo, carré d'agnello alle erbe e formaggi a pasta dura stagionati.

98 Points - James Suckling

An edgy Dom Perignon with intense and singular aromas of lemons, toast and botanicals. Medium-bodied with a dense center palate and a vivid and rocking finish. Tight, muscular bubbles frame this nicely. Tense. Developing well in the bottle. 62% chardonnay and 38% pinot noir. 4.5 g/L dosage. Drink now or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Of the two releases—the 2017 and the 2018—the 2017 Dom Pérignon is the deeper and more structurally endowed wine, unfurling from the glass with a complex bouquet of orange peel, dried apricot and burnt buttered toast, mingling with nuances of dried flowers, toasted hazelnut and cacao bean, all strongly singed with the house’s signature smoky reduction. On the palate, it is full-bodied and concentrated, with a rich core of fruit. Its darker, open-knit profile is animated by a pillowy mousse, vibrant acidity and attractively bitter, structuring phenolics that assert themselves on a long, resonant finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A vivid Champagne, offering a finely detailed mousse, with a toasty overtone to the flavors of crushed white raspberry and white cherry fruit, grapefruit pith, toast point and oyster shell, all defined by chiseled, lemony acidity. A fine example from a challenging vintage. Drink now through 2037.

castiglione-del-bosco-millicento-riserva.title: Castiglion del Bosco Brunello di Montalcino 2019
castiglione-del-bosco-millicento-riserva.bodyHtml:
Castiglion del Bosco Brunello di Montalcino 2019 is a magnificent, highly refined expression of 100% Sangiovese reflecting an exceptional growing season in Tuscany. Sourced from the estate's organically farmed Capanna vineyard in the northwestern zone of Montalcino, this wine underwent natural fermentation followed by 24 months of maturation in French oak barrels. It possesses a bright, luminous ruby-red color, introducing an aromatic bouquet of ripe cherries, wild strawberries, and mandarin orange blossoms seamlessly woven with hints of cedar, sweet tobacco, and fresh Mediterranean herbs. The medium-to-full-bodied palate reveals a creamy texture, weightless concentration, and crisp acidity, wrapped in beautifully integrated, fine-grained tannins that carry into an incredibly long, vivid, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with slow-braised wild boar, grilled Florentine steaks, roasted rosemary leg of lamb, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

96 Points - James Suckling

This is really fine on the palate with wonderfully integrated tannins that give tension and focus. It’s medium-bodied with lovely berry, cherry, cedar and spice. Peaches and flower stems, too. Creamy texture. Extremely long and vivid. Structured, but showing beautiful drinkability with wonderful balance and form. One to drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Cherry, plum, leather, earth and tomato leaf flavors highlight this broad, beefy red, with iron and sanguine accents creeping in as this winds down on the finish. Succulent and long, with a dusty grip in the end. Best from 2027 through 2043.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose starts floral, with aromas of roses, vanilla and cherry, then turns earthy, before spiced undertones of cloves and bergamot float to the surface. The cherries return on the palate, with more bitter citrus and earth tones, while finely grained tannins tickle the back of your tongue.

siding-14-switch-point-honey-cream-ale.title: Siding 14 Switch Point Honey Cream Ale 4 Tall Cans
siding-14-switch-point-honey-cream-ale.bodyHtml: Siding 14 Switch Point Honey Cream Ale 4 Tall Cans

phillips-jurassic-dino-sour-variety-pack.title: Phillips Jurassic Dino Sour Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans
phillips-jurassic-dino-sour-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Phillips Jurassic Dino Sour Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans

krug-tribute-to-time-159e.title: Krug Grand Cuvee Tribute To Time 159e
krug-tribute-to-time-159e.bodyHtml:
Every year, the Krug House seeks to create the richest expression of champagne. This limited edition box of three bottles allows you to discover the influence of time on the 159th Edition of the house.

97 Points - James Suckling

A beautiful array of complex toastiness, fresh and roasted mushrooms, lemon, tangerine and peach, with honeysuckle and some spicy elements, too. The complexity and comfortingly rich, warming aromatic depth is in full song. The palate has vivacious, rich orange grapefruit, peach and lemon rind, with some exotic moments, and spicy flashes, too. There's a distinctive, plush and alluringly long, grapefruit and hazelnut finish.

asylum-barrel-imperial-stout.title: The Bruery Black Tuesday Bba Imperial

hawk-tail-brewery-rye-milk-stout.title: Hawk Tail Brewery Rye Milk Stout 4 Tall Cans
hawk-tail-brewery-rye-milk-stout.bodyHtml: Hawk Tail Brewery Rye Milk Stout 4 Tall Cans

talenti-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Talenti Brunello Di Montalcino 2020
talenti-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
In the 1950's Pierluigi Talenti moved from Romagna to the gently rolling and sunny hills of Montalcino. After a few years, he decided to acquire the estate and all its lands he had fallen in love with. Through the years, he devoted his time to the clonal research of Sangiovese all over Montalcino, taking his wines to the highest levels of quality. Today, his grandson Riccardo Talenti runs the winery and continues that research with the utmost respect for tradition, working with the very same passion and determination.

93 Points - James Suckling

Floral style to this tense Brunello, together with cherry jam in a positive, delicate way. Medium- to full-bodied and firm with chalky tannins, yet ripe and refreshing acidity. Juicy overall, with a touch of blood orange in the aftertaste. Drink from 2025 or hold.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Talenti 2020 Brunello di Montalcino (with 21,000 bottles made) shows a savory side with cigar smoke and cured leather that cede to dark fruit and baked blackberry. There is a hint of earthy minerality that adds focus and sharpness to the wine's medium-bodied finish. The 2020 vintage is a bit leaner on the mid-palate.

robert-mondavi-napa-fume-blanc.title: Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2022
robert-mondavi-napa-fume-blanc.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2022 is a vibrant, gentle, and fruit-forward white wine that beautifully captures the character of its world-renowned terroir. It opens with bright, inviting aromas of citrus blossom, lime zest, and subtle jasmine, perfectly layered with notes of fresh green apple, honeydew melon, and yellow peach. On the palate, this estate-grown wine is medium-to-full-bodied and elegantly balanced, offering a softly rounded texture achieved through partial barrel fermentation. Juicy flavors of candied orange, tropical fruit, and a distinct underlying minerality are lifted by refreshing, mild acidity, leading to a long, crisp, and beautifully harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spring vegetable frittatas, fresh fish tacos, grilled asparagus, zesty citrus ceviche, and vibrant mixed green salads.

91 Points - James Suckling

This is a gentle, fruit-forward, estate-grown wine with fresh citrus flavors and mild acidity. Partially barrel fermented, which gives some richness to the fruit and roundness to the texture. Includes 7% semillon blended in. Full-bodied and well balanced.

finca-los-primos-malbec-1.title: Bodegas Bianchi Finca Los Primos Malbec 2024 1L
finca-los-primos-malbec-1.bodyHtml: Finca Los Primos Malbec 1L is a lively, aromatic Argentinian Malbec with a rich, fruity flavor profile. It features aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, vanilla, and a hint of mint. The taste is described as a sweet entry with soft, round tannins, medium structure, and great freshness, according to Marquis Wine Cellars. It is balanced and well-suited for various occasions.

undurraga-t-h-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Undurraga Terroir Hunter Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
