undurraga-t-h-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: A cedary and expressive Cabernet Sauvignon, with aromas of ripe blackcurrants and fresh berries, graphite notes and the subtle herbal hints characteristic of Cabernet Sauvignon wines from cool areas in Maipo. Refined and soft on the palate, the wine has tense, structured tannins and a subtle influence of fine oak.

campolongo-di-torbe-amarone.title: Masi Campolongo Di Torbe Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico 2013/2015
campolongo-di-torbe-amarone.bodyHtml:
The Campolongo di Torbe Amarone della Valpolicella Classico from Masi is named after the top Amarone vineyard of the same name. It produces a unique wine that is second to none. Its impenetrable ruby red color finds its counterpart in the intense aromas of baked fruit and cinnamon. On the palate, the senses are indulged by ripe cherries, plums, and bitter almonds. Nuances of tar, orange peel, and blackberry jam also emerge. This wine is bursting with power, it is extremely rich, and the flavor of black fruits spreads through the mouth like a soft, comforting wave. The opulence of the wine is evident in its full body, underscored by velvety tannins. Finally, the grand finale follows: a beautiful finish with hints of clover and paprika. This wine matured for 36 months in oak barrels – a true rarity, with only a limited number of bottles available.

95 Points - James Suckling

The first single vineyard produced in the region. 8 ha, all pergola and sited c.400 metres. Subsequently the appassimento is extremely slow, completed in small buildings in the middle of the vineyards, on bamboo racks. Aromas of salumi, tarragon, fennel and the signature bitter, pithy, molten cherry bon bon notes that define Amarone. Incredible levels of extract here, coating the inner gums with a curvaceous brushstroke of tannin. The finish is firm, ferrous, coffee-grind gritty and impressive, with a twist of bitter orange chocolate at the finish to tone the lingering sweetness. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A graceful red, with a rich core of black plum reduction and espresso crema flavors, with minerally accents of loamy earth and iron, sassafras and black tea leaves. Medium- to full-bodied, broad and creamy on the palate, with well-meshed, dense tannins emerging only on the finish to trim it slightly. Corvina, Rondinella and Molinara. Drink now through 2035.

veuve-clicquot-rose-vintage-reserve.title: Veuve Clicquot Rose Brut
veuve-clicquot-rose-vintage-reserve.bodyHtml:
This non-vintage Rose is the end result of a desire to create a Rose champagne with a delightfully luscious, fruit-based charm. Jacques Peters, the cellarmaster, and his team wanted a champagne that would be accessible and naturally engaging while conserving Veuve Clicquot's essential values in terms of style.

The wine has a luminous color with attractive pink glints. The nose is generous and elegant, with initial aromas of fresh red fruit (raspberry, wild strawberry, cherry, blackberry), leading to biscuity notes of dried fruits and Viennese pastries (almonds, apricots and brioche).

The fresh attack is followed by a fruity harmonious sensation on the palate. The wine is perfectly balanced in the best Veuve Clicquot style of pink champagnes, combining elegance and flair. The wine works its magic—this delectably full champagne can be enjoyed as a true delicacy. A deliciously fruity wine in earlybloom, this is a wonderful aperitif to be shared as a twosome or simply with friends.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Minerally on the nose and lacy in texture on the palate, this layers tangy mandarin orange peel acidity with rich hints of toasted brioche and vanilla as well as flavors of wild strawberry, candied ginger and pastry cream. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Drink now.

91 Points - James Suckling

Grapefruit color with aromas of cherries, strawberries, almonds, pastries and honey. Creamy and rounded, with a medium body and soft bubbles. All nicely integrated. Blend of majority pinot noir with chardonnay and meunier, with 12% red wine.

glencadam-10-year-old.title: Glencadam 10 Year Old
glencadam-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Multi-award winning Glencadam 10 Years Old is fragrant, with a grassy freshness and notes of citrus and spice, whilst maintaining a rounded smoothness on the palate.

Matured exclusively in American oak ex-bourbon barrels, Glencadam 10 Years Old displays a natural sweetness, a soft yet spicy oak and clean, crisp citrus flavours. Additionally, this well-balanced single malt is neither coloured nor chill-filtered.

tbilvino-khvanchkara-medium-sweet-red.title: Tbilvino Khvanchkara Red Semi Sweet 2023 750ml
tbilvino-khvanchkara-medium-sweet-red.bodyHtml: The Tbilvino Khvanchkara 2023 is a Georgian semi-sweet red wine from the Racha region, made from the Aleksandrouli and Mujuretuli grape varieties. Expect a ruby-colored wine with a harmonious, velvet taste, balancing sweetness with fruity notes of berries and cherry. It pairs well with light, soft cheeses, fruit platters, or boiled and smoked meats.

vina-cobos-bramare-marchiori-malbec.title: Vina Cobos Hobbs Estate Malbec 2020
vina-cobos-bramare-marchiori-malbec.bodyHtml:
With the inaugural vintage of Cobos Malbec in 1999, Viña Cobos marked a milestone in viticulture, defying existing standards and firmly positioning Malbec and Argentina on the international wine scene. Since then, their prestigious wines have been recognized around the globe by critics and consumers alike.

Ruby red color with good intensity. Aromas of cherries, cedar and hints of graphite. On the palate the wine is full, rich and round with good tension, chewy tannins and a long finish.

95 Points - James Suckling

A luscious yet crunchy red with crushed berries, hibiscus, oyster shells and redcurrants. Tight and chalky tannins on the palate, closed and linear at the end. Very fine for the vintage. New wine from Cobos and giving a nod to the Hobbs family. Drink or hold.

cinzano-bianco.title: Cinzano Vermouth Bianco 1L
cinzano-bianco.bodyHtml:
Created in Torino, Cinzano is authentically Italian. Established in 1757, with over 250 years of heritage, Cinzano is about consistent quality that remains constant through time, enduring generations and passing trends.

Over ice with a splash of soda, garnished with a lemon slice and olive, or neat with a lemon-sugar rim.

adobe-carmenere.title: Emiliana Adobe Reserva Carmenere
adobe-carmenere.bodyHtml:
Ripe plum, blackberry and dark cherry aromas mingle with black pepper, herbs and gentle spice. The palate is juicy and balanced, with soft tannins, fresh acidity and generous dark fruit leading into a smooth, savory and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled beef, roast pork, lamb, barbecue, hearty pasta, empanadas, roasted vegetables, or semi-hard cheeses.

ricasoli-colledila-chianti-classico.title: Barone Ricasoli Colledila Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021
ricasoli-colledila-chianti-classico.bodyHtml:
Ruby red color. Intense and elegant nose with ripe plum, wood notes and caramel. Round, silky and elegant in the mouth with velvety tannins, which, together with a crisp acidity, gives a wrapped softening mouthfeel.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Packed with cherry, raspberry and pomegranate flavors, this red is also succulent and verging on racy in profile, with a deep vein of mineral and peppery spice notes that intensify on the extended finish. Shows superb balance and grace, with the best yet to come. Best from 2027 through 2048.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Barone Ricasoli 2021 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Gaiole Colledilà opens to dark fruit, but perhaps more significantly, you get a slate-like mineral note that adds focus. That mineral note appears in all these beautiful Gran Selezione wines from vintner Francesco Ricasoli, but in the case of this bottle, it adds a dark or slightly brooding personality. The finish is absolutely savory and salty.

95 Points - James Suckling

Fresh and crunchy with orange peel, cherries, raspberries and hints of raw meat. It’s medium-bodied with medium-round tannins and a succulent finish. Polished and creamy. Lightly chewy and crisp at the end.

penfolds-bin-311-tumbarumba-chardonnay.title: Penfolds Bin 311 Chardonnay 2022
penfolds-bin-311-tumbarumba-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 311 Chardonnay 2022 is an exceptionally elegant, precise, and cool-climate Australian white wine that beautifully showcases Penfolds' multi-regional blending expertise. Sourced from premier cool-climate regions—including Tasmania, Tumbarumba, and the Adelaide Hills—this wine is aged for 8 months in French oak barriques (approximately 34% new). In the glass, it displays a pale straw-gold color with brilliant green hues. The nose is highly expressive, offering vibrant aromas of white peach, lemon curd, and grapefruit zest, beautifully framed by subtle notes of roasted hazelnuts, wet slate, and delicate white blossoms. On the palate, this medium-bodied Chardonnay is tense and mineral-driven, seamlessly balancing a creamy texture with a razor-sharp, chalky line of acidity that carries refreshing citrus and stone fruit flavors into a long, crisp, and beautifully structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared scallops in lemon-butter sauce, roasted chicken with tarragon, grilled lobster tail, or creamy goat cheese crostini.

94 Points - James Suckling

Flint. Kumquat, lime zest and stone fruit allusions. Cool climate Tasmania and Tumbarumba fruit. Mid-weighted and tautly furled with a core of fruit sweetness that expands across the filigreed finish. Long! I like this wine. While it is reductive in the contemporary Australian vein, it is far less so than the Penfolds chardonnay style of just a few years ago, with a relaxed glide across the finish. Creamed cashew and praline at its core, conferring generosity. Real juice, thrust and crunch to this. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Bin 311 Chardonnay hails from three regions: Tasmania (38%), Tumbarumba (33%) and the Adelaide Hills (29%). It matured in French oak for eight months (34% new). Crushed salted nuts, white peach and layers of nectarine and green apple populate the palate. It's svelte, polished and classy to a tee. It has the Penfolds phenolic stamp of seamlessness without being glossy or overdone. Lovely wine. Pleasure here! It was a lovely season in all three regions.

vina-cobos-cocodrilo-corte.title: Vina Cobos Cocodrilo Corte 2023
vina-cobos-cocodrilo-corte.bodyHtml:
Deep red ruby with dark tones. Aromas of sweet spices, roasted red pepper, clove and black chocolate. On the palate it is balanced and juicy with sweet tannins and long finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

This shows black and red berries, spices and a touch of cedar on the nose. The palate is round and succulent with plush, polished tannins and voluminous, lustrous dark fruit. Caressing texture and a generous finish. Drink now or hold.

89 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh and youthful red, offering cherry paste and plum flavors at the core, with subtle cassis and herb notes folding in. Finishes with firming tannins and a late tug of earth and toast. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Malbec and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2036.

tenuta-di-sesta-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Tenuta Di Sesta Brunello Di Montalcino 2021
tenuta-di-sesta-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Tenuta Di Sesta Brunello Di Montalcino 2021 is an outstanding, deeply expressive Tuscan red wine produced from 100% Sangiovese grown on warm, south-facing slopes in the southern sector of Montalcino between Saint'Angelo in Colle and Castelnuovo dell'Abate. Visually presenting an intense ruby-red color with garnet reflections, it opens with a fragrant and complex bouquet of ripe wild cherries, red plums, and crushed violets, seamlessly woven with nuances of dried herbs, leather, pipe tobacco, and flinty minerality. On the palate, it is full-bodied, structured, and elegant, driven by vibrant natural acidity and fine-grained, noble tannins that lead to a long, persistent, and beautifully balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with roasted red meats, braised beef short ribs, Florentina steak, wild boar ragù, truffle dishes, and mature aged Pecorino cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

Ripe cherries, dried herbs and some sweet roasted spices here. Nice savoriness, too. Medium body with fine-grained tannins and a long, supple finish. The fine tannins provide an enveloping, caressing feel. Drink or hold.

santos-da-casa-reserva-douro-doc.title: Santos Da Casa Reserva Douro Tinto 2015 750ml
santos-da-casa-reserva-douro-doc.bodyHtml:
91 Points - James Suckling
A mature and complex Douro red that has evolved beautifully, offering a nuanced bouquet of dried figs, stewed plums, cedar, and spice box. The palate is smooth and fully integrated, with resolved tannins and a long, savory finish that speaks to its careful aging.
90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This 2015 Reserva shows the graceful aging potential of Douro blends, with layered flavors of baked fruit, leather, and tobacco. The texture is velvety and the finish is persistent, offering a delightful drinking experience from a ready-to-enjoy vintage.

glenturret-sherry-edition.title: The Glenturret Sherry Edition
glenturret-sherry-edition.bodyHtml:
The Glenturret Sherry Edition is a Highland single malt from The Glenturret, the small distillery near Crieff that traces its origins to 1775. It is matured in a combination of Spanish oak and American oak casks seasoned with sherry, a pairing that brings a sweet spiciness over a soft background of oak. In the glass it shows a deep, burnished gold colour. Bottled at 43% ABV in a 700ml bottle, it is an approachable, sherry-led introduction to one of Scotland's oldest working distilleries.

Tasting Notes: Sweet spice and soft oak from sherry-seasoned Spanish and American oak.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass; add a few drops of water to open it up.

glenturret-peated-edition.title: The Glenturret Peated Edition
glenturret-peated-edition.bodyHtml:
The Glenturret Peated Edition is a Highland single malt from The Glenturret, the distillery on the banks of the River Turret near Crieff that dates back to 1775 and is counted among Scotland's oldest working distilleries. This edition is made from malted barley dried over peat fires, giving a heavy smokiness that harks back to the style of whisky made when the distillery was first licensed. It is bottled at 43% ABV in a 700ml bottle, and pairs a sweet, smoky palate with a gentle salty edge and a soft, lingering peat finish.

Tasting Notes: Smoky and sweet, with a slightly salty note.

Nose: Warm bitumen and freshly baked brownie.

Palate: Sweet and smoky with a slightly salty edge.

Finish: Lingering, soft peat.

Serve: Neat in a nosing glass; add a few drops of water to open it up.

hundred-acre-wraith-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Hundred Acre Wraith Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
hundred-acre-wraith-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Wraith is a fusion of all three Hundred Acre single vineyard estates, but not just three wines blended together, that would be boring and muddled. Winemaker Jason Woodbridge chose these barrels for their perfect expression of only the ultra-unique qualities of the vintage and vineyard sites. These qualities are carefully woven together to create a super-intense, wildly fine structured, matchless expression of Hundred Acre, while at the same time still being able to see clearly the singular and exceptional characteristics of ARK, Kayli Morgan and Few and Far Between single vineyards that year through a single lens.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
A blend of fruit from the three single vineyards, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Wraith offers up more cherries and cranberries beautifully complemented by deep loam and mocha undertones. It's full-bodied, lush and velvety in texture, with a long, vibrant finish. It's even a bit tart.

twa-dogs-the-dog-pack-variety-pack.title: Twa Dogs The Dog Pack Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans
twa-dogs-the-dog-pack-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Twa Dogs The Dog Pack Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans is a craft beer assortment from Twa Dogs Brewery, part of Macaloney Brewers & Distillers in Victoria, British Columbia. Featuring eight 473ml cans across four beer styles, this collection showcases the brewery's Scottish-inspired heritage and diverse approach to brewing. From crisp, refreshing lagers to malt-balanced pale ales and hop-forward IPAs, The Dog Pack offers a variety of flavours, aromas, and bitterness levels. Ideal for gatherings and beer enthusiasts looking to explore different styles, this mixed pack provides a convenient introduction to Twa Dogs' craft beer range.

old-ballanturan-peated-single-malt.title: Teeling Blackpitts Peated Single Malt
old-ballanturan-peated-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Produced by Teeling Whiskey in Dublin, Ireland, Blackpitts Peated Single Malt is a triple-distilled Irish single malt named after the historic Blackpitts area behind the Teeling Whiskey Distillery. Made entirely from heavily peated malted barley and matured in ex-bourbon and ex-Sauternes white wine casks, it combines distinctive barbecue-style smoke with fruit, honey and caramel sweetness. Triple distillation softens the more medicinal aspects often associated with heavily peated whisky, while retaining its savoury smoke character. It is bottled at 46% ABV and non-chill filtered.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, barbecue pork, grilled pineapple, mature cheddar, dark chocolate, or caramel-based desserts.

Tasting Notes: Smoky yet fruit-forward, balancing savoury barbecue smoke with orchard and tropical fruits, honey, caramel and warming spice.

Nose: Aromatic barbecue smoke leads into cloves, butterscotch and orange peel, creating a balance between savoury peat and sweeter citrus notes.

Palate: Applewood smoke and honey develop alongside allspice, stewed pears and grilled pineapple, with the fruit sweetness balancing the peated malt.

Finish: Lingering salted caramel and seasoned wood are joined by savoury smoke, leaving a warming combination of sweetness, oak and peat.

Serve: Enjoy neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or tulip-shaped glass; a few drops of water can help open its fruit, caramel and smoky character.

jim-barry-assyrtiko.title: Jim Barry Assyrtiko 2021
jim-barry-assyrtiko.bodyHtml:
A crisp Clare Valley Assyrtiko with lifted white florals and wet stone aromas. The palate delivers citrus, light floral notes and wet slate, supported by a distinctive mineral texture and vibrant acidity. A classic saline note carries through the clean, refreshing and impressively long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled octopus, fresh oysters, lemon-baked snapper, or salt-and-pepper calamari.

schrader-rbs-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Schrader RBS To Kalon Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
schrader-rbs-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
The grapes used in the creation of this wine came from the Beckstoffer Family's portion of H. W. Crabb's original To Kalon Vineyard which was established in 1868.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon RBS Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard is Clone 337, matured 18 months in 100% new Darnajou and Taransaud barrels. Marked on the nose by red berries, cherries and cedar, plus delicate cinnamon and clove shadings, this is a plush, concentrated full-bodied wine with a core of firmness to it and a long, lingering finish, both positive signs for aging. It's one of the more approachable Schrader wines this vintage, but it should easily go another two decades. Best After 2025. 

97 Points - James Suckling

Racy, dark nose with pulpy character. Dried lychee, lavender and sandalwood. This is quite juicy, ample and almost a bit ethereal, despite the color and high alcohol. There is a fine twist of salinity on the palate that runs smoothly with lots of purple flowers. Really immaculate. Almost soft texture.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Gushes with pure violet, plum and cassis notes, all flecked with hints of black tea, anise and sassafras. Driven, with a graphite underpinning providing a spine that stays in the background as the fruit stretches out. Approachable already but no rush at all. Drink now

galius-st-emilion-grand-cru.title: Galius Saint-Emilion Grand Cru 2020
galius-st-emilion-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Galius Saint-Émilion Grand Cru 2020 is an expressive, modern Right Bank red wine vinified by the Union de Producteurs de Saint-Émilion (UDP Saint-Émilion) from parcels planted on clay-limestone soils. Sourced from mature vines and aged for 12 to 14 months in French oak barrels (50% new oak, 50% one-use), it presents a deep ruby hue with dark garnet glints. The nose opens with aromatic intensity, revealing ripe dark plums, black cherries, blueberries, and loganberries complemented by crushed violets, dried bay leaves, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it delivers a dense, full-bodied profile with concentrated black fruit and bitter chocolate framed by firm, polished tannins and fresh natural acidity that carry into an enduring, structured finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled entrecôte steak with shallots, garlic-studded roast leg of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison medallions, and mature Comté cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Dark plums, blueberries, violets, loganberries and bay leaves on the nose. Full-bodied with firm, polished tannins. I like the intense and persistent bitter chocolate and dark berry fruit. Better from 2025.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This fine wood-aged wine has a powerful density and concentration. It is an age worthy wine, its blackberry flavors layered with firm tannins. At the end, the wine's acidity adds to its potential. Drink the wine from 2026.

ravel-stitch-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
ravel-stitch-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a highly refined, elegant, and classic expression of Napa Valley. It presents a deep, saturated ruby color and features a vibrant nose of black raspberry, blackcurrant, and dark blackberry preserves, layered with delicate floral notes of violet and lavender. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, its boisterous and bright dark fruit flavors are supported by savory hints of chaparral sagebrush, bay laurel, and subtle cedar. The texture is soft and silky, framed by velvety-rich tannins and crisp acidity that offer a balanced, firm grip leading into a long, sumptuous finish.

Food Pairing: This savory, structured Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, herb-crusted rack of lamb, or rich mushroom ravioli.

93 Points - James Suckling

A very refined and polished red with fine tannins, bright acidity and a tangy undertone. Medium-bodied, juicy and savory. Citrusy. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Earthy, cocoa powder aromatics combine with ripe black fruits on the palate. Lengthy, robust, full bodied and fully flavored, this powerful wine is carried by powdery-fine tannins and a persistent, palate-cleansing acidity.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

There's a caressing feel to the mix of cassis and boysenberry puree flavors that are gilded with a pretty violet note. The long finish has a toasty edge and lingers prettily.

fercullen-10-year-old-irish-whiskey.title: Fercullen 10 Year Old Single Grain Irish Whiskey
fercullen-10-year-old-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml: Carefully selected from rare stocks of aged Irish Whiskey, the Fercullen 10-year-old Single Grain Irish Whiskey has been aged exclusively in white oak for over a decade before being recasked to mature in fresh bourbon barrels. Balanced, with light, sweet, subtle tones, this inspiring Irish whiskey lends character and company to any occasion.

conte-della-vipera-sauvignon-blanc.title: Marchesi Antinori Castello della Sala Conte Della Vipera 2024
conte-della-vipera-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Castello della Sala Conte Della Vipera 2024 is an elegant, vibrant white wine displaying a straw yellow color with subtle greenish hues. The nose opens with expressive notes of pink grapefruit, lychee, lime, and pineapple. On the palate, it is crisp, lively, and beautifully structured, featuring ripe citrus, subtle mineral nuances, and a persistent, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with seafood crudo, zucchini carpaccio, grilled white fish, goat cheese, and light pasta dishes.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Pink grapefruit and ripe pear dancing through lime zest while fresh pineapple brings the sunshine. The palate flows with elegant precision, where bright fruit and crisp focus turn seafood crudo or zucchini carpaccio into an event.

vallein-tercinier-46-small-batch-cognac.title: Vallein Tercinier 46 Small Batch Cognac
vallein-tercinier-46-small-batch-cognac.bodyHtml:
Vallein Tercinier 46 Small Batch Cognac is a blend from the family-run Vallein Tercinier house, which has matured cognac in old French oak since 1850. The master blender married two batches: a 25-year-old Fins Bois and a 15-year-old Bons Bois, and bottled them at 46% ABV without chill filtration or added colour to keep the full, fruity character. It comes in a 700ml bottle and shows a natural gold colour.

Nose: Fine and intense, with apricot, honey, orange and plum, rounded by anise and almond.

Palate: Opens with ginger, then the same soft, intense fruit returns in balance.

Serve: Neat in a tulip glass, or with a single ice cube.

peats-beast-single-malt.title: Peats Beast Single Malt
peats-beast-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Peat's Beast Single Malt is an intensely peated single malt Scotch whisky, created in 2011 by a team led by former Whyte & Mackay director Eamonn Jones and importer Gerald Erdrich, with input from master blender Richard Paterson. The distillery is kept secret, but the style is not: this is a ferociously full-bodied malt with a big bite of untamed peat smoke. It is bottled at 46% ABV without chill filtration, additives or colouring, and Jim Murray's Whisky Bible 2019 scored it 92 points. On the nose, sea spray, bonfire smoke, damp earth and cinnamon give way to peat moss, wet grass, crushed pear, apple and fresh bread; the palate is bold, with thick tar, peat smoke and creamy liquorice. 700ml.

Nose: Sea spray, bonfire smoke, damp earth and cinnamon, then peat moss, wet grass, crushed pear, apple and fresh bread.

Palate: Bold and structured, with thick tar, peat smoke and creamy liquorice.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water to tame the beast.

kah-reposado.title: Casamigos Reposado Tequila 1.75L
kah-reposado.bodyHtml:
Casamigos Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. The agave pinas are slow-roasted in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours and fermented using a proprietary yeast blend. Aged for 7 months in premium American white oak barrels, it offers a smooth, balanced combination of sweet cooked agave, rich oak, and subtle spices.

Food Pairing: Grilled meats, pork carnitas, chicken mole, fish tacos, roasted vegetables, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : Golden honey in appearance with a smooth, soft, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet agave, vanilla, toasted oak, caramel, and light cocoa.

Palate : Smooth and rich with flavors of sweet cooked agave, vanilla, oak, caramel, and subtle hints of dried fruit and spice.

Finish : Smooth, long, and clean with lingering notes of warm oak and sweet vanilla.

Serve : Best served neat, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic tequila cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Reposado Paloma.

vallein-tercinier-bon-bois-1990-42-90.title: Vallein Tercinier 1990 Bons Bois Single Cask Brut de Fut Cognac
vallein-tercinier-bon-bois-1990-42-90.bodyHtml:
Vallein Tercinier 1990 Bons Bois is a single-cask vintage Cognac from the Vallein Tercinier family house at Chermignac, founded in 1850. Distilled from the 1990 harvest in the Bons Bois cru, it spent 31 years in French oak cask no. 205 before bottling in 2021 at its natural cask strength of 42.9% ABV. The label calls it a Très Vieux Cognac Brut de Fût, bottled with natural colour and without chill filtration, and the release was limited to 571 bottles of 700ml.

Nose: Almond and port-like fragrance, moving towards honey, liquorice, Sichuan pepper berries and praline.

Palate: Fresh, unctuous and spicy, with pepper and candied apricot.

Finish: Delicate jasmine, vanilla and roasted hazelnut.

Serve: Neat at room temperature in a tulip glass; give it a few minutes in the glass.

casamigos-reposado-1.title: Casamigos Reposado Tequila 1.75L
casamigos-reposado-1.bodyHtml:
Casamigos Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. The agave pinas are slow-roasted in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours and fermented using a proprietary yeast blend. Aged for 7 months in premium American white oak barrels, it offers a smooth, balanced combination of sweet cooked agave, rich oak, and subtle spices.

Food Pairing: Grilled meats, pork carnitas, chicken mole, fish tacos, roasted vegetables, and dark chocolate desserts.

Tasting Notes : Golden honey in appearance with a smooth, soft, and medium-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet agave, vanilla, toasted oak, caramel, and light cocoa.

Palate : Smooth and rich with flavors of sweet cooked agave, vanilla, oak, caramel, and subtle hints of dried fruit and spice.

Finish : Smooth, long, and clean with lingering notes of warm oak and sweet vanilla.

Serve : Best served neat, on the rocks, or as an elevated base in classic tequila cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Reposado Paloma.

s-m-o-s-blair-athol-10-year-parcel-no-6.title: S.M.O.S Blair Athol 10 Year Old Parcel No.6
s-m-o-s-blair-athol-10-year-parcel-no-6.bodyHtml:
S.M.O.S Blair Athol 10 Year Old Parcel No.6 is a single malt Scotch whisky from the Blair Athol Distillery, bottled by The Single Malts of Scotland (Elixir Distillers). Distilled in 2011 and aged for 10 years, this small batch bottling (Parcel No. 6) combines five ex-bourbon barrels to highlight Blair Athol's signature rich, nutty, and fruity style.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork chops with apple sauce, aged cheddar, grilled sausage, or toasted nut pastries.

Tasting Notes : Bright amber in appearance with a smooth, medium-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Green apples, citrus zest, toasted almonds, sweet malt, and gentle vanilla.

Palate : Creamy vanilla, poached pears, honeyed cereal, nutmeg, and soft oak spice.

Finish : Medium in length, clean, and warming with lingering notes of orchard fruit and mild wood spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or with a few drops of water to open up the fruity and floral notes.

glenallachie-11-year-old-px-finish.title: The GlenAllachie 11 Year Old PX Finish
glenallachie-11-year-old-px-finish.bodyHtml:
This glorious rich mahogany malt has been matured for over nine years in American Oak Barrels. The additional maturation in richly seasoned Pedro Ximénez puncheons adds layers of complexity, resulting in a sweeter, fruitier flavour experience.

Bottled at 48%, with no added colouring and unchilfiltered for flavour.

From Batch 3 of The GlenAllachie Wood Finish Range.

glenallachie-12-year-old-ruby-port-finis.title: The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old Ruby Port Finish
glenallachie-12-year-old-ruby-port-finis.bodyHtml:
This gorgeous ruby red malt was initially aged for ten years in American Oak Barrels before being re-racked into Ruby Port Pipes. The secondary maturation period further develops the depth of flavour and complexity, as well as bestowing a vibrant, rich colour.

Bottled at 48%, with no added colouring and unchilfiltered for flavour.

From Batch 3 of The GlenAllachie Wood Finish Range.

glenallachie-13-year-old-madeira-finish.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 13
glenallachie-13-year-old-madeira-finish.bodyHtml:
GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 13 is a rich, full-flavored single malt Scotch whisky crafted by Master Distiller Billy Walker at the GlenAllachie Distillery in Speyside. Bottled at natural cask strength, non-chill filtered, and with no added color, this expression delivers a robust, multi-layered profile resulting from a complex maturation process in Spanish Sherry oak, Pedro Ximénez, Oloroso, Virgin Oak, and Rioja casks.

Food Pairing: Rich dark chocolate desserts, sticky toffee pudding, venison stew, blue cheese or sharp aged gouda, and roasted chestnuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany in appearance with a heavy, coating, and full-bodied mouthfeel that brings intense, warming complexity.

Nose : Waves of heather honey, dark chocolate, dried fruit, mocha, cinnamon spice, orange zest, and soft espresso.

Palate : Rich cocoa, treacle, raisins, gingerbread, dark cherries, butterscotch, and sweet oak spices balanced by warm barley malt.

Finish : Long and lingering with notes of dark chocolate, spiced orchard fruit, citrus peel, and seasoned oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of pure spring water in a Glencairn glass.

ulysses.title: Ulysses Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
ulysses.bodyHtml:
Ulysses Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 is an outstanding, estate-grown red wine produced by Christian Moueix on the historic Oakville Bench along the slopes of the Mayacamas Range. Crafted primarily from Cabernet Sauvignon with small additions of Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, it displays a deep, inky ruby-purple hue. The nose is complex and expressive, revealing alluring aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry reduction, cassis, and truffle, beautifully layered with nuances of mocha, sweet tobacco, graphite, crushed herbs, and warm earth. On the palate, it exhibits a dense, vertical structure with rich, velvety concentration and seamless, tight-knit tannins, perfectly balanced by a lively line of freshness that carries into an extraordinarily persistent, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with grilled dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, venison tenderloin, or aged Gouda cheese.

98 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of terra cotta, chocolate and hazelnut with iron and ink. Dusty. Full-bodied and round. Layered. Flamboyant and juicy. Rather soft and gorgeous. Some walnut and chocolate at the end. Persistent. Always there. Drinkable now, but will age wonderfully.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The current-release 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon shows more cherries and bay leaf on the nose than prior vintages. There's still a solid framework of cedar, loam and cassis, hints of mocha and licorice, but there's also a bit more freshness and lift. It's medium to full-bodied and densely concentrated yet silky and finessed, with a long, elegant finish.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Dark and reserved in style, with a core of black currant and blackberry reduction wrapped in singed alder and warm loam. Tightly wound for now, with the fruit held in check, but the underlying structure is polished and there's mineral-laced drive on the finish.

dillons-tangerine-a-hint-of-mint.title: Dillon's Tangerine & A Hint Of Mint 6 Cans
dillons-tangerine-a-hint-of-mint.bodyHtml: Dillon's Tangerine & A Hint Of Mint 6 Cans

compass-box-experimental-grain-whisky.title: Compass Box Nectarosity Blended Scotch Whisky
compass-box-experimental-grain-whisky.bodyHtml: Part artistry, part alchemy, Nectarosity generously brings you honeyed fruit and toasted oak notes, straight from our Blending Room. Special American oak barrels are deployed twice. First to impart sweet spice to grain spirit, which finishes maturing in other casks. Once prepared, the barrels age malt whisky. We expertly blend these two characterful whiskies with selected others to dial up the fruit and toffee notes. Joyously zesty with honey, lychee, juicy apricot and pineapple. Toffee and vanilla pull off a palate takeover, with lasting flavours of cinnamon bun.

compass-box-vellichor.title: Compass Box The Peat Monster
compass-box-vellichor.bodyHtml:
For 2019, The Peat Monster has a new label. Featuring this quite marvellous specially-commissioned painting, all batches released going forward will showcase the new artwork. It isn’t just the packaging that is different, however: the recipe has evolved, too.

Still very much the whisky for those who love big, rich, smoky-peaty malts, our latest version of THE PEAT MONSTER is older and more elegant than before.

Inspired by feedback from smoky whisky lovers, our new Painting Label of THE PEAT MONSTER incorporates single malts with a more aromatic and graceful style of smokiness. We have sought to retain the peaty intensity for which THE PEAT MONSTER has long been celebrated, whilst creating a depth and elegance not seen before.

New batches of THE PEAT MONSTER boast a spectrum of powerful coastal flavours, combining the smokiness of a driftwood fire with more medicinal peat notes. Orchard fruits and rich cask-derived creaminess balance the multi-layered smoke. It is a new peaty landscape, as the Painting Label shows.

The evolution is a subtle one. We hope you will hunt down both labels and enjoy teasing out the contrasts.

truly-margarita-variety-pack.title: Topo Chico Margarita Variety Pack 12 Cans

social-lite-fruit-punch.title: Truly Punch Mix Pack 12 Cans
social-lite-fruit-punch.bodyHtml:
The Truly Punch Mixed Pack is a 12-can variety pack of hard seltzers crafted with real fruit juice. It is widely distributed across Canada and features bold fruit flavor combinations. 
The assortment provides three 355 mL cans of each of the following four styles:
  • Fruit Punch: A classic, lively mashup of mixed fruits with a sweet, crisp finish.
  • Berry Punch: A bold blend highlighting ripe strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries.
  • Tropical Punch: A smooth mix featuring tropical notes of pineapple, mango, and passionfruit.
  • Citrus Punch: A bright, zesty combination of lemon, lime, and orange.

austin-hope-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Austin Hope Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
austin-hope-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Austin Hope Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, opulent, and expressively bold California red wine from Paso Robles. Visually displaying a deep ruby core, it opens with enticing aromas of fresh black cherry, dark plum preserves, cassis, and subtle burnt sugar with a delicate hint of smokiness. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied, lush mouthfeel brimming with layered flavors of blackberry syrup, mocha, vanilla, and sweet spices, seamlessly balanced by integrated fine-grained tannins and a bright touch of natural acidity that leads into a smooth, lengthy, and velvety finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime ribeye steak, barbecued beef short ribs, grilled lamb chops, dark chocolate desserts, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

There's a significant spice of oak that comes through on the nose of this bottling, with solid blackberry fruit as well. The palate combines black cherry and blackberry syrup with root beer spices, as the finish lingers atop tannins amid vanilla, nutmeg and oak spices.

20-aldeas-condado-de-haza.title: Biregas Condado De Haza 20 Aldeas 2018 750ml
20-aldeas-condado-de-haza.bodyHtml:
Clear and bright. Cherry-red color with a violet rim. Intense aroma of black fruits, blackberries and a hint of dairy, with the licorice characteristic of the Tempranillo grape variety, followed by toasted notes such as vanilla, coffee caramel and lightly smoky notes from the ageing process in American oak barrels. It is a potent wine that is fleshy at entry, with a remarkable balance between tannins and acidity. It has a broad mouthfeel with well-rounded tannins that fill the mouth with a fruity flavor rounded off with persistent toasted notes, licorice, coffee caramel and toffee. It has a long-lasting, pleasant aftertaste.

Organically grown grapes

95 Points - James Suckling

A rich, structured red with blueberry and blackberry. Toasted oak and coffee, too. It’s full-bodied and chewy with solid tannins and a flavorful finish. Really solid. A little old-school, but shows clarity and focus. From organically grown grapes.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This garnet-colored wine offers aromas of dried cranberry, freshly picked red cherry and dried Mediterranean herbs. It is soft on entry, with pronounced flavors of red and black plums, brown baking spices and dark chocolate. It is medium-bodied with soft tannins, and there is a touch of dried savory herbs in the persistent finish.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A smooth and silky red, offering a creamy profile of cassis, warm spice, dried fig and dried thyme enmeshed with light, sculpted tannins. Well-balanced, with a fresh finish showing tar and mineral hints. Drink now through 2028.

90 Points - Decanter
This has a sour-sweet red fruit styling, with nicely-judged layers of oak, fine-grained tannins and lively vanilla and raspberry notes.

moet-grand-vintage-1993.title: Moet & Chandon Grand Vintage Collection 1993 750ml
moet-grand-vintage-1993.bodyHtml:
Light golden colour with finely integrated bubbles. Very nice roasted nose with hints of roasted hazelnuts, almonds, fine spices, ripe citrus and yellow fruit, nice maturity and complexity. The palate has a very good grip, firm and mouth-watering with vibrant fruit, yet with some mature notes and rounded texture, fine creaminess and a long roasted finish, very nice and perfectly drinkable.

 

90 Points - Wine & Spirits

moet-grand-vintage-1995.title: Moet and Chandon Grand Vintage Collection 1995
moet-grand-vintage-1995.bodyHtml:
Moët & Chandon Grand Vintage Collection 1995 is an exceptional vintage Champagne from the historic house of Moët & Chandon in Épernay, France. Crafted from 50% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, and 10% Pinot Meunier, this mature expression showcases the remarkable balance of richness and freshness achieved through extended cellar aging. Aromas of candied citrus, ripe pear, toasted brioche, and roasted almonds lead into a creamy, complex palate with notes of apricot, honey, gingerbread, and delicate spice. Its elegant acidity and lingering finish make it a distinguished collector's Champagne.

Food Pairing: Seared scallops, lobster, roasted poultry, foie gras, aged Comté, wild mushroom risotto, toasted almonds, and delicate seafood dishes.

 

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The vintage Moët seems a bit sugary, with broad, simple flavors. It's a blocky wine; a bit of citrus here, some butterscotch there, and that sugary kick to the finish. Just a bit too paint-by-the-numbers.

moet-grand-vintage-1996.title: Moet & Chandon Grand Vintage Collection 1996 750ml
moet-grand-vintage-1996.bodyHtml:
Toast, Mirabelle plum, a touch of chalk, and an almost caramel richness seem to play on the nose. On the palate there is vivid briskness, a mouth-watering brightness and such precision. This is vivid, almost electric and very animating. The vivid, bursting bubbles only heighten that expression. This is sleek, concentrated, racy, exciting and oh so fresh. Like a little dancing sprite of freshness.

89 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Fairly youthful and fresh, with lively apple and floral notes alongside deeper, toastier aromas and flavors. Creamy in the mouth, and finishes with a hint of bitter grapefruit.

moet-grand-vintage-1999.title: Moet & Chandon Grand Vintage Collection 1999 750ml
moet-grand-vintage-1999.bodyHtml:
Each Grand Vintage is unique, expressing the Moët & Chandon Cellar Master's personal interpretation of the year. In Champagne, 1999 was the culmination of contrasting and often unseasonable weather.

Grand Vintage Collection 1999 is the culmination of a contrasting and unseasonable year with a hot and dry summer. It exalts the depth and character of an almost euphoric harvest, the unforgettable story of a captivating twilight. The 66th vintage in the history of the House.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Moët's style, with its delicious forward fruit, is well evidenced in this 1999 vintage. It is full bodied, with apple and almond flavors, developing a toasty character, but still retaining a ripe, open freshness.

broken-compass-hard-tea-variety-pack.title: Broken Compass Hard Tea Variety Pack 12 Cans
broken-compass-hard-tea-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Broken Compass Hard Tea Variety Pack 12 Cans

chivas-regal-12-year-old-3.title: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old 1.75L
chivas-regal-12-year-old-3.bodyHtml:
Chivas Regal 12 Year Old is a classic, world-renowned blended Scotch whisky created by the Chivas Brothers in Aberdeen, Scotland. Crafted from a selection of fine malt and grain whiskies—with Strathisla single malt at its heart—this signature expression is aged for a minimum of 12 years. It delivers a smooth, rich, and accessible Speyside-influenced profile known for its balance of orchard fruits, wild herbs, and sweet honey.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork loin, smoked salmon, creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert, apple pie, and shortbread biscuits.

Tasting Notes : Radiant, warm amber color. Smooth, round, and creamy texture with a light-to-medium body.

Nose : An aromatic infusion of wild herbs, heather, honey, and orchard fruits like ripe apples and peaches.

Palate : Rich and fruity with flavors of sweet honey, poached apples, vanilla, butterscotch, and subtle hazelnut notes.

Finish : Smooth and lingering with gentle notes of oak spice, honey, and subtle maltiness.

Serve : Serve neat, on the rocks, or mixed into classic cocktail recipes such as a Highball or Rob Roy.

opus-one-2013.title: Opus One 2013 750ml
opus-one-2013.bodyHtml:
The 2013 Opus One offers splendid aromas of blueberry, cassis, and blackberries. A creamy entry gives way to layers of complexity which unfold in the mid-palate with velvety tannins enrobing a center of concentrated black-fruit. Elegantly balanced, the acidity and core structure deliver a persistent finish with hints of dark chocolate. 
100 Points - James Suckling
The greatest Opus ever. Terrific aromas of crushed black currants, blueberries and flowers with hints of sweet tobacco. Roses continue to exude opulence and class. Full body, superb balance of ultra-fine tannins and vibrant acidity. Complex aftertaste of black fruits and citrus fruit. Extremely persistent. So approachable now and enjoyable. But will be even better in 2019 and beyond.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet colored, the 2013 Opus One needs a little swirling before exploding with preserved black and blue fruits—blueberry compote, blackberry pie and blackcurrant cordial—giving way to notes of unsmoked cigars, new leather, beef drippings and menthol with wafts of roasted rosemary and rose oil. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is both powerful and ethereal, charged with energy and backed up by profound black fruits, supported with plush tannins and seamless freshness, finishing very long and beautifully perfumed.

94 Points - Decanter
An early harvest in perfect conditions gave a black fruit-dominated wine more of elegance than power, with a fine future.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Seductive from the get-go, with a supple entry to the layers of complexity, mixing flavors of mocha, currant, plum, licorice, spice and cedary oak. Well-proportioned, showing a grip of fine-grained tannins that will benefit from cellaring. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Malbec. Drink now through 2028.

opus-one-2012.title: Opus One 2022 375ml
opus-one-2012.bodyHtml:
Opus One 2022 exudes charm and sophistication from the glass. Primary aromas of blueberry, cassis, and dried rose petals with underlying notes of olive, cigar box, and graphite create a rich and inviting bouquet. On the palate, bright red-fruit flavors, cocoa, and fresh orange peel waltz together into a harmonious and balanced profile. Long and elegant, the finish delivers touches of wet stone, vanilla, and a hint of coffee. Fine-grained tannins and juicy ripeness signal the promise of a long future in the cellar.

96 Points - James Suckling

Generous, with savory aromas of ripe blackcurrants and fresh black cherries and a gentle texture that shows a slight nip of tannin. It is well structured and a bit tight, which is normal for a young cabernet sauvignon-based red that’s a proven collectible. Gives up graphite and pencil shavings, some cocoa and espresso. Full-bodied. Spicy, toasty oak is really showing through right now. Best from 2028.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Picked before, during and after the year's early September heat, the 2022 Opus One—a blend of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 8% Petit Verdot, 6.5% Cabernet Franc, 5% Merlot and 0.5% Malbec—admirably reflects the vintage, boasting a ripe, extroverted personality but also a slightly open-knit, coarser mouthfeel than either the 2021 or 2023. Rosemary and sandalwood notes accent cherries on the nose, while the medium- to full-bodied palate is expansive and plush, finishing with ample length and soft tannins.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a lighter-bodied, fresher profile than most in this vintage, with a mix of red currant, damson plum and cherry coulis notes stitched with savory, tobacco and rose petal accents. There’s a subtle cedar shading through the finish, with a flicker of iron at the tail end. Takes a modest approach to escape most of the pitfalls of this extreme vintage. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Malbec. Best from 2027 through 2037. Tasted twice, with consistent notes.

92 Points - Vinous

The 2022 Opus One is a soft, relatively easygoing wine from an extremely challenging vintage in which the estate decided to pick straight through the heat. The 2022 offers terrific brightness throughout. Today, the tannins are a bit searing in their intensity, so it will be interesting to see how things ultimately shake out here. I find the 2022 is a bit edgy in its contours at this stage.

belle-glos-chardonnay-glasir-holt.title: Belle Glos Glasir Holt Chardonnay 2021 750ml
belle-glos-chardonnay-glasir-holt.bodyHtml:
The Belle Glos Glasir Holt Chardonnay offers aromas of pie crust, lightly toasted marshmallow, banana cream pie, and hints of granny smith apple. On the palate, the wine finds large, luscious tones of melon, bright apple, and hints of buttery brioche. The wine has a well-balanced mouthfeel that dances on the palate with bright and lively acidity and minerality, resulting in a phenomenal expression of a coastal-driven Chardonnay.
92 Points - Wine Enthusaist
There's an exotic mint aroma on the nose of this bottling, along with melon rind, Key lime pie and graham cracker crust. Tropical flower flavors of plumeria and jasmine arise on the palate, which lingers on a riper apple element into the finish.

juyondai-daiginjo-tatsuno-no-otoshiko.title: Juyondai Daiginjo Tatsuno No Otoshiko 1.8L 十四代 純米大吟酿 龍の落とし子
juyondai-daiginjo-tatsuno-no-otoshiko.bodyHtml:
Juyondai Tatsuno No Otoshiko Junmai Daiginjo is a prestigious Japanese sake crafted by Takagi Shuzo in Yamagata Prefecture. Brewed using the brewery's proprietary Tatsu No Otoshigo rice, polished to 40%, this refined sake captures the elegance of Juyondai's celebrated craftsmanship. Delicate melon aromatics, graceful sweetness and a rich, silky mouthfeel create a beautifully balanced expression with remarkable purity and finesse.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with premium sushi and sashimi, sea scallops, snow crab, lobster, delicate white fish, lightly grilled chicken, fresh oysters and subtle Japanese appetizers.

Tasting Notes: An elegant and aromatic Junmai Daiginjo with ripe melon, delicate orchard fruit, gentle rice sweetness and a refined balance of fruit, acidity and umami.

Nose: Inviting aromas of ripe melon, delicate white blossoms and fresh pear, accompanied by subtle sweet rice nuances.

Palate: Silky and rounded, with soft melon sweetness, delicate fruit character, gentle umami and a beautifully balanced, luxurious texture.

Finish: Clean, graceful and lingering, with soft fruit sweetness and refreshing clarity.

hundred-acre-dark-ark-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Hundred Acre Ark Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
hundred-acre-dark-ark-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Stunning with a deep garnet color and aromas of blueberry pie and baked plums layered with savory notes of grilled meats, roasted lamb and tilled earth. The full-bodied palate has opulent black fruit with a firm, velvety body that finishes long and fresh.

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Ark Vineyard features beguiling scents of Montreal-style smoked meat backed by waves of black cherries and cassis. It's full-bodied, rich, plush and expansive on the palate, captivating for its mix of savory and fruity flavors. Offering tons of fun in the glass, this finishes long and tannic but also smoothly silky. It's a complete wine by any measure.

togouchi-single-malt.title: Togouchi Single Malt Japanese Whisky
togouchi-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Togouchi Single Malt Japanese Whisky is the flagship single malt of Sakurao Distillery, located in the Hiroshima region of Japan, and the distillery's first single malt release. According to the producer it is matured for three years in a combination of bourbon and sherry casks, giving a rounded, gentle whisky with nutty and sweet-spiced character. Distilled and bottled at Sakurao, it is presented at 43% ABV in a 700ml bottle with a gift box, and its approachable profile makes it a good introduction to Japanese single malt.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla, apple, orange marmalade, nuts and sweet spice.

Nose: Fresh, with vanilla, apple and orange marmalade.

Palate: Rounded and sweet, with nuts and sugar.

Finish: Bright and short, with sweet spices and ginger.

Serve: Neat, with a drop of water, or over ice.

coors-seltzer-orange-cream-pop.title: Vizzy Cream Pop Variety 12 Cans
coors-seltzer-orange-cream-pop.bodyHtml:
Vizzy Cream Pop Variety 12 Cans is a nostalgic, fruit-and-cream inspired hard seltzer variety pack produced by Molson Coors under the Vizzy Hard Seltzer line. Crafted with sparkling water and a fermented malt base, this 12-can variety pack includes three distinct ice-pop-inspired flavors: Orange Cream Pop (sweet orange blended with creamy vanilla), Strawberry Cream Pop (juicy strawberries with a luscious cream finish), and Raspberry Cream Pop (tart raspberries balanced with smooth velvety cream notes). Each expression delivers a light, sparkling, and easy-drinking body with a nostalgic blend of sweet fruit and rich vanilla cream notes.

Food Pairing: Fresh fruit tarts, vanilla ice cream, fish tacos, grilled chicken skewers, or light summer salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear to faintly hued with active effervescence and a light, crisp, and refreshing mouthfeel across all three flavors.

Nose : Bright zesty citrus orange, sweet ripe strawberries, tart red raspberries, and prominent smooth vanilla cream aromas.

Palate : Crisp and effervescent featuring vibrant fruit flavors of orange, strawberry, and raspberry seamlessly balanced by sweet, velvety vanilla cream.

Finish : Clean, short, and refreshing with a crisp carbonated snap and lingering sweet fruit and smooth vanilla notes.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled straight from a cold can or poured over fresh ice in a tall glass.

babe-variety-pack.title: Georgian Bay Gin Cocktail Variety Pack 12 Cans

opus-one-2016.title: Opus One 2016 1.5L Magnum
opus-one-2016.bodyHtml:
The 2016 Opus One is remarkably elegant and bright offering sumptuous aromas of fresh red and blue fruit, baking spices and vanilla, and a delicate fragrance of spring florals. The initial bouquet is augmented by more nuanced notes of sage, rosemary, and black olive. Juicy flavors of black cherry, blackberry and cassis flood the palate and creamy, fine-grained tannins deliver a delightfully round structure. Harmonious and lively, the flavors linger to create an enduring finish with touches of dark chocolate and espresso.

99 Points - James Suckling

Fantastic aromas that are complex and complete with blackcurrants, blueberries and herbs, such as basil and bay leaf. But always subtle. Full-bodied yet linear and very refined with a very persistent finish. It shows drive and brightness. So refined at the end. Needs at least three to five years to come together.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2016 Opus One bursts from the glass with ripe blueberries, black cherry jam and crème de cassis with hints of violets, dark chocolate, cedar chest and cardamom, plus a touch of charcoal. Full-bodied, rich and concentrated, the palate delivers layer upon layer of opulent stewed black fruit with amazing tension and firm, ripe, fine-grained tannins, finishing long with a whole array of exotic spices coming through.

98 Points - Decanter
Love the juiciness of this, right off the bat, rich deep black cherry rippling with menthol and eucalyptus notes, and these beautiful floral aromatics that Opus gets in the best years. A very classic style, touches of baked vanilla, rosemary and olive. Harvest 9th September to 12th October (starting off slowly then speeding up as the heat rose). 1% Malbec, 8% Petit Verdot completes the blend, 17 days skin contact.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2016 Opus One is brilliant and shows yet again that 2016 was a magical vintage for Napa Valley. Based largely on Cabernet Sauvignon mixed with 8% each of Petit Verdot and Merlot, with 5% Cabernet Franc and a splash of Malbec, its deep purple hue is followed by a beautiful bouquet of black cherries, crème de cassis, and blueberry fruit intermixed with notions of cedary spice, toasty oak, graphite, and flowers. With an almost Bordeaux-like class and structure, this full-bodied beauty has no hard edges, plenty of ripe tannins, and is extraordinarily pure, elegant, and long. It can be drunk today (give it a healthy decant) or cellared for 2-3 decades. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator
A focused, restrained style, with a steady beam of fresh red and black currant preserve flavors, laced with bay leaf, cedar and tobacco notes. An iron edge pierces the finish, while the fruit keeps pace. A bit more classically backward than its Oakville peers, so tuck this away in the cellar. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Malbec. Best from 2020 through 2038.

opus-one-2015.title: Opus One 2015 750ml
opus-one-2015.bodyHtml:
The essence of time is expressed in Opus One by the character of each vintage. Place, often defined as terroir, represents the geography, the climate and the essential human element which is captured in the wine’s balance between power and finesse, structure and texture.

98 Points - James Suckling
Purity and brilliance on the nose with so much currant and flower character. Roses, currant bush and fresh leaves, too. Brightness is the word that comes to mind. Full-bodied and broad-shouldered. Juicy and so gorgeous now. Balance is so wonderful here. All about harmonious fruit and tannin balance. I like it slightly better than the excellent 2014. 81% cabernet sauvignon, 4% petit verdot, 7% cabernet franc, 6% merlot and 2% malbec. Drink or hold.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
“This wine was too much—too much like a caricature for me,” winemaker Michael Silacci confessed to me while tasting the 2015 Opus One together again recently. “So, when we took it out of barrel to prepare for bottling we added a few more components.” Medium to deep garnet-purple color, it bursts from the glass with beautiful violets, lavender, rose hip tea and chocolate-covered cherries scents over a core of crushed blackberries, black cherries, cassis and iron ore. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is wonderfully bright and crunchy, with bags of fresh black and red berries and a wonderfully plush, finely grained texture, finishing long and fragrant

93 Points - Wine Spectator
Pure, rich dark berry, plum and gravelly earth flavors are framed by spicy, cedary oak notes, ending long, clean and elegant, with just the right touch of tannins. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Malbec. Best from 2020 through 2030.

opus-one-2014.title: Opus One 2014 750ml
opus-one-2014.bodyHtml:
The 2014 Opus One exudes subtle aromas of fragrant florals, fresh garden herbs, and forest floor that give way to a concentrated blend of red cherry, blackberry, and black currant. Fine-grained tannins offer a velvety texture and complex structure that builds to a long, vibrantly fresh finish with a touch of mocha. Enjoyable now, the wine will delight for years to come.
97 Points - James Suckling
Mesmerizing aromas of flowers, bark, currants and blackberries. So perfumed. You just want to smell it. Exquisite tension and finesse with an almost Burgundian texture, yet it’s Napa in its soul with ripe fruit, stones, spices and Chinese tea leaf flavors. Savory and delicious. Drinkable but better in 2020.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet colored, the 2014 Opus One opens with youthful notes of warm blackberries, chocolate-covered cherries, redcurrant jelly and blackcurrant pastilles with hints of bay leaves, tobacco leaf and underbrush. Medium to full-bodied, firm and grainy with a lively backbone and tightly wound black and red berry layers, it finishes with a compelling herbal lift.

93 Points - Wine Spectator
Youthfully packed, featuring currant and cherry paste notes balled up at the core, while savory, menthol and sage flavors stay buried in the background. Offers a singed alder frame, with a telltale cast iron bolt emerging at the very end. This still has a ways to go before peaking. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Malbec. Non-blind Opus One vertical. Best from 2027 through 2036. 27,000 cases made.

93 Points - Decanter
A cool bouquet of fruit compote and wild plum mingles with notes of clove, incense and lilac. On the palate the wine is youthfully taut, with a good line of acidity and fine but assertive tannins. It's quite a serious, savoury Opus which will need a few years in the cellar to unwind.

opus-one-2017.title: Opus One Overture 2022
opus-one-2017.bodyHtml:
A luxurious Napa Valley red blend layered with aromas of blackberry, cassis, violet, and cedar. The palate reveals rich dark fruit, cocoa, graphite, and baking spice balanced by velvety tannins and vibrant acidity. Elegant and refined, this wine delivers exceptional depth, structure, and complexity beautifully.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with filet mignon, braised short ribs, roast lamb, truffle pasta, aged gouda, wild mushroom dishes, or herb-crusted beef tenderloin.

 

94 Points - Decanter

Gorgeous Cabernet aromas, clear and crystalline, some herbal notes with a cool blueberry and chalky element. Rose scents, dark cherries and cinnamon bark. Full and expressive, warming tones but great acidity that gives such lift. Lovely purity and drive, this has a great sense of confidence - nothing overdone, really pristine and finessed. If anything it’s not super heavy, but it’s the better for it. You get the Napa richness in the fruit concentration but it’s so well defined and still with a graceful power. Yum. 0.5% Petit Verdot completes the blend.

chum-churum-original-soju-2.title: Chum Churum Original Soju
chum-churum-original-soju-2.bodyHtml:
Chum Churum Original Soju is the brand's original soju, bottled at 16.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Chum Churum (Cheoeumcheoreom, 'like the first time') is a soju brand of Lotte Chilsung Beverage, launched in 2006 and made with alkaline water, which the brand credits for its smoothness. Clear, light-bodied and velvety, it is a classic partner for Korean barbecue and spicy dishes.

Serve: Well chilled, neat in a shot glass or over ice.

meukow-xo-with-gift-box.title: Meukow XO Cognac
meukow-xo-with-gift-box.bodyHtml: Meukow XO is the fruit of the blend that combines the power of the tannins brought by the long ageing in oak wood barrels and the delicacy of Grande and Petite Champagne eaux-de-vie with the sweetness of Fins and Bons Bois eaux-de-vie.

last-drop-colin-scott.title: The Last Drop Colin Scott
last-drop-colin-scott.bodyHtml:
Created by Master Blender Colin JP Scott, this release, just the 22nd since the company was founded in 2008, is The Last Drop’s inaugural Signature Blend, marking their first foray into the creation, as well as curation, of remarkable spirits.

This unique and unrepeatable blended Scotch Whisky, limited to just 500 bottles worldwide, bears not just the physical signature but all the stylistic expression of one of the great architects of the world of blended Scotch Whisky.

Colin Scott joined The Last Drop as their Master Blender after a long and distinguished career at Chivas Brothers, where as Master Blender he created the iconic Chivas Regal 18 Year Old, alongside the original founders of The Last Drop.

longmorn-2008-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Longmorn 2008 11 Year Old 56.6% ABV
longmorn-2008-twa.bodyHtml:
This Longmorn 11 Year Old is a Speyside single malt Scotch distilled in 2008 and matured for 11 years in a single ex-bourbon barrel, then bottled by The Whisky Agency at a powerful 56.6% ABV. A one-off single cask, best explored slowly. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

vallein-tercinicer-lot-66-petite-champag.title: Vallein Tercinier Lot 66 1966 Petite Champagne Cognac
vallein-tercinicer-lot-66-petite-champag.bodyHtml:
Vallein Tercinier Lot 66 is a single cask of 1966 Petite Champagne Cognac, aged 56 years in French oak cask F151 and bottled brut de fût in 2022 at 49.7% ABV. Just 287 bottles were filled, with natural colour and no chill filtration.

Tasting Notes: spice, gingerbread, orange, liquorice, plum and saffron.

Nose: Complex and elegant, with spice, cardamom and fennel, then gingerbread, macerated orange and exotic fruit.

Palate: Powerful, with liquorice and bitter cocoa giving way to plum, dried fruit and ripe pear, balanced by gentle rancio and saffron.

Finish: Long and peppery, ending on old port.

Serve: Neat in a tulip glass at room temperature; add a drop of water to open it up if you like.

ole-smoky-hunch-punch.title: Ole Smoky Hunch Punch Lightnin' Moonshine
ole-smoky-hunch-punch.bodyHtml:
A dangerously drinkable homage to the legendary, fruit-fueled party punches of college tailgates and backyard barbecues! Ole Smoky Hunch Punch Lightnin' takes its inspiration from the classic Southern tradition of mixing strong white lightning with a massive array of fruit juices. To create this vibrant concoction, they blend their smooth, high-quality corn whiskey with a proprietary mix of fresh orange, pineapple, and cherry juices.

Bottled at a formidable 80 proof (40% ABV), it drinks incredibly easy despite its high alcohol content. The palate hits with an aggressive, sweet wave of tropical fruit punch, juicy citrus, and tart cherry, completely masking the harsh burn of the moonshine beneath it. It is ready to pour straight over ice for an instant party, or can be topped off with lemon-lime soda for a dangerously refreshing summer cocktail.

bavaria-86-original.title: Bavaria 86 Original 4 Tall Cans
bavaria-86-original.bodyHtml:
A strong bottom-fermented beer made from the finest barley from our own malt house. Full-bodied with a rich palate. 8.6 Original has a fruity taste due to its special fermentation recipe.

A refreshing and clear blonde beer, with a high alcohol content and rich flavour.

One sip and your taste buds will immediately spring into action. 8.6 Original is the ultimate beer for strong personalities!

agavero-orange-liqueur.title: Patron Citronge Orange Liqueur
agavero-orange-liqueur.bodyHtml: PATRÓN CITRÓNGE ORANGE is a premium orange tequila liqueur delicately blended for a delightful and sophisticated taste profile. It is perfectly crafted with the finest Mexican oranges and PATRÓN's iconic 100% Blue Weber agave PATRÓN Tequila to elevate your super premium Margaritas.

koloa-spiced-rum.title: The Kraken Black Spiced Rum 1.75L
koloa-spiced-rum.bodyHtml:
The Kraken Black Spiced Rum is an iconic, deeply dark Caribbean spiced rum named after the mythical, colossal sea beast of maritime lore. Crafted from naturally sweet molasses-based rums distilled in Trinidad, this spirit is aged for up to two years before being infused with a secret blend of 13 exotic, aromatic spices. Packaged in its distinctive Victorian-style flagon bottle with dual handles, it delivers an intensely bold, sweet, and robustly spiced flavor profile that stands out dramatically in any cocktail.

Food Pairing: Barbecue pulled pork sliders, fiery Jamaican jerk chicken, dense gingerbread cake, or rich sticky toffee pudding.

TASTING NOTES Deep, opaque dark brown—almost black—in appearance with a heavy, unctuous, and highly coating mouthfeel.

NOSE Powerfully aromatic and sweet, bursting with heavy notes of dark chocolate, strong vanilla, molasses, and espresso, accented by spicy cloves, cinnamon, and ginger.

PALATE Bold, rich, and syrupy on the tongue, dominant with flavors of sweet molasses, vanilla bean, and cola, quickly followed by warming layers of black pepper, clove, allspice, and dark chocolate.

FINISH Long, sweet, and decidedly spicy with a lingering warmth of cinnamon, charred oak, and a punchy hit of clove.

SERVE Exceptional when paired with ginger beer and a lime wedge for a classic "Perfect Storm," or simply enjoyed over plenty of ice.

pol-roger-brut-vintage.title: Pol Roger Brut Vintage 2018
pol-roger-brut-vintage.bodyHtml:
Pol Roger Brut Vintage 2018 is an exceptionally structured, generous, and expressive vintage Champagne crafted from a traditional house blend of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay sourced from 20 illustrious Grand and Premier Cru vineyards across the Montagne de Reims and the Côte des Blancs. Displaying a beautiful pale yellow hue with bright silver highlights and an incredibly fine, persistent stream of microscopic bubbles, this elegant cuvée opens with an open and alluring bouquet of fresh pear, white peach, and orange zest, layered harmoniously alongside richer notes of pastry dough, fresh brioche, and a touch of exotic fruit. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied, muscular, and beautifully textural mouthfeel that seamlessly balances a core of rich, sweet orchard fruit against a succulent yet vibrant acidity and a lacy, refined mousse. Having spent six years maturing on its fine lees in the house's deep, cool subterranean chalk cellars in Épernay, it culminates in a remarkably long, enveloping, and polished finish defined by a clean, focused, and distinctively chalky, saline mineral edge.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with pan-seared chicken supreme with chanterelle mushrooms, roasted duck breast, capon with morel mushrooms, or butter-poached lobster tails.

94 Points - James Suckling

I like the berry fruit aromas mingling with bread crust, grapefruit and lemon pastries. It's lively on the palate, with excellent structure and a bright wild-berry character. Clean and nicely focused. 60% pinot noir and 40% chardonnay.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

From a year marked by above-average maturity—at least as of this writing—and a relatively early harvest that began on August 20th, Pol Roger’s 2018 Brut Vintage, disgorged in March 2024 with a dosage of seven grams per liter, offers a generous and expressive interpretation of this cuvée. Aromatically, it unfurls from the glass with notes of pear, peach, orange zest and pastry, with a touch of exotic fruit. On the palate, it is full-bodied, muscular and textural, with a core of rich, sweet fruit supported by succulent yet vibrant acidity, culminating in a long, enveloping finish. Stylistically, the 2018 vintage aligns more closely with the gourmand profiles of 2015 and 2012 rather than the more tensile 2016 or 2013. The cuvée is composed of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This sleek, mineral-driven Champagne has a lacy mousse and a smoky underpinning, with Meyer lemon peel–infused acidity driving an appealing range of flavors, including nectarine, macerated raspberry, saffron and crystallized honey, plus a touch of toasted brioche. Long and lively on the finish. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Drink now through 2035.

pol-roger-rose.title: Pol Roger Rose Vintage 2018
pol-roger-rose.bodyHtml:
Pol Roger Rosé Vintage 2018 is an exceptionally structured, intense, and deeply gastronomic vintage Champagne crafted only in years of outstanding ripeness. It is produced from a blend of 65% Pinot Noir and 35% Chardonnay drawn from approximately 20 Premier and Grand Cru vineyards across the Montagne de Reims and the Côte des Blancs. To achieve its lovely pale salmon color with delicate pink and golden hues, roughly 15% of still Pinot Noir from the famed crus of Bouzy, Ambonnay, and Cumières is vinified "en rouge" and added to the blend before the secondary fermentation. Undergoing careful malolactic fermentation and aged for over five years in the house’s deepest, coolest subterranean chalk cellars, the nose opens with an expressive basket of red berries, including fresh raspberry, redcurrant, and wild strawberry, intertwined with exotic nuances of mango, papaya, honeysuckle, and rose petals. On the palate, this full-bodied, vinous Champagne delivers a silky, mouth-filling texture where a succulent core of candied citrus, sour cherry, and light pastry notes is uplifted by a driving spine of crisp, refreshing acidity and an incredibly fine, velvety mousse, leading into a long, focused finish marked by a distinctively chalky, saline mineral edge.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled salmon, fresh tuna tartare, duck breast with cranberry reduction, assorted sushi, or a forced rhubarb fruit fool.

95 Points - James Suckling

This has fragrant aromas of strawberries, hibiscus, blood oranges and a hint of mint. Delightfully bright, concentrated and fruit-driven, with a medium body, tight bubbles and a long, mouthwatering and delicious finish. Dry. Pinot noir and chardonnay plus 16% red wine. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

There is still some youth in this Champagne. Its red fruits and balancing acidity and texture are finely poised, the wine showing its good percentage of Pinot Noir in the blend. It is already rich and will gradually move into greater maturity. Drink now for freshness or wait until at least 2026 for maturity.
93 Points - Wine Spectator
The core of black cherry and wild strawberry fruit is ripe and juicy in this harmonious rosé, enmeshed with accents of toasted brioche, red licorice, violet and pickled ginger. Shows fine, raw silk–like texture and a frame of deftly honed acidity, with a minerally underpinning driving the finish. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Disgorged March 2023. Drink now through 2035. 
92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Generous and demonstrative, shaped by the warm, early-ripening growing season, Pol Roger's 2018 Brut Rosé, disgorged in July 2024 with a dosage of eight grams per liter, bursts from the glass with a pretty bouquet of raspberry, cranberry and rose water, mingling with brioche and honeysuckle. On the palate, it reveals a full-bodied, broad-shouldered and textural profile, structured and vibrant, boasting a dense core of luscious fruit. A pillowy mousse and ripe yet lively acidity lend energy, guiding it toward a long, perfumed finish. Comprising 65% Pinot Noir and 35% Chardonnay, this is a gastronomic rosé Champagne, built to age gracefully and pair beautifully with dishes such as red meat or tuna.

pol-roger-blanc-de-chardonnay.title: Pol Roger Blanc de Blancs Vintage 2015
pol-roger-blanc-de-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Pol Roger Blanc de Blancs Vintage 2015 is an exceptionally elegant, precise, and beautifully textured vintage Champagne crafted exclusively from 100% Grand Cru Chardonnay vineyards across the prestigious Côte des Blancs, including Avize, Chouilly, Cramant, Oiry, and Oger. Displaying a pale gold hue with shimmering green highlights and a steady trail of microscopic bubbles, this expressive sparkling wine opens with a powerful bouquet of lemon zest, fresh green apple, and Asian pear, layered beautifully with rich undertones of warm brioche, hazelnut liqueur, and fresh butter. On the palate, it reveals a full-bodied, vinous structure wrapped in a creamy, velvety mousse. A fleshy core of orchard fruit is enlivened by a vibrant line of natural acidity, seamlessly building depth and tension before tapering into a remarkably long, polished finish anchored by a distinctively chalky, salty mineral edge.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with freshly shucked oysters, pan-seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster tails, or a delicate citrus-dressed crab salad.

94 Points - James Suckling

So much bread dough on the nose, together with green-apple and pear undertones that follow through to a full body with soft, creamy tannins and a long, flavorful finish. Subtle and polished. Drink now.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Sleek and minerally, this elegant Champagne is crisply lacy in texture, with notes of Asian pear, lemon preserves, salted almond and white blossoms that are lightly honeyed and juicy throughout. Shows good drive on the firm, lingering finish. Drink now

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Pure Chardonnay given a rich treatment has resulted in a Champagne that is now mature. The wine is ripe, its mineral edge fully integrated into the white fruit flavors. It is well ready for drinking.

93 Points, Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

After the pillowy, chiseled 2013, Pol Roger's 2015 Brut Blanc de Blancs is cut from richer, broader cloth. Offering up aromas of crisp golden orchard fruit, white flowers and subtle hints of warm biscuits, it's full-bodied, broad and vinous, with a fleshy core of fruit, lively acids and a precise, chalky finish. In style, it's reminiscent of a somewhat more sun-kissed version of the 2012 rendition.

titos-handmade-vodka-3.title: Tito's Handmade Vodka 375ml
titos-handmade-vodka-3.bodyHtml:
Tito's Handmade Vodka is a premium American vodka produced in Austin, Texas, by Fifth Generation, Inc. at the Mockingbird Distillery. Founded in 1997 by Tito Beveridge, it is micro-distilled six times in traditional copper pot stills from a 100% yellow corn mashbill, resulting in an unaged, naturally gluten-free spirit renowned for its smooth texture and subtle corn sweetness.

Food Pairing: Fresh seafood (such as oysters and shrimp cocktail), smoked salmon, cured meats, light salads, caviar, and citrus-infused poultry dishes.

Tasting Notes - A crystal-clear spirit with a smooth, slightly creamy mouthfeel.

Nose - Light and clean, featuring subtle hints of sweet corn, soft grain, and gentle citrus.

Palate - Exceptionally smooth and clean with a mild sweetness from the corn base, accompanied by subtle notes of black pepper, roasted grain, and light vanilla.

Finish - Clean, crisp, and warm with a lingering smoothness and a subtle sweet grain note.

Serve - Serve chilled, on the rocks, straight from the freezer as a shot, or mixed into cocktails such as a Moscow Mule, Bloody Mary, or Vodka Soda.

darisiti-xtabentun-liqueur.title: D'Aristi Xtabentun Honey & Anise Liqueur
darisiti-xtabentun-liqueur.bodyHtml:
D'Aristi Xtabentún is the signature honey and anise liqueur of Casa D'Aristi, a liqueur house based in Mérida in Mexico's Yucatán peninsula, which has worked to its original recipe since 1935. The producer traces Xtabentún back to balché, a sacred drink taken during Mayan ceremonies, combined with anise, which the Spanish brought to Mexico. The result is a sweet, aromatic liqueur that the house calls its legacy product and that remains closely tied to Yucatecan culture.
