This bottling is presented at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle, with a pale golden-green colour and a label illustrating a Mayan offering scene. Expect honeyed sweetness carried by a clear, fragrant anise character, making it a natural after-dinner sip or a distinctive accent in coffee and cocktails.

Serve: Chilled or over ice as a digestif, or in coffee and cocktails.

shin-premium-yuzu-wine.title: Shin Premium Yuzu Wine 720ml
shin-premium-yuzu-wine.bodyHtml: SHIN Premium Yuzu Wine uses fresh premium yuzu fruit grown in the famous region called Katsuragi in Japan. Yuzu (aka. citrus Junos) is a rare hybrid citrus fruit popular in Japan for centuries and has been historically cultivated as herbal remedy. The wine’s aroma and flavor offer a rare and complex blend of lime, lemon, grapefruit, and mandarin orange with tangy acidity that is perfect for seafood or served as a dessert wine. Asahara Brewery Co., Ltd. is located in Moroyama, Saitama Prefecture of Japan, and has been famous for cultivating Katsuragi yuzu, one of Japan’s distinctive spiciness of citrus, since the Nara period. SHIN Yuzu wine uses natural squeezed juice from fresh Katsuragi yuzu, brings out the fragrant and refreshing overtones of citrus, as well as the mellow sweetness of the zest. This product does not contain any preservation or artificial colors. Enjoy the natural flavor. Suitable to drink neat or with ice, soda, sparkling water or in cocktails.

tracy-mademoiselle-de-t-pouilly-fume.title: Chateau De Tracy Mademoiselle De T Pouilly Fume
tracy-mademoiselle-de-t-pouilly-fume.bodyHtml:
Chateau De Tracy Mademoiselle De T Pouilly Fume pours a brilliant, pale straw-yellow color with vibrant shimmering silvery and green highlights. The nose is remarkably expressive and aromatically complex, revealing an intense bouquet of crisp lime juice, fresh grapefruit, passion fruit, and white peach. These fruit profiles are beautifully layered with delicate herbal notes of boxwood, anise, and a hallmark flinty, smoky minerality. On the palate, this exceptional Sauvignon Blanc delivers a lively and straightforward attack with a wonderfully textured, medium-bodied mouthfeel. Energetic mountain acidity seamlessly wraps around succulent layers of citrus zest and green apple, culminating in a clean, refreshing, and persistent finish characterized by a precise, wet-stone salinity.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with fresh oysters, pan-seared sea bass, grilled shrimp risotto, warm goat cheese salads, ceviche, and delicate sushi dishes.

gibsons-bold-8-year-old-whisky.title: Gibson's Finest Bold 8 Year Old Whisky 1L
gibsons-bold-8-year-old-whisky.bodyHtml:
Gibson's Finest Bold 8 Year Old is a full-bodied Canadian whisky, matured and bottled in Ontario, that is aged longer and bottled at a higher strength than the classic range: 46% ABV, or 92 proof. Eight years in barrel build a deep flavour with strong vanilla aromas, and the extra strength helps it stand out in mixed drinks. It is blended to pair with cola, while also performing well neat or on ice. This is the 1L bottle.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla, maple and oak with a bold rye character.

Nose: Vibrant vanilla sweetness, light maple and delicate oak, with hints of fruit and spice.

Palate: Rich and sweet, with a bold, rich rye character.

Finish: Full-bodied, with lingering sweetness and a long finish.

Serve: With cola over ice and a lime wedge, or in an Old Fashioned.

carneros-springs-napa-cabernet.title: Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
carneros-springs-napa-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 pours an opaque, deep purple-ruby color with brilliant violet edges in the glass. Sourced from a diverse palette of eight premium Napa Valley sub-appellations, this expressive Cabernet Sauvignon represents the Wagner family's iconic signature style of opulent fruit density and supple tannic structural power. The highly fragrant bouquet opens with lush aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis paste, and black cherry compote, intricately layered with secondary notes of cocoa powder, espresso bean, warm baking spices, and fine toasted cedarwood. On the palate, the wine delivers a full-bodied, texturally luxurious mouthfeel framed by incredibly soft, fine-grained tannins that eliminate any youthfully bitter edges. A dense mid-palate of concentrated dark orchard fruits and mocha flows seamlessly alongside well-balanced acidity, carrying outstanding weight into a long, satisfyingly plush finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with prime grilled ribeye steak with rosemary butter, slow-braised beef short ribs, or an artisanal board of aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

mezcal-agua-santa-espadin-1.title: Agua Santa Espadin Joven Mezcal
mezcal-agua-santa-espadin-1.bodyHtml: Agua Santa Angustifolia is made with maguey Espadin (agave Angustifolia) in “The Mezcal Capital of the World” Santiago Matatlan, Oaxaca. The agaves are cooked in an underground pit oven with Oak and Pine wood. Once cooked, they are milled by horse-drawn tahona, and fermented with open-air, naturally occurring yeasts. They are then double distilled in copper pot stills. 42%ABV

ole-smoky-moonshine-peaches.title: Ole Smoky Moonshine Peaches
ole-smoky-moonshine-peaches.bodyHtml:
Ole Smoky Moonshine Peaches is a famously sweet and fruit-forward Southern spirit that features real, succulent peach slices soaked directly in Ole Smoky's signature White Lightnin' corn moonshine. Produced in Gatlinburg, Tennessee, at the gateway to the Great Smoky Mountains, this 65-proof expression relies on the natural infusion of actual fruit rather than just artificial flavorings. The result is a highly versatile, dessert-like moonshine that perfectly bridges the gap between a fruit liqueur and a traditional corn whiskey.

Food Pairing: Vanilla bean ice cream, traditional peach cobbler, grilled pork chops, pulled pork sandwiches, and sharp cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Golden and viscous in appearance, featuring real peach slices floating within the jar, delivering a juicy, sweet, and syrupy mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh, ripe peaches and jammy stone fruit aromas arrive immediately, joined by a soft, sweet corn character and subtle vanilla from the moonshine base.

Palate : Boldly sweet and juicy, offering prominent flavors of freshly sliced peaches and sweet syrup, backed by a mild corn grain structure and a touch of warm brown sugar without any harsh alcohol bite.

Finish : Clean, fruity, and refreshing, leaving a lingering, sticky peach sweetness that tapers off gently.

Serve : Serve the infused peaches straight from the jar with a fork, spoon the liquid and fruit over vanilla ice cream, or mix the moonshine into iced tea, lemonade, or a ginger beer mule.

navy-island-navy-strength-rum-57-00-abv.title: Navy Island Navy Strength Rum
navy-island-navy-strength-rum-57-00-abv.bodyHtml:
Navy Island Navy Strength is a Jamaican rum made entirely in pot stills, blended from 11 small-batch rums of various ages and bottled at navy strength, 57% ABV, in a 700ml bottle. The brand is run by the Navy Island Rum Company of Amsterdam. Deep amber in colour, it is a high-ester, full-bodied and heavy style of rum, intensely aromatic and distinctly funky. It won a Silver Medal at the International Wine & Spirit Competition (IWSC) 2019 and is presented in a cylindrical gift case.

Tasting Notes: Ripe fruits and banana with hints of vanilla; deep and well balanced.

Finish: Long.

Serve: Neat or on the rocks, or in a Mai Tai with lime juice, dry orange curaçao and orgeat.

alfred-giraud-harmonie-french-malt-whisk.title: Ardbeg Uigeadail
alfred-giraud-harmonie-french-malt-whisk.bodyHtml:
Uigeadail (pronounced ‘Oog-a-dal’) is Gaelic for “a dark, mysterious place.”

Named after the distillery’s water source, this whisky is a marriage of sweetness, spice and deep smokiness. The peat-laden waters of Loch Uigeadail provide the smoky tones in this whisky, while maturation in ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks imparts rich, warm flavours – perfect for a dramatic, stormy night.

But the true secret behind Ardbeg Uigeadail's success? A unique vatting method that marries the deep, smoky notes from ex-bourbon American oak with the luscious, raisin-like character of ex-sherry Oloroso casks.

Non chill-filtered.

koloa-cacao-rum.title: Distillerie Arsenal Coco Explorentum Rum
koloa-cacao-rum.bodyHtml:
Coco Explorentum is a flavoured rum from Distillerie Arsenal & Co., a Quebec distillery whose Explorentum series takes its rums on themed journeys around the world, with spiced editions inspired by Spain and Japan. It is bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle, a lighter strength suited to easy tropical-style drinks.

Serve: Over ice, with pineapple juice, or in a coconut daiquiri.

laura-secord-chocolate-liquor.title: Poli Ciok Cocoa Liqueur
laura-secord-chocolate-liquor.bodyHtml:
Poli Ciok Cocoa Liqueur is a rich, dark, and extraordinarily indulgent Italian chocolate liqueur crafted by the historic Poli Distillerie in Schiavon, Veneto. Made according to a traditional family recipe, this premium liqueur infuses high-quality cocoa powder with a pure spirit base and sugar, completely avoiding any dairy or cream elements. This specific approach results in an intensely deep, dark chocolate profile that drinks like a liquid dessert. The spirit showcases a velvety, dense texture that is packed with natural cocoa bitterness and balanced by a refined sweetness, capturing the true, unadulterated essence of fine dark chocolate.

Food Pairing: The deep, unctuous dark chocolate profile of this liqueur makes it a natural partner for sweet, rich desserts. It pairs exquisitely with classic Italian treats like tiramisu, biscotti, almond cantucci, and panettone. It also serves as a flawless companion to vanilla bean gelato, fresh raspberries or strawberries, and orange-infused tarts, or it can be enjoyed alongside a selection of aged cheeses like a sharp Parmigiano-Reggiano or blue cheese.

TASTING NOTES - A dense, opaque, deep dark mahogany brown. The texture is full-bodied, rich, and heavily viscous, coating the palate in a velvety, luxurious layer of liquid chocolate without being overly syrupy.

NOSE - Intensely fragrant and deeply comforting, opening with upfront aromas of premium roasted cocoa beans, dark chocolate fudge, and hints of warm brownie batter, backed by a subtle touch of vanilla bean.

PALATE - Bold, decadent, and beautifully balanced. Strong flavors of bitter dark cocoa and sweet milk chocolate seamlessly coat the mouth, perfectly harmonized by a natural sweetness that avoids being cloying, thanks to the natural bitterness of the cocoa.

FINISH - Long, warm, and highly memorable. The heavy chocolate coating slowly recedes, leaving a comforting, long-lasting aftertaste of rich dark cocoa powder and a soft, delicate spirit warmth.

SERVE - Highly versatile. Best served slightly chilled or over ice in a small spirits snifter or a traditional tulip-shaped glass as an indulgent after-dinner digestif. It can also be poured directly over premium ice cream for a sophisticated dessert, or added to hot coffee or espresso for an elevated mocha experience.

grand-love-reposado-tequila.title: Grand Mayan Reposado Tequila
grand-love-reposado-tequila.bodyHtml: Grand Mayan's handcrafted Reposado Tequila is produced with the purest, central-highland Blue Agave with the highest standards of production. Aged in American and French oak casks for 6-8 months, Grand Mayan Reposado Tequila is smooth for sipping with notes of oak and chocolate.

la-gritona-tequila.title: La Gritona Reposado Tequila
la-gritona-tequila.bodyHtml: La Gritona Reposado Tequila is a subtle rested tequila distilled by Melly Barajas and her staff of women at her small distillery in Valle De Guadalupe, Jalisco (NOM 1533). Melly distills La Gritona only with agave that has matured, always with an age of between 8-10 years, and all of her piñas must originate in the iron-rich red soil of the local Jalisco highlands. These agave plants are cultivated at the height of their sugar production, near the end of the life cycle. They are put into ovens within 24 hours of trimming. La Gritona IS and ALWAYS has been additive-free.

garrison-brothers-single-barrel.title: Garrison Brothers Single Barrel Texas Straight Bourbon
garrison-brothers-single-barrel.bodyHtml:
A bold testament to the craftsmanship of Texas' first legal bourbon distillery. Made from a custom mash bill of Texas-grown organic corn, soft red winter wheat, and malted barley, each barrel is aged under the intense Texas sun for a minimum of three years. Because each single barrel is hand-selected by the Master Distiller, no two are exactly alike, but all deliver the deep, robust, and dark flavor profile that Garrison Brothers is famous for. Bottled at a sturdy 94 proof.

 

NOSE

Rich and complex with warm aromas of butterscotch, charred oak, vanilla, and dark red fruits.

PALATE

A rich, slightly syrupy mouthfeel bursting with flavors of sweet oak, smoky caramel, leather, and baking spices.

FINISH

Long, memorable, and warming with lingering notes of sweet vanilla and Texas oak.

strongbow-ultra-variety-pack.title: Strongbow Ultra Variety Pack 12 Cans
strongbow-ultra-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Strongbow Ultra Variety Pack 12 Cans is a refreshing cider assortment featuring three fruit-forward flavours from the iconic Strongbow brand. Crafted with apples and natural fruit flavours, this lighter-style collection includes Classic Apple, Dark Fruit, and Mango ciders. Each variety offers a distinctive combination of crisp apple character, juicy fruit, gentle sweetness, and refreshing carbonation. At 4.5% ABV, Strongbow Ultra provides a smooth, approachable drinking experience ideal for barbecues, summer gatherings, and casual entertaining.

eau-claire-flourish-vodka.title: Eau Claire Distillery Flourish Vodka
eau-claire-flourish-vodka.bodyHtml:
Eau Claire Distillery Flourish Vodka is a grain-distilled vodka from Eau Claire Distillery, Alberta's original craft distillery, based in Turner Valley about 30 minutes south of Calgary. Eau Claire grows and harvests its own barley, works some of its fields with draught horses, and draws water that flows from the Sheep River near Mount Rae, part of a farm-to-glass approach in which every small batch is personally tended. Flourish Vodka is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Chilled, over ice, or as the base for vodka cocktails.

romeos-gin-v.title: James Gin By James May London Drizzle JG.04 Gin
romeos-gin-v.bodyHtml:
James Gin London Drizzle JG.04 is an earthy British gin inspired by petrichor, the distinctive aroma created when rain hits warm pavement. Beetroot provides the foundation for this unusual character, joined by lovage, bay, orange and ginger to create lighter notes balanced by earthy botanical tones.

Food Pairing: Pair with roasted beetroot, herb-roasted chicken, grilled vegetables, or savoury charcuterie.

Tasting Notes: Atmospheric and earthy, combining lighter botanical notes with the distinctive earthy quality of beetroot and aromatic herbs.

Nose: Earthy and aromatic with beetroot, herbal lovage and bright orange character.

Palate: Beetroot provides earthy depth, balanced by lovage, bay and orange with warming ginger.

Finish: Earthy and botanical with lingering herbal and warming ginger character.

Serve: Enjoy with tonic over ice or use in botanical and citrus-forward gin cocktails.

ole-tequila-variety-pack.title: Ole Tequila Variety Pack 8 Cans
ole-tequila-variety-pack.bodyHtml: The Ole Tequila Variety Pack offers a mix of four premium tequila cocktails: Margarita, Paloma, Chili Mango, and Tequila Sunrise. Each can contains a blend of Tequila Blanco, real fruit juice, agave nectar, and a pinch of sea salt. The variety pack is gluten-free, vegan, and free from artificial colors, flavors, or sweeteners.

wayne-gretzky-founders-chardonnay.title: Wayne Gretzky Estates Chardonnay 2021
wayne-gretzky-founders-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Wayne Gretzky Estates Chardonnay 2021 pours a clear and bright straw yellow hue in the glass. The highly expressive, fruit-forward bouquet opens with appealing aromas of red apple, ripe Bartlett pear, and fresh pineapple, gracefully layered with delicate nuances of sweet baking spices, custard, and subtly integrated toasty oak. On the palate, this medium-bodied white wine delivers a smooth, slightly rich, and remarkably refreshing mouthfeel. A concentrated core of ripe tree fruits and juicy citrus unfolds across the palate, beautifully balanced by a clean line of crisp natural acidity. Having been barrel fermented and aged sur lie for 12 months in French oak barrels, its well-rounded texture carries persistent notes of orchard fruit, vanilla, and gentle spice into a dry, lingering finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with roasted chicken, herb-stuffed pork roast, smoked salmon risotto, cedar-plank salmon, or a creamy brie cheese served on fresh baguette.

lindemans-bin-85-pinot-grigio-3.title: Lindemans Bin 85 Pinot Grigio 750ml
lindemans-bin-85-pinot-grigio-3.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2015 vintage) "Every year I say the same thing about this wine but it is the truth – this is a well-made, fun to drink, grigio for the price. As fresh as it gets, this light, lean, northern Italian style grigio opens with bits of citrus fruit and honey. The attack mirrors the nose with round, citrus, watery, gulpable, grapefruit flavors. Good value in a clean, fresh, white wine for only $11. A super mid-week bargain. (Anthony Gismondi)." - 86/100, Gismondi on Wine

wolf-blass-gold-label-barossa-shiraz.title: Wolf Blass Gold Label Regional Reserve Shiraz 2018 750ml
wolf-blass-gold-label-barossa-shiraz.bodyHtml:
An intense and complex mix of blue fruits and dark red plums, with a hint of spice and delicate, well-integrated oak notes.

Blue fruits continue through to a rich, well-balanced palate with a plush mouthfeel, bright fruit flavours, and a long, even finish.

copper-moon-crisp-bright-1.title: Copper Moon Crisp & Bright 4L Bag In Box
copper-moon-crisp-bright-1.bodyHtml: Copper Moon Crisp & Bright 4L Bag In Box

cote-des-roses-pinot-noir-1.title: Gerard Bertrand Cote des Roses Pinot Noir 2022
cote-des-roses-pinot-noir-1.bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Côte des Roses Pinot Noir 2022 is an elegant, vibrant, and incredibly approachable red wine that beautifully expresses the sun-drenched yet balanced terroir of the South of France. Presented in an iconic glass bottle with its base intricately sculpted into the shape of a blooming rose, this pure, varietal Pinot Noir showcases a brilliant ruby-red hue. The bouquet is highly aromatic and inviting, revealing a luscious and complex tapestry of fresh red berries, wild strawberries, and morello cherries, accented by delicate floral notes and a subtle, refined touch of sweet baking spices and vanilla derived from careful maturation. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, silky, and wonderfully well-rounded, delivering a mouth-watering wave of juicy fruit flavors supported by smooth, perfectly integrated tannins. A vibrant mineral tension, influenced by the coastal Mediterranean breezes, carries through to a crisp, refreshing, and lingering finish, making this an exceptionally charming and versatile wine.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted poultry, vegetable couscous, grilled salmon, pan-seared calf’s liver, mushroom risotto, or an assortment of soft artisan cheeses.

lokoya-mt-veeder-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Lokoya Howell Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
lokoya-mt-veeder-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Traveling the road on an 1100cc American motorcycle with the engine’s low rumble and vibration under you, the wind in your face, and the feeling of power and acceleration in your grip—that’s how the 2018 Howell Mountain feels on the palate. With its low rumbling tannins, its depth of flavor, and its power-driven mouthfeel, you’ll be singing ‘Born to be Wild’ with each sip. This powerful Cabernet Sauvignon offers an ideal balance of acid and middle body weight.Blackberry, sourdough toast, crushed stone, and a little herb shine through in an intense depth of flavor.
96 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain was aged in French oak barrels for 22 months, 97% new. Deep garnet-purple colored, it rolls effortlessly out of the glass with notes of warm cassis, black cherries, mulberries and plum preserves plus hints of dark chocolate, crushed rock and tree bark with a waft of truffles. The full-bodied palate is densely laden with earthy/savory black fruit layers and super firm, rugged tannins, delivering a tightly wound, lively finish. Give it a good 5 years in bottle and drink it over the next 20+ years.
Rating: 96(+)

mi-terruno-uvas-syrah.title: Mi Terruno Uvas Syrah
mi-terruno-uvas-syrah.bodyHtml: This medium bodied Syrah has a nose reminiscent of red fruits and pepper with notes of dried figs. On the palate it’s smooth and sweet tannins are balanced with notable acidity.

mi-terruno-uvas-chardonnay.title: Mi Terruno Reserve Chardonnay
mi-terruno-uvas-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Toasty and flinty aromas to this ripe and tasty white, alongside apricots and pastries. It’s full-bodied, flavorful and balanced with a rounded texture and attractive pie-crust notes lingering.

partake-non-alcoholic-blonde-ale.title: Partake Non Alcoholic Blonde Ale 4 Cans

hipster-animal-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Hipster Animal Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 750ml
hipster-animal-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Hipster Animal Cabernet Sauvignon is a French red wine made by Domaine Navarre in the southern part of the country. The grapes are harvested from low-yielding vineyards in the Languedoc region, ensuring a consistent, high-quality product. The wine is handcrafted in a unique hipster style, utilizing natural methods, free of additives and preservatives. The wine has an intense ruby hue, with ample body and bright fruit flavors of cherry, raspberry, and sweet plums. Subtle oak notes, along with a hint of pepper, round out the palate. Soft tannins provide a smooth and savory finish, making this a great choice for pairing with roasted meats or rich cheeses. Hipster Animal Cabernet Sauvignon is a truly unique expression of French wines. Not only does this dry red offer exceptional quality, but it also has a certain cool attitude. The hipster label adds a unique flair, lending itself perfectly to a night out with friends or a small gathering. If you’re looking for a sophisticated and stylish yet approachable red wine, Hipster Animal Cabernet Sauvignon is just for you.

hipster-animal-sauvignon-blanc.title: Hipster Animal Sauvignon Blanc 2024 750ml
hipster-animal-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: Light to medium bodied. Fresh acidity. On the palate green apple, tropical notes, especially pineapple, a bit grassy. The citrus notes are subdued here which is a refreshing change.

lokoya-howell-mt-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: Lokoya Howell Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
lokoya-howell-mt-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
Traveling the road on an 1100cc American motorcycle with the engine’s low rumble and vibration under you, the wind in your face, and the feeling of power and acceleration in your grip—that’s how the 2018 Howell Mountain feels on the palate. With its low rumbling tannins, its depth of flavor, and its power-driven mouthfeel, you’ll be singing ‘Born to be Wild’ with each sip. This powerful Cabernet Sauvignon offers an ideal balance of acid and middle body weight.Blackberry, sourdough toast, crushed stone, and a little herb shine through in an intense depth of flavor.
96 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain was aged in French oak barrels for 22 months, 97% new. Deep garnet-purple colored, it rolls effortlessly out of the glass with notes of warm cassis, black cherries, mulberries and plum preserves plus hints of dark chocolate, crushed rock and tree bark with a waft of truffles. The full-bodied palate is densely laden with earthy/savory black fruit layers and super firm, rugged tannins, delivering a tightly wound, lively finish. Give it a good 5 years in bottle and drink it over the next 20+ years.
Rating: 96(+)

domaine-dugat-py-monthelie-tres-vieilles.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Monthelie Tres Vieilles Vignes 2023
domaine-dugat-py-monthelie-tres-vieilles.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Monthélie Très Vieilles Vignes 2023 is a remarkably concentrated and graceful red Burgundy sourced from old-vines planted across choice plots in the Côte de Beaune (historically acquired from Domaine Newman). Grown on gravelly limestone soils covered with red clay and marl, this 100% Pinot Noir reflects the domain's evolving, less interventionist style under Loïc Dugat-Py. To handle the sun-kissed 2023 vintage, the wine is crafted with a high proportion of whole-cluster fermentation and an integrated aging regime of 16 to 18 months in oak barrels (30% new), bottled entirely unfined and unfiltered. In the glass, it shows a bright ruby hue, opening with a highly expressive and perfumed nose of ripe redberries, wild pomegranate, and black plums, seamlessly laced with subtle hints of cracked black pepper, forest floor, and damp stone minerality. The palate is medium-bodied and beautifully clear, displaying a velvety texture with fine, digestively smooth tannins and a refreshing core of natural acidity that drives a persistent, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Roast duck, beef bourguignon, wild mushroom risotto, or mild semi-hard cheeses like Comté.

domaine-dugat-py-bourgogne-cuvee-halinar.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Cuvee Coeur de Roy Tres Vieilles Vignes 2022
domaine-dugat-py-bourgogne-cuvee-halinar.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Gevrey-Chambertin Cuvée Coeur de Roy Très Vieilles Vignes 2022 is a stunning, deeply concentrated village-level wine produced from parcels of ancient vines ranging from 50 to nearly 100 years old. Reflecting the modern evolution of the domain under Loïc Dugat-Py, the 2022 vintage shifts beautifully away from historical over-extraction, utilizing 50% whole-cluster fermentation and a dialed-back 40% new French oak regime. In the glass, it shows a bright, glossy ruby profile. The aromatics are perfumed and forward, delivering vivid layers of fresh strawberry, pomegranate, and dark cherries intermingled with hints of rose petals, cracked pepper, and subtle forest floor. On the palate, it balances intense, old-vine fruit density with an ethereal, lithe texture, supported by seamless, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant core of natural acidity that carries into a long, beautifully balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté cheese.

92 Points - Wine Advocate

Tasted from a bottle that saw fully 24 months' élevage (which will be indicated on the label), the 2022 Gevrey-Chambertin Coeur du Roy is much more civilized than it was from barrel, offering up a pretty bouquet of red berries, plums and orange rind mingled with rose petals and incense. Medium to full-bodied, succulent and seamless, with integrated tannins and a lively, harmonious profile, it will offer a broader drinking window than I had originally anticipated.

crozes-hermitage.title: Francois Villard Crozes Hermitage Cour de Recre Blanc
crozes-hermitage.bodyHtml:
François Villard Crozes-Hermitage Cour de Récré is a French Northern Rhône white wine crafted from Marsanne with a small portion of Roussanne. This elegant cuvée showcases aromas of citrus, apricot, peach, and exotic fruit, with a refined palate featuring rich texture, fine minerality, balanced acidity, creamy notes, and a persistent finish. 

Food Pairing: Grilled fish, roasted seafood, scallops, lobster, poultry, hard cheeses, cured meats, and refined Rhône-inspired cuisine.

imperial-22-year-old-smos-1998.title: The Single Malts of Scotland Imperial 22 Year Old 1998 Cask #103317
imperial-22-year-old-smos-1998.bodyHtml:
Imperial 22 Year Old 1998 is a single cask Speyside single malt from Elixir Distillers' The Single Malts of Scotland series. Distilled at Imperial Distillery on 2 October 1998, it matured for 22 years in ex-bourbon barrel #103317 before bottling on 24 June 2021 at a natural cask strength of 54.1% ABV. The cask yielded just 191 bottles of 700ml, released as an exclusive single cask.

Tasting Notes: Waxy and fruit-laden, with honey, tropical fruit and baking spice.

Nose: Fruity, waxy and floral, with fruit gums, beeswax, honey, marshmallow, baking spice and tropical fruit.

Palate: Rich and fruity, with crème caramel, honey, toasted marshmallow and tropical fruit, darkening towards dark chocolate.

Finish: Rich, waxy and coating, with toasted oak, baking spice, fruit and honey.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

deanston-12-year-old-smos-2008-cask-180.title: The Single Malts of Scotland Deanston 12 Year Old 2008 Cask 180 56.9% ABV
deanston-12-year-old-smos-2008-cask-180.bodyHtml:
This Deanston 2008 comes from The Single Malts of Scotland range, bottled by the independent firm Elixir Distillers. Distilled in 2008 at Deanston in the Scottish Highlands and drawn from cask number 180, it is bottled at 56.9% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Deanston itself is known for unpeated malt from locally sourced Highland barley and a distinctly waxy spirit, which makes a bottling like this a good way to taste the distillery outside its own core range.

Serve: Neat first, then with a few drops of water to open it up at this strength.

domaine-carneros-cuvee-brut.title: Domaine Carneros Brut 2020
domaine-carneros-cuvee-brut.bodyHtml:
Domaine Carneros Brut 2020 is a sophisticated and lively sparkling wine that embodies the signature style of this Taittinger-founded estate. Crafted primarily from Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this vintage reflects a challenging growing season defined by low yields and concentrated, complex fruit. The nose offers an inviting bouquet of pear, green apple, and citrus zest, underpinned by delicate, toasty notes of brioche and baked apple gained from a minimum of three years of aging on the lees. On the palate, it is sleek and elegant, featuring a fine mousse and a persistent finish with nuances of key lime pie and roasted nuts.


93 Points - Wine Spectator

Plush and round, offering sumptuous cherry and pear flavors laced with creme brulee and roasted nuts, this builds richness to the rich finish. Drink now.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Flavors of crisp green apple, fennel and toasted biscuit with a squeeze of lemon fill the palate with pleasing texture through a long and vibrant finish.

domaine-faiveley-bourgogne-chardonny.title: Faiveley Bourgogne Chardonnay 2022
domaine-faiveley-bourgogne-chardonny.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Domaine Faiveley Bourgogne Chardonnay is a brilliant and expressive white Burgundy that benefits from a warm and generous vintage. It presents a clear, pale gold colour and opens with an inviting bouquet of white flowers, ripe peach, and Meyer lemon, complemented by a subtle touch of toasted hazelnut from its time in French oak. On the palate, the wine is beautifully balanced, combining a round, fleshy texture with a vibrant mineral backbone and crisp acidity. The finish is clean and persistent, offering great purity of fruit. This wine serves as an excellent introduction to the Faiveley style, delivering village-level quality and elegance in a more approachable regional bottling.

91 Points - James Suckling

Brimming with candied lemon and fresh pomelo aromas. Very attractive interplay of discrete fruit, flinty character and fine tannins on the quite sleek, medium-bodied palate. Remarkable mineral character in the finish for the humble appellation. A cuvee that is half from domaine vineyards in the Cote Chalonnais and half from the Cote d'Or. Matured primarily in oak casks, plus a smaller part in stainless steel. Drink now.

deadeye-red-blend.title: Provenance Vineyards Deadeye Red 2018
deadeye-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Provenance Vineyards Deadeye Red 2018 pours a deep, concentrated purple-ruby color in the glass. The nose is remarkably expressive, opening with intense aromas of ripe blackcurrant, stewed blackberry, mint chocolate, and mocha, accented by subtle nuances of charred bark and baking spice. On the palate, this full-bodied Napa Valley red blend showcases an opulent, mouthfilling texture with round, sleek tannins and excellent balance. Deliciously chewy and plush, it delivers layers of ripe black cherry, bitter chocolate, and dark berry flavors that drive into a long, polished, and beautifully structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-crusted roasted lamb chops, or a rich wild mushroom ragù.

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripe-blackcurrant, stewed-blackberry, mint-chocolate, charred-bark and mocha aromas. It’s full-bodied with round, sleek tannins. Intense bitter-chocolate and dark-berry notes on the finish.

isle-of-jura-1998-21-year-old-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Isle Of Jura 1998 21 Year Old 49.2% ABV
isle-of-jura-1998-21-year-old-twa.bodyHtml:
This Isle of Jura 21 Year Old is a single malt Scotch distilled at the Jura distillery on the Isle of Jura in 1998 and matured in a single hogshead before The Whisky Agency bottled it in 2019. Bottled at 49.2% ABV, it is an island malt with more than two decades in oak, offered as a one-off independent bottling. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

secret-highland-2007-12-year-old-twa.title: The Whisky Agency Secret Highland 2007 12 Year Old 47.8% ABV
secret-highland-2007-12-year-old-twa.bodyHtml:
This Secret Highland 12 Year Old is a single malt Scotch from an undisclosed Highland distillery, distilled in 2007 and matured in a hogshead before The Whisky Agency bottled it at 47.8% ABV. An intriguing independent release for drinkers who enjoy discovering a whisky on its own merits. 700ml.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

domaine-faiveley-mercurey-vieilles-vigne.title: Domaine Faiveley Mercurey Vieilles Vignes 2023
domaine-faiveley-mercurey-vieilles-vigne.bodyHtml:
Domaine Faiveley Mercurey Vieilles Vignes 2023 is an elegant, balanced, and fresh red Burgundy crafted by Domaine Faiveley from old vines in the Côte Chalonnaise. Sourced from estate plots with limestone and clay soils, it undergoes traditional fermentation before aging in French oak barrels. In the glass, it displays a vibrant ruby color. The expressive nose offers aromas of fresh red cherry, wild raspberry, and blackcurrant alongside subtle earthy undertones, forest floor, and delicate wood spice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and fruit-forward, featuring crunchy red berry flavors, fine-grained tannins, balanced acidity, and a smooth, clean finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken, duck breast, pork tenderloin, grilled salmon, wild mushroom risotto, and mild cheeses like Brie or Comté.

bimber-apogee-pure-malt-whisky.title: Bimber Apogee XII 12 Year Old Pure Malt Whisky
bimber-apogee-pure-malt-whisky.bodyHtml:
Apogee XII whisky offers flawless balance with additional layers of flavour and complexity derived from the vivid, fruit and spice-forward character of the ex-Bimber casks.

Sourced from some of the finest single malt whiskies from both the Highlands and Speyside. These whiskies were matured for a minimum of 12 years before being enhanced further through skilful, meticulous blending and an additional maturation in ex-bourbon casks that were previously used to age Bimber’s award-winning London single malt whisky.

Bottled at 46.3% ABV with no colouring or chill-filtration, Apogee is presented in a striking, custom glass bottle – which features a tactile, hammered glass that has been fashioned to imitate the surfaces of Bimber’s small copper pot stills.

Nose Spiced pears and oven-baked apricot flans are sweetened by candy necklaces and scented with rosewater, nutmeg and powdered ginger

Palate Syrupy orchard and stone fruits provide a bright and fresh mouthfeel supported by lightly charred oak, gentle white pepper and cooling mint

Finish Lingering ripe and sweet fruits alongside sympathetic, aromatic oak

velenosi-ninfa-marche-rosso.title: Velenosi Ninfa Rosso 2022
velenosi-ninfa-marche-rosso.bodyHtml:
Velenosi Ninfa Rosso 2022 is an expressive, rich, and full-bodied red wine produced by Azienda Vitivinicola Velenosi in Italy's Marche region. Crafted from a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Montepulciano, and Syrah harvested from estate vineyards in Offida and Castel di Lama, it undergoes aging in new barrels for 18–24 months. The wine displays an intense deep ruby color with violet reflections, opening with aromas of ripe blackberry, dark cherry preserves, and plum, interwoven with complex layers of graphite, black pepper, tobacco leaf, and subtle balsam. On the palate, it delivers a warm, powerful texture balanced by finely rounded tannins and a long, fruit-forward finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled lamb chops, wild boar ragù, slow-braised short ribs, beef fillet, or aged Pecorino cheese.

johnnie-walker-black-label-5.title: Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old 50ml
johnnie-walker-black-label-5.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old is an iconic and highly regarded blended Scotch whisky, crafted using whiskies drawn from the four corners of Scotland. Aged for a minimum of 12 years, this masterful blend combines the lighter, sweeter whiskies of the east with the robust, peaty malts of the west. The result is a deep, complex, and incredibly well-balanced spirit that has set the benchmark for premium blends worldwide.

Food Pairing: The smoky and rich flavor profile of this whisky pairs wonderfully with hearty and savory dishes like slow-cooked BBQ pork, smoked brisket, or a rich charcuterie board. It is also exceptional alongside dark chocolate or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep gold with rich amber highlights in appearance, offering a smooth, medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Bold and aromatic, featuring heavy notes of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, and dark orange peel, beautifully balanced by underlying wood spice and gentle, fragrant peat smoke.

Palate : Complex, smooth, and layered. Rich flavors of sweet vanilla, creamy toffee, and dark fruit give way to warm winter baking spices, toasted oak, and a distinct wave of peat smoke.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth, leaving a lingering impression of soft smoke, sweet malt, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, over ice in a double rocks glass, or mixed with high-quality ginger ale or soda water in a tall highball glass with a fresh orange wedge.

johnnie-walker-blue-label.title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
johnnie-walker-blue-label.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label is an iconic, ultra-premium blended Scotch whisky crafted by Johnnie Walker. Hand-selected by Master Blender Jim Beveridge from some of the rarest casks across Scotland—including irreplaceable stocks from ghost distilleries—only one in ten thousand casks possesses the quality and character required for this blend. It delivers a rich, velvety balance of sweet honey, dark chocolate, ripe fruits, and a gentle, lingering cloud of soft Islay smoke.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, caviar, seared duck breast, dark chocolate truffles, and aged blue cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a silky, rich, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Mellow and rounded with aromas of dry smoke, raisins, sweet honey, toasted nuts, and subtle orange peel.

Palate : Complex and velvety, delivering flavors of hazelnut, dark chocolate, sandalwood, honey, Kumquat fruit, and sweet sherry wood spice.

Finish : Rich, long, and warming with lingering notes of gentle peat smoke, dark fruit, dried spice, and pepper.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass accompanied by a glass of ice water on the side to cleanse the palate between sips.

johnnie-walker-double-black-1.title: Johnnie Walker Double Black 1L
johnnie-walker-double-black-1.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Double Black is a bold, amplified interpretation of the iconic Johnnie Walker Black Label. Crafted by former Master Blender Jim Beveridge, this expression takes the signature balanced profile of Black Label and dials up the intensity by incorporating heavily peated West Coast and Islay single malts, along with whiskies matured in deeply charred oak casks. The result is a robust, full-bodied Blended Scotch Whisky that delivers profound layers of smoldering campfire smoke, rich vanilla, and spiced orchard fruits, offering a more powerful and rugged drinking experience without losing the brand's trademark smoothness.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, BBQ pork ribs, strong blue cheeses like Roquefort, dark chocolate, or roasted salted almonds.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a rich, full-bodied, and slightly syrupy mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense and inviting, leading with sweet campfire smoke, maritime peat, toasted oak, and rich vanilla, underscored by hints of crisp green apple and citrus zest.

Palate : Bold and robust, delivering a powerful wave of peaty smoke, creamy vanilla, and caramelized sugar, beautifully balanced by spiced apples, dried raisins, and a touch of deeply charred wood.

Finish : Long, warming, and distinctly smoky, leaving a lingering finish of smoldering peat, dry oak tannin, and a whisper of sweet fruit.

Serve : Serve neat, over a large ice cube, or with a splash of water to open up the complex smoky aromatics.

johnnie-walker-gold-label-1.title: Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve
johnnie-walker-gold-label-1.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve is a luxury blended Scotch whisky crafted by Master Blender Jim Beveridge to celebrate the art of blending. Built around single malt whisky from Clynelish, alongside selected malt and grain whiskies from across Scotland, it is known for its sweet, honeyed profile and smooth, creamy character.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, dark chocolate desserts, fruit tarts, and mild cheeses such as Brie or Gruyère.

Tasting Notes : Bright gold in color with a full, smooth, and creamy mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Soft nectar, gentle floral aromas, and honeyed sweetness with underlying notes of subtle wood smoke and ripe fruit.

Palate : Smooth and rich with flavors of heather honey, vanilla, poached apples, and light wood spices.

Finish : Medium-long and warming with lingering notes of sweet honey, gentle oak, and faint peat smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, over a large ice cube, or with a splash of chilled apple juice and soda water for a signature highball.

johnnie-walker-18-year-old.title: Johnnie Walker 18 Year Old
johnnie-walker-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Aged 18 Years is made using whiskies that have matured for at least 18 years. Carefully chosen for their flavor and quality, these whiskies make for a wonderful combination of both classic and contemporary tastes – blending notes of citrus and fragrant almonds, with warm vanilla and a hint of tropical tangerines. 

NOSE
A wonderfully rich aroma, combining notes of rich, sweet fruit with hints of toffee and caramel.

PALATE
A comforting mix of warming, malty cereal and smooth creamy vanilla, with fragrant notes of almond and tropical tangerine.

FINISH
A lingering finish with hints of dark chocolate, citrus peel and a very light, aromatic smoke.

Food Pairing: Splendidly complements roast chicken, duck with fruit glaze, grilled salmon, aged cheeses such as Comté or Gruyère, dark chocolate desserts, and nut-based pastries.

chateau-liversan.title: Chateau Livran 2018
chateau-liversan.bodyHtml:
Located in the northern Médoc, Château Livran presents aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, ripe plum, cedar, tobacco, and graphite. Full-bodied yet refined, it combines firm tannins with vibrant freshness, layered dark fruit, and a persistent finish that showcases classic Left Bank character.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled ribeye, roast lamb, beef bourguignon, duck confit, mushroom risotto, aged cheddar, roasted vegetables, or venison.

painted-rock-syrah-estate-grown.title: Painted Rock Syrah 2021 750ml
painted-rock-syrah-estate-grown.bodyHtml:
Floral aromas of violet and white pepper are delicately balanced with the blackberry, plum, and dark cherry notes. The palate offers velvety, integrated tannins and has an additional subtle vanilla note. 

93 Points - John Schreiner 

The wine begins with aromas of violets, cherries and white pepper. The palate delivers a medley of dark fruit flavours, including fig, plum and cherry with a hint of pepper and spice.

kosta-browne-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2021
kosta-browne-sonoma-coast-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
A compilation of ripe, red and blue fruit ignites the senses with slight undertones of forest rain. Soft and smooth on the palate with pure electric dark berry flavors and deep, unified tannins add volume to a refined finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of umami, seaweed, mushroom and bark follow through to a medium body, with firm and fine velvety tannins and a flavorful finish with a salty undertone at the end. Oyster shell. Drink now.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast was matured in 39% new oak for 15 months. The nose opens slowly from allspice and brown sugar to a core of red cherry and cranberry, tea leaves and lavender. The medium-bodied palate offers surprisingly concentrated fruit supported by grainy tannins and seamless freshness, and it has a long, spicy finish.

miro-cellars-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Miro aCure Estate Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
miro-cellars-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Miro aCure Estate Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich and expressive California red wine showcasing the depth, structure and elegance of Cabernet Sauvignon. Produced under the Miro label, this estate-designated wine highlights ripe fruit character, balanced tannins and the complexity associated with carefully cultivated vineyard fruit. The 2022 vintage offers an inviting profile of blackcurrant, blackberry, ripe plum and dark cherry, complemented by notes of cedar, cocoa, vanilla and subtle baking spice. On the palate, this Cabernet Sauvignon is expected to be full-bodied and well-structured, with concentrated dark fruit, firm yet polished tannins and a lingering, savoury finish. Its bold character makes it an excellent choice for steak dinners, special occasions and Cabernet Sauvignon enthusiasts.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, filet mignon, braised beef short ribs, roasted lamb, barbecue brisket, venison, mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, aged cheddar, Gouda and blue cheese.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This rich and fruit-driven Cabernet jumps from the glass with aromas of chocolate covered cherry, violets and raspberry on the nose, while the palate delivers a wave of lively acidity, cherry, coffee and black pepper flavors with enough tannin for mid-term aging. Drink 2025-2035.

long-hop-brewing-hazy-pale-ale.title: Long Hop Hazy Pale With Fresh Hops
long-hop-brewing-hazy-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Long Hop Hazy Pale With Fresh Hops

lui-malbec-bonarda.title: Lui Umile Malbec 2022
lui-malbec-bonarda.bodyHtml:
Lui Úmile Malbec 2022 is a fresh, vibrant, and expressive high-altitude Argentine red crafted by winemaker Mauricio Vegetti. Sourced from choice estate vineyards situated at 1,120 meters above sea level in Vista Flores, within Mendoza's prestigious Uco Valley, the vines thrive in alluvial soils rich in sand and rounded river stones. The nose is incredibly inviting, bursting with bright aromas of fresh red plums, ripe cherries, and raspberries, intricately layered with notes of hibiscus, dark spices, and a quintessential Uco Valley backdrop of desert herbs and wet stones. On the palate, this medium- to full-bodied Malbec showcases a beautifully crunchy fruit character, seamlessly balanced by fine, sturdy tannins and a vivid vein of natural acidity. Maturing 60% of the blend for 10 to 12 months in neutral French oak barrels imparts a sophisticated, silky texture and a touch of vanilla while keeping the focus squarely on its pure, juicy fruit, which carries through to a long, flavorful finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with premium grain-fed ribeye steaks, slow-braised beef short rib tacos, grilled lamb cutlets, or traditional chorizo pasta dishes.

91 Points - James Suckling

Notes of ripe raspberries and cherries with hibiscus, dark spices and wet stones. Medium- to full-bodied with crunchy tannins and vivid acidity. Very attractive fruit character and a flavorful finish. Drink now or hold.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

The nose exhibits aromas of fresh red plums leading the senses to a fruit-driven palate, where a medley of blackberries and ripe cherries is framed by balancing acidity and sturdy tannins. This is a lively Malbec from the Uco Valley, featuring a long finish of desert herbs.

lui-malbec.title: Lui Umile Malbec 2022
lui-malbec.bodyHtml:
