sheringham-rhubarb-gin-liqueur.title: Sheringham Fresh Rhubarb Liqueur
sheringham-rhubarb-gin-liqueur.bodyHtml: Drawn to the winning combination of rhubarb and star anise, he envisioned a liqueur that would taste as fresh and bright as a new summer’s day. With its classic gin base, premium rhubarb grown in British Columbia, and maceration process involving star anise and lemon skins, this liqueur achieves a perfect balance of tart, sweet, and subtly vegetal notes.

lui-pinot-noir.title: Lui Umile Pinot Noir 2022 750ml
lui-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Lui Pinot Noir (750ml) is a red wine made from the Pinot Noir grape variety. It is known for its light to medium-bodied style, often featuring flavors of cherry, raspberry, and other red fruits. It is typically dry with balanced acidity and silky tannins. Some Lui Pinot Noirs, particularly those from regions like Burgundy, may also exhibit notes of earthy or floral aromas. The wine is generally well-suited to pairing with grilled meats, roasted vegetables, and cheeses.

lui-sauvignon-blanc.title: Lui Sauvignon Blanc 2021 750ml
lui-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: is a premium white wine that showcases the exceptional quality of Sauvignon Blanc grapes from select vineyards. Crafted with meticulous care, this wine exemplifies the vibrancy and elegance of the varietal, making it a delightful choice for any occasion.

two-stacks-first-cut.title: Two Stacks First Cut Irish Whiskey
two-stacks-first-cut.bodyHtml:
Two Stacks The First Cut is the Signature Blend of this modern Irish whiskey brand, bottled at 43% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Two Stacks revives the tradition of Irish whiskey bonding, in which merchants selected and blended spirit from different distilleries, combining grain, malt and pot still whiskeys into one smooth, versatile blend. The First Cut was created to challenge the idea that blended Irish whiskey has to be uniform and anonymous, showcasing a range of matured spirits instead. It is approachable enough for newcomers and works equally well neat or in a highball.

Tasting Notes: honey, vanilla, caramel and dried fruit.

Nose: Honey, vanilla, toasted oak and a hint of citrus.

Palate: Smooth and balanced, with caramel, spice and dried fruit.

Finish: Light, clean and gently sweet.

Serve: Neat, on ice, or in a highball with soda water or ginger ale and a lemon twist.

two-stacks-smoke-and-mirrors.title: Two Stacks Smoke And Mirrors Irish Whiskey
two-stacks-smoke-and-mirrors.bodyHtml:
Two Stacks Smoke and Mirrors is a peated Irish single malt bottled at 48% ABV in a 700ml bottle. It sets out to challenge the common belief that Irish whiskey is never peated, reviving a style that was once part of Irish distilling before falling out of favour. Part of the malt is finished in casks that previously held Imperial Irish Stout from Brehon Brewery in County Monaghan, adding a rich, dark sweetness to the smoke. The result balances campfire character with chocolate and toffee, and will appeal to drinkers who enjoy smoky Islay malts but want something distinctly Irish.

Tasting Notes: campfire smoke, dark chocolate, toffee and roasted nuts.

Nose: Campfire smoke, dark chocolate, caramel and earthy spice.

Palate: Bold and smoky, with toffee, dried fruit and roasted nuts.

Finish: Long and peaty with a lingering sweetness.

Serve: Neat or with a few drops of water; also works in a smoky twist on a French 75.

last-best-show-pony-aussie-pale-2.title: Last Best Show Pony Aussie Pale 6 Cans
last-best-show-pony-aussie-pale-2.bodyHtml: Last Best Show Pony Aussie Pale 6 Cans

ardbeg-ardcore-general-release.title: Ardbeg Ardcore 46% ABV
ardbeg-ardcore-general-release.bodyHtml:
From a Distillery with more ups and downs that a pogoing punk comes Ardcore. Created with roasted black malt, roasted to the extreme, this spirit is all about what happens up front ¬¬– centre stage. The malt is what defines its distinctive profile. Described as tasting like ‘biting on a spiky ball’, Ardcore is a dram that wears its heart on its sleeve… its black heart!

Notes of charcoal and sweet smoke make for an in-your-face nose, while potent notes of aniseed and dark chocolate stamp this bottle out as one fit only for the most Ardcore of fans.

Non chill-filtered at 46% ABV.

the-prisoner-pinot-noir.title: The Prisoner Pinot Noir 2022
the-prisoner-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Pinot Noir 2022 is a rich, full-bodied, and deeply expressive California red wine crafted primarily from high-quality vineyards across Sonoma County and select coastal sites. Visually displaying a dense, dark ruby hue, it opens with an alluringly complex bouquet of ripe dark cherry, wild raspberry, marionberry, and dried cranberry, layered with delicate aromatics of chai tea, cardamom, clove, and toasted oak. On the palate, it delivers a lush, velvety mouthfeel brimming with ripe red and dark fruit flavors, seamlessly balanced by fine-grained, approachable tannins and integrated vanilla spice. The fruit-driven intensity is elevated by a bright, refreshing underlying acidity that carries through to a long, decadent, and spice-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted duck breast with cherry reduction, grilled lamb chops, mushroom risotto, pork loin, and aged Gruyère cheese.

pump-house-crafty-radler-variety-pack.title: Pump House Crafty Radler Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans
pump-house-crafty-radler-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Pump House Crafty Radler Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans

kaiyo-the-rubi-1st-edition-japanese-whis.title: Kaiyo The Rubi 1st Edition Japanese Whisky
kaiyo-the-rubi-1st-edition-japanese-whis.bodyHtml:
The latest in Kaiyo's special release cask finish series is a lovely flirtation with Ruby port pipes. The un-chill filtered malt whisky ages for three years in Japanese Mizunara oak before heading out to sea like all of Kaiyo's whiskies, for three months. Upon returning to Japan, it ages a further seven years before being briefly rested in former Ruby port pipes for four months. 

On the nose, candied orange and toasted marshmallow open the show, with notes of sandalwood and mango following. Hints of dark chocolate and peppermint last on the palate with fantastic viscosity, sticking around for a long finish.

kaiyo-the-kuri-ariake-wood-collection.title: Kaiyo The Kuri Ariake Wood Collection Japanese Whisky
kaiyo-the-kuri-ariake-wood-collection.bodyHtml:
Kaiyo 'The Kuri' Japanese Whisky (Japanese Kuri Wood) is a unique Japanese whisky matured in casks made from Japanese Kuri (chestnut) wood. Distilled from 100% malted barley, the spirit undergoes an ocean maturation process on ships traveling across sea routes, where the motion and temperature changes accelerate interaction with the wood. The use of Kuri wood imparts a distinct flavor profile characterized by nutty, sweet, and soft tannic oak qualities that complement the delicate malt foundation.

Food Pairing: Grilled yakitori, smoked pork belly, roasted chestnut dishes, dark chocolate, or aged gouda cheese.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber appearance with a smooth, velvety, and medium-to-full mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Aromatic roasted chestnuts, honeyed malt, sweet vanilla, soft oak spice, and a hint of dried orchard fruit.

Palate : Rich and well-rounded with prominent nutty chestnut flavors, sweet malt, dark caramel, subtle baking spices, and soft oak tannins.

Finish : Long, warm, and lingering with notes of sweet nuttiness, light smoke, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, over a large ice sphere, or with a splash of pure spring water.

wemyss-cherry-bakewell-glen-keith-22-yr.title: Wemyss Cherry Bakewell Glen Keith 1996 22 Year Old 46% ABV
wemyss-cherry-bakewell-glen-keith-22-yr.bodyHtml:
Cherry Bakewell is a single cask Glen Keith from independent bottler Wemyss Malts. Distilled in Speyside in 1996, it was matured for 22 years in a refill sherry butt and bottled at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

kavalan-classic-single-malt-whisky.title: Kavalan Classic Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-classic-single-malt-whisky.bodyHtml:
Kavalan Classic Taiwanese Single Malt Whisky is the signature expression from Taiwan's acclaimed Kavalan Distillery, located in Yilan County. Crafted from malted barley and matured in a combination of bourbon, sherry, and wine casks, this whisky develops remarkable depth in Taiwan's warm, humid climate. Its elegant character combines tropical mango, pear, honey, vanilla, and delicate floral aromas with gentle oak spice. Bottled at 40% ABV, Kavalan Classic offers a smooth, rounded introduction to Taiwanese single malt whisky.

Food Pairing: Grilled pork, roasted chicken, glazed duck, aged Gouda, tropical fruit desserts, toasted coconut, and milk chocolate.

Tasting Notes: Fresh, fruity, and floral, combining tropical mango, honey, pear, vanilla, coconut, and gentle oak spice.

Nose: Butterfly orchid, honey, ripe mango, pear, vanilla, coconut, and subtle chocolate.

Palate: Sweet mango, tropical fruit, creamy vanilla, honey, and warming oak spices, with a smooth, rounded texture.

Finish: Medium-length and gently warming, with lingering citrus, tropical fruit, and subtle oak spice.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass at room temperature. Add a few drops of water to enhance its floral and tropical fruit characteristics.

kavalan-solist-px-moscatel-decanter.title: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
kavalan-solist-px-moscatel-decanter.bodyHtml:
Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and recharred in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the wood into the whisky overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness.
It has a complex and multi-dimensional background of pepper, spice, dates and other fruits, such as ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of bursting citrus fruits.

Colour
Deep autumn gold

Flavour
A rich fusion of vanilla and caramelized sugars with dark chocolate on top. Ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of citrus fruits burst. Pepper is also present in the background waiting to be noticed.

Palate
The taste ends with clean and complex flavours embodying all that is best in the finest malt whiskies enjoying a long aftertaste.

Tasting
We suggest drinking Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask neat.

johnnie-walker-black-label-6.title: Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old 1.75L
johnnie-walker-black-label-6.bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Black Label 12 Year Old is an iconic and highly regarded blended Scotch whisky, crafted using whiskies drawn from the four corners of Scotland. Aged for a minimum of 12 years, this masterful blend combines the lighter, sweeter whiskies of the east with the robust, peaty malts of the west. The result is a deep, complex, and incredibly well-balanced spirit that has set the benchmark for premium blends worldwide.

Food Pairing: The smoky and rich flavor profile of this whisky pairs wonderfully with hearty and savory dishes like slow-cooked BBQ pork, smoked brisket, or a rich charcuterie board. It is also exceptional alongside dark chocolate or roasted nuts.

Tasting Notes : Deep gold with rich amber highlights in appearance, offering a smooth, medium-bodied, and velvety mouthfeel.

Nose : Bold and aromatic, featuring heavy notes of sweet vanilla, dried fruit, and dark orange peel, beautifully balanced by underlying wood spice and gentle, fragrant peat smoke.

Palate : Complex, smooth, and layered. Rich flavors of sweet vanilla, creamy toffee, and dark fruit give way to warm winter baking spices, toasted oak, and a distinct wave of peat smoke.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth, leaving a lingering impression of soft smoke, sweet malt, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass, over ice in a double rocks glass, or mixed with high-quality ginger ale or soda water in a tall highball glass with a fresh orange wedge.

bols-apricot-brandy.title: Bols Apricot Brandy Liqueur
bols-apricot-brandy.bodyHtml:
Bols Apricot Brandy is an amber apricot liqueur from Bols of Amsterdam. Its rich, nutty character comes from a blend of crushed apricot kernels, fresh apricot juice and brandy, giving juicy ripe apricot backed by hints of cognac and almond. Bottled at 24% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it has long been a staple of classic cocktails such as the Mai Tai, and it also works simply with orange juice or soda.

Tasting Notes: Juicy ripe apricot with hints of cognac and almond; rich and nutty.

Serve: In a Mai Tai or Apricot Sour, or long with orange juice or soda.

bolskaya-vodka.title: Bolskaya Vodka 375ml
bolskaya-vodka.bodyHtml:
Bolskaya Vodka is an unflavoured vodka from Lucas Bols B.V. and a product of Alberta, Canada. It is bottled at 40% ABV and offered here in the 375ml size; the same vodka also comes in 200ml, 375ml, 750ml, 1.14L and 1.75L formats, so it is easy to match the bottle to the occasion. As a regular, unflavoured vodka it is made for mixing, from simple highballs with soda or tonic to Caesars, Moscow Mules and fruit punches.

Serve: Well chilled with soda or tonic and a wedge of lime, or as the base of a Caesar or Moscow Mule.

gordons-london-dry.title: Gordon's London Dry Gin 1.75L
gordons-london-dry.bodyHtml:
Gordon's London Dry Gin is the classic juniper-led gin first created by Alexander Gordon in London in 1769, and widely known as the gin behind the classic G&T. The Gordon's recipe blends wild juniper berries with coriander, angelica and liquorice, and is triple distilled. Juniper leads the aroma, the palate is crisp and refreshing, and the finish is simple and mild. This 1.75L bottle is bottled at 40% ABV for the Canadian market and is a product of Ontario, Canada. The large format suits busy bars and parties.

Tasting Notes: Juniper-forward and crystal clear.

Palate: Crisp and refreshing.

Finish: Simple and mild.

Serve: With tonic water over ice and a wedge of lime, or in classic gin cocktails.

cupcake-chardonnay.title: Cupcake Chardonnay 2022 750ml
cupcake-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "Light apple flesh and white melon aromas pick up a toasted almond warmth on the easy nose of this bottling. The palate is very straightforward with honeysuckle and light pear flavors. Matt Kettmann" - 88/100, Wine Enthusiast

sapporo-3.title: Sapporo 30L Keg
sapporo-3.bodyHtml: Clear bright gold with light foamy head; malt, citrus and hop aromas; light to medium body, dry style; citrus and light hops for a clean refreshing finish.

potters-premium.title: Potter's Premium Vodka 1.75L
potters-premium.bodyHtml:
Potter's Premium Vodka is a clean, smooth vodka from Potter's, a brand dating back to 1958 and produced in Alberta by Highwood Distillers. It is made to work equally well straight or mixed, and is a natural base for classics such as the Kamikaze, Harvey Wallbanger and Black Russian. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 1.75L bottle.

Serve: Chilled and neat, or with orange juice for a Screwdriver.

amarula-cream-1.title: Amarula Marula Fruit Cream Liqueur 375ml
amarula-cream-1.bodyHtml: Made from the exotic marula fruit that is grown exclusively in Africa. This rich and delicious liqueur pours a light creamy coffee colour and offers aromas and flavours of sweet toffee, vanilla and fresh marula fruit with a velvety texture.

copper-moon-cabernet-sauvignon-2.title: Copper Moon Cabernet Sauvignon 1.5L Magnum
copper-moon-cabernet-sauvignon-2.bodyHtml:
Approachable aromas of ripe blackberry, dark plum, sweet cherries, and a touch of vanilla open the nose. The palate is smooth and medium-bodied, delivering flavours of juicy red and black fruits complemented by gentle baking spices and subtle toasted oak, supported by soft, rounded tannins on an easy-drinking finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled burgers, barbecue ribs, beef chili, pepperoni pizza, roast beef sandwiches, or mild cheddar cheese.

bolskaya-vodka-1.title: Bolskaya Vodka 1.75L
bolskaya-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Bolskaya Vodka is an unflavoured vodka from Lucas Bols B.V. and a product of Alberta, Canada. It is bottled at 40% ABV and offered here in the 1.75L size; the same vodka also comes in 200ml, 375ml, 750ml, 1.14L and 1.75L formats, so it is easy to match the bottle to the occasion. As a regular, unflavoured vodka it is made for mixing, from simple highballs with soda or tonic to Caesars, Moscow Mules and fruit punches.

Serve: Well chilled with soda or tonic and a wedge of lime, or as the base of a Caesar or Moscow Mule.

errazuriz-estate-sauvignon-blanc.title: Errazuriz Max Reserva Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
errazuriz-estate-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: The citric notes, green apple and herbal touches dominate the palate, giving an intense varietal character and tension. It has excellent persistence, medium volume, broad entrance, and acidity, creating a vertical, balanced, refreshing wine.

bombay-sapphire-2.title: Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin 1.14L
bombay-sapphire-2.bodyHtml:
Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin is an iconic, world-renowned gin crafted using a proprietary vapor-infusion process. First created in 1987 based on an 1761 recipe, ten sustainably sourced botanicals are held separately from the spirit in perforated copper baskets and infused with hot spirit vapor, yielding a delicate, bright, and perfectly balanced botanical profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, seafood tapas, goat cheese crostini, lemon tarts, or sushi.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and luminous in appearance with a smooth, light, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh juniper, bright citrus, floral notes, subtle pine, and warm earthy spices.

Palate : Clean, balanced, and round with vibrant juniper berries, zesty lemon, peppery coriander, subtle liquorice, and almond sweetness.

Finish : Medium, crisp, and refreshing with lingering hints of citrus zest and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve as the foundational spirit in a classic Gin & Tonic with fresh lime, in a Dry Martini, or over ice with tonic water.

mikes-hard-lemonade-1.title: Mike's Hard Lemonade Variety Pack 12 cans

cono-sur-gewurztraminer.title: Wolfberger Signature Collection Gewurztraminer 2022
cono-sur-gewurztraminer.bodyHtml:
Wolfberger Signature Collection Gewurztraminer 2022 is an exceptionally expressive, aromatic, and off-dry French white wine that beautifully highlights the exotic, luscious character of Alsace's signature grape variety. In the glass, it displays a bright straw-yellow color with golden highlights. The nose is highly intense and wonderfully floral, opening with an explosive bouquet of fresh lychees, passion fruit, and white rose water, layered with hints of honeyed stone fruits, orange peel, and warm baking spices like ginger and cinnamon. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied white is remarkably supple and rich, offering a rounded, almost honeyed texture packed with juicy peach and tropical syrup flavors. This opulent sweetness is perfectly balanced by a clean, refreshing line of acidity that ensures a crisp, harmonic, and incredibly persistent finish with lingering notes of sweet spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with spicy Thai chicken curry, sweet-and-sour dishes, pungent classic Alsatian Munster cheese, or caramelized pear tarts.

screw-it-shiraz-1.title: Screw It! Shiraz 4L Bag In Box

grey-goose-vodka-3.title: Grey Goose Vodka
grey-goose-vodka-3.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Vodka is an ultra-premium, world-renowned spirit crafted in the celebrated Cognac region of France. Created by Maître de Chais (Cellar Master) François Thibault, this expression is distilled using only two high-quality ingredients: single-origin soft winter wheat from the fertile Picardy region and pure spring water naturally filtered through limestone from a dedicated well in Gensac-la-Pallue. Distilled a single time using a continuous column still process to preserve the character of the grain, this vodka bypasses extensive filtration to ensure a naturally rich, soft, and round texture, setting a global standard for high-end luxury vodka.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with fresh oysters on the half shell, caviar with blinis, smoked salmon canapés, creamy goat cheese, or light lemon-herb grilled chicken skewers.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear with brilliant clarity, featuring a plush, smooth, and rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Delicate and floral with subtle notes of sweet winter wheat, citrus zest, and light almond.

Palate : Smooth, soft, and slightly sweet with notes of cracked grain, subtle almond, light cream, and fresh citrus.

Finish : Warm, ultra-clean, and satisfying with a lingering, gentle peppery warmth and soft grain sweetness.

Serve : Serve ice-cold neat from the freezer, on the rocks, or as the refined base in a classic Vodka Martini or Espresso Martini.

mikes-hard-lemonade-2.title: Mike's Hard Lemonade Variety Pack 12 cans

russian-standard-original-vodka.title: Grey Goose Vodka 1.75L
russian-standard-original-vodka.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Vodka is an ultra-premium, world-renowned spirit crafted in the celebrated Cognac region of France. Created by Maître de Chais (Cellar Master) François Thibault, this expression is distilled using only two high-quality ingredients: single-origin soft winter wheat from the fertile Picardy region and pure spring water naturally filtered through limestone from a dedicated well in Gensac-la-Pallue. Distilled a single time using a continuous column still process to preserve the character of the grain, this vodka bypasses extensive filtration to ensure a naturally rich, soft, and round texture, setting a global standard for high-end luxury vodka.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with fresh oysters on the half shell, caviar with blinis, smoked salmon canapés, creamy goat cheese, or light lemon-herb grilled chicken skewers.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear with brilliant clarity, featuring a plush, smooth, and rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Delicate and floral with subtle notes of sweet winter wheat, citrus zest, and light almond.

Palate : Smooth, soft, and slightly sweet with notes of cracked grain, subtle almond, light cream, and fresh citrus.

Finish : Warm, ultra-clean, and satisfying with a lingering, gentle peppery warmth and soft grain sweetness.

Serve : Serve ice-cold neat from the freezer, on the rocks, or as the refined base in a classic Vodka Martini or Espresso Martini.

liquid-ice-organic-vodka.title: Belvedere Organic Dirty Brew
liquid-ice-organic-vodka.bodyHtml:
Belvedere Dirty Brew is a coffee-flavoured spirit from the Polish vodka house Belvedere, made by combining Belvedere Organic Vodka with the flavour of robusta coffee. The producer describes a dark liquid with russet tones, toffee notes and a rich, viscous texture, and positions it for late-evening drinking and coffee cocktails. It is bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle; the producer's nutrition table shows about 6 g of sugar per 100 ml. Belvedere's own suggested serves include a Dirty Latte, a Dirty Espresso, a Dirty Affogato and a Dirty Tonic.

Tasting Notes: Coffee, toffee and dark chocolate with a velvety texture.

Nose: Roasted coffee beans with rich toffee.

Palate: Fresh espresso with silky dark chocolate.

Finish: Soft, smooth and velvety, with a hint of rye spice.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, over ice, with tonic, or in an espresso martini.

hpnotiq-1.title: Hpnotiq 375ml
hpnotiq-1.bodyHtml:
Hpnotiq is a blend of tropical fruit juices, French vodka and a touch of Cognac, made in France and sold in the liqueur category. It came onto the market in 2001, and the brand credits its signature colour, a bright blue, and its original flavour with winning it a following around the world. It is bottled at 17% ABV, well below the strength of a standard spirit. Expect tropical fruit on the nose, with mango, passion fruit and citrus, and a soft, lightly sweet palate that ends clean and refreshing. This listing is the 375ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Tropical fruit and citrus; soft, lightly sweet and refreshing.

Serve: Chilled, over ice, or mixed in cocktails.

sour-puss-blue-raspberry.title: Sour Puss Blue 375ml
sour-puss-blue-raspberry.bodyHtml:
Sour Puss Blue is a vivid blue sweet-and-sour liqueur from the Sour Puss range made by Phillips Distilling Company, the Minnesota distiller that has been producing spirits since 1912. The brand blends what it calls secret and exotic natural flavours to create its signature curiously sweet and sour taste, and Sour Puss is one of Canada's best-selling liqueur brands. This 375ml bottle is bottled at 15% ABV, a lighter strength that suits chilled shots, sours and colourful mixed drinks, and the smaller size makes it easy to keep on hand for parties.

Serve: Well chilled as a shot, or mixed with lemon-lime soda over ice.

liquid-ice-organic-vodka-1.title: Royal Dragon The Emperor Limited Edition Vodka 1L
liquid-ice-organic-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Royal Dragon Emperor Limited Edition is an ultra-premium luxury vodka crafted by Royal Dragon. Distilled five times from organic winter wheat in copper pot stills, this vodka is filtered through charcoal and infused with edible 23-karat gold leaf flakes. Presented in a hand-blown 1-liter glass bottle that features an intricate 3D glass dragon sculpted into the interior, it represents a statement of visual craftsmanship and refined smoothness.

Food Pairing: Caviar, oysters, sushi, sashimi, smoked salmon, blinis with sour cream, and light tapas.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear with floating 23-karat gold leaf flakes. Light, silky, and clean on the palate with a smooth texture.

Nose : Clean and subtle with delicate notes of grain, soft wheat, faint citrus, and light peppery spice.

Palate : Exceptionally smooth and round, delivering clean grain sweetness, subtle mineral undertones, and a touch of white pepper.

Finish : Clean, short, and crisp, leaving a soft warmth with lingering mineral and light cereal notes.

Serve : Serve ice-cold neat in a vodka shot glass or chilled martini glass, or use as a luxurious base in high-end vodka cocktails.

elephant-island-crab-apple-fruit-wine.title: La Crema Monterey Chardonnay 2024
elephant-island-crab-apple-fruit-wine.bodyHtml:
La Crema Monterey Chardonnay 2024 is a crisp, bright, and fruit-forward California white wine produced from cool-climate vineyards in Monterey County. Benefiting from coastal fog and gentle winds off Monterey Bay, it preserves vibrant natural acidity while developing expressive, well-balanced fruit profiles. In the glass, it presents a pale straw color with lively aromas of meyer lemon, yellow apple, white peach, and subtle nuances of toasted oak and vanilla. On the palate, it is smooth and medium-bodied, delivering juicy citrus, green apple, and soft tropical fruit flavors framed by crisp acidity and a clean, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pan-seared halibut, roasted chicken breast, creamy seafood pasta, crab cakes, Caesar salad, and mild semi-soft cheeses like Brie.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Clean aromas of lemon zest, lime pith and sliced apple show on the nose of this always reliable brand. The palate is energetic with familiar flavors of Meyer lemon and nectarine.

kahlua.title: Kahlúa Original Coffee Liqueur 1.14L
kahlua.bodyHtml:
Kahlúa Original Coffee Liqueur is the well-known Mexican coffee liqueur, presented here in a 1.14L bottle. It was created in Veracruz, Mexico, in 1936 and is made with 100% Arabica coffee beans and rum; the current label adds that the beans are hand-harvested, medium roasted and of single-country origin. In Alberta it is bottled at 16% ABV. Deep brown in colour, sweet and full of roasted coffee flavour, it is one of the key ingredients in classic cocktails such as the White Russian, the Black Russian and the Espresso Martini, and it is just as useful in coffee and desserts.

Tasting Notes: Sweet, rich and coffee-led.

Nose: Sweet fresh-brewed coffee with hints of vanilla and coconut.

Palate: Sweet, mild coffee flavour with a thick, full body.

Serve: Over ice, in a White Russian or Espresso Martini, or stirred into coffee.

casillero-del-diablo-carmenere.title: Casillero Del Diablo Reserva Carmenere
casillero-del-diablo-carmenere.bodyHtml: A signature expression of Chile's emblematic grape, this Reserva Carmenere is celebrated for its deep purple-red hue and smooth, approachable character. The nose is highly expressive, featuring intense notes of black plums, currants, and dark chocolate, accented by the variety’s characteristic hints of green peppercorn and gentle spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and well-structured, offering a velvety texture and polished tannins. Flavors of ripe dark fruit blend seamlessly with subtle toasted oak and coffee notes derived from its aging process. Its balanced acidity and soft finish make it an excellent companion for spicy dishes, grilled meats, and creamy cheeses.

beringer-main-vine-sparkling-white-zin.title: Beringer Main & Vine Chenin Blanc 750ml
beringer-main-vine-sparkling-white-zin.bodyHtml: Beringer Main & Vine Chenin Blanc is a well-balanced wine with aromas and flavors of crisp citrus, melon, and spicy ginger. This wine is meant to be enjoyed with a variety of foods, from Asian and Mexican dishes to a casual backyard barbecue with friends.

bols-blue.title: Bols Blue Curacao Liqueur
bols-blue.bodyHtml: Even though the colour of this liqueur is blue, its flavour is orange! Bols Blue Curaçao liqueur is prepared using a very special type of orange peel and infused with natural botanicals. A delicious and colorful addition to your cocktail.

patron-xo-cafe-tequila-liqueur.title: Patron XO Cafe Coffee Liqueur
patron-xo-cafe-tequila-liqueur.bodyHtml:
Patrón XO Cafe Coffee Liqueur is a legendary, luxurious blend of ultra-premium Patrón Silver tequila and the natural essence of fine Arabica coffee. Sourced from the Mexican states of Jalisco and Veracruz, this beloved spirit set itself apart from traditional coffee liqueurs by opting for a notably dry profile rather than a cloyingly sweet, syrupy one. The higher proof brings out the bold, roasted flavors of the coffee alongside the earthy, peppery notes of the cooked agave base. Though famously discontinued in 2021 (and occasionally seen in limited re-releases), it remains an iconic benchmark in the coffee liqueur category, prized for its exceptional balance and versatility as both a sipper and a premium cocktail ingredient.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate truffles, classic tiramisu, fresh churros with chocolate dipping sauce, premium vanilla bean ice cream, and aged savory cheeses like Manchego.

Tasting Notes : Deep, opaque dark brown in appearance with a smooth, velvety, and medium-bodied mouthfeel that elegantly coats the glass.

Nose : Intense and inviting, leading with bold aromas of freshly roasted espresso beans and dark cocoa, underscored by subtle hints of sweet vanilla and the distinct earthy, herbal scent of roasted agave.

Palate : Bold, rich, and decidedly dry. It delivers a robust wave of fresh espresso, roasted nuts, and dark chocolate, gracefully balanced by the peppery bite and mild agave sweetness of the Patrón Silver base, preventing it from feeling overly confectionery.

Finish : Smooth, clean, and notoriously dry, fading elegantly with lingering notes of dark roasted coffee, subtle vanilla, and the gentle warming heat of premium tequila.

Serve : Serve chilled neat, on the rocks, poured directly over vanilla ice cream, or as the robust foundation for a premium Espresso Martini or Baby Stout cocktail.

patron-silver-tequila-1.title: Patron Silver Tequila
patron-silver-tequila-1.bodyHtml:
Patrón Silver Tequila is a smooth, handcrafted ultra-premium blanco tequila produced in small batches at the Hacienda Patrón distillery in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Made from 100% Weber Blue Agave harvested at peak maturity, the agave piñas are slowly baked in traditional brick ovens, crushed using both a volcanic stone tahona wheel and a modern roller mill, fermented, and distilled in small copper pot stills. Bottled immediately without aging, it captures the crisp, pure, and vibrant essence of fresh sweet agave balanced with bright citrus and subtle peppery notes.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh ceviche, grilled shrimp tacos, guacamole with tortilla chips, seared scallops, citrus-marinated chicken, and fresh queso fresco.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and bright with a smooth, light-to-medium body and a clean, crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh cooked agave, sweet citrus zest, green pear, white flowers, and subtle herbal notes.

Palate : Crisp and smooth with flavors of sweet roasted agave, lemon and lime peel, fresh tropical fruit, and a touch of cracked white pepper.

Finish : Clean, light, and warming with lingering notes of sweet agave and gentle black pepper spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tequila tasting glass or flute, chilled on the rocks with a lime wedge, or as the crisp foundation in classic cocktails such as a Margarita or Paloma.

four-vines-old-vine-zinfandel.title: 7 Deadly Wines Old Vine Zinfandel 2022 750ml
four-vines-old-vine-zinfandel.bodyHtml: This Zinfandel explodes with sweet plums and pepper dominates on the nose along with blueberries, ripe raspberries, vanilla and sweet spices on the palate. It is full, rich and jammy with soft velvety tannins and lots of flavour.

bowmore-18-year-old.title: Bowmore 18 Year Old
bowmore-18-year-old.bodyHtml:
A masterful combination of ripe fruit, dark chocolate and Islay smoke.

Cosseted away in the finest, hand-selected oak casks and allowed to mature at its own sedate pace, this is one of the most remarkable, perfectly balanced single malt scotch whiskies of its kind. One of our rarest whiskies, bottles of Bowmore 18 Year Old may be limited, but there's no end to its enjoyment.

beringer-main-vine-chardonnay.title: Beringer Main & Vine Chardonnay 750ml
beringer-main-vine-chardonnay.bodyHtml: A wonderfully approachable and refreshing wine. Full of lush fruit flavors and aromas, the bright citrus perfectly offsets the honeyed apricot, culminating in a smooth, delicious wine with a lasting finish. A wine that immediately conjures up the bounty and sunshine of California.

benromach-10-year-old.title: Benromach 10 Year Old Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
benromach-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Benromach 10 Year Old is the signature single malt of the Benromach distillery in Forres, Speyside, founded in 1898 and owned by Gordon & MacPhail. The whisky is made by hand and matured exclusively in first-fill casks: it spends most of its decade in a mix of bourbon and sherry casks before finishing its final year in sherry casks, which gives it rich, lasting sherry notes. Benromach pairs that with a subtle touch of smoke, delicate forest fruits and creamy malt. It carries natural colour and is bottled at 43% ABV, here in the 750ml size. Benromach 10 has won Gold at the World Whiskies Awards in the Speyside 12 years and under category.

Tasting Notes: forest fruits, creamy malt, light smoke, sherry, ginger, oak

Nose: Dry barley, malt and oak with pine, fruit, sweet spice, a hint of prune and maple fudge.

Palate: Barley and malt, slightly herbal and grassy, with a little fruit and ground ginger.

Finish: Bittersweet, with ginger and dry sherry.

Serve: Neat, or with a dash of water.

cassone-obra-prima-reserve-malbec.title: Trivento Golden Reserve Malbec 2023
cassone-obra-prima-reserve-malbec.bodyHtml:
Trivento Golden Reserve Malbec 2023 is a premium, estate-grown Argentinian red wine that presents an intense, deep red color with vibrant violet hues. The aromatic profile is highly expressive, unfolding with sharp layers of fresh red and dark fruits like raspberries, blackberries, and spiced black cherries, woven together with subtle notes of chocolate, lavender, graphite, and toasted hazelnut from careful oak aging. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied experience with a juicy, rounded structure and firm, energetic tannins that lead into a remarkably smooth and lengthy finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak with chimichurri sauce, roasted lamb cutlets, barbecued brisket, empanadas, and strong, hard cheeses like aged Gouda or Manchego.

93 Points - James Suckling

Some fine spices with a touch of cocoa powder to the black cherries and berries. Medium- to full-bodied with plenty of juicy blue fruit and firm, fresh tannins. Solid fruit in the lengthy finish. Really well-balanced. Drink now or hold.

absolut-apple-vodka.title: Absolut Watermelon Vodka
absolut-apple-vodka.bodyHtml:
Absolut Watermelon Vodka is a refreshing flavoured vodka produced by The Absolut Company in Åhus, Sweden. Crafted with natural watermelon flavour and no added sugar, this vibrant expression captures the juicy sweetness of ripe watermelon while maintaining Absolut's signature smooth character. Fresh melon aromas lead into a light, fruity palate with subtle cucumber notes and a clean, refreshing finish. Bottled at 38% ABV, Absolut Watermelon is a versatile spirit ideal for summer cocktails, sparkling mixers, and entertaining.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp, watermelon and feta salad, spicy chicken tacos, fresh fruit platters, citrus-marinated seafood, and light summer appetizers.

Tasting Notes: Fresh and fruity, featuring ripe watermelon, subtle cucumber, natural melon sweetness, and a smooth, refreshing character.

Nose: Juicy watermelon, fresh melon, delicate cucumber, and subtle fruity sweetness.

Palate: Ripe watermelon, soft melon sweetness, light cucumber notes, and a clean vodka base.

Finish: Smooth and refreshing, with lingering watermelon and delicate fruit sweetness.

Serve: Enjoy chilled over ice, mixed with soda water or lemonade, or in a Watermelon Spritz or Watermelon Cosmopolitan.

vex-kiwi-mango.title: Vizzy Exotic Twist Max Variety Pack 12 Cans
vex-kiwi-mango.bodyHtml:
Vizzy Exotic Twist Max Variety Pack 12 Cans 7% is a high-ABV hard seltzer variety pack produced by Molson Coors under the Vizzy brand. Formulated at a bold 7% ABV, this 12-can variety pack features four vibrant dual-fruit flavour combinations: Papaya Pineapple, Dragonfruit Mango, Blueberry White Peach, and Passionfruit Kiwi. Each style delivers a higher-proof wave of tropical refreshment with active effervescence, balancing sweet and sour fruit notes.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp tacos, spicy Thai noodles, citrus-marinated chicken, fresh fruit platters, or summer salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear appearance with bright effervescence and a crisp, light, yet full-flavoured mouthfeel across the assortment.

Nose : Tropical aromas featuring sweet papaya, juicy pineapple, exotic dragonfruit, ripe mango, fragrant blueberry, white peach, tart passionfruit, and kiwi.

Palate : Crisp and lively with a balance of sweet and sour fruit notes, showcasing bold dual-fruit flavours of tropical papaya-pineapple, dragonfruit-mango, sweet blueberry-peach, and zesty passionfruit-kiwi.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering sweet tropical fruit notes and a bubbly carbonated finish.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled straight from a cold tall can or poured over fresh ice in a glass.

original-16-pale-ale.title: Original16 Pale Ale 15 Cans
original-16-pale-ale.bodyHtml: A smooth, refreshing beer, with a real beer taste. Brewed using only the finest, two-row Prairie barley, five choice hop varietals, and 100% Copeland malt.

southern-comfort-whiskey-liqueur-3.title: Southern Comfort Original Whiskey Liqueur 1.14L
southern-comfort-whiskey-liqueur-3.bodyHtml:
Southern Comfort Original is the whiskey liqueur created by M.W. Heron in New Orleans in 1874. The Canadian bottling is produced in Quebec for Sazerac and bottled at 35% ABV; this is the 1.14L bottle. Deep amber in colour, it balances sweetness and spice, with ripe apricot, peach, cinnamon and vanilla leading into a sweet, luscious palate and a long, warm finish. Smooth and easygoing, it is equally at home over ice or as the base for classic mixed drinks.

Nose: Ripe apricot, peach, cinnamon and vanilla.

Palate: Sweet and luscious with spice.

Finish: Long and warm.

Serve: Over ice, with cola, or with orange juice and lemon.

vex-strawberry-smoothie.title: Tres Agaves Organic Strawberry Margarita Mix 1L
vex-strawberry-smoothie.bodyHtml: Got an easy, go-to strawberry margarita recipe? Now you do. Our Organic Strawberry Margarita & Daiquiri Mix is crafted from just five all-natural ingredients: organic strawberry purée, organic agave nectar, organic lime juice, pure filtered water, and Vitamin C. Together, these simple ingredients complement Tequila’s unique taste profile while delivering a soothing, soul-replenishing taste of summer. No wonder our Strawberry Margarita & Daiquiri Mix is among the best-tasting, healthiest mixes out there. And the perfect base for one of the classic tequila drinks. Together, our simple ingredients complement Tequila’s unique taste profile while delivering a soothing, soul-replenishing taste of summer.

hennessy-paradis-cognac.title: Hennessy Paradis Cognac
hennessy-paradis-cognac.bodyHtml:
Hennessy Paradis Cognac is an ultra-premium, incredibly elegant French cognac created in 1979 by legendary Master Blender Maurice Fillioux. Named after the historic "Paradis" cellar—the founder's cellar where the house of Hennessy stores its oldest and most precious eaux-de-vie—this masterpiece is a harmonious blend of up to 100 different eaux-de-vie that have been aged for up to 130 years. Primarily sourced from the prestigious Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne crus, it is celebrated worldwide for its voluptuous complexity, silky finesse, and exceptional depth of flavor.

Food Pairing: Seared duck breast with cherry reduction, candied orange peel dipped in dark chocolate, glazed pork tenderloin, or premium blue cheeses like Roquefort.

TASTING NOTES - A deep, luminous amber with rich coppery highlights. It possesses a highly velvety, voluptuous, and remarkably silk-like mouthfeel that coats the palate in luxurious warmth and deep, refined oiliness.

NOSE - Extremely elegant and floral, revealing a delicate bouquet of dried roses and honeysuckle, deeply layered with sweet spices, cinnamon, cardamom, candied fruits, and subtle notes of honey and rancio wood.

PALATE - Rich and incredibly smooth, offering an explosion of ripe peaches, dried apricots, and crystallized oranges, which melt into deeper flavors of sweet vanilla, fresh honey, roasted nuts, truffle, and warm oak spices.

FINISH - Monumentally long, smooth, and persistent, fading gracefully with lingering notes of dark chocolate, sweet spices, light smoke, and highly mature rancio oak.

SERVE - Best served neat at room temperature in a tulip glass, allowing the complex aromas to develop fully. It is also excellent served over a single large block of clear, slow-melting ice in a heavy tumbler.

black-sage-cabernet-franc.title: Black Sage Cabernet Franc 2023
black-sage-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml:
The nose has pleasant notes of red berries, some red currants, dried strawberries, and smoky mocha notes. The flavours on the nose carry over to the palate. With bright red fruits, mocha and vanilla, and some hints of spice on the finish. The acidity is lively and the tannins are firm yet approachable.
Pair with rack of lamb, venison, duck breast, slow-cooked pork, sauteed mushrooms and mature, hard cheese.

appleton-12-year-old-rare-casks-1.title: Appleton Estate 12 Year Old Rare Casks Rum 1L
appleton-12-year-old-rare-casks-1.bodyHtml: Appleton Estate Rare Blend 12 Year Old is a ‘minimum age’ rum as indicated by the number 12 displayed on the bottle. The rum is carefully aged in Number One Select American Oak barrels for a deep bronze, honey color and bittersweet, luscious finish.

deadbolt-red.title: Decoy California Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
deadbolt-red.bodyHtml:
Decoy California Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a lush, alluring, and refined red wine crafted under the esteemed Duckhorn Portfolio. This highly approachable expression opens with an inviting bouquet of vibrant red and blue fruits, showcasing aromas of ripe black cherry, blackberry, and plum accented by subtle hints of nutmeg, sweet baking spices, and bittersweet cocoa. On the palate, it delivers a succulent and well-rounded mouthfeel, where layers of dark berry and raspberry fruit are framed by silky, polished tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a long, luxurious finish with nuanced touches of toasted oak.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, wood-fired burgers, roasted lamb chops, or rich pasta dishes with a savory meat ragù.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Dark berry and plum aromas on the nose of this bottling are cut by nutmeg, cola and bittersweet cocoa touches. The palate is quite dry with flavors of dark-chocolate flake and oregano, as dark berry fills in the fruit tones. A very classic California Cab.

epica-red-blend.title: Derange Red Blend by The Prisoner 2021 / 2022
epica-red-blend.bodyHtml:
The dark and silky appearance of the 2022 Dérangé Red Blend is inviting, and the nose, featuring bramble fruit, dark cherry, and graham cracker, suggests a rich and nuanced aromatic experience. 

On the palate, the soft, juicy tannins paired with flavors of vanilla, toasty oak, and black sweet fruit paint a picture of complexity and depth. The hints of cassis and plum skin add layers of richness, while the herbal notes of bay leaf and sage provide a refreshing and sophisticated touch. This combination of elements embodies a wine that’s both approachable and intriguing, with a nice balance of fruit and savory elements.

alley-kat-variety-pack-1.title: Alley Kat Seven Variety Pack Seltzer 12 Cans
alley-kat-variety-pack-1.bodyHtml: Alley Kat Seven Variety Pack Seltzer 12 Cans

bulleit-rye.title: Bulleit 10 Year Old Bourbon
bulleit-rye.bodyHtml:
Bulleit 10 Year Old Bourbon is a premium Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey aged for a full decade in charred American white oak barrels. Selected from reserve barrels set aside by the master blender, this high-rye bourbon offers an exceptionally smooth, rich, and complex sipping experience with a refined balance of deep oak and vibrant spice.

Food Pairing: Ribeye steak, smoked brisket, dark chocolate truffles, aged gouda, or maple-glazed bacon.

Tasting Notes : Deep russet amber in color with a rich, smooth, and moderately viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet oak, dark cherries, toasted caramel, dried fruit, and subtle baking spices with light floral accents.

Palate : Complex and well-rounded with rich caramel, vanilla, dried apricot, toasted oak, pepper, and warm cinnamon spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and smooth with lingering oak tannins, subtle smoke, and sweet spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn tasting glass or over a large ice cube.

jim-beam-single-barrel-54.title: Jim Beam Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon
jim-beam-single-barrel-54.bodyHtml:
A premium step up for any Jim Beam fan. Because it is a Single Barrel release, every bottle is completely unique and drawn from a single, hand-selected cask chosen by the Master Distiller for its exceptional flavor. Generally bottled at a robust 108 proof (54% ABV) to preserve its bold, uncut character, this bourbon delivers an intense, rich, and highly complex tasting experience that highlights the very best of what the distillery has to offer.

NOSE

Deep and aromatic with heavy notes of toasted oak, rich vanilla bean, dark caramel, and a hint of sweet tobacco.

PALATE

Bold, rich, and full-bodied. Prominent flavors of dark brown sugar, roasted nuts, baked apple, and heavy baking spices coat the palate.

FINISH

Exceptionally long, warming, and robust with lingering sweet oak and cinnamon spice.

kraken-black-spiced.title: The Kraken Black Spiced Rum 50ml
kraken-black-spiced.bodyHtml: One of the fastest growing rum brands, The Kraken® is the world’s first black spiced rum, housed in an iconic bottle. Taste the flavors of cinnamon, vanilla, and nutmeg and experience its magic. The Kraken® Original is 94 proof. It has a distinct aroma of caramel, toffee and spice with flavors of cinnamon and vanilla and a lingering spicy finish. (47% ABV - 94 proof) The Kraken®, blended with secret spices, is perfect to spice up classics and new favorite cocktails or as a shot.

bodacious-smooth-white-2.title: Bodacious Smooth White 3L Bag In Box
bodacious-smooth-white-2.bodyHtml:
Bodacious Smooth White is a lively, refreshing, and incredibly crowd-pleasing Canadian white blend crafted for easy-drinking appeal and casual entertaining. Displaying a clean, pale straw color, it opens with an aromatic and lifted bouquet filled with sweet aromas of ripe pears, crisp green apples, and juicy cantaloupe melon, subtly accented by soft floral notes and fresh herbs. On the palate, this light-to-medium-bodied white wine is intentionally off-dry and medium-sweet, featuring a wonderfully smooth, juicy, and fruit-forward profile. Its vibrant fruit concentration is balanced by a soft, approachable acidity, making it exceptionally refreshing and highly accessible for any social occasion.

Food Pairing: This off-dry white pairs wonderfully with light appetizers, fresh summer salads, spicy Asian cuisine, sweet chili chicken skewers, or fruit-and-cheese platters.

wild-rose-industrial-park-ale-1.title: Wild Rose Industrial Park Ale 4 Tall Cans
wild-rose-industrial-park-ale-1.bodyHtml: A beautiful copper-coloured ale, rich in caramel malt character and well balanced with plenty of hops; handcrafted for the true ale drinker. We recognize the birthplace of our brewery in Calgary’s Foothills Industrial Park with this time-honoured recipe for a well-balanced IPA .

wild-rose-wraspberry-ale-1.title: Wild Rose Wraspberry
wild-rose-wraspberry-ale-1.bodyHtml: Wild Rose Wraspberry is a beloved Alberta craft classic and the signature fruit ale from Calgary’s Wild Rose Brewery. This award-winning beer is brewed with a massive amount of real raspberries, which imparts its strikingly vibrant pink-red colour and an unmistakable bouquet of fresh-picked berries. Unlike many fruit beers that rely on syrups, Wraspberry maintains a "crystalline precision" by balancing its lush, jammy sweetness with a crisp, tart finish and a subtle wheaty backbone. On the palate, it is light-bodied and exceptionally refreshing, making it one of the most popular "patio beers" in Western Canada.

wild-rose-barracks-brown-ale-1.title: Wild Rose Barracks Brown Ale 6 Bottles

tool-shed-star-cheek-ipa-1.title: Tool Shed Star Cheek Ipa 6 Cans

nz-pure.title: Alberta Pure Vodka 1.75L
nz-pure.bodyHtml:
Alberta Pure Vodka is a Canadian vodka distilled by Alberta Distillers in Calgary, Alberta. Crafted from 100% locally grown Western Canadian prairie grain and blended with pure, glacier-fed Rocky Mountain water, it undergoes a triple distillation and charcoal filtration process to yield a clean, neutral, and exceptionally smooth spirit.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, caviar, pickled herring, oysters on the half shell, charcuterie, and pierogies.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and bright in appearance, featuring a crisp, light, and clean mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and subtle with faint notes of neutral grain and fresh mineral water.

Palate : Smooth and light-bodied with mild grain sweetness, delicate wheat notes, and a clean, neutral character.

Finish : Short, crisp, and refreshing with a soft, clean end.

Serve : Best served well-chilled, neat, over ice, or as a versatile base in cocktails such as a Vodka Soda, Caesar, or Moscow Mule.

tool-shed-belgian-dip-belgian-ipa.title: Tool Shed Star Cheek IPA 4 Tall Cans
tool-shed-belgian-dip-belgian-ipa.bodyHtml: Tool Shed Star Cheek IPA 4 Tall Cans

bacardi-oakheart-spiced-cola.title: Bacardi Spiced & Cola 473ml
bacardi-oakheart-spiced-cola.bodyHtml: A convenient and flavorful ready-to-drink cocktail. It brings together the warm, rich flavors of Bacardi Spiced Rum—with notes of vanilla, cinnamon, and nutmeg—and the classic taste of cola for a smooth, balanced, and refreshing experience

catdaddy-spiced-moonshine.title: Ole Smoky Moonshine Cherries
catdaddy-spiced-moonshine.bodyHtml:
The legendary "Appalachian Party Favor" that packs a serious punch! Ole Smoky Moonshine Cherries are not just a flavored spirit; every single mason jar is packed to the brim with real, whole maraschino cherries that have been left to soak in a high-octane bath of 100-proof original moonshine. As the cherries rest, they naturally sweeten the harsh white lightning, while simultaneously absorbing the strong alcohol, resulting in a dangerously delicious boozy treat.

Bottled at a full 100 proof (50% ABV), the liquid itself takes on a bright, syrupy cherry flavor combined with a fiery, white whiskey burn. The real star of the show, however, is eating the cherries themselves. They are the ultimate garnish for a high-end cocktail, a fantastic high-proof shooter alternative, or a guaranteed conversation starter at your next party.

mad-jack-root-beer.title: Crazy Uncle Hard Root Beer 473ml
mad-jack-root-beer.bodyHtml: A delightful twist on a classic favorite, blending the nostalgic flavors of traditional root beer with a spirited kick. This unique beverage boasts rich, creamy notes of vanilla and sassafras, complemented by a hint of wintergreen and a touch of spice. Smooth, rich flavour of natural sarsaparilla, sweet birch, wintergreen and licorice root with a creamy vanilla finish. Crisp and refreshing without being overly sweet.

rumchata-cream-liquor.title: RumChata Cream Liqueur
rumchata-cream-liquor.bodyHtml:
RumChata is a cream liqueur inspired by horchata, the cinnamon-scented drink of Spain and Latin America; its label sums it up as "Horchata con Ron". It blends Caribbean rum with real dairy cream and is flavoured with sweet vanilla and warm cinnamon, giving a smooth, creamy sip. The liqueur is made in Wisconsin and bottled at 13.75% ABV in the brand's white 750ml bottle with a gold cap. Its versatility is a big part of its appeal: it can be enjoyed chilled as a shot, poured over ice, stirred into coffee in place of creamer or used in sweet, dessert-style cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Milky white, rich and full.

Nose: Spice, ginger, toast and vanilla.

Palate: Creamy and sweet, with honeycomb and spiced flavours.

Serve: Chilled as a shot, on the rocks, in coffee or in cocktails.

root-sellers-pedal-hard-ginger-beer.title: Root Sellers Pedal Hard Ginger Beer 4 Tall Cans
root-sellers-pedal-hard-ginger-beer.bodyHtml: Root Sellers Pedal Hard Ginger Beer 4 Tall Cans

new-belgium-voodoo-ranger-ipa-1.title: Brave New Spirits Whisky of Voodoo Serpent's Ember Blair Athol 11 Year Old 53.2% ABV
new-belgium-voodoo-ranger-ipa-1.bodyHtml:
Brave New Spirits Whisky of Voodoo Serpent's Ember is an adventurous 11 Year Old Highland single malt from Blair Athol Distillery. Released as part of Batch #3 of the Whisky of Voodoo series, this small-batch expression combines whisky matured in first-fill Rum casks and second-fill Islay hogsheads before bottling at a robust 53.2% ABV.

The unusual combination of rum and Islay casks brings tropical sweetness and subtle smoky character to Blair Athol's rich Highland malt. Ripe orchard fruit, caramelized sweetness and creamy vanilla are complemented by dried fruit, herbal nuances and gentle dying embers.

Food Pairing: Pair with barbecued pork, smoked cheddar, grilled pineapple, toasted nuts, apple crumble or caramel-based desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and expressive with red apple, tropical sweetness, creamy vanilla and subtle smoke balanced by mineral and herbaceous notes.

Nose: Rum raisin, malted barley and tropical citrus zest with red apple, sweet vanilla and a touch of smoke.

Palate: Creamy and full-bodied with vanilla, banana, dried apricot and caramelized sweetness followed by mineral and herbal notes.

Finish: Medium-long with apricot pastry, lingering malt sweetness and subtle dying embers.

carlsberg-lager.title: Carlsberg 6 Bottles
carlsberg-lager.bodyHtml: Carlsberg is a classic Danish pilsner known for its well-balanced and refreshing taste. Brewed since 1847, this iconic beer is characterized by its crisp hop bitterness, subtle malt sweetness, and a clean, smooth finish. Its distinctive flavor profile makes it a globally recognized and perfectly sessionable European lager.

dusty-boots-hard-orange-cream.title: Dusty Boots Hard Orange Cream 6 Cans

beringer-main-vine-rose.title: Beringer Main & Vine White Zinfandel 750ml
beringer-main-vine-rose.bodyHtml:
Our signature varietal, this wine is always a crowd pleaser. In making White Zinfandel, the focus is to highlight the fresh red berry, citrus and melon aromas and flavors, and round them out with subtle hints of nutmeg and clove. This wine has a youthful exuberance that is enjoyable as a sipper on its own, or with a variety of dishes.

86 Points - Wine Enthusiast
"A sweet and refreshing blush wine with prominent strawberry and watermelon flavors. Light-bodied and slightly fizzy, it's a straightforward, crowd-pleasing choice."

breezer-sparkling-raspberry-lemon.bodyHtml: Breezer Tropical Orange Smoothie is a premium cooler made with Bacardi rum. It features a dreamy blend of orange and vanilla flavours, creating a taste that is reminiscent of a classic orange creamsicle. This ready-to-drink cocktail is best served well chilled for a refreshing, smooth experience

wild-rose-high-harvest-session-ale.title: Wild Rose The Hoppy Herd Mix Pack 8 Tall Cans
wild-rose-high-harvest-session-ale.bodyHtml:
Wild Rose The Hoppy Herd Mix Pack 8 Tall Cans is a diverse craft beer collection produced by Wild Rose Brewery in Calgary, Alberta. Featuring two 473 mL tall cans of four distinct hop-forward styles—Alberta Slammer Tropical Pale Ale, Horns in the Haze New England IPA, Sun Scout Hazy India Session Ale, and IPA (Industrial Park Ale)—this mix pack showcases a wide spectrum of hoppy flavor profiles ranging from juicy citrus and tropical fruit to crisp, resinous pine and sessionable haze.

Food Pairing: Spicy barbecue, bacon cheeseburgers, buffalo chicken wings, sharp cheddar cheese, or fish tacos.

Tasting Notes : Ranging from straw gold to hazy orange and deep amber across the four styles, featuring lively carbonation and medium-light to full, mouth-coating textures.

Nose : A complex bouquet of tropical mango, passionfruit, juicy citrus zest, sweet stone fruit, pine resin, and toasted malt.

Palate : Dynamic and hop-forward, delivering notes of juicy tropical fruit, bright grapefruit, sweet malt backbone, soft oat smooth haze, and crisp, piney hop bitterness.

Finish : Clean, dry, and refreshing with lingering hop bitterness, tropical fruit notes, and a crisp malt finish.

Serve : Serve well-chilled in a tulip or IPA glass to release hop aromatics, or straight from a cold tall can.

schweppes-blueberry-elderberry-cocktail.title: Donna Italian Spritz Elderflower
schweppes-blueberry-elderberry-cocktail.bodyHtml:
Donna Italian Spritz Elderflower is a elderflower-flavoured Italian-style spritz from Dame Beverage Co. of Ontario, Canada, made under its Donna line, which the company sums up as Italian roots with Canadian sparkle. It is bottled at 5% ABV in a 355ml format.

Serve: Well chilled, over ice, with a citrus slice.

wild-rose-electric-avenue-blond.title: Wild Rose Electric Avenue Blond 6 Bottles

beringer-brothers-chardonnay.title: Beringer Brothers Bourbon Barrel Aged Red Wine Blend 2020
beringer-brothers-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
This wine is bursting with aromas of ripe black cherry, dark chocolate, and vanilla. The palate is lush with ripe tannins and and integrated acidity, showcasing toasted hazelnuts, toffee, and blackberry preserves on the finish.

86 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This smooth and slightly soft wine offers gentle dark-plum, milk-chocolate and vanilla flavors. It's full bodied and low in acidity.

beringer-brothers-red-blend.title: Beringer Brothers Bourbon Barrel Aged Red Wine Blend 2020

This wine is bursting with aromas of ripe black cherry, dark chocolate, and vanilla. The palate is lush with ripe tannins and and integrated acidity, showcasing toasted hazelnuts, toffee, and blackberry preserves on the finish.

86 Points - Wine Enthusiast

appleton-15-year-old-black-river-casks-1.title: Appleton Estate 15 Year Old Black River Casks Rum
appleton-15-year-old-black-river-casks-1.bodyHtml: Appleton Estate 15 Year Old is a tribute to the Black River, the source of the limestone-filtered water used in all of Appleton Estate rums. The blend of rare pot and column still rums have all been aged for a minimum of 15 years. A Beautiful copper hue appearance with a honey gold ring of age this rum is rich and full-bodied. With aromas of toasted almond and hazelnut, followed by notes of orange peel, vanilla and hints of roasted coffee and molasses you'll regret having only five senses.

fitzsimmons-big-hill-blonde.title: Fitzsimmons Big Hill Blonde 4 Tall Cans

fitzsimmons-east-lake-amber.title: Fitzsimmons East Lake Amber 4 Tall Cans

annex-force-majeure-1.title: Annex Force Majeure 4 Tall Cans
annex-force-majeure-1.bodyHtml:
Annex Force Majeure is a standout New England Hazy IPA crafted by Annex Ale Project in Calgary. Known for its intensely juicy, dank, and tropical profile, this double dry-hopped ale showcases a vibrant blend of Cryo Mosaic, Bru-1, and Vic Secret hops. With its deliberately soft and hazy character, it delivers a fruit-forward experience that remains remarkably smooth, making it a highly sought-after favorite in the Alberta craft beer scene.

Food Pairing: Baja fish tacos with mango salsa, spicy Thai green curry, classic smash burgers, grilled pineapple, or a sharp, aged cheddar cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep, opaque, and hazy golden-yellow in appearance, capped with a dense, fluffy white head, offering a soft, smooth, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : A massive burst of tropical and citrus fruit, leading with vibrant mango, passion fruit, fresh citrus zest, and a distinct underlying dank, resinous hop aroma.

Palate : Extraordinarily juicy and soft, washing the palate with sweet tropical flavors of mango, pineapple, and citrus peel, perfectly balanced by a mild, approachable bitterness and a subtle resinous dankness.

Finish : Smooth, lingering, and fruit-forward, leaving a clean, mildly bitter citrus and tropical fruit essence that invites the next sip.

Serve : Serve well-chilled (around 45-50°F / 7-10°C) straight from the tall can or poured into a tulip or IPA glass to concentrate the intense hop aromatics.

med-hat-burnside-blood-orange-1.title: Med Hat Burnside Blood Orange 4 Tall Cans
med-hat-burnside-blood-orange-1.bodyHtml: Med Hat Burnside Blood Orange 4 Tall Cans

ungava-gin.title: Ungava Gin
ungava-gin.bodyHtml:
Ungava Gin is a Canadian gin from Quebec, made with botanicals gathered in the Canadian North. Its recipe uses Nordic juniper, Labrador tea, crowberry, cloudberry, wild rose hip and an Arctic blend, and those botanicals give the gin its natural lemon-yellow colour, which makes it easy to spot on the back bar. The label notes 100% natural ingredients. It is bottled at 43.1% ABV in a 750ml bottle, and pairs a classic juniper backbone with herbal tea notes, spice and tart northern fruit.

Tasting Notes: Juniper and herbal tea with spice and tart berry fruit.

Nose: Juniper, herbal tea, spice and tart fruit.

Palate: Dry and medium-bodied.

Finish: Warm and spicy.

Serve: With tonic and a twist of citrus, or in a Martini or Negroni.

phillips-oro-blanco-grapefruit-sour.title: Phillips Oro Blanco Grapefruit Sour 4 Tall Cans
phillips-oro-blanco-grapefruit-sour.bodyHtml: Phillips Oro Blanco Grapefruit Sour 4 Tall Cans

lonetree-peach-apple-cider.bodyHtml: We believe the old ways are still the best. That's why we always use genuine apples to craft our authentic cider selections. Now, we've added a zesty twist of real ginger, for an exotic and lightly spicy cider experience. We know you'll taste the difference. This cider is crafted with locally sourced genuine apples, making it naturally gluten-free.

Hanalei Island IPA is brewed with passionfruit, orange, and guava (POG) for a crisp, aromatic, and sessionable beer with a tropical Hawaiian twist. It combines a hoppy aroma with a balanced, fruity profile for a coppery ale that reflects the spirit of the islands

long-hop-brewing-pale-ale.title: Long Hop Hazy Pale With Fresh Hops
long-hop-brewing-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Long Hop Hazy Pale With Fresh Hops

smirnoff-caesar-1.title: Smirnoff Vodka 1.75L
smirnoff-caesar-1.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff No. 21 Vodka is a classic, globally recognized vodka originally created in 1864. Renowned for its purity and versatility, it undergoes a rigorous triple distillation process and is filtered ten times through seven columns of environmentally sustainable charcoal. This meticulous production method yields a pristine, neutral, and exceptionally smooth spirit that has become a staple for mixologists worldwide.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon, blinis with caviar, pickled vegetables, cured charcuterie, and light seafood dishes.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear in appearance, delivering a crisp, clean, and light-bodied mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Clean and highly neutral with very faint hints of grain sweetness, subtle black pepper, and light minerality.

Palate : Smooth and neutral with a very subtle touch of sweetness, a hint of charcoal, and light peppery spice.

Finish : Short, crisp, and exceptionally clean.

Serve : Best served well-chilled, neat, over ice, or mixed in classic cocktails such as a Moscow Mule, Bloody Mary, or Vodka Soda.

black-fly-vodka-lime.title: Black Fly Vodka Crushed Purple Mixer Pack 12 Cans
black-fly-vodka-lime.bodyHtml: It’s Pop-Culture Black Fly style. Black Fly’s NEW Vodka Crushed Mixer introduces two crushingly good NEW flavours - Fresh n’ juicy Strawberry Kiwi and Electric Lemon Lime together with popular Grapealicious Vodka Sour Grape and fan favourite Vodka Crushed Orange. 4 Great Flavours. Perfect to pop with friends.

alley-kat-fish-bone-new-england-ipa.title: Alley Kat Ryed The Storm Rye Ipa
alley-kat-fish-bone-new-england-ipa.bodyHtml: Alley Kat Ryed The Storm Rye Ipa

new-belgium-fat-tire-1.title: Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon
new-belgium-fat-tire-1.bodyHtml:
Blanton's Original Single Barrel Bourbon is a landmark Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey widely recognized as the world's first commercially available single barrel bourbon, introduced in 1984 by Master Distiller Elmer T. Lee. Named in honor of Colonel Albert B. Blanton, who spent over five decades managing the historic Buffalo Trace Distillery (formerly the George T. Stagg Distillery), each bottle is drawn from an individual cask aged in the center-cut section of Warehouse H—the only metal-clad warehouse on the distillery grounds, known for rapid temperature fluctuations that accelerate wood interaction. Crafted from Buffalo Trace's high-rye Mashbill #2 and bottled at 93 proof, it delivers a rich, complex, and remarkably balanced profile of sweet vanilla, citrus, caramel, and warm baking spices, housed in its iconic round bottle topped with a collectible cast-metal horse and jockey stopper.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-smoked beef brisket, glazed pork ribs, seared duck breast, aged sharp cheddar or Gouda, dark chocolate pecan tarts, and warm bread pudding with caramel sauce.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber with warm copper-orange highlights, presenting a full, rich body with a velvety, smooth, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Warm vanilla, honey, caramel, dried orange peel, toasted oak, nutmeg, and subtle rye spice.

Palate : Rich and creamy with flavors of burnt sugar, sweet corn, dark toffee, clove, cinnamon, citrus zest, and seasoned charred oak.

Finish : Long, smooth, and warming with lingering notes of sweet vanilla, baking spices, honey, and subtle dry oak tannins.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn or rocks glass, over a single large ice cube, or as the rich centerpiece in classic cocktails such as an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

original-16-copper-ale.title: Original 16 Copper 15 Cans
original-16-copper-ale.bodyHtml: A smooth and refreshing beer brewed with 100% two-row Prairie barley, a blend of roasted black and caramel malts, and five hop varietals

caltha-rosehip-calendula-grisette.title: Caltha Rosehip & Calendula Grisette 4 Tall Cans

hawk-tail-double-ipa.title: Hawk Tail IPA 4 Tall Cans
hawk-tail-double-ipa.bodyHtml: An American-style IPA featuring classic, old-school hops for a bold, hop-forward experience with robust bitterness and flavours of stone fruit and floral notes

bruxa-lime-margarita.title: Jose Cuervo Lime Margarita 1.75L
bruxa-lime-margarita.bodyHtml:
Jose Cuervo Lime Margarita 1.75L is the ultimate party-sized, ready-to-serve cocktail that brings the classic flavors of Mexico straight to your glass. Crafted with authentic Jose Cuervo tequila, premium triple sec, and a perfect balance of tart lime and sweet citrus flavors, this large 1.75-liter bottle is designed for effortless entertaining. There is no need for mixing, shaking, or measuring—simply pour and enjoy a consistently delicious, bar-quality margarita every time.

Food Pairing: This classic margarita pairs flawlessly with festive Mexican fare such as nachos loaded with jalapeños and melted cheese, sizzling steak fajitas, fresh ceviche, or simply a large bowl of tortilla chips and homemade guacamole.

TASTING NOTES - A pale, slightly opaque lime-green liquid that feels smooth, vibrant, and perfectly balanced, delivering a quintessential, thirst-quenching margarita experience.

NOSE - Prominent aromas of freshly squeezed lime juice and sweet citrus zest, backed by the unmistakable earthy, agave notes of classic tequila.

Palate - A harmonious balance of sweet and sour. Zesty lime and bright lemon-citrus notes lead the way, supported by the smooth, warming presence of Jose Cuervo tequila and a touch of orange liqueur sweetness.

FINISH - Clean, tangy, and refreshing, leaving a lingering, pleasant tartness and a mild hint of earthy agave.

SERVE - Simply pour over ice in a salt-rimmed margarita glass and garnish with a fresh wedge of lime. It can also be blended with ice for a quick and easy frozen margarita.

fitzsimmons-pb-lager.title: Gp Brewing Cold One'S Lager 15 Cans
fitzsimmons-pb-lager.bodyHtml: GP Brewing's Cold Ones Lager is described as a well-balanced, crisp lager with flavors of sweet grain and toasted bread, along with subtle caramel notes on the finish according to Liquor Lodge. The lager is brewed by GP Brewing Co in Alberta, Canada.

georgian-bay-gin-smash-1.title: Georgian Bay Gin Smash Mixed Pack 12 Cans
georgian-bay-gin-smash-1.bodyHtml: A crowd favourite! Four flavours of Gin Smash in one convenient pack. Made using craft Canadian gin, the Smash Pack has three 355mL cans of each Cherry Gin Smash, Original Citrus Gin Smash, Cranberry Gin Smash and our new Cucumber Citrus Mint. Flavourful and refreshing!

black-fly-grapefruit-gin-soda-fizz-1.bodyHtml: Black Fly Grapefruit Gin Soda Fizz 4 Cans

good-company-vodka.title: Good Company Vodka 1.14L
good-company-vodka.bodyHtml:
Good Company Vodka is a handcrafted Canadian vodka bottled at 40% ABV, presented here in a 1.14 L bottle. The label notes that it is made from quality Canadian wheat. Good Company is the everyday-spirits label of Latitude 55 Distillery in Grande Prairie, Alberta - a range built to be simple, smooth and easy to mix, priced for casual get-togethers and backyard barbecues. The line was recently refreshed with clean, bold new bottles and labels, while the liquid stays the same. It is crafted in Alberta and made for easy mixing, from a quick Caesar to a simple vodka soda.

Serve: In a Caesar, with soda and a squeeze of lime, or chilled over ice.

alley-kat-bab-smash-session-ale.bodyHtml: Alley Kat Set To Summit Session Ale
