ariel-cabernet-sauvingon-non-alcoholic.title: Ariel Cabernet Sauvingon Non Alcoholic 750ml
ariel-cabernet-sauvingon-non-alcoholic.bodyHtml:
ARIEL oak-aged Cabernet Sauvignon offers aromas of black currants, cherry, blueberries and chocolate, with soft tannins and a dry finish.

Try this with manchego, carne asada, Texas chili, wood-fired pizza.

naked-grape-unoaked-vidal-icewine.title: Peller Estates Vidal Icewine 3x375ml
naked-grape-unoaked-vidal-icewine.bodyHtml:
Peller Estates Vidal Icewine is a Canadian dessert wine crafted from Vidal grapes in Ontario. This three-bottle collection contains three 375ml bottles, offering a rich Icewine expression with concentrated fruit character balanced by refreshing acidity. Each bottle provides a classic introduction to Canada's renowned Icewine style.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with blue cheese, peach tart, creme brulee, or foie gras.

vex-hard-kiwi-mango-lemonade.title: Vizzy Exotic Twist Max Variety Pack 12 Cans
vex-hard-kiwi-mango-lemonade.bodyHtml:
Vizzy Exotic Twist Max Variety Pack 12 Cans 7% is a high-ABV hard seltzer variety pack produced by Molson Coors under the Vizzy brand. Formulated at a bold 7% ABV, this 12-can variety pack features four vibrant dual-fruit flavour combinations: Papaya Pineapple, Dragonfruit Mango, Blueberry White Peach, and Passionfruit Kiwi. Each style delivers a higher-proof wave of tropical refreshment with active effervescence, balancing sweet and sour fruit notes.

Food Pairing: Grilled shrimp tacos, spicy Thai noodles, citrus-marinated chicken, fresh fruit platters, or summer salads.

Tasting Notes : Clear appearance with bright effervescence and a crisp, light, yet full-flavoured mouthfeel across the assortment.

Nose : Tropical aromas featuring sweet papaya, juicy pineapple, exotic dragonfruit, ripe mango, fragrant blueberry, white peach, tart passionfruit, and kiwi.

Palate : Crisp and lively with a balance of sweet and sour fruit notes, showcasing bold dual-fruit flavours of tropical papaya-pineapple, dragonfruit-mango, sweet blueberry-peach, and zesty passionfruit-kiwi.

Finish : Clean, crisp, and refreshing with lingering sweet tropical fruit notes and a bubbly carbonated finish.

Serve : Serve thoroughly chilled straight from a cold tall can or poured over fresh ice in a glass.

golden-wedding-1.title: Golden Wedding Canadian Whisky
golden-wedding-1.bodyHtml:
Golden Wedding is a classic Canadian whisky with a long history. It began as an American whiskey brand that Schenley's Louis Rosenstiel moved to Canada, where it was distilled at Valleyfield, Quebec, before production moved to the Black Velvet distillery in Lethbridge, Alberta. It has loyal followings in pockets across Canada. Simple but not simplistic, it is hot and peppery with plenty of toffee, burnt caramel and nutty dry grain, while rye brings dusty, earthy and flinty notes alongside cooked fruit and a hint of flowers. It finishes with the typical pithiness of Canadian whisky. Bottled at 40% ABV, 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Toffee, burnt caramel, pepper and dry grain with earthy rye.

Palate: Hot and peppery, with toffee, burnt caramel, nutty grain, earthy rye and cooked fruit.

Finish: Pithy and balanced.

Serve: Mixed with ginger ale, on ice in a tall glass, or straight.

jacobs-creek-shiraz-cabernet.title: Jacob's Creek Shiraz Cabernet 750ml
jacobs-creek-shiraz-cabernet.bodyHtml:
87 Points - James Suckling
A reliable and crowd-pleasing Australian blend, offering straightforward notes of dark plum and blackberry with a soft, easy-drinking structure. It's a consistent, value-driven red for everyday enjoyment.
86 Points - Wine Companion
This classic Aussie blend delivers simple, fruity flavors and a smooth finish. An uncomplicated and widely accessible wine that represents dependable quality.

rocca-delle-macie-roccato-super-tuscan.title: Familia Zingarelli Rocca delle Macie Roccato Toscana 2020 750ml
rocca-delle-macie-roccato-super-tuscan.bodyHtml:
Deep ruby red with garnet reflections. Rich in bouquet and persistent, with hints of red berries and spices like cocoa, vanilla and coffee. Tastes warm and well-balanced, with a consistent structure of tannins which support the long finish of the wine.

2019 

93 Points - James Suckling
Lots of blackcurrants, licorice and mint with some graphite on the nose. Medium to full body with integrated tannins and a very long, fresh finish. Rather open already. Another year or two will make it even better.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The full-bodied Rocca delle Macìe 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Roccato (with 6,500 bottles released) shows sweet fruit, dark cherry, toasted almond and milky cinnamon cream. Fourteen months of barrique aging plays a big role in the intensity and textural support of this wine. It feels rich over the palate and thick around the middle.

2020

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is primarily savory, with notes of cured meat, topsoil and graphite, but undertones of sour cherries and tart berries provide some buzz. The ebb and flow of earthiness and astringency continues on the palate, while insistent tannins and lively acidity provide structure for that interplay.

jp-chenet-reserve-merlot-cabernet.title: Jp Chenet Reserve Merlot-Cabernet 2021 750ml
jp-chenet-reserve-merlot-cabernet.bodyHtml: A beautiful deep ruby red, dark and limpid. A bouquet with fine aromas of cherry and blackcurrant enhanced with a light note. With a fine tannic structure, this full, elegant wine finishes on a delicate woody note.

hayes-ranch-in-the-saddle-cabernet-sauvi.title: DAOU Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
hayes-ranch-in-the-saddle-cabernet-sauvi.bodyHtml:
DAOU Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a remarkably rich, elegant, and beautifully structured Californian red wine that sets a benchmark for the incredible potential of Paso Robles mountain terroir. It pours a deep, shimmering ruby-purple color in the glass, unfurling a highly aromatic and expressive bouquet of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with complex notes of dried sage, cocoa dust, and toast. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is exceptionally balanced and fruit-forward, delivering lush, concentrated layers of black raspberry, pomegranate, and blueberry crumble. Its fine-grained, sappy tannins provide excellent structural backbone, while a touch of integrated French oak lends luxurious accents of mocha spice and sweet vanilla that carry through to an impeccably polished finish.

Food Pairing: This robust red pairs excellently with a grilled prime ribeye steak, rosemary-braised lamb shanks, wild mushroom risotto, savory wood-fired pepper pizzas, or mature cheeses like sharp aged Cheddar and Gruyère.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Clean lines of cherry, toasted wood, red flower and a pinch of thyme make for a satisfying nose on this widely available bottling. The palate pairs familiar blackberry flavors with mocha spice.

layer-cake-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Layer Cake Cabernet Sauvignon 2020/2021 750ml
layer-cake-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
91 Points - James Suckling
"A rich and opulent Cabernet with layers of dark fruit, chocolate, and spice. Full-bodied and velvety with a long, lush finish that truly lives up to its name."

jean-louis-blanc-de-blancs.title: Jean Louis Blanc De Blancs 750ml
jean-louis-blanc-de-blancs.bodyHtml: Charles de Fère Cuvée Jean-Louis Blanc de Blancs Brut is a French sparkling wine made by Maison Louis Bouillot, bottled at 11.5% ABV. As a blanc de blancs it is made only from white grapes, which gives a fresh, approachable style built on crisp acidity, fine bubbles and the purity of the fruit. The Brut dosage keeps it dry,. The bottle is dressed in the brand's blue and gold livery under a gold foil capsule. Serve well chilled as an aperitif, with oysters and seafood, or for celebrations. A 750ml bottle.

50th-parallel-estate-pinot-noir.title: 50th Parallel Estate Pinot Noir 2022 750ml
50th-parallel-estate-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: The Estate series, A flagship Pinot Noir, retains the qualities it has been defined by for a decade. Dark Ruby Red Hue. Aromas of Black Cherry, Anise and Hazelnut. Flavours of Dark Ripe Berries, Dark Cocoa and Peppercorn. Silky Tannins with Wet Stone Textures. Silky cocoa powder tannins with a slaty, mineral mouthfeel.

kim-crawford-hawkes-bay-merlot.title: Kim Crawford Hawke's Bay Rose
kim-crawford-hawkes-bay-merlot.bodyHtml: Hawke's Bay is one of New Zealand's oldest wine regions and classic Bordeaux varietals do exceptionally well there. This rosé is made from Merlot and Malbec and will offer pink grapefruit, red currant, floral, red plum and candy notes. Perfect for summer salads or grilled seafood.

la-junta-cabernet-franc-grand-reserve.title: Finca La Sabina Cabernet Gran Reserva
la-junta-cabernet-franc-grand-reserve.bodyHtml: This distinguished Gran Reserva is a flagship expression from the Familia Conesa estate, located at a rare altitude of 1,100 metres in the heart of the Campo de Montiel. Sourced from gravel-rich clay-loam soils, the wine undergoes an extensive aging process of 22 months in French oak barrels. It presents a medium-deep Bordeaux-red hue with brick and ruby reflections, opening with a complex bouquet of ripe compote fruits, spices, and a delicate floral hint of violets. The palate is characterized by poised equilibrium and mature, expressive tannins that provide a fleshy texture, leading to a long, savoury finish.

lady-lola-pinot-grigio-moscato.title: Pelee Island Lola Pinot Grigio
lady-lola-pinot-grigio-moscato.bodyHtml:
Light and refreshing, with pear, green apple, citrus, white peach, and delicate floral notes. The palate is crisp and fruit-forward, offering bright acidity, juicy orchard fruit, and a clean, easy-drinking finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with seafood, grilled fish, sushi, salads, roast chicken, fresh vegetables, light pasta dishes, or mild cheeses.

jijiji-malbec-pinot-noir.title: Meiomi Pinot Noir 2022/2023
jijiji-malbec-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Meiomi Pinot Noir 2022 is a richly textured, opulent, and fruit-forward California red wine crafted from grapes sourced across premier coastal winegrowing regions, including Monterey, Sonoma, and Santa Barbara counties. Fermented using both punch-downs and pump-overs to ensure balanced extraction of color and flavor, the wine is aged for six months in 100% French oak barrels prior to final blending and bottling. In the glass, it displays a deep, luminous ruby-garnet hue. The aromatic bouquet opens with lifted notes of bright strawberry, dark cherry, and ripe raspberry layered with toasted vanilla, mocha, cedar, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a plush, medium-to-full-bodied mouthfeel marked by jammy red and dark berry flavors, gentle tannins, and subtle oak spice, culminating in a smooth, lingering, and off-dry finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled cedar-plank salmon, herb-roasted duck breast, wild mushroom risotto, roasted pork tenderloin, or soft triple-cream Brie and Camembert cheeses.

invivo-x-sarah-jessica-parker-sauv-blanc.title: Invivo X, SJP Sauvignon Blanc 2024 750ml
invivo-x-sarah-jessica-parker-sauv-blanc.bodyHtml: Invivo X, SJP Sauvignon Blanc is a white wine from Marlborough, New Zealand, created by Invivo in collaboration with actress Sarah Jessica Parker. It shows the lifted tropical fruit and citrus that Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc is known for, with a subtle touch of oak that gives a smooth, broad texture and a long finish. Notes of ripe apricot, melon and citrus zest sit on a fleshy frame, with a hint of honeysuckle lingering at the end. Juicy and very drinkable, it suits goat cheese, shellfish, Thai salads and summer patio sipping. This 2024 release comes in a 750ml bottle at 13% alcohol.

gamer-knight-level-2-ipa.title: Gamer Knight Level 2 Ipa 4 Tall Cans

hells-basement-fruit-bat-peach.title: Hell's Basement Fruit Bat Peach 6 Cans

gamble-family-sauvignon-blanc.title: Peller Family Vineyards Sauvignon Blanc 4L Bag in Box
gamble-family-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml: This Sauvignon Blanc is light-bodied and refreshing with flavours of citrus and apple on the palate. Refreshing notes of citrus and white currant linger on the finish.

chateau-moulin-du-cadet-grand-cru-classe.title: Chateau de Ferrand Saint-Emilion Grand Cru Classe 2016
chateau-moulin-du-cadet-grand-cru-classe.bodyHtml:
Château de Ferrand Saint-Émilion Grand Cru Classé 2016 is an elegant, full-bodied Bordeaux red wine from the limestone plateau of Saint-Émilion on France's Right Bank. Produced from 80% Merlot, 15% Cabernet Franc, and 5% Cabernet Sauvignon, this distinguished 2016 vintage combines concentrated dark fruit with refined structure and balanced freshness. Aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, and ripe cherries are complemented by subtle oak and floral complexity. The palate is rich yet lively, with polished tannins, layers of dark berries, and a long, harmonious finish. Classified as Grand Cru Classé, Château de Ferrand showcases the depth and elegance of Saint-Émilion's celebrated terroir.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, duck breast, mushroom risotto, aged Comté, and slow-cooked beef.

 

95 Points - James Suckling

This has very attractive aromas of bright red fruit with a neat array of wild herbs and flowers, too. The palate has a succulent, juicy and fresh feel with stony tannins, delivering length and richness with impressive focus. Great wine. A blend of merlot, cabernet franc and cabernet sauvignon.

black-label-2.title: Goslings Black Seal Rum
black-label-2.bodyHtml:
Goslings Black Seal is a dark rum from Bermuda, bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) in a 750ml bottle; the label calls it Bermuda Black Rum. The producer explains that the blend includes distillates from both pot stills and continuous stills, which it credits for the rum's nuanced character. It follows a Gosling family recipe more than 150 years old, is aged in charred American oak casks, has been exported to the United States since 1980 and is now Bermuda's largest export product. It is the rum used in the Dark 'n Stormy, the trademarked Bermudian cocktail made with Goslings Stormy Ginger Beer and a lime garnish. The colour is a dark copper mahogany.

Tasting Notes: Dark copper mahogany; rich and intricate, with sweet spice, stewed fruit and vanilla.

Nose: Fruitcake, herbs and spice, butterscotch, banana and vanilla.

Palate: Rich and well balanced, with thick sweet spices, stewed fruits and vanilla.

Finish: Spicy, crisp and tingling.

Serve: In a Dark 'n Stormy: fill a tall glass with ice, pour in 6 oz ginger beer and float 2 oz Black Seal on top, with a lime wedge.

black-label-3.title: Copper Tear Reserve Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey
black-label-3.bodyHtml:
Copper Tear Reserve Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a single barrel bourbon from Copper Tear, a family business that has been making spirits for three generations. The label describes it as cut to proof in small batches with artesian spring water and aged in new charred American oak barrels in Texas. The mash bill is 80% corn, 17% rye and 3% barley, and it is bottled at 45% ABV (90 proof) in a 750ml bottle. The label also notes a Double Gold at the 2022 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. Expect a savoury, peppery bourbon with buttery corn sweetness, cocoa and vanilla, finishing with spice and a hint of honey and peach.

Tasting Notes: Charred butcher paper, black pepper, buttered corn, clove, cocoa nibs, vanilla

Nose: Charred butcher paper, black pepper and drawn butter on sweet corn.

Palate: Clove, cocoa nibs and vanilla, with a medium-to-full body.

Finish: Medium-to-long, with sweet spice and honey and peach.

Serve: Neat, over a large cube, or in an Old Fashioned.

don-julio-reposado-1.title: Don Julio Reposado Tequila 375ml
don-julio-reposado-1.bodyHtml: Aged for eight months in American white-oak barrels, Don Julio® Reposado Tequila is golden amber in color, and offers a rich, smooth finish—the very essence of the perfect barrel-aged tequila. With a mellow, elegant flavor and inviting aroma, Don Julio® Reposado Tequi

pisco-capel-pina-colada.title: Pisco Capel Pina Colada
pisco-capel-pina-colada.bodyHtml:
Pisco Capel Piña Colada is a creamy, smooth ready-to-drink Piña Colada from Chile made with Pisco Capel. Bottled at 12% ABV in a 700ml bottle, it is made to pour over ice straight from the bottle.

Serve: Over ice, well chilled.

st-george-terroir-gin.title: St. George Spirits Terroir Gin
st-george-terroir-gin.bodyHtml: Terroir began with a hike and a fir tree. Master distiller Lance Winters created St. George Terroir Gin to evoke the magic of the forest. Wildcrafted Douglas fir and locally foraged California bay laurel form its signature, while coastal sage and wok-roasted coriander connote the hillside chaparral.

duckhorn-paraduxx-proprietary-red.title: Paraduxx Proprietary Red 2022
duckhorn-paraduxx-proprietary-red.bodyHtml:
This wine greets the nose with rich aromas of dark red cherry, black cherry and black currant, intertwined with baking spices and a touch of sweet oak. The palate bursts with vibrant, fresh fruit, elevated by lively acidity. Supple tannins and a smooth texture reveal layers of spice and subtle oak undertones. A generous, well-balanced wine with impressive depth, it is anchored by the structure of its Cabernet Sauvignon core.

92 Points - James Suckling

A good, full-bodied wine that’s polished in texture and nicely rich in black fruit flavors. Moderate tannins wrap around delicious blackberries, blueberries and dark chocolate. Well-concentrated and mouth-filling. Drink now or hold.

granville-english-bay-pale-ale-1.title: Granville English Bay Pale Ale 50L Keg

belgian-moon-4.title: Belgian Moon 473ml
belgian-moon-4.bodyHtml: Belgian Moon Belgian White 473ml is a refreshing, unfiltered Belgian-style wheat ale produced by Molson Coors Canada. Brewed with malted barley, wheat, rolled oats, Valencia orange peel, and coriander, this popular witbier delivers a smooth, creamy texture with bright citrus flavours and delicate spice. Its hazy golden appearance, light malt sweetness, and gentle bitterness create a balanced, approachable drinking experience. At 5.4% ABV, Belgian Moon is an excellent choice for warm afternoons, casual gatherings, and pairing with seafood or lightly spiced dishes.

miller-lite-5.title: Miller Lite 15 Cans
miller-lite-5.bodyHtml: The times change. But some things never do. The best times are spent together with our best friends drinking a few beers. That's why we started brewing Miller Lite in 1975, why we made it taste great, and why we'll never stop. It's Miller Time.

pisco-capel-mango.title: Pisco Capel Mango
pisco-capel-mango.bodyHtml:
Pisco Capel Mango Sour is a ready-to-drink tropical cocktail from Chile, made with Pisco Capel and mango juice. It balances ripe tropical fruit with fresh acidity and the soft character of the pisco, and is bottled at 12% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Very cold, straight from the fridge or over ice.

coors-edge.title: Edge Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
coors-edge.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Edge Cabernet Sauvignon was sourced from premium Alexander Valley vineyards, specifically chosen for their high-quality fruit and tannin structure. Ray Signorello and his winemaking team have crafted a rich and luscious age-worthy Cabernet Sauvignon that will drink beautifully for the next 5-8 years.

92 Points - James Suckling

A supple and gentle red wine that soothes the palate with soft tannins and broad, ripe black cherry flavors. Light oak accents. Full-bodied, broad and generous, with chocolate, vanilla and cinnamon notes and a lingering finish.

coors-edge-1.title: Edge Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
coors-edge-1.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Edge Cabernet Sauvignon was sourced from premium Alexander Valley vineyards, specifically chosen for their high-quality fruit and tannin structure. Ray Signorello and his winemaking team have crafted a rich and luscious age-worthy Cabernet Sauvignon that will drink beautifully for the next 5-8 years.

92 Points - James Suckling

A supple and gentle red wine that soothes the palate with soft tannins and broad, ripe black cherry flavors. Light oak accents. Full-bodied, broad and generous, with chocolate, vanilla and cinnamon notes and a lingering finish.

ormes-de-pez.title: Chateau Ormes De Pez 2023
ormes-de-pez.bodyHtml: Château Ormes de Pez 2023 is a red Bordeaux from Saint-Estèphe in the northern Médoc. The estate dates back to the eighteenth century and has belonged since 1940 to the Cazes family, owners of Château Lynch-Bages, who craft wines that express its gravelly soils. 750ml, 14.5% ABV.

granville-northwest-pale-ale.title: Granville Island English Bay Pale Ale 6 Cans
granville-northwest-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Granville Island English Bay Pale Ale 6 Cans

granville-west-coast-ipa.title: Granville Island West Coast Ipa 6 Cans

molson-export-ale.title: Canadian 36 Cans
molson-export-ale.bodyHtml: Pours a light golden colour with a soft fluffy head. Delicate floral and barley aromas with notes of citrus, grain and sweet fruit. Crisp, clean, medium bodied and smooth on the palate.

miller-genuine-draft-4.title: Miller Genuine Draft 28 Bottles
miller-genuine-draft-4.bodyHtml: Miller Genuine Draft is a quintessential American lager, famously known for its "Cold-Filtered" process that delivers a smooth, draft-style taste in a bottle. Unlike many traditional lagers that are heat-pasteurized, MGD is continuously chilled throughout the brewing and filtration process, which preserves a fresh, crisp character and a bright golden clarity. On the palate, it offers a light-bodied and mellow profile with subtle notes of sweet corn and toasted grain, balanced by a very mild hop bitterness. The result is an exceptionally easy-drinking and refreshing beer with a clean, smooth finish. This 28-bottle pack is a high-value format designed for larger social gatherings, offering the signature premium smoothness that has made the brand a global favorite.

sol-1.title: Perez Barquero 1905 Oloroso Solera Fundacional
sol-1.bodyHtml:
Perez Barquero 1905 Oloroso Solera Fundacional is a dry Oloroso made entirely from Pedro Ximenez and aged oxidatively through the Criaderas and Soleras system. Dark mahogany in appearance, it offers vanilla, aged oak and cinnamon aromas, followed by a velvety, dry, persistent and fragrant palate.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with braised oxtail, hare stew, wild boar, or fruit-based desserts.

heineken-lager-8.title: Heineken Lager 28 Bottles
heineken-lager-8.bodyHtml: Heineken Lager is a premium all-malt lager brewed using only the finest ingredients, including Heineken's proprietary A-yeast and a unique blend of hops. The beer comes in a 28 oz. bottle, which preserves the quality and flavor of the beer. The beer has a golden yellow color and a thick, creamy head. It has a creamy, malty body with subtle notes of hop bitterness and flavor. Its taste is clean and crisp with a pleasant and complex aroma. The finish is smooth and slightly sweet. Heineken is a refreshing, full-bodied beer that makes a great addition to any party or get together, or just to enjoy on its own.

coors-organic-3.title: Tres Agaves Organic Reposado Tequila
coors-organic-3.bodyHtml:
Crafted in Amatitán, Jalisco by Ilusión Cannabis (NOM 1522 / Tequila El Viejito) and bottled under the Tres Agaves label, Tres Agaves Organic Reposado Tequila is a 100% Blue Weber agave spirit certified USDA Organic. Made using estate-grown agave cooked in traditional brick ovens and fermented with wild yeast, it is aged for approximately 6 to 9 months in used bourbon barrels. This expression balances vibrant, herbal agave character with smooth vanilla and light oak notes.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken tacos, fish ceviche, carne asada, pork carnitas, and mild Mexican cheeses like Queso Fresco or Oaxaca.

Tasting Notes : Light straw to pale amber color. Soft, smooth, and medium-bodied with a clean, approachable texture.

Nose : Bright citrus peel, cooked agave, and fresh herbs balanced by subtle hints of vanilla, light oak, and soft caramel.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of sweet roasted agave, citrus, mild black pepper, vanilla, and light oak spice.

Finish : Medium-length and crisp, leaving lingering notes of warm agave, subtle baking spice, and delicate oak.

Serve : Excellent served neat, on the rocks, or as a premium base for organic Margaritas and Paloma cocktails.

jose-cuervo-tradicional-anejo-tequila.title: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Añejo Tequila
jose-cuervo-tradicional-anejo-tequila.bodyHtml: Tradicional® Añejo is 100% blue agave tequila aged in charred American oak, then finished in Irish single malt whiskey barrels. It is the pinnacle of the Jose Cuervo Tradicional line, which has been masterfully honed over 200 years. Carried out completely in the artisanal tradition developed by Jose Antonio de Cuervo: cooking the agave in clay ovens and distilling the tequila in copper stills. (40% ABV-80 proof) • Founded in 1795, the Cuervo® distillery, La Rojeña, in Jalisco, Mexico, is the oldest active spirits distillery in Latin America. Jose Cuervo was the first commercial producer of tequila in the world.

granville-peach-sour.title: The Crabbie Goat Distillery Sour Peach Moonshine

shankys-whip.title: Shanky's Whip Black Irish Whiskey Liqueur
shankys-whip.bodyHtml:
Shanky's Whip is a Black Irish whiskey liqueur, distilled, blended and bottled in Ireland and presented here in a 750 ml bottle at 33% ABV. It combines Black Irish whiskey and Irish spirit with caramel and vanilla to create a creamy, sweet liqueur, although it contains no actual cream. The brand is named for Shanky, a legendary Irish jockey and part-time distiller who, as the story goes, was banned from racing horses and took up riding ostriches instead, which is why the retro-styled label shows a rider being pulled along by an ostrich. On the nose and palate expect toffee, butter, cream, vanilla and sweet spices. It can be sipped over ice, served as a shot or mixed into cocktails.

Tasting Notes: Toffee, butter, cream, vanilla and sweet spices.

Serve: Over ice, as a chilled shot, or in coffee and cocktails.

bower-hill-single-barrel-bourbon.title: Bower Hill Barrel Strength Bourbon
bower-hill-single-barrel-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey with a high Rye mash bill rested in a #3 char new American oak barrel for 4 years or more. Bottled at full proof, right from the barrel.

 

AROMA

Crème Brule and pecans, sweet

PALATE

Bold, sweet vanilla, hint of nuts

FINISH

Very long and complete balance of spices

vincent-latour-corton-charlemagne-grand.title: Domaine Vincent Latour Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 750ml
vincent-latour-corton-charlemagne-grand.bodyHtml: Louis Latour Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 2022 has a bright and pale yellow color. Its nose is intense with toasty, floral aromas, particularly honeysuckle. The palate is full and round, with aromas of brioche and vanilla. The finish lingers on notes of acacia honey.

lochlea-single-malt-scotch.title: Lochlea 7 Year Old Single Estate Single Malt Scotch
lochlea-single-malt-scotch.bodyHtml:
Lochlea 7 Year Old Single Estate Single Malt Scotch is a limited-edition Lowland single malt distilled in 2018 and released by Lochlea Distillery in January 2026. Crafted entirely on the distillery's Ayrshire estate, this expression was matured for seven years in seven carefully selected first-fill bourbon casks stored in traditional dunnage warehouses. Bottled at 50% ABV without chill filtration or added colouring, it showcases a rich, creamy character with notes of tropical fruit, stewed apples, vanilla custard, and fresh oak. Buttery pastry, sweet cereal, and warming spices provide depth, creating a beautifully balanced expression of Lochlea's fruit-forward house style.

Food Pairing: Roasted pork tenderloin, aged Gouda, buttery shortbread, apple crumble, vanilla custard, and toasted almonds.

Tasting Notes: Stewed apples, ripe tropical fruits, vanilla custard, creamy cereal, fresh oak, buttery pastry, and warming spice.

Nose: Rich and creamy aromas of stewed apples, soft vanilla, sweet cereal, and delicate orchard fruits.

Palate: Full-bodied and creamy, with tropical fruits, fresh apples, vanilla custard, and gentle oak sweetness.

Finish: Long and warming, with lingering buttery pastry, cereal notes, gentle spice, and refreshing tart green apple.

Serve: Enjoy neat to appreciate its creamy texture and layered fruit character, or add a few drops of water to reveal additional vanilla and orchard fruit sweetness.

moutai-chun-2008.title: Moutai Chun 2008
moutai-chun-2008.bodyHtml: Moutai Chun 2008 (茅台醇 2008) is a Chinese baijiu from the Kweichow Moutai Distillery Group Technology Development Co. in Guizhou province, home of China's most celebrated sauce-aroma spirits. It is bottled at 53% ABV in a 500ml glossy red bottle with gold lettering and comes in a matching red gift box, making it a striking bottle to share at a celebration or to give as a gift.

cannery-naramata-nut-brown-ale.title: Cannery Naramata Nut Brown Ale 4 Tall Cans
cannery-naramata-nut-brown-ale.bodyHtml: Cannery Naramata Nut Brown Ale 4 Tall Cans

clydeside-stobcross-single-malt.title: Clydeside Stobcross Single Malt Scotch Whisky
clydeside-stobcross-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Clydeside Stobcross is the first single malt Scotch whisky from The Clydeside Distillery, a Lowland distillery in the heart of Glasgow. It takes its name from Stobcross Road, where the distillery's story began. Made from just water from Loch Katrine, 100% Scottish barley and yeast, it is matured in oak casks and bottled at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle, presented in a red and cream tube. The style is light and fresh: floral notes and tropical sweetness on the nose, orchard fruit and a touch of white pepper on the palate, and a fresh, fruity finish.

Tasting Notes: Floral, vanilla, orchard fruit and white pepper.

Nose: Floral notes, fresh sweetness and tropical tones.

Palate: Orchard fruits with hints of white pepper.

Finish: Fresh, fruity tones.

Serve: Neat, over ice, or in a highball with soda.

bacardi-tropical.title: Bacardi Tropical Flavoured Rum
bacardi-tropical.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Tropical 

This 750ml bottle of Bacardi Tropical offers a rich, fruity flavor that is perfect on its own or mixed with a cocktail. The flavor is carefully crafted with a unique blend of tropical fruits and is best served cold. Enjoy the smooth and tantalizing taste of Bacardi Tropical anytime.

818-tequila-blanco.title: 818 Anejo Tequila
818-tequila-blanco.bodyHtml:
Crafted from 100% Weber Blue agave harvested at peak maturity in Jalisco, Mexico. Cooked slowly, fermented, and double-distilled in copper pot stills, it is aged for over 1 year in oak barrels to deliver a rich, velvety flavor profile with harmonious notes of sweet agave, toasted wood, and warm spices.

Food Pairing: Dark chocolate desserts, braised short ribs, aged Manchego cheese, roasted pork tenderloin, and mole dishes.

Tasting Notes : Pale amber with shiny golden hues presenting a full-bodied, smooth, and silky mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet cooked agave, caramel, mild vanilla, toasted nuts, cacao, and soft spices.

Palate : Smooth cooked agave with toasted pecans and almonds, rich caramel, and spiced vanilla.

Finish : Long, silky, and rich with a smooth, lingering warmth.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a snifter, on the rocks, or as the base spirit in an Añejo Old Fashioned.

818-tequila-reposado.title: 818 Reposado Tequila
818-tequila-reposado.bodyHtml: Produced in Jalisco, Mexico using a carefully selected blend of highland and lowland agave and American oak barrel aging to create a reposado with amber color, hints of vanilla and toffee in the aroma and rich roasted agave flavor with a classic silky finish.

lochlea-single-malt-sowing-edition.title: Lochlea Sowing Edition First Crop
lochlea-single-malt-sowing-edition.bodyHtml: The Lochlea Distillery has kicked off a series of limited edition bottlings with the Sowing Edition First Crop. The range shines a light on the growing of the most important ingredient for single malt whisky – barley. This particular expression represents spring, when the barley seeds are sown. The whisky was filled into first-fill bourbon casks and eventually bottled up at 48% ABV.

wild-tea-kombucha-variety-pack.title: Wild Tea Kombucha Variety Pack 12 Cans

decoy-limited-napa-valley-red-blend.title: Decoy Limited Alexander Valley Red 2023
decoy-limited-napa-valley-red-blend.bodyHtml:
Decoy Limited Alexander Valley Red 2023 is a luxurious, well-structured, and deeply expressive red wine blend that beautifully showcases the exceptional quality of Sonoma County's premier growing regions. Sourced from some of the most acclaimed estate properties and vineyard blocks in the warm Alexander Valley, this inaugural style blend benefits from a cool growing season that allowed for extended hangtime, resulting in remarkable intensity and beautifully balanced acidity. Composed primarily of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, and rounded out with Petite Sirah, Petit Verdot, and Malbec, the wine was aged for 15 months in 100% French oak barrels (40% new, 60% neutral). In the glass, it reveals a dark, concentrated ruby core with purple reflections. The highly aromatic nose opens with inviting scents of fresh boysenberry, ripe muddled strawberry, and dark plum, complexly layered with warm undertones of toasted cinnamon, cedarwood, and subtle sweet baking spices. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and voluptuously textured, showing an engaging, fruit-driven fluid coherence where its core of rich blackberry pie and dark cherries is effortlessly framed by silky, polished tannins and an enlivening thread of natural acidity. It concludes with a long, smooth finish accented by lingering notes of dark cocoa, refined wood oak, and a delicate touch of savory spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with wood-fired wild mushroom pizza, grilled rosemary lamb chops, smoky barbecue beef brisket, or mature extra-sharp white cheddar cheese.

jadot-puligny-montrachet-referts.title: Louis Jadot Puligny-Montrachet 2021
jadot-puligny-montrachet-referts.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Puligny-Montrachet 2021 is a refined, classic, and beautifully balanced village-level white Burgundy crafted by Maison Louis Jadot from select vineyard sites across the Puligny-Montrachet appellation. Fermented and matured in French oak barrels (a third new) for up to 15 months, it opens with pure and elegant aromas of white flowers, lemon curd, green apple, and blanched almond, layered over subtle notes of fresh butter and wet stone minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with crisp, vibrant acidity and a satiny texture, delivering focused flavors of orchard fruit and citrus that lead to a long, chalky, and precise finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with poached lobster in butter sauce, pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken with cream, Dover sole, and aged goat cheese.

pilsner-3.title: Pilsner Urquell 6 Bottles
pilsner-3.bodyHtml:
Pilsner Urquell’s signature flavour balances sweetness from the triple-decocted malt, and bitterness from our Saaz hops. The thick head of dense wet foam adds smoothness
and seals in flavour and aroma.

canadian-5.title: Latitude 55 Canadian Whisky Batch #3
canadian-5.bodyHtml:
Latitude 55 Canadian Whisky Batch #3 is an Alberta-made whisky from Latitude 55 Distillery in Grande Prairie. It is a blend of five carefully selected 3-year-old wheat whiskies, matured predominantly in ex-Kakwa Rum barrels, giving it a soft, sweet profile with caramel, vanilla, molasses and dried-fruit character.

Food Pairing: Barbecue, smoked meats, grilled steak, roasted nuts, aged cheddar and dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: Soft and sweet with caramel, vanilla, molasses, chocolate, toffee and dried-fruit notes.

Nose: Wood, caramel, vanilla custard, butterscotch, gingerbread and dried fruit.

Palate: Molasses, chocolate, toffee, leather and tobacco with touches of grape and plum.

Finish: Short, dry and light with gentle spice and apricot.

Serve: Enjoy neat, over ice, or with a few drops of water; adding water brings out warmer baking spices and richer tannins.

coors-light-8.title: Coors Light 15 Cans
coors-light-8.bodyHtml: Coors Light is a light lager with a crisp, clean, and refreshing taste, packaged in a convenient 15-can carry case. It's brewed with Coors' proprietary yeast and aged slowly for a smooth, easy-drinking experience. The beer features a light body with malt notes and low bitterness, making it a popular choice for various occasions like parties, barbecues, or tailgating. It has a 4.2% ABV and 99 calories per 12-ounce serving, according to Platina Liquor.

canadian-7.title: Canadian Club Premium 1.14L with 50ml Pack
canadian-7.bodyHtml:
A Canadian Club Premium value pack with a total volume of 1.19 L at 40% ABV. Canadian Club Premium is the brand's flagship blended Canadian whisky, made from corn, rye, rye malt and barley malt and aged in white-oak American bourbon barrels for longer than the three years Canadian law requires. The brand describes it as bright gold, with almond and peppery spice on the nose, zesty spice, oak and vanilla on the palate, and a clean, dry finish.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks, or with soda or ginger ale.

pilsner-7.title: Pilsner 24 Cans
pilsner-7.bodyHtml: Brewed with Western Canada two-row barley to give it that select aroma and bittering hops. A medium-bodied lager that is true to its Western Canadian roots. It is a rich copper color, with a burst of freshly toasted barley enhanced with solid hop aroma. 16 IBU's.

stella-artois-8.title: Stella Artois 18 Bottles
stella-artois-8.bodyHtml: Stella Artois 18 Bottles is a premium Belgian-style pale lager celebrated for its crisp, balanced character and refreshing finish. Originally established in Leuven, Belgium, Stella Artois combines traditional European brewing influences with a smooth, approachable flavour profile. Brewed with carefully selected barley malt and hops, this golden lager offers delicate floral aromas, gentle malt sweetness, and refined hop bitterness. At 5.0% ABV, it delivers a clean, dry finish and exceptional drinkability. This convenient 18-pack contains 330ml glass bottles, making it ideal for gatherings and entertaining.

licor-beirao.title: Licor Beirão d'Honra
licor-beirao.bodyHtml: The Beirão d’Honra, which was born as a tribute to J. Carranca Redondo, and with the intention of being a limited edition, is a recipe enriched with aged wine brandy. The recipe is secret, the flavor is enveloping and it is ideal for unique and memorable moments: word of honor. As for consumption, unlike Licor Beirão, Beirão d'Honra should preferably be made in a Balloon Glass and in its pure state - without ice.

shinas-estate-verdict.title: Shinas Estate 'The Verdict' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
shinas-estate-verdict.bodyHtml:
Shinas Estate 'The Verdict' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, full-bodied, and intensely flavored Australian red wine produced by Shinas Estate in the Victoria region. Sourced from low-yielding vines, it undergoes careful oak aging to produce a deeply concentrated profile. In the glass, it presents an opaque crimson color. The bouquet opens with powerful aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis, and dark plum, backed by complex notes of vanilla, toasted oak, dark chocolate, and subtle eucalyptus. On the palate, it is bold and plush, delivering dense black fruit flavors supported by firm, velvety tannins and balanced acidity through a long, warm finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, barbecued beef ribs, slow-braised lamb shanks, venison, rich beef stews, and sharp aged cheddar cheese.

shinas-estate-executioner.title: Shinas Estate The Executioner 2018 750ml
shinas-estate-executioner.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "There's a little Cabernet Sauvignon and Viognier in the mix of this wine. It's ripe yet bright with candied strawberry and cherry at the fore and just a whisper of ground pepper, green herb and floral notes. There's plenty of plump fruit on the palate but lifted acidity as well. A straightforward, modern Shiraz for drinking young. Christina Pickard" - 89/100, Wine Enthusiast

rough-rider-bourbon.title: Rough Rider Straight Bourbon Whiskey
rough-rider-bourbon.bodyHtml:
A spectacular, highly unique craft bourbon from Long Island Spirits in New York. Named in honor of Theodore Roosevelt and his legendary volunteer cavalry regiment, this high-rye bourbon features a mash bill of 60% corn, 35% winter rye, and 5% malted barley. After its initial aging in newly charred American white oak, it undergoes a phenomenal secondary maturation process where it is finished in French oak casks that previously held local Long Island Merlot. Bottled at 90 proof, this creates a brilliant, deeply complex flavor profile that beautifully balances spicy rye with dark, jammy wine notes.

 

NOSE

A complex and floral bouquet of dark cherry, ripe plum, warm caramel, and a hint of sweet vanilla.

PALATE

Smooth, rich, and highly layered. Peppery rye spice and toasted oak are beautifully softened by lush flavors of dark berry, milk chocolate, and sweet honey.

FINISH

Exceptionally smooth, long, and warming with lingering dark fruit and a gentle spice.

deerfield-zinfandel-los-chamizal-vineyar.title: Caymus California Zinfandel 2022
deerfield-zinfandel-los-chamizal-vineyar.bodyHtml:
Caymus California Zinfandel 2022 is a rich, expressive, and full-bodied red wine that pays homage to late co-founder Charlie Wagner Sr.'s fondness for California's heritage grape. Sourced from select vineyards across the state, this wine pours a deep ruby color and opens with an inviting bouquet of ripe blackberry, boysenberry, and dark cherry, seamlessly intertwined with notes of sweet vanilla, toasted oak, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a generous, densely concentrated fruit profile balanced by a round, lush mouthfeel, moderate acidity, and supple tannins, leading to a long, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing:

This robust Zinfandel is a perfect match for hearty dishes such as classic barbecued pork ribs, beef bourguignon, savory mushroom pizza, and aged cheeses.

deerfield-ranch-drx.title: Deerfield Ranch DRX Meritage 2013
deerfield-ranch-drx.bodyHtml: The 2013 Deerfield Ranch DRX Meritage is the winery's flagship Bordeaux-style blend, representing the pinnacle of their production from an exceptional California vintage. This "Clean Wine" is a selection of the very best barrels from the cellar, meticulously blended to achieve maximum complexity and balance. It offers an opulent bouquet of blackberry, black cherry, and cassis, interwoven with sophisticated notes of tobacco, cedar, and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and powerful, yet remarkably smooth, featuring fine-grained tannins and a long, seamless finish. Having benefited from extended aging, this 2013 vintage displays a harmonious integration of ripe fruit and savory secondary characteristics.

rhino-whisky.title: Rhino Whisky
rhino-whisky.bodyHtml:
Rhino Single Malt Scotch Whisky Limited Reserve is a Speyside single malt from an undisclosed distillery, matured in ex-bourbon casks and then finished in rum casks for a double cask maturation. Bottled at 43% ABV in a 750ml bottle and presented in a tube, it carries the brand's message of supporting the preservation of rhinos in Africa.

Tasting Notes: Malt, vanilla and caramelized fruit.

Nose: Rich malt with biscuity sweetness, fresh fruit and a leafy note balanced by vanilla.

Palate: Sweet and rounded, with vanilla oak, malt and caramelized fruit.

Finish: Mellow and long.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

aguardiente-blanco-del-valle-sin-azucar.title: Aguardiente Blanco del Valle Sin Azúcar
aguardiente-blanco-del-valle-sin-azucar.bodyHtml:
Blanco del Valle Aguardiente is considered by many to be the smoothest Colombian spirit of the category. It is distilled from sugar cane and flavored with the natural essence of anise. Do not be deceived by its silky flavor and low calories. This aguardiente packs a punch and is a favorite of millennials and younger demographics. 

Colombia - Sin Azucar means without sugar. This strong Colombian national drink will pack a punch however you choose to drink it. The natural flavor is the trademark of this dry spirit.

This beautiful crystal clear spirits is soft, clean, and creamy with a silky mouth-feel and offers an excellent mix ability in a variety of cocktails.

tenuta-di-castellaro-marsili.title: Tenuta Di Castellaro Mar Sili 2020 750ml
tenuta-di-castellaro-marsili.bodyHtml: Tenuta di Castellaro Marsili 2020 is a lightly sparkling pétillant naturel from Tenuta di Castellaro in the Aeolian Islands, just north of Sicily. It is made entirely from Pinot Noir. As a pet nat, it is made in the ancestral method: the wine is bottled young while some grape sugar is still unfermented, and it finishes fermenting in the bottle, which creates a gentle sparkle and can leave a little natural sediment. The wine takes its name from Marsili, a nearby active underwater volcano. Production is very small and the wine is rarely found outside Italy. 750ml, 12.5% alcohol.

tullibardine-tasting-collection.title: Tullibardine 'The Murray' 2008 Chateauneuf-du-Pape Cask Finish
tullibardine-tasting-collection.bodyHtml:
Tullibardine 'The Murray' 2008 Châteauneuf-du-Pape Cask Finish is a limited-edition Highland single malt Scotch whisky released as part of the distillery's Marquess Collection. Distilled in 2008, it was matured initially in first-fill American oak ex-bourbon barrels before being re-casked for a finish in red wine barriques from the famous Châteauneuf-du-Pape appellation in the Rhône Valley. The red wine wood influence imparts vibrant red fruit depth, dark plum notes, and subtle spice to Tullibardine's signature sweet, vanilla-and-caramel malt profile.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted venison with a berry reduction, duck breast, charcuterie featuring dried meats and aged cheeses like Gouda or Manchego, or dark chocolate desserts with raspberry.

Tasting Notes : Russet amber with warm copper hues, boasting a smooth, medium-to-full body with a silky texture.

Nose : An assortment of spicy and sweet aromas with red berries, ripe autumn fruits, dark plums, vanilla, and subtle red wine oak.

Palate : Abundance of ripe red fruit, soft juicy cherries, blackcurrants, sweet caramel, and toasted malt balanced by gentle red wine spices.

Finish : Fresh and creamy with lingering notes of mint chocolate, soft juicy cherries, dark fruit, and subtle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or add a few drops of water to gently unlock the fruit and oak aromas.

cadenhead-7-stars-blend.title: Wm Cadenhead 7-Stars Blended Scotch Whisky
cadenhead-7-stars-blend.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead's 7-Stars is a blended Scotch whisky from William Cadenhead of Campbeltown, Scotland's oldest independent bottler. The name revives a historic Cadenhead blend first bottled decades ago to show that an exceptional whisky could be built from carefully chosen casks in the firm's warehouses. Today's 7-Stars combines single malt and grain whiskies from distilleries across Scotland in a high-malt recipe, then gives the blend a generous finish in Oloroso sherry casks for extra richness. It is bottled at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle, non-chill filtered and with no added colouring.

Tasting Notes: Red fruit and cream, baked apple, citrus peel and brown sugar, with a dried-fruit and cocoa finish.

Nose: Strawberries and cream, apple crumble, butter biscuits.

Palate: Tangerine skin, muscovado sugar, ginger snap biscuits.

Finish: Raisins, cold cocoa, a slightly hoppy, zesty edge.

Serve: Neat or with a drop of water; also works in a highball.

rough-rider-happy-warrior-cask-strength.title: Rough Rider The Happy Warrior Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whisky
rough-rider-happy-warrior-cask-strength.bodyHtml:
A bold, high-rye masterpiece that pays homage to Teddy Roosevelt and his legendary Rough Riders! Crafted by Long Island Spirits, "The Happy Warrior" is a limited-edition cask strength bourbon aged for a minimum of four years (and up to seven) in new American oak. The real magic happens during a unique secondary maturation: the whiskey is finished for several months in French oak casks sourced from local Long Island wineries that previously held Merlot and Chardonnay. Before finishing, these barrels are "washed" with high-proof brandy distilled in-house from local grapes. Bottled straight from the cask at a formidable 114 proof (57% ABV), it is a complex, non-chill filtered spirit that beautifully balances intense barrel heat with sophisticated fruit and floral notes.

 

NOSE

Rich and surprisingly floral. Bold aromas of sweet charred oak, marshmallow crème, and vanilla bean are layered with hints of fresh green apple, honeysuckle, and warm baking spices like nutmeg and cinnamon.

PALATE

Big, viscous, and "bruising" in the best way. Intense flavors of toasted rye bread and caramel hit first, followed by a wave of blackberry jam, dulce de leche, and dark chocolate. The high rye content (35%) provides a sharp, piquant spice of clove and peppercorn that cuts through the brandy-sweetness.

FINISH

Long, warming, and elegant. It leaves a lingering trail of salted caramel, seasoned oak, and a unique, tart acidity from the wine-cask influence.

ad-rattray-macduff-2002.title: A.D. Rattray Cask Collection Macduff 18 Year Old 2002 First Fill Sherry Butt Cask 900262 58.5% ABV
ad-rattray-macduff-2002.bodyHtml: A wonderful 18 year old single malt, distilled at Macduff in 2002 and independently bottled by A.D. Rattray in 2021. Drawn from a single sherry cask, and bottled at cask strength, there was an outturn of 539 bottles in total.

north-star-highland-13-year-old.title: North Star Spirits Series 017 Secret Highland 13 Year Old 2007
north-star-highland-13-year-old.bodyHtml:
This North Star Spirits bottling is a 13 year old single malt Scotch whisky from a Highland distillery that the Glasgow bottler does not name, released in its Series 017. Distilled in 2007 and bottled in 2021, it was matured in a first-fill Oloroso sherry butt that yielded 330 bottles, and is presented at 42.9% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Sherried and fruity, with a touch of smoke.

Nose: Rubber, sherry, dried fruit and toffee.

Palate: Raspberry chocolate, waxy texture and a little smoke.

Finish: Warm tarmac and liquorice, then clean and fruity.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

north-star-glenallachie-13-year-old.title: North Star The GlenAllachie 13 Year Old
north-star-glenallachie-13-year-old.bodyHtml:
The GlenAllachie 13 Year Old 2008 is a single cask Speyside single malt bottled by Glasgow independent bottler North Star Spirits for its Cask Series 017. Distilled at GlenAllachie in 2008 and matured for 13 years in a sherry butt, it was bottled in October 2021 at 56.8% ABV, without chill filtration and at natural colour. The sherry cask has given it a notably deep colour. Only 690 bottles of 700 ml were produced.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

north-star-glasgow-5-year-old.title: North Star Spirits Cask Series 017 Glasgow 5 Year Old 2016 Refill Barrel

deerfield-ranch-sonoma-reserve.title: Deerfield Ranch Sonoma Private Reserve Sonoma Cuvee 2014
deerfield-ranch-sonoma-reserve.bodyHtml: The 2014 Deerfield Ranch Private Reserve Sonoma Cuvee is a sophisticated "Super Valley" red blend that represents the winemaker's selection of the finest barrels from across Sonoma County. This vintage is characterized by its opulent structure and deep concentration, offering a complex bouquet of black cherry, cassis, and ripe plum, intertwined with secondary notes of dark chocolate, cedar, and tobacco leaf. As a "Clean Wine," it was produced using triple-hand sorting and low-sulfite techniques to ensure a pure, polished palate. Now showing the benefits of extended aging, the 2014 displays seamless integration between its rich dark fruit, velvety tannins, and nuanced oak influence, leading to a long and savory finish.

ad-rattray-glentauchers-10-year-old.title: A.D. Rattray Cask Collection Glentauchers 10 Year Old 2011 Sherry Butt Cask 423 59.4% ABV
ad-rattray-glentauchers-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Another of the Ballantine’s trio of malts, this Glentauchers sherry butt was finished in a 2nd fill Oloroso sherry butt (ex-Glenallachie) for 21 months.

Tasting Notes - Berry and Spice

Colour: Shining ochre.
Nose: Butterscotch, peanut, bramble and raisin. 
Palate: Treacle toffee, black cherry and allspice. 
Finish: Mild tobacco drifts over raspberry and blackcurrant.

ad-rattray-tormore-13-year-old.title: A.D. Rattray Cask Collection Tormore 13 Year Old 2008 Bourbon Barrel Cask 701188 58.8% ABV
ad-rattray-tormore-13-year-old.bodyHtml:
Perhaps the most striking distillery in Scotland, and with a growing reputation to boot. A cask for those with a sweet tooth, as fruity Speyside spirit and American oak work in perfect harmony.

Tasting Notes - Sweet with Citrus Fruit

Colour: Brilliant gold.
Nose: Sweet tangerine, crème brûlée and jasmine blossom.
Palate: Brown sugar, blood orange, subtle mint and candy cane.
Finish: Red apple, cinnamon and aniseed on a toasted coconut foundation.

cut-point-benrinnes-2008.title: Cut Point Benrinnes 2008 13 Year Old Cask #307387 Ex-Bourbon Hogshead 57.4% ABV
cut-point-benrinnes-2008.bodyHtml:
This 2008 Benrinnes spent 13 years in an Ex-Bourbon hogshead (Cask # 307387) and was bottled at cask strength 57.4%. This cereal-forward dram has the right amount of cask influence to balance out the spirit.

Nose hints of vanilla fudge, honey, and toast.
Palate spice, lemon zest, stone fruit notes and hints of vanilla and toffee.

cut-point-caol-ila-2011.title: Cut Point Caol Ila 2011 Ex-Bourbon Hogshead 56.5% ABV
cut-point-caol-ila-2011.bodyHtml:
Distilled in 2011 and aged in Ex-Bourbon Hogshead casks. 

On the nose absolute sea feeling with salty spray, oyster shells and seaweed On the fruit side, it runs in the wake of fresh mandarins and lemons. Medium-bodied palate, toffee, malt, honey, thins on the palate, vanilla oak wood, dry slate and a hint of salt plus a touch of hot pepper.

south-star-spirits-speyside.title: South Star Spirits Speyside
south-star-spirits-speyside.bodyHtml:
South Star Spirits Speyside 10 Year Old 2011 is the first Speyside Series release from South Star Spirits, the sister company of independent bottler North Star Spirits. The distillery is not disclosed. Distilled in 2011 and assembled from a small batch of ten hogsheads, it was bottled in 2021 at 48% ABV, with 2148 bottles released. It was one of South Star's inaugural trio of regional single malts, alongside a Highland and an Islay.

Tasting Notes: Lemon, toffee and baked orchard fruit.

Nose: Fruity and floral with citrusy lemon slice.

Palate: Syrupy toffee with a touch of saltiness.

Finish: Cinnamon on baked apples and pears.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

south-star-spirits-highland.title: South Star Spirits Highland
south-star-spirits-highland.bodyHtml:
South Star Spirits Highland 10 Year Old 2011 is the first release in the Highland Series from South Star Spirits, the sister company of independent bottler North Star Spirits. The distillery is not disclosed. The whisky was distilled in 2011 and assembled from a small batch of ten hogsheads, then bottled in 2021 at 48% ABV as one of 2148 bottles. It was part of South Star's inaugural trio of regional single malts, alongside a Speyside and an Islay.

Tasting Notes: Citrus peel, tobacco and dark chocolate.

Nose: Dried orange with a whiff of tobacco.

Palate: Thick, nutty dark chocolate.

Finish: Long, nutty and very chewy.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

south-star-spirits-islay.title: South Star Spirits Highland
south-star-spirits-islay.bodyHtml:
South Star Spirits Highland 10 Year Old 2011 is the first release in the Highland Series from South Star Spirits, the sister company of independent bottler North Star Spirits. The distillery is not disclosed. The whisky was distilled in 2011 and assembled from a small batch of ten hogsheads, then bottled in 2021 at 48% ABV as one of 2148 bottles. It was part of South Star's inaugural trio of regional single malts, alongside a Speyside and an Islay.

Tasting Notes: Citrus peel, tobacco and dark chocolate.

Nose: Dried orange with a whiff of tobacco.

Palate: Thick, nutty dark chocolate.

Finish: Long, nutty and very chewy.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

gib-brewers-choice-summer-pack.title: Gib Brewers Choice Summer Pack 12 Cans

faustino-v-rioja-reserva.title: Faustino V Reserva 2018
faustino-v-rioja-reserva.bodyHtml:
Faustino V Reserva 2018 pours a brilliant cherry-red color developing toward elegant maroon tones at the rim. The nose is remarkably intense and expressive, opening with inviting aromas of ripe black fruits, Luxardo cherry, and balsamic nuances, seamlessly layered with sweet baking spices, cocoa, and toasted vanilla notes from its extended aging in American oak barrels. On the palate, this elegant Rioja blend showcases a medium body with excellent structural balance and a gracefully smooth texture. Fine-grained, muscular tannins are beautifully supported by a vibrant core of well-integrated acidity, carrying flavors of dark berries and warm cloves into a long, persistent, and sophisticated finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled red meats, slow-cooked lamb loin, wild mushroom risotto, medium-aged cheeses, and traditional savory Spanish tapas.

93 Points - James Suckling

Juicy and expressive Rioja with some dark spices, black earth and a hint of peppercorn to the cherries and plums. Fresh and bright on the palate with a medium body rounded by fine-grained tannins. Succulent and long. Consistent quality. The first year that there is some maturana in the blend. Drink now, but can hold well, too.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This dark ruby-colored wine offers aromas of Luxardo cherry and toasted baking spices. It is very spicy at first sip as flavors of clove and mint leaf with a touch of black pepper hit the taste buds, followed by blackberry, cherry and raspberry flavors. Muscular tannins are balanced out by well-integrated acidity that stays around for a while.

louis-jadot-echezeaux-grand-cru.title: Louis Jadot Echezeaux Grand Cru
louis-jadot-echezeaux-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Echezeaux Grand Cru is an elegant Grand Cru Pinot Noir offering aromas of sweet cherries, red berries, rose petals, spice, and subtle earth. The palate is supple yet concentrated with silky tannins, vibrant acidity, and a long, refined finish built for graceful aging.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roast duck, venison, beef tenderloin, mushroom risotto, truffle dishes, and aged cheeses.

jadot-gevrey-chambertin-clos-st-jacques.title: Louis Jadot Gevrey-Chambertin Clos St. Jacques Premier Cru 2017
jadot-gevrey-chambertin-clos-st-jacques.bodyHtml:
A full-bodied, complex wine, this Premier Cru has a broad array of aromas and fine expression of terroir as well as impressive length on the palate. It will develop for more than 10 years in the bottle—or up to 40 in great vintages.Serve with game, meats, mushroom dishes and strong cheeses.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

With its dense tannins and concentration, this wine is impressive both for aging and for its power. With bold structure the wine sustains the black fruits with verve. It will age well and will not be ready before 2025.


94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2017 Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru Clos Saint-Jacques (Domaine Louis Jadot) unfurls in the glass with an incipiently complex bouquet of sweet red berries, coffee roast, raw cocoa, candied peel and cedary new wood. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, ample and layered, with an abundance of satiny structuring tannin, juicy acids and a long, pure finish. As usual, this will require some bottle age, but it's one of the high points of the collection. 

93 Points - James Suckling
Shows a solid finish with ripe and linear tannins, as well as attractive sliced-strawberry, raspberry and citrus flavors. Medium to full body. Solid. Give it three to four years to soften. Try after 2023.

red-rooster-meritage.title: Red Rooster Rare Bird Series Meritage 750ml

spy-valley-marlborough-sauvignon-blanc.title: Spy Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2024
spy-valley-marlborough-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
Spy Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2024 is an intensely aromatic, vibrant, and energetic white wine produced by Spy Valley Wines in Marlborough’s Waihopai Valley. Sourced from sustainably farmed estate parcels and select grower vineyards across Marlborough, the grapes thrive in stony, free-draining alluvial riverbed soils. Following harvest at peak physiological ripeness, the fruit undergoes gentle juice extraction and cool temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats using select aromatic yeasts to preserve primary aromatics, crisp freshness, and regional typicity. In the glass, it reveals a brilliant, pale lemon-straw hue with shimmering platinum reflections. The expressive bouquet leaps with aromas of passion fruit, fresh lime zest, pink grapefruit, and lemongrass, layered with undertones of crushed herbs, white peach, and a flinty, sea-spray minerality. On the palate, it delivers a medium body characterized by crisp texture, energetic acidity, and concentrated citrus and tropical fruits that lead to a clean, chalky, and lingering saline-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Freshly shucked oysters, grilled sea bass, green salads with goat cheese, citrus ceviche, or steamed mussels with herbs.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of lemons and limes follow through to a medium body with creamy texture and a fresh and crisp finish. Some green melon in the aftertaste. Drink now. Screw cap.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Lemongrass, lime leaf and passionfruit lend bright likability to this crisp, summery wine. There's tang acidity, lime tartness, herbal undertones and a white peach flavor to the finish.

parallel-49-jelly-monster-variety-pack.title: Parallel 49 Jelly Monster Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans
parallel-49-jelly-monster-variety-pack.bodyHtml: Parallel 49 Jelly Monster Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans

pabst-iced-tea.title: Pabst blue Ribbon Strong Iced Tea 12 Cans
pabst-iced-tea.bodyHtml:
Pabst Blue Ribbon Strong Iced Tea 12 Cans is a hard iced tea produced by Pabst Brewing Company. Crafted with real brewed tea and natural flavors, it delivers a sweet, smooth, and refreshing iced tea taste balanced with a bold alcohol strength.

Food Pairing: Barbecue ribs, grilled burgers, spicy wings, pulled pork sandwiches, fried chicken, or salty snacks.

Tasting Notes : Rich amber brown in appearance with a smooth, light-bodied, and easy-drinking mouthfeel.

Nose : Sweet black tea leaves, bright lemon zest, and subtle caramel sweetness.

Palate : Classic black tea flavor, sweet lemon, cane sugar, and gentle malt undertones.

Finish : Clean, smooth, and refreshing with lingering sweet tea notes.

Serve : Serve well-chilled directly from the can or poured over ice in a tall glass with a lemon wedge.

mikes-hard-iced-tea-variety-pack.title: Mikes Hard Iced Tea Variety Pack

uccelliera-brunello-di-montalcino-riserv.title: Uccelliera Brunello di Montalcino 2017
uccelliera-brunello-di-montalcino-riserv.bodyHtml:
A powerful and evocative expression of one of Tuscany’s most prestigious appellations, the 2017 Uccelliera Brunello di Montalcino reflects the warmth of its vintage with remarkable depth and concentration. This wine presents a deep ruby red color and opens with a complex, sun-drenched bouquet of dried cherries, ripe blackberries, and plums, layered with savory notes of leather, balsamic herbs, and earthy underbrush. On the palate, it is full-bodied and robust, showcasing a rich texture with firm, ripe tannins and a characteristic saline minerality. Nuances of tobacco, cedar, and dark chocolate emerge through a long, expansive finish that balances ripeness with vibrant acidity.

93 Points - James Suckling

A solid 2017, but there’s tangy freshness to this, and relatively fine tannins that frame the wine nicely. Plenty of ripe fruit. Some fresh mushroom, too. Drink after 2023.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Cherry and plum fruit flavors are allied to mint, camphor and spice flavors in this dense, powerful red, which is lively and resonates on the finish with echoes of fruit, herbs and spices. Best from 2025 through 2042.

glendronach-31yo-cask-7423.title: The GlenDronach 31 Year Old Cask 7423
glendronach-31yo-cask-7423.bodyHtml:
The GlenDronach 31 Year Old 1990 Cask 7423 is a single cask Highland single malt Scotch whisky, distilled in 1990 and matured for 31 years in a single Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheon. It was bottled straight from the cask at 56.9% ABV in a 700ml bottle, and the cask was shared between only a few markets.

Tasting Notes: Treacle, dark fruit, coffee and cocoa.

Nose: Treacle and liquorice root with roasted coffee, blueberry preserve, sultana and raisin.

Palate: Raisin oil and bramble fruit, with cocoa-dusted plum and velvety espresso.

Serve: Neat, with a drop of water if you like.

finlandia-vodka-4.title: Finlandia Vodka
finlandia-vodka-4.bodyHtml:
Finlandia Vodka is the classic unflavoured vodka from Finland's Finlandia, bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is made from golden Suomi barley and pure glacial water, and the brand credits Finland's midnight sun as part of its character. The style is dry and light, easy on the palate and silky-smooth with a gentle aroma, which makes it a versatile choice for mixing as well as for serving ice cold on its own.

Tasting Notes: Dry, light and silky-smooth with a gentle aroma.

Serve: Serve ice cold as a shot, or mix with soda, tonic or fruit juice over ice.

smirnoff-blue-label.title: Smirnoff Blue Label 50% ABV Vodka
smirnoff-blue-label.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Blue Label is the higher-strength version of Smirnoff vodka, bottled at 50% ABV (100 proof) instead of the usual 40%. This 750 ml bottle is made in Canada. The extra strength makes it a good fit for cocktails that are diluted with plenty of mixer or ice.

Serve: In a Moscow Mule, a Bloody Mary or a Caesar, or chilled in a martini.

bombay-sapphire-gin.title: Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin
bombay-sapphire-gin.bodyHtml:
Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin is an iconic, world-renowned gin crafted using a proprietary vapor-infusion process. First created in 1987 based on an 1761 recipe, ten sustainably sourced botanicals are held separately from the spirit in perforated copper baskets and infused with hot spirit vapor, yielding a delicate, bright, and perfectly balanced botanical profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, seafood tapas, goat cheese crostini, lemon tarts, or sushi.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and luminous in appearance with a smooth, light, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh juniper, bright citrus, floral notes, subtle pine, and warm earthy spices.

Palate : Clean, balanced, and round with vibrant juniper berries, zesty lemon, peppery coriander, subtle liquorice, and almond sweetness.

Finish : Medium, crisp, and refreshing with lingering hints of citrus zest and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve as the foundational spirit in a classic Gin & Tonic with fresh lime, in a Dry Martini, or over ice with tonic water.

budweiser-3.title: Budweiser 36 Cans
budweiser-3.bodyHtml: Budweiser is a medium-bodied, flavourful, and crisp American-style lager. Known as the "King of Beers," it is brewed using a blend of premium hop varieties, barley malt, rice, and water. A signature part of its production is the beechwood aging process, which results in a naturally carbonated beer with a smooth, clean finish. The 15-pack of 341ml glass bottles offers a subtle honey aroma and a trace of citrus, punctuated by notes of malt and noble hops.

busch-lager-1.title: Busch Lager 740ml
busch-lager-1.bodyHtml: Busch Lager is a classic, easy-drinking American-style lager known for its smooth taste and crisp finish. It is brewed using a blend of premium hops, malted barley, and select cereal grains, with a long maturation process that results in a light-bodied beer with a refreshing profile. The 740ml single can format is a large-volume option that highlights the beer's clean, subtle malt sweetness and fast finish. It is positioned as a straightforward, dependable lager designed for high drinkability.

kokanee-7.title: Kokanee 18 Cans
kokanee-7.bodyHtml: Kokanee Glacier Lager is a quintessential Western Canadian pale lager, celebrated for its exceptionally crisp and "crystalline" profile that mirrors its mountain heritage. Brewed with a blend of three different varieties of Pacific Northwest hops and mountain-pure water, it offers a light-bodied texture with a clean, refreshing taste and a subtle, grainy sweetness. The 18-can pack is a popular mid-sized format that balances portability with value, making it a reliable choice for camping, fishing, or backyard social gatherings. Each pour delivers a smooth, thirst-quenching experience with a dry finish that has established it as one of the most iconic beers in British Columbia and Alberta.

lucky-lager-1.title: Lucky Lager 8 Cans
lucky-lager-1.bodyHtml: Lucky Lager is a classic Canadian lager that has been quality-brewed since 1934. Known for its clean, crisp, and refreshing taste, this easy-drinking beer is a lighter-tasting lager with a light body and balanced malt and hop flavors. It's a straightforward, no-fuss beer perfect for casual enjoyment.

budweiser-5.title: Budweiser 36 Cans
budweiser-5.bodyHtml: Budweiser is a medium-bodied, flavourful, and crisp American-style lager. Known as the "King of Beers," it is brewed using a blend of premium hop varieties, barley malt, rice, and water. A signature part of its production is the beechwood aging process, which results in a naturally carbonated beer with a smooth, clean finish. The 15-pack of 341ml glass bottles offers a subtle honey aroma and a trace of citrus, punctuated by notes of malt and noble hops.

bud-light-5.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-5.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

jack-daniels-tennessee-honey-2.title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Honey 50ml
jack-daniels-tennessee-honey-2.bodyHtml: A blend of Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey and a unique honey liqueur of their own making, for a taste that's one-of-a-kind and unmistakably Jack. With hints of honey and a finish that's naturally smooth, Jack Daniel's Tennessee Honey offers a taste of the unexpected.

flowers-sonoma-coast-chardonnay.title: La Crema Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2024
flowers-sonoma-coast-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
La Crema Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2024 is an elegant California white wine showcasing the cool-climate character of Sonoma Coast. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay, this expressive wine offers inviting aromas of Meyer lemon, ripe pear, white flowers, and subtle oak. Flavours of crisp apple, golden peach, and pineapple unfold across a rich, textured palate, complemented by delicate graham cracker and pastry notes. Vibrant acidity balances its generous fruit character, creating a smooth, refreshing wine with a lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Butter-poached lobster, grilled salmon, crab cakes, seared scallops, roasted chicken, creamy seafood pasta, butternut squash risotto, and soft cheeses.

 

89 Points - Wine Spectator

Fresh-cut Fuji apple, pear and lemon sorbet flavors are fresh and lively, with grace notes of cardamom and ginger snap, plus a whiff of toasted, buttery brioche on the finish. Drink now.

shock-top-belgian-white-ale.title: Helix - Belgian White
