lucky-lager-3.title: Lucky Lager 8 Cans
lucky-lager-3.bodyHtml: Lucky Lager is a classic Canadian lager that has been quality-brewed since 1934. Known for its clean, crisp, and refreshing taste, this easy-drinking beer is a lighter-tasting lager with a light body and balanced malt and hop flavors. It's a straightforward, no-fuss beer perfect for casual enjoyment.

two-hands-heartbreak-hill-shiraz.title: Two Hands Angel’s Share Shiraz 2022
two-hands-heartbreak-hill-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Two Hands Angel’s Share Shiraz 2022 is a brilliantly balanced, full-bodied red wine celebrating the rich, sun-drenched fruit of South Australia's premium maritime climate. It opens with an expressive bouquet of ripe black cherries, blueberries, and mulberries mixed with nuances of licorice, savory dried herbs, and pink peppercorn. The palate is concentrated and lush, offering a silk-like texture framing deep plum flavors and fine, supple tannins that lead to an incredibly seamless, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled lamb chops with rosemary, slow-cooked beef brisket, wild game, hearty stews, and aged cheddar cheese.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Angel's Share Shiraz is saturated with black cherry, raspberry, licorice and pink peppercorn-rolled pastrami. In the mouth, it is all of this: silky and spicy and concentrated but not heavy. Nicely done. 14.4% alcohol, sealed under screw cap.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

acks a laser beam of pure fruit flavors, including boysenberry, blackberry and blueberry at the core, while accents of dried rose petal, toasted cumin and fresh sage linger on the velvety finish. Drink now.

bud-light-7.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-7.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

barbaresco-rabaja.title: Bruno Giacosa Barbaresco Falletto Rabaja 2021
barbaresco-rabaja.bodyHtml:
Bruno Giacosa Barbaresco Falletto Rabajà 2021 is a benchmark, highly expressive red wine crafted by Bruna Giacosa from the estate's south-southwest-facing 0.5-hectare parcel in the prestigious Rabajà vineyard. Made from 100% Nebbiolo, it undergoes extended temperature-controlled fermentation and maceration in stainless steel before aging for up to 24 months in traditional large French oak casks. In the glass, it displays a radiant ruby-garnet color with light orange reflections. The complex bouquet reveals lifted notes of fresh wild strawberries, dark red cherries, violet, flint, dried orange peel, and terracotta. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied, dense, and structured, marrying remarkable concentration with ultra-fine, velvety tannins, bright natural acidity, and a long, saline-mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, truffle-infused risotto, duck breast, roasted game, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano.

99 Points - James Suckling

This opens beautifully on the nose, with strawberries, cherries and some flint, terra cotta, peaches and orange peel. Medium- to full-bodied with ultra-fine tannins that are ready. The consistency and length are so beautiful. You can drink this now, but it will age for decades and always satisfy. Available in January 2025. Try on release, but it’s going to be much better in three or four years.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Bruno Giacosa 2021 Barbaresco Rabajà comes in a bottle with a white label. Bruna Giacosa explains that although she came close to making a Riserva (or red label) in 2017, Rabajà is usually presented in a white label. Rabajà has more backbone and a greater sense of richness and density. The Asili site is characterized by sandy soils, resulting in elegant and finessed wines. Even though Asili is right next door to Rabajà, the soil composition is completely different. Here, you get darker fruit tones with a very pretty mineral or salty signature. This is a beautiful vintage, one that excels in focus and clarity of fruit. I really love this expression of Rabajà, but you are best off giving it more bottle time to evolve.
tags: Azienda Agricola Falletto di Bruno Giacosa

stanley-park-windstorm-west-coast-pale-a.title: Stanley Park Windstorm West Coast Pale A 50L Keg
stanley-park-windstorm-west-coast-pale-a.bodyHtml: Stanley Park Windstorm West Coast Pale A 50L Keg

valdicava-rosso-di-montalcino-docg-2019.title: Valdicava Rosso di Montalcino 2022
valdicava-rosso-di-montalcino-docg-2019.bodyHtml:
Valdicava Rosso di Montalcino 2022 is a highly refined and structured Tuscan red wine that behaves like a "baby Brunello" on the palate. Made from declassified estate-grown Sangiovese Grosso grapes, this complex red opens with initial notes of black cherry, wild herbs, mentholated spices, and a hint of white smoke. The palate is bone dry, medium-to-full-bodied, and tightly wound, displaying exceptional balance between crisp, refreshing acidity, silky berry concentration, and savory minerals. Youthful, dusty tannins guide this elegant wine to a remarkably long, grippy finish.

Food Pairing: This highly structured Rosso pairs exquisitely with a rich Bolognese ragù, slow-cooked beef stews, classic charcoal-grilled Bistecca alla Fiorentina, or aged hard cheeses.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A dense red, evoking cherry, earth and eucalyptus flavors, this is tightly wound. Not giving a lot of pleasure today, but give this a few months to unravel. Then make a nice ragu. Best from 2025 through 2029. 750 cases made, 530 cases imported.

brewer-clifton-sta-rita-hills-chardonnay.title: Racines Bentrock Vineyard Sta. Rita Hills Chardonnay
brewer-clifton-sta-rita-hills-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Racines Bentrock Vineyard Sta. Rita Hills Chardonnay is a single-vineyard Chardonnay from the renowned Bentrock Vineyard in Sta. Rita Hills. Crafted by Racines, it reveals layered aromas of Meyer lemon, green apple, white peach, citrus blossom, wet stone, brioche, saline notes, and subtle hazelnut. Bright acidity, refined texture, and pronounced minerality lead to a long, elegant finish with excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with butter-poached lobster, seared scallops, roast chicken, grilled halibut, shellfish pasta, creamy risotto, soft-ripened cheeses, and refined seafood dishes.

i-w-harper.title: I.W. Harper Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
i-w-harper.bodyHtml:
I.W. Harper Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is the core bottling of a bourbon label that dates back to 1872 and is now owned by Diageo. The brand left the US market in the 1990s and returned in 2015 with this expression, which combines whiskey distilled at the Bernheim Distillery with other fine whiskeys; the stocks were most recently aged at the Stitzel-Weller Distillery. It is bottled at 82 proof (41% ABV) in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Creamy vanilla, oak, spice and a subtle fruitiness.

Nose: Creamy vanilla.

Palate: Vanilla with bursts of oak and spice, then a subtle fruitiness.

Finish: Sweet and pleasant.

Serve: Neat, on the rocks or in an Old Fashioned.

demuerte.title: Demuerte Classic 2022
demuerte.bodyHtml: Deep purple color in the glass with magenta hues. On the nose fine well-defined black and red fruits with a complex background of oak, brioche, balsamic, spice and vanilla notes follow. On the palette the body is full, with fleshy tannins, balancing acidity and a lasting aftertaste.

bud-light-9.title: Bud Light Apple 12 Cans
bud-light-9.bodyHtml: Bud Light Apple is a crisp and refreshing light lager infused with the sweet, natural flavor of green apple. This easy-drinking beer offers a smooth balance of malt and a distinct apple taste, creating a uniquely refreshing profile that is both light and flavorful. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a fruity twist on a classic American light beer.

port-askaig-28-year-old.title: Port Askaig 28 Year Old 45.8% ABV
port-askaig-28-year-old.bodyHtml:
A mysterious bottling from Port Askaig, in that there is little to no information as to which Islay distillery the whisky actually originated from. What we do know is that this 28 year old was matured throughout this duration in American hogshead casks, a complex drop with herbal aromas and strong notes of orange peel.

(rumored to be Laphroaig)

banded-peak-uptrack-ipa.title: Banded Peak Microburst Hazy IPA 4 Tall Cans
banded-peak-uptrack-ipa.bodyHtml: A Microburst is an intense small-scale downdraft produced by a thunderstorm. With the help of science we have created a new iteration of microburst: a powerful deluge of flavour  from new world hops that cascades your olfactory senses with tropical juiciness. The Microburst Hazy IPA will be gone as quickly as it arrived

lucky-lager-5.title: Lucky Lager 24 Cans
lucky-lager-5.bodyHtml: Lucky Lager is a classic Canadian lager celebrated for its light, easy-drinking character. First introduced in 1934—its name chosen from a public contest—Lucky Lager is fully fermented using select ingredients and hops to deliver a clean, crisp taste. Brewed in the tradition of a classic Canadian lager with no preservatives and 5% ABV, it’s a refreshing, timeless beer that’s perfect for any occasion, available in convenient 24-can cases across Canada.

moosehead-lager-4.title: Moosehead Canadian Lager 24 Cans
moosehead-lager-4.bodyHtml:
Moosehead Lager is Canada’s iconic, independent lager brewed by Canada's oldest independent brewery, Moosehead Breweries Limited in Saint John, New Brunswick. Brewed using a classic lager recipe with 100% Canadian 2-row malted barley, pure water, and a double-fermentation process, this pale lager delivers a finely balanced balance between sweet maltiness and mild hop bitterness. It is clean, crisp, and refreshing, making it an accessible and timeless Canadian classic.

Food Pairing: Grilled burgers, fish and chips, barbecue chicken, soft pretzels with mustard, and mild cheeses like young cheddar or Colby.

Tasting Notes : Bright golden straw yellow in color with a clear appearance and a light, crisp, and effervescent mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh and clean with notes of sweet grain, light corn, subtle malted barley, and a faint touch of grassy floral hops.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with light malt sweetness, soft cereal grains, and a crisp, gentle hop bitterness that cleanses the palate.

Finish : Short, clean, and refreshing with a crisp, dry finish and slight lingering grain notes.

Serve : Serve well-chilled at 38–42°F (3–5°C) directly from the bottle or poured into a classic pilsner or pint glass.

jack-daniels-tennessee-apple-1.title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Apple
jack-daniels-tennessee-apple-1.bodyHtml: The distinct character of Jack Daniel's charcoal-mellowed Tennessee Whiskey, blended with vibrant natural apple flavour. Experience caramel, toasted oak and spicy notes, coupled with fresh green apple. Enjoy neat over ice, or add crisp apple nuances to your favourite whiskey cocktail.

inchmurrin-12-year-old.title: Loch Lomond Inchmurrin 12 Year Old
inchmurrin-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Aged in three types of American Oak casks, Loch Lomond Inchmurrin 12 year old single malt shows off the fruit and sweet elements of our distillery's signature style with delightful notes of peach, apricot, toffee and vanilla. 

A celebration of Loch Lomond's orchard fruit character, Inchmurrin 12 year old Single Malt whisky is brought together by our Master Blender, Michael Henry, using spirit  from our remarkable Straight Neck stills and aged in selected American Oak casks for a sweeter, mellow taste.

Inchmurrin 12 year old shows off the fruit and sweet elements of our distillery's signature style with delightful notes of peach, apricot, toffee and vanilla on the finish.

inchmoan-12-year-old.title: Loch Lomond Inchmoan 12 Year Old
inchmoan-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Loch Lomond Inchmoan 12 Year Old is the smokier side of the Loch Lomond single malt range, presented under the distillery's 'Rich Smoke & Spice' banner. Master Blender Michael Henry builds it from spirit made on Loch Lomond's unusual straight neck stills together with its more traditional swan neck stills, then ages it for 12 years in three types of American oak casks. Soft peat smoke takes the lead, backed by warming spice, roasted coffee, green apple and clove. It is bottled at 46% ABV and is not chill filtered. The distillery sits on the Lomond Estate in Alexandria, Scotland, and the brand dates its whisky making to 1814. This is the 700ml bottle.

Nose: Dry peat smoke with vanilla syrup and cracked black pepper.

Palate: Sweet, medicinal peat and smoked bacon, then roasted coffee bean with clove and star anise, warming spice, green apple and pear.

Finish: Long and waxy peat with a citrus hop note and gooseberry.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

siempre-reposado.title: Siempre Reposado Tequila
siempre-reposado.bodyHtml:
Siempre Reposado Tequila is a 100% blue Weber agave tequila produced using traditional and modern methods in Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted from a blend of agave sourced from both the Highlands (Los Altos) and Lowlands (El Valle), it is double distilled and aged for up to six months in American oak barrels. This process balances the bright, peppery agave flavor with soft vanilla, oak, and warm baking spices.

Food Pairing: Tacos al pastor, grilled shrimp, ceviche, roasted pork tenderloin, carnitas, and flan or caramel desserts.

Tasting Notes : Warm golden amber in appearance, offering a soft, smooth, and rounded mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Sweet cooked agave, vanilla, and honey accompanied by notes of toasted oak, citrus zest, and light white pepper.

Palate : Smooth and balanced with flavors of sweet agave, caramel, vanilla, subtle baking spice, and gentle wood tannins.

Finish : Medium-long and warm, leaving lingering notes of sweet oak, pepper, and cooked agave.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat, over a large ice cube, or as a premium base in elevated cocktails such as a Reposado Paloma or Old Fashioned.

bombay-sapphire-light-gin-tonic.title: Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin 50ml
bombay-sapphire-light-gin-tonic.bodyHtml:
Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin is an iconic, world-renowned gin crafted using a proprietary vapor-infusion process. First created in 1987 based on an 1761 recipe, ten sustainably sourced botanicals are held separately from the spirit in perforated copper baskets and infused with hot spirit vapor, yielding a delicate, bright, and perfectly balanced botanical profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, seafood tapas, goat cheese crostini, lemon tarts, or sushi.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and luminous in appearance with a smooth, light, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh juniper, bright citrus, floral notes, subtle pine, and warm earthy spices.

Palate : Clean, balanced, and round with vibrant juniper berries, zesty lemon, peppery coriander, subtle liquorice, and almond sweetness.

Finish : Medium, crisp, and refreshing with lingering hints of citrus zest and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve as the foundational spirit in a classic Gin & Tonic with fresh lime, in a Dry Martini, or over ice with tonic water.

banded-peak-javalanche-coffee-stout.title: Banded Peak Southern Aspect 4 Tall Cans
banded-peak-javalanche-coffee-stout.bodyHtml: Throughout the winter, southern aspects on mountainous slopes can present uncertain and variable conditions. It also leads to epic lines on bluebird days for those willing to take the risk. This beer was born out of taking risks and chasing adventure.

banded-peak-microburst-hazy-pale-ale.bodyHtml: A Microburst is an intense small-scale downdraft produced by a thunderstorm. With the help of science we have created a new iteration of microburst: a powerful deluge of flavour  from new world hops that cascades your olfactory senses with tropical juiciness. The Microburst Hazy IPA will be gone as quickly as it arrived

banded-peak-plainsbreaker-wheat-ale.title: Banded Peak Plainsbreaker 4 Tall Cans
banded-peak-plainsbreaker-wheat-ale.bodyHtml: An aromatic, style bending approach to the pale ale. The Plainsbreaker is bursting with late addition hops, boasting a huge tropical flavour and aroma. Well balanced, interesting and very approachable, this beer is for every adventure

banded-peak-southern-aspect-ipa.title: Banded Peak Southern Aspect Ipa 30L Keg

banded-peak-summit-seeker-ipa-1.title: Banded Peak Summit Seeker Ipa 50L Keg

banded-peak-fired-up-hazy-blonde-ale.title: Banded Peak Fired Up Haze Ale 4 Tall Cans
banded-peak-fired-up-hazy-blonde-ale.bodyHtml: Blasty is back for the '22-'23 season! Debuting in '98 as the team's third jersey, the famed logo became a fixture with fans. It began alongside the meteoric rise of the Flames' all-time leading scorer, #12, and lived on the team's shoulder patch for that epic Cup run. Here's to another great season. GO. FLAMES. GO.

busch-lager-2.title: Busch Lager 30 Cans

The age-old olive trees known as “Auru te Ulie” in the local dialect, which means “gold,” because olive oil was considered like a precious metal by the local people.

Drumshanbo Gunpowder Irish Gin with Sardinian Citrus is made at The Shed Distillery in Drumshanbo, County Leitrim, and slow distilled by hand in copper pot stills. It builds on the original Drumshanbo Gunpowder recipe of eight pot-still and four vapour-infused botanicals, including gunpowder tea, and adds “Sa pompia” (Citrus monstruosa), a rare citrus relative of the orange and grapefruit that founder PJ Rigney came across in the village of Siniscola on Sardinia. The result keeps the brand’s oriental, tea-led character with a fresh citrus lift. Bottled at 43% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Nose: Gunpowder tea and oriental botanicals with bright Sardinian citrus.

louis-roederer-collection-1.title: Louis Roederer Collection 242 3L Double Magnum
louis-roederer-collection-1.bodyHtml:
The Collection 242 blend is dominated by Chardonnay which was of exceptional quality in the 2017 vintage. The perfectly ripe Chardonnay grapes lend the wine its aromas of ripe, sweet fruit complemented by subtle oaky notes. The palate is rich and ripe with a luxurious texture that coats the palate, the signature of an outstanding Chardonnay. The Pinot noir and Meunier grapes from the Vallée de la Marne complete the wine’s broad, luscious, smooth and juicy character. The finish is energetic and fresh.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of cooked apple, bread dough and lemon tart follow through to a full body with round, delicious fruit and a rich, flavorful finish. Yet, it remains tight and fine with lovely, compressed bubbles. New energy and freshness. Medium to full-bodied with layers of fruit and vivid intensity. 42% Chardonnay, 36% Pinot Noir and 22% Pinot Meunier. 8 grams dosage. Four years on the less. A new-format non-vintage that designates the year of the 242nd harvest, 2017, plus reserve wine of 2009, 2011, 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

"Roederer's Brut Premier was created in the 1980s to prove to consumers that we could deliver consistent quality with a blend that compensated for less than perfectly ripe vintages," explains Jean-Baptiste Lecaillon. "We were blending in pursuit of maturity, of ripeness. The concept behind the Brut Collection is the opposite: we're looking for freshness—and we are embracing singularity, something we're emphasizing by enumerating each year's blend." This project has been in the making since 2012, when Lecaillon set aside 21,000 liters of wine to constitute a perpetual reserve aged in large tanks without malolactic fermentation. Sourcing has evolved too: less must is coming from cooperatives, and only vineyards cultivated without the use of herbicides inform the blend. A dedicated team oversees all this, visiting every grower three times per year. And vinification is parcel by parcel to deliver a maximum of blending components.

martini-bianco-1.bodyHtml:
Martini Bianco is a classic Italian sweet white vermouth crafted by Martini & Rossi, renowned for its delicate floral character, aromatic complexity and beautifully balanced sweetness. Produced in Piedmont, Italy, this elegant aperitif is made from carefully selected white wines, including Trebbiano, blended with a proprietary selection of aromatic herbs, botanicals and natural flavourings. Its pale straw-gold colour introduces an inviting bouquet of fragrant flowers, soft vanilla, fresh citrus and delicate herbal notes. Smooth and approachable on the palate, Martini Bianco reveals layers of gentle sweetness, vanilla, orchard fruit and subtle spice, complemented by a refreshing botanical bitterness that creates an elegant, harmonious balance. Its light, aromatic character and lingering finish make it a versatile expression of traditional Italian vermouth craftsmanship. Presented in a generous 1L bottle at 15% ABV, Martini Bianco captures the timeless spirit of the Italian aperitivo tradition.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with Mediterranean antipasti, marinated olives, prosciutto, fresh mozzarella, burrata, grilled artichokes and herb-seasoned focaccia. Its delicate sweetness and aromatic herbal character also complement smoked salmon, grilled prawns, mild cheeses, roasted almonds and lightly spiced appetizers.

Tasting Notes: A smooth and aromatic sweet white vermouth offering delicate floral notes, vanilla, fresh citrus, gentle spice and subtle herbal bitterness, with a refreshing and balanced character.

Nose: Fragrant aromas of vanilla, white flowers, fresh herbs and citrus peel, complemented by delicate orchard fruit and subtle spice.

Palate: Smooth, lightly sweet and aromatic, revealing vanilla, pear, melon, citrus and floral botanicals, balanced by gentle herbal bitterness and refreshing acidity.

Finish: Soft, elegant and gently bittersweet, with lingering vanilla, citrus zest and delicate herbal notes.

Clase Azul Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila made from 100% Blue Weber Agave, harvested in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. hennessy-richard-2-0-carafe.bodyHtml:
Richard Hennessy Cognac is the house's tribute to its founder, the Irishman who established Maison Hennessy in Cognac in 1765, and it sits at the summit of the Hennessy range. The blend draws on more than 100 eaux-de-vie held in the family's reserves, a number of them set aside in the early nineteenth century and nurtured by successive generations of the Fillioux family of master blenders. Retailers describe the components as ranging from roughly 40 to almost 200 years of age. Hennessy itself presents the cognac in a crystal decanter and describes a pure, warm amber colour. Bottled at 40% ABV, it is a collector's cognac intended for slow, attentive tasting on special occasions.

Tasting Notes: floral, nutmeg, fennel, soft spice, leather, preserved fruit

Nose: Delicate florals with gentle spice, nutmeg and a touch of fennel.

Palate: Layers of spice, leather and preserved fruit that echo and deepen the aromas.

Serve: Pour a small measure neat into a tulip glass at room temperature and allow it time to open.

dalmore-rare-fine-30-year-old-1.title: The Dalmore 30 Year Old
dalmore-rare-fine-30-year-old-1.bodyHtml:
With just 1,318 bottles available globally, the 2021 Edition whisky started life in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before being transferred into exceptionally rare Graham’s 30 Year Old Tawny Port Pipes, until ready to be bottled. The Tawny Port Pipes work in harmony with The Dalmore’s characteristic house style to create a truly exceptional 30-Year-Old Single Malt to deliver a gorgeously mellow whisky with an amazing, long finish

With an ABV of 42.8%, The Dalmore 30 Year Old 2021 Edition promises decadently sweet aromas of freshly baked brioche and candied orange, followed by a palate packed with rich forest fruits imparted by the Tawny Port Pipes, finished with aromas of vanilla and shaved almonds.

dalmore-constellation-1976-cask-3.title: The Dalmore Constellation Collection 1976 35 Year Old Cask #3
dalmore-constellation-1976-cask-3.bodyHtml:
The Dalmore Constellation Collection 1976 35 Year Old Cask #3 is an exceptionally rare Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky, distilled in 1976 and matured for 35 years in a first-fill American white oak bourbon barrel. Part of The Dalmore's prestigious Constellation Collection, this remarkable single-cask expression was bottled in 2012 at a natural cask strength of 51.1% ABV, with only 231 bottles produced. Presented in an exquisite crystal decanter with luxurious presentation packaging, it showcases decades of patient maturation through an elegant interplay of orchard fruits, tropical sweetness, delicate oak and refined confectionery notes.

Food Pairing: Beautifully complemented by almond macarons, vanilla crème brûlée, peach tart, aged Comté cheese or delicate white chocolate pralines. Its layered fruit character also pairs elegantly with poached pears and lightly spiced desserts.

Tasting Notes: A richly layered and sophisticated Highland single malt displaying golden amber hues with copper highlights. Luscious orchard and tropical fruits intertwine with creamy caramel, marzipan, vanilla confectionery and gentle warming spice.

Nose: Creamy caramel, vanilla fudge and marzipan unfold alongside pineapple, tangerine and lemon cheesecake. Delicate sandalwood introduces further complexity, followed by praline, peach melba and a subtle touch of ginger.

Palate: Bramley apples, peaches and cream, chewy toffee and fresh kiwi lead into delicate macaroons. Turkish delight, honeyed pears, freshly baked rye bread and marzipan create a beautifully intricate and indulgent progression.

Finish: An elegant, lingering impression of honeyed orchard fruits, soft almond confectionery, delicate oak sweetness and gentle warming spice.

tamnavulin-1970-speyside-scotch-whisky.title: Tamnavulin 1979 39 Year Old Vintages Collection Single Malt Scotch Whisky
tamnavulin-1970-speyside-scotch-whisky.bodyHtml:
This last batch of whisky from the 1970s was laid down in a combination of first fill Sherry butts and Bourbon barrels. Non-Chill Filtered.

Tasting Notes

Maturation
Initially matured in Bourbon barrels then transferred to 30 Years Old Matusalem Oloroso Sherry butts before being returned to First Fill Bourbon barrels for a final maturation period to conclude the 39 year maturation.
Colour
Amber gold.
Nose
Mediterranean oranges, figs, almonds and freshly baked ginger cake.
Palate
Tropical pineapple, roasted coffee and decadent Black Forest fruits.

craigellachie-13-year-old.title: Craigellachie 13 Year Old
craigellachie-13-year-old.bodyHtml:
Craigellachie 13 Year Old is a distinctly robust and unconventional Speyside single malt, often affectionately referred to as the "bad boy of Speyside." Unlike the typically light and floral whiskies of the region, Craigellachie utilizes traditional worm tub condensers and an oil-fired malt roasting process. This old-school production method imparts a heavy, meaty, and slightly sulphury character that is beautifully balanced by sweet notes of toasted marshmallows and baked orchard fruits. Bottled at 46% ABV without chill-filtration or added color, it offers a rich and deeply satisfying drinking experience for those seeking a whisky with real heft and character.

Food Pairing: Grilled pork chops, thick-cut bacon, smoked charcuterie, aged cheddar, or a roasted apple tart.

Tasting Notes : Light golden amber in appearance with a noticeably viscous, heavy, and oily mouthfeel.

Nose : A unique and complex aroma of baked apples, toasted marshmallows, vanilla, and honey, underscored by a signature savory, meaty note and a faint hint of struck match or sulfur.

Palate : Oily, rich, and robust, delivering sweet flavors of roasted pineapple, baked apple, and malted milk, which give way to savory, meaty undertones, cloves, and toasted oak.

Finish : Long, warming, and distinctly savory, leaving lingering notes of sweet malt, oak spice, and a very subtle hint of wood smoke and sulfur.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its robust character, or add a few drops of water to soften the meaty notes and elevate the sweet orchard fruits.

finca-la-mina-de-pradorey.bodyHtml: A single vineyard Tempranillo from one of the most visited wineries in Ribera del Duero, this wine is only produced in exceptional vintages that can guarantee the qualities needed for long aging, both in the barrel and the bottle.

rocca-di-montegrossi-chianti-marcellino.title: Rocca Di Montegrossi Chianti Classico 2022 750ml
rocca-di-montegrossi-chianti-marcellino.bodyHtml:
In the glass it is lively ruby, with bright violet reflections, and on the nose displays the rich fruity aromas typical of the varietals, particularly forest berry fruit and sour cherries. On the palate it is harmonious and well structured, with nice tannins and savory notes.

93 Points - Decanter

As high temperatures in mid-August shut down the ripening of Sangiovese, Marco Ricasoli reports picking approximately a week later than usual. He also introduced a sorting table to remove dried or green berries as well any pieces of stems. His resulting annata is pristine and sophisticated. Deep violet in colour and equally youthful on the nose, it exudes wild berries, black plum, and hints of wood spice. Tangy dark red cherry fills the mouth, buoyed by rambunctious acidity and framed by suede-textured tannins. Winter mint and liquorice root linger on the finish. With admirable complexity, this outperforms its category.

red-shoulder-chardonnay.title: Shafer Relentless 2019
red-shoulder-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Shafer Relentless 2019 is a bold, complex, and deeply concentrated red blend that pours a dark purple-black color. The bouquet opens with an enticing, savory range of aromas including grilled meat, black pepper, roasted almonds, baked earth, and wild sage. On the palate, it is mouth-filling and rich, delivering intense flavors of blackberry, blueberry, black tea, and wet stone. This full-bodied blockbuster balances its powerful structure and plush, velvety tannins with a lively undercurrent of acidity, culminating in a remarkably long, polished finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted rack of lamb, prime rib, venison steak, braised beef cheeks in a rich red wine reduction, or strong, savory cheeses.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This powerful, rough-hewn wine that contains 11% Petite Sirah holds extremely deep black and blue fruits in a framework of grippy tannins. A tight, reserved expression on the midpalate signals more aging is needed for best enjoyment. The wine’s ripe, compelling, late-harvest fruits match the massive structure. Best from 2028– 2040

95 Points - James Suckling

Rich and deep dark-fruited character with hints of roast bacon, chocolate and grilled herbs. Full-bodied with a broad, structured palate that has a deep core of dark berry fruit, and an array of plush, velvety tannins that lasts for minutes, leading to a polished, slightly chewy finish.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Relentless is a blend of 89% Syrah and 11% Petite Sirah that spent 30 months in 100% new French oak. The nose is a bit briary, with intriguing herbal complexities from the Syrah, vibrant purple-raspberry fruit and perhaps some blueberry fruit from the Petite Sirah. This is full-bodied, tannic, sturdy stuff that needs time to come around, but as it's packed with fruit, that shouldn't be an issue. Patience will be required.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Potent yet polished, with deeply structured flavors of black cherry, smoked pepper and dried sage that build tension toward medium-grained tannins. Syrah and Petite Sirah. Drink now through 2030. 3,300 cases made.

gaja-gaia-rey-langhe-bianco-chardonnay.title: Gaja Gaia & Rey Langhe 2022
gaja-gaia-rey-langhe-bianco-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Gaja Gaia & Rey is a "terrific" and "dazzling" expression from a hot, dry vintage that resulted in extra aromatic intensity. It maintains the wine's legendary reputation for Burgundian-style complexity but with a profile uniquely shaped by the 2022 growing season.

96 Points - James Suckling

What a beautiful chardonnay, with sliced cooked apples, pears, light cream and pineapple, but so well knit together with a mouthfeel that is caressing and fine textured. So enticing to drink now, but will improve with age. Drink or hold.
95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Currently on the market, the Gaja 2022 Langhe Gaia & Rey is a very expressive interpretation of Chardonnay, with extra aromatic intensity in this hot and dry vintage. The bouquet opens to Sicilian orange blossom, sweet almond and peach. There is a pretty mineral note and some spice too, but the citrusy note is what stands out most at the moment. The wine is 100% oak aged, but there has been a recent move to larger oak vessels used in combination with barrique. This pretty white finishes with an elegantly creamy texture.

azelia-san-rocco-barolo-docg.title: Azelia Barolo San Rocco 2017
azelia-san-rocco-barolo-docg.bodyHtml:
Fleshy, extremely focused. Here Serralunga d’Alba is present with signs of licorice, spices and dark fruits. Cherry, currant and blueberry melt harmoniously together. Velvety and sweetly ripe, with splendidly integrated tannins. San Rocco gives an impression of great power, austerity, with incredible aging potential.

96 Points - James Suckling    Very pure fruit with crushed strawberries, spices and white truffles on the nose. The palate is full and tight with brightness and focus. Firm, creamy tannins. The super quality of fruit really comes through here.

94 Points - Vinous    The 2017 Barolo San Rocco is powerful and tightly wound. All of its energy is focused inward today. There is terrific brightness and focus to the red berry fruit, but the 2017 is not in a mood to show much today. Readers will have to be patient. I am encouraged by the wine's solid feel and pure power.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck    The 2017 Barolo San Rocco has aromas of leather, black cherry, cedar, and licorice. The palate is ripe up front and leads with black raspberry, baking spice, and balsamic. Consistent with gripping structure, these wines need time to unfurl.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    The Azelia 2017 Barolo San Rocco shows some tightness and firmness initially, but it ultimately reveals an open and accessible quality of fruit with dried raspberry, cherry and wild plum. Those fruit flavors take a sudden turn to embrace some of the more mineral aromas associated with Serralunga d'Alba, such as iron ore and rusty nail. This hot and dry vintage release of 7,500 bottles doesn't show the same depth or complexity that we saw in the classic 2016 growing season. Instead, this wine is fruit forward and a little more contoured and streamlined overall.

91 Points - Wine Spectator    Macerated cherry and berry flavors are the main themes in this red, graced by menthol, tobacco and tar. Lively acidity and firm, raspy tannins lend support. This is lean and sinewy, yet long.

champagne-piper-heidsieck.title: Piper-Heidsieck Cuvee Brut 375ml
champagne-piper-heidsieck.bodyHtml:
The Brut NV represents the epitome of the Piper-Heidsieck style: a classic, well-structured, and fruit forward champagne. Piper-Heidsieck carefully selects fruit from more than 100 of Champagne’s crus to blend the Brut NV. This adds great complexity and dimension to the wine and allows the bold Piper-Heidsieck style to shine through. A majority blend of Pinot Noir provides structure to the composition while Pinot Meunier expands the wine with its brilliant fruit expression and fleshiness and Chardonnay bring elegant tones and acidity. The precious reserve wines create a consistent flavor profile year after year.

This Champagne teases and allures us with its festive, light-drenched, pale gold shimmer and joyful display of neat, lively bubbles. Notes of almond and fresh hazelnut accompany the precise ascent of its bubbles. It is lively, subtle and light, leaving a deliciously incisive sensation of smoothness, marked by the pureness of fresh pear and apple and a delicate hint of citrus fruits. A harmonious mixture of bright, crunchy pomelo, blonde grapes and juicy white fruits creates the delightfully surprising sensation of lightness embraced by the structure and depth from the Pinot Noir; all beautifully balanced.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Creamy and well-balanced, this lively Champagne offers flavors of ripe black currant and black cherry, candied lemon peel, and brioche, plus fragrant notes of anise and clove. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The Champagne is balanced between a soft Brut character and crisper lemon flavors. That balance gives a fine wine, open and easy, but with a fine bite of acidity at the end.

90 Points - James Suckling

Croissants, sliced apples and lemon pastries on the nose of this creamy Champagne. It’s rounded and soft with attractive pastry character.

brunello-di-montalcino-pomona-vps.title: Banfi Brunello di Montalcino 2021
brunello-di-montalcino-pomona-vps.bodyHtml:
Banfi Brunello di Montalcino 2021 is a rich, powerful, and elegantly structured red wine from the rolling hills of southern Montalcino. Displaying a deep ruby hue with garnet reflections, it opens with sweet, fragrant aromas of black cherry, plum, and redcurrant, seamlessly integrated with complex undertones of licorice, pipe tobacco, and subtle baking spice. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied texture backed by dense, fine-grained tannins, vibrant natural acidity, and layers of dark berry fruit, iron, and earthy Mediterranean herbs that carry through to a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with prime beef, braised wild boar ragù, roasted lamb, osso buco, or aged Pecorino cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

Solid, showing dusty spices, dried citrus and an earthy, savory undertone. Traditional in style, with tight tannins and a nice grilled-orange character. Very well-balanced, supple and composed. Try from 2027.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers power in the form of dense tannins and intense flavors of black cherry, blackberry and black currant. Iron, tomato leaf and Mediterranean scrub notes add depth as this expands midpalate and through the detailed finish. Best from 2029 through 2046.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Supporting good concentration and volume, the Castello Banfi 2021 Brunello di Montalcino checks all the boxes for the vintage, reflecting careful blending and cellar precision in a warm year. There is richness and freshness, with layers of plum, blackcurrant and sweet spice. The tannins are well managed. The wine delivers exactly what is expected without pushing beyond its stylistic boundaries. This is a fine choice for near- to mid-term drinking, and like many new releases in this portfolio, it shows a high level of alcohol at 15.5%.

joel-gott-gott-14.title: Joel Gott "Gott" Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
joel-gott-gott-14.bodyHtml:
The 2017 Joel Gott "Gott" Cabernet Sauvignon is a premium, limited-production offering that represents the pinnacle of the producer's portfolio. Sourced from high-elevation and prestigious vineyard sites in the Napa Valley, this vintage expresses the concentration and depth typical of the region. It features an intense bouquet of blackcurrant, dark chocolate, and black plum, expertly integrated with sophisticated notes of tobacco leaf, cedar, and exotic spices from aging in new French oak. On the palate, the wine is powerful and opulent, boasting a rich texture, firm yet velvety tannins, and a persistent, complex finish. This is a bold, age-worthy wine designed for those seeking a more elevated expression of California Cabernet.

91 Points - James Suckling

A ripe and plush nose with opulent blackberry and dark-chocolate notes. The palate is rich and full-bodied with silky, powdery tannins that melt into the fruit. A little overripe, but hedonistic. Excellent bottle for those who seek a little more opulence in their cabernet. Drink now.

luce-1-5l.title: Tenuta Luce Toscana 2020 1.5L Magnum
luce-1-5l.bodyHtml:
Intense ruby red in color, Luce 2020 stands out on the nose for its complexity and elegance, characterized by ripe black fruits, particularly blackberry and mulberry, which are joined by hints of cocoa and sweet spices. On the palate it is harmonious, lively, with excellent structure, balanced by vibrant acidity and soft, silky tannins that give an elegant finish with great persistence.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Well-marked by vanilla from the new oak, this also features flavors of black currant, blackberry, flowers and iron. Racy even, with vibrant acidity and a line of dusty tannins lingering on the finish. Comes together with air, so give this a few years to absorb the oak. Sangiovese and Merlot. Best from 2025 through 2040.

il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-3.title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020 375ml
il-poggione-brunello-di-montalcino-3.bodyHtml:
Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020 is an exceptionally elegant, complex, and beautifully balanced Italian red wine crafted from hand-picked Sangiovese grapes grown on the estate’s oldest vines. Born from a warm growing season, the 2020 vintage reveals a slightly more approachable and open-knit style than traditional years without sacrificing its serious aging potential. In the glass, it displays a deep ruby red color, opening with an explosive and shifting bouquet of blackcurrants, ripe Marasca cherries, and cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex nuances of liquorice root, dusty sage, tobacco leaf, and a delicate hint of pressed roses. On the palate, this wine is full-bodied, structured, and deep, balancing its rich wild berry flavors with a vibrant, refreshing acidity. Its chalky, fine-grained tannins are remarkably velvety, intertwining with flavors of dark cocoa and rosemary before gliding into a long, persistent, and beautifully textured finish marked by notes of flint, lavender, and a distinct mineral tension.

Food Pairing: The combination of powerful structure, bright acidity, and robust tannins makes this Brunello di Montalcino a spectacular companion for rich, savory dishes. It pairs wonderfully with roasted red meats, a classic Bistecca alla Fiorentina (Florentine steak), slow-cooked beef stews, or herb-crusted rack of lamb. It is also an excellent match for hearty game meats like wild boar ragù tossed over fresh pappardelle, truffle-infused risottos, and mature, artisanal hard cheeses such as aged Pecorino Toscano or Parmigiano-Reggiano.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained mix of licorice and graphite, bright red cherries and toasted notes. Firm tannins on the medium- to full-bodied palate with refreshing acidity. Chewy style overall. Try in 2025, but best after 2026.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Showing very nice results, with greater accessibility in this vintage, the Il Poggione 2020 Brunello di Montalcino has dark fruit aromas with blackcurrant followed by something spicy or herbal. I am reminded of licorice root, exotic spice, pressed rose and fragrant tea leaf. It finishes smoothly with silky tannins and an open-knit approach. This vintage is almost ready to drink, and you get elegant complexity at the same time. It sees three years in oak botti. Fruit is sourced across vineyards with 25-year-old-plus vines. This is an ample production of 200,000 bottles.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This red is rich and dense, woven with flavors of cherry, blackberry, plum, black pepper, earth, iron and tobacco. Combines power and grace, with fine balance. The finish echoes the fruit and spice notes. Best from 2028 through 2045.

grgich-hill-cabernet-sauvignon-2012.title: Grgich Hills Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2010 750ml
grgich-hill-cabernet-sauvignon-2012.bodyHtml:
Grgich Hills crafts their Cabernet Sauvignon with minimal intervention, farming our vineyards naturally, without artificial pesticides or herbicides. This wine is packed with rich aromas of black cherry and licorice with a hint of mocha and vintage leather. Its full body and fine-grained tannins make it the perfect partner with grilled steak, rack of lamb or roasted duck.
91 Points - Wine Spectator
A wine that offers a tight, focused beam of loamy earth, dried dark berry, cedar, anise and espresso. Features good length, with gripping tannins. Shows Grgich Hills at the top of its Cabernet game. Best from 2015 through 2026.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This valley-wide blend comes from Yountville, Calistoga and Rutherford. It combines the best fruit of the appellations, resulting in a dry, full-bodied and tannic young wine, with classic Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon flavors of cassis. Beautiful now, after a few hours of decanting, and should hold in the bottle for at least eight years.

grgich-hills-chardonnay-2015.title: Grgich Hills Estate Chardonnay 2015 750ml
grgich-hills-chardonnay-2015.bodyHtml:
The winemaker did not allow this Chardonnay to undergo malolactic fermentatin, preserving its natural acidity. The wine displays ripe peach, mango and tropical flavors, with a note of minerality.

Enjoy with fresh seafood, roasted chicken, grilled pork and creamy cheeses.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This divine and complex white delivers tones of almond paste, sea salt, lime and tangerine that are balanced by fresh, vibrant acidity. This is a well-balanced, food-friendly wine that impresses from start to long finish. Editors’ Choice

smith-hook-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Smith & Hook Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
smith-hook-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
A seductive deep brick red with crimson hues, this Reserve offers aromas of red cherries, cassis, cedar, warm gravel and graphite. With time, the nose continues to evolve, revealing plum, leather and tobacco accents. The wine is in constant motion, playfully dancing across the palate to finish with fine, dusty tannins.

95pts Decanter
Lovely, elegant nose - an inviting mix of restrained blackcurrants and cassis with a hint of menthol, leather and newly sawn wood. A dense, weighty palate with good acidity and grippy tannins. Subtle black fruits linger pleasantly. Lovely structure and good freshness. Intriguing all round.Blend : 97% Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Petite Sirah

glendronach-28-year-old-grandeur-11.title: The GlenDronach 28 Year Old Grandeur 11
glendronach-28-year-old-grandeur-11.bodyHtml:
The GlenDronach Grandeur Batch 11 is a 28 year old Highland single malt that sits at the very top of the GlenDronach range. For this eleventh batch, Master Blender Dr Rachel Barrie selected a very small number of Oloroso sherry casks of exceptional character and matured the whisky entirely in them for 28 years. It is bottled at 48.9% ABV, non-chill filtered and at natural colour, and only 3,181 bottles were filled; each 700ml bottle is wax sealed, numbered by hand and presented in a wooden case. Rachel Barrie describes it as a single malt of elegant finesse, with sherry aromatics woven through dark manuka honey, roasted almond and walnut.

Tasting Notes: Manuka honey, walnut, baked plum, black cherry, espresso and dark chocolate.

Nose: Opulent sherry aromatics with dark manuka honey, roasted almond and walnut; baked plum and ginger deepen to vintage leather and freshly ground coffee.

Palate: Intense and full-bodied, with dark fruit on a base of velvet and fine leather, building to black cherry and espresso.

Finish: Persistent chocolate, liquorice and walnut.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature, given time in the glass.

dom-perignon-p2-2004.title: Dom Perignon P2 Plenitude 2004
dom-perignon-p2-2004.bodyHtml:
For each vintage and from its inception, a limited number of bottles are set aside in the cellars, predestined for longer maturation. With this extra time, the inner activity in the bottle increases. The yeast transfers its energy to the wine... a mysterious transfer of life. After close to 15 years, expansion of energy reaches its peak and Dom Pérignon rises to an apex of essential, radiant vitality in its state of Plénitude. Elevated to new heights, it unfurls across every dimension – wider, deeper, longer, more intense – and gifted further with an extended longevity.

The 2004 fruit remains discreet, yet more clearly defined in this second life of the Vintage. Citrusy notes of pink grapefruit and blood oranges gently cede to figs. The additional time on the lees elevates the minerality of the vintage with the sublime maturity that is Dom Pérignon’s signature. Cocoa, mocha, roasted nuts, brioche and honey. The wine balances on the edge with immediacy and surprise, evolving between tension and weightlessness. It has an extreme, tactile precision, deep and sculptural. The sensations come together in a persistent and elegant finish, underlined by sappy, licorice notes.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Delivers mandarin orange, ripe cherry, raspberry and apricot fruit notes, which are an exuberant burst of flavor at the entry point of this otherwise refined and subtle Champagne. The expressive fruit is joined on the lacy mousse by toast, pastry cream, Earl Grey tea leaf and an underpinning of minerally chalk and smoke. Lithe and graceful on the palate, but with a dancer's sense of restrained power. Drink now through 2037.

97 Points - James Suckling
Structured, tight and mineral with so much tension. White grapefruit, lemon rind, dried apple, seashell, iodine, biscuit and blanched almond. Vibrant. Fantastic focus and verticality.

96 Points - Decanter
P2 is the acronym for the Plénitude 2 series, Dom Pérignon’s second life. It indicates that bottles are kept by the house to let them age on the lees and to obtain different expressions of the same wine throughout its life, letting time work its magic and thus acquiring additional complexity. This year, Dom Pérignon’s cellar master, Vincent Chaperon, decided to release the 2004 vintage. ‘2004 was a contrast to 2003,’ he said. After rain in January, the spring was hot and sunny, like the beginning of summer. But the summer was wet, with 50% more rain than in an average year. Despite this, the health of the grapes was stable and the crop was abundant. ‘This is quite a perfect vintage,’ he added. The bouquet impresses with its finesse and elegance, its delicate aromas of pastry, orchard fruit, nuts, and lemon oil, and both iodine and chalky hints with air. The palate is medium- to full-bodied, very charming, with a sappy texture, racy acids, and a long and lingering finish. This is a very harmonious and rather chalky Dom Pérignon, which must be approached in its singularity.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2004 Dom Pérignon P2 is drinking beautifully on release, wafting from the glass with aromas of sweet orchard fruit, fresh peach, pastry cream, buttered toast and cotton candy that display a less reductive profile than the original disgorgement. Medium to full-bodied, pillowy and charming, with an ample, enveloping core of fruit, succulent acids and a pretty pinpoint mousse, it concludes with a long, sapid finish. Forward and giving, there's no obvious reason to defer gratification.

hundred-acre-ark-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Hundred Acre Ark Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 1.5L Magnum
hundred-acre-ark-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Hundred Acre is located in the United States, within California's Napa Valley and the specific subregion of Howell Mountain. Founded in 2000 by Canadian investment banker Jayson Woodbridge, the winery is known for its meticulous, 'berry by berry' harvesting process and a philosophy of complete estate ownership that allows for total creative freedom. Woodbridge, an autodidact in winemaking, manages the estate alongside his wife Helen Mawson, focusing on producing iconic Cabernet Sauvignon from unique volcanic terroirs.

The Cabernet Sauvignon Ark Vineyard presents a deep garnet-black colour, opening with a provocative sensory profile of baked black cherries, plum preserves, and crème de cassis. On the palate, this full bodied wine is rich and spicy, supported by a rock-solid backbone of grainy tannins and lively acidity that leads to a long, exotic finish. Composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, it displays complex notes of black truffles, Chinese five spice, and earthy forest floor.

tamdhu-batch-strength-no-7.title: Tamdhu Batch Strength Batch No. 007
tamdhu-batch-strength-no-7.bodyHtml:
Tamdhu Batch Strength Batch No. 007 is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from Tamdhu Distillery, the seventh edition of its Batch Strength series and a limited release. It is bottled without chill-filtration at 57.5% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Like every Tamdhu, it is matured exclusively in sherry casks: this batch draws its natural copper colour from full maturation in Oloroso sherry seasoned casks from the bodegas of Jerez, Spain. The distillery describes a thick, luxurious mouthfeel, and suggests that a drop of water brings out caramel apricot, oak spice and lemon. It is presented in a gift box.

Nose: Vanilla sponge, spicy cinnamon and roasted praline.

Palate: Raspberry pavlova, caramel apricots, a wave of oak spice and zingy lemon.

Finish: Long; warm oak spice, baked figs, sherry and freshly peeled clementine.

Serve: Neat, then with a drop of water.

inamore-rosso-igt-terre-di-chieti.title: Inamore Rosso Igt Terre Di Chieti 750ml
inamore-rosso-igt-terre-di-chieti.bodyHtml: Inamore Rosso IGT Terre di Chieti 750ml is a red wine from the Terre di Chieti region in Abruzzo, Italy. It is a blend of Sangiovese, Merlot, and potentially other grapes, offering a well-balanced profile with notes of ripe fruit, such as cherry, and a hint of spice. The wine is typically medium-bodied, with good acidity and mild tannins, making it easy to drink.

le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia-2022.title: Ornellaia Le Serre Nuove dell’Ornellaia 2022
le-serre-nuove-dellornellaia-2022.bodyHtml:
Ornellaia Le Serre Nuove dell’Ornellaia 2022 is a radiant, deeply expressive, and impeccably balanced second wine from the legendary Tenuta dell'Ornellaia estate, reflecting its signature sophistication even in a warm, sun-drenched vintage. Exhibiting a deep red-purple hue in the glass, it opens with a highly aromatic and complex nose featuring notes of ripe blackcurrants, wild plums, and dark cherries, accented by elegant layers of violets, freshly ground coffee, sweet tobacco, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red is remarkably plush, juicy, and focused, displaying an exceptional purity of fruit that counters the vintage's natural weight. Matured for 15 months in French oak barriques, its velvety texture is beautifully supported by super-fine, structured tannins and a persistent, blood orange-tinged vein of freshness, culminating in a long, savory, and wonderfully polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with grilled rosemary lamb chops, slow-cooked beef brisket, rich wild boar ragù, or a prime ribeye steak cooked rare.

95 Points - James Suckling

The brightness and purity of fruit is so beautiful here, showing flowers and currants. Very aromatic. Lots of finesse and focus on the medium-bodied palate with super-fine tannins and a lovely finish.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is both savory and floral, with aromas of violets, crushed rose petals, fresh brewed coffee, top soil, mixed herbs and figs. The palate has the tangy richness of black cherries, black figs and dark chocolate, but a current of mint, saltwater and licorice creates a very fresh, vibrant overall feel.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Ornellaia 2022 Bolgheri Rosso Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia is a blend of 65% Merlot, 25% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Cabernet Franc that saw 15 months in barrique with one-third new oak. Following in the general Ornellaia philosophy, the team has been leaning off long maceration times for more delicate extraction. Blending for this wine usually occurs 12 months after fermentation. This vintage is structured and rich with sweet tannins and a supple texture. This hot vintage brings more fruit weight for sure, but the wine remains fresh and well balanced overall.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A smooth red, this evokes cedar, plum, black currant, blackberry, vanilla and resin aromas and flavors. Broad and dense, with accents of leather, earth and tobacco on the long finish. Cabernet Sauvignon.

le-volte-dell-ornellaia-2020.title: Ornellaia Le Volte dell'Ornellaia 2020 1.5L Magnum
le-volte-dell-ornellaia-2020.bodyHtml:
Ornellaia Le Volte dell'Ornellaia 2020 is an incredibly vibrant, expressive, and beautifully balanced Super Tuscan red wine that provides a highly approachable entry into the celebrated winemaking philosophy of the legendary Tenuta dell'Ornellaia estate. Sourced from choice vineyards along the sun-drenched Tuscan coast, this wine reflects the excellent conditions of the warm 2020 vintage. A thoughtful blend of Merlot, Sangiovese, and Cabernet Sauvignon, each variety was fermented separately in small steel vats to preserve its primary regional characteristics before undergoing malolactic fermentation. The wine was aged for 10 months in a combination of concrete tanks and seasoned French oak barriques previously used for the estate's flagship bottling. In the glass, it displays a bright, concentrated ruby-red color. The nose is highly complex, showing fragrant aromas of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and fresh dark plums, beautifully laced with notes of rose petals, Mediterranean scrub, sweet spices, and subtle chocolate. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red is remarkably smooth and supple, integrating soft, velvety tannins with a lively line of food-friendly acidity that carries into a long, clean, and savory finish filled with spice and primary fruit.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rustic pasta dishes topped with a savory wild boar ragù, grilled rosemary pork chops, or medium-aged Pecorino cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

Attractive aromas of blue fruit with slate and black-licorice character. It’s full-bodied with juicy fruit and an orange-peel undertone. Wet earth, some fresh sage and rosemary, too. I like the Mediterranean flavors in this vintage.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Arom,as of pencil shavings, tree bark and soil open the nose of this blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Sangiovese, before blackberries, blueberries and wild herbs emerge. More berries and brambles show on the palate, with flavors of wild mint, pepper and dark chocolate. Elegant and satisfying.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of Merlot, Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon, the Ornellaia 2020 Le Volte dell'Ornellaia shows medium darkness and texture followed by a very primary and fruit-forward bouquet. There is a generous display of cherry, cassis and wild plum. On second nose, this easy and straightforward Tuscan blend reveals hints of spice, cardamon and polished river stone. In a hot vintage like this, the wine comes together nicely and rather effortlessly.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

This balanced red is laced with black cherry, blackberry, violet and spice flavors. Concentrated and juicy, leaving a lining of dusty tannins on the long finish. Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Sangiovese.

le-volte-dell-ornellaia-2021.title: Ornellaia Le Volte dell'Ornellaia 2020 3L Double Magnum
le-volte-dell-ornellaia-2021.bodyHtml:
Ornellaia Le Volte dell'Ornellaia 2020 is an incredibly vibrant, expressive, and beautifully balanced Super Tuscan red wine that provides a highly approachable entry into the celebrated winemaking philosophy of the legendary Tenuta dell'Ornellaia estate. Sourced from choice vineyards along the sun-drenched Tuscan coast, this wine reflects the excellent conditions of the warm 2020 vintage. The wine was aged for 10 months in a combination of concrete tanks and seasoned French oak barriques previously used for the estate's flagship bottling. In the glass, it displays a bright, concentrated ruby-red color. The nose is highly complex, showing fragrant aromas of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and fresh dark plums, beautifully laced with notes of rose petals, Mediterranean scrub, sweet spices, and subtle chocolate. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied red is remarkably smooth and supple, integrating soft, velvety tannins with a lively line of food-friendly acidity that carries into a long, clean, and savory finish filled with spice and primary fruit.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rustic pasta dishes topped with a savory wild boar ragù, grilled rosemary pork chops, or medium-aged Pecorino cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

Attractive aromas of blue fruit with slate and black-licorice character. It’s full-bodied with juicy fruit and an orange-peel undertone. Wet earth, some fresh sage and rosemary, too. I like the Mediterranean flavors in this vintage.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Arom,as of pencil shavings, tree bark and soil open the nose of this blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Sangiovese, before blackberries, blueberries and wild herbs emerge. More berries and brambles show on the palate, with flavors of wild mint, pepper and dark chocolate. Elegant and satisfying.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of Merlot, Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon, the Ornellaia 2020 Le Volte dell'Ornellaia shows medium darkness and texture followed by a very primary and fruit-forward bouquet. There is a generous display of cherry, cassis and wild plum. On second nose, this easy and straightforward Tuscan blend reveals hints of spice, cardamon and polished river stone. In a hot vintage like this, the wine comes together nicely and rather effortlessly.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

This balanced red is laced with black cherry, blackberry, violet and spice flavors. Concentrated and juicy, leaving a lining of dusty tannins on the long finish. Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Sangiovese.

decero-petit-verdot-remolinos-vineyard.title: Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Mini Ediciones Petit Verdot 2021
decero-petit-verdot-remolinos-vineyard.bodyHtml:
Finca Decero Remolinos Vineyard Mini Ediciones Petit Verdot 2021 is a highly distinct, small-batch single-vineyard red wine that highlights the incredible potential of this traditionally blending grape when showcased entirely on its own. Sourced from preferred low-vigour plots within the high-altitude, 3,500-foot Remolinos Vineyard in Alto Agrelo, the vines are meticulously tended to produce less than one bottle per vine. In the glass, it presents an opaque, inky purple hue. The aromatically intense nose opens with an expressive basket of sour cherries, baked blueberries, and wild blackberries, beautifully intertwined with complex undertones of fresh tobacco, dried lavender, roasted nuts, and a touch of graphite. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, robust, and tightly packed, balancing its concentrated dark fruit core with a vibrant, lifting line of natural acidity. Structured with fine-grained, gripping mountain tannins and a judicious integration of French oak maturation, it leaves a dense, energetic finish showing hints of cocoa dust and subtle baking spices.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with rosemary-infused roasted rack of lamb, slow-braised venison stew, grilled prime ribeye steak with garlic butter, and mature hard cheeses like an aged farmstead cheddar.

92 Points - James Suckling

Rich nose of dried flowers, baked blueberries, tobacco and roasted nuts. Dense and full-bodied, with firm yet nicely polished and creamy tannins. Compact. Better from 2025.

91 Points - Wine Ethusiast

The nose needs a few minutes to open up. When it does, it offers a basket of berries that marks the character of this red. The wine's vigorous palate delivers sour cherry flavors that mix with dark fruit. Gripping tannins and excellent acidity provide support.

stuhlmuller-alex-valley-cabernet-sauv.title: Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
stuhlmuller-alex-valley-cabernet-sauv.bodyHtml:
Silver Oak Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a benchmark, expressive California red crafted from estate-owned and grower vineyards across Sonoma County’s sun-drenched Alexander Valley. Vinified in temperature-controlled stainless steel and matured for 24 months exclusively in American oak barrels (roughly 50% new and 50% once-used) sourced from the winery's dedicated Missouri cooperage, it was aged an additional 15 months in bottle prior to release. In the glass, it displays a deep, opaque ruby core with vibrant violet edges. The bouquet reveals intense, inviting aromas of ripe cassis, black cherries, and wild blackberry compote, seamlessly layered over Silver Oak's signature hallmarks of sweet vanilla bean, toasted coconut, dried sage, cedar, and subtle pipe tobacco. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, supple mouthfeel driven by concentrated dark bramble fruit and mocha, framed by fine-grained, velvety tannins and lively natural acidity that lead into an elegant, persistent, and oak-spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, herb-roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild mushroom risotto, and aged sharp white cheddar cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

So full-bodied, ripe and robust, offering spicy, iron-like, black fruit aromas, with generous dark cherries on a firmly tannic palate. Concentrated black plum, graphite, black pepper, coffee bean, pine resin and oak toast flavors on a full body. The tannins are powerful and fine-grained, shaping the texture significantly at this stage. Drinkable now, but best from 2030.

tolpuddle-vineyard-pinot-noir.title: Stoller Family Estate Dundee Hills Pinot Noir 2023
tolpuddle-vineyard-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Stoller Dundee Hills Pinot Noir 2023 is a pure expression of its unique Oregon terroir, sourced from a selection of blocks and clones across the estate vineyard. It opens with inviting notes of ferrous minerality, warm baking spice, and vibrant layers of juicy red berries like raspberry and black cherry. On the palate, it is beautifully structured and generous, featuring a plush core with soft, lush tannins. Lingering notes of cordial cherry, forest floor, and crushed stones fade seamlessly into a long, relaxed, and remarkably elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted duck breast, herb-crusted wild salmon, earthy mushroom risotto, and savory pork tenderloin with fruit glazes.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich and structured at the core, with handsome flavors of raspberry and pomegranate laced with forest floor and dusky spices as this gathers tannins on the finish.

 

91 Points - James Suckling

Polished and textured, this medium-bodied pinot offers ripe red fruit, red flowers and earthy nuances. Velvety and mouth-filling, with fine, well-integrated tannins and a sleek, easygoing aftertaste. Drink now.

giovanni-chiappini-guado-degemoli.title: Giovanni Chiappini Guado De' Gemoli Bolgheri Superiore 2018 750ml
giovanni-chiappini-guado-degemoli.bodyHtml:
97 Points by Falstaff

Intense, dark ruby. Compact and dense on the nose, full of tobacco, some liquorice, then lots of ripe plum and mulberry. Mouth-filling on the palate with firm, dense tannin, dark berry fruit and fine cedar wood savouriness on the finish.

elio-sandri-barolo-riserva.title: Elio Sandri Barolo Perno Riserva 2017/2018 750ml
elio-sandri-barolo-riserva.bodyHtml:
he Wines from Elio Sandri are world class and just under the radar which is perfect! The vineyards are farmed lovingly, in a truly minimally interventionist style, planted roughly between 300 and 350 meters above sea level, only account for part of the brilliance of these wines. There is of course the winemaking as well. Adhering to a similar non-interventionist tact in the cellar, Elio has quietly been producing wines that should be recognized as among the region's best. Elio's been the guiding hand at Cascina Disa since the 2000 vintage, though the property was purchased by his father in 1965, coincidentally the year of his birth. He has a gift and has quietly been producing wines that will be recognized as deserving the same acclaim as the top Barolo houses. The biggest impediment to that fame is the limited production of about 300 cases a year of Barolo.

2017 Vintage Rating

96 Points - Vinous

The 2017 Barolo Perno Riserva is a real stunner.  Deep, pliant and super-expressive, the 2017 boasts gorgeous inner sweetness and depth to lay off its huge, imposing tannins. The ripeness and overall intensity of the year comes through in the wines captivating aromatics and pliant layered mid-palate. Even so, the 2017 has a boatload of tannins and tons of searing structural intensity to assimilate. I would not dream of touching a bottle anytime soon.

morgenster-reserve-1.title: Morgenster Estate The Reserve Red 2010
morgenster-reserve-1.bodyHtml:
A prestigious Stellenbosch Bordeaux-style blend from Morgenster Estate, combining Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Blackcurrant, raspberry, cherry, violet, licorice, thyme, forest floor, vanilla and mocha unfold across a full, structured palate with vibrant acidity, velvety tannins and excellent age-worthiness.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb shanks, grilled ribeye steak, prime rib, braised beef short ribs, venison, and aged hard cheeses.

finca-de-los-arandinos-crianza.title: Finca De Los Arandinos Crianza 2016 750ml
finca-de-los-arandinos-crianza.bodyHtml: Finca de los Arandinos Crianza 2016 is a red Rioja from Finca de los Arandinos, an estate winery in La Rioja, Spain, bottled under the Rioja Denominación de Origen Calificada. As a Crianza, it carries the barrel and bottle ageing required for that classification before release. The wine is described as combining complexity with elegance: red fruit on the nose, edged with balsamic hints and black pepper, followed by a balanced palate with a silky entry and ripe tannins that round out the finish. At 14% alcohol in a 750ml bottle, this 2016 vintage is a classic, food-friendly Crianza to pour with roast lamb, grilled meats or aged cheeses.

chateau-malescot-saint-exupery-2016.title: Chateau Malescot St. Exupery 2016 750ml
chateau-malescot-saint-exupery-2016.bodyHtml:
Dark and glossy this wine has a garnet color. It doesn't lack depth and structure, with a powerful nose and a hint of black currant. the wood fades behind the structure of silky tannins, full of ripe red fruits. To top it off the finish is beautiful, tender and precise with hints of spices which add to the complexity of this wine.

97 Points - James Suckling

A stunning red with currants, blackberries, roses and violets. Medium to full body, ultra-fine tannins and polish and finesse to the powerful tannins. A real stunner. Better than 2015. Take a serious look at it, beginning 2024.

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The ruby/plum-colored 2016 Château Malescot Saint-Exupéry comes from vines in the heart of the Margaux appellation and is 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 37% Merlot, and the balance Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. It’s a total rock star of wine and has fabulous notes of crème de cassis, barbecue smoke, graphite, and sandalwood that build beautifully with time in the glass. Medium to full-bodied, concentrated, layered, and seamless, it’s incredibly impressive and I’d wager up with the finest vintages ever from this estate. Give it a few years and enjoy over the following 20-25. Bravo!

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Medium to deep garnet-purple colored, the 2016 Malescot St. Exupery sings of cassis, fragrant earth, tobacco and lilacs with a compelling waft of mocha. Medium to full-bodied and strutting loads of expressive fruit layers at this youthful stage, it's framed by ripe, grainy tannins and oodles freshness, finishing with great length and depth.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This estate is really improving. The wine in this vintage is full of fragrant fruit, with the tannins making a fine backdrop to the juiciness. It's going to be a fine medium-term wine.

93 Points - Decanter

This has forward oak edging and attractively smoky fireside notes of ash and grilled sarments. The tannins are monolithic at this stage, and there's a lot to be impressed about in this wine, although it has closed down pretty severely, emphasising austerity rather than seduction. There's no question that all the elements for ageing are present and correct - it's a confident expression of the vintage and one with huge potential. Matured in 70% new oak. From a high yield of 51hl/ha.

93 Points - Wine Spectator
This opens slowly, showing a slight woodsy bent, with alder and mesquite notes leading off, but as it does the core of red currant, blackberry and plum fruit flavor fleshes out nicely, soaking up the woodsy element while adding in light savory detail and black tea and violet notes. A long mineral echo chimes through the finish. Best from 2022 through 2036.

contrada-passochianche.title: Passopisciaro Contrada PC Bianco 2021
contrada-passochianche.bodyHtml:
This wine is the fruit of the experience Passopisciaro has accumulated over the years in understanding their various parcels of Chardonnay.

Year after year, implementing precision viticulture where varying maturation levels were tracked separately, they began to separate the primary material in various phases of harvest and vinification, even within the same parcel. Their Contrada PC is the result and the clear demonstration of how, even with the same variety and position, Etna provides a range of unique and diverse expressions from angle to angle. Contrada PC comes from a minute parcel of Chardonnay planted on small and laborious terraces between 870 and 950 meters, where the production is naturally limited and the maturation very particular and complex.

96 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of cooked apples, creme caramel, and nougat follow through to a full body with layers of fruit. It is soft and round textured, yet tensioned with lots of acidity at the end. Minerals such as stone and basalt. Some white pepper and honeysuckle, too. Pure chardonnay planted at 950 meters high, and is said to be the highest chardonnay vineyard in Italy. Made in stainless and aged in large oak vats. Complex. Drink now or hold.

charles-heidsieck-brut-2012.title: Charles Heidsieck Brut 2012 750ml
charles-heidsieck-brut-2012.bodyHtml:
94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Disgorged in 2019 with eight grams per litre dosage, the 2012 Brut Millésimé offers up aromas of crisp orchard fruit, white flowers and clear honey, complemented by hints of toasted bread and citrus zest and linden. Medium to full-bodied, elegantly fleshy and nicely concentrated, with lively acids and a pinpoint mousse, it's more generous and demonstrative than the 2008. Still, it will nonetheless reward a bit of bottle age.

domaine-giraud-lirac-rouge.title: Domaine Tour Saint Michel Lirac Rouge 2022
domaine-giraud-lirac-rouge.bodyHtml:
Domaine Tour Saint Michel Lirac Rouge is a French Rhône red wine crafted from traditional Southern Rhône grape varieties. This elegant expression showcases aromas of black fruits, cassis, violet, and wild herbs, with a refined palate featuring ripe fruit, smooth tannins, freshness, and a balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled meats, beef dishes, charcuterie, aged cheeses, Mediterranean cuisine, roasted vegetables, and hearty stews.

domaine-giraud-cdp-tradition.title: Domaine Latour-Giraud Meursault-Genevrieres Premier Cru 2023
domaine-giraud-cdp-tradition.bodyHtml: The Domaine Latour-Giraud Meursault-Genevrières Premier Cru 2023 is an elegant, sophisticated, and deeply complex Old World white wine that beautifully captures the unique, sun-drenched limestone soils and natural concentration of this exceptionally balanced vintage. It pours a beautiful mid-yellow colour with subtle greenish reflections in the glass, lifting with an immediate, aromatic bouquet of fresh lime blossom, verbena, and delicate fresh apples, seamlessly layered with intricate undertones of jasmine tea, gardenia, and a hint of warm baking spices. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied Chardonnay is remarkably poised, graceful, and smooth, coating the mouth with pure, velvety intensities of white peach, ripe citrus rind, and a fine-boned framework driven by chalky, tingly minerality. Aged carefully in French oak barrels (25% new) to enhance its structural depth and natural sophistication, it is driven by a finely balanced, food-friendly acidity and a super-sleek texture that carries into a long, persistent, and beautifully measured finish accented by an integrated touch of spice and lemon confit.

domaine-giraud-cdp-galimardes.title: Domaine Giraud Les Galimardes Chateauneuf-Du-Pape 2017 750ml
domaine-giraud-cdp-galimardes.bodyHtml:
Formerly, this wine was labelled as Tradition.

Critic tasting note: (2017 vintage) "Aromas of raspberry and boysenberry mingle into savory sage and thyme on this decadent, perfumed blend of Grenache (80%), Syrah (15%) and Mourvèdre (5%). The palate offers rich, ripe layers of plum preserves, sweet spice, garrigue and fig. Soft and mouthwatering, it's framed by ripe, persistent tannins. Irresistible already but should gain complexity through 2037. Anna Lee C. Iijima" - 94/100, Wine Enthusiast

domaine-giraud-grenaches-de-pierre.title: Champagne Henri Giraud Ay Fut de Chene MV20 Brut Grand Cru
domaine-giraud-grenaches-de-pierre.bodyHtml:
The founding Cuvée of the new Giraud history, a symbol of a return to excellence and the origins of Champagne. Multi Vintage, a guardian of Champagne know how and natural modernity, combines traditional craftsmanship and modern winemaking techniques while keeping in mind the period when the great families of Champagne built the region's history on the genius of its people and its wines. Here is a unique lace built in the image of great perfumes, the perpetual reserve, gentle animal attraction. Salinity and warmth underline the meticulousness, harmony, and dexterity of MV. The hand-embedded clip is a sign of its authenticity.

 

97 Points - James Suckling

A wild energy here with sliced dried apricots, lychees, Asian pears and iodine. Chalk. Medium-bodied, it has a very tight palate with elegance and structure. Extremely long and polished. Pinot noir with a dash of chardonnay. Aged 11 months in 50% old and 50% new wood barrels. Dosage 5 g/L. Disgorged November 2024. Drink or hold.

matthiasson-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvign.title: Matthiasson Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
matthiasson-napa-valley-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:
Matthiasson Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is an elegant and beautifully structured red wine produced by Matthiasson Wines in Napa Valley, California. Crafted with a focus on balance, freshness, and traditional winemaking techniques, this Cabernet Sauvignon showcases the distinctive character of Napa Valley while maintaining a refined, restrained style. The 2019 vintage offers a harmonious combination of dark berry fruits, savoury herbs, subtle earthy notes, and well-integrated oak. With its vibrant acidity, fine tannins, and sophisticated complexity, this wine is an excellent choice for fine dining, special occasions, and Cabernet Sauvignon enthusiasts.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, beef tenderloin, mushroom risotto, roasted vegetables, aged cheddar, and herb-crusted meats.

 

93 Points - James Suckling
