Lovely aromas of roses, red cherries, melted chocolate and redcurrants. Medium-bodied with silky tannins. A lot of freshness and energy here. Pretty is a good word. Bright red fruit and rose petals. From organically grown grapes.

barolo-docg.title: Barolo Docg
barolo-docg.bodyHtml: Francone Barolo DOCG is a red wine from the Barolo appellation in Italy's Piedmont region, made by the Piedmont producer Francone, whose range also includes Barbaresco, Roero Arneis and Barbera d'Alba. Barolo carries Italy's top DOCG classification. 14% ABV, 750 ml.

barolo-brunate.title: Ceretto Barolo Brunate 2019
barolo-brunate.bodyHtml:
This exceptional single-vineyard vintage Barolo opens with an incredibly complex and highly expressive bouquet of ripe black cherries, dark plums, and fresh lavender, beautifully layered with nuances of sweet licorice, balsamic herbs, and dark tobacco leaf. On the full-bodied palate, it showcases monumental structure and focus, pairing a dense, muscular core of dark fruit with a vibrant line of acidity and tight, exceptionally refined noble tannins. The finish is remarkably long, savory, and expansive.

Food Pairing: A perfect choice for slow-braised beef shanks, roasted wild boar ragù, pan-seared venison chops, and highly aged cheeses like Castelmagno.

 

98 Points - James Suckling

The purity of fruit and flowers is exceptional with lavender and blue berry aromas that follow through to a medium to full body with ultra-fine tannins and a long and racy finish. Better in four or five years but shows its greatness already. One of the great Brunate’s from here in a long time.

 

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This wine sees fruit sourced from one of the most distinctive crus in the appellation that is known for elegant and powerful wines. The organic 2019 Barolo Brunate has power and a good amount of brawn, whereas wines from La Morra tend to be softer and silkier overall. This wine, however, shows dark fruit flavors, pretty chalky mineral definition and fragrant iris. Everything is delivered with nuanced intensity.

 

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Beautiful aromas of wild cherry, allspice, fresh leather and flowers gracefully emerge from the glass. The wine delights with mouthwatering acidity and crushed red fruits, like raspberry and strawberry, accompanied by balsamic notes. It has a juicy and round profile, well-integrated and poised for aging. Drink 2025–2045.

rinaldi-barbaresco.title: Rinaldi La Bricca Barbera d'Asti Superiore
rinaldi-barbaresco.bodyHtml:
A magnificent Northern Italian red wine sourced from the highly prized "bricca"—the sun-drenched top crest of the estate's rolling hills in Alto Monferrato. Displaying a deep ruby-red color with brilliant violet hues, the highly complex nose opens with a vinous, intense bouquet of ripe dark cherries, fleshy plums, and crushed wild blackberries. This vibrant fruit core is masterfully layered with sophisticated notes of woodsmoke, sweet baking spices, black pepper, and an ethereal floral trace characteristic of the finest Barbera grapes. On the full-bodied palate, it beautifully balances its deep concentration of dark fruit and the grape's signature vibrant, mouth-watering acidity with a remarkably smooth, harmonious texture supported by 12 months of careful aging in select wood barrels, leading into an exceptionally long, savory, and polished finish with excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with rich pasta dishes like handmade tajarin with meat ragù, wild mushroom risottos, slow-cooked pot roasts, and well-aged cheeses like Castelmagno or Pecorino.

feudo-montoni-rose-di-adele.title: Feudo Montoni Nerello Mascalese Rose di Adele 2025
feudo-montoni-rose-di-adele.bodyHtml:
Feudo Montoni Nerello Mascalese Rosé Di Adele 2025 is a vibrant, elegant, and organic Sicilian rosato crafted by Fabio Sireci at the historic Feudo Montoni estate. Grown at high altitudes in central Sicily, 100% Nerello Mascalese grapes yield a pale copper-pink wine with expressive aromatics of wild strawberry, pomegranate, pink rose petals, citrus peel, and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it is crisp, juicy, and energetic, featuring layers of tart red fruit, bright acidity, and a distinctive savory, saline mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, grilled octopus, seared tuna, goat cheese crostini, caprese salad, and light seafood pasta dishes.

ch-chantegrive-cuvee-caroline-2018.title: Chateau de Chantegrive Cuvee Caroline
ch-chantegrive-cuvee-caroline-2018.bodyHtml:
Chateau de Chantegrive Cuvee Caroline is a premium white wine from the Graves appellation, offering expressive citrus, white peach, floral aromas, and subtle minerality. Richly textured yet vibrant, it finishes with freshness, elegance, and impressive balance.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled lobster, scallops, roasted chicken, creamy seafood pasta, halibut, and goat cheese.

yarra-yering-chardonnay.title: Yarra Yering Chardonnay 2019 750ml
yarra-yering-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Oyster shell nose with grapefruit, pears and ginger. A faint impression of vanillan oak bringing a sweet perfume. Finesse combine with pillowy fruit weight; this is a wine that is fine boned with citrus flavours dominating in its youth. A citrus energy drives the palate with a pithy interest and texture on the back palate. An extremely fine grained oak tannin framework lingers on the finish.

96 Points – James Halladay

While Yarra Yering makes its mark as a red wine producer of excellence, of late its chardonnay is really standing out. It’s changing. It’s finer. It’s pristine, with layers of citrus and tangy acidity lengthening out a palate that’s seamless and textural. It has the right amount of moreish sulphides to the fruit weight. Try putting this down. – Jane Faulkner, 2022 Halliday Wine Companion.

ornellaia-poggio-alle-gazze.title: Ornellaia Poggio alle Gazze dell'Ornellaia 2021
ornellaia-poggio-alle-gazze.bodyHtml:
Poggio alle Gazze dell’Ornellaia is one of Italy’s most innovative and progressive white wines, providing an altogether different experience of the Ornellaia estate and its Mediterranean influences.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

An elegant, complex nose offers lime, citrus blossom and gooseberry, then mixed dried herbs and an almost imperceptible but essential umami undertone of Parmesan rind. The balance between savory and citrus continues on the palate, where a mineral backbone and substantive acidity provide structure within a rich, satiny texture.

93 Points - James Suckling

Sliced apple, pineapple, apricot and crushed stone aromas follow through to a medium body with creamy texture and pleasant bitter lemon flavors at the end. 72% sauvignon blanc, 16% vermentino, 6% viognier, and 6% verdicchio. 

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Made mostly with Sauvignon Blanc, the 2021 Poggio alle Gazze dell'Ornellaia reveals a luminous and transparent appearance with fresh aromas of passion fruit, citrus and green apple. The wine is very focused in this classic vintage with upfront acidity and pretty mineral notes. Ornellaia is one of the only estates to offer a Sauvignon Blanc in this part of Tuscany. This bottle is especially popular at the many local fish restaurants along the coast.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

This white starts out round and fleshy, reminiscent of gooseberry, peach and elderflower in its aromas and flavors. Firms up midpalate, where a bitter citrus element emerges along with mouthwatering acidity. Salty finish.

chablis-grand-cru-les-clos-pinson-freres.title: Alain Geoffroy Chablis Grand Cru Les Clos
chablis-grand-cru-les-clos-pinson-freres.bodyHtml:
Produced from the prestigious Les Clos Grand Cru climat, this Chardonnay expresses the hallmark power and elegance of Chablis with aromas of citrus, white peach, white flowers and pronounced chalky minerality. Richly textured yet vibrant, it delivers exceptional balance, precision and a long, refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with lobster, scallops, oysters, turbot, roasted poultry in cream sauce or aged Comté cheese.

nardi-brunello-di-montalcino-docg.title: Tenute Silvio Nardi Brunello di Montalcino DOCG 2018
nardi-brunello-di-montalcino-docg.bodyHtml:
Tenute Silvio Nardi Brunello di Montalcino 2018 is a distinguished Italian red wine from the prestigious Montalcino appellation in Tuscany. Produced exclusively from Sangiovese grapes, this elegant Brunello reflects the heritage and winemaking expertise of Tenute Silvio Nardi, a historic estate celebrated for crafting wines of exceptional character, structure and ageing potential. The 2018 vintage captures the distinctive terroir of Montalcino, combining traditional Tuscan elegance with expressive fruit and refined complexity. This sophisticated Brunello reveals aromas of ripe red cherries, wild berries and dried flowers, complemented by notes of tobacco, leather, cedar and delicate spice. The palate is beautifully structured, offering polished tannins, refreshing acidity and layers of red fruit balanced by subtle earthy undertones. Its long, harmonious finish and graceful character make it an excellent choice for collectors, fine dining and special occasions.

Food Pairing: Florentine steak (Bistecca alla Fiorentina), roasted lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, porcini mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, aged Pecorino Toscano and Parmigiano Reggiano.

 

93 Points -  James Suckling

I like the transparent savoriness here, with aromas of currants, dried cherries, chocolate, dried flowers and bark. Medium-bodied, with gently chewy tannins and a fine, fresh and elegant finish. Drink or hold.

91 Points - Wine Advocate 

Packaged with the burgundy-colored label, the Tenute Silvio Nardi 2018 Brunello di Montalcino reveals a darkly saturated, almost inky appearance with black ruby highlights. The bouquet is laced with dark cherry fruit and blackberry preserves, and there is juice and energy inside, which is very nice. A second wave of spice and mild tobacco adds to the wine's volume and intensity. I do feel the oak tannins. However, the wine's powerful 15.5% alcohol content is an obstacle that takes away from the elegance of the grape. This is a 150,000-bottle production.

mazzei-vicoregio-gran-selezione.title: Mazzei Castello di Fonterutoli Vicoregio 36 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione DOCG 2019
mazzei-vicoregio-gran-selezione.bodyHtml:
Mazzei Castello di Fonterutoli Vicoregio 36 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione DOCG 2019 is a distinguished Tuscan red wine crafted from 100% Sangiovese grown in the Vicoregio vineyard of Castelnuovo Berardenga. Featuring 36 distinct Sangiovese biotypes, this exceptional Gran Selezione highlights the complexity of its limestone-rich terroir. Matured for 18 months in French oak barrels followed by four months in concrete tanks, it offers concentrated cherry, blackberry, floral notes, and savoury spice. Structured yet elegant, with refined tannins and vibrant acidity, this limited-production wine showcases the depth and aging potential of the outstanding 2019 vintage.

Food Pairing: Spiced roasted lamb, braised beef, wild boar, grilled steak, mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, aged Pecorino, and mature Parmesan.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

A very linear and fine-tannined Chianti Classico with crunchy cherry fruit and hints of minerals. Medium body. Crisp and lively finish. Closed and tight in the mid-palate. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This represents the third vintage in which this wine carries a Gran Selezione designation. Fruit comes from an experimental vineyard at 350 meters in elevation with compact clay soils (with a few stones to break it up), good ventilation and a dominant south-facing position. The property measures 12.5 hectares and was acquired in 1997. Following the graceful 2018 vintage, the Mazzei 2019 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Castello di Fonterutoli Vicoregio 36 shows medium-rich concentration and sweet tannins with plenty of dark fruit, spice, underbrush and wild mint. The 2019 growing season was warm and without rain for most of the summer.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

This classy red boasts a core of ripe, juicy plum, cherry and blackberry fruit framed by a subtle touch of new oak and a mineral underpinning. Reveals refined tannins, which should come into the fold over the next five to seven years as this integrates fully. Shows terrific balance and length, with finesse and complexity. Best from 2026 through 2045.

mazzei-badiola-gran-selezione-docg.title: Fonterutoli Badiòla Gran Selezione Chianti Classico 2017 750ml
mazzei-badiola-gran-selezione-docg.bodyHtml:
Critic tasting note: (2017 vintage) "Made entirely with Sangiovese planted in high-altitude vineyards, this has aromas of violet, new leather, menthol and French oak. The medium-bodied palate offers ripe Marasca cherry, espresso and licorice alongside fresh acidity and fine-grained, drying tannins. Kerin O’Keefe" - 91/100, Wine Enthusiast

Tasting Notes
An innate elegance and freshness, hints of wild berries and red fruits for this wine that is born at an altitude of 570 m, from vineyards that are among the highest in Chianti Classico, with soil composed of marl and sandstone. The municipality of Radda in Chianti, where the vineyards are located, benefits from an overall cooler climate and above all from daytime temperatures among the lowest of the whole company: delayed sprouting, later ripening and harvests around mid-October return a Sangiovese of great verticality and tension.

clos-de-luz-massal-1945-cabernet-sauvign.title: Clos de Luz Massal 1945 Cabernet Sauvignon
clos-de-luz-massal-1945-cabernet-sauvign.bodyHtml:
Deep and expressive, with cassis, blackberry and ripe cherry layered with graphite, tobacco, cedar and subtle herbal notes. The palate is concentrated and elegant, combining vibrant acidity, refined tannins and savory complexity through a long, structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled steak, roasted lamb, braised beef, game meats, mushroom dishes, hearty stews, or aged hard cheeses.

barolo-vigna-rionda.title: Luigi Oddero Barolo Vigna Rionda 2015
barolo-vigna-rionda.bodyHtml:
Bright garnet-red colored with a pale orange tinge after long ageing. Intense, ethereal, very persistent aromas with notes of spices, underwood, licorice and wilted flowers. Dry, full and well-structured on the palate.

It is excellent with roast meats, game meat and fine aged cheese.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

2008-barolo-vigna-rionda.title: Luigi Oddero Barolo Vigna Rionda 2007 750ml
2008-barolo-vigna-rionda.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2007 vintage) "Aromas recall fennel, grilled herb, leather, mocha and a whiff of balsam. Reflecting the heat of the vintage, the palate is already evolved but still shows dried black cherry and black pepper. Drink through 2017." - 90/100, Wine Enthusiast

kamen-kashmir.title: Kamen Kashmir 2018
kamen-kashmir.bodyHtml:
Kamen Kashmir 2018 is a rich, powerful, and deeply expressive single-vineyard red wine produced from high-elevation organically farmed vines on the volcanic slopes of Mount Veeder in Sonoma Valley. Displaying an opaque, deep purple-black hue, it opens with an intense, captivating bouquet of cassis, crushed black plums, blackberry reduction, cocoa nibs, and graphite, intertwined with nuanced accents of violet, crushed rock, and dried lavender. On the palate, it is full-bodied, opulent, and seamlessly constructed, delivering layers of concentrated dark berry fruit supported by fine-grained, firm volcanic tannins and vibrant acidity that leads into a exceptionally long, mineral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with prime dry-aged ribeye, braised short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, venison loin, or aged gouda and cheddar cheeses.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This large-scaled wine offers up waves of warmed plum sauce, blackberry compote and black Mission fig paste flavors carried by ample graphite and a cast iron-accented structure. The fruit drips over the frame though, easily absorbing it, while violet, melted licorice and ganache accents fill in on the finish. Impressive combo of heft and cut. Best from 2023 through 2038.

villa-don-maximiano-2017.title: Errazuriz Villa Don Maximiano 2017 750ml
villa-don-maximiano-2017.bodyHtml:
The inaugural release of Villa Don Maximiano, a special blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Malbec and Cabernet Franc, is elegant, dense and re fined. The wine displays fruit purity and intensity, yet it is distinctively focused. A rush of red fruit and-oral notes rise from the glass including notes of red cherry, fresh blueberries, cocoa and a soft note of currant leaves. Once in the palate, notes of sour cherries plus fresh blueberries emerge. It is a very fruity and refreshing wine that has a seamless impression from beginning to end. Its tannins are firm and well structured, with a beautiful intensity and balance. This vintage of Villa Don Maximiano will certainly age nicely for years to come.

95 Points - Descorchados

The second version of Villa is 28% syrah, 25% cabernet sauvignon, 20% malbec, 17% cabernet franc, and the rest is mourvèdre. 100% of the wine was aged in oak (75% in barrels and the rest in a foudre) for 22 months. It’s rich in red fruits and juicy tones of herbs and spices, but it’s also generous in vibrant textures supported by tense, nervy tannins.

94 Points - James Suckling

Beautiful aromas of currants, coffee and dried flowers.  Full body, round and juicy tannins with berry, chocolate and light vanilla undertones.  Delicious finish.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

indigenous-world-winery-simo.title: Indigenous World Simo Small Lot Red Blend 2017 750ml
indigenous-world-winery-simo.bodyHtml: Simo, pronounced See-Moo, is the signature Bordeaux blend made at Indigenous World. Winemaker Jason Parkes has worked magic with this outstanding red, made in small lots and aged for 44 months at the winery. The blend is merlot led, mixed with cabernet sauvignon from the Okanagan Valley. Parkes has retained the balance and vibrancy of the vintage and used it to ignite a bouquet of black raspberries, leather, and vanilla that spill onto a lively palate with more of the same streaked with licorice and pepper. It is complex and elegant, which is no easy task. However, it is another example of why you should hunt for 2016 BC reds.

clos-de-luz-azuda-syrah.title: Clos De Luz Azuda Syrah 2018 750ml
clos-de-luz-azuda-syrah.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "This syrah from granite-rich soils was planted in the Almahue zone in the mid-2000s. It was aged in barrels for a year (10% new) and shows a light touch of smoke, but the truth is that the focus is on pure red fruit, spices, and a meaty touch in a wine with tense acidity and firm tannins. Think of lamb." - 92/100, Patricio Tapia - Descorchados

clos-de-luz-massal-1945-carmenere.title: Clos De Luz Massal 1945 Carmenere 2019 750ml
clos-de-luz-massal-1945-carmenere.bodyHtml:
Rapel Valley
Touching the Pacific in the west and stretching up into the Andes on its eastern side, the Rapel Valley is one of the more substantial fine red wine producing regions of Chile and contains both the Colchagua Valley in its south and west and the Cachapoal in its north and east. While it is recognized for its exceptional warm-climate reds, the region does produce some fine Pinot noir and Sauvignon blanc on its coastal side.

Some of the country’s finest Cabernet Sauvignon comes from the Rapel’s Andean foothills—with significant individualized smaller zones already identified. Soils here are mixtures of loam, clay, and sand; Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenère, and Merlot are the most prolific varieties throughout the region.
Carmenere
Dark, full-bodied and herbaceous with a spicy kick, Carménère found great success with its move to Chile in the mid-19th century. However, the variety went a bit undercover until 1994 when many plantings previously thought to be Merlot, were profiled as Carménère. Somm Secret— Carménère is both a progeny and a great-grandchild of the similarly flavored Cabernet Franc.

camino-real.title: Guimaro Camino Real 2020 750ml
camino-real.bodyHtml:
Ribeira Sacra Wine
Located in the center of the Galician region in northern Spain, the Ribeira Sacra is one of Spain's most beautiful vineyard areas with stunningly breathtaking views. Vines are planted in the steep valleys and precipitous gorges of the Rivers Miño and Sil that wind through Galicia's lush green countryside. The Ribeira Sacra region has similar dramatic landscapes as the Mosel or Douro Valleys, but a more sparse population and a tranquility unmatched. The region gained official DO status in 1996.

Both white wine and red wine production are dominated by blends of local Galician grapes, with varietal wines being the exception. Today, while the region has seen some consolidation and modern stainless-steel equipment is widespread, winemaking remains artisanal. This reflects the tiny landholdings and farmhouse wineries, along with a traditional and predominantly organic approach to viticulture. With such low yields and often minuscule production levels, these wines are highly sought-after and can be difficult to find on the export market.

Ribeira Sacra DO’s principal white grape varieties tend to be highly fragrant and include Albariño, Doña Blanca, Godello, Loureira, Torrontés and Treixadura. Principal red grape varieties here include Mencía, Brancellao, Merenzao, Caiño, Sousón and Tempranillo.

domaine-du-pegau-cuvee-laurence-red-2012.title: Domaine du Pegau Chateauneuf-du-Pape Cuvee Laurence 2017
domaine-du-pegau-cuvee-laurence-red-2012.bodyHtml:
The 2017 Domaine du Pégau Châteauneuf-du-Pape Cuvée Laurence is a sophisticated, deeply complex, and traditional French red wine of incredible character, essentially representing an extended wood-aged selection of the estate's flagship Cuvée Réservée. It pours a dark ruby-garnet color with subtle ochre brightening on the rim in the glass. The nose lifts with an enveloping, warm, and highly expressive bouquet of ripe red cherries, dark berries, and plum, seamlessly integrated with complex layers of dried rose, graphite, tobacco, and smoked bacon fat. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is juicy, earthy, and fruit-forward, delivering concentrated layers of sweet cherry fruit, nougat, licorice, and peppery herbs. Patiently matured for up to four years in traditional oak foudres before bottling, it balances its powerful richness with a fresh acidity and firm, stunningly fine tannins, transitioning into a long, mineral-driven finish marked by exotic spices and a distinct savory undertone.

 

97 Points - James Suckling

Enveloping, warm and spicy nose with an extremely wide spectrum of aromas, ranging from dried rose to graphite via thyme and smoked bacon. Very powerful, concentrated and earthy, yet there’s brightness in there that makes it shine, Stunningly fine tannins power the super-long finish. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

 The 2017 Châteauneuf du Pape Cuvée Laurence was set to be bottled in November 2021, just after my visit. It boasts restrained aromas of leather, plum and garrigue but compensates for the slightly more sedate aromatics with a supple, complete and rounded feel on the palate. It's full-bodied, silky and long, ready to drink on release or anytime over the next decade and a half. My tastings during my evening visit to Domaine du Pegau included a number of other wines, both from Chateau Pegau and Selection Laurence Feraud. Those will be included in my follow-up coverage of other appellations of the Southern Rhône. For this report, I've focused on the current and upcoming releases from the property itself.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Time has softened the edges of this elegant, earthy, well-built red. Slightly old-school in style, with incense, forest floor, smoked meat and iodine layered over mulled raspberry and red tea. Beautifully textured, with present tannins holding firm on the dry finish. Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre.

marques-del-silvo-reserva.title: Marques del Silvo Reserva Tinto 2017 750ml
marques-del-silvo-reserva.bodyHtml:
Marqués del Silvo Reserva Tinto 2017 is a Spanish red wine presented in the traditional Reserva style, offering a rich and approachable drinking experience. With a profile of ripe dark berries, plum, gentle spice, and savoury oak-inspired notes, this wine is suited to those who enjoy structured, full-flavoured reds. Its combination of fruit character, balanced acidity, and a lingering finish makes it an appealing choice for dinners, celebrations, or relaxed evenings.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with grilled beef, roasted lamb, pork tenderloin, hearty stews, mushroom dishes, aged Manchego cheese, and traditional Spanish tapas.

 

90 Points - James Suckling

Fresh red cherries, strawberries and plums with hints of vanilla and sweet spices. A medium-bodied Rioja with firm tannins and juicy red-berry fruit. Drink now.

2015-vina-magna-reserva.title: Dominio Basconcillos Vina Magna Reserva 750ml
2015-vina-magna-reserva.bodyHtml:
A number of critics have rated this Ribera del Duero wine extremely highly.

Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) " Color: deep cherry. Aroma: ripe fruit, dried herbs, creamy oak. Flavour: powerful, ripe fruit, spicy, round tannins. " - 93/100, Guia Penin
Tempranillo in Rioja
In Rioja, Tempranillo is, more often than not, the major component of a Rioja blend (alongside varying proportions of Garnacha, Mazuelo (Carignan) and Graciano. In Ribera del Duero, the variety is known as "Tinto Fino" and, if not blended with the likes of Cabernet Sauvignon, wines here are often made as a 100-percent Tempranillo.
Tempranillo flavors & characteristics
Tempranillo is a relatively thick-skinned red grape with a high anthocyanin count that makes for deep-colored red wines with moderate tannins and, where rosé is produced from the variety, generally quite deeply-hued, pink colors.

Aromas
While the variety is often accused of lacking its own idiosyncratic flavor profile, Tempranillo wines can produce a wide range of aromas, ranging from strawberries, blackcurrants and cherries to prunes, chocolate, leather and tobacco depending on vineyard age and mesoclimate.

Palate profile
Moderate to full-bodied, Tempranillo generally shows moderate tannins with moderate to low acidity. Temperate climates (or those with good diurnal temperature shift) such as Rioja and Ribera del Duero produce long-lived, structured, often elegant wines.

In warmer climates, the variety can take on a darker fruit aspect with high alcohol, high tannins and low acidity.

xavier-vins-arcane-les-amoureux.title: Xavier Vignon Arcane VI 'Les Amoureux' 2016
xavier-vins-arcane-les-amoureux.bodyHtml:
Xavier Vignon Arcane VI 'Les Amoureux' 2016 is a rich, opulent, and masterfully blended Southern Rhône red created by oenologist Xavier Vignon. Sourced from five distinct crus—Lirac, Gigondas, Beaumes-de-Venise, Vacqueyras, and Rasteau—this wine is aged exclusively in concrete tanks to preserve fruit purity and terroir expression. In the glass, it displays a deep ruby hue and releases expressive aromas of ripe black cherry, cassis, dried herbs, garrigue, tapenade, and crushed black pepper. The palate is full-bodied, supple, and beautifully balanced, offering concentrated layers of dark plum, wild raspberry, and licorice framed by silky, powdery tannins and a salivating, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, duck breast with berry reduction, or braised wild boar ragù.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
A blend of lots from five different Southern Rhône crus (and hence declassified to Côtes du Rhône), the 2016 Cotes du Rhone Arcane VI Les Amourcaux is a stunning effort, showcasing raspberry and strawberry fruit, a silky-creamy texture and lush, mouthwatering flavors. No, it doesn't speak of the individual terroirs (Beaumes de Venise, Gigondas, Lirac, Rasteau, Vacqueyras), but it delivers sheer deliciousness.

93 Points - James Sukling
Red berries, red flowers and a berry-pastry edge to the nose, making for an attractive offering. The palate has a super juicy feel with succulent, vibrant raspberry and red-plum flavors, carrying long on silky, powerful tannins. Impressive. Drink or hold.

alvaro-castro-reserva.title: Alvear Gran Reserva 25 Year Old Brandy
alvaro-castro-reserva.bodyHtml: This brandy Alvear Gran Reserva has a reddish mahogany colour. On the nose it has a powerful aroma of wood, with notes of pastry, sharp and distillate background. On the palate, it is sweet, spirited, long and persistent with hints of nuts and wood.

voyager-the-modern-cab-sauv.title: Voyager Estate The Modern Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 750ml

ashes-and-diamonds-bates-ranch.title: Ashes & Diamonds Bates Ranch Mountain Cuvee No.1 2016 750ml
ashes-and-diamonds-bates-ranch.bodyHtml:
This strong and concentrated blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc was made by Diana Snowden Seysses of Burgundy’s famed Domaine Dujac. Fruit hails from dry-farmed soils and is co-fermented with native yeasts and aged in oak, 35% of which is new. The final wine is plush and balanced, marked by well-integrated tannins, dark fruit, and a lengthy finish. 

93 Points - Vinous

The 2016 Bates Ranch Mountain No. 1 is terrific. It is also one of the wines in this range where site and style are very well matched. The blend 65% Cabernet Sauvignon and 35% Cabernet Franc, co-fermented, works beautifully here. Savory, mineral and tightly wound, the 2016 is going to need time to unwind, but it is undoubtedly very promising. It will be interesting to see what winemaker Diana Snowden-Seysses does with this fruit in future vintages.

zorzal-gran-terroir-chardonnay.title: Zorzal Gran Terroir Chardonnay 2020/2023 750ml
zorzal-gran-terroir-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Our 'Gran Terroir' come from vineyards planted at altitude which give life to complex and aromatic wines, given the thermal difference that occurs between day and night during maturation. Its special character, complexity and structure are given by aging in French and American oak barrels.

View: bright green with golden flashes.

Nose: of great mineral complexity, with the presence of graphite, gunpowder and nuts.

Palate: it is a wine of tension, fine textures and a very long finish.

93 Points - Descorchados

For this Gran Terroir, winemaker Juan Pablo Michelini selects chardonnay vines from vineyards with sandy and calcareous soils in Gualtallary, toward the northern end of the Uco Valley, and more than 1,300 meters up in an area known as "Gualtallary Albo." The wine begins its fermentation in cement eggs and ends it in 500-liter barrels, where it also aged for about 10 months. The wine has the imprint of the place—the saline notes and the firm acidity—but the ripeness of the fruit flavors and the toasted touches from the oak are also added here and lend complexity. A creamy, succulent wine.

zorzal-el-barba.title: Zorzal El Barba Malbec 2018 750ml
zorzal-el-barba.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "This new edition of El Barba in one of the best vintages of the decade continues to be a very particular malbec. It comes from Zorzal's own vineyards beside the winery in Gualtallary, and the vines are planted on sandy soils with a depth of about four meters. Fermented in concrete eggs and then aged in 2,000-liter foudres for just over a year, this version is intense in flavors of red fruits and notes of spices and herbs in a powerful body with sharp tannins, intense acidity, and a finish that tastes like tart black fruits. One for the cellar." - 96/100, Patricio Tapia - Descorchados

villa-wolf-forster-pechstein-riesling.title: Joh. Jos. Prüm Graacher Himmelreich Riesling Kabinett 2023
villa-wolf-forster-pechstein-riesling.bodyHtml:
A refined Mosel Riesling Kabinett from Joh. Jos. Prüm, sourced from the renowned Graacher Himmelreich vineyard. Light peach, apricot and citrus lead into expressive acidity, delicate sweetness and deep slate minerality, creating an elegant, vibrant wine with remarkable freshness and length.

Food Pairing: Spicy Asian cuisine, sushi, fresh seafood, light poultry dishes, soft cheeses and fruit-based desserts.

94 Points - James Suckling

Super cool and bright with a wide spectrum of delicate garden herb and white tree fruit aromas. Sleek, light-bodied and pristine, with a wonderful balance of restrained juiciness and stony freshness in the long

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Bernkasteler Badstube Kabinett shows ripe and lush but delicate fruit with finely weathered slate aromas. This weightless Riesling is light, filigreed and very delicate on the palate, and fruit and acidity are in perfect balance. This is not a super substantial Badstube but a very delicate palate dancer. 9% stated alcohol. Natural cork.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A dry-leaning style, with persimmon, lime zest and heather flecked with celery seed and white tea. A steely mineral edge drives the energy, while finely beaded acidity brings litheness despite the sweetness and power. Shows length, complexity and poise. Drink now through 2030. 80 cases imported.

200-monges-gran-reserva-blanco.title: Bodegas Vinicola Real 200 Monges Gran Reserva Blanco 2009
200-monges-gran-reserva-blanco.bodyHtml: Bodegas Vinicola Real 200 Monges Gran Reserva Blanco 2009 is a rare and prestigious aged white Rioja, marking the first white Gran Reserva released by the estate. Crafted from 100% Viura grapes sourced from high-altitude vineyards in the Alto Najerilla, the wine is produced as a "white with a red soul," featuring a robust structure designed for exceptional aging. After years of maturation in 225-litre oak barrels and the bottle, it presents a deep yellow to bright golden hue. The aromatic profile is expansive and fresh, offering complex layers of dried flowers, ripe stone fruits, wild herbs, and sweet oak spices like cinnamon and nutmeg. On the palate, it is full-bodied and meaty with a powerful citrus backbone, balanced by a saline minerality and a long, savory finish.

cueva-del-monge-tinto.title: Bodegas Vinicola Real Cueva Del Monge Rioja 2015
cueva-del-monge-tinto.bodyHtml: Bodegas Vinícola Real Cueva del Monge Rioja 2015 is a versatile and expressive red wine from the Iregua Valley, designed to showcase a more youthful and fruit-forward personality compared to the estate's longer-aged "200 Monges" line. The 2015 vintage, harvested manually in small boxes, underwent a 12-day fermentation at controlled temperatures before aging for 10 months in French and American oak barrels. This maturation takes place in the winery's unique rock-hewn cellars, which maintain natural temperature and humidity levels year-round. The wine presents an intense red colour with purple hues and a complex aromatic profile of ripe red fruits, toffee, and spice, complemented by subtle smoky notes from the barrel. On the palate, it is well-structured and fleshy, offering flavors of black cherry and chocolate supported by integrated tannins and a fresh, persistent finish.

ashes-and-diamonds-grand-vin.title: Ashes & Diamonds Bates Ranch Mountain Cuvee No.1 2016 750ml
ashes-and-diamonds-grand-vin.bodyHtml:
This strong and concentrated blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc was made by Diana Snowden Seysses of Burgundy’s famed Domaine Dujac. Fruit hails from dry-farmed soils and is co-fermented with native yeasts and aged in oak, 35% of which is new. The final wine is plush and balanced, marked by well-integrated tannins, dark fruit, and a lengthy finish. 

93 Points - Vinous

The 2016 Bates Ranch Mountain No. 1 is terrific. It is also one of the wines in this range where site and style are very well matched. The blend 65% Cabernet Sauvignon and 35% Cabernet Franc, co-fermented, works beautifully here. Savory, mineral and tightly wound, the 2016 is going to need time to unwind, but it is undoubtedly very promising. It will be interesting to see what winemaker Diana Snowden-Seysses does with this fruit in future vintages.

ashes-and-diamonds-vineyard-1.title: Ashes & Diamonds Vineyard 1 Cabernet Sauvignon 2015 750ml
ashes-and-diamonds-vineyard-1.bodyHtml:
The 2015 Ashes & Diamonds Vineyard 1 Cabernet Sauvignon is absolutely gorgeous. This vineyard has a remarkable history, as a portion of it was planted in 1895 by Mrs. Thomas Rutherford herself, and it was later used by the iconic winemaker André Tchelistcheff, to make some of the classic wines for Beaulieu Vineyards. The Vineyard consists of Cabernet clones 6 and 4, which are planted to thin, gravelly soils. The 2015 Vineyard 1 Cabernet Sauvignon is made by talented winemaker Steve Matthiasson, and is a simply beautiful, elegant and classic expression. It begins with pretty aromas of red currants and red berries woven together with tobacco, herbs, spices, dried roses, black tea and hints of dusty minerals all taking shape. On the palate this is beautifully structured around a medium body with fine tannins and lovely acidity at its core, keeping it bight and lively through the finish. While its potential is already quite evident, this is ultimately an age-worthy wine which will thrive in the cellar. 

95 Points - Falstaff

Dark ruby garnet, violet glints, delicately paler at the rim. Ripe bouquet, delicate nuances of dried plums, candied orange zest, underlaid with dark berry jammy notes. Juicy, expressive texture, smooth, mature style, round tannins, chocolatey as well as ripe plums. Already easy to drink despite its youthfulness, fine spicy aftertaste.

ashes-and-diamonds-red-hen.title: Ashes & Diamonds 'Red Hen' Cabernet Sauvignon 2016 750ml
ashes-and-diamonds-red-hen.bodyHtml: Diana Snowden Seysses makes some of the most esteemed Burgundy around at Domaine Dujac, but she was born in California and hasn't forgotten her roots. At Ashes & Diamonds, she makes wine that reflects that heritage: this bottle is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon from a great vineyard in Napa Valley. It has bright, fresh flavors, and a richness and savoriness as satisfying as the steak you should eat alongside it.

michel-rey-pouilly-fuisse-les-crays.title: Eve & Michel Rey Les Crays Pouilly-Fuisse 2020 750ml
michel-rey-pouilly-fuisse-les-crays.bodyHtml:
The nose is spicy, vanilla but also somewhat liquorice. Freshness and intensity are there.

Fresh vanilla prevails on the palate but is followed by a few notes of white apricot fruits. The finish is a little woody but with finesse and blend. A nice density of wine.

porseleinberg-syrah-2017.title: Pearce Predhomme Cinsault Syrah 2017
porseleinberg-syrah-2017.bodyHtml:
A vibrant Stellenbosch red blend made from bush vines planted in Koffieklip soils. Fresh cherry, strawberry and wild raspberry mingle with spice and granite minerality. Light-bodied and juicy, it offers lively acidity, delicate tannins and concentrated fruit.

Food Pairing: Grilled meats, salmon, vegetables and spicy dishes.

senses-charles-heintz-chardonnay.title: Substance 'Ch' Chardonnay 2020
senses-charles-heintz-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Substance 'Ch' Chardonnay 2020 is an incredibly refined, artisanal-style white wine crafted to bring authentic Burgundian-inspired restraint to Washington State. Barrel-fermented with 100% native yeasts and aged on its lees for ten months in French oak, it yields an inviting and complex bouquet of Fuji apples, glazed lemons, orange blossoms, and candied ginger, supported subtly by hints of brioche, toasted vanilla, and wet limestone. The palate is beautifully balanced and medium-to-full-bodied, delivering an oily yet crisp texture with layers of lemon meringue and fresh pear that glide effortlessly into a clean, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing:

This textured and vibrant Chardonnay pairs wonderfully with pan-seared sea scallops, roasted chicken with tarragon cream sauce, grilled halibut, or creamy pasta dishes.

93 Points by James Suckling
Aromas of candied ginger, baked pear and fresh herbs. Full-bodied with a lovely, oily texture. Layered flavors of chamomile and lavender at the beginning, but turns toward fresh cream and then the note of candied ginger on the nose returns. Linear and balanced.

senses-mcm-88-pinot-noir-1.title: Bachelet-Monnot Maranges 1er Cru 'La Fussiere' Rouge 2023
senses-mcm-88-pinot-noir-1.bodyHtml:
Bachelet-Monnot Maranges 1er Cru 'La Fussiere' Rouge 2023 is a remarkably pure, expressive, and refined Pinot Noir hailing from one of the most celebrated Premier Cru vineyards in the southernmost appellation of the Côte de Beaune. Exhibiting a vibrant ruby color, it unfolds on the nose with red cherries, wild strawberries, and crushed cranberries, seamlessly balanced by subtle notes of rose petals, damp earth, and delicate baking spices. On the palate, the wine delivers a beautifully focused medium body, silken tannins, and bright natural acidity that carries through to a long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with duck breast, roasted pork tenderloin, grilled quail, mushroom risotto, coq au vin, and mild French cheeses like Époisses.

94 Points - Vinous

The 2023 Maranges La Fussières 1er Cru Rouge is blended with 30% whole bunch. This has an understated bouquet with light earthy red fruit with sous-bois and mineral scents. It opens succinctly in the glass. The palate is medium-bodied with finely chiseled tannins, very poised, airy and transparent yet with real weight and presence on the finish. Bon vin!

92 Points - Jasper Morris

50% whole bunch. One plot with concentrated small berries and one very old vines, mean that whole bunches work well here on a heavier clay soil. Almost a black centre with a purple rim. This is very generous but not too sunny, a wealth of black cherry and raspberry fruit, velvet texture which is very rare in Maranges and a long finish.

benegas-estate-cabernet-franc.title: Morgenster Estate Cabernet Franc 2021
benegas-estate-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml:
A refined Stellenbosch Cabernet Franc from Morgenster Estate, showcasing cassis, red cherry, blueberry, cranberry, lavender, roasted bell pepper and sweet tobacco. The palate is juicy and elegant, with savoury depth, chalky tannins and a lingering finish of red fruit and spice.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops, grilled duck breast, beef tenderloin, pork loin with herbs, wild mushroom risotto, and aged goat cheese.

 

92 Points - James Suckling

Ripe blackberries and mulberries with hints of walnut, licorice and cedar. Medium- to full-bodied with chalky tannins and impressive tension. Layered and textured, with vivid fruit character and spicy finish. Drink or hold.

ch-cheval-blanc-2016.title: Chateau Cheval Blanc 2016
ch-cheval-blanc-2016.bodyHtml:
Chateau Cheval Blanc is a Saint-Emilion Grand Cru red centered on Cabernet Franc and Merlot. Its distinctive gravel and clay terroir contributes freshness, elegance, power, and finesse, while precise parcel-by-parcel vinification creates a complex, balanced expression combining aromatic refinement, structured depth, and exceptional aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roasted lamb loin, beef tenderloin, duck breast, or braised short ribs.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple in color, with intense red currant, black cherry, wild blueberry, violet, star anise, cinnamon, cigar box, and smoky notes. The palate shows exceptional elegance and depth, layered red and black fruit, mineral character, firm grainy texture, and an extraordinarily persistent, perfumed finish.

99 Points - James Suckling

Wet earth, fresh mushroom, menthol, blackberry, and blueberry aromas lead into a full-bodied, dense, structured palate. Powerful tannins are remarkably integrated, with detailed definition, a cashmere-like texture, and a long, polished finish.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Rich and smoky, with powerful fruit and an impressive perfumed character. Spice and blackberry notes combine with substantial tannins, providing firmness, structure, and excellent aging potential.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

A highly structured and refined expression with concentrated fruit, firm tannins, freshness, and considerable length, showing the depth and balance expected from the 2016 vintage.

ch-rieussec-2016.title: Chateau Rieussec Sauternes (Premier Grand Cru Classe) 2016 750ml
ch-rieussec-2016.bodyHtml:
Pale lemon in color, the 2016 Carmes de Rieussec features notes of candied orange peel and honey-drizzled peaches with touches of beeswax and lemon curd.
The palate is rich with a lovely line of freshness cutting through the stone fruit layers, finishing on a spicy note.

buoncristiani-napa-valley-o-p-c.title: Buoncristiani O.P.C. (Ol' Pa's Cuvee) Proprietary Red 2019

chateau-caronne-ste-gemme-haut-medoc.title: Chateau Caronne Ste. Gemme Haut-Medoc 2019 750ml
chateau-caronne-ste-gemme-haut-medoc.bodyHtml:
Several important critics have rated this Haut-Medoc wine highly.

Critic tasting note: (2020 vintage) "Dried herbs, tobacco leaf, cedar, and peppery currants are easy to spot in the perfume and on the palate. Medium-bodied, chewy and savory, the wine leaves you with in herb-infused, minty, red currant finish. Drink from 2024-2039." - 88/100, Jeff Leve, The Wine Cellar Insider

cesare-bussolo-barolo-del-comune-di-la-m.title: Cesare Bussolo 'Del Comune di La Morra' Barolo 2021
cesare-bussolo-barolo-del-comune-di-la-m.bodyHtml:
Cesare Bussolo 'Del Comune di La Morra' Barolo 2021 is a wonderfully elegant and fragrant expression of Nebbiolo, crafted by one of Piedmont's rising stars under the mentorship of Roberto Voerzio. Luminous and precise, the nose is redolent with bright, fresh aromas of Morello cherry, wild raspberry, and crushed rose petals, beautifully layered with nuances of dry, gravelly earth, sweet spices, and subtle licorice. On the palate, it exhibits a refined, almost Burgundy-like texture, delivering a vibrant core of primary fruit balanced by a crisp, lively acidity and fine, silky tannins, culminating in a long, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with classic Piedmontese dishes like truffle-shaved tajarin pasta, slow-braised veal osso buco, roasted lamb, and aged cheeses like Toma.

chardonnay-mcminnville-ava.title: Martin Woods Yamhill Chardonnay 2021
chardonnay-mcminnville-ava.bodyHtml:
Martin Woods Yamhill Chardonnay 2021 is an exceptional premium Oregon Chardonnay from the acclaimed Yamhill Valley Vineyard in the McMinnville AVA, crafted by Martin Woods with a precise terroir-driven philosophy. This beautifully structured Chardonnay reveals layered notes of grilled peach, Meyer lemon, pear, honeycomb, chamomile, cardamom, wet stone minerality, and subtle smoky complexity. Rich texture balanced by vibrant acidity and saline tension creates a polished, age-worthy Chardonnay that beautifully captures Oregon’s cool-climate elegance.

Food Pairing: Butter-poached lobster, seared scallops, roast chicken with herbs, creamy mushroom risotto, grilled halibut, shellfish pasta, soft-ripened cheeses, and elegant seafood dishes.

 

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Chardonnay Yamhill Valley Vineyard is deep and expressive. Matured in French and Oregon oak for 11 months, it has intense aromas of grilled peaches, honeycomb, ginger, mushroom and candle smoke. The medium-bodied palate is youthfully tangy and tense with a coiled core of fruit and saline character that gives it a shimmery feel. It has a luxurious texture that extends the finish, and it's a pleasure to drink straight from the bottle despite its potential for graceful aging.

89 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of baked apples, tarragon and yogurt. Medium- to full-bodied. Ripe and creamy on the palate with a weighty finish. Drink now.

cesare-bussolo-barolo-fossati.title: Cesare Bussolo 'Fossati' Barolo 2020
cesare-bussolo-barolo-fossati.bodyHtml:
Cesare Bussolo 'Fossati' Barolo 2020 is an exceptional, terroir-driven expression of Nebbiolo sourced from the renowned Fossati cru in La Morra. Cultivated with extremely low yields and organic practices, this exquisite wine pours a luminous garnet hue. The complex and expressive nose offers captivating aromas of Parma violet, ripe raspberry, and red currant, intricately layered with notes of anise, cedar, tea roses, and rich earth. On the palate, it is beautifully structured and profound, balancing a vibrant core of red fruit with firm yet polished tannins and a crisp acidity, leading into a long, savory, and exceptionally elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rich mushroom risotto, slow-braised veal, roasted lamb, truffle-shaved tajarin pasta, and aged hard cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano.

domaine-labbe-abyme-de-savoie.title: Domaine Labbe Abymes L'Authentique
domaine-labbe-abyme-de-savoie.bodyHtml:
Domaine Labbe Abymes L'Authentique is a wonderfully refreshing, vibrant, and mineral-driven alpine white wine that perfectly captures the unique terroir of the French Savoie region. Cultivated in vineyards scattered with glacial debris and broken limestone—known locally as "abymes" following a historic mountain avalanche from Mont Granier—this wine is crafted exclusively from the indigenous Jacquère grape. On the nose, it offers a delicate and inviting bouquet of crisp green apple, white peach, and freshly sliced pear, beautifully accented by hints of white alpine flowers, wild herbs, and bright lemon zest. The palate is light-bodied, bone-dry, and highly energetic, showcasing a razor-sharp, mouthwatering acidity and a distinct, stony minerality that leads to a clean, snappy, and exceptionally thirst-quenching finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with fresh oysters, light summer salads, delicate white fish, and classic alpine cheese dishes like fondue or raclette.

frind-estate-big-white.title: Frind Estate Winery Big White
frind-estate-big-white.bodyHtml:
Frind Estate Winery Big White is a refreshing and approachable Canadian white wine produced by Frind Estate Winery in British Columbia's beautiful Okanagan Valley. Crafted as a vibrant white wine blend, Big White showcases the fresh, fruit-forward character of the region, offering an enjoyable combination of orchard fruits, citrus, and delicate floral notes. Its bright acidity, smooth texture, and refreshing finish make it an excellent choice for casual gatherings, summer celebrations, and everyday enjoyment. Versatile and easy to pair with food, Frind Estate Winery Big White delivers a delightful expression of British Columbia's winemaking character.

Food Pairing: Grilled chicken, fresh seafood, shrimp tacos, sushi, light pasta dishes, summer salads, roasted vegetables, goat cheese, and mild Asian cuisine.

la-pelle-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Austin Hope Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
la-pelle-reserve-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Austin Hope Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a premium, full-bodied red wine from California's Paso Robles region. Crafted from carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grown across six Paso Robles districts, this Reserve release undergoes extended French oak maturation to develop exceptional depth and structure. Rich aromas of cocoa and raspberry lead into layers of ripe blueberry, olallieberry, and savoury earthiness. Plush tannins, concentrated dark fruit, and subtle spice create a luxurious palate with a long, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted lamb, smoked brisket, venison, mushroom risotto, aged cheddar, and rich barbecue dishes.

altar-uco-edad-media-tinto.title: Altar Uco Edad Media Tinto 2016 750ml
altar-uco-edad-media-tinto.bodyHtml:
This is a blend composed of Malbec (50%), Cabernet Franc (30%) and Merlot (20%), made from grapes from Gualtallary. Its 12-month ageing process in 500-liter French oak barrels provides it with structure, while its subsequent ageing in 3000-liter concrete amphoras gives calm, peacefulness and harmony. Finally, the blend sits one year in bottles.

This wine is full of life and history, the present and the past, and lets us catch a glimpse of the growth it will experience over the years thanks to its storing capacity.

altar-uco-edad-media-blanco.title: Altar Uco Edad Media Blanco 2018 750ml
altar-uco-edad-media-blanco.bodyHtml:
It is a blend composed of Chardonnay (90%) and Sauvignon Blanc (10%).

Raised in 500-liter French oak barrels, it is an elegant, inspiring and intellectual white. Today wine lives its current youth, but time will lead it to more subtle and complex expressions. It can be kept for more than 10 years.

perinet-merit-doq-priorat.title: Perinet Merit 2016 750ml
perinet-merit-doq-priorat.bodyHtml:
Perinet Merit 2016 - 750ml

The Perinet Merit 2016 is a sophisticated red blend wine hailing from Spain's Priorat region, renowned for its bold and structured wines. This vintage is crafted from a harmonious blend of varieties such as Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Syrah, offering a modern twist on traditional Spanish viticulture.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Deep ruby-red with a garnet hue.
  • Aroma: Intense notes of dark fruits like blackberries and plums, intertwined with subtle hints of vanilla, spice, and a touch of minerality.
  • Palate: Full-bodied and well-balanced, with velvety tannins and a rich texture. Flavors of ripe blackberries, cherries, and cocoa lead to a long, elegant finish with nuances of licorice and toasted oak.
  • Finish: Persistent, with a balance of freshness and complexity.

Food Pairing:
Pairs beautifully with grilled meats, aged cheeses, and hearty dishes like lamb stew or steak.

Aging Potential:
Enjoy now or cellar for up to 10 years for further development and complexity.

Alcohol Content: 14.5%

chateau-mouton-rothschild-2004.title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild Le Petit Mouton 2016
chateau-mouton-rothschild-2004.bodyHtml:
A luxurious Pauillac with aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, violet, cedar, graphite, and dark chocolate. Richly textured with velvety tannins, vibrant freshness, and remarkable concentration, it delivers exceptional depth, precision, and an elegant, persistent finish worthy of long cellaring.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, grilled ribeye, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, aged Comté, or mushroom risotto.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

This is a very powerful Petit Mouton with so much rich fruit and power. Full-bodied, tannic yet polished and long. Muscular for the second wine of Mouton.
94 Points - Decanter
Petit Mouton always shows charm in a rich, seductive expression, even in muscular vintages like 2016. It has the most wonderful sweetness to it, a highly seductive mix of the austerity of 2016 with the natural joy and exuberance of Petit Mouton, showing lovely rich damson fruit and huge persistence. It need time in the glass to open up.
93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2016 Le Petit Mouton is a blend of 62% Cabernet Sauvignon, 35% Merlot and 3% Cabernet Franc. It has a deep garnet-purple color and gives up an intensely plummy nose with cigar box and fallen leaves scents leading to aroma layers of kirsch, red and black currants and tilled soil. Medium-bodied with a racy line of freshness cutting through the muscular fruit and a good, firm frame of grainy tannins to support, it finishes on a lingering menthol note.
93 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This wine has structure and a generous fruity character from the ripeness of the Merlot in the blend. It is full in the mouth, with a smoky character on the palate and acidity coming through on the close
92 Points - Wine Spectator
The gently steeped plum and red currant fruit allows light anise, iron and cedar notes to enter slowly before taking hold on the slightly taut, savory-tinged finish. The iron element lingers longest in the end, giving this a sense of refinement. Best from 2022 through 2035.

reichsgraf-von-kesselstatt-wehlener-sonn.title: Reichsgraf Von Kesselstatt Wehlener Sonnenuhr Riesling Kabinett 2015 750ml
reichsgraf-von-kesselstatt-wehlener-sonn.bodyHtml:
The Reichsgraf Von Kesselstatt Wehlener Sonnenuhr Riesling Kabinett 2015 is a distinguished German white wine originating from the Mosel region, renowned for its world-class Rieslings. Here’s an overview of its profile:

Tasting Notes:

  • Flavor: This Riesling Kabinett offers a delightful balance of sweetness and acidity. Expect flavors of ripe peach, apricot, green apple, and citrus, complemented by subtle honeyed notes.
  • Aroma: Aromas of white flowers, lime zest, and slate minerality are prominent, reflecting the unique terroir of the Wehlener Sonnenuhr vineyard.
  • Finish: A refreshing, crisp finish with a hint of minerality and a touch of residual sweetness.

Vineyard & Terroir:

  • The Wehlener Sonnenuhr vineyard is famed for its steep, slate-rich slopes, which provide optimal conditions for producing high-quality Riesling. The slate soils contribute to the wine's mineral character and help retain heat for even grape ripening.

Vintage:

  • The 2015 vintage was exceptional for Mosel Rieslings, marked by ripe fruit, vibrant acidity, and excellent aging potential.

Pairing Suggestions:

  • Complements dishes such as spicy Asian cuisine, seafood, white meats, or mild cheeses.
  • Its light sweetness pairs beautifully with both sweet and savory flavors.

Additional Information:

  • Classification: Kabinett (indicating a light, off-dry style).
  • Alcohol: Typically around 8-9% ABV.
  • Aging Potential: Can be enjoyed now or cellared for up to 10-15 years to develop further complexity.

This wine is an excellent choice for those who appreciate nuanced, terroir-driven Rieslings with a harmonious balance of sweetness and acidity.

el-coto-reserva-50-aniversario.title: El Coto Reserva 50 Aniversario 750ml
el-coto-reserva-50-aniversario.bodyHtml: The El Coto Reserva 50 Aniversario is a special-edition Spanish red wine produced to commemorate El Coto's 50th anniversary. This Reserva wine is crafted from carefully selected Tempranillo grapes and aged to perfection in oak barrels, resulting in a rich, complex profile. The wine offers deep flavors of ripe red fruits, vanilla, and spice, with elegant tannins and a smooth finish.

tobias-estate-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Tokara Estate Premium Cabernet Sauvignon
tobias-estate-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
A polished Cabernet Sauvignon from Tokara’s Premium Collection in Stellenbosch, South Africa. Estate-grown fruit delivers perfumed violet and black-fruit aromas, with a medium-bodied palate showing cassis, subtle peppermint and spice. French oak maturation adds gentle cedar complexity while preserving freshness, structure and elegant tannins.

Food Pairing: Grilled steak, braised beef, springbok carpaccio, roast lamb and hearty meat stews complement its cassis fruit, savoury spice and structured tannins.

deerfield-ranch-sangiovese-2016.title: Deerfield Ranch Red Rex 2021
deerfield-ranch-sangiovese-2016.bodyHtml: The 2021 Deerfield Ranch Red Rex is the winery’s signature "Super Valley" red blend, designed for maximum complexity and approachability. This vintage brings together a diverse array of classic Bordeaux and Rhone varietals, resulting in a rich, multi-layered profile. It opens with vibrant aromas of black cherry, plum, and ripe berries, followed by nuances of toasted oak, vanilla, and savory spices. Crafted under the "Clean Wine" protocol with low sulfites and triple-hand sorting, it delivers a remarkably smooth and velvety texture on the palate. The 2021 release is characterized by its bright fruit core, supple tannins, and a long, seamless finish that makes it a versatile choice for a wide variety of food pairings.

natte-valleij-pow-bordeaux-blend.title: Natte Valleij P.O.W. 2021
natte-valleij-pow-bordeaux-blend.bodyHtml:
Natte Valleij P.O.W. 2021 is a characterful, elegant, and historically inspired red blend produced by winemaker Alex Milner at the historic Natte Valleij estate in South Africa. Named in honor of an Italian prisoner of war housed on the farm in 1943 who helped work the vineyards, this wine is a unique South African take on a Bordeaux-style blend with a Rhône influence. Sourced from dryland bush vines and old vineyard sites across the Coastal Region, it is naturally fermented with native yeasts and aged in neutral oak barrels and large foudres. In the glass, it presents a dark ruby hue with vibrant aromatics of spiced black cherry, dark plum, wild raspberry, cracked peppercorn, and subtle tobacco leaf. The palate is medium-bodied and silky, offering bright red and dark fruit flavors supported by a fine sour-cherry acidity and soft, well-integrated cocoa-dusted tannins leading to a savory, spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with South African braai, grilled lamb chops, roasted duck breast, braised beef short ribs, pork tenderloin, and aged hard cheeses.

dalla-valle-oakville-estate-cab-sauv.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
dalla-valle-oakville-estate-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

montalto-pennon-hill-chardonnay.title: Montalto Pennon Hill Chardonnay 2022 750ml
montalto-pennon-hill-chardonnay.bodyHtml: The Montalto Pennon Hill Chardonnay 2021 is a crisp and vibrant Australian white wine from the acclaimed Mornington Peninsula region. This Chardonnay offers a harmonious blend of citrus, stone fruit, and subtle oak, resulting in a well-balanced, refreshing wine. The 2021 vintage showcases the best of the region’s cool climate, giving the wine a bright acidity and complexity that pairs well with a wide range of dishes.

millton-te-arai-vineyard-chenin-blanc.title: Faber Vineyard Chenin Blanc
millton-te-arai-vineyard-chenin-blanc.bodyHtml:
A fresh Swan Valley Chenin Blanc with bright citrus, green apple and pear fruit accompanied by delicate floral notes. The palate is crisp and lively, showing juicy orchard fruit, refreshing acidity and a clean, dry finish with excellent drinkability.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled prawns, fresh oysters, white fish, roast chicken, summer salads, goat cheese, or lightly spiced Asian dishes.

millton-riverpoint-vineyard-viognier.title: Millton Opou Vineyard Chardonnay
millton-riverpoint-vineyard-viognier.bodyHtml:
Millton Opou Vineyard Chardonnay is an expressive Gisborne white offering orange blossom, white flowers, honey, hazelnut, oatmeal, citrus, and stone fruit. The palate is fresh and textured, with creamy complexity, cleansing acidity, subtle oak, silken tannins, and a long rounded finish.

Food Pairing: Roast chicken, grilled salmon, scallops, creamy seafood, pork, mushroom risotto, roasted vegetables, soft cheeses, and rich poultry dishes.

torres-gran-murallas-2016.title: Familia Torres Grans Muralles 2016
torres-gran-murallas-2016.bodyHtml:
Cherry red with lovely, intense depth of color. Delicious aroma of black forest fruit (blackberry) with sensual notes of dried fruit (dates) against a licorice backdrop. The palate reveals a personality-driven wine and the unmistakable character of its variety and its elegant, historical terroir. The subtle, refined tannins stand in contrast to the powerful structure of this great wine: intense, flavorful, with a distinctive identity.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This bold and sinewy red is packed with flavor. Notes of steeped black cherry and currant are teamed up with graphite, wild herb and espresso underpinnings. A vibrant acidity accentuates the tea, spice and orange peel elements, marking the long finish. Should age nicely. Garnacha, Monastrell, Querol, Samso and Garro. Drink now through 2033.

90 Points - James Suckling

A fruity and rather jammy red with cherry, berry, citrus and chocolate character. Full-bodied. Round and creamy tannins give a soft mouth feel. But jammy on the finish. This is for people who are looking for lots of fruit. A little overdone. Drink or hold.

athenaeum-rutherford-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Rutherford Hill Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
athenaeum-rutherford-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Rutherford Hill Cabernet Sauvignon is an outstanding example of the bold personality and unbridled flavour characteristics of a Napa Valley Cabernet.

Pair with steak, burgers, bison, lamb, mushroom dishes & eggplant.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of dark and purple fruits, spices, cedar, tobacco leaves and licorice. The full-bodied palate has firmly framed tannins and balanced acidity that lead to a savory, rustic finish. Plenty to like. Drink or hold.

brunello-di-montalcino-docg-reserva.title: Pinino Brunello Di Montalcino Vigna Docg

mazzei-gran-selezione-ipsus.title: Caggio Ipsus Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2016
mazzei-gran-selezione-ipsus.bodyHtml: 2016 was a later harvest, with picking interspersed with rain showers. 18 micro-vinifications took place in 25% new tonneaux and 75% stainless steel tanks, using wild yeast for the first time (the 2015 was inoculated). It was also the first year of using large barrels as the team sought to reduce overt oakiness in the wine, and so the 2016 was matured for 24 months in new tonneaux and one large 15hl barrel, followed by five months in cement before bottling. It has a darker profile with more black cherry character compared to 2015, grippier, more powerful and silky in the mouth. It has great freshness, showing plenty of balsamic influence and raspberry acidity, finishing with flourishes of wood, herbs, spice and earthiness. (James Button,decanter.com,Feb. 29, 2024)

the-mill-keeper-napa-valley-cabernet.title: Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
the-mill-keeper-napa-valley-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Freemark Abbey Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 is a classic, classic-styled Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon crafted from premium vineyard sources across the valley floor and mountain slopes. In the glass, it displays a deep garnet-purple color with intense clarity. The bouquet opens with inviting aromas of blackberry jam, dark plum, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with notes of milk chocolate, baking spices, cedar, dried tobacco, and subtle forest floor. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and supple, offering a dense core of black fruit flavor underpinned by fine-grained, firm tannins and a balanced, lively acidity that leads to a long, polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted rack of lamb, savory venison stews, and aged hard cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This bold, ripe but nicely polished wine wraps black cherries, black currants and mint in moderate, fine-grained tannins that will help carry it for several years. Subtle cinnamon, clove and cedar accents keep it interesting on the finish. Best through 2030.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, polished style, with a relatively open-knit core of boysenberry and black cherry compote backed by friendly singed vanilla and licorice notes. A crowd-pleaser. Drink now through 2031.

mark-herold-coombsville-cabernet.title: Mark Herold Coombsville Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
mark-herold-coombsville-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Mark Herold Coombsville Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 pours a glass-staining, inky black-purple color. The highly expressive and complex bouquet opens with concentrated aromas of roasted blackberries, ripe black cherries, and dusty plums, beautifully layered with distinct undertones of graphite, creamy volcanic minerals, purple violets, suede leather, and a hint of exotic black cardamom spice. On the palate, this full-bodied, opulent red wine delivers an incredibly rich, dramatic fruit-driven punch balanced by a refreshing core of acidity. Its abundant but remarkably soft, velvety tannins frame concentrated dark berry and cocoa flavors, carrying through to a long, powerful, and persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with charcoal-grilled ribeye steak, roasted rosemary lamb chops, slow-braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, or mature hard cheeses.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Alluring, with lovely açaí berry, plum and blackberry compote notes supported by a well-inlaid cast iron hint. Reveals a lovely backdrop of violet and black licorice through the finish, with the fruit keeping pace. Polished, but not overly so. Nicely done. Drink now through 2038.

filipa-pato-nossa-calcario-baga.title: Filipa Pato Nossa Calcario 2019
filipa-pato-nossa-calcario-baga.bodyHtml:
This refined Bairrada red showcases pure aromas of red cherry, raspberry, cranberry, and violet with pronounced limestone-driven minerality and subtle earthy spice. Light to medium-bodied, the palate is precise and elegant with fine tannins, vibrant acidity, and lifted red fruit, finishing long, fresh, and deeply terroir-driven.

Food Pairing: Roast poultry, duck breast, grilled pork, mushroom dishes, charcuterie, soft cheeses, and refined Mediterranean cuisine.

 

95 Points - Robert Parker Wine Advocate

The 2019 Nossa Calcário red is a Baga from old vines. It was aged for 18 months in second-use French oak and comes in at 12.7% alcohol. This is hardly a big, blockbuster-style wine with super-ripe fruit and lots of concentration. That's not really the grape or the region, and Pato tends to make a rather refined version. This sure does show you, though, what the difference is between this and something like the Post-Quercus or the D.N.M.C. reds also reviewed in this report. Here, there is more stuffing, for starters. It is not only fresh, silky, elegant and lively, but here there is also some tension on the finish. It coats the palate respectably, too, while the mid-palate nicely counters the acidity and ripe tannins. There's more tannic pop on the finish, though—a real backbone that will serve this in good stead as it ages. Baga does age well and this should, too, but it is made in a more approachable, less rustic style. If you want to drink this now you could, but that would be a bad mistake, as it is still a little disjointed. With a few years, it should become more harmonious and more interesting. There is no rush. It should hold at least for 20 years from the vintage date, probably more. It's a silky beauty.

delas-sainte-epine-saint-joseph.title: Delas Sainte-Epine Saint Joseph 2018 750ml
delas-sainte-epine-saint-joseph.bodyHtml: The wine has a deep ruby color with purple tinges. Its nose shows aromas of blackberries and spices, lifted by some mineral and gently wooded notes. Well concentrated, this has pure flavors that come to the palate in successive layers of varying aromas, all of equal intensity.

aldo-conterno-langhe-nebbiolo-il-favot.title: Aldo Conterno Il Favot Langhe Nebbiolo 2020
aldo-conterno-langhe-nebbiolo-il-favot.bodyHtml:
Il Favot is a refined expression of Nebbiolo sourced from vineyards in Bussia, Monforte d'Alba. Aromas of cherry, strawberry, rose petals, blood orange, and crushed stone lead to a structured palate with vibrant acidity, firm tannins, and impressive precision. Elegant and approachable in its youth, it offers the depth and character that define great Piedmont Nebbiolo.

Food Pairing: Braised beef, osso buco, mushroom risotto, truffle dishes, roast lamb, and aged cheeses.

 

93 Points - James Suckling

Mineral and savory nose with lots of crushed stones, iron, seaweed, spiced blood orange and cranberries. Structured and vertical on the palate but nothing fleshy here. It shows more mineral tension and tautness than fruit. A pure, long Nebbiolo Langhe that gives clarity and precision. Already very drinkable now, but can hold as well.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This harmonious red is really singing today, with a beautiful expression of cherry, strawberry and rose aromas and flavors. Firmly built, offering licorice and spice notes that add depth, with a terrific aftertaste. Drink now through 2028. 1,620 cases made, 1,000 cases imported.

chateau-de-la-tour-clos-vougeot-cuvee-cl.title: Louis Jadot Clos Vougeot Grand Cru 2018
chateau-de-la-tour-clos-vougeot-cuvee-cl.bodyHtml:
Light-bodied red with hints of candied strawberry and cherry, plus dusty tannins and hints of spice at the finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

This is chewy and meaty with lots of savory fruit and hints of new wood. Yet, it comes out structured and driven. Full-bodied with intense character and a flavorful finish. Try after 2023.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Aromas and flavors of black currant, black cherry, violet and spice are backed by a solid spine of tannins in this supple, yet muscular red. The tannins are assertive now, leaving a dusting of chalk and cocoa on the finish. Best from 2024 through 2045.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Revisited in bottle, the 2018 Clos Vougeot Grand Cru (Domaine Louis Jadot) is showing very well, unwinding in the glass with a youthfully reserved bouquet of red cherries, raspberries, sweet soil tones and warm spices. Full-bodied, muscular and tightly wound, with lively acids and prodigious reserves of fine, chalky tannins, this is a serious, structured Clos Vougeot unapologetically built for the long haul. For the patient, everything suggests there's considerable upside, but this is not a wine to "pop and pour" any time in the next decade.

chateau-de-la-tour-clos-vougeot-hommage.title: Louis Jadot Clos Vougeot Grand Cru 2018
chateau-de-la-tour-clos-vougeot-hommage.bodyHtml:
Light-bodied red with hints of candied strawberry and cherry, plus dusty tannins and hints of spice at the finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

This is chewy and meaty with lots of savory fruit and hints of new wood. Yet, it comes out structured and driven. Full-bodied with intense character and a flavorful finish. Try after 2023.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Aromas and flavors of black currant, black cherry, violet and spice are backed by a solid spine of tannins in this supple, yet muscular red. The tannins are assertive now, leaving a dusting of chalk and cocoa on the finish. Best from 2024 through 2045.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Revisited in bottle, the 2018 Clos Vougeot Grand Cru (Domaine Louis Jadot) is showing very well, unwinding in the glass with a youthfully reserved bouquet of red cherries, raspberries, sweet soil tones and warm spices. Full-bodied, muscular and tightly wound, with lively acids and prodigious reserves of fine, chalky tannins, this is a serious, structured Clos Vougeot unapologetically built for the long haul. For the patient, everything suggests there's considerable upside, but this is not a wine to "pop and pour" any time in the next decade.

istrian-malvasia-coronica.title: Coronica Malvazija 2022
istrian-malvasia-coronica.bodyHtml:
Coronica Malvazija 2022 is a fresh, crisp, and mineral-driven white wine produced by Moreno Coronica in the Istria region of Croatia. Crafted from 100% Malvazija Istarska grapes harvested from distinctive red clay soils (Terra Rossa), it is vinified and matured in stainless steel tanks to preserve its natural purity and varietal character. In the glass, it presents a bright straw-yellow color with subtle greenish highlights. The bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of white peach, green apple, citrus peel, and acacia flowers, complemented by subtle stone minerality. On the palate, it is light- to medium-bodied, vibrant, and well-balanced, featuring crisp orchard fruit flavors, lively acidity, and a clean, saline finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, grilled octopus, sea bass, seafood risotto, goat cheese salads, and light Mediterranean pasta.

gran-teran-coronica.title: Coronica Gran Teran 2018
gran-teran-coronica.bodyHtml:
Coronica Gran Teran 2018 is a deeply expressive, robust, and structured Croatian red wine crafted from old-vine Teran grown in the iron-rich red clay soils (Crljenica) of Istria. The wine exhibits an intense ruby-purple hue. On the nose, it offers rich aromas of dark cherries, crushed blackberries, and wild blueberries, seamlessly integrated with notes of game, leather, forest floor, and a distinct iron-like minerality. On the palate, it is full-bodied and powerful, featuring vibrant, high-strung acidity balanced by firm, chewy tannins and a long, savory, and mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted wild boar, grilled venison, traditional Istrian fuži pasta with truffles, slow-cooked beef stew, and aged hard cheeses.

gran-malvasia-coronica.title: Coronica Gran Malvazija 2017
gran-malvasia-coronica.bodyHtml:
Coronica Gran Malvazija 2017 is a refined, structured, and complex Croatian white wine crafted from aged Malvazija Istarska vines grown in the red clay soils (Crljenica) of northwestern Istria. Fermented and aged in large wooden vats, it exhibits a straw-yellow hue with golden highlights. The expressive bouquet opens with rich notes of yellow apple, dried apricot, and acacia flower, layered with accents of toasted almond, honey, and a distinct salty minerality. On the palate, it is full-bodied and textured, offering a rich, mouth-coating fruit core balanced by crisp acidity and a long, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled sea bass, roasted poultry, white truffle pasta, pork tenderloin in cream sauce, and aged semi-hard cheeses.

krolo-crljenak-kastelanski.title: Krolo Crljenak Kastelanski 2018 750ml
krolo-crljenak-kastelanski.bodyHtml: The Krolo Crljenak Kastelanski 2016 is a premium red wine from Croatia, showcasing the unique indigenous grape variety Crljenak Kastelanski, which is considered a relative of the Zinfandel. This wine offers rich flavors of dark fruit, blackberries, and plums, complemented by hints of spice, earthiness, and a touch of tobacco. With well-integrated tannins and a balanced acidity, it is an excellent example of Croatian winemaking tradition.

dingac-kiridzija.title: Kiridzija Dingac 2020
dingac-kiridzija.bodyHtml: A powerful and robust red wine from the steep, sun-drenched slopes of the Dingač appellation. The 2020 vintage offers a concentrated nose of dried figs, black cherries, and plums, complemented by Mediterranean herbs, sage, and a characteristic touch of sea salt minerality. On the palate, it is full-bodied and deeply textured with firm tannins and a rich warmth, featuring flavours of dark berries, carob, and earthy undertones that lead to a long, persistent, and slightly savoury finish.

grand-select-zlatan-otok.title: Zlatan Plavac Otok Grand Select 2018
