rosso-veronese-igt-rosso-dei-falezza.title: Tenute Falezza Rosso Dei Falezza 2014 750ml
rosso-veronese-igt-rosso-dei-falezza.bodyHtml: The Falezza family is making classic Veronese wines, and this rosso is no exception. A blend of corvina Veronese, corvinone, rondinella, molinara and oseleta presents a round, juicy, warm, soft manner. Expect a nose of dry, earthy fragrant cherries and more of the same on the palate where the plummy/cherry fruit flecked with spice finishes medium-long with soft tannins, leather and licorice notes. Ready to drink and a perfect spaghetti red for Wednesday night.

masi-costasera-amarone-classico-2006.title: Masi Costasera Amarone Classico 2018 5L Jeroboam
masi-costasera-amarone-classico-2006.bodyHtml:
Very dark ruby red. On the nose baked fruit, plums and cherries. Fruity tastes, with hints of coffee and cocoa. Very well balanced.

Excellent as an after-dinner wine, or to go with red meat, game, quails

and richly-flavoured dishes. Very good with well-aged cheeses, such as parmesan, pecorino and gorgonzola. 

93 Points - James Suckling
The flagship: 70% corvina, 25% rondinella and a smidgeon of the oft-forgotten molinara for welcome freshness. Only south-west facing hillside fruit is used for the Amarones here, promoting a longer and slower appassimento process. Often the grapes are still on the vine come November, with extended appassiono on traditional bamboo racks. The formidable level of dry extract is consumed across a spread of bitter cherry, amaro bitters and dried herbs, strewn across the long, impressive finish. I like this. A wine for drinking rather than for the mantle. A very good opening act. Drink now.

domaine-de-lenclos-chablis-1er-montmain.title: Bersan Chablis Aoc 1Er Cru Montmains
domaine-de-lenclos-chablis-1er-montmain.bodyHtml: Domaine Bersan Chablis Premier Cru Montmains comes from the family estate of Jean-Louis and Jean-Christophe Bersan in Saint-Bris-le-Vineux, whose 22 hectares are farmed to certified organic standards. The Chardonnay grows on Kimmeridgian clay-limestone and is Guyot-pruned. Grapes are hand-picked, sorted and pressed straight away, and fermentation starts spontaneously with native yeasts; the wine then spends 8 months in barrel and 4 months in stainless steel before bottling. The domaine describes an elegant, mineral Montmains with hazelnut and white flowers on the nose and a brioche-like, ample palate with a long, tangy finish. Serve at 11 to 13°C with fish, poultry or seafood; it can be kept for 7 to 8 years. 12.5% ABV, 750 ml.

domaine-de-lenclos-chablis-1er-fourchau.title: Domaine Vrignaud Chablis Premier Cru Fourchaume
domaine-de-lenclos-chablis-1er-fourchau.bodyHtml:
Domaine Vrignaud Chablis Premier Cru Fourchaume is a mineral-driven Chardonnay with aromas of lemon zest, white flowers, ripe citrus, orchard fruit, and distinctive flinty notes. Crisp acidity, layered complexity, and pronounced Kimmeridgian minerality create a focused, elegant palate with exceptional length and aging potential. 
 
Food Pairing: Pair with lobster, oysters, grilled fish, shellfish, goat cheese, or enjoy as a refined aperitif.

checkmate-fools-mate-chardonnay-2015.title: Checkmate Fool's Mate Chardonnay 2015
checkmate-fools-mate-chardonnay-2015.bodyHtml:
Checkmate Fool's Mate Chardonnay 2015 is an exceptionally rich, complex, and full-bodied Canadian white wine sourced from five distinct estate vineyard sites across the southern Okanagan Valley. Crafted with wild yeast fermentation and aged in French oak barriques and concrete eggs, it opens with enticing aromas of bright citrus fruit, buttered croissant, lanolin, and wet stone minerality. The palate exhibits a lush, layered texture balanced by crisp acidity, delivering flavors of white peach, ripe nectarine, baking spices, and a hint of saline on a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared halibut with lemon butter, roasted chicken, Dungeness crab, creamy mushroom risotto, or lobster bisque.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A bit of a chameleon, this white starts out soft and finishes with some zip and grip. Peach, apple pie, butterscotch and oak spice flavors mesh nicely, supported by the bright acidity. Fruit, spice and butterscotch elements converge on the lingering finish. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A multi-vineyard blend, this uses both barrel and concrete egg ferments. It's textured and complex, with lightly buttery apple fruit, a whiff of toast and salty minerality. It was aged for 16 months, and roughly half of the barrels used were new.

butterfield-nuits-saint-georges.title: Domaine Henri Gouges Nuits Saint Georges 2016 750ml
butterfield-nuits-saint-georges.bodyHtml:
Inhabiting the bottom end of the northern half of the Côte d’Or, Nuits-St-Georges is a busy, market-driven town and home to many of Burgundy’s negociants. It is also the largest town in the Côte d’Or after Beaune and contributes "nuits" to the name of Côte de Nuits (i.e., the northern half of the Côte d’Or).

The appellation itself is divided into two parts, where in the north it directly borders Vosne-Romanée, the southerly end is the commune of Prémeaux. There are no Grands Crus in this village, though it does have a large number of Premiers Crus.

The best Nuits-St-Georges Pinot Noir are layered with cherry, plum, underbrush and sandalwood. The fruit is sweet, the wine energetic, and the finish long and lush.

veronica-ortega-roc.title: Veronica Ortega 'ROC' 2022
veronica-ortega-roc.bodyHtml:
Verónica Ortega 'ROC' 2022 is an artisanal, highly expressive single-vineyard red wine crafted by winemaker Verónica Ortega in Valtuille de Abajo, within the Bierzo region of Spain. Sourced from 80- to 100-year-old vines planted on mineral-rich sandy, clay-slate soils, it is made predominantly from Mencía co-fermented with a small percentage of native local white varieties. Hand-harvested and wild-yeast fermented with a significant portion of whole clusters, the wine is aged for over a year in neutral oak barrels. In the glass, it features a deep ruby-garnet core. The aromatic nose displays intense scents of black cherry, wild raspberry, dried rose petals, licorice, and a cool, slate-like mineral backbone. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, refined, and focused, presenting dark berry flavors balanced by vibrant natural acidity, fine-grained firm tannins, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, grilled pork chops, duck breast, mole negro, venison ragù, wild mushroom tart, and aged cheeses.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The serious and slightly more reticent 2022 ROC was very recently bottled and needed a little more time in the glass to open up. This is the first wine she ever produced in Bierzo in 2010, and it has kept the elegant profile through the years. In the very warm 2022 vintage, she picked the grapes on September 2 and, thus, managed to keep contained ripeness and alcohol (13.3%). It fermenting with full clusters in large oak vats and aged in 228-liter oak barrels for 16 months. It's textured and juicy, with very fine tannins, a rounder mouthfeel and great purity of flavors. 4,972 bottles were filled in March 2024.

chateau-grand-corbin-manuel-2018.title: Famille De Gaye Chateau Grand Corbin Manuel 2018 750ml
chateau-grand-corbin-manuel-2018.bodyHtml: The blend of mainly Merlot with Cabernet Franc is impressively rich and ripe. Acidity and fine black fruits come through strongly as the wine ages.

orofino-clone-239-rielsing.title: Orofino Hendsbee Vineyard Riesling Clone 239 2018 750ml
orofino-clone-239-rielsing.bodyHtml:
Orofino Hendsbee Vineyard Riesling Clone 239 2018 750ml

Hendsbee Vineyard on the Cawston Bench is planted to two different clones, and Orofino has chosen to bottle them separately. Bone dry and just under 13 percent, 239 is a stony, mineral, crunchy riesling that is almost Saar-like with the added electricity of the Similkameen Valley. The name refers to the clone 239; the vines are now a dozen years old. The driest of all the Orofino rieslings, it is a delight to sip. Lime, nectarine skin, green apples, and crunchy pear all hit the palate with precision. It will age forever, but if you open one bottle, you might open them all. Real wine.

dogwood-thistle-oppenlander-pinot-noir.title: Dogwood & Thistle Carignan
dogwood-thistle-oppenlander-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Dogwood & Thistle Carignan is an expressive, artisanal red wine crafted from historic vines in Northern California. It exhibits energetic aromatics of bright red raspberry, Bing cherry, tart red plum, and wild strawberry, accented by subtle floral notes of rose petal, dried herbs, wet stone, and light toasted spice. On the palate, it delivers a fresh, medium-bodied profile with vibrant acidity, sleek fruit, fine-grained tannins, and a crisp, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, grilled pork chops, duck breast, mushroom risotto, charcuterie, and aged sheep’s milk cheeses like Manchego.

pierres-seches-saint-joseph-lussas.title: Domaine Des Pierres Seches Saint-Joseph Rouge 2019 750ml
pierres-seches-saint-joseph-lussas.bodyHtml:
The Domaine des Pierres Seches Saint-Joseph Rouge 2019 is a full-bodied, 750 ml red wine from the Northern Rhône Valley of France: 
Winemaker: Sylvain Gauthier, a rising star in Saint-Joseph 
Grapes: Syrah/Shiraz 
Region: Saint-Joseph, an appellation d'origine controlee (AOC) in the Northern Rhône Valley 
Tasting notes: Fresh, vibrant, with notes of red and black cherries, cracked black pepper, cloves, and herbal garrigue smokiness 
Food pairing: Pairs well with lamb 
Best served: Shows brilliantly in its youth

pierres-seches-saint-joseph-aubert.title: Domaine Des Pierres Seches Saint-Joseph Rouge 2018 750ml
pierres-seches-saint-joseph-aubert.bodyHtml: The 2018 Domaine Des Pierres Sèches Saint-Joseph Rouge is described as a wine with vibrant flavors and energetic spice, showcasing black fruit, peppery spice, and licorice aromas. It's considered a full-bodied and textured wine with fine-grained tannins. This particular Saint-Joseph, specifically the "Revirand" cuvée, is known for being crafted from a high-altitude, pure granite plot, resulting in a wine of power and harmony. It's also mentioned as being a great wine for cellar aging.

pierres-seches-saint-joseph-revirand.title: Pierres Seches Saint Joseph Gauthier Revirand 2019 750ml
pierres-seches-saint-joseph-revirand.bodyHtml:
Jeb Dunnuck, 96 Points 

"The 2019 Saint Joseph Cuvée Revirand is all Syrah that was not destemmed and saw malolactic fermentation in barrel followed by 18 months in French oak. Just a thrilling Saint Joseph that pretty much stopped me in my tracks, it has ample red and black fruits, notes of leather, woodsmoke, iron, and pepper, full-bodied richness, beautiful tannins, and a great finish. I followed this bottle for multiple days, and it showed more structure and depth with air. It can certainly be drunk today, but it will ideally be given 2-3 years in the cellar, and I’d be shocked if it didn’t evolve gracefully for another decade or more." 

Wine Advocate, 92 Points 

"The 2019 Saint Joseph Cuvée Revirand—from 50-year-old vines on a south-facing granite slope—features attractive, complex aromas of menthol, star anise and blackberries, plus a wiry, herbal streak. Made entirely using whole clusters and aged in pièces de Bourgogne, it's full-bodied and dense, with ample concentration, ripe tannins and a long, dusty finish. Give it a couple of years in the cellar and drink it through the end of the decade."

pierres-seches-saint-joseph-cuvee-1930.title: Domaine Des Pierres Seches Saint Joseph Cuvee 1930 2019
pierres-seches-saint-joseph-cuvee-1930.bodyHtml:
Domaine des Pierres Sèches Saint-Joseph Cuvée 1930 2019 is an exceptional single-parcel Syrah from France's Northern Rhône Valley, crafted by winemaker Sylvain Gauthier. Sourced from vines planted in 1930 on the historic Côte Sainte-Épine hillside, this concentrated Saint-Joseph showcases the depth and character of old-vine fruit grown on granite soils. Rich black cherry, spiced plum, cracked pepper, and savoury notes of leather and iron are complemented by polished tannins and impressive structure. A refined, age-worthy expression of classic Northern Rhône Syrah.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled ribeye, venison, duck breast, braised beef, wild mushroom risotto, herb-roasted pork, and aged cheeses.

chateau-montus-madiran-2016.title: Brumont Chateau Montus Madiran 2016
chateau-montus-madiran-2016.bodyHtml:
Château Montus Madiran 2016 is a classic, deeply concentrated red wine crafted by Alain Brumont, the pioneer who put Madiran on the map. Sourced from steep slopes covered in rounded pebbles over brown and orange clay, this robust blend is dominated by Tannat. The complex nose reveals expressive aromas of wild blackberries, ripe black cherries, and sweet spices, layered with subtle undertones of licorice, menthol, and woody vanilla. On the palate, the wine is powerful and fleshy, showing a concentrated core of dark fruits, cacao, and fine-grained, powdery tannins that offer remarkable structure and lead to a long, beautifully balanced, and fresh finish.

Food Pairing: This powerful, structured red pairs exceptionally well with rich, slow-cooked duck confit with porcini mushrooms, traditional French cassoulet, or a hearty roasted venison shank.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The spectacular hillside vineyard of Montus, overlooking the Adour Valley, is producing some of the finest Madiran. This 80% Tannat wine reveals the quality and intensity of the grape. It is still full of tannins, but the fruit really shines. Give this wine time and drink from 2023.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Chateau Montus exhales a fresh, dense bouquet of dark wild berries, menthol, spices and flowers. Medium to full-bodied, it is somewhat less structured than Bouscassé Vieilles Vignes, presenting a round and enveloping texture with a delicate, fleshy core of fruit, bright acids and powdery tannins. Comprising 80% Tannat and 20% Cabernet Sauvignon, it concludes with a long, tense finish and an ethereal aftertaste.

cabriz-touriga-nacional-dao-doc.title: Quinta de Cabriz 'Cabriz' Touriga Nacional Tinto 2019 750ml
cabriz-touriga-nacional-dao-doc.bodyHtml:
Quinta de Cabriz 'Cabriz' Touriga Nacional Tinto 2022 is an expressive Portuguese red wine from the Dão region, crafted exclusively from Touriga Nacional. Displaying a deep garnet colour with violet highlights, it offers inviting aromas of ripe cherries, blackberries, and delicate florals. Partial maturation in French oak contributes subtle complexity, while soft tannins and balanced acidity create a smooth, well-structured palate with a pleasantly persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled lamb, roasted pork, braised beef, chicken, mushroom pizza, game meats, and semi-aged cheeses.

 

90 Points - James Suckling

Fragrant aromas of vanilla beans, purple plums and black cherries follow through to a medium-bodied, creamy and subtly spicy palate, framed by powdery tannins. Drink now.

88 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is an attractively textured wine with dominant Touriga Nacional bringing tannins and ripe black fruits. Its dark chocolate aroma and juicy acidity give the wine a fine future. Drink from 2026.

casa-santar-vinha-dos-amores-encruzado.title: Casa De Santar Vinha Dos Amores Encruzado Dao Branco 2017 750ml
casa-santar-vinha-dos-amores-encruzado.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2017 vintage) "Wood aging for a year has not dimmed the rich creamy Encruzado fruit in this wine. Fine acidity goes with the toastiness, and with plenty of citrus and red apple flavors. This is a balanced wine, ready to drink now. Roger Voss" - 90/100, Wine Enthusiast

santar-vinha-dos-amores-touriga-nacional.title: Casa De Santar Vinha Dos Amores Touriga Nacional 2017 750ml
santar-vinha-dos-amores-touriga-nacional.bodyHtml:
Intense garnet color with notorious violaceous tones. Aroma intense and complex, are well-known the fruits of the forest, very mature red fruits and jelly of the same. It also has floral notes and notes of spices. In the mouth it is fruity, soft, well-structured and with noticeable final persistence.

Ideal for mature cheeses other meat and fish courses.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is a well-matured wine, made with Touriga Nacional, the black grape with white pulp. It is soft with a lemon aroma and ripe citrus flavors to go with the toastiness.

cabriz-edicao-espicial-red-dao-doc.title: Cabriz Edicao Especial Tinto 2015 750ml
cabriz-edicao-espicial-red-dao-doc.bodyHtml: Produced with a blend of grapes, 60 % Touriga National, 20% Alfroncheiro and 20% Aragonez. The bouquet shows aromas of ripe red and black berried fruit with light spice and toasty notes. Rich concentrated fruit with chalky tannins, full-bodied; pair with game, beef or pork dishes. Score - 92 ROGER VOSS, WE August 1, 2020

piro-presquile-vineyard-pinot-noir.title: Piro Presqu'ile Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020 750ml
piro-presquile-vineyard-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Piro Presqu'ile Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020

armand-heitz-meursault-villages-gruyache.title: Armand Heitz Meursault Premier Cru Les Perrieres 2021
armand-heitz-meursault-villages-gruyache.bodyHtml:
Armand Heitz Meursault Premier Cru Les Perrières is a benchmark Chardonnay from one of Meursault's finest Premier Cru vineyards. Aromas of ripe citrus, pear, white flowers, toasted hazelnut, and flint lead to a concentrated palate with vibrant acidity, pronounced minerality, exceptional depth, and a remarkably long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with butter-poached lobster, seared scallops, roast chicken, turbot, creamy mushroom risotto, or aged Comté and Gruyère cheeses.

gogi-wines-pinot-noir-29.title: GoGi Errin Pinot Noir 2017 750ml
gogi-wines-pinot-noir-29.bodyHtml:
Partnership between Kurt Russell and Ampelos Cellars

Critic tasting note:  "Quite light and transparent in the glass, this bottling by actor Kurt Russell starts with aromas of Montmorency cherries, dewy herbs and pine-forest floor on the nose. It's a fresh, snappy and lean style of Pinot Noir, with flavors of tart red plum, raspberry and orange rind that benefit from a hefty dusting of wild herbs. Matt Kettmann"

hearst-ranch-bunkhouse-cabernet-sauv.title: Hearst Ranch Bunkhouse Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 750ml
hearst-ranch-bunkhouse-cabernet-sauv.bodyHtml: The 2022 Hearst Ranch Bunkhouse Cabernet Sauvignon (750ml) is a Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon known for its rich, dark fruit flavors, including black cherry, blackberry, and cassis. It also exhibits notes of toasted oak, vanilla, and spice. The wine is full-bodied with firm tannins, offering a long and smooth finish.

pere-ventura-vintage-brut-gran-reserva.title: Pere Ventura Cava Paraje Calificado Can Bas Gran Reserva Brut Gran Vintage 2015 750ml
pere-ventura-vintage-brut-gran-reserva.bodyHtml:
Pere Ventura's family heritage with Cava dates back to 1872, when his great grandfather, Manuel Montserrat Font, helped produced the first bottles of Cava at Codorniu. The family-based PERE VENTURA FAMILY WINE ESTATES produces and markets its own wines and cavas (sparkling wines), which are known worldwide for their great quality and prestige.

All Pere Ventura Cavas undergo the “Traditional Method” of sparkling wine production, the same method used for Champagne. Grapes are hand harvested and de-stemmed before they undergo a first fermentation in stainless steel tanks at a temperature of 61°F to 64°F. The juice is then clarified and stabilized before undergoing secondary fermentation which takes place in the bottle.

The wine is riddled, disgorged and the dosage is added before the bottle is sealed. The minimum aging is 14 months.

Tasting Notes:

It has a rich, generous yet delicate bouquet and very good acidity. It is creamy and full, with notes of fresh fruit, lemon cream, tinned pears, raw yolks, maple syrup, and pastries. This cava has an intense taste and velvety mouthfeel.

p-v-gran-vin-cava-de-paraje-calificado.title: Pere Ventura Cava Paraje Calificado Can Bas Gran Reserva Brut Gran Vintage 2015 750ml
p-v-gran-vin-cava-de-paraje-calificado.bodyHtml:
Pere Ventura's family heritage with Cava dates back to 1872, when his great grandfather, Manuel Montserrat Font, helped produced the first bottles of Cava at Codorniu. The family-based PERE VENTURA FAMILY WINE ESTATES produces and markets its own wines and cavas (sparkling wines), which are known worldwide for their great quality and prestige.

All Pere Ventura Cavas undergo the “Traditional Method” of sparkling wine production, the same method used for Champagne. The wine is riddled, disgorged and the dosage is added before the bottle is sealed. The minimum aging is 14 months.

Tasting Notes:

It has a rich, generous yet delicate bouquet and very good acidity. It is creamy and full, with notes of fresh fruit, lemon cream, tinned pears, raw yolks, maple syrup, and pastries. This cava has an intense taste and velvety mouthfeel.

vino-di-anna-qveri-rosso.title: Vino di Anna Jeudi 15 Rosso 2020
vino-di-anna-qveri-rosso.bodyHtml:
A vibrant and expressive natural red wine from the northern slopes of Mount Etna. Aromas of red cherries, wild raspberries, and delicate white flowers lead into a juicy, medium-bodied palate layered with bright red fruit, subtle spice, fine tannins, and a distinctive mineral finish shaped by Etna's volcanic soils. Crafted from organically farmed old-vine fruit and bottled without fining or filtration.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled lamb, charcuterie, roasted poultry, mushroom dishes, pizza, and tomato-based pasta.

barge-cote-rotie-les-cotes.title: Gilles Barge Les Cotes Cote-Rotie 2020 750ml
barge-cote-rotie-les-cotes.bodyHtml:
A step up, the 2019 Côte Rôtie Les Cotes has plenty of black fruits, black olive, smoke, and crushed stone in its medium to full-bodied, nicely concentrated profile.

90
Jeb Dunnuck, JebDunnuck.com, February 2022

quercia-al-poggio-chianti-classico-riser.title: Quercia Al Poggio Vigna Le Cataste Gran Selezione Chianti Classico 2016 750ml
quercia-al-poggio-chianti-classico-riser.bodyHtml: Quercia al Poggio Chianti Classico is produced in limited quantities from grapes grown to certified organic farming protocols. The estate releases a single Chianti Classico from a selection of the cellar’s nest Sangiovese and other traditional native grapes. A small proportion of wine from Sangiovese only is bottled as Chianti Classico Riserva, which receives longer maturation in oak and aging in glass. The Gran Selezione is our Cru that comes from the Sangiovese selection of the oldest vineyard.

quercia-al-poggio-cc-gran-selezione.title: Quercia Al Poggio Vigna Le Cataste Gran Selezione Chianti Classico 2016 750ml
quercia-al-poggio-cc-gran-selezione.bodyHtml: Quercia al Poggio Chianti Classico is produced in limited quantities from grapes grown to certified organic farming protocols. The estate releases a single Chianti Classico from a selection of the cellar’s nest Sangiovese and other traditional native grapes. A small proportion of wine from Sangiovese only is bottled as Chianti Classico Riserva, which receives longer maturation in oak and aging in glass. The Gran Selezione is our Cru that comes from the Sangiovese selection of the oldest vineyard.

saint-clair-marlborough-origin-sb.title: Saint Clair Family Estate Origin Sauvignon Blanc 2020 750ml
saint-clair-marlborough-origin-sb.bodyHtml:
Marlborough Wine
New Zealand
An icon and leading region of New Zealand's distinctive style of Sauvignon blanc, Marlborough has a unique terroir, making it ideal for high quality grape production (of many varieties). Despite some common generalizations, which could be fairly justified given that Marlborough is responsible for 90% of New Zealand's Sauvignon blanc production, the wines from this region are actually anything but homogenous. At the northern tip of New Zealand’s South Island, the vineyards of Marlborough benefit from well-draining, stony soils, a dry, sunny climate and wide temperature fluctuations between day and night, a phenomenon that supports a perfect balance between berry ripeness and acidity.

The region’s king variety, Sauvignon blanc, is beloved for its pungent, aromatic character with notes of exotic tropical fruit, freshly cut grass and green bell pepper along with a refreshing streak of stony minerality. These wines are made in a wide range of styles, and winemakers take advantage of various clones, vineyard sites, fermentation styles, lees-stirring and aging regimens to differentiate their bottlings, one from one another.

Also produced successfully here are fruit-forward Pinot noirs (especially where soils are clay-rich), elegant Riesling, Pinot gris and Gewürztraminer.
Sauvignon Blanc
Capable of a vast array of styles, Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp, refreshing variety that equally reflects both terroir and varietal character. Though it can vary depending on where it is grown, a couple of commonalities always exist—namely, zesty acidity and intense aromatics. This variety is of French provenance. Somm Secret—Along with Cabernet Franc, Sauvignon Blanc is a proud parent of Cabernet Sauvignon. That green bell pepper aroma that all three varieties share is no coincidence—it comes from a high concentration of pyrazines (herbaceous aromatic compounds) inherent to each member of the family.

hermandad-winemaker-series-pinot-noir.title: Familia Falasco Hermandad Winemaker Series Pinot Noir 2019 750ml
hermandad-winemaker-series-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The Hermandad Winemaker Series Pinot Noir offers aromas of cherries and strawberries. It is ripe on the palate, with subtle spicy notes. Sweet entry, good acidity that provides freshness, rough-textured tannins, accompanied by a persistent finish.

90 Points James Suckling
Woody spices, orange peel, dried strawberries and some herbs. A chewy pinot with quite a lot of spice and some grainy tannins on the palate. Would love to see more fruit concentration holding up this structure.

hermandad-fausto-old-vines-malbec.title: Hermandad Fausto Old Vines Malbec
hermandad-fausto-old-vines-malbec.bodyHtml:
Hermandad Fausto Old Vines Malbec is a premium Argentine red wine crafted from old-vine Malbec in Vista Flores, Uco Valley, Mendoza. This elegant expression delivers aromas of blackberry, blueberry, cherry, violet, rosemary, and spice, with a rich palate of concentrated fruit, silky tannins, balanced acidity, subtle oak, and a long finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled steak, roasted lamb, beef empanadas, barbecue ribs, aged cheeses, charcuterie, mushroom dishes, and hearty pasta.

marques-de-riscal-rioja-reserva-gift-tin.title: Marques de Riscal Reserva 2021
marques-de-riscal-rioja-reserva-gift-tin.bodyHtml:
Marques de Riscal Reserva 2021 is a classic and highly consistent expression of the Rioja Alavesa sub-region. Produced from vines over 15 years old, this Reserva is aged for approximately two years in American oak barrels, followed by a minimum of one year in the bottle before release. The 2021 vintage is noted for its balance and aromatic precision, featuring a complex bouquet of ripe red berries and blackcurrants layered with the estate's signature notes of liquorice, balsamic, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied and elegant, showcasing a refreshing acidity, supple tannins, and a long, spicy finish with hints of toasted oak and vanilla.

92 Points - James Suckling

A combination of licorice, blackberries and cherries on the nose, a floral element emerging as the wine evolves. The medium- to full-bodied palate is incisive with polished, focused tannins and a clean, chiseled finish. Uncomplicated. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Poised, classic, and linear, this Reserva Tempranillo delivers detail and length in a approachable wine. Spiced blackberry and dark cherry pick up baking spices and a drop of molasses. Tannins melt across the palate maintaining friendly poise for a highly drinkable Rioja.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe mulberry and boysenberry fruit is accented by wild thyme, warm spices, mineral and mandarin orange peel in this well-balanced red, with light, taut tannins. Tempranillo and Graciano. Drink now through 2031.

valdemar-walla-walla-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Valdemar Estates Component Trial Stone Valley Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
valdemar-walla-walla-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Valdemar Estates Component Trial Stone Valley Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 is a single-vineyard red from the Walla Walla Valley in Washington State. Valdemar's Component Trial series bottles small lots from individual sites, and this one is Cabernet Sauvignon from Stone Valley Vineyard, produced and bottled by Valdemar Estates in Walla Walla. The vineyard's basalt and cobblestone soils give the wine natural concentration, sleek tannins and an old-world character, with a sweet and savoury edge. 750ml, 14.3% ABV.

valdemar-klipsun-vineyard-cabernet.title: Valdemar Estates Klipsun Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
valdemar-klipsun-vineyard-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Nose: Intense aromas of blackberry, cassis, and dark chocolate.
Taste: Rich flavors of ripe black fruits, plum, and hints of vanilla.
Palate: Full-bodied with velvety tannins, balanced acidity, and a long, lingering finish.

valdemar-estates-columbia-val-chardonnay.title: Valdemar Estates Chardonnay 2019 750ml
valdemar-estates-columbia-val-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The grapes from this wine come from well-established vines in Gamache Vineyard and French Creek Vineyard.

WINEMAKING NOTES: Harvested September 25 at 22.8 brix; fermented for 59 days; and aged 8 months in 25% new and 75% 2-year-old, French oak.

lucien-muzard-santenay-champs-claude.title: Lucien Muzard & Fils Santenay Champs Claude 2023
lucien-muzard-santenay-champs-claude.bodyHtml:
Lifted and aromatic on the nose with delicate scents of red cherry, pomegranate, rose petals, sassafras, and wet crushed rock, followed by hints of forest floor and subtle liquorice. The palate is vibrant and youthful, showing pure red berry fruit, energetic acidity, and fine, lightly structured tannins leading to a clean, refreshing, and mineral-accented finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast duck breast, pan-seared pork medallions, grilled salmon, roasted mushroom risotto, or mild washed-rind cheeses.

lucien-muzard-santenay-vielles-vignes.title: Lucien Muzard & Fils Vieilles Vignes Santenay 2021 750ml
lucien-muzard-santenay-vielles-vignes.bodyHtml:
Robert Parker: 89

Generous and expressive, the 2018 Santenay Vieilles Vignes evokes notions of ripe cherries, strawberries and plums. Medium to full-bodied, velvety and enveloping, it's one of the supplest, most charming reds in the Muzard range this year and it will drink well young.

lucien-muzard-santenay-1er-cru-maladiere.title: Domaine Lucien Muzard La Maladiere 2020 750ml
lucien-muzard-santenay-1er-cru-maladiere.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Domaine Lucien Muzard La Maladiere is a red wine from the Santenay 1er Cru region of Burgundy, France. It's made from Pinot Noir grapes and has the following characteristics: 
Flavor: A classic Santenay pinot with notes of red fruit, such as raspberry and cherry, as well as earthy, mushroom, and oaky notes 
Body: Medium bodied with gentle tannins and a smooth finish 
Nose: A complex and intense nose 
Food pairing: A wonderful food wine that should be enjoyed in good company and in large glasses 
The vineyard that produces the Domaine Lucien Muzard La Maladiere uses sustainable farming practices, including no herbicides, pesticides, or chemical fertilizers. The reds are bottled unfined and with only a coarse filtration.

lucien-muzard-santenay-1er-cru-graviere.title: Muzard Santenay Gravieres Premier Cru 2023
lucien-muzard-santenay-1er-cru-graviere.bodyHtml:
Gravieres presents a deep, lightly pigmented ruby colour in the glass. The nose is seductively aromatic, revealing intense notes of strawberries and crushed raspberries complemented by subtle floral hints of rose and a delicate buttery touch. On the palate, the wine is magnificently smooth and unctuous, featuring a full, velvety mid-palate where the tannins are finely coated by ripe fruit. This 100% Pinot Noir displays a refined complexity and a savory, classic style with a persistent, graceful finish.

This wine's rich texture and nuanced fruit profile make it an ideal companion for roasted poultry such as duck or turkey. It also pairs exceptionally well with savory game birds and slow-cooked casseroles that mirror its smooth, structured character.

delas-linge-de-crete-les-grandes-vignes.title: Delas Ligne de Crete Les Grandes Vignes Hermitage 2019 750ml
delas-linge-de-crete-les-grandes-vignes.bodyHtml:
The nose discloses aromas of spice and leather intertwined with deep berry aromas (blackberry, redcurrant) and heady floral notes, liquorice and incense. Its richness, complexity and elegance are by no means a contradiction. The finest granite soils of the Hermitage hillside are to thank for this wine's incredible minerality and finesse. The wine is rich and dense on entry to the palate, where it shows an elegant, broad and flavorsome character. The ripe, smooth and well-integrated tannins contribute to the wine's powerful yet harmonious structure. The palate reveals the same aromas as those found on the nose with nuances of blueberry, raspberry, violet and bitter chocolate. Ligne de Crête is characterized by its exceptional structure, harmony and balance.

99 Points by Wine Advocate

While I've had multiple looks at previous vintages, this is my first review of the 2018 Hermitage Ligne de Crete Les Grandes Vignes. Inky in hue, it boasts powerful, brooding aromas that include hints of hardwood charcoal, dark berries, licorice, crushed stone and pencil shavings. Full-bodied and almost painfully intense, it's a huge, mouthfilling wine that seems capable of aging up to three decades. Rich, supple and creamy in texture, yet possessing remarkable length and retronasal nuance, it has to rank up there with some of the Hermitage hill's classics from other, more renowned producers. It certainly deserves a seat at that table and may be a candidate for a perfect score in the future.

95 Points by Wine Spectator

Plum paste, linzer torte and cassis notes give this a fruit-filled profile, while licorice, sweet spice and dark earth accents provide a solid background. There's a buried iron underpinning, and a late echo of singed alder on the finish. All of this feels seamless, thanks to an understated polish. Drink now through 2036.

chateau-dalem-fronsac-aoc.title: Chateau Dalem 2019
chateau-dalem-fronsac-aoc.bodyHtml:
Château Dalem 2019 is a rich, elegant Bordeaux red wine from the Fronsac appellation on the Right Bank of France. Crafted from 90% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Franc, this exceptional vintage showcases the estate's clay-limestone terroir and meticulous winemaking. Aged for 18 months in French oak barrels, it reveals concentrated aromas of black cherries, ripe blackberries, violets, and delicate spice. Its velvety tannins, vibrant acidity, and subtle mineral character create a beautifully balanced wine with impressive depth, complexity, and aging potential.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, duck breast, venison, mushroom risotto, aged Comté, and beef tenderloin.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep purple-black colored, the 2019 Dalem needs a few swirls before it really starts to show off all its vibrant black cherries, kirsch and black raspberry scents, followed by hints of camphor, pencil shavings and tobacco leaf. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is chock-full of crunchy black fruits with loads of freshness and perfume and a soft, approachable texture, finishing with a minty kick.

93 Points - James Suckling

Blueberries, minerals, slate and stone. It’s medium-bodied with medium, polished tannins and a linear finish. Nice balance. Lovely length to this.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Sleek and taut, with chalky threads running along the edges of a core of fresh cherry puree and cassis notes. Features a subtle tobacco accent throughout, with nice cut through the finish. Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. Drink now.

cuvee-millesime-brut-grand-cru.title: Eric Rodez Brut Grand Cru Cuvee des Grands Vintages
cuvee-millesime-brut-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Clear golden color with yellow highlights. Long nose, complex, expressed with notes of ripe pear and quince with hints of warm brioche. Vinous palate, ample, broad but fresh, conspicuous by its balance.Beautiful golden color, with copper highlights. The nose delivers aromas of quince blossom and orange marmalade. The Champagne evolves in the glass with elegance, quality that reveals a long palate, powerful and very aromatic.

93 Points - James Suckling

Delicate and complex, showing elegant violet aromas, strawberries and cherries with whiffs of pastry. Light-bodied with pinprick bubbles and fresh vinous flavors. Polished finish. More elegant than powerful. From biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Disgorged in April 2020 with three grams per liter dosage, the latest rendition of the NV Brut Cuvée des Grand Vintages wafts from the glass with inviting aromas of pear, toasted almonds, dried white flowers, honeycomb, peach and nougat. Full-bodied, elegantly fleshy and enveloping, with ripe but racy acids, a pillowy mousse and a nicely layered core, it's already quite expressive despite its recent disgorgement, but I suspect it will show even more depth and dimension with another year or two on cork.

chateau-fourcas-borie-2015.title: Chateau Fourcas-Borie Listrac-Medoc 2015 750ml
chateau-fourcas-borie-2015.bodyHtml: The palate is medium-bodied with supple, ripe black fruit, good grip in the mouth with a dense, well-balanced and convincing finish that attests to breeding and thoughtful winemaking. If Bruno Borie's other wines are out of financial reach, then reach for this splendid Listrac.

dominus-othello.title: Dominus Othello 2021
dominus-othello.bodyHtml:
Dominus Othello 2021 is a rich, Napa Valley red blend crafted in a structured, Bordeaux-inspired style by the Dominus Estate team. It typically shows ripe blackberry, plum, cassis, and dark cherry layered with cedar, cocoa, graphite, and subtle spice. The palate is full-bodied with firm tannins, balanced acidity, and a polished but powerful finish designed for both early enjoyment and short-term aging.

Food pairing: grilled ribeye, lamb chops, braised short ribs, beef stew, roasted duck, aged hard cheeses, and dishes with rich mushroom or truffle sauces.

96 Points - James Suckling

Lots of blackberries, dark cherries and hints of orange peel and bark in the aromas.Medium- to full-bodied with fine creamy tannins that caress the palate. The tannic tension give this focus and brightness. 85% cabernet sauvignon, 9% cabernet franc and the rest petit verdot. 

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Produced largely from the vines at the very front of the property, where there are higher proportions of clay and silt, the 2021 Othello Red Wine marks the first time this wine has been released to the US market (it has been made since 2005, first for the Japanese market, then sold into Canada as well). There are 1,000 cases of this wine, which is a blend of 85% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Cabernet Franc and 6% Petit Verdot that saw just 20% new French oak, with the balance being second or third-use. Aromas include raspberry and cherry fruit, with some softly dusty earth tones. Medium to full-bodied, the wine exhibits fairly soft tannins and a silky mouthfeel, not that rich or concentrated but balanced and gently savory on the lingering, mocha-tinged finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

This red offers friendly and focused notes of black currant, warm earth and singed alder on a medium-weight and readily accessible frame. There's nice freshness through the finish, where an echo of bay chimes. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. Drink now through 2032.

marco-gavio-brunello-de-montalcino.title: Martoccia Brunello di Montalcino 2020
marco-gavio-brunello-de-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Martoccia Brunello di Montalcino 2020 is an elegant and expressive Tuscan red crafted from 100% Sangiovese Grosso cultivated in the southwest vineyards of Montalcino. Aged extensively in traditional Slavonian oak barrels followed by bottle refinement, this vintage opens with vivid aromas of ripe red cherries, wild crushed plums, dried violet petals, pipe tobacco, and subtle earthiness. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied structure supported by vibrant natural acidity, fine-grained firm tannins, and a long, persistent finish marked by savory spice and mineral undertones.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with florentine T-bone steak, braised wild boar, roasted rack of lamb, truffled pasta dishes, and aged pecorino cheese.

90 Points - James Suckling

Ripe and lightly spirit-soaked cherries, together with plums. Lacks a little layering. The attack is firm, with velvety to chalky tannins and crisp acidity. Full body with a warming finish and slightly bold character overall. Drink from 2025.

oakville-winery-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
oakville-winery-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

trione-henrys-blend-geyserville-red.title: Trione Geyserville Ranch Henry's Blend 2017 750ml
trione-henrys-blend-geyserville-red.bodyHtml: This wine is soft, supple, and velvety on initial impact. Aromas and flavors of spice, black currants, and blackberry pie. The finish is long and lingering with integrated hints of cedar and cigar box.

varner-chardonnay.title: Beringer Private Reserve Chardonnay 2024
varner-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Beringer Private Reserve Chardonnay 2024 is a classic, rich, and beautifully crafted California white wine, representing the pinnacle of Beringer’s Chardonnay winemaking in Napa Valley. Displaying a luminous golden hue, it opens with fragrant aromas of ripe yellow apple, white peach, honeysuckle, and toasted brioche, seamlessly supported by delicate oak spices and vanilla notes. On the palate, it is full-bodied, opulent, and creamy, delivering a lush mouthfeel balanced by lively natural acidity that carries rich flavors of baked pear, lemon curd, and subtle toasted hazelnut through a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken with herbs, pan-seared sea scallops, creamy mushroom risotto, and aged Gruyère cheese.

96 Points - James Suckling

This has a vivid intensity balanced with freshness and just the right influence of oak. Aromas of preserved lemons, salted caramel, orange blossoms, lanolin and spices. The palate is tightly wound, showing mouthwatering acidity and a lovely texture with a flavorful finish. About 80% malolactic fermentation. Drink or hold.

kelley-fox-nerthus.title: Kelley Fox Nerthus 2021 750ml
kelley-fox-nerthus.bodyHtml:
I’m excited to offer you this delicious wine made of 34% Early Muscat, 34% Pinot gris, 18% Riesling, and 14% Pinot blanc. This year, I decided to whole cluster press all of the fruit at picking except for a couple of fermenters of skin-contact Pinot gris (one pigeage per day, pressed at dryness). Because of the timing of picks this year, each component was fermented separately, and the final wine was blended after all wines were finished. It was allowed to complete malolactic fermentation. Élevage was in stainless tanks until bottling.

This Nerthus is brilliant, transparent pale peach in colour with hints of pale pink. It’s visually very pleasing and the nose and mouth are even more so. The nose is full of fresh peach and honeysuckle notes along with powdery minerality. Though bone dry, there is mouth-watering peach character that is carried nicely by the refreshing acidity and lovely texture. This alpine-fresh wine is a real joybringer. It feels like spring, and I wholeheartedly enjoy making this wine every year.

kelley-fox-willamette-blanc.title: Kelley Fox Willamette Valley Blanc 2020 750ml
kelley-fox-willamette-blanc.bodyHtml: The Willamette Blanc is a brilliantly transparent, very light rose-gold colour. Made from 70% blanc de noir old vine Weber Vineyard Pinot Noir and 30% Chardonnay from three vineyards that in any other year would have been bottled as single-vineyard wines of place. It is not a rosé. The nose smells of fresh oceanic air, sweet rain and minerals. There are touches of citrus, blossoms, and strawberry, and it is a solid everyday “farmhouse” table wine.

kelley-fox-durant-vineyard-lark-block-ch.title: Kelley Fox Weber Vineyard Pinot Noir 2019
kelley-fox-durant-vineyard-lark-block-ch.bodyHtml: This is my third Pinot produced from Weber Vineyard, a beautiful vineyard just down Worden Hill Road from Maresh Vineyard that I have prized for a very long time. The vines in this block were planted in 1983 on their own roots. Strong, old Oregon oak trees and towering old maples guard the southern part of my block for this wine, while the eastern border of my block is a wild, mixed forest filled with unseen songbirds singing during the light hours. The Weber is a medium, youthful, and rich tone of red with brilliant transparency. The classic Dundee Hills nose is pure-fruited, inviting, and full red and blue berries and subtle spices. The mouth has beautiful, silken texture full of strawberries and raspberries. It has nice acidity and fine structure that has a long, silky, and weightless finish. When I wrote these notes, this wine felt like it should be in a fairy tale.

liger-belair-bourgogne-les-deux-terres.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Bourgogne Les Deux Terres 2016/2019 750ml
liger-belair-bourgogne-les-deux-terres.bodyHtml: It has an attractive bouquet of brambly red fruit, raspberry preserve and crushed strawberry with hint of pepper. The medium-bodied palate offers a sweet, cassis-tinged entry and tobacco and stewed berries. Smooth in texture with round tannin, it feels very sweet on the finish.

bodega-izadi-el-regalo-vinedo-singular.title: Bodegas Izadi El Regalo 2018
bodega-izadi-el-regalo-vinedo-singular.bodyHtml:
Bodegas Izadi El Regalo 2018 is a sophisticated and powerful "Viñedo Singular" (Singular Vineyard) red wine that represents the pinnacle of the estate's Rioja Alavesa production. Sourced from a historic 3.85-hectare plot in Villabuena de Álava planted in 1936, this flagship wine is celebrated for its "crystalline precision" and deep expression of terroir. The 2018 vintage offers an intense ruby-red colour and a complex bouquet of ripe morello cherry, bramble, and smoke, layered with secondary notes of toasted oak, spices, and roasted coffee. On the palate, it is full-bodied and structured, featuring velvety tannins, a silky texture, and a long, persistent finish with hints of aromatic herbs and dark fruit.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of plums, dried herbs, tea leaves, cedar and baking spices. It’s full-bodied with velvety tannins. Round and creamy with a fruity edge and a long finish. Touch of chocolate to the fruit. Drink now or hold.

chateau-marzy-pomerol.title: Chateau Marzy Pomerol 2020
chateau-marzy-pomerol.bodyHtml:
A classic Pomerol expressing the richness of Bordeaux's Right Bank, Château Marzy reveals aromas of black cherry, blackberry, ripe plum, violet, cocoa, and cedar. Smooth and beautifully structured, it offers velvety tannins, vibrant freshness, layered complexity, and a long, elegant finish with impressive depth.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef tenderloin, roast duck, grilled lamb, mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, aged Gruyère, braised short ribs, or venison.

e-molino-barolo-bricco-rocca-riserva.title: E. Molino Barolo Riserva Del Fico 2015 750ml
e-molino-barolo-bricco-rocca-riserva.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2015 vintage) "Aromas of iris, roasted coffee bean, eucalyptus and French oak form the nose. The firm, linear palate offers tart cranberry, vanilla and coconut before closing on notes of star anise and rusty nail. Austere, close-grained tannins grip the finish. Drink after 2027. Kerin O’Keefe" - 91/100, Wine Enthusiast

carolans-cold-brew.title: Jameson Cold Brew Irish Whiskey
carolans-cold-brew.bodyHtml:
Jameson Cold Brew is a coffee-flavoured Irish whiskey that brings together triple-distilled Jameson Irish Whiskey and natural cold brew coffee made with Arabica beans from Brazil and Colombia. It is bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle. The aroma is led by rich coffee bean, backed by the vanilla nuttiness of Jameson; the taste is bold and coffee-driven, followed by a charred wood note from the pot still whiskey, with a full-bodied, smooth and warming feel. It is made to be enjoyed cold rather than as a hot Irish Coffee.

Nose: Intense coffee bean with vanilla and nutty Jameson character.

Palate: Refreshing cold brew coffee, then charred wood from the pot still whiskey; full-bodied and smooth.

Serve: Chilled, over ice, with cola and a twist of orange.

j-denuziere-hermitage.title: J. Denuziere Crozes-Hermitage Blanc 2019
j-denuziere-hermitage.bodyHtml:
J. Denuziere Crozes-Hermitage Blanc is an expressive Northern Rhone white showing ripe pear, peach, citrus, white flowers, and delicate mineral notes. Its rounded texture is balanced by fresh acidity, creating a harmonious, aromatic palate with generous fruit and a clean, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled fish, shellfish, roast poultry, creamy seafood, vegetable dishes, or soft cheeses for an elegant Northern Rhone pairing.

 

90 Points - James Suckling

A supple, straightforward and fresh blend of marsanne and roussanne. On the nose, aromas of dried pears, quince and wildflower honey dominate, following through to a medium body with a soft character. Delicate and linear. Drink now.

i-vigneri-vinudilice-sparkling-rosato.title: I Vigneri Vinudilice 2018 750ml
i-vigneri-vinudilice-sparkling-rosato.bodyHtml:
The I Vigneri Vinudilice 2018 is a sparkling rosé wine from the Terre Siciliane region of Southern Italy. It's made from a blend of white and red grapes grown in the vineyard, and is characterized by its vibrant mineral strawberry aroma and subtle mineral ginger finish:
Aroma: A vibrant mineral strawberry aroma
Flavor: Delicate, rich flavors of berry fruit, minerals, and a touch of lime
Finish: A subtle mineral ginger finish
Other notes: Gentle foam on the palate

amiral-de-beychevelle-st-julien.title: Amiral de Beychevelle 2022
amiral-de-beychevelle-st-julien.bodyHtml:
The 2022 vintage presents a striking, deep ruby colour with subtle purple reflections. The highly aromatic nose is resplendent with notes of red cassis, black cherry, and blackberries, layered with spring flowers, violet, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and supple, offering a polished texture with flavours of sweet currants, ripe plums, and a judicious touch of chocolate and cocoa. The structure is defined by noble, velvety tannins and an astonishing freshness that provides a vibrant energy leading into a long, persistent finish. The varietal composition for this vintage is approximately 65% Cabernet Sauvignon and 35% Merlot. It has an ABV of 13.5% or 14% depending on the specific lot and is produced using sustainable viticulture practices.

95 Points - James Suckling

Very refined and pretty already with linear fine tannins that run the length of the wine. Medium body. Attractive finish. 65% cabernet sauvignon and 35% merlot.

delas-domaines-tourettes.title: Delas Domaine des Tourettes Hermitage 2018 750ml
delas-domaines-tourettes.bodyHtml:
96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Coming from three sites of the Hermitage (including the cru Les Bessards, the flagship of the estate), this syrah reveals obvious veins of crushed granite and tar that enhance rich and opulent flavors of blackcurrant and licorice jam. Although the tannins are ripe, this young grilled and spicy wine culminates in peppery notes of cloves, dark chocolate and espresso. It is better not to open it before 2023, and it should evolve until 2035 at the very least. A selection for the cellar. Note - 96. (Anna Lee C. Iijima, Wine Enthusiast, May 1, 2021)

julia-kemper-dao-tinto-reserve.title: Julia Kemper Reserva Tinto 2010
julia-kemper-dao-tinto-reserve.bodyHtml:
An award-winning, highly acclaimed organic Portuguese red displaying a smooth, ripe, and elegant profile with beautiful purity. The nose reveals a satisfying melting pot of complex aromas, including black cherry, plum, sweet tobacco, and a hint of fine oak spice. The palate is beautifully structured and precise, combining a solid tannic framework with rich berry fruits, fine minerality, and an impressive, age-worthy finish.

Food Pairing: Outstanding when paired with structural, intense red meat dishes like slow-braised venison game stews, roasted lamb shanks, or traditional roasted beef.

 

93 Points- Wine Enthusiast 

This blend of Touriga Nacional, Tinta Roriz, Alfrocheiro and Jaen is a satisfying melting pot of complex flavors. Its tannins are solid, although now complementing the rich berry fruits. It is an impressive wine that could still age further before complete maturity. Drink from 2019.

scribe-baker-lane-syrah.title: Scribe Baker Lane Syrah 2022 750ml
scribe-baker-lane-syrah.bodyHtml:
This bold, spicy wine typically has heaps of raspberry, black fruit and heady levels of alcohol. Syrah is relatively new to California, yet it's taken extremely well to the climate. It loves long periods of sunshine, and the heat of the Central Coast AVA.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
"A stunning, cool-climate Syrah with complex aromas of blackberry, violet, black pepper, and smoked meat. Elegant and structured with a vibrant, mineral-driven finish."

gratavinum-gv5-priorat.title: Gratavinum GV5 Priorat 2016 750ml
gratavinum-gv5-priorat.bodyHtml:
Gratavinum GV5 Priorat 2016 is a rich, full-bodied Spanish red wine from the renowned Priorat region of Catalonia. Produced by Gratavinum, this expressive wine showcases the intensity and character of Priorat's Mediterranean climate and distinctive slate-rich soils, known locally as llicorella. The 2016 vintage offers concentrated dark fruit flavours, complemented by notes of black cherry, blackberry, plum, Mediterranean herbs, spice, and subtle mineral undertones. Structured tannins, balanced freshness, and a long, elegant finish make this wine an excellent choice for special occasions or cellaring.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, braised beef, venison, slow-cooked short ribs, wild mushroom dishes, and aged cheeses. Its depth and structure complement rich, savoury meals.

hauts-de-granget-st-emilion-grand-cru.title: Les Hauts De Granget Saint-Emilion Grand Cru 2018
hauts-de-granget-st-emilion-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Les Hauts De Granget Saint-Emilion Grand Cru 2018 is a classic and robust Right Bank Bordeaux red wine, crafted from a traditional blend of Merlot (85%) and Cabernet Franc (15%). This wine opens with an inviting and complex bouquet of ripe black cherries, wild blueberries, and dark plums, beautifully laced with nuances of warm cinnamon, cedar, sweet tobacco, and wet gravel. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied with a soft, round mouthfeel and rich, concentrated layers of dark fruits. The Cabernet Franc adds a refreshing streak of acidity and fine-grained, ripe tannins that carry through to a long, structured, and elegant finish accented by a delicate touch of oak.

Food Pairing: Grilled or roasted red meats (such as ribeye steak, lamb chops, or duck breast), mushroom stroganoff, crown roast of pork, and strong, semi-mature cheeses.

batasiolo-barolo-riserva.title: Beni di Batasiolo Barolo Riserva 2017
batasiolo-barolo-riserva.bodyHtml:
A careful selection of grapes and long ageing in oak casks give this wine a haunting character rich in mature aromas.

Deep garnet red colour with delicate orange tinges. It is distinguished by a particular aromatic range tending towards maturity. It is jammy, nutty, toasty and floral with a good development. A winning taste with supply hints backed by a good alcohol content and a harmonious union of tannins and crispness, offering pleasant sensations of completeness and body.

valdemar-estates-walla-walla-syrah.title: Valdemar Estates Blue Mountain Vineyard Syrah 2019 750ml
valdemar-estates-walla-walla-syrah.bodyHtml: The terroir of this distinctive Walla Walla vineyard really shines through, with hallmark aromas of blackberry, acai, lilac, and cacao nibs. Lovely sense of energy, tension, and vibrancy. Crisp with a distinct, savory fruit character. Blue Mountain Vineyard enjoys good airflow, rainfall, and sunlight.

10000-hours-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: Caymus Special Selection Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 1.5L Magnum
10000-hours-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
The Caymus 'Special Selection' Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptional wine made from this storied Napa Valley estate. Following some time to open, this incredible Cabernet begins to yield profound aromatics of black cherry compote, blueberry pie and boysenberry along with creosote, black tar, milk chocolate and licorice all soaring from the glass. The mouthfeel is rich, voluptuous and intense, as this wine offers exceedingly dense, concentrated flavors of black cherry reduction, blueberry pie, raspberry liquor and boysenberry, alongside milk chocolate shavings and tar, all cascading on to the long mouth coating finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Lush and polished, with waves of cassis and blackberry compote pouring through, underscored by chocolate, espresso crema and roasted vanilla bean. Maintains a lush, velvety feel through the lengthy finish, where flashes of sweet tobacco and warm earth peek through. For the power Cabernet crowd. Best from 2024 through 2038.

10000-hours-red-blend-2019.title: 10000 Hours Red Blend 2019 750ml
10000-hours-red-blend-2019.bodyHtml:
There’s a theory that says to become truly accomplished at something (karate, painting, the cello) it takes at least 10,000 hours of practice. This holds true for winemaking, too, where in this case the hours are counted in decades, and one thing is undeniable, there are no shortcuts. Their rich, complex 10,000 Hours reds are the culmination of that dedication. Each is deep, structured, and born of the famously exclusive Red Mountain terroir in eastern Washington, where the land and climate impart flavour characteristics like no other region in the world. This combination of patient toil and perfect sun, soil and rainfall conditions result in Cabernet Sauvignon and Red Blend experiences that are meant to be savored, not rushed. Will you be able to taste the decades of passion and master craftsmanship that go into each bottle? Instantly.

This Red Mountain gem was aged for 20 months in French oak barrels and can be enjoyed now or age in the bottle for 10+ years. Raspberry preserves, dried savoury herb and mocha on the nose with hints of liquorice, clove and vanilla. Expansive on the fore palate, building to a dense and rich mid palate with strong notes of ripe fruit and baking spices. Long, lingering finish with hints of toasty oak and vanilla.

63% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Merlot, 6% Petit Verdot, 3% Malbec and 2% Cabernet Franc from Red Mountain. Aged 20 months in 35% new French oak.
91 Points - James Suckling
A rich, layered red with red-berry, plum and chocolate aromas and flavors. Medium-bodied with velvety tannins. Better in a year or two, when it will have softened.

aquilini-red-mountain-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Aquilini A56 Red Mountain Red Blend 2019
aquilini-red-mountain-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
92 Points - James Suckling

This is ripe and rich with spiced plums, dark berries, cloves, chocolate and forest wood. Full-bodied with an array of succulent dark fruit and firm, fine-grained tannins. Fleshy and chocolaty with an earthy finish. Drink or hold.

aquilini-red-mountain-family-blend.title: Aquilini Family Blend 2017 750ml
aquilini-red-mountain-family-blend.bodyHtml:
The conundrum presented by our 2017 Aquilini Family Blend is whether to celebrate it now, or savor it down the road. Either way, this wine romances with lush berries, chewy espresso, and a beguiling softness. Grown with the same care in the Blackwood Canyon and The Canyons vineyards beside our Cabernet Sauvignon, these grapes offer all the pleasure of the Cabernet with a bit of bounce from Petit Verdot. Although this wine will age beautifully, it’s so delicious now, you may be tempted not to let it.

Lush. Layered. Fresh. Bright aromas of African espresso, raspberries and rose powder burst from the glass. The wine is balanced with well-integrated acidity and framed by firm, ripe tannins. Energetic and fresh this wine is approachable in its youth yet will age gracefully over the next decade.

aquilini-red-mountain-sauvignon-blanc.title: Aquilini A56 Red Mountain Red Blend 2019
aquilini-red-mountain-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
92 Points - James Suckling

This is ripe and rich with spiced plums, dark berries, cloves, chocolate and forest wood. Full-bodied with an array of succulent dark fruit and firm, fine-grained tannins. Fleshy and chocolaty with an earthy finish. Drink or hold.

chocalan-alexia-red-2017.title: Vina Chocalan Alexia 2017 750ml
chocalan-alexia-red-2017.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2017 vintage) "This is the top wine of the winery (which you can tell by the obscene bottle weight), based on cabernet franc (75%) with merlot, cabernet sauvignon, and petit verdot from the Coastal area of Maipo Valley, near the Maipo River and rooted in granitic clays and loam. This is aged in French barrels for 18 months. Potent and impactful, with herbal black cherry, cassis, raspberry, heady menthol on a dense and full palate. Cracked pepper and tobacco are woven throughout, housed by ample, well-integrated yet grippy tannins, and brightened with a fresh coastal acidity to a saline finish. Intense, this is drinking well now with an appropriately intense fire-grilled meal, but will be happy in the cellar for the next few years. (Treve Ring)." - 92/100, Gismondi on Wine

masi-costasera-amarone-1990.title: Masi Costasera Amarone Classico 2020
masi-costasera-amarone-1990.bodyHtml:
Masi Costasera Amarone Classico 2020 is an iconic, full-bodied Italian red wine displaying a very dark ruby-red color and complex, expressive aromas of baked plums, dark cherry jam, and ripe blueberries, interwoven with elegant notes of dark chocolate, cocoa, coffee, and subtle dried herbs. On the palate, it delivers a rich, velvety texture supported by firm yet polished tannins, balanced vibrant acidity, and a long, warming finish with lingering nuances of sweet baking spices, blood orange, and cocoa.

Food Pairing: Excellent as an after-dinner wine or paired with roasted red meats, braised beef short ribs, game, polenta with sausage, or aged cheeses such as Parmigiano-Reggiano and Gorgonzola.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained and reductive style, showing aromas of bay leaves, red and black cherries and a whiff of flowers. Full-bodied, it has a compact profile on the palate with ripe and velvety tannins, tight-knit acidity and a superprecise finish. A bit technical and young at the moment but very good. It is drinkable now, but wait for more complexity to develop.

91 Points - Wine Advocate

The Masi 2020 Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Costasera (made with 70% Corvina, 25% Rondinella and 5% Molinara) shows dark fruit ripeness with meaty cherry and blackberry. Thanks to the younger vintage, you can appreciate the wine's primary intensity. A potent 15% alcohol content and a full-bodied texture sets this bottle up for a pairing with polenta and sausage. Tart cherry appears as a final send-off.

culmina-malbec-2016.title: Culmina Malbec 2021
culmina-malbec-2016.bodyHtml:
A vibrant expression of Malbec, aromas of ripe bramble fruits and black cherry are interwoven with subtle hints of sandalwood, tea leaves, and cloves. On the palate, it presents a harmonious blend of graphite and gentle oak tannins, accented by a touch of star anise and more cherry notes. The finish is bright, lively, and elegantly sustained.

Pair with Chef Nick's chocolate chili short rib au jus with creamy polenta and honey brown butter carrots

arette-blanco-fuerte.title: Arette Fuerte Blanco 101 Tequila
arette-blanco-fuerte.bodyHtml:
Arette Fuerte Blanco 101 Tequila is a high-proof, unaged tequila produced by the Orendain family at the historic El Llano distillery in Tequila, Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in the Tequila Valley, this expression is traditionally cooked in brick ovens, fermented in concrete tanks, and double-distilled in stainless steel pot stills. Bottled at 50.5% ABV (101 proof), it preserves the bold character of cooked agave, bright citrus, earthy minerals, and warming pepper spice. Its full-bodied intensity makes it an excellent sipping tequila or a robust foundation for premium cocktails.

Food Pairing: Spicy shrimp aguachile, grilled steak, pork carnitas, roasted peppers, fresh ceviche, aged cheeses, and citrus-marinated seafood.

Tasting Notes: Bold and vibrant, featuring sweet cooked agave, fresh citrus, herbal notes, earthy minerality, and warming black pepper.

Nose: Cooked agave, citrus zest, green pepper, herbal aromas, and subtle earthy minerals.

Palate: Rich roasted agave, lemon zest, black pepper, gentle sweetness, vegetal notes, and warming spice.

Finish: Long, warming, and peppery, with lingering agave sweetness, citrus peel, and earthy complexity.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a tequila tasting glass, with a few drops of water if desired, or use in a bold Margarita or Paloma.

thevenet-fils-petit-perou-morgon-vv.title: Thevenet Fils Petit Perou Morgon Trad
thevenet-fils-petit-perou-morgon-vv.bodyHtml:
Thevenet Fils Petit Pérou Morgon Tradition is a classic Beaujolais red crafted from Gamay Noir. It offers aromas of ripe cherry, raspberry, blackberry, and violet, with a fresh palate featuring lively acidity, supple tannins, juicy fruit, earthy complexity, balanced structure, and a smooth finish.

Food Pairing: Roast chicken, charcuterie, grilled pork, sausages, mushroom dishes, beef, pâté, and traditional French country cuisine.

obsidian-ridge-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Obsidian Ridge Volcanic Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
obsidian-ridge-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Obsidian Ridge Volcanic Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, robust, and intense California red wine crafted from high-elevation, volcanic soils planted with obsidian glass gravel in the Mayacamas Mountain Range. On the nose, it unveils expressive aromas of lush boysenberry, dark plum, clove, and toasted oak, intertwined with delicate floral notes of violet and black pepper. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied structure brimming with concentrated blackberry, blood orange peel, dark chocolate, and sarsaparilla flavors, framed by grippy, firm tannins and vibrant acidity that leads into a persistent, structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs fantastically with braised lamb shanks, grilled ribeye steak, roasted venison, wild mushroom risotto, or sharp aged cheeses.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine is aromatic, with lush boysenberry, star anise, clove, violets, and toasted oak on the nose. The palate offers blackberry, blood orange peel, sarsaparilla, bittersweet chocolate, vanilla cream, and grippy acidity on the finish. Aerate and pair with lamb shank.

f-rinaldi-barolo-cannubi.title: E. Pira e Figli Chiara Boschis Cannubi Barolo 2020
f-rinaldi-barolo-cannubi.bodyHtml:
Barolo Cannubi by Francesco Rinaldi & Figl is an elegant expression of this famous red wide, made with 100% Nebbiolo grapes coming from Cannubi cru in Baorlo. It's a strong, classic wine, with an excellent ageing potential. In the glass it is ruby red with bright maroon shades. The bouquet is intense, wide, floral and fruity, with hints of cherry, ripe strawberry, plum, sweet spices and dried flowers. The sip is vigorous, balanced with great persistence and soft tannic texture. Barolo Cannubi by Francesco Rinaldi & Figli is recommended with red meat, roasts, game and matured cheese.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The E. Pira e Figli - Chiara Boschis 2020 Barolo Cannubi is a fine and delicate wine, although there is a little more grit and richness in this warm vintage. The quality of the fruit is exceptional, especially its crisp ripeness. Dark cherry, blackcurrant, rose blossom, pink pepper and white limestone add considerable high-toned notes. The freshness is great and the fruit stays juicy, fueling a long, elegant finish. Only 4,000 bottles were made.

97 Points - James Suckling

Nervy and complex nose with excellent depth. Oranges, nutmeg, steel, mineral and a touch of white pepper and oyster shell. Broad and expansive on the palate with very structured, chalky tannins that extend to a lengthy, mineral finish. Long and youthful. From organically grown grapes. Can drink now, but better from 2027.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A well of pure cherry bubbles up in this red, complemented by rose, strawberry, mineral, wet pine and underbrush aromas and flavors. Though exuding finesse, this is layered with chalky tannins, yet still extends with a kaleidoscope of red fruit, mineral and savory notes on the long finish. Best from 2028 through 2046. 3,330 cases made, 1,110 cases imported.

purlieu-missouri-hopper-cabernet-sauv.title: Purlieu Missouri Hopper Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
purlieu-missouri-hopper-cabernet-sauv.bodyHtml:
The Purlieu and Le Pich wines are made by Julien Fayard. Julien's name is just becoming recognizable with consumers, but he's been making world class Cabernet for well over a decade, and his name is well-known in Napa's inner circles. Julien has lived in the Napa Valley since 2006, when he and his wife agreed to settle down by "meeting halfway" - between his home in France… and hers in Sonoma. In France, Julien worked in both Provence and Bordeaux, where he defined his core winemaking style at the exalted first growth Château Lafite-Rothschild (he even lived in Lafite's grand château for a period) as well as at Smith Haut Lafitte. In Napa, Julien worked at Quintessa before joining Atelier Melka, where he spent five years as the Director of Winemaking. It was here, working with a variety of clients including Lail Vineyards, Gemstone, Dalla Valle, and more that Julien further developed his winemaking style - while also gaining an intimate understanding of the valley's vineyards and establishing strong relationships with its many passionate, quality-dedicated growers.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer Missouri Hopper sings of stewed red and black plums, crème de cassis and wild blueberries, plus suggestions of violets, dusty soil and wild sage. Full-bodied, laden with flavors and solidly structured, the palate delivers taut, muscular black fruits and lots of earthy nuances on the long finish. A classic, stunning expression of Missouri Hopper!

sebastien-riffault-auksinis.title: Sebastien Riffault Auksinis Sancerre 2014 750ml
sebastien-riffault-auksinis.bodyHtml:
Sébastien Riffault's Auksinis Maceration Sancerre is a bold and distinctive expression of Sauvignon Blanc that pushes the boundaries of traditional winemaking. The name "Auksinis," meaning gold in Lithuanian, reflects the wine's rich and amber-hued personality, a result of the unique maceration process applied by Riffault.
Tasting Notes
NOSE:
This distinct Sancerre opens with an intriguing nose of sun-ripened peaches, orange blossom, and a subtle earthiness.

TASTE:
The maceration process adds a layer of texture, providing a velvety mouthfeel that envelops the palate. Flavors of tropical fruits, apricot skin, and a hint of chamomile intermingle with a touch of tannin derived from the skin contact.

FINISH:
The result is a wine that marries the freshness of Sauvignon Blanc with the structure and complexity of extended skin maceration, culminating in a lingering, textured finish.
Food Pairing
Auksinis Maceration Sancerre is a versatile companion to a range of hearty dishes. Its robust character makes it an excellent pairing with aged cheeses like Comté or Manchego. The wine's structure also complements grilled poultry, particularly duck breast with a fruit compote. For a unique experience, try it with Moroccan tagine or a dish featuring spiced quinoa and roasted vegetables.

millton-clos-de-ste-anne-chardonnay.title: The Millton Vineyards Clos de Ste. Anne Naboth's Vineyard Chardonnay 2019 750ml
millton-clos-de-ste-anne-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Hailing from Naboth's Vineayrd 1 Kings Ch. 21. The first vineyard in the world to see the sun. The 2019 vintage is again an energetic, luminous wine. Only 10 months on primary yeast lees offers a biscuity richness to the primary fruit. Exotic perfumes of acorns, vanilla and almonds welcome the finesse and delicacy combined with a full rich palate. A New world classic and a collectors dream.

agostina-pieri-riserva-brunello.title: Agostina Pieri Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2020
agostina-pieri-riserva-brunello.bodyHtml:
Agostina Pieri Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2020 is an incredibly refined, powerful, and single-varietal Tuscan red that represents the pinnacle of this family-run estate's production. Crafted only in outstanding vintages from south-facing parcels in Castelnuovo dell'Abate, it undergoes extended oak and bottle aging to develop profound complexity. The nose unfurls an intense bouquet of macerated black cherries, dark plums, and crushed violets, seamlessly layered with notes of cured leather, tobacco leaf, and exotic sweet spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied and beautifully structured, presenting a deep core of dark fruits balanced by vibrant acidity and robust, velvety tannins that glide into a remarkably long, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Exceptionally suited for rich, slow-braised wild boar ragù, charcoal-grilled Bistecca alla Fiorentina, rosemary-roasted leg of lamb, or matured Pecorino Toscano cheese.

riondo-amarone.title: Riondo Amarone Della Valpolicella 2019 750ml
riondo-amarone.bodyHtml:
Riondo Amarone della Valpolicella is an elegant, full-bodied, complex wine. A flavor of black cherry on the palate, with spicy notes of vanilla and a coffee finish.

A wine to accompany first courses with elaborate sauces made with truffles or perhaps pair with game, braised meats, roasts and tasty, well-matured hard cheeses.

chateau-haut-carles-2011.title: Chateau De Carles Haut-Carles 2016 750ml
chateau-haut-carles-2011.bodyHtml: A lovely wine, medium body with plenty of fresh red fruit and a touch of spice, sweet vanilla and ripe damson fruit. Well balanced with a very pleasant, long finish.

girolamo-russo-etna-rosato.title: Girolamo Russo Etna Rosato 2021 750ml
girolamo-russo-etna-rosato.bodyHtml: The nose is complex and enticing, with notes of peach, orange skin and light summer berries. The palate is classy, delicate and textural, with textbook Russo flintiness. It has a fascinating combination of elements of a fine white wine and light red wine. Fabulous with pasta dishes, seafood, and grilled light meats.

girolamo-russo-etna-bianco-nerina.title: Cusumano Alta Mora Guardiola Etna Rosso 2020
girolamo-russo-etna-bianco-nerina.bodyHtml:
Cusumano Alta Mora Guardiola Etna Rosso 2020 is an elegant, highly aesthetic volcanic red wine crafted from 100% Nerello Mascalese. Sourced from one of the highest and steepest cru sites on Mount Etna at an altitude of up to 1,000 meters, this limited-edition wine comes from ancient vines up to 150 years old that are deeply rooted in mineral-rich lava rock. It displays a transparent ruby color with a brick-red rim, offering a complex, restrained bouquet of sour cherry, dried flowers, orange zest, and thyme, underlined by smoky, wet-stone minerality. On the palate, it is slender and vertically structured, balancing nervy acidity and silky, fine-grained tannins with cool, precise flavors, culminating in a long, salty, and crystal-clear finish that beautifully expresses its pure, uncompromising terroir.

Food Pairing:

Matches beautifully with grilled lamb chops with rosemary, roasted pork tenderloin, dark poultry dishes, rich white meat ragù, or mildly matured pecorino cheese.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Alta Mora's top-shelf red is the 2020 Etna Rosso Guardiola. This limited release of 3,000 bottles is made with fruit from exceptionally old vines (up to 160 years old) on their own roots in bush-trained vines placed on steep stone terraces at 900 meters in elevation. Guardiola is one of the best-performing growing sites on the volcano, and it always shows an especially polished mineral character. The wine sees 20 days of skin contact during fermentation and ages in large oak casks. This wine has complexity and depth, but ultimately it adheres to the accessible and mid-weight identity of the vintage.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Enticing aromas of anise, cinnamon, graphite and leather lace flavors of fig cake, baked cherry and Earl Grey in this supple red, with fine-grained tannins. Shows lovely integration and overall balance, with its ripe fruit juiciness carrying the flavor profile through the lasting finish. Drink now through 2040.
92 Points - James Suckling
Showing plums and cherries with tobacco and smoke undertones throughout, this is medium-bodied, round and fruity. Hints of wood at the end. Needs two or three years to come together. Drink or hold.

girolamo-russo-rosso-san-lorenzo.title: Girolamo Russo San Lorenzo Etna Rosso 2019
girolamo-russo-rosso-san-lorenzo.bodyHtml:
Girolamo Russo San Lorenzo Etna Rosso 2019 is an elegant, highly expressive red wine produced by Giuseppe Russo from old vines grown on volcanic soil in the San Lorenzo vineyard. Fermented with indigenous yeast and aged in used oak casks, it shows aromas of wild red berries, orange rind, dried herbs, and volcanic minerals, with vibrant acidity and refined tannins.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops, duck breast, pork tenderloin, wild mushroom dishes, and aged cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

This displays an amazing balance of power and grace, throwing in a shovel load of terroir, too.
