The aromas and flavors extend from ripe red fruit, through red licorice, tufo, orange rind and bright herbs. Medium-bodied with some firm tannin, but there's no stopping the complex fruit. This is top-class Etna rosso. Drinkable now, if you don't mind the firm tannin, or hold.

barnett-viineyards-sauvignon-blanc.title: Barnett Vineyards Andrews Vineyard Sauvignon Blanc 2022
barnett-viineyards-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
This light straw gold wine is bursting with aromatics. Loaded with passionfruit and honeydew melon the nose turns to lime zest and white pepper. The wine is quite lush for Sauvignon blanc, with lemon custard and kiwi on the palate. Bright acidity balances out the lushness and the wine finishes with a myriad of tropical fruit. This wine has always been at its best in its youth.
93 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This full-bodied, creamy-textured wine has good backing from lively lemon and lime acidity to counter its vanilla and coconut richness.

gardet-prestige-charles-millesime-2006.title: Charles Gardet Prestige Millesime Champagne 2008
gardet-prestige-charles-millesime-2006.bodyHtml:
Charles Gardet Prestige Millésime Champagne 2008 is a magnificent, classic, and beautifully sculpted vintage Champagne that perfectly captures the legendary tension, purity, and longevity of the historical 2008 harvest. Sourced exclusively from Premier and Grand Cru vineyards across the Côte des Blancs, Montagne de Reims, and Vallée de la Marne, this exceptional cuvée is crafted without malolactic fermentation to retain its laser-like freshness, before undergoing extensive aging in the house's deep chalk cellars. In the glass, it displays a brilliant golden-yellow hue with golden highlights and a fine, persistent mousse. The sophisticated, multi-layered nose opens with subtle sea spray, iodine, and chalky mineral notes, evolving gracefully into aromas of white flowers, lemon meringue, granny smith apples, and warm brioche. On the palate, the wine is full of incredible delicacy and structure, showing a linear fluid coherence where a concentrated core of citrus zest and crunchy white orchard fruits is effortlessly framed by a searing spine of natural acidity and deep autolytic weight, leading to an intensely fresh, enduring, and remarkably mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with grilled lobster tails, pan-seared sea bass, scallops in white wine sauce, or as a luxurious aperitif.

dalla-valle-maya.title: Dalla Valle Maya 2020 750ml
dalla-valle-maya.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Maya exudes confidence and elegance from the first sip. It is a classic Maya blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc, the core coming from "Maya’s Vineyard" Cabernet Sauvignon always blended with carefully chosen Cabernet Franc lots to harmonize and bring lift to the energetic qualities of the Cabernet Sauvignon. An exquisite symphony of frankincense, clove, and cedar jump from the glass in the beginning, then subtle fruit notes of rainier cherries and lingonberries meld together both on the nose and continue on the palate. The classic silky yet firm tannins leave a prolonged weight leading to a long finish. 

Blend: 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 40% Cabernet Franc

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Perhaps there's a subtle added touch of leafy complexity to the 2020 Maya that the Cabernet Sauvignon doesn't show, but otherwise, this 60-40 blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc is reasonably similar, with black cherries, dark loamy notes, hints of cassis, cedar and vanilla. It's medium to full-bodied, richly textured and tannic but with a slightly open-knit feel and a ripe, softly wooly finish.

96 Points - James Suckling

Subtle yet transparent blackberry, black licorice and cassis bush. Some sage and lavender as well. Graphite, too. Full-bodied, yet tight and poised on the palate, with tight and refined tannins that are compact in the mouth. They are layered and run vertically down the wine. Turns nicely austere at the end. Very well done for the vintage.

96+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Even better, the 2020 Maya Proprietary Red Wine checks in as the usual blend of 60% Cabernet Sauvignon and 40% Cabernet Franc, and it's another full-bodied example of this cuvée that has a brilliant core of both red and black fruits as well as dark chocolate, leafy tobacco, spring flowers, and a kiss of chalky minerality. Structured, concentrated, and perfectly balanced, it doesn't get any better in 2020.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Features a cassis and black cherry fruit core flanked by a prominent tobacco note, with a loamy edge driving through as well. The slightly taut finish is underscored by alder and warm paving stone accents. Shows its Cabernet Franc side more than the Cabernet Sauvignon component. Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2024 through 2035.

chateau-la-fleur-petrus.title: Chateau La Fleur-Petrus 2019
chateau-la-fleur-petrus.bodyHtml:
The 2019 vintage is an exceptional and highly rated release that perfectly balances the natural opulence of a warm year with the estate’s signature aristocratic restraint. It opens with a sophisticated bouquet of blackcurrant, damson plum, and crushed violets, layered with subtle notes of truffle, licorice, and iron. On the palate, it is full-bodied and strikingly pure, featuring a dense core of black fruits supported by seamless, velvet-like tannins and a refreshing mineral lift. The finish is remarkably long and harmonious, marking this as one of the most complete and age-worthy vintages in the property's history.
98 Points - James Suckling

So much dried-flower, black-olive, earth and spice character, together with dried fruit, violets and black licorice. Full, yet so fine and linear. It accelerates at the finish, going on and on. A classic beauty. So racy.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 La Fleur-Pétrus dares to outshine Trotanoy this year, wafting from the glass with aromas of rich berry fruit, plum preserve, dark chocolate, cigar box and spices. Full-bodied, rich and enveloping, it's broad and layered, with beautifully polished tannins, a ripe core of fruit and a seamless, enveloping profile. This is an elegantly muscular, generous Pomerol whose sumptuous personality reflects the warm, dry vintage.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Seriously dark and winey, showing a deep core of black currant preserve, warmed fig paste and plum reduction flavors inlaid with racy graphite, mouthwatering tobacco and enticing singed alder, bay leaf and freshly plowed humus. Delivers density, grip and definition on the long finish. Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Best from 2025.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The structure of the wine masks the superrichness of the black fruits. Tannins are definitely to the fore giving density and ripeness. This is a big wine, needing to age. Drink from 2027.

chanson-chablis-1er-cru-fourchaumes.title: Chanson Chablis Premier Cru Fourchaume 2021
chanson-chablis-1er-cru-fourchaumes.bodyHtml:
Domaine Chanson Chablis Premier Cru Fourchaume 2021 is a refined, dense, and precise natural expression of Chardonnay crafted by the historic Burgundy house Domaine Chanson. Sourced from selected plots within 'Fourchaume'—one of Chablis' most renowned Premier Cru vineyards located on steep, south-west facing slopes composed of fossil-rich Kimmeridgian limestone soils—this wine undergoes gentle pneumatic pressing and temperature-controlled vinification in stainless steel tanks to preserve the maximum purity of fruit and site-specific terroir. In the glass, it displays a pale yellow hue with bright golden highlights. The nose reveals a complex aromatic bouquet of fresh lemon, green apple, white floral blooms, and crushed flint minerality. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, concentrated, and structured profile balanced by crisp, electric acidity and a long, saline, and refreshing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fresh oysters, grilled sea bass, pan-seared scallops, lobster, roasted poultry, and fresh goat cheese.

chanson-chablis-1er-cru-montee-de-tonner.title: Billaud-Simon Chablis Montee de Tonnerre Premier Cru
chanson-chablis-1er-cru-montee-de-tonner.bodyHtml:
Billaud-Simon Chablis 1Er Cru Montee de Tonnerre is a refined Premier Cru Chardonnay showcasing vibrant citrus, white orchard fruit, floral aromas, and pronounced mineral character. Elegant and precise, it offers excellent freshness, depth, and a long, saline finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, lobster, scallops, grilled white fish, roasted poultry, creamy seafood dishes, and aged Comté cheese.

chanson-chablis-1er-cru-montmains.title: Bersan Chablis Aoc 1Er Cru Montmains
chanson-chablis-1er-cru-montmains.bodyHtml: Domaine Bersan Chablis Premier Cru Montmains comes from the family estate of Jean-Louis and Jean-Christophe Bersan in Saint-Bris-le-Vineux, whose 22 hectares are farmed to certified organic standards. The Chardonnay grows on Kimmeridgian clay-limestone and is Guyot-pruned. Grapes are hand-picked, sorted and pressed straight away, and fermentation starts spontaneously with native yeasts; the wine then spends 8 months in barrel and 4 months in stainless steel before bottling. The domaine describes an elegant, mineral Montmains with hazelnut and white flowers on the nose and a brioche-like, ample palate with a long, tangy finish. Serve at 11 to 13°C with fish, poultry or seafood; it can be kept for 7 to 8 years. 12.5% ABV, 750 ml.

kilbeggan-triple-cask.title: Kilbeggan Triple Cask Irish Whiskey
kilbeggan-triple-cask.bodyHtml: A delightful release from Kilbeggan that is matured in three different cask types (Bourbon, Pedro Ximenez Sherry, and American Oak). This premium blend delivers a characterful Irish whiskey with rich notes of summer fruits and vanilla, leading into an oak spice finish.

s-by-ray-signorello-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Signorello Estate S Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
s-by-ray-signorello-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Signorello Estate S Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a plush, modern, and deeply complex expression of Napa Valley terroir. Crafted from premium vineyards across St. Helena, Oakville, and Howell Mountain, this blockbuster vintage is renowned for its luxurious texture and rich concentration. The wine reveals an alluring aromatic profile brimming with boysenberry, blackcurrant liqueur, and peak summer ripe cherries. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, seamlessly weaving its dark berry core with complex layers of tobacco spice, cacao nibs, graham cracker nuances, and finely integrated cedarwood from 26 months of maturation in 50% new French oak. Characterized by striking graphite-laced precision and supple, velvety tannins, it delivers a remarkably deep mid-palate and finishes with impressive length and elegance.

Food Pairing: Excellent alongside robust dishes such as a classic bone-in ribeye steak, hearty braised lamb, spare ribs, Toulouse sausages with herb mash, or mature hard cheeses like Mimolette.

montefalco-sagrantino-chiusa-di-pannone.title: Antonelli San Marco Chiusa di Pannone Montefalco Sagrantino 2015 750ml
montefalco-sagrantino-chiusa-di-pannone.bodyHtml: Intense ruby red in colour. A rich and powerful, ethereal and very complex nose. Typically characterised by notes of fruit and aromatic herbs, with citrus features, cherry, berry, mint and oregano. On the palate this wine is very structured, with firm and integrated tannins. A wine that is best expressed with a long bottle ageing.

presquile-santa-barbara-chardonnay.title: Presqu'ile Santa Barbara Chardonnay 2022
presquile-santa-barbara-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Presqu'ile Santa Barbara Chardonnay 2022 is a refined, crisp, and coastal-driven white wine crafted by Presqu'ile Winery. Native-yeast fermented and aged predominantly in neutral French oak, it pours a bright pale straw hue. On the nose, it delivers vibrant aromas of Meyer lemon, yellow pear, crushed white flowers, and citrus peel anchored by a signature ocean spray minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, zesty, and beautifully balanced, offering a satiny texture balanced by energetic acidity and a long, saline, fruit-filled finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with pan-seared sea scallops, grilled halibut, creamy pasta dishes, crab cakes, roasted chicken, and soft goat cheeses.

presquile-santa-barbara-pinot-noir.title: Presquile Bien Nacido Pinot Noir 750ml
presquile-santa-barbara-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2021 vintage) "This bottling shows a rustic, Old World-leaning style, beginning with aromas of leather, herb-coated and gamy meats, and crushed berries. The palate combines a similar herb and dried-meat component." - 90/100, Wine Enthusiast

borro-boscone-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Vint Bourbon Barrel Aged Cabernet Sauvignon
borro-boscone-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Deep rich ruby. Aromas of blackberry cobbler, ripe and dark mixed berries, graham cracker, brown sugar, vanilla, milk chocolate, toasty oak, with notes of coffee and smoke. On the palate, ripe blackberry cobbler, blueberry pie, pralines, sweet vanilla custard, brown sugar, caramel, mocha with hints of coffee. Ripe, dense and soft chewy tannins with toasty oak round the wine out with a lush, long, and lingering finish. A superb accompaniment to bourbon glazed ribs, charcuterie board, hearty pasta dishes, and strong cheeses.

sebastien-riffault-auksinis-1.title: Sebastien Riffault Auksinis Sancerre 2016
sebastien-riffault-auksinis-1.bodyHtml:
Sébastien Riffault Auksinis Sancerre 2016 is an extraordinary natural white wine from France's celebrated Loire Valley, offering a richly textured and unconventional interpretation of Sauvignon Blanc. Crafted by visionary winemaker Sébastien Riffault in Sancerre, this distinctive wine reflects a commitment to organic and biodynamic viticulture, mature vines and traditional, minimal-intervention winemaking. Sourced from old vines rooted in the region's clay-limestone soils, the grapes are harvested by hand, with carefully selected ripe and botrytis-affected fruit contributing remarkable depth and complexity. Fermented naturally with indigenous yeasts and matured patiently in oak, the wine develops an intense golden colour and a fascinating aromatic profile. Expressive notes of ripe peaches, baked apples, dried apricots and citrus peel intertwine with delicate florals, honeyed nuances, earthy undertones and subtle savoury spice. Rich and layered on the palate, its concentrated fruit character is beautifully balanced by vibrant acidity, gentle mineral tension and a supple, rounded texture. The finish is long and complex, revealing lingering orchard fruit, dried herbs and an elegant oxidative nuance. A captivating expression of Sancerre that combines natural winemaking, maturity and remarkable individuality.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted duck breast, herb-roasted chicken, slow-cooked pork belly, grilled seafood and rich mushroom dishes. Its generous texture and savoury complexity also complement creamy risotto, Moroccan vegetable tagine, spiced roasted cauliflower, aged Comté, Manchego and mature goat cheese. Particularly well suited to dishes featuring warm spices, roasted vegetables and rich cream-based sauces.

chateau-dissan-margaux-2016.title: Chateau Margaux 2016 750ml
chateau-dissan-margaux-2016.bodyHtml:
99 Points - James Suckling

It’s very friendly and warm on the nose showing flowers, such as roses, and red fruit. But then on the palate, it lets you know how serious it is. Full-bodied, yet reserved, extremely tight and well-formed with super polished tannins that go on for minutes. A solid and typical Margaux with all the personality and beauty in strength. Try after 2027.

99 Points - Wine Enthusiast

With a rare 94% Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend, this wine is packed both with black-currant flavors and impressive tannins and acidity. It moves Château Margaux into a new dimension with its dense, dry core of tannins that will power the wine into a seriously long-term future. Best after 2025. Cellar Selection

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2016 Château Margaux (blended of 94% Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Cabernet Franc, 2% Merlot and 1% Petit Verdot) sashays out of the glass with glamorous red currants, candied violets, kirsch and crushed blackcurrants scents followed by notions of tilled black soil, forest floor, cast iron pan and cigar box with subtle wafts of lavender and oolong tea. Medium-bodied, mineral laced accents hover over the palate with an ethereal sensation of weightlessness, yet it is super intense with layers of red and black flavors supported by a firm texture of silt-fine tannins, finishing wonderfully fragrant and incredibly long.

98 Points - Decanter

This is a serious Margaux, hugely Cabernet dominant on both nose and palate as you would expect with 94% of the blend. It has an extremely fine, elongated tannic structure, just barely there and so classy, focussing on the gentle elasticity. There are more blue than black fruits here, wonderfully spun out and softened with crushed tobacco. It has the expansive aromatic structure of Margaux, the floral and mineral aspects clear, as is the tension that lifts the palate up and out. It's reminiscent of the 2005, though with less evident tannins. It's not as hefty as the 2010 or as staggering as the 2015, but is still a joyful expression of the estate. 1% Petit Verdot completes the blend.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The grand vin 2016 Château Margaux is a beauty and tastes like the essence of Margaux. Thrilling notes of blueberries, cassis, crushed violets, flowery incense, and spice notes all give way to a full-bodied 2016 that strikes an incredible balance between richness and elegance. A blend of 94% Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Cabernet Franc, 2% Merlot and 1% Petit Verdot brought up in new barrels, it’s more focused and elegant than the 2015, yet I suspect it’s just as concentrated, and readers are going have a blast comparing these two magical vintages over the coming 4-5 decades.
Rating: 97+

97 Points - Wine Spectator
Beautifully rendered, with a lush and seamless flow of cassis, steeped cherry, warmed raspberry and gently mulled blackberry fruit flavors gliding through. Light lilac, savory, mesquite and mineral accents underline the finish, adding additional texture and length. Deep and long, with sublime definition and gorgeous fruit. Best from 2024 through 2040.

brunello-di-montalcino-1.title: Altesino Brunello di Montalcino 2021
brunello-di-montalcino-1.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Altesino Brunello di Montalcino is a vibrant and highly aromatic expression of a stellar vintage, noted for its exceptional freshness and "crunchy" fruit profile. It presents a bright ruby-red colour and opens with an ethereal bouquet of violets, lavender, and fresh red berries, seamlessly layered with sophisticated notes of tobacco, dark chocolate, and a hint of cedar. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and impeccably balanced, showcasing a silky texture supported by fine-grained tannins and a focused line of acidity. The finish is remarkably long and energetic, leaving persistent impressions of raspberry, savory herbs, and a refined mineral lift.

Food Pairing: Perfectly matches with roasted lamb, Bistecca alla Fiorentina, wild boar ragù over pappardelle, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

95 Points - James Suckling

A lively Brunello with aromas of plums, ripe cherries, cedar and teak that follow through to a medium body with fine tannins and a crisp finish. Crunchy and linear. Lovely energy at the end. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Altesino 2021 Brunello di Montalcino was a little shy when I tasted it, but knowing the track record of this estate, I have no doubt that the wine will flesh out with bottle age. Give it a year or two more. The bouquet offers blackcurrant and wild berry with a dark mineral note and grilled herb. Pressed violet also rises to the top of the wine, which is firmly structured and very lively in terms of mouthfeel. This popular release of 110,000 bottles ages in Slavonian oak casks only.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

The flavors of black cherry, blackberry and black currant are pure, with accents of violet, wild herbs and earth. This is smooth, picking up chalky tannins as the flavors build to the lengthy conclusion. Best from 2028 through 2045.

chianti-riserva-trecione.title: Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
chianti-riserva-trecione.bodyHtml:
Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 is an incredibly harmonious, traditional Tuscan red wine crafted with a core of Sangiovese. Following extensive maturation in a combination of Slavonian and French oak barrels, it reveals an elegant ruby hue alongside complex, expressive aromas of black cherries, wild blackberries, red plums, and violets, layered with hints of cedar, sweet vanilla, and earthy iron notes. The palate is full-bodied, dense, and beautifully framed by muscular, structured tannins and vibrant, balanced acidity, easing into a long, generous finish marked by warming spices.

Food Pairing: Pair this savory Riserva with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, rosemary-roasted lamb, wild boar ragù, or mature pecorino cheese.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This beefy red relies on its dense texture, concentrated flavors of black cherry and blackberry fruit, and muscular tannins to get its message across. Wild herb, iron and earth notes add depth, while the finish is long and spicy.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is savory and umami, with aromas of leather, graphite, underbrush, crushed rocks, bitter herbs and citrus swirling in the glass. Those earthy, bitter notes remain on the palate, but sweet cherries and wild strawberries pop overhead, while charged with powerful tannins and acid.

la-rioja-alta-finca-martelo-reserva.title: Torre De Ona Finca Martelo Reserva 2019
la-rioja-alta-finca-martelo-reserva.bodyHtml:
Intense ruby color, with a bright, clean pink rim. Powerful fruit on the nose with an initial surge of wild strawberries, raspberries and blackberries, opening up to delicate spicy, peppery notes, cedar wood, licorice and pastry. The palate is vibrant and elegant, expressing the terroir with freshness and intensity. Pleasant and long with a fleshy finish and hints of red fruit and spices.

With its structure and elegance, it is ideal with food. This is a wine that invites you to drink and is a good accompaniment to stewed and roasted meats, as well as game and cured charcuterie.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Finca Martelo comes from property planted with a blend of 95% Tempranillo and 5% Mazuelo, Garnacha and Viura at 630 meters in altitude that they only bottle in very good or excellent years. The 2019 was picked starting October 15th, and the destemmed grapes were put through optical sorting, a five-day cold soak and then fermented in stainless steel and went through malolactic in new French and American oak barrels. The élevage was in 80% American and 20% French oak barrels and lasted for two years, during which time it was racked four times. 2019 feels like a very complete harvest for Martelo; the wine is very harmonious and balanced, with power and freshness, intensity and persistence. The palate is surprisingly fresh, medium-bodied and fine-boned, clean and elegant.

93 Points - James Suckling

Scented and expressive nose with fresh cherries, plums, strawberries, stones, mussels and fine sweet spices. Fresh, juicy and medium-bodied on the palate with chalky tannins and a long, linear finish. 95% tempranillo and 5% mazuelo, garnacha and viura. Very drinkable.
91 Points - Wine Spectator
Toast and vanilla accents join flavors of cherry preserves and roasted plum, plus cured tobacco, mineral and spice hints. Chewy, well-integrated tannins work alongside the tang of orange peel acidity to structure this polished red.

harmand-geoffroy-gc-1er-la-perriere.title: Harmand-Geoffroy Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru 'LaPerriere' 2019 750ml
harmand-geoffroy-gc-1er-la-perriere.bodyHtml:
93+ points John Gilman (View From the Cellar): "The 2019 la Perrières from Monsieur Harmand is a lovely bottle in the making. The nose wafts from the glass in a complex blend of dark berries, cassis, smoked meats, a lovely foundation of black minerality, coffee bean, woodsmoke and new oak. On the palate the wine is pure, precise and full-bodied, with a beautifully plush attack, a fine core, lovely soil signature and a long, ripely tannic and very well-balanced finish. A fine, fine bottle in the making. 2033-2085. (Jan/Feb 2022)"

91 points/'Outstanding,' Allen Meadows (Burghound): "(30+ year old vines). Discreet wood influence sets off the spicier and riper aromas of earth-inflected black cherry fruit. The relatively rich and discreetly stony medium-bodied flavors possess good flesh, yet the mouthfeel is sleek and detailed on the persistent and complex finale that is a bit firmer if not as precise. Drink: 2031+. (Jan 2022)"

kosta-browne-mt-carmel-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Russian River Pinot Noir 2021
kosta-browne-mt-carmel-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Enchanting aromatics delight with pronounced blackberry and layers of ripe red cherry and raspberry. The palate is silky smooth with delicate tension and a remarkable finish.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Pinot Noir Russian River Valley was matured for 15 months in 34% new oak. It has a medium ruby color and generous aromatic layers of lavender, licorice, eucalyptus and forest floor with a core of dark fruit. The medium-bodied palate is powerful, its concentrated fruit complemented by well-integrated oak spice. It has abundant, grainy tannins, bursts of mouthwatering acidity and a very long, layered finish. Offer it another 2-3 years in bottle to unwind.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromatic with ripe fruits and black fruits as well as strawberries with some black tobacco and tea leaf. Full-bodied with a solid core of fruit. Dark chocolate and bark with mushroom undertones to the fruit at the finish. Tangy and zesty at the end. Why wait? Drink now.

fratelli-seghesio-la-villa-barolo-docg.title: Fratelli Seghesio Barolo La Villa 2016 750ml
fratelli-seghesio-la-villa-barolo-docg.bodyHtml:
Garnet red with orange reflections. nose: balsamic with notes of mint and licorice. Velvety tannins, with excellent finesse and elegance in taste persistence.

Pair with roast meat, game, aged cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A big, juicy red with plum, berry, cherry and hints of cedar character. It's full-bodied but remains agile and structured. Flavourful finish with chewy tannins.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Barolo la Villa is a more complete and elaborate wine than the classic Barolo, also released by Fratelli Seghesio. There is more depth here and less of that ripeness that I encountered in the other Barolo. This wine has more layers with dark fruit, licorice, iron ore and crushed limestone. These various aromatic elements come together with pretty harmony and focus. The finish is smooth and firmly structured, revealing an elegant and genuine personality. Fruit comes from the oldest vines in the Castelletto cru of Monforte d'Alba.

brunello-di-montalcino-amore-e-magia.title: La Magia Brunello di Montalcino 2020
brunello-di-montalcino-amore-e-magia.bodyHtml:
The colour is ruby red tending towards garnet, with typical red berry fruit opening out on the nose and in the mouth, mineral overtones, delicate spices, supported by generous acidity, restrained tannin and a long finish.

Direct and engaging is the sensory profile of a solid, centred Brunello. Red plums blend well with nuances of orange juice and pink grapefruit. Slightly opaque the background is reminiscent of black plums, blackberries, incense, wet geraniums, coriander and cumin. Full-bodied, savoury on the palate it shows structure and matter, biting tannins of considerable tension and a really sharp finish that will need time to unwind.

96 Points - James Suckling

Fine-textured, with integrated tannins that frame the wine nicely. It’s medium-bodied with juicy, dark fruit, as well as notes of bark, spice and walnut husk. Flavorful and intense, focused and polished. Drink in two or three years, but already impressive.

stolichnaya-premium-harvey-milk.title: Stoli Harvey Milk Vodka
stolichnaya-premium-harvey-milk.bodyHtml: Stoli Harvey Milk Limited Edition Vodka offers a refined and smooth tasting experience that's as vibrant as the rainbow itself. On the nose, delicate hints of citrus and floral notes intertwine, inviting you into a world of elegance and sophistication.

henri-rebourseau-gevrey-chamb-corvees.title: Henri Rebourseau Gevrey Chambertin Aux Corvees 2019 750ml
henri-rebourseau-gevrey-chamb-corvees.bodyHtml:
Gevrey-Chambertin Wine
Cote de Nuits, Burgundy
This small village is home to the Grands Crus in the farthest northerly stretches of Côte de Nuits and is famous for some of the deepest and firmest Burgundian Pinot Noir.

Gevrey boasts nine Grands Crus, the best of which are arguably Le Chambertin and Chambertin-Clos de Bèze. As with all of the fragmented vineyards of Burgundy, it isn’t easy to differentiate between the two, which are situated adjacent with Clos de Bèze slightly further up the hill than Le Chambertin. Clos de Bèze has a shallower soil and if you’re really counting, may produce wines less intense but more likely to charm. Some compare Le Chambertin in both power and plentitude only to the prized Romanée-Conti Grand Cru farther south in Vosne-Romanée.

Two other Grands Crus vineyards, Mazis-Chambertin (also written Mazy-) and Latricières-Chambertin command almost as much regard as Le Chambertin and Chambertin-Clos de Bèze. The upper part of Mazy, called Les Mazis Haut is the best and Latricières-Chambertin offers an abundance of juicy fruit and a silky texture in the warmer vintages.

Other Grands Crus are Ruchottes-Chambertin, Charmes-Chambertin, Mazoyères-Chambertin, Griotte-Chambertin and Chapelle-Chambertin.

The most respected Pinot Noir wines from Gevrey-Chambertin are robust and powerful but at the same time, velvety and expressive: black fruit, black liquorice and chocolate come into play. After some time in the bottle, the wines are harmonious with bright and sometimes candied fruit, and aromas of musk, truffle and forest floor. These have staying power.
Pinot Noir
Thin-skinned, finicky and temperamental, Pinot Noir is also one of the most rewarding grapes to grow and remains a labor of love for some of the greatest vignerons in Burgundy. Fairly adaptable but highly reflective of the environment in which it is grown, Pinot Noir prefers a cool climate and requires low yields to achieve high quality. Outside of France, outstanding examples come from in Oregon, California and throughout specific locations in wine-producing world. Somm Secret—André Tchelistcheff, California’s most influential post-Prohibition winemaker decidedly stayed away from the grape, claiming “God made Cabernet. The Devil made Pinot Noir.”

jane-eyre-bourgogne-blanc.title: Jane Eyre Santenay Blanc 2021 750ml
jane-eyre-bourgogne-blanc.bodyHtml:
Melbourne-born Jane Eyre-Renard, one of the pioneers of the growing micro-negotiant movement, has been based in Burgundy since 2003, paying her dues at some top domaines including de Montille and Comtes Lafon.

She currently makes her own wines in a facility in Bligny-le-Beaune, shared with, among others, Dominique Lafon. Her wines, whether from Beaune, Nuits, or Beaujolais, display her distinctive style - charming and inviting, with supple tannins and soft but bright fruits.

Gentle extraction and judicious use of new oak means these have been among the more immediately appealing Burgundies in our portfolio. The 2018 vintage however has clearly stamped its imprint over Jane’s wines as there is greater power, deeper fruit and gravitas allied to the usual charm and definition. Her decision to include 30% whole bunches (as opposed to none last year) has given the wines extra depth and complexity to balance the ripe fruit. Meanwhile her preference for early bottling, important in a vintage like 2018 to preserve freshness and prevent the fruit drying out, still means the range is pretty accessible, but it is definitely serious. Jane says “ultimately vintage and vineyard should trump your winemaking” but in 2018 all three elements have combined to create something rather special.

89-92 Points - Jasper Morris MW

"3 barrels, 1 new, from certified organic and biodynamic vines, 30% whole bunch. Gorgeous dense mid purple with classy fruit on the nose. Ripe certainly (13.5%) but very engaging, and with a welcome freshness at the back. I like the intensity and energy here."

92 Points - Tim Atkin MW, Decanter

"Australian Jane Eyre makes a small but increasingly well recognised range of Pinot Noirs as well as Down Under. This was picked at the end of August, but still quite a ripe, plush, palate-coating style, with 30% whole bunches and 25% new wood. The fruit is appealingly supple and is balanced by appealing acidity and zip."

jane-eyre-cote-du-jura.title: Jane Eyre Cote Du Jura 2018 750ml
jane-eyre-cote-du-jura.bodyHtml:
Jane Eyre grew up in Gippsland, Victoria, Australia. For 10 years, she cut hair in Melbourne, and one of her clients was the wife of Aussie wine critic Jeremy Oliver, which opened the door for her to go to work in Burgundy (she did vintage there in 1998). When she got back she met wine merchant Philip Rich and got a job at his Prince Wine Store. She started doing vintages at various wineries in Australia, New Zealand and Burgundy. Eventually she decided to move to Burgundy, which she did in 2004, and where she now works as a winemaker at Domaine Newman, as well as running her own micro-negociant operation (since 2011, she shares a winery with Dominique Lafon). These are lovely wines with a distinctive, nicely poised, lean house style. She doesn't over extract. 'You'll kill the beauty of Pinot by over-extracting it.'

This Côte du Jura is the most recent addition to Jane’s portfolio, the fruits comes from a biodynamically run vineyard in Arbois. The average age of the vines is 60 years. The wine has been made and aged in the Jura. It's been fermented and aged partly in stainless steel and in a 500L one-year-old oak barrel. Indigenous yeast and only sulphured lightly prior to bottling in February.

portia-prima-la-encina.title: Portia Prima La Encina 2018 750ml
portia-prima-la-encina.bodyHtml:
Formerly, this wine was not labeled as 'La Encina'

Critic tasting note: (2018 vintage) "A warm balsamic essence along with dark plum and berry scents push the nose on this Tinto Fino. Scrubbing tannins are out front on a healthy palate, while this pops with dark berry flavors and toasty oak. A steady finish shows power and youthful energy, so drink now or hold through 2030. Michael Schachner" - 92/100, Wine Enthusiast

jane-eyre-yarra-valley.title: Jane Eyre Cote Du Jura 2018 750ml
jane-eyre-yarra-valley.bodyHtml:
Jane Eyre grew up in Gippsland, Victoria, Australia. For 10 years, she cut hair in Melbourne, and one of her clients was the wife of Aussie wine critic Jeremy Oliver, which opened the door for her to go to work in Burgundy (she did vintage there in 1998). When she got back she met wine merchant Philip Rich and got a job at his Prince Wine Store. She started doing vintages at various wineries in Australia, New Zealand and Burgundy. Eventually she decided to move to Burgundy, which she did in 2004, and where she now works as a winemaker at Domaine Newman, as well as running her own micro-negociant operation (since 2011, she shares a winery with Dominique Lafon). These are lovely wines with a distinctive, nicely poised, lean house style. She doesn't over extract. 'You'll kill the beauty of Pinot by over-extracting it.'

This Côte du Jura is the most recent addition to Jane’s portfolio, the fruits comes from a biodynamically run vineyard in Arbois. The average age of the vines is 60 years. The wine has been made and aged in the Jura. It's been fermented and aged partly in stainless steel and in a 500L one-year-old oak barrel. Indigenous yeast and only sulphured lightly prior to bottling in February.

arnot-roberts-chard-sanford-benedict.title: Arnot-Roberts Sanford & Benedict Vineyard Chardonnay 2020 750ml
arnot-roberts-chard-sanford-benedict.bodyHtml:
The 'Sanford and Benedict' vineyard in California's Sta Rita Hills AVA winemaking region is home to some of the state's oldest and most prestigious Chardonnay vines.

This wine comes from vines planted in 1971, cultivated organically with a gentle touch. There's a minerality that comes through in the wine, tapping into the limestone and quartz soil beneath the hills.

An exceptional wine with balanced winemaking and gentle use of oak. California's answer to Grand Cru Burgundy.

95 Points - Vinous

"The 2020 Chardonnay Sanford & Benedict captures all the magic of this iconic Sta. Rita Hills site. Ample, creamy and inviting, the 2020 is beautifully textured from start to finish. Apricot, lemon confit, white flowers, mint and marzipan build as the 2020 opens with a bit of air. Arnot-Roberts pulls fruit from the old-vine section of S&B, which was planted in 1971 with own-rooted vines." - Antonio Galloni (Vinous)

dom-de-lenclos-chablis-1er-mont-de-mili.title: Courtault Michelet Chablis 1er Cru Mont de Milieu 2023
dom-de-lenclos-chablis-1er-mont-de-mili.bodyHtml:
Sourced from the south-facing Mont de Milieu Premier Cru vineyard, this Chardonnay offers vibrant citrus, white orchard fruit and classic Chablis minerality. Bright acidity and refined structure are complemented by subtle complexity, leading to a long, elegant finish with excellent ageing potential.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with lobster, sole meuniere, turbot, roast chicken, veal and creamy seafood dishes.

lucien-muzard-les-cras-vielles-vignes.title: Lucien Muzard & Fils Pommard LesCras 2022 750ml
lucien-muzard-les-cras-vielles-vignes.bodyHtml:
From vines planted in 1922, from a relatively low-lying vineyard towards the border with Volnay. Les Cras comes from the word ‘craie’ which translates as lime. Low yielding from a parcel of less than 0.5ha.
90-92 4 Stars Jasper Morris, Inside Burgundy: "Old vines, around 80 years, with 50% whole bunch vinification. Deep dense concentrated purple. The bouquet is excellent, very deep, all about the fruit. Just a few strawberries but the raspberry dominates. Perhaps some deep red cherry too. Very complete on the palate, a little peppery crunch, well managed tannins and very good length." Tasted: October 2021

elaboraciones-ancestrales-tinto.title: Vinatigo Elaboraciones Ancestrales Tinto 2018 750ml
elaboraciones-ancestrales-tinto.bodyHtml:
Nose: Intense aromas of ripe red fruits, such as cherries and raspberries, with hints of floral notes and a touch of spice.

Taste: Rich and velvety on the palate, with flavors of blackberries, plums, and a subtle earthiness. Well-balanced acidity and smooth tannins.

Palate: Medium-bodied with a long, lingering finish. Delicate hints of vanilla and oak add complexity to the wine.

elaboraciones-ancestrales-blanco.title: Vinatigo Elaboraciones Ancestrales Blanco Islas Canarias 2020 750ml
elaboraciones-ancestrales-blanco.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Vinatigo Elaboraciones Ancestrales Blanco is a white/orange wine from Bodegas Viñátigo in La Guancha, Tenerife, Canary Islands: 
Color: Intense golden yellow with orange hues 
Aroma: Aromas of white flowers, orange blossom, undergrowth, and mineral limestone notes 
Taste: Deliciously acidic on the palate, with a long finish and a final tannic tip 
Alcohol content: 13.5% ABV 
Allergens: Contains sulfites 
The wine is made from ungrafted Gual vines planted in small plots in the north-west of Tenerife, overlooking the ocean. It's described as having a textured, rich, and complex palate, with juicy fruit and herbal nuances, fresh acidity, and a great salty finish.

rene-rostaing-la-viallere.title: Domaine Rostaing Cote-Rotie La Viallere 2020 750ml
rene-rostaing-la-viallere.bodyHtml: While this vineyard suffered immensely from frost in the spring of 2021, the 2020 Cote Rotie la Viaillere looks amazing. Marked by vibrant, intense notes of purple raspberries and violets, this is full-bodied, rich and velvety, with wonderfully fine tannins and a nearly never-ending finish. While La Viallière is not my favorite lieu-dit, this is truly special.

michel-mallard-ladoix-1er-la-corvee.title: Domaine Michel Mallard Ladoix 1er Cru La Corvee 2019 750ml
michel-mallard-ladoix-1er-la-corvee.bodyHtml:
The Ladoix 1er Cru La Corvée is located in Ladoix-Serrigny and has a southeastern mid-slope exposure. The term La Corvée refers to the medieval politico-economic system which lasted until 4 August, 1789. This term refers to the unpaid work imposed by a lord or master on his dependents; it was a form a non-monetary tax. Under this feudal system, serfs and people that were free but too poor were liable to the corvée, i.e. they were indentured servants. 

Age of vines: Between 50 and 60 years. This Ladoix 1er Cru La Corvée, is designed to be kept for many years, it is aged 15 months in 50% new wood casks (228L Burgundian tuns).

"The 2021 Ladoix 1er Cru La Corvée is a highlight of the range this year, bursting with aromas of sweet red berries and peonies. Medium to full-bodied, satiny and pure, with a fleshy core of fruit, racy acids and melting tannins, it's a bright, charming wine from Mallard." - 92 Points, Wine Advocate

michel-mallard-ladoix-le-clos-royer-blan.title: Domaine Michel Mallard Ladoix Le Clos Royer 2019 750ml
michel-mallard-ladoix-le-clos-royer-blan.bodyHtml:
Domaine Michel Mallard Ladoix Le Clos Royer Blanc 2019
This cuvée has 35% new oak in the shape of new 350-liter barrels. They give a nice – but not dominant – oak impression. The bouquet has a citrus entry moving over to peach, quince, and pear; exotic without being extrovertedly sweet or overly ripe

zenato-alberto-delectus-rosso-veneto-igt.title: Zenato Alberto Rosso del Veneto 2017 750ml
zenato-alberto-delectus-rosso-veneto-igt.bodyHtml:
A project born in 1997 when Alberto Zenato turned 30 years old. On that day he thought about creating a wine by making his own selection of grapes.

Since then, every ten years, Alberto Zenato chooses the best blend of grapes to express a territory of excellence to which he belongs to and to which he feels an ambassador to the world.

A Rosso del Veneto IGT, made from indigenous Corvina Veronese grapes grown in the Costalunga estate in Valpolicella Classica and from Merlot grapes an international variety, grown in the morainic hills of Lake Garda, where the family and the winery have their roots.

The grapes undergo a partial appassimento and the wine ages for two years in oak barrels. A distinctive an important wine of great structure, body, balance, fineness and elegance.

luneau-papin-terre-de-pierre-2008.title: Pierre Luneau-Papin Terre De Pierre 2008 750ml
luneau-papin-terre-de-pierre-2008.bodyHtml:
Domaine Pierre Luneau-Papin Terre de Pierre is a beautiful dry white wine made from the Melon de Bourgogne grape, grown in the Loire Valley of France. The wine has a pale and golden yellow color with hints of green on the rim. On the palate, it exudes refreshing flavors of green apple, lemon zest, fresh-cut hay, and mineral notes. This wine has a vibrant acidity and a saline finish, making it the perfect midday aperitif wine or an ideal partner to seafood dishes. With its elegant taste and impressive complexity, Domaine Pierre Luneau-Papin Terre de Pierre is the perfect wine companion for those who love to explore the world of wine with their senses.

Tasting Notes
Everything that is done in the vineyard (tilling the soil, picking by hand) and the cellar is designed to produce a top-quality wine that reflects the unique terroir and character of the Serpentinite. The pure minerality of this wine is a true expression of its terroir.

bouchard-pere-hautes-cotes-de-beaune.title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Beaune du Chateau Premier Cru Rouge 2021
bouchard-pere-hautes-cotes-de-beaune.bodyHtml:
Bouchard Père & Fils Beaune du Château Premier Cru Rouge 2021 is a classic expression of the Beaune appellation in Burgundy's Côte de Beaune. Crafted from a selection of seventeen Premier Cru parcels vinified separately and blended together, this 100% Pinot Noir showcases an inviting dark ruby-garnet hue. On the nose, it reveals vibrant aromas of redcurrants, raspberries, and wild cranberries, accented by subtle floral notes of peony, sage, dried herbs, and a touch of warm earth and oak spice. The palate is medium-bodied, harmonious, and refined, supported by fine-grained, well-structured tannins, refreshing acidity, and a savory, mineral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exce. duck breast, roasted game birds, pan-seared beef tenderloin, mushroom risotto, and aged Comté cheese.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Bursting with aromas of raspberries, sweet spices and deep soil tones, the 2021 Beaune 1er Cru du Château is medium-bodied, ample and charming, with lively acids, melting tannins and a saline finish. This high-quality, comparatively accessible bottling is always reliable, though I confess I'd love to see some of the great parcels that go into it as standalone cuvées.

90 Points - James Suckling

An intense sage aroma is married to bright red berry fruit - redcurrant, raspberry and cranberry - plus a healthy dose of well-crafted tannins on the medium-bodied palate. Good length with some interesting savory character at the finish. Just about drinkable now, but a bit more time in bottle would help. Drinkable now, but best from 2025.

le-chiuse-rosso-di-montalcino.title: Le Chiuse Rosso Di Montalcino 2021 750ml
le-chiuse-rosso-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
The wine-making process for this red wine is the same as the Brunello, the grapes and type of vines used are again of 100% large Sangiovese, but without the need of ageing. It has a shining, clear appearance and is ruby red in color. It has a good fragrance and intensity with the recognizable scent of small fresh fruits. To the taste, the wine is dry with a good persistence. It is ready to drink, even if kept for some time.
Wine Enthusiast
  • we93

Ripe berry, violet and baking spice aromas emerge from the glass along with a whiff of mint. Elegant and savory, the bright, polished palate features juicy red cherry, raspberry compote and star anise accompanied by taut, refined tannins and tangy acidity. It has great youthful tension and can be enjoyed now or over the next several years. Drink through 2028.

Kerin O'Keefe, July 1, 2022
Vinous
  • v90

A smoky mix of wild herbs, crushed rocks, young strawberries and rose petals wafts up from the 2020 Rosso di Montalcino. It's seamlessly silky with nuances of candied citrus and bright cherry fruits that light up the palate, as exotic inner florals amass toward the close. The 2020 maintains energy throughout, finishing remarkably fresh yet also potent and long. This is one of the most elegant vintages I've yet experienced from the Le Chiuse Rosso, but watch out for its 14.5% abv. that can easily sneak up on you.

Eric Guido, October 2022
Wine Advocate
  • wa90

Made with certified-organic fruit, the Le Chiuse 2020 Rosso di Montalcino is bright and punchy, showing energy and electricity along the way. There are some terrific Rossos on the market now, and this streamlined, elegant style is exactly what you what from this entry-level wine. Cassis and sour cherry merge with lilac and spring violets.

Monica Larner, February 17, 2022
Wine Spectator
  • ws90

A bright, spicy red, revealing cherry, raspberry, floral and mineral aromas and flavors. Sleek and elegant, with a firm backbone and an excellent finish. Drink now through 2026.

Bruce Sanderson, October 31, 2022

jb-boudier-ezconnardises-savlesbeaune.title: Domaine Jean-Baptiste Boudier Ez Connardises Savigny-Les-Beaune 2018 750ml
jb-boudier-ezconnardises-savlesbeaune.bodyHtml: Beautifully fragrant. Showing more florals and red fruits without the underlying darker fruit profile of the previous 2 wines. That being said the red fruits are perfectly ripe and showing beautiful detail and moreish ripe characters. The palate is vibrant with nice weight. Cherry dominant with pleasing round, ripe tannins yet not heavy. Long cherry with a pleasing, slightly bitter amaro cherry. - Jono Hersey, FWC

jb-boudier-pernand-verg-1er-sousfretille.title: Domaine Jean-Baptiste Boudier Pernand-Vergelesses 1er Cru 'Sous Fretille' 2019
jb-boudier-pernand-verg-1er-sousfretille.bodyHtml:
Domaine Jean-Baptiste Boudier Pernand-Vergelesses 1er Cru 'Sous Frétille' 2019 is an exquisite, refined white Burgundy sourced from a prestigious Premier Cru climat situated high on the hill of Corton. It reveals lifted aromas of crisp green apple, lemon zest, white flowers, crushed limestone, and toasted hazelnut. On the palate, it exhibits precise tension, fine concentration, and vibrant, electric acidity, delivering a beautifully structured texture and a long, lingering, saline-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with pan-seared sea scallops, butter-poached lobster, roasted poultry with cream sauce, grilled turbot, or aged Comté cheese.

tenuta-la-fuga-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Tenuta Di Sesta Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2019
tenuta-la-fuga-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Tenuta Di Sesta Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2019 is an exceptional, elegant, and deeply complex Tuscan red wine crafted exclusively from 100% Sangiovese grown in the southern region of Montalcino. Visually featuring a vibrant ruby-red hue turning toward garnet with age, it opens with an intense, ethereal bouquet of ripe wild strawberries, red cherries, and dried plum, intricately layered with spicy notes of licorice, tobacco leaf, forest floor, and crushed-stone minerality. On the palate, it exhibits full-bodied richness and remarkable structure, balanced by lively natural acidity and velvety, finely integrated tannins that lead to a dry, persistent, and beautifully harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with roasted red meats, braised venison, wild boar ragù, Florentina steak, truffle pasta dishes, and mature aged pecorino cheeses.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is layered, with herbaceous spice, saline warmth and fruit aromas of cherries and strawberries. Juicy, plump, ripe berries swell on the palate and are joined by flavors of chocolate and orange, creating a warm, textured, comforting sensation.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Tenuta di Sesta 2019 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Duelecci Ovest shows black fruit ripeness, thick concentration and a soft, gritty texture. To the nose, it delivers perfumed wood or Swedish sauna, cedar, toasted spice and tobacco. I'm not going to suggest a very long drinking window for this 5,000-bottle release. The emphasis here is on fruit concentration instead of age-worthy qualities like finesse and freshness.

xavier-vins-arcane-le-soleil.title: Xavier Vignon Arcane XIX Le Soleil Cotes Du Rhone Villages 2015 750ml
xavier-vins-arcane-le-soleil.bodyHtml:
Deep and dense ruby-purple. Alluring wild strawberry, raspberry, black cherry, garrigue, warm stones, salvia, and pink peppercorn aromas rush energetically from the glass. Full-bodied and full of vibrant red fruit and wild herbal flavors. Supple, satiny tannins frame the palate, building to a rich, lasting finish. Dense, beautiful, and full of Grenache classically augmented by touches of spice and added richness from the Syrah and Mourvèdre.

94 pts
Wine Advocate
The 2015 Cotes du Rhone Villages Arcane XIX Le Soleil is youthfully dark in color and fruit-forward, but it also shows softening, silky tannins. It's full bodied but not overblown, with a sensationally seductive mouthfeel. Black cherries define the fruit, joined by hints of dark chocolate and enough garrigue to give it a seriously savory character despite the fruit. This is an old-vine blend of 80% Grenache with 10% each Syrah and Mourvèdre, aged 15 months in one-third new oak, the rest in concrete or foudre. Maybe the best Côte du Rhône Villages I've ever tasted, it looks to have the stuffing to go another 10 years.


93+ pts
Jeb Dunnuck
Coming from 100-year-old Grenache vines (there’s 10% each of Syrah and Mourvèdre in the blend) mostly in the northern part of the Southern Rhône, the 2015 Côtes du Rhône Villages Arcane le Soleil saw 15 months in one-third each of new barrels, concrete tanks, and stainless-steel tanks. This inky colored beauty offers a terrific perfume of blueberries, scorched earth, graphite, and crushed violets. Deep, full-bodied, incredibly pure, and elegant, with silky tannin, it’s a sensational Côtes du Rhône that’s better than most Chateauneuf du Pape in the vintage. It will be better in another year or two and keep for 8-10 years.

xavier-vins-arcane-l-hermite.title: Xavier Vignon Arcane IX 'L'Hermite' 2016
xavier-vins-arcane-l-hermite.bodyHtml:
Xavier Vignon Arcane IX 'L'Hermite' 2016 is a complex and deeply expressive Southern Rhône red wine crafted from old vines in Gigondas. Winemaker Xavier Vignon utilized an innovative double-aging method—submerging selected wine barrels directly inside wine-filled tanks—resulting in exceptional plushness and structural refinement. In the glass, it reveals an intense ruby-purple hue with a bouquet of black cherry compote, stewed raspberries, garrigue herbs, graphite, dark chocolate, and exotic spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied, supple, and rich, featuring velvety tannins, vibrant mineral acidity, and an extraordinarily long, spiced finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with slow-cooked beef daube, roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, wild boar ragù, venison steaks, or aged semi-firm cheeses.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Gigondas Arcane VIII L’Hermite likely won’t be released for three to four years, said Vignon (it’s already bottled). It is linear, tight and crisply focused, so no doubt he’s right about when it will be approachable. Cedar frames bright cherry fruit in this medium to full-bodied GSM blend.

anciano-no-5-rioja-crianza.title: Anciano No.5 Crianza 2021
anciano-no-5-rioja-crianza.bodyHtml:
Anciano Rioja Crianza comes from leading producer Criadores de Rioja located near Logroño, at the heart of Rioja Alta. The winery belongs to a family with one of the longest traditions in Rioja winemaking and our winemaker has access to some of the finest wines

Elegant, complex, well-structured, fresh and fruity. Classic Rioja style which is enjoyed in the many tapas bars of Logroño. Aromas of red fruits and vanilla with subtle hints of licorice and toffee. Silky and persistent finish with a touch of spice. Suitable for vegetarians and vegans.

Versatile with all kinds of Mediterranean dishes such as pasta, rice, white meat, pulses and barbecues.

anciano-no-7-rioja-reserva.title: Anciano No.7 Reserva
anciano-no-7-rioja-reserva.bodyHtml:
Anciano No. 7 Reserva is a highly approachable, smooth, and well-matured Spanish red wine that elegantly showcases the traditional character of Rioja. Sourced from mature Tempranillo vineyards in Rioja Alta, it is aged in American oak barrels followed by further bottle maturation to develop its signature mellow profile. It displays a bright cherry-red color with a thin terracotta rim. The nose offers complex aromas of ripe black cherries, plums, and balsamic notes, complemented by sweet toffee, vanilla, and warm wood spices. On the palate, the wine is dry and medium-bodied, exhibiting silky tannins, balanced acidity, and a smooth, savory finish.

Food Pairing:

Pairs beautifully with grilled red meats, slow-cooked beef stews, pork sausages, roasted lamb chops, or a rustic platter of medium-aged cheeses.

elodie-roy-bourgogne-hcdb.title: Domaine Elodie Roy Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Beaune Pinot Noir 2021
elodie-roy-bourgogne-hcdb.bodyHtml:
Domaine Elodie Roy Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Beaune 2021 is an elegant and expressive Pinot Noir from the celebrated Côte de Beaune in Burgundy, France. Crafted by talented winemaker Elodie Roy, who took over her family's vineyards in 2018 after gaining extensive experience at Domaine Anne Gros, this refined red wine reflects the freshness and distinctive character of Burgundy's elevated vineyard sites. Produced entirely from Pinot Noir grown on clay-limestone soils, the 2021 vintage showcases a beautiful balance of vibrant fruit, lively acidity and supple tannins. Its inviting purple-red colour introduces delicate aromas of fresh raspberries, ripe cherries and subtle woodland nuances. The palate is medium-bodied, generous and beautifully textured, revealing juicy red berry flavours supported by refreshing acidity and soft, integrated tannins. Graceful, approachable and wonderfully balanced, this charming Burgundy finishes with lingering red fruit and a clean, elegant freshness. Domaine Elodie Roy Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Beaune 2021 is an excellent expression of the region's classic Pinot Noir character.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted duck breast, herb-crusted lamb, grilled pork tenderloin, beef bourguignon, roasted chicken and mushroom risotto. Its bright acidity and delicate red fruit character also complement charcuterie, pâté, grilled salmon, roasted mushrooms, Brie, Camembert and aged Comté cheese.

elodie-roy-maranges-la-rue-des-pierres.title: Domaine Elodie Roy La Rue Des Pierres Maranges 2020 750ml
elodie-roy-maranges-la-rue-des-pierres.bodyHtml: 'La rue des Pierres' Maranges from Domaine Elodie Roy is a red Burgundy wine of great elegance. It offers fruity, floral and spicy scents on the nose, for a mouth-watering and refined sip with a mineral note.

elodie-roy-maranges-le-goty.title: Domaine Elodie Roy Maranges Le Goty 2021
elodie-roy-maranges-le-goty.bodyHtml:
Domaine Elodie Roy Maranges Le Goty 2021 is an elegant Pinot Noir with aromas of black cherry, wild raspberry, violet, and gentle earthy spice. Fine-grained tannins, vibrant acidity, and subtle mineral notes create a refined, balanced palate with impressive depth and a lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast duck, herb-crusted pork, grilled lamb, mushroom risotto, roasted poultry, or Brie and Comté cheeses for an excellent match.

domaine-elodie-roy-santenay-les-gravier.title: Domaine Elodie Roy Santenay 1er Cru Les Gravieres 2020
domaine-elodie-roy-santenay-les-gravier.bodyHtml:
Domaine Elodie Roy Santenay 1er Cru Les Gravières 2020 is an elegant red Burgundy from the prestigious Les Gravières Premier Cru vineyard in Santenay, Côte de Beaune. Produced from 100% Pinot Noir, this expressive wine reflects the concentration and ripeness of the 2020 vintage. Matured in French oak barrels, it combines aromas of dark plum, cassis, and warm spice with a rich, beautifully structured palate. Smooth tannins, lively acidity, and subtle oak influence provide balance, while the limestone-rich vineyard contributes finesse and complexity. Bottled at 14% ABV, it offers depth without sacrificing Burgundy's characteristic elegance.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, braised beef, veal with mushrooms, herb-roasted lamb, wild mushroom risotto, aged Comté, and roasted poultry.

elodie-roy-maranges-en-buliet.title: Domaine Elodie Roy Maranges En Buliet 2021 750ml
elodie-roy-maranges-en-buliet.bodyHtml: Domaine Elodie Roy's En Buliet Maranges 2020 is a 750ml bottle of Burgundy made from Pinot Noir grapes grown in the Maranges appellation. This full-bodied red offers notes of juicy blackberry, mulberry, and graphite, with a hint of toasty oak on the finish. Enjoy now or cellar for up to 20 years.

orofino-beleza.title: Orofino Beleza 2018
orofino-beleza.bodyHtml:
Orofino Beleza 2018 is a signature Bordeaux-style red blend produced from Cawston Bench vineyards in British Columbia's Similkameen Valley. Sourced from slate and limestone-rich soils, it undergoes 18 months of barrel maturation in French and American oak. In the glass, it shows a deep ruby hue with expressive aromas of black cherry, dark plum, mint, crushed gravel, and baking spices. On the palate, it delivers concentrated dark berry flavors, balanced acidity, and finely structured tannins that carry through to a long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, duck breast, and aged hard cheeses.

fleur-rose.title: Les Fleurs du Mal Cevennes Rose 2015
fleur-rose.bodyHtml:
Les Fleurs du Mal Cevennes Rose is a French rose from the mountainous Cevennes region in southern France. This dry, approachable wine offers bright berry fruit, red cherry, strawberry, citrus and floral notes. Its fresh profile and balanced character make it a versatile choice for lighter dishes.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with chicken tagine, grilled fish and roasted vegetables.

chateau-du-tertre.title: Chateau Du Tertre 2023
chateau-du-tertre.bodyHtml:
Château Du Tertre 2023 is an exceptionally refined, elegant red wine from the historic Fifth Growth estate in the Margaux appellation. Featuring an increased proportion of Cabernet Sauvignon from newly maturing replanted plots, it reveals an inviting nose of dark berries, wild cassis, black tea, violet, and subtle cedar spice. On the palate, it exhibits a supple, medium-bodied structure with velvety, powdery tannins, vibrant acidity, and a seamless finish marked by notes of licorice, dark fruit, and graphite minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, grilled duck breast, venison, wild mushroom risotto, and aged hard cheeses.

95 Points - James Suckling

Lovely fruit, with blackberry, dark chocolate, walnut and meat aromas and flavors. Medium-bodied with a solid core of fruit, creamy tannins and just a hint of chocolate. 70% cabernet sauvignon, 15% merlot, 11% cabernet franc and 4% petit verdot. Needs three or four years of bottle age. Drink after 2028.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Château du Tertre has turned out beautifully, revealing aromas of cassis, dark wild berries, rose petals and fresh licorice, accented by refined spice. Medium- to full-bodied, it is round and sapid, layered and deep, built around a fleshy core of fruit framed by velvety, powdery tannins and a gently sweet profile. This blend of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Cabernet Franc, 11% Merlot and 4% Petit Verdot is a sleeper of the vintage.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A flattering red, with a caressing feel to its red and black cherry compote notes, while violet and iris add range. Judicious toast lets smoldering alder and savory flecks peek in gently on the finish. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2032.

chateau-la-croix-canon-2016.title: Chateau Canon 'Croix Canon' 2016
chateau-la-croix-canon-2016.bodyHtml:
Château Canon 'Croix Canon' 2016 is a highly refined, vibrant, and elegant Right Bank Bordeaux red wine, serving as the official second wine of the renowned Premier Grand Cru Classé estate Château Canon. Visually displaying a deep ruby-purple hue with shaded garnet reflections, it opens with an alluringly complex and delicate bouquet of fresh black currant, wild blueberry, and dark plum, interwoven with subtle notes of sliced mushroom, graphite minerality, violet florality, and cedary oak. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body characterized by a juicy, pure fruit core, remarkable tensile freshness, and fine-grained, chalky tannins that reflect its limestone plateau terroir, leading into a long, silky, and harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, prime ribeye steak, duck breast, braised beef short ribs, wild mushroom risotto, and aged hard cheeses.

93 Points - James Suckling

A juicy richness to the fruit with dark-berry and sliced-mushroom character on the nose and palate. Full body, chewy tannins and a flavorful finish. Very structured. Try from 2023.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Croix Canon is a blend of 76% Merlot and 24% Cabernet Franc this year and matured in 25% new oak. It has a very precise bouquet with blackcurrant, touches of blueberry and subtle mineral aromas, gaining intensity as it opens in the glass. The palate is medium-bodied with crisp tannin, very tensile in the mouth with touches of graphite and tobacco, seguing into a supple and refined finish. It seems very approachable at this stage, but even as a Deuxième Vin, I can see this aging nicely over a decade, possibly more.

perticaia-sagrantino.title: Perticaia Montefalco Sagrantino 2015
perticaia-sagrantino.bodyHtml:
Perticaia Montefalco Sagrantino 2015 is an intense, full-bodied, and beautifully structured red wine produced by Società Agricola Perticaia in the heart of Umbria. Crafted exclusively from 100% Sagrantino grapes, it undergoes a lengthy maceration followed by 24 to 36 months of aging in large oak casks and French barriques, along with additional bottle maturation before release. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby-garnet color. The aromatic profile is complex and expressive, offering notes of ripe blackberry, baked cherry, plum, crushed terracotta, leather, and sweet baking spices. On the palate, it delivers dense dark fruit flavors framed by power, firm wood tannins, and vibrant natural acidity that leads to a long, persistent, spice-accented finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with roasted meats, braised beef, game ravioli, wild boar ragù, and aged hard cheeses like Grana Padano.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackberries and crushed terra cotta follow through to a full body with chewy tannins that are slightly austere, yet show verve and intensity. Very typical for the appellation. Needs roasted meat immediately. Drink or hold.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

From a hot, sunny vintage, the 2015 Montefalco Sagrantino shows bacon fat and lots of plump dark fruit with notes of savory spice and tobacco. Having spent 24 months in barrique, the tannins are dry and integrated, but you never really get rid of that Sagrantino astringency. There is some black pepper on the close. Some 28,000 bottles were made.

dry-red-no3.title: Yarra Yering Dry Red No. 3 2019 750ml
dry-red-no3.bodyHtml:
Boysenberry and cardamom spices, mocha and charcuterie complexity. Bright blackcurrant fruit and licorice spice of Touriga Naçional, the Tinta Cão brings bright and fragrant blue fruit energy. Tinta Roriz brings a savoury depth to the palate to compliment the Tinta Amarela’s floral and bay leaf herbal lift. To tie everything together the finesse of Alvarelhão and the acidity of the Sousão tightens and drives the long palate. Wonderfully complex and yet medium bodied.

95 Points – James Halliday
This blend of Portuguese varieties has come together seamlessly and offers immediate drinking appeal. Heady with violets and lavender, blackcurrants and Szechuan pepper, blackstrap licorice and Mediterranean herbs, all adding to its youthful beauty. Fine tannins, raspberry-like acidity and complexity raise it way above ordinary. – Jane Faulkner, 2022 Halliday Wine Companion.

yarra-yering-pinot-noir.title: Yarra Yering Pinot Noir 2019 750ml
yarra-yering-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The grapes were hand-picked and chilled overnight. Processing the following day along a fruit sorting table and destemmed gently into our signature small fermenters. Some whole bunches were used to contribute subtle stalk structure and a generous fruit profile. Working of the ferment by gentle hand plunging twice daily contributes to the soft fruit palate along with gentle pressing. Maturation for 10 months in all French barrels with 30% new and the balance older oak.

Lilac perfumed nose, cherry fruits with a pinch of aniseed spice. Black cherry fruits dominate the palate and a pinch of Chinese five spice. A silky elegance combined with a defined tannin structure, both grape and oak tannin to produce a medium-bodied yet powerful style. A Pinot noir that will reward cellaring.

veronica-ortega-cal.title: Veronica Ortega VO CAL 2020 750ml
veronica-ortega-cal.bodyHtml:
An aromatic and fragrant wine

Bierzo, with a low interventionist vinification process. This white wine has been crafted with the personality, freshness and elegance of the native Godello grape variety. It is perfect to accompany grilled seafood, smoked fish, fish rice dishes, cod and baked fish in general.

anna-de-codorniu-reserva-cava.title: Anna De Codorniu Cava Brut Blanc De Blancs
anna-de-codorniu-reserva-cava.bodyHtml:
Anna de Codorníu Cava Brut Blanc de Blancs is an elegant Spanish sparkling wine produced by the historic Codorníu winery in Catalonia's Penedès region. Crafted from Chardonnay alongside traditional Cava grape varieties, this refreshing expression combines bright citrus and tropical fruit with delicate notes of toasted brioche. Extended aging on the lees contributes fine, persistent bubbles and a smooth, creamy texture. Bottled at 11.5% ABV, it offers a harmonious balance of freshness, subtle complexity, and crisp acidity, making it ideal for celebrations, entertaining, or enjoying as an aperitif.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, grilled shrimp, sushi, seafood paella, Spanish tapas, roasted chicken, soft cheeses, and lightly seasoned vegetable dishes.

bauquiere-moment-singulier-rose.title: La Grande Bauquiere Moment Suspendu Cotes De Provence Rose 2021 750ml
bauquiere-moment-singulier-rose.bodyHtml: DOMAINE LA GRANDE BAUQUIÈRE 'Moment Suspendu' - Côtes de Provence Rosé - France. Beautiful pale peach color. Subtle aromatic expression, Subtle aromatic expression, raising its sharpness on at the same time floral notes, rose water and from fruits to white flesh associated to a touch of citrus fruit.

tate-jacks-vineyard-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Tate Spring Street Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
tate-jacks-vineyard-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Tate Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley St. Helena Spring Street Wolf Family Vineyard 2022 is an expressive, impeccably balanced, and finely crafted single-vineyard red wine produced by winemaker David Tate. Sourced entirely from the historic Wolf Family Vineyard on the valley floor in St. Helena, the fruit benefits from well-draining benchland alluvial soils and warm Napa Valley sun exposure tempered by cool afternoon breezes. In the glass, it displays a medium-to-deep ruby core with bright purple tinges. The bouquet is complex and layered, opening with aromas of ripe blackberries, cassis, and dark plums intertwined with crushed violets, dried herbs, pencil shavings, cedar wood, and fine French oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full body marked by pure, focused dark fruit, velvety and fine-grained tannins, balanced natural acidity, and a seamless, lingering finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, braised short ribs, venison loin, or aged sharp cheddar cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackberries, cassis, plums, red currants, violets, cedar and licorice. The palate is full-bodied with finely integrated tannins and balanced acidity. Balanced, fresh and savory, with a persistent finish.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon Spring Street Wolf Family Vineyard is gently herbal, with cedary overtones to the blackberry and cassis fruit. Medium to full-bodied, this juicy, fruit-forward wine is supple, flattering and easy to drink.

cartuxa-pera-manca-tinto.title: Cartuxa Pera-Manca Tinto
cartuxa-pera-manca-tinto.bodyHtml:
Alentejo Wine
Portugal
Responsible for a majority of Portugal’s fine wine production—and over half of the world’s cork production—Alentejo represents a major force in Portugal’s wine industry. This southern Portugese region is characterized by stretches of rolling plains and vineyards dotted with majestic cork oaks. Access to land enables the farmers of Alentejo to produce wines in great economies of scale, without compromising quality, compared to those regions to the north. The region of Alentejo indeed covers a third of the country.

Its classified (DOP) wines must come from one of eight subregions, where elevations are a bit higher, air cooler and less fertile soils are perfect for vines. The optimal regions are Portalegre, Borba, Redondo, Reguengos de Monsaraz, Granja-Amareleja, Vidigueira, Evora and Moura. Alentejo is not without the conveniences of modern winemaking as well. Irrigation supplements low rainfall and temperature control in the winery assures high quality wines.

The potential of the area has attracted many producers and its wine production continues to grow. Alentejo’s charming, fruit-forward wines have naturally led to local and global popularity.

White wines tend to be blends of Antão Vaz, Roupeiro and Arinto. However, in growing proportions, the white grapes Verdelho, Alvarinho and Viognier have been enjoying success. But red varieties actually exceed whites in Alentejo. Aragonez, Trincadeira, Alicante Bouschet and Castelão grapes blend well together and are responsible for most of the Alentejo reds.

tinta-pesquera-crianza.title: Tinto Pesquera Crianza 2019
tinta-pesquera-crianza.bodyHtml:
Tinto Pesquera Crianza 2019 is a richly structured Spanish red wine from the renowned Ribera del Duero region of Castilla y León. Produced by Familia Fernández Rivera from 100% Tempranillo grapes, this 2019 vintage combines ripe fruit concentration with the complexity of oak maturation. Aged for approximately 18 months in oak barrels, it offers expressive aromas of black cherry, raspberry, blackberry, and toasted spice. The palate is generous and silky, with well-integrated tannins, refreshing acidity, and notes of vanilla, espresso, and dark fruit. Bottled at 14.5% ABV, it delivers a harmonious balance of richness, structure, and elegance.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, Iberian ham, braised beef, pork tenderloin, mushroom dishes, and aged Manchego cheese.

bm-poet-the-muse-reserve-cabernet.title: Austin Hope Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bm-poet-the-muse-reserve-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Austin Hope Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a premium, full-bodied red wine from California's Paso Robles region. Crafted from carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grown across six Paso Robles districts, this Reserve release undergoes extended French oak maturation to develop exceptional depth and structure. Rich aromas of cocoa and raspberry lead into layers of ripe blueberry, olallieberry, and savoury earthiness. Plush tannins, concentrated dark fruit, and subtle spice create a luxurious palate with a long, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted lamb, smoked brisket, venison, mushroom risotto, aged cheddar, and rich barbecue dishes.

arrow-branch-black-label-cabernet.title: Arrow & Branch Black Label Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 750ml
arrow-branch-black-label-cabernet.bodyHtml:
93 Points by James Suckling
Lots of ripe fruit with aromas of blackberries, blueberries and flowers. Hint of lavender. Full-bodied, layered and balanced with a fine tannin structure. Very nicely crafted for the vintage.

93 Points by Jeb Dunnuck
Harvested all before the fires, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Black Label is a juicy, rock star of a Napa blend that has lots of chocolate fruit, tobacco, and spice to go with a full-bodied, juicy, opulent style on the palate. Drink it over the coming 10-15 years.

93 Points by Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
Coming from the Lewelling, Criscione and Beckstoffer Dr. Crane vineyards, the 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Black Label is a blend of 92% Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Merlot and 2% Petit Verdot aged 20 months in 65% new French oak. It has a deep garnet-purple color and delivers exuberant black cherries, ripe plums and crème de cassis notes with nuances of fallen leaves, pencil lead and charcoal plus a touch of dried herbs. Full-bodied, firm and grainy, it packs in the black fruit and earthy layers, finishing with a mineral kick.

arrow-branch-red-wine-right-bank-blend.title: Astral de Chateau Puybarbe
arrow-branch-red-wine-right-bank-blend.bodyHtml:
Astral de Château Puybarbe is a vibrant, elegant, and deeply expressive red wine crafted at the highest elevation of the Right Bank within the historic Côtes de Bourg appellation. Commanding a south-sloping plateau looking over the Gironde estuary, this sustainably farmed property shapes a beautifully balanced and terroir-driven blend led predominantly by Merlot. Following meticulous berry selection, a extensive cold maceration, and extended concrete-tank and oak vinification, the wine unrolls an opulent, layered profile in the glass. It exhibits a deep, inky ruby core with shimmering purple reflections along the rim. On the nose, it delivers a striking aromatic bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, wild dark bramble berries, and black plums, seamlessly layered with subtle nuances of sweet vanilla, fresh lemongrass, cedar, and discreet baking spices. The palate is medium-to-full-bodied, driving a juicy, dense core of concentrated dark fruit flavors across a fresh backbone of lively acidity and grainy, fine-grained structural tannins before concluding with a long, clean, and mildly spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with roasted duck breast, savory game meats, grilled chicken skewers, or hearty mediterranean salads.

arrow-branch-stagecoach-sauvignon-blanc.title: Arrow & Branch Stagecoach Sauvignon Blanc 2019 750ml
arrow-branch-stagecoach-sauvignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
With an expressive bouquet of candied lime leaf, fresh blossoms, and white peach, this wine exudes freshness and perfectly ripe fruits.  The texture offers a core of citrus-laced acidity that is balanced by a sense of creaminess achieved by the winemaking technique of sur lie aging.  Highly exuberant in flavor, this wine finishes long with precision and minerality.

-Jennifer Williams, Arrow&Branch Winemaker

peju-cabernet-franc-napa-valley.title: Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
peju-cabernet-franc-napa-valley.bodyHtml:
Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is a rich, elegant, and full-bodied red wine from California's renowned Napa Valley. Crafted with carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine showcases the region's exceptional winemaking heritage and Beaulieu Vineyard's commitment to quality. It offers concentrated dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, and subtle oak influences, creating a beautifully balanced and sophisticated drinking experience. With its smooth texture, layered complexity, and lingering finish, this Cabernet Sauvignon is an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining, or enjoying with a hearty meal.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, barbecue, hearty pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses such as cheddar and Gouda.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Focused and brilliant flavors of red and black cherries and black currants drive this sleek and powerful wine, as minty, toasty, and tobacco-like accents stay subtly in the background until the finish. A full body, medium to full tannins and good fruit acidity lend tangy freshness. Best from 2026.

91 Points - James Suckling 

A juicy and delicious wine with a round and polished texture with hints of chocolate and walnuts. Some iron shavings, too. Medium body. Savory at the end. Lovely dark fruit in the finish. Juicy. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator
