Shows a light mesquite edge that mingles with gently mulled plum and blackberry fruit flavors, while lightly singed vanilla and tobacco fill in through the finish. Reveals a solid graphite spine, too. Drink now through 2033. Tasted twice, with consistent notes

chateau-de-ferrand-st-emilion-grand-cru.title: Chateau de Ferrand Saint-Emilion Grand Cru Classe 2016
chateau-de-ferrand-st-emilion-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Château de Ferrand Saint-Émilion Grand Cru Classé 2016 is an elegant, full-bodied Bordeaux red wine from the limestone plateau of Saint-Émilion on France's Right Bank. Produced from 80% Merlot, 15% Cabernet Franc, and 5% Cabernet Sauvignon, this distinguished 2016 vintage combines concentrated dark fruit with refined structure and balanced freshness. Aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, and ripe cherries are complemented by subtle oak and floral complexity. The palate is rich yet lively, with polished tannins, layers of dark berries, and a long, harmonious finish. Classified as Grand Cru Classé, Château de Ferrand showcases the depth and elegance of Saint-Émilion's celebrated terroir.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, duck breast, mushroom risotto, aged Comté, and slow-cooked beef.

 

95 Points - James Suckling

This has very attractive aromas of bright red fruit with a neat array of wild herbs and flowers, too. The palate has a succulent, juicy and fresh feel with stony tannins, delivering length and richness with impressive focus. Great wine. A blend of merlot, cabernet franc and cabernet sauvignon.

montagny-1er-cru-chazelle.title: Courtault Michelet Chablis 1er Cru Mont de Milieu 2023
montagny-1er-cru-chazelle.bodyHtml:
Sourced from the south-facing Mont de Milieu Premier Cru vineyard, this Chardonnay offers vibrant citrus, white orchard fruit and classic Chablis minerality. Bright acidity and refined structure are complemented by subtle complexity, leading to a long, elegant finish with excellent ageing potential.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with lobster, sole meuniere, turbot, roast chicken, veal and creamy seafood dishes.

chateau-haut-carles-2019.title: Chateau De Carles Haut-Carles 2020 750ml
chateau-haut-carles-2019.bodyHtml:
This exceptional vintage from plot selections of old vines is superb in concentration. It was launched in 1994 to compete with the most prestigious Bordeaux wines. After gentle extraction during vinification, Haut-Carles is aged for nearly 18 months in French oak barrels (40% of which are new). With elegance, it reveals the bright fruit of Merlot, a delicate woodiness and a creamy mouthfeel lined with silky tannins. Delicious in its youth, it lets an even more complex and harmonious bouquet emerge over time.

Haut Carles, located in the Fronsac appellation in the Right Bank of Bordeaux is one of the older estates in the appellation. The actual Haut Carles chateau dates its creation back to the 1400s when it was used as a fortress. The vineyard is planted to a vine density of 10,000 vines per hectare for their newer plantings, which is quite high for the Right Bank, especially in Fronsac. The vineyard is managed using 100% organic farming techniques.

Haut Carles is best paired with all types of classic meat dishes, veal, pork, beef, lamb, duck, game, roast chicken, roasted, braised, and grilled dishes. It's also excellent when matched with Asian dishes, and rich fish courses like tuna, mushrooms, and pasta.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of olives, chocolate orange, toffee, plums, peppercorns and cherries. Creamy and mouth-filling with velvety tannins and a full body. Plush and polished. Chocolaty finish

provenance-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Provenance Vineyards Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
provenance-napa-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Provenance Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 pours a deep, concentrated ruby-purple color in the glass. The nose is remarkably expressive, opening with intense aromas of ripe black currants, cassis, tapenade, and dark chocolate, layered with subtle oak spices and warm licorice. On the palate, this full-bodied red showcases a sleek, mouthfilling texture with ample, well-structured grains of tannin and broad fruit concentration. It exhibits a beautiful balance of plush dark berry fruit and refined depth, leading into a long, polished, and vertical finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled prime ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-crusted roasted lamb chops, or rich wild mushroom ragout.

93 Points - James Suckling

Intense aromas of rich currants, tapenade, grilled red pepper and dark chocolate. Broad, ripe and structured on the palate with ample tannins and a long yet vertical finish. Opulent but refined.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ah, this is an engaging, mouthfilling wine, with everything in the right proportions for enjoyment now or later. A sleek texture, rich fruits and subtle oak spices weave together beautifully on a full body. Best from 2025.

mazzei-concerto.title: Fonterutoli Concerto Di Fonterutoli 2020
mazzei-concerto.bodyHtml:
Mazzei Castello di Fonterutoli Concerto di Fonterutoli 2020 is an exceptional Super Tuscan red wine from the historic Mazzei family's estate in Castellina in Chianti, Tuscany. First produced in 1981, Concerto helped pioneer the Super Tuscan movement by combining 80% Sangiovese with 20% Cabernet Sauvignon. The 2020 vintage offers concentrated blackberry, blackcurrant, and dark cherry flavours complemented by earthy undertones, refined oak, and elegant spice. Matured for 18 months in French oak, it delivers remarkable structure, freshness, and aging potential.

Food Pairing: Braised short ribs, grilled ribeye steak, wild boar ragù, roasted lamb, aged Pecorino, truffle pasta, and hearty mushroom dishes.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

An extremely aromatic red with currants, flowers and spices, following through to a full-bodied yet so crunchy and juicy palate with crushed blackberries and raspberries. Citrusy acidity. Bright and agile. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose balances the peppery, sanguine smokiness of grilled meat with a succulent swirl of black cherries and chocolate. On the palate, that balance continues, and is spotlighted by a strong undertow of spice and salt, while polished tannins and integrated acid create cohesion.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This rich yet taut red is marked by a beam of black cherry and black currant fruit, with oak spice, earth and wild Mediterranean herb accents. Compact, dusty finish. Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon. Best from 2025 through 2038.

peyrassol-le-clos-rose-aop.title: Peyrassol Le Clos Peyrassol Rose 2022/2023 750ml
peyrassol-le-clos-rose-aop.bodyHtml: Extremely pale pink in colour, this emblematic cuvée cultivates elegance, finesse and concentration. This is a lacy wine, with aromas of white cherry blossom, citrus fruit and white fruit (peach, pear). Fresh and generous on the palate, it immediately delivers the complexity typical of great wines. The aromas are gradually released and intermingle to offer the full expression of the grape varieties of Provence in their chosen terroirs. Built around the grape’s acids, this wine is very long on the palate, elegantly prolonged by bitters and a measured salinity.

massolino-barbaresco-docg.title: Massolino Barbaresco 2021
massolino-barbaresco-docg.bodyHtml:
Barbaresco
Piedmont, Italy
A wine that most perfectly conveys the spirit and essence of its place, Barbaresco is true reflection of terroir. Its star grape, like that in the neighboring Barolo region, is Nebbiolo. Four townships within the Barbaresco zone can produce Barbaresco: the actual village of Barbaresco, as well as Neive, Treiso and San Rocco Seno d'Elvio.

Broadly speaking there are more similarities in the soils of Barbaresco and Barolo than there are differences. Barbaresco’s soils are approximately of the same two major soil types as Barolo: blue-grey marl of the Tortonion epoch, producing more fragile and aromatic characteristics, and Helvetian white yellow marl, which produces wines with more structure and tannins.

Nebbiolo ripens earlier in Barbaresco than in Barolo, primarily due to the vineyards’ proximity to the Tanaro River and lower elevations. While the wines here are still powerful, Barbaresco expresses a more feminine side of Nebbiolo, often with softer tannins, delicate fruit and an elegant perfume. Typical in a well-made Barbaresco are expressions of rose petal, cherry, strawberry, violets, smoke and spice. These wines need a few years before they reach their peak, the best of which need over a decade or longer. Bottle aging adds more savory characteristics, such as earth, iron and dried fruit.
Nebbiolo
Responsible for some of the most elegant and age-worthy wines in the world, Nebbiolo, named for the ubiquitous autumnal fog (called nebbia in Italian), is the star variety of northern Italy’s Piedmont region. Grown throughout the area, as well as in the neighboring Valle d’Aosta and Valtellina, it reaches its highest potential in the Piedmontese villages of Barolo, Barbaresco and Roero. Outside of Italy, growers are still very much in the experimentation stage, but some success has been achieved in parts of California. Somm Secret—If you’re new to Nebbiolo, start with a charming, wallet-friendly, early-drinking Langhe Nebbiolo or Nebbiolo d'Alba.

massolino-barbaresco-albesani-docg.title: Massolino Albesani Barbaresco 2019 750ml
massolino-barbaresco-albesani-docg.bodyHtml:

Critic tasting note: (2019 vintage) "Clear, brightening ruby. Opens with a charming nose of ripe raspberry and strawberry, some cotton candy and truffles in the background. Very juicy on the palate, polished tannin, ripe raspberry fruit, then grippy on the finish, firm drive." - 94/100, Falstaff

corofin-pinot-noir-settlement-vy.title: Corofin Settlement Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020
corofin-pinot-noir-settlement-vy.bodyHtml:
Corofin Settlement Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020 is an elegant Marlborough Pinot Noir offering raspberry, red cherry, wild strawberry, rose, herbs, and subtle spice. The palate is refined and silky, with bright acidity, delicate tannins, mineral freshness, savoury complexity, and impressive length.

Food Pairing: Roast duck, lamb, venison, grilled salmon, roasted poultry, mushroom dishes, pork, charcuterie, and earthy vegetable preparations.

 

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of red and black cherries, ash, charcoal and basked raspberries. Medium- to full-bodied with soft tannins. Iron mineral notes ground the crushed cherry palate. Subtle richness in the mid palate. From organically grown grapes. Drink now. Screw cap.

trediberri-barolo-del-comune-di-la-morra.title: Trediberri Barolo Del Comune Di La Morra 2022
trediberri-barolo-del-comune-di-la-morra.bodyHtml:
Trediberri Barolo del Comune di La Morra 2022 is an extraordinarily fresh, elegant, and energetic red wine produced by Nicola Oberto and his team in La Morra. Crafted primarily from estate vineyards in Berri alongside a portion from the famed Rocche dell'Annunziata, this 100% Nebbiolo undergoes slow fermentation and brief aging in large oak casks to preserve raw fruit purity. On the nose, it releases vibrant aromas of crunchy cranberry, wild redcurrant, and tart cherry, harmoniously intermingled with delicate notes of violet, cardamom, brushwood, and crushed stone. The palate is medium-bodied, refined, and slender, defined by lively, mouth-watering acidity, fine-grained tannins, and a crisp, mineral-accented finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb chops, braised veal shanks, agnolotti dal plin, wild mushroom risotto, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano or Castelmagno cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

A restrained style, showing subtle red currants, slightly confected strawberries and sweet violets, quite contemporary and not too spicy. Medium-bodied with ripe, velvety tannins, crisp acidity and a crunchy palate. Elegant and easy to drink yet a bit lacking in depth. Drink now.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

If La Morra made a calling card for its finest and most elegant Barolo, it would look a lot like this, all silky perfume, rose petal, and dried cherry floating from the glass with a purity and prettiness that is genuinely hard to look away from. The palate is vibrant and lifted, where fine polished tannins and a bright mouthwatering acidity somehow make something this beautiful feel almost criminally easy to drink. Editor’s Choice.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Trediberri 2022 Barolo del Comune di La Morra shows a beautiful quality of fruit, with sweet cherry, redcurrant and a soft, delicate character that is understated to the best effect. Although lighter in color, the wine is lush, supple and unmistakably La Morra in personality, capturing the warmth of this hot, dry vintage with terrific clarity. I especially appreciate the interplay between sweet and savory elements. Produced from a blend of 82% Berri and 18% Rocche dell'Annunziata after the estate elected not to bottle its two single-vineyard Barolos separately, this wine is conceived with drinkability in mind. The finish is marked by fine, powdery tannins with a subtle chalky edge, reflecting the slightly uneven phenolic ripeness of the vintage.

the-sheriff-of-buena-vista.title: Buena Vista 'The Sherriff of Buena Vista' 2019
the-sheriff-of-buena-vista.bodyHtml:
Buena Vista 'The Sheriff of Buena Vista' 2019 pours a dark, inky red-purple color in the glass. The highly expressive and perfumed nose opens with intense aromas of super-ripe strawberry jam, fresh blackberries, and wild blueberries, beautifully accented by secondary notes of wood spice, toasted cedar, vanilla, and sweet tobacco leaf. On the palate, this bold and full-bodied red blend showcases a juicy fruit core framed by firmly structured, polished tannins and a refreshing streak of natural acidity. Layered flavors of dark currant preserves, brambly herbs, and a savory hint of dark chocolate seamlessly intertwine through 15 months of barrel aging, culminating in a long, elegant, and persistent finish touched by notes of cracked black pepper and star anise.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rosemary lamb chops, barbecued bison burgers, or mature, hard artisanal cheeses like sharp Cheddar.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Superripe, jammy flavors of strawberries and blackberries are nicely accented by oak spices of vanilla, toast and cedar in this moderately tannic, firmly structured wine. It offers lots of fruit and power.

barnard-griffin-sangiovese-rose.title: Barnard Griffin Rose Of Sangiovese 2023
barnard-griffin-sangiovese-rose.bodyHtml:
Features an expressive nose with melon rind and maraschino cherry notes that compliment its strawberry nuances. The well-structured palate is at once full-bodied yet also bright and fruity.

A remarkably appealing, dry, food-friendly Rosé.

89 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Brimming with acidity, the Barnard Griffin Rosé of Sangiovese is a juicy treat. It begins with aromas of bright red cherries and peach jam. Then you get this delightful combination of strawberries and cream, with a little bit of orange zest tang. Pour this for your next session of beach blanket bingo.

quinta-do-portal-reserva-tinto.title: Quinta de Zom Douro Tinto Reserva
quinta-do-portal-reserva-tinto.bodyHtml:
Quinta de Zom Douro Tinto Reserva is a full-bodied Portuguese red wine from the Douro Valley, offering intense aromas of wild red fruits, subtle balsamic notes, and warm spices. Aged in French oak, it delivers a well-balanced palate with refined tannins, concentrated fruit, and a long, complex finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled red meats, roasted lamb, braised beef, white meats, and oven-baked fish.

wvv-whole-cluster-pinot-noir.title: Elk Cove Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2024
wvv-whole-cluster-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Elk Cove Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2024 is a lively, elegant, and beautifully balanced red wine crafted from 100% estate-grown fruit across six distinct site vineyards in Oregon's Northern Willamette Valley. Fermented in small open-top stainless steel tanks and aged for 10 months in French oak, it draws on diverse soil types and clones to deliver an expressive, fruit-forward profile. In the glass, it reveals inviting aromas of fresh red cherry, strawberry-rhubarb pie, wild raspberry, rose petal, and delicate oak spice. On the palate, it is light-to-medium-bodied and supple, offering flavors of ripe red currant, juicy plum, and dark berry compote layered with subtle earthy notes, fine-grained tannins, and a silky, refreshed finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast, grilled salmon, pork tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, and semi-soft cheeses like Brie.

91 Points - James Suckling

A fresh, juicy, light- to medium-bodied wine with loads of red-cherry, spice and rose-petal aromas. Fine, gentle tannins and a silky texture.

nicolas-feuillatte-blanc-de-blanc.title: Nicolas Feuillatte Reserve Exclusive Brut
nicolas-feuillatte-blanc-de-blanc.bodyHtml:
Nicolas Feuillatte Brut Reserve is a traditional Champagne crafted from Pinot Meunier, Pinot Noir, and Chardonnay. Extended cellar aging develops fine bubbles, vibrant orchard fruit, citrus freshness, and delicate brioche notes, delivering an elegant, balanced palate with a long, refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, smoked salmon, shrimp, soft cheeses, and light poultry dishes.

bachelet-saint-aubin-1er-cru-white.title: Domaine Aurore Bachelet Saint-Aubin 1er Cru En Remilly 2020
bachelet-saint-aubin-1er-cru-white.bodyHtml:
Domaine Aurore Bachelet Saint-Aubin 1er Cru En Remilly 2020 is an elegant Premier Cru Chardonnay from Burgundy's prestigious Côte de Beaune. Grown in the limestone-rich En Remilly vineyard, this refined white wine offers bright orchard fruit, citrus, delicate florals, and subtle oak influence. Its creamy texture, vibrant acidity, and mineral-driven finish showcase the finesse and character of Saint-Aubin's exceptional terroir.

Food Pairing: Seared scallops, grilled lobster, roasted chicken, creamy mushroom risotto, baked halibut, and aged Comté cheese.

bachelet-maranges-1er-cru-pinot-noir.title: Bachelet-Monnot Maranges 1er Cru 'La Fussiere' Rouge 2023
bachelet-maranges-1er-cru-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Bachelet-Monnot Maranges 1er Cru 'La Fussiere' Rouge 2023 is a remarkably pure, expressive, and refined Pinot Noir hailing from one of the most celebrated Premier Cru vineyards in the southernmost appellation of the Côte de Beaune. Exhibiting a vibrant ruby color, it unfolds on the nose with red cherries, wild strawberries, and crushed cranberries, seamlessly balanced by subtle notes of rose petals, damp earth, and delicate baking spices. On the palate, the wine delivers a beautifully focused medium body, silken tannins, and bright natural acidity that carries through to a long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with duck breast, roasted pork tenderloin, grilled quail, mushroom risotto, coq au vin, and mild French cheeses like Époisses.

94 Points - Vinous

The 2023 Maranges La Fussières 1er Cru Rouge is blended with 30% whole bunch. This has an understated bouquet with light earthy red fruit with sous-bois and mineral scents. It opens succinctly in the glass. The palate is medium-bodied with finely chiseled tannins, very poised, airy and transparent yet with real weight and presence on the finish. Bon vin!

92 Points - Jasper Morris

50% whole bunch. One plot with concentrated small berries and one very old vines, mean that whole bunches work well here on a heavier clay soil. Almost a black centre with a purple rim. This is very generous but not too sunny, a wealth of black cherry and raspberry fruit, velvet texture which is very rare in Maranges and a long finish.

bachelet-santenay-1er-cru-pinot-noir.title: Domaine Aurore Bachelet Santenay 1er Cru 'Clos des Mouches' 2021 750ml
bachelet-santenay-1er-cru-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The Domaine Aurore Bachelet Santenay 1er Cru 'Clos des Mouches' 2021 is a red wine from the Santenay region of France:


Color: A dark, brilliant black-cherry color
Bouquet: Evokes rose-petals, peony, violet, red fruits, and a hint of liquorice
Taste: A deep and intense attack in the mouth 

Santenay is a region in Burgundy that mainly produces red wine from the Pinot Noir grape. The French system of wine classification uses the term appellation controlee (AC) to indicate the geographical origin of a wine. Each AC has a set of rules that define the region, permitted grapes, yields, and sometimes alcohol and sugar levels.

domaine-de-baron-arques-rouge-2016.title: Domaine De Baron'Arques Rouge 2016 750ml
domaine-de-baron-arques-rouge-2016.bodyHtml:
Domaine de Baronarques Rouge 2016 is a rich, elegant red wine from Limoux in southern France, produced by the Rothschild family's Baron Philippe de Rothschild wine estates. Blending Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Malbec, this distinctive wine combines Bordeaux-inspired structure with Mediterranean character. Aromas of blackcurrant, ripe plum, spice, and chocolate lead to a generous palate with silky tannins. Twelve months of French oak maturation adds complexity, creating a harmonious, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye, roasted lamb, braised short ribs, duck breast, wild mushroom risotto, aged Comté, and hearty stews.

 

92 Points - James Suckling

Fresh and aromatic with basil and dried flowers to the currants and berries. Medium-bodied with a solid core of fruit and medium, firm tannins and a savory finish. Hints of rosemary and crushed stones to the currants in the aftertaste. Drink now or hold.

thienpont-letoile-de-pomerol.title: L'Etoile Lalande de Pomerol 2020
thienpont-letoile-de-pomerol.bodyHtml:
A lush and polished Right Bank Bordeaux red, the 2020 L'Etoile highlights the exceptional quality of a top-tier vintage in the Libournais. This wine presents an aromatic profile of ripe cherries, dark plums, and violets, elegantly layered with nuances of wet earth, chocolate-coated plums, and a touch of licorice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and remarkably fresh, showcasing a silky, forward texture with velvety tannins. Subtle hints of mocha, espresso, and savory herbs lead to a graceful finish. Crafted from 5 hectares of gravel and sand-based vineyards, it reflects the classic Merlot-driven elegance of its neighborhood.

91 Points - James Suckling
Ripe, smoky plums with toasted sweet spices, chocolate and a hint of tar. Some mushroom, too. Full and intense with cassis and plum skins on offer. Firm tannins and a deep dark-fruited character. Lingering finish. 82% merlot, 14% cabernet franc and 4% cabernet sauvignon. Drink or hold.

chateau-pavie-macquin-les-chenes-de-macq.title: Les Chenes de Macquin 2019 750ml
chateau-pavie-macquin-les-chenes-de-macq.bodyHtml:
The nose is elegant and offers a beautiful finesse of the grain, a beautiful elegance as well as subtility and a small power. It reveals notes of bright cassis, bright blackberry and small notes of fleshy blueberry associated with fine touches of crushed redcurrant, fresh cornflower, a hint of lilac, black tea, liquorice and very discreet hints of sweet spices. The palate is fruity, well-balanced and offers a beautiful definition, a beautiful freshness, elegance, deepness, precision and finesse of the grain. On the palate this wine expresses notes of juicy/pulpy cassis, bright raspberry and juicy/bright violet plum associated with touches of juicy/bright currant on the tong, lilac, cornflower, small bright berries as well as hints of nutmeg, toasted, chocolate and a very discreet hint of mild tobacco (in the background). Good length. Tannins are elegant and offer a very discreet chew. A very discreet saline/sapid hint on the persistence.

97 points - Falstaff

Deep dark ruby, purple reflections, discreet bright rim. Multifaceted bouquet of wild berries and fine oak, ripe cherries, fresh orange zest, a hint of vanilla and nougat. Juicy, highly elegant, finely pronounced fruit texture, silky tannins, fresh structure, mineral and long lasting, fine sweetness on the finish, very harmonious, great future potential.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

94–96. Barrel Sample. The pure black currant fruits of this exemplary wine are matched with bright acidity and ripe, solid tannins. It is impressively rich and will certainly age well. Roger Voss

la-gravette-de-certan.title: Chateau La Gravette de Certan 2019
la-gravette-de-certan.bodyHtml:
Château La Gravette de Certan 2019 is an elegant Bordeaux red wine from the renowned Vieux Château Certan estate in Pomerol, on Bordeaux's Right Bank. Produced entirely from Merlot grapes sourced from the estate's younger vines, this exceptional second wine captures the richness and refinement of the celebrated 2019 vintage. Matured in French oak, it reveals layers of ripe black cherry, blackberry, plum, and licorice, complemented by delicate floral notes and subtle tobacco. Medium-to-full-bodied with silky tannins and vibrant acidity, it offers remarkable balance, depth, and aging potential.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, duck breast, mushroom risotto, truffle dishes, aged Comté, and grilled steak.

edetaria-finca-terrenal.title: Edetaria Finca La Terrenal 2018 750ml
edetaria-finca-terrenal.bodyHtml:
Edetària Finca La Terrenal 2018 is a white wine from Terra Alta, Catalunya, Spain made from 100% Garnacha Blanca grapes grown in old vineyards on sunny clay slopes. It is described as having a pronounced character on the nose and being elegantly matured and complex. 

Grapes
100% Garnacha Blanca
Vineyards
Old vineyards on sunny clay slopes
Region
Terra Alta, Catalunya, Spain
Description
Elegant, complex, and pronounced on the nose

edetaria-finca-genuina.title: Edetaria Finca La Genuina 2018 750ml
edetaria-finca-genuina.bodyHtml:
This wine is made exclusively from Garnacha Fina coming from a selection of the best vineyards with this grape, all of them in “tapàs” soils, made from several layers of marls  formerly under the sea, displaying outstanding colour and soil’s complexity. This unique grape, an indigenous clone of Terra Alta, with small-grained and loose grapes, displays pure Mediterranean personality, thanks to ideal ripening in the region’s climate.

Tasting
Aromas display Mediterranean perfumes, a red fruit explosion and garrigue undergrowth notes showing a genuine personality. The palate is coated by with sweet tannins. Thanks to perfect grapes ripening the wine displays a sublime finesse and elegance.

edetaria-finca-pedrissa-carignan.title: Edetaria Finca La Pedrissa 2018 750ml
edetaria-finca-pedrissa-carignan.bodyHtml:
Made exclusively from Carinena/Carignan from ancient 80-year-old vines grown in poor, rocky, and calcareous soil called ‘tapas blanc’, from which Romans extracted stones for their buildings. Thanks to the soil’s austerity, this Carinena offers a unique expression that’s rich and highly concentrated. Gosh, I want a case, but sadly only 10 cases in total arrived in NZ. Scoring 94 in Decanter and awarded their 10 Top Full-Bodied Spanish Reds in April 2021. The pedigree is all there, you just need the patients and the cellar in which to age it. Given 10 years+ in a temperature-controlled cellar and there will be magic in the bottle.

Smells
layers of complexity with florals, a series of black fruits, cedar, red clay, and hints of iron filings with a toasty vanilla edge.


Tastes
The palate is overwhelming juicy but balanced perfectly by the chalky tannic spine. Flavours of vibrant red berries, red and black liquorice with a meaty vein, all add to the charm. The components are all there, fruit, structure, and length and with time the harmony, complexity and drive will be spellbinding.

edetaria-finca-personal-garnatxa-peluda.title: Edetaria Finca La Personal 2018 750ml
edetaria-finca-personal-garnatxa-peluda.bodyHtml:
Winemaker Notes
Aromas display a series of red fruit and forest berries, together with Mediterranean herbs and a balsamic ending. The palate shows endless fleshy red fruit, along with a nice wide texture and a wild touch, it finishes long and elegant.

Press

Rated 92 Points James Suckling
Some baked plums, dried strawberries, licorice, walnuts and mossy red berries. Balsamic, too. Quite bright and juicy, with more wild berries and licorice on the palate with a hint of Coca-Cola. Very refined tannins here. 100% garnatxa peluda, or hairy garnacha.

Rated 91 Points Wine Spectator
A stylish red without being flashy, with chalky tannins fleshed out by flavors of bitter cherry and black plum, dried sage, mocha and graphite. Fresh, spiced finish. Best after 2024.

haut-medoc-cru-bourgeois-superieur.title: Chateau Coufran Haut Medoc 2010
haut-medoc-cru-bourgeois-superieur.bodyHtml:
Chateau Coufran Haut Medoc is a distinguished Cru Bourgeois Superieur renowned for its Merlot-dominant style, uncommon on Bordeaux's Left Bank. Aromas of black cherry, plum, cassis, cedar, tobacco, graphite, and baking spice unfold into a rich, velvety palate with polished tannins, balanced freshness, and excellent aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast lamb, grilled ribeye, braised beef, duck confit, mushroom dishes, or aged Comte for a classic Haut Medoc experience.

 

88 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blueberries and delicate floral notes lead into a medium- to full-bodied palate with firm, chewy tannins. The wine shows an austere, structured character and finishes a little short, though it has the balance to improve with additional bottle age. Best from 2015.

gallen-de-chateau-meyre-margaux.title: Chateau Meyre Gallen de Chateau Meyre 2020
gallen-de-chateau-meyre-margaux.bodyHtml:
Dark ruby red core. Fragrant nose offering wild berries, tobacco, mocha, fine oak and mild spices. Elegant medium bodied palate with plush red fruit, soft and rounded texture with gentle tannin, fresh and savoury with well-integrated oak and a smooth long finish.

91 Points - James Suckling

A juicy and savory red with crushed berries, cherries and spices. Medium to full body. Chewy and medium tannins and a savory finish. From organically grown grapes. Drinkable now, but better in a year or two.

bodega-noemia-malbec-patagonia.title: Bodega Noemia Patagonia A Lisa Malbec 2022 750ml
bodega-noemia-malbec-patagonia.bodyHtml:
A dense violet and plum color. Bouquet of dark berries, cherry, minerals, and cocoa. Medium-bodied with an excellent structure, notes of cherry and cassis; with balanced, persistent tannins.

Pair with steak, turkey and pasta dishes.

chateau-batailley-2015.title: Chateau Batailley 2015
chateau-batailley-2015.bodyHtml:
The Château Batailley 2015 is a highly regarded vintage from this historic 5th Growth Pauillac estate, marking a return to a more generous and opulent style after a series of cooler years. The 2015 growing season in the Médoc was characterized by a superb, dry summer followed by a successful harvest, resulting in a wine with exceptional aromatic intensity and silkier tannins than the structured 2014. Critics have praised this vintage for its "hedonistic" appeal and classical Pauillac pedigree, earning scores such as 94 points from Wine Enthusiast and 93-95 points from Wine Advocate. It is a beautifully balanced, full-bodied red featuring a signature core of crème de cassis, cedar, and graphite, with the structural depth to age gracefully for 20–30 years.

95 Points - James Suckling

Impressive depth to the wine from the outset with a gently smoky edge to the ripe blackberries, blueberries and red plums. Some attractive spicy oak here, too. The mid-weight palate has a very composed and linear shape with a long, succulent and regal finish. Great polish and balance here; the structure is superb. Try from 2022.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A showy mint note leads off, followed by a flash of ganache before giving way to a core of steeped black currant and fig fruit. A strong charcoal edge through the finish gives this texture and length, while a bay leaf note adds freshness. There's lots to like in this old-school version. Best from 2022 through 2033.

chateau-beau-site-2016.title: Chateau Beau-Site Saint-Estephe 2016 750ml
chateau-beau-site-2016.bodyHtml: Expert tasting note: (2016 vintage) "The color is a medium intensity of darkly pigmented ruby-red. The aromas are of earthy dark fruit. The Palate has a fine structure, dark plum, damson & bullace fruit is overlaid with a distinct earthy note. The wine is medium to full bodied. Alcohol is slightly warming & the acidity is fresh. There is an excellent intensity of concentrated licorice fruit that lasts very well on a harmonious finish." - 07/23 DCAMW

dictador-xo-platinum-rum.title: Dictador Platinum Aged Rum
dictador-xo-platinum-rum.bodyHtml:
Dictador Platinum Rum is made from the fermentation of unique virgin sugar cane honey, then distilled in a modern stainless steel alembic. It is then aged in pre-used quality oak barrels from Jerez and Port that now and again reburn to caramelize the interior to achieve sweet flavours coming from the oak.

By carefully hand selecting barrels from each year’s vintage using the highest level of technology and our secret method, our master blender uses all his skills to create the most exquisite blended rum, which is then approved for bottling at the highest standard.

vista-reserve-cabernet.title: Austin Hope Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
vista-reserve-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Austin Hope Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a premium, full-bodied red wine from California's Paso Robles region. Crafted from carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grown across six Paso Robles districts, this Reserve release undergoes extended French oak maturation to develop exceptional depth and structure. Rich aromas of cocoa and raspberry lead into layers of ripe blueberry, olallieberry, and savoury earthiness. Plush tannins, concentrated dark fruit, and subtle spice create a luxurious palate with a long, balanced finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, roasted lamb, smoked brisket, venison, mushroom risotto, aged cheddar, and rich barbecue dishes.

kosta-browne-santa-rita-hills-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir 2021
kosta-browne-santa-rita-hills-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Kosta Browne Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir 2021 is a masterful exploration of one of California’s most dramatic cool-climate regions. Sourced from prestigious vineyards defined by maritime fog and transverse mountain ranges, this vintage captures the signature tension and intensity of the area. It offers a captivating bouquet of wild strawberries, hibiscus, and crushed pomegranate, layered with nuanced notes of orange zest and dried thyme. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and vibrantly structured, showcasing a core of bright red fruit supported by ultra-fine tannins and a distinct saline minerality. The finish is remarkably long and energetic, reflecting the cool, wind-swept terroir of the Sta. Rita Hills.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This beloved brand manages to click a lot of Pinot Noir boxes in each bottling, including the spice, herb and fruit combo of strawberry, cherry, cinnamon stick and bay leaf on the nose. The palate is ripe and expressive with cherry compote flavors that are enhanced by a toasted pecan warmth and leathery grip.

93 Points - James Suckling

A subtle and pretty pinot with a lovely middle palate with a fine dusty tannin texture to it. Medium body and succulent with a savory finish. Orange peel. Lovely finish. This is very tame.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Matured for 15 months in 52% new oak, the 2021 Pinot Noir Sta. Rita Hills has a very pretty expression this vintage. The nose features detailed scents of blueberries, strawberries, Earl Grey tea leaves and forest floor, and the medium-bodied palate offers generous, perfumed fruit on a delicate frame, finishing long and layered.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Tasty, with a large core of succulent cherry and blackberry fruit notes laced with a light briar note, all backed by subtle mesquite and savory elements on the racy finish.

kosta-browne-anderson-valley-pinot-noir.title: Kosta Browne Anderson Valley Pinot Noir 2020
kosta-browne-anderson-valley-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Kosta Browne Anderson Valley Pinot Noir 2020 is an elegant, expressive California Pinot Noir crafted from select vineyard sites in Mendocino County's cool, coastal Anderson Valley, including the Cerise, Ferrington, Gowan Creek, Confluence, and Narrows vineyards. Aged for 15 months in French oak barrels (38% new) and neutral oak casks, it showcases a brilliant ruby hue with complex aromas of dark cherry, cranberry, fresh blueberry, wild rose, and forest floor. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, expansive, and nicely layered, balancing vibrant acidity with ripe red and dark berry flavors, subtle baking spice notes, fine tannins, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with duck breast, roasted pork tenderloin, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, and mild cheeses.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Attractive, complex and ripe tasting, this medium-bodied wine blends black cherry and warm black-plum flavors on light tannins and good fruit acidity. Freshness aligns with nice balance, showing off intricate rhubarb and sour-cherry notes on repeated sipping.
91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Pinot Noir Anderson Valley has a nose of cranberries and blackberries with accents of burnt orange peel, forest floor and allspice. The medium-bodied palate is grainy and fresh, with earth-laced fruits and a long finish laced with baking spices.

adobe-road-carbon.title: Adobe Road Carbon 2018 750ml
adobe-road-carbon.bodyHtml: Red Wine Blend of Peite Sirah, Malbec, Cabernet Sauvgnon, and Petit Verdot and the newest release of The Racing Series wines. Dark, strong, and full bodied yet approachable, Carbon comes charging off the line with opaque black color in the glass. Aromas of black cherries, licorice, and deeply toasted oak seamlessly transition to flavors of ripe plum and crushed blackberries, finishing with sculpted tannins and violet accents.

la-pelle-ceniza-vineyard-cabernet-1.title: Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
la-pelle-ceniza-vineyard-cabernet-1.bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a highly refined, elegant, and classic expression of Napa Valley. It presents a deep, saturated ruby color and features a vibrant nose of black raspberry, blackcurrant, and dark blackberry preserves, layered with delicate floral notes of violet and lavender. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, its boisterous and bright dark fruit flavors are supported by savory hints of chaparral sagebrush, bay laurel, and subtle cedar. The texture is soft and silky, framed by velvety-rich tannins and crisp acidity that offer a balanced, firm grip leading into a long, sumptuous finish.

Food Pairing: This savory, structured Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, herb-crusted rack of lamb, or rich mushroom ravioli.

93 Points - James Suckling

A very refined and polished red with fine tannins, bright acidity and a tangy undertone. Medium-bodied, juicy and savory. Citrusy. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Earthy, cocoa powder aromatics combine with ripe black fruits on the palate. Lengthy, robust, full bodied and fully flavored, this powerful wine is carried by powdery-fine tannins and a persistent, palate-cleansing acidity.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

There's a caressing feel to the mix of cassis and boysenberry puree flavors that are gilded with a pretty violet note. The long finish has a toasty edge and lingers prettily.

la-pelle-oak-knoll-cabernet.title: J. Lohr 'Seven Oaks' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
la-pelle-oak-knoll-cabernet.bodyHtml:
The 2022 J. Lohr 'Seven Oaks' Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic and fruit-forward icon that has defined the Paso Robles style for over thirty vintages. Born from a dry and warm growing season, it presents an exceptionally dark color and a layered bouquet of black cherry, currant, and plum, accented by an authentic barrel-aged bouquet of toasted pastry, hazelnut, and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and smooth, featuring juicy red-fruit flavors supported by velvety, softly textured tannins. Matured for 12 months in 60-gallon American oak barrels (18% new wood), it balances its concentrated ripeness with a long, gratifying finish. It is widely recognized as a "best buy" for its consistency and is ideal for pairing with grilled ribeye steak or hearty pasta dishes.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb chops, hearty beef stews, sausage pasta, and aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

90 Points - James Suckling

Currants, sage, roasted plums and cloves on the nose of this rich and spicy red. It’s full-bodied, plush and toasty, with ripe tannins.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Damp earth aromas lead quickly into sharp yet ripe cherry aromas on the nose of this bottling. Likable flavors of black cherry greet the palate, as wet clay, cocoa, mint and mace flavors add impressive complexity at this price point.

la-pelle-st-helena-cabernet.title: Domaine Helena 7 Favors Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 12x750ml
la-pelle-st-helena-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Domaine Helena 7 Favors Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a bold, refined red wine produced from organically grown grapes at Mount St. Helena Vineyard in Lake County. It displays a deep ruby hue with garnetry highlights and an enticing bouquet of dark plum, cassis, and mocha, accompanied by subtle nuances of black pepper, clove, cocoa, and graphite. On the palate, it delivers rich layers of black cherry and forest berries anchored by a savory umami character, lively acidity, and structured tannins that lead into a long finish marked by dark chocolate and mineral undertones.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild mushroom risotto, charcuterie, and aged cheeses like Manchego or Gruyère.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This small but mighty vineyard site produces unique selections. It is situated near the Volcano, which is its namesake. There are a plethora of microclimates that complement the varying styles of wine offered. The 7 Flavors Cabernet Sauvignon highlights the clone 7 in a special vineyard block. The aromas are Red currant, black raspberry, dried bay leaf, and coffee grounds with notes of dried flowers on the nose. The flavors on the palate are supple, dark cherry, dark plum, dried fennel, and bittersweet chocolate with silky, grippy tannins. Decant and enjoy with a grilled pork chop

domaine-nico-grand-mere.title: Domaine Nico Soeur et Freres Grand Mere : Pinot Noir 2022
domaine-nico-grand-mere.bodyHtml:
A delicate and perfumed high-altitude Pinot Noir, the 2022 Grand Mère is sourced from a single parcel in the Villa Bastías district of the Uco Valley at approximately 3,675 feet. This label is dedicated to Laura Catena's French grandmother, Anne-Marie, and aims to capture a feminine, graceful style. The wine presents a translucent ruby color and opens with a charming bouquet of red cherries, wild strawberries, and hints of dried rose petals and white pepper. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied and exceptionally silky, showcasing crunchy red fruit flavors balanced by a vibrant, "cool-climate" acidity and very fine-grained tannins. Matured in French oak (20% new), it offers a clean, elegant finish with subtle earthy undertones and a touch of spice.

94 Points - James Suckling

Wild raspberry, olive and orange rind aromas with dark undertones of tobacco, bark and rock salt. It’s medium-bodied and savory on the palate, with wonderfully fine and precise tannins. Weightless in feeling, and persistent. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Lovely aromas of bergamot and lemon thyme pave the way for a suave-textured and juicy display of cherry, pomegranate and red currant flavors, which ride a gentle wave of minerally acidity onto the clean, precise finish, with subtle herbal notes folding in. Drink now through 2032.

domaine-nico-grand-pere.title: Domaine Nico Soeur et Freres Grand Mere : Pinot Noir 2022
domaine-nico-grand-pere.bodyHtml:

domaine-nico-histoire-da.title: Domaine Nico Soeur et Freres Histoire d’A: Pinot Noir 2023
domaine-nico-histoire-da.bodyHtml: A crystalline and high-toned expression of high-altitude viticulture, the 2023 Histoire d’A is sourced from a specific, limestone-rich parcel in Gualtallary at an elevation of 4,430 feet. Named for Laura Catena’s daughter, Nicola Adriana, this wine is defined by its remarkable aromatic purity and mineral tension. It displays a translucent ruby hue and opens with a complex bouquet of red currants, wild raspberries, and violets, interwoven with signature notes of wet stones, graphite, and white pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and laser-focused, showcasing a vertical structure, racy acidity, and chalky, fine-grained tannins typical of the region’s calcareous soils. The finish is exceptionally long and saline, reflecting the cool-climate precision of this top-tier parcel.

domaine-nico-la-savante.title: Domaine Nico Soeur et Freres La Savante : Pinot Noir 2023
domaine-nico-la-savante.bodyHtml:
A profound and meticulously structured Pinot Noir, the 2023 La Savante is sourced from a specialized high-altitude parcel in the Gualtallary district at 4,757 feet. This site is defined by its extreme limestone and gravel soils, which impart a unique "savante" or scholarly precision to the wine. It presents a translucent ruby color and opens with a complex, high-toned bouquet of red cherries, wild strawberries, and rose petals, layered with sophisticated notes of forest floor, black tea, and a distinct chalky minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and remarkably focused, showcasing a vibrant acidity and firm, fine-grained tannins that provide a serious, vertical structure. The finish is exceptionally long and savory, marked by persistent notes of wet stones and savory herbs.

96 Points - James Suckling

This is floral yet subtle, with enveloping aromas of rose petals and red fruit. The palate is chalky, with incisive yet blurry tannins, delicate red fruit and a fresh lift that adds dimension. This comes from a 1.44-hectare plot planted in 1994 in Gualtallary. Drink now or hold.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 La Savante Pinot Noir is another blazingly bright and compelling expression of Uco Valley, originating from 1994 plantings at Adrianna Vineyard. It was fermented with roughly 40% whole clusters in 600-liter roll fermenters and matured in 225-liter barrique, 10% of which were new. It offers the most distinctly spice-driven and savory bouquet while retaining the alpine, citrus and herbal notes that are a through line in this roster. The palate is lifted, high-toned, racy and slender, seamlessly transitioning to an angular finish that balances austerity with juicy succulence and ever-present minerality. This is a fantastic and crystalline showing of Argentine Pinot Noir.

domaine-nico-le-paradis.title: Domaine Soeur et Freres Nico Le Paradis : Pinot Noir 2017
domaine-nico-le-paradis.bodyHtml:
A rare and profoundly elegant expression of high-altitude viticulture, the 2017 Le Paradis is sourced from an extreme vineyard site in Gualtallary at an elevation of 4,921 feet. This "Extreme Pinot Noir" parcel is characterized by its limestone-rich, calcareous soils and cool temperatures, producing a wine of immense tension and mineral precision. It displays a translucent garnet color and opens with a complex, high-toned bouquet of wild strawberries, rose petals, and citrus peel, seamlessly interwoven with notes of wet stones, graphite, and white pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and laser-focused, showcasing a vertical structure, vibrant acidity, and chalky, fine-grained tannins. Matured for 18 months in French oak, it delivers an exceptionally long, savory finish with persistent floral and mineral nuances.
96 Points - James Suckling
A very complex, cerebral pinot noir that has the kind of subtle layering that you find in wines from the Grand Cru sites on the Côte d’Or. The violets, cherries, cassis, blueberries and wild red fruit are all interwoven with a thread of spicy earthy, undergrowth. The palate has fine layered build and such smooth creamy tannins. The finish runs deep, very fluid and long. The tannins are super fine. The energy here is astonishing, as is the concentration. Drink or hold.

mendel-cabernet-franc.title: Mendel Cabernet Franc 2020
mendel-cabernet-franc.bodyHtml:
Mendel Cabernet Franc 2020 is an incredibly elegant, precise, and old-world-influenced Argentine red wine that beautifully captures the high-altitude intensity of the southern Uco Valley. Under the meticulous guidance of renowned winemaker Roberto de la Mota, the fruit is meticulously sourced from the calcareous blocks of Finca Remota in Paraje Altamira, situated at an impressive 1,100 meters above sea level. Following manual berry selection, the wine undergoes traditional vinification before aging for 12 months in French oak barrels (split evenly between new, second-use, and third-use oak). In the glass, it reveals a dense, vibrant dark garnet-ruby hue with brilliant clarity. The highly expressive nose opens with complex aromas of fresh raspberries, dark cherries, and wild herbs, masterfully layered with sophisticated undertones of crushed black pepper, wet graphite, jalapeño, and ash, all backed by a subtle whisper of toasted vanilla. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and texturally striking, showcasing an engaging, refreshing fluid coherence. Its concentrated core of red and dark forest fruits is effortlessly framed by fine, chalky, yet remarkably firm tannins and a lively line of natural acidity, concluding with a long, linear, and elegantly persistent finish marked by savory spice and a cool mineral grip.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled rosemary lamb chops, pepper-crusted ribeye steak, traditional beef lasagna, savory wild mushroom ragù, or aged goat cheeses.

mendel-unus-blend.title: Mendel Unus 2019 750ml
mendel-unus-blend.bodyHtml:
Winemaker Notes
Layers of ripe cherry, berry fruits, white pepper, mint, chocolate, caramel, smoke,
and toast. There are loads of ripe, soft tannins, so this wine will certainly age beautifully for a decade or longer.
Try with charcuterie, fajitas, and roasted cocoa.
Blend: 65% Malbec, 25% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Petit Verdot

Professional Ratings
93
James Suckling
A full-bodied red with violets, plums, blueberries, chocolate orange and sweet tobacco on the nose, with vanilla pods. Firmly structured, with broad and dusty layers and a lengthy, spicy finish. Malbec, cabernet sauvignon and petit verdot. Better after 2024.
91
Wine Enthusiast
The nose of this smooth blend of 65% Malbec, 25% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Petit Verdot is rich in aromas of maraschino cherry and cinnamon, along with other baking spices. Oaky notes are integrated on the palate, where a fair amount of red and black berries contribute to the balance of flavors.

mendel-finca-remota.title: Mendel Finca Remota Malbec 2018 750ml
mendel-finca-remota.bodyHtml:
Dark as night, a basket of enticing floral aromas (especially violets), Malbec’s intense red and black fruit flavors underlined with superbly integrated French oak notes giving way to a long, spicy finish.

Food Pairing
Firm but supple tannins make this wine worthy of rich foods like steak with a port reduction, duck with an intense cherry sauce, or a slowly-braised veal shank.

mario-natur.title: Mario Natur 750ml
mario-natur.bodyHtml:
The sparkling wine is pale lemon in color. The bubbles are medium active. Pronounced medium bouquet reminds of flowers, yellow fruit, peeled apples, and somewhat of yeast. Schist, clay and sandstone.

Directly pressed grapes. Spontaneous fermentation without the addition of yeast. Maturation and mixing on fine lees. No filtration. chardonnay (80 %), rumeni plavec (20 %)

joseph-perrier-champa-cuvee-royale-2012.title: Joseph Perrier Cuvee Royale Brut Vintage Champagne 2012
joseph-perrier-champa-cuvee-royale-2012.bodyHtml:
Joseph Perrier Cuvée Royale Brut Vintage Champagne 2012 is an elegant vintage Champagne produced by the historic Joseph Perrier house in Châlons-en-Champagne, France. Crafted from 54% Pinot Noir and 46% Chardonnay, this exceptional 2012 vintage spent 108 months aging in the producer's cellars, developing remarkable complexity and finesse. Its brilliant golden colour introduces aromas of fresh brioche, delicate spice, and dried fruit. With fine bubbles, refreshing acidity, and a refined mineral character, this sophisticated Champagne offers a beautiful balance of richness, freshness, and maturity.

Food Pairing: Scallop carpaccio, seared foie gras, oysters, lobster, roasted poultry, creamy Camembert, and delicate seafood dishes.

 

94 Points - James Suckling

Straight, focused and mineral with a linear core of lemons, green apples, biscuits,sourdough and chalk. Bitter lemon, too. Very fresh and dry, with tight bubbles and a sharp backbone of acidity.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

With its poise between toasty, warm maturity and fresh white fruits, this Champagne is at its peak. It has good depth and touches of spice that add complexity and richness to a wine that is now ready to drink.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

There's a citrusy, lemon peel overtone to this sleek and creamy Champagne, with a bright note alongside the accessible green pear, blanched almond and ground ginger notes. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

floral-de-cantanhede-baga-gold-edition.title: Foral de Cantanhede Gold Edition Grande Reserva Baga 2011
floral-de-cantanhede-baga-gold-edition.bodyHtml:
This powerful Bairrada red shows intense aromas of black cherry, plum, blackberry, dried herbs, leather, and subtle spice. Full-bodied and firmly structured, the palate delivers concentrated dark fruit, pronounced yet refined tannins, and vibrant acidity, finishing long, complex, and age-worthy with classic Baga character.

Food Pairing: Roast lamb, grilled steak, wild game, duck confit, mushroom dishes, aged cheeses, and rich traditional Portuguese cuisine.

 

87 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

This is a limited edition in a handsome bottle that is much too heavy. The wine is showing signs of age, with a dry edge that is not going to soften. So drink now, with richly flavored food. Roger Voss

marques-de-marialva-cuvee-brut-nature.title: Marques De Marialva Cuvee Primitivo Brut Nature 2014
marques-de-marialva-cuvee-brut-nature.bodyHtml:
An exceptional, highly sophisticated vintage sparkling white wine crafted via the classic traditional method by the historic Adega de Cantanhede. Made entirely from the Arinto grape variety and aged for an extensive 60 to 100 months on its lees, this bone-dry, zero-dosage cuvée showcases a striking intense citrus hue with brilliant golden highlights and ultra-fine, persistent bubbles. The complex nose opens with mature aromas of dried fruits, roasted hazelnuts, toasted brioche, and warm bread crust. 

Food Pairing: Outstanding as a serious celebratory aperitif, or paired alongside fresh oysters, sea bass ceviche, roasted white meats, or lightly spiced Mediterranean, Indian, and Chinese cuisine.

 

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Arinto gives intense acidity to this bone-dry wine. It has softened in the eight years since harvest, giving freshness alongside a spicy character. The wine is ready to drink.

marques-de-marialva-baga-cuvee-brut.title: Marques De Marialva Cuvee Primitivo Brut Nature 2014
marques-de-marialva-baga-cuvee-brut.bodyHtml:
An exceptional, highly sophisticated vintage sparkling white wine crafted via the classic traditional method by the historic Adega de Cantanhede. Made entirely from the Arinto grape variety and aged for an extensive 60 to 100 months on its lees, this bone-dry, zero-dosage cuvée showcases a striking intense citrus hue with brilliant golden highlights and ultra-fine, persistent bubbles. 90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

domaine-de-chevalier-blanc-2020.title: Domaine de Chevalier Blanc 2020
domaine-de-chevalier-blanc-2020.bodyHtml:
One of Bordeaux's finest white wines, Domaine de Chevalier Blanc offers captivating aromas of grapefruit, lemon zest, white peach, pear, acacia blossom, flint, and delicate toasted oak. Richly textured yet brilliantly fresh, it delivers crystalline acidity, remarkable precision, profound minerality, and an exceptionally long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with lobster, seared scallops, grilled turbot, oysters, roast chicken, creamy seafood pasta, goat cheese, or butter-poached asparagus.

 

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This classic white wine reveals impressive potential as it unfolds. Along with its enveloping white fruits and crisp citrus it also has a wrought texture that will push it forward for the long term.
Barrel Sample: 96-98
97 Points - James Suckling

This is a phenomenal white with big density and energy. Full bodied, yet incredibly agile and intense. Fabulous character of salt, minerals, and shells. Just a hint of tannins. Dried white peaches. Pears and apples. Super subtle character. 70% sauvignon blanc and 30% semillon. Great wine. A wine for the future but so great now. Barrel Sample: 96-97

95 Points - Decanter

An excellent white with precision, flesh and confidence, sure to age well. A ton of white pear and some soft pepper spice keeps up the pace and lift from beginning to end, and the intensity continues to build after the wine has left the palate - a sure sign of something special happening. A yield of 43hl/ha. Tasted twice. Unusual for me to score the red and white Chevalier at the same level, but both are extremely successful in this vintage.
Barrel Sample: 95
95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Another terrific vintage for this wine, the 2020 Domaine de Chevalier Blanc unwinds in the glass with aromas of nectarine, pear, nutmeg, passionflower and hazelnuts. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and seamless, with racy acids and a bright, pure profile, it nips at the heels of the brilliant and somewhat racier, more refined 2019. Best After 2025

95 Points - Wine Spectator

A very young, powerful, coiled-up white, with verbena, mirabelle plum, quinine, gooseberry jelly and fleur de sel notes weaving together. The long finish has a flash of bitter almond but keeps a nice nervy feel, with an underlying mineral hint. One to cellar a bit and let unwind. Sauvignon Blanc and Semillon.

marques-de-marialva-bical-arinto-reserva.title: Marques De Marialva Bical Arinto Reserva

marques-de-marialva-baga-reserva.title: Marques De Marialva Baga Reserva 2017
marques-de-marialva-baga-reserva.bodyHtml:
This elegant Bairrada Reserva made from Baga displays aromas of red cherry, blackberry, dried cranberry, violet, and subtle spice with earthy complexity. Medium to full-bodied, the palate offers firm yet refined tannins, vibrant acidity, and exceptional balance, finishing long, structured, and beautifully age-worthy.

Food Pairing: Roast duck, grilled lamb, pork dishes, mushroom risotto, charcuterie, aged cheeses, and traditional Portuguese cuisine.

 

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Baga is here in all its mature glory, with a fine backdrop of dusty tannins set against jammy black fruits. Spice and vanilla give complexity, followed by a juicy aftertaste. Drink the wine now. Roger Voss

2018-kenefick-ranch-cab-sauv.title: Kenefick Ranch 'Chris's Cuvee' Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
2018-kenefick-ranch-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
Kenefick Ranch 'Chris's Cuvee' Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 is a remarkably bold, structured, and luxurious red wine that beautifully expresses the sun-drenched, volcanic terroir of the northern Napa Valley. Nestled at the foothills of the Palisades Mountain range in Calistoga, this estate-grown bottling unrolls a highly complex nose of ripe blackcurrants, dark plum, and chocolate shavings, intertwined with hints of sweet leather, cigar box, and grilled herbs. On the palate, it delivers an ample, full-bodied mouthfeel driven by a concentrated core of juicy blueberries and blackberry preserves, enveloped in round, creamy tannins. Balanced by an undercurrent of natural acidity, it glides into a seamless, velvety finish defined by rich mocha and baking spice notes.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with slow-cooked barbecue pork spare ribs, rosemary-crusted grilled lamb shanks, pan-seared ribeye steak, or a selection of aged Mimolette cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

Plenty of chocolate, berry and currant aromas and flavors. It’s full-bodied with round, creamy tannins and a flavorful finish. Chewy, yet polished. Blue fruit comes through with stones. Good improvement in quality here. This will come around nicely in 2023.

pc-quartz-and-yarrow-sustainable-red.title: Quartz & Yarrow Sustainable Red 2016 Okanagan Valley
pc-quartz-and-yarrow-sustainable-red.bodyHtml:
Quartz & Yarrow Sustainable Red 2016 is a rich and expressive Canadian red wine produced by Phantom Creek Estates from sustainably farmed vineyards in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Inspired by a philosophy of environmental responsibility and balanced winemaking, this premium blend combines 53% Cabernet Sauvignon, 36% Merlot, 9% Cabernet Franc and 2% Syrah. Sourced from established vineyards with vines approximately 20 years old, the grapes deliver depth, concentration and a distinctive expression of Okanagan terroir. The wine is matured for 18 months in French oak barrels, including 30% new oak, developing complexity while maintaining its generous fruit character. Deep ruby in colour, Quartz & Yarrow Sustainable Red 2016 offers inviting aromas of black cherry, blackcurrant, ripe plum, vanilla and toasted oak, complemented by notes of licorice, pepper and savoury spice. The full-bodied palate reveals concentrated dark fruit, supple texture, ripe tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a long, opulent finish. Awarded 90 points by wine critic Anthony Gismondi, this elegant yet powerful red blend showcases the richness and sophistication of premium Okanagan Valley winemaking.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs, rosemary-crusted lamb chops, smoked brisket, roast venison and barbecue pork ribs. Its concentrated dark fruit and savoury spice also complement wild mushroom dishes, hearty beef stews, aged cheddar, mature Gouda and other robust hard cheeses.

brocard-chablis-1er-cru-vaulorent.title: Jean-Marc Brocard Chablis 1er Cru Vau De Vey
brocard-chablis-1er-cru-vaulorent.bodyHtml:
A Premier Cru Chablis crafted from Chardonnay grown on the steep east-facing slopes of the Vau De Vey climat. The wine displays vibrant citrus, white flowers, and pronounced mineral character, supported by lively acidity and a long, refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, shellfish, grilled white fish, sushi, roast chicken, and goat cheese.

c-des-carmes-haut-brion-2019.title: Chateau Les Carmes Haut-Brion 2021
c-des-carmes-haut-brion-2019.bodyHtml:
A distinctive Pessac-Léognan with captivating aromas of black cherry, cassis, violet, graphite, smoked herbs, and subtle spice. Elegant yet intensely concentrated, it reveals silky tannins, vibrant acidity, exceptional precision, and a remarkably persistent finish with extraordinary depth and refinement.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast lamb, beef Wellington, duck breast, venison, wild mushroom risotto, aged Comté, truffle dishes, or braised short ribs.

 

97 Points - James Suckling

The texture and weight make this wine classy and unique with subtle berries, chocolate, bark and hints of cloves and dried flowers. Graphite. Medium- to full-bodied with very integrated, fine and lightly chewy tannins with lots of polish and focus. Juicy and crunchy. So much spice and earth. Average vine age of the cabernet franc is 80 years. 45% whole-bunch. 40% cabernet franc, 35% cabernet sauvignon and 25% merlot.

96 Points - Decanter

A gorgeous aromatic display draws you in: crystalline, floral with iris, peony and violet, herbal, earthy and fruity. Sumptuous, this is a classy wine, beautifully smooth but with powdery tannins that give grip and intensity to the structure. It’s grippy at the moment, not as ethereal or silky as some right now, but it’s characterful with power, all while being nuanced and detailed. Charming but still yet to fully come out of its shell. Crunchy, great energy and focus with salty minerality on the finish. This will be a beauty.
95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
I'd put the 2021 Château Les Carmes Haut-Brion up with the crème de la crème of the vintage. Based on 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, 35% Cabernet Sauvignon, and the rest Merlot, aging in 80% new barrels, it offers a brilliant perfume of plum and black raspberry fruits supported by lots of spice and exotic floral notes. Medium to full-bodied on the palate, it has a rounded, expansive mouthfeel that's rare to find in the vintage, terrific mid-palate depth, moderate acidity, and a great finish. It's a singular, brilliant Pessac that will benefit from 2-4 years of bottle age and cruise for 20-25+ in cold cellars. Enough can't be said about the quality and passion being brought to this estate by winemaker Guillaume Pouthier, and this is an estate readers need to be purchasing.
95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2021 Les Carmes Haut-Brion has turned out beautifully in bottle, though it is more introverted and brooding than it appeared during en primeur tastings, unwinding in the glass with aromas of dark berries mingled with spices, loamy soil, licorice, rose petals, gentian and black pepper. Medium to full-bodied, deep and seamless, with a concentrated core of fruit framed by ripe but abundant structuring tannins and bright acids, it concludes with a long, palate-staining finish. As readers may remember, it's a blend of 40% Cabernet Franc, 35% Cabernet Sauvignon and 25% Merlot.

qtr-wines-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: Caymus Special Selection Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 1.5L Magnum
qtr-wines-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
The Caymus 'Special Selection' Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptional wine made from this storied Napa Valley estate. Following some time to open, this incredible Cabernet begins to yield profound aromatics of black cherry compote, blueberry pie and boysenberry along with creosote, black tar, milk chocolate and licorice all soaring from the glass. The mouthfeel is rich, voluptuous and intense, as this wine offers exceedingly dense, concentrated flavors of black cherry reduction, blueberry pie, raspberry liquor and boysenberry, alongside milk chocolate shavings and tar, all cascading on to the long mouth coating finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Lush and polished, with waves of cassis and blackberry compote pouring through, underscored by chocolate, espresso crema and roasted vanilla bean. Maintains a lush, velvety feel through the lengthy finish, where flashes of sweet tobacco and warm earth peek through. For the power Cabernet crowd. Best from 2024 through 2038.

ride-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Obsidian Ridge Volcanic Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
ride-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Obsidian Ridge Volcanic Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a rich, robust, and intense California red wine crafted from high-elevation, volcanic soils planted with obsidian glass gravel in the Mayacamas Mountain Range. On the nose, it unveils expressive aromas of lush boysenberry, dark plum, clove, and toasted oak, intertwined with delicate floral notes of violet and black pepper. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied structure brimming with concentrated blackberry, blood orange peel, dark chocolate, and sarsaparilla flavors, framed by grippy, firm tannins and vibrant acidity that leads into a persistent, structured finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs fantastically with braised lamb shanks, grilled ribeye steak, roasted venison, wild mushroom risotto, or sharp aged cheeses.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine is aromatic, with lush boysenberry, star anise, clove, violets, and toasted oak on the nose. The palate offers blackberry, blood orange peel, sarsaparilla, bittersweet chocolate, vanilla cream, and grippy acidity on the finish. Aerate and pair with lamb shank.

bruce-patch-the-red-dress-red.title: Bruce Patch The Red Dress Primitivo 2019
bruce-patch-the-red-dress-red.bodyHtml:
Bruce Patch The Red Dress Primitivo 2019 is a rich and expressive Californian red wine crafted by Bruce Patch Wines in Sonoma County. Showcasing the bold personality of the Primitivo grape, this distinctive wine offers inviting aromas of ripe blackberries, dark cherries and juicy plums, layered with notes of black pepper, warm baking spices and subtle dark chocolate. Generous and fruit-forward on the palate, it delivers concentrated dark berry flavours, supple tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a smooth, lingering finish. With its vibrant character, savoury complexity and approachable richness, The Red Dress Primitivo is an excellent expression of California's distinctive red wine style.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, barbecued beef brisket, herb-roasted lamb chops, smoky pork ribs and Italian sausage. Its ripe fruit flavours and subtle spice also complement wood-fired pizza, rich tomato-based pasta, roasted eggplant, grilled portobello mushrooms and aged cheddar cheese.

jl-denois-sainte-marie-chardonnay.title: JL Denois Brut Rose Pinot Noir
jl-denois-sainte-marie-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Crafted entirely from Pinot Noir, this traditional method sparkling rose offers aromas of wild strawberry, raspberry, red currant and brioche. The palate is fresh and finely textured with lively acidity, delicate mousse and a crisp, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, smoked salmon, sushi, charcuterie and fresh berry desserts.

volcanic-hills-lava-red.title: Volcanic Hills Lava Red 2020 750ml
volcanic-hills-lava-red.bodyHtml: Light-bodied, aromas of cherry, raspberry, mixed red berries with a hint of spice & oak. It's semi-sweet with flavours of bright red fruits, ripe cherry and plum. Good structure, nicely integrated fruit, oak and acid with velvety tannins and a smooth, lively finish.

gerard-julien-cote-de-nuits-armand.title: Domaine Gerard Julien & Fils Cote De Nuits-Villages Armand 2022
gerard-julien-cote-de-nuits-armand.bodyHtml:
Domaine Gerard Julien & Fils Cote De Nuits-Villages Armand 2022 is a deeply expressive and refined expression of Pinot Noir. It opens with an attractive bouquet dominated by wild black and red fruits, including raspberries and sour cherries, layered with noble green vegetal freshness, violets, and sweet spices. On the palate, the wine is juicy, sensual, and beautifully balanced. Its elegant, well-placed structure features firm, integrated tannins and a vibrant line of crisp acidity that complements the core of ripe fruit. The finish is long, harmonious, and accented by a delicate touch of smoke and lingering baking spices from careful French oak aging.

Food Pairing: This classic, savory Burgundy pairs wonderfully with duck breast served with a berry reduction, roasted goose, grilled lamb chops, veal cutlets, wild mushroom risotto, and classic French cheeses like Comté or Brie de Meaux.

gerard-julien-aloxe-corton-1er-valoziere.title: Domaine Julien Aloxe-Corton 1er Cru 'Les Valozieres' 2020 750ml
gerard-julien-aloxe-corton-1er-valoziere.bodyHtml:
Aloxe-Corton Wine
Cote de Beaune, Burgundy
Prevailing over the charming village of Aloxe, the hill of Corton actually commands the entire appellation. Corton is the only Grand Cru for Pinot Noir in the entire Côte de Beaune. Its Grand Crus red wines can be described simply as “Corton” or Corton hyphenated with other names. These vineyards cover the southeast face of the hill of Corton where soils are rich in red chalk, clay and marl.

Dense and austere when young, the best Corton Pinot Noir will peak in complexity and flavor after about a decade, offering some of the best rewards in cellaring among Côte de Beaune reds. Pommard and Volnay offer similar potential.

The great whites of the village are made within Corton-Charlemagne, a cooler, narrow band of vineyards at the top of the hill that descends west towards the village of Pernand-Vergelesses. Here the thin and white stony soils produce Chardonnay of exceptional character, power and finesse. A minimum of five years in bottle is suggested but some can be amazing long after. Fully half of Aloxe-Corton is considered Grand Cru.

gerard-julien-nuits-saint-georges.title: Domaine Gerard Julien & Fils Nuits-Saint-Georges 2021 750ml
gerard-julien-nuits-saint-georges.bodyHtml:
Nuits-St-Georges Wine
Cote de Nuits, Burgundy
Inhabiting the bottom end of the northern half of the Côte d’Or, Nuits-St-Georges is a busy, market-driven town and home to many of Burgundy’s negociants. It is also the largest town in the Côte d’Or after Beaune and contributes "nuits" to the name of Côte de Nuits (i.e., the northern half of the Côte d’Or).

The appellation itself is divided into two parts, where in the north it directly borders Vosne-Romanée, the southerly end is the commune of Prémeaux. There are no Grands Crus in this village, though it does have a large number of Premiers Crus.

The best Nuits-St-Georges Pinot Noir are layered with cherry, plum, underbrush and sandalwood. The fruit is sweet, the wine energetic, and the finish long and lush.

gerard-julien-nsg-aux-saint-juliens.title: Domaine Gerard Julien & Fils Nuits-Saint-Georges 'Aux Saints-Juliens' 2020
gerard-julien-nsg-aux-saint-juliens.bodyHtml:
Domaine Gérard Julien & Fils Nuits-Saint-Georges 'Aux Saints-Juliens' 2020 is an exceptionally crafted red Burgundy that reflects the rich heritage and meticulous viticulture of Comblanchien-based Domaine Gérard Julien & Fils. Sourced from the single lieu-dit 'Aux Saints-Juliens' situated just south of the Nuits-Saint-Georges town center, this Pinot Noir displays a deep ruby hue in the glass. The nose is highly expressive, opening with alluring aromas of ripe dark cherries, wild blackberries, and redcurrants, layered with subtle notes of crushed violet, forest floor, and delicate oak spice. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied, structured, and elegant, showcasing a concentrated core of dark berry fruit framed by fine-grained, firm tannins and a vibrant, balanced acidity that culminates in a long, savory, limestone-inflected finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted duck breast, pan-seared beef tenderloin, rack of lamb, wild mushroom risotto, coq au vin, and aged French cheeses.

michel-rey-pouilly-fuisse-sur-la-roche.title: Eve & Michel Rey 'Sur La Roche' Pouilly-Fuisse 2020
michel-rey-pouilly-fuisse-sur-la-roche.bodyHtml:
Eve & Michel Rey 'Sur La Roche' Pouilly-Fuissé 2020 is an exquisite, artisanal Premier Cru white Burgundy produced by the dynamic husband-and-wife team Eve and Michel Rey in Vergisson. Sourced from the steep, limestone-dense amphitheater of the 'Sur La Roche' climate—one of Pouilly-Fuissé's most revered Premier Cru sites—the grapes are organically farmed and harvested entirely by hand. Vinified naturally with indigenous yeasts and aged gracefully in seasoned neutral oak barrels, this wine presents a luminous pale gold color. The complex, highly aromatic nose opens with refined scents of lemon curd, white peach, acacia blossom, crushed chalk, and subtle roasted hazelnut notes. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied, precise, and tense, balancing concentrated orchard fruit and rich texture with a striking backbone of mineral acidity, leading to a long, chiseled, saline-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with butter-poached lobster, pan-seared sea scallops, roasted Bresse chicken, turbot in cream sauce, wild mushroom risotto, and aged goat cheese.

michel-rey-pouilly-fuisse-aux-charmes.title: Eve & Michel Rey Aux Charmes Pouilly-Fuisse 2020 750ml
michel-rey-pouilly-fuisse-aux-charmes.bodyHtml:
The nose is delicately floral. Vanilla and anise share the aromatic palette but citrus fruits are not left out.

The woodiness is very well integrated here and we can clearly sense the transformation of the aging with orange notes. The finish is still toasty and will still require a little time to integrate, but it bodes well for ensuring this wine has many good years ahead of it. The freshness remains astonishing in the midst of this opulence. Density, chiseling and roundness characterize this wine with very good aging potential.

breton-clos-senechal-bougueil.title: Breton Clos Senechal Bougueil
breton-clos-senechal-bougueil.bodyHtml:
Breton Clos Sénéchal Bourgueil is a biodynamic Cabernet Franc from a single south-facing vineyard in Restigné. Concentrated aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, violet, graphite, and herbs lead to a structured palate with silky tannins, vibrant freshness, pronounced minerality, and exceptional aging potential

Food Pairing: Pair with roast lamb, duck breast, grilled beef, mushroom dishes, charcuterie, or aged goat and hard cheeses.

caparsa-chianti-class-riserva-caparsino.title: Caparsa Doccio A Matteo Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 750ml
caparsa-chianti-class-riserva-caparsino.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2016 vintage) "Big and enveloping giving immediate pleasure in the vibrant sensory picture that is rich with sour cherries, wild un-ripe strawberries, crumbled plaster, withered jasmine and wet lavender. Full bodied, juicy and brilliant on the palate showing the greatness of the terroir and the correct interpretation of a slightly early harvest. The tannins are mature and slightly rustic giving dynamism and tension and the finale is vertical, one of the freshest and sharp in the tasting. Exceptional now but will be better from 2023." - 95/100, Raffaele Vecchione - WinesCritic.com

caparsa-chianti-ris-doccio-a-matteo.title: Caparsa Doccio A Matteo Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 750ml
caparsa-chianti-ris-doccio-a-matteo.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2016 vintage) "Big and enveloping giving immediate pleasure in the vibrant sensory picture that is rich with sour cherries, wild un-ripe strawberries, crumbled plaster, withered jasmine and wet lavender. Full bodied, juicy and brilliant on the palate showing the greatness of the terroir and the correct interpretation of a slightly early harvest. The tannins are mature and slightly rustic giving dynamism and tension and the finale is vertical, one of the freshest and sharp in the tasting. Exceptional now but will be better from 2023." - 95/100, Raffaele Vecchione - WinesCritic.com

la-croix-ducru-beaucaillou-2019.title: La Croix Ducru-Beaucaillou 2022
la-croix-ducru-beaucaillou-2019.bodyHtml:
A focused and compact nose that first reveals kirsch and blueberry coulis, with nuances of cloves, Bourbon vanilla, dried black ink and smoky graphite slowly unfurling in the glass. The palate is composed of a dense core with a backbone of very fine-grained tannins enveloped in rich fruits, giving a suave silky texture to the wine. A vein of saline freshness weaves through the fruit and underscores the lingering spicy fruit finish. A wine with pedigree and panache.

95 Points - James Suckling

Such a youthful La Croix that’s full of bright blue fruit with lots of mineral tension. Violets, graphite and wet stones on the nose. Tight-grained and crunchy on the palate, with an almost full body and a long, fresh and compact finish. Firm, fresh and vibrant, with nicely chewy, stony tannins.
