It needs three to four years to come around. 66% merlot, 32% cabernet sauvignon and 2% petit verdot.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 La Croix de Beaucaillou opens in the glass with aromas of dark berries, cigar wrapper and fresh mint, framed by creamy new oak. Medium to full-bodied, rich and fleshy, with a deep core of fruit framed by chunky tannins, it's a blend of 66% Merlot, 32% Cabernet Sauvignon and 2% Petit Verdot.

poggiocaro-brunello-di-montalcino-reserv.title: Poggiocaro Brunello di Montalcino
poggiocaro-brunello-di-montalcino-reserv.bodyHtml:
Crafted from 100% Sangiovese in the renowned hills of Montalcino, this Brunello displays classic aromas of black cherry, wild berries, violet, tobacco, leather, and sweet spice. Full-bodied and elegant, it combines vibrant acidity with refined tannins and remarkable depth, culminating in a long and age-worthy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with braised beef, lamb shank, wild boar ragù, truffle dishes, and aged Pecorino cheese.

chateau-fleur-haut-gaussens-grand-vin.title: Chateau Haut-Brion 2016 750ml
chateau-fleur-haut-gaussens-grand-vin.bodyHtml:
#55 Wine Enthusiast Top 100 Cellar Selections of 2019

Blend: 56% Merlot, 37.5% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6.5% Cabernet Franc


100pts Wine Enthusiast

Immensely tannic, this is a great Haut-Brion, one of the finest for many years. It shows the severe side of this estate, with a dense structure to match the powerful black fruits. Rich with berry flavors and lifted by enough acidity, the wine will age for many years. Drink from 2026.
Cellar Selection

100pts Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2016 Haut-Brion is blended of 56% Merlot, 37.5% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6.5% Cabernet Franc. Medium to deep garnet-purple colored, the nose is at once profound and arresting, offering drop-dead gorgeous Morello cherries, lilacs and red rose scents with a core of Black Forest cake, warm blackcurrants and blueberry preserves plus wafts of sandalwood and underbrush. Medium-bodied, the elegantly crafted palate is completely packed with intense floral, mineral and cassis-laced flavors with a firm frame of very finely pixelated tannins and seamless freshness, finishing very long and achingly stunning.

100pts James Suckling
Stunning black fruit with plenty of forest berries in there, the whole picture cool and very delicate, also on the concentrated and highly structured palate. The tannins are very fine-grained, but decisively austere and, together with the vibrant acidity, they propel the finish out towards infinity and leave a breathtaking final impression. A blend of 56 per cent merlot, 37.5 per cent cabernet sauvignon and 6.5 per cent cabernet franc. Very long aging potential, but you could try it in 2023.

100pts Decanter
This has a little more reticence initially on the nose than La Mission, but after a few minutes the rich texture begins to reveal itself, with charcoal, tobacco, dark plum and damson fruits that are straining at the leash. It has hidden power and subtle oak toasting - this clearly feels no need to shout about its presence, but there will be plenty to discover over time. You can feel those tannins licking around your teeth, building up one layer at a time. A great wine En primeur that has settled into greatness.

98pts Wine Spectator
Large and in charge, this has a prodigious core of steeped plum, black currant and loganberry fruit flavors that show both compote and coulis aspects. While that steeps, this delivers a sturdy frame of roasted mesquite, smoldering tobacco and incense, surrounding a muscular spine of worn cedar and tar. Still rather backward, this will be showing well when most others from the vintage have had their day. Best from 2025 through 2045.

98pts Jeb Dunnuck
As to the reds, the 2016 Haut Brion is a prodigious, legendary wine in the making, although it’s not for those seeking instant gratification. Deeper colored and more concentrated than the La Mission Haut Brion, it reveals a purple/ruby color as well as a sensational bouquet of blackcurrants, cassis, cigar tobacco, cold fireplace, violets, and lead pencil. Deep, masculine, structured, and mineral-laced, it has a stacked mid-palate, full-bodied richness, building tannins, and a firm, blockbuster styled finish that lasts for close to a minute. A wine for the ages, don’t even think about opening bottles for at least 7-8 years. It should keep for half a century. The blend in 2016 is 56% Merlot, 37.5% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 6.5% Cabernet Franc.
Rating: 98+

merlin-cherrier-sancerre-chene-marchand.title: Thierry Merlin Cherrier Le Chene Marchand Sancerre Blanc 2019
merlin-cherrier-sancerre-chene-marchand.bodyHtml:
Thierry Merlin-Cherrier Le Chêne Marchand Sancerre Blanc 2019 is an elegant French white wine from the prestigious Sancerre appellation in the Loire Valley, France. Produced from Sauvignon Blanc grapes grown in the renowned Le Chêne Marchand vineyard, this wine showcases the distinctive minerality, freshness, and refined character associated with Sancerre. The 2019 vintage offers an expressive combination of citrus fruits, green apple, delicate floral aromas, and mineral complexity. Its crisp acidity, elegant structure, and refreshing finish make it an excellent choice for seafood, fine dining, and wine enthusiasts seeking a classic Loire Valley Sauvignon Blanc.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, grilled shrimp, scallops, baked salmon, goat cheese, seafood pasta, roasted chicken, asparagus, and light Mediterranean dishes.

brand-napa-valley-vineyard-no95-cabernet.title: Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
brand-napa-valley-vineyard-no95-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Beaulieu Vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is a rich, elegant, and full-bodied red wine from California's renowned Napa Valley. Crafted with carefully selected Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine showcases the region's exceptional winemaking heritage and Beaulieu Vineyard's commitment to quality. It offers concentrated dark fruit flavours, refined tannins, and subtle oak influences, creating a beautifully balanced and sophisticated drinking experience. With its smooth texture, layered complexity, and lingering finish, this Cabernet Sauvignon is an excellent choice for special occasions, fine dining, or enjoying with a hearty meal.

Food Pairing: Perfect with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, barbecue, hearty pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses such as cheddar and Gouda.

 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast 

Focused and brilliant flavors of red and black cherries and black currants drive this sleek and powerful wine, as minty, toasty, and tobacco-like accents stay subtly in the background until the finish. A full body, medium to full tannins and good fruit acidity lend tangy freshness. Best from 2026.

91 Points - James Suckling 

A juicy and delicious wine with a round and polished texture with hints of chocolate and walnuts. Some iron shavings, too. Medium body. Savory at the end. Lovely dark fruit in the finish. Juicy. Drink now.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Shows a light mesquite edge that mingles with gently mulled plum and blackberry fruit flavors, while lightly singed vanilla and tobacco fill in through the finish. Reveals a solid graphite spine, too. Drink now through 2033. Tasted twice, with consistent notes

brand-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.title: Caymus Special Selection Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 1.5L Magnum
brand-cabernet-sauvignon-2018.bodyHtml:
The Caymus 'Special Selection' Cabernet Sauvignon is an exceptional wine made from this storied Napa Valley estate. Following some time to open, this incredible Cabernet begins to yield profound aromatics of black cherry compote, blueberry pie and boysenberry along with creosote, black tar, milk chocolate and licorice all soaring from the glass. The mouthfeel is rich, voluptuous and intense, as this wine offers exceedingly dense, concentrated flavors of black cherry reduction, blueberry pie, raspberry liquor and boysenberry, alongside milk chocolate shavings and tar, all cascading on to the long mouth coating finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Lush and polished, with waves of cassis and blackberry compote pouring through, underscored by chocolate, espresso crema and roasted vanilla bean. Maintains a lush, velvety feel through the lengthy finish, where flashes of sweet tobacco and warm earth peek through. For the power Cabernet crowd. Best from 2024 through 2038.

immortal-estate-slope-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
immortal-estate-slope-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

louis-latour-corton-charlemagne-grand-cr.title: Domaine Vincent Latour Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 750ml
louis-latour-corton-charlemagne-grand-cr.bodyHtml: Louis Latour Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 2022 has a bright and pale yellow color. Its nose is intense with toasty, floral aromas, particularly honeysuckle. The palate is full and round, with aromas of brioche and vanilla. The finish lingers on notes of acacia honey.

latour-aloxe-corton-1er-cru-les-chaillot.title: Louis Latour Aloxe-Corton Premier Cru Les Chaillots 2020
latour-aloxe-corton-1er-cru-les-chaillot.bodyHtml:
Deep ruby-garnet in colour, opening with expressive aromas of ripe wild raspberry, black cherry, redcurrant, and crushed violet, layered with subtle notes of forest floor, clove, liquorice, and toasted French oak. The palate is medium-to-full-bodied, structured, and refined, delivering concentrated red and dark berry flavours framed by firm yet silky tannins, lively Burgundian acidity, and a long, mineral-laced finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with roasted duck breast with cherry reduction, coq au vin, herb-crusted rack of lamb, beef Bourguignon, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Burgundian cheeses such as Epoisses and Citeaux.

louis-latour-volnay-en-chevret-2020.title: Louis Latour Volnay Premier Cru En Chevret 2020
louis-latour-volnay-en-chevret-2020.bodyHtml:
Louis Latour Volnay Premier Cru En Chevret 2020 is an elegant red Burgundy from the prestigious Côte de Beaune, crafted entirely from Pinot Noir grown in the renowned En Chevret vineyard. Situated near the celebrated Caillerets vineyard, this Premier Cru benefits from clay-limestone soils and an eastern exposure. Matured for 10–12 months in French oak barrels, the wine offers concentrated black cherry, delicate earthy notes, and subtle coffee aromas. Its rounded palate, supple tannins, and refined structure beautifully express the character of Volnay and the richness of the 2020 vintage.

Food Pairing: Veal with creamy morel sauce, roasted duck, venison, wild mushroom risotto, herb-crusted lamb, and mature cheeses.

 

95 Points - James Suckling

This is so sensual that it's dangerous and it ought to be classified as a listed drug! So sweet, silky and delicate, in spite of the excellent structure behind it. Only medium-bodied, but in a particular way that increases its appeal. Then comes the very fresh finish that makes it positively refreshing. Drink or hold.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Powerful and concentrated aromas of crushed rose petals and strawberry shrub dusted with white pepper sit atop a layer of wild mint, cardamom and musk. Dark black cherry, black licorice and oak spice meld seamlessly with its youthful tannins.

carter-beckstoffer-missouri-hopper-cab.title: Carter Cellars Beckstoffer Missouri Hopper Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 750ml
carter-beckstoffer-missouri-hopper-cab.bodyHtml:
This wine is a 100% Cabernet Sauvignon blend from all of our vineyards and showcases the best that Napa Valley has to offer. The various vineyard elements blend together to create a rich, lush Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon with tremendous concentration and intensity. On the palate, this wine offers everything you would want from a great Cabernet Sauvignon, including dense flavors of blackberry, damp earth and tobacco undertones framed by a well-integrated oak profile. This full-bodied, layered and racy style shows the purity and elegance of the 2019 vintage, a wine suitable for cellaring as well as immediate enjoyment.

97 Points Antonio Galloni
The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer Missouri Hopper, a new wine in this range, is terrific. It has all the savoriness that is such a signature of this southern sector in Oakville, along with the textural richness readers have come to expect from Mark Carter. I love the energy and vibrancy here. The Hopper Cabernet is a great addition to this lineup. Don't miss it.

redtail-vineyard-nero-davola.title: Gulfi Nerobaronj Nero d'Avola
redtail-vineyard-nero-davola.bodyHtml:
This remarkably sophisticated, energetic, and masterfully precise organic Sicilian red wine stands as a legendary single-vineyard cru. It opens with an alluring, high-toned bouquet of wild raspberries, blood orange zest, and fresh red cherries, beautifully accented by sophisticated notes of field violets, licorice root, sweet pipe tobacco, and an underlying streak of smoky volcanic ash and flint. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it showcases an impeccable vertical balance, offering an almost effortless, easy-drinking core of red orchard berries that is instantly elevated by an electric, mouth-watering regional acidity. A dense line of chalky mineral tension and subtle, fine-grained tannins anchors the beautifully structured mid-palate, carrying into an impressively long, dry, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: A majestic partner for fine gastronomy; pairs flawlessly with roasted duck breast, grilled lamb chops, slow-braised veal shanks, rich mushroom risottos, or traditional wild boar ragù.

castello-di-querceto-chianti-classico-gr.title: Castello Di Querceto Il Picchio Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2018 750ml
castello-di-querceto-chianti-classico-gr.bodyHtml: Castello Di Querceto Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Il Picchio2018 750ml

castello-di-querceto-colli-della-toscana.title: Castello Di Querceto Colli Della Toscana Centrale La Corte 2018 750ml
castello-di-querceto-colli-della-toscana.bodyHtml: Castello di Querceto La Corte 2018 is a Chianti Classico Gran Selezione from a south- and south-west-facing vineyard with well-drained sandy soils. The 2018 season brought freezing winter temperatures and a hot summer. The wine is aged 12 months in barriques and tonneaux of Tronçais and Allier oak, then a further six months in bottle before release. 750ml, 13.5% ABV.

chateau-cantenac-brown.title: Chateau Cantenac Brown
chateau-cantenac-brown.bodyHtml:
A historic Margaux estate renowned for elegance and precision, Château Cantenac Brown reveals aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, violet, cedar, graphite, and fine oak. Richly layered yet beautifully refined, it offers silky tannins, vibrant freshness, remarkable depth, and an exceptionally long, graceful finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, truffle potatoes, aged Comté, wild mushrooms, or braised short ribs.

soul-growers-provident-shiraz.title: Soul Growers Provident Shiraz 2023
soul-growers-provident-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Deep and vibrant with blackcurrant, ripe cherry, plum and dark berry aromas accented by peppery spice. The palate delivers lifted fruit, bright acidity and fine, sandy tannins, with softly integrated oak adding structure before an elegant, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with grilled steak, slow-roasted lamb, beef short ribs, barbecue ribs, mushroom dishes, or hearty beef stews.

domaine-des-pasquiers-gigondas.title: Domaine Des Pasquiers Gigondas 2022 750ml
domaine-des-pasquiers-gigondas.bodyHtml: This 50/50 Grenache/Syrah blend is a powerful and complex wine with notes of Jammy black cherries, white pepper and spicy aromas. The perfect companion for game, beef and venison ragu!

fabrizio-iuli-vino-rosso-umberta.title: Umberto Cesari Liano 2022
fabrizio-iuli-vino-rosso-umberta.bodyHtml:
Umberto Cesari Liano 2023 is an expressive, richly structured Italian red blend crafted by Umberto Cesari in the rolling hills of Castel San Pietro Terme, Emilia-Romagna. Composed of 70% Sangiovese Grosso and 30% Cabernet Sauvignon sourced from estate vineyards planted on clay-rich hillside soils, the two varietals are harvested and vinified separately with temperature-controlled fermentation before being blended and matured for 18 months in French oak tonneaux and barriques, followed by bottle aging. In the glass, it displays a luminous, deep ruby-red hue with garnet reflections. The aromatic profile opens with intense notes of ripe black cherry, blackberry, and plum layered with sweet baking spices, vanilla, cocoa, and subtle Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, velvety mouthfeel balanced by lively acidity and smooth, well-integrated tannins, culminating in a long, harmonious, and savory finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled prime ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù with tagliatelle, roasted lamb chops, or aged Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese.

michel-mallard-savigny-1er-serpent-2005.title: Domaine Michel Mallard Savigny-Les-Beaune 1er Cru 'Les Serpentieres' 750ml
michel-mallard-savigny-1er-serpent-2005.bodyHtml: Domaine Michel Mallard's Savigny-Les-Beaune 1er Cru "Les Serpentieres" is a red Burgundy wine made from 100% Pinot Noir grapes. It is known for its complex bouquet of dark fruits, including black cherry and blackberry, along with hints of earth, spice, and leather. The wine is full-bodied and velvety, with rich flavors of black fruit and a long, lingering finish.

mark-herold-oakville-cabernet.title: Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
mark-herold-oakville-cabernet.bodyHtml:
Robert Mondavi The Estates Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a rich, powerful, and impeccably balanced Napa Valley red wine. Sourced primarily from the historic To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville, it captures the depth, tension, and signature valley floor character of this iconic AVA. In the glass, it displays a dark garnet color with vibrant aromas of ripe blackberries, black cherries, cassis, and fresh mint. On the palate, it is full-bodied, delivering complex layers of dark fruit preserves, cocoa, dried herbs, and graphite, structured by firm, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity leading to a long finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with prime dry-aged ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, venison tenderloin, and aged sharp cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberries and black cherries on the nose lead to vivid focused cherries, blueberries and minty, spicy accents on the palate. Firm in tannins and fresh with good acidity, this outstanding wine is well-balanced.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Generous in feel, this offers up a big gush of boysenberry, plum and blackberry preserve flavors that fold in nicely, with licorice, apple wood and cocoa notes on the finish.

grassi-ribolla-gialla.title: Grassi Ribolla Gialla 750ml
grassi-ribolla-gialla.bodyHtml: Standout white wine of the day. Apple, pear, brioche, peach, grass, almond, hay, and some lemon. What a nice balance between fruits and earthy notes. Refreshing, floral, with some pear, honeydew, and almonds.

chateau-olivier-pessac-leognan-rouge-aoc.title: Chateau Olivier Le Dauphin d Olivier 2016
chateau-olivier-pessac-leognan-rouge-aoc.bodyHtml:
A refined Pessac Leognan with aromas of blackberry, black cherry, cedar, and subtle spice. Medium-bodied with polished tannins and fresh acidity, it offers elegant structure, balanced dark fruit, and a persistent finish with delicate earthy and mineral notes.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roast lamb, grilled beef, duck, mushroom dishes, and aged cheeses.

 

91 Points - James Suckling

A firm and round-textured red with juicy plum and chocolate character and a medium finish. Shows richness and ripeness for a second wine. Better after 2021.

ol-pommard-charmots-premier-cru.title: Parent Pommard 1er Cru Les Charmots
ol-pommard-charmots-premier-cru.bodyHtml:
Parent Pommard 1er Cru Les Charmots is crafted from Pinot Noir grown on the clay-limestone soils of this distinguished Premier Cru vineyard. Matured in French oak, it reveals vibrant red cherry, blackberry, violet, and spice with refined tannins, fresh acidity, and an elegant, persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with duck breast, roast lamb, beef tenderloin, wild mushroom dishes, and aged Gruyere.

sadie-family-palladius.title: The Sadie Family Palladius 2021
sadie-family-palladius.bodyHtml:
The Sadie Family Palladius 2021 is a benchmark South African multi-varietal white blend produced by winemaker Eben Sadie. Sourced from 17 distinct, low-yielding old-vine sites across the Swartland, it undergoes whole-bunch pressing and spontaneous fermentation, followed by 12 months of aging in concrete eggs and clay amphorae and an additional 12 months in large neutral oak foudres. In the glass, it exhibits a brilliant straw color with complex aromas of waxed lemon, dried apricots, white flowers, sea salt, melted candle wax, and subtle herbal nuances. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and layered with incredible tension and texture, offering notes of lemon pastry cream, ginger, and stone fruit balanced by a piercing streak of natural acidity and a long, saline, mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted pork belly, grilled lobster with herb butter, pan-seared scallops, creamy poultry dishes, and aged goat cheese.

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Toeing the line to triple digits, the 2021 Palladius is a blend of Chenin Blanc, Grenache Blanc, Marsanne, Roussanne, Viognier, Sémillon, Colombard, Verdellho and Palomino. Instantly impressive in the glass, the wine is bold with waxy aromas that sway with seductive notes of lemon pastry cream, dusty melon and citrus blossoms. Medium-bodied and with 13.7% alcohol, the palate is succulent and bright with fantastic acid and displays a kiss of phenolic bitterness that beams with focus and precision. Subtle notes of beeswax and lees drive the finish with immense complexity and considerable weight. The aftertaste summersaults with complexity, offering fresh and bright citrus notes with notions of dusty flowers. It will remain food friendly for decades. It's devastatingly beautiful and cerebral.

96 Points - James Suckling

This is showing aromas of waxed lemons, thyme, grapefruit rind, mango stones, apricots, white flowers and sea shells. Seductively supple, fresh, with bright acidity and a seashell-like minerality. Sophisticated, seamless blend that makes you think. Holding back a little at the moment. Blend of 35% chenin blanc, with equal parts of marsanne, roussanne, clairette, colombard, viognier, verdelho, palomino, grenache blanc, grenache gris, semillon blanc and semillon gris.

sadie-family-columella.title: The Sadie Family Columella 2023
sadie-family-columella.bodyHtml:
The Sadie Family Columella 2023 is a benchmark South African red blend produced by visionary winemaker Eben Sadie. Crafted from old, dry-farmed bush vines across multiple distinct soil types in the Swartland region—including granite, slate, and gravel—this wine undergoes spontaneous fermentation in open concrete tanks followed by 24 months of aging in French oak barrels and large foudres. In the glass, it reveals a deep ruby hue with complex aromas of dark cherries, fresh plums, garrigue, sandalwood, oriental spices, and delicate floral violets. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, elegant, and tightly wound, displaying fine-grained, silky tannins, vibrant acidity, and an exceptionally long, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, grilled ribeye steak, venison tagine, wild mushroom risotto, and mature hard cheeses.

98 Points - James Suckling

Black cherries, fresh plums, sandalwood, peach pits, sage and cloves on the nose of this deliciously polished and complex red. It’s medium- to full-bodied, intense yet full of finesse and elegance, with firm and very fine-grained tannins. Long, continuous and delicious, with a beautiful interplay of fruit and spice. I love this wine. Syrah, mourvedre, grenache, carignan, cinsault, tinta barocca and pinotage. Drinkable already but better after a couple of years.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Sadie Family 2023 Swartland Columella is fresh yet densely concentrated, offering layered dark fruit, savory spice and impressive volume across a beautifully fleshed-out mid-palate. Drawn from multiple Swartland sites across Paardeberg, Kasteelberg, Malmesbury and Piketberg, the wine blends Syrah, Mourvèdre, Grenache, Carignan, Cinsault and Tinta Barroca aged over 24 months into a seamless regional expression. The complex mix of schist, granite, limestone, alluvial clay and sandstone underscores Columella’s identity as a true Swartland benchmark. Despite the challenges of cloudy weather, vintner Eben Sadie says 2023 is one of his most satisfying vintages.

benjamin-zidarich-vitovska.title: Zidarich Vitovska 2019 750ml
benjamin-zidarich-vitovska.bodyHtml: Zidarich Vitovska 2019 is a skin-contact white from Benjamin Zidarich in the Carso, the limestone plateau of Friuli Venezia Giulia in north-east Italy. Vitovska is a native white grape found almost only in this corner of Italy, where it grows on iron-rich red soils. Zidarich's winemaking is rooted in the character of the vine and the territory, with close attention to the natural balance of the vineyard. Because the juice ferments in contact with the grape skins, the wine has the texture and grip often associated with orange wine. 750ml, 12.5% ABV.

benjamin-zidarich-prulke.title: Zidarich Prulke 2019 750ml
benjamin-zidarich-prulke.bodyHtml: Zidarich Prulke 2019 is a white blend of Vitovska, Malvasia and Sauvignon from Benjamin and Marisa Zidarich, who tend about 8 hectares in the rocky Carso of Friuli Venezia Giulia, on the Slovenian border, in a natural, low-intervention style. Its name comes from the historic place-name Prulke, the area just below Prepotto where the winery stands and where the estate is expanding its vineyards; the winery describes it as a wine that mirrors its land. Alcohol is 13%.

benjamin-zidarich-terran.title: Benzamin Zidarich Teran 2019 750ml
benjamin-zidarich-terran.bodyHtml: Zidarich Teran is a red from Benjamin Zidarich in the Carso, in Friuli-Venezia Giulia. Terrano is one of the few red grapes of the Carso, its name linked to the red earth it grows in. It gives crunchy, earth-tinged red fruit, bright acidity, fresh herbs and red liquorice at a modest alcohol level. 750ml, 11.5% ABV.

benjamin-zidarich-lehte-malvasia.title: Zidarich Lehte Malvasia 2019 750ml
benjamin-zidarich-lehte-malvasia.bodyHtml: Lehte Malvasia 2019 comes from Benjamin Zidarich in the Carso, the limestone plateau of Friuli-Venezia Giulia near the Slovenian border. It is made from Malvasia Istriana, the finest of Italy's many Malvasia grapes, grown in Friuli and neighbouring Slovenia. This 2019 is a 750ml bottle at 14.5% ABV.

remi-leroy-extra-brut.title: Remi Leroy Extra Brut Champagne 2019 750ml
remi-leroy-extra-brut.bodyHtml: Rémi Leroy Extra Brut is a grower Champagne from Meurville in the Côte des Bar, in the Aube at the southern end of the Champagne region, on the same Kimmeridgian limestone as nearby Chablis. Rémi Leroy trained in Bordeaux as an oenologist and agricultural engineer before taking over his 9-hectare family estate, which once sold all its grapes to the large houses; he now bottles part of the crop under his own name. His vineyards are mostly Pinot Noir with Chardonnay and some Pinot Meunier. He settles juice naturally, ferments with native yeasts, keeps sulphur low and picks fully ripe fruit so his dosages can stay low. 750ml, 12.5% alcohol.

remi-leroy-blanc-de-noirs.title: Remi Leroy Blanc De Noirs Champagne 2018 750ml
remi-leroy-blanc-de-noirs.bodyHtml: Rémi Leroy Blanc de Noirs 2018 is a grower Champagne made entirely from Pinot Noir: a white Champagne pressed from black grapes. The wine spends at least five years ageing before it is disgorged. This 2018 is a 750ml bottle at 12.5% ABV.

remi-leroy-blanc-de-blancs.title: Remi Leroy Blanc de Noirs Reserve
remi-leroy-blanc-de-blancs.bodyHtml:
A distinctive grower Champagne revealing ripe red berries, yellow fruit, dried flowers, brioche, and delicate spice. Pinot Noir provides generous texture and vinous depth, while fine bubbles and mineral freshness create an elegant, precise Extra Brut with impressive balance and persistence.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast poultry, pork, salmon, shellfish, charcuterie, mushroom dishes, soft cheeses, or refined appetizers.

remi-leroy-4-cepages-mer-sur-mont.title: Remi Leroy Mer Sur Mont Blanc De Quatre Cepages Champagne 2014 750ml
remi-leroy-4-cepages-mer-sur-mont.bodyHtml: Mer sur Mont 2014 is a vintage Champagne from Rémi Leroy, a family domaine of about eight hectares at Meurville in the Côte des Bar. Rémi Leroy trained as an oenologist and agronomist in Bordeaux before taking on the vineyards, which grow on clay-limestone soils of the Upper Jurassic and are planted mainly with Pinot Noir. As its name says, this cuvée is a white Champagne made from four grape varieties, among them Pinot Blanc. Gault&Millau scored the 2014 90/100, describing a bright, sunny colour, pastry and yellow-fruit tart on the nose, and a salty, pure palate with crisp acidity balanced by a 6 g/l dosage and a refreshing finish. 750ml, 12.5% alcohol.

remi-leroy-rose-saignee-les-crots.title: Remi Leroy Les Crots Rose De Saignee Champagne 2018 750ml
remi-leroy-rose-saignee-les-crots.bodyHtml: Rémi Leroy Les Crots Rosé de Saignée 2018 is a single-vineyard rosé Champagne from a grower based in Meurville, in the Côte des Bar, in the Aube region of Champagne. Rémi Leroy trained in oenology and works mainly with Pinot Noir, alongside some Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier. Les Crots is a mid-slope Pinot Noir parcel facing south-east, and this small-production cuvée is made entirely from its grapes. Rather than blending red wine into white, the colour comes from the saignée method: the must stays in contact with the skins for an extended maceration, which gives a deep ruby hue. Bottled at 12.5% in 750ml from the 2018 harvest.

mazzolino-pinot-noir-doc.title: Tenuta Mazzolino Noir Pinot Nero 2018 750ml
mazzolino-pinot-noir-doc.bodyHtml: Tenuta Mazzolino Noir 2018 is a 100% Pinot Nero from the Oltrepò Pavese in Lombardy, northern Italy. The family-owned estate works with high-density, low-yield vineyards on clay-loam soils veined with sandstone over a gypsum base, and follows a minimal-intervention philosophy. Grapes are hand-harvested and fermented in stainless steel before ageing in oak barrels for 12 months. 750ml, 13.5% ABV.

aia-vecchia-orleto.title: Aia Vecchia Orleto 2018
aia-vecchia-orleto.bodyHtml:
Aia Vecchia Orleto 2018 is a remarkably sophisticated and powerful single-varietal red wine that marks a significant milestone as the estate’s first new wine release in over two decades. Crafted exclusively from Cabernet Franc grapes grown in the sun-drenched vineyards of the Bolgheri coastal region, it showcases a deep, concentrated ruby-purple color with an complex and enticing aromatic profile. The nose opens with intense layers of black cherry, crushed blackberries, and dark plums, seamlessly integrated with characteristic varietal notes of dried herbs, graphite, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is bold yet meticulously structured, displaying an excellent balance between ripe, opulent dark fruit and a vibrant backbone of acidity. Firm, fine-grained, and velvety tannins give it an elegant mouthfeel that carries through to an exceptionally long, savory, and beautifully perfumed finish. It represents a masterful and authentic expression of how perfectly suited the maritime microclimate of the Tuscan coast is for producing top-tier, world-class Cabernet Franc.

Food Pairing: This robust and structured Cabernet Franc pairs beautifully with roasted rosemary rack of lamb, grilled ribeye steak, wild boar ragù, or aged pecorino cheese.

oberon-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Michael Mondavi Oberon Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 750ml
oberon-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
A kiss of Petit Verdot and a dash of Zinfandel helped to create Oberon's deep colors, supple silky tannins, and notes of vibrant black cherry, candied blackberry and spices. A hint of coffee and dark chocolate create a lingering and delightful finish.

91 Points - Tasting Panel

Spiced cedar Lunardo cherry and a warming note of onnamon create an appealing mouthfeel and flavor profile Touches of tiled earth, sweet tobacon and muling spices ft well into this balanced red.

chateau-moulin-du-cadet.title: Yvon Mau Chateau Moulin de la Riviere
chateau-moulin-du-cadet.bodyHtml:
Yvon Mau Château Moulin de la Rivière is a classic Médoc Bordeaux red blend crafted from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Cabernet Franc. This Left Bank wine showcases aromas of cassis, red cherry, earth, and spice, with a balanced palate featuring firm tannins, fresh acidity, refined structure, and a lingering finish.

Food Pairing:Grilled beef, lamb chops, roasted poultry, game meats, mushroom dishes, aged cheeses, and traditional French cuisine.

gloria-reynolds-tradition.title: Reynolds Wine Growers Gloria Reynolds Art & Tradition2011 750ml
gloria-reynolds-tradition.bodyHtml: Reynolds Wine Growers Gloria Reynolds Art & Tradition2011 750ml

william-cuvee-deutz.title: Deutz Cuvee William Deutz Millesime Brut Champagne 2013 750ml
william-cuvee-deutz.bodyHtml: Cuvée William Deutz is the prestige champagne of Deutz, the independent family house founded in Aÿ in 1838. Launched in 1959 as a tribute to founder William Deutz, it became the house's flagship cuvée. It is made predominantly from Grand Cru Pinot Noir with Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier, drawing on the terroirs of Aÿ, Bouzy, Verzenay and the Côte des Blancs, and is aged for around ten years in the house's historic cellars before release. The house describes it as a dense, distinguished wine for connoisseurs in which candied fruit, liquorice and toasted notes develop with age, and recommends it with fine dining such as lobster, foie gras, caviar and refined meats. This listing is the 2013 vintage, 750ml.

the-absconder-grenache.title: Upsidedown Cluster F@*#!! Grenache 750ml
the-absconder-grenache.bodyHtml: Upsidedown Grenache Whole Cluster is a red wine from the Yakima Valley AVA in Washington state. It's made from Grenache grapes that are partially fermented using the whole-cluster method, which means that many of the berries are not crushed before fermentation. The wine has a bright, amiable nose with notes of fresh red raspberry, bing cherry, wild strawberry, and wet stone minerality. It also has savory aromas of chocolate, pepper, mint, and fresh thyme.

sette-cieli-indaco-toscana-igt.title: Tenuta Sette Cieli Indaco 2018 750ml
sette-cieli-indaco-toscana-igt.bodyHtml: Tenuta Sette Cieli Indaco 2018 is a Toscana IGT red from Tenuta Sette Cieli in Tuscany, Italy. Winemaker Elena Pozzolini has become one of the most talked-about rising names in Tuscany, and Indaco is the estate's Bordeaux-style blend of Malbec, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. It is a powerful, age-worthy wine, smooth and open-knit when young, with savoury notes of leather and cedar and good grip, and it shows the ripeness and warmth of its vintage. Its simple label carries just the Indaco name above Tenuta Sette Cieli. 750ml, 14% ABV.

sette-cieli-scipio-toscana-igt.title: Tenuta Sette Cieli Scipio 2018 750ml
sette-cieli-scipio-toscana-igt.bodyHtml: Tenuta Sette Cieli Scipio 2018 is the flagship of an organic estate founded by the family of Erika Ratti in the high coastal hills of Monteverdi Marittimo, above Bolgheri in the Tuscan Maremma. Named after the Roman general Scipio Africanus, it comes from terraced estate vineyards at about 400 metres, rooted in poor, rocky soils of galestro, alberese limestone and flint. The site combines strong high-altitude sunlight with cooling sea breezes and wide day-night temperature swings, which the estate credits with allowing Cabernet Franc to ripen fully while keeping freshness. Bottled as Toscana IGT, 750ml, 14.5% alcohol.

paul-autard-chateauneuf-du-pape.title: Clos Des Papes (Paul-Vincent Avril) Chateauneuf-Du-Pape Rouge 2020
paul-autard-chateauneuf-du-pape.bodyHtml:
Clos des Papes (Paul-Vincent Avril) Châteauneuf-du-Pape Rouge 2020 is a profound, beautifully poised, and incredibly elegant red wine from one of the Southern Rhône's most legendary estates. Sourced from organically farmed, low-yielding vines, the 2020 vintage is a classic blend of Grenache, Mourvèdre, and Syrah, with a touch of other permitted varieties. In the glass, it reveals a brilliant ruby hue. The highly expressive, aromatic bouquet opens with captivating notes of sweet kirsch, wild framboise, and crushed blackberries, seamlessly intertwined with complex nuances of Asian spices, dried flowers, and classic Provençal garrigue. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied yet remarkably weightless, delivering a pure, concentrated core of red and dark fruit. This luxurious texture is perfectly structured by ultra-fine, silky tannins and a beautifully integrated freshness, culminating in a seamless, complex, and extraordinarily long finish that promises decades of graceful evolution in the cellar.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with herb-crusted rack of lamb, savory duck confit, classic beef bourguignon, robust wild mushroom dishes, and mature aged cheeses.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Beguiling, with a plume of black tea and incense leading off, followed by black cherry reduction, cassis, melted black licorice, warm earth, singed tobacco and garrigue accents. Offers breadth and depth with a seamless feel, capped by a subtle mineral edge that lingers lengthily amid the beautiful fruit. Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre. Best from 2024 through 2040.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

I last reported on the 2020 Chateauneuf du Pape prior to bottling, so let me update readers here. It's a terrific, red-fruited version of Clos des Papes, with raspberry and cherry notes accented by hints of black olive and allspice. Full-bodied, taut and firmly structured, with a long, concentrated finish, this is a vintage that should reward cellaring.

95 Points - James Suckling

A fine and poised Chateauneuf-du-Pape with aromas of cassis, candied cherries, dried herbs, baking spices and black pepper. It's full-bodied with finely grained tannins. Velvety and layered with good concentration. It's elegant yet energetic and vibrant, with a flavorful, bright finish. Drink or hold.

lucien-muzard-santenay-clos-faubard.title: Lucien Muzard & Fils Santenay Clos Faubard Premier Cru 2021 750ml
lucien-muzard-santenay-clos-faubard.bodyHtml: Lucien Muzard & Fils Santenay Premier Cru Clos Faubard 2021 is a Pinot Noir from Santenay in Burgundy's Côte de Beaune. Clos Faubard is a Premier Cru vineyard at the top of the Santenay hillside, and the wine is grown and made by Lucien Muzard & Fils. 750ml, 13% ABV.

delille-chaleur-blanc.title: DeLille Chaleur Blanc 2022
delille-chaleur-blanc.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Chaleur Blanc is bright, energetic and, on its release date, possesses wonderful tension. More prominent than recent vintages, classic Sauvignon Blanc notes of gooseberry lead on the nose, followed by whiffs of green apple, apricot and white flowers. The palate has flavors of lemon brioche and peach-infused mascarpone, buttressed with flinty, mineral qualities. The finish is round and defined by its length and enticing freshness. Enjoy now or cellar for 10+ years to experience the complexity and evolution of this beauty.

93 Points - James Suckling

This Bordeaux-style white has 31% semillon blended into sauvignon blanc. Mostly barrel fermented and in 42% new French barrels, it has a tang of toasty oak backed by vivid citrus fruit. Very stylish, spicy and well-balanced by acidity.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Supple yet vibrant, this blend has multilayered beeswax, lemon verbena and fresh fig accents that linger on the long, plush finish. Sauvignon Blanc and Semillon. Drink now through 2025. 8,700 cases made.

delille-d2-red.title: DeLille Cellars D2 2021 750ml
delille-d2-red.bodyHtml: D2 is the Bordeaux-style red blend of DeLille Cellars, the Woodinville, Washington winery founded in 1992 that helped pioneer Bordeaux-style blends in the state. The wine is a Columbia Valley red, built on the idea that a well-made blend is greater than the sum of its parts, and it is produced and bottled by DeLille Cellars. 750ml, 14.6% ABV.

felton-road-pinot-noir-macmuir.title: Felton Road MacMuir Pinot Noir 2022 750ml
felton-road-pinot-noir-macmuir.bodyHtml: Dark fruit and cocoa lead this saturating and brooding bouquet. The palate is similarly intense, a different iteration of Felton Road, but it nevertheless has openness and immediate silky appeal. Sandalwood, dark chocolate and cranberry lingers on a sustained and immensely impressive finish. Certainly no stage fright in this new performer!

alzinger-loibenberg-smaragd-gruner-velt.title: Alzinger Reid Loibenberg Smaragd Gruner Veltliner 2024
alzinger-loibenberg-smaragd-gruner-velt.bodyHtml:
Alzinger Ried Loibenberg Smaragd Grüner Veltliner 2024 is a poised, crystalline, and deeply mineral white wine produced by Weingut Alzinger, one of the premier estates in Austria's Wachau region. Sourced from the south-facing, terraced Ried Loibenberg vineyard with its weathered gneiss and granite soils, this Smaragd-level expression showcases exceptional complexity and power balanced by intense precision. The wine exhibits inviting aromas of ripe white peach, yellow apple, pink grapefruit zest, crushed rock minerality, and subtle white pepper spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, concentrated, and texturally rich, balanced by vibrant acidity and a long, saline, slate-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted pork tenderloin, grilled trout, pan-seared veal cutlets, Wiener Schnitzel, roasted chicken, Asian spiced dishes, and aged mountain cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

This juicy, charming white has aromas of sliced pears, chopped apples, juniper berries and some acacia honey. It’s full-bodied but cool and supple, with lovely fresh stone-fruit character and a light peppery touch. Drink now or hold.

alzinger-riesling-loibenberg-smaragd.title: Alzinger Reid Loibenberg Smaragd Gruner Veltliner 2024
alzinger-riesling-loibenberg-smaragd.bodyHtml:
Alzinger Ried Loibenberg Smaragd Grüner Veltliner 2024 is a poised, crystalline, and deeply mineral white wine produced by Weingut Alzinger, one of the premier estates in Austria's Wachau region. Sourced from the south-facing, terraced Ried Loibenberg vineyard with its weathered gneiss and granite soils, this Smaragd-level expression showcases exceptional complexity and power balanced by intense precision. The wine exhibits inviting aromas of ripe white peach, yellow apple, pink grapefruit zest, crushed rock minerality, and subtle white pepper spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, concentrated, and texturally rich, balanced by vibrant acidity and a long, saline, slate-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted pork tenderloin, grilled trout, pan-seared veal cutlets, Wiener Schnitzel, roasted chicken, Asian spiced dishes, and aged mountain cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

This juicy, charming white has aromas of sliced pears, chopped apples, juniper berries and some acacia honey. It’s full-bodied but cool and supple, with lovely fresh stone-fruit character and a light peppery touch. Drink now or hold.

2012-tenuta-di-valgiano.title: Tenuta di Valgiano Colline Lucchesi 2012 750ml
2012-tenuta-di-valgiano.bodyHtml:
Aromas of red and black plums, cassis, licorice, southern herbs and lavender. Medium-bodied with refined tannins and impressive depth.

95 Points - Vinous

The flagship 2012 Tenuta di Valgiano is beautifully resonant and generous in the glass, but also translucent in its ample beauty. Pine, mint, wild flowers and spices add an appealing upper register as the 2012 shows off its radiant personality. The Tenuta is a bit less overt and ripe than the Palistorti, but, it, too is not a shy wine. All the elements fall into place effortlessly. This is the finest wine I have tasted from Valgiano, without question.

2013-tenuta-di-valgiano.title: Tenuta di Valgiano Colline Lucchesi 2013 750ml
2013-tenuta-di-valgiano.bodyHtml: Aromas of red and black plums, cassis, licorice, southern herbs and lavender. Medium-bodied with refined tannins and impressive depth.

tenuta-di-valgiano.title: Tenuta di Valgiano Colline Lucchesi 2016 750ml
tenuta-di-valgiano.bodyHtml:
Aromas of red and black plums, cassis, licorice, southern herbs and lavender. Medium-bodied with refined tannins and impressive depth.

95 points - Jeb Dunnuck

The flagship 2016 Colline Lucchesi Rosso Tenuta di Valgiano checks in as 60% Sangiovese and 20% each of Syrah and Merlot, aged in older French oak for 12 months followed by six months in concrete tanks. Blueberries, blackberries, violets, leafy herbs, chocolate, and some peppery notes all define the bouquet, and this beauty is medium to full-bodied, with silky tannins, no hard edges, and a great finish. This gorgeous, elegant wine just shines on all accounts. 

94 points - Vinous

The 2016 Tenuta di Valgiano packs a serious punch. A heady, flamboyant wine, the 2016 possesses tremendous breadth as well as a real sense of authority. Dark berry fruit, herbs, sage, tobacco, licorice and scorched earth are some of the elements that run through the 2016. Although the 2016 offers tons of intrigue in its exotic, powerful personality, its qualities will be even more expressive in another few years’ time. 

94 points - Wine & Spirits
Moreno Petrini and Laura di Collobiano farm their 40 vineyard acres biodynamically (Demeter certified), the vines rooted in humus-rich, well-aerated soils in the hills above the Tuscan town of Lucca. This is their flagship wine, a blend of 60 percent sangiovese with equal parts merlot and syrah, the grapes hand-harvested and fermented with ambient yeasts before aging in old French-oak barrels for one year. The wine unfolds with notes of orange zest, licorice and anise that weave through flavors of blackberry and wild cherry. Opulent and layered, it picks up accents of tobacco and black pepper on the way to a long, balanced finish.

michael-david-rapture.title: Michael David Winery Rapture Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 750ml
michael-david-rapture.bodyHtml:
Rapture represents the very best Cabernet Sauvignon by Michael David Winery. Similar to 1st growth Bordeaux, Rapture is only produced on exceptional vintage years. The grapes for this wine come from Michael Phillips' own vineyard, which is rotary fermented and aged in 100% French oak barrels. Meanwhile, David Phillips gave this wine its creative identity by using the biblical name Rapture. With the limited production of this wine, “Don’t be left behind!”

Another stand-apart vintage for Rapture, our 2021 offering presents tempting layers of dark chocolate-covered berries, brown sugar and rich coffee aromas on the nose. Full bodied with a smooth, velvety mouthfeel, flavors of black cherry, ripe black currant and cacao nibs are carried through by a pleasantly balanced, long-lasting finish.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This wine is opulent, with aromas of blackberry, blueberry, nutmeg, violets and toasty vanilla on the nose. The flavors on the palate are black plum, pomegranate-Concord grape and black pepper, intertwined with bramble dark cherry, orange zest, vanilla cream and a dry, silky finish

maurizio-alongi-barbischio-chianti.title: Marchesi Antinori Badia A Passignano Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021
maurizio-alongi-barbischio-chianti.bodyHtml:
Marchesi Antinori Badia A Passignano Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021 is a premier single-vineyard Tuscan red wine made entirely from Sangiovese grown on the historic estate surrounding the 10th-century Abbey of Passignano. Aged in French and Hungarian oak barrels, it offers rich aromatics of ripe dark cherry, orange peel, wild violet, and dried rose petal alongside subtle accents of vanilla, sandalwood, and sweet spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, structured, and vibrant, balancing refined, firm tannins with crisp acidity, earthy complexity, and a persistent, polished finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with Florentine T-bone steak, wild boar ragù, roasted lamb with herbs, osso buco, and aged Pecorino cheese.

96 Points - James Suckling

Wow. This shows a beautiful shift in character towards freshness and brightness, with lots of dried flowers and hints of sandalwood. Medium to full body with firm, fine tannins. Energetic finish. Lots of fresh herbs and pine to the fruit at the end. Pure sangiovese. Give this a couple of years, but already top-quality Chianti Classico. Best ever?

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

I had previously reviewed this vintage closer to its commercial release. Tasted seven months later, the Marchesi Antinori 2021 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Badia a Passignano has fleshed out nicely and has successfully shedded its oak signature. What you get now is a pretty mouthful of rich, ripe black fruits with background notes of green spice and smoked bacon. There is a hint of fragrant rose that emerges beautifully at one specific point a few minutes in. This expression from the San Donato in Poggio UGA delivers bright and lively fruit overall. With a storied winemaking tradition and first produced in 1988, you could say that this wine is the control sample against which the three new UGA expressions are measured.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A deep well of cherry, pomegranate, iron, tobacco and wild herb aromas and flavors highlights this intense red, while a dense layer of tannins provides support. Lively acidity drives the lingering aftertaste of fruit, mineral and herb notes. Best from 2026 through 2043.

chateau-rauzan-segla-2009.title: Chateau Rauzan-Segla 2009
chateau-rauzan-segla-2009.bodyHtml:
Looking, smelling and tasting a glass of Rauzan-Segla wine is an invitation to a journey like no other. This journey of pleasure begins with the eye. The beauty of a color so intense that is impossible to take one's eye off of it. A color that draws us in and makes us want to discover it secrets. The pleasure of its luxurious aromas disclosing cigar bo notes which combine harmoniously with aromas of ripe fruit. The first sip coats the palate seductively with a combination of finesse, elegance and unparalleled charm. The wine's smooth, complex texture will make you want to linger over the tasting experience. To taste a glass of Rauzan-Segla is to savor its fruity freshness and let yourself be transported by its silky smooth texture, the result of over three centuries of winemaking expertise.

96 Points - James Suckling

Deep, spicy and earthy, but with plenty of cabernet sauvignon cassis aroma and solid tannins giving it a serious structure. It's not the most polished Médoc of the vintage, but there's plenty of concentration and energy driving the long firm finish. Give it more time. Try after 2021.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A rich and opulent wine, very ripe, packed with luscious blackberry and damson fruit as well as sweet tannins. It is a fruit salad of fruit flavors given structure by a core of dryness. Already a gorgeous wine, but one that will also age.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet colored, the 2007 Rauzan-Ségla is scented of cigar box, baking spices and preserved plums with nuances of pencil shavings, leather and bay leaves. The medium-bodied palate is delicately styled with maturing earth and spice flavors plus a chewy frame, finishing with an herbal lift. The blend this year is 59% Cabernet Sauvignon, 36% Merlot and 5% Petit Verdot, harvested between September 21st and October 10th, at an average yield of 43 hectoliters per hectare. It was aged for 18 months in French oak, 60% new. The alcohol is 13.5%.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
A very toasty style, with lots of caressing plum sauce, melted licorice and warm fig flavors splayed out over polished, rounded structure. Picks up some grip and tar on the finish, but stays clearly on the modern side, with its noticeable reliance on toast. Best from 2014 through 2026. Tasted twice, with consistent notes.

henkell-dealcoholized-sparkling-wine.title: Henkell Dealcoholized Sparkling Wine 750ml
henkell-dealcoholized-sparkling-wine.bodyHtml:
Henkell Dealcoholized Sparkling Wine offers the refined sparkle of traditional bubbly without the alcohol. Crafted with the same care as Henkell’s classic sparkling wines, this non-alcoholic alternative combines freshness, finesse, and a crisp character that’s perfect for any occasion where you want to celebrate without the buzz.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Bright, pale straw with a fine and lively mousse.

  • Nose: Elegant aromas of pear, apple, and citrus with floral hints.

  • Palate: Light and refreshing on the palate, showcasing juicy fruit flavors with balanced acidity and a clean, smooth finish. Slightly sweet with a soft, sparkling texture.

Highlights:

  • Alcohol Content: <0.5% ABV

  • Style: Non-alcoholic sparkling wine

  • Country: Germany

  • Serving Suggestion: Best served well chilled, ideal as an aperitif or paired with light salads, fruit, or desserts.

Perfect For:

Brunches, baby showers, work parties, or any moment where you want the sparkle without the alcohol.

settlement-wines-settlement-pinot-noir.title: Settlement Pinot Noir 2019 750ml
settlement-wines-settlement-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Some of Settlement’s youngest vines are represented by their eponymous PInot Noir. Planted in 2009, the fruit already shows a level of depth and soul to be expected from such a unique terrain. With loess and clay soils at steep, north facing slopes, the Settlement Vineyard Pinot Noir displays a dramatic range of flavor woven into a delicate yet confident structure. Jubilant strawberry and red currant notes fold neatly with loamy earth on the nose, matching in flavor on the palate with silky tannins and a long finish

93 Points - Cam Douglas

From the Settlement Vineyard - aromas of black currant and dark cherry, there’s plenty of wood spices and barrel smoke moments, dried herb and dry stone mineral notes bring complexity, depth and intrigue. On the palate - dry, tense, youthful, fruity and young. A wine that must remain in your cellar till at least the end of 2022 so integration and harmonies can begin to engage. In the meantime and if you must open a bottle - be sure to serve with fresh protein foods. Firm tannins and acid line add texture, the core of fruit remain but is hidden till the tannins and dried herb layers are allowed to integrate. Plenty of potential and a lovely expression with best drinking from December 31st 2022 through 2028+. Am keen to try this wine again in 12 months to check its progress.

cirillo-1850-ancestor-vine-semillon.title: Cirillo 1850 Ancestor Vine Semillon 2018 750ml
cirillo-1850-ancestor-vine-semillon.bodyHtml:
The Cirillo 1850 Semillon is harvested entirely of a single vineyard in the Light Pass region in the Barossa Valley believed to be the oldest Semillon (Madeira) vineyard in the world. It is one of the few remaining Madeira vineyards left in Australia. This is why it is released under the Semillon varietal name, as opposed to the Madeira region.

Picked early in the season, normally in mid‐late January, it is harvested with great acidity. The fruit is handpicked and basket pressed. The wine is then tank fermented, without oak.

It is extremely pale green/yellow, almost clear in colour. The aroma is of lifted lemongrass with some clean mineral characters. Fruit is dominant on the palate with a lean, light structure and driven acid finish.

This Semillon is the ideal balance of fruit and acidity. Truly an exciting Semillon that will reward early drinking or cellaring for years to come.

Pairs well with dishes like risotto ai frutti di mare, yabbies with roasted garlic mayonnaise, or satay chicken due to its lean, light structure and driven acid finish.

cirillo-1850-ancestor-vineyard-grenache.title: Klinker Brick Grenache Blanc
cirillo-1850-ancestor-vineyard-grenache.bodyHtml:
This refreshing Grenache Blanc from Lodi offers vibrant aromas of pear, green apple, citrus blossom, and white peach with subtle mineral notes. Crisp and medium-bodied on the palate, it delivers bright orchard fruit flavors, lively acidity, and a clean, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with seafood, grilled chicken, fresh salads, soft cheeses, or light pasta dishes.

tenuta-rocca-barolo.title: E. Molino Barolo Bricco Rocca 2022
tenuta-rocca-barolo.bodyHtml:
E. Molino Barolo Bricco Rocca 2022 is an exceptional, handcrafted Nebbiolo from the prized Bricco Rocca vineyard in La Morra. Displaying a luminous ruby-red color with garnet highlights, it opens with delicate aromas of red cherries, rose petals, dried herbs, and crushed orange peel, layered over notes of leather, damp earth, and subtle sweet spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, elegant, and finely balanced, combining vibrant acidity with silky yet structured tannins that carry through to a long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted leg of lamb, braised beef, wild mushroom risotto, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese.

tenuta-rocca-barolo-bussia.title: Barolo Bussia Attilio Ghisolfi 2019 750ml
tenuta-rocca-barolo-bussia.bodyHtml:
Ruby-red almost-garnet color, with a flowery, rich and expansive nose. The taste is well-balanced, mature, deep and tannic, with a long finish. This wine is excellent for drinking from an early age.

Maceration on skins takes place over ten days at controlled temperatures, with natural fermentation taking place using native yeasts. The wine is aged in large Slavonian oak barrels for 36 months, with a further aging of six months in the bottle at a controlled temperature.

On the palate it is rich and authoritative with medium tannins. Best paired with truffle dishes, roasted red meat and game or with mature cheeses.

94 Points - James Suckling

Attractive notes of raspberries, orange peel, red licorice, cedar and dried mushrooms. Medium- to full-bodied with firm tannins that have a chalky texture to them. The vivid acidity and underlining notes of juicy red berries give it joy and vibrancy. Mineral finish. Better after 2026.

j-de-villebois-sancerre-blanc.title: J. De Villebois Sancerre Blanc 2024
j-de-villebois-sancerre-blanc.bodyHtml:
J. de Villebois Sancerre Blanc 2024 is a vibrant and highly expressive Sauvignon Blanc that reflects the complex terroir of the Sancerre appellation. This signature cuvée is a meticulous blend of grapes grown on the region's three primary soil types: Caillottes (limestone), Terres Blanches (marl), and Silex (flint). The 2024 vintage required vigilant vineyard management, resulting in grapes harvested at optimal ripeness to maintain both elegant freshness and mineral tension.
On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of white peach, green apple, and citrus fruits like mandarin and yuzu, accented by delicate floral notes of elderflower. The palate is full and textured, showcasing flavours of gooseberry, pink grapefruit, and nectarine. It features a bright acidity and a distinct saline minerality, leading to a long, persistent finish with a fine touch of citrus pith.

j-de-villebois-pouilly-fume.title: J. De Villebois Pouilly Fume 2021 750ml
j-de-villebois-pouilly-fume.bodyHtml: J. de Villebois Pouilly-Fumé 2021 is a classic Loire Valley Sauvignon Blanc, known for its distinctive smoky character and vibrant acidity. It's a dry, white wine with a pale yellow-green hue, and a nose dominated by citrus fruits and subtle smoky notes. The palate offers a balance of zesty flavors like lemon and lime, with a characteristic minerality and a long, refreshing finish.

mission-hill-estate-compendium-2017.title: Mission Hill Compendium 2017 750ml
mission-hill-estate-compendium-2017.bodyHtml:
A COMPENDIUM is a compilation of concise items on a subject, in our case, the combination of soil, climate, clone selection, and hand-harvesting of grape clusters to create this unique wine. The fruit was selected from specifically designated blocks within our vineyard estates in Osoyoos and Oliver, where the porous soil forces the vines to search for nutrients. This struggle results in elegant and luscious fruit. Following fermentation and extended maceration, this wine was aged for eighteen months in French oak barrels.

Cabernet sauvignon 45 %, Merlot 37 %, Cabernet franc 16 %, Petit Verdot 2 %

93 Points by Decanter

Intense cassis, tar, liquorice and espresso bouquet, powerful ripe tannins; long, complex and extracted. Marked purity of flavour.

tunella-pinot-grigio-friuli.title: Tunella Pinot Grigio 2024
tunella-pinot-grigio-friuli.bodyHtml:
Tunella Pinot Grigio 2024 is an elegant, expressive, and wonderfully fresh white wine originating from the prestigious Friuli Colli Orientali DOC in northeastern Italy. Cultivated on the region's signature marl and sandstone soils, locally known as "ponca," this wine displays a brilliant straw-yellow hue. On the nose, it delivers a fragrant and inviting bouquet of acacia blossom, ripe pear, tropical fruit, and delicate hints of warm bread crust. The palate is harmonious and beautifully textured, showcasing bright, zesty acidity intertwined with subtle yeasty brioche notes gained from extended aging on the lees. Finishing with a crisp, mineral-driven persistence, it beautifully captures the classic alpine freshness and depth characteristic of high-quality Friulian whites.

Food Pairing:

Matches wonderfully with light appetizers, Parma ham, fresh white fish, grilled shrimp, simple white meat dishes, or served as a refreshing apéritif.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Tunella 2024 Friuli Colli Orientali Pinot Grigio shows aromas of dried flowers, chamomile and mountain herbs, followed by citrus tones and white peach. This is a well-executed Pinot Grigio that captures the grape’s freshness and easygoing nature while offering a touch of added texture and softness, making it suitable for dishes like grilled shrimp or baked fish.

chateau-marquis-dalesme.title: Chateau Marquis d'Alesme 2016
chateau-marquis-dalesme.bodyHtml:
A beautifully refined Margaux from the outstanding 2016 vintage, Château Marquis d'Alesme reveals aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, violet, cedar, graphite, and exotic spices. Silky yet powerful, it delivers polished tannins, vibrant freshness, remarkable depth, and a long, elegant finish with exceptional aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, truffle potatoes, aged Comté, wild mushrooms, or braised short ribs.

 

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Talk about a gem in the vintage, I was blown away by the 2016 Château Marquis d'Alesme Becker on each of the three times I was able to taste it. This estate has been on an undeniable roll since the arrival of Marjolaine de Conicnck in 2009, and the 2016 is unquestionably the best yet. A blend of 62% Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot, 5% Petit Verdot and the rest Cabernet Franc, brought up in 65% new French oak, its deep purple color is followed by an essence of Cabernet bouquet that includes loads of crème de cassis, blueberries, graphite, crushed rocks, sandalwood, and violets. Almost Saint Julien in style, this beauty is laser-focused on the palate, medium to full-bodied, brilliantly textured, and has a blockbuster finish. It deserves 4-5 years of bottle age and will keep for 25-30 years. Bravo!

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2016 Marquis d'Alesme Becker leaps from the glass with gregarious notions of plum preserves, crème de cassis and Black Forest cake with hints of potpourri, star anise, menthol and tapenade. Full, rich, firm and grainy, with fantastic freshness lifting the densely packed palate, it has a long, beautifully fragrant finish.

93 Points - Decanter

There has been a lot of investment in this property from the all-female team, from owner Nathalie Perrodo to winemaker Marjolaine Maurice-de Coninck. Don't think this means a feminine take on the vintage though; we have the full gamut of chewy tannins running through well structured, ripe cassis fruit. It holds back on the finish, with a sense of confidence and careful extraction. Maybe not as floral as some, but for me it's another step up in quality from this fast-rising estate. Drinking Window 2027 - 2050

93 Points - James Suckling

Ripe and fragrant nose that says Margaux loud and clear. Then comes the rather concentrated and powerful palate, where the supple tannins build nicely. Needs some time for them to resolve. Try it in 2022.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Alluring, with a core of warmed plum sauce and black currant paste flavors, melding with incense, black tea and alder notes. Shows a velvety texture on the finish and a perfumy echo as the fruit lingers gently. Best from 2022 through 2032.

caparzo-brunello-di-montalcino-2008.title: Caparzo Brunello Di Montalcino 2008
caparzo-brunello-di-montalcino-2008.bodyHtml:
Caparzo Brunello Di Montalcino 2008 displays a deep ruby hue transitioning to garnet at the rim, opening with a complex, penetrating bouquet of wild dark berries, ripe cherries, and plum, complemented by underlying notes of sweet tobacco, licorice, and forest floor. On the palate, this traditional Tuscan red is full-bodied, savory, and well-structured, featuring polished tannins, bright balancing acidity, and a long, elegant finish marked by lingering spice and fine minerality.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with roasted lamb chops, braised beef short ribs, Fiorentina steak, wild boar ragù, truffle risotto, and aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

A wine with a solid core of fruit here. Fresh and clean with lovely focused fruit. Full body, with a velvety texture and a flavorful finish. Very ready and enjoyable now. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Caparzo’s 2008 Brunello di Montalcino is impressive. It boasts serious depth, nuance and complexity. Smoke, licorice, spices, black cherries and plums all develop in the glass, supported by firm, beautifully integrated tannins. This is a solid Brunello with plenty of upside for the next decade, if not longer. Anticipated maturity: 2015-2028.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Caparzo delivers a consistent and clean expression of Brunello year after year. This shows a touch of bright acidity, formed thanks to a cooler than average growing season, and is backed by aromas of forest fruit and cola. Full flavors of tobacco and spice carry the wine smoothly over the palate.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Fresh cherry and raspberry flavors highlight this juicy red, with accents of underbrush and tobacco lending nuance, followed by a spicy finish. The dense tannins suggest this is built for the long haul. Best from 2016 through 2030.

caparzo-brunello-di-montalcino-2009.title: Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino 3L Double Magnum 2020
caparzo-brunello-di-montalcino-2009.bodyHtml:
Vibrant and structured, this Brunello shows aromas of red berries, citrus peel, and subtle earthy spice. The palate is medium-bodied with firm, integrated tannins that provide focus and length, supported by bright acidity and layered fruit. Balanced and energetic, it delivers precision and elegance, finishing long with notes of cherry, mineral, and savory complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs well with Braised beef, lamb, wild boar, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses.

 

95 Points - James Suckling

A bright red with firm, integrated tannins that provide length and focus. It’s medium-bodied with citrus and berry character and excellent length. I like it now, but give it two or three years to show its full potential. Same quality as 2019? Best after 2027.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

This harmonious red reveals ample energy and dimension, with a spice hint framing cherry, iron, sanguine and underbrush flavors. Its tannins are dense and present but not obtrusive. Fine length. Best from 2027 through 2042.

caparzo-la-casa-brunello-docg-2004.title: Caparzo La Casa Brunello Di Montalcino 2004 750ml

caparzo-brunello-riserva-docg-2007.title: Caparzo Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2007 750ml
caparzo-brunello-riserva-docg-2007.bodyHtml: Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2007 is made only in the best vintages, from grapes selected personally by winemaker Massimo Bracalente. The fruit comes from vineyards in the north of Montalcino at about 220 metres and partly from the south at 270 metres, all on sandy, stony Pliocene soils facing south and south-east. After hand harvesting, fermentation lasts seven days at 28–30°C, with skin contact extended a further 10 to 15 days, followed by at least two years in wood and six months in bottle. First made in 1980, the Riserva is produced in limited numbers; the house describes a ruby colour turning garnet with age, a broad bouquet recalling wild berries, and a dry, warm, harmonious palate.

caparzo-brunello-riserva-docg-2006.title: Caparzo Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2006 750ml
caparzo-brunello-riserva-docg-2006.bodyHtml:
The origins of the place named Caparzo are still unknown. According to some people, the name is derived, as shown by ancient maps, from Ca’ Pazzo; according to others, the term should derive from the Latin Caput Arsum, indicating "a place touched by sun”. 

The history of Caparzo dates back to the end of the 1960s at the dawning of Brunello di Montalcino, when a group of friends, fond of Tuscany and of wine, purchased an old ruin with vineyards at Montalcino. The farm estate was renovated, modernized, and new vineyards were planted. In a short time, Caparzo made itself known in the Brunello market. In 1998, 30 years after the first rows of vines were planted, the farm estate came to a turning point when Elisabetta Gnudi Angelini purchased Caparzo. With the help of her son, Igino, and daughter, Alessandra, she immediately carried out her objective: combining tradition with innovation to create a high-quality wine that is the expression of an excellent territory.

Garnet red in the glass with intense and brilliant color accompanied by hints of light orange. On the nose it has a penetrating bouquet, very full and varied, reminiscent of wild berries followed by dry, warm and full-bodied flavors maintaining being delicate and austere at the same time maintaining the balance and harmony of the wine.

95 Points - James Suckling

Complex aromas of walnuts, almonds, cedar, plums, chocolate and aniseed. Full and chewy with a beautiful finish of fruit, parmigana and berries. Lasts for minutes. SO right now.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This shows bright Sangiovese tones of crisp berry and forest floor, followed by subtle touches of spice, leather, black licorice, dried ginger and rosemary. The true character and freshness of the Sangiovese fruit comes through loud and clear.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

This elegant red is harmonious, exhibiting plum and cherry notes, with dense yet integrated tannins carrying the finish. Very supple overall, with a spicy aftertaste. Best from 2013 through 2025.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2006 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva is an attractive wine laced with sweet red cherries, tobacco, flowers, mint and licorice. The 2006 is an especially refined, subtle Riserva that impresses for its class and elegance. Caparzo gave the 2006 Riserva three years in Slavonian and French oak casks. This is a strong showing from Caparzo. Anticipated maturity: 2016-2026.

capraia-chianti-classico-docg-gran-selez.title: Capraia Effe 55 Chianti Classico (Gran Selezione) 2016 750ml
capraia-chianti-classico-docg-gran-selez.bodyHtml:
The Capraia Effe 55 Gran Selezione 2016 is a prestigious expression of Chianti Classico, showcasing the elegance, structure, and age-worthiness that define the top tier of Sangiovese-based wines. Produced only in exceptional vintages, this Gran Selezione represents the pinnacle of the estate’s winemaking from meticulously selected grapes and the finest vineyard parcels.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Deep ruby red with garnet reflections.

  • Nose: Complex and refined, with aromas of ripe cherries, blackberries, violets, leather, and a touch of tobacco, enhanced by earthy undertones and hints of sweet spice.

  • Palate: Full-bodied, structured, and harmonious. The tannins are firm yet silky, perfectly balanced by vibrant acidity. Layers of dark fruit, dried herbs, and oak notes unfold across a long, elegant finish.

Grape Variety:

  • 100% Sangiovese (typical of Gran Selezione wines)

Aging:

Aged extensively in oak barrels and bottle-aged before release, this wine is built to evolve beautifully over time.

Serving Suggestions:

Serve at 18°C. Ideal with rich Tuscan dishes, bistecca alla fiorentina, aged cheeses, or game meats.

Cellaring Potential:

Excellent aging potential – drink now through 2035.

dario-princic-pinot-bianco.title: Dario Princic Pinot Bianco 2019 750ml
dario-princic-pinot-bianco.bodyHtml: The 2019 Dario Princic Pinot Bianco is an orange wine, known for its unique characteristics resulting from extended maceration of the grape skins with the juice. This wine features a complex profile with herbal, citrus, and stone fruit notes, alongside a fresh, savory palate with delicate tannins and a long finish.

dario-princic-trebez-bianco.title: Dario Princic Bianco Trebez 2016
dario-princic-trebez-bianco.bodyHtml:
Dario Prinčič Bianco Trebež 2016 is a profoundly complex and highly revered natural orange wine crafted by one of the pioneers of skin-contact winemaking in Oslavia. Pouring a striking dark amber hue, it opens with an intense, aromatic bouquet of dried apricot, candied peach, wild herbs, and preserved tangerine. On the palate, this biodynamically farmed blend of Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, and Pinot Grigio is full-bodied, rich, and remarkably textured due to extended maceration. It delivers deep, savory autumnal layers of chestnut, caramel, roasted coffee, and subtle black tea, beautifully balanced by a long, vibrant finish marked by the stony minerality of the region's ancient "ponca" soils.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted pork belly, savory wild mushroom risotto, rich fish stews, and mature, hard artisan cheeses.

foxtrot-the-waltz-pinot-noir-6-case.title: G&F Richoux - Irancy 750ml
foxtrot-the-waltz-pinot-noir-6-case.bodyHtml: G&F Richoux's Irancy is a red wine crafted from 100% Pinot Noir grapes, grown in the Irancy appellation of Burgundy, France. The wine is known for its vibrant fruit flavors, like red cherries and raspberries, alongside subtle spice and earthy notes. It's characterized by lively acidity, fine tannins, and a refreshing, elegant finish.

foxtrot-estate-pinot-noir-3.title: Domaine Carneros Estate Pinot Noir 2022
foxtrot-estate-pinot-noir-3.bodyHtml:
Domaine Carneros Estate Pinot Noir 2022 is a sophisticated and highly expressive red wine that captures the cool-climate elegance of the Carneros region. Sourced exclusively from the estate's six sustainably farmed vineyards, this wine benefits from the maritime influence of the San Pablo Bay, which provides the fog and cool breezes essential for developing complex aromatics while maintaining fresh acidity. The 2022 vintage was aged for approximately 10 months in small French oak barrels to enhance its structure and mouthfeel.
On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of black cherry, pomegranate, and wild strawberry, accented by delicate floral notes of violet and a hint of sandalwood. The palate is medium-bodied and silky, showcasing layers of juicy red fruit, plum, and savory earthy notes. It features fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that carries the flavours through to a long, graceful finish with a touch of baking spice and toasted oak.

94 Points - James Suckling

Vibrant aromas of strawberries, blueberry bush, citrus peel and cassia bark. The palate is medium-bodied with finely integrated tannins and bright acidity, showing a plush and generous mouthfeel with underlying tension. Very refined and pure, with a soft touch. Drink or hold.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ripe, dark red fruits swirled through with baking spices and freshly cracked pine, reveal a mouthwatering, flavorful, and juicy still, Pinot Noir. Silken tannins and an ultra long finish.

barbacarlo-lino-maga-montebuono.title: Barbacarlo Montebuono Provincia Di Pavia Rosso 2018

dievole-chianti-classico-ris-novecento.title: Dievole Novecento Chianti Classico Riserva 2018 750ml
dievole-chianti-classico-ris-novecento.bodyHtml:
Dievole produces its incredible-quality Chianti Classico and manages four Tuscan estates, including Montalcino and Bolgheri. Dievole is set in tranquil surroundings, nestled in the beautiful Tuscan hills, long known as a little piece of heaven on Earth. 

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast
A blend of 95% Sangiovese, 3% Canaiolo and 2% Colorino opens with black-skinned berry, leather and tobacco aromas. Made with organically farmed grapes, the wine features a savoury, polished palate offering dried black cherry, star anise, white pepper, and fine-grained tannins. Drink through 2028.

dievole-vigna-di-sessina-chianti-classic.title: Dievole Vigna di Sessina Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2019
dievole-vigna-di-sessina-chianti-classic.bodyHtml:
Intense ruby red with subtle garnet highlights. The aromas are intense with distinct notes of ripe red fruit and subtle hints of dried violet. The bouquet also boasts spiced fragrances. Elegant on the palate. The notable freshness is paired with excellent, mature tannins, boasting depth and pleasant to the senses. Excellent, well-balanced and long finish.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

In the bottle with the black label, the organic Dievole 2019 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Vigna di Sessina is a real beauty that offers a twofold delivery of elegance and power in this vintage. There are plenty of black fruit aromas that slide delicately into crushed stone, spice and grilled herb. This estate opts for fermentation in cement and quick oak aging lasting about one year.
