These steps insure intact primary flavors, and the wine is characterized by energy and lively aromas. 

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Featuring strawberry, cherry, rose and mineral aromas and flavors, this pretty red is firmly structured, closing up on the tightly wound finish. Nonetheless, there's plenty of fruit, and this is super long on the aftertaste. Best from 2027 through 2047. 

94 Points - James Suckling

Polished and pretty nose of dried flowers, cloves, mocha, dried cherries and chocolate orange. It’s medium-bodied with tight-grained tannins. Lovely freshness and balance, with a lengthy and elegant finish. From organically grown grapes. Drink or hold.

podere-brizio-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Podere Brizio Brunello Di Montalcino 2017 750ml
podere-brizio-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml: Podere Brizio Brunello di Montalcino 2017 is a red from the Brunello di Montalcino DOCG in Tuscany. Its label carries the Parpagliola, a silver coin minted in 1556 that recalls the Sienese republic in Montalcino. 750ml, 14% ABV.

podere-brizio-brunello-di-montalcino-ris.title: Podere Brizio Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2017
podere-brizio-brunello-di-montalcino-ris.bodyHtml:
Podere Brizio Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2017 is an exceptional, organic Tuscan red wine produced from high-altitude Sangiovese vineyards in the southwestern sector of Montalcino. Displaying an intense ruby-red color with garnet highlights, it offers an expressive bouquet of sweet red berries, orange peel, crushed flowers, cedar, and subtle forest floor nuances. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and elegant, featuring vibrant natural acidity, fine linear tannins, and a persistent, crunchy mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Roasted rack of lamb, braised wild boar ragù, Fiorentina steak, truffle pasta, and aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

poggio-landi-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Poggio Landi Brunello di Montalcino DOCG 2019
poggio-landi-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Poggio Landi Brunello di Montalcino 2019 is a distinguished Italian red wine from the celebrated Montalcino appellation in Tuscany. Produced from 100% Sangiovese grapes, this Brunello reflects the elegance, depth and traditional winemaking heritage that have made the region internationally renowned. The exceptional 2019 growing season produced wines known for their balance, concentration and ageing potential. Poggio Landi's Brunello showcases expressive aromas of ripe red cherries, wild berries, dried violets and Mediterranean herbs, complemented by hints of tobacco, leather and warm spice. The palate is structured and refined, offering vibrant acidity, well-integrated tannins and a long, savoury finish.

Food Pairing: Florentine steak, roasted lamb, braised beef short ribs, wild boar ragù, venison, porcini mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, aged Pecorino Toscano and Parmigiano Reggiano.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Vanilla, coffee, clove, Luxardo cherry and blackberry form a rich, sweet, sophisticated nose. Sweet dark berries on the palate are contrasted by tangy earth laced with wild herbs. Powerful tannins and mouthwatering acidity add to the appeal.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A lean style, this red delivers a core of cherry and strawberry fruit shaded with earth, tobacco and mineral accents. Stiff tannins take over on the chewy finish. Best from 2027 through 2040. 10,500 cases made, 4,000 cases imported.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackberries, dried dark mushrooms and forest floor follow through to a medium body with firm, polished tannins and a juicy finish. Lightly chewy at the end. From organically grown grapes. Needs a couple of years to soften. Best after 2026.

meraviglia-bolgheri-sup-maestro-di-cava.title: Tenuta Meraviglia Dievole Maestro Di Cava 2017 750ml
meraviglia-bolgheri-sup-maestro-di-cava.bodyHtml: Tenuta Meraviglia Maestro di Cava 2017 is a Bolgheri Superiore DOC from Tenuta Meraviglia, the Dievole-owned estate based at Donoratico in the province of Livorno. The estate presents Maestro di Cava as a great example of Cabernet Franc, made entirely from that variety on south-west-facing vines at about 150 m on stony soils of volcanic origin (San Vincenzo rhyolites), Guyot-trained at 5,600 plants per hectare. Fermentation is spontaneous with indigenous yeasts in raw concrete tulip vats for about 20 days, followed by roughly 24 months in 60 hl untoasted French oak casks. The producer describes an intense ruby wine with red fruit, tobacco and leather, a fresh, mineral palate and well-integrated tannins. 750 ml, 13.4% alcohol.

le-colonne-bolgheri-superiore.title: Tenuta Le Colonne Bolgheri Superiore 2020 750ml
le-colonne-bolgheri-superiore.bodyHtml: Tenuta Le Colonne Bolgheri Superiore 2020 is a red from the Bolgheri Superiore DOC on the Tuscan coast, produced by Tenuta Le Colonne. 750ml, 13.5% ABV.

fattoria-pomona-chianti-classico-riserva.title: Pomona Chianti Classico Riserva 2018 750ml
fattoria-pomona-chianti-classico-riserva.bodyHtml: Fattoria Pomona Chianti Classico Riserva 2018 is a pure Sangiovese from a small family estate in the commune of Castellina in Chianti, in the heart of Tuscany's Chianti Classico DOCG. The winery is run by Monica Raspi, who returned to her family's land to carry on its legacy. She farms sustainably and works with minimal intervention in the cellar, with careful attention in both vineyard and winery so the wines reflect the character of the Chianti hills. Serve with bistecca alla fiorentina, wild boar ragù or aged pecorino. 750ml, 14% alcohol.

roeno-enantio-riserva-1865pre-fillossera.title: Roeno Enantio Riserva 1865 Pre-Fillossera 2017 750ml
roeno-enantio-riserva-1865pre-fillossera.bodyHtml: Roeno Enantio Riserva 1865 Pre-Fillossera 2017 is a Terradeiforti DOC red from the Roeno family winery, on the border between Veneto and Trentino where mountain slopes flank the Adige River. It is made from the local Enantio grape, from vines more than 150 years old that were never affected by phylloxera. 750ml, 14% ABV.

ca-del-baio-moscato-dasti.title: Ca’ del Baio 101 Moscato d'Asti 2025
ca-del-baio-moscato-dasti.bodyHtml:
Ca’ del Baio 101 Moscato d'Asti 2025 is an inviting, fresh, and delightfully aromatic sweet white wine produced by the historical Grasso family estate in the Langhe region of Piedmont. Sourced from plot 101 in Treiso, this 100% Moscato Bianco displays a luminous straw-yellow color with golden highlights and a fine, persistent perlage. The fragrant bouquet opens with expressive notes of white flowers, lime blossom, juicy white peach, apricot, and honeysuckle. On the palate, it is light-bodied, gently sweet, and vibrant, balancing its natural grape sugars with a crisp, refreshing acidity that leads to a clean, fruity finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with fruit tarts, hazelnut cake, apple strudel, spicy Asian dishes, panettone, fresh berries, and light creamy cheeses.

brunello-di-montalcino-riserva-d-o-c-g.title: Col D’orcia 'Poggio Al Vento' Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2016
brunello-di-montalcino-riserva-d-o-c-g.bodyHtml:
Col D'Orcia 'Poggio Al Vento' Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2016 is an iconic, highly acclaimed Italian red wine produced from the historic single-vineyard "Poggio al Vento" estate in southern Montalcino. Aged for four years in large Slavonian oak casks and an additional three years in bottle prior to release, it displays a deep, brilliant ruby-red hue with subtle garnet reflections. The nose reveals a complex and intoxicating bouquet of ripe red cherry, wild blackberry, crushed flowers, and dried herbs, seamlessly interwoven with leather, graphite, and exotic baking spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied, structured, and muscular, delivering vibrant red berry and dark fruit flavors underpinned by fine, persistent tannins and energetic natural acidity that ensure remarkable longevity.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with Florentine T-bone steak, braised venison, roasted wild boar, truffled dishes, and long-aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

98 Points - James Suckling

Super classic Brunello from a classic vintage, being released now. The perfume to this is really something, with cherries, flowers, lead pencil and light hints of graphite. Then it moves to raspberries and black cherries with some sandalwood shavings. You just want to smell it. Clear and transparent. Full-bodied with very fine and succinct tannins that fill the mouth and show super tension and form. Extremely long and structured. Beautiful now, but this will age for decades ahead. Drink or hold.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Packed with vibrant cherry, strawberry, rose, mineral and tobacco aromas and flavors, this red is racy and pure, with a superb aftertaste. Defined by its bracing acidity and precise fruit flavors, this still has some tannins to resolve. So youthful and fresh, it feels like this has hardly budged in its evolution. Best from 2027 through 2045.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is primarily savory, with aromas of old leather, dirt and mixed spices, like a general store in the Old West with cherry and licorice candy in bins. The palate is more fruit-forward, with notes of cherries and figs, with currents of coffee and sambuca mingling to create a subtle sense of edginess. Tannins and acid oversee affairs without intruding, like a good party host.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The organic Col d'Orcia 2016 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Poggio al Vento (in a medium-heavy glass bottle) is quite beautiful, truth be told, with a unique sense of direct power, medium-rich texture and evolved fruit. This Riserva takes us back in time to one of the most successful vintages in Montalcino history. The bouquet is distinguished by dried fruit, rose potpourri and roasted chestnut husk. The tannins are resolved, and the wine ends on a softly silky note.

monteraponi-chianticl-rsv-campitello.title: Monteraponi Chianti Classico Riserva Il Campitello 2019
monteraponi-chianticl-rsv-campitello.bodyHtml:
Monteraponi Chianti Classico Riserva Il Campitello 2019 is an exceptional, elegant Tuscan red wine crafted from low-yielding organic vines over 40 years old. It opens with intense, refined aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild red berries, crushed violet, dried herbs, and subtle iron minerality. On the palate, it exhibits superb tension and focus, showing a core of concentrated fruit balanced by bright acidity, silky fine-grained tannins, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled Florentine T-bone steak, braised wild boar ragù, roasted lamb chops, rich mushroom risotto, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The organic Monteraponi 2019 Chianti Classico Riserva Il Campitello is a beautiful wine that expresses itself elegantly, thanks to balanced fruit, good concentration and well-dosed intensity. The wine is a blend of 90% Sangiovese, 5% Colorino and 5% Canaiolo with berries from 55-year-old vines on a mix of schistous galestro and limestone alberese soils. It offers a noticeably darker appearance with aromas of pressed blackberry, button mushroom and blue flower. This Riserva maintains a wild but delicate personality throughout, with a spot of crushed white pepper in a distant background role. Only 6,600 bottles were made.

monteraponi-baron-ugo-toscana-rosso-igt.title: Monteraponi Baron' Ugo Toscana Rosso 2019 750ml
monteraponi-baron-ugo-toscana-rosso-igt.bodyHtml: Monteraponi Baron'Ugo 2019 is a Toscana Rosso IGT from Monteraponi, an organic estate at Radda in the heart of Chianti Classico. It is made mainly from Sangiovese with small amounts of Canaiolo and Colorino, grown on a single high vineyard at around 560 metres on stony alberese limestone soils. The vineyard was among the first planted by Antonio Braganti after he bought the property in 1974. The 2019 vintage was aged for three years in cask before bottling. 14% ABV, 750ml.

monteraponi-chianti-classico.title: Monteraponi Chianti Classico Riserva Il Campitello 2019
monteraponi-chianti-classico.bodyHtml:
Monteraponi Chianti Classico Riserva Il Campitello 2019 is an exceptional, elegant Tuscan red wine crafted from low-yielding organic vines over 40 years old. It opens with intense, refined aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild red berries, crushed violet, dried herbs, and subtle iron minerality. On the palate, it exhibits superb tension and focus, showing a core of concentrated fruit balanced by bright acidity, silky fine-grained tannins, and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with grilled Florentine T-bone steak, braised wild boar ragù, roasted lamb chops, rich mushroom risotto, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The organic Monteraponi 2019 Chianti Classico Riserva Il Campitello is a beautiful wine that expresses itself elegantly, thanks to balanced fruit, good concentration and well-dosed intensity. The wine is a blend of 90% Sangiovese, 5% Colorino and 5% Canaiolo with berries from 55-year-old vines on a mix of schistous galestro and limestone alberese soils. It offers a noticeably darker appearance with aromas of pressed blackberry, button mushroom and blue flower. This Riserva maintains a wild but delicate personality throughout, with a spot of crushed white pepper in a distant background role. Only 6,600 bottles were made.

brunello-di-montalcino-2017.title: Altesino Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2017
brunello-di-montalcino-2017.bodyHtml:
This Brunello Riserva offers a solid, full body and excellent aging potential. Its ample and complex bouquet is reminiscent of violets, wild berries, cedar, leather, tobacco and spices. On the palate, it is austere and seductive with a perfect blend of fruit, acidity and mouth coating tannins. This is the perfect bottle for Brunello lovers.

Pair with steak au poivre, rack of lamb or beef carpaccio.

95 Points - James Suckling
Complex and fragrant nose of neroli, currants, sour cherries, sandalwood, cassis and wild herbs. Roasted walnuts, too. Full-bodied with firm, fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity. Full of energy and power. Try in 2024.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2017 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva (with 13,000 bottles made) shows dark fruit, dried cherry and baked plum. The wine is slightly subdued aromatically speaking compared to the new Brunello annata release, and I chalk that up to the very hot and dry conditions of the relentless 2017 summer. Cinnamon, cumin and crushed clove appear in a second wave and underline this Riserva's more elaborate aging regime. The finish is layered and rich with full-bodied Sangiovese intensity.

93 Points - Wine Spectator
This red starts out round, turning more precise and taut as it builds to the finish. Shows cherry, wild herb, soy and loam flavors that ply the supple texture, before the tannins exert their influence and the finish tightens up (a good sign for the future).

le-petit-haut-lafite-blanc.title: Chateau Smith Haut Lafitte 'Le Petit Smith Haut Lafitte' Blanc 2019
le-petit-haut-lafite-blanc.bodyHtml:
A sophisticated and high-toned second label white from the prestigious Smith Haut Lafitte estate, the 2019 Le Petit Haut Lafitte Blanc reflects the brilliance of a warm, dry vintage. This wine presents a pale straw color and opens with a vibrant, complex bouquet of pink grapefruit, lemon zest, and white peaches, accented by elegant notes of white blossoms and a subtle flinty minerality. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with a remarkable tension between its creamy, barrel-fermented texture and a crisp, citrus-driven acidity. Delicate hints of vanilla, fresh ginger, and honeysuckle emerge on the long, saline finish. Crafted with the same meticulous care as the Grand Vin, it offers exceptional precision and freshness.

95 Points - James Suckling

A bright, salty white with dried-apple, lemon and hot-stone character. It’s full-bodied, yet vivid and tight with vibrant energy at the end.

piper-heidsieck-brut-2014.title: Piper-Heidsieck Brut Vintage 2014
piper-heidsieck-brut-2014.bodyHtml:
Opens with radiant aromas of orange blossom, apricot, toasted brioche, and roasted almonds. The palate is refined and vibrant with a delicate, creamy mousse, revealing flavours of mandarin, lime zest, golden pear, and subtle liquorice, balanced by crystalline acidity and a long, chalky mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with fresh oysters, butter-poached lobster, sea scallops, prawn gratin, black truffle tartines, or aged Comté cheese.


93 Points - James Suckling

Showing nicely complex notes of figs, red apples, golden pears, walnuts and lemon conserve on toast, with a touch of beeswax. It’s medium-bodied, with bright acidity and a textured, phenolic palate. Tight bubbles. Dry feel.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2014 Brut Vintage, a blend of 55% Pinot Noir and 45% Chardonnay with a dosage of seven grams per liter, has turned out nicely with aromas of pear, peach, almonds and smoky hints. Medium to full-bodied, supple and fruity with a delicate mousse, this is a structured, tension-filled but airborne Champagne with high acidity, the sign of a cool weather vintage.

bombay-sapphire-3.title: Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin 1.75L
bombay-sapphire-3.bodyHtml:
Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin is an iconic, world-renowned gin crafted using a proprietary vapor-infusion process. First created in 1987 based on an 1761 recipe, ten sustainably sourced botanicals are held separately from the spirit in perforated copper baskets and infused with hot spirit vapor, yielding a delicate, bright, and perfectly balanced botanical profile.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, seafood tapas, goat cheese crostini, lemon tarts, or sushi.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear and luminous in appearance with a smooth, light, and crisp mouthfeel.

Nose : Fresh juniper, bright citrus, floral notes, subtle pine, and warm earthy spices.

Palate : Clean, balanced, and round with vibrant juniper berries, zesty lemon, peppery coriander, subtle liquorice, and almond sweetness.

Finish : Medium, crisp, and refreshing with lingering hints of citrus zest and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve as the foundational spirit in a classic Gin & Tonic with fresh lime, in a Dry Martini, or over ice with tonic water.

powers-cabernet-sauvignon-champoux.title: Powers Cabernet Sauvignon
powers-cabernet-sauvignon-champoux.bodyHtml:
A vibrant Washington Cabernet with red fruit, blackberry and anise aromas leading into jammy plum and raspberry. The palate is juicy and approachable, with subtle toasted oak, soft tannins and a smooth fruit-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Excellent with grilled steak, mushroom risotto, roasted beef, burgers, braised meats and sharp aged cheeses.

powers-cabernet-sauvignon-kiona.title: Powers Kiona Vineyards Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml

arteis-co-blanc-de-blancs-2013.title: Arteis & Co Blanc De Blancs Extra Brut Champagne 2013 750ml
arteis-co-blanc-de-blancs-2013.bodyHtml:
Arteis might just be the best Champagne you have never heard of. This boutique producer is making some truly outstanding wine. These wines are powerful yet elegant, with zesty citrus and green apple flavours, along with hints of almonds and brioche. It’s a brilliant bottle of bubbly. 

2013 Vintage

Artéis & Co, with a focus on high-quality, artisanal, vintage champagne, is the brainchild of Chef de Cave Fabien Gay (who previously worked at Perrier-Jouët and Mumm) and Jean-Philippe Diot, a grower based in Vinay. Building on their solid experience and knowledge they wanted to build a project that celebrates expression and craftsmanship, rather than being bound by a house style. They aim to produce world-class champagnes that rival those of the most prestigious houses, but with a fresher take for a fraction of the price.

fattoria-del-pino-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Fattoria del Pino Brunello di Montalcino 2018
fattoria-del-pino-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml: Jessica Pellegrini of Fattoria Del Pino is a rising star in Montalcino. Her winery was born in 2000, two years after her father Nerio purchased 7 hectares of land in the Montosoli. She produces lovely wines from this small plot located in northern Montalcino.

fattoria-del-pino-brunello-di-montalcino.title: Fattoria Del Pino Brunello Di Montalcino 2019
fattoria-del-pino-brunello-di-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Fattoria Del Pino Brunello Di Montalcino 2019 is an artisanal, highly expressive Tuscan red wine produced by winemaker Jessica Pellegrini from organically farmed Sangiovese vines located on the cooler, high-altitude slopes north of Montalcino. Spontaneously fermented with native yeasts and aged for 36 months in large traditional Slavonian oak casks, it displays a vibrant ruby-garnet color. The nose opens with alluring aromatics of ripe red cherry, wild strawberry, dried rose petals, and orange peel, intertwined with underlying notes of fresh herbs, leather, and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it is elegant, medium-to-full-bodied, and beautifully balanced, offering pure red fruit flavors underpinned by fine-grained tannins, bright acidity, and a long, savory, earth-inflected finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with classic Bistecca alla Fiorentina, braised wild boar ragù, herb-roasted rack of lamb, osso buco, and aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

94 Points - James Suckling

A juicy and layered red with lovely fruit that ranges from cherries to orange peel. It’s medium-bodied with firm tannins that take you down the wine. Structured and focused with lovely purity of fruit. Drink after 2027.

jaffurs-santa-barbara-county-syrah.title: Jaffurs Santa Barbara County Syrah 2020
jaffurs-santa-barbara-county-syrah.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Jaffurs Syrah from Santa Barbara County is a red wine known for its floral aromatics, red fruit notes, and a touch of tobacco leaf. It exhibits a balanced and layered palate with flavors of cherry, mulberry, and a savory herbaceous quality, all culminating in a finish characterized by silky tannins. This wine is described as elegant and capable of aging gracefully over 5-8 years, according to Jaffurs Wine Cellars. 

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This county blend gives a firm sense of the Jaffurs style, offering lovely aromas of lavender, blueberry, white pepper and a touch of vanilla on the nose. The palate lands with a crisp plum and berry combo, riding a taut, linear line of acidity into a finish laced with fresh flowers and pepper dust.

jaffurs-bien-nacido-vineyard-syrah-2018.title: Jaffurs Bien Nacido Vineyard Syrah 2018
jaffurs-bien-nacido-vineyard-syrah-2018.bodyHtml:
Bien Nacido is our coolest-climate Syrah vineyard, planted across two blocks up the hillsides overlooking Santa Maria Valley. The 2018 is a dark, full-bodied wine. Classic Syrah flavors include black currant, cured meat, crushed pepper and green olive. Bright acidity and a supple mid-palate texture, with mineral tension and a long, saline finish. This is a textbook Bien Nacido Syrah that will improve with cellaring, and should hold well into a decade past release.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This sure-to-be long-lasting expression of this historic vineyard kicks off with snappy aromas of black raspberry, white pepper and charred meat on the nose. There is a fresh and edgy quality to the hearty palate, full of charred berries, black pepper and rounded violet flavors. It opens steadily with air. Drink now through 2038

corvezzo-pink-organic-1955-prosecco.title: Corvezzo Pink Organic 1955 Prosecco 750ml
corvezzo-pink-organic-1955-prosecco.bodyHtml: Corvezzo Organic Prosecco Rosé is a sparkling wine from the Corvezzo family estate in the Veneto, part of its Family Collection and presented in a distinctive faceted bottle. It is an organic Prosecco DOC Rosé with a fine, persistent mousse and an elegant pale pink colour. It shows wild strawberry and other small red fruits with delicate hints of citrus and acacia flowers, and the palate is fresh and lively, with an aftertaste that lingers on berries and flowers. Serve well chilled as an aperitif, on a picnic, with charcuterie or with crispy fried fish. 750ml, 11% alcohol.

corvezzo-extra-organic-1955-prosecco.title: Corvezzo Extra Organic 1955 Prosecco 750ml
corvezzo-extra-organic-1955-prosecco.bodyHtml: Corvezzo Family Collection 1955 is an organic Prosecco DOC from the Veneto, labelled Organic / Biologico. It shows a fine, silky perlage, with pear, green apple and white flowers on the nose and nuances of acacia blossom, wax and honey that the producer attributes to its limestone soils. Fresh, with good acidity and balance, it suits any toast and pairs well with light raw-fish starters. This listing is a 750ml bottle at 11.5% ABV.

chateau-la-haye.title: Chateau Haut-Brion Blanc 2020 750ml
chateau-la-haye.bodyHtml:
98 Points - James Suckling

Very perfumed with floral, citrus and stone aromas, as well as hints of grapefruit. It’s full-bodied and seamless in texture. Extremely long and fine-grained. 72% sauvignon and 28% semillon. Normally 50/50. Barrel Sample: 97-98

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2020 Château Hosanna is up there with the crème de la crème of the appellation and is a true gem. Awesome cassis, candied violets, truffle, chocolate, and underbrush-like notes define the bouquet, and it's full-bodied, with a seamless, silky texture, ultra-fine tannins, and a rock star of a finish. This is another magical Pomerol from the Moueix family that you couldn't have enough of.
Barrel Sample: 96-98

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Tightly textured, this is a wine whose future is assured. With intense white fruits, spice and touches of toast from the wood aging, the wine's concentration and taut character combine richness and structure.
Barrel Sample: 96-98

96 Points - Decanter
Grippy fresh, green-tinged flavors, a little more evident than in the Mission Haut-Brion Blanc, here you get more angular acidities, and yet it works. Sauvignon-dominant flavors and aromatics of rosemary, mint, turmeric, lime blossom and steely citrus. Excellent persistency and a deliciously mouthwatering finish.
Barrel Sample: 96

patricia-green-estate-vineyar-pinot-noir.title: Girlan Patricia Pinot Noir 2023
patricia-green-estate-vineyar-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Ruby red color with intense aroma of sweet and sour cherry as well as raspberry. This wine shows a lively acidity-framework and convinces with a juicy finish. Thanks to its velvety structure, it goes well with a wide variety of meat dishes.

patricia-green-chehalem-mntn-vy-pinot-no.title: Patricia Green Cellars Chehalem Mountain Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021 750ml
patricia-green-chehalem-mntn-vy-pinot-no.bodyHtml: Patricia Green Cellars Chehalem Mountain Vineyard Pinot Noir 2021 750ml

barnett-pinot-noir-tina-marie-vineyard.title: Barnett Vineyards Tina Marie Pinot Noir 2023
barnett-pinot-noir-tina-marie-vineyard.bodyHtml: The 2023 Tina Marie Pinot Noir is a beautiful medium ruby color. The nose is very bright and fragrant filled with pomegranate, cherry blossoms, white pepper and fresh truffles. Slight dusty cocoa and an edge of cinnamon spice also make up the aromatics. Due to a five-day cold soak there is a beautiful viscosity to the wine. The palate is full of red berry fruit, raspberries and strawberry jam which is balanced with a nice gravel minerality. This vintage has a bit more grip as far as the tannins are concerned, however the fresh acid from this cool sub-appellation keeps them in check. There is a long fresh cherry finish.

barnett-chardonnay-2021-sangiacomo.title: Butternut Chardonnay 2021/2022 750ml
barnett-chardonnay-2021-sangiacomo.bodyHtml:
Butternut Chardonnay is a rich, approachable California white wine produced by Miller Family Wine Company. Offering inviting aromas of ripe peach, baked apple, and vanilla, this Chardonnay delivers a smooth, creamy palate with notes of butterscotch and gentle spice. Its generous fruit character and balanced finish make it an excellent choice for casual entertaining or pairing with comforting dishes.

Food Pairing: Creamy chicken pasta, roasted poultry, grilled salmon, buttery seafood, mushroom risotto, soft cheeses, and roasted vegetables.

piro-points-west-pinot-noir.title: Piro Presqu'ile Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020 750ml
piro-points-west-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Piro Presqu'ile Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020

piro-sandford-benedict-pinot-noir.title: Piro Presqu'ile Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020 750ml
piro-sandford-benedict-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Piro Presqu'ile Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020

castello-di-verduno-barbaresco-rabajabas.title: Castello Di Verduno Rabaja Barbaresco 2018 750ml
castello-di-verduno-barbaresco-rabajabas.bodyHtml: Castello di Verduno Barbaresco Rabajà-Bas 2018 is a single-vineyard Barbaresco DOCG from Castello di Verduno, the historic estate of the Burlotto family led by Gabriella Burlotto and Franco Bianco, whose cellar sits at the top of the village of Verduno. The wine is 100% Nebbiolo from vines planted between 1974 and 1990 in Rabajà-Bas, a site once part of the famous Rabajà cru before a road divided it in the 1990s. It is fermented with indigenous yeasts in stainless steel, aged 18 to 24 months in large used Slavonian oak vats, and bottled without fining or filtration. This 2018 vintage is a 750ml bottle at 14% ABV.

castello-di-verduno-barolo-masara.title: Castello Di Verduno Barolo Massara 2018
castello-di-verduno-barolo-masara.bodyHtml:
This flies under the radar compared to Monvigliero, and it feels a little closer in style to La Morra, but there’s fine-boned tannins and a lovely sense of savouriness on the finish. Very well balanced.

94 Points - Vinous

The 2018 Barolo Massara is impressive. Deep and yet weightless, the Massara captures much of the best this tricky vintage has to offer. Wild cherry, rose petal, mint, dried herbs, orange peel and exotic spice notes abound. This layered Verduno Barolo is superb and also distinctive.

leblon-cachaca-1.title: Leblon Cachaca
leblon-cachaca-1.bodyHtml:
Leblon Cachaca is a Brazilian cachaca from Maison Leblon, a craft distillery in Patos de Minas, in the western highlands of Minas Gerais, that produces nothing but Leblon. The sugar cane is cut by hand, taken quickly to the distillery and pressed gently for fresh juice, which is distilled in batches in copper alambique pot stills. The spirit then rests for up to six months in brandy-cured casks from France, a step meant to round it out without masking the fruity cane aroma, before batches are blended. It is bottled at 40% ABV in a 750 ml bottle and is the classic base for a Caipirinha, Brazil's national cocktail.

Tasting Notes: Fresh sugar cane, fruit and spice with a gentle sweetness and a smooth, light to medium body.

Nose: Lively and fruity, with layers of fresh-cut sugar cane, spices and fruit.

Palate: Warming, with a gentle sweetness in the middle of the tongue that builds as it lingers.

Finish: Ultra-smooth.

Serve: In a Caipirinha with lime and sugar; the producer notes that it mixes well with most fruits, herbs, spices and liqueurs.

patz-hall-dutton-ranch-chardonnay.title: Patz & Hall Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 750ml
patz-hall-dutton-ranch-chardonnay.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2021 vintage) "This harmonious and well-balanced wine opens with light butter, toast and Bartlett pear aromas, then fills the mouth with rich pear and peach flavors accented by vanilla. A full body is nicely paired with good acidity, so the wine works fine as a cocktail or with lunch and dinner." - 92/100, Wine Enthusiast

patz-hall-chenoweth-pinot-noir.title: Patz & Hall Chenoweth Ranch Pinot Noir 2019 750ml
patz-hall-chenoweth-pinot-noir.bodyHtml: Patz & Hall Chenoweth Ranch Pinot Noir 2019 is a single-vineyard Pinot Noir from the Chenoweth Ranch in the Russian River Valley of Sonoma County, California. The label notes that 32 barrels were produced. 750ml, 14.5% alcohol.

st-cosme-chateauneuf-du-pape.title: Chateau De Saint Cosme Saint Cosme Chateauneuf-Du-Pape 2022 750ml
st-cosme-chateauneuf-du-pape.bodyHtml:
Chateau de Saint Cosme is the leading estate of Gigondas and produces the benchmark wines of the appellation. The property has been in the hands of the Barruol family since 1490. Louis Barruol took over from his father in 1992 making a dramatic shift to quality and converting to biodynamics in 2010.

The estate lies in the heart of Gigondas where 15 hectares of vineyard grow in the shade of the Dentelles de Montmirail mountain. In addition to the estate-grown wines labeled “Chateau de Saint Cosme,” Louis Barruol buys grapes from contracted growers, labeling these “negociant” wines simply as “Saint Cosme.”

Saint Cosme Chateauneuf-du-Pape comes from three climats, the most famous of which is the plateau of La Crau with its distinctive galets over clay, bringing power and structure to the blend. The climats of Valori and Christia are on sandy soils, giving the wine its perfume and freshness. The wine is a blend of Grenache Mourvedre, Syrah, and Cinsaut, made with whole cluster fermentation from indigenous yeasts, is aged for 24 months in old 228-liter barrels, and bottled without fining or filtration.

93 Points - Wine Spectator - Modern and stylish, offering an engaging mix of raspberry puree, warm baking spices and red licorice, with vanilla highlights. A beam of iron minerality brings shape and balance to this version, while invigorating acidity and tannins drive the energy. Grenache, Mourvedre, Syrah and Cinsault.

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck - The 2019 Chateauneuf Du Pape comes from La Crau and a few other terroirs and is 60% Grenache and 40% Mourvedre. Blackberries, black raspberries, peppery herbs, and some solid earthy minerality give way to a medium to full-bodied, ripe, yet also structured 2019. Some 2019's can have a touch of austerity in their tannins, but this is supple and seamless. It will evolve for 10-15 years.

stolpman-estate-grown-roussanne.title: Stolpman Vineyards Roussanne 2019 750ml
stolpman-estate-grown-roussanne.bodyHtml: Critic tasting note: (2019 vintage) "Earthy aromas of lemon wedges covered in dust are lifted by honey and nut oil on the nose of this bottling. There's a viscous texture to the palate, where baked lemon, toasted almond and delicate honey flavors converge. Matt Kettmann" - 91/100, Wine Enthusiast

william-fevre-chablis-1er-cru-vaillons.title: Domaine William Fevre Chablis Premier Cru Vaillons 2022 750ml
william-fevre-chablis-1er-cru-vaillons.bodyHtml: Domaine William Fèvre Chablis Premier Cru Vaillons 2022 is a 100% Chardonnay from the Côte des Vaillons, a 129-hectare premier cru on the left bank of the Serein. Here the soil is more limestone than clay, over hard, fractured Portlandian limestone. The domaine works by gravity, presses gently for 1.5 to 2 hours, settles the must lightly and lets fermentations run naturally; 30–40% of the wine is fermented in French oak barrels averaging six years old, the rest in small stainless steel tanks. In 2022 the harvest began on 31 August with healthy, thick-skinned grapes. The domaine notes a fresh, intense bouquet of fruit and flowers with a touch of minerality and a round, full palate. 750 ml, 13% ABV.

chateau-carbonnieux-grand-cru-classe.title: Chateau Carbonnieux Blanc 2020
chateau-carbonnieux-grand-cru-classe.bodyHtml:
Château Carbonnieux Blanc 2020 is an exceptionally crisp, elegant, and aromatically complex dry white Grand Cru Classé de Graves from Pessac-Léognan. Sourced from gravelly clay-limestone soils, this estate blend exhibits vibrant, lifted aromas of yuzu, lime zest, pink grapefruit, and green apple interwoven with white flowers, lemon curd, crushed stone minerality, and subtle beeswax. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, offering a satiny, mouth-coating texture balanced by bright, driving natural acidity, delivering a long, crisp, and citrus-focused finish.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, pan-seared sea scallops, goat cheese crostini, grilled sea bass with lemon butter, or herb-roasted chicken breast.

93 Points - James Suckling

Lots of dried lemon, spiced pear, matchstick, and ginger aromas and flavors. Full-bodied, with light caramel, honey and some tropical fruits. Dense wine, but framed with phenolics. Delicious finish. Outstanding as always. 65% sauvignon and 35% semillon. Drink now.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Carbonnieux Blanc has turned out very well in bottle, exhibiting attractive aromas of lemon oil, pomelo, crisp stone fruit, mint and white flowers. Medium to full-bodied, satiny and incisive, with a layered, concentrated mid-palate and a penetrating finish, it's a great success in the estate's Sauvginon-dominant style.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Fresh and breezy, with a fleur de sel edge that adds nice energy to the core of gooseberry, white peach and lemon gelée. Presents a pretty quinine echo through the finish. Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon. Drink now through 2026.

chateau-troplong-mondot-grand-cru-classe.title: Chateau Troplong Mondot 2016 750ml
chateau-troplong-mondot-grand-cru-classe.bodyHtml:
Critic tasting note: (2016 vintage) "The inky hue in the wine clearly matches up with the level of concentration in the ripe, dark berries. Add in liberal doses of black licorice, smoke, espresso, chocolate and boysenberry, and you have the core of the wine. Powerful, full, rich and with real depth of flavor, give this 10-12 years before popping a cork." - 97/100, Jeff Leve, The Wine Cellar Insider

Classification
Saint-Emilion Premier Grand Cru Classé B


Producer Notes
The power of the ‘terroir’ tempered by the glistening fruit. The aromatic richness enhanced with elegant precision. The perfect balance of elements that respond to one another. The revelation of a unique universe that opens itself up over time. A feeling of fullness.

Drinking Window 2021-2050

Blend

90% Merlot, 8% Cabernet Sauvignon, & 2% Cabernet Franc
Vineyard Notes
Troplong Mondot dominates the landscape. Located at the highest point of the appellation, its ‘terroir’ benefits from an exceptional 360° exposure and incomparable soil complexity. In this atypical panorama, the vineyard is part of a natural heritage whose biodiversity is a long-standing reality. As the outcome of this perfect balance, the wines reflect the estate’s riches and reveal an identity like no other.

chateau-feytit-clinet-pomerol.title: Chateau Feytit-Clinet Pomerol 2020 750ml
chateau-feytit-clinet-pomerol.bodyHtml: Château Feytit-Clinet 2020 is a Pomerol from a small estate on the right bank of Bordeaux, owned by the Chasseuil family since 2000. The vineyard covers about six hectares of Pomerol with vines averaging around 33 years old. For the 2020 vintage the blend is 90% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Franc. After harvest the grapes are sorted twice, before and after destemming, then given a three-day cold pre-fermentation maceration in cement vats. Fermentation combines punch-downs with gentle pump-overs, and macerations last three to four weeks. The grand vin is then run off into barrels, 70% of them new, for the malolactic fermentation, and kept on its fine lees with regular stirring for two months before racking. This listing is the 750ml bottle.

bodegas-arzuaga-amaya.title: Bodegas Arzuaga Reserva Especial 2017
bodegas-arzuaga-amaya.bodyHtml:
A limited-production Ribera del Duero red displaying aromas of black cherry, cassis, cedar, tobacco, and sweet baking spice. Rich and concentrated on the palate, it combines refined tannins, layered dark fruit, and remarkable depth with a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roast lamb, dry-aged beef, game meats, braised short ribs, and aged Manchego cheese.

coil-chenin-blanc.title: Alheit Vineyards Huilkrans Chenin Blanc 2024
coil-chenin-blanc.bodyHtml:
Alheit Vineyards Huilkrans 2024 is an exceptional South African white wine from the Skurfberg area of the Citrusdal Mountain region in the Western Cape. Produced by Alheit Vineyards, founded by Chris and Suzaan Alheit, this single-vineyard Chenin Blanc showcases the remarkable character of old vines grown in one of South Africa's most distinctive wine-growing landscapes. The name Huilkrans, meaning "Crying Cliff" in Afrikaans, reflects the dramatic natural surroundings of the vineyard. The wine offers an elegant expression of Chenin Blanc, combining citrus fruit, ripe pear, white peach and delicate floral aromas with subtle notes of honey, herbs and crushed stone. Its concentrated palate is balanced by vibrant acidity, a textured mouthfeel and a long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Grilled sea bass, roasted halibut, seared scallops, lobster, lemon-herb chicken, roasted pork tenderloin, creamy seafood pasta, mushroom risotto, goat cheese and aged Comté.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

This wonderfully cool, creamy and textured white has aromas and flavors of sliced pears, mango pits, pomelo rind, seashells and honey. It’s medium-bodied with bright acidity and saline freshness. Long, savory and precise finish. From old-bush vines on Skurfberg (Citrusdal Mountain). Drink or hold.

96 Points - Wine Advocate

The Alheit Vineyards 2024 Citrusdal Mountain Huilkrans comes from bush vines in their mid-50s, rooted in red sand over red clay at roughly 450 meters in elevation, a low-yielding site that naturally drives intensity and tension. The wine can show high acidity, shaping a distinctly different mineral and aromatic profile that leans into orange blossom, lemon blossom and lifted floral notes rather than overt fruit, recalling the exotic scents of a Moroccan garden such as the Jardin Majorelle in Marrakesh. Dry and linear on the palate, it finishes fresh and finely etched, with brightness and precision outweighing richness.

clos-des-papes-chdnp-blanc-2021.title: Clos Des Papes (Paul-Vincent Avril) Chateauneuf-Du-Pape Blanc 2021
clos-des-papes-chdnp-blanc-2021.bodyHtml:
Clos des Papes (Paul Avril) Châteauneuf-du-Pape Blanc 2021 is a brilliantly crafted, age-worthy white wine from one of the Southern Rhône's most legendary estates. Meticulously blended from equal parts of all six permitted white varieties—Grenache Blanc, Roussanne, Clairette, Bourboulenc, Picpoul, and Picardan—this wine is co-fermented in stainless steel with malolactic fermentation blocked to preserve its incredible freshness and tension. In the glass, it reveals a pale, brilliant lemon hue. The aromatic bouquet is elegant and complex, opening with alluring notes of white peach, Anjou pear, and crushed stone, layered with nuances of pink grapefruit, anise, and white spring flowers. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, remarkably focused, and impeccably balanced, delivering a layered, creamy core of orchard fruit offset by a crisp, vibrant acidity and a striking saline minerality. The finish is remarkably pure, precise, and gracefully long, promising beautiful evolution in the cellar for over a decade.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with pan-seared sea scallops, buttery lobster tail, roasted poultry in creamy herb sauces, and delicate, fresh goat cheeses.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A more classic, age-worthy vintage for Clos des Papes's white wine, the 2021 Chateauneuf du Pape Blanc features compelling aromas of crushed stone, pink grapefruit and lime. Medium-bodied, fresh and focused, it's a relatively lean example that should easily age into the next decade, seeming to add richness along the way.

92 Points - James Suckling

A focused and aromatic nose of citron, grapefruit, bay leaves, toasted bread and white pepper. Medium body with a creamy core of apricots and stone fruit on the palate. Round and caressing with a silky, fruity and floral finish. Drink or hold.

lightfoot-wolfville-brut-2017.title: Lightfoot & Wolfville Blanc De Blancs Brut 2017 750ml
lightfoot-wolfville-brut-2017.bodyHtml: The 2017 Lightfoot & Wolfville Blanc de Blancs Brut is a sparkling wine made from 100% Chardonnay grapes. It exhibits a pale straw color with fine, persistent bubbles. Nose offers layered aromas of brioche, lemon shortbread, almond skin, and salty beach stones. On the palate, it's focused and precise, with vivid acidity, crisp green apple notes, and rich lees-aged flavors, complemented by a creamy mid-palate and distinct minerality.

bedrock-wine-co-evangelho-vineyard-heri.title: Beringer Private Reserve Chardonnay 2024
bedrock-wine-co-evangelho-vineyard-heri.bodyHtml:
Beringer Private Reserve Chardonnay 2024 is a classic, rich, and beautifully crafted California white wine, representing the pinnacle of Beringer’s Chardonnay winemaking in Napa Valley. Displaying a luminous golden hue, it opens with fragrant aromas of ripe yellow apple, white peach, honeysuckle, and toasted brioche, seamlessly supported by delicate oak spices and vanilla notes. On the palate, it is full-bodied, opulent, and creamy, delivering a lush mouthfeel balanced by lively natural acidity that carries rich flavors of baked pear, lemon curd, and subtle toasted hazelnut through a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken with herbs, pan-seared sea scallops, creamy mushroom risotto, and aged Gruyère cheese.

96 Points - James Suckling

This has a vivid intensity balanced with freshness and just the right influence of oak. Aromas of preserved lemons, salted caramel, orange blossoms, lanolin and spices. The palate is tightly wound, showing mouthwatering acidity and a lovely texture with a flavorful finish. About 80% malolactic fermentation. Drink or hold.

la-serena-brunello-reserva-gemini-2015.title: La Serena Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Gemini 2015 750ml
la-serena-brunello-reserva-gemini-2015.bodyHtml:
Intense and bright ruby red color. Ample and persistent bouquet with elegant hints of fruit, ethereal notes of marasca cherry in alcohol, suggestions of dried tobacco and complex hints of sweet spices. Velvety, opulent and long tannins, well supported by a crunchy acidity that leaves no doubt about the ability of a long aging. Juicy, savory and very mineral finish, characterized by an interminable gustatory energy, which stimulates salivation and recalls important meat-based foods, with which the partnership of this Reserve can reach perfection. Wine with a strong personality.

95 Points - James Suckling
A firm, linear red with plum, berry, dark chocolate and mushroom character. It’s full-to medium-bodied with a solid core of tannins to the ripe fruit. A rather traditional, tight red. Better after 2024.

grgich-hills-cabernet-sauvignon-2010.title: Grgich Hills Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2010 750ml
grgich-hills-cabernet-sauvignon-2010.bodyHtml:
Grgich Hills crafts their Cabernet Sauvignon with minimal intervention, farming our vineyards naturally, without artificial pesticides or herbicides. This wine is packed with rich aromas of black cherry and licorice with a hint of mocha and vintage leather. Its full body and fine-grained tannins make it the perfect partner with grilled steak, rack of lamb or roasted duck.
91 Points - Wine Spectator
A wine that offers a tight, focused beam of loamy earth, dried dark berry, cedar, anise and espresso. Features good length, with gripping tannins. Shows Grgich Hills at the top of its Cabernet game. Best from 2015 through 2026.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This valley-wide blend comes from Yountville, Calistoga and Rutherford. It combines the best fruit of the appellations, resulting in a dry, full-bodied and tannic young wine, with classic Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon flavors of cassis. Beautiful now, after a few hours of decanting, and should hold in the bottle for at least eight years.

poggerino-chianti-classico-ris-bugialla.title: Poggerino Bugialla Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 750ml
poggerino-chianti-classico-ris-bugialla.bodyHtml:
Poggerino's "Bugialla" Chianti Classico Riserva is a distinguished expression of 100% Sangiovese from the Radda in Chianti region. The 2019 vintage showcases fresh primary fruit with medium-rich concentration, harmonious balance between fruit and spice, and vibrant brightness characteristic of Radda in Chianti. The wine is aged traditionally, resulting in a brilliant garnet hue and aromas of wild berries, pressed roses, and dark spices. On the palate, it reveals fleshy raspberries, blood orange, and licorice, framed by velvety tannins and vibrant acidity. The long, savory finish highlights its impeccable balance and aging potential.

Poggerino Chianti Classico Bugialla Riserva is a brilliant ruby red color. On the nose notes of blackberries, leather, cherries and red currants with a touch of licorice, graphite and tobacco. Sweet and persistent tannins.

Pairs well with aged cheeses, pizza and your favorite pasta dishes.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Expressive, sporting cherry, plum, floral and mineral flavors matched to a vibrant frame. Open, elegant and beautifully balanced, making this approachable now. Features fine length, too. Drink now through 2036.

chateau-cruzeau-saint-emilion-grand-cru.title: Chateau d'Arcie Saint-Emilion Grand Cru 2020
chateau-cruzeau-saint-emilion-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Aromas of ripe dark berries. A medium bodied approachable claret with juicy berry fruit backed up by savoury tobacco notes. This wine is classically proportioned and well balanced. Elegant tannic structure releasing a delicious range of fruity flavours with crisp acidity, lingering hints of spice. A fabulous dry red.

92 Points -James Suckling

Tasty and layered, with dark plums, ash, dried herbs and blackcurrants on the nose. Medium to full body with firm yet rounded tannins. Excellent balance and depth. Drink from 2024.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The wine was aged in wood for 12 months and is full of pepper and juicy black fruits. It is a powerful wine, dense with firm tannins and ready to age further. Drink from 2026.

chateau-daiguilhe-cotes-de-castillon.title: Chateau d'Aiguilhe 2020
chateau-daiguilhe-cotes-de-castillon.bodyHtml:
Château d'Aiguilhe 2020 is an expressive, fruit-forward, and mineral-driven red wine from the Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux appellation, owned and managed by Stephan von Neipperg. Sourced from clay-limestone soils on a high plateau on Bordeaux's Right Bank, this blend of 90% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Franc undergoes vinification in oak vats and concrete tanks. It displays an intense ruby-purple hue with inviting aromas of black raspberry, juicy plum, cassis, and violets, balanced by subtle notes of cocoa, tobacco leaf, and crushed limestone. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied and supple, offering a ripe berry core anchored by fine-grained tannins, fresh acidity, and a long, mineral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted rack of lamb, braised short ribs, duck breast, grilled pork chops, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté cheese.

92 Points - James Suckling

Black cherry, black berry and orange peel with some cedar aromas, follow through to a medium body with fine and chalky tannins. Dried herb and bark undertones. Some salt, too. Drink or hold. 

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Aromas of cassis, dark berries and cherries mingle with subtle hints of incense and spices in an inviting bouquet to introduce the 2020 d'Aiguilhe, a medium to full-bodied, fleshy and layered wine with powdery tannins and the lively acids that are typical of this later-ripening, limestone-rich sector. Always a notable value, this age-worthy cuvée has turned out very well this year.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Nicely rendered, with a very pure beam of cassis and cherry puree leading the way, infused gently with violet and savory accents. The fresh, focused finish is sneaky long. Merlot and Cabernet Franc. Drink now through 2034.

sebastien-riffault-les-quarterons.title: Sebastien Riffault Les Quarterons Sancerre Blanc 2019 750ml

champagne-barons-de-rothschild-2012.title: Champagne Barons de Rothschild Brut NV 750ml
champagne-barons-de-rothschild-2012.bodyHtml:
A carefully balanced blend, for a highly sophisticated champagne.

Each style of Barons de Rothschild champagne has the exceptional characteristics of a great champagne. Barons de Rothschild's Brut is a  rich and complex.
It is made by blending wines aged at least 3 years, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier from the Champagne region's best terroirs. 

This unique blend gives the wine its fine bubbles, its golden color, and its fine, subtle aromas of white fruit. It has a  low dosage  and is kept at least six months after disgorgement process, for a pleasant, balanced mouth fell that can be enjoyed as an aperitif or throughout the meal.

93 points Wine Spectator
A refined Champagne with elegant layers of pear, citrus, and white flowers. Subtle notes of brioche and almond emerge on the palate, supported by fine, persistent bubbles and vibrant acidity. The finish is long, clean, and beautifully balanced.

92 points Vinous
An expressive and well-crafted Champagne offering aromas of apple, lemon zest, and a touch of toasted bread. The palate is fresh and lively, with a creamy texture and harmonious structure, leading to a precise, mineral-driven finish.

94 points James Suckling
A sophisticated sparkling wine displaying remarkable finesse and complexity. Flavors of ripe orchard fruits, lemon curd, and toasted hazelnut unfold gracefully, supported by ultra-fine bubbles. The finish is elegant, vibrant, and endlessly persistent.

93 points Decanter
A classic Champagne showing a perfect balance of richness and freshness. Notes of baked apple, citrus peel, and delicate floral tones shine through, complemented by a creamy mousse and a seamless, lingering finish.

trinoro-campo-di-magnacosta.title: Tenuta Di Trinoro Toscana Campo Di Magnacosta Rosso 2023
trinoro-campo-di-magnacosta.bodyHtml:
In the glass, Campo di Magnacosta 2023 shows a lighter red color than the other parcels. The nose brings together red and black forest fruits with spice and gentle floral hints. On the palate, the warm and enveloping structure and the bright acidity make for a long and progressive taste, accompanied by tannins that are firm but never pushy.

93 Points - James Suckling

Supple and fragrant aromas of plums, blackberries and spices. Medium-bodied, it shows a powerful structure, grainy tannins and refreshing acidity. It deserves time to soften a bit. Try in 2026.

sancaba-pinot-nero.title: Vini Franchetti Sancaba Pinot Nero 2019 750ml
sancaba-pinot-nero.bodyHtml: Tenuta Di Trinoro Pinot Nero Toscana Vini Franchetti Sancaba Rosso 2019 750ml

passopisciaro-franchetti-igt.title: Passopisciaro Franchetti 2019 750ml
passopisciaro-franchetti-igt.bodyHtml: Franchetti is the top wine of Passopisciaro, the estate Andrea Franchetti founded on the north side of Mount Etna in Sicily. Instead of the local Nerello Mascalese, he planted the late-ripening Bordeaux grape Petit Verdot, from St. Julien cuttings, alongside Cesanese d'Affile in contrada Guardiola, at very high density on volcanic soils. The 2019 is 97% Petit Verdot and 3% Cesanese d'Affile. After a cold spring and a hot summer, the grapes were hand-picked from 23 to 31 October, fermented in steel for 15 days, then aged four months in new barriques and 14 months in large oak barrels and cement vats before bottling in May 2021. Vinous scored it 96+ points, Falstaff 96 and The Wine Advocate 95. Sold as Terre Siciliane IGT. 750ml, 14% ABV.

nutrl-juicd-blood-orange-slk.title: Nutrl Juic'D Blood Orange Slk 6 Cans

meursault.title: Justin Girardin Meursault
meursault.bodyHtml:
Produced from estate vineyards in Meursault, this Chardonnay offers aromas of peach, melon, apricot and exotic fruit with remarkable richness and mineral precision. Careful barrel fermentation and extended ageing on fine lees create a textured palate balanced by freshness and a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with grilled sea bass, scallops, lobster, veal in cream sauce and Beaufort cheese.

fontanafredda-barolo-la-rosa.title: Fontanafredda Barolo Vigna La Rosa 2013
fontanafredda-barolo-la-rosa.bodyHtml:
On the nose, clear-cut overtones of withered roses, violets, tobacco, underbrush, spices, and a slight touch of vanilla. Dense, closely-woven tannins start out smooth, almost velvety, and then explode in the palate with fruit. It is excellent served with flavorful meat dishes and mature cheeses.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Vigna la Rosa is located behind the gardens beyond the central cluster of buildings that make up the stunningly beautiful Fontanafredda estate. The 2013 Barolo Vigna la Rosa offers firm structure and elegance, that stylistically speaking pegs the wine closer to the more robust Serralunga d'Alba identity. This wine is aged in a combination of barrique and large oak casks. The bouquet is redolent of dark fruit and spice and there is a distant hint of roasted chestnut on the finish. It offers staying power and strength.
93 Points - James Suckling

Interesting aromas of dried strawberry, lemon grass and stone follow through to a full body, chewy tannins and a savory finish. This is really tannic and powerful. Needs four or five years to soften. Better in 2021.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Ripe cherry, leather, iron and tar flavors mark this dense, vibrant red. All the components are here, but this needs some time to come together. The fruit and tannins dovetail on the long finish. Best from 2022 through 2036.

domaine-de-la-baume-fitou-terroir-saint.title: Terroir La Baume Saint-Paul Fitou 2021
domaine-de-la-baume-fitou-terroir-saint.bodyHtml:
Terroir La Baume Saint-Paul Fitou 2021 is a rich, expressive, and full-bodied French red wine produced by Domaine de La Baume (La Baume Saint-Paul) in the Languedoc-Roussillon region. Crafted predominantly from Carignan and Grenache with Syrah, it displays a deep ruby color with violet reflections in the glass. The nose exhibits concentrated aromas of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, and plum, interwoven with distinct nuances of wild Mediterranean garrigue herbs, crushed black pepper, dark chocolate, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it is supple yet firmly structured, offering dense dark fruit flavors supported by solid, fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity that lead to a long, savory, and spicy finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs superbly with roasted leg of lamb, grilled ribeye steak, wild boar ragù, braised short ribs, and sharp aged cheeses.

waterbrook-malbec.title: Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023
waterbrook-malbec.bodyHtml:
Luca Old Vine Malbec 2023 is a powerful yet incredibly elegant Argentine red crafted by Dr. Laura Catena, highlighting the genetic diversity and depth of Mendoza's historic, low-yielding vines. Sourced from high-altitude, ungrafted vines (averaging over 50 years old) across premier subregions of the Uco Valley—including La Consulta, Gualtallary, and Paraje Altamira—it pours a deep, luminous purplish-red. The nose is inviting and complex, offering expressive aromas of dark plums, ripe black cherries, and wild berries, thoughtfully accented by notes of cocoa, bark, charcoal, and subtle dried herbs. On the palate, it is precise, linear, and gracefully structured, showcasing a juicy core of crunchy red and blue fruit balanced by velvety, approachable tannins and a vibrant vein of natural acidity. Matured for 12 months in a combination of new and second-use French oak barrels, it delivers a deeply refined and stylish finish laced with savory hints of espresso and bright mineral tension.

Food Pairing: Pairs magnificently with grilled venison, traditional Argentine ribeye steak with chimichurri, roasted lamb shanks, hearty pork roast, or medium-strong cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

This shows plums, bark and charcoal on the nose. The palate is precise, sharp, linear and super elegant, with velvety tannins and crunchy fruit. It’s long, refined and very stylish. Drink now.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Old Vine Malbec combines ungrafted vines from six Uco Valley growers who previously sold grapes for use in bulk wines. It was destemmed and fermented in stainless tank before maturing for 12 months in 35% new barrique. Opening with a pleasant nose of red and blue fruits, anise and dried spices, the palate is plush and straightforward, concluding with a lifted, fragrant finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose reveals enticing aromas of crushed berries leading the way to a juicy palate filled with rich dark fruit flavors and a hint of rosemary. Framed by gripping tannins and vibrant acidity, this full-bodied Malbec features a distinctive chalky texture and a long lasting finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Hints of roasted herbs and loam lead but quickly give way to the core flavors of Santa Rosa plum and cherry, culminating with crunchy acidity, mineral and cocoa powder notes that fill out the structured finish.

yeyo-silver-tequila.title: Yeyo Joven Sol Volume II A Toast to the Sun Tequila
yeyo-silver-tequila.bodyHtml:
Sol Joven Vol. II is a celebration of the sun—radiant, energizing, and full of life. This limited release blends75% Reposado and 25% Blanco,aged for 11 months inex–spiced apple cider casks.

The result is a tequila that shines withwarm notes of spiced apple, sweet agave, and citrus, balanced by a crisp, clean finish. Bright yet layered, it’s crafted for those who appreciate bothsweetness and spicein their tequila.

Let’s toast to the sun—where souls shine eternal.

  • Made withSingle Estate Blue Weber Agave
  • Made in theHighlands of Jalisco, Mexico
  • Fermented withChampagne Yeast
  • All Natural

zuccardi-q-malbec.title: Zuccardi Q Malbec 2023
zuccardi-q-malbec.bodyHtml:
Deep purple color, with bluish hues. Intense red fruits and flowers aromas, such as roses and violets. Herbal notes. Soft and silky entry, great structure, acidity that provides freshness and mineral texture. Long finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

Brooding and inky. Lots of warm stone, mussel shells and iodine to the deep, fresh purple fruit and violets. Broad and nicely chewy and fresh on the palate with a full body and a long, pristine and tightly wound finish. Grapes from Paraje Altamira and Los Chacayes. Better in two more years.


92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Q Malbec aptly summarizes the profile readers can expect throughout the Zuccardi portfolio: poise, balance and precision, regardless of price point. It leads with a vibrant, dark-fruited nose showcasing remarkable purity, followed by a sumptuous, enveloping palate. It concludes with a saturated, concentrated finish that remains lifted and focused.

arran-calvados-17-year-old.title: Arran 17 Year Old Rare Batch Calvados Cask
arran-calvados-17-year-old.bodyHtml: Arran was an early adopter of cask finishes. Just 8 years after starting production, the distillery released its first limited-edition Calvados Cask Finish expression. The Arran 17 Years Old Rare Batch Calvados Cask Edition takes it a step further: this rare single malt was fully aged in casks previously used to mature Calvados. These casks were sourced from a producer whose family has been making Calvados in the region of Pont-l’Eveque in Normandy for generations. The result is a full-bodied and complex whisky enriched with notes of orchard fruits, heather honey, dried apple, nutmeg and cocoa. Just 4200 bottles were released in late 2022.

the-kraken-gold-spiced-rum.title: The Kraken Gold Spiced Rum
the-kraken-gold-spiced-rum.bodyHtml: The Kraken's deep and watery keep is said to be filled with the only thing it loves more than darkness - gold. Oh, and rum. Obviously. Kraken Gold Spiced Rum, a Caribbean spiced rum from the Dominican Republic, aged for two years with hints of vanilla and cinnamon, rich beyond words and perhaps the only bit of lightness the beast loves with as much passion as its storied black ink.

eagle-rare-17-year-old.title: Eagle Rare 17 Year Old Bourbon
eagle-rare-17-year-old.bodyHtml:
Eagle Rare 17 Year Old Bourbon is a Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey from Buffalo Trace Distillery and part of the Buffalo Trace Antique Collection. Aged for 17 years in oak barrels, it is released in very limited quantities each fall and bottled at 101 proof (50.5% ABV) from Buffalo Trace's Mash Bill #1. The long maturation brings an almost wine-like aroma of almond, cigar box and cinnamon, followed by a dry palate of leather, vanilla and tobacco. A collector's bourbon that rewards slow sipping.

Tasting Notes: Almond, cigar box, cinnamon, leather, vanilla, tobacco, toffee.

Nose: Almost wine-like, with almond, cigar box and cinnamon.

Palate: Delicate and dry, with leather, vanilla and tobacco.

Finish: Lingering, with leather and toffee.

Serve: Neat or with a single drop of water.

james-eadie-caol-ila-11-yaer-old.title: James Eadie Caol Ila 11 Year Old 2009 Palo Cortado Sherry Cask Finish 56.5% ABV
james-eadie-caol-ila-11-yaer-old.bodyHtml:
Caol Ila 11 Year Old 2009 Palo Cortado Sherry Cask Finish is an independent bottling of Islay single malt Scotch whisky from James Eadie, released in the bottler's Autumn 2021 Cask Finish series. The whisky was distilled at Caol Ila on 28 October 2009 and, before bottling in 2021, spent a further 13 months finishing in a refill European oak hogshead that had held Palo Cortado sherry. It comes from a single cask, #358024, which gave just 316 bottles, and is bottled at cask strength of 56.5% in a 70 cl bottle. The Cask Finish series revives James Eadie's own Victorian practice of maturing whisky in ex-fortified wine casks, and like all of the bottler's limited releases it is presented at natural colour and without chill filtration.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

james-eadie-linkwood-10-year-re-chared.title: James Eadie Linkwood 10 Year Old Re-Chared 54% ABV
james-eadie-linkwood-10-year-re-chared.bodyHtml:
James Eadie Linkwood 10 Year Old is another splendid selection from James Eadie, an independent Scottish bottler based in London but with a history that goes back over 150 years. Years of experience: after managing a brewery, the company began selecting and distributing whiskey casks, always trying to maintain an excellent level of quality so as not to disappoint its customers, usually pubs and clubs from all over Scotland. In this case, James Eadie has selected three single barrels of whiskey distilled at Linkwood, a distillery that is not well known in Italy because it is completely absent from the shelves, being a malt whiskey mainly used to give structure to various blends of the Diageo group.

Linkwood, on the other hand, has an important dignity due to the high level with which various bottles appear – more often than not thanks to the work of independent bottlers as in the case of ours, James Eadie. A small lot of just over a thousand bottles.

novas-carmonere-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Novas Carmonere Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
novas-carmonere-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Emiliana Novas Gran Reserva Carmenère Cabernet Sauvignon is an organic red blend from the D.O. Valle de Colchagua in Chile, bottled at 14.5% ABV. Emiliana farms its vineyards organically and biodynamically, and Novas is its Gran Reserva range of organic wines. This blend pairs Carmenère with Cabernet Sauvignon. The producer describes an intense black-cherry colour, a nose of ripe fruit balanced by the herbaceous notes typical of Carmenère, and a palate with soft tannins, pleasant acidity and a harmonious finish. Enjoy it with grilled red meats, roasted vegetables or hard cheeses. A 750ml bottle.

yukon-gold-english-style-pale-ale.title: Yukon Gold English Style Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans
yukon-gold-english-style-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Yukon Gold English Style Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans

apothic-red.title: Apothic Red 3L Bag in Box
apothic-red.bodyHtml:
Apothic Red is a remarkably bold, innovative, and luxuriously smooth California red blend crafted to challenge traditional winemaking rules. Inspired by the "Apotheca," a mysterious 13th-century European cellar where early vintners blended and stored their most coveted creations, this off-dry red opens with an effusive, jammy bouquet of ripe black cherries, blueberries, and grape jam, beautifully layered with indulgent suggestions of rich mocha, sweet licorice, and warm vanilla bean. On the palate, it delivers a medium- to full-bodied experience defined by a lush, velvety mouthfeel and remarkably soft, unassertive tannins. A concentrated core of dark forest fruits, boysenberry, and subtle baking spice is guided by a gentle hint of residual sweetness, concluding with a long, rounded, and decadent finish rich with toasted oak and dark chocolate undertones.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with slow-cooked barbecue pork ribs, pepperoni pizza, sharp aged cheddar, and rich dark chocolate desserts.

village-chatter-box-variety-pack.title: Village Chatter Box Variety Pack 8 Tall Cans

high-noon-passion-fruit.title: Pinaq Original Passion Fruit Liqueur
high-noon-passion-fruit.bodyHtml:
Piñaq Original Passion Fruit Liqueur is an ultra-premium, exotic tropical spirit famed as much for its striking, metallic-gold pineapple-shaped decanter as it is for the liquid inside. Produced in the Netherlands, this vibrant liqueur features an upscale, multi-spirit architecture: it expertly blends high-quality Dutch vodka with rich, aged French VSOP Cognac and infuses it with real, natural passion fruit juices. This creates a beautifully complex liqueur that avoids the cloying, syrup-heavy nature of cheap tropical modifiers, balancing bright citrus acidity with a smooth, warming brandy backbone.

Food Pairing: Coconut shrimp with a sweet-chili drizzle, tangy key lime pie, fresh mango and pineapple skewers, or sharp, salty goat cheese.

TASTING NOTES Luminous, vibrant golden hue with a smooth, silky, and beautifully refreshing light-to-medium body.

NOSE Powerfully aromatic and highly tropical, bursting with upfront notes of fresh tart passion fruit, ripe pineapple, and sweet honey, balanced by a subtle trace of warm caramel and vanilla oak from the Cognac base.

PALATE A masterfully balanced entry; a vibrant, juicy wave of sweet passion fruit and tropical citrus citrus oils is met by a crisp, pleasant tang of natural acidity. The mid-palate reveals the smooth, velvety, and sophisticated warming presence of the French VSOP Cognac.

FINISH Clean, refreshing, and short-to-medium in length, leaving a lingering, mouthwatering tartness of passion fruit alongside a soft, clean spirit warmth.

SERVE Highly versatile; fantastic when served well-chilled on its own, over crushed ice, topped with tonic water or club soda for a quick spritz, or used to elevate a tropical Margarita or White Rum punch.

nutrl-juicd-tropical-punch-sleek-cans.title: Nutrl Juic'D Tropical Punch Sleek Cans 6 Cans

moet-chandon-grand-vintage-1.title: Moet & Chandon Grand Vintage Extra Brut 2016
moet-chandon-grand-vintage-1.bodyHtml:
Slightly golden yellow with vibrant green reflections. Initial fleeting aromas are brown and dry: toasted bread, grains and hazelnut. The secondary aromas are softer: gingerbread, marzipan, barley sugar. Finally, the most persistent background notes are fruity and floral: plum, mirabelle, quince, orange blossom and aniseed. A serene, round palate. Sensations enfold effortlessly, akin to a fading scene in a movie or a gentle wave rolling over smooth sand before softly retreating. The initial round, supple attack effortlessly transitions into a structured core-like sensation, culminating in a finish reminiscent of the sweet, tangy freshness of a clementine or pomelo.

93 Points - James Suckling

Lovely salinity to this Champagne, which has notes of Asian pears, aniseed, preserved lemons, chalk and biscuits. It’s mineral and seamless, with transparency and brightness. Fine bubbles. 48% chardonnay, 34% pinot noir and 18% meunier. 5g/L dosage. Disgorged March 2023. Drink now or hold.

dalmore-21-year-old.title: The Dalmore 21 Year Old
dalmore-21-year-old.bodyHtml:
It takes time to attain our full potential. But at 21 years old, we come of age and The Dalmore 21 is a true coming-of-age single malt.

We call it the pinnacle of our Principal Collection because it is the very epitome of whisky-making artistry, and the perfect prelude to our range of rare and aged single malts.

Making it takes meticulous care and craft but it is a labour of love.

clos-de-loratoire-st-emilion-gcc.title: Clos De L'Oratoire St Emilion Gcc 750ml
clos-de-loratoire-st-emilion-gcc.bodyHtml: Clos de l'Oratoire Saint-Emilion Grand Cru is a red wine from the Bordeaux region of France, known for its deep crimson color and powerful fruity aromas. The wine is typically made from a blend of Merlot and Cabernet Franc, with Merlot contributing roundness and opulence, and Cabernet Franc adding power, complexity, and a long aftertaste.

moet-chandon-brut-at-home-gift-pack.title: Moet & Chandon Brut with Red Gift Box
moet-chandon-brut-at-home-gift-pack.bodyHtml:
An elegant golden straw yellow with amber highlights. Its aromas are radiant, revealing bright yellow-fleshed fruits (apple, pear, yellow peach), honey, floral nuances (lime blossom) and elegant blond notes (brioche and fresh nuts). The palate is seductive, richly flavorful and smooth combining generosity and subtlety, fullness and vigor, followed by a delicately fresh crispiness (fruit with seeds), to reveal the magical balance of Champagne.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An elegant version, fine and creamy in texture and backed by lively, orange peel acidity. A streak of smoke-tinged minerality underscores flavors of almond madeleine, poached pear, anise and preserved lemon. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Champagne gets better and better. It has a fine dryness with a crisp apple and citrus character. That goes with the touches of maturity that give the wine fine balance.

90 Points - James Suckling

Nicely complex aromas here, from dried apples, peaches and pears to candied citrus and brioche. It’s fruity, soft and rounded on the palate. Medium-bodied, lightly honeyed and balanced. Blend of pinot noir, pinot meunier and chardonnay.

krug-col-95.title: Krug Brut Collection 1995
krug-col-95.bodyHtml: To the delight of Krug Lovers around the world, a very limited number of Krug Vintage bottles are kept in ideal conditions in the House’s cellars. They are tasted and appraised as they wait to blossom into a second life. The Cellar Master might then decide that some Krug Vintages reveal a new personality and become Krug Collection. Krug Collection is a tribute to time sublimation: maturity exposes hidden facets, depth and new flavours, while gaining structure and complexity. Krug Collection is always a wonderful discovery, a deeper story of the Krug Vintage. Krug Collection 1995 is time’s second revelation of Krug 1995.

gran-faustino-i-gran-reserva-2004.title: Gran Faustino I Gran Reserva Limited Edition 2004
gran-faustino-i-gran-reserva-2004.bodyHtml:
Gran Faustino I Gran Reserva Limited Edition 2004 pours an exceptional, bright garnet color with a luminous rim in the glass. The complex nose captures the finest traits of traditional aging, opening with prominent tertiary aromas of prunes, dried dark berries, tobacco leaf, and leather, beautifully interwoven with subtle hints of cocoa and warm baking spices. On the palate, this medium-bodied Rioja blend delivers magnificent elegance and harmony. Taut, velvety tannins and a vibrant core of zesty acidity seamlessly carry layers of black plum, orange zest, licorice, and savory undergrowth toward an incredibly long, silky, and ethereal finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs elegantly with slow-roasted lamb shanks, roasted duck breast, savory rabbit with truffle sauce, or deeply aged Manchego cheese.

97 Points - Decanter

Classy wine with engaging tobacco, smoke and earthy aromatics. Complex and energetic with spice and red fruit flavours whooshing through the palate in a seductive style. A satisfying aged wine with thrillingly well-integrated new oak and a long, savoury finish.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This deep-garnet-colored wine has aromas of blackberry, black currant and olive tapenade. It is soft at first sip, and then rugged tannins build on the palate, ferrying flavors of dark plum, pomegranate, cocoa powder, thyme and orange zest that wend their way to a surprisingly bright finish. Drink through 2035.

95 Points - James Suckling
An extremely well-aged and understated Rioja, showing discreet complexity with plums, oranges, leather, dusty red berries and minerals. Juicy and bright on the palate with a zesty nature to the berry and orange citrus. Silky, taut tannins and a long yet elegant finish. Lots of finesse here, with almost pinot etherealness. Tempranillo, graciano and mazuelo from selected plots. 36 months aging, with American oak in use, too. Drinkable now, but can hold for another 10 years.

tomatin-1976.title: Tomatin 12 Year Old
tomatin-1976.bodyHtml:
The Tomatin 12 Year Old is classically smooth, having been matured in traditional Scotch Whisky, ex-Bourbon and ex-Spanish Sherry casks. Aromas of wild heather, pine and cedar soon sweeten to reveal notes of crème caramel with apples, pears and mango before a full bodied and buttery finish.

Cask Type: Matured in a combination of Bourbon barrels and Sherry casks
Strength: 43% alc./vol.

AWARD MEDALS

DOUBLE GOLD 2019 San Francisco WSC
GOLD 2018 San Francisco WSC
GOLD 2017 San Francisco WSC
DOUBLE GOLD 2016 San Francisco WSC
GOLD 2015 San Francisco WSC
SILVER 2015 IWSC
GOLD 2014 San Francisco WSC
SILVER 2014 IWSC
BEST HIGHLAND MALT 2013 WWA

benriach-30-year-old.title: Benriach The Twelve 12 Year Old
benriach-30-year-old.bodyHtml: To make Benriach Twelve, Benriach spirit is three cask matured for at least twelve years in sherry casks, bourbon barrels and port casks. The whisky from each cask is then expertly married together to create a smooth, sherry-rich single malt, layered with baked fruit, maple honey and cocoa, perfectly balanced with a lingering sultana and spiced mocha finish.

krug-clos-du-mesnil-2004.title: Krug Clos du Mesnil 2004
krug-clos-du-mesnil-2004.bodyHtml:
Maison Krug’s unique craftsmanship has revealed a rare champagne from a remarkable terroir, the Clos du Mesnil.
Born at a time when the conventions in Champagne concentrated on blending multiple wines from varied plots, Krug Clos du Mesnil offers a Champagne of exceptional beauty and poise, telling a story of this plot’s grapes, only on very special years.

krug-clos-du-mesnil-2008.title: Krug Clos Du Mesnil 2008
krug-clos-du-mesnil-2008.bodyHtml:
Maison Krug’s unique craftsmanship has revealed a rare champagne from a remarkable terroir, the Clos du Mesnil.

Born at a time when the conventions in Champagne concentrated on blending multiple wines from varied plots, Krug Clos du Mesnil offers a Champagne of exceptional beauty and poise, telling a story of this plot’s grapes, only on very special years.
99 Points - James Suckling
This is a powerful, sensual and intense Blanc de Blancs with lots of chalk, lemon, apricot stone, walnut, flint, biscuit, toast, white grapefruit and quince. Vibrant, tight and structured. Tight bubbles and a sharp backbone of acidity. Very long and persistent.

arca-pinot-noir.title: Argot Sonoma Mountain Pinot Noir 2024
arca-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Argot Sonoma Mountain Pinot Noir 2024 is a rich, beautifully structured California Pinot Noir that displays expressive aromas of dark bing cherry, wild blackberry, forest floor, and warm baking spices. The palate offers a velvety texture, refined tannins, and vibrant acidity, culminating in a long, complex finish highlighted by subtle notes of crushed rocks and French oak.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast, pan-seared pork chops, grilled salmon, mushroom risotto, or mild cured meats and artisanal aged cheeses.
