millstone-sm-peated-rivesaltes-3yo.title: Millstone Peated Rivesaltes 3 Year Old Special #26 Dutch Whisky
millstone-sm-peated-rivesaltes-3yo.bodyHtml: This peated malt whisky has the beautiful color of old gold, and a rich and luscious flavour profile that far exceeds its relative youthfulness. The whisky expresses those typical notes that you would expect from a relatively youthful peated whisky with a full maturation in Rivesaltes casks. Despite the full maturation in Rivesaltes casks the first impression is fresh more than sweet. When you give the whisky a little time in your glass and the whisky shines with its warm and complex character. The unique qualities of this whisky come from the use of a crystal-clear wort that is slowly fermented for 7 days and the slow distillation method with the relatively early cut point. After distillation the whisky had a full maturation in Rivesaltes casks that give the whisky its beautiful color and adds to the elegant sweetness and rich complex flavour.

old-oude-genever-3yo-peated-px.title: Zuidam Distillers Genever 3 Year Old Peated PX
old-oude-genever-3yo-peated-px.bodyHtml:
Zuidam Distillers Oude Genever Peated Pedro Ximénez 3 Year Old is Special No. 30 from the Zuidam family distillery in Baarle-Nassau, the Netherlands. It is distilled from equal parts corn, rye and heavily peated malted barley, which gives the genever its structure and a delicate smoky quality. The spirit is triple distilled in pot stills, then part of it is distilled a fourth time with juniper, licorice and aniseed before the two are blended and aged in Pedro Ximénez sherry casks. Distilled on 2 September 2019 and bottled on 6 September 2022, it is limited to 2,719 numbered bottles at 38% ABV, with natural colour and no chill filtration. 1 litre bottle.

Nose: Rich vanilla, honey and gentle smoke, opening to apricot, orange and lime, with subtle chocolate and liquorice from the PX casks.

Palate: Warm and rich, with soft peat smoke, stewed apricots and peaches, like a chocolate-covered apricot pie.

Finish: Medium-long, with subtle peat smoke and stewed fruit.

Serve: Neat at room temperature in a tulip glass.

millstone-single-grain-9yo.title: Millstone 9 Year Old Single Grain Dutch Whisky
millstone-single-grain-9yo.bodyHtml:
Millstone 9 Year Old Single Grain is a Dutch grain whisky from the Zuidam family distillery in Baarle-Nassau, in the south of the Netherlands, selected for Canada from several casks. It is made from a mash of rye, malted barley, corn, spelt and wheat, and all of the whisky in the bottle was aged in virgin oak casks. The batch came in at around 47% and was bottled at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle. The Millstone name refers to the Dutch windmills that grind the grain, and the distillery's range now spans single malts, ryes and multi-grain whiskies. The virgin oak gives this one a profile that sits between a well-aged bourbon and an older grain whisky.

Tasting Notes: Oak-led, with toffee, cherry, green apple, citrus and herbs.

Nose: Virgin oak up front with iced tea and lemonade, grape candy, rye spice, dill, cedar, fresh apple juice and sponge toffee.

Palate: Cherry pie, green apple, sponge toffee, fresh dill, mint, rooibos, orange and lime peel, oatmeal cookie and a touch of ginger.

Finish: Slightly dry, with oak and fruit lingering.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

millstone-peated-px-single-cask-cdn-sp.title: Millstone Peated PX Single Cask Canadian Release 4
millstone-peated-px-single-cask-cdn-sp.bodyHtml:
Millstone Peated PX Single Cask Canadian Release 4 is a Dutch peated single malt whisky from Zuidam Distillers, bottled as an individual single-cask release at 53.93% ABV. Matured in a Pedro Ximénez sherry cask, it combines robust peat smoke with the intensely rich dried-fruit sweetness associated with PX maturation, creating a powerful interplay of smoke, dark fruit, chocolate, spice and oak. 

Food Pairing: Pair with smoked brisket, barbecued beef, blue cheese, roasted nuts, dark chocolate or rich dried-fruit desserts.

Tasting Notes: Rich and full-bodied, with smoky peat layered over dried figs, raisins, dark chocolate, caramel, warming spice and sweet sherry character.

Nose: Peat smoke leads into dried figs, raisins, dark caramel and cocoa, supported by toasted oak and warming spice.

Palate: Full-bodied and richly textured, showing smoked malt, dark chocolate, dried fruit, molasses and clove alongside earthy peat and sweet PX richness.

Finish: Long and warming, with lingering smoke, dark-fruit sweetness, oak and spice.

millstone-25yo-oloroso-single-cask-cdn.title: Millstone 25 Year Old Oloroso Single Cask Canada Exclusive
millstone-25yo-oloroso-single-cask-cdn.bodyHtml: 25 Year Oloroso – This Canada Exclusive is the oldest single malt whisky that Millstone has ever bottled. Matured for 25 years in an Oloroso Sherry hogshead, this was one of the first batched of single malts that master distiller Patrick van Zuidam ever produced. Single cask, bottled at cask strength 44.92%.

ledaig-red-wine-whisky-2012.title: Ledaig 9 Year Old 2012 Bordeaux Red Wine Cask Matured
ledaig-red-wine-whisky-2012.bodyHtml:
The latest Limited Edition release from Ledaig has been fully matured in red wine casks and bottled at cask strength. The resulting dram is bursting with flavor - heather and pine cones with woody sea salt and floral notes on the finish.

A small batch limited edition release, the peated Ledaig has spent 9 years maturing in the finest Bordeaux red wine casks. Bottled at cask strength at 56.8% ABV allows the character of the whisky to shine through, creating intense and rich flavours. Like all our whiskies, this release is non-chill filtered and natural color.

Color:
Bronze.

Nose:
Smoked fudge, eucalyptus oil and carbolic soap.

Palate:
Burning heather and pine cones. Grape skins and melons, wood smoked meats.

Finish:
As the smoke drifts, some floral notes develop and finally lime pastilles.

smirnoff-creamsicle-blast.title: Smirnoff Creamsicle Blast Vodka
smirnoff-creamsicle-blast.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Creamsicle Blast is a flavoured vodka beverage that blends orange and cream flavours, inspired by the classic orange creamsicle ice pop. It combines vodka with an orange-soda flavour and a touch of vanilla, and comes in a retro-styled bottle. Bottled at 30% ABV in a 750 ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Orange soda and a hint of vanilla cream.

Serve: Over ice with lemon-lime soda or cream soda, or in a creamy orange cocktail.

invergordon-single-malt.title: Master Of Malt Invergordon 16 Year Old
invergordon-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Master of Malt Invergordon 16 Year Old is a limited-edition Highland single grain Scotch whisky distilled in 2009 and independently bottled in 2026. Matured for 16 years in a single Oloroso Sherry puncheon, this expression showcases the rich sweetness and velvety character of mature grain whisky. Aromas of candied almonds, vanilla sponge cake and tropical fruit lead into an indulgent palate of toasted brown sugar, sweet coffee, hazelnut chocolate and caramelized stone fruit. Bottled at 52.2% ABV, with 828 bottles produced, it offers a beautifully layered combination of dessert-like sweetness, roasted nuts and lingering Sherry richness.

Food Pairing: Pecan pie, vanilla cheesecake, roasted hazelnuts, crème brûlée, dark chocolate truffles, coffee desserts or aged Gouda.

Tasting Notes: Candied almonds, vanilla custard, tropical fruit, toasted brown sugar, sweet coffee, hazelnut chocolate, golden syrup and warming oak.

Nose: Sugar-coated almonds, candied pecans, vanilla sponge cake, dried apple, tropical fruit and buttery pastry.

Palate: Sweet coffee, toasted brown sugar, vanilla cream, grilled nectarine, hazelnut chocolate and caramelized waffle.

Finish: Lingering golden syrup sweetness, coffee candy, roasted nuts and gentle oak spice.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn glass to appreciate its rich dessert-like aromas. Add a few drops of water to soften the intensity and reveal additional vanilla and nutty sweetness.

goose-island-bourbon-county-stout-isaacs.title: Goose Island Bourbon County Stout Isaacs 500ml

glen-scotia-victoriana-single-malt.title: Glen Scotia Victoriana
glen-scotia-victoriana-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Each cask is chosen for its rare character and exceptional maturity. Finished in deep charred oak, the result is an exceptionally smooth single malt whisky whose aroma and flavour work in harmony. Bottled in the traditional way straight from the cask and without filtration, its subtle wood and vanilla flavour is enhanced by a full bodied spicy fruit aroma and mildly smokey aftertaste.

NOSE

Dark again. An elegant nose with hints of oak driving the bouquet. Interesting creme brulee notes leading to generous caramelised fruits and finally polished oak.

PALATE

Sweet and concentrated start with some jammy blackcurrant fruitiness. A big mid palate. Typical tightening towards the back palate. Becomes more austere with water.

FINISH

Clean and initially sweet.The green bean, with cocoa characteristic.

arak-brun-special-reserve.title: Domaine des Tourelles Arak Brun Special Reserve 5 Year Old
arak-brun-special-reserve.bodyHtml:
Domaine des Tourelles Arak Brun Special Reserve is a limited aged version of the Bekaa Valley house's well-known Lebanese arak. Domaine des Tourelles, producing since 1868, starts with grape spirit distilled with aniseed. This Special Reserve then rests for five years in old clay jars in the estate's cellars, a process the producer says turns it into a distinctive spirit apart from the standard Arak Brun. The label carries the Latin motto "Quinquennis Regalis", a nod to the five years of ageing. It is bottled at 53% ABV in a 750ml bottle and presented in a gift box.

Food Pairing: Mezze and other Mediterranean dishes.

Tasting Notes: Grape spirit and aniseed, softened by five years in clay.

Serve: Diluted with water over ice, as an aperitif or with mezze.

simply-spiked-lemonade.title: Simply Spiked Lemonade Variety Pack
simply-spiked-lemonade.bodyHtml: These sparkling spiked lemonades are juicy and refreshing. The variety pack includes the Signature Lemonade with sweet and tart lemon flavour, the Strawberry Lemonade with fresh berry fruit and the Blueberry Lemonade with subtle fruit. Great for get-togethers or sipping on a hot afternoon. Pair with savoury snacks.

topo-chico-margarita-variety-pack.title: Topo Chico Margarita Variety Pack 12 Cans

coors-seltzer-slushie-variety-pack.title: Coors Seltzer Slushie Flavours Pack 12 Cans

motts-clamato-caesar-variety-pack.title: Mott's Clamato Caesar Variety Pack 12 Cans
motts-clamato-caesar-variety-pack.bodyHtml: The Mott's Clamato Variety Pack includes the 3 top-selling customer favourites: Original, Extra Spicy and Pickled Bean. There's something in this pack for every Caesar lover. Serve chilled or over ice with your favourite Caesar garnish.

ole-tequila-mule.title: Clase Azul Gold Tequila
ole-tequila-mule.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Gold Tequila is an ultra-premium Joven tequila that harmoniously blends Clase Azul Plata with a special Reposado tequila aged in French oak casks and an extra añejo aged in American whiskey casks and finished in sherry casks. Encased in a handcrafted ceramic decanter featuring a night-sky black body and 24-karat gold inlay, this expression captures the rich complexity, smooth character, and artistic elegance of traditional Mexican craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with pan-seared duck breast with cherry reduction, mole negro, dark chocolate tarts, rich aged cheeses like Manchego, or seared ahi tuna.

Tasting Notes : Rich amber with copper highlights. It has a silky, full-bodied mouthfeel with refined elegance and smooth viscosity.

Nose : Agave nectar, dried figs, toasted oak, hazelnut, candied orange peel, and subtle hints of vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and complex with flavors of toasted oak, rich caramel, ginger, dark chocolate, toasted almonds, and sweet agave.

Finish : Long and warming finish featuring lingering notes of sweet oak, dried fruit, subtle spice, and cacao.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip-shaped glass or Tequila Riedel glass to fully appreciate its aromas and complexity.

seguin-manuel-clos-vougeot-gc.title: Seguin-Manuel Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru 2020
seguin-manuel-clos-vougeot-gc.bodyHtml: Seguin-Manuel Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru 2020 is a monumental and deeply concentrated expression from a solar, high-intensity vintage. Sourced from the lower portion of the historic walled vineyard, the wine benefits from the 2020 season’s exceptional fruit ripeness and structural power. It offers a brooding bouquet of black cherries, wild blackberries, and violets, seamlessly layered with notes of dark chocolate, toasted spices, and a hallmark flinty earthiness. On the palate, it is full-bodied and impeccably structured, showcasing a dense core of black fruit supported by firm, noble tannins and a surprising core of freshness that ensures remarkable longevity.

clase-azul-dia-de-muertos-1.title: Clase Azul Dia de Muertos Edicion Limitada 2022 'Colores' Tequila
clase-azul-dia-de-muertos-1.bodyHtml:
Born from the encounter between cultures and worldviews, the celebration of Día de Muertos is one of Mexico’s most beloved and emblematic traditions.

During this time, we celebrate the memory of our loved ones who are no longer with us. As promoters of our culture, we’d like the whole world to be able to discover the magic and beauty of this colorful celebration.

We’re proud to present the new Clase Azul Tequila Día de Muertos Limited Edition Colores, a creation that pays homage to the colors that illuminate this iconic Mexican celebration.

The añejo tequila of this limited edition is inspired by Calaveritas de Azucar, a colorful sweet traditionally made during Día de Muertos.

In honor of this tradition, our Master Distiller chose to finish this tequila in casks of rhum agricole, an artisanal rum from the island of Martinique. The essence of this rum distilled from fresh sugarcane juice remains in the wooden casks and helps give the tequila its unique profile.

Depictions of skulls are one of the key features of Día de Muertos and are commonplace in wider Mexican culture. These skulls often spark the curiosity of first-time travelers to Mexico; however, they are more a symbolic celebration of life than a traditional representation of death. 

An important part of Día de Muertos is the creation of traditional sweets called calaveritas de azúcar. These iconic skulls are fashioned from sugar and decorated with colorful icing and metallic foil.

clase-azul-25th-anniversary-1.title: Clase Azul Reposado Tequila
clase-azul-25th-anniversary-1.bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium tequila made from 100% Blue Weber Agave, harvested in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Cooked slowly in traditional brick ovens and distilled twice in copper pot stills, it is aged for eight months in American whiskey casks. This aging process imparts a silky texture, rich hazelnut and vanilla flavors, and a smooth profile. Encased in Clase Azul's iconic, hand-painted ceramic decanter featuring cobalt blue feather designs, it stands as an international symbol of luxury and Mexican craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with slow-cooked pork carnitas, grilled ribeye steak, aged cheeses such as Manchego, mole poblano, dark chocolate desserts, or vanilla bean ice cream.

Tasting Notes : Intense amber color with copper highlights and a smooth, rich, medium-to-full body with a silky mouthfeel.

Nose : Agave nectar, vanilla, candied orange peel, toasted oak, hazelnut, and subtle hints of cinnamon.

Palate : Smooth and complex with rich flavors of cooked agave, toasted oak, vanilla, clove, hazelnut, and soft caramel.

Finish : Long, warm, and elegant finish with lingering notes of sweet agave, vanilla, toasted wood, and gentle baking spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip-shaped glass or Tequila Riedel glass to fully appreciate its aromas and flavor profile.

white-claw-mango-vodka.title: White Claw Mango Vodka
white-claw-mango-vodka.bodyHtml:
White Claw Mango Vodka is a mango-flavoured vodka from White Claw Spirits, the spirits line from the brand behind White Claw hard seltzer. Produced in Kentucky, United States, it is bottled at 30% alc./vol. in a 750ml bottle, a lighter strength than a standard 40% vodka, which makes it an easy base for long drinks and simple highballs.

Serve: Over ice with soda water and a squeeze of lime, or in a mule with ginger beer.

white-claw-pineapple-vodka.title: White Claw Mango Vodka
white-claw-pineapple-vodka.bodyHtml:
White Claw Mango Vodka is a mango-flavoured vodka from White Claw Spirits, the spirits line from the brand behind White Claw hard seltzer. Produced in Kentucky, United States, it is bottled at 30% alc./vol. in a 750ml bottle, a lighter strength than a standard 40% vodka, which makes it an easy base for long drinks and simple highballs.

Serve: Over ice with soda water and a squeeze of lime, or in a mule with ginger beer.

white-claw-premium-vodka.title: White Claw Vodka
white-claw-premium-vodka.bodyHtml:
White Claw Premium Vodka is the unflavoured vodka from White Claw Spirits, produced in Kentucky, United States. It is made from 100% American grain that is distilled five times and then filtered three times under pressure equal to a thirty-foot wave, a process the brand calls Triple Wave Filtered and describes as the first of its kind for vodka. The aim is a clean, smooth spirit. It is bottled at 40% alc./vol. (80 proof) in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Chilled and neat, over ice with soda and citrus, or as the base for a martini or mule.

empress-elderflower-rose-gin.title: Empress 1908 Elderflower Rose Gin
empress-elderflower-rose-gin.bodyHtml:
Inspired by our beautiful location in Victoria, British Columbia, Empress Elderflower Rose Gin pays homage to ‘The City of Gardens,’ where flowers blossom nearly year-round. The fresh, floral botanicals create a delicate spirit with a distinctive all-natural rose hue, adding a touch of our home to your next cocktail creation.

Nine beautifully blended botanicals create a delicate spirit with a stunning all-natural rose hue. Empress Elderflower Rose has a rich aroma and a surprisingly understated floral palate. With exquisite citrus and spice notes and a hint of sweetness, Elderflower Rose Gin allows each botanical to shine.

deanston-12-year-old.title: Deanston 12 Year Old
deanston-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Deanston 12 Year Old is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky from Deanston Distillery near Doune in Perthshire. The distillery was established in 1966 inside a former cotton mill that had stood on the River Teith for almost two centuries, and it still draws its water from the Teith; it is also noted for generating its own electricity from the river. The 12 Year Old is aged in ex-bourbon casks and bottled un-chillfiltered with natural colour at 46.3% ABV, giving a fuller texture than most entry-level malts. Expect a creamy, honeyed and malty style with soft fruit, vanilla and a closing tingle of clove. Presented in a 750ml bottle in Alberta.

Tasting Notes: Creamy, honeyed and malty with fruit, vanilla and clove.

Nose: Fresh summer hay, malty cereal, creamy toffee and heather honey with sweet oak and barley sugar.

Palate: Smooth and creamy-sweet, with hints of fruit, malty honeyed spice and soft vanilla.

Finish: Crisp, with a tingle of clove that lingers and then fades gently.

Serve: Neat, or with a dash of water.

plantation-rum-venezuela-2010.title: Planteray Artisanal Rum Gift Box 6 x 100ml
plantation-rum-venezuela-2010.bodyHtml:
The Planteray Artisanal Rum gift box, from the house formerly known as Plantation, gathers six 100ml bottles in a cigar-box style case as an introduction to rum styles and origins from Maison Ferrand's range. The set sold under this barcode holds 3 Stars, a white blend of Barbados, Trinidad and Jamaica rums; Original Dark, a rich Barbados-style rum with plum, banana, cinnamon and clove; Grande Réserve, a double-aged Barbados rum with grilled coconut and woody vanilla; Gran Añejo, a fresh, spicy blend from Guatemala and Belize; Xaymaca Special Dry, a 100% pot still Jamaican rum full of classic funk; and the XO 20th Anniversary, an old Barbados rum with chocolate, ripe banana and mango. Average strength 41.03% ABV, 600ml in total.

Serve: Taste side by side, from the 3 Stars to the XO, neat or with a little water.

catena-zapata-malbec-argentino-2008.title: Catena Zapata Malbec Argentino 2008
catena-zapata-malbec-argentino-2008.bodyHtml:
A powerful and profoundly deep Malbec, the 2008 Malbec Argentino is a masterpiece of high-altitude blending, sourced from the most historic rows of the Nicasia and Adrianna vineyards. This wine presents an impenetrable dark violet color and an explosive bouquet of ripe blackberries, cassis, and black plums, seamlessly integrated with sophisticated notes of wood smoke, violets, and graphite. On the palate, it is full-bodied and opulent, showcasing a remarkably concentrated core of dark fruit supported by firm, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity. Nuances of mocha, tobacco, and black pepper emerge on an exceptionally long and structured finish, reflecting the incredible longevity and complexity of this benchmark vintage.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2008 Argentino Malbec is a blend of 65% Adrianna and 35% Nicasia fruit. It, too, spent 24 months in 100% new French oak. The Argentino offers a similar aromatic and flavor profile but with just a bit of extra nuance, presumably because of the blending. Dense, rich, and voluptuous, this lengthy effort should easily achieve its 20th birthday in peak form. It will be most enjoyable to taste these three wines side-by-side in another 10-15 years.
93 Points - James Suckling

This tangy and fruity red with hazelnut and chocolate character. Full body, with fine tannins and a bright finish. Refined and silky. Why wait? Drink it.
93 Points - Wine Spectator

Very pure for the vintage, offering a core of racy blackberry, raspberry ganache and spicy fig paste notes that are woven with nuances of Asian spice, mesquite and grilled herb that linger on the long, fruit-filled finish. Drink now through 2015. 400 cases imported.
91 Points - Wine Enthusiast
A sniff is rewarded with sandalwood, dry spice and thick, jammy berry aromas. It's concentrated and well integrated on the palate, with ultraripe and sweet flavors of coconut, vanilla cream and berry fruit. Seems a touch flat and candied on the finish, with a final blast of sweetness.

plantation-grande-reserve.title: Plantation Planteray Grande Reserve Rum
plantation-grande-reserve.bodyHtml:
Plantation Grande Reserve is a blend of Barbados rums from West Indies Rum Distillery, founded in 1893 on Brighton Beach on the island's Caribbean coast. Part of the blend is distilled in "Old Gregg", a copper pot still handcrafted in 1850,, reflecting the distillery's preserved Barbadian rum-making traditions. Now sold under the Planteray name, it won Gold at The Spirits Business Rum and Cachaça Masters 2022. The producer describes its style as warm and exotic, and it works both neat and in cocktails. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or in a classic rum punch with lime juice and simple syrup.

drouhin-chambolle-musigny-les-baudes.title: Joseph Drouhin Chambolle-Musigny 2022 1.5L Magnum
drouhin-chambolle-musigny-les-baudes.bodyHtml: Fine lace and silk are the words most often associated with this wine. Bright, intense color and complex aromas evoking violet, black cherry and damp earth. According to the vintages, there are also notes of truffle and game. Refined tannins coat the palate. Good balance between texture and acidity. Long aftertaste, with notes of cherry and candied fruit.

meukow-vanilla-liqueur.title: Meukow Vanilla Liqueur
meukow-vanilla-liqueur.bodyHtml: Meukow vanilla is the subtle blend of Cognac Meukow and vanilla aromas. The aromatic harmony shows the perfect balance between the cognac, long and delicate, and the vanilla, silky and powerful, offering a new sensation to be enjoyed on the rocks or in a cocktail.

meukow-xpresso-liquor.title: Meukow Xpresso
meukow-xpresso-liquor.bodyHtml: Meukow Xpresso is a coffee and cognac liquor with a smoothness and sweetness that reveals powerful aromas of roasted coffee, burnt oak, dark chocolate and bitter orange. This liquor is best enjoyed frozen, in a cocktail and with desserts.

lismore-21-year-old-single-malt.title: Lismore 21 Year Old The Legend
lismore-21-year-old-single-malt.bodyHtml:
Lismore 21 Year Old The Legend is the oldest expression in William Lundie & Co.'s Lismore range of Speyside single malt Scotch whisky, presented in a decanter-style bottle. The Lundie family were whisky brokers in Scotland, and the second generation, Alan and Bruce Lundie, created the Lismore brand in 1974 using whiskies from Speyside. The brand describes the 21 year old as a mouth-filling, sherry-led malt with notes of cherry, cinnamon and sugar. It is bottled at 43% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Sherry, cherry, cinnamon and sugar, with a full, mouth-coating texture.

Nose: Chelsea buns, brown sugar and light wafts of peppery oak.

Palate: Custard, cinnamon and sherried fruit, with blood orange and sultanas.

Finish: Vanilla fudge and dried fruit.

Serve: Neat or with a few drops of water.

kujira-whisky-inari.title: Kujira Ryukyu Inari Japanese Whisky
kujira-whisky-inari.bodyHtml:
Distilled by Masahiro Shuzo, one of the oldest and largest distillery in Okinawa, Japan. KUJIRA Ryukyu Whisky INARI was distilled from 100% Indica rice, and mashing with “black Koji”, an unique koji that could only be found in Okinawa. “INARI” means the god of rice cultivation in Japanese mythology, which reflects to the ingredient of Kujira Whisky. Vatted the top quality Ryukyu whisky from hand-picked casks for the best balance of harmonious flavors and aromas. Non chill filtered and non-colored.

Tasting Notes
00mL

glenallachie-21-year-old-batch-3.title: The GlenAllachie 21 Year Old Batch 3 51.5% ABV
glenallachie-21-year-old-batch-3.bodyHtml:
The celebrated Speyside distillery introduces Batch 3 of its revered aged cask strength single malt.

After a year of 50th anniversary celebrations for its veteran Master Distiller, Billy Walker, The GlenAllachie Distillery has launched a third iteration of one of its oldest core range expressions: The GlenAllachie 21-year-old Cask Strength Batch 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

Batch 3 is a very limited global release of 2,400 bottles, follows in the footsteps of highly sought-after previous instalments of the annual expression. The new ultra-premium small-batch Scotch whisky marries single malt matured in three vintage Pedro Ximénez Sherry puncheons.

Each cask was personally selected and expertly blended by industry leader, Walker, who over the course of his 50-year-long career has earnt recognition for demonstrating exceptional wood management capabilities and peerless sensory instinctiveness.  Chosen from the Speyside-based distillery’s enviable inventory of over 50,000 casks held on-site, the Spanish Sherry casks have imparted bold and complex flavour attributes, joining the distinctive heather honey character of The GlenAllachie’s house style.

The antique walnut-hued liquid is said to deliver refined qualities of “black grapes, fresh espresso, brandy butter and stem ginger, leading to indulgent dark chocolate fondant”.

Encased in a luxurious suedette-lined pine green box with gold foil detailing, the whisky was bottled at its natural cask strength of 51.5% ABV, with no added colour and without undergoing chill filtration.

mollydooker-velvet-glove-shiraz-1.title: Mollydooker Velvet Glove Shiraz 2022 750ml
mollydooker-velvet-glove-shiraz-1.bodyHtml:
In the glass, the 2022 Velvet Glove is a wine of depth and intensity, reflecting the essence of McLaren Vale Shiraz and Fruit Weight™. It balances strength, depth, and finesse, with a pleasing aroma that harmonizes berries and a blend of spices. Initially, flavours of ripe blackberry and cassis are accompanied by hints of raspberry and chocolate coffee cream. The wine’s supple tannins and velvety mouthfeel complement the richness of the flavors, maintaining an exquisite balance and finesse throughout the tasting experience. 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Concentrated and dense, with velvety tannins, this shows a good mix of generosity and restraint, displaying blackberry preserves, salted black licorice, Kalamata olive and mocha. Date nut bread and black walnut liqueur notes add richness on the finish, which offers plenty of harmony and a wonderful sense of restraint as the tannins firm up. Drink now through 2037.

raphet-charmes-chambertin-gc.title: Domaine Gerard Raphet Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru 2021
raphet-charmes-chambertin-gc.bodyHtml:
Domaine Gérard Raphet Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru 2021 is an exquisitely charming, aromatically complex red Burgundy that beautifully captures the fresh essence of a classic, cooler growing season. Sourced from the estate’s remarkably old Pinot Noir vines within the highly acclaimed Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru climat, it benefits from traditional, low-intervention winemaking including indigenous yeast fermentation and zero fining or filtration. The wine presents a luminous, translucent ruby color, uncurling in the glass with beautiful aromas of fresh red cherries, wild raspberries, and herbal tea notes layered over a core of newly turned earth, wet limestone, and delicate floral undercurrents. On the palate, it is round, succulent, and seductively textured, offering a lighter yet highly elegant and savory profile backed by fine-grained tannins and vibrant, mouthwatering acidity.

Food Pairing: This elegant Grand Cru Pinot Noir pairs exquisitely with classic pan-seared duck breast, roasted pheasant with wild mushrooms, roasted veal chops, or slow-cooked coq au vin.

raphet-clos-de-vougeot-gc.title: Domaine Gerard Raphet Clos De Vougeot Grand Cru 2021
raphet-clos-de-vougeot-gc.bodyHtml:
Domaine Gérard Raphet Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru 2021 is a classic, high-toned, and beautifully precise French red wine that perfectly mirrors the refreshing, traditional character of the 2021 Burgundian vintage. Sourced from the estate's down-slope parcel marked by a historic family stone wall, this 100% Pinot Noir thrives in deeper, clay-rich limestone soils. True to the Raphet signature, it pours a surprisingly translucent, delicate ruby color in the glass, yet immediately commands attention with a forceful intensity of flavor. The nose is cool, airy, and elegantly reticent in its youth, gradually opening with a perfume of fresh red cherries, wild cranberries, and dark berries, laced with hints of rose petals, damp earth, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, this medium-bodied Grand Cru offers remarkable tension and volume, balancing its core of bright red-fruit sapidity with a racy, mouth-watering acidity. Aged for 18 months in primarily older French oak barrels and bottled unfined and unfiltered, its structural frame is defined by tight, fine-grained tannins that lend a youthfully austere power, leading into a long, balanced, and deeply savory mineral finish.

Food Pairing: This elegant, structured Grand Cru pairs magnificently with roasted pork loin with savory herbs, classic roast chicken with root vegetables, duck breast with a sour cherry reduction, wild mushroom tarts, or semi-firm cheeses like classic Comté and Tomme de Savoie.

raphet-clos-de-vougeot-vv-gc.title: Domaine Gerard Raphet Clos De Vougeot Vieilles Vignes Grand Cru
raphet-clos-de-vougeot-vv-gc.bodyHtml:
Domaine Gérard Raphet Clos de Vougeot Vieilles Vignes Grand Cru is a monumental French red wine of exceptional depth, concentration, and historic character. While the estate’s standard Grand Cru bottling is already sourced from old vines, this specific Vieilles Vignes designated cuvée focuses heavily on the family's oldest centenarian plots—with vines ranging from 60 to over 100 years of age—primarily located within the prized Les Grands Maupertuis climat near the top of the wall. Here, the roots drill deep through thin limestone soils into the bedrock. In the glass, it pours the producer’s signature translucent, delicate ruby-red color. The nose is incredibly intense and noble, opening with an aromatic bouquet of wild blackberries, ripe cherries, and pomegranate, intricately layered with notes of warm baking spices, turned earth, forest floor, and a hint of dark tobacco. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied masterpiece displays a sapid, dense fruit core effortlessly balanced by a vibrant, racy acidity. Matured for 18 months in older French oak barrels (with only about 15% new oak) and bottled unfined and unfiltered, its fine-grained, chalky tannins provide an imposing, tightly knit structure that drives through to an incredibly long, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: This powerful and highly structural Grand Cru pairs magnificently with traditional duck confit, slow-roasted venison loin with a wild berry reduction, classic coq au vin, wild mushroom and black truffle risotto, or rich, mature French cheeses like Époisses and long-aged Comté.

raphet-clos-de-vougeot-vv-gc-1.title: Domaine Gerard Raphet Clos De Vougeot Vieilles Vignes Grand Cru
raphet-clos-de-vougeot-vv-gc-1.bodyHtml:
Domaine Gérard Raphet Clos de Vougeot Vieilles Vignes Grand Cru is a monumental French red wine of exceptional depth, concentration, and historic character. While the estate’s standard Grand Cru bottling is already sourced from old vines, this specific Vieilles Vignes designated cuvée focuses heavily on the family's oldest centenarian plots—with vines ranging from 60 to over 100 years of age—primarily located within the prized Les Grands Maupertuis climat near the top of the wall. Here, the roots drill deep through thin limestone soils into the bedrock. In the glass, it pours the producer’s signature translucent, delicate ruby-red color. The nose is incredibly intense and noble, opening with an aromatic bouquet of wild blackberries, ripe cherries, and pomegranate, intricately layered with notes of warm baking spices, turned earth, forest floor, and a hint of dark tobacco. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied masterpiece displays a sapid, dense fruit core effortlessly balanced by a vibrant, racy acidity. Matured for 18 months in older French oak barrels (with only about 15% new oak) and bottled unfined and unfiltered, its fine-grained, chalky tannins provide an imposing, tightly knit structure that drives through to an incredibly long, savory, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: This powerful and highly structural Grand Cru pairs magnificently with traditional duck confit, slow-roasted venison loin with a wild berry reduction, classic coq au vin, wild mushroom and black truffle risotto, or rich, mature French cheeses like Époisses and long-aged Comté.

raphet-clos-de-la-roche-gc.title: Domaine Gerard Raphet Clos De La Roche Grand Cru 2022
raphet-clos-de-la-roche-gc.bodyHtml:
Domaine Gérard Raphet Clos De La Roche Grand Cru 2022 is a profound, beautifully concentrated Grand Cru red Burgundy from one of the most powerful and structured sites in Morey-Saint-Denis. True to the estate's traditionalist philosophy, this old-vine Pinot Noir is vinified using ambient yeasts and bottled unfined and unfiltered to showcase its raw geological heritage. The solar and successful 2022 vintage endows the wine with an intense dark ruby color and a deeply layered nose of black cherries, red plums, and wild strawberries, layered with nuances of wet stone, baking spices, and warm, loamy earth. On the palate, it exhibits superb textural depth, driven by a fine balance of concentrated dark berry fruit, velvety yet robust tannins, and a persistent limestone minerality.

Food Pairing: This powerful and structured Grand Cru Burgundy pairs excellently with pan-seared duck breast, roasted venison, wild boar ragù, or rich wild mushroom risotto.

raphet-chambertin-clos-de-beze-gc.title: Domaine Gerard Raphet Chambertin Clos De Beze Grand Cru
raphet-chambertin-clos-de-beze-gc.bodyHtml:
Domaine Gérard Raphet Chambertin-Clos De Bèze Grand Cru is a highly coveted, monumental red Burgundy that showcases the exceptional power and structural complexity of one of the world's finest Pinot Noir sites. Sourced from remarkably old vines planted in thin, brown limestone soils over fragmented bedrock, this wine is vinified with minimal intervention, utilizing indigenous ambient yeasts and aging gracefully in French oak barrels. While it exhibits a relatively delicate, translucent ruby hue in the glass, it surprises the senses with its commanding intensity, uncurling with multi-layered aromas of dark cherries, wild blackberries, and field violets, all deeply integrated with nuances of sweet baking spices, pipe tobacco, and forest floor. The palate delivers striking opulence and depth, masterfully balanced by a vibrant, rocky mineral tension and firm, sophisticated tannins that allow it to evolve magnificently for decades.

Food Pairing: This powerful, majestic Grand Cru Pinot Noir couples beautifully with roasted duck breast, roasted venison with juniper berries, slow-cooked rabbit stew, or fine Comté cheese.

pycm-chassagne-montrachet-1er-cru.title: Armand Heitz Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Morgeot 2021
pycm-chassagne-montrachet-1er-cru.bodyHtml:
Armand Heitz Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Morgeot Blanc 2021 is an exceptionally precise and elegant white Burgundy crafted from Chardonnay vines grown in the historic Morgeot Premier Cru climat. Sourced from a small 0.44-hectare parcel managed with a focus on sustainable agronomy, this wine showcases the depth and textural richness characteristic of Chassagne-Montrachet. The clay-limestone soils impart a structural tension and profound mineral clarity to the palate. Vinified carefully with minimal intervention and aged in oak barrels, the wine unfurls with vivid aromas of orchard white fruits, lemon zest, and fresh pear, beautifully offset by underlying hints of flint and sea salt.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic roasted chicken, pan-seared lobster in garlic butter, rich wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté cheese.

juyondai-hizoushu-720ml.title: Juyondai Junmai Daiginjo Hizoushu Koshu Sake 720ml
juyondai-hizoushu-720ml.bodyHtml:
Juyondai Junmai Daiginjo Hizoushu Koshu Sake 720ml is a rare, premium Japanese sake produced by Takagi Shuzo in Yamagata Prefecture. Known as Hizoushu, meaning a treasured or carefully reserved sake, this exceptional Junmai Daiginjo undergoes extended maturation at extremely low temperatures to develop remarkable smoothness and complexity. Delicate aromas of ripe pear, apricot, and subtle nuts lead into a velvety palate with mellow sweetness, layered umami, and refreshing citrus acidity. Its elegant, lingering finish showcases the refined character of traditionally matured Japanese sake.

Food Pairing: Premium sashimi, sushi, grilled sea bass, steamed crab, lobster, shrimp tempura, delicate mushroom dishes, and lightly seasoned Japanese cuisine.

adelphi-chichibu.title: Adelphi Chichibu Japanese Whisky
adelphi-chichibu.bodyHtml:
Chichibu 7 Year Old 2013 is a single cask Japanese single malt from the Chichibu distillery, selected and bottled by independent bottler Adelphi for its Adelphi Selection range. Distilled in 2013 and bottled in 2023 from cask 3090, it yielded only 210 bottles at a natural cask strength of 57.8% ABV, presented in a 700ml bottle with no added colour and no chill filtration. The gap between the distillation date and the age statement is explained by the spirit resting in stainless steel tanks in Japan before it was shipped to Scotland for bottling. Chichibu was founded by Ichiro Akuto, grandson of the founder of the Hanyu distillery, and has built a cult following among whisky collectors.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

chassagne-montrachet-1er-cru.title: Armand Heitz Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Morgeot 2021
chassagne-montrachet-1er-cru.bodyHtml:
Armand Heitz Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Morgeot Blanc 2021 is an exceptionally precise and elegant white Burgundy crafted from Chardonnay vines grown in the historic Morgeot Premier Cru climat. Vinified carefully with minimal intervention and aged in oak barrels, the wine unfurls with vivid aromas of orchard white fruits, lemon zest, and fresh pear, beautifully offset by underlying hints of flint and sea salt.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic roasted chicken, pan-seared lobster in garlic butter, rich wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté cheese.

ornellaia-bianco-2019.title: Ornellaia Bianco 2019
ornellaia-bianco-2019.bodyHtml:
The desire to nurture the estate’s exceptional qualities has shaped Ornellaia’s philosophy since the beginning. Ornellaia Bianco is primarily produced with Sauvignon Blanc coming from three small vineyards that have demonstrated their remarkable capacity to express the unique character of Ornellaia.

95 Points - James Suckling
Lots of sweat pear and ripe green apple on the nose with some lemon grass and green melon. Medium-to full-bodied with a solid core of fruit that is tight and focused. Stone and dried-flower undertones to it. Vivid, lemony finish. Serious phenolic tension and framing to the wine. Drinkable now, but will age beautifully in time.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Made with 81% Sauvignon Blanc and 19% Viognier, the Ornellaia 2019 Ornellaia Bianco is fragrant and fresh, but the wine also shows a rather robust side with extra concentration. This is a hallmark of the vintage, and you even notice it in the distinctive light golden hue that shines prettily from the glass. To the nose, the wine displays a summery set of aromas with stone fruit, ripe peach, midnight jasmine and a touch of fragrant beeswax. There is some density to the otherwise streamlined mouthfeel, with white almond flavors on the close and an elegant touch of crushed stone or chalk. This 2019 vintage is poised for more years of bottle age

ornellaia-bianco-2019-magnum.title: Ornellaia Bianco 2019 1.5L Magnum
ornellaia-bianco-2019-magnum.bodyHtml:
The desire to nurture the estate’s exceptional qualities has shaped Ornellaia’s philosophy since the beginning. Ornellaia Bianco is primarily produced with Sauvignon Blanc coming from three small vineyards that have demonstrated their remarkable capacity to express the unique character of Ornellaia.

kilchoman-loch-gorm.title: Kilchoman Sanaig
kilchoman-loch-gorm.bodyHtml:
Kilchoman Sanaig is a rich and heavily peated Islay single malt Scotch whisky named after a small rocky inlet near the distillery on the rugged west coast of Islay. Matured in a high proportion of both Oloroso sherry and ex-bourbon casks, it offers a harmonious balance of deep peat smoke, rich dried fruits, and sweet oak complexity.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with dark chocolate, smoked meats, sticky barbecue ribs, blue cheese, or oysters on the half shell.

Tasting Notes : Deep beech color with a medium-to-full body and a rich, oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Soft cooked fruits, dark chocolate, raisins, and red berries followed by warm peat smoke and sweet oak.

Palate : Rich and rounded with layers of dark plum, sweet dried fruit, Demerara sugar, roasted coffee beans, and lingering peat smoke.

Finish : Long and warming with lingering peat smoke, dark chocolate, fruit cake, and gentle oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of water to gently unlock deeper fruit and peat aromas.

underberg-herbal-digestive.title: Underberg Herbal Digestive 3 x 20ml
underberg-herbal-digestive.bodyHtml:
Underberg is the German herbal digestif bitter created in 1846 by Hubert Underberg, who selected aromatic herbs from 43 countries and developed a gentle process to extract their character. It is made from natural ingredients without additives, colourings or added sugar, and is bottled at 44% ABV in its signature single-serve 20ml bottles wrapped in paper; this pack contains three. In the glass it is golden amber, with fragrant aromas of herbs and spices and a light impression of sweetness on the palate. Traditionally it is taken in one go after a meal.

Serve: Straight from the 20ml bottle, after a meal.

roscato-dark.title: Cavit Roscato Sparkling Sweet Red
roscato-dark.bodyHtml:
Cavit Roscato Sparkling Sweet Red is a lively, luscious, and fully effervescent Italian sparkling wine that upgrades the brand's signature sweet red profile into a celebratory spumante style. Crafted by the renowned Cavit cooperative, this expression is made from a proprietary blend of red grapes grown across Northern Italy that are specifically suited for sparkling production. Utilizing a natural second fermentation in closed tanks (the Charmat method), the winemaking team builds a much deeper bubble structure and a slightly higher alcohol content than their classic frizzante wines, adding a beautiful texturing weight while locking in intense fruit purity. In the glass, it shows an intense ruby-red color with a persistent, foaming perlage. The highly expressive, fruity nose opens with rich aromas of sweet blackberries, ripe wild berries, and red cherries, layered with subtle undertones of strawberry jam and red apple peel. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, vibrant, and smoothly textured, showing an engaging, fruit-forward fluid coherence. Its concentrated core of sweet dark berries is effortlessly supported by a racy line of natural acidity, balancing the residual sugar beautifully and finishing with a clean, effervescent snap.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with spicy barbecue chicken wings, creamy Brie or blue cheeses, and rich strawberry cheesecake.

el-tequileno-reposado-rare.title: El Tequileño Reposado Rare Tequila
el-tequileno-reposado-rare.bodyHtml: The world’s first and only Reposado Rare is an exclusive limited release offering that combines only the most coveted 100% Blue Agave from the Highlands of Jalisco with the mineral rich water of El Volcan de Tequila. The extracted mosto is then fermented with our own natural yeast influenced by 150 year old mango trees before distilling in Copper Pot Stills. This exquisite tequila is matured in a slow unique manner by using a large American Oak barrel, called a Pipón with a 25,000 liter capacity, for 6 years.

chairmans-reserve-original.title: St. Lucia Distillers Chairman's Reserve Finest Rum 50ml
chairmans-reserve-original.bodyHtml:
Chairman's Reserve Original is a Saint Lucia rum from St. Lucia Distillers, here in a 50ml miniature at 40% ABV. First blended in 1999 under then-chairman Laurie Barnard, Chairman's Reserve combines continuous and pot still rums after ageing, and its versatility has made it a favourite for cocktails both on the island and abroad. The brand has won Gold - Best in Class at the International Wine & Spirits Competition and Double Gold at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

Serve: Over ice, in a rum old fashioned, or with ginger beer and lime.

lagg-batch-01-ex-bourbon-cask.title: Laphroaig Quarter Casks
lagg-batch-01-ex-bourbon-cask.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig Quarter Cask is an iconic Islay single malt Scotch whisky that revives the historic tradition of aging whisky in smaller casks. After an initial maturation in standard ex-bourbon barrels, the spirit is transferred into smaller American oak quarter casks, creating up to 30% greater contact between the wood and the liquid. This accelerated maturation imparts a soft, velvety sweetness that balances Laphroaig's signature powerful peat smoke, medicinal brine, and coastal intensity without chill filtration.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with smoked meats, charred steak, oysters on the half shell, strong blue cheeses such as Roquefort or Stilton, and rich dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes : Sparkling golden amber with a medium-to-full body and a rich, oily, and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Powerful peat smoke, medicinal iodine, sea salt spray, sweet coconut, soft vanilla, and ripe banana.

Palate : Deep, complex, and full-bodied with a surge of peat embers, ash, and brine balanced by sweet vanilla cream, coconut, toffee, and toasted oak spice.

Finish : Very long, dry, and smoky with lingering notes of wood ash, coastal salt, sweet vanilla, and gentle spice.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass, or add a few drops of pure water to open up the sweet oak and vanilla layers beneath the heavy smoke.

lagg-batch-02-ex-oloroso-sherry-cask.title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Sherry Oak Cask Finish
lagg-batch-02-ex-oloroso-sherry-cask.bodyHtml:
Smoke and sherry here from Laphroaig! The legendary distillery on the south coast of Islay has gone and released a fab 10 year old single malt Scotch whisky which has been finished in Oloroso sherry casks for over 12 months, and bottled up at 48% ABV. Alongside the familiar, intensely peaty elements of Laphroaig’s classic 10 Year Old expression, you’ll also find helpings of dark chocolate and maple syrup notes in this one’s flavour profile.
Those enjoying the Laphroaig 10 Year Old will first notice the bold, smoky taste, followed by a hint of seaweed and a surprising sweetness. This full-bodied variant is the foundation of all Laphroaig expressions and comes with a long finish.

This whisky was also named 2019 Best Single Malt Scotch 10 Years & Under by Jim Murray's Whisky Bible.

lagg-batch-03-ex-red-wine-charred-cask.title: Lagg Batch 03 Ex-Red Wine Charred Cask 50%
lagg-batch-03-ex-red-wine-charred-cask.bodyHtml:
Distilled in 2019, this is the first of a trio of Inagural Release bottlings from the Lagg Distillery. Opened by the folks who brought you the Isle of Arran Distillery, now called Lochranza, Lagg started production in 2019. This release is made from double distilled heavily peated Concerto malt matured initially in ex-Bourbon casks before finishing for 6 months in ex-Rioja Red Wine casks. 50%.

Producer Description

"For this series of inaugural bottlings, we used Concerto malted barley and water from our own borehole. The malt is peated to 50ppm in the kiln. We receive it, crush it and agitate it in our mash tun to create a cloudy wort which delivers a more oily, robust flavor. Our chosen yeast and fermentation time allows us to create the full-bodied flavor we're looking for in our distillation. We then distill twice, at nearly twice the speed of Lochranza, in our handmade copper pot stills. The spirit for this release was matured in first fill, ex-bourbon casks for 30 months and then finished for 6 months in 55L ex-Rioja red wine casks prior to release. It was bottled unchill-filtered, without the addition of any colorings and at the higher strength of 50% ABV. A rich, complex dram, full of notes of dark fruit and toasted oak."

Color: Yellow Gold/Old Gold

Nose: Light intensity. Earthy peat with some light minerality and a hint of oak. 

Palate: Thick, mouth coating. More of the peat comes through on the mouthfeel. There is a sweetness. Lots of berries maybe some dark fruit. Some more herbaceous notes in the background.

Finish: Medium. More peat, nice balance with a little pinch of saltiness. 

Comment: Water brings out a little more of the minerality. Earthy peat with dark fruits and berries, hints of herbs and some slight salinity.

alley-kat-new-moon-hazy-pale-ale.title: Alley Kat New Moon Hazy Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans
alley-kat-new-moon-hazy-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Alley Kat New Moon Hazy Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans

henderson-brew-rush-canadian-golden-ale.title: Henderson Brew Rush Canadian Golden Ale 4 Tall Cans
henderson-brew-rush-canadian-golden-ale.bodyHtml: Henderson Brew Rush Canadian Golden Ale 4 Tall Cans

louis-latour-chassagne-montrachet-blanc.title: Olivier Leflaive Chassagne Montrachet 1er Cru Abbaye de Morgeot Blanc 2018 750ml
louis-latour-chassagne-montrachet-blanc.bodyHtml:
90-92 Points - Allen Meadows - Burghound
Moderate reduction once again suppresses the underlying fruit though it does seem ripe. More interesting are the slightly bigger and richer flavors that manage to retain pretty good delineation on the attractively textured and vibrant finale where the only reproach is a hint of warmth.

90-93 Points - Jasper Morris - Inside Burgundy
Clear bright lemon. Biscuity toast on the nose, perhaps the oak speaking. There is substantial muscle to this, all in white fruit, some clay soil flesh, a little lemony note behind. Just ripe enough.

louis-lat-meursault-1er-cru-ch-de-blagny.title: Louis Latour Meursault-Blagny 'Chateau de Blagny' Premier Cru 2020
louis-lat-meursault-1er-cru-ch-de-blagny.bodyHtml:
Louis Latour Meursault-Blagny 'Château de Blagny' Premier Cru 2020 is an elegant, terroir-driven white Burgundy crafted from hand-harvested Chardonnay grapes grown in the unique high-elevation hamlet of Blagny, overlooking Meursault. Fermented and matured for 8 to 10 months in traditional French oak barrels (15% new), it displays a pale yellow hue in the glass. The complex nose opens with seductive aromas of white acacia flowers, toasted brioche, fresh citrus, and subtle grilled almond. On the palate, it is rich, generous, and textured, delivering flavors of white peach, lemon oil, and baking spice balanced by a fine line of racy tension, refreshing acidity, and a long, flinty, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with rock lobster, pan-seared scallops, salmon with sorrel sauce, roasted poultry, wild mushroom ragù, and aged Comté cheese.

93 Points - James Suckling

Here’s a very typical Meursault that combines the generosity and textural complexity we expect from this appellation, with liveliness that makes it very satisfying. Good concentration. A ton of flinty character at the substantial finish.
93 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Aromas of lemon zest, orange oils and acacia delight with precision. Pure and delicate notes of lemon, orange oil, geranium, white mushroom, brioche and crushed stone gently lingers on the palate along its long vanilla finish.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Luscious and well-delineated, too, this white offers lemon oil, sliced apple and clove flavors, with an underlying mineral element. Long and will benefit from an additional year in bottle. Best from 2023 through 2029. 2,500 cases made, 750 cases imported.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Meursault 1er Cru Château de Blagny offers up aromas of crisp Anjou pear, white flowers, green apple and freshly baked bread. Medium to full-bodied, round and rich, it's a gourmand, textural white from this higher-altitude site.

louis-latour-cru-cuvee-heritiers-latour.title: Louis Latour Cru Cuvee Heritiers Latour 750ml
louis-latour-cru-cuvee-heritiers-latour.bodyHtml: The Louis Latour Chambertin "Cuvée Héritiers Latour" Grand Cru is a renowned Burgundy wine known for its complex and powerful character. It's a full-bodied, red wine made exclusively from Pinot Noir grapes, showcasing a beautiful garnet color.

latour-grand-cru-chateau-grancey-2020.title: Louis Latour Chateau Corton Grancey Grand Cru 2020
latour-grand-cru-chateau-grancey-2020.bodyHtml:
The 2020 Chateau Corton Grancey Grand Cru reveals a deep ruby color with a hint of garnet. It is complex on the nose with aromas of black cherry, blueberry, and mocha. Round in the mouth, it is lightly peppery on the final. This wine stands out for its complexity and the softness of its tannins.

98 Points - James Suckling

Complex meaty and spicy nose. This effortlessly marries the wild and refined sides of this Grand Cru! The fruit character stands on a mighty tower of tannins that are at once fine and slightly herbal. What an amazingly energetic finish!

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Delivers a velvety texture that wraps around flavors of black cherry, blackberry, plum, earth and spice. This is holding back a little now, with excellent balance and a finish that should develop even more length with time. Shows a solid core of fruit. Best from 2025 through 2045.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine reveals an umami-mushroom core, emerging from layers of black cherries and stone. The palate is sophisticated, with juicy tannins perfectly balanced by vibrant acidity, highlighting notes of black plum, wild thyme, and morello cherry.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Rich and round, the 2020 Château Corton-Grancey Grand Cru is a full-bodied, ample and layered wine evocative of raspberries, cherries, sweet spices, peonies and dark chocolate. Built around sweet, powdery tannins, a touch of subtle back-end warmth bears the signature of the hot, dry growing season.

louis-latour-marsannay-rouge-2019.title: Louis Latour Marsannay Rouge 2019 750ml
louis-latour-marsannay-rouge-2019.bodyHtml:
The Marsannay is sturdy and robust due to the rich iron-based soil. The wine has an intense bouquet of red fruit and a silky palate with a distinct gamey character and great tannic appeal.

92 Points - Wilfred Wong of Wine.com

COMMENTARY: The 2019 Louis Latour Marsannay Rouge shows excellent and intricate nuances. TASTING NOTES: This wine excels with aromas and flavors of red and black fruits. Enjoy it with garlic and rosemary-infused roast leg of lamb. (Tasted: April 6, 2022, San Rafael, CA)

latour-romanee-saint-viv-les-quatre-jour.title: Latour Romanee Saint Viv Les Quatre Jour 750ml
latour-romanee-saint-viv-les-quatre-jour.bodyHtml: The Latour Romanee Saint Viv Les Quatre Journaux 750ml is a Grand Cru Pinot Noir wine from the Burgundy region of France, specifically from the village of Vosne-Romanée. It's known for its deep color, intense aromas of blackcurrant, mocha, and licorice, and a full, silky palate with lingering flavors. The wine is aged in oak barrels, which adds toasty notes and complexity.

latour-corton-charlemagne-grand-cru-2019.title: Charles Henri Bourguignon Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 2019 750ml
latour-corton-charlemagne-grand-cru-2019.bodyHtml: The 2019 Charles Henri Bourguignon Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru is a white wine from Burgundy, France, known for its power and complexity. It is produced from the Chardonnay grape variety and is a Grand Cru appellation, meaning it's one of the highest quality white wine appellations in Burgundy.

poggio-alle-gazze-dellornellaia-2020.title: Ornellaia Poggio alle Gazze dell'Ornellaia 2020
poggio-alle-gazze-dellornellaia-2020.bodyHtml:
With its classic bright straw-yellow color, Poggio alle Gazze dell’Ornellaia 2020 expresses itself on the nose with a beautiful aromatic intensity: aromas of boxwood and white flowers, accompanied by notes of white peach, sage and aromatic herbs are all released once poured. The wine fills the palate with elegance and determination upon tasting, revealing the proper balance of acidic freshness and density. The finish is lively, persistent and with a nice tanginess.

93 Points - James Suckling

The grapefruit and white-peach character is very lively in this young white, with a zesty lemon undertone to it all. It’s medium-to full-bodied with crisp acidity and a flavorful finish. I keep thinking about oysters while I taste this! Bright and delicious sauvignon blanc.

93 Points - Wine & Spirits

Abundant spring rain in 2020 kept the vines refreshed through the summer, allowing full development of sauvignon's herbal and citrus scents in this lively wine. Notes of sage and lemongrass accent the flavors of white grapefruit and crystallized pineapple. Half of the wine aged in barriques (25 percent new), adding a creamy texture to complement the fresh citrus tones.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Intense savory notes dominate the nose of this wine, from caramelized onions to fried herbs to fresh pastry. Lemon and other citrus offer an acidic throughline that carries over to a still very savory and now also saline palate. More spicy, herbal notes run through a leisurely finish.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The Ornellaia 2020 Poggio alle Gazze dell'Ornellaia is a delightfully fresh and tonic white blend made primarily with Sauvignon Blanc supplemented by Vermentino and Viognier. It pours from the bottle with crystalline luminosity and displays a full range of varietal flavors from lime to lemon grass, white flower and acacia. Despite the hot growing season, the wine's acidity is vibrant and bright.

latour-grands-echezeaux-grand-cru-2017.title: Charles Henri Bourguignon Grands-Echezeaux Grand Cru 2017 750ml

latour-grands-echezeaux-grand-cru-2020.title: Charles Henri Bourguignon Grands-Echezeaux Grand Cru 2020 750ml

g-chambertin-1er-cru-petitechapelle-2018.title: Charles Henri Bourguignon Gevrey-Chambertin 1Er Cru Petite Chapelle 2018
g-chambertin-1er-cru-petitechapelle-2018.bodyHtml: The Charles Henri Bourguignon Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru Petite Chapelle 2018 is a masterful expression of one of Burgundy’s most cherished premier cru climates, situated just below the legendary Chapelle-Chambertin Grand Cru. This wine captures the power and opulence of the 2018 vintage while maintaining the signature elegance of the Petite Chapelle vineyard, which is renowned for its deep, stony soils that provide exceptional drainage and mineral tension. On the palate, it reveals a seductive core of dark cherry, wild raspberry, and crushed violets, underpinned by savory notes of forest floor, iron, and fine-grained tannins that provide a sophisticated structure. Produced with a focus on traditional Burgundian craftsmanship, this 1er Cru showcases a remarkable balance of muscularity and grace, offering a long, perfumed finish that promises to evolve beautifully with further cellar aging.

bourgogne-hautes-cotes-de-beaune-2020.title: Philippe le Hardi Bourgogne Hautes Cotes de Beaune Le Champ Lambert 2020
bourgogne-hautes-cotes-de-beaune-2020.bodyHtml:
Produced from Pinot Noir grown in the Bourgogne Hautes Cotes de Beaune appellation, Le Champ Lambert offers aromas of fresh red berries, floral notes, subtle spice, and delicate oak. The palate is silky and vibrant with refined tannins, bright acidity, and an elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roast chicken, duck breast, grilled pork, mushroom dishes, charcuterie, and soft cheeses.

l-latour-pinot-noir-les-pierres-dorees.title: Louis Latour Pinot Noir Les Pierres Dorees 2017
l-latour-pinot-noir-les-pierres-dorees.bodyHtml:
Louis Latour Pinot Noir Les Pierres Dorées is an elegant French red wine from the golden limestone hills of southern Beaujolais. Produced by Maison Louis Latour, this expressive Pinot Noir combines Burgundian winemaking traditions with the distinctive clay-limestone terroir of Les Pierres Dorées. Aromas of black cherries, red berries, delicate florals, and gentle spice lead into a rounded palate with fresh acidity and refined tannins. Aged in stainless steel and French oak, it offers an appealing balance of fruit, freshness, and savoury complexity.

Food Pairing: Roasted lamb, grilled salmon, duck breast, mushroom risotto, herb-roasted chicken, tuna tartare, goat cheese, and grilled vegetables.

chassagne-montrachet-1er-cru-lesembazees.title: Armand Heitz Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Morgeot 2021
chassagne-montrachet-1er-cru-lesembazees.bodyHtml:
Armand Heitz Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Morgeot Blanc 2021 is an exceptionally precise and elegant white Burgundy crafted from Chardonnay vines grown in the historic Morgeot Premier Cru climat. Sourced from a small 0.44-hectare parcel managed with a focus on sustainable agronomy, this wine showcases the depth and textural richness characteristic of Chassagne-Montrachet. The clay-limestone soils impart a structural tension and profound mineral clarity to the palate. Vinified carefully with minimal intervention and aged in oak barrels, the wine unfurls with vivid aromas of orchard white fruits, lemon zest, and fresh pear, beautifully offset by underlying hints of flint and sea salt.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with classic roasted chicken, pan-seared lobster in garlic butter, rich wild mushroom risotto, or aged Comté cheese.

penderyn-gold-range-portwood-whisky.title: Penderyn Gold Range Portwood  Welsh Whisky
penderyn-gold-range-portwood-whisky.bodyHtml:
Penderyn Portwood Single Malt Welsh Whisky is part of Penderyn's Gold Range and the distillery's most full-bodied expression. Penderyn spirit, made in its distinctive copper Faraday still, is finished in port casks, which the distillery says add a richness that bourbon and sherry casks cannot match. The nose brings rich dried fruit, dark chocolate and cranberry, the palate is full of honeyed spice, and the finish is smooth with soft oak and honey. Bottled at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle and presented in a gift box.

Nose: Rich dried fruit, dark chocolate and cranberry.

Palate: Honeyed spice.

Finish: Smooth, with soft oak and honey.

Serve: Neat or with a splash of water.

armand-heitz-meursault-1er-porusots.title: Domaine Heitz-Lochardet - Armand Heitz Les Porusots 750ml
armand-heitz-meursault-1er-porusots.bodyHtml: The Armand Heitz Meursault 1er Cru Les Porusots is a 750ml bottle of white wine made from Chardonnay grapes. It's a Premier Cru wine from the Burgundy region of France, specifically the village of Meursault. The wine is known for its rich, buttery, and complex flavor profile, with notes of vanilla, coconut, butter, and dill, and a long, harmonious finish. It's often described as a full-bodied and creamy wine with a buttery mouthfeel.

armand-heitz-pommard-1er-cru-chaniere.title: Armand Heitz Pommard 1Er Cru Chaniere 2020 750ml
armand-heitz-pommard-1er-cru-chaniere.bodyHtml: Armand Heitz Pommard 1er Cru Chaniere is a red wine from the Burgundy region of France, specifically from the Pommard village, known for its rich and complex flavors. It is a single vineyard wine made from Pinot Noir grapes and aged in oak barrels. The wine is described as having a medium ruby color, with notes of red fruit, berries, and tertiary flavors like earthiness and leather.

armand-heitz-msd-1er-monts-luisants.title: Armand Heitz Morey-Saint-Denis 1er Cru Monts Luisants 2021 750ml
armand-heitz-msd-1er-monts-luisants.bodyHtml: Morey-Saint-Denis is a small village located between Gevrey-Chambertin and Chambolle-Musigny. The wines produced there have a strong identity that I really like. Morey-Saint-Denis also saw very recently the two largest families of world luxury put down their suitcases. The 1er Cru Les Monts-Luisants is a star climate of the village of Morey-Saint-Denis. Interspersed between the Clos de la roche and the Grand Cru Latricières-Chambertin, it is almost impossible to find better neighbors.

armand-heitz-echezeaux-grand-cru.title: Armand Heitz Corton Grand Cru Chaumes 2020
armand-heitz-echezeaux-grand-cru.bodyHtml:
Armand Heitz Corton Grand Cru Chaumes 2020 is an exceptional and highly refined red Burgundy that highlights the magnificent power and complexity of the Corton hill. Originating from the "Les Chaumes" climat—a historical name designating an old parcel of land that was once left fallow before being successfully reclaimed as a premium vineyard—this wine breaks away from the traditionally tough, heavily rustic expectations of Corton reds. Winemaker Armand Heitz employs mindful viticultural methods and thoughtful hands-off cellaring to emphasize aromatic clarity and structural sophistication over sheer extraction. The wine displays a radiant ruby profile, leading into a expressive bouquet filled with fresh red cherries, black raspberries, dark wild berries, and complex accents of sweet baking spices, forest floor, and crushed stones. On the palate, it exhibits deep concentration and a round, velvety texture, supported by energetic limestone acidity and seamlessly integrated tannins that transition into a remarkably long, peppery, and mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs perfectly with roasted duck breast, wild game birds, herb-crusted rack of lamb, and aged French cheeses like Époisses or Comté.

armand-heitz-charmes-chambertin-grand-cr.title: Armand Heitz Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru 750ml
armand-heitz-charmes-chambertin-grand-cr.bodyHtml:
Like Montrachet, it is a legendary appellation. The vines are exposed to the East and rather on the upper part of the hillside. The result is a powerful, serious and complex wine. I particularly appreciate the minty and spicy notes on the palate.

Grape:Pinot Noir

Nevertheless, we remind you that: alcohol abuse is dangerous for your health. To consume with moderation.

g-m-speymalt-macallan-2001.title: Gordon & MacPhail Speymalt From Macallan Distillery 2001 20 Year Old 54.6% ABV
g-m-speymalt-macallan-2001.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail bottles a series of single malt whiskies from one of the world’s most
famous distilleries – Macallan. Established in 1824 the distillery overlooks some of the finest fishing beats on the River Spey.

It is likely that whisky has been distilled on the Macallan site, a small hill overlooking the
river Spey, since the late 1700's. The first licensed distillation at Macallan took place in
the earliest days of legalised production, in 1824. The distillery changed hands several
times throughout the 19th century and in 1894 was bought by Elgin merchant, Roderick Kemp (who also owned Talisker on Skye).

Nose: Muted but complex: caramel fudge, butter cookies, fragrant yeast and apple cake. Closes with a rather subtle, sulphureous, sherry funk. 

Palate: Hints of caramel but slightly on the tannic-dry side with the high ABV well integrated. Adding a few drops of water brings all the fruity characteristic to the fore. Stewed red stone fruits with prominent oak spiciness.

Finish: Medium length, rich texture and sweetness, caramel carries through to the finish.

g-m-speymalt-macallan-2002.title: Gordon & MacPhail Speymalt From Macallan Distillery 2002 58.2% ABV
g-m-speymalt-macallan-2002.bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail bottles a series of single malt whiskies from one of the world’s most
famous distilleries – Macallan. Established in 1824 the distillery overlooks some of the finest fishing beats on the River Spey.

It is likely that whisky has been distilled on the Macallan site, a small hill overlooking the
river Spey, since the late 1700's. The first licensed distillation at Macallan took place in
the earliest days of legalised production, in 1824. The distillery changed hands several
times throughout the 19th century and in 1894 was bought by Elgin merchant, Roderick Kemp (who also owned Talisker on Skye).

g-m-connoisseurs-choice-brackla-2009.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseur's Choice Brackla 2009 12 Year Old 58.8% ABV
g-m-connoisseurs-choice-brackla-2009.bodyHtml:
NOSE

Aromas of PEAR give way to fresh APPLE and sweet LEMON. Notes of HONEY develop alongside subtle hints of PASSION FRUIT.

TASTE

Spiced APPLE combines with ripe MANGO and PINEAPPLE. SEVILLE ORANGE PEEL comes to the fore and is balanced by CRACKED BLACK PEPPER.

FINISH

Full and spicy with lingering TROPICAL FRUIT.

g-m-priv-collection-glen-mhor-1982.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Glen Mhor 1982 50.8% ABV
g-m-priv-collection-glen-mhor-1982.bodyHtml: Rich sherry influences with toasted hazelnuts and subtle milk chocolate. Morello cherry notes develop alongside sweet treacle toffee. Intense stewed fruit leads to pressed apple and demerara sugar. Raspberry compote combines with soft white pepper and a hint of dried tobacco. A full finish with citrus and summer fruit.

g-m-private-collection-st-mag1982.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection St. Magdalene 1982 39 Year Old 54.8% ABV
g-m-private-collection-st-mag1982.bodyHtml: Baked apple aromas lead to demerara sugar and faint dried herbs. Grapefruit zest develops accompanied by white chocolate and freshly cut grass. Dried pineapple flavours infuse with passion fruit and crystallised violet. Lemon curd comes to the fore alongside subtle icing sugar and a faint herbal edge. White pepper and charred oak linger on the finish with citrus fruit.

g-m-private-collection-lochside-1981.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Lochside 1981 40 Year Old 49.2% ABV
g-m-private-collection-lochside-1981.bodyHtml: Rich Sherry aromas complement fragrant mandarin peel. Salted almonds come to the fore with raspberry compote and faint malted biscuit. Roasted coffee beans lead to walnuts and stewed raisins. Blackcurrant jam accompanies Seville orange peel and red apple. A long finish with lingering hazelnuts and cocoa powder.

g-m-private-collection-banff-1975.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Banff 1975 46 Year Old 48.6% ABV
g-m-private-collection-banff-1975.bodyHtml: Dried banana aromas combine with candied lime peel and soft black liquorice. Vanilla custard notes give way to white pepper and subtle green apple. Fresh lemon zest is accompanied by faint marzipan and honeydew melon. Fresh cut grass notes develop with a hint of spiced orange. Medium-bodied finish with citrus fruit and soft spice.

g-m-private-convalmore-1975.title: Gordon & MacPhail Private Collection Convalmore 1975 46 Year Old 47.8% ABV
g-m-private-convalmore-1975.bodyHtml: Orange sherbet and lemon peel give way to subtle notes of rhubarb. Rose petal aromas develop with lime bitters and mature oak. Lemon drizzle cake flavours combine with orange oil and toasted almonds. Honeysuckle gives way to a soft herbal note and brown sugar. Full and creamy finish with lingering citrus and vanilla pod.

louis-latour-saint-aubin-1er-cru.title: Francois Carillon Saint-Aubin 1er Cru 'Les Murgers Des Dents de Chien' 2021
louis-latour-saint-aubin-1er-cru.bodyHtml: Francois Carillon Saint-Aubin 1er Cru 'Les Murgers Des Dents de Chien' 2021

white-claw-black-cherry-vodka.title: White Claw Black Cherry 6 Cans
white-claw-black-cherry-vodka.bodyHtml: A hard seltzer with the perfect balance of natural ripe black cherry and a hint of tart cranberry flavor. Best served cold

g-m-connoisseurs-choice-bladnoch-1988.title: Gordon & MacPhail Connoisseurs Choice Bladnoch 33 Year Old 1988 Refill Sherry Hogshead Cask 2107 54.1% ABV
g-m-connoisseurs-choice-bladnoch-1988.bodyHtml:
Sweet SHERRY aromas complement AUTUMN SPICES and toasted HAZELNUT. ORANGE MARMALADE notes develop, leading to BROWN SUGAR and subtle dried TOBACCO.

STEWED RED BERRIES give way to rich TOFFEE APPLES. CRACKED BLACK PEPPER balances the palate and leads to dark TREACLE and MATURE OAK.

A medium-bodied finish with lingering notes of FRUITCAKE.

rum-sponge-enmore-1990-31-year-58-4.title: Rum Sponge Edition No.15 Enmore 1992 29 Year Old
rum-sponge-enmore-1990-31-year-58-4.bodyHtml:
For Rum Sponge Edition No.15 we've selected a dark, syrupy and juicy 1992 Enmore from Guyana. A single barrel bottled at natural cask strength of 58.4%. 

Long aged, dark, unctuous, sticky, complex and perfectly drying and medicinal. This is murky rum for inquisitive nerds, geeks, fanatics and enthusiasts.

To be sipped and discussed in quiet, reverential fervour with beads of trepidatious sweat coagulating on your quivering brow!

lobos-1707-reposado-tequila.title: Lobos 1707 Reposado Tequila
lobos-1707-reposado-tequila.bodyHtml: From 100% pure Blue Weber agave, Lobos 1707 Tequila, Reposado reaches its perfectly robust flavor through rest. After ruminating for over six slow months in American white oak barrels, the liquid is blended with a touch of Lobos 1707 Tequila, Extra Añejo and finished at its leisure in historic PX wine barrels using the solera method. Once sipped, it reveals its spicy, audacious character.

lobos-1707-extra-anejo.title: Lobos 1707 Extra Anejo Tequila
lobos-1707-extra-anejo.bodyHtml: Lobos 1707 Tequila, Extra Anejo is the alpha Tequila – over four hundred years of refinement that harkens back to 1707. Born of 100% pure Blue Weber agave Tequila, it is aged to perfection for three years in American white oak and finished in historic PX wine barrels using the solera method, permitting the Tequila time to evolve into its most lasting, flavorful experience. Superbly unorthodox. Unapologetically smooth.

wild-rose-the-herd-mix-pack.title: Wild Rose The Herd Mix Pack 8 Tall Cans
wild-rose-the-herd-mix-pack.bodyHtml: Wild Rose The Herd Mix Pack 8 Tall Cans

teremana-tequila-anejo.title: Teremana Anejo Tequila
teremana-tequila-anejo.bodyHtml: Following the success of Teremana Blanco and Reposado and backed by global superstar Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson, their Añejo is now entering the tequila ring. Apple, pear, oak, vanilla, agave, caramel, and baking spice notes. The rich palate guides you to a long, complex finish. Try with samosas topped with green chutney.

whisky-sponge-old-rhosdhu-1993-57-1-abv.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.67 Old Rhosdhu 1993 29 Year Old 57.1% ABV
whisky-sponge-old-rhosdhu-1993-57-1-abv.bodyHtml:
Step into the petrified brain of the Sponge, from which only Old Rhosdhu can grow... 

Or in this case, specifically, a 1993 refill hogshead of Old Rhosdhu, distilled at Loch Lomond distillery in their famously confusing still room. It was aged for 29 years (almost 30 dammit!) and bottled with around 2 degrees reduction to 57.1% (100° proof in Brexlish). We deliberately did this because it made everything just that bit more fruity and exotic, and as you very well know, Old Rhosdhu is all about weird, pulpy, overripe, gungy, funky exotic fruits all smooshed up into a slurry and aged in a damp hessian sack with a fistful of mottled old thruppeny bits. The kind of fruits you wouldn't dream of putting anywhere near your mouth in real, physical life, but in whisky form are actually scrumdiddlyumptious. 

Anyway, we sent a LOT of emails to make this whisky get into glass bottles and eventually into a storage location from which we can facilitate its dispatch to YOU, our noble and coveted consumer. As such we hope you enjoy this luscious fluid. Please buy generously.

whisky-sponge-glen-garioch-1988-33-year.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.68 Glen Garioch 1988 33 Year Old 44.6% ABV
whisky-sponge-glen-garioch-1988-33-year.bodyHtml:
A single refill hogshead of Glen Garioch, distilled and filled in 1988, matured for 33 years and bottled at natural cask strength. 

What are the connections between 1988 Glen Garioch and the Mona Lisa you may very well ask? If I purchase one of these Glen Gariochs does it enable me to skip the queue in the Louvre? Will I, at any stage in the proceedings, have to have lunch with Dan Brown? Am I descended from Jesus? 

The answers to all these questions - and more - can be learned by purchasing and consuming a bottle of this delicious and decided 'old style highlands' Glen Garioch 1988. The answers to all you seek* lie within... 

*does not contain literally all answers. Subjects not covered include but are not limited to: hoovers, slinkys, radishes, Postman Pat, Boltzmann Brains, tarragon and the fascinating archaeological discoveries of Gobekli Tepe - your statutory rights are a social construct and do not exist*

nas-blended-malt-30-year-old-45-1-abv.title: Decadent Drinks Notable Age Statements No.1 Blended Malt 30 Year Old 45.1% ABV
nas-blended-malt-30-year-old-45-1-abv.bodyHtml:
A single sherry butt of blended malt. This is vatted stock of numerous old Signatory cask samples and bottling run ends that was married and put into fresh sherry wood with a minimum age of 16 years old.

The composition is by now at least 30 years old, but contains within it many much, much older whiskies, many of which hail from closed distilleries and date back to the 1960s. We've bottled this butt at natural cask strength and the result is a wonderfully aromatic and old style sherried malt.

whisky-sponge-inchgower-2001-21-year-old.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.71 Inchgower 2001 21 Year Old 48.9% ABV
