whisky-sponge-inchgower-2001-21-year-old.bodyHtml:
A charming, sophisticated and deeply philosophical single cask of 2001 Inchgower. Aged for 21 years in a single refill hogshead before bottling at natural cask strength. 

This is a lovely dram which displays many of the gently old school, distillate-forward attributes which are often overlooked about Inchgower as a whisky. Expect soft waxes, green and yellow fruity flavours and an all round, general thought-provoking nature which will motivate you to ponder some of the deepest and most ancient questions of sentient humankind. Such as: why do I care so much about scores? Who keeps outbidding me at auction? Why am I not happy despite being financially comfortable enough to enjoy malt whisky as a hobby? And, what would it be like to taste whisky on Pluto? 

Purchasing and consuming one of these bottles will bring you the answer to all these questions, along with unquantifiable satisfaction and a general sense of cosmic serenity - like a nice, comfy sock floating in deep space...

nas-ben-nevis-2014-7-year-old-57-1-abv.title: Decadent Drinks Notable Age Statements No.2 Ben Nevis 2014 7 Year Old 57.1% ABV
nas-ben-nevis-2014-7-year-old-57-1-abv.bodyHtml:
The second bottling in our Notable Age Statements series is a 7 year old Ben Nevis. Distilled in 2014 and matured for 7 years in a 2nd fill sherry butt before bottling at our favourite bottling strength of 100° proof. 

We chose this for the NAS series as we felt it is a great example of how good younger whiskies can be. It has power and punchiness of youth, but with a wonderfully rich layer of sherry flavour from the cask, all underpinned by a strong and clear sense of Ben Nevis's wonderful distillate character. Expect lots of earthiness, tobacco, waxiness and a nicely oily and mechanical side. A perfect counterpart to the 30 year old Blended Malt we released as NAS 1, which was conversely more about age and maturity. 

We bottled half of this butt as our Equinox & Solstice Autumn edition at 48.5%, this is the full-power 100° proof version with extra spicy and waxy heft!

whisky-sponge-ardmore-2000-22-year-54-2.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.69 Ardmore 2000 22 Year Old
whisky-sponge-ardmore-2000-22-year-54-2.bodyHtml:
Whisky Sponge Edition No.69 Ardmore 2000 22 Year Old is a cult-favourite independent single malt Scotch whisky distilled at Ardmore Distillery in the Eastern Highlands in 2000 and bottled in 2022 by Angus MacRaild under his witty, collector-adored Whisky Sponge label (Decadent Drinks). Matured for 22 years in a refill bourbon barrel, this release showcases Ardmore's celebrated signature style: gentle, earthy Highland peat smoke intertwined with waxy orchard fruits, heather honey, and coastal minerality. Bottled at its natural cask strength of 54.2% ABV without chill-filtration or added colouring—and adorned with the label's trademark satirical artwork—it exemplifies mature, unhurried, single-cask Highland whisky craftsmanship.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoked venison carpaccio, pan-seared sea scallops with bacon lardons, aged Isle of Mull cheddar or Comté cheese, grilled wild salmon, dark chocolate with sea salt, or roasted chestnuts.

Tasting Notes: A remarkably balanced, waxy, and aromatic mature Highland single malt uniting gentle campfire smoke and earthy soot with orchard fruits, beeswax, heather honey, and zesty citrus.

Nose: Complex, waxy, and expressive with aromas of soft Highland peat smoke, beeswax polish, baked green apple, poached pear, heather honey, lemon oil, and damp hearth ash.

Palate: Full-bodied, oily, and textured at cask strength, delivering rich layers of smoked orchard fruit, toasted barley, salted caramel, vanilla bean, gentle coal smoke, and white pepper warmth.

Finish: Long, warming, and cleanly smoky, lingering with sweet waxy malt, mineral salinity, dried citrus peel, and lingering embers.

Serve: Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn or copita tasting glass after resting for 10 to 15 minutes; adding a few drops of pure spring water opens up deeper beeswax, tropical fruit, and honeyed malt nuances alongside the delicate peat smoke.

whisky-sponge-ledaig-2005-17-year-62-1.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.70 Ledaig 2005 17 Year Old 62.1% ABV
whisky-sponge-ledaig-2005-17-year-62-1.bodyHtml:
Every so often we try some casks and think ‘we just absolutely have to bottle this!’. This 2005 Ledaig was one such occasion. 

Comprised of two 2nd fill sherry butts of 2005 Lediag that were clearly still very active and had matured in warehouse conditions which had delivered a highly concentrative maturation profile resulting in very low levels of whisky remaining in cask, at naturally very high strengths. The resulting whisky displayed such an intense and pure expression of sherry and peat we were instantly reminded of some of the great 1972 Ledaigs from sherry casks.

whisky-sponge-secret-speyside-2003-19-ye.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.72 Speyside 2003 19 Year Old 51.2% ABV
whisky-sponge-secret-speyside-2003-19-ye.bodyHtml:
This whisky comes from a major distillery, and that's all you need to know dammit! 

Having said that, we can tell you that this whisky was distilled in 2003 from an unusual batch of very lightly peated malt, matured in a refill hogshead for 19 years and then bottled, under our instruction, at natural cask strength. 

It is delicious and outrageously top secret! Please do not attempt to decipher the clues on the label to determine what distillery this whisky is from, they have been set to 'Dan Brown novel' level of impenetrability, you would only embarrass yourself. 

Please immediately purchase this bottle and destroy all evidence with your face hole! 

Yours under dense encryption

whisky-sponge-saillt-mor-2014a-8-year.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.73A Saillt Mor 2014 8 Year Old 57.1% ABV
whisky-sponge-saillt-mor-2014a-8-year.bodyHtml:
This whisky from German distiller Ralf Hauer really impressed us with its power, purity and vivid peat flavours. German whisky with a decidedly Scottish accent.  

This was distilled in 2014 and filled into 1st fill bourbon barrels where it was matured for 8 years in Germany before transferring to the UK for bottling. We bottled this with a few degrees reduction to 57.1% to help the distillate character shine loud and clear.

Edition 73A was distilled using peated malt and presents a beautifully rugged and pure take on peat flavour, with breads, spices and smoky / salty notes in abundance.

whisky-sponge-saillt-mor-2014b-8-year.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No. 73B Saillt Mor 2014 8 Year Old 57.1% ABV
whisky-sponge-saillt-mor-2014b-8-year.bodyHtml:
This whisky from German distiller Ralf Hauer really impressed us with its power, purity and vivid peat flavours. German whisky with a decidedly Scottish accent.  

This was distilled in 2014 and filled into 1st fill bourbon barrels where it was matured for 8 years in Germany before transferring to the UK for bottling. We bottled this with a few degrees reduction to 57.1% to help the distillate character shine loud and clear.

Edition 73B was made using beechwood smoked German malt. It shows off a deeply herbal and medicinal style of smokiness with plenty of power and complexity as well.

whisky-sponge-ardmore-1997-24-year-52-4.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No.76 Ardmore 24 Year Old 1997 Refill Hogshead 52.4% ABV
whisky-sponge-ardmore-1997-24-year-52-4.bodyHtml:
Since the dawn of creation, conscious beings have been asking themselves one thing: why does Ardmore taste like the smelly matter you find in Scottish farmyards...? 

The answer to this question has eluded the greatest scientific minds in the cosmos. Mayans, Vulcans, Time Lords, Vogons and David Attenborough have all tried, and failed, to discover the pungent truth. 

All we can do is play Sponge scrabble and ruminate deeply and profoundly, on the sheer number of silly toilet-centric words you can invent in association with Ardmore and all its bum-scented glory. 

Please enjoy this extremely classical 25 year old Ardmore that has been matured full term in a withered old refill hogshead and bottled at natural cask strength, thus retaining its maximum dung-addled distillate potency.

Headily yours

Whisky Sponge 

PS: you may also be interested to compare this bottling with Whisky Sponge Edition No.69, which is also a highly delicious old Ardmore, except that one is drenched in sticky, dark, gooey old sherry. Why not buy both of them and guzzle both bottles simultaneously at a festive dinner party? Enjoy the looks upon your friends and family's faces as you cackle, splutter and gurgle your way through the bottles. Thrill to their gasping intakes of breath as the viscous nectars drizzle and blend their way in rivulets down your chin and pool upon the platters of partially consumed pigs in blankets... Just an idea.

equinox-solstice-mortlach-10-year-48-5.title: Decadent Drinks Equinox & Solstice Winter 2022 Edition Mortlach 10 Year Old 2012 48.5% ABV
equinox-solstice-mortlach-10-year-48-5.bodyHtml:
To close out our 2022 series of Equinox & Solstice we've selected this gorgeous, velvety and rich 10 year old Mortlach. It was distilled in 2012, matured initially in refill hogsheads and then double matured in a 1st fill sherry butt for over two years. As always with this series, we've bottled it at our favourite dramming strength of 48.5%. 

For most of us, when we think of whisky and winter, our minds go to dark and delectably sherried whiskies. That's exactly what we've tried to deliver with this year's Equinox & Solstice winter edition. It's a beautifully deep, rich, silky and satisfyingly thick sherry bomb. Full of that typical Mortlach meat and sinew, but capped with some wonderful and classic sherry flavours of walnut oil, dark chocolate, freshly roasted coffee and fruit scented pipe tobaccos. 

A modern sherry profile that is robust, clean, rich and hugely satisfying for sipping by the fire with words, music, company - or all three.

whisky-sponge-springbank-1994-27-year-47.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.60A Springbank 1994 27 Year Old 47% ABV
whisky-sponge-springbank-1994-27-year-47.bodyHtml:
A single cask of 1994 Springbank, matured full term in a refill sherry hogshead and bottled at natural cask strength of 47%. 

A special bottling featuring flavours of the olden days, when everything was better in newspapers and imaginations. 

Sip it and feel yourself drawn irrevocably into the warm, comforting supermassive black hole of nostalgia that sits at the galactic core of all whisky thought and holds our culture together.

whisky-sponge-ben-nevis-1996-25-year-53.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No. 58A Ben Nevis 25 Year Old 1996 Refill Butt 53% ABV
whisky-sponge-ben-nevis-1996-25-year-53.bodyHtml:
This is a hyper-distillate driven, almost ideologically 'refill' profile Ben Nevis 1996. You have been warned! 

However, for those of you who also enjoy this extremely pure, naked and invigorating style of highland malt whisky - you shall find yourself contorted with satisfaction. 

For this edition, the Sponge interviews his older self about his successes, failures and unrequited vengeances. You'll have to wait until next year, when we bottle the other half of this cask, to find out what his answers are...

The first half of this stark-naked refill butt has been bottled reduced to 53% to bring out a slightly fruitier style on the palate. Next year we will likely do the rest at cask strength. If civilisation remains moderately intact. Stay tuned...

whisky-sponge-highland-malt-1993a-44-7.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No. 58A Ben Nevis 25 Year Old 1996 Refill Butt 53% ABV
whisky-sponge-highland-malt-1993a-44-7.bodyHtml:
This is a hyper-distillate driven, almost ideologically 'refill' profile Ben Nevis 1996. You have been warned! 

However, for those of you who also enjoy this extremely pure, naked and invigorating style of highland malt whisky - you shall find yourself contorted with satisfaction. 

For this edition, the Sponge interviews his older self about his successes, failures and unrequited vengeances. You'll have to wait until next year, when we bottle the other half of this cask, to find out what his answers are...

The first half of this stark-naked refill butt has been bottled reduced to 53% to bring out a slightly fruitier style on the palate. Next year we will likely do the rest at cask strength. If civilisation remains moderately intact. Stay tuned...

whisky-sponge-secret-islay-1990-51-abv.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.61 Islay 1990 31 Year Old 51% Abv
whisky-sponge-secret-islay-1990-51-abv.bodyHtml:
Whisky Sponge Edition No.61 is a single refill barrel of 1990 Islay Single Malt. 

Featuring a slightly more thoughtful label themed around memory, family and the future, this is probably as close as we'll get to bottling named whisky from 'that' particular southern Islay distillery. We opted to bottle this cask at natural cask strength as we felt it was just perfect as it came from the wood. Wonderfully fresh, coastal and peaty with tang of green and exotic fruits in the mix that hark back to a slightly older style example of this great Islay make.

rum-sponge-caroni-1998-22-year-60-2-abv.title: Rum Sponge Edition No.16 Caroni 1998 24 Year Old
rum-sponge-caroni-1998-22-year-60-2-abv.bodyHtml:
Another rather luscious cask of Caroni that pairs the glorious flavours of tarred black olives and rueful cubism. 

This single barrel of Caroni was distilled in 1998, underwent around 5 years growing up in the tropics, went on holiday to the UK, and never came back. 

We opted to bottle this one at natural cask strength because it was lovely, just as it is. We hope you enjoy it in a suitably wistful and pensive fashion.

rum-sponge-barbados-2000-22-year-47-6.title: Rum Sponge Edition No.18 Barbados 2000 22 Year Old
rum-sponge-barbados-2000-22-year-47-6.bodyHtml:
A single refill barrel of Barbados rum, distilled in 2000 and matured for 22 years before bottling at natural cask strength of 47.6%. 

The label for this edition celebrates the blissful joy that is Teams and Zoom meetings, which we have all discovered and come to love during the pandemic. It is also a helpful guide to identifying this rum's distillery of origin, given that the label is made up of four squares. 

This is a sibling cask to Rum Sponge edition 14 and, like that one, is decidedly easy and approachable while still displaying richness of character and depth. The nose is highly exotic with tinned tropical fruits in syrup, while the palate shows firm oak spices, medicines and fresh bread notes. Luscious, easy and super pleasurable! 

Why not pour a significant measure into a coffee cup and gently melt away over the course of a two hour virtual strategy meeting. Responsibly, of course.

ruffino-alauda-2015.title: Ruffino Alauda 2021
ruffino-alauda-2015.bodyHtml:
Ruffino Alauda 2021 is an elegant, full-bodied Super Tuscan crafted at the Tenuta Poggio Casciano estate. Made primarily from Cabernet Franc and Merlot, it undergoes 24 months of aging in French oak barriques to produce a deeply structured, harmoniously balanced profile. In the glass, it displays a dark ruby red color with violet overtones, yielding aromas of dark plum, wild blackberry, espresso, crushed lavender, and toasted cedar wood. The palate delivers a concentration of dark berry fruit framed by firm, velvety tannins, balanced acidity, and tertiary accents of balsamic, tobacco, and cocoa that linger on a refined, mouthwatering finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, wild boar pappardelle, braised short ribs, roasted lamb shoulder, and aged Pecorino cheese.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This youthfully exuberant red exudes ripe blackberry, black cherry, fruitcake, iron and toasty oak aromas and flavors. Vibrant and well-stocked, with firm, dense tannins, this extends on the finish, where the oak spice lingers. Cabernet Franc and Merlot. Best from 2027 through 2035. 

92 Points - James Suckling

An intense nose of burnt spices, toasted cedar, walnuts and ripe dark and blue fruit. Full-bodied and deep, with a firm tannin frame around a core of succulent berry fruit layered with nut and bitter spice flavors. A little chewy at the end. Try from 2026.

lone-river-ranchrita-blood-orange.title: Lone River Ranchrita Blood Orange 4 Cans

laws-cask-strength-rye-whiskey.title: Laws San Luis Valley Straight Rye Whiskey Cask Strength
laws-cask-strength-rye-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Laws San Luis Valley Straight Rye Whiskey Cask Strength is the full-proof version of the flagship rye from Laws Whiskey House in Colorado. It is distilled from 100% heirloom rye, a low-yield, semi-wild grain the Cody family has grown at 7,400 feet in the San Luis Valley since the 1930s. The distillery selects and marries individual barrels, each aged more than four years in new 53-gallon oak, and bottles them at cask strength to show the full force of this terroir-driven grain. This batch is bottled at 60.55% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Citrus, baking spice and golden raisin, with bright mint, fresh grass and tropical fruit.

Nose: Citrus, baking spice and golden raisin.

Palate: Bright mint, fresh grass and tropical fruit.

Serve: Neat; at this strength a few drops of water help open it up.

lone-river-ranchrita-classic-margarita.title: Lone River Ranchrita Blood Orange 4 Cans

white-claw-surf-variety-pack-12pk.title: White Claw Surf Variety Pack 12 Cans

white-claw-surf-citrus-yuzu.title: White Claw Surf Citrus Yuzu 6 Cans

midleton-very-rare-irish-whiskey.title: Midleton Very Rare Irish Whiskey 2025
midleton-very-rare-irish-whiskey.bodyHtml:
Midleton Very Rare Irish Whiskey 2025 is the 42nd release in the prestigious annual vintage series from Midleton Distillery, celebrating the peak of Irish whiskey blending mastery. Master Distiller Kevin O'Gorman selected exceptional single pot still and single grain Irish whiskeys aged between 12 and 33 years in lightly charred ex-bourbon American oak barrels. This expression balances rich orchard fruit notes, delicate floral tones, and warm oak spices, delivering an exceptionally smooth, complex, and memorable tasting experience.

Food Pairing: Roasted duck breast, aged Gouda, dark chocolate truffles, crème brûlée, or glazed pork belly.

Tasting Notes : Luminous honeyed gold hue with a silky, rich, and velvety mouthfeel on the palate.

Nose : Ripe green apples, sweet pears, vanilla bean, floral blossom, toasted oak, honeyed malt, and gentle nutmeg spice.

Palate : Smooth and complex with layers of orchard fruits, candied orange peel, butterscotch, creamy vanilla, toasted coconut, and warm clove spice.

Finish : Exceptionally long, warm, and elegant with persistent sweet fruitiness, gentle oak tannins, and lingering baking spices.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a tulip glass, or with a few drops of pure water to open up the delicate aromas.

veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-rose-90.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut Rose 1989
veuve-clicquot-brut-cave-privee-rose-90.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Cave Privée Brut Rosé 1989 is a rare, mature prestige Champagne crafted predominantly from Grand and Premier Cru vineyards in the Montagne de Reims, Grande Vallée de la Marne, and Côte des Blancs. Aged for over two decades in the house's historic chalk cellars, it displays a copper-gold hue with pale salmon undertones. The nose opens with aromas of dried apricots, candied orange peel, saffron, roasted nuts, and warm brioche. On the palate, it exhibits a rich, velvety texture balanced by fine-grained minerality and vibrant acidity, leading to a complex, long finish with notes of dried red berries, spice, and toasted almonds.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck breast, pan-seared squab, wild mushroom risotto, grilled lobster, or aged Comté cheese.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This very pale rosé has the richness of toast and croissant that comes from complete maturity. It also features fresh hints of the red and white fruits that were present during the wine's younger years. This is ready to drink now.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich and creamy, this is aging gracefully. The finely tuned acidity and lightly beaded texture provide an elegant frame for the layers of coffee liqueur, toasted almond, cherry bonbon, iodine and orange peel flavors. The long finish is tinged subtly with smoky mineral. Disgorged October 2008.

borgogno-barolo-fossati-docg.title: Borgogno Barolo Fossati 2019
borgogno-barolo-fossati-docg.bodyHtml:
This cru originated around 6 million years ago through sedimentation from the Padano sea, after which the African earth plates collided with those of the Italian peninsula. Being a relatively young plot, it has a good percentage of sand in its composition that ensures that the wines are characterized by explosive floral and red fruit notes. It can be found along the secondary road that runs from Barolo to La Morra. This vineyard measures around 3.20 hectares with a south-eastern exposure that varies from 290 to 50 meters above sea level.

Barolo goes well with important dishes, such as traditional Piedmontese meat main courses. Ranging from world traditions, there is gulasch in Eastern Europe. Going to Japan instead gyoza (fried dumplings stuffed with spring onion, marinated pork and spices). Moving to The United States of America, beef (angus, wagyu, bue nostral, longhorn) in the brisket cut. But if you have the pleasure, even a simple “special” toast is perfect!

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The well-crafted wine reveals a gradual opening of aromas of dark cherry, wild herbs, dried rose, mint and orange zest. The generous palate delights with ample mixed berry fruit, harmonized by notes of licorice, savory elements and oolong tea. Supple tannins and vibrant acidity captivate the palate on the finish. Drink 2025–2045.

orin-swift-8-years-in-the-desert-2.title: Orin Swift Cellars 8 Years In The Desert 2019 1.5L Magnum
orin-swift-8-years-in-the-desert-2.bodyHtml:
Zinfandel was blessed with ideal growing conditions across the state. Syrah and Petite Sirah also benefited from the growing season. Sourced from premier California growing regions, 8 Years in the Desert is a quintessential exemplar of drinkability, perceived sweetness and complexity.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Medium garnet-purple coloured, the 2019 Zinfandel Blend 8 Years in the Desert delivers notions of stewed plums, baked raspberries and fruitcake with hints of powdered cinnamon, clove oil, tree bark, hoisin and dusty soil. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is chock-full of ripe, spicy black and red fruits, supported by chewy tannins and tons of freshness, finishing long and earthy.

dom-perignon-brut-2.title: Dom Perignon P2 Plenitude 2006
dom-perignon-brut-2.bodyHtml:
Dom Pérignon Vintage 2006 Plénitude 2 reveals a soft, warm and reassuring sweet bouquet, rich in subtle nuances. Its aromatic profile boasts a remarkable finesse with floral and mineral tones. This composition rapidly unfolds to reveal delicate notes of wild peach, citron, calisson and mocha, creating a unique and memorable experience on the nose.

The palate of Dom Pérignon 2006 is full-bodied, both restrained and tender, developing into a thick texture that gradually becomes firmer. The complexity of the wine increases, revealing a subtly saline nuance. On the finish, an exquisite bitterness and wonderful maturity prevail, enriched by deep aromas of dried fruit, cocoa and toasted hazelnut, which blend harmoniously to offer an exceptional wine tasting experience.

Dom Pérignon Vintage 2006 Plénitude 2 is distinguished by its soft, warm character, ideally expressed when paired with seafood such as langoustine and scallops. This wine pairing harmony continues with veal and Jerusalem artichoke dishes, which highlight its delicate, enveloping nature. The flavours are further enhanced by herbs such as rosemary and basil, while hints of acidity from lemon and bergamot fully reveal its breadth and refined structure. This vintage illustrates Dom Pérignon’s ability to create fine wines that capture and enhance the essence of the ingredients with which they are served.

98 Points - Vinous

The 2006 Dom Perignon P2 is magnificent. Rich and soaring in its intensity, the P2 is absolutely stunning. What comes through most is the style of the year more than the style of the P2 series. Tangerine, apricot, mint, white pepper, passion fruit and spice all race out of the glass. The ripeness of the year is evident, but all the elements are so masterfully balanced. The balance of exoticness and freshness is just mind-blowing.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

A blonde bombshell of a Champagne, hedonistic with its alluring brioche, creamed cherry and glazed tangerine flavors that show embellishments of fragrant saffron, candied ginger, fennel seed and vanilla, yet there's lovely definition and focus via the racy, lemon-infused acidity and plush texture. Long and minerally on the finish, with the rich profile joined by a subtle undertow of smoke, oyster shell and brine. Drink now through 2040.

96 Points - Decanter

The P2 late-release concept does seem to work wonders with riper, heavier vintages, and 2006 is no exception. The sheer fruitiness of orange confit, juicy stone fruit, mango and roasted citrus has quietened a little into an integrated, honeyed and voluptuous whole, marked with ground coffee and baklava decadence of age yet held in check with a bitter citric snap, charry smokiness and a lick of tannic firmness rather than acidity.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2006 Dom Pérignon P2, crafted from a blend of 55% Pinot Noir and 45% Chardonnay with a modest dosage of 4.5 grams, is presenting exceptionally well at this stage. It unfurls a complex, deep bouquet of smoke, ripe orchard fruits, mango, exotic fruits and spices. Medium to full-bodied, rich and expressive, it’s harmonious and enveloping and has gained structure and tension compared to the initial 2006 Dom Pérignon, while the palate is perfectly balanced with delicate gastronomic bitterness and chalky dry extracts that contribute to its long, mineral-driven finish. It should go well with delicate fare. P2 is the acronym for the Plénitude 2 series, Dom Pérignon’s second life, indicating that bottles are kept by the house to let them age on the lees and to obtain different expressions of the same wine throughout its life, letting time work its magic and thus acquiring additional complexity.

krug-grande-cuvee-2.title: Krug Grande Cuvee 170eme 1.5L Magnum
krug-grande-cuvee-2.bodyHtml:
Krug Grande Cuvée 170ème Édition is an extraordinarily rich, elegant, and complex multi-vintage Champagne composed of 195 wines from 12 different years, spanning from 1998 to 2014. Crafted around the 2014 base harvest and blended with 45% reserve wines, it spent around seven years aging in Krug's cellars. In the glass, it shows a pale golden hue with fine, persistent effervescence, opening with captivating aromas of toasted brioche, lemon curd, candied citrus, honeysuckle, and dried fruits. On the palate, it delivers a silken, generous texture layered with flavours of ripe yellow orchard fruits, grapefruit pith, marzipan, and warm spices, perfectly balanced by a chiseled backbone of vibrant, mouthwatering acidity and a long, chalky, saline-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with fresh oysters, caviar, butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken with truffles, turbot, and rich semi-aged cheeses.

96 Points - James Suckling

This is full-bodied and very rich with lots of dried and fresh lemons with lemon curd and delicate Italian croissant. Fine and flavorful. Drink or hold.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The numbering indicates this is the 170th blending of this Champagne. This iteration has a fine poise—it's mature and toasty on the one hand and offers rich fruit on the other. It is a finely balanced wine that is ripe and full in the mouth. Drink this beautiful wine now. Roger Voss

tres-generaciones-reposado.title: Sauza Tres Generaciones Reposado Tequila
tres-generaciones-reposado.bodyHtml: Their Reposado Tequila is made from 100% blue agave. It is triple-distilled for smoothness, then rested in American Oak barrels for at least four months. Aromas of pepper, spice and herbs in balance with light oak character. Initial spiciness, with toasted oak, on a background of herbs and fresh agave on the palate. The finish is warm and dry with lingering white pepper.

koloa-coconut-rum.title: Kalani Coconut Rum Liqueur
koloa-coconut-rum.bodyHtml:
Kalani Coconut Rum Liqueur is a coconut liqueur from Casa D'Aristi on Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula, bottled at 30% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Casa D'Aristi is a family-owned distillery founded in 1935, and its name appears on the label alongside Yucatán, México. The house works with natural regional ingredients and makes Kalani from yellow dwarf coconuts harvested on its own 19th-century plantation at Oxtapacab, combined with pure sugar cane rum. The liqueur is clear, rich and velvety, with a syrupy texture in which coconut and almond sweetness is set against a peppery edge from the rum. The current bottle is labelled simply Kalani Coconut Liqueur.

Tasting Notes: Coconut, toasted macaroon, dark chocolate and caramel with a gentle rum spice.

Nose: Fresh desiccated coconut, toasted macaroon and dark chocolate, with crème caramel and citrus.

Palate: Velvety and syrupy, with coconut icing and almond sweetness against a peppery bite from the rum.

Finish: Long, elegant and fresh, with toasted coconut.

Serve: Chilled, over ice, or in tropical cocktails.

koloa-coffee-rum.title: Ron Zacapa Centenario Sistema Solera 23 Gran Reserva Rum
koloa-coffee-rum.bodyHtml:
Ron Zacapa Centenario Sistema Solera 23 Gran Reserva Rum is an ultra-premium, world-renowned dark rum that serves as a masterclass in high-altitude aging and intricate blending. Produced in the volcanic highlands of Guatemala, this iconic spirit is uniquely crafted from "virgin sugar cane honey"—the concentrated syrup from the first pressing of fresh sugar cane juice—rather than traditional molasses. The rum is then aged "above the clouds" at an altitude of 2,300 meters, where the cool mountain climate slows maturation and lowers evaporation. Utilizing a dynamic Sistema Solera fractional blending process, it marries rums aged between 6 and 23 years in a sequence of casks that previously held robust American whiskey, delicate Oloroso sherries, and sweet Pedro Ximénez dessert wines, culminating in a spirit of legendary smoothness, density, and multi-layered dessert-like complexity.

Food Pairing: This rich, deeply complex rum pairs magnificently with slow-braised meats like barbecued beef brisket, roasted duck breast, or glazed pork belly. It is also an unparalleled companion to rich desserts such as sticky toffee pudding, pecan pie, or artisanal dark chocolate truffles, and matches flawlessly with intense, salty blue cheeses like Roquefort or Stilton.

TASTING NOTES - A deep, rich mahogany amber with reddish copper highlights. The texture is immensely full-bodied, unctuous, and heavily mouth-coating with a luxurious, liqueur-like viscosity.

NOSE - Soft, incredibly sweet, and highly inviting. Pronounced aromas of buttery caramel, vanilla fudge, and dark cocoa are beautifully intertwined with toasted hazelnuts, caramelized Brazil nuts, dried banana, and a rich, sherried wave of plump raisins and dates.

PALATE - Complex, generous, and perfectly rounded. A sweet, decadent entry of honeyed malt, dark brown sugar, and molasses transitions into deep layers of dried figs, apricots, and milk chocolate, beautifully balanced by a warming mid-palate of savory oak, tobacco leaf, nutmeg, and ginger spice.

FINISH - Exceptionally long, smooth, and warming. The heavy molasses and chocolate sweetness gently recede, leaving a sophisticated, lingering trail of dry oak spice, honeyed butterscotch, and a faint hint of roasted coffee.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat or over a single large, slow-melting ice sphere in a spirits snifter or a premium rocks glass to appreciate its full structural depth. Its bold character also makes it an extraordinary, ultra-premium base for an elevated Old Fashioned or a Rum Manhattan.

tapatio-tequila-reposado.title: Tapatio Reposado Tequila
tapatio-tequila-reposado.bodyHtml:
Aged 4-6 months in American white oak barrels, previously used in ageing Bourbon.

Pale straw yellow color; luminous, with golden and slightly greenish tones. Medium bodied due to its lower alcoholic content. Fruity, intense cooked Agave, apple, pear, vanilla and caramel, slightly smoky. White pepper comes in a subtle form. Allowed to breath it becomes creamy with hints of butter. Spices such as clove and sandalwood.

The sweetness of the cooked Agave flavors predominate; herbal, pepper, slightly smoked with notes of caramel, cocoa, vanilla and nuts (walnut, peanut, hazelnut). A very soft & smooth, yet spicy finish.

A very well balanced tequila between the spicy and the sweet flavors. Perfect for a Margarita cocktail, but also to enjoy neat or on the rocks.

jayson-suavignon-blanc.title: Jayson Sauvignon Blanc 2020
jayson-suavignon-blanc.bodyHtml:
This wine reveals classic Napa Sauvignon Blanc expression with fresh aromas of pineapple, white peach, grapefruit, and ripe goldenberries, as well as intriguing hints of cool slate and lime zest. The complex fruit carries over onto a soft, rich palate balanced with firm acidity.

92 Points - James Suckling
A fresh, tangy white with aromas of grapefruit, lime zest, guava and fresh herbs. It’s medium-bodied with crisp acidity. Zesty, flinty finish. Drink now.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

The white is light and airy, but with a core of peach and citrus flavors that show lots of intensity, backed by hints of marmalade and candied ginger, plus plenty of mouthwatering acidity. Drink now.

rabbit-hole-dareringer.title: Rabbit Hole Dareringer Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Pedro Ximenez Sherry Casks
rabbit-hole-dareringer.bodyHtml:
Rabbit Hole 'Dareringer' Kentucky Straight Bourbon is an exceptionally elegant, ultra-premium wheated bourbon that stands out for its unique, artisanal finishing process. Crafted in Louisville, Kentucky, this expression utilizes a smooth, rye-free mashbill where wheat serves as the flavoring grain to create a soft, approachable core. After initial maturation in hand-selected, toasted and charred new American oak barrels, the bourbon is transferred to fine Spanish Pedro Ximénez (PX) sherry casks from Casknolia cooperage for a luxurious secondary aging period. This double-cask maturation infuses the traditional, sweet corn foundations of the bourbon with deep, decadent dark fruit and nutty layers, resulting in a beautifully complex and distinct sensory experience.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with dark chocolate flourless cake, dry-aged ribeye steak, artisanal charcuterie boards featuring prosciutto and figs, warm pecan pie, or aged Gouda cheese.

Tasting Notes : Deep ruby amber in appearance with a velvety, rich, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Aromatic and complex with scents of sweet sherry, dried dark fruits, raisin, toasted oak, and soft vanilla.

Palate : Smooth and decadent, featuring flavors of sweet plum, marzipan, caramel, brown sugar, and warm cinnamon spice.

Finish : Long, warm, and satisfying with lingering notes of dried fruit, toasted oak, and subtle sherry sweetness.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn or rocks glass, on the rocks, or as the foundation for a luxury Old Fashioned.

mouton-cadet-rose.title: Mouton Cadet Rose 750ml
mouton-cadet-rose.bodyHtml:
On the nose opens on fresh red fruit aromas such as raspberry and redcurrant, joined with airing by touches of strawberry and mint. A supple and very fresh attack dominated by the same fruit as on the nose leads into a rich and elegant mid-palate and a lingering finish full of freshness and fruit.

Merlot: 86%, Cabernet Sauvignon: 12%, Cabernet Franc: 2% Red fruits aromas, structured and powered, refinement and elegance. Maturity in vats on fine lees for four to five months.

86 Points - James Suckling
A simple, dry rosé with light notes of strawberry and citrus. Crisp and clean, it's an easy-drinking, uncomplicated wine for casual occasions.
85 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This rosé offers straightforward red berry flavors and a refreshing profile. A reliable, mass-market option for picnics or apéritifs.

krug-clos-dambonnay-1995.title: Krug Clos D'Ambonnay 1995
krug-clos-dambonnay-1995.bodyHtml:
Krug Clos d’Ambonnay was born from the fifth generation of the Krug family, Rémi and Henri Krug’s quest to pay tribute to the Pinot Noir grapes of Ambonnay, a terroir dear to the Maison, while remaining loyal founder Joseph Krug’s plot-by-plot approach to winemaking.

Krug Clos d’Ambonnay is a rare gem epitomising the attention to detail, uncompromising quality and appreciation for unique terroirs inherited from Joseph Krug.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 1995 Brut Blanc de Noirs Clos d’Ambonnay is simply profound from the very first sip. Totally rich and seductive, the 1995 Clos d’Ambonnay is a wine that will stimulate the intellectual and hedonistic senses to the maximum. In a word, it is divine. The 1995 Clos d’Ambonnay is hard to resist today, but it should continue to develop positively in bottle for a number of years

top-shelf-saskatoon-berry-pie.title: Top Shelf Saskatoon Berry Pie
top-shelf-saskatoon-berry-pie.bodyHtml:
Top Shelf Saskatoon Berry Pie Liquor belongs to the Taste of Canada Dessert Liquor line from Top Shelf Distillers in Perth, Ontario. It celebrates a Western Canadian tradition: the Saskatoon berry pie, made with rare prairie berries harvested only in July and prized for their sweet, earthy, almond-like character. Its key ingredients are Saskatoon berries, pie crust, sugar, flour, butter and lemon, for a balance of sweet and tart. Bottled at 17% ABV in a 375ml bottle.

Serve: Chilled, over ice, or with soda.

wild-common-still-strength-blanco.title: Wild Common Blanco Still Strength Tequila
wild-common-still-strength-blanco.bodyHtml: Wild Common still strength tequila blanco is an honest expression of agave with nothing to hide. Clean, bold agave flavors dominate this exceptional tequila blanco. Bright citrus, cinnamon, and anise lead the way while the velvety mouthfeel envelopes your palate. Long, warm, and complex, this tequila is for agave purists with the highest of standards. At 50% Alc./Vol., our team has unanimously chosen to 2x distill this tequila blanco to proof and not add any water. Master distiller Salvador Rosales Trejo - aka “Chava”, has flexed his lifetime of experience here. Salud.

lone-river-ranchrita-blood-orange-1.title: Lone River Ranchrita Blood Orange 4 Cans

social-lite-cream-soda-seltzer.title: Wild Thing Hard Orange Cream Soda

ole-smoky-banana-pudding-cream-moonshine.title: Ole Smoky Banana Pudding Cream Moonshine
ole-smoky-banana-pudding-cream-moonshine.bodyHtml:
A luxuriously creamy, dessert-forward creation that brings a Southern potluck classic straight to your glass! Crafted in the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee, this decadent spirit blends Ole Smoky’s signature, smooth-sipping corn whiskey with the rich, indulgent flavors of real dairy cream, crushed vanilla wafers, and sweet banana. It is a wildly creative take on flavored moonshine that drinks more like a premium cream liqueur.

Bottled at 35 proof (17.5% ABV), the texture is thick, velvety, and completely coats the palate. Lush, authentic flavors of whipped cream and ripe banana puree are perfectly rounded out by a distinct, baked-vanilla-wafer finish. It is an absolute showstopper when served over ice, blended into a boozy milkshake, or splashed into your weekend coffee.

blackwell-rum-007-limited-edition.title: Emperor Limited Edition London Bridge Rum
blackwell-rum-007-limited-edition.bodyHtml:
Emperor London Bridge Rum is a Mauritian rum from the Emperor range. Emperor creates its rums by blending Mauritian distillates made from both fresh sugar cane juice and molasses, produced on column and traditional pot stills, then matures them in oak casks, with some expressions given an additional finish in wine or fortified-wine casks. London Bridge is bottled at 40% ABV in a 700 ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, over ice or in a classic rum cocktail.

la-crema-sonoma-pinot-noir.title: La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2022/2023
la-crema-sonoma-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir is an elegant, medium-bodied red wine that perfectly captures the cool-climate maritime influence of California's coastal vineyards. The nose is incredibly fragrant, offering inviting aromas of macerated red cherry, red plum, cranberry, and delicate hints of forest floor, mushroom, and cinnamon spice. On the palate, it delivers concentrated layers of ripe raspberry, black cherry, and cocoa, beautifully accented by savory touches of cold black tea and a hint of fresh mint. Supported by vibrant, pithy acidity and fine, plush tannins, this well-structured Pinot Noir offers a smooth, generous mouthfeel that leads into a long, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing: Enjoy with grilled salmon, roasted duck, veal medallions, roasted pork loin, mushroom risotto, braised lamb, or chicken stuffed with goat cheese.

banff-ice-vodka-1.title: Banff Ice Vodka 1.75L
banff-ice-vodka-1.bodyHtml:
Banff Ice Vodka is a Canadian grain vodka from Alberta Distillers in Calgary, presented here in the 1.75L PET (plastic) bottle format at 40% ABV. The distillery describes it as triple distilled and cold filtered for smoothness, made with locally sourced Canadian grain and Banff glacial spring water from the Rocky Mountains. The style is clean and crisp rather than neutral to the point of blandness, with a soft, slightly creamy texture. Banff Ice took silver medals at the SIP Awards, the International Spirits Challenge and the San Francisco World Spirits Competition in 2022. A dependable house vodka for mixed drinks, Caesars and chilled shots.

Tasting Notes: Crystal clear; caramel, vanilla and strawberry mousse over a gentle white-pepper spice.

Nose: Caramel and vanilla with a touch of creaminess.

Palate: Strawberry mousse, vanilla and candy floss, soft white pepper and light chocolate tones.

Finish: Long and silky with vanilla, white pepper and a hint of dark cocoa.

Serve: Well chilled, or as the base for a Caesar, vodka soda or martini.

gp-cold-ones-beer.title: Gp Brewing Cold One'S Strong 15 Cans

gp-cold-ones-strong-beer.title: Gp Brewing Cold One'S Strong 15 Cans

kah-tequila-anejo.title: Kah Anejo Tequila
kah-tequila-anejo.bodyHtml:
KAH Tequila Añejo is made from 100% Blue Agave and is aged in American Oak casks for at least 12 months, bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

The black bottle design is inspired by the Nicaraguan tradition of Day of the Dead. In Nicaragua, in addition to the standard traditions of building a shrine and gift-giving, many people linger and sleep in the graveyard. They believe that this act re-enforces the emotional connection between them and the deceased.

gp-whisky.title: The Glen Grant 12 Year Old
gp-whisky.bodyHtml:
The Glen Grant 12 Year Old is a remarkably bright, elegant, and award-winning single malt Scotch whisky that beautifully showcases the classic, fruit-forward style of the Speyside region. Crafted at the historic Rothes distillery under the long-standing guidance of legendary Master Distiller Dennis Malcolm, this expression is distilled using the distillery's famously tall, slender pot stills equipped with unique cooling purifiers. This distinctive design captures only the lightest, most delicate vapors during distillation. Matured for a full dozen years exclusively in high-quality ex-bourbon casks, the resulting spirit balances Speyside's signature orchard fruit character with rich layers of vanilla and oak, offering a highly approachable yet sophisticated dram.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken or pork medallions with an apple glaze, light creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert, smoked salmon crostini, or lemon curd tarts.

Tasting Notes : A bright, polished golden straw color with a light-to-medium body and an exceptionally clean, crisp, and silky texture on the palate.

Nose : Fresh, vibrant, and orchard-forward, opening with distinct aromas of ripe green apples, honeyed pears, and citrus zest, beautifully complemented by notes of vanilla fudge, toasted almonds, and a light herbal undertone.

Palate : Soft and highly balanced on the tongue, delivering dominant flavors of sweet caramel, vanilla cream, and apple pie spice, layered with subtle hints of rich malt, honey, and soft oak tannins.

Finish : Medium in length, clean, and pleasantly dry, resolving smoothly with lingering notes of warm wood spice, soft vanilla, and a trailing hint of citrus fruit.

Serve : Best enjoyed neat or with a tiny splash of pure spring water in a classic Glencairn glass at room temperature, or served over a single large ice cube to enhance its bright fruit notes.

peller-family-pinot-grigio-1.title: Peller Family Vineyards Pinot Grigio 200ml
peller-family-pinot-grigio-1.bodyHtml:
Easy drinking, refreshing white wine, sourced from vineyards in Canada and around the world. Shows aromas of cantaloupe, yellow berries and pear with a hint of chocolate. Extra dry, medium-bodied with refreshing melon, berries and pear flavours. Perfect for casual sipping or pair with light fare, salads and appetizers.

85 points Wine Enthusiast

ruinart-r-de-ruinart.title: Ruinart Brut Blanc de Blancs
ruinart-r-de-ruinart.bodyHtml:
A supple, harmonious attack on the palate, firm but rounded. A voluptuous texture and vinosity that is not excessive, supported by excellent freshness. A very refreshing mineral finish.

At first very intense on the nose, giving way to fresh fruit notes, particularly ripe citrus and exotic fruits (pineapple). A highly refined floral second nose with notes of linden and white fruits (white peach).

Beautiful pale yellow color with glints of gold and green, a vibrant, luminous color. Active effervescence with a fine, persistent release of bubbles.

Ruinart Blanc de Blancs is a champagne for all occasions: aperitifs, lunch, dinner or celebratory meals. The vivacity is a perfect complement to seafood and white fish, pairing perfectly with dishes such as sea scallop carpaccio and sea bream tartare.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ruinart is a specialist in Blanc de Blancs Champagne. This wine is finely balanced between maturity and taut fresh, mineral-driven fruit.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A toasty blanc de blanc with an aromatic overtone of smoke and lemon peel notes accenting flavors of poached apricot, brioche, passion fruit coulis and fresh thyme. Fine and creamy in texture, with a racy finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Lemon tart, grapefruit and almonds on the nose, followed by a rounded, silky palate with soft bubbles. Pretty lemon curd and vanilla flavors to close.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Based on the 2019 vintage and disgorged in 2022, Ruinart's newly released NV Blanc de Blancs bursts with characteristically reductive aromas of yellow orchard fruit, citrus oil, iodine and toasted bread. Medium-bodied, pillowy and fleshy, with lively acids and a saline finish, it is an attractive Champagne that incorporates 20% reserve wines.

veuve-clicquot-demi-sec.title: Veuve Clicquot Brut
veuve-clicquot-demi-sec.bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label manages to reconcile two opposing factors, strength and silkiness and to hold them in perfect balance with aromatic intensity and a lot of freshness. With golden yellow tiny bubbles, this non-vintage Champagne shows the fruitiness of peach, Mirabelle plum, and pear alongside notes of vanilla and toasted brioche. This consistent power to please makes it ideal as an aperitif, and perfect as the Champagne to enjoy with a meal.

92 Points - James Suckling

This has aromas of grapefruit, citrus peel, quince, toast and almonds. It’s medium-bodied with creamy, fine tannins. Silky texture. Nutty complexity at the end.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Lively, with tangy acidity and a zesty mousse, this aperitif-style Champagne shows notes of mandarin orange, blackberry, toast and a touch of pastry cream. Subtle, smoke-tinged finish. Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay. Drink now.

tailgunner-dame-dorthey-hazy-pale-ale.title: Tailgunner Dame Dorthey Hazy Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans
tailgunner-dame-dorthey-hazy-pale-ale.bodyHtml: Tailgunner Dame Dorthey Hazy Pale Ale 4 Tall Cans

tailgunner-linton-stephenson-czech-pilsn.title: Tailgunner Linton Stephenson Czech Pilsn 4 Tall Cans
tailgunner-linton-stephenson-czech-pilsn.bodyHtml: Tailgunner Linton Stephenson Czech Pilsn 4 Tall Cans

two-stacks-12-year-single-grain-moscato.title: Two Stacks 12 Year Single Grain Moscato Finish Irish Whiskey
two-stacks-12-year-single-grain-moscato.bodyHtml:
Two Stacks 12 Year Old Single Grain Moscato is an Irish single grain whiskey from Two Stacks, the modern Irish whiskey bonder. Twelve-year-old grain whiskey has been matured with Moscato wine cask influence and bottled at a powerful 62.5% ABV in a 700ml bottle, making it a high-strength sipper for fans of wine-cask Irish whiskey.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

jack-daniels-twice-barreled-special-rele.title: Jack Daniel's Twice Barreled Special Release
jack-daniels-twice-barreled-special-rele.bodyHtml: Our fifth annual special release is here - Jack Daniel’s Twice Barreled 2022 Special Release American Single Malt Whiskey finished in Oloroso Sherry Casks. This year’s special release celebrates a brand new grain bill from the Jack Daniel Distillery - 100% malted barley. This is a one-of-a-kind experience crafted from the highest quality malted barley, charcoal mellowed, and twice barreled for a complex taste. This special release is first aged in brand new, American white oak barrels and then finished in the finest Oloroso sherry casks and bottled in its truest form, straight from the  cask, with the proof ranging from 106.1-107.8.

kujira-15-year-old-japanese-whisky.title: Kujira Ryukyu 15 Year Old Japanese Whisky
kujira-15-year-old-japanese-whisky.bodyHtml:
Kujira Ryukyu 15 Year Old Single Grain Japanese Whisky is distilled from 100% premium rice and matured in Sherry, Bourbon and American White Oak Casks for more than 15 years, giving a mellow taste and silky texture to this exquisite whisky. The subtropical climate in Okinawa provides a warm and humid storage condition that accelerates the maturation process. This environment creates subtle fruity and botanical flavors with intense texture, enhancing the uniqueness of Ryukyu Whisky.

Nose: Dried plums, candied fruits, with mints and chocolate aromas.
Palate: Sweet elements such as chocolate, vanilla, and honey giving a pleasant taste, followed with spices, slight smoky flavors and toasty breads.
Finish: Remarkably smooth, slightly sweet licorice and peppery texture develops into a clean and long finish.

Distillery: Masahiro Distillery

anciano-no-10-rioja-gran-reserva.title: Anciano Rioja Gran Reserva No.10 2016 750ml
anciano-no-10-rioja-gran-reserva.bodyHtml: Bright red wine with garnet rim, turning to brick, showing its extended ageing in barrels and bottle. Complex aromas of mature dark fruit, vanilla and cinnamon spice with mineral notes. It has a velvety smooth texture with a harmonious long finish, fresh and a delicious balsamic character. Ageing potential 10-15 years. Suitable for Vegetarians and Vegans.

kanekou-new-born-series-1.title: Kanekou Okinawa Japanese Whisky
kanekou-new-born-series-1.bodyHtml: Kanekou Whisky is a new one-of-a-kind Okinawan whisky produced by Shinzato Distillery. Blended with three types of whisky – malt, wheat whisky aged three or more years, and rice whisky aged in sherry casks for eight or more years. This original blend gives rise to an aromatic and rounded taste with aromas of tropical fruits and flavours with notes of citrus, ginger candy and minerals.

whisky-sponge-old-orkney-2005-ed-2-55.title: Orkney Sponge Edition OO2 Old Orkney 2005 16 Year Old 55% ABV
whisky-sponge-old-orkney-2005-ed-2-55.bodyHtml:
Orkney Sponge 2 is a single refill hogshead of 2005, 16 year old Orkney single malt whisky, bottled with a few degrees reduction at 55%. 

Another fresh, blustery and tasty expression of Orkney malt, wrapped up in some vintage Old Orkney tribute labelling and bottled at a strength that we felt balanced approachability with power! 

Please enjoy this whisky furtively inside a damp Broch. Thank you.

whisky-sponge-secret-islay-1990-50-6-ab.title: Islay Sponge Part 1 1990 31 Year Old
whisky-sponge-secret-islay-1990-50-6-ab.bodyHtml:
Introducing the first in a new, limited mini-series called Islay Sponge. A celebration of all things whacky and wonderful about Islay and it's tasty whiskies. 

This is a single refill barrel of 1990 unnamed Islay single malt - although it is almost certainly from a distillery on the south shore of the Island. It's peaty, coastal and fruity in all the right ways! 

Part 1 features the legendary Jackie T and a youthful, side-burned Sponge.

masseto-massetino-2020.title: Masseto Massetino 2020
masseto-massetino-2020.bodyHtml:
The high quality potential perceived when tasting the grapes before harvesting is reflected in the qualitative expression of Massetino 2020. A wine characterised by integrity, crispness and brilliant colours. The aromas are immediately memorable for their persistence and fullness. Vibrant, young and evolving tannins keep the palate alive with tenacity. Massetino 2020 is as powerful as the vintage in which it was born.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The Masseto 2020 Massetino (Merlot with a touch of Cabernet Franc) is extremely generous and rich. This wine puts it all out there in full view with a bouquet that is stitched together with ripe blackberry and black cherry preserves, black stone or pencil shaving, sweet spice, cigar, smoke and tar. This was a warm and sunny vintage, and you feel the power of those sunbeams locked within the dark, opulent and concentrated fruit on display here. This is a special treat, and the 2020 edition offers a clear identity for Massetino. This vintage comes close to out-powering the bouquet of the 2019 Masseto also hitting the market now.

95 Points - James Suckling

Very floral and perfumed with red fruits and hints of sandalwood. Medium body, very fresh and fine yet open grained. Crisp and long. Hard not to drink now. But better in three or four years when it comes together.

patron-gran-piedra-1.title: Gran Patron Piedra Extra Anejo Tequila
patron-gran-piedra-1.bodyHtml:
Gran Patrón Piedra is an extra añejo tequila from Patrón, named after the Spanish word for stone because it is made exclusively with the traditional tahona process, in which a heavy volcanic stone wheel crushes the cooked agave. Patrón describes it as one of very few tequilas still produced only this way. Made from 100% Weber Blue agave from the Jalisco Highlands, it is aged for four years in a combination of French Limousin oak and new American oak barrels, giving a deep mahogany colour. It is presented in a crystal decanter with a gift box. 40% ABV, 750ml.

Tasting Notes: Earthy and velvety with vanilla, caramel, nutmeg and apple.

Nose: Toasted coconut, sweet potato and dried apple with a hint of toasted French oak.

Palate: Subtly earthy with a velvety texture, vanilla, caramel and nutmeg.

Serve: Neat or on the rocks.

rest-be-thankful-finglassie-2017.title: Rest & Be Thankful Finglassie 2017
rest-be-thankful-finglassie-2017.bodyHtml:
"The name Rest & Be Thankful comes from the inscription on a stone made by soldiers who built a military road in 1753 in the West coast of Scotland; the road out of Glen Croe was so long and so steep that it was traditional for travellers to rest at the top and be thankful for having reached the highest point."

The Finglassie was distilled at the Lowlands, Inchdairnie Distillery - which is located in the Kingdom of Fife on the east side of Scotland. The distillery began distilling in 2016, contributing the Finglassie to Rest & Be Thankful. Finglassie is described as a memorable Single Malt Scotch Whisky allowing the exploration of the different faces of Peat. This non-coloured, non-chill filtered whisky was aged in ex-Islay bourbon casks and finished in Sherry Butts. Total worldwide out turn was: 5899 bottles. 

Nose: Vegetal peat, bonfire smoke and spices.

Palate: Lemon, sherried orange, smoke.

Finish: Dark Chocolate and cereals.

rest-be-thankful-bruichladdich-2004.title: Rest & Be Thankful Bruichladdich 2004
rest-be-thankful-bruichladdich-2004.bodyHtml:
Bruichladdich 17 Year Old 2004 is a single cask Islay single malt bottled by the independent bottler Rest & Be Thankful. Distilled in November 2004, it matured in an ex-bourbon barrel, cask #1433, and was bottled in 2022 at a natural cask strength of 52.1% ABV. The barrel yielded only 154 bottles of 700ml. With no wine or sherry influence, this is a chance to taste the distillery's own character through American oak, and like all Rest & Be Thankful single casks it is bottled without chill filtration or added colour. Presented in a gift box.

Tasting Notes: White chocolate, honeycomb, salted caramel, dried apricot and toasty oak.

Nose: White chocolate, honeycomb and comte cheese, with dried apricot, grilled pineapple, a hint of ozone and salted caramel, growing creamier with time.

Palate: White chocolate, honeycomb and salted caramel over an oily, mineral malt; balanced, toasty oak with gentle spice and a touch of tropical fruit.

Finish: Fresh, coating and toasty, with soft fruits and a savoury edge.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

rest-be-thankful-bruichladdich-2002.title: Rest & Be Thankful Bruichladdich 2002
rest-be-thankful-bruichladdich-2002.bodyHtml:
Bruichladdich 20 Year Old 2002 is a single cask Islay single malt selected by the independent bottler Rest & Be Thankful. Distilled in July 2002, it spent its full maturation in a wine hogshead, cask #531, before being bottled in 2022 at a natural cask strength of 52.2% ABV. The cask gave just 231 bottles of 700ml. As with every Rest & Be Thankful single cask, it is bottled as found: no chill filtration and no added colour. Long wine-cask maturation gives a dense, fruit-laden Bruichladdich with plenty of spice, and it comes presented in a gift box.

Tasting Notes: Dried and candied fruit, fig jam, warm spice, chocolate and leather.

Nose: Jujube sweets, fig jam and marmalade, with fennel, clove and anise, candied nuts and raisins.

Palate: Thick, sweet and coating; dried and candied fruit, salted caramel and manuka honey, cinnamon and ginger, then chocolate, leather, tobacco, smoked cedar and bitter orange.

Finish: Long, warming and spicy, with more fruit, chocolate, leather and tobacco.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

rest-be-thankful-port-charlotte-2005.title: Rest & Be Thankful Port Charlotte 2005
rest-be-thankful-port-charlotte-2005.bodyHtml:
Port Charlotte 16 Year Old 2005 is a single cask of Bruichladdich's smoky Port Charlotte single malt, bottled by the independent bottler Rest & Be Thankful. Distilled in October 2005, it matured in a wine hogshead, cask #1577, and was bottled in August 2022 at a natural cask strength of 54.6% ABV, giving 272 bottles of 700ml. Port Charlotte past ten years of age is scarce, and here the wine cask sits quietly behind the peat smoke, sea salt, citrus and stone fruit of the spirit. Bottled without chill filtration or added colour, and presented in a gift box.

Tasting Notes: Earthy peat, maritime smoke, citrus, melon and apricot.

Nose: Musty oak and damp cellar, wet burlap and aged cheddar, then earthy peat, brush smoke and drying seaweed, with new leather and a touch of maderized wine.

Palate: Dunnage and burlap, nutty with citrus, melon and apricot; ashy, maritime smoke with a medicinal edge.

Finish: Juicy melon, apricot and citrus, pipe tobacco, drying spice and sea salt.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

rest-be-thankful-assemblage-2008.title: Rest & Be Thankful Rum Co. Assemblage No1 2008 13 Year Old Pure Blended Rum
rest-be-thankful-assemblage-2008.bodyHtml:
This limited-edition, small-batch rum is a pure marriage of rums, crafted in collaboration with 4 esteemed Jamaican distilleries and aged for 13 years.Get ready to be transported to a tropical paradise with its intense and fruity nose of passionfruit, mango, and lime.

Don’t miss out on this perfect balance of warm, tropical flavors and spice. Get your hands on a bottle of Assemblage #01 while you still can!

duncan-taylor-bunnahabhain.title: Duncan Taylor Single Cask Bunnahabhain 2008 13 Year Old Cask #385511381
duncan-taylor-bunnahabhain.bodyHtml:
Duncan Taylor Single Cask Bunnahabhain 2008 13 Year Old Cask #385511381 is an exceptional independent bottling of Islay single malt Scotch whisky. Distilled at the renowned Bunnahabhain distillery in 2008, this spirit was carefully matured for 13 years before being selected and bottled as a single cask by the prestigious independent bottler, Duncan Taylor. Bottled without chill-filtration or added coloring, this expression captures the robust, unadulterated character of Bunnahabhain. It beautifully showcases the distillery's signature unpeated coastal maritime influence, delivering a rich maltiness paired with complex layers of dried fruit, toasted nuts, and warming oak spice.

Food Pairing: Smoked seafood, charcuterie boards with cured meats, roasted almonds, dark chocolate, and strong cheeses like aged cheddar or Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Natural golden amber in appearance with a rich, full-bodied, and slightly oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Coastal sea spray and maritime brine, intertwined with sweet malt, toasted hazelnuts, dried orchard fruits, vanilla, and a gentle earthy oak spice.

Palate : Rich, warming, and robust, delivering complex flavors of caramelized brown sugar, roasted nuts, baked apple, and coastal salinity, perfectly balanced by waves of peppery oak and baking spices.

Finish : Long, warming, and distinctly coastal, leaving lingering notes of sweet malt, salted caramel, and dry oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass. Given its cask strength, adding a few drops of room-temperature water is highly recommended to unlock further fruity aromas and soften the alcohol heat.

duncan-taylor-bunnahabhain-peated.title: Duncan Taylor Single Cask Bunnahabhain 2008 13 Year Old Cask #385511381
duncan-taylor-bunnahabhain-peated.bodyHtml:
Duncan Taylor Single Cask Bunnahabhain 2008 13 Year Old Cask #385511381 is an exceptional independent bottling of Islay single malt Scotch whisky. Distilled at the renowned Bunnahabhain distillery in 2008, this spirit was carefully matured for 13 years before being selected and bottled as a single cask by the prestigious independent bottler, Duncan Taylor. Bottled without chill-filtration or added coloring, this expression captures the robust, unadulterated character of Bunnahabhain. It beautifully showcases the distillery's signature unpeated coastal maritime influence, delivering a rich maltiness paired with complex layers of dried fruit, toasted nuts, and warming oak spice.

Food Pairing: Smoked seafood, charcuterie boards with cured meats, roasted almonds, dark chocolate, and strong cheeses like aged cheddar or Roquefort.

Tasting Notes : Natural golden amber in appearance with a rich, full-bodied, and slightly oily mouthfeel.

Nose : Coastal sea spray and maritime brine, intertwined with sweet malt, toasted hazelnuts, dried orchard fruits, vanilla, and a gentle earthy oak spice.

Palate : Rich, warming, and robust, delivering complex flavors of caramelized brown sugar, roasted nuts, baked apple, and coastal salinity, perfectly balanced by waves of peppery oak and baking spices.

Finish : Long, warming, and distinctly coastal, leaving lingering notes of sweet malt, salted caramel, and dry oak spice.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass. Given its cask strength, adding a few drops of room-temperature water is highly recommended to unlock further fruity aromas and soften the alcohol heat.

axr1-reserve-napa-valley-cab-sauv.title: AXR1 Reserve Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon (Flagship) 2018 750ml
axr1-reserve-napa-valley-cab-sauv.bodyHtml:
The Flagship Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon by AXR is a Napa Valley icon wine, made with intention and showing a direct reflection of the prestigious vineyards it comes from - Sleeping Lady, Artalade, Denali and their estate V Madrone vineyards. Shiny, in color with dark black cherry with touches of currant and velvet. Beautiful nose of cedar, thyme, nutmeg and cassis with dark cherry, licorice and plum. Dense but fresh entrance evolving on freshly picked red cherry, red currant and macerated strawberry, lingering on granular tannins and spices.

96 Point by Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
A barrel selection, “flagship” cuvee, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Flagship is deep garnet-purple colored. It bursts from the glass with opulent notes of baked blackberries, warm black cherries and cassis with nuances of chocolate box, redcurrant jelly, roses and cedar chest. The full-bodied palate is jam-packed with black fruit and floral layers, framed by beautifully ripe, fine-grained tannins and seamless freshness, finishing long and fragrant.

95 Points by Wine Enthusiast
A soft, supple texture gives in to velvety tannins in this robustly built, complex and intensely powerful wine. Clove, black currant and black pepper dot a midpalate of viscous opulence and generous fruit, accented in tobacco and salty oak. Enjoy best from 2028–2033.

leflaive-batard-montrachet-gc-blanc-2010.title: Domaine Leflaive Batard-Montrachet Grand Cru Blanc 2010 750ml
leflaive-batard-montrachet-gc-blanc-2010.bodyHtml: A rich, oaky dry white wine. Long and powerful, yet elegant in a masterly combination of toast, nuts and honey. One of the greatest white Burgundy wine produced.

woodford-reserve-batch-proof-1.title: Woodford Reserve Batch Proof Bourbon 2022
woodford-reserve-batch-proof-1.bodyHtml:
Batch Proof is a celebration of Woodford Reserve’s proprietary process – blending barrels into a batch and then bottling the whiskey at its actual proof, straight from the barrel. Batch Proof is crafted using the same grain bill and process as Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon.

Batch Proof, however, takes Woodford Reserve’s trademark flavor range of sweet vanilla and toasted oak to a whole new level offering consumers the privilege of tasting Woodford Reserve in its purest form (and not the standard 90.4 for which Woodford is known).

cht-pichon-comtesse-de-lalande.title: Chateau Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2023
cht-pichon-comtesse-de-lalande.bodyHtml:
An exceptional Pauillac offering cassis, blackberry, violet, cedar, graphite, and tobacco aromas. Silky tannins meet impressive concentration and freshness, creating a graceful, structured palate with layered complexity and a remarkably persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, truffle dishes, aged Comte, or grilled ribeye.

 

 

99 Points - James Suckling

A racy and focused Pichon Lalande with expressive aromas and flavors of black currant, blackberry and black cherry accented by licorice. Medium- to full-bodied, it features tight yet beautifully polished tannins, followed by layers of black currant, chocolate, walnut and subtle spice. With air, the wine reveals remarkable class, refinement and grace, supported by a silky tannic backbone. From organically and biodynamically grown grapes. A blend of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 17% Merlot and 3% Cabernet Franc.

98 Points - Decanter

A beautifully aromatic Pauillac with lush black currant and black cherry complemented by pencil lead, graphite, licorice and menthol. Supple and energetic on the palate, vibrant acidity provides freshness and drive while generous minerality adds a cool, classical character. Sleek, precise and refined, it maintains impressive structure and directness from beginning to end. One of the standout Pauillac wines of the vintage. Barrel Sample: 98.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Composed of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 17% Merlot and 3% Cabernet Franc, the 2023 Pichon Lalande offers dark currants, violets, smoky tobacco, lead pencil and graphite alongside the estate's signature floral character. Medium- to full-bodied, pure and beautifully layered, it combines a graceful texture with polished, steadily building tannins and outstanding length. A classic expression with approximately four decades of aging potential. Drink 2027–2067.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande reveals a serious, structured personality with aromas of blueberries, blackberries and plums layered with pencil shavings, violet and crushed mint. Medium- to full-bodied, deep and concentrated, it is supported by sweet, well-integrated tannins and concludes with a long, penetrating finish. A blend of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 17% Merlot and 3% Cabernet Franc.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Warm cassis, plum and cherry reduction flavors are complemented by subtle wet earth, ink and iris notes. The tannic grip is juicy yet seamlessly integrated, while fresh cedar emerges through the finish. Solidly structured and balanced throughout, this is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Cabernet Franc.

glen-scotia-10-year-old-single-malt.title: Glen Scotia 10 Year Old
glen-scotia-10-year-old-single-malt.bodyHtml:
A unique flavour profile of rich oils, green fruits and citrus, and our signature maritime nuances.

A delicious entry level whisky from the Campbeltown distillery. This is aged in 100% first-fill bourbon barrels and offers a superb introduction to one of the great whisky regions of Scotland.

NOSE - Seaspray, sliced apple, lemon zest and toasted oak

TASTE - Syrup, melted brown sugar, orange marmalade,
tangy pineapple, creamy oak vanilla

FINISH - Long with gentle ground ginger and
cinnamon spiciness

vodkow-cream-eggnog.title: Vodkow Cream Eggnog
vodkow-cream-eggnog.bodyHtml:
Vodkow Eggnog Cream Liquor is a festive, lactose-free cream liqueur made in Ontario by Dairy Distillery, bottled at 15% ABV in a 750ml bottle. It is crafted from Canadian dairy and layers the warm holiday spices of nutmeg, cinnamon and cloves into a smooth, creamy base. The distillery makes its vodka from milk sugar left over from dairy production, and all of its cream liquors are lactose-free and made entirely in Canada. Enjoy it as a seasonal sipper or as the base of a holiday cocktail.

Tasting Notes: Creamy and smooth, with nutmeg, cinnamon and clove.

Serve: Over ice, stirred into coffee, or shaken into a holiday cocktail.

brocard-chablis-1er-cru-cote-du-jouan.title: Jean-Marc Brocard Chablis 1er Cru Vau De Vey
brocard-chablis-1er-cru-cote-du-jouan.bodyHtml:
A Premier Cru Chablis crafted from Chardonnay grown on the steep east-facing slopes of the Vau De Vey climat. The wine displays vibrant citrus, white flowers, and pronounced mineral character, supported by lively acidity and a long, refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with oysters, shellfish, grilled white fish, sushi, roast chicken, and goat cheese.

brocard-chablis-grand-cru-les-clos-mag.title: Alain Geoffroy Chablis Grand Cru Les Clos
brocard-chablis-grand-cru-les-clos-mag.bodyHtml:
Produced from the prestigious Les Clos Grand Cru climat, this Chardonnay expresses the hallmark power and elegance of Chablis with aromas of citrus, white peach, white flowers and pronounced chalky minerality. Richly textured yet vibrant, it delivers exceptional balance, precision and a long, refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with lobster, scallops, oysters, turbot, roasted poultry in cream sauce or aged Comté cheese.

drouhin-savigny-les-beaune.title: Savigny Les Beaune 1Er Cru En Redrescul
drouhin-savigny-les-beaune.bodyHtml: Savigny-lès-Beaune "En Redrescul" is a Premier Cru wine from Burgundy, France, known for its lively and balanced character, particularly in its red and white varietals. Red wines from this site display deep, cherry-colored hues with notes of black and red fruits, while white wines offer a pale yellow color with floral and citrus aromas.

montes-muse-2019.title: Montes Muse Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 750ml
montes-muse-2019.bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon has the characteristic deep ruby-red colour, with very elegant and delicate aromas, where ripe red berries dominate, including strawberry, red plum, and sarsaparilla, as well as cassis liqueur and cherry syrup. From its time spent aging in oak, there are notes of tobacco, dulce de leche, and mocha, very well balanced with the fruity profile. The tannins are very smooth, in accordance with the purity of the aromas. The wine is vibrant and broad, but balanced at the same time, showing complexity and a very long finish.

94 Points- Vinous

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Muse hails from Buin in Maipo Alto. It was aged for 18 months in French oak barrels, 70% first use and 30% second use. This is the first vintage; it was released on La Place de Bordeaux. A textbook Cabernet from Maipo. Dark garnet red in the glass. The nose presents redcurrant and blackberry notes over a balsamic layer with hints of black pepper on a bed of cedar. Dry and smooth in the mouth. The finely grained, polished tannins and mildly juicy flow establish a relaxed, gentle, rewarding palate. A long-lasting red with lingering dark fruit flavor

drouhin-corton-grand-cru.title: Joseph Drouhin Grands-Echezeaux Grand Cru 2021
drouhin-corton-grand-cru.bodyHtml: In its youth, the wine displays aromas of great finesse, reminiscent of cherry and dark chocolate or cocoa bean, which is a delicate and sought after characteristic of this wine. As the wine matures, these aromas evolve towards other refined nuances evoking undergrowth, truffle, fine leather and sometimes light notes of cigar or cedar wood. The result is of great elegance and breed. The tannins are refined and the silk and velvet of the body are a perfect match. Very long aftertaste in which some of the aromas previously encountered are again in evidence and create the most elegant sensation.

drouhin-beaune-clos-des-mouches-rouge.title: Joseph Drouhin Beaune Clos des Mouches Premier Cru Rouge 2023
drouhin-beaune-clos-des-mouches-rouge.bodyHtml:
An exceptional wine. Beautiful, deep-red ruby color, with the bright sheen of great Burgundies. Intense and fresh nose for the young wines. Primary notes of red fruit dominate, such as Morello cherry (griotte or wild cherry), raspberry, blackberry. There are hints of complexity with smoky flavors evolving towards licorice. When the wine is maturing, aromas of pepper, tobacco, humus and undergrowth appear. When drinking the wine, the first impression is always clear-cut and the texture fleshy. The body is firm without being rough, well meshed without being heavy. There is great freshness in the younger wines. With age, the wine gets rounder. It takes on gras (velvety texture) and a more precise architecture, supported by silky tannins. It is lively and refined at the same time. There remains a final and most pleasing sensation of harmony, fullness and delicate tannins, as the wine lingers on the palate.

96 Points - James Suckling

Beautiful nose of wild raspberries, cherries, sandalwood, cloves, orange fruit and cardamom. So harmonious on the palate, with very fine, seamless tannins and fresh acidity, all integrated. Medium-bodied, long and full of energy. Drink or hold.


95 Points - Wine Spectator

Pure, velvety and evoking black cherry, blackberry, violet, sandalwood and mineral aromas and flavors, this red is lushly textured and harmonious. Guided by vibrant acidity that drives the saturated aftertaste. Offers superb balance and length.
 
94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2022 Beaune 1er Cru Clos des Mouches (Domaine) is shaping up beautifully, revealing aromas of sweet cherries, cassis, licorice and spices deftly framed by toasty new oak. Medium to full-bodied, rich and layered, with a fleshy core of fruit, succulent acids and powdery tannins, the Drouhin's own fully 14 hectares of this prime premier cru, which is divided equally between Chardonnay and Pinot Noir.

rest-be-thankful-port-charlotte-2002.title: Rest & Be Thankful Port Charlotte 2002
rest-be-thankful-port-charlotte-2002.bodyHtml:
Port Charlotte 19 Year Old 2002 is a single cask of Bruichladdich's smoky Port Charlotte spirit, bottled by the independent bottler Rest & Be Thankful. Distilled in November 2002, it matured for its whole life in a wine hogshead, cask #1195, and was bottled in September 2022 at a natural cask strength of 56.3% ABV. Only 222 bottles of 700ml were filled. Port Charlotte is rarely seen at this age, and the wine cask adds jammy red fruit and tannin to the smoke. Bottled without chill filtration or added colour, and presented in a gift box.

Tasting Notes: Bonfire smoke, jammy red fruit, licorice, leather and spice.

Nose: Quince paste, salted caramel, licorice, cigar and beach-bonfire smoke, with dried cranberry, strawberry, old leather and wine gums.

Palate: Big, jammy and intensely smoky; dried cranberry and seared strawberry, salty and sweet licorice, old oak and ash, clove, fennel seed and nutmeg, with leather and red-wine tannins.

Finish: Long, dry and leathery, with ashy smoke, drying spice and earthy tannins.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

edi-fettercairn-bourbon.title: Hunter Laing The First Editions Fettercairn 14 Year Old 2008 Bourbon Cask #19729 58.1% ABV
edi-fettercairn-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Fettercairn 14 Year Old 2008 is a single cask Highland single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Hunter Laing & Co. for The First Editions series. Distilled at Fettercairn in 2008, it matured in a single bourbon cask, number 19729, before being bottled in 2022 at 14 years old, yielding 214 bottles. Like every First Editions release it is bottled at natural cask strength, 58.1% ABV, without colouring or chill filtration, and is presented in a 700ml bottle with a gift tube.

Tasting Notes: Sweet spice and stewed fruit with nutty depth.

Nose: Sweet and rich, with cinnamon, caramel and a touch of nutmeg.

Palate: Stewed fruit with raisins and grated walnut.

Finish: Long, with a gingery note.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water to taste at cask strength.

edi-craigellachie-bourbon.title: Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Bourbon Batch A124
edi-craigellachie-bourbon.bodyHtml:
Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Bourbon Batch A124 is the first release of 2024 in Heaven Hill's highly acclaimed, uncut, and non-chill-filtered barrel proof series. True to the brand's batch naming convention ("A" denoting the first release of the year, "1" for January, and "24" for 2024), this specific expression carries an exact age statement of 10 years and 9 months. Bottled at a relatively approachable 119.0 proof, it delivers a rich, robust, and unadulterated bourbon experience that highlights the deep oak character and complex spice of Heaven Hill's traditional mashbill.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, smoked barbecue ribs, aged Gouda, dark chocolate, or pecan pie.

Tasting Notes : Deep mahogany to dark amber in appearance with a thick, viscous, and full-bodied mouthfeel.

Nose : Rich caramel, toasted oak, vanilla bean, baked apple, cinnamon spice, and a hint of dark chocolate and leather.
