The black bottle is inspired by the tunics that would have been worn by the monks that roamed the grounds of Lindores Abbey back in 1494, including Friar John Cor, the monk commissioned to produce aqua vitae from malt in the first written reference to Scotch whisky! Bottled at a hearty 60.2% ABV, without added color or chill filtration.

az-agr-margherita-otto-barolo-mag.title: Az Agr Margherita Otto Barolo 1.5L Magnum

jane-eyre-santenay-village-blanc.title: Jane Eyre Santenay Blanc 2021 750ml
jane-eyre-santenay-village-blanc.bodyHtml:
Melbourne-born Jane Eyre-Renard, one of the pioneers of the growing micro-negotiant movement, has been based in Burgundy since 2003, paying her dues at some top domaines including de Montille and Comtes Lafon.

She currently makes her own wines in a facility in Bligny-le-Beaune, shared with, among others, Dominique Lafon. Her wines, whether from Beaune, Nuits, or Beaujolais, display her distinctive style - charming and inviting, with supple tannins and soft but bright fruits.

Gentle extraction and judicious use of new oak means these have been among the more immediately appealing Burgundies in our portfolio. The 2018 vintage however has clearly stamped its imprint over Jane’s wines as there is greater power, deeper fruit and gravitas allied to the usual charm and definition. Her decision to include 30% whole bunches (as opposed to none last year) has given the wines extra depth and complexity to balance the ripe fruit. Meanwhile her preference for early bottling, important in a vintage like 2018 to preserve freshness and prevent the fruit drying out, still means the range is pretty accessible, but it is definitely serious. Jane says “ultimately vintage and vineyard should trump your winemaking” but in 2018 all three elements have combined to create something rather special.

89-92 Points - Jasper Morris MW

"3 barrels, 1 new, from certified organic and biodynamic vines, 30% whole bunch. Gorgeous dense mid purple with classy fruit on the nose. Ripe certainly (13.5%) but very engaging, and with a welcome freshness at the back. I like the intensity and energy here."

92 Points - Tim Atkin MW, Decanter

"Australian Jane Eyre makes a small but increasingly well recognised range of Pinot Noirs as well as Down Under. This was picked at the end of August, but still quite a ripe, plush, palate-coating style, with 30% whole bunches and 25% new wood. The fruit is appealingly supple and is balanced by appealing acidity and zip."

jane-eyre-beaune-1er-cru-avaux.title: Jane Eyre Beaune Premier Cru Les Avaux 2021 750ml
jane-eyre-beaune-1er-cru-avaux.bodyHtml:
Jane observes that "a year in a barrel does amazing things". The very concentrated 2020s ("like Barossa shiraz" she quips) have softened and developed brighter perfumes and elegance, and the lighter 2021s have fleshed out, increasing in intensity and are "matier" or more substantial. "They needed time to grow" which provides even more excitement for this tight and fragrant 2021 vintage.

Jane draws the comparison with 2007, a lighter weight vintage which initially went under the radar but has aged extremely well and rather longer than was expected, now providing very fine and harmonious drinking across a number of domaines.

jane-eyre-julienas.title: Jane Eyre Julienas 2021 750ml
jane-eyre-julienas.bodyHtml: Jane observes that "a year in a barrel does amazing things". The very concentrated 2020s ("like Barossa shiraz" she quips) have softened and developed brighter perfumes and elegance, and the lighter 2021s have fleshed out, increasing in intensity and are "matier" or more substantial. "They needed time to grow" which provides even more excitement for this tight and fragrant 2021 vintage. Jane draws the comparison with 2007, a lighter weight vintage which initially went under the radar but has aged extremely well and rather longer than was expected, now providing very fine and harmonious drinking across a number of domaines.

plantation-xo-20th-anniversary-1.title: Plantation XO 20th Anniversary Rum 375ml
plantation-xo-20th-anniversary-1.bodyHtml:
Planteray XO 20th Anniversary Amber Rum (formerly known as Plantation XO) is a world-renowned, exceptionally luxurious, and masterfully blended expression created to honor Master Blender Alexandre Gabriel's landmark two decades of spirits craftsmanship. Sourced from the sun-drenched island of Barbados, this elegant rum utilizes a time-honored "double aging" process to bridge exotic Caribbean intensity with sophisticated European refinement. It initially matures in the tropics for 8 to 15 years in traditional American white oak ex-bourbon casks before being shipped to the southwest of France. There, it undergoes a secondary finishing period of 2 to 10 years at Château de Bonbonnet in small French oak casks previously used to age premium Ferrand Cognac. It pours a beautiful, shimmering mahogany-amber hue in the glass, lifting with a spectacular and complex bouquet of toasted coconut, sugarcane, creamy vanilla, and cocoa, further complexed by undertones of candied orange peel, holiday baking spices, and old cigar box. On the palate, this rum is full-bodied, velvety, and fruit-forward, coating the mouth with sweet, rich flavors of milk chocolate, ripe banana, and fresh mango. Balanced beautifully by a refined spirit warmth, soft molasses chewiness, and an incredibly delicate structure, it glides effortlessly into an expansive, long-lasting finish rich with hints of warm cinnamon and caramelized brown sugar.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with decadent desserts like dark chocolate molten lava cake, tiramisu, classic crème brûlée, bananas Foster, and pecan pie, as well as savory dishes like slow-braised glazed pork belly, rich duck breast with a fruit reduction, or a premium cigar and an artisanal cheese board featuring mature blue cheese and aged Gouda.

chateau-haut-brion-2015.title: Chateau La Mission Haut Brion 2014
chateau-haut-brion-2015.bodyHtml:
Chateau La Mission Haut Brion is one of Bordeaux's greatest wines, revered for its extraordinary power, elegance, and longevity. Aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, graphite, cedar, cigar box, violet, and exotic spice unfold into a concentrated palate with velvety tannins, exceptional depth, and a remarkably persistent finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, or aged Comte for an unforgettable Bordeaux experience.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

The typicity of La Mission is really here. Aromas of iodine, oyster shell, currants and orange peel are evident. Full-bodied, tight and tannic with a muscular and toned texture that holds the wine down at the moment, but it’s waiting to release its joy and true nature. Fine-grained. Give it until 2023.

95 Points - Decanter

Medium-bodied, fresh attack, dominated by late summer fruits, suggesting perfectly but not overly ripe fruit with great integrity. A floating, gossamer quality to the structure, the tannins are deceptively fine, yet they hold the wine together very tightly. You feel it on the finish, where blackberry and raspberry fruits are kept firmly in check. A lovely wine with medium- to long-term potential and great capacity to provide pleasure.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2014 Château La Mission Haut-Brion is slightly more elegant and pretty compared to the richer, slightly more masculine Haut-Brion. A blend of 54% Merlot, 45% Cabernet Sauvignon and a splash of Cabernet Franc, it shows a kiss of red fruits in its core of darker currants, smoked tobacco, scorched earth, vanilla bean and spice-driven aromas and flavors. With medium- to full-bodied richness, impeccable balance, fine tannins and a great finish, it’s a downright classy La Mission that will benefit from 4–5 years of bottle age and keep for 20+ years.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2014 Château La Mission Haut-Brion is a blend of 54% Merlot, 1% Cabernet Franc and 45% Cabernet Sauvignon, picked between September 15 and October 8 and raised in 55% new oak. It has retained that engagingly fresh and vibrant bouquet, the bashful nature that it showed in barrel replaced by a more outgoing personality. This is an exquisite bouquet with pure black fruit, cold stone, a touch of black olive and later a suggestion of boysenberry preserve. The palate is still structured and, considering that a majority is Merlot, quite masculine. There remains some new oak to be fully assimilated, although there is clearly the fruit to soak that up. It comes more alive on the second half with a lovely spiciness and impressive persistence. It will have more to give down the line, and the strictness implies that this La Mission Haut-Brion should be afforded a decade in the cellar before it will show what it can do.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Richly endowed, the wine is beautifully concentrated. Still young, it has considerable potential with its rich fruits and firm tannins. There is a strongly juicy aftertaste that brings in the freshness of the year. The wine will age well and should not be drunk before 2026.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Fleshy and very compact, with layers of dark fig, black currant paste and blackberry reduction still sorting themselves out. Sports a serious spine of tar while a well-roasted apple wood element forms the backdrop on the dense finish. The range and density set this apart. Should be rather long-lived for the vintage. Best from 2020 through 2030.

mi-familia-xtra-anejo.title: Mi Familia Flores Extra Añejo Tequila
mi-familia-xtra-anejo.bodyHtml:
Mi Familia Flores Extra Añejo is a 100% blue Weber agave tequila from the Flores family, produced in Amatitán in the Valles region of Jalisco. It is aged for 36 months in American oak barrels, three years that build deep colour and layers of caramel, toasted oak and vanilla around a core of cooked agave. In the glass it shows a reddish gold hue with bright highlights; the nose brings cooked agave, oak, vanilla and sweet notes, and the palate follows with roasted agave, wood, chocolate and caramel. Bottled at 40% ABV in a faceted 750ml bottle, it is a rich, dessert-like extra añejo to sip slowly.

Tasting Notes: cooked agave, caramel, vanilla, oak, chocolate

Nose: Cooked agave, oak, vanilla and sweet notes.

Palate: Cooked agave with intense roasted notes, wood, vanilla, chocolate and caramel.

Finish: Long and smooth with sweet agave, oak warmth and soft spice.

Serve: Neat or on the rocks.

dewars-white-label-scotch-whisky.title: Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky 1.75L
dewars-white-label-scotch-whisky.bodyHtml:
Dewar's White Label Blended Scotch Whisky 1.75L is one of the world’s most recognizable and highly awarded blended Scotch whiskies, first created in 1899 by Master Blender A.J. Cameron. This classic blend brings together up to 40 of Scotland’s finest single malt and grain whiskies, with Aberfeldy single malt at its sweet, honeyed heart. Dewar’s is renowned for its signature double-aging process, wherein the whiskies are blended together and then returned to oak casks to mature further, ensuring an uncommonly smooth and seamlessly integrated flavor profile.

Food Pairing: Traditional fish and chips, honey-glazed ham, mild cheddar cheeses, or shortbread biscuits.

TASTING NOTES Clear, pale golden amber in appearance with a light, crisp, and exceptionally smooth mouthfeel.

NOSE Clean and invitingly sweet, opening with distinct aromas of heather honey, fresh orchard fruits like green apples and pears, and a subtle undertone of warm unbaked dough.

PALATE Light and well-rounded, delivering dominant flavors of golden honey, sweet malt, and subtle vanilla fudge, beautifully balanced by a touch of fresh citrus and a faint trace of oak wood.

FINISH Short to medium, clean, and refreshing with a gentle, trailing warmth of black pepper and a brief, clean dry note.

SERVE Highly versatile; perfect enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as the quintessential base for a refreshing Scotch Highball mixed with club soda and a lemon twist.

dewars-18-year-old-2.title: Dewar's 18 Year Old Gift Tin
dewars-18-year-old-2.bodyHtml:
Dewar's 18 Year Old is a blended Scotch whisky drawn from some of the oldest casks in the Dewar's reserves. The label explains that it is blended from old and rare Highland, Speyside and Lowland single malts and grain whiskies, each at least 18 years old, with Aberfeldy, Macduff, Royal Brackla, Craigellachie and Aultmore named among the house's malts. After blending, the whiskies are married together in refill casks as part of Dewar's two-stage ageing process, which the producer credits for the harmony of flavour and texture. It shows honey, toffee, dark chocolate and fruit. Dewar's lists a Gold medal at the 2024 International Spirits Challenge and Gold and Double Gold at San Francisco in 2023 and 2022. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle, presented here in a gift tin.

Tasting Notes: Honey, toffee, dark chocolate, marzipan and rich fruit.

Nose: Perfumed and floral, with honey and nuts.

Palate: Rich and complex, with toffee, dark chocolate and fruit.

Finish: Lingering and creamy, with full-bodied oak easing into delicate herbal notes.

Serve: Neat, or in a Rob Roy.

benromach-single-cask-2002-bourbon-875.title: Benromach Single Cask 2002 Bourbon Barrel #875
benromach-single-cask-2002-bourbon-875.bodyHtml:
Benromach Single Cask 2002 #875 is a single-cask Speyside single malt in the distillery's current packaging. Distilled on 18 November 2002 at Benromach in Forres, Speyside, it matured in a single first-fill ex-bourbon barrel and was bottled on 3 October 2022, just short of its twentieth birthday, at a cask-strength 56.2% ABV. Only 196 bottles of 700ml were filled. It is bright, creamy and tropical with clean smoke. Benromach is owned by Gordon & MacPhail.

Tasting Notes: Tropical fruit, baked apple, honey, orange zest and soft smoke.

Nose: Rich tropical fruit leading to baked apple and black pepper.

Palate: Sweet honey and orange zest.

Finish: Gentle, soft smoke.

Serve: Neat, adding water drop by drop if preferred.

penderyn-icon-of-wales-the-headliner.title: Penderyn Icons of Wales No. 9 The Headliner Welsh Whisky
penderyn-icon-of-wales-the-headliner.bodyHtml:
The 9th in Penderyn’s Icons of Wales Edition whiskies is called The Headliner. The only Welsh Prime Minister, David Lloyd George (1863-1945), was a social reformer and accidentally established the premium whisky industry. He became a symbol of the national reawakening of Wales, and created more headlines than any other 20th century statesman.

This 70o ml bottle has an abv of 46%, and is matured in Jamaican Rum & Ruby Port Casks.

Tasting Notes

Nose: Red berries, strawberries and cream; a hint of cranberries, light oak and vanilla. Nutmeg and cinnamon spice.

Palate: Rich sweet flavours of dried fruits, salted caramel, floral honey and a spicy kick of black pepper with a tannin dryness.

Finish: Sweetness, fading into a dry yet fruity finish.

drouhin-beaune-1er-cru-greves.title: Jadot Beaune Greves 1Er Cru Blanc 2020
drouhin-beaune-1er-cru-greves.bodyHtml: Louis Jadot Beaune Grèves Premier Cru Le Clos Blanc 2020 is a white Burgundy from Maison Louis Jadot, founded in Beaune in 1859, and bears the Famille Gagey name on its label. Les Grèves is best known for red wine, but this Chardonnay comes from limestone-rich parcels whose gravelly, sandy soils (grèves) drain freely. The house presses gently, ferments with native yeasts and matures the wine on fine lees in French oak barrels, about 30% new, for 12 to 15 months. 750ml, 13.5% alcohol.

garrison-brothers-single-13279-66-30.title: Garrison Brothers Single Barrel Cask Strength Barrel 13279

s-m-o-s-ardmore-1998-cask-750768.title: The Single Malts of Scotland Ardmore 23 Year Old 1998 Hogshead Cask 750768 51.2% ABV
s-m-o-s-ardmore-1998-cask-750768.bodyHtml: his Highland single malt whiskey from the Ardmore Distillery was distilled in 1998 and matured in a Hogshead #750768 for a full 23 years. Here it is: In 2022, this single cask whiskey was bottled by independent bottler Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland range at a cask strength of 51.2%. Don't miss the chance to taste this exquisite whisky!

s-m-o-s-caol-ila-2010-cask-302273.title: Single Malt of Scotland S.M.O.S Caol Ila 2010 12 Year Old Cask 302273 54.3%
s-m-o-s-caol-ila-2010-cask-302273.bodyHtml: Single Malts of Scotland Caol Ila 2010 is a single cask Islay single malt Scotch whisky from cask 302273, bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland range. It is presented at 54.3% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

s-m-o-s-glentauchers-2011-cask-110000389.title: S.M.O.S Glentauchers 2011 Cask 110000389
s-m-o-s-glentauchers-2011-cask-110000389.bodyHtml:
Glentauchers 10 Year Old 2011 is a single cask Speyside single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland series. Distilled in 2011, it matured in a single ex-bourbon barrel, cask #110000389, before bottling at a natural strength of 59.4% ABV in 700ml bottles. The producer's notes describe a dessert-like dram: apple strudel and vanilla ice cream with shortbread and milk chocolate on the nose, biscuity peach and apple on the palate, and a long, sweet finish that turns gingery. Adding water brings the fruit forward.

Tasting Notes: Apple strudel, vanilla ice cream, shortbread, milk chocolate, peach and ginger.

Nose: Hot apple strudel with melting vanilla ice cream, buttery shortbread, milk chocolate and soft lemon Turkish delight.

Palate: Biscuity, with a mellow fruity sweetness of peach and apple; water intensifies the fruit and spice shows at the end.

Finish: Long, sweet and syrupy, tailing off into warming ginger.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

s-m-o-s-orkney-2009-cask-7.title: S.M.O.S Orkney 2009 Cask 7
s-m-o-s-orkney-2009-cask-7.bodyHtml:
Orkney 12 Year Old 2009 is a single cask single malt from an undisclosed Orkney distillery, bottled for The Single Malts of Scotland, the independent range from Elixir Distillers. Distilled on 5 November 2009, it matured in hogshead cask 7 for 12 years and was bottled in 2022 at 56.3% ABV, in a 700ml bottle presented in a box.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

s-m-o-s-ledaig-2005-cask-78.title: S.M.O.S Ledaig 2005 Cask 78
s-m-o-s-ledaig-2005-cask-78.bodyHtml:
Ledaig 17 Year Old 2005 is a single cask of peated single malt from Tobermory Distillery on the Isle of Mull, bottled for The Single Malts of Scotland, the independent range from Elixir Distillers. Distilled on 3 February 2005, it spent 17 years in ex-bourbon barrel 78 before bottling on 7 April 2022 at 54.2% ABV. Only 253 bottles were filled, each a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

s-m-o-s-laphroaig-2013-cask-190.title: S.M.O.S Laphroaig 2013 Cask 190
s-m-o-s-laphroaig-2013-cask-190.bodyHtml:
Laphroaig 9 Year Old 2013 is a single cask Islay single malt from The Single Malts of Scotland, the independent range bottled by Elixir Distillers. Distilled at Laphroaig on 23 April 2013, it matured in hogshead cask 190 until 4 May 2022, when it was bottled at a full 61.4% ABV. Just 332 bottles were filled, each a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

s-m-o-s-ardmore-12-yr-cask-708026.title: S.M.O.S Ardmore 12 Year Old Cask 708026
s-m-o-s-ardmore-12-yr-cask-708026.bodyHtml:
Ardmore 12 Year Old 2009 Cask 708026 is a single cask Highland single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland range. It was distilled on 1 December 2009 and matured in a single ex-Laphroaig barrel until bottling on 24 February 2022, yielding just 245 bottles. It is bottled at 54.1% ABV in a 700 ml bottle, with no added colouring and without chill filtration, and is presented in the range's black gift box.

Serve: Neat first, then with a little water to open it up.

s-m-o-s-caol-ila-12-yr-cask-301292.title: S.M.O.S Caol Ila 12 Year Old Cask 301292
s-m-o-s-caol-ila-12-yr-cask-301292.bodyHtml:
Caol Ila 11 Year Old 2011 Cask 301292 is a single cask Islay single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland range. Distilled on 21 January 2011, it matured for 11 years in a single sherry butt before bottling on 24 February 2022, yielding 587 bottles. It is bottled at 59.8% ABV in a 700 ml bottle and comes in the range's black gift box. The sherry cask layers red fruit and chocolate over Caol Ila's gentle smoke.

Tasting Notes: Raspberry, peach and milk chocolate with smoked sugar, jam-topped scones and lapsang souchong.

Nose: Freeze-dried raspberries in milk chocolate, soft peach and raspberry-cream meringue made with smoked sugar, with a smoky peach melba and fruity menthol lozenges.

Palate: Toasted sultana scones singed at the edges, buttered and topped with sharp raspberry jam, alongside smoky lapsang souchong tea.

Finish: Red fruit, then a hint of coal dust and a wisp of wood smoke.

Serve: Neat, then with a little water.

s-m-o-s-clynelish-26-yr-cask-8659.title: Single Malts of Scotland S.M.O.S Clynelish 1995 26 Year Old Cask 8659 50.7%
s-m-o-s-clynelish-26-yr-cask-8659.bodyHtml:
Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Bottled by: Elixir Distillers 70cl / 50.7%

A single cask 1995 Clynelish 26-year-old bottled in 2022 without colouring or chill filtration by Elixir Distillers for their Single Malts of Scotland series.

The mid-1990s were a golden era for Clynelish, with the 1995-1997 vintages particularly special. As you might have guessed from the colour, this particular Clynelish 1995 came from a sherry butt – Cask 8659, which yielded 576 bottles at its cask strength of 50.7%. This will be an epic dram.

s-m-o-s-linkwood-14-yr-cask-800856.title: S.M.O.S Linkwood 14 Year Old Cask 800856
s-m-o-s-linkwood-14-yr-cask-800856.bodyHtml:
Linkwood 14 Year Old 2008 is a single cask Speyside single malt from The Single Malts of Scotland, the independent range from Elixir Distillers, which picks individual casks from selected distilleries. Distilled at Linkwood on 23 January 2008, it matured in hogshead 800856 until 4 March 2022 and was bottled at 58.9% ABV. The cask gave just 262 bottles, each a 700ml bottle presented in a box.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

whisky-trail-haiku-dailuaine-12-yr.title: Whisky Trail Haiku Dailuaine 12 Year Old
whisky-trail-haiku-dailuaine-12-yr.bodyHtml:
Whisky Trail Haiku Dailuaine 12 Year Old is a single malt Scotch from Dailuaine Distillery in Speyside, bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Whisky Trail's Haiku range. Distilled in October 2009, it spent twelve years in a fresh sherry hogshead before bottling in 2022 at a full-strength 55.8% ABV. The label carries a short haiku about the distillery's slow distillation, likening it to the making of a flavoursome stock. The sherry cask has given a rich profile of orange, ginger, dark chocolate and figs. 700ml.

Nose: Spiced orange polenta cake and sweet dessert wine, with freshly brewed coffee and fruity fudge behind.

Palate: Orange oil and crystallised ginger over rich dark chocolate, then soft treacle toffee and figs in syrup.

Finish: Spiced dark fruit with a waft of clove.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

whisky-trail-haiku-strathclyde-28-yr.title: Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10 Year Old
whisky-trail-haiku-strathclyde-28-yr.bodyHtml:
Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10 Year Old is a flagship heavily peated Islay single malt Scotch whisky crafted from 100% Scottish barley and peated to 40 PPM. Matured for 10 years on Islay in a combination of 65% first-fill American whiskey casks, 10% second-fill American whiskey casks, and 25% second-fill French wine casks, this non-chill filtered expression marries intense marine peat smoke with rich sweet vanilla, coconut, and vibrant orchard fruit complexity.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, oysters on the half shell, dark chocolate, blue cheese, or barbecue pork ribs.

Tasting Notes : Golden amber appearance with a rich, oily, and coating texture on the palate.

Nose : Heavy peat smoke balanced with sweet vanilla, caramel, sea salt spray, charred oak, lemon curd, and dried floral notes.

Palate : Smooth and rich with dominant barbecue smoke, sweet malt, coconut, fudge, orange peel, and gentle baking spice.

Finish : Long, warming, and smoky with lingering dried oak, marine salt, sweet barley, and soft fudge.

Serve : Served neat at room temperature or with a few drops of water in a Glencairn glass.

whisky-trail-haiku-invergordon-28-yr.title: Whisky Trail Haiku Invergordon 28 Year Old
whisky-trail-haiku-invergordon-28-yr.bodyHtml:
This Invergordon single grain Scotch whisky was distilled in 1993 and matured for 28 years in an ex-bourbon barrel before independent bottler Elixir Distillers released it in the Haiku range of its Whisky Trail series, each label carrying a short poem – here, 'Elegant aging, simplicity in spirit, the dram ennobled.' It is bottled at 50.3% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Nose: Thick custard over banana cake with a crisp caramelised sugar and flaked almond topping; freshly baked vanilla cookies.

Palate: Rich, soft salted-caramel soufflé followed by creamy toffee-vanilla custard.

Finish: Long, decadent layers of caramel, butterscotch and toffee.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

whisky-trail-haiku-teaninich-14-yr.title: Whisky Trail Haiku Teaninich 14 Year Old
whisky-trail-haiku-teaninich-14-yr.bodyHtml:
Whisky Trail Haiku Teaninich 14 Year Old is a single cask Highland single malt Scotch from Teaninich Distillery, bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Whisky Trail's Haiku range. Distilled in September 2007 and matured in hogshead #700145, it was bottled in February 2022 at 14 years old and a cask strength of 56.6% ABV. Its label haiku speaks of complexity from modern mashing and purity from the stills. Bright and fruit-led, with citrus and orchard fruit to the fore. 700ml.

Nose: Lemon drizzle cake and a bowl of fresh fruit salad, with pineapple, apple, kiwi and melon dusted in citrus zest.

Palate: The fruit builds into soft stone fruits with a sharp citrus tang; a drop of water softens the citrus and reveals gentler layers of fruit.

Finish: Long, fruity and slightly creamy.

Serve: Neat, with a drop of water to soften the citrus.

s-m-o-s-ardlair-11-yr-res-parcel-no-8.title: S.M.O.S Ardlair 11 Year Old Res. Parcel No.8
s-m-o-s-ardlair-11-yr-res-parcel-no-8.bodyHtml:
Ardlair 11 Year Old 2010 Reserve Casks Parcel No. 8 is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland Reserve Casks series. Ardlair is the name used for the unpeated spirit of the Ardmore distillery, better known for its smoky malt. This parcel was distilled in 2010 and married from three sherry butts before bottling in 2022 at 11 years old. It is bottled at 48% ABV in a 700 ml bottle and comes in a kraft gift box.

Tasting Notes: Linseed oil, vanilla and blackberry, dark honey and baking spice, and a lingering jammy finish.

Nose: Linseed oil opening onto vanilla ice cream rippled with blackberry coulis, with wood spice warming into sandalwood.

Palate: Dark runny honey with cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla; sweet, creamy and rich.

Finish: Long, with forest-floor notes after rain and the dark, jammy fruit of the nose returning.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

s-m-o-s-glen-elgin-13-yr-res-parcel-no-8.title: S.M.O.S Glen Elgin 13 Year Old Res Parcel No.8
s-m-o-s-glen-elgin-13-yr-res-parcel-no-8.bodyHtml:
Glen Elgin 13 Year Old Reserve Casks Parcel No. 8 is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland. The Reserve Casks range marries a small parcel of casks from one distillery; this parcel brings together eight hogsheads of Glen Elgin distilled in 2008 and bottled in 2022 after 13 years. It is bottled at 48% ABV in a 700ml bottle and comes in a kraft gift box. The producer describes a rich, bright and fruity whisky built around honey, orange blossom and ripe peach, finishing like a glass of iced peach tea.

Tasting Notes: Honey, orange blossom, vanilla custard, peach, coconut, lemon zest and black tea.

Nose: Honey, orange blossom and vanilla custard, with ripe peach slices and dark chocolate shavings.

Palate: Juicy peach with creamy coconut, a sprinkle of cinnamon and clove, and fresh lemon zest.

Finish: Peach, honey and lemon with a black tea note, like iced peach tea.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

s-m-o-s-orkney-13-yr-res-parcel-no-8.title: S.M.O.S Orkney 13 Year Old Res Parcel No.8
s-m-o-s-orkney-13-yr-res-parcel-no-8.bodyHtml:
Orkney 13 Year Old 2008 is part of Parcel No. 8 in the Reserve Casks series from The Single Malts of Scotland, the independent range from Elixir Distillers, with each parcel selected by Oliver Chilton. The label names only an Orkney distillery. Distilled in 2008, the whisky is a marriage of two sherry butts and two ex-bourbon barrels, bottled in 2022 after 13 years at 48% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Heather smoke and dark chocolate run through it.

Tasting Notes: Peppermint, heather smoke, dark chocolate, golden syrup and cherries.

Nose: Fresh peppermint and elegant heathery smoke, with velvety dark chocolate.

Palate: Florentine biscuits, golden syrup, candied ginger, cinnamon and dark chocolate, with smouldering heather.

Finish: Long and fresh, with Morello cherries in syrup, cream, dark chocolate shavings and peppermint tea.

Serve: Neat, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

s-m-o-s-benrinnes-12-yr-res-parcel-no-9.title: S.M.O.S Benrinnes 12 Year Old Res Parcel No.9
s-m-o-s-benrinnes-12-yr-res-parcel-no-9.bodyHtml:
Benrinnes 12 Year Old 2009 Reserve Casks Parcel No. 9 is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland Reserve Casks series. Distilled at Benrinnes in 2009, it was matured in a small parcel of five refill sherry hogsheads and bottled in 2022 at 12 years old. It is bottled at 48% ABV in a 700 ml bottle and comes in a kraft gift box. A rich, sherried take on Benrinnes' famously robust spirit.

Tasting Notes: Cherry, spice and chocolate with a peppery finish.

Nose: Cherries and spice, with sandalwood, clove and cinnamon.

Palate: Chocolate and cherry in the style of a black forest gateau topped with almond slivers, balanced by ginger snaps and coffee.

Finish: Intense and spicy, fading to cherry cola and black peppercorn.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

s-m-o-s-caol-ila-8-yr-res-parcel-no-9.title: S.M.O.S Caol Ila 8 Year Old Res Parcel No.9
s-m-o-s-caol-ila-8-yr-res-parcel-no-9.bodyHtml:
Caol Ila 8 Year Old Reserve Casks Parcel No. 9 is an Islay single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland. The Reserve Casks range marries a small parcel of casks from one distillery: here, six ex-bourbon barrels of Caol Ila distilled in 2014 and bottled in 2022 after eight years. It is bottled at 48% ABV in a 700ml bottle and presented in a kraft gift box. The producer describes a coastal, smoky dram where bonfire smoke and sea air meet bright citrus, warm baking spice and a sweet, salty finish.

Tasting Notes: Bonfire smoke, sea air, lemon cake, baking spice, ginger, liquorice, pear and sea salt.

Nose: Sweet bonfire smoke and sea air, with lemon drizzle cake and a crunchy vanilla sugar glaze.

Palate: Cinnamon, clove and nutmeg over lemon and lime, with glace ginger and a thread of salty liquorice.

Finish: Turning sweet, with juicy ripe pear and flakes of sea salt.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

s-m-o-s-dailuiane-10-yr-res-parcel-no-9.title: S.M.O.S Dailuiane 10 Year Old Res Parcel No.9
s-m-o-s-dailuiane-10-yr-res-parcel-no-9.bodyHtml:
Dailuaine 10 Year Old Reserve Casks Parcel No. 9 is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland. The Reserve Casks range brings together a small parcel of casks from a single distillery; this one combines hogsheads of Dailuaine distilled in 2006, 2010 and 2011, each aged at least ten years before bottling in 2022. It is bottled at 48% ABV in a 700ml bottle and comes in a kraft gift box. The producer's notes move from melon and buttered toast to pear, lemon zest and roasted nuts, with the weighty texture Dailuaine is known for.

Tasting Notes: Honeydew melon, buttered toast, honey, pear, lemon zest, vanilla cream and roasted nuts.

Nose: Slices of honeydew melon with warm buttered toast and honey.

Palate: Melon turns to juicy pear and bright lemon zest, rounded by vanilla cream and honey-roasted nuts.

Finish: Lemon sherbet sweetness with almonds, hazelnuts and orchard fruit.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

s-m-o-s-glen-garioch-10-yr-res-parcel-9.title: S.M.O.S Glen Garioch 10 Year Old Res Parcel 9
s-m-o-s-glen-garioch-10-yr-res-parcel-9.bodyHtml:
Glen Garioch 10 Year Old Reserve Casks Parcel No. 9 is a Highland single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland. Independent bottlings of Glen Garioch are uncommon, and this one marries five ex-bourbon barrels distilled in 2012 and bottled in 2022 after ten years. It is bottled at 48% ABV in a 700ml bottle and comes in a kraft gift box. The producer's notes describe a pastry-led dram, all almond croissant and rose water on the nose, with caramel and white peach on the palate and a weighty, chocolatey finish.

Tasting Notes: Almond pastry, rose water, caramel, white peach, oat biscuit and milk chocolate.

Nose: Frangipane and flaky buttery pastry, like an almond croissant, with rose water and an earthy note of rain-soaked wood.

Palate: Soft, chewy caramels opening to white summer peach and wood spice, with the pastry turning to oat biscuits.

Finish: Weighty, like milk chocolate melting on the tongue, with a final touch of rose water.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

s-m-o-s-glenrothes-31-yr.title: The Single Malts of Scotland Glenrothes 31 Year Old A Marriage of Casks 53.2% ABV
s-m-o-s-glenrothes-31-yr.bodyHtml:
This is a marriage of whiskies whose vintages range from 1989 to 1990, matured in just two casks, a hogshead and sherry butt, which yielded a total of 560 bottles. This whisky offers a variety rich fruit and sweet notes entwined with a woody, spiced finish.

Region: Speyside

Tasting Notes:

Nose:Blackcurrant jam in a leather pot with juicy raisins and sticky dates. Rich notes of plum sit alongside maraschino and glacé
cherries – depth of flavour and crisp sweetness combined. Malt loaf and fruity dark chocolate develop, balanced by tarry touches and a sip of sweet Pedro Ximénez sherry.

Palate: Intense. Raisins and charcoal with stewed plums, sour and sweet cherries, molasses and soft oaky spice. Tarry notes are layered with liquorice, dark chocolate, sweet blackcurrant jam and polished oak. Ginger cake and chocolate-covered crystallised ginger provide a backbone of sweetness countered by rich riverbank earth.

Finish: Polished oak and fruity jam fade to leave nutmeg, allspice, brown sugar and a touch of tar.

s-m-o-s-speyside-25-yr.title: S.M.O.S Speyside 25 Year Old
s-m-o-s-speyside-25-yr.bodyHtml:
Speyside Distillery 25 Year Old 1996 is a cask-strength single malt from The Single Malts of Scotland's A Marriage of Casks range, bottled by Elixir Distillers. For this release Master Blender Oli Chilton brought together three ex-bourbon hogsheads distilled at the Speyside Distillery in 1996 and bottled them in 2022 at 52.6% ABV, without colouring or chill filtration, for an outturn of 780 bottles in 700ml. Marriage of Casks releases are small vattings picked from the bottler's inventory by the Master Blender and presented in a gift box.

Nose: Baked apple and ripe pear with lemon and marmalade, then grassiness, fragrant mint, juicy nectarine and wax-polished oak.

Palate: Sweet and fruity over layers of spice; baked apple with cinnamon, creamy lemon tart, buttery pastry and mint fondant, with a little char and oak under unripe mango and pineapple.

Finish: Pineapple turning to apple as the char fades and soft spice lingers.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

s-m-o-s-craigellachie-10-yr-cask-900094.title: S.M.O.S Craigellachie 10 Year Old Cask 900094
s-m-o-s-craigellachie-10-yr-cask-900094.bodyHtml:
Craigellachie 10 Year Old 2011 is a single cask Speyside single malt Scotch whisky bottled by Elixir Distillers for The Single Malts of Scotland series. Distilled on 20 April 2011, it matured in a single sherry butt, cask #900094, until bottling on 25 February 2022. The butt yielded 563 bottles at a formidable natural strength of 68.9% ABV, so a splash of water is well worth trying. The producer calls it a dram of two halves: chocolate and ginger biscuits neat, with fruit such as apple and pineapple coming forward once water is added.

Tasting Notes: Dark chocolate, ginger biscuit, apple pastry, honeycomb, poached orchard fruit and citrus.

Nose: Dark chocolate chip and ginger shortbread; with water, sangria-soaked apple slices and overripe pineapple.

Palate: Apple Danish pastry and dark chocolate honeycomb, moving to gingery brandy snaps and calvados-poached orchard fruit.

Finish: Long, with cooked apples dusted in cinnamon sugar and a sharp citrus tang.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

montes-wings-carmenere-1.title: Montes Wings Carmenere 2020 750ml
montes-wings-carmenere-1.bodyHtml:
Deep red colour, with the purple undertones very characteristic of Carmenère. The intense nose reveals aromas of black fruit, such as blackberry and blueberry, accompanied by pleasing spice notes of bell pepper and black pepper, joined by sweet notes from the French oak barrels, delivering a very complex wine. The rounded palate of the wine shows extreme smoothness and potency, with a very long, pleasant finish.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Grapes come from vines that grow on the hillside of Apalta. This is a Carménère with a ripe character and lovely acidity. Aromas of berry jam join cinnamon, nutmeg and peppercorn on the nose. The palate is silky and fruity, with nice notes of cranberry sauce and red plum. Sweet spices add an extra layer of flavor.

claude-dugat-bourgogne-rouge.title: Domaine Dugat-Py Bourgogne Rouge 2022
claude-dugat-bourgogne-rouge.bodyHtml:
Domaine Dugat-Py Bourgogne Rouge 2022 is a powerhouse regional red Burgundy produced by one of the most revered and meticulous domains in Gevrey-Chambertin. The 2022 vintage yielded beautifully ripe, expressive fruit, resulting in a Bourgogne Rouge that displays remarkable depth and old-vine concentration well beyond its regional classification. Grown entirely under strict organic practices, the wine undergoes traditional, low-intervention vinification and is aged for 15 to 18 months in French oak casks before being bottled unfined and unfiltered. In the glass, it shows a luminous, deep ruby hue, revealing a highly aromatic nose packed with fresh redcurrants, dark cherries, and wild raspberries, complexed by savory elements of cracked black pepper, wet stone minerality, smoky oak, and dried flowers. The palate is medium-bodied yet densely textured, balancing the classic, muscular structure and fine-grained tannins characteristic of the Dugat-Py style with a vibrant, refreshing core of acidity. While incredibly expressive in its youth, its balance and concentration ensure it will evolve gracefully over the next several years.

Food Pairing: Pan-seared duck breast, roasted pork tenderloin, Coq au Vin, wild mushroom risotto, or mild semi-hard cheeses like Comté.

claude-dugat-gevrey-chambertin.title: Domaine Claude Dugat Gevrey-Chambertin 2022
claude-dugat-gevrey-chambertin.bodyHtml:
Domaine Claude Dugat Gevrey-Chambertin 2022 is an exceptional, highly sought-after village-level red wine crafted from low-yielding old vines in the Côte de Nuits region of Burgundy. Domaine Claude Dugat is renowned for producing concentrated, extraordinarily precise, and structured Pinot Noir. On the nose, it offers an expressive bouquet of dark cherries, wild raspberries, red plums, violet, earthy forest floor, and subtle baking spice. The palate is medium- to full-bodied with a succulent core of ripe red and dark fruits, supported by vibrant acidity, fine-grained tannins, and a long, mineral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck, grilled lamb chops, game birds, boeuf bourguignon, wild mushroom risotto, and aged Comté or Époisses cheese.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Aromas of sweet cherries, berries, spices and licorice introduce the 2022 Gevrey-Chambertin Village, a medium to full-bodied, bright and fleshy wine with a lively core of fruit, sweet tannins and a youthfully chalky finish. This lands somewhere between the 2017 and 2019 in style.

claude-dugat-gevrey-chambertin-la-marie.title: Domaine Claude Dugat Gevrey-Chambertin 2022
claude-dugat-gevrey-chambertin-la-marie.bodyHtml:
Domaine Claude Dugat Gevrey-Chambertin 2022 is an exceptional, highly sought-after village-level red wine crafted from low-yielding old vines in the Côte de Nuits region of Burgundy. Domaine Claude Dugat is renowned for producing concentrated, extraordinarily precise, and structured Pinot Noir. On the nose, it offers an expressive bouquet of dark cherries, wild raspberries, red plums, violet, earthy forest floor, and subtle baking spice. The palate is medium- to full-bodied with a succulent core of ripe red and dark fruits, supported by vibrant acidity, fine-grained tannins, and a long, mineral-tinged finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted duck, grilled lamb chops, game birds, boeuf bourguignon, wild mushroom risotto, and aged Comté or Époisses cheese.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Aromas of sweet cherries, berries, spices and licorice introduce the 2022 Gevrey-Chambertin Village, a medium to full-bodied, bright and fleshy wine with a lively core of fruit, sweet tannins and a youthfully chalky finish. This lands somewhere between the 2017 and 2019 in style.

claude-dugat-charmes-chambertin-gc.title: Claude Dugat Charmes Chambertin Gc 750ml
claude-dugat-charmes-chambertin-gc.bodyHtml: The Claude Dugat Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru 750ml is a highly regarded Burgundy wine from the Gevrey-Chambertin region, renowned for its powerful and expressive Pinot Noir wines. This Grand Cru wine is characterized by its full-bodied, layered flavors with notes of red fruit, warm earth, and spice, often accompanied by a long, perfumed finish. It's known for its ability to age gracefully, developing complex aromas of musk, truffle, and forest floor over time.

sokol-blosser-evolution-pinot-noir.title: Sokol Blosser Evolution Pinot Noir 2022
sokol-blosser-evolution-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
The Willamette Valley never fails to produce beautiful fruit flavors in its Pinot. This wine is packed with bright red fruit flavors, warm baking spices, and a hint of savory mushroom.

A foodies delight, this wine pairs with darn near everything! Pumpkin chipotle soup, glazed pork chops, wild mushroom risotto, even a decadent dark chocolate torte!

92 Points - James Suckling

The nose exhibits red fruit and a hint of iron. Lively flavors of raspberry, bright red cherries and red currants on the palate. Medium-bodied with mellow tannins. Warm and earthy finish.

appleton-estate-hearts-collection-1993.title: Appleton Estate 21 Year Old Nassau Valley Casks Rum
appleton-estate-hearts-collection-1993.bodyHtml:
Appleton Estate Nassau Valley Casks 21 Year Old rum is a luxury, dark Jamaican rum masterfully crafted by Master Blender Joy Spence. A meticulous blend of rare pot and column still rums, each aged individually for a minimum of 21 years in the tropical climate of Jamaica's Nassau Valley. The extended barrel aging delivers exceptional complexity, seamlessly marrying oak tannins, dark cocoa, and spice with signature Jamaican fruit and floral notes without added sugar or sweeteners.

Food Pairing: Fine dark chocolate, artisanal charcuterie, roasted macadamia nuts, dry-aged ribeye steak, stilton or blue cheese, and dried figs or dates.

Tasting Notes : Deep copper in appearance, with a rich, velvety, and mouth-coating feel that showcases supreme balance and tropical complexity.

Nose : Floral blossom, rich vanilla, orange peel, fresh espresso beans, toasted almond, dark cocoa, and subtle tobacco leaf.

Palate : Complex layers of brown sugar, dried fruit, dark chocolate, baking spices, walnuts, and toasted oak, complemented by subtle hints of ripe banana and orange zest.

Finish : Long, dry, and elegant, characterized by lingering oak tannins, dark cocoa, sweet spices, and a touch of peppery warmth.

Serve : Serve neat or with a few drops of limestone water in a snifter or Glencairn glass.

appleton-estate-hearts-collection-2002.title: Appleton Estate Hearts Collection 2002 20 Year Old Rum
appleton-estate-hearts-collection-2002.bodyHtml:
Introduced by Master Blender Joy Spence and rum expert Luca Gargano, Hearts Collection is a very rare and limited collection of 100% pot-still single marque rums from Appleton Estate’s legendary inventory.

Distilled in 2002 and bottled in 2022, aged for 20 tropical years in the climate of Jamaica (63% ABV).

The Hearts Collection, an exclusive limited release of 100% pot still single marque rums, is the untamed essence of Appleton Estate. Each vintage is the heart of the distillates, showcasing the diversity of the Estate’s unique nectars across decades, thanks to its exclusive aged inventory.

Single Proprietary Marque for Each Vintage. Most expert rum makers, including Appleton Estate, blend different marques together to create various expressions seen today. What makes Hearts Collection different from other single-marque rums is that the collection was distilled in a Forsyth Pot Still, aged between 18-37 years – compared to the traditional 10-12-year-old single-marque rums on the market – and each proprietary marque was chosen specifically by Master Blender Joy Spence.

glenallachie-2012-vintage-cuvee-winecask.title: The GlenAllachie 2012 Vintage Cuvee Wine Cask Finish
glenallachie-2012-vintage-cuvee-winecask.bodyHtml:
To craft The GlenAllachie Wine Cask Series, Master Blender Billy Walker first expertly matured our spirit in the finest American oak ex-Bourbon barrels, before transferring the whisky into hand-selected European wine barriques for secondary aging. Billy added a distinctive twist to this release by ultimately blending four exceptional wine cask finishes into one unique expression: The Cuvée Wine Cask Finish.

A French term, ‘Cuvée’ is used in the wine sector to reference a blend that typically comprises more than one variety of grape. Likewise, our 9-year-old Cuvée is a marriage of spirit from several fine wine casks sourced from the world-renowned regions of Bordeaux, Languedoc and Valpolicella.

The character development of each individual barrique was carefully monitored, before the whiskies were expertly blended together by Billy. The resulting golden liquid offers up elegant stone fruits, hints of toasted almonds and zesty orange peel on the palate.

This limited expression is bottled unchilfiltered for flavour with no added colouring at 48% ABV.

glenallachie-10-yo-cask-strength-batch-9.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 9 58.1% ABV
glenallachie-10-yo-cask-strength-batch-9.bodyHtml: Since 2017 the Glenallachie distillery has been the playground of master distiller Billy Walker – a 50-year veteran in the Scotch whisky industry. As one of his pride and joy – each batch of Glenallachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength works as a guidepost for the next step of the distillery’s journey. Batch 9 is a marriage of whiskies aged for a minimum of 10 years in a combination of Pedro Ximenez, oloroso, Rioja, and medium-toasted American oak barrels. Bottled at natural cask strength of 58.1%, this whisky has classic sherried notes of dark chocolate and dried fruits, coupled with sweet spices and red berries – and a kick.

glenallachie-7-yo-hungarian-virgin-oak.title: The GlenAllachie 7 Year Old Hungarian Virgin Oak
glenallachie-7-yo-hungarian-virgin-oak.bodyHtml:
From Batch 3 of our Virgin Oak Series, we are proud to present an innovative single malt which enjoyed secondary aging in Hungarian oak. Master Distiller Billy Walker’s search for the unusual led him to the mountains of northeast Hungary to the Zemplén forest. Its rocky volcanic soil, along with its colder climate and higher altitude, means that the trees in this region grow very slowly, giving the oak a tight grain – a desirable trait for aging spirit.

Keen to experiment with this rare oak, the barrels were toasted and charred to a medium level before hosting our complex spirit. One of the world’s first single malts finished in Hungarian virgin oak (Quercus Petraea), expect an aromatic, well-balanced and wonderfully unique whisky delivering silky smooth richness.

Bottled at 48%, natural colour and non chill filtered.

glenallachie-8-yo-scottish-oak.title: The GlenAllachie 8 Year Old Scottish Oak
glenallachie-8-yo-scottish-oak.bodyHtml:
From Batch 3 of our Virgin Oak Series, we are proud to present a rare single malt which underwent additional maturation in casks made of Scottish Sessile Oak (Quercus Petrae), sourced from the Atlantic coast. Scottish oak is incredibly challenging to work with at all stages of production: growing, milling and coopering. Its rarity, costliness and tendency to knot mean it is scarcely used for whisky maturation.

Before being filled, the wood was air dried for 36 months, then toasted and charred to a medium level. Despite presenting difficulties, this desirable oak imparts luxurious notes of blonde chocolate, with hints of zesty orange and smooth toffee to offer a truly unique drinking experience.

Bottled at 48%, natural colour and non chill filtered.

glenallachie-10-year-old-spanish-oak.title: The GlenAllachie 10 Year Old Spanish Oak 48%
glenallachie-10-year-old-spanish-oak.bodyHtml:
From Batch 3 of our Virgin Oak Series, this mahogany malt obtains its spicy, treacly flavours from maturation in hogsheads made of Spanish Oak (Quercus Robur). This particular wood was sourced from the regions of Galicia and Asturias, specifically from the forests of the Cantabrian Mountains, which have a cool, humid climate.

The oak was air dried for around 18 months and then toasted and charred to a medium level, opening up the oak to allow our complex spirit to extract its cask character. The secondary ageing in these virgin casks deepened the mahogany hue of the whisky and created a palate rich with dried fruits, maraschino cherries and hints of stem ginger.

Bottled at 48%, natural colour and non chill filtered.

glenallachie-white-heather-15-yo.title: The GlenAllachie White Heather 15 Year Old
glenallachie-white-heather-15-yo.bodyHtml:
Promising Complex Layers Of Butterscotch, Ripe Fruits, Mocha And Gentle Puffs Of Peat Smoke

Marrying The Finest Speyside, Islay And North Highland Single Malts With Specially Selected Grain Whiskies, White Heather 15-Year-Old
Elivers A Full-Bodied Whisky With Exceptional Balance Between Honeyed Sweetness And Subtle Peat Smoke.

Undertaking A Complex Dual Maturation System, The Whisky Began Its Life In American Ex-Bourbon Barrels And Hogsheads, As Well As A Quantity Of Spanish Sherry Butts. Once Carefully Blended, The Spirit Was Re-Racked Into Specially Selected Pedro Ximénez And Oloroso Puncheons, Along With American Virgin Oak Casks, To Enjoy Secondary Maturation At The Glenallachie Distillery. Experienced Master Blender Billy Walker Frequently Monitored The Spirit Development To Ensure Optimal Flavour Experience Was Achieved.

White Heather 15-Year-Old Is Proudly Presented At A High Strength Of 46% Abv, Natural Colour And Non Chill Filtered, Allowing The Quality Of The Liquid Within Every Bottle To Speak For Itself.

macnairs-lum-reek-10-yo-cask-strengthb2.title: MacNair's Lum Reek 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 2
macnairs-lum-reek-10-yo-cask-strengthb2.bodyHtml:
MacNair’s Boutique House of Spirits, a brand curated by acclaimed blender Billy Walker, has launched the next iteration of its decade-old Blended Malt Scotch Whisky: Lum Reek 10-year-old Cask Strength Batch 2.

The brand gets its name from the old Scottish toast to a long and healthy life, ‘lang may yer lum reek’, literally meaning ‘long may your chimney smoke’.

The second instalment combines single malt whiskies from two of the most sought-after regions in Scotland: Speyside and Islay.

With peated and unpeated spirit contained in the blend, the flavour profile is said to entail “gentle smoke and sweet spice in perfect harmony”.

Each aged single malt component was carefully selected by Walker to deliver specific desired sensory characteristics to the final blend, which includes GlenAllachie Speyside Scotch whisky.

Once skillfully blended, the spirit was filled to a mix of Sherry, red wine and virgin oak casks for an additional aging period; picking up further character from the wood and allowing the whiskies time to marry.

MacNair’s Lum Reek 10-year-old Cask Strength Batch 2 – 55.8% ABV

Colour: Rich Mahogany.
Nose: Waves of grilled honeycomb, ginger and vanilla, with cinnamon, campfire smoke and treacle.
Taste: Bursting with dark chocolate, burnt orange peel and honeycomb, followed by smoked spices, butterscotch and roasted coffee beans, with notes of ginger on the finish.

glenallachie-2012-cuvee-wine-cask.title: The GlenAllachie 2012 Vintage Cuvee Wine Cask 700ml
glenallachie-2012-cuvee-wine-cask.bodyHtml:
To craft The GlenAllachie Wine Cask Series, Master Blender Billy Walker first expertly matured our spirit in the finest American oak ex-Bourbon barrels, before transferring the whisky into hand-selected European wine barriques for secondary aging. Billy added a distinctive twist to this release by ultimately blending four exceptional wine cask finishes into one unique expression: The Cuvée Wine Cask Finish.

A French term, ‘Cuvée’ is used in the wine sector to reference a blend that typically comprises more than one variety of grape. Likewise, our 9-year-old Cuvée is a marriage of spirit from several fine wine casks sourced from the world-renowned regions of Bordeaux, Languedoc and Valpolicella.

The character development of each individual barrique was carefully monitored, before the whiskies were expertly blended together by Billy. The resulting golden liquid offers up elegant stone fruits, hints of toasted almonds and zesty orange peel on the palate.

This limited expression is bottled unchilfiltered for flavour with no added colouring at 48% ABV.

chalk-hill-sonoma-coast-chardonnay.title: Chalk Hill Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2024
chalk-hill-sonoma-coast-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Chalk Hill Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2024 is an opulent, expressive, and beautifully balanced California white that expertly highlights the cool-climate character of the rugged Sonoma Coast. Poured into a glass, it displays a brilliant pale gold hue. The nose is instantly captivating, delivering a fragrant bouquet of ripe white peaches, crisp yellow apples, and fresh lemon zest, underpinned by delicate nuances of honeysuckle, toasted almonds, and vanilla bean. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and mouth-filling, balancing a generous, creamy texture with a driving vein of vibrant, juicy natural acidity. Succulent orchard and stone fruit flavors melt into notes of light pastry crust and a refined, clean mineral finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with butter-poached scallops, creamy fettuccine Alfredo, roasted herb chicken, or soft cheeses like double-cream Brie.

93 Points - James Suckling

Fruit-forward and opulent, showing juicy acidity and flavors of white peaches. A mouth-filling, weighty, full-bodied wine. Generous and satisfying with a big burst of flavor and a clean finish.

kim-crawford-illuminate-rose.title: Kim Crawford Illuminate Rose
kim-crawford-illuminate-rose.bodyHtml: Award-winning and iconic Kim Crawford Winery introduces a lower alcohol rosé. Using 'spinning cone' technology, alcohol is lowered to 7% without compromising flavour! Enjoy tones of watermelon, berries and flowers. Pale pink with crisp acidity and a dry, elegant finish. You'll love this with a summer salad.

north-star-caol-ila-8yo-charity-bottling.title: North Star Caol Ila 8 Year Old Charity Bottling
north-star-caol-ila-8yo-charity-bottling.bodyHtml:
8 year old single malt from North Star Spirits distilled at Caol Ila distillery. Bottled from a refill butt at 51% abv. Proceeds from each bottle go to CHAS (Children’s Hospices Across Scotland). 600 bottles were produced.

Tasting Notes
Nose: Peated aniseed with burnt orange slices.

Palate: Citrusy soot & ash.

Finish: Medicinal salty marmalade.

whisky-sponge-glenlivet-2007.title: Cadenhead's Original Collection Glen Moray-Glenlivet 16 Year Old 2007
whisky-sponge-glenlivet-2007.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead's Original Collection Glen Moray-Glenlivet 16 Year Old 2007 is an independently bottled Speyside single malt Scotch whisky highlighting the soft, fruit-forward character of Glen Moray Distillery. Distilled in 2007 and matured for 16 years in Bourbon casks, it was bottled by William Cadenhead in May 2024 at 46% ABV. The long Bourbon maturation brings together ripe fruit, vanilla-rich sweetness, nuts and creamy dessert notes with warming cocoa and cinnamon spice. 

Food Pairing: Pair with roast chicken, baked Brie, toasted walnuts, crème brûlée, banana bread or vanilla sponge cake.

Tasting Notes: Soft and fruity with ripe banana, creamy vanilla, caramelized dessert notes, nuts and warming spice.

Nose: Ripe banana, banana sweets, light muscovado sugar, walnuts and icing sugar.

Palate: Crème brûlée, white chocolate, vanilla sponge and subtle earthy notes.

Finish: Cocoa powder, cinnamon sticks and warming spice.

whisky-sponge-jura-27-yr.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No. 97 Jura 1994 30 Year Old Refill Hogshead
whisky-sponge-jura-27-yr.bodyHtml:
This is Whisky Sponge Edition No.97, it is a 30 year old, single refill hogshead of 1994 Isle of Jura single malt, bottled at natural cask strength.  

This bottling is paired with Whisky Sponge Edition No.96: a single 1st fill barrel of Bruichladdich 2005, also bottled at natural cask strength.  

Both these casks spent their entire life maturing at their respective distilleries on their islands of origin. As we hit the final run of our Whisky Sponge series, we wanted to focus on and celebrate the distilleries and profiles we really love. And there aren’t many places as close to our hearts as Islay and Jura. We deliberately looked for two single casks from these two beautiful Islands which were both unpeated and which had both matured fully on the Islands. We are pretty delighted with the results, and we feel it forms part of a fitting final run of Sponges.  

This is pure, distillate-driven, old school, charismatic, well-aged Jura. Like a bone-dry, old Chenin Blanc, it is pure, mineral, waxy, herbaceous and complex whisky that balances delicacy and elegance with vivid coastal and Island character.  

*Specially rescued from the tentacles of the Caramel Kraken for your pleasure and delectation.*

glen-garioch-10-year-48-5-abv.title: Decadent Drinks Equinox & Solstice Summer 2022 Edition Glen Garioch 10 Year Old 2011 48.5% ABV
glen-garioch-10-year-48-5-abv.bodyHtml:
Glen Garioch 10 Year Old is the Summer 2022 release of Equinox & Solstice, the seasonal single malt series from independent bottler Decadent Drinks. It was distilled in 2011 at Glen Garioch in the Highlands, matured in two first-fill bourbon barrels and bottled at 10 years of age at the series’ signature 48.5% ABV in a 700ml bottle. The bottlers picked it as a young, full-flavoured Highland malt with plenty of old-school personality and body: waxy, naturally sweet and easy to drink. The label artwork is by Sutherland-based artist Melissa Nash, whose work draws on ecology, the natural world and Celtic folklore.

Tasting Notes: Full-bodied, waxy and naturally sweet.

Serve: Neat, with a splash of water, or lengthened into a refreshing highball.

whisky-sponge-springbank-1995-27-year.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.60B Springbank 1995 26 Year Old 51.1% ABV
whisky-sponge-springbank-1995-27-year.bodyHtml:
A follow up cask to edition 60a, 60b is a 1995 refill Americal oak hogshead. Aged for 26 years and bottled at natural cask strength of 51.1% with an outturn of 249 bottles.

Stunningly fresh, coastal and waxy with gentle notes of citrus fruits and old style peat smoke.

Just perfect!

whisky-sponge-glen-garioch-1991.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.65 Glen Garioch 1991 30 Year Old 41.4% ABV
whisky-sponge-glen-garioch-1991.bodyHtml:
Whisky Sponge Edition No.65A is a 30 year old Glen Garioch 1991 bottled at natural cask strength of 41.4%.

We don't normally like port influence in our whiskies, but this was an altogether different proposition. Matured for its initial 10 years in a refill hogshead, this whisky was then transferred to a 1st fill port barrique for a further 20 years of maturation - thus making it well and truly a proper double maturation. 

The robust Glen Garioch malt pairs very well with a rich, active, sticky sweet, unctuous and slightly tart port cask. The result is a mature, dark and luscious old single malt, at a naturally quaffable drinking strength and displaying many of the characteristics found in older style sherried malts with a lot of dark sticky fruit, chocolate and rancio qualities. 

A delicious and very silly whisky that should probably be enjoyed while wearing extremely comfortable slippers within a radius of no more than 10 meters of a modest log fire.

whisky-sponge-highland-malt-1993.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No.76 Ardmore 24 Year Old 1997 Refill Hogshead 52.4% ABV
whisky-sponge-highland-malt-1993.bodyHtml:
Since the dawn of creation, conscious beings have been asking themselves one thing: why does Ardmore taste like the smelly matter you find in Scottish farmyards...? 

The answer to this question has eluded the greatest scientific minds in the cosmos. Mayans, Vulcans, Time Lords, Vogons and David Attenborough have all tried, and failed, to discover the pungent truth. 

All we can do is play Sponge scrabble and ruminate deeply and profoundly, on the sheer number of silly toilet-centric words you can invent in association with Ardmore and all its bum-scented glory. 

Please enjoy this extremely classical 25 year old Ardmore that has been matured full term in a withered old refill hogshead and bottled at natural cask strength, thus retaining its maximum dung-addled distillate potency.

Headily yours

Whisky Sponge 

PS: you may also be interested to compare this bottling with Whisky Sponge Edition No.69, which is also a highly delicious old Ardmore, except that one is drenched in sticky, dark, gooey old sherry. Why not buy both of them and guzzle both bottles simultaneously at a festive dinner party? Enjoy the looks upon your friends and family's faces as you cackle, splutter and gurgle your way through the bottles. Thrill to their gasping intakes of breath as the viscous nectars drizzle and blend their way in rivulets down your chin and pool upon the platters of partially consumed pigs in blankets... Just an idea.

whisky-sponge-highland-park-1998.title: Decadent Drinks Whisky Sponge Edition No. 58A Ben Nevis 25 Year Old 1996 Refill Butt 53% ABV
whisky-sponge-highland-park-1998.bodyHtml:
This is a hyper-distillate driven, almost ideologically 'refill' profile Ben Nevis 1996. You have been warned! 

However, for those of you who also enjoy this extremely pure, naked and invigorating style of highland malt whisky - you shall find yourself contorted with satisfaction. 

For this edition, the Sponge interviews his older self about his successes, failures and unrequited vengeances. You'll have to wait until next year, when we bottle the other half of this cask, to find out what his answers are...

The first half of this stark-naked refill butt has been bottled reduced to 53% to bring out a slightly fruitier style on the palate. Next year we will likely do the rest at cask strength. If civilisation remains moderately intact. Stay tuned...

whisky-sponge-dailuaine-1997-48-8-abv.title: Whisky Sponge Edition No.64 Dailuane 1997 25 Year Old 48.8% ABV
whisky-sponge-dailuaine-1997-48-8-abv.bodyHtml:
Whisky Sponge Edition No.64 is a mix of two refill hogsheads of 1997 Dailuaine, bottled at natural cask strength of 48.8% after 25 years of maturation. 

A rather lush and juicy example of Dailuaine. Classic, fuller-bodied Speyside in style with sweet biscuity richness, yellow fruits and soft, peppery waxiness. Two reasonably low-volume hoggies were mashed together and this is the rather delectable 25 year old result. Shows plenty maturity at a hyper-gluggable natural strength without any overt woody elements. Braw! 

Please enjoy this Dailuaine quietly in a forest glade while wearing a cape and pretending you are in an expensive cinema advert for life insurance.

cognac-sponge-grand-champagne-72-502.title: Decadent Drinks Cognac Sponge Edition No. 6 Grosperrin Heritage N.72 Grande Champagne 50.2% ABV
cognac-sponge-grand-champagne-72-502.bodyHtml:
Cognac Sponge Edition No.6 is a Heritage 72 Grande Champagne cognac, one of 180 bottles from a single cask at natural cask strength of 50.2%. 

If our 1972 Armagnac could be equated to an old Glen Grant, this rather more subtle, fine-boned and complex old Grande Champagne Cognac of similar pedigree could be said to resemble a venerable aged Linkwood or Strathisla. Anyway, all you whisky hoarding grainiacs should stop messing about with whisky (except our bottlings, naturally) and give these Cognacs a spin! Dried fruits, earths, tobacco and rancio with a slender drizzle of honey over the top - there are abundant pleasures to be had with these old spirits.

wild-rose-big-hoodoo-lager.title: Wild Rose The Hoppy Herd Mix Pack 8 Tall Cans
wild-rose-big-hoodoo-lager.bodyHtml:
Wild Rose The Hoppy Herd Mix Pack 8 Tall Cans is a diverse craft beer collection produced by Wild Rose Brewery in Calgary, Alberta. Featuring two 473 mL tall cans of four distinct hop-forward styles—Alberta Slammer Tropical Pale Ale, Horns in the Haze New England IPA, Sun Scout Hazy India Session Ale, and IPA (Industrial Park Ale)—this mix pack showcases a wide spectrum of hoppy flavor profiles ranging from juicy citrus and tropical fruit to crisp, resinous pine and sessionable haze.

Food Pairing: Spicy barbecue, bacon cheeseburgers, buffalo chicken wings, sharp cheddar cheese, or fish tacos.

Tasting Notes : Ranging from straw gold to hazy orange and deep amber across the four styles, featuring lively carbonation and medium-light to full, mouth-coating textures.

Nose : A complex bouquet of tropical mango, passionfruit, juicy citrus zest, sweet stone fruit, pine resin, and toasted malt.

Palate : Dynamic and hop-forward, delivering notes of juicy tropical fruit, bright grapefruit, sweet malt backbone, soft oat smooth haze, and crisp, piney hop bitterness.

Finish : Clean, dry, and refreshing with lingering hop bitterness, tropical fruit notes, and a crisp malt finish.

Serve : Serve well-chilled in a tulip or IPA glass to release hop aromatics, or straight from a cold tall can.

bud-light-seltzer-hardsoda-mixer12x355ml.title: Bud Light Seltzer Hard Soda Variety Pack 12 Cans
bud-light-seltzer-hardsoda-mixer12x355ml.bodyHtml: Bud Light Seltzer Hard Soda Variety Pack 12 Cans

compass-box-peat-monster-cask-strength.title: Compass Box The Peat Monster
compass-box-peat-monster-cask-strength.bodyHtml:
For 2019, The Peat Monster has a new label. Featuring this quite marvellous specially-commissioned painting, all batches released going forward will showcase the new artwork. It isn’t just the packaging that is different, however: the recipe has evolved, too.

Still very much the whisky for those who love big, rich, smoky-peaty malts, our latest version of THE PEAT MONSTER is older and more elegant than before.

Inspired by feedback from smoky whisky lovers, our new Painting Label of THE PEAT MONSTER incorporates single malts with a more aromatic and graceful style of smokiness. We have sought to retain the peaty intensity for which THE PEAT MONSTER has long been celebrated, whilst creating a depth and elegance not seen before.

New batches of THE PEAT MONSTER boast a spectrum of powerful coastal flavours, combining the smokiness of a driftwood fire with more medicinal peat notes. Orchard fruits and rich cask-derived creaminess balance the multi-layered smoke. It is a new peaty landscape, as the Painting Label shows.

The evolution is a subtle one. We hope you will hunt down both labels and enjoy teasing out the contrasts.

compass-box-delos.title: Compass Box Delos Blended Scotch Whisky
compass-box-delos.bodyHtml:
Compass Box Delos Blended Scotch Whisky is part of Compass Box's Extinct Blends Quartet, which reappraises four very different styles of blended Scotch using some of the company's most precious parcels of whisky. Delos captures the vibrancy and soothing sweetness of Asyla, first created in 2001 and a cornerstone of the Compass Box core range until its retirement in 2018, using older stocks.

It is named after the island of Delos, with its mosaics and ruined ancient temples. Malt whiskies from the Glen Elgin, Imperial and Miltonduff distilleries, all from American oak barrels, bring exotic fruit and vanilla notes, while fragrant grain whisky preserves the delicate mouthfeel that was Asyla's hallmark.

hundred-acre-dark-ark-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Hundred Acre Ark Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
hundred-acre-dark-ark-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml:
Stunning with a deep garnet color and aromas of blueberry pie and baked plums layered with savory notes of grilled meats, roasted lamb and tilled earth. The full-bodied palate has opulent black fruit with a firm, velvety body that finishes long and fresh.

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Ark Vineyard features beguiling scents of Montreal-style smoked meat backed by waves of black cherries and cassis. It's full-bodied, rich, plush and expansive on the palate, captivating for its mix of savory and fruity flavors. Offering tons of fun in the glass, this finishes long and tannic but also smoothly silky. It's a complete wine by any measure.

louis-m-martini-lot-1-napa-cabernet.title: Louis M. Martini Lot 1 Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 750ml
louis-m-martini-lot-1-napa-cabernet.bodyHtml:
The pinnacle of our portfolio, Lot No. 1 is Cabernet Sauvignon at its peak form of expression. This wine showcases standout blocks from iconic Napa Valley vineyards, resulting in a blend that exhibits power, depth and intensity with a discernible measure of polish and elegance. On the nose, the 2018 vintage showcases enticing aromas of wild blackberries, cocoa and toasted oak supported by notes of brown spice and humidor. The rich, plush palate boasts flavors of shaved chocolate and reduced blackberry compote with hints of cinnamon. The long finish reveals classic oak character and plush tannins.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Very deep purple-black, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Lot 1 explodes from the glass with vibrant black cherries, mulberries and redcurrant jelly scents followed by a core of crème de cassis, cedar chest and roses plus hints of chocolate box and fragrant earth. Full-bodied, the palate delivers impactful, mouth-coating black fruits with a firm structure of grainy tannins and bold freshness, finishing long with some mineral sparks coming through.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

This has a frankly toasty note overlaying rich cassis, plum and boysenberry compote flavors, while licorice root, loam and roasted mesquite notes fill in on the finish. Not shy in the muscular approach. For fans of the style. Best from 2023 through 2036.

91 Points - James Suckling

This is a firm and structured red with blackberry, conifer and chocolate character. It’s full-bodied, yet tight and poised. Lots of dark fruit at the end and chewy tannins. 61% mountain fruit and 39% valley-floor. Long finish. Dry at the end. A little hot from the high alcohol. Retro-styled. Try in 2023.

orin-swift-papillon.title: Orin Swift Cellars Papillon 2021
orin-swift-papillon.bodyHtml:
The 2021 Papillon fills the glass with an unmistakable dark crimson, a flash of neon purple and a ruby rim. Tears move glacially and the wine opens with aromatics of boysenberry jam, violets, chocolate covered blueberry and hints of Cara Cara rind, graphite and brioche. The entry and mid-palate are bright throughout with considerable weight—tones of cassis, blackberry and baking spices flourish. Enveloping texture, chalky, drying tannins and an enduring finish bows out the wine.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of five Bordeaux varieties, the 2021 Papillon Red Wine is marked by scents of mint, crushed stone, cassis and black cherries. It's full-bodied and expansive, framed by ripe, silky tannins, then finishes long and mouthwatering. With more than 35,000 cases produced and a street price as much as $20 below the suggested retail, it's a wine that should win the Orin Swift brand many fans.

90 Points - James Suckling
Lots of delicious, juicy fruit with spices and berries. Medium to full body, affective, fresh and clean, but a little straightforward.

castiglion-del-bosco-prima-pietra.title: Castiglion del Bosco Prima Pietra 2020
castiglion-del-bosco-prima-pietra.bodyHtml:
Castiglion del Bosco Prima Pietra 2020 is an elegant and powerful Super Tuscan crafted from the highest coastal vineyards in Riparbella, Tuscany, situated at an elevation of 450 meters. This organically farmed, Bordeaux-inspired blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot is meticulously vinified and aged for 18 months in French oak barriques. In the glass, it pours a deep ruby-red color with vibrant purple reflections. The bouquet is broad and complex, offering intense aromas of dark cherries, ripe plums, and cassis, beautifully woven with notes of dark chocolate, cedar, and subtle Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, the wine is muscular yet exceptionally harmonious, delivering a concentrated core of dark berry fruit framed by lively acidity and dense, velvety tannins that culminate in a long, incredibly refined finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, roasted wild game, robust beef stews, and matured aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

94 Points - James Suckling

A very muscular red with blackcurrant, black berry, stone and mineral aromas and flavors. Full-bodied yet tightens down with firm and racy tannins and a long and flavorful finish. This cabernet-based coastal wine will age beautifully. Try after 2028.

ruinart-blanc-de-blanc-magnum.title: Ruinart Brut Blanc de Blancs
ruinart-blanc-de-blanc-magnum.bodyHtml:
A supple, harmonious attack on the palate, firm but rounded. A voluptuous texture and vinosity that is not excessive, supported by excellent freshness. A very refreshing mineral finish.

At first very intense on the nose, giving way to fresh fruit notes, particularly ripe citrus and exotic fruits (pineapple). A highly refined floral second nose with notes of linden and white fruits (white peach).

Beautiful pale yellow color with glints of gold and green, a vibrant, luminous color. Active effervescence with a fine, persistent release of bubbles.

Ruinart Blanc de Blancs is a champagne for all occasions: aperitifs, lunch, dinner or celebratory meals. The vivacity is a perfect complement to seafood and white fish, pairing perfectly with dishes such as sea scallop carpaccio and sea bream tartare.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Ruinart is a specialist in Blanc de Blancs Champagne. This wine is finely balanced between maturity and taut fresh, mineral-driven fruit.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A toasty blanc de blanc with an aromatic overtone of smoke and lemon peel notes accenting flavors of poached apricot, brioche, passion fruit coulis and fresh thyme. Fine and creamy in texture, with a racy finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Lemon tart, grapefruit and almonds on the nose, followed by a rounded, silky palate with soft bubbles. Pretty lemon curd and vanilla flavors to close.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Based on the 2019 vintage and disgorged in 2022, Ruinart's newly released NV Blanc de Blancs bursts with characteristically reductive aromas of yellow orchard fruit, citrus oil, iodine and toasted bread. Medium-bodied, pillowy and fleshy, with lively acids and a saline finish, it is an attractive Champagne that incorporates 20% reserve wines.

cognac-hors-dage-cognac.title: Leyrat XO Hors d'Age Cognac
cognac-hors-dage-cognac.bodyHtml:
Produced at the Domaine de Chez Maillard in the Single Estate tradition of the Single Estate Cognac house Domaine Leyrat, this XO Hors d'Age is an exceptional single-estate cognac from the Fins Bois cru. Distilled exclusively from Ugni Blanc grapes grown, fermented, distilled, aged, and bottled entirely on the estate premises in the Charente region of France, this release showcases old stock matured for decades in Limousin oak casks. The unique microclimate and chalky terroir of the estate grant this cognac remarkable elegance and finesse, delivering complex layers of dried fruit, candied citrus, acacia honey, pastry spice, and rich oak rancio.

Food Pairing: Aged Comte cheese, dark chocolate tarts, crème brûlée, roasted figs with honey, or enjoyed alongside a fine cigar.

Tasting Notes: Deep mahogany with brilliant old-gold and amber reflexes, displaying rich body and heavy, slow-moving legs along the glass.

Nose: Sophisticated and multi-layered, opening with dried apricot, candied orange peel, and acacia honey, followed by toasted hazelnut, vanilla bean, old leather, and delicate floral jasmin with noble oak rancio.

Palate: Silky, rich, and impeccably balanced on the palate, featuring sweet dried figs, dark plum, and butterscotch upfront before developing into soft oak tannins, nutmeg, cinnamon, and subtle tobacco leaf.

Finish: Unusually long, warm, and refined with lingering notes of candied fruit, sweet wood spice, toasted nuts, and a dry, lingering rancio finish.

Serve: Enjoy neat at room temperature in a tulip glass as a fine digestif, letting the glass rest for several minutes to allow its aged estate bouquet to fully unfold.

craigellachie-17-year-old.title: Craigellachie 17 Year Old
craigellachie-17-year-old.bodyHtml:
Craigellachie 17 Year Old is a richly complex and robust Speyside single malt that builds beautifully upon the distillery's famously meaty and distinctive character. Retaining the traditional use of oil-fired malt and old-fashioned worm tub condensers, this expression benefits from an extended 17-year maturation process in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks. The extra time in oak elegantly mellows its signature savory and faintly sulphury edge, elevating notes of exotic roasted pineapple, sweet vanilla, and rich oak spice. Bottled at 46% ABV without chill-filtration or added coloring, it is a heavy, old-school whisky with remarkable depth and character.

Food Pairing: Glazed roast pork, smoked sausages, rich fruitcake, mature cheddar, or roasted root vegetables.

Tasting Notes : Deep golden amber in appearance with a noticeably thick, waxy, and luxurious mouthfeel.

Nose : Complex and expressive, intertwining sweet aromas of baked apple, roasted pineapple, and vanilla with a distinctive savory, meaty undertone and a faint, alluring hint of struck match or sulfur.
