Palate : Rich, viscous, and deeply flavorful, opening with sweet notes of tropical fruits, honey, and toasted oats, before evolving into complex layers of clove, licorice, subtle wood smoke, and a savory, meaty backbone.

Finish : Long, warming, and waxy, leaving lingering impressions of sweet oak, dried fruit, and a gentle savory smoke.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn glass to fully appreciate its bold complexity, or add a few drops of water to tame the sulfur notes and enhance the tropical fruitiness.

dom-de-la-janasse-cnp-vieille-vignes.title: Domaine E.A.R.L. George Chablis Vieilles Vignes 2023
dom-de-la-janasse-cnp-vieille-vignes.bodyHtml:
Domaine E.A.R.L. George Chablis Vieilles Vignes 2023 is a vibrant Chardonnay displaying aromas of green apple, lemon zest, white flowers, and oyster shell minerality. Old vines contribute extra depth and concentration, while crisp acidity and a long, saline finish showcase classic Chablis purity.

Food Pairing: Pair with oysters, grilled white fish, shrimp, scallops, goat cheese, or lemon herb chicken to highlight its bright minerality and freshness.

bayou-satsuma-rum-liqueur.title: Bayou Spiced Rum
bayou-satsuma-rum-liqueur.bodyHtml:
Bayou Spiced Rum is a Cajun-style spiced rum from Bayou Rum, a craft distillery in Lacassine, Louisiana that pot-distils in copper from locally grown sugarcane. The rum rests for up to 30 days with a delicate blend of spices inspired by Louisiana Creole baking - including three styles of natural vanilla, cinnamon and sweet figs - which give it a big flavour and an amber colour that holds up in cocktails. A multiple gold medal winner, it is also suggested for baking. Bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Cinnamon, banana, maple and Creole baking spice.

Nose: Sweet cinnamon and ripe banana.

Palate: Mild but complex: maple, banana, allspice, clove, vanilla and pepper.

Finish: Full, with lingering Creole baking spices.

Serve: With cola, or in long drinks with iced tea and lemonade.

licor-43-horchata.title: Licor 43 Horchata
licor-43-horchata.bodyHtml:
The delicate fusion of the traditional Horchata from Valencia & Licor 43 Original makes a deliciously light, silky Spanish liqueur: the extraordinary Licor 43 Orochata. Vegetable-based. Cream free. Low calorie. Gluten free.

Aromas of cinnamon, vanilla, white chocolate, hazelnuts, tiger nuts and nutmeg. With a silky mouthfeel, Orochata is slightly sweet with light spice nuances, cinnamon, nutmeg, and faint milk chocolate.The delicate fusion of the traditional Horchata from Valencia & Licor 43 Original makes a deliciously light, silky Spanish liqueur: the extraordinary Licor 43 Orochata. Vegetable-based. Cream free. Low calorie. Gluten free. Aromas of cinnamon, vanilla, white chocolate, hazelnuts, tiger nuts and nutmeg. With a silky mouthfeel, Orochata is slightly sweet with light spice nuances, cinnamon, nutmeg, and faint milk chocolate.

chateau-clinet.title: Chateau L'Eglise Clinet 2020
chateau-clinet.bodyHtml:
One of Pomerol's greatest estates, Château L'Église-Clinet is renowned for its extraordinary depth and finesse. It reveals captivating aromas of black cherry, blackberry, plum, truffle, violet, graphite, dark chocolate, and exotic spice. Intensely concentrated yet impeccably refined, it delivers velvety tannins, remarkable freshness, exceptional precision, and an extraordinarily long finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, Wagyu steak, roast lamb, duck breast, venison, black truffle dishes, wild mushrooms, aged Comté, or braised short ribs.

 

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 L'Eglise Clinet is a blend of 90% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Franc. The Merlot was picked between the 11th and the 14th of September, and the Cabernet Franc was picked on the 16th of September. It has an alcohol of 14.4% and is aging in French oak barrels, 80% new. Displaying and opaque purple-black color, it needs a bit of swirling to reveal a fascinating array of earthy notes—black truffles, charcoal, mossy tree bark and fallen leaves—over a profound core of preserved plums, blackberry preserves and violets, with a waft of tapenade. The medium to full-bodied palate has exquisitely ripe tannins and bold freshness supporting the seductively ripe, black fruit layers, finishing on a lingering fragrant earth note. 

98 Points - James Suckling

A linear and transparent red with violets and dark fruits with sliced tangerines. Full- to medium-bodied with firm and racy tannins. Brightness and energy. Hints of chocolate and malted milk. Lovely purity to it. Drink after 2026 and onwards.
97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

There's a clear jump from the second wine to the 2020 Château L'Eglise Clinet, a riveting Pomerol that checks in as 90% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Franc that spent 18 months in 80% new French oak. Offering a restrained, yet concentrated, structured style, it reveals classic notes of red and black currants, leafy tobacco, loamy earth, and chocolate. This carries to a full-bodied, powerful, tannic 2020 that needs a solid 7-8 years of bottle age. It's going to be long-lived but is not for those seeking instant gratification.

96 Points - Decanter

Noémie Durantou has taken over from her late father Denis with this vintage, and has produced a L'Eglise Clinet that is dark ruby in colour, and needs time in the glass as it is built and muscular. You need a little patience for the cassis, bilberry and raspberry fruits to arrange, enjoy instead the silky, velvety texture that stops the tannins being too restrictive and allows the palate to slowly expand. Not as expressive as in some vintages, but still exudes quiet confidence.

bask-cabernet-sauvignon.title: Bask Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
bask-cabernet-sauvignon.bodyHtml: Bask Cabernet Sauvignon is a Canadian red wine created to be low in sugar while keeping plenty of flavour; the label states 0 g of sugar per serving. It opens with inviting aromas of blackcurrant, black cherry, toast and spice. The palate is dry and full-bodied, and subtle warming spices round out the finish. Try it with smoky grilled duck breast and a peach barbecue sauce. This listing is a 750ml screw-cap bottle at 12.5% ABV.

single-cask-nation-foursquare-10-year.title: Ardbeg 10 Year Old
single-cask-nation-foursquare-10-year.bodyHtml:
Ardbeg 10 Year Old is a world-renowned Islay single malt Scotch whisky revered by peat enthusiasts for its intensely smoky, complex, and surprisingly balanced profile. Distilled on the rugged south coast of Islay, it is matured for a minimum of ten years in a combination of first-fill and second-fill American oak ex-bourbon casks. Bottled non-chill-filtered at 46% ABV to preserve maximum flavor and texture, it showcases Ardbeg's signature phenolic peat smoke—drawn from heavily peated malted barley—alongside bright lemon and lime zest, coastal sea spray, and creamy vanilla sweetness.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh Pacific oysters, smoked salmon, grilled langoustines, barbecued pork ribs, dark chocolate truffles, and pungent blue cheeses such as Roquefort or Stilton.

Tasting Notes : Pale straw gold with bright platinum highlights, presenting a full, oily body with a rich and coating mouthfeel.

Nose : Intense bonfire peat smoke, fresh lemon and lime zest, coastal sea brine, cracked black pepper, sweet vanilla, and subtle menthol.

Palate : Explosive peat smoke balanced by bright citrus fruits, sweet malted cereal, espresso, dark chocolate, tarry rope, and creamy toffee.

Finish : Very long, smoky, and warming with lingering notes of sea salt, toasted malt, charred oak, and sweet aniseed.

Serve : Serve neat at room temperature in a Glencairn glass or tulip-shaped whisky tasting glass, or add a few drops of pure water to tame the intense smoke and highlight the underlying citrus and vanilla sweetness.

chateau-chasse-spleen-2019.title: Chateau Chasse Spleen 2022
chateau-chasse-spleen-2019.bodyHtml:
The 2022 Château Chasse-Spleen is a classic and intensely structured Moulis, benefiting from a high-concentration vintage that produced small, flavor-dense berries. It presents a deep ruby-red hue and opens with a complex, primary bouquet of blackcurrant, Bing cherry, and blackberry, seamlessly layered with notes of pencil shavings, tobacco leaf, and subtle licorice spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and powerful, showcasing a "tightly knit" texture with firm, chalky tannins and a vibrant, saline acidity. Aged for 12 to 18 months in French oak (40% new), it delivers a long, precise finish with lingering impressions of graphite, dark fruit, and cocoa.

Food Pairing: Perfectly complements classic meat dishes such as roasted lamb, Bistecca alla Fiorentina, duck confit, or grilled portobello mushrooms with truffle oil.

94 Points - James Suckling

An excellent Chasse-Spleen that shows fine sweet spices and creamy yet vibrant plums and cassis. Lovely precision, with minerals and berries on the palate. Bright and refined, with dense, chalky tannins and a lengthy finish. Drink from 2027.

caribou-crossing-whisky.title: Pendleton Canadian Whisky 1.75L
caribou-crossing-whisky.bodyHtml:
Pendleton Canadian Whisky is a premium, exceptionally smooth blended whisky born from a unique cross-border collaboration. Crafted as a tribute to the legendary Pendleton Round-Up rodeo, it is distilled and aged in Canada using select northern grains, then brought to Hood River, Oregon, where it is cut to proof using pure, glacier-fed spring water from Mount Hood. This distinctive process gives it an uncommonly gentle, approachably sweet character that celebrates the heritage of the American West.

Food Pairing: Smoked beef brisket, grilled barbecue ribs, sharp cheddar cheese, or warm pecan pie.

TASTING NOTES Light golden-amber in color with a silky, soft, and remarkably light-to-medium body.

NOSE Inviting and sweet with upfront aromas of warm vanilla, clover honey, butterscotch, and sweet biscuit dough, accented by a hint of grated cinnamon.

PALATE Highly approachable and mellow, featuring dominant flavors of caramel and honey balanced by baked apple, pear, subtle rye bread undertones, and a touch of light baking spice.

FINISH Short to medium, clean, and extraordinarily smooth with a gentle trailing warmth, light oak structure, and a touch of sweet corn.

SERVE Highly versatile; perfect for casual sipping neat, on the rocks, or as an excellent, smooth base for a Highball or Whisky Sour.

bridgeland-double-barrel-berbon-bsw.title: Bridgeland Taber Corn Berbon Whisky 101
bridgeland-double-barrel-berbon-bsw.bodyHtml:
Bridgeland Taber Corn Whisky 101 is a bold Alberta corn whisky crafted by Bridgeland Distillery in Calgary using locally grown Taber corn alongside Penhold barley and wheat. Made from a mashbill of 60% corn, 32% barley, and 8% wheat, it is twice distilled in a traditional copper pot still and matured in new American oak barrels with a #4 char. Bottled at an elevated 101 proof, it delivers a rich, concentrated expreassion of Alberta grain with creamy fruit, caramelized sweetness, oak, and warming spice.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, barbecue pork ribs, grilled steak, maple-glazed pork, aged cheddar, toasted pecans, peach cobbler, and crème brûlée.

Tasting Notes: Rich and full-bodied with creamy peach, caramelized sweetness, sweet oak, warming pepper, and a gently herbal touch of fennel.

Nose: Rich peach custard pie with creamy sweetness, ripe fruit, and subtle sweet oak.

Palate: Salted caramel and sweet oak develop into ripe stone fruit, toasted grain, and warming pepper.

Finish: Lingering and warming with gentle pepper, sweet oak, and a subtle touch of sweet fennel.

san-polino-brunello.title: San Polino Brunello Di Montalcino 2017
san-polino-brunello.bodyHtml:
San Polino Brunello Di Montalcino 2017 is an exceptionally elegant, complex, and full-bodied Tuscan red wine that beautifully manages the warmth of the 2017 vintage with classic structural balance. Crafted from hand-harvested, biodynamically grown grapes on the northern slopes of Montalcino, it opens with an inviting and multi-layered bouquet of dark plums, black cherries, and wild herbs, gracefully layered with tertiary hints of earthy black truffle, leather, tobacco smoke, and sweet spices. On the palate, it reveals a concentrated, muscular, yet remarkably agile mouthfeel where a succulent core of black-skinned fruits and raspberry jam is buttressed by a vibrant vein of refreshing natural acidity and fine, close-grained, velvety tannins. Matured traditionally in large Slavonian oak casks, it maintains a striking purity and focus, culminating in a long, lingering, and highly polished mineral-driven finish highlighted by a classic Sangiovese lift.

Food Pairing: Pairs spectacularly with roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, charcoal-grilled dry-aged ribeye steak, wild boar ragù, or rich wild mushroom risotto.

94 Points - James Suckling

Brunello that shows the ripeness of the vintage. At the same time the rich plum and cherry character is buttressed with bright acidity and dusty tannins. It’s chewy yet polished. Fresh at the end. Drink in 2023 and onwards. From organically grown grapes.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is rather shy but eventually offers truffle, leather, ripe black-skinned fruit and crushed mint. Full-bodied and concentrated, the chewy palate doles out fleshy black cherry, raspberry jam and licorice alongside velvety, close-grained tannins. Drink through 2027.

san-polino-brunello-helichrysum.title: San Polino Brunello di Montalcino Helichrysum 2017
san-polino-brunello-helichrysum.bodyHtml:
San Polino Brunello di Montalcino Helichrysum 2017 is an exceptionally structured, elegant, and masterfully crafted organic and biodynamic Tuscan red wine that takes its name from an aromatic wild herb growing among the estate's highest vineyards. Sourced from a south-facing plot planted at 450 meters above sea level on the unique microclimates of Montalcino, it opens with a breathtaking and highly expressive bouquet of unique dried flowers, sandalwood, and ripe black cherries, beautifully layered with slow-developing nuances of camphor, new leather, forest floor, and pipe tobacco. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied yet remarkably agile and weightless framework where a juicy, concentrated core of fleshy Morello cherry, steeped prune, and black raspberry is balanced by a vibrant vein of natural acidity. Maturation in large Slavonian and French oak barrels shapes fine, dusty tannins that float effortlessly across the mid-palate, guiding the wine into an incredibly long, savory finish highlighted by sweet baking spices, licorice, and a distinctively fresh mineral tension.

Food Pairing: Pairs flawlessly with rosemary-crusted roasted leg of lamb, slow-braised wild boar ragù, charcoal-grilled peppercorn ribeye steak, or aged Pecorino cheese.

96 Points - James Suckling

Unique aromas of dried flowers and sandalwood with ripe black cherries. Breathtaking. It’s full bodied yet rather agile and weightless with fine dusty tannins that float across the palate. Wonderfully done for this difficult vintage. Gorgeous and delectable now.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Camphor, new leather, pipe tobacco and cedar aromas slowly take shape in the glass along with forest floor notes. Made with organically grown grapes, it's full-bodied and savory, delivering steeped prune, fleshy Morello cherry, baking spice and licorice framed in tightly woven, enveloping tannins. Drink 2024–2029.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The San Polino 2017 Brunello di Montalcino Helichrysum (with 9,000 bottles made) shows slightly lighter fiber compared to the annata release, and this wine is also more floral, with pressed rose, dried lavender and bay leaf. This more compact style is well suited to this hot and dry vintage that naturally produced a lot of sugar (alcohol) and extract. Farming at San Polino is organic and biodynamic.

san-polino-brunello-riserva-2015.title: San Polino Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2015
san-polino-brunello-riserva-2015.bodyHtml:
A fresh and elegant Montalcino red with bright cherry, raspberry, red plum, violet, and subtle earthy spice. Medium-bodied and lively, it combines vibrant acidity with supple tannins, juicy fruit, and a clean savory finish with excellent drinkability.

Food Pairing: Pair with pasta, pizza, grilled poultry, pork, roasted vegetables, salumi, mushroom dishes, or young Tuscan cheeses.

97 Points - James Suckling

The beauty and balance of this Brunello is wonderful, offering blueberry, black-cherry and violet character. It’s full-bodied, yet so layered and refined with and ultra fine palate of silky tannins. A joy to taste...One both to drink and for the cellar.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Made with organically farmed grapes and fermented with wild yeasts, this delicious wine has balsamic aromas of camphor that mingle with new leather, blue flower and spiced plum. Generous and enveloping, the full-bodied palate is full of flavor and already approachable, doling out dried black cherry, blackberry jam and licorice before a baking-spice close. Drink 2022–2028. Kerin O’Keefe

chateau-lafite-rothschild.title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild
chateau-lafite-rothschild.bodyHtml: Chateau Lafite Rothschild is located to the north of the appellation, bordering Saint Estèphe. Lafite's best terroirs stretch on the 50ha Plateau des Carruades to the west of the Château. This plateau, which is the highest point of the Pauillac appellation, is well-drained and enjoys optimal sun exposure. Its clayey gravel soils offer excellent water regulating abilities, and provide optimal ripening conditions for the Cabernet Sauvignon.

chateau-mouton-rothschild-1.title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild Le Petit Mouton 2016
chateau-mouton-rothschild-1.bodyHtml:
A luxurious Pauillac with aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, violet, cedar, graphite, and dark chocolate. Richly textured with velvety tannins, vibrant freshness, and remarkable concentration, it delivers exceptional depth, precision, and an elegant, persistent finish worthy of long cellaring.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, grilled ribeye, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, aged Comté, or mushroom risotto.

 

96 Points - James Suckling

This is a very powerful Petit Mouton with so much rich fruit and power. Full-bodied, tannic yet polished and long. Muscular for the second wine of Mouton.
94 Points - Decanter
Petit Mouton always shows charm in a rich, seductive expression, even in muscular vintages like 2016. It has the most wonderful sweetness to it, a highly seductive mix of the austerity of 2016 with the natural joy and exuberance of Petit Mouton, showing lovely rich damson fruit and huge persistence. It need time in the glass to open up.
93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The 2016 Le Petit Mouton is a blend of 62% Cabernet Sauvignon, 35% Merlot and 3% Cabernet Franc. It has a deep garnet-purple color and gives up an intensely plummy nose with cigar box and fallen leaves scents leading to aroma layers of kirsch, red and black currants and tilled soil. Medium-bodied with a racy line of freshness cutting through the muscular fruit and a good, firm frame of grainy tannins to support, it finishes on a lingering menthol note.
93 Points - Wine Enthusiast
This wine has structure and a generous fruity character from the ripeness of the Merlot in the blend. It is full in the mouth, with a smoky character on the palate and acidity coming through on the close
92 Points - Wine Spectator
The gently steeped plum and red currant fruit allows light anise, iron and cedar notes to enter slowly before taking hold on the slightly taut, savory-tinged finish. The iron element lingers longest in the end, giving this a sense of refinement. Best from 2022 through 2035.

chateau-haut-brion.title: Chateau Haut Brion
chateau-haut-brion.bodyHtml:
Château Haut-Brion is one of Bordeaux's most legendary First Growth estates, renowned for its extraordinary complexity, finesse, and longevity. Profound aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, cedar, graphite, tobacco, truffle, and spice unfold over silky tannins and remarkable precision, culminating in an exceptionally long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roasted lamb, venison, duck breast, black truffle dishes, wild mushrooms, or aged hard cheeses.

chateau-pichon-comtesse-de-lalande.title: Chateau Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2022
chateau-pichon-comtesse-de-lalande.bodyHtml:
Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande is the Grand Vin of the estate in the Pauillac appellation of Bordeaux. Crafted from estate-grown fruit, it is renowned for its elegance, complexity, refined structure, and exceptional ageing potential, expressing the distinctive gravel terroir of Pauillac.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, duck, venison, braised short ribs, wild mushroom dishes, and aged hard cheeses.

 

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande has turned out even better in bottle than I anticipated, bursting from the glass with aromas of cassis and blackberries mingled with scents of licorice, violets and pencil shavings. Full-bodied, layered and enveloping, it's suave, seamless and complete, with faultless precision, pristine integration of tannin, controlled sweetness and a long, expansive finish. The 2022 manages to unite the sensuality that's the estate's calling card and the ripeness of the vintage on the one hand, with a sense of Pauillac classicism on the other, threading the needle to deliver one of the finest wines of the vintage and a benchmark Pichon Comtesse. It's a blend of 78% Cabernet Sauvignon, 17% Merlot and 5% Cabernet Franc.

99 Points - James Suckling

What perfect aromas of blackcurrants, lead pencil, violets, blood oranges and blood. Some iron. Medium- to full-bodied, this has incredible tannins that are completely loaded and integrated, melting into the wine with such a glorious mouthfeel. The finish goes on and on, lightly austere in the most sophisticated way. Racy and rigorously focused. 78% cabernet sauvignon, 17% merlot and 5% cabernet franc.

98 Points - Decanter

One of my favourite wines from 2022, utterly seductive from the first sip, this is a stunning effort that shows the power of Pauillac in 2022 delivered with elegance and class. Heavily scented on the nose, full of dark fruits, savoury notes of salty chocolate and floral scents. Smooth and so appealing in the mouth, the texture stands out, deep and rich but soft and chalky, tannins have a subtle powderiness that spreads the mouth, cooling and refreshing giving the minerality while the cool black and blue fruits linger in layers expanding vertically. This is so refined and polished - it's serious no doubt, not super fun, but it doesn’t need to be, it’s rich and sumptuous with sweet blue fruits balanced by high acidity that keeps the focus and energy. Bright, bold, well worked, clean, crystalline and pure. Somehow delicate and punchy at the same time. A mind-blowing wine that you just have to marvel at with intensity, brightness and vibrancy, building as it goes. A long, clean finish leaves you wanting more, salivating for that next sip.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Looking at the flagship 2022 Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse De Lalande, it's based on 78% Cabernet Sauvignon, 16% Merlot, and the balance Cabernet Franc that spent 19 months in two-thirds new oak and one-third in once-used barrels. Its similarly deep purple hue is followed by a magical, heavenly 2022 that has a layered, full-bodied profile that brings an incredibly floral character as well as a huge core of darker currant fruits, ripe, polished, velvety tennis, no hard edges, and a thrilling finish. It’s a quintessential Comtesse that brings the forward, supple elegance of the château while still offering plenty of classic Pauillac depth, structure, and character.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

This brims with notes of dark currant, blackberry and black cherry preserves that sparkle subtly with reserved energy, while sweet tobacco, licorice snap, chestnut, violet and ink notes work harmoniously through the long, crumpled velvet finish. A late humus echo provides a beautiful counterpoint, which just makes you want to go right back and start the experience all over with another sip. A total stunner. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Cabernet Franc.

chateau-pontet-canet-1.title: Chateau Pontet-Canet 1990s Mixed Case 6 x 750ml
chateau-pontet-canet-1.bodyHtml:
Chateau Pontet-Canet 1990s Mixed Case presents six Pauillac vintages: 1990, 1994, 1995, 1996, 1998, and 1999. Each 750ml bottle represents the estate's classified Bordeaux production across the decade. The collection provides a vertical selection of Chateau Pontet-Canet, a Fifth Growth estate from the Pauillac appellation.

Food Pairing: Pairs best with roasted lamb rack, beef tenderloin, braised short ribs, and aged Comte.

chateau-latour.title: Chateau Latour Les Forts de Latour 2019
chateau-latour.bodyHtml:
The 2019 Les Forts de Latour is a powerhouse and a "jewel of a wine" that marks a significant milestone as the estate's first release fully certified organic and biodynamic. Produced with the same meticulous care as the Grand Vin, it originates from dedicated parcels outside the famed "Enclos". This vintage offers a complex bouquet of blackberries, cassis, and iris, interwoven with sophisticated notes of cedar, cigar box, and graphite. On the palate, it is full-bodied and velvety, featuring powerful yet ultrafine linear tannins and a mineral core of crushed stone. Aged in approximately 70% new French oak, it displays an extraordinary balance of tension and sapid freshness with a resonant, long-lasting finish.

97 Points - James Suckling

Exquisite aromas of lavender, cigar ash and Spanish cedar with dried citrus follow through to a medium body and a solid palate with powerful, ultrafine and linear tannins. The muscle and long finish are so beautiful. Give it two or three years but already a solid wine. Drink after 2028.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Les Forts de Latour appears to have tightened up a little since I last tasted it a few years ago. Unwinding in the glass with aromas of sweet cassis fruit mingled with hints of cedar, iris, orange zest and new oak, it's medium to full-bodied, lively and nicely concentrated, with a ripe core of fruit underpinned by chalky structuring tannins. While it's approachable after a decant, it certainly merits additional patience. As readers will remember, this bottling mostly derives from dedicated parcels located further inland from Latour's famous "Enclos," next to Château Haut-Batailley.

opus-one-2010-magnum.title: Opus One 2010 1.5L Magum
opus-one-2010-magnum.bodyHtml:
Aromas of blackberry, rose petals, chocolate and espresso accentuate fruity and earthy nuances. Round velvety tannins enrobe a silky texture with a touch of minerality. The flavors of dark fruit are enhanced by the well integrated acidity. The acidity and tannin structure promise a very long life ahead.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2010 Opus One is on another level and is a deep, concentrated, full-bodied, flawlessly balanced beauty. From a cooler vintage that saw significant heat spikes later in the year, it has incredible purity in its cassis and darker fruits as well as leafy tobacco, flowers, and background oak. With a great mid-palate, ripe, building tannins, and full-bodied richness on the palate, it’s a brilliant wine that has another two decades or more of prime drinking.

97 Points - Decanter

A harvest lasting 30 days offered structure and tannins, deep and complex fruit with earthy nuances, still bursting with energy.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A glorious perfume of sweet charcoal, truffle, black currants and spice box soars from the glass of the saturated purple-colored 2010 Opus One. The gorgeous aromatics are followed by a beautifully knit, full-bodied red blend (84% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5.5% Merlot, 5.5% Cabernet Franc, 4% Petit Verdot and 1% Malbec) displaying lots of spicy black currant fruit, medium to full body, velvety tannins, and not a hard edge to be found. The texture, length and richness are all impressive. This estate has been making great Cabernet-based wines for nearly a decade ... and this is another one.

96 Points - James Suckling

One of the best ever from Opus, it shows beautiful blackcurrant cabernet sauvignon character. A powerful and poised wine with well-crafted tannins. Needs about four years to soften.

chateau-haut-brion-blanc-1.title: Chateau Haut-Brion Blanc 2020 750ml
chateau-haut-brion-blanc-1.bodyHtml:
98 Points - James Suckling

Very perfumed with floral, citrus and stone aromas, as well as hints of grapefruit. It’s full-bodied and seamless in texture. Extremely long and fine-grained. 72% sauvignon and 28% semillon. Normally 50/50. Barrel Sample: 97-98

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2020 Château Hosanna is up there with the crème de la crème of the appellation and is a true gem. Awesome cassis, candied violets, truffle, chocolate, and underbrush-like notes define the bouquet, and it's full-bodied, with a seamless, silky texture, ultra-fine tannins, and a rock star of a finish. This is another magical Pomerol from the Moueix family that you couldn't have enough of.
Barrel Sample: 96-98

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Tightly textured, this is a wine whose future is assured. With intense white fruits, spice and touches of toast from the wood aging, the wine's concentration and taut character combine richness and structure.
Barrel Sample: 96-98

96 Points - Decanter
Grippy fresh, green-tinged flavors, a little more evident than in the Mission Haut-Brion Blanc, here you get more angular acidities, and yet it works. Sauvignon-dominant flavors and aromatics of rosemary, mint, turmeric, lime blossom and steely citrus. Excellent persistency and a deliciously mouthwatering finish.
Barrel Sample: 96

aile-dargent-blanc.title: Aile d'Argent by Chateau Mouton Rothschild 2022
aile-dargent-blanc.bodyHtml:
Aile d'Argent Blanc is the acclaimed dry white wine of Château Mouton Rothschild, crafted from a refined blend led by Sauvignon Blanc with Sémillon and Muscadelle. Bright citrus, white peach, acacia blossom, and subtle oak aromas lead to a rich, mineral-driven palate with vibrant acidity and an exceptionally elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with lobster, oysters, grilled sea bass, roast chicken, creamy risotto, goat cheese, or fresh shellfish.

 

97 Points - James Suckling

So vibrant and minerally with salt and dried apple, peach and pears. Medium- to full-bodied with a creamy texture. Some phenolics. Dried fruit skin. Vivid acidity. 3.18 pH. 52% Sauvignon Blanc, 39% Sémillon, 8% Sauvignon Gris, and 1% Muscadelle.

cheval-blanc-2019.title: Chateau Cheval Blanc 'Le Petit Cheval' Blanc 2019 750ml
cheval-blanc-2019.bodyHtml: Fresh, bright and vibrant, the wine is all about its crisp, lively yellow citrus, white flowers, vanilla, green apple and orange blossom character. I love the lift, vibrancy and purity in the fruits with their mild touch of honey and spice in the finish.

chateau-leoville-las-cases-2019.title: Chateau Leoville Las Cases 2023
chateau-leoville-las-cases-2019.bodyHtml:
Chateau Leoville Las Cases is one of Saint Julien's most iconic estates, renowned for producing wines of extraordinary precision, structure, and longevity. Aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, blackberry, graphite, cedar, cigar box, and violet unfold into a powerful palate with refined tannins, remarkable concentration, and an exceptionally long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, venison, duck breast, truffle dishes, or aged Comte for an exceptional Bordeaux dining experience.

99 Points - James Suckling

So subtle and complex, with aromas of violets, lavender, dark roses and fresh currants. Wonderfully open, with a beautiful hint of fresh herbs. Full-bodied, featuring ultra-fine tannins that create a multilayered texture and lead to a savory, succulent finish emphasizing brightness and exceptional length. Tangy and vivid on the finish, with remarkable purity and youthful energy. A blend of 86% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Cabernet Franc and 4% Merlot. Best after 2028, though already thrilling to taste today.

pichon-baron-2019.title: Chateau Pichon-Longueville Baron 2020
pichon-baron-2019.bodyHtml:
A legendary Pauillac estate, Château Pichon Longueville Baron reveals intense aromas of cassis, blackberry, black cherry, graphite, cedar, cigar box, violet, and fine oak. Powerful yet impeccably refined, it delivers velvety tannins, exceptional concentration, vibrant freshness, and an extraordinarily long finish with immense aging potential.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, grilled ribeye, roast lamb, venison, duck confit, truffle potatoes, aged Comté, or braised short ribs.

 

99 Points - James Suckling

Fabulous aromas of blackcurrant, blueberry, crushed stone, graphite and lead pencil. Some violets and other flowers, too. Full-bodied with incredibly encompassing tannins that are like the finest velvet in texture. The structure is superb, with so much tension and focus. Seamless. This could be the new 1990 or better. Try after 2028.
98 Points - Decanter
Gentle and delicately aromatic but rich too, full of coffee, mocha, dark chocolate, caramel and medicinal herbs - mint and aniseed with a combination of red, blue and black berry fruits. Lovely density and weight on the palate, really very tannic but wide with an aerated effect so it doesn't feel at all heavy with a bright juiciness and extremely long length. The tannins make the first impression with a velvet texture and chalky minerality but it’s clean and the fruit has a crystalline purity that gives a sleek and direct overall impression. Generous, elegant and refined yet still not showing its best.
98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The flagship 2020 Château Pichon-Longueville Baron is pure gold, a full-bodied, rich, powerful 2020 displaying the vintage's purity, focus, and structure front and center. A blend of 76% Cabernet Sauvignon and 24% Merlot, its dense purple hue is followed by a mammoth-sized bouquet of cassis, blackberries, smoked earth, graphite, and cedar pencil. With ripe tannins, a seamless, layered mouthfeel, and one heck of a finish, it comes closest in my mind to the estate 2010, and I think is clearly in the same realm as the 1989, 1990, 2000, 2009, 2010, 2015, and 2019.
98 Points - Wine Enthusiast
Made with a high percentage of Cabernet Sauvignon, this wine offers dark tannins that give density and massive black fruits. With a magnificent combination of dark fruits and rich structure, it is set for long-term aging.
97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
The brilliant 2020 Pichon-Longueville Baron offers up inviting aromas of sweet berries and cassis mingled with pipe tobacco, loamy soil, pencil shavings and licorice. Medium to full-bodied, deep and layered, its velvety attack segues into a concentrated mid-palate that's framed by rich, powdery tannins, concluding with a long, vibrant finish. A blend of 76% Cabernet Sauvignon and 24% Merlot, it's a true classic that's a touch less demonstrative out of the gates than the sensual 2019, but which in the fullness of time will prove every bit as good.
97 Points - Wine Spectator
This has a very large-scaled yet properly proportioned core of cassis, plum and blackberry fruit flavors that are remarkably pure and focused. Buried deep within is a sleek, vibrant iron spine that drives the finish as the fruit keeps pace. Extra savory, tobacco and cedar nuances fill out all the remaining available space. A towering wine, with a buttoned-up feel. Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Best from 2030.

il-borro-igt-toscana.title: Il Borro Igt Toscana 2019 750ml
il-borro-igt-toscana.bodyHtml:
Critic tasting note (2020 vintage):
“Absolutely solid and focused, it displays notes of black plums, blackberries, juniper berries, black plums, sour cherries, licorice, dark chocolate, guarana, green tea leaves, eucalyptus, sage, and calamint. Medium to full body, soft tannins, and a finish of great grace and lightness. Better from 2025.”
— Raffaele Vecchione, WinesCritic.com

chateau-de-musar-red-2016.title: Chateau Musar Rouge 2018
chateau-de-musar-red-2016.bodyHtml:
The 2018 vintage is a rich and opulent expression, characterized by deep garnet colour and a complex bouquet of candied red fruits, white mushrooms, leather, and peppery spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied with a concentrated profile of cranberries, raisins, and dates, balanced by fresh acidity and finely integrated tannins. True to the Chateau Musar style, it was fermented in concrete vats, aged for 12 months in French Nevers oak, and matured in bottle for several years before release.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Fresh and dried cherries, just-picked raspberries, figs and juicy dates headline this impeccably balanced, garnet-hued blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cinsault, Carignan from Lebanon's Bekaa Valley. Drink it now or in several years; either way, you'll be glad you did.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A distinctive style, with a saline-infused core of chocolate-covered cherry, spices and dried green herbs, plus a foundation of dusty earth and leafy forest floor. Delicate in form, with menthol lift and eucalyptus notes powered by mouthwatering blood orange acidity through the bitter finish. A unique and delicious version that will have fans. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cinsaut and Carignan. Drink now through 2030.

domaine-lafage-nicolas.title: Domaine Lafage Nicolas 2021
domaine-lafage-nicolas.bodyHtml:
Domaine Lafage Cuvée Nicolas 2021 is a rich, full-bodied, and generously expressive French red wine crafted by winemaker Jean-Marc Lafage from 100% old-vine Grenache Noir (averaging 65 years of age) grown on south-facing schist slopes in the Roussillon region. Visually displaying a deep ruby-purple core, it reveals a perfumed and enticing nose filled with aromas of ripe black cherries, dark plums, and crushed raspberries, seamlessly layered over subtle hints of garrigue herbs, licorice, and mineral-driven crushed stone. On the palate, it exhibits a opulent, mouth-filling texture supported by fine, silky tannins and well-integrated acidity, delivering layered flavors of dark fruit, cocoa, and Mediterranean spices that flow into a long, warming, and harmonious finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak, braised beef short ribs, pork tenderloin, wild boar ragù, and aged hard cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

A flavorful grenache, full of red plums, redcurrants, potpourri and raw spices. Medium- to full-bodied palate with lightly chewy tannins and plenty of dried strawberries. Drink now.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A 100% Grenache from vines averaging 65 years of age, the 2021 IGP Côtes Catalanes Nicolas (it does include 15% of the previous vintage) spent just eight months in demi-muids prior to bottling. A terrific effort for near-term consumption, it delivers subtle hints of garrigue, crushed stone and licorice, all on a bed of ripe black cherries. Full-bodied, round and expansive, framed gently by silky tannins, it finishes long and harmonious.

hall-napa-cabernet.title: Whitehall Lane Napa Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
hall-napa-cabernet.bodyHtml:
This Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic example of a perfectly balanced valley floor Cabernet with excellent fruit concentration. On the nose, this wine offers blackberry pie, dried Mission figs, baking spices, blackberry coulis and a hint of cigar box. The palate offers smooth and velvety tannins, chocolate-covered cherries, red currants, huckleberry pie, toasted walnuts, vanillin and hibiscus tea. This offering is enjoyable today but will also evolve with cellar aging through 2038.

Blend: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon

driftwood-swash-box-variety-pack-2.title: Driftwood Swash Box Variety Pack #2 8 Tall Cans

smirnoff-seltzer-peach-lemonade.title: Smirnoff Peach Lemonade Vodka
smirnoff-seltzer-peach-lemonade.bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Peach Lemonade is a flavoured vodka beverage infused with natural peach and lemonade flavours, giving a bright, sweet and summery profile. It is bottled at 30% ABV in a 750 ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Ripe peach and fresh lemonade.

Serve: Over ice with soda water or lemon-lime soda, or in a summer punch.

western-honey-pepper-whiskey.title: Western Honey Pepper Whiskey
western-honey-pepper-whiskey.bodyHtml:
A brilliantly crafted, sweet-and-spicy thrill ride in a glass! Western takes an exceptionally smooth, small-batch whiskey base and masterfully infuses it with natural honey and fiery chili peppers. Bottled at an easy-drinking 60 proof (30% ABV), it is purposefully designed to start with a lush, syrupy sweetness before finishing with a deeply satisfying, warming chili kick. It is the absolute perfect spirit for taking chilled shots, or for giving your next Old Fashioned a savory, spicy twist.

 

NOSE

Inviting aromas of thick floral honey, sweet vanilla cream, and a distinct, sharp peppery spice.

PALATE

Sweet, thick, and highly dynamic. A rush of soothing honey and caramel coats the palate, quickly followed by a building, fiery chili pepper heat.

FINISH

Long, spicy, and satisfying with a perfect balance of lingering sweet sugar and tingling pepper.

captain-morgan-mango-mai-tai.title: Captain Morgan Mango Mai Tai 4 Cans

simply-spiked-lemonade-variety-pack.title: Simply Spiked Lemonade Variety Pack
simply-spiked-lemonade-variety-pack.bodyHtml: These sparkling spiked lemonades are juicy and refreshing. The variety pack includes the Signature Lemonade with sweet and tart lemon flavour, the Strawberry Lemonade with fresh berry fruit and the Blueberry Lemonade with subtle fruit. Great for get-togethers or sipping on a hot afternoon. Pair with savoury snacks.

veuve-clicquot-cave-privee-2002.title: Veuve Clicquot Cave Privee Brut 2002 1.5L Magnum
veuve-clicquot-cave-privee-2002.bodyHtml:
The 2002 vintage has a pale gold color with silver accents. It has a brilliant aspect and an effervescence that is lively and long-lasting. The nose is very open, pure and complex. The Chardonnay gives this wine a refined mineral flavor accompanied with pleasant flowery notes of acacia. Aerating the wine reveals hints of yellow-fleshed fruit and pastries(brioche, marzipan). These give way to delicately spicy aromas, followed by elegant notes of licorice and high-bred teas. In the mouth, the wine is silky and generous. The expectations promised by the nose are met and even exceeded as the complexity of this wine is superlative:simultaneously evoking fruity and floral, mineral and spicy notes, menthol and toast. This wine is quite simply dazzling with its wealth of aromas, and a deliciously long and powerful finish.

Pair this with with bass tartare, poached turbot served on a bed of fresh pasta, or cappuccino of Bresse chicken with candied citrus fruits.

93 Points - Wine & Spirits

This combines the richness of the Clicquot style with flavor precision and the length of the '02 vintage. It's delicious juice, accelerated by the bubbles into a blast of flavor that lasts. There's flinty minerality as well as lime and ginger root, youthful and invigorating for now and suited to years in the cellar.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

This firm, racy Champagne offers fresh spring blossom, almond paste and apple pastry notes, with good intensity on a refined frame. The finish of lemon zest and spice lingers. Best from 2012 through 2017.

bridgeland-limoncello.title: Bridgeland Distillery Limoncello
bridgeland-limoncello.bodyHtml: A Limoncello like no other you have tasted! Bridgeland Distillery’s take on Limoncello is unique with a reduction on both bitterness and sweetness to produce a well balanced and<br data-mce-fragment="1">delicate product. Fresh aromas of spring apple blossoms with a touch of early summer honey. The acidity of the lemons combines with the sweetness of honey provides a balanced palate. The finish is a light refreshing sweetness.

castelgiocondo-brunello-di-montalcino-ma.title: Frescobaldi CastelGiocondo Brunello di Montalcino 2019 1.5L Magnum
castelgiocondo-brunello-di-montalcino-ma.bodyHtml:
Frescobaldi CastelGiocondo Brunello di Montalcino 2019 1.5L Magnum is a powerful, highly sophisticated, and classic expression of Sangiovese from a historic estate in the southwestern hills of Montalcino. Pours a brilliant, deep ruby red and opens with an intense, multi-layered bouquet of ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and dark plums, seamlessly interwoven with elegant aromas of dried violets, wild rose, nutmeg, and cocoa beans alongside savory undergrowth and sweet cedar tobacco. On the palate, it exhibits a full-bodied structure with dense, beautifully integrated tannins, vibrant balanced acidity, and a rich core of dark fruit that carries into a long, fragrant finish marked by lingering notes of licorice root and crushed stone minerality. The 1.5L Magnum format allows for slower, more graceful aging in the cellar.

Food Pairing: Pairs exceptionally well with prime Florentine T-bone steak, slow-roasted leg of lamb, wild boar ragù, braised beef short ribs, or aged Pecorino Toscano cheese.

95 Points - James Suckling

Black cherries, black bark, blackberries and lavender. Medium- to full-bodied with juicy and polished tannins and a long, flavorful finish. Needs four or five years to open and come together. Best after 2027.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This substantial red is as savory as it is fruity, boasting cherry, plum, leather, wild thyme, woodsy underbrush, iron and tobacco notes. Burly, with dusty tannins guarding the lingering finish. Best from 2027 through 2043.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Frescobaldi 2019 Brunello di Montalcino CastelGiocondo has oaky notes, dried spice, redwood and cured tobacco. At its core, the wine shows dark fruit and a thick level of extraction. The tannins are soft and resolved, setting this Brunello up for an immediate drinking window. The wine is exactly where you want it to be, especially if served across from a steak and baked potato.

wild-life-rye-whisky.title: Wild Life Rye Whisky
wild-life-rye-whisky.bodyHtml:
Wild Life Rye Whisky is an Alberta-crafted Canadian rye whisky produced by Wild Life Distillery in Canmore. Made from a mashbill of 88% rye and 12% malted barley, it is distilled in a 500L alembic copper pot still and matured for at least 3.5 years in 53-gallon American white oak barrels. Bottled at 45.9% ABV, it showcases locally focused Alberta whisky production using prairie grain and Rocky Mountain water.

Food Pairing: Smoked brisket, grilled steak, barbecued pork, aged cheddar, roasted nuts, maple-glazed bacon, and dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: A robust, grain-forward rye whisky combining caramelized sweetness, toasted oak and warming rye spice.

Nose: Rye grain, caramel, vanilla and toasted oak with underlying baking spice.

Palate: Full-flavoured rye spice with caramelized grain, vanilla, toasted oak and peppery warmth.

Finish: Warming and persistent with lingering rye spice, caramel and dry oak.

romero-dark-rum.title: Romero Distilling Co Dark Rum Broubon Barrel Aged
romero-dark-rum.bodyHtml:
Romero Dark Rum is a bourbon barrel aged rum from Romero Distilling Co. in Calgary, Alberta. It begins with glacier-fed water from the eastern slopes of the Canadian Rockies and Canadian molasses, is distilled in a Canadian-made copper pot still and matures in freshly emptied Woodford Reserve bourbon barrels. The rum is then spiced with vanilla beans, cardamom, nutmeg, clove, cinnamon and a touch of cracked black pepper, and bottled at 40% ABV in a 750ml bottle. Its awards include Gold at the 2021 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, Gold and Best Canadian Spirit at the 2022 Frankfurt International Trophy, and Best in Class at the 2025 Alberta Beverage Awards.

Tasting Notes: Vanilla first, followed by a cascade of fresh spice; very smooth, with a long, complex finish.

Serve: Neat, on ice or in a premium cocktail.

stagg-65-50-abv.title: Stagg Bourbon 65.50% ABV
stagg-65-50-abv.bodyHtml:
Stagg Bourbon Batch 18 is an uncut, unfiltered bourbon named for George T. Stagg, who built the most dominant American distillery of the 19th century during the Gilded Age of Bourbon. Aged for nearly a decade, it is bottled at full barrel strength, 131 proof (65.5% ABV), in a 750ml bottle. Batch 18 is the first release to drop "Jr" from the name.

Tasting Notes: Chocolate, brown sugar, rye spice, cherry and clove.

Palate: Rich and sweet, with chocolate and brown sugar balanced by bold rye spice.

Finish: Long, with cherry, clove and a hint of smoke.

Serve: Neat with a few drops of water, or over a large ice cube.

lignier-mich-chamb-mussig-vielles-vignes.title: Thibault Liger-Belair Chambolle-Musigny Vieilles Vignes Cote de Nuits 2018 750ml
lignier-mich-chamb-mussig-vielles-vignes.bodyHtml: This wine has notes of red and black cherry, violet and spice. The light but well-defined licorice-tinged bouquet opens nicely with aeration. The medium-bodied palate offers succulent black cherries and cassis on the entry and fine acidity. The finish is a bit tight but with time it softens.

tomintoul-21-year-old.title: Tomintoul 21 Year Old
tomintoul-21-year-old.bodyHtml:
Master Distiller, Robert Fleming expertly selects only the finest American oak ex-bourbon barrels for the maturation of Tomintoul 21 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

The end result is an award-winning rich and complex single malt with notes of fresh citrus fruits on the nose, sweet and warming toffee on the palate , rounded off with a gentle spicy finish.

worthy-park-2006-single-estate-reserve.title: Worthy Park Single Estate 2006 12 Year Old
worthy-park-2006-single-estate-reserve.bodyHtml: Worthy Park 2006 Single Estate Reserve rum is a blend of sugar cane molasses rums, produced by the Worthy Park distillery in Jamaica. Distilled in still copper still pot still, the rum then aged in old bourbon barrels only under the tropical climate of the island between 6 and 10 years. This blend was created to highlight the unique complexity and distinctive taste that Worthy Park has to offer to the most enlightened rum lovers

luzhou-laojiao-te-qu.title: Luzhou Laojiao Tequ Baijiu 500ml
luzhou-laojiao-te-qu.bodyHtml:
Luzhou Laojiao Tequ is a strong aroma baijiu from Luzhou Laojiao, bottled at 52% ABV in a 500ml bottle that comes in a red presentation box. The producer describes Tequ as the typical representative of strong aroma baijiu in China: its brewing technique, flavour characteristics and style are used as the production and inspection standards for the whole category. In 2006 Luzhou Laojiao Tequ was certified by China's Ministry of Commerce as one of the first "Time-honored Brands of China", a title that is printed on the box. In the glass it is aromatic and crisp, with great intensity and length.

Tasting Notes: Aromatic and crisp, with great intensity and a long finish.

Serve: Neat at room temperature, in small glasses.

maotai-chun-2008-ib.title: Maotai Chun 2008 Ib
maotai-chun-2008-ib.bodyHtml: Maotai Chun 2008 is a Chinese baijiu from the Kweichow Moutai Distillery Group, bottled at a full 53% ABV in a 500ml bottle. Baijiu is traditionally served at room temperature in small cups and sipped slowly, often alongside food.

lady-mac-session-blonde-ale-4x473-ml.title: Lady Mac Session Blonde Ale 4X473 Ml 4 Tall Cans

ardnamurchan-single-malt-ad.title: Ardnamurchan AD Single Malt
ardnamurchan-single-malt-ad.bodyHtml:
A single malt whisky from the Ardnamurchan distillery in the Highlands of Scotland. This was created using a 50:50 split of peated and unpeated spirit.

Before bottling, the liquid was matured in a combination of ex-bourbon (65%) and ex-sherry (35%) casks before being bottled at 46.8% ABV.

carolans-irish-cream-6x1x1750.title: Carolans Irish Cream Liqueur 1.75L
carolans-irish-cream-6x1x1750.bodyHtml:
Carolans Irish Cream Liqueur (1.75L) is the original Carolans, developed in Ireland in 1978 and named after the 17th-century Irish harpist Turlough O'Carolan. It blends Irish whiskey and Irish spirits with farm-fresh Irish cream and naturally harvested honey, the ingredient that sets it apart from other cream liqueurs. The result is rich and silky, with toffee, vanilla and honey flavours. Carolans has grown into one of the largest Irish cream brands in the world, and won Platinum at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition in 2025 for the second year running. Bottled at 17% ABV in a 1.75L bottle.

Tasting Notes: Silky and smooth.

Nose: Toffee, vanilla and honey.

Palate: Creamy and silky, with toffee, vanilla and honey.

Serve: On the rocks, in coffee, or in dessert cocktails.

barrell-craft-bourbon-batch-33.title: Booker's Small Batch Bourbon
barrell-craft-bourbon-batch-33.bodyHtml:
Booker's Small Batch Bourbon is a premium, barrel-proof Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey produced by James B. Beam Distilling Co. Originally created by 6th-generation Master Distiller Booker Noe as a private gift for friends and family before its public release, this uncut and non-chill filtered bourbon is bottled directly from the center cut of Jim Beam’s rackhouses, offering an intense, robust, and full-bodied profile.

Food Pairing: Smoked beef brisket, prime ribeye, dark chocolate truffles, pecan pie, or strong blue cheeses.

Tasting Notes : Deep amber-bronze in appearance with a rich, heavy, and viscous mouthfeel.

Nose : Robust and complex with powerful aromas of vanilla, roasted nuts, brown sugar, toasted oak, baking spices, and subtle leather.

Palate : High-proof warmth balanced by intense flavors of sweet caramel, vanilla cream, dark fruits, toasted oak, rye spice, and subtle tobacco.

Finish : Very long, warm, and lingering with notes of dark chocolate, wood spice, charred oak, and caramel.

Serve : Serve neat in a Glencairn or rocks glass, or add a splash of spring water or a large ice cube to open up the aromas and tame the barrel-proof strength.

alley-kat-main-squeeze-grapefruit-ale-1.title: Alley Kat Main Squeeze Grapefruit Ale 4 Tall Cans
alley-kat-main-squeeze-grapefruit-ale-1.bodyHtml: Alley Kat Main Squeeze Grapefruit Ale 4 Tall Cans

alley-kat-mangolorian-mango-ale.title: Alley Kat Mangolorian Mango Ale 4 Tall Cans

alley-kat-razzykat-raspberry-sour-1.title: Alley Kat Razzykat Raspberry Sour 4 Tall Cans
alley-kat-razzykat-raspberry-sour-1.bodyHtml:
Alley Kat Razzykat Raspberry Sour is a vibrant fruit sour ale produced by Alley Kat Brewing Company in Edmonton, Alberta. Crafted with real raspberry puree, this tart and refreshing beer delivers a striking balance between bold, jammy raspberry fruitiness and a clean, puckering sourness with a light wheat malt backbone.

Food Pairing: Fresh spinach salad with goat cheese, grilled pork chops, creamy cheesecake, dark chocolate tarts, or lemon bars.

Tasting Notes : Deep ruby pink with a soft pink head, presenting a light-bodied, crisp, and effervescent mouthfeel.

Nose : Bright, fresh raspberries, tart red berries, light wheat malt, and subtle citrus notes.

Palate : Tart and juicy with dominant flavors of natural ripe raspberries, crisp lemon acidity, and a light cereal malt backbone.

Finish : Crisp, dry, and tart with lingering raspberry flavor and a refreshing acidic finish.

Serve : Serve well-chilled in a tulip or pint glass.

alley-kat-fruit-hopia-tropical-ipa.title: Alley Kat Fruit-Hopia Tropical Ipa 4 Tall Cans

grizzly-paw-rundlestone-easy-6x4x473-cls.title: Grizzly Paw Rundlestone Easy 6X4X473  4 Tall Cans

banded-peak-fired-up-hazy-blonde-ale-1.title: Banded Peak Fired Up Hazy Blonde Ale
banded-peak-fired-up-hazy-blonde-ale-1.bodyHtml: BANDED PEAK FIRED UP HAZY BLONDE ALE

bacardi-rts-mojito.title: Bacardi Mojito Cocktail Ready to Serve
bacardi-rts-mojito.bodyHtml:
Bacardi Mojito Ready to Serve is a bottled Mojito from Bacardí's Ready to Serve range, built on a base of Bacardí rum. The label describes it as a premium rum cocktail made with lime juice and natural mint flavours and sweetened with cane sugar, and Bacardí notes that it is made with natural flavours and real ingredients. There is nothing to muddle or measure: simply pour it over ice. Bottled at 12.5% ABV in a 750ml bottle, it is a convenient choice for summer gatherings, picnics and patios when you want a crisp, minty rum drink without the work.

Serve: Chill and pour over ice; top with a splash of soda and garnish with mint and lime if you like.

woodbridge-rose.title: Woodbridge Rose 750ml
woodbridge-rose.bodyHtml: Woodbridge Rosé, a 750ml bottle, is a light and refreshing wine with flavors of red berries, citrus, and a hint of floral notes. It's known for its crisp finish and is ideal for sipping on a warm day or pairing with light dishes, like salads or seafood.

grey-goose.title: Grey Goose Vodka 1.75L
grey-goose.bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Vodka is an ultra-premium, world-renowned spirit crafted in the celebrated Cognac region of France. Created by Maître de Chais (Cellar Master) François Thibault, this expression is distilled using only two high-quality ingredients: single-origin soft winter wheat from the fertile Picardy region and pure spring water naturally filtered through limestone from a dedicated well in Gensac-la-Pallue. Distilled a single time using a continuous column still process to preserve the character of the grain, this vodka bypasses extensive filtration to ensure a naturally rich, soft, and round texture, setting a global standard for high-end luxury vodka.

Food Pairing: Pairs exquisitely with fresh oysters on the half shell, caviar with blinis, smoked salmon canapés, creamy goat cheese, or light lemon-herb grilled chicken skewers.

Tasting Notes : Crystal clear with brilliant clarity, featuring a plush, smooth, and rounded mouthfeel.

Nose : Delicate and floral with subtle notes of sweet winter wheat, citrus zest, and light almond.

Palate : Smooth, soft, and slightly sweet with notes of cracked grain, subtle almond, light cream, and fresh citrus.

Finish : Warm, ultra-clean, and satisfying with a lingering, gentle peppery warmth and soft grain sweetness.

Serve : Serve ice-cold neat from the freezer, on the rocks, or as the refined base in a classic Vodka Martini or Espresso Martini.

fandango-mezcal-ib.title: Fandango Joven Mezcal
fandango-mezcal-ib.bodyHtml: Fandango is a premium mezcal crafted in the state of Oaxaca, Mexico. The objective behind the creation of this spirit was to clearly accentuate the taste and scent of the roasted agave piñas. You will enjoy this Mezcal cold and neat as much as in cocktails. The balance between the rich taste of agave and the smokiness resulting from roasting the fruit will allow you to experience the spirit in one of the most traditional ways like the indigenous people of Oaxaca did when they were taught the distillation process by the Spanish 400 years ago.

liberty-school-chardonnay.title: Liberty School Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
liberty-school-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
Liberty School Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is an accessible, fruit-forward, and tried-and-true California red that has served as a benchmark for Paso Robles Cabernet for decades. Pouring a rich ruby hue, it opens with an inviting bouquet of fresh vanilla, lush dark cherries, and ripe blackberries, thoughtfully layered with subtle herbaceous nuances, black pepper, and earthy undertones. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and exceptionally smooth. Bright cherry and black currant notes mingle effortlessly with warm toasted toffee, cocoa, and sweet oak. Balanced by a touch of bright acidity and framed by soft, supple, and dusty tannins, it delivers a deeply comforting and widely appealing finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with everyday favorites like juicy gourmet burgers, grilled ribeye steak, classic meatballs, braised short ribs, or medium-aged cheddar cheese.

pongracz-south-african-sparkling.title: Pongracz Brut Methode Cap Classique
pongracz-south-african-sparkling.bodyHtml:
Crafted in the Western Cape of South Africa, Pongrácz Brut is a iconic Méthode Cap Classique (MCC) sparkling wine made in the traditional champagne method. Named in honor of the legendary Hungarian viticulturist Desiderius Pongrácz, whose pioneering spirit transformed South African viticulture, this bottle is a classic blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Sourced from cool-climate vineyards, the grapes undergo secondary fermentation in the bottle and spend extended months maturing on their lees, developing rich complexity, fine effervescence, and elegant structural balance.

Food Pairing: Fresh oysters, smoked salmon, seafood ceviche, roast chicken, creamy cheeses, and buttered popcorn.

fat-bastard-chardonnay.title: Fat Bastard Chardonnay 2023 750ml
fat-bastard-chardonnay.bodyHtml:
The grapes for our FAT bastard Chardonnay are sourced from selected vineyards in the Languedoc-Roussillon, spanning the banks of the Rhône in the east, Carcassonne in the west, the foothills of the Massif Central in the north, all the way to the Mediterranean coast in the south. The winemakers work very closely with the growers to determine the start of each harvest. The goal is to seek aromatic ripeness and rich varietal character.

Golden yellow colour. Elegant with aromas of white fruits (peach, pear).
Full-bodied structure with great fruit flavours and hints of vanilla.

Excellent on its own. Perfect match with baked salmon, grilled tuna steak, flavourful seafood dishes, white meat (chicken, veal with mushrooms) and cheese.

carmel-road-pinot-noir.title: Carmel Road Pinot Noir 2023
carmel-road-pinot-noir.bodyHtml:
Carmel Road Pinot Noir 2023 is a smooth, expressive red wine sourced from cool-climate estate vineyards in Monterey County, California. Crafted under Jackson Family Wines, it undergoes cold soaking before fermentation and gentle aging in French oak barrels to retain its bright fruit profile. In the glass, it displays a vibrant ruby color with inviting aromas of fresh red cherry, wild strawberry, black tea, and subtle woodsy spices. On the palate, it is light- to medium-bodied, juicy, and well-balanced, featuring bright acidity, soft tannins, and flavors of ripe berries and cola that lead to a crisp, silky finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with roasted chicken, grilled salmon, pork tenderloin, mushroom pizza, and mild cheeses like Brie or Gruyère.

delarche-pernand-vergelesses-1er-cru.title: Domaine Etienne Delarche Pernand~Vergelesses Les Vergelesses Premier Cru 2022
delarche-pernand-vergelesses-1er-cru.bodyHtml:
Domaine Étienne Delarche Pernand-Vergelesses Les Vergelesses Premier Cru 2022 is an elegant, terroir-driven, cool-climate red Burgundy that beautifully expresses the nuances of the Côte de Beaune. Crafted from 100% Pinot Noir vines within the esteemed "Les Vergelesses" Premier Cru vineyard, this wine reflects the excellence of a warm and low-yielding vintage. In the glass, it displays a bright ruby-red color with an aromatic bouquet of wild redcurrants, sour cherries, and ripe raspberries, accented by delicate notes of earth, dried herbs, and a hint of white pepper. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and seamlessly balanced, combining a succulent core of pure red stone fruit with integrated, grainy tannins and a lively thread of mineral-driven acidity. Having aged in fine French oak, it retains a remarkable freshness while showing complex layers of damp soil and dark spice that carry into a persistent, refined, and distinctly savory finish.

Food Pairing: This elegant red Burgundy pairs spectacularly with roasted duck breast with cherry reduction, pan-seared quail, wild mushroom risotto, or classical French escargots Bourguignonne.

delarche-corton-renardes-grand-cru-vv.title: Domaine Etienne Delarche Corton 'Les Renardes' Grand Cru 2023
delarche-corton-renardes-grand-cru-vv.bodyHtml:
Domaine Etienne Delarche Corton 'Les Renardes' Grand Cru 2023 is a complex, deeply structured, and aromatic red wine produced from old vines (50+ years old) in the famed "Les Renardes" climat on the Corton hill. Sourced from stony clay-limestone soils in Aloxe-Corton, it showcases the power and earthy elegance characteristic of this terroir. In the glass, it reveals an alluring deep garnet color, opening with aromas of wild dark cherries, black raspberries, dark plum, and forest floor, complemented by subtle nuances of black pepper, game, crushed stones, and delicate oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied with remarkable depth and texture, displaying concentrated black fruit flavors, firm yet refined tannins, and a persistent, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing: Pairs brilliantly with roasted duck, venison, braised beef short ribs, wild boar, or aged Époisses cheese.

sea-change-turbo-stout.title: Sea Change Turbo Stout 4 Tall Cans

kilchoman-px-sherry-matured.title: Kilchoman 100% Islay 11 Year Old Sherry Cask Matured
kilchoman-px-sherry-matured.bodyHtml:
The 100% Islay Sherry Cask Matured 11 Years Old, was distilled from our 2011, 2012 and 2013 barley harvests, and matured for a minimum of 11 years in ex-oloroso sherry butts. Bottled at 50% abv. with no added colour or chill-filtration, this release combines 16 individually selected first-fill oloroso sherry butts originally used by José y Miguel Martin, Jerez, Spain.

This release differs significantly from the recent 100% Islay 15th Edition, which was matured exclusively in ex-bourbon barrels for nine years. Ex-sherry casks impart remarkable depth, with pronounced notes of dark fruits, spice, and smoked meat, in contrast to the lighter citrus-driven profile more typical of our previous 100% Islay expressions.

borgogno-barolo-cannubi-docg.title: Fratelli Serio & Battista Borgogno Barolo Cannubi 2020
borgogno-barolo-cannubi-docg.bodyHtml:
A distinguished Barolo from the legendary Cannubi cru, this wine opens with aromas of red cherry, wild strawberry, rose petals, licorice, and sweet spice layered with subtle mineral notes. The palate is elegant yet powerful, offering vibrant red fruit, savory herbs, and earthy complexity supported by bright acidity and finely structured tannins. Harmonious and persistent, it finishes long with floral lift, spice, and remarkable finesse.

Food Pairing: Braised veal, truffle risotto, roasted game, mushroom dishes, and aged Parmigiano Reggiano.

 

88 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This Barolo captivates with herbal notes of bay leaf and laurel, balanced by tart cherries and cranberries. Medium-bodied with fine-grained tannins, it's like a Mediterranean garden where fragrant herbs mingle with ripe berries. An unconventional flavor profile that challenges the palate, it pairs beautifully with herb-infused dishes. Drink Now - 2040.

borgogno-barolo-liste-docg.title: Borgogno Barolo Liste 2019
borgogno-barolo-liste-docg.bodyHtml:
The cru orginated around 13 millon years ago due to erosion of the overlying terrain. As a result its composition differs slightly from the other lanhe lands. Liste essentially acquired acompletion of macro and micro elements that give the future wine an unequalled complexity and longevity. Highly visible from the curves of the secondary road that rises from Barolo towards the old Castello della Volta, the vineyards of this renowed cru cover around 6.75 hectares, with a southern exposureand an altitude that varies from 270 to 330 meters above sea level.

Barolo goes well with important dishes, such as traditional Piedmontese meat main courses. Ranging from world traditions, there is gulasch in Eastern Europe. Going to Japan instead for example fish, such as Black Cod (Alaskan fish marinated with sugar, sake, miso). Moving to The United States of America, beef (angus, wagyu, bue nostral, longhorn) in the brisket cut. One recipe is, for example, onion stout beef. But if you have the pleasure, even a simple “special” toast is perfect!

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Needing time to unfold, this Barolo opens with wafting aromas of dried cherry, sage, licorice, clove and crushed chalk. Ripe mixed red-berried fruits appear on the palate with notes of tea, truffle, worn leather and savory herbs with fine-grained tannins.

james-eadie-mannochmore-11-year-rechar.title: James Eadie Small Batch The Rising Sun Mannochmore 11 Year Old 2010
james-eadie-mannochmore-11-year-rechar.bodyHtml:
This 11 year old single malt from Mannochmore, independently bottled by James Eadie. This expression was drawn from three re-charred hogsheads that were laid down in 2010 and cracked open in 2022. Following that rest, the whisky was bottled at 46% ABV and bestowed a name that refers to a pub that James Eadie once owned years ago.

Nose: Bright fruit sweetness, with hints of roughly chopped herbs and freshly baked rye bread.

Palate: Brown sugar, peppercorn, clementine, buttered crumpets.

Finish: Grassy malt gives it a fresh feel on the finish.

james-eadie-glen-spey-10-year-recharred.title: James Eadie Small Batch The Half Moon Glen Spey 10 Year Old 2011
james-eadie-glen-spey-10-year-recharred.bodyHtml: From the glorious Glen Spey Distillery in Speyside comes a ten year old single malt Scotch whisky, independently bottled by the marvelous James Eadie. This edition was drawn from a pair of re-charred hogsheads that were filled in 2011 and emptied in 2022, and has been bottled at 46% ABV. Its name, The Half Moon, is an homage to a pub that James Eadie owned back in the old days.

textbook-merlot.title: Textbook Merlot 2020
textbook-merlot.bodyHtml: A lush and beautifully balanced expression of Napa Valley, the 2020 Textbook Merlot highlights the variety’s signature velvet-like texture. Sourced from premier vineyards in the Oak Knoll and Rutherford districts, this wine exhibits a deep ruby color and an inviting bouquet of ripe black cherries, plums, and violets, accented by elegant notes of cocoa powder and dried herbs. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and remarkably supple, showcasing juicy flavors of red currant and blackberry compote supported by soft, integrated tannins and a vibrant acidity. Maturation in French oak provides sophisticated nuances of vanilla bean and toasted spice, leading to a long, polished finish with a hint of graphite.

duncan-taylor-the-octave-macallan-1991.title: Duncan Taylor The Octave Macallan 31 Year Old 1991 48.8% ABV
duncan-taylor-the-octave-macallan-1991.bodyHtml:
Duncan Taylor The Octave Macallan 1991 is a single cask Speyside single malt distilled at Macallan in 1991 and bottled by the Huntly-based independent bottler Duncan Taylor in 2022 for its Octave Premium range. The label states 31 years of maturation in oak casks; like every whisky in The Octave range it then spent a final period in a small ex-sherry octave cask, where the greater contact between spirit and wood intensifies colour and flavour. It is bottled at cask strength, 48.8% ABV, in a 700ml bottle presented in the range's black gift box. It is a pale gold whisky with a nutty, chocolate-rich and sherried nose.

Nose: Nutty toffee brittle dipped in milk chocolate, then dark chocolate and sherried fruit, mostly cherries and plums; intense and almost floral.

Serve: Neat, at room temperature; add a few drops of water if desired.

dusse-vsop-1.title: D'Usse VSOP Cognac
dusse-vsop-1.bodyHtml: Naturally aged for at least four and a half years in the cellars of France's Château de Cognac, where some of the world's finest Cognacs have been made for over 200 years. This emerges as a bold, full-bodied blend that is uniquely powerful and has a pleasantly smooth and balanced finish.

pian-delle-ginestre-brunello-montalcino.title: Tenuta Pian Delle Ginestre Brunello Di Montalcino 2020 750ml
pian-delle-ginestre-brunello-montalcino.bodyHtml:
Intense ruby red. A rich bouquet. In the nose a smell of ripe blackberries and forest fruits, leather and tobacco. The taste is smooth, powerful with warm tannins and dark chocolate.

It is a full bodied red wine of immense finesse, balance and longevity.

Pair with red meat, wild boar, game and old cheese.

ciroc-honey-melon.title: Ciroc Summer Watermelon Vodka
ciroc-honey-melon.bodyHtml: This fresh and fruity spirit is distilled five times resulting in a cocktail-friendly spirit. Anticipate attractive notes of ripe summer watermelon which lead to a crisp, clean finish. This is perfect over ice with tonic water alongside a fresh fruit salad or create a watermelon martini.

cadenhead-7-stars-blend-30-yo.title: Wm Cadenhead 7 Stars 30 Year Old Blended Scotch Whisky 48.2% ABV
cadenhead-7-stars-blend-30-yo.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead’s 7-Stars is an historic Blended Scotch Whisky, originally bottled many decades ago to demonstrate that exquisite whisky could be created by blending carefully selected casks from the vast array of stock we owned in our warehouses.

Our traditions and methods haven’t changed and so we have resurrected 7-Stars using whisky from distilleries all over Scotland. The blend is then finished in Oloroso sherry casks – giving it a bolder, yet well balanced, flavour.

Proof: 96.4

Tasting Notes:

Nose: Fresh, lemon drizzle, coffee & walnut cake, rum and raisin, caramel

Palate: Lightly roasted coffee, date syrup, sticky toffee pudding

Finish: Peppery, salted caramel, nutmeg, flint

cadenhead-aultmore-glenlivet-12-year-old.title: Wm Cadenhead Original Collection Aultmore-Glenlivet 12 Year Old 2010
cadenhead-aultmore-glenlivet-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead's Original Collection Aultmore-Glenlivet 12 Year Old is an independently bottled Speyside single malt Scotch whisky distilled at Aultmore in 2010. Matured for 12 years using 75% ex-Fino sherry and 25% ex-Manzanilla sherry casks, it was bottled by William Cadenhead in 2023 at 46% ABV. The sherry maturation complements Aultmore's fruity character with dried fruits, citrus, nuts and warming spice. 

Food Pairing: Pair with roast pork, Manchego cheese, toasted walnuts, dried fruits, apple tart or orange-infused dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: Fruity and sherry-forward with citrus, dried fruits, nuts, brown sugar and warming spice.

Nose: Orange peel, Demerara sugar, cocktail cherries and pecan nuts.

Palate: Green apple and cinnamon with dates, sultanas and other dried fruits.

Finish: Walnuts, orange pulp and maple syrup.

cadenhead-benriach-glenlivet-12-year-old.title: Wm Cadenhead Original Collection Aultmore-Glenlivet 12 Year Old 2010
cadenhead-benriach-glenlivet-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead's Original Collection Aultmore-Glenlivet 12 Year Old is an independently bottled Speyside single malt Scotch whisky distilled at Aultmore in 2010. Matured for 12 years using 75% ex-Fino sherry and 25% ex-Manzanilla sherry casks, it was bottled by William Cadenhead in 2023 at 46% ABV. The sherry maturation complements Aultmore's fruity character with dried fruits, citrus, nuts and warming spice. 

Food Pairing: Pair with roast pork, Manchego cheese, toasted walnuts, dried fruits, apple tart or orange-infused dark chocolate.

Tasting Notes: Fruity and sherry-forward with citrus, dried fruits, nuts, brown sugar and warming spice.

Nose: Orange peel, Demerara sugar, cocktail cherries and pecan nuts.

Palate: Green apple and cinnamon with dates, sultanas and other dried fruits.

Finish: Walnuts, orange pulp and maple syrup.

cadenhead-craigellachie-glenlivet-15-yea.title: Cadenhead's Original Collection Glentauchers-Glenlivet 14 Year Old 2008
cadenhead-craigellachie-glenlivet-15-yea.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead's Original Collection Glentauchers-Glenlivet 14 Year Old 2008 is an independently bottled Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from Glentauchers Distillery. Matured for 14 years in a combination of Sherry and Bourbon casks, it was bottled by William Cadenhead at 46% ABV. Sweet and fruit-forward, the whisky combines ripe orchard fruit with creamy vanilla, chocolate and warming baking spices, while the Sherry component adds richness and depth.

Food Pairing: Pair with roast pork, baked Brie, aged Gouda, poached pears, dark chocolate or spiced fruit cake.

Tasting Notes: Sweet and fruity with pears and peaches complemented by creamy vanilla, chocolate, warming spice and rich wine-influenced notes.

Nose: Pear drops, peaches and treacle with warming nutmeg.

Palate: Pears poached in red wine, gentle tannins and vanilla ice cream with milk chocolate flakes.

Finish: Rich and warming with orange, cloves, mulled-wine character and dark chocolate.

cadenhead-glencadam-10-year-old.title: Wm Cadenhead Original Collection Glencadam 10 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
cadenhead-glencadam-10-year-old.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead Original Collection Glencadam 10 Year Old is an independently bottled single malt Scotch whisky from Glencadam, founded in 1825 and now the only working distillery in the county of Angus. Distilled in 2012 and matured in a combination of bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks, it was bottled by Wm Cadenhead of Campbeltown for the Original Collection at 46% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Cadenhead's tasting panel enjoyed a fruity nose of strawberries, peaches and fruit salad, a palate that stays fruity, and a sweet, creamy finish recalling custard creams, Bakewell pudding and pastel de nata.

Tasting Notes: Strawberries, peaches, fruit salad, custard creams, Bakewell pudding, pastel de nata.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

cadenhead-springbank-11-year-old.title: Cadenhead Springbank 11 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
cadenhead-springbank-11-year-old.bodyHtml:
Cadenhead Springbank 11 Year Old is a highly sought-after single malt Scotch whisky that beautifully showcases the classic Campbeltown character. Bottled by the historic independent bottler Wm Cadenhead (Springbank’s sister company), this 11-year-old expression is typically matured in ex-bourbon casks. It offers a wonderful balance of sweet, coastal, and subtly smoky notes. On the nose, you will find inviting aromas of briny sea salt, ripe tropical fruits like mango, lemon sherbet, and a gentle wisp of candle smoke. The palate is creamy and complex, delivering flavors of vanilla, coconut, bubblegum sweetness, and toasted marshmallows, all leading to a gently peated and satisfyingly long finish.

Food Pairing: Smoked salmon with capers, seared scallops, roasted salted nuts, mild blue cheeses, and sweet desserts like crème brûlée or toasted marshmallow treats.

hey-yall-variety-pack-15-for-12.title: Hey Y'All Variety Pack 15 For 12 15 Cans

springbank-local-barley-11-year.title: Springbank Local Barley 11 Year Old 2023 Release
springbank-local-barley-11-year.bodyHtml: The Local Barley is an annual release made from barley grown in or around Campbeltown. Each year a local farmer is commissioned to grow barley on our behalf to continue producing this ‘grain to glass’ limited edition. Different farms, barley varieties, cask maturations and length of time the whisky spends in the casks from one batch to the next allow our customers a unique tasting experience every time.

springbank-hazelburn-sherry-12-year-old.title: Hazelburn 12 Year Old 2010 Oloroso Cask Matured
springbank-hazelburn-sherry-12-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Hazelburn Sherry Wood is an annually released limited edition matured exclusively in Oloroso Sherry casks.

The annually released Hazelburn Sherrywood range provides a stark contrast to the fully Bourbon matured Hazelburn 10 year old. Matured in 100% Oloroso Sherry casks, this 12 year old release is a complex, full-bodied dram.

kilkerran-8-year-old-bourbon-finish.title: Kilkerran 12 Year Old
kilkerran-8-year-old-bourbon-finish.bodyHtml:
