Kilkerran 12 Year Old is a highly acclaimed, lightly peated single malt Scotch whisky produced at the historic Mitchell’s Glengyle Distillery in Campbeltown. Reopened in 2004 by the legendary Mitchell family (owners of Springbank), Glengyle revived a historic distillery that had been silent for nearly eighty years, restoring Campbeltown's status as a distinct whisky region. This flagship expression is matured in a careful combination of 70% ex-bourbon casks and 30% ex-sherry casks. It is bottled without chill-filtration or added coloring, offering a wonderfully complex, oily, and authentic Campbeltown profile that beautifully balances coastal brine, sweet malt, and a delicate kiss of peat smoke.

Food Pairing: Pairs wonderfully with smoked duck breast, grilled lamb chops with rosemary, mature pecorino cheese, or rich dark chocolate sea salt caramels.

TASTING NOTES - A bright, pale gold color with a medium-bodied, oily, and wonderfully waxy mouthfeel typical of classic Campbeltown malts.

NOSE - Fragrant and complex, offering aromas of toasted oak, sweet honey, marshmallow, and dried citrus peel, coupled with a gentle, earthy peat smoke and a touch of maritime brine.

PALATE - Robust and incredibly balanced on the tongue, revealing sweet notes of butterscotch, lemon meringue, and vanilla biscuit, layered with black pepper, dry peat, and a light coastal saltiness.

FINISH - Long and clean, ending with a drying, warming mix of ash, oak spice, and lingering sweet brine.

SERVE - Best enjoyed neat in a Glencairn glass to experience the coastal and peaty nuances, or with a few drops of water to bring out more vanilla sweetness.

kilkerran-8-year-old-sherry-finish.title: Kilkerran 8 Year Old Cask Strength Sherry Cask Matured 2023 Release
kilkerran-8-year-old-sherry-finish.bodyHtml:
Kilkerran 8 Year Old Cask Strength Sherry Cask Matured 2023 Release is a cask-strength Campbeltown single malt from Glengyle Distillery, home of Kilkerran. The 8 year old cask strength is part of Kilkerran's limited range and is released annually, in one or two parts, with full maturations in bourbon, port and sherry casks over the years. This 2023 edition was fully matured for eight years in sherry casks and bottled at its natural strength of 57.5% ABV, in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat at full strength first, then with a few drops of water to open it up.

motts-original-caesar-2.title: Mott's Clamato Original Caesar 12x341ml Cans
motts-original-caesar-2.bodyHtml: Canada's official cocktail has been a legend for over 50 years! Now you can easily enjoy the complex, bold and savoury -- salty and herbal -- spicy and tangy, flavours of this classic cocktail in a ready-to-drink format. Perfect for anytime!

north-star-blair-athol-16-year-old.title: North Star Blair Athol 16 Year Old
north-star-blair-athol-16-year-old.bodyHtml:
Blair Athol 16 Year Old 2006 is a single malt Scotch whisky from the Blair Athol distillery in the Scottish Highlands, bottled by Glasgow independent bottler North Star Spirits for its Cask Series 021. Distilled in September 2006 and filled into a refill hogshead, it was finished in an oloroso sherry hogshead before bottling at 49.5% ABV, without chill-filtration and at natural colour. Only 287 bottles were filled (700ml).

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

north-star-campbeltown-8-year-old.title: North Star Campbeltown 8 Year Old 55.1% ABV
north-star-campbeltown-8-year-old.bodyHtml:
North Star Campbeltown 8 Year Old 2014 is a blended malt Scotch whisky from Glasgow independent bottler North Star Spirits, released as part of its Cask Series 021. It brings together single malts distilled in 2014 at undisclosed distilleries in Campbeltown, the small Kintyre whisky town, and matured for eight years before bottling at cask strength of 55.1% ABV. Presented in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water to open it up.

north-star-dalwhinnie-14-year-old.title: North Star Dalwhinnie 2008 14 Year Old 48.9% ABV
north-star-dalwhinnie-14-year-old.bodyHtml:
The approachably sweet and sticky character of Dalwhinnie single malts is the result of an extensive process of mellowing their robust and sulphurous new make. This rustic spirit character is borne out of a distillation process which involves relatively little copper contact, with simple pot stills and worm tub condensers.

This whisky, from independent bottlers and blenders, North Star, has undergone this transformation over the course of its years in cask. Spirit distilled at Dalwhinnie distillery in March 2008 was filled into a single refill hogshead for maturation. The whisky was later racked into an Oloroso Sherry hogshead to finish, before bottling in November 2022. This cask yielded 252 bottles of unchillfiltered, naturally coloured whisky at the selected strength of 48.9% abv.

Official Tasting Notes
Nose – Toasted green peppercorns & a fist full of salted pistachio shells

Palate – Caramelised apricot porridge with clove custard

Finish – Chocolate-coated popcorn at the pictures

north-star-dalmunach-6-year-old.title: North Star Spirits Cask Series 021 Dalmunach 2016 6 Year Old
north-star-dalmunach-6-year-old.bodyHtml:
Distilled at Dalmunach Distillery in Speyside in February 2016, this young single malt was independently bottled by North Star Spirits after six years of maturation. It began its life in a refill barrel before receiving a finish in a Ruby Port barrel, adding concentrated red-fruit and fortified-wine character to Dalmunach’s malty spirit. Bottled in November 2022 as part of Cask Series 021, it was released at 56.4% ABV, natural colour and without chill filtration, with just 285 bottles produced. 

Food Pairing: Mature cheese, dark chocolate, cherry desserts, charcuterie, roasted nuts or rich fruit cake.

Tasting Notes: Rich and full-bodied, with the Ruby Port finish bringing dark fruit, chocolate, fortified-wine sweetness and warming spice.

Nose: Sweet and vinous with rich dinner-table aromas, developing toward red fruit, cinnamon and chocolate.

Palate: Intensely rich and warming, with fortified wine, cherry jam, cocoa, peppery oak and butterscotch.

Finish: Warming and spicy with prunes, ginger and lingering Port-influenced fruit. 

Serve: Enjoy neat first, then add a few drops of water to open the fruit and chocolate notes and soften the 56.4% cask strength.

north-star-glendronach-31-year-old.title: North Star The GlenDronach 31 Year Old 44.1% ABV
north-star-glendronach-31-year-old.bodyHtml: This indie bottling of Glendronach single malt comes from Glasgow based North Star Spirits. This is part of their Series 21 expressions. This particular bottling was distilled way back in 1991 before been bottled in November 2022 after spending 31 years in a refill Oloroso sherry butt. One of only 346 bottles, Glendronach is rarely seen in independent bottlings, so this release is a bit of a unicorn to say the least.

north-star-mannochmore-14-year-old.title: North Star Spirits Cask Series 021 Mannochmore 2008 14 Year Old
north-star-mannochmore-14-year-old.bodyHtml:
Distilled at Mannochmore Distillery in March 2008, this 14 Year Old Speyside single malt was matured in a refill hogshead before being finished in an Oloroso Sherry hogshead. North Star Spirits bottled it in November 2022 as part of Cask Series 021 at 53.9% ABV. The official release was limited to only 303 bottles, presented at natural colour and without chill filtration. Its profile leans toward bright citrus confectionery and rich dessert flavours, giving the whisky a lively contrast between Mannochmore's fruitiness and the richer Oloroso finish. 

Food Pairing: Lemon tart, crème brûlée, key lime pie, caramel desserts, roasted almonds, dark chocolate or mature cheese.

Tasting Notes: A sweet, citrus-driven Speyside malt combining lemon confectionery with caramelised dessert notes, creamy richness and the added depth of an Oloroso Sherry finish. 

Nose: Lemon sherbet and cola-cube confectionery. 

Palate: Caramelised lemon with rich crème brûlée sweetness. 

Finish: Key lime pie followed by an iced-coffee character. 

Serve: Enjoy neat initially, then add a few drops of water to soften the 53.9% strength and bring forward the citrus, caramel and creamy sherry-influenced flavours.

north-star-tarot-blend-6-year-old.title: North Star Tarot Blend 6 Year Old 57.3% ABV
north-star-tarot-blend-6-year-old.bodyHtml:
The Fool is a 6 year old blended Scotch whisky from Glasgow independent bottler North Star Spirits, released in early 2023 as the first of its Tarot blends; in tarot, The Fool is card number 0. Distilled in 2016, the blend is 20% malt whisky from the Edrington portfolio and 80% North British grain whisky, all matured in refill ex-Oloroso sherry butts and bottled at a robust 57.3% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Tasting Notes: Sweet, spicy and honeyed, with sherry fruit and a coastal edge.

Nose: Honey barbecue glaze, sea salt, almond paste, golden raisins, heather, toffee apple and vanilla custard.

Palate: Sweet and spicy with sharp ginger, honey, mandarin, light roast coffee and sea salt.

Finish: Good length with dried apple and pear, sea salt, heather, honey, ginger and citrus.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water to open it up.

north-star-blend-10-year-old.title: North Star Spirits Cask Series 21 Blended Scotch 10 Year Old 2012 46.1% ABV
north-star-blend-10-year-old.bodyHtml: This impressive blended Scotch whisky joins Cask Series 21 from indie bottler North Star Spirits. 2012 vintage whisky from a mix of distilleries matured for a decade in a pair of sherry butts, which were opened in 2022 to release a total of 802 bottles.

lochlea-single-malt-sowing-edition-2.title: Lochlea Sowing Edition Second Crop
lochlea-single-malt-sowing-edition-2.bodyHtml: Lochlea Sowing Edition is a seasonal small batch release celebrating the Scottish farm distillery calendar. The second release – named Second Crop – has been aged exclusively in first-fill ex-bourbon casks, giving it aromas of fruity sweet apples and pears. The palate brings out notes of vanilla pods and almond oil that lead to a crisp, refreshing finish with a hint of pine.

lochlea-ploughing-edition-crop-1.title: Lochlea Ploughing Edition First Crop
lochlea-ploughing-edition-crop-1.bodyHtml: The fourth limited seasonal release single malt from Lochlea distillery, Ploughing Edition is inspired by winter and the connection between Lochlea Farm and Robert Burns, who lived and worked on the farm from 1777 to 1784. Launched on Burns Night 2023, it is the first smoky whisky to come from the Ayrshire distillery and has been matured in a combination of ex-Islay whisky barrels and peated quarter casks, imparting a warming, lightly peated character with notes of cooked apples, brazil nuts, boiled sweets and lingering peat smoke throughout the palate.

edradour-21-year-old-56-5.title: Edradour 21 Year Old 2000 Oloroso Cask Finish Small Batch
edradour-21-year-old-56-5.bodyHtml: This is a small-batch release from Edradour that was matured for 21 years and finished in three ex-oloroso sherry casks before it was bottled in 2022. This mature single malt is an elegant expression of the distillery’s character and holds aromas of toffee apple, orange blossom and raisin on the nose, leading to rich notes of prune, caramel and ground almond on the palate.

benrinnes-46-signatory-vintage.title: Signatory Vintage Un-Chillfiltered Collection Benrinnes 12 Year Old 2010 Oloroso Sherry Finish
benrinnes-46-signatory-vintage.bodyHtml:
Signatory Vintage Benrinnes 12 Year Old 2010 Single Malt Scotch Whisky is an independently bottled Speyside single malt from Benrinnes Distillery. Distilled in September 2010 and bottled in 2023 after 12 years of maturation, the whisky was finished in first-fill Oloroso sherry butts and bottled at 46% ABV without added colouring or chill filtration. The sherry influence complements Benrinnes' robust character with layers of dark fruit, chocolate, nuts and warming spice.

Food Pairing: Pair with dark chocolate, roasted almonds, aged cheddar, charcuterie or slow-roasted beef.

Tasting Notes: Rich and sherry-driven with dark chocolate, candied fruit, nuts, warming spice and a savoury depth.

Nose: Dark chocolate, ripe berries and candied fruit with hints of nuts, liquorice and rich sherry.

Palate: Full and rounded with chocolate-covered fruit, almonds, dark confectionery, leather and subtle tobacco.

Finish: Warming and increasingly spicy, with lingering chocolate, dried fruit and nutty sherry notes.

blair-athol-46-signatory-vintage.title: Signatory Vintage Blair Athol 2011 11 Year Old 46% ABV
blair-athol-46-signatory-vintage.bodyHtml:
Distilled on September 30, 2011, the whisky was matured in Dechar/Recharred Hogsheads for 11 years before bottling in January of 2023 at 46% without added colouring or chillfiltration.

Nose: dried orchard fruits, wine gums, creamed honey, juicy malt and toasted oak; a touch of funk, pine sap and agave nectar.

Palate: lush and waxy; grassy and malty, more creamed honey, agave nectar, and toasted oak; delicate spices, still funky, with more orchard fruits and wine gums.

Finish: warming, spicy, and toasty; grassy, waxy, and a fading fruity tones.

Comment: a very fresh malt, spirit driven, and tasty with a lovely mouthfeel!

port-dundas-43-signatory-vintage.title: Port Dundas 43% Signatory Vintage
port-dundas-43-signatory-vintage.bodyHtml:
Port Dundas Single Grain Signatory Vintage is a single grain Scotch whisky from the Port Dundas distillery, bottled by the independent bottler Signatory Vintage at 43% ABV in a 700ml bottle.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

ardlair-2011-62-5-signatory-vintage.title: Signatory Ardlair 2011 11 Year Old 62.5% ABV
ardlair-2011-62-5-signatory-vintage.bodyHtml:
A cask strength bottling from those brilliant folks at Signatory Vintage of something pretty unusual here: Ardlair, the unpeated single malt from Ardmore distillery. A distillery that sits right on the line of Highlands and Speyside, most of Ardmore goes in to the blended Scotch whisky Teacher's. This expression, distilled in January 2011, was drawn from a single refill Oloroso sherry butt and bottled in January 2023.

A great bottle if you are planning a whisky tasting, as very few people, even whisky aficionados, will have tried an Ardlair.

signatory-vi-auchroisk-sherry-1996-48-7.title: Signatory Auchroisk Refill Sherry Cask 1996 26 Year Old 48.7%
signatory-vi-auchroisk-sherry-1996-48-7.bodyHtml:
This single malt whisky was distilled in 1996 at the Auchriosk Distillery in Speyside, Scotland. It was then placed in a single Hogshead for approximately 21 years before being finished in a fresh Sherry Butt for 65 months. It has spent no less than 26 years maturing in oak. Bottled with natural colour and no chill-filtration at 48.7% ABV from cask number 1 as part of the Signatory Vintage Cask Strength Collection. Only 687 bottles were produced.

Signatory Vintage are an independent bottler founded in 1988 by Andrew and Brian Symington. The name ‘Signatory’ was derived from the initial intention to find a person of suitable standing to sign the labels for bottles drawn from a single cask. The first cask bottled was a 1968 Glenlivet which quickly sold through long before any suitable signee could be found.

Signatory currently bottle at three strengths: 43%, 46% Unchillfiltered (UCF) and Cask Strength. To add proof of authenticity to their cask strength bottlings, Signatory always include the cask numbers, date of distillation, date of bottling and number of bottles produced.

Nose - Beautiful Sherry aromas, sweet plums and sour cherries, summer berries and sultanas. There's a wonderful combination of toasted nuts and milk chocolate with a hint of cinnamon spice.

Palate - Wonderful notes of plum and cherry, summer berries again but now in the form of blueberries and blackberries. There's raisins soaked in creamy chocolate caramel and some black pepper spice which leads to a hint of ginger and clove.

Finish - Very long and oily, thick and creamy, summer berries, some notes of coffee and dark chocolate with cherry syrup and spicy notes of cove. Very satisfying!

signatory-vintage-benrinnes-1996-53-5.title: Signatory Vintage Benrinnes 1996 26 Year Old 53.5%
signatory-vintage-benrinnes-1996-53-5.bodyHtml:
Benrinnes 1996 from Signatory Vintage is a Speyside single malt drawn from a pair of hogsheads filled on 24 October 1996 and bottled on 23 November 2022, after 26 years, at cask strength of 53.5% ABV. Light, floral and delicate at first, it opens into a lush, toasty and waxy whisky full of orchard and tropical fruit, pastry and honey.

Tasting Notes: Almond pastry, lemon meringue, apricot, pineapple, vanilla and honey.

Nose: Light and floral; almond-filled croissant, shortbread and lemon meringue pie, then apricot, melon, pineapple and plantain.

Palate: Lush and toasty, with sweet vanilla, tropical and orchard fruit, more lemon meringue and shortbread, honey and golden syrup.

Finish: Long, warm and spicy, with fading fruit, pastry and floral vanilla.

Serve: Neat, with a few drops of water if desired.

signatory-vintage-benrinnes-2012-58-9.title: Signatory Vintage Benrinnes 2012 10 Year Old 58.9%
signatory-vintage-benrinnes-2012-58-9.bodyHtml: A 2012 Benrinnes single malt from independent bottler Signatory Vintage that was matured in a first-fill bourbon hogshead for a decade, before being bottled in January 2023 as part of its Cask Strength Collection.

signatory-vintage-caol-ila-2007-53-7.title: Signatory Vintage Caol Ila 2007 53.7%
signatory-vintage-caol-ila-2007-53-7.bodyHtml:
Signatory Vintage Caol Ila 15 Year Old 2007 is an Islay single malt Scotch whisky from the Caol Ila distillery, independently bottled by Signatory Vintage. Distilled in 2007, it was bottled at 15 years of age, having spent the final 24 months of its maturation finishing in a first-fill Oloroso sherry butt. The sherry finish layers richer, darker cask character over the smoky Islay spirit Caol Ila is known for. It is bottled at 53.7% ABV in a 700ml bottle, a strength that rewards a little time in the glass and, if you like, a splash of water.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

signatory-caol-ila-2009-58-3.title: Signatory Caol Ila 2009 58.3%
signatory-caol-ila-2009-58-3.bodyHtml:
Signatory Caol Ila 2009 is an Islay single malt Scotch whisky distilled at Caol Ila in 2009 and bottled by the independent bottler Signatory Vintage at 58.3% ABV. Caol Ila stands near Port Askaig on the Sound of Islay, and independent releases like this one give a look at the distillery's spirit outside its own official range. 700ml.

Serve: At this strength, taste neat first, then add a few drops of water.

signatory-vinta-craigellachie-2012-67-4.title: Signatory Vinta Craigellachie 2012 67.4%
signatory-vinta-craigellachie-2012-67-4.bodyHtml:
Craigellachie 10 Year Old 2012 is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky from Signatory Vintage's Cask Strength Collection. Distilled on 4 September 2012, it spent a decade in a single first-fill Oloroso sherry butt, cask 900694, before being bottled on 12 January 2023 at a powerful natural cask strength of 67.4% ABV. The cask yielded just 610 bottles of 70cl, presented with natural colour in Signatory's distinctive decanter and tin. A powerful, sherried dram built for slow sipping and a splash of water.

Tasting Notes: Cinder toffee, dried fruit, dark chocolate, baking spice.

Nose: Cinder toffee, raisins, dates, candied citrus and oaky spice.

Palate: Warm toasted oak, a hint of furniture polish, treacle tart, dark chocolate and baking spice.

Finish: Orchard fruit with peppery spice.

Serve: Neat first, then with a little water to temper the strength and open up the sherry notes.

signatory-vintage-dailuaine-1997-48-2.title: Signatory Vintage Dailuaine 1997 48.2%
signatory-vintage-dailuaine-1997-48-2.bodyHtml:
Dailuaine 25 Year Old 1997 is a Speyside single malt bottled by independent bottler Signatory Vintage for its Cask Strength Collection. Distilled on 21 May 1997, it matured for 25 years in two hogsheads, casks 7249 and 7250, before being bottled on 23 November 2022 at a natural cask strength of 48.2% ABV. It carries natural colour, and only 397 numbered bottles were filled. Presented in a 700ml bottle with Signatory's black and copper tin, it is a rare, long-aged expression from one of Speyside's lesser-seen distilleries.

Tasting Notes: Orchard fruit, toasted nuts, vanilla, toffee and gentle oak spice.

Nose: Freshly peeled apples and toasted nuts with integrated cinnamon and freshly shaved oak.

Palate: Earthy vanilla with pistachio, toffee and black pepper; the oak is very well integrated.

Finish: Long, with soft oak and freshly baked ginger biscuits.

Serve: Neat, or with a drop of water.

tenuta-monteti-toscana.title: Tenuta Monteti 'Monteti' 2019
tenuta-monteti-toscana.bodyHtml:
The Tenuta Monteti 'Monteti' 2019 is a monumental, sophisticated, and deeply complex Super Tuscan red wine from an exceptional growing season. It pours a deep garnet-red color with intense violet reflections in the glass. The bouquet releases mysterious, savory aromas of black cherry, dark forest fruits, and juniper berries, beautifully layered with complex notes of cedar wood, cigar box, palo santo, graphite, and perfumed violets. On the palate, this full-bodied, low-yield blend is remarkably dense, juicy, and focused, enveloping the mouth with a rich fruit core and balsam undertones that reflect the steady, even ripening conditions of the 2019 vintage. Matured meticulously for 18 months in fine French oak (70% new) and cellared in the bottle for an additional 24 months without fining or filtering, its structural depth is sustained by a remarkable freshness and tightly woven, sparkling tannins that carry into a long, harmonious, and savory finish.
Food Pairing: This powerful, well-structured blend pairs beautifully with a wide range of premium or rustic culinary choices, including slow-cooked wild boar ragù over thick pasta, prime cuts of grilled ribeye steak with herbed butter, pan-seared veal chops, venison stew, and aged artisanal cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

92 Points - James Suckling

Nicely balanced between freshness and concentration. Aromas of spices, tobacco, earth and violets. On the palate, flavors of fresh cherries and black and red berries with a juicy middle and silky tannins. Good length. Sustainable. Drink now.

gran-centenario-anejo.title: Gran Centenario Añejo Tequila
gran-centenario-anejo.bodyHtml:
Crafted in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico, Gran Centenario Añejo is a historic 100% Weber Blue Agave spirit steeped in tradition since its creation in 1895 by Lazaro Gallardo. Produced using estate-grown agave cooked in traditional masonry ovens, crushed in roller mills, and double-distilled in copper pot stills, this expression utilizes the signature Selección Suave process. This proprietary technique involves blending hand-selected aged reserve batches to achieve exceptional smoothness. Aged for up to 36 months in new American oak barrels, it offers a harmonious profile where rich oak, toasted nuts, and sweet baking spices accent a soft cooked agave core.

Food Pairing: Grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised pork carnitas, dark chocolate tarts, aged Manchego cheese, churros with caramel sauce, or mole poblano.

Tasting Notes: Deep amber-gold with bright copper reflections, medium-heavy body, and smooth, slow-forming tears.

Nose: Rich and inviting, opening with toasted oak, warm vanilla bean, and sweet caramel, supported by dried fruits, subtle clove spice, and roasted agave.

Palate: Velvety, smooth, and well-rounded on the palate, featuring sweet butterscotch, toasted almonds, and cooked agave upfront before unfolding into layers of cinnamon, nutmeg, light oak tannins, and subtle chocolate.

Finish: Long, warm, and sweet with lingering notes of vanilla, gentle oak spice, and a soft, rounded agave finish.

Serve: Enjoy neat in a Glencairn or Riedel Tequila glass, over a single large ice sphere, or as a sophisticated base for a Tequila Old Fashioned or Mexican Manhattan.

emperador-light.title: Emperador Light Brandy
emperador-light.bodyHtml:
Emperador Light is the lighter-strength expression of Emperador, the best-known brandy brand of the Philippines. The front label describes it as a premium brandy liqueur made from spirits distilled from grapes, blended and bottled by Emperador Distillers, Inc. in Quezon City, and meticulously blended for an extra-smooth character, full body and a distinctive aroma. At 27.5% alcohol by volume it is noticeably gentler than a standard 40% brandy, which is why it is widely poured long with cola, soda or over ice rather than neat. This listing is the 750ml bottle, a product of the Philippines.

Serve: Over ice, or long with cola or soda water.

signatory-vintage-glen-grant-1995-49-1.title: Signatory Vintage Glen Grant 1995 27 Year Old 49.1%
signatory-vintage-glen-grant-1995-49-1.bodyHtml:
Glen Grant 1995 27 Year Old is a Speyside single malt bottled by independent bottler Signatory Vintage for its Cask Strength Collection. Distilled at Glen Grant in 1995, the whisky matured for 27 years in a pair of bourbon barrels, casks 88229 and 88235, which were bottled together in November 2022. The release ran to 384 numbered bottles at a natural cask strength of 49.1% ABV, without chill filtration or added colouring, in a 700ml bottle. At 27 years old, this vatting of two long-aged ex-bourbon barrels shows the distillery well into its third decade. A limited bottling aimed at collectors and fans of mature Speyside malt.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

signatory-vintage-glen-rothes-1996-53-6.title: Signatory Vintage Glenrothes 1996 53.6%
signatory-vintage-glen-rothes-1996-53-6.bodyHtml:
Glenrothes 1996 is a Speyside single malt Scotch whisky distilled at Glenrothes in 1996 and bottled by independent bottler Signatory Vintage. It is bottled at 53.6% ABV in a 700ml bottle. Signatory has released a number of single casks and cask pairs from Glenrothes' 1996 vintage, each with its own strength and character, and this bottling is one of them.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

signatory-vintage-glenburgie-1995-56-7.title: Signatory Vintage Glenburgie 1995 27 Year Old 56.7%
signatory-vintage-glenburgie-1995-56-7.bodyHtml:
Glenburgie 1995 27 Year Old is a Speyside single malt from independent bottler Signatory Vintage's Cask Strength Collection. Distilled at Glenburgie, west of Forres, in 1995, it spent 27 years in two hogsheads, casks 6667 and 6675, which were combined and bottled in July 2022. The outturn was 420 numbered bottles at a natural cask strength of 56.7% ABV, with no chill filtration and no added colouring, in a 700ml bottle. Official Glenburgie single malt releases are rare, so long-aged independent bottlings such as this are the usual way to taste the distillery on its own. A limited, full-strength bottling for collectors of mature Speyside whisky.

Serve: Neat, or with a little water to soften the strength.

signatory-vintage-glenlivet-2006-60-7.title: Signatory Vintage Glenlivet 2006 60.7%
signatory-vintage-glenlivet-2006-60-7.bodyHtml:
Glenlivet 16 Year Old 2006 is a single-cask Speyside single malt bottled by independent bottler Signatory Vintage for its Cask Strength Collection. Distilled on 15 August 2006, it spent 16 years in a single first-fill sherry butt, cask 900800, before being bottled on 23 November 2022 at a cask strength of 60.7% ABV. The cask yielded 626 numbered bottles, presented without added colouring or chill filtration in a 700ml bottle with Signatory's tin. Independent bottlings of Glenlivet are rarely seen, which makes this sherried single cask a notable find.

Tasting Notes: Honeyed baking, stewed fruit, milk chocolate and cocoa.

Nose: Toasted teacake with honey, frangipane and digestive biscuits.

Palate: Plum skin, stewed apple, milk chocolate and sultanas.

Finish: Ripe nectarine, figs and dusty cocoa.

Serve: Neat, adding a little water to tame the high strength if preferred.

signatory-vintage-ledaig-2005-64-9.title: Signatory Vintage Ledaig 2005 64.9%
signatory-vintage-ledaig-2005-64-9.bodyHtml:
Ledaig 17 Year Old 2005 is a single-cask single malt Scotch whisky bottled by independent bottler Signatory Vintage for its Cask Strength Collection. Distilled on 19 September 2005, it matured for 17 years in a single refill sherry butt, cask 900043, and was bottled on 28 September 2022 at a powerful cask strength of 64.9% ABV. The cask gave 463 numbered bottles, presented with natural colour in a 700ml bottle and Signatory's tin.

Serve: Neat with a splash of water; at this strength a little dilution helps it open up.

signatory-vintage-linkwood-1997-54-6.title: Signatory Vintage Linkwood 1997 25 Year Old 54.6%
signatory-vintage-linkwood-1997-54-6.bodyHtml:
Linkwood 1997 25 Year Old is a Speyside single malt from independent bottler Signatory Vintage's Cask Strength Collection. Distilled at Linkwood on 30 June 1997, it matured in two hogsheads, casks 7572 and 7573, which were married and bottled on 29 September 2022. The vatting produced 453 numbered bottles at a natural cask strength of 54.6% ABV, with natural colour, in a 700ml bottle presented in Signatory's black Cask Strength Collection tin. Each bottle is individually numbered, and with 25 years in two hogsheads this is a mature, well-documented bottling for collectors of Speyside single malt.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water.

signatory-vintage-port-dundas-1996-56-2.title: Signatory Vintage Port Dundas 1996 25 Year Old 56.2%
signatory-vintage-port-dundas-1996-56-2.bodyHtml:
Signatory Vintage Port Dundas 1996 25 Year Old is a single grain Scotch whisky from the Cask Strength Collection, drawn from a single hogshead, cask 128323. Distilled at Port Dundas in Glasgow on 24 September 1996, it was bottled on 20 July 2022 after a quarter century in wood, yielding 268 numbered bottles. It is presented at a cask strength of 56.2% ABV and natural colour in a 700ml bottle. Port Dundas was once one of Scotland's largest grain distilleries and has since closed, so mature single casks such as this are increasingly scarce.

Serve: Neat, or with a splash of water to temper the cask strength.

signatory-vintage-orkney-2005-55-6.title: Signatory Vintage Orkney 2005 17 Year Old 55.6%
signatory-vintage-orkney-2005-55-6.bodyHtml: A 2005-vintage Secret Orkney single malt from bottler Signatory Vintage that was made at a mystery distillery on the island and matured in a first-fill oloroso sherry butt for 17 years, before being bottled in January 2023 as part of its Cask Strength Collection.

signatory-vintage-speyside-2005-61-5.title: The Macallan Sherry Oak 12 Year Old
signatory-vintage-speyside-2005-61-5.bodyHtml:
The Macallan Sherry Oak 12 Years Old forms part of our Sherry Oak range which features a series of single malt whiskies matured exclusively in hand-picked sherry seasoned oak casks from Jerez for richness and complexity. A matured character, the 12 Years Old delivers rich wood spice and dried fruits and a natural rich gold color.

When matured exclusively in Oloroso sherry seasoned oak casks from Jerez, Spain, our rich, fruity and full bodied ‘new make’ spirit is transformed into a classic single malt. Once filled, the maturing spirit remains undisturbed in the same casks for 12 years and is brought together in this rich and complex whisky characterized by spice and dried fruit and a natural rich golden color.

signatory-vintage-unnamed-islay-51-9.title: Signatory Vintage Unnamed Islay 51.9%
signatory-vintage-unnamed-islay-51-9.bodyHtml:
Unnamed Islay 31 Year Old 1990 is a single-cask Islay single malt Scotch whisky from an undisclosed Islay distillery, bottled by independent bottler Signatory Vintage for its Cask Strength Collection. Distilled in 1990, it matured for 31 years in a single bourbon barrel, cask 4349, and was bottled in 2022 at a cask strength of 51.9% ABV. Only 259 numbered bottles were produced, each presented in a 700ml bottle with Signatory's tin. A rare, long-aged Islay malt from a highly regarded vintage.

Serve: Neat, or with a few drops of water.

signatory-vintag-bunnahabhain-1971-42-8.title: Signatory Vintag Bunnahabhain 1971 42.8%
signatory-vintag-bunnahabhain-1971-42-8.bodyHtml:
Bunnahabhain 46 Year Old 1971 is an exceptionally rare Islay single malt Scotch whisky from Signatory Vintage's Rare Reserve range within the Cask Strength Collection. Distilled on 8 April 1971, it matured for 46 years in a single hogshead, cask 2226, before being bottled on 24 July 2017 at its natural strength of 42.8% ABV. Only 95 bottles of 70cl were drawn, each presented in a Rare Reserve case, with natural colour and no chill filtration. Signatory Vintage was founded in 1988 by Andrew and Brian Symington and later acquired the Edradour distillery. A true collector's whisky.

Tasting Notes: Pineapple, mango, melon, sweet tropical fruit.

Nose: Sweet and fruity, with tropical fruit: pineapple, mango and melon.

Palate: Rich and fruity, with pineapple and melon.

Finish: Long.

Serve: Neat in a tulip glass; allow time in the glass and add water only sparingly, if at all.

absolut-limited-edition-2023.title: Absolut 2023 Limited Edition Vodka
absolut-limited-edition-2023.bodyHtml: Bold, original, creative. Absolut Vodka launched in New York, 1979. Our transparent bottle, inspired by an 18th Century medicine bottle, stood out from its tall, flashy, competitors. This was 1970s New York, after all. You had to be different to get noticed.

eisele-altagracia-araujo-mix-vintage-cs.title: Eisele Vineyard Altagracia Cabernet Sauvignon Mixed Vintage Case #1 6x750ml
eisele-altagracia-araujo-mix-vintage-cs.bodyHtml:
The Eisele Vineyard Altagracia Cabernet Sauvignon Mixed Vintage Case #1 is an ultra-exclusive, estate-curated OWC (Original Wooden Case) showcasing a horizontal and vertical journey of the estate’s secondary label.

Altagracia is crafted using the same rigorous biodynamic standards as the flagship Eisele Cabernet but leans on the property's eastern, volcanic hillside parcels and select younger blocks to deliver a more approachable, aromatically open style in its youth. These direct-from-winery mixed cases are typically released to allocation list members and premier global brokers, serving as a masterclass in how different Napa Valley growing seasons impact the estate’s distinct terroir.

What to Expect in the Case

  • The Format: Typically presented as an insulated, estate-branded 6-bottle wooden case ($6 \times 750\text{ml}$).

  • The Vintages: While "Case #2" focuses on a slightly later set of years, Case #1 typically groups a trio of highly acclaimed, foundational back-to-back vintages from the late 2010s (most frequently featuring two bottles each of 2017, 2018, and 2019).

  • The Experience: It highlights the fascinating contrast between the structural tension and freshness of a cooler year (like 2017), the textbook perfection and balance of an epic year (like 2018), and the opulent, sun-kissed, plush fruit profile of a warmer year (like 2019).

The Wine Profile (Altagracia Style)

  • The Bouquet: Remarkably perfumed and lifted. It reveals high-toned aromas of cassis, black raspberries, and red plums, layered beautifully with violet petals, sandalwood, tobacco leaf, and a distinct graphite/crushed volcanic rock minerality.

  • The Palate: Medium-to-full-bodied with an elegant, weightless feel compared to typical Napa blockbusters. It strikes a balance between rich dark fruit and savory spices (clove, cocoa powder, and cumin).

  • The Tannins: Supple and powdery, backed by a persistent line of fresh acidity that grants these vintages an open drinking window now while maintaining a solid 10 to 15-year cellaring potential.

tequila-cascahuin-11-brix-blanco-limited.title: Cascahuin Destino Blanco Limited Release Tequila
tequila-cascahuin-11-brix-blanco-limited.bodyHtml: An ultra-rare, high-proof blanco crafted for true agave purists. Destino Blanco blends six distinct distillations using traditional tahona, stone ovens, and wild fermentation techniques—all from 100% mature Blue Weber agave. Bottled at still strength and unfiltered, it delivers intense layers of roasted agave, peppery spice, citrus, and deep minerality. A bold, expressive tequila celebrating 70 years of Cascahuín heritage.

promontory-2018.title: Promontory 2018
promontory-2018.bodyHtml:
Just after fermentation, the 2018 vintage of Promontory already reflected the gentle, extended growing season, showing uncommonly detailed tannins. During its many months in the cellar, the wine has retained its effusive brightness and fresh acidity while continuing to acquire elevated nuance and bringing forward its many facets. Blue-fruit aromas, as well as pleasantly resinous qualities, accompany a fresh, cool note that rises to greet the nose. The wine’s lifted and profound dimension emanate outward from a center of almost ethereal form. Although the fine-grained tannins introduce an element of restraint to this translucent radiancy, the intrinsic nobility of this wine persists at each stage of its measured procession across the palate to the finish.

100 Points - James Suckling

Violets and blueberries with cloves and pine cones, following through to a medium to full body with tight, seamless tannins, like finely cut diamonds. It’s very closed and reserved at the end. Weightless. Needs plenty of time to open. Unique wine.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Promontory is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon; the estate has some Cabernet Franc planted, but it hasn't yet been utilized in the blend. Scents of crushed mint, ripe cherries and river stones mingle easily on the nose, while the medium to full-bodied palate is tense and fresh. This has what is fashionably described as "tension" in spades, then finishes long and silky. Give it some time in the cellar, and my rating my look stingy in a decade. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers a juicy, compact core of black currant and dried black cherry fruit mixed with dried sage, warm earth and roasted cedar. Shows a slightly rugged, old-school aspect at first glance, but with time in the glass this unwinds and reveals freshness and purity, albeit in a dark profile, with a riveting cast iron spine coursing through the finish. Best from 2024 through 2038.

le-pin-2012.title: Chateau Le Pin 2012
le-pin-2012.bodyHtml:
An iconic Pomerol displaying aromas of black cherry, plum, truffle, violet, cedar, tobacco, and dark chocolate. Silky and beautifully evolved, it offers extraordinary depth, seamless texture, refined elegance, and a remarkably persistent finish that defines one of Bordeaux's greatest wines.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, truffle risotto, venison, aged Gruyère, wild mushrooms, or filet mignon.

 

97 Points - James Suckling 

This is the essence of Le Pin with incredible silk texture and beautiful fruit. A berry, sweet-tobacco, chocolate and dusty undertone. It reminds me of many wonderful and underrated Le Pins of the 1980s like 1985 or 1986. What a wine. Better in 2018. But who can wait? Cystal clear. It’s like the 2001 that was always better than 2000.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate 

asted blind at the Southwold 2012 tasting, 2012 Le Pin put in a very strong performance. It has a strict, graphite-infused bouquet that is strangely Pauillac-like (not a trait I have noticed on other vintages; I wonder whether it is just a passing phase?). This is earthier than its peers, with hints of leather in the background and sous-bois aromas becoming more and more accentuated by time. The palate is medium-bodied with fine tannin, elegant and understated in style with a fine line of acidity, harmonious and thankfully not screaming and shouting towards the stylish finish. This is an outstanding wine from Jacques Thienpont that might well be unfairly over-shadowed by the 2009 and 2010. Tasted January 2016.

le-pin-2014.title: Chateau Le Pin 2014
le-pin-2014.bodyHtml:
An iconic Pomerol displaying aromas of black cherry, plum, truffle, violet, cedar, tobacco, and dark chocolate. Silky and beautifully evolved, it offers extraordinary depth, seamless texture, refined elegance, and a remarkably persistent finish that defines one of Bordeaux's greatest wines.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roast lamb, duck breast, truffle risotto, venison, aged Gruyère, wild mushrooms, or filet mignon.

 

98 Points - James Suckling

A ravishing red that pours out aromas of crushed raspberries, blueberries and dried flowers. Black truffle skins and undertones of violets. Full-bodied yet so tight and refined with incredible finesse and polish. The beauty and chic runs on for minutes on the finish. A truly endless and breathtakingly harmonious wine. It just rolls off the palate. Drink in 2022.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

This features a remarkable display of fruit, both fresh and steeped -- primarily raspberry, but with notes of blackberry and boysenberry as well -- all gliding through seamlessly while light anise, Lapsang souchong tea and roasted mesquite details underscore the finish. The texture is equally sublime. Best from 2020 through 2040. 348 cases made.

haut-brion.title: Chateau Haut Brion
haut-brion.bodyHtml:
Château Haut-Brion is one of Bordeaux's most legendary First Growth estates, renowned for its extraordinary complexity, finesse, and longevity. Profound aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, cedar, graphite, tobacco, truffle, and spice unfold over silky tannins and remarkable precision, culminating in an exceptionally long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing: Pair with beef Wellington, roasted lamb, venison, duck breast, black truffle dishes, wild mushrooms, or aged hard cheeses.

mouton-rothschild.title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild 2023
mouton-rothschild.bodyHtml: Château Mouton Rothschild 2023 is the grand vin of the Pauillac Premier Grand Cru Classé. A mild, wet winter refilled the soils after dry 2022, flowering went perfectly in late May, five days ahead of average, and June was the hottest the estate has recorded since 1962. Harvest ran from 7 to 30 September in changeable weather that alternated sunny days with storms. The blend is 93% Cabernet Sauvignon and 7% Merlot. The château describes a gleaming garnet-red wine with a crimson hue, ripe blackberry aromas with touches of pastry, candy and dark chocolate, a smooth, full-bodied palate on powerful, stylish tannins with lead pencil and smoky notes, and a long finish of toasted hazelnut and cocoa bean. 750ml, 14% ABV.

tragically-hip-fifty-mission-cab.title: Stoney Ridge The Tragically Hip Fifty Mission Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 750ml
tragically-hip-fifty-mission-cab.bodyHtml:
The newest wine offering from The Tragically Hip commemorates the 30th anniversary of their seminal album, Fully Completely which includes one of the band’s most popular songs: “50 Mission Cap”. The bands first wine, Fully Completely Reserve Red was originally produced to celebrate the 20th Anniversary of the album, 50 Mission Cab continues this tradition as the album reaches it 30 year milestone.  

Working in conjunction with guitarist Rob Baker, the label concept pays homage to the lyrics of 50 Mission Cap and celebrates the legacy and final flight of Toronto Maple Leafs legend, Bill Barilko. The artwork was derived from a hand carved linocut image created by a Canadian artist commissioned for this design.

Tasting Notes:

A robust Cabernet Sauvignon, deep ruby to garnet in colour. The nose showcases deep notes of black cherry, wild blueberry compote, plum, floral notes of violet and lavender, and smoky spicy notes of black pepper, anise and caramel. The palate is medium to full bodied with elegant flavours of cassis, raspberry, and blackberry jam with hints of cigar, savoury herbs, and a toasty oak finish. The wine has an elegant tannin structure giving the wine very good length on the finish. Recommended drinking 2023 – 2028.

Winemakers Notes:

A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon with a small amount of Merlot from 2 select vineyards in in the Niagara Peninsula. Fruit was harvested late October with good fruit flavour concentration and an average brix of 23°. Grapes were crushed and fermented in one tonne fermenter bins with daily manual punch-down of the caps. The wine was then racked into French oak barrels (30% new barrels, 40% 1 year old, 30 % seasoned) for 12 months prior to blending. 426 cases were bottled November 2022.

darioush-red-table-wine.title: Michael David Winery Freakshow Petite Petit 2022
darioush-red-table-wine.bodyHtml:
Michael David Winery Freakshow Petite Petit 2022 is a grandiose, booming, and larger-than-life red wine that perfectly captures the bold, playful spirit of Lodi winemaking. True to its name and its famous circus-elephant label, this is a show-stopping blend of two dark, deeply concentrated grape varieties: Petite Sirah and Petit Verdot. Saturated with an inky, near-opaque purple hue, it opens with powerful aromas of rich plum, boysenberry jam, and black cherry, interwoven with notes of sweet vanilla bean and dried violet petals. On the palate, it delivers a massive, full-bodied experience packed with velvety flavors of blackberry compote, dark cocoa nibs, and warm baking spices. Its thick, opulent texture is firmly held together by strong, structured tannins and a warming core, concluding with a long, satisfying, and deeply robust finish.

Food Pairing: Barbecued beef ribs, flame-grilled ribeye steak, slow-braised venison, hearty meat lasagna, or smoky pulled pork sliders.

91 Points - James Suckling

A show-stopping blend of two dark and tannic grape varieties, this monster of a red wine is potent in flavor and thick in texture. Blackberry, dried-blueberry, cocoa, graphite and cacao-bean flavors are firmly held by strong tannins. Petite sirah and petit verdot. Drink now or hold. Screw cap.

darioush-duel-cabernet-sauvignon-shiraz.title: Lion Creek Cabernet Sauvignon Shiraz
darioush-duel-cabernet-sauvignon-shiraz.bodyHtml:
Deep berry in colour, the wine opens with ripe cherry and a touch of white pepper. Fresh berries and plum carry through the palate alongside cedar undertones, finishing with warming spice and balanced structure.

Food Pairing: Grilled meats, beef stew, spicy pasta and hard cheeses.
